title: ' Ud
description: ' Ud The ' ud ( OOD ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument similar to both the lute or guitar . Because of its rich tone , the " ' ud " was often referred to as " amir al - tarab " which translated as " prince of enchantment " in Midani . Description .
description_long: ' Ud The ' ud ( OOD ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument similar to both the lute or guitar . Because of its rich tone , the " ' ud " was often referred to as " amir al - tarab " which translated as " prince of enchantment " in Midani . Description . An " ' ud " consisted of a short fretless neck attached to a widened pear - shaped body . This instrument typically had five double strings , though " ' uds " from the Free Cities of Zakhara had an extra string . The strings were plucked with a small pick made from bone or from the shaft of an eagle or roc feather . The body was made from wood , but it was not uncommon to see " ' uds " from the Crowded Sea region to have bodies made from a tortoise shell . History . The " ' ud " was a popular instrument among the wandering rawun of the Land of Fate .

title: ' Ud of the marids
description: ' Ud of the marids The ' ud of the marids was a beautiful magical " ' ud " created by marid luthiers to be presented to the new high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , therefore multiple " ' uds of the marids " existed throughout Zakhara . Description .
description_long: ' Ud of the marids The ' ud of the marids was a beautiful magical " ' ud " created by marid luthiers to be presented to the new high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , therefore multiple " ' uds of the marids " existed throughout Zakhara . Description . The entire body of this instrument was pure white and covered with intricate pearl carvings . The base , or soundbox , was actually made from a single giant pearl taken from one of the giant clam s of the Crowded Sea . Since collecting the giant pearl was a dangerous task , the marids wisely had lesser beings perform this task . Powers . This " ' ud " allowed the user to cast a strong " charm person " spell when the instrument was played . Bard s and " rawunin " could use this power twice per day , but all others could only access this magic once per day . Only bards and " rawunin " could " raise the waters " when playing the " ' ud of the marids " , summoning a powerful water elemental to do their bidding .

title: A - Ling Shan
description: A - Ling Shan The A - Ling Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . An extension of the great Yehimal , this mountain range divided the southern portion of Raurin from the Katakoro Plateau .
description_long: A - Ling Shan The A - Ling Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . An extension of the great Yehimal , this mountain range divided the southern portion of Raurin from the Katakoro Plateau . It also marked the northeastern and eastern borders of the kingdom of Ulgarth in the south . The Jumpa River flowed past the A - Ling Shan in the north - west . Description . Like its parent the Yehimal , the A - Ling Shan was a tangled labyrinth of high , ice - capped peaks . The frozen peaks of this range , most notably the Mahamsaratsu Shan in the east , reached high into the sky . Most reached elevations of between 17 , 000 and 24 , 000 ft . ( 5200 – 7300 m ) . The A - Ling Shan was among the " high peaks " category of the ranges of the Hordelans , which were typically formed from folded and upthrust granite , with jagged profiles . Several notable glaciers , including the Shigatse Glacier and the Glacier of the Dragon , were found within the A - Ling Shan range . The glaciers crept at almost the very sides of range . Lakes from glacial run - off formed at the base of the mountains as melting snow and ice were trapped by rocky depressions .

title: A Discovery of the World
description: A Discovery of the World A Discovery of the World , also called A Description of the World , was a book written by Vilhiard of Procampur , a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir . It told of his travels into the Hordelands and other lands of the East , and described all the lands he explored and the customs of the peoples he met , such as the Tuigan . The book was written with the Thorass script in a corresponding archaic language and older spellings for Tuigan terms , such as naming them " Taangan " .
description_long: A Discovery of the World A Discovery of the World , also called A Description of the World , was a book written by Vilhiard of Procampur , a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir . It told of his travels into the Hordelands and other lands of the East , and described all the lands he explored and the customs of the peoples he met , such as the Tuigan . The book was written with the Thorass script in a corresponding archaic language and older spellings for Tuigan terms , such as naming them " Taangan " . It was an illuminated manuscript ; that is , it contained painted images . Vilhiard wrote his book after carrying out a number of missions to the East on the orders of his Hierarch , telling of all that he saw and discovered on his journeys . Though his observations were generally accurate , he also saw many strange things he could not fully explain , either in amazement or for lacking the right words , which led to some clumsy descriptions in his work . This , combined with some rough abridgements of his book , lead to number of inaccurate tales of his exploits , which became confused with even less accurate tales from other travelers .

title: A History of the Tuigan
description: A History of the Tuigan Observations of the Tuigan Historian , Recording the Life of Yamun Khahan from his Rise to his Death in the Lands of the West , from Notes made for King Azoun of Cormyr , with the tentatively shortened title of A History of the Tuigan , was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR . Following his " Life among the Tuigan " , Koja expanded his notes into his new book , aiming to give a complete account of Yamun Khahan , the Tuigan people , and their history . He wrote much of the book while staying at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast , and was close to finishing it in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR .
description_long: A History of the Tuigan Observations of the Tuigan Historian , Recording the Life of Yamun Khahan from his Rise to his Death in the Lands of the West , from Notes made for King Azoun of Cormyr , with the tentatively shortened title of A History of the Tuigan , was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR . Following his " Life among the Tuigan " , Koja expanded his notes into his new book , aiming to give a complete account of Yamun Khahan , the Tuigan people , and their history . He wrote much of the book while staying at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast , and was close to finishing it in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . He planned to quote a non - magical sutra from the " Yanitsava " at the beginning , to invoke Furo ' s blessing . The temple of Deneir was willing to make copies of the " History " and send it to all their fellow temples across the Heartlands .

title: A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt
description: A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt A Reader ' s Guide to R .
description_long: A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt is a guide written by Philip Athans in cooperation with R . A . Salvatore which was published by Wizards of the Coast , Inc . in August 2008 to celebrated twenty Years of The Legend of Drizzt Saga . The book is a large reference book detailing the characters , items , and locations within R . A Salvatore ' s novels . Their book is printed in color with numerous detailed maps and illustrations .

title: AD & D Trading Cards
description: AD & D Trading Cards AD & D Trading Cards or Collector Cards were a series of trading cards published by TSR , Inc . between 1991 and 1993 . The cards adhere to 2nd - edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , and were released in three separate yearly series .
description_long: AD & D Trading Cards AD & D Trading Cards or Collector Cards were a series of trading cards published by TSR , Inc . between 1991 and 1993 . The cards adhere to 2nd - edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , and were released in three separate yearly series . Description . The " AD & D Trading Cards " were released in three yearly sets between 1991 and 1993 . Each set consists of two different series , and the 1992 and 1993 sets feature additional promotional and rare cards in addition to the main set . Cards . Each individual card has the dimensions 63 × 88 mm ( 2 . 5 × 3 . 5 inches ) , and is printed on cardboard , with the exception of promotional cards included with issues of " Dragon " magazine . The front of each card features art , either re - used from other TSR products , or original to the " Trading Cards " . The art is outlined by a thick , solid - color border , the color of which varies depending on series and / or rarity . History . The " AD & D Trading Cards " were first introduced by TSR employee James Ward in issue # 160 of " Dragon " magazine , as an insert of 17 cards .

title: Aalangama Gulderhorn
description: Aalangama Gulderhorn Lady Aalangama Gulderhorn was Countess of Morninggold , Title Chancellor of Tethyr , Marquise Scion of Siamorphe , and commander and one of the founders of the Order of the Silver Chalice . She was also the unofficial Crown Ecclesiastic of Tethyr . Description .
description_long: Aalangama Gulderhorn Lady Aalangama Gulderhorn was Countess of Morninggold , Title Chancellor of Tethyr , Marquise Scion of Siamorphe , and commander and one of the founders of the Order of the Silver Chalice . She was also the unofficial Crown Ecclesiastic of Tethyr . Description . Aalangama appeared much older than she actually was , because of her level of stress and hard work . Personality . Aalangama had a driven personality . She was also somewhat of a chatterbox , her favorite topic being matters of religion and politics . This personality trait was bothersome to Malcor Grannox , the Count of Ithmonn . She was impatient and grew easily frustrated with hypocrisy among the nobles who pretended to be religious . Relationships . Aalangama had been married and had a son and a daughter , but she was a widow by 1370 DR . Responsibilities . As Countess of Morninggold and commander of the Order of the Silver Chalice , Lady Aalangama saw to the defense of the eastern borders of Tethyr . As Title Chancellor , the countess oversaw matters of hereditary ascension and records .

title: Aarakocra
description: Aarakocra Aarakocras ( æ - ra - KO - kras ) were a race of avian monstrous humanoid s . Appearance . Aarakocras resembled humanoid birds .
description_long: Aarakocra Aarakocras ( æ - ra - KO - kras ) were a race of avian monstrous humanoid s . Appearance . Aarakocras resembled humanoid birds . The average specimen stood about 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) tall and had a wingspan of 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) . Halfway along the edge of each wing was a hand with three human - sized fingers and an opposable thumb . An elongated fourth finger extended the length of the wing and locked in place during flight . The hands could not grasp while flying , but they were nearly as useful as human hands when an aarakocra was perched and its wings folded back . Their powerful legs ended in four sharp talons that could unlock and fold back to reveal another pair of functional hands . These humanoids had hollow , fragile bones . Their faces combined the features of both parrot s and eagle s . They had gray - black beaks and black eyes . Plumage color varied , but males generally had red , orange , and yellow coloration , while females tended towards brown and gray . Society . Aarakocras lived among the highest mountain peaks in small tribes that controlled hunting territories and shared a communal nest .

title: Aarin Gend
description: Aarin Gend Aarin Gend was Lord Nasher ' s personal spymaster and played a part in protecting Neverwinter through the Wailing Death , the Cult of the Eye ' s plots and attack from Luskan . Description . A large human man with dark skin and hair .
description_long: Aarin Gend Aarin Gend was Lord Nasher ' s personal spymaster and played a part in protecting Neverwinter through the Wailing Death , the Cult of the Eye ' s plots and attack from Luskan . Description . A large human man with dark skin and hair . Personality . As spymaster , he was determined and ambitious to succeed despite the consequences whilst he kept a calm , and at times witty , exterior . He also struggled with his loyalties and worried deeply about repeating a situation where he would have to choose between his work for Lord Nasher and his heart , but ultimately he always chose the greater good for Neverwinter . Abilities . As a rogue , Aarin had high persuasive skills , use of a blade and high stealth ability . He also could forge documents . During his time in Neverwinter , he showed skills in leadership and assisted in saving Neverwinter and its inhabitants . Possessions . Owned an amulet which he would have given away as a sign of his love for the recipient . Relationships . Aarin was an ally to Aribeth de Tylmarande and did his best efforts to find her when she was missing before ultimately discovering her betrayal and fighting against her .

title: Aaronarra
description: Aaronarra Aaronarra was an old copper dragon living on the western side of the High Moor , near the Misty Forest . He was around 700 years old in 1368 DR and had a bad attitude . For food , he selected creatures whose populations could reasonably be reduced , such as goblin s .
description_long: Aaronarra Aaronarra was an old copper dragon living on the western side of the High Moor , near the Misty Forest . He was around 700 years old in 1368 DR and had a bad attitude . For food , he selected creatures whose populations could reasonably be reduced , such as goblin s .

title: Aarun
description: Aarun Aarun was a Harper in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Aarun was a member of the Harpers based in Ten Towns .
description_long: Aarun Aarun was a Harper in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Aarun was a member of the Harpers based in Ten Towns . In 1485 DR , he grew suspicious about Vaelish Gant and his minions . Aarun discovered that Vaelish ' s minions were wererat s of Ship Rethnor and contacted fellow Harper Emryn Dawe in Luskan , requesting silver weapons . Emryn promised to send them in the next shipment but , in the meantime , Vaelish discovered Aarun ' s true nature . He faked a letter from Mithann , leading him into an ambush , where he murdered Aarun . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Aarun died before the start of the adventure .

title: Aasim
description: Aasim Aasim was an elven sha ' ir living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Aasim was responsible for inspecting all of the cargo at the wharf in Bandar al - Sa ' adat .
description_long: Aasim Aasim was an elven sha ' ir living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Aasim was responsible for inspecting all of the cargo at the wharf in Bandar al - Sa ' adat . Relationships . He was the brother - in - law of Mahmud Ben Aziz .

title: Aasim al - Nazi
description: Aasim al - Nazi Aasim al - Nazi was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Aasim was an honest man who was completely devoted to his work .
description_long: Aasim al - Nazi Aasim al - Nazi was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Aasim was an honest man who was completely devoted to his work . Activities . Aasim was responsible for the treasury of the Golden Mosque . He organized and allocated all funds , both magical and mundane , that were donated to the mosque from the faithful . This money was used for general maintenance as well as to help the hospices located throughout the city . History . Aasim once caught a thief who was shrunk and placed into a bottle and donated to the mosque as a genie . She was caught sneaking a backpack full of treasure from the mosque but did not survive the encounter .

title: Aasimar
description: Aasimar Aasimar , derived from the Mulhorand i word " aasimon " , were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that had in their blood some good , otherworldly characteristics . They were often , but not always , descended from angel s and other creatures of pure good alignment , but while predisposed to good alignments , aasimar were by no means always good . Description .
description_long: Aasimar Aasimar , derived from the Mulhorand i word " aasimon " , were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that had in their blood some good , otherworldly characteristics . They were often , but not always , descended from angel s and other creatures of pure good alignment , but while predisposed to good alignments , aasimar were by no means always good . Description . Aasimar bore the mark of their celestial touch through many different physical features that often varied from individual to individual . Most commonly , aasimar were very similar to humans , like tieflings and other planetouched . Nearly all aasimar were uncommonly beautiful and still , and they were often significantly taller than humans as well . While several aasimar were immediately identifiable as such , others were even less distinguishable than tieflings from their human ancestors , commonly standing out with only one unusual feature . Most aasimar had pupil - less pale white , gray , or golden eyes or silver hair , but those descended from planetar s could also have emerald skin , while those descended from avoral celestials might have feathers mixed in with their hair .

title: Ab ' i
description: Ab ' i Ab ' i was a plant that grew in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Viewed from the surface , ab ' i looked like tall brown grass .
description_long: Ab ' i Ab ' i was a plant that grew in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Viewed from the surface , ab ' i looked like tall brown grass . The succulent blood red tubers of this plant lay around 3 feet ( 0 . 9 meters ) underground . These tubers were edible and contained up to a gallon ( 3 . 8 liters ) of fresh water .

title: Aba
description: Aba An aba ( pronounced AH - bah ) was a sleeveless , light fabric robe or cloak worn by men and women to protect against the elements , common to peoples from desert climes , such as Calishite s , Zakharan s , or the Bedine . Variants . A heavier , more expensive type of aba , called a " jellaba " was worn in winter .
description_long: Aba An aba ( pronounced AH - bah ) was a sleeveless , light fabric robe or cloak worn by men and women to protect against the elements , common to peoples from desert climes , such as Calishite s , Zakharan s , or the Bedine . Variants . A heavier , more expensive type of aba , called a " jellaba " was worn in winter .

title: Aba of the desert
description: Aba of the desert The aba of the desert was a magical garment that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Aba s " were light robes or cloaks in Zakhara .
description_long: Aba of the desert The aba of the desert was a magical garment that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Aba s " were light robes or cloaks in Zakhara . Powers . Wearing one of these items granted the wearer all of the effects of the " cool strength " spell , which was a very useful feature for the desert tribes . The wearer could not use this item with any armor heavier than leather armor . Cultural Note . A desert tribe in possession of one of these magical garments often allowed their aged , ill , or pregnant tribe members to use them in order to ease their strains .

title: Aba of the elements
description: Aba of the elements An aba of the elements was a magic robe found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The coloration of an " aba of the elements " depended on the element it represented with flame being red , wind being blue , sand being white , and sea being green .
description_long: Aba of the elements An aba of the elements was a magic robe found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The coloration of an " aba of the elements " depended on the element it represented with flame being red , wind being blue , sand being white , and sea being green . Powers . An " aba of the elements " had similar in powers to " robes of the archmagi " , save that they were classified by the element they represented . An elemental mage who donned an " aba of the elements " for any element outside of his speciality suffered excruciating pain and a permanent loss of some of their skills . A sorcerer could safely wear one of these robes for either of their two chosen elements . An " aba of the elements " granted the wearer magic resistance and made them more difficult to strike during combat . It amplified elemental spells cast by the wearer so that the target of these spells was less likely to resist their effects .

title: Aballister Bonaduce
description: Aballister Bonaduce Aballister Bonaduce was a wizard and head of the Triumvirate of Castle Trinity . Aballister Bonaduce was the nemesis of his son Cadderly Bonaduce . Calculating , cold , and merciless , Aballister did everything to see his quest for the Chaos Curse completed .
description_long: Aballister Bonaduce Aballister Bonaduce was a wizard and head of the Triumvirate of Castle Trinity . Aballister Bonaduce was the nemesis of his son Cadderly Bonaduce . Calculating , cold , and merciless , Aballister did everything to see his quest for the Chaos Curse completed . Guided by the goddess Talona , Mistress of Poison , Aballister created the Chaos Curse and unleashed it upon the Edificant Library , home of Cadderly and his friends . History . Not much was known of Aballister ' s previous life before he created the Chaos Curse . He spent some time at the Edificant Library after he left Carradoon , though he was asked to leave because of his desires and choices in the use of his magical arts . When he was expelled , he left his son at the library under the care of Headmaster Avery Schell , who became a father figure to young Cadderly . He was killed by Cadderly in a spell duel on another plane of existence . Relations . Aballister ' s familiar was the imp Druzil , who himself held the wizard in distaste .

title: Aban al - Hadhar
description: Aban al - Hadhar Aban al - Hadhar was a gnome barber who lived in Hawa . Description . Aban possessed a loud voice and could usually be heard at any time in the cities ' Free Market .
description_long: Aban al - Hadhar Aban al - Hadhar was a gnome barber who lived in Hawa . Description . Aban possessed a loud voice and could usually be heard at any time in the cities ' Free Market . He favored speaking quickly and it was said his razors were almost as fast as his speech . Activities . Aban was a wealth of information and always seemed to be aware of important gossip and news . He was an excellent source of tips for travelers willing to provide an appropriate tip in exchange .

title: Abarax
description: Abarax Abarax was a pit fiend that managed to depose and assume the identity of Lord Orgauth until he was slain by Scyllua Darkhope . Description . Abarax in his true form stood 12ft ( 3 .
description_long: Abarax Abarax was a pit fiend that managed to depose and assume the identity of Lord Orgauth until he was slain by Scyllua Darkhope . Description . Abarax in his true form stood 12ft ( 3 . 6m ) tall . History . Abarax had been summoned and imprisoned by one of Lord Orgauth ' s mages until 1368 DR when armies sent by Cyric attacked Zhentil Keep . During the attack , the mage who had imprisoned Abarax was killed and the pit fiend managed to escape his bonds . Once free , Abarax stumbled across the body of Lord Orgauth , who had died whilst trying to return to his family . Abarax disposed of his body and hatched a plan to take on the dead lord ' s identity by transforming into his form . Later , Abarax " gate d " in an erinyes ally named Eshaeris to pose as a courtesan named Desmonda , who ' d vanished in the siege . Only they knew eachother ' s secret identities . Together , they used their magic to befuddle the various nobles and lords , leaving them rulers of Zhentil Keep . Abarax ruled absolutely until , one cold winter night in 1370 DR , Scyllua Darkhope sought out and confronted " Lord Orgauth " .

title: Abas for All
description: Abas for All Abas for All was a shop located in the Clothiers ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Abas for All sold a wide variety of hand - crafted aba s .
description_long: Abas for All Abas for All was a shop located in the Clothiers ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Abas for All sold a wide variety of hand - crafted aba s . They specialized in selling abas depicting dragon s and wyvern s since no other clothier in Huzuz could accturately depict the beasts on cloth . Inhabitants . Gundar Silvershine owned and operated this establishment .

title: Abazigal
description: Abazigal Abazigal was one of The Five , the loosely allied group of powerful Bhaalspawn who rose to prominence during the time of the fulfillment of Alaundo ' s prophecy about the children of Bhaal . Apparently the offspring of Bhaal and a blue dragon , he could assume the form of either a humanoid hybrid with reptilian features , or a powerful blue dragon . He had his lair in a cavern complex somewhere in Tethyr and may have been amassing an " army " of dragons , though this was only implied .
description_long: Abazigal Abazigal was one of The Five , the loosely allied group of powerful Bhaalspawn who rose to prominence during the time of the fulfillment of Alaundo ' s prophecy about the children of Bhaal . Apparently the offspring of Bhaal and a blue dragon , he could assume the form of either a humanoid hybrid with reptilian features , or a powerful blue dragon . He had his lair in a cavern complex somewhere in Tethyr and may have been amassing an " army " of dragons , though this was only implied . He had as servants an enslaved green dragon , his son Draconis , and a number of lesser creatures such as water weird s and a greater werewyvern . In humanoid form , he used Gram the Sword of Grief in battle .

title: Abbalaya
description: Abbalaya The Abbalayar ( singular Abbalaya ) were a tribe of human s in Calimshan known and feared for their divinatory powers . They were so unique both magically and physically that they were often considered a distinct subrace of human . Etymology .
description_long: Abbalaya The Abbalayar ( singular Abbalaya ) were a tribe of human s in Calimshan known and feared for their divinatory powers . They were so unique both magically and physically that they were often considered a distinct subrace of human . Etymology . The name " Abbalayar " came from Mount Abbalayat , the holy peak in the Marching Mountains from which all Abbalayar hailed . Description . Abbalayar appeared human at first glance , but upon closer inspection , their distinctive physical qualities became apparent . The strangest feature was their second eyelid . This eyelid was transparent and could shield an Abbalaya from a number of ill effects , such as both natural and magical blinding effects and even the gaze attacks of monsters . All Abbalayar also possessed an extra bone in each finger , which provided them with an extra elegance when casting spells with somatic component s . Abbalayar had pale skin like humans from the north , in stark contrast to the dusky - and tan - skinned Calishite s and Tethyrian s living around them . Their skin also had a subtle red tint to it .

title: Abbathor
description: Abbathor Abbathor ( ÆB - ba - thor ) , also known as the Great Master of Greed , was the neutral evil dwarven god of greed before becoming an exarch of Bane . He was an intensely greedy deity and was both desirous and envious of others ' riches . Abbathor and his followers believed in the acquisition of all forms of wealth by any and all means necessary .
description_long: Abbathor Abbathor ( ÆB - ba - thor ) , also known as the Great Master of Greed , was the neutral evil dwarven god of greed before becoming an exarch of Bane . He was an intensely greedy deity and was both desirous and envious of others ' riches . Abbathor and his followers believed in the acquisition of all forms of wealth by any and all means necessary . Worshipers . Abbathor ' s priests dressed in red leather armor and leather caps . His holy days were on the solar eclipse and he demanded the sacrifice of both blood and gem s annually . Relationships . Abbathor ' s relations with his fellow dwarven deities were strained , but he was not cast out of the pantheon .

title: Abbey of St . Sollars
description: Abbey of St . Sollars The Abbey of Saint Sollars was the temple of Ilmater in Bloodstone Village , Damara . Structure .
description_long: Abbey of St . Sollars The Abbey of Saint Sollars was the temple of Ilmater in Bloodstone Village , Damara . Structure . The Abbey was a medium - sized building made up of an entrance hall , central sanctuary , a bell tower , and a parish house . The entrance hall opened to the outside by way of two large wooden doors . The sanctuary was the largest room of the structure . It was the central place of worship and contained several rows of wooden pews , a high arched buttressed ceiling , and a large altar on a raised dais . The Book of Saint Sollars laid open on the altar . Behind the altar , stained glass windows let light shine down upon the altar . The bell tower contained four floors with two large bells at the top . The parish house was attached to the side of the abbey and was where the resident abbot dwelt . It contained a small library of theological works , a copying room for scribing manuscripts , and four cells for the abbot and his assistants . Inhabitants . Abbot Aldric was the current senior priest at the Abbey of Saint Sollars . History . The abbey was named after Sollars the Twice - Martyred , considered a saint by the Church of Ilmater .

title: Abbey of the Just Hammer
description: Abbey of the Just Hammer The Abbey of the Just Hammer was an abbey in Tasseldale , in the Dalelands , dedicated to Tyr . It was positioned close to the River Ashaba . The abbey ' s focus was upon the justice element of Tyr ' s portfolio and provided legal education for free .
description_long: Abbey of the Just Hammer The Abbey of the Just Hammer was an abbey in Tasseldale , in the Dalelands , dedicated to Tyr . It was positioned close to the River Ashaba . The abbey ' s focus was upon the justice element of Tyr ' s portfolio and provided legal education for free . As of 1372 DR , the Abbey lacked numbers due to the drow threat in the north . On 22 Mirtul 1373 DR , the Abbey was attacked by the green dragon Sirvinhandra , who was defeated by Lord High Justiciar High Avenger Deren Eriach .

title: Abbey of the Rose
description: Abbey of the Rose The Abbey of the Rose was a secret temple in shadovar - dominated Sembia . It was located near the river Draal before it joined the river Arkhen , east of the Thunder Peaks . Once it was a temple to Mask .
description_long: Abbey of the Rose The Abbey of the Rose was a secret temple in shadovar - dominated Sembia . It was located near the river Draal before it joined the river Arkhen , east of the Thunder Peaks . Once it was a temple to Mask . It was made invisible from the shadovar thank to the spirit s of Elgrin Fau . However in 1484 DR the Oracle released the spirits and so Sayeed and Zeeahd invaded the Abbey with their pack of spined devil s .

title: Abbey of the Sword
description: Abbey of the Sword The Abbey of the Sword was a large temple to Tempus in Battledale , which was built atop a network of caverns leading to " portals " to the Underdark . Leadership . The abbey ' s founder , Eldan Ambrose led the abbey until his death during a battle with drow .
description_long: Abbey of the Sword The Abbey of the Sword was a large temple to Tempus in Battledale , which was built atop a network of caverns leading to " portals " to the Underdark . Leadership . The abbey ' s founder , Eldan Ambrose led the abbey until his death during a battle with drow . After Ambrose ' s death , the abbey was led by Priest - General Gorym Harndrekker who commanded two companies of fifty warriors each . Each company was led by a First Sword . History . The temple was founded by an Amnian priest named Eldan Ambrose shortly after the Time of Troubles . Ambrose followed a vision of Tempus to a long abandoned castle five miles southwest of Essembra . He rebuilt the castle and established the abbey on the site . Over the next decade the abbey established an alliance with Battledale and worked to clear the surrounding area of its monstrous inhabitants . During this period they discovered portals to the Underdark . In 1371 DR a force of drow slipped through an unknown portal and attacked the abbey . Eldan Ambrose was killed in the attack but the portal was destroyed .

title: Abdel Adrian
description: Abdel Adrian Abdel Adrian was a male human Bhaalspawn and a mercenary warrior . He became tangled in the sinister plans of a number of other Bhaalspawn , as well as of Jon Irenicus , but emerged victorious . Appearance .
description_long: Abdel Adrian Abdel Adrian was a male human Bhaalspawn and a mercenary warrior . He became tangled in the sinister plans of a number of other Bhaalspawn , as well as of Jon Irenicus , but emerged victorious . Appearance . During his adventuring career , Abdel was almost 7 feet ( 2 . 13 m ) tall with ink - black hair that he kept long . He had dark eyes and made sure to keep his tanned face clean shaven . In 1479 DR , Abdel appeared to be in his sixtieth year despite being well over a century old . He had lost none of his obvious strength or stature but his hair had begun to turn grey and his face appeared more wizened . Equipment . Abdel wielded a broadsword which he kept strapped to his back and wore a chain mail tunic . His prized possession was a magical dagger , given to him by Gorion as a coming - of - age gift , though Abdel remained oblivious to its magical nature . Biography . Early life . Abdel was rescued from a group of deathstalker s by the Hands of Loyal Fury . The order of paladin s knew of his lineage and wished him destroyed , but their leader , Sir Daesric the Pious , could not bring himself to allow the killing of an infant .

title: Abeir
description: Abeir Abeir was the twin planet of Toril , located in the same material plane of its sibling world , but within a " pocket dimension " that was out of synchrony with Toril . Abeir revolved around the same sun of Realmspace , although from Abeir the sun was seen as blue colored . Abeir shared the lunar satellite Selûne and its Tears with Toril .
description_long: Abeir Abeir was the twin planet of Toril , located in the same material plane of its sibling world , but within a " pocket dimension " that was out of synchrony with Toril . Abeir revolved around the same sun of Realmspace , although from Abeir the sun was seen as blue colored . Abeir shared the lunar satellite Selûne and its Tears with Toril . Geography . Abeir had steel - colored sky due to the arambar , the residue energy left by the death of the primordial of the same name . The only known continents of Abeir were Shyr and Laerakond . For a time , Maztica was also part of this world . Inhabitants . Abeir was inhabited primarily by primordials , dragon s , dragonborn , dwarves , genasi , halfling s , human s , and a few other races that also inhabited Toril . Like Toril , it also contained an Underdark inhabited by drow . Aside from drow , elves and other fey creatures were almost unheard of in Abeir . Magic . Magic manifested differently on Abeir than in Toril , as there was no Weave and no normal ways to contact any god s , as gods were wary about this world .

title: Abeir - Toril
description: Abeir - Toril Abeir - Toril ( Ai - BEER - toh - RILL ) was the name of a prehistoric planet that existed before - 31000 DR when Ao sundered the world into two worlds : Abeir and Toril . The name was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " . Geography .
description_long: Abeir - Toril Abeir - Toril ( Ai - BEER - toh - RILL ) was the name of a prehistoric planet that existed before - 31000 DR when Ao sundered the world into two worlds : Abeir and Toril . The name was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " . Geography . The shape of the planet was very different from either modern Abeir or modern Toril , consisting of one massive supercontinent known as Merrouroboros , which was dominated by the giantkin and the mysterious Creator race s . History . Abeir - Toril was one of many worlds that appeared after Ao crafted Realmspace out of the Phlogiston . Though barren and devoid of life , creatures of manifest entropy and elemental nature known as the primordial s began to appear in Realmspace , coveting those worlds . Unknown to the primordials , the first gods also began to appear in Realmspace . Selûne and Shar were the first ones , and they began to create life on the world of Abeir - Toril , creating the goddess Chauntea and the sun to sustain that life .

title: Abeiran Underdark
description: Abeiran Underdark The Abeiran Underdark was the equivalent of Toril ' s Underdark on the world of Abeir . Other than it was inhabited by drow and mysterious monsters , nothing more was known about this region . A portion of the Abeiran Underdark was transported to Toril alongside Laerakond during the Blue Breath of Change .
description_long: Abeiran Underdark The Abeiran Underdark was the equivalent of Toril ' s Underdark on the world of Abeir . Other than it was inhabited by drow and mysterious monsters , nothing more was known about this region . A portion of the Abeiran Underdark was transported to Toril alongside Laerakond during the Blue Breath of Change .

title: Aberration
description: Aberration Aberrations were creatures from or touched by the Far Realm , thereby making them utterly alien to the Prime Material Plane , the fundamental plane s , the parallel plane s , or any other regions of the local cosmology . Aberrations generally all had bizarre anatomies , strange abilities , alien mindsets , or any combination thereof . Most aberrations had darkvision out to 60 feet .
description_long: Aberration Aberrations were creatures from or touched by the Far Realm , thereby making them utterly alien to the Prime Material Plane , the fundamental plane s , the parallel plane s , or any other regions of the local cosmology . Aberrations generally all had bizarre anatomies , strange abilities , alien mindsets , or any combination thereof . Most aberrations had darkvision out to 60 feet . As a group , they had no other special abilities or immunities .

title: Abishai
description: Abishai Abishai ( ÆB - i - shy ) were medium - sized baatezu devil s from the first two circles of the Nine Hells , who were servants of Tiamat . They were guards and torturers . Description .
description_long: Abishai Abishai ( ÆB - i - shy ) were medium - sized baatezu devil s from the first two circles of the Nine Hells , who were servants of Tiamat . They were guards and torturers . Description . They resembled cornugon s , the only difference was their color and the size . They could be found in various colors : red , white , black , green and blue . Combat . In battle , they relied on their claws , but the elder ones could possess some magic abilities , such as opening a gate between the Nine Hells and the Prime Material Plane , and some lesser confusing spells . History . During the Time of Troubles , a group of thirteen abishai were marooned in Unther . The Cult of the Dragon in Unther considered this a blessing from Tiamat . Each of the thirteen maintained a lair in the Underdark below the city of Unthalass . In truth , Tiamat did not send them as a blessing ; the thirteen enjoyed their freedom from serving Tiamat , and the high priest of the Cult was blackmailing them into following his orders lest he send them back to Tiamat in Hell .

title: Abjuration
description: Abjuration The abjuration school of magic encompassed protective spells . They created physical or magical barriers , negated magical or physical abilities , harmed trespassers , or even banished the subject of the spell to another plane of existence . The abjuration school had no subschools .
description_long: Abjuration The abjuration school of magic encompassed protective spells . They created physical or magical barriers , negated magical or physical abilities , harmed trespassers , or even banished the subject of the spell to another plane of existence . The abjuration school had no subschools . A wizard who specialized in abjuration was known as an abjurer . Some abjuration spells included " dispel magic " and " resist energy " .

title: Abjure undead
description: Abjure undead Abjure undead was a " channel divinity " prayer cast by avenger s . When an avenger cast " abjure undead " he or she pulled any undead within a 5 foot ( 1 . 5 m ) radius at least10 feet ( 3m ) toward themselves .
description_long: Abjure undead Abjure undead was a " channel divinity " prayer cast by avenger s . When an avenger cast " abjure undead " he or she pulled any undead within a 5 foot ( 1 . 5 m ) radius at least10 feet ( 3m ) toward themselves . Undead caught in the blast were momentarily paralyzed or , at the very least , seared by the severe light of the prayer .

title: Aboleth
description: Aboleth Aboleths ( ÆB - o - leths ) were a race of malevolent , eel - like aberration s with potent psionic abilities . Description . Aboleths were fish - like amphibians of immense size , often reaching 20 feet ( 6 .
description_long: Aboleth Aboleths ( ÆB - o - leths ) were a race of malevolent , eel - like aberration s with potent psionic abilities . Description . Aboleths were fish - like amphibians of immense size , often reaching 20 feet ( 6 . 1 meters ) in length and weighing up to 6 , 500 pounds ( 3000 kilograms ) , though they continued to grow as they aged and some fantastically ancient specimens might reach 40 feet ( 12 . 2 meters ) in length . They resembled a bizarre eel , with long , tubular bodies , as well as a tail at one end and two fins near the head and another along the back . Aboleths ' mouths were lamprey - like , filled with serrated , jawless teeth . Aboleth bodies were also segmented , like a worm or insect . Aboleth underbellies were often orange - pink , while their topsides were typically sea - green . A little bit back from the head were four long tentacles , two sprouting from across each other on the top , and two more of the same on the underbelly . Their heads were roughly triangular - shaped , with a spherical , somewhat beak - like nose . Above the nose were their three eyes , each one set atop the other .

title: Abolethic Sovereignty
description: Abolethic Sovereignty The Abolethic Sovereignty were the original aboleth s of the Realms , who dwelt in the flying , obelisk - shaped city of Xxiphu , that has existed since prehistoric times . The Abolethic Sovereignty originally came to Abeir - Toril when the world was young , when Xxiphu plummeted to the world and settled deep below what is now the Sea of Fallen Stars . The oldest - known aboleth and possibly the progenitor of the entire species , the Eldest , was an enormous creature that rested atop the city like a throne .
description_long: Abolethic Sovereignty The Abolethic Sovereignty were the original aboleth s of the Realms , who dwelt in the flying , obelisk - shaped city of Xxiphu , that has existed since prehistoric times . The Abolethic Sovereignty originally came to Abeir - Toril when the world was young , when Xxiphu plummeted to the world and settled deep below what is now the Sea of Fallen Stars . The oldest - known aboleth and possibly the progenitor of the entire species , the Eldest , was an enormous creature that rested atop the city like a throne . When Abeir - Toril was sundered into two twin planets , Abeir and Toril , the city of Xxiphu remained on Abeir . During the Spellplague , Xxiphu was transported to Faerûn , and the members of the Abolethic Sovereignty took great interested in the world of Toril . The main goal of the Abolethic Sovereignty was to unlock the Far Manifold with the " Key of Stars " and open the gate to the Far Realm to unleash their masters onto the world . They were also greatly interested in the effects of the Spellplague , and searched and studied areas of active Spellplague across Faerûn .

title: Abolethic Sovereignty ( series )
description: Abolethic Sovereignty ( series ) Abolethic Sovereignty is a trilogy of novels written by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary .
description_long: Abolethic Sovereignty ( series ) Abolethic Sovereignty is a trilogy of novels written by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary . Raidon Kane emerges from the Spellplague with a sapphire tattoo burned into his flesh , strange supernatural powers that aid him in fighting aberrant monstrosities such as aboleth s , and eleven missing years , spent encased in crystal . Everything he knew has changed . His daughter is dead , his home has been destroyed , and the world desperately needs his help . A nightmare empire bent on reducing the world to chaos , known as the Abolethic Sovereignty , has begun to stir . Meanwhile , a powerful artifact known as the Dreamheart is infecting weak minds with twisted dreams of power if only they serve its ancient , alien masters . As the corrupted fight over the Dreamheart and use it to their own ends , they unknowingly aid the Sovereignty in realizing its terrible aim . If Raidon is to have a chance at defeating the Sovereignty , he will need help . Guidance from an abandoned construct created to monitor and hold prisoner the high priest of the Sovereignty .

title: Abomination
description: Abomination Abominations were a loosely organized group of creatures of varying origin left over from the Dawn War between the god s and their primordial adversaries . Many abominations were either weapons forged for the purpose of destruction or creatures created out of the ashes of the war . Some were created purposefully by gods , others by primordials , and others were complete accidents , created inadvertently .
description_long: Abomination Abominations were a loosely organized group of creatures of varying origin left over from the Dawn War between the god s and their primordial adversaries . Many abominations were either weapons forged for the purpose of destruction or creatures created out of the ashes of the war . Some were created purposefully by gods , others by primordials , and others were complete accidents , created inadvertently . All were of either immortal or elemental origin and some shared aspects of both .

title: Abon Duum
description: Abon Duum Abon Duum was a human man and a pasha of Manshaka in Calimshan in the 14th century DR . History . For over half a century , Abon Duum ruled the city of Manshaka and its Arenas of Blood as a ruthless despot and crime - lord holding absolute power .
description_long: Abon Duum Abon Duum was a human man and a pasha of Manshaka in Calimshan in the 14th century DR . History . For over half a century , Abon Duum ruled the city of Manshaka and its Arenas of Blood as a ruthless despot and crime - lord holding absolute power . In his intrigue - laden court served Ralan el Pesarkhal , together with his scribe , Abbas el Quaahl . Some time before 1347 DR , a thief and con - artist named Conner approached Duum with a scam , in which he claimed that his young protégé Vajra Valmeyjar was the intended bride of Hoar , god of revenge . So impressed by Vajra that he was , Duum believed it — at first . But even after he came to doubt the tale , he still desired Vajra . Thus , when Conner ' s scheme at last went awry , he was forced to sell Vajra into slavery to Abon Duum , so that he could go free with their money . Duum placed Vajra with his stable of gladiators at the Arena of Blood , and she became the most accomplished and profitable of them . Meanwhile , six months later , Conner tried to rescue Vajra , but Duum ' s men beat him and left him for dead in the desert . Countless plans followed , all without success .

title: Aborana Startoucher
description: Aborana Startoucher Aborana Startoucher was a famous oracle and fortune teller in Memnon , before having to relocate to the Calling Horn in Beliard . History . Famous for her accuracy as a seer , Aborana would often give advice to those whose fortunes were less than pleasant .
description_long: Aborana Startoucher Aborana Startoucher was a famous oracle and fortune teller in Memnon , before having to relocate to the Calling Horn in Beliard . History . Famous for her accuracy as a seer , Aborana would often give advice to those whose fortunes were less than pleasant . One day , she read the fortune of a merchant , seeing an unholy and bloody death . This fate seemed to emanate from the Nether Regions , thus she was unable to advise the merchant around it . He cursed her and her family for this perceived slight ; many of whom died shortly thereafter . After escaping to the North , Aborana heard of the merchant ' s death at the hands of a multi - limbed abomination . Since she resettled in the Calling Horn Inn , Aborana became quite an avid book collector . She came across a small tome bound in scaly red leather . Members of the Kraken Society in Yartar were actively seeking this book , believing it to be within her possession . They constantly harassed her since discovering its whereabouts .

title: Abordabe
description: Abordabe Abordabe was the chieftain of the largest tribe in Narfell in 1359 DR , the Adordabe . Activities . Abordabe supervised the massive Trade Fair each summer .
description_long: Abordabe Abordabe was the chieftain of the largest tribe in Narfell in 1359 DR , the Adordabe . Activities . Abordabe supervised the massive Trade Fair each summer . All his tribesmen considered him the best warrior of Narfell and few tried to challenge him . Personality . Abordabe was an honorable individual , wise and tolerant to outsiders ( for a Nar ) . However , he did not want to abandon power despite his old age .

title: Abraxus
description: Abraxus An abraxus was a magical creation similar to a golem or automaton . History . The abraxus were created by Chondath an mages to serve Sembia ' s Chondathan borders .
description_long: Abraxus An abraxus was a magical creation similar to a golem or automaton . History . The abraxus were created by Chondath an mages to serve Sembia ' s Chondathan borders . An abraxus was responsible for an assassination attempt on King Pryntaler Obarskyr in 1188 DR but it was disabled and the threat was removed . An abraxus was the center of the abraxus affair in 1369 DR when King Azoun IV of Cormyr was struck down by the creature .

title: Abraxus affair
description: Abraxus affair The abraxus affair referred to the attack on King Azoun IV by an abraxus , a magical golden bull - like creature in 1369 DR . Beginning . The king was hunting in the forest with his cousins Baron Thomdor and Duke Bhereu , and Aunadar Bleth , when the creature sprung unexpectedly from an abandoned ruined elven watch tower , giving off poisonous gas as it attacked .
description_long: Abraxus affair The abraxus affair referred to the attack on King Azoun IV by an abraxus , a magical golden bull - like creature in 1369 DR . Beginning . The king was hunting in the forest with his cousins Baron Thomdor and Duke Bhereu , and Aunadar Bleth , when the creature sprung unexpectedly from an abandoned ruined elven watch tower , giving off poisonous gas as it attacked . Although the group were able to inflict enough damage to the creature to disable it , Azoun , Thomdor and Bhereu all succumbed to the poison , falling into a coma - like state . Aunadar was unaffected . Diagnosis . The remains of the abraxus were brought back to the royal palace for examination by Laspeera Inthré and Emthrara Undril . Lord Dimswart was able to discover that the affliction was a venom that spread a blood disease resistant to conventional magic , causing internal organ damage . Casualties . Duke Bhereu died soon after the attack . Baron Thomdor lasted days longer but eventually succumbed and died as well . Political implications .

title: Abu Bakr
description: Abu Bakr Abu Bakr was the Caliph of Semphar during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Abu Bakr ruled Semphar from the capital of Dhaztanar .
description_long: Abu Bakr Abu Bakr was the Caliph of Semphar during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Abu Bakr ruled Semphar from the capital of Dhaztanar . He resided in the magnificent royal palace of Dar al - Kalif . He was known to use his treasury to support places of learning , and colleges for wizards . He also gave large donations to temples , but was known to persecute others , including those of Ilmater , as he feared they would rally the oppressed people of Semphar against him .

title: Abul Fiydah
description: Abul Fiydah Abul Fiydah was the Amir of Estanil during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As the ultimate commander of the forces stationed in Estanil , Abul was faced with the difficult task of defending the border city of Semphar .
description_long: Abul Fiydah Abul Fiydah was the Amir of Estanil during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As the ultimate commander of the forces stationed in Estanil , Abul was faced with the difficult task of defending the border city of Semphar . Five thousand troops were at his disposal , though only 1 , 000 were in the city at any given time . They were stationed in the only stone building within the city . Strangely enough , his most difficult challenges did not come from the goblin s and elves who attacked from outside of the city , but from the Council of Loggers found within .

title: Abutsu
description: Abutsu Abutsu was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Abutsu was a widow of Seinin village .
description_long: Abutsu Abutsu was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Abutsu was a widow of Seinin village . In 1358 DR , Abutsu saw the death of Toshi by the Soldiers of Iron kabukimono under order of a figure in yellow . Afterward , she met Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party at the village ' s shrine . Abutsu told Minhiro the truth about the killing of his ex - wife .

title: Abysmal Creed
description: Abysmal Creed The Abysmal Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They focused on instilling fear into thrall populations . They were highly efficient at torturing thrall races .
description_long: Abysmal Creed The Abysmal Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They focused on instilling fear into thrall populations . They were highly efficient at torturing thrall races . One such method was the use of the Nerve swimmer . Bases . The Abysmals had a base called the Vaults of Terror in Oryndoll . In the city , they were not only known for being able to efficiently cow the thrall population , but they were also known for making decorative masks that captured moments of pure terror upon them , which they sold to whoever would buy them . They worked closely with the Venerator Creed .

title: Abyss
description: Abyss The Abyss ( a - BIS ) was the birth place of the demon s , a chaotic evil universe unto itself with uncountable layers of infinite variety connected haphazardly . The Abyss ' s place in the cosmology of the Forgotten Realms shifted over time , but the nature of the plane remained fairly constant : a violent , malevolent place where the strong survived on the backs of the weak , the weak conspired to overthrow the strong , alliances only lasted while convenient , and the landscape itself tortured the mind and body of all who dared to pass . Cosmology .
description_long: Abyss The Abyss ( a - BIS ) was the birth place of the demon s , a chaotic evil universe unto itself with uncountable layers of infinite variety connected haphazardly . The Abyss ' s place in the cosmology of the Forgotten Realms shifted over time , but the nature of the plane remained fairly constant : a violent , malevolent place where the strong survived on the backs of the weak , the weak conspired to overthrow the strong , alliances only lasted while convenient , and the landscape itself tortured the mind and body of all who dared to pass . Cosmology . In the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Abyss was an Outer plane on the Great Wheel connected to the Astral plane , Pandemonium , Tarterus , and Concordant Opposition . It was estimated that the Abyss had 666 possibly infinite layers but no one could be certain . The first layer , named Pazunia after the demon lord Pazuzu , was described as a barren , dusty place baking under a red sun , broken only by great iron fortresses , huge holes in the ground , and the river Styx .

title: Abyssal Plague
description: Abyssal Plague The Abyssal Plague is a multiverse - spanning series of seven novels and one novella , published by Wizards of the Coast between 2010 and 2012 . The event revolves around the Voidharrow , an entity from a dead universe that is unleashed across multiple worlds . Two of the novels in the " Abyssal Plague " series are set in the Forgotten Realms .
description_long: Abyssal Plague The Abyssal Plague is a multiverse - spanning series of seven novels and one novella , published by Wizards of the Coast between 2010 and 2012 . The event revolves around the Voidharrow , an entity from a dead universe that is unleashed across multiple worlds . Two of the novels in the " Abyssal Plague " series are set in the Forgotten Realms . Description . The Abyssal Plague event was divided into three parts : Plot . Origins . The Chained God Tharizdun stirs in his prison in Pandemonium . On the world of Nerath , Tharizdun makes contact with one of his disciples , who is instructed to use a fragment of an artifact known as the Living Gate to pierce Tharizdun ' s prison and allow the god to free himself . As Tharizdun ' s plan is underway , the benevolent deities Ioun and Pelor move to foil him through their own mortal champions , among which is Demascus , the Sword of the Gods . The champions chase the disciple and his minions from Nerath unto Sigil and finally into Pandemonium itself , but are unable to stop the ritual in time . The entity known as the Voidharrow slips out of Tharizdun ' s prison , imbued with a fraction of the god ' s willpower .

title: Abyssal Plague ( disease )
description: Abyssal Plague ( disease ) The Abyssal Plague was a condition inflicted upon victims who came into contact with the Voidharrow . This disease and its malevolence was divine in nature , and its victims ' used symbols and scripts associated with the worship of Tharizdun , an interloper deity from another world . It was usually fatal unless cured or until the victim was transformed into a plague demon .
description_long: Abyssal Plague ( disease ) The Abyssal Plague was a condition inflicted upon victims who came into contact with the Voidharrow . This disease and its malevolence was divine in nature , and its victims ' used symbols and scripts associated with the worship of Tharizdun , an interloper deity from another world . It was usually fatal unless cured or until the victim was transformed into a plague demon . Acquisition . The primary way to contract this disease was to consume the Voidharrow itself . There was also the possibility of contracting this disease by coming into contact with it or with the blood of another infected creature , or by the attack and death throes of a plague demon . They could develop symptoms of the disease and transformed upon their death . The disease also spread in food and drink . Effects . Should the infection take root , the victim began to grow dark - red crystalline sores that appeared to be laced with silver and contained flecks of gold . These sores spread across the body , causing the victim to become even more contagious , but they also became more resilient and willful .

title: Abyssal drake
description: Abyssal drake Abyssal drakes were a mixing of demon s , red dragon s , and wyvern s , created to serve as mounts for demon rulers . Description . An abyssal drake appeared similar to a wyvern , but it had red scales and bat - like wings .
description_long: Abyssal drake Abyssal drakes were a mixing of demon s , red dragon s , and wyvern s , created to serve as mounts for demon rulers . Description . An abyssal drake appeared similar to a wyvern , but it had red scales and bat - like wings . Combat . Abyssal drakes would divebomb their prey , while breathing a cone of unholy fire . They had barbed tails , like wyverns did , with poisonous stings .

title: Abyssal ghoul
description: Abyssal ghoul Abyssal ghouls were extraplanar undead creatures that served the drow goddess Kiaransalee . Description . Appearing much like an ordinary ghoul with a twisted and bestial humanoid form , an abyssal ghoul differed in a few ways .
description_long: Abyssal ghoul Abyssal ghouls were extraplanar undead creatures that served the drow goddess Kiaransalee . Description . Appearing much like an ordinary ghoul with a twisted and bestial humanoid form , an abyssal ghoul differed in a few ways . It had hideously elongated fingers and toes that ended in wicked - looking claws . Dangling from its mouth was a tongue , roughly 1 ft ( 0 . 3 m ) long , that trailed into incorporeal smoke . Its eyes were effectively blind . Abilities . Very strong for its size and surprisingly agile , an abyssal ghoul could overpower most foes with its savage attacks . Despite being blind they compensated more than adequately with their other senses . After the collapse of the Abyss into the Elemental Chaos , abyssal ghouls demonstrated some different abilities compared to before . Psychology . Despite their bestial appearance , abyssal ghouls were possessed of a great deal of cunning . Most notably in battle , they would work together to out maneuver an opponent and pick their perfect moment to strike . Opportunistic combatants , they would sometimes lie in wait for just the right moment to pounce . History .

title: Abyssal language
description: Abyssal language The abyssal language was the language of demons . History . It was a form of the Primordial language warped and twisted by the evil of the Abyss .
description_long: Abyssal language The abyssal language was the language of demons . History . It was a form of the Primordial language warped and twisted by the evil of the Abyss . Sound . Lower - ranking demons spoke using sounds like the barking of canines , while the speech of more refined demons sounded like softly droning ocean waves mingled with the violence of a swarm of angry hornets . As with everything involving the tanar ' ri , however , their speech was unpredictable , and sometimes an elite balor ' s words were rougher or a lowly bar - lgura ' s words smoother . Script . Abyssal used the Infernal language ' s script or the Barazhad alphabet .

title: Academy of Shapers and Binders
description: Academy of Shapers and Binders The Academy of Shapers and Binders was a magic academy for the Red Wizards of Thay , located on Thaymount in Thay . The school specialized in transmutation magic . Its motto was " Nothing is immutable .
description_long: Academy of Shapers and Binders The Academy of Shapers and Binders was a magic academy for the Red Wizards of Thay , located on Thaymount in Thay . The school specialized in transmutation magic . Its motto was " Nothing is immutable . " Organization . The headmistress was Nefris and among the instructors were Safiya , Djalfi , and Araman . A famous student was Ammon Jerro . Description . Passing through a small valley , a path with glowing , apparently magical lanterns led the way to the academy . Various walls and hostile Thayan gnoll s protected the academy . History . The academy was founded by the Founder , a female Red Wizard and lover of the Chosen of Myrkul , Akachi , as part of her plan to free her lover . Kalach - Cha briefly traveled to The Academy of Shapers and Binders by using a secret portal in the Plane of Shadow s in Mulsantir , which was located in Rashemen . However , just before the Kalach - Cha arrived there to confront the Founder , Araman launched a coup and seized control of the academy , killing many , including the former headmistress of the Academy and the students and teachers loyal to her .

title: Acamar
description: Acamar Acamar was an elder evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Acamar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .
description_long: Acamar Acamar was an elder evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Acamar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description . Acamar was a dead star of utterly black inky nothingness that ate other celestial bodies that drew too close to it . History . Acamar and the other Far Realm – infested stars of Realmspace were somehow related to the Eldest . Acamar ' s hunger was endless , and when its influence on Toril was as its peak , it sent its agents , the Maws of Acamar , to devour everything they encountered in their path to sate the hunger of the dead star . Acamar was one of the stars the warlock Japheth Donard sought out in 1396 DR , after having lost his pact with the archfey Neifion .

title: Accalia
description: Accalia Accalia was a female human priest from the Temple of Tempus in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . As a follower of Tempus , the priestess wore armor even while completing her temple duties .
description_long: Accalia Accalia was a female human priest from the Temple of Tempus in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . As a follower of Tempus , the priestess wore armor even while completing her temple duties . History . Accalia traveled from Neverwinter after Everard ' s fellow priest , Renfeld , was killed outside Bryn Shander during a Reghedmen barbarian raid . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Accalia aided Everard in his duties for maintaining the temple .

title: Achaierai
description: Achaierai Achaierais ( a - CHY - ur - ys ) were large , flightless , birdlike creatures that could be found in the Barrens of Doom and Despair and in Acheron . Description . These creatures resembled 15 - ft - tall ( 4 .
description_long: Achaierai Achaierais ( a - CHY - ur - ys ) were large , flightless , birdlike creatures that could be found in the Barrens of Doom and Despair and in Acheron . Description . These creatures resembled 15 - ft - tall ( 4 . 6 m ) flightless birds , albeit with four long stilt - like legs that ended in wicked claws . They had colorful feathers , varying from brown to red in hue , though their claws and beak shone like burnished metal . Its plump , round body was roughly the size of a small pony . Abilities . An achaierai could release a toxic black cloud when threatened . This cloud had an adverse effect on any caught within it , damaging them and possibly driving the victims to madness . Achaierai were very resistant to magic . Psychology . These outsider s were known for their evil personalities , their predatory instincts , and their love of torture .

title: Acham el Jhotos
description: Acham el Jhotos Acham el Jhotos , whose full name was Acham yn Aban el Jhotos , yi Almraiven and who was commonly referred to as the Weavepasha , was a mighty wizard and the ruler of Almraiven in Calimshan . He was considered to be one of the most powerful mortals alive in 1479 . His entire life was dedicated to defending the city of Almraiven from djinn , efreet , and other menaces .
description_long: Acham el Jhotos Acham el Jhotos , whose full name was Acham yn Aban el Jhotos , yi Almraiven and who was commonly referred to as the Weavepasha , was a mighty wizard and the ruler of Almraiven in Calimshan . He was considered to be one of the most powerful mortals alive in 1479 . His entire life was dedicated to defending the city of Almraiven from djinn , efreet , and other menaces . He appeared as an older man but in reality was much older . His oldest granddaughter , the vizar Munaa yr Oma el Jhotos , was nearly 100 years old . Acham was an abolitionist who wanted to free all the slaves in Calimshan . Appearance . Acham el Jhotos appeared as an older , grey - haired man with olive skin and a short - trimmed grey beard that ended in a sharp point .

title: Achazar ' s Throne
description: Achazar ' s Throne Achazar ' s Throne was a mountain located in the Nightmare ' s Hoof mountain range , near the the city of Sambral , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . The mountain had a depression in its southern face beneath its peak .
description_long: Achazar ' s Throne Achazar ' s Throne was a mountain located in the Nightmare ' s Hoof mountain range , near the the city of Sambral , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . The mountain had a depression in its southern face beneath its peak . Legends claimed this mountain was used by the primordial Achazar as a throne .

title: Acheron
description: Acheron Acheron ( ÆTCH - ur - un ) was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful evil and lawful neutral with emphasis on law . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Clangor , Nishrek , and Warrior ' s Rest when that cosmology became popular . Nishrek and Warrior ' s Rest survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model .
description_long: Acheron Acheron ( ÆTCH - ur - un ) was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful evil and lawful neutral with emphasis on law . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Clangor , Nishrek , and Warrior ' s Rest when that cosmology became popular . Nishrek and Warrior ' s Rest survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model . Description . Acheron was the bridge between the ultimate order of Nirvana and the regimented evil of the Nine Hells and as such , each layer emphasized order over evil . The land masses on each layer were blocks of geometric simplicity the size of nations floating in a sea of air . The blocks would slowly collide and part without causing any upheaval or tremor , allowing beings to move to a new block if desired . The dance of the blocks was carefully orchestrated and creatures of high intelligence could usually discern a pattern for an area by studying the motions . It was said gravity pulled toward the center of the blocks but in practical terms gravity was normal to each surface . Avalas .

title: Achmed al - Assad
description: Achmed al - Assad Achmed al - Assad was the father of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir — the Grand Caliph of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Achmed served as the Grand Caliph until his death .
description_long: Achmed al - Assad Achmed al - Assad was the father of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir — the Grand Caliph of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Achmed served as the Grand Caliph until his death . Relationships . Achmed was the eldest brother of Prince Tannous and Prince Cheddah

title: Achreny Ulyeltin
description: Achreny Ulyeltin Achreny Ulyeltin was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Achreny was a boorish man without trace of civilization about him .
description_long: Achreny Ulyeltin Achreny Ulyeltin was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Achreny was a boorish man without trace of civilization about him . He was smelly , vulgar , and utterly without manners . History . Around 1489 DR , Achreny attached his two wagons to a great caravan , which unknown to him was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Acid
description: Acid Acid was a grisly liquid that could cause major and permanent scarring , and possible death . Spell Use . Acid was a component in the following spells : A number of spells produced effects with acid : Magic items .
description_long: Acid Acid was a grisly liquid that could cause major and permanent scarring , and possible death . Spell Use . Acid was a component in the following spells : A number of spells produced effects with acid : Magic items . The following magic item properties were acidic : Sale . A one - pound ( 450 - gram ) vial of standard acid could typically be purchased for 25 gold pieces in Faerûn . History . The Do ' Urden patron and weapon master , Zaknafein , while transformed into a Zin - carla , willingly fell into a pit of acid to prevent himself from murdering his son , Drizzt . In this battle , Guenhwyvar , Drizzt ' s magical panther , also fell into the same chasm , but , escaping and healing in the Astral Plane , Guenhwyvar made a full recovery .

title: Acid Aerie
description: Acid Aerie The Acid Aerie was gorge located several days walk west of Blingdenstone . Description . The Acid Aerie was several hundred - foot - wide and filled with foul - smelling acid , the result of a wizard ' s experiment long ago .
description_long: Acid Aerie The Acid Aerie was gorge located several days walk west of Blingdenstone . Description . The Acid Aerie was several hundred - foot - wide and filled with foul - smelling acid , the result of a wizard ' s experiment long ago . Several crisscrossing stone walkways of various widths allowed land - bound creatures to traverse the cavern and leave via the many tunnels that lined the walls , several of which lead into simple side - corridors or into the Wormwrithings . History . The ' Aerie ' part of its name was gained from a flock of dire corbies that inhabited the area , which were killed by Drizzt Do ' Urden , Belwar Dissengulp , Clacker , and the spirit wraith of Zaknafein Do ' Urden .

title: Acid arrow
description: Acid arrow Acid arrow , sometimes called more completely Melf ' s acid arrow is a somewhat complex wizard spell learned very early on in a mage ' s training . When cast , " acid arrow " conjure s an arrow of acid that speeds from the caster ' s hand towards a single creature within 100 feet . The " acid arrow " , upon hitting , not only deals immediate damage but leaves a festering wound of acid .
description_long: Acid arrow Acid arrow , sometimes called more completely Melf ' s acid arrow is a somewhat complex wizard spell learned very early on in a mage ' s training . When cast , " acid arrow " conjure s an arrow of acid that speeds from the caster ' s hand towards a single creature within 100 feet . The " acid arrow " , upon hitting , not only deals immediate damage but leaves a festering wound of acid . Since the arrow is actually made of acid , rather than being coated with acid , it explodes upon contact with its target , spraying its contents onto adjacent creatures to injure them as well , to a lesser degree . It is also for this reason that , even if the arrow misses its initial target , it will still cause some small injury simply by its close proximity . " Acid arrow " , in spite of being a spell learned early on by most wizards , is of great complexity and requires so much concentration that mages can cast it only once per day . Prior to the Spellplague " acid arrow " was a spell used by sorcerer s as well as wizard s , and was considered somewhat more complex .

title: Acid dart
description: Acid dart An acid dart was a hollow dart that contained acid . When striking something , the dart broke and released the acid in a splashing fashion , as well as the usual piercing action associated with darts . Acid darts cost 20 gp each and weighed around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .
description_long: Acid dart An acid dart was a hollow dart that contained acid . When striking something , the dart broke and released the acid in a splashing fashion , as well as the usual piercing action associated with darts . Acid darts cost 20 gp each and weighed around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .

title: Acid fog
description: Acid fog Acid fog , also known as death fog , was an conjuration spell that created acid ic vapors . Users . " Acid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s , as well as cleric s who commanded the Water domain .
description_long: Acid fog Acid fog , also known as death fog , was an conjuration spell that created acid ic vapors . Users . " Acid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s , as well as cleric s who commanded the Water domain . Effects . The spell was similar in effect to a " solid fog " spell , but the mists it produced were also highly corrosive to any creature or item caught within it . Components . Like " solid fog " , a casting of " acid fog " required a mixture of a pinch of powdered hoof from some animal , and a pinch of powdered dried peas . History . This spell , together with the less powerful but similar " stinking cloud " , was invented by the Netherese arcanist Tolodine in −2363 DR , early in the history of Netheril .

title: Acid splash
description: Acid splash Acid splash , also known as acid orb , was a conjuration spell used by sorcerer s and wizard s . Effect . When " acid splash " was cast , the sorcerer or wizard conjured a sphere of liquid acid which , when thrust at a target , collided and exploded , burning one creature with its contents .
description_long: Acid splash Acid splash , also known as acid orb , was a conjuration spell used by sorcerer s and wizard s . Effect . When " acid splash " was cast , the sorcerer or wizard conjured a sphere of liquid acid which , when thrust at a target , collided and exploded , burning one creature with its contents . The spell was easily cast and one needed not rest before recasting it . The potency of the spell ' s effects also increased over time , dependent both on the sorcerer ' s level of experience as well as , as in the case of most sorcerer spells , the sorcerer ' s strength of personality . Like other spells , " acid splash " could only be cast as many times as its caster either had energy left for spellcasting or , in the case of wizards , had prepared for it . History . Between the Spellplague and the Second Sundering , " acid splash " was better known as " acid orb " and could be cast only by sorcerers . This form of the spell was significantly stronger .

title: Acid storm
description: Acid storm Acid storm was a spell that caused acid to rain down in an area 20 feet ( 6 meters ) in diameter . Components . The material component of this spell was a flask of acid .
