description_long: Acid storm Acid storm was a spell that caused acid to rain down in an area 20 feet ( 6 meters ) in diameter . Components . The material component of this spell was a flask of acid . History . " Acid storm " was created by the Red Wizard s , who called it acid rain . By 1372 DR , the spell was known throughout the Realms .

title: Acidic burst
description: Acidic burst Acidic burst is a quality that can be applied to weapons , making them corrosive to the touch , and causing them to spew a burst of acid on a critical strike . If ranged weapons are given this quality , the effects apply to any ammunition loaded into them .
description_long: Acidic burst Acidic burst is a quality that can be applied to weapons , making them corrosive to the touch , and causing them to spew a burst of acid on a critical strike . If ranged weapons are given this quality , the effects apply to any ammunition loaded into them .

title: Ackyn Selebon
description: Ackyn Selebon Ackyn Selebon was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ackyn was one of the contacts of Leosin Erlanthar and provided support for the adventuring party recruited to fight the Cult of the Dragon when they passed through his city .
description_long: Ackyn Selebon Ackyn Selebon was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ackyn was one of the contacts of Leosin Erlanthar and provided support for the adventuring party recruited to fight the Cult of the Dragon when they passed through his city .

title: Acrobat
description: Acrobat Acrobats were agile individuals . Background . Those who studied the art of acrobatics seldom wore armor and attacked with very light weapons or simply their bare hands .
description_long: Acrobat Acrobats were agile individuals . Background . Those who studied the art of acrobatics seldom wore armor and attacked with very light weapons or simply their bare hands . Their profession forced them to be in top condition and they knew how to use their weapons well , for it was their only line of offense and defense . Out - maneuvering their opponent was critical during a fight , which was why acrobats focused on training their dexterity over strength . Weapons and tactics . They often carried dagger s or dart s and were very skilled in using them . Quick , precise strikes were their preferred method of attack . They often targeted tendons , ligaments , and veins and arteries to disable their opponents . They moved often and quickly , knowing that a stationary opponent was an easy target , and preferred to fight in very crowded areas , like dense forests and tavern s . Skills . Acrobats were skilled climbers who were able to climbing nearly anything assuming they could find some handholds .

title: Ad ' non Kareese
description: Ad ' non Kareese Ad ' non Kareese was a male drow and a member of a band of four renegades including Donnia Soldou , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett , and Tos ' un Armgo . History . Ad ' non belonged to House Khareese of Ched Nasad .
description_long: Ad ' non Kareese Ad ' non Kareese was a male drow and a member of a band of four renegades including Donnia Soldou , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett , and Tos ' un Armgo . History . Ad ' non belonged to House Khareese of Ched Nasad . He was once a scout , thief , and assassin there , but a failed assassination attempt forced him to leave the Underdark . He was killed in battle in 1370 DR when Drizzt Do ' Urden vaulted behind him and sliced his head off . Relationships . He was Donnia Soldou ' s lover .

title: Adaerglast
description: Adaerglast Adaerglast , also known as the Land of Mages , was a coastal region in the west of the Border Kingdoms . Its coastline was sometimes known as the Garden Coast because it was one of the most fertile areas of farmland in Faerûn . " Adaernen " was the word used to describe inhabitants of Adaerglast .
description_long: Adaerglast Adaerglast , also known as the Land of Mages , was a coastal region in the west of the Border Kingdoms . Its coastline was sometimes known as the Garden Coast because it was one of the most fertile areas of farmland in Faerûn . " Adaernen " was the word used to describe inhabitants of Adaerglast . History . Some time ago ( the exact year is not clear ) , two mage s named Iraun and Srivven immigrated from Murghôm and built a castle in the city of Myrinjar . The castle became known as the Castle of Dark Dreams because the mages sent out magical dreams to the city ' s inhabitants that appeared to show them as the rightful rulers of Adaerglast . The mages adopted bodyguards and other servants to do their bidding and killed those who they deemed to be traitors . These traitors ' lands were seized and their relatives sold into slavery . An alliance of wizards and temples from the nearby town of Yallasch was supported by Halruaa and Waterdeep and stood guard against invasion by Iraun and Srivven . Various attempts were made to defeat the mages , but the Zhentarim , Red Wizards , and an emissary from Halruaa all failed .

title: Adalon
description: Adalon Adalon was a silver dragon living in the Underdark near the city of Ust Natha . Her task was to guard the drow city and maintain peace and the balance between the drow and the elves of Suldanessellar . History .
description_long: Adalon Adalon was a silver dragon living in the Underdark near the city of Ust Natha . Her task was to guard the drow city and maintain peace and the balance between the drow and the elves of Suldanessellar . History . When Jon Irenicus and his drow allies planned to attack Suldanessellar in 1368 DR , the mage stole Adalon ' s eggs and held them for ransom , giving them to the matron mother of one of the houses in Ust Natha . To retrieve the eggs , Adalon sought to enlist the aid of a group of adventurers chasing Irenicus , proposing to turn them into the likeness of drow so that they might infiltrate the drow city . The Matron mother Ardaluce wanted to use the dragon ' s eggs as a tribute for a demon invoked during a ritual .

title: Adalwulf Longfang
description: Adalwulf Longfang Adalwulf Longfang was the honorable of the Red Tiger Tribe Uthgardt barbarian tribe located primarily in the Cold Wood . Personality . Under Adalwulf ' s rule , the Red Tigers were strictly a wild and solitary tribe .
description_long: Adalwulf Longfang Adalwulf Longfang was the honorable of the Red Tiger Tribe Uthgardt barbarian tribe located primarily in the Cold Wood . Personality . Under Adalwulf ' s rule , the Red Tigers were strictly a wild and solitary tribe . Adalwulf ' s goal in life was teaching his son Shinoras how to rule with honor . Over the years , he felt the cold touch of age and the feelings of being a burden on the tribe , but Shinoras refused to become chieftain of the tribe until his father passed away . Relationships . Longfang married Shala Longfangwife and had one son Shinoras . History . In 1368 DR , all Adalwulf ' s dreams vanished with the death of Shinoras . His nephew , Thradulf Longfang became his heir and took the role of making decisions for the tribe .

title: Adam Gillespie
description: Adam Gillespie Adam Gillespie is an illustrator who works with numerous clients including Wizards of the Coast . Adam ' s art is usually cover art as he works in full color . His most recent work for Wizards was several images in " A Reader ' s Guide to R .
description_long: Adam Gillespie Adam Gillespie is an illustrator who works with numerous clients including Wizards of the Coast . Adam ' s art is usually cover art as he works in full color . His most recent work for Wizards was several images in " A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt " .

title: Adama
description: Adama The Adama was a spiritual belief held by almost all Durpar ians . After Mulhorand invaded Durpar and wiped out the barbarian clans , a simple trader emerged to lead the remnants of his people . His name was Satama and he claimed to have experienced a divine revelation , which he turned into the philosophy of the Adama .
description_long: Adama The Adama was a spiritual belief held by almost all Durpar ians . After Mulhorand invaded Durpar and wiped out the barbarian clans , a simple trader emerged to lead the remnants of his people . His name was Satama and he claimed to have experienced a divine revelation , which he turned into the philosophy of the Adama . Tenets . The core principle of the Adama was that everything " is " the Adama . The gods , the world and everything in it were just aspects of the Adama . To become one with the Adama , a person must have been born many times . As each reincarnation of that person was believed to reflect their previous life , believers in the Adama strove to improve themselves and their lives . Crime was as dangerous to oneself as it was to the victim as it grievously jeopardized a person ' s chance of being reincarnated as anything better than an animal . Therefore , not only did followers of the Adama make very hard workers at whatever they chose to do , but crime levels were surprisingly low all over the Shining Lands . Killing was frowned upon , even in self - defense .

title: Adama ' s Wrath
description: Adama ' s Wrath Adama ' s Wrath was the highest peak of the mighty Dustwall Mountains in the Shining South . Description . Though the Dustwall Mountains averaged 15 , 000 ft .
description_long: Adama ' s Wrath Adama ' s Wrath was the highest peak of the mighty Dustwall Mountains in the Shining South . Description . Though the Dustwall Mountains averaged 15 , 000 ft . ( 4600 m ) in height , Adama ' s Wrath towered over the rest of the range at 22 , 000 ft . ( 6700 m ) .

title: Adama Miiralin
description: Adama Miiralin Adama Miiralin was a young and naive cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Adama was a young and enthusiastic man .
description_long: Adama Miiralin Adama Miiralin was a young and naive cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Adama was a young and enthusiastic man . He hoped to rise through the ranks of the church of Tymora . Despite his usually wise nature , he believed wholly in luck , and took wild risks as a matter of course . History . Adama hailed from Arabel in Cormyr but departed to distance himself from the heretical local clerics of Tymora . In Waterdeep , he stayed near the Yawning Portal , observing adventurers that entered and exited Undermountain and keeping records of those who attempted Lady Luck ' s ultimate test

title: Adamantine
description: Adamantine Adamantine was a jet - black alloy of adamantium and other metals . Usually black in colour , adamantine had a green sheen when viewed by candlelight or a purple - white sheen when viewed by magical light . It was found only in veins of ore near earth node s and areas of " faerzress " in the Underdark .
description_long: Adamantine Adamantine was a jet - black alloy of adamantium and other metals . Usually black in colour , adamantine had a green sheen when viewed by candlelight or a purple - white sheen when viewed by magical light . It was found only in veins of ore near earth node s and areas of " faerzress " in the Underdark . Occasionally , small meteorites consisting of some adamantine would fall to Abeir - Toril as well . Adamantine , when smelted , was ultra - hard but this was a costly procedure . Adamantine weapons were useful for damaging the weapons and armor of opponents . A set of adamantine armor or a shield was nearly impenetrable to normal weapons . Adamantine was often used by drow elves of the Underdark , and their adamantine weapons were usually swords that were magically enhanced . Their magical strength and sharpness faded if brought into contact with direct sunlight .

title: Adan Longstride
description: Adan Longstride Adan Longstride was an ambassador to the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the midst of council , Adan Longstride maligned the good will of the commander of the Legendary Campaign , who had been appointed emissary to Nix with the task of negotiating peace terms with the king of the goblins . In accordance with goblin custom , they had to resolve their disagreement in trial by combat , which they did through bloodforge battle .

title: Adanac Harpell
description: Adanac Harpell Adanac Harpell was the elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Relationships . The magic - user was the father of Ardanac Harpell .
description_long: Adanac Harpell Adanac Harpell was the elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Relationships . The magic - user was the father of Ardanac Harpell . History . Around 1357 DR , Adanac lived in the Ivy Mansion , the Harpell ' s ancestral home , on a hill in the center of Longsaddle .

title: Addazahr
description: Addazahr Addazahr , or Backbiters , were tiny flying insects that lived in Zakhara ’ s deserts , hills , and plains . Description . These tiny creatures were only 2 inches ( 5 .
description_long: Addazahr Addazahr , or Backbiters , were tiny flying insects that lived in Zakhara ’ s deserts , hills , and plains . Description . These tiny creatures were only 2 inches ( 5 . 1 cm ) long . Their bodies were extremely thin and pale , giving them the appearance of strands of hay floating on the breeze . Their fragile wings were nearly invisible when in flight . Combat . These creatures were not aggressive and did not enter into combat in the traditional sense . Their bite injected a debilitating saliva that caused soreness and mild swelling of the joints . Pack animals were especially susceptible to this bite and would refuse to move if bitten enough times . Unless cured by a " cure disease " spell or potion , the effects of an addazahr bite lasted for two weeks before wearing off naturally . Habitat / Society . Addazahr constantly flew around in small groups in search of food , searching for warm blood which they used to reproduce . After feeding on live blood an addazahr would become a female , laying eggs within three days . The nearly invisible eggs were deposited on whatever terrain was available , hatching a month later .

title: Addemios Three - Dawn
description: Addemios Three - Dawn Addemios Three - Dawn was one of the lieutenants of Merrisara Winterwhite , the leader of the returned Iliyanbruen eladrin in Neverwinter Wood . However , Addemios ' s true goal was more nefarious than rebuilding the ancient elven empire . He wanted to start a war between the Iliyanbruen elves and the human s of Neverwinter , under orders of his god Asmodeus .
description_long: Addemios Three - Dawn Addemios Three - Dawn was one of the lieutenants of Merrisara Winterwhite , the leader of the returned Iliyanbruen eladrin in Neverwinter Wood . However , Addemios ' s true goal was more nefarious than rebuilding the ancient elven empire . He wanted to start a war between the Iliyanbruen elves and the human s of Neverwinter , under orders of his god Asmodeus .

title: Adder River
description: Adder River The Adder River ran south to north from the Adder Peaks to empty into the Bay of Chessenta through the Adder Swamp . Geography . The Adder River was described as being a wide , slow flowing river with muddy water .
description_long: Adder River The Adder River ran south to north from the Adder Peaks to empty into the Bay of Chessenta through the Adder Swamp . Geography . The Adder River was described as being a wide , slow flowing river with muddy water . Lush vegetation surrounded the river for its entire length , hiding plenty of dangerous snakes . Inhabitants . A community of werecrocodiles was also known to inhabit its waters near the Adder Swamp .

title: Adder Swamp
description: Adder Swamp The Adder Swamp was a dangerous expanse of lycanthrope - infested marshland that surrounded the Adder River delta in Chessenta . History . The native werecrocodile s had a half - sunken settlement somewhere on the seaward edge of the swamp , but when a community of wererat s migrated to the area , the werecrocodiles ' territorial nature caused the two races to immediately come to blows .
description_long: Adder Swamp The Adder Swamp was a dangerous expanse of lycanthrope - infested marshland that surrounded the Adder River delta in Chessenta . History . The native werecrocodile s had a half - sunken settlement somewhere on the seaward edge of the swamp , but when a community of wererat s migrated to the area , the werecrocodiles ' territorial nature caused the two races to immediately come to blows . The chaotic halfling barony of Ursuma managed to stay out of the lycanthrope war when it was founded within the swamp sometime during the Era of Upheaval . Environment . Like the Adder River , the Adder Swamp was also known for its large snake population . It was also one of the few rare places along the entire coast of Chessenta where sailors would not moor their boats .

title: Addition
description: Addition Addition was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to create one or more simple , ordinary , identical objects or even a single , small , natural creature . This was accomplished by " adding a term to the equation of the moment . " Effects .
description_long: Addition Addition was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to create one or more simple , ordinary , identical objects or even a single , small , natural creature . This was accomplished by " adding a term to the equation of the moment . " Effects . The object created had to be ordinary and non - magical , with a complexity no greater than a crossbow and containing no abstract knowledge ( writings or diagrams ) . The caster was required to describe the object in a single word or short phrase . For example , a priest could create " a block of wood " , " a fork " , " a longbow " , " a footstool " , or " a water pitcher " , but not " a spellbook " ( magical , contains writing ) , " a blunderbuss " ( too technologically advanced ) , " the crown of Azoun the First " ( not ordinary ) . The caster had no control over design . A water pitcher might be tall , light , and green or short , heavy , and yellow . And unless specified , might be made of wood , metal , or glass , for example . Objects could not be created inside another object or creature , or appear in a space already occupied by something .

title: Adera ( intellect devourer )
description: Adera ( intellect devourer ) " Adera Moonfist " was a disguised intellect devourer in the Moonsea region . Personality . Like its master , the mind flayer Vanquo , its main goal was to acquire an artifact from the Elemental Plane of Earth .
description_long: Adera ( intellect devourer ) " Adera Moonfist " was a disguised intellect devourer in the Moonsea region . Personality . Like its master , the mind flayer Vanquo , its main goal was to acquire an artifact from the Elemental Plane of Earth . History . In 1491 DR , after Vanquo had absorbed all information from Adera Moonfist , it replaced her brain with an intellect devourer . The intellect devourer began recruiting mercenaries and adepts of the Cult of the Black Earth to aid in the search for the Turning Key ' s treasure in the Flooded Forest . The intellect devourer commanded the mercenaries to start preying upon caravans along the North Road , hoping to gain information . However , an adventuring party hired to clear the area of bandits confronted and defeated " her " .

title: Adera Moonfist
description: Adera Moonfist Adera Moonfist was a famed thief in Ravens Bluff . History . She descended from Satcheera Moonfist , a member of the Turning Key , a famed Mulmaster adventuring party that had hidden a treasure in Flooded Forest .
description_long: Adera Moonfist Adera Moonfist was a famed thief in Ravens Bluff . History . She descended from Satcheera Moonfist , a member of the Turning Key , a famed Mulmaster adventuring party that had hidden a treasure in Flooded Forest . In 1491 DR , she decided to seek out her ancestor ' s treasure . However , in her search , Adera approached the mind flayer Vanquo . Vanquo also desired that treasure and seized the opportunity to capture Adera . It absorbed all information from her and finally replaced her brain with an intellect devourer , killing her . The intellect devourer then adopted her identity .

title: Adhal
description: Adhal Adhal was a small town in North Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Adhal was located along several caravan routes in between Qudra and the Sea of Caravans .
description_long: Adhal Adhal was a small town in North Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Adhal was located along several caravan routes in between Qudra and the Sea of Caravans . It ' s position at the northern end of the Sea of Caravans provided with a constant supply of commercial and pilgrim traffic .

title: Adhan el Ilmater
description: Adhan el Ilmater Adhan el Ilmater was a human man and a priest of Ilmater . He was the leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1370 DR . Adhan was a kind and wise man , who often worked directly with his patients .
description_long: Adhan el Ilmater Adhan el Ilmater was a human man and a priest of Ilmater . He was the leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1370 DR . Adhan was a kind and wise man , who often worked directly with his patients . He was gray - haired and balding , but usually smiling .

title: Adhe Wood
description: Adhe Wood Adhe Wood was a forest located in the Vast , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains , between the North Road and the Tsurlar Forest , north - east of the hamlet of Sevenecho . It was infested with arachnid monsters . Description .
description_long: Adhe Wood Adhe Wood was a forest located in the Vast , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains , between the North Road and the Tsurlar Forest , north - east of the hamlet of Sevenecho . It was infested with arachnid monsters . Description . The forest was old , dense and overgrown , and the trunks of its tree s stood very close together . Most of these were duskwoods and shadowtop s , while felsul s and oak s were found on the southern edge . The tallest trees grew over 80 feet ( 24 meters ) tall . As a result , the depths of Adhe Wood were kept in eternal darkness . Inhabitants . Deep in Adhe Wood were found large numbers of ettercap s and spider s . These spiders could be of any size or variety , and most possessed bizarre magical powers and mutations , such as hooked , slashing claws or stinging tails . They were exceedingly vicious and constantly hunted both each other and those who ventured into the forest . Legends . The many mutant spiders were thought to be the result of some magic al force active in the heart of Adhe Wood , likely ancient and evil . One possibility was an artifact that mutated the wildlife , another was an insane mage experimenting on the spiders .

title: Adimond Kroskas
description: Adimond Kroskas Adimond Kroskas was the leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . He was enslaved by Valindra Shadowmantle , who also gained his " ring of dragons " . However , he agreed to her project of resurrecting the legendary dragon Lorragauth as a dracolich .
description_long: Adimond Kroskas Adimond Kroskas was the leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . He was enslaved by Valindra Shadowmantle , who also gained his " ring of dragons " . However , he agreed to her project of resurrecting the legendary dragon Lorragauth as a dracolich . However , the problems stalling the project put him under a lot of stress , being caught between the elven lich and his Cult subordinates .

title: Adisha Brombottle
description: Adisha Brombottle Adisha Brombottle was a halfling merchant at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Adisha was depressed , bored , and very often drunk .
description_long: Adisha Brombottle Adisha Brombottle was a halfling merchant at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Adisha was depressed , bored , and very often drunk . She believed , out of paranoia , strangers to be agents for the Great Worm of the glacier intending to destroy the barrier that kept the storm at bay . History . Adisha was one of the guests at the monastery in 1491 DR with her two teamsters .

title: Adjudicators
description: Adjudicators The Adjudicators ( " Schatjamaetrish " in Tymantheran ) < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p146 " > < / ref > were an organization of dragonborn soldiers gathered from every clan , who served as the police force of Djerad Thymar under the direct command of the Vanquisher .
