Agrathan played a large role from the very begin during Mirabar ' s time of unrest between it ' s Dwarven and Human population .

title: Agricultural Promenade
description: Agricultural Promenade The Agricultural Promenade , or Farmers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Farmers ' Road separated the Clothiers ' District and Peasants ' District , branching off from the Road to Enlightenment near the Gulf Gate to run north roughly parallel to Clothiers ' Way before terminating at the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .
description_long: Agricultural Promenade The Agricultural Promenade , or Farmers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Farmers ' Road separated the Clothiers ' District and Peasants ' District , branching off from the Road to Enlightenment near the Gulf Gate to run north roughly parallel to Clothiers ' Way before terminating at the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .

title: Agrivar
description: Agrivar The Agrivars were a prominent noble family of the North in the 1350s DR , producing the renowned wizard Ostus Agrivar and his children the famed adventurers Kyriani and Priam Agrivar . Base . The family seat was the Agrivar estate on Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North .
description_long: Agrivar The Agrivars were a prominent noble family of the North in the 1350s DR , producing the renowned wizard Ostus Agrivar and his children the famed adventurers Kyriani and Priam Agrivar . Base . The family seat was the Agrivar estate on Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North . Their home there was called Ostus ' s Hold . Crest . The family crest was a sable griffin rampant — that is , a black griffin standing with forelegs raised and facing to the left .

title: Aguul
description: Aguul Aguul was a ogre man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . Oddly for an ogre , Aguul served as an apprentice printer to Forgemaster Inkstain , a dwarf , in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . Description .
description_long: Aguul Aguul was a ogre man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . Oddly for an ogre , Aguul served as an apprentice printer to Forgemaster Inkstain , a dwarf , in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . Description . Aguul was thickly muscled and quite hairy , with warty arms .

title: Ahazu
description: Ahazu Ahazu the Seizer is a demon lord that now functions as a vestige as a result of his self - imposed imprisonment in the Abyssal layer known as the Wells of Darkness . Description . Ahazu appears as a dark - skinned naked humanoid with bat - like wings , long thin arms , and an elongated head dominated with a mouth filled with needle - sharp teeth .
description_long: Ahazu Ahazu the Seizer is a demon lord that now functions as a vestige as a result of his self - imposed imprisonment in the Abyssal layer known as the Wells of Darkness . Description . Ahazu appears as a dark - skinned naked humanoid with bat - like wings , long thin arms , and an elongated head dominated with a mouth filled with needle - sharp teeth . Ahaz has long sharp talons and his legs appears to trail away into nothingness The demon lord Ahazu earned his title of The Seizer for his portfolios of the night and of abduction . Ages past , Ahazu stumbled upon the Abyssal layer that would become the Wells of Darkness . This layer apparently lies in an infinite void called Shattered Night . The layer itself is surrounded by a planar ' membrane ' that separates it from the void itself . Ahazu discovered that by digging shafts into the terrain of the layer itself , he can reach thin spots in the membrane which would act as " windows " to Shattered Night .

title: Ahbhaer Mhilshoun
description: Ahbhaer Mhilshoun Ahbhaer Mhilshoun was a Calishite human inhabitant of Beliard around 1368 DR who owned Milshoun ' s Stronghouses . History . Originally from Calimshan , Ahbhaer gained his magical items by killing a sleeping wizard and stealing them .
description_long: Ahbhaer Mhilshoun Ahbhaer Mhilshoun was a Calishite human inhabitant of Beliard around 1368 DR who owned Milshoun ' s Stronghouses . History . Originally from Calimshan , Ahbhaer gained his magical items by killing a sleeping wizard and stealing them . Personality . He was a failed merchant but liked to give the impression that he was powerful with many connections in Calimport and Waterdeep , and was exiled as a satrap or magically powerful being . Equipment . Ahbhaer possessed a " spellbattle ring " and a " ring of magic missiles " . Discrepancy . On page 37 of Volo ' s Guide to the North , Ahbhaer ' s establishment is called " Milshoun ' s Stronghouses " , but his last name is spelled " Mhilshoun " , which is a different spelling .

title: Ahghairon
description: Ahghairon Ahghairon was a human mage from northwest Faerûn and the first Open Lord of Waterdeep . He created the Lords of Waterdeep , the system by which Waterdeep had been ruled ever since , except for a six - year period immediately following his death . Background .
description_long: Ahghairon Ahghairon was a human mage from northwest Faerûn and the first Open Lord of Waterdeep . He created the Lords of Waterdeep , the system by which Waterdeep had been ruled ever since , except for a six - year period immediately following his death . Background . Birth . Ahghairon was born on Midsummer ' s Night , 920 DR . Legends say that the symbol of Mystra was glowing in the sky at the time . The Trollwars . The Second Trollwar broke out in 940 DR , as troll s were pushed down into the area later known as the Trollmoors by orc uprisings further north . After a decade of battles , a young Ahghairon distinguished himself , using his magic to turn the war against the trolls . First , the Waterdhavian defenders drove the trolls back from their walls . The human realms then united under Aeroth , War Captain of Silverymoon ; Ahghairon of Waterdeep ; and Samular Caradoon of Tyr , and together they eradicated trolls across the Evermoors , with war finally coming to an end in 952 DR . A third Trollwar almost took place in 963 DR , when the traitors Aviss and Fellandar led an army of trolls out of the Mere of Dead Men against the city .

title: Ahghairon ' s dragonward
description: Ahghairon ' s dragonward Ahghairon ' s dragonward was a powerful mythal cast by the famous mage Ahghairon over the city of Waterdeep . Centuries before the 14th century DR , Ranressa Shiard returned as a hero from her journeys to Waterdeep atop a mighty dragon . Although she was welcomed home , the appearance of her mount flying over the city unsettled the majority of the populace .
description_long: Ahghairon ' s dragonward Ahghairon ' s dragonward was a powerful mythal cast by the famous mage Ahghairon over the city of Waterdeep . Centuries before the 14th century DR , Ranressa Shiard returned as a hero from her journeys to Waterdeep atop a mighty dragon . Although she was welcomed home , the appearance of her mount flying over the city unsettled the majority of the populace . Ahghairon crafted this " mythal " to allay their fears . Centered under Ahghairon ' s tower , the mythal projected a permanent 12 , 800 - f - radius dome , which encompassed the city as it existed in Ahghairon ' s day . In newer areas of Waterdeep , the " dragonward " ' s effects were less severe or non - existent . Any creature with draconic blood that tried to enter the city was overcome with an overwhelming urge to leave the area , never to return . However , any draconic creature that touched the " Dragonstaff of Ahghairon " was able to bypass the " dragonward " for as long as the staff ' s wielder allowed or until the creature was struck by the staff .

title: Ahja
description: Ahja Ahja the Azure was a male human magician of Luskan on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ahja was a mage of Luskan , who was trained by the Host Tower wizards .
description_long: Ahja Ahja the Azure was a male human magician of Luskan on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ahja was a mage of Luskan , who was trained by the Host Tower wizards . Black Garius employed him to send the Luskan agents to Neverwinter . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha and companions encountered the Luskan spies , they needed to defeat them and Ahja . When Ahja is severely wounded , he would told them that his employer was Garius , the Master of the Fifth Tower . Once done , he would become hostile once more and needed to be killed .

title: Ahlarkhem
description: Ahlarkhem Ahlarkhem was a barony of Erlkazar encompassing the High Peaks and their evirons . Description . Ahlarkhem Barony was the center of trade for the kingdom of Erlkazar .
description_long: Ahlarkhem Ahlarkhem was a barony of Erlkazar encompassing the High Peaks and their evirons . Description . Ahlarkhem Barony was the center of trade for the kingdom of Erlkazar . The barony contained nine villages , which thrived on farming , fishing , and mining . The troops here also were responsible for defending the country from the goblin s of the Cloven Mountains . Geography . Ahlarkhem was the southeastern barony , neighbored by Tanistan to the west and Shalanar to the northwest . Shalane Lake and the Deepwash formed its northern border , and the High Peaks of the Cloven Mountains took up most of its southern territory . Flowing through the High Peaks toward the Deepwash , the Arglander River was located in this region . It only had a single crossing , the Shadebridge on the road from Duhlnarim to Saarlik . The Wintercloak River also ran through this barony . Government . In 1370 DR , Lord Purdun " The Firefist " ruled Ahlarkhem . He was married to the king ' s sister , Princess Dijara . Notable Inhabitants . The vampire ss Shyressa of the Twisted Rune secretly maintained her primary lair deep within the crypts of the ruins of Dajaan .

title: Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen
description: Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen was a female drow cleric of Lolth and a member of the mercantile House Lysaen of the city of Karsoluthiyl in 1370 DR . She was chosen to lead a group of three other priestesses and a 32 - strong hunting party of her house to establish a hold on Level Two of Undermountain , with the goal of rebuilding an ancient slave - trading route to the surface , in order to bypass the route used by House Tanor ' Thal , the ruling house of Karsoluthiyl .
description_long: Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen was a female drow cleric of Lolth and a member of the mercantile House Lysaen of the city of Karsoluthiyl in 1370 DR . She was chosen to lead a group of three other priestesses and a 32 - strong hunting party of her house to establish a hold on Level Two of Undermountain , with the goal of rebuilding an ancient slave - trading route to the surface , in order to bypass the route used by House Tanor ' Thal , the ruling house of Karsoluthiyl .

title: Ahmaergo
description: Ahmaergo Ahmaergo was a member of the Iron Ring and the most competent slaver of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Ahmaergo was in charge of buying and selling the slaves acquired by the Guild .
description_long: Ahmaergo Ahmaergo was a member of the Iron Ring and the most competent slaver of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Ahmaergo was in charge of buying and selling the slaves acquired by the Guild . He also was in charge of the logistic aspect of the slave market , moving them to and from those involved . Ahmaergo worked many for years in the Guild as a slaver but the Xanathar did not fully trust him and kept a close watch on him , usually via Avaereene , the Guild ' s slave - taker . The dwarf hated this intrusion in his business . He was starting to get ambitious , wanting to leave the Xanathar and work as an independent slaver . To add more temptation , Ahmaergo was also secretly one of the leaders of the Iron Ring . He was allegedly a liaison with the Iron Ring . Equipment . He usually had many magical objects on his person for self - defense .

title: Ahmahd abd al - Iffa
description: Ahmahd abd al - Iffa General Ahmahd abd al - Iffa directed the mamluk s of the Honored Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ahmahd was a burly eunuch .
description_long: Ahmahd abd al - Iffa General Ahmahd abd al - Iffa directed the mamluk s of the Honored Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ahmahd was a burly eunuch . He grew rather soft after going years without seeing real combat . Activities . Ahmahd was in charge of the security of the Royal Harim of the Grand Caliph . He directed a legion of fanatical eunuchs of the Honored mamluk society . The Honored ' s close ties to the crown meant that Ahmahd seldom left the parade grounds of Huzuz . He reported to Preani Qin . Rumors and Legends . Ahmahd had a weakness for sweets , a fact that many of the Grand Caliph ' s wives took advantage of if they wanted to sneak men into the harem .

title: Ahryn Firefinger
description: Ahryn Firefinger Ahryn Firefinger was the leader of a dozen or so Red Wizard s within their enclave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Ahryn ' s responsibilities were to ensure that their magical item trade remained profitable .
description_long: Ahryn Firefinger Ahryn Firefinger was the leader of a dozen or so Red Wizard s within their enclave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Ahryn ' s responsibilities were to ensure that their magical item trade remained profitable . He maintained a relationship with Tharchion Dmitra Flass to ensure they were working towards the same end .

title: Ahs Trango Shan
description: Ahs Trango Shan Ahs Trango Shan , or the South Guardian Peak , was a mountain located in Khazari . Geography . The South Guardian Peak formed part of the natural border of eastern Khazari , along with the Nas Trango Shan , providing a rocky barrier against Kara - Tur and the outside world .
description_long: Ahs Trango Shan Ahs Trango Shan , or the South Guardian Peak , was a mountain located in Khazari . Geography . The South Guardian Peak formed part of the natural border of eastern Khazari , along with the Nas Trango Shan , providing a rocky barrier against Kara - Tur and the outside world . Description . At 15 , 641 ft . ( 4 , 767 m ) , the South Guardian Peak was the smaller of two peaks located in eastern Khazari . The Broken Wall Pass ran between the two peaks . Strong fortifications , in the form of fort Luntse Dzong , were present to ensure the protection of the valuable Silk Road that passed through the mountains . Inhabitants . Bandits , led by Brusha around 1359 DR , and dangerous creatures inhabited the valleys surrounding the base of the mountains .

title: Ahtahqugotak Sea
description: Ahtahqugotak Sea The Ahtahqugotak Sea was a body of water in Ibelgrak Valley in Angalpuk on the Great Glacier . Geography . The Ahtahqugotak Sea was the largest sea in Angalpuk , at almost 70 miles ( 112 kilometers ) across at its widest point , but also quite shallow , being only 75 feet ( 23 meters ) deep .
description_long: Ahtahqugotak Sea The Ahtahqugotak Sea was a body of water in Ibelgrak Valley in Angalpuk on the Great Glacier . Geography . The Ahtahqugotak Sea was the largest sea in Angalpuk , at almost 70 miles ( 112 kilometers ) across at its widest point , but also quite shallow , being only 75 feet ( 23 meters ) deep . In winter , it was covered in thick ice , and in spring this broke apart as platform ice . In summer , it was nearly ice - free . Its waters were clear and calm , while it shores were dense with white birch es and lush evergreen s , making it possibly the most picturesque sea on the Great Glacier . Its waters were fertile with game fish , such as bloatfish , black burner s , and polar cod . The surrounding area was almost free of predators and hunters , so caribou , musk oxen , and many kinds of birds were abundant . Legends . Despite the abundant game animals and fish , many Angulutiun s avoided the Ahtahqugotak , fearing the fever virus that had spread from the Ibelgrak Valley in the Year of Scorching Suns , 460 DR , to kill thousands . However , there was no evidence that the disease lurked in the Ahtahqugotak water or the local wildlife .

title: Ahtayir
description: Ahtayir Ahtayir was a djinn i in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In the past , Torhild Flametongue , king of the Besilmer dwarves , found a horn capable of summoning Ahtayir .
description_long: Ahtayir Ahtayir was a djinn i in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In the past , Torhild Flametongue , king of the Besilmer dwarves , found a horn capable of summoning Ahtayir . Torhild used the djinni ' s services to build part of his royal palace . In 1491 DR , Aerisi Kalinoth found the horn and summoned Ahtayir once again . She ordered him to rebuild all of Tyar - Besil to its former glory .

title: Aid
description: Aid Aid was a spell that belonged to many schools because it gave the recipient a temporary boost in health and improved both morale in the face of fear and combat skill . Effects . The abjuration version of this spell could be cast on a target up to 30 ft ( 9 .
description_long: Aid Aid was a spell that belonged to many schools because it gave the recipient a temporary boost in health and improved both morale in the face of fear and combat skill . Effects . The abjuration version of this spell could be cast on a target up to 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) away . In all other versions , the caster had to touch the recipient in order to cast this spell . The effect of this spell was a health boost that lasted for the duration of the spell or until the health was lost due to subsequent injury , poison , energy drain , etc . , whichever came first . In addition , earlier versions of this spell included the effect of " bless " . Components . The enchantment version of this spell required verbal and somatic components , including touching the subject , and the priest ' s holy symbol or divine focus . The necromantic version of this spell also required a small bandage in the form of a white strip of cloth with an adhesive ( such as tree sap ) on each end . The abjuration version of this spell also used a small strip of white cloth , but did not require an adhesive .

title: Aida al - Irrahman
description: Aida al - Irrahman Aida al - Irrahman was a the true leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Aida ' s cunning knew no bounds .
description_long: Aida al - Irrahman Aida al - Irrahman was a the true leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Aida ' s cunning knew no bounds . She was a master of disguise and often paraded around as a man . She was also a superb orator . Aida took a practical view on romance , bedding powerful men if she believed she could manipulate them to her advantage and further the goals of the Everlasting . Decription . Aida had pale skin and dark , curly hair . She had dark brown eyes . Her fingers and limbs were long and slender . Activities . The Shadow Caliph recognized Aida ' s potential to be his successor upon his eventual death . Because of this he had her operating far away from the intrigue and danger of Sarahin . Aid worked in the city of Qudra , building the power of the Everlasting there and in other great cities across Zakhara through spreading propaganda . Possessions . Aida owned a pair of " bracers of defense " , " chime of opening " , " dagger of life stealing " , " jellaba of protection " , and a " ring of human influence " .

title: Aihonen
description: Aihonen Aihonen was a great hero who killed the white dragon Icasaracht . Description . When in battle , Aihonen used his sword the Blade of Aihonen and equipped a shield which bore the symbol of Tempus .
description_long: Aihonen Aihonen was a great hero who killed the white dragon Icasaracht . Description . When in battle , Aihonen used his sword the Blade of Aihonen and equipped a shield which bore the symbol of Tempus . Relationships . Over the years , Aihonen fought with the Uthgardt barbarian tribes of the North . During this time , the sea spirit Elisia fell in love with him . History . Around 1181 DR , Aihonen fought the last of the great white dragon matriarchs of the Spine of the World on banks of Lac Dinneshere . Death . During the battle , Aihonen fell before the might of Icasaracht , but with his dying breath , he pierce her heart with the Blade of Aihonen .

title: Aileen
description: Aileen Aileen was one of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . When she went on scouting missions , Aileen covered her shining armor with a woolen tunic of green , earthen tones and changed her lance for a bow , along with a slim sword .
description_long: Aileen Aileen was one of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . When she went on scouting missions , Aileen covered her shining armor with a woolen tunic of green , earthen tones and changed her lance for a bow , along with a slim sword . Relationships . As part of the Sisters of Synnoria , she fought under Brigit ' s command and had Maura and Carina as companions . Her steed was called Osprey . History . Aileen took part in the battle of Corwell Road , where she was wounded by one of the Bloodriders . . Although she was still affected by her wound , she served as a messenger in the defense of Caer Corwell . Aileen was finally slain in the battle of Caer Corwell in 1345 DR slain by the same rider that had wounded her before .

title: Ailoth
description: Ailoth Ailoth was an diviner and an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay for the Sembia and Hillsfar , part of the network of Alzegund . Description . Ailoth was a white - haired magic - user .
description_long: Ailoth Ailoth was an diviner and an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay for the Sembia and Hillsfar , part of the network of Alzegund . Description . Ailoth was a white - haired magic - user . Personality . Not overly intelligent , Ailoth ' s activities as a spy did not go unnoticed by the governments of Sembia and Hillsfar who were acknowledged to his true work . History . The Red Wizard arrived in the region of Sembia around 1337 DR under Alzegund . After some time Ailoth broke with Alzegund to start a private business , but this was a facade to cover his work as a Thayan spy under his master . In 1357 DR , Ailoth was known as a moneylender and the buyer of thieves goods . In truth , he was gathering information from a network of spies and giving information to his master when he and Alzegund were in the same city .

title: Aingst
description: Aingst The Aingst were a tribe of Nar found in western Narfell . Activities . Generally speaking , the Aingst did not mind dealing with others , particularly farmers from Damara , so long as they did not tread within the borders of Narfell .
description_long: Aingst The Aingst were a tribe of Nar found in western Narfell . Activities . Generally speaking , the Aingst did not mind dealing with others , particularly farmers from Damara , so long as they did not tread within the borders of Narfell . Base of Operations . The Aingst made their home in and around the Giantspire Mountains between the border of Narfell and Damara .

title: Air
description: Air The element of air was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter , and the origin of everything that was gaseous . It represented change , flexibility , and freedom . Cosmology .
description_long: Air The element of air was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter , and the origin of everything that was gaseous . It represented change , flexibility , and freedom . Cosmology . Air manifested its position in the cosmos as the Elemental Plane of Air , one of the Inner Planes . The element was also represented there in living form as air elemental s . The ruler over the portfolio of air in Faerûn and Zakhara was the elemental lord Akadi — in the Hordelands known as Teylas — while in the Maztica n pantheon it was held by Qotal . Among demihuman deities , Aerdrie Faenya of the elves held dominion over air . The archomental Yan - C - Bin also announced his wish to dominate the element by calling himself Master of Evil Air . A number of Toril ian powers were concerned less directly with the elemental aspect of moving air , either as beneficial wind — Bahamut , Eha , Hakiyah , Haku , Valkur — or destructive storm — Anhur , Talos , Umberlee ( at sea ) , and Set ( in the desert ) . Magic . School of Elemental Air . Many magic al spells utilized the element of air .

title: Air elemental
description: Air elemental An air elemental was a being made up of wind and living air . It appeared as a cyclone of air that moved in any direction , even against the wind when enraged . Air elementals were always flying , an expression of freedom that they enjoyed to its fullest .
description_long: Air elemental An air elemental was a being made up of wind and living air . It appeared as a cyclone of air that moved in any direction , even against the wind when enraged . Air elementals were always flying , an expression of freedom that they enjoyed to its fullest . They attacked targets from the air , detesting touching the ground even for the slightest moment .

title: Air mephit
description: Air mephit An air mephit was a mephit from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . An air mephit was about four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall and weighed only a pound ( half a kilogram ) .
description_long: Air mephit An air mephit was a mephit from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . An air mephit was about four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall and weighed only a pound ( half a kilogram ) . They had pale white skin . Like all mephits , air mephits were imp ish in appearance and had wispy wings , which sprouted from their humanoid upper torsos . They had whirlwinds where one would expect their legs to be . Personality . Air mephits tended to me more skittish than other mephits . Abilities . Air mephits could heal themselves as long as there was moving air present . They had the ability to breathe a conical cloud of dust and grit . They also had the innate power to surround themselves with vapor about once every hour or to call forth a powerful gust of wind once per day . They were immune to the effects of lightning or poisons . Combat . Air mephits would rather flee than fight , but , if pressed , would attack by biting and clawing and also by injuring opponents with their breath . Society . Air mephits preferred living in places where the wind was constantly blowing , such as mountaintops or shores . Reputation .

title: Air walk
description: Air walk Air walk was a transmutation spell that allowed a single creature to walk on air as though it were solid ground . Effects . Through the use of this spell , a creature or being could ambulate normally with no solid support .
description_long: Air walk Air walk was a transmutation spell that allowed a single creature to walk on air as though it were solid ground . Effects . Through the use of this spell , a creature or being could ambulate normally with no solid support . It was possible to move upwards or downwards , but only at a maximum of 45° , as though walking up or down a slope . Wind affected the air walker normally so it was possible to be blown in one direction in moderate winds , or even be blown uncontrollably in strong winds . Animals were required to be specifically trained to adapt to the effects of this spell before it could be cast upon them with beneficial results . If the spell expired or got dispelled while the creature was still in the air , it drifted to the ground slowly for up to half a minute , but if it was a long way to the ground , the drifting could turn into falling , potentially causing injury . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , as well as the priest ' s holy symbol or divine focus . Earlier versions of this spell also required a wisp of thistledown .

title: Airspur
description: Airspur Airspur was the capital of Akanûl . The city was located on two cliffs facing a narrow bay . Many buildings were located on earthmotes that floated over the bay and were connected to each other and the cliffs by bridges .
description_long: Airspur Airspur was the capital of Akanûl . The city was located on two cliffs facing a narrow bay . Many buildings were located on earthmotes that floated over the bay and were connected to each other and the cliffs by bridges . Although there were some human residents in Airspur , the majority of inhabitants were genasi with airsouls the most common variety . History . Prior to the spellplague , Airspur was a city - state allied variously with Chessenta or Chondath . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR most of the genasi nation of Shyr was translocated from Abeir to Akanûl . The spellplague opened the huge gorge that runs through the city and moved the Sea of Fallen Stars . Most of the population died during the catastrophe . The earth motes that make up Airspur still float , even after the Second Sundering caused others across Faerûn to fall . Government . Airspur was ruled by a hereditary monarch who was advised by a council of genasi of each of the four primary manisfestations : air , water , fire and earth . The council members were selected by nobles . All important government positions were occupied by genasi . Military .

title: Airsteppers Guild
description: Airsteppers Guild The Airsteppers Guild was a messenger guild of windsoul genasi located in Airspur . Due to the vertical nature of Airspur , travel throughout the city was challenging . However , windsoul genasi could levitate over short distances and float and thus made excellent couriers .
description_long: Airsteppers Guild The Airsteppers Guild was a messenger guild of windsoul genasi located in Airspur . Due to the vertical nature of Airspur , travel throughout the city was challenging . However , windsoul genasi could levitate over short distances and float and thus made excellent couriers . Guild members wore blue and white robes and followed a strict code of secrecy .

title: Aizel Treemaine
description: Aizel Treemaine Aizel Treemaine was an elf wizard in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Aizel was hired by the Red Wizard of Thay Varriel to explore on her behalf a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain .
description_long: Aizel Treemaine Aizel Treemaine was an elf wizard in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Aizel was hired by the Red Wizard of Thay Varriel to explore on her behalf a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain . However , she joined the doomed Rutherford Urmbrusk ' s party and disappeared . Just after Rutherford entered a secret passage , Aizel was captured by the vampire Dayan , who used her for one of his experiments . She was placed inside a helmed horror guardian . To power it , a person had to die inside the armor and Dayan chose Aizel as a sacrifice . She was slowly dying from starvation and only Dayan could free her from the armor without killing her .

title: Ajami
description: Ajami Ajami were alien wizard s in Zakhara . Requirements . Ajamis had no special requirements .
description_long: Ajami Ajami were alien wizard s in Zakhara . Requirements . Ajamis had no special requirements . Role . Zakharans treated all outsiders with suspicion , but they were especially wary of those who wielded more power . Possessions . Ajamis typically had foreign equipment . Replacing such outland equipment while in Zakhara usually cost at least five times the item ' s value . Benefits . Ajamis were able to learn new universal Zakharan spell s . Hindrances . New Zakharan magic was impossible for ajamis to learn without taking drastic measures . Even " regular " spells such as " fireball " were beyond their reach because the Zakharan " fireball " was based on the elemental " flame " magic unique to the Land of Fate . Only alien elementalists could learn spells from the equivalent Zakharan element . Ajamis desperate to learn Zakharan magic could abandon their outsider practices and begin study of Zakharan magic but at the cost of forever losing access to all previous spells they learned .

title: Ajantis Ilvastarr
description: Ajantis Ilvastarr Ajantis Ilvastarr is a human paladin in the Baldur ' s Gate computer game . Personality . He is a righteous and somewhat naive young paladin found in the farmlands just north of the Friendly Arm Inn .
description_long: Ajantis Ilvastarr Ajantis Ilvastarr is a human paladin in the Baldur ' s Gate computer game . Personality . He is a righteous and somewhat naive young paladin found in the farmlands just north of the Friendly Arm Inn . Ajantis is a newly trained paladin operating under the Order of the Radiant Heart . He has been sent by his superior Keldorn Firecam to investigate and wipe out the bandits currently plaguing the Sword Coast . Appearances . In " " , it is discovered ( if you have Keldorn or Anomen in your party when you go to the Windspear Hills ) that Ajantis was made to appear like an ogre by Firkraag , tricking the character and his party into killing him and a group of paladins similarly changed . Behind the scenes . As the only NPC paladin in the Baldur ' s Gate game , Ajantis is a good fighter with decent healing abilities .

title: Ajax Firestorm
description: Ajax Firestorm Ajax Firestorm was a red dragon who lived disguised as an elven merchant of Huzuz named Aja Pelima . Description . Aja Pelima , also called Mad Aja , was the eccentric owner of Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons , a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz .
description_long: Ajax Firestorm Ajax Firestorm was a red dragon who lived disguised as an elven merchant of Huzuz named Aja Pelima . Description . Aja Pelima , also called Mad Aja , was the eccentric owner of Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons , a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Aja appeared as an elven male with flaming red hair , but there was much speculation as to his actual heritage . Aja preferred wearing brightly colored clothes and sashes decorated with fireballs and lightning bolts . In his true form Aja Pelima appeared as a venerable red dragon . Personality . Ajax was highly intelligent and unusually patient for a red dragon . He had a wild personality and was a high - pressured salesman . Abilities . Ajax possessed many spell - like abilities but usually favored evocation , enchantment , and charm magic . He also had an uncanny ability to figure out who had the coin to pay for his goods . Possessions . He was known to possess an " amulet of non - detection " , various magical wands ( fire , frost , lightning ) , and a unique wand that was unidentifiable . This wand was actually the control rod for his stolen ship . Activities .

title: Ajayib
description: Ajayib Ajayib , also called the " City of Wonders " , was the youngest of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities , and its most westerly . Beyond it lay the wilderness of al - Suqut Mountains . Trade .
description_long: Ajayib Ajayib , also called the " City of Wonders " , was the youngest of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities , and its most westerly . Beyond it lay the wilderness of al - Suqut Mountains . Trade . The source of Ajayib ' s wealth was cultivated on the steep hills which rose above the city . Though famous for their splendid coffee , Ajayib also exported fruits , frankincense , aromatic gum s . The productions of bright dyes was also a major portion of their trade dealings .

title: Ajhuu
description: Ajhuu Ajhuu was a powerful marid leader during the time of the Calim Empire . He was one of Calim ' s most powerful allies but grew frustrated when Calim capitulated to the elves of Keltormir and the dwarves of Shanatar to fix his borders at the edges of their realms . Ajhuu was one of several powerful genies who broke from Calim ' s alliance to establish their own realms .
description_long: Ajhuu Ajhuu was a powerful marid leader during the time of the Calim Empire . He was one of Calim ' s most powerful allies but grew frustrated when Calim capitulated to the elves of Keltormir and the dwarves of Shanatar to fix his borders at the edges of their realms . Ajhuu was one of several powerful genies who broke from Calim ' s alliance to establish their own realms . By the time Calim returned to his seat of power in Calimport , the city of Ajhuutal had already been built . Calim was determined to bring the rogue genies back under his exclusive control and waged war on Ajhuu , starting the Steam Clashes . Calim won the wars but they took a heavy toll on both sides and the surrounding land .

title: Ajimo Heikaru
description: Ajimo Heikaru Ajimo Heikaru was a Wererat samurai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Heikaru was the first son of the warlord of ito family but against his family ' s wishes he fall in love with Emi Towiki a kitchen worker .
description_long: Ajimo Heikaru Ajimo Heikaru was a Wererat samurai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Heikaru was the first son of the warlord of ito family but against his family ' s wishes he fall in love with Emi Towiki a kitchen worker . Distracted by his love he was negligent in rallying the clan ’ s army when needed in 647 DR . So the curse transformed him in a Wererat condemned to guard his lover room in caves deep the castle for eternity . At last in 1360 DR , an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed him .

title: Ajmer Forest
description: Ajmer Forest The Ajmer Forest was located in northeast Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . This tropical rainforest was stiflingly hot and humid .
description_long: Ajmer Forest The Ajmer Forest was located in northeast Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . This tropical rainforest was stiflingly hot and humid . Inhabitants . The Ajmer Forest was home to the only sizable community of elves within Durpar . These elves were unique among their kind in that they followed the teachings of Adama . The elves monitored the loggers to make sure they collected their timber in a manner that would allow the forest to recover quickly . The southern regions of the forest were home to monsters and many exotic animals . It was even rumored that a rakshasa noble had a headquarters there .

title: Ak ' chazar
description: Ak ' chazar Ak ' chazar are rakshasa with the heads of white tiger s . Abilities . They are powerful spellcasters and specialize in necromantic magic .
description_long: Ak ' chazar Ak ' chazar are rakshasa with the heads of white tiger s . Abilities . They are powerful spellcasters and specialize in necromantic magic . Ecology . They typically keep a low profile , establishing a lair in graveyard or old battlefield and directing their minions to carry out their plots .

title: Ak ' hafta
description: Ak ' hafta Ak ' hafta was a drow soldier hunting Drizzt Do ' Urden in Mithral Hall for Vierna Do ' Urden . History . In 1357 DR , Artemis Entreri disguised himself as Regis and infiltrated Mithral Hall for Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe .
description_long: Ak ' hafta Ak ' hafta was a drow soldier hunting Drizzt Do ' Urden in Mithral Hall for Vierna Do ' Urden . History . In 1357 DR , Artemis Entreri disguised himself as Regis and infiltrated Mithral Hall for Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe . The mercenary was working for Vierna Do ' Urden , who wanted to sacrifice her brother to Lloth . Death . The dark elf used his levitation powers to descend a chute used by Drizzt to escape from his villainous sister . Thinking he had sneaked upon the ranger lying on the ground , Ak ' hafta used his club to strike at the prone drow , but the soldier only hit an empty cloak . Drizzt , breaking his vow of not kill another of his kind a second time , slammed his scimitar , Twinkle , into Ak ' hafta ' s exposed back . Later , Drizzt used a similar trick with Ak ' hafta ' s body to confuse Artemis into thinking the drow ' s body was that of Drizzt , but it failed . Legacy of Ak ' hafta . After his death , Drizzt shot Artemis Entreri with Ak ' hafta ' s hand crossbow while clinging to a cliff in Mithral Hall , after Artemis revealed he had a " cloak of the bat " which saved him from falling to his death .

title: Akabar Bel Akash
description: Akabar Bel Akash Akabar Bel Akash is the name of the male Turmish wizard who is a sometimes companion to Alias of Westgate . His first appearance is in the novel " Azure Bonds " , written by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak . Appearance .
description_long: Akabar Bel Akash Akabar Bel Akash is the name of the male Turmish wizard who is a sometimes companion to Alias of Westgate . His first appearance is in the novel " Azure Bonds " , written by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak . Appearance . Akabar is a tall man with dusky skin and brown hair . He wears a mustache and a beard , the beard being cut straight across the bottom . He has blue eyes , three dots tattooed on his forehead ( marking him as a scholar of religion , reading , and magic ) , and a sapphire earring denoting that he is married . Biography . Akabar describes himself as a mage " of no small water , " though Alias refers to him constantly as a " greengrocer , " or a dabbler in the art . His work shown in the first book would tend to bear out Alias ' disparagement , though he is clearly far more advanced during the third book . He does not have a part in the events of the second book . Akabar joined Alias almost from the first , being the one who reassured the ownership and clientèle of the inn that Alias found herself in at the beginning of Azure Bonds that the unconscious woman was not a witch .

title: Akachi
description: Akachi Akachi was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir . He along with his brother Araman was offered as a " sacrifice , " and they were given the names " Akachi " and " Eveshi . " He became a favored priest , seemingly immune to poison and disease , and was unaffected when a plague called the " Black Whisper " spread throughout Mulsantir .
description_long: Akachi Akachi was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir . He along with his brother Araman was offered as a " sacrifice , " and they were given the names " Akachi " and " Eveshi . " He became a favored priest , seemingly immune to poison and disease , and was unaffected when a plague called the " Black Whisper " spread throughout Mulsantir . Only he and his brother were willing to go forth and tend to the dying in the city , and as such Myrkul allowed the other priests hiding in the temple to be stricken with the plague and die . Akachi was anointed as High Priest , and would continue to spread the teachings of the Lord of Bones and acted as Myrkul ' s hand of justice . For his service as his Chosen , Myrkul took the Silver Sword of Gith from the Nine Hells and gifted it to his high priest . The Betrayer ' s Crusade . Akachi had a lover , a wizard who was Faithless . She died due to accidental spell backfire . Akachi was distraught over her fate ; he knew she would be condemned to Myrkul ' s Wall of the Faithless . He petitioned to Myrkul to spare her that judgement , but Myrkul refused to grant exemption , even for his Chosen ' s beloved .

title: Akadi
description: Akadi Akadi ( pronounced " ah - KAH - dee " ) , the Queen of Air , was the embodiment of the element of air and goddess of elemental air , speed , and flying creatures . As an immortal being of freedom and travel , she instructed her followers to move as much as possible from place to place and from activity to activity . History .
description_long: Akadi Akadi ( pronounced " ah - KAH - dee " ) , the Queen of Air , was the embodiment of the element of air and goddess of elemental air , speed , and flying creatures . As an immortal being of freedom and travel , she instructed her followers to move as much as possible from place to place and from activity to activity . History . Technically , Akadi was not a true goddess but a primordial , a member of an elemental race once in competition with the gods before they were driven away to Abeir . As one of the few primordials who did not war with the gods , Akadi remained in power on Toril . Akadi was considered one of the four elemental deities , a god who remained unchanged by history and the passage of time . Over the course of the Second Sundering , Akadi left Toril for Abeir . Relationships . Akadi had many allies , including Quorlinn and Syranita , but she was enemies with Grumbar , the elemental god of earth and a fellow greater power . The archomental Yan - C - Bin wanted to challenge her power , but in truth Akadi had no superiors among aerial beings .

title: Akalan
description: Akalan Akalan was the original tongue of the Arkaiun s . Speakers . By 1367 DR , Akalan was a language used by most of the population of Dambrath .
description_long: Akalan Akalan was the original tongue of the Arkaiun s . Speakers . By 1367 DR , Akalan was a language used by most of the population of Dambrath . The Arkaiuns of the outlaw Swagdar wastes spoke a Swag creole dialect of Akalan . The language was used by traders across Durpar and Var the Golden and possibly even as far as Zakhara .

title: Akana Kiku
description: Akana Kiku Akana Kiku was a wu jen adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kiku studied wu jen arts under the Grey Master of Okazara .
description_long: Akana Kiku Akana Kiku was a wu jen adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kiku studied wu jen arts under the Grey Master of Okazara . After his death in 1354 DR she started travel for Kozakura . Kiku had many problems with male fighters that always considered her weak and unfit for fight . She always defeat her opponents , hoping that they understood their fault , but most Kiku need changed her base of operations . She liked bought clothing and objects like flowers , gems , and shining metal , but she became bored of them after few time , needing money to buy new ones In 1357 DR Kiku was among the candidates values by Ko Mei Kho for the mission in Akari . In 1358 she had decided to settle in Shou Lung , a more civilized place even for women when was possibly approached by Ko Ho San Behind the scenes . Akana Kiku is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari . She was presented again upgraded for adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Akanûl
description: Akanûl Akanûl was a land that once belonged to the world of Abeir as part of the realm of Shyr , but was transposed onto the plane of Toril during the ravages of the Spellplague . The land carried with it a large population of Abeir genasi who , as of 1479 DR , controlled the region that used to be Chondath and western Chessenta . Geography .
description_long: Akanûl Akanûl was a land that once belonged to the world of Abeir as part of the realm of Shyr , but was transposed onto the plane of Toril during the ravages of the Spellplague . The land carried with it a large population of Abeir genasi who , as of 1479 DR , controlled the region that used to be Chondath and western Chessenta . Geography . Akanûl resembled Abeir much more than Toril . The vast majority of land was a hodgepodge of spectacular spires and erratic ravines . It boasted the largest number of earthmote s and watermotes in all of Faerûn . The southern edge of the region was bordered by a large finger of the Underchasm . One of the land ' s more unusual feature was an enormous piece of translucent quartz known as the Glass Mesa , which citizens were forbidden to approach . Climate . Akanûl was primarily temperate , but due to the large amount of wild elemental energy lingering from the separation from Abeir , wind patterns were erratic , as was weather . The climate in Akanûl was largely humid , due to the constant drift of mist and rain from the watermotes that floated over the countryside . Society .

title: Akar Kessell
description: Akar Kessell Akar Kessel was an unskilled mage who lived in Luskan ' s Host Tower of the Arcane under the tutelage of Morkai the Red . History . During a trip to Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , Dendybar the Mottled persuaded Kessel to kill Morkai in return for a place of power in the Host Tower .
description_long: Akar Kessell Akar Kessel was an unskilled mage who lived in Luskan ' s Host Tower of the Arcane under the tutelage of Morkai the Red . History . During a trip to Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , Dendybar the Mottled persuaded Kessel to kill Morkai in return for a place of power in the Host Tower . Kessel , blinded by greed , killed Morkai - the nearest thing he had to a father . Dendybar , in return , left him to freeze in the snow . By chance ( or perhaps not ) Kessel came upon " Crenshinibon " . The crystal shard dominated his weak mind easily . Together , he and the artifact dominated an army of orc s , goblin s and troll s as well as others over the next five years , allying them with the local Reghedmen and the Balor lord Errtu in an attempt to take over the Ten - Towns before moving on to loftier goals . Kessel didn ' t count on the likes of the drow Drizzt Do ' Urden , his magical companion Guenhwyvar , the barbarian Wulfgar , the dwarf Bruenor , his daughter Catti - brie , or even the halfling Regis - who unravelled Kessel ' s ( Crenshinibon ' s ) plans . Wulfgar caused the Reghedmen to switch sides and Drizzt banished Errtu back to the Abyss .

title: Akashnu Mountains
description: Akashnu Mountains The Akashnu Mountains lay in the land of Malatra in Kara - Tur . Geography . The Akanshu Mountains rose 6000 – 7000 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Akashnu Mountains The Akashnu Mountains lay in the land of Malatra in Kara - Tur . Geography . The Akanshu Mountains rose 6000 – 7000 feet ( 1 . 8 – 2 . 1 kilometers ) above the jungles of Malatra . They had rough terrain and rocky peaks , with a number of valleys between the ridges . History . Thanks to the precious metals and stones found in the Akashnu Mountains , settlements in the mountains flourished . The range soon became home to the Kuong Kingdom , with its priest - kings ruling from the capital city of Suranatra . They grew powerful and maintained safety in the mountains . However , when the capital of the Kuong Kingdom was relocated , the city and mountains were abandoned . The safe - trails became lost and the ways through grew dangerous . The peaks were very dangerous for inexperienced travelers ; most stayed near Srelanat Road . Inhabitants . After the Kuong Kingdom left , the mountains became home to bandits and korobokuru . Those lived in the mountains dwelt primarily in the valleys between the ridges .

title: Akbara Abd al - Yahruq
description: Akbara Abd al - Yahruq Akbara Abd al - Yahruq was a mamluk inhabiting Talab in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akbara was the leader of the Parched Mamluk Society and held the title of Most Respected Warrior .
description_long: Akbara Abd al - Yahruq Akbara Abd al - Yahruq was a mamluk inhabiting Talab in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akbara was the leader of the Parched Mamluk Society and held the title of Most Respected Warrior . She ensured that the supply of fresh water for the city of Talab was never compromised .

title: Akbet - Khrul
description: Akbet - Khrul Akbet - Khrul was a pirate lord of the Pirate Isles . History . In 1361 DR , Akbet - Khrul ' s fleet plagued the seas near Amn until the Council of six hired the Golden Legion to defeat the pirates .
description_long: Akbet - Khrul Akbet - Khrul was a pirate lord of the Pirate Isles . History . In 1361 DR , Akbet - Khrul ' s fleet plagued the seas near Amn until the Council of six hired the Golden Legion to defeat the pirates . Cordell and his men fought Akbet - Khrul ' s pirates in a great battle and were victorious . Halloran found the body of Akbet - Khrul himself with multiple arrows in him after the battle .

title: Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook
description: Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook was a spellbook written by Akdam . It was a thin , traveling spellbook containing several simple spells . The title was printed on the cover in an old , rare script .
description_long: Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook was a spellbook written by Akdam . It was a thin , traveling spellbook containing several simple spells . The title was printed on the cover in an old , rare script . The Vipers bandits took it from a merchant and their leader , Cedric Ravajar , kept it at the Vipers ' Nest in 1369 DR .

title: Akh ' Faer
description: Akh ' Faer The Akh ' Faer ( elven for Army of the Art ) was the arcane branch of the Akh ' Velahr military in the elven empire of Cormanthyr that existed up until the fall of Myth Drannor at the close of the Weeping War . Headquartered in the Art Tower of Castle Cormanthor , they numbered over four hundred " akf ' faern " ( members ) during the empire ' s peak ( circa 650 DR ) . Heirarchy .
description_long: Akh ' Faer The Akh ' Faer ( elven for Army of the Art ) was the arcane branch of the Akh ' Velahr military in the elven empire of Cormanthyr that existed up until the fall of Myth Drannor at the close of the Weeping War . Headquartered in the Art Tower of Castle Cormanthor , they numbered over four hundred " akf ' faern " ( members ) during the empire ' s peak ( circa 650 DR ) . Heirarchy . The Akh ' Faer was mixed between the gold elves and the moon elves . They were comprised of roughly three hundred primary troops ( 4th - 8th level wizards ) , one hundred junior officers ( 9th to 12th level wizards ) and fifty senior officers ( 13th level or higher wizards ) below the leadership . The leader of the Akh ' Faer is called the Spell - Major , and is chosen by ritual of blade - rite , having been able to successfully draw the Artblade . A Spell - Major also names his four second in command , the Spell - Captains . Examine the table to the right to learn about the officer ranks in the Akh ' Faer . To read the table , look at one rank to see what group is is a part of and how many troops he commands as part of that group .

title: Akhlaur
description: Akhlaur Akhlaur was a powerful conjurer who lived in Halruaa during the mid – 12th century DR . Activities . Akhlaur was only interested in increasing his power by researching dangerous magic .
description_long: Akhlaur Akhlaur was a powerful conjurer who lived in Halruaa during the mid – 12th century DR . Activities . Akhlaur was only interested in increasing his power by researching dangerous magic . He eventually summoned a laraken that was beyond his control and he was taken against his will back to the creature ' s native plane . Akhlaur ' s disappearance left a permanent gateway open to the Elemental Plane of Water , causing an unending flow of water to pour forth into the area known as Akhlaur ' s Swamp . Possessions . This powerful conjurer was rumored to own magical items that most wizard s only dreamed about , leading to a steady supply of adventurers delving deep into Akhlaur ' s Swamp with hopes of finding priceless treasure .

title: Akhlaur Swamp
description: Akhlaur Swamp The Swamp of Akhlaur was a marshland located west of Lake Halruaa and Halagard . Description . The swamp covered an oblong area roughly 95 miles ( 152 .
description_long: Akhlaur Swamp The Swamp of Akhlaur was a marshland located west of Lake Halruaa and Halagard . Description . The swamp covered an oblong area roughly 95 miles ( 152 . 8 km ) long by 30 miles ( 48 . 3 km ) wide . The Swamp of Akhlaur was filled with cypress trees , moss and assortment of fauna including crocodiles and dangerous piranha . Unnatural creatures such as undead were also present . Laraken also inhabited the swamp , making this a dangerous location for any spellcaster . History . The swamp was named for the famed conjurer who perished here when he was taken to the Elemental Plane of Water by a summoned laraken . The gate through which he disappeared remained open , allowing a constant flow of water to expand the swamp at a rate of an additional 100 ft . ( 30 m ) per year .

title: Akil Festir
description: Akil Festir Akil Festir was a powerful and ambitious wind mage who resided in Huzuz , the City of Delights . Personality . His delusions of grandeur often exceeded his abilities to bring them to fruition .
description_long: Akil Festir Akil Festir was a powerful and ambitious wind mage who resided in Huzuz , the City of Delights . Personality . His delusions of grandeur often exceeded his abilities to bring them to fruition . History . Akril was credited with founding the Exterminators , an adventuring company specializing in ridding Huzuz of elemental vermin .

title: Akila Abd al - Amin
description: Akila Abd al - Amin Akila Abd al - Amin was a caravan guard captain from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Akila was a small , wiry woman .
description_long: Akila Abd al - Amin Akila Abd al - Amin was a caravan guard captain from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Akila was a small , wiry woman . Activities . She commanded a group of mamluk guards called the " Faithful . " The Faithful was comprised of three 10 - man platoons .

title: Akim al - Kalaas
description: Akim al - Kalaas Akim al - Kalaas was a sha ' ir and leader of the Unclean in 1367 DR . He had many nicknames , including the Sage , the Undaunted , Opener of Wisdom , and He Whom the Stars Obey . Personality .
description_long: Akim al - Kalaas Akim al - Kalaas was a sha ' ir and leader of the Unclean in 1367 DR . He had many nicknames , including the Sage , the Undaunted , Opener of Wisdom , and He Whom the Stars Obey . Personality . Akim behaved like a madman , which was a role he cultivated well to anyone with whom he dealt . Description . Akim was a tall , thin man who appeared almost emaciated . He had a sharply aquiline nose , wild eyes , and an unkempt beard . Activities . As a devout and zealous follower of Hajama , the Zakharan god of bravery , Akim proved his devotion by tempting the patience of genie s . Akim spent much of his time causing trouble in the cities of Zakhara , hoping to bring an attack against Sarahin where the Shadow Caliph might be killed . Through Akim ' s power over genies , a truce was arranged between the Everlasting and the Jann of the Haunted Lands . Because of Grandfather Marwan ' s belief in astrology , Akim came to Sarahin ' s observatory on clear nights to work on astrological charts . History . Akim was the only sha ' ir to be exiled from Hiyal during the entire history of the city .

title: Akima Abd al - Garib
description: Akima Abd al - Garib Akima Abd al - Garib was a mamluk inhabiting the island of Afyal in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akima served as the leader of the Wondrous Mamluk Society , an organization dedicated to protecting the Padisha of Afyal .
description_long: Akima Abd al - Garib Akima Abd al - Garib was a mamluk inhabiting the island of Afyal in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akima served as the leader of the Wondrous Mamluk Society , an organization dedicated to protecting the Padisha of Afyal . Since she publicly shared the padisha ' s belief that his personal troops were not to be wasted , the Wondrous usually only served as guards on parades or within the palace .

title: Akir Abd al - Himaya
description: Akir Abd al - Himaya Akir Abd al - Himaya was the commander of the Defenders Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Akir and his Defenders were responsible for the security and defense of Qudra .
description_long: Akir Abd al - Himaya Akir Abd al - Himaya was the commander of the Defenders Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Akir and his Defenders were responsible for the security and defense of Qudra . This responsibility actually rotated between the various mamluk societies on a monthly basis , but the Defenders were responsible when the other groups were absent from the city . Akir Abd al - Himaya did not hold much power on the Mamluk Council , so he often traded favors in exchange for support for his personal goals regarding the Defenders .

title: Akirakeiko
description: Akirakeiko Akirakeiko was a sohei adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Akirakeiko lived in a Konjo temple in Shizume Province , always busy in skirmishes with rival sohei of Kanchai temple .
description_long: Akirakeiko Akirakeiko was a sohei adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Akirakeiko lived in a Konjo temple in Shizume Province , always busy in skirmishes with rival sohei of Kanchai temple . In circa 1357 DR , however , the Kanchai sohei gained the support of the shugo - daimyo of Shizume and attacked in large numbers , destroying the temple . Akirakeiko survived , being away at an isolated outpost that day . Unable to remain in Shizume because of pressure the shugo - daimyo , Akirakeiko went to the Konjio temple of Miyama , where he met and befriended the young shukenja Annen . Together they went on adventures . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Akirakeiko was a pre - created PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Akkabar ' s battleblade ring
description: Akkabar ' s battleblade ring Akkabar ' s battleblade ring was the first of the " Qysari Rings " and could form a " blade barrier " when a command word was spoken . Description . Like other " shoonring " s , this ring was made from strands of metal woven like twisted vines , but each vine was made of swords touching point to pommel .
description_long: Akkabar ' s battleblade ring Akkabar ' s battleblade ring was the first of the " Qysari Rings " and could form a " blade barrier " when a command word was spoken . Description . Like other " shoonring " s , this ring was made from strands of metal woven like twisted vines , but each vine was made of swords touching point to pommel . The direction of the pointing swords turned at right angles if a cleric , druid , or other priest donned the ring . Warrior s and rogue s saw the raised pattern of swords become smooth to the touch . Wizard s saw no change in the design when placed on their finger . Copies of this ring were known to exist , but they did not exhibit this morphing feature when donned by someone other than a practitioner of the Art . Powers . Once a day the ring could be commanded to produce a " blade barrier " in the direction indicated by the wearer . The swords on the ring unraveled from the wearer ' s hand and became whirling daggers of force that slashed anything that tried to penetrate the sharp curtain .

title: Akkabar Shoon the Elder
description: Akkabar Shoon the Elder Akkabar Shoon was a mighty wizard , the Pasha of Calimshan and the man ultimately behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Description . By all accounts , Akkabar was considered a " prodigy " in regards to the use of magic .
description_long: Akkabar Shoon the Elder Akkabar Shoon was a mighty wizard , the Pasha of Calimshan and the man ultimately behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Description . By all accounts , Akkabar was considered a " prodigy " in regards to the use of magic . He was the first wizard ruler of Calimshan in hundreds of years , and he used magic to extend his lifespan well beyond what was natural for a human . His understanding of the workings of magic allowed him to outwit his rivals , easily scrying through whatever weak magical protections they had . Personality . Akkabar was described as both ever - ambitious and avaricious , seeking power above all else and by any means . Possessions . Akkabar was in possession of the first of the so - called " Qysari Rings " , his " battletide ring " , which he had crafted for him early in his rise to power . With a command word , the ring woulf fly off his finger and form into a circle of blades , much like the effects of the " blade barrier " spell . Activities . Akkabar saw to the construction and development of Shoonach as the capital of his empire .

title: Akkabar Shoon the Younger
description: Akkabar Shoon the Younger Akkabar Shoon the Younger was the less - famous grandson of Akkabar Shoon the Elder , the mastermind behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Relationships . Akkabar the Younger was the son of Akkabar the Elder ' s first son .
description_long: Akkabar Shoon the Younger Akkabar Shoon the Younger was the less - famous grandson of Akkabar Shoon the Elder , the mastermind behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Relationships . Akkabar the Younger was the son of Akkabar the Elder ' s first son . His mother ' s name was Una . His young sister Arhymeria would become Queen of Tethyr , and his younger brother Amahl King of Tethyr after her death . Akkabar was the father of Amahl Shoon II and grandfather of Amahl Shoon III , the first " qysar " of the Shoon Imperium . History . Akkabar was destined to rule over Calimshan as sole heir of Syl - Pasha Akkabar the Elder ' s throne . He plotted along with his grandfather how to absorb the kingdom of Tethyr into Calimshan ; however , he never saw these plans come to fruition , as he was assassinated in −1 DR in what was made to look like a bar brawl . His murderers were Tethyrian clansmen seeking revenge for the death of King Amahl I . This political upheaval caused much suffering in Tethyr , as Akkabar ' s son Amahl II currently ruled Tethyr as a puppet king .

title: Akkabar el Souvlak
description: Akkabar el Souvlak Revered Father Akkabar el Souvlak was the head abbot of the House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing , an Ilmatari monastery on the western coast of Calimshan . Akkabar was a fat man who loved food and believed that his god , Ilmater , wanted to end the suffering of hunger .
description_long: Akkabar el Souvlak Revered Father Akkabar el Souvlak was the head abbot of the House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing , an Ilmatari monastery on the western coast of Calimshan . Akkabar was a fat man who loved food and believed that his god , Ilmater , wanted to end the suffering of hunger . The abbey he ran was dedicated to preaching the appreciation of good food and diet .

title: Akla
description: Akla Akla was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Akla was one of the monks kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a plot to access an elemental node .
description_long: Akla Akla was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Akla was one of the monks kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a plot to access an elemental node . In one of the rooms of the node complex under the monastery , she was kept in the custody of some gargoyle s until an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks defeated the gargoyles and freed her .

title: Aklar Delkash
description: Aklar Delkash Aklar Delkash was a human man and merchant operating in the Vast in the late 1360s DR . History . Aklar was a trader in quality fur s and woven rug s .
description_long: Aklar Delkash Aklar Delkash was a human man and merchant operating in the Vast in the late 1360s DR . History . Aklar was a trader in quality fur s and woven rug s . He planned to sell these in the city of Procampur , and stopped at the hamlet of Sevenecho on the way . There he stayed at the The Worried Wyvern inn . On the 2nd Eleint in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Aklar learned that a local well had been contaminated with a magic - resistant poison . Frightened , he made a quick departure . Description . Aklar Delkash was a dark - skinned man with black hair and bushy eyebrows . He had beady , somewhat shifty - looking dark brown eyes . He was 5 feet and 4 inches ( 1 . 6 meters ) tall and weighed 180 pounds ( 82 kilograms ) . He dressed flamboyantly , in brightly colored fine silk s . This was at odds with his generally dour attitude . Allies . He had hired four mercenaries to protect and assist him on his journey .

title: Akota
description: Akota Akota was a mysterious country somewhere beyond the western shores of Zakhara . It exported gold , slave s , wood , and exotic goods to the Land of Fate through an overland trade route crossing the Southern High Desert to the city of Tajar . It had its own language called Akotan .
description_long: Akota Akota was a mysterious country somewhere beyond the western shores of Zakhara . It exported gold , slave s , wood , and exotic goods to the Land of Fate through an overland trade route crossing the Southern High Desert to the city of Tajar . It had its own language called Akotan . City of Akota . Akota was also the name of a city at Zakhara ' s western shore , located just south of the Range of the Marching Camels , where the caravan route from Tajar to the " country " of Akota ended at the Great Sea .

title: Akura al - Hiyali
description: Akura al - Hiyali Akura al - Hiyali was a member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and remained an active corsair captain despite his responsibilities in the city . Description . Akura possessed medium height and had a trim build .
description_long: Akura al - Hiyali Akura al - Hiyali was a member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and remained an active corsair captain despite his responsibilities in the city . Description . Akura possessed medium height and had a trim build . He had light brown eyes and sun - streaked brown hair . He favored black clothing paired with brightly colored scarves or sashes . He always kept his mustache and beard neatly trimmed . Personality . Akura was bold — so bold that he often attacked other corsair ships in addition to regular merchant vessels . His reputation for aggressiveness and ruthlessness often preceded him . Abilities . Akura was an accomplished sha ' ir and knew many wizard spell s and even a few priest spells . Possessions . Akura possessed a " sash of defense AC 3 " , " jambiya + 1 / + 2 vs . magic - using and enchanted creatures " , " jambiya of fear " ( as " wand of fear " ) , " staff of the sea " , two potions of extra healing , and a " ring of genie summoning " . Most of his treasure was stored in a base located on the far side of the Wizard ' s Reach . Activities . His ultimate goal was to become the next Pirate King of the Corsair Domains .

title: Akyar al - Awasif
description: Akyar al - Awasif Akyar al - Awasif was a noble djinni who lived in Rog ' osto in East Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique among noble genie s , Akyar served the Khedive of Rog ' osto by choice .
description_long: Akyar al - Awasif Akyar al - Awasif was a noble djinni who lived in Rog ' osto in East Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique among noble genie s , Akyar served the Khedive of Rog ' osto by choice . Samia al - Said once freed Akyar from imprisonment , forever earning her gratitude and voluntary service . This was quite the reward for Samia , considering that Akyar was too powerful for even accomplished sha ' ir s to bind . Akyar served as the Sherif of Rog ' osto , though she spent much of her time playing match - maker between some of the younger members of the court . Relationships . Akyar was inseparable from Samia .

title: Akyid al - Neti
description: Akyid al - Neti Akyid al - Neti was the Headmaster of Al - Bidir Sallah , or the " Home of the Seekers of Knowledge " , which was located in Huzuz , in 1367 DR . Description . Akyid was a half - elven male sorcerer .
description_long: Akyid al - Neti Akyid al - Neti was the Headmaster of Al - Bidir Sallah , or the " Home of the Seekers of Knowledge " , which was located in Huzuz , in 1367 DR . Description . Akyid was a half - elven male sorcerer . Activities . Akyid lectured for several hours each week covering the finer points of magic . His audience for these lectures was composed of wizards of at least moderate skill . Foreign wizards wishing to study at the College of Magic were first interviewed by Akyid to determine their motives . These interviews were conducted while Akyid wore a " ring of truth " so he could discern if the applicants were lying to him . History . Akyid was also the dean of the College of Magic and the third such person to hold the title of Dean and Headmaster at the University . He believed that anyone possessing a modicum on intelligence could learn at the least basic magical skills .

title: Al - Adib River
description: Al - Adib River Al - Adib River , also known as the " River of Courtesy , " wound itself through southwestern Zakhara for more than 100 miles ( 161 km ) across the plains of the High Desert to the coast of the Golden Gulf . Description . Al - Adib was filled with rancid water , courtesy of centuries of local humans using it as their dumping ground .
description_long: Al - Adib River Al - Adib River , also known as the " River of Courtesy , " wound itself through southwestern Zakhara for more than 100 miles ( 161 km ) across the plains of the High Desert to the coast of the Golden Gulf . Description . Al - Adib was filled with rancid water , courtesy of centuries of local humans using it as their dumping ground . This practice was forbidden by Sheikh Ali al - Hadd , ruler of Tajar , but most of the local peasants ignored his decree and continued filling the river with soiled clothing , vegetable matter , and even an occasional donkey carcass . Some areas of the river were so congested with garbage that dim - witted " battan " fish lurking just an inch beneath the surface could not be seen , making it one of the least attractive rivers in the Land of Fate . Geography . The western portion of Al - Adib was criss - crossed by a web of small tributaries , many only a few inches deep . Deeper tributaries played home to several variety of " battan " fish that were easily caught and delicious . Salty mineral deposits made the water here undrinkable , even though human pollution was considerably less than the eastern portions of the river .

title: Al - Asaf
description: Al - Asaf al - Asaf , or the Sorrowful , served as the cavalry of the efreet army in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . This part of the army of the efreet had around 25 , 000 lancers and their mounts .
description_long: Al - Asaf al - Asaf , or the Sorrowful , served as the cavalry of the efreet army in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . This part of the army of the efreet had around 25 , 000 lancers and their mounts . They were not very good soldiers and most never returned from their assignments . Activities . Members of this organization served as cavalry for the efreet . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of al - Asaf .

title: Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace
description: Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace was a magical building connected to the Ethereal plane . Description . This huge palace was made from fine white marble and was decorated with minarets .
description_long: Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace was a magical building connected to the Ethereal plane . Description . This huge palace was made from fine white marble and was decorated with minarets . Powers . The owner of the key to the palace ' s front gate could summon the palace wherever they wished . The palace was invisible during the day , though occupants could see everything within the palace once they were inside . At night the palace shone with white light . The interior of the palace was fully furnished , complete with a staff of " unseen servant s " to cater to the owner ' s every whim . Gentle music played by invisible musicians filled the palace . To ensure that future owners did not enjoy the palace after his death , Al - Azid placed a curse upon his home . Once someone used the key to the front gate of the palace , they were forever haunted by an invisible stalker .

title: Al - Azra ' Wadi
description: Al - Azra ' Wadi Al - Azra ' Wadi , or the Blue Valley , was a village located on the Island of Gardens within the Genie ' s Turban off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Description . The village sat between two natural coves , providing beautiful scenery for the natives .
description_long: Al - Azra ' Wadi Al - Azra ' Wadi , or the Blue Valley , was a village located on the Island of Gardens within the Genie ' s Turban off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Description . The village sat between two natural coves , providing beautiful scenery for the natives . It faced the Island of Firethorns , which could be seen across Chaos Bay . The jungle surrounding the village was covered with beautiful blue orchids . Inhabitants . Al - Azra ' Wadi was ruled by Alima bint Khayri . Most of the village ' s inhabitants were former corsairs

title: Al - Badia
description: Al - Badia The term Al - Badia referred to the nomads comprising the wandering tribes of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . These people were driven by the constant need for food , water , and suitable land for their livestock .
description_long: Al - Badia The term Al - Badia referred to the nomads comprising the wandering tribes of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . These people were driven by the constant need for food , water , and suitable land for their livestock . Life wandering the harsh lands of Zakhara transformed " Al - Badia " into a hearty people , most being able to not only survive , but thrive on meager sustenance . Poor by most common standards , " Al - Badia " considered themselves to be the richest people throughout the Land of Fate because of their independence and freedom which they cherished above everything else .

title: Al - Bakbuk
description: Al - Bakbuk Al - Bakbuk , or the Babbler , was a gibbering mouther living in the Pit of a Thousand Voices within Sarahin in 1367 DR . Description . The Babbler was formed from the carcasses of holy slayer s and saluqi greyhounds , giving it a distinct voice that was a combination of both .
description_long: Al - Bakbuk Al - Bakbuk , or the Babbler , was a gibbering mouther living in the Pit of a Thousand Voices within Sarahin in 1367 DR . Description . The Babbler was formed from the carcasses of holy slayer s and saluqi greyhounds , giving it a distinct voice that was a combination of both . Activities . The Babbler fed on holy slayers who were lowered into the Pit of a Thousand Voices as punishment for their crimes against the Everlasting .

title: Al - Barq bin Mawli
description: Al - Barq bin Mawli Al - Barq bin Mawli , or the Lightning , was a member of the House of Mawli in 1367 DR . Activities . Al - Barq was infamous for her lightning - quick attacks on caravans traveling through the southeast regions of the Haunted Lands .
description_long: Al - Barq bin Mawli Al - Barq bin Mawli , or the Lightning , was a member of the House of Mawli in 1367 DR . Activities . Al - Barq was infamous for her lightning - quick attacks on caravans traveling through the southeast regions of the Haunted Lands .

title: Al - Bidir Sallah
description: Al - Bidir Sallah Al - Bidir Sallah , also known as the Home of the Seekers of Knowledge , was a massive university located in Huzuz in 1367 DR that housed 20 , 000 students and hundreds of instructors . Easily the largest of its kind in all of Zakhara , the university included colleges for Alchemy , Barbering , Combat , Fine Arts , Magic , and Science .
