Each college had its own dean who met with the other deans on a monthly basis to discuss university issues .
description_long: Al - Bidir Sallah Al - Bidir Sallah , also known as the Home of the Seekers of Knowledge , was a massive university located in Huzuz in 1367 DR that housed 20 , 000 students and hundreds of instructors . Easily the largest of its kind in all of Zakhara , the university included colleges for Alchemy , Barbering , Combat , Fine Arts , Magic , and Science . Each college had its own dean who met with the other deans on a monthly basis to discuss university issues . All deans reported to the headmaster Akyid al - Neti , who was also the dean of the College of Magic . Students from all over Faerûn were welcome to attend studies here , though outland barbarians paid double fees and were not permitted to pay their way via work - study programs . The six colleges and their deans are listed below : College of Alchemy . Students attending this college were required to provide their own materials and ingredients , hence the high cost of tuition . Classes were divided into three types : General Survey , Basics of Potion - Making , and multiple potion - specific classes . Students often had to wait for a year to attend a specific potion - making class .

title: Al - Fatir River
description: Al - Fatir River Al - Fatir River , also called the Tepid River , was a slow - flowing river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Originating in Al - Yabki Mountains north of Gogal Pass , the Tepid River flowed eastward from the mountain range to the city of Jumlat on the coast of the Golden Gulf .
description_long: Al - Fatir River Al - Fatir River , also called the Tepid River , was a slow - flowing river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Originating in Al - Yabki Mountains north of Gogal Pass , the Tepid River flowed eastward from the mountain range to the city of Jumlat on the coast of the Golden Gulf . The Tepid River measured 70 miles ( 112 km ) in length .

title: Al - Hadhar
description: Al - Hadhar The term Al - Hadhar referred to the sedentary inhabitants of the towns and cities of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . " Al - Hadhar " had easy lives compared to their desert nomad kin .
description_long: Al - Hadhar The term Al - Hadhar referred to the sedentary inhabitants of the towns and cities of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . " Al - Hadhar " had easy lives compared to their desert nomad kin . These people never dealt with the constant search for water , food , and shelter that dominated the lives of " Al - Badia " . " Al - Hadhar " came from all walks of life including the nobility , merchant families , laborers , and craftsmen . Most respected honor and followed the teachings of the Enlightened Gods .

title: Al - Haul River
description: Al - Haul River Al - Haul River was a small river found in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river flowed down from the Furrowed Mountains on a northwestern course before reaching the Great Sea .
description_long: Al - Haul River Al - Haul River was a small river found in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river flowed down from the Furrowed Mountains on a northwestern course before reaching the Great Sea . Description . Qadib , the City of Wands , was founded along Al - Haul ' s eastern bank . As with all rivers found along the coast of North Zakhara , the lands surrounding the banks of Al - Zulma as it neared the coast were highly fertile , allowing the city and its inhabitants to flourish .

title: Al - Hyam Dhazid
description: Al - Hyam Dhazid Al - Hyam Dhazid was a magic - user in Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Al - Hyam acted as an advisor for Tyranthraxus , trying to learn his secrets .
description_long: Al - Hyam Dhazid Al - Hyam Dhazid was a magic - user in Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Al - Hyam acted as an advisor for Tyranthraxus , trying to learn his secrets . However , Tyranthraxus tricked Al - Hyam and he believed he served a true dragon .

title: Al - Iltifat River
description: Al - Iltifat River Al - Iltifat River was one of the mightiest rivers in the Cities of the Ancients in East Zakhara . Geography . Al - Iltifat wound for hundreds of miles from the fringes of the barren Haunted Lands , through the jungles of the Ruined Kingdoms before finally emptying into the Crowded Sea where it met the Salt Jungle .
description_long: Al - Iltifat River Al - Iltifat River was one of the mightiest rivers in the Cities of the Ancients in East Zakhara . Geography . Al - Iltifat wound for hundreds of miles from the fringes of the barren Haunted Lands , through the jungles of the Ruined Kingdoms before finally emptying into the Crowded Sea where it met the Salt Jungle . Description . The course of the river changed constantly as it meandered through the terrain on its way to the sea .

title: Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement
description: Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement The Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement was a group of wandering ethoist priests in the coastal towns of Zakhara . Activities . This group differed from most ethoists organizations in that they chose to wander around the Land of Fate and spread the word of their god .
description_long: Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement The Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement was a group of wandering ethoist priests in the coastal towns of Zakhara . Activities . This group differed from most ethoists organizations in that they chose to wander around the Land of Fate and spread the word of their god . By far , the vast majority of ethoists favored sedentary existences in their temples and mosques . After decades of spreading their word , their activities ceased after the untimely death of their leader .

title: Al - Kufr River
description: Al - Kufr River Al - Kufr River was a small river found in the Free Cities of Zakhara . Geography . Al - Kufr originated in the northern expanse of the Furrowed Mountains .
description_long: Al - Kufr River Al - Kufr River was a small river found in the Free Cities of Zakhara . Geography . Al - Kufr originated in the northern expanse of the Furrowed Mountains . The river flowed northwest on a brief course before meeting the Great Sea . Description . Though small compared to other rivers in Zakhara , Al - Kufr ' s fertile banks were vital for the survival of Hafayah , which was found on the east bank .

title: Al - Malih River
description: Al - Malih River Al - Malih River , also called the Dry River , was located in Zakhara near Halwa in 1367 DR . Geography . This river originated northeast of Halwa somewhere in the Great Anvil and flowed past the city for hundreds of miles toward the southwest .
description_long: Al - Malih River Al - Malih River , also called the Dry River , was located in Zakhara near Halwa in 1367 DR . Geography . This river originated northeast of Halwa somewhere in the Great Anvil and flowed past the city for hundreds of miles toward the southwest . Activities . Al - Malih River was a major feature along the Dihl al - Taif trade route since it offered a fresh source of water to caravans parched from hundreds of miles of desert travel .

title: Al - Malja River
description: Al - Malja River Al - Malja River was found in the far southern corner of west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Malja River flowed east down from Al - Suqut Mountains through the Pearl Cities region .
description_long: Al - Malja River Al - Malja River was found in the far southern corner of west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Malja River flowed east down from Al - Suqut Mountains through the Pearl Cities region . It emptied into the Crowded Sea at Ajayib , the City of Wonders . Description . Though small in size , Al - Malja , and the fertile lands hugging its banks , were vital for the city of Ajayib .

title: Al - Mauqida
description: Al - Mauqida Al - Mauqida , or the Hearth , was the bazaar in the city of Liham in north Zakhara . Description . The Hearth was named for the multitude of red clothing worn by the roaming citizens of Liham .
description_long: Al - Mauqida Al - Mauqida , or the Hearth , was the bazaar in the city of Liham in north Zakhara . Description . The Hearth was named for the multitude of red clothing worn by the roaming citizens of Liham . The marketplace was often clogged with camels and caravans , creating a congested bustle of activity .

title: Al - Nuhas River
description: Al - Nuhas River Al - Nuhas River , also called the River of Copper , was a small river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Al - Nuhas flowed east from the center of Al - Yabki Mountains for 75 miles ( 120 km ) before reaching the city of Sikak on the coast of the Golden Gulf .
description_long: Al - Nuhas River Al - Nuhas River , also called the River of Copper , was a small river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Al - Nuhas flowed east from the center of Al - Yabki Mountains for 75 miles ( 120 km ) before reaching the city of Sikak on the coast of the Golden Gulf .

title: Al - Qadim
description: Al - Qadim Al - Qadim ( literally , " The Old " in Arabic ) is an " " - themed campaign setting for the " Dungeons & Dragons " role - playing game . The setting was developed by Jeff Grubb for TSR , Inc . , and was first released in 1992 .
description_long: Al - Qadim Al - Qadim ( literally , " The Old " in Arabic ) is an " " - themed campaign setting for the " Dungeons & Dragons " role - playing game . The setting was developed by Jeff Grubb for TSR , Inc . , and was first released in 1992 . Al - Qadim is set in the land of Zakhara , called the “ Land of Fate . ” Thematically , the land of Zakhara is a blend of the historical Arabian Empire , the stories of legend , and a wealth of Hollywood cinematic history . Zakhara is a peninsula on the continent of Faerûn in the world of Toril , the locale of the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting , although " Al - Qadim " is designed to stand on its own or be added to any existing campaign setting . The basic campaign setting was divided between two game products : " Al - Qadim : Arabian Adventures , " a sourcebook describing character creation rules , equipment , and spells unique to the setting , and " Al - Qadim : Land of Fate , " a boxed set describing the land of Zakhara , with separate sourcebooks for the players and the Dungeon Master . Important concepts .

title: Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse
description: Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse is a game for MS Dos and was published in 1994 by Strategic Simulations Inc . ( SSI ) . It followed the rules of the 2nd Edition of AD & D .
description_long: Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse is a game for MS Dos and was published in 1994 by Strategic Simulations Inc . ( SSI ) . It followed the rules of the 2nd Edition of AD & D . It is not a typical roleplay game of that era , but more like a single - player action role - playing game . The story takes place in Zakhara . Plot . The player character was a member of the Al - Hazrad family , one of the two ruling families of the town of Zaratan . After his training as a warrior the player returned home and became a part of the feud between both families . A treaty with the Wassabs should have been signed but after that things got worse . The ship with , the princess , the lover of the player , and her father was destroyed by a genie . It seemed that the genie of the family had its hands in destroying the ship . That started the quest of the player to clear the honor of his family and try to rescue his bride .

title: Al - Sabiya River
description: Al - Sabiya River Al - Sabiya River , also called the River of Maidens , flowed through the central region of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Al - Sabiya flowed south from Al - Yabki Mountains for 120 miles ( 190 km ) before emptying into Gana Bay on the Crowded Sea .
description_long: Al - Sabiya River Al - Sabiya River , also called the River of Maidens , flowed through the central region of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Al - Sabiya flowed south from Al - Yabki Mountains for 120 miles ( 190 km ) before emptying into Gana Bay on the Crowded Sea . The large trade city of Gana sat at its mouth . Geography . Al - Sabiya originated high in Al - Yabki Mountains near the center of the Pearl Cities region .

title: Al - Sari River
description: Al - Sari River Al - Sari River divided the city of Liham in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Sari originated in the foothills of the southwest tail of the Furrowed Mountains .
description_long: Al - Sari River Al - Sari River divided the city of Liham in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Sari originated in the foothills of the southwest tail of the Furrowed Mountains . It flowed on a northwestern course until reaching Liham and the Great Sea . Features . Two stone bridges crossed the river as it wound its way through the Furrowed Mountains . These bridges were easily destroyed by removing key stones if the hill tribes inhabiting the region were ever threatened . Al - Badia trading along the banks of the river gave the hill tribes a wide berth to avoid any unwanted debacles . History . Al - Sari River was used to transport goods from Liham across the hinterlands to the people inhabiting the regions of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Al - Sarif River
description: Al - Sarif River Al - Sarif River , also called the River of Nobility , was located in Zakhara . Description . Al - Sarif River originated in Al - Akara Mountains located several hundred miles inland east from Suq Bay .
description_long: Al - Sarif River Al - Sarif River , also called the River of Nobility , was located in Zakhara . Description . Al - Sarif River originated in Al - Akara Mountains located several hundred miles inland east from Suq Bay . Huzuz , the City of Delights , was located along Al - Sarif River . Ferries were used to cross the river and transport students to Al - Bidir Sallah , perhaps the greatest college in all of the Land of Fate . Inhabitants . A pair of dao operated the ferry , crossing Al - Sarif twice every hour . Since the river was often used as a burial ground of sorts , great ghul s took up residence under the surface of the water , feeding on the constant supply of corpses from the city above . Sometimes the ghuls would climb aboard docked ships and feast on lone sentries . A tasked slayer genie was imprisoned under the water within a bottle . The genie ' s previous master dropped the bottle into the water when he was killed during a raid upon the docks of the Harbor District . One of the dao ferrymen stumbled upon the bottle and recognized it for a genie prison .

title: Al - Suqut Mountains
description: Al - Suqut Mountains Al - Suqut Mountains , or the Tumbling Mountains , were found in west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Suqut Mountains separated the western " border " of the Pearl Cities from the Great Sea .
description_long: Al - Suqut Mountains Al - Suqut Mountains , or the Tumbling Mountains , were found in west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Suqut Mountains separated the western " border " of the Pearl Cities from the Great Sea . They were situated just south of the High Desert . Description . The mountains were strung along the western coast of the southern portion of west Zakhara , sitting in a roughly linear north to south position .

title: Al - Tariq Channel
description: Al - Tariq Channel Al - Tariq Channel , also called the Passage , was a strait found in North Zakhara connecting the Sea of Caravans and the North Quarter of Suq Bay . Geography . The Passage stretched for over a hundred miles between the two larger bodies of water .
description_long: Al - Tariq Channel Al - Tariq Channel , also called the Passage , was a strait found in North Zakhara connecting the Sea of Caravans and the North Quarter of Suq Bay . Geography . The Passage stretched for over a hundred miles between the two larger bodies of water . Its southern face was shadowed by the steep cliffs of the Spine of the Dog . Flat grasslands and fertile river basins were found on the northern shore in the foothills of the Furrowed Mountains . History . Al - Tariq served as an important shipping lane , allowing trade between Qudra and the Free Cities with the Cities of the Heart .

title: Al - Wahl River
description: Al - Wahl River Al - Wahl River was an important river found within Interior Zakhara that fed the industry of Hiyal . Geography . Al - Wahl originated in the peaks of the southern tip of the Furrowed Mountains .
description_long: Al - Wahl River Al - Wahl River was an important river found within Interior Zakhara that fed the industry of Hiyal . Geography . Al - Wahl originated in the peaks of the southern tip of the Furrowed Mountains . It flowed south for a short distance before meeting the North Quarter of Suq Bay at the junction of Al - Tariq Channel . Description . Though small , Al - Wahl was a critical resource for the industrious city of Hiyal . The lands surrounding the river were quite fertile .

title: Al - Warrakh
description: Al - Warrakh Al - Warrakh was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As a wizard , Al - Warrakh would use his magical powers to assist Sheik Ar - Rabi on raids in southern Murghôm and on the various tribes of the Plains of Purple Dust .
description_long: Al - Warrakh Al - Warrakh was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As a wizard , Al - Warrakh would use his magical powers to assist Sheik Ar - Rabi on raids in southern Murghôm and on the various tribes of the Plains of Purple Dust .

title: Al - Yabki Mountains
description: Al - Yabki Mountains Al - Yabki Mountains , also called the Mountains of the Tears or simply the Mountains of Tears , were located in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara . Geography . The mountain range ran for several hundred miles from the northwest near Tajar to the southeast near Jumlat and Gana .
description_long: Al - Yabki Mountains Al - Yabki Mountains , also called the Mountains of the Tears or simply the Mountains of Tears , were located in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara . Geography . The mountain range ran for several hundred miles from the northwest near Tajar to the southeast near Jumlat and Gana . Notable Features . Several rivers — including Al - Nuhas , Al - Fatir , and Al - Sabiya — originated within the heights of Al - Yabki Mountains . Rumors & Legends . The mountains were home to a wise genie named Baran al - Amin al - Jinn who acted as a " qadi " for the region .

title: Al - Zabdiyat
description: Al - Zabdiyat Al - Zabdiyat , or the Bowl , was a group of mountainous islands located near Masud Jazayir in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . Geography . The islands of Al - Zabdiyat were crescent shaped laying at the mouth of the Strait of Woe .
description_long: Al - Zabdiyat Al - Zabdiyat , or the Bowl , was a group of mountainous islands located near Masud Jazayir in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . Geography . The islands of Al - Zabdiyat were crescent shaped laying at the mouth of the Strait of Woe . Inhabitants . Most travelers and sailors avoided these islands because of Khadiga . The sha ' ir was known to keep dangerous " pets " that discouraged visitors to her sanctuary . Rumors and Legends . A great domed mausoleum made of clear crystal was rumored to rise from the center of the lagoon .

title: Al - Zalim River
description: Al - Zalim River Al - Zalim River was the lifeblood of Muluk , the City of Kings , in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river began its short trek to the Great Sea in the peaks of the Furrowed Mountains found southeast of Muluk .
description_long: Al - Zalim River Al - Zalim River was the lifeblood of Muluk , the City of Kings , in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river began its short trek to the Great Sea in the peaks of the Furrowed Mountains found southeast of Muluk . Description . Fertile lands were found along each bank of Al - Zalim , allowing Muluk to grow and prosper as a city .

title: Al - Zira
description: Al - Zira Al - Zira , or the Arm , formed the large islands of the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Inhabitants . All kinds of genie s could be found on the islands of Al - Zira .
description_long: Al - Zira Al - Zira , or the Arm , formed the large islands of the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Inhabitants . All kinds of genie s could be found on the islands of Al - Zira . Marid enjoyed the warm coral lagoons , djinn flew through the air with the birds , and dao explored the rocky mountains . The efreet were the only major form of genie not found on the island . Rumors and Legends . These islands were widely feared because they were believed to be owned by the marid .

title: Al - Zulma River
description: Al - Zulma River Al - Zulma River was a small river found in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Zulma orginated in the northern reaches of the Furrowed Mountains .
description_long: Al - Zulma River Al - Zulma River was a small river found in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Zulma orginated in the northern reaches of the Furrowed Mountains . Description . The river stretched for roughly a hundred miles , flowing north and northeast down from the mountains before reaching the coast of the Great Sea and the city of Utaqa . As with all rivers found along the coast of North Zakhara , the lands surrounding the banks of Al - Zulma as it neared the coast were highly fertile , allowing the city and its inhabitants to flourish .

title: Al - jahar
description: Al - jahar Al - jahar , or dazzles , were sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , who masqueraded as beautiful humanoids . Description . The true form of a dazzle was that of a winged humanoid - shaped mass of sparkling light and waves of heat .
description_long: Al - jahar Al - jahar , or dazzles , were sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , who masqueraded as beautiful humanoids . Description . The true form of a dazzle was that of a winged humanoid - shaped mass of sparkling light and waves of heat . Combat . Dazzles could cast " delude " and " non - detection " at will . Hakima s , genie s , and gen had a strong chance to see through their disguises , so they avoided them whenever possible . Al - jahar avoided direct combat , but fueled the emotions of others around them to fight in their stead . They used the following spell - like abilities to accomplish this : " charm person " , " friends " , " hypnotism " , " taunt " , " confusion " , and " ventriloquism " . If discovered , a dazzle would revert to its true form and attempt to fly away . It could use " light " , " shocking grasp " , " blindness " , " rainbow pattern " , and " domination " to assist with its flight . Habitat / Society . Al - jahar were usually found within large cities where they had easy access to prey and could blend in with the population . They used several disguises , each with its own personality .

title: Al Dimeneira
description: Al Dimeneira Al Dimeneira was a powerful angelic deva which tried to defeat the power of Crenshinibon without success . What is known of this being is that at some time it tried to put an end to the evil power of the relic called Crenshinibon . Also the demon Errtu was looking for the relic , but for a different aim : it craved its power .
description_long: Al Dimeneira Al Dimeneira was a powerful angelic deva which tried to defeat the power of Crenshinibon without success . What is known of this being is that at some time it tried to put an end to the evil power of the relic called Crenshinibon . Also the demon Errtu was looking for the relic , but for a different aim : it craved its power . Al Dimeneira banished Errtu back to the Abyss with one single word and then went after the relic . Crenshinibon ' s power overwhelmed the one of the angelic being though , burning its hands . Al Dimeneira just managed to throw the relic across the planes of existence , putting it far away from Errtu ' s grasp .

title: Al Qahara
description: Al Qahara Al Qahara was a hidden elven town located in a cavern in the southern Raurin desert . The settlement was isolated but did some trade with oasis settlements in the desert . Description .
description_long: Al Qahara Al Qahara was a hidden elven town located in a cavern in the southern Raurin desert . The settlement was isolated but did some trade with oasis settlements in the desert . Description . The entrance to the town was located in the face of a ravine . Beyond the entrance was a large plaza lit by oil lamps .

title: Ala ' i Kalin
description: Ala ' i Kalin Ala ' i Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Ala ' i ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded .
description_long: Ala ' i Kalin Ala ' i Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Ala ' i ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded . He viewed the Grand Caliph ' s actions as an abuse of justice and carried deep hatred for the man ever since that day . Activities . Ala ' i used his magical abilities on raids against caravans traveling along Dihl al - Taif . He delighted in slaying as many living targets as possible , a behavior that often earned him scoldings from Fasim Kaldur who saw the value of keeping the caravan animals alive . Relationships . Ala ' i ' s older brother was Mamood Kalin .

title: Ala ' i ibn - Hasim
description: Ala ' i ibn - Hasim Ala ' i ibn - Hasim was a dwarven sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ala ' i was in charge of the Hall of the Treasury .
description_long: Ala ' i ibn - Hasim Ala ' i ibn - Hasim was a dwarven sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ala ' i was in charge of the Hall of the Treasury . His official title was Keeper of the Treasury . In order to prevent him from misusing funds , or betraying the Grand Caliph in other ways , Ala ' i accepted a " geas " . Ala ' i helped secure the treasury by placing " paralysis " glyphs throughout the building .

title: Alaeros Margaster
description: Alaeros Margaster Alaeros Margaster was a red haired fighter and agent of the Lords ' Alliance . He was a very kind man with many talents . He had a moral belief that meant he would never cut down a live tree .
description_long: Alaeros Margaster Alaeros Margaster was a red haired fighter and agent of the Lords ' Alliance . He was a very kind man with many talents . He had a moral belief that meant he would never cut down a live tree . History . Alaeros Margaster was born a noble of Waterdeep . At the age of nine , he was kidnapped by pirates from Luskan . After they sold him to slavers , he was rescued by agents of the Lords ' Alliance . He was brought to the Margaster estate in Neverwinter . Even though he was freed his life did not exactly improve . Alaeros had to live with his cruel uncle , Orn Margaster , who convinced him that his parents never wanted have him . The Margaster family , as a whole , was in fact in great trouble . The noble house had financially indebted itself to the Zhentarim making it more problem then honor to be a family member . The head of the Waterdhavian branch of the family was greatly ill during Alauros youth , and his family fell to infighting to claim what little could be salvaged of their birthright . In the midst of this turmoil , Alaeros was left to fend for himself . At the age of 15 he began service in the local militia .

title: Alagh Rorncaurak
description: Alagh Rorncaurak Alagh Rorncaurak , or the Battlecavern of Unquenched Valor , was both a chasm and a temple of Clangeddin Silverbeard , the Father of Battle , in the dwarven city of Earthfast , deep below the Earthfast Mountains between the Vast and Impiltur , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . Description . Alagh Rorncaurak was a huge natural chasm that served as a natural cathedral to Clangeddin .
description_long: Alagh Rorncaurak Alagh Rorncaurak , or the Battlecavern of Unquenched Valor , was both a chasm and a temple of Clangeddin Silverbeard , the Father of Battle , in the dwarven city of Earthfast , deep below the Earthfast Mountains between the Vast and Impiltur , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . Description . Alagh Rorncaurak was a huge natural chasm that served as a natural cathedral to Clangeddin . It lay in the heart of Earthfast , but with much of the city abandoned , it came to sit on the western edge of the dwarf - held territory . History . In the 1360s DR , Alagh Rorncaurak stood on the frontlines of the orc ish siege of Earthfast . The orcs launched wave after wave of attacks against it , particularly through the ruined western barracks of the temple . The immigrating dwarves of Clan Hammerhand were much - needed reinforcements , and their assistance gave the dwarves time to fortify the temple ' s defences . They kept the temple ' s central sanctuary and the entrance to the rest of the city free of orcish incursion . But " circa " 1369 DR , clashes between dwarven defenders and orc patrols remained frequent . Organization .

title: Alaghôn
description: Alaghôn Alaghôn , the capital of Turmish , was an ancient city that saw its share of trials and tribulations over the years , ranging from terrible fires to occupation by the blue dragon Anaglathos during the Reign of the Wyrm . Throughout all of this , Alaghôn survived as a trade center known as the " throne of Turmish . " Architecture .
description_long: Alaghôn Alaghôn , the capital of Turmish , was an ancient city that saw its share of trials and tribulations over the years , ranging from terrible fires to occupation by the blue dragon Anaglathos during the Reign of the Wyrm . Throughout all of this , Alaghôn survived as a trade center known as the " throne of Turmish . " Architecture . There were numerous stonemasons involved in the creation of the stone buildings , vaults , houses , and drains that comprised Alaghôn . This construction created " a thousand thousand " hiding places . This fact was especially true where the works of a human stonemason covered up the older workings of a dwarven craftsman . The secret passages and cubby holes created by such overlapping workmanship were popular places for children to play . Sometimes , the children ran into monsters - never again to run through the city streets of Alaghôn . When a child went missing , adventuring companies are sent to investigate . Districts . Alaghôn was divided up into city districts . Surprises . Sometimes , children came across long - forgotten vaults that most likely once belonged to ancient rulers of Turmish .

title: Alahar Khaumfros
description: Alahar Khaumfros Alahar Khaumfros was the Waterbaron of Yartar . History . Around 1366 DR , four illithids walked into the Baron ' s Hall and murdered Alahar .
description_long: Alahar Khaumfros Alahar Khaumfros was the Waterbaron of Yartar . History . Around 1366 DR , four illithids walked into the Baron ' s Hall and murdered Alahar . During this time , he was the leader of the Kraken Society and was killed for his fraudulent dealings of the societies money .

title: Alaia Serrat
description: Alaia Serrat Alaia Serrat was a powerful human shaman and one of the three leaders of the merchant family House Serrat . She was the adopted mother of the yuan - ti pureblood Zaltys Serrat . Description .
description_long: Alaia Serrat Alaia Serrat was a powerful human shaman and one of the three leaders of the merchant family House Serrat . She was the adopted mother of the yuan - ti pureblood Zaltys Serrat . Description . In her youth , Alaia was considered attractive in an aloof way . Abilities . Until she lost most of her abilities due to her diminishing connection to the natural world , Alaia could cast powerful shamanic spells . She had a spirit boar she used as a scout . History . In 1362 DR while harvesting terazul blossoms in the jungles south of Delzimmer , guards from her caravan discovered a seemingly human infant girl and brought her back to camp . The child was thought to be the last surviving member of a tribe that had been massacred by derro . Having no children of her own and needing an heir , Alaia adopted the girl and named her Zaltys . In 1479 DR Zaltys discovered that her tribe may have been enslaved rather than killed by derro and decided to enter the Underdark with her cousin Julen in search of survivors . Zaltys and Julen were attacked by derro and she sent a psychic sending to the Serrat guard captain Krailash .

title: Alaine
description: Alaine Alaine was a female human villager of Ember on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alaine was a minor inhabitant of village of Ember , located near Luskan .
description_long: Alaine Alaine was a female human villager of Ember on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alaine was a minor inhabitant of village of Ember , located near Luskan . Gameplay . Alaine would thank the Kalach - Cha and the companions for defeating the githyanki , but could be responded to with hostility , causing Bishop to be impressed . After the Luskans destroyed Ember , the Kalach - Cha and the companions could go to Port Llast to talk with Haeromos Dothwintyl , and could speak with Alaine . Alaine would become aggressive , but reveal that the Kalach - Cha ( or someone that looked like the Kalach - Cha ) had slain many villagers , with a dozen men . She escaped , but it could be learned that the Luskans had let her leave to spread word of what she saw . She would go to the trial to speak her testimony against the Kalach - Cha , but could be persuaded to reveal the truth .

title: Alak Abaeir
description: Alak Abaeir Alak Abaeir was a drow assassin under the employment of the church of Vhaeraun with membership in the same . History . It wasn ' t clear when or where , but Alak Abaeir was born in a traditional drow city ruled by Lolth ' s clergy .
description_long: Alak Abaeir Alak Abaeir was a drow assassin under the employment of the church of Vhaeraun with membership in the same . History . It wasn ' t clear when or where , but Alak Abaeir was born in a traditional drow city ruled by Lolth ' s clergy . He learned early on that him being male meant that he didn ' t have any control over his life . He was conditioned to fear the priestesses and knew that the best future was to become the consort of a priestess who could discard him at any time . He didn ' t give in to fear , though . He started to resent the priestesses for their behavior and the fact that they were secure or in power at all solely due to holding the Spider Queen ' s favor for being female . He wanted to change drow society but knew that he wasn ' t capable of fighting an open battle , so he started fighting them in a more covert way as an assassin . He learned to become unremarkable . He made himself so plain that people didn ' t notice him when he stood in plain sight or remember him after he left their sight . At some point , Vhaeraun , the drow deity of thievery , whose agenda was to free the drow from Lolth , noticed Alak and sent some cleric s of his to recruit him .

title: Alak Faerzhind
description: Alak Faerzhind Alak Faerzhind was the Master of Apportation of the school of Alteration in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Activities . Alak was a senior member of the school of Alteration who served directly the Master of Alteration and member of the Conclave of Sshamath , Shurdriira Helviiryn .
description_long: Alak Faerzhind Alak Faerzhind was the Master of Apportation of the school of Alteration in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Activities . Alak was a senior member of the school of Alteration who served directly the Master of Alteration and member of the Conclave of Sshamath , Shurdriira Helviiryn . His position included the control of all magical and non - magical entry into the city , a position that gave him great influence in Sshamath . Alak served as the primary emissary of the Conclave when the dealing with Darkhold and over the years he forged a strong working partnership with Sememmon and Ashemmi .

title: Alamber Sea
description: Alamber Sea The Alamber Sea was the primary trade avenue between the nations of Mulhorand , Unther , Thay , and Tymanther ( and for a time , High Imaskar as well ) . As a result , its waters were considered neutral territory . Geography .
description_long: Alamber Sea The Alamber Sea was the primary trade avenue between the nations of Mulhorand , Unther , Thay , and Tymanther ( and for a time , High Imaskar as well ) . As a result , its waters were considered neutral territory . Geography . As of 1489 DR , the waters of the Alamber Sea were bordered by Mulhorand to the east and Unther and Tymanther to the west . The nation of Thay bordered the Alamber to the north , except where it connected to the larger Inner Sea . The northernmost island of Alaor served as the center of Thayvian naval power in the region . Inhabitants . Despite its status as neutral territory , merchant vessels and other ships found in the Alamber Sea were usually Thayvian in origin . A considerable number of pirates frequented these waters , and below the surface lay the sahuagin kingdom of Aleaxtis . Trivia . Dragonborn from Tymanther called the Alamber Sea " " Kuhri Ternhesh " " , what means " the River of Stone " in Tymantheran draconic .

title: Alambit
description: Alambit Alambit was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the peninsula of Altumbel and the lands along the coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars towards the Alamber Sea , from Spandeliyon in the northwest to Thasselen in the southeast . Alambit was considered a Chessentic language , being related to Chessentan , and was divided into two dialects , Altumbelan and Coastal ( or Reach ) Alambit .
description_long: Alambit Alambit was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the peninsula of Altumbel and the lands along the coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars towards the Alamber Sea , from Spandeliyon in the northwest to Thasselen in the southeast . Alambit was considered a Chessentic language , being related to Chessentan , and was divided into two dialects , Altumbelan and Coastal ( or Reach ) Alambit .

title: Alamontyr
description: Alamontyr Alamontyr was a large fishing and agricultural town in the far northeast of the Border Kingdoms . It was the easternmost notable settlement within the Border Kingdoms . Alamontyr lay on Zarcel ' s Run , a river that flowed from the Duskwood in the south to the shores of the Lake of Steam in the north .
description_long: Alamontyr Alamontyr was a large fishing and agricultural town in the far northeast of the Border Kingdoms . It was the easternmost notable settlement within the Border Kingdoms . Alamontyr lay on Zarcel ' s Run , a river that flowed from the Duskwood in the south to the shores of the Lake of Steam in the north . Alamontan was the name given to an inhabitant of Alamontyr . Ruler . Alamontyr was ruled by Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer and his forty Griffon Knights , who policed the town and the surrounding areas fairly and with particular respect for local religious leaders . This made him well - loved not only with the people of Alamontyr but also the people of the Realm of the Smoking Star to the west . The Shield Duke was quite old but had not yet named a successor by 1374 DR , leading to much speculation and meddling . Trade . Because of the relative safety and security of life in Alamontyr , it had become home to many different craftspeople , such as finesmiths , woodcarvers , potters , glaziers , jewelers , and tailors , who exported their wares widely . Attempts to bring corruption to Alamontyr had been made by Chessenta , Westgate , the Red Wizards , and Zhentil Keep .

title: Alandor River
description: Alandor River The Alandor River was a major river in Amn . Description . The Alandor was a slow - moving and wide river .
description_long: Alandor River The Alandor River was a major river in Amn . Description . The Alandor was a slow - moving and wide river . Because of this , it had a great deal of barge traffic , especially between the cities of Crimmor and Athkatla . Horses and mules towed barges up the river along the River Road . In Crimmor , children often used the river for swimming . The river flooded in the early spring . The lands south of the river were good for grazing . Geography . The river began at Minsor Vale on the southeastern point of Lake Weng . From there , it flowed west , passing Crimmor before emptying into the Sea of Swords at Athkatla , splitting the city in two .

title: Alandra
description: Alandra Alandra was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Alandra was a Cult member who joined the reformed faction under Severin Silrajin .
description_long: Alandra Alandra was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Alandra was a Cult member who joined the reformed faction under Severin Silrajin . She was the main cultist delegate to the great dragon Claugiyliamatar of Kryptgarden Forest . She managed to establish an alliance with the green dragon ' s primary agent , Garbul , also acquiring the Green Dragon ' s Mask . However , in the end , both Garbul and Alandra were killed by an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones .

title: Alansyn Ambrilar
description: Alansyn Ambrilar Alansyn Ambrilar was a male human cleric of Lathander , the Morninglord , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Ambrilar was High Morninglord of the Morning Halls temple to Lathander at the time . He led fourteen priests and twenty - one lay - followers .
description_long: Alansyn Ambrilar Alansyn Ambrilar was a male human cleric of Lathander , the Morninglord , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Ambrilar was High Morninglord of the Morning Halls temple to Lathander at the time . He led fourteen priests and twenty - one lay - followers .

title: Alanza DaNosta
description: Alanza DaNosta Alanza DaNosta was a member of the Golden Legion . Personality . DaNosta was well known for his greed .
description_long: Alanza DaNosta Alanza DaNosta was a member of the Golden Legion . Personality . DaNosta was well known for his greed . He plotted to gain such a large amount of gold that nobody would notice the trifling amount that he diverted for himself . Relationships . Ironspike secretly worked for him . History . DaNostaa was appointed as commander of the garrison of Fort Cordell by the Amn ian government . He spent most of his time cataloguing all the mistakes he felt had been made by Governor Cordell , especially his leniency to the Payit . In 1362 DR , he tried to convince the adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume to instead give it to him after recovered it .

title: Alaor
description: Alaor Alaor ( or sometimes The Alaor ) was an island on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was under the control of Thay and housed Thayan shipyards until it was wiped out by a huge wave caused by a volcanic eruption . The House of Holy Tides , a temple to Istishia on the southern shore of the island , survived intact , and went on to take power , turning the island into a free state .
description_long: Alaor Alaor ( or sometimes The Alaor ) was an island on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was under the control of Thay and housed Thayan shipyards until it was wiped out by a huge wave caused by a volcanic eruption . The House of Holy Tides , a temple to Istishia on the southern shore of the island , survived intact , and went on to take power , turning the island into a free state . Mulhorand sought to control the island and regularly blockaded its ports .

title: Alaphondar
description: Alaphondar Lord Alaphondar was one of the leading sages in service to the royalty of Cormyr in Suzail . Background . Flammos Galdekund .
description_long: Alaphondar Lord Alaphondar was one of the leading sages in service to the royalty of Cormyr in Suzail . Background . Flammos Galdekund . In 1369 DR , during the abraxus affair , Alaphondar was disguised as a stooped , stout merchant with missing teeth . He assumed the name of " Flammos Galdekund " , so that he and Queen Filfaeril Obarskyr could hide in Waterdeep until the plot against the crown could be resolved . Possessions . Alaphondar had a magical stone that could summon the High Wizard Vangerdahast .

title: Alarashan Tlor
description: Alarashan Tlor Alarashan Tlor was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was one of the more rationally minded magelords and agreed with his master Ithboltar to fight together but died in the spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower .
description_long: Alarashan Tlor Alarashan Tlor was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was one of the more rationally minded magelords and agreed with his master Ithboltar to fight together but died in the spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower .

title: Alaric Hembreon
description: Alaric Hembreon Alaric Hembreon was a Tethyrian noble and member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Alaric spent all his life in Tethyr ian politics , being the heir of the Draknor duchy and a member of the Knights of the Shield by family connections .
description_long: Alaric Hembreon Alaric Hembreon was a Tethyrian noble and member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Alaric spent all his life in Tethyr ian politics , being the heir of the Draknor duchy and a member of the Knights of the Shield by family connections . In his youth , he was the standard bearer of Prince Rythan at the disastrous Battle of Nightflames . Alaric managed to take the dead body of the prince back home , whom he considered the epitome of all the virtues of a true king . However , just fifteen days before the Days of Terror , he was exiled from Tethyr on trumped - up charges . Alaric came back in his country in 1349 DR to help reunify the kingdom , becoming a member of the council in Zazesspur . Alaric was the first noble to submit to Zaranda Star , whom Alaric saw as a fellow spirit of Rythan . He was permitted by the queen to be the duke of the Golden Marches , in the hope of eradicating the blight of the Duchy of Dusk . He was also nominated as Lord High Chancellor of Tethyr .

title: Alarm
description: Alarm Alarm was an abjuration spell designed to alert its caster . Effects . The caster picked an area of no more than 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: Alarm Alarm was an abjuration spell designed to alert its caster . Effects . The caster picked an area of no more than 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) wide that when crossed by a creature the spell would alert the caster . When casting the spell , the caster could choose what creatures would not trigger the alarm . The alarm itself was a " ping " in the mind of the caster that would wake them if they were asleep . Components . To cast this spell , the wielder needed a small bell and a length of slender silver wire .

title: Alaron
description: Alaron Alaron was an island in the Moonshae Isles . Although not the largest of the Moonshae Isles , it was considered the most powerful prior to the Spellplague . In the 14th century DR , the isles were collectively ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr by High Queen Alicia Kendrick .
description_long: Alaron Alaron was an island in the Moonshae Isles . Although not the largest of the Moonshae Isles , it was considered the most powerful prior to the Spellplague . In the 14th century DR , the isles were collectively ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr by High Queen Alicia Kendrick . While the capital was a port on the eastern side of Alaron , the castle from which the Kendrick family ruled was actually built by previous inhabitants of the Moonshaes . Alaron was House Kendrick ’ s last bastion of a once great empire among the Isles . Society . Ruled from the city of Caer Callidyrr , the island of Alaron was the seat of House Kendrick ' s power . The rugged Fairheight Mountains to the north of Caer Calliyrr separated the traditional lowland homes of the Ffolk in the south from the homes of the Northlander s . Intermarriage between the two peoples slowly eliminated the divide between their customs . Notable Locations . Caer Callidyrr . This city on the northern edge of the Dernall Forest was the home of High King Derid . Dernall Forest . A forest teeming with goblin s and evil fey . Druid s loyal to King Derid waged war with the humanoid s . Fairheight Mountains .

title: Alascartha Vyperwood
description: Alascartha Vyperwood Alascartha Vyperwood was a human woman and a fighter . She was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .
description_long: Alascartha Vyperwood Alascartha Vyperwood was a human woman and a fighter . She was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Alascartha was formerly an adventuress in Bellas ' s Band , under Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while Alascartha took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . Activities . Alascartha and the dukes grew increasingly wealthy and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . In all decisions on major policies , Alascartha had one vote while Bellas had two . Alascartha and the Dukes often confiscated property and magic from visitors , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power . They acquired a large collection of magical item s this way , and still sought more . Alascartha lived in a palatial house close to the Fortress of the Five Vultures .

title: Alashan
description: Alashan Alashan was a city located in the kingdom of Khazari within the Hordelands . Geography . This important city sat along the banks of the Kuruk Muren river where the Silk Road passed through the western border of the country .
description_long: Alashan Alashan was a city located in the kingdom of Khazari within the Hordelands . Geography . This important city sat along the banks of the Kuruk Muren river where the Silk Road passed through the western border of the country . Alashan was nestled into a pass where the steep Katakoro Shan mountains broke . Trade . Alashan ' s position along the Silk Road caused great wealth to flow through the city . Many merchants and craftsmen called this city home . Defenses . Alashan ' s location offered strong natural defenses . In addition to these , strong fortifications were built , sheltering the city within from raiding horse bandits . A large gate house was complimented by towers located at each corner of the city , and a fortified palace dominated the center . A walled gate built across the Silk Road made collecting tolls and defending the pass an easier ordeal . Some 3 , 000 soldiers were assigned to guard the pass , and an additional 4 , 000 were kept in reserve guarding the palace and patrolling the countryside . These soliders were mostly footmen , armed with spears and longswords , with cotton padded armor , and large wicker shields . History .

title: Alasklerbanbastos
description: Alasklerbanbastos Alasklerbanbastos was an ancient blue dracolich who ruled Threskel from his lair on Mount Thulbane . He held the distinction of being the only dracolich to have his physical form destroyed twice in the same year . History .
description_long: Alasklerbanbastos Alasklerbanbastos was an ancient blue dracolich who ruled Threskel from his lair on Mount Thulbane . He held the distinction of being the only dracolich to have his physical form destroyed twice in the same year . History . Pre - Spellplague . Alasklerbanbastos fought with Tchazzar over control of western Unther during the 10th century DR . When Tchazzar became divine in 1018 DR , Alasklerbanbastos enlisted the aid of the Cult of the Dragon to become a dracolich . After the dragon cult cell in Unther collapsed in 1024 DR , Alasklerbanbastos went to sleep for several centuries , emerging only occasionally to wreak havoc in surrounding lands . In 1324 DR he emerged from his lair to inflict a summer - long reign of terror . When Tchazzar was thought to have died during the Time of Troubles , Alasklerbanbastos began rebuilding the Cult of the Dragon in Unther . When Tchazzar returned in 1373 DR , he slaughtered many of the young Chromatic dragon s allied with Alasklerbanbastos . Post - Spellplague . In 1479 DR , Alasklerbanbastos began sending humanoid troops on raids into Chessenta . The raids started a short war with Chessenta that Threskel lost .

title: Alastra Hathwinter
description: Alastra Hathwinter Alastra Hathwinter was a wizard in Longsaddle . History . In her youth , Alastra was a wide - wandering adventurer : she went from Nimbral to Malatra in Kara - Tur and from Zakhara in the distant south to the castles of the cloud giant s above the endless ice of the North .
description_long: Alastra Hathwinter Alastra Hathwinter was a wizard in Longsaddle . History . In her youth , Alastra was a wide - wandering adventurer : she went from Nimbral to Malatra in Kara - Tur and from Zakhara in the distant south to the castles of the cloud giant s above the endless ice of the North . Finally , Alastra settled in Longsaddle near her friend Auglyth Harpell . Alastra opened a festhall in the village and continued her business even after Auglyth died in 1358 DR . She was rumored to be a Harper or a Harper ally . Alastra resurfaced around 1487 DR as a fully Harper , and secret lover of Malchor Harpell , and competed with other archmages for the possession of the Lost Spell during a spellstorm . Alastra was however killed by Maraunth Torr .

title: Alasturan Malatheer
description: Alasturan Malatheer Alasturan Malatheer was a shopkeeper in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . He was also the local representative of the female adventuring company , the Galadran Company , and collaborated often with the Soft Claws .
description_long: Alasturan Malatheer Alasturan Malatheer was a shopkeeper in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . He was also the local representative of the female adventuring company , the Galadran Company , and collaborated often with the Soft Claws . Unknown to him , his good friend Amundra Nelaerdra was the leader of the Soft Claws , and a steel dragon . Personality . Alasturan was always in control of himself . His shop sold maps and charts .

title: Alasz Ironwood
description: Alasz Ironwood Alasz Ironwood was a sarcastic horse breeder and trader in High Dale . History . Alasz was once a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale .
description_long: Alasz Ironwood Alasz Ironwood was a sarcastic horse breeder and trader in High Dale . History . Alasz was once a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Alasz was a member of the Council of the High Dale .

title: Alathene Moonstar
description: Alathene Moonstar Alathene Moonstar was the archlich matriarch of House Moonstar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . She was for a long time involved in the faith of Selûne in the city . Alathene was obsessed with hunting down her evil brother Vanrak Moonstar and bringing him to justice .
description_long: Alathene Moonstar Alathene Moonstar was the archlich matriarch of House Moonstar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . She was for a long time involved in the faith of Selûne in the city . Alathene was obsessed with hunting down her evil brother Vanrak Moonstar and bringing him to justice .

title: Alatorin
description: Alatorin Alatorin was the ancient dwarven settlement formed when Taark Shanat ' s dwarves defeated the inhabitants of Rringlor Noroth in the Cloaker Wars , including four blue dragon s slain by Taark himself . It was the first settlement established in Shanatar and contained Brightaxe Hall and the famous Wyrmskull Throne . History .
description_long: Alatorin Alatorin was the ancient dwarven settlement formed when Taark Shanat ' s dwarves defeated the inhabitants of Rringlor Noroth in the Cloaker Wars , including four blue dragon s slain by Taark himself . It was the first settlement established in Shanatar and contained Brightaxe Hall and the famous Wyrmskull Throne . History . Alatorin was founded at the end of the Cloaker Wars when Taark Shanat ' s dwarves claimed the caverns for themselves . It was captured by the drow of Guallidurth during the First Spider War ( - 8170 to - 8150 DR ) , at which time the eight kingdoms of Shanatar allied to reclaim it . The Second Spider War in - 8145 DR saw the dwarves reclaim Alatorin from the drow , but the drow attacked again in the Third Spider War around - 6150 DR . This conflict lasted around thirty years , with the eventual victory of the drow . Alatorin was evacuated by the dwarves ( who took the Wyrmskull Throne with them ) .

title: Alatos Thuibuld
description: Alatos Thuibuld Alatos Thuibuld , known as " Ravenscar " , was the leader of a thieves ' guild in Baldur ' s Gate . History . In the years prior to the return of Eldrith the Betrayer , Ravenscar was the guildmaster of the thieves until she created her own thieves guild led by the beholder Xantam , it was aptly named the Guild of Xantam .
description_long: Alatos Thuibuld Alatos Thuibuld , known as " Ravenscar " , was the leader of a thieves ' guild in Baldur ' s Gate . History . In the years prior to the return of Eldrith the Betrayer , Ravenscar was the guildmaster of the thieves until she created her own thieves guild led by the beholder Xantam , it was aptly named the Guild of Xantam . The Zhentarim Agent Karne destroyed the guild for Xantam who was then executed according to the Zhentarim ' s plans . Around 1369 DR , Alatos recruited Gorion ' s Ward for a mission under the orders of Resar . Personality . He maintained a civil , yet somewhat distant relationship with the city ’ s four Grand Duke s .

title: Alaundo
description: Alaundo Alaundo the Seer was the singular sage whose prophecies proved to be true over the years . Citing a seer from past ages that Alaundo called “ the T Source ” , the prophecies he made included The Creation of the Bhaalspawn and The Creation of the Seven Scourges . Upon his death , Candlekeep became a haven for the veneration of his prophecies and knowledge .
description_long: Alaundo Alaundo the Seer was the singular sage whose prophecies proved to be true over the years . Citing a seer from past ages that Alaundo called “ the T Source ” , the prophecies he made included The Creation of the Bhaalspawn and The Creation of the Seven Scourges . Upon his death , Candlekeep became a haven for the veneration of his prophecies and knowledge . Alaundo arrived at Candlekeep in 75 DR . His skull was supposedly stolen shortly after his death and was a priceless relic venerated by the faithful of Deneir , Oghma and Savras . It was greatly sought after by the illithid s of Oryndoll , and rumours of its existence and whereabouts around 1370 DR caused an increase in illithid activity on the southern shores of the Deepwash . It was said that the bearer of the skull could speak directly with Alaundo using a " speak with dead " spell .

title: Alauthshaee
description: Alauthshaee Lady Alauthshaee was a female elf notorious for her wealth and the manner of her death . History . Over her life - time , Lady Alauthshaee married six wealthy husbands , and outlived each one .
description_long: Alauthshaee Lady Alauthshaee was a female elf notorious for her wealth and the manner of her death . History . Over her life - time , Lady Alauthshaee married six wealthy husbands , and outlived each one . Each time , she took her deceased husband ' s fortune as her own , growing extremely wealthy . This made her famous and notorious . An elven mage , Ilthuryn , tried to court Alauthshaee , but she rejected him harshly . Enraged , Ilthuryn attacked her with wild spell s as she rode in her flying carriage . It reportedly crashed to earth within Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast . Ilthuryn then buried the carriage , the guards , and Alauthshaee herself alive . The spell - battle left a dead - magic zone over the valley . By 1370 DR , the flying carriage of Lady Alauthshaee and the great treasures within had not been found , but were thought to be buried or sunk in a pond somewhere in Dead Tree Hollow . It also possibly still contained the bodies of Alauthshaee and her guards . Adventurer s occasionally came to search the valley for it . Personality . Alauthshaee was described as haughty . Possessions . Via her husbands , Alauthshaee collected extreme wealth .

title: Albaeri Mellikho
description: Albaeri Mellikho Albaeri Mellikho was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Albaeri was a pot - bellied and jovial woman .
description_long: Albaeri Mellikho Albaeri Mellikho was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Albaeri was a pot - bellied and jovial woman . She was recently worried about the strange activity of the moving stones in the hidden chambers below Red Larch , but she was reluctant to share her concerns with strangers . Activities . Albaeri ran a stoneworks shop in the village . History . In 1491 DR , Larrakh of the Cult of Black Earth used Albaeri ' s shop as a meeting place with the Believers and she help scare her own stonecutters . Later , under Larrakh ' s secret suggestions , Albaeri , along with Ilmeth Waelvur and Marlandro Gaelkur , killed some people in order to protect the secret of the Believers . Discovered her crimes by some adventurers she until the end professed her innocence

title: Albaeron Thalion
description: Albaeron Thalion Albaeron Thalion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . History . Thalion hailed from Athkatla , where he was a great calligrapher and artist until Oghma appeared in his dreams to call him .
description_long: Albaeron Thalion Albaeron Thalion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . History . Thalion hailed from Athkatla , where he was a great calligrapher and artist until Oghma appeared in his dreams to call him . In time , he became one of the Great Readers of Candlekeep . In 1487 DR , Thalion , after being saved from shadovar and Moonstars , agreed to participate in Larloch ' s plan to rebuild the Weave .

title: Alban
description: Alban Alban was a wight ruler in Maztica . History . Alban was the ruler of the city of Mictlatepec , an administrative center of the old Zateca people .
description_long: Alban Alban was a wight ruler in Maztica . History . Alban was the ruler of the city of Mictlatepec , an administrative center of the old Zateca people . The arrogant Alban decided that he wanted to live forever so he instructed the royal hishnashaper s to create a talisman that would allow him to do so . However , at the time of his death , Alban rose again as a wight . In fury , Alban slew some of the hishnashapers with his new power . Afterward , however , he came to appreciate his new form and ordered the surviving hishnashapers to forge an artifact able to create more creatures like him . They created the knife of perpetual service , which transformed all people killed with it into various kinds of lesser undead , like ghoul s , ghast s , or zombie s , depending on their former social standing . Alban eventually killed all the city ' s inhabitants . They continued to do at night the same things they did as living beings , while sleeping during the day .

title: Albarrana
description: Albarrana Albarranas were the fortresses used by efreet for defensive purposes that were scattered across their vast empire . Location . Each efreet thurgur could have up to four albarranas within its borders .
description_long: Albarrana Albarranas were the fortresses used by efreet for defensive purposes that were scattered across their vast empire . Location . Each efreet thurgur could have up to four albarranas within its borders . Description . These fortresses were composed of rock , brick , and a special concrete made from volcanic rock . Inhabitants . Between 1 , 000 and 5 , 000 efreet soldiers were garrisoned at each albarrana . They were commanded by a single noble efreeti . When in the field , these heavily armed units were usually accompanied by special guides and scouts called " dalil " .

title: Albert
description: Albert Albert seemed to be a young boy in Nashkel , looking for his dog Rufie . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward offered to help him but when Gorion ' s Ward delivered the dog to Albert , he revealed his true form , a pit fiend . Albert and his dog then " plane shift ed " back to the Nine Hells .
description_long: Albert Albert seemed to be a young boy in Nashkel , looking for his dog Rufie . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward offered to help him but when Gorion ' s Ward delivered the dog to Albert , he revealed his true form , a pit fiend . Albert and his dog then " plane shift ed " back to the Nine Hells .

title: Albhaera Haerldoun
description: Albhaera Haerldoun Albhaera Haerldoun was a Vaasan human woman . She was an adventurer and wizard , and owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description .
description_long: Albhaera Haerldoun Albhaera Haerldoun was a Vaasan human woman . She was an adventurer and wizard , and owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description . Albhaera was a strikingly beautiful woman , and was fit and lithe in build . She made a habit of wearing exotic armors of flattering designs and revealing cutaway sections , which attracted customers to her store . Personality . When young , Albhaera was demure and quietly spoken , though she was restless and charismatic . She grew into a hot - tempered and flirtatious woman , but settled down a bit in later years . Abilities . When young , Albhaera was a proficient fighter , and was well trained , fit , and dexterous . She knew how to make and repair helm s , bracers , shield s , belt s , and baldric s , and also knew their proper values . Later in life , Albhaera practiced as a wizard , and worked a smithy as part of her trade . Activities . Albhaera imported and sold a range of armor pieces and shield s , as well as some basic weapon s , from her store and had an excellent range . Her store was also the best place in Wheloon to buy and sell magical armors .

title: Albie Grizlow
description: Albie Grizlow Albie Grizlow was a teenager cattle rancher in Uluvin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Albie and his friend Leshonna Daar escaped after their village was invaded by a group of hill giant s and goblin s .
description_long: Albie Grizlow Albie Grizlow was a teenager cattle rancher in Uluvin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Albie and his friend Leshonna Daar escaped after their village was invaded by a group of hill giant s and goblin s . They tried to recruit a traveling adventuring party to save Uluvin

title: Alchemist
description: Alchemist An alchemist was a craft profession . At the most basic level , anyone who mixed substances together in a liquid form to create a wanted effect could be considered an alchemist . Alchemy required a fair amount of intelligence , as well as time and materials .
description_long: Alchemist An alchemist was a craft profession . At the most basic level , anyone who mixed substances together in a liquid form to create a wanted effect could be considered an alchemist . Alchemy required a fair amount of intelligence , as well as time and materials . It could also be a very expensive pursuit . An alchemist could craft mundane substances , such as acid , alchemist fire , sunrod s , tanglefoot bags and thunderstones , magical substances such as potions and oils , and other things such as the special brews that were used in the process of creating a dracolich . Not all alchemists were spellcasters , but many were , as spellcasting ability was needed to make magical potions . Of all the races , gnomes were best known across the Realms as alchemists .

title: Alcheringa
description: Alcheringa Alcheringa was a philosophy followed by the Osslander s of Osse . They revered ancestral heroes as totems and believed that the stars were the spirits of their ancestors . One of these was Tumbarum , revered as the spirit of music .
description_long: Alcheringa Alcheringa was a philosophy followed by the Osslander s of Osse . They revered ancestral heroes as totems and believed that the stars were the spirits of their ancestors . One of these was Tumbarum , revered as the spirit of music . Appendix . Background . " " Alcheringa " " is a word in the referring to the in Indigenous Australian beliefs .

title: Aldamair Galashar
description: Aldamair Galashar Aldamair Galashar was a rogue hired by Gormstadd the Rerisen of Voonlar to be the steward of Twilight Gate Farm , a hunting lodge , and the surrounding land until Gormstadd retired and was able to take possession himself . Description . In his younger days , Aldamair was a good - looking charmer , but as he aged his comeliness faded a bit .
description_long: Aldamair Galashar Aldamair Galashar was a rogue hired by Gormstadd the Rerisen of Voonlar to be the steward of Twilight Gate Farm , a hunting lodge , and the surrounding land until Gormstadd retired and was able to take possession himself . Description . In his younger days , Aldamair was a good - looking charmer , but as he aged his comeliness faded a bit . Personality . Aldamair ' s youthful charm and good looks allowed him to be a womanizer , but his charm turned slick and creepy in his later years . To Gormstadd and anyone else who could advance his personal wealth or standing , he was deferential to the point of obsequiousness . Abilities . Aldamair was very nimble , ambidextrous , able to bluff anyone from thugs to nobility , and a skilled pick pocket . He was good with disguises , locks , spreading rumors , and was a passable forger . Activities . He was a member of a crime syndicate that operated in many ports around the Sea of Fallen Stars . Their " modus operandi " was to loot a warehouse and substitute garbage for the stolen goods , then burn the building to hide the evidence .

title: Aldanon
description: Aldanon Aldanon is an important NPC in the Neverwinter Nights 2 official campaign . Abilities . An accomplished wizard , Aldanon had specialised in the art of divination .
description_long: Aldanon Aldanon is an important NPC in the Neverwinter Nights 2 official campaign . Abilities . An accomplished wizard , Aldanon had specialised in the art of divination . In addition , he was capable of crafting magic al wand s and potion s . History . Aldanon is a wealthy , yet absent - minded , sage living in the Blacklake district of Neverwinter . Originally , he build his manse on the outskirts , away from the main thoroughfare , but the reconstruction following the war with Luskan resulted in his home being in the middle of the new Blacklake district . As such , he began putting wards in order to keep out opportunistic nobles hoping to buy his estate , as well as the recent murderer on the loose . Aldanon had came into the possession of one of the silver shard from the Sword of Gith , though he had long since forgotten who sold it to him . He knew Ammon Jerro from long ago , when he was a court wizard at Castle Never , and knew that Jerro had once possessed a githyanki silver sword ( though not that it was Gith ' s own blade ) .

title: Aldeth Sashenstar
description: Aldeth Sashenstar Aldeth Sashenstar was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a head of the Merchant ' s League . Relationships . Aldeth had a nephew , Dabron Sashenstar .
description_long: Aldeth Sashenstar Aldeth Sashenstar was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a head of the Merchant ' s League . Relationships . Aldeth had a nephew , Dabron Sashenstar . History . When Aldeth met Gorion ' s Ward in Cloak Wood , he asked for protection from some druid s . Gameplay . If Gorion ' s Ward helped Aldeth in Cloak Wood , then they would meet him again at the headquarters of the Merchant ' s League . Aldeth would then ask them to investigate strange things happening in his organization .

title: Aldimer
description: Aldimer The Aldimer family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Aldimers were allied with the Mathlin and Uruthkurt families .
description_long: Aldimer The Aldimer family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Aldimers were allied with the Mathlin and Uruthkurt families .

title: Aldor Urnpoleshurst
description: Aldor Urnpoleshurst Aldor Urnpoleshurst was a lawyer just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aldor was very suspicious of others and made accusations over nothing .
description_long: Aldor Urnpoleshurst Aldor Urnpoleshurst was a lawyer just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aldor was very suspicious of others and made accusations over nothing . He was a lawyer in training but a skunk in inclination . History . Around 1489 DR , Aldor was forced to escape from Baldur ' s Gate , probably because he ' d been involved in a scandal . He boarded a great caravan , which unknown to him was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Aldorn Thuragar
description: Aldorn Thuragar Baron Aldorn " Foesmasher " Thuragar is the cautious , yet committed ruler of Sespech . While he holds his court in the capital of Ormpetarr , Thuragar also frequents Mimph and Elbulder with appearances . The three - day long celebration known as the Feast of Purple Majesty , is held annually in the last few days of Alturiak to celebrate the baron ' s rise to power .
description_long: Aldorn Thuragar Baron Aldorn " Foesmasher " Thuragar is the cautious , yet committed ruler of Sespech . While he holds his court in the capital of Ormpetarr , Thuragar also frequents Mimph and Elbulder with appearances . The three - day long celebration known as the Feast of Purple Majesty , is held annually in the last few days of Alturiak to celebrate the baron ' s rise to power . Possessions . Among the Baron Thuragar ' s possessions are a rod of lordly might , a scarab of protection and a ring of mind shielding . Background . Baron Thuragar was once a member of the adventuring company known as the Band of Iron .

title: Aldreth
description: Aldreth Aldreth was the largest of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Aldreth was considered to be the most sophisticated of the Sword Lands towns , and the most snooty by envious people of other towns .
description_long: Aldreth Aldreth was the largest of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Aldreth was considered to be the most sophisticated of the Sword Lands towns , and the most snooty by envious people of other towns . The merchants of Aldreth fancied themselves as the true lords of the Sword Lands because their great wealth . Economy . Aldreth was the most wealthy of the towns along the Sword River , with the best markets and a great variety of goods , travelers , and strange curios from afar . Goverment . The lord of the town was chosen by the wealthy Aldran merchants , who decided who would take that appointment through financial support and careful assassination . History . Some years before 1479 DR , Swordlanders from other towns hired some adventurers to thwart the operations of Aldran merchants . In 1479 DR , those merchants retaliated by hiring adventurers to hit back .

title: Aldric
description: Aldric Aldric was the abbot of the Abbey of St . Sollars of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities .
description_long: Aldric Aldric was the abbot of the Abbey of St . Sollars of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Aldric was the spiritual leader of the Barony . History . In 1357 DR , Aldric opposed the idea of hiring Gareth Dragonsbane and his party . Some time after the adventurers defeated the bandit army minions of Orcus infected Aldric with vampirism , driving him mad . He so said to all that he was sick and never exit more in daytime . At same time he summoned rat s and worg s that spread chaos near the abbey . At last he tried to escape from the village in gaseous form . Personality . Aldric was very fatalistic , disapproving of going against destiny . He was a powerful opponent .

title: Aldrur Hariburt
description: Aldrur Hariburt Aldrur Hariburt was a local herald based in Myratma , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Aldrur was a pompous bureaucrat with an inflated sense of importance .
description_long: Aldrur Hariburt Aldrur Hariburt was a local herald based in Myratma , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Aldrur was a pompous bureaucrat with an inflated sense of importance . Abilities . As a Herald , he was an expert in blazonry and the protocol of nobility . Possessions . Aldrur Hariburt was comfortably wealthy . Activities . Chastus served the Duchess of the Purple Marches in the capacity of Herald over non - noble blazonry , including miller ' s marks , guild symbols , merchant fleet flags , trading coster badges , and other symbols of commerce around Myratma . Hariburt was driven to prevent the untrained masses from designing heraldic devices on their own , which he saw as the exclusive charter of the Heralds . He was obsessed with ruining the business of Ilmurk Jongrath , a miller who designed and painted simple blazons on shields and other accouterments in his spare time . Aldrur petitioned for fines , arrest warrants , and even ducal censure against Jongrath , but to no avail . Relationships . Hariburt and his fellow Herald from Darromar , Chastus Beldrorn , were particularly nettled by an amateur heraldist named Ilmurk Jongrath .

title: Alduvar Snowbrand
description: Alduvar Snowbrand Alduvar Snowbrand was one of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Alduvar as Blue Sword was a strenue supporter of major ties with Sembia , believing the Dales need a new powerful ally .
description_long: Alduvar Snowbrand Alduvar Snowbrand was one of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Alduvar as Blue Sword was a strenue supporter of major ties with Sembia , believing the Dales need a new powerful ally . In public role he was a merchant and shopkeeper . History . Alduvar for many years was an army ' s battlemage .

title: Alea Dahast
