description: Alea Dahast Alea Dahast was a female elf who led a raiding party on a human camp in Cormanthor in - 75 DR . The purpose of the raid was to kill the camp ' s inhabitants and destroy the settlement , but Alea and her party rescued the Netherese wizard Baerauble Etharr in the process . The two would later become lovers .
description_long: Alea Dahast Alea Dahast was a female elf who led a raiding party on a human camp in Cormanthor in - 75 DR . The purpose of the raid was to kill the camp ' s inhabitants and destroy the settlement , but Alea and her party rescued the Netherese wizard Baerauble Etharr in the process . The two would later become lovers . Known as the High Lady of Art , she helped raise the " mythal " over Myth Drannor . Later Alea become the Spell - Major of the Akh ' Faer .

title: Aleaxtis
description: Aleaxtis Aleaxtis , the Kingdom of the Sahuagin , was a dangerous neighbor of the Old Empires . Description . Though the exact location of this kingdom remained unknown , it was believed to lay somewhere north of a volcanic island called the Ship of the Gods .
description_long: Aleaxtis Aleaxtis , the Kingdom of the Sahuagin , was a dangerous neighbor of the Old Empires . Description . Though the exact location of this kingdom remained unknown , it was believed to lay somewhere north of a volcanic island called the Ship of the Gods . Inhabitants . The city of Vahaxtyl held 13 , 000 sahuagin and was ruled by Kromes , a tyrant who sunk any ship found in their territory . Both Tiamat and the Cult of Set approached the sahuagin seeking an alliance but were refused . Red Wizards from Thay would often pay tribute to the sahuagin in an attempt to protect Thayan vessels , but the vicious creatures still attacked ships from Thay on a regular basis .

title: Aleena Paladinstar
description: Aleena Paladinstar Aleena Paladinstar was the daughter of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson . Description . Aleena was tall and serious .
description_long: Aleena Paladinstar Aleena Paladinstar was the daughter of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson . Description . Aleena was tall and serious . History . In 1355 DR , Aleena put on her father ' s armor and fooled people into thinking she was him . Aleena was secretly apprenticed to Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and became a graduate of Blackstaff Academy . In the 1360s DR , Aleena spent years away from Waterdeep planewalking . It was rumored that she would return to replace her father , the Open Lord of Waterdeep , when his reign ended . . Aleena and her husband Savengriff were prolific writers . In 1479 DR , Renaer Neverember possessed their entire collection of their mundane works , which included Aleena ' s " Of Fathers , Faiths , and Fortunes " ( 1403 DR ) . Relationships . Aleena was the only child of Piergeiron the Paladinson and Maethiira , who died in 1344 DR . Aleena married the wizard Savengriff .

title: Aleina Brightlance
description: Aleina Brightlance Aleina Brightlance was a knight - commander of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century . Relationships . She established a sexual relationship with Wulfgar History .
description_long: Aleina Brightlance Aleina Brightlance was a knight - commander of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century . Relationships . She established a sexual relationship with Wulfgar History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orc s and drow on the Silver Marches , Aleina commanded a knight contingent sent to help King Firehelm in the defense of Sundabar . She was captured in the fall of the city and brought to Underdark by a drow party . She was saved by Regis and Wulfgar of the Companions of the Hall along with many other prisoners . Afterward , Aleina helped them in fighting orcs and drow and partnered with Wulfgar . In 1485 DR , having received reinforcement , Aleina commanded a battalion of Knights in Silver in the decisive battles of the war .

title: Alek Lenter
description: Alek Lenter Alek Lenter was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Alek was a fence in Waterdeep before he was recruited by the Xanathar for his operations in Skullport .
description_long: Alek Lenter Alek Lenter was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Alek was a fence in Waterdeep before he was recruited by the Xanathar for his operations in Skullport . Alek , however , secretly spied on the Xanathar ' s Guild for his friends in the Shadow Thieves , who wanted know all that happened in " their " city . Alek hoped to use this situation to gain as much money as possible . If he was caught , he would be killed .

title: Aleksei
description: Aleksei Aleksei was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Aleksei was the rotten son of a minor noble .
description_long: Aleksei Aleksei was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Aleksei was the rotten son of a minor noble . Having a bad life with his parents , in 1489 DR he left home and soon joined the water cultists . Aleksei acted as a pirate with fellow cultists until 1491 DR . In that year , Aleksei ' s cell was ordered to attack Furgis Boltsmelter ' s ship and take the elemental codex . However , an adventuring party hired by Furgis near Mulmaster as his bodyguards destroyed the cell and captured Aleksei . Personality . Aleskei felt constantly oppressed in his home because his parents were completely ignorant to the troubles and tribulations of a teenager . In the Cult , his life was instead a flurry of worshiping , scuttling ships , and generally being a nuisance to local fisherman until recent times . Aleksei started to consider what it meant to be a cultist and was in search of an answer .

title: Aleksi Drejkov
description: Aleksi Drejkov Aleksi Drejkov was a noble member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Aleksi saw his allegiance to the Howling Hatred only as another method by which he could damage his rivals .
description_long: Aleksi Drejkov Aleksi Drejkov was a noble member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Aleksi saw his allegiance to the Howling Hatred only as another method by which he could damage his rivals . History . Aleksi ' s family once ruled a great trading empire , but he had no ability to rule it , and soon his rivals outmaneuvered and betrayed him . So Aleksi joined the Cult of the Howling Hatred and became leader of a cell in the city . In 1491 DR , after many schemes had been ruined , the high leaders of the cult decided to wipe out the Drejkov ' s cell and sent a cadre of assassins led by Little Wing to silence them . After killing Drejkov ' s steward , Niko Sevek , the cultist assassins burned Dreikov ' s mansion . Aleksi managed to escape in time , but was confronted by an adventuring party who ' d been falsely accused of one of the cultists ' s assassinations . He was sniped at by the assassins .

title: Alemander I
description: Alemander I King Alemander I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the seventh king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Called Alemander the Spellbinder , he was regarded as one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Abilities .
description_long: Alemander I King Alemander I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the seventh king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Called Alemander the Spellbinder , he was regarded as one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Abilities . Alemander was a wizard before he became a monarch . Possessions . Alemander ' s sword , the " Lion ' s Sword " , was forged by a dwarven ally . Alemander later enchanted the blade , granting it the power of flame , a magical power that was rare at that time for weapons in Tethyr . Activities . As king , Alemander I gave royal contributions to support the orders of Torm ish and Ilmatari priests at Barakmordin , who had supported him in his rise to power . With these funds , the fortified abbey received its outer walls and a new central keep . Relationships . Alemander I was the oldest grandson of King Coram I . He had three sisters and a younger brother named Coram II , who for some reason lost to scholars , took the throne before him . History . Alemander was born in 1038 DR . In 1070 DR , Teremir Bormul started a coup against King Coram II , Alemander ' s brother .

title: Alemander II
description: Alemander II King Alemander II of House Tethyr was the ninth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the grandson of King Coram III , whom he would eventually succeed .
description_long: Alemander II King Alemander II of House Tethyr was the ninth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the grandson of King Coram III , whom he would eventually succeed . He had a bastard half - elven son named Kymer and a son through marriage named Coram . Besides Kymer ' s mother , Alemander was also rumored to have had an affair with his court vizera Wyvorlaa . Regardless of the truth of the rumors , she indeed influenced his rule more than his own dukes and chancellors . History . Alemander was born in 1150 DR and was crowned king in the Year of the Shieldtree , 1181 DR . In 1188 DR , Alemander ' s vizera Wyvorlaa was accused of consorting with a lich living beneath the Starspire Mountains . The king ' s nobles pressured him to order her execution , and he at last consented . Alemander died in 1202 DR ; Coram , his firstborn legitimate son , succeeded him as Coram IV . He was buried in what would later become County Bardshyr ; the tomb was known as Alemander ' s Needle .

title: Alemander III
description: Alemander III King Alemander III of House Tethyr was a king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the nephew of King Errilam I .
description_long: Alemander III King Alemander III of House Tethyr was a king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the nephew of King Errilam I . He was married to a woman named Lhayronna , and they had twin sons , Jaszur and Olosar . Each son would later reign after him . Alemander also had a younger sister named Zakhina . Activities . Alemander III commissioned the construction of the Minaret Palace in Zazesspur , which served as a summer palace for the royal family . Alemander also commissioned the writing of a work of history , the " Chronicla Tethyria " , which described the history of the kingdom . Because of his hatred of elves , however , the work covered up any mention of elf - human relations . History . Alemander III was born in 1262 DR . He took the throne in 1277 DR , when his uncle King Errilam was assassinated . Because of rumors that Errilam had been slain by elves , Alemander began a persecution of them . King Alemander died in 1288 DR and was succeeded by his son Jaszur .

title: Alemander IV
description: Alemander IV King Alemander IV of House Tethyr was the last king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Personality .
description_long: Alemander IV King Alemander IV of House Tethyr was the last king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Personality . Alemander ' s reign was marked by his strict rule and severe punishments for even lesser crimes . Relationships . Alemander was the eldest nephew of King Olosar and a cousin of Prince Rythan , the Paladin Prince . He was married twice . His first wife died sometime before 1334 DR and left him with a single heir , Alemander V . His second wife , Queen Rhinda was the mother of his son , Haedrak III . The elder Alemander had a terrible relationship with his son . The former considered Alemander V to be greedy and power hungry and did not trust him . The son took sides with many of the lesser nobles of Tethyr against his father . History . Alemander IV was born in the Year of the Deep Moon , 1294 DR . He was crowned king of Tethyr in the Year of the Fallen Throne , 1319 DR , at the age of twenty - five - years - old . Sometime after 1330 DR , Alemander secretly plotted with the Twisted Rune to engineer an elaborate assassination of Prince Rythan , which involved the short - lived country of Mulsparkh .

title: Alemander V
description: Alemander V Crown Prince Alemander V of House Tethyr was the last member of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He never ruled , having been slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Relationships .
description_long: Alemander V Crown Prince Alemander V of House Tethyr was the last member of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He never ruled , having been slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Relationships . Alemander V was the first son and heir of King Alemander IV . He got along terribly with his father . The latter found the former to be greedy and domineering and wished that his second son , Alemander V ' s half - brother Haedrak , could be the next to rule instead . Alemander V was married to a woman named Dhara , and the two had two sons , named Jhodak and Leodom . History . Alemander V was born in the Year of Chains , 1321 DR . He died during the beginning of the Ten Black Days of Eleint in the Year of the Bright Blade , 1347 DR , when all of Castle Tethyr burned to the ground . His wife and two sons also died in the fire , as did the king and queen . Rumors and Legends . While never proven , it was believed that Prince Alemander V orchestrated the king ' s death with General Sharboneth . However , the two men turned against each other and the fires got out of hand . Sharboneth also died in the fires , though his body was never found .

title: Alenuath
description: Alenuath House Alenuath was a sun elf house on Evermeet . Unusually for sun elves , its members were typically ranger s , hunters , or others who spent a great deal of time alone . Although the house had a small manse in Leuthilspar , it was often unoccupied for extended periods .
description_long: Alenuath House Alenuath was a sun elf house on Evermeet . Unusually for sun elves , its members were typically ranger s , hunters , or others who spent a great deal of time alone . Although the house had a small manse in Leuthilspar , it was often unoccupied for extended periods . During this time , it was cared for by moon elf servants . As of 1368 DR , the house was led by Thalanil Alenuath . " Haramara ' s bow " was a non - magical bow that had great significance in the house . The house ' s colours were gray and green .

title: Aleratha Ilnatar
description: Aleratha Ilnatar Aleratha " Rubytresses " Ilnatar was an elf woman of the city of Ylraphon in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Aleratha assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the human mage Beldossan the Short in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .
description_long: Aleratha Ilnatar Aleratha " Rubytresses " Ilnatar was an elf woman of the city of Ylraphon in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Aleratha assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the human mage Beldossan the Short in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .

title: Alestone
description: Alestone Alestone , also known as , was named for its brown to yellowish brown color , the hues of old s . Description . This semi - precious stone was found in crystals and cut into gems of handsome appearance .
description_long: Alestone Alestone , also known as , was named for its brown to yellowish brown color , the hues of old s . Description . This semi - precious stone was found in crystals and cut into gems of handsome appearance . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Alex
description: Alex Alex was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alex ' s father , Zachan , told Alex about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle .
description_long: Alex Alex was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alex ' s father , Zachan , told Alex about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle . This caused Alex and his brother , Andrew , to gain confidence and go adventuring . However , they ended up near Highcliff Castle , where they got cornered by a bunch of wolves . Gera and Zachan asked the Kalach - Cha to rescue their sons . Upon rescuing them , the Kalach - Cha could tell the truth there were twice as many duergar , or lie that there was no battle .

title: Alexa
description: Alexa Alexa was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Alexa was one of the most promising apprentices in the College of Conjuration and the wife of Eldrinn Elpragh of the College of Divination .
description_long: Alexa Alexa was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Alexa was one of the most promising apprentices in the College of Conjuration and the wife of Eldrinn Elpragh of the College of Divination . In 1377 DR , Eldrinn proposed to Q ' arlynd Melarn that Alexa join the new College of Ancient Arcana but Q ' arlynd refused her because he feared that Eldrinn would gain too much power inside the new school . However , for the time being , the site of the new school was the house of Alexa and Eldrinn , so she was casually involved in an experiment attempted by Q ' arlynd to master a " kiira " . In the experiment , Q ' arlynd found a clue to finding the mythical Kraanfhaor ' s Door magic school and understood that he must accept Alexa in the College of Ancient Arcana to buy her silence . In 1379 DR , Alexa healed Master Q ' arlynd and announced to him the death of Master Guldor Zauviir at the hands of Ilharess Laele Zauviir .

title: Alexandrite
description: Alexandrite Alexandrite was a greenish variety of that appeared reddish under non - natural light , such as " light " spells . This transparent gem was usually faceted and used in pendants and earrings . Alexandrites were used as a magic focus for items that provided good luck , favorable reactions , protection , or other good omens .
description_long: Alexandrite Alexandrite was a greenish variety of that appeared reddish under non - natural light , such as " light " spells . This transparent gem was usually faceted and used in pendants and earrings . Alexandrites were used as a magic focus for items that provided good luck , favorable reactions , protection , or other good omens . Examples included luckstone s and the cursed lodestone . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp or 500 gp .

title: Aleyd Burral
description: Aleyd Burral Aleyd Burral was a knight in Phlan and a member of the Knights of the Black Fists during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Aleyd was always concerned with corruption inside the Black Fists and wanted to do something to unveil it .
description_long: Aleyd Burral Aleyd Burral was a knight in Phlan and a member of the Knights of the Black Fists during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Aleyd was always concerned with corruption inside the Black Fists and wanted to do something to unveil it . She found proof of a secret prison where her fellows tortured prisoners for sport and of bribery at Stojanow Gate . In 1489 DR , she was involved in a case of books stolen by a member of the Cult of the Dragon . Some time later , she decided to hire an adventuring party to investigate an overly long - running trial against the Cult member Spernik , who , despite being accused of stealing a book from Mantor ' s Library and instigating a red dragon to attack the city , was not yet condemned . She soon became involved in a coup by Dragon Cultists in the city , as one of the leaders of the forces fighting against the cultists . Later , she sent the adventurers to free Lord Regent Brahms , gaining them time by fighting against corrupt Black Fists allied with the cultists . She died in the skirmish .

title: Alfrendo Galona
description: Alfrendo Galona Alfrendo Galona was a businessman in Shining Plains in 1358 DR . Activities . Alfrendo managed the Alfrendo ' s Mythical Menagerie , a circus of mythical creatures , all made inoffensive .
description_long: Alfrendo Galona Alfrendo Galona was a businessman in Shining Plains in 1358 DR . Activities . Alfrendo managed the Alfrendo ' s Mythical Menagerie , a circus of mythical creatures , all made inoffensive . History . In 1358 at the festival of Urml Alfrendo had a chimera , a gargoyle , a harpy and a baby copper dragon named Cueperia , that Alfrendo treated as a pet .

title: Alfun Deeprock
description: Alfun Deeprock Alfun Deeprock was a deep gnome cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Lorn Tauth discovered that the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron .
description_long: Alfun Deeprock Alfun Deeprock was a deep gnome cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Lorn Tauth discovered that the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron . They organized an expedition before the rightful owner of the mine , Leleanor , could claim it . However , as Alfun and Lorn found the Seed , they were confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired by Leleanor to explore the mine .

title: Algashon Nathaire
description: Algashon Nathaire Algashon Nathaire was a wizard and a priest of Bane who was the one responsible of the madness of Sammaster . History . The first time Algashon met Sammaster was near Baldur ' s Gate in 865 DR and soon the two became friends , traveling together for many years .
description_long: Algashon Nathaire Algashon Nathaire was a wizard and a priest of Bane who was the one responsible of the madness of Sammaster . History . The first time Algashon met Sammaster was near Baldur ' s Gate in 865 DR and soon the two became friends , traveling together for many years . In truth , Algashon considered Sammaster a perfect choice for a would - be - tyrant and his faith in Bane drove him to support the ascent of tyrants . Algashon soon started to convince Sammaster to embrace evil and it was he that incited Sammaster to attack his former love , Alustriel , with the hope of stealing Alustriel ' s " silver fire " , in 875 DR . He failed in his plot but Sammaster , after Algashon saved his life after the battle , fully embraced evil . Soon after , Sammaster came up with the idea of the dracolich and the Cult of the Dragon was born . Algashon always supported him . However , they differed in the views on the structure of the cult ; Algashon wanted a system of secret cells , while Sammaster preferred to act openly . Algashon eventually tired of Sammaster .

title: Algorind
description: Algorind Algorind was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Algorind was a man who ' d lost his way .
description_long: Algorind Algorind was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Algorind was a man who ' d lost his way . His unquestioning willingness to follow superiors ' orders had led him far from Tyr ' s path , although he remained a sincere , earnest , and dedicated man . Full of confusion , he asked for advice from Gareth Cormaeril , who was secretly the man responsible for Algorind ' s troubles . Thus he followed without question the orders of his tormentor . History . Algorind , starting out as a very zealous paladin , was for years deceived by Gareth into trying to fulfill many futile quests . Becoming Gareth ' s pawn , he had orders to avoid Bronwyn Caradoon , who had worked for the opposing faction in the Thornhold affair .

title: Alhoon
description: Alhoon Alhoons were magic - using outcasts from mind flayer societies who had defied the ruling elder brain s to achieve a limited form of lich dom . Only the most powerful mind flayer mages could achieve true lichdom and were known as illithiliches ; however , many in the Realms did not make this distinction . Alhoons combined powerful wizardry and sorcery with their innate skill at psionics to become a new threat to the established order of the Underdark and beyond .
description_long: Alhoon Alhoons were magic - using outcasts from mind flayer societies who had defied the ruling elder brain s to achieve a limited form of lich dom . Only the most powerful mind flayer mages could achieve true lichdom and were known as illithiliches ; however , many in the Realms did not make this distinction . Alhoons combined powerful wizardry and sorcery with their innate skill at psionics to become a new threat to the established order of the Underdark and beyond . Their skin possessed none of the wet , smooth , slimy texture of living illithids , instead appearing dry , wrinkled , and cracked as a result of the powerful magic resistance that had prevented a perfect conversion to lichdom . Alhoons were ignored , feared , and hated by mortal illithids for their rejection of the illithid circle of life , culminating with the physical and psychic merging with an elder brain . Locations . In 1369 DR , alhoons were known to have taken up residence in the abandoned drow city of Telnarquel .

title: Ali - bin - Jafar
description: Ali - bin - Jafar Bertrem Thinwick , also known as Ali - bin - Jafar , was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Bertrem was a cunning Skullport native who understood that having an exotic name would help increase his business .
description_long: Ali - bin - Jafar Bertrem Thinwick , also known as Ali - bin - Jafar , was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Bertrem was a cunning Skullport native who understood that having an exotic name would help increase his business . So , under the name " Ali - bin - Jafar " , he started selling carpets from Calimshan , Kara - Tur , Zakhara , and the Hordelands . Ali was a brilliant salesman and few who entered his shop departed empty handed . He also acted as a smuggler for Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild and Misker .

title: Ali Abdal Akim
description: Ali Abdal Akim Ali Abdal Akim was a daolani who lived in the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Driven by a wicked and sadistic nature , Ali would harass anyone if he believed he could get away with it .
description_long: Ali Abdal Akim Ali Abdal Akim was a daolani who lived in the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Driven by a wicked and sadistic nature , Ali would harass anyone if he believed he could get away with it . Ali ' s master enjoyed seeing the look of fear in his victim ' s eyes . Relationships . Ali served the leader of the Unclean , Akim al - Kalaas . Activities . Ali did as his master commanded . He knew the secret identity of Farouk Abd al - Bazan , but wisely kept this knowledge to himself , fearful of what the genie s would do if his master died and he was sent back to the Elemental planes .

title: Ali Mirza Ahmak
description: Ali Mirza Ahmak Ali Mirza Ahmak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Ali was a djinni spy who masqueraded as a smoke merchant within the city .
description_long: Ali Mirza Ahmak Ali Mirza Ahmak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Ali was a djinni spy who masqueraded as a smoke merchant within the city . Rumors abounded constantly throughout the city that the city guard would arrest anyone with conjured charges that they were spying , making Ali a nervous man anytime the guard was in sight .

title: Ali al - Lazan
description: Ali al - Lazan Ali al - Lazan was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . History . Ali attempted to incinerate the royal palace of Sultana Alurah bint Asrah of Hiyal .
description_long: Ali al - Lazan Ali al - Lazan was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . History . Ali attempted to incinerate the royal palace of Sultana Alurah bint Asrah of Hiyal . Though he failed , his actions prompted the Sultana to issue a 500 , 000 - gp bounty on his head for his capture and return to Hiyal . If returned dead , the Sultana wished for his body to be in a condition from which he could be raised .

title: Ali al - Mustasib
description: Ali al - Mustasib Ali al - Mustasib lived in Iris Well Spring in the Hordelands during the mid 14h century DR . History . Atabeg Ali al - Mustasib was an exiled ruler of Semphar who was forced to live in the small community of Iris Well Spring located to the east of Semphar .
description_long: Ali al - Mustasib Ali al - Mustasib lived in Iris Well Spring in the Hordelands during the mid 14h century DR . History . Atabeg Ali al - Mustasib was an exiled ruler of Semphar who was forced to live in the small community of Iris Well Spring located to the east of Semphar . A jailer visited him yearly to deliver supplies and confirm that he remained in exile without fleeing . Activities . Ali viewed the Tuigan horde under Yamun Khahan as a way to possibly retain control in Semphar . The Khahan ' s son , Hubadai , used information gathered from Ali to plan his invasion of Semphar . Ali was rewarded for this information with a spot on Hubadai ' s military council . Ali ' s daughter was also taken as a royal concubine to ensure his further cooperation . Relationships . Ali was the father of Dura al - Mustasib .

title: Ali ben Ali
description: Ali ben Ali Ali ben Ali was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Ali was just as famous for his somber demeanor as he was for his magical prowess .
description_long: Ali ben Ali Ali ben Ali was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Ali was just as famous for his somber demeanor as he was for his magical prowess . Description . Ali was a pauper . As such he was quite disheveled and filthy . History . Renowned in Zakhara for his precise visions of the future , Ali traveled to the City of Brass 20 years ago with the hopes of becoming the Great Sultan ' s personal councilor . It wasn ' t until then that Ali discovered his abilities as an accomplished mystic did not work for genie s . Amused by Ali ' s antics , the Sultan had him blinded and cast out of his court . Activities . Ali wandered the streets and markets of the City of Brass , struggling to earn a living by telling traveler ' s fortunes .

title: Aliah
description: Aliah Aliah was a Payit princess of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Aliah was a princess , promised to her half - brother Xetl .
description_long: Aliah Aliah was a Payit princess of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Aliah was a princess , promised to her half - brother Xetl . However , Tacal , a prince of Tulom - Itzi , decided that Aliah should be his . So he decided to kidnap her with the help of his retinue . On the day of the wedding , Tacal and his warriors managed to kidnap Aliah but only with the deaths of most of his warriors . At last , in revenge , the Payit decided to slay the whole royal family of Tulom - Itzi , who had been guests at the wedding with no knowledge of Tacal ' s plan . When Tacal , still surrounded by Ulatos ' s armies , saw at a distance the bodies of his family , he killed Aliah out of desperation . Soon after , Payit arrows killed Tacal . This act signaled the end of the Payit Golden Age .

title: Alias
description: Alias Alias was a created construct that had been given true life . She was not a natural human being , but instead the construct of an alliance between several powerful groups . She became a sell - sword who fought for good causes .
description_long: Alias Alias was a created construct that had been given true life . She was not a natural human being , but instead the construct of an alliance between several powerful groups . She became a sell - sword who fought for good causes . History . Alias ' s origins were with Finder Wyvernspur , a bard and hero , who feared the loss of his great artistic works at the end of his life . In order to prevent that , he attempted to create a clone of himself , but he failed in that endeavor , killing one of his assistants and injuring another , leading the Harpers to erase his very name from existence and banish him to the Citadel of White Exile . However , this erasure was not total , and a powerful sorceress , Cassana of Westgate , learned of Finder ' s actions , and sought him out , in order to remake his creation . Allied together , Finder ; Cassana ; her former lover , the lich Zrie Prakis ; the Cult of Moander ; and the Fire Knives , a band of assassins , attempted to create their own clone , Alias , intended to be a magical servant , spy and assassin . Cassana created Alias ' body , made in her own image , while Zrie Prakis made it immortal .

title: Alice Tinker
description: Alice Tinker Alice Tinker worked at the Curious Past in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep as an assistant to Bronwyn Caradoon . Activities . Alice was a skilled drawer and appraiser .
description_long: Alice Tinker Alice Tinker worked at the Curious Past in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep as an assistant to Bronwyn Caradoon . Activities . Alice was a skilled drawer and appraiser . Her presence at Bronwyn ' s shop made it a notable meeting place for halfling s and gnome s in Waterdeep .

title: Alicia
description: Alicia Lady Alicia was the head of the Zhentarim wizards at the Citadel of the Raven in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Alicia grew up in Zhentil Keep and soon she joined the Zhentarim .
description_long: Alicia Lady Alicia was the head of the Zhentarim wizards at the Citadel of the Raven in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Alicia grew up in Zhentil Keep and soon she joined the Zhentarim . Under the tutelage of Manshoon Alicia was elected to the Council of Lords of Zhentil Keep . She escaped the siege of the Keep by Cyric ' s horde in 1368 DR thanks to Manshoon , and in 1370 DR , after the Manshoon Wars broke out , Fzoul Chembryl appointed her Mage - Protector of the Citadel with equal rank as the military commander Kandar Milinal . Alicia plotted to became the consort of the Great Tyrant of Bane , Fzoul himself . She was also one of the few to maintain a business relationship with Lord Taradril Aumraven in order to control the Anauroch routes and skim much of the profits .

title: Alicia Kendrick
description: Alicia Kendrick Alicia Kendrick was the High Queen of the Moonshae Isles . History . Born in 1346 DR , Princess Alicia was the eldest daughter of High King Tristan Kendrick and the druid Robyn Kendrick .
description_long: Alicia Kendrick Alicia Kendrick was the High Queen of the Moonshae Isles . History . Born in 1346 DR , Princess Alicia was the eldest daughter of High King Tristan Kendrick and the druid Robyn Kendrick . Groomed during her early years by the kingdom ' s archmage Keane , Alicia became an adventurer in 1365 DR during the events of the " Druidhome trilogy " . Relationships . She had a son named Gregory Kendrick .

title: Alignment
description: Alignment The alignment system is a two - dimensional grid , one axis of which measures a " moral " continuum between good and evil , and the other " ethical " between law and chaos . Those characters that fall on one of the extremes are " good " or " evil " , " lawful " or " chaotic " ; in addition , there is a middle ground of " neutrality " on both axes , describing characters that are indifferent , committed to balance , or conflicted about the struggle between good and evil ( or law and chaos ) . By combining the two axes , any given character has one of nine possible alignments .
description_long: Alignment The alignment system is a two - dimensional grid , one axis of which measures a " moral " continuum between good and evil , and the other " ethical " between law and chaos . Those characters that fall on one of the extremes are " good " or " evil " , " lawful " or " chaotic " ; in addition , there is a middle ground of " neutrality " on both axes , describing characters that are indifferent , committed to balance , or conflicted about the struggle between good and evil ( or law and chaos ) . By combining the two axes , any given character has one of nine possible alignments . Certain classes are restricted in the sorts of alignment they can take . A paladin traditionally must be of lawful good alignment ; rogue s and barbarian s are seldom lawful in alignment . Cleric s and other priests must typically uphold the alignments favoured by their . Druid s must be wholly or partially neutral in their allegiances . Assassin s are usually evil . These restrictions have been somewhat relaxed in the 3rd and 5th editions of the " Dungeons & Dragons " game , although a character ' s alignment may shift if he acts in marked variance from his declared alignment .

title: Aliisza
description: Aliisza Aliisza was an alu - fiend ( child of a succubus and human ) servant and consort of the half - demon Kaanyr Vhok . She was also friend of the fallen astral deva Tauran and mother of Kael , a knight of Torm . Description .
description_long: Aliisza Aliisza was an alu - fiend ( child of a succubus and human ) servant and consort of the half - demon Kaanyr Vhok . She was also friend of the fallen astral deva Tauran and mother of Kael , a knight of Torm . Description . Aliisza appeared as a disarming adult human female with lustrous black curly hair , sea green eyes , and sharply defined eyebrows . Her true form bore her heritage by the pair of black demon wings mounted on her upper back . She often carried means to take different shapes to hide her wings and thus not reveal her true self unless necessary . Aliisza ' s natural form had sharp fangs , which she usually disguised to as to appear more humanlike . She often wore a tight black leather corset . She also owned a red dress , which she wore with a tight corselet with black lace . Personality . Alliisza was calculating and cold , always planning her moves ahead of time . She was also alluring and voluptuous . She was not averse to seducing anyone , for either business or pleasure . History . Background . Aliisza was the consort of Kaanyr Vhok , the leader of the Scoured Legion . She spent decades with him trapped beneath Hellgate Keep . War of the Spider Queen .

title: Alik Aksama
description: Alik Aksama Alik Aksama was a merchant and the proprietor of Fine Rugs in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Alik was always busy .
description_long: Alik Aksama Alik Aksama was a merchant and the proprietor of Fine Rugs in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Alik was always busy . The three tents of Fine Rugs streamed with customers , most of whom never left empty - handed . Relationships . Alik imported fine rugs from distant Kara - Tur or had cheaper rugs woven by his apprentices in Huzuz . Appendix . See Also . Fine Rugs

title: Alim Baybars
description: Alim Baybars Alim Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Alim ' s face and body were ruined from constant exposure to humid air , dark magic , and his own obsessive pursuit of power .
description_long: Alim Baybars Alim Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Alim ' s face and body were ruined from constant exposure to humid air , dark magic , and his own obsessive pursuit of power . Activities . Alim was a rare Zakharan in that he willingly departed the Land of Fate in search of powerful magic to give him mastery over the dead . History . Alim left Zakhara at a young age in search of dreadful magic . He returned to Zakhara centuries later to the island of Kaff where he could practice his dark art in secrecy . Skills . Alim was skilled in the use of the sword and necromantic magic . Possessions . Alim owned a " ring of mind shielding " , a " wand of fire " , a " caftan of protection " , a " crystal ball " , and a " ring of regeneration " . Relationships . Alim had one daughter , Melisende Baybars , who wished to kill him .

title: Alim Zangi
description: Alim Zangi Alim Zangi was a powerful sha ' ir living on Jazirat al - Sayyad in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Alim was the sha ' ir responsible for binding a group of herdsman genie s to watch over the fabulous Sayyad bloodline of horses on the island of Jazirat al - Sayyad .
description_long: Alim Zangi Alim Zangi was a powerful sha ' ir living on Jazirat al - Sayyad in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Alim was the sha ' ir responsible for binding a group of herdsman genie s to watch over the fabulous Sayyad bloodline of horses on the island of Jazirat al - Sayyad . Alim tricked the genie s into servitude , but over the centuries the genies have taken great pride into what the Sayyad horses have become .

title: Alima bint Khayri
description: Alima bint Khayri Alima bint Khayri was a halfling corsair living in the Al - Azra ' Wadi in 1367 DR . Personality . Alima ' s cheerful personality led many to underestimate her .
description_long: Alima bint Khayri Alima bint Khayri was a halfling corsair living in the Al - Azra ' Wadi in 1367 DR . Personality . Alima ' s cheerful personality led many to underestimate her . She was a savvy negotiator . Activities . Alima served as the ruler for Al - Azra ' Wadi .

title: Alimir Mountains
description: Alimir Mountains The Alimir Mountains served as the eastern border of Calimshan and were once the home of a great horde of beholder s . Geography . The Alimir Mountains composed the southern end of the Iltkazar Range , the same chain of mountains containing the Omlarandin Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Snowflake Mountains , and the Giant ' s Run Mountains .
description_long: Alimir Mountains The Alimir Mountains served as the eastern border of Calimshan and were once the home of a great horde of beholder s . Geography . The Alimir Mountains composed the southern end of the Iltkazar Range , the same chain of mountains containing the Omlarandin Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Snowflake Mountains , and the Giant ' s Run Mountains . The mountains ran down into the Lake of Steam in the east and extended into the Shining Sea in the south in what was known as the Alimir Peninsula . The Alimirs were not surrounded by gradual foothills as were the more northerly mountains in the Iltkazar Range ; they exploded out of the ground with steep sides . After a few thousand feet in height , most of the trees gave way to exposed rock , and the steep slopes began to level off only after around 4 , 000 feet ( 1 , 200 meters ) on average . The majority of the peaks had summits above 6 , 000 feet ( 1 , 800 meters ) over sea level . The two tallest peaks were Mount Kahdas ( 7 , 800 ft or 2377 m ) and Mount Phevos ( 8 , 500 ft or 2591 m ) , which were located in the middle of the range .

title: Alin Cateln
description: Alin Cateln Alin Cateln is a human bard and a brief member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Alin wears a light tunic , an indigo - dyed vest and leather breeches .
description_long: Alin Cateln Alin Cateln is a human bard and a brief member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Alin wears a light tunic , an indigo - dyed vest and leather breeches . He carries and plays a harp . His weapon is a rapier . Personality . Alin always had to sing for his supper , rides and things he needed . Alin enjoys collecting stories . Magic . Alin felt his magic was useless in a fight , especially against dragons . History . Alin was orginaly from Tilverton and was sent away by his father for falling at the Cormyrean academy .

title: Alisannara Morcane
description: Alisannara Morcane Alisannara Morcane was a female drow and the High Priestess of Lolth in Szith Morcane . History . She was consumed by a " destruction " spell when followers of Kiaransalee from Maerimydra overthrew House Morcane .
description_long: Alisannara Morcane Alisannara Morcane was a female drow and the High Priestess of Lolth in Szith Morcane . History . She was consumed by a " destruction " spell when followers of Kiaransalee from Maerimydra overthrew House Morcane . Afterward , Alisannara remained in the Fane of Lolth above House Morcane as a keening spirit attacking any who entered its inner fane . Description . Alisannara was a stern drow cleric of slight proportions , dressed in a black robe trimmed with purple and burgundy . In death , she looked much the same although she manifested as a hazy and insubstantial version of her living self .

title: Alix
description: Alix Alix was a merchant living in Bandar al - Sa ' adat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR , but originally came from outside of Zakhara . Description . Alix had blonde hair that was showing more gray with each passing year .
description_long: Alix Alix was a merchant living in Bandar al - Sa ' adat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR , but originally came from outside of Zakhara . Description . Alix had blonde hair that was showing more gray with each passing year . She was a small woman .

title: Aljanor Keenblade
description: Aljanor Keenblade Aljanor Keeblade was a knight member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . At the start of Rage of Demons , Ajanor was captured by the drow of Menzoberranzan during one of their surface raids , but all believed him to have been killed in the fighting .
description_long: Aljanor Keenblade Aljanor Keeblade was a knight member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . At the start of Rage of Demons , Ajanor was captured by the drow of Menzoberranzan during one of their surface raids , but all believed him to have been killed in the fighting . He remained a prisoner of the drow until some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer arrive to investigate the threat of demon lord s . Ryzliir Symryvvin threatened to kill Ajanor if the adventurers did not leave . Personality . Aljanor had made his peace with Tyr and was ready to died at the drow ' s hands . He would be disappointed if good lives were lost because of him .

title: Alkilith
description: Alkilith Society . The alkilith is among the demon s that disgust and terrify . These shapeless horrors are used by demon lord s for assignments in areas that most demons would hesitate to travel to , for alkiliths can survive and even thrive in the most chaotic and hellish and unlivable areas of the Abyss .
description_long: Alkilith Society . The alkilith is among the demon s that disgust and terrify . These shapeless horrors are used by demon lord s for assignments in areas that most demons would hesitate to travel to , for alkiliths can survive and even thrive in the most chaotic and hellish and unlivable areas of the Abyss . They are corruption and pollution made hatefully alive , making it easy to understand why they ' re feared by much of demonkind . Tales claim the alkilith has no limit to its size — travelers of the plane s have spoken of alkiliths the size of lakes in the deepest reaches of the Abyss . Appearance . Alkiliths are shivering messes of phosphorescent green corruption surrounded by cracked , leathery coatings , always oozing , secreting , thickening , and breaking open , with dark eye - globes covering their bodies . They are usually the size of a regular human , but they have been known to be able to shape their bodies to fit in cracks that are as small as one inch wide . Combat . Even though alkiliths have a gelatinous shape they can move at a decent speed .

title: All sphere
description: All sphere The All sphere was a group of spells that were granted to cleric s and druid s of any mythos . These spells were utilitarian in nature and were not associated with particular deities . Spells in normal text are listed in the " Tome of Magic " 2 edition .
description_long: All sphere The All sphere was a group of spells that were granted to cleric s and druid s of any mythos . These spells were utilitarian in nature and were not associated with particular deities . Spells in normal text are listed in the " Tome of Magic " 2 edition . Spells in italics were added to the All Sphere in the " " sourcebook .

title: Allafel
description: Allafel Allafel was an elf during the late 15th century DR . History . Allafel was the younger brother of Tarathiel .
description_long: Allafel Allafel was an elf during the late 15th century DR . History . Allafel was the younger brother of Tarathiel . During the War of the Silver Marches of 1484 DR – 1485 DR . He called loudly for elf intervention in the war . After the start of the elves ' operations , he led a contingent of Moonwood troops .

title: Allamon Sorn
description: Allamon Sorn Allamon Sorn was a Calishite human man of the mid – 14th century DR . History . He was an acquaintance of Pasha Abon Duum and sat with him in the stands at the Arena of Blood in Manshaka , Calimshan , in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR .
description_long: Allamon Sorn Allamon Sorn was a Calishite human man of the mid – 14th century DR . History . He was an acquaintance of Pasha Abon Duum and sat with him in the stands at the Arena of Blood in Manshaka , Calimshan , in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . Sorn remarked that the recaptured famous gladiator Vajra Valmeyjar might perish in her first match against a troll , but Duum , her captor , spoke in her favor . Sorn fled as the illusion of a manticore appeared to assault Duum . Description . Allamon was thin , with a pointed black goatee and dark skin , and wore blue robes and turban .

title: Allan Redhand
description: Allan Redhand Allan Redhand was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Allan was not bright , and had little patience for social interaction and intrigues .
description_long: Allan Redhand Allan Redhand was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Allan was not bright , and had little patience for social interaction and intrigues . He was happy following Devlin ' s orders , not caring for the consequences . History . Allan joined the Free Company of the Crescent after Devlin happened to save Allan ' s sister . In 1479 DR , he went with his fellow to Spellgard hoping to find Lady Saharel ' s treasures .

title: Allathast
description: Allathast Allathast was a male human fighter and the commander of the guards of the city of Daerlun in 1369 DR . He was secretly a thrall of the Cult of the Dragon , controlled by magic and Cultist friends . History .
description_long: Allathast Allathast was a male human fighter and the commander of the guards of the city of Daerlun in 1369 DR . He was secretly a thrall of the Cult of the Dragon , controlled by magic and Cultist friends . History . Although the ruler of Daerlun was the elderly merchant Halath Tymmyr , Allathast had the true power by influencing Tymmyr . With backing from the Cult of the Dragon , Allathast controlled the city . The Cult leaders used Daerlun very cautiously , not openly showing their power , but using it as a secret sanctuary for the Cult ' s holdings and members .

title: Allesian
description: Allesian Allesian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Thesk and Ashanath , the region southwest of Lake Ashane , from Kront in the north to the River Umber in the south and from Telflamm in the west to the Plateaus of Thay in the east . It was a Raumtheran language , just as Rashemi , which was spoken to the northeast . It had two dialects , Ashane and Golden Allesian .
description_long: Allesian Allesian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Thesk and Ashanath , the region southwest of Lake Ashane , from Kront in the north to the River Umber in the south and from Telflamm in the west to the Plateaus of Thay in the east . It was a Raumtheran language , just as Rashemi , which was spoken to the northeast . It had two dialects , Ashane and Golden Allesian .

title: Allessia Faithhammer
description: Allessia Faithhammer Allessia Faithhammer is a Cleric of Helm and one the five starting playable characters in . She is a human from Secomber and employs the abilities and spells typical of her character class . Adventuring Career .
description_long: Allessia Faithhammer Allessia Faithhammer is a Cleric of Helm and one the five starting playable characters in . She is a human from Secomber and employs the abilities and spells typical of her character class . Adventuring Career . Allessia was summoned to Baldur ' s Gate from her home in Secomber by her mentor , Huros . She came to the city in hopes of defending it from the threat posed by Eldrith the Betrayer and her Dark Alliance . However , by the time of her arrival Eldrith had already been defeated and her Onyx Tower already banished from Toril . Playing Allessia pits her instead against the designs of Mordoc SeLanmere as well as other nefarious forces in the Western Heartlands . Allessia ' s optional unique story arc is to work for the Church of Helm in Baldur ' s Gate , which is run by Huros . She can gain experience by donating increasingly large sums of gold to the church which are spent on projects including an orphanage , additional fortifications to the city walls and a warship to help defend the harbour of Baldur ' s Gate . Allessia also has the option of travelling to an unholy mausoleum on the church ' s orders .

title: Alleviators
description: Alleviators The alleviators were a cleric al order devoted to the god Ilmater . History . The alleviator order was developed by the priests of Ilmater themselves , rather than commanded or inspired by their god .
description_long: Alleviators The alleviators were a cleric al order devoted to the god Ilmater . History . The alleviator order was developed by the priests of Ilmater themselves , rather than commanded or inspired by their god . They were a fairly new faction within the church of Ilmater by 1369 DR . Attitudes . The alleviators did not passively accept the pain and suffering of others . Nor did they feel it was their role to remove or cure such pains . Instead , they focused on teaching people to cope with and endure their pain . They believed that helping people bear such hurts would make them stronger , and that this was preferable to standing against the evil and suffering of the world and failing . However , some alleviators did attempt to alleviate suffering where it occurred , and they also spoke up for the rights of common people . Such alleviators were considered radicals within the church of Ilmater . Activities . The alleviators were ascetics who lived quite modestly . They often dressed in plain , gray robes with rope for a belt , and they refused armor and shield s . They wore a leather thong tied around each wrist in honor of their god , but these were not bound together .

title: Allian
description: Allian Allian was a young halfling from Lowhill within the Moonshae Isles . Description . The female halfling had a high squeaky voice .
description_long: Allian Allian was a young halfling from Lowhill within the Moonshae Isles . Description . The female halfling had a high squeaky voice . Personality . Shy as a maid , Allian blushed at sight of the Calishite Daryth . History . In 1345 DR , during the Festival of the Spring Equinox on Gwynneth , Pawldo escorted Allian to Lowhill for the spring dance .

title: Alliance of Belt Watchers
description: Alliance of Belt Watchers The Alliance of Belt Watchers was a military organization in Damara in the Bloodstone Lands in 1359 DR . It was a group of three races who formed an interesting pact . Organization .
description_long: Alliance of Belt Watchers The Alliance of Belt Watchers was a military organization in Damara in the Bloodstone Lands in 1359 DR . It was a group of three races who formed an interesting pact . Organization . The Alliance gathered all the dwarves and the halfling s of the Barony of Bloodstone , later joined also by the centaur s . The alliance was only a defensive one but used brilliant tactics , thanks also to capable tacticians like Gailan , Fredegast , and Valon . Activities . Comprised of dwarves , halflings , and centaurs who all shared similar interests profiting from mining , the Alliance of Beltwatchers also helped protect Bloodstone Barony during times of need . History . The Alliance was established in 1357 DR by the halflings and the dwarves of Bloodstone , who had had a strong bond from a long time before human s arrived in the area . They organized themselves into an army in order to protect themselves from the army of Zhengyi . Later , the halflings brought the centaurs into the alliance . The alliance remained active after Zhengyi was defeated and in 1359 DR the dwarves offered for the deep gnome King Ruggedo to join the alliance . Base of Operations .

title: Alliance of Seventon
description: Alliance of Seventon The Alliance of Seventon began as a confederation of seven villages . At first , it was a paradise of rivers , forests , lakes , and plains . Seventon ' s history began in - 3859 DR , or 1 NY ( Nether Years ) .
description_long: Alliance of Seventon The Alliance of Seventon began as a confederation of seven villages . At first , it was a paradise of rivers , forests , lakes , and plains . Seventon ' s history began in - 3859 DR , or 1 NY ( Nether Years ) . Nether the Elder . The founder of Seventon , and its only king , Nether created the calendar of Netheril and maintained Seventon . Until in 32 NY , Nether renamed Seventon to Netheril , meaning Nether ' s land . At the celebration of his newfound dictatorship , an unknown man killed him with a poisoned dirk . That man was widely believed to be Nether the Younger . Before his assassination , Nether planned to oversee Netheril from his village , Gers , as the Shaman of Netheril , giving the title of King to Darzal Nether . Nether the Younger . A just ruler , Alandril Nether , or Nether the Younger , assumed rulership of Netheril upon his father ' s death . He was loved by the people and militia of Netheril .

title: Allip
description: Allip Allips were the incorporeal remnants of persons driven to insanity who then killed themselves . They were a type of undead creature commonly conjured by evil spellcasters using the more advanced versions of the " summon undead " spell . Description .
description_long: Allip Allips were the incorporeal remnants of persons driven to insanity who then killed themselves . They were a type of undead creature commonly conjured by evil spellcasters using the more advanced versions of the " summon undead " spell . Description . Allips were spectral variations of the persons they once were , with nightmarish , warped features befitting of the madness that possessed them . Their lower portions trailed away into a dark fog as they floated . Abilities . An allip had the ability to drain sanity from any creature it touched , growing more powerful in the process . An allip was as insane in death as in life ; anyone detecting an allip ' s thoughts by magic or telepathy was driven to the same madness . Behavior . An allip ' s only desire was revenge on those who supposedly pushed it over the edge to suicide . They swung wildly at any creature they detected , unaware that their incorporeal forms could cause no physical harm . They babbled constantly in incoherent whines . This mad muttering could hypnotize any sane creatures within a 60 - foot radius .

title: Allyn ' s Anvil
description: Allyn ' s Anvil Allyn ' s Anvil was an ancient stone circle situated high in the northern Alimir Mountains between Calimshan and the Lake of Steam . It lay east of St . Wityn ' s Hospice .
description_long: Allyn ' s Anvil Allyn ' s Anvil was an ancient stone circle situated high in the northern Alimir Mountains between Calimshan and the Lake of Steam . It lay east of St . Wityn ' s Hospice . Description . The site consisted of a semi - circle of stone boulders , all long - shattered as if by some titanic explosion , half - buried by grass and brambles . At the center was the Anvil itself : a pair of megaliths , one lying on top of the other , amidst patches of nettles . The upper stone was black and marbled all over with white stripes — this type of stone was unique , not found anywhere else in the Iltkazar Range . Legends . Legend told that uncounted artifact s were forged upon the Anvil . It was considered to a sacred site by those churches who valued justice , in particular the church of Tyr . History . Sometime in the 1st century DR , Tyr the Just God appeared at Allyn ' s Anvil and consecrated the " Demonsbane " shields .

title: Almaestaddamir Auldcastle
description: Almaestaddamir Auldcastle Almaestaddamir Auldcastle , commonly called Almaes , is an alchemist who lives in Ashabenford . He is known for crafting and selling such items as tanglefoot bag s , sunrod s , various acids and antitoxins and smokepowder . Almaes once offered to build a smokepowder - keg - throwing device to combat the drow for Haresk Malorn , but he politely ( and likely wisely ) declined the offer .
description_long: Almaestaddamir Auldcastle Almaestaddamir Auldcastle , commonly called Almaes , is an alchemist who lives in Ashabenford . He is known for crafting and selling such items as tanglefoot bag s , sunrod s , various acids and antitoxins and smokepowder . Almaes once offered to build a smokepowder - keg - throwing device to combat the drow for Haresk Malorn , but he politely ( and likely wisely ) declined the offer .

title: Almari bint - Kafira
description: Almari bint - Kafira Almari bint - Kafira , or the Shark of Suq Bay , was a notorious Zakharan pirate in 1367 DR . She flew under a flag depicting a black hammerhead shark on a sea - green background . The sight of this flag was enough for most ships to strike their colors because of a unique deal that Almari offered .
description_long: Almari bint - Kafira Almari bint - Kafira , or the Shark of Suq Bay , was a notorious Zakharan pirate in 1367 DR . She flew under a flag depicting a black hammerhead shark on a sea - green background . The sight of this flag was enough for most ships to strike their colors because of a unique deal that Almari offered . Activities . Almari ' s pirate fleet consisted of five vessels — two galleon s and three . Over 400 corsairs manned these vessels . Unique compared to other pirates who favored absolute butchery , Almari preferred to rob a ship and let it go so she could rob it again in the future . Merchants sailing on Suq Bay knew that if they struck their colors and gave Almari a third of their cargo , then they would be allowed to continue their journey unmolested . Any ship offering resistance was rightly obliterated to the last man . History . Almari ' s flag used to depict a shark jumping a ship , but poor artwork made the shark appear more like a dolphin . One brave ajami named Michal Bluestar taunted her by calling her the " Dread Porpoise . " Almari was impressed with his bravery and offered to spare the wizard ' s life if he promised to make her a new flag .

title: Almorel
description: Almorel Almorel was a cosmoplitan yet primarily human trade city on the Golden Way . Geography . Almorel was located on the southeastern shores of the Lake of Mists where the Golden Way ran alongside it .
description_long: Almorel Almorel was a cosmoplitan yet primarily human trade city on the Golden Way . Geography . Almorel was located on the southeastern shores of the Lake of Mists where the Golden Way ran alongside it . It was the last caravan stop before entering the Endless Waste . Structure . Almorel was a sprawling town , buildings were almost all built out of wood and designed to be low and wide , with most households having attached stables and barns ( so it wasn ' t necessary to go outside during the cold winters ) as well as gardens and workshops . It was extremely rare for any building to have more than two stores . Wealthy families erected stockades around their properties . The gold dwarves of Almorel lived in a series of tunnels beneath the city . Traditionally , humans were not allowed down in the tunnels but the dwarves had set up small guest houses to receive human visitors . The dwarves did not speak openly about their underground homes which elicited much rumormongering of the secrets the dwarves kept down there . Defenses .

title: Almraiven
description: Almraiven Almraiven sat on the shore of the Shining Sea and was the only remaining human city in Calimshan around 1479 DR . History . Founded around - 5521 DR , the city weathered countless natural and man - made disasters and was rebuilt many times .
description_long: Almraiven Almraiven sat on the shore of the Shining Sea and was the only remaining human city in Calimshan around 1479 DR . History . Founded around - 5521 DR , the city weathered countless natural and man - made disasters and was rebuilt many times . The city was relatively unscathed by the Spellplague and the city ' s mage s were able to fend off genasi attacks during their rebellion . Government . The archmage Acham el Jhotos ruled Almraiven for many years and worked tirelessly to protect the city from djinn and efreet threats . Slavery was legal in Almraiven but el Jhotos was an abolitionist who sought to eventually free all slaves in Calimshan .

title: Alokkair
description: Alokkair Alokkair also known as Alokkair the Wizard - King was once the ruler of the lost kingdom of Hlontar who lives on as a Lich within Shadowdale . Appearance . Alokkair was very tall , standing at 6 ' 8 " , and had a long flowing white beard with long , wispy white hair .
description_long: Alokkair Alokkair also known as Alokkair the Wizard - King was once the ruler of the lost kingdom of Hlontar who lives on as a Lich within Shadowdale . Appearance . Alokkair was very tall , standing at 6 ' 8 " , and had a long flowing white beard with long , wispy white hair . His skin was putrid gray , but otherwise whole , and had shrunken to wrap his horribly gaunt , bony frame . Alokkair ' s eyes glowed in their skeletal sockets . He wore long flowing robes of purple silk and thick gray musterdelvys that were frayed and stained with mildew around the edges . Personality . Alokkair was a cold , brilliant , and sarcastic man who anticipated attacks and his opponent ' s strategies with cunning , yet paranoid ease . Alokkair was eloquent and persuasive , and enjoyed a good debate . He was driven by his greed for magic , with the intent of reclaiming his lost kingdom . Possessions . The Wizard - king outfitted himself with differing items over the centuries but a few have been noted including a " Ring of free action " , a " Ring of spell turning " and numerous magical scroll s . Alokkair hid his phylactery somewhere outside of his " Dread Lair " . History .

title: Alonmarch
description: Alonmarch Alonmarch was a county in Suretmarch in eastern Tethyr . Geography . Alonmarch was located just where the lowlands and the highlands of Tethyr met .
description_long: Alonmarch Alonmarch was a county in Suretmarch in eastern Tethyr . Geography . Alonmarch was located just where the lowlands and the highlands of Tethyr met . Its northern border was the River Ith . Counties Surkazar and Mirkazar were located east and south , respectively . Government . In 1370 DR , Count Vartan Thrynnar ruled Alonmarch from his castle of Thynnar ' s Hold atop Komar ' s Hill . He was one of a small number of rulers who maintained his holdings throughout the Tethyrian Interregnum . History . Alonmarch was one of the few stable areas of the country during the unrest of the Tethyrian Interregnum , because Count Vartan Thrynnar went out of his way to protect his tenant peasants , permitting some of them to even take refuge in Thrynnar ' s Hold . The region had traditionally been the site of many monster uprisings , as was the case with much of eastern Tethyr . In 1370 DR , because of the conflict with Teldorn Darkhope southeast in Kzelter and the defection of two cities from Amn in the north , many of the needed troops had been pulled out of the area . Notable Locations .

title: Alonso de Bartuella
description: Alonso de Bartuella Alonso de Bartuella was a sea captain in 1357 DR . Personality . His biggest flaw was being very vulgar at dinner .
description_long: Alonso de Bartuella Alonso de Bartuella was a sea captain in 1357 DR . Personality . His biggest flaw was being very vulgar at dinner . Activities . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . He always demanded the most exorbitant price for his services , but was a very competent captain and navigator with a loyal crew .

title: Alora
description: Alora Alora was a halfling thief . Alora was a cheerful and sweet halfling girl whose curiosity prompted her to frequently investigate forbidden and dangerous territory ( usually other people ' s property ) . She could be caught by adventurers while breaking into the High House of Wonders in Baldur ' s Gate at night , and offered to join them if they helped her case the joint .
description_long: Alora Alora was a halfling thief . Alora was a cheerful and sweet halfling girl whose curiosity prompted her to frequently investigate forbidden and dangerous territory ( usually other people ' s property ) . She could be caught by adventurers while breaking into the High House of Wonders in Baldur ' s Gate at night , and offered to join them if they helped her case the joint .

title: Alphar
description: Alphar Alphar was an island in the Pirate Isles . Geography . There were several harbours on the island and the westernmost harbour was neutral , allowing any ships to dock .
description_long: Alphar Alphar was an island in the Pirate Isles . Geography . There were several harbours on the island and the westernmost harbour was neutral , allowing any ships to dock . History . Immurk created his first pirate hold here . Inhabitants . The island was populated with around 3 , 000 pirates .

title: Alpuk
description: Alpuk Alpuk , also called the Central Basin , was the largest of the three regions of the Great Glacier and the home of the Iulutiun people . Geography . The Great Glacier was naturally divided into three regions .
description_long: Alpuk Alpuk , also called the Central Basin , was the largest of the three regions of the Great Glacier and the home of the Iulutiun people . Geography . The Great Glacier was naturally divided into three regions . The largest region was Alpuk , located in the southwest and bordered by the Uppuk River in the north , the Tuutsaas Chain in the west , the Lugsaas Chain in the south , and the Keryjek Ridge in the east . The region of Angalpuk was to the east , and Nakvaligach to the north . Alpuk encompassed the two largest seas in the Great Glacier , the Nakalpgotak and the Lugalpgotak . The mysterious mountainous region known as Novularond , home of frost giant s and arctic dwarves , was also within its borders . Most of the land was at a low elevation , but the ground was rough and occasionally contained rolling hills . Weather . Average temperatures in Alpuk ranged from −30 °F ( −34 °C ) to 35 °F ( 2 °C ) from Mirtul to Kythorn with a daytime average of 15 °F ( −9 °C ) and a nighttime average of −15 °F ( −26 °C ) .

title: Alro Randulkyn
description: Alro Randulkyn Alro " Five Flames " Randulkyn was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . His specialty was evocation spells . Personality .
description_long: Alro Randulkyn Alro " Five Flames " Randulkyn was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . His specialty was evocation spells . Personality . Alro was a rollicking , swashbuckler of a mage that didn ' t much care about collateral damage when it came to spellcasting . He wrapped himself in fine clothing and partook of the best wine and women that money could buy . While enjoying life was high on his list of priorities , his fun sometimes turned into cruelty to others . History . Sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Alro was present in the common room of the Whistling Wizard inn when Elminster Aumar of Shadowdale walked in and started teasing prominent members of the Tarntar about personal and private matters of business and pleasure . Alro was not foolish enough to attack the Sage of Shadowdale , but when the Old Mage sat on the lap of one of his business partners and transformed into a woman , he was likely one of the first to attack with spellcasting abandon . Unfortunately for him , the woman was the Simbul .

title: Altar of the Air
description: Altar of the Air The Altar of the Air was a shrine to the goddess Akadi built over a crypt in the center of the ruins of the city of Dashadjen . Inhabitants . The mummified priestess of Akadi , El Sadhara , resided there .
description_long: Altar of the Air The Altar of the Air was a shrine to the goddess Akadi built over a crypt in the center of the ruins of the city of Dashadjen . Inhabitants . The mummified priestess of Akadi , El Sadhara , resided there . Defenses . Some unknown power protected the shrine from the destructive power of the sands of the Calim Desert , and the Altar and its tombs below were said to contain treasures and magic unimaginable . History . The structure was built by lesser djinn during the time of Coramshan to honor the djinni Calim , and much of its elemental treasures awaited his supposed return .

title: Alter normal winds
description: Alter normal winds Alter normal winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Alter normal winds Alter normal winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . With this spell the caster could harness normal wind and increase its power to the next state . Becalmed wind could be changed into a breeze , a storm could be changed into a gale , etc . This spell had no effect on creatures from the Elemental Plane of Air . Components . A small silver tube was needed to cast this spell . The caster would blow into the tube to attract the wind ' s attention .

title: Alter self
description: Alter self Alter self , originally known as Quantoul ' s alterer , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to change his or her body to a new form . Effects . This spell only worked on the caster , and transformations were limited to the same general body type , " i .
description_long: Alter self Alter self , originally known as Quantoul ' s alterer , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to change his or her body to a new form . Effects . This spell only worked on the caster , and transformations were limited to the same general body type , " i . e . " , a biped could not become a quadruped or an arachnid . The earliest version of " alter self " allowed the caster to increase or decrease body size by half their normal size . All aspects of appearance , including clothing and belongings on his or her person , could be changed within that limit — height , weight , hair and skin color , gender — essentially anything that " change self " could do except that it was a real transmutation and not an illusion . If the new form had gills like a sea elf , the caster could breathe under water . If the new form had wings like a harpy , the caster could fly , although slower and more awkwardly than a real harpy .

title: Althea
description: Althea Althea the Abased was a priestess of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . History . Around 1267 DR , Althea the Abased succeeded Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn as leader of the House of the Broken God , after Waelarn had been expelled from office for triggering a holy war over the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater .
description_long: Althea Althea the Abased was a priestess of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . History . Around 1267 DR , Althea the Abased succeeded Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn as leader of the House of the Broken God , after Waelarn had been expelled from office for triggering a holy war over the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater . Seeing the carnage wrought by the fight for ownership of the " Tome " , Althea declared that no high - ranking member of the church was worthy of it . She said that Ilmater had given them the " Tome " for the " low and truly needy " priests to " further the will and work of Ilmater in the wilderlands and perilous places of all Toril " , and recruit non - believers to the faith of the Crying God . Soon after , Althea underwent her First Suffering . She had herself bound to a rack and dragged by mules as she visited temples and shrines of Ilmater all along the Sword Coast . Whenever the mules were rested , she was to be beaten once , but hard , with a consecrated threshing flail by a non - believer .

title: Altho Farambler
description: Altho Farambler Altho Farambler was a halfling merchant who lived at the Chang - liu - shui oasis in the Hordelands . Activities . Altho setup a small shop in his home , catering to clients travelling from the west .
description_long: Altho Farambler Altho Farambler was a halfling merchant who lived at the Chang - liu - shui oasis in the Hordelands . Activities . Altho setup a small shop in his home , catering to clients travelling from the west . Many of the natives of the Hordelands or Shou Lung found his items to be strange and exotic . He occasionally had trouble dealing with nomads who came to Chang - liu - shui to take water from the well , usually leaving it depleted . Altho began storing water from the well in casks that he kept inside of his house . He would sell this water to travelers if he could get a good deal .

title: Alton DeVir
description: Alton DeVir Alton DeVir was a drow wizard of House DeVir who posed as a master of Sorcere in the city of Menzoberranzan . Description . In 1297 DR , Alton marred his face with acid , making his features appear unrecognizable .
description_long: Alton DeVir Alton DeVir was a drow wizard of House DeVir who posed as a master of Sorcere in the city of Menzoberranzan . Description . In 1297 DR , Alton marred his face with acid , making his features appear unrecognizable . History . In 1297 DR , Alton was a student of Sorcere near to graduation . He was summoned to meet with one of the masters of Sorcere , the Faceless One . The Faceless One , having made an agreement with House Do ' Urden , attempted to kill Alton so that he would not be a surviving witness to House DeVir ' s destruction by House Do ' Urden . However , before the Faceless One could kill Alton , his apprentice , Masoj Hun ' ett , killed the Faceless One instead .
