It sold skewered vegetables that had been dipped in gravy , and during the winter it imported fruit and vegetables from the Shining South , selling them at high prices , especially out of season .

title: Ammanadas Silversword
description: Ammanadas Silversword Ammanadas Silversword was a member of the Silversword noble house of Cormyr . In 1369 DR , he stabbed Ensibal Threen , a War Wizard , in the throat for believing him to be a supporter of Vangerdahast ' s proposed regency . He was quickly subdued by Lareth Gulur , a passing Purple Dragon .
description_long: Ammanadas Silversword Ammanadas Silversword was a member of the Silversword noble house of Cormyr . In 1369 DR , he stabbed Ensibal Threen , a War Wizard , in the throat for believing him to be a supporter of Vangerdahast ' s proposed regency . He was quickly subdued by Lareth Gulur , a passing Purple Dragon .

title: Ammaratha Cyndusk
description: Ammaratha Cyndusk Ammaratha Cyndusk was a song dragon , and the mother of Narnra Shalace by Elminster . History . Early life .
description_long: Ammaratha Cyndusk Ammaratha Cyndusk was a song dragon , and the mother of Narnra Shalace by Elminster . History . Early life . Ammaratha ' s early life was not known ; what was known about her came mainly by way of Elminster and their daughter Narnra . Around 1300 DR , Ammaratha adventured in the form of a human sorceress , using the pseudonym Maerjanthra Shalace . She eventually settled in Waterdeep , where she became a jeweler for the nobility , and became known as Lady Maerjanthra of the Gems . During this time , she became one of Elminster ' s many occasional lovers . Eventually , she decided to bear him a child , which presented a problem : as a Chosen of Mystra , Elminster had conscious control over his own fertility . She decided to go to her lover ' s fellow Chosen , Khelben Arunsun , to get a spell to let her conceive . Arunsun at first refused , but then the goddess Mystra herself intervened , commanding the Blackstaff to grant the request . Life in Cormyr . After fleeing Waterdeep , she settled in the city of Marsember in Cormyr , where she took the name Lady Joysil Ambrur , presenting herself as a wealthy Sembia n merchant noble . 15th century .

title: Ammarindar
description: Ammarindar Ammarindar was a ruined city in the Northdark inhabited by tanarukk s . Geography . Ammarindar was located primarily in the Northdark between the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad .
description_long: Ammarindar Ammarindar was a ruined city in the Northdark inhabited by tanarukk s . Geography . Ammarindar was located primarily in the Northdark between the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . However , at its height , the kingdom also included territory covering the upper Delimbiyr Vale , between the High Forest and the Fallen Lands . Ammarindar was located some 250 miles southeast of Menzoberranzan and was linked to the city by dwarven tunnels carved over the Darklake . The path through Ammarindar was considered the quickest journey between Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad , but it was less traveled ( in 1372 DR ) because of the danger that lurked there . Structure . Originally carved by dwarves , the city ' s tunnels bore many features of dwarven architecture . The city had large boulevards and large chambers . The walls were inscribed with Dethek runes . Ammarindar had a foundry of black iron and runes . It was located in a huge cavern with pillars carved into the shapes of dragons . History . Ammarindar was a dwarven kingdom founded before both Cormanthyr and Netheril in - 4100 DR .

title: Ammatha Braceryn
description: Ammatha Braceryn Ammatha Braceryn was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was pleasantly plump , but light on her feet .
description_long: Ammatha Braceryn Ammatha Braceryn was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was pleasantly plump , but light on her feet . Personality . Ammatha was flirtatious and circulated among the customers making sure their needs were met . Abilities . She was a great cook , able to quickly whip up a meal . She and her sister brewed a sweet beer from berries . Relationships . The Three Elves was a very popular inn throughout the Moonsea region and its owner / operators were highly regarded . Ammatha had a sister , Baralea .

title: Ammathluir
description: Ammathluir Ammathluir was an important trading hub in Luiren in the Shining South . Geography . Ammathluir was situated south of the Long Forest in western Luiren .
description_long: Ammathluir Ammathluir was an important trading hub in Luiren in the Shining South . Geography . Ammathluir was situated south of the Long Forest in western Luiren . Description . Though it boasted a population of 10 , 000 halfling s , only a small fraction of the buildings of Ammathluir were found above ground , leading travelers to believe the city was just a simple village . Most of the population resided within halfole s underground . A temple to Yondalla was built into the side of a hill in Ammathluir . Inhabitants . Many skilled woodcarvers and tradesmen lived in Ammathluir , drawing caravans from the nearby Great Trade Way . Activities . Luiren traded salbread , Luiren Stout , and various carved wooden items with Dambrath and the surrounding nations of the Shining South . Armed Forces . At least a dozen halfling whistler s lived in Ammathluir , helping to keep the city safe from wild animal attacks .

title: Ammathtar
description: Ammathtar Ammathtar was a city located in northeastern Dambrath . Geography . Ammathtar was located between the Granuin forest on the east and the Trader ' s Way on the west .
description_long: Ammathtar Ammathtar was a city located in northeastern Dambrath . Geography . Ammathtar was located between the Granuin forest on the east and the Trader ' s Way on the west . History . Ammathtar was more tolerant than other areas of Dambrath due to trader ' s from the rest of Faerûn and halflings from Luiren . Prices for goods was discounted for crinti but inflated for every other race . A small percentage of all business transactions when to the city coffers , helping to fund a strong army . The largest horse pens in all of Dambrath were found in Ammathtar , holding upward of 5 , 000 prized steeds . Foreign travelers entering Ammathtar , including all adventurers , had to bribe an official with 100 gp each in order to enter the city . Defense . An army of 1 , 000 heavy cavalry and 50 wizard s defended Ammathtar from attack .

title: Ammisyll Veldann
description: Ammisyll Veldann Lady Ammisyll Veldann was the sun elven governor of Nimlith on the island of Evermeet and a member of the Council of Evermeet . Personality . Ammisyll had extremely conservative views and opposed the monarchy on Evermeet .
description_long: Ammisyll Veldann Lady Ammisyll Veldann was the sun elven governor of Nimlith on the island of Evermeet and a member of the Council of Evermeet . Personality . Ammisyll had extremely conservative views and opposed the monarchy on Evermeet . During the daemonfey assault on elven settlements in Faerûn in 1374 DR , she and Selsharra Durothil threatened to withdraw the support of the houses of Durothil and Veldann if Queen Amlaruil Moonflower sent forces from Evermeet to aid the Faerûnian elves . Relationships . Ammisyll was cousin to Tarthas .

title: Ammon Jerro
description: Ammon Jerro Ammon Jerro is a powerful warlock of the Sword Coast . Ammon is best known for his position as the chief enemy of the King of Shadows prior to the rise of the Kalach - Cha . Description .
description_long: Ammon Jerro Ammon Jerro is a powerful warlock of the Sword Coast . Ammon is best known for his position as the chief enemy of the King of Shadows prior to the rise of the Kalach - Cha . Description . Bald and aged , Ammon Jerro is nonetheless a physically impressive man made all the more powerful seeming by his considerable charisma , commanding voice , and determined manner . Ammon is reputed to never look relaxed or at ease , though he might flash an amused smile or sneer . The effects of his chosen profession are apparent on his own body . Covering his face and forehead are a latticework of glowing tattoos , likely magical in nature and possibly Thay an in origin . Other effects included Ammon ' s eyes , which are tinted and glowed with gold - red luminescence and the smell of smoke and blood that arose from him when angered . Ammon ' s hair is reddish in hue . Typically , Ammon is dressed in a leather suit covered in what appear to be alchemical ingredients , though during his confrontation with the King of Shadows he also wore a black cape and hood . Personality . Ammon Jerro has no tolerance for fools and little patience for politics .

title: Ammut
description: Ammut The ammut was a horrifying creature which inhabited Zakhara and performed judgments over sinners . Description . These creatures were a cross between a crocodile , a lioness , and a hippopotamus in mannish form .
description_long: Ammut The ammut was a horrifying creature which inhabited Zakhara and performed judgments over sinners . Description . These creatures were a cross between a crocodile , a lioness , and a hippopotamus in mannish form . Their tail and legs were like a crocodile , belly and neck were from a hippo , and they had lionlike arms and head . The typical ammut was 12 ft ( 3 . 7 m ) in length . Personality . Ammuts were gluttonous creatures that always wanted to eat . They were very fat , and often tunneled passages into tombs and burial grounds . Combat . Usually ammut used their fangs and claws to hurt prey . They would unexpectedly attack from underground and kill their victims very quickly . The keen eyes of an ammut gave it the power to see creatures within the Ethereal Plane . Ammut hunt individuals with evil in their souls . In battle , ammuts issued a hideous roar which could be heard for miles . Society . Ammuts avoided people by living in caves , mountains , and other uninhabited places . Many tribes of ammut would make their homes close to evil societies . The ammut were ruled by a matriarchy where the word of a female was law , although not all males obeyed .

title: Amn
description: Amn Amn , also known as the Merchant ' s Domain , was a tremendously wealthy nation in West Faerûn . Prior to the Spellplague and the continent ' s disappearance , Amn held colonies far away in Maztica . Post - Spellplague it still controlled important trade routes to Calimshan and Baldur ' s Gate as well as colonial ports in the Moonshaes and Chult .
description_long: Amn Amn , also known as the Merchant ' s Domain , was a tremendously wealthy nation in West Faerûn . Prior to the Spellplague and the continent ' s disappearance , Amn held colonies far away in Maztica . Post - Spellplague it still controlled important trade routes to Calimshan and Baldur ' s Gate as well as colonial ports in the Moonshaes and Chult . Its population , mostly human with a large minority population of halfling s , was historically in the range of 3 million . The country ' s natural resources and wealth , combined with its mercantile nature led Amn to become one of the most important and influential trading centers throughout Faerûn . The crowning jewel of this powerful state was the capital city of Athkatla , founded in 100 DR or 0 AR in official documents and often known as the " City of Coin . " Geography . Geographically , Amn was a fairly small state , though its size was impressive compared with its neighbor and frequent rival , Baldur ' s Gate . Historically , Amn held several colonies in Maztica but during the Spellplague these disappeared from Toril along with the rest of the continent .

title: Amnemis
description: Amnemis Amnemis was a black dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . She was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent but when she became too big , Vargo choose a new familiar and Amnemis became his cohort .
description_long: Amnemis Amnemis was a black dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . She was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent but when she became too big , Vargo choose a new familiar and Amnemis became his cohort . In truth , Amnemis was very devoted to Vargo and was really jealous of other familiars . Activities . The dragon resided in the Well of Dragons with her master .

title: Amnestria
description: Amnestria Amnestria Moonflower ( later known as Z ' beryl ) was the daughter of Amlaruil Moonflower and Zaor Moonflower and therefore a princess of Evermeet . She was also mother to Arilyn Moonblade . Description .
description_long: Amnestria Amnestria Moonflower ( later known as Z ' beryl ) was the daughter of Amlaruil Moonflower and Zaor Moonflower and therefore a princess of Evermeet . She was also mother to Arilyn Moonblade . Description . Amnestria was considered extremely beautiful , with the rare and prized hair color of deep blue . Her eyes were blue flecked with gold . Arilyn apparently bore a resemblance to her , as Elaith Craulnobur mistook Arilyn for Amnestria at first glance . Personality . Amnestria was described as possessing a " rare spirit and inner fire . " She was very intelligent and perceptive . She was often light - hearted . Elaith viewed as having a " humanlike " nature . History . Amnestria inherited her moonblade from her great - aunt , Thasitalia , who had been away from Evermeet . After her death , the moonblade was passed on to Arilyn . Amnestria grew up on Evermeet with Elaith Craulnobur . They were distantly related . They were later betrothed until Elaith ' s family moonblade rejected him ; the betrothal was nullified and Elaith went into self - imposed exile . Amnestria met and fell in love with the human ranger Bran Skorlsun . They had a child together ( Arilyn Moonblade ) .

title: Amnian phrases
description: Amnian phrases Amnian phrases are those with specific meaning in Amn . There are a number of these in common usage . B .
description_long: Amnian phrases Amnian phrases are those with specific meaning in Amn . There are a number of these in common usage . B . Book – Used with an adjective such as clean , other or true , to imply that someone is being dishonest . " What is in your clean book ? " is a request for the truth , as are " give me the true book " and " read from your other book " . The terms refer to a corrupt business which keeps two copies of account books . Buy – Used in the place of ' accept ' , of a deal , explanation or plan . C . Crimson ink – Very bad luck . See also red ink . D . Dragon – Can be used to describe a person who is miserly , although sensible , with their wealth . The term implies respect . F . Finance – To gain something beyond one ' s monetary means or something undeserved . Foreclose – A very loose term that can mean a variety of things depending on context and intent , including stop , take over , steal , hijack or kill . G . Good business – A general expression that can mean ' hello ' or ' goodbye ' . K . Kobold – A derogatory term used to imply stupidity . O . Outbid – To beat or be more impressive . P . Pearl – Used to personify luck .

title: Amnic Basult
description: Amnic Basult Amnic Basult was a male Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . He was the proprietor of Basult ' s Books , and was the only bookseller in town . Relationships .
description_long: Amnic Basult Amnic Basult was a male Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . He was the proprietor of Basult ' s Books , and was the only bookseller in town . Relationships . Amnic was the husband of Mela Basult . The two were heard to have loud arguments , but Mela firmly believed her husband still loved her . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Amnic visited the new Temple of Mystra in town and took a pamphlet , but doubted whether the goddess Mystra truly supported the priests there . Early in the month of Eleint , Amnic went missing ; he was last seen in his shop , where signs of a scuffle could be found . Mela was distraught and sought someone to help , but the militia of the Wheloon Watch did not investigate such cases . Neighbors , meanwhile , rumored Amnic had left his wife , either taking a few days away or taking up with another woman . Mela , meanwhile , tried to manage the bookshop in Amnic ' s absence . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , adventurers discovered that the temple was actually a front for priests of Shar and Cyric to kidnap magic - users and spirit them away to the Vast Swamp for some nefarious purpose .

title: Amnizu
description: Amnizu Amnizu were powerful baatezu found mostly on the layer of the Nine Hells called Stygia . Description . Amnizu were usually around 4 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Amnizu Amnizu were powerful baatezu found mostly on the layer of the Nine Hells called Stygia . Description . Amnizu were usually around 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) tall and had an elongated , bald head on which lay a mouth full of jagged teeth , a pug - nose , and heavily - browed , large porcine eyes . They had stubby limbs and large leathery wings . If they aged without a promotion , amnizu could grow to up to 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) tall . Behavior . Amnizu were aloof , thanks to their position as members of the ' nobility ' of the Nine Hells . They were hateful toward any other baatezu short of a pit fiend or archdevil as they were the creatures in charge of promoting them to an even higher station . Activities . Amnizu were typically charged with one of three duties , either as guardians of the River Styx , as the generals of mighty armies of abishai and erinyes or as the ferriers of new souls into the Nine Hells .

title: Amnurflow
description: Amnurflow The Amnurflow was a river in Amn that flowed into Lake Weng . Geography . The river was the northernmost of the tributaries of Lake Weng .
description_long: Amnurflow The Amnurflow was a river in Amn that flowed into Lake Weng . Geography . The river was the northernmost of the tributaries of Lake Weng . It began in the Cloud Peaks west of Citadel Amnur . Midway to Lake Weng , it was joined by the Rashturiver from the east . Comassur Creek merged with the Amnurflow five miles northeast of the lake . History . This river was named after General Amnur , a legendary military man who was the younger brother of the second king of Amn .

title: Amnwater
description: Amnwater Amnwater was a small city on the Eshpurta Road between Crimmor and Keczulla , in Amn . Until 1107 DR , Amnwater was simply a tavern . After this time , it became a village of farmers and caravan drovers .
description_long: Amnwater Amnwater was a small city on the Eshpurta Road between Crimmor and Keczulla , in Amn . Until 1107 DR , Amnwater was simply a tavern . After this time , it became a village of farmers and caravan drovers . As of 1368 DR , the population was about 7 , 500 permanent residents , although this number increased to 15 , 000 in the summer , and to 26 , 000 when harvests and caravan runs took place . As of 1368 DR , the town was spread out and surrounded by low stone walls , with large gates to control trade traffic , and smaller gates for pedestrians .

title: Amori De ' Spri
description: Amori De ' Spri Amori De ' Spri was a resurrected noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In her past , Amori was a noble in Waterdeep .
description_long: Amori De ' Spri Amori De ' Spri was a resurrected noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In her past , Amori was a noble in Waterdeep . She was buried in Undermountain after her death , together with her husband Julain De ' Spri . In 1479 DR , the vampire Dayan using a strange resurrection machine he had found resurrected Amori . However , because she returned to life thanks to the life forces of kobold s and rage drake s , Amori ' s mind was temporarily addled and she often displayed kobold and rage drake mannerisms . Amori disliked her new life and wanted to return to her death with her Julain .

title: Amphail ( village )
description: Amphail ( village ) Amphail was a village on the Long Road . Population . It had a population of 600 , supporting 250 more in outlying farms .
description_long: Amphail ( village ) Amphail was a village on the Long Road . Population . It had a population of 600 , supporting 250 more in outlying farms . The population was mostly human s , but there were elves , half - elves and a smattering of dwarves and halfling s . History . Amphail was named after one of Waterdeep ' s early warlords , Amphail the Just , who had estates here . Geography . The village was three days ' ride north of Waterdeep . Trade . Its main trade was growing food for Waterdeep , but it was also known for its outstanding horse s ( Amphail Grays and glossy black chargers ) , and due to this it suffered from the stench of horse manure during the warmer months . The wealthier inhabitants or landowners of Amphail were generally the ones who bred horses . The largest horse breeder was the Roaringhorn family of Waterdeep , but others included Amcathra , Ilzimmer , Jhansczil , and Tarm , as well as individual breeders Rorth Baldasker , Ohm Oglyntyr , and Elraghona Selember . Although not breeders , the Eagleshield family made tack for the horses and operated a farm for the treatment of sick animals . Defense .

title: Amphail the Just
description: Amphail the Just Amphail the Just was a human War Lord of Waterdeep . He reigned during the second Trollwar , but his reign lasted only one year because he was killed during a battle against the troll s . His rule followed on from that of Gharl , successor to Nimoar , and he was succeeded by another five War Lords before the end of that twelve - year period .
description_long: Amphail the Just Amphail the Just was a human War Lord of Waterdeep . He reigned during the second Trollwar , but his reign lasted only one year because he was killed during a battle against the troll s . His rule followed on from that of Gharl , successor to Nimoar , and he was succeeded by another five War Lords before the end of that twelve - year period . The village of Amphail is named after him , and his ghost is still said to walk the streets there . Amphail was the middle of three Caradoon brothers . The oldest brother was Renwick Caradoon , a noted wizard , and the youngest brother was Samular Caradoon . Amphail and Samular were both paladins in the service of Tyr .

title: Ampherd Holt
description: Ampherd Holt Ampherd Holt was a Zhentarim cleric of Tempus at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Ampherd had an unbalanced mind , being in permanent state of battle madness .
description_long: Ampherd Holt Ampherd Holt was a Zhentarim cleric of Tempus at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Ampherd had an unbalanced mind , being in permanent state of battle madness . However , his sermons about the glory received from death in battle became very popular among the soldiers , and many considered Ampherd their chaplain . Boruse Temlor hated him for his popularity , and Kandar Milinal distrusted him because of his craziness .

title: Amphisbaena
description: Amphisbaena An amphisbaena ( æm - fis - BAY - na ) resembles a pit viper with instead of one head two of them at each end of its body . Alu - fiend Physical description . An amphisbaena ' s skin molts just like other snakes , and little horns above each eye helps it to shed its skin .
description_long: Amphisbaena An amphisbaena ( æm - fis - BAY - na ) resembles a pit viper with instead of one head two of them at each end of its body . Alu - fiend Physical description . An amphisbaena ' s skin molts just like other snakes , and little horns above each eye helps it to shed its skin . The skin of an amphisbaena has the same variation as found in normal viper s . Amphisbaene slither sideways just like other snakes . It can step up its pace of movement by grabbing its own head with the other , and rolling like a hoop . Combat . In combat amphisbaena ' s can use both heads when snapping at opponents simultaneously . It enables the monster to attack and defend at the same time . Its bite , when succesfully piercing the armor of its opponent , can transform flesh into stone . Using this ability , an amphisbaena will attempt to bite its own head with the other upon impending death , so to turn itself into stone . Location . Sages have documented the hatching of a clutch of amphisbaenea some years ago in the town of Chariton in the Battledale .

title: Amplify
description: Amplify Amplify was a simple alteration spell used to alter the volume of sound . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .
description_long: Amplify Amplify was a simple alteration spell used to alter the volume of sound . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects . This spell allowed the caster the change the volume of sounds near the spell ' s area of effect , lasting for several hours depending on the skill of the caster . The effected disk - shaped area glowed softly from the magic ' s effects . Sound entering the caster ' s side of the disk exited up to five times louder or softer than the original sound . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a cone of paper to cast .

title: Amra
description: Amra Amra was an ancient human kingdom of Returned Abeir . History . According to old legends , one of the kings that ruled Amra centuries before the Spellplague was a dragonheir .
description_long: Amra Amra was an ancient human kingdom of Returned Abeir . History . According to old legends , one of the kings that ruled Amra centuries before the Spellplague was a dragonheir . This king made Gauwervyndhal promise that she or any other dragon would never attack the Sword Lands . Amra fell when the king was assassinated and the lords fought one another for the throne . Amra ' s castles and keeps were destroyed during the war . Legacy . Even after Amra fell , no dragon attacked the Sword Lands ever since .

title: Amrath Mulnobar
description: Amrath Mulnobar Amrath Mulnobar was the castellan of Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Amrath was the castellan of the Hunt Lords keep for more than two centuries serving them from before they entered in a pact with Orcus becoming wight .
description_long: Amrath Mulnobar Amrath Mulnobar was the castellan of Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Amrath was the castellan of the Hunt Lords keep for more than two centuries serving them from before they entered in a pact with Orcus becoming wight . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR only Amrath remained in the keep with the Hunt Lords .

title: Amratha Shuldeiroun
description: Amratha Shuldeiroun Amratha Shuldeiroun was the senior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Amratha was a petite woman with beautiful , angular features and red hair .
description_long: Amratha Shuldeiroun Amratha Shuldeiroun was the senior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Amratha was a petite woman with beautiful , angular features and red hair . Personality . Amratha swirled about the inn seeing that all the guests ' needs were met or even anticipated . She had a no - nonsense attitude and a sharp tongue but did not stoop to using vulgarities ; rather , she cajoled with wit or sarcasm as the situation warranted . Abilities . At some point in her life she received basic training as a fighter . Activities . As the senior chatelaine , she ruled the day shift , talking to the guests and directing the staff on how best to serve them . Relationships . She was essentially second in command after Mester Rauvaraudo , the majordomo of the Sign of the Shield . She and her night - shift counterpart , Maeragra Duskwinter , were similar in hair color , stature , appearance , and demeanor , but were unrelated .

title: Amree
description: Amree Amree was a human ship ' s wizard whose home port is Westgate . In 1479 DR she sailed on a ship owned by the Nine Golden Swords and successfully defended the ship from attack by Sahuagin and the boat was able to limp back into port in Westgate . Unfortunately , the ship had taken too much damage and sank in Westgate harbor after all the cargo had been unloaded .
description_long: Amree Amree was a human ship ' s wizard whose home port is Westgate . In 1479 DR she sailed on a ship owned by the Nine Golden Swords and successfully defended the ship from attack by Sahuagin and the boat was able to limp back into port in Westgate . Unfortunately , the ship had taken too much damage and sank in Westgate harbor after all the cargo had been unloaded . The ship ' s captain blamed Amree for the loss of the ship and the Nine Golden Swords attempted to collect the debt from her . A ship owned by the Standing Tree Monastery needed a mage for a journey to confront the exiled eladrin Cealynna and two monks from the ship , Kwan Shang - Li and his father Kwan Yung , went to the inn at which Amree was staying to ask her to join the crew . At the inn , they confronted members of the Nine Golden Blades who were attempting to kidnap Amree and killed or incapacitated all the thugs . Amree agreed to join the crew and they sailed into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Cealynna sank the ship and took Kwan Shang - Li to her castle at the bottom of the sea . The surviving crew members were able to breath in Cealynna ' s domain due to her magic .

title: Amrelle Mistwind
description: Amrelle Mistwind Lady Amrelle Mistwind was a human female . Description . Amrelle was stunningly beautiful and had dark swirling hair that matched her eyes .
description_long: Amrelle Mistwind Lady Amrelle Mistwind was a human female . Description . Amrelle was stunningly beautiful and had dark swirling hair that matched her eyes . A gem - studded wyvern tattoo graced her upper thigh . She was not in the habit of wearing undergarments . Activities . Amrelle was involved in the Rightful Conspiracy against the crown .

title: Amreth Gaunt
description: Amreth Gaunt Armreth Gaunt was a master merchant who resided in Scornubel . He was sly and had a glib tongue . He was willing to deal with anyone with the exception of eladrin whom he considered out of his league .
description_long: Amreth Gaunt Armreth Gaunt was a master merchant who resided in Scornubel . He was sly and had a glib tongue . He was willing to deal with anyone with the exception of eladrin whom he considered out of his league . He didn ' t trust anyone and never took a wife because of his innate distrust of others . Description . Although he may once have been handsome , by his fifth decade , this was no longer the case . Abilities . Gaunt was an accomplished fencer but preferred to avoid direct combat .

title: Amryyr Yauntyrr
description: Amryyr Yauntyrr Amryyr Yauntyrr was a courier in Skullport for the Dark Dagger . History . Amryrr was born to House Druu ’ giir , a noble house in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Amryyr Yauntyrr Amryyr Yauntyrr was a courier in Skullport for the Dark Dagger . History . Amryrr was born to House Druu ’ giir , a noble house in Menzoberranzan . In 1370 DR , he still held on his house insignia but his relationship with his house was as good s non - existent . He met his best friend Malakuth Tabuirr in Menzoberranzan when the latter still ran caravans in service of his merchant house in Karsoluthiyl . At some point , he became a member of the Dark Dagger , the main reason for his entry was that his friend Malakuth was the leader of the local cell . Personality . Amryyr had a reserved personality and valued his friendship with Malakuth Tabuirr . Amryrr followed Vhaeraun and hated Lolth ' s priestesses for their readiness to hurt people to satisfy religious demands . In other words , female drow who didn ’ t act in such ways received his respect and friendship as did Xalyth , the quasi monopolist of the spell component market in Menzoberranzan . Activities . Amryrr was mostly traveling as part of his courier work between Skullport and many Underdark settlements , including his hometown of Menzoberranzan .

title: Amsha al - Lanim
description: Amsha al - Lanim Amsha al - Lanim was in charge of the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Amsha was harsh and strict , relentlessly driving her employees to strive for perfection in their duties .
description_long: Amsha al - Lanim Amsha al - Lanim was in charge of the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Amsha was harsh and strict , relentlessly driving her employees to strive for perfection in their duties . Activities . Amsha took great pride in running the busiest gate in all of Huzuz — a gate that admitted more people to the city than even the whole harbor . She took her job very seriously and never missed a day of work in eight years on the post , including the days when she gave birth to her two children . Relationships . Unable to find an enlightened Zakharan husband who would tolerate her lofty career goals , Amsha married a foreign wizard named Elfinster , who operated a small school . Possessions . Amsha owned a magical longsword and jambiya . Her wedding ring was actually a " ring of regeneration " .

title: Amstel River
description: Amstel River The Amstel River was a river in eastern Amn that began with the merging of Trifin Creek and the River Rimril at Eshpurta . Geography . The river flowed safely southward for about 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) until it was joined by the Khalleshyr at Trollford , then it turned west and became impossible to ford for 75 miles ( 120 kilometers ) .
description_long: Amstel River The Amstel River was a river in eastern Amn that began with the merging of Trifin Creek and the River Rimril at Eshpurta . Geography . The river flowed safely southward for about 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) until it was joined by the Khalleshyr at Trollford , then it turned west and became impossible to ford for 75 miles ( 120 kilometers ) . As it approached Lake Esmel , the Amstel became passable again but the banks near the lake were made of the bright red clay of the region .

title: Amulet of Dreams
description: Amulet of Dreams The Amulet of Dreams was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . While wearing an Amulet of Dreams , the owner could summon up to three sandmen .
description_long: Amulet of Dreams The Amulet of Dreams was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . While wearing an Amulet of Dreams , the owner could summon up to three sandmen . The sandmen would obey the owner ' s commands if they were fed a jewel worth at least 100 gp or if they temporarily drained some of the owner ' s health . The sandmen would attack the owner if they were not allowed to feed .

title: Amulet of Laeral ' s Tears
description: Amulet of Laeral ' s Tears Amulets of Laeral ' s tears were named after the famed sorceress , Laeral Silverhand . They temporarily bestowed greater health upon those who wore the amulet against their skin . A variant of these amulets , known as an Amulet of Dark Blessing , were found among the drow of the Underdark and besides their appearance they functioned identically .
description_long: Amulet of Laeral ' s Tears Amulets of Laeral ' s tears were named after the famed sorceress , Laeral Silverhand . They temporarily bestowed greater health upon those who wore the amulet against their skin . A variant of these amulets , known as an Amulet of Dark Blessing , were found among the drow of the Underdark and besides their appearance they functioned identically . Description . Strung along these amulets were soft , brittle , and colorless fancy stone crystals known as Laeral ' s tears . They were often large and kept a glossy , magnificent finish . The Underdark - wrought " Amulets of Dark Blessing " were crafted using a single iridescent black gemstone , however . After being expended , both versions of the amulet would crumble to dust . Powers . Whilst worn next to the skin the amulet bestowed a temporary increase to one ' s health . However , once this bonus health had been eroded ( via injury ) then the amulet crumbled into worthless dust . History . The Witches of Rashemen used to craft these amulets using many large colorless stones .

title: An Army of One Thousand
description: An Army of One Thousand The spider katanga are massing again and the rivers flowing from Fire Mountain are poisoning the lands they flow through . Two groups of heroes are required - one group to cause a distraction and rescue the scouting party who were captured when they were sent to investigate , and another to venture into the spider katanga lair to kill their Mother of a Thousand Young before she can birth an army .
description_long: An Army of One Thousand The spider katanga are massing again and the rivers flowing from Fire Mountain are poisoning the lands they flow through . Two groups of heroes are required - one group to cause a distraction and rescue the scouting party who were captured when they were sent to investigate , and another to venture into the spider katanga lair to kill their Mother of a Thousand Young before she can birth an army .

title: Ana - Mashhal
description: Ana - Mashhal Ana - Mashhal was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Ana - Mashhal was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Ana - Mashhal Ana - Mashhal was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Ana - Mashhal was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Ana - Mashhal was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Anabraxis
description: Anabraxis Anabraxis the Black Talon was a runescribed dracolich revered by the Cult of the Dragon as their ultimate authority around the Year of the Ageless One . Activities . She had various lairs in Lorosfyr in the Underdark , from were she could travel to the Shadowfell at will through its bottomless abyss , and she commanded a tribe of Death giant s that lived in the deepest regions of the chasm .
description_long: Anabraxis Anabraxis the Black Talon was a runescribed dracolich revered by the Cult of the Dragon as their ultimate authority around the Year of the Ageless One . Activities . She had various lairs in Lorosfyr in the Underdark , from were she could travel to the Shadowfell at will through its bottomless abyss , and she commanded a tribe of Death giant s that lived in the deepest regions of the chasm .

title: Anaconda
description: Anaconda Anaconda were a mercenary company based in Elven Wood near Elmwood and operating in Dalelands and Stonelands around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership .
description_long: Anaconda Anaconda were a mercenary company based in Elven Wood near Elmwood and operating in Dalelands and Stonelands around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership . The Anaconda recruited only married couple . They were a calculating and closed group , mourning every loss . They had two units of infantry , one of cavalry and one of archers , each of 50 members . There were also 10 scouts , 10 sorceresses and 20 priestesses . Tactics . They were very effective as irregular troops and advance scouts with a talent for the ambushes on night . large battles or when on caravan duty they employed their elephant mascot Blanka . Contracts . The Anacondathey never backed out of a contract . They charged 120 gold piece s per week for their services and 400 gp for night ambush and long - rage reconnaissance . History . The history of the Anaconda was one of only rumors . They originated from an unknown southwest island . Rumors said that they worked both defending and attacking caravans in Dalelands and helping or defeating Stonelands goblinoid . Some said they worked for the Zhentarim .

title: Anagakok
description: Anagakok An anagakok was a special type of wizard unique to the Great Glacier who had been magically adapted to the cold . Description . An anagakok was immediately recognizable , because the secret ceremony of his or her initiation magically and permanently changed his or her physiology — an anagakok had fur like an animal .
description_long: Anagakok An anagakok was a special type of wizard unique to the Great Glacier who had been magically adapted to the cold . Description . An anagakok was immediately recognizable , because the secret ceremony of his or her initiation magically and permanently changed his or her physiology — an anagakok had fur like an animal . An inch of soft , white fur covered the entire body of an anagakok . If the hair was shaved off , it would grow back in less than a day . Unlike other Ulutiun s and because of their warm fur , anagakoks did not dress in thick , layered clothing . Instead , they tended to wear simple , loose tunics . Abilities . Anagakoks had excellent , almost instinctive , survival skills and could locate food even in the worst conditions . They could also magically increase the fortune of themselves and their companions . An anagakok ' s fur granted him or her protection from the cold ; however , it meant that they overheated easily if in hot environments , and , outside the Great Glacier , they were viewed with suspicion , since they had such a strange appearance .

title: Anagrys Brightbrass
description: Anagrys Brightbrass Anagrys Brightbrass was a gold dwarf wizard who grew up in the Great Rift . History . She showed a remarkable aptitude for magic from an early age .
description_long: Anagrys Brightbrass Anagrys Brightbrass was a gold dwarf wizard who grew up in the Great Rift . History . She showed a remarkable aptitude for magic from an early age . When she reached her fiftieth birthday , her family enrolled her into the Academy Arcane , a dwarven magical institution in the Rift . She studied under the archmage Randak Forn , an ex - adventurer who played a large role in exterminating the aberration s that lived in the surrounding area . Randak taught her with the intention that she would follow in his footsteps , and , upon completion of her wizard training , that is exactly what she did . As a congratulatory gesture , Randak bestowed upon Anagrys his helm , which he had worn during his adventures . She immediately joined with a group of gold dwarf adventurers and set about continuing her master ' s quest of killing the aberrations living in the nearby Underdark tunnels . The party was very successful at first , freeing a large number of dwarf and human slaves in raids on duergar slavers and beholder cults . However , when the party came across their first group of mind flayer s , things took a sharp turn for the worse .

title: Analyze device
description: Analyze device Analyze device was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was used primarily by mechanician s . Effects .
description_long: Analyze device Analyze device was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was used primarily by mechanician s . Effects . With this spell , a wizard or mechanician was able to discern the workings of a clockwork device crafted by another . Random information was determined , making the mechanism ' s primary purpose difficult to discern . More functions were determined the longer the caster kept the spell active . The spell would end automatically if all of the functions for a device were discovered . Components . This spell required a special mechanical device to cast .

title: Analyze opponent
description: Analyze opponent Analyze opponent was a divine magic divination spell available to priests , holy strategists , and holy warriors of the Red Knight , the Lady of Strategy . It let the caster gauge the strengths and weaknesses of one or more creatures for tactical intelligence . Effects .
description_long: Analyze opponent Analyze opponent was a divine magic divination spell available to priests , holy strategists , and holy warriors of the Red Knight , the Lady of Strategy . It let the caster gauge the strengths and weaknesses of one or more creatures for tactical intelligence . Effects . Beginning Red Knightists casting this spell could learn one strength or weakness about one creature . Higher level casters were able to learn up to four or five strengths and weaknesses about a single creature or about each member of a group of creatures . The caster learned the most powerful advantages and disadvantages first . So , for example , the ability to cast " finger of death " at will would be revealed before a natural resistance to sonic energy . The targets of " analyze opponent " had a chance to resist the magic of this spell and , if successful , the caster learned nothing . Components . This spell had a somatic component and utilized the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus . Rumors and legends . There was a legend about one of the first priests of Tempus who earned or won the Lady of Strategy ' s favor . He was granted " analyze opponent " and used it on a rakshasa .

title: Analyze portal
description: Analyze portal Analyze portal was a divinatory spell used by arcane spellcasters in the Realms . Cleric s of Eilistraee or Shaundakul who mastered the portal domain could also cast this spell . Effects .
description_long: Analyze portal Analyze portal was a divinatory spell used by arcane spellcasters in the Realms . Cleric s of Eilistraee or Shaundakul who mastered the portal domain could also cast this spell . Effects . Upon casting this spell , which took a full minute , the caster could sense if the area within a cone of 60 - foot radius contained any portal s . If portals were present , the caster could continue to concentrate and analyze each portal to learn its properties . The caster would instantly know the size and location of a portal within the area of effect . As successive seconds passed , the caster would learn new properties , depending on his or her power , in the following order : One could not extend the effects of other divinatory magics through the portals being studied . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic component s and the use of a lens made of crystal and a small mirror , which were consumed in the casting . Clerics who could access this spell instead used their holy symbol as a focus .

title: Ananta
description: Ananta Ananta was a dragonborn who served as the Guardian of Dracowyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Ananta was able to breathe acid .
description_long: Ananta Ananta was a dragonborn who served as the Guardian of Dracowyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Ananta was able to breathe acid . Equipment . Ananta possessed a powerful magical staff granted to her by the dragon Princes of Murghôm . It gave her access to spell s powerful enough to subdue any dragon and enhanced her acid breath . History . Ananta was rescued from a presumably nasty fate by the blue dragon Skalnaedyr , and she swore fealty to him ever since . Skalnaedyr made her Guardian of Dracowyr . Her role as Guardian was to attend any dragon who wanted to parlay with the rulers of Murghôm , and contact with her master if such an event happened ; and to make sure neutrality remained sacred in Dracowyr . In 1479 DR , she fought and lost against the vampiric smoke drake Brimstone when he appeared to parlay with the princes of Murghôm . However , he allowed her to live with the condition that she helped him to contact Skalnaedyr . After the blue dragon accepted to play in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " , he tasked Ananta to help the drake in his duties as referee of the game .

title: Anarch of Shyr
description: Anarch of Shyr The anarchs of Shyr are one of the oldest orders of swordmage s on either Abeir or Toril , having originated long ago amongst genasi arcane spellcaster s on the continent of Shyr . In contrast to some of the more esoteric or abjuration based swordmages , anarchs of Shyr concentrate on focusing the arcane magic that flows through the Elemental Chaos into powerful blasts of energy . This has served the anarchs of Shyr well for centuries , making them ideal enemies of the dragon s of Abeir and Returned Abeir .
description_long: Anarch of Shyr The anarchs of Shyr are one of the oldest orders of swordmage s on either Abeir or Toril , having originated long ago amongst genasi arcane spellcaster s on the continent of Shyr . In contrast to some of the more esoteric or abjuration based swordmages , anarchs of Shyr concentrate on focusing the arcane magic that flows through the Elemental Chaos into powerful blasts of energy . This has served the anarchs of Shyr well for centuries , making them ideal enemies of the dragon s of Abeir and Returned Abeir . Culture . The original anarchs of Shyr , who still exist , were members of an arcane order located on the continent of Shyr , who served to protect the local genasi kingdoms against the aggression of Abeir ' s powerful dragon lords . Although bound to defend the kingdom , anarchs of Shyr were not necessarily loyal , and often saw themselves not merely as protectors of the state but of the people within it , leading them to rebel against local lords and kings if they felt the establishment leaned too far towards tyranny . It is in this way that most anarchs of Shyr still serve on Abeir .

title: Anarchic
description: Anarchic Anarchic is a weapon quality that can be added to any weapon . The weapon becomes chaotically aligned and inflicts more damage to creatures of lawful alignment . Any lawful creature welding an " anarchic " will be weakened .
description_long: Anarchic Anarchic is a weapon quality that can be added to any weapon . The weapon becomes chaotically aligned and inflicts more damage to creatures of lawful alignment . Any lawful creature welding an " anarchic " will be weakened . Creation . The creator of an anarchic weapon must be chaotic and know the spell chaos hammer .

title: Anariel
description: Anariel Anariel was an individual who gave the elven longbow " Taulmaril " and a quiver of Anariel to Clan Battlehammer . She had the title " Sister of Faerûn " . History .
description_long: Anariel Anariel was an individual who gave the elven longbow " Taulmaril " and a quiver of Anariel to Clan Battlehammer . She had the title " Sister of Faerûn " . History . Anariel once gifted the bow " Taulmaril " and a quiver of endless arrows to Clan Battlehammer at Mithril Hall . In 1356 DR , the Companions of the Hall explored the ruins of Mithril Hall and Regis discovered Taulmaril and the quiver in a crack in a stone wall . They gave both quiver and bow to Catti - brie , and she went on to use both in many battles . The quiver was named the " quiver of Anariel " after Anariel .

title: Anastes
description: Anastes Anastes was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1369 DR . Description . Anastes had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Anastes Anastes was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1369 DR . Description . Anastes had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven and typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Personality . Like most giants of Lake Woe mountain , Anastes was dour and melancholy , so much so that the weather around him was affected . Anastes believed strongly in predestination . He acted out of duty , because he believed he did not have any true choice in any matter . Possessions . Ramos bore a sword in battle that was twenty - feet long . History . By 1369 DR , Anastes , and five other storm giants were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . They heeded his call . Anastes spoke at length with Brianna while she was nursing the child . She tried to convince him that Lanaxis was evil , but Anastes claimed that there was nothing he could do . She even showed him her son ' s face , which was hideously ugly , as proof that his supposed new emperor was a monster .

title: Anastra Syluné Silverhand
description: Anastra Syluné Silverhand Anastra Syluné Silverhand , more commonly known as Syluné and also known as the Witch of Shadowdale , was the eldest of the Seven Sisters . After her death at the hands of a dragon cult , she remained in Shadowdale as a spectral harpist . History .
description_long: Anastra Syluné Silverhand Anastra Syluné Silverhand , more commonly known as Syluné and also known as the Witch of Shadowdale , was the eldest of the Seven Sisters . After her death at the hands of a dragon cult , she remained in Shadowdale as a spectral harpist . History . Syluné decided that she could best serve Mystra by settling down and nurturing a community to show that magic was more than just a weapon . She hoped to one day set up a magical school , as well . Mystra agreed , and so Syluné wandered the Realms for centuries , enhancing her own magecraft and looking for a suitable place to achieve her goal . In her quest , she trained under hermits , druid s , priests and lich es , as well as other mages . She spent a lot of time in the east in Thay ( in disguise ) , with the witches of Rashemen , and she visited the land of Kara - Tur several times as well . She made many powerful acquaintances during this time , and also found and used the " Scepter of Savras " , but eventually handed it over to Azuth ( after Savras , in an attempt to escape from his prison , gave her the secret ability to transform herself into a silver dragon ) .

title: Anathar ' s Dell
description: Anathar ' s Dell Anathar ' s Dell was an inn located in southern Daggerdale . Geography . The establishment was nestled between Serpentsbridge to the north and the Spiderhaunt Wood s to the south .
description_long: Anathar ' s Dell Anathar ' s Dell was an inn located in southern Daggerdale . Geography . The establishment was nestled between Serpentsbridge to the north and the Spiderhaunt Wood s to the south . Inhabitants . The Dell was settled by the dwarven Clan Brightblade , two old human families — Blacklock and Talop — and two half - elven families — Snowgold and Winterwood . Defenses . In spite of its size and relative exposure , Anathar ' s Dell was surprisingly well defended . Firstly , the farm family ' s borders were protected by ten or more trained hunting cats , which were fiercely loyal and attacked any non - humans or demihumans that got too close . Thanks to the dwarves , the farm folk were outfitted with arms and armor ( ranging from chain mail up to plate mail ) and could all be equipped rather quickly . In addition , the Dell had a few " secret defenses " , among which included a potent sleep gas that was developed by the dwarves . The townsfolk become immune to its effects over many years of exposure resulting in a combination that often surprised many bands that thought the Dell easy prey .

title: Anauria
description: Anauria Anauria was one of a small number of cities of Netheril that survived Karsus ' s Folly . Afterwards , it grew into a kingdom . Nevertheless , it was eventually swallowed up by the growing Anauroch desert .
description_long: Anauria Anauria was one of a small number of cities of Netheril that survived Karsus ' s Folly . Afterwards , it grew into a kingdom . Nevertheless , it was eventually swallowed up by the growing Anauroch desert . Description . Anauria was one of Netheril ' s famed flying cities . It was famous for the craftsmanship of its swords and for its magic , and after the fall of Netheril , it became the richest of the three surviving states , collectively known as the Lost Kingdoms . Geography . The capital city of Anauria was Amazandar , which was located west of the Desertsmouth Mountains . The city of Anauril was located northeast of Amazandar and west of modern Shadowdale . Helvara was located south of Lake Miir and was the center of Anauria ' s agricultural activity . Government . Anauria was a human - ruled kingdom . Population . The Lost Kingdom of Anauria was inhabited by humans , elves , and half - elves . Those among the upper classes enjoyed such diversions as hunting , and the lower classes produced vast quantities of grain to export to the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars . The noble houses of Anauria were History .

title: Anauroch
description: Anauroch Anauroch ( either Ah - " NOR " - ach or An - OAR - ock - hh ' ) , or The Great Sand Sea , was a magical desert in northern Faerûn . It held the remnants of the once - powerful Netherese Empire , their flying enclaves having crashed to the ground when their greatest mage Karsus , in a desperate bid to end the war against the phaerimm , challenged the goddess Mystryl for her divine mantle , causing the Weave to falter and all magic to fail . For generations since , Anauroch , the greatest desert in Faerûn , encroached relentlessly on border nations , burying them beneath the sands .
description_long: Anauroch Anauroch ( either Ah - " NOR " - ach or An - OAR - ock - hh ' ) , or The Great Sand Sea , was a magical desert in northern Faerûn . It held the remnants of the once - powerful Netherese Empire , their flying enclaves having crashed to the ground when their greatest mage Karsus , in a desperate bid to end the war against the phaerimm , challenged the goddess Mystryl for her divine mantle , causing the Weave to falter and all magic to fail . For generations since , Anauroch , the greatest desert in Faerûn , encroached relentlessly on border nations , burying them beneath the sands . Inhabitants . The only people to call Anauroch home were the nomadic Bedine tribes and a small Zhentarim garrison , tasked with patrolling and defending a line of oases along the Black Road , the trade route that winded west from the ruins of Teshendale to Llorkh at the foot of the Graypeak Mountains . A diminutive people called the D ' tarig were the only other major inhabitants , who lived along the borders of the desert and interact somewhat with peoples from surrounding countries .

title: Anauroch : The Empire of Shade
description: Anauroch : The Empire of Shade Anauroch : The Empire of Shade is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the 3 . 5 - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Summary .
description_long: Anauroch : The Empire of Shade Anauroch : The Empire of Shade is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the 3 . 5 - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Summary . " Anauroch : The Empire of Shade " offers PCs the opportunity to at last confront the ambitious machinations of the Princes of Shade , who have the power of Karsus himself within their grasp . The PCs must sift through history to determine what threat looms over the land , and then overcome the challenge of trekking through a hostile environment without the comfort of the Weave and its magic to aid them . To stop the shades from advancing their ambitions against the rest of the world , the characters must penetrate the very heart of the Empire of Shadow . Only by scattering the pages of the " Nether Scrolls " can they put a halt to the Shadovar scheme and prevent Shar from shattering magic forever .

title: Anaxim
description: Anaxim An anaxim , also called a sheen , was a golem - like metallic elemental native to the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The anaxims did not had a definite form .
description_long: Anaxim An anaxim , also called a sheen , was a golem - like metallic elemental native to the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The anaxims did not had a definite form . They were a conglomerate of metallic parts jutting with too many cutting implements and rusted surfaces . While no two anaxims were exactly alike , these creatures were classified in broad types , such as the " hounds " ( that looked like dog s ) or the " maulers " ( that where humanoid in appearance ) . Habitat . Anaxims were encountered exclusively in the Glaur Barrens , an inhospitable region north to the kingdom of Gontal . There were sections of the ancient fortress of Glaur that were infested with anaxims . Explorers called them the " Dominion of the Mindless " . Ecology . Anaxims were mindless creatures , lacking even an animal ' s basic instincts . They did possess some form of pseudo - consciousness , but it was filled with a murderous intent that made them dangerous to any other lifeforms , including even themselves . Anaxims didn ' t born naturally , but instead were created by the Storm Spire of the fortress of Glaur .

title: Anaya
description: Anaya Anaya was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Anaya and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Anaya Anaya was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Anaya and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Anaya was full of hatred , which could damage other beings at a touch .

title: Ancestral mound
description: Ancestral mound ORIGINS When Uthgar conquered the beast Gods and ascended on his sky pony to join his father Beorunna he left his people with a path and totem animals to lead them on the path outlined by Tempus . By assigning the totem spirits to the tribes the shamans were gifted with the power to invoke the strength and characteristics of the deity , either upon themselves or others of the tribe . The ancestor mound was a pivitol socio / religious focus point of the tribes , with each tribe generally regarding at least one mound as their traditional veneration site , of which the history of the people would be remembered in oral tradition .
description_long: Ancestral mound ORIGINS When Uthgar conquered the beast Gods and ascended on his sky pony to join his father Beorunna he left his people with a path and totem animals to lead them on the path outlined by Tempus . By assigning the totem spirits to the tribes the shamans were gifted with the power to invoke the strength and characteristics of the deity , either upon themselves or others of the tribe . The ancestor mound was a pivitol socio / religious focus point of the tribes , with each tribe generally regarding at least one mound as their traditional veneration site , of which the history of the people would be remembered in oral tradition . DESIGN Traditionally the mounds were constructed in a series of concentric raised earthern banks with lower regions in between , known as Cairn rings and Vales . In the centre would be the altar mound and the altar stone . Menhirs were common marking the points is the compass on the outer Cairn rings . Some mounds stood out for being of unusal design .

title: Anchin
description: Anchin Anchin was a Tsuyoi - no - kami acolyte in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . As a new monk , Anchin was assigned to do all the most menial works no one else wished to perform .
description_long: Anchin Anchin was a Tsuyoi - no - kami acolyte in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . As a new monk , Anchin was assigned to do all the most menial works no one else wished to perform . History . Anchin and Kaian were temped by the young maiden O - Shino , acting under the orders of monks Kogi and Bupposo of the Winter Sect temple , as part of a good prank Personality . Anchin was full of doubt about his life and if monastic life was the best for him . He was bored of menial work . Anchin mistakenly saw all this doubts as a sign of weakness .

title: Anchorome
description: Anchorome Anchorome ( " Ang - kor - OH - may " ) is the far western continent of Toril . It lies roughy 3 , 000 miles ( 4800 km ) west across the Trackless Sea of the Sword Coast , or about 1 , 000 miles ( 1600 km ) west of Evermeet . Anchorome is directly north of Maztica .
description_long: Anchorome Anchorome ( " Ang - kor - OH - may " ) is the far western continent of Toril . It lies roughy 3 , 000 miles ( 4800 km ) west across the Trackless Sea of the Sword Coast , or about 1 , 000 miles ( 1600 km ) west of Evermeet . Anchorome is directly north of Maztica . History from the Heartlands viewpoint . Anchorome was first discovered by the famed explorer Balduran , who returned with great wealth . These riches were used in part to build a wall around the fledgling city of Baldur ' s Gate . Apparently , he came back to Anchorome only to meet his death , certainly killed by Poscadari . Shorty after the Golden Legion reported the discovery of Maztica in 1361 DR , Duke Entar Silvershield decided to find Anchorome . He quickly assembled a fleet of 20 ships , led by the Flaming Fist and sent them west . This expedition met with disaster , beset by problems such as plagues and storms . They eventually made it to Helmsport in Maztica and then turned north . Soon they had found the shores of Anchorome and they anchored their 15 ships off the coast . Unfortunately , this put the fleet right above the sahuagin nation of Itzcali .

title: Ancient Ones
description: Ancient Ones The Ancient Ones were believed to be supernatural beings of great power by the Nexalan s , but they were actually drow . History . The Ancients lived in the Highcave at the summit of Zaltec ' s sacred volcano , Mount Zatal .
description_long: Ancient Ones The Ancient Ones were believed to be supernatural beings of great power by the Nexalan s , but they were actually drow . History . The Ancients lived in the Highcave at the summit of Zaltec ' s sacred volcano , Mount Zatal . Like many drow , they could not stand direct sunlight and thus only operated in darkness . They were capable of practicing powerful Hishna magic . Their duties included feeding Zaltec ' s Darkfyre and advising the high priest of Nexal . Lolth turned the Ancient Ones into drider s during the Night of Wailing as punishment for their lack of faith in her .

title: Andahar
description: Andahar Andahar was a unicorn that could be summoned by Drizzt Do ' Urden . Description . Drizzt possessed a horn charm on a silver chain .
description_long: Andahar Andahar was a unicorn that could be summoned by Drizzt Do ' Urden . Description . Drizzt possessed a horn charm on a silver chain . When blown into , the charm summoned Andahar who appeared , running and gradually growing in size , from another dimension . However , unlike Drizzt ' s other magical companion , Guenhwyvar , Andahar was mortal and could be wounded . He also could also be summoned at any time for as long as required . Andahar was 17 hands tall . He had a white coat of fur , an ivory horn tipped with a golden point , and blue piercing eyes . He also had bells tied to his reins , which Drizzt could silence or set to ringing as he saw fit . History . The ruling council of Silverymoon commissioned Andahar the mount for Drizzt in gratitude for his work during the Third Orc War .

title: Andannas Dalkur
description: Andannas Dalkur Andannas Dalkur was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Dalkur hailed from Secomber , later moved to Tharsult , and finally settled in Candlekeep .
description_long: Andannas Dalkur Andannas Dalkur was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Dalkur hailed from Secomber , later moved to Tharsult , and finally settled in Candlekeep . Before 1487 DR , someone killed him and used his appearance to infiltrate the monastery . In 1487 DR , Elminster Aumar found Dalkur ' s body under Candlekeep . He also decided to use Dalkur ' s disguise to infiltrate the monastery and find the one who killed Dalkur . Relationship . Dalkur was an acquaintance of Elminster , who considered him a good writer .

description_long: Andar Andar was the " Realms " name for , a durable gemstone that could be facet - cut by a skilled to produce translucent " andars " with a green - red or brown - red flash . Description . This semi - precious stones could be found as small crystals , averaging 0 . 5 in ( 13 mm ) in diameter , or as tumbled streambed pebbles . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Andar ( sunmaster )
description: Andar ( sunmaster ) Andar was a cleric and sunmaster of Amaunator . He organized a torchbearer service , employing orphans , to light the ways of citizens moving about in the dark . His torchbearers often brought him news of unlawful things occurring in the darkness , which he sought to deal with .

His torchbearers often brought him news of unlawful things occurring in the darkness , which he sought to deal with .

title: Andar Obarskyr
description: Andar Obarskyr Andar Obarskyr was brother to Ondeth and uncle to Faerlthann , first king of Cormyr . He was part of the first human settlement in what was then known as the Wolf Woods . In an argument between the humans and an elf hunter by the name of Thatoryl Elian , Andar slew the elf .
description_long: Andar Obarskyr Andar Obarskyr was brother to Ondeth and uncle to Faerlthann , first king of Cormyr . He was part of the first human settlement in what was then known as the Wolf Woods . In an argument between the humans and an elf hunter by the name of Thatoryl Elian , Andar slew the elf . In retribution , a group of elven warriors , led by Thatoryl ' s betrothed , Lorelei Alavara , attacked their camp and killed everyone there , save Andar , who had been answering nature ' s call at the time .

title: Andareunarthex
description: Andareunarthex Andareunarthex , aka Dareun , is a young Green dragon and a player of the game of Xorvintaal . In 1479 DR he made the audacious move of entering Waterdeep and establishing a lair in an antiquaries shop the Trades Ward , outside the range of the Ahghairon ' s dragonward . His ultimate goal appears to have been domination of Waterdeep .
description_long: Andareunarthex Andareunarthex , aka Dareun , is a young Green dragon and a player of the game of Xorvintaal . In 1479 DR he made the audacious move of entering Waterdeep and establishing a lair in an antiquaries shop the Trades Ward , outside the range of the Ahghairon ' s dragonward . His ultimate goal appears to have been domination of Waterdeep . Clytemorrenestrix ( Nestrix ) , a Blue dragon who had been changed by the spellplague into a woman and her companion Tennora Hedare broke into Dareun ' s shop and stole a magical mask on behalf of Aundra Blacklock . Dareun tracked Tennora back to her apartment and attacked her . When Nestrix showed up during the confrontation he recognized her as a dragon and assumed she was a fellow player of Xorvintaal who was making a move against him . Dareun subdued Nestrix and teleported her back to a hideout in the sewers . He agreed to free Nestrix if Tennora would steal the Song Dragon ' s Choker , a relic that allows the wearer to escape the effects of the dragonward . Dareun double crossed Tennora and attempted to have her killed .

title: Andarphisk Hawkspike
description: Andarphisk Hawkspike Andarphisk Hawkspike was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Andarsphisk was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in the poor quarters of Suzail .
description_long: Andarphisk Hawkspike Andarphisk Hawkspike was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Andarsphisk was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in the poor quarters of Suzail . History . Around 1480 DR , Andarphisk and his partner Drounan Harbrand were paid by Lady Dawningdown to go to the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr .

title: Anders Aricssen
description: Anders Aricssen Anders Aricssen was a Northman rogue living in the city of Ravens Bluff . History . Along with Jack Ravenwild , Anders broke into House Kuldath in order to steal a set of five perfect rubies purchased by the Brothers Kuldath from jeweler Shorlock Revahl .
description_long: Anders Aricssen Anders Aricssen was a Northman rogue living in the city of Ravens Bluff . History . Along with Jack Ravenwild , Anders broke into House Kuldath in order to steal a set of five perfect rubies purchased by the Brothers Kuldath from jeweler Shorlock Revahl . He also accompanied Jack and the dwarf Tharzon in an attempt to find the tomb of master distiller Cedrizarun by following Zandria and her band of adventurers .

title: Andorra
description: Andorra Andorra of the Many Veils , or the Gazelle , was a wildly popular dancer living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Combined with her impressive dancing skills , Andorra ' s beauty , genuine smile , and friendly demeanor ensured she always had a captive audience of amorous nobles .
description_long: Andorra Andorra of the Many Veils , or the Gazelle , was a wildly popular dancer living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Combined with her impressive dancing skills , Andorra ' s beauty , genuine smile , and friendly demeanor ensured she always had a captive audience of amorous nobles . Activities . Andorra danced at the restaurants and coffee shops of Huzuz ' s " suqs " . Her call to fame was an enchanting display involving flamboyant sheer silk veils that disappeared during her performance . Rumors & Legends . Unknown to all who watched her perform , Andorra was an elite agent of the Soft Whisper . She used her position to gather intelligence from naive young nobles and reported directly to the Grandmother of the Soft Whisper . Possessions . Andorra owned a magical " jambiya " , " pipes of sounding " , and an assortment of assassination tools .

title: Andranth Glarvreth
description: Andranth Glarvreth Andrath Glarvreth was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Glarvreth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I in order to become a noble .
description_long: Andranth Glarvreth Andrath Glarvreth was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Glarvreth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I in order to become a noble . He had assembled an armory in Suzail . He had some dealings with Relgadrar Loroun and was supported by a Sembia n - aligned cabal . Manshoon , after enslaving Relgadrar Loroun , decided he needed to talk with Glarvreth . Later , Andranth met Lord Olgarth Oldbridle to ask for his support and Manshoon entered his mansion using the body of Burrath , Oldbridle ' s bodyguard . However , they were attacked by Kormoroth of Westgate and his men . Personality . Glarvreth wanted by all means to become a noble and had no problem in plotting against the king if this would help his plan .

title: Andreas Vanderslyke
description: Andreas Vanderslyke Andreas Vanderslyke was a monster hunter . Personality . The hunter traveled far and wide in search of evil creatures to stalk .
description_long: Andreas Vanderslyke Andreas Vanderslyke was a monster hunter . Personality . The hunter traveled far and wide in search of evil creatures to stalk . His home was the wilderness , and he was uncomfortable in towns and cities . He explored dungeons not to find treasure , but to test himself against dangerous monsters that lived there . ] History . Around 1369 DR , Andreas and his companion Honus were ambushed and pursued by the Shadowcloaks of Calaunt . Trapped in a small room , Vanderslyke and Honus were surrounded by the criminal organization and given a mock trial with Shartana acting as judge and jury .

title: Andrew
description: Andrew Andrew was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Andrew ' s father , Zachan , told Andrew about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle .
description_long: Andrew Andrew was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Andrew ' s father , Zachan , told Andrew about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle . This caused Andrew and his brother , Alex , to gain confidence and go adventuring . However , they ended up near Highcliff Castle , where they got cornered by a bunch of wolves . Gera and Zachan asked of thr Kalach - Cha to rescue their sons . Upon rescuing them , the Kalach - Cha could tell the truth there were twice as many duergar , or lie that there was no battle .

title: Andrew Goldhawk
description: Andrew Goldhawk Andrew Goldhawk is a fantasy illustrator who was born in 1966 in Buffalo , New York . He graduated from the Colorado Institute of Art and from the early 1990s he has worked with RPG companies such as TSR , White Wolf , and Wizards of the Coast . He considers himself to be a science fiction and horror artist , and prefers to use traditional methods such as oil , pencil , and brush .
