He graduated from the Colorado Institute of Art and from the early 1990s he has worked with RPG companies such as TSR , White Wolf , and Wizards of the Coast . He considers himself to be a science fiction and horror artist , and prefers to use traditional methods such as oil , pencil , and brush .

title: Andrik Gos
description: Andrik Gos Andrik Gos was a mad artist in Mulmaster . Relationship . Andrik was the nephew of Zor Faltyn Gos , one of the Blades of Mulmaster .
description_long: Andrik Gos Andrik Gos was a mad artist in Mulmaster . Relationship . Andrik was the nephew of Zor Faltyn Gos , one of the Blades of Mulmaster . He had an older brother Garwyl Gos and a sister Liticia Gos . History . Andrik was always an artist and a painter . Around 1491 DR , when the Blades competed with each other over the arts , Andrik was generously sponsored by his uncle . However , true success arrived only with his patron Doril Cire , secretly a cultist of the Cult of the Eternal Flame . Thanks to the infusion of elemental fire in his paintings , his works attracted more people . Doril manipulated him into creating a masterpiece that could summon an elemental blast that would destroy the city . At last , however , an adventuring party hired to uncover the truth behind an arson attack on Tiega Gos managed to defeated Doril and stop Andrik . Afterwards , his talent vanished completely , leaving Andrik despondent .

title: Androsphinx
description: Androsphinx Androsphinxes ( ÆN - dro - sfink - ses ) were the males of the sphinx species . They were physically powerful creatures with inherent magical powers and a terrifying roar . While they tended to be short - tempered and terse , androsphinxes possessed good - natured ideals and always attempted to do the right thing .
description_long: Androsphinx Androsphinxes ( ÆN - dro - sfink - ses ) were the males of the sphinx species . They were physically powerful creatures with inherent magical powers and a terrifying roar . While they tended to be short - tempered and terse , androsphinxes possessed good - natured ideals and always attempted to do the right thing . Androsphinxes were favored by the elven deities Aerdrie Faenya and Solonor Thelandira , the dwarven god Vergadain , the Mulhorandi god Horus - Re , and the god Nobanion . They would sometimes send them as messengers to her followers .

title: Andrus Kriivor
description: Andrus Kriivor Andrus Kriivor was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Andrus Kriivor Andrus Kriivor was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . He was a competent leader , able to keep his head and make tactical decisions in crisis situations . Abilities . Andrus was a specialist with the longsword . Possessions . He wore chain mail and carried a shield , but he could don plate mail stored in a few caches around town if needed . He carried a longsword , club , and dagger . History . Andrus was trained by the Zhentilar and chosen for the position of deputy .

title: Andy Collins
description: Andy Collins Andy Collins is a game designer for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Collins received his bachelors degree in English from in 1994 .
description_long: Andy Collins Andy Collins is a game designer for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Collins received his bachelors degree in English from in 1994 . Projects . Collins has worked at Wizards of the Coast since 1996 . He was the author of the " Sage Advice " column of " Dragon " magazine . His projects included the 3 . 5 edition and 4 edition revisions of the Dungeons & Dragons rulesets .

title: Andzrel Baenre
description: Andzrel Baenre Andzrel Baenre was the weapons master of House Baenre and a commander of the Army of the Black Spider . Description . Andzrel wore black mithral plate and a dark cloak .
description_long: Andzrel Baenre Andzrel Baenre was the weapons master of House Baenre and a commander of the Army of the Black Spider . Description . Andzrel wore black mithral plate and a dark cloak . He was tall and disciplined . He wielded a two - bladed sword . He was the son of one of Quenthel Baenre ' s cousins , a thus a noble , but not a very high one . History . Background . Andzrel was once " polymorph ed " into a riding lizard by Nauzhror Baenre and promptly bit him in the buttocks . Since then their relationship was somewhat strained . War of the Spider Queen . When Triel Baenre ordered the formation of the Army of the Black Spider in 1372 DR , she placed Andzrel as its commander . Although Andzrel was very capable , Nimor Imphraezl ( disguised as Captain Zhayemd of House Agrach Dyrr ) was able to charm Andzrel into taking his misleading advice . Forming a decisive plan against the armies of Gracklstugh , Andzrel led the the drow to the defense of the Pillars of Woe , where the army was betrayed by the plans of Nimor .

title: Angah Lalla
description: Angah Lalla Angah Lalla was a curios dealer and fence for stolen goods in the city of Scornubel . Appearance . Angah dressed in flowing off - white robes with a black veil .
description_long: Angah Lalla Angah Lalla was a curios dealer and fence for stolen goods in the city of Scornubel . Appearance . Angah dressed in flowing off - white robes with a black veil . He wore a large gold rune - engraved " amulet of protection + 2 " around his neck . His long black hair was braided and tied with off - white cloth . He spoke in a hoarse whisper . Background . There were rumours that Angah was from the lands east of Thay and Rashemen or Zhakar , mostly perpetuated by his dress sense and his reluctance to show his face . Angah was actually a character invented by a married couple , Aareem and Leila , who came to Scornubel from Sembia after angering a powerful prince . One half of the team was usually out collecting information while the other stayed behind in the shop . Aareem and Leila were both in their forties with a teenaged daughter named Ezther , who also began assuming the guise of Angah . Shop . Angah ' s shop was near the center of Scornubel and appeared large from the outside , but it was dimly lit with maze - like shelving arrangements within . The contents of the shop consisted of weapons , books , scrolls , armor , and other knick - knacks .

title: Angel
description: Angel Angels , also known as the aasimon , were celestial immortal s of varying humanoid form that hailed from any of the celestial plane s or the Astral Sea . In the Dawn War , angels served deities as soldiers , though they are not necessarily in the service of the gods anymore . Angels were ancient enemies of elemental archon s as well as all manner of fiend s .
description_long: Angel Angels , also known as the aasimon , were celestial immortal s of varying humanoid form that hailed from any of the celestial plane s or the Astral Sea . In the Dawn War , angels served deities as soldiers , though they are not necessarily in the service of the gods anymore . Angels were ancient enemies of elemental archon s as well as all manner of fiend s . Description . Angels , who ranged from human - like to ogre - like in size , were not so much physical beings as energy given form . Made both from the essence of the Astral Sea and that of the celestial planes , angels were basically the physical forms of the mixture of those energies . This form was vaguely humanoid , with varying degrees of similarity to mortals . Most angels had only the most basic masculine or feminine features , with lower bodies that trailed off into floating energy . Others , however , appeared much more human , possessing comely looks and what appeared to be wholly physical bodies , though this was an illusion . Angels all exhibited wings of some form , which they used to fly . Combat . Angels had a number of unique abilities granted to them by their nature .

title: Angel McCoy
description: Angel McCoy Angel Leigh McCoy grew up delving into fantasy and horror novels to escape the doldrums of long , hot summers . She won her first essay contest in 6th grade and has been writing ever since . As time passed , she studied French Literature at the University of Illinois in Champaign - Urbana and rediscovered the attractions of myth and magic .
description_long: Angel McCoy Angel Leigh McCoy grew up delving into fantasy and horror novels to escape the doldrums of long , hot summers . She won her first essay contest in 6th grade and has been writing ever since . As time passed , she studied French Literature at the University of Illinois in Champaign - Urbana and rediscovered the attractions of myth and magic . Evolution happened . She traveled . She learned . Gaming became a part of her life . Over the years , she has designed RPG material for companies such as White Wolf , Wizards of the Coast , FASA , and Pinnacle Entertainment Group . She worked for Microsoft Game Studios , writing articles as Xbox . com correspondent Wireless Angel . Currently , she is a game developer at ArenaNet , where she is part of a vast team effort to make the coolest MMORPG ever : Guild Wars 2 .

title: Angel of decay
description: Angel of decay The Angel of Decay was an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Standing 9 - feet tall and weighing 500 – 700 lbs with wings and claws , their putrid bodies constantly decomposed , and pools of filth dribbled around their feet .
description_long: Angel of decay The Angel of Decay was an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Standing 9 - feet tall and weighing 500 – 700 lbs with wings and claws , their putrid bodies constantly decomposed , and pools of filth dribbled around their feet . In battle they were ferocious , using their ogre - like size and strength to pummel opponents who have not already succumbed to their aura of corruption . When they spoke they did so with a slurred , muddy voice .

title: Angel of vengeance
description: Angel of vengeance An angel of vengeance was an angel sent to punish those who defied or angered the gods , or to test a mortal who was in danger of falling from the path a deity set for them . Combat . When in battle , these immortal s wore plate mail and fought with dual longsword s .
description_long: Angel of vengeance An angel of vengeance was an angel sent to punish those who defied or angered the gods , or to test a mortal who was in danger of falling from the path a deity set for them . Combat . When in battle , these immortal s wore plate mail and fought with dual longsword s . Personality . These angels showed no mercy . Society . Influential clergy members were known to use a powerful ritual to call forth one of these angels to deal out their deity ' s wrath .

title: Angelar ' s skin
description: Angelar ' s skin Angelar ' s skin , also called angel ' s skin , was not a mineral but a delicate pink coral found on reefs in shallow tropical waters . Description . Proper preparation of these fancy stones included baking in the sun for many days to dry them out and to eliminate the odor of dead sea life .
description_long: Angelar ' s skin Angelar ' s skin , also called angel ' s skin , was not a mineral but a delicate pink coral found on reefs in shallow tropical waters . Description . Proper preparation of these fancy stones included baking in the sun for many days to dry them out and to eliminate the odor of dead sea life . It could then be worked into jewelry but had to be protectively mounted to avoid accidental breakage . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp .

title: Angelic avenger
description: Angelic avenger An angelic avenger is a paragon path available to cleric s . This particular path places one in high accord with one ' s deity to the point where in battle one may begin to look like an angel , a servant of the gods . One ' s face becomes unrecognizable , wings sprout from one ' s back and legs dissipate and one looks as if to float .

title: Angelo Dosan
description: Angelo Dosan Angelo Dosan was a corrupt Flaming Fist officer who worked for Sarevok , briefly becoming the head of the Fist when Scar was assassinated and Duke Eltan incapacitated . He fell along with Sarevok in his final stand in the Undercity . He was also the father of the female warrior called Shar - Teel .
description_long: Angelo Dosan Angelo Dosan was a corrupt Flaming Fist officer who worked for Sarevok , briefly becoming the head of the Fist when Scar was assassinated and Duke Eltan incapacitated . He fell along with Sarevok in his final stand in the Undercity . He was also the father of the female warrior called Shar - Teel . History . Gorion ' s Ward heard rumors about Dosan after they returned to Baldur ' s Gate following the accusation of the murder of Rieltar Anchev and Brunos Costak levied against them . If they let themselves be captured , then they were brought before Angelo , who wantonly sentenced them and their party to death by hanging and had them thrown in a cell to wait . However , if Shar - Teel had joined Gorion ' s Ward , Dosan would simply let them go . Later , in the final battle , Angelo , equipped with a number of magic items including a " ring of invisibility " and " arrows of detonation " , rushed into the combat and released " fireball " s near himself , heedless of who was hit by them . Appendix . Notes . Angelo Dosan only appeared in the non - canon " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game and not the canon novelization .

title: Angels of Death
description: Angels of Death The Angels of Death were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Fully 35 , 000 efreet armed with composite short bows made up the Angels of Death .
description_long: Angels of Death The Angels of Death were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Fully 35 , 000 efreet armed with composite short bows made up the Angels of Death . Activities . The Angels of Death were the archers of the efreet army . The archers were both mounted and unmounted . Mounted archers rode nightmare s , ghost mount s , or skeletal horse s . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Angels of Death .

title: Anghara Hettix
description: Anghara Hettix Anghara Hettix was a gnome merchant in the Moonsea region . Personality . Anghara was an experienced and well - traveled merchant .
description_long: Anghara Hettix Anghara Hettix was a gnome merchant in the Moonsea region . Personality . Anghara was an experienced and well - traveled merchant . She had a pleasant manner and a tendency to use long , multisyllabic words whenever possible . Activities . Anghara led a caravan from Mulmaster to Tantras . History . Anghara was a rogue from Icewind Dale . After securing a small amount of wealth , she decided to start a new life as a merchant in Moonsea . In 1491 DR , she was convinced by Captain Gideon Holke to add to her caravan an adventuring party that , unknown to Anghara , he had hired to clear the area of bandits .

title: Angharradh
description: Angharradh Angharradh , also referred to as the Queen of Arvandor , who was sometimes considered the personification of three separate elven goddesses , Aerdrie Faenya , Hanali Celanil , and Sehanine Moonbow , as well as a single goddess who extended beyond these three separate aspects before the Spellplague , was the chief goddess of the Seldarine . As such , her nature reflected traits of each of these deities . Due to the nature of her creation , Angharradh exhibited a fierce protectiveness and strong resolve .
description_long: Angharradh Angharradh , also referred to as the Queen of Arvandor , who was sometimes considered the personification of three separate elven goddesses , Aerdrie Faenya , Hanali Celanil , and Sehanine Moonbow , as well as a single goddess who extended beyond these three separate aspects before the Spellplague , was the chief goddess of the Seldarine . As such , her nature reflected traits of each of these deities . Due to the nature of her creation , Angharradh exhibited a fierce protectiveness and strong resolve . Despite her vigilance , the reversal of the Elven Retreat and the return of drow to Cormanthor weakened Angharradh ' s spirit while causing the three goddesses to spend more time apart . Worshipers . The church of Angharradh was essentially the unified face of the three separate , but closely allied , churches of Aerdrie , Hanali and Sehanine . Most cleric s of Angharradh were affiliated with at least one aspect of the Three , being considered wise women and sages , often being consulted when important issues arose .

title: Angharradh ' s favor
description: Angharradh ' s favor Angharradh ' s favor was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , granted to worshipers of Angharradh that granted one ally a burst of skill or luck against various types of attacks . This power could only be invoked after the caster or an ally demonstrated skill or luck on their own .
description_long: Angharradh ' s favor Angharradh ' s favor was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , granted to worshipers of Angharradh that granted one ally a burst of skill or luck against various types of attacks . This power could only be invoked after the caster or an ally demonstrated skill or luck on their own .

title: Anglathammaroth
description: Anglathammaroth Anglathammaroth was a male black dragon who served as the mount of Undarl , the malaugrym magelord of Athalantar . History . In 240 DR , during Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection against the magelords , Undarl rode Anglathammaroth in his battle with Elminster .
description_long: Anglathammaroth Anglathammaroth was a male black dragon who served as the mount of Undarl , the malaugrym magelord of Athalantar . History . In 240 DR , during Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection against the magelords , Undarl rode Anglathammaroth in his battle with Elminster . Elminster , however , was supported by the elven wizard Baerithryn , who transformed himself into a silver dragon . In the fierce fighting that followed , Anglathammaroth and Braerithryn killed each other .

title: Angrath Woodwise
description: Angrath Woodwise Angrath Woodwise was one of servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Angrath was the chief hunter for Lord Marsten until his master was killed some time before the Tyranny of Dragons and the lodge was occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .
description_long: Angrath Woodwise Angrath Woodwise was one of servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Angrath was the chief hunter for Lord Marsten until his master was killed some time before the Tyranny of Dragons and the lodge was occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel . She decided to use Angrath and the other servants as her own . However , Angrath was demoted to head groom and his position went to Trespin . Angrath greatly hated the troll .

title: Angruin Myrvult
description: Angruin Myrvult Angruin Myrvult was a powerful Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR Angruin was the commander - in - chief of a secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale ; however Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr discovered the Zhent plot about the dale and started an insurrection against the Zhent and thanks also to the coming of the Time of Troubles the Zhent were defeated and Angruin died by a spell going crazy .

title: Angsaas Chain
description: Angsaas Chain The Angsaas , or " Eastern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the east of the Great Glacier . Geography . The Angsaas Chain overlooked the plains of Sossal and formed the border between that land and Angalpuk .
description_long: Angsaas Chain The Angsaas , or " Eastern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the east of the Great Glacier . Geography . The Angsaas Chain overlooked the plains of Sossal and formed the border between that land and Angalpuk . It was one of the three " Saas " , " Shields " , that surrounded and protected the Great Glacier and divided it off from the rest of Toril . Flora & Fauna . White caribou grazed on the lower slopes of the southern mountains of the chain . As in the other Shields , remorhaz also were present here in large numbers . White dragon s also laired in the tallest peaks in the southern parts .

title: Angulutiun
description: Angulutiun The Angulutiuns were a human ethnic group living in the Angalpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were a nomadic race of caribou - herders , and were one of the peoples collectively known as the Ulutiun s . Description .
description_long: Angulutiun The Angulutiuns were a human ethnic group living in the Angalpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were a nomadic race of caribou - herders , and were one of the peoples collectively known as the Ulutiun s . Description . Like all Ulutiuns , Angulutiuns were short and stocky and had round and flat facial features . They were rarely taller than five feet ( 150 cm ) . Males usually weighed between 130 and 260 pounds ( 60 – 120 kg ) , and females were about 35 pounds ( 16 kg ) lighter . They had short and thick legs with stubby fingers and toes . Their ears and nose were tiny , and they had especially wide teeth . They had light yellow or brown skin — which was a little darker than the skin color of Iulutiun s — dark brown eyes , and black hair . Angulutiuns had more fat under their skin than other humans and extra blood vessels in their extremities . Males could not grow facial hair . These adaptations gave them a special resistance to living in the frigid cold weather of their native lands . These people tended to have greater strength and fortitude than other human races but , with their stubby fingers and shorter legs , lacked the speed and dexterity of other humans .

title: Angus
description: Angus Angus was an old moorhound owned by Tristan Kendrick , Prince of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Deep in his years , Angus had a worn brown face and a shaggy neck .
description_long: Angus Angus was an old moorhound owned by Tristan Kendrick , Prince of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Deep in his years , Angus had a worn brown face and a shaggy neck . History . In 1345 DR , Daryth became the kennel master of Angus and Tristan ' s other hunting dogs .

title: Angus Materi
description: Angus Materi Angus Materi was an important member of the Zhentarim and the leader of the Outriders of Darkhold , an elite cavalry troop of vanguard raiders based in Darkhold . Personality . Angus was among the most easily encountered of the Zhent secondary leaders .
description_long: Angus Materi Angus Materi was an important member of the Zhentarim and the leader of the Outriders of Darkhold , an elite cavalry troop of vanguard raiders based in Darkhold . Personality . Angus was among the most easily encountered of the Zhent secondary leaders . He had an intense hatred for king Azoun IV of Cormyr and attacked all Purple Dragons on sight . Relationships . The fighter reported all activity in the area surrounding Darkhold to the Pereghost .

title: Anhur
description: Anhur Anhur ( pronounced " an " - hur ) , also known as Rumathep , Ramathant in Thay , and Ramatep in Unther , is a wise and peace - loving deity . He remains ever vigilant in his role of protecting Mulhorand from evil , but still finds the time to appreciate those he defends . History .
description_long: Anhur Anhur ( pronounced " an " - hur ) , also known as Rumathep , Ramathant in Thay , and Ramatep in Unther , is a wise and peace - loving deity . He remains ever vigilant in his role of protecting Mulhorand from evil , but still finds the time to appreciate those he defends . History . Anhur and his church were highly esteemed in Mulhorand prior to the Orcgate Wars , but fell out of favor after the death of Re . He has been blamed for most of Mulhorand ' s military failures by the followers of Horus - Re , and the two churches remain rivals to this day . As the orc hordes surged forward , emboldened by the victory of Gruumsh over Re , Anhur devised a counter assault that eventually led to the end of the Orcgate Wars . During the Time of Troubles , Anhur secured the portfolio of the recently slain Untheric deity Ramman . He forced Hoar , who had slain Ramman , to leave Unther once again ; an act that Hoar actively seeks revenge for . He also distinguished himself by confronting the sahuagin deity Sekolah during this period of history . The church of Anhur suffered numerous political attacks originating from the clergy of Horus - Re during the Time of Troubles .

title: Animal companion
description: Animal companion Animal companions were the bonded creatures of ranger s and druid s . They helped in fighting , scouting , and friendship . They most commonly were wolves or badger s , but sometimes were boar s , bear s or even snake s , as was the case with the dwarven druid Pikel Bouldershoulder .
description_long: Animal companion Animal companions were the bonded creatures of ranger s and druid s . They helped in fighting , scouting , and friendship . They most commonly were wolves or badger s , but sometimes were boar s , bear s or even snake s , as was the case with the dwarven druid Pikel Bouldershoulder .

title: Animal friendship
description: Animal friendship Animal friendship was an enchantment spell that allowed a druid to befriend one or more natural animals and eventually train them to do tricks or perform tasks . If the creature would be harmed by any allies of the caster the spell would end . Components .
description_long: Animal friendship Animal friendship was an enchantment spell that allowed a druid to befriend one or more natural animals and eventually train them to do tricks or perform tasks . If the creature would be harmed by any allies of the caster the spell would end . Components . Verbal , somatic and a morsel of food .

title: Animal growth
description: Animal growth Animal growth was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to double the size of one or more animals . The reverse of this spell , shrink animal , caused animals to shrink to half their size . Effects .
description_long: Animal growth Animal growth was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to double the size of one or more animals . The reverse of this spell , shrink animal , caused animals to shrink to half their size . Effects . Casting this spell caused a number of animals to grow to twice their normal size . This doubled each animal ' s height , length , and width , increasing its weight by a factor of eight . This increase in size had a number of effects including making the creature more powerful but it also made the creature easier to attack . The creature ' s strength and hardiness were also increased . This spell did not affect Colossal sized creatures , although the reverse of this spell could . When the spell ended , the creature ' s size and power returned to normal , and any injuries suffered by the creature were reduced in severity by half . The spell gave the caster no special means of command or influence over the enlarged animals . Components . The older version of this spell required verbal , somatic and material components , including a bite of food . The newer version did not require any food .

title: Animal messenger
description: Animal messenger Animal messenger , also known as Messenger , was an enchantment spell that recruited a tiny - sized creature to carry a message , following simple directions . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components and a small morsel of food as a material component .
description_long: Animal messenger Animal messenger , also known as Messenger , was an enchantment spell that recruited a tiny - sized creature to carry a message , following simple directions . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components and a small morsel of food as a material component .

title: Animal shapes
description: Animal shapes Animal shapes is a transmutation spell that causes one ally per level to polymorph into a chosen animal . Effect . As " polymorph other " , except you polymorph up to one willing creature per level into an animal of your choice ; the spell has no effect on unwilling creature .
description_long: Animal shapes Animal shapes is a transmutation spell that causes one ally per level to polymorph into a chosen animal . Effect . As " polymorph other " , except you polymorph up to one willing creature per level into an animal of your choice ; the spell has no effect on unwilling creature . Recipients remain in the animal form until the spell expires or you dismiss the spell for all recipients . In addition , an individual subject may choose to resume her normal form ( as a full - round action ) ; doing so ends the spell for her and her alone . The allowed size of the animal form depends on your caster level : Creatures polymorphed by this spell don ' t suffer the disorientation penalty that those transformed by " polymorph other " often do .

title: Animal sphere
description: Animal sphere The Animal sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that allowed influence , summoning , communication , control , alteration , or friendship with animals and insects . Spells in normal text are listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Animal Sphere in the sourcebook .
description_long: Animal sphere The Animal sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that allowed influence , summoning , communication , control , alteration , or friendship with animals and insects . Spells in normal text are listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Animal Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Animal summoning II
description: Animal summoning II Animal summoning II was an improved version of " animal summoning I " , which operated in the same way but could summon up to twelve animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " or up to six animals approximately twice that size .
description_long: Animal summoning II Animal summoning II was an improved version of " animal summoning I " , which operated in the same way but could summon up to twelve animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " or up to six animals approximately twice that size .

title: Animal summoning III
description: Animal summoning III Animal summoning III was an improved version of " animal summoning II " . It operated in the same way as " animal summoning I " but could summon up to sixteen animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " , or up to eight animals of the larger size from " animal summoning II " , or up to four animals approximately twice the size of the larger ones from " animal summoning II " .
description_long: Animal summoning III Animal summoning III was an improved version of " animal summoning II " . It operated in the same way as " animal summoning I " but could summon up to sixteen animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " , or up to eight animals of the larger size from " animal summoning II " , or up to four animals approximately twice the size of the larger ones from " animal summoning II " .

title: Animal trance
description: Animal trance Animal trance is an enchantment spell that fascinates animals . Effect . Your swaying motions and music ( or singing , or chanting ) compel animal s , beast s , and magical beast s to do nothing but watch you .
description_long: Animal trance Animal trance is an enchantment spell that fascinates animals . Effect . Your swaying motions and music ( or singing , or chanting ) compel animal s , beast s , and magical beast s to do nothing but watch you . Only creatures with Intelligence scores of 1 or 2 can be affected by this spell . Roll 2d6 to determine the total number of HD that you entrance . The closest targets are selected first until no more targets are selected first until no more targets within range can be affected . For example , if Vadania affects 7 HD worth of animals and there are several 2 - HD wolves within close range , only the three closest wolves are affected . Animals trained to attack or guard , beasts , and magical beasts are allowed saving throws ; animals not trained to attack or guard are not . An entranced creature can be struck ( with a + 2 bonus to the attack roll , as if it were stunned ) , but it then recovers from the compulsion and is no longer affected by the spell .

title: Animate
description: Animate An animate was a creature artificially vested with life or intelligence . Animates were generally under the control of their creators and were devoid of most qualities typical of life , such as breathing , consumption , or sleep . Animates differed little by planar origin and none arose naturally under normal circumstances .
description_long: Animate An animate was a creature artificially vested with life or intelligence . Animates were generally under the control of their creators and were devoid of most qualities typical of life , such as breathing , consumption , or sleep . Animates differed little by planar origin and none arose naturally under normal circumstances . Oddly , not all creatures who were artificially infused with life were considered animates . For example , warforged , in spite of being the result of deliberate creation through magic , were considered humanoid s . This was because warforged were sentient , unlike animates , who might have been intelligent but lacked any consciousness .

title: Animate blood
description: Animate blood Animate blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created tiny beings from the caster ' s blood .
description_long: Animate blood Animate blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created tiny beings from the caster ' s blood . They were linked to the caster , allowing the caster to experience the world through their senses as well as his own . Upon casting the spell the caster gave themselves a small cut . The droplets of blood from the cut assumed the form of small animals under the command of the caster . The animals were small enough to fit under most doors but the moved extremely fast . They could also seep through any crack or tight opening that water could penetrate . This spell was useful for spying on others , or examining a locked room . Any spells cast upon the blood affected the caster as well . The blood animals could attack targets , causing blindness if they successfully struck the eyes . The blood burned like acid wherever it landed on a target . Regardless of the circumstances , using the blood to attack a target was considered an act of great evil . Components . This spell required the caster ' s blood to cast .

title: Animate dead
description: Animate dead Animate dead was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to raise one or more mostly intact skeletons or corpses as undead skeleton s or zombie s under his or her control . Effects . This spell was a staple of the necromantic arts and saw many incarnations as magic evolved over time .
description_long: Animate dead Animate dead was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to raise one or more mostly intact skeletons or corpses as undead skeleton s or zombie s under his or her control . Effects . This spell was a staple of the necromantic arts and saw many incarnations as magic evolved over time . The earliest version of this spell treated zombies and skeletons equally and a caster could animate one of either kind of undead per experience level , but only from human remains . The state of the remains determined if a skeleton ( almost no flesh ) or a zombie ( most flesh intact ) was created . Undead created by this version of the spell could be destroyed by " dispel magic " as well as being turned by a cleric or destroyed by physical damage , magical damage , fire , etc . A caster could stand in the middle of a graveyard and animate corpses within a 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) radius . The second version of " animate dead " expanded the types of remains that could be used and treated a skeleton as slightly less than a zombie . The size of the creatures in life determined ( by a relatively complex formula ) how many undead could be created .

title: Animate objects
description: Animate objects Animate objects ( also seen as animate object ) was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to temporarily bring to life one or more inanimate objects to attack a designated target . Effects . This spell could animate objects made of any non - magical material such as ceramic , fabric , glass , leather , metal , or wood .
description_long: Animate objects Animate objects ( also seen as animate object ) was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to temporarily bring to life one or more inanimate objects to attack a designated target . Effects . This spell could animate objects made of any non - magical material such as ceramic , fabric , glass , leather , metal , or wood . For the older transmutation version of this spell , the caster could animate the equivalent of one Small object for each level of experience . For the newer version , it was limited to a maximum of 10 Small objects . One Medium object was equivalent to two Small objects ; one Large object was equivalent to two Medium objects , and so on . For the alteration versions this spell , the caster could animate a volume of 1 ft ( 28 , 000 cm ) per experience level . The caster could also animate masses of raw matter , such as water , a stone from a wall , or a rock on the ground , as long as the volume of material did not exceed 1 ft ( 28 , 000 cm ) per experience level . The duration of " animate objects " was one minute per caster experience level , and the objects immediately attacked a target designated by the caster .

title: Animate rope
description: Animate rope Animate rope , originally known as Vilate ' s restriction and later bind , was an arcane alteration / enchantment or transmutation spell that could animate a rope - like object to move or loop , coil , or tie knots as directed by the caster . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Vilate ' s restriction " could be cast by arcanist s of the Variation specialization .
description_long: Animate rope Animate rope , originally known as Vilate ' s restriction and later bind , was an arcane alteration / enchantment or transmutation spell that could animate a rope - like object to move or loop , coil , or tie knots as directed by the caster . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Vilate ' s restriction " could be cast by arcanist s of the Variation specialization . " Bind " could be learned and cast by arcane magic - user s , namely wizard s of the enchantment school , and wu jen . " Animate rope " could be learned and cast by wizards with access to the transmutation school , and by sorcerer s and bard s , as well as wu jen . In Zakhara , elemental mage s and sorcerers could learn it as part of the universal province . " Animate rope " could be also be used by cleric s with access to the Craft domain — that is , those who worshiped Gond of the Faerûnian pantheon ; Geb or Thoth of the Mulhorandi pantheon ; Callarduran Smoothhands , Flandal Steelskin , or Garl Glittergold of the gnome pantheon ; or Dugmaren Brightmantle , Dumathoin , Laduguer , or Moradin of the dwarven pantheon . Effects .

title: Aniseed
description: Aniseed Aniseed was an effective items used by some rogue s to thwart a dog ' s sense of smell . Uses . When dropped on the ground behind them , a fleeing thief could usually successfully cover - up their scent with aniseed , effectively blocking dog ' s from picking up their trail for several minutes or several hours depending on the dog ' s training .
description_long: Aniseed Aniseed was an effective items used by some rogue s to thwart a dog ' s sense of smell . Uses . When dropped on the ground behind them , a fleeing thief could usually successfully cover - up their scent with aniseed , effectively blocking dog ' s from picking up their trail for several minutes or several hours depending on the dog ' s training . Prices . A vial of aniseed cost 1 gold .

title: Anithlynn
description: Anithlynn Anithlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Anithlynn was born with Briglynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .
description_long: Anithlynn Anithlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Anithlynn was born with Briglynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth . The triplets were taught from birth the mysteries of mystics . By their thirteenth birthday , Celya had died . Activities . Anithlynn managed with her sisters the Sisters Three Waxworks . She was the master of potions . Personality . Anithlynn was the most cunning of the triplets and the least predictable . She was selfish and ambitious , living strong passions and hatreds . She sometimes manipulated her sisters , but genuinely loved them .

title: Anival Dyrr
description: Anival Dyrr Anival Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan from 1373 DR . History . Anival was the first daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr in 1373 DR when , during the Silence of Lolth , House Agrach Dyrr entered into a secret alliance with the Jaezred Chaulssin and betrayed Menzoberranzan ' s Army of the Black Spider to the armies of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok .
description_long: Anival Dyrr Anival Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan from 1373 DR . History . Anival was the first daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr in 1373 DR when , during the Silence of Lolth , House Agrach Dyrr entered into a secret alliance with the Jaezred Chaulssin and betrayed Menzoberranzan ' s Army of the Black Spider to the armies of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok . After the house ' s betrayal was revealed , the house compound was besieged by House Xorlarrin and its allies . With the destruction of the house temple by Gromph Baenre , both Yasraena and the Lichdrow Dyrr , the true leader of the house , were definitively annihilated . Anival was the highest remaining member of her house . She was approached by Triel Baenre , who offered the survival of her house and her appointment as matron mother in exchange for becoming the vassal of House Baenre for centuries . With no other option , Anival accepted the offer .

title: Ankaram
description: Ankaram Duchy Ankaram , formerly Ankramir , was the territory of Tethyr bordering Calimshan in the south . Geography . Ankaram was located between the River Ith and the River Memnon .
description_long: Ankaram Duchy Ankaram , formerly Ankramir , was the territory of Tethyr bordering Calimshan in the south . Geography . Ankaram was located between the River Ith and the River Memnon . It was bordered by the Sea of Swords in the west and the Forest of Mir in the east . The region was sparsely populated but included several well - guarded forts along the border , so Calimshan was cautious about ever attacking it . The duchy contained two counties , Calimmon and Monteshi , the latter of which included Monrativi Teshy Mir , an area of contention between Calimshan and Tethyr . Ankaram was the location of two of the most dangerous adventuring sites of Tethyr , the ruined cities of Shoonach and Memnonnar . Government . In 1369 DR , Duchess Vajra Valmeyjar ruled Ankaram , officially from her castle of Maratimmir , 30 miles east of the city of Myratma . History . Ankaram was given to Tethyr as a gift in - 150 DR by Syl - Pasha Kamus el Tarshaj of Calimshan . Before the Tethyrian Interregnum , this duchy was known as " Ankramir " .

title: Ankhapur
description: Ankhapur Ankhapur was a city located in the Lake of Steam region on the southern edge of interior Faerûn . Trade . The city was primarily known for its pearl industry , which involved many of its citizens .
description_long: Ankhapur Ankhapur was a city located in the Lake of Steam region on the southern edge of interior Faerûn . Trade . The city was primarily known for its pearl industry , which involved many of its citizens . Legends . There were a number of tressym in the city . Curiously , on the day before Highsummer each year , every tressym in the city mysteriously disappeared and only returned three days later .

title: Ankheg
description: Ankheg The ankheg ( ÆNK - eg ) was a huge insectoid monster with many slender limbs and large antennae . It burrowed underground and hunted from below . Environment .
description_long: Ankheg The ankheg ( ÆNK - eg ) was a huge insectoid monster with many slender limbs and large antennae . It burrowed underground and hunted from below . Environment . Living in warm climates , the ankheg dwelt in partially collapsed burrows usually around 40 feet underground . The ankheg hunted in forests or grasslands where prey would wander into its traps . If an area became too barren , the ankheg moved on to other , more lucrative areas . Ankheg tunnels were sometimes filled with the remains of victims , eggs , or chitin . Their tunnels would sometimes be around 60 to 150 feet long and 5 feet high . Hollow tunnel ends were used for lair purposes , such as sleeping or hibernation . Combat . The ankheg was an ambush predator that waited around 5 – 10 feet underground for prey to wander into position . The attack was quick , as the prey was crushed and ground in its mandibles and assaulted with acidic digestive enzymes . If a foe proved too difficult , the ankheg could also squirt acid to take it down . If several ankhegs were attacking a group , the ankhegs would try to attack different targets .

title: Ankhwood
description: Ankhwood Ankhwood ( once part of the Winterwood ) was a forest whose insect , animal and plant populations become mutated . There were once wild magic and dead magic areas orbiting one another in the forest , but by 1374 DR this effect had subsided and the elves living in the area were investigating the cause of the mutations .
description_long: Ankhwood Ankhwood ( once part of the Winterwood ) was a forest whose insect , animal and plant populations become mutated . There were once wild magic and dead magic areas orbiting one another in the forest , but by 1374 DR this effect had subsided and the elves living in the area were investigating the cause of the mutations .

title: Anklet
description: Anklet Anklets were decorative jewelry worn around the ankles of women in Zakhara . Description . Anklets could be rather common or incredibly ornate .
description_long: Anklet Anklets were decorative jewelry worn around the ankles of women in Zakhara . Description . Anklets could be rather common or incredibly ornate . Precious metal and jewels were often used in their construction . The women of Zakhara used them as a sign of vanity . Bells were often attached so that a prestigious women could be heard before she was seen . Prices . The price of anklets varied depending on the metal used and the presence of inset stones . A common price range for common aklets was 5 - 15 gp while ornate anklets sold for 30 - 60 gp .

title: Ankramir
description: Ankramir The Principality of Ankramir was the southwestern of Tethyr . Geography . Ankramir included the of Kamlann , the Purple Marches , and Ankaram , and was the location of Tethyr ' s former capital and largest city , Zazesspur .
description_long: Ankramir The Principality of Ankramir was the southwestern of Tethyr . Geography . Ankramir included the of Kamlann , the Purple Marches , and Ankaram , and was the location of Tethyr ' s former capital and largest city , Zazesspur . The region was sparsely populated , relative to other areas of Tethyr . In cultural feel , it was akin to Calimshan , which bordered it to the south . Government . Formally , this principality was under the authority of Princess Cyriana Rhindaun in 1370 DR , who was the daughter of Queen Zaranda Star Rhindaun and her consort King Haedrak Rhindaun III . Since the princess was a young child at that time , the ruling of the principality was handled by Cyriana ' s regent , Vajra Valmeyjar , the Duchess of Ankaram .

title: Annaeus
description: Annaeus Annaeus was a dwarven priest in the Illefarn empire , and was responsible for the creation of the King of Shadows . History . When the Knight Captain of Crossroad Keep encountered his spirit in the Gem Mines in the ruins of Arvahn , Annaeus stated that he did not regret his creation , before helping the Captain to unlock one of the statues of the Ritual of Purification designed by Annaeus himself to weaken the King of Shadows .
description_long: Annaeus Annaeus was a dwarven priest in the Illefarn empire , and was responsible for the creation of the King of Shadows . History . When the Knight Captain of Crossroad Keep encountered his spirit in the Gem Mines in the ruins of Arvahn , Annaeus stated that he did not regret his creation , before helping the Captain to unlock one of the statues of the Ritual of Purification designed by Annaeus himself to weaken the King of Shadows .

title: Annah
description: Annah Annah of the Shadows is a tiefling female thief from the computer game . She is described as the daughter of the Collector Pharod , but not as a natural issue . Most likely , she was found as an orphan on the streets of Sigil , and raised by Pharod .
description_long: Annah Annah of the Shadows is a tiefling female thief from the computer game . She is described as the daughter of the Collector Pharod , but not as a natural issue . Most likely , she was found as an orphan on the streets of Sigil , and raised by Pharod . Appearance . Annah is decribed and pictured as a striking red - headed woman of average height . Her eyes and ears are somewhat pointed , a throwback to her tiefling heritage , and are somewhat covered with the short hairstyle she prefers . The most striking effect of her mixed blood is her tail that resembles a cat ' s . A series of linked plates that resemble dragon scales covers her right arm and leg , but whether this is armor or natural growth is never explained . Skills . At the time of recruiting into the party , Annah is a 5th level thief , and highly capable with the punch daggers she wields . Her most damaging strikes come from her ability to blend with the shadows and backstab her opponents . Gear . Annah prefers tight fitting leathers that don ' t restrict movement . The weather of Sigil is extremely temperate , allowing her to use this scant protection and not worry about the elements .

title: Annam All - Father
description: Annam All - Father Annam All - Father was a giant deity and creator of the giant race . Background . Annam came across the planet of Abeir - Toril at a time before the existence of dwarves , elves , and human s .
description_long: Annam All - Father Annam All - Father was a giant deity and creator of the giant race . Background . Annam came across the planet of Abeir - Toril at a time before the existence of dwarves , elves , and human s . He met and married Othea , who took the form of a mountain on the edge of the Cold Lands . They had children , who were not Annam ' s first ( he had previously had immortal children ) , but they were Annam ' s first terrestrial children . His favorite sons were Lanaxis , Masud , Nicias , Obadai , Ottar , Ruk , and Vilmos , who all went on to form one of the main giant species , and his two - headed son , Arno and Julian , went on to become ettin , meaning " runt " . He also believed that Dunmore was his son , but this was not the case : Dunmore ' s father was Ulutiu . Giant traditions held that Annam stopped the Thousand Year War , after having convinced the dragon god Garyx to settle the war with a game of " wah - ree " . So skilled were the two opponents that game ended in a stalemate , and the war came to an end . Annam discovered that his wife was having an affair with Ulutiu and killed Ulutiu as a result .

title: Anne Gray McCready
description: Anne Gray McCready Anne Gray McCready is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . McCready earned her B .
description_long: Anne Gray McCready Anne Gray McCready is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . McCready earned her B . A . in English in 1982 from the . Projects . McCready has worked on projects in the Dragonlance , Forgotten Realms , Greyhawk , and Ravenloft settings .

title: Annen
description: Annen Annen was a shukenja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Annen lived most of his life in the Konjo temple of Miyama until , in 1357 DR , his master said that to achieve enlightenment he needed to see the world .
description_long: Annen Annen was a shukenja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Annen lived most of his life in the Konjo temple of Miyama until , in 1357 DR , his master said that to achieve enlightenment he needed to see the world . So Annen , together with his friend the sohei Akirakeiko , went outside the temple . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Annen was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Annihilation
description: Annihilation Annihilation by Philip Athans is the fifth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The novel opens in Menzoberranzan , still besieged by the duergar army of Gracklstugh and tanarukk warriors of Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion .
description_long: Annihilation Annihilation by Philip Athans is the fifth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The novel opens in Menzoberranzan , still besieged by the duergar army of Gracklstugh and tanarukk warriors of Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion . Archmage Gromph Baenre seeks out new eyes ( literally ) as he prepares for his coming spell battle with the Lichdrow Lord Dyrr . Meanwhile , on the ship of chaos in the Lake of Shadows , everyone ' s nerves are on end . The leader of the group , Quenthel Baenre , sends Valas Hune and Danifae Yauntyrr to Eryndlyn to gather supplies for the coming journey while Pharaun Mizzrym continues to put the ship in working order . In Eryndlyn , Danifae tracks down Zinnirit Yauntyrr , the former house wizard of House Yauntyrr and convinces him to dispel her Binding with Halisstra Melarn before killing him and stealing his ring of teleportation . When she and Valas return to the ship of chaos , they find their group more ragged than before , having fought Raashub , the imprisoned uridezu captain , and his summoned hordes of rats and uridezu .

title: Annis
description: Annis An annis ( ÆN - nis ) was the most physically powerful of the hag s . Appearance . An annis was a giant crone with blackened skin , stringy , black hair , fingers that ended in long talons , and sharpened teeth that looked like iron nails .
description_long: Annis An annis ( ÆN - nis ) was the most physically powerful of the hag s . Appearance . An annis was a giant crone with blackened skin , stringy , black hair , fingers that ended in long talons , and sharpened teeth that looked like iron nails . They stood over eight feet tall and weighed 325 pounds . While an annis could assume a more attractive form , she could not change her size . Thus , they always assume the form of a gentle giantess or extremely tall woman . Lair . An annis made her lair in a dark cave , burrow , or ruin , where she stalked and fed upon the unwary . Of all the hags , an annis delighted in tearing her victims to shreds with her bare hands , all while relishing in the screams of pain and terror .

title: Annulus Conflagros
description: Annulus Conflagros Annulus Conflagros was the second " Qysari Ring " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It gave the wearer both protection from fire and access to arcane fire spells . There were other " shoonring s " made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) with similar properties , but only one imperial ring .
description_long: Annulus Conflagros Annulus Conflagros was the second " Qysari Ring " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It gave the wearer both protection from fire and access to arcane fire spells . There were other " shoonring s " made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) with similar properties , but only one imperial ring . Description . Like other " shoonrings " , this ring was made from woven strands of copper made to resemble a loop of leaping flames . What distinguished this ring from the flashy copies ( see below ) was its behavior when donned by an individual that was not a practitioner of the Art . When placed on the finger of a cleric , druid , or other priest , the direction of the dancing flames turned at right angles to the circumference of the ring . If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised pattern of flames became smooth to the touch . Wizard s saw no change in the design when placed on their finger . Powers . This ring made the wearer completely immune to normal fires . He or she could hold the burning end of a torch with a bare hand , walk through a bonfire , and be unaffected when drenched by burning oil .

title: Annulus Qysarus Major
description: Annulus Qysarus Major Annulus Qysarus Major was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It randomly reflected some or all of each spell cast directly at the wearer . When worn with the " Annulus Qysarus Minor " ring , it transformed incoming spells into healing for the wearer .
description_long: Annulus Qysarus Major Annulus Qysarus Major was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It randomly reflected some or all of each spell cast directly at the wearer . When worn with the " Annulus Qysarus Minor " ring , it transformed incoming spells into healing for the wearer . Description . Magic rings made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , were constructed of twisted bands of two different metals and were known as " shoonring s " . What easily distinguished the " Qysari Rings " from ordinary " shoonrings " was that they changed form depending on the nature of the person wearing them . When placed on the finger of a cleric , druid , or other priest , the direction of the metal weave turned at right angles to the circumference of the ring . If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised pattern became smooth to the touch but still visible . Wizard s saw no change in the design when it was placed on their finger . Powers . This ring was essentially a " ring of spell turning " that reflected some portion of an incoming spell back at the caster . The spell had to be targeted directly at the wearer of this ring , " i . e .

title: Annulus Qysarus Minor
description: Annulus Qysarus Minor Annulus Qysarus Minor was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It had the power to store a small number of spells and allow the wearer to cast them as desired . When worn with the " Annulus Qysarus Major " ring , it allowed the wearer to sacrifice some health to achieve greater effectiveness when casting a stored spell .

If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised pattern became smooth to the touch but still visible . Wizard s saw no change in the design when it was placed on their finger . Powers .

title: Annunaki
description: Annunaki Annunaki was the ruler of Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Annunaki was busy with survive from the rebel siege to the royal palace .
description_long: Annunaki Annunaki was the ruler of Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Annunaki was busy with survive from the rebel siege to the royal palace . Personality . Annunaki was one of the most brutal man in Unther . He was also scheming and ambitious with the secret goal to became the ruler of Unther instead of Gilgeam . Annunaki was too proud to accept a negotiate with the rebels or to surrender .

title: Annuv
description: Annuv An annuv was either a written symbol or a hand motion that was used among Calishite s to indicate that one ' s proper titles had been left unwritten or unsaid for the sake of brevity . Because the nobility of Calimshan often had a long list of titles before their names , it became a common practice for members of the same or higher class to dispense with naming the titles , instead offering proper respect by using the " annuv " . The " annuv " was correctly performed using only the left hand .
description_long: Annuv An annuv was either a written symbol or a hand motion that was used among Calishite s to indicate that one ' s proper titles had been left unwritten or unsaid for the sake of brevity . Because the nobility of Calimshan often had a long list of titles before their names , it became a common practice for members of the same or higher class to dispense with naming the titles , instead offering proper respect by using the " annuv " . The " annuv " was correctly performed using only the left hand . With all the fingertips together , the speaker would rotate his or her hand toward his heart . This would be performed once for every title that was being skipped . However , miscounting the number of " annuvs " required could result in dire consequences . For example , in 1370 DR , Calimshan was ruled by Ralan el Pesarkhal , whose proper , full title was " Syl - Pasha of All Pasha s , Syl - Sabbalad of Sabbalad s , Syl - Ralbahr of el Nallojal , Syl - Qayadin of the Armies , Syl - Ynamalik of the Lands of the Three Rivers , Syl - Sultan of the Cities , and Caleph of Our People , His Majesty , Ralan el Pesarkhal .

title: Anointed knight
description: Anointed knight Anointed knights were holy warriors who used alchemical secrets to become formidable combatants . Powers . Wielding an ancestral weapon , they searched for obscure lore , consulted historians and alchemists , and communed with the powers of good .
description_long: Anointed knight Anointed knights were holy warriors who used alchemical secrets to become formidable combatants . Powers . Wielding an ancestral weapon , they searched for obscure lore , consulted historians and alchemists , and communed with the powers of good . Their combat prowess was matched only by their thirst for knowledge . Anointed knights crafted and drew power from potions and oils . They could anoint themselves with these oils to unlock supernatural abilities within their being . They could also anoint their weapon bestowing additional properties . Background . Anointed knights were usually fighter s or paladin s who combined their power with an arcane spellcasting class , usually sorcerer or wizard . More rarely they were single - class wizards , sorcerers , cleric s , or bard s . Regardless of background , they often befriended more knowledgeable arcane spellcasters and allied themselves with good outsider s like angel s and eladrin . Ideals . Anointed knights believed in crusades against evil and enjoyed taking the fight to their opponents .

title: Anok - Imaskar
description: Anok - Imaskar Anok - Imaskar was one of the three successor states of Imaskar after the Empire ' s fall , the others being Deep Imaskar and Solon . Geography . At its height , Anok - Imaskar stretched from the Celestial Sea to the Segara Sea ( a large portion of what was later Shou Lung and T ' u Lung ) .
description_long: Anok - Imaskar Anok - Imaskar was one of the three successor states of Imaskar after the Empire ' s fall , the others being Deep Imaskar and Solon . Geography . At its height , Anok - Imaskar stretched from the Celestial Sea to the Segara Sea ( a large portion of what was later Shou Lung and T ' u Lung ) . It did not spread west , owing to claims by Solon on the lands south of the Raurinshield Mountains . History . The eastern provinces of Imaskar emerged relatively unscathed from the Empire ' s destruction . The mountainous Khati province and the flatter Katakoro province were both protected from the Mulan rebellion by distance and the natural defenses provided by the Katakoro Shan . Unlike Imaskar ' s vassals , Durpar and Gundavar , these provinces maintained some of Imaskar ' s magical might , including one of the " False Imaskarcana " , Dhonas ' s Shroud . Within a year of Imaskar ' s fall , the surviving artificer Kujawa founded a new realm when he claimed the throne of the former capital of Upper Imaskar in the Khati city of Thakos . Anok - Imaskar was prosperous and quickly spread east , north and south . They traded with their fellow successor state Solon to the west .

title: Anomen Delryn
description: Anomen Delryn Anomen Delryn was a human fighter and cleric , and a squire in the Most Noble Order of the Radiant Heart . Personality . Anomen ' s first impression was of someone insufferably vain who constantly bragged about battles he ' d most likely never fought .
description_long: Anomen Delryn Anomen Delryn was a human fighter and cleric , and a squire in the Most Noble Order of the Radiant Heart . Personality . Anomen ' s first impression was of someone insufferably vain who constantly bragged about battles he ' d most likely never fought . History . Anomen Delryn , a native of Athkatla , was the son of Lord Cor and Lady Moirala Delryn , and had a younger sister , Moira . His mother later died . In the 1360s DR , Anomen ' s ambition to become a paladin of Helm was denied when his father , wanting his son to join him in the family merchant business , refused to sponsor him for knighthood . He became estranged from his father . Instead , Anomen chose to train as a warrior - priest of Helm , and sought his knighthood through the sponsorship of the Church of Helm . In 1369 DR , he was a squire in the Most Noble of Order of the Radiant Heart , and would soon be facing his knighthood trial . He was in the Copper Coronet in the Slums District of Athkatla when he met and potentially joined Gorion ' s Ward and companions .

title: Ansel Burwyth
description: Ansel Burwyth Ansel Burwyth , also called the Master of Gems , was a skilled wizard who lived during the 4th century DR in Mulhorand . History . Ansel was hired in 326 DR , along with many other mages , by the ruling bodies of Tashalar to rid them of Magister Onsilur Maerdrathom who had become quite a nuisance to their way of life .
description_long: Ansel Burwyth Ansel Burwyth , also called the Master of Gems , was a skilled wizard who lived during the 4th century DR in Mulhorand . History . Ansel was hired in 326 DR , along with many other mages , by the ruling bodies of Tashalar to rid them of Magister Onsilur Maerdrathom who had become quite a nuisance to their way of life . Ansel succeeded where others who came before him failed . He was able to trap the soul of Onsilur within a " kiira " . Lured by the riches left for the taking in Onsilur ' s tower , Ansel hid the " kiira " and entered the tower only to be killed by the wide array of magical traps Onsilur had in place .

title: Ansi
description: Ansi Ansi , meaning West Protecting Fortress , was a small town located in the northern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands around 1359 DR . Description . The small town of Ansi was little more than a fortified inn built near an oasis of bitter water .
description_long: Ansi Ansi , meaning West Protecting Fortress , was a small town located in the northern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands around 1359 DR . Description . The small town of Ansi was little more than a fortified inn built near an oasis of bitter water . What little importance the town had came from the fact that it sat at the top of a narrow pass in the hills of the Quoya Desert , and only its close proximity to Shou Lung kept it from being totally unknown . The town itself was mostly rundown buildings , surrounded by a wall of brick . The wells produced enough water for a few small melon farms , but farming in the area was difficult because of the constant winds blowing dust , which often accumulated along the walls , sometimes even spilling over . The town offered few services , including a , wool and hide dealers , a few melon farmers , and a pair of merchants who bought and sold goods with the nomads who came and went through the year . It also had a small temple to the Shou gods , serviced by a single priest . Inhabitants . No more than 100 people lived in this small settlement . Most , if not all , of them had Shou ancestry .

title: Ansilber Klauthaudra
description: Ansilber Klauthaudra Ansilber Klauthaudra was once the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar until his untimely and premeditated death just after winter had arrived in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR . Description . Ansilber was a corpulent man with droopy features that made it look like he was half asleep most of the time .
description_long: Ansilber Klauthaudra Ansilber Klauthaudra was once the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar until his untimely and premeditated death just after winter had arrived in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR . Description . Ansilber was a corpulent man with droopy features that made it look like he was half asleep most of the time . Personality . He was a lazy man who enjoyed ordering others about . He had a cruel nature but did not seem to take pleasure in it . Rather , he wanted others to suffer instead of himself . History . Ansilber was a tailor in Essembra before he moved to Voonlar and purchased the Wizard , perhaps from the famed mage Casimur . During his tenure at the Wizard , he was the boss of a magically tethered Dove Silverhand , who was disguised and played the role of serving wench . She was released by her soon - to - be husband , Florin Falconhand before the winter of 1356 set in . Within a month or two of her rescue , Ansilber was gruesomely murdered in his own common room ; dismembered . Few mourned his passing and the hasty investigation by the local authorities turned up no suspects .

title: Ansong
description: Ansong Ansong was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Ansong lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .
description_long: Ansong Ansong was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Ansong lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo . Activities . The shipwrights of Ansong built the very best ships in the land . Some were created with magic that enabled them to float more easily and to sail more swiftly , such that seemed to fly over and above the waves when at full sail . They also built barges that never rocked in heavy seas . Thus , foreigners from Wa and as far as Shou Lung came to Ansong to purchase ships . Inhabitants . The fishermen of Ansong , along with those of In ' ani , were claimed to be the best in the world , having done such things as eliminate the prides of sea lion s in the Straits of Koryo and catch the enormous eel Ghartii Nung . History . Around 1357 DR , a massive sea monster assaulted Ansong ' s harbor , sinking many vessels and eating all the fishermen . Those who saw it and survived claimed it had a seal - like body with a lizard ' s head , and that it used its long and stick tongue to catch victims like a lasso . Authorities promised a great reward to any who slew the beast and turned in its head .

title: Ansrivarr
description: Ansrivarr Ansrivarr was a large heavy - hafted greatsword , one of the six Cormyrean Swords of State , that originally belonged to Mondar Bleth . Its name is the elvish word for " memory " . After Mondar ' s death , the sword was taken by Faerlthann Obarskyr .
description_long: Ansrivarr Ansrivarr was a large heavy - hafted greatsword , one of the six Cormyrean Swords of State , that originally belonged to Mondar Bleth . Its name is the elvish word for " memory " . After Mondar ' s death , the sword was taken by Faerlthann Obarskyr . It was used actively by Faerlthann and his sons , but beyond this it became a ceremonial sword , used only during coronations . Baerauble Etharr and Alea Dahast wove magical enchantments into the sword that made it very nearly invulnerable .

title: Anstruth harp
description: Anstruth harp An Anstruth harp was a masterwork magical harp and an Instrument of the Bards . Description . An " Anstruth harp " was slender and graceful of design , small and light enough to be played in one ' s lap .
description_long: Anstruth harp An Anstruth harp was a masterwork magical harp and an Instrument of the Bards . Description . An " Anstruth harp " was slender and graceful of design , small and light enough to be played in one ' s lap . It was carved of teak wood engraved with designs of waves and fog , with silver wire for strings . Powers . " Anstruth harps " were superior in every way to ordinary harps . Like other Instruments of the Bards , they could only be used properly by bards , and could be dangerous if anyone else — even lesser bards with insufficient skill — attempted to play or even carry them . Bards wielding an " Anstruth harp " had their charming abilities greatly amplified by their magic . Like all Instruments of the Bards , these harps had the capability of storing spells . A bard playing an " Anstruth harp " could invoke the spells " fly " , " invisibility " , " levitate " , " protection from evil and good " , " control weather " , " cure wounds " , and " wall of thorns " each once a day , until the instrument recharged its magic at the next dawn .

title: Antatlab of the Shaking Stones
description: Antatlab of the Shaking Stones Antatlab of the Shaking Stones was the head of the College of Elemental Magic , the College that gathered all wizards with the most exotic specializations , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Rumors said Antatlab was a secret worshiper of Vhaeraun .
description_long: Antatlab of the Shaking Stones Antatlab of the Shaking Stones was the head of the College of Elemental Magic , the College that gathered all wizards with the most exotic specializations , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Rumors said Antatlab was a secret worshiper of Vhaeraun . In 1379 DR , Antatlab was totally against the proposal by Master Guldor Zauviir to elevate T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic , as a new member of the Conclave . This was because Antatlab thought the bardic traditions were not true magic .

title: Antethriss
description: Antethriss Antethriss was a female Netherese shadovar and an assassin and duchess in 1480 DR . History . Antethriss was once a personal assassin of the Prince of Shade Clariburnus Tanthul .
description_long: Antethriss Antethriss was a female Netherese shadovar and an assassin and duchess in 1480 DR . History . Antethriss was once a personal assassin of the Prince of Shade Clariburnus Tanthul . Later she was elevated to the position duchess and given command of the small Netherese enclave of Kolthunral . In 1480 DR , Clariburnus , in an attempt to gain control of New Neverwinter from Thay , ordered Antethriss to attack the Thayan city of Surcross . However , after months of besieging Thay , Kolthunral crashed into the ground , thanks to the efforts of some adventurers . Antethriss likely died in the fall .

title: Anth - Malar
description: Anth - Malar Anth - Malar was the Chosen of Malar and leader of the Furious Hunt lycanthrope cult . Appearance . Though a pure - blooded human , anth - Malar had the aspect of a furry humanoid beast with hooked claws .
description_long: Anth - Malar Anth - Malar was the Chosen of Malar and leader of the Furious Hunt lycanthrope cult . Appearance . Though a pure - blooded human , anth - Malar had the aspect of a furry humanoid beast with hooked claws . Biography . Little was known about anth - Malar before he became Malar ' s Chosen except that he was considered his god ' s most devout worshiper and laired in the Twisted Run northeast of Silverymoon . Malar bestowed upon anth - Malar his Chosen status in response to the formation of Luruar — seen by the god as civilization encroaching too far upon his beloved wilderness . Through the actions of a subordinate , Kazok , anth - Malar discovered that blacktooth fungus could be used to intensify the effects of lycanthropy . He planned on using an army of so - called blacktooth lycanthropes to eradicate the settlements of Luruar . Personality . Anth - Malar was devoted to his god , leading many more High Hunt s within the Twisted Run than was usual per year . He was sadistic , preferring to impale living victims on the points of stalactites above him . Possessions .

title: Anthan Narlgold
description: Anthan Narlgold Anthan Narlgold was a half - dwarven warrior of Clan Narlgold . Personality . Anthan was a heroic and fearless warrior .
description_long: Anthan Narlgold Anthan Narlgold was a half - dwarven warrior of Clan Narlgold . Personality . Anthan was a heroic and fearless warrior . Relationships . Anthan Nargold was the son of Clan Chief Jhaz Narlgold and the heir of Clan Narlgold . History . In Hammer of 714 DR , Anthan took part in the Darkwoods Conflict and was present at the Lost Trench . Towards the close of the battle , Anthan killed the enemy commander ; a nycaloth named Gaulguth . Anthan impaled Gaulguth with a 7 - foot - long spike of mithral . As Gaulguth died , he swung his great axe Heartcleaver and split Anthan in two , killing him instantly .

title: Anthara Shalymarr
description: Anthara Shalymarr Anthara " Softangles " Shalymarr was a Mulhorand i woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a former thief and later a tavern keeper and proprietress of the Scarlet Sheath tavern . Description & Personality .
description_long: Anthara Shalymarr Anthara " Softangles " Shalymarr was a Mulhorand i woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a former thief and later a tavern keeper and proprietress of the Scarlet Sheath tavern . Description & Personality . Anthara was tall and sinuous of build , with dark eyes . She was also hot - tempered , and often hurled a dagger into too - lusty patrons . She operated it under three firmly held principles : that a tavern should provide comfortable furniture and swift service ; that tapestries could conceal holes or burn marks in the walls ; and that it should be separate from daily matters , where people could talk freely . Anthara had an agreement with Lord Sarp Redbeard , ruler of Wheloon , that no one could be held accountable for things said in the Scarlet Sheath . History . Anthara was once a thief in Mulhorand , but retired and later came to Wheloon in Cormyr . There , she took over an abandoned , ruined building , turning it into the Scarlet Sheath tavern by 1358 DR . She still ran it by 1369 DR .

title: Anthilar
description: Anthilar Anthilar was a lich of Tashalar . History . Antilar was one of the main leaders of Untisczer in Lapaliiya in 285 DR but managed to survive his city ' s destruction at the hands of the Shoon Imperium by relocating to a secret lair in the mountains west of the Tashan Gap .
description_long: Anthilar Anthilar was a lich of Tashalar . History .
