Antilar was one of the main leaders of Untisczer in Lapaliiya in 285 DR but managed to survive his city ' s destruction at the hands of the Shoon Imperium by relocating to a secret lair in the mountains west of the Tashan Gap . There he became a lich with the goal of controlling the merchants of Tashluta . In 1056 DR , Antilar resurfaced and unveiled the reigning oligarch as a yuan - ti abomination . This started a spell - battle between the two that ended with the yuan - ti dead and the lich severely incapacitated . Profiting of this weakness , Anthilar ' s body was encased inside a massively armored metal " lich ' s coffin " and shipped north by the priests of the Skullspire in Tulmon to the Myrkulyte Conclave of Doom for study . However , during the journey , the coffin was stolen many times . At last , it became part of the hoard of Tostyn Alaerthmaugh , a young adult male mercury dragon lairing in the depths of Everlake , in the heart of the Evermoors .

title: Anthraxus
description: Anthraxus Master of Khin - Oin and nominal ruler of the Blood Rift , Anthraxus the Decayed ( æn - THRAK - sus ) commands considerable power and authority . To the demon s of the rift and the Wasting Tower , he is the Lord of Misery and Despair , worshiped in fear and revered as a god . Anthraxus appears as a gaunt , ghoulish creature draped in moldering gray robes .
description_long: Anthraxus Master of Khin - Oin and nominal ruler of the Blood Rift , Anthraxus the Decayed ( æn - THRAK - sus ) commands considerable power and authority . To the demon s of the rift and the Wasting Tower , he is the Lord of Misery and Despair , worshiped in fear and revered as a god . Anthraxus appears as a gaunt , ghoulish creature draped in moldering gray robes . His skin is covered with ulcers and oozing pustules , and his eyes glow red from deep in their sockets . Lore . Anthraxus was not the first master of Khin - Oin , and he has held control of the Wasting Tower more than once . Though he reclaimed the great throne known as the Siege Malicious only a century ago as of approximately 1479 DR , Anthraxus has ruled Khin - Oin for nearly three millennia all together , far longer than any of his predecessors . Anthraxus was once an unenhanced ultroloth , but a coven of night hag s transformed him into an altraloth , tasking him with destroying a crusade of paladins . Once he had fulfilled his contract with the hags , in approximately - 1522 DR , Anthraxus violently wrested the Wasting Tower from his predecessor to become the reigning Oinoloth of the yugoloth race .

title: Anthrus Strongarms
description: Anthrus Strongarms King Anthrus Strongarms was the ruler of the dwarves of Ironfang Keep in Turmish , and had been so for over half a century by 1370 DR . A veteran of the Campaign of Darkness , King Strongarms was as a result very untrusting of the duergar , even more so than he was of human s .
description_long: Anthrus Strongarms King Anthrus Strongarms was the ruler of the dwarves of Ironfang Keep in Turmish , and had been so for over half a century by 1370 DR . A veteran of the Campaign of Darkness , King Strongarms was as a result very untrusting of the duergar , even more so than he was of human s .

title: Antilife shell
description: Antilife shell Antilife shell , also known as anti - animal shell , was an abjuration spell that produced a hemispherical barrier that was impermeable to most types of living creatures . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster and lasted almost two hours at a minimum ( longer for higher level casters ) .
description_long: Antilife shell Antilife shell , also known as anti - animal shell , was an abjuration spell that produced a hemispherical barrier that was impermeable to most types of living creatures . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster and lasted almost two hours at a minimum ( longer for higher level casters ) . For the older version called " anti - animal shell " , the force field prevented entry of creatures that were at least partially animal . This included all humanoids , beast s , magical beast s , giant s , vermin , and hybrids like cambion s . The newer version added more lifeforms such as aberration s , dragon s , fey , monstrous humanoid s , ooze s , plant s , and shapechanger s to this list . Creatures that were unaffected by this spell included aerial servant s , imp s , quasit s , construct s ( like golem s ) , elemental s , outsider s , or undead . ( See the " Monster Manual " for an explanation of creature types . ) Like most abjuration spells , this one could not be used offensively to push a warded creature . Any such attempt resulted in the collapsing of the force field .

title: Antimagic field
description: Antimagic field Antimagic field , also known as anti - magic shell , was an abjuration spell that nullified all magic within a sphere . Effect . The caster created a 10 - foot - wide ( 3 meters ) sphere around them that removed all magical forces inside .
description_long: Antimagic field Antimagic field , also known as anti - magic shell , was an abjuration spell that nullified all magic within a sphere . Effect . The caster created a 10 - foot - wide ( 3 meters ) sphere around them that removed all magical forces inside . The sphere made all magics within non - existent . As it followed , the caster all spells would cease and magic weapons became mundane . The sphere could not be dispelled or cancelled by another " antimagic field " and if a magic item left the field it would regain its magical properties . Any summoned creatures would disappear in the field but when the field left the space where the creature was it would reappear .

title: Antimineral shell
description: Antimineral shell Antimineral shell was an abjuration spell that created a barrier of force that prevented all manner of elemental creatures and animated elements from entering the zone of effect . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster .
description_long: Antimineral shell Antimineral shell was an abjuration spell that created a barrier of force that prevented all manner of elemental creatures and animated elements from entering the zone of effect . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster . The effect lasted over two hours at a minimum ( longer for higher level casters ) . The invisible force field generated by this spell was impervious to animated stone and metals ( such as armor or weapons ) , stone - based lifeforms such as galeb duhr , xorn , and xaren , golem s and similar construct s , and creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth . As an added bonus , it also prevented entrance of other creatures of elemental origin such as aerial servant s , djinn , mephit s , and salamander s for example . " Antimineral shell " did not prevent entry of normal , non - animated stone or metal such as a thrown boulder or a rockslide . If the caster attempted to push the shell up against a warded creature in order to get it to move , the spell was soon broken . Components .

title: Antipathy
description: Antipathy Antipathy is an enchantment spell repels certain creatures from an object or location . Effect . You cause an object or location to emanate magical vibrations that repel either a specific type of intelligent creature or creatures of a particular alignment , as defined by you .
description_long: Antipathy Antipathy is an enchantment spell repels certain creatures from an object or location . Effect . You cause an object or location to emanate magical vibrations that repel either a specific type of intelligent creature or creatures of a particular alignment , as defined by you . The particular type of creature to be affected must be named specifically ( e . g . red dragon s , hill giant s , wererat s , lammasu , cloaker s , or vampire s . Larger groups , such as " goblinoid s , " are not specific enough . Likewise , the specific alignment must be named , for example , chaotic evil , chaotic good , lawful neutral , or true neutral . Creatures of the designated type or alignment feel an overpowering urge to leave the area or to avoid the affected item . A compulsion forces them to abandon the area or item , shunning it and never willingly returning to it while the spell is in effect . A creature who makes a successful saving throw can stay in the area or touch the item , but feels very uncomfortable doing so . This distracting discomfort reduces the creature ' s Dexterity score by 4 points . " Antipathy " counters and dispels " sympathy " .

title: Antiplant shell
description: Antiplant shell Antiplant shell was an abjuration spell that protected the caster and all creatures within a short distance from animated plants and plant creatures . Effects . This spell created an invisible barrier at a radius from the caster than moved as the caster moved .
description_long: Antiplant shell Antiplant shell was an abjuration spell that protected the caster and all creatures within a short distance from animated plants and plant creatures . Effects . This spell created an invisible barrier at a radius from the caster than moved as the caster moved . All creatures within the " shell " were protected from melee or missile attack by plant - based lifeforms and magically animated plants . The size of the " shell " varied from generation to generation with the earliest druids casting a 15 to 16 ft ( 4 . 6 to 4 . 9 m ) diameter barrier , whereas later druids improved the spell to a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) diameter . Any attempt to force the shell up against an abjured creature caused the " shell " to collapse . The protection lasted for 10 minutes per experience level of the caster . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . Early druids often used mistletoe for all spell casting .

title: Antivermin barrier
description: Antivermin barrier Antivermin barrier was an abjuration spell that warded a large area against small , non - magical creatures . Effects . This spell created a protected area and prevented entry by all manner of small vermin , i .
description_long: Antivermin barrier Antivermin barrier was an abjuration spell that warded a large area against small , non - magical creatures . Effects . This spell created a protected area and prevented entry by all manner of small vermin , i . e . , insects and spiders , snakes , rodents , worms , etc . The spell also worked on giant varieties of these pests , but only the very weakest ones . Creatures inside the area when the spell was cast were oblivious , but would be prevented from entering the area if they left and tried to come back . The spell lasted at least an hour and more experienced priests received more hours . There was some confusion about how big an area could be warded by this spell ( see Notes ) . Components . In addition to the verbal and somatic components , " antivermin barrier " required the caster ' s holy symbol and the whisker of a rodent to cast .

title: Anton Marivaldi
description: Anton Marivaldi Anton Marivaldi was a male pirate from Turmish in the Sea of Fallen Stars during the Second Sundering . History . Anton originated from Sapra in Turmish but after some crime he went into exile and became a pirate captain .
description_long: Anton Marivaldi Anton Marivaldi was a male pirate from Turmish in the Sea of Fallen Stars during the Second Sundering . History . Anton originated from Sapra in Turmish but after some crime he went into exile and became a pirate captain . Wanting the reward of a bounty , Anton tried to capture the young Chosen of Lathander Stedd Whitehorn but in the end he chose to help him in his mission . Behind the Scenes . Anton shared name and surname with a ( probable ) ancestor , a follower of the Red Knight that fought the Cult of the Dragon and raging marine dragons in 1373 . Richard Lee Byers admitted that he forgot he ' d used the name before .

title: Antrysn Barriath
description: Antrysn Barriath Antrysn Barriath was a " zekyl " ( " half - shadow - dragon drow " ) and the Anointed Blade of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Personality . Antrysn had a nasty temper and a penchant for sadism .
description_long: Antrysn Barriath Antrysn Barriath was a " zekyl " ( " half - shadow - dragon drow " ) and the Anointed Blade of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Personality . Antrysn had a nasty temper and a penchant for sadism . He liked red , unadorned cloths and was bald . A special physical feature was his scarred skin . He habitually scarred his own skin for his magic . History . Antrysn was the favorite son of patron father Xorthaul Barriath of Jhachalkhyn , and for a long time the Anointed Blade , the principal assassin , of the group . He was killed just before the Silence of Lolth by his main rival Nimor Imphraezl , who replaced him as Anointed Blade . However , secretly , Xorthaul resurrected Antrysn , so when the Silence of Lolth ended with Nimor defeated and demoted , Antrysn reappeared and assumed once again the position of Anointed Blade . In the Post - Spellplague era , Antrysn still held the position of the Anointed Blade . His relationship with Nimor deteriorated even further over the years . By 1480 DR , it was thought , that the next violent showdown between the two assassins was about to happen . Abilities .

title: Anusha Marhana
description: Anusha Marhana Anusha Marhana was the spoiled daughter of the Marhana merchant family . History . In 1396 DR , she was lost within the dreams of the Eldest in her dream form , where she met Yeva .
description_long: Anusha Marhana Anusha Marhana was the spoiled daughter of the Marhana merchant family . History . In 1396 DR , she was lost within the dreams of the Eldest in her dream form , where she met Yeva . Family . Her mother and father were both killed in Sembia . She was the younger half - sister of Behroun Marhana .

title: Anwae Mavin
description: Anwae Mavin Anwae Mavin was a half – song dragon half – moon elf monk sorcerer , and the leader of the Sisterhood of Essembra in 1374 DR . Background . She was the granddaughter of the song dragon Essembramaerytha .
description_long: Anwae Mavin Anwae Mavin was a half – song dragon half – moon elf monk sorcerer , and the leader of the Sisterhood of Essembra in 1374 DR . Background . She was the granddaughter of the song dragon Essembramaerytha . Anwae was interested in aiding metallic dragon s , dragonborn of Bahamut , and other humanoids after the last Rage of Dragons , in 1373 DR . Although she knew that her support of the followers of Bahamut would draw the ire of the followers of Tiamat , she continued helping them nonetheless .

title: Anwar Tulam
description: Anwar Tulam Anwar Tulam was an elven corsair and captain of the pirate vessel the " Reaver " in 1367 DR . His banner was a flying pair of crossed cutlass es . Personality .
description_long: Anwar Tulam Anwar Tulam was an elven corsair and captain of the pirate vessel the " Reaver " in 1367 DR . His banner was a flying pair of crossed cutlass es . Personality . Easily the most - feared pirate haunting Suq Bay and even the Golden Gulf , Anwar ' s bloodthirsty nature struck terror into the hearts of anyone sailing on the bay . Activities . Anwar and his crew attacked anyone they came into contact with on the open water . Fire was his preferred method of attack . He enjoyed using his liquid star projector on ships from the Admiralty of Huzuz . As of 1367 DR , Anwar had a 5 , 000 dinar price tag attached to his head . Rumors and Legends . After a brutal attack on the admirality , Anwar ' s ship was left short of men and was believed to be heading for the Pearl Cities to recruit new crewmembers .

title: Anwar al - Makruh
description: Anwar al - Makruh Anwar al - Makruh was a sha ' ir who lived in Medina al - Afyal on the island of Afyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar ran an impressive spy network within Afyal and beyond .
description_long: Anwar al - Makruh Anwar al - Makruh was a sha ' ir who lived in Medina al - Afyal on the island of Afyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar ran an impressive spy network within Afyal and beyond . His brilliant use of djinn spies ensured that his information was quick and accurate . It was rumored that any word uttered would be carried on the wind straight to Anwar ' s ears .

title: Anwar al - Sifr
description: Anwar al - Sifr Anwar al - Sifr was the Cipher of Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar al - Sifr was secretly a holy slayer who protected their interests in Liham , sometimes through the use of well - planned attacks where he would plant messages before making his escape .
description_long: Anwar al - Sifr Anwar al - Sifr was the Cipher of Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar al - Sifr was secretly a holy slayer who protected their interests in Liham , sometimes through the use of well - planned attacks where he would plant messages before making his escape . Possessions . Anwar owned a Potion of flying .

title: Anyo
description: Anyo Anyo was a very old chiang lung in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Anyo was the ultimate loremaster of the Fochu Peninsula : all seekers of knowledge tried to find her lair to gain the rarest information .
description_long: Anyo Anyo was a very old chiang lung in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Anyo was the ultimate loremaster of the Fochu Peninsula : all seekers of knowledge tried to find her lair to gain the rarest information . Anyo usually granted information to all people who agreed to indulge her whims . She had a fondness for scholarly discussion . Lair . Anyo lived in a palace under an underground cave lake , which was located in another plane of existence . The gate was at the bottom of the lake .

title: Anyspell
description: Anyspell Anyspell was a transmutation spell that allowed a spell domain cleric to cast an arcane spell of up to . Effect . Anyspell allowed the caster to read and prepare any arcane spell of up to 2nd level .
description_long: Anyspell Anyspell was a transmutation spell that allowed a spell domain cleric to cast an arcane spell of up to . Effect . Anyspell allowed the caster to read and prepare any arcane spell of up to 2nd level . The cleric must have had arcane magical writing ( a scroll or spellbook ) on hand to cast Anyspell . During the spell ' s 15 - minute casting time , the caster could scan the spells available and choose one to read and prepare . Once the cleric chose and prepared an arcane spell , he retained it in his mind . The prepared spell took the place of a 3rd - level divine magic domain spell . If the cleric read the spell from a spellbook , the book was unharmed , but reading a spell from a scroll erased the spell from the scroll . When the cleric cast the arcane spell , it worked just as though cast by a wizard of the same power as the cleric except that his wisdom determined the likelihood of an affected creature resisting the spell . The cleric had to have at least average wisdom to cast lower power arcane spells and more powerful spells could only be cast by wiser clerics .

title: Ao
description: Ao Lord Ao ( " AY " - oh ) was the Overgod of the worlds of Abeir - Toril . As Overgod , all deities and primordial s of Toril , even those who also operated in other spheres and planes such as Lolth , were subject to him . To be more precise , only aspects of gods directly connected with Abeir - Toril were under Ao ' s power .
description_long: Ao Lord Ao ( " AY " - oh ) was the Overgod of the worlds of Abeir - Toril . As Overgod , all deities and primordial s of Toril , even those who also operated in other spheres and planes such as Lolth , were subject to him . To be more precise , only aspects of gods directly connected with Abeir - Toril were under Ao ' s power . Otherwise extra - planar deities were unaffected . If it were not for Ao ' s involvement in the Time of Troubles , he would most likely be forgotten by the mortals of Faerûn . Ao did not want to be known , for cults once dedicated to him only a decade ago began to die out , and Ao ' s name disappeared from written records . What went on in Toril and what the other deities did were of no concern to Ao , as long as the deities upheld their individual portfolios and did not completely ignore their worshipers . In addition , unlike the other gods under him , Lord Ao had no need for worshipers whatsoever , whereas those " normal " gods who did not receive the worship of mortals could " die " from lack of worship . Ao initiated this after the Time of Troubles in order to enforce his will that the gods act as guardians of the Balance rather than kings of mortals .

title: Aosinin Truesilver
description: Aosinin Truesilver Aosinin Truesilver was a member of the Truesilver noble house of Cormyr and the cousin of King Galaghard III . Background . Aosinin fought in the Battle with the Witch Lords in 900 DR alongside King Galaghard III and Thanderahast .
description_long: Aosinin Truesilver Aosinin Truesilver was a member of the Truesilver noble house of Cormyr and the cousin of King Galaghard III . Background . Aosinin fought in the Battle with the Witch Lords in 900 DR alongside King Galaghard III and Thanderahast . He survived the battle . Possessions . In battle , Aosinin wore full plate mail armor with an open helm and rode a brown gelding .

title: Aoth Fezim
description: Aoth Fezim Aoth Fezim is a warmage and leader of the Brotherhood of the Griffon . He was formerly captain of the Griffon Legion of Pyarados . Aoth is spell - touched and hasn ' t aged since the Spellplague .
description_long: Aoth Fezim Aoth Fezim is a warmage and leader of the Brotherhood of the Griffon . He was formerly captain of the Griffon Legion of Pyarados . Aoth is spell - touched and hasn ' t aged since the Spellplague . Appearance . Aoth is of Mulan descent though he doesn ' t look like it with his blunt features and short , stocky frame . His body and hands show the intricate tattooing of a wizard . He wears badges revealing him as a rider of the elite Griffon Legion . Since he was affected by the Spellplague , Aoth Fezim ' s eyes show hints of the blue flame retained inside . In an attempt to restore his eyesight , Aoth had sigils of healing and clearvision tattooed above his eyes . He starts to wear a dark bandage covering his eyes though it is no hindrance to his flame - altered sight . Weapons and Magical Abilities . His primary weapon is his long spear that serves as warrior ' s lance and wizard ' s staff . He often carries a sword such as a falchion as a secondary weapon . Aoth can summon a flare of silvery light from the head of his spear or a wall of violet flame . The tattoos on his body grant him different kinds of enchantment , such as : He has spells to sober himself on will .

title: Aphras Tirin
description: Aphras Tirin Aphras Tirin was a drow merchant in Mantol - Derith . Relationship . the drow tried to approach Zarell Tahaladar numerous times in order to buy her spellbooks , but she would not collaborate .
description_long: Aphras Tirin Aphras Tirin was a drow merchant in Mantol - Derith . Relationship . the drow tried to approach Zarell Tahaladar numerous times in order to buy her spellbooks , but she would not collaborate . History . Around 1479 DR , Aphras sold spell components and alchemical items .

title: Aphrunn Mountains
description: Aphrunn Mountains The Aphrunn Mountains were a mountain range forming the southern border of the republic of Turmish in the Vilhon Reach . The range was famous for Mount Kolimnis , a volcano that destroyed the city of Gildenglade in 1423 DR . The gold dragon Frizzerfraz made his home in these mountains .
description_long: Aphrunn Mountains The Aphrunn Mountains were a mountain range forming the southern border of the republic of Turmish in the Vilhon Reach . The range was famous for Mount Kolimnis , a volcano that destroyed the city of Gildenglade in 1423 DR . The gold dragon Frizzerfraz made his home in these mountains .

title: Apostle of peace
description: Apostle of peace Apostles of peace are an unusual breed , forswearing violence and material possessions in favor of using their life to promote peace and nonviolent resolutions to conflict . An apostle possesses powerful access to divine magic , but his spells are aimed at healing , calming hostilities , and aiding allies . Background .
description_long: Apostle of peace Apostles of peace are an unusual breed , forswearing violence and material possessions in favor of using their life to promote peace and nonviolent resolutions to conflict . An apostle possesses powerful access to divine magic , but his spells are aimed at healing , calming hostilities , and aiding allies . Background . Though apostles of peace come from all walks of life , former barbarian s , fighters , and rogue s are rare : they have understandable difficulty with the vows of nonviolence and peace required for the class , and several of the required skills are cross - class for them . Paladin s are even rarer : their very being requires them to go out and fight evil . Cleric s , bard s , and druid s sometimes gravitate towards this class , but any character could conceivably convert to pacifism and become apostles of peace . Apostles of peace are usually solitary wanderers or even hermits . Many apostles are far removed from the violent struggles of the adventuring life , but may serve as resources of knowledge , spells , or spiritual guidance for adventurers . In the Realms , apostles of peace typically worship Eldath or Ilmater .

title: Applebane
description: Applebane A small steel dagger with a shadowtop handle , Applebane was once owned by the halfling thief Peliwen Redgrass . Peliwen was a kind but morose individual who spent most of his time sitting in a large rocking chair that he took with him on adventures . Before important adventures , he would just sit in his rocking chair and eat apples with the aid of his dagger Peliwen ' s blade was so rarely used for combat that his comrades starting calling it " Applebane " .
description_long: Applebane A small steel dagger with a shadowtop handle , Applebane was once owned by the halfling thief Peliwen Redgrass . Peliwen was a kind but morose individual who spent most of his time sitting in a large rocking chair that he took with him on adventures . Before important adventures , he would just sit in his rocking chair and eat apples with the aid of his dagger Peliwen ' s blade was so rarely used for combat that his comrades starting calling it " Applebane " .

title: Appointments with the Mighty
description: Appointments with the Mighty Appointments with the Mighty was a shop located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Appointments with the Mighty could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Appointments with the Mighty Appointments with the Mighty was a shop located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Appointments with the Mighty could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Inhabitants . Rayad al - Farif owned and operated this establishment . Activities . Rayad claimed to be able to make appointments for his customers with the heads of the various mosques or even the Grand Caliph . He only charged his customers if he succeeded in making the appointment . For appointments with the Grand Caliph , Rayad merely signed his customer up to attend a public audience .

title: Apsel
description: Apsel Apsel was a scrimshawer in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The older man dressed in dull grey clothing .
description_long: Apsel Apsel was a scrimshawer in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The older man dressed in dull grey clothing . Possessions . The scrimshawer craved items from scrimshaw including fine dagger s . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Apsel ' s shop was ransacked by a ravenous wolf .

title: Aquatic elf
description: Aquatic elf Aquatic elves ( also called sea elves and Alu ' Tel ' Quessir in their own tongue ) , are water - breathing cousins to land - dwelling elves . They live amid the waves and the ocean depths with allies such as dolphins and whales . Aquatic elves fight underwater with trident s , spears , and nets .
description_long: Aquatic elf Aquatic elves ( also called sea elves and Alu ' Tel ' Quessir in their own tongue ) , are water - breathing cousins to land - dwelling elves . They live amid the waves and the ocean depths with allies such as dolphins and whales . Aquatic elves fight underwater with trident s , spears , and nets . Description . Although they are of the same subrace , aquatic elves from the Great Sea have a different appearance to those from the Sea of Fallen Stars . The former have deep green skin , mottled and striped with brown . The latter have blue skin with white strips and patches . Both groups are robust and tall with long limbs , and long , thickly webbed digits . Their hair is usually thick and somewhat stringy , and can be blue , black silver or even occasionally red . The most unusual feature is the gills visible in their necks and over their ribs . Sea elves are either lightly clad or wear no clothes at all . Their clothes are formed from underwater plants , in blacks , browns and greens . Warriors clip their hair , but other sea elves wear it long and flowing .

title: Aquatic longbow
description: Aquatic longbow An aquatic longbow is an underwater version of a longbow that is favored by aquatic elves . It typically weighs 3 lb ( 1 . 4 kg ) and costs 400 gp , with a kelp string to dampen vibration .
description_long: Aquatic longbow An aquatic longbow is an underwater version of a longbow that is favored by aquatic elves . It typically weighs 3 lb ( 1 . 4 kg ) and costs 400 gp , with a kelp string to dampen vibration . Unlike regular underwater weapons , the aquatic longbow does not suffer from range - related penalties . Mighty composite versions of the aquatic longbow range from 600 gp to 900 gp .

title: Aquessir
description: Aquessir Aquessir , also known as Shadowtop Borough , was a floating city of Netheril . Noted for its inhabitants ' friendly disposition towards outsiders , as well as being the original home of the malevolent " Crown of Horns " , Aquessir was destroyed in −342 DR when the city ' s " mythallar " failed . Geography .
description_long: Aquessir Aquessir , also known as Shadowtop Borough , was a floating city of Netheril . Noted for its inhabitants ' friendly disposition towards outsiders , as well as being the original home of the malevolent " Crown of Horns " , Aquessir was destroyed in −342 DR when the city ' s " mythallar " failed . Geography . Aquessir was most commonly found floating near Shadowtop Alp , which overlooked the Janick river . Description . Unlike most other Netherese enclaves , the inhabitants of Aquessir were happy to participate in trade with outsiders , particularly elves . Although Aquessir was home to many arcane researchers , the creation of quasi - magical items was never popular within the enclave . History . The city was founded by the archwizard Trebbe in −2267 DR . Trebbe ruled Aquessir until he died in −2237 DR while finishing his work on the artifact known as the " Crown of Horns " . The ensuing explosion leveled an entire city block , and the artifact was subsequently lost . In −1423 DR , the archwizard Requiar seized power in Aquessir . Having found the " Crown of Horns " , Requiar used the artifact to stage a bloody coup that left thirty inhabitants dead .

title: Ar - Rabi
description: Ar - Rabi Sheik Ar - Rabi was a bandit leader during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ar - Rabi was the leader of the bandit group known as the Desert Wind .
description_long: Ar - Rabi Sheik Ar - Rabi was a bandit leader during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ar - Rabi was the leader of the bandit group known as the Desert Wind . His base of operations was the Grinning Skull oasis located deep within the Plains of Purple Dust . Ar - Rabi would use captured prisoners to sample the potentially deadly water of the oasis before allowing his men to drink . He would organize raids on the tribes of the desert and southern Murghôm .

title: Ara bint Cala
description: Ara bint Cala Ara bint Cala was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Ara was a pilot who helped safely guide incoming ships through the treacherous coral maze of Chaos Bay .
description_long: Ara bint Cala Ara bint Cala was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Ara was a pilot who helped safely guide incoming ships through the treacherous coral maze of Chaos Bay . She ran afoul of the Corsair Council after demanding more pay and prestige for the sea elves living in Chaos Bay , even going to far as to reveal the secrets of safely navigating the coral maze to outsiders .

title: Araag Dyrr
description: Araag Dyrr Araag Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Araag graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time .
description_long: Araag Dyrr Araag Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Araag graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time . During the siege of Dyrr ' s compound for their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Araag was called back to his house together with all other Dyrr wizards to help raise magical defenses .

title: Araband Tymin
description: Araband Tymin Araband Tymin was a commander in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Araband was the commander of the military forces of the city of Timindar , which was ruled by his father , Reland Tymin .
description_long: Araband Tymin Araband Tymin was a commander in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Araband was the commander of the military forces of the city of Timindar , which was ruled by his father , Reland Tymin . Usually he spent most of his time drinking with friends . He usually talked with all strangers about faraway lands . History . In 1358 DR , at the Black Eye inn , Araband got totally drunk and argued with the Gray Doom mercenaries leader Olway Lezard . Later , he became involved in the Battle of Thurgabanteth . Personality . Despite looking irresponsible , in times of need Araband was a capable leader . He dreamed of becoming an adventurer but never left home . Normally Araband disliked metal armor and never used the emblem of his station . Relationship . Araband was the best friend of Zerbin Gethrik , the local cleric of Tempus .

title: Arabel
description: Arabel Arabel was a fortified city in northern Cormyr . The city stood at an important crossroads and was a major trade center . Etymology .
description_long: Arabel Arabel was a fortified city in northern Cormyr . The city stood at an important crossroads and was a major trade center . Etymology . A person from Arabel was known as an Arabellan . Geography . Arabel was about 30 miles ( 48 kilometers ) east of Eveningstar . Arabel was at the junction of the High Road , Calantar ' s Way , the East Way , and the Moonsea Ride . Trade . Major exports included coal , horses , dry red wine , black beer , and cheese . Laws and customs . Unlike other Cormyrian cities , inhabitants of Arabel , even mercenaries , could keep their weapons unbound . History . Arabel was almost as old as Suzail . It began as a logging camp , and maintained a degree of independence . The first rebellion occurred during the reign of King Tharyann , who put an end to it . By 245 DR , Arabel was in rebellion again . By 376 DR , Arabel had seceded three times . Another rebellion occurred some time between 376 DR and 432 DR , caused by a " Merchants ' Revolutionary Committee " .

title: Arabellan Cheddar
description: Arabellan Cheddar Arabellan Cheddar was a cheese crafted in Arabel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Arabellan Cheddar Arabellan Cheddar was a cheese crafted in Arabel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This sturdy orange cheese was the most popular cheese around the Sea of Fallen Stars . It traveled well , making it the cheese of choice for adventurer s . Prices . Arabellan Cheddar could be purchased in the following sizes :

title: Arabellan Dry
description: Arabellan Dry Arabellan Dry was a wine exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This fine red wine was best served at cellar temperature .
description_long: Arabellan Dry Arabellan Dry was a wine exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This fine red wine was best served at cellar temperature . It was dry with a slight woodsy undertone with a hint of berry . Prices . Arabellan Dry could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Arabeth Raurym
description: Arabeth Raurym Arabeth Raurym was a female human sorcerer , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . She was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . She was also the eldest daughter of Elastul Raurym , Marchion of Mirabar .
description_long: Arabeth Raurym Arabeth Raurym was a female human sorcerer , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . She was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . She was also the eldest daughter of Elastul Raurym , Marchion of Mirabar . Description . Arabeth ' s stature was average but she bore a striking mane of reddish - brown hair that reached down to her waist . She tended to wear clothing that complemented her abilities as a spellcaster , with numerous storage spaces for her spell components . During her journeys to the lands south of Luskan , Arabeth would garb herself in clothing that matched whatever culture she would be encountering . Abilities . During her misspent youth in Mirabar , Arabeth developed skills in burglary and selling stolen goods . By 14 , she had already manifested sorcerous powers and by 18 she had enough skill to defy her father , the Marchion of Mirabar , and evade his guards long enough to reach Luskan . Eventually her ability with magic was considered enough for her to become an Overwizard of the Arcane Brotherhood . History .

title: Arach - Tinilith
description: Arach - Tinilith Arach - Tinilith was the clerical school in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Like the rest of the Academy , it was located in Tier Breche . Structure .
description_long: Arach - Tinilith Arach - Tinilith was the clerical school in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Like the rest of the Academy , it was located in Tier Breche . Structure . The complex - - the largest of the Academy - - was located on the northern side of the Tier Breche cavern and was shaped like a spider . The " cephalothorax " of the spider housed the grandest chapels , the holiest altars , and the quarters of the senior priestesses . The crowning gem of the complex was a the main chapel , carved from a single mass of black stone . Inside , seats surrounded circular platform that held a statue of spider with the head of drow female . The Mistress of the academy had an office on the highest level that had a tapestry depicting Lolth looming over a sacrificed surface elf . The Mistress also wore a brooch that allowed her to unlock all doors in Arach - Tinilith . There were dungeon - like kitchens located in the lower levels . Slaves , such as the ogre slave Chirank in 1361 DR , were employed there . A small library was located somewhere in the complex . History .

title: Arachhar Sevenstar
description: Arachhar Sevenstar Arachhar Sevenstar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Arachhar was a genius boy from Yhaunn , known for his talent in creating new spells and his frequent episodes of insanity .
description_long: Arachhar Sevenstar Arachhar Sevenstar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Arachhar was a genius boy from Yhaunn , known for his talent in creating new spells and his frequent episodes of insanity .

title: Arachnomancer
description: Arachnomancer The Arachnomancer is a prestige class of the Underdark that focuses on the strength and power of spider s . Relations . Because of the worship of Lolth among the Drow , an Arachnomancer can expect good reception within the majority of drow society .
description_long: Arachnomancer The Arachnomancer is a prestige class of the Underdark that focuses on the strength and power of spider s . Relations . Because of the worship of Lolth among the Drow , an Arachnomancer can expect good reception within the majority of drow society . The Aranea and Chitine are drawn to the Arachnomancer class as well , due to their own relativity to spiders . The Arachnomancer attractiveness is more about what culture , race or personal interest then what class it used to be . All Arachnomancer are spell casters , to be specific arcane spellcaster s . A cleric who worships a deity of the Spider domain might take up arcane studies to gain some of the Arachnomancer abilities . Requirements . All spell casters who wish to become Arachnomancers must be part of a scarification ritual that involves burning symbols into his face and rubbing the symbols with ash or other colorings in order to create raised and clear spider - shaped markings of his devotion to mastery of spider magic . also the one who wants to be an Arachnomancer also has to be evil and knowledgeable about nature .

title: Araevin Teshurr
description: Araevin Teshurr Araevin Teshurr is a sun elf . His home has been Tower Reilloch for the last eighty years . Relatives .
description_long: Araevin Teshurr Araevin Teshurr is a sun elf . His home has been Tower Reilloch for the last eighty years . Relatives . Araevin ' s parents have both been dead for over one hundred years . He has a sister , Sana Teshurr , who lives in Drelegara , and cousins Eredhor and Erevyella , who both have children . He is distantly related to Elorfindar Floshin . Araevin carries the blood of House Dlardrageth through some unknown bonding a long time ago , and this technically makes him a member of the house but he is not evil . Appearance . Araevin is tall by sun elf standards , and stands about the height of an average human . He is part eladrin . Equipment . Araevin wears a mithril mail shirt and a magical scarlet cloak that conveys protection and warding . He carries the blade of House Teshurr , a magical longsword named Moonrill . Familiar . More than ten years ago , Araevin ' s familiar , Whyllwyst , died . Childhood . Araevin was born at the House of Cedars , exploring the surrounding trails as a child . Studies . Araevin spent years travelling northwest Faerûn studying elven portals and spell structures after finding that Evermeet ' s libraries were not sufficient .

title: Aragath Taltar
description: Aragath Taltar Aragath Taltar was a evil lich - like undead in Turmish in 1370 DR . History . Aragath was a priest of Talos in the smugglers ' city of Jathrin ' s Jump .
description_long: Aragath Taltar Aragath Taltar was a evil lich - like undead in Turmish in 1370 DR . History . Aragath was a priest of Talos in the smugglers ' city of Jathrin ' s Jump . He was planning to become an undead when his temple was destroyed by followers of Lathander . Somehow he returned from death as a wraith - like lich leading some stone golem s . Around 1310 DR , a thief recovered Aragath ' s diary and sold it to the Uluuthin family , who died later during an adventure . Around 1370 DR , Aragath killed an adventurer .

title: Arahnar
description: Arahnar Arahnar is a female human werewolf . She was found injured in human form by Kharran Fel , who nursed her back to health and they began a relationship . She does not remember who caused these injuries , how she got separated from her pack , or much about her pack , but she is determined to find them again .
description_long: Arahnar Arahnar is a female human werewolf . She was found injured in human form by Kharran Fel , who nursed her back to health and they began a relationship . She does not remember who caused these injuries , how she got separated from her pack , or much about her pack , but she is determined to find them again . Appearance . Arahnar has trim build , dark hair and dark eyes . She has hawkish features . Because of her lycanthropy , she prefers loose - fitted garments that won ' t tear when she changes shape . Equipment . Arahnar carries both a dagger and a short sword and is equally dangerous with either . Search for her pack . Arahnar believed that the Circle of Vehlarr was the key to her finding her pack again . She remembered hearing legends about it when she was a child and it is holy to her people . She travelled to Scornubel with Kharran to find Angah Lalla , the fence whom she believes to possess a map to the Circle . On entering Angah ' s shop and asking for the map , three members of the Silver Stake stepped out of a hidden door and confronted Arahnar and Kharran .

title: Arakon
description: Arakon Arakon was an archmage who attacked the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale with a band of mercenaries . History . The archmage fought the tribes of the Uthgardt and Reghedmen , but when his army appeared to have been beaten , Arakon opened a portal to the Lower Planes .
description_long: Arakon Arakon was an archmage who attacked the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale with a band of mercenaries . History . The archmage fought the tribes of the Uthgardt and Reghedmen , but when his army appeared to have been beaten , Arakon opened a portal to the Lower Planes . To save both sides from the demon hordes , the shaman Jerrod sacrificed himself by throwing himself into the gate and creating the Jerrod ' s stone which destroyed the passageway to the plane : Baator .

title: Araldyk
description: Araldyk Araldyk was a helmed horror directly under the control of the mage , Yather Indaglol . Personality . Being a mindless helmed horror under control of a wizard , Araldyk was silent , attentive , and menacing .
description_long: Araldyk Araldyk was a helmed horror directly under the control of the mage , Yather Indaglol . Personality . Being a mindless helmed horror under control of a wizard , Araldyk was silent , attentive , and menacing . Activities . The floating suit of metal armor , Araldyk , worked at Yather ' s tavern , the Helm at Highsun , in Red Larch . Araldyk served as waiter , usher , bouncer , and occasionally a cloak rack . Araldyk also enforced the tavern ' s motto , " No one bothers you at the Helm . "

title: Aralent
description: Aralent Aralent was a settlement in the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . It was the site of the House of the Harmed temple of Ilmater , and home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . History .
description_long: Aralent Aralent was a settlement in the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . It was the site of the House of the Harmed temple of Ilmater , and home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . History . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan at the House of the Harmed in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers and never made it to Olbedan . The " Tome " was thought lost in the winter snows .

title: Araman
description: Araman Araman ( also known as Eveshi and Ahrraman ) was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir and was later a Red Wizard of Thay . History . He , along with his brother Akachi , was offered as a " sacrifice " and he was given the name " Eveshi " .
description_long: Araman Araman ( also known as Eveshi and Ahrraman ) was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir and was later a Red Wizard of Thay . History . He , along with his brother Akachi , was offered as a " sacrifice " and he was given the name " Eveshi " . He became a priest of Myrkul like his brother but unlike him Eveshi was shy and seldom spoke , often remaining in the shadow of his brother , though he would sometimes laugh or giggle . Akachi named him " Ahrraman " . Ahrraman remained a cleric of Myrkul while his brother rose through the ranks , becoming high priest and a Chosen of his god . When , in the wake of the death of the Founder , Akachi turned against his faith and god and started a crusade against Myrkul , Araman loyally joined him . After Akachi ' s defeat , Myrkul himself approached Araman and gave him a choice : to join his brother as a spirit eater or to correct these mistakes by killing the " Red Woman . " Araman chose the latter , and was made immortal and placed under a " geas " .

title: Arambar
description: Arambar Arambar was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Arambar was a gigantic primordial with the size of a mountain and a vaguely humanoid form .
description_long: Arambar Arambar was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Arambar was a gigantic primordial with the size of a mountain and a vaguely humanoid form . History . Arambar fought against the gods and was killed during the conflict that took place before the world of Abeir - Toril was divided into two twin worlds , Abeir and Toril , when his dragon mount betrayed him amid the battle and delivered itself the killing blow . Arambar ' s corpse was left in the world of Abeir after the two worlds were separated , in the continent of Laerakond in the lands that would later will be known as Skelkor . The stones that made its corpse rearranged themselves each night , and some believed the spirit of Arambar was the one who changed the position of the stones as a way to mark the time left for some great event to happen . Not long after the residual energy from his corpse enveloped Abeir , causing the " Steelsky " . Eventually , a group of escaped slaves from Skelkor founded a village in the remains of Arambar named Wandering Stones .

title: Arambar ( energy )
description: Arambar ( energy ) Arambar was a kind of ambient energy that enveloped the atmosphere of the world of Abeir , changing the color of the sky from blue to steel - colored . Abeirans called this phenomenon the " Steelsky " . Uses .
description_long: Arambar ( energy ) Arambar was a kind of ambient energy that enveloped the atmosphere of the world of Abeir , changing the color of the sky from blue to steel - colored . Abeirans called this phenomenon the " Steelsky " . Uses . A few Abeiran dragon s inhaled arambar in a complicated ritual before their sleep in hopes of gaining insights into current or past events in a specific area of knowledge . This process was not reliable , however , and most of the time the dragons who performed the ritual learned nothing . In a few and rare instances , dragons failed to wake up again , and in time faded to a wraith - like form called rathrea , gaining the ability to predict the future . As of 1479 DR , the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal was known for forcing her suzerains to perform the ritual on her behalf . Arambar had other uses as well , such as its ability to grant temporary precognitive powers . History . The arambar began to exist on Abeir not long after the death of the primordial Arambar , and many believed this energy came from its corpse , hence the name .

title: Arambarium
description: Arambarium Arambarium was an extremely rare metal that resembled polished silver . It was tuned to primordial and elemental energy and could amplify magic al effects . It also had mundane uses such as in armor .
description_long: Arambarium Arambarium was an extremely rare metal that resembled polished silver . It was tuned to primordial and elemental energy and could amplify magic al effects . It also had mundane uses such as in armor . The only known source of Arambarium was Ithimir Isle off the coast of Akanûl . The Akanûlans mined the deposit and kept its location a closely guarded secret . In reality , the Arambarium mother lode was the preserved fist of the dead primordial Arambar .

title: Aran Linvail
description: Aran Linvail Aran Linvail is the name of two distinctly different characters that play a very broadly similar role in the and versions of " Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn " . The novel . Aran Linvail was an assassin who was killed by Abdel Adrian .
description_long: Aran Linvail Aran Linvail is the name of two distinctly different characters that play a very broadly similar role in the and versions of " Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn " . The novel . Aran Linvail was an assassin who was killed by Abdel Adrian . Adrian needed a large sum of money to go after two of his friends , and Bodhi passed him the offer to gain the sum by killing Linvail . He hesitated at first , having decided never to kill for money again , but as he very much needed the money , he decided killing an assassin might be a form of justice . He infiltrated Linvail ' s house , waited in his closet for him to be finished with a lover , and finally killed him after a protracted , awkward fight . Who wanted Linvail dead and why , or if there even was a genuine outstanding price on his head , is never explained . The only source of information on this was Bodhi , who had her own agenda . In game . Aran Linvail was the Shadowmaster of Athkatla , the leader of the Shadow Thieves , and one of the most powerful people in all of Amn .

title: Aranea
description: Aranea The araneas ( sometimes called " werespiders " ) were a magical race of sentient , shape - changing spider - like creatures inhabiting the Spider Swamp in Calimshan . Description . While they were not true lycanthropes , aranea could transform between the appearance of a humanoid and a giant monstrous spider .
description_long: Aranea The araneas ( sometimes called " werespiders " ) were a magical race of sentient , shape - changing spider - like creatures inhabiting the Spider Swamp in Calimshan . Description . While they were not true lycanthropes , aranea could transform between the appearance of a humanoid and a giant monstrous spider . Their humanoid form was that of a Calishite human , a Calishite half - elf , or , in some rare cases , a drow . The form and gender they could take was fixed at birth . In their natural form , these creatures appeared to be giant humpbacked spiders with some subtle differences . In this form they also had a pair of short arms ending in many - jointed fingers and double - jointed thumbs , which extended from below their mandibles . Oddly , their brain was not located in their head segment but in a large hump on their back . Aranea also could take on a third , hybrid form . This form was humanoid , but the aranea bore sharp fangs , had spinnerets in his or her hands , and had four eyes instead of two . On occasion , the hybrid form would also include additional arms , but never more than 8 in total . Abilities .

title: Araneth Idogyr
description: Araneth Idogyr Araneth Idogyr was a half - elven former adventurer who later ran the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery in the Shalanar Barony of Erlkazar . He was the half - brother of the famous Tethyr ian mage Gamalon Idogyr . Activities .
description_long: Araneth Idogyr Araneth Idogyr was a half - elven former adventurer who later ran the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery in the Shalanar Barony of Erlkazar . He was the half - brother of the famous Tethyr ian mage Gamalon Idogyr . Activities . Araneth ' s claim to fame was his brewing of the popular brew , Old One Eye . He acquired the recipe for this unique ale from a cyclops he met and befriended during his time in the Goblin Wars of 1358 DR .

title: Aranghthal
description: Aranghthal Aranghthal was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Aranghthal was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl .
description_long: Aranghthal Aranghthal was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Aranghthal was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl . Every time the location of Rokthorl changed , the dragonborn also moved Aranghthal to a western cavern near the capital ' s current location .

title: Arangor Obarskyr
description: Arangor Obarskyr Arangor Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr and the father of Azoun II . He was on the throne in 1018 DR . Relatives .
description_long: Arangor Obarskyr Arangor Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr and the father of Azoun II . He was on the throne in 1018 DR . Relatives . Arangor ' s only son was Azoun II . Background . In the same year , while attacking a red dragon that had set Suzail ablaze , he was thrown out of his saddle and severely injured .

title: Arash bint Sanjar
description: Arash bint Sanjar Arash bint Sanjar was a Grand Caliph of Zakhara , ruling from the Enlightened Throne in the mid – 7th century DR . He was the daughter of Sanjar . History .
description_long: Arash bint Sanjar Arash bint Sanjar was a Grand Caliph of Zakhara , ruling from the Enlightened Throne in the mid – 7th century DR . He was the daughter of Sanjar . History . According to a treatise by a Mar writer of the Utter East , in the Year of the Nine Stars , 657 DR , suffering the Plague of Fiends , the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East had sent ships out north and south , desperately begging for aid from their neighbors . Grand Caliph Arash bint Sanjar heard these pleas , but he saw the Ffolk people as only heathens and barbarians , the land as infected and ravaged by the fiend s and undead . Instead , he sent an armada of " sambuk " to the Utter East in early Mirtul of 657 DR . The corsair s launched a surprise attack on the Five Kingdoms , swiftly overrunning and seizing their defenseless port cities . Then legions of " askar " , clad in djinn - forged lamellar and thrusting killing katar s , disembarked and marched across the land . With murderous efficiency , they razed every village and slew all they encountered , whether fiend or Ffolk , in what became known as the Scouring of the Utter East .

title: Arashta Tharbrow
description: Arashta Tharbrow Arashta Tharbrow was a Zhentarim sorceress in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Arashta was in Daggerdale with the mission to kill Randal Morn .
description_long: Arashta Tharbrow Arashta Tharbrow was a Zhentarim sorceress in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Arashta was in Daggerdale with the mission to kill Randal Morn . Suddenly her god Bane appeared in front of her , saying that she would became his chosen tyrant in Faerûn if she could kill Elminster Aumar and that Randal was not an important being in his plots . Quickly Arashta went to kill the Old Mage , not knowing that " Bane " was Issaran of the malaugrym . Arashta attacked Elminster , who was together the Rangers Three and others allies , alongside a band of hobgoblin s but she failed in her assassination . Sharantyr attacked Arashta that managed to cast a defense spell but , as often in Time of Troubles , her spell no worked and Sharantyr killed her .

title: Arathane
description: Arathane Queen Arathane was a stormsoul genasi and the ruler of Akanûl in 1479 DR . Appearance . Arathane was a stunningly beautiful genasi with lavender skin .
description_long: Arathane Queen Arathane was a stormsoul genasi and the ruler of Akanûl in 1479 DR . Appearance . Arathane was a stunningly beautiful genasi with lavender skin . Unlike other Abeir an genasi , her " szuldar " were almost non - existent . History . She was considered a fair and just ruler by her subjects . At least until her mid - forties , she remained unmarried and was besieged by would - be suitors . Arathane was in no hurry to bear a successor , as both her mother and grandmother bore children late in life . In 1479 DR , Aoth Fezim of the Brotherhood of the Griffon sought out Queen Arathane to convince her to not give her support to Tchazzar in the invasion of Tymanther , however he was unable to convince Queen Arathane to not attack the dragonborn . She changed her opinion later , when Aoth and members of the Fire Cabal killed the gray dragon Vairshekellabex .

title: Arathluth
description: Arathluth Arathluth was a male malaugrym . Unable to fly in air , he disliked winged shapes ; having no magic power of his own , he collected magic item s to empower him . He was believed to reside in Amn impersonating a human merchant ; known aliases included " Ulstult " and " Imbar " .
description_long: Arathluth Arathluth was a male malaugrym . Unable to fly in air , he disliked winged shapes ; having no magic power of his own , he collected magic item s to empower him . He was believed to reside in Amn impersonating a human merchant ; known aliases included " Ulstult " and " Imbar " . By the 1479 DR Arathluth was in Sword Coast posing as a merchant or a mercenary and add to his known aliases " Gahnek " and " Napid " .

title: Araugauthos
description: Araugauthos Araugauthos ( The Bluetalon ) is an old blue dragon that was imprisoned in the ruins of Undermountain by Halaster Blackcloak . She later escaped from imprisonment . Background .
description_long: Araugauthos Araugauthos ( The Bluetalon ) is an old blue dragon that was imprisoned in the ruins of Undermountain by Halaster Blackcloak . She later escaped from imprisonment . Background . In autumn , 1369 DR , Citadel Amnur in Amn was attacked by an unknown red wyrm . Soon after , Araugauthos attacked the red wyrm by ripping through its wings with her claws , causing it to fall to its death , becoming impaled on sharp rocks . Araugauthos questioned the troops at Citadel Amnur for news of Faerûn since her imprisonment and left after two tendays , taking most of the contents from the lair of the red wyrm . She travelled to the lair of her mother , Iryklathagra where she aids in the defence of the lair & acts as a decoy to would - be dragonslayers . Her mother rewards her well for the service & the two get along very well . Iryklathagra surmises that the reason for Halaster ' s imprisonment of her daughter dates back to when she herself was a wyrmling & looted an abandoned tower that belonged to the Mad Mage .

title: Araumycos
description: Araumycos Araumycos ( Dwarvish for “ Great Fungus ” ) was an enormous fungal growth that lived in the Upper Northdark and lay beneath the High Forest between the cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . Description . Araumycos a huge life form , a single organism that covered almost all the parts of the Underdark beneath the High Forest , beginning at a depth of one mile ( 1 .
description_long: Araumycos Araumycos ( Dwarvish for “ Great Fungus ” ) was an enormous fungal growth that lived in the Upper Northdark and lay beneath the High Forest between the cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . Description . Araumycos a huge life form , a single organism that covered almost all the parts of the Underdark beneath the High Forest , beginning at a depth of one mile ( 1 . 6 km . ) under the surface and ending at a depth of three miles ( 4 . 8 km . ) . It was believed to extend from the Shining Falls to the Lost Peaks and from Tall Trees to the Hall of Four Ghosts , wholly occupying the labyrinth of tunnels and caverns that existed beneath the High Forest . But it seemed that it had reached its peak of volume since it no longer grew through other territories . History . Centuries ago the area where Araumycos was located was mined and occupied by the dwarves of Ammarindar during the time of the elven realm Eaerlann . The dwarves of ancient Ammarindar spoke of their mines located in the region beneath the elven realm of Eaerlann that were abandoned to the slow , inexorable growth of Araumycos .

title: Araundor
description: Araundor Araundor was a wizard from Mulhorand , who became a lich and went to live in a small refuge in the Underdark . History . A long time before 1372 DR , Araundor was once a wizard in Mulhorand .
description_long: Araundor Araundor was a wizard from Mulhorand , who became a lich and went to live in a small refuge in the Underdark . History . A long time before 1372 DR , Araundor was once a wizard in Mulhorand . However , by 1372 DR , he was a semi - crazed lich that existed only to destroy intruders in his lair . Personality . Araundor greatly enjoyed destroying his enemies , but he usually tried to read their minds first so he could use their personal information against them . Araundor liked mocking his enemies by telling them what he had learned from reading their minds , but only when one or two adversaries remained .

title: Araundras Othaun
description: Araundras Othaun Araundras Othaun was a Chosen of Mystryl in ancient Netheril . History . In the time of Netheril , Araundras was a Chosen of Mystryl .
description_long: Araundras Othaun Araundras Othaun was a Chosen of Mystryl in ancient Netheril . History . In the time of Netheril , Araundras was a Chosen of Mystryl . However , Larloch , a fellow Chosen , doubted Araundras ' s loyalty to the goddess , so he gave him a ring with a scrying spell inside . Some time later , Telamont Tanthul killed Araundras and took his ring as a trophy . Thus , after Thultanthar returned to Toril in 1372 , Larloch was able to use the ring to spy upon the shadovar ' s plans . In 1487 DR , Larloch told Elminster Aumar all about Araundras .

title: Arauntan of Selgaunt
description: Arauntan of Selgaunt Arauntan of Selgaunt ( the Wandering Wizard ) was a wizard from Selgaunt . He is notable because in 1351 DR , he recalled that three brothers in Harrowdale had dramatically changed their appearance . History .
description_long: Arauntan of Selgaunt Arauntan of Selgaunt ( the Wandering Wizard ) was a wizard from Selgaunt . He is notable because in 1351 DR , he recalled that three brothers in Harrowdale had dramatically changed their appearance . History . In 1351 DR , Arauntan was described as a " three - hundred - year - old wizard " so he was born in or prior to 1051 DR . A farmstead in Harrowdale was home to three brothers from Sembia : Torstan , Ulbaern , and Durthar Morgath . However , on the morning after " fey blue mage - fire " was seen above the farmstead , Arauntan swore that the appearances of these brothers had become those of Lord Elmaer Oraun ( formerly Lord of Harrowdale circa 1180 DR ) , his son Erammon Oraun , and his swordmaster Thaeron , who had disappeared centuries earlier at the Battle of Marak ' s Stile . Durthar Morgath would later , during the second inter - dale war , declare himself " Thaeron , Rightful Swordmaster of Harrowdale " .

title: Arauthator
description: Arauthator Arauthator was a white dragon who lived under Lonefang Mountain in the Spine of the World in the Endless Ice Sea . History . Arauthator was among the dozen or so dragons that attacked the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan because of Sammaster ' s Rage of Dragons in 1373 DR .
description_long: Arauthator Arauthator was a white dragon who lived under Lonefang Mountain in the Spine of the World in the Endless Ice Sea . History . Arauthator was among the dozen or so dragons that attacked the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan because of Sammaster ' s Rage of Dragons in 1373 DR . When part of the tower fell , Arauthator made off with a good deal of magical items , including a few powerful , priceless tomes . The dragon in c . 1480 DR made his home an iceberg called Oyaviggaton on the Sea of Moving Ice . In 1484 DR Arauthator and his son Aurbangras allied with the orc s and drow forces that assaulted Luruar during the Darkening ; he also was ridden by Tiago Baenre in the assault against Nesme . Relationships . Arauthator ' s mate was Arveiaturace . They had offspring , including Aurbangras .

title: Aravilar Moondown
description: Aravilar Moondown Aravilar Moondown was a new Knight of the Weave from Halruaa in 1374 DR . He was tasked with the mission of finding and stopping a potion - peddler who sold magic items corrupted by the Shadow Weave . Aravilar was confident in himself to the point of being arrogance .
description_long: Aravilar Moondown Aravilar Moondown was a new Knight of the Weave from Halruaa in 1374 DR . He was tasked with the mission of finding and stopping a potion - peddler who sold magic items corrupted by the Shadow Weave . Aravilar was confident in himself to the point of being arrogance . He was also totally convinced of elven supremacy and unconsciously treated all others like underlings .

title: Arcadia
description: Arcadia Arcadia ( ar - KAY - dee - a ) was the Outer Plane representing alignments between lawful neutral and lawful good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Dwarfhome , House of the Triad , and even Dweomerheart when that cosmology became popular . Dwarfhome and the House of the Triad ( which became known as Celestia ) survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology .
description_long: Arcadia Arcadia ( ar - KAY - dee - a ) was the Outer Plane representing alignments between lawful neutral and lawful good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Dwarfhome , House of the Triad , and even Dweomerheart when that cosmology became popular . Dwarfhome and the House of the Triad ( which became known as Celestia ) survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology . Dweomerheart was destroyed at the start of the Spellplague . Description . The first layer of Arcadia was a well - ordered place with well - tended crops , orchards , and cities all laid out in regular geometric shapes . Properly shaped and arranged flowerbeds of every color were always in bloom and never needed a gardener , nourished by gentle rains . Night and day were provided by a huge rotating sphere , half radiant , half dark , set into the highest mountain in the plane . The trees of Arcadia grew in straight orchard rows or tidy forests . They had bark of iron , copper , silver , or gold , depending on the type of tree .

title: Arcana domain
description: Arcana domain The arcana domain , or magic domain as it is sometimes called , ( not to be confused with the spell domain ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters prayer s connected to the power of the arcane . They may , as part of their training , gain the ability to use wizard ly implement s such as scrolls , wand s , and rod s . Deities with the Arcana domain .
description_long: Arcana domain The arcana domain , or magic domain as it is sometimes called , ( not to be confused with the spell domain ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters prayer s connected to the power of the arcane . They may , as part of their training , gain the ability to use wizard ly implement s such as scrolls , wand s , and rod s . Deities with the Arcana domain . After the Spellplague , Corellon , Selûne , and Sseth connected themselves to the governance of the arcane , splitting the domain between themselves . None of the three possess the same degree of control over magic that Mystryl , Mystra , or Midnight did , but their influence is far from negligible and each has a unique approach that defines , to an extent , their worshipers ' connection to the arcane . Corellon , who supports the efforts of Elven high mage s , favors the use of arcane magic in the creation of beautiful art and his eladrin followers approach magic through an almost aesthetic frame of mind .

title: Arcanabula
description: Arcanabula An Arcanabula , sometimes known as an " orizon " , is the term used for a wizard ’ s working spellbook ; often a hodgepodge of spells ( including some that were unusable by the author ) and research notes for both the completed spells therein and for spell concepts still in progress . An arcanabula differs in concept from a " travelling spellbook " in that the latter is generally a distilled copy of one or more arcanabulae , lacking the research notes for the sake of compactness , though most travelling spellbooks with blank pages remaining almost inevitably become aracanabulae . Appearance .
description_long: Arcanabula An Arcanabula , sometimes known as an " orizon " , is the term used for a wizard ’ s working spellbook ; often a hodgepodge of spells ( including some that were unusable by the author ) and research notes for both the completed spells therein and for spell concepts still in progress . An arcanabula differs in concept from a " travelling spellbook " in that the latter is generally a distilled copy of one or more arcanabulae , lacking the research notes for the sake of compactness , though most travelling spellbooks with blank pages remaining almost inevitably become aracanabulae . Appearance . Throughout Faerûn , the most common form of arcanabula is the spellbook that every aspiring wizard starts his or her career with . This is a well - bound book , approximately 9 ” x 12 ” , with leather - covered suthwood front and back covers protecting fifty leaves of well - crafted parchment suitable for writing on both sides ( total : 100 pages ) , the whole weighing in at three pounds . The cover material varies widely from region to region , some are cloth or felt covered , some are uncovered , and some use linen paper or even vellum instead of parchment .

title: Arcanaloth
description: Arcanaloth The arcanaloths were the record keepers of yugoloths . All transactions for services rendered in the Blood War went through them . As yugoloths go , they were a civilized breed .
description_long: Arcanaloth The arcanaloths were the record keepers of yugoloths . All transactions for services rendered in the Blood War went through them . As yugoloths go , they were a civilized breed . Description . An arcanaloth appeared as a robed human with the head of a fanged jackal or war dog . Combat . The physical attack of a powerful arcanaloth consisted of a claw and bite routine . They enjoyed inflicting pain and torment with their claws . All arcanolths commonly memorized destructive spells but they kept a wise eye on their escape and defensive spells for good measure . They were extremely intelligent and used their spells to their best advantage . In general , these creatures avoided hand - to - hand combat . Arcanaloths were harmed only by magical weapons of great enchantment . They were immune to mind - affecting spells cast by mortals . In a rare instance of an arcanaloth affected by mind - affecting magic , Inthraxis the Oinoloth had a mentally dominated arcanaloth seneschal of Corpsehaven . They could never be surprised while on the lower planes . They could only be permanently destroyed while on Gehenna .

title: Arcanamach
description: Arcanamach Known as the Suel arcanamachs on Oerth , the arcanamachs of Toril can be associated with the elite warrior - mage traditions of Netheril , Imaskar , or even Jhaamdath or Mulhorand . These empires were known for the great and terrible power wielded by their archmages ( technically , Jhaamdath was known for psionicist s instead ) , and so elite schools of combat training were necessary to fight the dangerous magic of an archmage ' s rivals . The arcanamach , then , is an elite guard serving archmage masters , serving the greatest wizards of their empire with both sword and spell .
description_long: Arcanamach Known as the Suel arcanamachs on Oerth , the arcanamachs of Toril can be associated with the elite warrior - mage traditions of Netheril , Imaskar , or even Jhaamdath or Mulhorand . These empires were known for the great and terrible power wielded by their archmages ( technically , Jhaamdath was known for psionicist s instead ) , and so elite schools of combat training were necessary to fight the dangerous magic of an archmage ' s rivals . The arcanamach , then , is an elite guard serving archmage masters , serving the greatest wizards of their empire with both sword and spell . They are also assassins and spies trained to slay powerful wizards of rival noble families ; they also defend the wizards of their own families . They perfect their art by training against other arcanamachs in hidden academies , in hundreds of secret duels involving both spells and steel . Since the days of the empires of old , the tradition of the archamachs survive only in a rare set of magical tomes known as the " Grimoire Arcanamacha " .

title: Arcane Brotherhood
description: Arcane Brotherhood The Arcane Brotherhood is a mercantile company and wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . It is known however that their primary goal was the political and economic control of the North .
description_long: Arcane Brotherhood The Arcane Brotherhood is a mercantile company and wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . It is known however that their primary goal was the political and economic control of the North . Many powerful groups , such as the Zhentarim , the Cult of the Dragon and the Red Wizards of Thay attempted to infiltrate the Brotherhood , to no avail though the Unseen had a minor success in this regard . History . Arklem Greeth , the original Archmage Arcane of the Brotherhood , first appeared in Luskan around 1311 DR . Meticulously building a group of powerful and evil mages , Greeth sought to acquire control of the North by first dominating trade using the far reaching arm of Luskan . Greeth and the Brotherhood first gained full control of Luskan ( through the High Captains ) sometime around 1357 DR . After conquering the island of Ruathym ( on the second attempt ) in 1361 DR , Luskan was forced to return it by the Lords ' Alliance . Greeth then had Luskan embark on a number of disastrous military and naval ventures .

title: Arcane Power
description: Arcane Power Contents . " Arcane Power " is a 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " sourcebook intended as supplementary rules for players playing as characters using the arcane power source , such as wizards or warlocks . It covers all of the officially released classes of the arcane power source , including swordmages , to that point but not later released ones , such as the artificer class .
description_long: Arcane Power Contents . " Arcane Power " is a 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " sourcebook intended as supplementary rules for players playing as characters using the arcane power source , such as wizards or warlocks . It covers all of the officially released classes of the arcane power source , including swordmages , to that point but not later released ones , such as the artificer class .
