In addition to providing new builds , the book also comes with new feats , ritual s , paragon paths , and epic destinies as well as rules for using familiar s . Although a book mostly built on game mechanics and rules , also known as " crunch , " the book contains a small amount of lore to provide players with a context for their class , such as details on how different races play out different classes . The book is organized into seven chapters , as follow :

title: Arcane archer
description: Arcane archer The arcane archer is a prestige class whose members mix archery with magic , making them fearsome combatants . Abilities . Enhance Arrow Upon firing a mundane arrow it becomes enhanced .
description_long: Arcane archer The arcane archer is a prestige class whose members mix archery with magic , making them fearsome combatants . Abilities . Enhance Arrow Upon firing a mundane arrow it becomes enhanced . The strength of this enhancement increases as the archer gains experience . Imbue Arrow The arcane archer can place an area spell on an arrow . The area spell is centered on where the arrow lands . Thus increasing the range of certain spells to as far as the archer can cast an arrow . The arrow must be cast soon or the spell will dissipate . Seeker Arrow Once a day an experienced arcane archer can launch an arrow at any target known to them in their range . This arrow travels to its target even if it needs to round corners . Phase Arrow Once a day a more experienced arcane archer can launch an arrow at any target known to them in their range . This arrow will fly straight at the target traveling through any non magical barrier or wall . If correctly aimed it will strike the target directly , even passing through its armor . Arrow of Death A master arcane archer can create a powerful arrow that can strike a foe dead .

title: Arcane devotee
description: Arcane devotee Arcane devotee is a prestige class on Faerûn comprised of arcane spellcaster s dedicated to the deity they worship . Usually they expand their studies into divine magic and acquire lesser divine - related abilities . Arcane devotees often work for the respective church of their deity and are among their most respected members .
description_long: Arcane devotee Arcane devotee is a prestige class on Faerûn comprised of arcane spellcaster s dedicated to the deity they worship . Usually they expand their studies into divine magic and acquire lesser divine - related abilities . Arcane devotees often work for the respective church of their deity and are among their most respected members . Devotees also support the church ' s armies during times of conflict . The churches of Azuth , Mystra , Lliira and Bane attract the highest number of arcane devotees . Culture . Although many deities appeal specifically to certain niche groups , most of the greater god s pull followers from all walks of life . Arcanists in particular hold few solid allegiances to the god other than , formerly , Mystra , and many of those who study and use arcane magic can be found worshiping just about any of the major deities . Although many arcanists , particularly wizards , are not particularly devout in their worship and ally themselves with their church primarily for reasons of caution or convenience , others can be truly pious individuals who are willing to give themselves over fully to their patron god ' s will .

title: Arcane eye
description: Arcane eye Arcane eye was an arcane divination spell that allowed its caster to spy on things from a distance . Effects . The spell would create an invisible floating eye , which would give a mental image to the caster whenever it was dark and within 30 feet .
description_long: Arcane eye Arcane eye was an arcane divination spell that allowed its caster to spy on things from a distance . Effects . The spell would create an invisible floating eye , which would give a mental image to the caster whenever it was dark and within 30 feet . The eye could travel 30 feet from its caster and could enter holes as small as 1 inch ( 2 . 5 centimeters ) in diameter . The eye would move as per the caster ' s demands of it . Components . A bit of bat fur .

title: Arcane gate
description: Arcane gate Arcane gate was an arcane conjuration spell that created a portal between two points . Effects . The caster picked two spots that they could see , the first within 10 feet ( 3 meters ) and the other within 500 feet ( 152 meters ) , and a portal would be created between the two .
description_long: Arcane gate Arcane gate was an arcane conjuration spell that created a portal between two points . Effects . The caster picked two spots that they could see , the first within 10 feet ( 3 meters ) and the other within 500 feet ( 152 meters ) , and a portal would be created between the two . The portal was 10 feet in diameter and could only be seen and accessed one one side . The portal showed showed glowing mist on its surface . The portal could not be cast on a creature and the portal could also be turned on and off at the will of the caster .

title: Arcane lock
description: Arcane lock Arcane lock , also known as wizard lock , was an arcane abjuration ( formerly alteration ) spell that allowed the caster to lock closed entryways . Effect . By touching a closed door , window , gate or other entryway , the caster would lock it .
description_long: Arcane lock Arcane lock , also known as wizard lock , was an arcane abjuration ( formerly alteration ) spell that allowed the caster to lock closed entryways . Effect . By touching a closed door , window , gate or other entryway , the caster would lock it . The caster could pick a creature type or even a password that would allow them to open the locked entryway . Unwanted visitors could enter only if the object was broken or if the spell was suppressed . The spell could be suppressed by a " knock " spell and the suppression lasted for 10 minutes . When the spell was active , the lock was harder to pick or break . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components and gold dust worth 25 gold piece s .

title: Arcane magic
description: Arcane magic Arcane magic ( the Art ) is the direct manipulation of energy . Arcane magic is created out of manipulation of the Weave . Anyone who can fully duplicate the gestures and sounds required of each spell can use arcane magic .
description_long: Arcane magic Arcane magic ( the Art ) is the direct manipulation of energy . Arcane magic is created out of manipulation of the Weave . Anyone who can fully duplicate the gestures and sounds required of each spell can use arcane magic . Manipulating the Weave can be done via magical writings , Rune magic ( though Rune magic is more involved with divine magic ) , Gem magic , Circle magic , etc . Historically , arcane magic is the most unreliable form of magic .

title: Arcane scholar of Candlekeep
description: Arcane scholar of Candlekeep Arcane scholars of Candlekeep seek to raise the study of magic to the level of an academic discipline . Their interest is not in researching new spells or finding more specialized uses for their craft , but in understanding the fundamental processes of magic and the inner workings of the Weave , which is the fabric that underlies all magic . The arcane scholar class was created in - house by Obsidian Entertainment for " " .
description_long: Arcane scholar of Candlekeep Arcane scholars of Candlekeep seek to raise the study of magic to the level of an academic discipline . Their interest is not in researching new spells or finding more specialized uses for their craft , but in understanding the fundamental processes of magic and the inner workings of the Weave , which is the fabric that underlies all magic . The arcane scholar class was created in - house by Obsidian Entertainment for " " . Background . The first arcane scholars emerged from the dusty libraries of Candlekeep , where they pored through the writings of a thousand long - dead mages , seeking the unifying principles that underlie all magic . But even the archives of Candlekeep have their limits , and not all practitioners of magic have the means or desire to record their experiences with the Art . So arcane scholars dispersed into the wider world , observing and recording all the various expressions of magic they could find . Their tradition has gradually spread , and some mages who have never set foot in Candlekeep have adopted their disciplined and systematic approach to magic .

title: Arcane trickster
description: Arcane trickster Arcane trickster was a prestige class that combined arcane spellcasting ability with stealth . Culture . Arcane tricksters tended to prepare for any eventuality and then winged it , relying on their stealthiness to sneak in and use their spells to maximum advantage , then get away quickly .
description_long: Arcane trickster Arcane trickster was a prestige class that combined arcane spellcasting ability with stealth . Culture . Arcane tricksters tended to prepare for any eventuality and then winged it , relying on their stealthiness to sneak in and use their spells to maximum advantage , then get away quickly . Abilities . An arcane trickster could sneak attack just like a rogue but was able to deliver more damage . As an advanced technique , the trickster could , once a day , just decide to make a particular melee or ranged attack a sneak attack , catching their opponent off - guard and flat - footed . A highly advanced trickster could do this twice per day . Combining magic with the practical abilities of the trade , an arcane trickster could perform sleight of hand moves , disable devices , and open locks on targets up to 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) away .

title: Arcane wellspring
description: Arcane wellspring An arcane wellspring is a sorcerer for whom the wielding of arcane magic comes even more easily , almost instinctively than it does for even other sorcerers . When an arcane wellspring unleashes its power , it does not flow , but rather erupts , bellowing forth from them like an arcane geyser . To an arcane wellspring , magic is less a stream of power they let flow through them than a part of their very being , as much as their flesh or blood .
description_long: Arcane wellspring An arcane wellspring is a sorcerer for whom the wielding of arcane magic comes even more easily , almost instinctively than it does for even other sorcerers . When an arcane wellspring unleashes its power , it does not flow , but rather erupts , bellowing forth from them like an arcane geyser . To an arcane wellspring , magic is less a stream of power they let flow through them than a part of their very being , as much as their flesh or blood . Eventually , this becomes physical , to the point that arcane wellsprings actually transform into pure arcane energy time for a time . Abilities . Arcane wellsprings have a number of unique features universal to them , acquired through their intense connection to the arcane . Unlike most sorcerers , arcane wellsprings have resistance to two or more forms of energy at once , rather than one , an affinity which transfers also to their attack spell s for extra lethality against creatures with a similar resistance . Arcane wellsprings also have wider coverage for their spells , enabling them to attack multiple opponents at once , and with additional training they can teleport an equal number creatures hit by their spells .

title: Arcanist
description: Arcanist Arcanists were Netherese individuals who wielded arcane magic in the days of the first Netherese Empire . The title " arcanist " was synonymous with the more modern word " wizard . " Culture .
description_long: Arcanist Arcanists were Netherese individuals who wielded arcane magic in the days of the first Netherese Empire . The title " arcanist " was synonymous with the more modern word " wizard . " Culture . The Netherese culture was extravagant , wasteful , and decadent . Magic was plentiful and nearly everyone could wield it to some extent . Arcanists were the elite spellcasters in society and were looked to for the defense , prowess , and prosperity of Netheril . The most powerful arcanists were known as archwizards . Arcanists were arrogant in general and looked upon divine magic with utter disdain because they felt they were on a path to godhood and to accept healing or aid from a priest was to forfeit their chance at becoming a deity themselves . Thus , arcanists of this stripe relied heavily on " potions of healing " and other arcane forms of healing and life preservation . Abilities . The Netherese arcanists achieved the highest level of magical ability ever wielded by mortals . Indeed , one archwizard , Karsus , actually promoted himself to godhood for a very brief moment by stealing the power of Mystryl , the Mother of All Magic , in the Year of Sundered Webs , – 339 DR .

title: Arcata
description: Arcata The duchy of Arcata was found in Damara . History . The start of the Bloodstone Wars was marked by a conflict between Arcata and the neighbouring Barony of Bloodstone , in which Duke William Horgath attempted to seize bloodstone mines in the barony ' s territory .
description_long: Arcata The duchy of Arcata was found in Damara . History . The start of the Bloodstone Wars was marked by a conflict between Arcata and the neighbouring Barony of Bloodstone , in which Duke William Horgath attempted to seize bloodstone mines in the barony ' s territory . The attack was ill - prepared and hundreds of Arcatans died , before peace was instated by Gareth Dragonsbane in what became known as Gareth ' s Gamble . The resolution of the conflict and the concentration of both armies on the threats to the south have led many of the Arcatan people to favour unification with the Barony of Bloodstone under Gareth Dragonsbane ' s rule . Rumours are rife that the Ducal Guard in Valls are loyal to the barony instead of their duke . Government . As of 1358 DR , it is ruled by Duke William Horgath and has a population of around 15 , 000 . Its capital is the town of Valls . The duchy is mainly made up of farmers , although there are some mines harvesting iron and silver . The Arcatan people are known for their hard work ethic and being self - sufficient . Settlements . With a population of 1300 , Valls is the largest settlement in Arcata and the capital .

title: Arch Wood
description: Arch Wood Arch Wood was a forest on the northern border of Archendale . Geography . Throughout history , the majority of the forest was never been logged .
description_long: Arch Wood Arch Wood was a forest on the northern border of Archendale . Geography . Throughout history , the majority of the forest was never been logged . The Arch Wood was a dark , dense forest full of oak , ash , elm , shadowtop and duskwood trees . Notable locations . The Arch Wood had ruins in it including the remains of an old elven school of wizardry .

title: Arch of Goolgog
description: Arch of Goolgog The Arch of Goolgog was an orc - made monumental arch in the Vast . It held a " portal " to the Battle of Bones in the Western Heartlands . History .
description_long: Arch of Goolgog The Arch of Goolgog was an orc - made monumental arch in the Vast . It held a " portal " to the Battle of Bones in the Western Heartlands . History . The arch was constructed on the orders of the orc leader Goolgog Elvenbane to celebrate his great victory against elves and human s in ancient times . To that end , it was fashioned from the bones of the defeated enemies on the battlefield . Goolgog marched his whole army under the arch to demonstrate his triumph , before he returned to his base . In the late 11th century DR ( shortly after " circa " 1072 DR ) , followers of the god of the dead , Myrkul , Lord of Bones , arrived at the Arch of Goolgog . They built a hidden temple close by , and desired a swift means of joining their brethren near the Well of Dragons in the Battle of Bones . One of their number was a sorcerer , and they worked together to create a " portal " within the arch and linked it to the center of the Battle of the Bones valley . The priests also animated the bones of the arch to defend it against the unfaithful .

title: Archdevil
description: Archdevil The archdevils are the rulers of the Nine Hells . They are also called the Lords of the Nine , the Archdukes of Hell , and the Lords of Hell . They each control one of the plane ' s nine layers and are the most powerful and highest - ranking devil s .
description_long: Archdevil The archdevils are the rulers of the Nine Hells . They are also called the Lords of the Nine , the Archdukes of Hell , and the Lords of Hell . They each control one of the plane ' s nine layers and are the most powerful and highest - ranking devil s . Unlike the chaotic evil demon lord s of the Abyss , the Lords of the Nine ( and all the baatezu of the Hells for that matter ) are arranged in a strict hierarchy . The lord of the first layer has the lowest rank of the nine archdevils , while the lord of the ninth layer has the highest rank . While the demons of the Abyss answer only to their own basic instincts , every single devil , at least in theory , answers to the Lord of the Ninth , Asmodeus . Each archduke is a unique devil of immense power and influence , with his own resources : military , magical , and political , to rely on in the endless scheming that characterizes devilish politics . Lord of the First : Bel the Warlord . Bel is a former pit fiend of great power who controls Avernus . He resides in his personal fortress in the center of the Bronze Citadel .

title: Archfey
description: Archfey Archfey were fey beings who gained great power and established a position of preeminence among fey - kind . Each archfey had a unique appearance and set of abilities . Most controlled a portion of the Feywild and had self - proclaimed titles .
description_long: Archfey Archfey were fey beings who gained great power and established a position of preeminence among fey - kind . Each archfey had a unique appearance and set of abilities . Most controlled a portion of the Feywild and had self - proclaimed titles . Some archfey were regarded as deities and granted divine abilities to their worshipers . Archfey could be contacted by a willing warlock to form a fey pact .

title: Archfey patron
description: Archfey patron An archfey patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and one of the archfey , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots .
description_long: Archfey patron An archfey patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and one of the archfey , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots .

title: Archfiend
description: Archfiend An Archfiend is a particularly powerful fiend , usually a creature that rules over one of the fiendish planes or has a fiendish army at their disposal . There are 10 Archdukes of Hell , an unknown number of Baernoloths and possibly an infinite number of Abyssal Lords , though only 10 really worth noting . Abyssal Lords .
description_long: Archfiend An Archfiend is a particularly powerful fiend , usually a creature that rules over one of the fiendish planes or has a fiendish army at their disposal . There are 10 Archdukes of Hell , an unknown number of Baernoloths and possibly an infinite number of Abyssal Lords , though only 10 really worth noting . Abyssal Lords . Each abyssal lord is a demon that has a realm on one of the layers of the abyss . They either scheme against each other , throw their armies into the Blood War or try to manipulate events on the Material Plane . In a theoretically infinite Abyss there are theoretically an infinite number of Abyssal Lords . only 10 Abyssal Lords regularly interfere in the affairs of mortals and these are : Lolth . After Araushnee was cast down from Arvandor into the Abyss , Corellon Larethian cursed her into becoming the Abyssal Lord Lolth . Lolth has since regained her divinty and left the Abyss , shedding her mantle of Abyssal Lord . Baernoloths . The Baernoloth s rule over the Yugoloth s but are not widely documented . As such , very few have any information on who they are . Archdevils . The archdevils have a strict hierarchy .

title: Archipelago of Altumbel
description: Archipelago of Altumbel The Archipelago of Altumbel was a collection of islands off the coast of Altumbel , on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were composed of coral and rock , and primarily contained fishing villages . There were numerous wizard towers on the islands , some of which were disused and some of which were still in use .
description_long: Archipelago of Altumbel The Archipelago of Altumbel was a collection of islands off the coast of Altumbel , on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were composed of coral and rock , and primarily contained fishing villages . There were numerous wizard towers on the islands , some of which were disused and some of which were still in use . Pirates also occupied the archipelago . Islands . Shamandra . The third largest island in the archipelago . Stolys . The second largest island in the archipelago . Thonn ' s Fist . The largest of the islands , also known as Vosos .

title: Architect genie
description: Architect genie Architect genies , also called builder genies , were special tasked genie s who were common in the Great Dismal Delve . They were also bound by sha ’ ir s in Zakhara to serve princes and lords . These genies were once dao but changed over time to suit their tasks .
description_long: Architect genie Architect genies , also called builder genies , were special tasked genie s who were common in the Great Dismal Delve . They were also bound by sha ’ ir s in Zakhara to serve princes and lords . These genies were once dao but changed over time to suit their tasks . The mystical stories told of cities springing up overnight were a direct result of the power of the architect genies . Description . These genies were bald and muscular . They usually had a brand of ownership on their hand or forehead . Combat . Architects could use the following spell - like abilities : " minor creation " , " vacancy " , " warp wood " , " stone shape " , " stone tell " , and " passwall " . Once per month they could use a " wish " related to building . These genies were masters at finding the weak points of any structure , making them deadly during a siege . Architects would only resort to combat as a final option , preferring to let others fight instead . These genies would defend their worksite if commanded , but would rarely fight beyond its walls . Habitat / Society . Their work was an architect ’ s reason for living ; their way to be remembered for all time .

title: Archive of Curiosities
description: Archive of Curiosities The Archive of Curiosities was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique gifts presented to the Grand Caliph and other treasures were displayed here for the public to see .
description_long: Archive of Curiosities The Archive of Curiosities was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique gifts presented to the Grand Caliph and other treasures were displayed here for the public to see . Some of the more interesting items included a pirate flag taken by the Grand Caliph himself during his adventuring days , a jade throne presented by the emperor of Shou Lung , a magical harp that played music on command , and a large tapestry depicting a king with a purple dragon on his shield . The Grand Caliph desperately wanted to add a genuine Halruaan skyship to his collection , and was willing to pay handsomely for the acquisition .

title: Archivist
description: Archivist The Archivist is a powerful divine spellcaster class . However , its method of spellcasting is more akin to that of a wizard than a cleric . It is a class representing the academic profession of collecting divine lore .
description_long: Archivist The Archivist is a powerful divine spellcaster class . However , its method of spellcasting is more akin to that of a wizard than a cleric . It is a class representing the academic profession of collecting divine lore . Alignment . Archivists are not tied to any aligned in the same way that a cleric is tied to their deity ' s alignment . They can follow whatever morals they choose in general but most are about the same alignment as their patron deity . Because of their scholarly approach , they tend to favor lawful alignments . Orders of Archivists in Faerûn . There are also significant numbers of archivists in the churches of Mystra and Azuth .

title: Archlich
description: Archlich Archliches were a type of lich that were good beings during their life . They can be of any type of spellcaster and devote their existence to whatever noble purpose motivated their transformation into lichdom . Basics .
description_long: Archlich Archliches were a type of lich that were good beings during their life . They can be of any type of spellcaster and devote their existence to whatever noble purpose motivated their transformation into lichdom . Basics . The method of becoming a archlich is nearly identical to becoming a lich . Unlike most other forms of undead creatures , the archlich retains all of the memories , personality , and abilities that it possessed in life - but it has a virtual eternity to hone its skills and inevitably becomes very powerful . Like other powerful forms of undead ( such as a vampire or mummy ) , an archlich has unnatural powers owing to his state . For example , they can put mortals in a paralyzed state of hibernation with a touch , making them seem dead to others . An archlich is capable of sustaining tremendous physical damage , and is immune to disease , poison , fatigue and other effects that affect only the living . However , despite all his undead " gifts " , an archlich ( like a lich ) counts his vast intellect , his supreme mastery of wizardry and limitless time to research and plan , as his greatest resources . Ecology .

title: Archmage
description: Archmage Archmage is a prestige class in Faerûn whose members are arcane magic users who have become experts at manipulating and altering their spell s often in strange ways . Most archmages are pure wizard s or sorcerer s , rarely multiclassing , so they may become masters in their study of magic . More generally , the term " archmage " may refer to any extremely powerful spellcaster such as Elminster Aumar or Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun .
description_long: Archmage Archmage is a prestige class in Faerûn whose members are arcane magic users who have become experts at manipulating and altering their spell s often in strange ways . Most archmages are pure wizard s or sorcerer s , rarely multiclassing , so they may become masters in their study of magic . More generally , the term " archmage " may refer to any extremely powerful spellcaster such as Elminster Aumar or Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Abilities . As archmages become more experienced they progress in their spellcasting ability as if done so through their primary arcane spellcasting class . For each level , the archmage also gains a high arcana ability . Each ability requires the archmage to give up a single spell slot from a certain level of spells he / she can cast .

title: Archmage ( novel )
description: Archmage ( novel ) Archmage by R . A . Salvatore is the first book of the Homecoming series , which follows the Companions Codex series .
description_long: Archmage ( novel ) Archmage by R . A . Salvatore is the first book of the Homecoming series , which follows the Companions Codex series . Summary . The story opens in the Abyss , where Lolth taunts the demon lord Balor , the chief rival of the demon lord Errtu . Lolth finally turns on Balor and traps him in her web . In Menzoberranzan , Archmage Gromph Baenre reveals the end of the War of the Silver Marches and the dispelling of the Darkening to Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre . Quenthel meditates on the solution to her spectacular failure on the surface . She sees a vision of Menzoberranzan in its early days , when demons roamed the streets . She believes it to be a vision brought to her by Lolth to solve her problems and bring chaos to the city — and thus security to her position . She begins summoning innumerable demons to the city , who cause chaos and destruction wherever they go . On the surface , Dark Arrow Keep is dismantled and Lorgru and the orc s of Many - Arrows are banished into the Spine of the World by the combined forces of the three dwarven kingdoms , the elves of the Glimmerwood , and the human s of the Silver Marches .

title: Archmage of Menzoberranzan
description: Archmage of Menzoberranzan The Archmage of Menzoberranzan was a title for the head of Sorcere in the fabled drow city . Activities . His role was to advise and serve the ruling Council , especially in devising magics for the defense of the city , and to help the inhabitants of the city keep track of time in the lightless Underdark by casting a lingering heat enchantment on Narbondel .
description_long: Archmage of Menzoberranzan The Archmage of Menzoberranzan was a title for the head of Sorcere in the fabled drow city . Activities . His role was to advise and serve the ruling Council , especially in devising magics for the defense of the city , and to help the inhabitants of the city keep track of time in the lightless Underdark by casting a lingering heat enchantment on Narbondel . This duty , incidentally , kept him tied to the city and under the watchful eye of its priestesses . History . The Archmage was almost always a wizard of House Baenre , who used their influence to ensure that one of their own occupied the position . Possessions . The Archmage of Menzoberranzan was known to possess a brooch allowing him to cast a lingering heat enchantment , an " amulet of eternal youth " , and an ornate , powerfully enchanted " piwafwi " .

title: Archtassel
description: Archtassel Archtassel was an unwalled " tassel " ( outsiders would call it a village ) of Tasseldale . Trade . Woodcutting and trapping were the usual trades in Archtassel .
description_long: Archtassel Archtassel was an unwalled " tassel " ( outsiders would call it a village ) of Tasseldale . Trade . Woodcutting and trapping were the usual trades in Archtassel . Brethyl fur — fox fur studded with " drops " of clear rock crystal — was produced here and sold in Sembia . The carvers here were famous for their relief - cut doors and wall panels .

title: Archwizard
description: Archwizard An archwizard was an arcane spellcaster . The first archwizard was Ioulaum of Netheril , who achieved this status when he created the first flying city in Faerûn , Xinlenal , through the use of a mythallar , another of Ioulaum ' s creations . The moment Xinlenal was afloat , every Netherese arcanist of sufficient power strove to make their own .
description_long: Archwizard An archwizard was an arcane spellcaster . The first archwizard was Ioulaum of Netheril , who achieved this status when he created the first flying city in Faerûn , Xinlenal , through the use of a mythallar , another of Ioulaum ' s creations . The moment Xinlenal was afloat , every Netherese arcanist of sufficient power strove to make their own . As a Prestige Class . An archwizard was an arcane spellcaster , almost invariably a wizard , who had their own city with a mythallar . In 1479 DR , only Thultanthar had an archwizard who met ancient Netheril ' s requirements . At this time , archwizards were known as archmages , with little or no relation to Netherese arcanists .

title: Arclath Delcastle
description: Arclath Delcastle Arclath Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the heir of House Delcastle . He was sometimes referred to derisively as the " Fragrant Flower of House Delcastle " , owing to his family ' s penchant for floral designs in their mansion . History .
description_long: Arclath Delcastle Arclath Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the heir of House Delcastle . He was sometimes referred to derisively as the " Fragrant Flower of House Delcastle " , owing to his family ' s penchant for floral designs in their mansion . History . Arclath spent his free time visiting various private clubs , especially those that featured mask dancers . In 1479 DR , at the Dragonriders Club , he fell in love with a mask dancer named Amarune Whitewave , who was Elminster ' s great - ( great ? ) - grandaughter . In the days prior to King Foril ' s Dragon Council , Arclath and Amarune blundered around Suzail , slowly uncovering a plot by Manshoon and his flunky Marlin Stormserpent to destroy Elminster and seize the crown for Manshoon . Later , they helped Elminster restore the Simbul to sanity . Relationships . Arclath had a frosty relationship with his mother , who seemed more interested in being pleasured by young men than in the family business . His father was a drunkard who cared for little more than drink . Arclath and Amarune became lovers . Initially , Arclath was extremely suspicious of Elminster , whom Amarune voluntarily allowed to possess her body .

title: Arcorar
description: Arcorar Arcorar , also known as the Great King Forest , was a large forest region that at one time included the realms / domains of Rystall Wood , Cormanthyr , Elven Court , Jhyrennstar , Semberholme and Uvaeren . Geography . At its largest extent , Arcorar stretched from west of Cormyr to east of the Moonsea .
description_long: Arcorar Arcorar , also known as the Great King Forest , was a large forest region that at one time included the realms / domains of Rystall Wood , Cormanthyr , Elven Court , Jhyrennstar , Semberholme and Uvaeren . Geography . At its largest extent , Arcorar stretched from west of Cormyr to east of the Moonsea . History . The forest was originally populated after the Crown Wars when the elves were spreading out looking for new unspoiled regions to settle . Over time , this forest broke up into smaller and smaller pieces until the name was no longer relevant , with the largest remaining fragment being Cormanthor .

title: Arctic circle
description: Arctic circle The arctic circle was a druid circle associated with the cold climate where glaciers formed and winters were harsh . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a climate had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Arctic circle The arctic circle was a druid circle associated with the cold climate where glaciers formed and winters were harsh . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a climate had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Arctic dwarf
description: Arctic dwarf Arctic dwarves , also known as Inugaakalikurit ( EE - nu - GA - ka - LEE - ku - rit ) , are a race of dwarves located in the isolated reaches of the Great Glacier in Faerûn ' s northernmost reaches . Arctic dwarves have a different origin than most of the other dwarves in Faerûn as well as the duergar , and are significantly different physiologically and culturally from other members of the Stout Folk , so much that they might be considered their own race . Arctic dwarves were almost entirely unheard of until relatively recent , when a group of them began settling the edges of Luruar a century ago .
description_long: Arctic dwarf Arctic dwarves , also known as Inugaakalikurit ( EE - nu - GA - ka - LEE - ku - rit ) , are a race of dwarves located in the isolated reaches of the Great Glacier in Faerûn ' s northernmost reaches . Arctic dwarves have a different origin than most of the other dwarves in Faerûn as well as the duergar , and are significantly different physiologically and culturally from other members of the Stout Folk , so much that they might be considered their own race . Arctic dwarves were almost entirely unheard of until relatively recent , when a group of them began settling the edges of Luruar a century ago . Ecology . Physical characteristics . Arctic dwarves are a very small race , not only in general but in comparison with dwarves as well . The average arctic dwarf is even shorter than a gnome or halfling , standing at just over half the height of a shield dwarf . Physically , arctic dwarves are squat , with pinched faces and stubby legs , being nearly as wide as they are tall with their fingers and toes thick and blunt and their feet flat and wide .

title: Arctigis
description: Arctigis Arctigis was a white dragon servant of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Zhengyi subdued Arctigis centuries ago when the wizard was still a living being .
description_long: Arctigis Arctigis was a white dragon servant of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Zhengyi subdued Arctigis centuries ago when the wizard was still a living being . In 1357 DR he was protecting the walls of Castle Perilous when Gareth Dragonsbane and his party infiltrated the castle . Personality . Arctigis was a cruel and vicious being , loving tormenting the weak . He truly enjoyed made the illusion for a captive to have a possibility to escape and after snatched that hope away . However Arctigis had learned to be cautious in the approach to powerful enemies . Relationship . In his twisted way Arctigis loved Zhengyi and he would do anything to avenge his death , no caring for himself ' s safety .

title: Arcturia
description: Arcturia Arcturia was a female half - fey human worm that walks and one of Halaster Blackcloak ' s apprentices , who were collectively known as the Seven . She resided in Arcturiadoom , deep in Undermountain . Description .
description_long: Arcturia Arcturia was a female half - fey human worm that walks and one of Halaster Blackcloak ' s apprentices , who were collectively known as the Seven . She resided in Arcturiadoom , deep in Undermountain . Description . Through much magical experimentation , Arcturia had transformed her human appearance into that of a half - fey , with sylph - like wings and fine scales of blue to protect her body . However , after her death during Halaster ' s Higharvestide , she was once more transformed through her carefully prepared contingency magic into a worm that walks . Her true form became one of a vile undead amalgamation of worms , though she would wear a mask to hide her inner appearance . Personality . Much like Murial , Arcturia ' s madness led her to experiment with bodies , both hers and others . Perhaps Halaster ' s most ambitious apprentice , she was known for her cruel experiments with polymorphing others to suit her whims . Since Arcturia ' s death and transformation into a worm that walks , she became far more measured in her activities and began to carefully plan and place contingencies for all eventualities . History .

title: Ardanac Harpell
description: Ardanac Harpell Ardanac Harpell was the chief family elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Personality . The son of Adanac Harpell , Ardanac was the only Harpell who could deal with the stress and headaches of the local politics or the doings of the world around them .
description_long: Ardanac Harpell Ardanac Harpell was the chief family elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Personality . The son of Adanac Harpell , Ardanac was the only Harpell who could deal with the stress and headaches of the local politics or the doings of the world around them . Relationships . The wizard was a member of the Lords ' Alliance . History . By 1358 DR , Ardanac lived in the Ivy Mansion , the Harpell ' s ancestral home , high on a hill in the center of Longsaddle .

title: Ardeep ( realm )
description: Ardeep ( realm ) Ardeep was a realm of moon elves , founded during the First Flowering around - 23600 DR . Geography . The realm of Ardeep encompassed the area later known as the Ardeep Forest as well as lands north of the River Delimbiyr .
description_long: Ardeep ( realm ) Ardeep was a realm of moon elves , founded during the First Flowering around - 23600 DR . Geography . The realm of Ardeep encompassed the area later known as the Ardeep Forest as well as lands north of the River Delimbiyr . History . Ardeep was a vassal state of Shantel Othreier at the beginning of the Crown Wars . At the conclusion of the Third Crown War in - 10600 DR , Shantel Othreier was conquered by Aryvandaar . Ardeep continued to battle against the forces of Aryvandaar until it was conquered in - 10460 DR . It took the next hundred years for Aryvandaar to gain complete control and two of Ardeep ' s rulers were slain : Ilitharath and his grandson , Tarosspur .

title: Ardeep Forest
description: Ardeep Forest The Ardeep Forest , also known as the Realm of the Deepening Moon and Faraway Forest , was a relatively small but thick woodland of blueleaf , duskwood and weirwood trees a few miles east of Waterdeep , on the south bank of the River Dessarin . Geography . Ardeep Forest contained a lot of ridges and steep gullies that were hidden beneath thick vines , dense shrubbery and cloaked in mists which could present a danger .
description_long: Ardeep Forest The Ardeep Forest , also known as the Realm of the Deepening Moon and Faraway Forest , was a relatively small but thick woodland of blueleaf , duskwood and weirwood trees a few miles east of Waterdeep , on the south bank of the River Dessarin . Geography . Ardeep Forest contained a lot of ridges and steep gullies that were hidden beneath thick vines , dense shrubbery and cloaked in mists which could present a danger . Thanks to the loamy ground , Ardeep Forest ' s vegetation was thick and healthy and aided the growth of mushroom s that glowed faintly . Visitors to Ardeep Forest either came to experience a truly untamed woodland or to seek secrecy . It was a place with sun - dappled paths and pleasant verges . Inhabitants . Ardeep Forest in 1372 DR , like most of the ancient forests of Faerûn , was a lot smaller than it used to be but it still contained large numbers of wild boar and a lot of deer . Eldreth Veluuthra . Traditionally , the Eldreth Veluuthra had been active in the forest . As of 1374 DR , two cells operated here , one hunting down worshipers of Eilistraee near the Dancing Dell and the Ladystone ; and the other guarding the ruins of Phalorm .

title: Ardeep River
description: Ardeep River The Ardeep River was a river in the Sword Coast North region , a few miles southeast of Waterdeep , between the River Dessarin and the River Delimbiyr . Geography . The river originated in the Ardeep Forest and flowed westward to the Sea of Swords , where it forked into three branches forming a small delta .
description_long: Ardeep River The Ardeep River was a river in the Sword Coast North region , a few miles southeast of Waterdeep , between the River Dessarin and the River Delimbiyr . Geography . The river originated in the Ardeep Forest and flowed westward to the Sea of Swords , where it forked into three branches forming a small delta . The northern branch was considered a continuation of the Ardeep River , while the central branch was a creek known as the Selpir and the southernmost branch was known as the South Ardeep River . Settlements . The fortified village of Nightstone was located on a fenced island on the Ardeep River , a few miles south of the Ardeep Forest . The river served as a moat to the village , and the area was rich with trout .

title: Ardenor Crush
description: Ardenor Crush Ardenor Crush was a reincarnated evil human fighter who appeared in the body of a hobgoblin . History . Crush was the founder of the Chill , a military organization for the purposes of gaining revenge on those who originally slew Ardenor .
description_long: Ardenor Crush Ardenor Crush was a reincarnated evil human fighter who appeared in the body of a hobgoblin . History . Crush was the founder of the Chill , a military organization for the purposes of gaining revenge on those who originally slew Ardenor . He was reincarnated by his friend and wizard , Grangor . Ardenor made an appearance in Tazok ' s bandit camp . The Chill had been hired along with the Blacktalons to disrupt trade and steal iron throughout the Baldur ' s Gate region as part of the Iron Throne ' s plans for gaining financial supremacy , and Ardenor and his men lived in uneasy coexistence with Taurgosz Khosann and his mercenaries . Equipment . Ardenor had " gauntlets of ogre power " and an amulet which allowed him to summon a nightmare .

title: Ardet Peytir
description: Ardet Peytir Ardet Peytir was a young socialite in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Ardet was one of the main opponents of the Liberators led by Aleyd Burral , saying that Mulmaster did not need a war against Phlan and could use those men in better ways .
description_long: Ardet Peytir Ardet Peytir was a young socialite in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Ardet was one of the main opponents of the Liberators led by Aleyd Burral , saying that Mulmaster did not need a war against Phlan and could use those men in better ways . For this he was kidnapped , and his mansion was destroyed by Aleyd and her brother Wylan Burral , who was secretly a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . He was eventually saved by an adventuring party hired by his cousin , Blade Cora Peytir , when she uncovered the truth and defeated Wylan and his minions . Activities . Ardet usually did nothing , instead existing on the money inherited from his dead father . He was a famous party habitué . Relationship . Ardet was the cousin of Blade Cora Peytir and Fedosia Peytir .

title: Ardred Briferhew
description: Ardred Briferhew Ardred Briferhew was a veteran caravan master just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Activities . Ardred worked for the High Road Charter Company with the role of managing the caravan traffic to points north of the city .
description_long: Ardred Briferhew Ardred Briferhew was a veteran caravan master just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Activities . Ardred worked for the High Road Charter Company with the role of managing the caravan traffic to points north of the city . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR Ardred led a great caravan that , unbeknownst to him , was full of agents of the Cult of the Dragon transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Ardreyth Mizzrym
description: Ardreyth Mizzrym Ardreyth Mizzrym was a drow woman and a former Matron Mother of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . One day during a hunt , she happened to swat a wingless wonder out of her way when it suddenly snarled and created a " meteor swarm " , obliterating her and most of her family in the area . As the dust cleared , the merely blackened wonder sighed and waddled away , as the remaining drow looked on in shock .
description_long: Ardreyth Mizzrym Ardreyth Mizzrym was a drow woman and a former Matron Mother of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . One day during a hunt , she happened to swat a wingless wonder out of her way when it suddenly snarled and created a " meteor swarm " , obliterating her and most of her family in the area . As the dust cleared , the merely blackened wonder sighed and waddled away , as the remaining drow looked on in shock .

title: Ardulace Despana
description: Ardulace Despana Matron Mother Ardulace was a powerful drow cleric and the head of the Ust Natha branch of house Despana . She formed an alliance with Jon Irenicus with the intent of attacking the elves of Suldanessellar . Using the eggs of the silver dragon Adalon given to her by Irenicus , she was to buy the services of a powerful demon to lead the attack .
description_long: Ardulace Despana Matron Mother Ardulace was a powerful drow cleric and the head of the Ust Natha branch of house Despana . She formed an alliance with Jon Irenicus with the intent of attacking the elves of Suldanessellar . Using the eggs of the silver dragon Adalon given to her by Irenicus , she was to buy the services of a powerful demon to lead the attack . However , her own daughter Phaere conspired ( unsurprisingly ) to murder her and take her place as matron mother . In , Adalon will try to recruit the player character to infiltrate Ust Natha ( disguised as drow ) and retrieve her eggs . To do this , they must first show their ability by performing a number of tasks , after which they are brought to meet Ardulace . She will charge them with retrieving the blood of the leaders of one of the powerful rivals of the drow in the area - either kuo - toa , illithid or beholder s . This will be used in summoning the demon . Phaere will ask the player character to steal the real eggs and replace them with fakes , so that she might be the one making the deal with the demon ; it is also possible to give her another set of fakes , provided by Solaufein .

title: Ardulrae Melarn
description: Ardulrae Melarn Ardulrae Melarn was a member of House Melarn and Matron of Scriptures of Arach - Tinilith in 1479 DR . History . Ardulrae was the third daughter of Kyrnill Melarn and thanks to the strength of the new House Melarn she rose through the ranks of the Arach - Tinilith instructors .
description_long: Ardulrae Melarn Ardulrae Melarn was a member of House Melarn and Matron of Scriptures of Arach - Tinilith in 1479 DR . History . Ardulrae was the third daughter of Kyrnill Melarn and thanks to the strength of the new House Melarn she rose through the ranks of the Arach - Tinilith instructors . Ardulrae ' s main objective was actually to take total control of the school for her house . Her spies constantly moved among the halls , hoping to unveil the secrets of Ardulrae ' s rivals .

title: Arellaxerrontoal
description: Arellaxerrontoal Arellaxerrontoal was an bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Amn and Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Arellaxerrontoal was a bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir in her mate in the past ; at one point the blue dragon great wyrm Iryklathagra killed her mate .
description_long: Arellaxerrontoal Arellaxerrontoal was an bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Amn and Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Arellaxerrontoal was a bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir in her mate in the past ; at one point the blue dragon great wyrm Iryklathagra killed her mate . For long time she was consumed by revenge . Arellaxerrontoal ' s work for the Moonstars alleviated her pains . Personality . Arellaxerrontoal believe that the unity of humanity and elves that the Moonstars hope to achieve can bring the demise of all evil dragons , like the killer of their mate .

title: Arena of Blood
description: Arena of Blood The infamous Arenas of Blood , also known as the Blood Arenas , were a pair of identical gladiatorial arenas located in the city of Manshaka in Calimshan . Location . One of the Arenas was located in the northeastern drudach of the northwestern sabban of the city ; the other was found in the southern drudach ( south of Drudach Street ) of the northeastern sabban .
description_long: Arena of Blood The infamous Arenas of Blood , also known as the Blood Arenas , were a pair of identical gladiatorial arenas located in the city of Manshaka in Calimshan . Location . One of the Arenas was located in the northeastern drudach of the northwestern sabban of the city ; the other was found in the southern drudach ( south of Drudach Street ) of the northeastern sabban . Description . The Arenas were large , circular structures , walled all around and with two levels of stands for spectators . The high walls around the arena bore banners and circular emblems depicting downward - pointing daggers . Huge gates led down to the dungeons beneath . Defenses . Beneath each Arena was a labyrinth of passages and tunnels intended to prevent escape , in addition to 100 guards . These dungeons were such a maze that it took the gladiator Vajra two years to memorize them before she made good her escape . Since that time , by 1357 DR , a blue dragon was kept in the dungeons as a guardian , though it was slain that year . Activities . As of 1370 DR , each Blood Arena held five shows per day for three " djenayin " per show or one " djenarba " for the whole day .

title: Arena of War ( game )
description: Arena of War ( game ) Dungeons & Dragons : Arena of War is a video game , an application for various pad and tablet devices . It is a supplement to the Second Sundering event and you take on the part of a “ Chosen ” of a non specific good deity and struggles to rid the realms of the blight of evil that spreads its influence . The Plot .
description_long: Arena of War ( game ) Dungeons & Dragons : Arena of War is a video game , an application for various pad and tablet devices . It is a supplement to the Second Sundering event and you take on the part of a “ Chosen ” of a non specific good deity and struggles to rid the realms of the blight of evil that spreads its influence . The Plot . Baldur ' s Gate . The game starts out with the introduction of Isteval , a Paladin of Lathander . He instructs the adventurers in game play and explains the point of each mission . The first story arc focuses upon the area surrounding Baldur ' s Gate . The adventurer must first defeat the kobold King Opak and his army which are trying to take over Beregost . The next quest takes place in Durlag ' s Tower . A group of mind flayer s are attempting to infiltrate the Tower to gain its secrets . Next is an investigation into the local Thieves ’ Guild of Baldur ' s Gate concerning a sequence of murders . The assassins are chased into the sewers , where they seek the aid of a beholder ally . After defeating the beholder , the adventurer is then summoned to the Wood of Sharp Teeth to stop organized attacks by goblin s , worg s , and human bandits .

title: Arganth Snarrl
description: Arganth Snarrl Arganth Snarrl was an orc shaman for the orc king Obould Many - Arrows . He was kidnapped and then killed by Innovindil in 1370 DR . Appearances .
description_long: Arganth Snarrl Arganth Snarrl was an orc shaman for the orc king Obould Many - Arrows . He was kidnapped and then killed by Innovindil in 1370 DR . Appearances . Arganth Snarrl appeared in " The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy " by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Argath
description: Argath Argath was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . History . Argath was originally a scoundrel from a settlement near Silverymoon .
description_long: Argath Argath was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . History . Argath was originally a scoundrel from a settlement near Silverymoon . After being banished from his home , he joined the Howling Hatred . In 1491 DR , he acted as the cult ' s liaison and the supervisor of the bugbear chieftain Hrar , in Damara near the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Eventually , an adventuring party hired for a mission at the monastery were convinced by sergeant Sergor to fight Hrar and his minions , and Argath also was killed .

title: Argent Legion
description: Argent Legion The Argent Legion was the state army of Luruar . Activities . Formed in an attempt to ensure the safety of the smaller settlements of Luruar , the Argent Legion ' s forces were drawn from the various armies maintained by the more powerful city - states of that nation .
description_long: Argent Legion The Argent Legion was the state army of Luruar . Activities . Formed in an attempt to ensure the safety of the smaller settlements of Luruar , the Argent Legion ' s forces were drawn from the various armies maintained by the more powerful city - states of that nation . Its purpose is to patrol Luruar ' s territory and garrison its settlements . Base of Operations . Based in Rauvinwatch Keep , which stood roughly 15 miles west of Silverymoon , the legion maintained a force of 400 troops ( mostly dwarves ) who spent their time either training or going out on patrols with the Knights in Silver . The other half of the Legion were stationed in or around Citadel Felbarr ( 100 dwarves , 100 Knights in Silver ) and Sundabar ( 200 soldiers ) , which had both seen heavy fighting prior to the formation of the Legion . A force of 50 Legionnaires were also stationed in Jalanthar as it was a frequent target for orc and Uthgardt raids . Membership . Any member of Luruar ' s various official state military forces could be transferred into the Legion .

title: Argent Palace
description: Argent Palace The Argent Palace was Graz ' zt ' s personal home in the city of Zelatar . Structure . The palace was composed of sixty - six ivory towers and scores and scores of mirrored hallways .
description_long: Argent Palace The Argent Palace was Graz ' zt ' s personal home in the city of Zelatar . Structure . The palace was composed of sixty - six ivory towers and scores and scores of mirrored hallways . The cold but meticulous hallways were filled with wandering bodaks and other more malevolent abyssal denizens as part of the demon lord ' s amusements . Woe to those residents of Zelatar who received an invitation to an audience with Graz ' zt in his palace ! Inhabitants . From his palace , Graz ' zt planned and schemed his intricate plots to gain more power while thwarting his enemies .

title: Argentor
description: Argentor Argentor was a village of earthsoul genasi located in southern Tethyr within the Mir Spires . Description . The village ' s dwellings were hollowed out from the spires by the genasi using their innate ability to shape rock .
description_long: Argentor Argentor was a village of earthsoul genasi located in southern Tethyr within the Mir Spires . Description . The village ' s dwellings were hollowed out from the spires by the genasi using their innate ability to shape rock . History . In 1479 DR , Argentor was attacked by minotaur s sent by the ruler of Calimport to abduct his long lost son , Cephas , who was traveling with a circus giving a performance at the village .

title: Arglander River
description: Arglander River The Arglander River was one of the major sources of the Deepwash . Geography . The river was located within Ahlarkhem Barony in Erlkazar .
description_long: Arglander River The Arglander River was one of the major sources of the Deepwash . Geography . The river was located within Ahlarkhem Barony in Erlkazar . It flowed down from the tallest of the High Peaks of the Cloven Mountains into the Deepwash . The river had many cascades and rapids , making it extremely difficult to cross . The only exception was at the Shadebridge .

title: Arglath
description: Arglath Arglath was a massive elder orb beholder from Ooltul , presumed to be alive in 1370 DR . History . Arglath was a beholder of monstrous size from Ooltul , and one of the mightiest beholders to escape the city ' s destruction .
description_long: Arglath Arglath was a massive elder orb beholder from Ooltul , presumed to be alive in 1370 DR . History . Arglath was a beholder of monstrous size from Ooltul , and one of the mightiest beholders to escape the city ' s destruction . At one point , it tried to conquer the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale but was destroyed by Elminster Aumar . Afterward , from time to time , Elminster disguised himself as Arglath , aided by the fact that nobody else knew of the death of the elder orb . In that role , Elminster foiled Manshoon ' s plot to take over Zhentil Keep and received in exchange a list of true name s of powerful beings , including the phaerimm Triumvirate ruling Ooltul .

title: Argrum Blackspear
description: Argrum Blackspear Argrum Blackspear was a bandit leader in Tethyr in 1358 DR who preyed upon the Trade Way . He once clashed with the Company of Eight . He tried to gather all bandit leaders of the area to form an alliance , hoping to also attract the Company of Eight so that he could eliminate them .
description_long: Argrum Blackspear Argrum Blackspear was a bandit leader in Tethyr in 1358 DR who preyed upon the Trade Way . He once clashed with the Company of Eight . He tried to gather all bandit leaders of the area to form an alliance , hoping to also attract the Company of Eight so that he could eliminate them . He had a knack for organization , which made him a good leader .

title: Argul
description: Argul Argul was a ruined castle located in northern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Argul was built by dragonborn slaves to serve as a lair for the dragon lord Argularragh .
description_long: Argul Argul was a ruined castle located in northern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Argul was built by dragonborn slaves to serve as a lair for the dragon lord Argularragh . Over time , people named the castle after the dragon . When Argularragh vanished without a trace , other Eskornar dragon lords razed the castle to stole whatever wealth Argularragh had hoarded within its lair and to ate its dragonborn inhabitants .

title: Argul Marammas
description: Argul Marammas Argul Marammas was a wizard who lived in Suzail in 1367 DR . Personality . Most people , warriors especially , were little more than lumbering fools who destroyed everything they could get their hands on .
description_long: Argul Marammas Argul Marammas was a wizard who lived in Suzail in 1367 DR . Personality . Most people , warriors especially , were little more than lumbering fools who destroyed everything they could get their hands on . Argus ' condescending attitude kept many mages from his company . Activities . Argus spent most of his time researching exotics planes of existence and spells involving personal protection . In order to fund his research , and his expensive taste in exotic dining , Argus sold scolls containing one to three spells . These scrolls sold for 5 , 000 gp per spell . Rumors and Legends . Eager to learn more about the planes , Argus was always interested in speaking with planar travelers .

title: Argularragh
description: Argularragh Argularragh was a dragon who lived in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Argularragh was a massive dragon , even by dragon standards .
description_long: Argularragh Argularragh was a dragon who lived in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Argularragh was a massive dragon , even by dragon standards . History . Argularragh was the ruler of the castle of Argul , in Eskorn , where it lorded over a commune of dragonborn slaves . However , one day Argularragh simply vanished without a trace . Most of the other Eskornar dragon lords believed Argularragh was killed by a rival during a sea battle and its body was lost in the waters , but a few of them believed that Argularragh was either trapped inside a magical item , or that the dragon learned how to change shape and went to live its remaining days as a member of another race . The few individuals who believed this tale , also believed Argularragh was still alive as of 1479 DR .

title: Argus Treader
description: Argus Treader The Argus Treader was a Gontese merchant ship owned by Captain Madwave of Szant . Background . The " Argus Treader " was one of the few Gontese ships that didn ' t belong to the Twelvefold .
description_long: Argus Treader The Argus Treader was a Gontese merchant ship owned by Captain Madwave of Szant . Background . The " Argus Treader " was one of the few Gontese ships that didn ' t belong to the Twelvefold . It was famous across Returned Abeir as the ship that never had lost either crew or cargo .

title: Argust Coppernight
description: Argust Coppernight Argust Coppernight was a dwarf in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went into Undermountain in search of locations for mining .
description_long: Argust Coppernight Argust Coppernight was a dwarf in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went into Undermountain in search of locations for mining . However , he was captured by the goblin and kobold followers of the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr . Zarr plucked out the dwarf ' s eyes for giving him an insolent look . Argust remained shocked and distraught , refusing to move .

title: Arhymeria Ithal
description: Arhymeria Ithal Queen Arhymeria Ithal was the wife of King Nishan Ithal II of Tethyr . Description . Arhymeria was an exquisitely beautiful Calishite woman and also a loving and compassionate one .
description_long: Arhymeria Ithal Queen Arhymeria Ithal was the wife of King Nishan Ithal II of Tethyr . Description . Arhymeria was an exquisitely beautiful Calishite woman and also a loving and compassionate one . Abilities . She was a wizard , a student of Princess Rhynda Ithal and a better one than her grandfather ever was . She was the creator of the royal artifact known as Arhymeria ' s Dagger , and she also developed several peaceful and fun spells . Family . Arhymeria was born Arhymeria yr Una el Shoon , the youngest daughter of Akkabar Shoon the Elder ' s oldest son and Una el Shoon , making her a granddaughter of Akkabar Shoon . She had an older brother , Akkabar , and a younger brother , Amahl . Her nephew , through Akkabar the Younger , was Amahl Shoon II . She gave birth to three sons and two daughters . Her third son Clovis ' descendants lived in exile until the fall of the Shoon Imperium . Relationships . Arhymeria was happily married to Nishan . She had little contact with her Calishite family , with the exception of her younger brother Amahl . History .

title: Aria of peace
description: Aria of peace Aria of peace was a powerful enchantment spell used to stop hostile interactions . Effects . This spell created soothing melodies of different instruments within the area of effect around the caster .
description_long: Aria of peace Aria of peace was a powerful enchantment spell used to stop hostile interactions . Effects . This spell created soothing melodies of different instruments within the area of effect around the caster . Listeners who were charmed by these sounds ceased all violent activities . The tunes could be kept up by the caster through concentration and then lasted some time longer , giving the caster the chance to settle the situation with more permanent means . Components . This spell required verbal components only . History . " Aria of peace " was the most powerful of the " magics of sight and sound " collected by Faerûn ian master bard Morion in his special spellbook . It saw widespread use within Zakhara , but had a different name there . Possibly the spell was invented in the Land of Fate . Users . " Aria of peace " was generally eschewed by evil spellcasters due to its nature .

title: Ariana
description: Ariana Ariana was a deep gnome merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Ariana was a gem merchant in Gracklstugh .
description_long: Ariana Ariana was a deep gnome merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Ariana was a gem merchant in Gracklstugh . During the Rage of Demons , her duergar business partner was arrested and executed for selling stolen jewelry . She tried to find smugglers near the city ' s gate to sell her goods .

title: Ariana Riverlost
description: Ariana Riverlost Ariana Riverlost was a wizard member of the Harpers in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ariana and her two half - elven scout companions Elifar and Lorendil were sent to the Halls of the Hunting Axe in order to stop Gargosh Blusterhelm from reclaiming the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " .
description_long: Ariana Riverlost Ariana Riverlost was a wizard member of the Harpers in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ariana and her two half - elven scout companions Elifar and Lorendil were sent to the Halls of the Hunting Axe in order to stop Gargosh Blusterhelm from reclaiming the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " . Somehow , the adventurers hired by Gargosh resolved the matter .

title: Aribeth ' s ring
description: Aribeth ' s ring Aribeth ' s ring was a magical ring that provided its wearer with resistance to spells . It was worth around 50 , 000 gold piece s . This ring was the family heirloom of Aribeth de Tylmarande , an elven paladin of Tyr , but it was lost when she was defeated in combat in Neverwinter in 1372 DR .
description_long: Aribeth ' s ring Aribeth ' s ring was a magical ring that provided its wearer with resistance to spells . It was worth around 50 , 000 gold piece s . This ring was the family heirloom of Aribeth de Tylmarande , an elven paladin of Tyr , but it was lost when she was defeated in combat in Neverwinter in 1372 DR .

title: Aribeth de Tylmarande
description: Aribeth de Tylmarande Lady Aribeth de Tylmarande was a half - elf paladin of Tyr , the Blind God of Justice . Biography . She is said to have been born in Thundertree , a town in the Neverwinter Woods , of uncertain parentage ; some say a union between half - elves , others a moon elf and a human .
description_long: Aribeth de Tylmarande Lady Aribeth de Tylmarande was a half - elf paladin of Tyr , the Blind God of Justice . Biography . She is said to have been born in Thundertree , a town in the Neverwinter Woods , of uncertain parentage ; some say a union between half - elves , others a moon elf and a human . The village ' s population was wiped out in an orc raid leaving her the sole survivor of the massacre . Vowing vengeance , she hunted down the perpetrators and slew them all . Unsatisfied , she continued to hunt and kill orcs in an obsessive quest until she was trapped in a sudden blizzard and rescued by a one - armed man she believed to be an avatar of the god Tyr , who took her to a monastery of Ilmater . Recovering her health there , she learned to be a paladin , gaining such fame that when she moved to Neverwinter , she was named to the elite bodyguard of Lord Nasher Alagondar , being the first woman and first non - human to be so honored . There she met and became engaged to Fenthick Moss , a cleric of Tyr in the Hall of Justice . Neverwinter Nights . Lady Aribeth was chosen by Nasher Alagondar to be in charge of the investigations surrounding the Wailing Death .

title: Ariella Kulmina
description: Ariella Kulmina Ariella Kulmina was a Windsoul genasi swordmage from Airspur . In 1479 DR she travelled with a delegation from Akanûl to Almraiven . While in Almraiven she became friends with the Earthsoul genasi Cephas and taught him how to manifest as a Windsoul .
description_long: Ariella Kulmina Ariella Kulmina was a Windsoul genasi swordmage from Airspur . In 1479 DR she travelled with a delegation from Akanûl to Almraiven . While in Almraiven she became friends with the Earthsoul genasi Cephas and taught him how to manifest as a Windsoul . Appearance . Like many Windsouls , Ariella has silver skin .

title: Arietta Seasilver
description: Arietta Seasilver Arietta Seasilver was the daughter of Farninger Seasilver , grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . She believed herself to be a Chosen of Siamorphe , the goddess of nobility and the patron deity of her family . Activities .
description_long: Arietta Seasilver Arietta Seasilver was the daughter of Farninger Seasilver , grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . She believed herself to be a Chosen of Siamorphe , the goddess of nobility and the patron deity of her family . Activities . When the shadovar armies attacked Cormyr , Arietta escaped Marsember with Kleef Kenric , paladin follower of the dead god Helm , and two Chosen , Malik el Sami , follower of Cyric , and Joelle Emmeline , follower of Sune . The two Chosen had a mission from their gods to take the Eye of Gruumsh to the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple in the Underchasm . Arietta decided to help them , believing herself to be a fellow Chosen . Arietta grew close to both Joelle and Kleef . She became a true Chosen of Siamorphe . With the sacrifice of Joelle in order to fulfill the mission , Arietta started a romantic relationship with Kleef .

title: Arik Stillmarsh
description: Arik Stillmarsh Arik Stillmarsh was a vampire hid in the Bargewright Inn sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arik hid in the inn thank of the protection of Nalaskur Thaelond of the Zhentarim .
description_long: Arik Stillmarsh Arik Stillmarsh was a vampire hid in the Bargewright Inn sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arik hid in the inn thank of the protection of Nalaskur Thaelond of the Zhentarim . In exchange Nalaskur used Arik to dispose of unwanted guests . On hoers times he preyed upon travelers on the Long Road and poor people of the Wormford village .

title: Arilyn ' s moonblade
description: Arilyn ' s moonblade Arilyn ' s moonblade was the hereditary moonblade wielded by Arilyn Moonblade , having been passed to her by her mother , Princess Amnestria of Evermeet . Description . The sword and its hilt appeared antique .
description_long: Arilyn ' s moonblade Arilyn ' s moonblade was the hereditary moonblade wielded by Arilyn Moonblade , having been passed to her by her mother , Princess Amnestria of Evermeet . Description . The sword and its hilt appeared antique . After Amnestria left Evermeet , the moonstone in the hilt was removed and replaced by a modernly cut topaz stone . That was how Arilyn carried it for many decades . However , the original moonstone was restored to the sword in 1361 DR . There was Espruar writing on the sword , as well as wards to protect the runes against translation spells . All in all , there were nine runes on the sword , each one indicating an ability of the sword that the wielder had given it . Arilyn wielded the sword with two hands . . Abilities . Like other moonblades , Arilyn ' s moonblade burned anyone who attempted to touch the sword , and potentially killed anyone who attempted to wield the blade . However , in 1361 DR Arilyn placed a rune on the sword that removed this restriction so that others could touch the sword if needed . The sword would not shed innocent blood .

title: Arilyn Moonblade
description: Arilyn Moonblade Arilyn Moonblade was a half - elf assassin and Harper originally from Evereska . Description . Like most half - elves , her ears were pointed and she retained her youthful appearance and vitality even into middle age .
description_long: Arilyn Moonblade Arilyn Moonblade was a half - elf assassin and Harper originally from Evereska . Description . Like most half - elves , her ears were pointed and she retained her youthful appearance and vitality even into middle age . Her eyes were blue , flecked with gold , and she had a more human build than elvish , though her skin was still quite fair . She had black hair and a hint of blue beneath her skin and generally looked more like an elf rather than a half - elf . She was 5 ' 9 " tall . In 1361 DR , around her fourth decade of life , Arilyn appeared 20 years of age , as reckoned by a human . Arilyn typical travel outfit included boots , trousers , a dark cloak , and a simple blue tunic over a loose shirt . However , she was very skilled at disguises . Aided by her moonblade , she could take on a number of disguises : a Sembia n courtesan , a street waif , and a cleric of Mielikki . Personality . Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun described Arilyn as hot - headed , stubborn , and independent . She had an aversion to magic , especially teleportation and magical fire ( due to having witnessed the incineration of the Hammerfell Seven ) . She disliked cooking . History .

title: Arin el Sujil
description: Arin el Sujil Sultan Arin yn Kahar el Sujil was the official ruler of Memnon in Calimshan in 1370 DR . In truth , the real power lay with his advisers and the pasha s . Personality .
description_long: Arin el Sujil Sultan Arin yn Kahar el Sujil was the official ruler of Memnon in Calimshan in 1370 DR . In truth , the real power lay with his advisers and the pasha s . Personality . Arin el Sujil was arrogant and paranoid with little power . His vizars kept him in power for show . Activities . Technically , Arin controlled the city ' s fishing , ship building , tavern , and wheelwright trades . History . The only reason Arin was a sultan was because of a political deal arranged by his father Kahar el Sujil .

title: Arina
description: Arina Arina was a merfolk princess in Myth Nantar . History . Arina was a member od the merfolk Homurr clan and seven in line of succession to the throne of Eadraal .
description_long: Arina Arina was a merfolk princess in Myth Nantar . History . Arina was a member od the merfolk Homurr clan and seven in line of succession to the throne of Eadraal . She born in 1354 DR from king Vhaemas . In her early life nobody cared for this a spitfire of a mermaid . During the Twelfth Serôs War at the Battle for Voalidru however Arina suddenly summoned a pod of whales saving her wounded father . The whales that followed her were decisive at the final battle in Myth Nantar against Iakhovas . After the war she was choose as her people ' s rappresentative inside the Nantarn Council . Arina found herself very good in this work and she also helped her elder brother in matters of state while Voalidru remained in monstrous hands . In her free time Arina teach merfolk song to the whale s learning from them their ones . Powers . As member of the bloodline of Selana she can communicated with fish and mammal creatures . Personality . Despite most saw her as a leading figure in Serôs , Arina was interesed only to became a noted bard

title: Ariser Creed
description: Ariser Creed The Ariser Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They sought to dominate the surface world . They believed that the best way to obtain exclusive knowledge was by attacking knowledge storehouses on the surface .
description_long: Ariser Creed The Ariser Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They sought to dominate the surface world . They believed that the best way to obtain exclusive knowledge was by attacking knowledge storehouses on the surface . For many years , the Arisers wished to plunder Candlekeep . Bases . The Arisers had a base called the Darkened Vault in Oryndoll . It was a minor faction in the city , unlike in other illithid hives . This Creed also founded a colony at Tellectus , with the aim of stealing from Candlekeep .

title: Aristocrat
description: Aristocrat " Aristocrat " was a general term for a member of the wealthy and educated upper class . The rulers of most nations , or those holding some other form of political power , were often aristocrats . Training and Education .
description_long: Aristocrat " Aristocrat " was a general term for a member of the wealthy and educated upper class . The rulers of most nations , or those holding some other form of political power , were often aristocrats . Training and Education . Usually , one was born into the role of aristocrat , although in some cases , such as former adventurers who became nobility later in life , individuals would learn the ways of the aristocracy and become members of this class . Because of their wealth , aristocrats had access to the best schooling and training , and so they could become exceptionally skilled in the fields of their choice . Outlook .
