Most members of this class were strong - willed individuals . Abilities . The aristocratic upper class was typically trained in the use of and and shield s and in the wearing of , even though their roles in society did not usually involve combat . Notable Aristocrats . Several famous persons in the Realms were trained specifically as aristocrats ; among them were :

title: Ariton Delmis
description: Ariton Delmis Ariton Delmis was a male human paladin and second - in - command of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . History . Ariton was a longtime member of the Riders , fighting the Zhentarim together with Randal Morn for a very long time .
description_long: Ariton Delmis Ariton Delmis was a male human paladin and second - in - command of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . History . Ariton was a longtime member of the Riders , fighting the Zhentarim together with Randal Morn for a very long time . In 1369 DR , he was the second - in - command of the group and the leader of the cavalry . He was the only survivor on an ambush in which Randal was kidnapped by the Zhent s . Afterward , he keep control of the Riders and , with the help of Elminster Aumar and Lhaeo , recruited some adventurers to find his leader . Ariton commanded the last battle against the invaders in Dagger Falls and afterward he welcomed Randal back to the freed dale .

title: Arkaiun
description: Arkaiun The Arkaiun were a human ethnic group residing primarily in Dambrath but also in Halruaa and the Shaar . Arkaiun culture was formed through the interbreeding of Nar refugees from Shandaular and Illuskan tribes . As of 1374 DR , the Dambrathan Arkaiuns lived as servitors of the half - drow Crinti .
description_long: Arkaiun The Arkaiun were a human ethnic group residing primarily in Dambrath but also in Halruaa and the Shaar . Arkaiun culture was formed through the interbreeding of Nar refugees from Shandaular and Illuskan tribes . As of 1374 DR , the Dambrathan Arkaiuns lived as servitors of the half - drow Crinti . Society . Arkaiuns living in Dambrath were considered second - class citizens and often worked at manual labor . Outside Dambrath some traditional Arkaiuns continued to live a nomadic lifestyle . Religion . In 1374 DR , Arkaiuns in Dambrath were forced to worship Loviatar or Lloth . Those living outside Dambrath often worshipped Tempus and sometimes Malar . History . The Arkaiuns could trace their origins to the fall of Shandaular in the far north in - 946 DR . Refugees from the city fled through a portal to the Council Hills area in the Shaar . Their king , Arkaius the Archmage , remained behind to close the portal and it is from Arkaius that they take their name . For serveral centuries , the Arkaiuns roamed the Council Hills region , interbreeding with a lost tribe of Illuskans .

title: Arkaneus Silvermane
description: Arkaneus Silvermane Arkaneus Silvermane was Archdruid of Mosstone and a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Abilities . Arkaneus knew how to fight with hammer , dagger , and staff .
description_long: Arkaneus Silvermane Arkaneus Silvermane was Archdruid of Mosstone and a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Abilities . Arkaneus knew how to fight with hammer , dagger , and staff . He could ride horses and knew healing techniques and how to tell the weather . Arkaneus was a polyglot , speaking a large number of languages , including such rare languages as the tongue of manticore s and several dialects of Sylvan . He was one of the most powerful members of the Company of Eight . Personality . Despite his great druidic powers , Arkaneus always adopted a low profile , rarely intervening during heated discussion between his companions . His patience extended to all areas of life . He had never maintained a single absolute point of view of things but changed according to facts , being a cool and rational decision - maker without emotional attachment . Arkaneus believed his service in the Company was a means to confer balance to the chaos of his country . Relationships . Arkaneus was attended by three apprentice druids , the married couple Leisha and Thastrun , who were devoted to the care of Cayr Thalwood , and Manfred Arbustle , who in 1357 DR joined the Company .

title: Arkaras
description: Arkaras Arkaras is a very tall bearded man who maintains a fierce expression . He is a shipwright operating out of the eastern side of the harbour at Scornubel , and he maintains the ships that operate in the area , including owning the ferry that crosses from Scornubel to the south bank of the River Chionthar .
description_long: Arkaras Arkaras is a very tall bearded man who maintains a fierce expression . He is a shipwright operating out of the eastern side of the harbour at Scornubel , and he maintains the ships that operate in the area , including owning the ferry that crosses from Scornubel to the south bank of the River Chionthar .

title: Arkas
description: Arkas Arkas was a grass found on the fields of the ranchos in Dambrath . Uses . This hearty grass was used as feed for local livestock .
description_long: Arkas Arkas was a grass found on the fields of the ranchos in Dambrath . Uses . This hearty grass was used as feed for local livestock . Description . Blades of arkas could grow between 3 to 4 ft . ( 0 . 9 – 1 . 2 m ) tall .

title: Arkhelthingril
description: Arkhelthingril Arkhelthingril ( also known as Ice ) was an old female white dragon who was transformed into a dracolich by the archmage of Maerimydra , Duneth Wharreil . Description . About 20 - ft - long ( 6 m ) , Ice ' s form had not fared well since its transformation into a dracolich and her flesh had rotted to the point where her bones were visible .
description_long: Arkhelthingril Arkhelthingril ( also known as Ice ) was an old female white dragon who was transformed into a dracolich by the archmage of Maerimydra , Duneth Wharreil . Description . About 20 - ft - long ( 6 m ) , Ice ' s form had not fared well since its transformation into a dracolich and her flesh had rotted to the point where her bones were visible . Personality . Arkhelthingril was a manipulative and patient example of her kind . When dealing with others she was coldly calculating and would often try to seek to bargain something out of them , trading information and even her co - operation depending on the prize offered . She had the same avarice as other dragon s and was even willing to subject herself to the dangerous experiments of Duneth Wharreil in order to acquire great wealth . Despite being transformed into a dracolich , she was a cautious creature , and preferred to observe and avoid her foes until she was sure she could overwhelm them . She would even take time to administer coup de grace ' s on her foes , if she could . Abilities . As a white dragon of some age , Arkhelthingril could expel a 50 - ft ( 15 .

title: Arkhen ' s Invocatorium
description: Arkhen ' s Invocatorium Arkhen ' s Invocatorium was a college of magic in Silverymoon that specialized in sorcery . The school was run by Arkhen the Icy , and was part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . The Invocatorium was once situated in a stone fortress on the east side of Silverymoon , but later moved into an entirely new building , filled with animated construct s .
description_long: Arkhen ' s Invocatorium Arkhen ' s Invocatorium was a college of magic in Silverymoon that specialized in sorcery . The school was run by Arkhen the Icy , and was part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . The Invocatorium was once situated in a stone fortress on the east side of Silverymoon , but later moved into an entirely new building , filled with animated construct s .

title: Arklem Greeth
description: Arklem Greeth Arklem Greeth was a powerful lich and Archmage Arcane of the Arcane Brotherhood . History . After spending many years attempting to extend his lifespan through the aid of " Wish " spells and other powerful magics his body was eventually wracked with age .
description_long: Arklem Greeth Arklem Greeth was a powerful lich and Archmage Arcane of the Arcane Brotherhood . History . After spending many years attempting to extend his lifespan through the aid of " Wish " spells and other powerful magics his body was eventually wracked with age . Arklem had spent much of that long life seeking the secrets of Faerûn ' s powerful magic . Plumbing the depths of far - flung lands such as Mulhorand , Thay , Zakhara and even Kara - Tur he eventually came to believe that one with such vast knowledge and power was destined to rule . After an attempted coup on his position in 1371 DR by the talented Eldeluc and Valkebar , killing Arklem ' s top lieutenant Queltar Thaeloon in the process , Arklem fled the Host Tower . During this period Nyphithys the Erinyes visited him and offered him the secrets of Lichdom in exchange for the Arcane Brotherhoods conquest of the fledgling Silver Marches . A deal which Arklem gladly agreed to . Following his transformation , a devastating coup of the Host tower with the help of his new devil ish allies began , setting Arklem back up as the undisputed master of the Arcane Botherhood and Luskan itself . Fall of the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Arktash
description: Arktash Arktash was an orc chieftain of the Il - Khan tribe that made its home in the Spine of the World , around the 14th century DR . Personality . While a mighty warrior in their own right , Arktash obtained their position as leader of the Il - Khan tribe through guile , not strength .
description_long: Arktash Arktash was an orc chieftain of the Il - Khan tribe that made its home in the Spine of the World , around the 14th century DR . Personality . While a mighty warrior in their own right , Arktash obtained their position as leader of the Il - Khan tribe through guile , not strength . Arktash was an intelligent and shrewd leader . History . Less than a year into Arktash ' s reign , the orc chieftain was slain by rivals . These usurpers felt Arktash had shown disrespect by not claiming power through force . Legacy . As a child , the blackguard Dorn Il - Khan greatly admired Arktash . He later used the fallen chieftain ' s story as a cautionary tale in conversation with the Bhaalspawn known as Gorion ' s Ward . Appendix . Arktash ' s gender is not defined in " " , as the game files simply alter the orc chieftain ' s gender to match that of the player character .

title: Arkuel
description: Arkuel Arkuel was a member of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In 1357 , Arkuel was one of the servants of the the Cult ' s archmage , Malark Himbruel , helping his master to enter the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale in order to capture Shandril Shessair .
description_long: Arkuel Arkuel was a member of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In 1357 , Arkuel was one of the servants of the the Cult ' s archmage , Malark Himbruel , helping his master to enter the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale in order to capture Shandril Shessair .

title: Arlaenga
description: Arlaenga Arlaenga was one of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Arlaenga was the head maid for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , her master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .
description_long: Arlaenga Arlaenga was one of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Arlaenga was the head maid for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , her master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel . She decided to use Arlaenga and the other servants as her own . Arlaenga hoped to show her loyalty to the new masters by spying on things she found suspicious .

title: Arlen
description: Arlen Arlen was the captain of the guard at Caer Corwell and the teacher of Prince Tristan Kendrick . Description . Arlen was a gruff old war veteran .
description_long: Arlen Arlen was the captain of the guard at Caer Corwell and the teacher of Prince Tristan Kendrick . Description . Arlen was a gruff old war veteran . Personality . While training Prince Kendrick , Arlen had the youth run across the moors for exercise . History . Death . Arlen died in 1345 DR while fighting a group of firbolg s in Llaryth Forest .

title: Arleon
description: Arleon Arleon , also known as Arleon the Unforgiven , was a powerful ogre warlord living in Neverwinter in ancient times . History . Arleon was a powerful warrior who in life killed many strong opponents .
description_long: Arleon Arleon , also known as Arleon the Unforgiven , was a powerful ogre warlord living in Neverwinter in ancient times . History . Arleon was a powerful warrior who in life killed many strong opponents . He was killed only by the combined efforts of ten valorous heroes . In 1484 DR , the emissary Xivros , a Red Wizard of Thay under Valindra Shadowmantle , decided to raise him as an undead to guide Valindra ' s undead army in the conquest of the city . Xivros succeeded in his ritual and Arleon the Unforgiven became a wight . However , soon after an adventurer sent by Sergeant Knox to stop the plot arrived and fought and defeated the ogre wight .

title: Arleosa Starhenge
description: Arleosa Starhenge Arleosa Starhenge was a tavern owner in Amphail sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Born in a wild magic area , Arleosa received the innate power to cast the " alter self " spell three times a day .
description_long: Arleosa Starhenge Arleosa Starhenge was a tavern owner in Amphail sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Born in a wild magic area , Arleosa received the innate power to cast the " alter self " spell three times a day . Using this power , she joined a carnival and traveled a lot . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , she settled in Amphail where she managed the Stag - Horned Flagon tavern .

title: Arlho ' s Fine Flasks
description: Arlho ' s Fine Flasks Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was an exceptional brewery and winery located in Ashabenford . Location . Situated on the north of the Moonsea Ride as it passed through Ashabenford , Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was one of many shops dotting the route .
description_long: Arlho ' s Fine Flasks Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was an exceptional brewery and winery located in Ashabenford . Location . Situated on the north of the Moonsea Ride as it passed through Ashabenford , Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was one of many shops dotting the route . Services . Selling ales and wines of quality rivalling those found in Cormyr , Sembia or The Vast , Arlho ' s drinks were quickly snatched up by many travelling merchants . However he was known to manage the production of his goods so that local Mistrans were never without drink . Of particular note was Arlho ' s Ashaben Ale and the proudly recommended Black Boot Stout or the green grape wine , Pearls of the Moon .

title: Arlith
description: Arlith Arlith was a halfling rogue living in Ravens Bluff in 1479 DR . She was a member of an adventuring group known as the Blue Wyvern Company . In a fight , she preferred to use ranged weapons rather than melee attacks and was proficient in the use of the crossbow .
description_long: Arlith Arlith was a halfling rogue living in Ravens Bluff in 1479 DR . She was a member of an adventuring group known as the Blue Wyvern Company . In a fight , she preferred to use ranged weapons rather than melee attacks and was proficient in the use of the crossbow . Arlith participated in the company ' s foray into the ancient dwarven city of Sarbreen to recover the Sarkenaegal tome . Description . Arlith had reddish hair .

title: Armas
description: Armas Armas was a half - elf sorcerer and a Chosen . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Armas was one of the associates of Oota .
description_long: Armas Armas was a half - elf sorcerer and a Chosen . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Armas was one of the associates of Oota . History . In 1486 DR , Armas helped Dahl Peredur and Tharra and introduced them to the eladrin Cereon . Later , Dahl discovered he was a Chosen .

title: Armor of Agathys
description: Armor of Agathys Armor of Agathys was a complex spell learned and used by young or inexperienced warlock s . Effect . When " Armor of Agathys " is cast , it creates a layer of thick , black ice around the body of its caster , adding to their vitality for several minutes and injuring enemies who draw too near with its frigid power , the deadliness of the ice depending upon the durability of the warlock .
description_long: Armor of Agathys Armor of Agathys was a complex spell learned and used by young or inexperienced warlock s . Effect . When " Armor of Agathys " is cast , it creates a layer of thick , black ice around the body of its caster , adding to their vitality for several minutes and injuring enemies who draw too near with its frigid power , the deadliness of the ice depending upon the durability of the warlock . " Armor of Agathys " draws heavily on a warlock ' s power and it can only be cast once per day . After the Sundering warlocks could cast it any number of times according to ability . Stronger Spell . If used within higher spell levels , the damage and vitality is amplified . Components . A cup of water .

title: Armor of concealed wizardry
description: Armor of concealed wizardry Armors of concealed wizardry were special suits of armor whose enchantments were hidden from magical detection . Shields also fell into this group . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate .
description_long: Armor of concealed wizardry Armors of concealed wizardry were special suits of armor whose enchantments were hidden from magical detection . Shields also fell into this group . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . The magic of these items prevented spells such as " detect magic " , " legend lore " , and " identify " from revealing the magical nature of the armor or shield in question , including whether or not the armor was even magical . Rawun s and barber s were able to use their special skills to determine the basic magical nature of these items .

title: Armor of darkness
description: Armor of darkness Armor of darkness was an abjuration spell exclusive to cleric s with the Darkness domain . It armored the subject with shadow . Effect .
description_long: Armor of darkness Armor of darkness was an abjuration spell exclusive to cleric s with the Darkness domain . It armored the subject with shadow . Effect . The spell enveloped the warded creature in a shroud of flickering shadows . The shroud could , if the caster desired , conceal the wearer ' s features . In any case , it granted the subject protection vs . attacks . The subject could see through the armor as if it did not exist and was also afforded darkvision . Finally , the subject gained a slight resistance against any holy , good , or light spells or effects . Undead creatures that were subjects of " armor of darkness " also gained turn resistance . History . " Armor of Darkness " was first known to the Nightcloak priests of Shar in Netheril . It remained a secret of the clergy of Shar for centuries . However , by 1372 DR , the clerics of Lolth , Mask , Set , and Shargass had gained knowledge and use of this spell .

title: Armor of swimming
description: Armor of swimming Armor of swimming was a magical armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This armor looked like regular lamellar armor .
description_long: Armor of swimming Armor of swimming was a magical armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This armor looked like regular lamellar armor . Powers . Wearers of this armor could move about in water as if they were unencumbered . This armor did not grant the ability to swim to someone who did not already know how to swim .

title: Armor of the desert evening
description: Armor of the desert evening Armor of the desert evening was a magical suit of armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magical armor was made using lamellar armor .
description_long: Armor of the desert evening Armor of the desert evening was a magical suit of armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magical armor was made using lamellar armor . Powers . Though it did not grant the wearer any additional protection compared to regular lamellar armor , the armor of the desert evening could be worn in the heat of the desert without causing any kind of additional discomfort to the wearer as other armor would when heated under the fierce burning sun . It should be noted that this armor did not protect the wearer from dehydration or sun exposure . Instead , it did not increase these effects as other armor would .

title: Armories ( Oryndoll )
description: Armories ( Oryndoll ) The Armories of the illithid city of Oryndoll were located all throughout the city . They stored weapons and armor that were needed to equip an army of thralls . They were heavily guarded in the event of another thrall uprising .
description_long: Armories ( Oryndoll ) The Armories of the illithid city of Oryndoll were located all throughout the city . They stored weapons and armor that were needed to equip an army of thralls . They were heavily guarded in the event of another thrall uprising . Most tzakand i under the control of the Tamer Creed were stationed in barracks around the arenas that lay at the core of each armory .

title: Arms of Hadar
description: Arms of Hadar Arms of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . At the caster ' s behest , the ground would sprout tendrils of dark energy in a 10 - foot ( 3 meter ) radius .
description_long: Arms of Hadar Arms of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . At the caster ' s behest , the ground would sprout tendrils of dark energy in a 10 - foot ( 3 meter ) radius . They would swing at the creatures in the area and harm them with their necrotic energies and hinder them . Only a test of strength would lessen the harm and not cause the creature to be hindered . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components .

title: Army of Darkness
description: Army of Darkness The Army of Darkness was a massive force of nearly 60 , 000 yugoloth s , ogre s , gnoll s , goblinoid s and several giant s . They were led by the Trio Nefarious who organized the monsters into tightly regimented battalions , which made it the biggest army ( seeing as a horde , some examples of which rival the Army ' s numbers , has very little structure ) that Faerûn has ever seen . It took twenty - nine months for the army ' s forces to be gathered .
description_long: Army of Darkness The Army of Darkness was a massive force of nearly 60 , 000 yugoloth s , ogre s , gnoll s , goblinoid s and several giant s . They were led by the Trio Nefarious who organized the monsters into tightly regimented battalions , which made it the biggest army ( seeing as a horde , some examples of which rival the Army ' s numbers , has very little structure ) that Faerûn has ever seen . It took twenty - nine months for the army ' s forces to be gathered . Aulmpiter was leader and tactician , Malimshaer was head scout , saboteur and spy while Gaulguth was field commander . Organization . Each nycaloth had five battalions under their command ( except Aulmpiter , who had six ) . Each battalion was led by a summoned mezzoloth general who each led 5 regiments of troops . These 80 regiments were each led by colonels who were either the chieftains of the larger tribes who now made up the warriors in said regiment or more summoned mezzoloths . Under the colonels were the majors who tended to be the chiefs of the smaller tribes .

title: Army of Gold
description: Army of Gold The Army of Gold was the name of the expedition of gold dwarves that set out from the Great Rift to reclaim the glory of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Gold entered into the War of Gold and Gloom with the gray dwarves of the Underspires around 1369 DR .
description_long: Army of Gold The Army of Gold was the name of the expedition of gold dwarves that set out from the Great Rift to reclaim the glory of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Gold entered into the War of Gold and Gloom with the gray dwarves of the Underspires around 1369 DR . As of 1372 DR , the fighting between the Army of Steel and the Army of Gold still raged .

title: Army of Steel
description: Army of Steel Army of Steel was the name for the duergar army from Underspires that clashed with the Army of Gold in the caverns of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Steel fought the gold dwarves from the Deep Realm around 1369 DR in the War of Gold and Gloom .
description_long: Army of Steel Army of Steel was the name for the duergar army from Underspires that clashed with the Army of Gold in the caverns of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Steel fought the gold dwarves from the Deep Realm around 1369 DR in the War of Gold and Gloom . As of 1372 DR , the fighting between the Army of Steel and the Army of Gold still raged .

title: Army of the Black Spider
description: Army of the Black Spider The Army of the Black Spider was an army put together by the noble houses of Menzoberranzan to defeat the approaching armies of Gracklstugh ( joined by Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion ) in 1372 DR during the Silence of Lolth . Description . The Army of the Black Spider was composed of soldiers from all great houses , as well as sixteen minor ones .
description_long: Army of the Black Spider The Army of the Black Spider was an army put together by the noble houses of Menzoberranzan to defeat the approaching armies of Gracklstugh ( joined by Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion ) in 1372 DR during the Silence of Lolth . Description . The Army of the Black Spider was composed of soldiers from all great houses , as well as sixteen minor ones . There were 30 commanding high priestesses , 4 , 000 drow soldiers , and 2 , 500 slaves . After the first battle , a fourth to a third of the army had been lost . House Baenre had 90 dead and 44 wounded — more than a quarter of their strength . House Barrison Del ' Armgo lost a quarter of their forces and all of their wagon trains . Base . The army mustered in a plaza near the border of the West Wall and Narbondellyn districts in Menzoberranzan . History . At the end of 1372 DR , during the Silence of Lolth when the city ' s priestesses were greatly weakened , the forces of Gracklstugh , driven by Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin , moved to attack Menzoberranzan .

title: Army of the Lion
description: Army of the Lion The Army of the Lion was a subsection of the Aglarond an army stationed at the fortress Emmech ( later Undumor ) and tasked with the defence of the nation against the threat from Thay through the Tannath Gap . In 1374 DR it was led by Lord Gante Demelin . Its battle wizards were led by Canton Karlesad , while the Aglarondan griffonrider s were led by Captain Araevil Darkeye .
description_long: Army of the Lion The Army of the Lion was a subsection of the Aglarond an army stationed at the fortress Emmech ( later Undumor ) and tasked with the defence of the nation against the threat from Thay through the Tannath Gap . In 1374 DR it was led by Lord Gante Demelin . Its battle wizards were led by Canton Karlesad , while the Aglarondan griffonrider s were led by Captain Araevil Darkeye . A special detachment of the army was assigned to guard the ruler of Emmech at the time : Lady Mantelia Parsuns .

title: Arn Forest
description: Arn Forest The Arn Forest was a forest on the edge of the Silver Marches . Description . The Arn Forest was an area of pine forests and swamps , which did not see many visitors .
description_long: Arn Forest The Arn Forest was a forest on the edge of the Silver Marches . Description . The Arn Forest was an area of pine forests and swamps , which did not see many visitors . On the edge of the forest stood Graevelwood , a small hidden settlement of rock gnome s . The western area of the forest was very rainy and marshy , unlike the eastern side . It was infested by several bands of kobold s and various ruins could be found inside that dated back to the ancient empire of Netheril . Geography . It was located south of Ascore between Anauroch and the Nether Mountains . Flora . The eastern region of the forest had .

title: Arnagus
description: Arnagus Arnagus the Shipwright was the wealthiest shipbuilder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Arnagus was a strong and vital man .
description_long: Arnagus Arnagus the Shipwright was the wealthiest shipbuilder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Arnagus was a strong and vital man . He was truly friendly with all people that he met but often had few words to say , even to friends he knew for years . Activities . As a shipbuilder with a great reputation , Arnagus was very influential in the Order of Master Shipwrights . He was also an able handler and trader . For his profound knowledge about the city ' s docks , he often helped the City Watch with crimes that happened in the port .

title: Arnglar
description: Arnglar Arnglar is a sleepy hill village in the west of the Border Kingdoms , situated not far from where the River Rith and Tumblestone River originate . It is a windswept site suited to pastoral grazing and the location was once the elven realm of Glorfindral . Arnglarren is the name given to an inhabitant of Arnglar .
description_long: Arnglar Arnglar is a sleepy hill village in the west of the Border Kingdoms , situated not far from where the River Rith and Tumblestone River originate . It is a windswept site suited to pastoral grazing and the location was once the elven realm of Glorfindral . Arnglarren is the name given to an inhabitant of Arnglar . Environment . Unlike many other parts of the Border Kingdoms ( see the Garden Coast ) , Arnglar ' s high elevation exposes it to the elements , making it difficult to grow crops that are not protected . Arnglar is home to shepherds who keep flocks on the hillsides . The burial mounds of the elven kings of Glorfindral form a ring around the village . The water supply is crystal - clear and comes from a deep well which has never run dry . Government , Trade and Religion . Arnglar is ruled by the Circle of Elders , a council of nine of the village ' s most influential people , including the village blacksmith Harneth Breldren . The village is generally unfriendly to visitors but will trade wool , tallow candles or mutton sausages . It favors lone or small groups of merchants to large , well - armed bands .

title: Arno and Julian
description: Arno and Julian Arno and Julian were the two heads of a single being , the origin of the ettin race . Relatives . Arno and Julian were the two heads of one of Annam All - Father ' s sons .
description_long: Arno and Julian Arno and Julian were the two heads of a single being , the origin of the ettin race . Relatives . Arno and Julian were the two heads of one of Annam All - Father ' s sons . History . Arno was killed by Tavis Burdun with a rune - arrow when the firbolg attacked their camp . Julian was able to yell the magical word required to make what would have been his death shot explode before Tavis could fire , seriously wounding Tavis . He was later killed by Princess Brianna of Hartwick .

title: Arphoind Bleth I
description: Arphoind Bleth I Arphoind Bleth was the child of Mondar Bleth and his wife , born in 8 DR or 10 DR . Arphoind was the first man knighted by Faerlthann . Relatives .
description_long: Arphoind Bleth I Arphoind Bleth was the child of Mondar Bleth and his wife , born in 8 DR or 10 DR . Arphoind was the first man knighted by Faerlthann . Relatives . Arphoind ' s father was Mondar Bleth . He was the youngest sibling , his other having died whilst giving birth . Over 1300 years later , another member of the Bleth family was given the name Arphoind . Arphoind Bleth II eventually became the head of the merchant family .

title: Arquiuius
description: Arquiuius Arquiuius was a wizard in Thay . History . Arquiuius was a reclusive wizard who took as apprentice the young orphan Halloran .
description_long: Arquiuius Arquiuius was a wizard in Thay . History . Arquiuius was a reclusive wizard who took as apprentice the young orphan Halloran . Around 1351 DR , he tried a very difficult summoning spell that went wrong . The summoned monster broke free and killed Arquiuius and destroyed his tower while Halloran escaped .

title: Arrabar
description: Arrabar Arrabar was the capital city of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . History . By 1372 DR , the empire of Chondath was much shrunken .
description_long: Arrabar Arrabar was the capital city of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . History . By 1372 DR , the empire of Chondath was much shrunken . Government . Around 1372 DR , Lord Eles Wianar ruled from his palace known as the Generon . Trade . At a key location in the Vilhon Reach , Arrabar stood at the end of two key trade roads : the southern Golden Road and the Emerald Way that ran across Chondath and ended at Hlath . These made the city a center for Vilhon trade , and kept it wealthy . Industry . The people of Arrabar largely engaged in trade , crafting , and fishing , as well as mercenary work as part of mercenary companies . These included both private armies that were permanently stationed in the capital and companies that were only based in the city and rested there between assignments in other lands . Among these were the Sapphire Crescent . Military . Thanks to mercenaries , Arrabar was quite strong militarily , and it could pose a threat in any land . Description . The city was ancient and sprawling , though the people kept it tidy , clean , and maintained . The grandest structure in Arrabar was the Generon , the palace of the Lord of Arrabar .

title: Arrath Vir
description: Arrath Vir Rath is a dwarven monk who lived in Waterdeep in the late 1470 ' s DR . Rath ' s true name is Arrath Vir but he is known to nearly everyone simply as Rath . He despises dwarven culture and has turned his back on his people and his gods .
description_long: Arrath Vir Rath is a dwarven monk who lived in Waterdeep in the late 1470 ' s DR . Rath ' s true name is Arrath Vir but he is known to nearly everyone simply as Rath . He despises dwarven culture and has turned his back on his people and his gods . Description . Rath wears his face clean shaven which is very unusual for a dwarf and often causes other dwarves to challenge him . He is very handsome for a dwarf and fastidious about his appearance . One side of his face was severely burned by Ilira Nathalan but Rath had it partially healed . Rath wears a heavy black robe at all times . Abilities . Rath is an expert at unarmed combat and is able to move with preternatural speed and grace . He carries a light blade of masterwork quality , which he refuses to use against all but the most worthy of opponents . History . Rath left his clan at an early age and trained at a monastery deep under a mountain . Once he learned all he could he slew his masters and travelled to Waterdeep where he began working as an agent for Lilten , the high priest of Beshaba .

title: Arrayan Faylin
description: Arrayan Faylin Arrayan Faylin is a female half - orc wizard living in Palischuk in the northeastern region of Vaasa . Her full name being Arrayan Faylin Maggotsweeper . Appearance .
description_long: Arrayan Faylin Arrayan Faylin is a female half - orc wizard living in Palischuk in the northeastern region of Vaasa . Her full name being Arrayan Faylin Maggotsweeper . Appearance . Arrayan ' s appearance favors the human half of her heritage - her features combine the most attractive qualities of all her racial aspects . Her reddish - brown hair is long and soft , flowing as if her face is framed by a soft red halo . She is short , like many orcs , but because of her elven blood , Arrayan was far from stocky with delicate shoulders . Her face is orclike wide but set with un - orclike large emerald green eyes , thick lips , narrow angled eyebrows and a button nose . She is in her mid - twenties . She often wears leather breeches and a vest , and a thin belt with several pouches for her spell components , as well as a set of writing components . Sometimes she dons a blue robe of light material over her clothes , held together at her waist by the belt . History . Arrayan received one of Zhengyi ' s writings from her uncle to study .

title: Arren
description: Arren Arren was a male human butler of Lord Temar on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Arren was Lord Temar ' s butler , who assisted him .
description_long: Arren Arren was a male human butler of Lord Temar on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Arren was Lord Temar ' s butler , who assisted him . History . If the Kalach - Cha and companions accepted Sir Nevalle ' s quest , they needed to visit Lord Temar . Arren would lead them to Lord Temar , then come to Temar ' s assistance to attack the Kalach - Cha soon after .

title: Arrizz
description: Arrizz Arrizz was a drow elf in the Moonsea . History . Arrizz lived as a member of a drow noble house very far from the Moonsea until he betrayed his house and struck out on his own .
description_long: Arrizz Arrizz was a drow elf in the Moonsea . History . Arrizz lived as a member of a drow noble house very far from the Moonsea until he betrayed his house and struck out on his own . He escaped pursuit by bounty hunters in the Underdark until he reached Moonsea . Near Cormanthor , Arrizz met the moon elf scout Deriel Rethslane and the two fell in love . During the Rage of Demons , Arrizz was pursued by duergar bounty hunters and contracted the darkborne rot illness . So he hid near the Goodroot farm . Unfortunately , he infected the half - elf farmers , and they died . Soon after , the farmer ' s daughter , Constance Goodroot , found him but a patrol of Red Plumes arrived to retrieve the red dye that the Goodroots produced from the beet juice harvested on the farm , as well as some adventurers and even two duergar bounty hunters . Later , Arrizz was saved from his illness but was captured by the Red Plumes and destined to go to the Hillsfar Arena . His lover Deriel negotiated an exchange for him : she would delivered to them worthy fighters and they would release Arrizz .

title: Arrk
description: Arrk Arrk was a well - known troll mercenary who operated in the Lake of Steam region in 1372 DR . Personality . While he was smaller than normal trolls , Arrk was a bit more intelligent ( though still possessing a quite short attention span ) and dependable .
description_long: Arrk Arrk was a well - known troll mercenary who operated in the Lake of Steam region in 1372 DR . Personality . While he was smaller than normal trolls , Arrk was a bit more intelligent ( though still possessing a quite short attention span ) and dependable . Arrk had a disturbing habit of licking his sword , which was cursed to continually bleed , whenever he was nervous or bored . He also had poor , trollish hygiene . Background . Arrk was born to a troll tribe at the Neth Stand . As he was somewhat diminutive within his tribe , Arrk was often a victim of their cruelty and fought to survive until he eventually chose to leave . After stumbling across and joining a group of bandits , he discovered a true knack for the work . However , finding the compensation of looting to be less than he wished , Arrk began working in a mercenary company . In this role , he was quite successful and became well known around the Lake of Steam area , though not popular . Activities . Arrk worked for anyone who had the money , provided the job didn ' t take more than a tenday , as he soon grew distracted and irritated with the company of other people .

title: Arrow
description: Arrow Arrows were a type of projectile , fired by bows . A normal arrow consisted of a shaft with an arrowhead attached to the front end , with fletchings and a nock at the other . Some arrows were enchanted in some way so they could deal larger damage , dispel , blind or silence their target .
description_long: Arrow Arrows were a type of projectile , fired by bows . A normal arrow consisted of a shaft with an arrowhead attached to the front end , with fletchings and a nock at the other . Some arrows were enchanted in some way so they could deal larger damage , dispel , blind or silence their target .

title: Arrow catching
description: Arrow catching Arrow catching shield s are useful defensive items , as they provide an added level of protection against ranged weaponry to the wielder and his or her allies . Creation . To enchant a shield with the " arrow catching " property , the enchanter must have the spell " entropic shield " available .
description_long: Arrow catching Arrow catching shield s are useful defensive items , as they provide an added level of protection against ranged weaponry to the wielder and his or her allies . Creation . To enchant a shield with the " arrow catching " property , the enchanter must have the spell " entropic shield " available . Activation . The wearer of an " arrow catching shield " can activate or deactivate the property with a command word . An " arrow catching shield " grants the wielder an additional level of defense against ranged attacks . Also , any projectile or thrown weapon that passes within 5 feet of the wearer bends in its flight path and targets the wearer instead . ( This does not hold true if the wearer is under total cover relative to the attacker , or if the projectile or thrown weapon has a higher enhancement bonus than the shield in question . ) The latter effect does have a downside , however . Though they may not do damage , diverted ranged attacks are far more likely to hit an activated " arrow catching shield " .

title: Arrow demon
description: Arrow demon Arrow demons were valued tanar ' ri made specifically to fight in the armies of the Abyss . Description . Emaciated but possessing unnatural strength for its frame , an arrow demon ' s body is also completely hairless .
description_long: Arrow demon Arrow demons were valued tanar ' ri made specifically to fight in the armies of the Abyss . Description . Emaciated but possessing unnatural strength for its frame , an arrow demon ' s body is also completely hairless . Its gray skin feels like cured leather but also has a strange wetness to the touch . Otherwise humanoid , an arrow demon ' s remarkable feature is its four arms , with which it can wield two large longbow s expertly despite being not much taller than an above average human . Combat . Arrow demons are fielded by their commanders in large units where they do what they do best and rain huge numbers of large arrows down on their foes . They are often shielded from melee combat by masses of demonic fodder , allowing them to concentrate on firing off as many shots as they can . When in smaller groups , arrow demons make extensive use of their ability to cast " Dimension door " to maximise their damage potential while minimizing the wounds they suffer .

title: Arrowhawk
description: Arrowhawk An arrowhawk was a creature from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Arrowhawks had four wings and four eyes ( one pair on either side of its beak ) .
description_long: Arrowhawk An arrowhawk was a creature from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Arrowhawks had four wings and four eyes ( one pair on either side of its beak ) . They were covered in blue scales with the occasional tuft of yellow feathers . Adults ( 11 – 40 years old ) were about 10 feet ( 3 meters ) long with a wingspan of 15 feet ( 4 . 6 meters ) . Adults weighed about 100 lbs ( 45 kg ) . Ecology . Arrowhawks were able to fly as soon as they hatched and the majority spent their entire lives in the air without ever setting down . Their ability to levitate aided them in flight . Combat . An arrowhawk had the ability to fire an electricity ray at its enemies .

title: Arsekaslyx
description: Arsekaslyx Arsekaslyx was a red dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . She was called to the Well of Dragons to reinforce the defense of the Cult ' s stronghold there . Relationship .
description_long: Arsekaslyx Arsekaslyx was a red dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . She was called to the Well of Dragons to reinforce the defense of the Cult ' s stronghold there . Relationship . Arsekaslyx enjoyed playing with the Cult ' s commanders in the Well ; she kept her presence secret from Naergoth Bladelord to avoid a confrontation for power . On the other hand , she tempted Vargo Kent with the secret of becoming a half - dragon dracolich . History . In order to retain her sanity during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR , she used an artifact called the " bone scepter of Zceryll , known as the " the star - spawn " , which protected her from the Rage ' s effects but also warped her physiology . She arrived at the Well of Dragons in around 1373 DR and remained there until at least 1479 DR .

title: Artblade
description: Artblade The Artblade ( also known as the Noble Sorcerer ' s Sword , or Ary ' Faern ' Kerym in Elven ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Spell - Major , the Defender by Art , as he is called . The wielder of the Artblade is responsible for the upkeep of magical defenses of the realm , and command of the Akh ' Faer , the arcane arm of the military .
description_long: Artblade The Artblade ( also known as the Noble Sorcerer ' s Sword , or Ary ' Faern ' Kerym in Elven ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Spell - Major , the Defender by Art , as he is called . The wielder of the Artblade is responsible for the upkeep of magical defenses of the realm , and command of the Akh ' Faer , the arcane arm of the military . Characteristics . The Artblade , like others of its type , shares some common characteristics with its kin ( see Elfblade ) , but also has its own special powers , described here . The blade appears as if made of darkness , and its shape is a tangible black void , outlined in a crimson streak which is the source of the blade ' s light . It cackles like lightning when drawn , and creates a sharp buzzing sound when swung , like that of an angry bee . Oddly , when the blade strikes a foe , there is no sound from the hit , despite the strength behind it . An elven rune near the pommel signifies a thing of magic . The Artblade like all of the elfblades has a bladerite , a test of character given by the blade itself .

title: Artemis Entreri
description: Artemis Entreri Artemis Entreri ( once known as Barrabus the Gray ) was a ruthless assassin and the former arch - nemesis of Drizzt Do ' Urden . A cunning and tactical assassin , Entreri lived an empty life , devoid of any kind of pleasure , existing only to kill . The passage of time caused him to soften his sentiments , but never his fighting edge .
description_long: Artemis Entreri Artemis Entreri ( once known as Barrabus the Gray ) was a ruthless assassin and the former arch - nemesis of Drizzt Do ' Urden . A cunning and tactical assassin , Entreri lived an empty life , devoid of any kind of pleasure , existing only to kill . The passage of time caused him to soften his sentiments , but never his fighting edge . He was credited with being one of the most feared and effective assassins in Faerûn . Description . Artemis Entreri was not very tall ( in fact , considered " small " ) but he was compact with wiry muscles . He was possessed of angular features , striking high cheekbones , and prominent sideburns . Though he was usually clean - shaven , Artemis always seemed to need a shave . He had brown skin , which was later tinged with a grayish hue . His raven - black hair was thick and full , but his eyes were gray and lifeless , portraying the emptiness of his life and his soul . When he was about 40 years old , Artemis had the lean athleticism of a man half his age . While traveling with the drow elf Jarlaxle , Artemis was often seen wearing a small - brimmed black hat called a bolero .

title: Arthagus
description: Arthagus Arthagus , called " Arthagus of the Miracles " , was a mage living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Arthagus was a skilled invoker who spent much of his time tutoring young spellcasters to fund his extensive research projects .
description_long: Arthagus Arthagus , called " Arthagus of the Miracles " , was a mage living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Arthagus was a skilled invoker who spent much of his time tutoring young spellcasters to fund his extensive research projects . He was known to aid the rulers of Sembia from time to time , usually by spreading false rumors with expertise . Possessions . Arthagus owned many protective magic items including an " onyx dog " .

title: Arthindol
description: Arthindol The Terraseer was originally a powerful ancient sarrukh lord who eventually became a lich and thereby survived the downfall of the ancient progenitor race . He dwelt , ever since , in the ruins of ancient Oreme , rarely interacting with the outside world . Most notably he served as a source of ancient arcane knowledge for the Netherese Empire .
description_long: Arthindol The Terraseer was originally a powerful ancient sarrukh lord who eventually became a lich and thereby survived the downfall of the ancient progenitor race . He dwelt , ever since , in the ruins of ancient Oreme , rarely interacting with the outside world . Most notably he served as a source of ancient arcane knowledge for the Netherese Empire .

title: Arthus Cavilos
description: Arthus Cavilos Arthus Cavilos was the Lord of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Cavilos , a veteran of War of the Silver Marches , raised hippogriff s .
description_long: Arthus Cavilos Arthus Cavilos was the Lord of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Cavilos , a veteran of War of the Silver Marches , raised hippogriff s . He was also a member of the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Arthylmas
description: Arthylmas Arthylmas was a sage of the city of Saerloon in Sembia of the 13th century DR . History . In the late 13th century DR , Kesten Orthalin of the Grimblades adventuring company had Arthylmas identify a short sword that had come into his possession .
description_long: Arthylmas Arthylmas was a sage of the city of Saerloon in Sembia of the 13th century DR . History . In the late 13th century DR , Kesten Orthalin of the Grimblades adventuring company had Arthylmas identify a short sword that had come into his possession . Arthylmas discovered it to be " Sarghathuld " , a legendary relic of Roldilar and Impiltur , and lost since the Year of the Luminar Procession , 1127 DR , a century and a half before .

title: Artifact
description: Artifact An artifact was a type of magic item of exceptional power that could not be reproduced using normal magical means . Artifacts created through spiritual means were sometimes called relics . This diverse category included the works of the great civilizations of old , such as Netheril , as well as the many magical creations of deities .
description_long: Artifact An artifact was a type of magic item of exceptional power that could not be reproduced using normal magical means . Artifacts created through spiritual means were sometimes called relics . This diverse category included the works of the great civilizations of old , such as Netheril , as well as the many magical creations of deities . Major artifacts . Major artifacts were usually creations of the gods themselves or at the very least brought into existence through never - before attempted magical exertion or a powerful phenomenon .

title: Artificer
description: Artificer Artificers are a rare kind of arcane spellcaster who treat magic in the same manner as a mason might see a chisel - as a tool for the creation of marvels . An artificer learns to wield his or her magic through the mastering of sigils and diagrams that they etch into that which they enchant , as well as magical ingredients . Artificers infuse objects of the world , be they inanimate or alive , with the power of the arcane , making them both powerful crafters and healers .
description_long: Artificer Artificers are a rare kind of arcane spellcaster who treat magic in the same manner as a mason might see a chisel - as a tool for the creation of marvels . An artificer learns to wield his or her magic through the mastering of sigils and diagrams that they etch into that which they enchant , as well as magical ingredients . Artificers infuse objects of the world , be they inanimate or alive , with the power of the arcane , making them both powerful crafters and healers . Culture . Artificers are not common in Faerûn , but can be found in nations where magic and technology blend in surprising ways . The most relevant example is High Imaskar , where artificers occupy a place of power in the imperial hierarchy . Artificers may also have a prominent place in Lantan or Netheril . Most artificers are human s or Deep Imaskari from High Imaskar , but dwarves are exceptionally good at the work of an artificer , due to their long and ancient history of magical crafting . This has led some to believe that dwarves , in fact , invented the artificer tradition . Eladrin , gnome s , and warforged also commonly make good artificers .

title: Artist genie
description: Artist genie Artist genies were special tasked genie s who were brilliant craftsman and artists capable of creating masterpieces so long as their masters treated them well . Enslaved , charmed , or mistreated artist genies always produced inferior work . Artist genies were once dao and djinn but were reshaped over time .
description_long: Artist genie Artist genies were special tasked genie s who were brilliant craftsman and artists capable of creating masterpieces so long as their masters treated them well . Enslaved , charmed , or mistreated artist genies always produced inferior work . Artist genies were once dao and djinn but were reshaped over time . Description . Artist genies varied in appearance based on their specialization . Combat . Artist genies could use the following spell - like abilities : " duo - dimension " , " mirror image " , " illusion " , " polymorph self " , and " stone shape " . Habitat / Society . Artist genies were sharp rivals with each other . The talked freely with other skilled creatures but disdained those who were deemed untalented . These genies were often very eccentric , wearing clothes bordering on the latest fashions and consuming bizarre foods on a regular basis . Ecology . These genies depended on their patron and were only found where knowledge people could appreciate their work . Artist genies separated from the tools of their trade eventually went mad or died .

title: Arton Githsberry
description: Arton Githsberry Arton Githsberry was the ruler of Turmish in 522 DR , whose seat of power was the city of Alaghôn . Activities . When petitioned by a joint delegation of Gulthmere druid s and Xorhun ian elves to cease Turmish ' s logging operations , Githsberry made a show of inviting all his lords to discuss the issue .
description_long: Arton Githsberry Arton Githsberry was the ruler of Turmish in 522 DR , whose seat of power was the city of Alaghôn . Activities . When petitioned by a joint delegation of Gulthmere druid s and Xorhun ian elves to cease Turmish ' s logging operations , Githsberry made a show of inviting all his lords to discuss the issue . This gathering was merely a political facade , however , as Githberry had no intention of heeding the druids ' request .

title: Artor Morlin
description: Artor Morlin Artor Morlin , also known as the The Baron of Blood , was a vampire Lord who saw Waterdeep as his own personal hunting grounds and brooked no challenges from rival vampires to his domain . Personality . As an immortal creature who had been living in the same place for well over four centuries , Artor had to create several personalities for himself to remain incognito .
description_long: Artor Morlin Artor Morlin , also known as the The Baron of Blood , was a vampire Lord who saw Waterdeep as his own personal hunting grounds and brooked no challenges from rival vampires to his domain . Personality . As an immortal creature who had been living in the same place for well over four centuries , Artor had to create several personalities for himself to remain incognito . In this , he lacked imagination as every one of his personae was a mercenary captain . He was a wary individual , He would try to observe his foes and send his vampire spawn or other minions to deal with with threats instead of confronting them himself . He therefore preferred to avoid notice wherever possible and maintain his public identity so that he could spend his free time hunting . After his expulsion from the Dungeon of the Crypt , he spent the next three decades anxiously waiting and watching for signs that people had forgotten about the existence of the Dungeon and that he was still out there . Artor spent a small fortune on bloodroot in order to suggest an addiction to the drug . The purpose of this was to suggest a weakness that enemies would think to exploit and thus reveal themselves .

title: Artur Grossman
description: Artur Grossman Artus Grossman was the leader of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Artus was fighting a cell of Fire Knives installed in Tilverton that had killed his father , the former Guildmaster .
description_long: Artur Grossman Artus Grossman was the leader of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Artus was fighting a cell of Fire Knives installed in Tilverton that had killed his father , the former Guildmaster . In 1357 DR , he asked the help of the adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds in order to free Princess Alusair Obarskyr from the Fire Knives . At that moment , a group of mercenaries attacked the Rogues ' hideout and Artus led his men in battle . Relationship . Grossman had two pets , a pair of dire wolves he raised from pups named Fluffy and Bojangles . Personality . Grossman liked bad poetry and a large library about this and histories .

title: Artus Cimber
description: Artus Cimber Artus Cimber was the youngest son of the highwayman known as Shadowhawk . Description . As a young child , Artus was scrawny with dark brown eyes .
description_long: Artus Cimber Artus Cimber was the youngest son of the highwayman known as Shadowhawk . Description . As a young child , Artus was scrawny with dark brown eyes . Personality . Unlike his brother Oric , Artus was intelligent and observant . Possessions . When Artus was a boy , he wore a threadbare tunic and breeches . History . When Artus was five , his father Scoril Cimber the Shadowhawk tried to teach him the fine arts of banditry in 1333 DR . In Uktar , 1335 DR while training his son , Scoril and Artus saved Prince Azoun from Zhent assassins on the road south of Waymoot toward the hamlet of Irath . Sometime after the Spellplague , Artus was made a Chosen by Auril . Artus had sired a misbegotten son , Sirac , who later emigrated to Icewind Dale . Appendix . Discrepancies . In 1993 , " The Code of the Harpers " sourcebook stated Artus as being neutral good and possibly a bard . In the 1996 " Heroes ' Lorebook " sourcebook , Artus was chaotic good and given the class of fighter .

title: Aru
description: Aru Aru was a town on the island of Tsukishima , part of the state of Wa in Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , it was a center of worship of Bishamon , and pilgrims from all over Wa traveled here . Geography .
description_long: Aru Aru was a town on the island of Tsukishima , part of the state of Wa in Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , it was a center of worship of Bishamon , and pilgrims from all over Wa traveled here . Geography . Aru was quite an isolated settlement , lying in a remote part of the northwestern coast of Tsukishima , huddled in the foothills of the Ikuyu Mountains . It was a difficult journey to reach Aru , as one had to traverse some of the most rugged passes of the mountains . History . Aru began as a simple shrine to Bishamon , and although only a few monks resided on the site , pilgrims still made the long and difficult journey through the Ikuyu Mountains to visit it . Since there were no facilities , they simply endured the elements during their stay . Eventually , owing to the number of pilgrims falling victim to the tough journey , buildings were erected on the site to allow them to stay in greater comfort . Through a combination of pilgrims setting up permanent residence and people setting up stalls to make a profit providing services to the pilgrims , the settlement began to grow .

title: Arun Maerdrym
description: Arun Maerdrym Arun Maerdrym was a half - elf of House Maerdrym from Myth Drannor . He was the father of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Relatives .
description_long: Arun Maerdrym Arun Maerdrym was a half - elf of House Maerdrym from Myth Drannor . He was the father of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Relatives . Arun ' s wife was Arielimnda . His son was Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Death . Arun was killed in 464 DR , along with his son Khelben , while in combat in the Sword of Anauroch with the phaerimm and Palron Kaeth . When the pair were low on spells , and inside a protective sphere , Arun struck the Duskstaff of Sarael using his Lupinaxe , killing them both and transforming the surrounding desert into a crater of glass . Khelben would later be resurrected by Mystra to become Chosen of Mystra .

title: Arundel
description: Arundel Arundel was the Archdruid of Kuldahar . Physical description . Arundel was an old human male and a druid of unknown power capable of using the Heartstone Gem which only someone with great natural or supernatural power could do .
description_long: Arundel Arundel was the Archdruid of Kuldahar . Physical description . Arundel was an old human male and a druid of unknown power capable of using the Heartstone Gem which only someone with great natural or supernatural power could do . Personality . Acting as representative of Kuldahar , Arundel spoke for the village like it ' s leader , although some living in the village were not capable of describing him . He was very wise and knew many things about the surrounding lands in the Spine of the World mountains .

title: Arunika
description: Arunika The devil Arunika was a succubus and , one of the major players in the struggle to claim Neverwinter from the ashes of the cataclysm which tore the city apart and plunged several factions into contention . History . Working indirectly , Arunika planned to weaken the warring factions of Thay and the Shadovar by playing them off one another until such a time as they were easy picking for the Abolethic Sovereignty .
description_long: Arunika The devil Arunika was a succubus and , one of the major players in the struggle to claim Neverwinter from the ashes of the cataclysm which tore the city apart and plunged several factions into contention . History . Working indirectly , Arunika planned to weaken the warring factions of Thay and the Shadovar by playing them off one another until such a time as they were easy picking for the Abolethic Sovereignty . Initially , Arunika sides with Herzgo Alegni , the shadovar representative in Neverwinter , thinking he is the most likely to come out on top . Things quickly changed however , when Sylora Salm was defeated by Drizz ' t Do ' Urden and Dahlia Sin ' felle ; which effectively removed Thay from the equation . Arunika changed her plans after this . She sensed that Alegni was up against forces that even he could not hope to overcome ; accordingly she shifted her intentions . In the ensuing showdown Arunika failed to come to the aid of the supposed ally , instead searching for further information on the dark elf through contacts in the Abyss . As a result , Alegni was defeated at the hands of Drizz ' t , Dahlia and Artemis Entreri .

title: Aruph Thunderfist
description: Aruph Thunderfist Aruph " Red " Thunderfist is a red - haired , burly fence from Luskan . A man who can always get the best deal on just about any item a person could want , Red is well - like and respected all over the city . He can often be found conducting business in a corner booth in the Cutlass , where he ' ll down an endless number of drinks with a near immunity to the effects of intoxication .
description_long: Aruph Thunderfist Aruph " Red " Thunderfist is a red - haired , burly fence from Luskan . A man who can always get the best deal on just about any item a person could want , Red is well - like and respected all over the city . He can often be found conducting business in a corner booth in the Cutlass , where he ' ll down an endless number of drinks with a near immunity to the effects of intoxication . Red is never one to betray trust and is often willing to accept favor over gold as payment for his services .

title: Arush Ashuak
description: Arush Ashuak Arush Ashuak was a village located on the southern lands of Tymanther , in the green lands near Ash Lake . History . For most of its story , Arush Ashuak was one of the agricultural trade hubs for the dragonborn .
description_long: Arush Ashuak Arush Ashuak was a village located on the southern lands of Tymanther , in the green lands near Ash Lake . History . For most of its story , Arush Ashuak was one of the agricultural trade hubs for the dragonborn . In 1487 DR , Arush Ashuak became one of the most important settlements of Tymanther , as it provided Djerad Thymar with supplies during the war against Unther .

title: Arush Vayem
description: Arush Vayem Arush Vayem was a small , isolated walled village located on the frontier of Tymanther , in an unmapped region of the Smoking Mountains . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p185 " > < / ref > History . Arush Vayem was a remote village unknown to the most people .
description_long: Arush Vayem Arush Vayem was a small , isolated walled village located on the frontier of Tymanther , in an unmapped region of the Smoking Mountains . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p185 " > < / ref > History . Arush Vayem was a remote village unknown to the most people . It was home for misfits , exiles and outcasts , and had a number of tiefling s among its population . It also had one of the few " natural " portal s that connected the worlds of Toril and Abeir . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p358 " > < / ref >

title: Arval
description: Arval Arval was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Arval was a servant of the King of Shadows .
description_long: Arval Arval was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Arval was a servant of the King of Shadows . He was sent to Neverwinter to form a secret cult and attract the younger citizens to join the cult . Once he gathered enough followers , he prepared the ritual to join with the shadow . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha came to the end of the Bryce crypt , Arval would be about to finish the ritual . He and his followers would attack the Kalach - Cha . However , Lisbet Bryce then completed the ritual , causing Arval and his followers to be revived as shadows , who would attack once more .

title: Arvandor
description: Arvandor Arvandor , sometimes rarely called Arborea , is the second root of the World Tree . It is covered in lush forests , massive mountains , perfectly clear streams , placid lakes , and an ocean called the Sparkling Sea , as befitting of the home of the Seldarine . Each one of the elven patron deities maintains a realm on this plane .
description_long: Arvandor Arvandor , sometimes rarely called Arborea , is the second root of the World Tree . It is covered in lush forests , massive mountains , perfectly clear streams , placid lakes , and an ocean called the Sparkling Sea , as befitting of the home of the Seldarine . Each one of the elven patron deities maintains a realm on this plane . None of these realms has a border and each one seamlessly melds into the other with absolutely no discernible borders apparent . Arvandor Links . Hanali Celanil maintains a portal to Sune ' s realm in Brightwater , and Erevan Ilesere maintains one that leads to the realm of Hlal in Dragon Eyrie . A portal to the House of Nature , maintained by the whole pantheon , stands at the shore of the Sparkling Sea . The eladrin s have a portal to the Gates of the Moon as well . Inhabitants . The celestial realms of Arvandor and the Gates of the Moon are the only two planes where the elflike eladrins dwell in significant numbers . The eladrins are not servants of the Seldarine , but they respect and generally cooperate with them in everyday matters as well as urgent ones .

title: Arveiaturace
description: Arveiaturace Arveiaturace was an ancient white dragon who served the wizard Meltharond , who also rode her into battle . Description . The white dragon had scales of powder blue and faded alabaster .
description_long: Arveiaturace Arveiaturace was an ancient white dragon who served the wizard Meltharond , who also rode her into battle . Description . The white dragon had scales of powder blue and faded alabaster . Her eyes showed cunning but her expression belied her brutish savagery . Combat . As the battle - mount to Meltharond , Arveiaturace learned well how to fight mages . Relationships . Before the Dracorage , she was ridden as a mount by the wizard Meltharond . With her master ' s death , she continued to live within the ice caverns carved out around the wizard ' s tower . She was careful with her former master ' s goods taking care not to cause damage with her bulk . Arveiaturace was on the lookout for another master and patrolled the Sword Coast with a mysterious rider . The dragon avoided the ships near to Waterdeep owing to her relationship with Laeral Silverhand . Other relations included Lashivian and the Cult of the Dragon to unknown extents , and her occasional mate Arauthator , whom she answered when he called . Arveiaturace had offspring with Arauthator , including Aurbangras . History .

title: Arvik Zaltos
description: Arvik Zaltos Arvik Zaltos was a Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford circa 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Arvik paid the Clotskull orc s to attack the Floshin Estates in order to gain access to an ancient altar to Yan - C - Bin in the family crypts .
description_long: Arvik Zaltos Arvik Zaltos was a Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford circa 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Arvik paid the Clotskull orc s to attack the Floshin Estates in order to gain access to an ancient altar to Yan - C - Bin in the family crypts . Eventually , an adventuring party discovered his involvement and he was identified and captured by Sir Isteval , the man who had hired the adventurers . Arvik was later hanged by the authorities of Daggerford but died laughing because he knew that the Red Wizards ' plan continued without interruption .

title: Arvin
description: Arvin Description . An unremarkable man , Arvin uses his easily forgettable appearance to his advantage , slipping between the cracks of society . He has short , dark hair and wears a clay cat ' s eye bead around his neck .
description_long: Arvin Description . An unremarkable man , Arvin uses his easily forgettable appearance to his advantage , slipping between the cracks of society . He has short , dark hair and wears a clay cat ' s eye bead around his neck . Background . Arvin was orphaned at a young age when his psionicist mother died of a plague . He spent his later childhood and adolescence at an orphanage headed by the priests of Ilmater , weaving ropes . He later took to the streets of Hlondeth where he was intercepted and put to work by the local thieves guild , making magical ropes exclusively for their use . Arvin is kidnapped by The Pox , and poisoned . The yuan - ti , Zelia neutralizes his poison and coerce ' s him into spying for her . They discover that Arvin is able to manifest psionic powers , such as the ability to charm and to move small objects with his mind .

title: Arvin Kothonos
description: Arvin Kothonos Arvin Kothonos was the Guildmaster of the Merchants ' Guild of Ravens Bluff around 1356 DR . Appearance . Arvin was 5 feet 9 inches ( 1 .
description_long: Arvin Kothonos Arvin Kothonos was the Guildmaster of the Merchants ' Guild of Ravens Bluff around 1356 DR . Appearance . Arvin was 5 feet 9 inches ( 1 . 7 meters ) tall and weighed 205 pounds ( 92 . 9 kilograms ) . In his younger days , he was 40 pounds ( 18 kilograms ) lighter . He wore expensive clothes and was always neat and clean shaven . Personality . Arvin was known as an affable and jovial family man but was a skillful negotiator ( mostly due to his " medallion of ESP " ) and would skate around the edges of the law to insure profits . He was a poor planner and secretly depended on his wife Charlotte for ideas and advice on major decisions . He would " sleep on it " if the matter was very important and then go home and describe the situation to Charlotte and get her insight . Arvin had a checkered past and would go to any lengths to conceal it . Background . Before coming to Ravens Bluff , Arvin was the pirate captain Garnet Smithson and he was a wanted man , although most people who knew of him had written him off as lost at sea by then . Garnet wore a full beard which was why Arvin was adamant about staying clean shaven .

title: Arvoreen
description: Arvoreen Arvoreen , also known as The Defender or The Wary Sword was the closest the halfling s had to a war god , but he was actually the halfling pantheon ' s deity of defense , guardians , and watchers . . Personality .
description_long: Arvoreen Arvoreen , also known as The Defender or The Wary Sword was the closest the halfling s had to a war god , but he was actually the halfling pantheon ' s deity of defense , guardians , and watchers . . Personality . Arvoreen was strict and preached aggressive watchfulness but only to react to aggression . He didn ' t support starting conflicts unless it was done to stop evil practices . Arvoreen never attacked first and didn ' t hold thieving to be dishonorable as long as it was against a foe . However , it was extremely forbidden to steal from the Hin ( halflings ) or their allies . Avatar . The avatar of Arvoreen appeared as a handsome young muscular halfling dressed in light clothing and chain mail . His weapons of choice ranged from two short sword s to a short sword and shield . He was always accompanied by a Keeper , and he sometimes appeared to go on patrol with his worshipers . Relationships . The Defender ' s enemies were evil deities such as Bane , Cyric , the Deities of Fury , and the goblinoid pantheon . His closest allies were the rest of the hin pantheon , especially Yondalla , Cyrrollalee , and Urogalan , but he disapproved of the behavior of Brandobaris .

title: Arxhadk
description: Arxhadk Arxhadk was the morkoth ambassador of Olleth in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Arxhadk hailed from the Arcanum of Olleth , the morkoth magocracy in the Sea of Fallen Stars . He survived out of the water thanks to a golem - like construct that resembled and had the powers of a massive water elemental , which he dwelt inside .
description_long: Arxhadk Arxhadk was the morkoth ambassador of Olleth in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Arxhadk hailed from the Arcanum of Olleth , the morkoth magocracy in the Sea of Fallen Stars . He survived out of the water thanks to a golem - like construct that resembled and had the powers of a massive water elemental , which he dwelt inside . Arxhadk had a slithering tracker as a familiar and sometimes he used it as silent and unseen assassin , unknown to the drow of Sshamath .

title: Aryselmalyn calendar
description: Aryselmalyn calendar The Aryselmalyn calendar is an example of how all elven nations marked the passage of time ( and still do in Evereska and Evermeet ) . It was used by the ancient and fallen Aquatic elf nation of Aryselmalyr . Four years marked one " aeloulaev " ( " when peaces meet " in elven ) which ended during the celebration of " Cinnaelos ' Cor " ( " The Day of Corellon ' s Peace " ) and started a new one .
description_long: Aryselmalyn calendar The Aryselmalyn calendar is an example of how all elven nations marked the passage of time ( and still do in Evereska and Evermeet ) . It was used by the ancient and fallen Aquatic elf nation of Aryselmalyr . Four years marked one " aeloulaev " ( " when peaces meet " in elven ) which ended during the celebration of " Cinnaelos ' Cor " ( " The Day of Corellon ' s Peace " ) and started a new one . The elves also marked time by the length of the reign of their rulers , known as a " rysar " which encompassed the entire reign of a single ruler of Aryselmalyr . When Aryselmalyr fell over 1500 years ago , the calendar had reached the 71st " aeloulaeva " of its 197th " rysar " , which sages later agreed added up to over 11000 years .

title: Aryvandaar
description: Aryvandaar Known also as the Vyshaantar Empire , Aryvandaar was a sun elf kingdom that fell during the Fifth Crown War . History . First Flowering .
description_long: Aryvandaar Known also as the Vyshaantar Empire , Aryvandaar was a sun elf kingdom that fell during the Fifth Crown War . History . First Flowering . The first settlements of Aryvandaar were founded around - 23900 DR in the area later known as the High Forest . Control of Aryvandaar was gained by the clan Vyshaan in - 15300 DR , under the leadership of Coronal Ivosaar Vyshaan . The Vyshaanti of Aryvandaar claimed a family link to the ruling family of Miyeritar . They then attempted a peaceful annexation of Miyeritar which was resisted . First Crown War . Aryvandaar began the First Crown War by invading Miyeritar in - 12000 DR . They also put pressure on Shantel Othreier to accept their rule or suffer the same . By - 11800 DR Aryvandaar had fully annexed and occupied Miyeritar though some parts continue to resist . Miyeritar wasn ' t considered fully conquered until - 11300 DR . Third Crown War . In - 10900 DR Aryvandaar , now the Vyshaantar Empire , ceased talks with Shantel Otheier and invaded , starting the Third Crown War . Around this time the Vyshaan lords gained a secret patron in Malkizid , a fallen solar .

title: Arzastra
description: Arzastra Arzastra was a half - ogre innkeeper and tavern owner in Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arzastra managed the Falling Orc inn and tavern .
description_long: Arzastra Arzastra was a half - ogre innkeeper and tavern owner in Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arzastra managed the Falling Orc inn and tavern . History . in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Arzastra took as waiters the poor shield dwarf Larg ( in truth a wanted criminal from Icewind Dale ) .

title: As Seconds Slip Away
