description: As Seconds Slip Away Intelligence suggests that the Zhentarim are planning a direct attack on Loudwater in a bid to take control of the Delimbiyr Vale . Scouts are needed to travel into Zhent territory to determine the truth of this report . The second part of the Tides of War mini series .
description_long: As Seconds Slip Away Intelligence suggests that the Zhentarim are planning a direct attack on Loudwater in a bid to take control of the Delimbiyr Vale . Scouts are needed to travel into Zhent territory to determine the truth of this report . The second part of the Tides of War mini series .

title: Asabi
description: Asabi Asabis , also known as laerti , were reptilian humanoid s that dwelt in the desert . Nomenclature . " Asabi " was the Bedine word for this creature .
description_long: Asabi Asabis , also known as laerti , were reptilian humanoid s that dwelt in the desert . Nomenclature . " Asabi " was the Bedine word for this creature . In the Common tongue , they were called " laerti , " which had its origins in Netheril . " Laerti " was the term they called themselves . Subraces . There were two different subraces of asabi : standard asabi and stingtail asabi . The two subraces were capable of interbreeding . Description . Asabis stood about seven feet tall on two legs . They had long tails . Their scales were gray to brown color , and they had light green or dun undersides . They had narrow , sloping skulls . Their eyes were very large , egg - shaped , and yellow , and they had forked tongues . Their limbs projected out at sharp angles , making their movements awkward to typical humanoid observers ; however , they could move as easily on four limbs as two , balancing with their long tails . It was very difficult to tell a male and female asabi apart . Asabis never wore armor heavier than aramor . Combat . Asabis liked to hide themselves in the sand and jump out at their targets . They were quite skilled at jumping and could jump 15 to 20 feet .

title: Asahi
description: Asahi Asahi was a member of the ninja Kata clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Asahi was an expect tactician , always taking the fewest risks .
description_long: Asahi Asahi was a member of the ninja Kata clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Asahi was an expect tactician , always taking the fewest risks . History . Asahi led one of the ninja teams sent by the daimyo Yoshi Yoyogi to recover an ancient weapon wielded by descendants of a disgraced samurai of his land in order to stop a prophecy about the end of his rule . Asahi ' s mission in Aru was to recover the blade Oil Seller and kill Fusae and Cachiko .

title: Asala
description: Asala Asala was a priestess of Kiaransalee in Szith Morcane . History . Asala was a young priestess of Kiaransalee under Velasta T ' sarran .
description_long: Asala Asala was a priestess of Kiaransalee in Szith Morcane . History . Asala was a young priestess of Kiaransalee under Velasta T ' sarran . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after the fire giant s occupied the outpost , Asala ' s lover was killed by a group of hell hound s and azer s while they tried to escape . Asala wanted vengeance .

title: Asanta
description: Asanta Asanta was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships .
description_long: Asanta Asanta was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships . Asanta was the daughter of Buldegas Mhaerkoon , and sister to Baerill . They chatted constantly and had noisy arguments . History . Buldegas Mhaerkoon was the long - time owner of the Wyvern Watch Inn , but following the devastation of the neighboring city of Arabel during the Goblin War in 1370 DR , Buldegas chose to relocate there and build a new inn . He took away his money and some of his best employees and left his daughters in charge of the Wyvern . Asanta and Baerill had recently taken charge by 1374 DR . They conveniently forgot Buldegas ' s instructions about watering down the drink , and their regular banter and arguing was a popular form of entertainment there . This made the Wyvern more popular with patrons .

title: Asbarode
description: Asbarode Asbarode , also known as Nith the Entertainer , was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She was unquestionably loyal to Ashemmi .
description_long: Asbarode Asbarode , also known as Nith the Entertainer , was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She was unquestionably loyal to Ashemmi . History . Asbarode was the head of of the largest Zhent spy network under the alias Nith the Entertainer , and her minions wandered around posing as an itinerant circus known as the Band of Rogues .

title: Asbeel
description: Asbeel Asbeel was a moon elf who was at once blessed and cursed by Tymora and Beshaba to become a sentinel for Tymora that was charged with watching over the Stone of Tymora . Asbeel was to watch the bearers of the stone without interfering , only acting to ensure that upon the death of the current bearer , the stone found its way to the next bearer . At some point during the centuries of watching over the bearers , Asbeel became disenchanted with his role and began interfering , even slaying more than a few of the bearers .
description_long: Asbeel Asbeel was a moon elf who was at once blessed and cursed by Tymora and Beshaba to become a sentinel for Tymora that was charged with watching over the Stone of Tymora . Asbeel was to watch the bearers of the stone without interfering , only acting to ensure that upon the death of the current bearer , the stone found its way to the next bearer . At some point during the centuries of watching over the bearers , Asbeel became disenchanted with his role and began interfering , even slaying more than a few of the bearers . For this , Asbeel was cursed to wear the visage of a demonic elf any time he was not in a temple to one of the Sisters of Luck . Asbeel is the arch - enemy of Maimun in the Stone of Tymora novels .

title: Asbravn
description: Asbravn To the travelers eye Asbravn looks like lush farms with wood lots , well - kept barns , drainage ditches and ponds and tranquility Asbravn is the market center of the southern Vale farmers . Rather here they do their trading with each other and traveling merchants then in the cities where others will make a profit from their food . Buyers from Berdusk and Iriaebor come to the market each day .
description_long: Asbravn To the travelers eye Asbravn looks like lush farms with wood lots , well - kept barns , drainage ditches and ponds and tranquility Asbravn is the market center of the southern Vale farmers . Rather here they do their trading with each other and traveling merchants then in the cities where others will make a profit from their food . Buyers from Berdusk and Iriaebor come to the market each day . It s common rumor that the market of Asbravn fills bellies all along the Chionthar . Asbravn lies in a shallow valley inbetween the Dusk Road and the Uldoon Trail . A dilapidated temple to Ilmater faces the market , which is ringed by swap shops , a cooper and cratemaker , a wagonworks , shrines to Lliira , Lathander and Waukeen ( nowadays a burnt - out shell abandoned by priest where local children play ) , the Tankard and Sheaf tavern and Board Laid Bare inn . The Riders in Red Cloaks , police and defenders , are well - known . A few experience warriors , occasionally bolstered mages and priest and local volunteers are sponsored by Iriaebor to safekeep the market and surrounding roads .

title: Ascalan
description: Ascalan Ascalan was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a wizard and fishmonger , and owner of The Fish House . Once a wizard , Ascalan retired to become a fishmonger at The Fish House .
description_long: Ascalan Ascalan was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a wizard and fishmonger , and owner of The Fish House . Once a wizard , Ascalan retired to become a fishmonger at The Fish House . He owned a " ring of frost " , which he used to both refrigerate fish and create blocks of ice , both of which he sold to the people of Wheloon , and other merchants and travellers passing through . Occasionally , he also sold potion s , albeit at great cost . By 1369 DR , he was old and rather portly . Ascalan enjoyed talking at length about adventurer ' s lore and lost treasure in Cormyr . He had sons who helped him in his business .

title: Ascarle
description: Ascarle Ascarle , the " Sunken City , " was an underwater elven city located off the northern shores of Trisk in the Purple Rocks . Description . The somewhat - ruined buildings and walkways were formed from crystal and red coral .
description_long: Ascarle Ascarle , the " Sunken City , " was an underwater elven city located off the northern shores of Trisk in the Purple Rocks . Description . The somewhat - ruined buildings and walkways were formed from crystal and red coral . They city was filled with air . History . The lost city of Ascarle was swept into the ocean by melting glaciers . Destroyed by the drow , it was used by Slarkrethel as headquarters for the Kraken Society . In 1361 DR , it was rumored that a kraken truly ruled the city , but the nominal Regent of Ascarle was the illithid Vestress . Vestress was a rogue illithid who had taken the city from hands of a drow banshee , whom she banished to Inthar on Ruathym via a portal . She desired to conquer Ruathym , but the banshee made that impossible , so she plotted to have the banshee destroyed by Liriel Baenre . Under the Kraken Society , she also allied with Rethnor of Luskan and Shakti Hunzrin as part of a plot to turn the Lords ' Alliance and Waterdeep into war with Ruathym . However , all of these plans were discovered by Liriel , who led an assault on the city , deposed Vestress , and released the illithid ' s captives . Inhabitants .

title: Ascendancy of the Last
description: Ascendancy of the Last Ascendancy of the Last is the third and final novel in The Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . The end to the Lady Penitent trilogy reveals the epic climax and aftermath of the sava match between Lolth and Eilistraee .
description_long: Ascendancy of the Last Ascendancy of the Last is the third and final novel in The Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . The end to the Lady Penitent trilogy reveals the epic climax and aftermath of the sava match between Lolth and Eilistraee . Lolth unleashes an all - out assault against Eilistraee ' s worshipers in the form of Ghaunadaur and his minions both ooze and drow and succeeds in killing both Eilistraee and her high priestess Qilue . While Lolth ' s offensive is a success , Eilistraee proves she is just as capable as her mother of weaving webs of deceit and misdirection ( courtesy of her merger with Vhaeraun ) as she uses Q ' arlynd yet again to achieve victory from within the depths of defeat by neutralizing the taint that the demon lord Wendonai had corrupted the ancient drow bloodlines at Lolth ' s behest . While Lolth ' s plan succeeds in finally defeating her wayward daughter ; Eilistraee ' s final ploy introduces an even more powerful player to the sava gameboard to take her place .

title: Ascension Hall
description: Ascension Hall The Ascension Hall , or the Golden Road , was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ivory and alabaster statues flanked the main hallway which was lined with solid gold .
description_long: Ascension Hall The Ascension Hall , or the Golden Road , was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ivory and alabaster statues flanked the main hallway which was lined with solid gold . The statues honored various heroes and legends known to the Enlightened Throne . Activities . This hall was reserved for special ceremonies including the annual honoring of the Grand Caliph on Ascension Day . Rumors and Legends . Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir had plans to honor the White Agate with a statue in the Ascension Hall .

title: Ascore
description: Ascore Ascore in 1374 DR is lonely , windswept ruin on the edge of the Anauroch . In its heyday , in the time of the Netherese Empire , Ascore was a bustling dwarven port city of the nation of Delzoun on the northern shores of the Narrow Sea . Tradegoods from Netheril flowed into Delzoun either via the docks of Ascore or via the Lowroad which connected to Ascore .
description_long: Ascore Ascore in 1374 DR is lonely , windswept ruin on the edge of the Anauroch . In its heyday , in the time of the Netherese Empire , Ascore was a bustling dwarven port city of the nation of Delzoun on the northern shores of the Narrow Sea . Tradegoods from Netheril flowed into Delzoun either via the docks of Ascore or via the Lowroad which connected to Ascore . Flora & Fauna . The ruins were sometimes infested with pernicon . Weird stone ships lay half - buried in the sand . Thirteen pyramids surrounded a pool of liquid shadow . It was of interest , though unclear why , to Thultanthar , who sent an expedition there in 1372 DR . While they created only a temporary camp , they remained there since . Nobody knew the pyramids ' origins but the material , some kind of red stone , was similar to the bleeding stone of Karse , Karsus ' corpse . Ascore was the primary , and official , destination of the " portal " . The Underdark under Ascore was special , because it connected two domains , the Buried Realms and the Northdark .

title: Asdag
description: Asdag Ruinlord Asdag was the head of internal security and head torturer of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Personality . Asdag was a cold and cruel person .
description_long: Asdag Ruinlord Asdag was the head of internal security and head torturer of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Personality . Asdag was a cold and cruel person . History . Asdag was a cleric , first as a High Priest of Bane , then Cyric , and later of Iyachtu Xvim , always following his master , Fzoul Chembryl . Around 1367 DR , he was the adviser of Guthbert Golthammer , military commander of Teshwave , but in truth he directed Guthbert ' s decisions , being the real lord of the dale . Later , Asdag was transferred to Zhentil Keep , where he assumed a position as head of internal security , just under Fzoul . He used this position to spy inside Xvim ' s clergy , on Lord Orgauth , and other power groups in the city for his master . Description . Asdag was a fat and tall man with a preference for black dress with crimson cloaks . He cultivated this look in order to inspire an air of evil power . Relationships . In his days in Teshwave , Asdag often found it incredibly easy to manipulate the slow - witted mind of Guthbert . However , Guthbert considered him a loyal advisor . On the other hand , Asdag was loyal to Fzoul .

title: Asdefk ' s Inn
description: Asdefk ' s Inn Asdefk ' s Inn was a popular inn and tavern in the capital city of Darromar in Tethyr . It was known for its extremely spicy Calishite and Tashalar an dishes , but was overpriced . The building was located on the west side of Star Street in the Temple Quarter of the city , directly across from the Wheel Market .
description_long: Asdefk ' s Inn Asdefk ' s Inn was a popular inn and tavern in the capital city of Darromar in Tethyr . It was known for its extremely spicy Calishite and Tashalar an dishes , but was overpriced . The building was located on the west side of Star Street in the Temple Quarter of the city , directly across from the Wheel Market .

title: Asgar Tellendar
description: Asgar Tellendar Asgar Tellendar was a human man and the chief priest of Ilmater of the House of the Suffering God in Asbravn in the late 1360s DR . Personality . Asgar was a devout follower of Ilmater , usually quite serene , and very wise .
description_long: Asgar Tellendar Asgar Tellendar was a human man and the chief priest of Ilmater of the House of the Suffering God in Asbravn in the late 1360s DR . Personality . Asgar was a devout follower of Ilmater , usually quite serene , and very wise . Activities . Asgar led a small clergy of only six priests , three novices , and four lay worshipers . The House of the Suffering God was a very poor and rundown temple , and the tithes were too few and too small to pay for repairs . Without enough local support , Asgar knew his temple was at risk of being shut down and further that the Zhentarim were infiltrating the town . For guidance , Asgar relied on dream - visions sent to him by Ilmater . However , the Zhents apparently discovered this and started to magically meddle with what he thought was sent to him by his god . These other visions showed Ilmater turning his back on the House of the Suffering God , but were always shortly followed by mysterious , silver - tongued visitors seeking to purchase the temple , so Asgar disbelieved them . The calm and serene Asgar was so angered and felt so defiled that from then on he ' d battle any Zhent agent who threatened him .

title: Asgetrion
description: Asgetrion Asgetrion the Learned was a local sage who lived in Arabel in Cormyr . Activities . He was perhaps the most accomplished expert on the study of gorgon s in all of Cormyr .
description_long: Asgetrion Asgetrion the Learned was a local sage who lived in Arabel in Cormyr . Activities . He was perhaps the most accomplished expert on the study of gorgon s in all of Cormyr . Due to the nature of his expertise , Asgetrion owned what some have called the largest collection of scrolls of " protection against petrification " in the realm . He would never sell his scrolls , but instead hoarded them jealously , sharing only his knowledge for a price . It was this knowledge that brought adventurers and War Mages alike to his home from all over Cormyr and beyond .

title: Asgorath
description: Asgorath Asgorath ( pronounced " AZ - gore - ath " ) , was the dragon god of creation . He ( or she , as some traditions suggested ) was regarded as the creator of the multiverse and of dragonkind , and he manipulated the destinies of all dragons by operating in a way that nobody suspected his involvement . Asgorath was supposed to encompass all alignments , but was often regarded as neutral .
description_long: Asgorath Asgorath ( pronounced " AZ - gore - ath " ) , was the dragon god of creation . He ( or she , as some traditions suggested ) was regarded as the creator of the multiverse and of dragonkind , and he manipulated the destinies of all dragons by operating in a way that nobody suspected his involvement . Asgorath was supposed to encompass all alignments , but was often regarded as neutral . In the Outer Planes , it was more commonly known as Io . His holy symbol , an unadorned circle , represented totality . Description . Asgorath never manifested himself before his worshipers . However , he made his existence felt as a powerful presence in their minds . Asgorath , however , could manifest physically if he wanted to , taking on the form of any dragon , and even in forms of other draconic creatures , such as pseudodragon s . The oldest myths of dragonkind claimed that Asgorath manifested physically only once , during the act of creating the multiverse . Those who believed in this myth believed Asgorath was so huge , that even his scales were larger than the largest mortal dragon that ever existed . Realm . Asgorath ' s home plane was unknown . Worshipers .

title: Ash ' ala Melarn
description: Ash ' ala Melarn Ash ' ala Melarn was a drow priestess of Menzoberranzan and third daughter of the First Priestess of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Description . Ash ' ala always dressed the robes of her office .
description_long: Ash ' ala Melarn Ash ' ala Melarn was a drow priestess of Menzoberranzan and third daughter of the First Priestess of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Description . Ash ' ala always dressed the robes of her office . Personality . Ash ' ala could be influenced by those who showed to believed that her was the right way to serve Lolth . She appreciated citing historical precedents or showing devotion to her House . History . Ash ' ala was her family ' s representative for an alliance with House Xorlarrin and Bregan D ' aerthe in handling a party of adventurer s . They first sent the team to gain power for Lolth ' s Demon Weave scheme . For the expedition , she asked adventurers loyal to her house to perform a holy ritual in the outpost objective of the mission . The ritual rinsed the altar to guard against taint from the Xorlarrin or Bregan D ' aerthe drow . After the adventurers returned from their first mission , Hoshtar Xorlarrin was invited to meet with members of the Council of Spiders by his cousin , Raelaryn Xorlarrin . At the meeting , a Jaezred Chaulssin assassin killed Raelaryn and captured Hoshtar . The alliance ' s hired team managed to rescue him .

title: Asha Vandree
description: Asha Vandree Asha Vandree was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Asha was ambitious enough to dream of ruling the outpost , but not so courageous as to openly challenge Ilvara Mizzrym , also knowing that for a permanent assignment she needed to also impress her superiors in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Asha Vandree Asha Vandree was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Asha was ambitious enough to dream of ruling the outpost , but not so courageous as to openly challenge Ilvara Mizzrym , also knowing that for a permanent assignment she needed to also impress her superiors in Menzoberranzan . Relationship . Asha initially considered Ilvara Mizzrym as a model to imitate , but changed her mind after the senior priestess discarded Jorlan Duskryn without hesitation . Activities . Asha was a drow of Menzoberranzan and a member of House Vandree , living in the Velkynvelve outpost , acting as a junior priestess and second - in - command to Ilvara .

title: Ashaba
description: Ashaba Ashaba was a water wizard and the first Lord of Shadowdale after driving the drow out of the Twisted Tower in 906 DR . Ashaba ruled Shadowdale for thirty four years until 940 DR . Ashaba created the " Pendant of Ashaba " , to be used to determine the rightful lord of Shadowdale .
description_long: Ashaba Ashaba was a water wizard and the first Lord of Shadowdale after driving the drow out of the Twisted Tower in 906 DR . Ashaba ruled Shadowdale for thirty four years until 940 DR . Ashaba created the " Pendant of Ashaba " , to be used to determine the rightful lord of Shadowdale . Ashaba ultimately changed himself into a water elemental in 940 DR . and merged with the river that he gave his name to , the River Ashaba .

title: Ashabenford
description: Ashabenford Ashabenford was the capital and largest settlement of Mistledale . Geography . Composed of rustic homes and collections of cottages , Ashabenford sat on the eastern side of the River Ashaba , though some of its notable buildings were found also on the west bank .
description_long: Ashabenford Ashabenford was the capital and largest settlement of Mistledale . Geography . Composed of rustic homes and collections of cottages , Ashabenford sat on the eastern side of the River Ashaba , though some of its notable buildings were found also on the west bank . The busy trade route of the Moonsea Ride passed through the center of the small town . Government . The Council of Six were elected representatives from around Mistledale who appointed the High Councilor of both Ashabenford and the dale . Once chosen , the High Councilor was expected to reside in Ashabenford all year round . Between , at least , the years of 1367 DR and 1372 DR , the reigning High Councilor was Haresk Malorn . Trade . The presence of the Moonsea Ride meant the town had little need for a large open air market , with many services instead being found along the route . Local farmers keen to sell their wares avoided the main trade route , tending instead to stop the wagons in the many yards or lanes dotted around the pleasant backstreets of the town . Defenses .

title: Ashaerond
description: Ashaerond Ashaerond was a merchant who lived in Westgate on the Dragon Coast and lived prior to 1369 DR . Ashaerond gave generously to the Church of Ilmater , in case of needing the Ilmatari ' s help one day . Ashaerond explained " If I pay for one extra potion today , it may be the last one tomorrow — but the one needed then to heal me .
description_long: Ashaerond Ashaerond was a merchant who lived in Westgate on the Dragon Coast and lived prior to 1369 DR . Ashaerond gave generously to the Church of Ilmater , in case of needing the Ilmatari ' s help one day . Ashaerond explained " If I pay for one extra potion today , it may be the last one tomorrow — but the one needed then to heal me . "

title: Ashala
description: Ashala Ashala was a lizardfolk of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp in 1374 DR . History . Ashala was the mate of Kessessek and also a cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss .
description_long: Ashala Ashala was a lizardfolk of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp in 1374 DR . History . Ashala was the mate of Kessessek and also a cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss . In 1374 DR , the neighboring lizardfolk tribe of Shadowscale allied with the Church of Shar and began to act strangely . They eventually started a war with the Sharptooth . In the fighting , Ashala was captured alongside others like the chieftain Gathan and ended up as prisoners in the Lost Refuge . From an adventuring party that assaulted the keep , she discovered that the Sharptooths believed the chieftain was dead and replaced him with Kessessek and was greatly pleased .

title: Ashanath
description: Ashanath Ashanath was an unsettled region of Thesk with rich soil . Description . It was primarily covered with grassland inhabited by ankheg s , bulette s , wild ox en and ponies .
description_long: Ashanath Ashanath was an unsettled region of Thesk with rich soil . Description . It was primarily covered with grassland inhabited by ankheg s , bulette s , wild ox en and ponies . The area was subject to tornadoes during the summertime , which might be related to the Red Wizard s ' weather - controlling magic .

title: Ashdra
description: Ashdra Ashdra was a drow in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Ashdra was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .
description_long: Ashdra Ashdra was a drow in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Ashdra was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments . More specifically , she was the chosen of Ibrandul , a god long believed dead . Ashdra was freed from his chains by the heroes of Daggerford .

title: Ashemmi
description: Ashemmi Ashemmi ( originally Shemmithil Maraphiir ) was a moon elf wizard and the lover and consort of the wizard Sememmon . Appearance . Ashemmi had flaxen hair and gold eyes , which went some way to explain the regular confusion over her true race , since these traits are rare in moon elves ( she had claimed to be a moon elf around 1372 DR ) .
description_long: Ashemmi Ashemmi ( originally Shemmithil Maraphiir ) was a moon elf wizard and the lover and consort of the wizard Sememmon . Appearance . Ashemmi had flaxen hair and gold eyes , which went some way to explain the regular confusion over her true race , since these traits are rare in moon elves ( she had claimed to be a moon elf around 1372 DR ) . Ashemmi changed her appearance frequently , every few months . As of 1374 DR , Ashemmi ' s hair was snow - blond , bound in several places with silver ties . Relatives . Ashemmi ' s mother was the gold elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar and her father was the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir . Her older brother was Malphys Maraphiir . Background . Early years . Ashemmi was born Shemmithil Maraphiir in 1171 DR , to her moon elf father Rhyem Maraphiir and gold elf mother Chelryn Sarynnryllar . She was born in Silverymoon , but shortly after birth , her parents travelled with her to the Neverwinter Woods , to live among the wood elves , where they were taken in by the Ilbaereth clan . Ashemmi ' s brother , Malphys , had apprenticed under Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , and when she was around 80 , Malphys began to teach her what he knew about magic .

title: Ashemmon
description: Ashemmon Ashemmon , also called Ashemmon of Rhymanthiin , was a half - elf sorcerer of Rhymanthiin and the fifth Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Description . Ashemmon wore no beard and had blond hair nearly to the ground .
description_long: Ashemmon Ashemmon , also called Ashemmon of Rhymanthiin , was a half - elf sorcerer of Rhymanthiin and the fifth Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Description . Ashemmon wore no beard and had blond hair nearly to the ground . Sigils and runes covered his shoulders and neck . He had hawklike features . History . Ashemmon became Blackstaff in Ches of 1424 DR , after the death of Krehlan Arunsun . According to Sarathus Hothemer in his treatise " " ( Year of the Forged Sigil , 1459 DR ) , Ashemmon outshone all Blackstaffs except Khelben in matters of statecraft . In his life , Ashemmon mentored Samark Dhanzscul , who became the sixth Blackstaff . Ashemmon died in the 1464 DR and was succeeded by Samark . Ashemmon ' s spirit - template went on to reside within Blackstaff Tower along with the spirit - templates of the other former Blackstaffs .

title: Ashenford Torinbow
description: Ashenford Torinbow Ashenford Torinbow was a druid and a member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave and a follower of Silvanus during the Second Sundering . History . Early in his life he was a Harper in Dalelands until 1328 DR when was captured and tortured by the Zhentarim .
description_long: Ashenford Torinbow Ashenford Torinbow was a druid and a member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave and a follower of Silvanus during the Second Sundering . History . Early in his life he was a Harper in Dalelands until 1328 DR when was captured and tortured by the Zhentarim . After being rescued Ashenford left the Harper and lived for a time in Waterdeep as bard before to relocate in Vilhon Reach where joined the Emerald Enclave . Ashenford represented half - elves among the three members of the Elder Circle . Because of the chaos caused by the Spellplague , which had altered nature ' s ecosystems and driven mad the elf member of the Elder Circle , Cindermoon , the Elder Circle was stagnating . In 1486 DR , the boy prophet of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn , arrived and successfully cured Cindermoon .

title: Ashenwood
description: Ashenwood The Ashenwood was a wild evergreen forest in Rashemen known for its large number of fey inhabitants . The Rashemi considered the Ashenwood sacred and would not settle within its borders . Geography .
description_long: Ashenwood The Ashenwood was a wild evergreen forest in Rashemen known for its large number of fey inhabitants . The Rashemi considered the Ashenwood sacred and would not settle within its borders . Geography . The Ashenwood was located between Lake Ashane to the west and hills and the Sunrise Mountains to the east . A river marked its southern boundary . The Ashenwood was a day ' s walk south of Immilmar . Inhabitants . Rashemi considered the forest sacred and so did not live in it . However , they believed many powerful spirits lived there , and there were certainly plenty of owlbear s , troll s , and ettercap s .

title: Asheyron
description: Asheyron Asheyron the Learned was a sage and the owner of the Elfskull Inn in Arabel in 1367 DR . Activities . Asheyron possessed a wealth of knowledge about monsters , particularly gorgon s .
description_long: Asheyron Asheyron the Learned was a sage and the owner of the Elfskull Inn in Arabel in 1367 DR . Activities . Asheyron possessed a wealth of knowledge about monsters , particularly gorgon s . He would perform lectures detailing the faiths that the different monster races followed and rituals they used during worship . In a vain attempt to capitalize on his uncle ' s will , Asheyron briefly adopted his brother Asgetrion ' s name . The gems that he hoped to get his hands on from the will were never found , so Asheyron switched back to his own name . Possessions . Asheyron wore an " amulet of protection from petrification " . Rumors and Legends . He was rumored to be immune to a gorgon ' s breath weapon because of his many unscathed exposures to the attack .

title: Ashhold
description: Ashhold Ashhold was an ash giant citadel in the Black Ash Plain . The citadel ' s fortifications were entirely natural and consisted of huge basalt pillars with lava pits and flows . History .
description_long: Ashhold Ashhold was an ash giant citadel in the Black Ash Plain . The citadel ' s fortifications were entirely natural and consisted of huge basalt pillars with lava pits and flows . History . Ashhold was considered a holy land by ash giants , and thus a neutral ground between their tribes . In 1479 DR , the green dragon Skuthosiin took control of the citadel and used its influence to control the ash giants tribes , and launched a campaign to conquer former Unther ic lands , including Tymanther . After the wizard Biri uncovered Skuthosiin as the true mastermind of the giants , Vanquisher Tarhun ordered a joint military operation with all the tymatheran military forces and led a siege to Ashhold . In the ensuing battle , the dragonborn killed Skuthosiin , ending the giant threat to Tymanther .

title: Ashigi Desugaki
description: Ashigi Desugaki Ashigi Desugaki was a provincial governor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ashigi , a follower of the emperor , was nominated governor of the Fukudo Province , a territory traditionally ruled by the family of Takenaka Okawa , in a very clever placement by retired emperor Gokammu .
description_long: Ashigi Desugaki Ashigi Desugaki was a provincial governor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ashigi , a follower of the emperor , was nominated governor of the Fukudo Province , a territory traditionally ruled by the family of Takenaka Okawa , in a very clever placement by retired emperor Gokammu . Ashigi Desugaki had his seat of government in Chimotoge , were he constructed Chimo Castle with imperial funds , and staffed it full of emperor - devoted soldiers . This movement greatly disturbed the shikken and in Chimotoge plots flourished . What Okawa did not know was that Ashigi also supported Takenaka Sugawara and could use his troops to help him . Personality . Ashigi was a good administrator but a mediocre military leader .

title: Ashira
description: Ashira Ashira were spirits of trees that lived mainly in palm trees , plum trees , banana trees , etc . These creatures were a subspecies of the fairies that lived on the open spaces of Zakhara . They led joyful and carefree lives and often were close friends of people who looked after their trees .
description_long: Ashira Ashira were spirits of trees that lived mainly in palm trees , plum trees , banana trees , etc . These creatures were a subspecies of the fairies that lived on the open spaces of Zakhara . They led joyful and carefree lives and often were close friends of people who looked after their trees . People could sometimes hear their beautiful singing at nights . Combat . Ashira were very peaceful creatures and always preferred to flee from battle , if their trees were not threatened or in danger . However , if presented with a direct threat to their garden , they could be very dangerous and bloodthirsty . To avoid a fight , they often used a spell of " charm " , although usually tried to negotiate first without the use of magic . Their main difference from dryad s was that ashiras held no attachment to a specific tree ; instead , they were attached to the whole garden or orchard . If the whole garden was threatened , then all the ashira there rushed frantically to its defense . If an ashira saw that it was losing a battle , then it could hide in any tree in their orchard .

title: Ashkabbar
description: Ashkabbar Ashkabbar was an orc leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Ashkabbar led a group of orcs into a section of Blingdenstone .
description_long: Ashkabbar Ashkabbar was an orc leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Ashkabbar led a group of orcs into a section of Blingdenstone . They started raiding the deep gnome settlers led by Kargien Dissengulp until , in 1479 DR , an adventuring party hired by Kargien defeated Ashkabbar and forced the orcs to abandon the city . Activities . Ashkabbar usually stayed in his camp with four burly female orcs with him at all times .

title: Ashmadai
description: Ashmadai The Ashmadai were a secretive devil worshiping cult based in Neverwinter dedicated to the god Asmodeus . The cult was well connected in Neverwinter prior to the cataclysm in 1451 DR and was even better connected as of 1479 DR . In the years prior to Neverwinter ' s destruction , the Ashmadai worked as agents of Thay although since the cataclysm , the Ashmadai are no longer allied with Szass Tam .
description_long: Ashmadai The Ashmadai were a secretive devil worshiping cult based in Neverwinter dedicated to the god Asmodeus . The cult was well connected in Neverwinter prior to the cataclysm in 1451 DR and was even better connected as of 1479 DR . In the years prior to Neverwinter ' s destruction , the Ashmadai worked as agents of Thay although since the cataclysm , the Ashmadai are no longer allied with Szass Tam . The Ashmadai had the ability to summon devils . However , whenever they summoned a fiend , they bound its essence to the body of a mortal . Because of this the Asmadai kidnapped residents of Neverwinter in order to make them vessels for summoned devils . History . Under Thay . Years before the cataclysm of Neverwinter , cultists of Asmodeus allied themselves with Thay . The exact nature of the bargain between the cult and Szass Tam was unclear , what was known was that Thay ' s regent , Valindra Shadowmantle , possessed a staff that the Ashmadai considered precious . The Ashmadai served Thay loyally , though all they simply desired was the staff . When control would be given to Sylora Salm , the Ashmadai would continue to serve loyally .

title: Ashni
description: Ashni Ashni was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Ashni was a student of Neverwinter Academy .
description_long: Ashni Ashni was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Ashni was a student of Neverwinter Academy . When Qara caused trouble at the Academy , Praven went after her . Once Qara and the Kalach - Cha came out of the Sunken Flagon and defeated Praven , Ashni would confront them and attack . After the battle , the headmaster , Jochris , appears and scolds Qara , then leaves off to prepare a plan for revenge for her . Appendix . Trivia . There was a scene that Praven and Ashni would comment on Qara and her companions and planning on how to deal with them .

title: Ashok
description: Ashok Ashok was a shadar - kai from the Shadowfell . Formerly a member of a small shadar - kai enclave , he later resided in Ikemmu , where was a considered a champion of the god Tempus . History .
description_long: Ashok Ashok was a shadar - kai from the Shadowfell . Formerly a member of a small shadar - kai enclave , he later resided in Ikemmu , where was a considered a champion of the god Tempus . History . Ashok was raised in a shadar - kai enclave located in a series of large caves north of Ikemmu . Ashok ' s father was the enclave ' s leader and he encouraged his sons to fight each other . Ashok ' s childhood was hardly idyllic as he had to constantly fight his brothers for standing within the clan . As a young man , he gained his father ' s approval by killing a brother in self defense in front of his father . In 1479 DR , the shadar - kai - ruled city of Ikemmu sent a scouting party led by the witch Ilvani to investigate the area near Ashok ' s enclave . At the same time , Ashok ' s father became concerned about a pack of shadow hound s near the enclave and he sent Ashok to eliminate the pack . Ashok killed the pack but was gravely wounded . He was found by a group of shadar - kai from Ikkemu who took him back to the city . The shadar - kai healed Ashok ' s wounds and he was given permission to roam the city , though he was always watched .

title: Ashroot
description: Ashroot Ashroot was a succubus agent of Graz ' zt in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . In the late 1480s DR , the demon lord Graz ' zt sent Ashroot disguised as a deep gnome to spread his madness in Zortagra .
description_long: Ashroot Ashroot was a succubus agent of Graz ' zt in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . In the late 1480s DR , the demon lord Graz ' zt sent Ashroot disguised as a deep gnome to spread his madness in Zortagra . She assisted the ruler Daleen Duerna in her throne room until an adventuring party , hired by Elanil Elassidil to investigate crazed duergar , arrived in Zortagra . Ashroot tried to kill them but the adventurers defeated Ashroot and her shadow demon minions and stopped the spread of madness by taking away her samovar .

title: Asilther Graelor
description: Asilther Graelor Asilther Graelor was an Harper . Personality . Asilther followed always Mintiper , as she saw it , she owed her life to him .
description_long: Asilther Graelor Asilther Graelor was an Harper . Personality . Asilther followed always Mintiper , as she saw it , she owed her life to him . She preferred wilderness than cities . History . Asilther was saved by Mintiper Moonsilver from Calishite slavers . She regained health but not memory , she only remembered to had born in the Forest of Tethir . She lived thieved slavers , especially those from Calimshan and was usually in company of Mintiper . Asilther was an acquaintance of lady Alustriel of Silverymoon and had many dealings with the Lords of Waterdeep but very few knew she was an Harper . Asilther usually performed missions like protecting and guiding some individuals , shadowing or kidnapping others and killing agents of Luskan and of Zhentarim . One of her best exploit was thieved most of the hoard of the adult black dragon Shammagar in mountain north of Waterdeep . Shammagar promised revenge but Asilther discovered thank to exploits of Mirt the secret name of the dragon , that was obliged to avoid a direct confrontation . Later some said she made peace with the dragon , agreeing to restore his hoard .

title: Askalan Larcloaks
description: Askalan Larcloaks Askalan Larcloaks was a gnome wheelwright in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Askalan and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer .
description_long: Askalan Larcloaks Askalan Larcloaks was a gnome wheelwright in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Askalan and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer . He protested about the detention of Lords Cornyn Risingbroke and Yarland Amflame inside Castle Irlingstar .

title: Askar
description: Askar Askar ( askara for females ) were the most common kind of warrior found in Zakhara . They served as the backbone of any defense . Requirements .
description_long: Askar Askar ( askara for females ) were the most common kind of warrior found in Zakhara . They served as the backbone of any defense . Requirements . Askar had no special requirements . Role . Many elite warriors began their careers as askar . They often served as caravan guards , city soldiers , or palace guards . Askar were typically found in urban areas and were more civilized than other warriors . The sky was the limit for how high a warrior beginning as an askar could rise . Many askar were extremely patriotic and were easily offended if their homeland was insulted . Equipment . Askar used a wide variety of weapons and equipment to suite their needs . Special Benefits . Any askar dwelling in their hometown was extremely comfortable and able to move about the city and undertake social interactions such as haggling with ease . Special favors or discounts from merchants were common as well . Special Hindrances . Askar had no special weaknesses other than their short tempers when their homeland was insulted .

title: Askavar
description: Askavar Askavar was an ancient elven settlement in the Glimmerwood . History . The evil wizard Uldoon used to send fiend s from his small realm of Torsil north of the Cloud Peaks to prey upon the elves of Askavar .
description_long: Askavar Askavar was an ancient elven settlement in the Glimmerwood . History . The evil wizard Uldoon used to send fiend s from his small realm of Torsil north of the Cloud Peaks to prey upon the elves of Askavar . Askavar was abandoned sometime in the late 5 century DR , its population leaving for Evermeet and Evereska . Trivia . A woman named Illyra , a scholar in giant lore , owned a collection of Askavarian pottery .

title: Askoro Imo
description: Askoro Imo Askoro Imo was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Imo was always a traveler , never remaining for too long in a place , even if was a good one .
description_long: Askoro Imo Askoro Imo was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Imo was always a traveler , never remaining for too long in a place , even if was a good one . Imo want always saw new things , met new people , and vanquished new foes . Also from a map inherited by his father he searched for the lair of a great creature that was afraid of cats and after vanquished made rich the one who defeated it . In 1357 DR , Imo was among the candidates values by Ko Mei Kho for the mission in Akari . In 1358 Imo was finally persuaded by friends and surviving family that the map represented no more than a fanciful illustration drawn by his father , and that the cat - fearing creature didn ' t exist . However soon after his father appeared to him in a dream telling that map was true but details were incorrect and revealed to Imo the true map . It is unclear if Imo truly trust his map anymore , but he was continuing to explore when was possibly approached by Ko Ho San Behind the scenes . Askoro Imo is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari . He was presented again upgraded for adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Asmodeus
description: Asmodeus Asmodeus ( æz - mo - DAY - us or æz - MO - dee - us ) , an archdevil before the Spellplague , Supreme of the Nine Hells ( or Baator ) , was the god of sin . An ever ambitious and careful creature , Asmodeus retained his position all through the Reckoning of Hell , unlike many of the other archdevils . Asmodeus was lord of Nessus , the Ninth Layer of Hell , though he was generally recognized as lord of all of his divine dominion of Baator , which lay within the Astral Sea .
description_long: Asmodeus Asmodeus ( æz - mo - DAY - us or æz - MO - dee - us ) , an archdevil before the Spellplague , Supreme of the Nine Hells ( or Baator ) , was the god of sin . An ever ambitious and careful creature , Asmodeus retained his position all through the Reckoning of Hell , unlike many of the other archdevils . Asmodeus was lord of Nessus , the Ninth Layer of Hell , though he was generally recognized as lord of all of his divine dominion of Baator , which lay within the Astral Sea . Asmodeus was the undisputed master of the Nine Hells , commanding fear and respect from all those who occupied his realm . Even the gods who dwelt in the Nine Hells gave Asmodeus his proper due . Though the archdevils might work to usurp him , few had the courage to act openly . Asmodeus ’ s machinations were long in the making , and they might take centuries , if not millennia , to see resolution . He worked on a grand scale , carefully constructing insidious and inexplicable intrigues , maneuvering the forces of wickedness like chess pieces on a board that encompasses all the planes . His core concerns were simple .

title: Aspect
description: Aspect An aspect was a lesser incarnation of a powerful creature , often a deity , though sometimes a demon lord or similar creature . An aspect was similar to an avatar , but unlike an avatar it was not a mortal incarnation but rather a powerful supernatural being in its own right . Aspects sometimes appeared to even have a distinct personality or differing abilities from the original personality , though in fact , an aspect was merely another face of that creature .
description_long: Aspect An aspect was a lesser incarnation of a powerful creature , often a deity , though sometimes a demon lord or similar creature . An aspect was similar to an avatar , but unlike an avatar it was not a mortal incarnation but rather a powerful supernatural being in its own right . Aspects sometimes appeared to even have a distinct personality or differing abilities from the original personality , though in fact , an aspect was merely another face of that creature . An example of an aspect was Yondalla , the halfling aspect of Chauntea .

title: Asper
description: Asper Asper was an inhabitant of Waterdeep and the wife of Mirt . Appearance . Asper was a lithe , petite beauty .
description_long: Asper Asper was an inhabitant of Waterdeep and the wife of Mirt . Appearance . Asper was a lithe , petite beauty . Activities . She followed the teachings of Lady Luck , Tymora . During her free time she also served as a member of the Gray Hands . History . Mirt rescued her when she was a babe and raised her .

title: Aspergillum
description: Aspergillum An aspergillum , also called an aspergill , was an implement used for spraying holy water . Description . Aspergillums came in various designs , but often took the form of a small metal club or light mace , sometimes hanging on the end of a chain .
description_long: Aspergillum An aspergillum , also called an aspergill , was an implement used for spraying holy water . Description . Aspergillums came in various designs , but often took the form of a small metal club or light mace , sometimes hanging on the end of a chain . Each had a reservoir inside that would contain a quantity of holy water , ranging from one to three flasks ' worth ( 1 – 3 pints , or 0 . 47 – 1 . 4 liters ) . Pressing a button on the shaft opened up the perforations in the head , allowing holy water to leak out . Alternatively , an aspergillum on a chain could be swung or whirled to spray out the holy water . In this way , the aspergillum could spray holy water over a short distance , using one flask ' s worth per shot , but over a greater distance than simply throwing or pouring it . They could be made of basic metals ( costing 5 gp ) , or of silver ( 20 to 50 gp ) or gold ( 45 gp ) . The heavy aspergillum was designed as a melee weapon , with the effectiveness of a heavy mace . Uses . The aspergillum was used by priests to sprinkle holy water and dispense the power of their god , whether in blessing or spellcasting , in both the temple and on the battlefield .

title: Asperii
description: Asperii Asperii , also known as wind steeds , were magical horse s that possessed keen minds and telepathic powers and the ability to fly . Description . Asperii appeared as normal horses , averaging around eight feet ( 2 .
description_long: Asperii Asperii , also known as wind steeds , were magical horse s that possessed keen minds and telepathic powers and the ability to fly . Description . Asperii appeared as normal horses , averaging around eight feet ( 2 . 4 meters ) tall . They had hides that were dun , gray , or white and long manes that were most often light gray , silver , or white . Behavior . Asperii were sentient creatures , being more intelligent than most human s . They considered hippogriff s and griffon s their mortal enemies and almost always attacked them on sight . Roc s were also sometimes attacked , but usually left alone . Conversely , asperii got on well with pegasi . Should they wish to , they were capable of rescuing those falling from great heights since their touch could impart a " feather fall " spell . Their young , known as " doffs " , were amenable to training as mounts by those of neutral , lawful neutral , and neutral good alignments . Once a rider was accepted , an asperii became devotedly loyal to them , never accepting another unless asked to by their first . Combat . Asperii were usually very gentle , except when it came to their enemies .

title: Asraf el Kahaman
description: Asraf el Kahaman Asraf yn Malik el Kahaman yi Manshaka was one of the most prominent members of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . For unknown reason he remain loyal to Khelben Arunsun even after his transformation .
description_long: Asraf el Kahaman Asraf yn Malik el Kahaman yi Manshaka was one of the most prominent members of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . For unknown reason he remain loyal to Khelben Arunsun even after his transformation . History . Asraf was initially a blood warrior of Manshaka ; after he entered in the Harper s as deep cover agent . He sided with Khelben in during the archmage ' s trial and entered in the Moonstar . At one point Asraf was assaulted and bitten by a vampire but even after his transformation in a night predator he remained loyal to Khelben and continued to be his agent in the Vilhon Reach region .

title: Asram
description: Asram Asram was originally one of the flying cities in ancient Netheril . It was one of only three cities ( the others being Anauria and Hlondath ) high enough above the ground that the reborn Mystra was able to save them before they tumbled to the ground and shattered . Instead , Mystra ensured they landed safely , although never again would they be able to fly .
description_long: Asram Asram was originally one of the flying cities in ancient Netheril . It was one of only three cities ( the others being Anauria and Hlondath ) high enough above the ground that the reborn Mystra was able to save them before they tumbled to the ground and shattered . Instead , Mystra ensured they landed safely , although never again would they be able to fly . After the Fall , Asram slowly expanded to become an independent kingdom . At its height , Asram was the second richest of the three realms that survived Netheril ' s fall . Abandoning or renaming the formerly - floating city that formed the realm ' s core , Asram became governed from the wealthy city of Phelajarama , known as the City of the Serpent for the gold - leaf - covered carved serpents that decorated it . More important , though , was Orolin , the City of Magicians . In Orolin , magic was used in everyday tasks by all citizens , not just the ruling elite as things had been in Netheril . With the wealth of its magicians , Oralin became a city of sprawling orchards and villas , with canals , parks , and a fortress in the city ' s central core .

title: Assad Bazaar
description: Assad Bazaar The Assad Bazaar , or Lion Bazaar , was a marketplace found within the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This bazaar derived its name because it faced a monument of an old hero of Huzuz named Assad al - Assad .
description_long: Assad Bazaar The Assad Bazaar , or Lion Bazaar , was a marketplace found within the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This bazaar derived its name because it faced a monument of an old hero of Huzuz named Assad al - Assad . A 20 ft . ( 6m ) sandstone carving called the Assad Head could be found in the bazaar . Activities . The activity within the Assad Bazaar paled in comparison to the bustle of the Grand Bazaar . Prices here were much steeper as well considering it catered to the wealthy inhabitants of the Court District .

title: Assad Head
description: Assad Head The Assad Head was a sculpture found in the Assad Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This 20 ft .
description_long: Assad Head The Assad Head was a sculpture found in the Assad Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This 20 ft . ( 6m ) tall figure was made of sandstone and resembled a lion ' s head . Its eyes were closed and the mouth was open . Rumors and Legends . Many locals believed the Assad Head would speak if certain events took place . Some even claimed that the head was facing a different direction than when they saw it from the previous night . Some believed that the statue was once an idol worshiped by isolated desert tribes . The statue was believed to have mysteriously followed the tribesmen into civilization once they became Enlightened . Once exposed to the Law of the Loregiver , the statue was said to have become Enlightened itself .

title: Assam
description: Assam Assam was a small city on the northern side of the Shining Plains . Geography . While Assam was the northernmost city in the Shining Plains , it was still several leagues south of the northern edge of the plain .
description_long: Assam Assam was a small city on the northern side of the Shining Plains . Geography . While Assam was the northernmost city in the Shining Plains , it was still several leagues south of the northern edge of the plain . It was located on the southern bank of the Wet River where the road from Ormath crossed the river at a wide ford . Assam had no walls to speak of and relied on its ruling cities for protection . That is not to say Assam was defenseless though , they had a sizable standing militia that kept fights and violence within the city to a minimum . Government . The city - states of Lheshayl and Ormath ruled Assam together . Delegates were sent from both city - states to make up the ruling council . In 1372 DR , Honlinar Tempest was the mayor and he kept everything running smoothly . Honlinar served both city - states and worked hard to keep them happy by dealing with any business interruptions swiftly . The most common dispute brought before the government of Assam was over the intermingling herds of cattle surrounding the city . Trade . Assam was a town of merchants and was dedicated to its trade . The town was surrounded by caravans , wagons , and herds of animals .

title: Assassin
description: Assassin Assassins are deadly and ruthless killers and spies that draw upon the power of shadow magic . Abilities . The abilities of an assassin are skilled at being able to kill or incapacitate a target while avoiding confrontation .
description_long: Assassin Assassins are deadly and ruthless killers and spies that draw upon the power of shadow magic . Abilities . The abilities of an assassin are skilled at being able to kill or incapacitate a target while avoiding confrontation . They are skilled at dealing critical damage from sneak attacks and can poison their weapons without the risk of accidentally poisoning themselves . With training they can deliver a sneak attack that can instantly kill their target ; alternatively , if the target is wanted alive they can merely paralyze it , allowing time for them to be tied up , placed in manacles or otherwise restrained . At higher levels the assassin can even hide themselves while in plain sight of an enemy . Provided they have a high enough intelligence , assassins also gain a limited amount of magical ability , allowing them to cast arcane spells . The spell effects are generally those that make it easier to approach or kill a target , or those that aid the assassin ' s escape if discovered . Only spells up to 4th level may be cast . Requirements for Assassin . To become an assassin , the character must be on an evil alignment .

title: Assassin ' s spear
description: Assassin ' s spear An Assassin ' s Spear is a + 1 magical shortspear that conveys this magical enhancement bonus when used in melee combat , but if thrown , grants the thrower " invisibility " . The enhancement bonus does not function for the duration of the invisibility spell , so it strikes as a normal shortspear . But once the invisibility spell is broken or wears off , the Assassin ' s Spear regains its magical bonus until the next time it is thrown .
description_long: Assassin ' s spear An Assassin ' s Spear is a + 1 magical shortspear that conveys this magical enhancement bonus when used in melee combat , but if thrown , grants the thrower " invisibility " . The enhancement bonus does not function for the duration of the invisibility spell , so it strikes as a normal shortspear . But once the invisibility spell is broken or wears off , the Assassin ' s Spear regains its magical bonus until the next time it is thrown . An Assassin ' s Spear is worth around 8000 gold pieces . Realmslore . The spear was made by a master assassin in the city of Amn who had become bored with all the methods of killing people he had tried . He wanted to be able to kill people in a large crowd in a spectacular fashion and yet still escape undetected . He created five weapons in the form of spears , since these were often carried by city guards , but told no one of their powers . These five items are now scattered across Faerûn . References . Sources . http : / / www . candlekeep . com / library / articles / cov / vehlarr _ 07 . htm

title: Assassin vine
description: Assassin vine An assassin vine was a type of carnivorous plant found in varieties both above and below the surface . Description . A single specimen usually consisted of a 20 - foot - long ( six meters ) main branch as thick as a human ' s forearm .
description_long: Assassin vine An assassin vine was a type of carnivorous plant found in varieties both above and below the surface . Description . A single specimen usually consisted of a 20 - foot - long ( six meters ) main branch as thick as a human ' s forearm . Smaller vines up to five feet ( 150 centimeters ) extended from the main branch and bore clusters of grape - like berries . The bark was stringy . The leaves of an assassin vine were distinct in their asymmetric five - pointed shapes , which resembled a hand . The plants were tougher than usual and were resistant to burning or freezing . Electricity did not harm them at all . The fruit of an assassin vine was tough and bitter , but it could be turned into a strong wine . Assassin vines could move along the ground but very slowly . Variants . A related plant was also found in the Underdark . These varieties had thinner stems and gray leaves with brown , silver , or white veins . Since they could not make energy from the sun , they required a source of thermal energy and would usually generate enough offal to also support colonies of subterranean fungi in a symbiotic relationship . Ecology .

title: Assassins Guild of the Galenas
description: Assassins Guild of the Galenas The Assassins Guild of the Galenas , also called the Citadel of Assassins , was an assassin s guild based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Guild was once loyal to Zhengyi the Witch - King .
description_long: Assassins Guild of the Galenas The Assassins Guild of the Galenas , also called the Citadel of Assassins , was an assassin s guild based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Guild was once loyal to Zhengyi the Witch - King . It remained an enemy to the throne of the Bloodstone Lands In 1372 DR , Bregan D ’ aerthe , under the orders of Jarlaxle ( and with the consent of Kimmuriel Oblodra ) easily infiltrated a base of the guild and forcefully recruited Knellict as an ally , thus bringing the Citadel of Assassins under the influence of the drow mercenary organization . Hierarchy . As of 1372 DR , the leader of the guild was Timoshenko , Grandfather of Assassins , who played the political face of the organization . His chief lieutenent , the wizard Knellict , carried out the dirty work . Headquarters . After the fall of Zhengyi , the Citadel was chased from Heliogabalus . They took refuge in a complex of caverns in the mountainside of the Galena Mountains , east of the Vaasan Gate . Suites of rooms reach far back into the mountain , some carved by hired stone masons and miners , many others created by Knellict ' s magic .

title: Assault on Maerimydra
description: Assault on Maerimydra Assault on Maerimydra , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the cavern of Sporedome , drow , fire giant s , and Maerimydra . Summary .
description_long: Assault on Maerimydra Assault on Maerimydra , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the cavern of Sporedome , drow , fire giant s , and Maerimydra . Summary . The adventure begins with adventurers gathering in Sporedome with the various factions that have rallied against the fire giant s of Maerimydra . The arrayed factions work together to concoct a plan to assault Maerimydra , splitting their forces across various objectives .

title: Assembly
description: Assembly The Assembly was a meeting hall in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . It was a huge , barn - like building . The Assembly was used to hold a variety of gatherings , including civic , private , and religious events .
description_long: Assembly The Assembly was a meeting hall in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . It was a huge , barn - like building . The Assembly was used to hold a variety of gatherings , including civic , private , and religious events . In poor weather , it became an under - cover town square or marketplace , where vendors erected booths to sell food , drink , and various goods and trinkets . Occasionally , public bouts were hosted , and were the subject of discreet betting . The hall was also a destination for folk seeking news , rumors , jobs , or to meet people . The interior walls were bedecked with help wanted advertisements and other notices .

title: Astanalan
description: Astanalan Astanalan was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Astanalan was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .
description_long: Astanalan Astanalan was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Astanalan was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . He was one of the dragons Alasklerbanbastos sought out to attack Luthcheq and destroy the Brotherhood of the Griffon after the dracolich and Brimstone discovered Aoth Fezim attempts to disrupt the " xorvintaal " . During the Battle of Luthcheq , Astanalan was freed of the compulsion of the " xorvintaal " by the dragonborn paladin Medrash , he turned against Alasklerbanbastos and Tchazzar . He later went to Dracowyr alongside the Brotherhood of the Griffon , the dragonborn Medrash and Balasar , and the surviving dragons of the Battle of Luthcheq . Together , they put an end to Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Astilabor
description: Astilabor Astilabor ( pronounced " As - TIL - uh - bore " ) was the neutral dragon goddess of acquisitiveness and wealth . She represented the draconic desire to acquire and treasure wealth and by doing so gain status , and so she was , in a way , the archetype of dragonkind . Description .
description_long: Astilabor Astilabor ( pronounced " As - TIL - uh - bore " ) was the neutral dragon goddess of acquisitiveness and wealth . She represented the draconic desire to acquire and treasure wealth and by doing so gain status , and so she was , in a way , the archetype of dragonkind . Description . Astilabor usually manifested as a huge dragon that shimmered with all the chromatic and metallic colors of dragonkind . Realm . Astilabor ' s home plane was unknown , but she was reputed to have a lair hidden somewhere in the plane of Limbo that contained more wealth than that found on all the planets of Realmspace . Worshipers . Astilabor was revered by dragons of all kinds but actively worshiped by few . She was also worshiped by draconic humanoids and by those who sought to increase their wealth . However , even those dragons that only paid lip service to her engraved her holy symbol on their hoards as a protective ward .

title: Astral Plane
description: Astral Plane The Astral plane ( sometimes Astral Plane ) was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Astral Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Astral plane connected the Prime Material Plane s to the first layers of the Outer planes .
description_long: Astral Plane The Astral plane ( sometimes Astral Plane ) was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Astral Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Astral plane connected the Prime Material Plane s to the first layers of the Outer planes . The Astral could be reached from almost any point in a Prime Material plane or first layer of any Outer plane by spell , psionic ability , or device . It was described as a barren place of other - dimensional nothingness extending in all directions . What little solid substance that floated in the bright , gray void was typically chunks of matter broken off from their original plane . The Astral had no gravity but objects did retain their mass so you could throw small items or push off from large objects to move in the weightless environment . Time in the Astral flowed at the same rate on a Prime Material plane but the " effects " of time were slowed almost to a stop — a thousand years in the Astral plane felt like only a day to the traveler .

title: Astral Sea
description: Astral Sea The Astral Sea , formerly known also as Astral Plane , was the home of the gods in the World Axis cosmology model of the planes of existence for the Forgotten Realms . The Astral Sea was described as being " above " the Prime Material Plane and its two reflections , the Feywild and the Shadowfell . The Spellplague destroyed the World Tree and set the dominion s of the gods adrift to wander about in the silvery void .
description_long: Astral Sea The Astral Sea , formerly known also as Astral Plane , was the home of the gods in the World Axis cosmology model of the planes of existence for the Forgotten Realms . The Astral Sea was described as being " above " the Prime Material Plane and its two reflections , the Feywild and the Shadowfell . The Spellplague destroyed the World Tree and set the dominion s of the gods adrift to wander about in the silvery void . Access to the Astral Sea was accomplished through passages found in the world or using the proper ritual . Once in the Sea , travel was initiated by thought and was very similar to flying . In addition to the astral dominions , the Astral Sea could be used by powerful beings to create demiplane s by focusing on an idea and applying a strong will . Each demiplane had its own traits and physical laws as dictated by the one who created it , and was always smaller than an astral dominion . If abandoned , it will break apart and fade from existence just like an astral dominion . The Astral Sea is unique in that it is infinitesimal instead of infinite ; there is no space or time here , though both catch up with you when you leave .

title: Astral dominion
description: Astral dominion Astral dominions , sometimes simply called dominions or more archaically the Outer Planes , were distinct plane s connected by the Astral Sea which were inhabited and maintained often , but not always , by one or more god s . In many ways an astral dominion was a plane in and of itself , and sometimes contained its own demiplane s . Nonetheless , each dominion was a part of the greater Astral Sea as described by the World Axis cosmology model .
description_long: Astral dominion Astral dominions , sometimes simply called dominions or more archaically the Outer Planes , were distinct plane s connected by the Astral Sea which were inhabited and maintained often , but not always , by one or more god s . In many ways an astral dominion was a plane in and of itself , and sometimes contained its own demiplane s . Nonetheless , each dominion was a part of the greater Astral Sea as described by the World Axis cosmology model . Each Astral dominion was unique and shaped by the will and nature of its creator and ruler . Some dominions were planet - sized , while others were far smaller — no bigger than small cities or even singular structures — although in general dominions were depicted as wondrous isles floating in a vast and infinite sea . Because each dominion was within the Astral Sea , none of the dominions were infinite in size , though they were often so large as to seem limitless . Often , astral dominions were viewed as places of divine reward or punishment , though this was not strictly true .

title: Astral dragon
description: Astral dragon An astral dragon was a type of dragon that was able to inhabit the Astral Sea . They were chromatic dragon s , but they bore only a slight resemblance to others in their subtype . Abilities .
description_long: Astral dragon An astral dragon was a type of dragon that was able to inhabit the Astral Sea . They were chromatic dragon s , but they bore only a slight resemblance to others in their subtype . Abilities . Astral dragons could see through the blur of the Astral Plane for up to ten miles ( 16 km ) , and could " plane shift " frequently , at will . They were able to fly on the Prime Material Plane thanks to an organ in the head , although they were not easily able to walk under the effect of gravity . Combat . In battle against creatures not native to the Astral Plane , the astral dragon would prioritize attacking spellcasters , since they might be responsible for keeping their companions in the Astral Plane , so killing them would defeat the entire group . Although an astral dragon had no psionic abilities , it could sense psionic abilities in others , up to around 240 ft ( 73 m ) . Ecology . Birth and development . A female astral dragon could lay one egg , 5 ft ( 152 cm ) in diameter , every few hundred years . This egg grew , over many years , to 10 ft ( 3 m ) in diameter and a hole opened at one end .

title: Astral projection
description: Astral projection Astral projection was a necromancy spell that projected the caster and his / her companions into the Astral Plane . Formerly , this spell was called the astral spell and was a member of the alteration school . Effects .
description_long: Astral projection Astral projection was a necromancy spell that projected the caster and his / her companions into the Astral Plane . Formerly , this spell was called the astral spell and was a member of the alteration school . Effects . Freeing your spirit from your physical body , this spell allows you to project an astral body into another plane altogether . You can bring the astral forms of other creatures with you , provided the creatures are linked in a circle with you at the time of the casting . These fellow travellers are dependent upon you and must accompany you at all times . If something happens to you during the journey , the companions are stranded wherever you left them . You project your astral self into the Astral Plane , leaving your physical body behind on the Material Plane in a state of suspended animation . The spell projects an astral copy of you and all you wear or carry onto the Astral Plane . Since the Astral Plane touches upon other planes , you can travel astrally to any of these other plane s as you will . You then leave the Astral Plane , forming a new physical body ( and equipment ) on the plane of existence you have chosen to enter .

title: Astral sphere
description: Astral sphere The Astral sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that allowed access to other planes of existence via the Astral Plane . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Astral Sphere in the sourcebook .
description_long: Astral sphere The Astral sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that allowed access to other planes of existence via the Astral Plane . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Astral Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Astral stalker
description: Astral stalker Astral stalkers are abomination s created by the gods as weapons for use in the Dawn War . Devious and bloodthirsty killers , astral stalkers have served since the Dawn War primarily as bounty hunters and assassins , though often they hunt simply for the sake of the challenge in cornering dangerous prey . Originally , astral stalkers were created by the gods in order to fight the primordial s and their servants .
description_long: Astral stalker Astral stalkers are abomination s created by the gods as weapons for use in the Dawn War . Devious and bloodthirsty killers , astral stalkers have served since the Dawn War primarily as bounty hunters and assassins , though often they hunt simply for the sake of the challenge in cornering dangerous prey . Originally , astral stalkers were created by the gods in order to fight the primordial s and their servants . Since the Dawn War , the astral stalkers have fallen away from their old allegiances , becoming independent from their creators . Astral stalkers often gather in small tribes , led by the most skilled hunter within the group . Physical characteristics . Astral stalkers are greenish - black humanoids , and are roughly the size of a human , though they appear notably more bestial . With toothed mouths , long , razor - sharp claws , and glowing eyes , astral stalkers look appropriately predatory for a race with such a function as theirs .

title: Astrid Saj
description: Astrid Saj Astrid Saj was a wealthy merchant in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Astrid was part of a merchant house that hoped to enter into the city ' s Blade elite .
description_long: Astrid Saj Astrid Saj was a wealthy merchant in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Astrid was part of a merchant house that hoped to enter into the city ' s Blade elite . In order to gain useful contacts , she hosted a great party at her villa in 1491 DR .

title: Astrolabe of entrapment
description: Astrolabe of entrapment Astrolabes of entrapment were rare magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These spherical were usually made of metal .
description_long: Astrolabe of entrapment Astrolabes of entrapment were rare magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These spherical were usually made of metal . Inscriptions of planet and constellation locations were found on the exterior . Powers . Those proficient with the use of regular astrolabes could use this to determine the time , date , and latitude . The main power of this item was its ability to trap genie s . Each of these items contained twelve genie prisons arranged inside of the metallic sphere . These prisons rotated with the constellations , so only one genie prison was active during any given month . During this time the owner could use any of the following three powers : The currently aligned prison deactivated at the end of each calendar month . This lasted for the next eleven months .
