During this time the genie was trapped with no chance of release . Only a powerful diviner was able to determine the exact type of genie trapped within each prison .

title: Astrologer
description: Astrologer Astrologers were unique wizard s in Zakhara who used the constellation s to enhance their spells and other powers . Requirements . Due to the strict nature of their unique way of practicing magic , astrologers tended to be very ordered and lawful individuals .
description_long: Astrologer Astrologers were unique wizard s in Zakhara who used the constellation s to enhance their spells and other powers . Requirements . Due to the strict nature of their unique way of practicing magic , astrologers tended to be very ordered and lawful individuals . Role . These wizards often had the reputation of being mad scientists and were regarded with a healthy mixture of respect and fear . Because they needed a wide variety of expensive and rare equipment in order to fully function , astrologers usually hailed from wealthy families or possessed other connections to wealthy individuals . Astrologers always constructed their laboratories far from cities . Many Zakharan rulers who desired to have an astrologer as a member of their court looked upon them with disfavor because of this , because they believed the astrologers were being reclusive to thumb their noses at others . This was not the case . Astrologers built their towers far from cities because the light produced by cities during the night impacted the astrologer ' s work in a negative manner by making it harder for them to properly view the constellations .

title: Astrosphinx
description: Astrosphinx Malevolent sphinx es whose heads resemble goat skulls . Combat . An astrosphinx uses its two great horns to attack with a head - butt first , striking with each horn separately .
description_long: Astrosphinx Malevolent sphinx es whose heads resemble goat skulls . Combat . An astrosphinx uses its two great horns to attack with a head - butt first , striking with each horn separately . Its bite is vicious and the claw - like hands are enough to finish most prey off in one hit . In rare instances ( 5 % of the time ) the creature wields a magical chaos sword of a large proportion . The magic sword is of + 1 enchantment and deals additional damage to lawful opponents . In melee the astrosphinx attacks homicidally , mindlessly until nothing living is still standing . As a rule the sphinx starts combat with its chain lightning first , followed on the next by its breath weapon and then launches itself into melee . Breath weapon . Like dragon s , the astrosphinx ' s have a breath weapon . They may breathe a cone of sleep gas ( 80 ft long and 40 feet wide ) . Targets caught will fall asleep for 1 - 6 minutes . Victims in wildspace in their own air - bubble remain asleep until the gas is somehow flushed out of the air supply . Abilities . The most feared attack of the astrosphinx is the ability to shoot a chain lightning , from its eye sockets .

title: Asuras
description: Asuras Asuras were good messenger spirits in service to deities , and as such were the main competitors to the deva s . They were a symbol of goodness and light , kindness and tenderness , and often appeared on the Material Plane helping mystic s and faithful . Description .
description_long: Asuras Asuras were good messenger spirits in service to deities , and as such were the main competitors to the deva s . They were a symbol of goodness and light , kindness and tenderness , and often appeared on the Material Plane helping mystic s and faithful . Description . An asuras resembled a human with marble - pale skin and huge red wings . Their feet were armed with eagle claws and they wore loose togas . Combat . From time immemorial , asuras were messengers , not soldiers , but their strength and combat experience were not to be underestimated . They preferred to attack their opponents from the air , causing terrible wounds by claws and hand - held weapons . Being one of the wisest creatures in the outer planes , they were immune to many forms of enchantment and were completely protected from illusion s . Thanks to their marvelous vision , an asuras could easily recognize lies and punish the guilty . Asuras could also transform into a human or demihuman to go unnoticed . In this case , their abilities were retained . Habitat / Society . In their native planes , asuras were managed by experienced commanders who they unconditionally obeyed .

title: Aswidorg
description: Aswidorg Aswidorg was a juvenile black dragon whose lair was in the Serpent Hills and the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . He was the great - grandson of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the son of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the brother of the black dragons Woklef , Cheleen and Kasidikal .
description_long: Aswidorg Aswidorg was a juvenile black dragon whose lair was in the Serpent Hills and the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . He was the great - grandson of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the son of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the brother of the black dragons Woklef , Cheleen and Kasidikal .

title: Aswiyah al - Muftahir
description: Aswiyah al - Muftahir Aswiyah al - Muftahir was the caliph of Muluk in 1367 DR . Personality . Aswiyah was a crafty and cunning individual , just like her ancestors .
description_long: Aswiyah al - Muftahir Aswiyah al - Muftahir was the caliph of Muluk in 1367 DR . Personality . Aswiyah was a crafty and cunning individual , just like her ancestors . She preferred to be addressed as " Caliph " , as opposed to the traditional feminine title of " Calipha . " Activities . The Caliph exercised her political skills during her reign by successfully negotiating alliances with each of the Free Cities of Zakhara . Relationships . Aswiyah was the eldest daughter of the previous caliph , Ibrahim al - Muftahir . She was the mother of princess Hadra bint Aswiyah .

title: Aszundar Zel
description: Aszundar Zel Aszundar Zel was a diplomat of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1350s DR . Around 1354 DR , Aszundar Zel paid a visit to the royal court of Cormyr and met Princess Alusair Obarskyr , later describing her as " impish " and " winsomely beautiful " .
description_long: Aszundar Zel Aszundar Zel was a diplomat of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1350s DR . Around 1354 DR , Aszundar Zel paid a visit to the royal court of Cormyr and met Princess Alusair Obarskyr , later describing her as " impish " and " winsomely beautiful " .

title: Atabeg al - Mazdaghani
description: Atabeg al - Mazdaghani Atabeg al - Mazdaghani was a noble marid who lived under the waters of the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Activities . The noble marid aggressively confronted any ship daring to drop anchor in his waters .
description_long: Atabeg al - Mazdaghani Atabeg al - Mazdaghani was a noble marid who lived under the waters of the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Activities . The noble marid aggressively confronted any ship daring to drop anchor in his waters . He was fond of making sailors take vows of servitude . He usually put them to work underwater and granted them a water breathing ability .

title: Ataman al - Hajar
description: Ataman al - Hajar Ataman al - Hajar was a noble dao who lived deep within an intricate cave system on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Ataman was short for a noble dao , but still possessed a truly massive frame .
description_long: Ataman al - Hajar Ataman al - Hajar was a noble dao who lived deep within an intricate cave system on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Ataman was short for a noble dao , but still possessed a truly massive frame . Personality . Like most noble dao , Ataman al - Hajar was an irritable genie who found it difficult to be polite to those who were beneath him . Activities . He directed a force of xorn and earth elemental s beneath the mountains of Al - Zira , collecting gems , precious ore , and other treasures .

title: Athalantar
description: Athalantar Athalantar ( also known as the Realm of the Stag ) whose capital , Hastarl , stood on the site of the settlement of Secomber , was a small human kingdom in the North . Geography . The Unicorn Run made its path through the middle of Athalantar , creating rich farmlands on its way to the Delimbiyr in the south where , the capital , Hastarl stood .
description_long: Athalantar Athalantar ( also known as the Realm of the Stag ) whose capital , Hastarl , stood on the site of the settlement of Secomber , was a small human kingdom in the North . Geography . The Unicorn Run made its path through the middle of Athalantar , creating rich farmlands on its way to the Delimbiyr in the south where , the capital , Hastarl stood . The northern border of Athalantar was defined by the edge of the High Forest that was slowly expanded by dilligent foresters over the years . History . Founded in 183 DR by Uthgrael Aumar , the " Stag King " , Athalantar occupied the area just south of what is now the High Forest . The kingdom helped to unite the leaderless farming communities of the area and was well on its way to greatness until the Stag King died in 216 DR . Eventually after much in - fighting between the princes of the realm the eldest prince , Belaur Aumar , took the throne in 218 DR with the help of powerful wizards ( later known as Magelord s ) .

title: Athalee
description: Athalee Athalee was an elf living in Kryptgarden Forest in past ages . History . Athalee was in a forgotten past a scholar who lived and died in Kryptgarden .
description_long: Athalee Athalee was an elf living in Kryptgarden Forest in past ages . History . Athalee was in a forgotten past a scholar who lived and died in Kryptgarden . In 1489 DR , the Red Wizard necromancer Zaralda raised him as an undead like many others . However , he was able to resist the compelling orders of the necromancer . Hating his new condition , Athalee attacked Zaralda and her allies , hoping to die with his tormentor . In the end , after an attack in which he killed many cultists and Thay ans , an adventuring party hired to defeat Claugiyliamatar assaulted Zaralda and her minions . Sensing the good will of the adventurers , he tested them to solve a riddle . After they solved it , Athalee manifested and offered his aid against Old Gnawbones in exchange for the death of Zaralda and the adventurers agreed .

title: Atherton Cooper
description: Atherton Cooper Atherton Cooper was an unusually tall , hawk - nosed halfling thief who often wore leathers and wielded the magic sword " Godsbane " before it was stolen from his village by the Zhent army led by Cyric . Personality . Atherton often responded to Sneakabout , and liked to show off his tracking skills .
description_long: Atherton Cooper Atherton Cooper was an unusually tall , hawk - nosed halfling thief who often wore leathers and wielded the magic sword " Godsbane " before it was stolen from his village by the Zhent army led by Cyric . Personality . Atherton often responded to Sneakabout , and liked to show off his tracking skills . He was found very entertaining by Kae Deverell and his men . Allies . Sneakabout had many allies : Radnor , the Cormyr ian ranger ; Midnight , the magic - user from Deepingdale , and Midnight ' s companions , Kelemvor and Adon . History . Early Life . Little is known about Sneakabout ' s early life . He was known to have stolen " Godsbane " from its previous owner before killing him , but not before the sword ' s former owner had gone mad . Time of Troubles . Atherton Cooper met Midnight ' s band shortly after his village was razed by the Zhentarim and the halflings of his village had robbed them blind . During the battle , Cyric stole " Godsbane " and Atherton ' s pony . He died trying to recover the blade . After Death .

title: Athkatla
description: Athkatla Athkatla was the capital city of Amn . Considered a pilgrimage site for followers of Waukeen , the City of Coin was rumoured to have streets paved with gold . This was , of course , untrue , especially in the slums and the notorious Docks districts , where people were poor and crime was rife .
description_long: Athkatla Athkatla was the capital city of Amn . Considered a pilgrimage site for followers of Waukeen , the City of Coin was rumoured to have streets paved with gold . This was , of course , untrue , especially in the slums and the notorious Docks districts , where people were poor and crime was rife . Just about anything was acceptable in Athkatla and actions that would be illegal or immoral in other lands were tolerated . The law permitted nearly anything including lewdness and slavery . Government . Athkatla was ruled by the Council of Five ( formerly the Council of Six ) . Although council positions were once held anonymously , the council members now rule openly . The five council positions were held by : House Selemchant who sponsors the Cowled Wizards of Athkatla , House Dannihyr which belongs to the Shadow Thieves , House Alibakkar , House Ophal and House Nashivaar which is closely allied with the Church of Cyric . Locations . Daranthur ' s Hall . Daranthur ' s Hall is a market found in downtown Athkatla . It is the first of the " shared - roof " markets that is becoming increasingly popular in Amn .

title: Athorton
description: Athorton Athorton was a sage from Nleeth on Vilhon Reach , living in the 13th century DR . History . Athorton was a young sage in the early 1200s DR .
description_long: Athorton Athorton was a sage from Nleeth on Vilhon Reach , living in the 13th century DR . History . Athorton was a young sage in the early 1200s DR . By the mid – 14th century DR , it was theorized that it was Athorton who stole the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater — from the priestess of Loviatar , Lalaskra of Ormpetarr . Lalaskra had worn the hairshirt tome constantly , but removed it during a ritual in the Year of the Crimson Crag , 1211 DR when it was stolen by an unknown thief , who also managed to make off with the tome ' s covers , stored in a backroom in Lalaskra ' s quarters in a nearby temple . Incensed , Lalaskra whipped her Loviatan minions into a frantic search for the " Tome " all across the southern Vilhon Reach lands , though without success . In later years , Athorton wrote extensively of the magic of the Ilmatari — magic known to few outsiders and widely mocked — and he may have acquired such knowledge via the " Tome " . As an old man , he became friends with Beromchess Ilthyn , a local priestess of Ilmater .

title: Athrogate
description: Athrogate Athrogate was a dwarven warrior of some reputation in the Bloodstone Lands and later in the North . He later became a companion of Jarlaxle and an agent of Bregan D ' aerthe . Description .
description_long: Athrogate Athrogate was a dwarven warrior of some reputation in the Bloodstone Lands and later in the North . He later became a companion of Jarlaxle and an agent of Bregan D ' aerthe . Description . Athrogate had the stout and powerful build of a typical dwarf . He wore his black beard parted in the middle , with two long braids of straight hair running down to midchest , each tied off at the end with a band set with three sparkling blue gemstones , or occasionally tipped with dung . His bushy eyebrows nearly covered his brown , almost black eyes . He had large ears . He wore a suit of armor , part leather , part plated , and covered with a myriad of buckles and straps . His twin morningstar s were tied in an X at his back , their handles reaching up and well beyond the back of his bushy hair . Athrogate ( perhaps jokingly ) explained to Jarlaxle that he was cursed by a wizard to live a long life and never to forget the hardship he went through . Thus , although few dwarves reached 300 years of age , Athrogate was about 370 years old . Personality .

title: Atia Scorvo
description: Atia Scorvo Atia Scorvo was a medusa member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . Personality . Atia was a cruel and vain individual .
description_long: Atia Scorvo Atia Scorvo was a medusa member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . Personality . Atia was a cruel and vain individual . She believed that all must admit that Atia was the most beautiful being . Those who eloquently praised her could sometimes delay their doom , but never for long . Atia also liked to play with her victims , offering an alliance but then quickly rejecting them and destroying anyone who believed her . History . Atia Scorvo was once a queen in Chessenta . She became obsessed with searching for the perfect suitor for her . Atia tried to fuse her most beautiful servants together in new bodies . For these crimes , she was transformed into a medusa . In recent times , by 1491 DR , she joined the Cult of the Black Earth and with her new powers and gargoyle minions she took control of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones in the Earthspur Mountains , reconsecrating it to Ogremoch . She managed to defeat the Ludwakazar dwarves , mortally wounding their king , Iorn Ludwakazar . However , an adventuring party hired to clear the mine eventually arrived and destroyed her .

title: Atiq el Catahras
description: Atiq el Catahras Atiq el Catahras was the owner of The Roving Rune , a popular inn in Teshburl , in 1370 DR . Relationships . Atiq was the nephew of former wizard who used to occupy the minaret tower in which The Roving Rune resided .
description_long: Atiq el Catahras Atiq el Catahras was the owner of The Roving Rune , a popular inn in Teshburl , in 1370 DR . Relationships . Atiq was the nephew of former wizard who used to occupy the minaret tower in which The Roving Rune resided . He was married to a woman named Raisa , and they had a daughter named Oma . The two woman were mage s — a rarity in Teshburl — and with his blessing they practiced their skills in the secret basement level of the tower . History . Atiq had previously lived in Memnon , until he learned that he had inherited a wizard ' s tower from his uncle . So he moved his family south to the isolated town of Teshburl and converted the former magic school into an inn and tavern . He had never fully understood all the secrets the tower had to offer .

title: Atl - Ollin
description: Atl - Ollin Atl - Ollin was a high priest of Calor in Nexal . History . Around 1351 DR , after a series of portents , Naltecona gathered all the high priests to ask them what the gods wished .
description_long: Atl - Ollin Atl - Ollin was a high priest of Calor in Nexal . History . Around 1351 DR , after a series of portents , Naltecona gathered all the high priests to ask them what the gods wished . Afterward , Naltecona questioned Atl - Ollin directly , who answered honestly that he did not understand the portents ' meaning .

title: Atonement
description: Atonement Atonement was an abjuration spell that could restore status , alignment , or abilities to a being who suffered a loss due to misdeeds against their deity or alignment . Effects . This spell could be used to alleviate a variety of moral and ethical ailments caused by acts contrary to the ethos of their class , religion , or profession , either good versus evil , law versus chaos , or both .
description_long: Atonement Atonement was an abjuration spell that could restore status , alignment , or abilities to a being who suffered a loss due to misdeeds against their deity or alignment . Effects . This spell could be used to alleviate a variety of moral and ethical ailments caused by acts contrary to the ethos of their class , religion , or profession , either good versus evil , law versus chaos , or both . It could also be used to grant an opportunity to shift alignment to that of the caster . Removing the onus of misdeeds required the subject to be truly repentant and have a strong desire to set things right . Often the caster of " atonement " would give the subject a task , penance , or " quest " to complete in order to prove the subject ' s commitment to change . In the most serious cases , a " geas " could be used . Possible applications for " atonement " included : If the subject committed the misdeed unwittingly or while under some form of compulsion , then forgiveness was usually without great price ( only material goods ) .

title: Atorrnash
description: Atorrnash Atorrnash was an ancient city of dark elves in the southern parts of Faerûn . It existed in the Dawn Age and was ruled by an Iythiiri - archmage . The City was on a peninsula surrounded by the sea on three sides .
description_long: Atorrnash Atorrnash was an ancient city of dark elves in the southern parts of Faerûn . It existed in the Dawn Age and was ruled by an Iythiiri - archmage . The City was on a peninsula surrounded by the sea on three sides . The whole City was made of dark stone drawn from the earth itself in the form of finished buildings . Gemstones formed elaborate mosaics and patterns on walls or paved the walkways . A wall of black rock surrounded the city . Atorrnash was destroyed during the changes and earthquakes following the First Sundering . Inhabitants . It was the city of Ilythiiri , dark elves and ancestors of the drow . But it was also a place of merchants and many of other folk came as visitors or lived there as minor classes . Some of the strangest creatures may have been created by magical meanings as slaves for the dark elves . Religion . The ruler of the city , the archmage Ka ' Narlist was a worshiper of Ghaunadaur but there were also worshipers of Vhaeraun at that time . Notable location . Ka ' Narlist ' s Keep . Atorrnash was dominated by a huge estate , surrounded by a high wall . It was a single expanse of solid rock .

title: Atreus Eleint
description: Atreus Eleint Atreus Eleint was a wealthy human noble and the descendant of an unknown noble family living in Erlkazar . A spell used on him in his youth had distorted his growth and caused him to become severely deformed , not detracting much from his physical abilities but ruining his appearance . This virtual handicap prevented him from living a normal life and caused him to become obsessed with trying to become handsome .
description_long: Atreus Eleint Atreus Eleint was a wealthy human noble and the descendant of an unknown noble family living in Erlkazar . A spell used on him in his youth had distorted his growth and caused him to become severely deformed , not detracting much from his physical abilities but ruining his appearance . This virtual handicap prevented him from living a normal life and caused him to become obsessed with trying to become handsome . Eventually , he joined the church of Sune , asking for a miracle , and was sent on an impossible quest to the Utter East to find the valley of Langdarma .

title: Atropal
description: Atropal Atropals are a race of unfinished immortal s modeled after the god s , who have since become undead abomination s . Existing solely to spread death and destruction , atropals roam across the planes , hunting down any prey that comes their way . Others are sealed away in forgotten delves .
description_long: Atropal Atropals are a race of unfinished immortal s modeled after the god s , who have since become undead abomination s . Existing solely to spread death and destruction , atropals roam across the planes , hunting down any prey that comes their way . Others are sealed away in forgotten delves . Physical characteristics . Atropals resemble ghoul s to some extent , with pale red skin , long tongues , and razor - sharp teeth . Most of the flesh of an atropal is rotted , with swollen joints and exposed bones . Unlike ghouls , however , atropals lack eyes , having instead empty , skin - covered sockets . They resemble the avatar s of the elder evil Atropus . Abilities . Atropals are very durable , as well as dexterous , and when in a fight they can use this to outlast their enemies . When forced into a direct fight , however , atropals are armed with several powerful abilities .

title: Atropus
description: Atropus Atropus , known as the World Born Dead , was an undead primordial whose coming was a harbinger of death and destruction . Description . Once a great power , little remained of Atropus but a decaying , disembodied head the size of a small moon , apparently made of black stone , heavily cratered , and covered with foul amniotic fluid .
description_long: Atropus Atropus , known as the World Born Dead , was an undead primordial whose coming was a harbinger of death and destruction . Description . Once a great power , little remained of Atropus but a decaying , disembodied head the size of a small moon , apparently made of black stone , heavily cratered , and covered with foul amniotic fluid . It was barren and rocky , roughly spherical and with mountainous ridges , deep trenches , and sharp spikes upthrusting from the ground . Noxious tar bubbled up from the craters . Glossy black stones , each 40 miles in diameter , formed its eyes . Atropal s were said to be cast - off detritus from Atropus ' s substance . Undead conjured from nightmares also inhabited the world , and the master of them all was a headless , alien humanoid that was the focus of Atropus ' s incomprehensible intellect . History . The sages who knew of Atropus all agreed that it was created when Ao created the first gods , though they didn ' t had a unified theory about how it was born .

title: Atsuko
description: Atsuko Atsuko was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Atsuko was a very paranoid individual .
description_long: Atsuko Atsuko was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Atsuko was a very paranoid individual . She always questioned people who followed her . Activities . Atsuko was one of the best accomplices of Naga . She was a yakuza collector of medium rank .

title: Aubaudameira Dree
description: Aubaudameira Dree Aubaudameira Dree , usually known as Alais , was a female elf who was the herald of the Coronal Eltargrim of Cormanthyr . History . Alais was a prominent member of Dree House .
description_long: Aubaudameira Dree Aubaudameira Dree , usually known as Alais , was a female elf who was the herald of the Coronal Eltargrim of Cormanthyr . History . Alais was a prominent member of Dree House . However , she was mentally enslaved by her fiancé , Glarald Starym , who used her in an attempt to kill the coronal . Glarald ' s plot failed and Alais was freed and became the new herald of the coronal , becoming one of his most trusted servants . Alais also lend her life - force for the raising of the " mythal " in 261 DR .

title: Aubrin Crownsilver
description: Aubrin Crownsilver Aubrin Crownsilver , who usually went by his nickname " Brin " , was a young acolyte of Torm and the scion of the Crownsilver family of Cormyr . Due to his grandmother ' s dalliance with a prince of Cormyr , his father was a bastard Obarskyr , which , under Cormyrean law , placed him in the line of succession for the throne . According to Cormyrean succession rules , Brin was currently fourth in line for the throne as of 1479 DR .
description_long: Aubrin Crownsilver Aubrin Crownsilver , who usually went by his nickname " Brin " , was a young acolyte of Torm and the scion of the Crownsilver family of Cormyr . Due to his grandmother ' s dalliance with a prince of Cormyr , his father was a bastard Obarskyr , which , under Cormyrean law , placed him in the line of succession for the throne . According to Cormyrean succession rules , Brin was currently fourth in line for the throne as of 1479 DR . Early Life . Brin ' s father was assassinated by Crownsilver rivals when Brin was just a boy , presumably because of his father ' s claim to the throne . His second cousin , Constancia Crownsilver , was assigned to look after him and be his nursemaid . Later , Brin ' s aunt , Helindra Crownsilver , placed him in a Tormite monastery to hide him from rivals . Brin was an indifferent acolyte and was not happy at the monastery . Teen Years . In 1477 DR , Brin ran away from the monastary , which led the Tormites to charge Constancia with dereliction of duty . When Constancia followed Brin to the Sword Coast region the Tormites placed a bounty on her .

title: Auckney
description: Auckney Auckney was a small fiefdom near the Spine of the World . It was ruled by the noble Auck family . Because its cold location was somewhat removed from busy trade routes , it was not often visited .
description_long: Auckney Auckney was a small fiefdom near the Spine of the World . It was ruled by the noble Auck family . Because its cold location was somewhat removed from busy trade routes , it was not often visited . Geography . Auckney was located on the Sea of Swords near the western edge of the Spine of the World . The village hugged a small , round harbor that was dominated by an island topped by Castle Auck . Sea cliffs lined the southern edge of the harbor and beyond the village ' s farms was the steep Maerlon Mountain . Description . The village was constantly beset by fog and strong , cold wind . An abandoned lighthouse sat on a cliff to the north of the harbor . Villagers said they could sometimes hear a woman screaming from inside the tower . In part because of its location in the harbor , Castle Auck was removed from the village . The castle , which had two 15 - foot - tall towers and a 12 - room house , itself was built in the 8th century DR by the Dorigast family . However , the Auck family had reigned there for more than 400 years . In addition to the Auck family themselves and their steward , half a dozen servants and ten guards lived or worked in the castle .

title: Audara Imryth
description: Audara Imryth Audara Imryth was a cleric of Mystra and a potion - seller in Westgate in 1370 DR . Secretly , she was a member of the Harpers , watching over the city . Audara was affiliated with the Harper branch based in Shadowdale and had a strained relationship with fellow local Harper Jamal , whom she did not trust .
description_long: Audara Imryth Audara Imryth was a cleric of Mystra and a potion - seller in Westgate in 1370 DR . Secretly , she was a member of the Harpers , watching over the city . Audara was affiliated with the Harper branch based in Shadowdale and had a strained relationship with fellow local Harper Jamal , whom she did not trust . In case of necessity , she would agree to work with her , however .

title: Audra Maskyr
description: Audra Maskyr Audra Maskyr was a sergeant of the Mulmaster City Watch . Personality . The sergeant was one of the more ambitious and competent members of the City Watch .
description_long: Audra Maskyr Audra Maskyr was a sergeant of the Mulmaster City Watch . Personality . The sergeant was one of the more ambitious and competent members of the City Watch . She was also a devotee of Bane . She was a little tyrannical , always focused on work and did not suffer fools . Her men believed her incapable of smiling or laughing . Relationships . Audra was a rising officer in the Watch . History . In 1491 DR , Audra led a City Watch patrol that found the corpse of a strange creature that had emerged from the sewers . She hired an adventuring party to investigate the matter .

title: Audrec SeTourne
description: Audrec SeTourne Audrec SeTourne was a duelist from Lantan who was in Mulmaster . Personality . The gladiator was known for his evil nature .
description_long: Audrec SeTourne Audrec SeTourne was a duelist from Lantan who was in Mulmaster . Personality . The gladiator was known for his evil nature . In fights , Audrec would backstab his fellow gladiators just to win the tournament gold , and he would kill innocents under the pretense of a " duel of honor " . History . In 1491 DR , Audrec fought in the gladiator matches held in the Boar Pit of the Black Blade and Bloody Boar tavern . At the same time , he extorted money from a noble of Mulmaster . However , his victim was an ally of the Zhentarim , who sent their agent Saerol Danonbryl to kill Audrec during one of the matches using a poison known as pale tincture .

title: Augathra the Mad
description: Augathra the Mad Augathra the Mad was a Netherese magic user , scholar , and seer . She received visions and wrote them down into a chronology that would become known as the Roll of Years . To her chagrin , she received dark and disturbing visions during her sleep .
description_long: Augathra the Mad Augathra the Mad was a Netherese magic user , scholar , and seer . She received visions and wrote them down into a chronology that would become known as the Roll of Years . To her chagrin , she received dark and disturbing visions during her sleep . These disturbing visions would become known as the Black Chronology and she would pen them into a new tome now called the Book of the Black . Personality . The dark prophesies she received slowly twisted her mind beyond the borders of sanity . In moments of clarity , Augathra would try to end her existence as an escape from the black divinations she was receiving . Unfortunately , all her attempts would end in some form of failure that would leave her alive . History . In her wanderings , she came to the ruins of Synod . Realizing the unique interaction of this site with the Sharn Wall she decided to research and perform a ritual to transform herself into a sharn , hoping this would end her torment . In 684 DR , after much research and preparation , she began the ritual . This time , as the rite reached its climax , a mage named Shar Cormrael interrupted Augathra ' s casting .

title: Augelite
description: Augelite Augelite was a clear , colorless crystal . Description . These ornamental stones were soft but fragile and therefore easily worked without special skill or tools but cannot hold fine detail without splitting .
description_long: Augelite Augelite was a clear , colorless crystal . Description . These ornamental stones were soft but fragile and therefore easily worked without special skill or tools but cannot hold fine detail without splitting . Because it is soft , it does not last long when worn for adornment . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Aughisky
description: Aughisky An aughisky is an exceedingly rare creature that takes the form of a beautiful - looking horse . Ecology . It wanders dry land looking for humanoid prey .
description_long: Aughisky An aughisky is an exceedingly rare creature that takes the form of a beautiful - looking horse . Ecology . It wanders dry land looking for humanoid prey . Once it finds a suitable meal it tries to make itself appear that it would be easy enough for its prey to ride it . If it takes the bait , the prey will find itself stuck to the aughisky ' s flesh . The aughisky will then gallop as fast as it can back to the waters where it makes its home . It will drown the trapped humanoid and then devour the corpse , leaving only the creature ' s liver which is often found washed up on the shore .

title: Augrek Brighthelm
description: Augrek Brighthelm Augrek Brighthelm was a deputy in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Usually , Augrek was found at the southwest gate of the city , where she welcomed all visitors with a well - rehearsed speech about the wonders of Bryn Shander .
description_long: Augrek Brighthelm Augrek Brighthelm was a deputy in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Usually , Augrek was found at the southwest gate of the city , where she welcomed all visitors with a well - rehearsed speech about the wonders of Bryn Shander . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Augrek was at the gate when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Augrek had a good heart . She truly wanted to protect her city . She also loved Sheriff Markham Southwell .

title: Augury
description: Augury Augury ( AG - ur - ee ) was a divination spell that learned whether a given action will be good or bad . Effect . An " augury " spell could tell you whether a particular action will bring good or bad results for you in the immediate future .
description_long: Augury Augury ( AG - ur - ee ) was a divination spell that learned whether a given action will be good or bad . Effect . An " augury " spell could tell you whether a particular action will bring good or bad results for you in the immediate future . For example , if a party is considered destroying a weird seal that closes a portal , an " augury " might determine whether it ' s a good idea . The base chance for receiving a meaningful reply is 70 % + 1 % per caster level ; the DM makes the roll secretly . The DM may determine that the question was so straightforward that a successful result is automatic , or so vague as to have no chance of success . If the " augury " succeeds , you get one of four results : If the spell fails , you got the " nothing " result . A cleric who gets the " nothing " result had no way to tell whether it resulted from a failed or successful " augury " . The " augury " could see into the future only about half an hour , so anything that might have happen after that did not affect the " augury " . Thus , it might miss the long - term consequences of the contemplated action .

title: Aulagol
description: Aulagol Aulagol was an illithilich wizard and a member of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , during a visit to the Astral Plane , Aulagol allowed a raiding party of githyanki to discover his " astral projection " and to pursue him to the astral portion of the city ' s elder brain .
description_long: Aulagol Aulagol was an illithilich wizard and a member of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , during a visit to the Astral Plane , Aulagol allowed a raiding party of githyanki to discover his " astral projection " and to pursue him to the astral portion of the city ' s elder brain . Soon the githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain . Taking desperate measures , the ulitharid Thalynsar transformed himself and several other illithid s , including Aulagol , into lich es so they could devour the elder brain , preserve its knowledge and powers , and take its place . Successful in their endeavor , the illithiliches formed a Conclave of Elders , with Thalynsar as the most powerful among them . He tried to retain much of the elder brain ' s knowledge for himself , but the excessive information steadily turned him insane , a trait that Aulagol noted . Nevertheless , Thalynsar ruled Ch ' Chitl for over a hundred years . Finally , around 1370 DR , Aulagol and the other Elders united and were obligated to kill the insane Thalynsar .

title: Auldus Breeklar
description: Auldus Breeklar Auldus Breeklar was a lord in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Storm Silverhand asked for the collaboration of Lord Breeklar and Lord Hamnlaer in helping King Foril Obarskyr I but Bleeklar did not believe her .
description_long: Auldus Breeklar Auldus Breeklar was a lord in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Storm Silverhand asked for the collaboration of Lord Breeklar and Lord Hamnlaer in helping King Foril Obarskyr I but Bleeklar did not believe her . At last , it was discovered that Breeklar was the culprit behind the theft of income tax that Rensharra Ironstave had been collecting . An unidentified man killed Breeklar .

title: Aulruick Thoster
description: Aulruick Thoster Aulruick Thoster was the captain of the ship the " Green Siren " . Appearance . While on board ship he wore a prodigious hat , a gold - trimmed coat , and a slender , straight sword in a silver sheath .
description_long: Aulruick Thoster Aulruick Thoster was the captain of the ship the " Green Siren " . Appearance . While on board ship he wore a prodigious hat , a gold - trimmed coat , and a slender , straight sword in a silver sheath . Relationships . Aulruick Thoster hired the mercenary wizard Seren Juramot . He had worked with Nogah several times .

title: Aulumpiter
description: Aulumpiter Aulmpiter was a nycaloth and a member of the Trio Nefarious and leader of the Army of Darkness . History . Aulmpiter was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .
description_long: Aulumpiter Aulmpiter was a nycaloth and a member of the Trio Nefarious and leader of the Army of Darkness . History . Aulmpiter was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese . Aldlas set them forth on the task to locate the Nether Scrolls , thought to be somewhere in the elven lands . For three months The Trio Nefarious ravaged the elven lands until they met with the army of Cormanthyr and were captured and imprisoned . Nearly 2 millenia later they escaped and began raising an army that soon descended upon Cormanthyr . Death . On Flamerule 15th , 714 DR , in the battle known as Banes ' Duel , Aulmpiter was slain in battle by Captain Fflar , five days before Myth Drannor was to fall to the remains of the army .

title: Aumark Lithyl
description: Aumark Lithyl Aumark Lithyl was the ruler of Ruathym . History . Before becoming the ruler of Ruathym , Aumark Lithyl was a member of the adventuring band known as the Knights of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Aumark Lithyl Aumark Lithyl was the ruler of Ruathym . History . Before becoming the ruler of Ruathym , Aumark Lithyl was a member of the adventuring band known as the Knights of Myth Drannor . He left the party after his father , Ulphron Lithyl was slain during the war with Luskan in Kythorn , 1356 DR . During a war with Luskan in Uktar , 1357 DR , Aumark united the island of Ruathym and brought the four conflicting nations together into a single united kingdom unified nation . Around 1358 DR , Aumark had 500 warrior s under his command and three warships , which were loaned to him by First Axe Wedigar Ruthmaald of Holgerstead , a smaller Ruathym kingdom .

title: Aumrauth
description: Aumrauth Aumrauth is a sea elf realm located in the Shining Sea between Tharsult and the mouth of the River Scelptar . Aumrauthans seem to spend most of their time farming various underwater flora and fauna , occasionally trading secretly with specially selected fishermen from the surface . History .
description_long: Aumrauth Aumrauth is a sea elf realm located in the Shining Sea between Tharsult and the mouth of the River Scelptar . Aumrauthans seem to spend most of their time farming various underwater flora and fauna , occasionally trading secretly with specially selected fishermen from the surface . History . Little is known of this strong , yet peaceful realm since its inhabitants are fairly isolationist , at least from surface peoples . However , they have been known to go to war with boats out of Calimshan and , unfortunately , it ' s leaders also have a history of being assassinated by ambitious elf usurpers . Government . Aumrauth is ruled by both an Exalted Lord and a Lady Queen ( both for - life positions ) but , strangely , the two are not married nor even have to consort with each other .

title: Aumry ' s cloak
description: Aumry ' s cloak Aumry ' s cloak was the cloak of Aumry , lord of Shadowdale . Powers . The cloak had the powers of a " cloak of charisma " .
description_long: Aumry ' s cloak Aumry ' s cloak was the cloak of Aumry , lord of Shadowdale . Powers . The cloak had the powers of a " cloak of charisma " . History . Aumry ' s cloak rested in Aumry ' s Tomb in Watcher ' s Knoll in Shadowdale .

title: Aumry Obarskyr
description: Aumry Obarskyr Aumry Obarskyr was the Lord of Shadowdale from 1300 DR to 1339 DR . His last name , Obarskyr , was known only to a few individuals . He was the husband of Syluné Silverhand .
description_long: Aumry Obarskyr Aumry Obarskyr was the Lord of Shadowdale from 1300 DR to 1339 DR . His last name , Obarskyr , was known only to a few individuals . He was the husband of Syluné Silverhand . He ruled Shadowdale peacefully until his assassination by Zhentarim agents in 1339 DR . His assassins were captured and killed by Jyordhan , but Jyordhan was himself a Zhentarim agent . Aumry was laid to rest in Aumry ' s Tomb , on Watcher ' s Knoll in Shadowdale . Possessions . Aumry had a magical staff and cloak . The staff was stolen from his tomb by Lashan Aumersair of Scardale in 1344 DR and was lost when Lashan ' s empire fell . It was later replaced by Esvele Greycastle in 1374 DR in an attempt to destroy Syluné , who at that time was a spectral harpist and would remain so only as long as her husband ' s possessions remained uninterred .

title: Aumvor
description: Aumvor Aumvor the Undying was an ancient Netherese lich , infamous since Netheril ' s Age of Discovery for his unmatched mastery over necromancy . He was named " the Undying " because , instead of seeking lichdom , he lived for centuries by leeching the living energy of his " living zombie " servitors , many of them members of his own family . The casting of " Karsus ' s Avatar " in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR , an event that nearly tore the Weave apart and caused the fall of Netheril , caused the activation of his contingency magics : Aumvor was teleported into his hidden lair inside the Endless Caverns , far below the High Forest and transformed into a lich .
description_long: Aumvor Aumvor the Undying was an ancient Netherese lich , infamous since Netheril ' s Age of Discovery for his unmatched mastery over necromancy . He was named " the Undying " because , instead of seeking lichdom , he lived for centuries by leeching the living energy of his " living zombie " servitors , many of them members of his own family . The casting of " Karsus ' s Avatar " in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR , an event that nearly tore the Weave apart and caused the fall of Netheril , caused the activation of his contingency magics : Aumvor was teleported into his hidden lair inside the Endless Caverns , far below the High Forest and transformed into a lich . Appearance . Aumvor , in life , was a short and stocky Netherese human mage , with fat hands , a sizable paunch , fair skin and a long , unkempt black hair . After attaining lichdom , he grew more obese , resembling the bloated , rotten corpse of a drowned man , with bone - white slimy skin dangling over his skeletal frame . Activities .

title: Aunadar Bleth
description: Aunadar Bleth Aunadar Bleth was a human from Cormyr . History . Since he was sighted in the royal library with the crown princess Tanalasta Obarskyr , it was rumored that they were sharing a romance .
description_long: Aunadar Bleth Aunadar Bleth was a human from Cormyr . History . Since he was sighted in the royal library with the crown princess Tanalasta Obarskyr , it was rumored that they were sharing a romance . In 1369 DR , Aunadar was on a hunt with King Azoun IV , Baron Thomdor , and Duke Bhereu when all three of his companions were poisoned by a magical abraxus in the abraxus affair . Aunadar escaped unscathed only to be revealed as a traitor and killed .

title: Aundra Blacklock
description: Aundra Blacklock Aundra Blacklock was a powerful Raptoran Sorceress who was the owner of a tenement building known as the God Catcher . She lived in a magical sphere that hovered above the building . Clytemorrenestrix , a Blue dragon changed into a human by the Spellplague , came to Aundra and asked her to reverse the effects of the Spellplague , something that Aundra claimed was within her power .
description_long: Aundra Blacklock Aundra Blacklock was a powerful Raptoran Sorceress who was the owner of a tenement building known as the God Catcher . She lived in a magical sphere that hovered above the building . Clytemorrenestrix , a Blue dragon changed into a human by the Spellplague , came to Aundra and asked her to reverse the effects of the Spellplague , something that Aundra claimed was within her power . Aundra asked Clytemorrenestrix to break into a shop and steal a magical mask from a shop owned by the Green dragon Andareunarthex . Aundra knew that the dragons would come into conflict and that one would either be killed or driven from Waterdeep . Even though Clytemorrenestrix returned the mask to Aundra , she didn ' t change her back into a dragon . Description . Aundra ' s head looked like a hawk ' s and she had white feathers .

title: Aunglass Roaryl
description: Aunglass Roaryl Aunglass Roaryl was a legendary hero of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , and the founder of the Roaryl dynasty . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Aunglass Roaryl led a rebellion against the dragon emperor Eskornamundyr .
description_long: Aunglass Roaryl Aunglass Roaryl was a legendary hero of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , and the founder of the Roaryl dynasty . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Aunglass Roaryl led a rebellion against the dragon emperor Eskornamundyr . Thanks to his efforts , the rebels were able to overcome their dragon master and gain their freedom . Legacy . He was the founder of Clan Roaryl , the ruling dynasty of Eskorn as of 1479 DR .

title: Aunrae Dhuurniv
description: Aunrae Dhuurniv Aunrae Dhuurniv was the eldest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Aunrae was always the most diplomatic and administrative of the Matron sisters .
description_long: Aunrae Dhuurniv Aunrae Dhuurniv was the eldest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Aunrae was always the most diplomatic and administrative of the Matron sisters . It was Aunrae that first proposed the alliance with the Church of Shar to survive the fall of Maerimydra and later with the Zhentarim in order to reclaim the Twisted Tower of Ashaba . In 1375 DR , having achieved her objectives , Aunrae started to organize all the Maerimydra survivors into a great army at her service . Meanwhile she tried to create dissent between the Zhentilar and Shar rans and even approached the new Myth Drannor government . The goal of Aunrae was to start a civil war on the surface and use it to conquer all of Shadowdale for the drow , as it was in past centuries .

title: Aunrae Nasadra
description: Aunrae Nasadra Aunrae Nasadra was the matron mother of House Nasadra and the uncrowned queen of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 689 DR , Aunrae succeeded her grandmother as head of House Nasadra and informally as queen of Ched Nasad .
description_long: Aunrae Nasadra Aunrae Nasadra was the matron mother of House Nasadra and the uncrowned queen of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 689 DR , Aunrae succeeded her grandmother as head of House Nasadra and informally as queen of Ched Nasad . In time , her power over the city became absolute , unmatched even by Yvonnel Baenre of Menzoberranzan . In 1372 DR , however , during the Silence of Lolth , fighting between House Zauvirr and House Melarn escalated with the participation of the duergar mercenary band Clan Xornbane , secretly manipulated by the Jaezred Chaulssin patron Zammzt . Soon , the the duergar stonefire threatened the very existence of the city . Thus Aunrae and the four other powerful matron mothers ( Umrae D ' Dgttu , Nedylene Zinard , Ulviirala Rilynt , and ShiNeerune Hlaund ) summoned a humongous black guardian spider . However , the guardian spider ( and soon another guardian spider it summoned ) was never in their telepathic control , as the artifacts were divine artifacts tied to the power of Lolth , and they began raging through the city , further compounding the chaos .

title: Auppenser
description: Auppenser Auppenser was a stoic god , and the precepts of his worship included moderation , inner balance , self - reflection , and reason . Relationships . His church reached its heights in Jhaamdath - primarily in the Twelve Cities of Swords - before its imperial expansion .
description_long: Auppenser Auppenser was a stoic god , and the precepts of his worship included moderation , inner balance , self - reflection , and reason . Relationships . His church reached its heights in Jhaamdath - primarily in the Twelve Cities of Swords - before its imperial expansion . At this time in Jhaamdath , the Twelve Cities were ruled by a psiocracy of bladelord s ( cleric psion s ) who considered the perfection of both mind and body of the highest importance . History . The Elven High Magic that destroyed Jhaamdath , also severely injured Auppenser by wiping out the vast majority of his worshipers , and his faith simply fell into obscurity over the next few hundred years . All is not lost , though , as a glimmer of hope survives : a few devotees of Auppenser yet remain .

title: Aura against flame
description: Aura against flame Aura against flame was a divine abjuration spell that protected against and extinguished natural and magical fires . Effects . This spell created an aura of blue mist that surrounded the cleric .
description_long: Aura against flame Aura against flame was a divine abjuration spell that protected against and extinguished natural and magical fires . Effects . This spell created an aura of blue mist that surrounded the cleric . The mist would absorb damage from fire and would extinguish any non - magical flames coming in contact with it . Whether or not magical flames would be snuffed out depended on the divine power of the caster . If successful at extinguishing magical flame , both the aura and the fire would be dispelled . The aura of mist could also dispel magical fire attacks made against the caster . The effects of the aura would last from two minutes or longer for powerful clerics . Components . This spell required clerical hand motions and spoken words to create the aura . History . " Aura against flame " was originally created by the goddess Eldath for her followers .

title: Aura of comfort
description: Aura of comfort Aura of comfort was an evocation spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold , and be protected from rain , snow , and hail . Effects . This spell lasted for a few hours ; longer for more experienced casters , and created a faint aura that shimmered around the subject .
description_long: Aura of comfort Aura of comfort was an evocation spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold , and be protected from rain , snow , and hail . Effects . This spell lasted for a few hours ; longer for more experienced casters , and created a faint aura that shimmered around the subject . The recipient and all they were wearing or carrying were insulated from cold or heat in the −20° F to 140° F ( −29° C to 60° C ) temperature range and instead perceived a comfortable 70° F ( 21° C ) for the duration of the spell . In addition , " aura of comfort " protected the recipient from non - magical rain , snow , and hail by blocking them from reaching the subject . If the temperature exceeded the range that this spell could handle , then the perceived temperature was increased or decreased one degree for every degree beyond the range . " Aura of comfort " did not protect against magically generated weather , fire , cold - based attacks , smoke , suffocation , etc . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Aura of life
description: Aura of life Aura of life was a divine abjuration spell that generated an aura of life preservation . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot ( 9 .
description_long: Aura of life Aura of life was a divine abjuration spell that generated an aura of life preservation . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot ( 9 . 1 meters ) radius that preserved the life of the caster and all allies within it . The aura gave resistance to necrotic energies and restored unconscious non - hostiles . The aura traveled with the caster . Components . The spell had only a verbal component .

title: Aura of purity
description: Aura of purity Aura of purity was an abjuration spell that created an aura of purifying energies . Effects . The aura extended to 30 feet ( 9 .
description_long: Aura of purity Aura of purity was an abjuration spell that created an aura of purifying energies . Effects . The aura extended to 30 feet ( 9 . 1 meters ) and kept non - hostile creatures from becoming diseased and gave resistance to poison . The aura also instilled resistance to becoming blinded , charmed , deafened , frightened , paralyzed , and stunned . The aura traveled with the caster and only lasted 10 minutes . Components . The spell had only a verbal component .

title: Aura of vitality
description: Aura of vitality Aura of vitality was an evocation spell for paladin s that created an aura that could heal creatures close by . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot radius ( 9 .
description_long: Aura of vitality Aura of vitality was an evocation spell for paladin s that created an aura that could heal creatures close by . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot radius ( 9 . 1 meters ) that was centered on the caster . The caster could pick a creature within the aura to regain some lost health . The aura only lasted for 1 minute . Components . The spell had a verbal component .

title: Auran
description: Auran Auran was the language of the Elemental Plane of Air . It was also known as Old Alzhedo , as the modern Alzhedo language spoken in Calimshan derived from it . Description .
description_long: Auran Auran was the language of the Elemental Plane of Air . It was also known as Old Alzhedo , as the modern Alzhedo language spoken in Calimshan derived from it . Description . Auran was a breathy , relaxed language that has been described as a slow exhaling of air . Derivative Languages . Both Alzhedo and Midani derived from Auran . Speakers . In addition to creatures native to the Plane of Air , Auran was sometimes spoken by Air genasi and smoke drake s .

title: Aurbangras
description: Aurbangras Aurbangras was a young white dragon . History . In 1484 DR , during the Darkening in Luruar , Aurbangras and his father Arauthator were allied with the drow Quenthel Baenre and Gromph Baenre .
description_long: Aurbangras Aurbangras was a young white dragon . History . In 1484 DR , during the Darkening in Luruar , Aurbangras and his father Arauthator were allied with the drow Quenthel Baenre and Gromph Baenre . The two dragons allowed Tiago Baenre to ride one of them into battle . The dragons believed that by doing this they could court the favor of Tiamat and bring " it " back ( what " it " refers to is unclear ) . In the closing stages of the War of the Silver Marches Aurbangras was killed . Relationships . Aurbangras was the son of Arauthator , better known as " Old White Death , " and presumably of his mate Arveiaturace .

title: Aurgloroasa
description: Aurgloroasa Aurgloroasa ( pronounced ore - " GLOR " - oh - " ASS " - ah ) , also known as Sibilant Shade , was a venerable shadow dragon responsible for the fall of the dwarven city of Thunderholme in the Thunder Peaks . Personality . Aurgloroasa was obsessed with research into death , undeath , necromancy , and shadow magic .
description_long: Aurgloroasa Aurgloroasa ( pronounced ore - " GLOR " - oh - " ASS " - ah ) , also known as Sibilant Shade , was a venerable shadow dragon responsible for the fall of the dwarven city of Thunderholme in the Thunder Peaks . Personality . Aurgloroasa was obsessed with research into death , undeath , necromancy , and shadow magic . She also considered herself to be the draconic death god Null ' s most faithful servant and her most ardent wish was to become his consort and thus a demipower in her own right . Towards this goal she aspired to bring a large portion of Faerûn under her sway and create a draconic theocracy in Null ' s name . History . Early Years . Born in the Year of the Black Dawn , 426 DR , to Shhuusshuru , she prowled her mother ' s domain in the Far Hills for nearly two centuries until establishing her first lair in the southwestern Thunder Peaks in 616 DR . Both elven rangers from Cormanthyr and dwarven scouts from Thunderholme noted her arrival but neither race chose to move against her . She stayed out of things for the following century and was eventually forgotten by all but the most devoted dragon hunters ( none of whom ever actually got to engage with her ) .

title: Auril
description: Auril Auril ( pronounced " AW - rill " ) , also known as The Cold Goddess , The Frostmaiden , Icedawn , and the Goddess of Winter , was a fickle , vain , and evil deity , who was primarily venerated out of fear . The few among the Iulutiun s of the Great Glacier who worshiped her called her Saukuruk . Relationships .
description_long: Auril Auril ( pronounced " AW - rill " ) , also known as The Cold Goddess , The Frostmaiden , Icedawn , and the Goddess of Winter , was a fickle , vain , and evil deity , who was primarily venerated out of fear . The few among the Iulutiun s of the Great Glacier who worshiped her called her Saukuruk . Relationships . Auril , along with Malar , Umberlee , and their superior Talos , was a member of the Deities of Fury . Umberlee and Auril cooperated with some degree of confidence , while Malar and Auril despised each other . Much of Auril ' s power was absorbed by Talos in recent times , weakening the minor deity . Despite this , or perhaps as a result of it , Auril quietly siphoned power from the slumbering deity Ulutiu who was in stasis under the Great Glacier . Kossuth and Auril were mortal enemies , but their followers seldom came across each other . Sune opposed Auril , as she blamed her for the destruction of much that was beautiful . Uthgar hated Auril as she turned the Elk Tribe away from his worship . Worshipers . Sacrifices to the Frostmaiden were common , especially in the North , as people hoped to appease her and thus avoid cripplingly cold winters .

title: Auril ' s flowers
description: Auril ' s flowers Auril ' s flowers was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused an explosion of sharp ice and small stones to burst from the ground in an area designated by the caster . Effects .
description_long: Auril ' s flowers Auril ' s flowers was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused an explosion of sharp ice and small stones to burst from the ground in an area designated by the caster . Effects . This spell had to be cast upon moisture - bearing ground within a range of 600 ft ( 183 m ) — it would not work on terrain that contained no moisture within 3 ft ( 91 cm ) of the surface , such as a dry , sandy desert or solid rock . Higher level casters could extend the range even further and cause more damage . From the target point , all subsurface moisture in a 30 ft ( 9 . 1 M ) radius instantly froze , causing a violent upwelling of ice and creating a soil - covered mound ( known as a ) . This action flung sharp ice shards and chunks of stone throughout the area , causing equal parts physical damage and cold damage . Creatures caught in this barrage could attempt to dodge the worst of it and , if successful , receive only half the damage . The area affected by this spell became covered in dense rubble that made it difficult to keep one ' s balance or perform any sort of tumbling skill .

title: Aurin
description: Aurin Aurin was a businessman and conjurer in Skullport . History . Aurin hailed from a country on the Sea of Fallen Stars near the Earthspur Mountains .
description_long: Aurin Aurin was a businessman and conjurer in Skullport . History . Aurin hailed from a country on the Sea of Fallen Stars near the Earthspur Mountains . Circa 1350 DR , he was forced out of his house and after a series of adventures , where he acquired some deepspawn , he arrived in Skullport . There he met Chantos Graybeard , Ysele the Cat , and Lord Ithvar Wordkiller , and the four created their breeding business . In time , Aurin assumed the primary role and the jealous Ithvar challenged him to a magic duel . Aurin won and also saved the life of his opponent , gaining the nickname of Aurin the Generous . Around 1370 DR , he became the target of a series of assassination attempts . Personality . Aurin never spoke about his past . Aside from this , he was a typical wizard : moody , secretive , and suspicious . He believed that the assassination attempts were sent by a business rival , possibly Lord Ithvar . Activities . Aurin and his three partners managed a business of breeding and selling deepspawn , usually for dungeons . Relationships . Aurin despised Ithvar and also did not trust Ysvele . However , Chantos was his best friend .

title: Auro ' pol Dyrr
description: Auro ' pol Dyrr ' Auro ' pol Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan during the Time of Troubles . History . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , House Agrach Dyrr was one of the several to take part in the Battle of Mithral Hall and its Matron Auro ' pol Dyrr went personally to the battle together with the mastermind of the attack : Matron Baenre .
description_long: Auro ' pol Dyrr ' Auro ' pol Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan during the Time of Troubles . History . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , House Agrach Dyrr was one of the several to take part in the Battle of Mithral Hall and its Matron Auro ' pol Dyrr went personally to the battle together with the mastermind of the attack : Matron Baenre . The defenders of Mithral Hall were fighting well and the drow army was suffering more causalities than planned , and many whispers of desertion among the drow forces reached Matron Baenre ears . Death . Auro ' pol entertained herself with thoughts about what the consequences would be if the old Matron died in battle . Her thoughts were read by the illithid El - Viddenvelp though , who promptly reported that to Matron Baenre . The Matron Mother , already angered by the not so positive situation , ordered the glabrezu she summoned not long before to kill Auro ' pol . The glabrezu caught the Matron by surprise and tore her body apart with its pincers

title: Aurochs
description: Aurochs Aurochs were powerful wild beasts sometimes revered and used as war mounts by some orc tribes , in particular those that worshiped Bahgtru . Notable aurochs . It was told in legends that Bahgtru tamed an aurochs with his bare hands and brought it to Nishrek under Gruumsh ' s rule .
description_long: Aurochs Aurochs were powerful wild beasts sometimes revered and used as war mounts by some orc tribes , in particular those that worshiped Bahgtru . Notable aurochs . It was told in legends that Bahgtru tamed an aurochs with his bare hands and brought it to Nishrek under Gruumsh ' s rule . He named it Kazaht ( the Orc word for bull ) and rode it into combat , occasionally leaping over its head to land upon his enemies .

title: Aurora
description: Aurora Aurora was the owner of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Aurora was an adventurer sorceress who traveled most of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Aurora Aurora was the owner of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Aurora was an adventurer sorceress who traveled most of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur . During her travels , she became fascinated by the differences in culture between far - away places . Once settled in Waterdeep , Aurora decided to open a business that could entertain her sense of exploration . In time , Aurora ' s business increased to a very high level , with agents in many places . Usually , Aurora managed the shop in Waterdeep with only an assistant .

title: Aurora ' s Emporium
description: Aurora ' s Emporium Aurora ' s Emporium was a curio shop located in Westgate . The shop sold exotic items from all over Faerûn . The Emporium was but one of a number of similar outlets located throughout Faerûn , connected through a network of teleportation spells and devices , with outlets in most major cities in western Faerûn , including at least six in the city of Waterdeep .
description_long: Aurora ' s Emporium Aurora ' s Emporium was a curio shop located in Westgate . The shop sold exotic items from all over Faerûn . The Emporium was but one of a number of similar outlets located throughout Faerûn , connected through a network of teleportation spells and devices , with outlets in most major cities in western Faerûn , including at least six in the city of Waterdeep .

title: Aurumvorax
description: Aurumvorax The aurumvorax ( a - rum - VOR - æks ; see plural for the plural form ) , sometimes known as the golden gorger , is a small , shaggy hole - dwelling creature with eight legs that is able to eat gold . It is sometimes used to locate gold , able to detect and find its veins in the ground . It is not fearful and can become vicious , able to defend itself against formidable creatures like chimera e .
description_long: Aurumvorax The aurumvorax ( a - rum - VOR - æks ; see plural for the plural form ) , sometimes known as the golden gorger , is a small , shaggy hole - dwelling creature with eight legs that is able to eat gold . It is sometimes used to locate gold , able to detect and find its veins in the ground . It is not fearful and can become vicious , able to defend itself against formidable creatures like chimera e . Appearance . When fully grown , an aurumvorax measures around 3 ' ( 1m ) in length and 18 " ( 0 . 5m ) in height . It has a hide of 3 " - long , golden fur which is highly prized , capable of fetching 15 , 000 – 20 , 000 gold pieces . It weighs around 500 pounds ( 227kg ) . Its eyes are silver , with bronze whiskers . Its claws and teeth are copper - colored . Ecology . Habitat . The aurumvorax is found in light forests or near the timberline of mountains . Although it occasionally lives at the bottom of ravines , it is more usual to find an aurumvorax burrow in the side of a hill . The burrow will normally extend through the top soil and into the rock beneath where its enormous weight can be supported . Where possible , the aurumvorax will burrow into rock rich in gold ore .

title: Auseriel
description: Auseriel Auseriel was the secret elven haven established by Lamruil Moonflower , Prince of Evermeet , the late Zaor ' s youngest son . History . After the nearly successful conquest of Evermeet , by Kymil Nimesin was thwarted , Queen Amlaruil gave the " Tree of Souls " to Lamruil and , at her urging , agreed to take the tree and establish an elven haven on the mainland .
description_long: Auseriel Auseriel was the secret elven haven established by Lamruil Moonflower , Prince of Evermeet , the late Zaor ' s youngest son . History . After the nearly successful conquest of Evermeet , by Kymil Nimesin was thwarted , Queen Amlaruil gave the " Tree of Souls " to Lamruil and , at her urging , agreed to take the tree and establish an elven haven on the mainland . He indicated he would establish this location far into the northern reaches and departed both with elves formerly of Evermeet and those displaced elves which were lured from other realms and , his betrothed , Maura Silverhand . Later , this haven was revealed to be Auseriel . In 1373 DR , the Year of Rogue Dragons , Auseriel was attacked by a group of white dragon s led by Harashnalthyn . At the insistence of Maura , Lamruil fled to Evermeet with the " Tree of Souls " . Maura stayed to provide a rearguard and ensured the unhindered escape of the " Tree of Souls " . Two days later Lamruil returned with a force of knights to find the city abandoned . His force found no trace of the rearguard aside from the corpses of several white wyrms .

title: Auspician
description: Auspician The auspician was a prestige class of for those who sought powers of luck . Entry . The auspician was often a worshiper of a deity of luck .
description_long: Auspician The auspician was a prestige class of for those who sought powers of luck . Entry . The auspician was often a worshiper of a deity of luck . They underwent a ritual where they consumed a poison called Tyche ' s blood , which was believed to be derived from blood taken from the deceased goddess ' s corpse . Regardless of whether the person who desired to become an auspician survived the effects of the poison ( some auspicians were actually resurrected after the poison killed them ) , the person gained the ability to command the effects of luck in all of its forms .

title: Austrus Flambrant
description: Austrus Flambrant Austrus Flambrant was a noble in Cormyr and the lord of Flambrant House . Relationships . Flambrant was close to Lady Jalassra Dawningdown .
description_long: Austrus Flambrant Austrus Flambrant was a noble in Cormyr and the lord of Flambrant House . Relationships . Flambrant was close to Lady Jalassra Dawningdown . History . Around 1480 DR , Lady Dawningdown disappeared from Suzail and Flambrant believed the culprits to be Mirt and Lady Rensharra Ironstave . He managed to find them near Lord Lothan Durncaskyn of Immerford and went asking for answers . Mirt confronted him and knocked him down .

title: Ausuriel
description: Ausuriel Ausuriel , mostly known as the blind goat , was an angel and the Herald of Shiallia , exarch of Mielikki , in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ausuriel lived in a small village on an isle not too far from Phlan .
description_long: Ausuriel Ausuriel , mostly known as the blind goat , was an angel and the Herald of Shiallia , exarch of Mielikki , in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ausuriel lived in a small village on an isle not too far from Phlan . She decided to live as a blind goat that accompanied the young Elisande . She followed Elisande in all her adventures , first befriending an adventuring party that had arrived in the village investigating rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships . Elisande and Ausuriel later moved to Phlan until the Cult of the Dragon took the city in a coup . After they escaped from Phlan , Elisande and the goat found a place to stay at Mulmaster ' s Underdark station post of Fort Iron . Here , they were possibly involved in another adventure in 1491 DR . During the Rage of Demons , Elisande and the goat briefly attended a celebration for Mielikki in the village of Elventree . Later , Elisande and the goat were inside a passage to the Upperdark near the village of the Stop . Later , in Sporedome , Elisande and the goat joined in the planning of an assault on Maerimydra .

title: Autton Shadowshroud
description: Autton Shadowshroud Autton Shadowshroud was a male elven assassin and a member of the Shadowkind assassin guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Description . Autton was 5 feet and 2 inches ( 1 .
description_long: Autton Shadowshroud Autton Shadowshroud was a male elven assassin and a member of the Shadowkind assassin guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Description . Autton was 5 feet and 2 inches ( 1 . 57 meters ) tall and weighed only 120 pounds ( 56 kilograms ) . However , Autton was surprisingly strong for his thin and small frame . As one of the Shadowkind , he dyed his naturally blond , short hair black . His eyes were almond in color , and displayed his intellect and cruelty . Abilities . Autton was a capable fighter and a stealthy assassin . Possessions . Autton wore leather armor and wielded a shortsword , a half - dozen dagger s , and a shortbow . He used poison on his weapons . History . When Calispar Delgorth , a Talona n priest and member of the Vipers bandits , offered to demonstrate his magic - resistant poison for the Shadowkind , Autton Shadowshroud was sent to represent the guild and oversee the test . On the 28th Eleasias in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Autton met with Calispar near Brynwood and was taken to the Vipers ' Nest .

title: Auvandell
description: Auvandell Auvandell , named after the human hero Auvan Arlandspyr , was a village located on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar , where the road descended out of Silverymoon Pass . The town clustered around an old , dwarf - built , Delzoun watchtower . Description .
description_long: Auvandell Auvandell , named after the human hero Auvan Arlandspyr , was a village located on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar , where the road descended out of Silverymoon Pass . The town clustered around an old , dwarf - built , Delzoun watchtower . Description . A small community lived around the gray base of the tower and was a place of repose for travelers . The area around Auvandell was not so easy to cultivate . Goats and sheep were the main resource for local agriculture , while apple and cherry orchards were cultivated on the slopes of the hills . Two small mines in the nearby hills were the primary business of Auvandell . A foundryman produced copper , lead and iron ingots , which were sent to Sundabar on heavy carts pulled by teams of oxen . Leadership . Auvandell wasn ' t so different from other villages , despite being the largest and the most defended . Despite Auvandell belonging to the jurisdiction of Sundabar , the village enjoyed administrative autonomy . Auvandell was governed by a High Sheriff , Jortheyn Serpentbane . Helm Dwarf - Friend , ruler of Sundabar , granted Jortheyn his title and role in return for services provided to Sundabar .

title: Ava Moonflower
description: Ava Moonflower Ava Moonflower was a Moon elf of House Moonflower long before the Crown Wars of the ancient realm Aryvandaar . She was also a mighty High Mage and served as a center for the high magic rituals . She was married to the sun elf Rolim Durothil shortly before both travelled the ocean with many elves to the island of Evermeet .
description_long: Ava Moonflower Ava Moonflower was a Moon elf of House Moonflower long before the Crown Wars of the ancient realm Aryvandaar . She was also a mighty High Mage and served as a center for the high magic rituals . She was married to the sun elf Rolim Durothil shortly before both travelled the ocean with many elves to the island of Evermeet . Their marriage was arranged , because her husband had little magical aptitude to pass it down to his children and his father wanted that his new wive would bring that into his family . At the beginning of the voyage both had their problems with that arrangement but during the travel they learned to respect and love each other . Four hundred years later , after the death of the High Council , Keishara Amarillis and Rolim became the new High Council of Evermeet . Rolim and Ava had a unusually large family . The children who came after their father became part of house Durothil , the others became part of house Moonflower .

title: Avaereene
description: Avaereene Avaereene was one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar , the leader of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Personality .
