Avaereene was a cruel and efficient person ; she enjoyed creating darkenbeast s to serve her deadly whims , and she intended to supplant the Blackstaff as the most powerful mage of Waterdeep .
description_long: Avaereene Avaereene was one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar , the leader of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Personality . Avaereene was a cruel and efficient person ; she enjoyed creating darkenbeast s to serve her deadly whims , and she intended to supplant the Blackstaff as the most powerful mage of Waterdeep . History . Avaereene was a skilled mage and slaver who served the Eye , capturing potential slaves in the seamier wards of Waterdeep at night . She led the Eye ' s snatch - and - grab kidnapping agents , known as the Hand . She commanded great loyalty from her forces , and they did anything to prevent her harm or capture . In 1479 DR , Avaereene was active as a lich and leader of a thieves guild called the Slightess .

title: Avaerl
description: Avaerl Avaerl of Sembresh was a Zhentarim wizard . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon sent Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage .
description_long: Avaerl Avaerl of Sembresh was a Zhentarim wizard . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon sent Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage . In truth , the High Lord of the Zhentarim was skeptical of Avaerl ' s chances and also sent Zalarth Bloodbrow to follow Avaerl and intervene if needed . Avaerl found Elmninster and Sharantyr at Spellgard . He confronted them but was easily killed by Sharantyr .

title: Avalanche hurler
description: Avalanche hurler Avalanche hurlers are ranger s who excel at flexibility in combat , focusing on neither melee nor ranged combat like most rangers but instead emphasizing both . Ever resourceful avalanche hurlers are equally effective in a melee or from a short distance . For this purpose avalanche hurlers specialize in the use of two smaller melee weapons that can be thrown effectively , such as dagger s or small hammer s .
description_long: Avalanche hurler Avalanche hurlers are ranger s who excel at flexibility in combat , focusing on neither melee nor ranged combat like most rangers but instead emphasizing both . Ever resourceful avalanche hurlers are equally effective in a melee or from a short distance . For this purpose avalanche hurlers specialize in the use of two smaller melee weapons that can be thrown effectively , such as dagger s or small hammer s . Though they lose range and damage through this avalanche hurlers gain an increased versatility beyond that of most warriors . The first avalanche hurlers are believed to have been dwarven slaves who rebelled against their giant masters and improvised the avalanche hurler ' s unique fighting style as a result , throwing their work tools as improvised weapons and ultimately succeeding in their rebellion . Whether these stories are true is ultimately unimportant as the style was developed indepedently by other races later on and is not a particularly dwarven tradition . However , the path of an avalanche hurler does remain an optimal one for rangers constantly beset upon by larger foes . Abilities .

title: Avan Vatsisen
description: Avan Vatsisen Avan Vatsisen is a Thay an wizard who was originally based in Eltabbar . He was sent by his Red Wizard master to Scornubel to oversee the transportation of rare spell components , available only in the Western Heartlands , back to Thay . He is accompanied by two flesh golem s .
description_long: Avan Vatsisen Avan Vatsisen is a Thay an wizard who was originally based in Eltabbar . He was sent by his Red Wizard master to Scornubel to oversee the transportation of rare spell components , available only in the Western Heartlands , back to Thay . He is accompanied by two flesh golem s . Appearance . Avan has shunned the traditional appearance of the Red Wizards and has dark hair and a full beard , although he still wears scarlet robes . He has five scars on his chest , inflicted by the claw of Arahnar . His skin is sallow . Equipment . Avan always carries a ring of fire resistance , a ring of regeneration , a wand of lightning and a wand of magic missiles . He also wields a magical + 2 dagger . Arahnar . While on a trip to Baldur ' s Gate , Avan met Arahnar on the roadside , and used his magic to entice her to fall for him . They made their way off the road and into a grove of trees , where Arahnar transformed into her semi - human form and attacked him , giving him five large scars on his chest . She would have killed him if his bodyguards had not been close by .

title: Avariel
description: Avariel The Avariel ( " Aril - tel - quessir " in elven or " winged folk " ) were amongst the first of the elven races to migrate to Faerûn . However , conflict with Dragon s almost wiped them out before the First Flowering and while they have survived since that time , they are considered by most to be myths or legends . Physical Description .
description_long: Avariel The Avariel ( " Aril - tel - quessir " in elven or " winged folk " ) were amongst the first of the elven races to migrate to Faerûn . However , conflict with Dragon s almost wiped them out before the First Flowering and while they have survived since that time , they are considered by most to be myths or legends . Physical Description . Avariel are more delicate than their earth - bound cousins , with hollow bones to aid their flight . They have pale skin , often porcelain white . An avariel ' s wings are usually white , but can be black , brown or speckled . Avariel are also known to practice the dyeing of wing tips . Their eyes are slightly larger than normal and range in color from brilliant blues to green or purple . Their hair color normally is a silver - white or black . Avariel are said to have the most beautiful voices of all the Tel ' Quessir , and their songs are greatly sought after by bard s of other races . Society .

title: Avatar
description: Avatar An avatar was a physical manifestation of a deity on Toril . It was usually significantly less powerful than the deity it represented . The deity Tiamat had her avatar slain twice , implying the loss of an avatar did not result in any permanent damage to the deity .
description_long: Avatar An avatar was a physical manifestation of a deity on Toril . It was usually significantly less powerful than the deity it represented . The deity Tiamat had her avatar slain twice , implying the loss of an avatar did not result in any permanent damage to the deity .

title: Avatar series
description: Avatar series The Avatar series , originally the Avatar trilogy , is a series of novels detailing the events of the Time of Troubles . The original three books were set from Kythorn 1 to Marpenoth 15 . The books are : The artwork for the covers of the books were provided by Brom .
description_long: Avatar series The Avatar series , originally the Avatar trilogy , is a series of novels detailing the events of the Time of Troubles . The original three books were set from Kythorn 1 to Marpenoth 15 . The books are : The artwork for the covers of the books were provided by Brom . The first three works center around the remaining members of the " Company of the Lynx " and the search for the Tablets of Fate , divine tablets that hold a listing of the Gods and their roles in the balance of Law and Chaos , during the Time of Troubles . The theft of these tablets was the actual cause of the Time of Troubles as all the gods with the exception of Helm were cast to Toril and faiths and magic ran wild . The Company of the Lynx , as it was , consisted of Kelemvor , Adon of Sune , Midnight , and Cyric . The last two books in the series account for what occurred after the Tablets were returned to Ao , including the aftermath of the ascension of several Company members to godhood ( Midnight took the mantle of Mystra , Kelemvor became god of the dead , and Cyric took several vile deities ' portfolios and went mad ) .

title: Avelyere
description: Avelyere Avelyere , most often referred to as Lady Avelyere , was a diviner who ran a school ( Coven ) for young sorceresses in the Shade Enclave in 1469 DR . Description . Lady Avelyere had light gray eyes and brown hair .
description_long: Avelyere Avelyere , most often referred to as Lady Avelyere , was a diviner who ran a school ( Coven ) for young sorceresses in the Shade Enclave in 1469 DR . Description . Lady Avelyere had light gray eyes and brown hair . Although she was in her early 40s in 1468 DR , she still appeared young and beautiful . History . In 1469 DR , Lady Avelyere ' s attention was drawn by Parise Ulfbinder and Draygo Quick to a talented young Bedine girl , who showed strong promise in the magical arts . She took her students out and used force to capture this girl , whose name was Ruqiah ( actually the reincarnated Catti - brie ) . Ruqiah became a student at the Coven and remained there for ten years . In 1479 DR , Lady Avelyere used a spell to force Ruqiah to reveal all her secrets , including her true identity and her intention to travel to Icewind Dale to find Drizzt Do ' Urden . Lady Avelyere took that information to Ulfbinder and Quick . When Catti - brie discovered what had happened , she faked her own death in a fire and fled to the Silver Marches . Lady Avelyere continued to pursue Catti - brie using magical means , detecting her in Longsaddle in 1482 DR . Lady Avelyere ' s Coven .

title: Avenger
description: Avenger An avenger was an agent of one or more god s who sought to bring divine wrath unto the enemies of their divine patron . Invested with traditions both ancient and quite often secret , avengers served as a well - crafted weapon of their deity , finding the enemies of their faith and striking them down . Of all a god ' s agents they were the most deadly , marked and empowered by rituals of investiture similar , but not identical to , those that which marked the training of a cleric or paladin .
description_long: Avenger An avenger was an agent of one or more god s who sought to bring divine wrath unto the enemies of their divine patron . Invested with traditions both ancient and quite often secret , avengers served as a well - crafted weapon of their deity , finding the enemies of their faith and striking them down . Of all a god ' s agents they were the most deadly , marked and empowered by rituals of investiture similar , but not identical to , those that which marked the training of a cleric or paladin . Culture . Avengers were not a part of every faith or organization . The work of an avenger was , for one thing , abhorrent to pacifists , since , in all but name , avengers were killers working on the behalf of the divine . Similarly , members of their own religion were as likely to view avengers as heretics as champions of the divine or perhaps an unpleasant necessity . As a result , many avenger traditions were so secretive that they were largely forgotten by the unitiated . This was not a problem for avengers , whose methodology required a degree of focus that made outside distractions unwanted . Most avengers were , in fact , trained in monasteries akin to those used by monk s .

title: Avenging slayer
description: Avenging slayer Avenging slayers are fighter s who see it as their duty to deal justice in a cruel and unforgiving world plagued by monsters and villains . These would - be heroes seek out the seeds of future destruction to prevent new further suffering and to quench the thirst for vengeance that many feel . Many avenging slayers begin as survivors left behind after some violent disaster , such as the pillaging of a village .
description_long: Avenging slayer Avenging slayers are fighter s who see it as their duty to deal justice in a cruel and unforgiving world plagued by monsters and villains . These would - be heroes seek out the seeds of future destruction to prevent new further suffering and to quench the thirst for vengeance that many feel . Many avenging slayers begin as survivors left behind after some violent disaster , such as the pillaging of a village . For these individuals , their life ' s course was set the day they were left alive while others died . Others have simply witnessed the suffering of too many and have taken it upon themselves the duty of preventing future sorrow and rooting out evil where it lurks . Whatever their origin these individuals find little rest in their mission , as danger and wickedness lurks around every corner . Even so , those who are wise fear the avenging slayers , for their blade is mercilessly efficient . Abilities . Avenging slayers train themselves to be the instrument of a collective will for vengeance across the lands , acquiring many useful abilities in their quest for justice .

title: Aventine
description: Aventine Aventine was a svirfneblin city located in the Underdark near Dambrath . History . The deep gnomes inhabiting Aventine , and much of the city , was destroyed by drow aided by crinti and arkaiun .
description_long: Aventine Aventine was a svirfneblin city located in the Underdark near Dambrath . History . The deep gnomes inhabiting Aventine , and much of the city , was destroyed by drow aided by crinti and arkaiun . Though the drow and crinti did not suffer many casualities during the attack , the arkaiun , or shebali , were nearly wiped out . Queen Melanith ' s consort , Sadalar , was killed during the conflict . For their suport , the drow awarded the crinti with prime drow males with whom to breed . Melanith selected a new consort from this bunch .

title: Aventurine
description: Aventurine Aventurine , also known as a love stone , was a variety of that glitters when viewed from certain angles due to inclusions . Description . This semi - precious stone could be medium to light green , dark to pale blue , or a beautiful sparkling shade of gold .
description_long: Aventurine Aventurine , also known as a love stone , was a variety of that glitters when viewed from certain angles due to inclusions . Description . This semi - precious stone could be medium to light green , dark to pale blue , or a beautiful sparkling shade of gold . only detracted from the flash below the surface of this translucent stone , so it was tumbled smooth , cut , or used as an inlay . Large deposits of aventurine with 20 lb ( 9 kg ) blocks were not uncommon . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Avenue of Wealth
description: Avenue of Wealth The Avenue of Wealth was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street entered Huzuz through the Gate of Wealth .
description_long: Avenue of Wealth The Avenue of Wealth was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street entered Huzuz through the Gate of Wealth . It served as the border between the East District , Affluent District , and Court District . The Avenue of Wealth ran southeast to northwest through the city until it terminated at the Caravan Boulevard near the middle of Huzuz .

title: Avenue of the Sea
description: Avenue of the Sea The Avenue of the Sea , or the Fishers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Avenue of the Sea entered Huzuz through a gate in the northwest corner of the city where it branched from the River Road , travelling southeast between the Merchants ' District and Northwest District before terminating at the Grand Bazaar .
description_long: Avenue of the Sea The Avenue of the Sea , or the Fishers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Avenue of the Sea entered Huzuz through a gate in the northwest corner of the city where it branched from the River Road , travelling southeast between the Merchants ' District and Northwest District before terminating at the Grand Bazaar . As the name implied , this was a popular road for fishermen to use in order to bring their fresh catches to the great market .

title: Avernus
description: Avernus Avernus was the first layer of Baator and was a vast charred wasteland of rubble over which the iron towers of the Dukes of Hell stood . Legions of devil s marched across its plains in continual readiness for the next battle of the Blood War . A red light suffused the sky and huge fireballs flew across the layer , randomly exploding wherever they hit .
description_long: Avernus Avernus was the first layer of Baator and was a vast charred wasteland of rubble over which the iron towers of the Dukes of Hell stood . Legions of devil s marched across its plains in continual readiness for the next battle of the Blood War . A red light suffused the sky and huge fireballs flew across the layer , randomly exploding wherever they hit . Culture . Sayings . Sayings spoken by devils in Avernus : Government . Zariel is the current ruler of Avernus , after Lord Bel , the former lord , was demoted to being her advisor by Asmodeus . She resides in a soaring basalt citadel . Landmarks . The Bronze Citadel is a huge fortress city , housing massive numbers of devil troops and war machines . It is constantly being added to in the form of new fortifications against attacks . The Pillar of Skulls is a hideous landmark of trophy - skulls of those killed in the Blood War that reaches a height of more than a mile . It is very close to the entrance to the second layer , Dis . Connections to the Forgotten Realms .

title: Avert evil eye
description: Avert evil eye Avert evil eye was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This popular spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Avert evil eye Avert evil eye was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This popular spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell protected individuals from the evil eye . The caster would cast the spell on a blue bead while saying the name of the recipient . The bead was then sewn into the recipient ' s clothing or crushed into a drink that they consumed . This spell lasted for several days depending on the caster ' s power . This spell was reversible and could be cast as " attract evil eye " . Components . This spell required a blue bead to cast .

title: Avery Schell
description: Avery Schell Avery Schell is a cleric of Deneir and the substitute father of Cadderly Bonaduce . History . Avery was one of the headmasters of the Edificant Library .
description_long: Avery Schell Avery Schell is a cleric of Deneir and the substitute father of Cadderly Bonaduce . History . Avery was one of the headmasters of the Edificant Library . He raised Cadderly Bonaduce as his own when Cadderly ' s father Aballister Bonaduce left under the shame of killing his wife and mother of Cadderly . Avery was killed by the mage Bogo Rath during an attack of the Night Masks in Carradoon - his student Kierkan Rufo leading to his murder .

title: Avgar Filroy
description: Avgar Filroy Avgar Filroy was the only innkeeper in Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Courageously , Avgar managed the White Hart Inn with the help of some " unseen servant s " for the cleaning .
description_long: Avgar Filroy Avgar Filroy was the only innkeeper in Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Courageously , Avgar managed the White Hart Inn with the help of some " unseen servant s " for the cleaning . He was a little delusional and always warned customers not to disturb the Hunt Lords or go out of the inn in the night .

title: Avid
description: Avid Avid was a merchant in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Avid hailed from Durpar .
description_long: Avid Avid was a merchant in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Avid hailed from Durpar . His family ' s largest caravan was confiscated by the clergy of Gilgeam , causing the bankruptcy of Avid ' s family and the suicide of his father . In 1357 DR , Avid went to Unther in order to support the rebellion among the mercantile community , wanting Gilgeam removed from power .

title: Avimmuck Wanderfoot
description: Avimmuck Wanderfoot Avimmuck Wanderfoot was the Cloakmaster of the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Location . Avimmuck owned a house in Riatavin .
description_long: Avimmuck Wanderfoot Avimmuck Wanderfoot was the Cloakmaster of the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Location . Avimmuck owned a house in Riatavin . Personality . Avimmuck was an outgoing and pleasant individual , although he usually looked distracted . Most people believed him to be a scout or a trader but in truth he was a ruthless assassin . Frequently , Avimmuck spied on meetings of his guildmasters in order to be sure they were not double - crossing him .

title: Aviss
description: Aviss Aviss was a once - human woman magically transformed into a bird - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Fellandar , Aviss lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR .
description_long: Aviss Aviss was a once - human woman magically transformed into a bird - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Fellandar , Aviss lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR . However , the pair came to despise the city and sought its destruction , and turned traitor against it . At some point , they went into the Mere of Dead Men , far to the north of the city . There they met with troll s , survivors of the earlier Trollwars waged against Waterdeep . The trolls believed the traitors could bring them victory in a third , and final , Trollwar , and promised them power over the city . Aviss and Fellandar chose to give up their humanity and swore a bond between them . As the trolls watched on , Aviss and Fellandar entered a certain pool where the fell magic of the Mere transformed them into inhuman creatures of raw and primal power . Empowered , the pair led a new troll army out of the Mere and south toward Waterdeep in the Year of the Thundering Horde , 963 DR . They knew well the city ' s defenses , and Castle Waterdeep had only just begun construction a month before .

title: Avner
description: Avner Avner of Hartsvale was a thief and scout in Hartsvale in the 14th century DR . History . Avner was an orphan living in Hartwick in Hartsvale .
description_long: Avner Avner of Hartsvale was a thief and scout in Hartsvale in the 14th century DR . History . Avner was an orphan living in Hartwick in Hartsvale . He lived as a thief from a young age until the firbolg Tavis Burdun opened his eyes to honest work . Avner changed his life and become one of the most reliable scouts of the vale . At last he died saving his queen ' s child . However , problems arose when his soul arrived in the Fugue Plane . The new god of death Kelemvor decided to send his soul to Torm ' s realm as he died in the line of duty but Mask arrived to explain that he was False , having always honored the giant goddess Diancastra , claimed to be an aspect of Mask . In order to save Avner , Kelemvor proclaimed him one of his Chosen : a seraph of death . Later , it was reveaked that Avner had all along followed Mask ' s instructions in a plot to discredit Kelemvor .

title: Avnos Des
description: Avnos Des Avnos Des was the head of the spirit s that protected the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . Avnos Des was once a human living in Elgrin Fau in the Plane of Shadow until Kesson Rel killed all the inhabitants .
description_long: Avnos Des Avnos Des was the head of the spirit s that protected the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . Avnos Des was once a human living in Elgrin Fau in the Plane of Shadow until Kesson Rel killed all the inhabitants . He became a spirit . When Erevis Cale ' s party destroyed Kesson Rel , in gratitude Avnos and his fellows agreed to protect the Abbey of the Rose . In 1484 DR , the Oracle released Avnos and his fellows from their service and they went to serve Drasek Riven .

title: Avolakia
description: Avolakia Avolakia were aberrations who lived deep underground in small tribal units . Description . In their natural form avolakias resembled a disgusting cross between an octopus , worm and insect .
description_long: Avolakia Avolakia were aberrations who lived deep underground in small tribal units . Description . In their natural form avolakias resembled a disgusting cross between an octopus , worm and insect . They had slimy , pale gray bodies and moved around on six tentacles , each of which had an eye . They reeked of death . Combat . These monsters preferred to rely on magic or their own spell - like abilities in combat . They would also send their undead servants into combat or , if forced into melee , would use their poisonous bite and flail with their claws . Ecology . Avolakia could animate corpses several times a day and use zombies as both minions and as a food source . Although they could eat flesh from living or freshly killed creatures they much preferred to eat undead meat . The tongue of the avolakia was composed of guttural , slobbering sounds . Most avolakias understood Undercommon , but their physiology made it impossible for them to speak it . Society . The avolakia lived in nests in the Lowerdark , defended by their undead minions . Avolakia were known to revere powers dedicated to death and decay , such as Ghaunadaur and Velsharoon .

title: Avos
description: Avos Avos the Fisher was a gang leader in Selgaunt . History . Avos was born among the city ' s fishermen but at an early age ran away and joined Selgaunt ' s underground .
description_long: Avos Avos the Fisher was a gang leader in Selgaunt . History . Avos was born among the city ' s fishermen but at an early age ran away and joined Selgaunt ' s underground . He gained a name for himself as a strong - arm robber and killer - for - hire . In time he joined the Quippers criminal fraternity and soon gained supremacy inside the organization . A longtime collaboration bound the Quippers to the Talendar family , so in 1372 DR , when Ossian Talendar needed men to help Marance Talendar ' s vengeance , Avos was happy to help for the right price . Personality . Avos was a bully at heart with loyalty to no one . He was merciless and cunning — traits that allowed his gang to prosper . Avos always wondered about the long - term consequence of their actions .

title: Awaken
description: Awaken Awaken was a transmutation spell that awakened intelligence and ability in a creature or plant of little or no intelligence . Effects . After eight hours of casting and touching a creature of little or no intelligence , the creature would gain average intelligence ( compared to humanoids ) and learn the language of the caster .
description_long: Awaken Awaken was a transmutation spell that awakened intelligence and ability in a creature or plant of little or no intelligence . Effects . After eight hours of casting and touching a creature of little or no intelligence , the creature would gain average intelligence ( compared to humanoids ) and learn the language of the caster . Plants also gained the ability to move their " limbs " . The creature was effectively charm ed by the caster for thirty days ; after that , the creature could chose to stay or turn hostile to the caster . Components . An agate worth at least 1 , 000 gp .

title: Awang Sophir
description: Awang Sophir Awang Sophir was a monk participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Possessions . Awang possessed a " ring of teleportation " .
description_long: Awang Sophir Awang Sophir was a monk participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Possessions . Awang possessed a " ring of teleportation " . History . Awang Sophir was a mysterious monk who arrived in Suijeng with four students from Petan to participate in the Komite . He was a master of the mystical style of Silat but knewn nothing about Chu ' Yuan . Awang Sophir managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists . In one of the final rounds of the tournament he competed against an adventurer but Awang was disqualified for his use of a magical lucky charm . Awang promised vengeance against the adventurer . Later , Awang tricked some villagers into believing that his adventurer opponent and their companions were demon s and sent them to kill them , but with no success . Soon after , Awang took control of the leaderless taring village of Gigit in Kutuk Valley . He ruled there until his adventurer opponent and their companions and / or the previous vampire ruler Xi - Chu came to Gigit . Awang quickly escaped using his " ring of teleportation " to avoid a confrontation . Following again his adventurer opponent and their companions Awang was attacked by tiger s and injured .

title: Awen
description: Awen Awen was a doomguide in Neverwinter . History . During an inspection to the city graveyard , Awen died at the hands of Red Wizard minions but rose as ghost , not acknowledging her death .
description_long: Awen Awen was a doomguide in Neverwinter . History . During an inspection to the city graveyard , Awen died at the hands of Red Wizard minions but rose as ghost , not acknowledging her death . Later , an adventurer was sent to cleanse the graveyard and helped her to achieve peace .

title: Axar Xyrl
description: Axar Xyrl Axar Xyrl was one of the morkoth arcount member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Axar Xyrl was a calculating and scheming individual that spoke what he thought in very rare occasions .
description_long: Axar Xyrl Axar Xyrl was one of the morkoth arcount member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Axar Xyrl was a calculating and scheming individual that spoke what he thought in very rare occasions . Normally Axar Xyrl remained behind and personally acted only his his subordinates were all defeated or he had a very personal interest in the matter . he greatly disliked being touched by anyone or anything . History . Around 1270 DR Axar Xyrl found the " Iltkazar Scepter " . During the Twelfth Serôs War Axar Xyrl tried to acquire the " Claw of Xynakt " during the morkoth attack on Abydos but his plan was ruined by the triton Keros . Axar Xyrl in 1370 accepted to ally with the aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok in exchange for the promise to gain a copy of the " Tome of Tujar the Dark Adherent " , that explained all the secrets of the Dukars , but in truth he planned to betray the elf and steal all he can find . Axar Xyrl first sent his subordinates Major Qyzal and Grand Caster Duupox to organized am ambush against some surface dwellers enemies of Kraok . Later he too , together with Gantar Kraok , entered in battle to help his subordinates .

title: Axe
description: Axe An axe is a single - or double - bladed weapon made from a metal or stone head mounted on a haft of varying length . The haft is usually made of wood to reduce the overall weight . The term " axe " is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons that fit this description and where the blade length is considerably less then the overall weapon length .
description_long: Axe An axe is a single - or double - bladed weapon made from a metal or stone head mounted on a haft of varying length . The haft is usually made of wood to reduce the overall weight . The term " axe " is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons that fit this description and where the blade length is considerably less then the overall weapon length . Axes are the favoured weapons of many fighter s and barbarian s ( especially dwarves ) .

title: Axe Grinders
description: Axe Grinders The Axe Grinders was a bodyguard business in Skullport . Geography . The business was located off in the Central Port district of Skullport , north of the Crossed Swords tavern and the Bane ' s Mistress festhall .
description_long: Axe Grinders The Axe Grinders was a bodyguard business in Skullport . Geography . The business was located off in the Central Port district of Skullport , north of the Crossed Swords tavern and the Bane ' s Mistress festhall . Interior . The Axe Grinders was in poor condition . Services . If a customer wanted a bodyguard to take on a more dangerous assignment , most enforcers at Axe Grinders would do it for triple price . Such missions included leaving Skullport or entering the Underhalls . Inhabitants . Many of the inhabitants of Axe Grinders were sellswords and down - on - their - luck mercenaries . Most bodyguards wore chainmail and fought with battleaxe s and longsword s . History . Around 1370 DR , the inn was owned by Alonyius Tackpun , who hired out bodyguards to those who had coin to spend .

title: Axe Kingdoms
description: Axe Kingdoms The Axe Kingdoms were a pair of merrow kingdoms , Khuur and Nmalk , in Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . They represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .
description_long: Axe Kingdoms The Axe Kingdoms were a pair of merrow kingdoms , Khuur and Nmalk , in Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . They represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History . In the Year of the Deep Wound , 582 DR , Tarag , a chieftain of the sea ogre s , used the powers of the sword " Ilbratha " and his own battle strategies to conquer the western frontiers of the merfolk realm of Hmurrath . There , Tarag founded the two Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . The Axe Kingdoms and Hmurrath fell to fighting in the Year of the Killing Blow , 653 DR , beginning the Ninth Serôs War . The merrow suffered a major defeat in the Battle of the Haunted Plains in the Year of the Coveted Briars , 654 DR . Following their defeat , four - fifths of all merrow in Serôs were forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall . The rest survived on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains . Three years of conflict culminated in the destruction of the Axe Kingdoms and the fall of the merrow to the merfolk of Hmurrath in the Year of the Volanth , 655 DR . This saw the end of merrow " civilization " in Serôs . Geography .

title: Axe of Mirabar
description: Axe of Mirabar The Axe of Mirabar is the two thousand strong militia of Mirabar , consisting of humans and five hundred dwarves . Its members wear the crest of Mirabar ( a deep red double - bladed axe with a pointed haft and a flaring , flat base on a black field ) on their shield or armour . They fight with crossbow s , lance s and hammer s , riding mountain ponies , and rothé in the winter .
description_long: Axe of Mirabar The Axe of Mirabar is the two thousand strong militia of Mirabar , consisting of humans and five hundred dwarves . Its members wear the crest of Mirabar ( a deep red double - bladed axe with a pointed haft and a flaring , flat base on a black field ) on their shield or armour . They fight with crossbow s , lance s and hammer s , riding mountain ponies , and rothé in the winter . It is commanded by Torgar Hammerstriker . The Axe is responsible for keeping the mines of Mirabar clear of monsters . New members must take an oath to protect the Marchion of Mirabar .

title: Axiomatic creature
description: Axiomatic creature Axiomatic creature was a transmutation spell that transfigured the subject into a perfect version of itself . This could only be cast by those with the archon subtype . Effects .
description_long: Axiomatic creature Axiomatic creature was a transmutation spell that transfigured the subject into a perfect version of itself . This could only be cast by those with the archon subtype . Effects . This spell transformed the target into an axiomatic creature — a perfect version of itself . The spell rid the creature of noticeable flaws , made its fur or scales appear shinier , and so forth . Animals touched by this spell became magical beasts , but otherwise the creature ' s type was unchanged . If the target was unintelligent , the spell imbued the target with animal intelligence , granting it minimal sentience . Material components . A diamond wand worth at least 10 , 000 gp .

title: Axithar
description: Axithar Axithar was a balor lord whose armies invaded the House of the Triad after the fall of Mystra . History . Not long after the death of Mystra ( in 1385 DR ) , the cambion Kaanyr Vhok and his companions were captured by the marilith Vhissilka , who served Lord Axithar .
description_long: Axithar Axithar was a balor lord whose armies invaded the House of the Triad after the fall of Mystra . History . Not long after the death of Mystra ( in 1385 DR ) , the cambion Kaanyr Vhok and his companions were captured by the marilith Vhissilka , who served Lord Axithar . Vhok abandoned his companions and allied with Axithar , providing information about the weaknesses of the House of the Triad so that Vhok could get his revenge for his treatment by the angel Tauran and so that he could reach the Lifespring , which he believed would give him the power to rule Sundabar as a glorious leader . Axithar ' s horde of demon s invaded the plane and were nearing victory against the angels when Bahamut ' s legions appeared and defeated the demon armies . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Aya Glenmiir
description: Aya Glenmiir Aya Glenmiir was an elven wizard in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aya was a brilliant individual , well versed in the Weave .
description_long: Aya Glenmiir Aya Glenmiir was an elven wizard in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aya was a brilliant individual , well versed in the Weave . She understood the allure and mystery that surrounded the elven race and had no scruples against using it for her vantage . Similarly she used her natural beauty . History . Aya was a 300 - year - old elf who was a scholar at Mantor ' s Library in Phlan . In 1489 DR a book propriety of the Library was stolen from her house and she was interrogated by some adventurers hired to recover it Later during the Cult of the Dragon ' s coup in the city , she and others were captured by the cultists led by Farnvik . Freed by some adventurers , Aya wanted to escape the city with the help of Glevith , a member of the Welcomer crime syndicate whom she knew . After refugee from Phlan arrived in Mulmaster Aya become one of the top advisor of resurrected Aleyd Burral .

title: Ayala
description: Ayala Ayala was an elven Harper and saved Drogan Droganson ' s life after the kobold attack on Hilltop . Description . Ayala was a slim elf , with long dirty - blonde hair , often put into a pony tail .
description_long: Ayala Ayala was an elven Harper and saved Drogan Droganson ' s life after the kobold attack on Hilltop . Description . Ayala was a slim elf , with long dirty - blonde hair , often put into a pony tail . She was a keen healer and herbalist and worshiped the greater deity Mystra . Personality . A deeply caring person , Ayala was very loyal to the Harpers . She knew a great deal about herbs , toxins and poisons and used her knowledge to help and heal others . Relationships . Though originally looked upon with suspicious by two of Drogan ' s apprentices , Xanos Messarmos and Dorna Trapspringer , Ayala earned their trust and worked alongside them in efforts to protect Hilltop . Mischa Waymeet was originally trusting of Ayala and stayed behind at the school to help her with the healing of Drogan and to protect the school from any further attacks . Ayala was a fellow Harper agent alongside Drogan and healed him back to health after he was gravely poisoned . History .

title: Ayana No - Shui
description: Ayana No - Shui Ayana No - Shui was a wu jen in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . History . Born with the mark of the maraloi , Ayana was always destined to become a wu jen .
description_long: Ayana No - Shui Ayana No - Shui was a wu jen in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . History . Born with the mark of the maraloi , Ayana was always destined to become a wu jen . For a time , she acted as an adventurer throughout Kara - Tur but in the end Ayana went back to her home country , the Symorok Valley . There , Ayana acted as prime counsel to the chieftain Shan Khantayan .

title: Ayesha al - Rumi
description: Ayesha al - Rumi Ayesha al - Rumi was a holy slayer inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Ayesha wore bright white robes that covered her entire body save for her intense dark eyes .
description_long: Ayesha al - Rumi Ayesha al - Rumi was a holy slayer inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Ayesha wore bright white robes that covered her entire body save for her intense dark eyes . Activities . As the most skilled agent of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Huzuz , Ayesha spent most of her time in a hidden temple to Kossuth . She was aware that Qirmiz min Hudid thought of her as a rival for the attention of men , so she avoided her at all cost , focusing her time on more important matters such as converting followers to Kossuth and punishing those who resisted .

title: Ayre Affapanov
description: Ayre Affapanov Zora Ayre Affapanov was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Rekationships . Ayre was the daughter of Lord Serge Affapanov , a noble predicted to become one of the Blade s allied with the Lords ' Alliance .
description_long: Ayre Affapanov Zora Ayre Affapanov was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Rekationships . Ayre was the daughter of Lord Serge Affapanov , a noble predicted to become one of the Blade s allied with the Lords ' Alliance . She spent most of her time with other noble scions : Elred Korsinchev , Orym Illustriana , and Liticia Gos . History . In 1491 DR , Ayre and some of her friends went missing . An adventuring party was hired to find them . She was at last found in the Yellow Breath Chapter House under Thylius Caramitru ' s influence .

title: Ayrorch
description: Ayrorch The Ayrorch was the ruling council of the island - nation of Lantan , based in Sambar . Activities . The council consisted of twelve members serving for life , chosen by the council itself .
description_long: Ayrorch The Ayrorch was the ruling council of the island - nation of Lantan , based in Sambar . Activities . The council consisted of twelve members serving for life , chosen by the council itself . The council elected an " Ayrar " to lead and speak for the council , and a " Lantar " to represent the nation abroad . The rest of the members were known as the " Santar " ( ancient Lantanese for " others " ) .

title: Azad the Free
description: Azad the Free Azad the Free was a former champion gladiator from Calimport who led a slave revolt and escaped into eastern Tethyr where he founded the Island of the Free on an earthmote . Azad was tricked by the Pasha of Calimport , Marod el Arhapan , into killing the Pasha ' s wife in the arena . After this , the Pasha made Azad a household slave whose primary job was to read bedtime stories to the Pasha ' s son Cephas .
description_long: Azad the Free Azad the Free was a former champion gladiator from Calimport who led a slave revolt and escaped into eastern Tethyr where he founded the Island of the Free on an earthmote . Azad was tricked by the Pasha of Calimport , Marod el Arhapan , into killing the Pasha ' s wife in the arena . After this , the Pasha made Azad a household slave whose primary job was to read bedtime stories to the Pasha ' s son Cephas . When Azad escaped Calimport , he abducted young Cephas who he trained as a gladiator to fight in the island ' s arena . Azad continued to read stories from the " Founding Stories of Calimshan " to Cephas from time to time prior to Cephas ' escape . When Cephas returned to the Island of the Free after killing his father and destroying his palace he confronted Azad and forced him to explain the circumstances of his mother ' s death . Equipment . Azad used a great two - headed flail in the arena which he later gave to Cephas .

title: Azak Throm
description: Azak Throm Azak Throm was a Red Wizard of Thay diplomat in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Azak was a cunning and calculating individual .
description_long: Azak Throm Azak Throm was a Red Wizard of Thay diplomat in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Azak was a cunning and calculating individual . He had an immense ego but was tempered by incredible patience . History . Azak worked at the Thay an embassy in Mulmaster as a diplomat . In truth , he was a spy of Szass Tam , which was suspected by the Hawks , Mulmaster ' s secret police , who always surveilled him . In 1491 DR , he happened to be involved in a mysterious arson attack on Tiega Gos , whilst meeting with her nephew , the mad painter Andrik Gos . An adventuring party hired to unveil the truth interrogated him .

title: Azalar Falconhand
description: Azalar Falconhand Azalar Falconhand , was a ranger of Mielikki and the son of Dove and Florin Falconhand . Azalar was the direct result of Mielikki ordering his parents to marry and beget a child . .
description_long: Azalar Falconhand Azalar Falconhand , was a ranger of Mielikki and the son of Dove and Florin Falconhand . Azalar was the direct result of Mielikki ordering his parents to marry and beget a child . . Appearance . Azalar , even at the age of 16 , was already over 180cm ( 6ft ) tall and still growing . He had the the same powerful build as his father and the silver hair of his mother which he tied back in a thick braid . Tiny horns and almond shaped eyed revealed his Fey ancestry . Background . Working with the fey of Shadowdale , Azalar earned the ire of the Zhentarim when they attacked the Dale in the summer of 1374 DR , subsequently imprisoning him in Castle Crag . Azalar was later freed by rebels seeking to overthrow the Zhentish army in Shadowdale where he confronted the horrific Susurrus under the direction of Mielikki . By leading the Susurrus out of the Fey crossroad s where the monster had been trapped , Azalar and a band of adventurers were able to defeat the beast once and for all . This would lead to Azalar and his fey allies aiding the folk of Shadowdale in its emancipation .

title: Azanza Mizzrym
description: Azanza Mizzrym Azanza Mizzrym was the leader of the House Mizzrym contingent that controlled the ruins of Sulasspryn in 1367 DR . Personality . Azanza was cunning and had good diplomatic skills , which helped in her dealings with other creatures that roamed the ruins .
description_long: Azanza Mizzrym Azanza Mizzrym was the leader of the House Mizzrym contingent that controlled the ruins of Sulasspryn in 1367 DR . Personality . Azanza was cunning and had good diplomatic skills , which helped in her dealings with other creatures that roamed the ruins . However , her main aim was vengeance — she would do anything to kill every Drowsbane heir . She often indulged in mindless acts of cruelty . History . Azanza ' s mother was killed by Sulass Drowsbane , the founder of the city of Sulasspryn . She and her fellows waited for the right occasion to take revenge against his family . Finally , the disaster that afflicted Sulasspryn in 1306 DR indicated to House Mizzrym that the time was arrived : in the next year , Mizzrym ' s slaves tunneled under the city and the drow clerics invoked the power of Lolth against the city . It collapsed into the Underdark , killing many citizens and most of the Drowsbane family . Afterward , Azanza made sure that nobody tried to reconstruct the city and she wanted to find and kill the last Drowsbane heirs .

title: Azariah Craulnober
description: Azariah Craulnober Azariah Craulnober ( pronounced " ah - ZAH - ree - ah " ) was the daughter of Elaith Craulnober , a moon elf crime lord of Waterdeep . Description . Azariah had silvery hair .
description_long: Azariah Craulnober Azariah Craulnober ( pronounced " ah - ZAH - ree - ah " ) was the daughter of Elaith Craulnober , a moon elf crime lord of Waterdeep . Description . Azariah had silvery hair . In the summer of 1364 DR , her ears were still soft and folded , like those of all elven toddlers . History . Azariah was an unexpected child , born in Waterdeep in the spring of 1363 DR to Elaith ' s sun elven mistress , who died in childbirth . After her birth , Elaith took her to Evindal Duirsar , the patriarch priest of Corellon Larethian in Waterdeep . Elaith wished for Azariah to receive her birthright , Elaith ' s dormant moonblade , so Evindal tasked him with retrieving the Morninglark harp , with the hope that the quest would restore Elaith ' s honor and allow the reactivation of the moonblade . Elaith , with the help of Danilo Thann and company , found the harp in the summer of 1364 DR , but after Danilo used it to reverse a curse , the harp was consumed and Elaith could not complete his task . However , in the process of defending Danilo , he was badly injured and his thoughts turned only to his daughter .

title: Azbara Jos
description: Azbara Jos Azbara Jos was a Red Wizard of Thay and a member of the faction loyal to Rath Modar . History . Azbara acted as Modar ' s envoy to the raiding armies of the reformed Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Azbara Jos Azbara Jos was a Red Wizard of Thay and a member of the faction loyal to Rath Modar . History . Azbara acted as Modar ' s envoy to the raiding armies of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . He traveled in a caravan to Baldur ' s Gate that was smuggling goods for the Cult ' s hoard . In the end , Azbara arrived at Skyreach Castle in the Greypeak Mountains , where the hoard was kept .

title: Azer
description: Azer Azers ( AY - zurz ) were elemental creature s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire and Elemental Chaos . Azers were created by fire titan s and fire giant s , whom they often served . Others , however , lived free and worked for their own benefit .
description_long: Azer Azers ( AY - zurz ) were elemental creature s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire and Elemental Chaos . Azers were created by fire titan s and fire giant s , whom they often served . Others , however , lived free and worked for their own benefit . Description . Azers resembled their ancestors , the dwarves , but with brass - colored skin and hair , their hair and beards being comprised of flames . Azer bodies were so hot that their weapons conducted heat , so much so that any creature within reach of an azer was injured by the intense heat . Many azers wore kilts of brass , bronze , or copper . Society . Azer society was best described as communal , as every individual had a place in society and matters of the state were more important than that of the individual . Living within fortresses made of bronze on the Elemental Plane of Fire , azer nobles wielded absolute power . Despite loving gems and constantly waging war against the efreet , Azers never started a fight unless the foe was carrying gems and in which case they might take them prisoner . Relations with other races . Azers were often slaves of fire giants and titans .

title: Azhakar
description: Azhakar Azhakar was a talking bird who lived in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . History . Azhakar was found living with a singing tree during the time of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s great - grandfather .
description_long: Azhakar Azhakar was a talking bird who lived in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . History . Azhakar was found living with a singing tree during the time of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s great - grandfather . As of 1367 DR , he lived in the gardens of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne with the same singing tree . Activities . Azhakar would frequently provide answers to important questions posed by the Grand Caliph . Others might be lucky enough to get an answer as well if Azhakar believed them worthy .

title: Azhaq
description: Azhaq Azhaq was a silver dragon paladin of Bahamut and was the " barb " of the Talons of Justice after the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but were defeated by Dorn Graybrook ' s team .
description_long: Azhaq Azhaq was a silver dragon paladin of Bahamut and was the " barb " of the Talons of Justice after the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but were defeated by Dorn Graybrook ' s team . After the metallic dragon s changed their minds and decided to join the fight against Sammaster , Azhaq and Moonwing helped break the chromatic dragon s ' siege of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . After an attempt to break the magic shield of the citadel that held the secret of the " Dracorage mythal " , Moonwing was killed . In the final battle , most of the Talons of Justice died , even their captain Havarlan . Thus , Azhaq tasked himself with rebuilding the Talons of Justice , stronger than before , eventually ascending to the rank of leader of the order .

title: Azharul
description: Azharul Azharul was a dragon god who lived in Dragon Eyrie , reputed for his mastery of magic . Description . His natural form was that of a fearsome , bad - tempered old dragon with many long , sharp projecting body - barbs .
description_long: Azharul Azharul was a dragon god who lived in Dragon Eyrie , reputed for his mastery of magic . Description . His natural form was that of a fearsome , bad - tempered old dragon with many long , sharp projecting body - barbs . Realm . Azharul ' s realm was known as the Dragonspawn Pits , located in the Dragon Eyrie ' s lowest region , the dark roots . History . Azharul was an old rival of Tiamat in the draconic pantheon . For that reason , after Tiamat ' s realm in Heliopolis was discovered to be a hoax by members of the Twisted Rune , in 1371 DR , she mind controlled those members and with their aid killed Azharul on his realm . She subsumed his divine essence , taking his body and divine realm , completely unbeknownst to anyone but herself .

title: Azharzel
description: Azharzel Azharzel was a blue dragon dracolich . At one point , a former high - ranking member of the Waterclock Guild and secret member of the Cult of the Dragon secreted Azharzel in the Waterclock Guild Crypts . Circa 1484 DR , both the Dragon Cultist and the Thayan minions of Valindra Shadowmantle searched for the dracolich .
description_long: Azharzel Azharzel was a blue dragon dracolich . At one point , a former high - ranking member of the Waterclock Guild and secret member of the Cult of the Dragon secreted Azharzel in the Waterclock Guild Crypts . Circa 1484 DR , both the Dragon Cultist and the Thayan minions of Valindra Shadowmantle searched for the dracolich . In the end , Valindra was victorious but soon after Azharzel was killed at Nasher Castle by an adventurer .

title: Azhir Kren
description: Azhir Kren Azhri Kren was a human fighter and tharchion of Gauros . Physical description . During a war expedition , she was usually armored in blue - enameled plate .
description_long: Azhir Kren Azhri Kren was a human fighter and tharchion of Gauros . Physical description . During a war expedition , she was usually armored in blue - enameled plate . She was skinny and had sharp - features . . History . After a failed attempt at conquering a Rashemi town , Azhir ' s army was rescued by Szass Tam and she thus sided with the lichlord for Szass Tam ' s cause of conquering Faerûn .

title: Aziz - Tagem
description: Aziz - Tagem Aziz - Tagem was a crime lord on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Aziz - Tagem , a man of mixed Bavanese and Bawani ancestry , ruled over the still small yakuza of Bawa .
description_long: Aziz - Tagem Aziz - Tagem was a crime lord on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Aziz - Tagem , a man of mixed Bavanese and Bawani ancestry , ruled over the still small yakuza of Bawa . He was a master organizer and a very prudent leader , hoping to expand his network without interference from the authorities . He usually directed the bold yakuza to explore the wilderness .

title: Aziz Jomini
description: Aziz Jomini Aziz Jomini was an elven associate of the Mosque of Free Haku in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz traveled far from Huzuz to a strange land called Maztica .
description_long: Aziz Jomini Aziz Jomini was an elven associate of the Mosque of Free Haku in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz traveled far from Huzuz to a strange land called Maztica . Upon his return to the City of Delights , the leaders of the mosque of Haku began organizing a return expedition for those eager to travel and experience a world full of adventure .

title: Aziz min Hajama
description: Aziz min Hajama Aziz min Hajama was a dwarven moralist who served as the commander of the Gate of Revelations within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz was serious about his duties , often taking the time to personally interview individuals who aroused his suspicion .
description_long: Aziz min Hajama Aziz min Hajama was a dwarven moralist who served as the commander of the Gate of Revelations within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz was serious about his duties , often taking the time to personally interview individuals who aroused his suspicion . He used divination magic to discover the truth during these interviews . Possessions . Aziz owned some " bracers of defense " , a " ring of djinni summoning " , " boots of striding and leaping " , and carried a " staff of the serpent " .

title: Aziza
description: Aziza Aziza was a seer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziza was follower of Zann and an active member of the Readers .
description_long: Aziza Aziza was a seer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziza was follower of Zann and an active member of the Readers . She ran a small shop called Books and Scrolls located in the Pilgrims ' District . As a Reader , she collected books merely to have things to read , rarely giving the book ' s subject matter more than a cursory glance before purchasing the volume . She was an accomplished mystic , charging the handsome sum of 125 dinar s for a reading . If no vision came to her , she often created a broad telling that was open to the interpretation of the customer .

title: Azla
description: Azla Azla was a female pirate in 1359 DR . History . Azla was an officer in the Cormyrean army and member of a prominent family .
description_long: Azla Azla was a female pirate in 1359 DR . History . Azla was an officer in the Cormyrean army and member of a prominent family . However her patrol was attacked and destroyed by zhentilar soldiers and in face of certain death Azla escaped . She never forgiven herself and , while believed dead with all her companions by her superiors and by her family , she went to the Pirate Isles hoping to met a forgiving death . Instead however Azla thrived and in time she rose the pirates ranks also thank to informations against some Sembia n targets . Slowly around her grew a group of supporters that wanted Azla as the new pirate lord . At this point around 1354 DR she clashed with Vurgrom and decided to relocated to Alphar Isle , waiting for the right time to strike . In 1359 Azla had forty ships under her in the Oresk harbor Personality . Azla was an able tactician and was generous in distributing taken wealth .

title: Azmaer Dhuurniv
description: Azmaer Dhuurniv The last powerful drow leader of the Twisted Tower was the Marshall Azmaer Dhuurniv in its last drow - held days . Azmaer oversaw the last retreat of the drow holdings in the face of a human uprising , and held the citadel against a year - long siege . History .
description_long: Azmaer Dhuurniv The last powerful drow leader of the Twisted Tower was the Marshall Azmaer Dhuurniv in its last drow - held days . Azmaer oversaw the last retreat of the drow holdings in the face of a human uprising , and held the citadel against a year - long siege . History . The drow rule of Shadowdale lasted until the early 900s Dale Reckoning ( - 2600 DR until + 907 DR , over 3 , 000 years ) , when the increased human population in the area brought the dark elves into conflict with their now more numerous neighbors . The humans were the Dales men who , a millennium earlier , had crossed the Dragon Reach and made peace with the elves of Myth Drannor , settling at the borders of the great woods that was the elven home . The drow soon found themselves under continual attack , and most of those who held overground settlements retreated back below . With supplies and slaves brought up from the Underdark directly into the tower , the drow could have conceivably held out forever ; However , a human slave ( family histories in the Dales indicate a number of possible individuals ) poisoned the well in the Tower and the citadel was easily overrun .

title: Azmyth
description: Azmyth An Azmyth is a small four foot long bat , with a three foot wingspan . They have crested heads , bearded chins and whitepupilless eyes . Skin color ranges from leathery gray , mauve or emerald green .
description_long: Azmyth An Azmyth is a small four foot long bat , with a three foot wingspan . They have crested heads , bearded chins and whitepupilless eyes . Skin color ranges from leathery gray , mauve or emerald green . A notable Azmyth would be Xuxa , the animal companion of noted ranger and archeologist Baylee Arnvold . Diet . The Azmyth eats flowers , small plants and insects . . Personality . Azmyth have higher then average intelligence . They often form close friendships with other creatures for mutual benefit . These friendships can last a life time . Combat . Azmyth can strike with both their bite and their needle - sharp tails . They can unleash a shock attack , similar to the spell shocking grasp . Magical abilities . Azmyth communicate by telepathy . They have the sense to know alignment . They can become invisible and create an area of silence around themselves .

title: Aznar Thrul
description: Aznar Thrul Aznar Thrul , Zulkir of Evocation , Tharchion of Priador , was one of the eight rulers of Thay and its Red Wizards . Personality . An exceedingly cruel and evil man , he was the greatest rival of the lich Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy .
description_long: Aznar Thrul Aznar Thrul , Zulkir of Evocation , Tharchion of Priador , was one of the eight rulers of Thay and its Red Wizards . Personality . An exceedingly cruel and evil man , he was the greatest rival of the lich Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy . History . He was originally trained in the Art at Blackstaff Tower by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . In his youth , Thrul bargained with Kossuth , god of fire , to aid the Red Wizards during the Salamander War . Their victory led to the capture of the Priador march and the appointing of Thrul as its tharchion . In the wake of becoming the tharchion of Priador , Aznar Thrul captured the former tharchion Mari Agneh and kept her as his slave and sexual play - thing . In 1375 DR , Mari was transformed by the blood fiend Tsagoth into his likeness and finally killed Thrul . Aznar Thrul ' s position as Zulkir of Evocation remained filled for a time . Appendix . Notes . On page 278 of the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition " , Aznar is quoted as being chaotic evil , but in a later book , " Unapproachable East " , page 168 , he is lawful evil . It also changes two of his archmage levels to epic wizard levels .

title: Azoun Obarskyr I
description: Azoun Obarskyr I Azoun I ( full name Azoun Obarskyr ) was the 51st king of Cormyr , reigning from 391 – 425 DR . He was the son of King Anglond of the Obarskyr dynasty , and was titled " the Crown Prince of Battles " for his campaigns as a prince . Description .
description_long: Azoun Obarskyr I Azoun I ( full name Azoun Obarskyr ) was the 51st king of Cormyr , reigning from 391 – 425 DR . He was the son of King Anglond of the Obarskyr dynasty , and was titled " the Crown Prince of Battles " for his campaigns as a prince . Description . As a young prince , Azoun was tall and broad - shouldered but had a soft , cultured voice . He had a soft beard . His prince ' s crown was an unadorned gold circlet . Personality . Azoun was charming and amiable . History . Azoun Obarskyr was born in the Year of the Battle Talons , 358 DR . He was the son and sole heir of his father , King Anglond , and of Queen Eleriel Obarskyr . As a boy , he was taught to read and write by the Royal Wizard , Baerauble Etharr . There was a tale he ' d once been caught stealing apples by Lady Ryndala Merendil ; it was equally possible he ' d been caught with one of her three daughters . Through the mid – 4th century DR , the small realm of Valashar — a client - state of Tethyr and a subject of the Shoon Imperium , under King Ashar Tornamn — had steadily extended its borders north to the Troll Mountains and beyond .

title: Azoun Obarskyr II
description: Azoun Obarskyr II Azoun Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . He was thin and lean in appearance . Relatives .
description_long: Azoun Obarskyr II Azoun Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . He was thin and lean in appearance . Relatives . Azoun was the only child of King Arangor Obarskyr . Background . Azoun fought against the red dragon attack on Suzail in 1018 DR , at a time when he was prince to his father , King Arangor Obarskyr . He was courting a young lady who was rescued from the burning Castle Obarskyr by Jorunhast , which displeased him greatly . Azoun had to help Jorunhast , who had panicked , during their battle with Thauglor , but Jorunhast tried to prevent him from entering the battle . Azoun attacked Thauglor with Orbyn and killing him by driving the blade into the dragon ' s brain . The two men had heightened mutual respect thereafter . Possessions . Azoun possessed the magical sword Orbyn .

title: Azoun Obarskyr IV
description: Azoun Obarskyr IV King Azoun Obarskyr IV of Cormyr was the king of Cormyr from 1336 DR to 1371 DR and a member of the Purple Dragon Knights . During his reign , the kingdom experienced unprecedented economic growth . He was killed in the Goblin War by Nalavarauthatoryl .
description_long: Azoun Obarskyr IV King Azoun Obarskyr IV of Cormyr was the king of Cormyr from 1336 DR to 1371 DR and a member of the Purple Dragon Knights . During his reign , the kingdom experienced unprecedented economic growth . He was killed in the Goblin War by Nalavarauthatoryl . Description . Azoun had a graying mustache and gray streaks in his hair but was otherwise physically fit and muscular . Personality . Azoun is content to be in battle , and despite the risks to himself , will not allow himself to be excluded from any combat that might arise in his presence . There are many rumors and tales of Azoun ' s encounters with the opposite sex , mostly from before his marriage , and there are a number of children as a result of these relations , but the matter is not discussed openly or officially . When making public addresses , Azoun preferred the term " Cormyte " over the more usual " Cormyrean " or " Cormyrian " . Possessions . Azoun ' s sword is contained in a very tatty scabbard . He has a brown scarf given to him by Filfaeril as a token of luck .

title: Azoun Obarskyr V
description: Azoun Obarskyr V Azoun Obarskyr V became the 72nd king of Cormyr , having inherited the throne after the death of his grandfather , the legendary Azoun IV , as well as a mythic sovereign . He is the son of former Crown Princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and Rowen Cormaeril , a scout in the army of Cormyr . History .
description_long: Azoun Obarskyr V Azoun Obarskyr V became the 72nd king of Cormyr , having inherited the throne after the death of his grandfather , the legendary Azoun IV , as well as a mythic sovereign . He is the son of former Crown Princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and Rowen Cormaeril , a scout in the army of Cormyr . History . In 1372 DR , Azoun was just a babe , and Regent Alusair Obarskyr and Dowager Queen Filfaeril Obarskyr were ruling Cormyr until he came of age . Azoun was cared for by Alaphondar , Royal Sage of Cormyr and lover of Filfaeril . The utmost care was given to keep Azoun ' s whereabouts a secret , as there were many ambitious malcontents who would wish to do him harm . . When he finally came of age in 1384 DR , at the insistence of the royal court , he surprised everyone by immediately stepping into the role of a political animal , a stark contrast to the warrior - king who was his grandfather . He immediately went about trying to change things to be more fair towards the commoners of his kingdom , but faced insurmountable adversity from the nobles of the realm .

title: Azuposi
description: Azuposi The Azuposi were a race of human s living in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Their existence was built upon agriculture and cultivating the harsh land of the basin , but they revered sophisticated culture . Society .
description_long: Azuposi The Azuposi were a race of human s living in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Their existence was built upon agriculture and cultivating the harsh land of the basin , but they revered sophisticated culture . Society . Azuposi society was matriarchal , meaning that the female was the owner of property , and it was passed down through the females in the family . Men worked the land but acted as caretakers rather than owners . Myths dictated that this system may have originated from a decree of one of the War Twins or may have come about because Sus ' sistinako ( the Spider Woman ) was instrumental in the creation of the Azuposi . The Azuposi spoke the Azuposi language . Tribes . The Azuposi lived in six separate tribal societies . Each tribe was named after one of six directions significant to the Azuposi due to the solstices . These directions were up , down , northwest , northeast , southwest and southeast . The respective tribes were eagle , shrew , mountain lion , badger , bear , and wolf . Spirituality . There was no concept of the afterlife in Azuposi culture , and they did not believe that they would be reincarnated or continue to exist after death .

title: Azure Legion
description: Azure Legion The Azure Legion , or the Thunderbolts , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 10 , 001 jann comprised the Azure Legion .
description_long: Azure Legion The Azure Legion , or the Thunderbolts , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 10 , 001 jann comprised the Azure Legion . Activities . This unit attacked with arrows and spears . Each officer wielded a " wand of lightning " , among other powerful magical items . Base of Operations . The Citadel of Ice and Steel within the Elemental Plane of Air served as base of all djinni military organizations .

title: Azuredge
description: Azuredge Azuredge was a magical , intelligent battleaxe forged by Ahghairon the mage . Its wielder was considered the greatest protector of Waterdeep . Description .
description_long: Azuredge Azuredge was a magical , intelligent battleaxe forged by Ahghairon the mage . Its wielder was considered the greatest protector of Waterdeep . Description . " Azuredge " had a solid steel handle etched with tiny runes , wrapped in blue dragon hide with a star sapphire set into the pommel . This handle connected to a double - bladed head forged from silver , electrum , and steel alloys whose edges constantly shimmered with a deep blue luminescence and had six more runes etched into it : one beside each of the four edges and one in the center of both sides of the head . These runes glowed blue , apparently when certain of the axe ' s powers were activated . The glowing could also be controlled by the wielder . Powers . The axe was unwieldy but magically balanced itself in the hands of a wielder chosen by the weapon . The axe allowed its wielders access to powers according to how worthy it judged them . Its least powerful ability was to negate the resistances of any creatures resistant to nonmagical weapons and / or weapons not made out of silver and any damage inflicted by it could not be healed with regenerative abilities like those of troll s .

title: Azurite
description: Azurite Azurite was a bluish form of malachite that is a little more scarce . Description . An azurite was a rich blue stone with mottling darker shades of blue , tumbled or cut and polished for use in decorating belts and rings .
description_long: Azurite Azurite was a bluish form of malachite that is a little more scarce . Description . An azurite was a rich blue stone with mottling darker shades of blue , tumbled or cut and polished for use in decorating belts and rings . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Azuth
description: Azuth Azuth ( pronounced " ah - ZOOTH " ) , also known as the Lord of Spells and the God of Wizards , was a lesser deity who concerned himself with the advancement and preservation of the magical arts . Worshiped by all manner of spellcasters ( and wizards in particular ) , the crafty deity acted as an adviser to the sitting deity of raw magic ; he and Mystra shared an amicable relationship akin to that of tutor and favorite student . Other deities found him crotchety , not understanding his dry wit or ceaseless dedication to collecting magical knowledge .
description_long: Azuth Azuth ( pronounced " ah - ZOOTH " ) , also known as the Lord of Spells and the God of Wizards , was a lesser deity who concerned himself with the advancement and preservation of the magical arts . Worshiped by all manner of spellcasters ( and wizards in particular ) , the crafty deity acted as an adviser to the sitting deity of raw magic ; he and Mystra shared an amicable relationship akin to that of tutor and favorite student . Other deities found him crotchety , not understanding his dry wit or ceaseless dedication to collecting magical knowledge . Azuth most often appeared as a white - bearded man wearing elaborate , antique clothing and wielding the powerful , gem - topped " Old Staff " . Worshipers . Among the most blessed of Azuth ' s terrestrial servants are The Favored , thought to be a cadre of slain human wizards resurrected by the Lord of Spells himself but which are in fact magical constructs of his subconscious mind . The Favored further the development and channeling of the Weave through written formulas , a process Azuthans view as the apogee of human scientific achievement .

title: Azzagrat
description: Azzagrat Azzagrat was a realm in the Abyss ruled by the demon lord Graz ' zt . Geography . Azzagrat spanned the 45th , 46th and 47th layers of the Abyss .
description_long: Azzagrat Azzagrat was a realm in the Abyss ruled by the demon lord Graz ' zt . Geography . Azzagrat spanned the 45th , 46th and 47th layers of the Abyss . All three layers were connected by the River of Salt . 45th layer . The 45th layer appeared as a windswept steppe with a continual gray sky . All sounds were muted and faded into the background noise , even the most terrible screams . The landscape was remarkably unremarkable — details bled together until it was nearly impossible to tell where one was going or where one had been and travelers rarely remembered anything of the lands and towns they had visited during their journeys , though people , creatures , and objects could be remembered as normal . The 45th layer was also home to the Viper Forest of Zrintor . 46th layer . The 46th layer shone with its own luminosity , projecting light and shadows upwards into the sky — the sky itself was dark and turned gray at night . 47th layer . The 47th layer glowed under the light of a blue sun . Heat and cold had an unusual relationship on this plane and often acted opposite to what was expected . Fire burned blue and purple and cold magic instead became hot .

title: Ba Salnang
description: Ba Salnang Ba Salnang was the owner of the Fountain of Happiness Inn in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Given the high flow of wealthy caravan traffic through his inn , and the number of local thieves that this traffic attracted , Ba offered free meals to all of the city guards on duty near his establishment with the hopes of gaining their prompt service should any illegal activities occur under his roof .
description_long: Ba Salnang Ba Salnang was the owner of the Fountain of Happiness Inn in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Given the high flow of wealthy caravan traffic through his inn , and the number of local thieves that this traffic attracted , Ba offered free meals to all of the city guards on duty near his establishment with the hopes of gaining their prompt service should any illegal activities occur under his roof .

title: Baalbisan
description: Baalbisan Baalbisan was a balor who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when he convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven . Baalbisan ' s matron was named Bethshiva .
