title: Baalzebul
description: Baalzebul Baalzebul was the lord of Maladomini , the seventh layer of the Nine Hells , and one of the most powerful archdevil s . Formerly a celestial archon known as Triel , he bore the titles Fallen One , Lord of the Flies , Lord of the Lies , and the Slug Archduke . The last refers to the form he was cursed with after the Reckoning of Hell ; Asmodeus has made his natural form that of a filth - covered giant slug with tiny arms .
description_long: Baalzebul Baalzebul was the lord of Maladomini , the seventh layer of the Nine Hells , and one of the most powerful archdevil s . Formerly a celestial archon known as Triel , he bore the titles Fallen One , Lord of the Flies , Lord of the Lies , and the Slug Archduke . The last refers to the form he was cursed with after the Reckoning of Hell ; Asmodeus has made his natural form that of a filth - covered giant slug with tiny arms . Relations . Baalzebul was allied with Belial , but opposed Mephistopheles in all things , and desired revenge on Asmodeus for his humiliation during the Reckoning . History . Originally an archon named Triel , Baalzebul was cast down into the Nine Hells and promoted to devilhood by Asmodeus himself . Baalzebul was a perfectionist , and this served him well as he climbed the ranks of devilhood . Eventually he ascended to the status of Lord of the Seventh , not just deposing the former Lord but expunging all knowledge of that entity from existence . Baalzebul was , for a long time , one of Asmodeus ' s favored . He controlled not only his own layer of Hell but the Sixth as well , through his viceroy Moloch .

title: Baar Tworgeir
description: Baar Tworgeir Baar Tworgeir was a carpenter living in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Baar was hired by Deirk Erlich to repair the vacant Tinfellow Farm .
description_long: Baar Tworgeir Baar Tworgeir was a carpenter living in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Baar was hired by Deirk Erlich to repair the vacant Tinfellow Farm . He suspected the farm was stolen but knew that Deirk ' s brother was Haakon Erlich , an officer of the Red Plumes , and was scared of reprisals if he disagreed .

title: Baatezu
description: Baatezu Baatezu were a category of devils inhabiting the Nine Hells of Baator . Like all other devils , they were ruled by the Archdevil s , or " Lords of the Nine " . Baatezu on the Fugue Plane .
description_long: Baatezu Baatezu were a category of devils inhabiting the Nine Hells of Baator . Like all other devils , they were ruled by the Archdevil s , or " Lords of the Nine " . Baatezu on the Fugue Plane . Some baatezu stayed on the Fugue Plane from the World Tree cosmology , where they tried to convince souls of the newly deceased to join their ranks by becoming lemure s . Few took up the offer , but to some the prospect of a chance of advancing in baatezu society was preferable to the fate they expected in afterlife .

title: Baatral
description: Baatral Baatral was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Baatral and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Baatral Baatral was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Baatral and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Baatral tried to charm other beings in the vicinity and convince them to harm their companions .

title: Baazka
description: Baazka Baazka was a pit fiend allied with the Red Wizards of Thay in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Baazka was a powerful pit fiend from the Nine Hells .
description_long: Baazka Baazka was a pit fiend allied with the Red Wizards of Thay in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Baazka was a powerful pit fiend from the Nine Hells . He was one of the leaders of the devil s that gained control of Dragonspear Castle . He led the Hordes of Dragonspear in the Second Dragonspear War in 1363 DR . However , at the end of that conflict Baazka was pierced with the magic sword " Illydrael " by a cleric of Tempus . Smote through the heart but not yet dead he escaped into the gate as it was on the verge of closing and returned to the Hells . Baazka had risked all , as if the sword had kill him while on Toril , he could have come back in a century , but if it had killed him in the Hells , he would have died for good . Baazka survived but was afraid to move the sword while he was in the Hells . He also couldn ' t return to Toril until the " gate " closed by " Illydrael " remained inactive . In 1485 DR , the Dragonspear gate reopened and Baazka returned in a ghostly state . In this state he tried to possess the Red Wizard Mennek Ariz but failed and Mennek alerted his superiors .

title: Babau
description: Babau Babaus usually serve as a spy or assassin to more powerful demons of the Abyss or sometimes to spellcasters on the material plane . Babaus strike with sudden ferocity after forming careful , devious plans . Most demon lords have at least several babaus as minions .
description_long: Babau Babaus usually serve as a spy or assassin to more powerful demons of the Abyss or sometimes to spellcasters on the material plane . Babaus strike with sudden ferocity after forming careful , devious plans . Most demon lords have at least several babaus as minions . Babaus usually try to summon another Babau before battle so they can both lay plans together using their telepathy and strike from either side of the opponent to get a flanking bonus . Description . Babaus stand about 6 feet tall and resemble a gaunt humanoid covered in black leathery skin with pointed ears and a long curved horn jutting out of the back of their heads . They also are covered by a red protective slimy jelly that damages anything it touches like acid . A babau appears to be a skeletal humanoid beast . Its skin is stretched taut over the demon ’ s wiry frame . The skull - like head of the babau is distinctively arrayed with a singular curved horn at its back . The body of the demon constantly oozes a caustic blood - like secretion . Combat . Babaus are sneaky and sly . They attack the most powerful foe first , hoping to eliminate the true threats quickly and then toy with the rest .

title: Bacao Foo
description: Bacao Foo Bacao Foo was a merchant in Suijeng in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bacao Foo was a friendly merchant who sat in restaurants waiting for the start of the Komite .
description_long: Bacao Foo Bacao Foo was a merchant in Suijeng in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bacao Foo was a friendly merchant who sat in restaurants waiting for the start of the Komite . He had made a plan to capitalize on the hungry crowds in the city , selling fresh meat from a herd of cattle that had been driven from Janshi in the south by his cattlemen and slaughtered afterward . He offered anyone a chance to invest in his business , requesting they pay in advance 6 ch ' ien per cow ; this was three times the normal price but with a guarantee to receive double in return .

title: Bacar
description: Bacar Bacar are intelligent , ant - like creatures living in the jungle in Far Payit in Maztica . As far as is known the only colony that exists lives in the ruined city of Ixtzul . The Bacar were created by the last ruler of Ixtzul ( Greyst ) using Hishna magic .
description_long: Bacar Bacar are intelligent , ant - like creatures living in the jungle in Far Payit in Maztica . As far as is known the only colony that exists lives in the ruined city of Ixtzul . The Bacar were created by the last ruler of Ixtzul ( Greyst ) using Hishna magic . Solitary bacar are relatively unintelligent but gain a sort of hive intelligence in larger groups . Combat . All bacar are capable of biting opponents . When grouped with other bacars , they acquire the intelligence to use weapons such as maca s and obsidian knives . Ecology . Bacar colonies are ruled by a highly intelligent queen . In order to avoid overpopulation the bacar will eat any unneeded eggs laid by the queen .

title: Baccira
description: Baccira Baccira was a soultaker ghul - kin living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Like all ghul - kin , Baccira used illusions to mask her true appearance , preferring to appear as an attractive dark - haired woman .
description_long: Baccira Baccira was a soultaker ghul - kin living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Like all ghul - kin , Baccira used illusions to mask her true appearance , preferring to appear as an attractive dark - haired woman . Activities . Baccira was a member of the Cult of Istishia , serving as a lesser priestess .

title: Backblast
description: Backblast Backblast was an abjuration spell that caused fire - based spells to be turned back and granted some fire resistance . History . The " backblast " spell was first developed by the phaerimm s .
description_long: Backblast Backblast was an abjuration spell that caused fire - based spells to be turned back and granted some fire resistance . History . The " backblast " spell was first developed by the phaerimm s . It was stolen by magic - users of other races and could later be found in many spellbooks across Faerûn .

title: Backlands
description: Backlands The Backlands were a large lawless , monster - haunted frontier in the Western Heartlands . The Backlands are all the land between the east of Serpent ' s Tail Stream , the Forest of Wyrms and the Trielta Hills ; north of the River Reaching ; west of Anauroch ; and south of the Greypeak Mountains . History .
description_long: Backlands The Backlands were a large lawless , monster - haunted frontier in the Western Heartlands . The Backlands are all the land between the east of Serpent ' s Tail Stream , the Forest of Wyrms and the Trielta Hills ; north of the River Reaching ; west of Anauroch ; and south of the Greypeak Mountains . History . Once the Backlands were covered by the fertile farms of Netheril .

title: Badger
description: Badger A badger was a squat , furry with a distinctive white stripe from the tip of its long nose to the back of its head and white cheeks . Expert diggers , badgers were also notorious for their fury when threatened ; despite their small size , when angered their strong bite and sharp claws could be highly dangerous . Badgers were admired by the gnome race and could often be seen serving as " watchdogs " for rock gnome homes .
description_long: Badger A badger was a squat , furry with a distinctive white stripe from the tip of its long nose to the back of its head and white cheeks . Expert diggers , badgers were also notorious for their fury when threatened ; despite their small size , when angered their strong bite and sharp claws could be highly dangerous . Badgers were admired by the gnome race and could often be seen serving as " watchdogs " for rock gnome homes . They were also favored by ranger s and druid s as animal companion s . The gods Garl Glittergold , Geb , Rillifane Rallathil , Sheela Peryroyl , Silvanus , and Tempus often chose badgers to act as symbols of their favor to their followers .

title: Badger mouse
description: Badger mouse A badger mouse is a mouse - like rodent roughly the size of a badger . They are native to the Duskwood and are most abundant during the Spring , when the ash wheat is in good supply . The badger mice are preyed upon by puff adder s .
description_long: Badger mouse A badger mouse is a mouse - like rodent roughly the size of a badger . They are native to the Duskwood and are most abundant during the Spring , when the ash wheat is in good supply . The badger mice are preyed upon by puff adder s .

title: Badiat al - Farif
description: Badiat al - Farif Badiat al - Farif was a member of the court of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Concerned because the Grand Caliph was unable to produce a male heir , she inquired about the issue at the Mosque of Zann the Wise , tasking them to try to find a solution to the problem .
description_long: Badiat al - Farif Badiat al - Farif was a member of the court of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Concerned because the Grand Caliph was unable to produce a male heir , she inquired about the issue at the Mosque of Zann the Wise , tasking them to try to find a solution to the problem . Members of the Readers spent many months searching through texts , hoping to experience an insightful vision that would shed some light on the problem .

title: Badiat bint Malin
description: Badiat bint Malin Badiat bint Malin was an influential sha ' ir who lived in Kadarasto in 1367 DR . Activities . Badiat may have been an ally of the Yikarian Empire , working to further the goals of the yak - folk in the Cities of the Ancients .
description_long: Badiat bint Malin Badiat bint Malin was an influential sha ' ir who lived in Kadarasto in 1367 DR . Activities . Badiat may have been an ally of the Yikarian Empire , working to further the goals of the yak - folk in the Cities of the Ancients . She directly opposed Khedive Aman al - Qasi abu Nari ' s goals and policies .

title: Badrazel
description: Badrazel Badrazel was a male balor and the chief lieutenant of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He stood roughly 12 ft ( 3 .
description_long: Badrazel Badrazel was a male balor and the chief lieutenant of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He stood roughly 12 ft ( 3 . 6 m ) tall and sported enormous clawed hands and wings . Badrazel ' s skin was a deep red and dancing flames wrapped around him . Personality . Badrazel was especially hot - tempered and was known to engage almost any foe he came across , only backing off if he was sorely wounded . Abilities . A powerful tanar ' ri , Badrazel possessed the full faculties of other balors of his kind . Notably , he preferred to engage foes on the wing and would enter combat with his " unholy aura " active . In battle , he relied on his whip or " greater dispel ling " power to disable most foes . Badrazel would unleash his more potent powers of " implosion " and " unholy blight " against enemies that resisted him . If all else failed , however , Badrazel could " summon " more demon s to his side . Possessions . Like others of his kind , Badrazel carried a flaming whip and a magic al longsword . Relationships . Badrazel has a working relationship with Kurgoth Hellspawn but preferred to operate alone rather than with the rest of Kurgoth ' s forces .

title: Bae ' qeshel
description: Bae ' qeshel Bae ' qeshel was a bardic art known to very few drow . Wielders of " bae ' qeshel " were known as the " dark minstrels . " The song was keening and magical .
description_long: Bae ' qeshel Bae ' qeshel was a bardic art known to very few drow . Wielders of " bae ' qeshel " were known as the " dark minstrels . " The song was keening and magical . Unlike divine magic , dark minstrels tapped into the Weave , and did not require a connection with a deity to wield it . The songs had effects ranging from the healing of wounds to sonic blasts capable of stripping bark off of trees .

title: Bael An Ashock
description: Bael An Ashock Bael An Ashok was the tiefling shopkeeper of the Grand Emporium in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . Personality . He usually gave advice to adventurers new to the city .
description_long: Bael An Ashock Bael An Ashok was the tiefling shopkeeper of the Grand Emporium in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . Personality . He usually gave advice to adventurers new to the city . History . Bael was also involved in some secret matter regarding the tiefling race and tried to recruit tiefling adventurers to do some missions . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Bael was involved in the storyline for the tiefling player race .

title: Baelnorn lich
description: Baelnorn lich Baelnorn liches , sometimes simply called baelnorns , were elves who chose a path of Prime - bound duty beyond death . These undead defenders unswervingly protected their clan and its holdings for centuries . The majority of baelnorn were spellcasters , and they maintained their mental and magical abilities in this state , though exceptions occurred .
description_long: Baelnorn lich Baelnorn liches , sometimes simply called baelnorns , were elves who chose a path of Prime - bound duty beyond death . These undead defenders unswervingly protected their clan and its holdings for centuries . The majority of baelnorn were spellcasters , and they maintained their mental and magical abilities in this state , though exceptions occurred . Creation . The method of becoming a baelnorn was a High Magic or divine ritual . Less fortunate baelnorns stored their souls in a magical receptacle called a phylactery , like lich es . In some cases , baelnorns did not need to use phylacteries , as their undeath was gifted to them by the Seldarine , but alas this process was uncommon . Description . Baelnorn , the willing undead elves , were the elf equivalent of liches , though they were hardly as disturbingly " wrong " as the corrupt undead and they did not project the fearsome aura of those wicked creatures . Sustained by magic and granted life of a sort beyond nature , baelnorn appeared largely as they did in life , though an immediate clue to a baelnorn ' s nature was the existence of shriveled and wrinkled skin turning slightly translucent over time .

title: Baeloth Barrityl
description: Baeloth Barrityl Baeloth Barrityl , also known as Baeloth the Entertainer , was a powerful drow sorcerer and the master of The Black Pits , a famous Underdark fighting pit . After being tricked by his servant djinni , Baeloth found himself banished to the topside of the Sword Coast , eventually joining Gorion ' s Ward during the iron crisis of 1368 DR .
description_long: Baeloth Barrityl Baeloth Barrityl , also known as Baeloth the Entertainer , was a powerful drow sorcerer and the master of The Black Pits , a famous Underdark fighting pit . After being tricked by his servant djinni , Baeloth found himself banished to the topside of the Sword Coast , eventually joining Gorion ' s Ward during the iron crisis of 1368 DR .

title: Baen Chalgash
description: Baen Chalgash Baen Chalgash was a wererat and a high - ranking member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . Relationships . The wererat was the brother and lieutenant of Varin Chalgash .
description_long: Baen Chalgash Baen Chalgash was a wererat and a high - ranking member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . Relationships . The wererat was the brother and lieutenant of Varin Chalgash . History . Baen was involved in the kidnap of the Nasher leader Gothwan Cooper but was killed by an adventurer sent to free Gothwan .

title: Baeniff Tor
description: Baeniff Tor Baeniff Tor was a hill in the marshland of the Evermoors , in Luruar . It was located about 15 miles ( 24 kilometers ) northeast of the town of Nesmé , and 2 miles ( 3 . 2 kilometers ) north of Morach Tor .
description_long: Baeniff Tor Baeniff Tor was a hill in the marshland of the Evermoors , in Luruar . It was located about 15 miles ( 24 kilometers ) northeast of the town of Nesmé , and 2 miles ( 3 . 2 kilometers ) north of Morach Tor . Around 1374 DR there existed flooded mines underneath the tor , which was where the lizardfolk of the Khoroshen tribe took the captured Chaver Tegarech of Nesmé to be sacrificed . The mines beneath the hill led into the Underdark .

title: Baerauble Etharr
description: Baerauble Etharr Baerauble Etharr ( - 116 - 429 DR , later Baerauble the Venerable and Baerauble the Wise ) was a Netherese wizard who lived for many years in the company of the elves inhabiting the Forest Country , and later became the first Royal Magician of Cormyr . Appearance . Baerauble was tall and lean with a ratty reddish beard .
description_long: Baerauble Etharr Baerauble Etharr ( - 116 - 429 DR , later Baerauble the Venerable and Baerauble the Wise ) was a Netherese wizard who lived for many years in the company of the elves inhabiting the Forest Country , and later became the first Royal Magician of Cormyr . Appearance . Baerauble was tall and lean with a ratty reddish beard . Once he began living with the elves , he wore elven green linen leggings and jacket . Relatives . The High Wizard Vangerdahast of Cormyr is descended from Baerauble , as was Amedahast . Background . Baerauble was born in - 116 DR . In - 75 DR , Baerauble was captured and imprisoned by a band of humans in the forest of Cormanthor , until rescued by Alea Dahast and a group of elven hunters . He would later become Alea ' s lover . When Ondeth Obarskyr and his settlers arrived on the land that would later become Suzail in 6 DR , Baerauble introduced himself and became a kind of intermediary between the humans and elves . By 16 DR , there was some feeling within the elven community that he had become a puppet for the humans .

title: Baerdeth Malagar
description: Baerdeth Malagar Baerdeth Malagar was the High Priest or Huntmaster of the High House of the Hunt , a temple devoted to the worship of Malar in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . As Huntmaster , Baerdeth supervised 11 other priests of Malar .
description_long: Baerdeth Malagar Baerdeth Malagar was the High Priest or Huntmaster of the High House of the Hunt , a temple devoted to the worship of Malar in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . As Huntmaster , Baerdeth supervised 11 other priests of Malar . Their congregation in 1358 numbered just shy of a score of worshipers of the Beastlord .

title: Baerelus
description: Baerelus Baerelus the Bold was a satyr and local expert on the lore , flora , and fauna of the King ' s Forest of Cormyr around 1367 DR . Beloved by the people , he enjoyed serving as a guide and source of wise advice to many young Cormyrean s within the area . He was kept informed of what was going on within Cormyr by the confessions of the young folk he spoke to in his daily travels .
description_long: Baerelus Baerelus the Bold was a satyr and local expert on the lore , flora , and fauna of the King ' s Forest of Cormyr around 1367 DR . Beloved by the people , he enjoyed serving as a guide and source of wise advice to many young Cormyrean s within the area . He was kept informed of what was going on within Cormyr by the confessions of the young folk he spoke to in his daily travels . King Azoun IV was known to stop by the forest with a sumptuous meal to learn from Baerelus ' experience . While he wouldn ' t reveal any secrets told to him in confidence , Baerelus gave the king a shrewd picture of the nation of Cormyr . Azoun was keen on heeding most of what Baerelus told him .

title: Baergil
description: Baergil Baergil was a former member of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . Baergil led the Riders of Mistledale until he devoted himself to Tempus and left the Riders to join the church of Tempus .
description_long: Baergil Baergil was a former member of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . Baergil led the Riders of Mistledale until he devoted himself to Tempus and left the Riders to join the church of Tempus . In 1358 DR , the Zhent s under the orders of Bane converged on Shadowdale . Witnessing a Zhentarim wizard raising undead in Essembra , Baergil joined the war . Relationship . Baergil was an acquaintance of Merith Strongbow of the Knights of Myth Drannor .

title: Baergon Bluesword
description: Baergon Bluesword Baergon Bluesword was a cleric of Tempus in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Baergon went to Daggerford with the City Guard of Waterdeep to fight against the evil of Dragonspear Castle .
description_long: Baergon Bluesword Baergon Bluesword was a cleric of Tempus in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Baergon went to Daggerford with the City Guard of Waterdeep to fight against the evil of Dragonspear Castle . Finding many fighters , he established a shrine to the God of Battles . Baergon had many devotees among the Waterdhavian soldiers , some militiamen , and adventurers but only in 1370 DR did the common folk of Daggerford start to accept him and still many farmers feared that Baergon would send their sons to fight in some far place . Baergon had explained many times that he never sent people to battle without going himself but this failed to change their minds .

title: Baerick Hammerstone
description: Baerick Hammerstone Baerick Hammerstone was a dwarf master of the black ice in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . Possessions . Wearing splint mail in battle , Baerick fought with a black ice maul and light hammer .
description_long: Baerick Hammerstone Baerick Hammerstone was a dwarf master of the black ice in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . Possessions . Wearing splint mail in battle , Baerick fought with a black ice maul and light hammer . History . Baerick was a simple miner of Clan Battlehammer when he and his crew were recruited by Pallidor , a former member of the Arcane Brotherhood , to recover the corpse of Akar Kessell . However , Baerick was the first to discover the black ice , which drove him mad . Crazed , he killed all his fellows and afterward became subservient to Kessel , who had risen as a wight . Under Kessel ' s orders , Baerick spread the black ice through the dale , corrupting many people . Meanwhile , back at Kelvin ' s Cairn , he questioned Stokely Silverstream ' s leadership , resulting in a schism in the group . Similarly disaffected dwarves followed Baerick and departed . They established themselves in the Halls of Black Ice , where Baerick plotted to conquer all dwarves .

title: Baerill
description: Baerill Baerill was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships .
description_long: Baerill Baerill was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships . Baerill was the daughter of Buldegas Mhaerkoon , and sister to Asanta . They chatted constantly and had noisy arguments . History . Buldegas Mhaerkoon was the long - time owner of the Wyvern Watch Inn , but following the devastation of the neighboring city of Arabel during the Goblin War in 1370 DR , Buldegas chose to relocate there and build a new inn . He took away his money and some of his best employees and left his daughters in charge of the Wyvern . Baerill and Asanta had recently taken charge by 1374 DR . They conveniently forgot Buldegas ' s instructions about watering down the drink , and their regular banter and arguing was a popular form of entertainment there . This made the Wyvern more popular with patrons .

title: Baerithryn
description: Baerithryn Baerithryn , also known as Braer , was an elf wizard who tutored the young Elminster Aumar . History . Baerithryn was an elf living in the High Forest and a powerful wizard , one of the last to know the secret of the magic of weredragon ing .
description_long: Baerithryn Baerithryn , also known as Braer , was an elf wizard who tutored the young Elminster Aumar . History . Baerithryn was an elf living in the High Forest and a powerful wizard , one of the last to know the secret of the magic of weredragon ing . Braer was also a devoted worshiper of Mystra , a choice unusual for an elf . Mystra herself in her mortal disguise asked Braer to tutor the young Elminster in magical art . Thus Braer became the first magical teacher of El . After Elminster learned all he could , the two parted ways . Years later , Elminster , by now a powerful wizard , came to ask for the help of Braer and his fellow elves in his insurrection against the Magelord s of Athalantar . Braer agreed and was decisive in the battle . In the end , Braer transformed into a silver dragon and confronted the black dragon of magelord Undarl but in the fighting both of them died .

title: Baerlatha Luruin
description: Baerlatha Luruin Baerlatha Luruin was the soft - spoken wife of the healer of Bargewright Inn , Chanczlatha Luruin , around 1365 DR . Description . Baerlatha was a thin woman with steel - gray eyes and blonde hair .
description_long: Baerlatha Luruin Baerlatha Luruin was the soft - spoken wife of the healer of Bargewright Inn , Chanczlatha Luruin , around 1365 DR . Description . Baerlatha was a thin woman with steel - gray eyes and blonde hair . Relationships . Along with mothering a sizable family of children the couple had adopted , Baerlatha spent a lot of her time creating potions for her husband .

title: Baern Harbrow
description: Baern Harbrow Baern Harbrow was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Glathra Barcantle ordered Harbrow to check a palace gate when Elminster Aumar , Storm Silverhand , Amarune Whitewave , and the ghost of Alusair Obarskyr arrived .
description_long: Baern Harbrow Baern Harbrow was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Glathra Barcantle ordered Harbrow to check a palace gate when Elminster Aumar , Storm Silverhand , Amarune Whitewave , and the ghost of Alusair Obarskyr arrived . They quickly destroy the defense ' s garrison and entered the palace . Quickly , Harbrow made a report to Glathra Barcantle .

title: Baernaloth
description: Baernaloth Baernoloths are one of the biggest mysteries of the multiverse . They wander in solitude , they scheme and discard them for something even more terrible . According to the rumors , they created the yugoloth s and demodand s .
description_long: Baernaloth Baernoloths are one of the biggest mysteries of the multiverse . They wander in solitude , they scheme and discard them for something even more terrible . According to the rumors , they created the yugoloth s and demodand s . Whether it ' s true or not , they are powerful . Even the yugoloths give them a wide berth . Description . A baernaloth is a tall , lanky creature , with long limbs . Its head is huge with large curving horns , and its mouth looks like that of a skeletal horse , with skin stretched over it . Its gray skin drips with pus , and its faraway , glassy yellow eyes ooze a revolting liquid . Though they travel alone most of the time , they occasionally take night hags or nightmares for companions . They stand about 8 feet tall and weigh 500 pounds . Combat . The baernoloths are canny , unfathomable creatures . Their plans , schemes and agendas span the ages of the multiverse . The plans of a particular baern can come to fruition next week or 1000 years later . They are equally capable combatants though they often toy with their opponents before transforming them into some humiliating form with their deform ability .

title: Baeron
description: Baeron Baeron was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Shilarn , he overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives .
description_long: Baeron Baeron was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Shilarn , he overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives . Baeron married Shilarn , also a Lord of Waterdeep . They had a daughter , Lhestyn the Masked Lady , who later became an Open Lord of Waterdeep . Background . After the Council of Guildmasters seized power in Waterdeep in 1256 DR , most of the Lords of Waterdeep were eliminated because their identities , which were supposed to have remained secret , had been compromised . Only Baeron and Shilarn are known to have survived this purge . In 1273 DR , they both entered the court of the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh , who were in power in the city at the time , and demanded that they leave the city . When they refused , Shilarn struck them down and killed them using her magic . Baeron revealed his identity , restoring the original form of government and becoming the Open Lord . Baeron died of fever in 1308 DR . His wife , Shilarn , killed herself by jumping onto his funeral pyre .

title: Baert Ghalhunt
description: Baert Ghalhunt Baert Ghalhunt was the personal huntsman of Marlin Stormserpent . History . Around 1479 DR , Marlin sent Ghalhunt to kill all the people that knew his hiding spot .
description_long: Baert Ghalhunt Baert Ghalhunt was the personal huntsman of Marlin Stormserpent . History . Around 1479 DR , Marlin sent Ghalhunt to kill all the people that knew his hiding spot . Ghalhunt did the job very well and reported to his master about it , but soon after he was killed by a Blueflame ghost .

title: Baervan Wildwanderer
description: Baervan Wildwanderer Baervan Wildwanderer , also known as The Forest Gnome , was the neutral good gnome deity of forests , travel and nature . He lived in the gnomish realm of the Golden Hills . His sacred animal was the raccoon and his holy days were on the full moon .
description_long: Baervan Wildwanderer Baervan Wildwanderer , also known as The Forest Gnome , was the neutral good gnome deity of forests , travel and nature . He lived in the gnomish realm of the Golden Hills . His sacred animal was the raccoon and his holy days were on the full moon . Worshipers . Baervan ' s cleric s wore wood - brown cloths and green caps . They worshiped Baervan in forest clearings while sacrificing treasure items to him monthly . Relationships . Baervan ' s closest friend was Chiktikka Fastpaws , a sentient giant raccoon . His superior was Garl Glittergold . Baervan considered Segojan Earthcaller , Brandobaris , Clangeddin Silverbeard , Gwaeron Windstrom and other good nature deities among his allies . Urdlen and Malar were particularly hated enemies .

title: Baerzlus Anagathiir
description: Baerzlus Anagathiir Baerzlus Anagathiir was the only Red Wizards of Thay magister knew for one of the shortest reign ever . Personality . The young Baerzlus believed that becoming Magister will grant him power among his peers .
description_long: Baerzlus Anagathiir Baerzlus Anagathiir was the only Red Wizards of Thay magister knew for one of the shortest reign ever . Personality . The young Baerzlus believed that becoming Magister will grant him power among his peers . History . Baerzlus thank to some luck managed to kill in 952 DR the hedonistic Magister Ildathchance Orlaer after discovering his refuge . However instead of the respect that he believed to receive from his fellow Baerzlus was welcomed with hostility by all red wizards . After one mage sent his slaves to kill him Baerzlus flew from Thay . After he spied from afar upon his fellows and sawing only assassin intents Baerzlus started killed one Red Wizards after one , all choose among his old foes and superiors . At last an army of Red Wizards attacked Baerzlus , all with the intent of personally kill him and claim the Magister ' s position , and this started one of the most terrific spell - battle ever , even creating a place of wild magic . Baerzlus was totally disintegrated like most of his attackers and Mystra and Azuth were so disgusted by the devastation and the loss of lives that decided to search in a other place the next Magister .

title: Baffenburg
description: Baffenburg Baffenburg was a large town in what is now the Fell Pass circa approximately - 335 DR . Baffenburg ' s residents were both orc s and dwarves and they had lived together in peace for many years , even merging their languages . It seems as if Baffenburg was originally a surface outpost of Delzoun , much like Citadel Felbarr , Citadel Sundabar and Citadel Adbar .
description_long: Baffenburg Baffenburg was a large town in what is now the Fell Pass circa approximately - 335 DR . Baffenburg ' s residents were both orc s and dwarves and they had lived together in peace for many years , even merging their languages . It seems as if Baffenburg was originally a surface outpost of Delzoun , much like Citadel Felbarr , Citadel Sundabar and Citadel Adbar . Then the orcs living in the surrounding region came to live there , held in check by a single orc wizard - chieftain named Bowug Kr ' kri who was then murdered by his followers , causing a period of unrest . Over the years the periods of unrest waxed and waned but got better and the two communities lived together for at least two centuries before an unknown catastrophe melted the permafrost beneath it and made it sink into the ground . This catastrophe likely involved a thinning of the planar borders as overgrown ethereal marauder s and creatures from the Plane of Shadow now inhabit the ruins .

title: Bag of holding
description: Bag of holding A Bag of holding was a small sack that acted as an opening to a nondimensional space . The space inside the bag could hold a huge amount of materials and it not increase the weight of the bag . History .
description_long: Bag of holding A Bag of holding was a small sack that acted as an opening to a nondimensional space . The space inside the bag could hold a huge amount of materials and it not increase the weight of the bag . History . Bags of holding were ancient magical items that have been known through out the Realms from antiquity . Uses . The Bag of Holding could hold more then it appears to be able too , so it was used to ease transportation of items . If a bag of holding was placed in extradimensional space like a Portable hole both would be lost forever , but a rift to the Astral Plane is opened . The bag also allowed a few of minutes of breathing air for creatures that would enter it . If a bag of holding got overloaded or if pierced by something sharp it and everything in it would be lost forever . Lore . The Lightfoot communities were intrigued with things related to ease of travel and so they were more common more then other communities , and so weir a bit cheaper to buy there than in most places . Variants . There are similar magical bags to the bag of holding :

title: Baga Choki
description: Baga Choki Baga Choki was a Tuigan warrior and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Description . Baga was tall for a Tuigan and possessed a sinister countenance .
description_long: Baga Choki Baga Choki was a Tuigan warrior and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Description . Baga was tall for a Tuigan and possessed a sinister countenance . Keen intelligence was reflected from his hard gaze . Activities . Baga was the commander of a " tumen " — a Tuigan military unit of 10 , 000 soldiers . He served within the portion of the army under Prince Hubadai Khahan ' s ultimate command . He was actively involved in the conquest of Semphar . Possessions . He owned a magical two - handed sword , magical lamellar armor , and a " amulet of sound thought " .

title: Bagatur Jokai
description: Bagatur Jokai Bagatur Jokai was a commander within the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Bagatur commanded an " arban " — a military unit of ten men — within the army .
description_long: Bagatur Jokai Bagatur Jokai was a commander within the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Bagatur commanded an " arban " — a military unit of ten men — within the army . The portion of the army under Prince Hubadai ' s command were camped outside of the ruins of Kushk when a large purple dragon attacked them . Bagatur and his men were sent to explore the city , where they stumbled upon an ancient scroll detaling a portion of the dragon ' s history . His " arban " was attacked on the return trip . Bagatur perished from wounds suffered at the hands of a blood - sucking jiki - ketsu - gaki .

title: Bagpipes
description: Bagpipes Bagpipes were a type of wind instrument that used a bag filled with the help of a mouthpiece to provide the necessary flow , while the sound came from the attached reed or reeds with different holes to vary the tone . Dwarves held bagpipes in high regard . Mizwid .
description_long: Bagpipes Bagpipes were a type of wind instrument that used a bag filled with the help of a mouthpiece to provide the necessary flow , while the sound came from the attached reed or reeds with different holes to vary the tone . Dwarves held bagpipes in high regard . Mizwid . The Zakhara n version of the bagpipes was called mizwid ( meaning " food pouch " in Midani ) . It was played with a double - reeded flute attached to the wind bag with corresponding two rows of holes where the melody could be played , while it produced an underlying droning tone at the same time .

title: Bahamut
description: Bahamut Bahamut ( pronounced " bah - HAHM - ut " ) was the dragon god of justice and a subservient deity to Torm , god of law . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , he was a member of the Draconic pantheon , as a deity of good dragons , metallic dragons , wisdom , and enlightened justice ( justice tempered with mercy and punishment with forgiveness ) known by the name of Xymor ( pronounced " ZIE - more " ) . For some time he was also a member of the Untheric pantheon , under the alias of Marduk .
description_long: Bahamut Bahamut ( pronounced " bah - HAHM - ut " ) was the dragon god of justice and a subservient deity to Torm , god of law . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , he was a member of the Draconic pantheon , as a deity of good dragons , metallic dragons , wisdom , and enlightened justice ( justice tempered with mercy and punishment with forgiveness ) known by the name of Xymor ( pronounced " ZIE - more " ) . For some time he was also a member of the Untheric pantheon , under the alias of Marduk . His natural form was that of a platinum dragon , said by many to be the only one of his kind . He was also the eternal rival of his sister Tiamat , queen of the chromatic dragon s . Description . In his natural form , Bahamut was a massive dragon ( approx 180 feet ( 55m ) long ) with a tail the same length as his body , with platinum scales tougher than any shield and blue eyes , the exact color of which was hard to specify and may have depended on Bahamut ' s mood . As Xymor , he was described as a huge dragon wrapped in a scintillating aura of light so brilliant that it was impossible to tell his color .

title: Bahgtru
description: Bahgtru Bahgtru was a rather stupid god of pure physical strength who scorned both weapons and magic alike . He was the son of Gruumsh . Worshipers .
description_long: Bahgtru Bahgtru was a rather stupid god of pure physical strength who scorned both weapons and magic alike . He was the son of Gruumsh . Worshipers . Bahgtru ' s followers were often the strongest of the orc tribes , and were required to be unwaveringly loyal to their chieftain - until he was defeated in a challenge of physical strength or was slain . Among Bahgtru ' s faithful , loyalty only extended to the clan and rivalries between clans were encouraged . Relationships . Bahgtru served Gruumsh loyally , and was feared by the other orc gods for his strength . He opposed the goblinoid deities , the Seldarine and sylvan deities . He respected the Dwarven gods for their strength , but would have liked to crush their skulls . Bahgtru also hated the deities of deception ; Baravar Cloakshadow , Cyric , and Mask .

title: Bahija Jalin
description: Bahija Jalin Bahija Jalin was a potion vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Due to skillful application of make - up , Bahija appeared to be in her 90 ' s .
description_long: Bahija Jalin Bahija Jalin was a potion vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Due to skillful application of make - up , Bahija appeared to be in her 90 ' s . In fact , she was only 27 years old . Activities . Most of Bahija ' s potions were non - magical but highly alcoholic . She sold these to unsuspecting fools or foreigners visiting Huzuz . Bahija was able to craft a potion of " ventriloquism " , but she rarely had these for sale in her shop . Customers could arrange for Bahija to cast the " evil eye " on someone if the price was right . She could also remove the curse of the " evil eye " from those who were afflicted .

title: Bahija al - Kesir
description: Bahija al - Kesir Bahija al - Kesir was a human pragmatist within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bahija led a contingent of priests who operated the palace hospital .
description_long: Bahija al - Kesir Bahija al - Kesir was a human pragmatist within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bahija led a contingent of priests who operated the palace hospital . She ensured that her staff was always prepared for a tragedy . They spent most of their time healing guards who were injured during training exercises . Bahija was also a superb midwife . She was ready to attend a wife or concubine of the Grand Caliph should they give birth .

title: Bahramiyah al - Musafir
description: Bahramiyah al - Musafir Bahramiyah al - Musafir was a caravan master from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . For over 40 years Bahramiyah oversaw the great caravans that transported fine weapons crafted by the House of Bulad from Hiyal to Qudra .
description_long: Bahramiyah al - Musafir Bahramiyah al - Musafir was a caravan master from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . For over 40 years Bahramiyah oversaw the great caravans that transported fine weapons crafted by the House of Bulad from Hiyal to Qudra . She traveled with each shipment . Relationships . Her sons and daughters managed most of the business as she aged .

title: Bai Kabor
description: Bai Kabor The Bai Kabor were one of the over 100 Bedine tribes . Honor was prime among the Bedine ' s beliefs . The Bai Kabor had a harsh existence , but their death and hardship made them resilient to the many obstacles they faced .
description_long: Bai Kabor The Bai Kabor were one of the over 100 Bedine tribes . Honor was prime among the Bedine ' s beliefs . The Bai Kabor had a harsh existence , but their death and hardship made them resilient to the many obstacles they faced . Abel Kerrington became their leader in 1483 , during the Era of Upheaval . The Bai Kabor gained more territories during this time , helping them rise to prominence . Their tribe gained recognition throughout the Anarouch region of northern Faerun .

title: Baishiria
description: Baishiria Baishiria was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Baishiria was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Baishiria Baishiria was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Baishiria was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Baishiria was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Baiyosho Degi
description: Baiyosho Degi Baiyosho Degi was a monk member of the Tairo in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Baiyosho was a monk from a family that had always provided generations of faithful servitors to the shogunate .
description_long: Baiyosho Degi Baiyosho Degi was a monk member of the Tairo in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Baiyosho was a monk from a family that had always provided generations of faithful servitors to the shogunate . Degi was assured a place as a jisha - bugyo commissioner , but shogun Matasuuri Nagahide noticed his great intelligence and fervid devotion to the Path of Enlightenment and asked him to give a series of private lectures about the Path . During those lectures , Degi explained to the shogun that the Path advocated a natural hierarchy and so Nagahide had a celestial blessing to rule . Impressed , the shogun granted Baiyosho a place in the Tairo , as the only non - samurai , and proclaimed the Path the national religion of Wa . Personality . Degli was a fleshy and expressionless individual , a loner who disliked human contact . He was a brilliant scholar and his loyalty to the shogun was absolute .

title: Bakar
description: Bakar Bakar , a survivor state of the Imaskar Empire , disappeared in approximately 357 DR when the River Athis dried up due to the curse of Bakar ' s last pharoah , Amun - Re . Bakar was located in Raurin , and it was the most recent of Imaskar ' s survivor states to rule there . Notable locations .
description_long: Bakar Bakar , a survivor state of the Imaskar Empire , disappeared in approximately 357 DR when the River Athis dried up due to the curse of Bakar ' s last pharoah , Amun - Re . Bakar was located in Raurin , and it was the most recent of Imaskar ' s survivor states to rule there . Notable locations . Locations in Bakar included Terbakar , the capital , which was also the magical source of the River Athis . Also along the River Athis was the garden city of Pazar , the Oasis of the White Palm , and Carthag , which is now known as Phoenix . Notable characters . Beside the pharoah , Amun - Re , other inhabitants of ancient Bakar include the land ' s Grand Vizier , Martek . Religion . The people of Bakar worshiped the gods of the Mulhorandi pantheon .

title: Bakhara Spires
description: Bakhara Spires The Bukhara Spires were circles of massive bronze spires , each etched with an intricate runic design said to be Batrachi in origin . These spires were created in the Early Dynastic period ( - 7975 to - 6422 DR ) , by the Imaskari who , around this time , had mastered transdimensional magic . These permanant , two - way portals allowed the rapid transportation of whole legions over vast distances in the blink of an eye .
description_long: Bakhara Spires The Bukhara Spires were circles of massive bronze spires , each etched with an intricate runic design said to be Batrachi in origin . These spires were created in the Early Dynastic period ( - 7975 to - 6422 DR ) , by the Imaskari who , around this time , had mastered transdimensional magic . These permanant , two - way portals allowed the rapid transportation of whole legions over vast distances in the blink of an eye . This allowed the Imaskar Empire to rapidly expand across Eastern Faerûn . After the Silent Death ( which started in - 4370 DR ) nearly destroyed lower Imaskar , Lord Artificer Khotan created twin Spires which connected to annother world where the people had no control over the art . During the next four centuries tens of thousands of slaves where taken from the other world . Eventually this slave population began to intermarry with the Imaskari , this gave rise to the Mulan ethnicity .

title: Bakshi
description: Bakshi The Bakshi were a yakuza clan who dominated the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Organization . At that time , the Bakshi were headed by So Golin - po , nicknamed " the Hojyko Yada " , of " the mountain badger " .
description_long: Bakshi The Bakshi were a yakuza clan who dominated the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Organization . At that time , the Bakshi were headed by So Golin - po , nicknamed " the Hojyko Yada " , of " the mountain badger " . He was the mastermind behind their rise to power . Activities . So Golin - po and the Bakshi were the true rulers of Ojy - do . Although the city was nominally ruled by a governor appointed by King Wanang Sun , the Bakshi were able to manipulate the governor . They controlled both the city guard and the criminal underworld . The Bakshi worked only to gouge money from the city . Golin - po was utterly ruthless in dealing with anyone who had the temerity to steal or con in the city , or who tried to shake his grip on power . Many who opposed the Bakshi were killed , and honorable folk had long since fled the city . Golin - po had illicit dealings with Kozakuran , which was an enemy of Koryo . Base of Operations . So Golin - po ' s house was the largest in the city and in fact it was a fortified compound . It contained a courtyard and a formal garden ; here , the Hojyko Yada executed those who offended him during martial training .

title: Bala
description: Bala Bala was a goddess of music of Zakhara and emphasized the importance of music to lift the spirit and mitigate suffering . She was a local goddess who was worshipped in the city of Mahabba , but her faith was outlawed and driven underground by the Pantheists . In this persecution her followers spread to other cities .
description_long: Bala Bala was a goddess of music of Zakhara and emphasized the importance of music to lift the spirit and mitigate suffering . She was a local goddess who was worshipped in the city of Mahabba , but her faith was outlawed and driven underground by the Pantheists . In this persecution her followers spread to other cities . Their sometimes violent resistance against their oppressors has brought the goddess the epithed " of Ill Tidings " . < br > Bala ' s symbol was a zither . < br > The goddess has been described as a colorfully but modestly dressed , middle - aged woman who played her zither in a way that enchants gods and genies . title: Balacer Macefist
description: Balacer Macefist Balacer Macefist was a human male and the Commander of the Golden Fortress Military Academy in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . The Golden Fortress was the primary garrison of the Amnian Army and Balacer Macefist commanded a total of 25 , 000 troops , officers , instructors , and trainees . Commander Macefist took orders from General Labak Craumerdaun but could act independently to aid the city if needed .

title: Balagos
description: Balagos Balagos , known as the Flying Flame , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Balagos was a megalomaniac .
description_long: Balagos Balagos , known as the Flying Flame , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Balagos was a megalomaniac . He truly believed that his destiny was to rule over all dragonkind and lead them in the extermination of human s and elves . However , on his path to dominion , he had to destroy all who opposed to him ; he killed so many other dragons that elves nicknamed him Dragonsbane . Despite his ego , Balagos was not stupid in the least , and he would escape from a losing battle in order to have vengeance another day . His three main talents were that he never forgot the face , name , or attitude of any being that he met ; he was a good judge of character ( and not limited only to dragons ) ; and he always calculated the consequences and outcomes of his acts . Balagos had no special affinities or hatred for anyone . In his mind , all were his rightful subjects , and only those who opposed him deserved death . He felt that he was one of the few rulers in Faerûn who could carry out such a policy and survive , as he had done for more than a thousand years . Activities . Balagos was very fond of human flesh , particularly that of youngish females .

title: Balanzia
description: Balanzia Balanzia was a dead city in T ' u Lung . Founded in 422 DR , Balanzia was once one of the largest cities in all Kara - Tur , thanks to its easy access to Zastrasai Bay and the Straits of Va ' shung , as well as its great sea wall and its magnificent towers . However , in 1118 DR , a wandering wise man named Loarru the Just came to Balanzia , advising that the city would fall , but nobody listened .
description_long: Balanzia Balanzia was a dead city in T ' u Lung . Founded in 422 DR , Balanzia was once one of the largest cities in all Kara - Tur , thanks to its easy access to Zastrasai Bay and the Straits of Va ' shung , as well as its great sea wall and its magnificent towers . However , in 1118 DR , a wandering wise man named Loarru the Just came to Balanzia , advising that the city would fall , but nobody listened . However , during the invasions by Shou Lung forces , the walls were weakened step by step until in 1153 DR the great Shou wu jen Moia Chun opened the final hole in the wall . The people went insane with fear and in less than a month the city became deserted .

title: Baldur ' s Gate
description: Baldur ' s Gate Baldur ' s Gate , also called simply the Gate , was a metropolis and city - state on the Sword Coast and Western Heartlands border , on the north bank of the River Chionthar about 20 miles ( 32 km ) east from its mouth on the Sea of Swords . It was located to the south of the great city - state of Waterdeep and to the north of the country of Amn , and was located along the well - traveled Coast Way road . This wealthy port metropolis , whose population , according to many accounts , exceeded that of Waterdeep , was an important merchant city on the Sword Coast .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate Baldur ' s Gate , also called simply the Gate , was a metropolis and city - state on the Sword Coast and Western Heartlands border , on the north bank of the River Chionthar about 20 miles ( 32 km ) east from its mouth on the Sea of Swords . It was located to the south of the great city - state of Waterdeep and to the north of the country of Amn , and was located along the well - traveled Coast Way road . This wealthy port metropolis , whose population , according to many accounts , exceeded that of Waterdeep , was an important merchant city on the Sword Coast . Its strong watch and the presence of the powerful Flaming Fists mercenary company kept the city generally peaceful and safe . Demonym . A person from Baldur ' s Gate was known as a Baldurian . History . In ancient times , the seafaring human hero Balduran returned from Anchrome with great wealth . Balduran used this wealth to build a wall at the end of the Chionthar river . Balduran later vanished , never to return . After Balduran vanished , local farmers took control of the wall and begin to tax sailors arriving .

title: Baldur ' s Gate ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate is a computer role - playing game developed by and released in 1998 by . It is the first game in the " Baldur ' s Gate " series , and is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . The gameplay is adapted from 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , featuring a mixture of turn - based and pausable real - time combat .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate is a computer role - playing game developed by and released in 1998 by . It is the first game in the " Baldur ' s Gate " series , and is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . The gameplay is adapted from 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , featuring a mixture of turn - based and pausable real - time combat . The game was critically acclaimed upon its release , and as of 2008 it had sold over 2 million copies . The plot of " Baldur ' s Gate " revolves around the main character , Gorion ' s Ward , and deals with the politics of the city of Baldur ' s Gate , as well as the aftermath of the Time of Troubles . The game was novelized by Philip Athans in 1999 , with a number of discrepancies between game and novel . An expansion pack to " Baldur ' s Gate " , titled " " , was published in 1999 . It adds between 20 and 30 hours worth of content to the original game , including four new areas . In 2012 , a remake was released under the title " " . In addition to various technical enhancements , it adds several new areas , companions , and quests . Plot .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance is the first in a series of role - playing games developed exclusively for game consoles . It was developed by Snowblind Studios and released for the PlayStation 2 in 2001 , with versions for the Xbox and Nintendo GameCube releasing in 2002 . A Game Boy Advance version of " Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance " was also released in 2004 , by Magic Pockets .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance is the first in a series of role - playing games developed exclusively for game consoles . It was developed by Snowblind Studios and released for the PlayStation 2 in 2001 , with versions for the Xbox and Nintendo GameCube releasing in 2002 . A Game Boy Advance version of " Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance " was also released in 2004 , by Magic Pockets . The sequel to the game , " " , was developed by Black Isle Studios for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox , releasing in 2004 . Plot . The player must choose between one of three ( or five ) characters : The game starts when the player character arrives in the city of Baldur ' s Gate , after a dangerous journey . Shortly after arrival the player is attacked and robbed , and is brought to an inn by guards to recover . There , the first hints about a great evil hiding in Baldur ' s Gate are revealed , and the player can choose to discover more .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox , released in 2004 . " Dark Alliance II " returned to Baldur ' s Gate with a new story and new characters . The story begins when the player ' s previous three heroes are taken prisoner by an evil vampire king , Mordoc SeLanmere .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox , released in 2004 . " Dark Alliance II " returned to Baldur ' s Gate with a new story and new characters . The story begins when the player ' s previous three heroes are taken prisoner by an evil vampire king , Mordoc SeLanmere . In part two , the player is one of the many adventurers seeking fame and fortune in Baldur ' s Gate . The gameplay is very similar to that of the original " " . The new characters are : Unlike in the original " Dark Alliance " game , players can create their own magical weapons , armor , and trinkets ( for a price ) in " Dark Alliance II " . Special appearances . Drizzt Do ' Urden and his nemesis , Artemis Entreri , both make appearances as playable characters if you beat the game once on normal , and then again on " extreme " mode .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn is the second computer role - playing game in the Baldur ' s Gate series and takes place just a few months after the events of " Baldur ' s Gate " . It is based on the outdated Advanced Dungeons and Dragons 2nd Edition system . Features .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn is the second computer role - playing game in the Baldur ' s Gate series and takes place just a few months after the events of " Baldur ' s Gate " . It is based on the outdated Advanced Dungeons and Dragons 2nd Edition system . Features . Character race . The player character can be a dwarf , elf , gnome , half - elf , halfling or human as before , with half - orc added as a new option . Character classes . Besides of the standard 2nd edition classes seen in " Baldur ' s Gate I " ( fighter , ranger , paladin , thief , bard , mage and specialist wizards , cleric and druid ) and their combinations , " Shadows of Amn " offers the option for the player character to be a barbarian , sorcerer or monk . All the old classes , except wizards that already have the school specialization possibility , also have the option to select a " kit " that will change their class abilities . Clerics have to gain these during the game , others choose them at the beginning . Many NPCs also use a kit . A list is available at . Strongholds .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal is an expansion pack for the computer role - playing game , and is the final chapter in the Baldur ' s Gate series . It adds one large optional bonus area to the Baldur ' s Gate II game : Watcher ' s Keep , a multi - level dungeon of sorts . Plot .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal is an expansion pack for the computer role - playing game , and is the final chapter in the Baldur ' s Gate series . It adds one large optional bonus area to the Baldur ' s Gate II game : Watcher ' s Keep , a multi - level dungeon of sorts . Plot . War breaks out throughout Tethyr between the agitated Bhaalspawn who turn out to be numerous and fight each other for power . The player must venture through treacherous regions , including the besieged city of Saradush , the Fire Giant - controlled Marching Mountains and the desert village of Amkethran . Five legendary Bhaalspawn , each so powerful that they are impervious to normal weapons , rise to power and notoriety , forcing the player character to defeat them either for personal glory or for the fate of Tethyr . The player comes a long way from his or her humble beginnings in Candlekeep . Ultimately , the player must vanquish all competitors and be presented with the choice of ascending the throne of Bhaal and becoming the new God of Murder , or destroying it and returning to peaceful life as a mortal .

title: Baldur ' s Gate series
description: Baldur ' s Gate series The " Baldur ' s Gate " series of computer games by BioWare Corp and the now - defunct Black Isle Studios have become some of the most respected computer roleplaying games to date . Followed by a trilogy of novels that weren ' t received nearly as well , the games are still played by a large , devoted group . The modding community is also still fairly vibrant as are the official ( and several unofficial ) forums .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate series The " Baldur ' s Gate " series of computer games by BioWare Corp and the now - defunct Black Isle Studios have become some of the most respected computer roleplaying games to date . Followed by a trilogy of novels that weren ' t received nearly as well , the games are still played by a large , devoted group . The modding community is also still fairly vibrant as are the official ( and several unofficial ) forums .

title: Baldur ' s Gate trilogy ( novels )
description: Baldur ' s Gate trilogy ( novels ) The Baldur ' s Gate trilogy are the novelizations of the " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game series . The first two novels are written by Philip Athans , editor of the " Forgotten Realms " novel line , and the third by Drew Karpyshyn . The novels are based on the storylines of the computer game series .
description_long: Baldur ' s Gate trilogy ( novels ) The Baldur ' s Gate trilogy are the novelizations of the " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game series . The first two novels are written by Philip Athans , editor of the " Forgotten Realms " novel line , and the third by Drew Karpyshyn . The novels are based on the storylines of the computer game series . They follow the bare basics of the original stories , but , as novels with linear and not very complex storylines , avoid several of the games ' numerous subplots and only include a few of the NPCs . The Bhaalspawn main character from the games appears as Abdel Adrian in the novels . Baldur ' s Gate . The novels are often criticized by fans of the series for being inaccurate to the games ' original story and spirit , as well as for leaving out or killing off many well - loved NPCs .

title: Balduran
description: Balduran Balduran is a legendary seafaring explorer . He was the first native of Faerûn to set foot on the lands known as Anchorome and made the trek up to Sossal . He returned full of tales and vast wealth .
description_long: Balduran Balduran is a legendary seafaring explorer . He was the first native of Faerûn to set foot on the lands known as Anchorome and made the trek up to Sossal . He returned full of tales and vast wealth . He put forth a large sum of money to protect his sparsely - settled home harbor town . Then he set sail of Anchorome again and has never been seen again . His money was well spent on the wall though , and that small town soon grew into the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Although he invested vast amounts of money into his home - town , it is rumoured that Before leaving for his second and final adventure , Balduran hid the rest of his fortune along with numerous relics in one of the many caves along the Sword Coast cliffs . These cliff ' s are known as the Sword ' s Teeth . The Flaming Fist took an expedition to Anchorome to discover the fate of Balduran . They encountered vast tribes of savage elves , that decimated the expedition . Balduran also lends his name to the Bay of Balduran on Anchorome , and the Seatower of Balduran in Baldur ' s Gate .

title: Balduran ' s Log Book
description: Balduran ' s Log Book Balduran ' s Log Book was the incomplete logbook of Captain Balduran , detailing his journey to Anchorome . It lay in the wreck of his ship , the " Wandering Eye " , on Werewolf Island . It was damaged by time and the elements .
description_long: Balduran ' s Log Book Balduran ' s Log Book was the incomplete logbook of Captain Balduran , detailing his journey to Anchorome . It lay in the wreck of his ship , the " Wandering Eye " , on Werewolf Island . It was damaged by time and the elements . In 1368 DR , Mendas in Ulgoth ' s Beard hired Gorion ' s Ward to go to Werewolf Island and retrieve the log book , claiming he wished to study it . Text . The surviving text read :

title: Balhiir
description: Balhiir Balhiir are energy creatures that feed off of magic , any form of magic , from thrown spells to s up to dragon magic . While they cannot be harmed with mundane objects , they can be drained or ' prisoned with telekinesis . A balhiir can only be destroyed by its releaser .
description_long: Balhiir Balhiir are energy creatures that feed off of magic , any form of magic , from thrown spells to s up to dragon magic . While they cannot be harmed with mundane objects , they can be drained or ' prisoned with telekinesis . A balhiir can only be destroyed by its releaser . Balhiir inhabit their own plane and can be summoned to the Prime Material Plane . They can be bound into objects or made to ' ride ' other beings . They resemble a loosely grouped cloud of lights .

title: Balian ' s yellow ioun stone
description: Balian ' s yellow ioun stone Balian ' s yellow ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " that boosted a random physical or mental trait of the bearer . Powers . When attuned , this seemingly faulty " ioun stone " gave an enhancement to one physical or mental trait of the bearer , as with " ioun stones " , but this was decided randomly each day .
description_long: Balian ' s yellow ioun stone Balian ' s yellow ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " that boosted a random physical or mental trait of the bearer . Powers . When attuned , this seemingly faulty " ioun stone " gave an enhancement to one physical or mental trait of the bearer , as with " ioun stones " , but this was decided randomly each day . The stone could only be attuned once a day , and only functioned for twelve hours , after which it dropped it the floor . It couldn ' t be used again until twelve hours after it was last used . History . Whilst serving as a guard at a convention of wizard s , one Balian Rocksmith discovered this " ioun stone " on the floor , apparently lost after it stopped functioning .

title: Balian Rocksmith
description: Balian Rocksmith Balian Rocksmith was a guard . Whilst serving as a guard at a convention of wizard s , Balian discovered a seemingly faulty " ioun stone " on the floor , apparently lost after it stopped functioning . It became known as " Balian ' s yellow ioun stone " .
description_long: Balian Rocksmith Balian Rocksmith was a guard . Whilst serving as a guard at a convention of wizard s , Balian discovered a seemingly faulty " ioun stone " on the floor , apparently lost after it stopped functioning . It became known as " Balian ' s yellow ioun stone " .

title: Balismo Dey Canna
description: Balismo Dey Canna Balismo Dey Canna was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Balismo was a noble of Calimport who , at the Amn ian court , decided to join the expedition to Maztica .
description_long: Balismo Dey Canna Balismo Dey Canna was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Balismo was a noble of Calimport who , at the Amn ian court , decided to join the expedition to Maztica . However , arriving in Helmsport , he was set to act as an overseer . Instead , he wanted to lead an expedition to find some gold and many times Balismo spoke to Lord Drakosa about this . Personality . Balismo grew bored of the " new world " in Ulatos and dreamed of leading a great expedition that would make him rich . However , he was too cautious to act without official permission . Balismo claimed he had nothing against the Maztican s , provided they obeyed his orders . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Balismo Dey Canna is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Baliver ' s House of Horses
description: Baliver ' s House of Horses Baliver ' s House of Horses was a rental stable in Luskan . History . The stables consisted of a series of walled paddocks and sheds located at the south end of the Upstream Span .
description_long: Baliver ' s House of Horses Baliver ' s House of Horses was a rental stable in Luskan . History . The stables consisted of a series of walled paddocks and sheds located at the south end of the Upstream Span . Inhabitants . The Arcane Brotherhood watched over the stables , which charged 4 gold piece s a night for each horse , and were known to use " tracer " spells on horses if they suspected they would need to track the owner . History . As of 1370 DR , it was the only rental stable in the city .

title: Balix
description: Balix Balix was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The drow was a wizard and a historian .
description_long: Balix Balix was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The drow was a wizard and a historian . History . In 1491 DR , he went with a scout companion to check the Fane but they were ambushed by the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Balix was captured and the scout killed . He remained a prisoner of some air cultists and a nycaloth until some adventurers infiltrated the Fane , killing the cultists , and freed him .

title: Ball lightning
description: Ball lightning Ball lightning , also known as nautical ball lightning , was an arcane conjuration spell that produced one or more spheres of coruscating electricity that skimmed along surfaces , possibly catching them on fire . Effects . This spell had a range of 180 ft ( 55 m ) and lasted a number of minutes equal to the caster ' s level .
description_long: Ball lightning Ball lightning , also known as nautical ball lightning , was an arcane conjuration spell that produced one or more spheres of coruscating electricity that skimmed along surfaces , possibly catching them on fire . Effects . This spell had a range of 180 ft ( 55 m ) and lasted a number of minutes equal to the caster ' s level . Once a " ball lightning " struck a target , it rolled rapidly along the surface , following the contours in random directions , turning corners , and climbing or descending without regard for gravity . There was a small chance that a ball would come to rest at one of the turning points and catch the surface on fire , if it was flammable . Living creatures touched by a " ball lightning " were shocked and sustained some damage even if they were able to resist this spell . Casters of advanced level could produce additional spheres which could each be hurled at different targets . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . History . This spell was associated with the pirates roaming the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Balor
description: Balor Balors , also known as type VI demon s , were one of the most powerful types of tanar ' ri . They were found serving as generals under demon lord s or even as minor princelings . Description .
description_long: Balor Balors , also known as type VI demon s , were one of the most powerful types of tanar ' ri . They were found serving as generals under demon lord s or even as minor princelings . Description . Balors were about 12 feet tall and weighed 4 , 500 pounds . Their skin was usually dark red and wrapped in flame . Personality . Balors were one of the most terrible creatures of the Abyss . They constantly strove for more power for themselves and chaos , terror , and misery for others . Combat . Balors preferred to battle from afar , using spells and abilities and ranged weapons . They usually carried a fiery whip and a vorpal ( or lightning ) sword . Balors were able to summon hordes of dretch es or a single more powerful tanar ' ri . When a balor was killed , it exploded , severely harming anyone close to it and destroying any weapons the balor was holding .

title: Balor ( individual )
description: Balor ( individual ) Balor was the greatest of the balor tanar ' ri demon s and the reason that his race was known as balors . History . Balor served all of the demon lord s at one point or another in his life .
description_long: Balor ( individual ) Balor was the greatest of the balor tanar ' ri demon s and the reason that his race was known as balors . History . Balor served all of the demon lord s at one point or another in his life . He was favored by Baphomet and Kostchtchie . In 1485 DR , Balor was accosted by the goddess Lolth , who was then allied with Balor ' s greatest rival , the balor Errtu . Lolth destroyed his minions , poisoned him , and entrapped him in a web cocoon . She did this as part of her agreement with Errtu to get rid of demon lords in the Abyss in return for his aid in her plan to weaken the barriers between the Abyss and the Prime Material Plane . Possessions . Balor carried a flaming whip .

title: Balrik Daershun
description: Balrik Daershun Balrik Daershun was a male bandit in the Dalelands . History . Balrik fought for Lashan Aumersair in his war of conquest of the Dalelands .
description_long: Balrik Daershun Balrik Daershun was a male bandit in the Dalelands . History . Balrik fought for Lashan Aumersair in his war of conquest of the Dalelands . After the defeat of Lashan , Balrik with three other companions turned to banditry . However , in early 1358 DR , the Knights of Myth Drannor ' s Sharantyr defeated them in a brief skirmish , impressing the arriving Elminster Aumar . Appendix . References . \

title: Baltak
description: Baltak Baltak was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Activities . Baltak was a talented transmogrifist , always busy isculpting his body in an effort to attain the perfect form .
description_long: Baltak Baltak was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Activities . Baltak was a talented transmogrifist , always busy isculpting his body in an effort to attain the perfect form . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn invited him to his new College of Ancient Arcana and he accepted . They were busy experimenting with the " kiira " found by Eldrinn Elpragh in order to find some ancient spellbooks .
