description: Barthus Barthus was a vampire priest of Bane that somewhere after the Spellplague established himself in the catacombs under the ruins of Spellgard . Using his divine powers , he cowed several undead already there into his service and created more from captured victims . Appearance .
description_long: Barthus Barthus was a vampire priest of Bane that somewhere after the Spellplague established himself in the catacombs under the ruins of Spellgard . Using his divine powers , he cowed several undead already there into his service and created more from captured victims . Appearance . He had a long white beard and cold black eyes . He wore a suit of blackened leather armor , carried a holy symbol of Bane hanging from his neck , and he always had in his hand his lifedrinker mace .

title: Barundar mac Idrin
description: Barundar mac Idrin Barundar mac Idrin was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord of Earthfast in the 8th century DR . History . Barundar was the son of Idrin .
description_long: Barundar mac Idrin Barundar mac Idrin was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord of Earthfast in the 8th century DR . History . Barundar was the son of Idrin . He became the ruler of Earthfast , holding the position of ironlord by the Year of the Splendid Stag , 734 DR . Barundar had come into possession of " Sarghathuld " , a legendary sword of the fallen dwarven realm of Roldilar . This he presented as a coronation gift to King Halanter I of Impiltur . King Halanter became the first Impilturan ruler to make a pact with the dwarves of Earthfast , and was known to them as " Arausamman " , or " Great Friend " . Activities . As ironlord , Barundar ruled as a king over Earthfast .

title: Barunga Foestone
description: Barunga Foestone Barunga Foestone was a frost giant in the late 15th century DR . History . Barunga was part of the frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .
description_long: Barunga Foestone Barunga Foestone was a frost giant in the late 15th century DR . History . Barunga was part of the frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening . She even took a drow husband . In 1485 DR , during the War of the Silver Marches , Barunga was part of a troop that was attacked by Luruar forces on the counterattack . In the fighting , her drow husband was killed by an arrow .

title: Barze
description: Barze Barze was an ancient , now - fallen kingdom neighboring what is now Vaasa . It was located between what would eventually be known as the West Galena Mountains and the Vercy Wood . History .
description_long: Barze Barze was an ancient , now - fallen kingdom neighboring what is now Vaasa . It was located between what would eventually be known as the West Galena Mountains and the Vercy Wood . History . Barze was founded by the Netherese arcanist Barze in - 456 DR . The previous year ( - 457 DR , the Year of the Sycophant ) , he had traveled with his followers from Netheril , fleeing persecution . He named his new nation after himself . The Kingdom of Barze lasted from - 456 DR to - 357 DR . It fell after the " sorcerer - king " Barze was assassinated by " one hailed as a hero . " This " hero " seems to have been one of the Dark Three who helped defeat Maram of the Great Spear , Bhaal . Shortly after Barze ' s death , the kingdom was conquered by the Twisted Ones and their ruler , the general Tyranthraxus . Tyranthraxus ruled cruelly , laying waste to the land and slaying the remaining princes of Barze and the lands of Horreb and the Vane to the south , until he was imprisoned in a vial of shining water and sunk beneath Lake Longreach .

title: Basad el Ostak
description: Basad el Ostak Basad yn Malik el Ostak was the leader of el Kahmir clan in Memnon in 1370 DR , chosen by that family to oversee the assassins ' , thieves ' , smugglers ' , and slavers ' guilds there . He was young at the time and loyal to the syl - pasha . Relationships .
description_long: Basad el Ostak Basad yn Malik el Ostak was the leader of el Kahmir clan in Memnon in 1370 DR , chosen by that family to oversee the assassins ' , thieves ' , smugglers ' , and slavers ' guilds there . He was young at the time and loyal to the syl - pasha . Relationships . Basad was a lifelong friend of the " Pasha of Assassins " , Rahim el Ornadas , who headed the assassins ' guild , and he was the older brother to Ottad el Ostak , who ran the thieves guild .

title: Basadoni
description: Basadoni Pasha Basadoni was the leader of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport and so one of the masters of Calimport ' s underworld . Basadoni tutored the young Artemis Entreri , who worked for Basadoni in his early years before entering the service of Pasha Pook . When Enteri returned to Calimport in 1364 DR , Pasha Basadoni invited him to join again , but Entreri refused .
description_long: Basadoni Pasha Basadoni was the leader of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport and so one of the masters of Calimport ' s underworld . Basadoni tutored the young Artemis Entreri , who worked for Basadoni in his early years before entering the service of Pasha Pook . When Enteri returned to Calimport in 1364 DR , Pasha Basadoni invited him to join again , but Entreri refused . Soon after , some high members of House Basadoni tried to kill Entreri to maintain the House ' s prestige , but Entreri killed them all — at the price of involving Jarlaxle and Bregan D ' aerthe . At last Entreri and the drow assaulted the Basadoni ' s palace and confronted the pasha . Basadoni acknowledged the power of the drow and offered instead an alliance with them with himself as figurehead leader and Jarlaxle commanding from shadows ; Entreri seemingly accepted the pact but killed Basadoni in cold blood , claiming the leadership of House Basadoni for himself .

title: Basel Indoulur
description: Basel Indoulur Basel Indoulur was the governor of Halagard in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Basel was an accomplished Conjurer .
description_long: Basel Indoulur Basel Indoulur was the governor of Halagard in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Basel was an accomplished Conjurer . He was also a leading Elder and member of the Council of Elders . One of the most interesting things about Basel was the fact that he enjoyed having apprentices , which was a true rarity among Halruaan wizards .

title: Basem bin Rumi
description: Basem bin Rumi Basem bin Rumi was a gnome alchemist and researcher living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Basem was a friendly fellow who was easily distracted by fantasies .
description_long: Basem bin Rumi Basem bin Rumi was a gnome alchemist and researcher living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Basem was a friendly fellow who was easily distracted by fantasies . His sense of humor made adventuring with Basem a pleasure . He was also incredibly resourceful under stress . Description . Fashion was important to Basem . He always dressed himself in fine silks and a gold - colored " fez " . Activities . Driven by what some considered a foolish pursuit , Basem spent much of his fortune attempting to discover a way to turn metals such as lead or copper into gold . His home was littered with large mechanical water clocks while he tried to discover new methods of making them more efficient . Basem resorted to adventuring any time his funds ran low . He also sold magical potions to other adventurers . History . Basem settled in Huzuz after a successful career spent adventuring on the Crowded Sea as captain of a " sambuk " . Possessions . Basem owned a pair of " bracers of defense AC 5 " , a " ring of water walking " , a " wand of fear " , a " bag of holding " and a multitude of magical potions .

title: Bashal ' s Tendrilight
description: Bashal ' s Tendrilight Bashal ' s Tendrilight was a magical lantern that could emit a dark tendril , which could attack an opponent . Description . The lantern was rectangular with a half - foot - by - half - foot base .
description_long: Bashal ' s Tendrilight Bashal ' s Tendrilight was a magical lantern that could emit a dark tendril , which could attack an opponent . Description . The lantern was rectangular with a half - foot - by - half - foot base . It had two standard lantern shutters , one each on opposite sides . On a third side , it contained a vertical column of five knobs . One side of the lantern was lit , and its corresponding shutter functioned normally . The other side , however , contained a black , quivering membrane that was warm to the touch and rubbery . A metal plate divided the two sides of the lantern internally , but each of the five knobs could open a vent on the metal plate that would allow light from the one side to pass into the other side . Abilities . If the shutter on the side of the lantern with the dark membrane was opened and the lantern was lit , turning one of the knobs would allow the light to cross the metal barrier and animate the black membrane , which would become a tendril , stretching out of the open lantern . Turning more of the knobs would lengthen the tendril . The tendril would attack opponents by lashing out like a whip .

title: Bashenee
description: Bashenee Bashenee was a githzerai craftsman . In a past age , in a realm beyond the Astral Plane , Bashenee created an " incandescent blue ioun stone " for a great githzerai monk , who later fell in battle with githyanki . The githyanki took the stone for their own .
description_long: Bashenee Bashenee was a githzerai craftsman . In a past age , in a realm beyond the Astral Plane , Bashenee created an " incandescent blue ioun stone " for a great githzerai monk , who later fell in battle with githyanki . The githyanki took the stone for their own .

title: Basidia
description: Basidia Basidia was the new myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Two years before , Basidia undertook a migration of its colony through the Underdark until they arrived in the Neverlight Grove , where fellow sovereign Phylo welcomed it , happy to have someone to share the burdens of leadership with .
description_long: Basidia Basidia was the new myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Two years before , Basidia undertook a migration of its colony through the Underdark until they arrived in the Neverlight Grove , where fellow sovereign Phylo welcomed it , happy to have someone to share the burdens of leadership with . During the Rage of Demons , the demon lord Zuggtmoy arrived in the Grove and she understood that the best strategy was to first corrupt Phylo and so gain control of the whole myconid community . Phylo was easily corrupted and so began a subtle ideological war during everyday melding to convert all the circle leaders to Zuggtmoy . Step by step , most of the myconids succumbed to madness , and only Basidia and its followers resisted . Basidia asked for the help of a party of adventurers ( who had escaped from drow slavers of Velkynvelve ) to investigate Phylo . Thank to the adventurers , Basidia , Rasharoo , Loobamub , and their followers abandoned the Grove before it was too late .

title: Basil
description: Basil Basil of Lyndusfarne was an unusual verbeeg in the service of the Kingdom of Hartsvale in the 1370s DR . He was a runecaster , a rarity among his people . He met and befriended Tavis Burdun , just moments before the princess Brianna was kidnapped .
description_long: Basil Basil of Lyndusfarne was an unusual verbeeg in the service of the Kingdom of Hartsvale in the 1370s DR . He was a runecaster , a rarity among his people . He met and befriended Tavis Burdun , just moments before the princess Brianna was kidnapped . He and the orphan Avner were the only people to accompany Tavis in the rescue mission . In time , he became a good friend of both Tavis and Brianna . Unfortunately during the final battle against the Twilight Spirit , Basil ' s body was permanently deformed .

title: Basil Arness
description: Basil Arness Basil Arness was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Basil was a member of the Champions of Muktar .
description_long: Basil Arness Basil Arness was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Basil was a member of the Champions of Muktar . He liked befriended his victims before kill them . He was also Deputy Brigade Commander of the the Maneuver Brigade of the Muktar ' s army . History . In 1358 DR Basil and his fellow Champions arranged the trap inside Fort Blood planned by the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , to eliminate an adventuring party well - known in Golconda . Later he took part in the Battle of Wilma Pass . Personality . Basil enjoyed killed supposed " friends " , believing this made the killing more poignant .

title: Basil Willowbrook
description: Basil Willowbrook Basil Willowbrook was a halfling innkeeper in Skullport . History . Once an adventurer in the Shining South , Basil settled in the Lower Heart district of Skullport , where he opened the Bindle ' s Blade inn .
description_long: Basil Willowbrook Basil Willowbrook was a halfling innkeeper in Skullport . History . Once an adventurer in the Shining South , Basil settled in the Lower Heart district of Skullport , where he opened the Bindle ' s Blade inn . Around 1370 DR , his inn was one of the best - priced quality establishments in the city .

title: Basilisk
description: Basilisk Basilisks were large , eight - legged reptile s with the terrifying ability to poison or petrify their prey . Though not malicious , basilisks were indisputably dangerous . They could be found all over Faerûn .
description_long: Basilisk Basilisks were large , eight - legged reptile s with the terrifying ability to poison or petrify their prey . Though not malicious , basilisks were indisputably dangerous . They could be found all over Faerûn . Basilisks could be found nearly everywhere , including subterranean biomes . Typically , basilisks sheltered within burrows , caves , or other similar areas . These dens were sometimes distinguished by what appeared to be statues , although these were , in fact , creatures that had been petrified by the gaze of the creature . The Bedine called basilisks " hagar motab " or " bringers of stone - death " , and it is from a Bedine explorer where most of the facts about basilisks came from . Physical description . Basilisks had eight legs , which they crawled upon . Basilisks came in a variety of colors from dark gray to dark orange , although they also commonly had a dull brown body with a yellowish underbelly . Basilisks possessed a single row of bony spines that lined their backs and a few had a curved horn atop their noses . Basilisk eyes were , however , the most notable feature , glowing with a pale green light . Adult basilisks could grow to be about 6 feet ( 1 .

title: Basket trick
description: Basket trick Basket trick was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable only by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Basket trick Basket trick was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable only by wizard s . Effects . " Basket trick " was similar to the " blink " spell . When cast , it allowed the caster to move about randomly to avoid injury . After casting , the caster randomly teleport ed to nearby baskets . The caster would continue to teleport for several minutes or until she or he deemed it safe to venture forth from the basket . Material filling a basket to which the caster teleported was instantly transported to the original basket . Components . The material component needed to cast this spell was a large basket or urn into which the caster climbed before casting the spell .

title: Baskor Tranth
description: Baskor Tranth Baskor Tranth was a surly wizard who dwelt in Suzail , frequenting its bars and taverns . Activities . He was haunted by the horrific memories he had of escaping the fall of Myth Drannor alone .
description_long: Baskor Tranth Baskor Tranth was a surly wizard who dwelt in Suzail , frequenting its bars and taverns . Activities . He was haunted by the horrific memories he had of escaping the fall of Myth Drannor alone . All of his friends and companions from the Brightstar Adventuring Company from Priapurl were slaughtered in the cataclysm . Although fascinated by tales of adventure , Baskor was horrified at the notion of ever going out and doing so again . This fear caused him to gather all the combat - oriented spells he could get his hands on ; a task that garnered the notice of the War Wizards . He even went so far as to get visiting mages drunk so that he could copy their spellbooks when they didn ' t notice . Despite these less - than - ethical tendencies , he made a habit of aiding young and novice adventurers if the price was right .

title: Bassana
description: Bassana Bassana was a spy of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Bassana was one of the agents of Boubakar of Golconda .
description_long: Bassana Bassana was a spy of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Bassana was one of the agents of Boubakar of Golconda . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar started a war against Golconda . In 1358 Bassana went to spy inside Muktar but was captured by the king of Muktar ( in truth the arcanaloth Yrkhetep ) that using hypnosis power manipulated Bassana in believed that he had discovered that the battle plans of Hetep were hid in the small keep of Fort Blood . Bassana reported the news to his master Boubakar . Still in Yrkhetep ' s power he eventually helped the adventuring party well - known to king Samakay hired to resolve the matter ( and true objective of Yrkhetep ) to escape from Count Belim .

title: Bassorah
description: Bassorah Bassorah was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Bassorah was a shrew of a woman .
description_long: Bassorah Bassorah was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Bassorah was a shrew of a woman . Activities . Driven by a desire to be accepted by the elite society of Huzuz , Bassorah spent all of her husband ' s hard - earned money hosting lavish parties that they could not afford . Her actions drove he husband to abandon her one night after such a party . Relationships . Bassorah was married to a physician named Mustapha , though she had not seen him in years since he abandoned her with their debts .

title: Bastabar Yulgont
description: Bastabar Yulgont Bastabar Yulgont was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Bastabar was on the high side of middle age and his once - toned body had become rotund and flabby .
description_long: Bastabar Yulgont Bastabar Yulgont was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Bastabar was on the high side of middle age and his once - toned body had become rotund and flabby . His hands and face were weather - worn and bore the scars of many battles from his former life as a warrior . His voice was low and husky , giving his speech a gravelly menace . Personality . He was a man of few words but he made those words count , delivering them straightforwardly and with emphasis appropriate to the situation . He was bitter about growing old and seeing younger priests rise in the ranks of the church of Cyric more rapidly , passing him by . He fantasized about getting rid of his Dark Patriarch Gormstadd and his fellow Dark Hand Meirgin Windtalon , perhaps by using passing adventurers or other outsiders to eliminate one or both . Then , he would rally the Fingers of Cyric ( the temple guards ) and avenge them in glorious battle and be promoted into Gormstadd ' s place or even higher .

title: Bastard sword
description: Bastard sword A bastard sword , also called a hand - and - a - half sword , is a weapon that is in between a longsword and a greatsword . Description . A bastard sword can be used in either one or two hands , thus giving it its name .
description_long: Bastard sword A bastard sword , also called a hand - and - a - half sword , is a weapon that is in between a longsword and a greatsword . Description . A bastard sword can be used in either one or two hands , thus giving it its name . It has a longer grip than a one - handed sword and has a shorter blade than a greatsword for extra precision in the strike . It is also more powerful than a longsword due to its increased weight . An average bastard sword costs 35gp and weighs 6lbs ( 2 . 7kg ) . Use . Bastard swords are martial weapons normally used two - handed . They require extra training to use effectively with one hand . Therefore they are classified as exotic weapons in 3rd edition and 3 . 5 edition D & D when used one - handed . Historical Comparison . Historically , the " bastard sword " was merely a form of Western European sword sized between the single - handed knightly or arming sword , and the larger two - handed longswords . The only functional difference is that the bastard sword could be readily wielded either one or two - handed ( whereas the arming sword was designed for single - handed use and the longsword was most effectively used two - handed ) .

title: Bastian Thermandar
description: Bastian Thermandar Bastian Thermandar was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bastian was a very paranoid individual , not trusting anyone .
description_long: Bastian Thermandar Bastian Thermandar was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bastian was a very paranoid individual , not trusting anyone . He was also greatly ambitious , scheming to gain for himself Tinderstrike and supplant Vanifer . History . Bastian learned much of his elemental magic from Vanifer herself . In 1491 DR , Bastian was responsible for guarding the northern half of the temple .

title: Bastion of good
description: Bastion of good Bastion of good is an abjuration spell that conjures a mighty barrier against evil attacks . Effect . A nimbus of light surrounds you , protecting you and those around you from spell effects and the attacks of evil creatures .
description_long: Bastion of good Bastion of good is an abjuration spell that conjures a mighty barrier against evil attacks . Effect . A nimbus of light surrounds you , protecting you and those around you from spell effects and the attacks of evil creatures . The aura excludes all spell effects of up to , exactly as a " minor globe of invulnerability does . In addition , the nimbus protects creatures within it as a " magic circle against evil " at double strength . Warded creatures gain a deflection bonus and a + 4 resistance bonus on saves against attacks from evil creatures , and they are protected from possession , mental control , and bodily contact by summoned or conjured creatures . Abstinence Component . You must fast for 24 hours before casting this spell .

title: Bastun
description: Bastun Bastun was a Vremyonni wizard of Rashemen . Appearance . Bastun wore a dark mask of wood inlaid with silver whorls and tiny designs resembling thorny vines that covered his face from forehead to jawline .
description_long: Bastun Bastun was a Vremyonni wizard of Rashemen . Appearance . Bastun wore a dark mask of wood inlaid with silver whorls and tiny designs resembling thorny vines that covered his face from forehead to jawline . He wore robes . Equipment . Bastun ' s mask was enchanted to enhance his hearing . He carried a magical staff with leather wrappings on its grip and a steel sphere at its tip . The tip could , with a command word , transform into a long , curving axe head . Family . Ulsera was Bastun ' s sister . History . Bastun was taught and inducted into the brotherhood of the vremyonni by Keffrass shortly after being suspected of tempting his sister to enter the Urlingwood , which was a capital offense in Rashemen . Bastun studied under Keffrass , who awakened a love of knowledge in him . He was later suspected in the murder of Keffrass and was given the choice of exile or death ; he chose exile and , in doing so , found out who was responsible for his master ' s death .

title: Basult ' s Books
description: Basult ' s Books Basult ' s Books was a bookshop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , on the western end of the city . " Circa " 1374 DR , it was the only bookseller in town , and was run by Amnic and Mela Basult . History .
description_long: Basult ' s Books Basult ' s Books was a bookshop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , on the western end of the city . " Circa " 1374 DR , it was the only bookseller in town , and was run by Amnic and Mela Basult . History . Early in the month of Eleint in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Amnic went missing ; he was last seen in his shop , where signs of a scuffle could be found . Although distraught , Mela tried to manage the bookshop in Amnic ' s absence . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , adventurers discovered that the new Temple of Mystra in town was actually a front for priests of Shar and Cyric to kidnap magic - users and spirit them away to the Vast Swamp for some nefarious purpose . Investigators found Amnic ' s body in a torture chamber beneath the false temple . Mela was informed of her husband ' s fate .

title: Bat
description: Bat Bats were a group of wild , flying mammal s of generally small size that fed on other small mammals , insect s , reptile s , or fruit . Although the majority of bats were small , a few larger varieties existed . Bats were almost all nocturnal .
description_long: Bat Bats were a group of wild , flying mammal s of generally small size that fed on other small mammals , insect s , reptile s , or fruit . Although the majority of bats were small , a few larger varieties existed . Bats were almost all nocturnal . Description . Most bats were roughly the size of a small bird although larger bats existed . All bats were adept at perceiving their surroundings in the dark though the precise mechanics differed by species , with most bats using a form of blindsight , shadowhunter bat s using darkvision , and fire bat s projecting light around them . Species . There were many varieties of unusual bat species , some of which are listed below :

title: Bat ' s Roost
description: Bat ' s Roost The Bat ' s Roost was a tavern in the Central Port of Skullport . Geography . The tavern was located in the northwest corner of the Central Port near the Pierced Navel and Gentleman ' s Groggery .
description_long: Bat ' s Roost The Bat ' s Roost was a tavern in the Central Port of Skullport . Geography . The tavern was located in the northwest corner of the Central Port near the Pierced Navel and Gentleman ' s Groggery . Description . The tavern was fair condition with damp wood and aged stone walls . The place was said to have smelled strongly of bat excrement . A wired obstacle - course arena was positioned near the main taproom , which was used to host bat fighting contests . Services . The Roost was well known as a place for trained bat fights . Based on size and power , patrons would bet on which bat was knocked to the ground or drew the first blood . History . Around 1366 DR , Schiropts won the Bat ' s Roost tavern after his bat familiar won a fighting tournament .

title: Bathaerel
description: Bathaerel Bathaerel was a purplish powder made from rocks found in the Abyssal layers of Rauwend and Voorz ' zt . When mixed with water , potato es and green plants and placed in a bag with rusty metal items , it will remove the rust from the iron .
description_long: Bathaerel Bathaerel was a purplish powder made from rocks found in the Abyssal layers of Rauwend and Voorz ' zt . When mixed with water , potato es and green plants and placed in a bag with rusty metal items , it will remove the rust from the iron .

title: Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods
description: Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods The Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods were located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Bathhouses of Jisan were located south of the Caravan District .
description_long: Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods The Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods were located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Bathhouses of Jisan were located south of the Caravan District . Structure . The separate structures for men and women were interconnected , but occupants were expected to remain on their appropriate side . Interior . Individual baths , and a large pool could be found within each bathhouse . Inhabitants . Priests of Jisan owned and administered the bathhouses , ensuring that the water was always clean and fresh . A pair of efreet were used to make steam in the steam rooms . Rumors and Legends . The priests secretly spied on the occupants of the bathhouses in order to collect information .

title: Batihat al - Saji
description: Batihat al - Saji Batihat al - Saji , also known as the Lagoon of the Brave , was a bay on Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The blue waters of this lagoon were calm , concealing the terror that lay on the bottom .
description_long: Batihat al - Saji Batihat al - Saji , also known as the Lagoon of the Brave , was a bay on Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The blue waters of this lagoon were calm , concealing the terror that lay on the bottom . The husks of sunken ships could be seen when the waters were calm . Inhabitants . The water of the lagoon teemed with a variety of fish , crab , coral , and other sea life . Rumors and Legends . A huge shimmering pearl lay at the bottom of the lagoon , serving as a portal to Pandemonium for Kar ' r ' rga . The god would occasionally enter the lagoon and come to the surface to claim his offerings or destroy those who did not pay him proper obeisance .

title: Batina al - Shaat
description: Batina al - Shaat Batina al - Shaat was a moralist priest of Hajama and the leader of the Preachers in 1367 DR . Personality . Batina was a rogue compared to other moralist priests in Zakhara .
description_long: Batina al - Shaat Batina al - Shaat was a moralist priest of Hajama and the leader of the Preachers in 1367 DR . Personality . Batina was a rogue compared to other moralist priests in Zakhara . Moralists typically did not support the use of holy slayer s to strike down enemies of their god . Batina held no such qualms . She smiled often when dealing with her followers , but her smile was not pleasant . Activities . Batina guided assassins to strike down anyone she felt was an enemy , including other members of the Everlasting . She advised the Shadow Caliph on all matters regarding the faith , yet she did not have any designs on leading the Everlasting . She viewed her current position as having just as much power without the constant risk that the Shadow Caliph faced . History . Batina was enemies with Emir Hatit Abd al - Wajib , who once spurned her for a position of power in Qudra . She never forgave him for the sleight . Possessions . Batina owned a magical short sword , a bag containing " powder of the hero ' s heart " , and a " shield of the holy " .

title: Batiri
description: Batiri The Batiri were a collection of clans and tribes of goblin s in Chult known and feared for their tracking skills . Description . Most Batiri had green skin , which blended well with the jungle surroundings .
description_long: Batiri The Batiri were a collection of clans and tribes of goblin s in Chult known and feared for their tracking skills . Description . Most Batiri had green skin , which blended well with the jungle surroundings . In all other ways , they appeared as typical goblins . Batiri typically wore little more than rags for clothing . High - ranking warriors might be found wearing poorly prepared dinosaur - hide breastplates or helmets . Personality . Batiri were feared by the other races of Chult and were considered " bloodthirsty " creatures . They were especially talented at the skill of tracking through the jungle and were experts in the lore of the jungle . Combat . The Batiri usually hunted at night , taking advantage of their natural darkvision . They preferred to use crude short bow s and spear s , but they were very adept at such weapons . A skilled warrior or general might be so fortunate to possess a stolen metal weapon from one of the neighboring human tribes or fallen adventurers . The Batiri would consume the victims of their raids or battles , provided they were not themselves Batiri . Society . A Batiri clan usually consisted of between 25 and 200 individuals .

title: Batrachi
description: Batrachi Batrachi were an amphibious race that are counted as one of the Creator Races . Geographical Region . It was discovered by illithids in 1370 DR that the batrachi ruled at least as far north as the Black Sea and as far south as Lopango .
description_long: Batrachi Batrachi were an amphibious race that are counted as one of the Creator Races . Geographical Region . It was discovered by illithids in 1370 DR that the batrachi ruled at least as far north as the Black Sea and as far south as Lopango . The Sea of Fallen Stars was created from four separate bodies of water when a moon - part dropped on the batrachi realm of Kolophoon . Deity . The batrachi who live in the Supreme Throne worship a deity called Ramenos , who changed into something by the frog - god . Being changed by the frog - god didn ' t happen only once . Organisations . The Order of the Black Flame that is associated with the Firebringer . an entity that claimed to be a batrachi lord who was changed by Ramenos into something and lived by 1370 DR . The Batrachi Empires . Kolophoon , Boitumelo , Nadezhda , Zhoukoudien and Pourounkorokale were the Batrachi Empires . Pourounkorokale was located underneath the Shining Sea . The tako ruled over tribes of kuo - toa , locathah , and other species of aquatic batrachi . Pourounkorokale fell after the fall of the other Batrachi empires due to dragon attacks and the betrayal by their sahuagin allies .

title: Battering Wave
description: Battering Wave The Battering Wave was a temple of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , the temple was led by Thogonia Grim , who was still in charge by 1370 DR . She was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs .
description_long: Battering Wave The Battering Wave was a temple of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , the temple was led by Thogonia Grim , who was still in charge by 1370 DR . She was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs .

title: Battle at the Bar
description: Battle at the Bar The Battle at the Bar was a fight that broke out in the common room of the Whistling Wizard inn sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . It involved two independent and uncoordinated Harper groups , members of a slavery and smuggling ring known as the Tarntar , an illithid , an ogre mage , at least two doppelganger s , various bodyguards , and eventually the local law enforcers . Location .
description_long: Battle at the Bar The Battle at the Bar was a fight that broke out in the common room of the Whistling Wizard inn sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . It involved two independent and uncoordinated Harper groups , members of a slavery and smuggling ring known as the Tarntar , an illithid , an ogre mage , at least two doppelganger s , various bodyguards , and eventually the local law enforcers . Location . The Whistling Wizard inn was located on the outskirts of Voonlar where the North Ride emerged from the forest when traveling north from Shadowdale . History . Early in the winter of the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , the owner of the Whistling Wizard , Ansilber Klauthaudra , was found hacked to pieces in the common room of his establishment . Within a tenday , the inn was then purchased by Ravvas Thurrpurtyn of Selgaunt who , Harper agents avowed , was killed and impersonated by an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay . Other reports deem it likely that the unnamed Red Wizard agent was soon assassinated and replaced by a malaugrym that played both roles , innkeeper and agent , for purposes unknown .

title: Battle captain
description: Battle captain Battle captains are frontline commanders and officers , warlord s who feel most confident leading their troops into battle personally . A battle captain is good for morale in a company of warrior s , obtaining a hard - earned devotion through their own accomplishments rather than merely titles or tactical brilliance . Few can inspire devotion in those following them as can a well - trained and courageous battle captain .
description_long: Battle captain Battle captains are frontline commanders and officers , warlord s who feel most confident leading their troops into battle personally . A battle captain is good for morale in a company of warrior s , obtaining a hard - earned devotion through their own accomplishments rather than merely titles or tactical brilliance . Few can inspire devotion in those following them as can a well - trained and courageous battle captain . Abilities . Battle captain training resolves almost entirely around learning how to effectively direct troops from the front line of a battlefield . Unlike some warlords , battle captains do this more through example and inspiration than through careful planning , though strategy is an important element as well . However , the battle captain ’ s approach to tactics is more instinctual and inexperienced battle captains learn to issue orders or give a helpful shout of encouragement at a moment ’ s notice to give their allies an edge in an instant . So effective is this leadership technique that even battle captains still early in their training can inspire confidence considerably well in their allies .

title: Battle mage
description: Battle mage Battle mages are wizard s trained in the heat of combat , developing their abilities for the purpose of offensive use . Battle mages are dangerous to behold , deadly and capable of long - term combat survival . Battle mages can be as useful as a fighter in a melee or as deadly as a ranger from afar , depending on the wizard ’ s individual preference .
description_long: Battle mage Battle mages are wizard s trained in the heat of combat , developing their abilities for the purpose of offensive use . Battle mages are dangerous to behold , deadly and capable of long - term combat survival . Battle mages can be as useful as a fighter in a melee or as deadly as a ranger from afar , depending on the wizard ’ s individual preference . Abilities . In order to make themselves all the more lethal in combat , battle mages are trained to unleash arcane magic in an instant if necessary and with considerable ease . From the beginning of their training , battle mages are capable of striking a hindered foe with a blast of arcane power straight from their own body , which manifests as either fire , cold , or electricity . Battle mages also learn to focus their attacks in order to make them substantially more accurate . More experienced battle mages are also capable of unleashing any of their most basic spell s reflexively when badly injured . Battle mage spells universally enhance the abilities of a wizard in battle .

title: Battle of Bloody Reeds
description: Battle of Bloody Reeds The Battle of Bloody Reeds was a battle fought in Impiltur against an orc horde from Vastar in the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR . Events . Lead up .
description_long: Battle of Bloody Reeds The Battle of Bloody Reeds was a battle fought in Impiltur against an orc horde from Vastar in the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR . Events . Lead up . In the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR , the orc nation of Vastar was on the rampage again , with orc hordes from here and other strongholds emerging and threatening Cormanthyr and many other lands with war . The orc chieftain Ulbror marched his horde through many small passes of the Earthspur Mountains and invaded the uplands of Impiltur instead . King Sharaun Mirandor and his three sons led a small army north to meet them and were defeated and slain in battle , killing off the Mirandor dynasty . The battle . Duke Harandil Durlaven — Sharaun ' s son - in - law — mustered another army and went after the orcs . The horde was routed at the Battle of Bloody Reeds . Aftermath . Harandil was declared king of Impiltur by the acclamation of his followers , and crowned on the battlefield itself . This founded the Durlaven dynasty .

title: Battle of Bones
description: Battle of Bones The Battle of Bones was the name given to an old battlefield in the Western Heartlands . History . The Battle was named after a huge battle between human s and various goblinoid races in the year 1090 DR .
description_long: Battle of Bones The Battle of Bones was the name given to an old battlefield in the Western Heartlands . History . The Battle was named after a huge battle between human s and various goblinoid races in the year 1090 DR . The goblinoid nations , along with hobgoblin and orc allies , came out of the dwindling Goblin Marches to overrun the north . A combined force of humans , elves and the last of several dwarven kingdoms met the invasion head on at this site . So many died in that week - long battle it was said that their bones covered the ground to a depth of twelve inches . Since then , only the undead walked in the Battle with no master of their own . The nightwalker s were by far the dominant race , ruling over skeleton s and zombie s . This all changed when the Vampire King Mordoc SeLanmere came to the Battle . Mordoc then took full control of the Battle and built the Keep of Pale Night in it . The nightwalkers , zombies , and skeleton warriors were then inaugurated into his vampire army under the rule of his servant , Xanhast . Upon Mordoc ' s destruction in Baldur ' s Gate , the vampire army scattered throughout the Battle . Inhabitants .

title: Battle of Bryn Shander
description: Battle of Bryn Shander Took place in 1351 The Year of the Crown . The barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale often raided the villages of the Ten Towns , but as autumn of 1351 DR came and the herds moved south , the tribes chose to make one massive thrust in an attempt to occupy the communities and live off slave labor . A traitor from one of the communities revealed his plan of attack .
description_long: Battle of Bryn Shander Took place in 1351 The Year of the Crown . The barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale often raided the villages of the Ten Towns , but as autumn of 1351 DR came and the herds moved south , the tribes chose to make one massive thrust in an attempt to occupy the communities and live off slave labor . A traitor from one of the communities revealed his plan of attack . Unbeknownst , Drizzt watched the traitor and promptly informed Bruenor and , through Regis ( a halfing rogue who had taken residence in the own ) , the Council of the Ten Towns . The halfling convinced his fellow councilmen to form an alliance and the Ten Towns stood ready . The bulk of the barbarian force moved south to Bryn Shander . Once the city was occupied , the barbarians could strike at leisure at the other communities . Aware of the plan , men of Maer Dualdon hid in Termalaine . When the tribe entered , it was overwhelmed . A threefold trap lay in wait at Bryn Shander for the main host . Inside the city walls stood the combined forces of Bryn Shander , Caer - Konig , and Caer - Dineval , armed with bows and hot oil .

title: Battle of Caer Moray
description: Battle of Caer Moray The Battle of Caer Moray was a brief assault on the lycanthrope - held castle at Caer Moray on the Isle of Moray in the Moonshae Isles . Lycanthropes loyal to the god Malar attacked the settlement at night . They attempted to use rough - cut logs as ladders to scale the castle walls but were initially repelled .
description_long: Battle of Caer Moray The Battle of Caer Moray was a brief assault on the lycanthrope - held castle at Caer Moray on the Isle of Moray in the Moonshae Isles . Lycanthropes loyal to the god Malar attacked the settlement at night . They attempted to use rough - cut logs as ladders to scale the castle walls but were initially repelled . They attacked again with renewed vigor and succeeded in gaining the walls and took part of the castle courtyard . At this time an incarnation of the goddess Chauntea intervened and caused an earthquake and subsequent tsunami that swept the attackers out to sea . Part of the castle ' s wall was destroyed by the tsunami and the defenders suffered a large number of casualties in the attack .

title: Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger
description: Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger The Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger took place on Tarsakh 11 , 1374 DR , between the daemonfey and their minions , and the Argent Legion and the elves . It occurred in the valley known as Daelyth ' s Dagger . The battle was an easy victory for the Argent Legion thanks to their superior tactics .
description_long: Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger The Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger took place on Tarsakh 11 , 1374 DR , between the daemonfey and their minions , and the Argent Legion and the elves . It occurred in the valley known as Daelyth ' s Dagger . The battle was an easy victory for the Argent Legion thanks to their superior tactics . Participants . Daemonfey . The daemonfey consisted of hundreds of fey ' ri accompanied by demon s , including vrock s , hezrou s , and babau s , as well as orc berserkers . Argent Legion . The Argent Legion was under the command of Methrammar Aerasumé . It included the dwarven Iron Guards of Citadel Adbar and the human and half - elf Knights in Silver of Silverymoon . Hundreds of wood elf archers and spellarchers concealed themselves on the upper cliffs of the valley . The more notable participants were : Battle . The orcs began their charge into the valley by the narrow entrance , opposed by the Iron Guard . Just before the orc charge hit the dwarven lines , the demons teleported in behind the Iron Guard , but they had predicted this move and reacted accordingly .

title: Battle of Deepfires
description: Battle of Deepfires The Battle of Deepfires was a battle fought beneath Mount Grimmerfang between the shield dwarves of Roldilar and the orcs of the Vast in north Faerûn in the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR . It marked the fall of the kingdom of the Roldilar . Events .
description_long: Battle of Deepfires The Battle of Deepfires was a battle fought beneath Mount Grimmerfang between the shield dwarves of Roldilar and the orcs of the Vast in north Faerûn in the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR . It marked the fall of the kingdom of the Roldilar . Events . Prior to the battle , Deep King Tuir Stonebeard led the dwarven armies against those of the attacking orc s and goblin s , but they were defeated at Viperstongue Ford over the River Vesper . Roldilar ' s defenses were broken , and the dwarves retreated to Mount Grimmerfang , the capital of Roldilar and once the capital of the previous orcish kingdom of Vastar . This retreat ended in the Battle of Deepfires , fought in underground passages beneath the mountain . This bloody struggle lasted for almost twenty days . It ended in defeat for the dwarves and the fall of Roldilar in 649 DR . Legacy . The Battle of Deepfires was infamous in dwarven history . In later years , dwarves referenced it in laments and woeful sayings . One saying often used by sick , injured , or depressed dwarves , or by dwarves overwhelmed with problems and miseries , was " I feel as if my axe was broken in the midst of Deepfires . "

title: Battle of Demarch ' s Fall
description: Battle of Demarch ' s Fall The Battle of Demarch ' s Fall was a battle fought in the Halls of Demarch beneath the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn , between rival factions of Demarch ' s Alliance . Events . Demarch ' s Alliance was an alliance between beguiler s who served Leira and those who served Mask .
description_long: Battle of Demarch ' s Fall The Battle of Demarch ' s Fall was a battle fought in the Halls of Demarch beneath the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn , between rival factions of Demarch ' s Alliance . Events . Demarch ' s Alliance was an alliance between beguiler s who served Leira and those who served Mask . But after Mask betrayed Leira in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the alliance was broken and the two factions fought a massive battle in their former headquarters , the Halls of Demarch . The rival beguilers fought a number of bloody skirmishes through the tunnels of the subterranean complex , all concealed in mists . An enormous amount of magic was cast , resulting in the opening of a rift to the Plane of Shadow . Shadow s and various other monsters fell out of the rift , along with several magic items and the " book of Suelivain " . The Maskarran and Leiran beguilers slaughtered eachother . Aftermath . The survivors fled across Faerûn , living in fear of revenge attacks and church agents seeking to learn or maintain their secrets , most never coming back .

title: Battle of Fell Pass
description: Battle of Fell Pass The Battle of Fell Pass took place centuries ago in Fell Pass between Delzoun dwarves and orc s . As of 1370 DR their ghost s still occupy the pass . Battle .
description_long: Battle of Fell Pass The Battle of Fell Pass took place centuries ago in Fell Pass between Delzoun dwarves and orc s . As of 1370 DR their ghost s still occupy the pass . Battle . The battle was originally going the orcs ' way but the dwarves used the many tunnels and caverns of the Fell Pass to resupply and heal the wounded . The dwarves then lured the orcs into a trap by presenting a small group , and waiting for the orcs to charge , at which point the full force of dwarves came out of concealment behind trapdoors and attacked . The battle was won by the dwarves , although at great cost .

title: Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm
description: Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm The Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm was a battle between Indrila ' s human army and the half - elves that took place in what would become Aglarond in 1065 DR . The battle was won by Brindor ' s half - elves , and Brindor went on to become king of the newly created nation of Aglarond . Motivations .
description_long: Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm The Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm was a battle between Indrila ' s human army and the half - elves that took place in what would become Aglarond in 1065 DR . The battle was won by Brindor ' s half - elves , and Brindor went on to become king of the newly created nation of Aglarond . Motivations . The declining elves of the Yuirwood began interbreeding with the humans who came to explore the area , creating the half - elf population in the area . These half - elves took exception to the humans felling the wood in order to create settlements and inhabit the land . Although the half - elves appealed to the humans to stop this behaviour , the warnings were not heeded , and in 1065 DR , the half - elves attacked . Battle . The half - elves had descended upon the human population , killing any humans they encountered , and driving them back towards their own coastal cities . The humans in these coastal cities were more vengeful than those inland , and launched a counter - attack from Velprin . This was quashed by the half - elves , and the humans were completely eliminated at Ingdal ' s Arm . Aftermath .

title: Battle of Keeper ' s Dale
description: Battle of Keeper ' s Dale The Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , known as Yvonnel ' s Folly by the drow , was a short war fought by Clan Battlehammer and their allies against the drow of Menzoberranzan and their slave army of humanoids . Location . The environs of Mithral Hall .
description_long: Battle of Keeper ' s Dale The Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , known as Yvonnel ' s Folly by the drow , was a short war fought by Clan Battlehammer and their allies against the drow of Menzoberranzan and their slave army of humanoids . Location . The environs of Mithral Hall . History . Causes . Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre had wished to conquer the surface world in the name of Lolth for most of her considerable lifespan . Flush with power from her successful eradication of House Oblodra , Matron Baenre pressed ahead with a previously delayed plan to assault Mithral Hall , home of the dwarves of Clan Battlehammer . Possessing the trapped Gandalug Battlehammer , Matron Baenre had gained the knowledge of the city ' s defenses and was confident that victory would be hers . Recently returned from an excursion to Menzoberranzan , Drizzt Do ' Urden came back armed with the knowledge that the drow were coming to Mithral Hall , and so King Bruenor Battlehammer appealed to his allies for aid . Longsaddle , Settlestone and Silverymoon responded , pledging significant numbers of men for the coming war .

title: Battle of Lendon ' s Dike
description: Battle of Lendon ' s Dike In Ches of 1479 DR , Kardhel Terov of the Warlock Knights approached warchief Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe . He offered the warlord complete control over Thar and its various tribes in return for an oath of fealty . After sacking Glister with the promised troops and armaments , the army - now consisting of the orcs of the Bloody Skulls and Burning Daggers , the ogre s of the Skullsmashers , the hobgoblin s of the Red Claws , and a contingent of Warlock Knights and their controlled beasts - marched on Hulburg .
description_long: Battle of Lendon ' s Dike In Ches of 1479 DR , Kardhel Terov of the Warlock Knights approached warchief Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe . He offered the warlord complete control over Thar and its various tribes in return for an oath of fealty . After sacking Glister with the promised troops and armaments , the army - now consisting of the orcs of the Bloody Skulls and Burning Daggers , the ogre s of the Skullsmashers , the hobgoblin s of the Red Claws , and a contingent of Warlock Knights and their controlled beasts - marched on Hulburg . They were met northwest of the town by an army half their size , led by Kara Hulmaster , known to the orcs as the Blue Serpent and a fearsome warrior . Kara ' s army - which consisted of the town ' s Shieldsworn , mercenaries hired by Hulburg ' s merchant companies , and the professional mercenary company known as the Icehammers - was defeated , and the survivors retreated to Lendon ' s Dike , the last defensible position between them and the town . There , they were met by Geran Hulmaster and Hulburg ' s mostly - untrained militia .

title: Battle of Luthcheq
description: Battle of Luthcheq The Battle of Luthcheq was a conflict between the nations of Chessenta , Akanûl , and Tymanther against the dragon players of Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " that took place in the Year of the Ageless One . History . When Alasklerbanbastos warned Brimstone about Aoth Fezim and the Brotherhood of the Griffon attempts to foil the " xorvintaal " , the smoke drake allowed the dracolich to reach other dragon allies , including Tchazzar and a few dragon Princes of Murghôm , among them Astanalan , Chelnadatilar , Ferzath , and Llemgradac , to attack and destroy the Brotherhood , who at the time were in the city of Luthcheq .
description_long: Battle of Luthcheq The Battle of Luthcheq was a conflict between the nations of Chessenta , Akanûl , and Tymanther against the dragon players of Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " that took place in the Year of the Ageless One . History . When Alasklerbanbastos warned Brimstone about Aoth Fezim and the Brotherhood of the Griffon attempts to foil the " xorvintaal " , the smoke drake allowed the dracolich to reach other dragon allies , including Tchazzar and a few dragon Princes of Murghôm , among them Astanalan , Chelnadatilar , Ferzath , and Llemgradac , to attack and destroy the Brotherhood , who at the time were in the city of Luthcheq . However , the battle actually started before the dragons reached the city , when Tchazzar , jealous of one of the members of the Brotherhood , Gaedynn Ulraes , forced Jhesrhi Coldcreek to kill him . Unable to kill her friend , Jhesrhi betrayed Tchazzar and the mad dragon ordered the chessentan army to kill the Brotherhood of the Griffon , and , in a fit of madness , to attack the akanûlan military forces led by Lord Magnol of the Four Stewards who were stationed in the city as allies of Chessenta in a potential war against Tymanther .

title: Battle of Marak ' s Stile
description: Battle of Marak ' s Stile The Battle of Marak ' s Stile was a battle for control of Harrowdale that took place around 1180 - 1185 DR ( no source has a precise date ) . The forces of Halvan the Dark invaded Harrowdale , and fought against the defending forces of Lord Elmaer Oraun , leader of Harrowdale . Battle .
description_long: Battle of Marak ' s Stile The Battle of Marak ' s Stile was a battle for control of Harrowdale that took place around 1180 - 1185 DR ( no source has a precise date ) . The forces of Halvan the Dark invaded Harrowdale , and fought against the defending forces of Lord Elmaer Oraun , leader of Harrowdale . Battle . The battle was won by Halvan the Dark , who took control of Harrowdale . Casualties . Lord Elmaer Oraun , his son Erammon Oraun , and swordmaster Thaeron disappeared during the battle , presumed dead , but some said that elven magic had saved them from death , and they would apparently be seen on various occasions many years later .

title: Battle of Mount Bogdo
description: Battle of Mount Bogdo The Battle of Mount Bogdo occurred on Tarsakh 1 , 1338 DR at the foot of Mount Bogdo in the Hordelands . Events . Lead up .
description_long: Battle of Mount Bogdo The Battle of Mount Bogdo occurred on Tarsakh 1 , 1338 DR at the foot of Mount Bogdo in the Hordelands . Events . Lead up . Before Yamun Khahan ' s rise to power among the Tuigan , Abatai of the Commani tribe promised him the hand of his daughter in marriage . Disgusted by Yamun ' s slaying of his own father to claim leadership of the Hoekun , Abatai later refused to honor the agreement . The Tuigan / Naican Alliance . Along with his Naican allies , Yamun decided to strike against the Commani before they had time to consolidate their forces . They began this conquest by picking off the Commani ' s eastern " ordus " . Once the way was clear to the Commani heartland , Yamun marched with four " minghans " , or 4 , 000 men , under his command . The Commani . Abatai had been elected Khahan of the Commani to eliminate the threat of the Tuigan . Commanded by Abatai , the Commani camped along the foot of Mount Bogdo . A hastily erected cairn wall of stones was raised to help block the forward advance of Yamun ' s forces . The Battle .

title: Battle of Nightflames
description: Battle of Nightflames The Battle of Nightflames occurred in 1334 DR between the armies of Mulsparkh and Tethyr . The Tethyrian forces were led by Crown Prince Rythan who was killed in the battle . The armies of Calimshan destroyed Mulsparkh itself soon after the battle .
description_long: Battle of Nightflames The Battle of Nightflames occurred in 1334 DR between the armies of Mulsparkh and Tethyr . The Tethyrian forces were led by Crown Prince Rythan who was killed in the battle . The armies of Calimshan destroyed Mulsparkh itself soon after the battle . Mulsparkh had been created by the Twisted Rune as part of their plot to exact revenge upon Rythan for his murdering Jhaniloth Puiral a few years earlier in 1330 DR .

title: Battle of Shallows
description: Battle of Shallows The Battle of Shallows occurred in 1370 DR between a huge force of orc s and frost giant s and the human and dwarf defenders of Shallows , a small settlement in the Spine of the World . Participants . Orcs and giants .
description_long: Battle of Shallows The Battle of Shallows occurred in 1370 DR between a huge force of orc s and frost giant s and the human and dwarf defenders of Shallows , a small settlement in the Spine of the World . Participants . Orcs and giants . The orcs were around a thousand in number , and they were accompanied by ten frost giants . Humans and dwarves . King Bruenor Battlehammer and the Companions of the Hall were in Shallows at the time of the attack , and were able to aid in the defense . This made a total of a hundred humans and twenty - six dwarves . The more notable amongst these were : Battle . The first wave was successfully repelled , although Regis was injured . The second wave was also repelled , but the walls and gates of Shallows took heavy damage , and many were injured . Bruenor was seriously hurt during this wave . The frost giants eventually began hurling firepots and most of the town was burned to the ground . Withegroo ' s tower was razed , and during the third wave , Withegroo himself died after casting one final fireball . The turning point of the battle came when the Gutbusters arrived with Pikel and Ivan Bouldershoulder and a number of other dwarves .

title: Battle of Tanglefork
description: Battle of Tanglefork The Battle of Tanglefork was the final battle in the War of the Returned Regent . Battle . Outmatched by the force assembled before him , Nanathlor Greysword called upon aid from Mielikki , who " awaken ed " the trees surrounding the battlefield , thereby granting Nanathlor an army of treant s .
description_long: Battle of Tanglefork The Battle of Tanglefork was the final battle in the War of the Returned Regent . Battle . Outmatched by the force assembled before him , Nanathlor Greysword called upon aid from Mielikki , who " awaken ed " the trees surrounding the battlefield , thereby granting Nanathlor an army of treant s . Pasuuk Rensha revealed his diabolic powers by summoning devil ish allies . The devils and Pasuuk were all killed in the fighting . Aftermath . The corpses of Pasuuk and his fiendish allies were burned and their ashes spilled on the ground , forever blackening the Tanglefork Woods with their evil . Nanathlor Greysword became the new High Lord of Loudwater and began work to restore the beauty of nature to the Delimbiyr Vale ' s strip mines .

title: Battle of the Crippled Mountain
description: Battle of the Crippled Mountain The Battle of the Crippled Mountain was the last battle the dragonborn slaves of Skelkor fought before they gained their freedom . History . After a decisive victory in a previous battle , the rebel dragonborn leaders Iskara and Shurideh had gained a powerful artifact known as the Eye of Blazing Rorn , after felling its previous owner , the silver dragon Asativarainuth .
description_long: Battle of the Crippled Mountain The Battle of the Crippled Mountain was the last battle the dragonborn slaves of Skelkor fought before they gained their freedom . History . After a decisive victory in a previous battle , the rebel dragonborn leaders Iskara and Shurideh had gained a powerful artifact known as the Eye of Blazing Rorn , after felling its previous owner , the silver dragon Asativarainuth . The two dragonborn sisters joined forces with the leaders of other rebel war bands , in order to kill the most powerful of the dragon tyrants of Abeir , the red dragon Rhodrolytharnestrix . They went to the Celestial Mountain , a dormant volcano where Rhodrolytharnestrix had his lair , and opened a tunnel to the lava chambers using the Breath of Petron . While the rest of the dragonborn leaders led their war bands against Rhodrolytharnestrix ' s dragon army , Iskara , Shurideh , Reshvemi , and Thuchir infiltrated the mountain and dropped the Eye of Blazing Rorn into the volcano , triggering an eruption so powerful that it killed Rhodrolytharnestrix , even though he was a red dragon . Aftermath . The Celestial Mountain was destroyed , and was called the Crippled Mountain since then .

title: Battle of the Cwm
description: Battle of the Cwm The Battle of the Cwm took place in the early hours of 27 Ches 1374 DR between the daemonfey army and an elven coalition from Evereska and Evermeet , on the West Cwm on the outskirts of Evereska . The battle was won by the elves , but at great cost . Participants .
description_long: Battle of the Cwm The Battle of the Cwm took place in the early hours of 27 Ches 1374 DR between the daemonfey army and an elven coalition from Evereska and Evermeet , on the West Cwm on the outskirts of Evereska . The battle was won by the elves , but at great cost . Participants . Daemonfey . Led by Sarya Dlardrageth , the daemonfey consisted of 1500 fey ' ri , 500 assorted demon s ( yugoloth s , mezzoloth s , vrock s , hezrou s , babau s , nycaloth s ) and thousands of orc s , ogre s , bugbear s and troll s . Sarya herself did not participate in the battle , nor did her general Mardeiym Reithel . The glabrezu Grushakk fought , however . Elves . The elves were led by Seiveril Miritar and consisted of 2000 Evereska n combatants , and 6000 elves from Evermeet , although 1000 Evereskans and 2000 of the less experienced of the Evermeet elves remained behind in Evereska as a precaution against a surprise attack directly on the city . The more notable elven participants were : Battle .

title: Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon
description: Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon The Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon was fought in late 1479 DR between undead Durthan s and their humanoid allies and Rashemi berserkers and fey commanded by Aoth Fezim . The Rashemi lead the attack and forced their way past the ruined gates of the fortress . Fey loyal to the Stag King , a dark fey with features of a deer , followed the Rashemi .
description_long: Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon The Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon was fought in late 1479 DR between undead Durthan s and their humanoid allies and Rashemi berserkers and fey commanded by Aoth Fezim . The Rashemi lead the attack and forced their way past the ruined gates of the fortress . Fey loyal to the Stag King , a dark fey with features of a deer , followed the Rashemi . Aoth Fezim and his companion Cera Eurthos circled above the battle and blasted Durthan witches off the battlements and the elemental mage Jhesrhi Coldcreek provided additional fire support for Aoth and his allies . The Durthan were driven back into the catacombs underneath the fortress where most were hunted down and slaughtered by Aoth and his allies although several key Durthan leaders escaped .

title: Battle of the Gods
description: Battle of the Gods The Battle of the Gods was a conflict between the Untheric and Mulhorandi pantheon s against the Orc pantheon , as well of one of the major battles in the ongoing Dragonfall War , that took place in - 1071 DR as part of the Orcgate Wars . History . During the Orcgate Wars , the gray orc s and their cleric s had developed amazingly powerful and deadly spell s ; the most potent of magic s being their ability to directly call down avatar s of their deities .
description_long: Battle of the Gods The Battle of the Gods was a conflict between the Untheric and Mulhorandi pantheon s against the Orc pantheon , as well of one of the major battles in the ongoing Dragonfall War , that took place in - 1071 DR as part of the Orcgate Wars . History . During the Orcgate Wars , the gray orc s and their cleric s had developed amazingly powerful and deadly spell s ; the most potent of magic s being their ability to directly call down avatar s of their deities . When the orcs invaded Mulhorand and Unther , the gods of those nations also sent their avatars to the lands that later would become Thay , to face the invaders ' gods , resulting in what was later known as the Battle of the Gods . Ill - prepared to defend themselves against the orc gods , however , the gods of Mulhorand and Unther were slaughtered . Re was the first to fall , slain by Gruumsh , with several more powers of the Untheric pantheon following : Girru , Ki , Inanna , Nanna - Sin , Nergal and Utu were killed by the orc deities . Tiamat , who was also the enemy of the other Untheric gods , saw an opportunity to slay Gilgeam while he was battling Ilneval .

title: Battle of the Gods ' Theater
description: Battle of the Gods ' Theater The Battle of the Gods ' Theater was a costly conflict during the Crown Wars . Circa - 10700 DR , after peace failed , the elves of Shantel Othreier fought to defend their lands from the acquisitive and corrupt Vyshaan of Aryvandaar . Into this already - bloody conflict , located in what is now the Tunlands , poured an enormous horde of orcs .
description_long: Battle of the Gods ' Theater The Battle of the Gods ' Theater was a costly conflict during the Crown Wars . Circa - 10700 DR , after peace failed , the elves of Shantel Othreier fought to defend their lands from the acquisitive and corrupt Vyshaan of Aryvandaar . Into this already - bloody conflict , located in what is now the Tunlands , poured an enormous horde of orcs . Shantel Othreier paid the price , and the northern half of the nation was occupied by Aryvandaar . A century later , Coronal Ynloeth died under mysterious circumstances , and Aryvandaar seized control of Shantel Othreier .

title: Battle of the Haunted Plains
description: Battle of the Haunted Plains The Battle of the Haunted Plains was a battle fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . It took place in the Haunted Plains in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History .
description_long: Battle of the Haunted Plains The Battle of the Haunted Plains was a battle fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . It took place in the Haunted Plains in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . The Axe Kingdoms and Hmurrath fell to fighting in the Year of the Killing Blow , 653 DR , beginning the Ninth Serôs War . At the Battle of the Haunted Plains in the Year of the Coveted Briars , 654 DR , the merrow suffered a major defeat . Four - fifths of all merrow in Serôs were forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall . The rest survived on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains . This crushing blow and three years of conflict culminated in the destruction of the Axe Kingdoms and the fall of the merrow to the merfolk of Hmurrath in the Year of the Volanth , 655 DR .

title: Battle of the Lonely Moor
description: Battle of the Lonely Moor The Battle of the Lonely Moor began at sunset on 11 Tarsakh , 1374 DR . It was fought between the daemonfey armies and the armies of Evermeet and Evereska on the boggy terrain of the Lonely Moor , which was to have an impact on the battle ' s outcome . Participants .
description_long: Battle of the Lonely Moor The Battle of the Lonely Moor began at sunset on 11 Tarsakh , 1374 DR . It was fought between the daemonfey armies and the armies of Evermeet and Evereska on the boggy terrain of the Lonely Moor , which was to have an impact on the battle ' s outcome . Participants . Daemonfey . The daemonfey army , led by Sarya Dlardrageth accompanied by her general Mardeiym Reithel , were the remnants of the one that fought the Battle of the Cwm , plus what other demons Sarya Dlardrageth could summon in time . Its main line consisted of orc s and ogre s , with demons backing them up and the fey ' ri responsible for airborne attacks . Elves . The elves were led by Seiveril Miritar and consisted of the Vale Guards of Evereska , the Silver Guards of Evermeet , and more than a thousand wood elf archers . The more notable participants were : Battle . Convinced that his forces were more agile on the boggy terrain , but that his mounted units would be less effective , Seiveril ordered an advance of his army ' s left flank , while holding the right flank back , which was bolstered by the Silver Guards and the Vale Guards , the more veteran units .

title: Battle with the Witch Lords
description: Battle with the Witch Lords The last battle with the Witch Lords took place in 900 DR between the armies of Cormyr and the armies of the Witch Lords who had invaded . This was the final decisive battle of a war that had lasted several months . It took place about 40 miles from the edge of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr , at dawn .
description_long: Battle with the Witch Lords The last battle with the Witch Lords took place in 900 DR between the armies of Cormyr and the armies of the Witch Lords who had invaded . This was the final decisive battle of a war that had lasted several months . It took place about 40 miles from the edge of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr , at dawn . Participants . Witch Lords . The Witchlords of Wyvernwater were necromancer s who had turned many of their human troops into zombie s before the battle . Their numbers included goblin s , ogre s , orc s , and troll s . Some higher - ranking humans entered the battle riding giant bat s . The wizard Luthax was among their number . Cormyreans . The Glory of Cormyr was King Galaghard III ' s army , which consisted of human foot troops and cavalry , including armies from Marsember and Arabel . It was supported by the High Wizard of Cormyr , Thanderahast , and the King ' s cousin , Aosinin Truesilver . Elves . The elf army was led by Othorion Keove and , although not large in number , was well armed and armored throughout . The army contained airborne units and those mounted on stag s . Battle .

title: Battleaxe
description: Battleaxe A battleaxe ( also battle axe ) is a martial melee weapon of the axe family . They are usually crafted with a wooden handle and metal head . Description .
description_long: Battleaxe A battleaxe ( also battle axe ) is a martial melee weapon of the axe family . They are usually crafted with a wooden handle and metal head . Description . The battleaxe is a simple axe head mounted on a wooden or metal haft about to 3 feet ( 75 to 90 cm ) long . They can be ornate or plain and the blade may be slightly curved to almost round . The back side of the axe head may have a short spike or blade and the end of the haft may have a spike also . Some models come with belt hooks on the side of the head . For mounted warriors , a version called the horseman ' s axe is slightly shorter than the infantry version and is equipped with a leather strap for swinging . The average battleaxe costs 10 gp and weighs 6 lbs ( 2 . 7 kg ) . Use . The battleaxe is the standard one - handed axe used in melee combat and favored by Dwarves .

title: Battledale
description: Battledale Battledale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Despite its name earned long ago , it was one of the more peaceful vales in the 14th & 15th centuries DR . Even though Battledale was one of the largest dales , it was also one of the least populated .
description_long: Battledale Battledale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Despite its name earned long ago , it was one of the more peaceful vales in the 14th & 15th centuries DR . Even though Battledale was one of the largest dales , it was also one of the least populated . Until 1422 DR , its capital was Essembra . History . On 7 Elesias 1373 DR , the red dragon Thraxata started many fires in Battledale , causing a large amount of woodland to be destroyed . In 1422 DR Battledale came under attack from Sembians allied with Netheril which forced evacuation of Essembra .

title: Battlefield archer
description: Battlefield archer Battlefield archers are ranger s trained to become the pinnacles of archery and are typically imagined as unrivaled in the use of ranged weapons . Calm in the heart of battle , battlefield archers rarely miss and are a valuable addition to any adventuring party . Abilities .
description_long: Battlefield archer Battlefield archers are ranger s trained to become the pinnacles of archery and are typically imagined as unrivaled in the use of ranged weapons . Calm in the heart of battle , battlefield archers rarely miss and are a valuable addition to any adventuring party . Abilities . Battlefield archers train themselves to become paragons of marksmanship , gaining several abilities and marks of their specialization as a result . Battlefield archers rarely miss and their arrows are quite often lethal . Battlefield archers are deadly foes and even the most inexperienced ones find the only limit to their range of targets is the strength of their senses and ability to percieve their surrounding . Perhaps more worrying is that veteran battlefield archers also possess an uncanny evasiveness , proving more difficult to hit than most warriors even as they strike arrows in their foes . Battlefield archer exploit s , as would be logical , focus on the use of ranged weapons , most often bow s . Battlefield archers are swift and deadly and often leap from the felling of one foe to attacking another .

title: Battlepriest of Cormyr
description: Battlepriest of Cormyr A Battlepriest of Cormyr was a prestige class of members of the Purple Dragons . Activities . The priests provided healing to their fellows while aiding in planning tactics and speeding their comrade ' s marching .
description_long: Battlepriest of Cormyr A Battlepriest of Cormyr was a prestige class of members of the Purple Dragons . Activities . The priests provided healing to their fellows while aiding in planning tactics and speeding their comrade ' s marching . Reputation . Their fellow soldiers gave them a great deal of respect for their abilities and spells . The War Wizards kept close tabs on the Battlepriests , nominally because they feared that they might be a threat if one of them decided to try and seize power . However , those in the know suspected that it was simply because the War Wizards derided them as rivals , calling them " spellbeggars " . Membership . Most battlepriests were cleric s of Helm , Lathander , Selûne , Tempus , Torm , Tymora , or Tyr , but some paladin s also counted themselves among their ranks .

title: Battlerager
description: Battlerager Battleragers are a type of dwarven fighter whose combat style relies on raw instinct , anger and physical strength . The individuals who practice this type of fighting are usually mentally unstable with a low life expectancy . Despite this simple attitude , battleragers are a key element of dwarven warfare .
description_long: Battlerager Battleragers are a type of dwarven fighter whose combat style relies on raw instinct , anger and physical strength . The individuals who practice this type of fighting are usually mentally unstable with a low life expectancy . Despite this simple attitude , battleragers are a key element of dwarven warfare . Their almost suicidal style allows more strategic fighters to plan and execute more complex techniques , on already worn down enemies . Physical Description . The close combat battlerager style means that all dwarves who practice it must be immensely strong and durable . Battleragers usually focus only on what they need to fight and survive , this has lead to individuals with poor personal hygeine . Battlerager armor is usually thick and spiked .
