This armor is incorporated into the fighting style of the battlerager . Most battleragers cover their entire bodies in tattoos and symbols , any skin left bare will be covered in war paint before battle . Etymology . Battleragers are known as Kuldjargh in their native Dwarvish , which literally translates to " axe idiot " . Beliefs .

title: Batu Min Ho
description: Batu Min Ho Batu Min Ho was a general first in the army of Shou Lung and later in the Grand Army of the Tuigan . History . Batu was the son of a lowlander of Tuigan ancestry in Chukei .
description_long: Batu Min Ho Batu Min Ho was a general first in the army of Shou Lung and later in the Grand Army of the Tuigan . History . Batu was the son of a lowlander of Tuigan ancestry in Chukei . He was a soldier in the personal army of Hsuan Yu Po . In order to marry Hsuan ' s daughter Hsuan Yu Wu Batu joined the Shou Lung army in 1348 DR becoming one of the most promising young general in Shou Lung and finally marring Wu . He served well in the provincial Army of Chukei for eight years . In 1359 , after the failing of War Minister Kwan Chan Sen at the Tsen - Ching , a tributary of the Sheng - Ti river , Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin ordered Batu to counterattack against the Tuigan that were invading the Empire . However , after some clues about Batu ' s possible treason , the emperor decided to move Batu ' s wife and children closer to himself . Batu ordered his forces to burn everything in the Tuigan ' s path and decided to attack the Tuigan near the city of Shu Kuan , coordinating his army with the personal armies of the nobles , the Twenty - Five Armies led by Tzu Hsuan .

title: Bauhei
description: Bauhei Bauhei , colloquially known as the Black Leopard , was a greater spirit in T ' u Lung . History . Bauhei was a very ancient spirit , ruling lands around Fenghsintsu province long before the rising of the Celestial Empire .
description_long: Bauhei Bauhei , colloquially known as the Black Leopard , was a greater spirit in T ' u Lung . History . Bauhei was a very ancient spirit , ruling lands around Fenghsintsu province long before the rising of the Celestial Empire . His human followers formed the Black Leopard Cult to revere him . However , in time , with the ascendancy of Celestial Emperor , Bauhei lost most of his power and at last was enslaved by the greedy high priest of the cult , Nan Kung Chi , who started a regime that spread terror Around - 1370 DR , Emperor Tan Chin of Shou Lung decided to destroyed the cult . With the aid his friend , the poet wu jen Kar Wuan , Tan Chin went to the main temple in Durkon and managed to free Bauhei , who quickly killed Nan Kung Chi . In 1358 DR , Bauhei agreed to fight Dragon Claw and his followers in T ' u Lung tried to oppose Dragon Claw ' s minions in all matters . He sent a bauh - yin , a leopard - headed servant , to Ko La Ko to guide the adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San . Personality . Bauhei was truly chaotic neutral , that is , unaligned and free . He cared little for mortals but took sporadic interest in the secret society that took his name .

title: Baule diviner
description: Baule diviner Baule diviners were a type of wizard found in Zakhara , who venerated Fate . They were diviner s who got their knowledge from studying the four elements of air , earth , fire , and water . Thus they also had access to spells from the priestly elemental sphere , while their specialization precluded them from using conjuration / summoning magic .
description_long: Baule diviner Baule diviners were a type of wizard found in Zakhara , who venerated Fate . They were diviner s who got their knowledge from studying the four elements of air , earth , fire , and water . Thus they also had access to spells from the priestly elemental sphere , while their specialization precluded them from using conjuration / summoning magic . Outwardly , they could be recognized by their shaved heads , special red garments , and the golden rings they wore around their arms and necks . Their insight into the ways of Fate was highly respected especially by city - dwellers , but they were known to reveal their wisdom only in a guarded way .

title: Bautha z ' hin
description: Bautha z ' hin Bautha Z ' hin , meaning " dodge and walk " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that made use of their natural agility and their favored kind of armor , the light armor . Description . As the name " dodge and walk " suggested , the fighting style was about dodging defenses and mobility .
description_long: Bautha z ' hin Bautha Z ' hin , meaning " dodge and walk " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that made use of their natural agility and their favored kind of armor , the light armor . Description . As the name " dodge and walk " suggested , the fighting style was about dodging defenses and mobility . It was about safely hitting a single enemy by surrounding it through use of the trained mobility and dodging abilities . User of this style often cooperated with users of the " z ' ress a ' thalak " style for they could serve as good anchor points for flanking maneuvers . The style was favored against enemies with who not only owned several ways to attack but also had long reaches . Training . As the name suggested , would - be users needed to learn to dodge and to be mobile . They trained themselves into able practitioners of hit - and - run tactics . Users also often learned the " orb alur " style to some degree . Reputation . As mentioned , the style was about using heightened mobility and surrounding a single enemy . In short , the strategy behind this fighting style was to gang up on one enemy with superior numbers .

title: Bay Town
description: Bay Town Bay Town was a small settlement found along Trader ' s Bay near the center of Impiltur . Bay Town ' s population in 1357 DR was 1 , 750 . Inhabitants .
description_long: Bay Town Bay Town was a small settlement found along Trader ' s Bay near the center of Impiltur . Bay Town ' s population in 1357 DR was 1 , 750 . Inhabitants . Bay Town was a haven for thieves , pirates and a slew of other unfavorable types . Aware that these seedy types of citizens will always find a way to carve their niche somewhere , the leaders of Impiltur preferred to at least have them all in one spot which also happened to be a rather insignificant location . Visitors to Bay Town often quickly found themselves shackled into slavery .

title: Bay of Azuth
description: Bay of Azuth The Bay of Azuth was a bay located in southeast Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Azuth offered a natural barrier to towns a cities located in southeast Halruaa , protecting them from pirates and harsh weather rolling in from the Great Sea .
description_long: Bay of Azuth The Bay of Azuth was a bay located in southeast Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Azuth offered a natural barrier to towns a cities located in southeast Halruaa , protecting them from pirates and harsh weather rolling in from the Great Sea . The bay was more enclosed than the Bay of Taertal , allowing for calm waters that could be easily fished by locals .

title: Bay of Chessenta
description: Bay of Chessenta The Bay of Chessenta was a large bay in the southern Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the preferred means of travel in Chessenta as the Chessentan roads were poorly maintained in the late 15th century DR . Oar - powered Chessentan triremes plied the waters of the often windless bay and there were many small harbors for ships to pull into .
description_long: Bay of Chessenta The Bay of Chessenta was a large bay in the southern Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the preferred means of travel in Chessenta as the Chessentan roads were poorly maintained in the late 15th century DR . Oar - powered Chessentan triremes plied the waters of the often windless bay and there were many small harbors for ships to pull into . In the years after the Spellplague , piracy became a problem and a band of pirates known as the Crimson Sea Maritime Priakos operated in the bay .

title: Bay of Halruaa
description: Bay of Halruaa The Bay of Halruaa was a bay located in south central Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Halruaa opened up the central portion of southern Halruaa to the Great Sea .
description_long: Bay of Halruaa The Bay of Halruaa was a bay located in south central Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Halruaa opened up the central portion of southern Halruaa to the Great Sea . It connected with the Halagard Channel to connect Lake Halruaa and all of Halruaa ' s major rivers and tributaries .

title: Bay of Kings
description: Bay of Kings The Bay of Kings was located on the coast of Estagund in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bay of Kings offered natural protection for the city of Klionna , sheltering many of their warships and fishing boats from the fierce winter storms that blew in from the Great Sea and wracked the region .
description_long: Bay of Kings The Bay of Kings was located on the coast of Estagund in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bay of Kings offered natural protection for the city of Klionna , sheltering many of their warships and fishing boats from the fierce winter storms that blew in from the Great Sea and wracked the region .

title: Bay of Taertal
description: Bay of Taertal The Bay of Taertal was a bay located in southwest Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Taertal offered natural protection for cities and towns dotting the southwest coast of Halruaa .
description_long: Bay of Taertal The Bay of Taertal was a bay located in southwest Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Taertal offered natural protection for cities and towns dotting the southwest coast of Halruaa . The presence of Halruaa ' s naval base on Rulasuu dissuaded many would - be pirates from attacking settlements found along the Bay of Taertal .

title: Bayel Droust
description: Bayel Droust Bayel Droust was a scholar and scribe from Impiltur . He was sent by the Grand Council in 1399 DR on an expedition to map the post - spellplague coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . The ship he was travelling on , the Grayling , was attacked and sunk by Cealynna near the island of Prespur .
description_long: Bayel Droust Bayel Droust was a scholar and scribe from Impiltur . He was sent by the Grand Council in 1399 DR on an expedition to map the post - spellplague coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . The ship he was travelling on , the Grayling , was attacked and sunk by Cealynna near the island of Prespur . Bayel possessed two books written by the Shou monk Liou Chang that described how to open teleporation gates . Cealynna wanted the spell s so she could return to the Feywild so she imprisoned Bayel in her undersea domain for eighty years where he was forced to work at breaking the code used by Liou Chang . Bayel was rescued by the monk Kwan Shang - Li in 1479 DR .

title: Bazaar ( Menzoberranzan )
description: Bazaar ( Menzoberranzan ) The Bazaar was the permanent market of Menzoberranzan located in the district of Duthcloim ( also known as " Manyfolk " ) . Some considered the Bazaar the heart of Menzoberranzan . Description .
description_long: Bazaar ( Menzoberranzan ) The Bazaar was the permanent market of Menzoberranzan located in the district of Duthcloim ( also known as " Manyfolk " ) . Some considered the Bazaar the heart of Menzoberranzan . Description . The Bazaar of Menzoberranzan attracted merchants and buyers from across the multiverse . Most races were welcome ( with the exception of beholder s , neogi and githyanki ) , and as long as the peace was kept and proper respect was shown to matron mother s , someone ( or something ) could buy whatever they might have desired here ( including cadavers ) , though non - drow were often spied upon . Many surface - dwelling merchants and trade goods passed through or remained in Menzoberranzan . All people of Menzoberranzan shopped at the Bazaar , even some matron mother s . In the Bazaar were cobblers , riding lizards , duergar , kuo - toa , and ogre mages . Slaves included orcs , gnolls , bugbears , goblins , and kobolds . There was also at least one barber stall , a game tent , and a portrait painter . One could obtain surgery or send messages to the surface from the Bazaar . There were also performers on its busy streets .

title: Bazidan
description: Bazidan Barzidan , also called Barzidan of the Flames was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Barzidan served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .
description_long: Bazidan Barzidan , also called Barzidan of the Flames was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Barzidan served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan . Barzidan controlled his own stronghold , complete with a staff of other efreet and noble efreet as well as a contingent of slaves of various races .

title: Bazim - Gorag
description: Bazim - Gorag Bazim - Gorag the Firebringer was an ascended primordial and one of the five elemental lords of Toril , and formerly a batrachi and a slaad lord . Description . Bazim - Gorag was a frog - like humanoid with red - gold skin and two froglike heads .
description_long: Bazim - Gorag Bazim - Gorag the Firebringer was an ascended primordial and one of the five elemental lords of Toril , and formerly a batrachi and a slaad lord . Description . Bazim - Gorag was a frog - like humanoid with red - gold skin and two froglike heads . Larger than an ogre , he carried a huge glaive of black iron , wreathed in dark flames . History . Bazim - Gorag claimed a massive empire on the supercontinent of Merrouroboros during the later half of the Days of Thunder . The leader of the Batrachi empires , Zhoukoudien , who had led his people to the zenith of their power , entered into a wasteful conflict with the giant s to the north , which decimated the carefully built - up batrachi lands . Not long later , the Tearfall struck Toril and the Batrachi , on the advice of the god Ramenos , fled to Limbo where they created the Supreme Throne . Ramenos ' s influence eventually caused the batrachi to turn into creatures most sages confused with the slaad i . He eventually became the most powerful member of his transformed species , but didn ' t openly offend the slaad lords Ygorl and Ssendam , therefore saving his own skin .

title: Bea Farbough
description: Bea Farbough Bea Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Bea and her husband Ebenz Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar .
description_long: Bea Farbough Bea Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Bea and her husband Ebenz Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar . When the city ' s First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - human s , Ebenz and Bea decided to house the ten abandoned children living in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children , and because Bea couldn ' t have children . A year later , however , Bea gave birth to six sons , so things became even more chaotic . Trouble arrived the year after when the Rage of Demons began and the tiefling boy Pynroth disappeared .

title: Beacon Cairn
description: Beacon Cairn Beacon Cairn was the easternmost town of Rashemen , and sat astride the Golden Way . History . The name came from a pinnacle of rock that rose above the plain to roughly 500 ft ( 152 m ) .
description_long: Beacon Cairn Beacon Cairn was the easternmost town of Rashemen , and sat astride the Golden Way . History . The name came from a pinnacle of rock that rose above the plain to roughly 500 ft ( 152 m ) . The flat landscape of the area allowed it to be seen many miles away . Atop the pinnacle was a beacon fire that glowed a flickering blue green . This fire was magically created long ago by Raumathar as part of a series of navigational aids for travelers in the empire . The town itself was clustered around the base of the tower , and was built out of the same red shale as the tower itself , which caused it to blend into the tower ' s base . The town itself was in decline because trade was shifting southward , most of the buildings were very decrepit , or ruined entirely . Most of the town had been abandoned in the twenty or so years prior to 1359 DR , though some of the ruins were over 500 years old . When the Tuigan passed south of the city , heading towards Thay , most people fled the town . After being driven from Thay , the Tuigan went north , passing through the town itself .

title: Beacon of hope
description: Beacon of hope Beacon of hope was an abjuration spell that granted health and feelings of hope . Effects . Any targeted person or creature within 30 feet ( 9 .
description_long: Beacon of hope Beacon of hope was an abjuration spell that granted health and feelings of hope . Effects . Any targeted person or creature within 30 feet ( 9 . 1 meters ) gained an advantage for surviving death effects and divine spells , like those of cleric s , druid s , and ranger s . The targets also gained the most out of heal ing spells cast on them . Components . The spell components were verbal and somatic .

title: Bear
description: Bear Bears were mammal s , typically of a predatorial nature , that were found throughout Toril . Although lacking in particularly supernatural abilities , larger bears were still dangerous creatures to enrage and could prove a match for the ill - prepared adventurer . Bears could be most often found in forested regions or caverns .
description_long: Bear Bears were mammal s , typically of a predatorial nature , that were found throughout Toril . Although lacking in particularly supernatural abilities , larger bears were still dangerous creatures to enrage and could prove a match for the ill - prepared adventurer . Bears could be most often found in forested regions or caverns . Physical description . Bears were incredibly powerful physically , possessing superhuman strength as well as a formidable durability , making attacking these clawed beast s an ill - advised idea . Among the most commonly encountered bears were human - sized , with larger species existing . Bears also had a powerful sense of smell and many were omnivorous . Species of bears . Some of the more commonly encountered bear species are listed below .

title: Beartrid Winters
description: Beartrid Winters Beartrid Winters was the wife of Kalas Winters , who owned the Wolf ' s Pelt Inn in the Icewind Dale community of Targos . Description . The hostess of the Wolf ' s Pelt was an attractive human with black hair and brown eyes .
description_long: Beartrid Winters Beartrid Winters was the wife of Kalas Winters , who owned the Wolf ' s Pelt Inn in the Icewind Dale community of Targos . Description . The hostess of the Wolf ' s Pelt was an attractive human with black hair and brown eyes . Beartrid was 5 ft 4 in ( 1 . 6 m ) tall and weighed around 130 lb ( 58 . 9 kg ) . Personality . When Beartrid greeted the many patrons of the Wolf ' Pelt , her voice was loud and jovial . While greeting guests , she would flirt with customers , but always kept an eye on her daughter , Dorthy Winters . On more than occasion , Beartrid had to stop a fight or other misconduct with her trusty frying pan . Relationships . Beartrid was married to Kalas Winters and had two children , Dorthy and Sims Winters . She was defiantly protective of her family . History . Around Tarsakh , 1369 DR , Beartrid lived with her family in the Ten Towns and kept a watchful eye on every customer who entered the Wolf ' s Pelt .

title: Beast
description: Beast A beast was any creature that behaved in a manner similar to that expected of common animal s dwelling in the Prime Material Plane . However , while animals were generally beasts , many beasts were not animals and could have highly abnormal origins or features . Physically , beasts tended to resemble animals or at the very least , other natural wildlife .
description_long: Beast A beast was any creature that behaved in a manner similar to that expected of common animal s dwelling in the Prime Material Plane . However , while animals were generally beasts , many beasts were not animals and could have highly abnormal origins or features . Physically , beasts tended to resemble animals or at the very least , other natural wildlife .

title: Beast Lord
description: Beast Lord The Beast Lord was an alhoon mage ally of the Zhentarim in the North . Personality . Incredibly secretive , the Beast Lord planned to conquer the North and parts of the Deepearth .
description_long: Beast Lord The Beast Lord was an alhoon mage ally of the Zhentarim in the North . Personality . Incredibly secretive , the Beast Lord planned to conquer the North and parts of the Deepearth . Activities . The mind flayer was known to have its lair in the ruins of Dekanter in the Savage Frontier . Within its lair , the Beast Lord created twisted monsters , such as bulette s , stegocentipede s , peryton , beholder s , and mongrelmen . One of his most famous creations were the Dekanter goblins . To aid the illithid in his war in the North , the Beast Lord had an army of 500 goblin s and 50 gargoyle s . Relationships . While allied with the Zhentarim , the Beast Lord fought the forces of the drow and the Harpers . Within the Dungeon of the Hark , the mind flayer had a roper ally known as Xuchallit , who had 12 ogre bodyguards . The Beast Lord shares his lair with the goblins of Dekanter lead by Lord High Chief Ghistpok . History . In Ches , 1357 DR , rumors spread about the rise of a Beast Lord in the North who used magic to create monstrous creatures , such as gorgimera and owlbear s .

title: Beast sense
description: Beast sense Beast sense was a divination spell that allowed a caster to use the senses of a willing creature . Effect . The caster gained any special senses possessed by the target creature .
description_long: Beast sense Beast sense was a divination spell that allowed a caster to use the senses of a willing creature . Effect . The caster gained any special senses possessed by the target creature . The caster was able to see and hear but was not able to do so from their own body . The spell lasted for an hour unless prompted to end early or if there was a loss of concentration . Components . The spell had somatic components .

title: Beast stalker
description: Beast stalker Beast stalkers are expert archer ranger s who specialize in the hunting and slaying of magical beast s . Beast stalkers track their prey through the dangerous wilds and through skill and training fell them with remarkable ease . Beast stalkers also , when required , can turn their methods against other creatures .
description_long: Beast stalker Beast stalkers are expert archer ranger s who specialize in the hunting and slaying of magical beast s . Beast stalkers track their prey through the dangerous wilds and through skill and training fell them with remarkable ease . Beast stalkers also , when required , can turn their methods against other creatures . Abilities . Beast stalker training reflects the chosen profession the stalkers take on , that of beast slaying . Beast stalkers are taught early on to deal death quickly and with uncanny accuracy , and little room is left for error . In order to prevent their own deaths , beast stalkers are trained to maintain their mobility within combat , shifting from one place to another in order to remain a difficult target . Though beast stalkers are deadly against most opponents , each individual stalker specialized in one of two forms of enemies , regular beast s or their magical kin . Beast slayer exploit s focus on making the ranger using them as deadly as possible and even inexperienced slayers can often pinpoint the exact location of their foe , even if it is concealed , striking it with an arrow .

title: Beastlands
description: Beastlands The Beastlands were a region of plains at the eastern end of the Shaar . It was home to various non - human monstrous tribes who were allied in a loose confederation for self - defense . The eastern edge of this region was formed by the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , a range which separated the plains from the desert to the east .
description_long: Beastlands The Beastlands were a region of plains at the eastern end of the Shaar . It was home to various non - human monstrous tribes who were allied in a loose confederation for self - defense . The eastern edge of this region was formed by the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , a range which separated the plains from the desert to the east .

title: Beaugrat
description: Beaugrat Beaugrat was a barbarian and a member of the Peacekeepers and the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He was of heavy build , although he wasn ' t much taller than an average human .
description_long: Beaugrat Beaugrat was a barbarian and a member of the Peacekeepers and the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He was of heavy build , although he wasn ' t much taller than an average human . Personality . He had a reputation of being a brawler and a bully . History . Beaugrat was an associate of Duvan and travelled with him to the edge of the Underchasm to retrieve a valuable spellbook for Tyrangal . Beaugrat was secretly working for the Order of Blue Flame and betrayed Duvan and tried to steal the book . Later , Beaugrat helped the Order capture Duvan for experimentation . Beaugrat was killed by the monk Slanya when she and others from her order rescued Duvan . Abilities . Beaugrat ' s spellscar allows him to project blue flames from his hands . Equipment . Beaugrat wore plate mail that had a custom - crafted gap in the right pauldron to show his deep and jagged spellscar . He used a huge two - handed sword and wore steel spiked gauntlets .

title: Beaumaris River
description: Beaumaris River The Beaumaris River flows south from the Great Glacier , turns east and cuts Vaasa in half , flows through the Galena Mountains at Bloodstone Pass , and heads to the south into Damara . It is a meltwater river and is completely frozen during the winter . At other times it flows very slowly and is shallow to such an extend that even small boats cannot navigate its fords without being carried .
description_long: Beaumaris River The Beaumaris River flows south from the Great Glacier , turns east and cuts Vaasa in half , flows through the Galena Mountains at Bloodstone Pass , and heads to the south into Damara . It is a meltwater river and is completely frozen during the winter . At other times it flows very slowly and is shallow to such an extend that even small boats cannot navigate its fords without being carried . The river has clean , refreshing cold water . In Vaasa it is frequented by goblinoid s and the local people consider it dangerous to use for passage through the land . Vaasa . Dead Man ' s Walk , a road in Vaasa , runs adjacent to the river as it flows through Vaasa . The ruins of Moortown stand on the river , and Nigel ' s Ford provides a crossing point . Damara . The river flows south into Damara and continues along this course for many miles until it turns to the northeast , where it flows to Goliad . At Goliad it merges with Goliad River and continues south to Heliogabalus where it flows into Lake Mogador .

title: Bebilith
description: Bebilith A bebilith was a massive demonic spider the size of a plow horse . They delighted in causing suffering and pain in others , but especially so in demon s whom they hunted for food . The bebilith seemed to be some form of supernatural demon predator .
description_long: Bebilith A bebilith was a massive demonic spider the size of a plow horse . They delighted in causing suffering and pain in others , but especially so in demon s whom they hunted for food . The bebilith seemed to be some form of supernatural demon predator . Bebiliths had spider - shaped bodies , with long fore - legs ending in razor - sharp claws . These claws were used to penetrate and rip armor plating from the bebiliths ' foes . Just as with spiders , bebiliths had a lethal bite , but rather than a venom ( to which demons were immune ) , they injected a vile fluid , a type of necrotic liquid , that caused accelerated rotting of the flesh . Bebiliths were incredibly aggressive and would attack anything they saw .

title: Bedeviling burst
description: Bedeviling burst Bedeviling burst is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , most frequently chaos sorcerers . When a sorcerer casts " bedeviling burst " they literally assault the mind of their foe , causing them so much pain that they literally stagger back from the psychic attack . Chaos sorcerers sometimes do this through actual telekinesis rather than simple effect .
description_long: Bedeviling burst Bedeviling burst is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , most frequently chaos sorcerers . When a sorcerer casts " bedeviling burst " they literally assault the mind of their foe , causing them so much pain that they literally stagger back from the psychic attack . Chaos sorcerers sometimes do this through actual telekinesis rather than simple effect . The spell is not easily cast and a short rest of at least a few minutes is required before the sorcerer can recast " bedeviling burst " .

title: Bedine
description: Bedine The Bedine were a proud warlike race that inhabited the southern Anauroch regions but were concentrated in the region known as the Sword . Description . They had brown - hued skin , brown eyes , and black or brown hair and were of average height and weight for a humanoid creature of Faerun .
description_long: Bedine The Bedine were a proud warlike race that inhabited the southern Anauroch regions but were concentrated in the region known as the Sword . Description . They had brown - hued skin , brown eyes , and black or brown hair and were of average height and weight for a humanoid creature of Faerun . Those rare instances of blue eyes or blonde hair were a product of " outlander blood " . History . In −339 DR , a group of humanoid s immigrated from Zakhara using a " portal " . They intermingled with some surviving Netherese and over time their culture became what was called the Bedine . They maintained knowledge of their spoken language , Midani , or Uloushinn , but had all but forgotten their native written language . Over the centuries since , traders introduced them to the Thorass alphabet . Culture . Honor was prime among the Bedine ' s beliefs . Their harsh existence , full of death and hardship , molded their culture to believe the gods would measure them based on their behavior in the Fugue Plane . The Bedine were divided into over 100 tribes with the largest having more than 300 members .

title: Bedon
description: Bedon Bedon was a human cleric and monk of Ilmater and the leader of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains " circa " 1374 DR . Brother Bedon instated a policy that no one who came to the monastery seeking knowledge could be denied .
description_long: Bedon Bedon was a human cleric and monk of Ilmater and the leader of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains " circa " 1374 DR . Brother Bedon instated a policy that no one who came to the monastery seeking knowledge could be denied . However , he made a special effort to assist all visitors that were dedicated to peace and goodness . He saw his role at the monastery , dedicated to the preservation and teaching of history , as a means to quell strife around Calimshan and the Lake of Steam .

title: Bedorn
description: Bedorn Bedorn is a coastal realm of the Border Kingdoms . The Shining Sea lies off its coastline to the west and the Scelptarmouth ( the mouth of the River Scelptar ) is to the north . The main centre of activity in Bedorn is the town of Oparl .
description_long: Bedorn Bedorn is a coastal realm of the Border Kingdoms . The Shining Sea lies off its coastline to the west and the Scelptarmouth ( the mouth of the River Scelptar ) is to the north . The main centre of activity in Bedorn is the town of Oparl . Background . The bogs and marshes that make up much of the land in Bedorn act as efficient defenses against invasions by the nomads of the Shaar to the south . Bedorn has long since become a playground for rich Calishite satraps who have built many palaces and lavish abodes in Oparl and the immediately surrounding areas . This has resulted in much of the land here being transformed into a lush and beautiful landscape of grass and trees . Many of these satraps host games and events for their own satisfaction , such as beast hunts or fights to the death . Occasional invasions from the Shaar and even pirate landings have proved to be only a small inconvenience due to the powerful wizard s who inhabit Bedorn such as Ilcanorr of Luthcheq . Inhabitants .

title: Beetle
description: Beetle The beetle was an insect found in many places and variations in the " Forgotten Realms " , often in giant sizes . Species . Giant bombardier beetle .
description_long: Beetle The beetle was an insect found in many places and variations in the " Forgotten Realms " , often in giant sizes . Species . Giant bombardier beetle . Giant bombardier beetle s were able to emit an acid cloud that burned enemies . Giant fire beetle . Giant fire beetle s were large ( about 2 ft long ) , nocturnal insects . They had two glands , one above each eye , that produced a red glow . Giant scarab beetle . Giant scarab beetle s , which could be up to 12 ft ( 4 m ) long , were found in many locations in the Underdark . Shrub beetle . The shrub beetle was known in Cormanthor for jumping into River Ashaba to cool off , but sinking and drowning .

title: Beggar - thief
description: Beggar - thief Beggar - thieves were among the lowest individuals of Zakharan society . Requirements . As the name implied , beggar - thieves were thieves .
description_long: Beggar - thief Beggar - thieves were among the lowest individuals of Zakharan society . Requirements . As the name implied , beggar - thieves were thieves . Bard s were not allowed to become beggar - thieves . Role . These individuals focused on daily survival on the scorched streets of the Land of Fate . Their lives were dominated by hunger and basic needs . Dreams of grand adventure were just that — dreams . Beggar - thieves were generally respectful of authority , assuming that the authorities had their backs turned . Possessions . Beggar - thieves had scant possessions . Those who had anything of value typically kept it hidden or stashed away to increase their chances of begging coins or food from charitable citizens . Special Benefits . Since there were many ragged individuals populating the streets of Zakhara , beggar - thieves had an uncanny ability to disappear in a crowd . Special Hindrances . Beggars were regarded as the lowest members of society , negatively affecting any interaction with non - beggars .

title: Beguiling tongue
description: Beguiling tongue Beguiling tongue , sometimes called " beguiling influence " , was a spell used by warlock s to enhance their own charm and capacity for persuasion by making the very voice of a warlock powerful with great magic . " Beguiling tongue " was particularly attractive to those who specialized in pacts with powerful archfey , since its power drew heavily on the magical energies of the Feywild . " Beguiling tongue " was relatively easy to cast and though a warlock could only use it intermittently , a short rest of a few minutes was enough to regain its power .
description_long: Beguiling tongue Beguiling tongue , sometimes called " beguiling influence " , was a spell used by warlock s to enhance their own charm and capacity for persuasion by making the very voice of a warlock powerful with great magic . " Beguiling tongue " was particularly attractive to those who specialized in pacts with powerful archfey , since its power drew heavily on the magical energies of the Feywild . " Beguiling tongue " was relatively easy to cast and though a warlock could only use it intermittently , a short rest of a few minutes was enough to regain its power . Prior to the Spellplague , " beguiling tongue " required no such rest .

title: Beguld Thormon
description: Beguld Thormon Beguld Thormon was a merchant who lived in Crimmor in Amn in the 14th century DR . History . Beguld was well respected over a long career , but was murdered by doppelganger sometime in the summer of Year of the Behir , 1342 DR .
description_long: Beguld Thormon Beguld Thormon was a merchant who lived in Crimmor in Amn in the 14th century DR . History . Beguld was well respected over a long career , but was murdered by doppelganger sometime in the summer of Year of the Behir , 1342 DR . The doppelganger adopted his identity and carried on his trade . In a market in Crimmor in the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , " Beguld Thormon " ran a stall dealing in " treasures for the adventurous " . The doppelganger came into the possession of the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater . This had been thought lost in the winter when the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company transporting it was slain — also by doppelgangers . " Beguld " sold the " Tome " for 20 , 000 gp to a group of Thay an agents who dealt in a number of criminal enterprises : kidnapping , slavery , smuggling , and the fencing and transport of stolen property . Ilmatari investigators later uncovered the doppelganger ' s true nature when they tracked down the " Tome " .

title: Behemoth
description: Behemoth Behemoths ( also known as dinosaurs or thunderers ) were a group of ancient reptilian creatures found on Toril . Description . Behemoths came in many shapes and sizes though , as their name implied , the best known were typically very large .
description_long: Behemoth Behemoths ( also known as dinosaurs or thunderers ) were a group of ancient reptilian creatures found on Toril . Description . Behemoths came in many shapes and sizes though , as their name implied , the best known were typically very large . Behemoths could be either herbivorous or carnivorous , depending on the species . Unlike dragons , behemoths were incapable of speech and were non - intelligent by nature . Behemoths came in many varieties , from small to large , but most shared a number of physical features . Behemoths were , for instance , all covered in a layer of pebble - like skin . Most also demonstrated a well - developed sense of smell , which predatory behemoths used to hunt . Many were also herbivorous . Psychology . Like dragons , predatory behemoths had a powerful lust to hunt , their razor - sharp teeth suitable for rending prey apart and were also highly territorial . Herbivorous behemoths were usually less aggressive although when defending their young or wounded or after being startled or irritated , they could be vicious enemies History .

title: Behir
description: Behir A behir ( pronounced be - HEER ) was a great serpentine monster with twelve legs and an electrical breath . Description . A behir was often mistaken for a wingless blue dragon .
description_long: Behir A behir ( pronounced be - HEER ) was a great serpentine monster with twelve legs and an electrical breath . Description . A behir was often mistaken for a wingless blue dragon . It had a long , snake - like body and could slither on the ground like a snake , but it also had six pairs of legs upon which it could walk or climb if it chose to do so . Each of a behir ' s twelve feet contained three clawed toes . They were surprisingly quick , and could outrun the typical human . Behirs had thick , armored scales , much like a dragon . Their scales were colored in variations of dark blue , being lighter on their undersides . They had long narrow heads , crocodilian in shape , with curved , black horns on the top , which were used for preening . Their mouths were full of many sharp teeth . A typical adult behir was 40 feet ( twelve meters ) long and weighed two tons ( 1 , 800 kilograms ) but could grow to gargantuan sizes . They were expert climbers . Variations . A subspecies of behir were native to Halruaa and were bred there as pets or guardians . Personality . Behirs hated all dragons and would refuse to share any territory with them .

title: Beholder
description: Beholder A beholder , sometimes called a sphere of many eyes or an eye tyrant , was a large aberration normally found in the Underdark . These large , orb - shaped beings had ten eyestalks and one central eye , each containing powerful magic . Powerful and intelligent , beholders were among the greatest threats to the world .
description_long: Beholder A beholder , sometimes called a sphere of many eyes or an eye tyrant , was a large aberration normally found in the Underdark . These large , orb - shaped beings had ten eyestalks and one central eye , each containing powerful magic . Powerful and intelligent , beholders were among the greatest threats to the world . Description . Beholders were immediately identifiable , being essentially a floating head with one single , cyclops - like eye surrounded by ten smaller eye stalks . Other than this , the main feature of a beholder ' s anatomy was its massive , gaping maw . Because of these features , beholders were occasionally known as " spheres of many eyes " or " eye tyrants , " although the latter also referred to a specific type of beholder . Because their entire body was covered in eyes , beholders had the capacity to see in all directions at once , making it nearly impossible to ambush them while also giving them an unusually high degree of perceptive ability . Although beholders lacked the capacity to see color , they had the ability to perceive even in the most darkened environment , under conditions in which a human or similar creature would be rendered blind .

title: Behroun Marhana
description: Behroun Marhana Behroun Marhana was a lord of the Marhana merchant family . Personality . Behroun was quite charming , when he wanted to be .
description_long: Behroun Marhana Behroun Marhana was a lord of the Marhana merchant family . Personality . Behroun was quite charming , when he wanted to be . Family . Behroun was half brother to Anusha Marhana . Business . Behroun employed both the warlock Japheth Donard and the pirate Aulruick Thoster .

title: Bejung
description: Bejung Bejung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay . History .
description_long: Bejung Bejung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay . History . In ancient times , the area held a city later called Old Bejung . However , with the eruption of the nearby Kanko volcano , it was engulfed in poisonous gas that killed all the people , before the city itself was obliterated in a matter of seconds and buried in ash . Over time , the site of the city was lost . However , by 1357 DR , the location of Old Bejung had been found again . A barbarian called Yuf Bawrax discovered an entrance into the ruins of the city ; he declined to step foot inside , but would show it to others . Locations . There was a tavern called The Sharpening House in Bejung . North of Bejung were farmlands . The wealthy merchant Merquam Pang owned a well - guarded estate here . Rumors . Since Old Bejung had been destroyed and buried so swiftly , many speculated that its treasures had survived and were plentiful , but it was an enormous burial mound to search through .

title: Bel Leos
description: Bel Leos Bel Leos was a hengeyokai in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bel Leos was a hengeyokai working with the Black Leopard Cult in the town of Lenachi in T ' u Lung .
description_long: Bel Leos Bel Leos was a hengeyokai in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bel Leos was a hengeyokai working with the Black Leopard Cult in the town of Lenachi in T ' u Lung . In 1358 DR , he investigated the many local Dragon Claw followers . Eventually , Bel Leos helped the wu jen Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San to escape from the city .

title: Belagon
description: Belagon Belagon was one of the best generals of Mephistopheles . History . In 1484 DR , when Drasek Riven invaded Cania with an army of undead from the Shadowfell , Belagon was one of the generals that led the devil legions to oppose them .
description_long: Belagon Belagon was one of the best generals of Mephistopheles . History . In 1484 DR , when Drasek Riven invaded Cania with an army of undead from the Shadowfell , Belagon was one of the generals that led the devil legions to oppose them . During the battle , in order to lure out Mephistopheles himself , Drasek confronted Belagon and killed him .

title: Belamy Lightfingers
description: Belamy Lightfingers Belamy Lightfingers was a halfling fighter from a strongheart clan in Red larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Belamy and his sister Bryn came from a family of bakers , known for their crumblecake .
description_long: Belamy Lightfingers Belamy Lightfingers was a halfling fighter from a strongheart clan in Red larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Belamy and his sister Bryn came from a family of bakers , known for their crumblecake . When the siblings grew old enough , Belamy decided to leave the family business , making his sister do the same . His time in the adventuring world did not go very well alone , so he decided to gain allies , and in Mirabar he found out about the Order of the Burning Dawn . Intrigued by the idea of using his blade for good and getting paid , he found his sister in the Ardeep Forest , and together they joined the order . In the Order , he might found a potential use for his rage and a surrogate family . Personality . He had the family tendency of a quick temper but also an open mind and curiosity . Appendix . Appearances . Belamy will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Belargh Thulin
description: Belargh Thulin Belargh Thulin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar early in his insurrection . Personality . He was a minor magelord , known for devoting his time to romancing all women who came within range of his eye ( and his magical compulsions ) in rural Ambletrees .
description_long: Belargh Thulin Belargh Thulin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar early in his insurrection . Personality . He was a minor magelord , known for devoting his time to romancing all women who came within range of his eye ( and his magical compulsions ) in rural Ambletrees . History . He was killed by Elminster in 234 DR when he , in the feminine form of Elmara , escaped from Athalantar .

title: Belaur Aumar
description: Belaur Aumar Belaur Aumar was the nominal king of Athalantar , but in truth he was under the power of the magelord s . Finally , he was killed by his nephew , Elminster Aumar . History .
description_long: Belaur Aumar Belaur Aumar was the nominal king of Athalantar , but in truth he was under the power of the magelord s . Finally , he was killed by his nephew , Elminster Aumar . History . Belaur was the oldest son of the Stag King of Athalantar , Uthgrael Aumar . At his father ' s death in 216 DR , he proclaimed himself king ; however , most of his brothers opposed him , starting a civil war . Belaur in the end defeated his brothers with the decisive help of a group of wizard s recruited by him , the magelords . However , the magelords proved themselves more powerful than Belaur and soon assumed control of the kingdom . Thus Belaur ruled in name only , but people considered him responsible for the situation . In 240 DR , his nephew , Elminster Aumar , started an insurrection against the magelords . Elminster killed Belaur .

title: Beldabar Yarryn
description: Beldabar Yarryn Beldabar Yarryn was an innkeeper in Yartar in 1370 DR . history . Once Beldabar was an adventurer , a member of the Hawks of the North .
description_long: Beldabar Yarryn Beldabar Yarryn was an innkeeper in Yartar in 1370 DR . history . Once Beldabar was an adventurer , a member of the Hawks of the North . One day , the Hawks decided to raid Hellgate Keep . Of sixteen members , only three , including Beldabar , survived . They went to Yartar , where they started to run a inn together . Later , the other two went off to adventure again , only to be quickly slaughtered by vengeful agents of Hellgate Keep . Only Beldabar remained alive , thanks to his magical protections in the inn .

title: Beldara Laerune
description: Beldara Laerune Beldara Laerune was a wayward Harper . Activities . Beldara was quite famous for her travels , like the one from Icewind Dale to Halruaa and the one from Nimbral to Sossal .
description_long: Beldara Laerune Beldara Laerune was a wayward Harper . Activities . Beldara was quite famous for her travels , like the one from Icewind Dale to Halruaa and the one from Nimbral to Sossal . She usually preferred to travel with elves or dwarves rather than with human s . She was a terrible cook but could easily read the surrounding area . History . Beldara left her home city of Melvaunt when the Zhentarim rose to power in Zhentil Keep , hoping to find less oppressive areas where she could find inspiration for her music , adventures , and treasures . Beldara found a lot of all three . In 1368 DR , she went missing and in Sembia some said she went inside a " gate " in Myth Drannor .

title: Beldora
description: Beldora Beldora was a secret Harper agent in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Beldora , posing as a homeless waif , gained coins by helping to tend other folk ' s campfires .
description_long: Beldora Beldora was a secret Harper agent in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Beldora , posing as a homeless waif , gained coins by helping to tend other folk ' s campfires . Secretly , she listened to all conversations around the fires and — thanks to a sending stone — once a day reported the relevant ones to her contact Thwip Ironbottom of Hundelstone . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Beldora was at the marketplace when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Beldora liked to tell lies to people , believing that this made life more interesting . However , she wanted to protect poor people .

title: Beldossan
description: Beldossan Beldossan the Short was a human of the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Beldossan was rumored to have dwarven blood , thus the nickname . In the early 7th century , Beldossan assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the elf sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar .
description_long: Beldossan Beldossan the Short was a human of the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Beldossan was rumored to have dwarven blood , thus the nickname . In the early 7th century , Beldossan assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the elf sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .

title: Beldred Truesilver
description: Beldred Truesilver Beldred Truesilver was a knight and a member of the Truesilver noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .
description_long: Beldred Truesilver Beldred Truesilver was a knight and a member of the Truesilver noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . Alusair placed Beldred in charge when she stepped aside to receive a private message ; Beldred sent Threldryn Imbranneth and Brace Skatterhawk to accompany her . But when they sighted the orcs , Beldred and the other knights impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush , and a few were killed . Alusair rallied her forces to defeat the orcs , before deducing they served a dark naga and the Zhentarim , who had been charming and transporting monsters into the area . Beldred was one of those who volunteered to aid Alusair against the naga , but she left him in command of the remaining forces , and he searched the area for more surprises .

title: Beldryn Klynrin
description: Beldryn Klynrin Hammer of the God Beldryn Klynrin was a priest of Tempus from Sembia who traveled often to Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Beldryn Klynrin Hammer of the God Beldryn Klynrin was a priest of Tempus from Sembia who traveled often to Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . Beldryn feared neither man nor beast because he served the Lord of Battles . His nickname was Beldryn the Bold . He did not mince words and did not hesitate to confront anyone about matters of faith and the proper way to worship Tempus . Activities . He traveled often from his base in northern Sembia , passing through Voonlar to check on the local shrine to Tempus , the House of the Helm . Beldryn made it clear to the Bron and his deputies that he would not tolerate any thefts or defacing of the shrine and would hold them responsible if any such acts were discovered . He also had no qualms against confronting agents of the Zhentarim or the Cyric ists from the local temple , the Dark God Reformed , if their machinations ran counter to the well - being of the shrine . When traveling , Beldryn Klynrin was typically accompanied by at least two veteran warrior s and one or more clerics of lower rank .

title: Belhifet
description: Belhifet Belhifet is a Baatezu with twisted horns similar to a kudu . He is the main enemy in the computer role - playing game Icewind Dale as well as , and dual wields falchions in battle against the player . In the events of the Icewind Dale story , Belhifet sought to conquer the home plane from which he was banished .
description_long: Belhifet Belhifet is a Baatezu with twisted horns similar to a kudu . He is the main enemy in the computer role - playing game Icewind Dale as well as , and dual wields falchions in battle against the player . In the events of the Icewind Dale story , Belhifet sought to conquer the home plane from which he was banished . To do this , he required an army . The answer to this lay under the temple of the war god , Tempus , in the town of Easthaven . It was there that long ago , a cleric named Jerrod , sacrificed himself to seal a portal to Baator , creating the landmark of Jerrod ' s stone . So Belhifet decided that his first step of his conquest of the North would be to secure the town of Easthaven , after which he would destroy Jerrod ' s stone and reopen the portal . Doing so would beset devils upon Icewind Dale , and the souls of the humans that would certainly be slain would be recruited into Belhifet ' s army . Disguising himself as Poquelin , a cleric of the god of suffering , Ilmater , Belhifet began a recruitment drive for the army needed to conquer the North .

title: Belhuar Thantarth
description: Belhuar Thantarth Belhuar Thantarth was a Harper and the master of Twilight Hall in Berdusk . Activities . Belhuar spent much of his time residing in Twilight Hall writing letters to fellow Harpers , studying maps , receiving reports , and managed Harper personnel in their operations against evil forces .
description_long: Belhuar Thantarth Belhuar Thantarth was a Harper and the master of Twilight Hall in Berdusk . Activities . Belhuar spent much of his time residing in Twilight Hall writing letters to fellow Harpers , studying maps , receiving reports , and managed Harper personnel in their operations against evil forces . He also spend time with his crew to repair homes near the city . History . In Tarsakh of 1370 DR , he was running the Harper stronghold during the absence of the severely ill Cylyria Dragonbreast when , under the urging of Bran Skorlsun , Belhaur agreed to discuss the evidence that showed Khelben Arunsun was a traitor . The Harpers had discovered that Khelben had been the one who had stolen the " Scepter of the Sorcerer - Kings " , a powerful Netherese artefact thirteen years before from the Catacombs of Ordulin . This artifact had since ended up in the hands of the Zhentarim . Belhuar was one of three Harpers chosen to preside over Khelben ' s trial , along with Obslin Minstrelwish , seneschal of Twilight Hall , and Bran Skorlsun .

title: Belial
description: Belial In name , Fierna rules Phlegethos , commanding the fiery layer from her palace of rock and magma . In truth , her father , Belial , is the power behind the throne . Sequestered away in the central Hall of One Thousand Sighs and Screams , he advises his daughter in the arts of love and pain , taking a personal hand in ensuring she learns all there is to know .
description_long: Belial In name , Fierna rules Phlegethos , commanding the fiery layer from her palace of rock and magma . In truth , her father , Belial , is the power behind the throne . Sequestered away in the central Hall of One Thousand Sighs and Screams , he advises his daughter in the arts of love and pain , taking a personal hand in ensuring she learns all there is to know . Up until now , the situation suited Fierna just fine . But thanks to her flowering relationship with Glasya , she has become more interested in taking Phlegethos in more than just name . No longer is she content to sit idly by and let her father make the decisions . She has even cultivated a few cults on the Prime Material Plane . Fierna ' s newfound ambition concerns Belial , but he has other worries . He had been assembling armies to invade the fifth and sixth layers , confident his forces could overcome those of Levistus and the Hag Countess . But Glasya ' s surprising coup stalled his plans , and now he can ' t move at all , since doing do so would invoke the full force of Asmodeus ' s ire . For now , Belial is content to watch and see what develops with this new player in Hell ' s vicious political game .

title: Beliard
description: Beliard Beliard was a small tree - cloaked village , east of the Stone Bridge . Geography . The village sat at the intersection of the Dessarin Road , Jundar ' s Pass , and the road toward Ironford .
description_long: Beliard Beliard was a small tree - cloaked village , east of the Stone Bridge . Geography . The village sat at the intersection of the Dessarin Road , Jundar ' s Pass , and the road toward Ironford . Atmosphere . A market town for cattle drovers , it was mainly used by the surrounding farmers and ranchers as a place to meet .

title: Believers
description: Believers The Believers was a secret society in Red Larch active until the end of the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Believers wasn ' t exactly a cult , although it had special ceremonies and rites had been passed down for generations , but it also wasn ' t a civic organization , despite the fact that some of the wealthiest and most powerful people in Red Larch were members .
description_long: Believers The Believers was a secret society in Red Larch active until the end of the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Believers wasn ' t exactly a cult , although it had special ceremonies and rites had been passed down for generations , but it also wasn ' t a civic organization , despite the fact that some of the wealthiest and most powerful people in Red Larch were members . The members of the Believers used their secret association to lead the businesses in the village , ruining competitors and sometimes taking care of local troublemakers when they crossed a line . History . The founding of the Believers was connected to the discovery by local miners of a secret underground chamber beneath the town . The miners began using the chamber to honor those who had died in quarry accidents and to appease Beshaba , goddess of misfortune and accidents . The Believers gathered secretly at the tomb once every nine nights to see if any stones had moved ; if any had moved they met again on the next night to discuss what the movements might mean and what was to be done . They kept the tomb and its strange secret to themselves .

title: Belim
description: Belim Belim was a count and later king in Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar started a war against Golconda .
description_long: Belim Belim was a count and later king in Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar started a war against Golconda . In 1358 during a king war council the spymaster Boubakar reported that one of his men had discovered that the battle plans of Hetep were hid in the small keep of Fort Blood . Belim no trusted Boubakar ' s words . However convinced by Boubakar ' s argumentations and despite Belim ' s objections King Samakay hired an adventuring party well - known to him to resolve the matter . However Belim had no intentions to change his mind and lead a small army of his retainers to attack the adventurers before they arrive to Fort Blood in order to stop them . His plan was capture and took them to his castle . After the improvvise death of king Samakay without heir Belim was one of the the two only possible candidates to the throne , the other being Baron Asakia . However neither Belim or Asakia had the necessary numbers of three - quarters of the noble heads of household need to be elected and Belim refused any compromises .

title: Belinda Heavensbow
description: Belinda Heavensbow Belinda Heavensbow was a former member of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . She was the best friend of Aleina Brightlance .
description_long: Belinda Heavensbow Belinda Heavensbow was a former member of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . She was the best friend of Aleina Brightlance . History . Belinda enrolled in the Knights in Silver together with Aleina . They rose through the ranks together until Belinda quit in order to help her father in their archers ' shop . They remained friends however . In 1485 DR , Belinda was the first to welcome Aleina back to the city , after believing her dead at the fall of Sundabar . Aleina explained all her adventures to her friend , including her sexual relations with the reborn Wulfgar .

title: Beliot Sevenecho
description: Beliot Sevenecho Beliot Sevenecho , or Beliost Sevenecho , was a human man of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . He was patriarch of the Sevenecho family and innkeeper of The Worried Wyvern inn in the late 1360s DR . History .
description_long: Beliot Sevenecho Beliot Sevenecho , or Beliost Sevenecho , was a human man of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . He was patriarch of the Sevenecho family and innkeeper of The Worried Wyvern inn in the late 1360s DR . History . Beliot was a member of the Sevenecho family of the hamlet of Sevenecho , which was named for the family . As a young man , he took to the path of an adventurer , but later returned to Sevenecho for a quieter life . In time , he became patriarch of the family and proprietor of the family - run inn . In the Year of the Crown , 1351 DR , Beliot re - founded the family ' s inn , The Wandering Wyvern , and renamed it The Worried Wyvern . In his time , Beliot had two wives and eleven sons . His second wife died in the late 1350s DR and he chose not to remarry . Instead , by 1370 DR , he was having romantic relationships with four of his chambermaids : Mreeiel Klintar , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , Chyndrie Stormwind , and Noelin Tlestlin . However , the women got along well with another , and commonly called Beliot " the chief adventurer in our band " .

title: Belisarius
description: Belisarius Belisarius is a powerful mage , who resides in Carradoon , at the foot of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . The mage has bushy brows and a similarly bushy , graying beard and wears a floppy , woolen cap atop his wiry stature .
description_long: Belisarius Belisarius is a powerful mage , who resides in Carradoon , at the foot of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . The mage has bushy brows and a similarly bushy , graying beard and wears a floppy , woolen cap atop his wiry stature . History . Belisarius prefers a life in solitude , tending with hermitlike devotion to his magical studies in order to perfect his craft . Abilities . Belisarius uses his magic primarily for illusionary dweomers , which he is quite adept at . He can detect magical eminations from objects and discern their magical abilities . One of his other talents is to enchant objects such as weapons bestowing them for example with greater distructive qualities , as he once did with Cadderly Bonaduce s walking stick . Belisarius ' Tower . The mage ' s tower stands on a round , steep - sided hillock , southwest of Carradoon . Like every eccentric wizard , Belisarius created some " inconveniences " for any trespasser or possible guest . The Missing Stairway . There are no obvious stairs that would allow an easy climb of the steep sides of the hill .

title: Beljuril
description: Beljuril Beljurils , also known as fireflashils , were gemstones unique to the Realms . They were a deep seawater green and all known specimens were roughly the size of a human fist and not quite spherical . About once every hour ( rates vary from stone to stone ) a beljuril would absorb an undetectable amount of energy from within a thirty foot ( ten meter ) radius and re - emit that energy as a " flash " of sparkling light without heat , sound , or electrical discharge .
description_long: Beljuril Beljurils , also known as fireflashils , were gemstones unique to the Realms . They were a deep seawater green and all known specimens were roughly the size of a human fist and not quite spherical . About once every hour ( rates vary from stone to stone ) a beljuril would absorb an undetectable amount of energy from within a thirty foot ( ten meter ) radius and re - emit that energy as a " flash " of sparkling light without heat , sound , or electrical discharge . The light produced was easily noticeable when the ambient light was dim ( candlelight or lantern light ) and in the dark it was dazzling to the eye . Beljurils were very difficult to cut with metal tools and the stone was very durable . They were sometimes claw - mounted to shoulder - plates or worn in a pectoral , or used as decorative lighting or beacons by the wealthy . They were found in ancient rock , usually blue claystone . The Lichdrow Dyrr used a beljuril for his phylactery .

title: Bell Market
description: Bell Market The Bell Market was , as of 1374 DR , a market at the center of Everlund , with broad streets leading from it to the various city gates . It took its name from its huge bell , hanging in an open space next to the city barracks , used to warn of incoming attacks . The market ' s opening hours were between one hour after dawn and one hour prior to dusk .
description_long: Bell Market The Bell Market was , as of 1374 DR , a market at the center of Everlund , with broad streets leading from it to the various city gates . It took its name from its huge bell , hanging in an open space next to the city barracks , used to warn of incoming attacks . The market ' s opening hours were between one hour after dawn and one hour prior to dusk . The market contained open - air stalls offering baked and fresh produce , livestock and poultry ; and permanent stalls offering manufactured goods . The market was surrounded by shops selling trade goods and services .

title: Bell Tower
description: Bell Tower The Bell Tower served as an alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The tower stood in the southwest corner of the city .
description_long: Bell Tower The Bell Tower served as an alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The tower stood in the southwest corner of the city . This tower was much smaller and less elaborate than the Drum Tower . Activities . The Bell Tower only served to warn the residents of Manass of fires . Though all of the buildings in Manass were made from stone or brick , each household stored their firewood on the roof , increasing the potential for dangerous fire to occur .

title: Bell in the Depths
description: Bell in the Depths The Bell in the Depths was one of the great mysterious sites in the Moonsea area . It was connected with legendary Northkeep , an island kingdom that was the first human citadel on the Moonsea . Northkeep was a great and magical city , and it was while under the protection of those magics that humanity began to press back the orc hordes and take command of the sea .
description_long: Bell in the Depths The Bell in the Depths was one of the great mysterious sites in the Moonsea area . It was connected with legendary Northkeep , an island kingdom that was the first human citadel on the Moonsea . Northkeep was a great and magical city , and it was while under the protection of those magics that humanity began to press back the orc hordes and take command of the sea . The power of Northkeep made it an obvious target for orcs , giants , and other evil races . However , these creatures were not inclined toward sea action , until the day when ( according to legend ) 40 , 000 inhuman mage s , shaman s , witch doctors , and priest s of all foul races gathered on the northern shore of the Moonsea , and began to chant , bringing the vengeance of their gods down upon the human interlopers . Their gods ( at least some of them ) came and destroyed their priests for disturbing them , but they also sank Northkeep beneath the waves . The upper reaches of Northkeep — its slender , now - broken spires — could be seen beneath the water by boats that sailed near by .

title: Bella don Delroy Harpell
description: Bella don Delroy Harpell Bella don Delroy Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and daughter of spokesman Delroy Harpell of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Description . Beautiful Bella was short ( barely five feet ) with one bright green eye and one dull green eye that looked in different directions .
description_long: Bella don Delroy Harpell Bella don Delroy Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and daughter of spokesman Delroy Harpell of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Description . Beautiful Bella was short ( barely five feet ) with one bright green eye and one dull green eye that looked in different directions . History . In 1358 DR , Bella journeyed with Harkle , Regweld , and Bidderdoo Harpell to help defend Mithral Hall .

title: Bellany Tundash
description: Bellany Tundash Bellany is a wizard who worked for the famous pirate Sheila Kree . She was one of her more trusted lieutenants . She is Morik the Rogue ' s lover .
description_long: Bellany Tundash Bellany is a wizard who worked for the famous pirate Sheila Kree . She was one of her more trusted lieutenants . She is Morik the Rogue ' s lover . Role in the Story . Bellany appears in Sea of Swords ( novel ) as Sheila Kree ' s ship wizard . After Kree is warned of a certain drow elf that is going to go after her she sends Bellany to get information about the previous owner of Aegis - Fang , Wulfgar . Bellany does so going to Luskan and asking Morik the Rogue , an old lover from back when she was an apprentice . She learns Morik has been visited by Drizzt , so she takes him with her to Sheila so her captain can interrogate him further . While the pirates stay in their hideout Bellany becomes Morik ' s lover once again . When the Companions of the Hall storm the place she decides not to kill Regis when she has the opportunity to do so . She is then saved from being killed thanks to Morik , who saved Wulfgar ' s life , interceding on her behalf . After Kree , her pirates and their ogre associates die she goes back to Luskan and lives with Morik there . She joins the Host Tower of the Arcane , where she is placed among the lowliest members .

title: Bellas ' s Band
description: Bellas ' s Band Bellas ' s Band was an adventuring company led by Bellas Thanatar that operated in the Vast in the 1330s DR . They later ruled the city of Calaunt as Supreme Scepter and Merchant Duke s . History .
description_long: Bellas ' s Band Bellas ' s Band was an adventuring company led by Bellas Thanatar that operated in the Vast in the 1330s DR . They later ruled the city of Calaunt as Supreme Scepter and Merchant Duke s . History . Bellas ' s Band was an adventuring company led by and named for Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while his followers each took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . They became tyrants who ruled by fear and robbing their people . Base . After taking over Calaunt , Bellas ' s Band based themselves in around the Fortress of the Five Vultures . Activities . In all decisions on major policies , each duke had one vote while Bellas had two . Nevertheless , the Dukes wielded significant power . Members . The members of Bellas ' s Band were :

title: Bellas Thanatar
description: Bellas Thanatar Bellas Thanatar was a human man and Supreme Scepter of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Bellas was formerly an adventurer and leader of Bellas ' s Band .
description_long: Bellas Thanatar Bellas Thanatar was a human man and Supreme Scepter of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Bellas was formerly an adventurer and leader of Bellas ' s Band . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while his followers each took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . Activities . In all decisions on major policies , Bellas had two votes , while each of the dukes had only one vote . Bellas and the rest of his cronies often confiscated property and magic from visitors to Calaunt , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power . They acquired a large collection of magical item s this way , and still sought more . Bellas in particular was known to possess great many magical weapons and items of protection . Bellas lived in the Keep of the Scepter in the Fortress of the Five Vultures .

title: Belleethe Kheldorna
description: Belleethe Kheldorna Belleethe Kheldorna was the Waterbaron of the city of Yartar . Activities . With justice and fairness , Belleethe oversaw the trade within her city .
description_long: Belleethe Kheldorna Belleethe Kheldorna was the Waterbaron of the city of Yartar . Activities . With justice and fairness , Belleethe oversaw the trade within her city . She also enforced the law of the land , dedicating herself to the protection of the worshipers of Tymora along with routing foreign agents from the city . These agents hailed from such groups as the Kraken Society , the Zhentarim , the Cult of the Dragon , and those from Thay . Personality . With a stern personality and a quick mind , Belleethe was an astute judge of character . She even impressed the local Uthgardt barbarian tribes so much that they began to take a second look at civilization . History . Belleethe was trained and schooled in Neverwinter , even learning a little from Piergeiron of Waterdeep . She was put forth as a candidate for the position of Waterbaron by the Lords ' Alliance , after the death of the previous Waterbaron .

title: Belmourn
description: Belmourn Belmoun was a cook in Yulash . Activities . Belmoun , together with Jamrry and Otiben , managed the chickens at the Red Plumes camp in Yulash .
description_long: Belmourn Belmoun was a cook in Yulash . Activities . Belmoun , together with Jamrry and Otiben , managed the chickens at the Red Plumes camp in Yulash . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , during the visit of Torin Nomerthal to the city , Belmourn possibly helped to overthrow the First Lord . Personality . Thank to his cousin , Belmourn was sympathetic to non - human s and helped them if he could . Relationship . Belmourn was cousin to the half - elf Constance Goodroot .

title: Belmuth Obarskyr
description: Belmuth Obarskyr Belmuth " the Bastard " was a king of Cormyr . He took the throne after his stepnephew Baerildo Obarskyr , who was only an infant , was slain by Gorauna . Belmuth ' s reign likewise ended because of his death in Gorauna ' s Purplethroat Plague , and his son Sargrannon succeeded him .
description_long: Belmuth Obarskyr Belmuth " the Bastard " was a king of Cormyr . He took the throne after his stepnephew Baerildo Obarskyr , who was only an infant , was slain by Gorauna . Belmuth ' s reign likewise ended because of his death in Gorauna ' s Purplethroat Plague , and his son Sargrannon succeeded him .

title: Belorgan
description: Belorgan Belorgan is a noble house of Cormyr . family head is the Earl of Wyvernshores , the farmland along the southeastern coast of the Wyvernwater . The Belorgan estates are called Mossfarms .
description_long: Belorgan Belorgan is a noble house of Cormyr . family head is the Earl of Wyvernshores , the farmland along the southeastern coast of the Wyvernwater . The Belorgan estates are called Mossfarms . The courtesy titles of Baron of Lowbridge ( a village ) and Baron of Mossfarms ( the Belorgan estates ) are unused but held by Harlo in case he has additional children . Windkeep and Fallturret are the names of the two castles owned by the Belorgans . The titles Baron of Windkeep and baron of Fallturret are additional titles held in reserve by the Belorgans , after the two Belorgan castles . Family Members Recently Alive . Raedlar Belorgan , one of five young men who attempted to assassinate Princess Tanalasta during the Abraxus Affair in 1369 DR and was killed in the attempt , rumored to have Raedlar , was titled Baron of Forgemarket ( a market crossroads in the Wyvernshores countryside ) .

title: Beloved of Lurue
description: Beloved of Lurue The beloved of Lurue are forest - living maidens who forever forswear mortal love to follow the unicorn deity Lurue , forming a close bond with unicorn s . Background .
