The beloved of Lurue come from all walks of life , but share two major characteristics : all are champions of good , and all are mortal women who have forsworn mortal men .
description_long: Beloved of Lurue The beloved of Lurue are forest - living maidens who forever forswear mortal love to follow the unicorn deity Lurue , forming a close bond with unicorn s . Background . The beloved of Lurue come from all walks of life , but share two major characteristics : all are champions of good , and all are mortal women who have forsworn mortal men . Most often they were exalted ranger s or druid s , given those classes ' inborn affinity to nature , but paladin s and even fighter s have also been known to take this class . Though there are no racial restrictions , most beloved of Lurue are human s , elves , and half - elves . Beloved of Lurue are solitary and shun civilization . They create for themselves a forest refuge and maintain few contacts with the outside world , much like druids . Woe betide the evildoer who comes too close to this refuge , for the beloved is a combatant on par with the paladin , and has a smattering of other abilities including the ability to call upon animal allies , particularly a unicorn .

title: Belpheron
description: Belpheron Belpheron was an ancient and powerful lich who once tried to destroy Faerûn , and the mentor of Heurodis . Belpheron ' s mummified hand somehow ended up in the posession of the Harpers , who gave it to Drogan Droganson for safekeeping . The hand was stolen from Droganson by a band of kobold s for the dragon Tymofarrar .
description_long: Belpheron Belpheron was an ancient and powerful lich who once tried to destroy Faerûn , and the mentor of Heurodis . Belpheron ' s mummified hand somehow ended up in the posession of the Harpers , who gave it to Drogan Droganson for safekeeping . The hand was stolen from Droganson by a band of kobold s for the dragon Tymofarrar . A resident of Cania , Belpheron aided Grimgnaw in his fight against Drogan Droganson ' s pupil .

title: Belprin ' s Hold
description: Belprin ' s Hold Belprin ' s Hold was an abandoned keep of human origin located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Inhabitants . As of 1479 DR , Belprin ' s Hold was home to fearsome monsters that preyed upon the outlaws who sought the keep as a haven , or the treasure - seekers who went to Belprin ' s Hold in search of its fabled hoards .
description_long: Belprin ' s Hold Belprin ' s Hold was an abandoned keep of human origin located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Inhabitants . As of 1479 DR , Belprin ' s Hold was home to fearsome monsters that preyed upon the outlaws who sought the keep as a haven , or the treasure - seekers who went to Belprin ' s Hold in search of its fabled hoards . History . Belprin ' s Hold was named after a legendary outlaw who led a small band of brigands and stole untold wealth from Eskonar citizens in ages past . Many criminals and treasure - seekers had inhabited the keep over the years , and tales of hidden treasures in Belprin ' s Hold were common in Eskorn .

title: Belshazu
description: Belshazu Belshazu was a glabrezu and the father of the draegloth Jeggred Baenre . Description . Belshazu was a glabrezu , so he had four arms ( two with pincers ) and a dog - like head .
description_long: Belshazu Belshazu was a glabrezu and the father of the draegloth Jeggred Baenre . Description . Belshazu was a glabrezu , so he had four arms ( two with pincers ) and a dog - like head . He was black and had yellow fangs with violet eyes . History . Belshazu was summoned to the material plane in 1372 DR by the wizard Pharaun Mizzrym . He and his group , led by Quenthel Baenre , wanted to know a way to get to the Demonweb Pits . Pharaun tricked the demon with a pool of frozen water instead of a summoning circle . Belshazu had to cut off his leg and leave it in the material plane to escape . He tried to get his revenge when the wizard and his group traveled to the Abyss . However , he was ultimately slain by Pharaun with a " wail of the banshee " spell . Possessions . Belshazu possessed a " ring of flying " , which Pharaun took from him upon his death to replace the magical rapier ring that Belshazu had destroyed . Relationships . Triel Baenre mated with Belshazu in a Lolth - sanctioned ritual and subsequently bore the draegloth Jeggred Baenre , who was viewed as a sign of the goddess ' s favor .

title: Belt
description: Belt Belt was one of the Grand Duke s during the years immediately following the Time of Troubles and a member of the Council of Four , the rulers of the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Baldurs Gate 2 Tutorial . Belt appears as the instructor for the tutorial for Baldurs gate 2 with a host of other characters that don ' t appear in the main story like Xan and Branwen .
description_long: Belt Belt was one of the Grand Duke s during the years immediately following the Time of Troubles and a member of the Council of Four , the rulers of the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Baldurs Gate 2 Tutorial . Belt appears as the instructor for the tutorial for Baldurs gate 2 with a host of other characters that don ' t appear in the main story like Xan and Branwen .

title: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
description: Belt of Storm Giant Strength The Belt of Storm Giant Strength is a great and decorated girdle with a silver buckle set with crossed lightning bolts . It imbues its wearer with the strength of a giant , the greatest of which were the Storm giant s that throw lightning bolts across mountain peaks . The belt enacts its magic when being tightened notch by notch .

It imbues its wearer with the strength of a giant , the greatest of which were the Storm giant s that throw lightning bolts across mountain peaks . The belt enacts its magic when being tightened notch by notch .

title: Belt of priestly might
description: Belt of priestly might Belts of priestly might were defensive magical items , created by servants of a given deity , that boosted the wearer ' s strength and natural defenses . They were normally named for their faith of origin ( e . g .
description_long: Belt of priestly might Belts of priestly might were defensive magical items , created by servants of a given deity , that boosted the wearer ' s strength and natural defenses . They were normally named for their faith of origin ( e . g . " Mystran belt of priestly might " ) ) . History . The first " belts of priestly might " appeared in Halruaa at the end of the Godswar ; the Halruaans took this as a sign that Mystra had returned . Appearance . " Belts of priestly might " were made of broad leather , and featured a stamp of a deity ' s holy symbol on the front . Creation . To manufacture " belts of priestly might " , an arcane spellcaster or divine spellcaster had to know both " barkskin " and " bull ' s strength " . They were created by many different faiths , and could only be worn safely by persons who were either of that deity ' s [ [ alignment ] , ] or had that deity as a patron . Sources . [ [ Category : Belts | Priestly might ] ] [ [ Category : Magic items ] ] [ [ Category : 40000 - 49999 gold pieces ] ]

title: Beltyn ' s burning blood
description: Beltyn ' s burning blood Beltyn ' s burning blood was a necromancy spell that ignited blood flowing out of open wounds , causing additional damage due to fire . Effects . The target of this spell was one creature that had open , bleeding wounds caused by an edged weapon or similar means ( wounds from blunt weapons or those that had been dressed or healed did not produce enough blood ) .
description_long: Beltyn ' s burning blood Beltyn ' s burning blood was a necromancy spell that ignited blood flowing out of open wounds , causing additional damage due to fire . Effects . The target of this spell was one creature that had open , bleeding wounds caused by an edged weapon or similar means ( wounds from blunt weapons or those that had been dressed or healed did not produce enough blood ) . The range of this spell was 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) per experience level of the caster , and it did not require line of sight to the target . The target had to have blood ( undead , elemental s , " etc . " were immune ) and not be impervious to fire . The burning lasted for three minutes and the victim had three chances to resist before the flames dissipated . " Beltyn ' s burning blood " could not be cast into the ethereal plane from the Prime Material Plane , but creatures that changed shape to hide wounds , or that melded with objects , such as trees or stones , could still be the target of this spell and suffer its effects . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a creature with open , bleeding wounds and a pinch of saltpeter . History .

title: Beluar
description: Beluar Beluar was an elven man and a heroic warrior of the Vast in the 7th century DR . He won a famous victory against an orc army to help save the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar . History .
description_long: Beluar Beluar was an elven man and a heroic warrior of the Vast in the 7th century DR . He won a famous victory against an orc army to help save the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar . History . The fall of Roldilar . In the the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR , hordes of orcs engulfed the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar in the lands later known as the Vast . Roldilar , fortunately , was aided by its human and elven allies , who would save the dwarves from extinction . One such ally was Beluar , who helped the dwarves in their fight against the orcs . That year , Deep King Tuir Stonebeard led the dwarven armies against those of the orcs and goblin s , but they were defeated at Viperstongue Ford over the River Vesper . Roldilar ' s defenses were broken , and the dwarves retreated to Mount Grimmerfang , ending ultimately in the fall of Roldilar . However , this fall was delayed thanks to the efforts of Beluar and his forces . They fought the orcs at Viperstongue Ford and were victorious , forcing the enemy into a rout . They then pursued the orcs north into an area of rolling , rugged hills , and won another victory against them there .

title: Beluar ' s Hunt
description: Beluar ' s Hunt Beluar ' s Hunt , or simply the Hunt , was a series of hills found in the north of the Vast , lying west of the North Road between Kurth and Maskyr ' s Eye , and extending southwest of Kurth . Geography . Beluar ' s Hunt was a series of rolling , drumlin hills .
description_long: Beluar ' s Hunt Beluar ' s Hunt , or simply the Hunt , was a series of hills found in the north of the Vast , lying west of the North Road between Kurth and Maskyr ' s Eye , and extending southwest of Kurth . Geography . Beluar ' s Hunt was a series of rolling , drumlin hills . They were rugged and a grassy , described as a wasteland . Wild horse s wandered the hills . History . In the the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR , as hordes of orcs engulfed the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar , the elven warrior Beluar and his forces pursued an orc army routed at Viperstongue Ford into these hills , and won another battle against them there . The hills became known as Beluar ' s Hunt to commemorate the victory . Sometime around 1350 DR , the Cult of the Dragon launched an expedition into Beluar ' s Hunt . They excavated a hill around some likely ruins of old pillars , apparently took away some treasures , and discovered an ancient tomb , which they then opened . Then a powerful lich with the antlers of a stag upon its skull emerged to slaughter them with its magic , rending their bodies with phantom claws .

title: Beluir
description: Beluir Beluir was the largest city ( usually considered the capital ) of the halfling realm of Luiren it also housed foreign dignitaries . Its was also known for having the largest Yondalla temple in Luiren , and so also the home of the Devout Voice of Yondalla . Geography .
description_long: Beluir Beluir was the largest city ( usually considered the capital ) of the halfling realm of Luiren it also housed foreign dignitaries . Its was also known for having the largest Yondalla temple in Luiren , and so also the home of the Devout Voice of Yondalla . Geography . Beluir was located on the shore of Luirenstrand Bay in the Great Sea . History . Beluir was established by Halflings in 14 DR . In 1105 DR , a powerful storm from the Great Sea destroyed most of the city , but it was rebuilt . Defence . The city is well defended by about a cohort of marchwardens as well as a large group of militia . The marchswardens would use skirmishing tactics to surround and ultimately destroy a besieging army . The Mayor of the town is known to have slain two Hill giant s on his own , they may have been drunk but he ' s still a fighter of renown . There was a network of portals leading to the temple of Sheela Peryroyl from all over the country that had a garrison of fighters and priests . There where a order of swaying Halflings calling them self ' s Hin blades of Brandobaris that were based in the city . These trouble coursers came out to defend the realm when ever needed . Resources .

title: Belwar Dissengulp
description: Belwar Dissengulp Belwar Dissengulp was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone and was known in the city of Blingdenstone as the " Most Honorable Burrow Warden " . Description . Belwar Dissengulp was a stout barrel - chested gnome with a deep voice .
description_long: Belwar Dissengulp Belwar Dissengulp was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone and was known in the city of Blingdenstone as the " Most Honorable Burrow Warden " . Description . Belwar Dissengulp was a stout barrel - chested gnome with a deep voice . After Belwar ' s hands were cut off , his people grafted enchanted weapons on each arm instead of hands , one being a pick - axe and the other a hammer . Possessions . His enchanted " hands " were activated by an incantation followed by the command word of " Bivrip " which allowed him to cast several spells , such as determining the thickness of stone or causing his weapons to buzz in order to mine . History . Belwar was with a mining party near Menzoberranzan when a drow patrol , led by Dinin and Drizzt Do ' Urden , attacked . Every svirfneblin was killed , except for Belwar , who was allowed to live and return to Blingdenstone through Drizzt ' s mercy , though Dinin had Belwar ' s hands cut off . The encounter proved humiliating to Belwar who never went on another mining expedition after the incident , blaming himself for the death of his fellow svirfneblin .

title: Belween
description: Belween Belween was the second bastard son of Berellip Xorlarrin . History . In 1484 DR , in preparation for the drow war against the Silver Marches , Belween , under the orders of Tiago Baenre and Ravel Xorlarrin , disguised himself as the orc prince Lorgru , who had been kidnapped previously .
description_long: Belween Belween was the second bastard son of Berellip Xorlarrin . History . In 1484 DR , in preparation for the drow war against the Silver Marches , Belween , under the orders of Tiago Baenre and Ravel Xorlarrin , disguised himself as the orc prince Lorgru , who had been kidnapped previously . So disguised , Belween killed the king of Many - Arrows , Obould .

title: Ben
description: Ben Ben , or Ben the Brewer was a herbalist living on the outskirts of Luskan . History . While working as healer for the farmers of Luskan , Ben was called by Meg to heal the poisoned Dahlia Sin ' felle , injured by a poisoned attack from Beniago of Ship Kurth .
description_long: Ben Ben , or Ben the Brewer was a herbalist living on the outskirts of Luskan . History . While working as healer for the farmers of Luskan , Ben was called by Meg to heal the poisoned Dahlia Sin ' felle , injured by a poisoned attack from Beniago of Ship Kurth .

title: Benchi
description: Benchi Benchi was a boatman on the Fenghsintzu river in T ' u Lung . History . Benchi was orphaned at very young age and sold to No Koni Wa , a old kensai uncle of the famous kensai master To Jano .
description_long: Benchi Benchi was a boatman on the Fenghsintzu river in T ' u Lung . History . Benchi was orphaned at very young age and sold to No Koni Wa , a old kensai uncle of the famous kensai master To Jano . To Jano taught Benchi the art of the sword . After the death of his master , Benchi wandered the countryside as a sellsword , becoming quite famous . Around 1357 DR , he grow bored of this life and bought a ship to ferry inhabitants of the ferry - keep of Bex Yr across the wide Fenghsintzu at Shosun . Poling was a good exercise and his sword saved his passengers many times from thieves and pirates . These exploits and his reputation as a honest man founded many tales about the kensai ferry - keep .

title: Bendekik
description: Bendekik Bendekik was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Bendekik was the high priest of the city until 1371 DR , the year of a drow attack .
description_long: Bendekik Bendekik was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Bendekik was the high priest of the city until 1371 DR , the year of a drow attack . Bendekik remained in the city and made a curse that no drow be able to use the power of the earth . During the fighting , he killed seven drow warriors before he died . In 1479 DR , his assistant Pingtu was back in the city and was the new head priest . Bendekik somehow manifested to him and explained how to end the curse . With the help of an adventuring party hired by Kargien Dissengulp , Pingtu followed the instructions and the curse disappeared .

title: Beniago
description: Beniago Beniago was a lieutenant and later the captain of Ship Kurth in Luskan . In reality he was a drow under the guise of a human who was a high - ranking lieutenant for Bregan D ' aerthe . Description .
description_long: Beniago Beniago was a lieutenant and later the captain of Ship Kurth in Luskan . In reality he was a drow under the guise of a human who was a high - ranking lieutenant for Bregan D ' aerthe . Description . In human form , Beniago appeared as a tall red - haired man . His human disguise did not age ( wizards had told him it would be too difficult ) , so he told others he was a half - elf so that they did not get suspicious about his longevity or unchanged appearance . By 1484 DR , Beniago claimed to be more comfortable in his human form than in his natural drow form . History . Beniago was previously a member of House Baenre . The father of his cousin Tiago Baenre betrayed him , forcing him to join Bregan D ' aerthe . In 1463 DR , he was the highest - ranking agent of Bregan D ' aerthe , only under Jarlaxle , Kimmuriel Oblodra , and Valas Hune . Luskan was considered his territory . In 1463 DR , Beniago was second to Luskan ' s High Captain Kurth . However , at some point prior to 1483 DR , he ascended to become High Captain Beniago Kurth , the most powerful of the five High Captains .

title: Benitus
description: Benitus Brother Benitus was a male human and a Cleric of Helm . He was a prelate of the Golden Fortress in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard He , along with younger priests of each faith , oversaw the chapels to Helm , Tempus , Torm , and Tyr that existed within the Golden Fortress .
description_long: Benitus Brother Benitus was a male human and a Cleric of Helm . He was a prelate of the Golden Fortress in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard He , along with younger priests of each faith , oversaw the chapels to Helm , Tempus , Torm , and Tyr that existed within the Golden Fortress .

title: Benji Sadira
description: Benji Sadira Benji Sadira was a simple innkeeper living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Benji ' s inn , the House of Safe Rest , lived up to its name since it was one of the safest places to stay within the often treacherous Harbor District .
description_long: Benji Sadira Benji Sadira was a simple innkeeper living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Benji ' s inn , the House of Safe Rest , lived up to its name since it was one of the safest places to stay within the often treacherous Harbor District .

title: Benju Matsumoto
description: Benju Matsumoto Benju Matsumoto was the daimyo of the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Benju cared very much about his family , although in his youth he liked to take the most dangerous missions .
description_long: Benju Matsumoto Benju Matsumoto was the daimyo of the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Benju cared very much about his family , although in his youth he liked to take the most dangerous missions . He loved music . Activities . Benju was the daimyo of Aru . His hobby was acting in noh plays with his right - hand man Yuji Takaesu . History . Benju rose through the ranks in the shogun ' s army until around 1346 DR , when his valor permitted him to become the daimyo of his home city of Aru . In 1358 DR , he hired an adventuring party in order to stop the killings of pilgrims going to the local Shining Temple of Bishamon .

title: Bennesey
description: Bennesey Bennesey ( known as Old Bennesey ) was a Sembia n who was alive around 1188 DR . He participated in the discussions with King Pryntaler Obarskyr in an attempt to acquire the city of Marsember . The others in his group were Kodlos Homfast , Lady Threnka and Jollitha Par .
description_long: Bennesey Bennesey ( known as Old Bennesey ) was a Sembia n who was alive around 1188 DR . He participated in the discussions with King Pryntaler Obarskyr in an attempt to acquire the city of Marsember . The others in his group were Kodlos Homfast , Lady Threnka and Jollitha Par .

title: Benson Delmo
description: Benson Delmo Benson Delmo was the mayor of Maldobar in 1340 DR . Description . Delmo was " obese " and cheerful .
description_long: Benson Delmo Benson Delmo was the mayor of Maldobar in 1340 DR . Description . Delmo was " obese " and cheerful . History . In 1340 DR , the Thistledown family of Maldobar was murdered . It was believed that the drow Drizzt Do ' Urden had done the deed ( when in fact Ulgulu had done it ) . Delmo was pressured by Roddy McGristle to offer a reward of 2 , 000 gold piece s for the head of the drow .

title: Bent Mermaid Inn
description: Bent Mermaid Inn The Bent Mermaid Inn was an inn at the edge of Tidetown in Westgate which was a hangout for pirates and other assorted trash . Structure . The inn was best known for a figurehead of a bent - over mermaid out the front of the establishment .
description_long: Bent Mermaid Inn The Bent Mermaid Inn was an inn at the edge of Tidetown in Westgate which was a hangout for pirates and other assorted trash . Structure . The inn was best known for a figurehead of a bent - over mermaid out the front of the establishment .

title: Bentley Mirrorshade
description: Bentley Mirrorshade Bentey Mirrorshade was an industrious gnome illusionist who ran the Friendly Arm Inn . Description . Bentley had curly hair and a very large nose .
description_long: Bentley Mirrorshade Bentey Mirrorshade was an industrious gnome illusionist who ran the Friendly Arm Inn . Description . Bentley had curly hair and a very large nose . Personality . Always clever and alert , Bentley had a habit of humming when in deep thought and scratching his very large nose when concerned . Possessions . Bentley was never short of money and it was rumored he had a portal nearby that led to an unknown location . History . In 1346 DR , Bentley abandoned his life as an adventurer to run the Friendly Arm Inn after he and his comrades cleared it out . Appearances . Bentley was concerned about the iron shortage around the Sword Coast .

title: Beorg
description: Beorg Beorg was the king of the Tribe of the Wolf . History . Beorg was the strongest Reghedman warrior and the most powerful king alongside Heafstaag .
description_long: Beorg Beorg was the king of the Tribe of the Wolf . History . Beorg was the strongest Reghedman warrior and the most powerful king alongside Heafstaag . He allied with Heafstaag and the traitor DeBernezan to unite all the tribes in an attack against the Ten Towns in 1351 DR . However , thanks to the scouting of Drizzt Do ' Urden , the men of Icewind Dale were ready for the battle . Beorg was killed in the fighting . His tribe suffered the most deaths and soon lost much of its influence , becoming a minor tribe .

title: Beornegar
description: Beornegar Beornegar was a well - respected member of the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) but was killed in a battle with another Reghedman barbarian tribe . Relationships . Beornegar was the son of Beorne .
description_long: Beornegar Beornegar was a well - respected member of the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) but was killed in a battle with another Reghedman barbarian tribe . Relationships . Beornegar was the son of Beorne . Beornegar was the father of Wulfgar , who , after the Reghedmen attempted to destroy Ten - Towns , was placed under indentured servitude by Bruenor . Despite promising to kill the dwarf , Wulfgar began to see Bruenor as a father figure , not to replace Beornegar , but in addition to him . . Beornegar ' s tales of Icingdeath and his discovery of an entrance into the dragon ' s lair led Wulfgar to defeat the dragon as a coming - of - age rite . After Delly Curtie died , it was Wulfar ' s memories of Beornegar that prompted him to return to Icewind Dale . Most of his friends realized his plans before Wulfgar told of them since he had started referring to himself as " son of Beornegar , " a title which he had not used for quite some time . Beornegar and Revjak were close friends during their lives .

title: Beorunna ' s Well
description: Beorunna ' s Well Beorunna ' s Well was a large settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Lion Tribe . Description . Members of the tribe lived in modest houses around the deep pit that once contained the ancestral mound .
description_long: Beorunna ' s Well Beorunna ' s Well was a large settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Lion Tribe . Description . Members of the tribe lived in modest houses around the deep pit that once contained the ancestral mound . At the bottom of the pit dwelt Underdark monsters that the barbarians feared . The Black Lion tribe forsook their nomadic habits and settled in a small , roughly built town surrounded by a stockade , where they traded timber , furs , and smoked meat . The Red Tigers held a different opinion about living like the southern folk and often resolved their disputes in duels to the death . Traders and merchants were welcome , though the journey there was full of dangers . Relationships . The town often traded with the dwarves of Citadel Felbarr , to whom they were connected by a trade route . History . Legend says that Beorunna , the father of Uthgar , defeated the demon Zukothoth at the ancestral mound , causing it to sink into the earth . In 1372 DR , the Uthgardt tribes of Black Lion and Red Tiger both considered Beorunna ' s Well their ancestral mound .

title: Beorunna ' s cure - all
description: Beorunna ' s cure - all Beorunna ' s cure - all was the name of a highly - prized plant found in the Savage Frontier . When its stem was boiled in a tea , drinking the resulting concoction would result in a general restorative effect that , when combined with an attempt to relieve a malady , be it wound or disease , it would benefit the result . The plant would enhance the effect of any treatment , munadane or magical , to make cuts heal better and defeat illnesses faster .
description_long: Beorunna ' s cure - all Beorunna ' s cure - all was the name of a highly - prized plant found in the Savage Frontier . When its stem was boiled in a tea , drinking the resulting concoction would result in a general restorative effect that , when combined with an attempt to relieve a malady , be it wound or disease , it would benefit the result . The plant would enhance the effect of any treatment , munadane or magical , to make cuts heal better and defeat illnesses faster . However , the plant had no inherent power to heal , it merely aided another form of treatment and the tea would provide no effect if drunk on its own .

title: Beralt
description: Beralt Beralt was a boy member of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea . History . Beralt studied as a druid under a master and was a member of the Emerald Enclave .
description_long: Beralt Beralt was a boy member of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea . History . Beralt studied as a druid under a master and was a member of the Emerald Enclave . During the Rage of Demons , his master sent him near Hillsfar to investigate corrupted creatures . There he saved the boy tiefling Pynroth from some wild dogs , with the help of some adventurers who happened to be near the farmhouse . Later , together they defeated some demon ic goats .

title: Berdusk
description: Berdusk Berdusk was known as the Jewel of the Vale as it sat on both the Uldoon Trail and the River Chionthar in Sunset Vale . Twilight Hall was located here , making the city the base of many operations for Harpers in the west and the north . A person from Berdusk was known as a Berduskan .
description_long: Berdusk Berdusk was known as the Jewel of the Vale as it sat on both the Uldoon Trail and the River Chionthar in Sunset Vale . Twilight Hall was located here , making the city the base of many operations for Harpers in the west and the north . A person from Berdusk was known as a Berduskan .

title: Berduskan Dark
description: Berduskan Dark Berduskan Dark was a wine exported from Berdusk and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy wine was dark and sweet with a slight burning aftertaste .
description_long: Berduskan Dark Berduskan Dark was a wine exported from Berdusk and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy wine was dark and sweet with a slight burning aftertaste . Possessed of a high alcohol content , this wine was eagerly sought throughout the Realms . At one point this wine was bottled thanks to cooperation between guilds in Berdusk . However , a falling out between the Vinter ' s and Alchemists guilds ended the bottling process . Prices . Berduskan Dark could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Beregost
description: Beregost Beregost is a town on the Coast Way , halfway between Baldur ' s Gate and Amn . The town receives many visiting merchant caravans and , as of 1368 DR , has one tavern and three inns . History .
description_long: Beregost Beregost is a town on the Coast Way , halfway between Baldur ' s Gate and Amn . The town receives many visiting merchant caravans and , as of 1368 DR , has one tavern and three inns . History . Beregost began as a small farming village , established some time after 1026 DR to support the school of magic run by the wizard Ulcaster . The school was destroyed in 1106 DR by Calishite mages and now only the ruins remain . The settlement however thrived and as of 1368 DR it had grown into a large town and an important trading center . Government . In 1368 DR while Beregost ' s offical government is a five - person town council , in reality , the town is run by the governor , Kelddath Ormlyr , who is also the high priest of Song of the Morning a major temple to Lathander . By 1372 DR , Beregost is recorded as having no " official government " and " being run by the high priest of the major temple to Lathander " . It is policed by the Flaming Fist from Baldur ' s Gate . Games . Beregost is the starting point for many quests in the game and also had a lot of valuables for any thief of skill , most of which are kept in chests locked away in homes .

title: Berellip Xorlarrin
description: Berellip Xorlarrin Berellip Xorlarrin was a priestess of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . Description . Berellip wore black robes with elaborate designs and spider - shaped charms .
description_long: Berellip Xorlarrin Berellip Xorlarrin was a priestess of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . Description . Berellip wore black robes with elaborate designs and spider - shaped charms . She was brash , loud , and stubborn . History . Berellip accompanied the expedition led by Ravel Xorlarrin to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . While there , her group came across Drizzt Do ' Urden , Artemis Entreri , and Dahlia Sin ' felle , who claimed to be agents of Bregan D ' aerthe . Berellip remembered Entreri from his previous journey to Menzoberranzan , when she had dangled Entreri over the ledge of the Clawrift while making love to him . She claimed he was her first " colnbluth " ( non - drow ) lover and said he was " quite skilled . " Berellip was killed by Artemis Entreri in 1484 DR after she imprisoned him and Dahlia Sin ' felle in Q ' Xorlarrin and allowed them to be tortured . Relationships . Berellip was the daughter of Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin . Berellip had at least two " bastard sons , " the second being Belween .

title: Berent Thallowood
description: Berent Thallowood Berent Thallowood was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Tallowood and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .
description_long: Berent Thallowood Berent Thallowood was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Tallowood and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember . However , Tallowood and Mandron Saldar were quickly killed by the death knight Targrael under the orders of Manshoon .

title: Berg ' inyon Baenre
description: Berg ' inyon Baenre Berg ' inyon Baenre ( alternately spelt Bergynion ) , the youngest son to Yvonnel , and interestingly the fifth Baenre son after Gromph , a second unknown son , Jarlaxle , and Dantrag , is a fighter of great prowess . He is Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s rival in the academy , but never once beats him . Later , when Drizzt comes back to the Underdark , Berg ' inyon helps his brother Dantrag in fighting Drizzt .
description_long: Berg ' inyon Baenre Berg ' inyon Baenre ( alternately spelt Bergynion ) , the youngest son to Yvonnel , and interestingly the fifth Baenre son after Gromph , a second unknown son , Jarlaxle , and Dantrag , is a fighter of great prowess . He is Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s rival in the academy , but never once beats him . Later , when Drizzt comes back to the Underdark , Berg ' inyon helps his brother Dantrag in fighting Drizzt . But when Dantrag begins to lose , Berg ' inyon betrays Dantrag and leaves the fight . Drizzt kills Dantrag , and Berg ' inyon becomes the new weapon master of his house . Description . Handsome even for drow standards , Berg ' inyon kept his short hair finely cut . Personality . He is described as a typical drow with high ambitions and no sense of morality . Berg ' inyon , along with Kelnozz , is introduced as a classmate of Drizzt Do ' Urden in Melee Magthere , where he is constantly ranked second to Drizzt , much to his dismay and to his mother ' s anger . Possessions . Being an elite drow soldier , Berg ' inyon was skilled in the use of handling subterranean lizard s , and armed himself with a 10 ft ( 3 . 05 m ) death lance and a hand crossbow . History .

title: Berkin Rould
description: Berkin Rould Berkin Rould was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . In his life at sea , Berkin had seen and heard all kinds of things .
description_long: Berkin Rould Berkin Rould was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . In his life at sea , Berkin had seen and heard all kinds of things . He did not like Rydah , but believed that Drayson Fivestars got what he deserved . Activities . Berkin managed the Rusty Chock bar . History . Berkin was a sailor until he retired with old age . Afterward , he chose to run a bar . In 1491 DR , he was involved in the killing of the Cloak Drayson Fivestars . He witnessed him and his soon - to - be - killers having an argument in his bar just before the latter ' s death .

title: Berkthgar
description: Berkthgar Berkthgar was a Reghedman barbarian from the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) who for a time was the chieftain of Settlestone before returning to become king of his tribe . Description . The barbarian chieftain had wild brown hair , which fell across his strong shoulders .
description_long: Berkthgar Berkthgar was a Reghedman barbarian from the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) who for a time was the chieftain of Settlestone before returning to become king of his tribe . Description . The barbarian chieftain had wild brown hair , which fell across his strong shoulders . Berkthgar had muscles the size of dwarf thighs and stood 6 ft 6 in ( 1 . 98 m ) . To add to his imposing presence , the huge human had strikingly blue eyes . Personality . As leader of Settlestone , Berkthgar lived in the shadow of Wulfgar and wanted Aegis - fang to demonstrate to his people he was the rightful chieftain of the Elk Tribe . He was set in his ways and viewed the dwarves and the residents of the Ten Towns as enemies . He was also " stymied by strong women , " namely Catti - brie Possessions . When in battle , Berkthgar used a great flamberge called Bankenfuere the " Northern Fury " and wore a fur covered . The huge 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) bladed sword rested in a leather sheath over his right shoulder . History . Berkthgar was the son of Beothgin . In 1357 DR , Berkthgar was an emissary between Settlestone and Mithral Hall who interacted with King Bruenor .

title: Beromchess Ilthyn
description: Beromchess Ilthyn Beromchess Ilthyn was a priestess of Ilmater in the 13th century DR . History . Beromchess lived locally to the elderly sage Athorton of Nleeth , and became friends with him .
description_long: Beromchess Ilthyn Beromchess Ilthyn was a priestess of Ilmater in the 13th century DR . History . Beromchess lived locally to the elderly sage Athorton of Nleeth , and became friends with him . It was later theorized that it was Athorton who ' d stolen the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater — from the priestess of Loviatar , Lalaskra of Ormpetarr . This was because , when Athorton died in the Year of the Shattered Altar , 1264 DR , Beromchess came into possession of the " Tome " . She covertly took the " Tome " to the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , a major temple of Ilmater at the time .

title: Berranzo
description: Berranzo Berranzo was a failed colony on the western side of the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . History . It was originally built by Calishite human s " circa " 1330 DR for the purposes of mining and refining , and was home to some 2000 people .
description_long: Berranzo Berranzo was a failed colony on the western side of the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . History . It was originally built by Calishite human s " circa " 1330 DR for the purposes of mining and refining , and was home to some 2000 people . Wizard s here employed fire elemental s to refine the ore . But , " circa " 1333 DR , after only three years of operation , every inhabitant of Berranzo was driven mad and most killed , the reason unknown . For some months thereafter , Northmen captains came across ore ships adrift in the sea , crewed only by gibbering lunatics and the dead , their precious cargos still present . The Berranzo colony was abandoned and left to fall into ruins by 1370 DR , with even the bold local Northmen afraid to venture there .

title: Berronar Truesilver
description: Berronar Truesilver Berronar Truesilver ( " bair " - oh - nahr " troo " - sill - vur ) was an intermediate deity in the dwarven pantheon . She was also known as The Revered Mother or the Mother of Safety . Activities .
description_long: Berronar Truesilver Berronar Truesilver ( " bair " - oh - nahr " troo " - sill - vur ) was an intermediate deity in the dwarven pantheon . She was also known as The Revered Mother or the Mother of Safety . Activities . Berronar was Moradin ' s bride and as such the matriarch of the dwarven pantheon . The Revered Mother acted as an authority figure for the other dwarven gods and she used her skills in negotiation and her calm demeanor as a way to keep the pantheon unified when tensions rose . Traditionalists of dwarven culture claimed that without these qualities the Morndinsamman and perhaps even the entire dwarven race would not have survived their slow decline . This decline finally seemed to have reversed with the coming of the Thunder Blessing in the 14th century . In this new age , the Revered Mother gave council to Faerûn ' s most trusted orthodox dwarven clerics as a way to aid Moradin in charting the dwarven destiny . Regardless of these recent events , the number of dwarves who turned their back on Berronar and Moradin was steadily growing , since they believed the couple led a too - conservative philosophy . Followers .

title: Bertold
description: Bertold Bertold the Seeker was a paladin of Torm , god of duty . History . According to legend , Bertold embarked on the traditional quest to rediscover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr , the realm of the once - mortal Torm .
description_long: Bertold Bertold the Seeker was a paladin of Torm , god of duty . History . According to legend , Bertold embarked on the traditional quest to rediscover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr , the realm of the once - mortal Torm . To aid him in this endeavor , cleric s of the House of the Hand temple in Procampur , the Vast , forged " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " . Bertold carried the sword with him on his journeys . Finally , while crossing the Toadsquat Mountains of the southeastern Shaar , Bertold was ambushed by ogre s and slain . He was unaware of his sword ' s soul binding power , however , and rather than go to the House of the Triad , Bertold ' s soul went into " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " , becoming an intelligent weapon . There her would remain until another found and claimed the sword , to become the beneficiary of Bertold ' s knowledge and experience . However , the sword was lost after Bertold ' s death and not found by 1374 DR . Many paladins of Torm sought it around Faerûn . The legend told that if another paladin wielded " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " and died , then their soul would also go into the sword , freeing Bertold to finally ascend to the afterlife . Personality .

title: Bertram Nettlebee
description: Bertram Nettlebee Bertram Nettlebee was the son of Wiggan Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bertram was a very fanatical believer of the cult , and full of bluster .
description_long: Bertram Nettlebee Bertram Nettlebee was the son of Wiggan Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bertram was a very fanatical believer of the cult , and full of bluster . However , he had no clear idea of the true objective of the cult . Relationships . Like his father , Bertram was fascinated by the Cult of the Black Earth and joined the cult , becoming an initiate . Thanks to the cultists , the Nettlebee became ever richer . History . In 1491 DR , after some adventurers had defeated the earth cultists at the Sacred Stone Monastery , the cult ' s leaders ordered Wiggan and Bertram to set a trap to kill the adventurers . They spread rumors about a " fire witch " in their fields , burning an old Uthgardt barrow mound , in order to lure the adventurers . When the adventurers came to investigate the mound , Wiggan summoned an earth elemental to destroy the mound and kill all inside . However , this also awoke a dead chieftain of the Elk Tribe , Javor . Javor rose as a revenant wanting revenge against Wiggan and Bertram . Somehow , the adventurers resolved the situation and Bertram was killed .

title: Berun ' s Hill
description: Berun ' s Hill Berun ' s Hill was a bare - topped , conical hill that commanded a splendid view of the valley of the Dessarin River to the east . History . The hill was used as a lookout for advancing barbarian s and orc hordes from north and east .
description_long: Berun ' s Hill Berun ' s Hill was a bare - topped , conical hill that commanded a splendid view of the valley of the Dessarin River to the east . History . The hill was used as a lookout for advancing barbarian s and orc hordes from north and east . The hill got its name from the ranger Berun . He was slain by an orc horde but managed to take 300 tuskers with him , before they overwhelmed him . Bandits sometimes watched for likely victims from this hill . Rumors and Legends . Legend tells that under the hill lay the grave of an ancient dwarf with rich golden armor and treasures , but none ever found it .

title: Bese al - Sedni
description: Bese al - Sedni Bese al - Sedni was a marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bese was tasked with helping incoming ships to the Trade Harbor find their docks .
description_long: Bese al - Sedni Bese al - Sedni was a marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bese was tasked with helping incoming ships to the Trade Harbor find their docks . He hated his job but knew that to disobey his master would have dire consequences . The only joy he found was in the form of particularly wild sea rides to the docks , usually at the expense of foreigners , since any complaint they made would be ignored . Relationships . Bese was bound in service to Sardi al - Danafi as a gift from his parents . The term of his contract was 100 years plus a day . As of 1367 DR , he still had many decades left of servitude .

title: Beshaba
description: Beshaba Beshaba ( pronounced " be - SHAH - ba " ) , or Lady Doom as she was also known , was the chaotic evil intermediate deity of accidents , bad luck , misfortune , and random mischief and a member of Tempus ' pantheon . She demanded worship to keep her bad luck at bay . Her aim in life was to destroy her sister Tymora , or Lady Luck .
description_long: Beshaba Beshaba ( pronounced " be - SHAH - ba " ) , or Lady Doom as she was also known , was the chaotic evil intermediate deity of accidents , bad luck , misfortune , and random mischief and a member of Tempus ' pantheon . She demanded worship to keep her bad luck at bay . Her aim in life was to destroy her sister Tymora , or Lady Luck . She also delighted in cursing others , often causing seafarers to lose their navigational instincts . History . Beshaba came into being when the deity Tyche split during the Dawn Cataclysm , a separate disaster relating to the machinations of Lathander . Tyche was infected with a taint of the dark god Moander and was forced to split into two parts by her friend Selûne . Those two parts , Tymora and Beshaba , sprang out fully formed and immediately fought . Relationships . Beshaba , who is said to have gotten Tyche ' s looks where Tymora got her love , is considered to be attractive to many male deities and some have been devoured by her lustful passions . She rejected advances from Talos , among other hopefuls . Mortals who perceived the Maid of Misfortune were often destroyed by their lust or driven to maddened loyalty .

title: Besilmer
description: Besilmer Besilmer was a dwarven realm in the hills of the valley of the River Dessarin . Its sign was a wheel over a plow . The realm extended from the Westwood , through Ironford , and as far east as the High Forest , although in Besilmer ' s time , the High Forest extended further westward than in 1368 DR .
description_long: Besilmer Besilmer was a dwarven realm in the hills of the valley of the River Dessarin . Its sign was a wheel over a plow . The realm extended from the Westwood , through Ironford , and as far east as the High Forest , although in Besilmer ' s time , the High Forest extended further westward than in 1368 DR . The northern edge of the realm was at the town of Caddarak , which , in 1368 DR , was only survived by Darthurn , and ran west along the hills south of Yartar , to Tsordvudd . Although the realm did not survive as of 1368 DR , two of its buildings did : the Stone Bridge and the Halls of the Hunting Axe . History . Besilmer was founded in - 4420 DR by Torhild Flametongue and his dwarves . They founded the realm above ground , in the belief that while dwarves created mines underground , they would be beleaguered as a race . Besilmer ' s aim was therefore to form a stable farming community and to prosper in building , inventing and repairs . Besilmer was attacked each year by troll s from the Evermoors , but the dwarves fought them off . Because the realm was unfortified , it became an attractive target for creatures such as giant s and wolves .

title: Besnell
description: Besnell Besnell was a high - ranking elven Knight in Silver who hailed from Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . He led the Knights in Silver against the drow during the battle for Mithral Hall . Description .
description_long: Besnell Besnell was a high - ranking elven Knight in Silver who hailed from Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . He led the Knights in Silver against the drow during the battle for Mithral Hall . Description . Like many elves , Besnell had angular features , golden hair and eyes , but was taller than most of his kind . Personality . Extremely noble , Besnell was not prideful and worked to keep all the forces protecting Mithral Hall from killing each other . Possessions . In battle , Besnell used a sword and wore a bright breastplate . History . In 1358 DR , Besnell and a hundred Knights of Silver combined forces with the Longrider s of Longsaddle , the Riders of Nesmé , and Berkthgar ' s barbarians of Settlestone to defend Mithral Hall from the drow of Menzoberranzan . During the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , Besnell was pierced through the lung by a goblin wielding a spear . Before he could fall to the ground , Berkthgar the Bold grabbed the fallen elf , who died in the barbarian ' s arms . His last words were " For the good of all goodly folk . "

title: Bestow curse
description: Bestow curse Bestow curse was a necromancy or abjuration spell that handicapped a creature . The reverse of this spell was " remove curse " . Effects .
description_long: Bestow curse Bestow curse was a necromancy or abjuration spell that handicapped a creature . The reverse of this spell was " remove curse " . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell that differed mainly in duration . The older version lasted a few hours at most , whereas the newer version was permanent until removed . The caster had to successfully touch the victim in order to cast this spell . The caster could choose one of three standard curses , or perhaps exercise some creativity and modify one of the standard curses to something similarly debilitating but unique . The three standard curses were : The " curse " could be resisted , but if that failed it could not be dispelled . Removal required a " break enchantment " , " limited wish " , " miracle " , " remove curse " , or " wish " . The fancy stone tremair , when worn next to the skin , was known to grant immunity to all magical curses . Post - Second Sundering . After the Second Sundering , the curse changed in several ways . The curse had a one - minute duration if not used with more skill or force but a skilled caster could make the curse last for hours , or if very skilled make it permanent .

title: Bethshiva
description: Bethshiva Zaxis was an hezrou who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . Speaking with Blooden , a Succubus , was discovered that Zaxis was in truth Bethshiva , a marilith demoted as a lower fiend , and also the mother of Baalbisan

title: Bevemar
description: Bevemar Bevemar was a cleric and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Bevemar tolerated no backtalk from those she worked with , let alone those who worked for her .
description_long: Bevemar Bevemar was a cleric and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Bevemar tolerated no backtalk from those she worked with , let alone those who worked for her . Activities . Bevemar worked for both the assassin and the enforcer chapters of the guild in northern Amn . Sometimes , her work forced her to travel to Baldur ' s Gate . Her moniker derived for her habit of removing the tongues of debtors of the Shadow Thieves .

title: Bevil Starling
description: Bevil Starling Bevil Starling is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Activity . Bevil , after he was recruited into the Greycloack army at Crossroad Keep , could ' ve been trained to become a sergeant .
description_long: Bevil Starling Bevil Starling is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Activity . Bevil , after he was recruited into the Greycloack army at Crossroad Keep , could ' ve been trained to become a sergeant . Personality . Bevil was a kind - hearted person , who would protect his village and the people from any attack . He was also shown not to have much knowledge , as Daeghun believed to " have his uses " . Relationships . Bevil was Kalach - Cha ' s and Amie Fern ' s friend , who grew up in West Harbor . He had a mother , who passed away after Ammon Jerro and his demons passed through the village . History . Neverwinter Nights 2 . Bevil , along with Amie Fern , were long - time friends of the Kalach - Cha in his / her home village of West Harbor . He is one of the rising stars within the West Harbor Militia . Bevil is generally good - natured and tends to do things by the book . He often helps his mother , Retta Starling , in looking after their barn and his younger brother and sister . He is also frequently picked on by the Mossfeld boys who once dangled him over the village well .

title: Bexron
description: Bexron Bexron was a glabrezu in Maerimydra . History . As of 1491 DR Bexron and two bar - lgura surveyed the entrance to the Undying Temple buth in truth they relaxed with a good smoke and boasted to each other .
description_long: Bexron Bexron was a glabrezu in Maerimydra . History . As of 1491 DR Bexron and two bar - lgura surveyed the entrance to the Undying Temple buth in truth they relaxed with a good smoke and boasted to each other . Personality . Bexron was a ferrous demon but the madness spread by demon lord Graz ' zt had changed him in a lazy and somehow friendly creature . Bexron now looked for new experiences to luxuriate in .

title: Beyab al - Rashid
description: Beyab al - Rashid Beyab al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Beyab and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .
description_long: Beyab al - Rashid Beyab al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Beyab and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham . They used this as a front to mark a for robbery . Relationships . Beyab was brother to Ramas al - Rashid and Harun al - Rashid .

title: Beyd Sechepol
description: Beyd Sechepol Beyd Sechepol was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Beyd was a very diplomatic individual , always evading arguments that divided public opinion , with exception of the topics of horse and gear , about which he was careless .
description_long: Beyd Sechepol Beyd Sechepol was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Beyd was a very diplomatic individual , always evading arguments that divided public opinion , with exception of the topics of horse and gear , about which he was careless . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR in order to sell his ale and beer , Beyd boarded a great caravan . Unknown to him , it was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Bezantur
description: Bezantur Bezantur was a port city located at the southern coast of Tyraturos , a region of Thay . She was also called Thay ' s City of a Thousand Temples and was famous for it ' s great harbour . Hexcidon , which was the only Hexblade college in Faerûn , was located in Bezantur .
description_long: Bezantur Bezantur was a port city located at the southern coast of Tyraturos , a region of Thay . She was also called Thay ' s City of a Thousand Temples and was famous for it ' s great harbour . Hexcidon , which was the only Hexblade college in Faerûn , was located in Bezantur . At this school , generations of hexblades studied to become elite bodyguards and generals for Thay . Religion . Many different gods were worshiped in the great temples of the town . Importance . In 1385 DR the town of Bezantur was the setting to the final encounter of the legions of the council of zulkir s and those of the self - proclaimed regent Szass Tam during the war of Thay . The lich used the priests of Bane that were stationed in the town to force the zulkirs to flee aboard vessels . The priests literally burned Bezantur ' s harbour to ashes in an attempt of destroying the vessels the zulkirs would use to flee . Szass then proclaimed the town ' s high priest of Bane , Zekidh Shezim , the new autharch of Bezantur .

title: Bezoldur Thornhand
description: Bezoldur Thornhand Bezoldur Thronhand was an elderly dwarven cook that worked in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . He was one of the very few non - humans that resided in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description .
description_long: Bezoldur Thornhand Bezoldur Thronhand was an elderly dwarven cook that worked in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . He was one of the very few non - humans that resided in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Bezoldur was completely bald but still had a beard . He was not very attractive by most standards . When working in the cookhouse , he wore very little clothing because the numerous ovens , bubbling cauldrons , and hearth fires made the kitchen hot like a dwarven forge . Personality . He and his coworkers constantly groused and snapped at each other , with Bezoldur often using foul language . They bickered amongst each other and berated the serving wenches constantly . Unfamiliar people entering the cookhouse were treated as invaders and , at the very least , could expect to be shouted at with thrown cutlery to soon follow . Abilities . He was a competent cook , able to produce plain , wholesome farm cuisine without frills . He still retained most of his skill as a warrior but rarely needed to use it .

title: Bhaal
description: Bhaal Bhaal ( pronounced " Beh - HAHL " ) , the Lord of Murder , was originally a mortal and one of the Dead Three . Along with Bane and Myrkul , Bhaal took the portfolios of the ancient deity Jergal . Despite his most common title , Bhaal was the god of death , but he especially favoured violent or ritual deaths .
description_long: Bhaal Bhaal ( pronounced " Beh - HAHL " ) , the Lord of Murder , was originally a mortal and one of the Dead Three . Along with Bane and Myrkul , Bhaal took the portfolios of the ancient deity Jergal . Despite his most common title , Bhaal was the god of death , but he especially favoured violent or ritual deaths . While originally he was the patron of assassin s and their victims , it wasn ' t long before common murderers used a claim of his worship to justify their sadistic actions , warping the manner of his worship . As a result , Bhaal was feared throughout Faerûn - especially in the island realm of the Moonshaes . The nature of what the Lord of Murder has power over is contested - in his best incarnation he may take strength in violently punishing murderers and warmongers , others that he judged whether a murder was righteous or not , while the Bhaalspawn simply believed he wanted " more " murder . Worshippers . Of all the dead deities of Abeir - Toril , Bhaal most likely has the most scattered cultists , the worst known as deathstalker s , attempting to bring him back to ' life ' .

title: Bhaalspawn
description: Bhaalspawn Bhaalspawn is the name given to the mortal offspring of the now dead god Bhaal . It is said that Bhaal foresaw his death during the Time of Troubles and came to Toril before the climactic event , mating with females of almost any species , not all of them humanoid . Like Bane , he would attempt to use these offspring to bring himself back to life .
description_long: Bhaalspawn Bhaalspawn is the name given to the mortal offspring of the now dead god Bhaal . It is said that Bhaal foresaw his death during the Time of Troubles and came to Toril before the climactic event , mating with females of almost any species , not all of them humanoid . Like Bane , he would attempt to use these offspring to bring himself back to life . Alaundo made a prophecy about the Bhaalspawn that foretold the great destruction they would bring . Nature . " Note : " General statements below are canonical . Game - specific examples , all indicated as such , are likely to conflict with the novels , however that does not directly indicate the nature of the novels as being canonical , according to our current policy . Some parts , aside from Abdel Adrian ' s existence , also apply to the games . Bhaalspawn mostly seemed like normal members of their race at first , so long as the race was humanoid ( Abazigal was considered a half - breed according to the game ) . Part of their soul was divine , however , and this would eventually reveal itself , sometimes granting supernatural powers of different kinds but usually also tempting them to evil and murder .

title: Bhaem Shumokh
description: Bhaem Shumokh Bhaem Shumokh was a human male and the head of the Shumokh mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . The Shumokh family made their fortune in the blacksmithing and armor business , but kind - hearted Bhaem chose to become a musician and lute - maker , which turned out to be quite lucrative .
description_long: Bhaem Shumokh Bhaem Shumokh was a human male and the head of the Shumokh mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . The Shumokh family made their fortune in the blacksmithing and armor business , but kind - hearted Bhaem chose to become a musician and lute - maker , which turned out to be quite lucrative .

title: Bhaerynden
description: Bhaerynden Bhaerynden was the first great kingdom of the dwarves of Faerûn , centered in the great cavern deep beneath the Shaar . Bhaerynden fell to the drow after the Crown Wars and the descent of the Drow . " See also : " The section on Bhaerynden tied to the Great Rift article as part of the Deep Realm , and the Great Bhaerynden article as part of the Underdark .

" See also : " The section on Bhaerynden tied to the Great Rift article as part of the Deep Realm , and the Great Bhaerynden article as part of the Underdark .

title: Bhaeryta Chassendora
description: Bhaeryta Chassendora Bhaeryta Chassendora was a human woman and a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Bhaeryta ' s specialty was to trade in rare and otherwise hard - to - find material components and substances required for magic , such as dragon blood , manticore spikes , and wyvern scales . She often acquired these from adventurers who won them in their exploits , and sold them onto mages .
description_long: Bhaeryta Chassendora Bhaeryta Chassendora was a human woman and a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Bhaeryta ' s specialty was to trade in rare and otherwise hard - to - find material components and substances required for magic , such as dragon blood , manticore spikes , and wyvern scales . She often acquired these from adventurers who won them in their exploits , and sold them onto mages .

title: Bhaluin
description: Bhaluin Bhaluin , or the Drowned City , was a ruin located in the middle of Gbor Nor in Semphar . Geography . The ruins of Bhaluin sat upon an island within Gbor Nor located 10 miles ( 16 km ) from the coast .
description_long: Bhaluin Bhaluin , or the Drowned City , was a ruin located in the middle of Gbor Nor in Semphar . Geography . The ruins of Bhaluin sat upon an island within Gbor Nor located 10 miles ( 16 km ) from the coast . Many of the ancient buildings were found under the waterline , giving the city its nickname . Description . The ruins of Bhaluin were well - preserved for the most part . Much of the streets were cluttered with rubble from collapsed walls . Seven large minarets were found at the center of the city , accompanied by a strange wailing sound that some believed was just the wind . History . Bhaluin was rumored to have been built 4 , 000 years ago during the height of the Raurin Empire . Inhabitants . A secret cult of the dead lay hidden somewhere deep within Bhaluin . Both living and undead members comprised their ransk . Rumors and Legends . Bodies from adventurers who explored the city were often found floating in leather boats . A few survivors reported doing battle with strange creatures wearing tattered red robes .

title: Bhamm ' s Herbs
description: Bhamm ' s Herbs Bhamm ' s Herbs was a shop in Eshpurta run by Eudhis Bhamm . The arcane arts were frowned upon in Amn and Eudhis would deny he had anything in stock ( other than herbs ) that could be considered a spell component . Inquiries were often met with ridicule and scorn .
description_long: Bhamm ' s Herbs Bhamm ' s Herbs was a shop in Eshpurta run by Eudhis Bhamm . The arcane arts were frowned upon in Amn and Eudhis would deny he had anything in stock ( other than herbs ) that could be considered a spell component . Inquiries were often met with ridicule and scorn . Persistent buyers with ready coin would eventually be escorted to his " compounding room " where a vast array of spell components were available for double the prices found in other countries . Bhamm ' s Herbs was located in the southern part of the city , next door to Gray Goose Provisioners , and across the street and a short walk south of the Hamstrung Giant .

title: Bharash
description: Bharash Bharash was a dragonborn who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . He was beside Sabine the general in charge of the Dagult Neverember army in the city .
description_long: Bharash Bharash was a dragonborn who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . He was beside Sabine the general in charge of the Dagult Neverember army in the city . Appendix . Behind the scenes . The general appeared in MODULE 4 of the " Neverwinter " game .

title: Bharavan Bhaerkantos
description: Bharavan Bhaerkantos Bharavan Bhaerkantos was a merchant and member of the Thousandheads Trading Coster . Activities . Bharavan was the founder and leader of the Thousandheads Trading Coster .
description_long: Bharavan Bhaerkantos Bharavan Bhaerkantos was a merchant and member of the Thousandheads Trading Coster . Activities . Bharavan was the founder and leader of the Thousandheads Trading Coster . He worked out of his base of operations in his stronghold located just east of Riatavin . History . In his youth Bharavan was an adventurer . In 1370 DR he was a member of the Merchant ' s Chosen and one of the leaders of the rebellion against Amn .

title: Bheloris
description: Bheloris Bheloris was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . Once Bheloris was a member of the elder ' s council that advised the Shadowmaster High before Dhalgrave decided to stoup down it .
description_long: Bheloris Bheloris was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . Once Bheloris was a member of the elder ' s council that advised the Shadowmaster High before Dhalgrave decided to stoup down it . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Bheloris approached the younger Neleyd and Huerbara . He proposed to hatch a plan together to increase the chance of their success for the hunt .

title: Bhereu Ammaeth
description: Bhereu Ammaeth Duke Bhereu Ammaeth was the Lord High Marshal of Cormyr . He is bald . He resided in High Horn .
description_long: Bhereu Ammaeth Duke Bhereu Ammaeth was the Lord High Marshal of Cormyr . He is bald . He resided in High Horn . Background . In 1369 DR Bhereu was on a hunt with King Azoun IV , Baron Thomdor and Aunadar Bleth when he was poisoned by a magical abraxus in the abraxus affair , putting him in a coma - like state . He died soon after this , vomiting black viscous bile . Relatives . Bhereu was the brother of Baron Thomdor and the cousin of former King of Cormyr , Azoun IV .

title: Bheur
description: Bheur Bheurs , also known as winter hags or blue hag , were found commonly in Auril ' s realm within the Deep Wilds as well as within the nation of Rashemen on the Prime Material Plane . They lived for the pleasure of bringing icy doom to as many people as they could . A common legend in Rashemen and surrounding lands suggested that there was only one bheur alive , because no more than one was ever seen at a time , but it was far more likely that they were solitary wanderers .
description_long: Bheur Bheurs , also known as winter hags or blue hag , were found commonly in Auril ' s realm within the Deep Wilds as well as within the nation of Rashemen on the Prime Material Plane . They lived for the pleasure of bringing icy doom to as many people as they could . A common legend in Rashemen and surrounding lands suggested that there was only one bheur alive , because no more than one was ever seen at a time , but it was far more likely that they were solitary wanderers . This was , in fact , false and bheur hags were the most common of Auril ' s handmaidens . Every winter , just before Tarsakh , hathran s were sent to battle the bheurs . If the hathrans failed in their battle , then spring was delayed for several more weeks in Rashemen . Bheurs were vulnerable to lightning or electricity . Some folk believed that orglash also worked together with bheur hags , but it was not known if such tales were true . Description . Bheurs resembled hideous old women , like all hags did ; however , a bheur ' s skin was blue - white , with white hair .

title: Bhevek Grimshackle
description: Bhevek Grimshackle Bhevek Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bhevek and his brother were only interested in money .
description_long: Bhevek Grimshackle Bhevek Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bhevek and his brother were only interested in money . He was filthy and bedraggled like his brother . Activities . Bhevek and his brother Ukharim Grimshackle opened Grimshackle Jail , where they took criminals whom they ransomed to the highest bidder . History . In 1489 DR , Bhevek permitted , for some money , an adventuring party to interrogate Gray Patriots ' s member Rathene Fel . Afterward , the adventures dealt with a planned prison break .

title: Bhokaran
description: Bhokaran Bhokaran was a priest of Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Bhokaran was an athletic young man .
description_long: Bhokaran Bhokaran was a priest of Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Bhokaran was an athletic young man . Personality . Keen intelligence helped Bhokaran rise quickly within the priesthood of Haku . Activities . He served as the spiritual advisor for Prince Tannous al - Assad . Relationships . Bhokaran had a close relationship with Prince Tannous and High Priest Gholam ibn Jubair .

title: Bhylqex
description: Bhylqex Bhylqex was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Bhylqex was known for her violent temperament , larger - than - normal size , and unique mutant ability to shoot barbed spikes from her tail like a manticore .

title: Bhyrindar Tellynnan
description: Bhyrindar Tellynnan Bhyrindar " Silverhart " Tellynnan was a moon elf werewolf and , as of 1374 DR , was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma and leader of a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra operating in the north of the High Forest . The Eldreth Veluuthra failed to ally with Turlang and Lossarwyn , and this was attributed to Bhyrindar ' s impatience .
