title: Bhùn Ludwakazar
description: Bhùn Ludwakazar Bhùn Ludwakazar was a dwarf gladiator of the Ludwakazar clan in Mulmaster . Personality . Having been exiled , Bhùn felt he had lost his honor and only wanted a death would win him glory in the afterlife .
description_long: Bhùn Ludwakazar Bhùn Ludwakazar was a dwarf gladiator of the Ludwakazar clan in Mulmaster . Personality . Having been exiled , Bhùn felt he had lost his honor and only wanted a death would win him glory in the afterlife . He regretted the conflict with his brother and secretly hoped they would reconcile before death . Activities . Bhùn was the champion gladiator of the illegal arena run by Gethmedra Darmov under the Black Blade and Bloody Boar tavern . History . Bhùn once lived with the rest of his clan in the Earthspur Mountains , acting as custodian of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones . The recent mining excavations alarmed them . Bhùn had a conflict with his brother , King Iorn Ludwakazar , and was subsequently exiled . After that , he went to Mulmaster where he gained fame as the Stone Dwarf in gladiator matches . In 1491 DR , an adventuring party approached him in order to learn about the mines and he told them his history , asking them to also send a letter of reconciliation to his brother .

title: Bichan Rarkat
description: Bichan Rarkat Bichan Rarkat was one of the Cloakmasters of Esmeltaran for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Bichan ' s parents were killed when he was ten and soon he become a thug for the Shadow Thieves .
description_long: Bichan Rarkat Bichan Rarkat was one of the Cloakmasters of Esmeltaran for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Bichan ' s parents were killed when he was ten and soon he become a thug for the Shadow Thieves . He made a career in the local guild of enforcers and thugs until he ascended to the status of guildmaster . When his boss died in a bizarre accident involving a rope in a festhall , Bichan was promoted to Cloakmaster . Personality . Bichan never forgot his humble beginnings , preferring plain and simple clothes like any ordinary half - orc on the street . He , however , emanated an air of authority . Bichan had a good relationship with the other Cloakmaster of Esmeltaran and had a firm control over his operations .

title: Bidderdoo Harpell
description: Bidderdoo Harpell Bidderdoo Harpell was a wizard from the Harpell family , an eccentric clan of mages from Longsaddle that lived in the Ivy Mansion . History . For seven years , Bidderdoo was trapped in the form of a dog due to a backfired spell .
description_long: Bidderdoo Harpell Bidderdoo Harpell was a wizard from the Harpell family , an eccentric clan of mages from Longsaddle that lived in the Ivy Mansion . History . For seven years , Bidderdoo was trapped in the form of a dog due to a backfired spell . During the Time of Troubles , the family ( or he himself ) later found a way to turn him back to human form but during the war between Mithral Hall and Menzoberranzan in 1358 DR , he had defensive animal urges that eventually took over , turning him into a silver werewolf . Upon his first true transformation into a werewolf , he killed Uthegental Armgo , saving Thibbledorf Pwent and the remaining forces of the Gutbuster Brigade . Bidderdoos . Bidderdoo ' s " legacy " was a number of werewolves that lived around the town of Longsaddle by 1479 DR , unintentionally scaring the townsfolk but in fact guarding the town . These werewolves were known as " the Bidderdoos . " Whether they are descendants of Bidderdoo by blood or by curse was unknown .

title: Bifely Lyeelm
description: Bifely Lyeelm Bifely Lyeelm was the high priestess of Cyric at the temple dedicated to his worship in Mulmaster . She was half - crazed from her incessant scheming , though it had worked out somewhat as she managed to ingratiate herself to High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . History .
description_long: Bifely Lyeelm Bifely Lyeelm was the high priestess of Cyric at the temple dedicated to his worship in Mulmaster . She was half - crazed from her incessant scheming , though it had worked out somewhat as she managed to ingratiate herself to High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . History . Previously a worshiper of the deity Bane , Bifely converted to the church of Cyric during the Time of Troubles . When Bane was resurrected , however , she did not forsake her new god . This led to much derision from the Black Lord ' s clergy in Mulmaster .

title: Biff the Understudy
description: Biff the Understudy Biff the Understudy was a human male fighter and an actor in Raelis Shai ' s theater performance at the Five Flagons Inn in Athkatla in 1369 DR . He served as an understudy for Haer ' Dalis , who was absent . Biff messed up his lines , prompting booing and causing the play to be abandoned .
description_long: Biff the Understudy Biff the Understudy was a human male fighter and an actor in Raelis Shai ' s theater performance at the Five Flagons Inn in Athkatla in 1369 DR . He served as an understudy for Haer ' Dalis , who was absent . Biff messed up his lines , prompting booing and causing the play to be abandoned . Appendix . Background . " Biff the Understudy " is a meta - character in the " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game . Many conversations in " Baldur ' s Gate " require a certain NPC , and in case such an NPC has been accidentally killed or otherwise not present , the game summons up Biff the Understudy to say the required lines . Biff can actually join the party in some instances , though his statistics leave something to be desired . He also has a brief cameo as a minor character in " " , as a genuine understudy in Athkatla . However , he is not necessarily present as a meta - character in " Baldur ' s Gate II " owing to a new feature , in which characters who need to flee or speak lines before dying are in fact impossible to bring below 1 hitpoint .

title: Big Head
description: Big Head The Big Head gang was a yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Big Head ' s main business was selling goods and fake medicines between the local villages and in the city and towns they controlled the business of the small street stalls . The stall owners payed protection money to the Big Head and normally the Big Head yakuza protected common people from the outrages of the samurai .
description_long: Big Head The Big Head gang was a yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Big Head ' s main business was selling goods and fake medicines between the local villages and in the city and towns they controlled the business of the small street stalls . The stall owners payed protection money to the Big Head and normally the Big Head yakuza protected common people from the outrages of the samurai . The Big Head was organized like a family with the boss as father of his underlings . There were only three important rules in the Big Head : not to do anything with the wife of another Big Head , not to talk about the Big Heads , and to obey the oyabun . If someone broke these rules , they were punished with death or exile . The Big Head were semi - officially recognized by the city ' s authorities and often the city ' s police asked for their help .

title: Big Tiger Pagoda
description: Big Tiger Pagoda The Big Tiger Pagoda was a large structure found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Structure . The pagoda was composed entirely of brick and stood seven stories tall , making it an impressive landmark in the city .
description_long: Big Tiger Pagoda The Big Tiger Pagoda was a large structure found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Structure . The pagoda was composed entirely of brick and stood seven stories tall , making it an impressive landmark in the city . Activities . Funds needed to maintain the building were raised by the governor of Manass through a special head tax . History . Big Tiger Pagoda was originally constructed to honor the " King - Who - Slew - Bambalan " , an ancient hero of Khazari .

title: Bigby ' s clenched fist
description: Bigby ' s clenched fist Bigby ' s clenched fist was an evocation spell that conjured a hand of force to attack one ' s foes . Clerics who cast this spell named it for their deities — " Torm ' s clenched fist " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as clenched fist , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Bigby ' s clenched fist Bigby ' s clenched fist was an evocation spell that conjured a hand of force to attack one ' s foes . Clerics who cast this spell named it for their deities — " Torm ' s clenched fist " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as clenched fist , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects . This spell was one of the " Bigby ' s hand " family of spells . It created a fist of force about the size of an ogre that could be used to pummel an opponent . All versions of this spell relied on the caster ' s senses to detect and locate a target , the fist did not have senses of its own . The earliest versions never missed the target once it was designated , but the quality of each strike and the amount of damage were random . A new target could be chosen after each attack , but otherwise the caster did not need to concentrate on the spell to maintain it . Later versions required a successful melee spell attack to damage an opponent and the caster had to direct the " fist " for the duration of the spell .

title: Bigby ' s crushing hand
description: Bigby ' s crushing hand Bigby ' s crushing hand was an evocation spell that created a hand of force to grapple , block , push , or squeeze an opponent . Cleric s who cast this spell named it for their deity — " Loviatar ' s crushing hand " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as crushing hand , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Bigby ' s crushing hand Bigby ' s crushing hand was an evocation spell that created a hand of force to grapple , block , push , or squeeze an opponent . Cleric s who cast this spell named it for their deity — " Loviatar ' s crushing hand " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as crushing hand , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects . This spell was one of the " Bigby ' s hand " family of spells . It created a hand about the size of an ogre or about 10 ft ( 3 m ) tall with a splayed finger span of about the same distance ( earlier versions could be even larger ) that could be used to block , push , or grab and squeeze a creature . All versions of this spell relied on the caster ' s senses to detect and locate a target , the fist did not have senses of its own . But once a target was designated , the " hand " would unerringly stick with the target regardless of invisibility , polymorphing , darkness , or other means of concealment or disguise .

title: Biggrin
description: Biggrin Description . The massive giant had his upper lip torn off by a , which left him permanently scarred . This wound help gave him his name : " Big - Grin " .
description_long: Biggrin Description . The massive giant had his upper lip torn off by a , which left him permanently scarred . This wound help gave him his name : " Big - Grin " . It was also implied he had great endurance , since he withstood a hammer blow to the head from Wulfgar ' s Aegis - fang . Possessions . He had a magic mirror to communicate instantly from his lair on the slopes of Kelvin ' s Cairn to Akar Kessell ' s crystal fortress . Relationships . He was accompanied by a group of verbeeg giant s .

title: Bija tree
description: Bija tree A bija tree was a type of tree found in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It grew in the Quang Muku Forest . Green sleeping dust could be made from the bija tree .
description_long: Bija tree A bija tree was a type of tree found in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It grew in the Quang Muku Forest . Green sleeping dust could be made from the bija tree . Appendix . Background . The bija tree may be named for the " bija " trees of Korea , which grow in the Bijarim forest on Jeju , though these only produce nutmeg .

title: Bildoobaris
description: Bildoobaris Bildoobaris , the unofficial capital of Narfell , was little more than an open plain that rested in the towering shadow of Mount Nar . For one tenday every summer , this plain turned into a bustling city consisting of over 30 , 000 Nars . Also called Bildoobaris , this festival was the largest and most important holiday in all of Narfell ; even the cruelest and most fierce Nar tribes came to drink , feast , and trade together .

title: Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal
description: Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal was the only gnome Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Bilskromminet loved pranks like all gnomes , but he always targeted people he disliked , and his pranks were usually very humiliating .

Bilskromminet ' s position in the guild in 1370 was to teach smaller members ( usually children ) how to take advantage of their size .

title: Bimaru
description: Bimaru Bimaru was the ambassador of the kingdom of Bertan on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Bimaru was a mysterious woman .
description_long: Bimaru Bimaru was the ambassador of the kingdom of Bertan on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Bimaru was a mysterious woman . Rumors said that she was taken from her monastery in Bertan only to fit her current assignation . She was very devoted to her queen and usually remained isolated in her quarters .

title: Bimasara
description: Bimasara Bimasara was the Padhrasattva of Barter within the Padhran religion . History . Before the city was destroyed , Kushk held a strong collection of Bimasara ' s followers at their temple called the Holy Mountain of Kus .
description_long: Bimasara Bimasara was the Padhrasattva of Barter within the Padhran religion . History . Before the city was destroyed , Kushk held a strong collection of Bimasara ' s followers at their temple called the Holy Mountain of Kus . Followers of Bimasara undertook a series of tests within the bowels of Mount Kus . Only the wisest of them were able to make it to the Tower of Harmony that sat atop the mountain .

title: Bineera Ethar
description: Bineera Ethar Skull Servant Bineera Ethar was a female human cleric of Cyric . She led the Cyricists ' s activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History .
description_long: Bineera Ethar Skull Servant Bineera Ethar was a female human cleric of Cyric . She led the Cyricists ' s activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Skull Servant Ethar served Blackwill Haarken Akhmelere , the Watchful Skull of the Twin Towers of the Eclipse in Amn . Ethar became the leader of a contingent of the church of Cyric allied with the black dragon Despayr and Esvele Graycastle in their plot to tear apart the Weave in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . She , her assistant Zetharmas , and several guards of the Ebon Spur traveled to the Plane of Shadow to consult for the Shar - worshipers in the ritual performed in the Black Rift . They were accompanied by the banelar Isti - Zar , who supported the Shadowscale tribe of shadowslain lizardfolk , a gloom golem for their own defense , and a blood golem as a gift to the Sharrans . However , the Sharrans did not trust the Cyricists , and did not allow them into the Rift without escort . Thus , Ethar , Zetharmas , and her men , together with the gloom golem , resided in the Monastery of Ebon Dome , a ruined monastery once dedicated to Shar for the duration of the plot .

title: Binnacy Kron
description: Binnacy Kron Binnacy Kron was a woman in Mulmaster . History . As result of the Brotherhood of the Cloak ' s actions , Binnacy ' s sister Maude Kron was killed .
description_long: Binnacy Kron Binnacy Kron was a woman in Mulmaster . History . As result of the Brotherhood of the Cloak ' s actions , Binnacy ' s sister Maude Kron was killed . She and her brothers Arne Kron and Jaque Kron sought vengeance , especially against the Cloak responsible for Maude ' s case , Nelvon deJuan . With assistance of Proskler , an adept of Talos , they devised a plot to kidnap Larch deJuan , younger brother of Nelvon . In 1491 DR , they acted at a great party held in Astrid Saj ' s villa . An adventuring party that happened to be present was hired by Nelvon and they quickly unveiled and confronted Binnacy . Personality . Binnacy in recent time was often angry . Despite totally focused on revenge she worried about the troubles that can attend her two brothers .

title: Bint al - Jawzi
description: Bint al - Jawzi Bint al - Jawzi was a dwarf merchant - rogue living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Jawzi was a formidable rubban in a profession dominated by men , human s , and elves .
description_long: Bint al - Jawzi Bint al - Jawzi was a dwarf merchant - rogue living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Jawzi was a formidable rubban in a profession dominated by men , human s , and elves . Possessions . Jawzi owned a " footman ' s mace " " + 4 " and a " scarab of protection " " ( cloaked wizardry ) " . Rumors and Legends . It was widely rumored that Jawzi was so skilled as a captain because she was the offspring of a marid . She neither confirmed nor denied this rumor .

title: BioWare
description: BioWare BioWare Corp is a Canadian entertainment software company best known for its roleplaying games , including a number of Forgotten Realms computer game titles . BioWare was founded in , in 1995 by medical students Ray Muzyka and Greg Zeschuk . After initially developing " " in 1996 , BioWare went on to develop " Baldur ' s Gate " for Black Isle Studios in 1998 , their first out of many contributions to the Forgotten Realms license .
description_long: BioWare BioWare Corp is a Canadian entertainment software company best known for its roleplaying games , including a number of Forgotten Realms computer game titles . BioWare was founded in , in 1995 by medical students Ray Muzyka and Greg Zeschuk . After initially developing " " in 1996 , BioWare went on to develop " Baldur ' s Gate " for Black Isle Studios in 1998 , their first out of many contributions to the Forgotten Realms license . " Baldur ' s Gate " proved to be both a smash success and critically acclaimed and in 1999 the developer put out an expansion pack , " " , followed by a sequel , " " in 2000 , which was even more acclaimed and acquired another expansion pack , " " in 2001 . In 2002 , BioWare released its last stand - alone Forgotten Realms game to date , " Neverwinter Nights " , which , again , proved a critical and commercial success . BioWare continued support for the game , releasing two story - based expansions ( " " and " " ) as well as several downloadable " premium modules " and the " " expansion pack . BioWare would later also provide limited oversight over Obsidian Entertainment ' s development of the sequel , released in 2006 .

title: Birdpipes
description: Birdpipes Birdpipes , also known as shalm , were a type of pan pipes . Sacred to Lliira and the satyr s , birdpipes were quite popular among the wood elves and wild elves . Description .
description_long: Birdpipes Birdpipes , also known as shalm , were a type of pan pipes . Sacred to Lliira and the satyr s , birdpipes were quite popular among the wood elves and wild elves . Description . Burdpipes were somewhat related to the common longhorn . Their rich sound came from a series of vertical tubes of different lengths , and was said to be able to charm ferocious animals . They could also be purchased through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Birthing Furnace
description: Birthing Furnace The Birthing Furnace was a powerful artifact created by the primordial Nehushta . Abilities . The Birthing Furnace had the ability to create living genasi babies .
description_long: Birthing Furnace The Birthing Furnace was a powerful artifact created by the primordial Nehushta . Abilities . The Birthing Furnace had the ability to create living genasi babies . It was believed that the Birthing Furnace produced more babes than the handful that emerged from it , but that , due to malfunctions , those with manifestations other than firesoul were consumed the by the forge ' s fires before they could crawl forth . The Birthing Furnace could only be activated once per year by using a special key at the proper time . History . The Birthing Furnace was used by members of the Dominion of the Burned to replenish their numbers by creating new genasi babies each year . As of 1479 DR , the owner of the Furnace ' s key was the leader of the Burned , Brindol . The existence of this artifact was used to lend credence to the legend that estated Nehushta was the creator of the genasi race .

title: Bishop
description: Bishop Bishop was a skilled and deadly ranger from the Sword Coast North . During the Shadow War , he notably traveled with the Kalach - Cha and aided them in their quest before eventually betraying them at the Siege of Crossroad Keep . Description .
description_long: Bishop Bishop was a skilled and deadly ranger from the Sword Coast North . During the Shadow War , he notably traveled with the Kalach - Cha and aided them in their quest before eventually betraying them at the Siege of Crossroad Keep . Description . Bishop was an attractive human , despite his rough lifestyle and poor hygiene , giving him a ruggedly handsome appearance . Bishop lived a full and dangerous life , the signs of which when he met the Kalach - Cha were his numerous scars and burns that ravaged his skin . His ruffled hair and touch of facial hair were brown , as were his eyes , which contrasted with his pale white skin . These features , and more , added to his feral appearance , which was accentuated by his tendency to sniff the air like a wild animal or constantly look over his shoulder , as if expecting an ambush or betrayal . Typically , Bishop dressed as if on the hunt , which he often was . When the Kalach - Cha met him in the Sunken Flagon , Bishop was dressed in leather armor and armed with a longbow and longsword , with his hands constantly on one or the other .

title: Bismalla bin Ala ' i
description: Bismalla bin Ala ' i Bismalla bin Ala ' i was a member of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Bismalla was a polite individual who deferred to those in charge for any decision .
description_long: Bismalla bin Ala ' i Bismalla bin Ala ' i was a member of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Bismalla was a polite individual who deferred to those in charge for any decision . He often spoke slowly , since he had to think hard about what he was about to say . Decription . Bismalla was an aging , overweight holy slayer who was well past his prime . It was said that he possessed both the strength and the brains of an ox .

title: Bison - gourd
description: Bison - gourd Bison - gourd was a flowering plant common on Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . Uses . The oils harvested from this plant ' s seeds were hard to smell but could be used as a natural insect repellent .
description_long: Bison - gourd Bison - gourd was a flowering plant common on Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . Uses . The oils harvested from this plant ' s seeds were hard to smell but could be used as a natural insect repellent . It should be noted that only normal - sized insects were repelled by the oil ; larger insects or swarms were not affected in the least . Description . Bison - gourd covered large areas of the prairie with runners that were usually dozens of feet long . This plant produced large yellow flowers that were shaped like trumpets . The flowers produced a fruit that could grow up to 5 inches ( 12 . 7 centimeters ) long .

title: Bistro Battenrooj
description: Bistro Battenrooj Bistro Battenrooj was the traveling companion of Bahooha Shortsleeves in Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . Bistro proclaimed himself a monk despite having no training as one .
description_long: Bistro Battenrooj Bistro Battenrooj was the traveling companion of Bahooha Shortsleeves in Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . Bistro proclaimed himself a monk despite having no training as one . However , thanks to his illusion powers , he managed to look like one . Personality . Nobody knew if Bistro truly believed himself to be a monk or maintained the facade for the thrill of the challenge , despite many suspecting the latter option .

title: Bitter Black
description: Bitter Black Bitter Black was a stout beer exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy beer tasted best when served at cellar temperatures .
description_long: Bitter Black Bitter Black was a stout beer exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy beer tasted best when served at cellar temperatures . Arabellans looked down upon anyone drinking it at a different temperature . Bitter Black had a dark black color with a thick head of deep brown foam . Prices . Bitter Black could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Bitter Well Oasis
description: Bitter Well Oasis Bitter Well Oasis was a small resting stop located in the southern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands . Description . Set on a plateau , this nearly abandoned oasis was small and pitiful .
description_long: Bitter Well Oasis Bitter Well Oasis was a small resting stop located in the southern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands . Description . Set on a plateau , this nearly abandoned oasis was small and pitiful . Only three buildings , mostly buried by sand , were located at the site , and two of them were abandoned . Water from the well tasted bitter and salty . It was one of several stops along the Bitter Well Caravan Route before the route was abandoned . Inhabitants . Ma Chung - ying was the only permanent resident of Bitter Well Oasis around 1359 DR . He stayed to keep the well clear of sand , and to report on the few actions of the nomad tribes to Shou Lung , in exchange for a stipend of food and wine .

title: Bjami Tengervaald
description: Bjami Tengervaald Bjami Tengervaald was an old shaman in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Bjami was born into the Tribe of the Bear .
description_long: Bjami Tengervaald Bjami Tengervaald was an old shaman in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Bjami was born into the Tribe of the Bear . He was always the true leader of the tribe , governing from behind Hing Gunvald Barrundson . He ably manipulated virtually all influential men of the tribe to do his will but made it appear that his most popular ideas were Gunvald ' s own . All this changed in 1485 DR when Hedrun Arnsfirth become the Chosen of Auril . Bjami , who had always been the Frostmaiden ' s follower , become ecstatic , seeing this as a sign of the coming of a new great age for all Reghedmen , under his and Hedrun ' s leadership . Thanks to some black ice , Bjami convinced Gunvald to ally with Hedrun in order to gain part of the spoils of war . He also moved the tribe ' s camp to near Hedrun ' s hideout in the Reghed Glacier . On Eleint 24 , Bjami led an attack of Hedrun ' s army against Elk warriors , killing or capturing many of them .

title: Black Altar
description: Black Altar The Black Altar was the temple complex devoted to the god Bane in the ruined city of Zhentil Keep . History . In 1263 DR , Fzoul Chembryl broke with the Black Lord ' s Altar , the orthodox banite church run by the High Imperceptor of Bane in Mulmaster and declared the Black Altar the new centre of the Black Lord ' s church .
description_long: Black Altar The Black Altar was the temple complex devoted to the god Bane in the ruined city of Zhentil Keep . History . In 1263 DR , Fzoul Chembryl broke with the Black Lord ' s Altar , the orthodox banite church run by the High Imperceptor of Bane in Mulmaster and declared the Black Altar the new centre of the Black Lord ' s church . With this power shift , Fzoul brought a large portion of Zhentil Keep ' s priests of Bane into the ranks of the Zhentarim . Fzoul remained highpriest of the Black Altar for much of his life . In 1357 DR , warrior - priests of the High Imperceptor briefly took control of the Black Altar , but Fzoul routed the orthodox banites . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , the Black Altar was destroyed when the avatar of the god Bane fell to the Realms directly on top of the temple . Bane ordered the temple to be rebuilt . On the final night of Marpenoth , 1361 DR , the Black Altar was again devastated by a huge column of flame that fell from a low hanging cloud . This was the signal that the Banedeath was to commence . Again , it was rebuilt , though as a temple to Cyric .

title: Black Ash Plain
description: Black Ash Plain Black Ash Plain was located west of Unther in East Faerûn . History . In 1373 DR , many refugees from the Untheric - Mulhorandi conflict ran through the plain .
description_long: Black Ash Plain Black Ash Plain was located west of Unther in East Faerûn . History . In 1373 DR , many refugees from the Untheric - Mulhorandi conflict ran through the plain . The ones that got out alive saw several ruined structures jutting up from the blackened earth . Survivors stated these ruins existed below the surface of the ground , but no one explored or proved that these subterranean levels even existed . When the Spellplague struck in 1385 DR , this wasteland , south of Tymanther , was devastated when part of Tymanchebar fell into Faerûn . Geography . Only sparse grass and twisted shrubs grow on the plain and strange rock formations shift and move around the landscape on their own . Many mysteries surrounded this dark land , which was blackened and infertile , so much even the Mulhorandi army avoided it . Inhabitants . Named for the volcanic black ash always falling from the Smoking Mountains to the north , the plains were home to dark skinned stone giant s , regionally called " ash giants " and brown dragon s .

title: Black Blood Tribe
description: Black Blood Tribe The Black Blood Tribe was a tribe of lycanthropes dedicated to summoning Kazgoroth , an aspect of the beastlord Malar , to Faerûn . The tribe was made up of both Faerûnian born lycanthropes as well as were - beasts from the Feywild . As of 1479 DR the tribe controlled most of Moray Isle in the Moonshae Isles .
description_long: Black Blood Tribe The Black Blood Tribe was a tribe of lycanthropes dedicated to summoning Kazgoroth , an aspect of the beastlord Malar , to Faerûn . The tribe was made up of both Faerûnian born lycanthropes as well as were - beasts from the Feywild . As of 1479 DR the tribe controlled most of Moray Isle in the Moonshae Isles .

title: Black Blood cultist
description: Black Blood cultist The Black Blood Cultist is a prestige class of Faerûn . The evil barbarian hordes of The North and other uncivilized , wild regions of the Realms came to idolize the shapeshifting worshipers of Malar , the People of the Black Blood . These Cultists of the Black Blood draw power from this idolization , becoming increasingly bestial and imitating the corrupt nature of their masters .
description_long: Black Blood cultist The Black Blood Cultist is a prestige class of Faerûn . The evil barbarian hordes of The North and other uncivilized , wild regions of the Realms came to idolize the shapeshifting worshipers of Malar , the People of the Black Blood . These Cultists of the Black Blood draw power from this idolization , becoming increasingly bestial and imitating the corrupt nature of their masters . Cultists of the Black Blood gain a variety of abilities that increase the power and frenzied ferocity upon their constant attacks on civilized beings of all races .

title: Black Chronology
description: Black Chronology " In the years before the Spellplague , word spread of a new Roll of Years , a Black Chronology fashioned by the goddess Shar , the Lady of Loss and her faithful . The purpose of this Shadow Roll was to mark the events that would lead to the ultimate ascendancy of Shar over all of Toril , but instead , the goddess of darkness ’ plans went all awry and brought on the Spellplague . " These are the years as dictated by the Black Chronology : 1352 the Year of the Lost King 1353 the Year of Masks 1354 the Year of Great Reaping 1355 the Year of Retreat 1356 the Year of the Drow 1357 the Year of Spell Flames 1358 the Year of Ascension 1359 the Year of the Carnival 1360 the Year of Armies 1361 the Year of the Golden Discovery 1362 the Year of the Sun 1363 the Year of Winter 1364 the Year of Lords 1365 the Year of Joyous Elves 1366 the Year of Icy Waters 1367 the Year of Unmasking 1368 the Year of Sons 1369 the Year of the City ' s Sorrows 1370 the Year of the Deep War 1371 the Year of the Toppling Towers 1372 the Year of the Dark Returns 1373 the Year of Madness 1374 the Year of Unraveling 1375 the Year of Harsh Goals 1376 the Year of False Hopes 1377 the Year of Black Banner 1378 the Year of Broken Hearts 1379 the Year of Lost Wisdom 1380 the Year of the Dull Blade 1381 the Year of the Fool 1382 the Year of Unwelcome Guests 1383 the Year of Unjust Rewards 1384 the Year of Stolen Thrones 1385 the Year of Revelation

title: Black Claw
description: Black Claw Black Claw was an orc tribe formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1026 DR , the Black Claw tribe was formed with the intention of destroying Waterdeep after the Brotherhood ' s previous attempt , the Broken Bone , succumbed to Lhammaruntosz .
description_long: Black Claw Black Claw was an orc tribe formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1026 DR , the Black Claw tribe was formed with the intention of destroying Waterdeep after the Brotherhood ' s previous attempt , the Broken Bone , succumbed to Lhammaruntosz . The tribe carried out massive raids on the Free City of Waterdeep , killing the city ' s leader , Warlord Laroun , before finally being defeated in the Stump Bog by Raurlor .

title: Black Claw Mercantile Company
description: Black Claw Mercantile Company The Black Claw Mercantile Company was a fellowship run mainly by House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Black Claw Mercantile Company The Black Claw Mercantile Company was a fellowship run mainly by House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan . It existed primarily to trade goods between Menzoberranzan and House Zauvirr in Ched Nasad , and was based upon a trade agreement .

title: Black Darts
description: Black Darts The Black Darts were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Darts was comprised of 2 , 000 manscorpion slaves who wielded javelin s effectively .
description_long: Black Darts The Black Darts were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Darts was comprised of 2 , 000 manscorpion slaves who wielded javelin s effectively . Activities . The Black Darts used their ranged weapons to weaken enemy lines for the infantry . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Black Darts .

title: Black Eagles
description: Black Eagles The Black Eagles , also called the Ashes , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Eagles were the only unit of jann among the armies of the efreet .
description_long: Black Eagles The Black Eagles , also called the Ashes , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Eagles were the only unit of jann among the armies of the efreet . The 3 , 000 hardened warriors of the Black Eagles were evenly divided between ranks of light cavalry , foot soldiers , and mounted archers . Activities . Each member of the Black Eagles was stolen from their tribe as a child . They were indoctrinated to be loyal servants to their efreet masters . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Black Eagles .

title: Black Flame Zealots
description: Black Flame Zealots The Black Flame Zealots , also known as the Order of The Black Flame , was a secret society of assassins who drew their power from the passions of anger and rage . They were originally only disciples of Kossuth , but their ardent practices have since inspired devotees of other worships to follow in their footsteps of the Black Flame Zealot . They served as the eyes , ears , and hands of Kossuth in Thay .
description_long: Black Flame Zealots The Black Flame Zealots , also known as the Order of The Black Flame , was a secret society of assassins who drew their power from the passions of anger and rage . They were originally only disciples of Kossuth , but their ardent practices have since inspired devotees of other worships to follow in their footsteps of the Black Flame Zealot . They served as the eyes , ears , and hands of Kossuth in Thay . They operated heavily before the Spellplague , and not even the mighty Zulkir were out of their reach . Since the Spellplague , the order has gone silent . However , there is some speculation of small sects working out of Amruthar . After the Spellplague , the Fire Knives were known to train new recruits in the ways of the original Black Flame Zealots , barring their initial strict worship of Kossuth . Assassin ' s guilds across the world began to harbor Black Flame Zealots disconnected from the worship of Kossuth .

title: Black Garius
description: Black Garius Black Garius was a powerful Luskan archmage , a member of the city ' s sinister ruling cabal , " Arcane Brotherhood . " Description . Garius wore regal - looking black robes and regarded others with a deep , intimidating stare .
description_long: Black Garius Black Garius was a powerful Luskan archmage , a member of the city ' s sinister ruling cabal , " Arcane Brotherhood . " Description . Garius wore regal - looking black robes and regarded others with a deep , intimidating stare . Abilities . A powerful necromancer , Garius was skilled enough to undertake the transformation in to lichdom . History . Early Life . Not much was known of his early life , save that he was once a lower level agent of theirs , Garius was noted for his nigh insatiable hunger for power and prestige , his never ending quest for these things brought him to meet with the fallen Guardian of Illefarn , the King of Shadows . As he entered his alliance with the shadow priests , unfortunate people who were enthralled into the King of Shadows ' clergy , Garius eventually came to realize that his place in this alliance was one that did not . . . " accommodate " his needs . Serving the King of Shadows . As he searched for a way to dupe the King of Shadows , Garius enlisted the aid of many powerful beings , among them , was the only man who was able to defeat the King of Shadows single handed , the mighty Warlock , Ammon Jerro .

title: Black Helm Tower
description: Black Helm Tower Black Helm Tower was the home of Black Vizor , one of the High Herald s of the organization known as the Heralds of Faerûn . Location . Black Helm Tower was located about a day ' s ride ( approximately 30 mi or 48 km ) to the north and east of Daggerford in west Faerûn , just north of the Delimbiyr river .
description_long: Black Helm Tower Black Helm Tower was the home of Black Vizor , one of the High Herald s of the organization known as the Heralds of Faerûn . Location . Black Helm Tower was located about a day ' s ride ( approximately 30 mi or 48 km ) to the north and east of Daggerford in west Faerûn , just north of the Delimbiyr river . Structure . This fortified compound sat on a small hill , affording it a minor strategic advantage .

title: Black Horde
description: Black Horde The Black Horde was the largest orc horde in the history of Faerûn . It compromised primarily of orcs and goblins . The Black Horde besieged countless settlements in the North and threatened kingdoms far south of it as well .
description_long: Black Horde The Black Horde was the largest orc horde in the history of Faerûn . It compromised primarily of orcs and goblins . The Black Horde besieged countless settlements in the North and threatened kingdoms far south of it as well . The Black Horde killed the Syl - Pasha of Calimport as well , in an attempt to take over the Prime Material Plane . The Horde attempted to take over Waterdeep , but failed in the process for two reasons : Ahghairon and his generals had provided griffon s and flying steeds for the army , and Waterdeep had called upon the Lords ' Alliance . The Lords ' Alliance sent the Company of the Crescent Blade , the militia of Baldur ' s Gate , led by Eldrith the Betrayer . Despite being outnumbered , Eldrith and her group attacked and scattered the horde . However , looking to deal a fateful blow on the horde to ensure it to never threaten Baldur ' s Gate again , as it would have attacked Baldur ' s Gate after Waterdeep , she defied the Grand Duke ' s orders and fought the horde for the second time . The horde , however , fought viciously and dealt Eldrith her first defeat , an action that would lead to the construction of the Onyx Tower .

title: Black Horn Regiment
description: Black Horn Regiment The Black Horn Regiment was a yugoloth mercenary company led by the ultroloth Inthracis . They were based in Corpsehaven within the Blood Rift . Description .
description_long: Black Horn Regiment The Black Horn Regiment was a yugoloth mercenary company led by the ultroloth Inthracis . They were based in Corpsehaven within the Blood Rift . Description . The company was composed by 500 members of various kinds of yugoloth . History . In 1373 DR , Inthracis was approached by the god Vhaeraun , who demanded that Inthracis kill the three priestesses who were candidates to become the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) : Quenthel Baenre , Danifae Yauntyrr , and Halisstra Melarn . As a reward , Vhaeraun promised Inthracis a higher position . Inthracis led his company to the Pass of the Soulreaver near the Demonweb Pits and there battled Quenthel , Danifae , Halisstra , Jeggred Baenre , and Pharaun Mizzrym . They defeated the regiment , however , and Inthracis was killed by Pharaun . His death was not permanent , however , as he had another clone body to revive in .

title: Black Isle Studios
description: Black Isle Studios Black Isle Studios was a division of the PC and video game developer and publisher Interplay Entertainment , created specifically for the development of PC role - playing games . The division was formed during 1996 , adopting the name " Black Isle Studios " during 1998 . The idea for the division ' s name came from the Black Isle in Scotland - founder Feargus Urquhart ' s native country .
description_long: Black Isle Studios Black Isle Studios was a division of the PC and video game developer and publisher Interplay Entertainment , created specifically for the development of PC role - playing games . The division was formed during 1996 , adopting the name " Black Isle Studios " during 1998 . The idea for the division ' s name came from the Black Isle in Scotland - founder Feargus Urquhart ' s native country . Black Isle Studios was most famous for working on the " Fallout " , " Icewind Dale " and " Baldur ' s Gate " series of PC role - playing games , though it only published the " Baldur ' s Gate " series . Closure . In 1998 , several key members responsible for the division ' s first title , " Fallout " , left Interplay to form Troika Games . On December 8 , 2003 , in the midst of serious financial difficulties , Interplay laid off the entire Black Isle Studios staff . , filing bankruptcy on June 2 , 2004 . By then , most members had moved on to found Obsidian Entertainment . Until last , Black Isle Studios worked on new innovative games , such as " Fallout 3 ( Codename : Van Buren ) " and " Black Isle ' s Torn " . Products .

title: Black Kumade
description: Black Kumade The Black Kumade was a magical javelin wielded by Lin Goh , clanmaster of the Panthers of Xi . It became a symbol of that ninja clan . It was an obsidian " + 2 javelin " that would return to its wielder when hurled .
description_long: Black Kumade The Black Kumade was a magical javelin wielded by Lin Goh , clanmaster of the Panthers of Xi . It became a symbol of that ninja clan . It was an obsidian " + 2 javelin " that would return to its wielder when hurled . It could also be spun like a baton to deflect attacks ; while spinning , it served as a " + 3 shield " .

title: Black Leopard Cult
description: Black Leopard Cult The Black Leopard Cult , later the Black Leopard Society was a very ancient and much - talked - about organization in T ' u Lung . Description . The Black Leopard Cult worshiped the Black Leopard Bauhei , an ancient greater spirit who preceded the Celestial Empire .
description_long: Black Leopard Cult The Black Leopard Cult , later the Black Leopard Society was a very ancient and much - talked - about organization in T ' u Lung . Description . The Black Leopard Cult worshiped the Black Leopard Bauhei , an ancient greater spirit who preceded the Celestial Empire . However , in early forms , their high priests in truth enslaved Bauhei to give them power they misused . History . Bauhei and his Black Leopard cultists ruled over the lands around Fenghsintsu province from before the founding of the empire of Shou Lung . In time , however , Bauhei was enslaved by the greedy high priest of the cult , Nan Kung Chi , who started a regime that spread terror . So Emperor Tan Chin , around - 1370 DR , decided to destroyed them . Thanks to his friend the poet wu jen Kar Wuan , Tan Chin went to the main temple in Durkon and managed to free Bauhei , who quickly killed Nan Kung Chi . The remaining followers fled out to sea , led by the Second High Priest of the order , so the Black Leopard Cult was defeated .

title: Black Lion ( tribe )
description: Black Lion ( tribe ) The Black Lion Tribe of the Uthgardt barbarian s were centered around the village of Beorunna ' s Well . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Lion ancestral mound was Beorunna ' s Well .
description_long: Black Lion ( tribe ) The Black Lion Tribe of the Uthgardt barbarian s were centered around the village of Beorunna ' s Well . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Lion ancestral mound was Beorunna ' s Well . Organization . It was within the Black Lion community of huts and long houses , the tribe found some contentment living as farmers and herders of livestock . Forsaking their barbaric heritage , their agricultural advancement allowed the tribe to become a source of trade in the region .

title: Black Mist
description: Black Mist The Black Mist gang was a recently formed yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Black Mist tried to control all illegal business in the city , entering in feud with both Big Head and Worthless Flower gang . The Black Mist in Nakamaru was not so powerful but elsewhere in Wa they were truly powerful and so the two other yakuza gang were cautious in trying to destroy the Black Mist .
description_long: Black Mist The Black Mist gang was a recently formed yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Black Mist tried to control all illegal business in the city , entering in feud with both Big Head and Worthless Flower gang . The Black Mist in Nakamaru was not so powerful but elsewhere in Wa they were truly powerful and so the two other yakuza gang were cautious in trying to destroy the Black Mist . The Black Mist followed the family - like - hierarchy but was also divided in into different branches , based on the type of illegal activity : one for gambling , one for protection and unique for Black Mist the gurentai , thugs than often attacked the Big Head bases . The Black Mist not had city ' s authorities ' recognition so they were always be on their guard against the police and local samurai . Instead they forged an alliance with traders of the foreign districts , especially merchants from Shou Lung .

title: Black Pearl
description: Black Pearl Black Pearl was a half - elf descended from a human and a sea elf . Description . Black Peal had white skin , dark eyes , and long black hair .
description_long: Black Pearl Black Pearl was a half - elf descended from a human and a sea elf . Description . Black Peal had white skin , dark eyes , and long black hair . History . Black Pearl ' s mother was rescued by sea elves after her ship was sunk off the coast of Calimport . Black Pearl did not feel accepted among the sea elves , so she spent most of her time with the selkie s in the ocean not far from Waterdeep . She participated in the Relay information system . Relationships . Black Pearl was acquainted with Arilyn Moonblade , who contacted her through the Relay . She and Arilyn shared a kinship because of their half - elven ancestry .

title: Black Raven Monastery
description: Black Raven Monastery Black Raven Monastery was founded in 1181 DR by Valas Belaem del Pharm . Geography . The monastery was located in the Spine of the World and connected Valas ' Tomb to the Underdark .
description_long: Black Raven Monastery Black Raven Monastery was founded in 1181 DR by Valas Belaem del Pharm . Geography . The monastery was located in the Spine of the World and connected Valas ' Tomb to the Underdark . Inhabitants . The monk s were taught to fight slavery of any kind , even imprisoning a criminal was prohibited by the monastery ' s philosophy . Furthermore , since Valas Black Raven was a slave , the monks believed all servants were to be treated with respect .

title: Black Raven Tribe
description: Black Raven Tribe The Black Raven Tribe was a particularly conservative band of the Uthgardt barbarian s who resided at Raven Rock . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Ravens ' ancestral mound was the Raven Rock .
description_long: Black Raven Tribe The Black Raven Tribe was a particularly conservative band of the Uthgardt barbarian s who resided at Raven Rock . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Ravens ' ancestral mound was the Raven Rock . Organization . They held to the old strict barbaric traditions and reacted violently to new customs or dynamics . They were the renowned raiders and bandits of the North , often preying on foreign merchants and missionaries . Appearances . In Icewind Dale II , the band of heroes crossed the Ice Marshes and were barraged by bands Black Raven barbarians numerous times . They got by the barbarian rock wall and then moved on to the white dragon lair .

title: Black Vizor
description: Black Vizor In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Black Vizor was one of the High Heralds . This office was charged with keeping a finger on the pulse of society , particularly political society in various states of conflict . The job required crisscrossing Faerûn to visit courts of nobles and governing bodies as well as regularly communicating with local Heralds and agents , keeping track of attitudes , mores , court dynamics , and intrigues , to declarations of war , peace treaties , trade agreements , and the balance of power .
description_long: Black Vizor In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Black Vizor was one of the High Heralds . This office was charged with keeping a finger on the pulse of society , particularly political society in various states of conflict . The job required crisscrossing Faerûn to visit courts of nobles and governing bodies as well as regularly communicating with local Heralds and agents , keeping track of attitudes , mores , court dynamics , and intrigues , to declarations of war , peace treaties , trade agreements , and the balance of power . This herculean task was greatly assisted by magical " portals " and various magical means of communicating . In addition to collecting this information for the Heralds , Black Vizor kept the Lords ' Alliance and the Merchant ' s League informed of the status of conflicts around Faerûn . The residence of this office was a fortification known as Black Helm Tower on the outskirts of Daggerford . Possessions . With the office came a giant - sized black war - helm which looked very threatening but was extremely heavy and unwieldy . Peering through the eyeslits gave Black Vizor " true sight " , allowing him or her to pierce illusions and avoid deception .

title: Black Watch
description: Black Watch The Black Watch was a dark group of mercenaries who operated in the Moonsea area . Equipment . Members of the Black Watch dressed in black clothing and wore chain mail with their demon ' s eye sigil .
description_long: Black Watch The Black Watch was a dark group of mercenaries who operated in the Moonsea area . Equipment . Members of the Black Watch dressed in black clothing and wore chain mail with their demon ' s eye sigil . History . In 1340 DR , the organization was hired by Gensor , a wizard working for Porphyrys Cadorna , to take control of the Cadorna Textile House and the library located in the ruins of Phlan . A little while later , the company took control of the city watch and assassinated the First Councilman of Phlan with an orc arrow , which allowed Cadorna to take the place of the councilman .

title: Black Wizards
description: Black Wizards Black Wizards , by Douglas Niles , is the second book in the Moonshae trilogy . Characters .
