title: Black bear
description: Black bear The black bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had black , blond , or cinnamon fur .
description_long: Black bear The black bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had black , blond , or cinnamon fur . Black bears on average were 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) . Behavior . These omnivore ursoids were not usually dangerous unless their cubs or food supply was threatened .

title: Black blade of disaster
description: Black blade of disaster Black blade of disaster was a drow arcane spell used to cut through anything in its path . Effect . This spell created a crack between the planes that looked like a dark blade .
description_long: Black blade of disaster Black blade of disaster was a drow arcane spell used to cut through anything in its path . Effect . This spell created a crack between the planes that looked like a dark blade . It was directed by the caster through concentration and could be wielded like a weapon to do great damage against creatures and even " disintegrate " them if a vital spot was hit . It also damaged man - made structures and could penetrate magical barriers like a " prismatic wall " or " sphere " , a " wall of force " , or an " antimagic shell " . Components . Proper casting of this spell required verbal and somatic component s only . Users . " Black blade of disaster " was a spell of the dreaded drow of the Underdark , but was also known and used by dimensionalist s due to its plane - related nature .

title: Black cloud of vengeance
description: Black cloud of vengeance The Black cloud of vengeance was a creation of those who violated the Laws of the Loregiver in the early days of the world . Although these were rare creations , they were mentioned in almost all cultures in Zakhara . Many people believed that only one cloud existed , but some wise men believed otherwise .
description_long: Black cloud of vengeance The Black cloud of vengeance was a creation of those who violated the Laws of the Loregiver in the early days of the world . Although these were rare creations , they were mentioned in almost all cultures in Zakhara . Many people believed that only one cloud existed , but some wise men believed otherwise . Black clouds were terrifying creatures possessing enormous strength . They were capable of moving against the strongest gales . Description . Red lightning flashed within the depths of a black cloud of vengeance . Their wind carried ash and soot mixed with debris . The winds increased their fury as the cloud approached . Their hum could only be compared with the strongest desert storms . A black cloud carried churning sand from the desert , making it extremely difficult for any living creature to breath . Combat . Regarding combat , black clouds of vengeance were capable of destroying entire cities just like a powerful tornado . Habitat / Society . Black Clouds combined the power of fire and wind into a deadly combination . Even the wisest sages were unclear about their origins , but believed that the clouds were sent by Fate to punish infidels .

title: Black dragon
description: Black dragon Black dragons , also known as skull dragons , are far and away the most vile tempered and cruel of all chromatic dragon s . Physical description . Black dragons appear abnormally slender in comparison to other chromatic dragons — wiry , but not gaunt .
description_long: Black dragon Black dragons , also known as skull dragons , are far and away the most vile tempered and cruel of all chromatic dragon s . Physical description . Black dragons appear abnormally slender in comparison to other chromatic dragons — wiry , but not gaunt . Physically , black dragons are most distinguished by their horns , which protrude from the sides of their heads and wrap around , projecting forward . A large frill adorns the upper part of the neck . They smell like rotting vegetation and foul water . A black dragon can grow up to a maximum size of 16 ft ( 4 . 9 m ) tall , 85 ft ( 25 . 9 m ) long , with a wingspan of 80 ft ( 24 . 4 m ) . It can weigh up to 160 , 000 lbs ( 72 . 6 mt ) . Combat . Black dragons prefer ambushes to straightforward fighting . They are vicious and ruthless adversaries , and their acidic bile can work its way under the heaviest armor with ease . Their only disadvantage is that their heavily wooded habitats tend to prevent them from flying very high in combat . Breath weapon . Black dragons expel a line of highly corrosive acid . Ecology . Lair . Black dragons live in swamps and fetid marshlands .

title: Black kumade ( Neverwinter Nights )
description: Black kumade ( Neverwinter Nights ) A black kumade was one of a number of magical spears once wielded by Guul Shatterneck and his bandits in the North of Faerûn . Description . These spears had three - pronged heads , hence their name as " kumades " , a type of weaponized rake of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Black kumade ( Neverwinter Nights ) A black kumade was one of a number of magical spears once wielded by Guul Shatterneck and his bandits in the North of Faerûn . Description . These spears had three - pronged heads , hence their name as " kumades " , a type of weaponized rake of Kara - Tur . Powers . A " black kumade " was a " + 2 spear " that also granted a degree of resistance to spell s . History . The bandit Guul Shatterneck and his kin used the " black kumades " to harass and dispatch their victims . Following the bandits ' defeat to the Gray Wolf Tribe , the " black kumades " circulated around the North and other lands .

title: Black opal
description: Black opal Black Opal is a greenish type of with black mottling and gold flecks . Usually found in ancient hot springs , the gem is usually tumbled smooth and cut cabochon . The phrase in the North " Black as a black opal " means , effectively , not very black ( or evil ) at all , and is used to describe good - hearted rogues and similar individuals who would be embarrassed by praise .
description_long: Black opal Black Opal is a greenish type of with black mottling and gold flecks . Usually found in ancient hot springs , the gem is usually tumbled smooth and cut cabochon . The phrase in the North " Black as a black opal " means , effectively , not very black ( or evil ) at all , and is used to describe good - hearted rogues and similar individuals who would be embarrassed by praise . A typical specimen has a base value of 1000gp . Uses . A black opal ( but not a normal opal ) could be used to enhance the effects of a wand , that contained a spell of the subschool of force . Only one could be built in per wand and once built in the wand ' s force spell magic either got harder for the target to resist or the strength behind the spell increased . This was a very attractive method for wand crafters to increase their wand ' s effectiveness . Normally crafting stronger wands required more spellcasting skills from the crafter , which he may not possess . The other aspect was more interesting . Normally , crafting any kind of magic item burnt some of the inner essence of the crafter , the stronger the item the more was burned .

title: Black pudding
description: Black pudding A black pudding was an ooze resembling a bubbling , heaping pile of thick black goo . Description . The average black pudding measured 15 ft ( 4 .
description_long: Black pudding A black pudding was an ooze resembling a bubbling , heaping pile of thick black goo . Description . The average black pudding measured 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) across and 2 ft ( 0 . 6 m ) thick and they weighed around 18 , 000 lb ( 8 . 2 mt ) . While most of these monsters were an inky black , some could be brown , grey , and even white . In underground locations , these creatures appeared as dark blobs . Behavior . These creatures were mindless underground - dwelling scavengers that wandered and absorbed whatever they found . A black pudding would position itself in a dungeon hallway like a shadow and wait for unsuspecting prey . Combat . Black pudding attacked by grabbing , grappling and constricting prey directly into their liquid - esque mass . Like other oozes , they also secreted a deadly acidic substance which strongly and quickly dissolved weapons , clothing , and organic tissue alike . When slashed at or pierced , the black pudding split into two smaller puddings , both of which would do the same ; this continued until they were too small and weak to do so further . A black pudding would eat bone , metal , and wood leaving only stone behind . Ecology .

title: Black sapphire
description: Black sapphire Black Sapphire was a rare variety of sapphire that was a deep , rich black with yellow or white highlights . They were found mostly in the South with the greatest concentration in the Great Rift . These stones were highly valued by dwarves .
description_long: Black sapphire Black Sapphire was a rare variety of sapphire that was a deep , rich black with yellow or white highlights . They were found mostly in the South with the greatest concentration in the Great Rift . These stones were highly valued by dwarves . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp Uses . A black sapphire ( but not a normal sapphire ) could be used to enhance the effects of a wand , that contained a spell of the subschool of darkness . Only one could be built in per wand and once built in the wand ' s darkness spell magic either got harder for the target to resist or the strength behind the spell increased . This was a very attractive method for wand crafters to increase their wand ' s effectiveness . Normally crafting stronger wands required more spellcasting skills from the crafter , which he may not possess . The other aspect was more interesting . Normally , crafting any kind of magic item burnt some of the inner essence of the crafter , the stronger the item the more was burned . Adding a gem was a way to increase the effectiveness of a wand without sacrificing one ' s own essence .

title: Black talon
description: Black talon Black talon was a divine magic spell available to priests of Cyric , the Prince of Madness . It turned the caster ' s arm into a claw - tipped , stretchable appendage for a short time . Effects .
description_long: Black talon Black talon was a divine magic spell available to priests of Cyric , the Prince of Madness . It turned the caster ' s arm into a claw - tipped , stretchable appendage for a short time . Effects . This spell lasted for at least three minutes , with more experienced casters able to add more minutes to the duration . When cast , one of the caster ' s arms became stretchable out to a distance of 10 ft ( 3 m ) and the hand became a talon with sharp nails . The caster could extend or retract this appendage at will to attack a foe . The " talon " could do a small amount of both physical damage and magical cold damage on a successful attack . A victim had a chance to resist the cold portion and took only half the damage if successful . Undead creatures were immune to the chilling damage . While this spell was in effect , the caster was unable to cast any spell that required a somatic component . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Black unicorn
description: Black unicorn Black unicorns are fiendish versions of their good unicorn brethren , magically created by the Red Wizards of Thay . They have become prominent in the armies of Thay , serving as elite cavalry . Black unicorns will only allow human or drow females of an evil alignment to ride them .
description_long: Black unicorn Black unicorns are fiendish versions of their good unicorn brethren , magically created by the Red Wizards of Thay . They have become prominent in the armies of Thay , serving as elite cavalry . Black unicorns will only allow human or drow females of an evil alignment to ride them . It is believed they particularly enjoy serving Blackguards .

title: Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop
description: Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop is a store and a trading post run by none othere than the Harper Ulblyn Blackalbuck . With a large outdoor terrace for adventurers and traders to display their wares , the Swap Shop is a great place to trade equipment or information to others .
description_long: Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop is a store and a trading post run by none othere than the Harper Ulblyn Blackalbuck . With a large outdoor terrace for adventurers and traders to display their wares , the Swap Shop is a great place to trade equipment or information to others .

title: Blackbread
description: Blackbread Blackbread was a type of bread made from flour and Amn ish molasses . Description . Molasses gave blackbread its dark color .
description_long: Blackbread Blackbread was a type of bread made from flour and Amn ish molasses . Description . Molasses gave blackbread its dark color . It was similar to bread . Availability . Blackbread was available in Amn . It was also available from the Friendly Flounder tavern in Waterdeep .

title: Blackbutter Inn
description: Blackbutter Inn Blackbutter Inn was an inn owned by Dhelosk Quelbeard in the town of Red Larch . Structure . The inn was a two - story building of stone and timber with a covered porch that ran parallel to the Long Road .
description_long: Blackbutter Inn Blackbutter Inn was an inn owned by Dhelosk Quelbeard in the town of Red Larch . Structure . The inn was a two - story building of stone and timber with a covered porch that ran parallel to the Long Road . History . The Blackbutter Inn was named after the Barglun Blackbutter , the founder and previous owner of the inn who was killed around 1365 DR .

title: Blackdagger Bandits
description: Blackdagger Bandits The Blackdagger Bandits were a powerful bandit group operated on the High Road led by the brothers Malus and Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .
description_long: Blackdagger Bandits The Blackdagger Bandits were a powerful bandit group operated on the High Road led by the brothers Malus and Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan . In the years just after the Spellplague of 1385 DR , they began their bandit careers with only a handful of men , but their ruthlessness and keen eye for opportunity earned them great success . The Blackdagger Bandits , as they were called , gained some measure of fame , and criminals flocked to join them . With the rebuilding of Neverwinter and the subsequent increase in trade , the Blackdagger Bandits saw an even greater increase both to their income and to their ranks . After Neverwinter put a bounty or their heads , the two brothers disappeared for a time and started rumors that they had been killed and someone else led the Blackdagger Bandits . The truth was more nefarious : the Red Wizard necromancer Kallos Tam had transformed them into undead in order to use them and their forces to attack the city of Neverwinter .

title: Blackfeather Bridge
description: Blackfeather Bridge Blackfeather Bridge was the name of a village surrounding the bridge of the same name across the River Ashaba in Featherdale on Raauthauvyr ' s Road . History . The village of Blackfeather Bridge was founded in 1358 DR The Blackfeather Bridge itself was once a wooden bridge painted black , but by 1368 DR , it was made of stone .
description_long: Blackfeather Bridge Blackfeather Bridge was the name of a village surrounding the bridge of the same name across the River Ashaba in Featherdale on Raauthauvyr ' s Road . History . The village of Blackfeather Bridge was founded in 1358 DR The Blackfeather Bridge itself was once a wooden bridge painted black , but by 1368 DR , it was made of stone . Geography . The village marked the western end of Featherdale . Notable locations . Temples . The Blackfeather bridge itself was considered a sacred site for the church of Cyric , as it was the location Cyric killed Leira . , and where mortal Cyric passed in life .

title: Blackguard
description: Blackguard Blackguard , also referred to by some as the antipaladin , is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn that epitomizes pure evil . Nothing short of a mortal fiend , they are quintessential black knights , carrying a reputation of the foulest sort . Consorting with demon s and devil s while serving dark deities , blackguards are hated and feared by all .
description_long: Blackguard Blackguard , also referred to by some as the antipaladin , is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn that epitomizes pure evil . Nothing short of a mortal fiend , they are quintessential black knights , carrying a reputation of the foulest sort . Consorting with demon s and devil s while serving dark deities , blackguards are hated and feared by all . They usually lead legions of undead , evil outsiders or other monsters to conquer under their own guide . Occasionally guards might end up as wandering purveyors of chaotic destruction , attacking with honorless guile or flat out smiting the forces of good that stand in their way . Fighter s , ex - paladin s , ranger s , monk s , druid s and barbarian s make for forceful combat - oriented blackguards , while rogue s and bard s are more likely to stress the subtle aspects of their abilities and spells . Sorcerer s , wizard s and cleric s who become blackguards favor dealing with fiends especially .

title: Blackhold
description: Blackhold Blackhold was a trademoot located in a cavern of the nation of Fimbrul , on Returned Abeir . It was inhabited only by humanoid s . Background .
description_long: Blackhold Blackhold was a trademoot located in a cavern of the nation of Fimbrul , on Returned Abeir . It was inhabited only by humanoid s . Background . The population of Blackhold was not fixed , waning and waxing with the passage of travelers and adventurers exploring the Howling Mountains . Blackhold was rarely attacked by dragon s , giant s or other monsters , and thus was considered neutral territory . Economy . Adventurers and travelers used Blackhold to get supplies , to rest during their travels , or to recruit new companions . The few permanent residents traded with them and with the dwarves of the nearby settlement of Forgefires . Architecture . Blackhold was made originally by dwarves , inside of a cavern near the surface of the Howling Mountains . Its dwellings were chains of narrow - linked side chambers cut into the walls of the cavern . The main area was dominated by beast pens , rocks that served as a podium , and by a pool referred to as the Drinkwater Pool .

title: Blackjackal
description: Blackjackal Blackjackal was the lieutenant and later the leader of a small tribe of elves living in the eastern starwood of Cormanthor . The elven tribe once used a large area of blueberries as their primary food source , which they shared amiably with shambling mound s . When a couatl covered in strange markings fell out of the sky into the blueberry field , the elves and mounds did not think much of it , but its decomposing corpse infected the blueberries with a form of vine blight .
description_long: Blackjackal Blackjackal was the lieutenant and later the leader of a small tribe of elves living in the eastern starwood of Cormanthor . The elven tribe once used a large area of blueberries as their primary food source , which they shared amiably with shambling mound s . When a couatl covered in strange markings fell out of the sky into the blueberry field , the elves and mounds did not think much of it , but its decomposing corpse infected the blueberries with a form of vine blight . The elves blamed their leader for this , and Blackjackal urged them to crush his head with a rock , assuming leadership for himself . Blackjackal formed an alliance with some of the shambling mounds , and the elves and mounds roamed the starwood , attacking whoever they found in the name of Talos .

title: Blacklight
description: Blacklight Blacklight was an evocation or alteration spell that created an area of magical darkness that only the caster could see through . Effects . " Blacklight " was very similar to " darkness " with the exception that the caster could act and see normally while within the area of effect .
description_long: Blacklight Blacklight was an evocation or alteration spell that created an area of magical darkness that only the caster could see through . Effects . " Blacklight " was very similar to " darkness " with the exception that the caster could act and see normally while within the area of effect . Normal light sources were extinguished by " blacklight " , as well as lower - level " light " spells . Those outside the sphere of darkness , including the caster , could not see into the affected area . The older version of this spell created a stationary area while the newer version could be cast on a movable object if desired . For the older version of " blacklight " , every minute spent inside the blacklit area allowed a creature a chance to overcome the blindness , but it was difficult , and even if they succeeded their sight returned for only one minute . Also , " light " , " continual light " , or " dispel magic " would dissipate the older " blacklight " . For the newer version , " blacklight " countered " daylight " and any lower - level . " Blacklight " was countered by " daylight " and any higher - level light spells . Components .

title: Blackrazor
description: Blackrazor Blackrazor , also known as the Sword of Souls , is a greatsword that appears to be forged from an unknown alloy of steel . It is sheathed in a black scabbard decorated with pieces of cut obsidian . When held , it shines like the night sky filled with stars .
description_long: Blackrazor Blackrazor , also known as the Sword of Souls , is a greatsword that appears to be forged from an unknown alloy of steel . It is sheathed in a black scabbard decorated with pieces of cut obsidian . When held , it shines like the night sky filled with stars . The wielder of the sword hears faint whispers whenever it delivers the killing stroke to a living creature . The sword has a sentient being of another plane of existence forced into it . This creature was once a powerful undead creature similar to an atropal . Blackrazor in Baldur ' s Gate II . Blackrazor is a longsword with powerful enchantments but an evil nature . It is offered to the protagonist of the game in the test of greed in the Pocket Plane near the end of " " . They may either choose to use it to kill an enslaved genie guarding one of the Tears of Bhaal and keep it , benefitting from its power especially if and when their story continues in " " , or choose to relinquish it , avoiding a fight and passing the test in the " good " way . Blackrazor has a + 3 enhancement bonus , and when wielded grants regeneration and immunity to Charm and Fear effects .

title: Blackscale
description: Blackscale The Blackscales were a tribe and subrace of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . Description . A blackscale was a humanoid reptilian , resembling other lizardfolk but much larger , standing 8 .
description_long: Blackscale The Blackscales were a tribe and subrace of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . Description . A blackscale was a humanoid reptilian , resembling other lizardfolk but much larger , standing 8 . 5 – 9 . 5 feet ( 2 . 6 – 2 . 9 meters ) tall and weighing around 600 pounds ( 270 kilograms ) , about the size of an ogre . It had stocky and thickly muscled build and its scales were black , and its tail was 4 – 5 feet ( 1 . 2 – 1 . 5 meters ) . Its sunken eyes and flat nostrils gave it a skull - like appearance , and a leathery crest ran from the top of its head to halfway down its back . It had claws and fangs like regular lizardfolk . Abilities . Blackscales were much like ordinary lizardfolk but larger and stronger , possessing a tougher scaly hide that protected against blows , an ability to hold their breath for long periods of time , and the same skill in swimming , leaping , and balancing . However , they also had darkvision and a resistance to acid . Personality . Blackscales were proud and ferocious warriors , focused on performing mighty deeds and gaining glory . They were highly dangerous when provoked , and weren ' t even as smart as other lizardfolk .

title: Blackstaff
description: Blackstaff Blackstaff is the title and name given to the master of the eponymous staff and Blackstaff Tower and the Archmage of Waterdeep . “ Blackstaff ” was originally a nickname given to Khelben Arunsun because of his powerful staff of the same name , but after his death it became the title used by his successors . Blackstaffs .
description_long: Blackstaff Blackstaff is the title and name given to the master of the eponymous staff and Blackstaff Tower and the Archmage of Waterdeep . “ Blackstaff ” was originally a nickname given to Khelben Arunsun because of his powerful staff of the same name , but after his death it became the title used by his successors . Blackstaffs . Over time , rituals and traditions formed , and it became customary for the Blackstaff to choose an heir . The heir served as the apprentice and assistant to the Blackstaff . The magical quasi - spirits of the former Blackstaffs reside within the tower and serve as advisors to the Blackstaff . They are not true spirits but are green - tinged facsimiles produced by the green " kiira " whose magic was bound to the tower . The " kiira n ’ vaelhar " once held the spirits and combined knowledge of the first three Blackstaffs , Khelben Arusun , Tsarra Chaadren , and Kyriani Agrivar , but Krehlan Arunsun and the Grand Mages of Rhymanthiin dissipated the " kiira " in the Year of Staves Arcane ( 1415 DR ) and bound its magic to Blackstaff Tower and its twin in Rhymanthiin , N ’ Vaerymanth .

title: Blackstaff ( spell )
description: Blackstaff ( spell ) Blackstaff was a spell applied to a staff or quarterstaff that enhanced its combat effectiveness , and gave it the ability to dispel magic or cause a spellcaster it struck to lose a prepared spell . History . This spell was created by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was part of the reason why his common appellation was " Blackstaff " , as he carried a staff of power that had this spell cast on it with permanency .
description_long: Blackstaff ( spell ) Blackstaff was a spell applied to a staff or quarterstaff that enhanced its combat effectiveness , and gave it the ability to dispel magic or cause a spellcaster it struck to lose a prepared spell . History . This spell was created by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was part of the reason why his common appellation was " Blackstaff " , as he carried a staff of power that had this spell cast on it with permanency . The blackstaff spell was found in " Laeral ' s Libram " , a spellbook written by the wizard Laeral Silverhand . Laeral lost the spellbook sometime during her madness induced by the Crown of Horns , and it was not been seen since . Khelben only shared this spell with those he trusted implicitly . However , by 1373 DR , the spell blackstaff was known and in use across the Realms .

title: Blackstaff ( staff )
description: Blackstaff ( staff ) The Blackstaff was the name for a series of powerful magical staves , created and used by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and / or his successor . It was believed that Khelben Arunsun , who carried the first Blackstaff title , selected a new Blackstaff every time he left Blackstaff Tower . However , it always appeared as a long wooden staff .
description_long: Blackstaff ( staff ) The Blackstaff was the name for a series of powerful magical staves , created and used by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and / or his successor . It was believed that Khelben Arunsun , who carried the first Blackstaff title , selected a new Blackstaff every time he left Blackstaff Tower . However , it always appeared as a long wooden staff . It was longer than an average human was tall , roughly seven feet from base to tip . A ring of bulbs circled the staff at about eye level , and the staff was topped by a curved claw shape . The entire staff was pure black in color . Samark Dhanzscul , the sixth Blackstaff , carried a staff known as the Duskstaff , which was a twisted metal staff with a crystal on top that flashed various colors . It was unknown whether this was an iteration of a Blackstaff or a different staff . The Duskstaff could only be moved by the current Blackstaff or by someone wielding Ncral ' s Ring . Vajra Safahr , the seventh Blackstaff , carried a silver - shod Blackstaff . The Blackstaff she carried when proclaiming her status as the new Blackstaff was a rune - inscribed duskwood staff with silver veins . The whole staff was blackened by use .

title: Blackstaff Tower
description: Blackstaff Tower Blackstaff Tower ( previously Arunsun Tower ; renamed by Khelben in 1322 DR ) was the home of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . The forbidding structure is one of the most recognizable landmarks in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . It was also the home of his apprentices and his consort Laeral Silverhand .
description_long: Blackstaff Tower Blackstaff Tower ( previously Arunsun Tower ; renamed by Khelben in 1322 DR ) was the home of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . The forbidding structure is one of the most recognizable landmarks in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . It was also the home of his apprentices and his consort Laeral Silverhand . The tower was protected against scrying magic . Structure . Exterior . Blackstaff Tower ' s main entrance was on Swords Street . There was also an apprentice ' s gate , through which apprentices could gain access by touching the gate with a left palm . The tower was surrounded by a 20 - foot wall . The appeared to be made out of smooth black stone , with no windows or doors . From the outside , the structure appeared to be a three - story stone tower , but inside , there were at least a dozen more levels , and some of these could only be reached by magical means . Everything connected to the central stairwell , although magical passwords were required to transport to certain areas of this stairwell . The three levels visible from the outside were all freely accessible via simply using the stairs .

title: Blackstaff Tower ( novel )
description: Blackstaff Tower ( novel ) Blackstaff Tower by Steven E . Schend is the first novel in the Waterdeep series . Summary .
description_long: Blackstaff Tower ( novel ) Blackstaff Tower by Steven E . Schend is the first novel in the Waterdeep series . Summary . The story takes place between 20 Marpenoth and 20 Nightal , 1479 DR . The story opens with Samark " the Blackstaff " Dhanzscul entering the tomb of Khelben Arunsun as his heir , Vajra Safahr , waits outside . Samark enters the tomb and retrieves the gold ring from Ahghairon ' s statue , as well as the silver and sapphire amulet from around its neck . When he exits the tomb , men in the service of Khondar " Ten - Rings " Naomal have taken Vajra hostage . Samark and Vajra , who can cast spells non - verbally , soon obtain the upper hand , but then suddenly Khondar ' s son Centiv Naomal arrives and kills Samark . In the next scene , young nobleman Renaer Neverember and his friend Torlyn Wands sit in a tavern discussing the progress of their book collections . Their friends Faxhal Xoram and Vharem Kuthcutter soon arrive and tell them that the Watch is after them . The four give the Watch the slip by using little - known routes through the city .

title: Blackstone
description: Blackstone Earl Blackstone of Fairheight was an earl who lived in the Moonshaes . He kept a pack of moorhound s , one of whom was called Warlock . Relations .
description_long: Blackstone Earl Blackstone of Fairheight was an earl who lived in the Moonshaes . He kept a pack of moorhound s , one of whom was called Warlock . Relations . Blackstone ' s son and heir , Currag Blackstone , was killed in mysterious circumstances in 1365 DR .

title: Blacktalons
description: Blacktalons The Blacktalons were a mercenary group based out of Iriaebor who predominantly took contracts guarding and raiding caravans . Led by Taurgosz Khosann , they were an unscrupulous company known for their autonomy , vengeance ( when they were cheated out of money ) , and for never reneging on a contract . As a testament to the bandits who preceded them , the Blacktalons were known for raiding unguarded caravans in order to encourage their owners to seek their protection .
description_long: Blacktalons The Blacktalons were a mercenary group based out of Iriaebor who predominantly took contracts guarding and raiding caravans . Led by Taurgosz Khosann , they were an unscrupulous company known for their autonomy , vengeance ( when they were cheated out of money ) , and for never reneging on a contract . As a testament to the bandits who preceded them , the Blacktalons were known for raiding unguarded caravans in order to encourage their owners to seek their protection . History . Formed less than a decade before 1358 DR , the Blacktalons were merely a gang of bandits before Taurgosz " Tenhammer " Khosann attained leadership of the gang ( along with his nickname ) by slaying ten men with a single swing of his warhammer . As the leader , he remade them into a legal mercenary company . While he led as a dictator , " Tenhammer " later established a small council with whom he conferred . Cost . The Blacktalons charged one gold piece per person per day for guard duty . A raid would cost 300 gold pieces , in advance .

title: Blackthorn
description: Blackthorn Blackthorn was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Blackthorn was a half - elf living in the Gulthmere Forest until human expansion in the area consumed him with bitterness .
description_long: Blackthorn Blackthorn was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Blackthorn was a half - elf living in the Gulthmere Forest until human expansion in the area consumed him with bitterness . Blackthorn decided to not only fight back against humanity but also conduct his personal war in one of the biggest cities of the Realms . He went to Westgate and joined the Night Masks , using his talents as a poisoner for the guild . In time , Blackthorn learned that the guild was a very useful tool in his war and he greatly delighted in poisoning merchants involved in the timber market .

title: Blackwash Fens
description: Blackwash Fens The Blackwash Fens was a boggy lowland area found along the coast of the Great Sea in the far northern reaches of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The fens were located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire on the banks of the River Ruin at the edge of Pearl Bay near the city of Lipo .
description_long: Blackwash Fens The Blackwash Fens was a boggy lowland area found along the coast of the Great Sea in the far northern reaches of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The fens were located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire on the banks of the River Ruin at the edge of Pearl Bay near the city of Lipo . The fens were created by the heavy rainfall the region experienced . The depth of the fens was determined by both the tides of the Great Sea and the current state of the River Ruin .

title: Blade
description: Blade A blade is a term meaning an edge that is sharp and used to cut . It is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons made of metal or other rigid material where the cutting edge makes up most of the length of the weapon , unlike axe s and pole arm s where the cutting edge is much shorter than the overall length . See Blade ( disambiguation ) for other uses of this name .

It is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons made of metal or other rigid material where the cutting edge makes up most of the length of the weapon , unlike axe s and pole arm s where the cutting edge is much shorter than the overall length . title: Blade ( individual )
description: Blade ( individual ) Blade was a wood elf fighter and assassin who ultimately abandoned his party of evildoers . Description . Long , brown hair framed Blade ' s stern face , which was adorned with green eyes , full lips , and a prominent nose .
description_long: Blade ( individual ) Blade was a wood elf fighter and assassin who ultimately abandoned his party of evildoers . Description . Long , brown hair framed Blade ' s stern face , which was adorned with green eyes , full lips , and a prominent nose . Personality . Blade was not a gentle man , but he also found the company of evil tiresome . Possessions . His extensive equipment included thieves ' tools , a dagger made from rib bone and obsidian , caltrop s , a pair of " bracers of defense " , a " ring of protection " , as well as a " cloak of protection " . History . Blade started out as a fighter , but was taught the art of assassination by his brother , who was an expert poison er . Blade followed in his brother ' s footsteps for a while , working as an assassin , but eventually grew tired of his evil compatriots and abandoned them .

title: Blade - rite
description: Blade - rite The ritual of Blade - rite was an elven ritual that involved the drawing of a magical sword to determine the worthiness of its wielder for a given assignment or position among the hierarchy of the elves . It was most closely associated with the drawing of the famous Elfblade s , used to determine the Coronal of Cormanthyr , and his two Defenders , the Arms - Major and the Spell - Major . Nature of the Rite .
description_long: Blade - rite The ritual of Blade - rite was an elven ritual that involved the drawing of a magical sword to determine the worthiness of its wielder for a given assignment or position among the hierarchy of the elves . It was most closely associated with the drawing of the famous Elfblade s , used to determine the Coronal of Cormanthyr , and his two Defenders , the Arms - Major and the Spell - Major . Nature of the Rite . The potent and ancient Blade - rite was always attended and closely governed by two elven High Mages . During the ritual , the sword ' s magic was enhanced by High Magic , creating a powerful test for any potential ruler . The testing challenged the would - be wielder ' s practical skills , their reasoning , and their character , and these tests occurred completely within the imagination of the candidate , privy only to himself and the two High Mages . Should the elf pass all three tests , he or she rose to the rank befitting the blade . Should they fail , however , certain consequences would befall him or her as befitting the blade he or she had drawn .

title: Blade and Stars
description: Blade and Stars The Blade and Stars was an inn in Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast of Faerûn . Structure . The long building was four stories high with an attached stable .
description_long: Blade and Stars The Blade and Stars was an inn in Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast of Faerûn . Structure . The long building was four stories high with an attached stable . The kitchens were on one side and the upper - room balconies were on the other . The rooms were tidy and clean . The front lobby hosted a small lounge where guests could meet citizens . Outside , the inn sign displayed a female hand clutching a lightly curved saber and several enchanted stars that twinkled softly . It was rumored the sign was plundered and purchased years ago from a raiding party in Amn . Atmosphere . The inn was fairly quiet and sold drinks at moderate prices . Meals were served in guests ' rooms rather than a dining room and consisted of regular ale , bread , and fish . The bread could be ordered with cheese or melted eggs . On winter nights , the staff served ruby cordial , a sweet brew of cherries dissolved in sugared red wine . Staff . The innkeeper , Aundegul Shawn , hired several guards to turn away street rogue s and thugs from entering the establishment . They were especially on the lookout for doppleganger s , which posed a growing problem in Baldur ' s Gate around 1367 DR .

title: Blade banshee
description: Blade banshee Blade banshees are eladrin ranger s trained in the art of wielding enchanted longsword s with another melee weapon . The rangers channel their innately magic al nature into the blade s they wield , making them deadly foes with a terrifying bond with their very weapons . The enchanted sword they wield sings in a ghostly voice , shrieking with each blow the blade banshee delivers and striking fear into the eladrin ' s foes .
description_long: Blade banshee Blade banshees are eladrin ranger s trained in the art of wielding enchanted longsword s with another melee weapon . The rangers channel their innately magic al nature into the blade s they wield , making them deadly foes with a terrifying bond with their very weapons . The enchanted sword they wield sings in a ghostly voice , shrieking with each blow the blade banshee delivers and striking fear into the eladrin ' s foes . Culture . Because eladrin originated in the Feywild much of their approach to combat and life in general seems almost artistic , be their methods good or evil . As a result , it is little surprise than that blade banshees treat their swordplay as a practice as deserving of delicate precision and creativity as painting or music . Both the traditions of the bladesinger and the blade banshee emerged from this philosophy . In the case of the blade banshee , eladrin are taught to channel their very essence into the blades they wield , particularly the traditional weapon of the eladrin race , the longsword . The longswords so enchanted have a special beauty to them .

title: Blade barrier
description: Blade barrier Blade barrier was an evocation spell that summoned a wall of spinning , razor - sharp blades of force . Effects . Older versions of this spell created a deadly curtain that could be as small as 5 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Blade barrier Blade barrier was an evocation spell that summoned a wall of spinning , razor - sharp blades of force . Effects . Older versions of this spell created a deadly curtain that could be as small as 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) square or as large as 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) square . Newer versions capped the height at 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) and the shape could be a straight wall or a circular barrier whose length or radius was dependent on the caster ' s level . Any creature passing through the wall was harmed , although nimble creatures could avoid some of the blades from the newer version of the spell . If cast in an area already occupied , those quick enough could avoid the wall as it formed and be safely on whichever side they chose . The barrier not only kept opponents at bay , but also provided some cover from ranged attacks that passed through it . After the Sundering the spell changed to cover more area in ether a wall or a ringed wall . The straight wall could stretch 100 feet long ( 30 , 48 meters ) , 20 feet high ( 6 . 096 meters ) and 5 feet thick ( 1 . 524 meters ) . The round wall could have up to 60 feet in diameter , 20 feet high and also 5 feet think . Components .

title: Blade dancer
description: Blade dancer Blade dancers are ranger s , typically of the two - blade , though not necessarily , whose combat style mimics dance in its grace and its refinement . To a blade dancer , their dual weapons , often blade s of some sort , are as two dance partners with whom they train and choreograph constantly . Masters of footwork as well as fencing , blade dancers are as deadly as they are elegant .
description_long: Blade dancer Blade dancers are ranger s , typically of the two - blade , though not necessarily , whose combat style mimics dance in its grace and its refinement . To a blade dancer , their dual weapons , often blade s of some sort , are as two dance partners with whom they train and choreograph constantly . Masters of footwork as well as fencing , blade dancers are as deadly as they are elegant . It is believed that the blade dancer style was initially invented by halfling s and was initially a dance form performed with music that mimicked swordplay . Gradually , the dance became a viable form of defense , though it remained tied to dance so as to enliven its practice . From the nomadic halflings it spread to other cultures , who picked up and passed the style on themselves . The mark of halflings is still visible , however , and masters of the blade dancer style foster a love of life and travel in their students much like that common among halflings . Abilities . Blade dancers differ from other rangers wielding dual weapons in their focus on defense , which much of their training focuses on .

title: Blade of Aihonen
description: Blade of Aihonen Blade of Aihonen was the sword of the hero Aihonen . Description . Even broken , the blade was extremely sharp .
description_long: Blade of Aihonen Blade of Aihonen was the sword of the hero Aihonen . Description . Even broken , the blade was extremely sharp . History . Around 1181 DR on the banks of Lac Dinneshere , the hero Aihonen fought against the last white dragon matriarch of the Spine of the World Icasaracht . During the battle , Aihonen was slain , but before his death , he drove the sword through the heart of the foul beast . In Mirtul , 1281 DR , the sea spirit Elisia gave the shattered blade to Aihonen ' s relative , Jhonen .

title: Blade of banishing
description: Blade of banishing A blade of banishing was a magical dagger that was able to destroy magical barriers , illusions , or protections upon coming in contact with them . The dagger was always active , it could not be " switched off " , and would have this effect whether or not it was being wielded , or if it was drawn . It simply needed to come into contact with the magic against which it was acting .
description_long: Blade of banishing A blade of banishing was a magical dagger that was able to destroy magical barriers , illusions , or protections upon coming in contact with them . The dagger was always active , it could not be " switched off " , and would have this effect whether or not it was being wielded , or if it was drawn . It simply needed to come into contact with the magic against which it was acting . A blade such as this was worth around 5 , 000 gold pieces as of 1368 DR .

title: Blade of doom
description: Blade of doom Blade of doom , also known as Shaeroon ' s scimitar , was an evocation spell that threatened one creature with injury from an invisible sword of force that was triggered by a condition chosen by the caster . Effects . This spell was a curse that followed its target , hovering over the creature ' s head , waiting to strike if the trigger condition occurred .
description_long: Blade of doom Blade of doom , also known as Shaeroon ' s scimitar , was an evocation spell that threatened one creature with injury from an invisible sword of force that was triggered by a condition chosen by the caster . Effects . This spell was a curse that followed its target , hovering over the creature ' s head , waiting to strike if the trigger condition occurred . The sword of force was invisible except to the caster , individuals that could see invisible objects , and to any who cast a successful " detect magic " on the unfortunate creature . The trigger condition was usually some action that was undesirable to the caster , such as drawing a weapon or beginning to cast a spell . This spell could last up to one year . The target did not get a chance to resist " blade of doom " until the curse was triggered and the blade struck the target . At that time , if the creature managed to resist the spell , no injury was received . Otherwise , the damage was proportional to the level of the caster . This curse could be removed before the expiration of the spell by the caster or powerful magic such as a " limited wish " . A normal " dispel magic " had no affect on this spell .

title: Blade of forgetfulness
description: Blade of forgetfulness Blades of forgetfulness were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special weapons were only used by Holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Blade of forgetfulness Blades of forgetfulness were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special weapons were only used by Holy slayer s . Description . These blades were available in sizes ranging from jambiya s to scimitar s . Powers . Blades of forgetfulness did not grant their wielder any additional fighting prowess . A wielder who waved the blade in a figure eight pattern could make anyone viewing the display lose their memories from the past few minutes before the display to the next few minutes after the display . These weapons were especially handy when bypassing guards while on an assassination mission .

title: Blade of mastery
description: Blade of mastery The Blade of mastery was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This weapon appeared as a small jambiya with an ethereal blade .
description_long: Blade of mastery The Blade of mastery was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This weapon appeared as a small jambiya with an ethereal blade . Powers . The blade of this weapon did not cause any damage . Instead , anyone struck by the blade received a permanent enhancement to one of their main physical or mental abilites .

title: Blade thirst
description: Blade thirst Blade thirst was a spell that allowed a slashing weapon being wielded by a ranger to gain a + 3 bonus and glow with a blue flame . The earlier version of this spell was an alteration spell called bladethirst . It was usable by wizards and worked on any single - edge blade .
description_long: Blade thirst Blade thirst was a spell that allowed a slashing weapon being wielded by a ranger to gain a + 3 bonus and glow with a blue flame . The earlier version of this spell was an alteration spell called bladethirst . It was usable by wizards and worked on any single - edge blade .

title: Bladebane
description: Bladebane Bladebane was a transmutation spell that caused a bladed weapon to temporarily do extra damage to a creature type . Effect . The caster imparted a deadly quality to a single bladed weapon for a short time .
description_long: Bladebane Bladebane was a transmutation spell that caused a bladed weapon to temporarily do extra damage to a creature type . Effect . The caster imparted a deadly quality to a single bladed weapon for a short time . Bladebane conferred the bane ability on the weapon touched , against a creature type of the caster ' s choice . The enhanced weapon was more likely to hit a creature of the appropriate type , and it dealt a moderate amount of additional damage to creatures of that type . Material components . A drop of blood and ruby dust worth 500 gp .

title: Bladeboots
description: Bladeboots Bladeboots were nasty footwear worn by some rogue s and adventurers . Uses . Bladeboots were most effective when used in a surprise attack , typically after the wearer was apprehended and stripped of their weapons .
description_long: Bladeboots Bladeboots were nasty footwear worn by some rogue s and adventurers . Uses . Bladeboots were most effective when used in a surprise attack , typically after the wearer was apprehended and stripped of their weapons . Bladeboots housed a dagger - sized blade within the sole of the boot . The blade was triggered by clicking the heels together , causing it to spring forward where it could be used with kicking attacks . Prices . A pair of bladeboots cost 15 gold .

title: Bladeling
description: Bladeling Bladelings were a race of humanoid outsider s from the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Their skin was covered with sharp , metallic spines , and they were known for their xenophobia . Description .
description_long: Bladeling Bladelings were a race of humanoid outsider s from the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Their skin was covered with sharp , metallic spines , and they were known for their xenophobia . Description . Bladelings were agile humanoid creatures covered in sharp , metallic spines that grew in patches on their tough , metal - hued skin . They were able to throw these spines , which acted like metal shrapnel to injure their foes . Bladelings had purple eyes that reflected like ice . Bladelings were immune to acid and the effects of rust , and they were resistant to cold and fire . Bludgeoning weapons were not very effective against them . Personality . Bladelings were famous for their superstitious fear of outsiders to their territory . They would not trust anyone they did not know . Bladelings were fearless in battle and quick to attack . Combat . Besides their ability to throw their spines , bladelings could strike with their sharp claws . They tended to carry longsword s in combat . A common tactic was to focus their attacks on the strongest opponents first . Society .

title: Bladen ' Kerst Baenre
description: Bladen ' Kerst Baenre Bladen ' Kerst Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a high priestess of Lolth . Personality . Bladen ' Kerst was known for her sadism and cruelty , as well as her lack of recognition for the protocols of drow society .
description_long: Bladen ' Kerst Baenre Bladen ' Kerst Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a high priestess of Lolth . Personality . Bladen ' Kerst was known for her sadism and cruelty , as well as her lack of recognition for the protocols of drow society . Those traits led her mother to keep her in - house for fear that she would attempt to form her own house and succeed , fail , or disgrace her mother in the process . In the meantime , Bladen ' Kerst was kept busy by terrorizing the house males . History . Bladen ' Kerst was killed by Gandalug Battlehammer , who strangled her with her own whip in 1358 DR . Relationships . Bladen ' kerst was the daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and the second - oldest daughter ( after Triel Baenre ) at home at House Baenre in the 1350s DR .

title: Blades ( Mulmaster )
description: Blades ( Mulmaster ) The Blades were the governing council that ruled the grand city of Mulmaster . The Blades were ten to sixteen of the most preeminent citizens , normally from the noble houses of the city . It was not clear how someone could become one of the Blades .
description_long: Blades ( Mulmaster ) The Blades were the governing council that ruled the grand city of Mulmaster . The Blades were ten to sixteen of the most preeminent citizens , normally from the noble houses of the city . It was not clear how someone could become one of the Blades . The Blades were ruled by the High Blade , the titular ruler of Mulmaster . They all usually resided in the Tower of Blades .

title: Blades for Daggerdale
description: Blades for Daggerdale Blades for Daggerdale , designed by Matthias Schäfer , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th edition ruleset . It focuses on Daggerdale , the gnoll s , and the zhent s . Summary .
description_long: Blades for Daggerdale Blades for Daggerdale , designed by Matthias Schäfer , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th edition ruleset . It focuses on Daggerdale , the gnoll s , and the zhent s . Summary . The adventure starts off as adventurers stumble across a merchant caravan bound for Dagger Falls under attack by gnoll s . After the ambush , the adventurers learn rumors of the Zhent Headless Horseman of Daggerdale and soon arrive in Dagger Falls . In the town , they learn that Zhent mercenaries are helping to fight off gnoll raids but a concerned Constable Morn asks for the adventurers ' support in a meeting with the mayor . At the meeting , attempts are made to convince the mayor not to hire the Zhents and the adventurers are sent to seek out a gnoll hideout . Along the way , they encounter a drowning dwarf who points them in the right direction to find the gnolls . Upon finding the gnoll cave , the adventurers locate proof of the Zhents ' involvement in the gnoll attacks .

title: Blades of the Moonsea
description: Blades of the Moonsea The Blades of the Moonsea series by Richard Baker is a trilogy of novels that follow a few years of the life of Geran Hulmaster , a thirty - something swordmage who returns from a decade of adventuring to find his home of Hulburg being taken over by those not native to the town . The novels take place primarily between mid - Eleint of 1479 DR to mid - Ches of 1480 DR , though there are occasional flashbacks to Geran ' s earlier history . The epilogue takes place a little less than a month after the events of the final novel .
description_long: Blades of the Moonsea The Blades of the Moonsea series by Richard Baker is a trilogy of novels that follow a few years of the life of Geran Hulmaster , a thirty - something swordmage who returns from a decade of adventuring to find his home of Hulburg being taken over by those not native to the town . The novels take place primarily between mid - Eleint of 1479 DR to mid - Ches of 1480 DR , though there are occasional flashbacks to Geran ' s earlier history . The epilogue takes place a little less than a month after the events of the final novel . The novels include : The artwork of the cover was provided by Raymond Swanland .

title: Bladesinger
description: Bladesinger The Bladesinger prestige class is comprised of Tel ' Quessir ( " " The People " " in the elven language ) who have blended art , swordplay , and arcane magic into a seamless whole . They use very discrete tactics and precise movement in battle to maintain a highly effective combat defense . Using a mixture of arcane and martial abilities , Bladesingers act as roving guardians of surface Tel ' Quessir culture , seeking to promote Tel ' Quessir ideals , and as protectors and champions of the eladrin and elven communities .
description_long: Bladesinger The Bladesinger prestige class is comprised of Tel ' Quessir ( " " The People " " in the elven language ) who have blended art , swordplay , and arcane magic into a seamless whole . They use very discrete tactics and precise movement in battle to maintain a highly effective combat defense . Using a mixture of arcane and martial abilities , Bladesingers act as roving guardians of surface Tel ' Quessir culture , seeking to promote Tel ' Quessir ideals , and as protectors and champions of the eladrin and elven communities . Bladesingers have a prominent place in the society of the Tel ' Quessir of Faerûn , being renowned as heroes of the Tel ' Quessir race , and welcomed in Tel ' Quessir communities . Bladesingers are taught in a single master - apprentice tutelage system , with a master taking on a single apprentice to carry on the work of defending the Tel - Quessir and promoting their principals and way of life . Bladesinger Abilities . Bladesong . The bladesong itself is an extremely demanding martial art , the epitome of Tel ' Quessir mastery of the sword , almost never taught to those not of Tel ' Quessir blood .

title: Blaermon
description: Blaermon Blaermon the Blessed was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Holy Warriors of Suffering in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Blaermon the Blessed was known for surviving a string of hopeless battles , for which he earned his name .
description_long: Blaermon Blaermon the Blessed was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Holy Warriors of Suffering in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Blaermon the Blessed was known for surviving a string of hopeless battles , for which he earned his name . " Circa " 1267 DR , Althea the Abased — the leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar and journeying up and down the Sword Coast — selected Blaermon for a holy task . She bade him to take away the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith , to the " wild places " of the Realms and bestow it upon the first " needy and worthy " Ilmatari he met , someone who worked or fought for the benefit of the common people and their faith , not merely for wealth and adventure . Blaermon obeyed and , in the Year of the Daystars , 1268 DR , he gave the " Tome " to Flaergon of Glister , who devoted his efforts to assisting miners and caravan - workers in the frozen north of the Moonsea .

title: Blaern ' s Trail
description: Blaern ' s Trail Blaern ' s Trail , also called the Wandering Trail , ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dead Tree Hollow . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Thindilar , Sendrin , and Fallentree , and ended at Dead Tree Hollow . On the way , it linked with the Hlintar Ride , the Cross Road , the Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and ended at the North Road .
description_long: Blaern ' s Trail Blaern ' s Trail , also called the Wandering Trail , ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dead Tree Hollow . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Thindilar , Sendrin , and Fallentree , and ended at Dead Tree Hollow . On the way , it linked with the Hlintar Ride , the Cross Road , the Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and ended at the North Road .

title: Blagothkus
description: Blagothkus Blagothkus was the cloud giant ruler of Skyreach Castle . Personality . Blagothkus was a survivor of the giant empires of the past , and his main dream was somehow to go back to those glorious times .
description_long: Blagothkus Blagothkus was the cloud giant ruler of Skyreach Castle . Personality . Blagothkus was a survivor of the giant empires of the past , and his main dream was somehow to go back to those glorious times . Using this motivation , the Cult convinced him that they were reestablishing a time when only giants and dragon s would rule . However , Blagothkus started to consider that the cultist might one day usurp his control of the castle and dismiss the alliance . In fear his suspicions would come true , Blagothkus revolted immediately against the cultists . His castle was in fact powered by the life energy of his lost wife , and Blagothkus would do anything to protect her memory . History . Blagothkus was a very old cloud giant lord in command of the floating Skyreach Castle . He allied with the Cult of the Dragon , dreaming to go back to the age when giants and dragons fought for the dominion of the world . The Cult used his castle as one of their main headquarters . During the Tyranny of Dragons , they collected here all the treasures destined for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen . Eventually , an adventurers ' party boarded the castle and confronted Blagothkus .

title: Blaine
description: Blaine Blaine was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Blaine was one of Fort Locke ' s best soldiers ( who spent decades in the Neverwinter army ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol .
description_long: Blaine Blaine was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Blaine was one of Fort Locke ' s best soldiers ( who spent decades in the Neverwinter army ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol . However , they were captured by the shadow priest . Repko was cornered , as the room he was in was trapped . The Kalach - Cha and Tann could ' ve rescued him .

title: Blaizette
description: Blaizette Blaizette was a halfling waitress in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Blaizette worked as waitress for her mother at the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle .
description_long: Blaizette Blaizette was a halfling waitress in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Blaizette worked as waitress for her mother at the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle . In 1489 DR , she was briefly interrogated by Buhrell Caah about a missing dangerous magic item .

title: Blakkal Mord
description: Blakkal Mord Blakkal Mord was a leather - worker in High Dale . History . Jatham was a very able warrior in High Dale and a secret agent of the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Blakkal Mord Blakkal Mord was a leather - worker in High Dale . History . Jatham was a very able warrior in High Dale and a secret agent of the Cult of the Dragon . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Blakkal was a member of the Council of the High Dale . He hated all outsiders . Constable Heladar Longspear believed him a sinister individual .

title: Blakrho Phull
description: Blakrho Phull Lord Blakrho Phull was a former scion of the noble House Phull of Waterdeep who turned on his family and pursued a life of banditry along the southern Sword Coast . Description . In spite of his age , Blakrho was described as youthful and handsome looking in 1479 DR .
description_long: Blakrho Phull Lord Blakrho Phull was a former scion of the noble House Phull of Waterdeep who turned on his family and pursued a life of banditry along the southern Sword Coast . Description . In spite of his age , Blakrho was described as youthful and handsome looking in 1479 DR . His youthfulness was attributed to either dark magic or vampirism although the former was considered more likely . History . Blakrho Pull was the second son of House Phull of Waterdeep . Around 1440 DR , Blakrho stabbed his older brother to death and blamed the crime on a younger brother , a charge that was initially believed by the city guard . However , Blakrho ' s father , Mhairdren Phull caught him beating his mother and Blakrho threw his father down a flight of stairs , severely injuring him . Blakrho fled Waterdeep with most of his family ' s money , his father ' s best horses and a carriage full of wine . He traveled to Amn where he began conning farmers and lordlings into giving him shelter . He would then kill his host and steal any valuables .

title: Blanaer
description: Blanaer Blanaer was a village in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Kurth and Thindilar . The Pass Trail led to Tavilar . History .
description_long: Blanaer Blanaer was a village in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Kurth and Thindilar . The Pass Trail led to Tavilar . History . In the early and lawless years of human settlement of the Vast , bandits battled openly along the Cross Way near where Blanaer later arose . Several times in the 1360s DR , bodies were discovered hanging from trees by the roads around Blanaer , having been hung in the night by bandits or thieves . Description . Blanaer was a stopover village home to hardworking farmers . It was a local agricultural center , with a market for selling sheep and cattle from nearby farms , paddocks to hold stock , and piles of manure for sale . " Stinks like Blanaer " was a common expression in the Vast . It was fairly unexciting . Rumors . Despite Blanaer ' s reputation , it had local treasure tales like many other communities in the Vast . On occasion , chests , buckets , saddlebags and nosebags stuffed with coins were unearthed in Blanaer ' s pastures , stockyards and even manure piles , and more finds were expected , though they were usually well defended by herds of cattle .

title: Blas Iwan
description: Blas Iwan Blas Iwan was a young red dragon that sought transformation in dracolich around 1370 DR . Relationships . Blas was a fanatical worshiper of the Sammaster ' s theories and entered in the Cult of the Dragon thinking was his destiny .
description_long: Blas Iwan Blas Iwan was a young red dragon that sought transformation in dracolich around 1370 DR . Relationships . Blas was a fanatical worshiper of the Sammaster ' s theories and entered in the Cult of the Dragon thinking was his destiny . However , he was too young to undergo the dracolich ' s transformation , so the Cult decided to helped him gain a treasure hoard and experience before the treatment .

title: Blaskar Lauthom
description: Blaskar Lauthom Blaskar Lauthlon was a male human wizard , and the Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the West Tower . He was responsible for the Arcane Brotherhood ' s operations in the western quadrant of Faerûn . Description .
description_long: Blaskar Lauthom Blaskar Lauthlon was a male human wizard , and the Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the West Tower . He was responsible for the Arcane Brotherhood ' s operations in the western quadrant of Faerûn . Description . Blaskar looked like a very ordinary , middle - aged man with a sturdy build and inexpensive clothes . But his looks were a tactic carefully crafted by Blaskar . He knew that looking ordinary gave him an advantage against an enemy that at first glance would not think him dangerous . History . Blaskar was a member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors of Waterdeep but was fired from the organization when his fellows discovered that he stole rare magical components for himself . Soon he become a mercenary wizard , known among smugglers and thieves for his complete amorality , willing to do anything for the right price . One day he was employed by a group of smugglers to protect their ship from pirates . When Luskan ' s pirates attacked the smuggler ' s ship , Blaskar destroyed them all . Agents of the Brotherhood discovered that it was Blaskar who destroyed the pirates and approached him with an offer to join their ranks .

title: Blasko Halamar
description: Blasko Halamar Blasko Halamar was a stout ex - warrior and stable owner who owned Halamar ' s Horses in Beliard around 1370 DR . Description . The stable master was stout with a long white beard .
description_long: Blasko Halamar Blasko Halamar was a stout ex - warrior and stable owner who owned Halamar ' s Horses in Beliard around 1370 DR . Description . The stable master was stout with a long white beard . Personality . Blasko enjoyed telling stories about adventures , orc battles , and treasure ; his favorite tale was about riches buried by wealthy ladies fleeing the fall of Netheril . Halamar was known for his shady side as well , buying lame horse s and then reselling them at marked up prices .

title: Blasphemy
description: Blasphemy Blasphemy was an evocation spell that could incapacitate or even kill nonevil creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The counterpart to this spell for casters of good alignments was " holy word " . Effects .
description_long: Blasphemy Blasphemy was an evocation spell that could incapacitate or even kill nonevil creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The counterpart to this spell for casters of good alignments was " holy word " . Effects . This spell compared the target ' s toughness or experience level with the experience level of the caster and had no effect on creatures that were superior to the caster , but the effects were increasingly severe and cumulative for those equal to or inferior . The only way to avoid these effects was to not hear the " blasphemy " , either by virtue of already being deaf , or some form of magical " silence " . In addition to the effects described below , this spell could send extraplanar creatures back to their home plane , as long as the " blasphemy " was spoken on the caster ' s home plane . This affected all weak - willed nonevil creatures , thus allowing it to banish those of a neutral alignment as well . This dismissal happened even if the creatures in the area of effect could not hear the " blasphemy " , and any banished creatures were blocked from returning to the caster ' s home plane for at least 24 hours .

title: Blast of pain
description: Blast of pain Blast of pain was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the combat and necromantic spheres .
description_long: Blast of pain Blast of pain was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the combat and necromantic spheres . It was commonly used priests of Ilmater . Effect . As its name suggested , the " blast of pain " spell inflicted intense pain on its victim , via a ray of smoky grey light shot from caster to the target . A creature that succumbed to the pain was left writhing in agony for some time , their nervous system damaged , incapable of action or coherent thought , and senseless to goings - on around them . One who resisted was merely slowed both mentally and physically , and harmed less , before the spell passed .

title: Blastback swipe
description: Blastback swipe Blastback swipe is a spell of the evocation school used by some swordmage s of relatively low experience and power , particularly those of the assault style . When cast " blastback swipe " causes debilitating sound to emanate from the swordmage ' s weapon as he or she swings it about a target with melee range . The sonic energy not only causes the creature injury , but if successfully used , pushes the target back up to ten feet .
description_long: Blastback swipe Blastback swipe is a spell of the evocation school used by some swordmage s of relatively low experience and power , particularly those of the assault style . When cast " blastback swipe " causes debilitating sound to emanate from the swordmage ' s weapon as he or she swings it about a target with melee range . The sonic energy not only causes the creature injury , but if successfully used , pushes the target back up to ten feet . Assault swordmages gain an additional benefit from the spell and can use it as a component of their " aegis of assault " spell . The spell is easily recharged with a rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Blazen Stoe
description: Blazen Stoe Blazen Stoe was one of the Blade s in Mulmaster . Personality . Stoe took great pride in his family ' s position and his role as a Blade .
description_long: Blazen Stoe Blazen Stoe was one of the Blade s in Mulmaster . Personality . Stoe took great pride in his family ' s position and his role as a Blade . He was concerned that his son did not understand this . Stoe wanted for Sebastian a good marriage that would produce the next generation of the Stoe family . Relationships . Stoe was the father of Sebastian Stoe . History . In 1491 DR , Stoe ' s son fell in love with a girl who worked in a bar , and he felt she was a woman totally inappropriate for a Blade ' s son . He confronted Sebastian , urging to him to break off the relationship but instead his son ran away from home . Later , at a great party in the Astrid Saj villa , Blazen Stoe hired an adventuring party to find and take the boy home .

title: Blazevale
description: Blazevale The Blazevale is a broad , sand - scoured valley near Evereska that separates the Sharaedim from the Greycloak Hills to the north . It is made up of scrubby pine s , thorn bush of cacti and wolf root , where only the hardiest of rabbit s , moon fox es , mice , lizard s , and meadow quail survive .
description_long: Blazevale The Blazevale is a broad , sand - scoured valley near Evereska that separates the Sharaedim from the Greycloak Hills to the north . It is made up of scrubby pine s , thorn bush of cacti and wolf root , where only the hardiest of rabbit s , moon fox es , mice , lizard s , and meadow quail survive .

title: Blazidon One - Eye
description: Blazidon One - Eye Blazidon One - Eye was the secret owner of the Bowels of the Earth tavern in the city of Waterdeep . Despite this , Blazidon spent most of his time as a hiring agent for sellswords at the Dock Ward or at the city ' s various inns and taverns . He was a business rival of Filiare , as the two compete over clients looking for work .
description_long: Blazidon One - Eye Blazidon One - Eye was the secret owner of the Bowels of the Earth tavern in the city of Waterdeep . Despite this , Blazidon spent most of his time as a hiring agent for sellswords at the Dock Ward or at the city ' s various inns and taverns . He was a business rival of Filiare , as the two compete over clients looking for work .

title: Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking
description: Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking The Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking was the famous battle standard of Ologh , the Overking of the orc ish kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . Ologh carried the Blazing Banner into battle , before being slain by the black dragon Iyrauroth in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR .
description_long: Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking The Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking was the famous battle standard of Ologh , the Overking of the orc ish kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . Ologh carried the Blazing Banner into battle , before being slain by the black dragon Iyrauroth in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR . At some point , the sapphire dragon Bleucorundum , a collector of important military artifacts , obtained the Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking . He kept it in his lair in the Halls of the Sleeping Legion in the Omlarandin Mountains of Tethyr by 1370 DR . Powers . The Blazing Banner had the powers of a " law ' s banner " , boosting the morale of lawful armies . When raised in battle , it also turned into a tapestry of fire .

title: Bledryn Scoril
description: Bledryn Scoril Bledryn Scoril was a member of the Scoril noble house of Cormyr , as well as the Crown ' s representative to , and Lord of , Marsember , having taken over the role from Ildool . He was the local Herald , Grand Marsember , and acted as the registrar of births , deaths , and marriages , as well as the Crown ' s witness to sentencing , contracts , treaties , and the like .
description_long: Bledryn Scoril Bledryn Scoril was a member of the Scoril noble house of Cormyr , as well as the Crown ' s representative to , and Lord of , Marsember , having taken over the role from Ildool . He was the local Herald , Grand Marsember , and acted as the registrar of births , deaths , and marriages , as well as the Crown ' s witness to sentencing , contracts , treaties , and the like .

title: Bleeder
description: Bleeder Bleeder was an enchanted axe . Description . The axe was heavy but finely crafted .
description_long: Bleeder Bleeder was an enchanted axe . Description . The axe was heavy but finely crafted . Powers . The axe was heavily ensorcelled , though it was not clear how . However , the axe was able to easily cut through the trunk of a four - inch - diameter maple tree .

title: Blentra Whaelbuckler
description: Blentra Whaelbuckler Blentra Whaelbuckler was an inhabitant of Marsember in 1367 DR . Description . A giant of a woman , Blentra ' s immense strength aided her well when fighting pirates .
description_long: Blentra Whaelbuckler Blentra Whaelbuckler was an inhabitant of Marsember in 1367 DR . Description . A giant of a woman , Blentra ' s immense strength aided her well when fighting pirates . Activities . Blentra was a secret agent for the Harpers . She owned a restaurant in Marsember that was a popular retreat . She loved adventuring and hated not being part of anything exciting taking place in Marsember .

title: Bless
description: Bless Bless was an enchantment or conjuration spell that temporarily increased the morale and combat skill of allies . The conjuration version of this spell was reversible and was called curse , also known as " bane " , and temporarily lowered the morale and combat skill of enemies . Effects .
description_long: Bless Bless was an enchantment or conjuration spell that temporarily increased the morale and combat skill of allies .
