The conjuration version of this spell was reversible and was called curse , also known as " bane " , and temporarily lowered the morale and combat skill of enemies . Effects . Those allies " blessed " were granted a brief boost to their morale in the face of fear and a slight improvement in combat skill that increased their chance to strike a blow or aim true . The conjuration version of this spell had to be cast just before the recipients engaged in combat . It could also be used to enhance a single weapon or item , such as a sword , an arrow , or a sling bullet , improving the chance to hit an enemy . " Bless " countered and dispelled " bane " or " curse " , and vice versa . The sundering version of the spell could only effect 3 allies and gave a minor bonus to attacks and recistence to effects . If used with more skill the spell could effect a higher number of targets . Unlike the earlier versions this does effect the Bane spell Components .

title: Bless weapon
description: Bless weapon Bless weapon is a transmutation spell that grants a weapon a temporary holy aura . Effect . This transmutation makes a weapon strike true against evil foes .
description_long: Bless weapon Bless weapon is a transmutation spell that grants a weapon a temporary holy aura . Effect . This transmutation makes a weapon strike true against evil foes . All critical rolls against evil foes are automatically successful ( so every threat is a critical hit ) . The weapon negates the damage reduction of evil creatures and is capable of striking evil incorporeal creatures as if it had a + 1 enhancement bonus . Also , the weapon is considered blessed , which means it has special effects on certain creatures . Individual arrows or bolts can be transmuted , but affected projectile weapons ( such as bows ) don ' t confer the benefit to the projectiles they shoot . This transmutation can ' t affect any weapon that already has a magical effect related to critical hits , such as a keen weapon or a vorpal sword .

title: Blessed abundance
description: Blessed abundance Blessed abundance was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to multiply a quantity of animal or vegetable matter . Effects . This spell worked on raw or prepared food and live or harvested plants , not on live creatures , metals , minerals , or magical items .
description_long: Blessed abundance Blessed abundance was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to multiply a quantity of animal or vegetable matter . Effects . This spell worked on raw or prepared food and live or harvested plants , not on live creatures , metals , minerals , or magical items . Up to one cubic foot ( 0 . 28 m ) of organic matter could be multiplied by the caster ' s level . The creations were real and permanent . Components . Verbal and somatic components , as well as the priest ' s holy symbol were required to cast this spell .

title: Blessing of Vhaeraun
description: Blessing of Vhaeraun Blessing of Vhaeraun was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun , the drow god of thievery , to augment their abilities . Effects . The caster ' s abilities were temporarily augmented , but only for a very short time and only for one use .
description_long: Blessing of Vhaeraun Blessing of Vhaeraun was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun , the drow god of thievery , to augment their abilities . Effects . The caster ' s abilities were temporarily augmented , but only for a very short time and only for one use . This one use could be expended to increase the accuracy of a physical attack or the abilities as a thief of the caster or another person touched with the spell . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Bleth
description: Bleth Bleth was a noble family of Cormyr . History . In the 1360s DR , the Bleth family was one of the more powerful and wealthier noble families of Cormyr , thanks to its control of the Seven Suns Trading Coster , one of the largest merchant groups in the kingdom .
description_long: Bleth Bleth was a noble family of Cormyr . History . In the 1360s DR , the Bleth family was one of the more powerful and wealthier noble families of Cormyr , thanks to its control of the Seven Suns Trading Coster , one of the largest merchant groups in the kingdom . The family was headed by Lord Gruen Bleth . In the late 1360s , Lord Gruen and Lady Amarsa Bleth were guests of Lord Partic Thistle at his manor , Thistleflame , on the occasion of King Azoun IV ' s birthday . The house was exiled in 1369 DR as a result of its involvement in the Abraxus affair . After the Fire Knives were driven from Cormyr , it was revealed that a number of members of the Bleth house were in - fact members of the Fire Knives . Activities . In the 1360s , the Bleth family had little involvement in the affairs of Cormyr ' s Royal Court . Instead , the mercantile Bleths focused on expanding their business and dominating the Cormyrean finances . They were successful and wielded great economic power . Base . The family was based at the Bleth Estate in the city of Suzail , Cormyr . It was situated beyond the Royal Gardens , near Castle Obarskyr . Relationships .

title: Bleucorundum
description: Bleucorundum Bluecorundum was a sapphire dragon living under the Omlarandin Mountains near Iltkazar in the Underdark in 1370 DR , who was the self - appointed Sapphire Sentinel of the Sleeping Legion of the Knights of the Crescent Moon . Personality . Bleucorundum was not aggressive by nature but was highly territorial and distrustful of strangers .
description_long: Bleucorundum Bluecorundum was a sapphire dragon living under the Omlarandin Mountains near Iltkazar in the Underdark in 1370 DR , who was the self - appointed Sapphire Sentinel of the Sleeping Legion of the Knights of the Crescent Moon . Personality . Bleucorundum was not aggressive by nature but was highly territorial and distrustful of strangers . He was a lover of history , and his language was laced with military and historical jargon . He was strongly dismissive of anyone who had not served in the military and even more so towards pacifists . The most important virtues , in his mind , were duty , honor , and military readiness . His devotion to duty meant that Bleucorundum was lonely . He longed for a mate , but he could not forsake his post guarding the Sleeping Legion , even though he had taken that role upon himself . Bleucorundum followed the dragon deity Null as well as the dwarven god Clangeddin Silverbeard . He also had great respect for Selûne , though he did not worship her directly . In battle , Bleucorundum was a cautious combatant , taking his time to evaluate opponents before going on the offensive .

title: Bleys Orltusk
description: Bleys Orltusk Bleys Orltusk , also known as The Blade or as Old Tusk , was a dwarf shopkeeper in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Bleys had lost one of his eyes .
description_long: Bleys Orltusk Bleys Orltusk , also known as The Blade or as Old Tusk , was a dwarf shopkeeper in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Bleys had lost one of his eyes . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Bleys managed the Crossed Blades shop . History . Many rumors abounded about Bleys colorful heritage and his presumed evil deeds .

title: Bleyshar
description: Bleyshar Bleyshar was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , there were only two surviving Bleyshars : Shalice Bleyshar and her nephew Tantram .
description_long: Bleyshar Bleyshar was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , there were only two surviving Bleyshars : Shalice Bleyshar and her nephew Tantram . Shalice was both feeble and old , while her nephew was eager to assume full control of the family wealth upon her death . Shalice had not left the family mansion west of Gray Oaks ( Bleys Hard ) for at least two decades .

title: Blibdoolpoolp
description: Blibdoolpoolp Blibdoolpoolp ( also known as the Sea Mother ) was the deity worshipped by the kuo - toa n race . Her symbol was a lobster head and black pearl . Blibdoolpoolp usually took the form of a 20 foot ( 6 .
description_long: Blibdoolpoolp Blibdoolpoolp ( also known as the Sea Mother ) was the deity worshipped by the kuo - toa n race . Her symbol was a lobster head and black pearl . Blibdoolpoolp usually took the form of a 20 foot ( 6 . 1 meter ) tall nude human female , with a lobster ' s head and claws in place of humanoid parts . At close range , her gaze caused insanity . Blibdoolpoolp ' s realm was a small moonlike temple drifting in The Fated Depths . History and Relationships . The Sea Mother was warped by her hatred of the surface - dwelling races that drove her children into the depths in the ancient past , and brooded over her people while plotting revenge . It could be inferred from this that she had no allies among the surface deities , and possibly none at all . Clergy and Temples . Priests of the Sea Mother were called " whips " and wore pearl - colored vestments , shell helms , and draped themselves in nets as part of ceremonies . Her holy day was the new moon , and rituals were held in underwater shrines . Gems , pearls , humans , and lobsters ( her sacred animal ) were sacrificed to her monthly . Divine spells .

title: Blight ( spell )
description: Blight ( spell ) Blight was a necromancy spell that bathed a creature or plant with necromantic energy . Effects . The spell would effectively drain water and vitality from a creature , which would suffer serious necrotic damage .
description_long: Blight ( spell ) Blight was a necromancy spell that bathed a creature or plant with necromantic energy . Effects . The spell would effectively drain water and vitality from a creature , which would suffer serious necrotic damage . Undead and construct s were immune as they either didn ' t have or didn ' t need moisture . Plants would just wither and die unless they were plant creatures or a magical plant , in which case they would just have a disadvantage to resist the spell , If they failed , they would suffer the full damage of the spell . If used with more skill , the spell would cause even more necrotic damage . Components . The spell had verbal and somatic components .

title: Blind
description: Blind The Blind was an old beholder who lived in Skullport beneath Waterdeep in the 15th century DR . Personality . As his name implied , he was blind .
description_long: Blind The Blind was an old beholder who lived in Skullport beneath Waterdeep in the 15th century DR . Personality . As his name implied , he was blind . He claimed to be the " Eye " , the infamous beholder from Skullport ' s past but most considered the claim unlikely since the Eye was known to have died in a fight with a lich known as Avaereene . Relationships . He was too weak to command his own gang but , because he was allied with no gang , the gangs trusted him as an arbitrator of disputes . History . As of 1479 DR , the Blind was looking for a relic known as the " Crown of Horns " .

title: Blinding beauty
description: Blinding beauty Blinding beauty was a transmutation spell that made the caster as beautiful as a nymph , allowing her to blind humanoids that looked at her . Effect . The caster gained the physical beauty of a nymph , with some of the supernatural accompaniments .
description_long: Blinding beauty Blinding beauty was a transmutation spell that made the caster as beautiful as a nymph , allowing her to blind humanoids that looked at her . Effect . The caster gained the physical beauty of a nymph , with some of the supernatural accompaniments . All humanoids within 60 feet of the caster who looked directly at her could be blinded permanently as though by the blindness spell . During the duration of the spell , the caster could suppress or resume this effect as a free action , while remaining stunningly attractive . Abstinence Component . The caster was required to abstain from sexual intercourse for one week prior to casting this spell .

title: Blinding glory
description: Blinding glory Blinding glory is a conjuration spell that brightly illuminates an area . Effects . A brilliant radiance spreads from you , brightly illuminating the area .
description_long: Blinding glory Blinding glory is a conjuration spell that brightly illuminates an area . Effects . A brilliant radiance spreads from you , brightly illuminating the area . The light is similar to that created by the " daylight " spell , but no magical darkness counters or dispels it . Furthermore , evil - aligned creatures are blinded within this light . Blinding glory brought into an area of magical darkness ( or vice versa ) , including an " utterdark " spell , is temporarily negated , so that the otherwise prevailing light conditions exist in the overlapping areas of effect . Material components . A polished rod of pure silver .

title: Blinding smite
description: Blinding smite Blinding smite was an evocation spell that made the next hit with a melee weapon create a explosion of light and radiant damage against the target . Effects . For the duration of the spell , a struck target could be blinded and would have to try and resist the magical brightness that struck their eyes .
description_long: Blinding smite Blinding smite was an evocation spell that made the next hit with a melee weapon create a explosion of light and radiant damage against the target . Effects . For the duration of the spell , a struck target could be blinded and would have to try and resist the magical brightness that struck their eyes . The spell also caused radiant damage to the target . Components . Only a verbal component was required to cast this spell .

title: Blindness or deafness
description: Blindness or deafness Blindness or deafness was a necromancy - or , in a variant , illusion - spell that rendered a target blind or deaf as chosen by the caster . Effects . There were several versions of this spell .
description_long: Blindness or deafness Blindness or deafness was a necromancy - or , in a variant , illusion - spell that rendered a target blind or deaf as chosen by the caster . Effects . There were several versions of this spell . The later version could be cast at any creature ( living or undead ) within 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) and rendered them blind or deaf for up to one minute . The target continually attempted to resist the magic of this spell , and the stronger its constitution , the more likely it would recover before the minute was up . If cast at a higher level , more creatures could be targeted . The older version of this spell had a much longer range ( a minimum of 120 ft or 36 . 6 m ) and the target only got one chance to resist or was struck blind or deaf permanently . This magically - induced condition could only be reversed by a " remove blindness or deafness " spell , or more powerful magics . Only living creatures were affected by this spell . There also existed two older separate versions based on illusion magic , where one could only inflict blindness , the other deafness . Components .

title: Blindsight
description: Blindsight " Blindsight " was a general term for the natural ability of certain creatures to perceive their surroundings as well as a sighted creature yet without using visual senses . Senses that could contribute to a creature ' s overall blindsight included enhanced hearing , an acute sense of smell , sensitivity to vibrations , or such specialized senses as echolocation . Because the sense of sight was not involved , a creature with blindsight was not hindered by such spell effects as " invisibility " or " darkness " .
description_long: Blindsight " Blindsight " was a general term for the natural ability of certain creatures to perceive their surroundings as well as a sighted creature yet without using visual senses . Senses that could contribute to a creature ' s overall blindsight included enhanced hearing , an acute sense of smell , sensitivity to vibrations , or such specialized senses as echolocation . Because the sense of sight was not involved , a creature with blindsight was not hindered by such spell effects as " invisibility " or " darkness " .

title: Blingdenstone
description: Blingdenstone Blingdenstone was a svirfneblin city - state founded in - 690 DR by svirfnebli fleeing the phaerimm . In 1371 DR , the city was destroyed and abandoned . However , beginning around 1440 DR the svirfneblin began to resettle the town with support from Mithral Hall and Silverymoon .
description_long: Blingdenstone Blingdenstone was a svirfneblin city - state founded in - 690 DR by svirfnebli fleeing the phaerimm . In 1371 DR , the city was destroyed and abandoned . However , beginning around 1440 DR the svirfneblin began to resettle the town with support from Mithral Hall and Silverymoon . Geography . The city was located some 45 miles west of the drow city Menzoberranzan in the Upperdark under the Silver Marches near Mithral Hall . History . In 1338 DR , Drizzt Do ' Urden spent many weeks there ( in the company of Most Honored Burrow Warden Belwar Dissengulp ) after surviving for ten years in the Underdark by himself . It was ruled by King Schnicktick at the time . Preceding their attack on Mithral Hall in 1358 DR , Menzoberranyr troops entered Blingdenstone to find it abandoned . The deep gnomes had fled the approach of the advancing drow but returned to their city some time after the drow army had passed through . Later in the year , Most Honored Burrow Warden Belwar Dissengulp led a small force of svirfnibli in a scouting / rear attack move that aided in the defense of Keeper ' s Dale during the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale .

title: Blink
description: Blink Blink was a transmutation spell caused the caster to " blink " randomly between the Prime Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane , similar to a blink dog . Effect . This made the caster harder to attack , since there was a chance an attack or spell would miss due to the caster not being on the Prime Material Plane at the time .
description_long: Blink Blink was a transmutation spell caused the caster to " blink " randomly between the Prime Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane , similar to a blink dog . Effect . This made the caster harder to attack , since there was a chance an attack or spell would miss due to the caster not being on the Prime Material Plane at the time . The caster could attempt to move through solid objects on the Prime Material Plane while blinked onto the Ethereal Plane , however , if the caster materialized in the same location as a solid object , he or she became " shunted " to the nearest available empty space , and this caused damage . The later post - Sundering version of the spell worked much in the same way but it allowed movement of only 10 feet . The caster could see and hear into the prime to a distance of only 60 feet but in shades of gray . While on the ethereal plane , the caster could not interact with creatures on the prime , only with those that connected to the ethereal plane . If no unoccupied space was found within 10 feet when the caster had to return , they would be randomly be placed in the nearest unoccupied area . Components .

title: Blink dog
description: Blink dog A blink dog was a mysterious , intelligent canine creature . Most blink dogs had yellow - brown fur and large ears . They were well known for their ability to " blink " — a supernatural teleportation ability .
description_long: Blink dog A blink dog was a mysterious , intelligent canine creature . Most blink dogs had yellow - brown fur and large ears . They were well known for their ability to " blink " — a supernatural teleportation ability . Abilities . Blink dogs had an average intelligence . They had powerful senses , including the ability to see in low light and see in the dark , as well as possessing acute scent detection and tracking . A blink dog ' s most well - known ability was its ability to " blink " , as well as use " dimension door " . Blink dogs occasionally served as manifestations of the deities Baravar Cloakshadow , Marthammor Duin , and Urogalan . Society . Blink dogs spoke their own language . They had a long hatred of displacer beast s , and would attack them on sight .

title: Bliss
description: Bliss Bliss was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lliira , the Joybringer . It caused one creature to fall into a trance of intense joy , ignoring other beings or dangerous situations and feeling no pain . Effects .
description_long: Bliss Bliss was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lliira , the Joybringer . It caused one creature to fall into a trance of intense joy , ignoring other beings or dangerous situations and feeling no pain . Effects . This spell could be cast at any creature that could be targeted within 45 ft ( 14 m ) of the caster ( more experienced casters could extend this range ) . The subject had a chance to resist the magic of this spell and , if successful , the spell fizzled and they remained unaffected . If the target failed to resist , they became dazed , dropped items in their hands , strolled around without purpose , and smiled with happiness for the next four minutes . This trance was so intense that the subject felt no pain while in this state , did not react to personal danger , could not be persuaded to perform any task , and could not be mentally influenced by " charm " spells , hypnosis , or psionics . As a side effect of being under the influence of this spell , the subject was rendered immune to " bliss " for the next day or two . Those with stronger constitutions got more hours of immunity than those less sturdy . Components .

title: Blister
description: Blister Blister was a Netherese military outpost established in - 1286 DR in the mountains of southeast Netheril . Defenses . The outpost was so well defended that it survived beyond the fall of the Empire .
description_long: Blister Blister was a Netherese military outpost established in - 1286 DR in the mountains of southeast Netheril . Defenses . The outpost was so well defended that it survived beyond the fall of the Empire . Rumors and Legends . There was a " portal " from the Temple of Tyche in what would later be known as the village of Monksblade , Cormyr . History . Though not its official name ( a name which , in Loross , roughly translated as " All - Seeing Master of Lightning " ) , the soldiers stationed there colloquially referred to the outpost as " Blister " , owing to the difficult life they led . In - 442 DR , phaerimm attacked Blister . They destroyed many of the underground supply rooms and several connecting tunnels beneath the outpost . Blister ' s garrison came close to starvation , and the commanding archwizard s fled after personal issues begin turning into spell - battles .

title: Bloated Gargoyle Inn
description: Bloated Gargoyle Inn The Bloated Gargoyle Inn was an inn in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . In the early 7th century DR , the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly caroused for several hours at the Bloated Gargoyle Inn . Finally , the Royal Constabulary discovered him and tried to arrest him and Urthag fled across the rooftops of the city .
description_long: Bloated Gargoyle Inn The Bloated Gargoyle Inn was an inn in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . In the early 7th century DR , the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly caroused for several hours at the Bloated Gargoyle Inn . Finally , the Royal Constabulary discovered him and tried to arrest him and Urthag fled across the rooftops of the city .

title: Bloirt Waelarn
description: Bloirt Waelarn Bloirt Waelarn was a human male priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . He was infamous for launching a holy war against the rival House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , and for his descent into murderous madness in an effort to possess the holy relic the " Tome of Torment " . History .
description_long: Bloirt Waelarn Bloirt Waelarn was a human male priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . He was infamous for launching a holy war against the rival House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , and for his descent into murderous madness in an effort to possess the holy relic the " Tome of Torment " . History . By 1265 DR , Archsuffer Bloirt Waelarn was the Father of the House , or high priest , of the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Calimshan , already the greatest temple of Ilmater in the Realms . At that time , the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the Ilmatari faith — had come into the possession of another temple , the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum . There , the senior Sage - Priest of the church , known as the Spontaer , prayed to Ilmater and received visions of powerful magical protections that would render the " Tome " usable only by priests of Ilmater . The Spontaer explicitly requested that the " Tome of Torment " be delivered to the House of the Broken God , before he worked the magic on the " Tome " and sacrificed his own life , " circa " 1265 DR .

title: Blood & Magic
description: Blood & Magic Blood & Magic is a computer game released by Interplay in 1996 which uses the " Dungeons & Dragons " license . Gameplay . " Blood & Magic " is a real - time strategy game , where players take on the role of wizards , using blood magic to create monsters .
description_long: Blood & Magic Blood & Magic is a computer game released by Interplay in 1996 which uses the " Dungeons & Dragons " license . Gameplay . " Blood & Magic " is a real - time strategy game , where players take on the role of wizards , using blood magic to create monsters . The game is set in the Forgotten Realms campaign setting in an area called the Utter East . The basic units of the game are the " basal golems " , which are created at the Bloodforge . They provide for the production of new units and can be turned into buildings or monsters . When four are placed on a foundation , they may transform into a mystical site dedicated to the kind of magic the player ’ s choosing . Placing a basal golem adjacent to a friendly mystical site will allow them to change into a different creature , based on the type of mystical site . The player automatically is only able to use the weakest transformation , and can unlock more by researching . Researching costs , which is gained by creating or transforming basal golems , creating or destroying structures , casting spells and slaying enemies .

title: Blood Above , Blood Below
description: Blood Above , Blood Below Blood Above , Blood Below , designed by Will Doyle , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It was designed to be played by three different parties of adventurers at the same time , each with their own objectives but with the success of all of them together determining the final outcome . Summary .
description_long: Blood Above , Blood Below Blood Above , Blood Below , designed by Will Doyle , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It was designed to be played by three different parties of adventurers at the same time , each with their own objectives but with the success of all of them together determining the final outcome . Summary . As two mass combats play out at the same time , a trio of powerful incubi , called the Crimson Trinity attempt to channel the souls of those who die to their master , Graz ' zt , in the hopes of giving him enough power to begin a conquest of Toril . Drow refugees from Szith Morcane have warned the Emerald Enclave , Harpers , Lords ' Alliance , Order of the Gauntlet and Zhentarim of the plot , and each faction together sends hundreds of their most able agents in secret to foil it .

title: Blood Rift
description: Blood Rift The Blood Rift was named for the rift that the River of Blood created crossing the planes . It served as the main connection between the Nine Hells and the Abyss , so it was the main battlefield for the Blood War . In addition , it sometimes connected to other lower planes , bringing the eternal struggle there , until it floated away or a deity took action to stop the carnage .
description_long: Blood Rift The Blood Rift was named for the rift that the River of Blood created crossing the planes . It served as the main connection between the Nine Hells and the Abyss , so it was the main battlefield for the Blood War . In addition , it sometimes connected to other lower planes , bringing the eternal struggle there , until it floated away or a deity took action to stop the carnage . The Blood Rift was very similar to the Barrens of Doom and Despair , with empty plains and rocky badlands , perfect for ambushes and treachery . Some time during the Hundred Years of Chaos , it was revealed that yugoloth s were demon s , and the Blood Rift was folded into the Abyss .

title: Blood War
description: Blood War The Blood War is an ancient conflict that once raged between the Fiends of the Lower Planes . The Tanar ' ri are the demonic forces of the Abyss , an evil plane of chaos . Representing the equally evil but lawful realm of Baator are the Baatezu , the dominant caste of devilkin .
description_long: Blood War The Blood War is an ancient conflict that once raged between the Fiends of the Lower Planes . The Tanar ' ri are the demonic forces of the Abyss , an evil plane of chaos . Representing the equally evil but lawful realm of Baator are the Baatezu , the dominant caste of devilkin . Neutral evil Yugoloths played both sides against the other . The Blood War had raged on since the Age Before Ages , a dark time when the Prime Material Plane had not fully developed . The conflict was massive , spanning entire planes of reality , and hosting an almost infinite number of fiends . Motivations . The cause of the Blood War is unknown , but most believe it to be a remnant of the great war of Law against Chaos waged by the Wind Dukes of Aaqa against the forces of the Queen of Chaos . The yugoloths liked to entertain the notion that the War was their own personal experiment into the nature of evil , one which they created and would ultimately end on their own terms . Of course the other fiends had their own notions about the war , colored by their particular alignments and racial propaganda .

title: Blood Wine
description: Blood Wine Blood Wine was a wine exported from Aglarond . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Blood Wine Blood Wine was a wine exported from Aglarond . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy - bodied wine had deep red tones complimented by a full taste with a slight afterbite . Blood Wine used shriveled grapes that only grew on vines rumored to be possessed by spirits who performed act of cruelty during life . Prices . Blood Wine could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Blood fiend
description: Blood fiend Blood fiends are abomination s who feed on the blood of living creatures . Initially created in the Elemental Chaos , they are just as prevalent in other planes , wherever there are creatures to provide food for them . Blood fiends are often mistaken for demon s .
description_long: Blood fiend Blood fiends are abomination s who feed on the blood of living creatures . Initially created in the Elemental Chaos , they are just as prevalent in other planes , wherever there are creatures to provide food for them . Blood fiends are often mistaken for demon s . Though they are not , in fact , demons , they are fiend s , as their name implies . Physical characteristics . Blood fiends are huge creatures with a purple - black or reddish scaly hide , a lupine muzzle with great fangs , red eyes , and four clawed hands . Each of these hands has five razor - sharp claws extending from them , as do the feet . Abilities . Blood fiends prey on other fiends , as vampire s prey on humans . They also have the same ability to transform other creatures into their kind . In order to assist them in their hunts , blood fiends can use the ability " terror gaze " , which immobilizes their unfortunate victim , making the feast all the easier for the blood fiend . Blood fiends themselves are immune to fear . Most wounds inflicted on them will heal in a matter of moments .

title: Blood mage
description: Blood mage Blood mages are powerful wizard s who have learned to turn their very blood into a weapon of arcane power . The way of a blood mage is undoubtedly painful but its rewards are enormous to those strong enough to survive it . With the proper training , a blood mage makes their own body the fuel to empower their spell s .
description_long: Blood mage Blood mages are powerful wizard s who have learned to turn their very blood into a weapon of arcane power . The way of a blood mage is undoubtedly painful but its rewards are enormous to those strong enough to survive it . With the proper training , a blood mage makes their own body the fuel to empower their spell s . Abilities . Blood mage training , as one would expect , focuses entirely on using the life - giving properties of blood as a force for lethal power . Among the most basic of these abilities is a blood mage ’ s capacity to wound themselves and then , using the blood shed in this self - injury , deal additional damage to an enemy of their choice by blending their blood into one of their spells . Blood mages can also prolong the damage dealt with one of their spells or , with more training , use their wounds , while badly injured , to create a deadly blast of arcane energy emanating from their own body . The spells of a blood mage are focused around increasing the power of the wizard using them . " Blood pulse " , the simplest blood mage spell , allows a blood mage to create a blast of arcane energy from a sliver of their own blood .

title: Blood of Lathander
description: Blood of Lathander The Blood of Lathander was a minor artifact unknown to or forgotten by most of the Realms . A relic of a long - ago battle between an avatar of the Morninglord Lathander and one of Mystra ' s Chosen , it resided in a shrine in the Dalelands thorp of Hap . Description .
description_long: Blood of Lathander The Blood of Lathander was a minor artifact unknown to or forgotten by most of the Realms . A relic of a long - ago battle between an avatar of the Morninglord Lathander and one of Mystra ' s Chosen , it resided in a shrine in the Dalelands thorp of Hap . Description . Small and unremarkable other than in its rarity , the artifact was merely four drops of the deity ' s blood suspended in hardened amber the size of a clenched fist . However , whenever a follower of Lathander made use of its powers , it would levitate motionless in the air and burn with a warm pink light that , depending on the god ' s will and the actions and intentions of the follower using it , could be soft and soothing or blazingly bright . It would also pulse or blink when queried for divine wisdom . Powers . When called upon by a paladin or cleric of Lathander only , the Blood could be employed to cast " cure critical wounds " four times a day and " raise dead " once a day ; every other day it could be used to regenerate a missing body part or to cast " restoration " .

title: Blood of Morueme
description: Blood of Morueme The collective term Blood of Morueme originally was given to a subservient race of half – blue dragon hobgoblin s and their descendants but later was also used to describe a clan of blue dragons that lived beneath Dragondoom Mountain in the easternmost peaks of the Nether Mountains " circa " the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . The hobgoblins selected for breeding came from the Red Flayers tribe , which , at the time , occupied Doomspire castle on the slopes of Dragondoom . Organization .
description_long: Blood of Morueme The collective term Blood of Morueme originally was given to a subservient race of half – blue dragon hobgoblin s and their descendants but later was also used to describe a clan of blue dragons that lived beneath Dragondoom Mountain in the easternmost peaks of the Nether Mountains " circa " the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . The hobgoblins selected for breeding came from the Red Flayers tribe , which , at the time , occupied Doomspire castle on the slopes of Dragondoom . Organization . As of 1373 DR , the Blood of Morueme consisted of four adult blue dragons , sixteen half – blue dragon hobgoblins , and about 120 draconic hobgoblins ( offspring of the half - dragons and normal hobgoblins , and their descendants ) . In the long history of the Morueme clan , there were seldom more than six pure - blood dragons living together at one time . Female dragons born into the clan were driven out or killed once they reached maturity in order to prevent inbreeding .

title: Blood of the martyr
description: Blood of the martyr Blood of the martyr is a necromancy spell that transfers the caster ' s life force to heal others . Effect . The cleric may transfer his own life force directly to a target creature within range .
description_long: Blood of the martyr Blood of the martyr is a necromancy spell that transfers the caster ' s life force to heal others . Effect . The cleric may transfer his own life force directly to a target creature within range . he must transfer at least a moderate amount of life force . The creature takes the cleric ' s transferred life as if receiving a " cure wounds " spell and can only be healed to full health . This spell transfers only actual life force , not temporary life force . An unconscious target is considered a " willing creature " for purposes of this spell .

title: Bloodaxe Mercenary Company
description: Bloodaxe Mercenary Company Bloodaxe Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Sundabar around 1358 DR . Organization . The Bloodaxe were very skilled and versatile , they adapted their tactics depending of the kind of job they would do .
description_long: Bloodaxe Mercenary Company Bloodaxe Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Sundabar around 1358 DR . Organization . The Bloodaxe were very skilled and versatile , they adapted their tactics depending of the kind of job they would do . Contracts . The Bloodaxe accepted any kind of job , better if involved killing humanoid . They charged 10 gold piece s per day for their services . History . The Bloodaxe were founded by the dwarf adventurer Deldagg Huldgrym gathering many dwarves outcasts around 1318 DR . In time many human joined the group and many dwarves died in the battles against orc s , bandits raiders from Luskan . At the death of Deldagg in 1331 DR was chosen as new leader his second in command , the human fighter Velkor Minairr .

title: Bloodberry bush
description: Bloodberry bush Bloodberry bushes grew on the plains surrounding the Battle of Bones . Description . Red berries and heart - shaped reddish - green leaves characterized this small bush .
description_long: Bloodberry bush Bloodberry bushes grew on the plains surrounding the Battle of Bones . Description . Red berries and heart - shaped reddish - green leaves characterized this small bush . Uses . Berries from these bushes were extremely poisonous . Eating just a few of them killed most creatures within minutes . Even using the twigs from this bush in a campfire could prove dangerous , causing eyes to swell shut from the toxic smoke .

title: Bloodbriars
description: Bloodbriars Bloodbriars was an evocation spell that entangled a foe in unseen briars . Effects . The spell created unseen but very sharp briars from magical energy , ensnaring the foe .
description_long: Bloodbriars Bloodbriars was an evocation spell that entangled a foe in unseen briars . Effects . The spell created unseen but very sharp briars from magical energy , ensnaring the foe . It harmed them if they attempted to move or cast spells . Component . The spell required a drop of blood . History . The " armathor s " of Myth Drannor often used the " bloodbriars " spell to capture criminals .

title: Blooden
description: Blooden Blooden was a succubus and mistress of the Deep Crest , the breeding grounds of the Abyss . She was one of the demon s and devil s bound to Ammon Jerro in order to increase his warlock power . She appeared to have an infatuation with Koraboros , despite the fact he was devil and she was a demon .
description_long: Blooden Blooden was a succubus and mistress of the Deep Crest , the breeding grounds of the Abyss . She was one of the demon s and devil s bound to Ammon Jerro in order to increase his warlock power . She appeared to have an infatuation with Koraboros , despite the fact he was devil and she was a demon . She commented rather casually that she had mated with many mortal men , even those of celestial descent , but none had survived her violent mating habits .

title: Blooding
description: Blooding The Blooding was a drow coming - of - age ritual in which a maturing drow must hunt down and kill an intelligent or dangerous creature from the surface . Much of the time the ritual was fulfilled during a surface raid , the preferred target being surface elves , but captives may sometimes be placed in the Underdark for the purposes of slaughter .
description_long: Blooding The Blooding was a drow coming - of - age ritual in which a maturing drow must hunt down and kill an intelligent or dangerous creature from the surface . Much of the time the ritual was fulfilled during a surface raid , the preferred target being surface elves , but captives may sometimes be placed in the Underdark for the purposes of slaughter .

title: Bloodpurge
description: Bloodpurge Bloodpurge was an herb that could be found in the deeper parts of polluted freshwater marshes in Faerûn . Usage . Bloodpurge could be dried and used as an herb to neutralize minor poisons .
description_long: Bloodpurge Bloodpurge was an herb that could be found in the deeper parts of polluted freshwater marshes in Faerûn . Usage . Bloodpurge could be dried and used as an herb to neutralize minor poisons . Bloodpurge that was to be used in this manner cost 15 gold pieces per dose .

title: Bloodring worm
description: Bloodring worm Bloodring worms were small parasites found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These small worms had metallic skin and four red eyes that looked like small gems .
description_long: Bloodring worm Bloodring worms were small parasites found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These small worms had metallic skin and four red eyes that looked like small gems . Ecology . Bloodring worms curled their bodies into a circle , appearing just like a jeweled ring , and waited for a victim to put them around their finger . Once attached , bloodring worms feed off the blood of their host , using most of this energy to fuel their natural magic resistance . When well - fed they could grow up to one inch ( 2 . 5 cm ) per week and reach a length of one foot ( 30 cm ) .

title: Bloodroot
description: Bloodroot Bloodroot was a plant root that grew only in the Mhair Jungles . Uses . It heightened the taste of blood and was therefore highly addictive to vampires , but not particularly to anyone else .
description_long: Bloodroot Bloodroot was a plant root that grew only in the Mhair Jungles . Uses . It heightened the taste of blood and was therefore highly addictive to vampires , but not particularly to anyone else . On initial consumption , the user could feel dazed , but in vampires , it had the potential to instigate a rage upon smelling blood . Geography . It was illegal in Waterdeep .

title: Bloodsong
description: Bloodsong The Bloodsong was a special ceremony performed on the Feast of the Moon each year by the Heralds of Faerûn . Heralds had a number of duties on the Feast of the Moon , a day when the dead were traditionally honored . Prime among these was to perform the Bloodsong ceremony , at which a Herald publically recited the genealogies of each noble family in the area .
description_long: Bloodsong The Bloodsong was a special ceremony performed on the Feast of the Moon each year by the Heralds of Faerûn . Heralds had a number of duties on the Feast of the Moon , a day when the dead were traditionally honored . Prime among these was to perform the Bloodsong ceremony , at which a Herald publically recited the genealogies of each noble family in the area . In this way , the Heralds reaffirmed a noble family ' s traditional authority and status , as well as the respect accorded to them . History . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , Thorn Tree , the Herald of Riatavin in Tethyr , disappeared hours before he was to recite the Bloodsong . This triggered a storm of controversy ; for one reason , the rebel government of Riatavin had hoped to use the Bloodsong to assert their authority over the city amidst their secession from Amn to Tethyr .

title: Bloodstaunch
description: Bloodstaunch Bloodstaunch was an herb used to stop or slow the bleeding of an open wound . Location . The herb could typically be found in gullies located in relatively arid , temperate regions .
description_long: Bloodstaunch Bloodstaunch was an herb used to stop or slow the bleeding of an open wound . Location . The herb could typically be found in gullies located in relatively arid , temperate regions . Usage . Bloodstaunch could be applied directly to open wounds . It thickened blood almost immediately , causing bleeding to slow or stop completely . Bloodstaunch had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Bloodstone
description: Bloodstone Bloodstone was the " Realms " name for the mineral , a deep green - gray chalcedony with inclusions of red jasper . Description . This semi - precious stone were usually cut with beveled edges , in smooth ovals which tended to resemble drops of blood .
description_long: Bloodstone Bloodstone was the " Realms " name for the mineral , a deep green - gray chalcedony with inclusions of red jasper . Description . This semi - precious stone were usually cut with beveled edges , in smooth ovals which tended to resemble drops of blood . A typical bloodstone has a base value of 50 gp . Historically , bloodstone was also sold in bars worth twenty - five gold pieces , each with the stamp of a Damaran noble house . History . Bloodstones were mined throughout the Galena Mountains in places such as the Bloodstone Mines primarily in Damara and supported a thriving gem trade in that region .

title: Bloodstone Barony
description: Bloodstone Barony Bloodstone was the name for the barony of Damara that lay within Bloodstone Pass , a narrow valley that crossed the Galena Mountains between Vaasa and Damara . History . The barony of Bloodstone was ruled by the king of Vaasa and Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane .
description_long: Bloodstone Barony Bloodstone was the name for the barony of Damara that lay within Bloodstone Pass , a narrow valley that crossed the Galena Mountains between Vaasa and Damara . History . The barony of Bloodstone was ruled by the king of Vaasa and Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane . The last Baron of Bloodstone was Gareth ' s father - in - law , Baron Tranth . Lordship passed to Gareth as a result of his magnificent leadership protecting Bloodstone Village from bandits , preventing evil priests from summoning Orcus to the material plane in the Bloodstone Mines , and defeating the Witch - King Zhengyi .

title: Bloodstone Lands
description: Bloodstone Lands The Bloodstone Lands were a part of the Cold Lands and referred to a cold region in northeast Faerûn , found nestled between the Great Glacier to the north , the nation of Impiltur to the south , and Thar , the Moonsea and Mulmaster to the west . It was roughly triangular in shape and primarily encompassed Damara and Vaasa . It had an area of around 150 , 000 square miles ( 388 , 500 km ) .
description_long: Bloodstone Lands The Bloodstone Lands were a part of the Cold Lands and referred to a cold region in northeast Faerûn , found nestled between the Great Glacier to the north , the nation of Impiltur to the south , and Thar , the Moonsea and Mulmaster to the west . It was roughly triangular in shape and primarily encompassed Damara and Vaasa . It had an area of around 150 , 000 square miles ( 388 , 500 km ) . Its northern boundary was formed by the edge of the Great Glacier , and to the west , the Galena Mountains and Earthspur Mountains acted as a natural border to Thar and Cormanthor . Impiltur was to the south , and Narfell , the Great Dale and Thesk to the east . The Bloodstone Lands received their name from bloodstone , a precious gem mined throughout the region . The nation of Damara used this commodity to establish themselves as a major power in Faerûn . History . The early recorded history of the " Bloodstone Lands " begins with the prosperous rise of Damara as a nation in 1064 DR under the long unbroken line of Feldrin Bloodfeathers , the first King of Damara and founder of its capital Heliogabalus .

title: Bloodstone Pass
description: Bloodstone Pass Bloodstone Pass was the only reasonable crossing point through the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . History . The pass acted as a trade route between Damara and Vaasa .
description_long: Bloodstone Pass Bloodstone Pass was the only reasonable crossing point through the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . History . The pass acted as a trade route between Damara and Vaasa . Due to the extremely impassable terrain that constituted the majority of the mountain range , the pass was the easiest route and was of great strategic importance to both Damara and Vaasa . It opened into Bloodstone Barony and contained Bloodstone Village , the Bloodstone Mines , Lake Midai , Waukeshire , the Vaasan Gate , Windless , and Virdin . Bloodstone Pass was originally formed only around 1070 DR when the edge of the Great Glacier withdrew to the north .

title: Bloodstone Pass ( adventure )
description: Bloodstone Pass ( adventure ) Bloodstone Pass is a adventure that was later into the " Forgotten Realms " . It was the first module to feature the tabletop rules . The storyline of " Bloodstone Pass " introduced the character of Gareth Dragonsbane and the Order of the Golden Cup , and was later expanded on in the H series of adventure modules .
description_long: Bloodstone Pass ( adventure ) Bloodstone Pass is a adventure that was later into the " Forgotten Realms " . It was the first module to feature the tabletop rules . The storyline of " Bloodstone Pass " introduced the character of Gareth Dragonsbane and the Order of the Golden Cup , and was later expanded on in the H series of adventure modules .

title: Bloodstone Village
description: Bloodstone Village Bloodstone Village was the second largest settlement in Bloodstone Pass , the only real accessible link between the lands of Vaasa and Damara . It was within the Barony of Bloodstone before 1357 DR , but the baron of the time , Baron Tranth , had little power over the dominion . In 1359 DR , it became the home of the King of Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane .
description_long: Bloodstone Village Bloodstone Village was the second largest settlement in Bloodstone Pass , the only real accessible link between the lands of Vaasa and Damara . It was within the Barony of Bloodstone before 1357 DR , but the baron of the time , Baron Tranth , had little power over the dominion . In 1359 DR , it became the home of the King of Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane . The village of Bloodstone layed on the shores of Lake Midai where it joined with the Beaumaris River which ran into the Galena Mountains . History . Before 1357 DR , Bloodstone Village was an important trade route . However , when a dragon turtle was slain in the seas to the south that terrorized shipping , a trade route by sea was opened in the Sea of Fallen Stars . The land trade route that ran through Bloodstone Village was less frequented and the village fell on hard times . During this time , the Bloodstone Pass became cut off from the rest of the Kingdom of Damara due to the war with Vaasa to the north . Many settlements within the area were reduced to anarachy . In this anarchy came the Citadel of Assassins and their hold on the village .

title: Bloodwind
description: Bloodwind Bloodwind was a high - member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , after his fellow cultists infiltrated the monastery , Bloodwind went there to commence an elemental ritual .
description_long: Bloodwind Bloodwind was a high - member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , after his fellow cultists infiltrated the monastery , Bloodwind went there to commence an elemental ritual . He dismissed the local cultist leader . He and his genasi assistants arrived at the monastery disguised as a group of sages and established themselves at the Tower of the Winds . There they started the ritual , generating a strange storm around the monastery . At last , thanks to Lana ' s report , an adventuring party hired by the Order of the Gauntlet , the Lords ' Alliance , and Zor Garwyl Gos of Mulmaster stopped the ritual and defeated him .

title: Bloody Keel
description: Bloody Keel The Bloody Keel was the ship of the fiery red haired rogue Sheila Kree . It received its name from the punishment its captain exacted upon those who did not obey , keelhauling . Cattie - Brie sank the Bloody Keel by shooting the helmsman as Sheila Kree and her band was making a hasty escape from her cove .
description_long: Bloody Keel The Bloody Keel was the ship of the fiery red haired rogue Sheila Kree . It received its name from the punishment its captain exacted upon those who did not obey , keelhauling . Cattie - Brie sank the Bloody Keel by shooting the helmsman as Sheila Kree and her band was making a hasty escape from her cove . With no one at the helm , the Bloody Keel crashed against the rocks and sank .

title: Bloody Skull
description: Bloody Skull The Bloody Skull was an orc clan in the Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn . History . In the mid - 12th century DR , the Bloody Skull were among an alliance of goblin s and orcs that were determined to annihilate the dwarves of Earthfast .
description_long: Bloody Skull The Bloody Skull was an orc clan in the Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn . History . In the mid - 12th century DR , the Bloody Skull were among an alliance of goblin s and orcs that were determined to annihilate the dwarves of Earthfast . In the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , while joining the Army of the Alliance , the Earthfast dwarves discovered an orcish attack on them south of Uthmerg in the Great Dale . Alusair Obarskyr feared the Bloody Skull were responsible , but they turned out to be from Zhentil Keep instead .

title: Bloom
description: Bloom Bloom was a minor arcane spell that allowed a magic - user to conjure flowers in bloom . Effect . The " bloom " spell simply conjured a cut flower , typically a rose , in full bloom and floating in the air where directed .
description_long: Bloom Bloom was a minor arcane spell that allowed a magic - user to conjure flowers in bloom . Effect . The " bloom " spell simply conjured a cut flower , typically a rose , in full bloom and floating in the air where directed . Practitioners . It was a special spell known to elves of Shadowdale . History . Cybriana of Shadowdale was travelling to Waterdeep in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR when she lodged with Jalma and two other elven women . At Jalma ' s question about the spells of Shadowdale elves , Cybriana demonstrated the " bloom " spell . However , she was shocked to find her fingers transformed into pink crystal , the result of a curse when she used arcane magic . Later , when trapped inside a " forcecage " , Cybriana used a " bloom " spell , conjuring fresh flowers throughout the caverns below where her friends battled through Imgig Zu ' s ogre minions . The flowers formed a trail , leading Timoth Eyesbright and the others to her rescue .

title: Bloppblippoodd
description: Bloppblippoodd Bloppblippoodd was a kuo - toa cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Bloppblippoodd was a bloodthirsty sadist absolutely assured that her divine vision would raise her in glory to rule her people .
description_long: Bloppblippoodd Bloppblippoodd was a kuo - toa cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Bloppblippoodd was a bloodthirsty sadist absolutely assured that her divine vision would raise her in glory to rule her people . History . Bloppblippoodd lived quietly in the village of Sloobludop on the Darklake , which was ruled by her father Ploopploopeen . During the Rage of Demons , however , she had a vision of a new god Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father , ( in truth , demon lord Demogorgon , ) and spread her new religion among the kuo - toa . Soon she had gathered so many followers to her that her father Ploopploopeen started to make plan to reclaim his position . To her surprise , her father and his minions came to Leemooggoogoon ' s temple offering as sacrifices a party of adventurers who had escaped from drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Blowpipe
description: Blowpipe Blowpipes come in varying sizes , depending on philosophy of use . When the user needs a medium ranged weapon , for hunting or fighting , the blowpipe is longer , about 2 to 4 feet long , and heavier and uses larger dart s . When they need a small , concealable short range weapon they are 8 inches to 2 feet .
description_long: Blowpipe Blowpipes come in varying sizes , depending on philosophy of use . When the user needs a medium ranged weapon , for hunting or fighting , the blowpipe is longer , about 2 to 4 feet long , and heavier and uses larger dart s . When they need a small , concealable short range weapon they are 8 inches to 2 feet . Sometimes the blowpipe is foldable , allowing it to be concealed but also offering greater range and stopping power . Description . Smaller blowpipes are generally made of wood , while larger blowpipes may be made out of any metallic substance , as they can double as clubs .

title: Blue Age
description: Blue Age The Blue Age was a time in the ancient history of Abeir - Toril when life on the planet resided in a single , vast ocean . The Dawn War between the god s and the primordial s raged mostly over this unfortunate planet at the time and one of the primordials , Dendar the Night Serpent , devoured one of Selûne ' s most favored creations , the sun ( a feat her sister Shar had been attempting since its creation ) . The temperatures on Abeir - Toril subsequently dropped markedly and not long afterward , most life on the planet became extinct .
description_long: Blue Age The Blue Age was a time in the ancient history of Abeir - Toril when life on the planet resided in a single , vast ocean . The Dawn War between the god s and the primordial s raged mostly over this unfortunate planet at the time and one of the primordials , Dendar the Night Serpent , devoured one of Selûne ' s most favored creations , the sun ( a feat her sister Shar had been attempting since its creation ) . The temperatures on Abeir - Toril subsequently dropped markedly and not long afterward , most life on the planet became extinct . Thus ended the Blue Age and gave rise to the Shadow Epoch .

title: Blue Bear Tribe
description: Blue Bear Tribe The Blue Bear Tribe were a tribe of the Uthgardt . History . In 1313 DR , the Tree Ghost tribe separated from the Blue Bears .
description_long: Blue Bear Tribe The Blue Bear Tribe were a tribe of the Uthgardt . History . In 1313 DR , the Tree Ghost tribe separated from the Blue Bears . Around 1368 DR , shaman and chieftain , Tanta Hagara , marched the Blue Bears on Hellgate Keep and in 1369 DR , the tribe destroyed at Hellgate Keep . Their totem was defeated and absorbed by Malar the Beastlord . Relationships . The Blue Bear tribe became extinct in 1369 DR , although its bloodline continued in the Tree Ghost tribe that broke off from the corrupt Blue Bears in 1313 DR . Notes . The Blue Bear deity appears to be the same as the so - called " render " from the Forgotten Realms DC Comic ( issue 14 ) .

title: Blue Dragons
description: Blue Dragons The Blue Dragons was the name of Cormyr ' s navy . They were based in the Citadel of the Purple Dragons in Suzail and patrolled the waters of the Dragonmere . Organization .
description_long: Blue Dragons The Blue Dragons was the name of Cormyr ' s navy . They were based in the Citadel of the Purple Dragons in Suzail and patrolled the waters of the Dragonmere . Organization . The Blue Dragons numbered 2500 trained naval warriors . Fourteen large vessels led the fleet . One , the unofficial royal barge called the " Crown of Cormyr " , was a floating palace . The lead ship was called the " Dragon " and was the largest warship in the fleet . These ships , brimming with ballista e and pots of alchemist ' s fire for throwing at enemies , were actually more for show than combat . Their mere presence in the harbor was enough to dissuade Westgate and the other enemy navies of the Sea of Fallen Stars from attacking Suzail . The ships that did most of the work were much smaller and faster coast - runners such as the " Blade of Espar " and the " Lance of Wheloon " . These were out almost every day on the waters of the Inner Sea hunting pirates .

title: Blue Kumi Bandits
description: Blue Kumi Bandits The Blue Kumi Bandits were a group of bandits who plagued the Fochu Peninsula around 1358 DR . They were originally a group of disaffected bushi of the city of Fochu . Without work , they turned to banditry , using a distinctive blue kumi ( braid ) dangling down their backs .
description_long: Blue Kumi Bandits The Blue Kumi Bandits were a group of bandits who plagued the Fochu Peninsula around 1358 DR . They were originally a group of disaffected bushi of the city of Fochu . Without work , they turned to banditry , using a distinctive blue kumi ( braid ) dangling down their backs . At last , they were defeated by the combined efforts of the heroine Oe - Ura and of Osari Minhiro and his foreign adventuring party .

title: Blue Lady
description: Blue Lady The Blue Lady was a spellplague - changed sirine worshiped by the Choir cult . History . The Blue Lady was a sirine that was transmuted by the Spellplague .
description_long: Blue Lady The Blue Lady was a spellplague - changed sirine worshiped by the Choir cult . History . The Blue Lady was a sirine that was transmuted by the Spellplague . Twisted , she resided in Tohrepur . There , prior to 1473 DR , she transformed the farmer Khault , who was fleeing from his destroyed village , into an aberration and he gathered a cult around her . In 1479 DR , Khault sent members to Airspur to recruit . The Choir kidnapped several residents of Airspur , including the twin sister of a genasi named Ghaelya who the cult believed to be a prophetess . With the help of Uthalion and a few of his friends , Ghaelya traveled to Tohrepur , where one of her friends killed Khault and destroyed the Blue Lady .

title: Blue Sigil
description: Blue Sigil The Blue Sigil was a mercenary company comprised of ogre s that was based in Mog ' s Keep , near Longsaddle and operated throughout the North . Around 1358 DR , they were led by an ogre named Mog the Fist , whose keep bore his name . History .
description_long: Blue Sigil The Blue Sigil was a mercenary company comprised of ogre s that was based in Mog ' s Keep , near Longsaddle and operated throughout the North . Around 1358 DR , they were led by an ogre named Mog the Fist , whose keep bore his name . History . The Blue Sigil was founded by Thorog , after his tribe had been repeatedly raided by adventures , brandishing unique symbols while being paid to kill ogres . He reasoned that if others could be paid to kill ogres , his tribe could turn the table and return in kind . Finding work was difficult at first , but the company garnered a reputation of reliability . Recruitment . Thorog and his successors ( of which Mog was the eighth ) accepted lone ogres into their group , provided they passed an initiation . This had led to a fairly large population within the group .

title: Blue Wyvern Company
description: Blue Wyvern Company The Blue Wyvern Company was an adventuring group based in Ravens Bluff . The group was best known for helping Jack Ravenwild recover the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal in 1479 DR . History .
description_long: Blue Wyvern Company The Blue Wyvern Company was an adventuring group based in Ravens Bluff . The group was best known for helping Jack Ravenwild recover the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Jack Ravenwild hired the Blue Wyverns at a pay rate of 500 gold pieces each to help him recover the Sarkenaegal from the ancient dwarven city of Sarbreen located beneath Ravens Bluff . In Sarbreen , the group fought and defeated a tribe of troglodyte s who were in service to a beholder . Once they found the book in the Temple of the Soulforger they had to fight Myrkyssa Jelan ' s gang , the Moondaggers , for possession of the book . Later , Jack hired the Blue Wyverns to back him up when he delivered a shadow simulacrum of himself to a mage who was trying to imprison Jack once again in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff . Jack hired the group a third time to ambush and capture the notorious slaver Fetterfist . The fourth service performed for Jack was on the house as the band rushed to a nobleman ' s party to drive off Fetterfist ' s gang and a group of drow who intended to kill as many nobles as possible and enslave the rest .

title: Blue dragon
description: Blue dragon Blue dragons , also known as storm dragons , are orderly creatures and are unusual for chromatics in that they keep fairly well - ordered , hierarchical societies . They are more likely to be mocking and manipulative than outrightly cruel or murderous to ' lesser ' creatures , aided greatly by their natural talents for hallucination . They are infamous for tricking desert travelers into drinking sand or going miles out of their way to avoid nonexistent dust basins .
description_long: Blue dragon Blue dragons , also known as storm dragons , are orderly creatures and are unusual for chromatics in that they keep fairly well - ordered , hierarchical societies . They are more likely to be mocking and manipulative than outrightly cruel or murderous to ' lesser ' creatures , aided greatly by their natural talents for hallucination . They are infamous for tricking desert travelers into drinking sand or going miles out of their way to avoid nonexistent dust basins . Their breath weapon is a line of lightning or a large electrical discharge . Physical description . Blue dragons are physically distinguished by the single large horns protruding from their heads and also by their ears , which are rather large and frilled . The tail is thick and bumpy , like that of a caterpillar . The wings are more pronounced than most other species ' . They smell like electricity or sand . Combat . The blue dragon excells at aerial combat , perhaps moreso than any other species of dragon . Their lightning discharges are very easy to aim at other aerial foes , or at creatures below them on the ground .

title: Blue ice
description: Blue ice Blue ice was a mysterious magical substance found in the Yellow Sea of Kara - Tur . Blue ice was so cold it burned flesh , yet it sizzled and smoked when immersed in water . Appendix .
description_long: Blue ice Blue ice was a mysterious magical substance found in the Yellow Sea of Kara - Tur . Blue ice was so cold it burned flesh , yet it sizzled and smoked when immersed in water . Appendix . Notes . It is completely unknown what blue ice could be .

title: Blue quartz
description: Blue quartz Blue quartz was a transparent , pale blue crystal . Description . These large , single crystallized ornamental stones were the preferred ingredient to produce gems of seeing , especially in ancient versions of this magic item .
description_long: Blue quartz Blue quartz was a transparent , pale blue crystal . Description . These large , single crystallized ornamental stones were the preferred ingredient to produce gems of seeing , especially in ancient versions of this magic item . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Blue slaad
description: Blue slaad Blue slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Blue slaadi had bone hooks protruding from the backs of their hands .
description_long: Blue slaad Blue slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Blue slaadi had bone hooks protruding from the backs of their hands . If a humanoid was hit by one of these hooks , it could become infected with a disease known as chaos phage . If allowed to run its course , chaos phage would drain the life of the humanoid within days . If a sufficiently powerful spellcaster was killed by chaos phage , he or she was instantly transformed into a green slaad . Otherwise , the disease produced a red slaad . In either case , the creature retained all its memories . The only way to revert this transformation once it was completed was through the use of a " wish " spell . Blue slaadi matured from slaad tadpole s that were born from eggs laid by red slaadi in humanoids .

title: Bluecap
description: Bluecap Bluecap fungus was the main staple grain of the Underdark . Description . Bluecaps were tall ( up to 6 inches ) , slender white mushrooms with pale blue caps .
description_long: Bluecap Bluecap fungus was the main staple grain of the Underdark . Description . Bluecaps were tall ( up to 6 inches ) , slender white mushrooms with pale blue caps . Uses . Bluecap was inedible in its raw state , but it could be ground into a bland flour and baked into nutritious sporebread ( also called bluebread ) . Bluecap was known for its ease of cultivation ( it could be grown with or without " faerzress " ) , and it was cultivated by nearly all of the Underdark races . A loaf of spoorbread was equivalent to one pound ( almost a half kilogram ) of food . The caps of bluecap mushrooms could be prepared by those with the correct herbalism knowledge to make a stew that would neutralize poison . Location . Bluecap was cultivated nearly everywhere in the Underdark . It was also found on the High Moor , where it was eaten by the creatures that wandered the moor and collected by human s for food .

title: Blueflame ghost
description: Blueflame ghost Blueflame ghosts are spirits which are imprisoned within blueflame magic items . Some members of the adventuring group The Nine are among the blueflame ghosts . The term comes from the magical blue flames that surround the ghosts .
description_long: Blueflame ghost Blueflame ghosts are spirits which are imprisoned within blueflame magic items . Some members of the adventuring group The Nine are among the blueflame ghosts . The term comes from the magical blue flames that surround the ghosts . The owner of the item containing a blueflame ghost may call the spirit forth and force it to do his bidding which is usually to kill someone . At least seven blueflame ghosts were known to exist and there may be many others . Larloch created the blueflame items with the help of the Imprisoners by binding the spirits of three liches to the items . Each of the items possesses its own power when the ghost is imprisoned but the power is dormant when the ghost is outside the item . Part of the goddess Mystra ' s power is bound to the items and The Simbul believes it may be possible to bring Mystra back through the blueflame items .

title: Blueleaf
description: Blueleaf A blueleaf was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Bluewood was the name of the wood taken from this tree . Description .
description_long: Blueleaf A blueleaf was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Bluewood was the name of the wood taken from this tree . Description . The tree resembled a large maple . It was so named for the color of its leaves , which were a strange , gleaming blue and had many points . They actually glowed with a faint , blue light . The wood of the tree was surprisingly durable ; the relatively thin trunk rarely broke , even when under extreme stress . They bent in winds and under snows , and in winter they could stabilize snow tunnels over roads that sheltered travelers . Blueleafs often grew in thick copses and typically reached heights of 40 feet ( 12 meters ) . Usage . Blueleaf leaves and sap could be crushed to make a bright blue dye often used in clothing manufacture in the North . These could also be burned to produce vivid , jumping blue flames that were favored by minstrels and storytellers for special effects . The wood of the blueleaf tree , known as bluewood , was used by Volodni craftsfolk to make weapons and armor . Bluewood was magically treated to become as hard as steel , though it weighed half as much . Locations .

title: Bluestone
description: Bluestone Bluestone was the " Realms " name for , or " ditroite " , which was a rich blue but soft and brittle mineral . Sometimes bluestone had veins of pink , white , cream , and yellow . Description .
description_long: Bluestone Bluestone was the " Realms " name for , or " ditroite " , which was a rich blue but soft and brittle mineral . Sometimes bluestone had veins of pink , white , cream , and yellow . Description . These ornamental stones were found in the Storm Horn Mountains , the Thunder Peaks and other geologically old mountain ranges . It was usually cut and polished or tumbled smooth ; very rarely it was hard enough to be cut in facets . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Blugdub
description: Blugdub Blugdub was an orog leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Blugdub , like Ashkabbar , led a group of orc s into a section of Blingdenstone .
description_long: Blugdub Blugdub was an orog leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Blugdub , like Ashkabbar , led a group of orc s into a section of Blingdenstone . They too started raiding the deep gnome settlers led by Kargien Dissengulp . Finally , in 1479 DR , an adventuring party hired by Kargien defeated Blugdub and Ashkabbar and forced the orcs to abandoned the city .

title: Blur
description: Blur Blur was an illusion spell that made the contours of a caster " blurry " . Effects . When under this spell , the caster would become harder to hit as they did not appear to have a solid form any more .
description_long: Blur Blur was an illusion spell that made the contours of a caster " blurry " . Effects . When under this spell , the caster would become harder to hit as they did not appear to have a solid form any more . Attacks made against a blurred caster by someone who couldn ' t see it ignored this spell , of course , as they couldn ' t see the effect . Components . The older versions of the spell needed verbal and somatic components , but the later version only needed a verbal component .

title: Blushing Mermaid
description: Blushing Mermaid The Blushing Mermaid was a famous lower - class tavern in the city of Baldur ' s Gate , located in the northeast part of the upper city on the Sword Coast . Structure . The tavern was long , low building which looked like it would collapse at any minute .
description_long: Blushing Mermaid The Blushing Mermaid was a famous lower - class tavern in the city of Baldur ' s Gate , located in the northeast part of the upper city on the Sword Coast . Structure . The tavern was long , low building which looked like it would collapse at any minute . It was surrounded on three sides by a tangle of stables , outbuildings , and enclosures . It was known to have at least four levels of cellars , and many more were said to exist . Stories told of hidden passages and connections to the city ' s sewer system . Interior . The lobby had a high of ceiling adorned with a crudely carved life - sized mermaid suspended over the reception desk . This nearly nude woman was adorned with more than a score of blackened and shriveled severed hands of patrons who did not pay their bills . There were rumors these hands could magically animate and aid the desk clerk in " handling " the city watch , intruders , or obnoxious guests . The tavern ' s other rooms had low ceilings and dim of lighting ; they were furnished with mismatched and much - abused furniture .

title: Blustich
description: Blustich Blustich was a small hamlet on the edge of the Hermit ' s Wood and the west bank of the Wyvernflow . Inhabitants . The villagers of Blustich spent most of their time hunting , fishing , and farming .
description_long: Blustich Blustich was a small hamlet on the edge of the Hermit ' s Wood and the west bank of the Wyvernflow . Inhabitants . The villagers of Blustich spent most of their time hunting , fishing , and farming . The townsfolk were known for their skill at " windraising " dancing where they could conjure up strong winds .

title: Bly Ruldegost
description: Bly Ruldegost Bly Ruldegost was a proud and honorable member of the Knights of the Shield and the regent of House Ruldegost . Personality . While Ruldegost attempted to recruit other Waterdhavian nobles to his order , he did not believe in instituting a Knight of the Shield within the ranks of the Lords of Waterdeep .
description_long: Bly Ruldegost Bly Ruldegost was a proud and honorable member of the Knights of the Shield and the regent of House Ruldegost . Personality . While Ruldegost attempted to recruit other Waterdhavian nobles to his order , he did not believe in instituting a Knight of the Shield within the ranks of the Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Boakhar
description: Boakhar Boakhar was what folk of the " Realms " called . Description . This semi - precious stone was extremely soft and fragile , but its tabular red or orange crystals yielded small transparent gem s for use in ornamental gem - work , such as inlays on furniture and royal displays .
description_long: Boakhar Boakhar was what folk of the " Realms " called . Description . This semi - precious stone was extremely soft and fragile , but its tabular red or orange crystals yielded small transparent gem s for use in ornamental gem - work , such as inlays on furniture and royal displays . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Boar
description: Boar Boars are wild relatives of the domestic pig . Physical description . Boars are covered in thick fur , often brown or grayish in color .
description_long: Boar Boars are wild relatives of the domestic pig . Physical description . Boars are covered in thick fur , often brown or grayish in color . The exact size of a boar varies from species to species , from roughly human size to roughly the mass of an ogre or similarly sized creature . All varieties of boars are armed with sharp tusks that jut out from beneath their snout and which are capable of causing serious injury . Boars also have a highly developed sense of smell . Personality . Though not predatory by nature , boars are ill - tempered and territorial , a combination made worse by boars ’ powerful musculature and sharp tusks . Ecology . Habitats . Boars are found in most locales across the world , from chilly tundras to hot jungles . They are also found in the Feywild as well as on the Prime Material Plane . Society . Boars usually travel in groups known as sounders . Species . There are several species of boar , some of which are listed below .

title: Boareskyr Bridge
