description: Boareskyr Bridge Boareskyr Bridge was the crossing over the Winding Water connecting Soubar , Triel , and Scornubel to Waterdeep and the Trade Way . History . The bridge was built by the traveler Boareskyr .
description_long: Boareskyr Bridge Boareskyr Bridge was the crossing over the Winding Water connecting Soubar , Triel , and Scornubel to Waterdeep and the Trade Way . History . The bridge was built by the traveler Boareskyr . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , the gods Cyric and Bhaal fought a battle on the bridge . The resulting destruction of Bhaal poisoned the water in the vicinity of the bridge and further downstream . Because of this , an oft - heard curse was " Go drink from the west side of the bridge ! " Structure . The bridge was made of black granite and had a statue of Cyric at one end and another of Bhaal at the other end . A semi - permanent trading community sprang up around the bridge . By 1481 DR , it was composed of numerous white tents , corrals , blacksmiths , and bustling marketplace . Because it was only a waystation , goods were not cheap there . Government . There was no formal government at the Boareskyr Bridge , but two adventurer s named Barim Stagwinter and Theskul Mirroreye walled off a tent community in order to make a proper town . By 1479 DR , the paladin s of Elturgard had built a keep to defend the bridge from invaders .

title: Bodak
description: Bodak Bodaks were what was left of a humanoid that had been destroyed by the touch of pure evil , such as that of a nightwalker . Undead creatures devoid of personality or a soul , bodaks were cruel and relentless hunters , either of their own volition or at the behest of some greater power , such as the nightwalker that created them . Ecology .
description_long: Bodak Bodaks were what was left of a humanoid that had been destroyed by the touch of pure evil , such as that of a nightwalker . Undead creatures devoid of personality or a soul , bodaks were cruel and relentless hunters , either of their own volition or at the behest of some greater power , such as the nightwalker that created them . Ecology . Physical characteristics . Bodaks resembled their living form to a certain extent , being roughly the same size and shape . However , there are differences which are immediately obvious to the eye . Bodak skin were a deathly , pale white or gray , devoid of any hair at all . More eerie still is their face , which is twisted into an inhuman visage of sheer madness and horror with empty , white eyes . Like many undead creatures , bodaks have an inherent weakness against brilliant light , and therefore shun sunlight whenever they are able to . They are , however , completely invulnerable to disease or poison and have a strong resistance against the effects of necrotic power . Abilities . Bodaks possessed a number of unusual abilities granted to them by their undead state .

title: Boddyknock Glinckle
description: Boddyknock Glinckle Boddyknock Glinckle was a male gnome sorcerer from Lantan who was present in Neverwinter during the Wailing Death . Description . A henchman to the Hero of Neverwinter , Boddyknock was skilled in arcane magic but also used a crossbow and dagger when needed .
description_long: Boddyknock Glinckle Boddyknock Glinckle was a male gnome sorcerer from Lantan who was present in Neverwinter during the Wailing Death . Description . A henchman to the Hero of Neverwinter , Boddyknock was skilled in arcane magic but also used a crossbow and dagger when needed . He was said to be a very serious looking gnome , often deep in thought and concentrating on the world around him . Personality . Similar to other born and bred Lantanese gnomes , Boddyknock was deeply interested in science and applied a logical outlook to his lifestyle and work , despite being skilled in magic and not an inventor like many Lantanese natives were . He tended to be very enthusiastic and obsessive with his past times , whatever they may have been , one of those being interested and investigating the plague which hit Neverwinter . He claimed to first and foremost be a sorcerer , despite his investigatory tendencies as well . Possessions . His adventures resulted in his search and acquisition of a leavened bread recipe , found in Siril ' s Bakery within the Beggar ' s nest district of Neverwinter .

title: Bodhi
description: Bodhi Bodhi was a vampire who was expelled from Suldanessellar , which would lead to her becoming an undead . She , with Jon Irenicus , was a plotter who wanted to drain the Tree of Life and become immortal . She was also once in love with Abdel Adrian , Hero of Baldur ' s Gate , as he was with her .
description_long: Bodhi Bodhi was a vampire who was expelled from Suldanessellar , which would lead to her becoming an undead . She , with Jon Irenicus , was a plotter who wanted to drain the Tree of Life and become immortal . She was also once in love with Abdel Adrian , Hero of Baldur ' s Gate , as he was with her . She was also in charge of a vampiric thieves guild designed to compete with the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla . In the novel . In the novel , Bodhi , posing as an ordinary woman , presents herself as a contact who can help Abdel Adrian find his sister Imoen and his lover Jaheira . Her neutrality in the task is compromised from the very beginning , however , when she sees Adrian fighting naked and feels stirrings that she has not felt for centuries and falls in love with him . She can ' t help but start blatantly seducing him from their first encounter . But as she ' s supposed to , she also informs him that she can arrange him passage to Spellhold if he can come up with an appropriate payment . He has no money , as he was earlier stripped of literally everything he had , but she " happens " to know of a job he could do to gain it .

title: Body link
description: Body link Body link was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable by wizard s and priest s ( cleric s ) . Effects .
description_long: Body link Body link was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable by wizard s and priest s ( cleric s ) . Effects . " Body link " was used to prevent death from decapitation , or other kinds of dismemberment , by linking all body parts so that their separation would not effect them in any way . Example : a wizard was decapitated , yet his head could still talk and eat normally . Decapitation could cause the wielder to collapse . The duration of this spell was based directly on the caster ' s power . Once dismemberment occurred , the spell lasted for a few more minutes . Any separated body part need only be placed at the site of dismemberment to be re - attached . The full normal effects of dismemberment were experienced if the body part was not re - attached before the spell expired . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a pearl worth at least 500 gold pieces , a small amount of tree sap which was eaten by the caster . Casting the spell destroyed the pearl .

title: Boesild Aerasumé
description: Boesild Aerasumé Boesild Aerasumé was Alustriel Silverhand ' s eighth son . He was known for being the most pragmatic of her sons . Boesild was also the Moonstars ' regional agent for Luruar and the Evermoors regions and the only one of Alustriel ' s children who got on well with Khelben Arunsun .
description_long: Boesild Aerasumé Boesild Aerasumé was Alustriel Silverhand ' s eighth son . He was known for being the most pragmatic of her sons . Boesild was also the Moonstars ' regional agent for Luruar and the Evermoors regions and the only one of Alustriel ' s children who got on well with Khelben Arunsun . The rest only barely tolerated him for their mother ' s sake .

title: Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II
description: Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II was a male gnome fighter and owner of the tavern called The Furniture ' s Fate in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Boffo , being an eccentric prankster , was usually at the center of brawls in the aptly named Furniture ' s Fate .
description_long: Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II was a male gnome fighter and owner of the tavern called The Furniture ' s Fate in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Boffo , being an eccentric prankster , was usually at the center of brawls in the aptly named Furniture ' s Fate . When he wasn ' t , he usually had his bouncer Stig lift him up and hurl the gnome into the fray .

title: Bog Luck
description: Bog Luck Bog Luck was a half - orc member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin , and the owner of the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North . History . Bog Luck owned a roadhouse north of Waterdeep on a highly trafficked caravan road - the High Road .
description_long: Bog Luck Bog Luck was a half - orc member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin , and the owner of the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North . History . Bog Luck owned a roadhouse north of Waterdeep on a highly trafficked caravan road - the High Road . He used this position to smuggle the Cult ' s goods away from the caravans that stopped at his place . The delivered goods were shipped further by some lizardfolk via a tunnel .

title: Bogclaw
description: Bogclaw Bogclaw was a lizardfolk in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bogclaw was a young and strong leader for his tribe .
description_long: Bogclaw Bogclaw was a lizardfolk in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bogclaw was a young and strong leader for his tribe . He hated Throstulgrael and did not accept serving him . In order to defeat the dragon , he was willing to do anything . History . Bogclaw was the heir of the Muckmarsh tribe , which was ruled by his father , Scalecrusher . However , in 1489 DR , the black dragon Throstulgrael arrived , killed Scalecrusher , and enslaved the Muckmarsh and two neighboring lizardfolk tribes . The dragon declared a contest to elect a new leader of all lizardfolk : each candidate had to kidnap as many humanoid s as possible and afterward compete against each other . Bogclaw , believed dead like his father , did not agree with these conditions and tried to ruin the contest . To this end , he indirectly helped an adventuring party hired to save the kidnapped people , and the adventurers managed to ruin the dragon ' s plot . Afterward , he led a coup to regain control of his tribe and then attacked the two other tribes . In the fighting , however , he was killed by the adventurers as they sought to protect the kidnapped people .

title: Boggle
description: Boggle Boggles were creatures born out of feelings of loneliness , materializing where the Feywild touched the world in proximity to an intelligent being that felt isolated or abandoned . Boggles were not murderous , and preferred to do simple tricks such as breaking dishes , and so on .
description_long: Boggle Boggles were creatures born out of feelings of loneliness , materializing where the Feywild touched the world in proximity to an intelligent being that felt isolated or abandoned . Boggles were not murderous , and preferred to do simple tricks such as breaking dishes , and so on .

title: Bogo Rath
description: Bogo Rath Bogo Rath was an evil wizard who was affiliated with the Night Masks and Castle Trinity . History . Bogo was a minor wizard in the Night Masks but later quit the thieves ' guild and entered into the service of the powerful wizard Aballister Bonaduce , leader of Castle Trinity .
description_long: Bogo Rath Bogo Rath was an evil wizard who was affiliated with the Night Masks and Castle Trinity . History . Bogo was a minor wizard in the Night Masks but later quit the thieves ' guild and entered into the service of the powerful wizard Aballister Bonaduce , leader of Castle Trinity . In 1361 , when Aballister decided to have Cadderly Bonaduce killed , Bogo Rath enlisted the help of his former fellows , for the right price , and assisted them by providing magic support . He proved himself very nefarious , twisting Kierkan Rufo in evil ways and manipulating him into causing the death of Avery Schell , the stepfather of Cadderly . It was all in vain , however , and Cadderly and his friends in the end slaughtered all the Night Mask ' s assassins and Bogo was also killed . .

title: Bok
description: Bok Bok was a powerful flesh golem manufactured by Dendybar the Mottled , a wizard and the guardian of the northern spire in the Hosttower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan . In 1356 DR , Dendybar sent Bok alongside the wizard Sydney and the soldier Jierdan in search of Drizzt Do ' Urden with the hopes of acquiring Crenshinibon . Bok was destroyed by Drizzt during a vicious fight near Mithral Hall .
description_long: Bok Bok was a powerful flesh golem manufactured by Dendybar the Mottled , a wizard and the guardian of the northern spire in the Hosttower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan . In 1356 DR , Dendybar sent Bok alongside the wizard Sydney and the soldier Jierdan in search of Drizzt Do ' Urden with the hopes of acquiring Crenshinibon . Bok was destroyed by Drizzt during a vicious fight near Mithral Hall . Dendybar teleport ed near the golem with the aim of recovering and reconstructing it , The spirit of Morkai the Red , a dead foe of Dendybar who was killed and enslaved as a spirit by the wizard , regained control of the remains of the golem and killed Dendybar . Appendix . Notes . Coincidentally , " Bok " is also the name of an animated gargoyle in the serial " The Daemons " .

title: Bokika Hokio
description: Bokika Hokio Bokika Hokio was a disgraced daimyo in Wa around 1357 DR and 1358 DR . Personality . Hokio was a bitter man , living only for revenge against the shogun .
description_long: Bokika Hokio Bokika Hokio was a disgraced daimyo in Wa around 1357 DR and 1358 DR . Personality . Hokio was a bitter man , living only for revenge against the shogun . He had a bad temper , always ready to explode . Hokio did not care much for administrative details . He himself had converted to Chauntea ' s worship in deep secrecy . Activities . Hokio was recruiting allies in order to gain revenge against the shogun . History . Bokika was the daimyo of Juzimura . However , he granted protection to the followers of Chauntea , who were persecuted by the shogun ' s government , believing himself safe as nephew of the Shogun Matasuuri Nagahide . He was wrong , and around 1335 DR , the shogun ' s army surrounded his castle , asking for the lives of Chauntea ' s worshipers . After a bloody and futile siege , Nagahide offered to spare Hokio and his officials , even allowing them to retain their status . However , Hokio was demoted to a tozama daimyo and granted lordship over the far and poor Fochu . Around 1348 DR , he was visited by the spirits of the dead priests of Chauntea , who asked him for a proper resting place for their remains .

title: Bol
description: Bol Bol was a tiefling warrior and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Bol was one of the members of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden .
description_long: Bol Bol was a tiefling warrior and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Bol was one of the members of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden . However , in the first skirmish against the pair of elves , Bol and most of his fellows were killed by Dahlia and Drizzt .

title: Bolas
description: Bolas A bolas is an exotic ranged weapon . Description . A set of bolas consists of two or three spheres connected by long cords to a central point .
description_long: Bolas A bolas is an exotic ranged weapon . Description . A set of bolas consists of two or three spheres connected by long cords to a central point . The spheres may be made of heavy wood , metal , or leather bags filled with stones . The cords may be woven leather straps or heavy twine . A typical bolas costs 5gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . The bolas is held at the connecting point and twirled in a circle high enough that the ground does not interfere , then released and thrown at the target where they hopefully entangle and wrap themselves around the legs of the opponent , causing them to trip . The bolas requires a lot of skill and practice to use effectively , therefore it is classified as an exotic weapon . Realmslore . Bolas were among the weapons favored by the Tabaxi of Maztica . Other editions . The bolas is not mentioned in the 1st or 2nd edition player ' s handbooks .

title: Bold Jhyak ' s
description: Bold Jhyak ' s Bold Jhyak ' s was a tavern and smokehouse in Teshburl that stood out in that naval town for appearing like a Northern roadhouse . Description . The tavern was a rustic building made of flagstone with low beams on its ceiling .
description_long: Bold Jhyak ' s Bold Jhyak ' s was a tavern and smokehouse in Teshburl that stood out in that naval town for appearing like a Northern roadhouse . Description . The tavern was a rustic building made of flagstone with low beams on its ceiling . The lightning was kept low intentionally for effect . Bold Jhyak ' s was full of large , beat - up furniture and tables large enough to dance on . Services . The smokehouse contained at least six spit racks , so that boar s or other large beasts could be roasted continuously over the fires . Besides the food , which offered an alternative to Teshburl ' s usual sea food , Bold Jhyak ' s was favored by adventurers and those who wanted to hear the tales of adventurers . Because the owner , Jhyak , was growing old , he hired two mercenaries for the purpose of telling stories to his patrons .

title: Boldovar Obarskyr
description: Boldovar Obarskyr Boldovar Obarskyr ( Boldovar the Mad ) was the king of Cormyr until his believed death in 242 DR . Although Boldovar was the second eldest male child , he was crowned after his father , Tharyann , outlived his older siblings . Relatives .
description_long: Boldovar Obarskyr Boldovar Obarskyr ( Boldovar the Mad ) was the king of Cormyr until his believed death in 242 DR . Although Boldovar was the second eldest male child , he was crowned after his father , Tharyann , outlived his older siblings . Relatives . Boldovar ' s father was King Tharyann . His son was Iltharl Obarskyr . Background . Boldovar was known as " Boldovar the Mad " due to his homophobic and enraged behavior , ( which is rumored to have involved him strangling his elder brother Dorglor , ) partially kept under control by the magic of Baerauble Etharr . During his reign he had the windows of Faerlthann ' s Keep transformed into barred slits . He was said to have died in 242 DR when he killed a female consort , but in her last moments , the woman grabbed him and pulled him over the battlements of Faerlthann ' s Keep . In reality , he was kept alive by Baerauble ' s magic for four more years but in death was claimed by the " Ghazneth Curse " . After he died he was placed beneath a sycamore . He was the third Ghazneth . Ghazneth . After being turned into a Ghazneth , Boldovar ' s appearance changed dramatically .

title: Bolhur the Clanless
description: Bolhur the Clanless Bolhur the Clanless was the father of Durlag Trollkiller and lived in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn . He was a great warrior in his time , earning him the name Thunderaxe . He roamed Faerûn , much like his son one day would .
description_long: Bolhur the Clanless Bolhur the Clanless was the father of Durlag Trollkiller and lived in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn . He was a great warrior in his time , earning him the name Thunderaxe . He roamed Faerûn , much like his son one day would . He was a well respected dwarf . Unfortunately , Bolhur ' s legacy would not be his adventures and achievements . People would remember him as Bolhur the Clanless , as he died whilst away on an adventure . Although he had a son , Bolhur died alone with no friends or family by his side . This lonesome death haunted his son Durlag , and the young dwarf vowed he would not share his father ' s fate . After completing many adventures himself , Durlag invested the wealth he had earned into a large fortress to raise a clan . However , due to a number of tragic circumstances , Durlag did end up dying alone . Appendix . Appearances . Although the player never interacts with Bolhur , they learn about him from books and riddles put in place by Durlag Trollkiller , in the game Baldur ' s Gate : Tales of the Sword Coast . The player can also loot Bolhur ' s tomb , and in doing so will find the best set of armor available in the game .

title: Bollus
description: Bollus Bollus was a caravaneer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Bollus was a caravaneer who originated from Calimport and owned a caravan business in Westgate , who traveled up and down between the two cities .
description_long: Bollus Bollus was a caravaneer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Bollus was a caravaneer who originated from Calimport and owned a caravan business in Westgate , who traveled up and down between the two cities . He was , however , so influenced by Westgate ' s customs that he stopped using his family and house names . His nickname , Copperteeth , derived from the particular predilection of Bollus for this metal , which he used in all forms and particularly to substitute four of his teeth . Some said , in contrast , that his nickname derived from his ability to convince traders to give him all their precious metal .

title: Bolothamogg
description: Bolothamogg Bolothamogg , " " Him Who Watches from Beyond the Stars " " , was a primal force or entity ( Elder Evil ) that sought to protect the Far Realm from the " taint " of the other dimensions . " " The Darkness between the Stars " " was honored by the Aboleth s by leaving large gaps and empty spaces in their architecture and by constructing large open buildings . Bolothamogg had made some sort of alliance with the demon lord Areex , whom he ordered to venture " Beyond the Stars " to pay the price of their deal .
description_long: Bolothamogg Bolothamogg , " " Him Who Watches from Beyond the Stars " " , was a primal force or entity ( Elder Evil ) that sought to protect the Far Realm from the " taint " of the other dimensions . " " The Darkness between the Stars " " was honored by the Aboleth s by leaving large gaps and empty spaces in their architecture and by constructing large open buildings . Bolothamogg had made some sort of alliance with the demon lord Areex , whom he ordered to venture " Beyond the Stars " to pay the price of their deal . Perhaps Bolothamogg was just another name for the Outer God Yog - Sothoth , " " The Key and the Gate " " , which was known from the writings of H . P . Lovecraft .

title: Bolt of glory
description: Bolt of glory Bolt of glory was an evocation spell that struck a target with a blast of positive energy . Effect . By casting this spell , one projected a bolt of energy from the Positive Energy Plane against one creature .
description_long: Bolt of glory Bolt of glory was an evocation spell that struck a target with a blast of positive energy . Effect . By casting this spell , one projected a bolt of energy from the Positive Energy Plane against one creature . A creature struck took varying damage , depending on its nature and home plane of existence , with evil outsider s and those from the Negative Energy Plane being most strongly affected .

title: Bolton Brimwell
description: Bolton Brimwell Bolton Brimwell was an innkeeper of the Guts and Garters in the Lower Heart of Skullport . Personality . The innkeeper would show patrons a secret passage to the alley near the Feathered Rat for an extra gold piece .
description_long: Bolton Brimwell Bolton Brimwell was an innkeeper of the Guts and Garters in the Lower Heart of Skullport . Personality . The innkeeper would show patrons a secret passage to the alley near the Feathered Rat for an extra gold piece . For added protection , Bolton could be persuaded to have one of his guards watch the room for another golden coin . History . Around 1370 DR , Bolton was known to rent out rooms in his inn by the hour to anyone with ready coin , guaranteeing their privacy .

title: Bone Dance
description: Bone Dance The Bone Dance was a religious hunting festival dedicated to Malar the Beastlord and practiced in the Vast . It was held on the night of Highsun 9th and hosted by cleric s of Malar . The Malarites animated the skeletons of great stag s and other beasts , and the oldest and youngest members of the community played hunters .
description_long: Bone Dance The Bone Dance was a religious hunting festival dedicated to Malar the Beastlord and practiced in the Vast . It was held on the night of Highsun 9th and hosted by cleric s of Malar . The Malarites animated the skeletons of great stag s and other beasts , and the oldest and youngest members of the community played hunters . Together , they enacted exciting hunting scenes and held a pageant around a bonfire , called the Bone Dance . There was also a great feast in which everyone ate and drank until late in the night . Early the next morning , they ventured out to track , hunt down and kill a dangerous predator or monster known to be in the area . The Bone Dance was more popular in the smaller country communities than in the cities .

title: Bone naga
description: Bone naga Bone nagas were an undead form of naga s . They resulted from a naga ' s resurrection process being interrupted by a necromantic ritual developed by the yuan - ti that transformed them into servants with a fraction of the abilities that the original nagas possessed .
description_long: Bone naga Bone nagas were an undead form of naga s . They resulted from a naga ' s resurrection process being interrupted by a necromantic ritual developed by the yuan - ti that transformed them into servants with a fraction of the abilities that the original nagas possessed .

title: Bone ring
description: Bone ring A bone ring is a magic ring that will protect its wearer from ability drain or energy drain . Despite its name , it can be made from bone , stone or ivory , but will never be made from any . Each time it protects the wearer , a charge is used up , and when all charges are gone , it crumbles to dust .
description_long: Bone ring A bone ring is a magic ring that will protect its wearer from ability drain or energy drain . Despite its name , it can be made from bone , stone or ivory , but will never be made from any . Each time it protects the wearer , a charge is used up , and when all charges are gone , it crumbles to dust . It is worth between 20 , 000 and 36 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Bone rot
description: Bone rot Bone rot was a disease that could cause bones to become brittle and rot away . It was prevalent in swamp areas containing the dead , particularly graveyards and battlefields . The disease was contracted through contact and had an incubation time of between one and three days .
description_long: Bone rot Bone rot was a disease that could cause bones to become brittle and rot away . It was prevalent in swamp areas containing the dead , particularly graveyards and battlefields . The disease was contracted through contact and had an incubation time of between one and three days . The devouring of the victim ' s bones caused a loss of dexterity , and made bones more likely to shatter , such as if struck by a blunt weapon .

title: Bonfire of insanity
description: Bonfire of insanity A Bonfire of insanity is a vile ritual performed during rainstorms by powerful necromancers . They build a pyre of human bones and burn it as the rain pours . As the smoke from the fire rises to the clouds , the rain itself is tainted for a mile around the ritual site .
description_long: Bonfire of insanity A Bonfire of insanity is a vile ritual performed during rainstorms by powerful necromancers . They build a pyre of human bones and burn it as the rain pours . As the smoke from the fire rises to the clouds , the rain itself is tainted for a mile around the ritual site . Corpses buried in even the most sacrosanct earth rise as undead creatures and any humanoid s that the rain touches are infected with a disease that will transform them into a ghoul by the next day unless a " heal " spell is cast upon them .

title: Bonnalurie
description: Bonnalurie Bonnalurie was a sun elf and priestess of Angharradh in Tintageer . When her home was destroyed in a war , she was the last surviving priestess with enough power to control High Magic . On behalf of Durothil , she began to dance and sing to create a magical gate through the boundaries of the realms .
description_long: Bonnalurie Bonnalurie was a sun elf and priestess of Angharradh in Tintageer . When her home was destroyed in a war , she was the last surviving priestess with enough power to control High Magic . On behalf of Durothil , she began to dance and sing to create a magical gate through the boundaries of the realms . In doing this , she helped fifty survivors and the prince to reach Faerûn , but she was consumed by the power of the magical forces she unleashed and was killed .

title: Bonnerbas Ironcap
description: Bonnerbas Ironcap Bonnerbas Ironcap was the dwarven soldier from Mithral Hall . He was killed by Proffit during the battle with troll s in 1370 DR . He was a member of the General Dagna Waybeard ' s squad , which was sent from Mithral Hall to protect the refugees from Nesme .
description_long: Bonnerbas Ironcap Bonnerbas Ironcap was the dwarven soldier from Mithral Hall . He was killed by Proffit during the battle with troll s in 1370 DR . He was a member of the General Dagna Waybeard ' s squad , which was sent from Mithral Hall to protect the refugees from Nesme .

title: Boo
description: Boo Boo was the pet and companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc , having joined him shortly after he sustained an injury to his head . While there was skepticism regarding the claim , Minsc insisted that Boo was , in fact , a miniature giant space hamster who was intelligent and could converse coherently with him . However , as Minsc was quite addled , it was unclear whether or not his claims were true .
description_long: Boo Boo was the pet and companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc , having joined him shortly after he sustained an injury to his head . While there was skepticism regarding the claim , Minsc insisted that Boo was , in fact , a miniature giant space hamster who was intelligent and could converse coherently with him . However , as Minsc was quite addled , it was unclear whether or not his claims were true . Appendix . Gameplay . In the " Baldur ' s Gate " series , Boo appears as an item in Minsc ' s inventory but if the player tries to remove him he scurries away and the protagonist receives a harsh glare from Minsc . He also features in Minsc ' s portrait in both " Baldur ' s Gate " I and , but in the second game only his hamster squeaks are heard alongside Minsc ' s dialogue .

title: Boobrie
description: Boobrie The boobrie is a magical beast and a giant relative of the stork at 12 ' ( 3 . 7m ) tall , that lives in swamps and marshes . It attacks by finding a tall patch of grass , hiding in it , and waiting for prey to come .
description_long: Boobrie The boobrie is a magical beast and a giant relative of the stork at 12 ' ( 3 . 7m ) tall , that lives in swamps and marshes . It attacks by finding a tall patch of grass , hiding in it , and waiting for prey to come . The boobrie hardly ever attacks humanoid s , instead sustaining itself on catfish , snake s , lizard s , giant insect s , and other wetland denizens . The boobrie , due to things it has been forced to eat in lean times , is immune to poison . It has some magical properties , though it cannot speak . Boobries were raised in the village of Dhedluk in Cormyr and used as a pest control .

title: Book Knowledge
description: Book Knowledge Adventurers out of Undermountain recently sold a local sage a book detailing the history of the first three Green Regent s . Bizarrely , it seems as though everyone who has come into contact with the book has vanished . The adventurers and the sage have all disappeared and the Sage ' s wife wants him back .
description_long: Book Knowledge Adventurers out of Undermountain recently sold a local sage a book detailing the history of the first three Green Regent s . Bizarrely , it seems as though everyone who has come into contact with the book has vanished . The adventurers and the sage have all disappeared and the Sage ' s wife wants him back .

title: Book of Bats
description: Book of Bats The Book of Bats was a spellbook of unknown origin found in the Realms . Description . This tome was tall and narrow , measuring approximately three handwidths wide and nine handwidths tall .
description_long: Book of Bats The Book of Bats was a spellbook of unknown origin found in the Realms . Description . This tome was tall and narrow , measuring approximately three handwidths wide and nine handwidths tall . All 22 pages were made from polished electrum and each page contained a different spell . The front and rear covers of the book were plated with blackened oak stamped with real bat wings , many of which still contained their claws . Powers . The " Book of Bats " contained the following spells : " censure " • " hold vapor " • " feign death " • " protection from good 10 ' radius " • " slow " • " Beltyn ' s burning blood " • " dimension door " • " fear " • " polymorph other " • " wall of fire " • " animate dead " • " cloudkill " • " cone of cold " • " feeblemind " • " telekinesis " • " wall of iron " • " anti - magic shell " • " death spell " • " geas " • " invisible stalker " • " project image " • " blade of doom " History . Though the book contained spells from the wizard s Beltyn and Shaeroon , it was believed to have been assembled after their deaths .

title: Book of Change
description: Book of Change The Book of Change was a book presenting a system of divination using trigrams . It was written by the sage Hsin Fu Chan . History .
description_long: Book of Change The Book of Change was a book presenting a system of divination using trigrams . It was written by the sage Hsin Fu Chan . History . Legend told that Hsin Fu Chan discerned the trigrams from patterns in the back of a great lizard as it slept . After this inauspicious start , the trigrams were developed over time into a more sophisticated , less lizard - based method . Usage . Use of the " Book of Change " was common to all levels of Shou Lung society . It was also an important aspect of the magic wielded by priests of the Way . It functioned rather like the spell " fate " known to shukenja , but could be used by anyone , though perhaps less reliably . By 1357 DR , it was common for one to toss a handful of broken and whole chopsticks into a circle , and choose six from the top , producing a pattern of broken and unbroken lines . The user then consulted the " Book of Change " , finding two out of six possible trigrams that best matched the pattern . Each of the eleven possible combinations corresponded to a symbol and an explanation or recommendation for the future ; those in the middle were more common than those at the extremes . Appendix . Backgrounds .

title: Book of Lore
description: Book of Lore The Book of Lore was a magical tome that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The binding of this book was red leather from an unknown creature .
description_long: Book of Lore The Book of Lore was a magical tome that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The binding of this book was red leather from an unknown creature . Powers . The book appeared small , but no matter how many times its pages were turned , one page always remained . Each page was decorated with beautiful calligraphy . Reading the book for a week granted the reader knowledge similar to the effects of a " legend lore " spell based on what they read .

title: Book of St . Sollars
description: Book of St . Sollars The Book of St . Sollars was a religious tome dedicated to St .
description_long: Book of St . Sollars The Book of St . Sollars was a religious tome dedicated to St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred , a saint of Ilmater the Broken God . It consisted of numbered verses . A copy rested on the altar of the Abbey of St . Sollars around 1359 DR .

title: Book of Tarchamus
description: Book of Tarchamus The Book of Tarchamus was a sentient book that was actually the consciousness of the ancient Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding . After Tarchamus built his library , he turned his physical form into a powerful mummy with the help of his apprentices . He placed most of his intelligence into a magical tome with the remainder staying with his physical body .
description_long: Book of Tarchamus The Book of Tarchamus was a sentient book that was actually the consciousness of the ancient Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding . After Tarchamus built his library , he turned his physical form into a powerful mummy with the help of his apprentices . He placed most of his intelligence into a magical tome with the remainder staying with his physical body . The book could communicate telepathically and read minds . It was willing to share information with researchers in the library but often answered questions with half - truths or outright lies . In 1478 DR , it was removed from the library by the Harper Tam Zawad , who utilized its mind - scrying abilities to interrogate suspected Harper turncoats . Appearance . The book appeared as a large tome written in ancient Netherese . The words seemed shift when read and the volume seemed to remain unusually dusty . A page had been cut from the book at one time but was reunited with the book by a party of adventurers led by Tam .

title: Book of the Holy Scourge
description: Book of the Holy Scourge The Book of the Holy Scourge was a sacred book of the Church of Ilmater . Though not the holiest book of the faith ( that honor went to the " Tome of Torment " ) , it was probably the most well - known and useful . Abilities .
description_long: Book of the Holy Scourge The Book of the Holy Scourge was a sacred book of the Church of Ilmater . Though not the holiest book of the faith ( that honor went to the " Tome of Torment " ) , it was probably the most well - known and useful . Abilities . The " Book of the Holy Scourge " contained but a single spell . Reading it caused spectral whip s to appear and lash at enemies some distance away . History . Thieves once stole the " Book of the Holy Scourge " and attempted to sell it . In response , no less than twenty high priests of the church , from all across Faerûn , appeared by magic and hurled killing spells at the thieves . Despite their own great power and a hard fight , the thieves were slain .

title: Book of the World
description: Book of the World The Book of the World was an enigmatic tome discovered in Asram in approximately 1254 DR ; from the oxidation of the pages , the book was probably created some 400 years before that . The book consisted of some 300 sheets of a thin , flexible metal upon which a simplified runic script in an extremely ancient form of Thorass had been scribed . Only a single copy of the book was ever found , but it was evidently once the center of a body of religious beliefs .
description_long: Book of the World The Book of the World was an enigmatic tome discovered in Asram in approximately 1254 DR ; from the oxidation of the pages , the book was probably created some 400 years before that . The book consisted of some 300 sheets of a thin , flexible metal upon which a simplified runic script in an extremely ancient form of Thorass had been scribed . Only a single copy of the book was ever found , but it was evidently once the center of a body of religious beliefs . It contained a massive amount of mythological content , apparently having sprung from a sophisticated culture of a kind never known to have formed in Asram . The " Book of the World " was notable for providing an origin myth for dragon kind , apparently a mythologized recount of the Tearfall in the Days of Thunder . Godlike beings mentioned in the myth include Asgorath , Zotha , and a dragon called the Renegade , credited for the creation of metallic dragon s . The Thorass word for renegade is " bahmat " , very similar to the modern name Bahamut .

title: Books and Scrolls
description: Books and Scrolls Books and Scolls was a small shop located in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Books and Scrolls was jammed with all kinds of books , scrolls , and maps .
description_long: Books and Scrolls Books and Scolls was a small shop located in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Books and Scrolls was jammed with all kinds of books , scrolls , and maps . The items were not sorted into any convenient system of organization . Activities . Aziza the Seer purchased volumes without worrying about their subject matter . As a member of the Readers , she simply needed to read anything to power her strange magic . Patient customers who were willing to spend hours digging through the mess of her shop could potentially be rewarded with stumbling across a rare tome containing forbidden magic or other wondrous lore . Inhabitants . Aziza owned and operated this establishment .

title: Booming blade
description: Booming blade Booming blade is a basic spell of the evocation school often used by shielding swordmages , as well as swordmage s of other styles . When a swordmage attacks a creature with their blade , they have the option to add the sonic energy to their attack , using a field of thunderous noise to injure their retreating foe . Like most swordmage spells , the spell is charged primarily by the swordmage ' s intellect , though their durability adds to the effectiveness of their sonic attack and more experienced swordmages cast " booming blade " with more power .
description_long: Booming blade Booming blade is a basic spell of the evocation school often used by shielding swordmages , as well as swordmage s of other styles . When a swordmage attacks a creature with their blade , they have the option to add the sonic energy to their attack , using a field of thunderous noise to injure their retreating foe . Like most swordmage spells , the spell is charged primarily by the swordmage ' s intellect , though their durability adds to the effectiveness of their sonic attack and more experienced swordmages cast " booming blade " with more power . " Booming blade " is among the easiest of swordmage spells to learn and can be cast at will .

title: Boots of elvenkind
description: Boots of elvenkind Boots of elvenkind were a magical item that allowed the wearer to step across any surface quietly . They were also known as Elven boots , Elvish boots , or Elven sneaking boots . Description .
description_long: Boots of elvenkind Boots of elvenkind were a magical item that allowed the wearer to step across any surface quietly . They were also known as Elven boots , Elvish boots , or Elven sneaking boots . Description . They were soft boots . Powers . The " boots of elvenkind " allowed the wearer to walk much more quietly . History . The boots original purpose was to allow elves to travel through the forest without causing any disturbance , but they were popular amongst thieves because they were ideal for committing crimes . Thus elven makers were reluctant about letting them fall into foreign hands . Since these boots were most commonly crafted by elves , it was extremely difficult to find these boots in other sizes . Slippers of soft movement . This magical item from the lands of Zakhara had the same properties as " boots of elvenkind " , but appeared as slippers , and adjusted themselves to fit the feet of the respective wearer .

title: Boots of the winterlands
description: Boots of the winterlands Boots of the winterlands were common magical boots that allowed the wearer to stride atop snow and ice and protected from the effects of bitter cold . Description . " Boots of the winterlands " weighed about a pound ( half a kilogram ) and gave off a faint aura of both abjuration and transmutation magic .
description_long: Boots of the winterlands Boots of the winterlands were common magical boots that allowed the wearer to stride atop snow and ice and protected from the effects of bitter cold . Description . " Boots of the winterlands " weighed about a pound ( half a kilogram ) and gave off a faint aura of both abjuration and transmutation magic . They typically sold for around 2 , 500 gold pieces . Abilities . The wearer of a complete pair of these boots could walk on snow or ice at normal speed without slipping , falling , or sinking in to leave tracks . ( A worn pair would not prevent him or her from sliding or falling from a vertical or steeply sloped path . ) In addition , the wearing of such boots would provide warmth , protecting the wearer as if by the same magic as an " endure elements " spell . Creation . Anyone trained in the art of crafting wondrous magical items who also knew the spells " cat ' s grace " , " endure elements " , and " pass without trace " could make " boots of the winterlands " .

title: Borador Goldhand
description: Borador Goldhand Borador ' Goldhand ' ( a moniker picked up for his legendary avarice ) is a dwarven treasure - hunter and one of the five starting playable characters in . He is classed as a rogue and uses numerous thief abilities . Background .
description_long: Borador Goldhand Borador ' Goldhand ' ( a moniker picked up for his legendary avarice ) is a dwarven treasure - hunter and one of the five starting playable characters in . He is classed as a rogue and uses numerous thief abilities . Background . Though this is not revealed until late in the game , Borador is a member of the Goblin - breaker Clan . His clan - brother , Durbem , speaks of a large debt that their clan owes to some elves , but does not reveal who exactly , or why the clan is indebted to them . Aiding his clan in paying the elves back is one of Borador ' s primary motivations for his adventuring work . Adventuring Career . In the introduction to Dark Alliance II , Borador ' s reason for travelling to Baldur ' s Gate in search of adventure is said to be ' wealth . ' This is reflected throughout the game , and he often makes sure he will be well - paid before before embarking on a quest . Nonetheless in the optional side - quests specific to Borador he donates large sums of gold to paying his clan ' s debt to the elves . In matters concerning his clan , Borador displays altruistic qualities that are not seen in his dealings with others .

title: Boraksaghegirak
description: Boraksaghegirak Boraksaghegirak , commonly called Borak , was an ancient blue dragon residing in the ruins of the city of Imer in the Calim Desert . History . Hundreds of years before the 14th century DR , Borak allied with an eager and able wizard .
description_long: Boraksaghegirak Boraksaghegirak , commonly called Borak , was an ancient blue dragon residing in the ruins of the city of Imer in the Calim Desert . History . Hundreds of years before the 14th century DR , Borak allied with an eager and able wizard . The two worked together for some time , acquiring great wealth and greater treasure , including a djinni in a ring — Rajief . After years of working together , the wizard tried to bind Borak to his servitude , which ended disastrously for the enterprising mage as he was killed and the city destroyed , its inhabitants scattered to the corners of the great desert . Thereafter , Borak decreed that the desert tribe pay tribute in the form of dragonly treasures and servants for pampering , or the occasional meal . Borak eventually grouped the male servants into a harem for her carnal amusements , visiting them in human form . More than once , she spawned a half - dragon offspring . Killing the females , the males became her personal guard , the Al - Iborak , or " Sons of Borak " .

title: Border Forest
description: Border Forest The Border Forest was a large forest that connected four different regions of Faerûn : the Dalelands to the south , Anauroch to the west , the Tortured Land to the north and the Moonsea to the east . Geography . The Border Forest was a mixture of pines , oak s and other deciduous trees ; the forest undergrowth was relatively thick , making the walk difficult .
description_long: Border Forest The Border Forest was a large forest that connected four different regions of Faerûn : the Dalelands to the south , Anauroch to the west , the Tortured Land to the north and the Moonsea to the east . Geography . The Border Forest was a mixture of pines , oak s and other deciduous trees ; the forest undergrowth was relatively thick , making the walk difficult . History . The Border Forest was once known as Rystall Wood by the Sylvan elves that lived there for many centuries after the Crown Wars . However , little evidence remains of their civilisation as they built few permanent structures . It was later known as the Eastern Forest by the Empire of Netheril before it got its modern name . In - 5000 DR , Rystall Wood was cut off from the rest of Arcorar during the Twelve Nights of Fire that were started by a falling meteor . Rystall Wood became a separate forest and realm after the Twelve Nights of Fire cleared away the mountain and hill trees that attached it to Arcorar . Although an independent forest after the event , its coronal still convened often with the leaders of the Elven Court .

title: Border Kingdoms
description: Border Kingdoms The Border Kingdoms occupy an area of lush grasslands between the Lake of Steam and the Shaar . This area is divided politically into many smaller principalities and kingdoms . Because of the instability of the Border Kingdoms , no accurate maps exist and the borders move around as rulers and boundaries change — this is the ideal place for adventurers wanting to start a kingdom of their own .
description_long: Border Kingdoms The Border Kingdoms occupy an area of lush grasslands between the Lake of Steam and the Shaar . This area is divided politically into many smaller principalities and kingdoms . Because of the instability of the Border Kingdoms , no accurate maps exist and the borders move around as rulers and boundaries change — this is the ideal place for adventurers wanting to start a kingdom of their own . A borderer is the name given to an inhabitant of the Border Kingdoms . , Geography . The Border Kingdoms have a coastline to the west where they meet the Shining Sea . This coastline extends from the mouth of the River Scelptar in the south to the opening of the Lake of Steam in the north , at Theymarsh . The northern edge of the Border Kingdoms is bordered by the Lake of Steam and this natural border continues east for about 700 miles to the town of Alamontyr , the easternmost settlement . The border with the Shaar is not a definite one although it runs roughly southwest from Alamontyr back to the coastal rivermouth of the Scelptar . Background .

title: Borem
description: Borem Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud was one of the Seven Lost Gods , possibly a primordial who remained on Toril after the split between Abeir and its twin . History . In - 359 DR , Borem became active after long years of appearing as a simple muddy river .
description_long: Borem Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud was one of the Seven Lost Gods , possibly a primordial who remained on Toril after the split between Abeir and its twin . History . In - 359 DR , Borem became active after long years of appearing as a simple muddy river . After a hot summer , the river broke its banks and became a lake in the space of a tenday of rainfall . In their quest for godhood , the adventurers Bane , Bhaal and Myrkul attacked Borem in his home plane after making the connection between him and the river . Killing him , they stole his heart , which they bore to Mezeketh Isle and buried .

title: Borem ' s Quagheart
description: Borem ' s Quagheart Borem ' s Quagheart was a potent magical artifact . Description . The " Quagheart " was a malodorous lump of brown skin and muscle , covered in slime and mud — the final remains of the god Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud .
description_long: Borem ' s Quagheart Borem ' s Quagheart was a potent magical artifact . Description . The " Quagheart " was a malodorous lump of brown skin and muscle , covered in slime and mud — the final remains of the god Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud . Powers . As long as the " Quagheart " remained pierced by another artifact , such as the " Jathiman Dagger " , it conferred great powers upon its wielder . The wielder grew tougher , gained the ability to breathe freely ( similar to the effect of a " necklace of adaptation " ) , and could walk on the surface of mud . If the piercing artifact were removed , the " Quagheart " would spew forth a geyser of warm and muddy water . If this geyser were allowed to continue for 30 days , it would reform the Lake of Boiling Mud , and legends claimed such an event would bring about the return of Borem himself . The only way to re - plug the hole in the " Quagheart " was through a massive feat of raw strength .

title: Borgan Selgard
description: Borgan Selgard Borgan Selgard was a mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Borgan was a grizzled man with gray hair and a short beard .
description_long: Borgan Selgard Borgan Selgard was a mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Borgan was a grizzled man with gray hair and a short beard . History . Borgan was a veteran mercenary and the leader of a mercenary company , the Skull and Club , founded long before by a cleric of Myrkul . In 1375 DR , they were recruited by the Zhentarim who ' d occupied Shadowdale . They attacked and destroyed the village of Oakwood Knoll with the Teeth mercenaries . Later , the two mercenary groups argued about the spoils .

title: Borigon Hillsafar
description: Borigon Hillsafar Borigon Hillsafar was the king of Hillsafar Hall in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1470 DR , the Warlock Knights of Vaasa invaded Hillsafar Hall .
description_long: Borigon Hillsafar Borigon Hillsafar was the king of Hillsafar Hall in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1470 DR , the Warlock Knights of Vaasa invaded Hillsafar Hall . Borigon assumed command and repelled the invaders . Afterward , he welcomed inside the Hall a handful of neighboring clans displaced during the war and with great reluctance Borigon ordered the gates to be closed . In 1479 DR , the gates were still closed . Relationship . Borigon was the third son of Garumbelly Hillsafar .

title: Boris Elberwelter
description: Boris Elberwelter Boris Elberwelter was a male human and the proprietor of the inn called The Sign of Thunder in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . His wife was Tasha . He heard the Wolfmasters adventuring company discussing rumors of a large ruin in the Vast Swamp .
description_long: Boris Elberwelter Boris Elberwelter was a male human and the proprietor of the inn called The Sign of Thunder in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . His wife was Tasha . He heard the Wolfmasters adventuring company discussing rumors of a large ruin in the Vast Swamp .

title: Borlann
description: Borlann Borlann was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1450 DR . History . He was the last lover of the Thayan elf Dahlia Sin ' felle but in that year Dahlia decided to terminate their relationship , and as always , she killed Borlann after the separation .
description_long: Borlann Borlann was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1450 DR . History . He was the last lover of the Thayan elf Dahlia Sin ' felle but in that year Dahlia decided to terminate their relationship , and as always , she killed Borlann after the separation . Possessions . Borlann was the grandson of Kensidan and possessed his " Cloak of the Crow " , a magic cape that could polymorph a person into a giant crow , which was later taken by Dahlia .

title: Borlin
description: Borlin Borlin , blood of Ghellin , titled Axe of the Iron House , was a male dwarf of the Iron House , the exiled royal court of the Mines of Tethyamar . He was a descendent of Ghellin , King - in - Exile of the Iron House . He was also a leader of dwarven armies , such as the Mithril Legion .
description_long: Borlin Borlin , blood of Ghellin , titled Axe of the Iron House , was a male dwarf of the Iron House , the exiled royal court of the Mines of Tethyamar . He was a descendent of Ghellin , King - in - Exile of the Iron House . He was also a leader of dwarven armies , such as the Mithril Legion . History . In the mid – 14th century DR , Borlin led a force of dwarves against the green dragon Urnalithorgathla , who laired in the Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . The victorious dwarves slew the wyrm and Borlin discovered in her hoard the sword " Sarghathuld " , a legendary blade of the fallen dwarven realm of Roldilar . He claimed the weapon to wield in battle . Borlin later inspired a large number of dwarven warriors to form the Mithril Legion and embark on a quest to reclaim the lost Mines of Tethyamar , near the Dalelands . They marched out of Tilverton in the Year of the Wave , 1364 DR , heading north - west , and vanished , their fate unknown . Some claimed that Borlin and the Mithril Legion had successfully retaken part of the Mines , and sent a report of such to King Ghellin via magic , but this was only speculation .

title: Bormton
description: Bormton Bormton was a village in Amn , lying between Trademeet and the Small Teeth mountains . History . Revered Brother Filithan of the Church of Ilmater originally hailed from Bormton .
description_long: Bormton Bormton was a village in Amn , lying between Trademeet and the Small Teeth mountains . History . Revered Brother Filithan of the Church of Ilmater originally hailed from Bormton . He was involved in the enchantment of the legendary sword " Dornavver " in the Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR . In the first days of Marpenoth of the Year of the Bright Blade , 1347 DR , Bormton was burned and razed by people from Tethyr because they heard a rumor that the village took in some refugees who had escaped the carnage during the Ten Black Days of Eleint .

title: Born
description: Born Born was a creature that claimed dominion over Dragonspear Castle in the Western Heartlands around 1479 DR . Born led the undead forces that emerged from the Nepenthe River under the castle . They slaughtered the living inhabitants and destroyed the shrine to Tempus , before shrouding the castle in a constant fog and repelling efforts to retake the castle .
description_long: Born Born was a creature that claimed dominion over Dragonspear Castle in the Western Heartlands around 1479 DR . Born led the undead forces that emerged from the Nepenthe River under the castle . They slaughtered the living inhabitants and destroyed the shrine to Tempus , before shrouding the castle in a constant fog and repelling efforts to retake the castle . Born raided the graves of lost cities on the High Moor to expand his army of undead .

title: Boronuil Ironfist
description: Boronuil Ironfist Boronuil Ironfist was a dwarven craftsman living in Galdel in 1367 DR . Activities . Boronuil was renowned for being one of the best electrum craftsmen in all of Halruaa .
description_long: Boronuil Ironfist Boronuil Ironfist was a dwarven craftsman living in Galdel in 1367 DR . Activities . Boronuil was renowned for being one of the best electrum craftsmen in all of Halruaa . With his supreme skill he was able to craft splendid items that were ready for enchanting . Because of his reputation , he was able to charge quadruple the normal rates . The citizens of Halruaa were more than willing to pay as he had a waiting list exceeding two years .

title: Borri mac Rogni
description: Borri mac Rogni Borri mac Rogni was a dwarf priest of Moradin in the Moonsea . Activities . Borri was a priest and a member of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast .
description_long: Borri mac Rogni Borri mac Rogni was a dwarf priest of Moradin in the Moonsea . Activities . Borri was a priest and a member of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast . Possessions . In battle , Borri dressed in a chain shirt and fought with a mace . History . In 1491 DR , after Furgis Boltsmelter stole the elemental codex from Earthfast , Borri was chosen to be part of a Hammer squad led by Kalda Purefist to pursue him and retake the item . Near Mulmaster , Kalda , Borri and the squad confronted Furgis and his adventuring party bodyguards when the Cult of the Black Earth attacked both groups . In the battle against the earth cultists , Kalda and most of her men died but Borri and the warrior Sunni mac Grunna survived . Borri made an agreement with Furgis and / or his adventuring party bodyguards and continued the journey with them . At last , after Murssvayas Dhuurniv copied the codex , Borri and Sunni took it back to Earthfast .

title: Borsipa
description: Borsipa Borsipa was an apprentice member of the Northern Wizards in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . In truth , Borsipa was a spy for Gilgeam , sending constant reports to the king ' s army .
description_long: Borsipa Borsipa was an apprentice member of the Northern Wizards in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . In truth , Borsipa was a spy for Gilgeam , sending constant reports to the king ' s army . She was collaborating with Shuruppak to kill all the Northern Wizards , a duty she performed without any doubt .

title: Borstag Duncastle
description: Borstag Duncastle Borstag Duncastle was a merchant prince and an official of Sembia in the 1370s DR . Activities . Borstag represented Sembian interests concerned with trade , settlement , and industry in the Dales and the Moonsea .
description_long: Borstag Duncastle Borstag Duncastle was a merchant prince and an official of Sembia in the 1370s DR . Activities . Borstag represented Sembian interests concerned with trade , settlement , and industry in the Dales and the Moonsea . History . In 1374 DR , Borstag was in Hillsfar where he , together with First Lord Maalthiir , dealt with Sarya Dlardrageth . Later he died in the war and was replaced by Miklos Selkirk He was killed in his bed by the disguised daemonfey Teryani .

title: Borth Jhandelspar
description: Borth Jhandelspar Borth Jhandelspar was a barbarian who worked as a guide in Triboar in the Savage Frontier . History . He was cast out of his tribe as a youth and adopted by a Triboar family .
description_long: Borth Jhandelspar Borth Jhandelspar was a barbarian who worked as a guide in Triboar in the Savage Frontier . History . He was cast out of his tribe as a youth and adopted by a Triboar family . There , he later served as a guide to anyone who came to the town seeking his services . He was known for traveling from Yartar to Triboar in a blizzard wearing only a loincloth and boots , carrying a sword and singing loudly , to bring the news whilst Triboar was snowed - in . When Volothamp Geddarm came to Triboar to write a guidebook on the region , and about Borth , Borth was pleased and thought it would bring in business . Borth advised him to cover a well - burning fire with damp turf in order to keep it alight overnight . Personality . Borth was good - humored , but was prone to go berserk in a fight .

title: Boruse Temlor
description: Boruse Temlor Boruse Temlor was the head cleric of Cyric at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Boruse was a cold and remote individual .
description_long: Boruse Temlor Boruse Temlor was the head cleric of Cyric at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Boruse was a cold and remote individual . His main concern was maintaining faith in Cyric in the most remote outpost . Boruse had a passably good relationship with Kandar Milinal , but Kandar was contemptuous of Boruse for his lack of interest in plots and schemes .

title: Borwald Firehammer
description: Borwald Firehammer Borwald Firehammer was the chief advisor of Horgar Steelshadow in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . Borwald was one of the most loyal followers of Horgar and was his chief advisor and marshal of the army .
description_long: Borwald Firehammer Borwald Firehammer was the chief advisor of Horgar Steelshadow in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . Borwald was one of the most loyal followers of Horgar and was his chief advisor and marshal of the army . In 1372 DR , after seizing power , Horgar instructed him to prepare the army to march upon Menzoberranzan , as planned with Nimor Imphraezl .

title: Bosturo
description: Bosturo Bosturo was a noted sage and keeper of the Muradi Lighthouse in Koryo around 1357 DR . History . Bosturo grew up in the Quang Muku Forest , but came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse in 1308 DR .
description_long: Bosturo Bosturo was a noted sage and keeper of the Muradi Lighthouse in Koryo around 1357 DR . History . Bosturo grew up in the Quang Muku Forest , but came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse in 1308 DR . With dedicated service , he had held this position for 49 years by 1357 DR . At one point , he received a scroll of commendation from the ex - king of Silla , and displayed it proudly in his studio . Activities . As Master of the Muradi Lighthouse , Bosturo ' s duty to keep its lamp burning to warn ships of the flaming seas that lay off the coast of the southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula . In his spare time , he studied and wrote of the flora and fauna of Koryo . He was a particular expert on the less - familiar plants of Quang Muku , and many of the potion s that could be brewed or distilled from them . He would speak of his studies for a fee . Personality . Bosturo was naturally rather lonely , and so was rather talkative when he had visitors . For a good conversation , he would even reduce his fee . Description . Bosturo had never cut his hair in his life , so his braided gray hair was so long it swept the floor behind him .

title: Bottom Feeder ( ship )
description: Bottom Feeder ( ship ) Bottom Feeder was a riverboat run by a crew of dwarves . Description . " Bottom Feeder " was as 20 - foot - long ( 6 .
description_long: Bottom Feeder ( ship ) Bottom Feeder was a riverboat run by a crew of dwarves . Description . " Bottom Feeder " was as 20 - foot - long ( 6 . 1 meters ) square - bottomed riverboat built by dwarves . The crew propelled the ship using long poles to push it along . A locker on board stored a number of crossbow s , which were used by the ship ' s crew to defend the ship . Activities . " Bottom Feeder " plied the waters of the River Chionthar from Baldur ' s Gate to Scornubel , occasionally even as far as Iriaebor .

title: Boubakar
description: Boubakar Boubakar was the spymaster of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Boubakar directed the spies of the small kingdom of Golconda .
description_long: Boubakar Boubakar was the spymaster of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Boubakar directed the spies of the small kingdom of Golconda . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar started a war against Golconda . In 1358 during a war council Boubakar reported to King Samakay that one of his men had discovered that the battle plans of Hetep were hid in the small keep of Fort Blood . Boubakar convinced the king that they need sent a small party to recover the papers in order to win the war despite Count Belim ' s objections . Samakay hired an adventuring party well - known to him to resolve the matter . After the improvvise death of king Samakay without heir Boubakar presented a parchment signed by King Samakay on his deathbed that nominated the adventurers temporary commanders of the Golconda ' s army until was crowned a new king and thank to this Golconda defeat for good the Muktar ' s troops at the Battle of the Wilma Pass .

title: Bouladin al - Mutajalli
description: Bouladin al - Mutajalli Bouladin al - Mutajalli was the Amir of the jann of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Bouladin was an honest and noble janni , but did not hesitate to strike against those who opposed him or threatened the House of Sihr .
description_long: Bouladin al - Mutajalli Bouladin al - Mutajalli was the Amir of the jann of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Bouladin was an honest and noble janni , but did not hesitate to strike against those who opposed him or threatened the House of Sihr . Relationships . A longtime ally of Tajar and Sheikh Ali al - Hadd , Bouladin aided the great city during times of need . Bouladin also made sure a janni representative from the House of Sihr appeared before the Grand Caliph to pledge their support to him as well . Bouladin ' s oldest daughter was named Jamala . Activities . Bouladin had to spend much of his time and effort keeping the ghul - kin and great ghul s of the Pit of the Ghuls in check .

title: Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun
description: Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun ( often known simply as Cavus Dun ) were renowned mercenaries from Netheril . Organization . Members of the mercenary group were not considered Netherese nobles , but were considered above commoners .
description_long: Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun ( often known simply as Cavus Dun ) were renowned mercenaries from Netheril . Organization . Members of the mercenary group were not considered Netherese nobles , but were considered above commoners . The leader of Cavus Dun was called the Grandfather . History . In the year 1463 DR , a group of Bounty Hirelings were hired by Effron to capture Dahlia Sin ' felle and kill Drizzt Do ' Urden . Following the failure of that group a larger force , lead by Glorfathel , was sent to aid Herzgo Alegni in Neverwinter and to retrieve Charon ' s Claw in Gauntlgrym . They failed in their task , in no small part because Ambergris turned on the group and defected to Drizzt ' s side , taking Afafrenfere with her .

title: Bounty hunter
description: Bounty hunter A Bounty hunter is someone who hunts for someone or something for a price . It is an occupation on Faerûn . The Bounty hunter will track , hunt , capture , kill or seize the thing or person for the right price , no matter the cost to him ( unless the cost is more than the gain ) .
description_long: Bounty hunter A Bounty hunter is someone who hunts for someone or something for a price . It is an occupation on Faerûn . The Bounty hunter will track , hunt , capture , kill or seize the thing or person for the right price , no matter the cost to him ( unless the cost is more than the gain ) .

title: Bounty of the Goddess
description: Bounty of the Goddess The Bounty of the Goddess was a temple and garden complex dedicated to Chauntea in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .
description_long: Bounty of the Goddess The Bounty of the Goddess was a temple and garden complex dedicated to Chauntea in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn . The temple itself stood at the intersection of the North Ride and Shind Road in the center of Voonlar . Description . The temple and extensive gardens were surrounded by walls and took up about a third of the town proper . The gates were circular in design and made of thick iron bars overgrown with flowering vines and moss . The frame around the gates bore a design of sheaves of wheat . The main temple was a beautiful edifice with multiple slender bell towers . The grounds of the compound were a maze of flagstone paths that passed by lush flower beds and blooming shrubbery interspersed with pools and trellis - covered benches . These bowers could be lit at night with " dancing lights " . There were also three guesthouses and several greenhouses all connected by tunnels used for heating and irrigation pipes . Activities .

title: Bounty seekers
description: Bounty seekers The bounty seekers were a trio of bounty hunters sent by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka in Calimshan to recapture Vajra Valmeyjar , the famous veteran slave - gladiator of the Arena of Blood who had escaped the baron ' s service . History . Baron Abon Duum wanted Vajra back in his service , as she ' d been very profitable to him as a gladiator , and so sent the bounty seekers after her .
description_long: Bounty seekers The bounty seekers were a trio of bounty hunters sent by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka in Calimshan to recapture Vajra Valmeyjar , the famous veteran slave - gladiator of the Arena of Blood who had escaped the baron ' s service . History . Baron Abon Duum wanted Vajra back in his service , as she ' d been very profitable to him as a gladiator , and so sent the bounty seekers after her . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , the bounty seekers had pursued Vajra to the city of Waterdeep . There , they heard of a street brawl in which Vajra and her companions had beaten off some thugs attacking a drunken beggar , Priam Agrivar , outside the Inn of the Crescent Moon . The bounty seekers found two of the thugs , roughed them up , and demanded to know which way Vajra and her companions had gone . Though the thugs hoped for a share of the reward , the bounty seekers killed them once they had received their answer . The bounty seekers tracked the adventurers on the way to Stoner ' s Needle and ambushed them as they returned .

title: Bouqthi
description: Bouqthi Bouqthi was a type of pastry made in Luiren . Despite its popularity , " bouqthi " was rarely exported since pastries did not fare well under the rigors of travelling over long distances . Description .
description_long: Bouqthi Bouqthi was a type of pastry made in Luiren . Despite its popularity , " bouqthi " was rarely exported since pastries did not fare well under the rigors of travelling over long distances . Description . This delicious pastry was made by stuffing sugared dough with red rhubarb stalks harvested from the southern edge of the Long Forest . There were easily a hundred different variations of the basic recipe , with all being a delicious treat in their own right .

title: Bow
description: Bow A bow was a two - handed muscle - powered projectile weapon used to shoot arrow s at a distant target . Bows came in a variety of different sizes and could be made of wood , horn , or bone . Composite bows were made of thin layers of these materials laminated together for extra strength .
description_long: Bow A bow was a two - handed muscle - powered projectile weapon used to shoot arrow s at a distant target . Bows came in a variety of different sizes and could be made of wood , horn , or bone . Composite bows were made of thin layers of these materials laminated together for extra strength . Often the price of a bow was greater than the price of a sword , and there was the added cost of arrows to be used as ammunition . Elves esteemed the art of archery and were proficient with long and short bows and the composite versions of each . Ranger s were proficient with all simple and martial weapons and could choose archery as a combat style . Rogue s were proficient with the shortbow but not the longbow because it was not easy to conceal or carry while moving stealthily . Bows in the Realms . Bows generally fell into one of two classifications : the shortbow , as the name implied , was smaller with correspondingly less range and penetration than the longbow . The strength of the archer could increase range and damage but the bow must be built to withstand the higher forces and this increased the cost dramatically .

title: Bow of the Black Archer
description: Bow of the Black Archer The Bow of the Black Archer was the weapon of the elven deity Shevarash until he was captured and slain by the drow . Description . Apart from the fact that the bow was as black as pitch , it was completely unremarkable in terms of looks .
description_long: Bow of the Black Archer The Bow of the Black Archer was the weapon of the elven deity Shevarash until he was captured and slain by the drow . Description . Apart from the fact that the bow was as black as pitch , it was completely unremarkable in terms of looks . When it was wielded however , the bow intermittently whispered softly in elven to the wielder about grief and loss . If a drow came within 60 feet ( 20 meters ) of the wielder , its whispers became angry and much more regular , talking about having revenge on all drow . History . Three hundred years after Shevarash was executed , an elven ranger named Valaderion decided he would recover the lost bow from the drow . He killed every dark elf he came across , always striking from the constant darkness of the Underdark so that he was never detected . He recovered the bow and made his way back to the surface . Along the way though , he met with a female drow exile named Kiralasha and was forced to work with her to kill a nest of beholder s that blocked both of their paths . He used the bow to devastating effect and , as a result , both survived the encounter .

title: Bowgentle
description: Bowgentle Bowgentle of Silverymoon was a legendary wizard . Personality . Bowgentle was noted for his calm demeanour , politeness and generosity , but also for his reckless adventuring .
description_long: Bowgentle Bowgentle of Silverymoon was a legendary wizard . Personality . Bowgentle was noted for his calm demeanour , politeness and generosity , but also for his reckless adventuring . Activities . Bowgentle spent much of his life venturing into dangerous places in search of hoarded magic . Upon escaping with his spoils , he would then share what he ' d found in cities . He cast spells for the benefit of others , making him a much - loved hero of the people . Biography . Bowgentle was born on Nightal 30 1034 DR . His father was a fisherman in Silverymoon . At the age of six , Bowgentle began his study of magic under Quintas Uhlawm . By the age of nineteen , Bowgentle had attracted the personal attention of Silverymoon ' s High Mage Orjalun , who took him on as a student for a time . Four years later , Bowgentle left his home city and began a grand career in wizardry up and down the Sword Coast and Savage Frontier , rivalled by few .

title: Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey
description: Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey was an arcane alteration spell that briefly teleported another person or creature to a nearby location and then back to the point of origin . Effects . This spell only worked on a single live creature ( not undead or an inanimate object ) that was successfully touched while casting the spell .
description_long: Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey was an arcane alteration spell that briefly teleported another person or creature to a nearby location and then back to the point of origin .
