Effects . This spell only worked on a single live creature ( not undead or an inanimate object ) that was successfully touched while casting the spell . If the creature was not willing , it had a chance to resist , in which case the spell was expended and nothing happened . For the teleport to be successful , the target creature could not be tightly restrained , such as in stocks , clasped in chains , tied up with ropes , caught in spider ' s webs , " etc . " , or overburdened with equipment or other encumbrances that put the target over the limit of 500 lb ( 227 kg ) . The destination of the teleported creature had to be in sight of the caster , at least casually familiar to the caster , and no farther away than 20 yd ( 18 m ) per level in the horizontal direction and 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) per level in the vertical direction .

title: Bowshot
description: Bowshot Bowshot sits aside the Trade Way north of the Way Inn and south of Liam ' s Hold . It was name for its location , being a " bowshot " from the Misty Forest when the village was founded . The woods are now considerably farther away as the years of logging have taken their toll .
description_long: Bowshot Bowshot sits aside the Trade Way north of the Way Inn and south of Liam ' s Hold . It was name for its location , being a " bowshot " from the Misty Forest when the village was founded . The woods are now considerably farther away as the years of logging have taken their toll . Recently caverns have been discovered at the western edge of the hamlet . The caves maybe connected to the upper Underdark and a large vein of silver .

title: Boyla ' s Court
description: Boyla ' s Court The Boyla ' s Court was a large outdoor courtyard found near the center of Manass in Khazari . Uses . The courtyard served as a prime location for a variety of events such as public announcements , executions , torturing criminals , and public festivals .
description_long: Boyla ' s Court The Boyla ' s Court was a large outdoor courtyard found near the center of Manass in Khazari . Uses . The courtyard served as a prime location for a variety of events such as public announcements , executions , torturing criminals , and public festivals . Inhabitants . The personal bodyguard of the governor of Manass kept watch along the perimeter of the courtyard .

title: Brace Lenalice
description: Brace Lenalice Brace Lenalice , who usually went by Brace the Bold , was a gnome bard who lived in Westgate Description . Brace had a huge nose and large ears . Abilities .
description_long: Brace Lenalice Brace Lenalice , who usually went by Brace the Bold , was a gnome bard who lived in Westgate Description . Brace had a huge nose and large ears . Abilities . Brace was an accomplished swordsman and trained in the bladedance technique at the Timeless Blade . He was also able to infuse his words with magic to heal . Possessions . Brace carried a magical rapier that he was able to split into two blades . History . In 1480 DR Brace met Myrin Darkdance and talked his way into her employ . Brace had an eternally sunny disposition and was something of a ladies man but he was also a bit of a bumbler . He wasn ' t a traditional bard but could effectively heal the wounded by shouting insults at them . Brace was killed by a crusader of Hoar named Vaelis while guarding a wounded Kalen Dren .

title: Brace Skatterhawk
description: Brace Skatterhawk Brace Skatterhawk was a knight and a member of the Skatterhawk noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .
description_long: Brace Skatterhawk Brace Skatterhawk was a knight and a member of the Skatterhawk noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . Beldred Truesilver sent Brace and Threldryn Imbranneth to watch Alusair when she stepped aside to receive a private message . They returned to find Beldred and the knights had impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush , and a few were killed . Alusair rallied her forces to defeat the orcs — Brace struck one — before deducing they served a dark naga and the Zhentarim , who had been charming and transporting monsters into the area . Brace was one of those who volunteered to aid Alusair , and had a hand in slaying the naga . Afterward , Kortyl Rowanmantle and other knights teased Brace over rumors that he was the illegitimate son of King Azoun IV .

title: Brace Ulmemur
description: Brace Ulmemur Brace Ulmemur was a City Watch fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Brace was very loyal to friends but was liable to hunt a betrayer to the end of the world .
description_long: Brace Ulmemur Brace Ulmemur was a City Watch fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Brace was very loyal to friends but was liable to hunt a betrayer to the end of the world . He was a little paranoid and distrustful of people he didn ' t know . History . Brace was an adventurer devoted to Tymora but every adventuring party he joined was decimated by monsters . In time , most adventurers said that Brace was " kissed by Beshaba " and nobody wanted him in their party any more . So Brace joined the City Watch to have a regular income and home .

title: Bracers of armor
description: Bracers of armor Bracers of armor were magical armor pieces for the forearms that protected the wearer with an invisible field of force that acted as a source of armor for his or her whole body . Description . Most bracers of armor appeared to be a pair of normal .
description_long: Bracers of armor Bracers of armor were magical armor pieces for the forearms that protected the wearer with an invisible field of force that acted as a source of armor for his or her whole body . Description . Most bracers of armor appeared to be a pair of normal . Powers . They could come in a wide range of power levels , ranging from protection equivalent to the wearing of padded armor to the defensive capabilities of full plate mail . The power of the bracers only manifested if both members of the pair were worn at the same time . Some bracers of armor , such as the Bracers of the Blinding Strike , came with additional powers .

title: Bracers of the blinding strike
description: Bracers of the blinding strike Bracers of the blinding strike were a pair of magical bracers worn on the wrists . Description . This pair of magical ringlets could be worn over any appendage , size permitting , to magically increase the speed of , in most cases , the limb that the ringlets adorned .
description_long: Bracers of the blinding strike Bracers of the blinding strike were a pair of magical bracers worn on the wrists . Description . This pair of magical ringlets could be worn over any appendage , size permitting , to magically increase the speed of , in most cases , the limb that the ringlets adorned . Therefore , they were referred to more commonly as " bracelets " or " anklets " . The bracers weighed 1 lb ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Use . In addition to serving as " bracers of armor + 6 " , the bracers gave the wearer excellent reaction time in battle and allowed them to attack more swiftly and more often . History . In 1357 DR , the drow weapon master Dantrag Baenre of Menzoberranzan wore " bracers of the blinding strike " . However , owing to the speed they imparted , Dantrag was unable to improvise during combat . The drow ranger Drizzt Do ' Urden was able to exploit Dantrag ' s weakness , forcing him to stick to rote and practiced combinations , which allowed Drizzt to gain the upper hand .

title: Brack ' thal Xorlarrin
description: Brack ' thal Xorlarrin Brack ' thal Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . History . Prior to the Spellplague , Brack ' thal was a powerful wizard favored by Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin .
description_long: Brack ' thal Xorlarrin Brack ' thal Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . History . Prior to the Spellplague , Brack ' thal was a powerful wizard favored by Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin . The Spellplague turned him half - mad and half - comatose . After the death of the house patron , Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin , Zeerith turned to her son for heirs , producing Ravel from his loins . Brack ' thal was ordered by his mother to accompany the expedition led by Ravel to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . Empowered by his ability to tame the fire elemental s and frustrated with his increasingly weak position in the family , he sabotaged the Forge and set fire elementals to attack the workers . While doing so , he was confronted by Drizzt Do ' Urden , Artemis Entreri , and Dahlia Sin ' felle , who were trying to reach the pit of the primordial . He attacked them and Entreri drew the killing blow . Skills . Brack ' thal was skilled in elemental magic . He learned his wizardry before the Spellplague , so his repertoire was considered outdated by the new " spellspinners " of House Xorlarrin .

title: Braden Yil
description: Braden Yil Braden Yil was a merchant retainer of House Cadorna of Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Braden was a nervous but meticulous individual .
description_long: Braden Yil Braden Yil was a merchant retainer of House Cadorna of Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Braden was a nervous but meticulous individual . He looked frequently at the sky in order to check his adherence to his time schedule . He spoke curtly and briefly and got exasperated when subjected to long speeches . History . Braden worked as merchant for House Cadorna . In 1489 DR , after a dramatic increase of bandit attacks around the Iron Route , he hired an adventuring party to solve the matter .

title: Braelen Hatherhand
description: Braelen Hatherhand Braelen Hatherhand was a boy in Red Larch and a son of a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , his father put him in the Tomb of Moving Stones as punishment for failed to deliver a message to Ilmeth Waelvur .
description_long: Braelen Hatherhand Braelen Hatherhand was a boy in Red Larch and a son of a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , his father put him in the Tomb of Moving Stones as punishment for failed to deliver a message to Ilmeth Waelvur . Here he was found by some adventurers who were investigating in the village .

title: Braelin Janquay
description: Braelin Janquay Braelin Janquay was a drow scout within Jarlaxle ' s Bregan D ' aerthe . History . In 1483 DR , Bregan D ' aerthe leader Jarlaxle met the reincarnated Regis and , despite not recognizing him , sent spies to report on him .
description_long: Braelin Janquay Braelin Janquay was a drow scout within Jarlaxle ' s Bregan D ' aerthe . History . In 1483 DR , Bregan D ' aerthe leader Jarlaxle met the reincarnated Regis and , despite not recognizing him , sent spies to report on him . Presumably , Braelin was one of these spies . Braelin discovered Regis ' s true identity , saved him from Ship Rethnor thugs , and reported on him and Catti - brie to Jarlaxle . He was also the one to report on Dahlia Sin ' felle ' s ascension to matron mother of House Do ' Urden . Skills . Braelin was considered one of Bregan D ' aerthe ' s most promising scouts . Possessions . Braelin ' s Bregan D ' aerthe insignia enabled him to levitate . He wielded two sword s , as well as a crossbow .

title: Braerindra Calauth
description: Braerindra Calauth Braerindra Calauth was an elven woman who was the last of Calauth House in Cormanthyr . After her death , she rose as a specter and was entrusted by the Coronal to act as guardian of his quarters . History .
description_long: Braerindra Calauth Braerindra Calauth was an elven woman who was the last of Calauth House in Cormanthyr . After her death , she rose as a specter and was entrusted by the Coronal to act as guardian of his quarters . History . Braerindra was one of the first elves to befriend Elminster Aumar in 241 DR .

title: Braeryn
description: Braeryn The Braeryn , nicknamed Stenchstreets , was the lowest , poorest , and most crowded district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Inhabitants . The Braeryn ' s houses were full of escaped or disposed of slaves of many races especially orc s and goblinoid s .
description_long: Braeryn The Braeryn , nicknamed Stenchstreets , was the lowest , poorest , and most crowded district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Inhabitants . The Braeryn ' s houses were full of escaped or disposed of slaves of many races especially orc s and goblinoid s . These were often termed " undercreatures . " Inhabitants often lived twenty to thirty per room , doing their business with no privacy whatsoever . Activities . A common sport for nobles was a Hunt through the Braeryn , in which nobles killed any undercreatures they saw . During this time , anybody on the street was denied entry for fear of risking the occupants of a building . Trophies from the Hunt often included teeth , ears , and heads of the inhabitants , including drow . History . Circa 1363 DR , there was an outbreak of the pox in Menzoberranzan that hit the poor inhabitants of the city , especially in the Braeryn , particularly hard . In 1372 DR , a number of male drow began disappearing . Assigned to investigate , Pharaun Mizzrym and Ryld Argith began skulking around the poorer districts of Menzoberranzan . They found various graffiti of orcish and other tribal natures in the Braeryn .

title: Brain golem
description: Brain golem A brain golem was an eight - foot - tall humanoid - shaped construct made entirely of brain tissue with a bud of an elder brain for a head . These creations existed only to serve an elder brain and its illithid community . They did not communicate in any way and only reacted to the telepathic orders of mind flayers , and could not attack any mind flayer .
description_long: Brain golem A brain golem was an eight - foot - tall humanoid - shaped construct made entirely of brain tissue with a bud of an elder brain for a head . These creations existed only to serve an elder brain and its illithid community . They did not communicate in any way and only reacted to the telepathic orders of mind flayers , and could not attack any mind flayer . Combat . The brain golems tried " mind blasting " their opponents and then tried to batter their strong arms on the weaker enemies . Brain golems were protected by a force field on the inside , similar to the spell " mage armor " .

title: Brainstealer dragon
description: Brainstealer dragon A brainstealer dragon was a mix of illithid and dragon . They sometimes ruled illithid settlements that did not have an elder brain . Appendix .
description_long: Brainstealer dragon A brainstealer dragon was a mix of illithid and dragon . They sometimes ruled illithid settlements that did not have an elder brain . Appendix . Notes . As illithids are parasitic creatures that take over their host , this is likely the result of an illithid tadpole being implanted into a dragon .

title: Brakar ( weasel )
description: Brakar ( weasel ) Brakar was a weasel and the familiar of Chaid al Farid al Fuqani . Chaid first bonded with Brakar on 28 Uktar 1374 DR . Chaid had wanted to name the creature " Brakar " , but on advice from Tsarra Chaadren , asked the weasel if it already had a name , and , on learning that it did not , asked if it minded being called " Brakar " , to which it agreed .
description_long: Brakar ( weasel ) Brakar was a weasel and the familiar of Chaid al Farid al Fuqani . Chaid first bonded with Brakar on 28 Uktar 1374 DR . Chaid had wanted to name the creature " Brakar " , but on advice from Tsarra Chaadren , asked the weasel if it already had a name , and , on learning that it did not , asked if it minded being called " Brakar " , to which it agreed .

title: Bralani
description: Bralani Bralani are noble eladrin who hold dominance over the autumn winds . They usher in winter in the great cycle of life , death , and rebirth . They are considered to be the fiercest and wildest of all the celestial s , living from moment to moment .
description_long: Bralani Bralani are noble eladrin who hold dominance over the autumn winds . They usher in winter in the great cycle of life , death , and rebirth . They are considered to be the fiercest and wildest of all the celestial s , living from moment to moment . Bralani love the chance to compete with others , suggesting tournaments and challenges of both physical and mental skill . Bralani appear as pale elves , their skin being a light blue in color and their hair similar to that of newly - fallen snow . In an instant , a bralani can assume the form of a whirlwind of dust and snow .

title: Bramas Thorntree
description: Bramas Thorntree Bramas Thorntree was a thief and smuggler in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Bramas worked for Kiros Tamadan , a spice merchant in Athkatla , that through various agents and blind contacts worked for Inselm Hhune .
description_long: Bramas Thorntree Bramas Thorntree was a thief and smuggler in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Bramas worked for Kiros Tamadan , a spice merchant in Athkatla , that through various agents and blind contacts worked for Inselm Hhune . History . Bramas worked for his boss for a long time . In 1370 DR it was ordered to Bramas to gathered a mercenary company and recovered " Sondarr Scepter " from a long - forgotten dwarven tomb in the Starspire Mountains . He gathered some old allies and mercenaries forming the Company of the Anvil . Together they recover the scepter . They were ordered to maintain a low profile in their come backing voyage and they stop in Uktar 10 to the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth for drink . Later that night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the Sondarr Scepter . However the dwarves accidentally started a brawl with the Shields of the Highland adventuring company . Bramas and his companions used this as an opportunity to escape with the " scepter " . Personality . Bramas took his work very seriously . He was totally loyal to his masters and always honored a contract .

title: Brambleberry
description: Brambleberry Lord Brambleberry was a noble of Waterdeep . He held a great hatred for Luskan ' s pirate activity . In 1376 DR , he agreed with Captain Deudermont of the " Sea Sprite " to reform Luskan by eliminating the High Captains of Luskan and the Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Brambleberry Lord Brambleberry was a noble of Waterdeep . He held a great hatred for Luskan ' s pirate activity . In 1376 DR , he agreed with Captain Deudermont of the " Sea Sprite " to reform Luskan by eliminating the High Captains of Luskan and the Arcane Brotherhood . Lord Brambleberry gathered his family ' s troops and together with Deudermont invaded Luskan . They were victorious in the fighting against the Brotherhood ' s forces ( the High Captains having retreated to see who was the victor of the battle ) . In the main attack against the Host Tower of the Arcane , the Archmage Arcane escalated the battle to extremes and forced Deudermont and Brambleberry to destroy the Host Tower . However , the destruction of the tower caused many dead , among them Lord Brambleberry .

title: Bran Skorlsun
description: Bran Skorlsun Bran Skorlsun was a well - respected High Harper , who dared to love an elven princess and was also the indirect cause for the creation of the Tel ' Teukiira . Description . Bran was a tall man beginning to visibly age at the time of Khelben ' s trial .
description_long: Bran Skorlsun Bran Skorlsun was a well - respected High Harper , who dared to love an elven princess and was also the indirect cause for the creation of the Tel ' Teukiira . Description . Bran was a tall man beginning to visibly age at the time of Khelben ' s trial . He had a weathered but square - jawed , healthy - looking face . Personality . Bran was known to be hot - headed , stubborn and unreasonable . His desire for a ' pure ' Harper organization was supposedly formed during his forty years as a tracker of spies and turncloaks and was only strengthened by his enmity with Khelben . He generally had a grim outlook and preferred to be alone . He was a good man , with the best of intentions , but his difficulty in social situations and overzealousness led many to think the worst of him . Still , he was capable of influencing people with that selfsame stubbornness . Bran disliked magic being used on him . Combat / Tactics . Bran was a very strong warrior . He could hold a man aloft with only one hand but he also possessed the grace and stealth of a cat . He was highly skilled in the use of dagger s , longsword s , and longbow s . He was an exceptional tracker .

title: Branch of Linden
description: Branch of Linden The Branch of Linden was an organization operating out of Tethyr in the mid 1400 ' s DR . Activities . Comprised of supporters of Evonne Linden and her revolt against her sister Anais Linden as queen of Tethyr , the Branch of Linden attempted to overthrow the current queen and her supporters .
description_long: Branch of Linden The Branch of Linden was an organization operating out of Tethyr in the mid 1400 ' s DR . Activities . Comprised of supporters of Evonne Linden and her revolt against her sister Anais Linden as queen of Tethyr , the Branch of Linden attempted to overthrow the current queen and her supporters . They ultimately failed , having been driven into Ebenspy Keep where most of them were defeated and then hanged after several days of siege .

title: Brand
description: Brand Brand was a sadistic wizard spell created by a " shig ' harak " of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . " Brand " was similar to the " wizard mark " spell save that it could be placed on any surface , including flesh .
description_long: Brand Brand was a sadistic wizard spell created by a " shig ' harak " of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . " Brand " was similar to the " wizard mark " spell save that it could be placed on any surface , including flesh . When cast , this spell burned between 1 - 6 figures into the subject matter . Living tissue suffered excruciating pain from the experience . Once placed upon an inanimate surface , only the caster of the spell could remove the " brand " . If placed on living tissue , the caster or a " heal " spell could remove a " brand " . Persons with a " brand " on a visible part of their body were often shunned by others . Components . This spell only required verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Branded
description: Branded The Branded , or abd Wusum , were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The efreet mamluk s of the Branded guarded the Sultan ' s personal harim .
description_long: Branded The Branded , or abd Wusum , were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The efreet mamluk s of the Branded guarded the Sultan ' s personal harim . There were 150 members of the Branded . All were known to be discreet and observant individuals who were immune to bribery attempts . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Branded .

title: Brandeen
description: Brandeen Brandeen is the common name in the Realms for stibiotantalite , a rare mineral which sometimes contains clear areas of reddish brown to honey - yellow hue which can be cut to yield small , hard , faceted gems . A typical specimen has a base value of 100gp .
description_long: Brandeen Brandeen is the common name in the Realms for stibiotantalite , a rare mineral which sometimes contains clear areas of reddish brown to honey - yellow hue which can be cut to yield small , hard , faceted gems . A typical specimen has a base value of 100gp .

title: Brandiar
description: Brandiar The Duchy of Brandiar was a small region of Damara in 1357 DR . Description . Farming settlements dominated the landscape for most of Brandiar .
description_long: Brandiar The Duchy of Brandiar was a small region of Damara in 1357 DR . Description . Farming settlements dominated the landscape for most of Brandiar . The duchy was bordered in the west by the Galena Mountains and the Goliad River in the east . History . Though the position remained vacant in 1357 DR , historically the Duke of Brandebury was the ruler of the duchy . Duke Ebelard was the last of the Brandebury line to rule . The ruling seat was vacated when he died of a broken heart soon after conceding defeat at the hands of the minions of Zhengyi . Without a successor , the seat remained vacant throughout the Bloodstone Wars . It was not until later , when the forces of Vaasa rose again , that the people of Brandiar joined in the Damaran rebellion . A common farmer named Dormythyrr assumed stewardship of Brandiar , marshaled an army , and joined Gareth Dragonsbane in the fight . Activities . Brandiar spent many years recovering from the horrors of the Bloodstone Wars . The saying " eight of the ten " was common here , referring to the eight years of the war that was fought largely within the duchy ' s borders .

title: Brandilar
description: Brandilar Brandilar was the guard captain of the Merchant ' s League headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate . History . During the iron crisis , Brandilar was aware of abnormalities in his organization ' s leaders .
description_long: Brandilar Brandilar was the guard captain of the Merchant ' s League headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate . History . During the iron crisis , Brandilar was aware of abnormalities in his organization ' s leaders . When he met Gorion ' s Ward , he expressed his concerns and helped the Ward in the investigation .

title: Branding smite
description: Branding smite Branding smite was an evocation spell that produced an astral radiant glow on a target when struck . Effects . If the enchanted weapon struck an invisible target , then it would give off a soft glow to a distance of about 5 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Branding smite Branding smite was an evocation spell that produced an astral radiant glow on a target when struck . Effects . If the enchanted weapon struck an invisible target , then it would give off a soft glow to a distance of about 5 feet ( 1 . 5 meters ) . The target would be struck with radiant damage proportional to the power of the caster . The effect lasted for a minute . Components . Only a vocal component was needed .

title: Brandobaris
description: Brandobaris Brandobaris was the halfling deity of thievery and an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . He was the misapprehensions of halflings held by most races in divine form . He was constantly scheming and meddling , as he was curious and with a short attention span .
description_long: Brandobaris Brandobaris was the halfling deity of thievery and an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . He was the misapprehensions of halflings held by most races in divine form . He was constantly scheming and meddling , as he was curious and with a short attention span . Where the tall races would add more interest in one ' s purse than his character , Brandobaris cares for character more . Brandobaris had few enemies , as his charm and wits allowed him to escape from trouble . Worshipers . Brandobaris ' worshipers were usually Lightfoot Halflings who share his curiosity . His stories were often adored by children who were raised with the stories of his exploits . Strongheart Halfling communities often discouraged his worship as it was associated with an undisciplined lifestyle and thievery . Ghostwise Halflings saw him as the perversion of civilized society . Relationships . Brandobaris had a relation with Tymora , which was likely the reason for his luck . Brandobaris also got on well with the rest of his pantheon . The other way around , however , was not the case .

title: Brandyr
description: Brandyr Brandyr was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Brandyr was in charge of the Six - Fingered Courtyard , where inhabitants paid homage to the demon lord Graz ' zt with four cambion assistants until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated her and her minions .
description_long: Brandyr Brandyr was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Brandyr was in charge of the Six - Fingered Courtyard , where inhabitants paid homage to the demon lord Graz ' zt with four cambion assistants until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated her and her minions .

title: Branislav Semyon
description: Branislav Semyon Branislav Semyon serves as a bodyguard within the Tower of the Blades in Mulmaster and often carries out assassin work for High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . He often disguises himself as Draazu , one of the region ' s earliest hired killers . Branislav is not the only person to have taken this name , only furthering the legend and mystery surrounding Draazu ' s whereabouts .
description_long: Branislav Semyon Branislav Semyon serves as a bodyguard within the Tower of the Blades in Mulmaster and often carries out assassin work for High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . He often disguises himself as Draazu , one of the region ' s earliest hired killers . Branislav is not the only person to have taken this name , only furthering the legend and mystery surrounding Draazu ' s whereabouts . Appearance . Semyon is just under 6 ' ( 1 . 8 m ) tall , with a muscular build and hard facial features . Magic Items . Among his possessions are various magical armors and weapons , a ring of protection + 1 , a bag of holding and various thieves tools including a grappling hook .

title: Brant Rethalshield
description: Brant Rethalshield Brant Rethalshield was a human aspirant to the Order of the Aster . He was the squire of Grayth Holmfast . Appearances .
description_long: Brant Rethalshield Brant Rethalshield was a human aspirant to the Order of the Aster . He was the squire of Grayth Holmfast . Appearances . Brant had sandy - blond hair and wide blue eyes . Equipment . Brant wore the orange surcoat of an aspirant to the Order of the Aster . Death . Brant was killed on 16 Ches , 1374 DR when a canoloth bit off his arm . None of the accompanying ( reformed ) Company of the White Star could get to him quickly enough to save him .

title: Branwen
description: Branwen Branwen was a human female cleric of Tempus who lived in the late 13th century DR . Born in the village of Seawolf in the Norheim Isles , Branwen was reviled by her fellow villagers for pursuing the traditionally male - oriented profession of priest . She wandered the Sword Coast , eventually falling in with a malicious adventuring troupe .
description_long: Branwen Branwen was a human female cleric of Tempus who lived in the late 13th century DR . Born in the village of Seawolf in the Norheim Isles , Branwen was reviled by her fellow villagers for pursuing the traditionally male - oriented profession of priest . She wandered the Sword Coast , eventually falling in with a malicious adventuring troupe . When Branwen realized the troupe engaged in banditry , she rebelled , but was turned to stone by the mage Tranzig . She remained encased in stone as an attraction at the Nashkel carnvival until 1368 DR , when she was freed by the Bhaalspawn known as Gorion ' s Ward . Appendix . For her appearance in " Baldur ' s Gate " , Branwen was voiced by the actress . The character briefly appears in " " , providing instructional help to the player in the game ' s tutorial .

title: Brass dragon
description: Brass dragon Brass dragons were the weakest of the metallic dragon s , and also one of the most benign of all species of dragon . They loved to talk , to the exclusion of most else . They loved to engage friends and foes alike in hours of long - winded conversation .
description_long: Brass dragon Brass dragons were the weakest of the metallic dragon s , and also one of the most benign of all species of dragon . They loved to talk , to the exclusion of most else . They loved to engage friends and foes alike in hours of long - winded conversation . It was not unusual for a brass dragon to be fluent in several hundred different languages , although they obviously preferred to converse in Draconic whenever possible . Description . Physically , the brass dragon was highly distinctive . From below , its outstretched wings formed a triangular shape , as they were attached to its body all the way to the tip of its tail . The wings were longest at the shoulder , and tapered gently as they reached the tail . Their scales seemed to radiate heat and light . As their name implied , brass dragons tended to have brass - colored scales . Their scales were a dull brown at a young age , becoming more glossy and brass in appearance as they aged . The shape of the head was quite unusual , as it included a large , curved plate that extended from the dragon ' s eyes and cheeks on either side and curved upwards into two points .

title: Brathes
description: Brathes Brathes was the bodyguard of the new pharaoh of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Brathes was trying to act as bridge between the new pharaoh and the clergy of Anhur .
description_long: Brathes Brathes was the bodyguard of the new pharaoh of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Brathes was trying to act as bridge between the new pharaoh and the clergy of Anhur . Relationship . Brathes was a childhood friend of Horustep III . The clerics of Anhur heavily supported him .

title: Braundlae ' s Best
description: Braundlae ' s Best Braundlae ' s Best was a restaurant and tavern on the promenade below the Roving Dragon in Suzail , Cormyr and staffed by Braundlae . Food and drink . The restaurant served live eel s in mint - and - lime hot sauce and sausage rolls with Silver dragon sauce .
description_long: Braundlae ' s Best Braundlae ' s Best was a restaurant and tavern on the promenade below the Roving Dragon in Suzail , Cormyr and staffed by Braundlae . Food and drink . The restaurant served live eel s in mint - and - lime hot sauce and sausage rolls with Silver dragon sauce .

title: Braxow
description: Braxow Braxow was a stone giant thane sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Braxow was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Braxow Braxow was a stone giant thane sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Braxow was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Braxow was one of the giant lords who had arrived in the Maelstrom citadel in search of news about Princess Serissa ' s plans for the future . Personality . Braxow feared not following the giant pantheon ' s ways .

title: Brazier
description: Brazier Braziers were simple devices that could be used to burn materials or to house burner s to provide a low but constant source of heat . Description . Braziers were essential in a wizard ' s laboratory .
description_long: Brazier Braziers were simple devices that could be used to burn materials or to house burner s to provide a low but constant source of heat . Description . Braziers were essential in a wizard ' s laboratory . A brass brazier was also a required material component in the " find familiar " spell . Bronze braziers with matching burners were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Breachgnome
description: Breachgnome Breachgnomes were a type of gnomish fighter that were trained to single - handedly hold off enemies for as long as possible . Most breachgnomes were fighter s , ranger s , paladin s , or barbarians . They were generally found only in gnomish villages , although occasionally they could be found traveling alone .
description_long: Breachgnome Breachgnomes were a type of gnomish fighter that were trained to single - handedly hold off enemies for as long as possible . Most breachgnomes were fighter s , ranger s , paladin s , or barbarians . They were generally found only in gnomish villages , although occasionally they could be found traveling alone .

title: Breastplate
description: Breastplate A breastplate was one of the better forms of medium armor . Description . The armor covered the wearer ' s front and back with a metal cuirass , and included a helmet and greaves .
description_long: Breastplate A breastplate was one of the better forms of medium armor . Description . The armor covered the wearer ' s front and back with a metal cuirass , and included a helmet and greaves . A light suit of studded leather beneath the breastplate finished the armor suit , protecting the wearer ' s limbs without restricting movement much .

title: Breath of Petron
description: Breath of Petron The Breath of Petron was a powerful dragonborn artifact . Description . The Breath of Petron was a flute that looked like a root made of red stone , branching in at least six different directions into finer tubes .
description_long: Breath of Petron The Breath of Petron was a powerful dragonborn artifact . Description . The Breath of Petron was a flute that looked like a root made of red stone , branching in at least six different directions into finer tubes . Abilities . The Breath of Petron granted those who played it the power to control elemental air , earth , and lightning . The artifact demanded a price for its use , however , turning the lungs of those who played it into crystal . History . The Breath of Petron was a piece of the lungs of a primordial named Petron . This artifact was made by a slave dragonborn named Haizverad , who stole a small part of the remains of Petron collected by the dragon Versveshardinazar . The Breath of Petron was inherited by the descendants of Haizverad , and used in the Battle of the Crippled Mountain against the red dragon Rhodrolytharnestrix . After the Spellplague , the dragonborn survivors of Tymanchebar used the Breath of Petron to construct Djerad Thymar , by lifting and fusing the remains of the capital " djerad " of Tymanchebar , the ruins of the God - Tomb of Nanna - Sin , and rocks from the Smoking Mountains .

title: Breath of life
description: Breath of life Breath of life was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to cure nonmagical diseases in many people over a wide area . The reverse of this spell , breath of death could infect people in a large area with a fatal disease . Effects .
description_long: Breath of life Breath of life was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to cure nonmagical diseases in many people over a wide area . The reverse of this spell , breath of death could infect people in a large area with a fatal disease . Effects . The caster had to pick a particular disease when casting this spell — only one disease could be cured at a time . Natural diseases could be cured , but not magically created disease , parasites , rot grub s , green slime , lycanthropy , etc . Once cured , this spell did not prevent recurrence of a disease due to re - exposure . The area covered by this spell was centered on the caster , who had to remain in one place for the 10 minutes it took to cast " breath of life " . He or she exhaled a pleasant - smelling breath that formed a gently swirling breeze that was unaffected by wind or weather . The " breath of life " expanded in a circle , increasing in diameter by 300 ft ( 91 m ) every hour , for an hour per experience level of the priest . This magical zephyr instantly cured the chosen disease in everyone it touched .

title: Breath of the Sultan
description: Breath of the Sultan The Breath of the Sultan was a special fountain found within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . The fountain was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Breath of the Sultan The Breath of the Sultan was a special fountain found within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . The fountain was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description . As a symbol of the Sultan ' s rule , the great fountain was huge . It spewed purple flames high into the air from where it sat in front of the Charcoal Palace . History . The fountain ' s fire would die out or dim in the event of the Sultan ' s death or deposition . The new Sultan would then relight the fires of the fountain in a thunderous explosion easily heard by every occupant of the City of Brass .

title: Breath of the Yellow Rose
description: Breath of the Yellow Rose Breath of the Yellow Rose , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Mulmaster , its noble families and the Chapter House of the Yellow Breath . Summary .
description_long: Breath of the Yellow Rose Breath of the Yellow Rose , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Mulmaster , its noble families and the Chapter House of the Yellow Breath . Summary . The adventure starts off as adventurers are invited to a party by Aleyd Burral in Mulmaster to help the knight gain support for Phlan . During the party it becomes apparent that a new philosophy from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , known as the Yellow Breath , has become popular among many young nobles . It is also noted that a few recent devotees of the Yellow Breath movement have gone missing . As the adventurers investigate this new movement and the young noble converts it seems the Yellow Breath philosophy is not what it seems , with many dubious rites being practiced . Eventually the Chapter House of the Yellow Rose is explored where the cult ' s leader Thylius Caramitru is faced .

title: Bredisker
description: Bredisker Bredisker was a thief of the 12th century DR . In the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , in the southern Sword Coast lands , Bredisker successfully stole the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . Bredisker fled east to the Thornwood , but was continually harassed and stalked by the Ilmatari .
description_long: Bredisker Bredisker was a thief of the 12th century DR . In the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , in the southern Sword Coast lands , Bredisker successfully stole the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . Bredisker fled east to the Thornwood , but was continually harassed and stalked by the Ilmatari . A weary Bredisker soon sold the book to Lalaskra of Ormpetarr , a priestess of Loviatar and an enemy of the church .

title: Breek
description: Breek Breek was a soup served at the Flying Stag inn , in Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . Breek was prepared by boiling beef from all parts of a cow ( including hooves ) into a broth and then straining out the solid bits .
description_long: Breek Breek was a soup served at the Flying Stag inn , in Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . Breek was prepared by boiling beef from all parts of a cow ( including hooves ) into a broth and then straining out the solid bits . This broth then became the stock for a soup of wild onions , radishes , and hot spices .

title: Breex Vandermast
description: Breex Vandermast Breex Vandermast was an evil half - orc sorcerer living in Hillsfar . Personality . Breex was an intelligent and annoyingly confident individual .
description_long: Breex Vandermast Breex Vandermast was an evil half - orc sorcerer living in Hillsfar . Personality . Breex was an intelligent and annoyingly confident individual . He was quick with a biting insult . His mind was filled with thoughts of money , even knowing that if the First Lord discovered his business he could expect a rather terrible punishment . He displayed a stupefying amount of prejudice against non - humans , but if anyone noted his orc ish ancestry Breex lost all of his composure , screaming and spitting in rage . History . Breex lived in Hillsfar , carefully disguised as a human . During the Rage of Demons , he approached Captain Haakon Erlich of the Red Plumes with an idea to become rich : kidnap non - human farmers from around the city and sell them to the Hillsfar Arena . Haakon agreed and they captured many people , included the halfling Tinfellow family and the drow Arrizz . At last , Breex and the corrupt Red Plumes tried to capture an adventuring party hired by the Harpers to find the kidnapped people . In the end , the adventuring party managed to escape from the Arena and in the fighting they killed Breex .

title: Bregan D ' aerthe
description: Bregan D ' aerthe Bregan D ' aerthe was an elite drow mercenary and later mercantile group founded and led by Jarlaxle , primarily based in Menzoberranzan in the Underdark . History . Founding .
description_long: Bregan D ' aerthe Bregan D ' aerthe was an elite drow mercenary and later mercantile group founded and led by Jarlaxle , primarily based in Menzoberranzan in the Underdark . History . Founding . Bregan D ' aerthe was founded by the houseless rogue Jarlaxle , choosing to separate from the matriarchal drow society . It was built of mainly rogue drow males from destroyed houses of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . It was widely employed by the ruling houses of Menzoberranzan , especially by House Baenre , which had the resources to hire the group regularly , particularly given that Jarlaxle himself was a Baenre . The group soon had an important role on major events at Menzoberranzan ; for instance , it was hired by House Do ' Urden to assist on the attack on the fifth house , House Hun ' ett , and it played a significant role in the demise of House Do ' Urden . 14th century DR . In 1358 DR , Bregan D ' aerthe played a role in the drow attack on Mithral Hall . After the battle was over , the illithid advisor to Matron Yvonnel Baenre , Methil El - Viddenvelp , was believed dead .

title: Brelaina
description: Brelaina Brelaina was the captain of the Watch of Neverwinter . Description . Brelaina was typically dressed as a soldier .
description_long: Brelaina Brelaina was the captain of the Watch of Neverwinter . Description . Brelaina was typically dressed as a soldier . She had a Watch uniform , which she kept it in a good condition . She was attractive . Personality . Brelaina , unlike Cormick , was a good diplomat and thought about her next steps wisely . While she did not want to pester people too much , she expected of her soldiers some loyalty , competence , and discipline . History . After the city guardhouse was burned and the Kalach - Cha and companions started to work for the Watch , they needed to go to the Merchant Quarter , where her office lay . Brelaina would task them with jobs like stopping bandit shipments , raiding a smuggler ' s warehouse , and rescuing Fihelis . Once done , she would give them a pass to Blacklake District . When the Kalach - Cha was accused of being a murderer , Brelaina had a new task : to go to Gannish Estate and hold a transaction . Once completed , she would give a reward . Later , she appeared talking with Aldanon about the prisoner that was held in Crossroad Keep .

title: Bremen
description: Bremen Bremen is the westernmost of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Bremen is located is located on the southwestern shore of Maer Dualdon where the Shaengarne River meets the lake .
description_long: Bremen Bremen is the westernmost of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Bremen is located is located on the southwestern shore of Maer Dualdon where the Shaengarne River meets the lake . Bremen ' s position makes it susceptible to flooding , although Bremenites know the signs and lives are rarely lost because of it . History . The town was nearly destroyed just prior to 1312 DR in the invasion of the Icewind Dale by the Legion of the Chimera . In 1356 DR , Bremen and Caer - Konig were given to the barbarians of Icewind Dale after the war with Akar Kessell and Revjak became the spokesperson for Bremen . The spokesman of the town around the 1360s was Gil Haerngen , who , like other Bremenites , had a hobby of searching for gold and treasure in on the floodplains along the banks of the river . In 1482 DR , Catti - brie set up a home base in Bremen while waiting for her appointed rendez - vous with her friends .

title: Bren Tallsword
description: Bren Tallsword Bren Tallsword was a male human fighter and the commander of the forces stationed at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Tallsword was a rigid and strict disciplinarian .
description_long: Bren Tallsword Bren Tallsword was a male human fighter and the commander of the forces stationed at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Tallsword was a rigid and strict disciplinarian . He also had no qualms about holding the fort at all costs , even to the loss of all lives , including his own . Activities . Answering to the Warden of the Eastern Marches in Arabel , Bren Tallsword commanded the garrison at Castle Crag , comprising 500 Purple Dragons and a detachment of War Wizards . He had a standing order to hold the castle against invaders , at all costs , but was confident reinforcements from Arabel would arrive or rout invaders before any got past him , provided he gave them time . The Crown considered him ideal for his role in the kingdom ' s defense . Unusually , Bren hired psionicist s to instantly transmit secure messages via telepathy to Arabel in the event the castle was attacked . The leadership in Suzail studied the system and considered implementing it throughout the realm , but some conservatives feared it would trigger an arms - race with Zhentil Keep and the Stonelands and would be costly and difficult to manage .

title: Brenna Graycloak
description: Brenna Graycloak Brenna Graycloak was a wizard and councilor of Aglarond . Personality . Brenna was once a city - dweller ignorant of life in the larger world , but after a mission to Thay , her mind was opened .
description_long: Brenna Graycloak Brenna Graycloak was a wizard and councilor of Aglarond . Personality . Brenna was once a city - dweller ignorant of life in the larger world , but after a mission to Thay , her mind was opened . Cities became her favorite places , and Brenna was always comfortable in a town . She was stubborn and wanted to be considered equal to her companions in all situations . History . Brenna was born in Glarondar and rose through the ranks of politics until she became a member of the ruling council of Aglarond , where she sometime served as the Simbul ' s apprentice . In 1362 DR , she was sent to ask the help of the Harpers Galvin and Wynter to investigate some trouble in Thay and Brenna decided to accompany them . Brenna proved indispensable during the missions , both for her magic powers and her knowledge of Thayan culture . During that mission , she come to love Galvin but knowing his dislike for her beloved cities , she said goodbye to him after the defeat of Maligor . She later became a Harper .

title: Brennus Tanthul
description: Brennus Tanthul Prince Brennus Tanthul was the youngest brother among the princes , and many would say that Telamont Tanthul has a special fondness for him . Identified early as an intellectual prodigy , the boy was placed in the hands of the city ' s finest tutors and educators . Although Brennus displayed the royal family ' s expected facility with arcane magic , his teachers noted that he showed an equally strong aptitude for history .
description_long: Brennus Tanthul Prince Brennus Tanthul was the youngest brother among the princes , and many would say that Telamont Tanthul has a special fondness for him . Identified early as an intellectual prodigy , the boy was placed in the hands of the city ' s finest tutors and educators . Although Brennus displayed the royal family ' s expected facility with arcane magic , his teachers noted that he showed an equally strong aptitude for history . At his father ' s direction , Brennus ' s tutors focused the prince ' s education on the rich history and lore of the Shadovar . Brennus thrived in this discipline , and today he is one of the City of Shade ' s foremost experts on its Netherese roots . It is he who located the remnants of Netheril still extant in Faerûn and sent expeditions to these sites to recover what treasures and knowledge remained there . The prince was convinced that the arcane power hidden in the ruins of Netheril held the key to that plan ' s success . Interaction . When dealing with others , Prince Brennus was very gentlemanly and formal . Lore .

title: Bresnos Huantilar
description: Bresnos Huantilar Bresnos Huantilar was a human male from Sembia and a member of the Saerloon chapter of the Cult of the Dragon . Description . Standing 5 ' 3 " ( 1 .
description_long: Bresnos Huantilar Bresnos Huantilar was a human male from Sembia and a member of the Saerloon chapter of the Cult of the Dragon . Description . Standing 5 ' 3 " ( 1 . 5 meters ) , Bresnos was not a tall man but was rather agile and patient instead . Personality . A devoted member of the Cult of the Dragon , Bresnos was more than willing to lay down his life to preserve the secrets of the Cult ' s activities . Abilities . Skilled in the the use of either short sword or dagger , Bresnos could bring his weapons to bear with lightning quick reactions . Having trained himself to fight even without a light source he preferred to fight his opponents in the dark . Possessions . Bresnos utilized both poison and a magically sharp short sword to deadly effect . If needed , Bresnos could disappear from view entirely by using dust of disappearance . History . In mid - 1372 DR , members of the Saerloon chapter of the Cult of the Dragon found a portal in a wine shop that they had been using as front for their activities . They also found a set of gold plates explaining how the portal operated and began exploring the portal nexus that it lead to .

title: Brian
description: Brian Brian , known as Brian the Swordmaster , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Brian was bald with a black beard and a permanent scowl .
description_long: Brian Brian , known as Brian the Swordmaster , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Brian was bald with a black beard and a permanent scowl . His eyes were gray . As a swordsmith and armorer , he had a strong physique . Personality . Brian liked to look at things directly and in a straightforward manner . Activities . Brian owned a smith and shop in the South Ward . His home was located above the shop . He worked among the common folk of Waterdeep . History . In 1373 DR , Brian insulted the shade Prince Aglarel of Thultanthar , resulting in the city ' s offer of a formal alliance being withdrawn . This event also caused Thultanthar to rescind any promise of further aid to Waterdeep . Relationships . Brian was one of the " Like - Minded Lords " in 1364 DR ( Mirt , Khelben , Durnan , Kitten , and Larissa ) , who frequently met up to enjoy each other ' s company . )

title: Brian Fargo
description: Brian Fargo Brian Fargo is a computer game producer and designer who founded both and . Career . Fargo began work in the video game industry in 1982 .
description_long: Brian Fargo Brian Fargo is a computer game producer and designer who founded both and . Career . Fargo began work in the video game industry in 1982 . Only a year later , he founded Interplay Entertainment . He was the executive producer of the Forgotten Realms - based Interplay game " Blood & Magic " , which was released in 1996 . He remained with the company until his resignation in 2000 . Two years later , he founded inXile Entertainment with many former Interplay employees .

title: Brian R . James
description: Brian R . James Brian R . James is a senior software developer by day .
description_long: Brian R . James Brian R . James is a senior software developer by day . In the evenings , he is an active member of the Forgotten Realms online community and an eager student of Realmslore . Brian lives in Washington State with his high school sweetheart Toni and their four children . Brian got his first big break with the creation of his " Grand History of the Realms " timeline compilation that started in the late 90s . Utilizing his website at the time , he created vast tomes of knowledge in the form of PDFs that allowed fans to reference each of his entries . This eventually caught the eye of senior Wizards of the Coast developers and was adapted to a print form : " The Grand History of the Realms " . Since then , Brian has gone on to co - author ( and contribute ) to many 4th Edition products and releases . He continues to contribute to Dragon Magazine as well as Dungeon Magazine ; providing exclusive Forgotten Realms content for 4th Edition D & D . Recently Brian and his younger brother Matt James have teamed up to produce additional content for the Forgotten Realms as well as D & D as a whole . They can be found at http : / / www . loremaster .

title: Brian Thomsen
description: Brian Thomsen Brian Michael Thomsen was a writer and editor who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Thomsen worked as the managing editor for fiction for TSR .
description_long: Brian Thomsen Brian Michael Thomsen was a writer and editor who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Thomsen worked as the managing editor for fiction for TSR . He also authored two Forgotten Realms novels , " Once Around the Realms " and " The Mage in the Iron Mask " , both of which involved the character Volothamp Geddarm .

title: Brianna Burdun
description: Brianna Burdun Brianna Burdun was a priestess of the giant goddess Hiatea and the queen of Hartsvale in 1366 DR . Description . Because of the giant - blood running in her veins , Brianna was nearly seven feet tall , with a body a rugged as most human males without sacrificing her femininity .
description_long: Brianna Burdun Brianna Burdun was a priestess of the giant goddess Hiatea and the queen of Hartsvale in 1366 DR . Description . Because of the giant - blood running in her veins , Brianna was nearly seven feet tall , with a body a rugged as most human males without sacrificing her femininity . Her face was striking , with clear skin , and she had long blonde hair . Personality . Brianna was a strong - minded and confident individual to the point of stubbornness about what she believed was right ; however , if someone showed an incontrovertible proof of her bad judgment , Brianna quickly admitted her mistake and apologized . She otherwise was easy to get along with . Brianna was intelligent and was very responsible about the rule of her kingdom . As follower of Hiatea , she was very serious about matters of childbirth and motherhood . She spent her time in that role counseling the people of her kingdom in matters of family affairs . Abilities . Brianna could fight with battleaxe , longsword , or spear . She could hold her own as a fighter , although , as queen , she usually had an escort and supported them in any combat with her clerical spells . Possessions .

title: Brianne Byndraeth
description: Brianne Byndraeth Brianne Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and the widow of fellow Lord and crime lord Carril Byndraeth . Brianne ' s marriage to a fellow Lord caused many troubles . The rift that was opened between the two just before Carril ' s death nearly caused the split of the Lords into two factions .
description_long: Brianne Byndraeth Brianne Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and the widow of fellow Lord and crime lord Carril Byndraeth . Brianne ' s marriage to a fellow Lord caused many troubles . The rift that was opened between the two just before Carril ' s death nearly caused the split of the Lords into two factions . After her husband ' s assassination by a black dragon , Brianne played the role of a respectable Waterdhavian widow for a long time , courted by many men wanting to marry for her wealth . She used this position to spy upon them on the orders of the Lords . In 1374 DR , she became engaged to the socialite wizard Randulaith of Mirabar . Residence . Brianne had a tower within the city proper but also lived in Carril ' s old estate outside of the city .

title: Briarbones
description: Briarbones Briarbones is an Avolakia wizard who lives in the Waterdeep sewers beneath Seawind Alley where he studies the phenomenom of the ghostly whispering voices . His lair is guarded by zombies he created . Briarbones was a tutor to the elven warlock Quessahn Uthraebor and she came to him for advice on stopping the First Flensing .
description_long: Briarbones Briarbones is an Avolakia wizard who lives in the Waterdeep sewers beneath Seawind Alley where he studies the phenomenom of the ghostly whispering voices . His lair is guarded by zombies he created . Briarbones was a tutor to the elven warlock Quessahn Uthraebor and she came to him for advice on stopping the First Flensing . Appearance . Briarbones usually polymorphs into human form when dealing with the inhabitants of Waterdeep . In this form he appears as a dotting old man . In his natural form he looks like a hideous cross between an octopus , worm and insect .

title: Briarsting
description: Briarsting Briarsting was a thorn who was tasked with guarding the tomb of a long dead druid in Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . Relationships . The thorn was friends with and often rode a semi - sentient Topiary dragon with whom he guarded the druid ' s tomb .
description_long: Briarsting Briarsting was a thorn who was tasked with guarding the tomb of a long dead druid in Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . Relationships . The thorn was friends with and often rode a semi - sentient Topiary dragon with whom he guarded the druid ' s tomb . History . Around 1467 - 1479 DR , Briarsting helped Sophraea Carver undo the curse that Dorgar Adarbrent placed on tombs in the graveyard .

title: Brickers
description: Brickers Brickers was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . History . For a long time , Brickers was a friend and admirer of Belwar Dissengulp .
description_long: Brickers Brickers was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . History . For a long time , Brickers was a friend and admirer of Belwar Dissengulp . Once , circa 1338 DR , he served in a mining expedition with Belwar and Belwar ' s new friend , the drow Drizzt Do ' Urden . His meeting with Drizzt changed Brickers ' mind about outsiders . From that time on , he helped to improve relations with surface dwellers , even inviting some visiting shield dwarves to join mining expeditions . Brickers was one of the most senior burrow wardens active in 1370 DR . Personality . At first , Brickers was very close - minded , always suspecting the worst of outsiders . After he met Drizzt , he become more open .

title: Bridge of the Ancients
description: Bridge of the Ancients The Bridge of the Ancients was a stone bridge over the Pasocada River in Maztica . It stood near the ruins of Esh Alakar in the Long Canyon . It offered a useful crossing point over the Pasocada River .
description_long: Bridge of the Ancients The Bridge of the Ancients was a stone bridge over the Pasocada River in Maztica . It stood near the ruins of Esh Alakar in the Long Canyon . It offered a useful crossing point over the Pasocada River . There were no other safe crossing points for miles in either direction .

title: Bridget
description: Bridget Bridget was a Ffolk human woman and a princess of Callidyrr on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , Princess Bridget of Callidyrr was to marry the Northlander prince Scothgar of Rogarsheim , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them .
description_long: Bridget Bridget was a Ffolk human woman and a princess of Callidyrr on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , Princess Bridget of Callidyrr was to marry the Northlander prince Scothgar of Rogarsheim , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them . That same year , Moonshaes Ffolk arrived on the shores of the Utter East , where they chose to settle .

title: Bright Banner Brandished
description: Bright Banner Brandished The Bright Banner Brandished was an adventuring company in Neverwinter . In 1261 DR , the wizard Ashemmi joined , having left her home in the Neverwinter Woods . In 1266 DR , the company were trapped in subterranean crypts north of Mirabar by the lich Orvanath .
description_long: Bright Banner Brandished The Bright Banner Brandished was an adventuring company in Neverwinter . In 1261 DR , the wizard Ashemmi joined , having left her home in the Neverwinter Woods . In 1266 DR , the company were trapped in subterranean crypts north of Mirabar by the lich Orvanath . The entire company died , except Ashemmi , who used a " teleport " scroll to escape .

title: Bright Beacon Springs
description: Bright Beacon Springs Bright Beacon Springs was a popular stopping point for both the nomads of the Endless Wastes and caravans traveling along the Spice Road . Geography . The city was located near the Kora Shan mountain range , not too far off the path of the Golden Way trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur .
description_long: Bright Beacon Springs Bright Beacon Springs was a popular stopping point for both the nomads of the Endless Wastes and caravans traveling along the Spice Road . Geography . The city was located near the Kora Shan mountain range , not too far off the path of the Golden Way trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . It was named after its various ponds , which were said to shine brightly on summer days . It was claimed that this water was good for people suffering from rheumatism and arthritis . Population . Bright Beacon Spring was home to around 500 people , mostly human , but included half - elves , korobokuru , dwarves , and even spirit folk from Shou Lung , giving the town a reputation for being a melting pot of races and cultures . The population also ran a large number of services including a smith , a wine merchant , an armorer , a cartwright , caravansaries , a horse market , several temples , a number of general merchants , and guides for the local area . The town also hosted a biannual fair , attracting people from great distances , and offered entertainment such as wrestling , horse races , and archery contests . Structure .

title: Bright Blade Brandished
description: Bright Blade Brandished The Bright Blade Brandished was a favorite tavern of adventurers in Silverymoon . Geography . The building was located in Northbank , on Sunset Lane in the westernmost angle of the Wallrun in the " Gem of the North " .
description_long: Bright Blade Brandished The Bright Blade Brandished was a favorite tavern of adventurers in Silverymoon . Geography . The building was located in Northbank , on Sunset Lane in the westernmost angle of the Wallrun in the " Gem of the North " . Structure . The alehouse consisted of two floors with curtained alcoves and booths of rustic charm . Atmosphere . The establishment was exceptionally luxurious and everyone was welcome there , no matter how strange or dangerous they were . Staff . The service was attentive and accommodating , the barmaids were often seen taking care of disputes , and even guided drunks home . The staff was aided by wizard s earning 1 sp per " Mage hand " spell to deliver drinks quickly from customer to customer .

title: Brightaxe Hall
description: Brightaxe Hall Brightaxe Hall was created from the lair of the four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat at end the Cloaker Wars . It formed the royal chamber for Alatorin and was the site of the Wyrmskull Throne from its creation around - 12 , 000 DR to its removal by the dwarves during the Third Spider War around - 6150 DR .
description_long: Brightaxe Hall Brightaxe Hall was created from the lair of the four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat at end the Cloaker Wars . It formed the royal chamber for Alatorin and was the site of the Wyrmskull Throne from its creation around - 12 , 000 DR to its removal by the dwarves during the Third Spider War around - 6150 DR .

title: Brightleaf
description: Brightleaf Brightleaf was a treant in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Brightleaf regularly reported forest news to Serinia of Elventree .
description_long: Brightleaf Brightleaf was a treant in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Brightleaf regularly reported forest news to Serinia of Elventree . History . During the Rage of Demons , he succumbed to the madness of the demon lord Graz ' zt until some adventurers ( members of the Emerald Enclave hired by Elanil Elassidil to bring peace to the spirit of her ancestor Meira Faerenduil ) confronted him . Personality . In his madness , Brightleaf considered himself a god . He was wary of strangers but not hostile at first . He spoke metaphorically and painfully slowly in a rich bass tone , but almost never reached a point . Relationship . Brightleaf was an ally of the Emerald Enclave and had dealings with Serinia .

title: Brightstar Risingsun
description: Brightstar Risingsun Brightstar Risingsun was a foreigner living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Brightstar was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith .
description_long: Brightstar Risingsun Brightstar Risingsun was a foreigner living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Brightstar was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith . He became Tralia ' s consort after the death or disappearance of her previous consort , Skield

title: Brightwater
description: Brightwater Brightwater was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the goddesses Lliira , Sharess , Sune , Tymora , and Waukeen until the Spellplague upset the cosmos . At least a portion of Brightwater survived the Spellplague and became Sune ' s realm in the Gates of the Moon .
description_long: Brightwater Brightwater was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the goddesses Lliira , Sharess , Sune , Tymora , and Waukeen until the Spellplague upset the cosmos . At least a portion of Brightwater survived the Spellplague and became Sune ' s realm in the Gates of the Moon . Description . As a Celestial plane , Brightwater was connected to the trunk of the sentient World Tree which sometimes allowed beings with good and noble purpose to pass unimpeded . Most travelers had to navigate the Astral plane using an " astral projection " or " plane shift " spell to visit this paradise . Some of the deities maintained permanent " portals " to allied realms . Sune and Hanali Celanil from Arvandor shared a portal and Tymora was known to keep a portal open to Green Fields . Sharess , who was known to the Mulhorand i as Bast , had a portal to her realm in Heliopolis . Brightwater had all the natural beauty of Arvandor but was less wild and more gentrified , with stately mansions , summer homes , winter retreats , beach cabins , cottages in the woods , and happy houses great and small .

title: Brightwing
description: Brightwing Brightwing was a female griffon , linked to the warmage Aoth Fezim . Description . Brightwing is 9 feet ( 2 .
description_long: Brightwing Brightwing was a female griffon , linked to the warmage Aoth Fezim . Description . Brightwing is 9 feet ( 2 . 7 meters ) long . Like all griffons , she had a lion ' s body and the wings , forelegs , and head of an eagle . She had scarlet eyes . She was named Brightwing because even as a cub her feathers had been a lighter shade of gold than normal . Though her beak and throat were not made for articulating human speech , she could communicate with Aoth , who understood her clacks and squawks . Aoth magically enhanced her stamina and intelligence , making her a formidable foe . Brightwing loved horseflesh for feed . History . Brightwing almost died in 1384 DR during the war of Thay , impaled by the sword of one of Szass Tam ' s undead champions .

title: Brigit
description: Brigit Brigit was the captain of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . Brigit ' s face was exceptionally slender and fine - boned , accented by a pair of huge , luminous brown eyes .
description_long: Brigit Brigit was the captain of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . Brigit ' s face was exceptionally slender and fine - boned , accented by a pair of huge , luminous brown eyes . She had golden hair . Relationships . As captain of the Sisters of Synnoria , she commanded , among other Llewyrr , Maura , Carina and Aileen . History . As part of the tradition in which the Sisters of Synnoria became pledged for a year ' s service to a person of royal birth who rode Avalon , Brigit put her group at the orders of Tristan Kendrick with whom she fought in the battle of Corwell Road and the defense of Caer Corwell .

title: Briglynn
description: Briglynn Briglynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Briglynn was born with Anithlynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .
description_long: Briglynn Briglynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Briglynn was born with Anithlynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth . The triplets were taught from birth the mysteries of mystics . By their thirteenth birthday , Celya had died . Personality . Briglynn was the most passionate of the triplets and the most self - centered . She was a quiet free spirit . She sometimes doubted her vocation and her bond with her sisters , but still loved them . Activities . Briglynn managed with her sisters the Sisters Three Waxworks . She was however often busy with personal projects .

title: Briiathor Alougarr
description: Briiathor Alougarr Briiathor Alougarr was the Lord Warder of Amphail and an unofficial member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard , though he was officially retired from that post . Personality . Briiathor was completely loyal to Piergeiron the Paladinson .
description_long: Briiathor Alougarr Briiathor Alougarr was the Lord Warder of Amphail and an unofficial member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard , though he was officially retired from that post . Personality . Briiathor was completely loyal to Piergeiron the Paladinson . A man who disliked ceremony , Briiathor spoke quietly yet kept an eye on everything and regularly patrolled Amphail on foot at all hours of the day . Description . Briiathor had grey eyes and a closely trimmed beard . History . Briiathor was an old battle - companion of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . He knew Arunsun when they adventured in the Wheel of Blades adventuring company .

title: Brimskarda
description: Brimskarda Brimskarda was a fire giant and the nagging wife of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Brimskarda was in the kitchen supervising a personnel composed of five smoke mephit s , two ogre s and twenty goblin s .
description_long: Brimskarda Brimskarda was a fire giant and the nagging wife of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Brimskarda was in the kitchen supervising a personnel composed of five smoke mephit s , two ogre s and twenty goblin s .

title: Brindani
description: Brindani Brindani was a half - elf fighter and former mercenary . History . Brin fought alongside Uthalion in Caidris when the village was attacked by the Abolethic Sovereignty .
description_long: Brindani Brindani was a half - elf fighter and former mercenary . History . Brin fought alongside Uthalion in Caidris when the village was attacked by the Abolethic Sovereignty . He was addicted to silkroot , which was slowly killing him . In 1479 DR , he was hired by Ghaelya to journey to Tohrepur in the Mere - That - Was region of Akanûl on a mission to rescue Ghaelya ' s twin sister from a cult known as The Choir . Brindani sought the help of his old friend Uthalion , who was living in the Spur Forest . Together , they travelled with Ghaelya through the Mere - That - Was . While passing through the village of Caidris , Brindani was briefly captured by a member of The Choir , who corrupted him so that he slowly turned into an aberration . When the group reached Tohrepur , they confronted Lord Khault , the leader of The Choir . Brindani killed Khault but died from injuries he received during the fight .

title: Brindell
description: Brindell Brindell was a halfling priestess of Eilistraee . Brindell was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History .
description_long: Brindell Brindell was a halfling priestess of Eilistraee . Brindell was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1377 DR , she was one of the six protectors chosen for an assault led by Cavatina Xarann on the main temple of Kiaransalee . However , after the death of Halav to a tentacle that suddenly emerged from a pool , Brindell was also attacked . At last , the Protectors managed to destroy the enemy and save Brindell . Brindell was later killed near the Acropolis of Thanatos during fighting with the Crones of Kiaransalee when one of them attacked her from behind . Resurrected in 1379 DR , Qilué Veladorn asked Brindell where Battlemistress Rylla was .

title: Brindlor Zidorion
description: Brindlor Zidorion Brindlor Zidorion was a deathsinger from Ched Nasad . Description . Brindlor wore fine clothes and gems .
description_long: Brindlor Zidorion Brindlor Zidorion was a deathsinger from Ched Nasad . Description . Brindlor wore fine clothes and gems . He had long hair , which he wore in many braids . In 1361 DR , the priestess Shakti Hunzrin placed the Ruby of Chissentra , a scrying gem , in his forehead and it appeared almost like a third eye . Abilities . As a deathsinger , Brindlor was able to control the dead through his song , which sounded as a keening wail with the harsh , irregular rhythm of drow chant . History . In 1361 DR , Brindlor was hired by Gorlist to help with and record the pursuit of Liriel Baenre in revenge for her killing of Nisstyre , Gorlist ' s father . He was killed in Gorlist ' s assault upon Liriel in Rashemen .

title: Brindol
