description: Brindol Brindol the Burned was a firesoul genasi and the leader of the genasi faction that lived in the Dominion of the Burned in Glaur as of 1479 DR . Description . Brindol was a fiery genasi armored in a carapace of burn - blackened iron , that had trophies of Brindol ' s past victories bolted across all the armor .
description_long: Brindol Brindol the Burned was a firesoul genasi and the leader of the genasi faction that lived in the Dominion of the Burned in Glaur as of 1479 DR . Description . Brindol was a fiery genasi armored in a carapace of burn - blackened iron , that had trophies of Brindol ' s past victories bolted across all the armor . Red tattoo - like designs curled across the rest of his body . Equipment . Brindol wielded a mighty warhammer that sometimes lighted with Brindol ' s own fire . Brindol also had two loyal " hounds " , half - tamed anaxim s he had subdued and trained to answer to him and him alone . Activities . As the leader of the Burned , Brindol was the owner of the key of the Birthing Furnace , a relic crafted by the primordial Nehushta , and thus he was responsible for the survival of the Burned genasi community as a whole . Brindol was also in charge of dispensing justice when necessary . Brindol was reputed to be even crueler with those genasi that had displeased him than former Burned leaders . History . In 1469 DR , Brindol became the leader of the few Burned who survived an anaxim invasion .

title: Brindor Olóssyne
description: Brindor Olóssyne King Brindor Olósynne ( born 998 DR , died 1128 DR ) was a half - elf and the king of Aglarond between 1065 DR and 1128 DR as the beginning of the Olósynne Dynasty . History . Brindor defeated the human army of Velprin in the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR , creating Aglarond and becoming its first ruler .
description_long: Brindor Olóssyne King Brindor Olósynne ( born 998 DR , died 1128 DR ) was a half - elf and the king of Aglarond between 1065 DR and 1128 DR as the beginning of the Olósynne Dynasty . History . Brindor defeated the human army of Velprin in the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR , creating Aglarond and becoming its first ruler . Brindor raised an army for Aglarond , and constructed the Emmech fortress ( later renamed Undumor ) , the citadel Glarondar , and the Watchwall . Brindor also commissioned the original palace on the site where the Palace of the Simbul stood , but this original wooden structure was burned down during a red dragon attack . Relatives . Brindor ' s son and sole heir was Althon ( later Althon " the Old " ) . He had blood ties with Aubayreer of Milvarn .

title: Brinna Alcott
description: Brinna Alcott Brinna Alcott was a merchant living in Bryn Shander in 1485 DR . History . Brinna was a merchant living in the Ten Towns , but in 1484 DR she became one of the cultists of Auril led by Davrick Fain .
description_long: Brinna Alcott Brinna Alcott was a merchant living in Bryn Shander in 1485 DR . History . Brinna was a merchant living in the Ten Towns , but in 1484 DR she became one of the cultists of Auril led by Davrick Fain . Under Fain ' s instruction , she accused Hengar Aesnvaard of robbery .

title: Briost Elthauryn
description: Briost Elthauryn Briost Elthauryn was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar . History . Briost was one of the most talented members of the magelords .
description_long: Briost Elthauryn Briost Elthauryn was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar . History . Briost was one of the most talented members of the magelords . He often acted as an envoy of the magelords in Athalantar and the lands around . He was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection .

title: Brister Fendlestick
description: Brister Fendlestick Brister Fendlestick was a human wizard who traveled the Underdark in his magical iron tower , which he carried with him wherever he traveled . Fendlestick polymorph ed a pech into the hook horror known as " Clacker . " Clacker was then returned to Brister by Drizzt Do ' Urden and Belwar Dissengulp in order to reverse the spell , but before the transformation could be completed , Clacker lashed out and killed Fendlestick .
description_long: Brister Fendlestick Brister Fendlestick was a human wizard who traveled the Underdark in his magical iron tower , which he carried with him wherever he traveled . Fendlestick polymorph ed a pech into the hook horror known as " Clacker . " Clacker was then returned to Brister by Drizzt Do ' Urden and Belwar Dissengulp in order to reverse the spell , but before the transformation could be completed , Clacker lashed out and killed Fendlestick . The cave where Fendlestick was killed had a fast - moving stream and was known as " Fendlestick ' s Folly " .

title: Briza Do ' Urden
description: Briza Do ' Urden Briza Do ' Urden was the eldest and most powerful of the daughters of Matron Mother Malice Do ' Urden of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Briza was large by drow standards and had a round figure .
description_long: Briza Do ' Urden Briza Do ' Urden was the eldest and most powerful of the daughters of Matron Mother Malice Do ' Urden of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Briza was large by drow standards and had a round figure . Personality . Briza had a cruel and hot temperament ; she was always quick to punish with her whip . She was ambitious and had a great devotion to Lolth . History . Briza was born to Malice Do ' Urden when Malice was 100 years old . She had two younger sisters , Vierna Do ' Urden , who outlived her , and Maya Do ' Urden , who did not . Briza became a high priestess of Lolth shortly before House Do ' Urden ' s attack on House DeVir in 1297 DR . When Briza found her rogue brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , deep in the Underdark , he cut off some of her fingers . The only reason she did not die was because Drizzt ' s panther Guenhwyvar leapt on him at the last moment , reminding him of his vow made after killing Masoj Hun ' ett and Alton DeVir not to kill another drow again . In 1339 DR , Briza killed her mother after she failed to kill Drizzt with Zin - carla . However , at that precise moment , House Baenre began attacking House Do ' Urden .

title: Broadsheet
description: Broadsheet A broadsheet , also known as a short scroll , was a short , printed document which usually contained tabloid - style news or political rants . They were common in Waterdeep . " The Vigilant Citizen " , " The Blue Unicorn " , " Daily Luck " and " Northwind " were popular Waterdavian broadsheets .
description_long: Broadsheet A broadsheet , also known as a short scroll , was a short , printed document which usually contained tabloid - style news or political rants . They were common in Waterdeep . " The Vigilant Citizen " , " The Blue Unicorn " , " Daily Luck " and " Northwind " were popular Waterdavian broadsheets .

title: Broadshield
description: Broadshield Broadshield was a outlaw in Cormyr . Activities . He led the notorious outlaw group known as Broadshield ' s Beasts , a gang notorious for kidnapping nobles .
description_long: Broadshield Broadshield was a outlaw in Cormyr . Activities . He led the notorious outlaw group known as Broadshield ' s Beasts , a gang notorious for kidnapping nobles . History . In 1480 DR , Broadshield was instructed by Manshoon to capture Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave and deliver them to Alorglauvenemaus but the two managed to escape from the ambush and arrive at Castle Irlingstar .

title: Broadsword
description: Broadsword Broadsword is the name given to a style of sword that has extra protection around the hilt . For game purposes , treat it the same as a longsword . Description .
description_long: Broadsword Broadsword is the name given to a style of sword that has extra protection around the hilt . For game purposes , treat it the same as a longsword . Description . A broadsword is roughly the same size as a longsword but with a hilt much like a rapier . The term " broad " was added to distinguish this sword from the thin - bladed rapier . Broadswords are also called basket - hilted swords because of the protective cage or basket surrounding the hilt . Early broadswords had just a simple wire guard which became increasingly ornate and covered more of the hand as this weapon evolved . Most broadswords are double - edged but there is a single - edged version called the " backsword " . Use . Because of the guard around the hilt , broadswords are one - handed weapons . They require training to wield effectively and are therefore classified as martial weapons . They are used as longsword s in all respects . Other views . The Adventurer ' s Vault source book apparently mentions broadswords . Here is the original entry for this article : Broadswords are not listed in 2nd Edition or 3 .

title: Broken Bone
description: Broken Bone The Broken Bone was a horde of orc s formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1024 DR , the Broken Bone tribe attacked Waterdeep after the crypt of their leader , Uruth Ukrypt , was plundered by the human adventuring company , the Dawnbringer Company .
description_long: Broken Bone The Broken Bone was a horde of orc s formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1024 DR , the Broken Bone tribe attacked Waterdeep after the crypt of their leader , Uruth Ukrypt , was plundered by the human adventuring company , the Dawnbringer Company . They aimed to destroy Waterdeep , but they were defeated by the dragon , Lhammaruntosz .

title: Broken Dagger
description: Broken Dagger The Broken Dagger was a stinking watering hole in the southern part of Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Structure . The main building of the Dagger was a burnt - out shell .
description_long: Broken Dagger The Broken Dagger was a stinking watering hole in the southern part of Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Structure . The main building of the Dagger was a burnt - out shell . To enter the tavern , customers passed under a sign painted with two broken halves of a weapon and descended old cellar stairs into a dirt covered room , lit by lanterns , and a row of beer kegs acting as the bar . There was a wide , sloped , comfortable leaning rail all around the walls to keep the filthy inhabitants from dirtying the painting of naked men and women wrestling , which circled the three of the walls of the taproom . Another set of stairs exited out behind the bar for breaking up fights or escorting drunks out into the street . History . In 1336 DR , the Zhentarim took control of Daggerdale and Dagger Falls fell under Zhent rule . Around 1367 DR , the tavern was frequented by Black Network soldiers and their orc allies . Around this time , a retired Zhentish fighter , Tharwin One - eye , owned the taphouse and turned it into a wild and dangerous bar .

title: Broken Ones
description: Broken Ones The Broken Ones were a monastic order devoted to the god Ilmater . Organization . The Broken Ones numbered both monk s and swordsage s among their ranks .
description_long: Broken Ones The Broken Ones were a monastic order devoted to the god Ilmater . Organization . The Broken Ones numbered both monk s and swordsage s among their ranks . The order had no temple or monastery to call a base , and nor did they have a fixed hierarchy . Attitudes . The Broken One monks were kind and enduring , and they acted purely in the name of Ilmater . Swordsages of the order were ascetics who remained detached from the world and lacked zeal . Activities . Members of the order were responsible for the defense of Ilmater ' s temples and shrines , as well as his followers . They also sought to track down and punish those who inflicted cruelty , especially followers of Loviatar . They performed good deeds and righted bad ones . The Broken Ones regularly traveled as pilgrims through the Dalelands , stopping at temples of Ilmater if no other lodging was available . They often visited the many shrines in the region . Abilities . A Broken One monk pursued the paths of a healer and a hunter in service to the faith .

title: Broken Pike
description: Broken Pike The Broken Pike was a tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain . It was owned and run by Marks in 1370 DR . A one - story tavern of shabby quality yet average prices , the Broken Pike ' s patron were a motley crew of fences , pirates , and smugglers .
description_long: Broken Pike The Broken Pike was a tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain . It was owned and run by Marks in 1370 DR . A one - story tavern of shabby quality yet average prices , the Broken Pike ' s patron were a motley crew of fences , pirates , and smugglers . They were a tight - knit bunch who saw all strangers as targets and prey . One had to stay alert and ready for tricks or violence . Some regulars used the Broken Pike as a venue to plan their crimes , from theft to murder to worse deeds . It was also a meeting place for the Unseen , so some regular patrons were doppelganger s . The duergar fence Thurn Blackskull could be found here many afternoons . Appendix . Notes . This is misspelled as " Broken Pipe " when briefly mentioned on page 100 of " Cloak & Dagger " .

title: Bromdurr Tathen
description: Bromdurr Tathen Bromdurr Tathen was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Activities . Bromdurr was a leading member ( Boar ' s Head ) of the Order of the Blue Boar .
description_long: Bromdurr Tathen Bromdurr Tathen was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Activities . Bromdurr was a leading member ( Boar ' s Head ) of the Order of the Blue Boar . He was an expert of naval operations . He had a ship and , if needed , happily sailed for battle . History . Bromdurr saved his hometown of Memnon in Calimshan from a pirate attack , gaining some fame . Later , he helped built the navy of Calimsham .

title: Bromm
description: Bromm Bromm was , together with his twin Harnoth , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was the son of the famous Harbromm . History .
description_long: Bromm Bromm was , together with his twin Harnoth , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was the son of the famous Harbromm . History . During the orc and drow invasion of the Silver Marches , Bromm and his brother were tricked by the half - drow Doum ' wielle Armgo when she posed as an envoy of the Moonwood . Bromm and a dwarf army were led to an ambush where all the dwarves were killed and Tiago Baenre slew Bromm .

title: Bronn Selgard
description: Bronn Selgard Bronn Selgard is a blacksmith in Shadowdale . Bronn is known for his great strength . Family .
description_long: Bronn Selgard Bronn Selgard is a blacksmith in Shadowdale . Bronn is known for his great strength . Family . Bronn ' s wife is name Leath . Together they have produced a very large family many of which have been trained in smithy . Death . Bronn was killed during the Zhentarim invasion of Shadowdale by the Army of Darkhope in Nightal 1374 DR .

title: Bronsheir ' s Charge
description: Bronsheir ' s Charge The Bronsheir ' s Charge was a battle fought between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater in the Year of the Groaning Hart , 1267 DR . Events . Holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith .
description_long: Bronsheir ' s Charge The Bronsheir ' s Charge was a battle fought between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater in the Year of the Groaning Hart , 1267 DR . Events . Holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith . On one side were the Mussum priests and the Companions of the Noble Heart paladin order , and on the other were Waelarn , his followers , the Holy Warriors of Suffering , and the Knights of the Bleeding Shield . Bronsheir ' s Charge was a bloody battle .

title: Bronwyn Caradoon
description: Bronwyn Caradoon Bronwyn Caradoon was a proprietor of an antiquities shop called the Curious Past , a part - time adventurer , and a member of the Harpers . Activities . Bronwyn was always one to share her knowledge of ancient texts and lore while making sure to pick up little gems of information — typically regarding lost or stolen items — in the process .
description_long: Bronwyn Caradoon Bronwyn Caradoon was a proprietor of an antiquities shop called the Curious Past , a part - time adventurer , and a member of the Harpers . Activities . Bronwyn was always one to share her knowledge of ancient texts and lore while making sure to pick up little gems of information — typically regarding lost or stolen items — in the process . Relationships . A friend of Ebeneezer Stoneshaft , Bronwyn was allied with the shield dwarves of Clan Stoneshaft . On the other hand , she was not on good terms with the Knights of Samular , Algorind of Tyr , or Sir Gareth Cormaeril . Bronwyn raised a girl named Cara , who was the daughter of Bronwyn ' s estranged brother Dag Zoreth . Possessions . As a descendant of Samular , Bronwyn had in her possession one of the three " rings of Samular " . History . While growing up in Amn , Bronwyn was captured by the Zhentarim and became quite the skilled counterfeiter of jewelry and coins . After purchasing her freedom , Bronwyn started dealing in antiquities and was eventually recruited by the Harpers .

title: Bronwyn Daggerford
description: Bronwyn Daggerford Bronwyn Daggerford was a wizard in Daggerford . History . Bronwyn was the sister of Pwyll Greatshout .
description_long: Bronwyn Daggerford Bronwyn Daggerford was a wizard in Daggerford . History . Bronwyn was the sister of Pwyll Greatshout . When she learned that Pwyll had been designated as heir of Daggerford ' s duchy by their father Pryden Daggerford , Bronwyn decided to learn the magical arts under the court magician Gwydion pen Dafwyd . Around 1362 DR , Bronwyn went to adventure for almost two years with the adventuring party the Iron Edge . When she came back , she was considerably more experienced as wizard and more wealthy . In 1370 DR , Bronwyn managed the magical duties of the court and trained militiamen in magic .

title: Bronze
description: Bronze Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin . Uses . " Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts " could manifest an urn of bronze that was capable of transporting users to Khalas on the plane of Gehenna .
description_long: Bronze Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin . Uses . " Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts " could manifest an urn of bronze that was capable of transporting users to Khalas on the plane of Gehenna . Bronze plate mail armour was the best known practical use of bronze by adventurers . Copper used for coinage and trade bars was typically a 94 – 96 % copper 4 – 6 % tin bronze alloy . Most adventuring equipment , including weapons and armour , could be made out of bronze .

title: Bronze Falcon
description: Bronze Falcon The Bronze Falcon was a province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bronze Falcon was the southern most province of the empire , covering the southern tip of the World Pillar Mountains where they bordered the Jungle of Monsters in northeast Zakhara .
description_long: Bronze Falcon The Bronze Falcon was a province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bronze Falcon was the southern most province of the empire , covering the southern tip of the World Pillar Mountains where they bordered the Jungle of Monsters in northeast Zakhara . Inhabitants . The Mountain Prince ruled this province , usually at the head of his army . Activities . Given its location , the Bronze Falcon was well situated to combat any threat to the Empire from the great jungles or any lands from the east .

title: Bronze Phalanx
description: Bronze Phalanx The Bronze Phalanx , also called the Nutcrackers , was part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The 1 , 200 azer of the Bronze Phalanx were the siege engineers for the Sultan ' s army .
description_long: Bronze Phalanx The Bronze Phalanx , also called the Nutcrackers , was part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The 1 , 200 azer of the Bronze Phalanx were the siege engineers for the Sultan ' s army . Activities . The Sultan of the efreet usually deployed the Bronze Phalanx against the djinn or rebellious noble efreeti . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Bronze Phalanx .

title: Bronze dragon
description: Bronze dragon Bronze dragons were the third most powerful of the metallic dragon s . Physical description . Physically , the bronze dragon was quite fierce in appearance , despite its good nature .
description_long: Bronze dragon Bronze dragons were the third most powerful of the metallic dragon s . Physical description . Physically , the bronze dragon was quite fierce in appearance , despite its good nature . While most of its body was a reflective bronze color , the wings were often tipped with green . The dragon had three large horns protruding from each cheek , pointing back towards the tail . The tips of these points were black and very sharp , and were often used for grooming . The tongue was purple - gray , long and pointed , and not forked . A large frill ran down the upper part of its neck . They smell like sea - spray . These dragons possessed the ability to alter their form , assuming the appearance of any type of animal or humanoid creature they choose . As such , many could have encountered a bronze dragon without ever being the wiser . A friendly dolphin that saved a drowning child ; a mercenary sailor eager to fight pirates ; a diver specializing in searching undersea shipwrecks for possible treasure … all of these could have been a bronze dragon .

title: Bronzefume
description: Bronzefume Bronzefume was a weak dragon turtle in service to the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bronzefume agreed to help the Cult in exchange for riches .
description_long: Bronzefume Bronzefume was a weak dragon turtle in service to the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bronzefume agreed to help the Cult in exchange for riches . She was a young and impressionable creature . She preferred to destroy boats more than people . History . In 1491 DR , Gar Shatterkeel convinced Bronzefume to help him in exchange for treasures . She patrolled a part of the temple , waiting for her next meeting with the water prophet .

title: Brooch of lingering heat
description: Brooch of lingering heat The brooch of lingering heat was one of the artifacts reserved for the archmage of Menzoberranzan . It was in the possession of Gromph Baenre . It granted the wearer the ability to fill Narbondel with twenty - four hours of heat , allowing the city ' s inhabitants to tell time even in the Underdark .
description_long: Brooch of lingering heat The brooch of lingering heat was one of the artifacts reserved for the archmage of Menzoberranzan . It was in the possession of Gromph Baenre . It granted the wearer the ability to fill Narbondel with twenty - four hours of heat , allowing the city ' s inhabitants to tell time even in the Underdark .

title: Brooch of perpetual youth
description: Brooch of perpetual youth A brooch of perpetual youth was a talisman that when worn made the wearer appear young and have a youthful appearance , similar to a Phylactery of long years In human years one wearing the brooch might appear 28 years old . In other races the apparent age would be different . One well known wearer of such a brooch was Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Brooch of perpetual youth A brooch of perpetual youth was a talisman that when worn made the wearer appear young and have a youthful appearance , similar to a Phylactery of long years In human years one wearing the brooch might appear 28 years old . In other races the apparent age would be different . One well known wearer of such a brooch was Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan . The brooch was obviously magical , yet had mysterious properties . One such property was that the magic of the brooch could in no way be canceled or dispelled . Gromph had frequently erected anti - magic shell s around himself yet continued to remain young via the magic of the brooch . Also , the brooch had no effect on a child of any race if worn . The magic somehow attuned itself to whatever race wore it , and the magic would not take effect unless it sensed that the wearer was above a certain age . Obviously , much more study was required to understand the full characteristics of the brooch of perpetual youth .

title: Brooch of shielding
description: Brooch of shielding A brooch of shielding was a magical protective device . A full - capacity brooch had a base value of 1 , 500 gp . Appearance .
description_long: Brooch of shielding A brooch of shielding was a magical protective device . A full - capacity brooch had a base value of 1 , 500 gp . Appearance . A " brooch of shielding " was a small piece of jewelry used to fasten a cloak or cape . They were often made of silver or gold . Powers . A " brooch of shielding " could harmlessly absorb the force darts from a " magic missile " spell directed at the wearer . A single brooch could only absorb a set amount of energy before melting .

title: Broog - Norb
description: Broog - Norb Broog - Norb was an ettin found into the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Broog - Norb was a particularly large and grumpy ettin .
description_long: Broog - Norb Broog - Norb was an ettin found into the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Broog - Norb was a particularly large and grumpy ettin . Broog - Norb wasn ' t a follower of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Broog - Norb found a way to Tyar - Besil . He only had a temporary truce with the earth cultists , who were careful to stay out of his way . He usually resided in the abandoned kitchen until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated him .

title: Broryn Windstag
description: Broryn Windstag Broryn Windstag was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Windstag noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Broryn gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .
description_long: Broryn Windstag Broryn Windstag was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Windstag noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Broryn gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war . He hid the fugitive Marlin for a time in his house . Later he was found dead in his house with all his servants . Relationship . Broryn was part of the cabal that supported Marlin Stormserpent .

title: Brotha
description: Brotha Brotha was a small agricultural village found within the Barony of Ostel in Damara southwest of Heliogabalus . Activities . The farmland surrounding Brotha was quite productive , helping Ostel maintain their independence from the larger baronies of Damara .
description_long: Brotha Brotha was a small agricultural village found within the Barony of Ostel in Damara southwest of Heliogabalus . Activities . The farmland surrounding Brotha was quite productive , helping Ostel maintain their independence from the larger baronies of Damara . Most of the people of Brotha harbored harsh feelings toward Baroness Sylvia , the ruler of Ostel . They were close allies with the people of Brandiar , who also wished to dethrone their ruler ( also a close ally of Sylvia ) . Inhabitants . Tom Haystacks was the mayor of Brotha and her 400 inhabitants in 1357 DR . Rumors & Legends . It was rumored that Mayor Haystacks attempted to contact the Twilight Riders to secure their aid in overthrowing Baroness Sylvia .

title: Brotherhood of the Cloak
description: Brotherhood of the Cloak The Brotherhood of the Cloak was a group of all the non - novice wizard s and sorcerer s within the city of Mulmaster . Created for the near - singular purpose to control the power of magic within the city , all arcane spellcasters with any signifigant experience were required to join the Brotherhood under penalty of exile . Regardless of this consolidation of power , the Brotherhood was tasked with the protection of the High Blade ( currently Rassendyll Uoumdolphin ) .
description_long: Brotherhood of the Cloak The Brotherhood of the Cloak was a group of all the non - novice wizard s and sorcerer s within the city of Mulmaster . Created for the near - singular purpose to control the power of magic within the city , all arcane spellcasters with any signifigant experience were required to join the Brotherhood under penalty of exile . Regardless of this consolidation of power , the Brotherhood was tasked with the protection of the High Blade ( currently Rassendyll Uoumdolphin ) . Ranks . Along with the many regular members of the Brotherhood of the Cloak , there are 35 higher - up members referred to as the Senior Cloaks . Non - members . As only foreign visitors were allowed to cast spells within Mulmaster , some representatives living within the city , such as members of the Red Wizards of Thay or magic - wielding Zhents , are not required to join the cloaks .

title: Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun
description: Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun was a sect of the church of Lathander that believed he was the reincarnation of the supposedly dead deity Amaunator . History . The Brotherhood was a recognized cleric and knightly order within the Church of Lathander .
description_long: Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun was a sect of the church of Lathander that believed he was the reincarnation of the supposedly dead deity Amaunator . History . The Brotherhood was a recognized cleric and knightly order within the Church of Lathander . Generally the members of the brotherhood were led by Sunmaster s . Around 1373 DR , the Brotherhood was under the leadership of Daelegoth Orndeir . Location . The Brotherhood was entrusted with the keeping of chapterhouses or shrines dedicated to the sun aspect of Lathander and thus could found across Faerûn . The sect was headquartered in the Temple of the Morn in Elversult . Dogma . Through actions , a Sunmaster ' s task was to show how superior the faith of Lathander was over others . Bold action , and triumphic victories over chaos was what the Sunmaster s believed would show how their interpretation of the connection between Lathander and Amaunator was the correct path . Sunmasters believed the sun was the ultimate symbol of their faith , representing dependibility , lawfulness , knowing what is right and banishing darkness . Members . Daelegoth Orndeir Andar the Sunmaster

title: Brotherhood of the Griffon
description: Brotherhood of the Griffon The Brotherhood of the Griffon was a mercenary company led by Aoth Fezim . The organization took its name from its griffon riders . Although the Brotherhood was best known for its griffon riders , they had companies of archers and spearmen as well .
description_long: Brotherhood of the Griffon The Brotherhood of the Griffon was a mercenary company led by Aoth Fezim . The organization took its name from its griffon riders . Although the Brotherhood was best known for its griffon riders , they had companies of archers and spearmen as well . The Brotherhood was a continuation of Aoth ' s Thayan Griffon Legion and is currently employed by the ancient Red dragon Tchazzar . History . Thayan War . In the years after the spellplague , Aoth founded the Brotherhood in Aglarond . The Brotherhood worked for Aglarond but , when Aoth learned of Szass Tam ' s plan to conduct the Ritual of Unmaking , the Brotherhood broke their contract with Aglarond , even going so far as to fight their former employers . Aoth led the Brotherhood and the Zulkirs ' forces into Thay where they sucessfully disrupted Szass Tam ' s ritual , possibly saving Toril from destruction . Impiltur . After defeating Szass Tam , Aoth led the Brotherhood to Impiltur where they took a contract to eliminate a cult of demon worshipers . The Brotherhood was betrayed by a noble and were unable to save a village from destruction by the cult .

title: Brotherhood of the True Flame
description: Brotherhood of the True Flame The Brotherhood of the True Flame was a notorious sorcerous society in Zakhara . Members . Most members of this society were pure flame elementalists .
description_long: Brotherhood of the True Flame The Brotherhood of the True Flame was a notorious sorcerous society in Zakhara . Members . Most members of this society were pure flame elementalists . Non - wizards also served within the society , but held much lower ranks compared to their elementalist brethren . This society held the largest collection of wizards with the same goals and specializations within all of the Land of Fate . They had members hidden within every major city of Zakhara . Their strongest fortresses were rumored to be located somewhere deep within the Weeping Desert and the Great Anvil . Initiation . The only wizards allowed into the ranks of the Brotherhood of the True Flame were fire elemental mages . Members from the brotherhood attempted to slay flame sorcerers because they were not pure . The actual initiation process remained unknown , but was rumored to be gruesome as every last vestige of goodness in the initiate was " burned out " of their mind . Description . This was a large organization , a fact that benefited and hindered them . Small factions broke off on a semi - regular basis and charismatic leaders arose . Goals .

title: Brown Maeve
description: Brown Maeve Brown Maeve was the Royal Magister of Ankhapur and the former wizard of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Maeve really loved drinking too much , to the point that her sanity was in decline .
description_long: Brown Maeve Brown Maeve was the Royal Magister of Ankhapur and the former wizard of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Maeve really loved drinking too much , to the point that her sanity was in decline . She liked to listen to sad stories , more so if they came with a free drink . History . Maeve was a wizard in Elturel . She joined Pinch ' s thieves guild . Maeve often partnered with Sprite - Heels , posing together as mother and child . She usually checked a place first to unveil magic protections . However , her drunkenness ruined some missions and Pinch considered getting her dried out at the first opportunity . Maeve was one of the thieves that followed her boss back to Ankhapur to regain his body .

title: Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company
description: Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company The Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company of Menzoberranzan was a fellowship created to counter House Baenre ' s profits from trade in the city . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company The Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company of Menzoberranzan was a fellowship created to counter House Baenre ' s profits from trade in the city . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan . The company was run by House Fey - Branche , which later gave some of its power to House Barrison Del ' Armgo .

title: Brown bear
description: Brown bear The brown bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had brown fur .
description_long: Brown bear The brown bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had brown fur . Black bears on average were 9 ft ( 2 . 7 m ) and weighed 1800 lb ( 816 . 5 kg ) . Behavior . These omnivore ursoids were very dangerous and territorial .

title: Brown dragon
description: Brown dragon Brown dragons , also known as great desert dragons , were ferocious dragons that lived under the desert sands . Physical description . They had sand colored scales , though unlike other types of dragon their scales were leathery .
description_long: Brown dragon Brown dragons , also known as great desert dragons , were ferocious dragons that lived under the desert sands . Physical description . They had sand colored scales , though unlike other types of dragon their scales were leathery . They had small webbed claws and very large , long mouths . Unlike most other types of dragons , they were wingless . To make up for this , they are the most adept diggers , speeding under loose sand very fast . Combat . Brown dragons preferred ambushes to straightforward fighting , often they buried themselves in the sand and waited for prey . They attacked with great fury . Breath weapon . A brown dragon ' s breath weapon was a line of acid , which reduced most animals to little more than sand and dust . Ecology . Lair . A brown dragon typically lived in a large cave or underground chamber , deep under the desert sand . Diet . A brown dragon ' s diet consisted of minerals , mostly sand , but they loved horseflesh .

title: Brown mold
description: Brown mold Brown mold was a fungus that grew in response to warm . So extremely did it absorb heat that it produced an area of cold around it . Description .
description_long: Brown mold Brown mold was a fungus that grew in response to warm . So extremely did it absorb heat that it produced an area of cold around it . Description . Brown mold often grew in subterranean or dungeon environments in large patches of about five feet ( one and a half meters ) or 10 feet ( 3 m ) in diameter . A patch of this size absorbed enough heat to cool the temperature of the air within a 30 - foot ( nine meter ) radius . Within five feet ( one and a half meters ) of the patch of mold , it was cold enough to cause non - lethal injury to some creatures . Brown mold grew extremely quickly when exposed to great sources of heat such as a nearby flame , doubling in size in only a matter of seconds . In contrast , the mold could be annihilated almost immediately by the effects of a spell dealing cold damage Usage . Besides its natural existence as a dungeon hazard , some found practical uses for brown mold , such as using it to cool food pantries , as was done in the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth . Brown mold was also created by the spell " mold touch " , which was a unique spell available to followers of nature deities Eldath , Mielikki , and Silvanus . Rumors .

title: Brownie
description: Brownie A brownie is sometimes said to be distant relative of the halfling ( perhaps half halfling , half pixie ) , but are smaller and far less common . Description . Brownies appear as small elves roughly one and a half feet tall .
description_long: Brownie A brownie is sometimes said to be distant relative of the halfling ( perhaps half halfling , half pixie ) , but are smaller and far less common . Description . Brownies appear as small elves roughly one and a half feet tall . They favor brightly colored garments . Psychology . Whatever their origin - whether a mixed breed or a type of fey all to their own - brownies are generally friendly to human s and their ilk . However , they are very shy and seldom allow themselves to be seen . The fact that they have exceptional senses in general and are never surprised helps them to accomplish this goal . Ecology . Brownies tend to prefer quiet , pastoral areas . They are sometimes said to inhabit houses or barns , and in return , they help the owners out with household tasks - making or repairing small items of leather , metal , or wood , for example . In keeping with their shyness , they only work at night , perhaps in exchange for small gifts or food . They are easily offended , however , and will abandon a house if their gifts are called payments or if they are offered gifts of clothing ( no matter how shabby their own clothes are ) .

title: Bruce R . Cordell
description: Bruce R . Cordell Bruce Robert Cordell is an American author of role playing games and fantasy novels . Born in South Dakota in 1968 , he graduated from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 1992 .
description_long: Bruce R . Cordell Bruce Robert Cordell is an American author of role playing games and fantasy novels . Born in South Dakota in 1968 , he graduated from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 1992 . He has worked for Wizards of the Coast since 1997 , before that he worked at TSR , Inc . starting in 1995 . He currently lives in the greater Seattle area . In 1998 he won the Origins Award for Best Adventure for " Return to the Tomb of Horrors " .

title: Bruenor Battlehammer
description: Bruenor Battlehammer < / ref > Bruenor Battlehammer was the eighth and tenth king of Mithral Hall from 1356 DR - 1362 DR and 1370 DR - 1409 DR . He was the dwarven adoptive father of Catti - brie and Wulfgar , friend to Drizzt Do ' Urden and Regis , crafter of Aegis - fang , and a member of the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Reginald Roundshield of Citadel Felbarr .
description_long: Bruenor Battlehammer < / ref > Bruenor Battlehammer was the eighth and tenth king of Mithral Hall from 1356 DR - 1362 DR and 1370 DR - 1409 DR . He was the dwarven adoptive father of Catti - brie and Wulfgar , friend to Drizzt Do ' Urden and Regis , crafter of Aegis - fang , and a member of the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Reginald Roundshield of Citadel Felbarr . Description . Bruenor had wild red hair and beard . He had a large , hawk - like , pointy nose that had been broken several times . His eyes were grayish blue and he stood four - and - a - half - feet tall . . In 1357 DR , he lost his right eye in battle and gained a great scar running from his forehead to his jaw . However , his eye was later restored . After his reincarnation , Bruenor looked the same as in his previous life , only much younger . Personality . Bruenor was gruff and stubborn , but he showed a tender side for his daughter , Catti - brie , and even Wulfgar at times . He was somewhat suspicious of magic . He was willing to put aside his prejudices for other races when needed , which helped him gain the friendship of Drizzt . He was a strong leader and equally strong fighter .

title: Bruenor Battlehammer I
description: Bruenor Battlehammer I Bruenor Battlehammer I was the 2nd King of Mithral Hall , and the namesake of the more widely known 8th and 10th king of Mithral Hall . He was the youngest of Gandalug Battlehammer ' s three sons , and inherited the throne despite not being the oldest . It is his personal battle armor that became the official royal armor of all future Battlehammer kings .
description_long: Bruenor Battlehammer I Bruenor Battlehammer I was the 2nd King of Mithral Hall , and the namesake of the more widely known 8th and 10th king of Mithral Hall . He was the youngest of Gandalug Battlehammer ' s three sons , and inherited the throne despite not being the oldest . It is his personal battle armor that became the official royal armor of all future Battlehammer kings . Towards the end of his life , Bruenor faked his death so he could abdicate his throne and go on a final adventure free of responsibility . References . < references >

title: Bruherd
description: Bruherd Bruherd was an outcast member of House Duskryn in Menzoberranzan . History . In 1372 DR , Bruherd was one of the many males who escaped from their House during the Silence of Lolth .
description_long: Bruherd Bruherd was an outcast member of House Duskryn in Menzoberranzan . History . In 1372 DR , Bruherd was one of the many males who escaped from their House during the Silence of Lolth . He joined Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl ' s group to incite a slave revolt . He was eventually killed during the suppression of the revolt .

title: Bruithyn Ammacaster
description: Bruithyn Ammacaster Bruithyn Ammacster was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch in 1358 DR . Bruithyn was famous for carrying an " iron bands of Bilarro " sphere , to deal with those who threatened him . When he traveled in Anauroch , he always had with him a bodyguard of Sembian mercenaries and a priest of Lathander from Eveningstar for healing .
description_long: Bruithyn Ammacaster Bruithyn Ammacster was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch in 1358 DR . Bruithyn was famous for carrying an " iron bands of Bilarro " sphere , to deal with those who threatened him . When he traveled in Anauroch , he always had with him a bodyguard of Sembian mercenaries and a priest of Lathander from Eveningstar for healing . Bruithyn was popular at the temple of Lathandar for the gifts he gave to that faith .

title: Bruldenthar
description: Bruldenthar Bruldenthar was a dwarven sage in Mirabar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Bruldenthar was chosen among many others as part of a diplomatic delegation , but at Beliard in the Dessarin Valley they were ambushed by the Cult of the Black Earth .
description_long: Bruldenthar Bruldenthar was a dwarven sage in Mirabar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Bruldenthar was chosen among many others as part of a diplomatic delegation , but at Beliard in the Dessarin Valley they were ambushed by the Cult of the Black Earth . Brudelnthar was captured and transported beyond the River Dessarin . There , in the Sumber Hills , they were attacked by the Cult of the Howling Hatred , which killed many earth cultists and prisoners . Brudelnthar remained a prisoner of the Black Earth and with two other diplomat prisoners was transported to the Sacred Stone Monastery . There , he was put to work in a subterranean mine with many other prisoners from others raids , but the diplomats were soon after put in another place . At last , some adventurers hired to find the missing delegation infiltrated the monastery and freed Brudelnthar and many other prisoners .

title: Bruneil
description: Bruneil Bruneil was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Bruneil was one of Fort Locke ' s newest soldiers ( who did not want to become a merchant ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol .
description_long: Bruneil Bruneil was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Bruneil was one of Fort Locke ' s newest soldiers ( who did not want to become a merchant ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol . However , they were captured by the shadow priest . Repko was cornered , as the room he was in was occupied by hostile undead . The Kalach - Cha and Tann could ' ve rescued him .

title: Brunos Costak
description: Brunos Costak Brunos Costak was one of the western divisional leaders of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . Costak accompanied Rieltar Anchev to Candlekeep to negotiate a treaty with the Knights of the Shield and was murdered there along with the others present in the negotiations .
description_long: Brunos Costak Brunos Costak was one of the western divisional leaders of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . Costak accompanied Rieltar Anchev to Candlekeep to negotiate a treaty with the Knights of the Shield and was murdered there along with the others present in the negotiations .

title: Brusha
description: Brusha Brusha was a bandit who lived in the Hordelands near Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Brusha was the leader of a secret bandit base located somewhere within the valleys southwest of Ahs Trango Shan beneath Katakoro Shan near Khazari .
description_long: Brusha Brusha was a bandit who lived in the Hordelands near Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Brusha was the leader of a secret bandit base located somewhere within the valleys southwest of Ahs Trango Shan beneath Katakoro Shan near Khazari . He commanded between 50 – 100 other bandits . Rumors and Legends . Rumored to be of noble birth , Brusha styled himself a rebel against the lord of Khazari .

title: Brymoel
description: Brymoel Brymoel was a male orc cleric and one of the son ' s of King Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . A fantacial devotee of Gruumsh , Brymoel envisioned all the orc s of the Spine of the World being ruled over by his deity ' s cleric s .
description_long: Brymoel Brymoel was a male orc cleric and one of the son ' s of King Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . A fantacial devotee of Gruumsh , Brymoel envisioned all the orc s of the Spine of the World being ruled over by his deity ' s cleric s . History . Born as the son of Obould Many - Arrows , Brymoel grew up to be one of his most ambitious spawn . By 1372 DR , Obould worried that the lands he hand conquered would not be enough for Brymoel and his brothers , especially Scrauth and Araug , so the King often sent him away on ranging patrols to keep them busy .

title: Bryn Lightfingers
description: Bryn Lightfingers Bryn Lightfingers was a halfling ranger from a strongheart clan in Red Larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . Personality . She had the family tendency of a quick temper but also an open mind and curiosity .
description_long: Bryn Lightfingers Bryn Lightfingers was a halfling ranger from a strongheart clan in Red Larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . Personality . She had the family tendency of a quick temper but also an open mind and curiosity . History . Bryn and her brother Belamy came from a family of bakers , known for their crumblecake . When the siblings grew old enough , they left their home and their baking ways to turn to a life of adventure and split up . When she came out in the world , she began training with the rangers of Ardeep Forest . This ended when the band was hunted out of the area by Eldreth Veluuthra . After a while of living off the land , she meet her brother again , who spoke with her about joining the Order of the Burning Dawn , where she later gained a leadership position . Appendix . Appearances . Bryn will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Bryn Shander
description: Bryn Shander Bryn Shander was the biggest of the Ten Towns and was known for being a trading center in Icewind Dale . Geography . The city was the only one of the Ten Towns not located on the shores of either Maer Dualdon , Redwaters , or Lac Dinneshere .
description_long: Bryn Shander Bryn Shander was the biggest of the Ten Towns and was known for being a trading center in Icewind Dale . Geography . The city was the only one of the Ten Towns not located on the shores of either Maer Dualdon , Redwaters , or Lac Dinneshere . The Eastway connected the city to the town of Easthaven in the east . Description . The circular walled town itself was placed upon a hill , with snowy plains stretching in all directions . There were three gates : north , south , and east . The City Hill sat just outside the wall to the northeast of the city . Defenses . Because of its defensive location , residents of cities east of Bryn Shander often took refuge within the city walls during wartime . History . Pre - Spellplague . In 1351 DR , the Ten Towns were attacked by the barbarian s of Icewind Dale . With the aid of Drizzt Do ' Urden and Bruenor Battlehammer , the horde was defeated at the gates of Bryn Shander . Around 1356 DR , Bryn Shander was under the leadership of spokesman Cassius . Post - Spellplague . In the fall of 1466 DR , the drow Tiago Baenre defeated the returned demon Errtu on a plain outside the city , endearing himself to the city .

title: Bryndar
description: Bryndar The Bryndar were a group rumored to dwell within Brynwood in the Vast . Stories about them varied , but agreed that they were a clan of evil , magic - using female shapeshifters . The most common of these claimed that they were evil magical creatures who could change their shape into that of a female human .
description_long: Bryndar The Bryndar were a group rumored to dwell within Brynwood in the Vast . Stories about them varied , but agreed that they were a clan of evil , magic - using female shapeshifters . The most common of these claimed that they were evil magical creatures who could change their shape into that of a female human . In this guise , they were said to lure male adventurer s into the depths of the Brynwood forest and there transformed into wolves , giant spider s , huge snake s , or owlbear s to then devour their victims . However , a rival tale reported the opposite , saying that they were in fact real human women who adopted animal forms to discourage anyone who ventured into the forest . A certain minstrel wrote a ballad about one of these women , whom he named " Snowhair the Sorceress " , a scornful , white - haired mage . A third story popular in tavern s in Impiltur said that the Bryndar ( so named in this story ) dwelled in an ancient castle with many spires deep in Brynwood , where they developed powerful spell s and used magical gate s or portal s to travel to far - flung cities like Airspur , Telflamm , Westgate , and Waterdeep .

title: Bryndar Obarskyr
description: Bryndar Obarskyr Bryndar Obarskyr was the third king of Cormyr , of the Obarskyr dynasty . He was born in the Year of the Vow Manifest , 44 DR , and was the only son of Imlon Obarskyr , the second king of Cormyr . Bryndar reigned as king himself from the Year of Lamplit Nights , 57 DR , aged only 13 , and ended his reign in the Year of Gleaming Frost , 64 DR , at age 20 .
description_long: Bryndar Obarskyr Bryndar Obarskyr was the third king of Cormyr , of the Obarskyr dynasty . He was born in the Year of the Vow Manifest , 44 DR , and was the only son of Imlon Obarskyr , the second king of Cormyr . Bryndar reigned as king himself from the Year of Lamplit Nights , 57 DR , aged only 13 , and ended his reign in the Year of Gleaming Frost , 64 DR , at age 20 . Bryndar died young without producing an heir . He was succeeded by his uncle , Eskruis Obarskyr .

title: Brynnlaw
description: Brynnlaw Brynnlaw was an island located on the Sea of Swords . History . It was home to a pirate lord as well as Spellhold , an asylum belonging to the Cowled Wizards that was attacked by Jon Irenicus in 1369 DR .
description_long: Brynnlaw Brynnlaw was an island located on the Sea of Swords . History . It was home to a pirate lord as well as Spellhold , an asylum belonging to the Cowled Wizards that was attacked by Jon Irenicus in 1369 DR . Inhabitants . The island was mainly occupied by pirates , along with the Cowled Wizards .

title: Brynwood
description: Brynwood Brynwood was a forest located in the Vast , covering a large area between the Earthfast Mountains and the North Road , lying north of the towns of Maerstar and Sevenecho . It was infamous for holding a number of monsters and legends . Description .
description_long: Brynwood Brynwood was a forest located in the Vast , covering a large area between the Earthfast Mountains and the North Road , lying north of the towns of Maerstar and Sevenecho . It was infamous for holding a number of monsters and legends . Description . The terrain under Brynwood was tumbled and uneven , going up and down with many outcroppings of rock and ravines with steep sides , and the forest spread chaotically across this . There were no tracks through it , and the Brynwood was said to be as difficult to traverse as the Stonelands of Cormyr . Fauna . The sage Elminster heard tales of a kind of rabbit living in the Brynwood that was capable of whistling like a canary . It could even be taught a surprising number of tunes . History . Korred s and satyr s once dwelt in Brynwood , but the two fey races came into conflict over territory . In the ensuing strife , both races fell before monstrous creatures whose numbers steadily grew more plentiful . Afterwards , few of the original inhabitants remained .

title: Bryon Kendrick
description: Bryon Kendrick Bryon Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family , the king of Corwell and father to Tristan Kendrick . Description . King Bryon was a strong man with dark hair and long black beard streaked gray .
description_long: Bryon Kendrick Bryon Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family , the king of Corwell and father to Tristan Kendrick . Description . King Bryon was a strong man with dark hair and long black beard streaked gray . Relationships . Adding to Bryon ' s despair , he was disappointed in the actions of his son , Prince Tristan . History . Around 1329 DR , Bryon ' s young wife died causing the king to fall into a deep depression . By 1345 DR , Bryon powerful presence had descended into a weakened state of discord .

title: Bryseis Kakistos
description: Bryseis Kakistos Very little is known about Bryseis Kakistos other than she was the leader of the Toril thirteen , the original thirteen tiefling warlock s who made pacts with Asmodeus . She was said by the cambion Lorcan to have been a thoroughly wicked person who was partially responsible for Asmodeus ' ascension to godhood . She lived near Vaasa and was alive in the 14th century .

One of her tiefling descendents named Farideh became a warlock in 1477 DR when she made a pact with the cambion Lorcan ,

title: Brysis
description: Brysis Brysis of Khaem was a wraith sorcerer in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . History . In life , Brysis was a great sorcerer in Netheril .
description_long: Brysis Brysis of Khaem was a wraith sorcerer in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . History . In life , Brysis was a great sorcerer in Netheril . On the day of her death , she was interred in a floating tomb . After the fall of Netheril , Brysis ' s tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark region of the Silken Paths , where it remained for centuries . The Rage of Demons unleashed magical energies that awoke Brysis from the eternal sleep of death as a wraith , served by specter s who were once her loyal retainers . A party of adventurers escaping drow slavers of Velkynvelve with help of Fargas Rumblefoot may have defeated her .

title: Bryth Moonaxe
description: Bryth Moonaxe Bryth Moonaxe was a half - dwarf commander of the Knights of the Crescent Moon who arrived in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Bryth was a rare half - dwarf born from the Lady of the Seven Silver Stars , Elhanna Moonhawk , and First Axe Therlarn Axesong .
description_long: Bryth Moonaxe Bryth Moonaxe was a half - dwarf commander of the Knights of the Crescent Moon who arrived in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Bryth was a rare half - dwarf born from the Lady of the Seven Silver Stars , Elhanna Moonhawk , and First Axe Therlarn Axesong . He became the commander of the Order of the Crescent Moon . Bryth and all his fellows voluntarily underwent a Phezult ' s sleep of ages spell . They awoke in 1370 DR , 1 , 445 years later . Under the able leadership of Bryth , the members of the order slowly adapted to that time and tried to reforge the bond with the crown of Iltkazar . However , Bryth saw stagnation around him and spoke against it , while also asking for a war against the beholder Alimir Hive .

title: Bubble Net
description: Bubble Net The Bubble Net , or Waterspout , was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Bubble Net was what the marid s called a large column of air that connected the Elemental Plane of Water to the Elemental Plane of Air , allowing passage to clouds of the Elemental Plane of Air .
description_long: Bubble Net The Bubble Net , or Waterspout , was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Bubble Net was what the marid s called a large column of air that connected the Elemental Plane of Water to the Elemental Plane of Air , allowing passage to clouds of the Elemental Plane of Air . On the Elemental Plane of Air , the djinn called this vortex the Waterspout because it resembled a large tornado made of water . Djinn attempting to travel to the Elemental Plane of Water through this vortex suffered from dangerous riptides plaguing the water . Rumors and Legends . This vortex was said to be created by a great leviathan pulling air from the greatest depths of the Elemental Plane of Water .

title: Buckler
description: Buckler A buckler was a small shield useful as a defense in melee combat . Due to its small size , a buckler was of limited use in defending against missiles . Use .
description_long: Buckler A buckler was a small shield useful as a defense in melee combat . Due to its small size , a buckler was of limited use in defending against missiles . Use . Bucklers could be made from various objects . Fighting cleric s could strap a field brazier to their arm to serve as a buckler . The eladrin wizard Caelynna used a clamshell as a buckler . In Zakhara , many daraq s ( Zakharan bucklers ) were made from tortoise shells . Bucklers were used by many groups . The Cultists of the Shattered Peak typically used bucklers . The amlakkar guard of Calimport typically wielded scimitars with bucklers . Bucklers sometimes served a symbolic purpose . Priests of Arvoreen wore buckler amulets .

title: Buckweather
description: Buckweather Sprite - Heels was Lord of the Watch of Ankhapur and a former halfling member of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Sprite - Heels loved ale and cheese , and he liked his comforts .
description_long: Buckweather Sprite - Heels was Lord of the Watch of Ankhapur and a former halfling member of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Sprite - Heels loved ale and cheese , and he liked his comforts . He was a very good gambler . However , Sprite - Heels often spoke before thinking , being an impulsive individual . Because of this , he often sniped at and insulted all members of the gang . History . Sprite - Heels was one of the thief companions of Pinch in Elturel . He followed his boss back to Ankhapur to regain his body . However , he was blinded by the lich Manferic III . Once Pinch became King Janol I , he appointed Sprite - Heels as Lord Buckweather .

title: Bugbear
description: Bugbear A bugbear is a massive humanoid distantly related to , but larger and stronger than , goblin s and hobgoblin s . Like many goblinoid s , bugbears speak the Goblin language . They are one of the only goblinoids to be covered in fur .
description_long: Bugbear A bugbear is a massive humanoid distantly related to , but larger and stronger than , goblin s and hobgoblin s . Like many goblinoid s , bugbears speak the Goblin language . They are one of the only goblinoids to be covered in fur . Physical description . Bugbears resemble hairy , feral goblins standing seven feet tall . They take their name from their noses and claws , which are similar to those of bears . Their claws are not long and sharp enough to be used as weapons , so bugbears often armor and arm themselves with a variety of purloined gear . Most often , this gear is second - rate and in poor repair . Many bugbears are chaotic evil in alignment , favoring the rogue class . Many scholars now believe that bugbears and goblins were both bred by the hobgoblins as slave races , with bugbears serving as elite soldiers . Psychology . Bugbears , like other goblinoids , have a reputation for being dim - witted and brutish . This claim is not unfounded and like their kin bugbears have easily provoked tempers and are prone to fitful rages . Few bugbears overcome this nature and their culture ' s brutal nature .

title: Buhrell Caah
description: Buhrell Caah Buhrell Caah was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Buhrell was an agent of the Emerald Enclave sent to Phlan .
description_long: Buhrell Caah Buhrell Caah was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Buhrell was an agent of the Emerald Enclave sent to Phlan . He went to Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle searching for a powerful and dangerous magical item . With the help of some adventurers he managed to locate and recover the item .

title: Builders ' Hall
description: Builders ' Hall Builders ' Hall was the guildhall of the Guild of Stonecutters , Masons , Potters , & Tile - makers in the South Ward of Waterdeep . Location . The guildhall was located at the intersection of Coach Street and Carter ' s Way in the South Ward .
description_long: Builders ' Hall Builders ' Hall was the guildhall of the Guild of Stonecutters , Masons , Potters , & Tile - makers in the South Ward of Waterdeep . Location . The guildhall was located at the intersection of Coach Street and Carter ' s Way in the South Ward . Structure . Builders ' Hall was a two story made from wood . Interior . In the basement of Builders ' Hall , there was a gate to Wyllowwood in Undermountain in the shape of a pair of marble statues .

title: Buirin Thalshond
description: Buirin Thalshond Buirin Thalshond was a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Speaking of treasure tales in the Vast in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Buirin remarked " Treasure ? Aye , lots of it in the Vast , lad ; why didn ' t ye ask earlier ?
description_long: Buirin Thalshond Buirin Thalshond was a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Speaking of treasure tales in the Vast in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Buirin remarked " Treasure ? Aye , lots of it in the Vast , lad ; why didn ' t ye ask earlier ? Oh … I see ; ye wanted to live a while , first . "

title: Buiyrandyn
description: Buiyrandyn Buiyrandyn was a tiny drow settlement in the northern Underdark , beneath the northern Sword Mountains . It was also famous for rejecting Lolth and other evil drow deities . Besides that it was the birhtplace of Qilué Veladorn , one of the Seven Sisters .
description_long: Buiyrandyn Buiyrandyn was a tiny drow settlement in the northern Underdark , beneath the northern Sword Mountains . It was also famous for rejecting Lolth and other evil drow deities . Besides that it was the birhtplace of Qilué Veladorn , one of the Seven Sisters . A long time before the 15th century DR , mindflayer s destroyed it and since then it was occupied by evil monsters . It became the lair of a small clan of hook horrors .

title: Buldegas Mhaerkoon
description: Buldegas Mhaerkoon Buldegas Mhaerkoon was a human man living in the cities of Wheloon and Arabel in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Wyvern Watch Inn and another inn . History .
description_long: Buldegas Mhaerkoon Buldegas Mhaerkoon was a human man living in the cities of Wheloon and Arabel in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Wyvern Watch Inn and another inn . History . Buldegas was formerly a warrior . He was the long - time owner of the Wyvern Watch Inn , in business by 1358 DR . During the Time of Troubles , he gave shelter to Kelemvor Lyonsbane , Midnight , and Adon , hiding them from their foes . He continued to manage the Wyvern through 1369 DR . Following the devastation of the neighboring city of Arabel during the Goblin War in 1370 DR , Buldegas chose to relocate there and build a new inn . He took away his money and some of his best employees . He was only recently gone by 1374 . He left his two daughters , Asanta and Baerill , in charge of the Wyvern . Description . Buldegas Mhaerkoon was overweight and red - faced . Personality . He was a cynical man but generally kind and generous . He was often patriotic to Cormyr , and always an entrepreneur . Relationships . Buldegas had two daughters , Asanta & Baerill . Activities . Buldegas made the Wyvern Watch Inn successful with his low prices , though he also went for low quality .

title: Bulette
description: Bulette The bulette ( pronounced boo - lay ) , also known as a landshark , is a particularly loathsome creature that lives in the Starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Feared and hated by most living creatures , bulettes are extremely dangerous , burrowing unseen beneath the soil before erupting up at an unexpected moment to seize their prey . Dwarves called the bulette a ghohlbrorn .
description_long: Bulette The bulette ( pronounced boo - lay ) , also known as a landshark , is a particularly loathsome creature that lives in the Starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Feared and hated by most living creatures , bulettes are extremely dangerous , burrowing unseen beneath the soil before erupting up at an unexpected moment to seize their prey . Dwarves called the bulette a ghohlbrorn . Description . Bulettes are sometimes supposed to be a bizarre cross between an armadillo and a snapping turtle , though there is little evidence to support this theory . Bulettes are heavily armored , however , like either creature , and have a powerful jaw mechanism for snapping up their unsuspecting prey . In many cases a bulette will swallow its prey whole , consuming their victims clothing , weapons , and other equipment along with the creature itself , which the bulette can in fact digest successfully through the use of powerful stomach acid . Bulettes are covered head to toe in armor . Around the head and rear , this armor is a blue - brown color , while in - between the hue might range from gray - blue to blue - green .

title: Bull ' s strength
description: Bull ' s strength Bull ' s strength , also known simply as strength , was an arcane or divine spell that caused the recipient to become stronger . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell , " bull ' s strength " that could be cast by both arcane and divine spellcasters , and " strength " which was only used by wizards .
description_long: Bull ' s strength Bull ' s strength , also known simply as strength , was an arcane or divine spell that caused the recipient to become stronger . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell , " bull ' s strength " that could be cast by both arcane and divine spellcasters , and " strength " which was only used by wizards . The two versions differed in duration , but otherwise had very similar effects . Both required the caster to successfully touch the target in order to bestow the benefits of this spell . The recipient gained a significant amount of strength , but not more than the strongest known specimen of his or her race , class , or species . For a time , the recipient gained all benefits for strength both in and out of combat . For " bull ' s strength " , this lasted a few minutes , whereas the arcane - only " strength " lasted for hours . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , " bull ' s strength " required a sample of hair or dung from a bull . The older " strength " spell accepted a similar sample from any strong animal , such as an ape , ox , bear , " etc . " History .

title: Bullywug
description: Bullywug Bullywugs are froglike humanoid creatures . Description . Bullywugs are described as humanoids with the head of frogs .
description_long: Bullywug Bullywugs are froglike humanoid creatures . Description . Bullywugs are described as humanoids with the head of frogs . They are usually shorter than a human , with leathery skin and webbed digits . They are very good jumpers , and can jump roughly 30 feet forward and 15 feet vertically . Bullywugs speak their own language of croaks , staccato notes , and clicks , called Bullywi , and the intelligent ones pick up Aquan , Sylvan , or Infernal . The average bullywug is smaller than a human , about the size of a halfling . A bullywug can survive on land and in water ; it is one of the water - breathing species and is amphibious . A bullywug must immerse itself in water once per day or suffer dehydration . Society . Bullywugs live in primitive groups , hunting and fishing together . The hierarchy is based on strength , with the strongest being the leaders . Bullywugs are very territorial , and mostly will attack anyone who trespasses . Oddly enough , they tend not to fight within the tribe , but rival bullywug tribes will fight with each other . Bullywugs rarely work alongside other creatures since they would rather use them for food or sacrifice .

title: Bundrigo Dalastarra
description: Bundrigo Dalastarra Bundrigo Dalastarra was a halfling man of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , he held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat , but proved rampantly corrupt . Personality .
description_long: Bundrigo Dalastarra Bundrigo Dalastarra was a halfling man of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , he held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat , but proved rampantly corrupt . Personality . Bundrigo was cheerful and good - natured , though also considered sly . History . Bundrigo Dalastarra held the position of Regent of City Works in Ravens Bluff for a number of years . In that position , he operated a huge and well - oiled system of bribery , kickbacks , and informers , the greatest ever known in Ravens Bluff . He paid his hardworking officials well , though some believed the money ultimately came from pirates . Bundrigo died during Ravens Bluff ' s war with Myrkyssa Jelan in the summer of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , though he was nowhere near the fighting . An unknown killer hacked him multiple times with a heavy bladed weapon , then left his body as a heap of smoldering ashes . Scandal erupted as all Bundrigo ' s crimes were uncovered , with all his closest aides and associates implicated in his misdeeds .

title: Bungalow Thump
description: Bungalow Thump Bungalow Thump was the leader of the Gutbuster Brigade , the battlerager brigade of Mithril Hall in 1484 DR . History . In addition to his duties as a Gutbuster , Bungalow was a personal bodyguard of King Connerad Brawnanvil .
description_long: Bungalow Thump Bungalow Thump was the leader of the Gutbuster Brigade , the battlerager brigade of Mithril Hall in 1484 DR . History . In addition to his duties as a Gutbuster , Bungalow was a personal bodyguard of King Connerad Brawnanvil . He was one of the main advisers of the king alongside Dagnabbet in the early stages of the War of the Silver Marches . He was with Connerad when the king welcomed the Companions of the Hall and the reborn Bruenor Battlehammer . Bungalow later took part in the all the major battles of the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR . Bungalow also guided his brigade in the reconquest of Gauntlgrym .

title: Buntaro Ostato
description: Buntaro Ostato Buntaro Ostato was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Buntaro had the personality ( and the look ) of a dyspeptic bear : he rarely smiled and always seemed arrogant .
description_long: Buntaro Ostato Buntaro Ostato was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Buntaro had the personality ( and the look ) of a dyspeptic bear : he rarely smiled and always seemed arrogant . Buntaro was deeply loyal to his daimyo , one of the few people who liked Buntaro . He was a man of honor and duty , hating people of unstable loyalty . Buntaro was in love with his servant , Sono . Relations . Buntaro was the son - in - law of the daimyo Benju Matsumoto , though his wife died in childbirth .

title: Buorstag Hlammythyl
description: Buorstag Hlammythyl Buorstag Hlammythyl is the elected bron of the town of Voonlar , in 1372 DR . The burly ex - mercenary is known to be a worshiper of Bane and is in fact a puppet ruler from the Zhentarim . Buorstag is assisted by six deputies and can call the militia in Voonlar to arms if needed .
description_long: Buorstag Hlammythyl Buorstag Hlammythyl is the elected bron of the town of Voonlar , in 1372 DR . The burly ex - mercenary is known to be a worshiper of Bane and is in fact a puppet ruler from the Zhentarim . Buorstag is assisted by six deputies and can call the militia in Voonlar to arms if needed .

title: Buppido
description: Buppido Buppido was a cunning derro murderer who lived in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Buppido was crazy at heart .
description_long: Buppido Buppido was a cunning derro murderer who lived in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Buppido was crazy at heart . He believed himself to be the living incarnation of the derro god Diinkarazan and , as the avatar of murder , he must offer bloody sacrifices to create a path of carnage through the Underdark for his people to follow to glory . In his mind , any setbacks were part of his " divine plan " . Convinced he was a god , he believed he could not be killed ( or at least the death of his mortal form meant nothing to him ) , so he was completely fearless . History . Buppido hailed from Gracklstugh but wandered the Underdark performing his carefully ritualized killings , hiding his true nature under a friendly facade . During the late 1480s DR , he was captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Bupposo
description: Bupposo Bupposo was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Bupposo was a good teacher at the monastery .
description_long: Bupposo Bupposo was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Bupposo was a good teacher at the monastery . Often he secretly went out with his friend Kogi . Bupposo was a very poor monk . History . Bupposo was at Winter Sect monastery from many years but remained a middle - level monk Bupposo and his friend Kogi elaborated a good prank against Tsuyoi - no - kami monks : they payed Ichi the Korobokuru yakuza to find a girl that can seduce the rival monks . So the young maiden O - Shino , acting under the orders of monks temped Anchin and Kaian Personality . Bupposo was a stubborn , mischievous and irreverent individual and also spiteful , remembering for a very long time slights . his only virtue was an incredible patience .

title: Burak
description: Burak Burak the Mongrel was a half - orc pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Personality . Burak had no strategy in his attacks and was not loved nor admired by his crew ; they followed him for money , and showed no mercy to their victims .
description_long: Burak Burak the Mongrel was a half - orc pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Personality . Burak had no strategy in his attacks and was not loved nor admired by his crew ; they followed him for money , and showed no mercy to their victims . However , Burak had a passion : destroying slave ships . But all slaves were dragged aboard his ship and given to the crew to do with as they willed . No slave taken by him and his crew was ever seen again on land . History . Burak was a bandit who at one point decided with other humanoids to turn to piracy . Despite his lack of strategy , Burak was quite successful in his career thanks to his rapid attacks and his ace card , a shaman in his crew . His ship was named " Flotsam " .

title: Buraq
description: Buraq Buraqs , or horses of heaven , were companions of princes and sultans , and helpers for many holy warriors . These free creatures had no master . Description .
