description_long: Buraq Buraqs , or horses of heaven , were companions of princes and sultans , and helpers for many holy warriors . These free creatures had no master . Description . Externally they resembled a horse with a long tail and a human face . In size , they were larger than donkeys , but smaller than mules . Their tails were red , blue , green or gold . Their hooves had magical properties that allowed them to move very quietly even at full gallop . Combat . Though they detested combat , buraqs could serve as warhorses . They preferred giving army command and staying out of the battle . If forced to fight , a buraq could use their hooves to cause significant damage to enemies . Buraqs were also great travelers . They could move through the air at the same rate as sprinting on the ground , but they needed to take a good running start . Riders upon a buraq experienced the trip as an instantaneous event . This was explained by the buraq ' s ability to stop time . Buraqs often uses this ability to help people . At will buraqs could " speak with animals " and learn three languages per day . Habitat / Society .

title: Burgher Xarod
description: Burgher Xarod Burgher Xarod was the original boss of the land that later became the Xiousing district in Marsember . History . Xarod controlled some of the neighborhoods around Xiousing and when the Sea of Fallen Stars retreated , he assumed control of the newly exposed land .
description_long: Burgher Xarod Burgher Xarod was the original boss of the land that later became the Xiousing district in Marsember . History . Xarod controlled some of the neighborhoods around Xiousing and when the Sea of Fallen Stars retreated , he assumed control of the newly exposed land . In 1419 DR , King Azoun V granted the Shou Duc - Sum Li regency over the Xiousing district , which infuriated Xarod . Even in his extreme old age , he plotted to regain the land he believed to be rightfully his .

title: Buried Realms
description: Buried Realms The Buried Realms , called the Phaerlin by the phaerimm , lie underneath the desert of Anauroch . This domain of the Underdark is home to the phaerimm , who are confined to the Buried Realms by the Sharnwall . This magical artifice that functions as a barrier for the phaerimm between their realm and the rest of Faerûn was created thousands of years ago by the Sharn to imprison the phaerimm .
description_long: Buried Realms The Buried Realms , called the Phaerlin by the phaerimm , lie underneath the desert of Anauroch . This domain of the Underdark is home to the phaerimm , who are confined to the Buried Realms by the Sharnwall . This magical artifice that functions as a barrier for the phaerimm between their realm and the rest of Faerûn was created thousands of years ago by the Sharn to imprison the phaerimm . In old times Anauroch was the site of the Netherese empire , now long lost and gone . Its ruins are found hidden in the sand and rocks of the Buried Realms . Since adventurers of any race can pass safely through the Sharnwall with the exception of the phaerimm themselves , many exploration parties have ventured into the Buried Realms in search of ancient lore or highly prized Netherese magical items . On 20 Nightal , 1371 DR , the magical barrier was breached near the city of Evereska , setting the phaerimm free to wreak havoc in a wider world . The return of Thultanthar has contained the phaerimm so far .

title: Burnbones
description: Burnbones Burnbones appear similar to the blazing bones found in Myth Drannor , but are selected high level members of the church of Cyric who have been transformed with a portion of his power by Cyric himself . Physical description . Usually proudly wearing a holy symbol of Cyric these undead monstrosities can call upon all the clerical powers they commanded when they were still alive and now do so with even more efficiency while their mere presence burns with the power of Cyric ' s dark fires .
description_long: Burnbones Burnbones appear similar to the blazing bones found in Myth Drannor , but are selected high level members of the church of Cyric who have been transformed with a portion of his power by Cyric himself . Physical description . Usually proudly wearing a holy symbol of Cyric these undead monstrosities can call upon all the clerical powers they commanded when they were still alive and now do so with even more efficiency while their mere presence burns with the power of Cyric ' s dark fires . The infusion of divine power dissolved their puny mortal frames and turned them into the blazing glory of the Dark Sun that are the burnbones . Personality . Burnbones exist only to serve the greater glory of the Prince of Lies , bending to his every whim , suffering insufferable pain and anguish if they even think about doing otherwise .

title: Burning Daggers
description: Burning Daggers The Burning Daggers were a fanatical Kossuth - worshiping group of orc s in Thar . Description . Each of them was branded in the center of the face with a dagger symbol as a sign of devotion .
description_long: Burning Daggers The Burning Daggers were a fanatical Kossuth - worshiping group of orc s in Thar . Description . Each of them was branded in the center of the face with a dagger symbol as a sign of devotion . Base . They inhabited deep caverns in Thar , around twenty miles from Glister , where there was a rift to the Elemental Plane of Fire , into which they threw anyone they took captive . A black flaming dagger floated in the air inside this rift . It had been the focus of many searches by the Black Flame Zealots for a long time . Branding . The branding of each orc took place once a year as a sign of devotion to Kossuth . The dagger brand covered the whole of the center of the face , with the point reaching towards the chin and the pommel on the forehead .

title: Burning Pool of Natifa
description: Burning Pool of Natifa The Burning Pool of Natifa was a small wonderous body of water located in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . The Burning Pool of Natifa was located near a cluster of crescent - shaped " barchan " dunes west of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams .
description_long: Burning Pool of Natifa The Burning Pool of Natifa was a small wonderous body of water located in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . The Burning Pool of Natifa was located near a cluster of crescent - shaped " barchan " dunes west of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams . Description . The pool measured 40 feet ( 12 . 2 m ) wide and was 20 feet ( 6 . 1 m ) deep . The water of the pool had a sweet smell of lemons and roses . Spindly plants called " arafaj " covered the entire surface of the pool , burning continuously and illuminating the entire pool with a magical glow that could be seen 10 miles ( 16 . 1 km ) away . These plants burned whenever they were in contact with the pool ' s surface ; even rain did not extinguish them . Periodically , a fountain would shoot water 20 feet ( 6 . 1 m ) into the air . A stone oven could be found near the southern end of the pool , complete with pots and other accessories . Inhabitants . The pool took its name from Natifa , a ghost who inhabited the pool .

title: Burning Rift
description: Burning Rift The Burning Rift was an underground volcanic rift in Chult . Geography . The Burning Rift was located in the Firelands directly beneath the Peaks of Flame .
description_long: Burning Rift The Burning Rift was an underground volcanic rift in Chult . Geography . The Burning Rift was located in the Firelands directly beneath the Peaks of Flame . Description . The Burning Rift had a number of " portal s " that linked it to the Elemental Plane of Fire . The rift was also connected to the Peaks of Flame volcanoes above it through lava tubes . History . During the Time of Troubles , the fire god Kossuth appeared in the Burning Rift as the firenewt blackguard avatar Chassan . In this form , Kossuth led the firenewt Ak ' ta tribe in war against the pterafolk of the Chultanegar . After departing the Prime Material Plane , Kossuth rewarded Chassan by allowing him to become a deathflame and return to leadership of the Ak ' ta tribe . Inhabitants . Firenewt s and salamander s dwelt in the Burning Rift , having migrated there from the Elemental Plane of Fire . Azer , hell hound s , flamesnake s , and magmin s also used the Burning Rift as a point of entry into the Firelands and the Peaks of Flame .

title: Burning blade
description: Burning blade Burning blade is among the most complex spell s learned by swordmage initiates and is used most commonly by those who invoke the assault style of arcane swordplay . When a swordmage casts " burning blade " he or she transmutes their sword ' s surface into flames , making it more deadly upon contact with the flesh of a swordmage ' s foe . The initial power of the spell is largely determined by a swordmage ' s intellect but the effect of the spell can continue for up to several minutes , during which time the intensity of the flames is dependent instead upon the swordmage ' s physical strength .
description_long: Burning blade Burning blade is among the most complex spell s learned by swordmage initiates and is used most commonly by those who invoke the assault style of arcane swordplay . When a swordmage casts " burning blade " he or she transmutes their sword ' s surface into flames , making it more deadly upon contact with the flesh of a swordmage ' s foe . The initial power of the spell is largely determined by a swordmage ' s intellect but the effect of the spell can continue for up to several minutes , during which time the intensity of the flames is dependent instead upon the swordmage ' s physical strength . " Burning blade " is fairly difficult to cast and , as such , can only be used once per day .

title: Burning hands
description: Burning hands Burning hands was a spell of the alteration or evocation school of magic . Effects . Learned by some wizard s of relatively low experience , " burning hands " momentarily engulfed the wizard ' s hands in a burst of magical flames and then expelled them rapidly into an adjacent area of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter .
description_long: Burning hands Burning hands was a spell of the alteration or evocation school of magic . Effects . Learned by some wizard s of relatively low experience , " burning hands " momentarily engulfed the wizard ' s hands in a burst of magical flames and then expelled them rapidly into an adjacent area of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter . Earlier versions projected a cone of flame from the fingertips of the caster ' s outstretched hands , thumbs touching . These flames did no harm to the wizard but could scorch the flesh of others caught nearby during the fiery blast . The effect was instantaneous but damaging and the wizard required only a short , momentary rest to refocus in order to cast the spell again . The post Second Sundering version cast flames in a 15 feet cone and had the older spell casting method of having ones thumbs together with outstretched hands . This ignited any flammable object that wasn ' t worn or carried . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast . History .

title: Burning sands
description: Burning sands Burning sands was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused regular sand to become combustible .
description_long: Burning sands Burning sands was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused regular sand to become combustible . The sand appeared exactly the same as normal sand , but also had the flammable properties of lantern oil . Once lit the sand would burn for the spell ' s duration or for one hour . This spell was used heavily by nomadic tribes who did not have access to wood or other material for their fires . One handful of burning sand provided the same heat as a cooking fire . Burning sand could not be extinguished by any normal means . Components . This spell required sand to cast .

title: Burning spray
description: Burning spray Burning spray is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , particularly those of a draconic heritage . When cast , " burning spray " allows a sorcerer to fling burning liquid from their arm as they sweep it and their implement through the air . The liquid , which sprays into a nearby area of roughly fifteen feet in diameter , causes any creatures it lands upon to be caught on fire , taking damage proportional to the strength of personality exhibited by the sorcerer casting the spell as well as that sorcerer ' s level of power .
description_long: Burning spray Burning spray is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , particularly those of a draconic heritage . When cast , " burning spray " allows a sorcerer to fling burning liquid from their arm as they sweep it and their implement through the air . The liquid , which sprays into a nearby area of roughly fifteen feet in diameter , causes any creatures it lands upon to be caught on fire , taking damage proportional to the strength of personality exhibited by the sorcerer casting the spell as well as that sorcerer ' s level of power . For dragon sorcerers there is an additional benefit to the spell , which leaves a trace of magical flame on the sorcerer so that when hit by an enemy melee attack , the attacker is scorched by the sorcerer ' s flesh to a degree dependent upon the sorcerer ' s physical strength . " Burning spray " is relatively easy to learn and can be recast at - will .

title: Burnt Ridge
description: Burnt Ridge Burnt Ridge was an area of burnt woodland outside the city of Myth Drannor that was used by its wizard s to practice hurling their spells . History . In 714 DR , it served as a last stand for the city ' s wizards who were overcome by the invading Army of Darkness , that would later bring about the fall of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Burnt Ridge Burnt Ridge was an area of burnt woodland outside the city of Myth Drannor that was used by its wizard s to practice hurling their spells . History . In 714 DR , it served as a last stand for the city ' s wizards who were overcome by the invading Army of Darkness , that would later bring about the fall of Myth Drannor .

title: Burrath
description: Burrath Burrath was the bodyguard of Lord Olgarth Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon used the body of Burrath to infiltrate the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth , who had invited Lord Olgarth .
description_long: Burrath Burrath was the bodyguard of Lord Olgarth Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon used the body of Burrath to infiltrate the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth , who had invited Lord Olgarth . However , just after they enter the mansion an order of assassins targeted them .

title: Burrowing owl
description: Burrowing owl Burrowing owls inhabited the High Desert of Zakhara on the plains north of the Range of the Marching Camels . Description . These owls possessed golden feathers and talons twice the size of normal owls .
description_long: Burrowing owl Burrowing owls inhabited the High Desert of Zakhara on the plains north of the Range of the Marching Camels . Description . These owls possessed golden feathers and talons twice the size of normal owls . Behavior . Burrowing owls typically lived near patches of ab ' i tubers . The owls would use their large talons to burrow several feet into the ground to avoid the daytime heat . They could be found in groups of 2 – 8 individuals . Travelers attempting to harvest the ab ' i who disturbed the owls were attacked aggressively .

title: Burto Milibuck
description: Burto Milibuck Burto Milibuck was an insane halfling thief in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Burto was scavenging in the ruins of the city when he saw the avatar of Moander that escaped from Yûlash .
description_long: Burto Milibuck Burto Milibuck was an insane halfling thief in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Burto was scavenging in the ruins of the city when he saw the avatar of Moander that escaped from Yûlash . From that day , he saw vegetable monsters everywhere .

title: Burtrar Malith
description: Burtrar Malith Burtrar Malith was a veteran bodyguard and caravan guard as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Personality . Burtar was particularly quiet and grim .
description_long: Burtrar Malith Burtrar Malith was a veteran bodyguard and caravan guard as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Personality . Burtar was particularly quiet and grim . Abilities . Along with all of the other members of the Company of the Cloak , Burtar possessed an immunity to oil of taggit ( which caused memory loss ) . Relationships . Burtat acted completely loyal to Mhair Gulzrabban , so as not to be deemed expendable yet wished to one day betray the party ' s leader and retire .

title: Bushi
description: Bushi A bushi was a class of fighter common in Kara - Tur . In Shou Lung , the bushi was known as a chanshi or warrior . Culture .
description_long: Bushi A bushi was a class of fighter common in Kara - Tur . In Shou Lung , the bushi was known as a chanshi or warrior . Culture . Although they could come from any race or social class , a bushi was most often a person of low station who , in order to improve their lot in life , had adopted the way of the warrior . A few bushi were failed or disgraced kensai . Many bushi became mercenaries or wandering swordsmen , others brigands or highwaymen . Some were professional soldiers serving in armies , working as guards for noble courts , or working for samurai . All bushi had no masters and no lords and no ties to a temple or monastery . Usually having poor beginnings , and usually still poor , bushi made their money by any means . Fortunately , a sturdy warrior or a strong arm was rarely out of work . Merchants and peasants hired bushi for protection , and though the coin was not great , and the fare and conditions not good , it was sufficient for a bushi to get by . However , it was not unknown for a bushi to steal when they had the need ; good bushi restricted their larceny to their enemies , lawful bushi only when in desperate poverty .

title: Bushido ( organization )
description: Bushido ( organization ) Bushido were a mercenary company based in Chessenta around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership .
description_long: Bushido ( organization ) Bushido were a mercenary company based in Chessenta around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership . Organized as an army , Bushido contained 60 heavy infantry , 60 medium cavalry , and 60 mounted archers . Tactics . Usually , the Bushido used their footmen as a wall against foes while the archers harried them . The cavalry was used for a final attack or to cover a withdrawal . Hard - riding messengers maintained contact between Noro and his three lieutenants . Contracts . The Bushido accepted only honorable work . They charged 700 gold piece s per week for their services . Leadership . They were commanded by the samurai Noro Amoto with a firm hand . Relationships . The Bushido fought two inconclusive battles against the Renegades . History . The samurai Noro Amoto founded the Bushido army to fight the Tuigan during the Horde Wars . Inspired by the Faerûn ians ' bravery during that war , Noro and his men decided to go to Faerûn even after the defeat of the Grand Army of the Tuigan , hoping to learn more about Faerûnian culture in order to strengthen Kara - Tur .

title: Buster Bracer
description: Buster Bracer Buster Bracer was one of the finer armorsmiths of Clan Battlehammer in Mithral Hall . Description . Buster had a blue beard .
description_long: Buster Bracer Buster Bracer was one of the finer armorsmiths of Clan Battlehammer in Mithral Hall . Description . Buster had a blue beard . History . While living in Icewind Dale , Buster crafted Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail . In 1357 DR , Buster worked on several of the Companions of the Hall ' s armor , including Regis . Around 1358 DR , Buster mended the figurine of Guenhwyvar after Catti - brie cut it into two pieces with her sword , Khazid ' hea .

title: Butt
description: Butt A butt was a container used to store beverages in Faerûn . Description . Butts were basically large barrels that stood 6 or 7 ft .
description_long: Butt A butt was a container used to store beverages in Faerûn . Description . Butts were basically large barrels that stood 6 or 7 ft . ( 1 . 8 – 2 . 1 m ) high . A butt could hold 100 gallons ( 378 . 5 liters ) of liquid .

title: Butter tea
description: Butter tea Butter tea was a beverage from Khazari , made from yak butter , salt , and tea . In 1362 DR , the lama Koja thought of yak - butter tea when he remembered his homeland . He was later presented with a magical feast that included it .
description_long: Butter tea Butter tea was a beverage from Khazari , made from yak butter , salt , and tea . In 1362 DR , the lama Koja thought of yak - butter tea when he remembered his homeland . He was later presented with a magical feast that included it .

title: Buzuq
description: Buzuq A buzuq ( buh - ZOOQ ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument that was comparable to an elongated lute . Description . The " buzuq ' s " metallic strings were stretched over a long fretted neck connected to a wider , nearly circular body .
description_long: Buzuq A buzuq ( buh - ZOOQ ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument that was comparable to an elongated lute . Description . The " buzuq ' s " metallic strings were stretched over a long fretted neck connected to a wider , nearly circular body . History . The " buzuq " was one of the favored musical instruments of the wandering tribes of Al - Badia , particularly in the southern regions of the Land of Fate .

title: Buzzard Beak Harbor
description: Buzzard Beak Harbor Buzzard Beak Harbor was a small bay found off the Easting Reach in northeast Faerûn . Geography . Part of the harbor was in Damara and the other part was in Impiltur .
description_long: Buzzard Beak Harbor Buzzard Beak Harbor was a small bay found off the Easting Reach in northeast Faerûn . Geography . Part of the harbor was in Damara and the other part was in Impiltur . The natural harbor was treacherous to shipping due to the many reefs and high concentration of weeds , but it was a popular destination with smugglers and pirates . Inhabitants . Rilaunyr ' s Warship was known to patrol the area .

title: Bwimb
description: Bwimb Bwimb , called the " Baron of Ooze " , was the evil archomental of ooze . History . Bwimb was considered a great general of the planes in ages past .
description_long: Bwimb Bwimb , called the " Baron of Ooze " , was the evil archomental of ooze . History . Bwimb was considered a great general of the planes in ages past . He was apparently summoned to the world of Oerth at least once . Bwimb was one of several powerful planar entities slain by Tenebrous . In a mistaken belief that Bwimb was in possession of the " Wand of Orcus " , the undead demon prince gladly slew Bwimb , whom he had nothing but disdain for when the archomental allegedly did nothing but beg for his life during interrogation . He was succeeded by his daughter Bwimb II . Relationships . In life , Bwimb was an ally of Ghaunadaur and fought for the Queen of Chaos during her war with the Wind Dukes of Aaqa . His daughter was thought to have formed from his remains after his murder .

title: Byronae Trilluach
description: Byronae Trilluach The self - styled Lord Byronae Trilluach was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Byronae still dressed in the typical Ardeep dress .
description_long: Byronae Trilluach The self - styled Lord Byronae Trilluach was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Byronae still dressed in the typical Ardeep dress . He dismissed curiosity about his noble title by affecting annoyance or making the inquirer feel ignorant that she or he did not already know , a tactic that worked well with society snobs . He was a compassionate individual . History . Byronae was born in Ardeep Forest to a moon elf woman and a human mercenary . In 1367 DR , he went to Skullport and soon became the leader of one of the three most powerful mercenary groups , thank to his numerous contacts outside Waterdeep . For this , he was constantly targeted by assassins hired by his competitors until he decided to remain closed up in his villa .

title: Byrtyn Fey
description: Byrtyn Fey Byrtyn Fey was the matron mother of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . Description . Byrtyn had a well - rounded , sensual figure .
description_long: Byrtyn Fey Byrtyn Fey was the matron mother of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . Description . Byrtyn had a well - rounded , sensual figure . She was well aware of this and wore revealing robes and shawls in order to emphasize her sensual appeal . Personality . Byrtyn was known for being hedonistic . She seduced males and had many public " passionate affairs " and " ribald exploits . " She was also a great repository of information about the other houses in the city ; in fact , this knowledge helped deter other houses from attacking her house and revealing their secrets . History . Byrtyn was matron mother in 1367 DR , when it was the eighth house of Menzoberranzan . Her house was long the sixth house until it became the fifth house in 1484 DR when House Xorlarrin departed Menzoberranzan for Q ' Xorlarrin . Byrtyn was still matron mother at this time and sat on the Council of Eight . At time of Rage of Demons she was considered the most skilled in forging alliance Possessions . Byrtyn possessed a six - headed " whip of fangs " , but preferred to use her violet " tentacle rod " as a weapon . She carried a " spider wand " and brewed potent " potions of magic resistance " .

title: Bythnara Shobalar
description: Bythnara Shobalar Bythnara Shobalar was a drow and the twenty - eight - year - old ( in 1348 DR ) daughter of Xandra Shobalar . Personality . She was envious of Liriel Baenre , feeling that Xandra gave her too much affection and that male drow preferred her .
description_long: Bythnara Shobalar Bythnara Shobalar was a drow and the twenty - eight - year - old ( in 1348 DR ) daughter of Xandra Shobalar . Personality . She was envious of Liriel Baenre , feeling that Xandra gave her too much affection and that male drow preferred her . History . Bythnara studied magic under the instruction of her mother , and shared a bedroom with Liriel Baenre . Bythnara was required to kill a goblin for the Blooding coming - of - age ritual . This was considered a weak foe compared to the usually more intelligent or dangerous creatures pitted against drow in this ceremony , and she resented the teasing it brought upon her . Bythnara and Liriel had a strong rivalry , having grown up together . In 1361 DR , Bythnara planned to dispose of her , so Liriel preemptively pushed Bythnara into a lake of flesh - eating " pyrimo " fish . Their friend Syzwick witnessed the murder but swore never to speak of it . Relationships . Bythnara ' s mother was Xandra Shobalar .

title: Byubo
description: Byubo Byubo was the Padhrasattva of " nyum " within the Padhran religion . " Nyum " was a Ra - Khatian word for boldness or guts . History .
description_long: Byubo Byubo was the Padhrasattva of " nyum " within the Padhran religion . " Nyum " was a Ra - Khatian word for boldness or guts . History . The monk s of the Rainbow Monastery worshiped Byubo and helped courageous travelers passing through that particular region of the Katakoro Shan range .

title: Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity
description: Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This magic item looked like a normal butter lamp .
description_long: Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This magic item looked like a normal butter lamp . Powers . Only a true follower of the Padhran religion could hold the lamp without suffering harm . All others would instantly be struck dumb . Followers of the Padhran religion gained the following clerical spells if they filled the lamp with oil , lit it , and then meditated for three hours : Users were only allowed to access one of these spells per day and they were required to use the spell within 24 hours or it would disappear .

title: Byuchyuch
description: Byuchyuch Byuchyuch was a goblin slave of House Do ' Urden in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History . Byuchyuch became an " indentured servant " to House Do ' Urden circa 1307 DR .
description_long: Byuchyuch Byuchyuch was a goblin slave of House Do ' Urden in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History . Byuchyuch became an " indentured servant " to House Do ' Urden circa 1307 DR . In or around 1317 DR , he was summoned by Maya and Malice Do ' Urden to play a part in their plan to force Drizzt Do ' Urden to sled blood before entering Melee - Magthere , the drow fighters ' academy . Malice magically turned Byuchyuch ' s appearance into that of a drow and Maya presented him as her champion , challenging Drizzt to a fight . Drizzt easily overcame the poor fighter . While Byuchyuch was helpless , Drizzt was magically compelled by Malice to kill him . Doing so made Byuchyuch the first being Drizzt had killed .

title: Cabrath Nelinderra
description: Cabrath Nelinderra Cabrath Nelinderra was a female drow keening spirit and a cleric of Kiaransalee . She was considered Irae T ' sarran ' s top lieutenant in life . Description .
description_long: Cabrath Nelinderra Cabrath Nelinderra was a female drow keening spirit and a cleric of Kiaransalee . She was considered Irae T ' sarran ' s top lieutenant in life . Description . In life , Cabrath was a dusky grey - skinned drow woman with amber eyes and gray - white hair . She tended to wear a heavy black robe with rich purple colors inside the sleeves . After her death and transformation into a keening spirit , Cabrath appeared as an insubstantial version of herself with her robes trailing off into smoky nothingness . Personality . A fearless devotee of Kiaransalee , Cabrath was well aware she would be transformed in the event of her death . She kept few physical objects , taking no pleasure in such luxuries . However , upon her transformation into a keening spirit , she seemed to become greatly distraught , wailing and sobbing continuously . Abilities . Cabrath was an adept leader and was considered capable enough to serve as Irae T ' sarran ' s second - in - command of the cult of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra . As a powerful cleric of Kiaransalee , Cabrath had a vast array of divine spells under command ; however , she had an especially keen talent for necromancy spells .

title: Cachiko
description: Cachiko Cachiko was a waitress in the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Cachiko was the granddaughter of Fusae and her translator , being very good in sign language .
description_long: Cachiko Cachiko was a waitress in the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Cachiko was the granddaughter of Fusae and her translator , being very good in sign language . History . Cachiko helped Fusae in managing the House of Heavenly Sand . In 1358 DR , she helped Fusae tell an adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto the truth about the dead body found inside her House .

title: Cadderly Bonaduce
description: Cadderly Bonaduce Cadderly Bonaduce is a priest and Chosen of Deneir . Appearance . Standing 6 feet tall and weighing a bit under 200 pounds , Cadderly is a handsome man in his late 20s with striking gray eyes , curly brown hair and a sincere , warm smile .
description_long: Cadderly Bonaduce Cadderly Bonaduce is a priest and Chosen of Deneir . Appearance . Standing 6 feet tall and weighing a bit under 200 pounds , Cadderly is a handsome man in his late 20s with striking gray eyes , curly brown hair and a sincere , warm smile . If he is angered , his glare can be unrelenting . Due to the extensive use of magic in the construction of the Spirit Soaring , Cadderly aged rapidly . By the time the church was completed , his body was as that of a 100 - year old man . As a reward from Deneir though , Cadderly gradually returned to his normal age over the course of several years . During the battle of Spirit Soaring against the Crenshinibon infused Dracolich Hephaestus , the Spirit Soaring took considerable damage . With Cadderly ' s life - force tied into the Spirit Soaring , every inch of damage the Spirit Soaring took aged Cadderly . Cadderly now appears as a 60 - year - old man that walks a sealing ward around Spirit Soaring in between the Material Plane and the Plane of Shadow .

title: Cadogan
description: Cadogan Cadogan was an adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Cadogan was once an adventurer and a member of the large adventuring party called Her Majesty ' s Reconnaissance Team .
description_long: Cadogan Cadogan was an adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Cadogan was once an adventurer and a member of the large adventuring party called Her Majesty ' s Reconnaissance Team . They were tasked by a crazy noblewoman with recovering family items from Netheril . After the noblewoman died , the adventurers kept the profits they acquired . However , the death of the noblewoman triggered a curse upon the company and they started dying , one each year . In 1370 DR , only Cadogan and two others remained and he was becoming paranoid .

title: Caelar Argent
description: Caelar Argent Caelar Argent , most commonly known as the Shining Lady , led a crusade against Dragonspear Castle around 1368 DR . She hailed from Waterdeep , where her family had ties with the Order of the Aster . Her uncle Aun Argent was a noted paladin in the Order and Caelar was also a member .
description_long: Caelar Argent Caelar Argent , most commonly known as the Shining Lady , led a crusade against Dragonspear Castle around 1368 DR . She hailed from Waterdeep , where her family had ties with the Order of the Aster . Her uncle Aun Argent was a noted paladin in the Order and Caelar was also a member . Divine blood runs through the Argents family , it had lain dormant generations till Caelar was born . As a child of nine , she was tasked to watch over the Order ' s library where she succumbed to temptation and read aloud from the Tome of The Nine then got herself locked in Belhifet ' s torture cage in Avernus . Aun Argent made an offer to Belhifet and trade his own soul for Caelar ' s . Afterward , Caelar left the order , then she met Hephernaan , a strange cleric who is a servant of Belhifet . Hephernaan hid his true identity well and managed to convince Caelar to lead a crusade to invade Avernus in order to rescue her uncle . They gathered an army and marched to Dragonspear Castle , where it was known that a " gate " to the Nine Hells existed .

title: Caelynna
description: Caelynna Caelynna , often referred to as The Blue Lady , was a powerful Eladrin wizard who was banished to Toril around the same time the spellplague struck . She was bound to a small piece of the Feywild that was transported to the bottom of the Sea of Fallen Stars between Pirate Isle and Prespur . She was either spellscarred by the spellplague or was able to develop her own innate powers to make herself much more powerful than she had been on Abeir .
description_long: Caelynna Caelynna , often referred to as The Blue Lady , was a powerful Eladrin wizard who was banished to Toril around the same time the spellplague struck . She was bound to a small piece of the Feywild that was transported to the bottom of the Sea of Fallen Stars between Pirate Isle and Prespur . She was either spellscarred by the spellplague or was able to develop her own innate powers to make herself much more powerful than she had been on Abeir . She twisted the sea creatures into strange monsters and created an area where surface dwellers could breath and move freely underwater . Caelynna began using her powers to sink ships that travelled close to her domain . So many ships were sunk that sailors began to tell of legends of the Blue Lady . One the passengers on a ship she sunk named the Grayling was the scribe Bayel Droust who had in his possession two books written by a Shou monk named Liou Chang that described how to open teleportation gates . Caelynna wanted the magic so that she could open a gate and return to the Feywild . She imprisoned Bayel and kept him alive for many years while he worked at translating the books .

title: Caemon
description: Caemon Caemon was a priest of Amaunator in Hillsfar . History . During a pilgrimage , he came across the Cult of the Dragon ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains and was captured by Talis Kasterel .
description_long: Caemon Caemon was a priest of Amaunator in Hillsfar . History . During a pilgrimage , he came across the Cult of the Dragon ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains and was captured by Talis Kasterel . However , he received good treatment , not like Craggnor and Miresella . Caemon suspected that this was because she wanted to convert him or to use him as a sacrifice to Tiamat .

title: Caer - Dineval
description: Caer - Dineval Caer - Dineval was one of the towns of Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Dineval was located on the northwestern bank of Lac Dinneshere , not far south of Caer - Konig .
description_long: Caer - Dineval Caer - Dineval was one of the towns of Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Dineval was located on the northwestern bank of Lac Dinneshere , not far south of Caer - Konig . The two towns had an agreement to share fishing rights , but nevertheless squabbled over fishing territory . The town itself is situated in a half - circle around Knucklehead Harbor , with The Caer castle overlooking the habor from the Cliffs of Dinev in the east . History . The Dinev family , displaced from their home in Cormyr , originally built the castle in 1050 DR , hoping to claim all of Icewind Dale for themselves but abandoned it eight years later in 1058 DR due to an orc siege that eliminated the town ' s population , either by death or by forcing them to flee . The Dinevs starved after three weeks inside their home and were too weak to fight back when the orcs got inside . A decade later , the castle was retaken from the orcs by the ancestors of the current townsfolk . In 1356 DR , young Jensin Brent was the councilman of the town . As spokesman , he lived in the Caer and greedily defended fishing rights against Caer - Konig .

title: Caer - Konig
description: Caer - Konig Caer - Konig was one of the towns of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Konig was located on the northern shore of Lac Dinneshere , not far from Caer - Dineval .
description_long: Caer - Konig Caer - Konig was one of the towns of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Konig was located on the northern shore of Lac Dinneshere , not far from Caer - Dineval . The fishing waters of the lake were shared between the two towns , but fishermen nevertheless often squabbled over territory . History . Dorim Lugar was the councilman of the town until he was killed over a fish in 1356 DR . His second - in - command , Schermont , became the new councilman after the incident . Schermont was known for his heavy - handed approach to rulership , and he held a particular grudge against Caer - Dineval . After the war with Akar Kessell and the Battle of Icewind Dale , Caer - Konig was given to the barbarian s , although the barbarians later left town for the open tundra . Description . The town straddled the round harbor in a semicircle , with a line of buildings at the edge of the harbor , an uphill slope , and a circular round with buildings .

title: Caer Callidyrr
description: Caer Callidyrr Caer Callidyrr was the capital city of the Ffolk people on the Moonshaes island of Alaron , overlooking Whitefish Bay . Its castle was constructed from alabaster and it was the tallest man - made structure in the Moonshaes . It was inhabited by the monarchy of the Ffolk .
description_long: Caer Callidyrr Caer Callidyrr was the capital city of the Ffolk people on the Moonshaes island of Alaron , overlooking Whitefish Bay . Its castle was constructed from alabaster and it was the tallest man - made structure in the Moonshaes . It was inhabited by the monarchy of the Ffolk .

title: Caer Corwell
description: Caer Corwell Caer Corwell was a small city and a mile outside of Lowhill on the isle of Gwynneth . Geography . The keep was located on a rocky cliff overlooking the common fields of Corwell and the waters of Corwell Firth .
description_long: Caer Corwell Caer Corwell was a small city and a mile outside of Lowhill on the isle of Gwynneth . Geography . The keep was located on a rocky cliff overlooking the common fields of Corwell and the waters of Corwell Firth . Structure . Castle . The castle was surrounded by a high wooden which ended in a stone gatehouse . The front gates of the castle were made of strong wood and an iron was lowered from the gatehouse , which had four stout watchtowers . Rising above the from the courtyard , the keep was protected by three towers ; the banner of the Kendrick family , a silver bear on a black field , hung in splendor from the tallest point of the castle . Within the keep , Caer Corwell had a huge hall with two great tables and a large fireplace in the corner . City . A large village green spread out below the keep with a druid ' s grove , surrounded by a ring of massive oak trees in the center , that also contained a Moonwell . The small wooden buildings of the Ffolk were protected by a three - sided low stone wall . A wooden harbor jutting out into the Corwell Firth was used to moor Corwellian fishing boats , coracles and Calishite trading vessels .

title: Caftan
description: Caftan A caftan was a long ankle - length garment worn in Zakhara . Description . The robe was usually made with cotton , but finer versions could be crafted from silk or brocade .
description_long: Caftan A caftan was a long ankle - length garment worn in Zakhara . Description . The robe was usually made with cotton , but finer versions could be crafted from silk or brocade . When worn , a sash was used as a belt around the waist . Nearly every woman in Calimshan would dress in a caftan . A typical caftan had a base value of 1 gp , but more elaborate ones could cost up to 20 gp .

title: Cage
description: Cage The Cage was a special prison located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Cage was completely enclosed by " walls of force " .
description_long: Cage The Cage was a special prison located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Cage was completely enclosed by " walls of force " . Powerful enchantments were in place to ensure that spellcasting , or the use of magical abilities , was not possible within the Cage . Activities . This enchanted prison was used to house dangerous mages , priests , and genie s . Due to the powerful enchantments warding the Cage , the Grand Caliph could safely question anyone held within . Still , he was always accompanied by an escort of the Dutiful , a sha ' ir , and several genies .

title: Cailek Balathorp
description: Cailek Balathorp Cailek Balathorp was a noble of Ravens Bluff who made his living by capturing surface dwellers and delivering them to the drow who lived in the Underdark beneath the city . He went by the nickname Fetterfists while operating as a slaver . Description .
description_long: Cailek Balathorp Cailek Balathorp was a noble of Ravens Bluff who made his living by capturing surface dwellers and delivering them to the drow who lived in the Underdark beneath the city . He went by the nickname Fetterfists while operating as a slaver . Description . Balathorp was tall and lanky with blond hair . In the guise of Fetterfists , he wore a leather half hood that obscured most of his face . History . In 1479 DR , Fetterfist ' s gang attacked a caravan near Ravens Bluff and delivered their captives to the drow beneath the city . A young noblewoman named Seila Norwood was among the slaves . Later , Balathorp was hired by the drow to return Jack Ravenwild to imprisonment in their underground realm . Jack tricked Balathorp into an ambush at a warehouse and captured him with the help of the Blue Wyvern Company . Thinking the city watch would imprison Balathorp , Jack tied him up in the warehouse and left a note describing Balathorp ' s crimes . Unfortunately , the city magistrates didn ' t believe a noble of Balathorp ' s stature could be a slaver so they set him free .

title: Cain
description: Cain Cain was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Cain was a performer in the Blacklake District .
description_long: Cain Cain was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Cain was a performer in the Blacklake District . History . Cain was a famous musician of Neverwinter . He allowed less - skilled musicians to play , only to humiliate them for their poor skill in performing . Gameplay . If the Kalach - Cha gained entrance to Blacklake , then Cain would embarrass one of the performers . The Kalach - Cha could choose act in his performance , by repeating his tones , either with honest skill or having Grobnar Gnomehands repeat the tones . After each successful performance , the Kalach - Cha could impress the audience or insult Cain . Furthermore , Qara could make fireworks , Sand could insult Cain , or Grobnar could play a duet with the Kalach - Cha in the final performance . Cain would be surprised and give them a lute . If the Kalach - Cha failed , they could attack Cain with fire and get the lute back .

title: Caiphon
description: Caiphon Caiphon was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Caiphon did not have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .
description_long: Caiphon Caiphon was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Caiphon did not have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description . Caiphon was a purple star . History . Caiphon , and the other Far Realm - infested stars of Realmspace , were somehow related to the Eldest . Many believed Caiphon was a guide star , but Caiphon usually betrayed those who relied too much upon it . In times of need , when even prayers to the god s failed , people offered their pleas to the star for help . On rare occasions , Caiphon listened and sent one of its emissaries . The emissary seemed like a good person , trying to help people to solve their problems . But not long after , chaos and war became common in the regions the emissary had appeared . In 1396 DR , after having lose his pact with the archfey Neifion , the warlock Japheth Donard made a pact with Caiphon .

title: Cairn
description: Cairn Cairn was a divine conjuration spell that created a pile of rocks . Effect . The spell gathered rocks and stones from all around ( not including any organic or other materials ) and dropped them on a given location from a height of 20 feet ( 6 meters ) .
description_long: Cairn Cairn was a divine conjuration spell that created a pile of rocks . Effect . The spell gathered rocks and stones from all around ( not including any organic or other materials ) and dropped them on a given location from a height of 20 feet ( 6 meters ) . This created a rough pile some 5 feet ( 1 . 5 meters ) and 15 feet ( 4 . 5 meters ) high . Uses . The " cairn " spell had a number of common uses , typically to form a grave , but also to mark a specific location , to bury or hide a buried stash or store , or whatever else one might use a pile of rocks for . More dangerously , it could be used to crush a victim under the falling rocks , and even bury them . Components . The spell required at least eight pebbles that could all fit in the caster ' s hand . The actual stones used in the " cairn " were lifted from random locations in the vicinity . History . The " cairn " spell appeared within the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the church of Ilmater , which first appeared in the Realms in 848 DR . In 1341 DR , the rogue priest of Ilmater , Brother Bloirt Waelarn used a " cairn " spell from the " Tome " to bury Sir Guth .

title: Cakl
description: Cakl Cakl was a Payit in Maztica in 1362 DR . History . In 1362 DR , he was one of the Payit recruited by the rogue priestess of Helm Mirandos .
description_long: Cakl Cakl was a Payit in Maztica in 1362 DR . History . In 1362 DR , he was one of the Payit recruited by the rogue priestess of Helm Mirandos . However , after he arrived in Ixtzul , the bacar , with Mirandos at their side , arrived and slaughtered all of Cakl ' s fellows . Cakl managed to escape and went back to his home . During the journey , he met an adventuring party hired by Bishop Devane to find the missing Mirandos .

title: Caknol
description: Caknol Caknol was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .
description_long: Caknol Caknol was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing . He invoked the protection of the god , which earned him the ire of Erixitl , who asked why the god had permitted the deaths of so many people .

title: Caladnei
description: Caladnei Caladnei ( kah - " lad " - nay ) was the Royal Mage of the Cormyr ian court , replacing Vangerdahast after his retirement . She was renowned for her feisty and opinionated personality and was often seen as hard to deal with in the Court . Caladnei was also the leader of the famed War Wizards .
description_long: Caladnei Caladnei ( kah - " lad " - nay ) was the Royal Mage of the Cormyr ian court , replacing Vangerdahast after his retirement . She was renowned for her feisty and opinionated personality and was often seen as hard to deal with in the Court . Caladnei was also the leader of the famed War Wizards . Background . Raised in Turmish by her Cormyrian father and Turmian mother , Caladnei had traveled throughout Faerûn in her youth , often via portals . She trained her fighting skills in Waterdeep , dueled with wizard s in Halruaa , and even learned forging skills with the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . When Caladnei ' s mother died in a storm at sea , her father took ill , and she returned to care for him . She began supporting herself as a mercenary and crafter of minor magical items . It was around this time that she attracted the attention of Vangerdahast and began the path to her position as Royal Mage . Caladnei was the only Mage Royal of Cormyr that was not descended from Baerauble Etharr and Alea Dahast . In 1399 DR , Caladnei was ravaged by the expanding Spellplague while in a heavily - warded spellcasting chamber known as the Dragonskull Chamber .

title: Caladorn Cassalanter
description: Caladorn Cassalanter Caladorn Cassalanter was a young and gallant secret Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Caladorn was a fighter : broad - shouldered , tall ( six feet ) , and he acted with purpose .
description_long: Caladorn Cassalanter Caladorn Cassalanter was a young and gallant secret Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Caladorn was a fighter : broad - shouldered , tall ( six feet ) , and he acted with purpose . He had short dark red or brown hair and was clean - shaven . He was somewhat older than his friend Danilo Thann . Personality . Caladorn was quite perceptive and intelligent . He loved to have fun , when the occasion called for it . Activities . He was very interested in the city ' s navy and understood the challenges they had in maintaining order around the Sea of Swords . History . Background . A member of the noble family of Cassalanter , one of the richest families in Waterdeep , Caladorn ceased using his family ' s name until he had done " something worthy of it . " His father , Lord Ohrl Cassalanter , believed that Caladorn would never deem himself worthy , and so he was left with the benefits of his birthright but none of the responsibilities . Starlight & Shadows . In 1361 DR , Caladorn was traveling on the ship " Cutter " , a seal - hunting ship captained by Farlow in the Sea of Moving Ice .

title: Caladorn the Wise
description: Caladorn the Wise King Caladorn the Wise was a ruler of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn before the 14th century DR . King Caladorn decreed that priests could not judge a person ' s worldly behavior . As a result , priests could not serve as either king ' s justices or baron ' s justices in the kingdom .
description_long: Caladorn the Wise King Caladorn the Wise was a ruler of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn before the 14th century DR . King Caladorn decreed that priests could not judge a person ' s worldly behavior . As a result , priests could not serve as either king ' s justices or baron ' s justices in the kingdom . The lieko , the gold coin currency of the realm used around 1367 DR , bore an image of King Caladorn the Wise on the front , with a mounted knight on the back .

title: Calantar ' s Way
description: Calantar ' s Way Calantar ' s Way was a long road running north to south in the nation of Cormyr . The northernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Arabel . The southernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Suzail .
description_long: Calantar ' s Way Calantar ' s Way was a long road running north to south in the nation of Cormyr . The northernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Arabel . The southernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Suzail . Calantar ' s Way crossed the Starwater River at Calantar ' s Bridge , just south of the town of Hilp . History . Calantar ' s Way was surveyed and built by the Calantar noble family in the late 900s DR as a cart road . Realmslore . Calantar ' s Way had been well - cared - for over the years by those who used it .

title: Calanti Snowdrop
description: Calanti Snowdrop Fatima Asad was a language teacher at the Grand University of Huzuz in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . Fatima was an albino with white hair , pale skin , and red eyes .
description_long: Calanti Snowdrop Fatima Asad was a language teacher at the Grand University of Huzuz in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . Fatima was an albino with white hair , pale skin , and red eyes . Activities . Fatima was actually just a fake identity created by the drow known as Calanti Snowdrop . Calanti was a mage from Dambrath who was sent to spy for her country to distant Zakhara . She used her magic to appear as an albino . She wished to return to her Queen in Dambrath in possession of an imprisoned genie .

title: Calathanorgoth
description: Calathanorgoth Calathanorgoth , also known as The Old One , was a powerful black dragon dracolich in High Moor in 1370 DR . Relationships . The dracolich lived in the ruins of Orogoth with her offspring : the venerable mated pair Wastirek and Vilholin , their son the adult Woklef and the young Aswidorg , and the mature adult female Cheleen .
description_long: Calathanorgoth Calathanorgoth , also known as The Old One , was a powerful black dragon dracolich in High Moor in 1370 DR . Relationships . The dracolich lived in the ruins of Orogoth with her offspring : the venerable mated pair Wastirek and Vilholin , their son the adult Woklef and the young Aswidorg , and the mature adult female Cheleen .

title: Calathlarra
description: Calathlarra Calathlarra was a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune around late 1487 DR . History . Calthlarra was one of the most cold and emotionless leaders of the Twisted Rune .
description_long: Calathlarra Calathlarra was a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune around late 1487 DR . History . Calthlarra was one of the most cold and emotionless leaders of the Twisted Rune . She was one of the archmages who competed for possession of the Lost Spell during a spellstorm . Calathlarra tried to kill Tabra but was ultimately killed by her in the fight .

title: Calaunt
description: Calaunt Calaunt was a city - state in the Vast , and formerly the village of Vespermouth . It sat on the mouth of the mouth of the River Vesper on the eastern side of the Dragon Reach , at the end of Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar and at the end of the Hlintar Ride from Hlintar . Language .
description_long: Calaunt Calaunt was a city - state in the Vast , and formerly the village of Vespermouth . It sat on the mouth of the mouth of the River Vesper on the eastern side of the Dragon Reach , at the end of Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar and at the end of the Hlintar Ride from Hlintar . Language . The city ' s people spoke the Easting language , which was related to the Damaran language . People and things from here were called " Calauntan " . The terms " Calauntian " and " Calaunan " were both incorrect . History . The Time of Glorious Fools . Originally , this was the site of the village of Vespermouth , named for its location on the mouth of the River Vesper . Prior to Calaunt ' s rise as a city , it was held by a band of robber - barons , who constructed the Fortress of the Five Vultures , which was named for them . During the Vast ' s so - called Time of Glorious Fools ( from 649 DR onwards ) , Calaunt was among those harbors that served as landing spots for immigrants and rest stops for pirates . These harbors were developed as trade ports for the trading vessels came from Aglarond , Impiltur , Sembia , and Westgate .

title: Calcitro Burrow
description: Calcitro Burrow Calcitro Burrow was the mayor of Beluir in 1367 DR . Description . Due to his love of food and drink , Calcitro was a portly fellow .
description_long: Calcitro Burrow Calcitro Burrow was the mayor of Beluir in 1367 DR . Description . Due to his love of food and drink , Calcitro was a portly fellow . Most of his opponents took one look at him and dismissed him as a warrior , a mistake he took full advantage of . Activities . As a member of the wealthy Burrow family , Calcitro helped manage their fruit plantation and several inns that they owned in the city . History . Calcitro single - handedly dispatched a pair of giant s in his youth , granting him legendary warrior status in Beluir . Possessions . Calcitro owned a nasty " dagger of severing " .

title: Caldor Fuldren
description: Caldor Fuldren Caldor Fuldren was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Caldor Fuldren Caldor Fuldren was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . Caldor was cruel and capricious , but fanatically dedicated to the Bron . He was known to attack , verbally and sometimes physically without warning , anyone who appeared to be speaking or working against the Bron ' s plans for the city . He was often erratic in battle but would usually listen to and follow the orders of Andrus Kriivor , the " de facto " leader of the deputies . Abilities . Andrus was a specialist with the short sword . Possessions . He wore chain mail and carried a shield , but he could don plate mail stored in a few caches around town if needed . He carried a short sword , club , and dagger . History . Caldor was trained by the Zhentilar and chosen for the position of deputy .

title: Caldor Raventree
description: Caldor Raventree Caldor Raventree was a young War Wizard of Cormyr from Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Caldor was among the many War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail .
description_long: Caldor Raventree Caldor Raventree was a young War Wizard of Cormyr from Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Caldor was among the many War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail . On this occasion , veteran wizard Yarjack Blamreld checked Caldor ' s personality .

title: Caldreth ' s Cobbling
description: Caldreth ' s Cobbling Caldreth ' s Cobbling was a shop in the town of Mornbryn ' s Shield as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Services . Caldreth Wyvernlyng repaired shoes , boots , and cloaks .
description_long: Caldreth ' s Cobbling Caldreth ' s Cobbling was a shop in the town of Mornbryn ' s Shield as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Services . Caldreth Wyvernlyng repaired shoes , boots , and cloaks . He also produced high , heavy leather boots that were waxed and waterproof , suitable for wading in streams , rivers , and lakes .

title: Caleb
description: Caleb Caleb was a male human bandit of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Caleb was one of the local Docks ' thugs , who was acting under Moire ' s employ .
description_long: Caleb Caleb was a male human bandit of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Caleb was one of the local Docks ' thugs , who was acting under Moire ' s employ . He did not respect the Watch , at all . Gameplay . If the Kalach - Cha and the compaions sided with the Watch , after helping Hagen defeat the thieves they would have to visit Caleb . Caleb refused to be arrested , so he and his thugs attacked them . If the Kalach - Cha and the companions sided with the thieves , Caleb would ask them to threaten Hagen . After returning to Caleb , Hagen would come back with the guards and attack . Once they were defeated , Caleb would advise the Kalach - Cha to speak with Moire .

title: Caledan Caldorien
description: Caledan Caldorien Caledan Caldorien was once a member of the Harpers and the adventuring group known as the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon . Relationships . While working with the Harper Mari Al ' maren , his comrades from the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon and his son Kellen , Caledan found meaning in his life .
description_long: Caledan Caldorien Caledan Caldorien was once a member of the Harpers and the adventuring group known as the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon . Relationships . While working with the Harper Mari Al ' maren , his comrades from the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon and his son Kellen , Caledan found meaning in his life .

title: Calendar of Harptos
description: Calendar of Harptos The Calendar of Harptos was the calendar used across most of Faerûn . It was created by the wizard Harptos of Kaalinth , although most people associate the word " Harptos " with the calendar . It was split into twelve months , each lasting three tenday s ( or thirty days ) .
description_long: Calendar of Harptos The Calendar of Harptos was the calendar used across most of Faerûn . It was created by the wizard Harptos of Kaalinth , although most people associate the word " Harptos " with the calendar . It was split into twelve months , each lasting three tenday s ( or thirty days ) . There were an additional five days that fell between months , bringing the total number of days in most years to 365 . Months and festivals . The names of the months and festivals used in Faerûn were as follows : Date conventions . The days making up a tenday did not have formal names . If precision was required , the number of the day and the number of the tenday were used , as in , " the fourth day of the first tenday of Flamerule " . Days of the month were typically written as the numerical date followed by the month name , for example , " 15 Hammer " or " " . Informally or poetically this could be spoken or written as " " .

title: Calesaer
description: Calesaer Calesaer was a large wood elf in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Calesaer was traveling through the Moonsea in order to look for his sister in the Border Forest .
description_long: Calesaer Calesaer was a large wood elf in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Calesaer was traveling through the Moonsea in order to look for his sister in the Border Forest . He stopped for a drink at the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . Relationship . Calesaer knew the situation of Hillsfar and tried to avoid attention over himself .

title: Calhyar
description: Calhyar Calhyar , or Calhyar of the Winds , was the third senior Witches of Rashemen in Mulsantir and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Personality . Khelben himself did not understand the motivations of Calhyar but preferred to have her close in order to unveil her secret .
description_long: Calhyar Calhyar , or Calhyar of the Winds , was the third senior Witches of Rashemen in Mulsantir and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Personality . Khelben himself did not understand the motivations of Calhyar but preferred to have her close in order to unveil her secret . History . Calhyar was the first to offer her services to Khelben Arunsun , saying to had have a premonition about four years before . Khelben accepted her only because he himself knew little about Rashemen and hoped to collect more information from Calhyar .

title: Caligarde ' s claw
description: Caligarde ' s claw Caligarde ' s claw was an arcane conjuration spell that created an invisible claw made of pure force , similar to the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . This spell could be cast at a target up to 60 yd ( 55 m ) away .
description_long: Caligarde ' s claw Caligarde ' s claw was an arcane conjuration spell that created an invisible claw made of pure force , similar to the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . This spell could be cast at a target up to 60 yd ( 55 m ) away . The target could be a particular entity or a 20 - ft ( 6 . 1 m ) diameter circular area . If the target was an individual , then that person had a chance to resist the spell , in which case the claw was created 10 ft ( 3 m ) away in a random direction , as if it were a missed grenade - like missile attack . Once cast on an area , either intentionally or by missing the intended target , the claw attacked the nearest being within its 10 ft ( 3 m ) reach . " Caligarde ' s claw " attacked once per minute for a duration equal to the caster ' s level , and with the same skill as the caster , but with the added feature that once it hit , it never missed again . If this spell successfully targeted an individual , then it was not fixed in place but continued to attack that being even if they moved more than 10 ft ( 3 m ) away .

title: Caligrosto
description: Caligrosto Caligrostos are perhaps the most sadistic of the known types of loumara , and considering the other three include the nature - razing wrath of the manitou s , the corpse - haunting decadence of the dybbuk s , and the murder - happy malevolence of the guecubu s , this indicates a level of cruelty that some demon s might even be shocked at . Spawned in the Dreaming Gulf of the Abyss from the nightmares of a long - forgotten dead god of healing and craftsmanship , the caligrosto come into the world with a red lust for the edge of a blade . Although incorporeal ( and remaining so once they have created a fiend ish shade ) , a caligrosto ’ s weapon remains a physical object and is thus subject to armor .
description_long: Caligrosto Caligrostos are perhaps the most sadistic of the known types of loumara , and considering the other three include the nature - razing wrath of the manitou s , the corpse - haunting decadence of the dybbuk s , and the murder - happy malevolence of the guecubu s , this indicates a level of cruelty that some demon s might even be shocked at . Spawned in the Dreaming Gulf of the Abyss from the nightmares of a long - forgotten dead god of healing and craftsmanship , the caligrosto come into the world with a red lust for the edge of a blade . Although incorporeal ( and remaining so once they have created a fiend ish shade ) , a caligrosto ’ s weapon remains a physical object and is thus subject to armor . Likewise , while a caligrosto can move through solid objects , they do so only in cases of extreme peril , since doing so forces them to leave behind their weapon and abandon their current fiendish shade . A caligrosto forced to abandon a favored weapon becomes obsessed with reclaiming control of that weapon , and once it does so , its wrath invariably turns upon those who forced it to abandon its blade . Ecology .

title: Calihye
description: Calihye Calihye was a female half - elf bounty hunter of some reputation in Vaasa . Description . Calihye had light blue , almost gray eyes , thin lips in an angular beautiful face were it not for a nasty scar on her right cheek .
description_long: Calihye Calihye was a female half - elf bounty hunter of some reputation in Vaasa . Description . Calihye had light blue , almost gray eyes , thin lips in an angular beautiful face were it not for a nasty scar on her right cheek . She had long black hair . Calihye was of medium height , lithe but strong , her graceful body being outlined by tight cords of muscles . She moved with the grace of a skilled warrior . Due to her scar she talked with a distinct lisp . She had received the scar on her lip while battling a pirate , his gaff hook drawing a jagged line from her cheek through the edge of her lips to the middle of her chin . Personality . The half - elf warrior could be ferocious or tender , often using her feminine charms on unwitting opponents on the battlefield , throwing them off guard before eviscerating them . History . Calihye made quite a bounty hunter of herself in Vaasa , her name topping the list of bounty hunter pay - outs . She worked alongside Parissus of Impiltur . In 1368 DR , Calihye fell in love with Artemis Entreri , the man who killed her dear friend Parissus .

title: Calim
description: Calim Calim was the noble djinni lord who founded the Calim Empire in what is now Calimshan . For millennia his body and mind were split and imprisoned in the Calim Desert . Description .
description_long: Calim Calim was the noble djinni lord who founded the Calim Empire in what is now Calimshan . For millennia his body and mind were split and imprisoned in the Calim Desert . Description . There are no records describing Calim when he had a physical form . His manifestation within the Calim Desert was known as " Calim ' s Breath " . Calim ' s Breath was a low , mournful tone on the winds , or a whispering breeze , or a thundering boom in a storm . However , on rare occasion , when Calim gathered the remnants of his magical power together , he could shape the clouds or dust with wind and appear in the form of a 50 - foot - tall genie . Personality . In his solid form , Calim was a tactical genius and innovator . He saw his rule as that of an artist . Every city and battle plan was seen as a masterpiece in his eyes . For this reason he was slow and calculating in all of his plans both civic and military . Abilities . In his disembodied and imprisoned form , Calim bore a strong resistance to spells and magical effects , apart , of course , from the elven high magic that was binding him .

title: Calim Desert
description: Calim Desert The Calim Desert was a rocky desert on the coast in the country of Calimshan . It was not formed by natural means , instead being the result of an epic magical war between two genie s , the djinn i Calim and efreet i Memnon . The sands hid the ruins of ancient cities , which were said to hold many treasures .
description_long: Calim Desert The Calim Desert was a rocky desert on the coast in the country of Calimshan . It was not formed by natural means , instead being the result of an epic magical war between two genie s , the djinn i Calim and efreet i Memnon . The sands hid the ruins of ancient cities , which were said to hold many treasures . Geography . The Calim Desert dominated the western half of Calimshan . The desert was contained to the east by the mighty Calim River . Counterclockwise from north to south , the desert was also bordered by the River Agis , the Trackless Sea , and the Shining Sea . The desert was roughly 100 feet below sea level , sloping at a gradual decline from the coast over 10 miles . Geographical Features . The Calim Desert was primarily a level and rocky , yet the magical effects of Calim and Memnon could change that . These often dangerous manifestations of the two genies were called " Calim ' s Breath " and " Memnon ' s Crackle " . The former was the cause of frequent sandstorms and whirlwinds ; the latter the cause of earthquakes or the creation of patches of hot sand . Flora and Fauna .

title: Calim Empire
description: Calim Empire The Calim Caliphates , more commonly referred to as the Calim Empire , was the great kingdom founded by the noble djinn i Calim and his people , the Djen . Geography . At its peak , the empire stretched from the southern Sword Coast to the River Agis and along the Marching Mountains to the Alimir Mountains and south to the Shining Sea .
description_long: Calim Empire The Calim Caliphates , more commonly referred to as the Calim Empire , was the great kingdom founded by the noble djinn i Calim and his people , the Djen . Geography . At its peak , the empire stretched from the southern Sword Coast to the River Agis and along the Marching Mountains to the Alimir Mountains and south to the Shining Sea . Government . For all but the last few decades of its existence , the empire was under the sole control of Calim , who ruled as caleph . History . Most of the history of the Caliphates were tied with that of Calim .

title: Calim River
description: Calim River The Calim River was the largest river in Calimshan . It formed the eastern border of the Calim Desert . Geography .
description_long: Calim River The Calim River was the largest river in Calimshan . It formed the eastern border of the Calim Desert . Geography . Its headwaters were in the western Marching Mountains . Despite its breadth , the river had a surprisingly strong current , and its waters were full of fish . South of Keltar , the river grew slow and wide until it reached the ocean at Calimport . Features . The Calim River flooded yearly , and this supply of water to the surrounding fields resulted in the most fertile farmland in all of Calimshan . The town of Keltar rested alongside the river , and massive sluice gates were used to divert the water into the canals of the town . This water was used for mills and to turn giant fans to blow the smell of cattle and tanneries away .

title: Calim cactus
description: Calim cactus Calim cacti were small , sharp - thorned cacti native to the Calim Desert that grew to between three and four inches tall . However , they had vast root systems that spread out over nearly a dozen square feet under the surface . These roots often poked through the surface and absorbed moisture from the air .
description_long: Calim cactus Calim cacti were small , sharp - thorned cacti native to the Calim Desert that grew to between three and four inches tall . However , they had vast root systems that spread out over nearly a dozen square feet under the surface . These roots often poked through the surface and absorbed moisture from the air . They could live in different types of soil , from hard to sandy , and grew very quickly . It was said that they could even shift positions overnight .

title: Calimar Arkhenneld
description: Calimar Arkhenneld Calimar Arkhenneld was a drow lich enchanter of the city of Sshamath in the 14th century DR . He was the Master Emeritus of the School of Enchantment and Charm , as well as a former member of the ruling Conclave of Sshamath . History .
description_long: Calimar Arkhenneld Calimar Arkhenneld was a drow lich enchanter of the city of Sshamath in the 14th century DR . He was the Master Emeritus of the School of Enchantment and Charm , as well as a former member of the ruling Conclave of Sshamath . History . Calimar was more than thirteen hundred years old by mid – 14th century , putting his birthdate around the start of Dalereckoning . In time , Calimar became the leader of the School of Enchantment and Charm and so a member of the ruling Conclave . However , after a time , he resigned to dedicate himself to study . Activities . Calimar had little interest in the everyday politics of the city and the Conclave . Instead , he concentrated one studying the mysteries of magic , devoting himself to the goddess Mystra . He was also the top creator of magical items in the city . In his long years of activity , Calimar created hundreds of unique objects , some copied from examples brought from fallen Netheril .

title: Calimban Knoll
description: Calimban Knoll Calimban Knoll , formerly called Calim ' s Bane , was a stone circle marking where a battle was fought in the Calim Desert at the end of the Fourth Age of Calimshan . Geography . Located near the northern border of the Calim Desert , 25 miles south of Memnon just off the Trade Way , Calimban Knoll was a circle of 21 s 700 yards in diameter with a tiny , rocky mound in the center .
description_long: Calimban Knoll Calimban Knoll , formerly called Calim ' s Bane , was a stone circle marking where a battle was fought in the Calim Desert at the end of the Fourth Age of Calimshan . Geography . Located near the northern border of the Calim Desert , 25 miles south of Memnon just off the Trade Way , Calimban Knoll was a circle of 21 s 700 yards in diameter with a tiny , rocky mound in the center . The appearance of this site varied depending on conditions in the desert . At times , the hill was exposed ; at other times , sand covered the knoll , such that only the tops of the standing stones were visible . By 1370 DR , a third of the stones had toppled over . History . The site memorialized where a small band of escaped slaves held off a full legion of Calishite soldiers in the Fourth Age of Calimshan . Rumors and Legends . Despite the passage of centuries , some magic seemed to preserve the menhirs , and Memnon ' s Crackle was unable to disturb the site .

title: Calimemnon Crystal
description: Calimemnon Crystal The Calimemnon Crystal was the magically created crystal that entrapped the essence of the genie s Calim and Memnon and hundreds of their servants . It was one of the most powerful magical artifact s ever to exist in Faerûn and the greatest magical achievement of the elves of Tethir and Mir . Description .
description_long: Calimemnon Crystal The Calimemnon Crystal was the magically created crystal that entrapped the essence of the genie s Calim and Memnon and hundreds of their servants . It was one of the most powerful magical artifact s ever to exist in Faerûn and the greatest magical achievement of the elves of Tethir and Mir . Description . To the normal eye , the " Calimemnon Crystal " appeared like a diamond with more than 60 sides . It sparkled , even when no light was present to shine on it . When viewed with a " true seeing " spell , however , the gem revealed itself to be a grotesque sight , as the faces of its genie captives could be seen straining and contorting against its many faces , struggling to escape . The " Crystal " was always cold , and this cold could be felt even if one were not touching it directly . This led to many theories among scholars as to its composition .
