However , in 1364 DR , he was pursued by the " Sea Sprite " and thanks to Drizzt Do ' Urden and Catti - brie , his ship was destroyed and Carrackus himself was killed .

title: Carradoon
description: Carradoon Carradoon was a shipwrights ' town on the southern shore of Impresk Lake , southeast of the Snowflake Mountains . Cadderly Bonaduce ' s Spirit Soaring cathedral lay north of the town . Layout .
description_long: Carradoon Carradoon was a shipwrights ' town on the southern shore of Impresk Lake , southeast of the Snowflake Mountains . Cadderly Bonaduce ' s Spirit Soaring cathedral lay north of the town . Layout . The city proper was walled . Many multi - story structures huddled inside the town walls . A long bridge connected the city of Carradoon to a nearby island — a section of the town reserved for the more wealthy inhabitants such as merchants and governing officials . It bordered on Impresk Lake , which drained into the Shalane River . The city contained a market with a winery , two inns : The Dragon ' s Codpiece and the Snoozing Dwarf Inn , and a private club , the Moth Closet , which was located at the end of Lakeview Street . Notable inhabitants . In the city stood the tower of Belisarius , the mage . Cadderly Bonaduce was born here .

title: Carrague
description: Carrague Ambassador Carrague was the honorary building inspector in Ravens Bluff for decades . He had been in the city for so long that no one remembered that his appointment was supposed to be honorary . Appearance .
description_long: Carrague Ambassador Carrague was the honorary building inspector in Ravens Bluff for decades . He had been in the city for so long that no one remembered that his appointment was supposed to be honorary . Appearance . Ambassador Carrague was a bent and stooped old man of 54kg ( 120lbs ) with long white hair and beard . He always wore a red robe with gold trim and leaned on his staff whenever standing . He was sometimes seen in the company of King , a well - known city dog with remarkable intelligence . Personality . Carrague was a pleasant fellow , slow to anger , wanting peace and quiet . However he would not tolerate builders who used inferior materials or sloppy methods of construction and he had an abiding grudge against the Builder ' s Guild . Unfortunately he grew senile and had trouble focusing on nearby events . In conversation he tended to ramble and become unintelligible at times . He could be oblivious to panic and chaos swirling around him which made the people of Ravens Bluff believe his calm was due to high self - confidence . Indeed , even his confusing pronouncements were taken as pearls of wisdom from an inscrutable oracle .

title: Carrelath
description: Carrelath Carrelath Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the territory of the Kuldin Peaks . Description . The Kuldin Peaks contained garrisons for Erlkazar ' s army .
description_long: Carrelath Carrelath Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the territory of the Kuldin Peaks . Description . The Kuldin Peaks contained garrisons for Erlkazar ' s army . The troops guarded the gap in the Iltkazar Range and defended the headwaters of the Shining Stream . In addition , Carrelath contained a few small mining villages and religious sites . Geography . The barony was the westernmost of Erlkazar ' s five baronies . It bordered Impresk in the north , Shalanar in the east , and Tanistan in the south . The entire territory was foothills , passes , or mountains of the Kuldin Peaks . Government . While in name ruled by a baron , in truth the true power rested in the hands of a shield dwarven priest , as had been the case since the time of Shanatar . History . The area had been settled since the time of Shanatar . In fact , the town of Tibold was the oldest continuously occupied location in the Lands of Intrigue , founded some 2 , 600 years before the start of the Dalereckoning . Before the Tethyrian Interregnum , the area was one of the counties of Tethyr .

title: Carril Byndraeth
description: Carril Byndraeth Carril Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and crime lord . He was also the husband of fellow Lord Brianne Byndraeth . Having Carril married to a fellow Lord caused many troubles .
description_long: Carril Byndraeth Carril Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and crime lord . He was also the husband of fellow Lord Brianne Byndraeth . Having Carril married to a fellow Lord caused many troubles . The rift that was opened between the two circa 1350 DR nearly caused the Lords to split into two factions . However , Carril was killed by a black dragon seeking the return of its eye . Residence . Carril had a old estate outside of the city .

title: Carrion Fleet
description: Carrion Fleet The Carrion Fleet was a fleet of ships sailed by fallen pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars . A legend told that these were pirates who were strung up on their own ships and had returned as undead . The fleet was spotted many times off the coast of Thesk between the River Eth and Cape Dragonfang .
description_long: Carrion Fleet The Carrion Fleet was a fleet of ships sailed by fallen pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars . A legend told that these were pirates who were strung up on their own ships and had returned as undead . The fleet was spotted many times off the coast of Thesk between the River Eth and Cape Dragonfang . Seeing the fleet was considered to be an omen of death in Thesk .

title: Carrion crawler
description: Carrion crawler A carrion crawler was a burrowing aberration that scavenged the dead and occasionally preyed on living creatures . Similar to a giant , toothed centipede in appearance , carrion crawlers were often accompanied by a foul odor of death , which warned others of their approach . Although their nature ultimately rested in the Far Realm , it was thought by many , and indeed was possible , that carrion crawlers were created through a mad wizard ' s experiments .
description_long: Carrion crawler A carrion crawler was a burrowing aberration that scavenged the dead and occasionally preyed on living creatures . Similar to a giant , toothed centipede in appearance , carrion crawlers were often accompanied by a foul odor of death , which warned others of their approach . Although their nature ultimately rested in the Far Realm , it was thought by many , and indeed was possible , that carrion crawlers were created through a mad wizard ' s experiments . Physical description . Carrion crawlers were large , pale yellow , and greenish aberrations whose appearance was akin to a three - to four - foot - long centipede . Crawlers possessed eight long tentacles protruding from the sides of their heads , allowing them to stun prey . Carrion crawlers also had two eye stalks , through which they could perceive their surroundings even in the darkest caverns . Additionally , carrion crawlers had a highly developed sense of smell . Behavior . Carrion crawlers often laid their eggs within a meal or mounds of waste . When the young hatched , often in numbers reaching into the hundreds , the baby crawlers quickly turned on one another , eating each other .

title: Carsomyr
description: Carsomyr Carsomyr was a powerful two - handed Holy Avenger sword found in Firkraag ' s " hoard " in " " . Physical description . Described as one of the most powerful weapons existing on Faerûn , the blade was technically a + 5 two - handed sword ( greatsword ) that granted magic resistance when wielded .
description_long: Carsomyr Carsomyr was a powerful two - handed Holy Avenger sword found in Firkraag ' s " hoard " in " " . Physical description . Described as one of the most powerful weapons existing on Faerûn , the blade was technically a + 5 two - handed sword ( greatsword ) that granted magic resistance when wielded . Uses . This powerful sword could be used to cast " dispel magic " . Carsomyr was extremely devastating to chaotic evil opponents and also dispelled their magic whenever it hit . Appendix . Appearances . In " " , Cespenar could combine Carsomyr with the Eye of Tyr to make it a + 6 weapon .

title: Carthoun Misintle
description: Carthoun Misintle Carthoun Misintle , also known as Alamondh , was a human male and the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Abilities . Misintle was a powerful evil mage , but used amulets and spells to conceal both his power and his evil nature , presenting himself as a good mage of half his actual power .
description_long: Carthoun Misintle Carthoun Misintle , also known as Alamondh , was a human male and the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Abilities . Misintle was a powerful evil mage , but used amulets and spells to conceal both his power and his evil nature , presenting himself as a good mage of half his actual power . He discreetly gathered a collection of magical items to aid him , and animated undead servants to carry out his wishes , such as attacking anyone who scrutinized his activities too closely . His goal was to eventually become a lich . History . Though formerly known as Carthoun Misintle , by 1358 DR , he was going by the name Alamondh and serving as Hamayarch to Thultyrl Rendeth of the Royal Blood , as his allegedly loyal mage - advisor and as the highest - ranking wizard in the court . The Hamayarch also governed and regulated the magic - users of Procampur . Misintle had desires on the throne and plotted to kill Rendeth and take his place under a magical disguise . However , he was forced to wait until Rendeth married and produced an heir with the family ' s distinctive appearance , to prevent suspicion .

title: Carzakh Halandir
description: Carzakh Halandir Carzakh Halandir was the leader of the reformed Shadow thieves guild in Athkatla on Amn . History . Carzakh was one of the five charismatic thieves and assassin that in 1255 DR founded the Shadow Thieves guild and remain one of the leader of the guild for the years after until the 1298 DR when the Masked Lady Lhestyn unveiled the guild .
description_long: Carzakh Halandir Carzakh Halandir was the leader of the reformed Shadow thieves guild in Athkatla on Amn . History . Carzakh was one of the five charismatic thieves and assassin that in 1255 DR founded the Shadow Thieves guild and remain one of the leader of the guild for the years after until the 1298 DR when the Masked Lady Lhestyn unveiled the guild . Carzakh was among the few Shadow Thieves that managed to survive the purge and went in hiding ( one other was Marune ) ; as most high surviving member was Carzakh that planned the next moves . Carzakh quickly promoted an other trusted assassin and thief with wizard ability to the command ' s chain and the Three ( as they were dubbed ) proceeded to the transformation and reformation of the guild . The Three decided to move in south Faerûn and change the guild ' s focus from assassin and thieves to wizard and priests ; those proved good moves and the guild began to infiltrated the government of Amn .

title: Casavir
description: Casavir Casavir , also known as Katalmach was a paladin of Tyr who participated in the Shadow War as a companion to the Kalach - Cha . Description . Middle - aged , Casavir was a well - built and dignified human with a handsome physique and sophisticated aura .
description_long: Casavir Casavir , also known as Katalmach was a paladin of Tyr who participated in the Shadow War as a companion to the Kalach - Cha . Description . Middle - aged , Casavir was a well - built and dignified human with a handsome physique and sophisticated aura . Black haired and blue eyed , Casavir would have been a powerful figure to behold were it not for the resigned expression that so often crossed his face . Dour and serious , Casavir was rarely exuberant but instead measured and calm in both verbal and body language . Casavir was often dressed in full plate armor and his weapon of choice when the Kalach - Cha encountered him was a large warhammer , paired with a shield . Personality . Virtuous by just about any measure , Casavir took his duties as a paladin very seriously . Adhering to his code by the letter , Casavir held himselves to very high standards , standards that he himself , in spite of his constant vigilance against evil or temptation , often failed to meet . His high standards were likely in part due to his past , which involved his self - exile from Neverwinter and his estrangement from a lost love .

title: Casildar
description: Casildar Ruinlord Casildar was a leader of the Zhentarim , the second - in - command of Iyachtu Xvim ' s Heart of the Hand and Tor Blackflame in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Casildar was a long time supporter of Fzoul Chembryl .
description_long: Casildar Ruinlord Casildar was a leader of the Zhentarim , the second - in - command of Iyachtu Xvim ' s Heart of the Hand and Tor Blackflame in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Casildar was a long time supporter of Fzoul Chembryl . As a cleric of Bane he was peripherally involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Casildar was promoted to be the second to the High Priestess of Xvim Xana the Once Martyred . After his promotion to head priest of the Heart of the Hand , Casildar gained some economic power helping coordinate the Zhent caravan trade .

title: Casin Cu Calas
description: Casin Cu Calas Casin Cu Calas or the Triple C are a group of vigilantes made up of human s , elves and dwarves from the Silver Marches who attack small orc settlements in and around the Kingdom of Many - Arrows around 1470 DR . The organization ' s name comes from an elven saying that means " honour in battle " . Non - affiliated elves have become upset at the use of this name and have taken to calling the group the Night Riders .
description_long: Casin Cu Calas Casin Cu Calas or the Triple C are a group of vigilantes made up of human s , elves and dwarves from the Silver Marches who attack small orc settlements in and around the Kingdom of Many - Arrows around 1470 DR . The organization ' s name comes from an elven saying that means " honour in battle " . Non - affiliated elves have become upset at the use of this name and have taken to calling the group the Night Riders . Mannerisms . The group operate as a kind of cult , with the leaders donning black and red robes and black hoods to preside over racist chants about killing orcs . The organization works in small bands of warriors , who attack orc homesteads . They behead any males they find , and thrust the severed heads on pikes around their camps .

title: Cassana
description: Cassana Cassana was an evil wizard who masterminded the creation of Alias for her own ends . Description . Like Alias , Cassana was 5 ft 10 in ( 1 .
description_long: Cassana Cassana was an evil wizard who masterminded the creation of Alias for her own ends . Description . Like Alias , Cassana was 5 ft 10 in ( 1 . 8 m ) tall with reddish - blonde hair , which lacked the luster of Alias ' , had green eyes and high cheekbones . Her features were similar in nearly every way to Alias ' but are much more cold and cruel . Personality . The wizard was thoroughly evil and had a compulsive need to dominate others as well as a love of tormenting those under her thumb for her own amusement . History . Cassana ' s story began several centuries before the events that would lead up to the creation of Alias . Early in her career she met and fell madly in love with the wizard Zrie Prakis but events split them up and many years would pass before they met once more . However , by that time , they had both become powerful , vain , hateful practitioners of The Art . A competition of sorts arose between the two mages to see who had become stronger , with Cassana coming out on top and Zrie dying . Regardless , Cassana ' s sanity was in question .

title: Cassandra Thann
description: Cassandra Thann Cassandra Thann was the daughter of Zelphar Arunsun , wife of Rhammas Thann , and mother of Danilo Thann . She was the powerful matriarch of the Thann clan Personality . Cassandra was intellectual and well - versed in politics and history of Waterdeep .
description_long: Cassandra Thann Cassandra Thann was the daughter of Zelphar Arunsun , wife of Rhammas Thann , and mother of Danilo Thann . She was the powerful matriarch of the Thann clan Personality . Cassandra was intellectual and well - versed in politics and history of Waterdeep . She almost single - handedly rebuilt the family ' s fortunes after the family abandoned the slave trade . Danilo considered her quite formidable . She was a skilled musician . Relationships . Cassandra was the daughter of Zelphar Arunsun and his first wife , a half - elf ( Cassandra keeps her elven heritage a close secret ) . The matriarch had nine children with Rhammas - Dertek , Eldaun , Randor , Zelphar , Harmon , Ildaera , Synthea , Danilo , and Judith - and thirteen grandchildren . Khelben " Ravencloak " Arunsun was her younger half - brother ; she sometimes suspected but did not know that he had been replaced by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Appendix . Notes . In the City of Splendors ( boxed set ) , Cassanda is stated as being a 0th level fighter , but later in " " , she is a 12th level aristocrat .

title: Cassiar
description: Cassiar Cassiar was the undead master who turned Jander Sunstar into an elven vampire . Description . The master vampire was young looking with coppery red hair , pale skin , and large doe - like eyes .
description_long: Cassiar Cassiar was the undead master who turned Jander Sunstar into an elven vampire . Description . The master vampire was young looking with coppery red hair , pale skin , and large doe - like eyes . Cassiar preferred to wear fine clothing , such as leather boots , calfskin gloves , and linen shirts . Personality . Cassiar was an evil creature who delighted in controlling and forcing others to do heinous acts against humanity , such as drinking the blood of an infant . History . In 1072 DR , Cassiar was once one of the master vampires that plagued Daggerdale . For this , he was pursued by a band of adventurers , including Jander Sunstar and the cleric of Ilmater Gideon , among others . Cassiar was ambushed by the adventurers but escaped while killing most of the group . After Cassiar turned the Gideon into an undead beast , the two vampires hunted down Jander Sunstar and transformed him into a vampire too .

title: Cassius
description: Cassius Cassius was the leader of and spokesman for the town of Bryn Shander , and principle spokesman ( " Elderman " ) on the Ten Towns Ruling Council . Description . Clean - shaven Cassius had short gray hair , bright blue eyes , and was slender .
description_long: Cassius Cassius was the leader of and spokesman for the town of Bryn Shander , and principle spokesman ( " Elderman " ) on the Ten Towns Ruling Council . Description . Clean - shaven Cassius had short gray hair , bright blue eyes , and was slender . While being a skilled diplomat , Cassius ' military ability and leadership skills were legendary throughout the Ten Towns . Cassius never put away the thief ' s ways he learned as child , but he nevertheless became a respected and capable leader . History . Cassius was originally from Luskan and grew up there as a street urchin .

title: Cassra Brandywine
description: Cassra Brandywine Cassra Brandywine was the head scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Cassra was a young but very smart woman .
description_long: Cassra Brandywine Cassra Brandywine was the head scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Cassra was a young but very smart woman . She was very busy and had no time for socializing . Thus Cassra became clumsy and socially awkward , often stammering when in front of more than two people . Activities . Cassra was the Scribe Master of Mantor ' s Library , the second - in - command of the Lord Sage of Phlan . History . In 1489 DR , she was involved in a case of stolen books , as one of the books was originally from the Library .

title: Cassyt
description: Cassyt Cassyt was a cleric of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Cassyt ' s principal character trait was a sense of humor that was dry and a little warped .
description_long: Cassyt Cassyt was a cleric of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Cassyt ' s principal character trait was a sense of humor that was dry and a little warped . Once being sunny and talkative , she later demonstrated a grim determination . She changed her alignment from Neutral good to Lawful good Relationship . She was good friends with Aleyd Burral . Later she had dealings with the Order of the Gauntlet History . Cassyt was a young worshiper of Kelemvor living in Phlan , working under Yovir Glandon . However , she spent most of her time studying books instead of patrol the graveyard ' s catacombs . Recently , by 1489 DR , she with some adventurers were instructed by doomguide Glandon to investigate the Graveyard , where were signaled undead activities and disappearance of some Kelemvorite . This adventure helped her grow . During the Cult of the Dragon coup in the city , she helped the resistance forces . She guided them through the sewers in order to get Lord Regent Ector Brahms safely out of the city .

title: Castings
description: Castings Castings was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Situated beneath the Furnace , Castings served as the barracks for the efreeti army .
description_long: Castings Castings was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Situated beneath the Furnace , Castings served as the barracks for the efreeti army . Inhabitants . Castings was the home of the efreeti soldiers , including the Ring of the Unquenchable . Since fighting among the soldiers was a common event , regular citizens were not safe here .

title: Castle Al - Amo
description: Castle Al - Amo Castle Al - Amo , also called the Fortress of Love and the Castle of St . Sollars , was the abode of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred on the plane of Mercuria in the Seven Heavens .
description_long: Castle Al - Amo Castle Al - Amo , also called the Fortress of Love and the Castle of St . Sollars , was the abode of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred on the plane of Mercuria in the Seven Heavens . St . Sollars called the castle " my spread out Mercuria way " . Description . It was a gold castle , resembling a fortified mission . History . In the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR , an adventuring party comprising Sir Gareth Dragonsbane , Olwen Forest - Friend , Friar Dugald , Riordan Parnell , Celedon Kierney , and Emelyn the Gray was escorted by Terxyx , a tome archon , and a troop of sword archons , to Castle Al - Amo , where they met St . Sollars outside to discuss what to do with the " Wand of Orcus " . Appendix . Background . Castle Al - Amo is of course the in , as part of St . Sollars ' s Texan theme in " The Throne of Bloodstone " .

title: Castle Crag
description: Castle Crag Castle Crag was a castle in northern Cormyr designed to protect it from the threats of the Stonelands in the mid – 14th century DR . Location . Castle Crag lay in the central north of Cormyr , at the base of the Storm Horns mountains .
description_long: Castle Crag Castle Crag was a castle in northern Cormyr designed to protect it from the threats of the Stonelands in the mid – 14th century DR . Location . Castle Crag lay in the central north of Cormyr , at the base of the Storm Horns mountains . It stood at the southern end of Gnoll Pass , east of the Mountain Ride road to Arabel and north of the Dragon Trail to Hillmarch . Structure . Castle Crag was a smaller and simpler construction than High Horn , a castle further east and higher in the Storm Horns . History . Fearing that bandits , orc s , and other marauders in the Stonelands and Tilver ' s Gap might one day threaten the northern border of Cormyr itself , the kingdom began building the fortress of Castle Crag around 1347 DR . It was intended to be a local strongpoint to protect the frontier , and it marked the greatest expansion of the kingdom in quite some time , being the easternmost outpost toward Tilverton . Construction continued for the next ten years , and was still underway by 1357 DR .

title: Castle Dasaajk
description: Castle Dasaajk Castle Dasaajk was a castle situated on the eastern edge of the Purple Hills in Tethyr . History . In the 3rd and 4th centuries DR , the location was the site of a fortress and the base of the Holy Warriors of Suffering , a paladin order devoted to Ilmater .
description_long: Castle Dasaajk Castle Dasaajk was a castle situated on the eastern edge of the Purple Hills in Tethyr . History . In the 3rd and 4th centuries DR , the location was the site of a fortress and the base of the Holy Warriors of Suffering , a paladin order devoted to Ilmater . By 1374 DR , the site was occupied by Castle Dasaajk . In the Year of the Hunted Elk , 841 DR , King Samyte of Tethyr was assassinated in Castle Dasaajk by Uthaedeol the Blooddrenched , a priest of Bhaal , along with his sons .

title: Castle Grimstead
description: Castle Grimstead Castle Grimstead ( formerly known as Castle Greatstead ) was a castle in Shadowdale , in the Dalelands . It was constructed in 834 DR by the Glittering Band with the aim of driving back the drow who inhabited the nearby Twisted Tower . The castle survived until 864 DR , when it was overrun and destroyed by a combination of drow forces above and below the ground .
description_long: Castle Grimstead Castle Grimstead ( formerly known as Castle Greatstead ) was a castle in Shadowdale , in the Dalelands . It was constructed in 834 DR by the Glittering Band with the aim of driving back the drow who inhabited the nearby Twisted Tower . The castle survived until 864 DR , when it was overrun and destroyed by a combination of drow forces above and below the ground . As of 1367 DR , the castle ' s walls were pitching at dangerous angles and the wood had mostly rotted away . It was uninhabited at that time .

title: Castle Hartwick
description: Castle Hartwick Castle Hartwick was the home of the royal family of Hartsvale and the seat of its throne . Location . Castle Hartwick was located on an island in the center of the Clear Whirl River east of the town of Hartwick and west of the village of Stagwick .
description_long: Castle Hartwick Castle Hartwick was the home of the royal family of Hartsvale and the seat of its throne . Location . Castle Hartwick was located on an island in the center of the Clear Whirl River east of the town of Hartwick and west of the village of Stagwick . The island was a sheer spire of granite , hundreds of feet above the water , and was covered in spruce trees . Two drawbridges , one on the west and one on the east , provided access to the island . Structure . The castle itself was constructed from whitened blocks of granite , and the castle included several flying turrets . One of the gates to the castle , located on the west side of the structure , was known as the Giants ' Gate , and this provided true giants with a means to have an audience with the reigning king or queen . Interior . Within the throne room of Castle Hartwick sat the Alabaster Throne , which had been a gift from the dwarves of the area . Defenses . Besides the defense of being built on an island , the turrets of the castle contained ballistae .

title: Castle Irlingstar
description: Castle Irlingstar Castle Irlingstar was a remote and secret prison stronghold in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate . History . It was established after 1369 DR by Royal Mage Vangerdahast Aeiulvana , who erected the magical wall , and survived the Spellplague .
description_long: Castle Irlingstar Castle Irlingstar was a remote and secret prison stronghold in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate . History . It was established after 1369 DR by Royal Mage Vangerdahast Aeiulvana , who erected the magical wall , and survived the Spellplague . It was originally built by the Irlingstar house of Waterdeep and then sold to Comryr . At one point before 1385 DR the first prisoner was Amarune , although she later escaped . In 1480 DR , a mysterious murder occurred inside the castle .

title: Castle Krag
description: Castle Krag Castle Krag was a castle built by the drow and was located in Shadowdale in the Dalelands . At the time when Jyordhan came to power in Shadowdale in 1339 DR , the castle was in a state of ruin , and he had intended for it to be reconstructed to rival Darkhold , but due to a lack of resources and a rebellion , the castle was rebuilt on a much smaller scale . The fortification was eventually set alight and razed by followers of Mane ' s Band , and , as of 1367 DR , lay in ruins , except for a single tower , with the surrounding area having become overgrown by briar and other undergrowth .
description_long: Castle Krag Castle Krag was a castle built by the drow and was located in Shadowdale in the Dalelands . At the time when Jyordhan came to power in Shadowdale in 1339 DR , the castle was in a state of ruin , and he had intended for it to be reconstructed to rival Darkhold , but due to a lack of resources and a rebellion , the castle was rebuilt on a much smaller scale . The fortification was eventually set alight and razed by followers of Mane ' s Band , and , as of 1367 DR , lay in ruins , except for a single tower , with the surrounding area having become overgrown by briar and other undergrowth .

title: Castle Maerimydra
description: Castle Maerimydra Castle Maerimydra was a fortification at the heart of Maerimydra and the seat of the ruling house . Physical Description . Standing atop a 100 - ft - high ( 30 m ) plateau , the elegant curves and fluted battlements of this castle represented the epitome of drow aesthetics .
description_long: Castle Maerimydra Castle Maerimydra was a fortification at the heart of Maerimydra and the seat of the ruling house . Physical Description . Standing atop a 100 - ft - high ( 30 m ) plateau , the elegant curves and fluted battlements of this castle represented the epitome of drow aesthetics . At 250 - ft ( 76 m ) tall and comprising seven floors , Castle Maerimydra was by far the the largest noble house in Maerimydra . It comprised three basic structures : the Great Tower , the Lesser Tower and the South Column . History . Originally , the castle housed the hundreds of drow that comprised House Chûmavh until the Silence of Lolth and the betrayal of the city ' s Archmage brought ruin to the drow city . The armies of Kurgoth Hellspawn attacked the city and , as the surviving loyalists of House Chûmavh barred themselves inside Castle Maerimydra , the fire giant s , demon s , and goblinoid s besieged it . However , on Elient 28 , 1372 DR , Irae T ' sarran , the leader of the cult of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra , gathered her followers to her and slaughtered the remaining Lolth - worshiping drow of House Chûmavh and seized the castle for her own .

title: Castle Obarskyr
description: Castle Obarskyr Castle Obarskyr , also known as the King ' s Castle , was the royal palace located in Suzail , Cormyr . Geography . The castle was located on a dominating hillock , separated from the rest of the city by Lake Azoun , the Royal Gardens , and several castles of lesser nobility .
description_long: Castle Obarskyr Castle Obarskyr , also known as the King ' s Castle , was the royal palace located in Suzail , Cormyr . Geography . The castle was located on a dominating hillock , separated from the rest of the city by Lake Azoun , the Royal Gardens , and several castles of lesser nobility . Structure . The royal wing of the castle was decorated with purple carpets . The castle ' s court was renowned for the small savoury pastries that were made in its kitchens . History . Faerlthann ' s Keep . Faerlthann ' s Keep was the original stone tower on the hillside in Suzail and the historical seat of power in Cormyr . It was named after Faerlthann Obarskyr , the first king of Cormyr . It was built up from the original house that stood on the spot . During the reign of Boldovar Obarskyr , the windows of the keep were turned into barred slits . Noble Court . Over the years up to 376 DR , the aristocrats and bureaucrats had gradually been thrown out of the keep itself , and had formed a collection of stone buildings further down the hillside , known as the Noble Court , or simply the court . Attack by Thauglor .

title: Castle Perilous
description: Castle Perilous On a single night in 1347 DR the dark stone and iron fortress called Castle Perilous was raised by the work of demons of the Abyss . It was located on a rocky crag on the shore of the Lake of Tears in Vaasa . It was the seat of power for the lich Zhengyi , the Witch - King of Vaasa .
description_long: Castle Perilous On a single night in 1347 DR the dark stone and iron fortress called Castle Perilous was raised by the work of demons of the Abyss . It was located on a rocky crag on the shore of the Lake of Tears in Vaasa . It was the seat of power for the lich Zhengyi , the Witch - King of Vaasa . With the aid of his demon patron Orcus , Zhengyi gathered an army of dire wolves , giants , goblins , orcs , and undead to conquer Damara . It was destroyed by Gareth Dragonsbane and his party of Seven in 1359 DR . Until 1477 DR Castle Perilous remained a crumbling ruin , filled with lurking monsters and frequented by adventurers looking for remnants of Zhengyi ' s magic . The heaps of rubble are often seen topped by Chromatic Dragons of all colors as Tiamat plans to use it as a staging ground for the dragonfall war with Bahamut who has his new centre of faith in Damara . In 1477 DR an earthquake struck the region and the castle shed its crumbling exterior to reveal seemingly new sleek black stone underneath . The ruling Ironfell Council was concerned by the events and sent investigators but no one could pierce the defensive runes on the castle ' s exterior .

title: Castle Spulzeer
description: Castle Spulzeer Castle Spulzeer was a castle , finished in 795 DR for the Spellseer family . It was located a few miles south of Tethir Road , en route to Riatavin . Construction of the castle began in 755 DR .
description_long: Castle Spulzeer Castle Spulzeer was a castle , finished in 795 DR for the Spellseer family . It was located a few miles south of Tethir Road , en route to Riatavin . Construction of the castle began in 755 DR . History . For 35 years , the castle was a stop for all kinds of traffic , renowned for the carnivals thrown exclusively for visitors , the peace , gaiety , good food and drink earned the Spellseer family untold renown and prestige . 830 to 836 DR was a terrible time for the family however , as merchants , jealous of the Spellseer ' s success used forged documents and false testimony to decrease the family ' s prestige with the royal family of Amn . To make matters worse , the Archmage / Necromancer Kartak " the All - Seeing " Spellseer was tried and convicted of 14 murders in the region of the Tejam Hills and then escaped justice when he fled to the Iltkazar Range . 2 years later , the family patriarch Tregas II changed the family name to Spulzeer and brought the renamed family back into the people ' s good graces .

title: Castle Trinity
description: Castle Trinity Castle Trinity was the headquarters of a sect worshiping the goddess Talona . It was located in the Snowflake Mountains . Architecture .
description_long: Castle Trinity Castle Trinity was the headquarters of a sect worshiping the goddess Talona . It was located in the Snowflake Mountains . Architecture . Located high in the Snowflake Mountains and mainly built underground , Castle Trinity was shaped to look like a rocky outcropping of the Snowflake Mountains themselves , to promote secrecy by repelling intruders and curious eyes . It was said that travelers walked right by it and never noticed it . When Aballister Bonaduce replaced Barjin as head of the sect , he started building walls and towers , diminishing the effect of the inconspicuousness of the architecture . Governing system . The castle was ruled by a triumvirate , or a triangle of power of a threesome of each wizard s , cleric s , and warrior s . Clerical order . Barjin , a cleric , was head the clerical order as well as the triumvirate . When Barjin died , Aballister Bonaduce took over leadership . Wizardly order . Aballister Bonaduce was the head of the wizards . Another notable member was the mage Dorigen . Martial order . The ogrillon Ragnor was the leader of the sect ' s warriors until his demise at the hands of the elf Elbereth during the war at Shilmista .

title: Castle Ward of Waterdeep
description: Castle Ward of Waterdeep The Castle Ward of Waterdeep lies at the center of the city . It encompasses Mount Waterdeep , its castle , and much of the government of the city . This includes the Palace of Waterdeep , occupied by Piergeiron the Paladinson , and the homes of many prosperous Waterdhavians .
description_long: Castle Ward of Waterdeep The Castle Ward of Waterdeep lies at the center of the city . It encompasses Mount Waterdeep , its castle , and much of the government of the city . This includes the Palace of Waterdeep , occupied by Piergeiron the Paladinson , and the homes of many prosperous Waterdhavians . Among these citizens are retired adventurers such as Mirt the Moneylender .

title: Castle Waterdeep
description: Castle Waterdeep Castle Waterdeep was a castle located in the city of Waterdeep . Description . Its walls were 60 - ft - thick ( 18 m ) on average , and high enough that when banners were displayed in honor of visiting parties , they were visible from many areas of the southern city .
description_long: Castle Waterdeep Castle Waterdeep was a castle located in the city of Waterdeep . Description . Its walls were 60 - ft - thick ( 18 m ) on average , and high enough that when banners were displayed in honor of visiting parties , they were visible from many areas of the southern city . They were also enchanted with magic spells . The castle held enough food to feed 50 , 000 people for ten days , and could accommodate up to 540 prisoners in 90 cells . There were many dungeons beneath the castle , mainly used for storage , which linked through to the Citadel of the Bloody Hand , creating a security concern . There were also deep wells beneath the castle that provided clean drinking water . Most of the castle ' s passageways were permanently lit by " continual light " spells . Militia . The castle was garrisoned by 1 , 400 of the City Guard , who , along with members of the City Watch , were trained in its courtyard . Seventy warhorses were kept in the castle stables . Thirty guards were always armed and keeping watch on the battlements , while twenty crossbowmen and two wizards were always on duty in a guardroom close to the castle gates . Capital punishment .

title: Castle of Illusion
description: Castle of Illusion The Castle of Illusion was once the home of the gnome illusionist Fhzmilliyun Sparkledrim , whose illusions lingered for years , even driving away an orc horde that settled in the ruined citadel . Geography . The castle was located near the eastern side of the Fell Pass .
description_long: Castle of Illusion The Castle of Illusion was once the home of the gnome illusionist Fhzmilliyun Sparkledrim , whose illusions lingered for years , even driving away an orc horde that settled in the ruined citadel . Geography . The castle was located near the eastern side of the Fell Pass . History . As of the 1360s DR , the castle was inhabited by the evil wizard MacBec Maclyon and his insane followers . Malcyon used to summon powerful demons and come to terms with the dark powers to get a wider magical knowledge . Some devil s were protecting his castle and hopping up and down on the surrounding land , while others teached him in black magic . The evil wizard was not aware it was on its way to build a second Hellgate Keep .

title: Castles ( boxed set )
description: Castles ( boxed set ) Castles is a 2nd edition Advanced Dungeons and Dragons accessory for the Battlesystem tabletop game . The box set includes three paperback booklets , each covering an imposing castle in a different gaming world . The first booklet , by Jeff Grubb , is about the Zhentarim fortress , Darkhold .
description_long: Castles ( boxed set ) Castles is a 2nd edition Advanced Dungeons and Dragons accessory for the Battlesystem tabletop game . The box set includes three paperback booklets , each covering an imposing castle in a different gaming world . The first booklet , by Jeff Grubb , is about the Zhentarim fortress , Darkhold .

title: Cat & Mouse
description: Cat & Mouse " Cat & Mouse " is the 15th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .
description_long: Cat & Mouse " Cat & Mouse " is the 15th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin . It is the third part of " Spell Games " , which related Vajra Valmeyjar ' s past and relationship to Conner and revealed the mystery of the cat child . Appendix . Reprints . This issue was reprinted in the Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 2 trade paperback by in October 2011 .

title: Cat ' s Eye circlet
description: Cat ' s Eye circlet This magical circlet was given to Cattie - Brie before she went to chase Drizzt Do ' Urden back in to the Underdark to his home city of Menzoberranzan . The Cat ' s Eye circlet allows the wearer to see in complete darkness as if under a sky filled with stars . The Cats Eye circlet was enchanted by Alustriel of Silverymoon .
description_long: Cat ' s Eye circlet This magical circlet was given to Cattie - Brie before she went to chase Drizzt Do ' Urden back in to the Underdark to his home city of Menzoberranzan . The Cat ' s Eye circlet allows the wearer to see in complete darkness as if under a sky filled with stars . The Cats Eye circlet was enchanted by Alustriel of Silverymoon .

title: Cat ' s Gate
description: Cat ' s Gate The Cat ' s Gate was a Netherese extra - planar portal located in Anauroch . Description . Most of this gate was buried by the shifting sands .
description_long: Cat ' s Gate The Cat ' s Gate was a Netherese extra - planar portal located in Anauroch . Description . Most of this gate was buried by the shifting sands . What was exposed stood fifty feet tall . The gate was composed of two worn stone pillars , both fifty feet apart . The surface of the pillars was covered with carvings of cats . Three sides of each pillar were straight , but the fourth was pyramidal . In operation , the active region showed as a pane of green light , rippling with green lightning bolts . The gate on the other side was inclined at a forty - five degree angle , to prevent the sands from draining away through the gate . Destination . The gate led to the Plane of Concordant Opposition ( the Outlands ) . The exit was near the home of Gzemnid , the god of eye tyrant s . History . Built during the height of Netheril , this gate was erected as part of an attempt to conquer the Outlands . The gate was large enough to admit an army for that reason . However , other more powerful beings of that plane had the same idea about Netheril . The city was abandoned after about a century of warfare , as the sands encroached .

title: Cat ' s grace
description: Cat ' s grace Cat ' s grace was a transmutation spell that increased the chance of performing any skill requiring dexterity . Effect . The caster had to touch the target of this spell in order to cast it .
description_long: Cat ' s grace Cat ' s grace was a transmutation spell that increased the chance of performing any skill requiring dexterity . Effect . The caster had to touch the target of this spell in order to cast it . The recipient was granted a few minutes of increased agility , coordination , and grace . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell require a few hairs of cat fur .

title: Cat ( person )
description: Cat ( person ) Cat of Ordulin ( Lady Wyvernspur ) was the wife of Giogioni Wyvernspur of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Description . Cat was pretty with copper - coloured hair and green eyes .
description_long: Cat ( person ) Cat of Ordulin ( Lady Wyvernspur ) was the wife of Giogioni Wyvernspur of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Description . Cat was pretty with copper - coloured hair and green eyes . She was one of the " other " Alias es that the creature Phalse made .

title: Cat One - eye
description: Cat One - eye Cat One - eye was a thief in Damara and a member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1359 DR . Activities . Cat , as a contract murderer , wandered Damara searching for the most difficult targets for assassinations .
description_long: Cat One - eye Cat One - eye was a thief in Damara and a member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1359 DR . Activities . Cat , as a contract murderer , wandered Damara searching for the most difficult targets for assassinations . She could kill anyone who annoyed her . Personality . Cat liked killing . She also found it exciting if the target was truly hard to hit .

title: Cat burglar
description: Cat burglar A cat burglar was a rogue trained in advanced acrobatic and athletic techniques . Masters of evasion and daring athletes , and capable of remarkable feats of skill and agility , cat burglars could surprise their opponents with their feats . Abilities .
description_long: Cat burglar A cat burglar was a rogue trained in advanced acrobatic and athletic techniques . Masters of evasion and daring athletes , and capable of remarkable feats of skill and agility , cat burglars could surprise their opponents with their feats . Abilities . A cat burglar enhanced their ability to control their physical momentum , darting from one place to another rapidly as well as enabling them to lessen the effect others ' could have upon their movement . With further training , cat burglars became more adept still , becoming true masters of the athletic arts , climbing , jumping , and swimming with an unusual degree of aptitude . The exploit s of a cat burglar likewise focused upon maintaining mobility throughout combat . " Cat burglar ' s gambit " was a basic technique learned early on by cat burglars to help them move swiftly and strike just as quickly . " Instant escape ] " allowed them to escape any kind of restraint with great effort . " Redirected death " , a more advanced exploit , taught cat burglars instead to carefully avoid incoming strikes in such a way as to allow for a neighboring enemy to take the blow instead .

title: Cat lord
description: Cat lord The cat lord ( also rendered as Cat Lord ) , also known as master cat , was one of the Animal Lords . The cat lord was the ruler of all felines , from the common house cat to the huge smilodon ( sabre - toothed tiger ) . Personality .
description_long: Cat lord The cat lord ( also rendered as Cat Lord ) , also known as master cat , was one of the Animal Lords . The cat lord was the ruler of all felines , from the common house cat to the huge smilodon ( sabre - toothed tiger ) . Personality . The cat lord was indifferent to nearly everything and everyone , except those things and creatures which affected the lives of cats . Abilities . A cat lord had superhuman strength and dexterity and a genius - level intelligence . Their hearing and vision were five times more acute than a normal human ' s , plus they could see great distances in the dark . They could leap 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) in any direction , including straight up , and always landed on ther feet with no recovery time needed . The cat lord could outrun a horse and could move almost perfectly silently under normal conditions . A cat lord spoke Common and all manner of feline languages , including caterwaul , chimera , displacer beast , dragonne , kamadan , sea lion , tabaxi , and weretiger . They had a form of " telepathy " that could be used to communicate with almost any creature once per day , if necessary .

title: Catacombs ( Djerad Thymar )
description: Catacombs ( Djerad Thymar ) The Catacombs were a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The lowest level of the city , the Catacombs were located in a tunnel network under the foundation of the city .
description_long: Catacombs ( Djerad Thymar ) The Catacombs were a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The lowest level of the city , the Catacombs were located in a tunnel network under the foundation of the city . Unlike the rest of Djerad Thymar , the tunnels weren ' t created by the dragonborn . The tunnel network had existed in the region before the Spellplague , as part of a ruined Unther ic mausoleum . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 " > < / ref > The " djerad " fell above the ruins in wake of the Spellplague , and the dragonborn remodeled the tunnels to suit their needs when they constructed Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 - 294 " > < / ref > The most transited sections of the tunnel network had various chambers and rooms that served as a storage area for military equipment and siege supplies , or to fulfill many other mundane purposes as well . The dragonborn also used a section of the network to serve as the graveyard of the city . The graveyard was composed by a series of burial chambers , each clan having their own private sections of the network for their own dead .

title: Catapult ( spell )
description: Catapult ( spell ) Catapult was an arcane alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a loose item roughly the weight of a double - fist sized stone to move in the direction indicated by the spell caster .
description_long: Catapult ( spell ) Catapult was an arcane alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a loose item roughly the weight of a double - fist sized stone to move in the direction indicated by the spell caster . The item moved in a straight line up to the range and / or for the duration of the spell and then dropped in place , unless it came in contact with something solid first . Depending on the nature of the missile and the target , and the speed at which it was hurled , damage could result . Components . No material components were required for this spell , only verbal and somatic , including pointing in the desired direction .

title: Cathakay Shintar
description: Cathakay Shintar Cathakay Shintar was a half - elven priestess and Queen of Dambrath during the 11th century DR . Relationships . Cathakay died without bearing a child , so the rulership of Dambrath passed to her niece , Melanith .
description_long: Cathakay Shintar Cathakay Shintar was a half - elven priestess and Queen of Dambrath during the 11th century DR . Relationships . Cathakay died without bearing a child , so the rulership of Dambrath passed to her niece , Melanith . Activities . Cathakay killed her mother , Filina Shintar after Filina had ruled for only 5 years . Catkakay ruled Dambrath for 54 years before dying in combat against a gold dragon .

title: Catharyn
description: Catharyn Catharyn was a crinti pirate who lived in Dambrath . Personality . Much to her mother ' s pride , Catharyn was cruel and ruthless .
description_long: Catharyn Catharyn was a crinti pirate who lived in Dambrath . Personality . Much to her mother ' s pride , Catharyn was cruel and ruthless . It was said that she never took prisoners on the open water . Activities . Catharyn sailed the Great Sea on Queen ' s Fury , her personal vessel . She raided the waters of the Great Sea and even ventured as far away as Nimbral on the Trackless Sea where she returned to Dambrath with four shiploads of booty . Relationships . Catharyn was Queen Yenandra ' s oldest daughter .

title: Cathedral of Emerald Scales
description: Cathedral of Emerald Scales The Cathedral of Emerald Scales was an opulent temple dedicated to Varae located in the city - state of Hlondeth . Varae was the goddess of a beast cult that worshiped the power of snakes and the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was literally surrounded by and wrapped in snake sculpture . Its domed structure dominated the Hlondeth skyline and influenced the architecture of the entire city .
description_long: Cathedral of Emerald Scales The Cathedral of Emerald Scales was an opulent temple dedicated to Varae located in the city - state of Hlondeth . Varae was the goddess of a beast cult that worshiped the power of snakes and the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was literally surrounded by and wrapped in snake sculpture . Its domed structure dominated the Hlondeth skyline and influenced the architecture of the entire city . Location . Before the Spellplague , the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was centrally located in the independent city - state of Hlondeth , the City of Serpents . Hlondeth was on the northern coast of the Vilhon Reach , an elongated bay on the southern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Hlondeth was south of Turmish , west of Chondath , north of Sespech , and east of the Deepwing Mountains . Structure . The Cathedral and its grounds occupied a circular area about 520 ft ( 160 m ) in diameter , surrounded by a fortified wall known as the Wall of the Amphisbaena .

title: Cathtyr
description: Cathtyr Cathtyr was a metropolis and the capital city of Dambrath . It was formerly known as Shantil . Cathtyr sat in a small bay on the far eastern end of Dambrath .
description_long: Cathtyr Cathtyr was a metropolis and the capital city of Dambrath . It was formerly known as Shantil . Cathtyr sat in a small bay on the far eastern end of Dambrath . It marked the final southern stop of the Trade ' s Way . The inner city was crowded and bustling . At the center of the city sat the queen ' s palace which was surrounded by broad green parks . The wealthy lived in two or three story town houses on the west side , while most of the poor huddled together in the eastern sections of the city closer to the docks . Some lived outside the city walls in hovels that reached southward along the coast . Defenses . Cathtyr had a garrison of 2 , 000 troops to keep order and defend the city from invaders and monsters . Cathyr also had a fleet of 12 warships , half closely defended the port while the other half patrolled the waters near the city out to sea . .

title: Cathtyr Shintar
description: Cathtyr Shintar Cathtyr Shintar was a half - elven priestess and eventually the first Queen of Dambrath during the 9th century DR . Relationships . Cathtyr ' s daughter was named Filina .
description_long: Cathtyr Shintar Cathtyr Shintar was a half - elven priestess and eventually the first Queen of Dambrath during the 9th century DR . Relationships . Cathtyr ' s daughter was named Filina . Activities . Rise to Power . Cathtyr Shintar , along with a large group of fellow priestesses , appeared to come to the rescue of Reinhar IX while he was corned by drow in the city of Malduir . Cathtyr offered the support of her priestesses . Reinhar IX believed this to be a sign from the gods and had a priestess assigned to each of his remaining companies . When the drow attacked , the priestesses within each company betrayed the arkaiun s . Cathtyr slew Reinhar IX herself during the betrayal . The drow , weakened by decades of war , realized their victory was only possible because of the aid from Cathtyr ' s priestesses . Cathtyr recognized an opportunity and made a deal with the drow that her group of priestesses would rule the surface land of Dambrath in exchange for free trade with the drow . Tired from war , and having no interested in the surface territory , the drow gladly agreed . The drow departed , taking the best arkaiun males as their slaves . Rule .

title: Catlord ( old )
description: Catlord ( old ) The Catlord was a werecat who was the current catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord .
description_long: Catlord ( old ) The Catlord was a werecat who was the current catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord . He decided that this new catlord must prowl beside cats in the towns and cities , not in the jungles as he did . Thus , he chose an apparently respectable human to teach his heir the ways of civilization , and gave the boy over to him . Unfortunately , unfamiliar with the ways of civilization and believing being respectable meant being civilized , the Catlord had chosen the cruel and ruthless Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka . This he would come to regret . Learning of Duum ' s wicked intentions for the boy , the Catlord came and rescued him . But Duum had made a deal with the god Malar , the Beastlord , who pounced upon the Catlord as he fled . It was a battle the Catlord knew he could not win . Then the rogue Conner appeared , claiming to be on a mission from a god to take the child to safety .

title: Catoblepas
description: Catoblepas A catoblepas was a mix of buffalo , dinosaur , warthog and hippopotamus that lived in swamps and wastelands . Legends said that hag s raised catoblepases like cattle and fed on their milk . Its most feared ability was its deadly gaze .
description_long: Catoblepas A catoblepas was a mix of buffalo , dinosaur , warthog and hippopotamus that lived in swamps and wastelands . Legends said that hag s raised catoblepases like cattle and fed on their milk . Its most feared ability was its deadly gaze . The flavorful death cheese sold by Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue was made by using catoblepas milk gathered by blind monks .

title: Catti - brie
description: Catti - brie Catti - brie was a female human and a friend and later wife to Drizzt Do ' Urden . She was a member of the Companions of the Hall and , later , a chosen of the goddess Mielikki . She was reincarnated as a Bedine girl named Ruqiah in 1463 DR .
description_long: Catti - brie Catti - brie was a female human and a friend and later wife to Drizzt Do ' Urden . She was a member of the Companions of the Hall and , later , a chosen of the goddess Mielikki . She was reincarnated as a Bedine girl named Ruqiah in 1463 DR . Description . Catti - brie was a beautiful , auburn - haired , and blue - eyed . When Catti - brie was struck by the blue fire of the Spellplague in 1385 DR , it gave her a spellscar in the distinctive form of an hourglass , the lower half of which was nearly filled while the top half had only a small sliver of bruising . In her second life , despite her new heritage , the reincarnated Catti - brie appeared much the same as in her first body : she had thick , light brown hair with red highlights and blue eyes . She also had a spellscar on each arm : a seven - pointed star on a circle of red on her left forearm ( the symbol of Mystra ) and a unicorn ' s head on her right forearm ( the symbol of Mielikki ) . After the Weave began to return , her spellscars turned red . In 1483 DR , Catti - brie wore a long , white , flowing dress that looked like one she wore in Iruladoon . She had commissioned it in the Shade Enclave .

title: Cauln Aumar
description: Cauln Aumar Cauln Aumar was the third of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and secretly a wizard . History . Cauln was a sour , suspicious , and secretive man with a natural affinity for magecraft .
description_long: Cauln Aumar Cauln Aumar was the third of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and secretly a wizard . History . Cauln was a sour , suspicious , and secretive man with a natural affinity for magecraft . He was secretly taught magic by the court wizard Theskyn but revealed himself as a wizard only in the fighting after the death of King Uthgrael Aumar . However , he was killed in 217 DR by a Calishite wizard , Rhangaun of Almraiven , who had been hired by his brother Elthaun Aumar .

title: Cause fear
description: Cause fear Cause fear was a cleric prayer or a necromancy or abjuration spell used by both divine and arcane spellcasters . It could cause a creature to flee in panic from the caster . Older versions of this spell were reversible , known as " remove fear " , and bolstered the morale and courage of the recipients .
description_long: Cause fear Cause fear was a cleric prayer or a necromancy or abjuration spell used by both divine and arcane spellcasters . It could cause a creature to flee in panic from the caster . Older versions of this spell were reversible , known as " remove fear " , and bolstered the morale and courage of the recipients . Effects . This spell / prayer has evolved over time : the prayer version could be used against a single creature within 50 ft ( 15 . 2 m ) , whereas the pre - Spellplague spell could effect more than one creature in a 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) area if the caster had sufficient experience . The oldest version of " cause fear " required the caster to successfully touch a single target . All versions filled the victims with dread and compelled them to flee the caster if they could not muster the will to resist . The victim could avoid obstacles and hazards but it was more vulnerable to enemy assault . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Cavatina Xarann
description: Cavatina Xarann Cavatina Xarann was a female drow Darksong Knight in service of Eilistraee . She was the fourth - generation devotee of the Lady of the Dance , born on the surface . .
description_long: Cavatina Xarann Cavatina Xarann was a female drow Darksong Knight in service of Eilistraee . She was the fourth - generation devotee of the Lady of the Dance , born on the surface . . Her mother was a Sword Dancer , Jetel Xarann , also a priestess of Eilistraee . Descripton . Cavatina was noted to be tall , thin and toned . She had black skin , as was the norm for the drow , with long , ivory hair . Possessions . After the loss of her mother ' s sword , Demonbane , she wields one of the twenty - five Singing sword s given to her by Qilué . She was also equipped with an Iron flask , a magical hunting horn , and usually wore a breastplate embossed with Eilistraee ' s symbol that has been dented from her battle with Selvetarm . . History . Cavatina was the Darksong Knight of The Promenade and was the central figure in The Lady Penitent Trilogy . She first appeared in Sacrifice of the Widow as a proud yet arrogant cleric of Eilistraee serving in The Promenade , accompanying a novice in a routine patrol . It was during the patrol that she encountered a Spellgaunt . Demonbane , her blade that was handed down from Jetel Xarann , her mother , was destroyed in the combat with the spider .

title: Cave fisher
description: Cave fisher A cave fisher was a lobster - like monster which inhabited subterranean locations and ambushed its prey using a sticky filament similar to a strand of giant spider silk . Description . Cave fishers grew to about seven feet ( 2 .
description_long: Cave fisher A cave fisher was a lobster - like monster which inhabited subterranean locations and ambushed its prey using a sticky filament similar to a strand of giant spider silk . Description . Cave fishers grew to about seven feet ( 2 . 1 meters ) long and had a hard , chitinous shell arranged in overlapping plates for an exoskeleton . It had eight legs and two forelimbs that ended in large pincers . Living underground , cave fishers were sightless creatures that used multiple auditory sensor organs to detect prey . These organs were located on the head and could be mistaken for multiple eyes . The creature had a large proboscis from which it shot a long ( up to 60 feet or 18 meters ) sticky filament . Behavior . The cave fisher hid on ledges above passageways and hunted by emitting a long strand of sticky filament , either dangling it to catch passing creatures such as bats , or shooting it at a creature as it wanders by . They could also secrete their adhesive onto their feet and anchor themselves to a ledge , wall , or ceiling once they found a good hunting spot .

title: Cave moss
description: Cave moss Cave moss was a moss found in the Underdark . Ecology . Although many creatures creatures , such as rothé and giant vermin , fed on cave moss , it was inedible to humanoid s .
description_long: Cave moss Cave moss was a moss found in the Underdark . Ecology . Although many creatures creatures , such as rothé and giant vermin , fed on cave moss , it was inedible to humanoid s . Locations . Cave moss grew solely in regions of " faerzress " in the Underdark .

title: Cave of the Monkey
description: Cave of the Monkey The Cave of the Monkey was a cave located in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range . Description . Located deep in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range , itself part of the larger Yehimal mountain range , stood the Cave of the Monkey , home to the greater spirit Monkey .
description_long: Cave of the Monkey The Cave of the Monkey was a cave located in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range . Description . Located deep in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range , itself part of the larger Yehimal mountain range , stood the Cave of the Monkey , home to the greater spirit Monkey . The cave was an important mythic place for many of the different faiths of Kara - Tur , as its home spirit was greatly tied to the founding or teachings of many of those faiths ' most revered figures . Considered little - known and hard to find , the cave was located in a deep , narrow valley in the mountains , only accessible through a maze of passes and other valleys . Its tunnels extended far into the depths , and included a number of caverns , sinks , and pits . The valley itself was a small sub - tropical forest , full of oak , pine , and bamboo trees , surrounded by the jagged icy rock of the high mountains . The actual home of Monkey was a series of large caves , each furnished with some of the most expensive furniture , rugs , paintings , and treasure , much of it stolen from around the world .

title: Cavelord
description: Cavelord The Cavelord is a prestige class of the Underdark that calls to those who have a love for the secret places of their home . Those who have a powerful wanderlust often take this class in order to better know everything they can of their surroundings , much like the rangers and druids of the surface races . Their connection to the rock beneath their feet and over their heads is such that it gives them the power to move quickly and accomplish impressive feats of strength .
description_long: Cavelord The Cavelord is a prestige class of the Underdark that calls to those who have a love for the secret places of their home . Those who have a powerful wanderlust often take this class in order to better know everything they can of their surroundings , much like the rangers and druids of the surface races . Their connection to the rock beneath their feet and over their heads is such that it gives them the power to move quickly and accomplish impressive feats of strength . Because of their almost obsessive need to search for older and older ruins and places of nature untouched by any other , they are only very rarely come across by any adventuring parties . Those that do come upon them can expect a reception based the Cavelord ' s alignment . A veteran Cavelord would be a valuable companion if one can be convinced to temporarily leave the solitude of their lone explorations .

title: Cavern of the Everlasting
description: Cavern of the Everlasting The Cavern of the Everlasting was located beneath the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . The Cavern of the Everlasting was a natural cavern .
description_long: Cavern of the Everlasting The Cavern of the Everlasting was located beneath the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . The Cavern of the Everlasting was a natural cavern . The cavern housed five statues depicting heroes of the Everlasting . Tables and benches were used during meetings . Activities . This location was often used when the holy slayer s of the Everlasting wished to hold a meeting during the heat of the day . Located underground , this cool chamber was a comfortable solution . Festivals or celebrations , usually as the result of the death of an enemy , were held here .

title: Caves of Ghazz
description: Caves of Ghazz The Caves of Ghazz were a series of caves on the island of Saishu , off the coast of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . They were a legendary site but their exact location was unknown . It was said the " mirror of perfection " had been hidden there since around 607 DR .
description_long: Caves of Ghazz The Caves of Ghazz were a series of caves on the island of Saishu , off the coast of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . They were a legendary site but their exact location was unknown . It was said the " mirror of perfection " had been hidden there since around 607 DR . The Caves of Ghazz were one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who would seek out the caves for him .

title: Caves of a Thousand Gods
description: Caves of a Thousand Gods The Caves of a Thousand Gods were an important religious site located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located at the eastern end of the Kora Shan mountain range in the Endless Wastes , the Caves of a Thousand Gods were one of the largest and most important religious sites of followers of the Path of Enlightenment , the major religion of most in Kara - Tur .
description_long: Caves of a Thousand Gods The Caves of a Thousand Gods were an important religious site located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located at the eastern end of the Kora Shan mountain range in the Endless Wastes , the Caves of a Thousand Gods were one of the largest and most important religious sites of followers of the Path of Enlightenment , the major religion of most in Kara - Tur . The caves ' existence wasn ' t widely known , and it was considered hard to access . Its location was a closely guarded secret , with only a few priests of The Path knowing were it was . A secret group of guides , known as the Golden Porters , were responsible for bringing supplies , and the few travelers who didn ' t stumble upon the site by accident , to the caves . The caves themselves were found at the bottom of a thin gorge , whose walls provided shade , and where a spring - drawn stream brought life to the otherwise dry and sandy landscape , turning it into an oasis of willows , vines , and reeds . The true importance of the site wasn ' t the oasis however , but rather the caves the monks had carved into the rock .

title: Cavil
description: Cavil Cavil was an assassin member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his party somehow captured Cavil and Cavil gave precious information about the guild to Gareth .
description_long: Cavil Cavil was an assassin member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his party somehow captured Cavil and Cavil gave precious information about the guild to Gareth . However it was discovered that was all a plot of the Grandfather to lure Gareth in a trap . Personality . Cavil was very loyal to the Grandfather of Assassins and considered him the greatest man in north Faerûn . He never betrayed him willingly . Only torture or powerful ensorcellment could break his will .

title: Cavil Zaltobar
description: Cavil Zaltobar Cavil Zaltobar was a mercenary wizard in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , hired by Drannin Splitshield , Cavil and some minions ambushed some adventurers and Gargosh Blusterhelm ( in truth a doppelganger posing as him ) at the Stone Bridge .
description_long: Cavil Zaltobar Cavil Zaltobar was a mercenary wizard in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , hired by Drannin Splitshield , Cavil and some minions ambushed some adventurers and Gargosh Blusterhelm ( in truth a doppelganger posing as him ) at the Stone Bridge . The adventurers defeated Cavil and his minions .

title: Caxal
description: Caxal Caxal was the ruler of Payit . History . Caxal was a cautious ruler , who wanted no intrusion from the temples .
description_long: Caxal Caxal was the ruler of Payit . History . Caxal was a cautious ruler , who wanted no intrusion from the temples . In 1361 DR , when many of his people witnessed the arrival of the Golden Legion ' s ships , he quickly called a war council with the leader of the Jaguar Knights , Gultec , and the leader of the Eagle Knights , Lok . Together with Lok and Gultec , Caxal decided to face the invaders at Ulatos . Caxal submitted himself and his city to Cordell immediately after the Golden Legion ' s easy victory . At 1362 DR Caxal was reduced to be a figurehead of governor Cordell . In 1362 he tried to convince the adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume to instead gave to him it after recovered . Hasoctl secretly worked for him .

title: Cedar
description: Cedar The cedar tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , as well as on Abeir - Toril ' s other continents . It was used by the Azuposi of Maztica to form prayer sticks , which were burned for protection , healing , and purification . Variations .
description_long: Cedar The cedar tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , as well as on Abeir - Toril ' s other continents . It was used by the Azuposi of Maztica to form prayer sticks , which were burned for protection , healing , and purification . Variations . Blue . The blue cedar was found in the groves near Essemore in the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor .

title: Cedarleaf
description: Cedarleaf Cedarleaf is a wood elf settlement in the lands of Damara / Vaasa near the Gemspark mine . It is the home village of Zhai , the half - drow daughter of a drow female and a wood elf male . The village ( as it appears in " Demon Stone " ) is a sprawling elven tree settlement .
description_long: Cedarleaf Cedarleaf is a wood elf settlement in the lands of Damara / Vaasa near the Gemspark mine . It is the home village of Zhai , the half - drow daughter of a drow female and a wood elf male . The village ( as it appears in " Demon Stone " ) is a sprawling elven tree settlement . It has many magical enchantments through out that utilize the trees and roots as bridges and gates . A large inter - planar portal is located within the village as well as several magical " safe houses " the elves use in time of crisis . The village was decimated when a githyanki general used the town ' s portal to begin bringing her army through . The general , Cireka , was stopped by a trio of adventurers , Rhannek , Illius and Zhai . Shortly thereafter , the slaad lord , Ygorl , teleported in with his slaad army . The githyanki and slaad forces laid waste to the village and slaughtered many of its inhabitants . If not for the efforts of the aforementioned adventurers , the town and its inhabitants might have been completely destroyed . By the end of the story - line of " Demon Stone " the trio return to Cedarleaf to find the elves rebuilding their home .

title: Cedarsproke
description: Cedarsproke Cedarsproke was a small , independent city in the middle of the Gulthmere Forest inhabited and ruled by druid s . Geography . The Cedar River divided the city in two .
description_long: Cedarsproke Cedarsproke was a small , independent city in the middle of the Gulthmere Forest inhabited and ruled by druid s . Geography . The Cedar River divided the city in two . Government . In 1372 DR , the city was governed by Zalaznar Crinios , a druid and a very popular ruler . Locations . The city was the home of Earthome College , a famous school for druidic teaching as well as for history of the Vilhon Reach region .

title: Cedric Ravajar
description: Cedric Ravajar Cedric Ravajar was a human man , once a leader of the Red Brigade mercenaries and later a leader of the Vipers bandit s . History . Cedric Ravajar was a mercenary for much of his adult life .
description_long: Cedric Ravajar Cedric Ravajar was a human man , once a leader of the Red Brigade mercenaries and later a leader of the Vipers bandit s . History . Cedric Ravajar was a mercenary for much of his adult life . He was also best friends with Soren Whitespear for many years , before either of them joined the Red Brigade as mercenaries . After four years of service , Cedric rose to lead the Red Brigade as its Captain , due to combat ability and charisma . Soren served as his second - in - command . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , he accepted Calispar Delgorth into his force and included the priest in all of the company ' s decisions . The two men became firm allies , perhaps even friends . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , while on a routine scouting expedition for a minor noble , two Brigade scouts reported a dead magic zone in the Brynwood forest . Cedric kept the find secret , telling only Calispar , and the two scouts disappeared shortly afterwards . During the mission , Cedric met Dura Gerathu , a ranger of Brynwood . Later that year , Cedric announced his retirement and disbanded the Red Brigade . In fact , he wished to go into business for himself .

title: Cedric deLancie
description: Cedric deLancie Cedric deLancie was a noble from Waterdeep . He was a commander in the City Guard ( Waterdeep ) , despite he had never saw a true battle . He however was an expert in military history and strategies .
description_long: Cedric deLancie Cedric deLancie was a noble from Waterdeep . He was a commander in the City Guard ( Waterdeep ) , despite he had never saw a true battle . He however was an expert in military history and strategies . He was appointed thank to manipulations of the deLancie patriarch . Torsin deLancie led the Waterdeep troops during the

title: Cel
description: Cel Cel was a fishermen in the Kabel ' s Hill community in Quivering Forest in 1489 DR . Personality . The fisherman was a taciturn but not rude person .
description_long: Cel Cel was a fishermen in the Kabel ' s Hill community in Quivering Forest in 1489 DR . Personality . The fisherman was a taciturn but not rude person . He always gave the shortest answer possible , so sometimes others needed time to understand his responses . Activities . He worked as fisherman or in transporting villagers ' goods up and down the river . If he had passengers , he also acted as a boatman to Sorcerer ' s Isle .

title: Cela Jardi
description: Cela Jardi Cela Jardi was a prominent camel - dealer within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Cela ' s time in the desert gave her a keen eye for selecting quality camels .
