description_long: Cela Jardi Cela Jardi was a prominent camel - dealer within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Cela ' s time in the desert gave her a keen eye for selecting quality camels . With her well - developed ability to haggle , and a selection of fine stock , Cela usually came out on top of any deal she bartered . Her favorite tactic was to pretend to be a lowly desert rider who was forced to sell her only mount in order to survive , attracting customers eager to take advantage of a wild al - badia from the desert . History . Cela spent her youth living in the desert as a member of the House of Bakr . She visited Huzuz on her first pilgrimage and decided to stay .

title: Celadrin
description: Celadrin Celadrin were a planetouched race that resulted from the union of elves and eladrins ( usually firre ) . Many of the celadrins encountered outside of their homes were warriors , though they were also known for their skill as bard s . Description .
description_long: Celadrin Celadrin were a planetouched race that resulted from the union of elves and eladrins ( usually firre ) . Many of the celadrins encountered outside of their homes were warriors , though they were also known for their skill as bard s . Description . Celadrins were of medium height and size . Celadrins resembled sun elves with the same golden - colored skin , but they also possessed gold eyes and flame - red hair . They preferred to wear brilliant robes , oftentimes fine silk with touches of silver and gold . Abilities . Known to be quite dexterous and charismatic , but with a frail constitution , celadrins had a number of useful abilities . They could see in the dark and had resistance to fire and " sleep " spells and effects . They possessed a fiery gaze that let them occasionally cast a " scorching ray " from their eyes . They were most notable for their melodious voice however , which could influence beasts and humanoids alike . Society . Celadrins were usually found living with sun elves , although a few were known to wander the world before eventually settling down in distant elven settlements .

title: Celedon Kierney
description: Celedon Kierney Celedon Kierney was a half - elf mage . Appearance . Celedon appeared as a charming rogue with more than a bit of elven blood in him .
description_long: Celedon Kierney Celedon Kierney was a half - elf mage . Appearance . Celedon appeared as a charming rogue with more than a bit of elven blood in him . Background . Celedon was associated with the scouting network Spysong . He had the task of keeping a close watch on the Grandfather of Assassins . The Grandfather in turn had placed a 1000 gold piece bounty on his head . The bard Riordan Parnell was his cousin .

title: Celestia
description: Celestia Celestia , commonly called in the past Mount Celestia , or more fully , the Seven Mounting Heavens of Celestia or even the Seven Heavens is a lawful good - aligned astral dominion that is currently ruled over by Torm as it drifts through the Astral Sea . Description . Celestia is the ultimate in law and good .
description_long: Celestia Celestia , commonly called in the past Mount Celestia , or more fully , the Seven Mounting Heavens of Celestia or even the Seven Heavens is a lawful good - aligned astral dominion that is currently ruled over by Torm as it drifts through the Astral Sea . Description . Celestia is the ultimate in law and good . All aspects of Celestia are beautiful and perfect ; it is where the souls of many creatures of lawful good alignment go to after death , particularly human s . Celestia is home to numerous celestial creatures including various types of archons , the petitioner s of this plane . Structure . As an outer plane , Celestia is spatially infinite , further consisting of seven infinite layers ( or sub - planes ) . The seven individual layers form a colossal ( perhaps infinite ) mountain that rises from an infinite sea of holy water on the bottommost layer , to the summit on the topmost layer . Ascending the mountain is analogous to travelling through subsequently higher or ' deeper ' layers to the top . Each of the different layers consists of various beautiful mountainous environments becoming more breathtaking the higher the mountain is ascended .

title: Celestial Emperor
description: Celestial Emperor The Celestial Emperor , also called the Celestial One and the Master of Heaven , was a deity who ruled the Celestial Empire and oversaw the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures . Description . The Celestial Emperor was depicted as a tall man of aristocratic aspect , with a face at once both stern and compassionate , with eyes that blazed white with the inner fire of karma .
description_long: Celestial Emperor The Celestial Emperor , also called the Celestial One and the Master of Heaven , was a deity who ruled the Celestial Empire and oversaw the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures . Description . The Celestial Emperor was depicted as a tall man of aristocratic aspect , with a face at once both stern and compassionate , with eyes that blazed white with the inner fire of karma . He dressed as a lord , wearing the high crown of the emperors of Shou Lung and shimmering robes of many hues . He held in his left hand Lien Min , " Compassion " , a golden chalice bearing the Essence of Life . He held in his right Kun P ' ing Shen p ' an , " Justice " , a mighty scepter fashioned of silver and intricately worked . Abilities . The Celestial One was said to have all - seeing eyes , able to see even that which was concealed , so his officials could hide nothing from him . He also had infinite wisdom and power . Possessions .

title: Celestial Empire
description: Celestial Empire The Celestial Empire , also known as the Celestial Heaven or the Empire of Heaven , was the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures , all through the Celestial Bureaucracy . The Spirit World . The Celestial Empire stood within the Spirit World , a plane that lay coexistent and coterminous with the land of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Celestial Empire The Celestial Empire , also known as the Celestial Heaven or the Empire of Heaven , was the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures , all through the Celestial Bureaucracy . The Spirit World . The Celestial Empire stood within the Spirit World , a plane that lay coexistent and coterminous with the land of Kara - Tur . Every deity who was a part of the Celestial Bureaucracy had a small realm attached to the Spirit World . The whole realm was known as the Celestial Heaven , or simply Heaven or the Sky . Lying at the Center of All Heaven , the Celestial Empire was governed from the Celestial Palace , where the Celestial Emperor sat upon the Jade Throne . Sphere of Influence . The Celestial Bureaucracy held dominion over the continent of Kara - Tur , from the empires of Shou Lung and T ' u Lung in the interior ; to the Ama Basin in the north ; Koryo , Kozakura , and Wa in the east ; Tabot in the west ; and Malatra and Petan and the islands of Bawa and Bertan in the south .

title: Celestial Fury
description: Celestial Fury The Celestial Fury was a powerful katana designed to slay a dragon but ended up housing its spirit . History . The province of a wa an daimyo , Hoshi Katahiroi , was suffering under unnatural and destructive weather .
description_long: Celestial Fury The Celestial Fury was a powerful katana designed to slay a dragon but ended up housing its spirit . History . The province of a wa an daimyo , Hoshi Katahiroi , was suffering under unnatural and destructive weather . A dragon of a type never encountered before was found to be the cause - it was dubbed Celestial Fury . Hoshi wished the dragon dead to spare his province more devastation . In his lands resided a reclusive weaponsmith called Chigatta who was also known to be a master of the mystic arts . Hoshi commissioned Chigatta to forge for him a weapon that could destroy Celestial Fury ' s spirit as well as its body . Chigatta created a katana more fine than Hoshi could ' ve imagined . The sword was imbued with the power of flight and so Hoshi took to the skies to slay the dragon . Above the stormclouds , roars echoed along with a man ' s shouts and fire lit up the night skies for several days until Hoshi returned to the ground claiming a victory of law over chaos since the dragon ' s spirit was now trapped inside his sword . Hoshi then asked Chigatta to craft a scabbard next and used a magical pearl that was in the dragon ' s possession to ornament it .

title: Celestial Heavens
description: Celestial Heavens The Celestial Heavens , or simply Heaven , was a realm in the Spirit World , the domain of the Celestial Empire of Kara - Tur . " Heaven " was often a byword for the Celestial Empire itself , or for the Celestial Emperor . Inhabitants .
description_long: Celestial Heavens The Celestial Heavens , or simply Heaven , was a realm in the Spirit World , the domain of the Celestial Empire of Kara - Tur . " Heaven " was often a byword for the Celestial Empire itself , or for the Celestial Emperor . Inhabitants . Heaven was home to the Celestial Emperor and the Nine Immortals , as well as the Lesser Immortals and other officials of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Heaven was also home to the Ancestors , the spirits of the dead who ' d been judged by the Lords of Karma to have lived a life of goodness and merit . They and enjoyed eternal lives without pain , weakness , or suffering . Locations . Each deity of the Celestial Bureaucracy had a small realm in Heaven . At the Center of All Heaven , the Celestial Emperor ruled from his Jade Throne in the Celestial Palace . Activities . The Moon Women of the Lesser Immortals had the great responsibility of maintaining Heaven itself . They refilled the oil lamps in the Sun , polished the crystal orbs of the stars , and steered the motions of the Moon and the constellation s . The Ladies of Compassion roamed Heaven to find and alleviate pain and suffering . Magic .

title: Celestial Stairway
description: Celestial Stairway A Celestial Stairway was a type of pathway linking the Realms with the plane s . A stairway led to a nexus , which led to the homes of all the gods . They were used by god s to traverse from the Realms to their home planes .
description_long: Celestial Stairway A Celestial Stairway was a type of pathway linking the Realms with the plane s . A stairway led to a nexus , which led to the homes of all the gods . They were used by god s to traverse from the Realms to their home planes . The stairways , invisible to ordinary people , could only be seen properly by gods or by very powerful mortals . When made visible to others , they appeared to constantly change shape , such as a long wooden spiral staircase , a marble ladder , a pathway of amber and pearl , or stranger forms . Locations . Celestial Stairways could be found :

title: Celestial archon
description: Celestial archon Archons , not to be confused with the similarly named elementals , are an elite group of celestial s in the service of all that is lawful and good . Archons are wholly good and lawful and are consistently at odds with fiend s of any kind , though they particularly despise demon s . Types of Archons .
description_long: Celestial archon Archons , not to be confused with the similarly named elementals , are an elite group of celestial s in the service of all that is lawful and good . Archons are wholly good and lawful and are consistently at odds with fiend s of any kind , though they particularly despise demon s . Types of Archons . Archons come in many varieties and are typically of a lawful good alignment .

title: Celestial blood
description: Celestial blood Celestial blood was an abjuration spell that granted the subject divine defenses . Effect . The caster channeled holy power to grant the subject some of the protection enjoyed by celestial creatures .
description_long: Celestial blood Celestial blood was an abjuration spell that granted the subject divine defenses . Effect . The caster channeled holy power to grant the subject some of the protection enjoyed by celestial creatures . The subject gained resistance to acid , cold , and electricity , a strong resistance to poison s , and strong damage reduction ( overcome by evil ) . Material Component . A vial of holy water , with which the caster anointed the subject ' s head .

title: Celestial brilliance
description: Celestial brilliance Celestial brilliance was an evocation spell that conjured a blaze of celestial light from an object . Effect . The object touched shed light brighter than bright sunlight , channeled directly from the celestial realms .
description_long: Celestial brilliance Celestial brilliance was an evocation spell that conjured a blaze of celestial light from an object . Effect . The object touched shed light brighter than bright sunlight , channeled directly from the celestial realms . The light extended to a 120 - foot radius : bright light to 60 feet and dim light in another 60 feet . Creatures with light sensitivity ( such as drow ) took twice the usual penalty when they are within 60 feet of the object . Undead creatures took damage each round they are within the bright light . Fiend s , as well as undead creatures that were specifically harmed by sunlight , took even more damage . Celestial brilliance brought into an area of magical darkness ( or vice versa ) was temporarily negated , so that the otherwise prevailing light conditions existed in the overlapping areas of effect . Celestial brilliance countered or dispelled any of equal or lower level , such as Deeper Darkness .

title: Celestial domain
description: Celestial domain The Celestial domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters celestial spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Celestial Domain Powers .
description_long: Celestial domain The Celestial domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters celestial spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Celestial Domain Powers . The cleric gains the ability to smite evildoers once per day , as a paladin can .

title: Celestial language
description: Celestial language Celestial was the language of celestial s . It was brought to Toril through contact with good folk from other planes . It was described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity .
description_long: Celestial language Celestial was the language of celestial s . It was brought to Toril through contact with good folk from other planes . It was described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity . Cleric s often took the time to learn it , and the Celestial alphabet was used to transcribe the Mulhorandi language , except in Thay , where they wrote their own dialect of Mulhorandi using the Infernal alphabet instead .

title: Celestial mystic
description: Celestial mystic Celestial mystics are spellcasters who seek to better their very souls by contemplating and studying the mysteries of Celestia . Background . Though they come from all walks of life , celestial mystics share a few features .
description_long: Celestial mystic Celestial mystics are spellcasters who seek to better their very souls by contemplating and studying the mysteries of Celestia . Background . Though they come from all walks of life , celestial mystics share a few features . All are spellcasters of one form or another - either arcane or divine , it doesn ' t matter - and they have all taken a few solemn oaths : Celestial mystics seek to improve themselves and earn the right to enter the seventh heaven - Chronias , or the Illuminated Heaven - uniting their very being with the highest good of all the planes . This path requires much study , something that comes easily to wizard s and academics . Cleric s and sorcerer s , too , sometimes follow this path , and multiclass monk s with spellcasting levels may also join it . Paladin s are also possible , but rare because several of the required skills are cross - class , it takes some time for them to learn powerful enough spells , and because it means giving up a great measure of their combat prowess .

title: Celestial paragon
description: Celestial paragon A celestial paragon is the antithesis of an archfiend . There are currently 16 paragons . 7 of them each rule one of the seven heavens of Mount Celestia on the House of the Triad .
description_long: Celestial paragon A celestial paragon is the antithesis of an archfiend . There are currently 16 paragons . 7 of them each rule one of the seven heavens of Mount Celestia on the House of the Triad . 6 of them reside on the House of Nature and 3 roam Arvandor and the Gates of the Moon on a whim . Unlike archfiends , infighting is unthinkable to paragons and no paragon ' s army has ever marched against anothers . The paragons operate outside of the ranks of the good - aligned deities . They have their own celestial agents and many have organizations working for them in Faerûn . They remind their followers constantly that they themselves are not gods and to worship them thus is a sin . They cannot directly grant spells to divine casters but sometimes petition good deities to grant their followers particular spells or allow them access to divine domains . Epic - level followers can also research and cast a spell that would allow them to channel a celestial paragon for a time , in case they have to battle with an archfiend or some other exceptionally powerful evil . . The Celestial Hebdomad .

title: Celestial planes
description: Celestial planes Celestial planes is a collective term used to describe a subset of the Outer Planes in the World Tree cosmology model . The celestial planes were generally associated with the good deities whereas the fiendish planes were generally associated with the evil ones . The celestial planes were : All of these planes were connected to the World Tree which could be used to travel directly between planes without having to pass through the Prime Material Plane , but this mode of travel was often dangerous .

The celestial planes were generally associated with the good deities whereas the fiendish planes were generally associated with the evil ones . The celestial planes were : All of these planes were connected to the World Tree which could be used to travel directly between planes without having to pass through the Prime Material Plane , but this mode of travel was often dangerous .

title: Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild
description: Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild The Cellarers ' and Plumbers ' Guild was a guild in Waterdeep that dug building foundations and maintained Waterdeep ' s sewer system . Base of operations . The Old Guildhall was located on Gaustus Street in the Trades Ward .
description_long: Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild The Cellarers ' and Plumbers ' Guild was a guild in Waterdeep that dug building foundations and maintained Waterdeep ' s sewer system . Base of operations . The Old Guildhall was located on Gaustus Street in the Trades Ward . Activities . The guild was employed to dig foundations and maintain the city ' s sewer system . They kept the sewers well - maintained . They used secret recipes to perform their maintenance duties and ordered their materials from others rather than making them themselves . Although they didn ' t always do so , the Cellarers and Plumbers had to call the Loyal Order of Street Laborers to fill in any holes that they had dug . Tactics . Frequently , the guild would dig up valuables and corpses during their excavations . They were required to inform the owner of the property beneath which the objects were found but commonly , they did not bother to do so unless being directly observed by said owner . Rumors were rife that the guild created nonfunctional pipelines in the sewers in which they could hide these things . Relationships .

title: Cellica
description: Cellica Cellica was a halfling rogue who lived in Waterdeep with her adoptive brother Kalen Dren . History . As a youth in Luskan , Cellica worked as a thief for the same organization as Kalen .
description_long: Cellica Cellica was a halfling rogue who lived in Waterdeep with her adoptive brother Kalen Dren . History . As a youth in Luskan , Cellica worked as a thief for the same organization as Kalen . The two became very close and considered each other brother and sister . When Kalen met Gedrin Shadowbane and joined the Eye of Justice , Cellica followed him to Waterdeep where they lived together in a rowhouse . While Kalen performed his duties in the city guard , Cellica stayed home and tended house . In 1479 DR Kalen attempted to stop a plot by the high priest of Beshaba to kidnap a powerful spellcarred wizard named Myrin . A dwarven monk named Rath who was working for the high priest entered their house and stabbed Cellica to death . Abilities . Although Cellica was not a spell caster , she had the power to use her voice to command others when she wanted to .

title: Centaur
description: Centaur The centaur was a large creature that lived in temperate forests . Physical Description . A centaur had the upper body of a humanoid , and the lower body of a large horse .
description_long: Centaur The centaur was a large creature that lived in temperate forests . Physical Description . A centaur had the upper body of a humanoid , and the lower body of a large horse . Society . Centaurs generally lived in tribal hunter - gatherer societies . They had good relations with elves , being as they were both creatures of the forest . They generally despised humans and dwarves but weren ' t actively hostile toward them . Centaur warriors were usually equipped with composite longbow s and longsword s . Religion . Centaurs revered the sylvan god , Skerrit the Forester . Regional . Cormanthor . In the 1200s DR , a plague affected the numerous centaurs in the Cormanthor forest , causing their left hind leg to be three inches ( 7 . 5cm ) shorter than the others , and as a result , they could not easily escape from predators such as dragon s . The elves and halfling s of the forest refused to help , fearing that the dragons would turn on them too . Populations dwindled so only three tribes of centaurs remained in the forest , each containing around one dozen families , and they are nomadic ( within the forest boundary ) .

title: Centaur ( constellation )
description: Centaur ( constellation ) The Centaur was a constellation resembling a centaur with a sword . Observation . It could be observed over the Sword Coast North in summer .
description_long: Centaur ( constellation ) The Centaur was a constellation resembling a centaur with a sword . Observation . It could be observed over the Sword Coast North in summer . History . The Centaur and the Woman Warrior came into full alignment , their swords crossing , in the summer of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , in the evening as Waterdeep experienced the hottest day of the year . Meanwhile , unaware , Timoth Eyesbright , a heroic centaur , and Vajra Valmeyjar , a renowned warrior woman , had a protracted arm - wrestling contest in the Selûne ' s Smile tavern . The cosmic alignment amplified the power of their contest , which merged with magic that had sweltered in the heat and tore a mystic nexus point into a rift . This opened a door to an extra - dimensional prison , releasing Aviss and Fellandar to wreak a path of destruction in the city . Khelben Arunsun urged Vajra and Timoth to continue arm - wrestling to hold the door open , before he hurled the villains back in . Vajra and Timoth broke off , closing the rift .

title: Centaur Bridge
description: Centaur Bridge Centaur Bridge was a small town in Turmish , just off the Halondar . Geography . Centaur Bridge was located in the Dancing Forest .
description_long: Centaur Bridge Centaur Bridge was a small town in Turmish , just off the Halondar . Geography . Centaur Bridge was located in the Dancing Forest . The town was surrounded by an ever - present , thick white mist . Rumors and Legends . Around 1370 DR , it was rumored that the tunnels beneath the vanished mansion hid vast treasure .

title: Centiv Naomal
description: Centiv Naomal Centiv Naomal was a human wizard specializing in illusion s . He was the one who slew Samark Dhanzscul , the sixth Blackstaff . Description .
description_long: Centiv Naomal Centiv Naomal was a human wizard specializing in illusion s . He was the one who slew Samark Dhanzscul , the sixth Blackstaff . Description . Centiv had chestnut hair and a full beard . Personality . Centiv tried hard to impress his father but his father didn ' t respect his abilities . History . Centiv resided with his father in Sundabar for a time before coming to Waterdeep around 1459 DR . Centiv helped his father kill Samark Dhanzscul and kidnap his heir Vajra Safahr in Marpenoth of 1479 DR . Centiv assumed the illusionary form of Samark and was able to convince everyone he encountered that he was the Blackstaff . When Khondar and Centiv attempted to break into Blackstaff Tower together , the pair were trapped but Khondar escaped , abandoning Centiv to his fate . Centiv remained trapped inside the tower , left to be tormented ( and perhaps killed ) by the spirits of the tower . Relationships . Centiv was the son of Khondar Naomal , the guildmaster of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors .

title: Central District
description: Central District The Central District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Central District was found in the North Quarter in the central portion of Huzuz just north of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne and the great mosques .
description_long: Central District The Central District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Central District was found in the North Quarter in the central portion of Huzuz just north of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne and the great mosques . It was a popular place for visitors to come because of the wide range of available services . Gambling occurred here as well , but most of the bets were fair . Since it was located in the center of Huzuz , the Central District was surrounded by other districts ; including the Pilgrims ' District to the south , the Warehouse District to the north , the Craft District to the northeast , the Merchants ' District to the northwest , and the Peasants ' District to the west . The Central District was framed by the Merchants ' Avenue on the west and the Street of the Ajami on the east . Inhabitants . A good portion of Huzuz ' s active military was quartered within the Central District . Their close presence limited the frequency of major disturbances , though minor instances still occurred .

title: Central Thorass languages
description: Central Thorass languages The Central Thorass language subgroup included Chondathan and Common and a large number of their lesser - known derivative languages and dialects . Languages . Despite the name , the parent language of the languages in this group was Jhaamdathan , or " Old Chondathan " .
description_long: Central Thorass languages The Central Thorass language subgroup included Chondathan and Common and a large number of their lesser - known derivative languages and dialects . Languages . Despite the name , the parent language of the languages in this group was Jhaamdathan , or " Old Chondathan " . Modern Chondathan derived directly from Old Chondathan , while Thorass / Old Common , the original trade language of Faerûn , was a mixture of Alzhedo and Jhaamdathan . Common was simply a modern version of Thorass . From Thorass sprang a number of lesser - known languages and dialects , including : Script . All the languages in this group used the Thorass alphabet .

title: Cephalopolop
description: Cephalopolop The Cephalopolop was a renegade kraken who was the secret ruler of Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Despite its small size as a kraken , the Cephalopolop compensated with cunning , secrecy and ambition .
description_long: Cephalopolop The Cephalopolop was a renegade kraken who was the secret ruler of Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Despite its small size as a kraken , the Cephalopolop compensated with cunning , secrecy and ambition . History . The Cephalopolop was a kraken from the seas of the surface until it arrived in Sloopdilmonpolop , where in time it assumed secret control of the kuo - toa . For a long time , Cephalopolop plotted against a kraken that ruled the seas off the coasts of Calimshan . In 1363 DR , the Cephalopolop ' s plans were weakened when , in the Nelanther Isles , a third kraken killed and replaced the dragon turtle known as the Curse of Irphong . Now with two potential rivals , the Cephalopolop became more cautious . By 1370 DR , its puppet was the Priest - King Dagagoorg , who believed the Cephalopolop was an incarnation of Blibdoolpoolp .

title: Cephalossk
description: Cephalossk Cephalossk was the ulitharid Creedmaster of the Venerators Creed in Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Its position and its powers made Cephalossk the second more powerful individual in the city . History .
description_long: Cephalossk Cephalossk was the ulitharid Creedmaster of the Venerators Creed in Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Its position and its powers made Cephalossk the second more powerful individual in the city . History . Cephalossk was the leader of the Creed of the Venerators , and so the high priest of Ilsensine , and a member of the Elder Concord during the Time of Troubles when the avatar of Ilsensine manifested in Oryndoll . Possessions . Like its fellow Elders , Cephalossk received a pair of " tendrils ring of Ilsensine " . However , these rings had additional , secret powers , many not known even by Cephalossk but which it was learning . Relationships . Cephalossk had a constant mental link with the Encephalithid .

title: Cephas
description: Cephas Cephas was a genasi and a skilled fighter . He was the long - lost heir to Pasha Marod el Arhapan , the leader of Calimport . Description .
description_long: Cephas Cephas was a genasi and a skilled fighter . He was the long - lost heir to Pasha Marod el Arhapan , the leader of Calimport . Description . As an Earthsoul , Cephas had dark , reddish skin and was heavily muscled . In his Windsoul manifestation , he was slighter in build and had silver skin . Possessions . Cephas wielded a great two - headed flail given to him by Azad the Free . He wore assorted pieces of scale armor . History . Childhood . Cephas ' mother , Valandra , was an Earthsoul genasi who manifested into a windsoul . The Pasha fell in love with her and she bore him a son . Valandra ran afoul of the Pasha and he made her a slave and tricked his champion gladiator , Azad the Free , into killing her in the arena . After his mother ' s death , Cephas was raised by a minotaur nanny . Azad later led a slave revolt and abducted young Cephas from the castle and took him into eastern Tethyr . Island of the Free . Azad found an earthmote over a canyon near the Omlarandin Mountains and built a small settlement known as the Island of the Free on the mote . Azad ' s wife , Sheneerah , trained Cephas to fight as a gladiator in the arena Azad built on the mote .

title: Cera Eurthos
description: Cera Eurthos Cera was the head priestess of Amaunator in the Chessentan town of Soolabax . She aided Aoth Fezim in uncovering Alasklerbanbastos ' plans to attack Chessenta although she believed that Amaunator wanted her to uncover an even bigger plot . She and Aoth later fell in love .
description_long: Cera Eurthos Cera was the head priestess of Amaunator in the Chessentan town of Soolabax . She aided Aoth Fezim in uncovering Alasklerbanbastos ' plans to attack Chessenta although she believed that Amaunator wanted her to uncover an even bigger plot . She and Aoth later fell in love . History . After Alasklerbanbastos ' physical form was destroyed in the second battle of the war with Threskel she resurrected his soul into the body of a young blue dragon . Because Cera controlled his phylactery , she was able to exert some control over Alasklerbanbastos . Cera and Aoth travelled together to Akanûl to talk the Akanûlans out of joining forces with Tchazzar ' s army . Cera compelled Alasklerbanbastos to follow but he was finally able to slip out of her control and regain his phylactery . During the Battle of Luthcheq Cera rescued the clergy of Amaunator and other legitimate gods who were held prisoner by the Church of Tiamat and led the attack against Alasklerbanbastos .

title: Ceratosaur
description: Ceratosaur Ceratosaurs were viscous bipedal carnivorous dinosaur s from the jungles of Chult . Description . These dinosaurs could reach 30 feet ( nine meters ) in length and walked on two thick , muscular legs .
description_long: Ceratosaur Ceratosaurs were viscous bipedal carnivorous dinosaur s from the jungles of Chult . Description . These dinosaurs could reach 30 feet ( nine meters ) in length and walked on two thick , muscular legs . Their body and tail were proportionally large . They had a curved neck with a lizard - like head , which had a distinctive nose horn and brow ridges and knobby bumps above their over - sized eyes . Their arms were tiny with four clawed fingers each . Behavior . Ceratosaurs hunted either alone or in pairs . If in pairs , one would intentionally drive prey into the clutches of the other . Combat . Ceratosaurs used their speed and powerful jaws to their advantage . If they caught a creature in their mouths , they would shake it violently . History . Ceratosaurs , like most dinosaurs , originated in Chult . No one had ever successfully tamed a ceratosaur .

title: Cerebrilith
description: Cerebrilith A cerebrilith was a type of tanar ' ri demon native to the Abyss . It was notable for possessing psionic powers . Physical description .
description_long: Cerebrilith A cerebrilith was a type of tanar ' ri demon native to the Abyss . It was notable for possessing psionic powers . Physical description . A cerebrilith appeared as a giant ogre - like humanoid creature , standing around 8 feet ( 2 . 4 meters ) high when upright in battle . However , it normally knuckle - walked on all fours due to its hunched back . The body was relatively gangly , with skin turned slick and slimy as if it continually leaked some fluid . Its skull was bulging and elongated , sweeping back and merging into its hunched back , with a bony brow and protruding fanged jaw with long , thin tongue . Its most obvious feature was a hideously swollen and exposed brain , shielded beneath a lattice of its spinal bones . Behavior . Cerebriliths spent their time cultivating their mental powers , usually acting alone or in groups of up to four , by hunting and killing mortal prey . They loved to kill intelligent beings and extract their brains , which they would examine in an effort to gain fresh insights into the powers of the mind .

title: Ceremorphosis
description: Ceremorphosis Ceremorphosis was a bodily change that occurred when an illithid tadpole reached maturity and was inserted into the brain of another humanoid being , usually a human . The tadpole ate away the victim ' s brain matter and essentially replaced the brain , erasing all of the subject ' s personality and memory , but leaving the physical body alive and under the tadpole ' s control . After this , " morphological transformations " occurred and a new illithid was created .
description_long: Ceremorphosis Ceremorphosis was a bodily change that occurred when an illithid tadpole reached maturity and was inserted into the brain of another humanoid being , usually a human . The tadpole ate away the victim ' s brain matter and essentially replaced the brain , erasing all of the subject ' s personality and memory , but leaving the physical body alive and under the tadpole ' s control . After this , " morphological transformations " occurred and a new illithid was created . Half - illithid . If this was done with a non - human , the result was called a " half - illithid " . Another name for a half - illithid was " ceremorph " . They did , however , still possess most of the powers of a regular illithid . Examples of creatures beyond humans that had undergone ceremorphosis successfully were : An illithid tadpole that survived but was not submitted to ceremorphosis was called a neothelid .

title: Cereon
description: Cereon Cereon was a sun elf . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Cereon was a leader of his fellow elves .
description_long: Cereon Cereon was a sun elf . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Cereon was a leader of his fellow elves . History . Cereon hailed from the Feywild but settled in Faerun many centuries before . In 1486 DR , Cereon agreed to meet Dahl Peredur , who asked his help to make his escape plan work . However , Cereon distrusted Dahl but suddenly the situation precipitated . So Cereon changed his mind and agreed to help .

title: Cerest Elenithil
description: Cerest Elenithil Cerest Elenithil was a gold elf originally from Myth Drannor . He was the offspring of an illicit liaison between his mother and another elf . Because of his illegitimate birth , he was never fully accepted by his family and left Myth Drannor at an early age .
description_long: Cerest Elenithil Cerest Elenithil was a gold elf originally from Myth Drannor . He was the offspring of an illicit liaison between his mother and another elf . Because of his illegitimate birth , he was never fully accepted by his family and left Myth Drannor at an early age . History . After leaving Myth Drannor , he traveled to Baldur ' s Gate where he began buying and selling magic items . During his time in Baldur ' s Gate he befriended a human adventurer named Elgreth Tearn . The two teamed up with a young couple who were interested in studying the effects of the Spellplague on Faerûn . During one of their expeditions , the group explored an old tower which had been ruined by the Spellplague . They accidentally released dormant blue fire , which killed the couple and horribly scared Cerest ' s face . Elgreth was also touched by the blue fire as was the couple ' s young daughter , Icelin . Elgreth ' s spellscar gave him the ability to detect anything magical , a skill very useful to an artifact hunter like Cerest .

title: Cerion Haldoreth
description: Cerion Haldoreth Cerion Haldoreth was a wood elf who lived in the Tower District of Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He helped elven adventurer s new to the city by telling them about Evermeet and recruiting them for missions benefiting the elven race .
description_long: Cerion Haldoreth Cerion Haldoreth was a wood elf who lived in the Tower District of Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He helped elven adventurer s new to the city by telling them about Evermeet and recruiting them for missions benefiting the elven race . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Cerion only interacted only with players who had elf as their race .

title: Cernd
description: Cernd Cernd is a party NPC in the " " computer game and its expansion " " , and can be recruited into the player ' s party from his prison cell beneath the Mayor of Trademeet ' s home . He plays a vital role in the quest to resolve the disturbance at the druid grove , and also gives the player access to another subquest involving his son . In the game , Cernd comes equipped with two personal items ; a Cloak of the High Forest and a Staff of the High Forest .
description_long: Cernd Cernd is a party NPC in the " " computer game and its expansion " " , and can be recruited into the player ' s party from his prison cell beneath the Mayor of Trademeet ' s home . He plays a vital role in the quest to resolve the disturbance at the druid grove , and also gives the player access to another subquest involving his son . In the game , Cernd comes equipped with two personal items ; a Cloak of the High Forest and a Staff of the High Forest . Only Cernd can use these items . Biography . Cernd is a respected senior druid from a grove in the land of Tethyr , to the south of Amn . In 1369 DR , he was sent north to investigate a disturbance at a druid grove in Amn . The influence of Shadow Druids had corrupted the once peaceful druid enclave , resulting in conflict with the nearby town of Trademeet ; while investigating the area Cernd was captured by the townsfolk and imprisoned . They mistakenly took him for one of the Shadow Druids responsible , and based on these suspicions they incarcerated him - delaying his investigation and prolonging the crisis . If Cernd joins your party , it will give you a side quest that concerns Cernd ' s past .

title: Cernd Shattermind
description: Cernd Shattermind Cernd Shattermind was a hybrid illithid dwarf living in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Cernd was a member of Clan Arnskull .
description_long: Cernd Shattermind Cernd Shattermind was a hybrid illithid dwarf living in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Cernd was a member of Clan Arnskull . In his youth , he was captured by the mind flayer s of Oryndoll and bought to their city as a mind - thrall . Cernd lived there for many years as a slave miner until his broken body became too unfit . He was then selected as a subject for ceremorphosis , which was unusual because dwarves were considered unsuitable for the procedure . In fact , the ceremorphois failed , resulting in an individual that half resembled a dwarf and half an illithid and with the personality of Cernd intact . Cernd managed to escape back to Iltkazar . Here , thank to the intercession of the high priest of Dumathoin , Bettargh Stoneshoulder , the Regency Council allowed Cernd to live in the city , albeit under discrete but constant supervision .

title: Cespenar
description: Cespenar Cespenar was an imp who used to serve Bhaal as a " butler " . He appeared to have vanished from existence with that deity ' s death , but reappeared in the Pocket Plane , which Gorion ' s Ward and party unconsciously created to protect themselves within Bhaal ' s domain . Cespenar was able to upgrade and create various enchanted items from the right ingredients .
description_long: Cespenar Cespenar was an imp who used to serve Bhaal as a " butler " . He appeared to have vanished from existence with that deity ' s death , but reappeared in the Pocket Plane , which Gorion ' s Ward and party unconsciously created to protect themselves within Bhaal ' s domain . Cespenar was able to upgrade and create various enchanted items from the right ingredients . Some of the items Cespenar could improve included : Cespenar likely ceased to exist again when Gorion ' s Ward dissolved the Pocket Plane before their final encounter .

title: Ch ' Chitl
description: Ch ' Chitl Ch ' Chitl was a city of mind flayers located 18 mi ( 28 . 97 km ) beneath the Sword Mountains . History .
description_long: Ch ' Chitl Ch ' Chitl was a city of mind flayers located 18 mi ( 28 . 97 km ) beneath the Sword Mountains . History . In 1154 DR , Ch ' Chitl was founded by a cult of illithids that planned the settlement as an adjunct to Skullport . Around 1250 DR , a surprise githyanki attack led to the mortal wounding of the Elder brain . The town was ruled by a council of elders after the death of it ' s elder brain . Ch ' Chitl was devastated by the Spellplague in 1385 DR and many of the illithids were horribly spellscarred . Three of the elders were merged into one being which became the settlement ' s new elder brain . The remaining illithids acquired extraordinary psionic powers from their spellscars .

title: Ch ' ou Chu Lan
description: Ch ' ou Chu Lan Ch ' ou Chu Lan was the Chamberlain of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Rumors said that Ch ' ou Chu Lan was originally a monk student of the Dragonfly school of kung fu and that he so impressed the young Kai Tsao Shou Chin with his clear thinking that the Emperor immediately appointed him to the Imperial household .
description_long: Ch ' ou Chu Lan Ch ' ou Chu Lan was the Chamberlain of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Rumors said that Ch ' ou Chu Lan was originally a monk student of the Dragonfly school of kung fu and that he so impressed the young Kai Tsao Shou Chin with his clear thinking that the Emperor immediately appointed him to the Imperial household . Ch ' ou Chu Lan ' s duties were to take care of all Imperial palaces , castles , and retreats , managing and paying the staff and even the guards . He was always calm and composed even in the most chaotic situation .

title: Chaab
description: Chaab Chaab was a Zhent agent during the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR . History . Chaab was an agent of the Zhentarim .
description_long: Chaab Chaab was a Zhent agent during the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR . History . Chaab was an agent of the Zhentarim . He was send to Phlan to investigate the story of a black dragon that had had strange dealings with outsiders but had recently been killed by adventurers . Chaab however ended up being captured by the Foulwater goblin tribe who used the dragon ' s lair as a base . At last , he was rescued by adventurers hired to defeat the goblins and told them his story . Later Chaab was possibly involved in the case of thief at Mantor ' s Library , the Zhent ' s objective was acquire the subterranean complex in Dragonspire Mountains discovered by the adventurers for themself .

title: Chac
description: Chac Chacs looked like slender jaguar s when on all fours and werejaguar s when they assumed a bipedal stance . They were spirits who helped control the rains in Maztica and lived in caves high in the mountains . From their caves they sent out rain to the surrounding countryside .
description_long: Chac Chacs looked like slender jaguar s when on all fours and werejaguar s when they assumed a bipedal stance . They were spirits who helped control the rains in Maztica and lived in caves high in the mountains . From their caves they sent out rain to the surrounding countryside . A chac ' s colouring depended on where they lived . Northern Maztican chacs were blue while those in the east were black . Chacs from the south were red while those in the west were yellow . Chacs tended to be lawful neutral .

title: Chachim
description: Chachim Chachim was an assassin of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Chachim was born in Amn and he trained at the School of Stealth in Zazesspur .
description_long: Chachim Chachim was an assassin of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Chachim was born in Amn and he trained at the School of Stealth in Zazesspur . Later , he became an agent of Inselm Hhune , rising to become one of the most trusted men of the First Shield Lord , often anticipating his master ' s commands . Usually he did the dirty work for the Shield Council .

title: Chad Dulac
description: Chad Dulac Chad A . Dulac is a serviceman in the U . S .
description_long: Chad Dulac Chad A . Dulac is a serviceman in the U . S . Navy who has been working as a concept artist on the side since the late 90s . His work has been published in both Dungeon and Dragon magazine s 14 times . He is also the COO of SilverHelm Sudios LLC . , a game design company . He has stated that he plans to retire from active service in 2016 and concentrate on his artwork . External Links . Chad Dulac ' s Deviantart page

title: Chadal
description: Chadal Chadal was a young thief in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Chadal was one the Little Rats , a gang of children affiliated with Dead Rats gang , acting as spies and messengers .
description_long: Chadal Chadal was a young thief in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Chadal was one the Little Rats , a gang of children affiliated with Dead Rats gang , acting as spies and messengers . History . In 1479 DR , she was on her way to meeting her boss Darla to tell her the location of Elden Vargas ' s base when Chadal was attacked and burned . Thanks to an adventuring party , she was cured and told them the crucial information .

title: Chador
description: Chador A chador ( pronounced " SHAH - dor " ) was a type of robe worn by some women of Zakhara . and Calimshan . Description .
description_long: Chador A chador ( pronounced " SHAH - dor " ) was a type of robe worn by some women of Zakhara . and Calimshan . Description . These robes covered a woman ' s entire body and came with hoods and special face - coverings that allowed the wearer to see clearly while still shielding her eyes from view . This garment was common in regions where moralists had power . Chadors were available in white for unmarried women , black for married women , and red for widows . Underneath a chador , a woman would wear trousers , a blouse , and a tunic , and sometimes a vest , or they would wear a caftan . Prices . A typical chador sold for 8 sp .

title: Chaggrin
description: Chaggrin Chaggrins , or soil beasts , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Because of their destruction of valuable minerals , chaggrins were considered to be elemental vermin on their native plane . Description .
description_long: Chaggrin Chaggrins , or soil beasts , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Because of their destruction of valuable minerals , chaggrins were considered to be elemental vermin on their native plane . Description . On the Elemental Plane of Earth , chaggrins appeared as hideous bipedal lumps of clay . Their tiny eyes gleamed with light . When encountered on the Prime Material Plane , chaggrins often looked like large moles or hedgehogs , though their skull - like heads made it evident that they were not normal creatures . Though only measuring a few feet in length while in this form , chaggrins could weigh 140 – 210 pounds ( 63 – 95 kg ) . Combat . Chaggrins could change their shape at will . While in their humanoid shape , they could merge into any surface of earth or stone . They could not move about while merging with the earth or stone , but could wait and hide . They used this ability to surprise unsuspecting targets . The sharp claws of the chaggrin were capable of inflicting serious wounds to their enemies . A favored tactic was to latch on to their target so the struggling enemy damaged itself further .

title: Chahir
description: Chahir Chahir was a vampire sorcerer that resided in the crypts of Dordrien . Description . Chahir sported thick black hair and and carefully trimmed beard and mustache .
description_long: Chahir Chahir was a vampire sorcerer that resided in the crypts of Dordrien . Description . Chahir sported thick black hair and and carefully trimmed beard and mustache . Despite a somewhat emaciated appearance , Chahir was noted as being particularly handsome and had almost beige - coloured skin . Dressing in ancient finery , Chahir wore a fine silken robe , embroidered with gold thread and held together down the front by gem - studded buttons . Abilities . Whilst having the formidable array of powerful abilities afforded most vampires , Chahir also utilized numerous sorcerous powers in conjunction with these to get the jump on interlopers . Often Chahir would turn himself invisible and seep out of his coffin undetected in his gaseous form before unleashing potent lightning bolt s upon his foes . Possessions . During his many years of preying on tomb robbers Chahir had ammassed a sizable amount of silver and gold coins and even an emerald . He stored this treasuer in his wife ' s vacant coffin .

title: Chaid al Farid al Fuqani
description: Chaid al Farid al Fuqani Chaid al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyrian human from Myratma . Description . Chaid had dusky skin , jet black curly hair , and bronze - colored eyes .
description_long: Chaid al Farid al Fuqani Chaid al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyrian human from Myratma . Description . Chaid had dusky skin , jet black curly hair , and bronze - colored eyes . Relationships . Chaid ' s brother was Tarik al Farid al Fuqani . History . Chaid resided at the Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep from a young age . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , he found his weasel familiar Brakar during a hunt in the Pellamcopse Woods under the supervision of Tsarra Chaadren . On the same day , Chaid and his brother used floating disks to dump salt on a nishruu which attacked Blackstaff Tower and and defeated it . They had become familiar with nishruu from hearing bedtime stories .

title: Chain lightning
description: Chain lightning Chain lightning was an evocation spell that blasted a target with lightning then jumped on to more targets . Effect . This spell created a lightning bolt that traveled from target to target doing successively less and less damage .
description_long: Chain lightning Chain lightning was an evocation spell that blasted a target with lightning then jumped on to more targets . Effect . This spell created a lightning bolt that traveled from target to target doing successively less and less damage . Distance between targets was more important then what type of target they where . Depending on the caster ' s skill , the chain lightning would " jump " between targets more and more . Older versions of the spell could be stopped by it striking a grounded target like an iron bars , which would send the lightning into the ground . The post - Second Sundering version cast a bolt that struck a target then split on to three different bolts that struck different targets . If used at a higher spell level , an additional bolt would leap from the first target . Components . The spell required vocal and somatic components , plus a bit of fur ; a piece of amber , glass , or a crystal rod ; and one silver pin for each level of the caster ' s power . The post - Second Sundering version needed the same except only three silver pins in total .

title: Chainmail
description: Chainmail Chainmail ( also knowns as chain mail or simply chain ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chainmail was a common form of armor made of interlocking metal rings .
description_long: Chainmail Chainmail ( also knowns as chain mail or simply chain ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chainmail was a common form of armor made of interlocking metal rings . Clothing was typically worn underneath such an article to prevent irritation and chafing . Chainmail could also provide the base of other armors , such as plate mail . Chainmail could comprise an entire set of armor , or it could be a specific article , such as a chain shirt or gauntlet . Aurora ' s Emporium sold chainmail chemises ( 45 gp ) , corsets ( 25 gp ) , leggings ( 35 gp ) , loin cloths ( 20 gp ) , bustenhalts / brassieres ( 15 gp ) , and skirts ( 40 gp ) . Chainmail was often used for barding ( armor for a horse or other mount ) . Chain shirts covered only the torso , leaving the arms and legs free . They usually had a cloth layer underneath to prevent chafing and bruising . A typical chain shirt was considered light armor and cost 100 gp . Chainmail armor covered most of the body and hung from the shoulders , making it uncomfortable to wear for a long time . A typical set of chainmail armor was considered medium armor and cost 150 gp . Some chainmail armor was considered heavy armor .

title: Chaka
description: Chaka A chaka was the term given to the core social unit of the Shining Lands . Organization . A basic chaka was comprised of a single extended family .
description_long: Chaka A chaka was the term given to the core social unit of the Shining Lands . Organization . A basic chaka was comprised of a single extended family . However , a large chaka could consist of dozens of families , including unrelated families who were allied together because of similar business interests . Chakas were usually led by the eldest family member , be they male or female . Many times the eldest , and best , trader would be away on business , at which point a younger member of the chaka would assume leadership until their return . Chakas were named in a manner similar to a clan . Some prominent chakas are listed below :

title: Chakas of 31
description: Chakas of 31 The Chakas of 31 were a group of prominent chaka s in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . Chakas of this group were usually the most successful merchant organizations within the Shining Lands .
description_long: Chakas of 31 The Chakas of 31 were a group of prominent chaka s in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . Chakas of this group were usually the most successful merchant organizations within the Shining Lands . Many members of these various chakas were also associated with the Council of Merchants , granting them influence with major decisions effecting the Shining Lands . Base of Operations . The Chakas of 31 were based out of Heldapan in central Durpar .

title: Chakram
description: Chakram A chakram was a small throwing disk . Description . A typical chakram was a metal ( often steel ) disk from five inches ( 13 centimeters ) to a foot ( 30 centimeters ) in radius with a sharpened outer edge and a rounded inner edge .
description_long: Chakram A chakram was a small throwing disk . Description . A typical chakram was a metal ( often steel ) disk from five inches ( 13 centimeters ) to a foot ( 30 centimeters ) in radius with a sharpened outer edge and a rounded inner edge . They usually weighed between one half and two pounds ( one kilogram ) . They were oven covered in intricate engravings . The cost to purchase a chakram varied from one to fifteen gold piece s . Usage . A chakram was thrown much like a discus . Notable Users . The chakram was the favored weapon of priests of the goddess Shar . She was said to carry a magical chakram called the " Disk of Night " . The deity Tyche also favored the chakram .

title: Chaks
description: Chaks Chaks was the Cloakmaster of Zazesspur for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Chaks was originally a slave in Calimshan until he escaped when a teenager .
description_long: Chaks Chaks was the Cloakmaster of Zazesspur for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Chaks was originally a slave in Calimshan until he escaped when a teenager . He made a career as a bounty hunter , but never hunted escaped slaves . He was considered by the Shade of the Sword sect for a position as guildmaster of the bounty hunters guild , but the need to fill the empty position of Cloakmaster of Zazesspur prevailed . Thus he was given the position in reward for an old service performed for the Shade . Activities . In public , he ran a small school for fighter s in Karlaggar , the mercenaries ' quarter of Zazesspur . Sometimes students of the Assassins ' School of Stealth were sent to his school . Chaks was not afraid to hunt down and kill another Cloakmaster who interfered with his work , but only after sending a note of protest to his superior in the Shadow Council .

title: Chalannos Firehawk
description: Chalannos Firehawk Chalannos " the Masked " Firehawk was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a retired adventurer . Chalannos was a former adventurer who retired to a cottage on a lane on the northeastern edge of Wheloon by 1358 DR .
description_long: Chalannos Firehawk Chalannos " the Masked " Firehawk was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a retired adventurer . Chalannos was a former adventurer who retired to a cottage on a lane on the northeastern edge of Wheloon by 1358 DR . There he was available to instruct other warriors , and was an expert trainer , able to teach his students how to use any particular weapon . His fees were several gold piece s or a magical item he could use .

title: Chalarstaukh
description: Chalarstaukh Chalarstaukh was the largest goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Chalarstaukh was located in the Chalarstaukh caverns in the western foothills of the Rauvin Mountains , not far from Citadel Felbarr .
description_long: Chalarstaukh Chalarstaukh was the largest goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Chalarstaukh was located in the Chalarstaukh caverns in the western foothills of the Rauvin Mountains , not far from Citadel Felbarr . Government . In 1372 DR , King Asglarek and his seven sons ruled Chalarstaukh . Inhabitants . Chalarstaukh was inhabited by goblins , who subsisted on yellow cave - worms . This habit meant that the Chalarstaukh goblins were called " Worm - Eaters " by the orc s above , who often raided the goblin warrens . History . In the 1370s DR , the goblins of Chalarstaukh delved southwest of their home and discovered a number of dwarf tombs . The goblins ransacked the tombs , finding a number of magical items they intended to use against their enemies — if they ever figured out how to use them .

title: Chalaska Muruin
description: Chalaska Muruin Chalaska Muruin was the unofficial ruler of Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Muruin was the master of the gate guards of the Inn and acted as unofficial ruler under orders of a cabal of plutocratic business owners , most of whom were in the pockets of the Zhentarim .
description_long: Chalaska Muruin Chalaska Muruin was the unofficial ruler of Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Muruin was the master of the gate guards of the Inn and acted as unofficial ruler under orders of a cabal of plutocratic business owners , most of whom were in the pockets of the Zhentarim .

title: Chalcedony
description: Chalcedony Chalcedony was a mixture of and , usually white , but rare variations included gray or black . Description . This semi - precious stone was the base mineral in many gem - quality stones such as carnelians , chrysoprase , and agate s .
description_long: Chalcedony Chalcedony was a mixture of and , usually white , but rare variations included gray or black . Description . This semi - precious stone was the base mineral in many gem - quality stones such as carnelians , chrysoprase , and agate s . It was usually cut and used in making devices that offered protection from the undead . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Chalco
description: Chalco Chalco was one of the greatest Nexal an rulers of history . History . After the rule of the warmonger Pakli , Chalco was chosen as the new ruler because he was the most powerful warrior of his time and a cousin of Pakli .
description_long: Chalco Chalco was one of the greatest Nexal an rulers of history . History . After the rule of the warmonger Pakli , Chalco was chosen as the new ruler because he was the most powerful warrior of his time and a cousin of Pakli . Immediately , Chalco launched the biggest invasion of Kultaka ever , capturing a large number of captives . The city of Kultakas itself was saved only by the timely emergence of Takamal in the Kultakans ' ranks . Chalco was forced to retreat but had won great honor . He decided that his next target would be the Otomis . Chalco ' s army greatly devastated the Otomis but they never surrendered and afterward Chaco went back to Nexal with many captives and treasures . The Otomis emerged from their hiding places and patiently rebuilt their civilization . Chalco developed two obsessions : to find the Nexalan s ' ancestral home and to find the fabled Tewacha but his research into both ended with no success . After his death , his successor was his grandson Axalt .

title: Chalsembyr ' s Heart
description: Chalsembyr ' s Heart Chalsembyr ' s Heart was a magic al greatsword central to the church of Torm the True , forged to guide paladin s who sought Chalsembyr . Description . " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " was a finely crafted greatsword forged of cold iron and gold , with a lion motif .
description_long: Chalsembyr ' s Heart Chalsembyr ' s Heart was a magic al greatsword central to the church of Torm the True , forged to guide paladin s who sought Chalsembyr . Description . " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " was a finely crafted greatsword forged of cold iron and gold , with a lion motif . The cross guards were shaped like lion ' s paws , and where they met the blade at the rain guard was an image of a lion ' s head , in profile on one side , face - on on the other . The hilt was bound in white leather and gold wire . Set into the pommel was a large , brilliant - cut white diamond , circled by five rectangular fiery yellow corundum s . The cold iron blade was tinted with gold , with the words " Seek the High Seat Always " written in the Celestial language etched on both sides . History . According to legend , Bertold the Seeker was a paladin of Torm who embarked on the traditional quest to rediscover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr , the realm of the once - mortal Torm . To aid him in this endeavor , cleric s of the House of the Hand temple in Procampur , the Vast , forged " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " . Bertold carried the sword with him on his journeys .

title: Chalthos Immer
description: Chalthos Immer Chalthos Immer was a man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Immerhand Inn . Chalthos Immer was once a mercenary warrior .
description_long: Chalthos Immer Chalthos Immer was a man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Immerhand Inn . Chalthos Immer was once a mercenary warrior . During his career , he relied on huge storm lanterns . He also managed to loot a number of paintings from all around Faerûn . He later retired to Wheloon to run the Immerhand Inn by 1358 DR , and was still in business " circa " 1369 DR . He furnished each room of his inn with his favored storm lanterns , and with one of his looted paintings .

title: Chamal Avenue
description: Chamal Avenue Chamal Avenue was a road in Myth Nantar leading east from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s center , to the Mermaid ' s Gate at its edge . It was named after Chamal , the only mermaid Dukar , and was paved with aqua - colored mosaics .
description_long: Chamal Avenue Chamal Avenue was a road in Myth Nantar leading east from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s center , to the Mermaid ' s Gate at its edge . It was named after Chamal , the only mermaid Dukar , and was paved with aqua - colored mosaics .

title: Chamber of Judges
description: Chamber of Judges The Chamber of Judges was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Chamber of Judges was a three - chambered structure .
description_long: Chamber of Judges The Chamber of Judges was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Chamber of Judges was a three - chambered structure . Activities . The most important cases in Huzuz were judged here by experienced " qadi " . Judgment was usually given quickly , sometimes aided by magical means of determining the truth . Any case heard by the Grand Caliph himself first passed through the Chamber of Judges to warrant its merit . Inhabitants . The " qadi " and scribes were guarded by two full platoons of the Valiant .

title: Chameleon leather
description: Chameleon leather Chameleon leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chameleon leather was made from the treated hide of an ophidian .
description_long: Chameleon leather Chameleon leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chameleon leather was made from the treated hide of an ophidian . The breastplate and shoulders of the armor were stiffened by boiling in oil . The rest of the armor remained tough , but flexible . The armor did maintain a fraction of the color - changing abilities that the ophidian once possessed . Chamelon leather could only be crafted by a master leatherwoker . Usage . Chameleon armor was only commonly found in communities near the Serpent Hills . Any serpentfolk who encountered non - serpentfolk wearing chameleon leather would treat the wearers with disdain or hostility .

title: Champion of Gwynharwyf
description: Champion of Gwynharwyf Champions of Gwynharwyf strive to emulate their celestial patron ' s balance of fury and reserve , proving that rage and righteousness can coexist in one being . Background . No matter what their background , every champion of Gwynharwyf needs at least one level of barbarian to gain access to the class ' s battle - frenzy requirement .
description_long: Champion of Gwynharwyf Champions of Gwynharwyf strive to emulate their celestial patron ' s balance of fury and reserve , proving that rage and righteousness can coexist in one being . Background . No matter what their background , every champion of Gwynharwyf needs at least one level of barbarian to gain access to the class ' s battle - frenzy requirement . ( For dwarves , one or more levels of battlerager will also suffice . ) Beyond this , however , anything goes , and the champions come from every background except that of the paladin , which is barred by the alignment restriction . Typically they are single - class barbarians , but fighter / barbarians and ranger / barbarians have also been known to take this class . The majority of champions are wanderers , battling evil with their rage wherever they find it . Some are guerrilla fighters seeking to overthrow evil governments and liberate the oppressed . Other champions delve into the ruins and caves of the world , driving out and destroying creatures of evil . Still others work the slums , fighting crime and crushing evil cults .

title: Champions Vigilant
description: Champions Vigilant The Champions Vigilant was a Tethyr ian knightly order of Helm . It was prestigious and popular and saved thousands of lives during the Tethyrian Interregnum . They had fortified bases dotting the countryside .
description_long: Champions Vigilant The Champions Vigilant was a Tethyr ian knightly order of Helm . It was prestigious and popular and saved thousands of lives during the Tethyrian Interregnum . They had fortified bases dotting the countryside . History . The order was founded in 1164 DR , during the reign of King Coram III .

title: Champions of Muktar
description: Champions of Muktar The Champions of Muktar were an evil adventuring company in Muktar in Turmish in 1358 DR . Organization . They acted as high - ranking officers in the army of the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , during the war between Muktar and Golconda .
description_long: Champions of Muktar The Champions of Muktar were an evil adventuring company in Muktar in Turmish in 1358 DR . Organization . They acted as high - ranking officers in the army of the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , during the war between Muktar and Golconda . Members . The five members of the group were : History . In 1358 DR the Champions arranged a trap inside Fort Blood planned by the king of Muktar to eliminate an adventuring party well known in Golconda . Later they led Muktar ' s troops in the Battle of Wilma Pass .

title: Chan Cheng
description: Chan Cheng Chan Cheng ( pronounced " chan ching " ) , called the Mighty Lord of Heroes , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of battle , bravery , and martial arts , and represented the virtue of courage in the Path of Enlightenment . As one of the Nine Immortals , Chan Cheng also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers .
description_long: Chan Cheng Chan Cheng ( pronounced " chan ching " ) , called the Mighty Lord of Heroes , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of battle , bravery , and martial arts , and represented the virtue of courage in the Path of Enlightenment . As one of the Nine Immortals , Chan Cheng also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers . History . The mortal . According to recorded history , Chan Cheng was a great leader who unified a number of warring states along the Ch ' ing Tung River in −1887 DR , ruling them from the Imperial City of Ten Mor Shou . This commenced what historians call the Second Age of Shou Lung . The Celestial Emperor blessed Chan Cheng , making him the first of the Nine Immortals . The immortal . According to the legendary history of Kara - Tur , shortly after the beginning of the world and human kind , the Celestial Emperor sent his great emissaries among the people , with each to teach one aspect of the True Path of Enlightenment . Chan Cheng was one of these emissaries , teacher of the virtue of courage .

title: Chan Chiong
description: Chan Chiong Chan Chiong was a skeleton in Kuning Valley in Shou Lung . History . In ancient times , Chan Chiong led the Segara Sea Lords , a large pirate fleet that preyed upon ships from their harbors in Muara Bay and Ahn Bay .
description_long: Chan Chiong Chan Chiong was a skeleton in Kuning Valley in Shou Lung . History . In ancient times , Chan Chiong led the Segara Sea Lords , a large pirate fleet that preyed upon ships from their harbors in Muara Bay and Ahn Bay . One day , the governor of Tempat Larang , Sangkal Chunbi , offered to bargain with Chan Chiong but when the pirates killed his ambassadors , he decided to crush him . When Chan Chiong heard about this , he gathered a fleet of 1 , 000 warships to attack Sampar , the port nearest to Tempat Larang . Governor Chunbi knew that his troops were ineffective against the pirates so he called his wu jen Kimasogi . Kimisogi counseled the governor to divide the pirates before attack . So Governor Chunbi sent to Chan Chiong a large ship full of treasures offering peace . Chan Chiong and his men started arguing about how to divide the treasure , no longer caring more the attack on Sampar . Meanwhile , the troops of Tempat Larang marched upon the pirate harbor . Attacking by surprise , the Shou troops captured most of the pirates and all their warships . Governor Chunbi converted most of the pirate sailors and the warships into the new southern fleet of Shou Lung .

title: Chancil Crystalheart
description: Chancil Crystalheart Chancil Crystalheart was a human mage of Memnon in Calimshan in the 1350s DR . Relations . Chancil was a subordinate of Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka .
description_long: Chancil Crystalheart Chancil Crystalheart was a human mage of Memnon in Calimshan in the 1350s DR . Relations . Chancil was a subordinate of Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka . Furthermore , Duum possessed Chancil ' s actual heart encased in a crystal and kept in his home in Manshaka , while a connecting crystal was embedded in Chancil ' s chest where his heart should be . Thus , he was called " Crystalheart " . With the heart , Duum knew when Chancil acted disloyally and punished him with agony as his heart beat more rapidly , and thus ensured his obedience . Chancil paid a band of thugs and mage apprentices to protect him and keep away those who sought him . Such men were equipped with wands of " telekinesis " . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Chancil and a group of bounty hunters traveled to Waterdeep and the Selûne ' s Smile tavern . Slipping a potion into the drinks , they rendered all the patrons unconscious and kidnapped the cat child . Chancil returned to Memnon , where he kept the cat child prisoner in his house prior to delivering him to Duum .

title: Chanczlatha Luruin
description: Chanczlatha Luruin Chanczlatha Luruin was a cleric of Lathander who lived at the Bargewright Inn in the Dessarin Valley around 1365 DR . Activities . He was a revered healer within his community who dedicated his life to tending the sick .
description_long: Chanczlatha Luruin Chanczlatha Luruin was a cleric of Lathander who lived at the Bargewright Inn in the Dessarin Valley around 1365 DR . Activities . He was a revered healer within his community who dedicated his life to tending the sick . An unassuming man with a stammer , Luruin was often called on to heal others who ' d fallen in peril with his gentle hands . Although always willing to heal the faithful of Lathander for free , the physician had to charge fees for his services to help cover the heavy costs of his medicines and the animals he cared for . Many of these beasts were kept alive where others would leave them to die . Relationships . The husband to a woman named Baerlatha , Chanczlatha was not one to often leave the community he called home .

title: Chaney
description: Chaney Chaney was the name assigned to a doppelganger who was Howard Holiday ' s chief spy in Ravens Bluff around 1356 – 1357 DR . No one knew its real name , or if it even had one . History .
description_long: Chaney Chaney was the name assigned to a doppelganger who was Howard Holiday ' s chief spy in Ravens Bluff around 1356 – 1357 DR . No one knew its real name , or if it even had one . History . Chaney was captured by Howard Holiday and his adventuring companions a few years previously . Howard took Chaney as part of his share of the treasure . The other members of the party figured Howard would turn the doppelganger into spell components and potion ingredients but Howard had other ideas . When he became Deputy Mayor of Ravens Bluff and the chief intelligence officer , the idea of having a doppelganger as a spy was so appealing that he put great effort into making the arrangement work . Chaney was convinced and served brilliantly ever since . Officially , the Lord Mayor knew nothing about Howard ' s " special project " . Description . Chaney was able to look like anyone , but normally assumed one of three different shapes and personalities : Curmudgeon : Typically used in the business district , this form was of a big , slow - witted common laborer that nobody looked twice at .

title: Chang - liu - shui
description: Chang - liu - shui Chang - liu - shui , or Inexhaustible Spring Halt , was a small town located on the Spice Road on the Plain of Horses . Description . This oasis could be found between the Merket Depression and the Ni - Ko Oasis .
description_long: Chang - liu - shui Chang - liu - shui , or Inexhaustible Spring Halt , was a small town located on the Spice Road on the Plain of Horses . Description . This oasis could be found between the Merket Depression and the Ni - Ko Oasis . The actual well was found beneath a lone willow tree near a muddy pond . Water from the well was drawn from a clean underground river . The constant supply of water from the river , which allowed it to never dry out , even in the worst heats , spawned the nickname of Inexhaustible Spring Halt .
