A small house , half buried in the ground , was located near the pond . Altho Farambler , a halfing from Faerûn , had setup a small business here by 1359 DR , often selling water to travelers .

title: Changchub Zangpo
description: Changchub Zangpo Changchub Zangpo was the Sergeant of the Guard for Saikhoi in Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As with all of his fellow sohei , Changchub was a fanatic while within the walls of Saikhoi , willing to give his life in defense of the city and its rulers .
description_long: Changchub Zangpo Changchub Zangpo was the Sergeant of the Guard for Saikhoi in Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As with all of his fellow sohei , Changchub was a fanatic while within the walls of Saikhoi , willing to give his life in defense of the city and its rulers . However , outside of Saikhoi , he was extremely superstitious and unpredictable . Abilities . Changchub was a practicing sohei — a dangerous type of warrior - monk found in Ra - Khati . His skills included training in martial arts ; weapons training ; and minor spell - like abilities such as " detect magic " , " remove fear " , and " hold person " .

title: Change domain
description: Change domain The goddesses Selûne and Tymora both are part of the change domain but both have a different view upon change . In the eyes goddess of the tides and the cycles of the moon Selûne everything that changes will some day change back . She looks upon change as a natural , continual , process essential to life and the world .
description_long: Change domain The goddesses Selûne and Tymora both are part of the change domain but both have a different view upon change . In the eyes goddess of the tides and the cycles of the moon Selûne everything that changes will some day change back . She looks upon change as a natural , continual , process essential to life and the world . Tymora believes people should embrace the change that occur in their lives no mater how small it might seam , and to seek out experiences that will alter their lives . The lady luck believes change , especially random change , invites growth . Power of change Domain . Any divine caster that worships a deity who claims the change domain may choose to channel the deities powers within the domain , and when the caster choses the domain she will become more skilled in thievery . When a caster who chooses to channel the domain uses a power that is within the domain she will become more accurate with her attacks shorty after the casting and within the battle . < br > The powers of the change Domain are : < br > Bolstering strike < br > Divine bolts < br > Overwhelming strike < br > Recovery strike < br > The cycle of change divinity .

title: Changestaff
description: Changestaff Changestaff was a transmutation or evocation and enchantment spell that made a specially prepared staff become a treant - like creature on command . Effects . This spell required a staff that was specifically prepared for use with this spell .
description_long: Changestaff Changestaff was a transmutation or evocation and enchantment spell that made a specially prepared staff become a treant - like creature on command . Effects . This spell required a staff that was specifically prepared for use with this spell . The caster planted the staff in the ground and spoke the command invocation and the staff immediately became a creature about 24 ft ( 7 . 3 m ) tall that looked and fought like a treant but had none of the other abilities of a treant . The staff - treant was at the command of the caster and would defend him or her to the death . If the staff - treant was killed , it turned into powder and the staff was lost . Otherwise , the creature turned back into a staff when the spell expired or at the command of the caster , whichever came first . The staff - treant could be summoned , refreshed and renewed , once every 24 hours . Components . There were two different methods of preparing the staff for this spell . The older version was complex and very demanding of the druid ' s time . First , a limb from a lightning - struck tree had to be harvested within 24 hours of the strike .

title: Chanii
description: Chanii Chanii was a ch ' i - lin member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Chanii was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .
description_long: Chanii Chanii was a ch ' i - lin member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Chanii was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Chanii oversaw about the hairy animals . She ruled Qui during the Season of the Unicorn . She governed directing 30 baboons and 10 giant badgers , of which 10 baboons always on patrol . She acted friendly with intruders at first . History . In 1358 DR , she summoned the General Tiger in order to expel Osari Minhiro and an adventuring party he had hired from Qui . He easily sent them into unconsciousness but insulted Chanii for asking his help .

title: Channath
description: Channath The Channath family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Channaths were allied with the Elovear , Laranadda , Tithlin , and Vandover families .
description_long: Channath The Channath family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Channaths were allied with the Elovear , Laranadda , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Chanoch
description: Chanoch Chanoch was a young Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu . History . Chanoch was born into a small Shadar - kai enclave .
description_long: Chanoch Chanoch was a young Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu . History . Chanoch was born into a small Shadar - kai enclave . His mother was murdered by a childless Shadar - kai who wanted Chanoch as her son . He escaped into the Shadowfell as soon as he could and was found by a patrol from Ikemmu . He was mentored by a priest of Tempus and was expected to one day take vows as a priest of Tempus . In 1479 DR , Chanoch was selected to accompany Vedoran and Ashok on a mission to rescue the witch Ilvani from from an enclave in the Shadowfell . While inside the enclave , Chanoch argued with Vedoran and , upon their return to Ikemmu , Vedoran accussed Chanoch of insubordination , a capital offense in Ikemmu . Uwan , the leader of Ikemmu , sentenced Chanoch to confinement until his soul faded .

title: Chansobal Dreen
description: Chansobal Dreen High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen ( known by locals as the Chanter ) was a High Morninglord of Lathander and led the Morningmist Hall in Marsember , Cormyr . Activities . He oversaw sixteen priests and twelve other staff , and was strongly opposed to piracy , often sending out ships against them .
description_long: Chansobal Dreen High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen ( known by locals as the Chanter ) was a High Morninglord of Lathander and led the Morningmist Hall in Marsember , Cormyr . Activities . He oversaw sixteen priests and twelve other staff , and was strongly opposed to piracy , often sending out ships against them . He was also an investor in new ventures .

title: Chansrin Aluar
description: Chansrin Aluar Chansrin Aluar was a female human wizard who lived in Scornubel in the 14th century DR . Personality . Chansrin was generous to her friends , but had a sharp tongue and was easily distracted and soon bored .
description_long: Chansrin Aluar Chansrin Aluar was a female human wizard who lived in Scornubel in the 14th century DR . Personality . Chansrin was generous to her friends , but had a sharp tongue and was easily distracted and soon bored . She was known for her enthusiastic and energetic personality , given to giggling in delight , biting people when angry or excited , and to wild and impulsive acts , such as leaping from windows to trees , swinging from balconies , or rushing into danger . She was keen on adventure and enjoyed battle , most happy when rushing off to deal with some trouble . Nevertheless , she was reluctant to leave her home of Scornubel . Description . She was short of build and slender , with fiery red hair and large , dark eyes . Activities . Chansrin was quick to the come to the aid of anyone in Scornubel , in a rescue or a fight , and readily and happily threw her spell s into any affray she came across . When bored , she often took the opportunity to accompany the city guards by casting spells at anyone they dealt with , such as rogue mages or disorderly adventurers .

title: Chant
description: Chant Chant was a conjuration spell that provided a " bless " on the caster ' s allies and a " curse " on the caster ' s enemies for as long as the chant could be maintained without interruption . Effects . Allies were filled with hope , boosting their morale and improving their combat ability , giving them a slightly better chance to strike a blow or aim true .
description_long: Chant Chant was a conjuration spell that provided a " bless " on the caster ' s allies and a " curse " on the caster ' s enemies for as long as the chant could be maintained without interruption . Effects . Allies were filled with hope , boosting their morale and improving their combat ability , giving them a slightly better chance to strike a blow or aim true . Simultaneously , the caster ' s enemies were filled with trepidations and doubt , lowering their morale and dulling their combat ability . The caster had to remain stationary and not be interrupted for the " chant " to be effective . Any successful attack , " silence " , or movement would break the spell . The newer version of this spell doubled in effectiveness when another priest of the same religion cast " prayer " . It also lasted as long as the caster could keep up the chant . The older version expired after 10 minutes and did not combine with " prayer " . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . The verbal component was the chant itself .

title: Chant Masters
description: Chant Masters The Chant Masters were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of bounty . The Chant Masters did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .
description_long: Chant Masters The Chant Masters were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of bounty . The Chant Masters did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities . These mystics gained their holy power through song and verse . They maintained excellent relationships with the rawun of western Zakhara . Members . As of 1367 DR , the Chant Masters had 400 members . Base of Operations . The Chant Masters were active within the hills of the Pearl Cities .

title: Chant Morven
description: Chant Morven Chant Morven was a portly human pawnbroker with a shop in one of Airspur ' s seedier districts . In spite of his large size , he was unusually nimble and quick on his feet . Chant owed a large gambling debt to Raneger , a local crime lord .
description_long: Chant Morven Chant Morven was a portly human pawnbroker with a shop in one of Airspur ' s seedier districts . In spite of his large size , he was unusually nimble and quick on his feet . Chant owed a large gambling debt to Raneger , a local crime lord . History . In 1475 DR , Chant was given a magic scarf to hold by the deva Demascus . Demascus retrieved the scarf in 1479 DR and Chant helped Demascus track down and destroy a rakshasa who was behind demonic cult activity in Akanûl . In Leafall of 1479 DR , Queen Arathane asked Demascus and Riltana to investigate potential trouble at an arambarium mine on Ithimir Isle off the coast of Akanûl . While investigating a warehouse owned by Raneger , the two stumbled opon a plot by drow from Menzoberranzan to steal Akanûl ' s supply of arambarium ore . Because of Chant ' s ties to Raneger , Demascus asked Chant to make introductions to the crime lord . Raneger agreed to work with Demascus and Chant and allowed Chant ' s son Jaul , who was an employee of Raneger ' s , to travel with the heroes . Chant and friends foiled the drow plot and returned the aramabarium to Queen Arathane . Appearance . Chant was middle - aged and overweight .

title: Chantlarn Iyrmerr
description: Chantlarn Iyrmerr Chantlarn Iyrmerr was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . In 240 DR , he was forcibly summoned to a spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower in Athalgard and died there .
description_long: Chantlarn Iyrmerr Chantlarn Iyrmerr was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . In 240 DR , he was forcibly summoned to a spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower in Athalgard and died there .

title: Chantos Graybeard
description: Chantos Graybeard Chantos Graybeard was a businessman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Chantos was a gentleman mage known for his quick wit and complex , but deft , hand gestures during spell casting .
description_long: Chantos Graybeard Chantos Graybeard was a businessman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Chantos was a gentleman mage known for his quick wit and complex , but deft , hand gestures during spell casting . He disliked Nestor Podgin and planned to ruin him . Activities . With three partners , Chantos managed the Hired Horrors , a business breeding and selling deepspawn , usually for dungeons . Relationship . Aurin and Chantos had been good friends for five decades . Ysvele and Ithvar were too greedy for Chantos . History . Chantos once adventured in the High Forest with Aurin . Arriving in Skullport , he , Aurin , Ysele the Cat , and Lord Ithvar Wordkiller created the deepspawn breeding business . In 1370 DR , he was concerned with the appearance of a competitor , Nestor Podgin ' s Monsters Made to Order . He would try everything to ruin him .

title: Chaos Bay
description: Chaos Bay Chaos Bay was an inlet of water on the Great Sea named for its often impassable coral reefs and sandbars , which offered natural protection for the corsairs ' main base of Hawa . Description . The coral reefs and sandbars guarding Chaos Bay were shifted regularly through the use of unknown magic .
description_long: Chaos Bay Chaos Bay was an inlet of water on the Great Sea named for its often impassable coral reefs and sandbars , which offered natural protection for the corsairs ' main base of Hawa . Description . The coral reefs and sandbars guarding Chaos Bay were shifted regularly through the use of unknown magic . The water was kept crystal clear since few dared enrage the sea elf keepers . Inhabitants . Sea elves maintained the reefs and sandbars of Chaos Bay , moving them at regular intervals to keep potential enemies confused . The sea elves guided friendly ships safely through the harbor . Wise captains offered gifts to the sea elves in exchange for their services . The pristine waters of the bay were populated with a large variety of creatures including fish , dolphin s , crustaceans , and sea horses . Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id and her son Ra ' id bin Kawthar led the sea elf colony , occasionally taking part in the Corsair Council of Hawa .

title: Chaos Curse
description: Chaos Curse The Chaos Curse or Tuanta Quiro Miancay ( Most Fatal Horror ) was a potion discovered by the imp Druzil and brewed by Aballister Bonaduce that made the afflicted being ' s desires paramount over all other things . Difficulty . Both gathering the ingredients and preparing the potion successfully was extremely difficult .
description_long: Chaos Curse The Chaos Curse or Tuanta Quiro Miancay ( Most Fatal Horror ) was a potion discovered by the imp Druzil and brewed by Aballister Bonaduce that made the afflicted being ' s desires paramount over all other things . Difficulty . Both gathering the ingredients and preparing the potion successfully was extremely difficult . The gathering took two years . Ingredients . Mentioned ingredients included : yote mushroom s ( from the Great Glacier ) , eye of an umber hulk , blood of a druid , and tentacles of a displacer beast . Appearance . The potion glowed blood - red when finished . Aballister placed it in an ever - smoking bottle . The potion is best dispensed in the form of a mist . Drinking it is extremely dangerous , as it turned Kierkan Rufo into a vampire when he did so .

title: Chaos bolt
description: Chaos bolt Chaos bolt is a spell used by sorcerer s , most often chaos sorcerers . When cast , " chaos bolt " shoots a blast of multicolored light out from a sorcerer ' s implement towards the head of an enemy within fifty feet , filling their mind with wracking pain in a telepathic attack . Enhanced and fueled by a sorcerer ' s charisma like virtually all sorcerer spells , " chaos bolt " grows in potency as the sorcerer casting it grows more powerful .
description_long: Chaos bolt Chaos bolt is a spell used by sorcerer s , most often chaos sorcerers . When cast , " chaos bolt " shoots a blast of multicolored light out from a sorcerer ' s implement towards the head of an enemy within fifty feet , filling their mind with wracking pain in a telepathic attack . Enhanced and fueled by a sorcerer ' s charisma like virtually all sorcerer spells , " chaos bolt " grows in potency as the sorcerer casting it grows more powerful . The bolt , when powered by the wild magic of a chaos sorcerer , has unpredictable effects . It may simply injure the target or it may lash out and strike another target within twenty - five feet of the first . If this happens , it is possible that it would strike yet another target within twenty - five feet . Regardless of its exact effects , " chaos bolt " is instantly recastable .

title: Chaos hammer
description: Chaos hammer Chaos hammer was an evocation spell exclusive to cleric s with the Chaos domain . It damaged and staggered lawful enemies . Effect .
description_long: Chaos hammer Chaos hammer was an evocation spell exclusive to cleric s with the Chaos domain . It damaged and staggered lawful enemies . Effect . The cleric unleashed chaotic power which took the form of a multicolored explosion of leaping , ricocheting energy . Only lawful and neutral creatures were harmed by the spell . The spell dealt a moderate amount of damage to lawful creatures and staggered them for several minutes . A staggered character could take only partial actions . Creatures with strong willpower could avoid some of the effects of the spell . The spell dealt only half damage against creatures who were neither lawful nor chaotic , and they were not staggered .

title: Chaos sphere
description: Chaos sphere The Chaos sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that followed deities of bad luck and trickery and to chaotic crusader s . These spells increased entropy , mischief , and confusion in the world . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .
description_long: Chaos sphere The Chaos sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that followed deities of bad luck and trickery and to chaotic crusader s . These spells increased entropy , mischief , and confusion in the world . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Chaos Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Chaotic evil
description: Chaotic evil Chaotic evil is power without control - selfishness unfettered by any law . A chaotic evil character does whatever his greed , hatred , and lust for destruction drive him to do . If he is simply out for whatever he can get , he is ruthless and brutal .
description_long: Chaotic evil Chaotic evil is power without control - selfishness unfettered by any law . A chaotic evil character does whatever his greed , hatred , and lust for destruction drive him to do . If he is simply out for whatever he can get , he is ruthless and brutal . If he is committed to the spread of evil and chaos , he is even worse . His plans are haphazard and any groups he joins or forms are poorly organized . Typically , chaotic evil people can be made to work together only by force , and their leader lasts only as long as he can thwart attempts to topple or assassinate him . These characters will commit any act to further their own ends . Chaotic evil is sometimes called " demonic " because demons are the embodiment of chaotic evil . Many serial killers would fit this description , as would indeed most of the more violent and reckless criminals found in the worst sorts of places . Characters . Some characters in the Forgotten Realms setting identified as chaotic evil include : < br >

title: Chaotic good
description: Chaotic good Chaotic good combines a good heart with a free spirit . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic good is found under the umbrella of the good alignment . A chaotic good character acts as his or her conscience directs with little regard for what others expect .
description_long: Chaotic good Chaotic good combines a good heart with a free spirit . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic good is found under the umbrella of the good alignment . A chaotic good character acts as his or her conscience directs with little regard for what others expect . Such characters are kind and benevolent , strong individualists hostile to the claims of rules , regulations , and social order . They hate it when people try to intimidate others and tell them what to do . They will actively work to bring down unjust rulers and organizations and to liberate the oppressed . They find lawful societies distasteful and will avoid them , often living as nomads or hermits . Noble rebel leaders fighting corrupt or venal regimes , vigilantes acting for what they see as the greater good , mercenaries who only work for the " good guys " and anyone who " robs from the rich to give to the poor " are all examples of chaotic good characters .

title: Chaotic neutral
description: Chaotic neutral Chaotic neutral is freedom from both society ' s restrictions and a do - gooder ' s zeal . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic neutral is found under the umbrella of the unaligned alignment . A chaotic neutral character follows his whims .
description_long: Chaotic neutral Chaotic neutral is freedom from both society ' s restrictions and a do - gooder ' s zeal . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic neutral is found under the umbrella of the unaligned alignment . A chaotic neutral character follows his whims . He is an individualist first and last . He values his own liberty but does not strive to protect the freedom of others . He avoids authority , resents restrictions , and challenges traditions . A chaotic neutral character doesn ' t intentionally disrupt organizations as part of a campaign of anarchy . To do so , he would have to be motivated either by good ( and a desire to liberate others ) or by evil ( and a desire to make others suffer ) . A chaotic neutral character may be unpredictable , but his behavior is not totally random . He is not as likely to jump off a bridge as to cross it . A wandering rogue who lives both by work for hire and petty theft is an example of a chaotic neutral character . Opposing alignment . A chaotic neutral character dislikes laws and regards them as restrictions to his or her freedom .

title: Char
description: Char The Char was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This walled section held the slave barracks .
description_long: Char The Char was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This walled section held the slave barracks . Inhabitants . As property of the Sultan , the slaves here worked for the smelters , smithies , and assorted crafts shops .

title: Charcoal Palace
description: Charcoal Palace The Charcoal Palace was a massive structure located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Palace was found within the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Charcoal Palace The Charcoal Palace was a massive structure located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Palace was found within the Furnace ward of the city . Description . Dark basalt was used to construct most of the structure of the palace . The basalt was so dark that it appeared to drain light from the flames surrounding the city . Gold , brass , and copper were used to cover many of the towers and domes of the palace . The Charcoal Palace was perched atop a landrise overlooking the entire city . Activities . The Charcoal Palace served as the seat of power for the Great Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan and his court of efreeti tyrants .

title: Chard languages
description: Chard languages The Chard language subgroup included Damaran and related Ulou languages . Languages . Damaran was considered by some to be some scholars to simply be a dialect of the Chardic language .
description_long: Chard languages The Chard language subgroup included Damaran and related Ulou languages . Languages . Damaran was considered by some to be some scholars to simply be a dialect of the Chardic language . In addition to Chardic and Damaran , the Easting language belonged to the Chard grouping .

title: Chardalyn
description: Chardalyn A chardalyn was a rare black stone which could naturally absorb and release magic , with larger stones able to hold more potent spells . Found only in the northern Sword Coast , they required no magical preparation to function . History .
description_long: Chardalyn A chardalyn was a rare black stone which could naturally absorb and release magic , with larger stones able to hold more potent spells . Found only in the northern Sword Coast , they required no magical preparation to function . History . First discovered in the Plain of Standing Stones in - 1205 DR ( 2654 NY ) by an arcanist named Elorian , who examined worthless rock brought up from the Fluvion mines . She was amazed at the degree of magic the stones seemed to possess . Before long , she realized that the fragile gems could hold a single spell that was cast into them , later releasing the magic when it was crushed . This discovery launched Netheril into a frenzy of mining and exploration that lasted more than 500 years . Appearance . Chardalyns appeared to be black , ordinary rocks , but were more fragile than usual . They contained natural magic . They turned to useless powder when struck forcefully . Explorers in abandoned Netherese cities were advised to step carefully . Uses . A single chardalyn could absorb one spell , which was released when the rock was crushed or destroyed .

title: Chardansearavitriol
description: Chardansearavitriol Chardansearavitriol , known as Ebondeath , was a black dragon who became a dracolich . History . in 631 DR , Ebondeath was the first dragon to settle in the Mere of Dead Men in the Sword Coast North , making his home in Uthtower and ruling all of the surrounding area .
description_long: Chardansearavitriol Chardansearavitriol , known as Ebondeath , was a black dragon who became a dracolich . History . in 631 DR , Ebondeath was the first dragon to settle in the Mere of Dead Men in the Sword Coast North , making his home in Uthtower and ruling all of the surrounding area . Ebondeath disappeared in 922 DR , becoming a dracolich at the behest of Strongor Bonebag , a priest of Myrkul and member of the Cult of the Dragon . The Ebondeath Sect of the Cult of the Dragon began worshiping him at the Mausoleum of the Ebondeath created at the Uthtower . In 1202 DR , under the Eye of Myrkul , Ebondeath ' s body disintegrated into dust due to the god Myrkul ' s influence , although his spirit was still tethered to his remains . Worshipers from the Ebondeath Sect traveled to the Mere of Dead Men to see the remains and the sect grew . However , the Ebondeath Sect collapsed around 300 years later in 1358 DR when Myrkul was destroyed . The location of Ebondeath ' s remains was subsequently lost .

title: Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV
description: Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV Lord Charles was the Lord Speaker of the Advisory Council of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? .
description_long: Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV Lord Charles was the Lord Speaker of the Advisory Council of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? . Appearance . Lord Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV is a lanky and somewhat awkward young man , standing 5 ' 11 " and weighing 160 pounds . In court or at social functions he wears custom - tailored fine silks and leather boots , a brocaded cape , a velvet hat with a roc ' s feather and a jeweled dagger tucked into his belt . When hunting or traveling he wears a custom - made suit of green studded leather armor and sometimes his magical gauntlets of swimming and climbing which he doesn ' t actually use , he just likes their finely - crafted appearance . Personality . Lord Charles enjoys his position and wealth , and doesn ' t mind flaunting them . He often brags about his hunting ability , his way with women , and his political connections , but with little evidence to back up his claims . If challenged , he will bluster and threaten , but if that doesn ' t work he finds some excuse to avoid a physical confrontation and save face ( literally ! ) . He throws many parties on his estate for his young friends and enjoys his reputation as a playboy .

title: Charles Oliver O ' Kane
description: Charles Oliver O ' Kane Charles Oliver O ' Kane was the Lord Mayor of Ravens Bluff from 1337 DR to 1370 DR . Description . At 5 ′ 11 ″ ( 1 .
description_long: Charles Oliver O ' Kane Charles Oliver O ' Kane was the Lord Mayor of Ravens Bluff from 1337 DR to 1370 DR . Description . At 5 ′ 11 ″ ( 1 . 8 m ) and 240 lb ( 109 kg ) , the Lord Mayor was an imposing figure around the town . He had a ruddy face , curly brown hair , and a full beard . His great strength was evident in his massive chest and arms , although middle age and a love of ale took their toll on his waistline by 1356 DR . He wore clothes of the finest quality but favored somber colors . His sword , ring , and chain of office were all decorated with gold and sapphire s . He never wore armor within the city , but always wore a sword in public . Personality . The Lord Mayor was a tenacious fighter on the battlefield and in the Council of Lords , seeking out weaknesses in his opponents . He took every advantage that was consistent with his sense of honor , which could be flexible if necessary . History . Charles Oliver O ' Kane came to Ravens Bluff specifically to participate in the Champion ' s Games , which were intended to choose a champion who would become Lord Mayor and assume the task of protecting the city from the pirates and other threats .

title: Charles Stross
description: Charles Stross Charles David George " Charlie " Stross ( born Leeds , October 18 , 1964 ) is a writer based in Edinburgh , Scotland . His works range from science fiction and Lovecraftian horror to fantasy . In the 1970s and 80s , Stross published some role - playing game articles for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons in the " White Dwarf " magazine , and some of his creatures , such as the death knight , githyanki , githzerai , and slaad ( a chaotic race notable for their rigid caste system ) were later published in the " Fiend Folio " monster compendium .
description_long: Charles Stross Charles David George " Charlie " Stross ( born Leeds , October 18 , 1964 ) is a writer based in Edinburgh , Scotland . His works range from science fiction and Lovecraftian horror to fantasy . In the 1970s and 80s , Stross published some role - playing game articles for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons in the " White Dwarf " magazine , and some of his creatures , such as the death knight , githyanki , githzerai , and slaad ( a chaotic race notable for their rigid caste system ) were later published in the " Fiend Folio " monster compendium . Background . Born in Leeds , England , Stross knew he wanted to be a science fiction writer from the age of six . He didn ' t really get started until his early teens ( when his sister loaned him a manual typewriter around the time he was getting heavily into Dungeons and Dragons ) . He made his first commercial for - money sale to Interzone in 1986 , and sold around a dozen stories elsewhere throughout the late 1980s and early 1990s before taking a break from his writing career . He began writing fiction again in 1998 . Stross studied at university in London and qualified as a Pharmacist .

title: Charm lycanthrope
description: Charm lycanthrope Charm lycanthrope was a sorcerer / wizard spell that could be used to charm natural lycanthropes , although it would not work with infected lycanthropes . In order to cast the spell , the caster had to use the blood of a natural lycanthrope as the material component . This spell did not end if the lycanthrope changed form .
description_long: Charm lycanthrope Charm lycanthrope was a sorcerer / wizard spell that could be used to charm natural lycanthropes , although it would not work with infected lycanthropes . In order to cast the spell , the caster had to use the blood of a natural lycanthrope as the material component . This spell did not end if the lycanthrope changed form . This spell was developed by Avan Vatsisen and he was likely the only one who is able to use it .

title: Charm monster
description: Charm monster Charm monster , formerly known as Pockall ' s monster hex , was an enchantment ( compulsion ) spell that turned a monster into an ally of the caster . Effect . This spell worked in the same fashion as " charm person " , except that it was not restricted to humanoid creatures or by their size .
description_long: Charm monster Charm monster , formerly known as Pockall ' s monster hex , was an enchantment ( compulsion ) spell that turned a monster into an ally of the caster . Effect . This spell worked in the same fashion as " charm person " , except that it was not restricted to humanoid creatures or by their size . For the spell ' s duration , a charmed creature considered the caster a friend and ally , and trusted them . Although the spell did not allow the affected creature to be dominated or controlled , and they retained their normal behavior , they were well disposed to their supposed " friend " and could be persuaded to do things . The spell was hampered or ended if the creature was threatened or attacked by the caster or their own allies . Users . The " charm monster " spell could be cast by wizard s , sorcerer s , bard s , and cleric s who commanded the charm domain . In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Mentalism specialization . History . The spell was named for Pockall , and it was introduced in 2392 NY ( −1467 DR ) under the name " Pockall ' s monster hex " . It later became known simply as " charm monster " .

title: Charm person
description: Charm person Charm person was an enchantment spell that made the subject a friend of the caster . Charm Person was a common spell in the Realms . Effect .
description_long: Charm person Charm person was an enchantment spell that made the subject a friend of the caster . Charm Person was a common spell in the Realms . Effect . The charm made a humanoid regard the caster as his or her trusted friend and ally . If the creature was being threatened or attacked by the caster or his or her allies , however , the creature was more likely to resist the effect of the spell . The spell did not enable the caster to control the " charmed " person as if he or she were an automaton , but he or she perceived the caster ' s words and actions in the most favourable way . The caster could try to give the subject orders , but the subject was unlikely to do anything outside its normal behaviour pattern . A " charmed " person never obeyed suicidal or obviously harmful orders , but he or she might have taken an action resulting in death if it would will save the caster ' s life . Any act by the caster or its apparent allies that threatens the " charmed " person broke the spell . Note also that the caster must have been able to speak the person ' s language to communicate commands , or be able to communicate and be understood with gestures .

title: Charm sphere
description: Charm sphere The Charm sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that influenced people or creatures with some intelligence . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Charm Sphere in the sourcebook .
description_long: Charm sphere The Charm sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that influenced people or creatures with some intelligence . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Charm Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Charon
description: Charon A major altraloth is Charon ( also known as Cerlic ) , the boatman of the River of Blood , who ferries souls down the River for a steep price . The River of Blood links the topmost layers of the Fiendish Planes , and it branches can be found anywhere from the Nine Hells to the Abyss . When encountered , the River is a deep , swift , and unfordable torrent .
description_long: Charon A major altraloth is Charon ( also known as Cerlic ) , the boatman of the River of Blood , who ferries souls down the River for a steep price . The River of Blood links the topmost layers of the Fiendish Planes , and it branches can be found anywhere from the Nine Hells to the Abyss . When encountered , the River is a deep , swift , and unfordable torrent . Those who touch or drink from the River will forget their past lives completely . Charon may be summoned only on the banks of the River . Appearance . Charon ' s appearance is that of a skeletal man with a haggard face and glowing eyes . He ' s typically dressed in fine robes or ermine and silk . Charon is about 6 feet tall , and weighs almost 240 pounds . His hands are bony claws and his feet are webbed . No - one alive or dead has ever seen Charon without his hood up . He will appear with a large black skiff that holds 10 , and if requested will ferry his charges to the topmost layer of any Lower Plane . Price . His price is a magical item , a silk bag of 100 pp , or two gems of 500 + gp value . Charon never carries this treasure but distributes it among his servants , the marraenoloth s .

title: Charon ' s Claw ( novel )
description: Charon ' s Claw ( novel ) Charon ' s Claw is third novel of The Neverwinter Saga by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Charon ' s Claw ( novel ) Charon ' s Claw is third novel of The Neverwinter Saga by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . In the underground drow city of Menzoberranzan in 1463 DR , Ravel Xorlarrin , Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin ’ s second son and the leader of the House ’ s wizards , met with the other members of his family . Through spying into a magical skull gem possessed by Gromph Baenre , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , Ravel had ascertained that the devastation of the city of Neverwinter over a decade earlier had been caused by a fire primordial that was magically entrapped in the ancient dwarven homeland of Gauntlgrym . After Ravel told his family what he had discovered , Zeerith ordered him to lead an expedition to Gauntlgrym and attempt to construct a new drow city that was under the control of House Xorlarrin in the dwarven stronghold .

title: Charon ' s Claw ( sword )
description: Charon ' s Claw ( sword ) Charon ' s Claw ( later known simply as Claw ) was a magical sword and gauntlet designed to battle wizard s . It was once wielded by the highly skilled assassin Artemis Entreri . It was assumed destroyed in 1463 DR .
description_long: Charon ' s Claw ( sword ) Charon ' s Claw ( later known simply as Claw ) was a magical sword and gauntlet designed to battle wizard s . It was once wielded by the highly skilled assassin Artemis Entreri . It was assumed destroyed in 1463 DR . Description . Charon ' s Claw was a sword and gauntlet combination , the perfect weapon when battling a wizard . Sword . The sword was a sentient artifact with the powers of a " + 4 keen smoking longsword " ; strong of will and possessed of arrogance . The sword could also intrude on the bearer ' s thoughts , turning them in dark and violence - inclined directions . Anyone who touched the blade or handle of this sword unprotected would need to compete with it in a battle of wills . Failure meant it would burn the flesh and skin of the wielder ' s head away . This ability could be used by the bearer of the sword , but it would require prolonged contact with the victim . Without defeating the blade in a battle of wills , the only way a person could safely use the item was by covering their hand with the enchanted gauntlet which was its counterpart . This kept the hostile sentience at bay .

title: Charsultketh
description: Charsultketh Charsultketh , also known as Helanna Darkstorm , was the newest member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Charsultketh was for a long time , the enforcer of Gargauth as well as his consort .
description_long: Charsultketh Charsultketh , also known as Helanna Darkstorm , was the newest member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Charsultketh was for a long time , the enforcer of Gargauth as well as his consort . Under orders from her patron , she assumed the human identity of " Helanna Darkstorm in " 1366 DR , a wizard / merchant of Chondath . In Helanna disguise she asked membership to the Knights of the Shield and thank of vice - chair , and secret cleric of Gargauth , Ghauntz , Helanna was immediately gained membership and promoted to member of the Shield Council . After she used her acumen for intrigues and her network of magical spies to advance the Knights ' power , at the same time enjoying embarrassing her fellow Knights . In truth Charsultketh patiently wait for the command of Gargauth to eliminate all the Knights that will refused convert to the treason ' s god doctrine the day that Garguath will have complete control of the organization .

title: Chartilifax
description: Chartilifax Chartilifax was a young green dragon living in Neverwinter Wood circa 1479 DR . Chartilifax was however seduced and later twisted by the succubus Rohini under orders from the Abolethic Sovereignty . She opened her mind to the dragon , driving him mad .
description_long: Chartilifax Chartilifax was a young green dragon living in Neverwinter Wood circa 1479 DR . Chartilifax was however seduced and later twisted by the succubus Rohini under orders from the Abolethic Sovereignty . She opened her mind to the dragon , driving him mad . Chartilifax came to believe he was an elf that a spellscar had transformed into a dragon , so he usually remained in the guise of elf . He served Rohini as her personal jailer and mobile weapon . He in 1479 was mentally dominated by Elden Vargas in Helm ' s Hold but defeated by an adventuring party

title: Chasme
description: Chasme A chasme ( pronounced KAZ - mee or CHAZ - mee ) , sometimes called a fly demon , was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss . Chasmes were horrid and disgusting hybrids of flies and humans who sucked blood and enjoyed tormenting and torturing their victims . The droning of their wings could lull an unwary being to sleep , who might awake to find themselves being fed upon and tortured .
description_long: Chasme A chasme ( pronounced KAZ - mee or CHAZ - mee ) , sometimes called a fly demon , was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss . Chasmes were horrid and disgusting hybrids of flies and humans who sucked blood and enjoyed tormenting and torturing their victims . The droning of their wings could lull an unwary being to sleep , who might awake to find themselves being fed upon and tortured . Chasmes often served greater demons as interrogators , taskmasters , or torturers , or in capturing runaways and deserters of the Blood War . Description . Frightful , wretched , and disgusting in appearance , a chasme resembled a terrible demonic cross between a fly and a human . With the body of a giant fly , it bore two sets of large , buzzing wings and carried six limbs , the two forelimbs resembling long , slender human arms with long - fingered hands , the other four being hooked insectoid limbs . Emerging from its thorax , it had a head vaguely like that of a human , but ugly and exaggerated , with a tiny mouth , compound eyes , and a large horn - like nose . This nose was hard , sharp , hooked , and could bite and suck blood .

title: Chastise
description: Chastise Chastise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on those who offended them .
description_long: Chastise Chastise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on those who offended them . This spell did nothing if a wizard used it on someone who did not offend them . Targets of this spell felt an overwhelming compulsion to abase themselves before the caster , performing menial tasks for the duration of the spell . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Chastus Beldrorn
description: Chastus Beldrorn Chastus Beldrorn was a local herald based in Darromar , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Chastus was known to be enamored with his own importance and imperious to those who challenged his authority .
description_long: Chastus Beldrorn Chastus Beldrorn was a local herald based in Darromar , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Chastus was known to be enamored with his own importance and imperious to those who challenged his authority . Abilities . As a Herald , he was an expert in blazonry and the protocol of nobility . Possessions . Chastus Beldrorn was comfortably wealthy . Activities . Chastus served the Duchess of the Purple Marches in the capacity of Herald over non - noble blazonry , including miller ' s marks , guild symbols , merchant fleet flags , trading coster badges , and other symbols of commerce around Darromar . During his bitter squabble with Ilmurk Jongrath , he hired some henchmen and led them against Jongrath ' s Mill in order to confiscate some newly painted shields displaying heraldic devices . Jongrath dissuaded them with a few well - placed crossbow bolts . Relationships . Beldrorn and his fellow Herald from Myratma , Aldrur Hariburt , were particularly nettled by an amateur heraldist named Ilmurk Jongrath . They accused him of usurping their authority , undercutting their prices , and generally being unfit to practice heraldry in any capacity .

title: Chathi Oandem
description: Chathi Oandem Chathi Oandem was a priestess of Kossuth . Appearance . Chathi was of willowy built .
description_long: Chathi Oandem Chathi Oandem was a priestess of Kossuth . Appearance . Chathi was of willowy built . She had hazel eyes . Old burn scars marred her left cheek and her body but didn ' t blemish her otherwise handsome appearance . Chathi had an air of energy and quick intelligence around her . During warfare , Chathi usually wore mail and helmet . Otherwise she liked to wear flame - patterend vestments . Weapon / Magical Abilities . Chathi was trained to fight her enemies with mundane weapons as well as her potent magic . She had also healing spells in her repertoire . History . Chathi took part in the war against an undead army invading Pyarados . There she met Aoth Fezim who later became her lover . During the fight at the Keep of Thazar she was killed by an exploding wand in her hand - a rod supplied by Szass Tam and his way of obliterating members of the church of Kossuth and his adversaries .

title: Chatkcha
description: Chatkcha A chatkcha was a type of exotic throwing weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . The chatkcha was a kind of triangular throwing wedge with three piercing points . The thri - kreen carved it from a crystalline material .
description_long: Chatkcha A chatkcha was a type of exotic throwing weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . The chatkcha was a kind of triangular throwing wedge with three piercing points . The thri - kreen carved it from a crystalline material . It could deal critical injuries to a target , and was effective to 20 feet ( 6 meters ) and could be thrown up to 270 feet ( 82 meters ) . A thrown wedge that missed its target could even return to the thrower . A warrior needed to be highly trained to use one , as it would cut an unprotected hand , but it was much more familiar to the thri - kreen . Collectors would pay for one in good condition .

title: Chatulio
description: Chatulio Chatulio was a copper dragon who helped Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , Chatulio was among those who disagreed , instead believing in searching for a cure .
description_long: Chatulio Chatulio was a copper dragon who helped Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , Chatulio was among those who disagreed , instead believing in searching for a cure . He joined his friend , the song dragon Karasendrieth , in investigating Northkeep on the trail of Sammaster . Chatulio later helped defend the Monastery of the Yellow Rose against an attack by chromatic dragon s allied with the Cult of the Dragon . Afterward , he and Kara began to search through the monastery ' s extensive archives for lore about the " Dracorage mythal " . Chatulio eventually left the monastery , sensing he would soon succumb to the Rage . Using his powerful illusion magic to disguise himself as a black dragon , Chatulio infiltrated the chromatic dragons besieging the monastery and instigated a fight between their leader - the red dragon Malazan - and the the green dragon Ishenalyr , who was one of the draconic mystics known as the hidecarved .

title: Chaul
description: Chaul Chaul is a hag who lives in and rules the village of Citadel Rashemar in Rashemen . She lives in the lower levels of the ruined keep in the former fortress and has a hatred for the hathran , having killed two of them who attacked her . She trains her ogre and goblin followers to use magic like she does .
description_long: Chaul Chaul is a hag who lives in and rules the village of Citadel Rashemar in Rashemen . She lives in the lower levels of the ruined keep in the former fortress and has a hatred for the hathran , having killed two of them who attacked her . She trains her ogre and goblin followers to use magic like she does . She associates with the half - orc Durakh Haan .

title: Chaul ' mur ' ssin
description: Chaul ' mur ' ssin Chaul ' mur ' ssin was a drow city in the Plane of Shadow . History . It was founded by the former inhabitants of Chaulssin , a city in the Underdark of Toril .
description_long: Chaul ' mur ' ssin Chaul ' mur ' ssin was a drow city in the Plane of Shadow . History . It was founded by the former inhabitants of Chaulssin , a city in the Underdark of Toril . The citizens of the Chaulssin , called Chaulssinyr , followed the faith of Vhaeraun and refused to accept the one of Lolth for which the goddess decided to kill them at the hands of the armies of Menzoberranzan , in 734 DR . Vhaeraun gave the Chaulssinyr ' s leaders a warning about the impeding danger in the form of a shared dream and help to safely evade the army towards the Plane of Shadow . The Chaulssinyr , already masters of planar magic , rapidly created several " portals " that allowed them safe travel to their destination and the entry of monsters into their city to cause massive harm to their enemies of Menzoberranzan . Once in the Plane of Shadow , the Chaulssinyr had problems with monsters but not with an organised army , which allowed them to build the city Chaul ' mur ' ssin where their population thrived . Their success bought themselves the enmity of denizens of the Plane of Shadow , primarily of Clan Malaug on minor note with the Shadovar .

title: Chaulssin
description: Chaulssin Chaulssin is a drow city in the Underdark . To some people it is also known as the City of Wyrmshadows . Chaulssin lies beneath the northern Rauvin Mountains .
description_long: Chaulssin Chaulssin is a drow city in the Underdark . To some people it is also known as the City of Wyrmshadows . Chaulssin lies beneath the northern Rauvin Mountains . It overhangs an extremely deep abyss and cold winds howl permanently through the city . It rests upon a great spar of stone . After it was conquered by shadow dragon s and ruled by their descendants the city was partially brought into the Plane of Shadow . Tendrils of shadow - stuff wind all the time through the city and deadly shadow creatures haunt the streets . Sometimes whole quarters of the city vanish into the Plane of Shadow and reappear years later . Due to its remote location and its little known history Chaulssin is largely unknown to most inhabitants of the Underdark , let alone the World Above . This fact makes it a perfect stronghold for the secret brotherhood of the Jaezred Chaulssin . In the time of the War of the Spider Queen it was only a faint shadow of its former self . Most of the city stood empty and was only patrolled intermittently by tribes of Dark bears or claimed by small bands of Shadar - kai . The zekylyn lived alone in the upper reaches of the city ' s great galleries .

title: Chaumyk Vorn
description: Chaumyk Vorn Chaumyk Vorn was a male human Red Wizard and khazark of the Thayan enclave in Hillsfar . Abilities . As a high - ranking Red Wizard and skilled evoker , Chaumyk was talented in the use of evocation spell s that could be highly destructive in battle .
description_long: Chaumyk Vorn Chaumyk Vorn was a male human Red Wizard and khazark of the Thayan enclave in Hillsfar . Abilities . As a high - ranking Red Wizard and skilled evoker , Chaumyk was talented in the use of evocation spell s that could be highly destructive in battle . Activities . Chaumyk Vorn held the position of khazark in the Thayan enclave of Hillsfar . History . In 1371 DR , land for a new Thayan enclave were purchased in Hillsfar with permission from Maalthiir . By 1372 DR , Chaumyk was the khazark of this new enclave but he was soon replaced in 1373 DR by Tola Vrass .

title: Chauntea
description: Chauntea Chauntea ( pronounced " Chawn - TEE - ah " ) , the Grain Goddess or the Great Mother was the god dess of life and a parallel deity to Silvanus , who was considered the god of wild nature , whilst Chauntea herself was seen as being the embodiment of all things agrarian or agriculture . She was a goddess of agriculture , plants cultivated by humans , farmers , gardeners , and summer . Some of her worshipers claimed that her divine glimmer gave life to the natural world , and some contended that she was the creator and source of all mortal races .
description_long: Chauntea Chauntea ( pronounced " Chawn - TEE - ah " ) , the Grain Goddess or the Great Mother was the god dess of life and a parallel deity to Silvanus , who was considered the god of wild nature , whilst Chauntea herself was seen as being the embodiment of all things agrarian or agriculture . She was a goddess of agriculture , plants cultivated by humans , farmers , gardeners , and summer . Some of her worshipers claimed that her divine glimmer gave life to the natural world , and some contended that she was the creator and source of all mortal races . In some sense , Chauntea was the manifestation of the earth itself — the avatar of the twin worlds Abeir - Toril . Her most despised enemy was Talona , the lady of pestilence , since she had a disposition to wreak suffering , disease and decay upon the natural world . History . Chauntea was believed to be one of the eldest gods in Faerûn — she was born when Toril was created by the primeval battles between Shar and Selûne . Selûne favored her and nurtured her with her light , with the help of Mystra . Aspects .

title: Chaunticleer
description: Chaunticleer Brother Chaunticleer was a brother at the Edificant Library who sung the Canticle of Deneir at mid - day every day . During the Chaos Curse , he momentarily forgot the words while thinking of fishing , and that proved to Cadderly Bonaduce that something was terribly wrong with the library . When Cadderly finally returned to a doomed and desecrated library , he eventually found Chaunticleer in his room , which he had warded against vampire s so Kierkan Rufo and his zombie and vampire lackeys could not enter .
description_long: Chaunticleer Brother Chaunticleer was a brother at the Edificant Library who sung the Canticle of Deneir at mid - day every day . During the Chaos Curse , he momentarily forgot the words while thinking of fishing , and that proved to Cadderly Bonaduce that something was terribly wrong with the library . When Cadderly finally returned to a doomed and desecrated library , he eventually found Chaunticleer in his room , which he had warded against vampire s so Kierkan Rufo and his zombie and vampire lackeys could not enter .

title: Chaver Tegarech
description: Chaver Tegarech Chaver Tegarech was an aide to First Speaker Tessarin Alaurun in Nesmé . In 1374 DR he rode from Nesmé to check upon a watchpost at Morach Tor and was kidnapped by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk , who had been hired to protect the town against attack from giant s and troll s . The lizardfolk betrayed Alaurun and Nesmé .
description_long: Chaver Tegarech Chaver Tegarech was an aide to First Speaker Tessarin Alaurun in Nesmé . In 1374 DR he rode from Nesmé to check upon a watchpost at Morach Tor and was kidnapped by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk , who had been hired to protect the town against attack from giant s and troll s . The lizardfolk betrayed Alaurun and Nesmé . Tegarech overheard a conversation between the lizardfolk and the trolls , to decide upon how to split Nesmé and its surrounding lands , and was captured . He was taken to Baeniff Tor via a small settlement at Morach Tor , where he scratched his initials , CT , and his destination , BT , into a wooden wall .

title: Chavyondat
description: Chavyondat Chavyondat was a port city and the capital of Estagund . It was the largest city in that realm . Chavyondat was formerly known as Klionna .
description_long: Chavyondat Chavyondat was a port city and the capital of Estagund . It was the largest city in that realm . Chavyondat was formerly known as Klionna . Geography . Situated on the protective Bay of Kings on the southern coast of Estagund , Chavyondat was the first line of defense against raiders from Dambrath . History . Shou Lung was working intrigues to establish an enclave — a Shou Town — in Chavyondat in Estagund in the mid - 1370s DR . Defenses . Chavyondat was guarded by a corps of skilled crossbowmen and powerful illusionist s . Additionally , Chaka Seltarir supplied 10 fully - armed warships to supplement the 5 used by the city .

title: Chayne Mulish
description: Chayne Mulish Chayne Mulish was a dwarf commander of Citadel Adbar . History . Chayne was a commander in 1484 DR .
description_long: Chayne Mulish Chayne Mulish was a dwarf commander of Citadel Adbar . History . Chayne was a commander in 1484 DR . In the same year , he was part of the doomed Adbar expedition led by King Bromm , which was attacked by orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . King Bromm was killed by Hartusk in the attack ; Chayne ' s fate was unknown .

title: Chazdan
description: Chazdan " Lord " Chazdan was a man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a former noble of Procampur , but later turned pirate . He was among the great pirate lord Immurk ' s fleet of 100 pirate ships at Dragonisle .
description_long: Chazdan " Lord " Chazdan was a man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a former noble of Procampur , but later turned pirate . He was among the great pirate lord Immurk ' s fleet of 100 pirate ships at Dragonisle . The fleet broke apart following Immurk ' s death in the Year of Embers , 1201 DR . Chazdan arose out of this collapse to become a notorious and vicious pirate captain . He cruelly forced his prisoners to drink themselves to death with quarts ( 0 . 25 gallons or ~ 1 liter ) of alcohol .

title: Chazlauth Yarghorn
description: Chazlauth Yarghorn Chazlauth Yarghorn was a wizard in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Chazlauth was a kind of dragon expert .
description_long: Chazlauth Yarghorn Chazlauth Yarghorn was a wizard in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Chazlauth was a kind of dragon expert . Chazlauth lived in a house in the North Ward of Waterdeep with a silver dragon wyrmling companion , Irizzorl . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , he suggested to an adventuring party working to stop a giant uprising to go to speak with Old Gnawbone in Kryptgarden Forest .

title: Chechu al Khish
description: Chechu al Khish Chechu al Khish was an exiled dao genie member of the Shadow Thieves in Westgate around 1370 DR . Personality . Chechu ' s objective was to overthrow his father ' s rival and his work for the Shadow Thieves gained him the money he needed to buy magic items needed for his plan .
description_long: Chechu al Khish Chechu al Khish was an exiled dao genie member of the Shadow Thieves in Westgate around 1370 DR . Personality . Chechu ' s objective was to overthrow his father ' s rival and his work for the Shadow Thieves gained him the money he needed to buy magic items needed for his plan . Although more neutral than his fellow dao , he was still generally evil . Abilities . As a not - yet - fully grown member of his race , Chechu could only use his dao abilities four times in a day , and could not cast " limited wish " . Activities . Acting as an earth elementalist wizard , Chechu helped in various construction and rescue efforts History . Chechu lived in the Elemental Plane of Earth as a son of a dao ataman . One day , a rival displaced his father but Cehechu was offered an alternative , to live as an exile in the Prime Material Plane , and he accepted . Chechu arrived in Calimshan , but understanding the distrust of the local population for elemental s , he decided to move to northward disguised as a human wizard . Finally , he settled in Westgate , where the Shadow Thieves found him and offered him work as a spy .

title: Ched Nasad
description: Ched Nasad Ched Nasad , or the " City of Shimmering Webs " or " City of Webs " , was a drow city in the Middle Northdark that was destroyed on Uktar 3 , 1372 DR . Geography . Ched Nasad was located in the Middle Northdark beneath the High Cap in the northern Graypeak Mountains .
description_long: Ched Nasad Ched Nasad , or the " City of Shimmering Webs " or " City of Webs " , was a drow city in the Middle Northdark that was destroyed on Uktar 3 , 1372 DR . Geography . Ched Nasad was located in the Middle Northdark beneath the High Cap in the northern Graypeak Mountains . In the Underdark , to the immediate east was the great Araumycos fungus . To the south were the remnants of the Graypeaks Hive of beholder s . To the east of the city were the phaerimm - held lands of ancient Netheril . To the far north was the dwarven Fardrimm . It was connected to the surface via tunnels through Ammarindar to the south , which eventually led to orc - held caverns in the Nether Mountains and the Fardrimm . Access points along the way could be found through the Nameless Dungeon , Hellgate Dell , and the ruins of Myth Glaurach . Menzoberranzan was a journey of several tendays to the northeast on the other side of Araumycos . The path through Ammarindar was the quickest journey between Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad , but it was less traveled because of the danger that lurked there . A portal to the ruins of Hlaungadath in Anauroch was located in the Dangling Tower .

title: Ched Nasad portal
description: Ched Nasad portal The so - called Ched Nasad " portal " was a portal that connected the drow city of Ched Nasad with the Dalelands . Geography . The Ched Nasad " portal " , like any other gate consisted of two gates : an Underdark one in Ched Nasad and a surface one in the Dalelands , namely Deepingdale .
description_long: Ched Nasad portal The so - called Ched Nasad " portal " was a portal that connected the drow city of Ched Nasad with the Dalelands . Geography . The Ched Nasad " portal " , like any other gate consisted of two gates : an Underdark one in Ched Nasad and a surface one in the Dalelands , namely Deepingdale . The Underdark end was found in a tunnel in the subterranean city ' s vicinity . In fact , the tunnel was well - traveled , and the surface end was connected with a drow community on the surface . Owners . The " portal " was owned by a cell of the church of Vhaeraun active in Ched Nasad and in Deepingdale . The Underdark one consisted mostly of disenfranchised male drow and the surface one a larger settlement that followed the faith of Vhaeraun . The " portal " was a close - guarded secret of the church , in fact they had their rogue and assassin members stationed in the " portal ' s " vicinity to organize the deaths of people who stumbled upon it . Uses . The Ched Nasad " portal " was effectively a smuggling route .

title: Cheddah al - Assad
description: Cheddah al - Assad Prince Cheddah al - Assad was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Cheddah was extremely obese .
description_long: Cheddah al - Assad Prince Cheddah al - Assad was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Cheddah was extremely obese . He always wore ceremonial battle armor with gold buckles and polished medals . Personality . Many considered him to be a boisterous buffoon who lacked any real talent outside of his birthright . Abilities . Cheddah was a poor tracker , did not understand religion , and lacked etiquette . His comprehension of military tactics was appalling . Open mockery was averted because of his skill with the bow and his extensive knowledge of ships . It was said he could hit a fleeing antelope ' s eye at 300 yards ( 274 meters ) . He could list the complete statistics of every ship in the royal navy . Possessions . Cheddah owned " armor of swimming + 2 " , a " long sword + 3 " , " composite long bow + 2 " , " ring of invisibility " , " gauntlets of dexterity " , and 2 " potions of extra - healing " . Activities . Prince Cheddah was an admiral in the royal navy of Huzuz . Relationships . Cheddah was the younger brother of Prince Tannous al - Assad and paternal uncle to the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir .

title: Cheese
description: Cheese Cheese was widely available in Faerûn . Terminology . Cheese was most often found in 1 - lb circular or elliptic wheels , or in rectangular loaves , which could then be divided further in wedges , or hunks .
description_long: Cheese Cheese was widely available in Faerûn . Terminology . Cheese was most often found in 1 - lb circular or elliptic wheels , or in rectangular loaves , which could then be divided further in wedges , or hunks . Some cheeses could also be found in large 100 - lb wheys , for example when ordered in bulk from " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . In Scornubel , cheese was often sold in chunks known as a " fist " .

title: Cheg
description: Cheg Cheg was a doppelganger member of the Unseen who disguised itself as the human Nool , a Hand Leader and a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport in 1370 DR . As Nool , he guided a squad of ten slavers in search of victims in Waterdeep ' s slums and using his peculiar talents they usually had a good hunt . As Cheg , his mission was to get near the Xanathar and discover his lair , in order for the Unseen to control him from afar and possibly assassinate the Xanathar at need .

title: Cheju
description: Cheju Cheju was a settlement on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Cheju stood at the end of a narrow bay that cut deep into the island .
description_long: Cheju Cheju was a settlement on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Cheju stood at the end of a narrow bay that cut deep into the island . Leadership . By 1357 DR , Dan Zor , the former king and later governor of Saishu , was granted the honorary title of " Master of Cheju " by King Wanang Sun .

title: Cheleen
description: Cheleen Cheleen was a mature adult black dragon whose lair was in the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . She was the great - granddaughter of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the daughter of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the daughter of the black dragons Woklef , Aswidorg and Kasidikal .
description_long: Cheleen Cheleen was a mature adult black dragon whose lair was in the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . title: Chelnadatilar
description: Chelnadatilar Chelnadatilar was a gold dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Chelnadatilar was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .
description_long: Chelnadatilar Chelnadatilar was a gold dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Chelnadatilar was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . He was one of the dragons Alasklerbanbastos sought out to attack Luthcheq and destroy the Brotherhood of the Griffon after the dracolich and Brimstone discovered Aoth Fezim attempts to disrupt the " xorvintaal " . During the Battle of Luthcheq , Chelnadatilar was freed of the compulsion of the " xorvintaal " by the dragonborn paladin Medrash , and he turned against Alasklerbanbastos and Tchazzar . In the battle , he killed the black dragon Ferzath . He later went to Dracowyr alongside the Brotherhood of the Griffon , the dragonborn Medrash and Balasar , and the surviving dragons of the Battle of Luthcheq . Together , they put an end to Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Chelryn Sarynnryllar
description: Chelryn Sarynnryllar Chelryn Sarynnryllar was a sun elf and the mother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Chelryn had two children with the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir .
description_long: Chelryn Sarynnryllar Chelryn Sarynnryllar was a sun elf and the mother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Chelryn had two children with the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir . History . Soon after Ashemmi ' s birth in Silverymoon , the family moved to live with the wood elves in the Neverwinter Wood , and were taken in by the Ilbaereth house .

title: Chen
description: Chen Chen was a general of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . General Chen attempted to overthrow the Emperor of Shou Lung and seize the throne for himself during the 1330s DR .
description_long: Chen Chen was a general of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . General Chen attempted to overthrow the Emperor of Shou Lung and seize the throne for himself during the 1330s DR . His coup nearly started a full - scale civil war between the northern and southern regions of Shou Lung . Chen was eventually captured but the Emperor ' s soothsayers saved him from execution , saying his spirit would return for revenge if he was killed . The Emperor chose to send him to the Valley of Exiles as punishment .

title: Cheng Han
description: Cheng Han Cheng Han was a noble officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Cheng Han was a noble and an officer in the personal armies of the nobles , the Twenty - Five Armies .
description_long: Cheng Han Cheng Han was a noble officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Cheng Han was a noble and an officer in the personal armies of the nobles , the Twenty - Five Armies . In 1359 DR , the Twenty - Five Armies led by Hsuan Yu Po were assigned to support General Batu Min Ho in his campaign against the Tuigan . Cheng Han tried many times to undermine Batu in front of Hsuan but was unsuccessful . After the Tuigan totally destroyed the Twenty - Five Armies , nobody knew what happened to Cheng .

title: Chenowyn
description: Chenowyn Chenowyn was a ruby dragon companion of queen Zaranda Star . Description . Chenowyn had spent most of her life in the form of a human orphan girl in the city of Zazesspur .
description_long: Chenowyn Chenowyn was a ruby dragon companion of queen Zaranda Star . Description . Chenowyn had spent most of her life in the form of a human orphan girl in the city of Zazesspur . In this form , she had red hair and amber eyes . Abilities . Chenowyn had the natural ability to cast " shocking grasp " , " summon swarm " , and " produce flame " spells without need for spell components . She would often cast these when angry , long before she understood that she was in fact a dragon . Zaranda also taught her how to cast " magic missile " . In her dragon form , Chenowyn could breathe a blast of caustic aluminum oxide that could dissolve armor . History . Her mother , an amethyst dragon , had left her in a orphanage , and for years , she had no idea that she was in fact a dragon . Most thought she was cursed , because of her strange powers . She was later adopted by Zaranda , who treated her like her adopted child and taught her how to control her magic . It was during the battle against deepspawn below the city that Zaranda and Chenowyn discovered the the latter was a ruby dragon .

title: Chenraya Xorlarrin
description: Chenraya Xorlarrin Chenraya Xorlarrin was a dark elf priestess of Lolth who conspired to steal arambarium ore from Akanûl in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , the goddess Lolth ordered her minions to collect as many blue fire items and relics of Mystra as possible so that Lolth could become the new goddess of magic .
description_long: Chenraya Xorlarrin Chenraya Xorlarrin was a dark elf priestess of Lolth who conspired to steal arambarium ore from Akanûl in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , the goddess Lolth ordered her minions to collect as many blue fire items and relics of Mystra as possible so that Lolth could become the new goddess of magic . Chenraya conspired with the oni mage Pashra to steal Akanûl ' s entire supply of arambarium ore . Arambarium was an extremely powerful metal that magnified the effects of magic . Her plans were thwarted by the deva Demascus .

title: Cherlrigo ' s Darkness
description: Cherlrigo ' s Darkness Cherlrigo ' s Darkness was supposedly the translation ( by Cherlrigo ) of a sonnet that could be found within " The Leaves of One Grass " , a work of prophetic yet cryptic messages penned by the Dark Diviners of Windsong Tower in Myth Drannor . This particular passage was thought to have originally been written two thousand years before the mid - fifteenth century Dale Reckoning and was heralded by many Shadovar nobles and sages , including Draygo Quick , Parise Ulfbinder and Rolan of Gloomwrought to directly relate to the power of the Shadowfell and have something to do with the Chosen . Notes .
