Notes . This passage referred to the Second Sundering but it was not clear what it meant .

title: Cherra
description: Cherra Sister Cherra was one of the monks of the Monastery of the Precipice . History . Cherra went from Waterdeep to the the Monastery in 1473 DR in search of answers to the disappearance of her brother .
description_long: Cherra Sister Cherra was one of the monks of the Monastery of the Precipice . History . Cherra went from Waterdeep to the the Monastery in 1473 DR in search of answers to the disappearance of her brother . She never met Lady Saharel and gave up hope . Instead , Cherra found a mission in helping other seekers , joining Allendi . In 1479 DR , she took care of the operation of the monastery ' s distillery .

title: Cherrapunni Nor
description: Cherrapunni Nor Cherrapunni Nor , or the Bottomless Lake , was a lake located in western Ra - Khati . Geography . Glacial run - off formed this large lake that formed part of the border of Ra - Khati .
description_long: Cherrapunni Nor Cherrapunni Nor , or the Bottomless Lake , was a lake located in western Ra - Khati . Geography . Glacial run - off formed this large lake that formed part of the border of Ra - Khati . The Gogrus River contributed to the lake ' s size as well . Description . Cherrapunni Nor was filled with beautiful clear blue water . Pilgrims traveling up the Gogrus River were required to stop at the lake and drink the water to help cleanse themselves of evil . In the days before Ra - Khati sealed its borders , a monastery , dedicated to the padhrasattva of pilgrims sat at the north end of the lake . Years of abandonment left the monastery a crumbling ruin . Pilgrims who made it to the lake took shelter in the ruins , and claimed the land radiated goodness . The shoreline of the lake dropped away quickly , leading to its nickname of the Bottomless Lake . It was also noted that the lake was remarkably free of dangerous monsters given its size . This was due to a magically altered giant octopus living in the lake , placed there by the fifth Dalai Lama to rid the lake of giant man - eating trout . There were a few settlements surrounding the lake .

title: Chess
description: Chess Lord Chess was the ineffectual overlord of Zhentil Keep from at least the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR until his death around the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Personality . Chess was a gluttonous , corpulent man who was vainly fastidious in manner and dress .
description_long: Chess Lord Chess was the ineffectual overlord of Zhentil Keep from at least the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR until his death around the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Personality . Chess was a gluttonous , corpulent man who was vainly fastidious in manner and dress . A coward at heart , he was prone to gossip and being self - important . Abilities . Chess started training as a cleric , switched to studying magic , then gave that up to be trained in the martial arts . He did not attain mastery of any of these professions . Relationships . The Zhentarim kept him in his position of overlord of the Keep because he was easy to manipulate and provided diplomatic cover for their operations . The enemies of the Zhents didn ' t want him to be removed for fear of someone actually competent taking his place and expanding the Zhent influence . Being cowardly and fearful of attack or assassination , he hired a small squad of five bodyguards to accompany him whenever necessary . History . Lord Chess was double - crossed by Mask during his bid to trap Kezef the Chaos Hound , which resulted in Chess ' death .

title: Chess ( game )
description: Chess ( game ) Chess was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with draughts , dice , and Talis . Description . In Faerûn , chess was played on a checkered board with six types of pieces : pawns , rooks , knights - errant , priests , queens , and kings .
description_long: Chess ( game ) Chess was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with draughts , dice , and Talis . Description . In Faerûn , chess was played on a checkered board with six types of pieces : pawns , rooks , knights - errant , priests , queens , and kings . Sets . While the more common chess sets were made of carved and dyed wood , finer sets were often made of more exotic materials . These included ebony and ivory for the pieces and marble for the board . Chess sets often used well - known figures , such as or , for the king pieces . For example , in addition to traditional sets , a selection of specialty sets were available from Aurora ' s Emporium : Chess Piece Gallery . The following are sample chess pieces from a variety of sets : Regional Variations . In Calimshan , a piece must be moved once it has been touched , but that rule was not used in Cormyr . In Cormyr , a player needed to announce their move out loud . Reputation . Chess was the most challenging of four " universal " games . Nobles often played chess as a diversion in the winter months when not at war . The goddess Red Knight used a red knight - errant piece as her holy symbol .

title: Chessan languages
description: Chessan languages The Chessan language group was a part of the Faerûnian language family and included the language of Chessenta . Subgroups . The Chessan group contained two diverse subgroups , the Chessentic group — which included languages spoken around the Sea of Fallen Stars near Chessenta — and Akalaic — including languages spoken in the Shaar , the Shining South , and the Chultan Peninsula .

title: Chessenta
description: Chessenta Chessenta took its name from the first Grand Viceroy Iphram Chess when the region was a province of Unther Prior to the Spellplague , Chessenta was a country of individual city - states that were often at war with one another . The city of Cimbar was the theoretical capital of Chessenta as it was the definitive capital of Tchazzar ' s brief Chessentan Empire . After Chessenta defeated Threskel in 1479 DR , Threskel became a vassal state .
description_long: Chessenta Chessenta took its name from the first Grand Viceroy Iphram Chess when the region was a province of Unther Prior to the Spellplague , Chessenta was a country of individual city - states that were often at war with one another . The city of Cimbar was the theoretical capital of Chessenta as it was the definitive capital of Tchazzar ' s brief Chessentan Empire . After Chessenta defeated Threskel in 1479 DR , Threskel became a vassal state . Culture . While they appreciated culture and theatre , the culture of the Chessentans revolved around war and war heroes . Magic was distrusted by most Chessentans but when Tchazzar returned he legalized magic and enacted laws protecting mage s . Diplomatic Relations . Post - spellplague , Chessenta had extremely chilly relations with High Imaskar and the two countries often engaged in naval raids . Chessenta had friendly relations with Akanûl but was on the verge of war with Tymanther . History . Chessenta was founded in - 1771 DR as a province of the first Untheric empire .

title: Chessentan Lotus Cheese
description: Chessentan Lotus Cheese Chessentan Lotus Cheese was a popular cheese crafted in Chessenta . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Chessentan Lotus Cheese Chessentan Lotus Cheese was a popular cheese crafted in Chessenta . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This novelty cheese was mixed with petals from many flowers before the Chessentans finally settled on lotus for its exotic qualities . Prices . title: Chessentan language
description: Chessentan language Chessentan , also called Chessic , was the regional language of the confederation of Chessenta , located in the Old Empires region of southern Faerûn . Speakers . It was spoken primarily by both Chessenta ns and Ixinos ians but included speakers in Aglarond , Altumbel , the Chondalwood , the Dragon Coast , Impiltur , the Moonsea region , Mulhorand , Sembia , Thay , Turmish , Unther , and the Vilhon and Wizards ' Reaches .
description_long: Chessentan language Chessentan , also called Chessic , was the regional language of the confederation of Chessenta , located in the Old Empires region of southern Faerûn . Speakers . It was spoken primarily by both Chessenta ns and Ixinos ians but included speakers in Aglarond , Altumbel , the Chondalwood , the Dragon Coast , Impiltur , the Moonsea region , Mulhorand , Sembia , Thay , Turmish , Unther , and the Vilhon and Wizards ' Reaches . Lightfoot halfling s also sometimes learned Chessentan as a second language , as did the gold dwarves of the Smoking Mountains and the elves of the Yuirwood . There were three major dialects — Western , Threskian , and Ixinosian . Script . Chessentan was usually written in the Thorass alphabet , but as late as 1357 DR , in their written records , Chessentans employed a variant of Untheric runes , reduced to the form of an alphabet . History . Chessentan was one of the Chessentic languages , derived from Auld Chessic and related to Alambit . Whilst they were a part of Unther ' s empire , the Chessentan people generally spoke Untheric .

title: Chestnut
description: Chestnut The chestnut tree can be found in various places in Faerûn , including the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . In the colder parts of its range , as at Cormanthor , it grows with beech , maple and oak . In the warmest areas , its companions include the fig , mulberry and olive .

title: Cheth Moonviper
description: Cheth Moonviper Cheth Moonviper was a balding alchemist in High Dale . History . Cheth was a priest of Bane and a scion of one of the most noble families of Zhentil Keep .
description_long: Cheth Moonviper Cheth Moonviper was a balding alchemist in High Dale . History . Cheth was a priest of Bane and a scion of one of the most noble families of Zhentil Keep . Under orders of Fzoul Chembryl , he settled in High Dale working as a physic , pharmacist , and tanner to the Dalesfolk . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Cheth was a member of the Council of the High Dale .

title: Chethel
description: Chethel Chethel was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Chethel was located on the coast of Luirenstrand ( the Great Sea ) .
description_long: Chethel Chethel was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Chethel was located on the coast of Luirenstrand ( the Great Sea ) . Directly to the southeast of the city was the Mortick Swamp . History . The city was founded in 47 DR . In 148 DR , the city was half - destroyed by merrow from Mortick Swamp . In 1105 DR , the city received widespread damage from a storm over the Great Sea . Trade . Chethel was one of Luiren ' s main trading cities . Its inhabitants were particularly skilled at shipbuilding . Inhabitants . In addition to halflings , one - tenth of the city ' s population were elves and half - elves .

title: Chevesh
description: Chevesh Chevesh was a powerful human wizard who liveed in a marble tower in Airspur . He was widely regarded by the citizens of Airspur to be crazy and most people avoided his tower . Chevesh was suspected of summoning demons and was investigated by Demascus .
description_long: Chevesh Chevesh was a powerful human wizard who liveed in a marble tower in Airspur . He was widely regarded by the citizens of Airspur to be crazy and most people avoided his tower . Chevesh was suspected of summoning demons and was investigated by Demascus . However , the investigation cleared him of demonic associations . Chevesh would have liked nothing more than to be a firesoul genasi and was researching methods to turn humans into firesouls . His tower was guarded by an azer .

title: Chezzara
description: Chezzara Chezzara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . Activities . Chezzara was one of the priestesses of the Misty Forest .
description_long: Chezzara Chezzara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . Activities . Chezzara was one of the priestesses of the Misty Forest . She was a powerful healer , knowing well the resurrection spell . History . Chezzara resurrected Rowaan Vrinn after her death at the hands of a large group of drider s . She later tried to resurrect Rowaan again after she was killed by a nightshadow of Vhaeraun , but with her soul stolen it was impossible for Chezzara to fulfill this the task .

title: Chical
description: Chical Chical was the old leader of the Eagle Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Chical tried to convince Poshtli , a fellow Eagle Knight and nephew of Naltecona , to abandon his fellows Halloran and Erixitl to their fates .
description_long: Chical Chical was the old leader of the Eagle Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Chical tried to convince Poshtli , a fellow Eagle Knight and nephew of Naltecona , to abandon his fellows Halloran and Erixitl to their fates . Later , alongside the Jaguar Knight Kalnak , Chical was chosen by Naltecona to lead an ambush against the Golden Legion at Palul , despite Chical ' s objection that this was not an honorable plan . Together , Chical and Kalnak welcomed the strangers while secretly their elite army waited in hiding . However , the mage Darien discovered the plan thanks to her magic and informed Cordell , who was at Kalnak ' s side . Quickly , Cordell surprised and killed Kalnak . Chical , however , survived the defeat and quickly went back to Nexal in eagle form to report the failure to Naltecona . After this defeat , the Nexalan ruler changed his mind and proclaimed the strangers as gods , ordering Chical to dismiss the army . When Naltecona was imprisoned by the legionaries , Chical tried to lead a platoon to liberate him but was dismissed by Naltecona himself . Later , he appealed to Poshti , by then the regent , to try again but with no success .

title: Chiguo Ihario
description: Chiguo Ihario Chiguo Ihario was a wakadoshiyori sohei in Wa . Personality . At heart , Chiguo was a bureaucrat and also a devotee of the Path of Enlightenment .
description_long: Chiguo Ihario Chiguo Ihario was a wakadoshiyori sohei in Wa . Personality . At heart , Chiguo was a bureaucrat and also a devotee of the Path of Enlightenment . He disliked using violence . Relationship . Although not particularly fond of Bokika , Chiguo served him loyally like any superior officers . History . Chiguo was a lifelong bureaucrat . In 1358 DR , he was in Fochu to assist and control the daimyo Bokika Hokio . Hokio asked for his help to send someone with a offering of food to a crypt deep in his palace that Hokio had built years before to house the the remains of some followers of the Path of Enlightenment ( in truth , they were worshipers of Chauntea . Tricked , Chiguo agreed to help Hokio and under his suggestion hired a foreign adventuring party to deal with the matter . The adventurers discovered that it was a trap devised by a lu nat .

title: Chil ' triss Kilsek
description: Chil ' triss Kilsek Chil ' triss Kilsek was the leader of a group of drider s . History . Chil ' triss was once a priestess of Lolth of House Kilsek before she was cursed to become a drider .
description_long: Chil ' triss Kilsek Chil ' triss Kilsek was the leader of a group of drider s . History . Chil ' triss was once a priestess of Lolth of House Kilsek before she was cursed to become a drider . In time , she became the leader of a large group of driders living in the Underdark under the Misty Forest . In 1375 DR , Chil ' triss and her fellows were recruited into the Selvetargtlin by the judicator Dhairn .

title: Children of the Starry Quill
description: Children of the Starry Quill The Children of the Starry Quill was an order of bard s that served the Church of Mystra as a news - gathering network and sometimes put to use as a propaganda machine spreading rumors that improved the church ' s position on some issue .
description_long: Children of the Starry Quill The Children of the Starry Quill was an order of bard s that served the Church of Mystra as a news - gathering network and sometimes put to use as a propaganda machine spreading rumors that improved the church ' s position on some issue .

title: Chilis
description: Chilis Chilis were strong spices from Maztica . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Chilis Chilis were strong spices from Maztica . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . The strong flavor of chilis was unique , but was considered similar to Malatra n pepper . The spices were said to be able to cover up even the worst flavors , such as bad meat . When purchased through " Aurora ' s " , chilis could be shipped either in whole dried pods or already ground .

title: Chill
description: Chill The Chill was a military band of goblinoid s and others , led by Ardenor Crush ( a reincarnation in a hobgoblin body ) and formed from the survivors of the Second Battle of Urml . Its base was Chill Tower in the Lurkwood and its symbol , worn on the upper arm , was a fist surrounded by a white nimbus . Its members headed into the North to slay the adventurers who had killed Ardenor .
description_long: Chill The Chill was a military band of goblinoid s and others , led by Ardenor Crush ( a reincarnation in a hobgoblin body ) and formed from the survivors of the Second Battle of Urml . Its base was Chill Tower in the Lurkwood and its symbol , worn on the upper arm , was a fist surrounded by a white nimbus . Its members headed into the North to slay the adventurers who had killed Ardenor . The organization was opposed to the Bloodaxes and the Blue Sigil , and although not well - received by the orc s in the region , they were sometimes hired by them . The group charged 500 gold pieces per week . Divisions . Each of the divisions is led by a lieutenant of the division ' s race .

title: Chill blade
description: Chill blade A chill blade is a magic dagger that glows white . It grants its wielder the ability to activate it , upon which it can confer extra damage upon a target , and imposes a magical effect on the target such that the target ' s own attacks are reduced in effectiveness for around an hour . The blade does a reduced amount of extra damage against the undead , but has a probability of turning them , causing them to flee temporarily .
description_long: Chill blade A chill blade is a magic dagger that glows white . It grants its wielder the ability to activate it , upon which it can confer extra damage upon a target , and imposes a magical effect on the target such that the target ' s own attacks are reduced in effectiveness for around an hour . The blade does a reduced amount of extra damage against the undead , but has a probability of turning them , causing them to flee temporarily . A " chill blade " is resistant to cold . It can be created from a regular ferrous metal dagger , a snowflake or ice , a " chill touch " spell , a lightning or electrical discharge , and a piece of rock crystal . As of 1368 DR , " chill blades " were worth around 1 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Chill metal
description: Chill metal Chill metal was a transmutation spell that made metal cold as ice . Effect . Chill metal made metal extremely cold .
description_long: Chill metal Chill metal was a transmutation spell that made metal cold as ice . Effect . Chill metal made metal extremely cold . A creature took cold damage if its equipment was chilled . It took full damage if its armor was affected or if it was holding , touching , wearing , or carrying metal weighing one - fifth of its weight . The creature suffered minimal injury if it was not wearing metal armor and the metal that it was carrying weighed less than one - fifth of its weight . Initially , the metal became very chilly and uncomfortable to touch but delt no damage . Shortly thereafter , icy coldness caused pain and damage . A few minutes later the metal became freezing cold , causing greater injury . Any heat intense enough to damage the creature negated cold damage from the spell ( and vice versa ) . Underwater , chill metal delta no damage , but ice immediately formed around the affected metal , making it more buoyant . Chill metal countered and dispelled by the heat metal spell .

title: Chill strike
description: Chill strike Chill strike is a wizard spell of relatively low complexity . When cast , " chill strike " creates a bolt of icy cold energy that is purplish in color . The bolt then flies towards its target , which must be somewhere within a range of fifty feet , dazing them if they are animated .
description_long: Chill strike Chill strike is a wizard spell of relatively low complexity . When cast , " chill strike " creates a bolt of icy cold energy that is purplish in color . The bolt then flies towards its target , which must be somewhere within a range of fifty feet , dazing them if they are animated . The spell is easy to master , but drains its caster ' s energy to a point that , in order to cast it again , the wizard must relieve themselves and rest for a few minutes .

title: Chill touch
description: Chill touch Chill touch , formerly known as Veridon ' s chiller , was a necromancy spell that disrupted the life force of the living . Users . " Chill touch " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold domain In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive and Variation specializations .
description_long: Chill touch Chill touch , formerly known as Veridon ' s chiller , was a necromancy spell that disrupted the life force of the living . Users . " Chill touch " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold domain In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive and Variation specializations . Effects . The caster ' s hand glowed blue and a touch from it channeled negative energy into a victim , disrupting their life force . It could also possibly weaken the target ' s muscles , draining their strength , though this effect could be resisted . The spell had a special effect on undead creatures . Undead touched suffered no damage or strength loss , but they could flee in terror for a short time in the spell overcame their will . The sundering version of the spell created a ghostly skeleton hand around a creature . The hand could by will of the caster attack the creature with necrotic energy and shortly hindering its ability to regain health as it clung on to it . A undead creature struck by the hand would have disadvantage on its attacks against the caster . History .

title: Chilling blow
description: Chilling blow Chilling blow was a swordmage spell of the transmutation school , most commonly used by those of the shielding style . When cast , " chilling blow " instilled the swordmage ' s weapon with magic al cold , so that the wound they left froze instantly , causing the target a level of pain proportional to the swordmage ' s intellect . This frozen flesh continued to injure its owner for a short while afterward ; precisely how much dependent upon the vitality of the swordmage in question .
description_long: Chilling blow Chilling blow was a swordmage spell of the transmutation school , most commonly used by those of the shielding style . When cast , " chilling blow " instilled the swordmage ' s weapon with magic al cold , so that the wound they left froze instantly , causing the target a level of pain proportional to the swordmage ' s intellect . This frozen flesh continued to injure its owner for a short while afterward ; precisely how much dependent upon the vitality of the swordmage in question . The spell was not particularly complex and it could be recast after a short rest of at least a few minutes .

title: Chimera
description: Chimera A chimera is a large magical beast that appears to be an amalgam of several different creatures , namely a dragon , a goat , and a lion . Although typically unintelligent , chimeras are self - aware creatures , with a limited capacity for language , often Draconic . Physical description .
description_long: Chimera A chimera is a large magical beast that appears to be an amalgam of several different creatures , namely a dragon , a goat , and a lion . Although typically unintelligent , chimeras are self - aware creatures , with a limited capacity for language , often Draconic . Physical description . A chimera has the hindquarters of a goat , the forequarters of a lion , and a set of dragon wings . Additionally , a chimera has three heads , that of a horned goat , a lioness , and a dragon . The goat head is often white or black in color , though in both cases it is marked by red eyes while the lion head exhibits green . Abilities . All chimeras have access to an array of various abilities . Each of the heads is capable of a unique attack , but the most dangerous by far is the dragon breath of the chimera ’ s draconic head . The exact attack varies from one individual to another , as in dragons , with the type varying based on color . For instance , a chimera with a white dragon head would cast a breath of cold air , while one with a red head would bellow forth scorching flames . Ecology . Culture .

title: Chioptl
description: Chioptl Chioptl was a Tabaxi in Nexal . History . Chioptl was a Tabaxi living in southern Maztica .
description_long: Chioptl Chioptl was a Tabaxi in Nexal . History . Chioptl was a Tabaxi living in southern Maztica . In 1362 DR , her tribe ' s elder , a Jaguar lord follower of Azul , was granted a vision by the god Tezca , telling of the location of the Cloak of One Plume . In order to become the elder ' s bride , Chioptl led a group of warriors to Nexal with the mission to recover it . However , in Nexal , the Tabaxi were captured by the orc s of Chief Jeordos . All the warriors were killed but Chioptl escaped thank to the intervention of orcs following Chief Michitl .

title: Chipgrin Goldwhisker
description: Chipgrin Goldwhisker Chipgrin Goldwhisker was the leader of the wererat s in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Chipgrin was a smart and reasonable leader .
description_long: Chipgrin Goldwhisker Chipgrin Goldwhisker was the leader of the wererat s in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Chipgrin was a smart and reasonable leader . During any negotiation , Chipgrin was affable but firm in his demands . He noted the strange behavior of his " cousins " sane by lycanthropy ( the wererats as bestial creatures were not afflicted by the demon lord Juiblex ' s madness ) . History . Chipgrin emerged as the leader of Clan Goldwhisker , the tribe of wererats living in Blingdenstone from the time of the drow attack on the city in 1371 DR . During the Rage of Demons , he acknowledged the threat of the Pudding King and was considering offering the help of his people to Dorbo Diggermattock in exchange for a formal recognition that they were citizens of Blingdenstone like the others .

title: Chiquong
description: Chiquong Chiquong was a shukenja and holy man in the land of Koryo . Seeking a suitable locale for his hermitage , Chiquong had journeyed to the southern tip of the island of Saishu , but had still found nothing to his liking . So instead he raised an island from the depths of the sea , a desolate rock that came to be called Su ' un .
description_long: Chiquong Chiquong was a shukenja and holy man in the land of Koryo . Seeking a suitable locale for his hermitage , Chiquong had journeyed to the southern tip of the island of Saishu , but had still found nothing to his liking . So instead he raised an island from the depths of the sea , a desolate rock that came to be called Su ' un . There he dwelled , with the wind his only companion . Rumors told that Chiquong still lived on Su ' un by 1350 DR , and that he could predict the future and hid great riches .

title: Chitikas
description: Chitikas Chitikas was a couatl servant of Qotal . History . Chitikas was the main agent of Qotal in preparation for his god ' s return .
description_long: Chitikas Chitikas was a couatl servant of Qotal . History . Chitikas was the main agent of Qotal in preparation for his god ' s return . He appeared to Erixitl , the girl prophesied to call back Qotal , and gave her the ability to speak with Faerun ian people . Chitikas appeared again during the Night of Wailing , just after the death of Naltecona , to guide Erixitl and Halloran in fighting the Ancient Ones . During the fighting against the drow at the Highcave in Mount Zatal , he sacrificed himself in order to kill the Ancestor and destroy the Darkfyre .

title: Chitin armor
description: Chitin armor Chitin armor was made from the shells of chitinous creatures such as ankheg , giant crab s , or remorhaz . It was flexible and could be comfortable , and was known to be used by aquatic elves and some savage cultures . The armor was valued around 75 gp and weighed 20 lb ( 10 kg ) .
description_long: Chitin armor Chitin armor was made from the shells of chitinous creatures such as ankheg , giant crab s , or remorhaz . It was flexible and could be comfortable , and was known to be used by aquatic elves and some savage cultures . The armor was valued around 75 gp and weighed 20 lb ( 10 kg ) .

title: Chitine
description: Chitine Chitines were humanoid s that resembled spiders and were found in the Underdark . Description . Chitines were about 4 feet tall and had four arms , each of which had an extra joint .
description_long: Chitine Chitines were humanoid s that resembled spiders and were found in the Underdark . Description . Chitines were about 4 feet tall and had four arms , each of which had an extra joint . Each of their hands and feet were embedded with claws , which allowed them to climb most surfaces . Their faces held faceted eyes and mandibles attached to their mouths . Chitines could spin webs from their stomach . Their skins secreted oil , preventing the chitines from sticking to their own webs . Combat . When possible , chitines used their webs to create pitfall traps to catch enemies unawares . Their ambidexterity and hooks in their hands made them extremely difficult to disarm . They were , however , sensitive to sunlight and bright lights . Chitines would often wear web armor made from their own hardened web . Society . Chitines usually lived in villages inside a cavern filled with maze - like webs . In the center of the cavern was always a temple to Lolth . The leaders of each village were choldrith s , chitine priests that were in fact a different species . History . In the 13th century DR , chitines were created by Ched Nasad an wizard s of House Mylyl as failed slave experiments .

title: Chitine web armor
description: Chitine web armor Chitine web armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chitin web armor was a rare type of armor made from the hardened web of chitine s .
description_long: Chitine web armor Chitine web armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chitin web armor was a rare type of armor made from the hardened web of chitine s . All chitines could create web armor for themselves and maintain it indefinitely . Nonchitines could pay chitine weavers to make web armor . This armor lasted for about three months before it started to deteriorate . After six months it would have completely dissolved . Chitine web armor ( like all chitine web based products ) was susceptible to fire . Web armor could also be built to resemble studded leather armor , by weaving metal studs into it .

title: Chizra
description: Chizra Chizra was a priestess of Eilistraee and one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . . History .
description_long: Chizra Chizra was a priestess of Eilistraee and one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . . History . In 1377 DR , she was one of the six Protectors chosen by Cavatina Xarann to lead an assault on the main temple of Kiaransalee . Cavatina ordered Chizra to return to the Promenade with the body of the dead Halav . Later , she went back to the expedition with Leliana Vrinn , but found only Q ' arlynd Melarn . In 1379 DR , Chizra was among the Protectors alerted by Cavatina to stop a dretch infiltrator in the Promenade .

title: Cho Lu - k ' u
description: Cho Lu - k ' u Cho Lu - k ' u was a wizard who once lived in Koryo . Cho Lu - k ' u died in the Dang Caverns and cursed its tunnels . This may have led to the evil monsters that lurked there .
description_long: Cho Lu - k ' u Cho Lu - k ' u was a wizard who once lived in Koryo . Cho Lu - k ' u died in the Dang Caverns and cursed its tunnels . This may have led to the evil monsters that lurked there . Meo Cha heard of this story from his old tutor before around 1350 DR .

title: Chog
description: Chog Chog the Yellow was one of the two Cloakmasters of Keczulla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Previously , Chog was the guildmaster of fences for the Shadow Thieves in the city .
description_long: Chog Chog the Yellow was one of the two Cloakmasters of Keczulla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Previously , Chog was the guildmaster of fences for the Shadow Thieves in the city . However , he proved absolutely inept in the Cloakmaster ' s role : Chog so badly mismanaged his half of the town that the Shadow Council was likely to soon eliminate and replace him . To avoid this outcome , Chog considered many wild schemes to somehow discredit the other Cloakmaster or " rescue " the city from a calamity engineered by himself .

title: Choi Tan Sai
description: Choi Tan Sai Choi Tan Sai was a yakuza adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Choi was a shrewd and cunning individual who never showed his true feelings .
description_long: Choi Tan Sai Choi Tan Sai was a yakuza adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Choi was a shrewd and cunning individual who never showed his true feelings . He disliked working with woman and non - human beings . Choi easily adapted to all kinds of contests and quickly gained contacts . Relationships . Choi was a member of the Yansi , the most powerful yakuza gang of Chu ' Yuan province . He acted as special agent , being a very flexible individual . His masters sent Choi on the most delicate missions . He had many dealings and contacts among magistrates and police . History . In 1358 DR , Choi was tasked with finding General Goyat Nagumo in order to make him pay the Yansi for spy services . He decided to attend the Komite . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Choi Tan Sai was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Shou Lung .

title: Choin
description: Choin Choin , or Choin the Blue - Nosed , was the bakemono ruler of Panjuis in 1359 DR . Description . As his name implied , Choin possessed a large blue nose centered on a bulbous head .
description_long: Choin Choin , or Choin the Blue - Nosed , was the bakemono ruler of Panjuis in 1359 DR . Description . As his name implied , Choin possessed a large blue nose centered on a bulbous head . He was scrawny even for a bakemono . Activities . Choin ruled over several hundred bakemono within Panjuis .

title: Choldrith
description: Choldrith Choldriths were the priest race of the chitine s in the Underdark . Description . Choldriths had eight legs ( though the front two served as arms ) and resembled bloated white spiders .
description_long: Choldrith Choldriths were the priest race of the chitine s in the Underdark . Description . Choldriths had eight legs ( though the front two served as arms ) and resembled bloated white spiders . Like chitines , they had faceted eyes and mandibles protruding from their mouths . Their ears looked like horns . Combat . When possible , choldriths hid behind shields of chitines while they used their clerical spells . Society . Choldriths lived alongside chitines in villages inside caverns filled with maze - like webs . In the center of the cavern was always a temple to Lolth . Choldriths served as the leaders of each village , as they were seen as blessed by Lolth . Locations . Choldriths were found alongside chitines in the upper and middle - Northdark . However , the majority lived in several connected villages known cumulatively as Yathchol , located beneath the Far Forest . In that city , choldriths made up 8 percent of the population in 1372 DR .

title: Chond
description: Chond Chond was a merchant from the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Chond partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .
description_long: Chond Chond was a merchant from the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Chond partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves . Chond ' s own small merchant company was converted into a regional base for the coster . Chond and the Seven Suns were in business by 1358 DR , and still going by 1374 DR .

title: Chondalwood
description: Chondalwood Chondalwood is a large forest located in Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , stretching from the Nunwood to the Nagaflow River . It is also known as Satyrwood . The village of Elbulder is to the south of the forest .
description_long: Chondalwood Chondalwood is a large forest located in Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , stretching from the Nunwood to the Nagaflow River . It is also known as Satyrwood . The village of Elbulder is to the south of the forest . History . The forest was once home to the green elf realm of Nikerymath . It contains the hidden city of Rucien - Xan . Inhabitants . The Chondalwood is now the home of several roving tribes of wild elves . Treant s still roam the forest , but mainly occupy the northern border , ever watchful of loggers and poachers . As of 1368 DR , troops of satyr s patrolled the Old Road , scaring travelers into making haste out of the forest or to go around it , and the forest was also inhabited by voadkyn ( wood giants ) and centaur s . As of 1372 DR , savage druids lived in the forest and posed a threat to anyone approaching them . Clans of ghostwise halfling s still roam about the forest , never staying in one spot for too long . Various plant creatures such as shambling mounds and tendriculos also live here . All of these intelligent races had one goal in mind : to prevent human encroachment .

title: Chondath
description: Chondath Chondath was a country located in the Vilhon Reach . It had a long history . It was located on what once was the psiocracy of Jhaamdath on the shore of the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Chondath Chondath was a country located in the Vilhon Reach . It had a long history . It was located on what once was the psiocracy of Jhaamdath on the shore of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Chondath was later a confederation of city - states under the capital of Arrabar , but used to be a powerful nation in times long past . All of Chondath was ruled by Eles Wianar , the Lord of Arrabar . He resided in the Generon , a large palace located in the capital . Society . Chondathan s were primarily traders , often dealing with far - off lands . They were also a somewhat warlike people and distrusted wizard s and magic altogether . Religion . Waukeen , the goddess of trade , was heavily worshiped here . Other important gods were Helm , god of guardians ; Lliira , goddess of joy ; Malar , god of the hunt ; Talos , god of storms ; and Tempus , god of war .

title: Chondathan
description: Chondathan Chondathans were one of the more common human ethnicities . Regions . Chondathans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Chondathan culture had a major influence on Damaran , Vaasan , and Tethyrian heritage .
description_long: Chondathan Chondathans were one of the more common human ethnicities . Regions . Chondathans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Chondathan culture had a major influence on Damaran , Vaasan , and Tethyrian heritage . Appearance . Chondathans were usually slender with tawny skin and brown hair . They were often tall with green or brown eyes .

title: Chondathan language
description: Chondathan language Chondathan was a popular human language spoken mainly in the western regions of Faerûn . Description . Chondathan was similar to Common , but it was far more expressive and complex in its grammar .
description_long: Chondathan language Chondathan was a popular human language spoken mainly in the western regions of Faerûn . Description . Chondathan was similar to Common , but it was far more expressive and complex in its grammar . Speakers . The Chondathan tongue was spoken in and around Waterdeep , in addition to the ubiquitous Common and the northern language of Illuskan . Other regions where Chondathan was commonly spoken as a primary language included Amn , Cormyr , the Dalelands , the Dragon Coast , Sembia , the Silver Marches , Tethyr , the Western Heartlands , and the Vilhon Reach . It was also spoken as a second language in Altumbel , the Anauroch , Calimshan , Chessenta , Damara , Impiltur , the Lake of Steam region , Lantan , the Moonsea region , the Moonshae Isles , the North , The Ride , the Sword Coast , Thesk , Turmish , The Vast Dwarves of the Galena Mountains and the Spine of the World or within the Underdark sometimes spoke Chondathan , as did elves living in the Chondalwood , Cormanthor , the Elven Court , Evereska , Evermeet , and the Sea of Fallen Stars . Aarakocra from the Storm Horns also frequently spoke Chondathan as a second language . Dialects .

title: Chondathan steelsword
description: Chondathan steelsword A Chondathan steelsword , named after Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , is a broad - bladed one - handed sword that behaves like a masterwork longsword and is particularly good at breaking other weapons . As of 1372 DR they were available in Cormyr , the Dalelands and Sembia . They were valued around 315 gp and weighed 5 lb ( 2 .
description_long: Chondathan steelsword A Chondathan steelsword , named after Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , is a broad - bladed one - handed sword that behaves like a masterwork longsword and is particularly good at breaking other weapons . As of 1372 DR they were available in Cormyr , the Dalelands and Sembia . They were valued around 315 gp and weighed 5 lb ( 2 . 5 kg ) .

title: Chonis
description: Chonis Chonis was an unknown being named in two ruins found in Cormyr : the ruins of Chonis ' Temple in the Stormhorns in the west and the Tomb of Chonis in the plains in the east . The word " Chonis " was written in the Thorass alphabet in prominent places in both structures . For example , it appeared on the stone lintel over the door in the tomb .
description_long: Chonis Chonis was an unknown being named in two ruins found in Cormyr : the ruins of Chonis ' Temple in the Stormhorns in the west and the Tomb of Chonis in the plains in the east . The word " Chonis " was written in the Thorass alphabet in prominent places in both structures . For example , it appeared on the stone lintel over the door in the tomb . This led to both structures being named for this Chonis . It was unknown who or what Chonis was by the 1370s DR . The ruins in the Stormhorns appeared to have once been a temple dedicated to Chonis , leading to speculation it was a long - forgotten deity , demigod , or fiend . Adding weight to this were two depictions of a horned face , carved into the walls of the tomb in a crude and ancient style . The first two were frowning , the third was smiling . Sages would likely pay a lot of money to identify Chonis .

title: Chonis ' Temple
description: Chonis ' Temple Chonis ' Temple was the name given to a ruined structure in western Cormyr . It lay east of Eagle Peak , in the foothills of the Stormhorns . The ruins were thought to have once been a temple , and prominently bore the name " Chonis " , written in the Thorass alphabet , a feature it shared with the Tomb of Chonis .
description_long: Chonis ' Temple Chonis ' Temple was the name given to a ruined structure in western Cormyr . It lay east of Eagle Peak , in the foothills of the Stormhorns . The ruins were thought to have once been a temple , and prominently bore the name " Chonis " , written in the Thorass alphabet , a feature it shared with the Tomb of Chonis . Hence , it was called " Chonis ' Temple " . None knew who or what Chonis was , however ; some speculated it was a long - forgotten deity , demigod , or fiend .

title: Choren Lendoren
description: Choren Lendoren Choren Lendoren was a tavern owner of the Dizzy Drake in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Choren started to drink with his customers .
description_long: Choren Lendoren Choren Lendoren was a tavern owner of the Dizzy Drake in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Choren started to drink with his customers . The reason was simple : Nhyris D ' Hothek had made his lair in his basement and forced Choren to assist him , by luring some of his patrons down to the lich . He obeyed out of fear .

title: Chosen
description: Chosen The Chosen are individuals imbued with divine power by one of the deities of the Realms , which grants them various abilities and boons , such as stopping the process of aging . It is believed that all deities are capable of " choosing " mortals , though it is impossible to say whether all of them take advantage of this power . It is possible for one being to be the chosen of more than one deity .
description_long: Chosen The Chosen are individuals imbued with divine power by one of the deities of the Realms , which grants them various abilities and boons , such as stopping the process of aging . It is believed that all deities are capable of " choosing " mortals , though it is impossible to say whether all of them take advantage of this power . It is possible for one being to be the chosen of more than one deity . As of 1485 DR there were no Chosen who weren ' t also exarch s .

title: Chosen of Bane
description: Chosen of Bane The chosen of Bane was a position granted by Bane to powerful members of his faith . Typically , there was only one Chosen of Bane at a time . Around 1372 DR , this position was held by Fzoul Chembryl .
description_long: Chosen of Bane The chosen of Bane was a position granted by Bane to powerful members of his faith . Typically , there was only one Chosen of Bane at a time . Around 1372 DR , this position was held by Fzoul Chembryl . Bane granted a number of spells and powers to his chosen . They gained " endure elements " , " mind blank " , and " negative energy protection " as bonus spells , and the ability to use " command " and " enthrall " as they willed ; " hypnotism " , " remove fear " , or " cause fear " , five times a day ; " charm monster " and " suggestion " three times a day ; and " dominate monster " and " geas " , once a day . They also took less damage from attacks , and they could not age , either naturally or as a result of magic . They could also summon death tyrant s and let their shadows roam free through a telepathic link . Finally , a chosen had greater force of charisma and was more wise .

title: Chosen of Lolth
description: Chosen of Lolth The Chosen of Lolth were , like other Chosen , mortals who were favored or otherwise " blessed " by a god or goddess , in this case Lolth . There were two apparent types of Chosen of Lolth : zedrinset and Yor ' thae . Zedrinset .
description_long: Chosen of Lolth The Chosen of Lolth were , like other Chosen , mortals who were favored or otherwise " blessed " by a god or goddess , in this case Lolth . There were two apparent types of Chosen of Lolth : zedrinset and Yor ' thae . Zedrinset . The first and less notable was known as " zedrinset " . The " zedrinset " became a favored vessel for the powers and wrath of the goddess . For a short time in 1361 DR , Lolth made Liriel Baenre a " zedrinset " and helped her in the battle of Ruathym and against the priestess Shakti Hunzrin . Being chaotic and cruel , the goddess did this against the will of Liriel . Yor ' thae . The other type of Chosen was known as " Yor ' thae " ( High Drow for " Chosen One " ; lit . " yorn " " servant of the goddess " + " orthae " " sacred " ) . In 1373 DR , at the end of the Silence of Lolth , Lolth summoned three priestesses to her in the Demonweb Pits to compete for the title of " Yor ' thae " : Quenthel Baenre , Danifae Yauntyrr , and Halisstra Melarn . Danifae became the " Yor ' thae " , consumed and literally turned into the eighth spider manifestation of Lolth .

title: Chosen of Mystra
description: Chosen of Mystra The Chosen of Mystra are , similarly to the Chosen of other deities , mortals who have been specifically blessed by Mystra . Due to this blessing they gain access to unprecedented magical power . Mystra ' s Chosen are all concerned with fighting evil and imbalances in the Weave .
description_long: Chosen of Mystra The Chosen of Mystra are , similarly to the Chosen of other deities , mortals who have been specifically blessed by Mystra . Due to this blessing they gain access to unprecedented magical power . Mystra ' s Chosen are all concerned with fighting evil and imbalances in the Weave . Benefits . Chosen of Mystra gain many benefits from her blessing , but there are a few notable powers that they gain . Obviously , they all have a greater command of the magic they wield , seeming to be able to cast more often with less effort . They also become more familiar with magic ; able to detect its presence . In addition , many also develop immunities to magic , and eventually immunities to disease and poison . They become much more hardy , showing a toughness uncharacteristic of most mages . Mystra ' s Chosen are also immune to the deleterious effects from the casting and wearing of a " mantle " : they suffer no loss of health or the removal of spells from their minds upon the raising of a " mantle " or the cumulative daily requirement of the spell .

title: Choshein
description: Choshein Choshein was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The city of Choshein was a subterranean one , with smooth , crystal walls and spired buildings .
description_long: Choshein Choshein was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The city of Choshein was a subterranean one , with smooth , crystal walls and spired buildings . The ruins of Choshein — if they could even be called that , as naught but a circle of seven columns remained — were located within a massive cavern of stone and frost under the High Ice of the Anauroch . These seven blue pillars acted as a portal to Gharreil , a sister city of the Empire , and to the capital of Jhothûn . Activating the portal required simply touching one of the columns . The default destination was Gharreil , but one could travel to the city of Jhothûn by speaking its name . When activated , curtains of heatless blue flame appeared between each of the columns , and persons could pass through any of the sides of the formed heptagon . When the destination was changed to Jhothûn , these magical curtains were purple in color . As late as 1372 DR , the portal was still functioning , yet its power was weak , and it could only be activated once per hour and was prone to malfunctioning . Government .

title: Chou Lin Shi
description: Chou Lin Shi Chou Lin Shi was the Minister of Sea of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Chou Lin Shi gained fame by defeating the pirates of Akari .
description_long: Chou Lin Shi Chou Lin Shi was the Minister of Sea of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Chou Lin Shi gained fame by defeating the pirates of Akari . Thanks to that battle , he was promoted to command of a warship with nobody paying attention to his heritage . In time , Chou Lin Shi rose through the ranks until he became minister some years before 1358 DR . For a long time , Chou Lin Shi had faced no great difficulties in this post . Chou Lin Shi was a great supporter of Grand General Kwan Chan Sen . He worked very hard to kept his heritage hidden and maybe only the Imperial Censors knew about it . Chou Lin Shi however always feared that Minister of Security would discover his secret and exile him .

title: Chourm Mristar
description: Chourm Mristar Chourm Mristar was a monk from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in Damara in the late 15th century DR . Relationship . Chourm was a good friend of Lana , and was one of the people that Lana trusted most .
description_long: Chourm Mristar Chourm Mristar was a monk from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in Damara in the late 15th century DR . Relationship . Chourm was a good friend of Lana , and was one of the people that Lana trusted most . Activities . Chourm lived in the village of Tomrav , acting as the monastery ' s envoy .

title: Chourst
description: Chourst Chourst is the slaad Lord of Randomness . Description . Chourst appears as a gangly , 20 ' tall chalk - white slaad ; his other forms are unknown .
description_long: Chourst Chourst is the slaad Lord of Randomness . Description . Chourst appears as a gangly , 20 ' tall chalk - white slaad ; his other forms are unknown . Chourst cares for nothing but himself . Independent , impulsive , erratic , and totally self - absorbed , Chourst does whatever he wishes from moment to moment . Chourst enjoys relaxing in the primordial soup of Limbo , as if soothing away cares that he does not really have . Chourst does not make plans and is not interested in anything beyond his momentary desires . Anything that requires more than a few minutes of his attention is not worth exploring . Relationships . Although Ygorl approves of the chaos and entropy Chourst wreaks , Chourst has made many enemies , especially among the githzerai who frequently fall on the receiving end of his antics . Chourst ’ s inquisitiveness once drove him to visit Mechanus , although he barely survived the encounter ; Primus himself showed up to deal with the slaad after he had worked enough mayhem and disorder on the orderly plane , and still seeks justice against Chourst . Realm . Chourst has no residence , home base , or even any temporary domicile ; he feels at home wherever he goes .

title: Chris Avellone
description: Chris Avellone Chris Avellone is a video game designer who has worked for the video game companies and Obsidian Entertainment . He was one of the co - founders of the latter company . He also writes comic books .
description_long: Chris Avellone Chris Avellone is a video game designer who has worked for the video game companies and Obsidian Entertainment . He was one of the co - founders of the latter company . He also writes comic books . Education . Avellone received a bachelor ' s degree in English with a minor in fine arts from the . Projects . Forgotten Realms games on which he contributed include Descent to Undermountain , , all of the Icewind Dale games , , and Neverwinter Nights 2 .

title: Chris Sims
description: Chris Sims Chris Sims is a game designer and associate editor working at Wizards of the Coast , Inc . . Biography .
description_long: Chris Sims Chris Sims is a game designer and associate editor working at Wizards of the Coast , Inc . . Biography . Chris Sims started out working for small d20 companies in 2003 , then landed a freelance editor gig for Wizards RPG R & D . Wizards finally hired him as the Duel Masters editor in 2005 . From there , Chris worked his way up into RPG R & D as an editor , and finally became a story designer .

title: Chris Tulach
description: Chris Tulach Chris Tulach is an RPGA Content Desginer and Program Manager at WOTC who ' s worked on several Dungeons & Dragons . Chris is best know for his RPGA or D & D Play reports which have been a regular feature in Dragon since April 2008 . Bibliography .
description_long: Chris Tulach Chris Tulach is an RPGA Content Desginer and Program Manager at WOTC who ' s worked on several Dungeons & Dragons . Chris is best know for his RPGA or D & D Play reports which have been a regular feature in Dragon since April 2008 . Bibliography . " Only titles relevant to this wiki are listed here . "

title: Chris Youngs
description: Chris Youngs Chris Youngs is a magazine editor at Wizards of the Coast . Career . Youngs first joined Wizards of the Coast in 1998 as an editing intern .
description_long: Chris Youngs Chris Youngs is a magazine editor at Wizards of the Coast . Career . Youngs first joined Wizards of the Coast in 1998 as an editing intern . He worked his way up in the company and joined the teams working on " Dragon " and " Dungeon " . Youngs was editor - in - chief for " Dragon " issues # 312 through # 315 and # 360 through # 388 . In 2007 , he joined the team .

title: Christie Golden
description: Christie Golden Christie Golden ( born 1963 ) is a Colorado based American fantasy author . Her first novel " Vampire of the Mists " ( 1991 ) marked the beginning of TSR ' s Ravenloft novel line . Her trips to the Forgotten Realms have thus far been limited to three short stories published in the anthologies series in which she further explores the character of the elven vampire Jander Sunstar , whom she established in " Vampire of the Mists " .
description_long: Christie Golden Christie Golden ( born 1963 ) is a Colorado based American fantasy author . Her first novel " Vampire of the Mists " ( 1991 ) marked the beginning of TSR ' s Ravenloft novel line . Her trips to the Forgotten Realms have thus far been limited to three short stories published in the anthologies series in which she further explores the character of the elven vampire Jander Sunstar , whom she established in " Vampire of the Mists " . Apart from her engagement for TSR , Golden has written several original novels and some set in the Star Trek universe . She is currently focusing on working with Blizzard Entertainment , having released novels in their Starcraft and Warcraft universes .

title: Christine Dragonsbane
description: Christine Dragonsbane Lady Christine was the wife of King Gareth Dragonsbane and the daughter of Baron Tranth , the former ruler of the Barony of Bloodstone in Damara . History . Christine had been raised as a noblewoman , being the daughter of Baron Tranth .
description_long: Christine Dragonsbane Lady Christine was the wife of King Gareth Dragonsbane and the daughter of Baron Tranth , the former ruler of the Barony of Bloodstone in Damara . History . Christine had been raised as a noblewoman , being the daughter of Baron Tranth . She received her druid ic training from Quillan , but inherited her title as Lady when her father , Baron Tranth , gave the throne of Bloodstone to her new husband . If she hadn ' t married , Christine would soon have become the Baroness anyway . Tranth knew she was ready to rule , and nobody in Bloodstone Pass doubted her ability to lead . When the Grandfather of Assassins ' bandit army first appeared , before Gareth and his friends arrived , Lady Christine was the first to take a stand . By the time Gareth and company rolled into town , she had already begun organizing the militia . Personality . Christine understood and fulfilled her duties as queen at court but was not comfortable with the facade . In her heart she was an adventurer and fighter .

title: Christopher Perkins
description: Christopher Perkins Christopher Perkins has written many supplements for Wizards of the Coast , first as a freelance contributor in Dungeon magazine , then as that magazine ' s editor before becoming editor - in chief for all Wizards of the Coast periodicals . He was also the design manager for the Eberron campaign setting before becoming the Story Design and Development Manager for all of Dungeons and Dragons in 2007 , acting as senior producer for the game .

title: Chromatic Demon
description: Chromatic Demon The Chromatic Demon was a tanar ' ri imprisoned in Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . He was forced into Helm ' s service to secure the Imprisoned One in the keep . He guarded a level of the dungeon imprisoned in a magical cage , and only he had the key for the next level .
description_long: Chromatic Demon The Chromatic Demon was a tanar ' ri imprisoned in Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . He was forced into Helm ' s service to secure the Imprisoned One in the keep . He guarded a level of the dungeon imprisoned in a magical cage , and only he had the key for the next level . Eventually , the demon met Gorion ' s Ward and convinced him to release him in exchange for the key . But when Gorion ' s Ward collected all the items to free the Chromatic Demon , the demon tried to kill Gorion ' s Ward but was instead killed himself .

title: Chromatic dragon
description: Chromatic dragon Chromatic dragons were a type of dragon distinguished typically by a solid , non - reflective coloring of their scales , hence the name . They were generally evil , greedy , and predatory , and usually worshiped Tiamat , whom they regarded as their queen . It was believed by scholars from Candlekeep that all species of chromatic dragons evolved from the proto - dragon species of the inficedraco genus .

Although there were many chromatic dragon species , the following are the ones known by sages of Faerûn :

title: Chromatic orb
description: Chromatic orb Chromatic orb was an evocation spell used by several sorcerer s and wizard s . When cast , " chromatic orb " shoot a dazzling , multicoloured globe towards a creature of the casters choice within fifty feet , which upon impact burst into a ray of whatever colour was currently dominant . Though this often resulted in debilitating effects , " chromatic orb " always dealt some degree of injury to its target , regardless of how well they defend themselves .
description_long: Chromatic orb Chromatic orb was an evocation spell used by several sorcerer s and wizard s . When cast , " chromatic orb " shoot a dazzling , multicoloured globe towards a creature of the casters choice within fifty feet , which upon impact burst into a ray of whatever colour was currently dominant . Though this often resulted in debilitating effects , " chromatic orb " always dealt some degree of injury to its target , regardless of how well they defend themselves . " Chromatic orb " was after the Spellplague among the most complicated spells learned by young or inexperienced sorcerers and as such , can only be cast once per day . Similar , but not identical in effect , to the " prismatic ray " spell used by wizard s , the exact effect of " chromatic orb " depend upon the colour that resulted as dominant . Yellow light indicated a harsh and brilliant light that dazes the spell ' s victim . Red , as might be expected , signified fire and similarly green resulted in the poisoning of the target . Turquoise light sent an electrifying charge through the flesh of its victim , causing them to move a number of feet dependent upon the caster ' s dexterity .

title: Chronomancy
description: Chronomancy Chronomancy was a school of magic dealing with movement through time , or the manipulation of time . It was a secretive and rare school of magic , and most wizard s had difficulty comprehending the possibility of altering the natural course of events . Those wielding power in this school were known as chronomancers .
description_long: Chronomancy Chronomancy was a school of magic dealing with movement through time , or the manipulation of time . It was a secretive and rare school of magic , and most wizard s had difficulty comprehending the possibility of altering the natural course of events . Those wielding power in this school were known as chronomancers .

title: Chronos
description: Chronos Chronos was an ancient deity , the god of time , ironically , lost to the ages . Religious texts and ancient histories speak of him in passing . He was known to be worshiped by the nation of Orva but it was unknown how he died .
description_long: Chronos Chronos was an ancient deity , the god of time , ironically , lost to the ages . Religious texts and ancient histories speak of him in passing . He was known to be worshiped by the nation of Orva but it was unknown how he died . Shrines of Chronos still held power millennia later . Offerings would crumble to dust in mere seconds and in return , the offerer may have received a vision of the past or the future . Statues of Chronos depicted him as a tall man in a hooded robe with feathered wings , holding a scythe and an hourglass . History . When the green elves migrated to the Yuirwood , the Seldarine merged with or absorbed the ancient Yuir gods and they became aspects of the various members of the elven pantheon . Chronos became an aspect of Labelas Enoreth .

title: Chroomeg
description: Chroomeg Chroomeg was a tavern owner in Mulmaster . Personality . The tavern owner was a gregarious and affable man with hints of orc blood in his veins .
description_long: Chroomeg Chroomeg was a tavern owner in Mulmaster . Personality . The tavern owner was a gregarious and affable man with hints of orc blood in his veins . Activities . Chroomeg managed the Oxpit Tavern in a lower part of the city . History . While managing a good tavern , in 1491 DR , Chroomeg had trouble with some vandals . During a party at Astrid Saj ' s estate , he decided to hire an adventuring party to solve the matter .

title: Chrysoberyl
description: Chrysoberyl Chrysoberyl , also known as a cat ' s eye , was a hard , transparent , green gem , usually facet - cut . Description . This fancy stones were used in producing devices which provide protection against " magic jar " spells or other forms of possession , and in weapons designed to affect ghost and similar creatures .
description_long: Chrysoberyl Chrysoberyl , also known as a cat ' s eye , was a hard , transparent , green gem , usually facet - cut . Description . This fancy stones were used in producing devices which provide protection against " magic jar " spells or other forms of possession , and in weapons designed to affect ghost and similar creatures . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Uses . A chrysoberyl gem could be used for short - range but very detailed scrying . For that reason , it was known as a " cat ' s eye " .

title: Chrysocolla
description: Chrysocolla Chrysocolla was a translucent variety of chalcedony , its blue - green to green color due to traces of copper . Description . These valuable ornamental stones had uniform color and no inclusions ( flaws caused by impurities ) .
description_long: Chrysocolla Chrysocolla was a translucent variety of chalcedony , its blue - green to green color due to traces of copper . Description . These valuable ornamental stones had uniform color and no inclusions ( flaws caused by impurities ) . Chrysocolla were most often tumbled but could be faceted for use as earrings and pendants . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp .

title: Chrysoprase
description: Chrysoprase Chrysoprase , also known as stormrock , was a translucent chalcedony with an apple - green color . Description . This semi - precious stone was found throughout the " Realms " but its greatest concentration was in the Stormhorn Mountains of Cormyr .
description_long: Chrysoprase Chrysoprase , also known as stormrock , was a translucent chalcedony with an apple - green color . Description . This semi - precious stone was found throughout the " Realms " but its greatest concentration was in the Stormhorn Mountains of Cormyr . Chrysoprase was used in the creation of items which provided " invisibility " and was used to ornament rings of invisibility . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp .

title: Chuchian
description: Chuchian Chuchian was a language spoken by the tribes of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands , those that dwelt along the border with Shou Lung and north of the Kora Shan . Related languages . Chuchian was of the Eastern Imaskari languages subgroup , which was in turn of the Imaskari languages family .
description_long: Chuchian Chuchian was a language spoken by the tribes of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands , those that dwelt along the border with Shou Lung and north of the Kora Shan . Related languages . Chuchian was of the Eastern Imaskari languages subgroup , which was in turn of the Imaskari languages family . These Eastern Imaskari tongues had been greatly influenced by Shou Chiang . Dialect . Each of the major tribes spoke their own dialect . The major tribes were the Fankiang , Kashghun , and Tsu - tsu , each with dialects named for them . The minor tribes of the Plain of Horses , namely the Guychiang , Igidujin , and T ' aghur s , adopted the dialect of the nearest major tribe with whom they were currently allied . These dialects changed as alliances shifted ; a keen ear could determine tribal politics by discerning which was used . Vocabulary . The vocabulary of Chuchian was very specific and precise . The Plainsmen considered general terms like " grass " , " tree " , or " place " as next - to - useless , even a bit insulting .

title: Chuhotl
description: Chuhotl Chuhotl was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Chuhotl was the son of Kichemel , a great Nexalan Eagle Knight .
description_long: Chuhotl Chuhotl was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Chuhotl was the son of Kichemel , a great Nexalan Eagle Knight . Kichemel was injured in 1361 DR during the ambush at Palul . Chuhotl and all his family managed to flee during the Night of Wailing . They retreated to south but Kichemel ordered Chuhotl to go east . He said to his son that when he proved worthy he would give him his Eagle Knight armor . Chuhotl decided to joined the Amn ians . He tried to ask for a crusade to destroy the Viperhands monsters . Personality . Chuhotl believed that only the Amnians could eradicate the evil that had taken root in the once - beautiful Nexal . However , they did not treat him with respect because they could not see the purity of his vision or the clarity of his soul . Chuhotl was proud to be a Nexalan . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Chuhotl is a pre - generated Maztican PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Chult
description: Chult Chult is located on an island in the southern part of the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Calimshan . Formerly , the land was located at the westernmost end of the Chultan peninsula . It is a mountainous jungle of savage beast s , hulking dinosaur s , and disease - ridden swamps .
description_long: Chult Chult is located on an island in the southern part of the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Calimshan . Formerly , the land was located at the westernmost end of the Chultan peninsula . It is a mountainous jungle of savage beast s , hulking dinosaur s , and disease - ridden swamps . Savage human tribes , goblin s , and even stranger monstrous folk haunt the thick jungles . Nevertheless , Chult draws adventurers who search for its legendary riches . The primordial Ubtao is almost exclusively revered in the land , for the divine powers of Faerûn awarded Ubtao the dominion over the land of Chult in exchange for the deity ' s vigilance over the threat from under the Peaks of Flame . Life and Society . The humans of Chult live in tribal communities , consisting of a dozen or so families , which move from one area to the next when the poor soil of the largely - jungle covered peninsula becomes depleted . For hunting and defence they rely on primitive non - metallic weapons like clubs , bows and shortspears . Harder metals like iron and steel are unavailable to them , and the few brought in by outsiders are nowhere near enough to sufficiently arm any number of people .

title: Chultan ( ethnicity )
description: Chultan ( ethnicity ) The term Chultan referred broadly to humans from the Chultan Peninsula , consisting primarily of members of the Tabaxi tribe . Description . Chultans were tall and had dark , ebony skin .
description_long: Chultan ( ethnicity ) The term Chultan referred broadly to humans from the Chultan Peninsula , consisting primarily of members of the Tabaxi tribe . Description . Chultans were tall and had dark , ebony skin . Chultans had adapted to the harsh climates of Chult and did not suffer the usual effects of heatstroke that most humans visiting that country endured . History . Chultans were originally from a continent southeast of Maztica and southwest of Zakhara , known only as " The Dark Continent " . In - 2809 DR , a group of tribes , including the Eshowe , the Tabaxi , and the Thinguth , traveled from their homes to Faerûn . These tribes were led by couatl s , who taught them about the god Ubtao . Upon arriving in Chult , they were met by Ubtao at the Peaks of Flame . The Thinguth settled in Thindol ; the other tribes populated the rest of the Chultan Peninsula . The Chultan holy city of Mezro was founded by Ubtao himself in - 2637 DR . In - 438 DR , a war erupted between the Tabaxi and Eshowe tribes that would continue for hundreds of years . In - 137 DR , the Eshowe unleashed Eshowdow , the " Shadow of the Eshowe " , and the ancient evil sacked Mezro .

title: Chultan Peninsula
description: Chultan Peninsula The Chultan Peninsula is the dominant area of Southwest Faerûn . It has an undeserved reputation of being a backward place with a complete lack of civilisation populated by savages . In fact , it boasts several large cities with stable governments that are all rife with culture .
description_long: Chultan Peninsula The Chultan Peninsula is the dominant area of Southwest Faerûn . It has an undeserved reputation of being a backward place with a complete lack of civilisation populated by savages . In fact , it boasts several large cities with stable governments that are all rife with culture . The Mhair Jungles mark the eastern end of the peninsula . After the events of the Spellplague , the Chultan Peninsula became an island . Nations . The peninsula contains four countries : Chult . The westernmost country of the Peninsula is a dangerous place , covered almost entirely by deadly jungle and infested with disease and dangerous monsters . Samarach . An isolationist vassal kingdom of Nimbral . Paths through the encapsulating mountain ranges are cloaked by powerful permanent illusions . Thindol . A country of mountains and tall grasses . Thindol is constantly under threat from the Yuan - ti and Kuo - toa from the waters both above and below ground . Tashalar . The only inviting country of the peninsula . Here , foreign traders are welcomed with open arms .

title: Chultan dwarf
description: Chultan dwarf Chultan dwarves were shield dwarves living in the vast mines of Chult . Description . The shield dwarves of Chult were albinos ; their hair and skin were white , and they had pink eyes .
description_long: Chultan dwarf Chultan dwarves were shield dwarves living in the vast mines of Chult . Description . The shield dwarves of Chult were albinos ; their hair and skin were white , and they had pink eyes . This meant that they were very sensitive to the hot sun of Chult and therefore only came above ground at night . Otherwise , they were physiologically like their northern cousins . Personality . Chultan dwarves were even more somber and grumpy on average than the shield dwarves of the north . They were not especially violent , but they would defend their homes and mines at any cost . Society . Most Chultan dwarves lived deep below the surface of Chult within one of its many mines full of gems , minerals , and ore . They made use of the dinosaur s of the surface as pack animals in their mining operations . Their culture revolved around the wealth of their subterranean mines , and they were superb craftsmen , particularly when working with gems and precious metals . Trade . Tabaxi superstitions equated the color white with death , so Chultan dwarves were often feared by the Chultan human s . Their usual trade partners were the Batiri goblin s from the Dimetrodon Clan .

title: Chultan language
description: Chultan language Chultan was a language group of south Faerûn and the main language of Chult and Samarach . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Calimshan , Lapaliiya , Nimbral , Tashalar , Tharsult , and Thindol . Tabaxi was the primary language of the Chultan language group .
description_long: Chultan language Chultan was a language group of south Faerûn and the main language of Chult and Samarach . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Calimshan , Lapaliiya , Nimbral , Tashalar , Tharsult , and Thindol . Tabaxi was the primary language of the Chultan language group . Speakers of Chultan used the Draconic alphabet .

title: Chuqali Shilai
description: Chuqali Shilai Chuqali Shilai was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Chuqali was the chieftain of the Fankiang tribe and the ruler of Li - Raz , the greatest city of the Plains .
description_long: Chuqali Shilai Chuqali Shilai was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Chuqali was the chieftain of the Fankiang tribe and the ruler of Li - Raz , the greatest city of the Plains . He truly believed that one day the Fankiang would rule all of the Plains . He tried to be fair - minded , but most administrative decisions were delegated to his subordinates . He was a skilled archer .

title: Church of Cyric
description: Church of Cyric The Church of Cyric was the organization dedicated to worshiping , as well as furthering the influence of , the deity Cyric . Regions . Waterdeep .
description_long: Church of Cyric The Church of Cyric was the organization dedicated to worshiping , as well as furthering the influence of , the deity Cyric . Regions . Waterdeep . Mount Waterdeep was a sacred site to the worshipers of Cyric as this was the location where he ascended . As such , many of Cyric ' s more fanatical followers would make regular pilgrimages to the city of Waterdeep .

title: Church of Dionysus
description: Church of Dionysus The Church of Dionysus was a temple of Ilmater dedicated to St . Dionysus . History .
description_long: Church of Dionysus The Church of Dionysus was a temple of Ilmater dedicated to St . Dionysus . History . Friar Dugald was a cleric of Ilmater and a member of the Order of St . Dionysus who adventured with Gareth Dragonsbane and his band . In their heroic adventures together , they liberated the Bloodstone Lands of Damara and Vaasa , slew Zhengyi the Witch - King , stole and destroyed the Wand of Orcus , and slew an avatar of Tiamat in the Abyss , before finally returning to Damara to rebuild in the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR . Dugald donated some of his share of the gold and gem s from Tiamat ' s hoard , over 1 million gold piece s , to the city of Goliad to be put into the construction of the Church of Dionysus . Although the money was donated anonymously , Dugald ' s identity was soon leaked — rather conveniently boosting his reputation . Some considered the Church ' s location to be a political move by Dugald and Baron ( later King ) Gareth to win over the people of Goliad and the Duchy of Brandiar , though none doubted Dugald ' s devotion .
