Owned by Arumn Gardpeck , it served pirates , merchants , fences , mercenaries , and all other sorts of colorful personalities . Notoriously dangerous , the Cutlass ' common room was renowned for the brawls that broke out and ended up turning fatal . This number increased so much so that the High Captain s instituted a " no weapons " policy in an attempt to steer business to safer venues . This was attempted to no avail as evidenced by the damages done to the inn after spell duels .

title: Cutlass of the Golden Gulf
description: Cutlass of the Golden Gulf The Cutlass of the Golden Gulf was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . It was favored by corsairs and other sailors . Powers .
description_long: Cutlass of the Golden Gulf The Cutlass of the Golden Gulf was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . It was favored by corsairs and other sailors . Powers . This weapon provided the wielder with small enhancements to their fighting skill , but its main power was that it allowed the wielder to breath underwater so long as the weapon was in their hand .

title: Cutter ( comic )
description: Cutter ( comic ) Cutter ( full name : Dungeons & Dragons : Cutter ) is a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos ' un and Doum ' wielle Armgo and the sentient sword " Khazid ' hea " ; it takes place just prior to " Night of the Hunter " . The story was written by R . A .
description_long: Cutter ( comic ) Cutter ( full name : Dungeons & Dragons : Cutter ) is a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos ' un and Doum ' wielle Armgo and the sentient sword " Khazid ' hea " ; it takes place just prior to " Night of the Hunter " . The story was written by R . A . Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore . The majority of the art was done by David Baldeon , with David Garcia Cruz ( colors ) and Neil Uyetake ( letters ) . Steve Ellis contributed cover art . Summary . Chapter 1 / Issue # 1 : " Birthright " . Tos ' un has been living in the Moonwood for a century with his family : Sinnafain , his elven wife , their son Teirflin , and their daughter Doum ' wielle . Tos ' un has been crippled by an orc ' s spear and his sword , " Khazid ' hea " , is ready to be passed on to an heir . The sun rises over a meadow as Teirflin asks his sister if she is ready . The two begin dueling as Tos ' un watches on , commenting on Doum ' wielle ' s skills to " Khazid ' hea " . " Khazid ' hea " is at first doubting , but admits it would be good to have no sister blade to compete with . Doum ' wielle gains the advantage and defeats Teirflin for the first time .

title: Cutter ( person )
description: Cutter ( person ) Lord Cutter , previously known as Ravendas , was a ruthless and power hungry agent of the Zhentarim and briefly the puppet tyrant of Iriaebor . History . After traveling to Baldur ' s Gate in order to learn martial skills , Ravendas ' s lust for power led her to Darkhold , where she sought membership in the Zhentarim .
description_long: Cutter ( person ) Lord Cutter , previously known as Ravendas , was a ruthless and power hungry agent of the Zhentarim and briefly the puppet tyrant of Iriaebor . History . After traveling to Baldur ' s Gate in order to learn martial skills , Ravendas ' s lust for power led her to Darkhold , where she sought membership in the Zhentarim . Sememmon himself gave her a task that she completed with ruthless efficiency , rising quickly through the organization ' s ranks . In about 1357 DR , the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon , which included her sister Kera and her lover Caledan , captured Ravendas after defeating her army at Hluthvar . Once she was alone with Kera , Ravendas convinced her Harper sister to release her and then strangled her with the bonds that previously held her . In 1363 DR , Cutter and her Zhentish forces conquered the city of Iriaebor , gaining control of the city and its trade routes . While looting Iriaebor of its valuables , Cutter sought and eventually found the crypt of the Shadowking deep beneath the city . Description . Cutter was beautiful and tall with pale skin , dusky eyes and pale gold hair cut to shoulder - length . Relationships .

title: Cutter ( ship )
description: Cutter ( ship ) The Cutter was a seal - hunting ship based near the Sea of Moving Ice . Crew . It was captained by Farlow , a black - bearded mercenary .
description_long: Cutter ( ship ) The Cutter was a seal - hunting ship based near the Sea of Moving Ice . Crew . It was captained by Farlow , a black - bearded mercenary . Other crewmembers were Narth and Darlson . History . In 1361 DR , the ship , carrying the secret Lord of Waterdeep Caladorn Cassalanter , ran into an abandoned ship holding crates of picked sea elves . The crew planned to bring the news to the Lords of Waterdeep , but they were intercepted by the " Elfmaid " and scuttled before they could explain . The crew was set adrift and the surviving crewmembers were rescued by the sea elf Xzorsh .

title: Cvaal Daoran
description: Cvaal Daoran Cvaal Daoran was an important member of the Zhentarim and a leader of the Brothers of the Black Fist who became the lord of Phlan and started the Shadowbane War . History . Cvaal was a member of the Zhentarim , from before the Time of Troubles .
description_long: Cvaal Daoran Cvaal Daoran was an important member of the Zhentarim and a leader of the Brothers of the Black Fist who became the lord of Phlan and started the Shadowbane War . History . Cvaal was a member of the Zhentarim , from before the Time of Troubles . After he become Hatemaster and captain of the Brothers of the Black Fist at the Citadel of the Raven devoting himself to the god Iyachtu Xvim . After the return of the god Bane , Cvaal commanded a Zhentilar army against Phlan in 1375 DR . In 1380 , Cvaal removed the Council of Ten from power in Phlan , installing himself as Lord Protector . In the same year , Fzoul Chembryl decided to ally the Zhentarim with the phaerimm and when the Shadovar protested , Cvaal killed one of the Princes of Shade , starting the Shadowbane War , where the Shadovar greatly weakened the Zhent forces . Cvaal survived the Zhentarim ' s defeat and even profited from this by distancing himself from the Zhent leaders , focusing only on the activities of Phlan . Successful , he and his descendants remained Lords of Phlan until before the Tyranny of Dragons .

title: Cybriana
description: Cybriana Cybriana was a female half - elf magic - user from Shadowdale in the Dalelands . Personality . Cybriana had great goodness in her soul , enough to reject any evil in her makeup .
description_long: Cybriana Cybriana was a female half - elf magic - user from Shadowdale in the Dalelands . Personality . Cybriana had great goodness in her soul , enough to reject any evil in her makeup . She was an innocent . She had a gentle nature , but she was courageous in the face of danger and against those who tormented the weak , whom she was quick to care for and defend . She was playful , for example splashing Timoth with water when they found a pool of fresh water . Description . Cybriana was a slender and beautiful half - elf woman with pointed ears , identical in form to Kilili . She had pale skin , long , curly blonde hair , and blue eyes . She wore a single white star earring from her left ear . She wore a green and brown dress and boots , trimmed with white fur , with brown straps on her left arm and a green glove on her right . Under the effects of the crystal curse , parts of Cybriana ' s body were transformed into pink crystal . This began at her fingers and extended up her arms to her shoulders every time she cast a spell . These parts were as hard as rock but remained flexible and did not seem to hamper her movement . These glowed with proximity to " Selûne ' s Eye " .

title: Cyclops
description: Cyclops Cyclopes were evil , one - eyed giant s that originally came from the Feywild . Description . Cyclopes were one of the smallest types of giants , standing only twelve feet ( four meters ) and weighing 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) , but they were as strong as the average stone giant .
description_long: Cyclops Cyclopes were evil , one - eyed giant s that originally came from the Feywild . Description . Cyclopes were one of the smallest types of giants , standing only twelve feet ( four meters ) and weighing 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) , but they were as strong as the average stone giant . Both males and females were bald and had spiked heads instead of hair . Cyclopes had earthy skin tones that blended with their surroundings . Some cyclops were depicted as having hair . The most peculiar and distinguishing thing about cyclopes was the fact that they only had one large eye in the middle of their foreheads . It tended to be the same as the color of their skin . This eye was rumored to cause fear in any who looked at it . Their single eye gave them poor depth perception , however , and therefore they couldn ' t use missile weapons very well . Abilities . Cyclopes could throw boulders like all giant - kin , but with less accuracy than normal because of their single eye . They had great strength and make excellent warriors , but they were also very intelligent and made good wizards and clerics .

title: Cyclopskin
description: Cyclopskin A cyclopskin is smaller version of a cyclops . Physical description . Typical cyclopskin stands 7 .
description_long: Cyclopskin A cyclopskin is smaller version of a cyclops . Physical description . Typical cyclopskin stands 7 . 5 ft ( 2 . 3 m ) and weights 350 lb ( 158 . 8 kg ) . These one - eyed monsters have poor depth perception and do not use missile weapons very well . Combat . In combat , most cyclopskin prefer to use club s or bardiche polearm s and dress in dirty garments of animal hide . Unlike all giant - kin , cyclopskin cannot throw boulders , because they are less accurate having only a single eye . Ecology . Most cyclopskin live alone or travel in small bands looking for prey and suitable captives . A number of such bands lived in Starspur in the Starspire Mountains of Tethyr . History . All cyclopskin believed they descended from the strong line of Annam , but most giants suspected these runts came from one of Othea affairs .

title: Cylyria Dragonbreast
description: Cylyria Dragonbreast High Lady Cylyria Dragonbreast was a member of the Harpers and the ruler of the city of Berdusk . Activities . Cylyria encouraged the city in a manner to maintain it as a peaceful haven for trade and negotiation , while keeping it firmly rooted in the Lords ' Alliance and maintaining the Harpers ' strength within .
description_long: Cylyria Dragonbreast High Lady Cylyria Dragonbreast was a member of the Harpers and the ruler of the city of Berdusk . Activities . Cylyria encouraged the city in a manner to maintain it as a peaceful haven for trade and negotiation , while keeping it firmly rooted in the Lords ' Alliance and maintaining the Harpers ' strength within .

title: Cymbals
description: Cymbals Cymbals were a percussion instrument played in the continent of Zakhara . They were also used by rock gnome s and in certain Khazari monasteries . Description .
description_long: Cymbals Cymbals were a percussion instrument played in the continent of Zakhara . They were also used by rock gnome s and in certain Khazari monasteries . Description . Cymbals consisted of two round thin plates made of brass , which were slammed together to produce sound . A pair of cymbals typically had a diameter of 18 inches , weighed four pounds and costed 20 gp . A smaller version called finger cymbals was also used in Zakhara .

title: Cymmarraa
description: Cymmarraa Cymmarraa was a young wizard who was once Manshoon ' s apprentice and lover , as were her sisters and her mother . Elminster used her to spy on Manshoon while he was lord of Westgate . He placed a powerful spell on Cymmarraa which prevented her from dying .
description_long: Cymmarraa Cymmarraa was a young wizard who was once Manshoon ' s apprentice and lover , as were her sisters and her mother . Elminster used her to spy on Manshoon while he was lord of Westgate . He placed a powerful spell on Cymmarraa which prevented her from dying . Unfortunately , for Cymmarraa , the spell turned out to be a curse . Manshoon sent Cymmarraa ' s mother and sisters to battle Elminster and they were all slain . He then literally stabbed Cymmarraa in the back , but , because of the spell Elminster placed on her , she was unable to die . Caught between life and death , with a dagger in her chest she was unable to remove without becoming undead , Cymmarraa spent the decades after the Spellplague plotting revenge on both Elminster and Manshoon . She managed to accumulate numerous Blueflame items and hoped to use the ghosts contained within to kill El and Manshoon . Cymmarraa traveled to Suzail where she killed the young noble Marlin Stormserpent and took the two Blueflame items he owned . She was destroyed in Shadowdale by the Simbul in 1479 DR . Appearance . Cymmarraa had white skin and large dark eyes . The dagger Manshoon stabbed her with stuck out from her chest .

title: Cynda
description: Cynda Cynda was a halfling ranger and the twin sister of Shan . She was also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak .
description_long: Cynda Cynda was a halfling ranger and the twin sister of Shan . She was also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak . Shan communicated with her sister using sign language . Description . Cynda had long auburn and a large scar on her throat where her vocal cord had been cut . Possessions . Like her sister , Cynda wore leather armor and used a short sword . She also carried darts to throw at her opponents . History . Cynda and Shan found many adventures together prior to joining the circus . After the circus was attacked by minotaur warriors from Calimport , Cynda and her sister traveled with Cephas and Corvus Nightfeather to Almraiven . Cynda was abducted in Almraiven by two firesoul genasi and teleported to Calimport where she was forced to fight in the arena . Shan traveled with Corvus and Cephas to Calimport where Cephas was reunited with his father the Pasha but Shan was sent to the gladiator stables . The Pasha scheduled a fight between Cynda and Shan and made it the main event .

title: Cynosure
description: Cynosure Cynosure , also known as the Outlands , is a small plane located very close - cosmologically speaking - to Toril . It is a plane only accessible to deities , and they can only access it from within their own domains . The plane is considered neutral ground by all the powers of Faerûn , and the plane is used as a meeting ground to settle disputes and decide upon punishments for those deities who upset the Balance ( as defined by the guidelines Ao left ) .
description_long: Cynosure Cynosure , also known as the Outlands , is a small plane located very close - cosmologically speaking - to Toril . It is a plane only accessible to deities , and they can only access it from within their own domains . The plane is considered neutral ground by all the powers of Faerûn , and the plane is used as a meeting ground to settle disputes and decide upon punishments for those deities who upset the Balance ( as defined by the guidelines Ao left ) . The only way in and out of Cynosure is through the portal s leading to each deities realm , and it cannot be accessed by spells that normally allow planar travel , so the plane cannot be used as a way station as Toril can . There can at times be several deities meeting in Cynosure , and yet other times the demi - plane lies empty for extended periods of time . While portals from Cynosure lead to the realms of the Elemental Lord s , none of them have ever been known to appear on the meeting plane .

title: Cyrag Hammerbone
description: Cyrag Hammerbone Cyrag Hammerbone was a dwarf of Illefarn circa 1363 DR . History . Cyrag was a veteran warrior in the High Moor before joining the reconstruction effort in Illefarn .
description_long: Cyrag Hammerbone Cyrag Hammerbone was a dwarf of Illefarn circa 1363 DR . History . Cyrag was a veteran warrior in the High Moor before joining the reconstruction effort in Illefarn . In 1363 DR , he was chosen to lead the Illefarn troops during the Second Dragonspear War .

title: Cyriana Rhindaun
description: Cyriana Rhindaun Her Highness Princess Cyriana Raisa Marela Vajra Eralea Rhindaun was the second daughter and third child of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III of Tethyr . Officially , she was the Princess of Ankramir and the third heir to the throne . Description .
description_long: Cyriana Rhindaun Her Highness Princess Cyriana Raisa Marela Vajra Eralea Rhindaun was the second daughter and third child of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III of Tethyr . Officially , she was the Princess of Ankramir and the third heir to the throne . Description . One of a set of triplets , Cyriana was unique among the royal children in that she had golden eyes . For this she was seen by the Queen ' s Minister , Lady Harlaa Assumbar , priestess of Siamorphe , as sacred to her goddess and destined to be a great prophetess . Relationships . Princess Cyriana ' s regent was Vajra Valmeyjar , Duchess of Ankaram . History . Cyriana and her two siblings were born in the month of Flamerule in 1370 DR . This was the first time there had been royal triplets in Tethyr since the reign of Queen Alisande Bormul in 832 DR . Rumors and Legends . Several organizations had made plans to kidnap the princess , because of her golden eyes . The church of Cyric in Amn and the Banites following Iyachtu Xvim in Mintar were two such groups . In each case , there were prophecies of their downfall being caused by a golden - eyed child .

title: Cyriana Rhindaun II
description: Cyriana Rhindaun II Cyriana Rhindaun II was the fourth queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the third queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Cyriana was the daughter of Prince Nishan and the niece of Queen Zaranda II .
description_long: Cyriana Rhindaun II Cyriana Rhindaun II was the fourth queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the third queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Cyriana was the daughter of Prince Nishan and the niece of Queen Zaranda II . She was married to Errilam II . History . Cyriana was crowned as Cyriana III in 1445 DR . At some point during her reign , Cyriana and her husband ' s life were saved from assassins by Vajra Safahr , Vajra ' s father , and Mynda Gyrfalcon - Thann .

title: Cyric
description: Cyric Cyric ( pronounced " SEER - ick " ) , whose titles included The Lord of Three Crowns , The Mad God , and The Prince of Lies , was the monomaniacal deity of strife and lies with an immense following , though after he murdered Mystra and caused the Spellplague , his faith diminished somewhat . He was petty and self - centered , and enjoyed misleading individuals of all inclinations so that they performed acts that ruined their lives or so that they made fatal mistakes . Cyric was closely associated with the essence of murder , conflict , lies , intrigue , and illusions .
description_long: Cyric Cyric ( pronounced " SEER - ick " ) , whose titles included The Lord of Three Crowns , The Mad God , and The Prince of Lies , was the monomaniacal deity of strife and lies with an immense following , though after he murdered Mystra and caused the Spellplague , his faith diminished somewhat . He was petty and self - centered , and enjoyed misleading individuals of all inclinations so that they performed acts that ruined their lives or so that they made fatal mistakes . Cyric was closely associated with the essence of murder , conflict , lies , intrigue , and illusions . Cyric was recognized in Faerûn by his symbol , a white jawless skull on a black or purple sunburst , and his alignment was chaotic evil . He was a greater power , who ruled supreme in his divine realm , the Supreme Throne . Gugari worshipers knew Cyric as Sirhivatizangpo and he was called N ' esr by the Bedine . Relationships . Cyric hated most of the other deities of Toril , but he particularly loathed Mystra , Kelemvor , and Bane . Cyric had no divine allies , but he made himself a wide variety of enemies .

title: Cyrinishad
description: Cyrinishad The Cyrinishad is an unholy tome created by Rinda the Scribe under the forced divine guidance of Cyric . Creation . The tome was made for the sole purpose to increase Cyric ' s power in Faerûn .
description_long: Cyrinishad The Cyrinishad is an unholy tome created by Rinda the Scribe under the forced divine guidance of Cyric . Creation . The tome was made for the sole purpose to increase Cyric ' s power in Faerûn . After the Time of Troubles the power of a deity is directly related to the size and devotion of their worshipers . The tome will turn anyone reading it into a devout worshiper of Cyric and thus increase Cyric ' s power . The tome is of great power and once you start reading you cannot willingly stop , and it even works against other deities . The final version of the Cyrinishad was the 398th version , and all the previous authors had suffered greatly for their failure to satisfy Cyric . Appearance . The book is made of raven - black leather , embossed with a pattern of small grinning skulls and sunbursts against a twisting , warped background of torture and chaos . The book has golden hinges and clasps , and it is closed with a lock of unbreakable metal . A skull the size of a child ' s fist dominates the front cover , the skull is animated by Rinda ' s blood and is the guardian of the book , preventing it from being destroyed or removed from the mortal realms . History .

title: Cyrrollalee
description: Cyrrollalee Cyrrollalee ( seer - oh - lah - lee ) is the halfling deity of Friendship , trust and hospitality as well as an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . Her symbol ( an open door ) shows the two way path that halflings should take : leave the door open to welcome friends and have a look outdoor to discover new places in Faerûn . Worshipers .
description_long: Cyrrollalee Cyrrollalee ( seer - oh - lah - lee ) is the halfling deity of Friendship , trust and hospitality as well as an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . Her symbol ( an open door ) shows the two way path that halflings should take : leave the door open to welcome friends and have a look outdoor to discover new places in Faerûn . Worshipers . Artisans , cooks , guards , halflings , hosts , innkeepers .

title: Cyrvisnea
description: Cyrvisnea Cyrvisnea was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Cyrvisnea along with Sythillis , her mate , led a goblinoid army with hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric on an assault on southern Amn as a part of the Sothillisian War .
description_long: Cyrvisnea Cyrvisnea was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Cyrvisnea along with Sythillis , her mate , led a goblinoid army with hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric on an assault on southern Amn as a part of the Sothillisian War . The end of this endeavor led with the capturing of gold from Maztica in Murann . In 1374 DR , the army was still occupying the city of Murann .

title: Cythandria
description: Cythandria Cythandria was a female half - elf wizard and a member of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . After the death of Tamoko , Cythandria became the lover of Sarevok Anchev in order to rise through the ranks .
description_long: Cythandria Cythandria was a female half - elf wizard and a member of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . After the death of Tamoko , Cythandria became the lover of Sarevok Anchev in order to rise through the ranks . She confronted Gorion ' s Ward at the top of the Iron Throne headquarters .

title: D ' tarig
description: D ' tarig D ' tarig were a race of human s inhabiting the Anauroch desert . Description . The average D ' tarig stood little more than four feet ( 122 cm ) tall .
description_long: D ' tarig D ' tarig were a race of human s inhabiting the Anauroch desert . Description . The average D ' tarig stood little more than four feet ( 122 cm ) tall . They had somewhat puggish noses and wrinkled brows . D ' tarig dressed in white and wore turbans . On their feet , they often wore special widened sandals designed to make walking atop sand easier . They usually covered their mouths with cloth so that only their nose and eyes were visible . While the Bedine tribes were perhaps more ( in ) famous , it was actually more likely for an outsider to the great desert to encounter a D ' tarig tribesman than a Bedine one . Personality . D ' tarig tended to be proud and boastful about their expertise of desert survival , making claims that were far from the truth . They were a naturally suspicious people , and because of this believed that they were immune to trickery , yet they were expert tricksters themselves . They typically had back - up plans and back - up plans for their back - up plans , so as not to be caught . They tended to selfishness , sometimes cruelty , and cowardice , but they were not without a sense of humor .

title: Daardendrien Balasar
description: Daardendrien Balasar Daardendrien Balasar was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a close friend of the paladin Medrash and Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon , and the lover of Biri . He was a high - ranking member of the Lance Defenders .
description_long: Daardendrien Balasar Daardendrien Balasar was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a close friend of the paladin Medrash and Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon , and the lover of Biri . He was a high - ranking member of the Lance Defenders . Description . Balasar was runt for a dragonborn , and had red eyes and ocher colored scales . Abilities . He was capable of breathe frosth . Personality . Balasar was described as frivolous , inmutare and irresponsible . Like most dragonborn , Balasar didn ' t followed the teachings of any deity . History . In 1479 DR , Balasar was sent to Luthcheq as member of a diplomatic party sent to assist ambassador Perra . He helped the Brotherhood of the Griffon track down and expose a group of abishai killers disguised as dragonborn . Soon after , the thymari diplomatic delegation was kicked out of Chessenta and Balasar was forced to return to Tymanther . During the travel back home , a topaz " taaldarax " ( one of the players of Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " ) attacked Perra and her delegation , but with the help of Medrash , Khouryn , and his men , the dragonborn were able to drive away the dragon .

title: Daardendrien Medrash
description: Daardendrien Medrash Daardendrien Medrash was a dragonborn member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a paladin of Torm , and later a follower of Bahamut . He was a good friend of the warrior Balasar .
description_long: Daardendrien Medrash Daardendrien Medrash was a dragonborn member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a paladin of Torm , and later a follower of Bahamut . He was a good friend of the warrior Balasar . He was a high - ranking member of the Lance Defenders . Description . Medrash had yellow eyes and russet colored scales . Abilities . He was capable of breathe lightning . Medrash was also blessed by both Torm and Bahamut , and was able to channel the divine magic of both deities at the same time . History . As a child , Medrash was timid and weak , a shame for his clan . In his youth , he saw Torm in dreams , exhorting him to push his limits . Craving for something that would gave a sense of purpose to his life , Medrash began to follow his dreams , and joined the military forces of Tymanther , eventually becoming one the finest warriors of Clan Daardendrien . In one of his journeys , he came across a temple of Torm and recognized the statues of the god . He asked the tormites to train him as a paladin , and they accepted . Clan Daardendrien didn ' t expelled him due to his reverence of a god because they saw his abilities as a paladin useful .

title: Dabron Sashenstar
description: Dabron Sashenstar Dabron Sashenstar was a male human fighter , ranger , and merchant prince of the city of Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast in the mid – 14th century DR . He was an aristocrat and leader of House Sashenstar and he also owned and led the Merchant ’ s League based in the city . He was a renowned explorer , who journeyed across the Great Glacier and mapped a trade route to the fabled realm of Sossal .
description_long: Dabron Sashenstar Dabron Sashenstar was a male human fighter , ranger , and merchant prince of the city of Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast in the mid – 14th century DR . He was an aristocrat and leader of House Sashenstar and he also owned and led the Merchant ’ s League based in the city . He was a renowned explorer , who journeyed across the Great Glacier and mapped a trade route to the fabled realm of Sossal . History . Expedition to the Great Glacier . Dabron Sashenstar was born to House Sashenstar and into the merchant aristocracy of Baldur ' s Gate . He was a favored scion of the house . In the 1350s DR , Dabron Sashenstar left Baldur ' s Gate and made an exploratory journey into Faerûn ' s far northeast in an expedition sponsored by the Merchant ' s League , which was headed by House Sashenstar . He endured freezing temperatures and other hazards , crossed the Great Glacier , and reached the near - legendary kingdom of Sossal in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . He had successfully charted a path through the glaciers of the north and became the first westerner to visit and detail the country of the Sossrim .

title: Dabus
description: Dabus The dabus are a race unique to Sigil and are the personal entourage of the Lady of Pain . Dabus are humanoids with white hair , goatlike horns and yellow - tan skin . They float inches above the ground , their feet never touching the earth .
description_long: Dabus The dabus are a race unique to Sigil and are the personal entourage of the Lady of Pain . Dabus are humanoids with white hair , goatlike horns and yellow - tan skin . They float inches above the ground , their feet never touching the earth . The dabus speak only through visual rebuses , with symbols that materialize and fill the air above their heads . They can understand spoken language . Dabus do not have names . The dabus report to and follow to the letter the unspoken orders of the Lady of Pain . They are routinely found maintaining the city of Sigil , building walls , destroying buildings , paving streets , maintaining portals according to the Lady ' s wishes . Despite the dabus ' patient nature , interrupting or standing in the way of their work is a risky affair that may land one in one of the Lady ' s mazes .

title: Dace Sontan
description: Dace Sontan Dace Sontan was the coordinator of the Spellhold prison in Amn , and the architect of the maze below it , where the sanity of the inmates of that asylum was tested . History . In 1369 DR , when Jon Irenicus and Bodhi took over Spellhold , the latter turned Dace into a vampire and ordered him to wait for Gorion ' s Ward in the dungeon under the prison .
description_long: Dace Sontan Dace Sontan was the coordinator of the Spellhold prison in Amn , and the architect of the maze below it , where the sanity of the inmates of that asylum was tested . History . In 1369 DR , when Jon Irenicus and Bodhi took over Spellhold , the latter turned Dace into a vampire and ordered him to wait for Gorion ' s Ward in the dungeon under the prison . Later , Gorion ' s Ward and their party destroyed Dace and used his severed hand to open the wards of the first level of the maze .

title: Dackto
description: Dackto Dackto was a Maztican drider . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .
description_long: Dackto Dackto was a Maztican drider . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History . In 1361 DR , after the Night of Wailing , Dackto was one of the many drow who survived and were transformed into driders by Lolth . He died at the hands of the Itza during the advance of Darien ' s army of giant ant s .

title: Daeghun Farlong
description: Daeghun Farlong Daeghun Farlong was a male elven inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Personality . Following his wife ' s death , Daeghun was grim and harsh , especially to his foster child , the Kalach - Cha .
description_long: Daeghun Farlong Daeghun Farlong was a male elven inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Personality . Following his wife ' s death , Daeghun was grim and harsh , especially to his foster child , the Kalach - Cha . He expects his orders to be respected and completed . Nevertheless , he was shown to be sensitive , as he defended the Kalach - Cha from being attacked by the undead and went to search for his foster child after the attack on the Mere of Merdalain . Abilities . An eminently skilled ranger , Daeghun was considered to be one of the finest archers around the Mere of Dead Men . He favored the use of the longbow in combat and was not above using poison on his arrows . Activities . Daeghun often went into the swamp to hunt animals , to trade their fur with the merchants . He attended the Archery Contest at the Harvest Fair . Finally , he joined the defense at Crossroad Keep , to scout out the enemy . Relationships . He was the adoptive father of the Kalach - Cha , and the half - brother of Duncan . History . Early Life . Daeghun was a scout of West Harbor , who was skilled with the bow .

title: Daelan Red Tiger
description: Daelan Red Tiger Daelan Red Tiger is a male half - orc barbarian raised by the Uthgardt tribe of the Red Tiger . He is an honorable warrior out to prove himself in the world , hoping to amend for his father ' s orc blood , and to end the exile by his tribe . He carries a spectacular double - axe and also has a longbow for a ranged weapon , and makes a powerful tank for the player .
description_long: Daelan Red Tiger Daelan Red Tiger is a male half - orc barbarian raised by the Uthgardt tribe of the Red Tiger . He is an honorable warrior out to prove himself in the world , hoping to amend for his father ' s orc blood , and to end the exile by his tribe . He carries a spectacular double - axe and also has a longbow for a ranged weapon , and makes a powerful tank for the player . Daelan is also available in Chapter 1 of " " as a henchman , but is prohibited from following you into Chapter 2 by Halaster . He became one of the most popular henchman in the original Neverwinter Nights for many fans .

title: Daelegoth Orndeir
description: Daelegoth Orndeir Daelegoth Orndeir was a leader of the Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun as well as major proponent behind recent growth of belief in the Risen Sun heresy . Background . Born the only son of Morninglord Hatthala Orndeir , Daelegoth quickly embraced the ideologies of Lathander and rose quickly in the ranks of the church .
description_long: Daelegoth Orndeir Daelegoth Orndeir was a leader of the Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun as well as major proponent behind recent growth of belief in the Risen Sun heresy . Background . Born the only son of Morninglord Hatthala Orndeir , Daelegoth quickly embraced the ideologies of Lathander and rose quickly in the ranks of the church . While investigating the connection between a holy site of Lathander and the legacy of Amaunator , he quickly began to believe that Lathander was Amaunator reborn . This led to his joining of the Brotherhood . Upon assuming his mother ' s power and position of archbishop of the Dragon Coast after his mother ' s death in 1370 DR , Daelegoth began to canonize the Risen Sun heresy within the church of Lathander . This led to a brewing conflict between Daelegoth , the Brotherhood , and the more traditional members of the church of Lathander . Abilities . Daelegoth had the ability to cast the epic spell " Amaunator ' s Eternal Sun " . Possessions . Among Daelegoth ' s possessions were a " + 2 periapt of wisdom " and a holy symbol of Amaunator made of gold . He also wielded " Shadowsmite " and " Sunshield " , a mace and a shield respectively .

title: Daelyth ' s Dagger
description: Daelyth ' s Dagger Daelyth ' s Dagger was a deep dell in the Lost Peaks with old fortifications . Its lower entrance was a narrow path alongside a stream that was only wide enough for one humanoid to walk along , with steep rock sides . Its upper entrance was a steep trail leading higher up into the mountains .
description_long: Daelyth ' s Dagger Daelyth ' s Dagger was a deep dell in the Lost Peaks with old fortifications . Its lower entrance was a narrow path alongside a stream that was only wide enough for one humanoid to walk along , with steep rock sides . Its upper entrance was a steep trail leading higher up into the mountains . There was also a secret cavern leading to neighbouring valleys .

title: Daemonfey
description: Daemonfey The Daemonfey are a clan of half - fiend s and fey ' ri who were imprisoned for over five thousand years and were freed in recent times . Although the term actually describes the organization , it is sometimes also used to mean the descendants of House Dlardrageth , who have royal demonic blood , and conversely the term " fey ' ri " is sometimes used to describe the descendants of the other corrupted houses of Siluvanede . History .
description_long: Daemonfey The Daemonfey are a clan of half - fiend s and fey ' ri who were imprisoned for over five thousand years and were freed in recent times . Although the term actually describes the organization , it is sometimes also used to mean the descendants of House Dlardrageth , who have royal demonic blood , and conversely the term " fey ' ri " is sometimes used to describe the descendants of the other corrupted houses of Siluvanede . History . In the former elven realm of Arcorar ( located in what would become Cormanthyr ) , House Dlardrageth began summoning demons to produce half - field offspring in a bid to strengthen their bloodline and succeeded and were killed by other elves , who were enraged over this practice . The surviving half - fiend offspring of House Dlardrageth fled to Siluvanede , around - 5000 DR . They brought with them their practice of producing half - fiends into their new home , where it was more readily accepted than in Arcorar , though it was only practiced in secret . The background for this readiness was , that the elves from Siluvanede had a uniquely bad view on the Seldarine .

title: Daerlun
description: Daerlun Daerlun was a city in Sembia . Its most prominent feature was a huge 500 - foot - tall curtain wall erected by the Netherese Empire . Government .
description_long: Daerlun Daerlun was a city in Sembia . Its most prominent feature was a huge 500 - foot - tall curtain wall erected by the Netherese Empire . Government . 1368 DR . The city was run by an elderly merchant named Halath Tymmyr , although he was a puppet for the evil commander of the guard , Allathast , who was a member of the Cult of the Dragon . 1439 DR . After Sembian control faltered due to Cormyr ian stratagems , the city declared itself an independent city - state , rather than being absorbed by Cormyr . 1484 . The city of Daerlun prepared defenses against a possible Shadovar and Sembian invasion . Rumors abounded in the city about gods , war , and natural disasters . Trade . As of 1368 DR , Daerlunian linen sold for around 8 silver pieces per square yard , while Daerlunian wool sold for between 9 silver and 2 gold pieces per square yard depending on the weight of the fabric . The city imported such commodities as parchment , wine , and wool from Eveningstar in Cormyr . Cult of the Dragon .

title: Daern
description: Daern Daern of Hawksroost was a warrior from the village of Hawksroost in the Ride in the late 13th and early 14th centuries DR . History . Daern became a devoted companion of Flaergon of Glister , a priest of Ilmater who dedicated himself to assisting miners and caravan - workers in the frozen north of the Moonsea lands .
description_long: Daern Daern of Hawksroost was a warrior from the village of Hawksroost in the Ride in the late 13th and early 14th centuries DR . History . Daern became a devoted companion of Flaergon of Glister , a priest of Ilmater who dedicated himself to assisting miners and caravan - workers in the frozen north of the Moonsea lands . Flaergon was also the bearer of the " Tome of Torment " , one of holiest books of the Ilmatari faith . After Flaergon died of a fall in a chasm near Whitehorn in the Year of the Claw , 1299 DR , Daern took the " Tome of Torment " across all of Faerûn back to the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan . Daern presented the " Tome " to the High Mistress of Worthy Suffering , Althea the Abased . Daern ' s devotion so moved Althea that she named him an honorary Brother of the temple . Daern became Althea ' s personal bodyguard , but his duties consisted largely of carrying the frail , crippled priestess around . Althea the Abased finally passed on in the Year of the Gate , 1341 DR , and Daern mourned her passing . He was given a new role as Guardian of the Tome , defending the artifact he ' d once traveled so far to deliver .

title: Daffir
description: Daffir Daffir the Prescient was a human member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath . History . Daffir was a human wizard diviner hailing from south Faerûn .
description_long: Daffir Daffir the Prescient was a human member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath . History . Daffir was a human wizard diviner hailing from south Faerûn . In 1377 DR , he was one of the members of the College of Divination sent to join the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee who planned to attack the main temple of Kiaransalee . In the Acropolis of Thanatos Daffir found a gate and sensing his destiny inside entered into . He emerged in the Demonweb Pits where he was killed by some monsters . Later Cavatina Xarann found his body in her escape from the Abyss .

title: Daffyd
description: Daffyd Daffyd was a stonemason who lived in Gracklstugh . He believed he was a Morndin of Clan Ironstar . Description .
description_long: Daffyd Daffyd was a stonemason who lived in Gracklstugh . He believed he was a Morndin of Clan Ironstar . Description . Daffyd had red beard braided in dwarven style . Equiment . Daffyd had inherited an Ironstar mace . History . Daffyd was the son of merchants from Hammergate . He left his family when he was able to use an Ironstar mace his father had bought to an old dwarf , as Daffyd believe he was one of the fabled Morndin . He went to the north were he became the apprentice of the stonemason Ryordin Hammerfist . He later accompanied the twin dwarves Gamlin and Farrik to an unlucky expedition to Araumycos to get rock gourd s , were he meet another Morndin , Rook . Daffyd claimed he was the true creator of the motedisc , and that Ryordin only merit was to stole the idea from him .

title: Daftar
description: Daftar A daftar was a Zakharan captain ' s most treasured item . Uses . Daftar comprised instructions , tables , charts , etc .
description_long: Daftar A daftar was a Zakharan captain ' s most treasured item . Uses . Daftar comprised instructions , tables , charts , etc . compiled over years of sailing the seas of the Land of Fate . A captain without their daftar found himself at a sad disadvantage while at sea . They were often jealously guarded and could never be purchased .

title: Dag Nost
description: Dag Nost The Dag Nost were a fairly large tribe of Nar found in Narfell that measured 3 , 200 strong in 1357 DR . Activities . Many travelers in and around Narfell considered the Dag Nost to be the most civilized of the Nar tribes .
description_long: Dag Nost The Dag Nost were a fairly large tribe of Nar found in Narfell that measured 3 , 200 strong in 1357 DR . Activities . Many travelers in and around Narfell considered the Dag Nost to be the most civilized of the Nar tribes . Some members made yearly visits to the Impilturian village of Uthmerg to hone their bargaining skills before the Trade Fair . Base of Operations . The tribe made their home in southern Narfell along the fringes of the Rawlinswood . They were known to range as far south as the Forest of Lethyr .

title: Dag Zoreth
description: Dag Zoreth Dag Zoreth , born Brandon Caradoon , is a priest of Cyric and the estranged brother of Bronwyn Caradoon . Dag was captured by the Zhentarim when he was a young boy and raised into the ways of evil . This was despite the fact that he was the son of a paladin .
description_long: Dag Zoreth Dag Zoreth , born Brandon Caradoon , is a priest of Cyric and the estranged brother of Bronwyn Caradoon . Dag was captured by the Zhentarim when he was a young boy and raised into the ways of evil . This was despite the fact that he was the son of a paladin . Eventually , Dag Zoreth would mastermind the attack on his father ' s keep and murder him in a sacrifice to the Dark Sun . Family . Dag Zoreth had a half - elven child by the elf Ashemmi , Cara . She is currently being raised by Bronwyn .

title: Dagagoorg
description: Dagagoorg Dagagoorg was a kuo - toa who was both the king of Sloopdilmonpolop and the high priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Dagagoorg was totally crazy : he believed he ruled over a vast empire in Underdark and the seas above .
description_long: Dagagoorg Dagagoorg was a kuo - toa who was both the king of Sloopdilmonpolop and the high priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Dagagoorg was totally crazy : he believed he ruled over a vast empire in Underdark and the seas above . Dagagoorg saw all creatures as fellow kuo - toa , whatever they really were . In his rare moments of lucidity , when he saw other creatures in their true form , he considered them enemy infiltrators and ordered pogroms against them . He also considered the Cephalopolop as an incarnation of Blibdoolpoolp . History . Va - Poolgol Dagagoorg was the nominal ruler of Sloopdilmonpolop but the true power was the Cephalopolop , because the Va - Poolgol , like most of his fellow kuo - toa , was crazy .

title: Dagan
description: Dagan Dagan , son of Belgin , blood of Jangarak was the last High Old One or high priest of Dumathoin in the lost dwarven kingdom of Thunderholme . He betrayed his people when the shadow dragon Aurgloroasa manipulated him into dedicating his newly anointed temple in the name of Null , the dragon god of death and undeath , and not his or his city ' s patron , Dumathoin . The priest then summoned Aurgloroasa , believing her to be an avatar of his deity .
description_long: Dagan Dagan , son of Belgin , blood of Jangarak was the last High Old One or high priest of Dumathoin in the lost dwarven kingdom of Thunderholme . He betrayed his people when the shadow dragon Aurgloroasa manipulated him into dedicating his newly anointed temple in the name of Null , the dragon god of death and undeath , and not his or his city ' s patron , Dumathoin . The priest then summoned Aurgloroasa , believing her to be an avatar of his deity . She then tore through the city slaying its inhabitants . The fate of Dagan was unknown , but it was assumed that he continued to serve her , likely as one of her undead minions .

title: Dagger
description: Dagger A dagger is a short , two - sided blade used for stabbing and thrusting . They are not as long as a short sword , but are larger than a common knife . Daggers are also easily thrown as improvised ranged weapons and are excellent for use in an off - hand for those who prefer dual - wielding melee weapons .
description_long: Dagger A dagger is a short , two - sided blade used for stabbing and thrusting . They are not as long as a short sword , but are larger than a common knife . Daggers are also easily thrown as improvised ranged weapons and are excellent for use in an off - hand for those who prefer dual - wielding melee weapons . Daggers are also sometimes used as implements by sorcerer s and cost 2 gp .

title: Dagger Falls
description: Dagger Falls Daggers Falls was a large , stone - walled town in the Daggerdale region of the Dalelands . The town was situated near a steep waterfall of the same name . Defenses .
description_long: Dagger Falls Daggers Falls was a large , stone - walled town in the Daggerdale region of the Dalelands . The town was situated near a steep waterfall of the same name . Defenses . Dagger Falls had a strong stone wall encompassing the town and whilst under the rule of Zhentil Keep boasted a garrison of 100 Zhentilar soldiers , 200 mercenaries , and roughly 130 Dalesmen reserves . Two gatehouses guarded the entrances to the town , holding 35 troops each , located by the northern forest gate and eastern river gate . History . The site was once used as a storage site for dwarven metals mined from the Desertsmouth Mountains to the east . As all cargo heading along the River Tesh needed to be unloaded before the Dagger Falls and reloaded on the other side it wasn ' t long before humans and other folk began coming to the site to trade with the dwarves . It was here that dwarven fortifications for the shipments sprang up and the beginnings of the village grew . Dagger Falls had long been the seat of power for Daggerdale if only by virtue of it being the largest settlement .

title: Dagger Hills
description: Dagger Hills The Dagger Hills were located south - east of Daggerdale . Description . In the mid – 14th century DR , the sparse human settlements , mostly small farms , dwindled during the Zhent occupation of Daggerdale and the hills became covered with dense thickets and thorn fields , resistant to fire and human intrusion .
description_long: Dagger Hills The Dagger Hills were located south - east of Daggerdale . Description . In the mid – 14th century DR , the sparse human settlements , mostly small farms , dwindled during the Zhent occupation of Daggerdale and the hills became covered with dense thickets and thorn fields , resistant to fire and human intrusion . Many monsters hunted in these hills : wolves , leucrotta s , owlbear s , lycanthrope s , and even beholder s . After the Spellplague , the lycanthrope presence became prominent and by 1479 DR these hills were infested mainly by murderous lycanthropes and their thralls . Despite the threat of the lycanthropes , small villages , protected by stockades , and farms still existed in the Dagger Hills . Locations . In the south - western part of the Dagger Hills , not far from the River Ashaba , lay the ruins of Castle Daggerdale , the seat of the ruling family of Daggerdale , the Morn s . During his heroic resistance against the Zhent occupation , Randal Morn often made camp here with his men . Rumors about the hidden treasure of the Morn family , hidden in a bricked tunnel in the cellar of Castle Daggerdale , abounded in Daggerdale .

title: Dagger of chaos
description: Dagger of chaos A dagger of chaos was a magic blade carrying a strange curse that transformed the wielder into many different forms . History . In the time of Netheril , the " dagger of chaos " was given to Serreg of Neverwinter by the god of war , Targus .
description_long: Dagger of chaos A dagger of chaos was a magic blade carrying a strange curse that transformed the wielder into many different forms . History . In the time of Netheril , the " dagger of chaos " was given to Serreg of Neverwinter by the god of war , Targus . Serreg was an archwizard serving Lady Polaris of Delia and investigating a mysterious blight on the land . He discovered it was the work of the phaerimm , and fled for his life . Praying to Targus for aid , he received the " dagger of chaos " . Polymorphing through several forms , Serreg slew the pursuing phaerimm . However , his final form was as a mighty dragon and he now cared nothing for mortal matters . Preferring his new form , he tore the dagger — now manifested as a claw — from his hand , used it as the beginning of his treasure hoard . Over time , the magic of the blade decayed — rather than transform the wielder , it transformed itself from time to time . Around the 14th century DR , it took the form of a greatsword , and was likely to stay this way for years . It surfaced in the North and in 1372 DR was being sold from Colmarr ' s Shop in Luskan . Powers . Original .

title: Dagger of defiance
description: Dagger of defiance A dagger of defiance is a magical dagger , first created in Myth Drannor , that grants the wielder an immunity to fear and repulsion , and enables the wielder to more easily resist the effects of enchantments , charms , polymorphs and petrification . Such a weapon requires a standard dagger , doppleganger blood , distilled essence of xorn flesh , and the casting of " fear " and " repulsion " spells . As of 1368 DR , the value of such a dagger was around 1 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Dagger of defiance A dagger of defiance is a magical dagger , first created in Myth Drannor , that grants the wielder an immunity to fear and repulsion , and enables the wielder to more easily resist the effects of enchantments , charms , polymorphs and petrification . Such a weapon requires a standard dagger , doppleganger blood , distilled essence of xorn flesh , and the casting of " fear " and " repulsion " spells . As of 1368 DR , the value of such a dagger was around 1 , 000 gold pieces . By 1372 DR , this was around 12 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Dagger of fiery demise
description: Dagger of fiery demise The dagger of fiery demise was a wicked magic weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . These daggers appeared to be slightly curved " jambiya s " .
description_long: Dagger of fiery demise The dagger of fiery demise was a wicked magic weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . These daggers appeared to be slightly curved " jambiya s " . Powers . When drawn from its sheath a " dagger of fiery demise " was cloaked with writhing blue flames . Wielding one during combat made it much easier for the wielder to strike their opponent . Anyone stabbed by the dagger was instantly engulfed in blue flames . Those who were not able to resist the dark magic were reduced to a pile of ash . These flames only affected the target of the strike , thus one killed by the dagger would not start a fire when the remains of their body fell to the ground . The strange blue fire not only incinerated the target ' s body , but also their soul , making any attempt at " raising " or " resurrecting " them impossible . Furthermore , using spells such as " speak with dead " upon the remains was utterly futile . A victim killed by the magic of this dagger could only be returned to life via a " wish " . The sinister power of the dagger only worked when the target was stabbed . Slashing at the target did not activate the power of the blue flames .

title: Dagger of quickness
description: Dagger of quickness Daggers of quickness were wonderful magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magic weapons could be found in many forms including common daggers , dirk s , " jambiya s " , knives , razors , and " katar s " .
description_long: Dagger of quickness Daggers of quickness were wonderful magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magic weapons could be found in many forms including common daggers , dirk s , " jambiya s " , knives , razors , and " katar s " . Powers . In addition to causing more physical harm than mundane daggers and bypassing armor more efficiently , " daggers of quickness " allowed their wielder to strike before any of their opponents , including when the dagger was thrown . This magic speed only applied to the beginning of combat .

title: Dagger of the Evil Eye
description: Dagger of the Evil Eye Daggers of the Evil Eye were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons could be found in any dagger form including jambiya s , dirk s , stiletto s , etc .
description_long: Dagger of the Evil Eye Daggers of the Evil Eye were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons could be found in any dagger form including jambiya s , dirk s , stiletto s , etc . Many other weapons in Zakhara could be cursed with the same effect , but daggers were by far the most common . Powers . Using this weapon during combat cursed the wielder with the evil eye . This curse could be removed by a rawun or through the " avert evil eye " spell but would strike again if the wielder used the dagger again in combat .

title: Dagger of truth
description: Dagger of truth Daggers of truth were cursed weapons that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . As with non - magical dagger s , these weapons were available in a wide variety of shapes and sizes .
description_long: Dagger of truth Daggers of truth were cursed weapons that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . As with non - magical dagger s , these weapons were available in a wide variety of shapes and sizes . Powers . " Daggers of truth " did make it easier for the wielder to strike their target . However , the curse of the weapon prevented the wielder from ever telling a lie .

title: Daggerdale
description: Daggerdale Daggerdale ( originally named Merrydale ) is a remote region of the Dalelands located between the Desertsmouth Mountains and the Dagger Hills . It is a region of dark forests and rocky hills with a single large settlement named Dagger Falls . Geography .
description_long: Daggerdale Daggerdale ( originally named Merrydale ) is a remote region of the Dalelands located between the Desertsmouth Mountains and the Dagger Hills . It is a region of dark forests and rocky hills with a single large settlement named Dagger Falls . Geography . A lightly wooded dale of rolling hills and perhaps one of the most unspoiled of landscapes among the Dalelands . Daggerdale is divided up by numerous rocky valleys and the few settled areas are centered around the town of Dagger Falls . Defenses . Since 1369 DR and Randal Morn ' s reclamation of the dale , the lord has used his Freedom Riders to drive beasts and Zhent s from the lands . The Freedom riders are supplemented by mercenaries bands to keep the scattered farmlands of Daggerdale safe . By 1480 DR , the Lord ' s Retinue had been formed , a fighting force of 150 mounted warriors that patrolled the dale and its roads . Stationed in Castle Daggerdale and Dagger Falls mostly ; they would be supplemented by local village militias when their numbers were insufficent . Trade . Daggerdale ' s economy was largely based on subsistence crops , furs and livestock ( notably sheep ) .

title: Daggerford
description: Daggerford Daggerford was a town that lay along the Shining River on the Sword Coast in the Western Heartlands . It was a walled town with a population of approximately 900 , with a number of outlying hamlets , farms , and estates bringing the population to over 2 , 000 . The town was strategically placed along the Trade Way and fortified by the local duke ' s dwarven - built castle .
description_long: Daggerford Daggerford was a town that lay along the Shining River on the Sword Coast in the Western Heartlands . It was a walled town with a population of approximately 900 , with a number of outlying hamlets , farms , and estates bringing the population to over 2 , 000 . The town was strategically placed along the Trade Way and fortified by the local duke ' s dwarven - built castle . It was primarily a farming community , but a desire to grow and be seen as an alternative to the northern city Waterdeep caused the town to actively seek craftsmen and artisans . Its streets were unpaved and the buildings were ramshackle in appearance . History . The town took its name from a 400 - year - old legend about a boy named Tyndal who fended off a tribe of lizardfolk with only a dagger . The first community was built along the shores of the river at that spot . All the Dukes of Daggerford claimed to be descended from Tyndal . Construction of Castle Daggerford atop the ruined remnants of Morlin Castle began immediately after the fall of the previous Duke of Calandor and the ducal site was relocated from Delimbiyran to Daggerford .

title: Daggermaster
description: Daggermaster Daggermasters , also sometimes called invisible blades , are deadly rogue s who prefer to use light blade s , particularly dagger s , in combat . Their training and techniques with these weapons make them just as lethal as most well - armed fighter s . As a result , daggermasters have a frightful reputation , one they enjoy cultivating through exaggeration .
description_long: Daggermaster Daggermasters , also sometimes called invisible blades , are deadly rogue s who prefer to use light blade s , particularly dagger s , in combat . Their training and techniques with these weapons make them just as lethal as most well - armed fighter s . As a result , daggermasters have a frightful reputation , one they enjoy cultivating through exaggeration . Regardless of their threat level , daggermasters relish any chance to demonstrate that the most unimposing weapons can be the most lethal . Abilities . Daggermasters are masters of their blades , learning to maximize their deadliness and versatility to a point where they no longer require other , similar blades . Early on , daggermasters learn to strike with unusual accuracy , pinpointing vital spots on an enemy and hitting them hard . Even where other , less worthy wielders of a dagger might fail , a daggermaster succeeds . When a dagger master hits their mark , they leave the enemy debilitated and weak , vulnerable to yet more strikes . Daggermaster exploit s require rogues of the path to be using a dagger , specializing them further and giving them an additional edge when wielding the light blades .

title: Dagh Illance
description: Dagh Illance Dagh Illance was a knight and a member of the Illance noble family in Cormyr who rode with Alusair Obarskyr . Personality . He was hot tempered and battle - hungry , but Alusair thought him a fool like Martin Illance and the rest of their family .
description_long: Dagh Illance Dagh Illance was a knight and a member of the Illance noble family in Cormyr who rode with Alusair Obarskyr . Personality . He was hot tempered and battle - hungry , but Alusair thought him a fool like Martin Illance and the rest of their family . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . They were on a high meadow north of Startop Crag when they sighted the orcs ; Dagh was the first to hurl a spear and the knights impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush . Their dark naga master hurled a lightning bolt and Dagh and a few others were killed , before Alusair rallied her forces to defeat their foes . She muttered " good riddance to Illance " .

title: Dagna Waybeard
description: Dagna Waybeard Dagna Waybeard was the dwarven general and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces . Description . The general was broad shouldered and huge by dwarf standards .
description_long: Dagna Waybeard Dagna Waybeard was the dwarven general and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces . Description . The general was broad shouldered and huge by dwarf standards . He would tuck his long brown beard into his expansive belts . History . He was born in Citadel Adbar . In 1356 DR , Dagna helped Bruenor Battlehammer reclaim Mithral Hall from the duergar of Clan Bukbukken . The general and two thousand Adbar dwarves decided to stay in the fortress of Clan Battlehammer . Dagna was killed during a battle with troll s in 1370 DR , when he tried to protect refugees from destroyed Nesme . Relatives . Dagna had only one son , Dagnabbit , who was killed by orc s at Shallows in 1370 DR . Dagnabbit had a daughter named Dagnabbet ( Dagna ' s granddaughter ) , who became the general of Mithral Hall under Connerad Brawnanvil .

title: Dagnabbet
description: Dagnabbet Dagnabbet was the general of Mithral Hall in Luruar . History . Dagnabbet served as general under King Connerad Brawnanvil in 1484 DR during the Darkening , a time when Mithral Hall was under threat from the orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows .
description_long: Dagnabbet Dagnabbet was the general of Mithral Hall in Luruar . History . Dagnabbet served as general under King Connerad Brawnanvil in 1484 DR during the Darkening , a time when Mithral Hall was under threat from the orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . She successfully repelled the first attack and prevented great losses because of her shrewd reasoning . Around 1486 DR Dagnabbet was the first Queen of Mithril Hall . Relationships . Dagnabbet was the daughter of Dagnabbit and the granddaughter of Dagna Waybeard .

title: Dagnabbit
description: Dagnabbit Dagnabbit was the son of dwarven general Dagna and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces , as well as a companion of Bruenor Battlehammer , although not considered part of the Companions of the Hall . History . Dagnabbit ' s primary role was to protect King Bruenor , a role given to him by Gandalug Battlehammer .
description_long: Dagnabbit Dagnabbit was the son of dwarven general Dagna and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces , as well as a companion of Bruenor Battlehammer , although not considered part of the Companions of the Hall . History . Dagnabbit ' s primary role was to protect King Bruenor , a role given to him by Gandalug Battlehammer . Dagnabbit was killed during the siege of the frontier town of Shallows in 1370 DR . Dagnabbit was crushed to death when raging fires and giant - thrown boulders caused the collapse of Withegroo Seian ' Doo ' s tower as he called out orders from its top . Relationships . Dagnabbit was the son of Dagna Waybeard . He had a daughter named Dagnabbet , who was serving as general of Mithral Hall under King Connerad Brawnanvil in 1484 DR .

title: Dagon
description: Dagon Dagon is a demon lord , also called Prince of the Depths . His realm is the 89th layer of the Abyss , and is known as Shadowsea . Dagon is an obyrith .
description_long: Dagon Dagon is a demon lord , also called Prince of the Depths . His realm is the 89th layer of the Abyss , and is known as Shadowsea . Dagon is an obyrith . Dagon is first mentioned in the first edition " Dungeons & Dragons " sourcebook " Monster Manual II " , where it is said in passing that he rules a liquid layer dominated by marine dretch es , hezrou s , kraken s , and horrible fish - monsters . Description . Dagon ' s form is a mixture of both octopus and fish . History . Dagon ' s history in the Realms lies below the surface of the Sea of Fallen Stars and the waters in the west of Maztica . He and his minions lurked for a long time in the Trench of Lopok and were only known as " Those Who sleep Below " . They infested the dreams of those who swam in the Sea of Fallen Stars with nightmares . The most ambitious of the demons was Prince Dagon , who planned to overcome a pantheon of sea creatures and achieve their divine powers . To reach this goal he brought the depths of the Sea of Fallen Stars under the control of his servants and their forces . The next step was made with long forgotten eldritch magic .

title: Dagsumm
description: Dagsumm Dagsumm was a wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Dagsumm was friendly and could be relied onto honor an agreement , but he had a hunger for new magic and was fastidious with regard to details .
description_long: Dagsumm Dagsumm was a wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Dagsumm was friendly and could be relied onto honor an agreement , but he had a hunger for new magic and was fastidious with regard to details . He preferred to work in the City of the Dead , far from the risk that someone might discover his secrets . When Dagsumm found about new magic items , he could become very irritating , asking very insistently for details . Activities . Outside of his experiments in the City of the Dead , Dagsumm passed his time at the Elfsong Tavern , near to the house he shared with his wife . History . Dagsumm hailed from Port Llast and was tutored in the magical arts by Malchor Harpell at the Tower of Twilight . His apprenticeship with Malchor ended peacefully around the 1320s DR , but they had not spoken to each other since . Afterward , he came to live in Waterdeep , where he met his wife Kyrss Wands of the Wands family .

title: Dagult Neverember
description: Dagult Neverember Dagult Neverember was the Open Lord of Waterdeep and the Lord Protector of New Neverwinter around 1479 DR . In 1489 DR , he focused entirely in his role as Lord Protector of Neverwinter . He also was a member of the Lords ' Alliance .
description_long: Dagult Neverember Dagult Neverember was the Open Lord of Waterdeep and the Lord Protector of New Neverwinter around 1479 DR . In 1489 DR , he focused entirely in his role as Lord Protector of Neverwinter . He also was a member of the Lords ' Alliance . Description . Neverember had " pumpkin - brown " hair , deep - set dark eyes , and broad shoulders . He was often called a " lion of a man " for both his appearance and bearing . Personality . Neverember had a quick temper . He held a dislike of demihumans and abused them in private . Publicly , however , he was quite a diplomat and appeared to have Waterdeep ' s , and later Neverwinter ' s , best interests at heart . History . Neverember married a member of the Brandarth family , adding her broad property holdings and wealth to his own . She bore him a son , Renaer Neverember , before dying when Renaer was still in his youth . She left everything to Renaer rather than Dagult , which contributed to Dagult ' s rocky relationship with his son .

title: Dahl Peredur
description: Dahl Peredur Dahl Peredur was an antiquarian and Harper apprentice . He was formerly a novice Oghman paladin but he fell from grace for reasons he didn ' t understand . History .
description_long: Dahl Peredur Dahl Peredur was an antiquarian and Harper apprentice . He was formerly a novice Oghman paladin but he fell from grace for reasons he didn ' t understand . History . As a young man , Dahl studied to be an Oghman paladin . For reasons unclear to Dahl , Oghma revoked his powers and Dahl was kicked out of his order . Dahl moved to Waterdeep and at some point began working for the Harpers , tracking down antiquities and magical items of interest . In 1478 DR , Dahl was assigned to hunt for antiquities with Tam Zawad , a fellow Harper . While looking around Waterdeep , the pair heard about a page from a magical Netherese tome for sale by a merchant . They were unable to buy the page , but Tam , Dahl and companions stole the page from the mansion of the wealthy caravan master who purchased it . With the help of Tam ' s daughter , Mira , they were able to locate the lost library of Tarchamus , which they explored , finding Tarchamus ' magic tome the page belonged to . In the process , they destroyed the library and the undead inside . Skills . Dahl was fairly skilled at ritual magic . He was also well educated , which was to be expected from a follower of Oghma .

title: Dahlia Sin ' felle
description: Dahlia Sin ' felle Dahlia Sin ' felle , originally known as Dahlia Syn ' dalay , was a young elf originally in the service of Szass Tam . She later traveled for a time with Drizzt Do ' Urden and became his lover . After her apparent death , she was rescued by Quenthel Baenre to serve as the figurehead matron mother of the restored House Do ' Urden .
description_long: Dahlia Sin ' felle Dahlia Sin ' felle , originally known as Dahlia Syn ' dalay , was a young elf originally in the service of Szass Tam . She later traveled for a time with Drizzt Do ' Urden and became his lover . After her apparent death , she was rescued by Quenthel Baenre to serve as the figurehead matron mother of the restored House Do ' Urden . Description . Dahlia was a beautiful , tall , blue - eyed elf with a head shaved clean but for a single braid of raven black and cardinal red locks , woven to run down the right side of her head . She wore a set of diamond s in her left ear ( one for each of the lovers she had killed ) and a set of sparkling studs in her right ( for lovers she had yet to kill ) . Like many Thayan s of the day , she tattooed her head with woad , a blue and purple dye , in a shape hinting at a hunting cat ready to pounce . However , she could also easily disguise herself to appear less striking . Dahlia often wore a crimson gown which was sleeveless , backless and cut low in the front . Personality . Dahlia was angry and bitter about her past . Her anger drove her to " collect " lovers with the intention to attack them when their relationship was over .

title: Dahlia Vhammos
description: Dahlia Vhammos Dahlia Vhammos was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Lady Dahlia was a medium - height slender woman .
description_long: Dahlia Vhammos Dahlia Vhammos was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Lady Dahlia was a medium - height slender woman . In life , she was beautiful , but her undead state contorted her beauty and she appeared as a pale regal predator . She had black hair ; violet , red - rimmed eyes , and high cheekbones . Dahlia dressed in clerical dress or in extravagant and expensive courtly clothing . History . Dahlia in life was a noble member of the Vhammos family , one of the ruling noble merchant families of Westgate , but she was secretly also a worshiper and cleric of Shar . Orbakh silently observed her , noting her ambition , intelligence , and cruelty and soon decided that Dahlia was perfect for the first recruit for his Court of Night Masters . Orbakh ' s judgement was proven correct and Dahlia was made responsible for the guild ' s assassins . She was perfect for this role , accurately appraising the worth and skills of a potential assassin . Sometimes Dhalia also led her assassins in some missions in Westgate . Dhalia considered her transformation to be a great opportunity .

title: Dai - Oni ( tengu )
description: Dai - Oni ( tengu ) The " Dai - Oni " was a disguised tengu master of the Black Temple in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . A tengu in 1357 DR had an idea for a great joke : he disguised himself as a dai - oni ( or " great oni " ) and became a leader of some raiders .
description_long: Dai - Oni ( tengu ) The " Dai - Oni " was a disguised tengu master of the Black Temple in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . A tengu in 1357 DR had an idea for a great joke : he disguised himself as a dai - oni ( or " great oni " ) and became a leader of some raiders . The idea went well and many sohei and yakuza gathered under the " dai - oni " master of the Black Temple . Soon his followers led raids against nearby villages to gather tribute . The amused tengu led some bizarre rituals in the temple for his followers . In the end , some adventurers , hired by Sato Masako to stop the raiders , attacked the temple and defeated the tengu and his followers . It wasn ' t until later when they found the tengu ' s diary that they discovered it was an elaborate prank .

title: Daidoji Rakan
description: Daidoji Rakan Daidoji Rakan was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and also a jito in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He controlled affairs in Takeo village in the center of a very beautiful Niwa shoen .
description_long: Daidoji Rakan Daidoji Rakan was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and also a jito in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He controlled affairs in Takeo village in the center of a very beautiful Niwa shoen . Personality . Despite his age , Rakan was very athletic and had no problem with carrying a sword . He considered any comment about his years or presumed feebleness as an offense .

title: Daidoji Tadako
description: Daidoji Tadako Daidoji Tadako was a samurai that run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . in a post house very near to Tamanokuni he led three bushi .
description_long: Daidoji Tadako Daidoji Tadako was a samurai that run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . in a post house very near to Tamanokuni he led three bushi . in truth Daidoji , a old man , was put there as reward for his hard years to live quietly . Tadako know all kind of stories and legends of Miyama Relationship . Sometimes Tadako was visited by his son Daidoji Kiyomoto .

title: Daile Redfletching
description: Daile Redfletching Appearance . She has short red - gold hair and blue eyes . Daile is the daughter of Ren O ' The Blade and Druid Priestess who died when Daile was young .
description_long: Daile Redfletching Appearance . She has short red - gold hair and blue eyes . Daile is the daughter of Ren O ' The Blade and Druid Priestess who died when Daile was young . Ren carved Daile a longbow and polished the wood with the Ioun Stones from the hilts of his Magical daggers Left and Right . The longbow is imbuded with the magical properties to shoot arrows with precision accuracy and distance . It emits a low hum when Daile wields it . The bow has a deep red - brownish color to it a highly polished surface . The Ioun Stones magically embedded themselves within Daile ' s bow when her father ' s Magical Daggers Left and Right were passed on to her after Ren ' s death .

title: Daisake Mayazato
description: Daisake Mayazato Daisake Mayazato was a wu jen in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . As an effect of his old age , Daisake had become senile and obsessed with some ideas for no real reason .
description_long: Daisake Mayazato Daisake Mayazato was a wu jen in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . As an effect of his old age , Daisake had become senile and obsessed with some ideas for no real reason . History . Daisake was an able wu jen . Some years before 1358 DR , he saved Moonlight , Smoke , and Snake of the ninja Warazawa clan from a spirit folk ambush . They agreed to repay his help by working for him for five years . In 1358 DR , he decided to ruin the Ceremony of the Three Thousand Steps because the pilgrims made too confusion .

title: Daitya
description: Daitya Daitya was the stone giant ruler of the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Daitya and all her fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue .
description_long: Daitya Daitya was the stone giant ruler of the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Daitya and all her fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue . Daitya became obsessed with carving a perfect replica of the Purple Statue .

title: Dak Zarre
