description: Dak Zarre Dak Zarre was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Dak led the Blood Hawks mercenary company , composed of many Turmish warriors .
description_long: Dak Zarre Dak Zarre was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Dak led the Blood Hawks mercenary company , composed of many Turmish warriors . They acted as military forces in Chondath . History . In 1358 DR , Dak Zarre was called to Hlath to a meeting of prominent citizens gathered to discuss the barbarian army from Kara - Tur that menaced the city . He was hired to work under Pohidge Plam . He took part in the defense of the city . Personality . Dak was able in tactics but preferred to follow orders , avoiding discussions about the command structure . He and his men were quite courageous .

title: Dakhim el Yndhar
description: Dakhim el Yndhar Dakhim el Yndhar was a former caleph arcane of Almraiven . While one of the most powerful wizards alive in Calimshan in 1370 DR , the elderly wizard chose to live as a hermit in one of the minarets in northern Memnon . From his simple - looking tower , he spent his time making specialty magic carpet s and other magic item variants .
description_long: Dakhim el Yndhar Dakhim el Yndhar was a former caleph arcane of Almraiven . While one of the most powerful wizards alive in Calimshan in 1370 DR , the elderly wizard chose to live as a hermit in one of the minarets in northern Memnon . From his simple - looking tower , he spent his time making specialty magic carpet s and other magic item variants . While the syl - pasha tried to bribe him to move to Calimport and provide his services at court , the old enchanter despised politics .

title: Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi
description: Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi was a goblin employee of the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The success of the Al - Kamari silk ventures was largely due to Dakim ' s skill and ingenuity .
description_long: Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi was a goblin employee of the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The success of the Al - Kamari silk ventures was largely due to Dakim ' s skill and ingenuity . He could fashion 6 , 000 different colors for dyes , many of which could not be reproduced by others attempting to mimic them . Dakim researched a project to make a bedsheet for the Grand Caliph from giant spider silk . He was trusted to make most business decisions for the merchant family and often inspected their factories and those of their competitors . History . Dakim began his relationship with the House of Al - Kamari as a slave . Though technically still owned by the Al - Kamari , his skills proved his worth to them a thousand times over , earning him a level of comfort far beyond even the most highest prized slaves .

title: Dala Silmerhelve
description: Dala Silmerhelve Dala Silmerhelve was a member of House Silmerhelve in 1489 DR . Personality . Dala deeply believed that evil must be defeated all time .
description_long: Dala Silmerhelve Dala Silmerhelve was a member of House Silmerhelve in 1489 DR . Personality . Dala deeply believed that evil must be defeated all time . She was also a skilled politician with a god charm History . Dala was the daughter of Lord Olrath Silmerhelve and acted as political face of her house . When in 1489 arrived rumors about a new faction inside the Cult of the Dragon and that they new cultist want help by Claugiyliamatar she agreed with House Brokengulf to hire an adventurers party to defeat the great dragon . Appendix . Appearances . " Corruption in Kryptgarden "

title: Dalabrac Bramblefoot
description: Dalabrac Bramblefoot Dalabrac Bramblefoot was a male halfling member of the Fire Knives during the Second Sundering . History . Dalabrac was an important leader of the Fire Knives in Westgate and he had many dealings with the pirate Anton Marivaldi .
description_long: Dalabrac Bramblefoot Dalabrac Bramblefoot was a male halfling member of the Fire Knives during the Second Sundering . History . Dalabrac was an important leader of the Fire Knives in Westgate and he had many dealings with the pirate Anton Marivaldi . In 1486 DR , Anton recruited Dalabrac and his men to break into a temple of Amaunator in order to free the Chosen of Lathander Stedd Whitehorn .

title: Dalagar ' s Dagger
description: Dalagar ' s Dagger Dalagar ' s Dagger was the highest peak in the northeast section of the Nether Mountains . History . The Dagger was named after Dalagar the dwarf who tried to climb the mountain around 372 DR and fell to his death .
description_long: Dalagar ' s Dagger Dalagar ' s Dagger was the highest peak in the northeast section of the Nether Mountains . History . The Dagger was named after Dalagar the dwarf who tried to climb the mountain around 372 DR and fell to his death . Over the years many dying blue , green , and black dragon s have committed suicide by impaling themselves on the knifelike pinnacle . Their bones were scattered all around the peak and among them there were gem s and jewelry that covered their scales with in life . This treasure remained mostly untouched since the Morueme s ( who have never dared to touch a single coin ) tenaciously defended the place against any approaching creatures . It looked like they were aware when someone was trying to reach the hoard . Moruemes ripped to pieces even two young dragon s came there to plunder the riches . It was discovered that one of these two young dragons was a mage under the effects of trasformation spell . The dragons Moruemes found out mage ' s residence and publicly returned his remains there as warning to other equally ambitious wizards .

title: Dalagor
description: Dalagor Dalagor the Cold was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Dalagor earned his nickname for his approach to his business , without emotion but with calculation and cruelty .
description_long: Dalagor Dalagor the Cold was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Dalagor earned his nickname for his approach to his business , without emotion but with calculation and cruelty . He thought of his subordinates only as resources to be efficiently utilized . He liked using undead minions because they were fearless , did not complain or rout , and required little or no upkeep aside from periodic mending . He only needed living warriors as leaders for his troops . Relationship . Mostly , Dalagor interacted only with his ju - ju zombies , skeleton s , and zombie s . His main advisor was the vampire Ezira Gloomdelve , whom Dalagor controlled by threatening to destroy her spellbook . Powers . He could control undead like an evil cleric . History . Dalagor was the leader of one of the three most powerful mercenary groups , thank to his undead troops . In 1370 DR , he started thinking of a way to extend his life . That year , after the death of Shradin Mulophor , Dalagor gained control of some of the ju - ju zombie s previously employed by the necromancer .

title: Dalai Lama
description: Dalai Lama The Dalai Lama was the spiritual leader and ruler for the nation of Ra - Khati in the Hordelands . Etymology . The phrase meant " ocean spirit father " .
description_long: Dalai Lama The Dalai Lama was the spiritual leader and ruler for the nation of Ra - Khati in the Hordelands . Etymology . The phrase meant " ocean spirit father " . History . Tsenya Garbo served as the Dalai Lama for over a century as of the mid 14th century DR .

title: Dalat
description: Dalat The Dalat were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Dalat lived in the southern region of the Endless Waste .
description_long: Dalat The Dalat were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Dalat lived in the southern region of the Endless Waste . Their lands bordered those of the Tuigan and Naican tribes . Society . They spoke the Dalat language , a language influenced by the Muhjuri language . The Dalat were enemies with the Naican and the Fankiang , while maintaining friendly relations with the Kashghun . They sometimes raided with the Oigur against the Naicans . History . For centuries , the Dalat have raided Naican territory , and the conflicts only grew worse over the years , resulting in blood feuds and nearly open warfare . Around the time of the late 14 century , a young Dalat " noyan " ( noble ) attended a " couralitai " , a grand council of the " khans " ( princes of the villages ) , called by Yamun Khahan . During this council , the " noyan " desired one of the other noblemans ' daughters for himself , from one of the Fankiang tribes . Even though she was engaged to another , this Dalat " noyan " kidnapped her , beginning a blood feud between the two groups .

title: Dalat language
description: Dalat language Dalat was a language of the Hordelands . Description . Dalat had harsh consonant sounds , especially its Ks , and the sound of L was aspirated .
description_long: Dalat language Dalat was a language of the Hordelands . Description . Dalat had harsh consonant sounds , especially its Ks , and the sound of L was aspirated . Its grammar had a subject – object – verb order . Speakers . Dalat was spoken primarily by the nomadic Dalat tribe . Script . Dalat did not have a written script . History . Scholars classified Dalat as one of the Southern Imaskari languages . It was strongly influenced by the Muhjuri language .

title: Dalath ' s Span
description: Dalath ' s Span Dalath ' s Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , at the south end of the bridge , there was a Harper symbol under a high window , and those in search of a Harper could make a seal noise during the night to summon one .
description_long: Dalath ' s Span Dalath ' s Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , at the south end of the bridge , there was a Harper symbol under a high window , and those in search of a Harper could make a seal noise during the night to summon one .

title: Dale Donovan
description: Dale Donovan Dale A . Donovan is a freelance author , editor , and game designer . He was an editor for " Dragon " magazine for over five years .
description_long: Dale Donovan Dale A . Donovan is a freelance author , editor , and game designer . He was an editor for " Dragon " magazine for over five years . He worked as a game designer for TSR , Inc . , Wizards of the Coast , and Hasbro for over five years before being let go in 2002 . Dale has been a gamer since 1981 .

title: Daleen Duerna
description: Daleen Duerna Daleen Duerna was the duergar Laird of Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . Daleen became the reigning Laird fifty years before when she murdered her father .
description_long: Daleen Duerna Daleen Duerna was the duergar Laird of Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . Daleen became the reigning Laird fifty years before when she murdered her father . In the late 1480s DR , her consort was captured by the fire giant s of Maerimydra . She led a raid to free him but with no success . Daleen however stole many treasures from Hledh Hellspawn ' s lair . Among them was a samovar modeled like a marilith . She drank from it and was possessed by the demon lord – inflicted madness , which soon spread to all the city . Daleen remained in her throne room assisted by the succubus Ashroot until an adventuring party , hired by Elanil Elassidil to investigate crazed duergar , arrived in Zortagra . Somehow , the adventurers stopped the spread of madness by taking away the samovar . Personality . Under the demon lord – inflicted madness , Daleen believed herself to be Deep Duerra reincarnated and was afraid of an imminent war with mind flayer s .

title: Dalekeva
description: Dalekeva Dalekeva , also known as Oberon ' s Hold , was a Low City near Tinnainen in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age , members of the Beneficent Traders ' Guild of Dalekeva requested an audience with Lady Polaris ' High Steward Candlemas to beg the Netherese to protect their city from the orc and human army of the One King , who destroyed their neighboring city of Tinnainen .
description_long: Dalekeva Dalekeva , also known as Oberon ' s Hold , was a Low City near Tinnainen in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age , members of the Beneficent Traders ' Guild of Dalekeva requested an audience with Lady Polaris ' High Steward Candlemas to beg the Netherese to protect their city from the orc and human army of the One King , who destroyed their neighboring city of Tinnainen .

title: Dalelands
description: Dalelands The Dalelands is a region neighbored by the kingdom of Cormyr to the southwest , the nation of Sembia to the south , the forest of Cormanthor to the northeast and the Anauroch desert ( over the Desertsmouth Mountains ) to the northwest . It is most famous for being the home of the wizard Elminster . Some say Dalelanders originally came from the Great Dale .
description_long: Dalelands The Dalelands is a region neighbored by the kingdom of Cormyr to the southwest , the nation of Sembia to the south , the forest of Cormanthor to the northeast and the Anauroch desert ( over the Desertsmouth Mountains ) to the northwest . It is most famous for being the home of the wizard Elminster . Some say Dalelanders originally came from the Great Dale . Each Dale , of which there are currently eleven , is an independent territory with its own unique government , military , industry and culture . The Dales . Archendale . Archendale is an autocracy , as well as the strongest military power in the Dales . Battledale . Throughout history , Battledale has been the scene of most of the grandest battles in the Dalelands ( hence the name ) . Daggerdale . For a long time , Daggerdale has been occupied by or at war with Zhentarim agents of Zhentil Keep . Its original name some centuries ago was " Merrydale " and it was famed for the hospitality of its inhabitants . After an outbreak of vampirism the dale lost its friendliness and eventually took the translation of the original dwarven name of the valley as its name . Deepingdale .

title: Daleport
description: Daleport Daleport was a tiny village situated in the Barony of Polten on the border with the Barony of Morov where the Icelace River met Lake Mogador . History . Daleport existed because its clever founders realized that caravans needed a safer way to cross between the two baronies .
description_long: Daleport Daleport was a tiny village situated in the Barony of Polten on the border with the Barony of Morov where the Icelace River met Lake Mogador . History . Daleport existed because its clever founders realized that caravans needed a safer way to cross between the two baronies . Before the founding of Daleport , all of the other roads within the area passed directly through dangerous bogs . Caravans often traveled out of their way to make the crossing in Daleport because of the safety and security it provided . Inhabitants . The inhabitants of Daleport spent most nights enjoying each others company in a massive tavern called the Barge House .

title: Dales Council
description: Dales Council The Dales Council meets once a year at Midwinter to decide on important matters that affect multiple members of the Dalelands . Each dale sends a delegate to the council to agree upon matter such as trade routes , foreign relations , common defense and various objections against other dales . Lately many meetings have concerned the growing threat of Drow in Cormanthor and the Zhents .
description_long: Dales Council The Dales Council meets once a year at Midwinter to decide on important matters that affect multiple members of the Dalelands . Each dale sends a delegate to the council to agree upon matter such as trade routes , foreign relations , common defense and various objections against other dales . Lately many meetings have concerned the growing threat of Drow in Cormanthor and the Zhents . The Dales Council is one of the only forms of unification in the Dalelands , and was established under Aencar , the Mantled King .

title: Dalfred Noakes
description: Dalfred Noakes Dalfred Noakes was a halfling innkeeper in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dalfred ran the Narbondel ' s Shadow , an inn and the " finest rooming house in Menzoberranzan " in Eastmyr district .
description_long: Dalfred Noakes Dalfred Noakes was a halfling innkeeper in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dalfred ran the Narbondel ' s Shadow , an inn and the " finest rooming house in Menzoberranzan " in Eastmyr district . He also opposed the drow government by smuggling goods and hiding wanted people , after an altercation with a young noble of House Hunzrin left him greatly scarred . Relationship . Dalfred adopted the half - drow Shinzi and used her as one of his spies .

title: Dalia bint Khalil
description: Dalia bint Khalil Dalia bint Khalil was a the youngest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Like her older sister Janya , Dalis lived in the Royal Harim for the first few years of her life before being moved to a secure location within Al - Akara Mountains .
description_long: Dalia bint Khalil Dalia bint Khalil was a the youngest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Like her older sister Janya , Dalis lived in the Royal Harim for the first few years of her life before being moved to a secure location within Al - Akara Mountains . She still visited her parents on a regular basis . Relationships . Dalia was the child of Khalil and his most favored wife Tanya bint Perijan . Her name was Khalil ' s way of honoring is first wife , Dalilah al - Nakar , though he of course received Tanya ' s permission before naming her .

title: Dalilah al - Nakar
description: Dalilah al - Nakar Dalilah al - Nakar was Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s first wife . Description . Dalilah was a mature beauty in her mid 40s in 1367 DR .
description_long: Dalilah al - Nakar Dalilah al - Nakar was Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s first wife . Description . Dalilah was a mature beauty in her mid 40s in 1367 DR . She always carried herself like a queen . Personality . Her discerning gaze noticed everything that went on in the Royal Harim . Relationships . Dalilah was betrothed to Khalil when he was still an adolescent boy . She preferred the friendship of Zaynal ibn Sabur to Khalil ' s other wives but was friendly with all of them . History . During the first years following their marriage , Khalil promised Dalilah that he would not take any more wives . Dalilah was never able to conceive children . Khalil ' s Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , informed him of the need to father children , and Dalilah released him from his oath . Her bitterness faded over the years .

title: Dalmar
description: Dalmar Dalmar was a human abbot and cleric of Chauntea who led the monk s of the Green Lady ' s Keep , a temple to Chauntea in Velprintalar , Aglarond , around 1368 DR . Personality . The abbot enjoyed making and drinking the strong ale brewed in the abbey .
description_long: Dalmar Dalmar was a human abbot and cleric of Chauntea who led the monk s of the Green Lady ' s Keep , a temple to Chauntea in Velprintalar , Aglarond , around 1368 DR . Personality . The abbot enjoyed making and drinking the strong ale brewed in the abbey .

title: Dalren
description: Dalren Lord Dalren was a noble of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . During the war against Luskan , Lord Dalren supplied Lord Nasher with troops and resources to fight the Luskan forces .
description_long: Dalren Lord Dalren was a noble of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . During the war against Luskan , Lord Dalren supplied Lord Nasher with troops and resources to fight the Luskan forces . The trade was questionable , leaving many citizens of Neverwinter angered , as he did not deserve to live past the war . Shortly before the Kalach - Cha arrived in Neverwinter , Dalren was visited by Ammon Jerro , who had " unfinished business " . Jerro killed Dalren and walked away ( since Dalren did not have a silver shard ) , while the Neverwinter Watch locked Blacklake District to investigate this murder .

title: Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth
description: Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth was a male moon elf wilder and a younger member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth had emerged as the leader of an expansionist contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , younger members who desired contact with non - elven psionicists , and perhaps even allow them to join the Kaliesh ' erai .
description_long: Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth was a male moon elf wilder and a younger member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth had emerged as the leader of an expansionist contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , younger members who desired contact with non - elven psionicists , and perhaps even allow them to join the Kaliesh ' erai .

title: Daltim ' s Tome of Fire
description: Daltim ' s Tome of Fire Daltim ' s Tome of Fire was a spellbook written by the wizard and psionicist Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . It contained a number of rare and unique fire - based spell s , details on several light - and fire - themed magical items , and brief treatises on fire magic , psionics , and the creation of psionically empowered items . It was lost , presumed stolen , in Tethyr in the 1360s DR .
description_long: Daltim ' s Tome of Fire Daltim ' s Tome of Fire was a spellbook written by the wizard and psionicist Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . It contained a number of rare and unique fire - based spell s , details on several light - and fire - themed magical items , and brief treatises on fire magic , psionics , and the creation of psionically empowered items . It was lost , presumed stolen , in Tethyr in the 1360s DR . Description . " Daltim ' s Tome of Fire " was a small book , only around 9 inches ( 22 . 8 centimeters ) high , 5 inches ( 12 . 7 centimeters ) wide and 1 inch ( 2 . 5 centimeters ) thick . It contained only fifty pages of thick paper light gray in color . It was bound in rich red leather , said to be the hide of a salamander , and a dragon - like design — Daltim ' s sigil — was stamped on the front cover . The cover was unnaturally warm to the touch , but the pages unnaturally cool . They could not be burned . Powers .

title: Daltim ' s fiery protector
description: Daltim ' s fiery protector Daltim ' s fiery protector was an arcane conjuration / enchantment spell that summoned and bound a minor fire elemental to defend a certain item . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .
description_long: Daltim ' s fiery protector Daltim ' s fiery protector was an arcane conjuration / enchantment spell that summoned and bound a minor fire elemental to defend a certain item . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects . The spell summoned a very minor and non - sentient fire elemental ( the " fiery protector " of the title ) , trapped it within a special symbol marked upon an object , and set the elemental to then defend that object . The spell could be applied to any object that could be opened or closed , like a book , chest , door , or door , similar to a " fire trap " spell , though it would not work in conjunction with any other closure or warding spells ; both would fail in such a case . The caster , or anyone who spoke a pre - determined password , could open and use the object safely , but anyone else released the fire elemental guardian . It would immediately attack to defend the object and kill or drive off the intruder . The elemental was bound to within 120 yards ( 110 meters ) of its prison , and would return if successful . If the elemental was slain , however , the spell was ended . Otherwise , it would last forever .

title: Daltim ' s fiery tentacles
description: Daltim ' s fiery tentacles Daltim ' s fiery tentacles was an arcane conjuration spell that caused flaming tentacles to emerge from the ground and grapple and burn creatures within reach . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .
description_long: Daltim ' s fiery tentacles Daltim ' s fiery tentacles was an arcane conjuration spell that caused flaming tentacles to emerge from the ground and grapple and burn creatures within reach . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects . The spell functioned in all ways like the well - known " Evard ' s black tentacles " causing a 40 - foot - wide ( 12 meters ) area to erupt with 10 - foot - long ( 3 meters ) rubbery black tentacles . Emerging from all flat surfaces , they tried to grab , grapple , and crush all within the area . To this , " Daltim ' s fiery tentacles " added a blue - white flame that wreathed the writhing members , burning as well as crushing the unfortunates trapped within . Components . Like " Evard ' s black tentacles " , " Daltim ' s fiery tentacles " required the usual verbal and somatic components and a piece of a tentacle of a giant octopus or squid . History . The spell was developed by the Halruaan mage Daltim Flamefist sometime in the mid – 14th century DR . By 1373 DR , " Daltim ' s fiery tentacles " was also known to Thebadol , a Halruaan elder .

title: Daltim ' s flaming fist
description: Daltim ' s flaming fist Daltim ' s flaming fist was an arcane evocation spell that created a fiery fist to strike one ' s foes . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa and was his signature spell . Effects .
description_long: Daltim ' s flaming fist Daltim ' s flaming fist was an arcane evocation spell that created a fiery fist to strike one ' s foes . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa and was his signature spell . Effects . The spell naturally created a flaming fist of roughly the same size as a human first , appearing midair at any location no more than 10 yards ( 9 . 1 meters ) away . The caster could then direct it anywhere within ( 55 meters ) of themselves , and strike a target with it , whereupon it would explode into a 6 - foot - wide ( 1 . 8 meters ) ball of fire , burning its target . If it collided with a flammable object , then that object could well catch fire . Surprisingly , if the " flaming fist " missed its target on its first attack , its heat energy was stored and carried over to the next attack . Thus , if it missed once , then hit , it did twice as much damage on the second attack . Without the caster ' s intervention , the " flaming fist " would continue to attack the last target it was given , or if told not to attack , it waited , though this ran the risk of igniting anything nearby . It lasted only a short duration . Components .

title: Daltim ' s proof against fire
description: Daltim ' s proof against fire Daltim ' s proof against fire was an arcane abjuration spell that bestowed a permanent immunity to fire upon an object . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .
description_long: Daltim ' s proof against fire Daltim ' s proof against fire was an arcane abjuration spell that bestowed a permanent immunity to fire upon an object . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects . The spell made a selected object completely immune to fire , such that it could not be burned by any means and remained always cool when touched . It had to be a solid object , and its volume in cubic feet was directly proportional to the caster ' s level of power . Furthermore , if " Daltim ' s proof against fire " was placed upon something that could be worn , then that item provided the same immunity to the wearer . This was provided it offered sufficient coverage to block a flame , such as a cloak or suit of armor . A wearer became immune to any natural fire , and was better able to resist magical flame . Components . In addition to the usual verbal and somatic components , the spell required an ink concocted from the blood of a red dragon and a crushed ruby valued at 5000 gold piece s . Prior to casting , protective runes were brushed onto the item to be protected , and these faded away when the spell was cast . History .

title: Daltim Flamefist
description: Daltim Flamefist Daltim Flamefist was a male Halruaan human wizard and psionicist from the realm of Halruaa in south Faerûn . He was well known as a powerful noble of Halruaa ; as the commander of the Destroyers , a mercenary company of mages and psionicists ; and for his groundbreaking research into fire magic , psionics , and the creation and reproduction of magical and psionic items . Description .
description_long: Daltim Flamefist Daltim Flamefist was a male Halruaan human wizard and psionicist from the realm of Halruaa in south Faerûn . He was well known as a powerful noble of Halruaa ; as the commander of the Destroyers , a mercenary company of mages and psionicists ; and for his groundbreaking research into fire magic , psionics , and the creation and reproduction of magical and psionic items . Description . Daltim Flamefist ' s personal sigil was a stylized dragon . Personality . He was a proudly patriotic Halruaan , and aspired to be an Elder . Abilities . Daltim Flamefist was a powerful wizard who specialized in the domain of elemental fire , known as a fire mage or pyromancer , rather than in any one school of magic . He also possessed a wild talent for psionics , learning several powers . These he cultivated , becoming a psion focused on the discipline of metacreativity , known as a shaper . He pursued both these avenues simultaneously , mastering magic and psionics , following the path of the cerebremancer .

title: Dalvar Corzon
description: Dalvar Corzon Dalvar Corzon was a captain of the Cormyrean Freesails in 1359 DR . History . Dalvar was trained by the clerics of Mielikki .
description_long: Dalvar Corzon Dalvar Corzon was a captain of the Cormyrean Freesails in 1359 DR . History . Dalvar was trained by the clerics of Mielikki . Dalvar for a few years tried to train seagull to act as couriers , he had few success but was still able to send to destination some messages , that proved to be decisive during the Time of Troubles and the Horde War . He was promoted as captain of the " Gullswing " by King Azoun Obarskyr IV himself . Personality . Dalvar was totally devotee to his country , always ready to defeat it enemies . He had developed an uncanny sense of pirates activities , growing a fierce reputation among the pirates . His clerics teachers told him that thank his exploits the goddess probably would permit to Dalvar also to cast spell s . This and the recognition from King Azoun had made Dalvar a bit too anxious for battle , taking bigger risks any time he sailed . Some started think he need to be stopped , for his own sake .

title: Dalzhel
description: Dalzhel History . Dalzhel was a skilled warrior of Zhentil Keep and during the Time of Troubles he was in the Zhentilar army stationed in Scardale . Dalzhel was promoted to lieutenant of the Company of the Scorpions under Cyric .
description_long: Dalzhel History . Dalzhel was a skilled warrior of Zhentil Keep and during the Time of Troubles he was in the Zhentilar army stationed in Scardale . Dalzhel was promoted to lieutenant of the Company of the Scorpions under Cyric . Dalzhel and Cyric assisted Bane ' s forces in the assault on Tantras , but after the death of Bane at the hands of Torm , Dalzhel and his men pledged loyalty to Cyric . Dalzhel was involved in the hunt for the Tablets of Fate and continued to follow Cyric even after the loss of most of his men . In the end , during a three - way confrontation with the then - human Kelemvor and the god Bhaal , Dalzhel was killed by the god of assassins . Personality and Traits . Dalzhel was a very practical man and he felt no particular loyalty to Bane , unlike most in the Zhentilar . He considered no god worthy of his adoration because he received no advantages from gods . However , Dalzhel followed Cyric loyally because he liked his plan for power . In a sense , he was the first worshiper of Cyric .

title: Dama
description: Dama Dama was a rebel leader in the Unther in 1357 DR . History . Once Dama was a gladiator in Chessenta but was captured to Thayan slavers and sold to a Unther ' s freeholder .
description_long: Dama Dama was a rebel leader in the Unther in 1357 DR . History . Once Dama was a gladiator in Chessenta but was captured to Thayan slavers and sold to a Unther ' s freeholder . However he in 1358 escaped and became one of the main leader of the slave revolt in Unther . His goal was destroy the church of Gilgeam and create as much chaos as possible .

title: Damara
description: Damara Damara was a sparsely populated kingdom in the Cold Lands of Northeast Faerûn . In 1357 DR it was ruled by King Virdin . Later ruled by King Gareth Dragonsbane as of 1371 DR , and , with Vaasa , formed the Bloodstone Lands .
description_long: Damara Damara was a sparsely populated kingdom in the Cold Lands of Northeast Faerûn . In 1357 DR it was ruled by King Virdin . Later ruled by King Gareth Dragonsbane as of 1371 DR , and , with Vaasa , formed the Bloodstone Lands . In 1479 DR , it was under rule by King Yarin Frostmantle . Major geographical features . Forests . The Earthwood forest was a small forest known for its resilience , with trees growing back extremely quickly . Mountains . The Galena Mountains were a jagged range of icy mountains that were largely inhabited by goblinoid s and giant s , but were also home to dwarves who mined the bloodstone , iron and silver deposits . Bloodstone Pass was the only pass through the Galena Mountains that was large enough for significant trade , linking Damara with neighboring Vaasa to the west . Climate . The people of Damara were generally hardy , and the winters were harsh . During the summer , the farming season was short . Politics . From its earliest days , Damara was divided into counties ruled by noble houses but united under the throne of Damara .

title: Damaran language
description: Damaran language Damaran was a regional language of Northeast Faerûn and the official language of the kingdom of Damara . Damaran was the major dialect of Chardic . Speakers .
description_long: Damaran language Damaran was a regional language of Northeast Faerûn and the official language of the kingdom of Damara . Damaran was the major dialect of Chardic . Speakers . The language was spoken in many lands and by many peoples including Aglarond , Altumbel , the Anauroch , Cormyr , the Dalelands , the Dragon Coast , the Great Dale , the Galena Mountains , the Great Glacier , Guidodale , the Hordelands , Icelace Lake , Impiltur , the Moonsea , Narfell , Rashemen , the Ride , Sembia , among the Shadovar , Thay , Thesk , Vaasa , the Vast , and the Vilhon Reach . It was also sometimes spoken among dwarves , elves , goblin s , half - elves , orc s , half - orc s , planetouched , taer s , and volodni . In Vaasa , a creole of Chardic was often spoken in addition to the Damaran dialect . Script . Speakers of the Damaran tongue used the Dethek alphabet of the dwarves . This practice developed from the relationship between the people of Impiltur and the dwarves of the Earthfast Mountains . Related languages . Damaran was in the Ulou language group , the language group to which Netherese belonged .

title: Damarite Red
description: Damarite Red Damarite Red was a cheese crafted in Damara within the Bloodstone Lands . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Damarite Red Damarite Red was a cheese crafted in Damara within the Bloodstone Lands . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This bloodcheese had a sharp flavor courtesy of goat ' s milk . A black rind helped this cheese travel well . Prices . Damarite Red could be purchased in the following sizes :

title: Dambrath
description: Dambrath Dambrath was a nation on the southern coast of Faerûn . It was notable as it was formerly ruled by a race of human , drow and elves collectively known as the Crinti , who comprised the upper class . Dambrath was a predominantly isolationist nation , though they did allow some limited trade with outsiders .
description_long: Dambrath Dambrath was a nation on the southern coast of Faerûn . It was notable as it was formerly ruled by a race of human , drow and elves collectively known as the Crinti , who comprised the upper class . Dambrath was a predominantly isolationist nation , though they did allow some limited trade with outsiders . During the Spellplague in 1385 DR , native Dambrathans rebelled against their half - drow masters and drove them from the land . In 1489 DR Dambrath was a nation of nomadic human clans , primarily horse riders . The clans met two times a year at The Hill of Kings to add the stories of the clans history to totems on the hill . Many of these Dambrathens sought the curse , or gift in their eyes , of lycanthropy . This was acceptable because of the local gods they served . The Dambrathans worshiped Silvanus , Selûne , and Malar all patrons of were - creatures . Geography . Dambrath stretched more than 700 miles east to west , and 300 miles north to south .

title: Dambrathan language
description: Dambrathan language Dambrathan was a regional tongue of south Faerûn and the nation of Dambrath . Speakers . Dambrathan was spoken primarily by the people of Dambrath , including the Arkaiun s .
description_long: Dambrathan language Dambrathan was a regional tongue of south Faerûn and the nation of Dambrath . Speakers . Dambrathan was spoken primarily by the people of Dambrath , including the Arkaiun s . Other places it was frequently spoken included Channath Vale , Halruaa , Luiren , Nimbral , and the Shaar . Script . The language sometimes employed the Dethek script and at other times the elven alphabet , Espruar . History . Dambrathan was a creole of Old Illuskan and Narfelli , making it both an Illuski and a Low Ulutim language . Examples . Typical Dambrathan surnames included Calaumystar , Lharaendo , Mristar , Talaudrym , and Wyndael . Common female names included Chourm , Glouris , Maeve , Hayaera , Sevaera , Xaemarra , and Zraela . Males might be named Aethelmed , Houn , Rhivaun , Umbril , Waervyn , Xaemar , or Zeltaebar .

title: Damian Krale
description: Damian Krale Damian Krale is a worshiper of Shar who has been tasked by the Mistress of the Night to unite cells dedicated to her worship throughout the Western Heartlands . The ultimate goal of his endeavours is mostly a secret and only a few of the leaders of the cells know what it is . Physical appearance .
description_long: Damian Krale Damian Krale is a worshiper of Shar who has been tasked by the Mistress of the Night to unite cells dedicated to her worship throughout the Western Heartlands . The ultimate goal of his endeavours is mostly a secret and only a few of the leaders of the cells know what it is . Physical appearance . Krale is a massive man with a booming voice , both of which serve to enhance the force of his impressive personality . Possessions . In battle Damian wields Shadowstone , a + 2 heavy mace that is also a minor artifact created by Shar .

title: Damien
description: Damien Damien was the son of Gaspar the Fishmonger in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young boy dressed in brown clothing .
description_long: Damien Damien was the son of Gaspar the Fishmonger in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young boy dressed in brown clothing . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , against his father ' s wishes , Damien decided to fish for knucklehead trout on the shores of Lac Dinneshere , but was attacked by a group of goblin s .

title: Damien Oneknife
description: Damien Oneknife Damien Oneknife was a deadly assassin living in Faerûn during the decades following the Time of Troubles ( 1358 DR ) . He was known for being opportunistic in battle , and he always tried to benefit from the assets of his enemies . One such battle saw him barely survive against a group of ghouls .
description_long: Damien Oneknife Damien Oneknife was a deadly assassin living in Faerûn during the decades following the Time of Troubles ( 1358 DR ) . He was known for being opportunistic in battle , and he always tried to benefit from the assets of his enemies . One such battle saw him barely survive against a group of ghouls . In a bid to improve his chances during subsequent battles , he skinned one of them and had the hide magically enchanted to provide heightened protection against the ghoul ' s signature paralysation attack . Damien was at one stage approached by an individual known as the Dockman and asked to assassinate the legendary drow warrior , Drizzt Do ' Urden . At first he refused to perform the task , citing Drizzt ' s superior battle prowess as the reason . He was eventually persuaded otherwise , however , when the Dockman bribed him with an enchanted dagger called Risktaker which , unbeknownst to Damien , impaired his reasoning and judgment . Damien was killed by Drizzt ' s companions .

title: Damlath
description: Damlath Damlath ( nicknamed the Laughing Mage ) was a wizard . Appearance . Damlath was dark - skinned .
description_long: Damlath Damlath ( nicknamed the Laughing Mage ) was a wizard . Appearance . Damlath was dark - skinned . Personality . Damlath had an acerbic personality to which few warmed . He was nicknamed the " Laughing Mage " because he cackled with glee between casting spells . He would usually only prepare very few combat spells , preferring spells that were investigative or concealing . Possessions . Damlath acquired a flying carpet from Llorbauth and used it as a mount , in preference to a horse . He wore a cloak with magical pockets that could store extra equipment , such as his carpet . Background . Damlath was originally from Erlkazar , and became a devotee of Oghma in Llorbauth at the Lore Halls . In 1350 DR , he went to Silverymoon to work with Sandrew the Wise , and when Sandrew began work on the Font of Knowledge in Waterdeep , Damlath helped in the construction . In 1371 DR , Damlath began working with Raegar Stoneblade , under Phanar Manthar at the Font of Knowledge in Waterdeep , with the aim of disclosing secrets held by wizards in the city .

title: Damos
description: Damos The Damos is a powerful artifact of Imaskari origin . It appears as a round , silver disk with a reservoir holding black fluid in the center . Anyone drinking the liquid is able to see the future with certainty .
description_long: Damos The Damos is a powerful artifact of Imaskari origin . It appears as a round , silver disk with a reservoir holding black fluid in the center . Anyone drinking the liquid is able to see the future with certainty . An unfortunate side effect is that the liquid is a deadly poison that kills the user . As of 1479 DR one of the Damos was in the possession of the Rakshasa Kalkan .

title: Dan Mishkin
description: Dan Mishkin Dan Mishkin is a comic book writer for . Collaborations . Since his teenage years , Mishkin has collaborated with writer , and they entered the comics industry together .
description_long: Dan Mishkin Dan Mishkin is a comic book writer for . Collaborations . Since his teenage years , Mishkin has collaborated with writer , and they entered the comics industry together . He also collaborated with Jeff Grubb to write the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons and Forgotten Realms series of comic books .

title: Dan Zor
description: Dan Zor Dan Zor was a male human samurai and the hereditary leader of the island kingdom of Saishu in Koryo , before becoming its governor , with the title " Master of Cheju " . He was also a noted sage . History .
description_long: Dan Zor Dan Zor was a male human samurai and the hereditary leader of the island kingdom of Saishu in Koryo , before becoming its governor , with the title " Master of Cheju " . He was also a noted sage . History . Born around 1289 DR , Dan Zor was the hereditary leader of the people of Saishu . In the early 14th century DR , the kingdom of Silla was at war with Saishu . Finally , in the 1330s DR , the king of Silla conquered Saishu , as well as the kingdom of Koguryo , unifying the whole land of Choson into the Sillan Empire . However , the Sillan king was a tyrant , abusing Dan and inflicting crippling taxes and martial law on Saishu , occupying it with Sillan troops . However , General Wanang Sun of Silla protected Dan Zor , even arranging a marriage between his second son and Dan ' s first daughter . Finally , around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ' s secret invasion of Kozakura ended in catastrophe that saw the end of his reign ; he abdicated and fled . In his place , General Wanang Sun seized the throne , becoming king and reforming the Sillan Empire into the Empire of Koryo . He welded the old factions of Choson into a unified nation .

title: Danactar the High Artificer
description: Danactar the High Artificer The heart of Gond ' s church is the High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration in the city of Illul in Lantan . This monastery is run by Danactar the High Artificer , Most Holy Servant of Gond . Danactar is the highest ranking mortal cleric of Gond ; he is the supreme voice in ecclesiastical matters and he serves in Lantan ' s ruling council , the Ayrorch .
description_long: Danactar the High Artificer The heart of Gond ' s church is the High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration in the city of Illul in Lantan . This monastery is run by Danactar the High Artificer , Most Holy Servant of Gond . Danactar is the highest ranking mortal cleric of Gond ; he is the supreme voice in ecclesiastical matters and he serves in Lantan ' s ruling council , the Ayrorch . The church of Gond consists mostly of wandering clerics who travel from settlement to settlement , finding work as artisans and engineers . Settling in one area is only encouraged in centers for innovation that warrant constant observation , such as Zhentil Keep , Waterdeep , Athkatla , and Suzail . The church encourages wealth , as it demonstrates the benefits of following Gond . As they travel , clerics take samples of any inventions they discover and assist innovators they encounter , filing regular reports to their superiors .

title: Dance of ruin
description: Dance of ruin Dance of ruin is a necromancy spell that seriously damages non - demon s . To cast this spell , the caster dances wildly and chants . After they finish their dance , a wave of crackling energy flashes outward up to the extent of the range .
description_long: Dance of ruin Dance of ruin is a necromancy spell that seriously damages non - demon s . To cast this spell , the caster dances wildly and chants . After they finish their dance , a wave of crackling energy flashes outward up to the extent of the range . All non - demon creatures within the area take a significant amount of damage .

title: Dance of the Dolphins
description: Dance of the Dolphins The Dance of the Dolphins was a spectacle that occurred in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath . It was the synchronized movement of thousands of dolphin s that gave the appearance of a dance . History .
description_long: Dance of the Dolphins The Dance of the Dolphins was a spectacle that occurred in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath . It was the synchronized movement of thousands of dolphin s that gave the appearance of a dance . History . The dance occurred at dusk when tens of thousands of dolphins would gather and play a complicated game that onlookers interpreted as a dance . Sages believe that the dolphins might be communicating with the deity of dolphins , or that they are simply performing some kind of unknown ritual . Rumors and Legends . Many believed that viewing the dance on a nightly basis warded off depression and other sicknesses of the mind .

title: Dancing Dell
description: Dancing Dell The Dancing Dell was a dell containing the Ladystone , a sacred stone touched by Eilistraee . The stone was very old , possibly dating back as far as the early settlements of Ardeep . Description .
description_long: Dancing Dell The Dancing Dell was a dell containing the Ladystone , a sacred stone touched by Eilistraee . The stone was very old , possibly dating back as far as the early settlements of Ardeep . Description . The dell was a smooth bowl - shaped valley filled with moss , ferns , and grasses , surrounded by a ring of raised earth . Defenses . The Ladystone ' s power guarded the dell and could strike out at intruders at the will of the goddess or her priestesses . Inhabitants . Qilue Veladorn lead worship at the Ladystone . History . It was said that Eilistraee had manifested in the dell more than once .

title: Dancing Dwarves
description: Dancing Dwarves The Dancing Dwarves was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Kor , the Zakharan god of wisdom . The symbol and favored weapon of the Dancing Dwarves was a battle - axe . Activities .
description_long: Dancing Dwarves The Dancing Dwarves was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Kor , the Zakharan god of wisdom . The symbol and favored weapon of the Dancing Dwarves was a battle - axe . Activities . Members of the Dancing Dwarves tended to be extremely conservative . Members . As of 1367 DR , the Dancing Dwarves had 200 members . The vast majority were dwarves , but membership was not limited to the stout folk . All members of the Dancing Dwarves were dervishes . Base of Operations . The Dancing Dwarves were based in Al - Akara Mountains near Huzuz .

title: Dancing hart
description: Dancing hart The dancing hart was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a deer that held a cup in its antlers .
description_long: Dancing hart The dancing hart was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a deer that held a cup in its antlers . Powers . Certain old records of arcane matters stated that the cup component should be filled with the blood of one ' s foe in order to activate the power of the " dancing hart " . However , its actual powers were lost to history . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " dancing hart " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . However , it was later lost . It was speculated to lie among the treasures of Toranu Gang - po , a fortress whose location was also lost by the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Dancing lightning
description: Dancing lightning Dancing lightning is an evocation spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training that is similar to " lightning bolt " . When a sorcerer casts " dancing lightning " , he or she causes lightning to strike from the sky into a target at some fifty feet or less . Thunder subsequently booms around the target as well , dealing further damage .
description_long: Dancing lightning Dancing lightning is an evocation spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training that is similar to " lightning bolt " . When a sorcerer casts " dancing lightning " , he or she causes lightning to strike from the sky into a target at some fifty feet or less . Thunder subsequently booms around the target as well , dealing further damage . " Dancing lightning " is not particularly difficult to cast , taking only an instant to use and a rest of a few minutes or more to recharge .

title: Dancing lights
description: Dancing lights Dancing lights was an evocation or alteration spell that produced levitating lights that could move at the caster ' s direction . Effects . All versions of this spell produced up to four floating lights that could be made to appear as torches , lanterns , or as orbs vaguely resembling will - o ' - wisp s .
description_long: Dancing lights Dancing lights was an evocation or alteration spell that produced levitating lights that could move at the caster ' s direction . Effects . All versions of this spell produced up to four floating lights that could be made to appear as torches , lanterns , or as orbs vaguely resembling will - o ' - wisp s . They could also be combined into a roughly man - sized glowing humanoid shape reminiscent of a being from the Elemental Plane of Fire . The lights were fairly dim , casting as much light as a regular torch . The oldest versions of this spell had a minimum range of 150 ft ( 46 m ) and a minimum duration of two minutes , both of which could be extended by casters of higher level . The separate lights could move independently and , once set in motion , did not require concentration by the caster . A newer version had a minimum range of 100 ft ( 30 m ) and a duration of one minute . The lights had to remain within a 10 - ft ( 3 m ) radius sphere . After the Second Sundering , this spell had a fixed range of 120 ft ( 36 . 6 m ) , one minute duration , required caster concentration , and each light had to remain within 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) of one of its siblings .

title: Dang Caverns
description: Dang Caverns The Dang Caverns were a series of caves lying beneath the northeastern Ziyero Ridge in Koryo . Description . The caverns were vast and extensive with hundreds of levels .
description_long: Dang Caverns The Dang Caverns were a series of caves lying beneath the northeastern Ziyero Ridge in Koryo . Description . The caverns were vast and extensive with hundreds of levels . They were also hundreds of ways to enter them , or to exit them . History . According to legend , the entire Han clan sought shelter in the vast Dang Caverns when the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted , raining fire over the land . The wizard Cho Lu - k ' u died in the Dang Caverns and cursed the tunnels , seemingly leading to the monsters that lurked there . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla and former emperor of Koryo abdicated his throne amidst a naval catastrophe . He and his most loyal supporters escaped to the Dang Caverns . There , in secret , he mustered an army with which to reconquer Koryo , apparently paid for with looted treasures and gem s mined in the caverns . He also made pacts with wicked wu jen and dreadful spirits of the deep pits for their aid . Inhabitants . The tunnels were reported to be home to evil monsters that hid from the light . At times , however , regular Koryoan human s were more likely to dwell in the caverns .

title: Danica Maupoissant
description: Danica Maupoissant Danica Bonaduce , formerly known as Danica Maupoissant , was a human monk . She was the wife of Cadderly Bonaduce and mother of their three children . Description .
description_long: Danica Maupoissant Danica Bonaduce , formerly known as Danica Maupoissant , was a human monk . She was the wife of Cadderly Bonaduce and mother of their three children . Description . A small woman , Danica was hardly taller than five feet . However , every inch of her body was covered in lean , toned muscle , a testament to her strict martial training . However , the muscle hardly diminished her feminine qualities , enhancing them rather . She had strawberry blonde hair , which fell just below her shoulders in unruly curls . Her eyes were dark and almond - shaped , thanks to her oriental heritage . Danica was noted as being stunningly beautiful , attracting the attention of Cadderly and Kierkan Rufo , as well as Elbereth , the elf prince of Shilmista . Personality . Danica was wholly devoted to the teachings of the great monk , Grandmaster Penpahg D ' Ahn . As such , she was disciplined , ordered , and in complete control of her emotions at all times . When Cadderly initially proposed marriage , Danica instantly informed him that she would not give up her studies for any man . Danica was also an extraordinarily perceptive young woman .

title: Danifae Yauntyrr
description: Danifae Yauntyrr Danifae Yauntyrr was a stunningly beautiful drow cleric who eventually would became the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) , a part of Lolth herself . Description . Danifae was described as very beautiful .
description_long: Danifae Yauntyrr Danifae Yauntyrr was a stunningly beautiful drow cleric who eventually would became the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) , a part of Lolth herself . Description . Danifae was described as very beautiful . She was curvaceous and had silver - toned hair with unusual gray eyes . Personality . Danifae was quite astute . She recognized immediately that the true source of power in Quenthel Baenre ' s group was the wizard Pharaun Mizzrym . She was not averse to using her beauty and charm to seduce others , including Quenthel , for her own benefit . She was a skilled manipulator . History . Background . Danifae was born in the city of Eryndlyn , where she studied magic with the house wizard and became a priestess of Lolth . Danifae and her mother , the matron mother of House Yauntyrr , once traveled to Llacerellyn . A threat against them turned into an assassination attempt involving an elemental . Danifae ' s mother was able to use her " ring of teleportation " to teleport them back to House Yauntyrr in Eryndlyn . Circa 1362 DR , Danifae was captured when House Yauntyrr fell . She ended up in a whole new city , in the possession of Halisstra Melarn of Ched Nasad .

title: Danilo Thann
description: Danilo Thann Danilo Thann was a young Waterdhavian nobleman of House Thann , the sixth son of Rhammas and Cassandra . He was also an ex - Harper as well as a former Lord of Waterdeep . While first and foremost married to Arilyn Moonblade , Danilo counted many other great Faerûnians among the ranks of those to whom he was close .
description_long: Danilo Thann Danilo Thann was a young Waterdhavian nobleman of House Thann , the sixth son of Rhammas and Cassandra . He was also an ex - Harper as well as a former Lord of Waterdeep . While first and foremost married to Arilyn Moonblade , Danilo counted many other great Faerûnians among the ranks of those to whom he was close . Description . Danilo was a young Waterdhavian nobleman and aspiring bard . He was about six feet tall and had wavy shoulder - length pale blond hair . Even among the nobles , Danilo ' s choice of clothing was considered " extravagantly ridiculous . " He commonly wore clothes that suit his theme as a dandy and dilettante - - from suits of " walking grape " to the " Ruathym Adventurer garb . " Whatever he wore , he was consistently found wearing the height of fashion among the Nobility of Waterdeep . He had gray eyes . He seemed particularly fond of green clothing and lots of jewelry . Personality . When faced by the public , Danilo acted like a complete fool . He appeared spoiled , shallow , and selfish . He spoke with a lazy drawl . He was widely known for his miscast spells and for generally causing mayhem .

title: Dannal Harftevor
description: Dannal Harftevor Dannal Harftevor was a half - elf male cavalry officer in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Originally from Tethyr , Dannal joined the Council Army Cavalry and rose to the rank of lieutenant . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Dannal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .
description_long: Dannal Harftevor Dannal Harftevor was a half - elf male cavalry officer in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Originally from Tethyr , Dannal joined the Council Army Cavalry and rose to the rank of lieutenant . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Dannal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .

title: Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods
description: Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods was a shop located in the city of Yartar on the Savage Frontier in northwest Faerûn . Operation . It was owned and run by Alukk Dannath and his three daughters .
description_long: Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods was a shop located in the city of Yartar on the Savage Frontier in northwest Faerûn . Operation . It was owned and run by Alukk Dannath and his three daughters . His daughters were all Harpers . Services . Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods specialized in providing foods suitable for travelers in the North , that were otherwise scarce in the area . These included dried apricot s , fig s , and garshell s from the Tashalar and the lands around the Lake of Steam . The foods were of good quality to suit the high prices . Dannath found any foods close to spoiling and converted them into another , longer lasting form , such as adding overripe fruit s in a wine or a syrup mash . Dannath ' s daughters also offered aid and sanctuary to Harpers in the building ' s cellars . The cellars led to tunnels running under Yartar , exiting in several places , like the Wink and the Kiss festhall .

title: Danthra
description: Danthra Danthra ( often called Danthra the Dreamer , a name chosen by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ) was a companion to Tsarra Chaadren , and considered Tsarra her best friend . Description . Danthra was very thin with a delicate build , long dark straight hair , and a wan complexion .
description_long: Danthra Danthra ( often called Danthra the Dreamer , a name chosen by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ) was a companion to Tsarra Chaadren , and considered Tsarra her best friend . Description . Danthra was very thin with a delicate build , long dark straight hair , and a wan complexion . History . Danthra often received visions while she slept , and spoke prophetic words during them , although she did not remember the words on waking . The visions and her words often came true . The visions incapacitated her for differing amounts of time from moments to days . Danthra began an apprenticeship at Blackstaff Tower in 1365 DR . Death . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , while Danthra was demonstrating a new spell designed to discern the origins of magical items , an explosion inadvertently caused by Raegar Stoneblade blew a hole in the side of Blackstaff Tower , destroying Danthra ' s physical form and injuring Tsarra Chaadren and Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Khelben placed Danthra ' s soul inside a kiira and attached it to Tsarra ' s head .

title: Dantrag Baenre
description: Dantrag Baenre Dantrag Baenre was a drow fighter , and the weapons master of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Description . A talented swordsman , Dantrag was unusually tall for a drow , closer to 6 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Dantrag Baenre Dantrag Baenre was a drow fighter , and the weapons master of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Description . A talented swordsman , Dantrag was unusually tall for a drow , closer to 6 ft ( 1 . 83 m ) than 5 ft , kept his white hair pulled up into a ponytail , and displayed watchful amber eyes , which blazed red when he was angered . Personality . Dantrag appeared to be an honorable warrior , preferring not to attack unarmed opponents or to strike from behind . However , this attitude was largely due to Dantrag ' s highly developed sense of pride ; he believed that no - one could best him in melee combat . Dantrag was the second - boy of House Baenre , behind his brother Gromph Baenre , the archmage of Menzoberranzan . However , he had no aspirations to usurp his brother ' s status . The only role he desired was that of Principle Master of Melee - Magthere , a position he was not allowed to acquire by his matron mother , Yvonnel Baenre , owing to his usefulness as weapons master of House Baenre . Relationships . Family . As a son of Yvonnel Baenre , Dantrag was related to many influential drow figures .

title: Danyig
description: Danyig Danyig was a skilled blacksmith who lived in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Danyig was easily the most skilled blacksmith within the entire city .
description_long: Danyig Danyig was a skilled blacksmith who lived in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Danyig was easily the most skilled blacksmith within the entire city . Not only could he forge beautiful Shou - style weapons and armor , he could also forge nearly any unique item if given a copy to work from .

title: Dao
description: Dao The dao were a variation of genie from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Dao often ran gem - mining operations there or on the Material Plane . They could especially be found in the wild regions of Zakhara .
description_long: Dao The dao were a variation of genie from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Dao often ran gem - mining operations there or on the Material Plane . They could especially be found in the wild regions of Zakhara . Dao appear as humanoid s with bodies that had external physical characteristics that evoked their elemental nature , though some varieties were capable of shape - shifting into another form . They formed their own distinctive societies in their native planes . Because they had powerful supernatural or magical abilities , genies were sometimes called upon or summoned by spellcasters to grant wishes or perform services for them . The individual varieties have differing attitudes towards humanoid races native to the Material Plane . The yikarian term for the dao was " earthservants . " Organization . Genies literally carved out an empire from the Elemental Plane of Earth , called the Great Dismal Delve , based strongly on slave labour . They ruled from their capital city of the Sevenfold Mazework by their Great Khan Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil .

title: Dao Khanate
description: Dao Khanate The Dao Khanate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the dao . Organization . The Great Khan , Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil , ruled over all of the noble dao comprising the Dao Khanate .
description_long: Dao Khanate The Dao Khanate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the dao . Organization . The Great Khan , Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil , ruled over all of the noble dao comprising the Dao Khanate . Activities . The Great Khan ' s favor was based upon industry and production , spurring the noble dao to undertake an endless number of mining operations and excursions through the Elemental Plane of Earth in search of precious gems and ore . The dao did not desire outright conquest of their elemental plane as did some of the other genie s . They were sorely focused on mining the Great Dismal Delve for all it was worth . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as the seat of power for the Dao Khanate .

title: Dao mazework
description: Dao mazework Dao mazeworks were the homes of noble dao who lived far from the vast Sevenfold Mazework . Location . These structures were typically located somewhere on the Elemental Plane of Earth , but could be found on other planes as well .
description_long: Dao mazework Dao mazeworks were the homes of noble dao who lived far from the vast Sevenfold Mazework . Location . These structures were typically located somewhere on the Elemental Plane of Earth , but could be found on other planes as well . Zakhara on the Prime Material Plane housed dao mazeworks . Inhabitants . In addition to the leading noble dao , a dao mazework usually held at least 40 dao accompanied by earth elemental s , other vassals and slaves , and several sandmen .

title: Daoine Teague Feer
description: Daoine Teague Feer Daoine Teague Feer also called The Star Enchantment was an ancient ritual performed by the forest elves of Shilmista in the Snowflake Mountains . History . The ritual was usually attended only by elves .
description_long: Daoine Teague Feer Daoine Teague Feer also called The Star Enchantment was an ancient ritual performed by the forest elves of Shilmista in the Snowflake Mountains . History . The ritual was usually attended only by elves . Cadderly and Danica were offered the honor of attendance by Elbereth , the forest elven prince , after helping defeat a group of marauding goblin s in the forest of Shilmista . Cadderly followed his love of knowledge , watching and recording the ritual rather than participating in it himself . Elbereth later included Cadderly in the ceremony . Procedure . The ritual took place at night , preferably under a full moon . It could only be performed by an elf of the ruling line , for example , by Galladel the king or Elbereth the prince of the forest elves . All elves attending the ritual dressed in their ceremonial robes and gathered in an open spot in the forest with a clear view of the starlit sky . They formed a circle and began the song of Shilmista . The song started as a spoken chant with the elves walking in a circle and lifting bowls towards the sky . Later , the walk became a dance and the chant a melodic song .

title: Daolani
description: Daolani Daolani , or sand gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Sand gen had tanned skin and dark black hair .
description_long: Daolani Daolani , or sand gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Sand gen had tanned skin and dark black hair . Their squat bodies made them appear almost circular in shape . Sand gen moved about with clunkiness . Personality . Daolani were the most direct of all gen . They were never shy about telling their masters what they wanted . These selfish creatures lacked sympathy for anyone in trouble . Unlike their cousins , the mighty dao , these gen did not covet gems save for the occasional snack .

title: Dar al - Kalif
description: Dar al - Kalif Dar al - Kalif , or the Crystal Palace , was the royal palace of Abu Bakr , Caliph of Semphar . Location . Dar al - Kalif was located in the heart of Dhaztanar .
description_long: Dar al - Kalif Dar al - Kalif , or the Crystal Palace , was the royal palace of Abu Bakr , Caliph of Semphar . Location . Dar al - Kalif was located in the heart of Dhaztanar . Structure . The structure of the Crystal Palace was crowned with minarets of clear crystal rock , which was transported , at great expense , from the mines of the distant Firepeaks . Sunlight illuminated these crystal spires with radiance , giving Dhaztanar its nickname of the Shining City . A fire was lit within the tallest spire at night . Sailors on the Semphar Water could see the beacon from up to 50 miles ( 80 km ) away . Inhabitants . Abu Bakr lived within the palace .

title: Daraq
description: Daraq Daraq were the Zakhara n counterpart to the common buckler . Description . Small , and light , these shields were favored by the desert warriors of Zakhara .
description_long: Daraq Daraq were the Zakhara n counterpart to the common buckler . Description . Small , and light , these shields were favored by the desert warriors of Zakhara . Common daraqs were made from laminated hide or tortoise shell , but sturdier metal versions were available as well . Prices . The buckler sold for around 1 gp and weighed around 2 lb in the bazaars of the Land of Fate .

title: Daraqadim
description: Daraqadim El Daraqadim was a former Calishite manor located in Calimmon County in Tethyr and was one of the keeps of the duke of Ankramir before the Interregnum period . After the Reclamation Wars , the keep became the county seat of Calimmon and the home of Her Excellency Kyrin Hawkwinter . Countess Hawkwinter prefered to call the manor The Cliff , instead of its old Alzhedo name .
description_long: Daraqadim El Daraqadim was a former Calishite manor located in Calimmon County in Tethyr and was one of the keeps of the duke of Ankramir before the Interregnum period . After the Reclamation Wars , the keep became the county seat of Calimmon and the home of Her Excellency Kyrin Hawkwinter . Countess Hawkwinter prefered to call the manor The Cliff , instead of its old Alzhedo name . Location . The keep was located 25 miles directly north of Memnon . The nearest major Tethyrian city was Myratma , to the north . As the countess ' s name for it suggests , Daraqadim rested on the edge of the coastal cliffs overlooking the Sea of Swords . Structure . The Cliff had the typical features of Calishite construction — large windows and breezeways , spacious balconies , gardens , and halls . Lady Kyrin had her friend Lord Zelphar Thann design and upgrade the keep ' s defenses . She also had the stable enlarged for her many horses .

title: Darastriverthicha
description: Darastriverthicha Darastriverthicha was an ancient dragon kingdom ruled by Caesinsjach , a mighty green dragon . Its name means " Dragon Mountain " . Among its vassal states was Darastrixhurthi , a nation of kobold s ruled by her spawn , Kurtulmak , located in what is now the Shoal of Thirst .
description_long: Darastriverthicha Darastriverthicha was an ancient dragon kingdom ruled by Caesinsjach , a mighty green dragon . Its name means " Dragon Mountain " . Among its vassal states was Darastrixhurthi , a nation of kobold s ruled by her spawn , Kurtulmak , located in what is now the Shoal of Thirst . During the first Rage of Dragons , Caesinsjach and her fellow dragons destroyed Darastriverthicha and its vassal states .

title: Darathra Shendrel
description: Darathra Shendrel Darathra Shendrel was the ruler of Triboar and a member of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Darathra was an adventurer from Waterdeep in her youth , during which time she joined the Harpers .
description_long: Darathra Shendrel Darathra Shendrel was the ruler of Triboar and a member of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Darathra was an adventurer from Waterdeep in her youth , during which time she joined the Harpers . When she retired from adventuring , she became the Lord Protector of Triboar . She was also a good winemaker . She remained busy adjudicating local laws , which were then enforced by her militia , the Twelve . Personality . Darathra believed that good people must prosper free from tyranny . He was willing to give her life for the people of Triboar .

title: Darbukkah
description: Darbukkah The darbukkah ( dar - BOOK - kah ) was a medium - sized Zakharan drum . Description . The " darbukkah " was a vase - shaped drum that was wider at the top .
description_long: Darbukkah The darbukkah ( dar - BOOK - kah ) was a medium - sized Zakharan drum . Description . The " darbukkah " was a vase - shaped drum that was wider at the top . Most " darbukkah " stood 2 feet high and were played while kneeling . However , the great " darbukkahs " of the Isle of the Elephant in the Ruined Kingdoms measured 4 feet high and were played while either standing or when the drum was mounted on the side of an elephant . " Darbukkah " were carved from hard wood and adorned with decorative artistry by master craftsmen . The head was made from the tanned hides of jungle creatures .

title: Darcassan
description: Darcassan Darcassan the Farseer was a male sun elf diviner of Windsong Tower . History . During his tenure as an elder of Windsong Tower , Darcassan came close to perfecting a method of using illusion s to create simulacra of himself that were telepathically linked and could be used to better defend the Tower from unruly students or outside forces .
description_long: Darcassan Darcassan the Farseer was a male sun elf diviner of Windsong Tower . History . During his tenure as an elder of Windsong Tower , Darcassan came close to perfecting a method of using illusion s to create simulacra of himself that were telepathically linked and could be used to better defend the Tower from unruly students or outside forces . Unfortunately , before he could complete his research , he felt that in order to protect Windsong Tower ' s secrets , he would become one with the tower rather than pursuing the path of the baelnorn . He was , in 1374 DR , among the many powerful mages Khelben Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor . Darcassan was meditating in 1375 DR when shadovar broke into Windsong Tower and stole the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar . He was too taken by surprise to stop them . Once he had repaired the damage to the tower and isolated the shadovar ' s cohorts left behind , he sent one of his simulacra into Myth Drannor and found it being rebuilt by elves .

title: Dardren
description: Dardren Dardren was a wizard from Memnon in Calimshan , of the 13th century DR . Dardren was slain by Glaragama Dunrohiyr , a rogue archmage who ' d disguised herself as a man . When she killed Dardren , she revealed her true form , then stole all his magic .
description_long: Dardren Dardren was a wizard from Memnon in Calimshan , of the 13th century DR . Dardren was slain by Glaragama Dunrohiyr , a rogue archmage who ' d disguised herself as a man . When she killed Dardren , she revealed her true form , then stole all his magic .

title: Daren Timbide
description: Daren Timbide Daren Timbide was a general of the Banite army stationed at Mintar in 1372 DR . Activities . A fervent worshiper of Bane , Daren was known for the speed with which he rose through the ranks of that evil army .
description_long: Daren Timbide Daren Timbide was a general of the Banite army stationed at Mintar in 1372 DR . Activities . A fervent worshiper of Bane , Daren was known for the speed with which he rose through the ranks of that evil army . He spent most of his time inspiring his troops with rousing speeches , practicing his martial skills , and worshiping Bane at a secret shrine he called the " Thunder Room " . Appearance . A classically handsome man , Daren had long blonde hair and intense blue eyes . Possessions . Daren Timbide wore " + 2 full plate armor " while wielding a " + 1 human bane longsword " and a " + 1 heavy steel shield " .

title: Darfin Floshin
description: Darfin Floshin Sir Darfin Floshin was a sun elf advisor in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Darfin was the son of Elorfindar Floshin , who acted as guardian of a portal nexus connecting the Ardeep Forest to Evermeet .
description_long: Darfin Floshin Sir Darfin Floshin was a sun elf advisor in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Darfin was the son of Elorfindar Floshin , who acted as guardian of a portal nexus connecting the Ardeep Forest to Evermeet . For centuries , Darfin acted together with his father as advisor to the dukes of Daggerford . Eventually , his father was forced to stop some daemonfey and destroyed the portal . When his father died Darfin was freed from his family duties .

title: Dargoth
description: Dargoth Dargoth was a merchant who was a member of the Peldar Merchant Fleet , but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in Sembia . History . As a leader of the Cult , he was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR .
description_long: Dargoth Dargoth was a merchant who was a member of the Peldar Merchant Fleet , but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in Sembia . History . As a leader of the Cult , he was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR .

title: Daria
