Divine champions come from all sorts of backgrounds and are united solely by their dedication and a loose set of shared skills , though all are considered holy warriors of their various churches , dedicated to the protection of holy sites , priests , and pilgrims , as well as leaders in any crusades . Culture .
description_long: Divine champion Divine champions are powerful individuals in the service of a specific deity . Divine champions come from all sorts of backgrounds and are united solely by their dedication and a loose set of shared skills , though all are considered holy warriors of their various churches , dedicated to the protection of holy sites , priests , and pilgrims , as well as leaders in any crusades . Culture . Whereas most divine spellcaster s are bound to serve their god under tight restrictions , divine champions are a more loose - ended form of soldier among the faithful , able to carry out the will of their god in ways that others might not be able to . Divine champions have , in fact , no alignment restriction at all and are not even required to be the same alignment as their deity , as an avenger , invoker , or paladin is and while it is unlikely , an evil divine champion could serve within the church of a good god such as Bahamut , so long as their faith was true . Little unites divine champions . Most of them have a military background , but it is not a requirement .

title: Divine disciple
description: Divine disciple Divine disciples are those members of the church that have a devotion to their deity far superior to the norm , and who are chosen by their deity to act as intermediaries in the Prime Material Plane . Disciples seek to become the living embodiment of their patron and at the end of their path they ascend to become something more than mere mortals , taking on qualities of the divine . Culture .
description_long: Divine disciple Divine disciples are those members of the church that have a devotion to their deity far superior to the norm , and who are chosen by their deity to act as intermediaries in the Prime Material Plane . Disciples seek to become the living embodiment of their patron and at the end of their path they ascend to become something more than mere mortals , taking on qualities of the divine . Culture . Although all divine spellcaster s are agents of divine will in one way or another , some are more devoted than others . It is from among the most zealous and pious of the gods ' servants that divine disciples are selected , singled out by the gods as exemplars of the faith . In theory , divine disciples are expected to act as paragons of their god ' s virtue , but in practice they are no more required to match their god ' s alignment than Chosen are , and the reasoning behind a god ' s selection of a divine disciple may not take this into consideration .

title: Divine domain
description: Divine domain A divine domain is a specific area of interest for deities . A cleric of a particular deity must choose two of the deity ' s domains to focus upon , and gains access to extra spells within those domains . A deity can have as many or as few domains as it pleases , although it is usual to have at least four .
description_long: Divine domain A divine domain is a specific area of interest for deities . A cleric of a particular deity must choose two of the deity ' s domains to focus upon , and gains access to extra spells within those domains . A deity can have as many or as few domains as it pleases , although it is usual to have at least four . Some domains naturally oppose one another , such as evil and good , or chaos and law . A cleric must conform to the alignment requirements in order to focus on these domains , even if his or her deity has them .

title: Divine favor
description: Divine favor Divine favor is a evocation spell that asks the favor of a deity in combat . Effects . The first version of the spell granted the caster a higher ability to successfully strike a enemy as well as increasing the damage of said hit .
description_long: Divine favor Divine favor is a evocation spell that asks the favor of a deity in combat . Effects . The first version of the spell granted the caster a higher ability to successfully strike a enemy as well as increasing the damage of said hit . The post Second Sundering version of the spell granted radiant damage to the casters strikes . Components . Vocal and somatic components where needed for this spell , but the older version also needed a divine focus .

title: Divine magic
description: Divine magic Divine magic ( the Power ) was magic granted from prayer with the gods . While divine magic could not function without the Weave , spellcasters who used divine magic had no ability to manipulate the Weave directly . Cleric s , druid s , ranger s , paladin s , and blackguard s predominantly used this type of magic .
description_long: Divine magic Divine magic ( the Power ) was magic granted from prayer with the gods . While divine magic could not function without the Weave , spellcasters who used divine magic had no ability to manipulate the Weave directly . Cleric s , druid s , ranger s , paladin s , and blackguard s predominantly used this type of magic . Although in actuality , druids received their power directly from their patron deities , they often thought of this power as coming through nature . Only deities with a direct tie to nature could provide spell power to druids . When a divine spellcaster used such magical power granted him or her by the gods , often a tangible feeling of appreciation was felt by the caster , manifesting in different ways depending on the patron of the practitioner .

title: Divine power
description: Divine power Divine power is an evocation spell that channels holy or unholy power to strengthen the caster ' s combat abilities . Effect . Calling upon the divine power of your patron , you imbue yourself with strength and skill in combat .
description_long: Divine power Divine power is an evocation spell that channels holy or unholy power to strengthen the caster ' s combat abilities . Effect . Calling upon the divine power of your patron , you imbue yourself with strength and skill in combat . You gain the base attack bonus of a fighter of your total character level , an enhancement bonus to Strength sufficient to raise your Strength score to 18 ( if it is not already 18 or higher ) , and 1 temporary hit point per level .

title: Divine rank
description: Divine rank Divine Rank . Each deity has a divine rank . A deity ’ s divine rank determines how much power the entity has .
description_long: Divine rank Divine Rank . Each deity has a divine rank . A deity ’ s divine rank determines how much power the entity has . Rank 0 . Creatures of this rank are sometimes called quasi - deities or hero deities . Creatures that have a mortal and a deity as parents also fall into this category . These entities cannot grant spells , but are immortal and usually have one or more ability scores that are far above the norm for their species . They may have some worshipers . Ordinary mortals do not have a divine rank of 0 . They lack a divine rank altogether . Rank 1 - 5 - " Demigod " . These entities , called demigods , are the weakest of the deities . A demigod can grant spells and perform a few deeds that are beyond mortal limits . A demigod has anywhere from a few hundred to a few thousand devoted mortal worshipers and may receive veneration or respect from many more . A demigod controls a small godly realm ( usually on an Outer Plane ) and has minor control over a portfolio that includes one or more aspects of mortal existence .

title: Divine sacrifice
description: Divine sacrifice Divine Sacrifice was a necromancy spell that traded the caster ' s life force for increased damage to opponents . Effects . The caster could sacrifice life force to increase the damage dealt to opponents .
description_long: Divine sacrifice Divine Sacrifice was a necromancy spell that traded the caster ' s life force for increased damage to opponents . Effects . The caster could sacrifice life force to increase the damage dealt to opponents . When cast , he or she could sacrifice a moderate amount of health in exchange for the ability to deal a significant amount of additional damage on the next successful attack . Components . Only verbal and somatic components are required to cast this spell .

title: Divine seeker
description: Divine seeker Divine seeker is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Divine seekers are stealthy characters dedicated to the service of their patron deity and church . They are called to perform different missions , like spying on enemy churches , retrieving holy relics or even assassination of heretics .
description_long: Divine seeker Divine seeker is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Divine seekers are stealthy characters dedicated to the service of their patron deity and church . They are called to perform different missions , like spying on enemy churches , retrieving holy relics or even assassination of heretics . Most skillful divine seekers can perform a mission without leaving any evidence of their church ' s involvement . They are also trained specifically in the ways of thwarting magical traps , and like rogues they are capable of performing sneak attacks .

title: Divine word
description: Divine word Divine word was an evocation spell where the caster spoke a word imbued with the power of the first creation . Effect . Casting this spell the caster would chose creatures within 30 feet whom had to attempt to resist the spellpower of the caster .
description_long: Divine word Divine word was an evocation spell where the caster spoke a word imbued with the power of the first creation . Effect . Casting this spell the caster would chose creatures within 30 feet whom had to attempt to resist the spellpower of the caster . If the chosen are celestial s , elemental s , fey s or fiend s and cant resist the spell are sent to there natural plane and cant return for 24 hours unless they cast wish . The chosen will be affected dependant on how healthy they individually are in 4 levels . The healthiest where defend for a minute , the level bellow are defend and blinded for 10 minutes , bellow that are blinded , stunned , defend for 10 minutes and last are instantly killed . Components . Only a verbal component are needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Diviner
description: Diviner A diviner was a type of mage who specialized in divination magics . They were typically worshipers of the god Savras and fortune tellers . Notable diviners .
description_long: Diviner A diviner was a type of mage who specialized in divination magics . They were typically worshipers of the god Savras and fortune tellers . Notable diviners . Alaundo the Seer was said to be the greatest of their number . Gromph Baenre was one of the most powerful diviners in Faerûn .

title: Diviner ' s staff
description: Diviner ' s staff A diviner ' s staff is usually made from gnarled hazel and magically enhances the wielder ' s knowledge . It also contains the " identify " , " locate creature " and " locate object " spells , and two each of the " analyze dweomer " and " vision " spells . It is worth around 137 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Diviner ' s staff A diviner ' s staff is usually made from gnarled hazel and magically enhances the wielder ' s knowledge . It also contains the " identify " , " locate creature " and " locate object " spells , and two each of the " analyze dweomer " and " vision " spells . It is worth around 137 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Divisav Irithyl
description: Divisav Irithyl Divisav Irithyl was the first son of Kahvoerm Irithyl and the second of the family line to attempt to draw the Rulers ' Blade and become the Coronal of Cormanthyr in - 2900 DR . Unlike his father and all of his line to follow , Divisav failed on account of his greed and was consumed by the elfblade . He died instantly in a bout of arcane green fire .
description_long: Divisav Irithyl Divisav Irithyl was the first son of Kahvoerm Irithyl and the second of the family line to attempt to draw the Rulers ' Blade and become the Coronal of Cormanthyr in - 2900 DR . Unlike his father and all of his line to follow , Divisav failed on account of his greed and was consumed by the elfblade . He died instantly in a bout of arcane green fire . The blade was thus passed to Kahvoerm ' s youngest great - grandson , Sakrattars Irithyl , who become second Coronal .

title: Diyah al - Wasil
description: Diyah al - Wasil Diyah al - Wasil was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Diyah had oily skin that marred his complexion .
description_long: Diyah al - Wasil Diyah al - Wasil was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Diyah had oily skin that marred his complexion . Despite looking like a scoundrel , he was completely loyal to Huzuz and the Grand Caliph . Personality . Diyah ' s competency was complimented by his thoroughness , making him a perfect tax collector . Activities . Diyah was responsible for the collection of taxes and inspecting caravans passing through the Pilgrims ' Gate in Huzuz .

title: Djaffar
description: Djaffar Djaffar is the leader of the Hammers , the Marchion of Mirabar ' s personal defence . He wears a plumed open - faced helmet . On more than one occasion , some mention is made of Djaffar ' s eyeing of Shoudra Stargleam , as if to suggest he has feelings for her , and that these feelings are not returned .
description_long: Djaffar Djaffar is the leader of the Hammers , the Marchion of Mirabar ' s personal defence . He wears a plumed open - faced helmet . On more than one occasion , some mention is made of Djaffar ' s eyeing of Shoudra Stargleam , as if to suggest he has feelings for her , and that these feelings are not returned . Behind the scenes . " Volo ' s Guide to the North " refers to " Djassar " ( p . 153 ) as one of the Hammers , but " The Thousand Orcs " describes " Djaffar " ( p . 53 ) . This is likely to be the same person , so the name from the newer source is given here .

title: Djalfi
description: Djalfi Master Djalfi was a Red Wizard of Thay and an instructor of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . History . Djalfi was one of the most notorious teachers at the Academy of Shapers and Binders .
description_long: Djalfi Master Djalfi was a Red Wizard of Thay and an instructor of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . History . Djalfi was one of the most notorious teachers at the Academy of Shapers and Binders . He was one of the few in the academy who was not involved in the feud between the Founder and Araman , so when Araman seized power inside the academy , Djalfi continued his work . However he decided to help his former student and fellow instructor Safiya and the Kalach - Cha to secretly enter the building .

title: Djen
description: Djen The Djen was a large group of djinn and their slaves and servants led by the powerful djinni Calim . They came to Faerûn from an unknown place around - 7800 DR and settled the areas immediately surrounding present - day Calimport . This event was known as " The Great Arrival " and within mere months , they had built a large city , whose spires quickly rose above the trees .
description_long: Djen The Djen was a large group of djinn and their slaves and servants led by the powerful djinni Calim . They came to Faerûn from an unknown place around - 7800 DR and settled the areas immediately surrounding present - day Calimport . This event was known as " The Great Arrival " and within mere months , they had built a large city , whose spires quickly rose above the trees . They then proceeded to clear and seize all of the lands south and west of the Marching Mountains but unfortunately , after only 10 years , their city fell to a flight of dragons . Although with the genie ' s magic , the city was rebuilt within a year , the attack caused Calim to lead the Djen in a campaign against the dragons of the Marching Mountains . Within 100 years , all of the dragons in that mountain range were dead . The Djen empire lasted nearly two millennia with Calim at its head but its existence was fraught with war , first with marid s , then with efreet led by Memnon . The battles with the efreet were particularly destructive . Eventually , tired of the senseless destruction , Elven High mage s disembodied Calim and Memnon , causing the creation of the Calim Desert .

title: Djerad Kethendi
description: Djerad Kethendi Djerad Kethendi ( the " Fortress of Gems " in Draconic < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p248 " > < / ref > ) was a Tymanther an port city in the Alamber Sea . Description . Djerad Kethendi was composed of three white pyramids constructed on the southern shore of the Alamber Sea ' s estuary .
description_long: Djerad Kethendi Djerad Kethendi ( the " Fortress of Gems " in Draconic < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p248 " > < / ref > ) was a Tymanther an port city in the Alamber Sea . Description . Djerad Kethendi was composed of three white pyramids constructed on the southern shore of the Alamber Sea ' s estuary . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p248 " > < / ref > History . The dragonborn constructed Djerad Kenthendi to the south of the ruins of Unthalass . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p43 " > < / ref > After the Second Sundering , on Nightal 26 of 1486 DR , Djerad Kethendi was one of the two tymantheran big settlements that remained on Toril , alongside Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p32 " > < / ref > Soon after , the Untherite forces led by Gilgeam tried to conquer Djerad Kethendi in an attempt to recover the ruins of Unthalass , < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p58 " > < / ref > and laid siege to the city , starting the First Tymanther - Unther War . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p173 " > < / ref > The siege was broken when Nanna - Sin was resurrected by Asmodeus , and a dragon turtle servant of Nanna - Sin destroyed the Untherite navy .

title: Djerad Kusold
description: Djerad Kusold Djerad Kusold ( the " Fortress of Kusold " in Draconic ) was a ruined dragonborn city in Melabrauth . History . Before the Blue Breath of Change , Djerad Kusold was a city that served as home for the slave dragonborn population of Melabrauth .
description_long: Djerad Kusold Djerad Kusold ( the " Fortress of Kusold " in Draconic ) was a ruined dragonborn city in Melabrauth . History . Before the Blue Breath of Change , Djerad Kusold was a city that served as home for the slave dragonborn population of Melabrauth . During the Wailing Years , the dragonborn of Djerad Kusold were able to get enough dragonbane amber to start a rebellion against their dragon masters . The city became a fortress for the leaders of the rebellion . The city was later destroyed by Melauthaur the Undying One , who used powerful Dawn Titan magic to swallow Djerad Kusold under the earth . In the later years of the 15th century DR , many dragonborn adventurers risked their lives exploring the jungles of Melabrauth in hopes to find the ruins of Djerad Kusold .

title: Djerad Thymar
description: Djerad Thymar Djerad Thymar ( the " Fortress of Thymara " < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 " > < / ref > , in Draconic ) was the capital city of Tymanther . It served as the cultural nexus for the dragonborn on Faerûn . Description .
description_long: Djerad Thymar Djerad Thymar ( the " Fortress of Thymara " < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 " > < / ref > , in Draconic ) was the capital city of Tymanther . It served as the cultural nexus for the dragonborn on Faerûn . Description . Djerad Thymar was considered by some as a renowned place throughout Faerûn for its incredible size , unique shape , and virtually impenetrable architecture . Unique in its design , the entire city was one giant hollow pyramid , that rested on a foundation supported by a huge number of columns . The top of the pyramid reached 1 , 500 feet ( 460 meters ) into the sky . A wide ramp was the only land entrance to the pyramid . The city was surrounded by a few farms and homesteads , as well as by the private states of the wealthy clans , which usually were built in Unther an ruins near to Djerad Thymar . Interior . Inside the pyramid , in the lowest level were a series of agorae that looked like rings around the columns , that served as the commercial area of the city .

title: Djinn freehold
description: Djinn freehold Djinn freeholds were the homes of noble djinni who did not reside in the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Description . Freeholds were made from large chunks of earth or stone that floated around in the Elemental Plane of Air .
description_long: Djinn freehold Djinn freeholds were the homes of noble djinni who did not reside in the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Description . Freeholds were made from large chunks of earth or stone that floated around in the Elemental Plane of Air . Location . Djinn freeholds could be located on the Elemental Plane of Air or on the Prime Material Plane . Inhabitants . Each noble djinn in charge of a freehold typically had several other households of djinn beneath them . A regular household contained 15 djinn , several jann servants , and a collection of other elemental servants . Noble djinn on the Prime Material plane only had one household .

title: Djinni
description: Djinni Djinn ( singular : djinni ) were creatures born from the Elemental Chaos . Having aided the primordials in their ancient battle with the gods over control of Faerûn , most were imprisoned in common objects and scattered . The few who were free sought to reclaim their power .
description_long: Djinni Djinn ( singular : djinni ) were creatures born from the Elemental Chaos . Having aided the primordials in their ancient battle with the gods over control of Faerûn , most were imprisoned in common objects and scattered . The few who were free sought to reclaim their power . They embodied the chaotic force of violent storms while possessing benevolent minds . Only the noble djinn possessed the power of the " wish " . Ecology . Although djinn did not require food or drink to live , they enjoyed rich flavors , smells , and other sensations . They commonly desired succulent fruits , great feasts , pungent wines , fine perfumes , shimmering silks , smooth satins , soft velvets , and other rich fare . The djinn were on good terms with jann and sometimes visited their camps in the high deserts of Toril . They were cool toward the marid s , disliking their haughtiness . They openly despised dao and efreet , and only rarely hesitated before attacking them . Environment .

title: Djinni ' s Claws
description: Djinni ' s Claws The Djinni ' s Claws were a group of islands in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara , located to the west of the Steaming Isles and to the south of Jazayir al - Sartan . Little was known about these islands and no enlightened Zakharans settled there . These mountainous islands of dense jungle were dreaded as the home of pirates , genie s , and monsters .
description_long: Djinni ' s Claws The Djinni ' s Claws were a group of islands in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara , located to the west of the Steaming Isles and to the south of Jazayir al - Sartan . Little was known about these islands and no enlightened Zakharans settled there . These mountainous islands of dense jungle were dreaded as the home of pirates , genie s , and monsters . Geography . Four different groups of islands were usually recognized within the archipelago : Yadd al - Djinni ( " Hand of the Djinni " ) with the larger island of Kaff ( " Palm " ) next to it , al - Zira ( " the Arm " ) and the many small islands of Kalb Bahriy Sahr ( " Shark Reef " ) .

title: Djinni ' s Flower
description: Djinni ' s Flower The Djinni ' s Flower , or the Floating Rose , was the sailing vessel of the corsair and pirate Ghunayya . Activities . Active in the waters of the Crowded Sea , the " Djinni ' s Flower " targeted Zakharan merchant vessels so it could return their goods to Masud Jazayir .
description_long: Djinni ' s Flower The Djinni ' s Flower , or the Floating Rose , was the sailing vessel of the corsair and pirate Ghunayya . Activities . Active in the waters of the Crowded Sea , the " Djinni ' s Flower " targeted Zakharan merchant vessels so it could return their goods to Masud Jazayir .

title: Djinni Caliphate
description: Djinni Caliphate The Djinni Caliphate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the djinn . Organization . The Great Caliph , Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim , ruled over all of the noble djinni comprising the Djinni Caliphate .
description_long: Djinni Caliphate The Djinni Caliphate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the djinn . Organization . The Great Caliph , Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim , ruled over all of the noble djinni comprising the Djinni Caliphate . Husam kept 20 of his most trusted followers near him at all times . Activities . The Great Caliph and his court rarely left their stronghold . When they did it was usually a trip to Zakhara to create trouble for the great cities of the Land of Fate . Base of Operations . The Citadel of Ice and Steel within the Elemental Plane of Air served as the seat of power for the Djinni Caliphate .

title: Djinnling
description: Djinnling Djinnlings , or wind gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Wind gen usually had bluish skin and white hair .
description_long: Djinnling Djinnlings , or wind gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Wind gen usually had bluish skin and white hair . However , their appearance tended to change with their mood , remaining light blue when they were happy and turning as dark as storm clouds if they were angry or felt threatened . Their skin was almost transparent if viewed under bright light . Personality . Djinnlings were often aloof creatures who provided unwanted advice to their masters about how better to accomplish any given task . As materialistic creatures , they were impressed by wealth and trinkets .

title: Dlara
description: Dlara Dlara was a wizard in the village of Amphail . History . Dlara was a wizard from Chult who ended up working as the second - in - command of Mother Gothal ' s festhall in Amphail .
description_long: Dlara Dlara was a wizard in the village of Amphail . History . Dlara was a wizard from Chult who ended up working as the second - in - command of Mother Gothal ' s festhall in Amphail . She was very popular among the young noblemen of Waterdeep for her wrestling shows , which was an unusual sport in the North .

title: Dlorna Roaryl
description: Dlorna Roaryl Dlorna Roaryl was the princess of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . She was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality .
description_long: Dlorna Roaryl Dlorna Roaryl was the princess of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . She was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality . Dlorna was an intelligent , just , and diplomatic woman . Background . In 1479 DR , Princess Dlorna was very popular among Eskornar nobles , who wanted to elevate her to the throne to replace her father as the monarch of Eskorn . Relationships . Princess Dlorna was the younger daughter of King Ornan Roaryl , and the youngest sister of Imrar and Flandarr Roaryl .

title: Dlusk
description: Dlusk Dlusk was a small town in Aglarond , near the mouth of the River Umber . It was a fishing town of narrow streets and weathered wooden buildings in the typical Aglarondan style . As of 1368 DR , its population was around one thousand and its harbor was filled with over a hundred vessels .
description_long: Dlusk Dlusk was a small town in Aglarond , near the mouth of the River Umber . It was a fishing town of narrow streets and weathered wooden buildings in the typical Aglarondan style . As of 1368 DR , its population was around one thousand and its harbor was filled with over a hundred vessels . It held an annual festival including feasts , parades , performances , and contests , which brought visitors from across Aglarond and places like Thesk and Chessenta .

title: Dmetrio Extaminos
description: Dmetrio Extaminos Dmetrio Extaminos was a male yuan - ti sorcerer and the son of Dediana Extaminos of Hlondeth in Turmish . He was involved in a relationship with Glisena Foesmasher , the daughter of Baron Thuragar Foesmasher of Sespech , making the relationship between Hlondeth and Sespech somewhat tense . Dmetrio was also the leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the city .
description_long: Dmetrio Extaminos Dmetrio Extaminos was a male yuan - ti sorcerer and the son of Dediana Extaminos of Hlondeth in Turmish . He was involved in a relationship with Glisena Foesmasher , the daughter of Baron Thuragar Foesmasher of Sespech , making the relationship between Hlondeth and Sespech somewhat tense . Dmetrio was also the leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the city .

title: Dmitra Flass
description: Dmitra Flass Dmitra Flass was the tharchion of Eltabbar within the realm of Thay and a Red Wizard of Illusion . She often tried to settle disputes between the Zulkir s and promote foreign trade of magic items within the Red Wizards of Thay . During the war of Thay in the years 1375 DR - 1385 DR , Dmitra was elected Zulkir of Illusion , following the demise of her predecessor Mythrellan .
description_long: Dmitra Flass Dmitra Flass was the tharchion of Eltabbar within the realm of Thay and a Red Wizard of Illusion . She often tried to settle disputes between the Zulkir s and promote foreign trade of magic items within the Red Wizards of Thay . During the war of Thay in the years 1375 DR - 1385 DR , Dmitra was elected Zulkir of Illusion , following the demise of her predecessor Mythrellan . Appearance . Dmitra often wore a crimson brocade gown . Personality . Dmitra was also called " First Princess of Thay " for her sharp wits , iron will and rosa - and - alabaster comeliness . Magical abilities . As a Red Wizard of Illusion , Dmitra could plant illusion s of nightmarish assailants in an adversary ' s mind . She could change her own appearance on will . As an illusionist , Dmitra could conjure a flying horse . Background . Dmitra Flass was married to the High Blade of Mulmaster , Rassendyll Uoumdolphin , making her the Princess of Mulmaster . This political marriage has greatly increased the Red Wizards ' power within the Moonsea region . She didn ' t spend much time in company of her husband or in his town .

title: Do Jang of Won Kwang
description: Do Jang of Won Kwang The Do Jang of Won Kwang was a military academy and " " in the city of Pyong Do in Koryo . It was one of ten respected schools in the land for the teaching of martial arts , particularly tae kwon do , and techniques of honorable behavior and warfare . History .
description_long: Do Jang of Won Kwang The Do Jang of Won Kwang was a military academy and " " in the city of Pyong Do in Koryo . It was one of ten respected schools in the land for the teaching of martial arts , particularly tae kwon do , and techniques of honorable behavior and warfare . History . In 925 DR , the noted monk , scholar , and philosopher Won Kwang established a school for martial arts and other skills in the city of Pyong Do in the then kingdom of Koguryo . Known simply as " the Master " , Won set down its daily routine and rules and also built a shrine there . By 1357 DR , the Do Jang of Won Kwang was a prestigious military academy . Philosophy & Rules . Won defined five rules for the basis of the school ' s teachings and the good behavior of its students : Furthermore , no saki or any other kind of intoxicant were allowed in the " do jang " . Structure . The school included a shrine and a temple , and a main building for training . Uniform . As was common for practitioners of tae kwon do , students of the " do jang " wore training uniforms , or " " , consisting of white pants and a short white robe , tied with a belt whose color and tips denoted their grade , or " " .

title: Dock Ward of Waterdeep
description: Dock Ward of Waterdeep The Dock Ward of Waterdeep is situated on the " Great Harbor " of Waterdeep . It contains the docks , shipbuilding yards , and warehouses for the sea trade . Compared to the rest of the city it is exceptionally dirty , smelly , and particularly dangerous .
description_long: Dock Ward of Waterdeep The Dock Ward of Waterdeep is situated on the " Great Harbor " of Waterdeep . It contains the docks , shipbuilding yards , and warehouses for the sea trade . Compared to the rest of the city it is exceptionally dirty , smelly , and particularly dangerous . In the words of Elminster himself , the Dock Ward is a " riotous , nigh - perpetual brawl that covers entire acres , interrupted only by small buildings , intermittent trade businesses , an errant dog or two , and a few brave watchguards , who manage to keep the chaos from spreading beyond the docks ; the whole lot wallowing in the stench of rotting fish . " History . After the Spellplague the northern section of Waterdeep harbor became delapidated with most of the harbor choked with sunken ship hulls . This section is now known as Mistshore .

title: Dodkong
description: Dodkong The Dodkong ( meaning " Deathking " in Giant ) was the stone giant ruler of Cairnheim , and also a powerful lich . History . Grugaran was an old and frail stone giant when he recovered the artifact known as the " Crown of Obadai " from human tomb robbers .
description_long: Dodkong The Dodkong ( meaning " Deathking " in Giant ) was the stone giant ruler of Cairnheim , and also a powerful lich . History . Grugaran was an old and frail stone giant when he recovered the artifact known as the " Crown of Obadai " from human tomb robbers . He and his young lover had a plan to turn themselves into liches using the ancient stone giant artifact , so that they could rule over a reborn Nedeheim . Unfortunately , when Grugaran first attempted to use it , the crown killed his young lover . Now a heartless lich , Grugaran declared himself Dodkong and set about his goal . He gathered the displaced stone giant clans of Nedeheim and with them , he refounded the kingdom , calling it Cairnheim . The Dodkong ruled his kingdom through fear . He considered wherever he was feared to be part of his kingdom and as such commanded several hill giant clans and collected tribute from several human settlements in the region . In addition , should he choose to call upon them , he could also command several large tribes of orc s and hobgoblin s to fight for him .

title: Doegan
description: Doegan Doegan ( pronounced " durgan " ) was a realm in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It was one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East . Geography .
description_long: Doegan Doegan ( pronounced " durgan " ) was a realm in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It was one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East . Geography . It lay south of the Free Cities of Parsanic and west of the country of Edenvale . The coastal area of Doegan was known as the Doegan Shores . The land around the Capital was open and clear , with pleasant green fields and palm trees , but harsh times saw it become dry and rocky , or as rippled brown earth like dried mud with patches of broken , rougher land . Marshes lay in the northwest . The climate was hot and muggy , and even a horse would grow weary here . History . Howl of Vengeance . During the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , invaders led by Rathgar the Raider overran Doegan and laid siege to the capital . To pacify his own poor clansmen , Rathgar plundered the realm of its bounty . Finally , he came for the crown itself , and confronted the king and princess in their own throne room . However , with his dying breath , the defiant king cursed him , declaring " For so long as you rule , a curse upon you . The dead will arise , to ensure your demise .

title: Dog
description: Dog Dogs were canines prevalent throughout Toril . Description . Dogs were a race of both wild and domesticated animals that were found all over the world .
description_long: Dog Dogs were canines prevalent throughout Toril . Description . Dogs were a race of both wild and domesticated animals that were found all over the world . They came in a variety of breeds , sizes , and appearances . Ecology . They are extremely numerous and have been domesticated for use amongst the humanoid races . Training . Some of the best - trained dogs are trained by the elven House Korianthil .

title: Dog People
description: Dog People The Dog People , also called the " North Ones " , were primitive , savage , nomadic tribesmen who lived in the deserts of northern Maztica . Traits . Dog People tended to act emotionless and did not seem bothered by poverty or pain .
description_long: Dog People The Dog People , also called the " North Ones " , were primitive , savage , nomadic tribesmen who lived in the deserts of northern Maztica . Traits . Dog People tended to act emotionless and did not seem bothered by poverty or pain . They were dexterous and especially tough but often lacked the charisma or intellect of other races . Society . The Dog People lived a nomadic life in the harsh , northern lands , organized into villages . The separate tribes of Dog People never cooperated . A typical village had huts of mud or else the people lived in caves , and the populations ranged from 50 to 500 persons . They survived by growing crops in the brush and savannah regions , until a drought would occur and they were forced to find other fields . Others set traps for birds or hunted or fished for food . While they did not have an ordered civilization , they had a vibrant oral tradition . In Dog People society , men and women were equivalent ; for example , women were as likely to be warriors as men were . On rare occasions , a foreigner might impress a Dog People village and be welcomed into the tribe as a brother or sister .

title: Dog Perry
description: Dog Perry Dog Perry was the assassin in the employ of the thieves guild of Quentin Bodeau in 1364 . He was a brutal and savage man . When Artemis Entreri came back to Calimport , Perry against all reasons thought to gain great glory by killing the elder assassin .
description_long: Dog Perry Dog Perry was the assassin in the employ of the thieves guild of Quentin Bodeau in 1364 . He was a brutal and savage man . When Artemis Entreri came back to Calimport , Perry against all reasons thought to gain great glory by killing the elder assassin . Unfortunately for Perry , Enteri was more deadly than him and Enteri slew Dog Perry .

title: Doi No Fugu
description: Doi No Fugu Doi No Fugu , or Inn of the Globefish , was a famous inn in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . The story of the Doi no Fugu started in the famous inn , Nami No Hana , where after the battle of Kyoki the founder of the Akimatsu Dynasty , the semi - legendary Akimatsu Mori decided to go there for dinner .
description_long: Doi No Fugu Doi No Fugu , or Inn of the Globefish , was a famous inn in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . The story of the Doi no Fugu started in the famous inn , Nami No Hana , where after the battle of Kyoki the founder of the Akimatsu Dynasty , the semi - legendary Akimatsu Mori decided to go there for dinner . However , the local head chef was brother to a deceased soldier of the army defeated at Kioki and wanted revenge . The chef prepared the first emperor ' s dinner with some lethal fugu but the apprentice chef Sumitomo Tomy noticed something wrong and alerted the emperor . The would - be poisoner was invited to dine with the emperor , and forced to eat his own cooking . The emperor wanted to elevate Tomy to noble status but he explained that all Sumitomos were master chefs and changing his status would be a dishonor to the previous generations ; he only wanted to finish his training as a chef and maybe one day opened his own restaurant . The emperor understood and departed but later still wanted to give a recompense to the valorous and modest Tomy .

title: Doin Sanehiro
description: Doin Sanehiro Doin Sanehiro , known also as the Monkey , was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Doin was a samurai of Tomobiki in the service of the Shimamura Clan in Kanazaki Province .
description_long: Doin Sanehiro Doin Sanehiro , known also as the Monkey , was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Doin was a samurai of Tomobiki in the service of the Shimamura Clan in Kanazaki Province . He was a good but not talented fighter who found his vocation in administrative work as head of the Samuraidokoro board . In 256 DR , however , the itinerant monk Jinchin started a revolt in Kanazaki , gathering an army of ronin , bandits , criminals , and sorcerers . All samurai sent to arrest him vanished without a trace . In 257 DR , Jinchin led his huge army against the Shimamura samurai and at Kiroshima , Jinchin ' s army , joined by many oni , bakemono , and other monstrous creatures , destroyed the samurai army led by Doin and Lord Shimamura . Doin was one of the few survivors . He was convinced by fellow survivors , the Wanderer and Kuang , to go back to defend the Shiramura castle , but was too late and he found the castle burning and his family killed . So Doin decided to hide his identity and under the name " the Monkey " , and started fighting Jinchin ' s rule . He gained two more companions ; the spirit woman Onoye , and the korobokuru Okotampe .

title: Dolblunde
description: Dolblunde Dolblunde was founded in 232 DR by several rock and deep gnome clans led by Olbrent Handstone . It was located in the Upper Northdark under the hills northeast of what was to become Waterdeep . Dolblunde joined the kingdom of Phalorm when it was formed in 523 DR but was sacked and pillaged by the Everhorde in 614 DR .
description_long: Dolblunde Dolblunde was founded in 232 DR by several rock and deep gnome clans led by Olbrent Handstone . It was located in the Upper Northdark under the hills northeast of what was to become Waterdeep . Dolblunde joined the kingdom of Phalorm when it was formed in 523 DR but was sacked and pillaged by the Everhorde in 614 DR . The survivors allied themselves with Delimbiyran the following year . In 698 DR , the city was attacked yet again by priests and worshipers of Urdlen ; their human allies would not come to their aid since they were too busy fighting a civil war and repelling orc raiders . With no help forthcoming , the remaining gnome s abandoned the city and the North lands for a safer home . In 1253 DR the city became the lair of the dracolich Daurgothoth .

title: Dolerphus Thongolir IV
description: Dolerphus Thongolir IV Dolerphus Thongolir IV was the Thongolir heir . He lived in Waterdeep . He was notable for putting out a public call for a wife after becoming disgusted with the predatory nature of the daughters of wealthy nobility and merchants who sought him .
description_long: Dolerphus Thongolir IV Dolerphus Thongolir IV was the Thongolir heir . He lived in Waterdeep . He was notable for putting out a public call for a wife after becoming disgusted with the predatory nature of the daughters of wealthy nobility and merchants who sought him . He was seeking a " kind , gentle woman who loves to cook , knows how to ride , won ' t disapprove of frivolity , hard drinking , or long hours of neglect while I attend to work , and is willing to share my bed . "

title: Dolman
description: Dolman A dolman was a type of clothing worn in Zakhara . Description . These garments were floor - length robes that had sleeves .
description_long: Dolman A dolman was a type of clothing worn in Zakhara . Description . These garments were floor - length robes that had sleeves . They were very similar to aba s but were much more common in urban areas . Prices . Dolman could be purchased for 5 – 8 silver piece s .

title: Dolphin
description: Dolphin Dolphins were plentiful in the waters of Abeir - Toril . They could be found in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath where they could be seen performing the Dance of the Dolphins . They were the allies of the aquatic elves and particularly old and intelligent dolphins could be found living with them in Myth Nantar .
description_long: Dolphin Dolphins were plentiful in the waters of Abeir - Toril . They could be found in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath where they could be seen performing the Dance of the Dolphins . They were the allies of the aquatic elves and particularly old and intelligent dolphins could be found living with them in Myth Nantar .

title: Dolphin ' s Climb
description: Dolphin ' s Climb The Dolphin ' s Climb was a river located in Dambrath . Description . The Dolphin ' s Climb flowed from the southwestern range of the Gnollwatch Mountains into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins .
description_long: Dolphin ' s Climb The Dolphin ' s Climb was a river located in Dambrath . Description . The Dolphin ' s Climb flowed from the southwestern range of the Gnollwatch Mountains into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins . Locations . The city of Herath was located along the banks of the Dolphin ' s Climb .

title: Domborcojh
description: Domborcojh Domborcojh was a sapphire dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Domborcojh was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .
description_long: Domborcojh Domborcojh was a sapphire dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Domborcojh was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . He was one of the dragons Alasklerbanbastos sought out to attack Luthcheq and destroy the Brotherhood of the Griffon after the dracolich and Brimstone discovered Aoth Fezim attempts to disrupt the " xorvintaal " . During the Battle of Luthcheq , Domborcojh was freed of the compulsion of the " xorvintaal " by the dragonborn paladin Medrash , he turned against Alasklerbanbastos and Tchazzar . He later went to Dracowyr alongside the Brotherhood of the Griffon , the dragonborn Medrash and Balasar , and the surviving dragons of the Battle of Luthcheq . Together , they put an end to Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Dome Dancers
description: Dome Dancers The Dome Dancers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Haku , the Zakharan god of freedom . The Dome Dancers wielded scimitar s in both hands . Activities .
description_long: Dome Dancers The Dome Dancers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Haku , the Zakharan god of freedom . The Dome Dancers wielded scimitar s in both hands . Activities . Similar to the Dancing Dwarves , the Dome Dancers were mystics known as " dervishes " . They derived their power from vigorous dancing and twirling . Their main goal was to completely free the desert tribes from any influence of the great cities of Zakhara . They would regularly join various desert tribes in raids on the civilized folk . Members . As of 1367 DR , there were 500 Dome Dancers in Zakhara . Base of Operations . The Desert Mosque within the northern regions of the High Desert was their center of power .

title: Dome of the Rose
description: Dome of the Rose The Dome of the Rose was a monastery and temple to Lathander in Athkatla . The impressive building lay in the Gem District . Description .
description_long: Dome of the Rose The Dome of the Rose was a monastery and temple to Lathander in Athkatla . The impressive building lay in the Gem District . Description . The Dome of the Rose was a three - story temple hall , capped with a dome of rose - tinted glass . This glass glowed at dawn during the morning song and prayer services . Inhabitants . Around 1368 DR , Mornmaster Thaddin Dawnhunter was the leading priest at the temple . He was a quiet , pious priest with little trade - sense .

title: Domes of Reason
description: Domes of Reason The Domes of Reason was a temple of Oghma in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . It was formerly the seat of Grand Patriarch Cullen Kordamant , the head of the Oghmyte church and widely recognized as the " Voice of Oghma " on Toril .
description_long: Domes of Reason The Domes of Reason was a temple of Oghma in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . It was formerly the seat of Grand Patriarch Cullen Kordamant , the head of the Oghmyte church and widely recognized as the " Voice of Oghma " on Toril . However , during the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Kordamant vanished without a trace from his home in Procampur , as did much of his immediate clergy . The disappearance was a subject of much mystery and speculation . Unfortunately , answers from Oghma and other gods were confusing and contradictory , providing no clear solution . Though some thought that Kordamant simply died during the chaos , others claimed that it was actually Oghma who died , and the Grand Patriarch ascended to replace him . Many chose a middle - ground , admitting the possibility that the Patriarch might be on another plane or had ascended to semi - divinity . With the Oghmyte church left without an ultimate head , the mystery caused a growing split into rival factions , disagreeing along hierarchical and theological lines .

title: Domgarten
description: Domgarten Domgarten was a young elf scout during the late 15th century DR . History . Domgarten was one of the elf scouts of the Moonwood during the War of the Silver Marches of 1484 DR – 1485 DR .
description_long: Domgarten Domgarten was a young elf scout during the late 15th century DR . History . Domgarten was one of the elf scouts of the Moonwood during the War of the Silver Marches of 1484 DR – 1485 DR . He went with the top scout Myriel to inspect the ground of a battle between dwarves and orcs .

title: Dominate animal
description: Dominate animal Dominate animal or Dominate beast was an enchantment spell that forced an animal to obey mental commands . Effect . A dominated animal could be commanded with basic orders like " attack " , " fetch " or " run " , though it wouldn ' t obey obviously suicidal instructions or attack creatures much bigger than it .
description_long: Dominate animal Dominate animal or Dominate beast was an enchantment spell that forced an animal to obey mental commands . Effect . A dominated animal could be commanded with basic orders like " attack " , " fetch " or " run " , though it wouldn ' t obey obviously suicidal instructions or attack creatures much bigger than it . The post Second Sundering version of the spell functioned much the same as the old version , except it would last for a minute unless cast with higher levels all up to a max of 8 hours . Components . Only verbal and somantic components where needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Dominate monster
description: Dominate monster Dominate monster was a enchantment spell that allowed the caster to telepathically control any creature . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " dominate person " , except that it was not restricted by creature type or size .
description_long: Dominate monster Dominate monster was a enchantment spell that allowed the caster to telepathically control any creature . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " dominate person " , except that it was not restricted by creature type or size . Beguiling the monster the caster could give it general commands like " Attack " , " move there " and " fetch that " for a hour . The command would be followed to the creatures best ability , and the command was telepathic but could only reach its target if on the same plane . If the monster took damage it could attempt to resist the spell . The spell could be cast at a higher level to last for 8 hours .

title: Dominate person
description: Dominate person Dominate person , also simply known as domination , granted the caster control over the actions of a humanoid creature . Effect . Casting " dominate person " on a person could give complete control of that person while on the same plane .
description_long: Dominate person Dominate person , also simply known as domination , granted the caster control over the actions of a humanoid creature . Effect . Casting " dominate person " on a person could give complete control of that person while on the same plane . The caster could command the person to " Move there " , " Attack " , " Fetch " and the charmed person would attempt to follow its orders to its best ability . The spell could last days if cast by a powerful spellcaster and only those very strong of will could break the spell . but that changed after the Second Sundering where the spells lastability was based on what level the spell was cast with , to a max of 8 hours . Realmslore . The Netherese arcanist Prug was given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 1874 DR . " Dominate person " was a common spell in the Realms in the 1360s DR . In general only evil spellcasters used this spell . In many places , such as Waterdeep the use of this spell was illegal and considered magical assault . Components . Only verbal and somantic components where needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Domincus
description: Domincus Domincus was an Amn ian bishop of Helm and a member of Cordell ' s Maztica n expedition . He took his daughter , Martine , on the voyage and when she was sacrificed by the natives of Payit he demanded retribution . Domincus ' thirst for vengeance led to a short war between the Golden Legion and Payit .
description_long: Domincus Domincus was an Amn ian bishop of Helm and a member of Cordell ' s Maztica n expedition . He took his daughter , Martine , on the voyage and when she was sacrificed by the natives of Payit he demanded retribution . Domincus ' thirst for vengeance led to a short war between the Golden Legion and Payit . The Legion easily won and claimed the Payit capital of Ulatos as a spoil of war . Domincus was captured by Nexal ans during the Golden Legion ' s retreat from Nexal and was sacrificed to Zaltec .

title: Domineering
description: Domineering Domineering was a magical quality that could be applied to weapons . The wielder ' s opponent would be forced to fight defensively against a weapon with this quality . Creation .
description_long: Domineering Domineering was a magical quality that could be applied to weapons . The wielder ' s opponent would be forced to fight defensively against a weapon with this quality . Creation . In order to forge a " domineering " weapon , the caster had to have the " fear " spell available .

title: Dominion of Bone
description: Dominion of Bone The Dominion of Bone was a small organization of undead who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . In 1385 DR , the Blue Breath of Change happened and destroyed the old fortress of Glaur , transporting Laerakond from the world of Abeir to the world of Toril .
description_long: Dominion of Bone The Dominion of Bone was a small organization of undead who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . In 1385 DR , the Blue Breath of Change happened and destroyed the old fortress of Glaur , transporting Laerakond from the world of Abeir to the world of Toril . Prince Nathur Hethkantan ' s expedition to the fortress was obliterated , but Nathur himself survived as an spellscar red dracolich . Unable to leave the section of Glaur known as the Sapphire Vortex , Nathur conquered it and rename it the " Dominion of Bone " , killing any creature who entered in his domain to create an army of undead servants . As of 1479 DR , " Dominion of Bone " bore a powerful army of undead whose mission was to find either the remains or at least a relic of the primordial Nehushta . Membership . The Dominion of Bone was composed by undead created by Prince Nathur . The oldest among them were a few members of Nathur ' s original expedition that weren ' t assimilated into his body , but most members were either genasi of the Dominion of the Burned or adventurers who didn ' t survived their exploration of the Sapphire Vortex .

title: Dominion of the Burned
description: Dominion of the Burned The Dominion of the Burned was a small and isolated tribe of savage firesoul genasi who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . Genasi members of the Burned believed themselves the original strain of their race , created by the primordial Nehushta long ago to serve as her slaves .
description_long: Dominion of the Burned The Dominion of the Burned was a small and isolated tribe of savage firesoul genasi who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . Genasi members of the Burned believed themselves the original strain of their race , created by the primordial Nehushta long ago to serve as her slaves . Genasi from other regions believed the Burned to be a degraded strain instead , one that could not survive without the use of the Birthing Furnace . Although the Burned were composed only by genasi of the firesoul manifestation , it was rumored that in the distant past the tribe have had members of all manifestations . Regardless of the truth , the members of the Dominion of the Burned had lived in the fortress of Glaur for thousands of years before the Spellplague sent Returned Abeir to Toril . In 1469 DR , Brindol became the leader of the few Burned who survived an anaxim invasion . Under his leadership , the Burned were able to conquer the small section of Glaur known as the " Dominion of the Burned " . Membership . The Burned was composed only of genasi of the firesoul manifestation .

title: Dominion of the Green King
description: Dominion of the Green King Dominion of the Green King ( or XGR - 5 ) was supposed to be the final module for the Legacy of the Green Regent RPGA campaign but it was never released to Dungeon Masters . Dominion of the Green King was supposed to have been played at the Winter Fantasy convention during February 23 - 26 of 2006 .
description_long: Dominion of the Green King Dominion of the Green King ( or XGR - 5 ) was supposed to be the final module for the Legacy of the Green Regent RPGA campaign but it was never released to Dungeon Masters . Dominion of the Green King was supposed to have been played at the Winter Fantasy convention during February 23 - 26 of 2006 .

title: Domo
description: Domo Domo was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . History . In order to recover a magic bottle that he believed was in the possession of a hobgoblin tribe , he polymorph ed into the form of a boy and asked the help of an adventuring party to defeat the hobgoblins , telling them a tragic story about the death of his parents at the hands of the monsters .
description_long: Domo Domo was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . History . In order to recover a magic bottle that he believed was in the possession of a hobgoblin tribe , he polymorph ed into the form of a boy and asked the help of an adventuring party to defeat the hobgoblins , telling them a tragic story about the death of his parents at the hands of the monsters .

title: Don Turnbull
description: Don Turnbull Don Turnbull was an editor and game designer who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Turnbill began his career as a high - school math teacher , but eventually began working in the game design industry .
description_long: Don Turnbull Don Turnbull was an editor and game designer who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Turnbill began his career as a high - school math teacher , but eventually began working in the game design industry . He was one of the initial contributors to the gaming magazine , to which he regularly wrote articles as part of a feature called " The Fiend Factory " . Gary Gygax was a fan of this column , and he hired Turnbull to join TSR to manage its operations in the UK and to be the editor of a second " Monster Manual " based on " The Fiend Factory " . This book became the 1 edition " Fiend Folio " .

title: Don Vaez
description: Don Vaez Don Vaez was an adventurer who led Amn ' s second Maztica n expedition . Vaez was from Calimshan and apprenticed with a thieves guild but was not a very good rogue . He later moved to Amn and became a mercenary .
description_long: Don Vaez Don Vaez was an adventurer who led Amn ' s second Maztica n expedition . Vaez was from Calimshan and apprenticed with a thieves guild but was not a very good rogue . He later moved to Amn and became a mercenary . Cordell ' s expedition had maintained some communication with Amn through Bishop Domincus ' magic . The Council of Six became concerned when communication with the Bishop ceased after the Bishop ' s death although the Council was not aware of the reason for the cessation of communication . Vaez used the influence of a powerful noblewoman to gain a commission as leader of the second expedition . He set sail for Maztica in 1362 DR with a fleet of 25 carrack s , 1 , 500 soldiers and two dozen minor mage s . After arriving at Helmsport , Vaez imprisoned the troops Cordell had left at the fort and set about trying to find the gold Cordell had buried somewhere in the area . Several months after Don Vaez arrived at Helmsport Cordell returned with a small force . Vaez had Cordell and his men imprisoned and attempted to persuade Cordell to reveal the location of the buried gold . Shortly thereafter , Halloran arrived at the fort with a large contingent of soldiers .

title: Dondon Tiggerwillies
description: Dondon Tiggerwillies Dondon was an afflicted wererat halfling in Calimport with many underworld dealings . Personality . Dondon had the confidence of Artemis Entreri and Regis , but always sided with the strongest .
description_long: Dondon Tiggerwillies Dondon was an afflicted wererat halfling in Calimport with many underworld dealings . Personality . Dondon had the confidence of Artemis Entreri and Regis , but always sided with the strongest . History . Dondon grew up as a thief on the streets of Calimport . He used his halfling size and voice to disguise himself as a human boy in order to trigger the sympathy of his marks . He became one of Calimport ' s " most skilled con artist , " but because he was so well known locally , he only preyed on foreigners . He lived in the Coiled Snake and often worked the Rogues Circle . During the absence of both Entreri and Regis , Rassiter turned Dondon into a wererat in order to gain his loyalty . Dondon tried to lure Entreri into an ambush when the assassin returned to Calimport , but Entreri saw the truth and Dondon admitted that he greatly resented his condition . Dondon ended up indulging his gluttony and was chained up at a room in his cousin Dwahvel Tiggerwillies ' s room in the Copper Ante . Relationships . Dondon was the cousin of Dwahvel Tiggerwillies .

title: Dongzhei Nangpo
description: Dongzhei Nangpo Dongzhei Nangpo was the leader of the Yellow Mountain Sect in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Dongzhei was the master of the Temple of the Yellow Mountain .
description_long: Dongzhei Nangpo Dongzhei Nangpo was the leader of the Yellow Mountain Sect in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Dongzhei was the master of the Temple of the Yellow Mountain . His high favor with the governor of Manass allowed him to attack and harass the Yellow Mountain Sect ' s rivals in the Temple of the Red Mountain without fear of political interference .

title: Donigarten
description: Donigarten Donigarten was the name for the district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan that surrounded Lake Donigarten . Geography . The district of Donigarten was located at the easternmost side of the cavern housing the city .
description_long: Donigarten Donigarten was the name for the district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan that surrounded Lake Donigarten . Geography . The district of Donigarten was located at the easternmost side of the cavern housing the city . It bordered the districts of Narbondellyn to the south and the Braeryn to the west , and encompassed the area around the small lake of Lake Donigarten and included the Isle of Rothe inside the lake . The Eastways , three tunnels , connected Donigarten and Menzoberranzan to the Underdark beyond . These tunnels were protected from the outside by jade spider – like scorpion statues . These tunnels led to Drider ' s Chasm , the Fardrimm , and dwarven Delzoun . Description . The land was sparsely populated ( but not by drow at all ) and called the " granary of Menzoberranzan " because it produced much of the cities produce . It was filled with two moss beds , giant mushrooms , fungi farms , and irrigated dungbeds . The moss bed on the island fed the herd , while the moss bed on the shore grew delicacies for consumption . Also on the shore were separate pens used for breeding rothé and housing more exotic beasts , such as mountain sheep from the surface .

title: Donnia Soldou
description: Donnia Soldou Donnia Soldou was a drow assassin and a member of a band of four , including Ad ' non Kareese , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Donnia had long silver hair which she wore across the right half of her face covering her right eye .
description_long: Donnia Soldou Donnia Soldou was a drow assassin and a member of a band of four , including Ad ' non Kareese , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Donnia had long silver hair which she wore across the right half of her face covering her right eye . She dressed in clothes of deep gray and black , and had a cowl . Relationships . Donnia was the lover of Ad ' non . History . She was originally from Ched Nasad . Death . In 1370 DR , Donnia was killed by Drizzt Do ' Urden while trying to escape from him by levitating down a precipice ; Drizzt shot her with her own hand crossbow , paralyzing her until the levitation spell wore off and she plummeted to her death .

title: Donnola Topolino
description: Donnola Topolino Donnola Topolino was the granddaughter of Pericolo Topolino , the Grandfather of Assassins in Delthuntle , Aglarond . She served as one of the captains of Morada Topolino ( the house of Topolino ) , along with the mage Wigglefingers . Skills .
description_long: Donnola Topolino Donnola Topolino was the granddaughter of Pericolo Topolino , the Grandfather of Assassins in Delthuntle , Aglarond . She served as one of the captains of Morada Topolino ( the house of Topolino ) , along with the mage Wigglefingers . Skills . Donnola was a skilled socialite who served as the eyes and ears for her grandfather . She was also trained as a pickpocket . She was skilled with the rapier and dirk . Description . Donnola was seen as quite beautiful . She had light brown hair , a button nose , freckles , dimples , and wide brown eyes . Relationships . Donnola took Spider Parrafin ( the reincarnated Regis ) under her wing and they became quite close . In 1481 DR , they became lovers . Although he was forced to flee Delthuntle , he resolved to come back for her at some point in the future .

title: Donnor Kerth
description: Donnor Kerth Donnor Kerth was a knight of Lathander . History . Donnor was trained in the ways of Lathander by Grayth Holmfast as a member of the Order of the Aster .
description_long: Donnor Kerth Donnor Kerth was a knight of Lathander . History . Donnor was trained in the ways of Lathander by Grayth Holmfast as a member of the Order of the Aster . When in 1374 DR Grayth died during the fey ' ri invasion of Evereska , Donnor went in search of Araevin Teshurr in order to know exactly how and why Grayth died . After listening to the story , he decided to join Araevin ' s party in order to finish what Grayth had started .

title: Doom
description: Doom Doom was a necromancy spell that reduced the subject ' s combat abilities . Effect . This curse caused a single being to become consumed with dread , which caused them to weaken and lose confidence .
description_long: Doom Doom was a necromancy spell that reduced the subject ' s combat abilities . Effect . This curse caused a single being to become consumed with dread , which caused them to weaken and lose confidence . The subject ' s attack ability , skills , and ability to avoid the effects of spells were all reduced .

title: Doomguard
description: Doomguard The Doomguard ( nicknamed Sinkers ) was one of the " official " philosophical and political factions of Sigil . Their belief was that the decay and entropy of everything was not only inevitable but a good thing , and what was " supposed " to happen . Though they did not generally act only to destroy everything they came across , they were in favour of the ideas of entropy and chaos and may well have been disposed to help them along in ways they saw as suitable .
description_long: Doomguard The Doomguard ( nicknamed Sinkers ) was one of the " official " philosophical and political factions of Sigil . Their belief was that the decay and entropy of everything was not only inevitable but a good thing , and what was " supposed " to happen . Though they did not generally act only to destroy everything they came across , they were in favour of the ideas of entropy and chaos and may well have been disposed to help them along in ways they saw as suitable . They were also not likely to worry much about the cessation , decay or destruction of anything , since that would have been against their tenets . They found common ground with the Bleak Cabal , a faction that believed nothing had any meaning , and the Dustmen , who believed this life is nothing but a bleak afterlife to be transcended by reaching oblivion . On the other hand , the Doomguard was at odds with the Harmonium and the Fraternity of Order , two factions that placed much importance on order . The Doomguard had a tower called Citadel Alluvius on the Plane of Dust , where everything slowly disintegrated into dust .

title: Doomguide
description: Doomguide Doomguides are devoted cleric s and paladin s of Kelemvor , god of the dead , whom they serve , along with the people of Faerûn , by helping mortals deal with their fears of death and existence after the fact . In order to help combat these fears , many of which are tied to the works of necromancer s , doomguides also serve as elite divine spellcasters who seek out necromancers and their undead servitors to destroy them and bring a measure of peace to the world . To doomguides and their god there is no greater abomination than the undead and doomguides train throughout their careers to free these souls and send them on their way to the City of Judgment .
description_long: Doomguide Doomguides are devoted cleric s and paladin s of Kelemvor , god of the dead , whom they serve , along with the people of Faerûn , by helping mortals deal with their fears of death and existence after the fact . In order to help combat these fears , many of which are tied to the works of necromancer s , doomguides also serve as elite divine spellcasters who seek out necromancers and their undead servitors to destroy them and bring a measure of peace to the world . To doomguides and their god there is no greater abomination than the undead and doomguides train throughout their careers to free these souls and send them on their way to the City of Judgment . To aid them Kelemvor grants his priests some measure of his power and grace , instilling doomguides with a power over death that fills the undead and their masters with fear . Culture . While important as hunters of the undead , for doomguides this is merely a secondary role they take up when necessary and all doomguides understand the need to both lay the undead to rest and comfort the living , regardless of their personal preferences .

title: Doomsayer
description: Doomsayer Doomsayers are specialized warlock s of the star pact , who delve into the maddening knowledge of the Far Realm willingly . With this eldritch lore , doomsayers can enhance their powers and affect the fate of others , issuing dark proclamations of doom that all too often prove to true . Doomsayers are not necessarily evil , but they are all dangerous .
description_long: Doomsayer Doomsayers are specialized warlock s of the star pact , who delve into the maddening knowledge of the Far Realm willingly . With this eldritch lore , doomsayers can enhance their powers and affect the fate of others , issuing dark proclamations of doom that all too often prove to true . Doomsayers are not necessarily evil , but they are all dangerous . Abilities . Doomsayers are deadly warlocks to cross , gaining arcane power from beyond the eyes of even the god s . Even warlocks who have only begun to learn the ways of a doomsayer are deadly , cursing their enemies with deadly effect . These same doomsayer initiates learn to enhance their fearsome reputation , making them terrifying even without the full breadth of their power and making it all the more difficult for enemies to retain their courage whilst in battle with then . With further training , even injuring a doomsayer can be dangerous , as the warlocks channel their pain into horrific power that strikes fear into the hearts of their foes . Doomsayer spell s , as one might expect , focus primarily on using fear itself as a weapon .

title: Doomvault
description: Doomvault The Doomvault of Thay was a massive dungeon containing laboratories used by Szass Tam to fuel his ascension to godhood . Geography . The Doomvault was located deep beneath Thaymount .
description_long: Doomvault The Doomvault of Thay was a massive dungeon containing laboratories used by Szass Tam to fuel his ascension to godhood . Geography . The Doomvault was located deep beneath Thaymount . Defenses . As an ancient dungeon located in the magical realm of Thay , the Doomvault was defended by numerous powerful Red Wizards , their golem servants , and a multitude of varied monsters , bound outsider s , and raised undead , as well as magical traps and natural hazards . History . The Red Wizard Kazit Gul spent the vast majority of his lifespan studying the most famous and deadly dungeons in Faerûn . Towards the end of his life , he began constructing a vast labyrinth and successfully pursued lich dom in order to finish his work . The purpose of the dungeon was to lure adventurers inside where Kazit Gul could then devour their souls to empower his phylactery . The Doomvault passed into legend as Thay became a less welcoming place to foreigners but Szass Tam rediscovered and repurposed it to his own ends . When Tam learned of the Second Sundering , he had his agents capture several Chosen for experimentation .

title: Doomwarding
description: Doomwarding Doomwarding is a quality that can be applied to weapons , usually those wielded by followers of Tymora . The quality usually gives the weapon seven charges , one of which can be used by the wielder to give a very brief burst of speed or to improve one attack . Creation .
description_long: Doomwarding Doomwarding is a quality that can be applied to weapons , usually those wielded by followers of Tymora . The quality usually gives the weapon seven charges , one of which can be used by the wielder to give a very brief burst of speed or to improve one attack . Creation . Applying the " doomwarding " quality requires the expenditure of a " limited wish " , 1 , 500 gold pieces , and a fairly small amount of time .

title: Doppelganger
description: Doppelganger Doppelgangers were monstrous humanoids , infamous for their shapeshifting abilities that allowed them to mimic almost any humanoid creature . They were lazy but cunning creatures , who killed or disposed of people then assumed their place . While not actually evil , doppelgangers were extremely self - centered and liable to look down on their victims .
description_long: Doppelganger Doppelgangers were monstrous humanoids , infamous for their shapeshifting abilities that allowed them to mimic almost any humanoid creature . They were lazy but cunning creatures , who killed or disposed of people then assumed their place . While not actually evil , doppelgangers were extremely self - centered and liable to look down on their victims . They were believed to be an artificial race , created by the Creator Race known as the batrachi . They had a fondness for working with the magically inclined ; mainly being used as assassin s or in elaborate plots to usurp power . Doppelgangers were feared for their ability to assume the form of any humanoid creature they encounter . Doppelgangers were used as spies and assassins by many beings all over the world . Many doppelgangers lived a stolen life . When they encountered a person whose appearance or station they desired for themselves , the doppelganger used their mental powers to learn everything they could about the chosen target . Once they had all the knowledge they needed , they quietly eliminated their target and assumed his or her form , taking their place in life . Physical characteristics .

title: Doquaio Baenre
description: Doquaio Baenre Doquaio Baenre was the second - boy of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre at the time of Jarlaxle Baenre ' s birth . History . When Doquaio ' s younger brother Jarlaxle was born , he was set to be killed in a ritual because he was the third - born son .
description_long: Doquaio Baenre Doquaio Baenre was the second - boy of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre at the time of Jarlaxle Baenre ' s birth . History . When Doquaio ' s younger brother Jarlaxle was born , he was set to be killed in a ritual because he was the third - born son . During the ritual , Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre continually stabbed at Jarlaxle but failed to break his skin . Doquaio was ordered to assist , but as he grabbed the infant , all of the kinetic energy of the attempted sacrifice was reflected on to him through the psionic power of the matron mother of House Oblodra , K ' yorl Odran . Doquaio was killed , but Jarlaxle ' s life was spared . Relationships . Doquaio was the son of Yvonnel Baenre and the older brother of Jarlaxle .

title: Dorban Smokestone
description: Dorban Smokestone Dorban Smokestone was a dwarf cleric of Mammon . He lived in a dwarf community , and , as a follower of Mammon , used his vast wealth to pay thieves and assassins to kill his enemies . Equipment .
description_long: Dorban Smokestone Dorban Smokestone was a dwarf cleric of Mammon . He lived in a dwarf community , and , as a follower of Mammon , used his vast wealth to pay thieves and assassins to kill his enemies . Equipment . Dorban used a magic heavy mace and wore magic and poison ed spiked plate armor with a " brooch of shielding " . He carried a " wand of cure light wounds " and a large metal shield .

title: Dorbo Diggermattock
description: Dorbo Diggermattock Dorbo Diggermattock and his wife Senni Diggermattock were the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dorbo oversaw the rebuilding of palaces and the reopening of mines , plus organizing patrols to explore as - yet - unexplored parts of the city and to defend the new citizens .
description_long: Dorbo Diggermattock Dorbo Diggermattock and his wife Senni Diggermattock were the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dorbo oversaw the rebuilding of palaces and the reopening of mines , plus organizing patrols to explore as - yet - unexplored parts of the city and to defend the new citizens . Personality .
