title: Dragon turtle
description: Dragon turtle Dragon turtles were aquatic creatures that were related to dragons . They were considered among the most dangerous aquatic creatures in existence and were even worshiped by some . Description .
description_long: Dragon turtle Dragon turtles were aquatic creatures that were related to dragons . They were considered among the most dangerous aquatic creatures in existence and were even worshiped by some . Description . Dragon turtles were distantly related to dragons and had dragon blood . They appeared as huge turtle - like creatures with a long tail and neck with large , taloned flippers . Their heads had a golden crest down the center . Shell . The shell of a turtle dragon measured between 15 and 25 feet in diameter and was strong enough to leave it almost impossible to harm . The shells were streamlined with jagged protrusions . The shell was often a shade of deep green , similar to the color of the ocean , with silver highlights running along the raised areas . This meant that a surfacing dragon turtle was often mistaken for light reflecting on the water . Due to the shell ' s immense strength , shields made from dragon turtle shells were exceptionally tough and had resistance to heat or steam attacks . Their shells were also valued for use as book covers , jewellery , spell components , furniture , or as a building material . Personality .

title: Dragonback Inn
description: Dragonback Inn The Dragonback Inn was a large building with fieldstone walls to chest height and wooden walls above , supported by thick timbers . The windows were made from dark - green , leaded glass , and above the door there hung a wooden sign . A dragon skull hanged over the fireplace in the main room , and the walls were decorated with banners and shields .
description_long: Dragonback Inn The Dragonback Inn was a large building with fieldstone walls to chest height and wooden walls above , supported by thick timbers . The windows were made from dark - green , leaded glass , and above the door there hung a wooden sign . A dragon skull hanged over the fireplace in the main room , and the walls were decorated with banners and shields . The Dragonback ' s owner was a heavyset dwarf with white whiskers and a red nose .

title: Dragonbait
description: Dragonbait Dragonbait ( also referred to as Champion ) is the finhead saurial companion of the adventurer Alias . Dragonbait is a paladin of the God of Law from his world , with his spells currently provided by the god Tyr . He was brought over into this world by a cruel trick of Moander ( prior to the Rotting God ' s death at the hand of Finder Wyvernspur during the Godswar ) along with a small portion of his people .
description_long: Dragonbait Dragonbait ( also referred to as Champion ) is the finhead saurial companion of the adventurer Alias . Dragonbait is a paladin of the God of Law from his world , with his spells currently provided by the god Tyr . He was brought over into this world by a cruel trick of Moander ( prior to the Rotting God ' s death at the hand of Finder Wyvernspur during the Godswar ) along with a small portion of his people . Dragonbait cannot speak Common and communication is difficult for him . He first appears in the 2E novel " Azure Bonds " by Kate Novak and Jeff Grubb . Appearance . Dragonbait stands roughly five feet in height , not counting the troglodyte - like head fin , though that is only in consequence to his posture , being canted forward at the hips , and balanced by a tail near long as his torso . His mouth is thinner and more rounded than the lizard - men of Faerûn , lipless to show sharp teeth to the fore and rounded molars to the rear . His scales are small and smooth , like beadwork .

title: Dragonbane
description: Dragonbane Dragonbane was an abjuration spell that warded an area against intrusion by dragon s . Effects . Any dragon that failed to resist " dragonbane " was physically unable to enter the protected area for the duration of the spell .
description_long: Dragonbane Dragonbane was an abjuration spell that warded an area against intrusion by dragon s . Effects . Any dragon that failed to resist " dragonbane " was physically unable to enter the protected area for the duration of the spell . Spellcasting , breath weapons , or hurled objects were not prevented from crossing the barrier . The area of effect was a cube whose sides were the caster ' s level times 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) . Any dragons already within the area when the spell was cast were not affected by this spell unless they left the area and attempted to reenter . The duration of " dragonbane " was only a few minutes but could be extended greatly by use of a " focus " spell . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the priest ' s holy symbol and a scale from a dragon .

title: Dragonbane amber
description: Dragonbane amber Dragonbane amber was a type of magic al amber crystal usually found underground in Returned Abeir . Powers . The dragonbane amber had the quality to greatly weaken any nearby dragon s to the point of killing them if exposed to the crystal during prolonged periods of time , hence the name .
description_long: Dragonbane amber Dragonbane amber was a type of magic al amber crystal usually found underground in Returned Abeir . Powers . The dragonbane amber had the quality to greatly weaken any nearby dragon s to the point of killing them if exposed to the crystal during prolonged periods of time , hence the name . History . Small quantities of dragonbane amber were uncovered after the Spellplague transported Returned Abeir to Toril , in more quantities in the lands of Skelkor than in other regions of the continent . Although small , those quantities of dragonbane amber were enough to kill a lot of dragons . Dragonborn slaves across the lands were able to get enough dragonbane amber to start a rebellion during the Wailing Years , killing many dragons and even destroying a few dragon empires . Among the most fierce rebellions were those of Skelkor and Djerad Kusold in Melabrauth . Eventually , however , the reserves of dragonbane amber were depleted and dragons were able to retaliate and destroy the rebels . In the 15th century DR , many adventurers and dragonslayers braved the dangerous lands of Skelkor and other dragon ruled nations in hopes to find new veins of dragonbane amber .

title: Dragonbloods
description: Dragonbloods The Dragonbloods were a Luskan gang whose members were predominately Shou . The gang ' s headquarters was the Dragon ' s Lair , a reconstructed watch barracks . Their leader , Umbra , was rumored to be a dragon although in reality he was some sort of doppelganger .
description_long: Dragonbloods The Dragonbloods were a Luskan gang whose members were predominately Shou . The gang ' s headquarters was the Dragon ' s Lair , a reconstructed watch barracks . Their leader , Umbra , was rumored to be a dragon although in reality he was some sort of doppelganger . Each member of the gang had a dragon tattoo with older members having elaborate tattoos that covered most of their torsos . The color of the dragon matched the personality of the gang member .

title: Dragonbones
description: Dragonbones The Dragonbones was seemingly bottomless gulf located in Fimbrul , where all dragon s in Returned Abeir went to die . Background . It was believed that dying dragons when to Dragonbones and killed themselves by crashing against the gulf , mingling their bones with those of long dead dragons .
description_long: Dragonbones The Dragonbones was seemingly bottomless gulf located in Fimbrul , where all dragon s in Returned Abeir went to die . Background . It was believed that dying dragons when to Dragonbones and killed themselves by crashing against the gulf , mingling their bones with those of long dead dragons . When dragons died in other regions of Returned Abeir , usually someone picked up one of its scales and went to Dragonbones to cast it down , for good luck . History . As of 1479 DR , no spellcaster was able to use up the powerful arcane energies that suffused the Dragonbones .

title: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn Dragonborn ( also known as Strixiki in Draconic ; or Vayemniri , " Ash - Marked Ones " , in Tymantheran Draconic ) were a race of native to Abeir , Toril ' s long - sundered twin . During the Spellplague the dragonborn nation of Tymanchebar was placed where Unther had once been , creating the nation of Tymanther , where most dragonborn of Faerûn dwelt in the 15th century DR . Dragonborn had a strong hatred of dragon s , who had enslaved them on Abeir .
description_long: Dragonborn Dragonborn ( also known as Strixiki in Draconic ; or Vayemniri , " Ash - Marked Ones " , in Tymantheran Draconic ) were a race of native to Abeir , Toril ' s long - sundered twin . During the Spellplague the dragonborn nation of Tymanchebar was placed where Unther had once been , creating the nation of Tymanther , where most dragonborn of Faerûn dwelt in the 15th century DR . Dragonborn had a strong hatred of dragon s , who had enslaved them on Abeir . Description . Standing on average around 6 ' 2 " – 6 ' 8 " ( 1 . 88 – 2 . 03 meters ) , dragonborn were impressively tall with a heavy weight to match , commonly possessing a mass of 220 – 320 lbs ( 100 – 145 kg ) . Dragonborn feet ended with three strong talon - like claws with a fourth claw in the back , while their hands were similar with three claws with a thumb replacing the rear claw . A dragonborn ' s head featured a blunt snout , a strong brow , and reptilian frills on the cheeks and ears . On the back of the head , a crest of hornlike scales formed what resembled a mess of ropy hair . Dragonborn eyes were usually red or gold in hue . Dragonborn resembled in many ways what their name suggests : humanoid dragons .

title: Dragonborn of Bahamut
description: Dragonborn of Bahamut Dragonborn of Bahamut ( also known as Ux Bahamuti in Draconic ) were a race of created by the deity Bahamut during the Time of Dragons to act as his emissaries in the mortal realm . Unlike normal creatures , dragonborn of Bahamut weren ' t born naturally , but instead were creatures reborn from good - aligned non - draconic humanoids who , to show their devotion to Bahamut , willingly took on draconic traits in place of their original biology . Dragonborn of Bahamut were powerful creatures who resembled their adoptive father .
description_long: Dragonborn of Bahamut Dragonborn of Bahamut ( also known as Ux Bahamuti in Draconic ) were a race of created by the deity Bahamut during the Time of Dragons to act as his emissaries in the mortal realm . Unlike normal creatures , dragonborn of Bahamut weren ' t born naturally , but instead were creatures reborn from good - aligned non - draconic humanoids who , to show their devotion to Bahamut , willingly took on draconic traits in place of their original biology . Dragonborn of Bahamut were powerful creatures who resembled their adoptive father . They had strong determination and were natural leaders , who took on the responsibility to lead the battle against their aberrant antithesis , the spawn of Tiamat . Description . After they underwent the " Rite of Rebirth " , the new dragonborn experienced such transformation that only the framework of their former appearance was all that remained , their new appearance giving an impression of virtuous purpose to all those who looked upon them . They were reborn into new draconic bodies , inheriting the best traits of metallic dragon s , although a few developed traits of song dragon s instead .

title: Dragoneye Dealing Coster
description: Dragoneye Dealing Coster The Dragoneye Dealing Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant company was originally founded by two brothers who did not want to ship overland to avoid pirates only to loose their goods to roadside bandits .
description_long: Dragoneye Dealing Coster The Dragoneye Dealing Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant company was originally founded by two brothers who did not want to ship overland to avoid pirates only to loose their goods to roadside bandits . Base of Operations . The Dragoneye Dealing Coster was based in Cimbar , but they also had headquarters in Iriaebor and Elturel .

title: Dragonfall War
description: Dragonfall War The Dragonfall War was a conflict between the draconic followers of Bahamut and Tiamat . In some respects the conflict never ended . It began in the Time of Dragons , a period that lasted about six millennia from c .
description_long: Dragonfall War The Dragonfall War was a conflict between the draconic followers of Bahamut and Tiamat . In some respects the conflict never ended . It began in the Time of Dragons , a period that lasted about six millennia from c . - 30000 DR . It began when followers of Xymor ( Bahamut ) slew Nagamat , a wyrm - general of Tiamat . Tiamat unleashed all sorts of dragonlike beings during the war , breeding warped creatures from her eggs . These aberrant entities became known as the Spawn of Tiamat . To counter them , Bahamut created his own agents , the dragonborn of Bahamut . The most recent era of conflict in the war occurred between - 2087 DR and - 1071 DR in Unther . Upon the arrival of Tiamat ' s cult in Unther , priests of Enlil began to claim that she was the " Nemesis of the Gods " and the god - kings claimed that she was responsible for Untherian setbacks . This conflict was concluded with the death of Tiamat at the hands of Marduk ( who was also killed ) during the Battle of the Gods in - 1071 DR . After the last Rage of Dragons , in 1373 DR , the dragon population of Faerûn regained their interest in worshiping the Draconic pantheon .

title: Dragonfang bolt
description: Dragonfang bolt Dragonfang bolt was a spell used by many sorcerer s who were inexperienced or had not yet obtained a vast amount of power . " Dragonfang bolt " , when cast , caused several venomous dragon fangs to appear in mid - air , which the sorcerer could then hurl towards one or two creatures within fifty feet of the caster , inevitably striking them and quite possibly poisoning them . The spell was not one that comes easily and " dragonfang bolt " could only be cast once per day .

title: Dragonfrost
description: Dragonfrost Dragonfrost is a spell similar to " ray of frost " used by sorcerer s , particularly dragon sorcerers . When it is cast , " dragonfrost " slams an icy gust into a creature of the sorcerer ' s choice within fifty feet , pushing them back up to five feet and causing them injury from its frigid power , which is fueled by the sorcerer ' s charisma like virtually all sorcerer spells . " Dragonfrost " is instantly recastable and its power grows as the sorcerer using it does .

title: Dragonheir
description: Dragonheir The Dragonheirs , formerly known as Dragonmasters , were an Abeir an human bloodline who had been granted the power to control dragon s by the primordials . Abilities . Dragonheirs had the ability to control dragons by gaze , voice , or touch .
description_long: Dragonheir The Dragonheirs , formerly known as Dragonmasters , were an Abeir an human bloodline who had been granted the power to control dragon s by the primordials . Abilities . Dragonheirs had the ability to control dragons by gaze , voice , or touch . A few legends told that the most powerful dragonheirs could harm dragons by gaze or by touch , as well . A dragon affected by the powers of a dragonheir was forced to flee to a remote place and sink into a deep torpor . History . The original dragonmasters were the roost masters of the primordials , humans charged to keep their dragon steeds in check . After the dragons defeated the primordials , they began to systematically kill any known dragonmaster , until only a few individuals remained . The most prominent surviving heirs of the dragonmasters , called dragonheirs in modern times , were those of the Arkeld , Horndragon , Marlserpent , and Relguld clans . The dragons also purged any dragonheir they knew about , and eventually they exterminated the Horndragon and Marlserpent bloodlines , while leaving only a few survivors of the Arkeld and Relguld clans . Notable Members .

title: Dragonheir Clans
description: Dragonheir Clans Dragonheir Clans was an Abeir an book that chronicled the story of the Dragonheir s of the Sword Lands , and recorded the genealogy of every Dragonheir clan that had existed . History . In 1479 DR , the book came into possession of the adventuress Jada Marlserpent , the last survivor of Clan Marlserpent .

title: Dragonisle
description: Dragonisle Dragonisle ( sometimes The Dragonisle ) is the largest island in the Pirate Isles . It is populated by around 4 , 000 pirates and is geographically dominated by the Earthspur , an 8 , 000ft ( 2 , 438m ) mountain at the southern end of the island . The island has historically been the seat of power for anyone controlling the islands as a whole .

title: Dragonjaw Mountains
description: Dragonjaw Mountains The Dragonjaw Mountains were mountains in Thesk inhabited by gnome s and copper dragon s . The gnomes were frequent visitors to the human city of Milvarune where they traded their crafts . The dragons were known to enter annual joke - telling competitions with the gnomes .
description_long: Dragonjaw Mountains The Dragonjaw Mountains were mountains in Thesk inhabited by gnome s and copper dragon s . The gnomes were frequent visitors to the human city of Milvarune where they traded their crafts . The dragons were known to enter annual joke - telling competitions with the gnomes . The village of Tegea was located in the southern reaches of the Dragonjaw Mountains . The village was cursed by Duke Gorgias , but the curse was lifted by Patriarch Adon of Mystra and his novice , Corene .

title: Dragonmere
description: Dragonmere The Dragonmere ( also known as the Lake of Dragons ) was a lake on the Dragon Coast at the western edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Cormyr and Sembia were on the northern part of this lake , with the Dragon Coast along the south . The Dragonmere was almost 100 miles from north to south at its widest point .
description_long: Dragonmere The Dragonmere ( also known as the Lake of Dragons ) was a lake on the Dragon Coast at the western edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Cormyr and Sembia were on the northern part of this lake , with the Dragon Coast along the south . The Dragonmere was almost 100 miles from north to south at its widest point . As of 1372 DR , at its narrowest point it was ten miles wide , with Westgate to the south , and Urmlaspyr to the north .

title: Dragonne
description: Dragonne Dragonnes are dangerous monsters that possess the ferocity of a lion and the cunning of a dragon . They appear to be lions covered in brass - colored scales with massive wings like those of a dragon . Dragonnes are highly territorial and will attack any invading creatures in their home .
description_long: Dragonne Dragonnes are dangerous monsters that possess the ferocity of a lion and the cunning of a dragon . They appear to be lions covered in brass - colored scales with massive wings like those of a dragon . Dragonnes are highly territorial and will attack any invading creatures in their home . They are not generally evil or malicious , allowing any intruders the opportunity to flee before they attack . Those who do not leave a dragonne ’ s lair will find themselves quickly set upon by a savage opponent . The roar of a dragonne is its greatest weapon . Those who hear this creature ’ s roar find their minds and body weakened , leaving them vulnerable to the attacks of the dragonne . A dragonne possesses huge claws and fangs , and large eyes , usually the color of its scales . A dragonne is about 12 feet long and weighs about 700 pounds . Dragonnes speak Draconic . Combat . A dragonne ’ s wings are useful only for short flights , carrying the creature for 10 to 30 minutes at a time . Nevertheless , it uses its wings effectively in battle . If opponents attempt to charge or encircle it , the dragonne simply takes to the air and finds a more defensible position . Maztica .

title: Dragonriders Club
description: Dragonriders Club The Dragonriders Club is a private club in Suzail , owned by Tress , that is the favorite nightime hangout of many nobles and wealthy merchants . The club ' s primary attraction is its beautiful Mask Dancers who dance on stages wearing nothing but a mask . During the daytime hours the club offers meals and services such as haircuts and baths to its members .
description_long: Dragonriders Club The Dragonriders Club is a private club in Suzail , owned by Tress , that is the favorite nightime hangout of many nobles and wealthy merchants . The club ' s primary attraction is its beautiful Mask Dancers who dance on stages wearing nothing but a mask . During the daytime hours the club offers meals and services such as haircuts and baths to its members . Amarune Whitewave dances at the club and is one of the most popular dancers . In 1479 DR the club was heavily damaged during a brawl between nobles .

title: Dragonslayer ( tribe )
description: Dragonslayer ( tribe ) The Dragonslayer tribe was a tribe of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . As their name told , they claimed to have slain a number of dragon s . Base of Operations .
description_long: Dragonslayer ( tribe ) The Dragonslayer tribe was a tribe of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . As their name told , they claimed to have slain a number of dragon s . Base of Operations . The Dragonslayer tribe had territory on the central eastern side of the Vast Swamp , where it flanked the Thunder Peaks . Relationships . Around 1367 DR , Dragonslayer territory lay south of the lands of the Darkstar orc tribe . History . The Dragonslayer tribe was known to live in the Vast Swamp around 1367 DR . They had claimed the credit for slaying several black dragon s over the decades . The last kill they claimed was of Tyra . The victorious Dragonslayers then moved into her lair . However , Tyra ' s brother Despayr had a dream of her death to the Dragonslayers , and of her unguarded hoard . Following his visions , Despayr came to Tyra ' s lair , massacred many of the lizardfolk , and enslaved the survivors . He then took her lair and hoard as his own . He had a daughter by one of the lizardfolk , Ketsarra Shadowscale , who became their new chieftain . In time , Despayr was visited by Esvele Graycastle , who retrieved from the treasure the " shadow shard " .

title: Dragonsoul heir
description: Dragonsoul heir Dragonsoul heirs , also known as dragon disciples , are an elite form of dragon sorcerer s . These spellcasters tap into the lingering residue of dragon blood within their bodies , unleashing it in the form of draconic abilities . As a dragonsoul heir progresses along the path they began , their physical appearance begins to change , becoming more and more dragon like as they realize the power within their blood .
description_long: Dragonsoul heir Dragonsoul heirs , also known as dragon disciples , are an elite form of dragon sorcerer s . These spellcasters tap into the lingering residue of dragon blood within their bodies , unleashing it in the form of draconic abilities . As a dragonsoul heir progresses along the path they began , their physical appearance begins to change , becoming more and more dragon like as they realize the power within their blood . Dragonsoul heirs , as such , emulate the sorcerous power of some of the most powerful dragons . Culture . It is an accepted fact that , from time to time , dragons choose to take humanoid form . In some such cases , the dragon mates with one of the humanoid species , usually leaving behind the child . While such cases , and the half - dragon s who result , are extraordinarily rare , they are common enough that individuals with a smaller fraction of draconic blood are not entirely uncommon , nor are those who have been exposed to draconic power through other means , such as the unnatural fusing of dragonic blood to their bodies .

title: Dragonspawn
description: Dragonspawn Dragonspawn , also known as the spawn of Tiamat , were a type of creatures descended from true dragon s . They were the antithesis of the dragonborn of Bahamut . Description .
description_long: Dragonspawn Dragonspawn , also known as the spawn of Tiamat , were a type of creatures descended from true dragon s . They were the antithesis of the dragonborn of Bahamut . Description . Kobold s and urd s were considered to be members of the dragonspawn group . While the mutant variants of dragonspawn were based on the five common chromatic dragons , there were a few species bred from other kinds of chromatics . Among dragon s devoted to Tiamat , the birth of a spawn of Tiamat was considered a sign of their goddess ' s favor . Psychology . Spawn of Tiamat were deeply loyal to their goddess , as they were created with a predisposition to serve the Dark Lady . They also shared her undying hatred of good dragonkind , and they disdained non - dragons of all sorts . They usually worked alongside of other creatures , whether in packs of their kind or with like - minded individuals of other races , particularly evil dragons . History . The first breeds of dragonspawn were kobolds and urds , appearing around −24 , 500 DR .

title: Dragonspear Castle
description: Dragonspear Castle Dragonspear Castle was a fortress , built across three low hills on the southwestern edge of the High Moor , east of Trollbark Forest and just north of where the Coast Way joins the Trade Way . Extensive tunnels were dug under the keep , connecting with an underground river , the already - abandoned city of Kanaglym , and hence the larger Underdark . The Castle became most notable for its interplanar portals , through which come baatezu and other fiends .
description_long: Dragonspear Castle Dragonspear Castle was a fortress , built across three low hills on the southwestern edge of the High Moor , east of Trollbark Forest and just north of where the Coast Way joins the Trade Way . Extensive tunnels were dug under the keep , connecting with an underground river , the already - abandoned city of Kanaglym , and hence the larger Underdark . The Castle became most notable for its interplanar portals , through which come baatezu and other fiends . History . The castle was built in 1255 DR by the half - dwarf Daeros Dragonspear , around the lair of his ally Halatathlaer . Ithtaerus Casalia set in motion the destruction of the Castle by creating a portal in 1290 , and following the exodus of its defenders it was taken over by various tribes of humanoids , notably hobgoblins . In 1315 , armies from Waterdeep and Baldur ' s Gate cleared out the ruin and built a temple of Tempus . One or more hostile entities including the Zhentarim opened new portals , and by 1354 the castle was controlled by devils . The next years were spent fighting off fiends and the humanoid armies they gathered .

title: Dragonspine Mountains
description: Dragonspine Mountains The Dragonspine Mountains was a range of peaks to the west of the region of the Moonsea . History . Around 1372 DR , Zhentil Keep had mines in the western half of the range , while Melvaunt and Hillsfar had mines in the eastern half .
description_long: Dragonspine Mountains The Dragonspine Mountains was a range of peaks to the west of the region of the Moonsea . History . Around 1372 DR , Zhentil Keep had mines in the western half of the range , while Melvaunt and Hillsfar had mines in the eastern half . Geography . The northern slopes of the western edge of the Dragonspine mountains were the location of the infamous Citadel of the Raven . Inhabitants . As of 1372 DR , red and white dragon s were known to lair in the higher peaks , whilst goblin s , orc s , and giant s filled the lower areas and valleys .

title: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon
description: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon The Dragonstaff of Ahghairon was a powerful magic staff . Powers . Any dragon touched by the staff became immune to the effects of Ahghairon ' s dragonward for a duration of time specified by the mage who controlled the staff .
description_long: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon The Dragonstaff of Ahghairon was a powerful magic staff . Powers . Any dragon touched by the staff became immune to the effects of Ahghairon ' s dragonward for a duration of time specified by the mage who controlled the staff . If a dragon was touched a second time , he was once again affected by the dragonward .

title: Dragonstail
description: Dragonstail The Dragonstail was a peninsula protruding from the Purple Hills in Tethyr in west Faerûn . Geography . The Dragonstail was low in elevation and described as serpentine , snaking out into the Sea of Swords .
description_long: Dragonstail The Dragonstail was a peninsula protruding from the Purple Hills in Tethyr in west Faerûn . Geography . The Dragonstail was low in elevation and described as serpentine , snaking out into the Sea of Swords . The town of Carathryn stood on its coast at the seaward end . History . In the Year of the Shattered Chains , 1123 DR , the Teeth of Talos storms lashed the southern Sword Coast . The storms completely sunk the Dragonstail peninsula , taking Carathryn with it . In later years , both the Dragonstail and Carathryn were a hazard to mariners along the coast , by ripping open the hulls of passing ships .

title: Dragonstooth
description: Dragonstooth Dragonstooth was a magical longsword containing the spirit of the red dragon dracolich Greshrukk , known as Red Eye . Powers . Dragonstooth was a " + 4 defending longsword " .
description_long: Dragonstooth Dragonstooth was a magical longsword containing the spirit of the red dragon dracolich Greshrukk , known as Red Eye . Powers . Dragonstooth was a " + 4 defending longsword " . Set in the pommel was a glassteel ed ruby that was also the phylactery of Greshrukk . History . Shhuusshuru , the dracolich leader of a newly formed Cult of the Dragon cell in Berdusk , wished for Greshrukk to be the next dracolich they created . The vessel chosen to bear his spirit was the ruby in this sword . Unfortunately for them , Harper agents attacked the ceremony , and Red Eye was slain at the culmination of the ceremony , just as he had become a dracolich . It was believed his spirit survived in the ruby , but the sword disappeared during the ensuring conflagration . Harpers and Cultists alike sought it out . In fact , one of the Harper agents stole the sword . Eventually the Harper was tracked and slain but the sword was lost . Both the Cult of the Dragon and the Harpers desperately searched for the missing sword until it turned up in the hands of some adventurers .

title: Dragonsword Mountains
description: Dragonsword Mountains The Dragonsword Mountains , located in central Mulhorand , served as a barrier between the Plains of Purple Dust and the rest of the nation . Geography . The Dragonsword Mountains were considered impassable by the people of Mulhorand , and as a result remained largely unexplored .
description_long: Dragonsword Mountains The Dragonsword Mountains , located in central Mulhorand , served as a barrier between the Plains of Purple Dust and the rest of the nation . Geography . The Dragonsword Mountains were considered impassable by the people of Mulhorand , and as a result remained largely unexplored . They protected the populated regions of the nation from the storms of the Plains of Purple Dust . Inhabitants . The inhabitants of the Dragonsword Mountains long plagued the nation of Mulhorand , and included a number of dracosphinx es as well as the descendants of the wizard Nezram . This mountain range was also known to contain the lair of the blue dragon Gestaniius .

title: Dragonwall
description: Dragonwall The Dragonwall was a giant wall located on the eastern edge of the Quoya Desert along the border with Shou Lung in Kara - Tur . Description . Thousands of miles long , the wall was built with brick and stone .
description_long: Dragonwall The Dragonwall was a giant wall located on the eastern edge of the Quoya Desert along the border with Shou Lung in Kara - Tur . Description . Thousands of miles long , the wall was built with brick and stone . The spirit of the dragon Pao Hu Jen inhabited the wall , making it invulnerable to anything but magical siege weaponry . The dragon ' s spirit could be freed through sacrifice . When freed , the wall crumbled and had to be rebuilt . The dragon could be talked with if the proper communication magic was used . The wall was protected by a large number of men and fortifications , along with infrequent patrols . A one - man guard tower with a signal fire was placed every mile , every 10 miles was a blockhouse with 100 men , and every 50 miles was a gate house with 1 , 000 men . Most of these men were poorly trained , and corruptly led , as the strength of the dragon wall had lulled Shou Lung into believing they were invulnerable . History . The Dragonwall was breached by the Tuigan Horde in 1359 DR near Lo Tu . The Tuigan armies were then able to march into Ching Tung in Shou Lung .

title: Dragonwrought kobold
description: Dragonwrought kobold Dragonwrought kobolds were rare kobold s who were considered a blessing by normal kobolds . History . Kobold myths maintained that the race was descended from true dragon s .
description_long: Dragonwrought kobold Dragonwrought kobolds were rare kobold s who were considered a blessing by normal kobolds . History . Kobold myths maintained that the race was descended from true dragon s . One of the strongest pieces of evidence for this claim was the rare hatching of a dragonwrought kobold .

title: Draguth Endroun
description: Draguth Endroun Draguth Endroun is the elderly and reclusive leader of the druid ic circle known as the Knightswood Nine . A stubborn and short - tempered man , Draguth is often found fighting with the other members of the group . He retains his leadership over the others by acting more powerful than he is along with possessing a brilliant store of knowledge about the King ' s Forest .
description_long: Draguth Endroun Draguth Endroun is the elderly and reclusive leader of the druid ic circle known as the Knightswood Nine . A stubborn and short - tempered man , Draguth is often found fighting with the other members of the group . He retains his leadership over the others by acting more powerful than he is along with possessing a brilliant store of knowledge about the King ' s Forest . Abilities . Along with possessing a " staff of the woodlands " , Draguth has a unique immunity to dryad charms . This ability has allowed him to befriend the tree folk and perfect a " dimension door " that allows him to travel from one tree to another many times in a single day . All these powers allow him to stalk those who journey into the woods in which he lives , confronting anyone who defiles the forest or rescuing wounded travelers .

title: Drakar
description: Drakar Drakar was a human man . He served as a cook to both the Red Brigade mercenaries and later the Vipers bandit s . History .
description_long: Drakar Drakar was a human man . He served as a cook to both the Red Brigade mercenaries and later the Vipers bandit s . History . Drakar was once the personal cook to Captain Cedric Ravajar of the Red Brigade during the 1360s DR . When Cedric disbanded the group in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Drakar followed him , and joined the new Vipers bandits . He cooked for them at the Vipers ' Nest . Description . Drakar was 6 feet ( 1 . 8 meters ) tall and weighed 250 pounds ( 113 kilograms ) . In his younger days , he had a muscular and athletic build , but he let himself go , fattening as he became a gourmand . He had black eyes , long , blond hair that was unclean and unkempt , and a scruffy beard as he went weeks between shaving .

title: Drake
description: Drake Drakes were draconic creatures that were distantly related to wyvern s . They were smaller and not as powerful as dragon s but were much easier to train , so they were commonly used as mounts . They were often used as guards by metallic dragon s , or they were given to the dragons ' humanoid servants .
description_long: Drake Drakes were draconic creatures that were distantly related to wyvern s . They were smaller and not as powerful as dragon s but were much easier to train , so they were commonly used as mounts . They were often used as guards by metallic dragon s , or they were given to the dragons ' humanoid servants .

title: Drakkar
description: Drakkar A drakkar , also known as a dragonship , was the largest vessel used by the Northmen of the Moonshae Isles . Description . Typically 100 ft ( 30 m ) long at the keel and 20 ft ( 6 m ) wide , drakkars were primarily rowed , but could raise a single mast and sail if desired .
description_long: Drakkar A drakkar , also known as a dragonship , was the largest vessel used by the Northmen of the Moonshae Isles . Description . Typically 100 ft ( 30 m ) long at the keel and 20 ft ( 6 m ) wide , drakkars were primarily rowed , but could raise a single mast and sail if desired . The minimum crew size was 20 , but it required 60 rowers to operate properly and could carry a maximum of 250 ( including rowers ) . A fully loaded drakkar could not sustain quarters or supplies for that many crew and therefore was typically used for raiding on or near the coast . Its deep sea capabilities were dubious . A drakkar could be armed with a large weapon ( such as catapult or ballista ) but was not built to wield a ram , Drakkars were not commonly seen in the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Drakosa
description: Drakosa Drakosa owned a plantation near Helmsport . History . Drakosa was a petty noble from Memnon who decided to go to Maztica .
description_long: Drakosa Drakosa owned a plantation near Helmsport . History . Drakosa was a petty noble from Memnon who decided to go to Maztica . Arriving in Helmsport , Drakosa bought a plantation from Jalimar Trollslayer , one of the original soldiers of the Golden Legion . He was capable in managing the plantation , raising tobacco and indigo . In 1362 DR , he hired an adventuring party to find the Cloak of One Plume in order to give it to Cordell to gain his favor . He sent his two servants Hasoctl and Ironspike with the adventurers to check up on them . In later years he managed to buy most of the Payit lands . In late 1369 DR Drakosa found a very prosperous new colony called Drakmul . Personality . Drakosa was a relatively lenient master with his slaves , using force only when truly necessary . He dreamed of becoming governor of his own region . He plotted to achieve this goal by manipulating factions like the merchants , the soldiers , and even the Payit . He also dreamed of finding a large amount of gold but cared too much for his own life to go on adventure himself . In his mind , the adventurers existed for this purpose . Activities .

title: Dral Thelev
description: Dral Thelev Dral Thelev was an one - eyed half - orc innkeeper in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Dral managed the Danivarr ' s House inn under the Zoar family .
description_long: Dral Thelev Dral Thelev was an one - eyed half - orc innkeeper in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Dral managed the Danivarr ' s House inn under the Zoar family . Both the Harpers and the Zhentarim spied upon the place .

title: Dralmorrer Borngray
description: Dralmorrer Borngray Dralmorrer Borngray was an elf who served as caretaker of Castle Naerytar for the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker Rezmir of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . He was also member of the Eldreth Veluuthra . Personality .
description_long: Dralmorrer Borngray Dralmorrer Borngray was an elf who served as caretaker of Castle Naerytar for the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker Rezmir of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . He was also member of the Eldreth Veluuthra . Personality . Borngray idolized Rezmir and followed all her orders and did all he could to help her . The only exception was Rezmir ' s pact with the bullywugs ; Borngray considered the lizardfolk to be more reliable and did what he could to benefit the lizardfolk and spite the bullywugs . He was also impatient for the arrival of Tiamat and the doom of humanity so he could go to more civilized places like Evermeet . History . Borngray was an elf supremacist and for this reason he left Evermeet and soon joined the Eldreth Veluuthra . However , he found no real way to destroy all human s . Everything changed when Borngray met Rezmir ; the half - dragon convinced the elf that Tiamat would destroy humanity but spare Evermeet . So Borngray joined the Cult of the Dragon and acted as a caretaker of Castle Naerytar for Rezmir and controlled the neighboring bullywug and lizardfolk tribes .

title: Dralpur
description: Dralpur Dralpur was a mining city of 8000 people in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located on the eastern slopes of the Galuil Mountains , known locally as the Mountains of Gold .
description_long: Dralpur Dralpur was a mining city of 8000 people in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located on the eastern slopes of the Galuil Mountains , known locally as the Mountains of Gold . This relative altitude made it the coolest inland city in the kingdom . It stood at the northern end of Barbarians ' Road , which formed the border between the realm and the barbarian lands of the east , Industry . As well as being a mining city working the Mountains of Gold , Dralpur was also home to many craftsmen . The city ' s smithies produced all manner of farming tools , which were supplied to the eastern mingari farms of Ulgarth . Weavers here produced silk and textiles , which , although they could not compete with Durpar ian products , met the everyday needs of Ulgarthan folk . Government . Dralpur was governed by Baron Kevin Olwynson around 1367 DR . Defense . A small but talented force of 500 warriors protected the city . Olwynson secured their loyalty and skills by paying them well with gold .

title: Dram Kallen
description: Dram Kallen Dram Kallen is an alchemist and inventor of the Silver Stake gas bomb , a device used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . He is also a founding member of the Silver Stake organization itself . He was born in Baldur ' s Gate and has lived there his entire life .
description_long: Dram Kallen Dram Kallen is an alchemist and inventor of the Silver Stake gas bomb , a device used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . He is also a founding member of the Silver Stake organization itself . He was born in Baldur ' s Gate and has lived there his entire life .

title: Dramar Lornen
description: Dramar Lornen Dramar Lornen was a collector from the " Royal Keep " of Ironhar in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Dramar was obsessed with the Dawn Titan ' s Spire , and , as of 1479 DR , she had hired many adventurers and agents in all of Returned Abeir to investigate any clues that would allow Dramar to gain entry to the Spire .
description_long: Dramar Lornen Dramar Lornen was a collector from the " Royal Keep " of Ironhar in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Dramar was obsessed with the Dawn Titan ' s Spire , and , as of 1479 DR , she had hired many adventurers and agents in all of Returned Abeir to investigate any clues that would allow Dramar to gain entry to the Spire .

title: Drann Barrow
description: Drann Barrow Drann Barrow was a member of the Zhentarim who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Drann was in the Whispering Carverns and directed many adventurers to disrupt the actives of the Cult of the Dragon , including in the fight with Vilithrax .
description_long: Drann Barrow Drann Barrow was a member of the Zhentarim who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Drann was in the Whispering Carverns and directed many adventurers to disrupt the actives of the Cult of the Dragon , including in the fight with Vilithrax .

title: Drannin Splitshield
description: Drannin Splitshield Drannin Splitshield was an evil dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Drannin was a self - serving individual who believed that , due to his heritage , he was owed better than he received .
description_long: Drannin Splitshield Drannin Splitshield was an evil dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Drannin was a self - serving individual who believed that , due to his heritage , he was owed better than he received . When he didn ' t receive the accolades , he began to see everyone in his way as the problem , trying to keep him down , and he vowed to do whatever it took to turn the tables . Drannin believed that with " Orcsplitter " in his possession he could establish himself as a powerful lord among his clan , and finally win the respect he thought he deserved . Possessions . Drannin ' s most prized possession was a shield guardian . He stole the amulet that controlled it from a sorcerer some years back . History . Like his cousin Gargosh Blusterhelm , Drannin was intent on claiming the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " . In 1491 DR , he devised a new plan : dupe his cousin Gargosh into finding the axe for him .

title: Drasek Riven
description: Drasek Riven Drasek Riven was a one - eyed former Zhentarim assassin and longtime rival of Erevis Cale . Background . After he and Erevis were pulled into a near - death experience at the hands of a shadow adept and his slaad i partners , they grudgingly joined forces to oppose them .
description_long: Drasek Riven Drasek Riven was a one - eyed former Zhentarim assassin and longtime rival of Erevis Cale . Background . After he and Erevis were pulled into a near - death experience at the hands of a shadow adept and his slaad i partners , they grudgingly joined forces to oppose them . During this period , Riven and Cale became the first and second of Mask ' s five mortal servants and were sometimes known as the right and left hands of Mask . Riven was Mask ' s Second , following Erevis Cale as his friend and associate . As Mask ' s second of five , Riven was imbued with certain skills reminiscent of a divine champion , including a shadow - based lay on hands , and divine wrath which causes his saber s to bleed shadow . He was also given the Black Speech which , when spoken , causes anyone within earshot to experience nausea and pain . Riven was a devout follower of the Shadowlord , and the caretaker of his temple which was stolen from the mad god Cyric . This temple was magically moved by a Githvyrik sorcerer named Vhostym to the Wayrock where it still stands . Riven was a cold - hearted and efficient killer , and never showed any sympathy towards anyone or anything other than .

title: Drashk
description: Drashk Captain Drashk was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drashk was a member of the Zhentarim who sometimes acted as captain of the " Lost Cause " .
description_long: Drashk Captain Drashk was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drashk was a member of the Zhentarim who sometimes acted as captain of the " Lost Cause " . He had an imp as advisor . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , the Zhentarim ordered Drashk to travel in search of the " Morkoth " .

title: Drasna Bluemantle
description: Drasna Bluemantle King Drasna Bluemantle , also known as Drasna the Fortunate was a human paladin of Torm and the ruler of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn in the mid - to - late 14th century DR . He ruled from the city of Orvyltar . History .
description_long: Drasna Bluemantle King Drasna Bluemantle , also known as Drasna the Fortunate was a human paladin of Torm and the ruler of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn in the mid - to - late 14th century DR . He ruled from the city of Orvyltar . History . Although he was the son of the king , Drasna spent his early years as an adventurer . Thanks to his " luckblade " and " stone of good luck " , he was able to win against odds that should have felled him , and slew many monsters . For this , he earned the moniker " the Fortunate " . Settling down , he ascended the throne and was king before 1367 DR . Drasna was still king by 1373 DR . Personality . Once he ' d become king , Drasna was very serious about his role and dedicated to being a good king . He was a firm believer in no one being denied the king ' s justice , and was merciful in making judgements . Possessions . Drasna wielded a " + 1 luckblade broadsword " and carried a " stone of good luck " , which both granted him great fortune . Base . As king , Drasna dwelled in the capital city , Orvyltar , where he held extensive estates . Activities . King Drasna toured the realm regularly , visiting each city once a year at least .

title: Draughts
description: Draughts Darughts , also known as checkers , was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with chess , dice , and Talis . Description . Draughts was played on the same 8×8 checkered board as chess , but draughts was a much simpler game to learn and faster to play .
description_long: Draughts Darughts , also known as checkers , was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with chess , dice , and Talis . Description . Draughts was played on the same 8×8 checkered board as chess , but draughts was a much simpler game to learn and faster to play . It contained 24 pieces of two colors . Sets in Faerûn often contained pieces made of clay or stone with a wooden board in a wooden case . Aurora ' s Emporium sold a more expensive set with red and black stone pieces .

title: Drava T ' syrr
description: Drava T ' syrr Drava T ' syrr was a drow warrior in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Drava lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s .
description_long: Drava T ' syrr Drava T ' syrr was a drow warrior in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Drava lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s . She led eight companions to Cormanthor . There , however , she fell under the madness of the demon lord Graz ' zt and started to dance and drink Some adventurers ( members of the Harpers hired by Elanil Elassidil to bring peace to her ancestor Meira Faerenduil ) tried to convinced Drava and her companions to go to a refugee camp but she never complied and in the end she was defeated . Personality . Drava fell completely to Graz ' zt ' s madness , in particular giving herself over to hedonistic impulses , drinking and singing . She was fearful of surface - dwellers , convinced that any meeting would inevitably end in bloodshed . Relationships . Drava always had at her side her second - in - command , the mage Ilztoj A ' Qaran .

title: Draven Millovyr
description: Draven Millovyr Draven Millovyr was an innkeeper of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Draven tried to join the Arcane Brotherhood but was refused .
description_long: Draven Millovyr Draven Millovyr was an innkeeper of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Draven tried to join the Arcane Brotherhood but was refused . Deluded he in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR become an innkeeper in Triboar buying the Everywyvern House . He created an inn good for the standard of the nobles of Waterdeep .

title: Drawmij ' s instant summons
description: Drawmij ' s instant summons Drawmij ' s instant summons was a conjuration spell that summoned a prepared item in an instant . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as instant summons , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects .
description_long: Drawmij ' s instant summons Drawmij ' s instant summons was a conjuration spell that summoned a prepared item in an instant . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as instant summons , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects . With " Drawmij ' s instant summons " , a caster attuned a valuable gem to an object . The object could then be summoned to the caster ' s hand by speaking a word and crushing the gem . The size of the object that could be summoned varied slightly between versions of this spell . The earliest versions limited the size to a " sword ' s length " in any dimension and no more than a " shield ' s weight " ; restrictions that were open to interpretation . Later versions codified this to a maximum length of 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) and a maximum weight of 10 lb ( 4 . 5 kg ) . There was no time limit on this spell , so it was permanent until activated , but the link to the object could be broken by a successful " dispel magic " on the gem .

title: Draygo Quick
description: Draygo Quick Draygo Quick was a powerful Netherese warlock . History . Draygo Quick was a noble in the Nethril Empire .
description_long: Draygo Quick Draygo Quick was a powerful Netherese warlock . History . Draygo Quick was a noble in the Nethril Empire . Draygo Quick maintained a home in a compound near Gloomwrought in the Shadowfell where where he imprisoned Drizzt Do ' Urden for quite some time and petrified Dahlia Sin ' felle and Artemis Entreri . The prisoners were rescued when the compound was assaulted by Bregan D ' aerthe at the bequest of Jarlaxle . Like Parise Ulfbinder , Draygo Quick had an intense interest in the Chosen of the gods . He suspected that Ruqiah / Catti - brie was the Chosen of Mielikki , and for a time he wondered if Drizzt Do ' Urden was the Chosen of Lolth , although he later rescinded that idea in favor of Dahlia Sin ' felle being favored of Lolth . Relationships . Draygo Quick was friends with Parise Ulfbinder , another Netherese noble . In 1469 DR , Draygo Quick was continuing to work with Bregan D ' aerthe ; Kimmuriel Oblodra agreed to share information he gathered from working with the illithids in return for forgiveness for his assault on Quick ' s home .

title: Drayson Fivestars
description: Drayson Fivestars Drayson Fivestars was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Drayson joined the Cloak at an early age .
description_long: Drayson Fivestars Drayson Fivestars was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Drayson joined the Cloak at an early age . His partner was Salvar Brix . In 1491 DR , during a routine visit to a lost tower near the city , Drayson was captured by the Cult of the Crushing Wave and brainwashed into joining them . The cult chapter ' s leader , Therus , sent Drayson back to the city to spread their doctrine among the worshipers of Umberlee . However , the high priestess of Umberlee , Rydah the Storm Soother , saw the threat and some of her followers killed Drayson .

title: Dread blast
description: Dread blast Dread blast was a divine necromancy spell only available to cleric s serving Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It fired a beam of negative energy at a target . Effects .
description_long: Dread blast Dread blast was a divine necromancy spell only available to cleric s serving Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It fired a beam of negative energy at a target . Effects . This spell could be used to heal undead creatures or harm live ones . It had a range of at least 170 ft ( 52 m ) and more experienced clerics could extend this range and cause / cure more damage . When cast , a black ray of energy from the Negative Energy plane shot out from the caster ' s hand at the intended target and had to succeed in making contact . A victim had a chance to resist the magic of this spell , and if successful , only received half as much damage as usual . Construct s and inanimate objects were unaffected by this spell . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Dread fang
description: Dread fang Dread fangs , sometimes called dread fangs of Lolth are elite warriors of drow society , trained as rogue s , typically in the service of a noble house or the Spider Queen . Cunning and deceptive , dread fangs embody the treacherous perils of drow society , though a few leave the terrors of their homeland for something better , becoming forces for good or at the very least opposed to Lolth ' s machinations . Masters of death , dread fangs excel at lowering their enemy ' s guard , and then , while they ' re defenseless , striking them down .
description_long: Dread fang Dread fangs , sometimes called dread fangs of Lolth are elite warriors of drow society , trained as rogue s , typically in the service of a noble house or the Spider Queen . Cunning and deceptive , dread fangs embody the treacherous perils of drow society , though a few leave the terrors of their homeland for something better , becoming forces for good or at the very least opposed to Lolth ' s machinations . Masters of death , dread fangs excel at lowering their enemy ' s guard , and then , while they ' re defenseless , striking them down . Culture . The drow are infamous for the death that infests their society , murdering to get to the top or even to keep the position they hold . Feared and hated , the drow are well - known as slavers and servants of Lolth and her demon ic servitors . However , the cruelty does not end with divine and arcane power and for the ambitious there is a path to power through skill with a blade and among the deadliest warriors of drow society are the so - called dread fangs . These deadly warriors , rather than fearing death , embrace it , learning to excel at killing from an early age .

title: Dread ring
description: Dread ring A dread ring was an enchanted area created by necromancer s with the intention of stealing the souls of the living in order to feed necromantic powers such as animating the dead or creating structures such as fortresses . People that died there fed the power of the necromancer casting the spell with their souls and would likely be raised as undead . Dread rings were most notably affiliated with the Red Wizard s of Thay under the rule of Szass Tam .
description_long: Dread ring A dread ring was an enchanted area created by necromancer s with the intention of stealing the souls of the living in order to feed necromantic powers such as animating the dead or creating structures such as fortresses . People that died there fed the power of the necromancer casting the spell with their souls and would likely be raised as undead . Dread rings were most notably affiliated with the Red Wizard s of Thay under the rule of Szass Tam .

title: Dread star
description: Dread star Dread star is a warlock invocation of some complexity learned early in some warlocks ' training . When a warlock casts " dread star " he or she conjures a fist - sized sphere of brilliant blue - white light , which then proceeds to whirl around a creature of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet , searing them with painful blasts of light that discourage movement of any kind . The intensity of the beams is largely determined by the warlock ' s charisma .
description_long: Dread star Dread star is a warlock invocation of some complexity learned early in some warlocks ' training . When a warlock casts " dread star " he or she conjures a fist - sized sphere of brilliant blue - white light , which then proceeds to whirl around a creature of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet , searing them with painful blasts of light that discourage movement of any kind . The intensity of the beams is largely determined by the warlock ' s charisma . Even if the orb fails to immobilize and injure its target , its light is so blinding that it reduces the creature ' s will to resist other , similar attacks . The orb dissipates within a short moment and , due to its complexity , can only be cast once per day .

title: Dread whisper
description: Dread whisper Dread whisper was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on a target and spoke of a terrible outcome that would happen if the target did not ignore the caster .
description_long: Dread whisper Dread whisper was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on a target and spoke of a terrible outcome that would happen if the target did not ignore the caster . For this spell to work the target and caster needed to speak the same language . If the spell succeeds , the target would be unable to do anything relating to the caster for the spell ' s duration . If they did anything relating to the caster the target would stand helpless as horrible images assaulted their mind . Wizards used this spell to keep people from mentioning the wizard ' s presence , usually in regard to the wizard being in a place where they were not supposed to be . This spell could only be used by evil wizards . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Dreadful word
description: Dreadful word Dreadful word , also known less commonly as frightful blast , is a relatively simple spell used by several warlock s , particularly those of the star pact . When a warlock casts " dreadful word " they can use its deadly power to fill the mind of one creature within twenty - five feet of them with petrifying pain and terror . Creatures who fall victim to this attack suffer a damage to their morale , making them less likely ro resist similar attacks later on .
description_long: Dreadful word Dreadful word , also known less commonly as frightful blast , is a relatively simple spell used by several warlock s , particularly those of the star pact . When a warlock casts " dreadful word " they can use its deadly power to fill the mind of one creature within twenty - five feet of them with petrifying pain and terror . Creatures who fall victim to this attack suffer a damage to their morale , making them less likely ro resist similar attacks later on . The effectiveness of the spell is determined almost entirely by the wielder ' s charisma , though star pact warlocks of great intellect are even more effective casters of " dreadful word " . However , " dreadful world " is too complex a spell for a warlock to cast more than once without a brief rest of at least a few minutes . Before the Spellplague , " frightful blast " was used by some warlocks as an altered manifestation of " eldritch blast . " At the time the spell , like all invocation s , could be cast at will .

title: Dreadmaster
description: Dreadmaster The Dreadmaster is a special prestige class for clerics of Bane . Much like the god whom they worship , Dreadmasters seek to control everyone around them , using the tools offered by Bane to inspire fear and loyalty in equal measure . Dreadmasters seek to reach the heights of any government or organization they are part of , believing that only they are capable of the control required to keep order .
description_long: Dreadmaster The Dreadmaster is a special prestige class for clerics of Bane . Much like the god whom they worship , Dreadmasters seek to control everyone around them , using the tools offered by Bane to inspire fear and loyalty in equal measure . Dreadmasters seek to reach the heights of any government or organization they are part of , believing that only they are capable of the control required to keep order .

title: Dream
description: Dream Dream was an illusion spell that would shape the dreams of a target . Effect . Choosing a known target within the same plane and casting the dream spell allows the caster or someone else to become a messenger and effect the chosen ' s dreams .
description_long: Dream Dream was an illusion spell that would shape the dreams of a target . Effect . Choosing a known target within the same plane and casting the dream spell allows the caster or someone else to become a messenger and effect the chosen ' s dreams . If the target is asleep the messenger can effect the targets dream creating any thing and the target would remember the dream perfectly . If the target is awake the messenger know it and can wait for it to fall asleep or end the trance ahead of time . If the target cant sleep the spell has no effect . If the messenger chooses to look horrific its message will be shortened and the target will attempt to resist the messenger . If the target resist the messenger the target wont be able to fully rest and have will have nightmares and when it wakes it takes psychic damage . If the caster had something from the body of the target like hair or nails the target would have disadvantage against the spell . Components . In order to cast this spell the caster needed the vocal and somatic components as well as a writing quill plucked from a sleeping bird , a dab of ink and a handful of sand . History .

title: Dream Brigade
description: Dream Brigade The Dream Brigade was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 4 , 000 sandmen comprised the Dream Brigade .
description_long: Dream Brigade The Dream Brigade was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 4 , 000 sandmen comprised the Dream Brigade . Activities . These fanatics were used to crush slave rebellions or as fodder to blunt attacks from elemental creatures . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Dream vestige
description: Dream vestige A dream vestige was an intangible entity , more like a huge mass of fog with anguished faces appearing in it , stretching , twisting , and dissolving back into the vapor . It was accompanied by a chorus of faint voices , some moaning , some gibbering , and others laughing . The souls that made up the cloud were in constant torment , trapped in a nightmare , and they hated one another even more than they hated the world .
description_long: Dream vestige A dream vestige was an intangible entity , more like a huge mass of fog with anguished faces appearing in it , stretching , twisting , and dissolving back into the vapor . It was accompanied by a chorus of faint voices , some moaning , some gibbering , and others laughing . The souls that made up the cloud were in constant torment , trapped in a nightmare , and they hated one another even more than they hated the world . A dream vestige began by gathering hundreds of nightmares , combining them , and infusing them with the energies of undeath . It grew by devouring any being possessed of a mind . It could pass back and forth between the physical realm and some sort of demiplane of dreams . It burned with an insatiable hunger and snatched up living beings with tentacles protruding from its mass , dissolving them into nothingness . Only mindless undead beings such as zombie s , skeleton s , and golem s could endure its touch . A bard or someone able to weave emotions could defeat the entity by enflaming the dream vestige ' s wrath and self hatred until it would be strong enough to overcome any constraining forces and dissolve the fog - like entity .

title: Dreamheart
description: Dreamheart The Dreamheart was an ancient aboleth magical artifact . History . The Dreamheart was first found in modern times by the kuo - toa Nogah in 1395 DR , in a drowned and destroyed illithid city deep under the Sea of Fallen Stars in Serôs .
description_long: Dreamheart The Dreamheart was an ancient aboleth magical artifact . History . The Dreamheart was first found in modern times by the kuo - toa Nogah in 1395 DR , in a drowned and destroyed illithid city deep under the Sea of Fallen Stars in Serôs . Description . The Dreamheart was a black stone , not quite spherical , about the size of a human ' s head . Abilities . The Dreamheart had great unknown power . The Dreamheart used telepathy to send its wielder visions , sounds , and information .

title: Dreaming Dragon
description: Dreaming Dragon The Dreaming Dragon was located near the Downriver Gate within Everlund . Inhabitants . Elves and halfling s loved the establishment because every night a great story and ballad would be heard .
description_long: Dreaming Dragon The Dreaming Dragon was located near the Downriver Gate within Everlund . Inhabitants . Elves and halfling s loved the establishment because every night a great story and ballad would be heard . Food and drink . The elverquisst at the Dragon was of a particularly fine quality .

title: Dreena Dellmon
description: Dreena Dellmon Dreena Dellmon was a druid during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Dreena was a druid and an agent of the Emerald Enclave .
description_long: Dreena Dellmon Dreena Dellmon was a druid during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Dreena was a druid and an agent of the Emerald Enclave . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the Dellmon farm . However , Kerbin Dellmon refused to abandon his farm and go to Yartar . Dreena sent messages both to the Enclave and to the elves of the High Forest asking for help . With the lucky arrival of some adventurers , the Dellmons managed to defend the farm .

title: Drelagara
description: Drelagara Drelagara is a small city on Evermeet that makes up in symmetry and quiet beauty what it lacks in grandeur . The buildings are all made from white marble , magically raised from the depths of Evermeet , and the whole city is located in the center of an expanse of gently rolling meadows that measures more than sixty miles ( 97km ) wide . This meadowland is surrounded on all sides by forests , and within a day ' s ride of the white - sand beaches of Siiluth .
description_long: Drelagara Drelagara is a small city on Evermeet that makes up in symmetry and quiet beauty what it lacks in grandeur . The buildings are all made from white marble , magically raised from the depths of Evermeet , and the whole city is located in the center of an expanse of gently rolling meadows that measures more than sixty miles ( 97km ) wide . This meadowland is surrounded on all sides by forests , and within a day ' s ride of the white - sand beaches of Siiluth .

title: Dresimil Chûmavh
description: Dresimil Chûmavh Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh was the matriarch of House Chûmavh , a drow clan that lived in a huge cavern beneath Ravens Bluff . Relationships . Dresimil had two brothers , Jezzryd and Jaeren , whom she seemed to at least tolerate , a rarity for dark elf matriarchs .
description_long: Dresimil Chûmavh Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh was the matriarch of House Chûmavh , a drow clan that lived in a huge cavern beneath Ravens Bluff . Relationships . Dresimil had two brothers , Jezzryd and Jaeren , whom she seemed to at least tolerate , a rarity for dark elf matriarchs . History . At some point between 1367 DR and 1479 DR , House Chûmavh moved into the huge cavern beneath the city and built Tower Chûmavhraele . In 1479 DR , Dresimil was supervising the re - activation of the ancient drow mythal in the cavern . Her drow accidentally released the rogue Jack Ravenwild from his imprisonment inside the mythal . Jack escaped and Dresimil she devoted some resources to recapture Jack . Ultimately , she lent drow warriors to the slaver Fetterfists for an attack on a social gathering of Ravens Bluff nobles . The attack was repelled and a large force led by Myrkyssa Jelan descended to the Underdark to free nobles captured in the raid and Dresimil was killed by Myrkyssa during the battle .

title: Dretch
description: Dretch Dretches were the least powerful of tanar ' ri demon kind . Description . Dretches were ape - like creatures with arms ending in clawed hands .
description_long: Dretch Dretches were the least powerful of tanar ' ri demon kind . Description . Dretches were ape - like creatures with arms ending in clawed hands . They stood about 4 feet tall and weighed 60 pounds . They were unable to speak and communicated only telepathically . Personality . Dretches were thoroughly wicked and possessed a driving need to cause dismay and ruin . They were very cowardly and incredibly stupid , but they were more afraid of their demon overlords than of death . Combat . Dretches preferred to attack in large mobs to overwhelm their victims . Each dretch had the ability to summon another dretch , but that ability often failed . Society . Dretches served greater tanar ' ri demons as fodder .

title: Dretchroyaster
description: Dretchroyaster Dretchroyaster , also known as Dretch , was a venerable green dragon that agreed to become dracolich in 1365 DR . Personality . Dretch was primarily a hunter of all kinds of living being .
description_long: Dretchroyaster Dretchroyaster , also known as Dretch , was a venerable green dragon that agreed to become dracolich in 1365 DR . Personality . Dretch was primarily a hunter of all kinds of living being . He liked the flesh of centaurs and considered elves an unfortunately too - rare delicacy ; for the sake of his twisted humor sometimes he would also eat treant . Unfortunately for him Dretch relaxed too much when he ate . In more combative situation Dretch was a good fighter with a high sense for tactics . His primary goal now was transforming himself in a spelljammer and flow to the space . History . Dretch was first remembered by the chronicles when in the Year of Watery Graves ( 1091 DR ) he battled the old female black dragon , Naxorlytaalsxar the Terror Tenebrous , in a aerial duel ; in the so called Battle of Falling Fishkill Dretch accidentally poisoned the Lake Sember , forcing the aquatic elf living here to exile . During this time Dretch regularly mated with venerable female green dragon Verthandantalynx , the Verdant Cloud , and considered her his mate .

title: Dreveth
description: Dreveth Dreveth the Gray was a male human diviner who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced wizard who specialised in divination magic , Dreveth could cast some of very powerful divination spell s , if needed .
description_long: Dreveth Dreveth the Gray was a male human diviner who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced wizard who specialised in divination magic , Dreveth could cast some of very powerful divination spell s , if needed . Activities . Dreveth the Gray was occasionally known to lend help to adventurer s in need of his aid . However this help was generally only given out to those he deemed to be serving the cause of good . History . In 1372 DR , Dreveth the Gray resided in Hillsfar where he would aid adventurers that he considered to be undertaking goodly deeds .

title: Drew Karpyshyn
description: Drew Karpyshyn Drew Karpyshyn has written two novels for Wizards of the Coast . Though his main works lie outside of the Faerûn setting , he carved out the time to write these two novels in 2001 . Before 2001 , however , he would not have dreamed of writing a novel , as he was a loan officer .
description_long: Drew Karpyshyn Drew Karpyshyn has written two novels for Wizards of the Coast . Though his main works lie outside of the Faerûn setting , he carved out the time to write these two novels in 2001 . Before 2001 , however , he would not have dreamed of writing a novel , as he was a loan officer . When he got in a car accident , he quit his job as a loan officer and was able to go to college again to gain a degree in English . After that he started to write his first novel , " Temple Hill " .

title: Drexa
description: Drexa Drexa was the chieftain of the Blackmaw lizardfolk tribe at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil and a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The lizard king believed that he should be one of the leaders of the Crushing Wave .
description_long: Drexa Drexa was the chieftain of the Blackmaw lizardfolk tribe at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil and a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The lizard king believed that he should be one of the leaders of the Crushing Wave . He dreamed of overthrowing Gar Shatterkeel one day . Relationships . Drexa led his tribe in the worship of Olhydra with the counsel of the shaman Sskesh . History . In 1491 DR , Drexa and his tribe were at the Fane of the Eye until some adventurers infiltrated the Fane and confronted and defeated him and his minions .

title: Dreyon
description: Dreyon Dreyon was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , possibly taking advantage of an eruption of elemental power , Dreyon and his cell of Black Earth cultists took control of Westbridge .
description_long: Dreyon Dreyon was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , possibly taking advantage of an eruption of elemental power , Dreyon and his cell of Black Earth cultists took control of Westbridge . However , some adventurers helped by Sedina Wolfpaw confronted and defeated him and his minions .

title: Drider
description: Drider Driders are drow that have been transformed from the waist down so they have the body of a spider . The transformation is typically a punishment for offending their goddess , or failing a test of Lolth . Ecology .
description_long: Drider Driders are drow that have been transformed from the waist down so they have the body of a spider . The transformation is typically a punishment for offending their goddess , or failing a test of Lolth . Ecology . Once a promising drow reaches 6th level , a high - level priestesses in good standing with Lolth may test the drow ' s loyalty to the Queen of Spiders . If the promising drow fails the test , he or she will be transformed into a drider , ( However this has changed from a punishment to a blessing according to the Dungeons & Dragons 4th edition ) . This transformation is extremely painful and lasts at least twelve hours . Driders develop a poisonous bite . Their digestion changes and they must drink the blood of living creatures for sustenance . Because they have failed Lolth ' s test , they become outcasts from their own people . Driders still maintain the spells and special abilities they had developed as a drow , thus there can exist any character class of drider . They retain intelligence and memories . This makes them bitter , spiteful creatures . Some hunt for magic powerful enough to undo the transformation .

title: Drider vampire
description: Drider vampire Drider Vampires were undead drider s that had been infected with vampirism . Physical Characteristics . Appearing similar to their once - living selves , drider vampires had clawed hands and venomous fangs that protruded from their mouths .
description_long: Drider vampire Drider Vampires were undead drider s that had been infected with vampirism . Physical Characteristics . Appearing similar to their once - living selves , drider vampires had clawed hands and venomous fangs that protruded from their mouths . Abilities . Drider vampires combined the abilities of both a drider and the more common vampire , though a few differences existed .
