Their bite was much more dangerous than an ordinary vampire , as they had little need to engage in grappling their victim but rather could drain their target with a single strike . Psychology . Drider vampires were creatures with a great loathing and hatred for all living creatures . Society . Outcasts by virtue of their status as driders and for their vampirism , drider vampires were generally solitary entities .

title: Driftdisc
description: Driftdisc A Driftdisc is a form of transport used by drow noble houses to convey Matron Mother s from place to place , usually within cities . They are especially used during special occasions , such as a visit to another noble household . Driftdiscs usually operate as an enchanted platform that magically hovers above ground , and serves as a portable throne ; Matron Mothers use them to signify their station in drow society .
description_long: Driftdisc A Driftdisc is a form of transport used by drow noble houses to convey Matron Mother s from place to place , usually within cities . They are especially used during special occasions , such as a visit to another noble household . Driftdiscs usually operate as an enchanted platform that magically hovers above ground , and serves as a portable throne ; Matron Mothers use them to signify their station in drow society . They can take the form of either enchanted physical objects , such as a stone disc mounted with an ivory throne , or a corporeal magical force , which appears as a shimmering blue disc . Yvonnel Baenre used a Driftdisc while travelling to Mithral Hall with the army of Menzoberranzan , suggesting that they can be used for travel over extended distances . The Driftdisc is also used by wizards , due to their ability to craft them , not just Matron Mothers .

title: Driftglobe
description: Driftglobe A driftglobe was a small glass orb that magically floated in the air and emitted light . Description . A " driftglobe " was a small sphere of thick glass , that weighed about one pound ( 0 .
description_long: Driftglobe A driftglobe was a small glass orb that magically floated in the air and emitted light . Description . A " driftglobe " was a small sphere of thick glass , that weighed about one pound ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Powers . The most common " driftglobes " had three basic magical effects . They glowed with bright light , equal to a torch , as per the cantrip " light " , on command . They could also glow with the brightness of full daylight , as per the spell " daylight " for an hour at a time , though use of this ability was limited to a number of charges before being used up . Lastly , the " driftglobe " floated in the air , as per the magical spell " levitate " . A " driftglobe " could also follow a creature that touched it , similar to the disk created by " Tenser ' s floating disk " . History . " Driftglobes " date back at least to the time of Cormanthyr at its height and were seen lighting up the night in Myth Drannor . The arcanist Congenio Ioun created the first light - emitting " ioun stone s " sometime in the age of Netheril but these were personal items that remained near their owner .

title: Drik Hargunen
description: Drik Hargunen Drik Hargunen was a duergar city in the Underdark region of Faerûn . Geography . The city was built around a natural rock chimney and iron stairways connected the various levels .
description_long: Drik Hargunen Drik Hargunen was a duergar city in the Underdark region of Faerûn . Geography . The city was built around a natural rock chimney and iron stairways connected the various levels . Inhabitants . The duergar of Drik Hargunen appeared to be more tolerant than many of their kin and allowed some human slavers and traders to live in the city . History . In 1480 DR , the duergar of Drik Hargunen devised a rune magic ritual that infected the dwarven god Moradin ' s River of Gold , his tangible link to Toril , and caused the Stoneplague .

title: Drisinil Armgo
description: Drisinil Armgo Drisinil Armgo was member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Drisinil was described as tall .
description_long: Drisinil Armgo Drisinil Armgo was member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Drisinil was described as tall . She had a sharp nose and green eyes . History . In 1372 DR , Drisinil was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith . She snuck out of Tier Breche and was punished for it by having some of her little fingers cut off . Soon after , she instigated a coup against Mistress Quenthel Baenre , seeking power and believing that demons attempting to assassinate her were signs of Quenthel ' s disfavor of Lolth . Quenthel discovered the plot and pretended to poison Drisinil in order to have her bring her fellow conspirators to an unused classroom in Arach - Tinilith , where she summoned hordes of spiders that slayed them . During the coup , Drisinil killed her aunt and instructor Molvayas Armgo , claiming that Molvayas would have betrayed them to Quenthel . As punishment for the plot , Drisinil was allowed to live but her fingers and tongue were cut off .

title: Drisinil Melarn
description: Drisinil Melarn Drisinil Melarn was the matron mother of House Melarn until her death and its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn .
description_long: Drisinil Melarn Drisinil Melarn was the matron mother of House Melarn until her death and its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn . She hired the duergar mercenary band Clan Xornbane , with the help of Zammzt , to assist . She took over the Black Claw Mercantile Company storehouse , which was operated by House Zauvirr , House Melarn , and the Menzoberranyr House Baenre . She ordered her guards to kill Drisinil . Clan Xornbane attacked and destroyed House Melarn , causing it to fall into the cavern of the city as the entire city was destroyed . Drisinil ' s daughter , Halisstra Melarn , escaped and joined Quenthel Baenre ' s group investigating the Silence of Lolth . Relationships . Known children :

title: Drizfryn Oblodra
description: Drizfryn Oblodra Drizfryn Oblodra was the weapon master of House Oblodra circa 1358 DR . Personality . Drizfryn was a violent psychopath , kept in check only by his mother .
description_long: Drizfryn Oblodra Drizfryn Oblodra was the weapon master of House Oblodra circa 1358 DR . Personality . Drizfryn was a violent psychopath , kept in check only by his mother . He cared nothing for his underlings and their deaths . History . Drizfryn was the fourth son of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran but held the position of second boy thanks to the deaths of two of his older brothers . He was always in search of new methods to test himself and his warriors , putting them in impossible situations and not caring for casualties .

title: Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail
description: Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail This piece of fabled armor belongs to Drizzt Do ' Urden and was crafted for him by Buster Bracer . The armor itself is chainmail , made from mithral . It is extremely lightweight without compromising it ' s protection .
description_long: Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail This piece of fabled armor belongs to Drizzt Do ' Urden and was crafted for him by Buster Bracer . The armor itself is chainmail , made from mithral . It is extremely lightweight without compromising it ' s protection . The mithral gives the armor a blue tint . Appendix . Appearances . In the game " Baldur ' s Gate " , the player can find Drizzt whilst he is fighting gnoll s . If strong enough , the player and his party can in fact kill Drizzt . On looting Drizzt ' s body in the game , the player finds his armor and his two scimitar s . The armor , referred to as " mithral chain mail + 4 " , is some of the best available in the game . The armor is a dark blue . The in - game description claims the armor was built by Bruenor Battlehammer . Unfortunately , if the player imports a character into who has previously killed Drizzt , he will reappear , extremely hostile .

title: Drizzt Do ' Urden
description: Drizzt Do ' Urden Drizzt Do ' Urden , also called Drizzt Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a male drow ranger . He was an atypical drow who had forsaken both the evil ways of his people and their home in the Underdark , to become the legendary hero of the North . Description .
description_long: Drizzt Do ' Urden Drizzt Do ' Urden , also called Drizzt Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a male drow ranger . He was an atypical drow who had forsaken both the evil ways of his people and their home in the Underdark , to become the legendary hero of the North . Description . Drizzt Do ' Urden was a drow . He stood about 5 ′ 4 ″ ( 1 . 63 m ) tall and weighed about 130 pounds ( 59 kg ) . His handsome features were sharp and well proportioned and , like other drow , Drizzt ' s skin was black and his stark white hair was long , thick , and flowing . His eyes were a lavender hue ( quite different from the drow race ' s typical red , even when he used his infravision , which normally caused eyes to glow red ) and seemed to glow fiercely when he was angry or determined . His vision was once accustomed to the pitch - blackness of the Underdark . However , many years after Drizzt first ventured onto the surface , his eyes adapted to the bright light of the world above . When using his infravision , the images , if held for a prolonged period of time , caused headaches and other symptoms of strain . .

title: Drogan Droganson
description: Drogan Droganson Drogan Droganson was a renowned dwarven wizard , cleric of Mystra , and secret member of the Harpers , who opened a school for adventurers after retiring from the his own adventuring life . His students included Xanos Messarmos , Mischa Waymeet and Dorna Trapspringer . Description .
description_long: Drogan Droganson Drogan Droganson was a renowned dwarven wizard , cleric of Mystra , and secret member of the Harpers , who opened a school for adventurers after retiring from the his own adventuring life . His students included Xanos Messarmos , Mischa Waymeet and Dorna Trapspringer . Description . The dwarf had a braided white beard , balding hair and half moon spectacles . Personality . Drogan spoke very little of his past life , though was known for his adventuring lifestyle and displayed many qualities associated with the northern shield dwarves . He ultimately sacrificed himself for his new apprentice which showed his deep loyalty to the Harper ' s cause and his students . Abilities . As well as being a member of the Harpers and a renowned wizard and cleric , he also had a passion for sharing his knowledge with new hopeful adventurers , resulting in him mentoring students in Hilltop after his retirement . Possessions . Drogan was entrusted by the Harpers to protect four magical artifacts : Belpheron ' s mummified hand , a dragon ' s tooth , a mask which once belonged to a Lord of Shadows high priest and a tower statue which was found in a desert tomb .

title: Droki
description: Droki Droki was a derro criminal in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Droki hated everyone in general and surfacers in particular .
description_long: Droki Droki was a derro criminal in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Droki hated everyone in general and surfacers in particular . If he met surfacers , he spent all his time insulting and misleading them . If someone took his satchel , Droki would throw an epic tantrum . He was also obsessed with do things exactly where and when they should be done , believing that not respecting this arrangement would alter his destiny . History . Droki was a notorious criminal courier transporting goods for many gangs and cabals in Gracklstugh . During the Rage of Demons , he had commissions for the Gray Ghosts thieves guild and for a secret cult of demon - worshiping derro . For this , he was wanted by Errde Blackskull and Gartokkar Xundorn .

title: Drom
description: Drom Drom was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Drom was one of the goblins who inhabited the caves near Duskwood .
description_long: Drom Drom was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Drom was one of the goblins who inhabited the caves near Duskwood . Gameplay . He would warn the Kalach - Cha not to take the Glowstone . If ignored , Drom would attack them .

title: Drom ( dwarf )
description: Drom ( dwarf ) Drom was a dwarf fighter worshiper of Helm and a member of Order of the Gauntlet in 1489 DR . Personality . Drom believed that you could fix problems with a big hammer .
description_long: Drom ( dwarf ) Drom was a dwarf fighter worshiper of Helm and a member of Order of the Gauntlet in 1489 DR . Personality . Drom believed that you could fix problems with a big hammer . History . He was the Gauntlet ' s delegate to help a hired adventuring party to defeat the great dragon Claugiyliamatar in Kryptgarden Forest . The objective of Drom ' s order was to destroy the Cult of the Dragon ' s contingent without warning the green dragon and to destroy all undead raised by Thayan necromancer s .

title: Dromond
description: Dromond A dromond was a large warship related to a galley used for both war and commerce on the Sea of Fallen Stars . They were originally of Chessentan design but were also used by Mulhorand due to a long tradition of raiding and capturing ships from each other . The Alaor in Thay boasted a dozen deadly dromonds as part of its navy .
description_long: Dromond A dromond was a large warship related to a galley used for both war and commerce on the Sea of Fallen Stars . They were originally of Chessentan design but were also used by Mulhorand due to a long tradition of raiding and capturing ships from each other . The Alaor in Thay boasted a dozen deadly dromonds as part of its navy . Description . The dromond was the largest ship in the Chessentan navy at 175 ft . ( 53 . 3 m ) along the keel and 15 ft . ( 4 . 6 m ) across the beam . It had two banks of 25 oars on each side . The smaller , lower bank were single - person oars while the upper bank required three persons on each oar . In this configuration , the minimum crew size was 200 , and when configured for war it could transport another 200 soldiers . Other dromond models were slightly smaller , at 100 ft . by 20 ft . and required only 100 oarsmen and a watch of at least 7 . Such smaller - sized dromonds could only carry an additional 100 passengers in addition to the rowers . The rowers were fully protected from attacks by a full deck .

title: Drone Wyvernspur
description: Drone Wyvernspur Drone Wyvernspur , called affectionately Uncle Drone by most of his younger kinfolk , was the archmage of Redstone Castle , the ancestral home of the Wyvernspur family . Description . Drone had all the typical male Wyvernspur features : blue eyes , beak - nosed , and black hair .
description_long: Drone Wyvernspur Drone Wyvernspur , called affectionately Uncle Drone by most of his younger kinfolk , was the archmage of Redstone Castle , the ancestral home of the Wyvernspur family . Description . Drone had all the typical male Wyvernspur features : blue eyes , beak - nosed , and black hair . But as an old man , his hair had streaks of white , and he shuffled about with enough wrinkles for two and seemed in Giogioni Wyvernspur ' s words to have been visited by old age twice over , unlike his cousin Dorath Wyvernspur , the family matriarch . Relationships . He was one of Giogioni Wyvernspur ' s favorite relatives and had a fondness for his cat Spot , even though both caused him some grey hairs over the years .

title: Drool
description: Drool Drool was an ogre at the Sacred Stone Monastery during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Drool acted as a subterranean guard and jailer of the monastery , under the orders of Jurth .
description_long: Drool Drool was an ogre at the Sacred Stone Monastery during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Drool acted as a subterranean guard and jailer of the monastery , under the orders of Jurth . Personality . Drool was a simpleton , not really understanding what was going on . He believed he could make jurth happy by torturing the prisoners . History . Some adventurers infiltrated the monastery and in the end confronted and defeated Drool , Jurth , and his minions .

title: Drosnin
description: Drosnin Drosnin was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Drosnin was the priest responsible for Yan - C - Bin ' s chapel inside Rivergard Keep .
description_long: Drosnin Drosnin was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Drosnin was the priest responsible for Yan - C - Bin ' s chapel inside Rivergard Keep . History . In 1491 DR , she managed the chapel at Rivergard Keep . However , Drosnin was confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Droth
description: Droth Droth , also known as Demon ' s blood , was a magic al substance made in the Abyss from the blood of mane s and the chitin of derghodemon s . Its primary use was to cure blindness when rubbed on the eyes or cure disease when swallowed . It could also be used to reverse the effects of acid .
description_long: Droth Droth , also known as Demon ' s blood , was a magic al substance made in the Abyss from the blood of mane s and the chitin of derghodemon s . Its primary use was to cure blindness when rubbed on the eyes or cure disease when swallowed . It could also be used to reverse the effects of acid .

title: Droth ( individual )
description: Droth ( individual ) Droth was a mercenary formerly in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Droth was hired by the Howling Hatred .
description_long: Droth ( individual ) Droth was a mercenary formerly in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Droth was hired by the Howling Hatred . However , during a skirmish with the Cult of the Black Earth , he was injured and captured . He remained catatonic in the Temple of the Black Earth ' s jail until some adventurers defeated the cultist jailers .

title: Drounan Harbrand
description: Drounan Harbrand Drounan Harbrand was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Drounan was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in poor quarters of Suzail .
description_long: Drounan Harbrand Drounan Harbrand was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Drounan was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in poor quarters of Suzail . History . Around 1480 DR , Drounan and his partner Andarphisk Hawkspike were paid by Lady Dawningdown to go to the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr to free Jeresson Dawningdown . In truth they planned to double - crossed Lady Dawningdown and asked a ransom for her son and escapes in Sembia . However arrived at the Castle they were pursued by a b lack dragon and refuged inside meeting Gelnur Farland , Arclath Delcastle , Amarune Whitewave , Duth Gulkanun and Imbrult Longclaws . Later Elminster Aumar , possessing the body of a drow priestess and posing as a War Wizard of Cormyr , introduced himself to them . Harbrand and Hawkspike managed to escape from the castle but met Alorglauvenemaus . They decided to collaborate with him .

title: Drow
description: Drow Drow , also known as dark elves , were a dark - skinned sub - race of elves that predominantly lived in the Underdark . They earned their reputation as evil people , with all justification , though some members with more neutral disposition did exist , as did an even smaller number of actually good members . On the surface , the drow were sometimes referred to as " The Ones Who Went Below " .
description_long: Drow Drow , also known as dark elves , were a dark - skinned sub - race of elves that predominantly lived in the Underdark . They earned their reputation as evil people , with all justification , though some members with more neutral disposition did exist , as did an even smaller number of actually good members . On the surface , the drow were sometimes referred to as " The Ones Who Went Below " . Description . In many ways , drow resembled eladrin . Height and Weight . They were shorter than many other sub - races of elves , and while there was no average height difference between male and female drow , males were on average a bit heavier . They usually varied in height from 5 ' 4 " – 6 ' ( 1 . 63 – 1 . 83 meters ) , and weighed from 130 – 175 lbs ( 59 to 79 kg ) on average . Coloration . Drow had skin of dark grey to obsidian color and white or yellow hair . Rare hair colors included copper and silver , the latter believed to be a sign of a mentally handicapped person , a superstition . Female drow with blonde hues indicated the drow in question was of an older age . Elder male drow had naturally silvering hair .

title: Drow - dragon
description: Drow - dragon Drow - dragons ( or " Draa ' zekyl " ) were an offshoot of both the drow and the shadow dragon , more precisely of the " zekyl " . Abilities . They were shadow dragon s but at the same time also drow .
description_long: Drow - dragon Drow - dragons ( or " Draa ' zekyl " ) were an offshoot of both the drow and the shadow dragon , more precisely of the " zekyl " . Abilities . They were shadow dragon s but at the same time also drow . They had the same abilities as the shadow dragon , which they developed further as they aged , but added to this the ability to change into an individual drow form and back to dragon form . They could stay in either form for an indefinite amount of time . They had a predisposition for sorcery . History . The drow - dragon was not a race that sprung up on its own . All drow - dragons traced their ancestry back to Clan Jaezred , a clan of shadow dragons who enslaved the drow of the city of Chaulssin in −221 DR but were killed by their own half - dragon offspring and servants in 634 DR . The population of Chaulssin then traveled to the Plane of Shadow to evade the armies of Menzoberranzan bent on killing them for being heretics in 734 DR . After founding their city Chaul ' mur ' ssin , they came into conflict with Clan Malaug .

title: Drow Merchant Houses
description: Drow Merchant Houses Drow Merchant Houses were an important part of drow society alongside independent traders . They were run mostly by male drow , though a few merchants , such as Nal Xalyth , contradicted this standard . The trade was a dangerous one , even more so for non - drow , and many died quickly due to " accidents " from Houses that disliked them or from rival traders .
description_long: Drow Merchant Houses Drow Merchant Houses were an important part of drow society alongside independent traders . They were run mostly by male drow , though a few merchants , such as Nal Xalyth , contradicted this standard . The trade was a dangerous one , even more so for non - drow , and many died quickly due to " accidents " from Houses that disliked them or from rival traders . Some were sponsored by noble Houses , ensuring their survival in some cases .

title: Drow dictionary
description: Drow dictionary A list of words in the Drow language . A . abban - " ally " , " not - enemy " .
description_long: Drow dictionary A list of words in the Drow language . A . abban - " ally " , " not - enemy " . abbil - " trusted friend " or " trusted comrade " . Largely an oxymoron based in cynicism since there are no real concepts of the word trust or friend in drow society even among family members . Also a term used by Jarlaxle towards his traveling companion Artemis Entreri , possibly meant as a legitimate term of endearment . akh - " group " . alur - " superior " . alust - " in front " . aluve - " I / we leave you " . Angardh xorr feleal - These appear to be the words to a charm spell . asanque - ambiguous word that means either " likewise " or " of course " . It can also mean " as you wish " . avinsin - " doomed " . B . bae ' qeshel - a rare type of drow bardic magic . bauth - " about " or " around " . bautha - " to dodge " . belaern - " wealth " , " coinage " or " treasure " . belbau - " to give " . belbol - " gift " . bol - term to describe " something mysterious or intriguing " . It indicates an " unidentified item " . brorn - " surprise " ; plural is brorna . bwael - " good " , " great " , " awesome " , anything positive . C . caballin - " food ' .

title: Drow judicator
description: Drow judicator The Drow Judicator is a special prestige class of the drow . Servants of demigod Selvetarm , to whom they must make an unholy pledge , judicators are spellcasters that have survived the vicious rites necessary to work with demons and Lolth - warped spiders . They often serve , albeit grudgingly , high - ranking priestesses of Lolth as defenders and assassins .
description_long: Drow judicator The Drow Judicator is a special prestige class of the drow . Servants of demigod Selvetarm , to whom they must make an unholy pledge , judicators are spellcasters that have survived the vicious rites necessary to work with demons and Lolth - warped spiders . They often serve , albeit grudgingly , high - ranking priestesses of Lolth as defenders and assassins . While at least some schooling in spellcasting is required for a drow to become a judicator , only the toughest and meanest sorcerer s and wizard s can survive the entry requirements .

title: Drow language
description: Drow language The Drow language is the most common native language of the drow . Deep Drow . Deep Drow , also known as Low Drow or Drowic , is the normal language of the drow .
description_long: Drow language The Drow language is the most common native language of the drow . Deep Drow . Deep Drow , also known as Low Drow or Drowic , is the normal language of the drow . Each isolated community has its own variant with a distinct accent . Deep Drow is read right to left in single - word columns with little punctuation . High Drow . High Drow is a more complex language than Deep Drow and has a larger , runic alphabet . This language is primarily used by priestesses in their rituals and by nobles who wish not to be understood by lower - born drow and slaves . Drow Sign Language . Drow Sign Language is a silent hand code used to communicate in the Underdark . Unlike other languages that must be heard to be comprehended , Drow Sign must be seen to gather meaning . It has no alphabet or written form . Human s and other goodly races often confuse the language ' s motions as spell conjurations . Drow Sign Language is commonly known by drow , who find it particularly useful on patrols and in other instances when silence is expedient . It is a very expressive language , able to convey tone and emotions .

title: Drow wanderer
description: Drow wanderer Drow wanderers are skilled drow who have eschewed their race ' s traditions to wander the depths of the Underdark . These unusual drow may be either good or evil but cast aside the way of their people to seek freedom in the darkness . Solitary and alone , these individuals must hone themselves to excellence in order to survive the many terrors that are common below the surface world .
description_long: Drow wanderer Drow wanderers are skilled drow who have eschewed their race ' s traditions to wander the depths of the Underdark . These unusual drow may be either good or evil but cast aside the way of their people to seek freedom in the darkness . Solitary and alone , these individuals must hone themselves to excellence in order to survive the many terrors that are common below the surface world . Culture . For most who wander the dark caverns within the Underdark it is a horrific and forbidding place , filled with unspeakable monstrosities and deadly horrors . Even most drow are unwilling to negotiate the twisting maze of tunnels to seek only certain death making drow wanderers , who not only live but indeed " thrive " in the Underdark , extremely abnormal but valuable individuals . Part of this skill comes from untapping the heritage of their race , turning the curse that ensnares their race into a strange blessing that gives them a special affinity for the pervading darkness of the world below . More importantly , however , is the special care that drow wanderers take to train their pathfinding abilities , which allows them to navigate the Underdark with relative ease .

title: Drowcraft
description: Drowcraft A drowcraft armor or weapon was one of a unique style of drow manufacture . Benefits . In an area of " faerzress " or inside an earth node , a " drowcraft " item became energized — a wielder of a " drowcraft " weapon would enjoy more fortune in making attacks and inflicting injuries , while a wearer of " drowcraft " armor would find attacks against them deflected .
description_long: Drowcraft A drowcraft armor or weapon was one of a unique style of drow manufacture . Benefits . In an area of " faerzress " or inside an earth node , a " drowcraft " item became energized — a wielder of a " drowcraft " weapon would enjoy more fortune in making attacks and inflicting injuries , while a wearer of " drowcraft " armor would find attacks against them deflected . This was in addition to its other enchantments . Disadvantages . A " drowcraft " armor or weapon had a number of inherent disadvantages . First , since it was powered by " faerzress " or an earth node , it lost its magic outside of such an area , but retained any other enchantments . Furthermore , these items were very weak against sunlight . When exposed to natural sunlight , even indirectly like in a room or even in a scabbard , there was a small risk they would disintegrate . Above ground , " drowcraft " armors and weapons kept safe inside a lead - lined container ( but could last there indefinitely ) or by coating them with " darkoil " , though only temporarily ( 1 day for armor , 3 days for a weapon ) . Reputation . " Drowcraft " armors and weapons were once quite popular among drow in the Underdark .

title: Drowned Lady
description: Drowned Lady " The Drowned Lady " was the name given to a ghost that haunted the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast around 1367 – 1370 DR . Locals regularly sighted her on or beside a pool named for her , Ghost Pond , just north of the hamlet . They described her as a beautiful woman .
description_long: Drowned Lady " The Drowned Lady " was the name given to a ghost that haunted the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast around 1367 – 1370 DR . Locals regularly sighted her on or beside a pool named for her , Ghost Pond , just north of the hamlet . They described her as a beautiful woman . Tales about her varied however . Some said she was a local woman , the great - grandmother of Beliot Sevenecho , the innkeeper . Others said she was a traveler who flirted with a local lad but then spurned , for which he killed her , likely by drowning her in the pond . The killer ' s identity and family varied according to the tale - teller .

title: Drowning Flagon
description: Drowning Flagon The Drowning Flagon was an inn in Marsember , Cormyr owned by Polinar Kirin and was originally established by a noble . Structure . It was situated on its own island and comprised of several buildings including kitchens , stables , and a central hall featuring luxurious dancing chambers .
description_long: Drowning Flagon The Drowning Flagon was an inn in Marsember , Cormyr owned by Polinar Kirin and was originally established by a noble . Structure . It was situated on its own island and comprised of several buildings including kitchens , stables , and a central hall featuring luxurious dancing chambers . Interior . This hall had three floors , the bottom two of which were used for dancing and the top floor for sleeping . It had two entrances : one for locals and one for visitors . It was used as a meeting place for gambling or for local organizations , but become expensive to stay in , attracting wealthier visitors to the city . Ever since a devastating fire , the kitchens were in their own separate building . Prices . Rooms for 7 gp per night for each person

title: Droze
description: Droze Droze was a fisherman who became the keeper of The Mermaid ' s Purse in Corth , Aglarond , after becoming injured in an accident . He would entertain guests at the inn , telling the story of rescuing a mermaid and being rewarded with three wishes from her king .
description_long: Droze Droze was a fisherman who became the keeper of The Mermaid ' s Purse in Corth , Aglarond , after becoming injured in an accident . He would entertain guests at the inn , telling the story of rescuing a mermaid and being rewarded with three wishes from her king .

title: Druarwood
description: Druarwood Druarwood was a forest west of Cold Wood and northeast of the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . The forest was sparse and narrow , full of pine , spruce firs and conifers .
description_long: Druarwood Druarwood was a forest west of Cold Wood and northeast of the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . The forest was sparse and narrow , full of pine , spruce firs and conifers . As the hills approached the mountains , the forest gave way to the scrub and heaths that were arid and cold , in which there were looming glaciers and peaks . Druarwood had a bad reputation as a place always being raided by orcs , giants , and other dangerous creatures . That fame was wholly deserved . Frost giant s and hill giant s descended into the forest looking for wild game , timber , and forage . Druarwood was also known for rothé , dire bear s , and dire wolverine s ; these latter creatures were so evil that even giants kept away from them . Geography . The wood was also the water source of River Redrun .

title: Drudach
description: Drudach A drudach was the smallest subdivision of a Calishite town or city , roughly equivalent to a precinct or neighborhood . Description . In cities , each drudach was surrounded by a short wall .
description_long: Drudach A drudach was the smallest subdivision of a Calishite town or city , roughly equivalent to a precinct or neighborhood . Description . In cities , each drudach was surrounded by a short wall . This was usually constructed of mud bricks and was six feet wide and three feet tall . ( In Calimport , the drudach walls were twice as wide . ) In smaller towns , the drudach boundaries were marked by other means , such as rows of stones or wooden fences . In the cities , the drudach walls were used as walkways for the upper class residents , so that their feet would never have to touch the dirt of the ground . Doors from upper class houses opened directly onto the drudach walls , and archways crossed over the gates from one drudach to another . Every drudach contained at minimum the following structures : Most drudachs contained clusters of residential buildings numbering 16 to 25 buildings per cluster . These clusters tended to be constructed at the corners of the drudach boundaries , ( as was the " amlakkhan " , ) and made use of the structure of the drudach walls if present . On average , about 500 people lived in each drudach .

title: Drudach Street
description: Drudach Street Drudach Street was the major road of the Calishite city of Manshaka . It ran west to east and effectively divided the city in half with four sabban s on each side . It ran from the gate of the city to its port region at the coast of the Shining Sea .
description_long: Drudach Street Drudach Street was the major road of the Calishite city of Manshaka . It ran west to east and effectively divided the city in half with four sabban s on each side . It ran from the gate of the city to its port region at the coast of the Shining Sea .

title: Drufi
description: Drufi Drufi was a frost giant who led an attack on Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drufi always traveled with her two winter wolves .
description_long: Drufi Drufi was a frost giant who led an attack on Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drufi always traveled with her two winter wolves . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of Jarl Storvald , Drufi led a giant contingent to Bryn Shander to search for Artus Cimber and the " Ring of Winter " .

title: Druid
description: Druid Druids were primal spellcaster s of considerable power and versatility , who gained their power through being at one with nature or through a connection to a powerful deity or nature spirit . Guardians of the wilderness , druids saw themselves less as masters of the natural order and more as an extension of its will . Culture .
description_long: Druid Druids were primal spellcaster s of considerable power and versatility , who gained their power through being at one with nature or through a connection to a powerful deity or nature spirit . Guardians of the wilderness , druids saw themselves less as masters of the natural order and more as an extension of its will . Culture . Known for their mysterious nature , druids called the wilderness their home , emulating the ways of wild beasts and other creatures of nature . Believing that nature ' s health depended on a precarious balance , druids believed that the four elements of the natural world - air , earth , fire , and water - must be prevented from ever gaining advantage over one another , lest the world become dominated by the forces of the elemental plane s . Likewise , druids believed nature exists outside of civilized conceptions of good , evil , order or chaos , instead seeking only to maintain a natural state of being which most of the civilized world cannot or will not understand .

title: Druid ' s Grove
description: Druid ' s Grove Druid ' s Grove was a large clearing filled with standing stones in a rough circle located to the northwest just outside of the village limits of Shadowdale . Flora . Oak trees surrounded the area around the Grove .
description_long: Druid ' s Grove Druid ' s Grove was a large clearing filled with standing stones in a rough circle located to the northwest just outside of the village limits of Shadowdale . Flora . Oak trees surrounded the area around the Grove . Mistletoe grew quite heavily around the Grove . Inhabitants . Several druids stayed in the area and tended the Grove , though they kept themselves apart from the rest of the Shadowdale community . A more formal group of druids , known as the Circle , once tended the Grove . Shortly after 1358 DR the Circle moved on and left the Grove . History . Druid ' s Grove had been a meeting place and a place of worship for druids for centuries before the 1300s DR . After the Spellplague , the Druid ' s Grove became known as a place of great primal power and it was sacred to the fey .

title: Druidcraft
description: Druidcraft Druidcraft was a transmutation cantrip spell that allowed the caster to commune with spirits to cause minor effects . Effect . The spell could have one of four effects chosen by the caster : Components .
description_long: Druidcraft Druidcraft was a transmutation cantrip spell that allowed the caster to commune with spirits to cause minor effects . Effect . The spell could have one of four effects chosen by the caster : Components . Only vocal and somatic components were needed for the casting of the spell .

title: Druidhome trilogy
description: Druidhome trilogy The Druidhome trilogy is the follow - up series to the Moonshae trilogy . The books were written by Douglas Niles . Douglas Niles also wrote a short story about the early days of the Moonshae Isles called " The First Moonwell " .
description_long: Druidhome trilogy The Druidhome trilogy is the follow - up series to the Moonshae trilogy . The books were written by Douglas Niles . Douglas Niles also wrote a short story about the early days of the Moonshae Isles called " The First Moonwell " . It is included in " Realms of Magic " anthology .

title: Druidic language
description: Druidic language Druidic was the secret language of druid s . Speakers . All druids were taught Druidic , and they were forbidden to teach the language to anyone who was not a druid .
description_long: Druidic language Druidic was the secret language of druid s . Speakers . All druids were taught Druidic , and they were forbidden to teach the language to anyone who was not a druid . Script . Druidic made use of its own alphabetic script . Sublanguages . Druidic was actually a language subgroup composed of two distinct but similar languages . The vast majority of druids spoke Drueidan ; those from the Moonshaes spoke a language called Daelic . History . Drueidan was developed by a powerful group of druids who worshiped Silvanus . Silvanus made an agreement with the other nature gods of the Faerûnian pantheon to allow druids all over Faerûn to speak it . Daelic , on the other hand , was developed by druids who worshiped the Earthmother .

title: Druids of Tall Trees
description: Druids of Tall Trees The Druids of Tall Trees were a secretive order of druid s who let few others into their woods and groves . Their main goal was to combat expansion and protect the Tall Trees within the High Forest . The organization was lead by the Great Druid Uthgang Jyarl .
description_long: Druids of Tall Trees The Druids of Tall Trees were a secretive order of druid s who let few others into their woods and groves . Their main goal was to combat expansion and protect the Tall Trees within the High Forest . The organization was lead by the Great Druid Uthgang Jyarl .

title: Drullister
description: Drullister Drullister was a phaerimm and the leader of a small hive in Synod in 1375 DR . History . Drullister and its hive gathered in Synod to study the strange sharn formed from Augathra the Mad , a fellow phaerimm , and Shar Cormrael .
description_long: Drullister Drullister was a phaerimm and the leader of a small hive in Synod in 1375 DR . History . Drullister and its hive gathered in Synod to study the strange sharn formed from Augathra the Mad , a fellow phaerimm , and Shar Cormrael . After 1372 DR , Hadrhune discovered the location and the very strange mythallar located there . Unknown to anyone , Hadrhune decided to make a deal with Drullister instead of fighting and agreed to teach it shadow magic in exchange for free access to study the mythallar . In 1375 , however , an adventuring party raided the ruins in order to disrupt the shadovar ' s plots .

title: Drum Tower
description: Drum Tower The Drum Tower was the main alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . Found in the center of the city near the Boyla ' s Court , the Drum Tower sported red beams , a black - tiled roof , and shining brass fittings .
description_long: Drum Tower The Drum Tower was the main alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . Found in the center of the city near the Boyla ' s Court , the Drum Tower sported red beams , a black - tiled roof , and shining brass fittings . The tower stood three stories high . A large drum hung from rafters at the top of the tower . Activities . The drum tower was used to rouse the militia , served as a fire alarm , and announced special proclamations occurring in the courtyard below . The Master of the Drum lived in quarters found at the base of the tower .

title: Drums
description: Drums Drums were a group of percussion instruments dating back a very long way and used by many races . They were all characterized by a membrane , usually made of skin , which was spanned tightly over some kind of hollow resonating body to create sound . Varieties .
description_long: Drums Drums were a group of percussion instruments dating back a very long way and used by many races . They were all characterized by a membrane , usually made of skin , which was spanned tightly over some kind of hollow resonating body to create sound . Varieties . Known varieties were kettledrums , side drums , bass drums , gong drums , bongos , tom - toms , cylinder drums , the changoo , talking drums , and slit drums . Special variants used in Zakhara were tapered drums or " darbukkah " , elephant drums , " jahlah " , the " naqqarah " , " qas ' ah baladi " , and the " tabl " . The Iulutiun s had a drum called " kilat " made of a sealskin over a circle of wood or bone .

title: Drunk sailor
description: Drunk sailor Drunk sailor was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Found near Flinn , this sailor was drinking ale and mistook the Kalach - Cha to be his friend and asked how was the Kalach - Cha ' s mother .
description_long: Drunk sailor Drunk sailor was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Found near Flinn , this sailor was drinking ale and mistook the Kalach - Cha to be his friend and asked how was the Kalach - Cha ' s mother .

title: Drusilla
description: Drusilla Drusilla was a young woman in Waterdeep in the late 1350s DR . One night in a tavern in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , she and a friend flattered and flirted with the dwarf adventurer Onyx the Invincible . However , this was a distraction so an old woman could get his autograph — on a marriage contract .
