The effect of the tremor depended on the type of terrain it was cast in , so a cavern would collapse and damage those caught in the collapse where heavily damaged . Areas with structures or woods would cause damage to the structures and trees , and a swamp would have its water drained . Components . Only vocal and somatic components and a pinch of dust , piece of rock and a lump of clay where needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Earthroot
description: Earthroot The Earthroot was a vast domain in the Underdark . Since it lay beneath the Unapproachable East - buried deep below Thay and the Sunrise Mountains few people knew of its existence and even fewer explorers mapped its tunnels and caves . In its northern reaches , it was a frigid area containing numerous ice formations and caves .
description_long: Earthroot The Earthroot was a vast domain in the Underdark . Since it lay beneath the Unapproachable East - buried deep below Thay and the Sunrise Mountains few people knew of its existence and even fewer explorers mapped its tunnels and caves . In its northern reaches , it was a frigid area containing numerous ice formations and caves . It southern portions extended beneath Raurin , the Dust Desert . The Earthroot was home to the Drow society of Undrek ' Thoz , as well as the duergar realm of Fraaszummdin . It also harbored the ruins of the ancient empires of Nar , Raumathar and Imaskar once built in and around the region of the Dust Desert . These empires ranked among the oldest human civilizations of Faerûn . The most mysterious and greatest hidden realm in the Earthroot was the realm of Deep Imaskar itself . It lay below the Endless Wastes in the most eastern part of the Earthroot .

title: Earthsoul genasi
description: Earthsoul genasi An earthsoul genasi , also known as an earth genasi , was a type of genasi that was able to harness the power of the earth . Description . Earthsoul genasi came in many physical shapes and appearances .
description_long: Earthsoul genasi An earthsoul genasi , also known as an earth genasi , was a type of genasi that was able to harness the power of the earth . Description . Earthsoul genasi came in many physical shapes and appearances . Many carried obvious traits of the Elemental Plane of Earth , such as blocky features or earthlike skin , but others had earthlike features that were less apparent . Personality . Earthsoul genasi tended to be strong and tough , but were often stubborn and oblivious . They tended to be indifferent to others of their kind and thus in many cases isolated themselves . Abilities . Earthsoul genasi were able to harness the power of the earth . They had darkvision and were able to pass over the ground without a trace . They said that the earth would speak to them and that they were able to talk back to it . Religion . The earthsouled worshiped many lords and gods and were not confined to just one . However , common deities worshiped by the earthsouled were Chauntea , Geb , and Grumbar . Locations . Earthsoul genasi could be found anywhere . However , they were more common in the North near the Spine of the World , where there were " portal s " to the Plane of Earth .

title: Earthspur
description: Earthspur The Earthspur was an 8 , 000 ft ( 2 , 438 m ) mountain at the southern end of the island of Dragonisle in the Pirate Isles . It was the main geographic feature of the island and acted as a navigational aid to seafarers in the area .
description_long: Earthspur The Earthspur was an 8 , 000 ft ( 2 , 438 m ) mountain at the southern end of the island of Dragonisle in the Pirate Isles . It was the main geographic feature of the island and acted as a navigational aid to seafarers in the area .

title: Earthspur Mountains
description: Earthspur Mountains The Earthspur Mountains , or simply the Earthspurs , and sometimes named the Giantspike Mountains or the Dragonspike Mountains , was a great mountain range in north Faerûn . It ran roughly from northwest to southeast , from the Moonsea and the Galena Mountains in the north to the Sea of Fallen Stars in the south . It had two arms : the smaller Troll Mountains and the Earthfast Mountains .
description_long: Earthspur Mountains The Earthspur Mountains , or simply the Earthspurs , and sometimes named the Giantspike Mountains or the Dragonspike Mountains , was a great mountain range in north Faerûn . It ran roughly from northwest to southeast , from the Moonsea and the Galena Mountains in the north to the Sea of Fallen Stars in the south . It had two arms : the smaller Troll Mountains and the Earthfast Mountains . This range bordered Damara , Vaasa , and Impiltur in the east with the Vast in the west . Geographical features . The Earthspur Mountains were high and imposing ; the range ' s tallest peaks were nearly 4 miles ( 6 . 4 kilometers ) high . There were few trails through the mountains , making them very dangerous . One was Three Trees Pass , a long cleft between the Earthfasts and the Troll Mountains . There was a gap in the mountains where the High Country of the Vast jutted east ; rumors told of hidden passes through the mountains into neighboring Impiltur . Further east was the High Pass west of the River Icehilt . At the center of the range , at its highest point , was the Glacier of the White Worm , from which cold winds continuously blew around the peaks .

title: Earthwood
description: Earthwood The Earthwood was a thick forest in the Earthspur Mountains within Damara , which consisted mainly of birch and evergreen trees . Geography . Despite the poor appearance of the stony , hilly soil , the fertility of the land was such that it allowed trees to grow quickly .
description_long: Earthwood The Earthwood was a thick forest in the Earthspur Mountains within Damara , which consisted mainly of birch and evergreen trees . Geography . Despite the poor appearance of the stony , hilly soil , the fertility of the land was such that it allowed trees to grow quickly . The cause of this was dictated by legend as the work of a druid who was attempting to defy the advance of the Great Glacier , which had reached this far south in the past . Inhabitants . The forest was thinly inhabited , and some woodcutters chose to live here , although more people did arrive when Rawlinswood became less tolerant towards outsiders . The goblin s and other inhabitants of the Earthspur Mountains would not enter the forest .

title: Earynspieir Ongluth
description: Earynspieir Ongluth Earynspieir Ongluth was a male elf of Cormanthyr and the Royal Archmage at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor in 241 DR . History . Earynspieir was one of the two Supreme Court Wizards in service to Coronal Eltargrim .
description_long: Earynspieir Ongluth Earynspieir Ongluth was a male elf of Cormanthyr and the Royal Archmage at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor in 241 DR . History . Earynspieir was one of the two Supreme Court Wizards in service to Coronal Eltargrim . The Srinshee considered him the most likely to oppose the Opening , but it was his colleague Ilimitar who attacked the Srinshee . Earynspieir , despite all his doubts and prejudices , ultimately helped to raise the " mythal " in 261 DR .

title: East District
description: East District The East District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The East District was found in the Palace Quarter and made - up most of the eastern section of the city along the city walls .
description_long: East District The East District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The East District was found in the Palace Quarter and made - up most of the eastern section of the city along the city walls . This district was bordered by the Affluent District in the south , the Court District in the west , and the Craft District in the north . The Avenue of Wealth rang along much of the East District ' s western border , while the Ghost ' s Route framed it from the north . Inhabitants . A portion of Huzuz ' s military was quartered within the East District . Though many caravanserai could be found around all of the gates of Huzuz , the East District was one of only two districts within the city walls to house a caravanserai neighborhood .

title: East Faerûn
description: East Faerûn East Faerûn bordered the eastern expanses of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Here the sea formed a long arm that traveled to the east before turning south to become the Alamber Sea . The northern nations of this mysterious area were termed by some people as the " Unapproachable East " and the southern nations the " Old Empires " , and , for a time , the " Empires of the Alamber Sea " .
description_long: East Faerûn East Faerûn bordered the eastern expanses of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Here the sea formed a long arm that traveled to the east before turning south to become the Alamber Sea . The northern nations of this mysterious area were termed by some people as the " Unapproachable East " and the southern nations the " Old Empires " , and , for a time , the " Empires of the Alamber Sea " . Many of these nations allowed slavery , and depended on slaves for much of their economy . After the Spellplague , a few new nations arose in this regions , including a interloper nation from Abeir . Regions . Aglarond . This nation lay on a long peninsula that jutted westward into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Its landward border joined it to Thay , a powerful enemy that Aglarond constantly opposed . Much of the peninsula was occupied by the Yuirwood , a forest home to half - elves and old ruins . Along the eastern border was the Umber Marshes . The capital city was Veltalar , home of a powerful sorceress known as the Simbul . Altumbel . A small , isolated kingdom on the western end of the peninsula it shared with Aglarond . Chessenta .

title: East Gate
description: East Gate The East Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . The East was located on the eastern side of Huzuz at the juncture of the River Road and the South Road .
description_long: East Gate The East Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . The East was located on the eastern side of Huzuz at the juncture of the River Road and the South Road . The Caravan Boulevard , or Dihl al - Taif , exited Huzuz through this gate . Activities . This gate was heavily used both by caravans bound for the Haunted Lands or those returning from them with goods .

title: Eastern Imaskari languages
description: Eastern Imaskari languages The Eastern Imaskari languages was a collection of languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the eastern parts of the Hordelands . Description . The Eastern Imaskari languages were nasal languages and spoken in the back of the throat .
description_long: Eastern Imaskari languages The Eastern Imaskari languages was a collection of languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the eastern parts of the Hordelands . Description . The Eastern Imaskari languages were nasal languages and spoken in the back of the throat . Long i and e sounds were drawn out . Languages . Chuchian , Gurri , Oigur , Quirish , and Zamogedi were commonly placed in this grouping . Two dialects of Chuchian , Fankiang and Khaghun , were distinct enough to sometimes be considered full languages of this group . Oigur and Quirish were also sometimes grouped with the Southern Imaskari languages . Gurri , the language of the Gur s , was so influenced by Halardrim as to be considered a and not a true language of the Eastern Imaskari group . All of the tribes speaking these languages were located along the border of Shou Lung , north of the Kora Shan . Scripts . While Gurri made use of the Thorass script , most of the other Eastern Imaskari languages did not have a written alphabet . History . All of these tongues had a common ancestor in ancient Imaskari , or Roushoum , and were strongly influenced by the Shou Chiang languages .

title: Eastern Plains
description: Eastern Plains The Eastern Plains were a region of deforested plains and rolling hills in the east of the kingdom of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . The Eastern Plains were bordered on the west by the Wyvernflow and Wyvernwater and on the north by the Thunder River .
description_long: Eastern Plains The Eastern Plains were a region of deforested plains and rolling hills in the east of the kingdom of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . The Eastern Plains were bordered on the west by the Wyvernflow and Wyvernwater and on the north by the Thunder River . To the northeast stood the Thunder Peaks , and below it to the east lay the Vast Swamp . In the south was the coast of the Dragonmere . Once forested , the denuded land comprised long stretches of low rolling hills covered in green grass . Hidden amidst these were sudden crevasses , quiet valleys and glens tangled with trees , rushing streams and clear pools of cold water . History . As with all of Cormyr , the Forest Kingdom , the whole area was once covered in forest , as it was in the 7th century before Dalereckoning . However , over the course of centuries , logging , agriculture , and war had stripped away the trees and left only rolling plains . The land was apparently completely bare by 112 DR . The area remained unclaimed by great powers , however , until the kingdom of Cormyr made its inevitable expansion past the Wyvernwater .

title: Eastern Shaar
description: Eastern Shaar The Eastern Shaar was the eastern extension of the Shaar . Its major feature was the Council Hills . As of 1479 DR , Okoth , a reawakened realm of the sarrukh , lay directly south of Azulduth ( the Lake of Salt ) , and the Gulf of Luiren , which was a realm named Luiren before the Spellplague , lay to the south of Okoth .
description_long: Eastern Shaar The Eastern Shaar was the eastern extension of the Shaar . Its major feature was the Council Hills . As of 1479 DR , Okoth , a reawakened realm of the sarrukh , lay directly south of Azulduth ( the Lake of Salt ) , and the Gulf of Luiren , which was a realm named Luiren before the Spellplague , lay to the south of Okoth . The eastern portion of the Eastern Shaar was called the Beastlands .

title: Easthaven
description: Easthaven Easthaven was one of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The town was located on the southern shore of Lac Dinneshere on the east end of the Eastway that led to Bryn Shander .
description_long: Easthaven Easthaven was one of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The town was located on the southern shore of Lac Dinneshere on the east end of the Eastway that led to Bryn Shander . Originally just a small hamlet , the building of the Eastway trade road to Bryn Shander proved to be a boon to the village which became the fastest - growing community in the region with a fishing fleet rivaling that of Caer - Dineval . A breakwater protected most of the piers that reached out into Lac Dinneshere . History . In 1281 DR , Hrothgar assembled an expedition to Kuldahar following the arrival of a messenger . However , the expedition was ambushed by frost giants in Kuldahar Pass and the only survivors to reach Kuldahar were a newly arrived group of adventurers . Akar Kessell murdered his mentor Morkai the Red in Easthaven . In 1356 DR , the representative to the council was Glensather . He was a respected and even - tempered councilman , viewing the Ten Towns as " sturdy bulwarks against barbarism .

title: Easting ( town )
description: Easting ( town ) Easting was a small town east of Iriaebor , hence its name . Description . Easting was typical of such small communities .
description_long: Easting ( town ) Easting was a small town east of Iriaebor , hence its name . Description . Easting was typical of such small communities . However , three things set it apart from other similar ( and often unnoticed ) communities throughout the Western Heartlands . While other communities might have a notable product , a significant nonhuman population , or a famed inhabitant , they rarely had all three like Easting did . Easting ’ s small size and location made it a meeting spot for dwarven merchants working out of hidden delves in the Far Hills . Their smith work was above the human average , and individuals wishing to contact such craftsmen , or to contact dwarven communities , usually started in Easting . Easting was the home of Rulthaven the Sage , whose area of expertise lay in the study of plants and their uses , including herbs and poisons . Rulthaven was consulted both by priests and representatives from Darkhold . Finally , Easting was the home of at least four noted horse breeders whose stables did a brisk trade in remounting travelers journeying from the Sword Coast to the Inner Sea . Their prices were competitive .

title: Easting Reach
description: Easting Reach The Easting Reach was a wide expanse of water at the northeast edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was calm and predictable , and was therefore well suited to trade . The city of Sarshel lay at its mouth .
description_long: Easting Reach The Easting Reach was a wide expanse of water at the northeast edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was calm and predictable , and was therefore well suited to trade . The city of Sarshel lay at its mouth . Settlements . In Impiltur , Sarshel was on the west bank of the Easting Reach at its mouth , and Kielbast was a little further north . Ilmwatch was even further to the north , and Buzzard Beak Harbor lay just south of there . Uthmere was on the eastern side of the Reach adjacent to Ilmwatch , and the Soleine River flowed into the Reach at its northernmost point .

title: Easting language
description: Easting language Easting was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the Vast and Impiltur , from Mulmaster and the Icemelt Mountains in the north to Lyrabar in the south , and from Tantras in the west to Easting Reach in the east . Many of the speakers of Easting also spoke Damaran , a closely related Chard language . There were several dialects of Easting , including Impilturian ( spoken in Impiltur ) , Mulman ( from Mulmaster ) , Procampan ( from Procampur ) , and Tantran ( from Tantras ) .
description_long: Easting language Easting was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the Vast and Impiltur , from Mulmaster and the Icemelt Mountains in the north to Lyrabar in the south , and from Tantras in the west to Easting Reach in the east . title: Eastmyr
description: Eastmyr Eastmyr was a district of Menzoberranzan that was primarily home to commoners . Inhabitants . Most commoners , including mercenaries and lesser merchants , lived in this neighborhood .
description_long: Eastmyr Eastmyr was a district of Menzoberranzan that was primarily home to commoners . Inhabitants . Most commoners , including mercenaries and lesser merchants , lived in this neighborhood . While better than the Braeryn district , Eastmyr was still where you would find many poor and outlaw drow and non - drow of no discernible means . The house of the city ' s primary agricultural family . A good but inexpensive inn along the northern cavern wall near the Braeryn . Narbondel ' s Shadow was run in 1370 DR by Nicholas Tindall , a retired human adventurer who was stranded in Menzoberranzan due to an angry deep dragon . Tindall had good contacts with the city ' s merchants and shared them with visitors due to his kindhearted , though cynical , nature . Symeera ' s was a fine inn run in 1370 DR by Symeera of Neverwinter , a mage of the Many - Starred Cloak guild of Neverwinter , who was stranded in the Underdark two decades previously . Symeera is also well - connected with the city ' s merchants .

title: Eastway
description: Eastway The Eastway was a road from Bryn Shander to Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The gravel road began in Bryn Shander traveling east toward the community of Easthaven and the banks of Lac Dinneshere .
description_long: Eastway The Eastway was a road from Bryn Shander to Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The gravel road began in Bryn Shander traveling east toward the community of Easthaven and the banks of Lac Dinneshere . History . By 1351 DR , the road aided Easthaven in building a fishing fleet rivaling Caer - Dineval .

title: Eastways
description: Eastways The Eastways were three tunnels and roads that lead east from the drow city of Menzoberranzan to Fardrimm and Delzoun . Menzoberranzan . The Eastways were three tunnels that opened up in to the cavern of Menzoberranzan at the district of Donigarten .
description_long: Eastways The Eastways were three tunnels and roads that lead east from the drow city of Menzoberranzan to Fardrimm and Delzoun . Menzoberranzan . The Eastways were three tunnels that opened up in to the cavern of Menzoberranzan at the district of Donigarten . Here they were defended by several scorpion - shaped jade spider s . Nearby was a series of east - west stalactites known as the Spiderfangs which were used by House Barrison Del ' Armgo to defend the city against hostile incursion . Route . The Eastways branched out into three main tunnels : the smallest and shortest led to the Driders ' Chasm , while the other two led north and east to the Fardrimm and fallen Delzoun .

title: Easy Blades Adventuring Band
description: Easy Blades Adventuring Band The Easy Blades Adventuring Band was an adventuring company that operated in Cormyr and Sembia in the mid - 14th century DR . The Easy Blades were chartered in Suzail . They were often suspect of conducting extensively smuggling operations along the coast of Sembia .
description_long: Easy Blades Adventuring Band The Easy Blades Adventuring Band was an adventuring company that operated in Cormyr and Sembia in the mid - 14th century DR . The Easy Blades were chartered in Suzail . They were often suspect of conducting extensively smuggling operations along the coast of Sembia . One member was Whelgar Taerncole , though he ' d retired before 1358 DR .

title: Easy march
description: Easy march Easy march was an evocation spell that allowed a number of creatures to march quickly for days without fatigue . Effects . The number of creatures that could be affected by this spell and the number of days of duration was related to the caster ' s level of experience .
description_long: Easy march Easy march was an evocation spell that allowed a number of creatures to march quickly for days without fatigue . Effects . The number of creatures that could be affected by this spell and the number of days of duration was related to the caster ' s level of experience . Those under the influence of " easy march " could move at two and a half times their normal movement rate for the whole day and not suffer from fatigue . Then after the usual amount of food and rest they could get up and do it again the next day , and repeat until the spell ended . During the time that " easy march " was active , those affected were less effective at fighting , perhaps due to their timing being thrown off . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , " easy march " required a piece of shoe leather to cast .

title: Easy trail
description: Easy trail Easy trail was an abjuration spell used by travelers of the wilderness in the Forgotten Realms . It created a path for the caster and any followers behind him by magically forcing aside any underbrush gently . Effects .
description_long: Easy trail Easy trail was an abjuration spell used by travelers of the wilderness in the Forgotten Realms . It created a path for the caster and any followers behind him by magically forcing aside any underbrush gently . Effects . The spell created a field of energy that effected natural plants but not plant creature s . Those traveling in the area of the effect could move as easily as if they were passing along a trail . An additional benefit to the use of the spell was that it effectively covered tracks automatically , as plants would return to their former places once the spellcaster passed 30 feet ( nine meters ) beyond , hiding any signs of passage . Once cast , the spell would last at least a couple hours , depending on the power of the caster . Components . This spell required both verbal and somatic component s .

title: Eather Heilean
description: Eather Heilean Eather Heilean is a High Harper , who was recruited by the organization at a young age . She has recruited many members to the Harpers that are loyal to Twilight Hall first and foremost . Eather has been also been an agent who has dealt with members who have defected to the Moonstars .

She has recruited many members to the Harpers that are loyal to Twilight Hall first and foremost . Eather has been also been an agent who has dealt with members who have defected to the Moonstars .

title: Ebenz Farbough
description: Ebenz Farbough Ebenz Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Ebenz and his wife Bea Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar .
description_long: Ebenz Farbough Ebenz Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Ebenz and his wife Bea Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar . When the city ' s First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - human s , Ebenz and Bea decided to house the ten abandoned children living in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children . A year later , Bea gave birth to six sons , so things became even more chaotic . Trouble arrived the year after when the Rage of Demons began and the tiefling boy Pynroth disappeared .

title: Ebi
description: Ebi Ebi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District .
description_long: Ebi Ebi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District . Ebi led around 350 yakuza for many decades . On the surface , Ebi posed as a successful shipping merchant . His main business was managing gambling houses and he was tolerated and sometimes supported by samurai of the Niwa clan in exchange for running honest games inside gambling houses and preventing any samurai from ruining themselves with excessive debts . History . In 1357 DR , Ebi ' s gang came in conflict with the recently arrived and more violent yakuza gang led by Musukosan no Hashi . They frequently fought in the streets . The situation reached the point that only one of the two gangs could survive .

title: Eboanaflimoth
description: Eboanaflimoth Eboanaflimoth , also known as Ebonflame , was a red dragon working with Cult of the Dragon . History . Hating Lathander with a passion , the dragon sent her cultists to attack the Morninglord ' s temple in Tilverton around 1370 DR .
description_long: Eboanaflimoth Eboanaflimoth , also known as Ebonflame , was a red dragon working with Cult of the Dragon . History . Hating Lathander with a passion , the dragon sent her cultists to attack the Morninglord ' s temple in Tilverton around 1370 DR . By 1374 DR , Ebonflame was transformed into a dracolich .

title: Ebon Lefash
description: Ebon Lefash Ebon Lefash was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Ebon Lefash led a a mob of looters and scavengers who moved into the deserted Old Stone Keep . The commander of the Legendary Campaign , which sought to unify the wartorn Utter East through conquest , seeking to take back something they believed to be rightfully theirs , came to the ruins to defeat Lefash in a bloodforge battle .
description_long: Ebon Lefash Ebon Lefash was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . title: Ebonsoul
description: Ebonsoul Ebonsoul was a lich whose ship , " Thepurl ' s Diamond " , was attacked and sunk by pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars around the time of the Spellplague ( 1385 DR ) . History . In 1481 DR , agents working for the halfling assassin guild master Pericolo Topolino discovered a shard of a Mirror of Opposition in Ebonsoul ' s wrecked ship in a 200 - foot - deep ( 61 meters ) trench in the Sea of Fallen Stars some 12 leagues southwest off Aglarond ' s southwesternmost point .
description_long: Ebonsoul Ebonsoul was a lich whose ship , " Thepurl ' s Diamond " , was attacked and sunk by pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars around the time of the Spellplague ( 1385 DR ) . History . In 1481 DR , agents working for the halfling assassin guild master Pericolo Topolino discovered a shard of a Mirror of Opposition in Ebonsoul ' s wrecked ship in a 200 - foot - deep ( 61 meters ) trench in the Sea of Fallen Stars some 12 leagues southwest off Aglarond ' s southwesternmost point . Because the wreck was so deep , Topolino had to rely on the reincarnated Regis , aka Spider , whose new body had watersoul genasi blood that allowed him to hold his breath for long periods of time . Regis dove to the wreck but inadvertently released Ebonsoul from imprisonment in his silver coffin . From the wreck , Regis was able to retrieve two magical items : a ring immunity to infravision and heat sensing , and a magical three - bladed snake dagger , probably Ebonsoul ' s own weapon , that released Ebonsoul ' s specter upon delivering the killing blow . A few days later , Ebonsoul appeared at Topolino ' s mansion in Delthuntle and killed the old halfling . Regis was forced to flee the city .

title: Ebony Queen
description: Ebony Queen The Ebony Queen was a special sailing vessel capable of travelling between all of the genie realms on the Elemental planes . Description . The entire ship was made from ebony wood and was set with an orrery of the inner planes .
description_long: Ebony Queen The Ebony Queen was a special sailing vessel capable of travelling between all of the genie realms on the Elemental planes . Description . The entire ship was made from ebony wood and was set with an orrery of the inner planes . Crew . The crew for the " Ebony Queen " was comprised of jann , corsairs , sea mage s , and amazons . Soot was their captain .

title: Ebusado
description: Ebusado Ebusado was one of the most talented kensai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebusado ran the Light - Sparkling Water School in Yoemura on Mikedono Island .
description_long: Ebusado Ebusado was one of the most talented kensai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebusado ran the Light - Sparkling Water School in Yoemura on Mikedono Island . There he had trained the best kensai and samurai of the country . It was very difficult to be accepted into the school .

title: Eckert
description: Eckert Eckert used to be the valet of Talbot Uskevren until he betrayed him and the other Uskevren s in exchange for the life of his daughter , Maelin , who was being kept by Radu and Stannis Malveen . When he outlived his usefulness , Radu nearly slew Eckert , but the man was saved by Feena Archwood , who managed to heal him in time . He was later dismissed by Talbot , who showed Eckert sympathy by not having him jailed .
description_long: Eckert Eckert used to be the valet of Talbot Uskevren until he betrayed him and the other Uskevren s in exchange for the life of his daughter , Maelin , who was being kept by Radu and Stannis Malveen . He was later dismissed by Talbot , who showed Eckert sympathy by not having him jailed . Notes . In " The Halls of Stormweather " , Eckert ' s name was spelled both Eckart and Eckert several times , but Eckert was used exclusively in " Black Wolf " .
