title: Ector Brahms
description: Ector Brahms Ector Brahms ( pronounced ECK - turr BRAMM ) was the ruler of Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ector was a stubbornly honorable and stoic man .
description_long: Ector Brahms Ector Brahms ( pronounced ECK - turr BRAMM ) was the ruler of Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ector was a stubbornly honorable and stoic man . He knew well what it was like to carry the burden of leadership . Ector was really shocked by Aleyd ' s death . History . Ector served as Knight Commander of the Knights of the Black Fist under the two previous Lords Protector , both of whom died suspiciously . As Lord Regent Ector tried to do well for his city . In 1489 DR , he luckily survived Vorgansharax ' s attack on Valjevo Castle , where all the city ' s leaders were killed . Hiding his true identity , he and many others were kept prisoner by the cultists in the secret prison at Stojanow Gate . Eventually , some adventurers aided by Black Fists loyalists led by Aleyd Burral defeated the cultist guards and Ector broke free . Being shocked by Aleyd ' s death he agreed to escape from the city in order to reorganize his troops against cultists and so helped by adventurers he tried to escaped using the sewers However he died during the escape .

title: Ed Bonny
description: Ed Bonny Ed Bonny is a freelance game designer . Ed recalled becoming hooked on the " Forgotten Realms " in the 1980s when he read the Time of Troubles trilogy . Ed considers himself obsessed with maintaining consistent lore for the Realms .
description_long: Ed Bonny Ed Bonny is a freelance game designer . Ed recalled becoming hooked on the " Forgotten Realms " in the 1980s when he read the Time of Troubles trilogy . Ed considers himself obsessed with maintaining consistent lore for the Realms . His work was featured in Chapters 1 , 2 , 4 , 5 , 7 , 9 , 10 , and 11 of " Lost Empires of Faerûn " , and he also participated in " Monster Manual II " for 3rd edition .

title: Ed Gentry
description: Ed Gentry Ed Gentry is the author of the novel " Neversfall " , part of The Citadels series . He began writing with an entry to the open call for " Maiden of Pain " . His short story " Freedom ' s Promise " appears in the Realms of the Dragons II compilation .
description_long: Ed Gentry Ed Gentry is the author of the novel " Neversfall " , part of The Citadels series . He began writing with an entry to the open call for " Maiden of Pain " . His short story " Freedom ' s Promise " appears in the Realms of the Dragons II compilation . Influences . Amongst Realms authors , Ed regards Paul S . Kemp as a tremendous talent , and regards Elaine Cunningham ' s characters as providing a lot from which to learn . He admires ' s series as " perhaps the most richly detailed work I ' ve ever read . " His other influences include , and . Ed uses films as an additional source of creativity .

title: Ed Greenwood
description: Ed Greenwood Ed Greenwood ( born 1959 ) is the creator of the Forgotten Realms . He first began in 1967 , writing fiction set in his imagined world . He created the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting for his own D & D games in 1975 , and its popularity with other gamers through Dragon Magazine led to TSR ' s purchase of the setting in 1986 .
description_long: Ed Greenwood Ed Greenwood ( born 1959 ) is the creator of the Forgotten Realms . He first began in 1967 , writing fiction set in his imagined world . He created the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting for his own D & D games in 1975 , and its popularity with other gamers through Dragon Magazine led to TSR ' s purchase of the setting in 1986 . Many believe Elminster to be an alter ego for Ed so he can say all of the things that Ed himself is too polite to say . Ed has denied this . When not writing Realmslore or yet another book , Ed keeps himself busy by attending conventions and working as a library clerk in Canada where he lives at a farmhouse in Ontario . Ed ' s ambition is to fully detail the entirety of the Forgotten Realms , fleshing out every place in full detail , but he admits that this is an unrealistic goal and is unlikely ever to be achieved . Other activities . Ed has contributed to most Forgotten Realms gaming accessories , and authored many more — including the detailed " Volo ' s Guide " series — and continues to DM his own campaign .

title: Edario
description: Edario Edario was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Edario was Highcliff ' s blacksmith , who specialized in crafting armor .
description_long: Edario Edario was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Edario was Highcliff ' s blacksmith , who specialized in crafting armor . However , he was disappointed , since he did not have much business . Later , Edario was asked to join Crossroad Keep to offer his services .

title: Eden of the Clearlight
description: Eden of the Clearlight Eden of the Clearlight claimed to be a high priestess of Tymora but in reality she was a self - serving , greedy person with few , if any divine powers . Eden lived in the Clearlight , Tymora ' s run - down temple in Luskan and was the leader of the Coin Spinners gang . History .
description_long: Eden of the Clearlight Eden of the Clearlight claimed to be a high priestess of Tymora but in reality she was a self - serving , greedy person with few , if any divine powers . Eden lived in the Clearlight , Tymora ' s run - down temple in Luskan and was the leader of the Coin Spinners gang . History . Little was known of Eden ' s early life but when she was young her mother drank herself to death . At an early age , she joined an adventuring company and left Luskan for a while . The Coin Spinners were active in Luskan at least as early as 1475 DR , so Eden had apparently returned to Luskan by then . In 1480 DR , Eden hired Toytere , the leader of the Dead Rats gang , to kidnap Myrin Darkdance . After Myrin was captured , Eden was approached by Lilten , a high priest and chosen of Beshaba and ordered to leave Myrin alone . A few days later , Kalen Dren cowered each of the gangs in Luskan over a ten - day period and announced a public assembly to select a king of Luskan . Eden showed up with her Coin Spinner entourage and the assembly of gangs quickly broke into a melee . The demon Scour arrived in the form of a swarm of vermin and attacked the gangs , killing many .

title: Edherli Lewel
description: Edherli Lewel Edherli Lewel was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was an impatient individual but took great care with her wagon and horse .
description_long: Edherli Lewel Edherli Lewel was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was an impatient individual but took great care with her wagon and horse . History . Around 1489 DR , Edherli was traveling from Chult to Waterdeep to sell exotic woods . She attached her wagon to a great caravan , which unknown to her was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Edificant Library
description: Edificant Library The Edificant Library was a library located in the south of the Snowflake Mountains . It stood for over 600 years . Architecture .
description_long: Edificant Library The Edificant Library was a library located in the south of the Snowflake Mountains . It stood for over 600 years . Architecture . The building was an old , ivy - veiled stone structure strongly resembling a fortress . The huge building was more than 400 feet ( 120 meters ) across and 200 feet ( 60 meters ) deep . It consisted of four above - ground levels and had an unknown expanse of storage tunnels and catacombs beneath . The first floor contained the library proper with unnumbered collections of mostly unique and ancient books , parchments , and artifacts . The second floor contained smaller study chambers and guest rooms for visiting scholars . It was built as self - contained town , complete with housing , for example guest quarters , a large eating hall , stables , and also an alchemy and herbalist shop . Dedication . The Library was erected as a tribute to Deneir and Oghma , the allied gods of knowledge , literature , and art . Visitors . The Edificant Library was open to all who wished to learn on the condition that they did not plan to use their knowledge for baneful purposes . Thus no scholars of evil religions were allowed entry to the Library .

title: Edik Brey
description: Edik Brey Edik Brey ( pronounced " ED - ick BRAY " ) was a foreman in Mulmaster . History . Edik was a foreman retainer of House Peytir .
description_long: Edik Brey Edik Brey ( pronounced " ED - ick BRAY " ) was a foreman in Mulmaster . History . Edik was a foreman retainer of House Peytir . He worked as manager at Peytir Timber until , in 1491 DR , a strange quake destroyed it and his employers disappeared . Personality . Edik was fiercely loyal to the Peytir family and was a natural leader . He truly cared about his job and the men and women who worked for him . He had a need for action and was anxious about the disappearance of his workers .

title: Edrae Obarskyr
description: Edrae Obarskyr Edrae " the Doomed Babe " was officially a king of Cormyr , but he was only an infant , and he did not live to see his fourth birthday . He was killed by his own mother as an act of mercy to end his suffering caused by the Purplethroat Plague .
description_long: Edrae Obarskyr Edrae " the Doomed Babe " was officially a king of Cormyr , but he was only an infant , and he did not live to see his fourth birthday . He was killed by his own mother as an act of mercy to end his suffering caused by the Purplethroat Plague .

title: Edwin Odesseiron
description: Edwin Odesseiron Edwin Odesseiron ( possibly related to Tharchion Homen Odesseiron of Surthay ) is a character in the " Baldur ' s Gate " and " " computer games . He is a member of the Red Wizards of Thay specialised in conjuration magic who as a novice was sent to the Sword Coast near Baldur ' s Gate on an unknown mission . He got into conflict with Dynaheir of Rashemen but failed to have her killed .
description_long: Edwin Odesseiron Edwin Odesseiron ( possibly related to Tharchion Homen Odesseiron of Surthay ) is a character in the " Baldur ' s Gate " and " " computer games . He is a member of the Red Wizards of Thay specialised in conjuration magic who as a novice was sent to the Sword Coast near Baldur ' s Gate on an unknown mission . He got into conflict with Dynaheir of Rashemen but failed to have her killed . Later , he moved to Amn and at some point lost his favour with the Red Wizards , ending up working at Mae ' Var ' s Shadow Thieves guild . Background . Edwin is a party NPC in the computer games " Baldur ' s Gate ( game ) " and " " and their expansions . Baldur ' s Gate game . In the first game , he is encountered near the bridge at Nashkel and wants to hire the player ' s party to kill the witch Dynaheir , who is in fact as good as dead without rescuing anyway . He offers his services as a wizard as a reward . If the player instead chooses to save Dynaheir - perhaps at the behest of Minsc , who is also found in Nashkel - Edwin if talked to again will attack . The second game assumes that Dynaheir survived and was part of the player ' s party .

title: Eel
description: Eel Eels were aquatic creatures . Species . Vilhon .
description_long: Eel Eels were aquatic creatures . Species . Vilhon . Vilhon eels were found in the Vilhon Reach and were long and ribbon - like . They were black with green mottling and proved difficult to catch by fishermen using nets . They were a local delicacy in Nimpeth . Monstrous eels . Ghartii Nung was an enormous 100 - feet - long ( 30 meters ) eel that once dwelt in the Yellow Sea off the coast of Koryo in Kara - Tur , until it was caught by local fishermen . Cuisine . Eel was used in brassla , a traditional Luskan rice dish . Snail - and - eel soup was made by the lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp around 1374 DR .

title: Efficacious monster ward
description: Efficacious monster ward Efficacious monster ward was an abjuration spell that could keep some undesirable creatures out of a large area for a few minutes . Effects . This spell was a stronger version of " antivermin barrier " that operated exactly like that spell except that it prevented entry of creatures roughly twice the size and / or toughness .
description_long: Efficacious monster ward Efficacious monster ward was an abjuration spell that could keep some undesirable creatures out of a large area for a few minutes . Effects . This spell was a stronger version of " antivermin barrier " that operated exactly like that spell except that it prevented entry of creatures roughly twice the size and / or toughness . Components . This spell require a pinch of salt in addition to verbal and somatic components .

title: Effran Redspur
description: Effran Redspur Effran Redspur was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Effran started her merchant career in order to travel throughout the Underdark , but Mantol - Derith was her first stop .
description_long: Effran Redspur Effran Redspur was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Effran started her merchant career in order to travel throughout the Underdark , but Mantol - Derith was her first stop . History . Around 1479 DR , Effran sold cured meat in Mantol - Derith .

title: Effron
description: Effron Effron , also known as " the Twisted " , was a tiefling warlock under the tutelage of the Netherese lord Draygo Quick . He was the son of Herzgo Alegni and Alegni ' s rape victim , Dahlia Sin ' felle . Description .
description_long: Effron Effron , also known as " the Twisted " , was a tiefling warlock under the tutelage of the Netherese lord Draygo Quick . He was the son of Herzgo Alegni and Alegni ' s rape victim , Dahlia Sin ' felle . Description . Effron had a scratchy voice . He was short , young - looking , frail , and thin . He had one red eye and one blue eye , indicating his mixed elf / tiefling heritage . He had black hair with purple highlights and ramlike horns . His left arm was useless , damaged since right after his birth , and usually hung behind him . He had an infuriating grin . He also tilted his body back and forth quickly so that his limp arm swung out in a wave on purpose to upset his father , Herzgo Alegni , who found this macabre sight repulsive . Possessions . Effron possessed a powerful magical staff topped with a small , humanoid skull . The staff was made of bone and the eyes of the skull glowed red when in use . It had the power to create undead zombie s from corpses . History . Effron ' s birth was the product of Herzgo Alegni ' s rape of Dahlia Sin ' felle when she was practically still a child .

title: Efreeti
description: Efreeti Efreet ( singular : efreeti ) , or efreeta for females , were unpredictable creatures with fiery forms and spectacular magical powers . They were a type of genie native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . The efreet were genie s from the Plane of Fire .
description_long: Efreeti Efreet ( singular : efreeti ) , or efreeta for females , were unpredictable creatures with fiery forms and spectacular magical powers . They were a type of genie native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . The efreet were genie s from the Plane of Fire . An efreeti stands about 12 feet tall and weighs 2 , 000 pounds . Efreet are cruel and self - serving . They all consider themselves to be of noble character and assume grand titles to make themselves seem impressive Physical and Magical Traits . Efreet are humanoid in appearance . They are very tall , generally reaching heights of twelve feet , and massive and solid . They are well - muscled , and have red or black skin that is always burning . For this reason , many resemble devil s and are often mistaken for them . Their bodies are said to be made of basalt , bronze , and solid flames . Efreeti magic is comparable to that of other powerful creatures , such as demons and lich es , and is quite versatile . One area in which it is pre - eminent is in magical weaponsmithing . Efreet are particularly renowned for their ability to create flaming weapons . Habitat . As water is to most life forms , heat is to efreet .

title: Efreeti bottle
description: Efreeti bottle An efreeti bottle was a powerful magical item in which an efreeti was entrapped . It was thus a variety of genie prison . Description .
description_long: Efreeti bottle An efreeti bottle was a powerful magical item in which an efreeti was entrapped . It was thus a variety of genie prison . Description . " Efreeti bottles " were usually crafted from brass or bronze and had a stopper made of lead and marked with mystical seals . Very often , the stopper did not prevent steam or smoke from escaping constantly from the heat of the efreeti trapped within . The bottle weighed about a pound ( half a kilogram ) . Efreeti bottles emitted a strong conjuration aura that could be detected by the proper magics . In most lands , an " efreeti bottle " might sell for the exorbitant price of 145 , 000 gold pieces . While Calishite s generally feared genies and avoided summoning magics , " efreeti bottles " were still common enough in Calimshan that one could find them there for ten percent of that cost . Powers . An " efreeti bottle " could only be opened once per day . When opened , the fire genie within was temporarily released and was compelled to serve his or her master completely for up to ten minutes before returning to the prison of the bottle .

title: Efreeti palazzo
description: Efreeti palazzo Efreeti palazzos were the homes of noble efreeti and their slaves . These buildings served as both a palace and stronghold . Location .
description_long: Efreeti palazzo Efreeti palazzos were the homes of noble efreeti and their slaves . These buildings served as both a palace and stronghold . Location . Most efreeti palazzos were located within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Inhabitants . The household of an efreeti palazzo contained the ruling noble efreeti , common efreet , jann and other slaves . Often a stable was also present which housed nightmares , hell hound s , and fire falcons .

title: Efreeti pashas
description: Efreeti pashas The efreet pashas represented the Sultan of the Efreet on the Prime Material Plane . Organization . Six elite noble efreeti were efreet pashas .
description_long: Efreeti pashas The efreet pashas represented the Sultan of the Efreet on the Prime Material Plane . Organization . Six elite noble efreeti were efreet pashas . Activities . Each of the great pashas had other noble efreeti serving beneath him . The efreet pashas loved hunting , and would spend many days running down prey of various kinds on their fiery chariots . Base of Operations . The efreet pashas preferred to have their strongholds located deep in the desert away from prying eyes , usually in ruins or abandoned locations . If discovered , they would move to a new location within one day .

title: Efreeti tyrants
description: Efreeti tyrants The efreeti tyrants were the ruthless leaders of the efreet . Organization . The Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan , ruled over all of the noble efreeti tyrants .
description_long: Efreeti tyrants The efreeti tyrants were the ruthless leaders of the efreet . Organization . The Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan , ruled over all of the noble efreeti tyrants . Activities . Efreet were obsessed with conquest and expanding their sulfurous empire , earning them many enemies along the way . Base of Operations . The City of Brass within the Elemental Plane of Fire served as the seat of power for the efreeti tyrants .

title: Efreetikin
description: Efreetikin Efreetikin , or flame gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Flame gen had jet black skin and fiery red hair .
description_long: Efreetikin Efreetikin , or flame gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Flame gen had jet black skin and fiery red hair . Their clawed fingers were in constant motion , as was the rest of their body . Forcing an efreetikin to remain still was a nearly impossible task . Personality . Efreetikin were inherently dangerous and malicious little creatures . If not monitored closely , they would start fires when their master was not looking . They enjoyed going where they were not allowed and explaining the faults of everything they witnessed .

title: Ehjax
description: Ehjax Ehjax was an ixilthetocal ruler of Seros . History . Born in 885 DR , Ehjax founded the modern ixilthetocal society of the Xedran Reefs , adjusting rules normally used only by ixilthetocal vampire s .
description_long: Ehjax Ehjax was an ixilthetocal ruler of Seros . History . Born in 885 DR , Ehjax founded the modern ixilthetocal society of the Xedran Reefs , adjusting rules normally used only by ixilthetocal vampire s . Ehjax also started the tradition that all vitanar s were bitten by the predecessor upon abdication each century and , if found unfit to rule , they were killed . He ruled until 985 DR .

title: Eichiro Tanaka
description: Eichiro Tanaka Eichiro Tanaka was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Eichiro was the son of Eiji Tanaka , a fellow general of Benju Matsumoto .
description_long: Eichiro Tanaka Eichiro Tanaka was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Eichiro was the son of Eiji Tanaka , a fellow general of Benju Matsumoto . During a battle , Eiji betrayed his army but Benju managed to win and executed Eiji for treason . Eichiro however believed that Benju killed his father out of jealousy over the man ' s superior generalship and promised vengeance . In 1358 DR , he hired the ninja Yamaguchi clan to kill the pilgrims going to the local Shining Temple of Bishamon . His goal was to ruin the Ceremony of the Three Thousand Steps and become the next daimyo of Aru , after Benju ' s demotion . Personality . Eichiro hated Benju but was not yet sure if getting revenge against the daimyo was his idea or Satomi ' s .

title: Eiellûr
description: Eiellûr Eiellûr was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21000 DR . History . Eiellûr was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Thearnytaar and Syòrpiir by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR .
description_long: Eiellûr Eiellûr was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21000 DR . History . Eiellûr was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Thearnytaar and Syòrpiir by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR . Eiellûr entered the second Crown War by allying with Thearnytaar and declaring war against Ilythiir after Ilythiir destroyed Syòrpiir with fire in - 11600 DR . The The Sable Wars , which began in - 11450 DR , were a series of battles during the Second Crown War . Aided by a few allies from Keltormir and Shantel Othreier , Eiellûr and Thearnytaar invaded Ilythiir , aiming to reform or conquer the dark elves before they destroyed any more realms . Over half their forces were wiped out by the dark elves ' corrupt magic . Around - 11400 DR , the kingdom was isolated from its allies and destroyed with fire by the dark elves of Ilythiir . The Illythiiri were aided by treacherous green elves seeking peace through appeasement . Over the course of time , the ruins of Eiellûr vanished under the forest canopies of the Winterwood .

title: Eigeron
description: Eigeron Eigeron was a ghost cloud giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Eigeron was the son of the cloud giant ruler Blagothkus .
description_long: Eigeron Eigeron was a ghost cloud giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Eigeron was the son of the cloud giant ruler Blagothkus . One day they went together to the Eye of the All - Father temple . The oracle told them that a great upheaval was in arrive and by then would arise an opportunity for giant s to shine . The oracle however told also that Blagothkus never can impress the giant pantheon and urged to Eigeron to abandon Blagothkus . This triggered a fight between the two giants and in the end Blagothkus killed his son and departed mourning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR an adventuring party together with Harshnag entered in the temple . Eigeron rose as ghost questioning them and helping them in using the oracle . However he can found peace only if someone killed his father .

title: Eight Million Gods
description: Eight Million Gods The Eight Million Gods is an ancient religion practiced in Wa and Kozakura , and it is a collection of beliefs and practices that has evolved over human history since humans arrived in those island kingdoms . The rituals of the practice relate to a variety of nature spirits who are believed to inhabit the land itself . In Kozakura , the worship is open and accepted , but in Wa it is not encouraged by the Shogunate government .
description_long: Eight Million Gods The Eight Million Gods is an ancient religion practiced in Wa and Kozakura , and it is a collection of beliefs and practices that has evolved over human history since humans arrived in those island kingdoms . The rituals of the practice relate to a variety of nature spirits who are believed to inhabit the land itself . In Kozakura , the worship is open and accepted , but in Wa it is not encouraged by the Shogunate government . Within the practice of this religion , shrines are constructed at sites of particular natural beauty or significance in a local legend . The larger , more extravagant and powerful shrines are known as first shrines , and these are the temples that are supported by the Emperor or by a local noble house . More often than not , these shrines are built in older districts of cities and provincial capitals . The smaller shrines are known as regular shrines , and have been built and supported by the local peasantry . These shrines tend to focus on more practical dogma for the adherents , such as ensuring good harvests or warding against evil spirits .

title: Eilistraee
description: Eilistraee Eilistraee was the chaotic good drow goddess of song , dance , swordwork , hunting , moonlight , goodness , and beauty , within the drow pantheon known as the Dark Seldarine . She was the patroness and protector of the few dark elves who longed to return to the surface and live there , at peace with other races , and to abandon the endless conflicts and intrigues that dominated the lives of most drow . She was often referred to as the The Dark Maiden , the Lady of the Dance , or Lady Silverhair , and sometimes The Dark Dancer , among other titles Briefly , she was known as The Masked Lady , while her faith subsumed that of the Masked Lord Vhaeraun , her divine brother .
description_long: Eilistraee Eilistraee was the chaotic good drow goddess of song , dance , swordwork , hunting , moonlight , goodness , and beauty , within the drow pantheon known as the Dark Seldarine . She was the patroness and protector of the few dark elves who longed to return to the surface and live there , at peace with other races , and to abandon the endless conflicts and intrigues that dominated the lives of most drow . She was often referred to as the The Dark Maiden , the Lady of the Dance , or Lady Silverhair , and sometimes The Dark Dancer , among other titles Briefly , she was known as The Masked Lady , while her faith subsumed that of the Masked Lord Vhaeraun , her divine brother . Her name was pronounced variously as " EEL - iss - TRAY - yee " , " eel - ISS - tray - ee " , " eel - iss - " tray " - yee " , or " eil - iss - " tray " - yee " . She was the daughter of Araushnee ( later Lolth ) and Corellon Larethian , a free - spirited and kind - hearted goddess , with a fiery streak in her personality . When , during her youth , a host of evil deities assaulted Arvandor ( her home ) , Araushnee ' s treachery almost made her slay her own father .

title: Eilistraee ' s Spellsong
description: Eilistraee ' s Spellsong The Spellsong was an evocation spell granted by Eilistraee to her speciality priestesses , the Sword Dancers . It was a form of Spellsong , a type of magic that used song and sometimes dance to draw power from the Weave Casters . The Sword Dancers could sing and dance to channel the power of Eilistraee .
description_long: Eilistraee ' s Spellsong The Spellsong was an evocation spell granted by Eilistraee to her speciality priestesses , the Sword Dancers . It was a form of Spellsong , a type of magic that used song and sometimes dance to draw power from the Weave Casters . The Sword Dancers could sing and dance to channel the power of Eilistraee . They had the ability to sing their magic even amidst the chaos of the battle , while dodging and dancing around or while wounded . Multiple priestesses could join in a song and dance around a focus ( which could be a creature to aid , a fire , a longsword with its blade planted in the ground or a holy symbol of Eilistraee ) , invoking magic of greater power . Effects . A single priestess could use the Spellsong to invoke magic equivalent to any 4th ( or lower ) level divine spell , or to return a single 4th ( or lower ) level spell cast through another Spellsong in the last two days to the mind of the priestess , to provide some healing to injured targets , or to grant spell immunity . When more than one priestesses joined the ritual , the healing magic of the Spellsong was empowered , and other effects could be obtained .

title: Eilistraee ' s moonfire
description: Eilistraee ' s moonfire Eilistraee ' s moonfire was an alteration spell granted by the goddess Eilistraee to her priestesses and , at her will , worshipers . Effects . This spell generated " moonfire " , a beacon of light , whose intensity and color could be controlled by the creator at will , ranging from a faint glow to a clear , bright — though not blinding nor strong enough to harm — light ) , though " moonfire " generally had the same intensity as moonlight .
description_long: Eilistraee ' s moonfire Eilistraee ' s moonfire was an alteration spell granted by the goddess Eilistraee to her priestesses and , at her will , worshipers . Effects . This spell generated " moonfire " , a beacon of light , whose intensity and color could be controlled by the creator at will , ranging from a faint glow to a clear , bright — though not blinding nor strong enough to harm — light ) , though " moonfire " generally had the same intensity as moonlight . Colors could be white , silver , blue - white , or a soft green . Manifested " moonfire " was normally always attached to the caster ' s body , but could move as the creator wished . More experienced clerics , however , could move the " moonfire " away from their bodies , like the spell " dancing lights " . The radiance could move around the creator ' s body as fast as desired , but moved only up to 40 feet ( 12 . 2 ) at a time when away from the caster . The caster could guide it in any direction , through any opening , and cause the glow to appear in any size , up to a volume determined by their power .

title: Eira
description: Eira Eira was a wood elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Eira was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .
description_long: Eira Eira was a wood elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Eira was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments . More specifically , she was the chosen of Rillifane Rallathil , a minor god of the Seldarine . In one of the experiments , Eira was infused with the essence of a sacrificed Chosen of Talona , a process that left Eira with half of her life energy . Eira was freed from her chains by the heroes of Daggerford and she asked to join them in the fight against the Thayans . However , in battle , there was a 50 % chance that she would manifest the Talona side and fought with no concern for her own safety .

title: Eiruk Weskur
description: Eiruk Weskur Eiruk Weskur was a young human wizard of Waterdeep . Description . Eiruk had black hair that he often worn shorn short in a skullcap .
description_long: Eiruk Weskur Eiruk Weskur was a young human wizard of Waterdeep . Description . Eiruk had black hair that he often worn shorn short in a skullcap . History . Eiruk joined the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors around 1473 DR . In 1479 DR , Eiruk was recruited by Khondar " Ten - Rings " Naomal to aid the Blackstaff , Samark Dhanzscul , in retrieving an item from the tomb of Sarael Arunsun . Eiruk was familiar enough with the Blackstaff to recognize that the man presenting himself was Samark was an impostor ( Centiv Naomal ) . However , he was unable to do anything but help the impostor retrieve the item , which would give Khondar the clues he needed to gain the keys to access to Blackstaff Tower . Only an honest and just person ( in this case Eiruk ) could receive the item ; that person also received an invisible , magical mark . Because he had the mark , Eiruk was made the backup heir to the Blackstaff . When Khondar tried to retrieve the keys from Ompahr Daergech , Ompahr saw that Khondar did not have the correct mark and so gave him the " wrong " set of keys .

title: Eirwyn
description: Eirwyn Eirwyn was an astral deva follower of Helm until the god ' s death . She was a skilled diviner . Description .
description_long: Eirwyn Eirwyn was an astral deva follower of Helm until the god ' s death . She was a skilled diviner . Description . Eirwyn had a silver braid and bronze skin . Eirwyn appeared old ; she had a lined face . She carried a silver mace . History . When Helm died in 1384 DR , Eirwyn dedicated herself to righteousness , rather than to a particular god . Eirwyn was a close friend of Tauran ' s . Against the orders of the High Council of Tyr , she aided Tauran when he began to express doubt about his faith in Tyr . She was imprisoned for her actions but later pardoned and sent to aid Erathaol the Seer , ruler of Venya in Mount Celestia . Erathaol convinced her to explore her visions , which led her to find Tauran again , along with his companions Aliisza , Kael , and Pharaun Mizzrym . She aided them in defending the Lifespring against Kaanyr Vhok and a demon ic invasion ; she and Kael were the only members of that group to survive . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Eiverbreen Parrafin
description: Eiverbreen Parrafin Eiverbreen Parrafin was the father of Spider Parrafin ( the reborn Regis ) . Personality . Eiverbreen was a drunkard .
description_long: Eiverbreen Parrafin Eiverbreen Parrafin was the father of Spider Parrafin ( the reborn Regis ) . Personality . Eiverbreen was a drunkard . He used his son ' s natural skills as a deep - sea diver as a source of income for himself . History . In 1463 DR , Eiverbreen ' s wife Jolee gave birth to a son . Jolee died during the birth and Eiverbreen never recovered from the grief . In order to see if his son had watersoul genasi blood in him , he attempted to drown him in the sea . He refused to give his son a name and became a drunkard , neglecting his son in impoverished conditions until his son was old enough to choose his own name ( Spider ) and earn money for his father . Eiverbreen arranged for Spider to collect oysters for Pericolo Topolino , who in turn provided room and board ( and free alcohol ) at the Lazy Fisher for Eiverbreen .

title: Ejen Horo
description: Ejen Horo Ejen Horo , or the Valley of the God , was a vale located between the Mountains of Copper and the Khopet Dag within the Hordelands . Description . Blessed with good weather , Ejen Horo was a lush garden - like valley that offered plentiful hunting as many animals were drawn to the bountiful vegetation .
description_long: Ejen Horo Ejen Horo , or the Valley of the God , was a vale located between the Mountains of Copper and the Khopet Dag within the Hordelands . Description . Blessed with good weather , Ejen Horo was a lush garden - like valley that offered plentiful hunting as many animals were drawn to the bountiful vegetation . Small lakes dotted the landscape , courtesy of the plentiful rainfall experienced in the valley . History . Sacred to the Tuigan , this large valley was believed to be the birthplace of their great nation . They vigorously defended the entire valley from intruders . The natives of the Hordelands used this valley to hold their annual couralitai meetings . Honored dead of the Tuigan were also buried within the valley . Inhabitants . Though physically beautiful , Ejen Horo could be a dangerous place since many spirits wandered the land . Usually their wrath was only reserved from those who attempted to rob burial mounds . A special group of Tuigan priests called the Irooukudel lived within the valley to oversee the care for the deceased .

title: Ekandor
description: Ekandor Ekandor was the leader of a team of Red Wizard s who hunted the half - elf wild mage Neera . History . Ekandor and his fellows hunted Neera for a long time for her unique magical ability .
description_long: Ekandor Ekandor was the leader of a team of Red Wizard s who hunted the half - elf wild mage Neera . History . Ekandor and his fellows hunted Neera for a long time for her unique magical ability . Finally , on the run near Beregost , Neera met and befriended Gorion ' s Ward , who helped her to defeat the pursing wizard s . Eventually , Neera joined the party of Gorion ' s Ward and later they defeated Ekandor . Neera became the apprentice of the famous wild mage Adoy .

title: Ekur
description: Ekur Ekur was the ruler of Shussel in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ekur was bargaining with the clergy of Isis for them to give their support to god - king Gilgeam .
description_long: Ekur Ekur was the ruler of Shussel in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ekur was bargaining with the clergy of Isis for them to give their support to god - king Gilgeam . Personality . Ekur was vicious and not very able as a ruler . He sensed a catastrophe was coming and wanted protection in case Gilgeam fell .

title: Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib
description: Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib was the general of the Dutiful Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . She served as the active voice for the Dutiful on the Mamluk Council because Hatit Abd al - Wajib ' s duties as emir prevented him from having a say on council matters .
description_long: Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib was the general of the Dutiful Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . She served as the active voice for the Dutiful on the Mamluk Council because Hatit Abd al - Wajib ' s duties as emir prevented him from having a say on council matters . Relationships . Ekuriyah was the protege of emir Hatit Abd al - Wajib .

title: El Ahimar
description: El Ahimar The Ahimar clan was the least well known and most secretive of the four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . They rose to power during the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR . Believed to have been a lost house , they were aided by Ralan el Pesarkhal , and as such were indebted to him and under his indirect control .
description_long: El Ahimar The Ahimar clan was the least well known and most secretive of the four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . They rose to power during the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR . Believed to have been a lost house , they were aided by Ralan el Pesarkhal , and as such were indebted to him and under his indirect control .

title: El Ashnarti
description: El Ashnarti The Ashnarti family of crime lords was one of the smaller crime families in Calimshan , with its base in Keltar , and was known for its brutes and thugs . The headquarters of the Guild of Enforcers and Thugs of Calimshan was located in Keltar and was the only rogues ' guild of note in the city . In 1370 DR , this guild was in the control of the sultan of Keltar , Duncan el Ashnarti , allowing him to control both illegal and legal activity there .
description_long: El Ashnarti The Ashnarti family of crime lords was one of the smaller crime families in Calimshan , with its base in Keltar , and was known for its brutes and thugs . The headquarters of the Guild of Enforcers and Thugs of Calimshan was located in Keltar and was the only rogues ' guild of note in the city . In 1370 DR , this guild was in the control of the sultan of Keltar , Duncan el Ashnarti , allowing him to control both illegal and legal activity there . Duncan was married to a niece of el Ahimar family , one of the four major crime families in Calimshan , which was in turn subservient to el Pesarkhal family and the syl - pasha himself , so the entire Ashnarti family and the underworld of Keltar was in control of Ralan el Pesarkhal .

title: El Kahmir
description: El Kahmir The Kahmirs were one of four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . Until the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR , they were the most powerful of all Calishite underworld groups since the Seventh Age of Calimshan . See also .
description_long: El Kahmir The Kahmirs were one of four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . Until the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR , they were the most powerful of all Calishite underworld groups since the Seventh Age of Calimshan . See also . The four major crime families of Calimshan in 1370 DR :

title: El Pesarkhal
description: El Pesarkhal The Pesarkhals were the post powerful crime family in Calimshan in 1370 DR , controlling each of the remaining three houses , because Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal sat on the throne . Ralan el Pesarkhal also intentionally married off his daughters to the other families to control them , and while the seat of control for el Pesarkhal was technically in Calimport , there was at least one Pesarkhal family member in a position of power in every city throughout Calimshan .
description_long: El Pesarkhal The Pesarkhals were the post powerful crime family in Calimshan in 1370 DR , controlling each of the remaining three houses , because Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal sat on the throne . Ralan el Pesarkhal also intentionally married off his daughters to the other families to control them , and while the seat of control for el Pesarkhal was technically in Calimport , there was at least one Pesarkhal family member in a position of power in every city throughout Calimshan .

title: El Sadhara
description: El Sadhara High Whirlwind Fida ' iya yr Iamar , commonly known as el Sadhara , " the Desert Rose " , was an exceptionally powerful priestess of Akadi who had been mummified . She resided at the Altar of the Air and was said to possess many treasures . She was also reported to believe that she was the lover of the djinni lord Calim .
description_long: El Sadhara High Whirlwind Fida ' iya yr Iamar , commonly known as el Sadhara , " the Desert Rose " , was an exceptionally powerful priestess of Akadi who had been mummified . She resided at the Altar of the Air and was said to possess many treasures . She was also reported to believe that she was the lover of the djinni lord Calim . In addition , she thought that Calim and Akadi were the same being . Background . From the Eighth Age of Calimshan , Fida ' iya was an airwalker , a special priest of the goddess Akadi . Sometime before the Time of Troubles , she was mummified so that she could continue to guard the Altar of the Air , a shrine to Akadi in the ruined djinni military fortress of Dashadjen , which remained from the time of the Era of Skyfire . For centuries , she went by the Alzhedo title " " el Sadhara " " , which translated as " the desert rose " . El Sadhara believed that Calim was in fact a manifestation of the goddess Akadi as well as being her lover . She stored up many powerful treasures for him in Dashadjen , in hopes to restore them to him at his return to power . She believed that he would grant her immense power in return for her service to him .

title: El Vyndahla
description: El Vyndahla The Vyndahla clan was the third - largest family in the criminal underworld of Calimshan . In truth , it was simply a puppet group of the Rundeen . The Darkstalker Wars robbed them of much of their power , but in 1370 DR they still controlled criminal activities in Almraiven and Volothamp .
description_long: El Vyndahla The Vyndahla clan was the third - largest family in the criminal underworld of Calimshan . In truth , it was simply a puppet group of the Rundeen . The Darkstalker Wars robbed them of much of their power , but in 1370 DR they still controlled criminal activities in Almraiven and Volothamp .

title: El Zarud
description: El Zarud El Zarud was the Zhent spokesman among the Bedine in Anauroch . Description . El Zarud had a silky mustache and bore many scars .
description_long: El Zarud El Zarud was the Zhent spokesman among the Bedine in Anauroch . Description . El Zarud had a silky mustache and bore many scars . History . El Zarud was a warrior who joined the Zhentilar and at one point was assigned to Anauroch to act as liaison between the Bedine and Zhents . However , in 1360 DR , he , together with the Zhentarim wizard Yhekal , plotted a large attack in order to enslave the Bedine , but thanks to the witch Ruha and the Harper Lander , his army was destroyed and El Zarud was killed .

title: Eladrin form
description: Eladrin form Eladrin form was a transmutation spell that transfigured the caster into an incorporeal globe . Effects . The caster assumed the form of an incorporeal globe of eldritch colors , 5 feet in diameter .
description_long: Eladrin form Eladrin form was a transmutation spell that transfigured the caster into an incorporeal globe . Effects . The caster assumed the form of an incorporeal globe of eldritch colors , 5 feet in diameter . In this form , the caster could fly at a speed of 1 , 500 feet per minute with perfect maneuverability , and could pass through walls and other solid objects . The mage could use any spell - like or psionic abilities he possessed , but could not cast spells or make physical attacks . The globe form was incorporeal , and the caster had no physical strength . While incorporeal , the caster could be harmed only by other incorporeal creatures , magic weapons , psionics , spells , spell - like abilities , or supernatural abilities . The caster was immune to all nonmagical attack forms . Even when hit by spells or magic weapons , there was a 50 % chance the caster would not take any damage from a corporeal source ( with the exception of positive energy , negative energy , effects , or attacks made with ghost touch weapons ) .

title: Elaerue Estspirit
description: Elaerue Estspirit Elaerue Estspirit was a half - elf woman and an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Elaerue was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the office and title of " Wheloon " . In addition to her heraldry and other duties , she served Lord Sarp Redbeard as his assistant , clerk , and record - keeper .
description_long: Elaerue Estspirit Elaerue Estspirit was a half - elf woman and an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Elaerue was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the office and title of " Wheloon " . In addition to her heraldry and other duties , she served Lord Sarp Redbeard as his assistant , clerk , and record - keeper . She held this position by 1357 DR and still held it by the end of 1367 DR .

title: Elaine Cunningham
description: Elaine Cunningham Elaine Cunningham is an American fantasy and science fiction author , especially known for her almost poetic literary style . Her contributions to the Forgotten Realms campaign world include the realms of Evermeet , Halruaa , Rashemen , Ruathym and Waterdeep . Amongst Elaine ' s most popular characters are the half - elf Arilyn Moonblade , the bard Danilo Thann , the quirky drow wizard Liriel Baenre , her companion the Rashemi berserker Fyodor , and Elaith " The Serpent " Craulnober ( created by Ed Greenwood ) .
description_long: Elaine Cunningham Elaine Cunningham is an American fantasy and science fiction author , especially known for her almost poetic literary style . Her contributions to the Forgotten Realms campaign world include the realms of Evermeet , Halruaa , Rashemen , Ruathym and Waterdeep . Amongst Elaine ' s most popular characters are the half - elf Arilyn Moonblade , the bard Danilo Thann , the quirky drow wizard Liriel Baenre , her companion the Rashemi berserker Fyodor , and Elaith " The Serpent " Craulnober ( created by Ed Greenwood ) . Elaine lives in New England .

title: Elaith Craulnober
description: Elaith Craulnober Elaith Craulnober was a moon elf adventurer and crime lord living in the city of Waterdeep . He was a cunning and opportunistic elven rogue with an infamous reputation . Description .
description_long: Elaith Craulnober Elaith Craulnober was a moon elf adventurer and crime lord living in the city of Waterdeep . He was a cunning and opportunistic elven rogue with an infamous reputation . Description . Elaith Craulnober was tall elven noble in his prime with with sharp , handsome features and a graceful build . He was 5 ' 8 " tall . Elaith had silver hair and the pale skin common to his people . His eyes were the color of amber . He favored his trademark black cape and elven daggers , which he often used to solidify his already fearsome reputation . He was often likened to a " silver snake " because of his appearance , which in part gave him his alias of " The Serpent . " Personality . Elaith was a tragic character who never truly recovered from his initial fall . His descent from nobility on Evermeet to the brutal and heartless crime lord he became contributed to his contrasting qualities . In Evermeet , Elaith was serious and proper , the " epitome of elfdom " according to Amnestria . After his exile , Elaith became a heartless crime lord with a penchant for cruelty .

title: Elak Dornen
description: Elak Dornen Elak Dornen was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and the informal leader of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . He was a stern and inflexible man , and he enjoyed the power he gained from bending others to his side .
description_long: Elak Dornen Elak Dornen was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and the informal leader of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . He was a stern and inflexible man , and he enjoyed the power he gained from bending others to his side . Elak dreamed of a day when he and the other Believers could openly take power Activities . Elak ran a shop . More importantly , he was a longstanding member of the Believers , often decisive in questions about how to direct the village ' s businesses and who was worthy to join the group . History . In 1491 DR , Elak was the first to be seduced by the whispers of Larrakh of the Cult of Black Earth . Later , fellow Believers Ilmeth Waelvur , Marlandro Gaelkur , and Albaeri Mellikho killed some people in order to protect the secret of the Believers . When some adventurers uncovered them , the Believers were ruined and Elak most likely left the town .

title: Elan
description: Elan Elans were psionic humanoids They were extremely long - lived , occasionally managing to live for 2 , 000 years or more . History . The elan came about during the the time of Jhaamdath but the method used to create them is long lost to mortals .
description_long: Elan Elans were psionic humanoids They were extremely long - lived , occasionally managing to live for 2 , 000 years or more . History . The elan came about during the the time of Jhaamdath but the method used to create them is long lost to mortals . When the elves of Nikerymath summoned a tidal wave that destroyed much of the psiocracy of Jhaamdath ( and the method of creating elans ) , the twelve rulers of the Jhaamdathan cities teleport ed to safety while their realm and it ' s people perished . Over the next three centuries , they lived and had families who went on to become the nobles of Chondath . All twelve eventually agreed that their time was ended and returned to the Palace of Naarkolyth . They placed themselves into temporal stasis until mortals once again entered Dhinnilith . Unknown to these scions of Jhaamdath , there was a gala celebrating the construction of Jhaamdath ' s new fleet being held at Naarkolyth when it was destroyed those centuries before , and two powerful beings were created from the souls that drowned that day . A caller in darkness known as Bpdethrys , formed from those of a callous bent , while a vestige named Abysm formed from the rest .

title: Elanee
description: Elanee Elanee was an elven druid from the Mere of Dead Men . Elanee is best known for her aid to the Kalach - Cha during the latter ' s quest to destroy the King of Shadows . Description .
description_long: Elanee Elanee was an elven druid from the Mere of Dead Men . Elanee is best known for her aid to the Kalach - Cha during the latter ' s quest to destroy the King of Shadows . Description . Thin and graceful , Elanee was most at home in the wilderness , where her spry muscles and keen senses served her well , and she typically dressed in the earthy toned robes typical of druids within her order . Like most wood elves , Elanee had high cheek bones , pointed ears , and pale skin with a coppery hue to it that glistened slightly . Young by elven standards and physically attractive , Elanee had a rugged beauty to her accentuated by her fine but often tangled copper colored hair . A few of the Kalach - Cha ' s companions commented that she did not bathe as often as they ' d prefer , but her beauty and grace was nonetheless remarked upon by several the hero met . Personality . Calm and reflective , Elanee was not generally prone to taking aggressive action and had a sound mind . In times of moral conflict , Elanee was often a voice of gentle charity or calm benevolence , advising the Kalach - Cha to take actions that would cause the most benefit for all .

title: Elanil Elassidil
description: Elanil Elassidil Elanil Elassidil was a famous bard and the Herald of Elventree , holding the office of " Moonsilver " around 1367 DR . Personality . She had a ready wit but a quick temper , and kept abreast of all goings - on in Elventree .
description_long: Elanil Elassidil Elanil Elassidil was a famous bard and the Herald of Elventree , holding the office of " Moonsilver " around 1367 DR . Personality . She had a ready wit but a quick temper , and kept abreast of all goings - on in Elventree . Although reticent about speaking with strangers , she had a reputation for honesty . Elanil was strong and confident in her abilities . She was not afraid to give her opinion on a subject , even when not asked . Usually , Elanil quickly gave historical details to support her opinions against those that did not back their opinions with similar evidence . She was able to calm all situations with a single song . Elanil had great diplomatic skill . History . Elanil lived in Elventree and acted as a Herald for the area by 1367 DR . During the Rage of Demons , she was worried about numerous drow arriving on the surface and , with the help of Seranolla of the Emerald Enclave and Zern Xerkstil , she hired an adventuring party to investigate the matter . From a drow prisoner she captured , Elanil discovered that the drow were fleeing Szith Morcane after a fire giant army from Maerimydra occupied the outpost .

title: Elanna Huntsilver
description: Elanna Huntsilver Elanna Huntsilver was Maestoon Huntsilver ' s wife . She was much younger than Maestoon and was a Dauntinghorn by birth . Description .
description_long: Elanna Huntsilver Elanna Huntsilver was Maestoon Huntsilver ' s wife . She was much younger than Maestoon and was a Dauntinghorn by birth . Description . Elanna had ash - blonde hair . She was thin and devastatingly beautiful . She was fond of using her beauty to toy with others .

title: Elassuara Narithan
description: Elassuara Narithan Elassuara Narithan was a female human cleric of Milil , Lord of Song , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Elassuara was high priestess of the Happy House of Splendor and Song temple to Milil at the time . She led six priests and eleven lay - followers .
description_long: Elassuara Narithan Elassuara Narithan was a female human cleric of Milil , Lord of Song , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Elassuara was high priestess of the Happy House of Splendor and Song temple to Milil at the time . She led six priests and eleven lay - followers .

title: Elastul Raurym
description: Elastul Raurym Elastul Raurym is the marchion of Mirabar . The Hammers are his personal bodyguard . , fighters named Djassar , Hulmm , Kriiador , and Turvon who command the marchion ' s 64 platinum mail wearing bodyguards .
description_long: Elastul Raurym Elastul Raurym is the marchion of Mirabar . The Hammers are his personal bodyguard . , fighters named Djassar , Hulmm , Kriiador , and Turvon who command the marchion ' s 64 platinum mail wearing bodyguards . Appearance . Elastul is fat , with a red beard . Personality . Elastul is often devising devious plots , but these are rarely put into practice . He is also known to be quite lustful with a love of money and decadent pleasures . Marchion Raurym makes a point of traveling south to warmer climes before the onset of winter , to negotiate trade agreements with rulers who have many luxuries , but little metal .

title: Elbereth
description: Elbereth Elbereth was an elf and the king of Shilmista . He was the son of Galladel , grandson of Dellanil Quil ' quien . Description .
description_long: Elbereth Elbereth was an elf and the king of Shilmista . He was the son of Galladel , grandson of Dellanil Quil ' quien . Description . The elf was about five and a half feet of height , with striking eyes . He commanded his people well . Abilities . He was an excellent fighter . He owned a " longsword of sharpness " that glowed with blue flame .

title: Elbulder
description: Elbulder Elbulder was once a logging town on the River Arran , south of the Chondalwood . It was used to send logs downstream to the Vilhon Reach and onwards to the Sea of Fallen Stars . During the Rotting War , the disapproval of the Emerald Enclave meant that the logging operation could not continue .
description_long: Elbulder Elbulder was once a logging town on the River Arran , south of the Chondalwood . It was used to send logs downstream to the Vilhon Reach and onwards to the Sea of Fallen Stars . During the Rotting War , the disapproval of the Emerald Enclave meant that the logging operation could not continue . Because magic boats were used to transport the logs along the river , magic is extremely well received in Elbulder .

title: Elbus Tinfellow
description: Elbus Tinfellow Elbus Tinfellow was a halfling living in the Moonsea . History . Elbus was the patriarch of the Tinfellow s , a large family of farmers in a valley near Hillsfar .
description_long: Elbus Tinfellow Elbus Tinfellow was a halfling living in the Moonsea . History . Elbus was the patriarch of the Tinfellow s , a large family of farmers in a valley near Hillsfar . During the Rage of Demons , some corrupt Red Plumes led by Captain Haakon Erlich and the sorcerer Breex Vandermast attacked Elbus ' s farm , capturing and killing all present . Elbus was captured and destined to go to the Hillsfar Arena . At last after a riot in the Arena Elbus and his family were for sure freed by an adventuring party hired by Olisara Lightsong Relationship . Elbus and his family were allies of the Harpers

title: Eldaerneth Spellstalker
description: Eldaerneth Spellstalker Eldaerneth Spellstalker was a sun elf rogue and enchanter . History . Around 1374 DR , Eldaerneth was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma .
description_long: Eldaerneth Spellstalker Eldaerneth Spellstalker was a sun elf rogue and enchanter . History . Around 1374 DR , Eldaerneth was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma . He was an infiltrator of the Night Masks in Westgate , tasked with gathering information and passing it back to the Vel ' Nikeryma .

title: Eldan Ambrose
description: Eldan Ambrose Eldan Ambrose was an Amnian priest of Tempus who came to Battledale during the Time of Troubles . History . Pilgrimage to Battledale .
description_long: Eldan Ambrose Eldan Ambrose was an Amnian priest of Tempus who came to Battledale during the Time of Troubles . History . Pilgrimage to Battledale . The god Tempus came to Faerûn in a ruined castle in Battledale during the Time of Troubles . Eldan and almost one - hundred of his followers rebuilt the castle , naming it the Abbey of the Sword . The Abbey of the Sword contained numerous " portals " in its many underground passages and entrances , and Eldan ' s followers took it upon themselves to guard them from intrusion . Drow invasion . In 1371 DR , drow came through an unguarded portal deep in the tunnels of the Abbey . The Vhaeraun - worshiping drow of the Auzkovyn clan attacked Eldan and his followers , who fought fiercely , but ultimately lost . Eldan was devoured by a summoned demon , and the drow escaped into the forest of Cormanthor , opening another portal to bring more of their kin to Faerûn . The defenders of the Abbey were greatly reduced in number , and all attempts to resurrect Eldan failed . It was determined that as long as the demon that ate him still existed , Eldan could not be raised from the dead , or resurrected .

title: Eldargh
description: Eldargh Eldargh was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Eldargh was among the many malaugrym that suddenly attacked El en masse .
description_long: Eldargh Eldargh was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Eldargh was among the many malaugrym that suddenly attacked El en masse . However , when the Simbul revealed herself to be disguised among them , and started killing his fellows , Eldargh confronted her . This gave most of his brethren time to go back to the Castle of Shadows but at the price of Eldargh ' s life .

title: Eldath
description: Eldath Eldath ( pronounced " " el " - dath " ) , also known as The Green Goddess or Mother Guardian of Groves , was a lake spirit who acted as the guardian of groves and watersheds , her presence was felt wherever there was calm . She was a pacifist who avoided hostile action , even if threatened . Although shy , quiet and enigmatic , Eldath was possessed of unknown depths of character and unexpressed resolve that could not be broken .
description_long: Eldath Eldath ( pronounced " " el " - dath " ) , also known as The Green Goddess or Mother Guardian of Groves , was a lake spirit who acted as the guardian of groves and watersheds , her presence was felt wherever there was calm . She was a pacifist who avoided hostile action , even if threatened . Although shy , quiet and enigmatic , Eldath was possessed of unknown depths of character and unexpressed resolve that could not be broken . Eldath protected rivers , streams , and druids ' groves ; her dogma was pacifistic , and her followers only resorted to violence in defense of themselves , of their friends and loved ones , and of pools and groves . She was regarded as a goddess of serenity , comfort , and healing . Any waters blessed by her were known to cure sickness and madness . They could also calm the dying giving them peace and a natural passing . Many rural communities have a designated pond or glade which serves as a holy site for local parishioners . These places were traditionally used as places to reflect and meditate .

title: Eldath ' s Mount
description: Eldath ' s Mount Eldath ' s Mount was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn at which the great Green Goddess Falls was located . The falls were a part of the River Rimril , and the Duskwood Dell into which the waters flowed was a sacred site to the goddess Eldath .
description_long: Eldath ' s Mount Eldath ' s Mount was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn at which the great Green Goddess Falls was located . The falls were a part of the River Rimril , and the Duskwood Dell into which the waters flowed was a sacred site to the goddess Eldath .

title: Eldeluc
description: Eldeluc Eldeluc was a male human wizard and a member of the Host Tower of the Arcane . He tried to usurp the position of the Archmaster Arcane Arklem Greeth . History .
description_long: Eldeluc Eldeluc was a male human wizard and a member of the Host Tower of the Arcane . He tried to usurp the position of the Archmaster Arcane Arklem Greeth . History . Eldeluc was a young talented wizard in the Arcane Brotherhood and an apprentice of the Archmaster Arcane Arklem Greeth . He was also a very scheming individual and a worshiper of Bane . He first conspired with Dendybar the Mottled and other associates to have Morkai the Red , the Master of the North Tower of the Host Tower of the Arcane , murdered by his apprentice Akar Kessel on their command in 1351 DR . Dendybar was nominated the new Master of the North Tower and Eldeluc rose in prominence . However , Eldeluc wanted more and , after many years of preparation and plotting , he and his fellow apprentice Valkebar assaulted Arklem in 1371 DR , nearly killing him and slaying Arklem ' s top lieutenant Queltar Thaeloon in the process . Barely alive , Arklem fled the Host Tower , which fell into the hands of Eldeluc and Valkebar and the Masters of the Four Towers pledged their loyalty to them .

title: Elden Corrinthal
description: Elden Corrinthal Elden Corrinthal , usually know as the Oracle , was the head priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1484 DR , the Oracle encouraged Vasen Cale to follow the destiny that Amaunator would show him .
description_long: Elden Corrinthal Elden Corrinthal , usually know as the Oracle , was the head priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1484 DR , the Oracle encouraged Vasen Cale to follow the destiny that Amaunator would show him . Later as dictated by a dream sent by his father the Oracle released the spirit s of Elgrin Fau that had kept safe the Abbey for so many years . Later Sayeed and Zeeahd invaded the Abbey with their pack of spined devil s . The Oracle was confronted by Zeeahd . Elden managed to humiliate Zeehad and so he ordered his spined devil s to kill Elden . The Oracle was well prepared for his death and died with a smile . Relationship . Elden ' s best friend was a dog called Browny .

title: Elden Mymn
description: Elden Mymn Elden Mymn was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Elden was a patient and quiet individual .
description_long: Elden Mymn Elden Mymn was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Elden was a patient and quiet individual . He preferred to stay in the background . He was very devoted to his god . Knowing that he had just started his path , Elden was deferential to his seniors . History . Elden was a young acolyte at the Temple of Kelemvor in Phlan . In 1489 DR , he was instructed to care for the madman Yip . Survived the Vorgansharax ' s coup he went in exile . Around 1492 DR Mymm joined the reclamation army of Jhessail Greycastle with the objective of found the body of his master Yovir Glandon . However Glandon somehow , likely with the help of the Dark Powers of Ravenloft , had risen as vampire and only thank of some adventurers Mymm gave final peace to Glandon .

title: Elden Vargas
description: Elden Vargas Elden Vargas was a businessman in Neverwinter . History . Elden was , before the Spellplague a War Wizard of Cormyr .
description_long: Elden Vargas Elden Vargas was a businessman in Neverwinter . History . Elden was , before the Spellplague a War Wizard of Cormyr . However , to augment his psychic powers he entered into a pact with Asmodeus and when his superior discovered this they attacked Elden . In the battle , Karis , the Rashemi witch wife of Elden , lost her mind , so Elden started planning how cure her . Soon , he became a successful trader on the Sword Coast , but also joined forces with the Ashmadai cult . In 1479 DR , Elden arrived in Neverwinter with Karis but his wife suffered a collapse and , thanks to Mordai Vell , Elden took her to Helm ' s Hold . However , Mordai used the situation to control the wizard . Elden started having his minions kidnap people in order to conduct experiments on them to one day cure Karis . However , the experiments produced only a number of blabbering idiots . Elden also tried to frame Mordai ' s Ashmadai for the kidnappings . However the Mordai ' s Ashmadai identified him and send a kill - team led by a devil to kill him .

title: Eldenser
description: Eldenser Eldenser , called " The Lurker " or " The Worm Who Hides in Blades " , was a male amethyst great wyrm known for his magical ability to " jump " his sentience from blade to blade . Description . By the 1370s DR , in his true dragon form , Eldenser appeared ancient and decrepit .
description_long: Eldenser Eldenser , called " The Lurker " or " The Worm Who Hides in Blades " , was a male amethyst great wyrm known for his magical ability to " jump " his sentience from blade to blade . Description . By the 1370s DR , in his true dragon form , Eldenser appeared ancient and decrepit . His scales had paled to white and his wings had withered . He had extra - large eyes and an array of white spines on his chin . The vast majority of the time , his body was magically preserved and protected in a crypt below Waterdeep , while his consciousness traveled Faerûn . Personality . Eldenser was a loner , preferring to avoid the company of other dragons . He was wanderer , rarely staying in one place , even before he gained the power to separate his mind from his body . He was free - spirited , friendly , easily amused , and ever - curious about the world around him . His favorite things to observe were things of beauty and the effect of love on people . He preferred to avoid combat , yet was a formidable foe if provoked . He had a great love of riddles and puzzles . Eldenser enjoyed meat from the great cats but would settle for cattle .

title: Elder
description: Elder The Elder was a respected priest of the Faceless God and the governor of the Enlightened Ring province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . As with the other members of the Seven Sages , the Elder was an appointed governor of one of the provinces of the Yikarian Empire .
description_long: Elder The Elder was a respected priest of the Faceless God and the governor of the Enlightened Ring province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . As with the other members of the Seven Sages , the Elder was an appointed governor of one of the provinces of the Yikarian Empire . He kept most of his slaves , who were predominantly dwarves , deep underground mining for riches . Many never saw the light of day . Rumors & Legends . Many yikarians believed the Elder was the first son of the Faceless God .

title: Elder Evils
description: Elder Evils " Elder Evils provides DMs with 160 pages of truly wicked threats to challenge high - level heroes . Each " elder evil " described in this nightmarish tome comes with a detailed description , stat blocks for the elder evil and its minions , tips for how to incorporate the elder evil into any D & D campaign , adventure seeds , and maps of the elder evil ' s lair ( complete with encounters and room descriptions ) . The book also provides guidelines to help DMs create their own unique elder evils as worthy campaign villains and endgame encounters .

title: Elder brain
description: Elder brain An elder brain was the final stage of the mind flayer life cycle . The elder brain lived in a brine - filled pool in the center of a mind flayer city , where it guided its community by filling them with dark dreams of illithid domination . Although its intellect was of godlike proportions , its only physical attack was by using its tendrils to lash out at or grapple an opponent .
description_long: Elder brain An elder brain was the final stage of the mind flayer life cycle . The elder brain lived in a brine - filled pool in the center of a mind flayer city , where it guided its community by filling them with dark dreams of illithid domination . Although its intellect was of godlike proportions , its only physical attack was by using its tendrils to lash out at or grapple an opponent . Therefore , mind flayers protected their elder brain by securing it in a well - protected cave inside the city . Its strong mind - affecting powers stem from the brains of long - dead mind flayers making up the viscous mass of the elder brain . Being composed of many brains as energy source for its intellect it can communicate telepathically with any creature within 350 ft ( 107 . 73 m ) distance . Combat . An elder brain could use its spell - quicken abilities in the same round as its tendril attacks . Usually it started its attacks with a powerful mind blast . In combat , it could use many psionic attacks such as charm and domination abilities . On top of those , it could cast spells as an extremely powerful sorcerer , making it an opponent to be feared . Society .

title: Elder evil
description: Elder evil Elder evils were ancient , powerful , and generally evil beings or entities . Their power could rival , or even surpass , that of demigod s to such that they could destroy an entire world . Elder evils .
description_long: Elder evil Elder evils were ancient , powerful , and generally evil beings or entities . Their power could rival , or even surpass , that of demigod s to such that they could destroy an entire world . Elder evils . Examples of these beings included Atropus , an undead planetoid said to be the first atropal , a stillborn god ; Zargon the Returner , the original lord of the Nine Hells who was cast out by Asmodeus ; Father Llymic , a being of intense power from the Far Realm who escaped the plane of madness to destroy the world but was encased in ice by elven mages ; Pandorym , an entity from a space between the plane s whose mind was imprisoned in a huge crystal , that was called to the world by the ancient Imaskari to intimidate the gods of their slaves . Other beings called Elder Evils include Shothragot and Haask , Voice of Hargut . Elder Eternal Evils . Three beings described as " Elder Eternal Evils " are Dendar the Night Serpent ; Kezef the Chaos Hound ; and Ityak - Ortheel , the Elf Eater . Later , Dendar and Kezef were considered primordial s . Aboleth Elder Evils .

title: Elder orb
description: Elder orb An elder orb was a very old and powerful beholder . Description . Elder orbs were between 4 and 6 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Elder orb An elder orb was a very old and powerful beholder . Description . Elder orbs were between 4 and 6 feet ( 1 . 2 – 1 . 8 m ) in diameter . They lost their eyes over time , being unable to regenerate them , but gained wizardly powers instead . They were extremely intelligent . Society . Elder orbs were generally the councilors or leaders of the beholder faction they lived in . Ecology . Elder orbs ate less food that other beholders and thus were able to tolerate more foods , including poison . The elder orb ' s body itself had a high level of magic resistance and could easily see through most illusion s . It was believed that elder orb brains could be used to create great spell s and magical items . Combat . Elder orbs were powerful spellcasters , although they were restricted to verbal spells that they developed on their own or stole from others . They guarded their knowledge jealously . Elder orbs were able to control death tyrant s with their magic , as well as create them . They preferred to use the death tyrants to do their dirty work for them , including fighting enemies .

title: Eldest
description: Eldest The Eldest was an aboleth of massive size , incalculable age and inconceivable malignancy . It ruled the city of Xxiphu and the Abolethic Sovereignty . It was the most powerful and oldest aboleth in the city of Xxiphu and was believed to be the only " living " being that could use the Key of Stars to unlock the Far Manifold beyond Forever ' s Reach .
description_long: Eldest The Eldest was an aboleth of massive size , incalculable age and inconceivable malignancy . It ruled the city of Xxiphu and the Abolethic Sovereignty . It was the most powerful and oldest aboleth in the city of Xxiphu and was believed to be the only " living " being that could use the Key of Stars to unlock the Far Manifold beyond Forever ' s Reach . History . The Eldest was said to have been old when Abeir - Toril was split asunder . Behind the scenes . The Eldest is based on H . P . Lovecraft ' s .

title: Eldeth Feldrun
description: Eldeth Feldrun Eldeth Feldrun was a shield dwarf scout who was made a prisoner of the drow during the late 1480s DR . History . Eldeth lived with her family in Gauntlgrym , where she worked as a scout .
description_long: Eldeth Feldrun Eldeth Feldrun was a shield dwarf scout who was made a prisoner of the drow during the late 1480s DR . History . Eldeth lived with her family in Gauntlgrym , where she worked as a scout . In the late 1480s DR , Eldeth was captured by the drow slavers of Velkynvelve and had been attempting to return home . Personality . The dwarf was high - spirited , defiant and self - sacrificing , and she had great pride in her heritage and in her people ' s recent reclamation of Gauntlgrym . She was also stubborn and hated drow and other " corrupt dark dwellers " like derro and duergar .

title: Eldkin Agetul
description: Eldkin Agetul Eldkin Agetul was a guard just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Eldkin was a perfectionist and wanted all to know this .
description_long: Eldkin Agetul Eldkin Agetul was a guard just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Eldkin was a perfectionist and wanted all to know this . History . Around 1489 DR , as she had done many times before , Eldkin acted as guard for a great caravan . Unknown to her , this one was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Eldorn Mindalar
description: Eldorn Mindalar Eldorn Mindalar was a male human cleric of Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Eldorn was high priest of the House of Skilled Hands temple to Gond at the time . He led nine priests and eighteen lay - followers .
description_long: Eldorn Mindalar Eldorn Mindalar was a male human cleric of Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Eldorn was high priest of the House of Skilled Hands temple to Gond at the time . He led nine priests and eighteen lay - followers .

title: Eldoth Kron
description: Eldoth Kron Found in the Cloakwood forest , Eldoth Kron is a sleazy , thrill - seeking dilettante who makes a living seducing rich women and living off their money . His latest scheme is to elope with his current lover , Skie Silvershield , then blackmail her father by claiming to have " kidnapped " her and threatening to harm her if he is not paid on a regular basis . A male chauvinist , Eldoth treats Skie quite badly , which earns him the hatred of both Garrick and Shar - Teel .
