description_long: Elgrin Fau Elgrin Fau was a city built by humans , and later sent to the Shadow Deep , in the Plane of Shadow by Kesson Rel . History . The city was built on a world now forgotten , nearly 9000 years previous to the events of Dawn of Night . Kesson Rel was exiled from the city and took revenge by banishing the entire city ( including the wall ) to the Plane of Shadow , using the power he gained as the first Chosen of Mask . The city managed to survive for some time . They undertook to bury their dead inside the city walls and constructed a necropolis in the middle of the city to house and keep them in their graves . Eventually the survivors abandoned the city and left for other planes . When the city was empty , Kesson Rel returned and opened a gate in the middle of the necropolis to taunt the dead interred there . He set a guard over the gate , a darkweaver .

title: Elgun
description: Elgun Elgun was a male human of Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elgun was a citizen of Port Llast .
description_long: Elgun Elgun was a male human of Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elgun was a citizen of Port Llast . He went in search of tree spirits , dryads , to see what he could do about them . On his way , though , he saw the village of Ember destroyed . Elgun came back home , but began telling stories of how he defeated Ember ' s attackers . Gameplay . The Kalach - Cha could have gathered information about Ember and confronted Elgun with the knowledge . Elgun would hesitate , but if undeniable proof was given , Elgun would explain the real story of what had happened .

title: Eliah Coastoar
description: Eliah Coastoar Eliah Coastoar was a seller in the Moonsea . Activities . Eliah worked at the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities as seller of wine and pies .
description_long: Eliah Coastoar Eliah Coastoar was a seller in the Moonsea . Activities . Eliah worked at the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities as seller of wine and pies . History . Eliah at the Rage of Demons ' s time noticed that Jubal bought four new attractions to the carnival : Madame Darkness , a mirror maze , dancing rats , and some fools .

title: Elikarashae
description: Elikarashae Elikarashae was a female Yuir elf warrior who became a deity and ascended to Arvandor . As a mortal , she used the spear " Shama " which was able to speak to a pure - hearted and noble elf ; the club " Maelat " , which could only be used in anger if it was to defend the Yuirwood ; and the sling " Ukava " , which was said to never miss .
description_long: Elikarashae Elikarashae was a female Yuir elf warrior who became a deity and ascended to Arvandor . As a mortal , she used the spear " Shama " which was able to speak to a pure - hearted and noble elf ; the club " Maelat " , which could only be used in anger if it was to defend the Yuirwood ; and the sling " Ukava " , which was said to never miss .

title: Elion
description: Elion Elion was a northern fishing town on the island of Evermeet within the Trackless Sea . Government . It was governed by a council elected to settle disputes and maintain order .
description_long: Elion Elion was a northern fishing town on the island of Evermeet within the Trackless Sea . Government . It was governed by a council elected to settle disputes and maintain order . Inhabitants . Most of the villagers were fishermen and kept to themselves . While extremely loyal to Queen Amlaruil Moonflower , the town remained neutral in political and military issues .

title: Elisa Nettlebee
description: Elisa Nettlebee Elisa Nettlebee was the only daughter of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Elisa had inherited her mother ' s personality .
description_long: Elisa Nettlebee Elisa Nettlebee was the only daughter of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Elisa had inherited her mother ' s personality . She greatly disliked her grandfather and his old way of life . History . In 1491 DR , she was in the family ranch and welcomed the adventurers whom her father and grandfather secretly wanted to entrap .

title: Elisande
description: Elisande Elisande was a young girl in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Elisande lived in a small village on a isle not too far from Phlan .
description_long: Elisande Elisande was a young girl in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Elisande lived in a small village on a isle not too far from Phlan . She lived with her parents until they both died of illness . From that day on , Elisande waited for an opportunity to leave the village . So when an adventuring party arrived in the village investigating rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships , she tried by all means to befriend them . She moved to Phlan until the coup of the Cult of the Dragon took the city After escaped from Phlan Elisande found a place to stay at the Mulmaster ' s Underdark station post of Fort Iron . Here possibly was involved in an other adventure in 1491 DR . During the Rage of Demons Elisande briefly attended a celebration for Mielikki in the village of Elventree . Later Elisande was inside a passage to Upperdark near the village of the Stop . Later Elisande joined in Sporedome the planning of the assault to Maerimydra . At last at the Undying Temple Elisande helped stop the Graz ' zt ' s ritual to to resist to the Vizeran DeVir ' s spell and was revealed to be a Chosen of Cyric . Personality .

title: Elisia
description: Elisia Elisia was a sea spirit who lived in Lac Dinneshere within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The elven - like water spirit had blue skin and light green hair .
description_long: Elisia Elisia was a sea spirit who lived in Lac Dinneshere within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The elven - like water spirit had blue skin and light green hair . Relationships . Elisia loved the great hero Aihonen , and felt very strong feelings toward his descendant , Jhonen , because of his resemblance to Aihonen . However , the sea spirit feared revealing herself to Jhonen for risk of transforming into water . History . Around 1181 DR , Aihonen died while fighting Icasaracht , the last white dragon queen of the Spine of the World on the banks of Lac Dinneshere . In 1281 DR , Elisia communicated to Jhonen through dreams how she felt about the young fisherman . Later , she gave him the shards of the Blade of Aihonen .

title: Elisker Hagathan
description: Elisker Hagathan Elisker Hagathan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God in the 14th century DR , holding the title of " Enduring Servant " . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , Ilmatari investigators discovered the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — in the possession of a group of Thayan agents based in Athkatla , Amn . An Ilmatari strike force assaulted their house one night in the autumn of that year .
description_long: Elisker Hagathan Elisker Hagathan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God in the 14th century DR , holding the title of " Enduring Servant " . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , Ilmatari investigators discovered the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — in the possession of a group of Thayan agents based in Athkatla , Amn . An Ilmatari strike force assaulted their house one night in the autumn of that year . The impressive Ilmatari attack destroyed the house and ended with the Thayan band pursued through the streets and slain , amidst a number of stabbings and desperate rooftop jumps . Before the fall of winter at the close of the year , Enduring Servant Elisker Hagathan carried the " Tome of Torment " in triumph back to the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Calimshan .

title: Elister Noggins
description: Elister Noggins Elister Noggins was a rock gnome priest of Gond from Loudwater . History . Elister lived in Loudwater as a clockmaker with his friend the clockwork construct Tick Tock .
description_long: Elister Noggins Elister Noggins was a rock gnome priest of Gond from Loudwater . History . Elister lived in Loudwater as a clockmaker with his friend the clockwork construct Tick Tock . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , he was captured by some stone giant raiders that took him to their thane Kayalithica when Elister said he knew about Loudwater ' s defenses . The stone giant put him inside a pouch tied to her mithral belt while waiting for her minions to check if the gnome told the truth about his city ' s defenses .

title: Elizar Dryflagon
description: Elizar Dryflagon Elizar Dryflagon was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall . History . Elizar was once a druid until he turned to the worship of Imix .
description_long: Elizar Dryflagon Elizar Dryflagon was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall . History . Elizar was once a druid until he turned to the worship of Imix . Soon he became one of the leaders of the Eternal Flame . In 1491 DR during the Elemental Evil crisis , Elizar and his minions , posing as the obscure ( and fictitious ) Circle of the Scarlet Moon druid circle , set up camp at Scarlet Moon Hall and called for help in performing the Rite of the Wicker Giant in order to restore the balance of nature in the troubled region , or so he claimed . At last , Elizar was confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Elizzaria Whitehand
description: Elizzaria Whitehand Elizzaria Whitehand was the lord of Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . As Grand Mairshar , Elizzaria had powers only over the defense of the dale .
description_long: Elizzaria Whitehand Elizzaria Whitehand was the lord of Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . As Grand Mairshar , Elizzaria had powers only over the defense of the dale . For all other matters , she consulted the Tassel Elders . History . In her youth , Elizzaria was an adventurer priestess of Tymora but abandoned the church of Tymora after a doctrinal dispute and went back to her dale . There , she joined the mairshar s and in 1353 DR was elected Grand Mairshar . Around 1368 DR , Elizzaria was on the verge of retirement and was training her successor , a cheerful paladin named Erich Inshiland .

title: Elk Tribe
description: Elk Tribe The Elk tribe was one of the Uthgardt barbarian tribes whose realm of influence includes the Evermoors , the Dessarin and the lower Surbrin valleys . Under the leadership of chieftain Zokan Thunderer , ( as of year 1359 . ) They have also gained loose ties with Luskan .
description_long: Elk Tribe The Elk tribe was one of the Uthgardt barbarian tribes whose realm of influence includes the Evermoors , the Dessarin and the lower Surbrin valleys . Under the leadership of chieftain Zokan Thunderer , ( as of year 1359 . ) They have also gained loose ties with Luskan . History . In 1372 DR , the Elk ancestral mound was the Flint Rock . Relationships . With respect to the other tribes , the Elk were the most arrogant and self - indulgent , often regarded as nothing than mere bandits . They raided caravans and villages endlessly , taking prisoners ransom or selling them as slaves . Religion . Under Zokan ' s rule , cleric s of Talos gained a stranglehold on the tribe .

title: Elkannath ( family )
description: Elkannath ( family ) The Elkannath family was a dwarven noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .
description_long: Elkannath ( family ) The Elkannath family was a dwarven noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities . History . Haelond was a mining outpost located in the Elkannath Mountains and run by the dwarves of the Elkannath family . In 1469 DR , the members of the Elkannath family had to abandon Haelond when it was overrun by mysterious monsters from the Underdark .

title: Elkannath Mountains
description: Elkannath Mountains The Elkannath Mountains were a range of mountains located in the southwestern region of Returned Abeir . It totally separated the kingdom of Gontal from the rest of Returned Abeir , as the only known way to traverse the mountains was through Gontal Pass , the eastern gate of Gontal City .
description_long: Elkannath Mountains The Elkannath Mountains were a range of mountains located in the southwestern region of Returned Abeir . It totally separated the kingdom of Gontal from the rest of Returned Abeir , as the only known way to traverse the mountains was through Gontal Pass , the eastern gate of Gontal City .

title: Elkantar Iluim
description: Elkantar Iluim Elkantar Iluim was the drow companion of Qilué Veladorn . History . Elkantar was a drow noble who had been sold into slavery by his matron mother because of his rebellious tendencies .
description_long: Elkantar Iluim Elkantar Iluim was the drow companion of Qilué Veladorn . History . Elkantar was a drow noble who had been sold into slavery by his matron mother because of his rebellious tendencies . He found refuge in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in Skullport , where he devoted himself to Eilistraee and her Chosen Qiluè . He became attracted to Qiluè and became her companion . They gave birth to a daughter , Ysolde Veladorn . Elkantar become the leader of the Protectors of the Song , the temple guards . In 1361 DR , Qiluè agreed to help Liriel Baenre against the Vhaeraun - worshiping Dragon ' s Hoard , sending her warriors , including Elkantar , to attack their headquarters . However , during the fighting , despite their victory , Gorlist killed Elkantar .

title: Ellaniath
description: Ellaniath Ellaniath was the name of Vhaeraun ’ s realm , the drow deity of thievery . It served as his base of operation and as the place of his followers ’ afterlife . Location .
description_long: Ellaniath Ellaniath was the name of Vhaeraun ’ s realm , the drow deity of thievery . It served as his base of operation and as the place of his followers ’ afterlife . Location . Ellaniath was a realm , with - uncharacteristically for a location - a moving history in the physical sense . It was originally situated in Colothys , the fourth layer of Carceri under the Great Wheel Cosmology . At some point in the 14th century DR , the planes shifted into the Worldtree Cosmology and Ellaniath was moved into the Demonweb Pits and hang among the strands as one of the baubles . After the Silence of Lolth , Lolth yanked the Demonweb Pits out and turned them into an independent realm , Ellaniath returned to Colothys . After Vhaeraun was killed by Eilistraee , Ellaniath merged with his sister ’ s portion of Arvandor and remained there after she died . Over the course of the Second Sundering , Vhaeraun returned , the planes rearranged themselves in the Great Wheel cosmology order . Features . Nobody outside of Ellaniath , save the ruling god , had an idea , where the realm was located , apart from the very general knowledge “ somewhere on Colothys " , and how it looked like .

title: Ellard Gauntur
description: Ellard Gauntur Ellard Gauntur was a War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Lady Glathra Barcantle sent Ellard with five Purple Dragons to arrest Rorskryn Mreldrake for treason but found he had escaped through a " gate " to Marsember .
description_long: Ellard Gauntur Ellard Gauntur was a War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Lady Glathra Barcantle sent Ellard with five Purple Dragons to arrest Rorskryn Mreldrake for treason but found he had escaped through a " gate " to Marsember . Personality . Ellard was young , callow , full of self - importance , and zealous .

title: Ellardin Darovik
description: Ellardin Darovik Ellardin Darovik was the priest of Goldenfields and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . The priest managed the largest walled temple - farm to Chauntea in the Dessarin Valley .
description_long: Ellardin Darovik Ellardin Darovik was the priest of Goldenfields and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . The priest managed the largest walled temple - farm to Chauntea in the Dessarin Valley . Personality . Ellardin was a reserved but generous man who disliked confrontation .

title: Ellery Dragonsbane
description: Ellery Dragonsbane Ellery Dragonsbane , her full name Ellery Tranth Dopray Kierney Dragonsbane Peidopare , was a famous commander of the Army of Bloodstone . Appearance . Ellery was tall and quite slender .
description_long: Ellery Dragonsbane Ellery Dragonsbane , her full name Ellery Tranth Dopray Kierney Dragonsbane Peidopare , was a famous commander of the Army of Bloodstone . Appearance . Ellery was tall and quite slender . Her skin was tanned with many freckles about her nose , enhancing her beauty by adding a touch of girlishness to a face full of intensity and power . Her bright blue eyes were wide set . Sometimes she wore her thick shock of long , fiery red hair falling free and tumbling down her back . When leaving for battle , the commander was armored in full plate decorated with carvings and delicate designs , wearing a great flat - topped helmet , plumed with a great red feather on the left - hand side , indicating her rank among the Army of Bloodstone . Personality . Growing up under the shadow of Zhengyi , the Witch - King , Ellery had seen many battles and had wielded her heavy axe since childhood . She spent years justifying her secret relationship with Canthan Doolittle , and thought herself in control of the relationship , but she was nothing but a pawn to Canthan . Her dark choices delayed her from emerging as a true paladin in the line of Gareth Dragonsbane . History .

title: Ellesime
description: Ellesime Ellesime was the elven queen of Suldanessellar . History . She was said to be of divine heritage ; indeed , her beauty was often compared to that of a goddess .
description_long: Ellesime Ellesime was the elven queen of Suldanessellar . History . She was said to be of divine heritage ; indeed , her beauty was often compared to that of a goddess . Ellesime inhabited the palace of Suldanessellar , which was built around the Tree of Life — the queen ' s eternal youth was said to be preserved by the tree , and as such it was difficult to judge her age . She was once in a relationship with the mage Irenicus , who was subsequently exiled from Suldanessellar for attempting to raise himself to the status of godhood . In 1368 DR , Ellesime was forced to flee Suldanessellar , after it was attacked by Joneleth , " The Exile " . She and the other survivors fled to Myth Rhynn .

title: Ellhimar
description: Ellhimar Ellhimar was a human wizard living in Iltkazar . History . Ellhimar hailed from Erlkazar but in 1366 DR he relocated to Iltkazakar , although he still considered himself a visitor .
description_long: Ellhimar Ellhimar was a human wizard living in Iltkazar . History . Ellhimar hailed from Erlkazar but in 1366 DR he relocated to Iltkazakar , although he still considered himself a visitor . Around 1370 DR , Ellhimar spent all his time in scholarly research but revealed to nobody the aim of his studies . In time , his attitude grew increasingly grim and many started to speculate that he had confirmed a hypothesis that he hoped would prove false .

title: Ellifain Tuuserail
description: Ellifain Tuuserail Ellifain Tuuserail ( male alias Le ' lorinel Tel ' e ' brenequiette ) was a moon elf in the Moonwood . Her mother was killed by a drow raiding party containing Drizzt Do ' Urden when she was a young child . Physical description .
description_long: Ellifain Tuuserail Ellifain Tuuserail ( male alias Le ' lorinel Tel ' e ' brenequiette ) was a moon elf in the Moonwood . Her mother was killed by a drow raiding party containing Drizzt Do ' Urden when she was a young child . Physical description . Being a silver elf , Ellifain had black hair with a bluish tint and very pale skin flecked with blue . Her eyes were shimmering azure with gold sparkles . Equipment . Surviving the wilds of the Moonwood , Ellifain wore a forest green cloak , brown leggings , and tunic . She would dress for battle armed with a longbow and a thin sword . History . Ellifain survived the raid when Drizzt smeared her with her mother ' s blood to make it look like she was mortally wounded , so the other drow would leave her alone . Scarred by the traumatic event and living with the elves of the Moonwood after Drizzt saved her life , she was consumed with thoughts of revenge once she heard rumours of a drow with lavender eyes who had come to live on the surface , despite the efforts of cleric s and wizard s to restore her mental state . In 1357 DR , she encountered Drizzt as he was traveling through the Moonwood .

title: Elliot Graves
description: Elliot Graves Elliot Graves was a Harper and the servant and close confident of Loene in Waterdeep . Description . Graves was a skilled soldier and chef .
description_long: Elliot Graves Elliot Graves was a Harper and the servant and close confident of Loene in Waterdeep . Description . Graves was a skilled soldier and chef . History . In 1361 DR , Graves was living and working in Loene ' s townhouse in the Castle Ward near Castle Waterdeep . After Arilyn Moonblade showed up in tow with an injured Danilo Thann , Graves was targeted and killed by the Harper Assassin .

title: Ellis Adarbrent
description: Ellis Adarbrent Ellis Adarbrent was a member of the noble house of Adarbrent and a cartographer in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ellis was a quiet man and he stuttered when nervous .
description_long: Ellis Adarbrent Ellis Adarbrent was a member of the noble house of Adarbrent and a cartographer in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ellis was a quiet man and he stuttered when nervous . History . Born as the third child of Lord Royus Adarbrent in 1344 DR , Ellis studied as an apprentice cartographer at Laran ' s Cartographers . Ellis later became a senior cartographer at Horizon ' s Sails . Relations . He was a good friend of Winter Zulth .

title: Ellison Berenger
description: Ellison Berenger Ellison Berenger was a sorcerer member of the Cult of the Dragon and a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Ellison was sent by his masters to infiltrated Mantor ' s Library , together with fellow cultists Tibeem and Spernik , who had another mission .
description_long: Ellison Berenger Ellison Berenger was a sorcerer member of the Cult of the Dragon and a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Ellison was sent by his masters to infiltrated Mantor ' s Library , together with fellow cultists Tibeem and Spernik , who had another mission . Ellison ' s mission was to recover lore about the Pool of Radiance under Valjevo Castle . He finally identified three books of interest and thieved them from their owners . However , in escaping Phlan , he suffered so many injuries that he came close to death . After he escaped from Phlan , he met with the black dragon wyrmling Rythnax in his lair . However , they were confronted by an adventuring party hired to recover the stolen books . In the fighting , Ellison was captured . After the Vorgansharax ' s coup Ellison severed his ties with the Cult of Dragon and tried to find a way to escape the city . Personality . Ellison believed himself to be a descendant of one of Phlan ' s noble houses and for this reason accepted the mission to Mantor ' s Library so he could research this . He despised Rythnax . Ellison was a intelligent and arrogant individual but no evil .

title: Ellym Thourin
description: Ellym Thourin Ellym " Catsjaw " Thourin was a priest of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Ellym once earned a reputation as an adventurer , but later retired . Subsequently , Ellym rose through the clergy of Helm to become High Watchful Weaponmaster of the Noble Hand temple by 1368 DR .
description_long: Ellym Thourin Ellym " Catsjaw " Thourin was a priest of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Ellym once earned a reputation as an adventurer , but later retired . Subsequently , Ellym rose through the clergy of Helm to become High Watchful Weaponmaster of the Noble Hand temple by 1368 DR . Under Ellym ' s leadership , the temple — which also operated as a school for guards — thrived .

title: Elmaer Oraun
description: Elmaer Oraun Elmaer Oraun was a former Sembia n war captain who became Lord of Harrowdale in the 1170s or 1180s DR . He vanished during the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , presumed dead , in which Harrowdale was lost to Halvan the Dark . Relationships .
description_long: Elmaer Oraun Elmaer Oraun was a former Sembia n war captain who became Lord of Harrowdale in the 1170s or 1180s DR . He vanished during the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , presumed dead , in which Harrowdale was lost to Halvan the Dark . Relationships . Elmaer Oraun had a son , named Erammon Oraun , and a swordmaster , Thaeron . History . Originally from Sembia , Elmaer rose to become a well - respected war captain . In the years around 1175 – 1185 DR ( no source confirms the exact year ) , Elmaer killed Harlstakh " Har - Stag " Kethtor , who was Lord of Harrowdale at the time , to become Lord of Harrowdale for himself . Described as " around twenty seasons " after gaining power in Harrowdale , the dale was invaded by Halvan the Dark , and the Battle of Marak ' s Stile ensued , in which Halvan was the victor , and Elmaer vanished , presumed dead , but some said that elven magic prevented his death instead , along with his son Erammon and swordmaster Thaeron , and that reports emerged of Oraun and Thaeron appearing in Elventree fifty years later , escorting an elven " great lady " and not appearing to have aged at all .

title: Elmanesse
description: Elmanesse The Elmanesse was an elven tribe in the Forest of Tethir . History . The tribe was formed when elves fled the fall of Myth Drannor and settled in Tethir .
description_long: Elmanesse The Elmanesse was an elven tribe in the Forest of Tethir . History . The tribe was formed when elves fled the fall of Myth Drannor and settled in Tethir . While the tribe was primarily concerned with protecting its tribal lands from human s , a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra infiltrated the group with hopes of finding the ancient city of Myth Rhynn around 1374 DR .

title: Elmariel Emmarask
description: Elmariel Emmarask Elmariel Emmarask was a member of the Emmarask noble house of Cormyr and a war wizard . He was a trusted friend of Luthax . Background .
description_long: Elmariel Emmarask Elmariel Emmarask was a member of the Emmarask noble house of Cormyr and a war wizard . He was a trusted friend of Luthax . Background . In 629 DR , Elmariel found a magical creature in the ruins of Netheril . He conspired with Luthax to kill King Draxius Obarskyr , but their plot was foiled when Thanderahast alerted the king . Amedahast found the conspirators and detonated her magical staff , killing Elmariel , Luthax , herself , and the others in the room .

title: Elminster ' s Choice
description: Elminster ' s Choice Elminster ' s Choice was a popular beer exported from Immersea and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This dark beer had a thick head and was clouded with yeast .
description_long: Elminster ' s Choice Elminster ' s Choice was a popular beer exported from Immersea and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . title: Elminster ' s effulgent epuration
description: Elminster ' s effulgent epuration Elminster ' s effulgent epuration was an arcane abjuration spell that created a number of floating spheres that protected an individual from targeted hostile magic . Effects . This spell had a few distinct variations , but all versions produced intangible spheres that floated about the caster or another creature as chosen by the caster , and did not require concentration to maintain .
description_long: Elminster ' s effulgent epuration Elminster ' s effulgent epuration was an arcane abjuration spell that created a number of floating spheres that protected an individual from targeted hostile magic . Effects . This spell had a few distinct variations , but all versions produced intangible spheres that floated about the caster or another creature as chosen by the caster , and did not require concentration to maintain . The number of spheres produced was equal to the caster ' s level . The spheres were about the size of the caster ' s head , typically 6 in ( 15 cm ) in diameter , and transparent with a silvery hue . They were insubstantial and could not be physically attacked , although one version of the " epuration " had spheres that could not pass through solid objects or magical forces such as " forcecage " , while other versions were completely unaffected by physical barriers or magical " walls " . The spheres could be moved by the mental direction of the caster up to the range of the spell , which varied widely between versions — anywhere from a " maximum " of 60 ft ( 18 m ) to a " minimum " of 180 ft ( 55 m ) — either independently or as a group , depending on the version .

title: Elminster ' s evasion
description: Elminster ' s evasion Elminster ' s evasion was an arcane evocation spell that transported the mind , soul , and body of the caster to a chosen location in the event of any of six predetermined trigger conditions . Upon arrival , one or two other stored spells were allowed to take effect . Effects .
description_long: Elminster ' s evasion Elminster ' s evasion was an arcane evocation spell that transported the mind , soul , and body of the caster to a chosen location in the event of any of six predetermined trigger conditions . Upon arrival , one or two other stored spells were allowed to take effect . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell that differed mainly in the preparation and casting but had very similar effects . " Elminster ' s evasion " was a powerful modification of the " contingency " spell intended to save the caster from disastrous events as specified by up to six conditions woven into the spell at casting time . The conditions could be specific or general , but they had to be unambiguous . They could be as benign as speaking a cryptic word , or as dire as death . Once triggered , the mind , body , and soul of the caster were all transported to the chosen location and reunited if necessary , thus foiling spells such as " magic jar " and " trap the soul " . However , if the caster was dead upon arrival , his or her soul then proceeded to the afterlife from that location . The destination could be on any plane or demiplane that the caster had previously visited .

title: Elminster ' s tower
description: Elminster ' s tower Elminster ' s tower was the abode of perhaps the most famous , or infamous , spellcaster throughout Toril — Elminster Aumar . Location . Elminster ' s tower was found in the village of Shadowdale .
description_long: Elminster ' s tower Elminster ' s tower was the abode of perhaps the most famous , or infamous , spellcaster throughout Toril — Elminster Aumar . Location . Elminster ' s tower was found in the village of Shadowdale . It sat just south of the Old Skull near a small pond . Structure . The tower stood only three stories tall . Vines covered nearly every one of the field stones used to form the structure . Numerous lean - tos and shacks had been added to the exterior to accommodate Elminster ' s growing collection of items both magical and mundane . The front of the tower was adorned with a simple wooden door . Interior . The first floor of the tower held a simple kitchen and office . A spiral staircase led to the second floor , which held Elminster ' s personal quarters . An even smaller room was located on the third floor and was sometimes used as a work room for guests . Defenses . Though no one knew the extent of magical protection placed about the tower , it was wise to assume that Elminster ' s home was safe from unwanted intrusion . History . Elminster built the squat tower sometime during the mid – 9th century DR . Inhabitants .

title: Elminster Aumar
description: Elminster Aumar Elminster Aumar , also known as the " Sage of Shadowdale " and the " Old Mage " , was one of the most famous and powerful wizards in all of Faerûn , as well as a fair fighter and thief . Description . As a high - level wizard , Elminster was capable of taking on almost any appearance imaginable .
description_long: Elminster Aumar Elminster Aumar , also known as the " Sage of Shadowdale " and the " Old Mage " , was one of the most famous and powerful wizards in all of Faerûn , as well as a fair fighter and thief . Description . As a high - level wizard , Elminster was capable of taking on almost any appearance imaginable . In his natural state , Elminster appeared as a gray - bearded man of weathered visage , gruff tone , alert eyes , and nondescript attire . He was almost always smoking a meerschaum pipe that was spouting some vile blue or green smoke . Elminster ' s most distinguishing physical feature was his hawk - like nose . Personality . A natural storyteller , Elminster was normally a witty , clever , and very charming man . He was a consummate actor , however , and could be imperious , grave , and terrible as the situation demanded . He rarely revealed the full extent of his true nature to anyone who was not an extremely close friend . He could portray himself as a trickster , a rake , a stern father figure , or any other stereotype he wanted to assume , depending on what he wanted to accomplish or what reaction he wanted to elicit from those around him .

title: Elminster Must Die
description: Elminster Must Die Elminster Must Die by Ed Greenwood is the debut fourth - edition appearance of Elminster . It is the first novel in the Sage of Shadowdale series . Appendix .
description_long: Elminster Must Die Elminster Must Die by Ed Greenwood is the debut fourth - edition appearance of Elminster . It is the first novel in the Sage of Shadowdale series . Appendix . Notes . At some point , the novel ' s title was changed from " Elminster Must Die ! " to " Elminster Must Die " . During that change , the novel ' s series was changed from The Sage of Shadowdale to simply Sage of Shadowdale .

title: Elminster hunting
description: Elminster hunting Elminster hunting is a name for the practice of the Zhentarim sending their members to seek Elminster , with predictable results . This used as a way to weed out those who are seen as too ambitious . Older members use this as a way to " die " out of the Brotherhood .

description: Elminster series The Elminster series is the signature work of Ed Greenwood , the founder of the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting . An open - ended series , all the novels center on Elminster , the Sage of Shadowdale , Chosen of Mystra , and general narrator of the Realms .

title: Elmwood
description: Elmwood Elmwood was a small farming community located on the southern shores of the Moonsea . Government . This tranquil place was loosely ruled by its constable , Thoyana Jorgadaul , a shield dwarf adventurer who retired here due to a respiratory disease .
description_long: Elmwood Elmwood was a small farming community located on the southern shores of the Moonsea . Government . This tranquil place was loosely ruled by its constable , Thoyana Jorgadaul , a shield dwarf adventurer who retired here due to a respiratory disease . Trade . Elmwood ' s merchant area was located in the center of the village . History . Elmwood was founded in the Year of the Screeching Vole ( 163 DR ) as a stopover for ships to and from the River Lis . Inhabitants . The village was home to woodcutters and fishermen , and a waystop for ships and adventurers passing by . The place was neutral and the people kept to themselves , protected both by their isolation and the fact that there was little worth taking by force .

title: Elorfindar Floshin
description: Elorfindar Floshin Lord Elorfindar Floshin was a sun elf who guarded the " portal s " of the Ardeep Forest . He lived in a manor close to the House of Long Silences . He was a distant relative of Araevin Teshurr .
description_long: Elorfindar Floshin Lord Elorfindar Floshin was a sun elf who guarded the " portal s " of the Ardeep Forest . He lived in a manor close to the House of Long Silences . He was a distant relative of Araevin Teshurr . History . Elorfindar was required to guard the " portals " in the Ardeep Forest as penance for the betrayals of his ancestors . In youth Elorfindar joined the kingdom of Phalorm and contrary of his fellow Ardeep elves he never abandoned the kingdom until it end . After he put all his efforts in made a new Phalorm but with few success . He acted as advisor for the dukes in Daggerford Circa 1468 DR , Elorfindar died and the estate was left to his eldest son Darfin .

title: Elovear
description: Elovear The Elovear family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Elovears were allied with the Channath , Laranadda , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Elrem the wise
description: Elrem the wise Elrem the Wise was the powerful shaman of the Great Worm Tribe of Uthgardt barbarians and resided permenatly at the Great Worm ancestor mound . Once human , Elrem had acquired the shape of a great Worm through some magical means . Either through pious devotion or the prays of his followers Elrem had became an embodiment of the totem spirit of his tribe .
description_long: Elrem the wise Elrem the Wise was the powerful shaman of the Great Worm Tribe of Uthgardt barbarians and resided permenatly at the Great Worm ancestor mound . Once human , Elrem had acquired the shape of a great Worm through some magical means . Either through pious devotion or the prays of his followers Elrem had became an embodiment of the totem spirit of his tribe . Legend has it he was a son of Uthgar , gifted with the beast powers by his father . Much was told of the treasure collected over the years , offered as gifts upon which Elrem rested . He seemed to only rouse himself for the annual runemeet , to lead the tribes celebrations , and to prophesied the future . Through his leadership the tribe had chosen evil creatures as their spiritual enemies . He had been described as a gigantic bat winged snake with the head of a red dragon . He was killed in 1368 DR by a Zhentarim - sponsored adventuring party .

title: Elsura Dauniir
description: Elsura Dauniir Elsura Dauniir was the field agent of the Moonstars for the north Faerûn in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Powers . She had the unique ability to transform herself in a black cat at will .
description_long: Elsura Dauniir Elsura Dauniir was the field agent of the Moonstars for the north Faerûn in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Powers . She had the unique ability to transform herself in a black cat at will . History . In 1370 DR , she was chosen as field agent of the Moonstar for the North ; she was quite famous in the region and some people , especially in Luskan , spoken to " clawed by Elsura " to indicate an unexpectable and mostly deathly surprise She was in 1374 DR among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor . Appearance . " Blackstaff ( novel ) "

title: Eltab
description: Eltab Eltab is a demon lord known as the " Lord of the Hidden Layer . " Description . Eltab appears as a fifteen - foot - tall humanoid with the head of a canine - like creature .
description_long: Eltab Eltab is a demon lord known as the " Lord of the Hidden Layer . " Description . Eltab appears as a fifteen - foot - tall humanoid with the head of a canine - like creature . His head sports numerous antlers and horns and his body is covered with bony dark red plates . He has slitted yellow glowing eyes . Realm . Eltab rules the 248th layer of the Abyss known as the Hidden Layer . It is a vast wasteland of boulders and fissures constantly beset with intensive electrical storms , making it inimical to most life except for demons and deadly plant life such as viper tree s , ironmaw s , and bloodthorn s . In the past thousand years or so , because of Eltab ’ s absence , the Hidden Layer has been fragmented in ever - changing fiefdoms as Eltab ’ s former lieutenants , including the balor Ndulu , fight over the vacated realm . Thanks to the bindings cast by the Narfell i demon - binders on Eltab when they summoned him , they also somehow linked fragments of the Hidden Layer into Faerûn , as well . So pieces of the layer , known as demoncysts , are lying scattered beneath the ground all over northeast Faerûn . Demoncysts are typically a hundred feet or more in diameter .

title: Eltan
description: Eltan Eltan was the founder and leader of the Flaming Fists mercenary company , as well as a Grand Duke of the city of Baldur ' s Gate in the late 1300s DR . During the iron crisis of 1368 DR , Eltan was nearly assassinated by members of the Iron Throne , but he survived the attempt . Description .
description_long: Eltan Eltan was the founder and leader of the Flaming Fists mercenary company , as well as a Grand Duke of the city of Baldur ' s Gate in the late 1300s DR . During the iron crisis of 1368 DR , Eltan was nearly assassinated by members of the Iron Throne , but he survived the attempt . Description . Eltan was a handsome , tall man with black hair and grey eyes . He was usually clad for combat , wearing a full suit of polished plate mail and carrying multiple magical items and weapons . He was extremely wealthy , as a result of leading the wildly successful Flaming Fists company . Personality . A steadfast and principled man , Eltan was respected by many Faerûn ian rulers , both for his tactical genius and because he was familiar with the plight of ruling a realm . Eltan had a sincere belief in maintaining the balance of power among the many small kingdoms of Faerûn , and as such actively sought to hire out his Flaming Fists to prevent the formation of empires . Although he had a love of fighting , Eltan strove to keep emotions separated from business . Possessions . Duke Eltan owned an enchanted suit of plate mail and a " displacer cloak " .

title: Eltargrim Irithyl
description: Eltargrim Irithyl Eltargrim Irithyl was sixth Coronal of Cormanthyr , seventh son of Coronal Tannivh Irithyl , ruling from - 223 DR to his death in 661 DR . He was of the unpopular opinion that the outside races ( such as human s , gnome s , halfling s and dwarves ) could not be held back by the elves due of their sheer numbers , so he allowed them entry to the forest of Cormanthor and to inhabit the city of Cormanthor , renaming it Myth Drannor in 261 DR . Description .
description_long: Eltargrim Irithyl Eltargrim Irithyl was sixth Coronal of Cormanthyr , seventh son of Coronal Tannivh Irithyl , ruling from - 223 DR to his death in 661 DR . He was of the unpopular opinion that the outside races ( such as human s , gnome s , halfling s and dwarves ) could not be held back by the elves due of their sheer numbers , so he allowed them entry to the forest of Cormanthor and to inhabit the city of Cormanthor , renaming it Myth Drannor in 261 DR . Description . Eltargrim was a gold elf , with golden eyes and long silvery white hair . He possessed a warrior ' s build until his death , though he was often seen in robes of state rather than armour after becoming Coronal . He wore his tattoos of military rank until his death : a black sword on one hand and two crossed rings on the other . History . Eltargrim was born in - 612 DR in the community of Semberholme . In his early years he joined the Akh ' Velahr , the standing army of Cormanthyr , remaining there for over three centuries and attaining the rank of penaal . Eltargrim ' s Rysar .

title: Elthaun Aumar
description: Elthaun Aumar Elthaun Aumar was the second of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Elthaun was the second son of the Stag King of Athalantar , Uthgrael Aumar .
description_long: Elthaun Aumar Elthaun Aumar was the second of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Elthaun was the second son of the Stag King of Athalantar , Uthgrael Aumar . He was a subtle manipulator . He fled the country for Calimshan in 219 DR . Later that year , Belaur Aumar ' s magelord s found and killed him .

title: Elthia
description: Elthia Elthia was a princess of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast , and later princess and queen of Impiltur in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate .
description_long: Elthia Elthia was a princess of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast , and later princess and queen of Impiltur in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate . Lamoth sought to bolster the legitimacy of his line by marrying his children , Elthia , among them , to royal families around the Inner Sea , often by sending them to visit their royal courts . Finally , Lamoth successfully arranged a marriage between Elthia and Prince Bellodar III of Impiltur . Elthia went to Lyrabar in Impiltur , accompanied by her dowry , which included the sword Galathos . Bellodar became king of Impiltur , and Elthia queen , in the Year of Sifting Sands , 642 DR . Galathos eventually became the traditional sword of the princes of Impiltur . Associates . Princess Elthia was the daughter of King Lamoth , who had five other daughters and eight sons . She married Bellodar III of Impiltur .

title: Elthryn Aumar
description: Elthryn Aumar Elthryn Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the father of Elminster Aumar . History . Elthryn was a calm , peaceful , just man .
description_long: Elthryn Aumar Elthryn Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the father of Elminster Aumar . History . Elthryn was a calm , peaceful , just man . At one point , not supporting the intrigues that plagued the court , Elthryn retired to the outlying village of Heldon and Uthgrael Aumar gave him the Lion Sword , a longsword with magical powers that had never left the king ' s hand until then . Some saw this act as the king appointing Elthryn as the true heir to the Stag Throne . In Heldon , Elthryn married a forester ' s daughter , Amrythale Goldsheaf , in 210 DR . They had one son , Elminster , born in 212 DR . Both parents were slain in the destruction of Heldon by the wizard Undarl in 224 DR .

title: Elturel
description: Elturel Once an independent city , Elturel later served as the capital of Elturgard . Geography . The city was situated atop a cliff , dominating the River Chionthar .
description_long: Elturel Once an independent city , Elturel later served as the capital of Elturgard . Geography . The city was situated atop a cliff , dominating the River Chionthar . After the Spellplague , a small pocket of plagueland appeared a few miles south of the city . The city itself was split into two districts : the High District and the Dock District . Trade . Elturel was the farming center of the Fields of the Dead and thrived on the trade the passed through its domain . Traders greatly appreciated the protection afforded to them by the city ' s Hellriders . After the founding of Elturgard , the officials who handled trade in the city became overly righteous and handed exorbitant taxes and punishments to traders who demonstrated even the slightest impiety . Defenses . Elturel ' s main defense for much of its existence were the mounted warriors known as the Hellriders . Though they numbered only 200 , they were not only the guards and police of the city , they also effectively patrolled the River Chionthar and surrounding roads .

title: Elturgard
description: Elturgard Elturgard was a theocracy in the Western Heartlands ruled by paladin s of Torm in the 15th century DR . History . Elturgard was first formed by the paladins and cleric s of the city of Elturel after the Spellplague in 1385 DR .
description_long: Elturgard Elturgard was a theocracy in the Western Heartlands ruled by paladin s of Torm in the 15th century DR . History . Elturgard was first formed by the paladins and cleric s of the city of Elturel after the Spellplague in 1385 DR . It was the first nation to have grown in the Western Heartlands . It encompassed much of the middle Heartlands and took up the region in the Fields of the Dead that was not already incorporated into the booming city - state of Baldur ' s Gate , an ally of Elturgard . In 1437 DR , an Amnian spy was returning to Amn with valuable information about the nation of Elturgard ; he was kidnapped and rescued by Flaming Fist recruits and the information reached Amn . However , an unethical merchant consortium in Baldur ' s Gate called the Twilight Brotherhood also gained the information . With a deva from Elturgard , the recruits once again handled this and became part of the Flaming Fists . Industry . About half of the Fields of the Dead belonged to the nation of Elturgard , as the metropolis of Baldur ' s Gate grew so massively that it encompassed half of the Fields . Both used it for farming .

title: Elturian Grey
description: Elturian Grey Elturian Grey was a cheese crafted in Elturel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Elturian Grey Elturian Grey was a cheese crafted in Elturel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy white cheese was streaked with black veins , giving it the appearance of stone . Despite its appearance , this pungent cheese was a tasty treat . Prices . Elturian Grey could be purchased in the following sizes :

title: Eluraunt Malabrak
description: Eluraunt Malabrak Eluraunt Malabrak was a shadovar arcanist . History . Eluraunt was one of the few shadovar surviving the fall of Thultanthar in 1487 DR .
description_long: Eluraunt Malabrak Eluraunt Malabrak was a shadovar arcanist . History . Eluraunt was one of the few shadovar surviving the fall of Thultanthar in 1487 DR . He joined the Court of Three . He was observed from far to be in the Oldspires mansion in Cormyr when Tabra , on her crusade against all surviving shadovar arcanists , found him and killed Eluraunt .

title: Elvar the Grainlord
description: Elvar the Grainlord Elvar the Grainlord was the ruler of the small village of Triel . Personality . Elvar was generally a reasonable lord when it came to trade , though he had two mild obsessions .
description_long: Elvar the Grainlord Elvar the Grainlord was the ruler of the small village of Triel . Personality . Elvar was generally a reasonable lord when it came to trade , though he had two mild obsessions . The first was his fear that the community might run out of food , and the second was his never - ending search for the right deity to worship . Elvar had a hunger for news and items such as food , firewood , and food - preservation items . Those who brought such items were given a feast .

title: Elvath Muirreste
description: Elvath Muirreste Lord Elvath Muirreste was a tall moon elf who served in the Silver Guard as the leader of the Elion legion until he followed Seiveril Miritar to Faerûn to combat the daemonfey invasion . Description . The strongly built elven lord had pale skin and very dark hair .
description_long: Elvath Muirreste Lord Elvath Muirreste was a tall moon elf who served in the Silver Guard as the leader of the Elion legion until he followed Seiveril Miritar to Faerûn to combat the daemonfey invasion . Description . The strongly built elven lord had pale skin and very dark hair . History . Death . Elvath was killed while pursuing the fleeing orc s at the Battle of the Cwm on 27 Ches , 1374 DR .

title: Elven Court
description: Elven Court The Elven Court ( sometimes called " Old Elven Court " after its destruction by the drow ) is one of four old elven communities in the forest of Cormanthor ( the others being Myth Drannor , Semberholme and the Tangled Trees ) , part of the newly refounded realm of Cormanthyr . It is a holy site for the elves , a Seldarine - blessed place of pilgrimage , where the elves first convened to serve justice and decide the outcome of the Crown Wars and the fate of elves . History .
description_long: Elven Court The Elven Court ( sometimes called " Old Elven Court " after its destruction by the drow ) is one of four old elven communities in the forest of Cormanthor ( the others being Myth Drannor , Semberholme and the Tangled Trees ) , part of the newly refounded realm of Cormanthyr . It is a holy site for the elves , a Seldarine - blessed place of pilgrimage , where the elves first convened to serve justice and decide the outcome of the Crown Wars and the fate of elves . History . The area known as Elven Court was first visited after the banishment of the drow from the surface world around - 10000 DR , marking the end of the four long and brutal Crown Wars . Important elves of Faerûn , including High Mages , nobles , and priests , were summoned by Corellon Larethian in reverie to convene and prepare for Court . Immediately , these elves began disappearing , and though originally thought that they were being summoned to Corellon ' s side consistent with their beliefs , they were instead summoned to a deep part of the Arcorar woods to the east . Corellon declared that it was here that they would decide their own fate .

title: Elven Port
description: Elven Port Elven Port was a flourishing elven city that stood at the edges of the High Forest . Description . Its piers were wetted by the river Delimbiyr .
description_long: Elven Port Elven Port was a flourishing elven city that stood at the edges of the High Forest . Description . Its piers were wetted by the river Delimbiyr . Elven Port was long one of the most accessible ruins of old Earlann and it was visited by several groups of adventurers . For many years , the ruins of Elven Port had provided cover to marauders and a few predators . However , by 1366 DR , the old tower of the town ' s lord was occupied by a powerful group of daemonfey , led by Vaerilmor Floshin . Vaerilmor and his followers were luring elven adventurers to corrupt them with their foul magic . History . Between 1366 DR and 1372 DR , all the adventurers who came across this place disappeared without leaving any traces .

title: Elven bow
description: Elven bow An Elven bow was a ranged weapon which could be used in melee as a club or staff . Description . A wondrous piece of art , elven bows were crafted mostly from wood , and beautifully designed .
description_long: Elven bow An Elven bow was a ranged weapon which could be used in melee as a club or staff . Description . A wondrous piece of art , elven bows were crafted mostly from wood , and beautifully designed . Elven crafters placed metal inlays within the bow to strengthen it , making it a suitable parrying weapon . Weaponology . Over the years , elves found their archers were attacked without much chance to protect themselves . The elven bow could be used as a melee weapon , with an elven shortbow used as a one - handed melee weapon and an elven longbow acting like a two - handed melee weapon . These bows weighed twice as much as regular bows , and elven shortbows cost 360 gp and elven longbows cost 450 gp .

title: Elven bread
description: Elven bread Elven bread was a highly nutritional bread produced in Evermeet . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Elven bread Elven bread was a highly nutritional bread produced in Evermeet . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Elven bread was fine - grained , light and sweet . Besides its fine taste , it was also extremely nourishing , and provided twice the nutritional value of iron rations with only half the weight . It was also rumored that an Elven bread - based diet played a role in Elminster ' s longevity .

title: Elven dualist
description: Elven dualist Dualists , commonly known as " elven dualists " despite the fact that in the time of Myth Drannor a few gnomes became " nelluonkkar " , were specialist wizard s who hailed from the ancient elven nations . History . In the time of Myth Drannor , the theory of magic revolved around fixed circular relationships between the eight schools of magic ; arcane wizardly specialists would sacrifice the school or schools that opposed their own and focus primarily on their specialty school with minor interest in the other , non - opposed , schools .
description_long: Elven dualist Dualists , commonly known as " elven dualists " despite the fact that in the time of Myth Drannor a few gnomes became " nelluonkkar " , were specialist wizard s who hailed from the ancient elven nations . History . In the time of Myth Drannor , the theory of magic revolved around fixed circular relationships between the eight schools of magic ; arcane wizardly specialists would sacrifice the school or schools that opposed their own and focus primarily on their specialty school with minor interest in the other , non - opposed , schools . The Elven Dualists were the first to challenge this notion . The Dualists would specialize exclusively in the two " opposing " schools of the prevailing theory , to the exclusion of all other schools of magic ( with the exception of minor divination and universal spells ) . Geography . Elven dualists were found in the following nations and times , but not before the founding of that particular nation : Organization . The titles of the four different dualist schools derived from Auld Dwarvish :

title: Elven high mage
description: Elven high mage Elves study magic with a matchless passion . But even among the elves , the high mages are regarded as obsessed with the accumulation of arcane power . Elven high mages are the masters of creating their own epic spells — " mythals " that can grow to engulf entire cities .
description_long: Elven high mage Elves study magic with a matchless passion . But even among the elves , the high mages are regarded as obsessed with the accumulation of arcane power . Elven high mages are the masters of creating their own epic spells — " mythals " that can grow to engulf entire cities . Learning the secrets of epic magic is the culmination of any arcanist ' s career , and the elves are very selective about who can learn such potent lore . Existing high mages often observe high mage candidates for a decade or more , probing for the faintest hint of unworthiness . So far , their extreme secrecy has worked . Less than a . . . Requirements . Wizard s or sorcerer s may both become high mages , but under normal circumstances only elven casters are capable of high magic . There are two methods to becoming a High Mage . The first method is to petition a council of high mages . The few that remain reside in various elven strongholds or elven dominated cities . If the petitioner is accepted , he or she may begin the study of High Magic through conventional means under the guidance and direction of the council .

title: Elven high magic
description: Elven high magic Elven High Magic ( Arselu ' Tel ' Quess in elven or the Great Art of the People ) is the term used to describe one of the most powerful forms of magic practiced in Faerûn . Casters of this magic are called Selu ' taar , also known as the " Art ' s Disciples " or simply as " High Mages " . High Magic spells are powerful enough to affect deities or to create world - changing spell effects .
description_long: Elven high magic Elven High Magic ( Arselu ' Tel ' Quess in elven or the Great Art of the People ) is the term used to describe one of the most powerful forms of magic practiced in Faerûn . Casters of this magic are called Selu ' taar , also known as the " Art ' s Disciples " or simply as " High Mages " . High Magic spells are powerful enough to affect deities or to create world - changing spell effects . Non - elves cannot cast High Magic as they are simply unable to wield such power without being consumed by it , and in truth even most elves are found lacking in the necessary finesse and skill . All High Magic spells are rituals , and they frequently require collaboration of more than one High Mage . In addition , the necessary material components and timing of High Magic can be very specific . For example , in 1375 DR a priest of Vhaeraun used a High Magic spell to open the realm of Eilistraee to Vhaeraun , in order that he might slay her . The components for this mighty ritual included a certain specific configuration of heavenly bodies existing in the skies of Faerûn .

title: Elven language
description: Elven language Elven ( commonly called Elvish and sometimes referred to as the True Tongue ) was the language ( or language family ) of the " Tel ’ Quessir " ( " e . g . " , eladrin , elves , and drow ) .
description_long: Elven language Elven ( commonly called Elvish and sometimes referred to as the True Tongue ) was the language ( or language family ) of the " Tel ’ Quessir " ( " e . g . " , eladrin , elves , and drow ) . Its script was known as Espruar .

title: Elvenblood Pass
description: Elvenblood Pass Elvenblood Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The High Trail ran through it to connect Procampur and Ravens Bluff . Description .
description_long: Elvenblood Pass Elvenblood Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The High Trail ran through it to connect Procampur and Ravens Bluff . Description . Elvenblood Pass was a rugged mountain pass , crossed by over a dozen narrow ravines , each thick with trees . Rockfalls were a frequent hazard , and it had many spots for ambushes and deliberate rockfalls . The pass was also haunted by a variety of predators : from stirge s , wyvern s , and other mountain - dwelling predators on the hunt ; to two - legged threats like orc s and bandits . The bandits and most of the flightless creatures dwelled in the forested ravines . Usage . Despite its dangerous reputation , Elvenblood Pass was heavily used , more so than the longer , safer Glorming Pass in the east . History . During the reign of King Glaurath the Great of Westgate ( −301 – −291 DR ) , thieves stole the royal treasury of Westgate and fled by ship to the Vast . They anchored at the spot where the city of Procampur would later lie , and went up into the Earthfast Mountains .

title: Elventree
description: Elventree Elventree was a sylvan community in the West Branch of the Moonsea in the forest of Cormanthor . Structure . Elventree had been built up with wood on ruins of stone buildings .
description_long: Elventree Elventree was a sylvan community in the West Branch of the Moonsea in the forest of Cormanthor . Structure . Elventree had been built up with wood on ruins of stone buildings . There was an elegant but natural - looking palace . There were also a number of structures in the trees which were linked by bridges of silver rope and white planks . History . Elventree was established in 702 DR . It became a haven for half - elves , ranger s , artists , druid s , and alter an outpost for the Harpers . Government . Elventree had no formal leadership and no formal laws , but nevertheless the inhabitants were able to live in harmony with each other and with the land . The office of the Herald was also known as Moonsilver . Elanil Elassidil held this position in 1367 DR . In 1372 DR , the half - elf Dessaer was called the Lord of Elventree . Trade . Elventree was home to a number of fine bowyers and fletchers , as well as wood carvers . Elventree also produced herbs , medicinal plants , exotic fruit , and tapestries . It imported swords , armor , parchment , wine , and seafood . Elventree was not on a caravan route and there were no trading houses .

title: Elverquisst
description: Elverquisst Elverquisst was a variety of elven spirit . Description . Elverquisst was ruby colored , " distilled from sunshine and rare summer fruits .
description_long: Elverquisst Elverquisst was a variety of elven spirit . Description . Elverquisst was ruby colored , " distilled from sunshine and rare summer fruits . " It was smooth but flecked with gold . It was generally stored in bottles made of transparent crystal , capable of absorbing light . Upon speaking a specific phrase in Elvish , the light gathered into thirteen distinct points that resembled the constellation Correlian . Elverquisst was highly prized by elves , especially in autumn . A ritual was involved in drinking Elverquisst . The ritual involved a chant , pouring the liquid into a goblet , swirling it around , sharing it with others , and offering a ritual bow of the head in thanks . Availability . The House of Good Spirits was one of the few places in Waterdeep where one could obtain elverquisst . It was also available in Elturel ' s famous tavern A Pair of Black Antlers , where it was the most expensive drink on offer .

title: Elveswatch
description: Elveswatch Elveswatch was a small city located in the Forests of Amtar in Dambrath . Geopgraphy . The city was located along the southeastern fringes of the great forest .
description_long: Elveswatch Elveswatch was a small city located in the Forests of Amtar in Dambrath . Geopgraphy . The city was located along the southeastern fringes of the great forest . Elveswatch experienced more rainfall than any other settlement in Dambrath . Activities . Most of the famed bluewood of Amtar moved through Elveswatch on its way to the rest of Dambrath . The people of the city had to remain vigilant for the attacks from the elves who lived in the forest . The elves hoped that their attacks would dissuade deforestation , but the attacks did not hinder the bluewood enterprise . Armed Forces . Elveswatch boasted a fighting force of 1 , 000 infantrymen , 500 cavalry , and 500 gnoll mercenaries . Inhabitants . Five thousand transients populated Elveswatch . The chance of killing surface elves brought many drow to the city , more so than any other city in Dambrath . Because of this , Lolth , and not Loviatar had the primary temple within the city .

title: Elvran Torchtower
description: Elvran Torchtower Elvran Torchtower was a human noble from Cormyr . Relationships . He was from the noble house of Torchtower .
description_long: Elvran Torchtower Elvran Torchtower was a human noble from Cormyr . Relationships . He was from the noble house of Torchtower . Description . Elvran was described as tall and quiet . History . Around 1371 DR , Elvran served with the Purple Dragons as a " Lionar " and showed a lot of potential . It was speculated that he could have become one of the youngest battlemaster s of Cormyr .

title: Elysium
description: Elysium Elysium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane embodying the concept of pure good without being overly restricted by law nor dissipated by the randomness of chaos . Some characteristics of this plane where ascribed to Heliopolis and the House of Nature in the World Tree cosmology model when that cosmology became popular . Heliopolis was essentially destroyed in the Spellplague and the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model .
description_long: Elysium Elysium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane embodying the concept of pure good without being overly restricted by law nor dissipated by the randomness of chaos . Some characteristics of this plane where ascribed to Heliopolis and the House of Nature in the World Tree cosmology model when that cosmology became popular . Heliopolis was essentially destroyed in the Spellplague and the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model . Description . Most features of the four layers of Elysium were found on or near the banks of the river Oceanus which linked the plane with two other Upper planes : Happy Hunting Grounds / Beastlands and Olympus / Arvandor . Oceanus was the counterpart to the river Styx which flowed through the Lower planes except that Oceanus had only natural hazards and contained potable water . Lands near the riverbanks were lush with pines and flowering trees that filled the air with natural perfume .

title: Elytharra Dinnesmore
description: Elytharra Dinnesmore Elytharra Dinnesmore was a half - elf woman and an enchantress from Neverwinter . History . Elytharra met Ulbrec Dinnesmore , who was in the guard at the time .
description_long: Elytharra Dinnesmore Elytharra Dinnesmore was a half - elf woman and an enchantress from Neverwinter . History . Elytharra met Ulbrec Dinnesmore , who was in the guard at the time . They eventually married , and when he retired , moved to Targos , where Ulbrec took up a seat on the council .

title: Embassy of Procampur
description: Embassy of Procampur The Embassy of Procampur was an embassy of the city of Procampur located in the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . Description . The embassy was found at the south end of the Foreign District in Ravens Bluff , where a looping side - lane provided access .
description_long: Embassy of Procampur The Embassy of Procampur was an embassy of the city of Procampur located in the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . Description . The embassy was found at the south end of the Foreign District in Ravens Bluff , where a looping side - lane provided access . It was surrounded by a wooded garden illuminated by lamps of ruby and emerald colors on dry evenings , in which visitors could wander freely . Activities . The Embassy of Procampur held frequent parties all through the year , drawing a large number of visitors and guests . These were mainly merchant s and veteran adventurer s considering moving to Procampur . They often explored the gardens , talked , and made various deals .

title: Embattlement
description: Embattlement Embattlement was a divine abjuration spell that made it more difficult to successfully attack the caster . History . The " embattlement " spell appeared within the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the church of Ilmater , which first appeared in the Realms in 848 DR .
description_long: Embattlement Embattlement was a divine abjuration spell that made it more difficult to successfully attack the caster . History . The " embattlement " spell appeared within the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the church of Ilmater , which first appeared in the Realms in 848 DR .

title: Embrae Aloevan
description: Embrae Aloevan Queen Embrae Aloevan was a moon elf Chosen of both Mystra and Sehanine . History . In the Year of Frostfires ( 292 DR ) , Aloevan became a chosen of Mystra and Sehanine .
description_long: Embrae Aloevan Queen Embrae Aloevan was a moon elf Chosen of both Mystra and Sehanine . History . In the Year of Frostfires ( 292 DR ) , Aloevan became a chosen of Mystra and Sehanine . However , just a few years later in 308 DR she was consumed by the silver fire s of Mystra and descended into madness and death creating what is now known as the Tears of Aloevan . Tears of Aloevan . Inside the Ardeep Forest lies the Tears of Aloevan , accessible by a mystical pool created by the death of Aloevan . As a Chosen of Mystra , she was constantly exposed to the silver fire granted by being a Chosen . Unfortunately , in 308 DR , this same gift would come to consume her with madness and cause her death . But instead of moving on to Arvanaith , she was trapped in a nimbus of silver fire . Some time later , cleric s of Sehanine realized her situation and seven of them created a link between the Pocket Plane where she was caught and the natural world . In the centuries since , priests of Sehanine have been working tirelessly to prevent the madness from taking over the queen completely . To accomplish this , priests have recreated the long lost Court of Silver Fire where she now resides .

title: Embrus Obarskyr
description: Embrus Obarskyr Embrus " the Old " was so named because even though he was only the second son of Faerlthann Obarskyr , he was the sixth king of Cormyr after his father for some reason declared him to be last in the line of succession , and was a ripe 49 years old when he took the throne in 79 DR after his younger brother Rhiiman died without an heir . Relationships . Embrus had two sons , both born before his coronation , Kaspler and Imbre to ensure the continuation of his line in the wake of three consecutive heirless kings .
description_long: Embrus Obarskyr Embrus " the Old " was so named because even though he was only the second son of Faerlthann Obarskyr , he was the sixth king of Cormyr after his father for some reason declared him to be last in the line of succession , and was a ripe 49 years old when he took the throne in 79 DR after his younger brother Rhiiman died without an heir . Relationships . Embrus had two sons , both born before his coronation , Kaspler and Imbre to ensure the continuation of his line in the wake of three consecutive heirless kings .

title: Embryn Crownsilver
description: Embryn Crownsilver Embryn Crownsilver was a member of the Crownsilver noble house of Cormyr . History . In 1369 DR , Embryn pledged allegiance to Vangerdahast as the Regent of Cormyr .
description_long: Embryn Crownsilver Embryn Crownsilver was a member of the Crownsilver noble house of Cormyr . History . In 1369 DR , Embryn pledged allegiance to Vangerdahast as the Regent of Cormyr . Description . Embryn wore a jeweled tunic with a pair of breeches , and a half - cloak . Possessions . Embryn possessed a jeweled blade .

title: Emelyn
description: Emelyn Emelyn , called the Gray , was a human wizard around 1368 DR . Appearance . Emelyn wore satin gray robes .
description_long: Emelyn Emelyn , called the Gray , was a human wizard around 1368 DR . Appearance . Emelyn wore satin gray robes . His long hair was white and often unkempt , and it hung down his shoulders . Magic . Emelyn was an archmage and personal friend of King Gareth Dragonsbane . As a magic user of considerable power Emelyn was capable of teleporting great distances across the width and breadth of Vaasa and Damara . One of his magical abilities was to polymorph into a bird to cover distances at fast speed . Background . Emelyn lived in Warrenwood , southeast of Bloodstone Village , together with centaur s .

title: Emerald
description: Emerald Emerald was a brilliant green variety of found in the Realms . Description . Emerald cleaved easily along orthogonal lines , making rectangular cuts ( the " emerald " cut , known as a modified step cut in lapidary parlance ) the most common form for this jewel .
description_long: Emerald Emerald was a brilliant green variety of found in the Realms . Description . Emerald cleaved easily along orthogonal lines , making rectangular cuts ( the " emerald " cut , known as a modified step cut in lapidary parlance ) the most common form for this jewel . This included table facet ( square ) and baguette ( long rectangular ) cuts . Emerald came in many shades , but only the most transparent brilliant green shade merited the highest prices . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp . Emeralds with weak or tainted coloring were classified as gem stones with base value of 1 , 000 gp . Emeralds in the post - Second Sundering years declined in value to where even the most desired shades were given a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Powers . Emeralds were associated with health , and so were used in creating and decorating magical devices which improved health and healing , fertility , and growth . Whole cut emeralds served well as the tip of a wand or other devices that had health and growth effects . Crushed and powdered , emerald dust was used in the inks for scrolls and added to magical immersions for items intended for these same purposes .

title: Emerald Brotherhood
description: Emerald Brotherhood The Emerald Brotherhood was a mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Emerald Brotherhood was originally an adventuring party operating in Amn , Tethyr , the Thornwood , and the Snowflake Mountains until they were taken into wildspace by mind flayer slavers .
description_long: Emerald Brotherhood The Emerald Brotherhood was a mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Emerald Brotherhood was originally an adventuring party operating in Amn , Tethyr , the Thornwood , and the Snowflake Mountains until they were taken into wildspace by mind flayer slavers . There they focused on destroying the mind flayers as well as the neogi .

title: Emerald Enclave
description: Emerald Enclave The Emerald Enclave was an organization of druid s and other nature worshipers on the island of Ilighôn . The actions of the Enclave influenced the lives of the high and low , its members avoiding good and evil to focus on the needs of the natural world and resist the growing influence of humankind . Despite their primary goal of preserving nature , members were not direct opponents of progress ; they preferred instead to work with civilized folk to promote the health of the natural world without resorting to acts of violence .
description_long: Emerald Enclave The Emerald Enclave was an organization of druid s and other nature worshipers on the island of Ilighôn . The actions of the Enclave influenced the lives of the high and low , its members avoiding good and evil to focus on the needs of the natural world and resist the growing influence of humankind . Despite their primary goal of preserving nature , members were not direct opponents of progress ; they preferred instead to work with civilized folk to promote the health of the natural world without resorting to acts of violence . After the Spellplague hit , and with their island becoming part of the Turmish mainland due to the receding waters of the Sea of Fallen Stars , the organization became perverted and xenophobic , bent on destroying all forms and manifestations of the Spellplague . Dogma . The original aims of the Enclave were six - fold : The Emerald Enclave of the post - Spellplague era believed that the natural order had to be respected and preserved , and that forces that would upset that natural order should be destroyed . They were also to keep elemental forces in check , and prevent the wilderness and civilization from wiping out one another .

title: Emerald burst
