description: Emerald burst Emerald burst is an evocation spell that turns an emerald into a grenadelike weapon . Effect . You infuse an emerald with magical power and it flies toward your enemies .
description_long: Emerald burst Emerald burst is an evocation spell that turns an emerald into a grenadelike weapon . Effect . You infuse an emerald with magical power and it flies toward your enemies . The gemstone explodes on impact , releasing a coruscating pulse of green light . Neutral creatures within the burst are dazed for six seconds . Evil creatures within the burst are stunned for up to 24 seconds . Good creatures within the burst are unaffected . Material component . The spell requires an emerald worth at least 1 , 000 gp .

title: Emerald dragon
description: Emerald dragon Emerald dragons were gem dragon s who were inquisitive and often more knowledgeable than most sages . Personality . They tended to be paranoid and distrustful of visitors , and their lairs often had many traps .
description_long: Emerald dragon Emerald dragons were gem dragon s who were inquisitive and often more knowledgeable than most sages . Personality . They tended to be paranoid and distrustful of visitors , and their lairs often had many traps . Combat . Emerald dragons could breath a cone of sonic energy . They might also generate a cloud of fog to blind opponents . Society . Emerald dragons preferred to live underground in areas close to civilization , although they seldom made their presence known , making cones of inactive volcanoes the favored spot for their lairs .

title: Emerus
description: Emerus King Emerus Warcrown of Citadel Felbarr was one of the Members of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Since 1367 DR he sought to rebuild the " once - glorious city of Felbarr " ; despite this , the Citadel was still very vulnerable . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p61 " > < / ref > In the second month of 1486 DR , King Emerus abdicated his throne and title to Parson Glaive to join on the march to reclaim Gauntlgrym .
description_long: Emerus King Emerus Warcrown of Citadel Felbarr was one of the Members of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Since 1367 DR he sought to rebuild the " once - glorious city of Felbarr " ; despite this , the Citadel was still very vulnerable . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p61 " > < / ref > In the second month of 1486 DR , King Emerus abdicated his throne and title to Parson Glaive to join on the march to reclaim Gauntlgrym . Later that year , Emerus Warcrown died and was named the 2nd King of Gauntlgrym . Emerus drew the runes on the doors and doorframe of the Rune Gate . < / nowiki > Description . Emerus was a fit and muscular shield dwarf with flaxen beard and scar from above the right eye thru his cheek ending at is right ear . He received the scar in the battle to recover Citadel Felbarr . In 1463 , he was more than 200 years old but he had the sort of physique that would " make a fifty - year - old jealous . "

title: Emi Towiki
description: Emi Towiki Emi Towiki was a maiden butterfly in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Towiki was a kitchen worker at the Ito family ' s castle .
description_long: Emi Towiki Emi Towiki was a maiden butterfly in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Towiki was a kitchen worker at the Ito family ' s castle . She fell in love with Ajimo Heikaru , the first son of the family ' s warlord . However , distracted by his love , Heikaru was negligent in rallying the clan ' s army when needed in 647 DR . So a curse transformed him into a wererat condemned to guard his lover ' s room for eternity , while she was turned into a butterfly . At last , in 1360 DR , an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed Heikaru . Afterward , Towiki met them , telling them information about the swords and later disappeared .

title: Emilo Haversack
description: Emilo Haversack Emilo Haversack was a kender from the world of Krynn . History . In 1368 DR , Emilo met Joel the Rebel Bard and Jasmine of Westgate , a former Krynn Spelljammer , after being gated to Sigil .
description_long: Emilo Haversack Emilo Haversack was a kender from the world of Krynn . History . In 1368 DR , Emilo met Joel the Rebel Bard and Jasmine of Westgate , a former Krynn Spelljammer , after being gated to Sigil . Physical description . He had pointed ears and his hair was drawn up into a topknot . His brown hair was streaked with gray .

title: Eminence of Araunt
description: Eminence of Araunt The Eminence of Araunt was a relatively new power in Toril . Brought to the world on the planeshifted continent of Returned Abeir , The Eminence viewed itself as the de facto ruler of all undead across Toril . Organization .
description_long: Eminence of Araunt The Eminence of Araunt was a relatively new power in Toril . Brought to the world on the planeshifted continent of Returned Abeir , The Eminence viewed itself as the de facto ruler of all undead across Toril . Organization . The organization ' s headquarters were located in the catacombs of Nornglast in Eskorn . The region had a reputation for being haunted , and the Eminence used those stories to cover its activities . The Eminence believed that all its members were equals , but a few ones had higher positions than others . While the organization was primarily made up by undead , it also employed a limited number of living allies , which it used as spies and traders to procure the exotic components required for the Eminence ' s ritual s . Most of Araunt ' s " citizens " were specter s and ghost s , called up by the Eminence ' s rituals . Both direhelm s and doomsept s were undead formed of several spirits , created to defend the Eminence ' s " principalities " . Araunt was hostile to all other cults and kingdoms of the undead , including Thay .

title: Emlar Goldsword
description: Emlar Goldsword Emlar Goldsword was a rogue fighter and a member of House Goldsword of Cormyr . Elmar was a bald man . He was loyal to Cormyr but not to the Obarskyr s .
description_long: Emlar Goldsword Emlar Goldsword was a rogue fighter and a member of House Goldsword of Cormyr . Elmar was a bald man . He was loyal to Cormyr but not to the Obarskyr s . In fact , he cleaved to Sembia and hated and feared the Obarksyrs . He preferred rule by a merchant council , but was too cowardly and too wise to actively rebel .

title: Emmer Jundhyl
description: Emmer Jundhyl Emmer Jundhyl was an Illuskan human and a member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , holding the position of watch civilar for the North Ward . Personality . The watch captain was hefty and outgoing .
description_long: Emmer Jundhyl Emmer Jundhyl was an Illuskan human and a member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , holding the position of watch civilar for the North Ward . Personality . The watch captain was hefty and outgoing . Always one to show off his great big grin , Emmer had a particularly boisterous and hearty laugh . Relationships . Emmer was good friends with Regnet Amcathra and Scirkhel Wands . History . In 1372 DR , Emmer was supplanted by the doppelganger Fengharl of the Unseen . At the time , no noticed the change and the real Emmer ' s whereabouts were unknown .

title: Emmergluth
description: Emmergluth Emmergluth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a .
description_long: Emmergluth Emmergluth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a . shadowmaster ) at large in Toril as of the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . As a shapeshifter , Emmergluth could appear as any living thing , but usually appeared as male . When not trying to blend into Faerûn ian society , his favorite guises were as a wraith or as a crimson death ( an amorphous cloud of red mist with a human - like head and arms ) . Personality . Emmergluth was a craven sycophant , befriending other shadowmasters more dominating than himself . He had an uncanny knack for joining the losing faction . Activities . Emmergluth perpetually chose to follow other shadowmasters who were ambitious but often foolhardy . He would serve them until their machinations for grasping power among the malaugrym led to their defeat and then he would flee . Because of this , he frequently went into hiding from his own kin . Rumors and Legends .

title: Emotion
description: Emotion Emotion , also known as emotion control , was an alteration and / or enchantment / charm spell that aroused strong emotions in one or more creatures . There were divine and arcane versions of this spell . Effects .
description_long: Emotion Emotion , also known as emotion control , was an alteration and / or enchantment / charm spell that aroused strong emotions in one or more creatures . There were divine and arcane versions of this spell . Effects . The arcane version of this spell was generally called " emotion " and affected one or more creatures in an area designated by the caster . The divine version was known as " emotion control " and operated very similarly to the arcane version , but could also be used defensively to shield the caster ' s true emotions from detection and manipulation . The alteration / enchantment versions affected a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) cube , in which the arcane version targeted all creatures in the region , whereas the number of creatures was limited by the level of the priest for the divine version . The illusionist version covered a 40 ft ( 12 m ) square area but had fewer options ( see below ) . The divine version lasted at least five minutes ; more for higher level casters . The arcane and illusionist versions all lasted for as long as the caster concentrated on keeping the emotional state heightened .

title: Emperel Ruousk
description: Emperel Ruousk Emperel Ruousk was a member of the Purple Dragons and the guardian of the Lords Who Sleep . He was killed by the ghazneth Xanthon Cormaeril while investigating a series of murders . Possessions .
description_long: Emperel Ruousk Emperel Ruousk was a member of the Purple Dragons and the guardian of the Lords Who Sleep . He was killed by the ghazneth Xanthon Cormaeril while investigating a series of murders . Possessions . Emperel was equipped with a weathercloak , a magical dagger , a magical ring that emitted light , and magical gauntlets that shot King ' s Bolts . Unfortunately , none of these items were of any use against the ghazneth .

title: Emperor ' s Quarters
description: Emperor ' s Quarters The Emperor ' s Quarters served as the palace of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne in the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Location . The Emperor ' s Quarters made - up a a full quarter of the size of the capital city of Nathong .
description_long: Emperor ' s Quarters The Emperor ' s Quarters served as the palace of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne in the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Location . The Emperor ' s Quarters made - up a a full quarter of the size of the capital city of Nathong . Description . Since yak - folk cities resembled large buildings compared to the traditional layout of most cities found on Toril , the Emperor ' s Quarters was actually just a large chunk of the city as a whole . Thousands of dwarven slaves toiled to enhance the beauty of that area of the city and display the Emperor ' s wealth .

title: Emperor of the Lotus Throne
description: Emperor of the Lotus Throne The Emperor of the Lotus Throne , also called the Lotus Emperor , was the traditional head of the Lotus Court and ruler of the Yikarian Empire . Activities . The Emperor not only ruled the vast Empire , but also served as the High Priest of the Faceless God — the only deity worshiped by the yak - folk .
description_long: Emperor of the Lotus Throne The Emperor of the Lotus Throne , also called the Lotus Emperor , was the traditional head of the Lotus Court and ruler of the Yikarian Empire . Activities . The Emperor not only ruled the vast Empire , but also served as the High Priest of the Faceless God — the only deity worshiped by the yak - folk . The Emperor himself was even sacrificed to his god after 20 years of serving as the Emperor . Traditionally , a younger yak - man was chosen by the Faceless God for this position .

title: Empires of the Alamber Sea
description: Empires of the Alamber Sea The Empires of the Alamber Sea was a collective term used in the late 14th century and through most of the 15th century DR to describe the empires of High Imaskar and Okoth . Although not technically an empire , people also usually associated the nation of Tymanther with this term as well .
description_long: Empires of the Alamber Sea The Empires of the Alamber Sea was a collective term used in the late 14th century and through most of the 15th century DR to describe the empires of High Imaskar and Okoth . Although not technically an empire , people also usually associated the nation of Tymanther with this term as well .

title: Empowerment candle
description: Empowerment candle An empowerment candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It increased spellcasting and weapon effectiveness to their greatest potential . Description .
description_long: Empowerment candle An empowerment candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It increased spellcasting and weapon effectiveness to their greatest potential . Description . " Empowerment candles " were silver in color and intended to be burned in ten - minute intervals . The longest - lasting candle that could be created burned for ninety minutes . For neutral mystics , this was the seventh type of candle they learned to make when studying candle magic . Good and evil mystics could learn to make this candle after they reached a sufficiently high level . Powers . After burning for the desired amount of time and then being extinguished ( either by blowing , snuffing , dousing , or reaching the end of its wick ) , this candle granted the subject maximum proficiency in spellcasting ability similar to a brick of " incense of meditation " . Both divine and arcane spellcasters could make use of this candle . Empowered recipients were able to achieve the maximum range , area , duration , damage , " etc . " when casting spells for one hour for each ten - minute interval the candle was lit .

title: Empty - Scabbard Killers
description: Empty - Scabbard Killers The Empty - Scabbard Killers , or Forak - Erach - Naek in an obscure dwarvish dialect , were a legendary order of duergar psionic assassins in Gracklstugh , whom common people believed to be mythical . They were one of the most feared groups in the Underdark . They practiced disciplines unknown to even the savviest derro or the wisest priest .
description_long: Empty - Scabbard Killers The Empty - Scabbard Killers , or Forak - Erach - Naek in an obscure dwarvish dialect , were a legendary order of duergar psionic assassins in Gracklstugh , whom common people believed to be mythical . They were one of the most feared groups in the Underdark . They practiced disciplines unknown to even the savviest derro or the wisest priest . More than a myth , these killers had been plying their trade for centuries , their motives unknown and their methods inscrutable . Members . Members were often assassin s and soulknives , who could manifest a blade of psychic energy , hence the name " empty scabbard " . Operations . Empty - Scabbard Killers patrolled the streets of Gracklstugh searching for psionically gifted children to abduct and train . They even recruited gifted " calassabrak " ( a kind of duergar outlaw shunned by other duergar ) . They usually conducted deadly missions for a select few personalities of the city , such as Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V . However , they would work and kill for anyone who had the gold . Base . The headquarters of the Forak - Erach - Naek was a well - guarded secret .

title: Empyreal ecstasy
description: Empyreal ecstasy Empyreal ecstasy is an abjuration spell that immunizes targets to pain and , and halves damage taken . Unfortunately , it also reduces skill modifiers . Effect .
description_long: Empyreal ecstasy Empyreal ecstasy is an abjuration spell that immunizes targets to pain and , and halves damage taken . Unfortunately , it also reduces skill modifiers . Effect . Like the " ease pain " spell , " empyreal ecstasy " immediately removes any lingering effects of pain , including penalties imposed by " symbol of pain " , " angry ache " , and similar spells . It neither prevents damage nor blocks other effects not directly related to pain ( such as the " recall agony " or " recall pain " psionic powers ) . The spell also induces a pleasurable fugue - like state that yields a number of additional effects : First , " empyreal ecstasy " renders its targets immune to mind - affecting spells and effects for the spell ' s duration , but does not negate mind - influencing effects already in place . Second , targets of the spell take only half damage from all melee and ranged attacks for the duration of the spell . Third , the fugue - like state induced by the spell makes it difficult for targets to concentrate on certain tasks .

title: Emryn Dawe
description: Emryn Dawe Emryn Dawe was a Harper based in Luskan in 1485 DR . History . She was contacted by a fellow Harper named Aarun from the Ten Towns .
description_long: Emryn Dawe Emryn Dawe was a Harper based in Luskan in 1485 DR . History . She was contacted by a fellow Harper named Aarun from the Ten Towns . He required silver weapons to use against a wererat . She managed to send the weapons to him with a caravan . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Although she was a secondary character , she was somehow involved with the arrival of the adventurers in the dale . The adventure started the day the caravan arrived in Bryn Shander .

title: Emrys
description: Emrys Emrys was a Netherese arcanist and a friend of Tarchamus the Unyielding . Approximately 5 , 000 years before the present ( 1479 DR ) , Tarchamus destroyed the Netherese floating city of Tenish using his volcano spell . After the destruction of Tenish , Emrys convinced the most powerful Netherese arcanists to block Tarchamus ' access to the Weave , which must have required the intercession of Mystryl .
description_long: Emrys Emrys was a Netherese arcanist and a friend of Tarchamus the Unyielding . Approximately 5 , 000 years before the present ( 1479 DR ) , Tarchamus destroyed the Netherese floating city of Tenish using his volcano spell . After the destruction of Tenish , Emrys convinced the most powerful Netherese arcanists to block Tarchamus ' access to the Weave , which must have required the intercession of Mystryl . Years after Tarchamus built his library , Emrys realized it was intended as a trap for Tarchamus ' rivals . Emrys entered the library and placed many wards on the structure to make it impossible to scry and thus extremely difficult for anyone to locate . He removed the volcano scroll from the pedestal on which Tarchamus had placed it and hid it away in a secret room . Emrys met his end when he set off a poisoned arrow trap . His ghost haunted the library for millennia , though he was much less malevolent than the ghosts of Tarchamus ' apprentices .

title: Emthrara Undril
description: Emthrara Undril Emthrara Undril was a female human Harper who worked as a dancer at The Laughing Lass tavern in Suzail to maintain her cover . Appearance . Emthrara was beautiful with long blonde hair .
description_long: Emthrara Undril Emthrara Undril was a female human Harper who worked as a dancer at The Laughing Lass tavern in Suzail to maintain her cover . Appearance . Emthrara was beautiful with long blonde hair . Background . Emthrara once defeated and took apart a clockwork horror , so she was called by Laspeera Inthré to help analyze the remains of the abraxus during the abraxus affair in 1369 DR . Possessions . Emthrara wore a silver locket around her neck that contained a tiny silver harp , the sign of a Harper . Personality . Emthrara was proud of the fact that she had met Elminster and he paid her a compliment about her dancing .

title: Encephalithid
description: Encephalithid The Encephalithid was the elder brain of Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Personality . The Encephalithid did not have absolute authority over the community ; instead , it led the Elder Concord and had an active role in the governing of the community .
description_long: Encephalithid The Encephalithid was the elder brain of Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Personality . The Encephalithid did not have absolute authority over the community ; instead , it led the Elder Concord and had an active role in the governing of the community . Its psionic power s were at a level unmatched by any other non - divine being in the Realms . History . The Encephalithid had lived for millennia . During the Time of Troubles , Ilsensine manifested and used the Encephalithid as its avatar . After that occasion , the Encephalithid retained the pair of tentacles commonly associated with the avatar form of the Tentacled Lord .

title: Encrypt
description: Encrypt Encrypt was an arcane illusion spell that permanently obscured a short written message from all eyes except a chosen few . Effects . The message was limited to 66 letters or characters ( spaces were not counted ) but could appear on any non - liquid surface such as paper , wood , stone , glass , sand , soot , or snow up to 80 ft ( 24 m ) away , and even farther for more experienced casters .
description_long: Encrypt Encrypt was an arcane illusion spell that permanently obscured a short written message from all eyes except a chosen few . Effects . The message was limited to 66 letters or characters ( spaces were not counted ) but could appear on any non - liquid surface such as paper , wood , stone , glass , sand , soot , or snow up to 80 ft ( 24 m ) away , and even farther for more experienced casters . The caster and one other person named during the casting of " encrypt " could read the message , as well as any persons specifically named in the body of the message . All other beings viewing the enchanted area found it to be illegible ; smeared and distorted beyond comprehension . The message could not be a spell or any other magical writing , but any non - magical text could be created in any language the caster knew . The medium used to hold the message gave off a magic aura that could be detected , but " encrypt " foiled all magical attempts to read the message ( " read magic " , " comprehend languages " , etc . ) except for " true seeing " . The message could be created by the caster at the time of casting , or could be a note written previously by anyone .

title: End ' s Rest
description: End ' s Rest End ' s Rest was a college for healer s located in the city of Heliogabalus in Damara around 1374 DR . The college was managed by a group of worshipers of Ilmater . These healers tended to the city ' s defenders , including paladin s and recruits , as well as the sick and injured of the community and pregnant women .
description_long: End ' s Rest End ' s Rest was a college for healer s located in the city of Heliogabalus in Damara around 1374 DR . The college was managed by a group of worshipers of Ilmater . These healers tended to the city ' s defenders , including paladin s and recruits , as well as the sick and injured of the community and pregnant women .

title: End to strife
description: End to strife End to strife is an enchantment spell that causes anyone who attacks in the spell ' s area of effect to take damage . Effect . This spell creates an invisible aura of divine power around the caster .
description_long: End to strife End to strife is an enchantment spell that causes anyone who attacks in the spell ' s area of effect to take damage . Effect . This spell creates an invisible aura of divine power around the caster . All intelligent creatures within the spell ' s area suddenly become aware that any hostile actions they take will be met with dire consequences . Any creature in the spell ' s area that makes an attack takes incredible damage . The caster decides whether the spell deals lethal or nonlethal damage but cannot change her mind once the spell is cast . Creatures with multiple attacks take the damage after every attack they make . Targets outside the area of the spell may freely attack creatures in the area without taking damage from this spell .

title: Enda Yate
description: Enda Yate Enda Yate was a halfling rogue in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , having heard about a ruby - eyed - statue somewhere inside Undermountain , Enda agreed to join the doomed Rutherford Urmbrusk ' s party .
description_long: Enda Yate Enda Yate was a halfling rogue in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , having heard about a ruby - eyed - statue somewhere inside Undermountain , Enda agreed to join the doomed Rutherford Urmbrusk ' s party . When Rutherford disappeared , the halfling abandoned her companions in search of the statue , discovering the statue ' s general location . So Enda went back to the surface and recruited a large number of ruffians to help her in her treasure hunt . So , leading a large group , Enda ventured back into the dungeon . However they met a large tribe of lizardfolk followers of Sess ' innek and in the fighting most of the Enda ' s fellows were killed or captured . Enda herself and a few of her ruffians hid in a room , praying for their lives with only Enda without any great injures .

title: Endarthar
description: Endarthar Endarthar was in wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . Personality . Endarthar was a brilliant spellcaster possessed of a fierce temper .
description_long: Endarthar Endarthar was in wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . Personality . Endarthar was a brilliant spellcaster possessed of a fierce temper . Activities . After fleeing Tethyr , Endarthar defeated the wizard Orthaerus Manycloaks and took his mansion as his own . He spent most of his time developing new spells and creating servants including griffon s , umber hulk s , and a few oozes and jellies . History . Endarthar once aided the crown of Tethyr with his magic before civil war ravaged that land . Rumors and Legends . The ghost of Orthaerus still haunted Wildwoods , tormenting Endarthar at any opportunity since the deceased wizard could still cast spells .

title: Endless Caverns
description: Endless Caverns The Endless Caverns were a series of deep - reaching cavern and tunnel complexes located to the south of the Star Mounts . Inside the Endless Caverns lived many powerful and dangerous creatures , such as Grimnoshtasdrano , the Riddling Dragon , and the lich Aumvor The Undying .
description_long: Endless Caverns The Endless Caverns were a series of deep - reaching cavern and tunnel complexes located to the south of the Star Mounts . Inside the Endless Caverns lived many powerful and dangerous creatures , such as Grimnoshtasdrano , the Riddling Dragon , and the lich Aumvor The Undying .

title: Endless Ice Sea
description: Endless Ice Sea The Endless Ice Sea was an enormous glacier north of the Spine of the World believed to house hidden treasure troves and magic . Geography . The Endless Ice Sea was located to the east of Reghed Glacier and a frozen wasteland .
description_long: Endless Ice Sea The Endless Ice Sea was an enormous glacier north of the Spine of the World believed to house hidden treasure troves and magic . Geography . The Endless Ice Sea was located to the east of Reghed Glacier and a frozen wasteland . To the south it was lined by the Spine of the World . The western edge of the glacier approximately lined up with Lurkwood and the Valley of Khedrun to the south .

title: Endless Revels of Life
description: Endless Revels of Life The Endless Revels of Life are holy days for the followers of Sharess . These revelries are celebrated on Midwinter , Midsummer , the vernal equinox , Highharvestide , the Feast of the Moon , the winter solstice , and every full moon . The most important of these events is the Midsummer revelry .
description_long: Endless Revels of Life The Endless Revels of Life are holy days for the followers of Sharess . These revelries are celebrated on Midwinter , Midsummer , the vernal equinox , Highharvestide , the Feast of the Moon , the winter solstice , and every full moon . The most important of these events is the Midsummer revelry .

title: Endra Mathlyn
description: Endra Mathlyn Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a priest ess of Helm and was High Guardian of the Tower of the Eye temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1367 DR . She had 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers .
description_long: Endra Mathlyn Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a priest ess of Helm and was High Guardian of the Tower of the Eye temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1367 DR . She had 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers .

title: Endrith Vallivoe
description: Endrith Vallivoe Endrith Vallivoe was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a contact of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The shopkeeper was a shy and scuttling little man .
description_long: Endrith Vallivoe Endrith Vallivoe was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a contact of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The shopkeeper was a shy and scuttling little man . He was an attentive watcher and listener and knew most of the village ' s rumors . He was a friend to the Harpers and was a useful and loyal informant for them . Activities . Endrith ran a shop in the village . History . Around 1491 DR , Endrith was a caravan leader in his youth until he retired to open a shop .

title: Endroth Knag
description: Endroth Knag Endroth Knag was an old member of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Every night after he finished his work in the Watch , Knag went to drink at the Yawning Portal tavern , pondering on unresolved cases .
description_long: Endroth Knag Endroth Knag was an old member of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Every night after he finished his work in the Watch , Knag went to drink at the Yawning Portal tavern , pondering on unresolved cases . History . Knag had been a member of the Watch for decades . His superiors in recent years pressured him to finally resign but Knag always refused . In 1479 DR , he was concerned with two mysteries : the disappearance of an entire team of the Cellarers & Plumbers ' Guild in the sewers without much blood around and the search for the notorious murderer Josephus Blaze . Personality . Knag hated mysteries . He never quit the Watch because he had to resolve all that he found .

title: Endurance domain
description: Endurance domain The Endurance domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters endurance spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Endurance Domain Powers .
description_long: Endurance domain The Endurance domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters endurance spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Endurance Domain Powers . Once per day , the cleric can supernaturally improve the overall health of his / her body for one minute .

title: Endurance of Ilmater
description: Endurance of Ilmater Endurance of Ilmater was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the necromantic and protection spheres , and by painbearer s , the specialty priests of Ilmater .
description_long: Endurance of Ilmater Endurance of Ilmater was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the necromantic and protection spheres , and by painbearer s , the specialty priests of Ilmater . Effect . The spell had several benefits for the health of the subject creature . It doubled the vitality of the creature , caused them to succeed in tests of strength and endurance , and allowed them to automatically overcome effects that attacked their health , such as disease and shock . Furthermore , the protected creature could never be knocked over by any means . History . " Endurance of Ilmater " was , of course , named for the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures .

title: Endure cold or heat
description: Endure cold or heat Endure cold / endure heat was an alteration spell that allowed a creature to withstand extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell was an improved version of the " resist cold " spell that allowed the caster to choose " endure cold " or " endure heat " at the time of casting .
description_long: Endure cold or heat Endure cold / endure heat was an alteration spell that allowed a creature to withstand extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell was an improved version of the " resist cold " spell that allowed the caster to choose " endure cold " or " endure heat " at the time of casting . The caster had to touch the creature in order to bestow this protection , and it prevented discomfort down to – 30° F ( – 34° C ) or up to 130° F ( 54° C ) . For every hour of exposure to temperatures below or above these extremes , this spell reduced the damage inflicted to the minimum possible damage for each degree ( 1° F or 0 . 56° C ) beyond the limit of the spell ' s protection . Any exposure to non - normal cold or heat ( spells , dragon breath , etc . ) immediately canceled this spell regardless which version was in effect . However , the act of cancellation absorbed a small amount of damage from the magical attack . The older version of this spell prevented all damage from the first contact with magical cold or heat and then was dispelled . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Endure elements
description: Endure elements Endure elements was an abjuration spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell lasted for 24 hours .
description_long: Endure elements Endure elements was an abjuration spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell lasted for 24 hours . The recipient and all they were wearing or carrying were insulated from cold or heat in the – 50° F to 140° F ( – 46° C to 60° C ) temperature range and instead perceived a comfortable temperature for the duration of the spell . " Endure elements " did not protect against magically generated weather , fire , cold - based attacks , smoke , suffocation , etc . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Energetic healing
description: Energetic healing Energetic healing is an conjuration spell that immunizes the target against a particular type of energy , and lets him regain 10 % of the would - be damage as healing . Effect . This spell converts magical energy damage into healing power .
description_long: Energetic healing Energetic healing is an conjuration spell that immunizes the target against a particular type of energy , and lets him regain 10 % of the would - be damage as healing . Effect . This spell converts magical energy damage into healing power . First , it renders the target immune to one energy type ( acid , cold , electricity , fire , or sonic ) specified when the spell is cast . Second , whenever the target is subjected to a magical attack of the selected energy type , he instead heals damage equal to 10 % of the damage dealt ( rounded down ) . For example , a creature protected by " energetic healing ( cold ) " that would normally take 35 cold damage from a " cone of cold " heals 3 points of damage instead . Once the spell heals a number of hit points equal to 2 per caster level ( maximum 30 ) , it is discharged . This spell does not convert nonmagical energy attacks ( such as damage from alchemist ' s fire ) into healing .

title: Energy drain
description: Energy drain Energy drain was a necromancy spell that could temporarily or permanently drain life energy levels from a creature . The older versions of this spell were the reverse of the necromantic " restoration " . Effects .
description_long: Energy drain Energy drain was a necromancy spell that could temporarily or permanently drain life energy levels from a creature . The older versions of this spell were the reverse of the necromantic " restoration " . Effects . The newer version of this spell was a ranged touch attack , whereas the older versions required a successful melee touch attack . The newer spell by this name was an improved version of " enervation " which could drain up to twice the number of life energy levels from a target and , if this didn ' t slay the creature outright , wracked the target for a whole day with all the ills that negative energy could produce : health loss , weakness , clumsiness , dulled senses , loss of combat prowess , loss of higher level spells , and increased susceptibility to just about everything . After this twenty - four hour period of life suppression , the victim had a chance to shake off the effects by matching its fortitude against the power of the spell , one negative level at a time . For each contest that was successful , the effects were removed . For each struggle that was unsuccessful , the effects were removed but a life experience level was lost .

title: Enervation
description: Enervation Enervation was a necromancy spell that severely weakened the subject . Effect . The caster pointed his finger and uttered the incantation , releasing a black bolt of crackling negative energy that suppressed the life force of any living creature it struck .
description_long: Enervation Enervation was a necromancy spell that severely weakened the subject . Effect . The caster pointed his finger and uttered the incantation , releasing a black bolt of crackling negative energy that suppressed the life force of any living creature it struck . The spell had a chance to kill its target or it could weaken the target ' s offensive capability , skills and spellcasting ability . Assuming the subject survived , he regained lost power after a number of hours . If the ray struck an undead creature , it temporarily increased the creature ' s un - lifeforce .

title: Enhance ability
description: Enhance ability Enhance ability was a transmutation spell that would enhance a targets abilities for up to a hour . Effect . The caster would pick an effect that would grant improvements to the target in a predetermined way : For every spell level higher then the normal spell level used , another target could gain a benefit of this spell .
description_long: Enhance ability Enhance ability was a transmutation spell that would enhance a targets abilities for up to a hour . Effect . The caster would pick an effect that would grant improvements to the target in a predetermined way : For every spell level higher then the normal spell level used , another target could gain a benefit of this spell . Components . Vocal and somatic components were needed , as well as a feather or fur from a beast .

title: Enhance fire creature
description: Enhance fire creature Enhance fire creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell toughened fire creatures .
description_long: Enhance fire creature Enhance fire creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell toughened fire creatures . This spell affected any creature from the Elemental Plane of Fire , creatures that could manipulate fire , and creatures that lived in fire . This spell did nothing for creatures that simply cast fire - based spells . Creatures affected by this spell had their attacks strengthened and were more resistant to damage . " Quench fire creature " was the reverse of this spell and had the exact opposite effect . Components . This spell required a rag seeped in pitch to cast .

title: Enhanen
description: Enhanen Enhanen was a mercenary recruiter in Arrabar . Activities . Enhanen usually recruited from his trusted veterans team , but newcomers were also welcome .
description_long: Enhanen Enhanen was a mercenary recruiter in Arrabar . Activities . Enhanen usually recruited from his trusted veterans team , but newcomers were also welcome . Thanks to a proven team of trusted messengers , he could gather 100 - 200 recruits in two days . History . During his youth , he often traveled with his company in search of glory . His views changed over the course of his life to where he saw it as just a job . In 1358 DR he together with the Company of the Singing Dawn and the Llandrydd ' s Steel faced the undead army of the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric .

title: Enixtryx
description: Enixtryx Enitryx was a black dragon and a member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . He was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent after Amnemis became too big and became Vargo ' s cohort instead .
description_long: Enixtryx Enitryx was a black dragon and a member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . He was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent after Amnemis became too big and became Vargo ' s cohort instead . Activities . The dragon resided in the Well of Dragons with his master .

title: Enki
description: Enki Enki was a god with several connections to the gods of Toril , although he was never worshiped on that world . He was god of rivers and oceans among the ancestors of the Mulan , and also the patron of jewelers , goldsmiths , and stonecutters . Description .
description_long: Enki Enki was a god with several connections to the gods of Toril , although he was never worshiped on that world . He was god of rivers and oceans among the ancestors of the Mulan , and also the patron of jewelers , goldsmiths , and stonecutters . Description . Enki was a shapeshifter , but in all his human forms he was recognizable by his green skin . He could summon any being that died in the water , move like a blink dog , and he was immune to all forms of heat . He was known as a binder of demon s , his hatred for the fiends so great that he would slay any being in his presence who had ever interacted with demons in a friendly way . He carried a small mace carved from green jade . His armor and shield were made from water . Relationships . Enki is a son of the Untheric deity Enlil . He was once a lover of Lliira . He once had a wife , Nin - Hursag . Realm . Enki once dwelled in a realm called the Waterwheel in the Clockwork Nirvana of Mechanus . This realm was a disk covered in water and spanned by a bridge of woven gold and finely crafted crystal , interlocking with the neighboring wheels of his fellow gods , Anu and Utu .

title: Enlarge desert creature
description: Enlarge desert creature Enlarge desert creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell let the caster increase the size of a desert creature .
description_long: Enlarge desert creature Enlarge desert creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell let the caster increase the size of a desert creature . This spell could be used on any creature but worked best on those whose natural habitat was the desert . The maximum size the creature could be enlarged was twice its original size . A creature could not be made larger than its immediate surroundings would physically permit . The reverse of this spell , " diminish desert creature " , had the exact opposite effect . Components . This spell and the reversible counterpart required a small stick of teak or mahogany to cast . The bead was crushed during casting .

title: Enlarge or reduce person
description: Enlarge or reduce person Enlarge person was a transmutation spell that doubled the height of one humanoid with a corresponding increase in mass . Earlier versions of this spell were called Aksa ' s growth or simply enlarge and worked on both humanoids and objects , but to different degrees . " Enlarge " was reversible , and the shrinking spell was called reduce .
description_long: Enlarge or reduce person Enlarge person was a transmutation spell that doubled the height of one humanoid with a corresponding increase in mass . Earlier versions of this spell were called Aksa ' s growth or simply enlarge and worked on both humanoids and objects , but to different degrees . " Enlarge " was reversible , and the shrinking spell was called reduce . With the Second Sundering the spell changed name to simply Enlarge / reduce but worked much the same way . Effects . The transmutation version of this spell instantly doubled a person ' s height and increased their mass by a factor of 8 . All clothing , equipment , and items carried were also doubled in each dimension , but any item that left the possession of the recipient immediately reverted to its original size . Enlarged people had greater strength and increased reach , but less dexterity . Enlarged weapons did more damage , but projectiles or thrown weapons reverted to original size , doing normal damage ( possibly enhanced by the double - size weapon that fired it or the strength of the arm that threw it ) . This version of the spell had a range of 25 ft ( 7 .

title: Enlightened Ring
description: Enlightened Ring The Enlightened Ring was part of the core of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This central province in the Land of the Yak - Men was located high in the World Pillar Mountains of northeast Zakhara .
description_long: Enlightened Ring The Enlightened Ring was part of the core of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This central province in the Land of the Yak - Men was located high in the World Pillar Mountains of northeast Zakhara . The Enlightened Ring was framed by three other yikarian provinces including Fiend ' s Wing to the south and east , Ghost Leopard to the north , and Red Goat to the west . Most of the province consisted of a single large plateau . Inhabitants . The Elder governed the province , but the ultimate rule of the entire empire fell to the Lotus Emperor in the capital of Nathong atop the Gate of Heaven . Activities . Though the province was an arid region of the mountains , the soil and rock was rich with minerals . The Elder kept his dwarven slaves toiling away night and day to gather the riches of the earth .

title: Enlil
description: Enlil Enlil was the patriarch of the Untheric pantheon . He abdicated in favor of his son Gilgeam and left Toril in - 734 DR . His symbol was a pickaxe .
description_long: Enlil Enlil was the patriarch of the Untheric pantheon . He abdicated in favor of his son Gilgeam and left Toril in - 734 DR . His symbol was a pickaxe . Description . Enlil was portrayed as a tall human male with a dark , weighty beard and curly hair . He could change his form at will , raise lightning storms , and he kept for himself , alone of his pantheon , the ability to raise the dead . Enlil wore a war helm that cannot be affected by any known attack or substance . He wielded an unbreakable stone axe that disenchanted any weapon it hit . Relationships . Enlil was the son of Nammu , the sea , and the original ruler of the Untheric pantheon . He was the father of Gilgeam and of Enki . Inanna was once his wife , but he set her aside . Realm . Enlil dwelt on the Great Mountain of the East in Eronia , the second layer of the plane of Elysium along with his fellow deities Ki , Nin - Hursag , and Nanna - Sin . The surrounding plains were flat , dotted with cities and sluggish rivers . Only petitioners and servants of the gods , or those with a legitimate request to make of the gods ' servants , could climb the mountain .

title: Enom Tobun
description: Enom Tobun Enom Tobun was a teamster just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Enom loved telling stories , not caring for the truthfulness of them .
description_long: Enom Tobun Enom Tobun was a teamster just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Enom loved telling stories , not caring for the truthfulness of them . If someone question this , he grew resentful and vindictive . On the other hand , he was a wonderful traveling companion . History . Enom had driven caravans across all Faerun , from Waterdeep to Calimport and from Baldur ' s Gate to Hillsfar . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 , Enom acted as teamster to a great caravan , which unknown to him was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Enserric the Sword
description: Enserric the Sword “ " this blade is almost as nasty as the personality that permanently resides within " ” – Description of blade Enserric is a magical + 4 sentient sword that was discovered in Undermountain among the hall of sleeping kings during Hordes of the Underdark Appearance . It was not known what Enserric looked like in his mortal life , though one could assume through his initial title , that he was generally attired in grey clothing , or that he was aged enough to have grey hair , or possibly both instances . As for the sword , the weapon is described to be a black with a red glittering effect , with the intensity increasing whenever Enserric speaks .
description_long: Enserric the Sword “ " this blade is almost as nasty as the personality that permanently resides within " ” – Description of blade Enserric is a magical + 4 sentient sword that was discovered in Undermountain among the hall of sleeping kings during Hordes of the Underdark Appearance . It was not known what Enserric looked like in his mortal life , though one could assume through his initial title , that he was generally attired in grey clothing , or that he was aged enough to have grey hair , or possibly both instances . As for the sword , the weapon is described to be a black with a red glittering effect , with the intensity increasing whenever Enserric speaks . Initially , the weapon appeared as a long sword , but due in part of Enserric ’ s presence within the sword , the size might have been varying , the possible shapes including , a dagger , a short sword or a great sword . Personality . “ " hmmm … Deader ? More dead ? Can anything be more dead ? That ’ s the sort of question that makes Enserric clam up and mutter in agitation . " ” - - Description of Blade Enserric is described as generally irritable , arrogant and easy to annoy .

title: Ensnaring strike
description: Ensnaring strike Ensnaring strike was a conjuration spell that gave a strike the chance of ensnaring a target with vines . Effect . The target was covered with vines .
description_long: Ensnaring strike Ensnaring strike was a conjuration spell that gave a strike the chance of ensnaring a target with vines . Effect . The target was covered with vines . If the target couldn ' t muscle their way out of the vines , they would be trapped in them . The vines would last up to a minute and damaged the victim every couple of seconds . If the target was large , then it would more easily break the vines ' hold . If the spell was cast with a higher spell level , then the vines would hurt more . Components . Only a verbal component was needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Entangle
description: Entangle Entangle was a transmutation or alteration spell that caused plants to hinder and ensnare all creatures in the area of effect . Effects . The transmutation version of this spell affected a circle of 40 ft ( 12 .
description_long: Entangle Entangle was a transmutation or alteration spell that caused plants to hinder and ensnare all creatures in the area of effect . Effects . The transmutation version of this spell affected a circle of 40 ft ( 12 . 2 m ) radius . The alteration version affected a 40 ft ( 12 . 2 m ) cube . Both versions animated the vegetation to loop and twist around any creature in the area of effect . Grasses and weeds , bushes , vines , and trees reached out and ensnared them , holding them fast , or at least slowed them down . Victims of the spell had a chance to break free of the entanglement although the plants would attempt to re - capture anyone who broke free . Creatures assaulted by the local flora found it nearly impossible to attack , defend , or cast spells until they exited the area . Exceptionally large or strong creatures were less likely to be bothered by the writhing plants . Components . Verbal and somatic components , as well as the priest ' s holy symbol or divine focus were required to cast this spell .

title: Entar Silvershield
description: Entar Silvershield Entar Silvershield was one of the Grand Dukes of the Council of Four that ruled the city of Baldur ' s Gate before the Spellplague . In the Baldur ' s Gate computer game , Entar is the father of the NPC Skie Silvershield . He lives in an estate in north - western Baldur ' s Gate with his wife Brilla .
description_long: Entar Silvershield Entar Silvershield was one of the Grand Dukes of the Council of Four that ruled the city of Baldur ' s Gate before the Spellplague . In the Baldur ' s Gate computer game , Entar is the father of the NPC Skie Silvershield . He lives in an estate in north - western Baldur ' s Gate with his wife Brilla . Near the end of the game Eltan is killed by the assassins Slythe and Krystin to enable Sarevok to get elected Grand Duke in his place . It is possible he was later resurrected and reinstated .

title: Entemoch
description: Entemoch Entemoch , the Prince of Earth Elementals , was the twin of Ogrémoch , but unlike his evil brother , Entemoch was good . Description . Like his brother , he resembled a gigantic earth elemental , like a living mountain .
description_long: Entemoch Entemoch , the Prince of Earth Elementals , was the twin of Ogrémoch , but unlike his evil brother , Entemoch was good . Description . Like his brother , he resembled a gigantic earth elemental , like a living mountain . He could also burrow through the ground , merging with earth and stones and moving through them without disturbing the ground . He could even manifest himself only as a face made of stone in a cavernous wall . Relationships . Entemoch maintained a good relationship with Segojan Earthcaller , the gnome deity of deep earth and nature . Ogrémoch considered Entemoch an enemy , but Entemoch ' s feelings toward his twin brother were unknown . Worshipers . It is unknown what kinds of races and creatures worshiped Entemoch , but the svirfneblin priests of Blingdenstone knew ways and rituals to summon him . Entemoch appeared to those deep gnomes a thousand of years before the mid – 14th century DR . This ritual involved placing green gemstones in a circle and breaking them apart .

title: Enthrall
description: Enthrall Enthrall was an enchantment spell that captivated any number of creatures in a wide area for up to an hour . Effects . The caster had to acquire the attention of the group first by making a loud noise , shouting , performing , casting " calm chaos " , or some other means .
description_long: Enthrall Enthrall was an enchantment spell that captivated any number of creatures in a wide area for up to an hour . Effects . The caster had to acquire the attention of the group first by making a loud noise , shouting , performing , casting " calm chaos " , or some other means . Once the audience ' s attention was focused on the caster , the caster had to speak or sing in a language they could understand for one minute without interruption to cast " enthrall " . If successful , those that were affected would ignore what was happening around them and give complete attention to the caster whom they regarded with friendship . Beings of great wisdom or experience were only made indifferent to the caster , were still aware of their surroundings , and could possibly break free of the enchantment if they observed events not to their liking . Members of an organization , race , or religion opposed to the caster were particularly difficult to sway . Those who were not " enthralled " could heckle and jeer the caster or try to disrupt the spell using their charisma to undermine the caster ' s message and sway the crowd ' s attitude with derision .

title: Entillis Fulsom
description: Entillis Fulsom Entillis Fulsom was an elf and a member of the Harpers living in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . Entillis was a friend of Gorion , Jaheira , and Khalid .
description_long: Entillis Fulsom Entillis Fulsom was an elf and a member of the Harpers living in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . Entillis was a friend of Gorion , Jaheira , and Khalid . History . When Gorion ' s Ward arrived in Baldur ' s Gate , Entillis told him important information about the Iron Throne ' s enemies and about possible allies for the young adventurer .

title: Entomb
description: Entomb Entomb was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Entomb Entomb was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . With this spell the caster trapped creatures within a 30 foot cube of stone raised from the earth . In order for the spell to succeed , the cube needed to be raised from natural earth , passing through any vegetation that was in the area . Any creature caught by this spell was trapped unless they possessed some ability to pass through stone . " Entomb " was a popular spell used among dao slavers . Components . This spell required a small cube of stone scored with lines on each side , as well as verbal components , to cast .

title: Entropic shield
description: Entropic shield Entropic shield is an abjuration spell makes it harder to hit the caster with ranged attacks . Effect . A magical field appears around you , glowing with a chaotic blast of multicolored hues .
description_long: Entropic shield Entropic shield is an abjuration spell makes it harder to hit the caster with ranged attacks . Effect . A magical field appears around you , glowing with a chaotic blast of multicolored hues . This field deflects incoming arrows , rays , and other ranged attacks . Each ranged attack directed at you suffers a 20 % miss chance ( similar to the effects of concealment ) . This miss chance affects all ranged attacks for which the attackers make attack rolls , including arrows , magic arrows , " Melf ' s acid arrow " , " ray of enfeeblement " , and so forth . It does not affect other attacks that simply work at a distance , such as dragon breath .

title: Entropic warding
description: Entropic warding Entropic warding was a defensive warlock invocation designed to deflect ranged attacks . Effect . " Entropic warding " appeared to be a combination of the spells " entropic shield " and " pass without trace " .
description_long: Entropic warding Entropic warding was a defensive warlock invocation designed to deflect ranged attacks . Effect . " Entropic warding " appeared to be a combination of the spells " entropic shield " and " pass without trace " . The warlock was surrounded by chaotic energies that deflected incoming projectiles , rays , thrown weapons , etc . He also left no trail , and could not be tracked by his scent . He could , however , still be detected by scent .

title: Entropomancer
description: Entropomancer Entropomancers are spellcasters that plumbed the depths of divine power , to the point of gaining a most advanced attunement to the great nothingness they say lies at the center of the universe . These students use this connection to develop strange powers , sacrificing some of their normal studies which retards their progress as spellcasters . Any entropomancer would say their new abilities are well worth the cost .
description_long: Entropomancer Entropomancers are spellcasters that plumbed the depths of divine power , to the point of gaining a most advanced attunement to the great nothingness they say lies at the center of the universe . These students use this connection to develop strange powers , sacrificing some of their normal studies which retards their progress as spellcasters . Any entropomancer would say their new abilities are well worth the cost . Entropomancers can summon and control a small shard of absolute nothingness , harnessing its power for a variety of magical effects . Most revel in destruction for its own sake , but some take a more nuanced approach to their terrifying discoveries , trying to understand the power of entropy that it might someday be controlled or even reversed . Generally work in small groups or cabals , most entropomancers have patron deities of death , destruction or fate . There also exists cults that kidnap victims to be sacrificed to the Great Nothingness .

title: Entropy
description: Entropy Entropy was a primordial , who was for a time an aspect of Tiamat . History . When Ao banished the primordial s to Abeir he imprisoned Entropy in the form of a " sphere of annihilation " and placed him on Toril as a warning to the gods that they faced annihilation if they did not behave .
description_long: Entropy Entropy was a primordial , who was for a time an aspect of Tiamat . History . When Ao banished the primordial s to Abeir he imprisoned Entropy in the form of a " sphere of annihilation " and placed him on Toril as a warning to the gods that they faced annihilation if they did not behave . In 1346 DR , Entropy got a following in Chessenta when a " sphere of annihilation " appeared in House Karanok ' s torture chamber and annihilated the wizard they were torturing there . House Karanok started worshipping it and by 1370 DR , Tiamat took the aspect of Entropy and the sphere didn ' t only create five smaller ones , but actually started to grant spells . With Mystra ' s death and the subsequent Spellplague , Entropy was freed from his prison and grew stronger , threatening to devour the universe . He was worshiped in Chessenta by the Cult of Entropy and dwelt in the Maw of the God Swallower in southern Chessenta in 1479 DR . a special type of clerics of Entropy , who specialize in the usage of a " sphere of annihilation " .

title: Eodraco
description: Eodraco The eodraco ( or " dawn dragon " , in a ) was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Many scholars believed " eodracos " were the first proto - dragon genus . Description .
description_long: Eodraco The eodraco ( or " dawn dragon " , in a ) was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Many scholars believed " eodracos " were the first proto - dragon genus . Description . According to information taken from incomplete fossil evidence , eodracos were similar in form and appearance to present age wyvern s , with an average length of 35 feet ( 10 meters ) and a 50 - foot ( 15 meter ) wingspan , with no evidence suggesting eodracos had a stinger on its tail like wyverns . Due to the size of its skull , it was also believed their brains were smaller than those of wyverns , making them less intelligent than those creatures , but bigger than those of dinosaur s , making " eodracos " more cunning than their contemporaneous species . History . It was widely believed by scholars from Candlekeep that " eodracos " were a divergent genus evolved from prehistoric dinosaurs , although they were never numerous enough to outnumber them . Due to their greater animal cunning , they developed the ability to anticipate and plan , and to cooperate with other members of their kind , making them a successful genus in a time dominated by powerful carnivorous dinosaurs .

title: Eodraco orientalis
description: Eodraco orientalis The Eodraco orientalis was a supposed proto - dragon species of the " Eodraco " genus that eventually evolved into the lung dragon s . History . There was no conclusive evidence of the existence of " E .
description_long: Eodraco orientalis The Eodraco orientalis was a supposed proto - dragon species of the " Eodraco " genus that eventually evolved into the lung dragon s . History . There was no conclusive evidence of the existence of " E . orientalis " , and many scholars believed the species was made up by apologists of the proto - dragon theory in an attempt to solve its inconsistencies , specifically the lack of an ancestor species for the lung dragons .

title: Ephram Darano
description: Ephram Darano Ephram Darano was a halfling wererat wizard near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Ephram was the patriarch of the Darano , a halfling clan cursed with lycanthropy .
description_long: Ephram Darano Ephram Darano was a halfling wererat wizard near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Ephram was the patriarch of the Darano , a halfling clan cursed with lycanthropy . In 1478 DR , he led his fellows to Spellgard , seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel with the hopes of finding a cure . However , during the full moon , an argument broke out and many Darano transformed and killed their fellow family members in a blood - fueled frenzy . Horrified by their actions , Ephram and his surviving fellows abandoned their quest and started living in one of the ruins , preying upon the seekers .

title: Epic magic
description: Epic magic Epic magic is magic of " astonishing power " . Usually associated with ancient magical kingdoms , due to Mystra ' s Ban , items and places of epic magic can still be found . In D & D epic magic is usually considered to be spells of 10th level or higher .
description_long: Epic magic Epic magic is magic of " astonishing power " . Usually associated with ancient magical kingdoms , due to Mystra ' s Ban , items and places of epic magic can still be found . In D & D epic magic is usually considered to be spells of 10th level or higher . Epic Spells . Spells over 9th level are considered High - level or Epic . High - level Spells before Karsus ' s Folly in - 339 DR . High - level spells are spells that are over 9th level . Epic Spells in 1374 DR . The following spells are known epic magic spells , as such are spells created after Karsus ' s Folly . Some epic magic spells are known by the same name as the version of the high - level spell before Karsus ' s Folly . Spells after 1385 DR . After the Spellplague , magic altered . It is not known if any High - level or Epic spells have been created .

title: Epidemic
description: Epidemic All over Loudwater , orc s are exploding ! The cause is a disease that is spreading quickly through the city ' s populace . There isn ' t enough cleric al magic to go around and an epidemic will soon strike if a cure is not found quickly .
description_long: Epidemic All over Loudwater , orc s are exploding ! The cause is a disease that is spreading quickly through the city ' s populace . There isn ' t enough cleric al magic to go around and an epidemic will soon strike if a cure is not found quickly .

title: Epidote
description: Epidote Epidote was a plentiful ornamental stone within the Realms . Description . This stone ' s color ranged from clear ( in the smallest crystals ) to dark red ( in larger crystal deposits ) .
description_long: Epidote Epidote was a plentiful ornamental stone within the Realms . Description . This stone ' s color ranged from clear ( in the smallest crystals ) to dark red ( in larger crystal deposits ) . One variety could be cut into large of a deep rose color . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Crushed epidote was used in the formula for " potions of undead control " and in making the ink for inscribing scrolls with " protection from undead " .

title: Epricante
description: Epricante Epricante was a drow warrior of House Xorlarrin living in Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . During the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , he along his old associate Maffizo Vailentarne was part of a Xorlarrin reinforcement army sent to help the orc warlord Hartusk after an orc defeat near Mithril Hall .
description_long: Epricante Epricante was a drow warrior of House Xorlarrin living in Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . During the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , he along his old associate Maffizo Vailentarne was part of a Xorlarrin reinforcement army sent to help the orc warlord Hartusk after an orc defeat near Mithril Hall . However , thanks to tge plotting of Gromph Baenre and Kimmuriel Oblodra , Hartusk believed that Epricante and his army were traitors and attacked and destroyed them .

title: Equarz
description: Equarz Equarz was an elf and a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster . History . Around 1491 DR , Equarz was based just outside of Mulmaster .
description_long: Equarz Equarz was an elf and a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster . History . Around 1491 DR , Equarz was based just outside of Mulmaster . He heard stories about a lost treasure at the bottom of the Lost Drop . When Lyrene began pestering him , wanting to join the Zhentarim , he said if she could recover the treasure he would help her . At last , an adverting party hired by Lyrene ' s sister Dylohra saved her from some strange monsters inside the lake .

title: Equinis
description: Equinis Equinis was an eladrin ritualist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Equinis went into Undermountain in search of magical knowledge .
description_long: Equinis Equinis was an eladrin ritualist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Equinis went into Undermountain in search of magical knowledge . However , he was captured by lizardfolk followers of Sess ' innek who wanted to use him as a sacrifice to summon an avatar of their god . Skills . Equinis had a great knowledge of rituals and arcane lore .

title: Era of Skyfire
description: Era of Skyfire The First Era of Skyfire . The Era of Skyfire was a time in Faerûn ian history when the efreeti Memnon and the djinni Calim brought their forces together against each other in twenty - two cataclysmic battles from - 6500 DR to - 6100 DR . Elven High Magic forcibly bound the two leaders and bound their elemental essences to the sky and earth respectively .
description_long: Era of Skyfire The First Era of Skyfire . The Era of Skyfire was a time in Faerûn ian history when the efreeti Memnon and the djinni Calim brought their forces together against each other in twenty - two cataclysmic battles from - 6500 DR to - 6100 DR . Elven High Magic forcibly bound the two leaders and bound their elemental essences to the sky and earth respectively . The ongoing struggles of the two noble genie s created the Calim Desert . The Second Era of Skyfire . The hostilities between the two groups resumed as the High Magic ritual binding the two genie s was unraveled by the Spellplague , and ended in 1450 DR when Calim and Memnon were mysteriously sent back to their home planes . This conflict was known as the Second Era of Skyfire by local sages .

title: Era of Upheaval
description: Era of Upheaval Era of Upheaval The Era of Upheaval was the time period between the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the Spellplague in 1385 DR . 1358 DR Time of Troubles : After the Tablets of Fate were stolen , the Overgod , Ao , forced all of the gods of Faerûn to walk on Toril in their mortal avatar forms . However , unlike when a god usually sent an avatar to Toril and his or her true form resided typically on one of the Outer Planes , the deities were all demoted and this was the only form that they had at the time , making them vulnerable , though still very powerful .
description_long: Era of Upheaval Era of Upheaval The Era of Upheaval was the time period between the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the Spellplague in 1385 DR . 1358 DR Time of Troubles : After the Tablets of Fate were stolen , the Overgod , Ao , forced all of the gods of Faerûn to walk on Toril in their mortal avatar forms . However , unlike when a god usually sent an avatar to Toril and his or her true form resided typically on one of the Outer Planes , the deities were all demoted and this was the only form that they had at the time , making them vulnerable , though still very powerful . Several major gods died during the Time of Troubles , and a small number of mortals attained divinity . Also during the catastrophic event , arcane and divine magic across Faerûn ceased to function properly , and chaos and destruction occurred throughout many nations and cities . Attempted Coup in Menzoberranzan : In the underground drow city of Menzoberranzan , the psionicists of House Oblodra were the only dark elves to retain their magical abilities during the Time of Troubles and attempted to seize power .

title: Eragyn
description: Eragyn Eragyn was a female cleric of Cyric living in Zhent - occupied Daggerdale in 1367 DR . Activities . Circa 1359 DR , she started an eight - year - long plan to resurrect the evil wizard and ruler of the dale Colderan Morn after discovering his crypt .
description_long: Eragyn Eragyn was a female cleric of Cyric living in Zhent - occupied Daggerdale in 1367 DR . Activities . Circa 1359 DR , she started an eight - year - long plan to resurrect the evil wizard and ruler of the dale Colderan Morn after discovering his crypt . In 1367 DR , her plan finally came to fruition but soon after the risen Colderan overpowered Eragyn and imprisoned her in the crypt , wanting himself to be the only ruler of the dale . He started spreading a magical illness . An adventurers ' band hired to stop the magical illness found the crypt and Eragyn but her fate was not clear .

title: Erakic
description: Erakic Erakic was a language spoken by the Eraka , the barbarians of The Ride , from Frozen Forest in the north to the Dragonspine Mountains in the south , and from Desert ' s Edge in the west to the Galena Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages .
description_long: Erakic Erakic was a language spoken by the Eraka , the barbarians of The Ride , from Frozen Forest in the north to the Dragonspine Mountains in the south , and from Desert ' s Edge in the west to the Galena Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages .

title: Eralynn Thunsonn
description: Eralynn Thunsonn Eralynn Thunsonn was a dwarven adventurer and member of the Order of Delvers . She was a good friend and sometimes delving companion of Torrin Ironstar . History .
description_long: Eralynn Thunsonn Eralynn Thunsonn was a dwarven adventurer and member of the Order of Delvers . She was a good friend and sometimes delving companion of Torrin Ironstar . History . Eralynn did not have an easy life . As a youth , her parents were killed by a red dragon when they became separated from a caravan traveling through a cavern system near the East Rift . After she joined the Delvers , she and her delving partner had some sort of accident in which her partner died . Fairly or not , other Delvers blamed Eralynn for her partner ' s death and considered her unlucky . At some point , she acquired spellscarred hands with which she was able to work some magic . Torrin was the only person who was willing to adventure with her , although much of the time she preferred solo delves . In 1480 DR , Eralynn handled tainted gold and became infected with the Stoneplague . She traveled to Sundasz , believing that the non - dwarven clerics in that city could cure her . Unfortunately , the clerics of Corellon Larethian could not cure her and she eventually succumbed to the disease .

title: Erammon Oraun
description: Erammon Oraun Erammon Oraun was son of Lord Elmaer Oraun , former Lord of Harrowdale . He fought in the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , defending Harrowdale against the forces of Halvan the Dark , but vanished during the battle , and the battle was won by the invading forces . History .
description_long: Erammon Oraun Erammon Oraun was son of Lord Elmaer Oraun , former Lord of Harrowdale . He fought in the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , defending Harrowdale against the forces of Halvan the Dark , but vanished during the battle , and the battle was won by the invading forces . History . After Erammon ' s disappearance at the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , he was presumed dead , but some said that he , along with his father Lord Elmaer , and swordmaster Thaeron , had been taken by elven magic . He was reportedly seen again in Harrowdale in 1351 DR , when " fey blue mage - fire " was observed above a farmstead belonging to three brothers , Torstan , Ulbearn , and Durthar Morgath . The wizard Arauntan of Selgaunt reports that the following morning , although the three brothers walked and talked the same as before , they had the appearances of Erammon , his father Elmaer , and swordmaster Thaeron . Torstan , or Erammon , depending on whose story is to be believed , disappeared in 1352 DR .

title: Erase
description: Erase Erase is a transmutation spell that causes mundane and magical writing to vanish . Effect . " Erase " removes writings of either magical or mundane nature from a scroll or from up to two pages of paper , parchment , or similar surfaces .
description_long: Erase Erase is a transmutation spell that causes mundane and magical writing to vanish . Effect . " Erase " removes writings of either magical or mundane nature from a scroll or from up to two pages of paper , parchment , or similar surfaces . It removes " explosive runes " , " glyphs of warding " , " sepia snake sigil s " , and " arcane mark s " , but it does not remove " illusory script " or " symbol s " . Nonmagical writings are automatically erased if touched and no one else is holding them . Magic writings must be touched . If an attempt fails to erase " explosive runes " , a " glyph of warding " , or a " sepia snake sigil " , the runes , glyph , or sigil become activated instead .

title: Erathaol
description: Erathaol Erathaol was a Seer and the ruler of Venya , the third layer of Mount Celestia . He dwelt in the library fortress of Xiranthador . Description .
description_long: Erathaol Erathaol was a Seer and the ruler of Venya , the third layer of Mount Celestia . He dwelt in the library fortress of Xiranthador . Description . Erathaol was tall and had long golden hair , white feathery wings , and a humanlike face . He spoke in a deep voice . He wore rich blue robes . History . After the death of Mystra , Erathaol summoned the astral deva diviner Eirwyn from her imprisonment in order to facilitate her visions . This action ultimately led to Eirwyn aiding Tauran and his companions in defending the Lifespring from Kaanyr Vhok .

title: Eravien Haund
description: Eravien Haund Eravien Haund was a half - elf and a noble member of the Lords ' Alliance during the Rage of Demons . History . Eravien was of both wood elf and Tethyrian descent , but lived in Waterdeep .
description_long: Eravien Haund Eravien Haund was a half - elf and a noble member of the Lords ' Alliance during the Rage of Demons . History . Eravien was of both wood elf and Tethyrian descent , but lived in Waterdeep . During the Rage of Demons , Eravien was the Lords ' Alliance delegate to King Bruenor Battlehammer of Gauntlgrym to discuss the madness spreading in the Underdark , despite not believing personally in the threat . He also knew that a deep - cover agent of the Lords ' Alliance in the Underdark , Khelessa Draga , had recently gone silent Personality . Eravien was a charming and sly courtier , able to be immediately size up any social situation . However , he focused too much on socializing , distracting him from important information .

title: Erdan
