description: Erdan Erdan was a priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1450 DR , Erdan and Derreg welcomed Varra and helped her to give birth to Vasen Cale , despite being suspicious about the child ' s heritage .
description_long: Erdan Erdan was a priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1450 DR , Erdan and Derreg welcomed Varra and helped her to give birth to Vasen Cale , despite being suspicious about the child ' s heritage . Relationships . Erdan was a good friend of Derreg .

title: Eregul
description: Eregul Eregul ( pronounced ERE - eh - GULL ) , usually known as the Freestave ( meaning that he was a wizard out for his own interests , while working for an organization ) , was a high - ranking Zhentarim wizard in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He died in 1375 DR in Shadowdale . Description .
description_long: Eregul Eregul ( pronounced ERE - eh - GULL ) , usually known as the Freestave ( meaning that he was a wizard out for his own interests , while working for an organization ) , was a high - ranking Zhentarim wizard in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He died in 1375 DR in Shadowdale . Description . Eregul was tall with black hair and a beard . He also had hard , dark eyes . Personality . Eregul was a cautious and scheming individual who spoke with a drawling voice peppered with sardonic mannerisms . He was always in search of the best opportunities to rise in rank . He greatly disliked Orgauth for his eternal smile . Relationship . Eregul had a loyal foulwing steed named Zvopua . History . Eregul joined the Zhentarim as an independent ally of Manshoon in order to gain power and influence . His long - term plan was to supplant Thagdal as master of the Tower of the Art in Zhentil Keep and obtain a place in the Lords ' Council . He wandered Cormyr , Sembia and the Dalelands . In 1370 DR , however , Eregul was in Darkhold to take command of the Zhent wizards there . In 1375 DR , Eregul was the most high - ranking Zhent wizard in the Zhentarim Occupation Army in Shadowdale .

title: Erek - Hus
description: Erek - Hus Erek - Hus , also known as The King of Terror , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . According to the few dragonborn of Abeir who believed in gods , the dragon god Asgorath ( known in Abeir by the name of Io ) fought alone against Erek - Hus during the Dawn War , and the primordial killed him by cutting Asgorath in twain with his giant adamantine axe .
description_long: Erek - Hus Erek - Hus , also known as The King of Terror , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . According to the few dragonborn of Abeir who believed in gods , the dragon god Asgorath ( known in Abeir by the name of Io ) fought alone against Erek - Hus during the Dawn War , and the primordial killed him by cutting Asgorath in twain with his giant adamantine axe . Some claim Asgorath died in that battle because the god Zehir betrayed him to Erek - Hus , because Zehir wanted to control the Dragon domain . Zehir ' s plan was destined to fail , however , as no sooner Asgorath had died , his two halves rose up as the dragon gods Bahamut and Tiamat , who joined forces for once in their lives and killed Erek - Hus before the primordial had even a chance to celebrate his victory .

title: Erelda
description: Erelda Erelda was the second - in - command of battlemistress Rylla of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1379 DR , during an attack by Ghaunadaur ' s followers on the Promenade , Erelda remained to control the seals that trapped the god ' s avatar .
description_long: Erelda Erelda was the second - in - command of battlemistress Rylla of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1379 DR , during an attack by Ghaunadaur ' s followers on the Promenade , Erelda remained to control the seals that trapped the god ' s avatar . However , a large group of ooze s attacked Erelda and her Protectors and managed to break the seal , awakening the avatar of Ghaunadaur .

title: Erelda H ' tithet
description: Erelda H ' tithet Erelda H ' tithet was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Ereda was very good at concealing her scorn for others .
description_long: Erelda H ' tithet Erelda H ' tithet was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Ereda was very good at concealing her scorn for others . She lived in fear of Talabrina Duskryn and did anything she said . However , Erelda personally thought she could do good business with the deep gnomes . Activities . Erelda usually sold art objects , poisons , and obsidian daggers , in exchange for salt and gems . History . In 1479 DR , Erelda was , following the suggestion of Talabrina Duskryn , the main opponent to re - opening the outpost to the deep gnome s of Blingdenstone .

title: Erelhei - Cinlu
description: Erelhei - Cinlu Erelhei - Cinlu is a drow city located in the Underdark of Oerth . Its importance in the Forgotten Realms is based on the fact that the names of several of the drow noble houses of this city , which is detailed in the AD & D module D3 Vault of the Drow , republished and expanded in the Queen of the Spiders campaign adventure , are mentioned in the 1991 Forgotten Realms publication " FOR2 The Drow of the Underdark " . The Drow Houses mentioned in both publications are : Aleval , Despana , Eilservs , Everhate , Godeep , Kilsek , Noquar and Tormtor .
description_long: Erelhei - Cinlu Erelhei - Cinlu is a drow city located in the Underdark of Oerth . Its importance in the Forgotten Realms is based on the fact that the names of several of the drow noble houses of this city , which is detailed in the AD & D module D3 Vault of the Drow , republished and expanded in the Queen of the Spiders campaign adventure , are mentioned in the 1991 Forgotten Realms publication " FOR2 The Drow of the Underdark " . The Drow Houses mentioned in both publications are : Aleval , Despana , Eilservs , Everhate , Godeep , Kilsek , Noquar and Tormtor . ( Queen of the Spiders pp . 85 - 7 & The Drow of the Underdark pp . 98 ) Behind the scenes . " It ' s largely undetailed . Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s Guide to the Underdark contains lore on Sschindylryn ' s Gate . . . but that relates more to a location nine days out from Menzoberranzan . Interestingly , in Eric ' s first draft of DDGttU , he intended Sschindylryn ' s Gate to lead to the drow city of Erelhei Cinlu on Oerth - creating an FR / GH crossover . This was in response to the fact that there was a listing of several Greyhawk drow cities and noble houses in Ed ' s The Drow of the Underdark .

title: Eressea Ambergyles
description: Eressea Ambergyles Preceptress Eressea Ambergyles was the ranking religious official at the The House of the Lady in Shadowdale . History . When Erressea was younger , she was a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Eressea Ambergyles Preceptress Eressea Ambergyles was the ranking religious official at the The House of the Lady in Shadowdale . History . When Erressea was younger , she was a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . She retired from the Knights after her death and resurrection in 1354 DR , and ministered to the faithful of Tymora in Shadowdale until , at least , 1374 DR .

title: Erethun Rivenstave
description: Erethun Rivenstave Erethun Rivenstave was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . History . Around 1359 DR , Erethun ' s predecessor suddenly died and Erethun was elected to the Council thanks to his wealth , despite nobody liking or trusting him .
description_long: Erethun Rivenstave Erethun Rivenstave was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . History . Around 1359 DR , Erethun ' s predecessor suddenly died and Erethun was elected to the Council thanks to his wealth , despite nobody liking or trusting him . In truth , Erethun was an agent of Mulmaster who had killed his predecessor . He plotted to eventually replace all the other councilors with his own thralls .

title: Erevain Blacksheaf
description: Erevain Blacksheaf Erevain Blacksheaf was an elven adventurer from Evereska who journeyed to the Icewind Dale town of Easthaven . Description . The gold - haired elf was of slender build and dressed in hunting leathers .
description_long: Erevain Blacksheaf Erevain Blacksheaf was an elven adventurer from Evereska who journeyed to the Icewind Dale town of Easthaven . Description . The gold - haired elf was of slender build and dressed in hunting leathers . Personality . Erevain was a kind elf who felt a great desire to see all Faerûn and not take the Retreat to Evermeet . Relationships . He had a cousin named Xan . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Erevain stayed at the Snowdrift Inn after traveling from Kuldahar in the Spine of the World . He was killed by spider s in Dragon ' s Eye later that year .

title: Erevan Ilesere
description: Erevan Ilesere Erevan Ilesere ( air - eh - van illeh - seer ) was the elven god of mischief and rogue s . Having lost power in the Spellplague , he became an exarch of Corellon . His titles included the Trickster and the Chameleon .
description_long: Erevan Ilesere Erevan Ilesere ( air - eh - van illeh - seer ) was the elven god of mischief and rogue s . Having lost power in the Spellplague , he became an exarch of Corellon . His titles included the Trickster and the Chameleon . Clergy . The Erevanian cleric s dressed in black leather armor with leather caps , and never worshiped him in the same place twice . Holy days and rituals . Erevan ' s holy day s were on the eclipses , and his faithful sacrificed stolen treasures to him whenever they felt it was appropriate .

title: Erevis Cale
description: Erevis Cale Erevis Cale is a shade and a chosen of Mask alongside Drasek Riven . He changed his name from Vasen Coriver upon his departure from the city of Westgate and the Night Masks thieves ' guild . Biography .
description_long: Erevis Cale Erevis Cale is a shade and a chosen of Mask alongside Drasek Riven . He changed his name from Vasen Coriver upon his departure from the city of Westgate and the Night Masks thieves ' guild . Biography . Another name for dawn . Vasen Coriver was a translator in training and an assassin under the employ of the Night Masks who adopted him and raised him in the streets of Westgate . Adopted by the leader of the Night masks " The Faceless " he was still just a another member and would be let go if needed be . The only friend and father figure was his teacher Theevis who helped him in his attempt to flee the city and the guild . Owning no loyalty to the guild he " skimmed " money from jobs in order to buy himself a way out . The guild does not let any members leave except in death . His crew , knowing that he had taken extra coin from the jobs , sent a young man named " Losk Cale " to get the money from Vasen ' s hideout . Losk attacked Vasen , losing in the struggle ; as he knew his life was about to end the boy asked to be spared , and this was the first person to be spared , marking the beginnings of change in Vasen ' s life .

title: Erevon Sunter
description: Erevon Sunter Erevon Sunter was a lord in Cormyr . Activities . Sunter commanded High Horn ' s garrison .
description_long: Erevon Sunter Erevon Sunter was a lord in Cormyr . Activities . Sunter commanded High Horn ' s garrison . History . In 1480 DR , Sunter saw the dismembered body of War Wizard of Cormyr Umbarl Darlhoun . Later , he asked a young war wizard for some explanations about it . At last after hearing rumors of civil war in verge to explode he decided to retire in a isolate farm .

title: Ergol Mrauksoun
description: Ergol Mrauksoun Ergol Mrauksoun was a moneylender and landlord in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Ergol and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer but the lord explained he was busy with two other troubles : a group of outlaws preying upon caravans and a possible crazy wizard in Hullack Forest .
description_long: Ergol Mrauksoun Ergol Mrauksoun was a moneylender and landlord in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Ergol and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer but the lord explained he was busy with two other troubles : a group of outlaws preying upon caravans and a possible crazy wizard in Hullack Forest .

title: Erhu
description: Erhu The erhu was a stringed instrument constructed with a long stick - like neck and a sound box at the bottom . The instrument had two strings and was played with a horse hair bow . The renowned erhuist Ping Chiang played the erhu at the Lily Pad Inn in Marsember .
description_long: Erhu The erhu was a stringed instrument constructed with a long stick - like neck and a sound box at the bottom . The instrument had two strings and was played with a horse hair bow . The renowned erhuist Ping Chiang played the erhu at the Lily Pad Inn in Marsember .

title: Erian
description: Erian Erian was a soldier in Caer Corwell . Description . Erian was a huge man with strong corded muscles .
description_long: Erian Erian was a soldier in Caer Corwell . Description . Erian was a huge man with strong corded muscles . Personality . As a veteran of Corwell ' s guards , Erian despised peacetime and enjoyed the thrill of battle . Hard as nails , Erian was know for kicking dog s with his heavy . History . After arresting Daryth in 1345 DR , Erian entered the Festival of the Spring Equinox to drink Callidyrr mead at the tent of Geoffrey and met the lovely Meridith . Death . Later that evening in 1345 DR , Erian laid down with Meridith , who was actually the Darkwalker Kazgoroth in disguise , and as their lips touched , the monster stole Erian ' s life energy and replaced it with an evil presence .

title: Eric Haddock
description: Eric Haddock Rich Redman is an author and game designer who has written for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines . He is the author of the " Cormyr " sourcebook , and has also produced work for . Background .
description_long: Eric Haddock Rich Redman is an author and game designer who has written for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines . He is the author of the " Cormyr " sourcebook , and has also produced work for . Background . Haddock grew up in a rural farming community in Illinois .

title: Eric L . Boyd
description: Eric L . Boyd Eric L . Boyd has co - authored a number of " Forgotten Realms " campaign supplements , most recently the " Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide " for 4th edition D & D .
description_long: Eric L . Boyd Eric L . Boyd has co - authored a number of " Forgotten Realms " campaign supplements , most recently the " Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide " for 4th edition D & D . He also authored . History . Boyd used to run a campaign set in the " Forgotten Realms " , specifically a set in Waterdeep , City of Splendors , revolving around the Waterdhavian nobility called " Hidden Splendors " . However , Hidden Splendors is currently on hiatus . More recently he has started up the " Six Swords " campaign set in the Sembia n city of Yhaunn .

title: Erik Mona
description: Erik Mona Erik Mona was the editor - in - chief of Dragon magazine from 2004 to 2007 and Dungeon magazine from 2004 to 2006 ; both magazines were published by Paizo Publishing until 2007 . He has edited , authored , and co - authored several products for the Dungeons & Dragons role - playing game , including the " Living Greyhawk Gazetteer " , " Faiths and Pantheons " , " Armies of the Abyss " , and " " . He is also the former editor of the " Oerth Journal " , an online publication devoted to the World of Greyhawk campaign setting .
description_long: Erik Mona Erik Mona was the editor - in - chief of Dragon magazine from 2004 to 2007 and Dungeon magazine from 2004 to 2006 ; both magazines were published by Paizo Publishing until 2007 . He has edited , authored , and co - authored several products for the Dungeons & Dragons role - playing game , including the " Living Greyhawk Gazetteer " , " Faiths and Pantheons " , " Armies of the Abyss " , and " " . He is also the former editor of the " Oerth Journal " , an online publication devoted to the World of Greyhawk campaign setting . Presently he works as the publisher of Paizo Publishing . He maintains a blog , the Analytical Engine , and lives in Seattle , Washington . He was recently named head publisher for Paizo .

title: Erik Scott de Bie
description: Erik Scott de Bie Erik Scott de Bie ( born July 18 , 1983 ) is an American fantasy author and technical writer . He has a degree in English Composition and Literature from in . His wife is named Shelley and he has several cats and a dog .
description_long: Erik Scott de Bie Erik Scott de Bie ( born July 18 , 1983 ) is an American fantasy author and technical writer . He has a degree in English Composition and Literature from in . His wife is named Shelley and he has several cats and a dog . His hobbies include fencing , rock music , movies and computer games . He is a self - confessed geek .

title: Erin M . Evans
description: Erin M . Evans Erin M . Evans is a fantasy author currently living in Seattle with her husband .
description_long: Erin M . Evans Erin M . Evans is a fantasy author currently living in Seattle with her husband . She holds an anthropology degree from Washington University in St . Louis and now lives with her husband in Seattle . " The God Catcher " was her first novel .

title: Erinyes
description: Erinyes Erinyes were baatezu devil s of the Nine Hells . Physical description . Erinyes originally appeared as beautiful women and men , with large feathered wings and glowing red eyes .
description_long: Erinyes Erinyes were baatezu devil s of the Nine Hells . Physical description . Erinyes originally appeared as beautiful women and men , with large feathered wings and glowing red eyes . They could be mistaken for a celestial . An erinyes generally stood around 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) tall and weighed approximately 150 pounds ( 68 kg ) . After Asmodeus ' ascension to godhood , the erinyes lost their wings , and received hooves and fangs in return , which made them look beastly . . Combat . Erinyes usually wielded a longsword , but their primary weapon was a shining red " + 1 flaming composite longbow " . They preferred to use it to fight a distance or from above , and used their powers to distract or disorganize their foes . They liked to tie up an enemy in a rope and fly them high into the sky before dropping them . Powers . An erinyes could use the spells of " charm monster " and " minor image " , and in common with other baatezu they could cast an " unholy blight " and " greater teleport " at will , as well as act under a constant " true seeing " . They could summon lemure s and bearded devil s to assist them .

title: Erione
description: Erione Erione was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Erione resented the fact that a few priests were in the cult ' s command structure and wanted to demonstrate that worship could bring even greater power .
description_long: Erione Erione was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Erione resented the fact that a few priests were in the cult ' s command structure and wanted to demonstrate that worship could bring even greater power . History . In 1491 DR , Erione and four fellow cultists managed the temple ' s altar . She plotted to sacrifice Rukhelmoth Glitterstone in order to control a black pudding living under the temple . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her and her minions .

title: Erixitl
description: Erixitl Erixitl was a young Maztican priestess of Qotal and the wife of the former Golden Legion officer Halloran . History . At the age of 10 , Erixitl was taken captive and held as a slave in the city of Kultaka .
description_long: Erixitl Erixitl was a young Maztican priestess of Qotal and the wife of the former Golden Legion officer Halloran . History . At the age of 10 , Erixitl was taken captive and held as a slave in the city of Kultaka . After being attacked by the son of her owner , Erixitl was sold to Kachin , a cleric of the god Qotal in Ulatos . Kachin freed Erixitl and told her she was to become a priestess . However , Erix was kidnapped by a priest of Zaltec and taken to be sacrificed at a pyramid on top of the Twin Visages . She managed to escape and the daughter of an Amn nian bishop of Helm was sacrificed in her place , which led to war between the Golden Legion and Ulatos . Erixitl was nearly killed during the battle between the Amnians and Ulatans but the Legionnaire Halloran rescued her . Halloran and Erixitl escaped into the jungle , eventually making their way to Nexal . Erixitl had visions of the destruction of Nexal and she wanted to do everything in her power to prevent this from happening . Erix and Halloran had a disagreement and Erix traveled back to her home village of Palul . She arrived just before the Golden Legion and she was pressed into service as a translator .

title: Erliza Daressin
description: Erliza Daressin Lady Erliz Daressin was a human woman and vampire and the Amnian ruler of Snowdown Isle in the Moonshae Isles in 1479 DR . When she was turned into a vampire in Amn , she had a vision of being reborn as a queen of the Feywild . Through research that mostly consisted of consulting sages and then drinking their blood , she found information that led her to believe the city of Karador contained a portal to the Feywild and she worked to obtain a position of power in Amn ' s colony of Snowdown .
description_long: Erliza Daressin Lady Erliz Daressin was a human woman and vampire and the Amnian ruler of Snowdown Isle in the Moonshae Isles in 1479 DR . When she was turned into a vampire in Amn , she had a vision of being reborn as a queen of the Feywild . Through research that mostly consisted of consulting sages and then drinking their blood , she found information that led her to believe the city of Karador contained a portal to the Feywild and she worked to obtain a position of power in Amn ' s colony of Snowdown . Only her closest confidants knew her true nature .

title: Erlkazar
description: Erlkazar Erlkazar was a small kingdom located due east of Tethyr . History . The land now known as Erlkazar was , until the last millennium , untamed wilderness .
description_long: Erlkazar Erlkazar was a small kingdom located due east of Tethyr . History . The land now known as Erlkazar was , until the last millennium , untamed wilderness . Karazir Tiiraklar of Tethyr , the consort of queen Vajra Korrunhel , and his brother Ellessor mustered an army and marched on this land . In 309 DR , Ellessor became the first duke of Elestam . When Shoonach fell , the lands reverted back into wilderness . King Strohm II , after defeating Tathtar ' s invading army , claimed Elestam as part of Tethyr in 731 DR . Nothing much of note occurred in the duchy until the time of the persecutions of the elves which left duke Valon Morkann torn . He supported the elves but was loyal to the crown . In the end , his loyalty won out and he kept the disputed trade routes open . Loyalty would play an important role during the Tethyrian Interregnum as well . During the Ten Black Days of Eleint in 1347 DR the political situation forced Morkann to accept the treacherous nobles in the realm who were allied to the tyrannical Duke of Dusk , even after four separate attempts on his life sponsored by them were foiled only by Morkann ' s friends in Elestam ' s Crusaders .

title: Erlranther Alibakkar
description: Erlranther Alibakkar Erlranther Alibakkar is the current Meisarch , the highest ranking member of the Council of Six , the government of Amn . He is noted as being in his late fifties as of 1362 DR ( see Age below ) and he has a slightly large belly . He was originally a caravan organizer and a fighter , but in 1333 DR he entered the Council of Six as the lower - ranked Namarch , moving his way up gradually .
description_long: Erlranther Alibakkar Erlranther Alibakkar is the current Meisarch , the highest ranking member of the Council of Six , the government of Amn . He is noted as being in his late fifties as of 1362 DR ( see Age below ) and he has a slightly large belly . He was originally a caravan organizer and a fighter , but in 1333 DR he entered the Council of Six as the lower - ranked Namarch , moving his way up gradually . In an argument , Erlranther will stare down upon his opponent and tense his muscles so that it appears he is ready to fight . Age . Erlranther is described in " Lands of Intrigue " as being the Lord of House Alibakkar from 1302 DR , and described as being in his late fifties as of 1362 DR . For this to be feasible , Erlranther must have been born in 1302 DR . As of 1372 DR this would make him approximately seventy years old .

title: Erned Stoutblade
description: Erned Stoutblade Erned Stoutblade was a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , having heard that the Iceshield orc s had attacked many farms in the Dessarin Valley , he decided to go to the Dellmon farm to help Kerbin Dellmon to fight them off .
description_long: Erned Stoutblade Erned Stoutblade was a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , having heard that the Iceshield orc s had attacked many farms in the Dessarin Valley , he decided to go to the Dellmon farm to help Kerbin Dellmon to fight them off . With the lucky arrival of some adventurers , the Dellmons managed to defend the farm .

title: Erngar Narrowlea
description: Erngar Narrowlea Gentle Father Erngar Narrowlea was a priest of Lathander in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Erngar Narrowlea Gentle Father Erngar Narrowlea was a priest of Lathander in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . Erngar was a forward - looking person who noticed details and speculated on how they might impact future events . He was kindly and helped those in need . Activities . His primary duty was to tend the House of the Holy Light , the shrine to the Morninglord in Voonlar , along with a few lay persons . In addition to nurturing the open - to - all herb garden around the shrine , he sold " potions of extra healing " and holy water to the many visitors that stopped by while passing through Voonlar . Unbeknownst to the Bron and the Cyric ists of the Dark God Reformed , Erngar did what he could to upset their plans without drawing attention to himself . He also assisted other followers of Lathander by providing small loans for business purposes . Possessions . Father Narrowlea tried to keep at least twenty large glass jars of holy water on hand for sale at the shrine .

title: Erqynak
description: Erqynak Erqynak was an elderly ixzan who was a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Activities . Erqynak ' s primary concern was with spell research .
description_long: Erqynak Erqynak was an elderly ixzan who was a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Activities . Erqynak ' s primary concern was with spell research . His nickname derived from the effect caused by an original spell he created , called " Erqynak ' s icy breath " . Erqynak studied cold - related dweomers and drew his innate spell powers mostly from the school of evocation .

title: Errde Blackskull
description: Errde Blackskull Errde Blackskull was the duergar commander of the Stone Guard s in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Errde ' s main concern was the growing corruption in the city ' s governments .
description_long: Errde Blackskull Errde Blackskull was the duergar commander of the Stone Guard s in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Errde ' s main concern was the growing corruption in the city ' s governments . Errde knew even her guards were ineffective in uncovering it . History . During the Rage of Demons , Errde concentrated her efforts on capturing the derro courier Droki , who she believed was a crucial pawn in a conspiracy of the Council of Savants .

title: Errtu
description: Errtu Errtu was a powerful balor . He commanded his own layer of the Abyss and the tanar ' ri inhabitants that resided there . Description .
description_long: Errtu Errtu was a powerful balor . He commanded his own layer of the Abyss and the tanar ' ri inhabitants that resided there . Description . Errtu was a balor , the second most powerful class of the true tanar ' ri demon s , after the demon lord s . He was twelve feet tall , covered in red scales , had a large pair of batlike wings and a tail , and and had a horned , ape - like head with a dog - like muzzle . When he was in the throes of lust for power , he drooled an acidic saliva . His voice was gravelly , guttural , and harsh . Personality . Errtu reveled in evil and chaos . Nothing pleased him more than to torment others . When needed , however , he could be a polite and patient negotiator and was known to reward his minions . He had a particular interest in gaining power on and from the Prime Material Plane , in particular Toril . Errtu ' s motivations were primarily that of the average demon ' s — his own power , his own survival , and the chance to cause havoc in the Prime Material Plane .

title: Eruption
description: Eruption Eruption was a powerful conjuration and flame spell that was used by high - ranking members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell had two very different effects depending on where it was cast .
description_long: Eruption Eruption was a powerful conjuration and flame spell that was used by high - ranking members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell had two very different effects depending on where it was cast . If cast upon land the spell opened a gate to the Para - Elemental Plane of Magma , immediately filling the area with molten lava . Any creature in the area unable to fly or escape by other means began to sink into the lava , suffering excruciating damage from contact with the molten rock . The area of effect for this spell depended on the skill of the caster , but typically measured hundreds of cubic feet . The lava would remain until successfully dispelled or until it cooled to solid rock after several days . " Eruption " was fully capable of destroying buildings and other structures . If " eruption " was cast in a body of water whose volume was greater than the effective area of the spell , then the spell failed . If the effective spell area was greater then it created a giant cloud of scalding steam the same size as the body of water . The intense heat from the steam harmed all creatures caught within before dissipating after 5 - 10 minutes .

title: Erve
description: Erve Erve was a priest of Jergal in the Moonsea . History . During the Rage of Demons , Erve went to an abandoned temple of Waukeen to take an inventory of the dead buried in the church ' s graveyard and crypt .
description_long: Erve Erve was a priest of Jergal in the Moonsea . History . During the Rage of Demons , Erve went to an abandoned temple of Waukeen to take an inventory of the dead buried in the church ' s graveyard and crypt . However , some of the builders of the temple were secretly cultists of Graz ' zt and their leader , by now a shadow demon , possessed Erve . Under demonic possession , Erve re - opened the temple as a sanctuary to Graz ' zt . At last an adventuring party found and defeated the demon . Around 1492 DR Erve joined the army that tried to free Phlan from the Vorgansharax . Relationship . Erve had dealings with the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Eryndlyn
description: Eryndlyn Eryndlyn was a drow city of more than sixty thousand in the Upper Underdark . Geography . Eryndlyn was located in caves beneath the High Moor in the Upperdark .
description_long: Eryndlyn Eryndlyn was a drow city of more than sixty thousand in the Upper Underdark . Geography . Eryndlyn was located in caves beneath the High Moor in the Upperdark . Eryndlyn dominated the northern Undermoor tunnels ; the southern tunnels were home to derro and illithid s . Description . The limestone cavern of the city was dome shaped and more than two miles in diameter . A shallow lake lies in the center of the cavern was fed by two freshwater rivers and drained by a third . The rivers left large plateaus upon which the drow dwelt ; slaves often dwelt in caves along the shores of the lake . The city ' s three plateaus were each dominated by one of three religious cults : Lolth ites held the largest plateau , located on the western side of the city . Vhaeraun ites dwelt on the northeastern plateau , and the southeastern plateau ( which was often flooded ) was home to followers of Ghaunadaur . History . Background . Eryndlyn was founded by drow seeking to reclaim the ancient elven realm of Miyeritar . They were not particularly religious , so unlike many other drow cities , Eryndlyn was not devoted to one particular deity .

title: Esalor Harumaar
description: Esalor Harumaar Esalor Harumaar was the field agent of the Moonstars for Cormanthyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Esalor was a half - elf ranger of wild elf descent from Semberholme .
description_long: Esalor Harumaar Esalor Harumaar was the field agent of the Moonstars for Cormanthyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Esalor was a half - elf ranger of wild elf descent from Semberholme . In 1370 DR , Esalor was chosen to be field agent of the Moonstars for Cormanthyr .

title: Esarhaddon
description: Esarhaddon Esarhaddon was the youngest of the leaders of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Esarhaddon planned to transform the Enclave into a political entity and attempt the conquest of the land .
description_long: Esarhaddon Esarhaddon was the youngest of the leaders of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Esarhaddon planned to transform the Enclave into a political entity and attempt the conquest of the land . He had made contacts with the bandit leader Furifax in order to spare the Enclave from the rebellion . Personality . Esarhaddon was young and impulsive , brilliant but impatient . He wanted Unther to become a magocracy and hated Gilgeam . He was so impatient that he might decide to support Furifax ' s plans . Esarhaddon was more interested in politics than magical research . Relationship . Esarhaddon was the apprentice of Isimud . He had a great following among the young apprentices but none of the masters supported his magocracy idea .

title: Esbresh
description: Esbresh Esbresh was a settlement near the Utter East and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn , lying on the shore of the Great Sea . There was a certain slaving ring based out of Luskan in far northwest Faerûn , fronted by one Inther Blackfeather , that reached all the way to Esbresh and Kelazzan . Appendix .
description_long: Esbresh Esbresh was a settlement near the Utter East and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn , lying on the shore of the Great Sea . There was a certain slaving ring based out of Luskan in far northwest Faerûn , fronted by one Inther Blackfeather , that reached all the way to Esbresh and Kelazzan . Appendix . Notes . Esbresh isn ' t mentioned in the Ulgarth chapter in " The Shining South " ( 1993 ) , nor does it appear on the maps , so it is unclear what relation it has to that kingdom . Kelazzan is described as the southernmost community of Ulgarth in " Shining South " ( 2004 ) , implying that Esbresh is not part of Ulgarth . It may be an independent city . This article only places it geographically in Ulgarth for organizational purposes .

title: Escalant
description: Escalant Escalant was a coastal city in Thay , in East Faerûn . As of 1357 DR , the city was independent of Thayan rule , but had been under Thayan control in the past . It was situated on the mouth of the River Lapendrar .
description_long: Escalant Escalant was a coastal city in Thay , in East Faerûn . As of 1357 DR , the city was independent of Thayan rule , but had been under Thayan control in the past . It was situated on the mouth of the River Lapendrar . Politics . Although the city was independent in 1357 DR , it maintained a loose association with Delthuntle , Laothkund , Lasdur , Murbant , Nethra , Taskaunt , Teth , and Thasselen , for mutual defense . Militia . The defenders of Escalant circa 1357 DR were a variety of troops hired as mercenaries . History . Escalant had been burned to the ground once prior to 1357 DR . In 1357 DR , the city was besieged by fire elemental s .

title: Esclarotta
description: Esclarotta Esclarotta was a cloud giant and the deceased wife of Blagothkus . Personality . Esclarotta greatly disliked all those cultists , dragon s , and kobold s inside her castle , but love her husband too much to act .
description_long: Esclarotta Esclarotta was a cloud giant and the deceased wife of Blagothkus . Personality . Esclarotta greatly disliked all those cultists , dragon s , and kobold s inside her castle , but love her husband too much to act . History . Esclarotta was once the wife of Blagothkus before she died . Somehow , he managed to resurrect her spirit and used her to manage the flying Skyreach Castle . If Blagothkus died for any reason , then he would replace Esclarotta as the spirit powering the castle . Presumably she would then go to the afterlife .

title: Escobert
description: Escobert Escobert the Red was a shield dwarf and the castellan of keep of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personailty . As master of the keep , Escobert knew all about the city ' s defenses and tunnels and sally port under it .
description_long: Escobert Escobert the Red was a shield dwarf and the castellan of keep of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personailty . As master of the keep , Escobert knew all about the city ' s defenses and tunnels and sally port under it . Description . Escobert was a dwarf with messy and unkept red hair . History . Around 1489 DR during the battle with the blue great wyrm Lennithon and the Cult of the Dragon , Escobert remained in command in the keep with the wounded governor Tarbaw Nighthill .

title: Eseldra Yeth
description: Eseldra Yeth Eseldra Yethwas a Red Wizard and the tharchion of Lapendrar from around the Year of the Emerald Ermine , 1387 DR , until the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Eseldra was a vampire and a follower of Szass Tam that was appointed tharchion of Lapendrar " circa " 1387 DR and remained in that position until the Tyranny of Dragons a century later .
description_long: Eseldra Yeth Eseldra Yethwas a Red Wizard and the tharchion of Lapendrar from around the Year of the Emerald Ermine , 1387 DR , until the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Eseldra was a vampire and a follower of Szass Tam that was appointed tharchion of Lapendrar " circa " 1387 DR and remained in that position until the Tyranny of Dragons a century later . She remembered well the War of the Zulkirs and to avoid a return to that time wanted to eradicate all exiled Red Wizard s . A band of adventurers who were working against the Cult of the Dragon convinced her to gather together all the other factions to thwart Rath Modar ' s faction because he planned to ally with Tiamat and conquer Thay .

title: Esh Alakar
description: Esh Alakar Esh Alakar was a site of ruins on the Pasocada River , in Long Canyon , Maztica . Nearby was the Bridge of the Ancients . Reputation .
description_long: Esh Alakar Esh Alakar was a site of ruins on the Pasocada River , in Long Canyon , Maztica . Nearby was the Bridge of the Ancients . Reputation . The origin of the ruins is not known but believed to be elven , possibly related to the Poscadar elves , who would not go near them , because they were alleged to be inhabited by ghost s or other malevolent creatures . The Nahopaca also refused to go near these ruins , because they feared what evil might be within . Inhabitants . Beneath the ruins were the remains of the inhabitants , who destroyed themselves in a magical war . Some were trapped within gems , after having suffered " trap the soul " . Others were turned into poisonous snake s that continued to inhabit the ruins . The backs of the snakes ' heads bore vague impressions of screaming faces on them . Stone golem s were scattered throughout the ruins , still waiting for commands from their long - dead masters . Some treasure , like gold , uncut gems , and magical item s , remained in the ruins , and some of it was guarded by traps .

title: Esham - Ana
description: Esham - Ana Esham - Ana was a dragonborn of Abeir , and the founder of Clan Yrjixtilex . History . Esham - Ana was a slave of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal .
description_long: Esham - Ana Esham - Ana was a dragonborn of Abeir , and the founder of Clan Yrjixtilex . History . Esham - Ana was a slave of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal . He worked on the mines located on the outskirts of Skelkor , and secretly hunted game in Gauwervyndhal ' s forest to provide food for his fellow slaves . When the Dragon Empress discovered that someone was hunting in her domains , she set her dragon vassals to search out the culprit . The bronze dragon Ororonymilith discovered that Esham - Ana was the thief and went to the mines to arrest him , but the other slaves rose in rebellion , killed Ororonymilith and fled from the mines . Eventually , Esham - Ana became the patriarch of his own clan , Clan Yrjixtilex .

title: Eshebala
description: Eshebala Eshebala is the Foxwoman deity of vanity , charm , greed and cunning . Her symbol is a female fox . Description Eshebala appears as a foxwoman , a shapely fur covered female with a fox ' s head or as a young elf maiden .
description_long: Eshebala Eshebala is the Foxwoman deity of vanity , charm , greed and cunning . Her symbol is a female fox . Description Eshebala appears as a foxwoman , a shapely fur covered female with a fox ' s head or as a young elf maiden . she is bedecked in rich clothing and jewels and carries a silver mirror . realm Eshebala ' s realm of Vulgarea can be found in the abyss . worshippers Eshebala is the patron of evil shapeshifters who use their wits and wiles before resorting to violence . She has many Foxwoman worshippers .

title: Eshowe
description: Eshowe The Eshowe were a Chult an tribe that was nearly extinct by 1370 DR . History . The Eshowe were one of the tribes that couatl s led from the Dark Continent to meet the god Ubtao on the Peaks of Flame in −2809 DR .
description_long: Eshowe The Eshowe were a Chult an tribe that was nearly extinct by 1370 DR . History . The Eshowe were one of the tribes that couatl s led from the Dark Continent to meet the god Ubtao on the Peaks of Flame in −2809 DR . They soon grew to become the one of the largest and most powerful tribes in Chult , second only to the Tabaxi . The Year of Dripping Daggers , −438 DR saw the beginning of a terrible civil war between the Tabaxi and Eshowe tribes . It would continue for nearly 300 years . Near the end of the bloody war , in the Year of Blooded Sunsets , −137 DR , the Eshowe somehow released an ancient Shadow Giant called Eshowdow , the " Shadow of the Eshowe " , which attacked the Tabaxi capital and holy city of Ubtao , Mezro . After nearly annihilating Mezro , Eshowdow turned on its summoners and wiped out nearly all of the Eshowe warriors . After this , Ras Nsi , one of the Chosen bara e of Ubtao , sought to wipe the surviving Eshowe from Toril in retaliation , and he nearly succeeded in this task , pursuing them all the way to the Valley of Lost Honor . Language . The Eshowe spoke Eshowan , which was unrelated to the language spoken by the Tabaxi . Rumors and Legends .

title: Eshpurta
description: Eshpurta Eshpurta , the " Shield City " of Amn , was a bustling military trade town in eastern Amn . Before the Sothillisian War in 1370 DR , Eshpurta contained about 70 , 000 townsfolk with another 10 , 000 in the surrounding ranches and farms . Additionally , there were 25 , 000 Amnian troops garrisoned in the city , bringing the approximate population to 105 , 000 .
description_long: Eshpurta Eshpurta , the " Shield City " of Amn , was a bustling military trade town in eastern Amn . Before the Sothillisian War in 1370 DR , Eshpurta contained about 70 , 000 townsfolk with another 10 , 000 in the surrounding ranches and farms . Additionally , there were 25 , 000 Amnian troops garrisoned in the city , bringing the approximate population to 105 , 000 . During the trade season , the population could reach 175 , 000 . During the war , a census in 1372 DR reported the population as less than 25 , 000 , which downgraded the once - thriving metropolis to a large city . Geography . Eshpurta was located at the confluence of Trifin Creek and the River Rimril where they merged to later join the Amstel River , which eventually flowed into Lake Esmel in the heart of Amn . Eshpurta was south of the Snakewood , south and west of the Troll Mountains , north of Trollford , and far to the east of Keczulla along the Eshpurta Road . Government . This fortified city had a strong military tradition and was governed by a council of six , called the Shield Council , whose members were the leaders of the local merchant families and clans .

title: Esklindrar Iol
description: Esklindrar Iol Esklindrar Iol was a sharp - tongued sage whose knowledge and memory of human lore along the Sword Coast surpassed that of anyone outside of Candlekeep . Description . Esklindrar had a white beard and appeared old , feeble , and a bit unsteady on his feet .
description_long: Esklindrar Iol Esklindrar Iol was a sharp - tongued sage whose knowledge and memory of human lore along the Sword Coast surpassed that of anyone outside of Candlekeep . Description . Esklindrar had a white beard and appeared old , feeble , and a bit unsteady on his feet . His looks may have been deceiving however , because his friend , the High Lady Alustriel Silverhand , was known to have cast several protective spells on him . Personality . Esklindrar was an irascible elderly man with a hunger for knowledge . Despite his appearance as a doddering old man , he had an excellent memory and a sharp tongue . Abilities . An expert in human writings , Esklindrar could remember every book he ' d seen , where he ' d seen it , and what it looked like . His knowledge of the Sword Coast area was the most extensive of anyone except a few Candlekeep scholars . As a result of being under the protection of Alustriel , he could surround himself with a spherical " wall of force " whenever he wished . His precious books , maps , and scrolls were guarded by " blade barrier s " that he could summon at will , even if the object had been stolen away .

title: Eskorn
description: Eskorn Eskorn , also known as the Wild Dragon Realm , was a human kingdom located in eastern Returned Abeir . Background . The realm was known as the Wild Dragon Realm not for its draconic past but for the Wilddragons , one of its former ruling families .
description_long: Eskorn Eskorn , also known as the Wild Dragon Realm , was a human kingdom located in eastern Returned Abeir . Background . The realm was known as the Wild Dragon Realm not for its draconic past but for the Wilddragons , one of its former ruling families . Eskorn was considered a backwater realm pretending to be a kingdom by the rest of the nations of Returned Abeir . Inhabitants . Although the former dragon lords of Eskorn had slaves from many humanoid races , after Eskorn was freed members of the demihuman races went to other lands , and Eskorn became a land inhabited mostly by humans . Government . The royal dynasty ( as of 1479 DR ) barely enforced the laws of the region , moving from one settlement to the next and the law of the land moved with them . The capital of Stormhelm was a small city on the Dragon Sea rife with political intrigue and backstabbing . Geography . Eskorn was composed of mostly wooded hills , streams , marshes , and many tiny ponds shrouded in mists at dawn and dusk . The wilderness was full of oxen , boars , venison , and groundfowl , wild turkeys that could grow as large as human children .

title: Eskornamundyr
description: Eskornamundyr Eskornamundyr was the dragon emperor of the realm of Eskorn , Laerakond , in the world of Abeir . History . Eskornamundyr was killed by rebel forces led by the legendary hero Aunglass Roaryl centuries before the Spellplague happened .
description_long: Eskornamundyr Eskornamundyr was the dragon emperor of the realm of Eskorn , Laerakond , in the world of Abeir . History . Eskornamundyr was killed by rebel forces led by the legendary hero Aunglass Roaryl centuries before the Spellplague happened . After his dead , Eskorn became a human - dominated realm . Legacy . The realm of Eskorn was named after him .

title: Eskrel Starbridge
description: Eskrel Starbridge Eskrel Starbridge was a highknight of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , during the Council of the Dragon Eskrel was busy with a secret mission out of Suzail .
description_long: Eskrel Starbridge Eskrel Starbridge was a highknight of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , during the Council of the Dragon Eskrel was busy with a secret mission out of Suzail . Later he helped Glathra Barcantle in find and stop what he believed was a Elminster Aumar ' s impostor .

title: Esmelflow
description: Esmelflow The Esmelflow was a collective term for a number of rivers in the northeast of Amn . Description . All of the rivers and streams within the Esmelflow ultimately fed Lake Esmel and were located north of that lake and the Amstel River , flowing south from the Ridge of the Cloud Peaks , the Snakewood , and the Qadim Hills of the Troll Mountains .
description_long: Esmelflow The Esmelflow was a collective term for a number of rivers in the northeast of Amn . Description . All of the rivers and streams within the Esmelflow ultimately fed Lake Esmel and were located north of that lake and the Amstel River , flowing south from the Ridge of the Cloud Peaks , the Snakewood , and the Qadim Hills of the Troll Mountains . Notable Rivers . Beginning from the west and heading east , the major rivers and streams that formed the Esmelflow included the Golden Creek and the Vudlur , which flowed from the Ridge and fed the Splendarrllur ; the Trifin Creek and the River Rimril , which flowed from the Snakewood ; and the Fireflow and Trollstooth Run , which flowed from the Qadim Hills and fed Khalleshyr .

title: Esmeltaran
description: Esmeltaran Esmeltaran was a halfling - dominated city in eastern Amn and lay to the northwest near Lake Esmel . The River Esmel , along with the lake , were both named after this city . Few halflings lived west of Esmeltaran , preferring to live in segregation in this city or in Riatavin , because these settlements were near the lost halfling realm of Meiritin .
description_long: Esmeltaran Esmeltaran was a halfling - dominated city in eastern Amn and lay to the northwest near Lake Esmel . The River Esmel , along with the lake , were both named after this city . Few halflings lived west of Esmeltaran , preferring to live in segregation in this city or in Riatavin , because these settlements were near the lost halfling realm of Meiritin .

title: Espar
description: Espar Espar was a hamlet in Cormyr , located north of Waymoot . As of 1368 DR , it consisted of about 120 stone buildings . It was ruled at that time by Lord Hezom .
description_long: Espar Espar was a hamlet in Cormyr , located north of Waymoot . As of 1368 DR , it consisted of about 120 stone buildings . It was ruled at that time by Lord Hezom . Espar was a farming town with one inn : The Watchful Eye , and a small shrine to Helm , where Lord Hezom , a priest of Helm , took care of the ill and wounded , when necessary . He was aided in this task by Gzelder Yespar , a reformed rogue . It was most notable for the swordcrafting of a local adventurer - turned - named Quiral . In 1022 DR , Elminster Aumar was looking for a band of adventurers for the Harpers . He found the Wanderers of Espar , led by Finder Wyvernspur , in Espar . The Knights of Myth Drannor also originated in Espar . History . In 1368 DR , Espar , along with Eveningstar , Tyrluk and Waymoot , was plagued by rogue dragons . Dove Falconhand temporarily moved to Espar with her husband , Florin Falconhand ( who was born in Espar ) , to bear her child . Trade . Animal pelts from the Thunder Peaks and the Storm Horns did very good business in Espar as of 1368 DR .

title: Esparin
description: Esparin Esparin was a kingdom until it was annexed into Cormyr in 1162 DR after the wedding of Queen Enchara and Cormyr ' s crown prince , Palaghard . Geography . The kingdom occupied most of the Stonelands .
description_long: Esparin Esparin was a kingdom until it was annexed into Cormyr in 1162 DR after the wedding of Queen Enchara and Cormyr ' s crown prince , Palaghard . Geography . The kingdom occupied most of the Stonelands . Inhabitants . The ruins were inhabited entirely by mad liches bound there by Vangerdahast ' s predecessors .

title: Essafah al - Jamila
description: Essafah al - Jamila Essafah al - Jamila was a sha ' ir and shopkeeper who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Essahah ' s shop , called Items for the Immortals , catered to genie s and other sha ' irs .
description_long: Essafah al - Jamila Essafah al - Jamila was a sha ' ir and shopkeeper who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Essahah ' s shop , called Items for the Immortals , catered to genie s and other sha ' irs . Essafah specialized in the creation of genie prison s , usually in the form of a lamp or bottle , though he claimed he could fashion a genie prison out of any container . He kept three such prisons within his shop . They contained a slayer genie , an efreeti , and a noble dao and sold for 2 , 000 dinar s . Relationships . A small fire gen served as Essafah ' s familiar . Since he was terrified that an angry genie would one day track him down and slay him , a pair of guardian genie s served as his loyal bodyguards .

title: Essafah al - Qadibi
description: Essafah al - Qadibi Essafah al - Qadibi was a sorcerer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Essafah ' s vanity was only matched by his cowardice .
description_long: Essafah al - Qadibi Essafah al - Qadibi was a sorcerer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Essafah ' s vanity was only matched by his cowardice . Despite this , he managed to find success on several dangerous assignments . Activities . Essafah aided holy slayer s of Hajama with his magic . He was a member of the holy slayer faction known as the Loyalists . He was chosen to lead a few dangerous missions where he swiftly dealt with magically warded opponents , earning him high praise from his fellow Loyalists . Possessions . Essafah owned a fez of disguise .

title: Essembra
description: Essembra Before it was abandoned in 1422 DR , Essembra was the largest town and centre of trade in Battledale . History . Essembra was settled when the Ordulin - Hillsfar road was cut through the Elven Court .
description_long: Essembra Before it was abandoned in 1422 DR , Essembra was the largest town and centre of trade in Battledale . History . Essembra was settled when the Ordulin - Hillsfar road was cut through the Elven Court . The town was named for the legendary adventuress Essembra ( really the song dragon Essembramaerytha ) . The statue to Aencar Burlisk was built on the site of her supposed birth . Her identity as a song dragon was revealed when she married a silver dragon . For centuries , Essembra was barely even a hamlet . When Aencar became the Warlord of Battledale in 1030 DR , he declared Essembra to be his seat since it was near his ancestral manor . Aencar ' s chief lieutenant , Ramorth Wyvernblade , took the title of lord of Essembra and built his manorhouse there . In 1422 DR Sembia ns allied with Netheril fought forces from Myth Drannor near Essembra . The battle forced abandonment of the town . Geography . Visitors usually found Essembra pleasant , but curiously unimpressive . Sitting astride Rauthauvyr ' s Road , the town saw a large amount of traffic on that road between Sembia and the Moonsea .

title: Essembramaerytha
description: Essembramaerytha Essembramaerytha was a song dragon who was known to non - dragon s as the legendary adventuress Essembra , for whom the town in Battledale was named . Description . In her human form , Essembra had red eyes and red hair .
description_long: Essembramaerytha Essembramaerytha was a song dragon who was known to non - dragon s as the legendary adventuress Essembra , for whom the town in Battledale was named . Description . In her human form , Essembra had red eyes and red hair . History . In 961 DR , Essembramaerytha was born in Battledale . At the time , the Dalelands were in a state of unrest and lawlessness , and when she grew up and was capable of defending herself , she quickly carved out a legendary reputation using her sword , her might , and her wit . Among her well - known deeds was when she spurned an elf lord ' s advancements , wrestled and choked to death a dwarf king with her bare hands , and many other great tales . She was also known for having had multiple lovers . Although it was assumed for years that she was more than a mere human woman , her true song dragon nature was revealed when she fell in love with the silver dragon Teskulladar . After they married , Essembra left behind her worldly wealth and achievements and traveled together with her husband across the Dalelands for many years until the day both disappeared without a trace .

title: Essylliss
description: Essylliss Essylliss was a demigod of the lizardfolk with dominion over their race , but he was nearly forgotten by them . Essylliss was considered an aspect of the World Serpent . History .
description_long: Essylliss Essylliss was a demigod of the lizardfolk with dominion over their race , but he was nearly forgotten by them . Essylliss was considered an aspect of the World Serpent . History . Following the creation of the lizardfolk race by the sarrukh , the World Serpent worried they would be distracted by the call of the many other gods and that they needed a deity of their own . Thus he created an fragment of himself in the semblance of a lizardman , Essylliss . Worship of Essylliss survived the decline of sarrukh rule in Mhairshaulk for some two millennia , until around −31 , 500 DR . However , the divided factions of lizardfolk eventually began to worship Semuanya , another fragment of the World Serpent representing the instinct to survive . By the 14th century DR , almost no trace of Essylliss survived and only a small number of lizardfolk continued to worship him . Among them was Kessessek , a low - placed lizardfolk of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp and cleric of this nearly forgotten god .

title: Estagund
description: Estagund Estagund was , alongside Durpar and Var the Golden , a part of the Shining Lands . As with all the Shining Lands , it was largely centered around trading . History .
description_long: Estagund Estagund was , alongside Durpar and Var the Golden , a part of the Shining Lands . As with all the Shining Lands , it was largely centered around trading . History . Estagund was conquered by Reinhar I and his arkaiun s in 551 DR , but quickly regained their independence when Reinhar was slain in Halruaa shortly thereafter by the archmage Mycontil . In 1023 DR Estagund invaded Dambrath . Not only did they fail to conquer the their neighbor , but the vengeful crinti attacked Estagund in retaliation , slaying most of the working age men throughout the country . Famine soon struck all of Estagund . Durpar jumped on the opportunity to pacify their violent neighbors and sent an emissary to negotiate terms with the king and nobles of Estagund . After days of negotiating , Dambrath purchased the country of Estagund for 24 gems . In return , they offered their full protection and showed taught them the way of Durpari life . A century later , Estagund was fully enveloped into the Shining Lands . Shou Lung was working intrigues to establish an enclave — a Shou Town — in Chavyondat in Estagund in the mid - 1370s DR .

title: Estanil
description: Estanil Estanil was a small burg located in northern Semphar on the banks of the River Estan near the Shalhoond forest . Description . The town of Estanil was considered a rarity in Semphar , for the fact that its buildings were made mostly out of wood , a rare resource in that land .
description_long: Estanil Estanil was a small burg located in northern Semphar on the banks of the River Estan near the Shalhoond forest . Description . The town of Estanil was considered a rarity in Semphar , for the fact that its buildings were made mostly out of wood , a rare resource in that land . The town was surrounded on three sides by a wooden stockade , and on the fourth by the waters of Gbor Nor . Built around a small harbor , the town ' s primary center was a collection of sawmills located on the River Estan . Most houses inside the city were two - stories high , though poorer farmers lived in smaller homes outside the stockade . Economy . Considered bustling for its size , the town was a major center of the lumber industry in the region , taking lumber from the nearby Shalhoond forest and shipping it to the other ports on Gbor Nor . Some of the lumber cut there was shipped as far as Thay and Mulhorand . Population . Largely independent in personality , the city contained a number of elves and goblin - kind , due to being so close to the forest . Each of these groups lived in different parts of the city , as riots and brawls between them were common .

title: Estelar Sunweaver
description: Estelar Sunweaver Estelar Sunweaver was an elf suprematist in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Estelar worked for the Serôs Aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok , acting as one of his agents on the surface .
description_long: Estelar Sunweaver Estelar Sunweaver was an elf suprematist in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Estelar worked for the Serôs Aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok , acting as one of his agents on the surface . History . In 1370 DR Estelar under doers of Gantar , disguised thank to his hat of disguise , followed the Company of the Anvil , after they had recovered " Sondarr Scepter " from a long - forgotten dwarven tomb in the Starspire Mountains . In Uktar 10 he was in the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth posing as the bard " Fylson Tarasp " . However in the inn were also the Shields of the Highland , depressed for the loss of two of their companions and demanded to Estelar to compose a dirge for their two fallen friends . Later that night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " and interrupting the ballad that Fylson was singing for Dumax . This greatly angered the Shields of the Highland .

title: Estele Greymantle
description: Estele Greymantle Estele Greymantle was a human woman and a priestess of Eldath . She was a noble lady in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . She was a retired adventurer and one of the wealthiest of the petty lords in the area .
description_long: Estele Greymantle Estele Greymantle was a human woman and a priestess of Eldath . She was a noble lady in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . She was a retired adventurer and one of the wealthiest of the petty lords in the area . She devoted herself to maintaining and regrowing woodlands in her domain .

title: Estellia Vizen
description: Estellia Vizen Estellia Vizen was a potter of Crack ' d Pots in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Estellia managed a clay laboratory , known to produce unattractive but very durable ceramics .
description_long: Estellia Vizen Estellia Vizen was a potter of Crack ' d Pots in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Estellia managed a clay laboratory , known to produce unattractive but very durable ceramics . She said she had such a long life thanks to the clay she collected from a certain place in the Sargauth river .

title: Estelner Ebonhawk
description: Estelner Ebonhawk Baron Estelner Ebonhawk was the head of Ebonhawk noble family of Cormyr in 1371 DR . He was young and unsure of him , and widely thought to be a dunderhead trying to look good to the Crown . He led a troop of lancers , but had no skill with the weapon himself .
description_long: Estelner Ebonhawk Baron Estelner Ebonhawk was the head of Ebonhawk noble family of Cormyr in 1371 DR . He was young and unsure of him , and widely thought to be a dunderhead trying to look good to the Crown . He led a troop of lancers , but had no skill with the weapon himself .

title: Estemal Talltankard
description: Estemal Talltankard Estemal Talltankard was a paladin of Arvoreen who around 1359 DR founded the military order of Arvoreen ' s Marchers , composed mostly of halfling s and some gnome s , to defend Tethyr . Personality . Estemal had strong determination , which helped him keep the Purple Hills region safer than most other areas during the Tethyrian Interregnum .
description_long: Estemal Talltankard Estemal Talltankard was a paladin of Arvoreen who around 1359 DR founded the military order of Arvoreen ' s Marchers , composed mostly of halfling s and some gnome s , to defend Tethyr . Personality . Estemal had strong determination , which helped him keep the Purple Hills region safer than most other areas during the Tethyrian Interregnum . History . During the Interregnum , Estemal and his warriors helped keep the Purple Marches secure . Estemal still led them by 1374 DR .

title: Estember Orntalar
description: Estember Orntalar Estember Orntalar was a priest of Oghma of Domes of Reason temple in the city of Procampur in the Vast . " Circa " 1369 DR , Orntalar held the position of High Loremaster Librarian at the Domes , but was engaged in an aggressive power struggle with fellow priests to succeed the missing Patriarch , Cullen Kordamant , and become leader of the Orthodox Church of Oghma . Orntalar was apparently set to win this position .
description_long: Estember Orntalar Estember Orntalar was a priest of Oghma of Domes of Reason temple in the city of Procampur in the Vast . " Circa " 1369 DR , Orntalar held the position of High Loremaster Librarian at the Domes , but was engaged in an aggressive power struggle with fellow priests to succeed the missing Patriarch , Cullen Kordamant , and become leader of the Orthodox Church of Oghma . Orntalar was apparently set to win this position .

title: Esvele Graycastle
description: Esvele Graycastle Esvele Greycastle was a human cleric of Shar and shadow adept . She was determined to fulfill her role as an exemplary worshiper of Shar . She was assigned to a secret temple in Urmlaspyr where she attempted to recruit new members to the church from the merchants of Sembia .
description_long: Esvele Graycastle Esvele Greycastle was a human cleric of Shar and shadow adept . She was determined to fulfill her role as an exemplary worshiper of Shar . She was assigned to a secret temple in Urmlaspyr where she attempted to recruit new members to the church from the merchants of Sembia . Of more note were her later attempts to create Dead - magic zone s in Cormyr and Shadowdale . Appearance . Esvele was of slim build and average height for her kind . She had curly brown hair down to her waist and amber eyes . She kept her emotions well guarded and only displayed those on her face that she wished to be known . Class . In " Lords of Darkness " ( 3rd edition , 2001 ) , Esvele is written as having 8 levels of cleric of Shar and 5 levels of shadow adept . However , in " " ( 3 . 5 edition , 2007 ) , she is written as having 13 levels of cleric of Shar alone . History . Early Years . Esvele was the middle daughter of a merchant family in Chondath . When her parents slumped into poverty after some poor trading decisions , they were approached by the clergy of the Church of Shar who offered them a substantial sum in gold for the purchase of thirteen - year - old Esvele .

title: Esvena Dyrr
description: Esvena Dyrr Esvena Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . Relationships . Esvena was the fourth daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr .
description_long: Esvena Dyrr Esvena Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . Relationships . Esvena was the fourth daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr . History . For their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan during the Silence of Lolth , her house ' s compound was besieged by House Xorlarrin and its allies . Esvena was present at the compound ' s bastions with her mother overseeing the situation . Yasraena discovered Gromph Baenre ' s infiltration of their compound , but by then it was too late .

title: Eternal Crimson
description: Eternal Crimson The Eternal Crimson served as the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The army of the efreet had around 100 , 000 soliders .
description_long: Eternal Crimson The Eternal Crimson served as the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The army of the efreet had around 100 , 000 soliders . General abd Multahib was their commander . Activities . Members of this organization served as main army for the efreet . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Eternal Crimson .

title: Eternal Flame Pavilion
description: Eternal Flame Pavilion The Eternal Flame Pavilion was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Eternal Flame Pavilion was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Eternal Flame Pavilion The Eternal Flame Pavilion was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Eternal Flame Pavilion was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description . This mosque was sheathed with finely beaten gold . Activities . The Eternal Flame Pavilion was dedicated to Agni , a fierce god who destroyed everything he touched with purifying flames . Since the priests of Agni preached the ideal of redemption and immortality , the worship of Agni was wildly popular among the common efreet , but only tolerated by the noble efreet who preferred to keep their subjects hard at work instead of praying .

title: Eternal Sun
description: Eternal Sun Eternal Sun was a plane of existence thought to be lost long ago but was found again after the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model . It was the astral dominion of Amaunator , who dwelt in the Palace of the Four Suns with his exarch , Siamorphe . The Palace was surrounded by Waukeen ' s Marketplace Eternal .
description_long: Eternal Sun Eternal Sun was a plane of existence thought to be lost long ago but was found again after the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model . It was the astral dominion of Amaunator , who dwelt in the Palace of the Four Suns with his exarch , Siamorphe . The Palace was surrounded by Waukeen ' s Marketplace Eternal .

title: Eth Junster
description: Eth Junster Eth Junster was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Eth was a young promising magelord .
description_long: Eth Junster Eth Junster was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Eth was a young promising magelord . However , he was sent to Narthil in 234 DR to quell a revolt started by Elminster . Eth was one of the first magelords killed by the young wizard .

title: Ethereal banishment
description: Ethereal banishment Ethereal banishment was an alteration spell that transported one creature to the Ethereal plane and kept it there for a limited time . It was often used on opponents , who had a chance to resist the magic . Components .
description_long: Ethereal banishment Ethereal banishment was an alteration spell that transported one creature to the Ethereal plane and kept it there for a limited time . It was often used on opponents , who had a chance to resist the magic . Components . Apart from verbal and somatic components this spell required either a drop of oil gained from a creature from the Ethereal Plane or a drop of " oil of etherealness " . Users . " Ethereal banishment " was a spell developed in the southern magic tradition of Mulhorand , Unther and Chessenta . There it was also simply known as etherealness , but was distinct from the related spell of the same name used elsewhere .

title: Ethereal barrier
description: Ethereal barrier Ethereal barrier was an abjuration spell that prevented encroachment by creatures moving through the Ethereal Plane . Effects . The wall ( s ) created by this spell were proof against creatures traveling through the Ethereal Plane by " phasing " , " dimension door " , " shadow walk " , or any other method of travel through the Border Ethereal adjacent to the plane of the caster ( usually the Prime Material Plane ) .
description_long: Ethereal barrier Ethereal barrier was an abjuration spell that prevented encroachment by creatures moving through the Ethereal Plane . Effects . The wall ( s ) created by this spell were proof against creatures traveling through the Ethereal Plane by " phasing " , " dimension door " , " shadow walk " , or any other method of travel through the Border Ethereal adjacent to the plane of the caster ( usually the Prime Material Plane ) . To those on the same plane as the caster , " ethereal barrier " was undetectable . This spell did not prevent travel through the Astral Plane ( " teleport " , " gate " , etc . ) . The area of effect was two 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) squares per level of the caster , arranged any way the priest desired . Multiple priests could cooperatively cast this spell for a greater duration , combining their areas of coverage . It took ten minutes to erect an " ethereal barrier " . Components . Besides verbal and somatic components , a compound of lead and rare earths was required . Estimated cost was 10 gp per square .

title: Ethereal marauder
description: Ethereal marauder An ethereal marauder was a predatory monster from the Ethereal Plane . Nilshai , sorcerers of that plane , were said to keep ethereal marauders as guardians . Description .
description_long: Ethereal marauder An ethereal marauder was a predatory monster from the Ethereal Plane . Nilshai , sorcerers of that plane , were said to keep ethereal marauders as guardians . Description . Marauders resemble blue or purple two - legged lizards with long , flexible tails . Having no neck to speak of , their massive mouth with its three mandibles was attached directly to the creature ' s body . The mouth was lined with black teeth . Between each pair of mandibles were one of its three tiny eyes . Marauders stood about four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall and tended to be seven feet ( 210 centimeters ) long , but some specimens could be double that size . They weighed a couple hundred pounds ( 90 kilograms ) on average . Behavior . The native behavior of ethereal marauders on their home plane was not well - known . Their forays into the Prime Material Plane occurred when they were hunting prey . They had no society or culture but behaved more similarly to natural wild animals . Survivors of their attacks claimed that they made an " eerie whine , " which varied in pitch depending on the monster ' s speed and condition Combat .

title: Ethereal plane
description: Ethereal plane The Ethereal plane was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Ethereal Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In the 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Ethereal plane existed adjacent to the Prime Material Plane and connected it to the Inner plane s ( the Elemental planes plus the Energy planes ) .
description_long: Ethereal plane The Ethereal plane was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Ethereal Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In the 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Ethereal plane existed adjacent to the Prime Material Plane and connected it to the Inner plane s ( the Elemental planes plus the Energy planes ) . The Ethereal touched the Prime at all points through what was called the Border Ethereal . The non - Border region was called the Deep Ethereal . While in the Border Ethereal , a traveler could still see into the adjacent plane but only dimly and not very far , whereas those on the bordering plane could not see the traveler without magical detection . Verbal communication was not possible between the Border Ethereal and the bordered plane . The Ethereal was unique among the many planes in that an individual could exist in two planes simultaneously : the Border Ethereal and the adjacent plane .

title: Ethereal stride
description: Ethereal stride Ethereal stride is a spell used by warlock s to enable them to fade out of the world for a split second , crossing into the Ethereal Plane or some equivalent thereof . When a warlock finishes the use of " ethereal stride " he or she finds themselves transplanted a distance of fifteen feet . The effects of the movement stick with the warlock a moment longer , however , making them slightly more difficult to attack due to their temporarily insubstantial nature .
description_long: Ethereal stride Ethereal stride is a spell used by warlock s to enable them to fade out of the world for a split second , crossing into the Ethereal Plane or some equivalent thereof . When a warlock finishes the use of " ethereal stride " he or she finds themselves transplanted a distance of fifteen feet . The effects of the movement stick with the warlock a moment longer , however , making them slightly more difficult to attack due to their temporarily insubstantial nature . " Ethereal stride " is straining on the warlock , but only slightly , and use of the spell can be regained with a rest of a few short minutes . The spell is similar to , but weaker , than the wizard spell " ethereal jaunt " .

title: Etherealness
description: Etherealness Etherealness was a transmutation spell made the caster travel to the Border ethereal . Effect . The older version of this spell functioned like ethereal jaunt except more targets could join the caster .
description_long: Etherealness Etherealness was a transmutation spell made the caster travel to the Border ethereal . Effect . The older version of this spell functioned like ethereal jaunt except more targets could join the caster . While the spell was active the caster could move about in the Ethereal plane , but only half as fast if descending or rising .
