The spell lasted for 8 hours , during this time the caster could see and hear in the the plane it was just on . If cast with a higher level the caster could have additional targets with it . Components . Vocal and somatic components where needed for the casting of this spell .

title: Ethoist
description: Ethoist Ethoists or Clerics of the Faith Ethical , were priests who primarily maintained the temples and mosques of Zakhara . They called for prayer , delivered sermons , and performed daily tasks required by their god . Requirements .
description_long: Ethoist Ethoists or Clerics of the Faith Ethical , were priests who primarily maintained the temples and mosques of Zakhara . They called for prayer , delivered sermons , and performed daily tasks required by their god . Requirements . Ethoists did not have any special requirements , though the spouse of a married ethoist needed to belong to the same religion . Role . Most ethoists were methodical individuals , carefully maintaining their daily routines and the happenings of their house of worship . Young ethoists were usually encouraged to go out and explore the world before returning for a more rigid lifestyle as a priest . These young ethoists were required to document their travels and activities . They would discuss their documentation with other ethoist priests whenever they reached a temple of their god . Possessions . Ethoists wore a turban adorned with a holy symbol of their god , usually made from precious metal . Ethoists also wore a shoulder vestment with their god ' s symbol . Benefits . All ethoists enjoyed great benefits from their temples including safe haven , monetary loans , companions , and assistants . Hindrances .

title: Ethur Anszim
description: Ethur Anszim Ambassador Ethur Anszim was the representative of the Red Wizards of Thay at their enclave within the city of Waterdeep . Personality . A witty yet unforgiving man , Ethur was often invited to the parties of Waterdhavian nobles who wish edto appear " daring " .
description_long: Ethur Anszim Ambassador Ethur Anszim was the representative of the Red Wizards of Thay at their enclave within the city of Waterdeep . Personality . A witty yet unforgiving man , Ethur was often invited to the parties of Waterdhavian nobles who wish edto appear " daring " . In secret , Ethur wished to control the city .

title: Etsi Hashoto
description: Etsi Hashoto Etsi Hashoto was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Esan in Fochu Peninsula and was a collector of butterflies .
description_long: Etsi Hashoto Etsi Hashoto was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Esan in Fochu Peninsula and was a collector of butterflies . In 1358 DR , he was trying to identify an unusual specimen . Eventually , he asked the counsel of Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party .

title: Etsu - no - kami Makoto
description: Etsu - no - kami Makoto Etsu - no - kami Makoto was a spirit folk samurai adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Makoto was born in Miyama to the samurai Etsu - no - kami Yasutoki and the spirit lady of a great willow .
description_long: Etsu - no - kami Makoto Etsu - no - kami Makoto was a spirit folk samurai adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Makoto was born in Miyama to the samurai Etsu - no - kami Yasutoki and the spirit lady of a great willow . Yasutoki held a small shoen until a plot in the provincial capital of Tamanokuni forced the shugo - daimyo to banish all the family and Yasutoki ' s position went to Inoue Kanemori of the Inoue clan . In 1357 DR , Yasutoki died and Makoto with his friend Saisho went back to Miyama in search of adventure . Behind the scenes . Makoto was a pre - created PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Ettercap
description: Ettercap An ettercap is one of a race of bestial spider - men aberration s located throughout Faerûn . Ettercaps are primitive , hunting Aberration s that have an affinity with spiders . Like spiders , they use webs as traps to capture prey , which is then injected with paralytic venom from the ettercap ’ s bite .
description_long: Ettercap An ettercap is one of a race of bestial spider - men aberration s located throughout Faerûn . Ettercaps are primitive , hunting Aberration s that have an affinity with spiders . Like spiders , they use webs as traps to capture prey , which is then injected with paralytic venom from the ettercap ’ s bite . Much like spiders , ettercaps tend to be solitary creatures , only gathering to mate . When ettercaps do socialize , it is with monstrous spiders , which they keep as pets and guards . An adult ettercap stands 6 feet tall and weighs 200 pounds . Physical description . Ettercaps resemble hunched , grey - purplish humanoid s with distended white underbellies , spider - like faces ( fangs and eyes and such ) , and two sharp , black chitinous claws instead of hands and feet . They are not particularly intelligent . Ettercaps possess the capability to shoot sticky webs and have an affinity for spiders . They are cowardly and vicious , and prefer to set traps to ensnare their enemies . Society . Ettercaps are very fond of spiders and other arachnids and often keep them as others keep bees .

title: Ettin
description: Ettin Ettin were giant s with two heads that were capable of independent thought and can each control one arm for attacking . Abilities . Typically , an ettin fought with two weapons , such as a morningstar and javelin .
description_long: Ettin Ettin were giant s with two heads that were capable of independent thought and can each control one arm for attacking . Abilities . Typically , an ettin fought with two weapons , such as a morningstar and javelin . Society . Ettins liked to make their homes in caves and underground settings . In Jotun the word " ettin " meant " runt " .

title: Euclase
description: Euclase Euclase was a rare precious stone found in the form of small crystals . Description . Euclase was easily cut into faceted gems and came in various colors ranging from colorless to pale yellow , vivid yellow , pale green , and blue .
description_long: Euclase Euclase was a rare precious stone found in the form of small crystals . Description . Euclase was easily cut into faceted gems and came in various colors ranging from colorless to pale yellow , vivid yellow , pale green , and blue . The blue hues commanded the highest price . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp . Powers . These gemstones had a dangerous and violet reaction to magic being cast upon them or upon a being wearing or carrying one . If successfully hit with a spell , a " flame strike " erupted from the euclase , destroying it in the process and damaging any creature or object in the area of effect .

title: Eudhis Bhamm
description: Eudhis Bhamm Eudhis Bhamm was a human male herbalist and the proprietor of Bhamm ' s Herbs in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . He had a surly disposition and was quick on the rejoinder . He was usually nervous and with good reason : he was a wizard in a land that had nearly outlawed wizardry .
description_long: Eudhis Bhamm Eudhis Bhamm was a human male herbalist and the proprietor of Bhamm ' s Herbs in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . He had a surly disposition and was quick on the rejoinder . He was usually nervous and with good reason : he was a wizard in a land that had nearly outlawed wizardry . With much persuasion , he could be convinced to allow potential customers into his " compounding room " where he had an almost complete stock of spell components for every occasion — at double the usual price .

title: Eulagad
description: Eulagad Eulagad the Maul was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Eulagad lived in the past , remembering the times where he fought evil with his dead companions .
description_long: Eulagad Eulagad the Maul was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Eulagad lived in the past , remembering the times where he fought evil with his dead companions . He was also concerned about the fact his line would end with him . Eulagad had seen the growth of the Port of Shadow into a large city . Relationship . Eulagad worked along with his former adventuring companion Ilyana Wyrmmruff . Activities . Around 1370 DR , Eulagad managed the Burning Troll inn with Ilyana . History . Eulagad was a famous adventurer with the Trollsinge Vanguard party and one of the few surviving members . With his companions , he explored deep into Undermountain , but they became most famous for their destruction of a marauding troll tribe . Eulagad retired after the death of his friends and for a long time managed an inn in Skullport .

title: Euripanee Thundershield
description: Euripanee Thundershield Euripanee Thundershield was a female dwarf mercenary in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Euripanee left Citadel Adbar for a life as a mercenary .
description_long: Euripanee Thundershield Euripanee Thundershield was a female dwarf mercenary in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Euripanee left Citadel Adbar for a life as a mercenary . In 1489 DR , during the Cult of the Dragon ' s coup in the city of Phlan , she and others were captured by the cultists led by Farnvik . Euripanee was freed by some adventurers .

title: Eusebius
description: Eusebius Eusebius was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Eusebius had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Eusebius Eusebius was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Eusebius had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven . Eusebius typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Possessions . Eusebius bore a sword in battle . History . By 1369 DR , the then - paramount of the storm giants of Mount Woe , Anastes , and five other storm giants were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . Eusebius was one of those giants . Eusebius was chosen to search the woods for a beehive to gather honey for Brianna to eat , but during this time , Tavis Burdun and armies of giant - kin attacked . Eusebius was then ordered by Anastes to deal with the fomorian s . However , the fomorians quickly abandoned the field to pursue Lanaxis , so Eusebius instead assisted Anastes by flanking the firbolg army .

title: Evaelathil
description: Evaelathil Evaelathil is a Baneblade of Demron in the shape of a short sword , sized for small wielders and usable only by halfling s . It glows with a soft green light when drawn . In addition to the standard baneblade abilities , Evaelathil grants its wielder resistance to fire and allows him or her to use " charm person " and " locate creature " each once per day .
description_long: Evaelathil Evaelathil is a Baneblade of Demron in the shape of a short sword , sized for small wielders and usable only by halfling s . It glows with a soft green light when drawn . In addition to the standard baneblade abilities , Evaelathil grants its wielder resistance to fire and allows him or her to use " charm person " and " locate creature " each once per day . Evaelathil was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , and is the first of his series of Baneblades .

title: Evaine
description: Evaine Evaine was a wizard in Phlan . Relationships . Evaine was an acquaintance of Shal Desanea .
description_long: Evaine Evaine was a wizard in Phlan . Relationships . Evaine was an acquaintance of Shal Desanea . History . Evaine lived in a small tower near the city of Phlan . Her duty was to protect the city from the evil of the pool of darkness . She lived with her cat familiar Gamaliel .

title: Evanara
description: Evanara House Evanara was an insular sun elf house . As of 1368 DR , it was led by the fighter - wizard Nylaathria Evanara . It was notable for producing war wizard s .
description_long: Evanara House Evanara was an insular sun elf house . As of 1368 DR , it was led by the fighter - wizard Nylaathria Evanara . It was notable for producing war wizard s . The house ' s estate was a large grassy compound filled with moon horse s and several small villas . The house colors were blue and white and its symbol featured a prancing white horse .

title: Evard ' s black tentacles
description: Evard ' s black tentacles Evard ' s black tentacles , or simply black tentacles , was a conjuration spell that conjured tentacles to grapple and restrain opponents . It was presumably developed by Evard . Effect .
description_long: Evard ' s black tentacles Evard ' s black tentacles , or simply black tentacles , was a conjuration spell that conjured tentacles to grapple and restrain opponents . It was presumably developed by Evard . Effect . This spell conjured many 10 - foot - long ( 3 meters ) rubbery black tentacles that erupted from flat surfaces and grabbed , grappled , and crushed everything in a 40 - foot - wide ( 12 meters ) area for a brief time according to the level of the caster . In a later version , the tentacles would try to restrain anything that entered or stayed in a 20 - foot - square ( 6 meters ) area , and cause bludgeoning damage , for up to a minute . The area that was covered by the tentacles would be difficult for creatures to traverse . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , as well as a piece of a tentacle from a giant octopus or squid . History . " Evard ' s black tentacles " was apparently unknown to the Netherese ; it was not recorded as known to them . By 759 DR , it was known only to southerner spellcasters . In the mid – 14th century DR , " Evard ' s black tentacles " was still a rare spell in the Realms .

title: Evelina Plaksina
description: Evelina Plaksina Evelina Plaksina was an earthsoul genasi and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , Evelina was part of the cell led by Yegor that pursued the dwarf Furgis Boltsmelter to take the elemental codex .
description_long: Evelina Plaksina Evelina Plaksina was an earthsoul genasi and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , Evelina was part of the cell led by Yegor that pursued the dwarf Furgis Boltsmelter to take the elemental codex . She was part of the cultists that attacked Furgis and his adventuring party bodyguards when they were confronted by a Hammer of Moradin squad near Mulmaster .

title: Evendur Highcastle
description: Evendur Highcastle Evendur Highcastle was an infamous pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars who rose as an undead Chosen of Umberlee during the Second Sundering . History . Before his death , Evendur was a notorious pirate lord .
description_long: Evendur Highcastle Evendur Highcastle was an infamous pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars who rose as an undead Chosen of Umberlee during the Second Sundering . History . Before his death , Evendur was a notorious pirate lord . In the wake of the Second Sundering , the goddess Umberlee resurrected him as her Chosen . Evendur was tasked to capture the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn , in order to perdure the Great Rains . He was defeated in 1486 DR by the combined forces of Anton Marivaldi , Umara Ankhlab , and the Turmish navy .

title: Evenhand
description: Evenhand Evenhand was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Evenhands contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .
description_long: Evenhand Evenhand was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Evenhands contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Eveningstar
description: Eveningstar Eveningstar is a small unwalled farming town of about fifty buildings located roughly 30 miles west of Arabel , in Cormyr . Eveningstar is located where the High Road crosses the Starwater River , Geography . Eveningstar is a pastoral village surrounded by fields and orchards situated in an elbow of the Starwater River just north of the King ' s Forest in Cormyr .
description_long: Eveningstar Eveningstar is a small unwalled farming town of about fifty buildings located roughly 30 miles west of Arabel , in Cormyr . Eveningstar is located where the High Road crosses the Starwater River , Geography . Eveningstar is a pastoral village surrounded by fields and orchards situated in an elbow of the Starwater River just north of the King ' s Forest in Cormyr . It stands at the intersection of the High Road , which runs west to High Horn and East to Arabel , and the Skywater Road ( known by locals as the " Suzail Road " or " Southrun " ) , which runs south to the village of Dhedluk in the King ' s Forest ( known by locals as the " Shadowood " ) . Immediately to the north of Eveningstar is the Eveningstar Gorge or the Starwater Gorge . The gorge , formed by the Starwater River as it flows down from the Storm Horn Mountains , provides relatively easy access to the Helmlands and the Storm Horns and is the only significant break in the limestone Stonecliff that runs from Tyrluk to the west to just short of Arabel . Economy .

title: Everard
description: Everard Everard was the head cleric of Tempus from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . Even within his temple , the war priest dressed in heavy armor , such as plate mail .
description_long: Everard Everard was the head cleric of Tempus from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . Even within his temple , the war priest dressed in heavy armor , such as plate mail . His body was covered in battle scars from his years of fighting to the righteous cause of Tempus Personality . As a member of the Order of the Broken Blade , Everard guarded the secret location of Jerrod ' s stone , but he felt Jerrod died in vain because the sign from Tempus meant the barbarian tribes were defeating the archmage Arakon and his demon s from the Lower planes . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , a messenger from Kuldahar was found dying outside the Temple of Tempus . After asking for the aid of Easthaven , Hrothgar decided to put together an expedition to Kuldahar , but Everard refused to travel into the Spine of the World .

title: Everbright
description: Everbright Everbright was a quality that could be applied to metal armor or weapons . The technique was well known by the sun elves of Evermeet . It made the item incredibly shiny and untarnishable , immune to rust and corrosion .
description_long: Everbright Everbright was a quality that could be applied to metal armor or weapons . The technique was well known by the sun elves of Evermeet . It made the item incredibly shiny and untarnishable , immune to rust and corrosion . When applied to weapons , the wielder could make it flash an extremely bright light twice per day , possibly dazzling those nearby . Creation . To craft " everbright " weapons or armor , one must have the spells " blindness deafness " and " searing light " available .

title: Everburning oil
description: Everburning oil Everburning oil , also called Greek fire by knowledgable wizards , was a mixture of oil and other substances designed for use in combat . It was easy to ignite but difficult to extinguish , and had a tendency to stick to anything it hit . Use .
description_long: Everburning oil Everburning oil , also called Greek fire by knowledgable wizards , was a mixture of oil and other substances designed for use in combat . It was easy to ignite but difficult to extinguish , and had a tendency to stick to anything it hit . Use . Everburning oil was sometimes employed in the defense of cities or as armament of ships in so - called Greek fire projectors or flame cannons . Distribution . In Zakhara it went by the name oil of stars or oil of liquid stars . The city of Qudra produced this dangerous substance , while the city of Ravens Bluff banned it in 1370 DR due to the risk it posed .

title: Everdusk Hall
description: Everdusk Hall Everdusk Hall , before being burnt to the ground , was one of the oldest and most revered temples within Silverymoon . Interior . The lower levels of this temple were decorated with many marble statues of the elven gods .
description_long: Everdusk Hall Everdusk Hall , before being burnt to the ground , was one of the oldest and most revered temples within Silverymoon . Interior . The lower levels of this temple were decorated with many marble statues of the elven gods . In the upper levels of the diamond - shaped hall was a library that contained many shelves filled with tomes and scrolls , all written in the Elven tongue . History . Long a place of worship for the elves of Silverymoon , Everdusk Hall was sadly burnt down by a mysterious fire in 1347 DR . Despite attempts by nearby Spellguard to quell the flames , the building had to be rebuilt from scratch . In 1369 DR , Everdusk Hall was still being run by the venerated elven priest , Loremaster Elaith Waterstill . Sometime before 1372 DR , the new Loremaster in charge was Vadalathra Rivermantle .

title: Evereska
description: Evereska Evereska ( " Eh - ver - Eh - ska " , elvish : " fortress home " ) was a fabled valley in the Western Heartlands , one of the last realms of the elves in the north . Founded in secret in - 8600 DR , Evereska became a haven for the remaining Fair Folk in Faerûn . Description .
description_long: Evereska Evereska ( " Eh - ver - Eh - ska " , elvish : " fortress home " ) was a fabled valley in the Western Heartlands , one of the last realms of the elves in the north . Founded in secret in - 8600 DR , Evereska became a haven for the remaining Fair Folk in Faerûn . Description . Evereska was in a valley encircled with twelve hills collectively known as the Shaeradim , which were sculpted into a large terraced garden , and inhabited by moon and sun elves . The houses were worked into the landscape and it was possible to float large items in the city . Blueleaf trees covered the valley and were sculpted by magic . Weather conditions and diseases were regulated by a magical mythal . Some elves spent their time in deep caverns to create new spells . Geography . Evereska itself was situated on a large stone pedestal that rose nearly a thousand feet from the grassland below . This was encircled by the Vine Vale , which was primarily agricultural land of vineyards and orchards . Outside of the vale were the Shaeradim : twelve hills that completely encircled Evereska so that it was not visible from the valley below .

title: Evereskan tomb guardian
description: Evereskan tomb guardian An Evereskan tomb guardian was a special prestige class for the elves of Evereska . Culture . To the elves of Evereska , nothing was more sacred than the bodies of the deceased and the countless tombs of great ancestors and heroes scattered around the region .
description_long: Evereskan tomb guardian An Evereskan tomb guardian was a special prestige class for the elves of Evereska . Culture . To the elves of Evereska , nothing was more sacred than the bodies of the deceased and the countless tombs of great ancestors and heroes scattered around the region . Unfortunately , the tales of buried treasures and magic items attracted many adventurers and defilers , seeking to strip the tombs of their precious items . The tomb guardians took a special oath to protect these tombs and to track , punish , and even kill the defilers — even if they had to chase them to the ends of the world . Tombs east of Evereska , on the border of the Anauroch desert , were frequently patrolled by tomb guardians , as they were a regular target of human and humanoid tomb robbers . Some tombs belonged to hated long - dead elven families , but nonetheless the tomb guardians upheld their oaths to protect these burial places . Entry . Those who sought to become tomb guardians had to have some degree of arcane spellcasting capability , combat ability , and skills in tracking , stealth , and alertness . They were typically sorcerer s who trained as a ranger or rogue . Abilities .

title: Everlasting
description: Everlasting The Everlasting , or the Brotherhood of the Everlasting , was perhaps the largest group of holy slayer s in Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Everlasting was a golden scimitar . Activities .
description_long: Everlasting The Everlasting , or the Brotherhood of the Everlasting , was perhaps the largest group of holy slayer s in Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Everlasting was a golden scimitar . Activities . Through an agreement with the Grey Fire , the territories of the Everlasting included the Free Cities of Zakhara , Qudra , Hiyal , Hilm , and Talab . It was not unheard of for either the Grey Fire or the Everlasting to operate outside of their territories by using the other ' s spy networks . Members . The Everlasting was ruled by the " Grandfather " who , in 1367 DR , was Marwan al - Jabal al - Hiyali . Factions . Known factions within the Everlasting included :

title: Everlasting fire
description: Everlasting fire Everlasting fire was an arcane evocation spell that conjured an always - burning flame . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .
description_long: Everlasting fire Everlasting fire was an arcane evocation spell that conjured an always - burning flame . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects . The spell opened a tiny " gate " to the Elemental Plane of Fire and summoned forth a fire , as large as would appear on a lit torch . It was a perfectly natural flame , but as its origins were on an elemental plane , it burned continuously , without need of fuel or air . It would burn even underwater or when covered over with earth . It never went out and could only be extinguished with a " dispel magic " or stronger spell . It would of course burn anything flammable The spell had to be cast upon on an object , typically of stone or metal or something else nonflammable . It could be even mounted on a magical construct , provided it wasn ' t inflammable , but never on any other creature . Usage . An " everlasting fire " could potentially be used to make an always - burning fire , like a " continual flame " was used to make an everburning torch , though with the added benefit — and hazard — of generating heat and being able to burn other items .

title: Everlund
description: Everlund Everlund ( formerly Besander ' s Blockhouse ) was a city of merchant traders and caravan teams and was one of the greatest supporters of the league of the Silver Marches . Located southeast of Silverymoon and situated on the north bank of the River Rauvin , Everlund was the second largest city in the Silver Marches and one of its most active mercantile communities . History .
description_long: Everlund Everlund ( formerly Besander ' s Blockhouse ) was a city of merchant traders and caravan teams and was one of the greatest supporters of the league of the Silver Marches . Located southeast of Silverymoon and situated on the north bank of the River Rauvin , Everlund was the second largest city in the Silver Marches and one of its most active mercantile communities . History . The walled city was resettled by humans from Ascalhorn on the site of Besander ' s Blockhouse in 515 DR . Since its humble beginnings as a fortified trading outpost and bridgehead on the Rauvin , the city ' s population and importance increased so that it became one of the most important trading cities in the region . Government . For nearly five hundred years , ( before 1372 DR ) Everlund was ruled by the Council of Elders . This group was composed of the people holding the most prominent positions in the city , although there was occasional debate over whether some civic figures were important enough to merit a seat on the council . The council was led by the First Elder , an office granted by vote of the others .

title: Everlund Pass
description: Everlund Pass The Everlund Pass was the road from Everlund to Silverymoon , which crossed the eastern end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The rough trail ran roughly on the eastern side of the River Rauvin , sometimes hundreds of feet above the river , and it snaked far away from the rushing waters into dangerous hills .
description_long: Everlund Pass The Everlund Pass was the road from Everlund to Silverymoon , which crossed the eastern end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The rough trail ran roughly on the eastern side of the River Rauvin , sometimes hundreds of feet above the river , and it snaked far away from the rushing waters into dangerous hills . Inhabitants . Many monsters roamed the area surrounding the valley , but patrols from Silverymoon and Everlund " mostly " kept the path clear .

title: Evermead
description: Evermead Evermead was a liquor crafted by the elves of Evermeet . Outside of the elven homeland , it was only sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Evermead Evermead was a liquor crafted by the elves of Evermeet . Outside of the elven homeland , it was only sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Evermead was the highest prized liquor consumed by the elves . The process by which Evermead was made remained unknown , but it was rumored to be aged for centuries before consumption . A single sip of this fine drink was said to be like tasting the higher planes themselves . Prices . Evermead could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Evermeet
description: Evermeet Evermeet , sometimes known as the Green Isle , is the final destination for all non - drow Tel ' Quessir ( meaning elves and eladrin ) from Faerûn . As of 1368 DR it is under the reign of Amlaruil Moonflower , a moon elf and a widow of Zaor Moonflower , a moonblade wielder who was killed by a sun elf . She rules from its capital city of Leuthilspar , and is home to many prominent Tel ' Quessir houses , including the Durothil s .
description_long: Evermeet Evermeet , sometimes known as the Green Isle , is the final destination for all non - drow Tel ' Quessir ( meaning elves and eladrin ) from Faerûn . As of 1368 DR it is under the reign of Amlaruil Moonflower , a moon elf and a widow of Zaor Moonflower , a moonblade wielder who was killed by a sun elf . She rules from its capital city of Leuthilspar , and is home to many prominent Tel ' Quessir houses , including the Durothil s . Evermeet is seen as the last true kingdom of the Tel ' Quessir , which very few non - elves have ever been permitted to visit . As of 1479 DR Evermeet resides primarily in the Feywild , the inhabited cities having all but disappeared from the Prime Material Plane . Queen Amlaruil Moonflower is gone , and a Royal Council rules in her place . However , the natural landscape of the island itself remains on the Prime , albeit uninhabited and with strong ties to its fey counterpart . It does sometimes act as a crossover between the Feywild and Faerûn . It can only be traveled to ( from and to the Prime Material Plane ) under the stars by a secret oceanic route . Geography .

title: Evermeet : Island of Elves
description: Evermeet : Island of Elves Evermeet : Island of Elves is a stand - alone novel by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The book is shaped as an elven history opera written by Danilo Thann .
description_long: Evermeet : Island of Elves Evermeet : Island of Elves is a stand - alone novel by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The book is shaped as an elven history opera written by Danilo Thann . In the first part of the book , it is narrated of the gods of the elven pantheon and in particular of the betrayal of Araushnee , who wanted to remove her partner and lover Corellon Larethian to gain his powers . To achieve that , she obtained the help of several other evil deities , eventually causing a gods war . Just when her plans were close to accomplishment , Sehanine Moonbow reported the dark elf goddess crimes and the Seldarine banished her to the Abyss and her son Vhaeraun , who helped her , to a mortal world . Araushnee ' s daughter , Eilistraee , also chose exile , having been unwittingly involved in her mother ' s plans . In the second part of the book , it is narrated of the elven heroes from the Dawn Age until their leave to Evermeet .

title: Evermoor Way
description: Evermoor Way The Evermoor Way is the road from Triboar to Bridge Gate in Everlund , although " The Savage Frontier " states that it extends to Silverymoon . Everlund has taken on the responsibility of keeping the road clear of danger from Everlund to Calling Horns , however has been hard pressed to do so in recent times .
description_long: Evermoor Way The Evermoor Way is the road from Triboar to Bridge Gate in Everlund , although " The Savage Frontier " states that it extends to Silverymoon . Everlund has taken on the responsibility of keeping the road clear of danger from Everlund to Calling Horns , however has been hard pressed to do so in recent times .

title: Evermoors
description: Evermoors The Evermoors , or Trollmoors , was a region of bog - pocketed hills , long rolling vistas , rocky ridges , and small peaks hiding deposits of valuable ore . It was located along the western edge of the Silver Marches . Geography .
description_long: Evermoors The Evermoors , or Trollmoors , was a region of bog - pocketed hills , long rolling vistas , rocky ridges , and small peaks hiding deposits of valuable ore . It was located along the western edge of the Silver Marches . Geography . The Evermoors were bound by the River Surbrin and the Lower Rauvin Vale to the north , the River Surbrin and the Surbrin Hills to the west , and the Silverwood to the east . To the south and east was open land and the High Forest . The river Laughingflow originated deep within the Evermoors , meeting the River Surbrin after it passed though the Surbrin Hills . Evermoor Way , the major route from Yartar to Everlund , passed between the Evermoors and the High Forest . Description . The moors were formed by large rocky plateaus , here and there interspersed by very steep small gorges dug by the water . Though if tors and rocky outcrop were visible everywhere , most of the area was covered with a thin layer of soil . The landscape was sterile , ventilated and full of grassy wavy hills . Shifting sands surrounded by a plenty of rare plants were formed in the depth of the region .

title: Evernight
description: Evernight Evernight was the dismal echo of Neverwinter located in the Shadowfell . It was a city of the undead and those that trafficked with them — unhinged necromancer s , slave traders , and followers of dark deities . Description .
description_long: Evernight Evernight was the dismal echo of Neverwinter located in the Shadowfell . It was a city of the undead and those that trafficked with them — unhinged necromancer s , slave traders , and followers of dark deities . Description . The whole city was in disrepair , as if the wood and stone that held the buildings together had the life leeched out of them , becoming rotten and crumbling . The few streets paved with cobblestones were cratered with potholes , and the rest were lanes and alleys filled with grave - dirt trodden and scuffed into a fine dust . The atmosphere was damp with a chill wind under a perpetually gray sky . Government . The city was controlled by a caste of intelligent ghoul s . Trade . Evernight imported live meat . Those that were lucky became slaves , those that were unlucky became meals . Inhabitants . The vast majority of the residents were undead , such as ghouls , vampire s , wight s , and zombie s . Other races were represented on an individual basis .

title: Evil
description: Evil In 4th edition , evil individuals were people who , using rules and order to give them power , took advantage of their position for personal gain , disregarding the well - being of others . They didn ' t go out of their way to cause harm , but didn ' t care if they did . They supported rigid caste structures and slavery , as long as it benefited them .
description_long: Evil In 4th edition , evil individuals were people who , using rules and order to give them power , took advantage of their position for personal gain , disregarding the well - being of others . They didn ' t go out of their way to cause harm , but didn ' t care if they did . They supported rigid caste structures and slavery , as long as it benefited them . The evil alignment represented a moral code similar to those of lawful evil and neutral evil alignments from previous editions .

title: Evil eye
description: Evil eye The evil eye was a unique power present in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . It was widely believed that every genie had the innate ability to cause misfortune to befall another simply by looking at them in a distasteful manner .
description_long: Evil eye The evil eye was a unique power present in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . It was widely believed that every genie had the innate ability to cause misfortune to befall another simply by looking at them in a distasteful manner . The effects of this curse ranged from a slight case of bad luck to full - blown tragedy . Being magical creatures , genies did not need to be physically present before an individual to invoke this power . They could curse someone with the evil eye simply by spying on them from afar . The evil eye was not necessarily a magical ability , but rather a simple part of life in a land full of genies . The simplest way to get cursed with the evil eye was to fail to exhibit modesty when presented with a compliment or praise . Performing amazing feats and then boasting about them usually made genies jealous . An individual could only remove the evil eye curse through the " avert evil eye " spell , a " remove curse " spell , or by performing a specific quest .

title: Evlyn
description: Evlyn Evlyn was a Moonstone Mask employee in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . If the Kalach - Cha and the companions entered the establishment , she would scold them if they did not spend any money at the establishment .
description_long: Evlyn Evlyn was a Moonstone Mask employee in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . If the Kalach - Cha and the companions entered the establishment , she would scold them if they did not spend any money at the establishment . Later , when Ammon Jerro came with the demons , she stood in his way . This proved a fatal mistake , since she died .

title: Evocation
description: Evocation The evocation school of magic included spells that manipulated energy or tapped an unseen source of power in order to produce a desired end . In effect , they created something out of nothing . Many of these spells produced spectacular effects , and evocation spells could deal large amounts of damage .
description_long: Evocation The evocation school of magic included spells that manipulated energy or tapped an unseen source of power in order to produce a desired end . In effect , they created something out of nothing . Many of these spells produced spectacular effects , and evocation spells could deal large amounts of damage . Many iconic offensive spells such as magic missile , lightning bolt and fireball were of the evocation school . The evocation school had no subschools . A wizard who specialized in evocation was known as an " evoker " . Notes . In 2nd edition D & D , this school was known as Invocation / Evocation , a specialist in this school was called an invoker .

title: Exaction
description: Exaction Exaction was a divine evocation and alteration spell that summoned a planar being to strike a bargain for a service . Effects . Possible creatures that could be summoned from another plane of existence included devas , devil s , and demon s , but nothing as powerful as a demigod .
description_long: Exaction Exaction was a divine evocation and alteration spell that summoned a planar being to strike a bargain for a service . Effects . Possible creatures that could be summoned from another plane of existence included devas , devil s , and demon s , but nothing as powerful as a demigod . The caster needed knowledge of the creature to use as leverage for striking a bargain , or else he or she had to offer something in fair trade , possibly a gift , monetary compensation , forgiving a debt , a favor , or a service in return . Creatures of opposing alignment ( good " vs . " evil , lawful " vs . " chaotic , or true neutral " vs . " any of those ) to the caster could not be summoned unless it was willing . Once a reasonable balance had been achieved between the task requested , the previous debt or promised favor , the relative risk to the creature , and the value of the compensation , " etc . " , then the spell took the form of a " quest " on the summoned creature . The creature got one chance to resist the spell , but it was typically automatically binding if the creature was willing or found the terms favorable .

title: Exalted Mamluk Society
description: Exalted Mamluk Society The Exalted Mamluk Society , also known as the Exalted , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Exalted were bitter rivals with the Devoted , leading to frequent conflicts in the region of the Cities of the Pantheon .
description_long: Exalted Mamluk Society The Exalted Mamluk Society , also known as the Exalted , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Exalted were bitter rivals with the Devoted , leading to frequent conflicts in the region of the Cities of the Pantheon . Organization . The Exalted were led by Jamala Abd Al - Raffa , the Most Respected Warrior . The Exalted was a moralist group dedicated to making Zakhara more civilized and law - abiding . Base of Operations . I ' tiraf and Hilm were the primary bases of operation for the Exalted .

title: Exarch
description: Exarch Exarchs are beings of extraordinary power . Exarchs are often called demigods ( but note that exarchs are not gods ( as in Demigod s ) of demipower status ( despite the name ) ) or heroes . Many are ascended mortal servants of greater gods , brought up from the world to serve as agents of their divine masters .
description_long: Exarch Exarchs are beings of extraordinary power . Exarchs are often called demigods ( but note that exarchs are not gods ( as in Demigod s ) of demipower status ( despite the name ) ) or heroes . Many are ascended mortal servants of greater gods , brought up from the world to serve as agents of their divine masters . Many , but not all , attract worshipers of their own , and they have some ability to grant spells , but are more often simply conduits from the mortal world to the attention of the higher gods . The divine hierarchy of a deity has exarchs at the top , just under the deity , and other divine servitors under them ( known as " proxies " in older editions ) A Chosen is not the same as an exarch , though it is possible for a Chosen to ascend to the rank of exarch . An exarch can be any Chosen , Demigod , Saint , archangel , or being of power that pledges their service to a particular Deity . The exarch gains no additional powers from this relationship as they are normally of considerable power already to earn the position .

title: Exile
description: Exile Exile is the second book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Exile Exile is the second book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book two of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . The story begins 10 years after the events of Homeland , the events begin in Menzoberranzan , where Matron Malice and the rest of the Do ' Urden family are waging war with House Hun ' ett still . With the help of renegade Jarlaxle and his group Bregan D ' aerthe , the Do ' Urden family win the fight moving them to Eighth position in the Menzo hierarchy . Meanwhile , Drizzt is living out in the wilds of the Underdark . He lives in a small cavern inhabited by himself and a group of Fungus - men or Myconids . The story starts with Drizzt fighting a basilisk invading his territory , which he defeats . He then hears voices from down a few corridors and decides to investigate . He uses his levitation skills to fly onto a ridge to watch . A group of svirfnebli ( deep gnomes ) are mining , and Drizzt watches over them for a while . When the Gnomes have filled their wheel - barrows to the top , they leave to return home .

title: Exorcessum
description: Exorcessum Exorcessum was a greatsword created by gods outside of Toril wielded by the deva Demascus . It had magic runes on each side which allowed Demascus to call magical abilities . The runes on one side were red and contained martial abilities while the runes on the other side were white and cast beneficial magic .
description_long: Exorcessum Exorcessum was a greatsword created by gods outside of Toril wielded by the deva Demascus . It had magic runes on each side which allowed Demascus to call magical abilities . The runes on one side were red and contained martial abilities while the runes on the other side were white and cast beneficial magic . The sword had multiple configurations and could be split to form two long swords . The final configuration was said to blaze as hot as a star with the capability of incinerating a god .

title: Expedition to Undermountain
description: Expedition to Undermountain Expedition to Undermountain is a combination sourcebook / campaign adventure for adventurer levels 1 - 10 . This is the D & D 3rd edition supplement for Undermountain . The book is split into an Introduction , briefly describing Halaster ' s death and a synopsis of the adventure , the first chapter , which briefly describes Undermountain , with maps of most levels and sublevels , chapters 2 - 5 , which are the campaign adventure , and an appendix of new creatures , such as the Eyeball Swarm , and new items , such as the Crown Adamant .
description_long: Expedition to Undermountain Expedition to Undermountain is a combination sourcebook / campaign adventure for adventurer levels 1 - 10 . This is the D & D 3rd edition supplement for Undermountain . The book is split into an Introduction , briefly describing Halaster ' s death and a synopsis of the adventure , the first chapter , which briefly describes Undermountain , with maps of most levels and sublevels , chapters 2 - 5 , which are the campaign adventure , and an appendix of new creatures , such as the Eyeball Swarm , and new items , such as the Crown Adamant .

title: Expeditious retreat
description: Expeditious retreat Expeditious retreat was an evocation spell that made the caster faster . Effect . The caster became allot quicker being able to walk , run or shift doubly as fast as normal .
description_long: Expeditious retreat Expeditious retreat was an evocation spell that made the caster faster . Effect . The caster became allot quicker being able to walk , run or shift doubly as fast as normal . The spell lasted differently depending on what type of magical consistency was in the world . Before the Spellplague it later longer depending on skill after it , it lasted very briefly and after the Second Sundering it lasted up to 10 minutes . Components . Only vocal and somatic components where needed .

title: Exploit
description: Exploit An exploit was a unique ability granted to a specific character class or role . Examples included exploits that allowed a fighter to better attack enemies or defend allies ; enabled a ranger to become preternaturally skillful and deadly with weapons ; gave a rogue an edge in strength , agility , or cunning ; and granted a warlord the ability to lead and inspire .
description_long: Exploit An exploit was a unique ability granted to a specific character class or role . Examples included exploits that allowed a fighter to better attack enemies or defend allies ; enabled a ranger to become preternaturally skillful and deadly with weapons ; gave a rogue an edge in strength , agility , or cunning ; and granted a warlord the ability to lead and inspire .

title: Explosive pyre
description: Explosive pyre Explosive pyre is a conjuration spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " explosive pyre " he or she places a storm of flames around a target of his or her choice within fifty feet of themselves . Any creature caught within this small storm , roughly five feet in diameter , during the next moment is scorched by its flames .
description_long: Explosive pyre Explosive pyre is a conjuration spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " explosive pyre " he or she places a storm of flames around a target of his or her choice within fifty feet of themselves . Any creature caught within this small storm , roughly five feet in diameter , during the next moment is scorched by its flames . " Explosive pyre " taxes the energy of a sorcerer slightly and requires a short rest of a few minutes or more before it can be cast again .

title: Explosive runes
description: Explosive runes Explosive runes was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that booby - trapped written or drawn information to prevent unauthorized viewing . Effects . This spell could be applied to written information in the form of a map , book , scroll , or a similar item containing written information .
description_long: Explosive runes Explosive runes was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that booby - trapped written or drawn information to prevent unauthorized viewing . Effects . This spell could be applied to written information in the form of a map , book , scroll , or a similar item containing written information . The abjuration version of this spell was limited to one object weighing 10 lb ( 4 . 5 kg ) or less . The alteration version had no such limit and presumably could be used on dwarven runestones and the like . The caster traced the " runes " onto the document where they blended with the writing , remaining dormant until viewed by an unauthorized person . The caster and anyone he or she specifically gave instruction on how to bypass the " runes " could read the material safely . When an unauthorized attempt to read the protected material was made , the runes exploded violently , damaging or destroying the warded writings and anyone within a 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) radius . The reader and those that were close enough to read the " runes " at the time of detonation took the full blast , while those that were just in the vicinity had a chance to resist or dodge part of the blast .

title: Exterminators
description: Exterminators Founded by a wind mage named Akil Festir , the Exterminators were an adventuring company whose main purpose was to rid Huzuz of elemental vermin , particularly the warehouses . Organization . Rather lax by most adventuring company standards , the Exterminators did not have strict requirements for membership .
description_long: Exterminators Founded by a wind mage named Akil Festir , the Exterminators were an adventuring company whose main purpose was to rid Huzuz of elemental vermin , particularly the warehouses . Organization . Rather lax by most adventuring company standards , the Exterminators did not have strict requirements for membership . Nearly anyone who wanted to join could get an appointment with Akil . The lack of discipline often resulted in different groups of Exterminators fighting each other over the right to kill vermin in order to claim the reward . Relationships . The Exterminators also clashed with mamluk s and city guards on a regular basis . Their reputation outside of the Warehouse District of Huzuz was practically nonexistent .

title: Extinction
description: Extinction Extinction by Lisa Smedman is the fourth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The group of drow adventurers — Quenthel Baenre , Pharaun Mizzrym , Jeggred Baenre , Valas Hune , Ryld Argith , Halisstra Melarn , and Danifae Yauntyrr - - continue to seek answers about the Silence of Lolth after fleeing House Jaelre .
description_long: Extinction Extinction by Lisa Smedman is the fourth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The group of drow adventurers — Quenthel Baenre , Pharaun Mizzrym , Jeggred Baenre , Valas Hune , Ryld Argith , Halisstra Melarn , and Danifae Yauntyrr - - continue to seek answers about the Silence of Lolth after fleeing House Jaelre . Quenthel sends Halisstra to Menzoberranzan to report on their progress , then orders Pharaun to summon the glabrezu Belshazu in order to determine a way to return to the Demonweb Pits . While the others are distracted with the demon , Ryld sneaks off to join Halisstra . After this point , the novel revolves around three distinct plot threads . After abandoning the group , Halisstra and Ryld run into followers of Eilistraee once again . Halisstra , her faith in Lolth now shaken , decides to convert to the worship of Eilistraee , despite Ryld ' s doubts . The two continue to develop a relationship that they even come to term " love , " an emotion usually unknown to the drow .

title: Extract water elemental
description: Extract water elemental Extract water elemental is a brutal and efficient way to summon an ally in a waterless region . History . The mage Akhlaur used a much stronger version of this spell when he was brought back to Faerûn by the elf Kiva .
description_long: Extract water elemental Extract water elemental is a brutal and efficient way to summon an ally in a waterless region . History . The mage Akhlaur used a much stronger version of this spell when he was brought back to Faerûn by the elf Kiva . He extracted one huge water elemental out of the body of many soldiers of the army of Mulhorand and Halruaa to destroy the Mulhorandi . When the elemental tried to destroy the Halruaans they killed it with the might of their gathered wizards and mages . Effects . The mage just needs some unhappy creature of flesh and blood . If he then uses the spell upon the living being it will extract the body fluids and if the creature is slain by this those fluids will reform into a Water elemental of similar size and weight . The elemental is for one minute under the total control of the spellcaster . The only beings immune to the spell are such of the fire subtype . Material components . The spell needs a somatic and vocal component .

title: Eye agate
description: Eye agate Eye agate was a special form of banded agate found in the Realms . Description . Eye agate was similar to banded agate but with the layers within the stone arranged in rings .
description_long: Eye agate Eye agate was a special form of banded agate found in the Realms . Description . Eye agate was similar to banded agate but with the layers within the stone arranged in rings . These rings came in a variety of colors , typically gray , white , brown , grayish blue , and drab green . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Like banded agates , these ornamental stones were often ground up and used in sleeping draughts , though their effectiveness was unknown and the practice was attributed to folklore .

title: Eye of Blazing Rorn
description: Eye of Blazing Rorn The Eye of Blazing Rorn was a powerful dragon artifact . Description . The Eye of Blazing Rorn was literally the eye of the primordial Rorn .
description_long: Eye of Blazing Rorn The Eye of Blazing Rorn was a powerful dragon artifact . Description . The Eye of Blazing Rorn was literally the eye of the primordial Rorn . It had the form of a ruby . Abilities . The Eye of Blazing Rorn had the ability to channel the fury of Rorn , detonating powerful explosions of heat . History . The dragons created this artifact by using one of the eyes of Rorn , who lost it during the War of Fang and Talon . The dragonborn of Tymanchebar stole it from its custodian , a silver dragon named Asativarainuth . The dragonborn used the Eye during the Battle of the Crippled Mountain to destroy the Celestial Mountain by trowing the Eye into the mountain , that was actually a sleeping volcano , triggering a powerful explosion that not only destroyed the mountain but also killed the red dragon Rhodrolytharnestrix . It its unknown what happened to the artifact after the destruction of the mountain .

title: Eye of Horus - Re
description: Eye of Horus - Re The Eye of Horus - Re was a special class of cleric s faithful to the chief deity of the Mulhorandi pantheon , Horus - Re . Among their ranks were those who crusaded against servants of Set and their undead minions . Unlike other organizations of Mulhorand , they were not tied to the pharaoh and followed their own hierarchical structure .
description_long: Eye of Horus - Re The Eye of Horus - Re was a special class of cleric s faithful to the chief deity of the Mulhorandi pantheon , Horus - Re . Among their ranks were those who crusaded against servants of Set and their undead minions . Unlike other organizations of Mulhorand , they were not tied to the pharaoh and followed their own hierarchical structure . They could be found in any place where followers of Set or the undead existed .

title: Eye of Justice
description: Eye of Justice The Eye of Justice was a religious sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God , a belief that held the gods Torm , Helm and Tyr were one and the same . Although the church was regarded as a heresy by Torm ' s followers , Torm apparently granted power to some of its members . The order was governed by the Council of Vigilent Seers and had few female members .
description_long: Eye of Justice The Eye of Justice was a religious sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God , a belief that held the gods Torm , Helm and Tyr were one and the same . Although the church was regarded as a heresy by Torm ' s followers , Torm apparently granted power to some of its members . The order was governed by the Council of Vigilent Seers and had few female members . By 1480 DR many members of the Eye had abandoned the Threefold God heresy and worshiped Torm exclusively . History . In 1384 DR , Gedrin a young member of the Night Masks thieves guild in Westgate had a vision in which Helm and Tyr fought , with Tyr slaying Helm . After he died , Helm ' s essence melded with Tyr ' s and Tyr ' s sight returned . When Gedrin woke from his vision , he held Helm ' s sword , Vindicator . Later , Gedrin had another vision in which Tyr was killed by the demon lord Orcus and Tyr ' s essence flowed into Torm ' s , making Torm the Threefold God . Gedrin became a religious zealot and recruited crusaders from among the Night Masks . The church was instrumental in driving the Night Masks from Westgate in 1391 DR .

title: Eye of the All - Father
description: Eye of the All - Father The Eye of the All - Father was a secret underground temple to Annam built in the time of ancient Ostoria in the Spine of the World . Inside , an oracle may have once made predictions . Only a handful of giants — among them Harshnag — knew the location .
description_long: Eye of the All - Father The Eye of the All - Father was a secret underground temple to Annam built in the time of ancient Ostoria in the Spine of the World . Inside , an oracle may have once made predictions . Only a handful of giants — among them Harshnag — knew the location . However , a few ancient dragons , like Klauth , Iymrith , and Claugiyliamatar , also knew about it .

title: Eye of the Tempest
description: Eye of the Tempest Eye of the Tempest is a 5 edition adventure module set in the Forgotten Realms . It is part of the Elemental Evil series of adventures published for the D & D Adventurers League . It was authored by Pieter Sleijpen and designed for characters of levels 5 – 10 .
description_long: Eye of the Tempest Eye of the Tempest is a 5 edition adventure module set in the Forgotten Realms . It is part of the Elemental Evil series of adventures published for the D & D Adventurers League . It was authored by Pieter Sleijpen and designed for characters of levels 5 – 10 .

title: Eye of the deep
description: Eye of the deep The eye of the deep was a water - dwelling relative of the beholder , covered with reddish lobster - like chitin . The eye of the deep possessed two antennae with eyes on their ends and two arms ending in lobster - like claws ; these features replaced the usual beholder eyestalks .
description_long: Eye of the deep The eye of the deep was a water - dwelling relative of the beholder , covered with reddish lobster - like chitin . The eye of the deep possessed two antennae with eyes on their ends and two arms ending in lobster - like claws ; these features replaced the usual beholder eyestalks .

title: Eye of truth
description: Eye of truth The eye of truth was a special ritual used by sha ' ir s to enhance their gen ' s vision . Preparation . The sha ' ir needed to provide a pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each .
description_long: Eye of truth The eye of truth was a special ritual used by sha ' ir s to enhance their gen ' s vision . Preparation . The sha ' ir needed to provide a pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each . The eye of truth ritual took 24 hours to complete . If successful this ritual granted the gen the permanent ability to see through magical illusions . The chance of a gen being able to see through an illusion increased based upon how powerful their sha ' ir was during the ritual .

title: Eyebite
description: Eyebite Eyebite was a spell that made the caster gaze cause negative effects . Effect . In most of the versions of the spell it was quite powerful , needing a caster of skill to be cast .
description_long: Eyebite Eyebite was a spell that made the caster gaze cause negative effects . Effect . In most of the versions of the spell it was quite powerful , needing a caster of skill to be cast . The Oldest known version of the spell had the caster chose between the effects " Charm " , " Fear " , " Sicken " or " Sleep " when casting . When looking at a creature and speaking the command word it would effect the target . Charm would attempt to make the target obedient and loyal to the caster , Fear caused terror in the victim making it attempt to escape . Sicken would attempt to weaken the target to half of its ability and it would move half as fast . Sleep would attempt to cause the target to sleep . A later version would have assaulted a target , causing more ill effects on weaker targets and less so to stronger ones . " Sickened " would have effect any one whom the spell succeeded on and it caused the target to be less able in combat and with its abilities or skills . " Panicked " would have been applied to the moderate or weak , It caused the target to panic and would become shaken for at least 10 minutes and if it saw the caster during that time it would panic again .

title: Eyes of Silvanus
description: Eyes of Silvanus The Eyes of Silvanus were two islands , Ilighôn and Wavecrest , near to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were formed from mountains when Jhaamdath fell . After the Spellplague hit and the waters from the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the islands no longer exist .
description_long: Eyes of Silvanus The Eyes of Silvanus were two islands , Ilighôn and Wavecrest , near to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were formed from mountains when Jhaamdath fell . After the Spellplague hit and the waters from the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the islands no longer exist .

title: Eyes of the eagle
description: Eyes of the eagle The eyes of the eagle was a special ritual that allowed sha ' ir s to enhance the acuity of their gen ' s vision . Preparation . A pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each was needed to perform the eyes of the eagle .
description_long: Eyes of the eagle The eyes of the eagle was a special ritual that allowed sha ' ir s to enhance the acuity of their gen ' s vision . Preparation . A pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each was needed to perform the eyes of the eagle . This ritual took 24 hours to complete . A gen with the eyes of the eagle had far superior vision compared to other " normal " gen , allowing them to spot items and creatures at a much farther distance . These gen were even more keen at noticing hidden doors or spotting individuals attempting to hide themselves within shadows .

title: Eyes of the spider
description: Eyes of the spider The eyes of the spider was a device that fitted over an individual ' s head and covered the wearer ' s left eye . It granted the wearer great visual prowess and protection . Description .
description_long: Eyes of the spider The eyes of the spider was a device that fitted over an individual ' s head and covered the wearer ' s left eye . It granted the wearer great visual prowess and protection . Description . Set with eight rubies and made of silver , the " eyes of the spider " fitted tightly over the user ' s head and covered the left eye . When worn , the first ruby was set where the covered eye would be with the rest of the gems rising in a thin line to the crown of the head . The edges of the item were reminiscent of jagged spider legs as if they clung to the wearer . A protrusion on the inside of the helm would bore through the wearer ' s eye to keep the device in place when worn . Powers . Whilst worn over the head , the " eyes of the spider " would affix itself to the wearer ' s skull by extending a protrusion through the left eye and destroyed it with agonizing pain . It could not be removed until the wearer was dead . Additionally , the " eyes of the spider " took up the position of both a magic item that covers the head ( like a helm or headband ) and one that covers the left eye ( like an " eye of charming " ) .

title: Eyon
description: Eyon Eyon was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Eyon was a callous mercenary who joined the Cult of the Crushing Wave .
description_long: Eyon Eyon was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Eyon was a callous mercenary who joined the Cult of the Crushing Wave . In 1491 DR , along with some other cultists and her shark mount , she controlled the lake landing near the temple until she and her minions were confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Eytan Bernstein
description: Eytan Bernstein Eytan Bernstein hails from exotic Long Island and spends his days writing and editing projects for numerous game companies . In addition to his work on Dragons of Faerûn , the Magic Item Compendium , and numerous other projects , Eytan serves as a partner and PR & Marketing Manager for Silven Publishing . Eytan enjoys hunting for gems and minerals in rock quarries , studying religion and theology , composing music , and playing with his many pets .

Eytan enjoys hunting for gems and minerals in rock quarries , studying religion and theology , composing music , and playing with his many pets .

title: Ezira Gloomdelve
description: Ezira Gloomdelve Ezira Gloomdelve was a vampire and a top advisor to the mercenary lord Dalagor in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Ezira was once an adventurer until she was bitten by a vampire while relaxing in Skullport .
description_long: Ezira Gloomdelve Ezira Gloomdelve was a vampire and a top advisor to the mercenary lord Dalagor in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Ezira was once an adventurer until she was bitten by a vampire while relaxing in Skullport . Her master was soon killed by his bride in revenge and Ezira found herself free , at least until she met Dalagor . He made her his servant by threatening her spellbook . She lived in Dalagor ' s mansion and could drain only slaves and was forbidden to create more vampires . Relationship . Aside from her partnership with Dalagor , Ezira had two human male vampire servants under her .

title: Ezril Treewarder
description: Ezril Treewarder Ezril Treewarder was a druid of Elmwood during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , a Zhentarim contingent conquered Elmwood and Ezril lodged a number of townspeople in the sacred grove .
description_long: Ezril Treewarder Ezril Treewarder was a druid of Elmwood during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , a Zhentarim contingent conquered Elmwood and Ezril lodged a number of townspeople in the sacred grove . Dorn Graybrook and his companions also took refuge there to reorganize . The night after their arrival , Dorn ' s party attacked and defeated the Zhent s , freeing Elwood in the process .

title: Fabada
description: Fabada Fabada , which lay along the northern border of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams , was one of the most durable communities of Zakhara ' s High Desert . Inhabitants . The settlement of Fabada comprised members from three tribes : the al - Shazzi , al - Waughiwan , and al - Zab .
description_long: Fabada Fabada , which lay along the northern border of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams , was one of the most durable communities of Zakhara ' s High Desert . Inhabitants . The settlement of Fabada comprised members from three tribes : the al - Shazzi , al - Waughiwan , and al - Zab . Collectively , they were called the " Numtanajd " . Two types of homes were used in Fabada : permanent " haristas " , and portable tent - like " pohtas " . These structures were arranged into circles where the livestock could be kept so the tribes ' herds would be safe from nighttime predators . Culture . Marriage between the tribes was forbidden , but the tribes mixed in virtually every other respect , working and getting along with one another peacefully . At the end of every summer , each tribe would elect a " kharah " to be their leader . " Kharahs " were always males at least 50 years old . Newly elected " kharahs " would shave their heads and burn their hair in ceremonial fires to show their status . Each " kharah " made all of the decisions for his tribe , and the entire " Numtanajd " did not do anything unless all of the " karahs " agreed unanimously .

title: Fabricate
description: Fabricate Fabricate ( originally called Aksa ' s contrivance ) was a transmutation spell that transformed raw materials into finished items or forms . Effect . With this spell the caster would use a amount of material equal to the resulted product within a set amount of space .
description_long: Fabricate Fabricate ( originally called Aksa ' s contrivance ) was a transmutation spell that transformed raw materials into finished items or forms . Effect . With this spell the caster would use a amount of material equal to the resulted product within a set amount of space . The size changed with every type of Weave , the Oldest known version had it based on skill to a minimum of a 1 yard ( 0 . 91M ) cube , after that it changed to 10 cubic ft . ( 3 . 04M ) maximum unless the caster was more skilled . After the Second Sundering it changed to a 10 foot cube or 5 - foot ( 1 . 52M ) cubes . One that that remained was that the size got greatly reduced when using minerals or metals , to as low as a 1 foot cube . This spell could have used to make wood or trees in to a bridge or wool in to cloths . If the caster wished to make more advanced items the caster needed to have the skills to make the intended item by hand . Material component . The spell only needed vocal and somatic component s and the original material in a appropriate amount . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Aksa the Destroyer in −2131 DR .

title: Faceless Guard
description: Faceless Guard The Faceless Guards were the guardians of the Gate of Heaven within the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . The elite yak - folk warriors of the Faceless Guard were tasked with protecting the Gate of Heaven , the provincial heart of the Empire that housed the capital city of Nathong as well as the Emperor of the Lotus Throne and his court .
description_long: Faceless Guard The Faceless Guards were the guardians of the Gate of Heaven within the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . The elite yak - folk warriors of the Faceless Guard were tasked with protecting the Gate of Heaven , the provincial heart of the Empire that housed the capital city of Nathong as well as the Emperor of the Lotus Throne and his court . Members of the Faceless Guard donned blank masks to honor their savage god . They possessed skills both martial and arcane , making them formidable foes on any battlefield . The Faceless Guard was composed entirely of yak - folk .

title: Fadime Zatar
description: Fadime Zatar Fadime Zatar was a former Red Wizard in Neverwinter . History . Fadime was a red wizard in Thay until she decided to defect and join the forces of Neverwinter ; she acted in all means to undermine the lich zulkir s .
description_long: Fadime Zatar Fadime Zatar was a former Red Wizard in Neverwinter . History . Fadime was a red wizard in Thay until she decided to defect and join the forces of Neverwinter ; she acted in all means to undermine the lich zulkir s . Her main objective was collect all pieces of Thay culture before Szass Tam destroy all culture in her land .

title: Fadiya al - Farid
description: Fadiya al - Farid Fadiya al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Fadiya held grudges for years at a time , but she was pleasant to anyone from whom she required help .
description_long: Fadiya al - Farid Fadiya al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Fadiya held grudges for years at a time , but she was pleasant to anyone from whom she required help . History . Her parents were killed when she was very young , forcing her and her brother to take care of themselves on the streets of Hiyal . Fadiya was once a member of the Everlasting , until she was cast out .

title: Faelfaril ' s Inn
description: Faelfaril ' s Inn Faelfaril ' s Inn was one of the oldest and least suitable houses in Bryn Shander . Location . This inn was located in Bryn Shander near the southwest gate near the stables .
description_long: Faelfaril ' s Inn Faelfaril ' s Inn was one of the oldest and least suitable houses in Bryn Shander . Location . This inn was located in Bryn Shander near the southwest gate near the stables . Description . Many small holes in the walls let the chill air in , cutting the wind chill factor but otherwise leaving the inside barely warmer than the outside . It is a rather large Inn , boasting 20 rooms , a feasting hall , and good selection of drinks , ranging from dwarvish ale , to various elven wines . Inhabitants . Faelfaril ' s Inn was owned and operated by Percevil Gracus . History . The inn was built by newcomers who hadn ’ t spent a winter in Icewind Dale .

title: Faerang ' s Doom
description: Faerang ' s Doom Faerang ' s Doom was a peak located in the Rauvin Mountains . Description . The peak had a shape similar to a knife and a waterfall flowed through it .
description_long: Faerang ' s Doom Faerang ' s Doom was a peak located in the Rauvin Mountains . Description . The peak had a shape similar to a knife and a waterfall flowed through it . It was named in memory of an orc king who chose to jump into the deep end rather than to surrender to enemies of the orc tribes .

title: Faerie dragon
description: Faerie dragon A faerie dragon is a mischievous branch of the dragon family tree . Physical description . Faerie dragons are extremely small in comparison to their large metallic dragon , or chromatic dragon cousins , only about one to two feet long .
description_long: Faerie dragon A faerie dragon is a mischievous branch of the dragon family tree . Physical description . Faerie dragons are extremely small in comparison to their large metallic dragon , or chromatic dragon cousins , only about one to two feet long . They have iridescent scales that reflect all colors of the rainbow . They have platinum colored butterfly - like wings and a long , prehensile tail . Combat . A faerie dragon prefers to deal with enemies from a distance . They use their magical abilities to confuse and bewilder foes . They rarely fight alone and often call upon allies in a fight . They will enter melee only if seriously pressed . Some faerie dragons have the ability to shift in and out of existence to avoid danger though this ability is not always successful , and the dragon still suffers harm . Like all dragons they have the tendency to be pranksters , although they take it to a whole new level . They are often referred to as the pranksters of the wild . Breath weapon . The faerie dragon ' s breath weapon is a cone of euphoria gas . Lair . They normally travel in groups and have been seen with faeries , pixies , and sprites .

title: Faerie fire
description: Faerie fire Faerie fire was a evocation or alteration spell that outlined a target . Effect . " Faerie fire " caused a glowing lining around targets in a selected area .
description_long: Faerie fire Faerie fire was a evocation or alteration spell that outlined a target . Effect . " Faerie fire " caused a glowing lining around targets in a selected area . In most versions , the spellcaster could chose the color of the glow , picking between green , blue , violet , or red . All versions of the spell made a target easier to hit , but the post - Spellplague version also caused radiant damage and slowed the target . The pre - Spellplague version negated the effects of spells like " blur " or " darkness " . Components . Other than the usual vocal and somatic components one version needed foxfire . Users . Drow had the innate ability to cast " faerie fire " . This ability was granted to them by Faerzress . The drow used the ability in combat as well as to decorate their cities .

title: Faerie pool
description: Faerie pool The Faerie pools were small pools of water tainted with an odd mineral in the rocks , located across the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . The pools produced gases that cause an " air frost " ( snowflakes ) that , if inhaled , caused brief but vivid hallucinations .
description_long: Faerie pool The Faerie pools were small pools of water tainted with an odd mineral in the rocks , located across the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . The pools produced gases that cause an " air frost " ( snowflakes ) that , if inhaled , caused brief but vivid hallucinations . Sages believed those gases were product of a mineral infected with the Spellplague . People with strong will could control those hallucinations and a few ones knew how to use that gas to divine the future . Common people believed the Faerie pools were portal s to the Feywild , and that fickle fey produced the hallucinations , hence the name of the pools . History . The Faerie pools began to appear in Returned Abeir after the Spellplague .

title: Faerinaal ' s hymn
description: Faerinaal ' s hymn Named for the consort to the eladrin queen Morwel , Faerinaal ' s hymn is an enchantment spell that prevents attacks of opportunity by evil creatures . Effect .
