This level of devotion went beyond that of even paladin s as paladins leaned toward fighting for good and law . The will of a faris ' s god ( and church ) took priority above all other matters . A faris also played an important role in recruiting followers to their god ' s path . Holy warriors went out of their way to aid others fighting for their gods . Goods , services , supplies , and shelter were just a few benefits that could be expected . Farisan were obedient followers of their god ' s church . As such they were expected to carry out orders from their superiors even in the face of certain death . Equipment . All armor and weapon types were available to farisan . Additionally , they usually carried the holy symbol of their chosen god .

title: Farl
description: Farl Farl was a thief in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar and the best friend of the young Elminster Aumar . History . Farl was the illegitimate son of the Royal Mage Neldryn Hawklyn , leader of the magelord s , but for his poor birth he lived on the fringes of society and became a thief .
description_long: Farl Farl was a thief in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar and the best friend of the young Elminster Aumar . History . Farl was the illegitimate son of the Royal Mage Neldryn Hawklyn , leader of the magelord s , but for his poor birth he lived on the fringes of society and became a thief . One day in 224 DR , Farl met and befriended the young Elminster , who was under the alias Eladar the Dark , and the two became one of the most infamous pair of thieves of the city . In 229 DR , shortly after the current Magister killed his father , a powerful thieves ' guild called the Moonclaw emerged in Hastarl . Farl and El with some others formed a gang dubbed the Velvet Hands in opposition . Soon however , El decided to leave the kingdom to fulfill his destiny and said goodbye to Farl . In the years after , Farl destroyed the Moonclaw , who were discovered to be servants of the magelords , and began a relationship with his fellow thief Tassabra . At last , Farl welcomed Elminster , by now a powerful wizard , who came back and helped in his insurrection and slew all magelords .

title: Farlong house
description: Farlong house The Farlong house was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Daeghun Farlong . Location .
description_long: Farlong house The Farlong house was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Daeghun Farlong . Location . The house was located beyond the river , north of the center of the village . There was a bridge that connected to the center , but that bridge was later destroyed . Structure . The house was wooden , like the other houses of West Harbor . Interior . The house was composed of two levels : the first had a hall and a fireplace , while the other had two bedrooms , for Daeghun and his foster child . History . This was the house where Daeghun and the Kalach - Cha lived . When the two escaped West Harbor following the Second War of the Shadow in 1374 DR , the house was destroyed when Ammon Jerro and his demon s passed through the village . Rumors and legends . It was here that the Kalach - Cha lived through their childhood .

title: Farmer ' s Cheese
description: Farmer ' s Cheese Farmer ' s Cheese was a simple cheese produced by small farming communities across the Realms . It was available for sale through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Farmer ' s Cheese Farmer ' s Cheese was a simple cheese produced by small farming communities across the Realms . It was available for sale through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Farmer ' s Cheese was a fresh cheese that did not travel well . For that reason , it used to be consumed locally , and a customer ordering Farmer ' s Cheese from Aurora ' s Catalogue would receive cheese from the closest location available , in order to guarantee a fresh product . The cheese used to be served with salt and pepper or with cream as a side dish .

title: Farninger Seasilver
description: Farninger Seasilver Farninger Seasilver was the grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . Activities . When the Shadovar armies attacked Cormyr , Marsember was easily sacked .
description_long: Farninger Seasilver Farninger Seasilver was the grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . Activities . When the Shadovar armies attacked Cormyr , Marsember was easily sacked . Farninger tried to escape to Everlund but the Prince of Shade Yder Tanthul managed to kill him . Relationships . Farninger was the father of Arietta Seasilver , the Chosen of Siamorphe .

title: Farnvik
description: Farnvik Farnvik the Venemous was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Farnvik was a cultist cleric of Tiamat .
description_long: Farnvik Farnvik the Venemous was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Farnvik was a cultist cleric of Tiamat . In 1489 DR , he was one of the main leaders of the contingent of cultists who ' d arrived secretly in Phlan aboard ships . Just after the green dragon Vorgansharax killed or captured the city ' s leaders at Valjevo Castle , Farnvik led a cultist patrol , including a guard drake and a half - dragon ettin , to collect " tributes " from Phlan ' s citizens . He was eventually defeated by an adventuring party .

title: Farouk Abd al - Bazan
description: Farouk Abd al - Bazan Farouk Abd al - Bazan was an efreeti and leader of the Sword Dancers sect of the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to most of his kind , Farouk was extremely charismatic .
description_long: Farouk Abd al - Bazan Farouk Abd al - Bazan was an efreeti and leader of the Sword Dancers sect of the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to most of his kind , Farouk was extremely charismatic . His personality drew many followers to the Sword Dancers . He enjoyed sarcastic conversation and was fond of issuing thinly - veiled threats . Description . Through the use of his shapechanging ability , Farouk appeared as a handsome man in his mid - twenties . In that form , he had dark green eyes and brown hair . Activities . Farouk ' s ultimate goal was to lead the Everlasting . Those within the fortress of Sarahin knew him to be a sorcerer of wind and flame and not an efreeti . Possessions . Farouk wore an " amulet of proof against detection and location " that disguised his true nature from hakima s and sha ' ir s . He also owned a " staff of the sands " .

title: Farrak
description: Farrak Farrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together .
description_long: Farrak Farrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together . They had the same morality as Devlin but kept an eye on their leader to avoid possible betrayals . History . Farrak and his twin Harrak were evil adventurers and members of the Free Company of the Crescent . In 1479 DR , he went with his fellows to Spellgard hoping to find Lady Saharel ' s treasures .

title: Farsann
description: Farsann " Farsann " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A farsann was responsible for managing the domestic staff of a noble house as well as for seeing to the planning and transpiring of feasts and ceremonies . A farsann was an inferior position to a sammafar .
description_long: Farsann " Farsann " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A farsann was responsible for managing the domestic staff of a noble house as well as for seeing to the planning and transpiring of feasts and ceremonies . A farsann was an inferior position to a sammafar .

title: Farsea Marshes
description: Farsea Marshes The Farsea Marshes was a wetland located in interior Faerûn west of Cormyr . Geography . The Farsea Marshes were located south of the Anauroch desert , west of the Stonelands , north of the Storm Horns mountain range , and east of Sunset Mountains .
description_long: Farsea Marshes The Farsea Marshes was a wetland located in interior Faerûn west of Cormyr . Geography . The Farsea Marshes were located south of the Anauroch desert , west of the Stonelands , north of the Storm Horns mountain range , and east of Sunset Mountains . This wetland eventually joined with the Marsh of Tun some time after the Era of Upheaval to form the Farsea Swamp .

title: Farsea Swamp
description: Farsea Swamp The Farsea Swamp was a wetland located on the western fringes of the nation of Cormyr . It formed when the Farsea Marshes joined with the Marsh of Tun some time after the Era of Upheaval . To the south was what remained of the dry Tunlands , east was the Storm Horns , and west were the Sunset Mountains and Far Hills .
description_long: Farsea Swamp The Farsea Swamp was a wetland located on the western fringes of the nation of Cormyr . It formed when the Farsea Marshes joined with the Marsh of Tun some time after the Era of Upheaval . To the south was what remained of the dry Tunlands , east was the Storm Horns , and west were the Sunset Mountains and Far Hills .

title: Fasim Kaldur
description: Fasim Kaldur Fasim Kaldur was the leader of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . Activities . As the leader of the Riders of Blood , Fasim coordinated attacks upon caravans traveling between Halwa and Huzuz .
description_long: Fasim Kaldur Fasim Kaldur was the leader of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . Activities . As the leader of the Riders of Blood , Fasim coordinated attacks upon caravans traveling between Halwa and Huzuz . Skills . Fasim was quite adept at throwing his magical jambiya . Possessions . Fasim owned a magical jambiya he named the " Fate maker " , a set of " ring mail of the desert evening " , a magical shield , a " ring of regeneration " , and a " ring of genie summoning " . His personal mount was named the Whirlwind .

title: Fasruil
description: Fasruil Fasruil was the northernmost city in Luiren . It was famous for the tasty red rhubarb that was traded across all of Luiren and other countries of the Shining South . Geography .
description_long: Fasruil Fasruil was the northernmost city in Luiren . It was famous for the tasty red rhubarb that was traded across all of Luiren and other countries of the Shining South . Geography . Fasruil sat along the southern rim of the Long Forest near the eastern border of Luiren . Much of the farmland surrounding this portion of the forest was considered the best in the whole country . Inhabitants . Some 3 , 000 halfling s called Fasruil home . Most of these halflings made their living through farming or baking . Silari Carver was the mayor of Fasruil in 1367 DR . Activities . As of 1367 , Fasruil was a quickly growing city because of increased trading with both Durpar and Halruaa . Armed Forces . A collection of forty warders patrolled the forest near the city .

title: Fastrin the Delver
description: Fastrin the Delver Fastrin the Delver was a powerful and good wizard and ruler of an ancient kingdom in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . That kingdom came to existence not long after the fall of the Netheril . One day though , Fastrin went mad and started to slaughter his people .
description_long: Fastrin the Delver Fastrin the Delver was a powerful and good wizard and ruler of an ancient kingdom in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . That kingdom came to existence not long after the fall of the Netheril . One day though , Fastrin went mad and started to slaughter his people . When asked for the reason of his menace , Fastrin claimed he had been robbed and now tried to find and kill the thief . Since he couldn ' t find the thief , Fastrin believed the death of everyone of his realm to be the only way to be safe . He not only killed many of his people but mangled the minds and spirits of others , stripping them of memory and reason . Some of them tried to stand against Fastrin and reappered as ghost s after their deaths , wandering the land without memory and purpose , like the ghost Mirror . After destroying his kingdom , Fastrin obliterated himself .

title: Fated Depths
description: Fated Depths Fated Depths was a Fiendish Plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home of Blibdoolpoolp , Sekolah , and many other evil aquatic creatures . After the Spellplague , this plane disappeared , perhaps becoming part of the Elemental Chaos .
description_long: Fated Depths Fated Depths was a Fiendish Plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home of Blibdoolpoolp , Sekolah , and many other evil aquatic creatures . After the Spellplague , this plane disappeared , perhaps becoming part of the Elemental Chaos . Description . Similar to the Elemental Plane of Water , Fated Depths was a bottomless ocean without a surface . Unlike the plane of water , Fated Depths was under crushing pressure , briny , and produced no light — the only light sources were those belonging to the inhabitants . The waters were fouled with the effluent of the River of Blood to such an extent that it was effectively unholy water , capable of injuring any celestial being that came in contact with it . This plane had many connections to the Elemental Plane of Water and the water - dominant layers of the Abyss . A " portal " also existed between Fated Depths and Fury ' s Heart , home of Umberlee , the Bitch Queen . The usual Astral Plane methods of travel were possible , and the vomiting mouth of the River of Blood provided access to nearly all the other fiendish planes . Inhabitants .

title: Fatell
description: Fatell Fatell was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . History . Fatell was a lumber merchant and a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak and also a fire cultist in Mulmaster .
description_long: Fatell Fatell was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . History . Fatell was a lumber merchant and a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak and also a fire cultist in Mulmaster . In 1491 DR , a fire destroyed his firewood shop . He and a few fellow surviving fire cultists were investigating the ruins of the shop when they were surprised by some adventurers hired by Cora Peytir , who uncovered and defeated Fatell . Lieutenant Grady Moll of the Soldiery , an agent of the Lords ' Alliance , was also investigating him . Relationship . Fatell , as a lumber merchant , had dealings with Cora Peytir . Personality . Fatell was very cunning and had a very good knowledge about the inner workings of Mulmaster ' s political structure .

title: Father of Spiders
description: Father of Spiders " The Father of Spiders " was a deepspawn speculated to exist within Adhe Wood in the Vast . The sage Alither studied the legends of Adhe Wood and believed that the many mutant spider s there were produced by a diseased or magically altered deepspawn , which was named " the Father of Spiders " .
description_long: Father of Spiders " The Father of Spiders " was a deepspawn speculated to exist within Adhe Wood in the Vast . The sage Alither studied the legends of Adhe Wood and believed that the many mutant spider s there were produced by a diseased or magically altered deepspawn , which was named " the Father of Spiders " .

title: Fatik al - Amin
description: Fatik al - Amin Fatik al - Amin was the falconer of the Dark Wind Stables in Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Fatik was a quiet man who loved his work .
description_long: Fatik al - Amin Fatik al - Amin was the falconer of the Dark Wind Stables in Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Fatik was a quiet man who loved his work . Activities . Fatik was focused solely on training an impressive array of birds including a golden eagle , four peregrine falcons , a pair of saker falcons from Dirs , and the great roc , Sar . He was also a member of the Loyalists . Possessions . Fatik owned a " ring of avian control " , allowing him to easily tame and train his birds .

title: Fatima Kossi
description: Fatima Kossi Fatima Kossi was a halfling who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima owned the Wanderer ' s Rest , catering to pilgrims visiting Huzuz .
description_long: Fatima Kossi Fatima Kossi was a halfling who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima owned the Wanderer ' s Rest , catering to pilgrims visiting Huzuz . She often let true pilgrims stay for free if they could not afford her rates . Fatima was a devout follower of Kor . She felt like she wasted much of her life in pursuit of money when she could have spent that time productively as a priestess . History . Though long retired , Fatima used to be an adventurer .

title: Fatima bint Fayiz
description: Fatima bint Fayiz Fatima bint Fayiz was a tailor who lived Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima made clothes for people based on personal orders , as well as bulk orders for larger merchant houses .
description_long: Fatima bint Fayiz Fatima bint Fayiz was a tailor who lived Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima made clothes for people based on personal orders , as well as bulk orders for larger merchant houses . She worked her cloth during the day and moved to the Grand Bazaar at night to sell her wares to the large crowds .

title: Fatula Chupa
description: Fatula Chupa Fatula Chupa , or the City of Monasteries , was a city located in the mountains of what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Location . Located deep within the mountains on the Katakoro Plateau , this city was almost hidden to those who were not looking for it .
description_long: Fatula Chupa Fatula Chupa , or the City of Monasteries , was a city located in the mountains of what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Location . Located deep within the mountains on the Katakoro Plateau , this city was almost hidden to those who were not looking for it . Description . Fatula Chupa ' s square , white - washed buildings appeared to blend in with the mountains surrounding them . Buildings were constructed wherever enough space could be found , resulting in structures creeping up the very sides of the mountains and the slopes of Fatu Pass . No walls surrounded the city as the inhabitants relied upon the natural barriers provided by the mountains for protection . Many of the buildings were in ruins , having been abandoned for ages , or because of death and misfortune . These ruins were scattered haphazardly throughout the valley , and contrasted with the bright colors of the newer monasteries . Inhabitants . Due to belief that the surrounding mountains and pass were sacred , every branch of the Path had a monastery located in Fatula Chupa .

title: Faurael Blackhammer
description: Faurael Blackhammer Faurael Blackhammer was the lord protector of the town of Triboar . Description . The Lord Protector had gray hair and a number of old wounds that caused him pain but he still continued to train the town ' s militia .
description_long: Faurael Blackhammer Faurael Blackhammer was the lord protector of the town of Triboar . Description . The Lord Protector had gray hair and a number of old wounds that caused him pain but he still continued to train the town ' s militia . Personality . Blackhammer worked hard over the years to influence the Lords ' Alliance and various mage s and cleric s to stop the plague of the orc hordes and protect Triobar once and for all . History . In 1369 DR , Faurael died fighting the tanar ' ri hordes of Hellgate Keep .

title: Favor of Ilmater
description: Favor of Ilmater Favor of Ilmater was a divine spell that could have two possible benefits : one to grant a recipient peace of mind in the most terrible circumstances , and the other to sacrifice one ' s life - force to aid another . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to priests of other faiths who named it after their own gods , such as favor of Torm for followers of Torm . A generic version was known as favor of the martyr .
description_long: Favor of Ilmater Favor of Ilmater was a divine spell that could have two possible benefits : one to grant a recipient peace of mind in the most terrible circumstances , and the other to sacrifice one ' s life - force to aid another . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to priests of other faiths who named it after their own gods , such as favor of Torm for followers of Torm . A generic version was known as favor of the martyr . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s — originally only those of Ilmater , but later priests of other faiths — and by painbearer s , the specialty priests of Ilmater , as well as by paladin s . However , a later version could be used only by paladins of any faith . Effect . The " favor of Ilmater " spell actually had two possible forms — " divine fortitude " and " pact of martyrdom " — that the caster could choose to apply , both closely linked to the dogma of Ilmater . The later , paladin - only version provided only the first effect . " Divine fortitude " .

title: Favor of the goddess
description: Favor of the goddess Favor of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to druid s , mystic s , ranger s , and shaman s of Chauntea . At the choice of the caster , it doubled the yield of either mature plants or picked fruit and vegetables . It also removed any taint , disease , or poison from plants or produce unless it was naturally harmful to humans .
description_long: Favor of the goddess Favor of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to druid s , mystic s , ranger s , and shaman s of Chauntea . At the choice of the caster , it doubled the yield of either mature plants or picked fruit and vegetables . It also removed any taint , disease , or poison from plants or produce unless it was naturally harmful to humans . If cast on immature plants , it advanced them to the fertile stage of life , instantly bearing normal - sized ripe fruit or vegetables . Effects . The caster had to touch the plants or produce in order to cast this spell . He or she could affect either six plants or six pieces of fruit or vegetables . Higher level casters could affect eight , then ten , and so on . Each plant or piece of produce could only be touched by this spell once . Casting this spell again on the same target had no effect . When cast on a living , mature , fruit - bearing tree or bush , or vegetable - producing plant , the fruit or vegetables instantly doubled in size . The same thing happened to fruit or vegetables that were already picked .

title: Favria
description: Favria Favria was the leader of the Ashmadai faction that remained loyal to Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . History . Favria born as a slave of a duergar clan that followed Asmodeus .
description_long: Favria Favria was the leader of the Ashmadai faction that remained loyal to Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . History . Favria born as a slave of a duergar clan that followed Asmodeus . Later she escaped but remained fascinated by the god Asmodeus . She went to Neverwinter as part of a search for Gauntlgrym . Here Favria joined the Ashmadai but continued her search for the lost dwarven city . She loyally followed Valindra because of her assumed possession of the " Ruby Rod of Asmodeus " . Favria usually resided in the ruined village of Thundertree , knowing she was too well known in Neverwinter .

title: Fayaniz al - Nokar
description: Fayaniz al - Nokar Fayaniz al - Nokar was an employee of the House of Wo in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fayaniz handled the daily workings of the , leaving Wo free to deal with food preparation .
description_long: Fayaniz al - Nokar Fayaniz al - Nokar was an employee of the House of Wo in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fayaniz handled the daily workings of the , leaving Wo free to deal with food preparation . History . Fayaniz was initially attracted to the House of Wo because of a desire to learn foreign magic from his employer . Wo taught Fayaniz a few spells , but the language barrier made progress slow for Fayaniz .

title: Fayiz Mikali
description: Fayiz Mikali Fayiz Mikali was a crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . As a sea mage , Fayiz made good use of his powers while raiding merchant vessels sailing on Suq Bay .
description_long: Fayiz Mikali Fayiz Mikali was a crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . As a sea mage , Fayiz made good use of his powers while raiding merchant vessels sailing on Suq Bay . Fayiz was also in charge of the other wizard s onboard the ship . Possessions . Fayiz owned a special " mirror of mental prowess " that Almari bint - Kafira used to communicate with Prince Tannous al - Assad back in Huzuz .

title: Fayne
description: Fayne Fayne was a fey ' ri rogue who lived in Waterdeep . She was the product of a relationship between a Gold elf and a demoness . Fayne earned her coin through petty theft and by writing stories for a scandalous broadsheet known as the " Mocking Minstrel " .
description_long: Fayne Fayne was a fey ' ri rogue who lived in Waterdeep . She was the product of a relationship between a Gold elf and a demoness . Fayne earned her coin through petty theft and by writing stories for a scandalous broadsheet known as the " Mocking Minstrel " . She also undertook missions for her father Lilten , the high priest of Beshaba . Her real name came from the Elvish " elie en , " which means " For Sorrow . " Description . In Waterdeep , Fayne normally wore the illusion of a young half - elf , often a redhead . In her natural fey ' ri form she had pink hair , pale skin , leathery wings and a tail . She had a nasty scar on her face where she was hit by a crossbow bolt fired by Ilira . In Westgate , Fayne wore the illusion of a regal looking purple and white striped deva . Possessions . Fayne had a magical wand to power her spells and an orb ( a gift from Lilten ) that allowed her to change her appearance at will . ( This talent may have been a function of her racial heritage , as fey ' ri had the ability to alter their appearance . ) Personality .

title: Fear
description: Fear Fear was a necromancy spell that caused subjects to flee . Effect . An invisible cone of terror caused living creatures to become panicked .
description_long: Fear Fear was a necromancy spell that caused subjects to flee . Effect . An invisible cone of terror caused living creatures to become panicked . They suffered a morale penalty , and they fled from the caster . A panicked creature had a 50 % chance to drop what it ’ s holding , chose its path randomly , and fled any other dangers that confronted it . If cornered , a panicked creature cowered . Material component . Either the heart of a hen or a white feather .

title: Fear no elements
description: Fear no elements Fear no elements was a spell used by swordmage s very similar to , but weaker than , the " resistance " spell used by wizard s . When " fear no elements " was cast , it transmuted its caster ' s body , making him or her less vulnerable to either acidic , electricity , fiery , freezing , or sonic attacks , to a degree dependent upon the swordmage ' s natural vitality . " Fear no elements " was a difficult spell to cast for its relative ease in learning and could only be cast once per day .
description_long: Fear no elements Fear no elements was a spell used by swordmage s very similar to , but weaker than , the " resistance " spell used by wizard s . When " fear no elements " was cast , it transmuted its caster ' s body , making him or her less vulnerable to either acidic , electricity , fiery , freezing , or sonic attacks , to a degree dependent upon the swordmage ' s natural vitality . " Fear no elements " was a difficult spell to cast for its relative ease in learning and could only be cast once per day .

title: Feast of the Moon
description: Feast of the Moon The Feast of the Moon , or Moonfest , was an annual festival in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring between the final night of Uktar and the first day of Nightal . It was the last great festival of the calendar year . The day traditionally marked the onset of winter .
description_long: Feast of the Moon The Feast of the Moon , or Moonfest , was an annual festival in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring between the final night of Uktar and the first day of Nightal . It was the last great festival of the calendar year . The day traditionally marked the onset of winter . It was also a time to celebrate and honor the ancestors and the respected dead . On this day , folk blessed their ancestors ' graves and performed the Ritual of Remembrance . People also gathered to tell stories of the deeds of their ancestors and of the gods until deep into the night , until they merged and became legend . This was a time to hear of past heroes , great treasures , and lost cities . In Faerûn , battles were typically fought between harvest - time and the coming of winter . This meant that most of the fighting usually occurred in the month of Uktar . The timing of the Feast of the Moon — after recently slain soldiers had joined the ranks of the dead — was thus practical , if sadly ironic . The Heralds of Faerûn had a number of special duties on the Feast of the Moon .

title: Feast of the Moon ( module )
description: Feast of the Moon ( module ) It is the Feast of the Moon and Waterdeep is full of happy revelers . In a house at the end of Dretch Lane , the partygoers find themselves being killed off , but the deaths appear to be due to drowning .
description_long: Feast of the Moon ( module ) It is the Feast of the Moon and Waterdeep is full of happy revelers . In a house at the end of Dretch Lane , the partygoers find themselves being killed off , but the deaths appear to be due to drowning .

title: Feather fall
description: Feather fall Feather fall was a spell that caused creatures or objects to fall slowly , like a feather . Effects . An early form of the spell had a duration and weight limit set by the experience and the power of the caster .
description_long: Feather fall Feather fall was a spell that caused creatures or objects to fall slowly , like a feather . Effects . An early form of the spell had a duration and weight limit set by the experience and the power of the caster . A later form of " feather fall " instantly changed the rate at which the target fell to an unnaturally steady rate of ten feet per second . The target of the spell was not damaged upon landing while the spell was in effect . Again the duration of the spell was limited by the experience and power of the caster . However , this spell had no weight limit , instead it was limited by size and number of targets . This spell could be cast in a moment . Post - Spellplague . After the Spellplague , this spell ' s effects lasted until the target touched the ground again . " Feather fall " was complex enough that its caster had to wait a day before casting it again . Users . Beholder s had a permanent " feather fall " effect . Silver dragon s could use a " feather fall " spell - like ability . History . The Netherese arcanist Yturn was given for the credit for the creation of this spell in - 1158 DR .

title: Feather turban
description: Feather turban Feather turbans were wondrously decorative magical apparel that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These turbans were woven with colorful peacock feathers .
description_long: Feather turban Feather turbans were wondrously decorative magical apparel that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These turbans were woven with colorful peacock feathers . Powers . A " feather turban " allowed the wearer to create a " gust of wind " three times per day . Additionally it also allowed them to assume " wind shadow " form once per day and summon a " wind carpet " once per month .

title: Feathergale Knights
description: Feathergale Knights The Feathergale Knights , or Feathergale Society , was a sub - branch of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Feathergale Knights usually acted as elite forces of the Howling Hatred cult or they surveyed the land around Feathergale Spire , guarding the entrance to the air cult ' s hidden temple .
description_long: Feathergale Knights The Feathergale Knights , or Feathergale Society , was a sub - branch of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Feathergale Knights usually acted as elite forces of the Howling Hatred cult or they surveyed the land around Feathergale Spire , guarding the entrance to the air cult ' s hidden temple . Tactics and Philosophy . The Feathergale Knights believed themselves above the Howling Hatred cultists , whom they considered lunatic perverts . They believed that had made tremendous sacrifices in order to make their country strong . In truth , however , they were deeply corrupted by Yan - C - Bin ' s influence and each of them had committed so many crimes they ' d earned the dislike all those they believed they protected . History . The Feathergale Knights were founded in Waterdeep by Thurl Merosska , who gathered around himself people of similar minds from among the wealthy of Waterdeep . Thurl selected his knights one by one . With reluctance , they pledged their loyalty to Aerisi Kalinoth .

title: Featherlung
description: Featherlung Featherlung was a respiratory disease . It was one of The Three Plagues of the more well - known contagious diseases of Faerûn . Effects .
description_long: Featherlung Featherlung was a respiratory disease . It was one of The Three Plagues of the more well - known contagious diseases of Faerûn . Effects . Featherlung was spread by inhalation , and took one to three days to take effect . One version of featherlung filled the lungs with dying flesh , which asphyxiated the victim . Another dried up the lungs and reduced their capacity , eventually suffocating the sufferer . Assisted manual ventilation ( repeated lifting of the body and depressing the chest ) was of no help since it was oxygen already in the lungs that wasn ' t being processed properly . This left sufferers weak and almost helpless , drifting in and out of consciousness and making them easy targets for opportunists . Even if properly treated , someone with featherlung could take a tenday or more to die , though if left without access to water , thirst frequently killed them before the disease could . Once someone was infected with featherlung , they became immune to the disease . However , even those that survived the illness sometimes had difficulty breathing in dry weather . History .

title: Fedosia Peytir
description: Fedosia Peytir Fedosia Peytir was a noble in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Fedosia and her husband were working on establishing an advantageous business alliance for House Peytir .
description_long: Fedosia Peytir Fedosia Peytir was a noble in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Fedosia and her husband were working on establishing an advantageous business alliance for House Peytir . She hoped that Ardet Peytir was dead , so she could inherit his land and buildings . Personality . Fedosia was a young woman who truly knew that her fortunes would rise and fall together with the Peytir name . She looked up to Cora Peytir , but she was more interested in growing the family ' s business interests rather than its political status .

title: Feeblemind
description: Feeblemind Feeblemind was a powerful enchantment spell that reduced a person ' s intelligence and personality to almost nothing . Effects . Arcane spellcaster s were quite vulnerable to the effects of this spell , which were hard to remove .
description_long: Feeblemind Feeblemind was a powerful enchantment spell that reduced a person ' s intelligence and personality to almost nothing . Effects . Arcane spellcaster s were quite vulnerable to the effects of this spell , which were hard to remove . History . The Netherese arcanist Hamring was given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 1293 DR . " Feeblemind " was a common spell in the Realms after 1358 DR .

title: Feena Archwood
description: Feena Archwood Feena Archwood was a natural werewolf and cleric of Selûne . Appearance . She often chose to dress simply in light sandals , a blue skirt of homespun wool , and a blouse of linen dyed yellow with yarrow .
description_long: Feena Archwood Feena Archwood was a natural werewolf and cleric of Selûne . Appearance . She often chose to dress simply in light sandals , a blue skirt of homespun wool , and a blouse of linen dyed yellow with yarrow . In wolf form , her pelt was russet in color , the same color as her hair . She was in her early 30s . History . Feena was the daughter of Maleva . Her mother , knowing that Feena was a werewolf , sent her to mother Dhauna at Moonshadow Hall , a temple of Selûne in Yhaunn , Sembia . At the temple , she was trained to control her inner wolf and to become an acolyte . In her stay at the temple , she met Mifano , who was a novice and an acolyte with her , a young man with silvery hair who was extremely flirtatious . Velsinore , their elder sister and the priestess in charge of the acolyte dormitory , always gave Feena harder punishments , maybe for the fact that she was a werewolf . Their relationship was always distant but Feena felt a sort of respect towards Velsinore . This respect was for her great devotion and passion towards Selûne . Equipment . She wore a battered and scratched medallion with the silver symbol of Selûne . Powers .

title: Feenoch
description: Feenoch Feenoch the Five - Fingered was an infamous rogue and adventurer of the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Feenoch was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed .
description_long: Feenoch Feenoch the Five - Fingered was an infamous rogue and adventurer of the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Feenoch was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed . Feenoch , together with Yostur Ulhmond , made it to Orm to tell their story , though they would not be drawn on the matter of treasure . By the end of the year , it was said in Hillsfar they were trying to muster a larger group of adventurers , bearing sledges , perhaps intending to return .

title: Feign death
description: Feign death Feign death was a necromancy spell that allowed one creature touched by the caster to temporarily fall into a state indistinguishable from death . Effects . There was an arcane and a divine version of this spell and both had the effect of putting the recipient into a cataleptic state with rigid muscles and posture , unresponsive pupils , and lack of respiration and vital signs .
description_long: Feign death Feign death was a necromancy spell that allowed one creature touched by the caster to temporarily fall into a state indistinguishable from death . Effects . There was an arcane and a divine version of this spell and both had the effect of putting the recipient into a cataleptic state with rigid muscles and posture , unresponsive pupils , and lack of respiration and vital signs . The recipient could hear , smell , and be aware of what was happening in their immediate environment , but could not see or feel anything . Reaction to wounds or mistreatment of their body was impossible , but damage was reduced to half and they were immune to poison , paralysis , and energy drain while " feigning " . Any poison introduced into the body would attempt to overcome the target ' s resistance and begin to take effect once the spell had worn off . The arcane version of this spell could affect any willing creature that was not higher level than the caster and lasted a minimum of almost two hours or until ended by the caster . ( The older arcane version of this spell lasted only a few minutes .

title: Feint of Honor
description: Feint of Honor A Feint of Honor was an ancient rite that allowed two dragon s ( or two parties of dragons each represented by a leading figure ) to settle a dispute without the need for mortal combat . All dragonkind followed the code that allows for this kind of ritual combat , regardless of their alignment . Description .
description_long: Feint of Honor A Feint of Honor was an ancient rite that allowed two dragon s ( or two parties of dragons each represented by a leading figure ) to settle a dispute without the need for mortal combat . All dragonkind followed the code that allows for this kind of ritual combat , regardless of their alignment . Description . The rite consisted of a battle between two dragons , each with one or more witnesses who did not take part , until one was subdued or surrendered , at which point the feint was concluded . The use of breath weapons and magic during the combat was forbidden . Dragons were bound by their honor to adhere to the terms and the outcome of the feint . Procedure . The formal procedure for initializing a Feint of Honor was as follows : History . Although Feints of Honor were almost always exclusively between dragons , in - 205 DR , the elf Iliphar Nelnueve challenged the black dragon Thauglor to a Feint of Honor .

title: Feisal Abd al - Jari
description: Feisal Abd al - Jari Feisal Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Feisal rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .
description_long: Feisal Abd al - Jari Feisal Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Feisal rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan . Possessions . Feisal carried a magic sword that benefited from a " continual light " spell .

title: Felarathael
description: Felarathael Felarathael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Felarathael and his fellow Lashrael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann .
description_long: Felarathael Felarathael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Felarathael and his fellow Lashrael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann . They explained to her that from that point all the followers of Eilistraee had been transformed into dark elves and allowed back into Arvandor , where she was then led by the solars .

title: Feldar ' s Trail
description: Feldar ' s Trail Feldar ' s Trail , also called the Mosstree Trail , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the town of Mossbridges and the village of Fallentree . From west to east , it began at Mossbridges , ran through Highbank Forest and Dark Hollow , and ended at Fallentree . On the way , it linked with the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , and Blaern ' s Trail .

title: Feldon Strongbeard
description: Feldon Strongbeard Feldon Strongbeard was a dwarf who lived in the Protector ' s Enclave within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He was a merchant member of the Harpers during the Tyranny of Dragons and helped equipped the adventurer s sent to fight the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Feldon Strongbeard Feldon Strongbeard was a dwarf who lived in the Protector ' s Enclave within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He was a merchant member of the Harpers during the Tyranny of Dragons and helped equipped the adventurer s sent to fight the Cult of the Dragon . At the climax of the resurrection of Tiamat , Feldon went to the Well of Dragons to offer support .

title: Felgolos
description: Felgolos Felgolos was a very imprudent bronze dragon . Activities . Felgolos wandered all North Faerûn , always crashing into things , causing mayhem , and appearing in the midst of draconic battles , clashes of armies , archmages ' spell - duels , and other spectacular events .
description_long: Felgolos Felgolos was a very imprudent bronze dragon . Activities . Felgolos wandered all North Faerûn , always crashing into things , causing mayhem , and appearing in the midst of draconic battles , clashes of armies , archmages ' spell - duels , and other spectacular events . However he always survived all this dangers . Sometimes bored he paired with some archmages like the Seven Sisters or Elminster Aumar and Malchor Harpell . Personality . Felgolos had sleek build , unshakable curiosity , and unfailing good nature . He refused to make enemies or to be prudent , and he like wandering Faerûn , intruding on the territories of other dragons and venturing into situations of great peril . His training with his parents gave him a carefree self - reliance about hoard , a very great knowledge about common life in Faerûn and a mastery of magic far beyond his age . He never lied to others , only hid informations if he believed was better . History . Felgolos was born from a pair of planewalker s bronze dragons masters of Art that teach him to to experiment , to observe , and to play with magic .

title: Feliane
description: Feliane Feliane was an elven priestess of Eilistraee in Cormanthor and Velarswood . Description . Feliane was short , smaller than the average drow , and had dark brown hair .
description_long: Feliane Feliane was an elven priestess of Eilistraee in Cormanthor and Velarswood . Description . Feliane was short , smaller than the average drow , and had dark brown hair . She had pale skin , but often rubbed black dye into her skin to simulate the appearance of a drow . She wore fine mail and a round helmet and wielded a thin blade . History . In 1372 DR , Feliane was accompanying Seyll Auzkovyn , Xarra , and Halisstra Melarn to an Eilistraeean dance when Halisstra charmed Feliane , sending her away and killing Seyll . Halisstra later converted to the worship of Eilistraee and set out with Ryld Argith to find the Crescent Blade in the Cold Field . The two were badly injured but were rescued by Feliane and Uluyara , who had scried them . In early 1373 DR , Feliane and Uluyara accompanied Halisstra to the Demonweb Pits in order to kill Lolth with the Crescent Blade . The three set up a small shrine to Eilistraee in Lolth ' s domain . Soon afterwards , the trio confronted Quenthel Baenre and Danifae Yauntyrr . Feliane was killed in the subsequent fight by Jeggred Baenre .

title: Felix
description: Felix Felix was chief lieutenant in King Virdin ' s Damara n army when they fought the army of Zhengyi the Witch - King . It is widely believed that Felix betrayed Virdin by making him believe that a magic wand would enable the Damaran army to cross the Goliad River at the Ford of Goliad . Zhengyi was waiting for them to fall into this trap and defeated them .
description_long: Felix Felix was chief lieutenant in King Virdin ' s Damara n army when they fought the army of Zhengyi the Witch - King . It is widely believed that Felix betrayed Virdin by making him believe that a magic wand would enable the Damaran army to cross the Goliad River at the Ford of Goliad . Zhengyi was waiting for them to fall into this trap and defeated them . It is also believed that Felix assassinated King Virdin with a dagger as he was watching his army ' s defeat . Felix was later uncovered as a member of the Citadel of Assassins , a group loyal to Zhengyi . In 1357 DR Felix commanded the Bloody Sword unit of the Fleet Brigade , a unit tasked with collect tributes from the Bloodstone Village

title: Feljack
description: Feljack Feljack was an adventurer of the Vast . History . With treasure won from adventuring , Feljack built a mansion called Feljack ' s Hall in the Tweenwalls area of Kurth , sometime around 1347 DR .
description_long: Feljack Feljack was an adventurer of the Vast . History . With treasure won from adventuring , Feljack built a mansion called Feljack ' s Hall in the Tweenwalls area of Kurth , sometime around 1347 DR . A sudden fire destroyed it one night , " circa " 1357 DR . Feljack was not found and was thought dead . Shortly after , as scavengers picked through the smoking wreckage for valuables , a giant skeleton armed with a magical black sword emerged from the ashes to slaughter them . A wizard identified the black sword as a " shadow blade " . The skeleton was presumed to be guarding some treasure , but the few who dared return to the ruins to investigate were often found cut to pieces on the road outside . The ruins of Feljack ' s Hall were wisely abandoned . However , after 1367 DR , on moonlit nights , human skeletons carrying swords were observed roaming the mound and poking around the rubble of the Hall , their presence and purpose unexplained . Feljack ' s supposed treasure went undiscovered by 1370 DR .

title: Fell Pass
description: Fell Pass Fell Pass is a large rocky east - to - west vale in the Spine of the World where ghost s from an old battle roam . The Dreadmont and Skyfire mountains are to the north and south . The east of the pass is within sight of the River Surbrin .
description_long: Fell Pass Fell Pass is a large rocky east - to - west vale in the Spine of the World where ghost s from an old battle roam . The Dreadmont and Skyfire mountains are to the north and south . The east of the pass is within sight of the River Surbrin . It is shrouded in fog in parts , and there is little grass . It is littered with the bones of the orc s and dwarves from what was thought to be a battle . There are tunnels and caverns at various places in the pass , some of which are natural and others that were carved out by the dwarves . History . The gnome illusionist Fitzmilliyun Sparkledrim built his Castle of Illusion in the Pass during the height of Ascalhorn ' s power . A century after his death , orcs overran its defenders . It was thought that the ghosts were those of the orc s and Delzoun dwarves slain in the Battle of Fell Pass . It was however discovered by a scouting party led by Bruenor Battlehammer much to his displeasure that what actually lay beneath the pass is what ' s left of Baffenburg .

title: Fellandar
description: Fellandar Fellandar was a once - human man magically transformed into a cat - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Aviss , Fellandar lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR .
description_long: Fellandar Fellandar was a once - human man magically transformed into a cat - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Aviss , Fellandar lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR . However , the pair came to despise the city and sought its destruction , and turned traitor against it . At some point , they went into the Mere of Dead Men , far to the north of the city . There they met with troll s , survivors of the earlier Trollwars waged against Waterdeep . The trolls believed the traitors could bring them victory in a third , and final , Trollwar , and promised them power over the city . Aviss and Fellandar chose to give up their humanity and swore a bond between them . As the trolls watched on , Aviss and Fellandar entered a certain pool where the fell magic of the Mere transformed them into inhuman creatures of raw and primal power . Empowered , the pair led a new troll army out of the Mere and south toward Waterdeep in the Year of the Thundering Horde , 963 DR . They knew well the city ' s defenses , and Castle Waterdeep had only just begun construction a month before .

title: Fellows of Free Fate
description: Fellows of Free Fate This is a special fellowship of clergy within the church of Tymora who have dedicated themselves to countering the efforts of Beshaba , and especially of the Black Fingers , her assassins . Any clergy member may join who shows experience , dedication to the cause and is vouched for by a senior Fellow .

title: Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon
description: Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon The Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon is a now retired adventuring group that consisted of Caledan Caldorien , Kera , the mage Morhion , Ferret the thief , Tyveris and the halfling Estah . After the events involving the rule of the Zhentarim under Ravendas over Iriaebor the Harper Mari Al ' maren joined the ranks of the fellowship .

title: Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain
description: Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain The Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain was an order of priest s dedicated to the god Geb of the Mulhorandi pantheon . The majority of adventuring priests of Geb were members of this order . The fellows were charged with discovering the location of a legendary mountain supposed to contain large mithral deposits .

title: Fellowship of the Purple Staff
description: Fellowship of the Purple Staff The Fellowship of the Purple Staff is a group of like - minded priest s and other faithful who have united to settle the area of the Gulthmere Forest and the other lands north of Turmish into a more civilized land they call the " Holy Realm " . Striking from the forest and the western settlement of Cedarspoke the Fellowship has successfully sought out to slay evil creatures and generally bring settlements of civilization to an uncivilized land . Membership .
description_long: Fellowship of the Purple Staff The Fellowship of the Purple Staff is a group of like - minded priest s and other faithful who have united to settle the area of the Gulthmere Forest and the other lands north of Turmish into a more civilized land they call the " Holy Realm " . Striking from the forest and the western settlement of Cedarspoke the Fellowship has successfully sought out to slay evil creatures and generally bring settlements of civilization to an uncivilized land . Membership . Almost all non - evil inhabitants of the region are welcome to the Fellowship , as long as they are willing to work hard and have something to contribute . " Fellows " of the Purple Staff are respected throughout the Holy Realm and are often assigned different tasks depending on their particular skills . Cleric s for example , with their " zone of truth " and " geas " spells , are often used in the administration of justice . Knowledgeable ranger s are often used as scouts and guides while wizards can often be found using their spells in a particularly unique fashion to facilitate and accelerate work projects . History .

title: Felodar Aumar
description: Felodar Aumar Felodar Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the most successful after his brother Belaur Aumar . History . Felodar never loved his country or his family , his only interest was amassing wealth .
description_long: Felodar Aumar Felodar Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the most successful after his brother Belaur Aumar . History . Felodar never loved his country or his family , his only interest was amassing wealth . Soon , he established a base in Calimshan . Once there , he fostered trade between Calimshan and Athalantar , and between the Realm of the Stag and everywhere else , pleasing his father very much . However , Felodar also involved himself in all kind of criminal dealings . He became so powerful in Calimshan that he decided to send his own group of mages , dubbed the Night Mages , to confront the magelord s who followed his brother Belaur Aumar , but with no success . Felodar remained a threat to Belaur ' s rule for nuch of the time the eldest prince sat on the Stag Throne but at last he was poisoned by a Calishite rival in late 239 DR .

title: Felratha
description: Felratha Felratha was a priestess of Lliira in the Moonsea . Activities . Felratha lead a minstrel band , the Felratha ' s Merry Minstrels .
description_long: Felratha Felratha was a priestess of Lliira in the Moonsea . Activities . Felratha lead a minstrel band , the Felratha ' s Merry Minstrels . History . During the Rage of Demons , Felratha met the drow Arrizz , who was on the surface to search for goods for the refugees from Szith Morcane . Felratha agreed to help him , thanks to her contacts . Together , they gained a shipment of supplies from the Zhentarim and planned to deliver them using the Waydown . For this , they hired an adventuring party to escort them . The plan was to use the minstrel band as cover in order to pass the Red Plumes ' garrison inside the Waydown without suspicion . She was also working with the Order of the Gauntlet to expose Commander Maggarl Helck ' s illicit activities . Personality . Felratha had a kind heart and was worried about the nonhumans ' plight in Hillsfar . She played her lute every time things grew dull . Relationship . Felratha had good connections with the Harpers , the Order of the Gauntlet , the Emerald Enclave , the Lords ' Alliance , and even the Zhentarim .

title: Felsul
description: Felsul Felsul was a type of deciduous tree that thrived in harsh conditions . Description . Felsul trees had flaky brown bark , from the hue of cinnamon to deep brown .
description_long: Felsul Felsul was a type of deciduous tree that thrived in harsh conditions . Description . Felsul trees had flaky brown bark , from the hue of cinnamon to deep brown . Underneath the layer of bark was a soft wood . The trees were often gnarled and twisted . They typically flowered briefly in the early spring . Usage . Fresh felsul wood could be eaten to decrease nausea and to numb the mouth and throat to enable eating and sleeping . Felsul wood was did not burn well and was too weak to have much other use . Felsul flowers could be crushed to make an alluring , spicy perfume . An ounce of this perfume cost 100 gp . A sack of flowers could be sold for 5 – 30 sp . Felsul root was sometimes used for small carvings , such as for holy symbol s , figurines , and toys . Locations . Felsuls were often found in cold , rocky places with poor soil . They could grow where no other tree could : in poor soil , on cliff sides , and in crags . They were common in northwest Faerûn . They were known to line the Laughingflow in the Evermoors . . Felsuls were also found in Adhe Wood in the Vast .

title: Feluna Moonstar
description: Feluna Moonstar Feluna Moonstar was a female human werecat cleric of Selûne in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Feluna had many of the traits of felines , like a strong sense of independence , nocturnal habits , and a hunter ' s mentality .
description_long: Feluna Moonstar Feluna Moonstar was a female human werecat cleric of Selûne in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Feluna had many of the traits of felines , like a strong sense of independence , nocturnal habits , and a hunter ' s mentality . History . Felina was the youngest sister of Rober Moonstar . Feluna ' s feline power appeared during the Time of Troubles when , after being kidnapped and gagged and left in the sewers for several days , she begged the moon goddess for help and was transformed into a cat .

title: Felyndiira T ' orgh
description: Felyndiira T ' orgh Felyndiira T ' orgh was the head of the College of Illusion and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Felyndiira was a slippery and oily individual .
description_long: Felyndiira T ' orgh Felyndiira T ' orgh was the head of the College of Illusion and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Felyndiira was a slippery and oily individual . Rumors said Felyndiira worshiped Lolth in secret . In 1379 DR , she supported Guldor Zauviir ' s proposal to promote T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic .

title: Fender Stouthammer
description: Fender Stouthammer Fender Stouthammer is a young dwarf of the Stouthammer clan . He was among those that followed Torgar when he left Mirabar for Mithral Hall . He was captured by Tos ' un Armgo in a sneak attack with a poisoned blade .
description_long: Fender Stouthammer Fender Stouthammer is a young dwarf of the Stouthammer clan . He was among those that followed Torgar when he left Mirabar for Mithral Hall . He was captured by Tos ' un Armgo in a sneak attack with a poisoned blade . He managed to warn refugees from Nesmé of an ambush before being skewered by a sharpened branch . He is later healed by a Cleric of Lolth , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett . Tos ' un and Kaer ' lic present him to Obould Many - Arrows as a gift . He returns home in the company of Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Feng Ironhead
description: Feng Ironhead Feng Ironhead was a half - orc shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Feng was a genius in his field : he could pick what looked to be an ordinary weapon or piece of armor that in truth was extremely durable .
description_long: Feng Ironhead Feng Ironhead was a half - orc shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Feng was a genius in his field : he could pick what looked to be an ordinary weapon or piece of armor that in truth was extremely durable . However , he was a bad businessmen , often selling good items for cheap prices , but he didn ' t care . Activities . Feng ran a shop in the village . History . Feng was a sellsword and caravan guard until 1489 DR when he settled in Red Larch , opening his shop .

title: Fenkenkabradon Dokaan
description: Fenkenkabradon Dokaan Fenkenkabradon Dokaan was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Fenkenkabradon . He was also the commander of the Lance Defenders in 1486 DR . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p256 " > < / ref > Description .
description_long: Fenkenkabradon Dokaan Fenkenkabradon Dokaan was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Fenkenkabradon . He was also the commander of the Lance Defenders in 1486 DR . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p256 " > < / ref > Description . Dokaan was tall dragonborn with bronze - colored scales . History . In 1479 DR , Dokaan took part in the operation to laid siege to Ashhold and kill the green dragon Skuthosiin . In 1486 DR , Dokaan was Clan Fenkenkabradon ' s candidate for the elections to chose the new Vanquisher , that were expected to be celebrated in 1487 DR . He was the candidate with the most weak claim to the title , due to his poor skills as a commander .

title: Fenmarel Mestarine
description: Fenmarel Mestarine Fenmarel Mestarine is a member of the Seldarine , though he refuses to have any contact with them unless absolutely necessary . He is sullen and withdrawn , offering cynicism and distrust to almost any non - elf who he comes across . Worshipers .
description_long: Fenmarel Mestarine Fenmarel Mestarine is a member of the Seldarine , though he refuses to have any contact with them unless absolutely necessary . He is sullen and withdrawn , offering cynicism and distrust to almost any non - elf who he comes across . Worshipers . Those most likely to worship Fenmarel Mestarine are pariahs and tribes of wild elves struggling to survive in a world hostile to their kind . The clergy of Fenmarel Mestarine offer training in techniques considered underhanded by some , including poisoning , guerilla warfare , and deception . Members of Fenmarel Mestarine ' s clergy pray at dusk , an analogy to when darkness first settles upon the world . Each independent group of worshipers worships and celebrates their god in their own unique way , a representation of the chaotic nature of a profoundly paranoid deity . Relationships . Solonor Thelandira , Shevarash , Gwaeron Windstrom , and Eilistraee are all on good terms with Fenmarel Mestarine , but only the beauty and gentleness of Sehanine Moonbow can bring him into the council halls of the Seldarine . History . Fenmarel Mestarine was Lolth ' s adulterous partner prior to her betrayal .

title: Fenn
description: Fenn Fenn was a young man of Waterdeep who was Kyriani Agrivar ' s current beau in the summer of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . Fenn was with Kyriani on the hottest day of summer , 1357 DR , in the Selûne ' s Smile tavern as Vajra Valmeyjar arm - wrestled Timoth Eyesbright while Onyx the Invincible collected bets . Fenn asked Kyriani which one to bet on , but Kyriani suggested he try his arm on the winner .
description_long: Fenn Fenn was a young man of Waterdeep who was Kyriani Agrivar ' s current beau in the summer of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . Fenn was with Kyriani on the hottest day of summer , 1357 DR , in the Selûne ' s Smile tavern as Vajra Valmeyjar arm - wrestled Timoth Eyesbright while Onyx the Invincible collected bets . Fenn asked Kyriani which one to bet on , but Kyriani suggested he try his arm on the winner . But at that point , Aviss and Fellandar were released from their extra - dimensional prison to wreak a path of destruction in the city , and Kyriani and Onyx pursued and fought them . When all was done , Fell was impressed with Kyriani ' s prowess . Description . Fenn had blond hair tied in a ponytail , and wore a mauve open vest open and hot - pink breeches .

title: Fennor
description: Fennor Fennor was a berserker and warlord of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Fennor led a small raiding band of the Elk tribe .
description_long: Fennor Fennor was a berserker and warlord of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Fennor led a small raiding band of the Elk tribe . In 1491 DR , following visions of her daughter , Fennor led her men to a mound near the Nettlebee ranch . There Fennor , as prophesied , met the old chieftain Javor , now risen as a revenant . She offered the support of her men to him in raiding the ranch . In truth , she wanted use this occasion to raid and destroy the ranch anyway . Personality . Fennor was a bloodthirsty leader , wanting massacres . However , she respected Javor and if asked by him Fennor could be convinced to abort the raid .

title: Fenris Aghatonn
description: Fenris Aghatonn Fenris Aghatonn was the Lady of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Fenris was the wife of Arthus Cavilos .
description_long: Fenris Aghatonn Fenris Aghatonn was the Lady of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Fenris was the wife of Arthus Cavilos . She was also the grandniece of Lord Taern Hornblade of Silverymoon . Activities . Fenris took care of her spirited daughters Lavencia Cavilos , who wanted to become a wizard like her mother , and Eryl Cavilos , who wanted to become a knight of Tyr like her father .

title: Fenthick Moss
description: Fenthick Moss Fenthick Moss was an elf who was Lady Aribeth ' s lover . Fenthick was working to help find the cure to the Wailing Death , supposedly along with Desther , when Desther stole the cure shortly after its creation . Fenthick followed Desther in the hope of making him recant and ended up hanged for his " collaboration " with the false Helm ite traitor .
description_long: Fenthick Moss Fenthick Moss was an elf who was Lady Aribeth ' s lover . Fenthick was working to help find the cure to the Wailing Death , supposedly along with Desther , when Desther stole the cure shortly after its creation . Fenthick followed Desther in the hope of making him recant and ended up hanged for his " collaboration " with the false Helm ite traitor . Years later , the spirit of Fenthick could be found in the Tomb of the Betrayers .

title: Feral spirit
description: Feral spirit Feral spirits are beastmaster s trained to an unusual degree , even amongst other beastmasters , in fostering a bond between themselves and their animal companion that transcends normal communication . Such rangers know on an instinctive level the goals , desires , fears , and actions of their feral partner as intimately as the animal itself and the same is true in reverse . In the heat of the moment , feral spirits and the beasts with whom they travel are , for all practical purposes , one being .
description_long: Feral spirit Feral spirits are beastmaster s trained to an unusual degree , even amongst other beastmasters , in fostering a bond between themselves and their animal companion that transcends normal communication . Such rangers know on an instinctive level the goals , desires , fears , and actions of their feral partner as intimately as the animal itself and the same is true in reverse . In the heat of the moment , feral spirits and the beasts with whom they travel are , for all practical purposes , one being . Feral spirits gain this uncanny ability , which seems telepathic to the uninitiated , through a literal binding of spirits . How this is accomplished is not quite understood , though the primal power of the world is believed responsible for the unusually tight connection between ranger and beast , which allows the two to feel one another ' s emotions and thoughts as they come . The original inventors of the tradition of the feral spirit are also unknown , though many point towards the elves . Abilities .

title: Fergana Pass
description: Fergana Pass Fergana Pass was a well - used route through the northern reaches of Teyla Shan in the Hordelands . Geography . Caravans heading north from Semphar into the vast steppes often chose this route since Iris Well Spring was found within a short distance where the pass exited the mountains .
description_long: Fergana Pass Fergana Pass was a well - used route through the northern reaches of Teyla Shan in the Hordelands . Geography . Caravans heading north from Semphar into the vast steppes often chose this route since Iris Well Spring was found within a short distance where the pass exited the mountains .

title: Feringal Auck
description: Feringal Auck Feringal Auck was the lord of Auckney . Description . Feringal was not considered a very effective leader , although considering Auckney ' s status that was not such a terrible thing .
description_long: Feringal Auck Feringal Auck was the lord of Auckney . Description . Feringal was not considered a very effective leader , although considering Auckney ' s status that was not such a terrible thing . Due to his status in court , he was quite lonely ; after setting his eyes on Meralda Ganderlay , he spent much effort courting her and trying to be as romantic as possible . History . Feringal became lord of Auckney after the death of his parents ( his father was Tristan Auck , lord of Auckney ) when he was only 14 years old . He fell in love with Meralda and arranged to marry her around 1369 DR . Relationships . Feringal ' s older sister , Priscilla Auck , advised Feringal ( whom she called " Feri " ) on matters of society . She heavily influenced Feringal in his rule of Auckney , since she considered the fiefdom to be properly hers . She was originally against Feringal ' s marriage to Meralda , in part because Meralda was a commoner and in part because of Priscilla ' s naturally controlling nature . Feringal relied on the advice of his steward , Temigast , who helped to raise him after his father ' s death .

title: Ferla Treeclimber
description: Ferla Treeclimber Ferla Treeclimber was a wild elf who lived in the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . Activities . Ferla ruled the Trunalor tribe for nearly 300 years through the mid 14th century DR .
description_long: Ferla Treeclimber Ferla Treeclimber was a wild elf who lived in the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . Activities . Ferla ruled the Trunalor tribe for nearly 300 years through the mid 14th century DR . As a shaman , she used her clerical powers to the benefit of the tribe . The Trunalor people were in constant conflict with the nation of Dambrath over the bluewood trees that grew in the forest .

title: Fern
description: Fern The fern was a common type of plant in Faerûn . Variations . Softwood .
description_long: Fern The fern was a common type of plant in Faerûn . Variations . Softwood . The softwood fern grew well in the sandy soil of the Rimwood , despite it being covered in slowly decomposing pine needles . Moonfern . Moonfern was a type of fern found in the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . It was found in the groves of alder s , hickories and bitternut s . Cooking . The parts of a fern — the fronds and the fiddlehead of a coiled young fern — were used in cooking , such as fern - frond soup and fiddlehead soup , fern - and - fiddlehead soup , boiled fiddleheads , and fiddlehead butter . There was also fern - and - mint wine .

title: Fern - frond soup
description: Fern - frond soup Fern - frond soup was a dish made in Faerûn , using the fronds of a fern . Geography . The village of Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast was famous for its fern - frond soup .
description_long: Fern - frond soup Fern - frond soup was a dish made in Faerûn , using the fronds of a fern . Geography . The village of Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast was famous for its fern - frond soup . It also made a fiddlehead soup from younger plants .

title: Ferremo Magli
description: Ferremo Magli Ferremo Magli was an assassin and the chief servant of the green dragon , Andareunarthex . Description . The blonde haired Ferremo liked to wear nice clothes because he found it made him less noticeable than clothing favored by most assassins .
description_long: Ferremo Magli Ferremo Magli was an assassin and the chief servant of the green dragon , Andareunarthex . Description . The blonde haired Ferremo liked to wear nice clothes because he found it made him less noticeable than clothing favored by most assassins . History . In 1479 DR , Magli helped kidnap Nazra Mray ' s young son so Andarenarthex could extort the " Dragonstaff " from Nazra . Death . During his rescue of Clytemorrenestrix , Tennora Hedare kill Magli in Andareunarthex ' s hideout .

title: Ferret
description: Ferret The ferret was a common animal in the Realms . Description . Like weasel s , these animals were small and furry creatures .
description_long: Ferret The ferret was a common animal in the Realms . Description . Like weasel s , these animals were small and furry creatures . Behavior . Ferrets could be extremely aggressive , but chose to attack smaller prey . Ecology . These animals could be trained and domesticated . Species . Semberholme . The Semberholme ferret was found in the Semberholme area of the Cormanthor forest . It was characterized by its color - changing fur , which was normally brown , but became white in the winter to provide extra camouflage against wolves .

title: Ferrodraco
description: Ferrodraco Ferrodraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that ferrodracos were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " Ignidraco " genus .
description_long: Ferrodraco Ferrodraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that ferrodracos were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " Ignidraco " genus . It was theorized that , unlike the ferocious inficedraco s , " Ferrodraco " species favored an intellectual and more social behavior , developing a level of intelligence superior to that of the inficedracos . Ferrodracos continued to undergo a series of rapid evolution process until they eventually evolved into the true metallic dragon species some time around - 10000 DR . Supporters of the proto - dragon theory believed that metallic dragons mentioned in historical documents written before that period of time , such as the " Parwiccan Cycle " and other similar documents , were in fact members of the " Ferrodraco " genus . Due to the lack of evidence to prove such claims , however , that theory not only wasn ' t popular enough among scholarly circles and reputed sages but also often ridiculed — along with their supporters .

title: Ferryl Nimersyl
description: Ferryl Nimersyl Ferryl Nimersyl was the commander of the Moon Knights . He was known to have fought well in Nimesin ' s War in 1371 DR . In 1374 he joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade .
description_long: Ferryl Nimersyl Ferryl Nimersyl was the commander of the Moon Knights . He was known to have fought well in Nimesin ' s War in 1371 DR . In 1374 he joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade . He and all his knights died in the final battle against the daemonfey at the Vale of Lost Voices .

title: Ferzath
description: Ferzath Ferzath was a black dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Ferzath was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .
description_long: Ferzath Ferzath was a black dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Ferzath was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . He was one of the dragons Alasklerbanbastos sought out to attack Luthcheq and destroy the Brotherhood of the Griffon after the dracolich and Brimstone discovered Aoth Fezim attempts to disrupt the " xorvintaal " . During the Battle of Luthcheq , Ferzath was killed by the gold dragon Chelnadatilar .

title: Fesric
description: Fesric Fesric was a Zhent soldier at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . In the wake of the disaster that had destroyed Zhentil Keep , Fesric became the leader of a group of like - minded Zhents who wanted to break away and transform the Citadel of the Raven into the base of a separate power . Kandar Milinal considered him a possible problem for the future , and he considered arranging an " accident " to befall Fesric .
description_long: Fesric Fesric was a Zhent soldier at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . In the wake of the disaster that had destroyed Zhentil Keep , Fesric became the leader of a group of like - minded Zhents who wanted to break away and transform the Citadel of the Raven into the base of a separate power . Kandar Milinal considered him a possible problem for the future , and he considered arranging an " accident " to befall Fesric .

title: Festival of the Founding
description: Festival of the Founding The Festival of the Founding was a celebration held in Menzoberranzan on Ches 20 every year to commemorate the anniversary of Menzoberranzan ' s founding by Menzoberra the Kinless . Unallied houses were to dine together as a display of unity . Sometimes Lolth appeared in the form of an avatar .
description_long: Festival of the Founding The Festival of the Founding was a celebration held in Menzoberranzan on Ches 20 every year to commemorate the anniversary of Menzoberranzan ' s founding by Menzoberra the Kinless . Unallied houses were to dine together as a display of unity . Sometimes Lolth appeared in the form of an avatar . History . The first house , House Baenre , usually held only a cursory celebration . However , in 1484 DR , Quenthel Baenre and her contingent dined with House Fey - Branche , where the " Yor ' thae " ( Danifae Yauntyrr ) of Lolth appeared to them , indicating that Quenthel was in the Spider Queen ' s favor .

title: Fetlock Court
description: Fetlock Court Fetlock Court was a large paved courtyard in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , adjoining the stables of the Palace . It was used as the staging area for mounted guards before their departure on patrols , and was unofficially a concert area for bard s to practice . It was also possible to purchase horse s here .
