The object would flee as fast as possible until at least 10 ft ( 3 m ) away from the nearest creature and then , if not threatened by further encroachment , the appendages would disappear , returning the object to normal . This scenario would repeat as often as necessary until the spell ended , the object was restrained , or the object was subdued or destroyed . Restraint was possible by throwing a net or heavy blanket over the object , or by being picked up by someone strong enough to hold the object . If surrounded , the object took random paths as it was able . The object only moved in open space , it would not attempt to open or crash through doors or windows , or dig its way out .

title: Frizzerfraz
description: Frizzerfraz Frizzerfrazz was a young gold dragon living in the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish in 1358 DR and 1374 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Frizzerfrazz was attacked by a group of wyvern s controlled by Muktar ' s army .
description_long: Frizzerfraz Frizzerfrazz was a young gold dragon living in the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish in 1358 DR and 1374 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Frizzerfrazz was attacked by a group of wyvern s controlled by Muktar ' s army . He was saved by his parents Wizzerrazz and Izzerazz , possibly with the assistance of some adventurers .

title: Froghemoth
description: Froghemoth Froghemoths were elephant - sized amphibious predators with four tentacles and three eyes . They were revered by bullywug s , who treated them as gods . Relations .
description_long: Froghemoth Froghemoths were elephant - sized amphibious predators with four tentacles and three eyes . They were revered by bullywug s , who treated them as gods . Relations . If a bullywug tribe came across a froghemoth , they would attempt to lure it to their den , paying tribute in the form of food and protection . They could communicate only at a basic level , so the froghemoth usually killed and ate a number of bullywugs before they could successfully communicate their intentions . Notable froghemoths . Froghemoths dwelt in a swamp outside Manshaka in Calimshan . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , lured by the fighting between Vajra Valmeyjar and Salabak , it burst out of the water and caught Salabak with its long tongue , devouring him before retreating underwater .

title: Frost ( property )
description: Frost ( property ) Frost is a property that can be magically added to a masterwork weapon . Upon command , a " frost " weapon is sheathed in icy cold . The cold does not harm the wielder .
description_long: Frost ( property ) Frost is a property that can be magically added to a masterwork weapon . Upon command , a " frost " weapon is sheathed in icy cold . The cold does not harm the wielder . The effect remains until another command is given . A " frost " weapon deals cold damage on a successful hit . Bows , crossbows , and slings so crafted bestow the cold energy upon their ammunition . Creation . The creator must cast either " chill metal " or " ice storm " upon the weapon to add this property . He must also sacrifice gold or other items worth 4 , 000 gp plus the weapon ' s enchantment cost ( see Tables 7 - 11 through 7 - 13 ) .

title: Frost Giant ' s Fury
description: Frost Giant ' s Fury Frost Giant ' s Fury is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by . It is a direct continuation of the previous series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " . Summary .
description_long: Frost Giant ' s Fury Frost Giant ' s Fury is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by . It is a direct continuation of the previous series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " . Summary . Having returned from the Demiplane of Dread , Minsc and Delina find themselves on the far northern end of Faerûn .

title: Frost Hills
description: Frost Hills The Frost Hills were a barren region in the southern reaches of the Spine of the World . Geography . Located in the southernmost tip of the Spine of the World , the Frost Hills were bordered by the Evermoors to the south and the Silver Marches to the west .
description_long: Frost Hills The Frost Hills were a barren region in the southern reaches of the Spine of the World . Geography . Located in the southernmost tip of the Spine of the World , the Frost Hills were bordered by the Evermoors to the south and the Silver Marches to the west . Description . The Frost Hills was the place that hosted Mithral Hall , one of the most powerful dwarven stronghold of the North . There also dwelt several Uthgardt tribes , orc s , frost giant s , white dragon s and the lich - lord who lay buried between its labyrinthine ruins under the ice in slow decomposition .

title: Frost agate
description: Frost agate Frost agate , also called frost stone , was a beautiful member of the agate family found in the Realms . Description . These rare ornamental stones were had white markings that resembled frost over the base color of the stone .
description_long: Frost agate Frost agate , also called frost stone , was a beautiful member of the agate family found in the Realms . Description . These rare ornamental stones were had white markings that resembled frost over the base color of the stone . They were usually tumbled and polished to a beautiful glassy finish . A master could cut the fragile stone in , such as in a cut , so that at each point where facets met , a " snowflake " of white " frost " appeared . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Frost agates were often enchanted to be " luckstones " . Low quality stones were treated like other agates : powdered for use in sleeping draughts and other potions . Frost agate in particular was useful when mixing potions together as it nearly always prevented an explosive or poisonous result .

title: Frost backlash
description: Frost backlash Frost backlash is a fairly complex spell learned by swordmage initiates , particularly those of the shielding style of arcane swordplay . Unlike most spells , " frost backlash " can be cast instantaneously , and is used to transform the magic al warding projected by all swordmages into frigid ice , which explodes out from the swordmage ' s weapon when they are injured by a nearby enemy . Even if the spell misses its target , the wave of cold energy still injures the attacker , making " frost backlash " an effective form of retaliation .
description_long: Frost backlash Frost backlash is a fairly complex spell learned by swordmage initiates , particularly those of the shielding style of arcane swordplay . Unlike most spells , " frost backlash " can be cast instantaneously , and is used to transform the magic al warding projected by all swordmages into frigid ice , which explodes out from the swordmage ' s weapon when they are injured by a nearby enemy . Even if the spell misses its target , the wave of cold energy still injures the attacker , making " frost backlash " an effective form of retaliation . " Frost backlash " is fairly difficult to cast and , as such , can only be used once per day .

title: Frost breath
description: Frost breath Frost breath was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused a blast of frigid air to emit from the caster ' s mouth . Effects .
description_long: Frost breath Frost breath was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused a blast of frigid air to emit from the caster ' s mouth . Effects . " Frost breath " gave the caster a one - use breath weapon , blasting a cone - shaped area with extreme cold that caused damage to all susceptible creatures , items , and materials in its path . The cone extended outward from the caster ' s mouth to a distance of 35 ft ( 11 m ) , even farther and more damaging for more experienced casters . Creatures caught in the blast could attempt to avoid the worst of it , taking only half the usual damage . Those that could not dodge the frigid breath were also stunned for a few seconds by the shock to their system . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the caster had to have three drops of water or ice chips which were held in the palm and blown toward the intended victims . History . This spell was believed to be recorded in a holy book of Auril called " Revelations of the Icedawn " and was only granted to her clerical and druidic followers .

title: Frost fingers
description: Frost fingers Frost fingers was a divine spell given to specialty priest s of Auril . This spell produced a fan of freezing cold and ice analogous to the " burning hands " spell . There was an arcane version of this spell that had a narrower field but greater range than the divine version .
description_long: Frost fingers Frost fingers was a divine spell given to specialty priest s of Auril . This spell produced a fan of freezing cold and ice analogous to the " burning hands " spell . There was an arcane version of this spell that had a narrower field but greater range than the divine version . Effects . The divine version of this spell produced shooting shards of ice and bone - chilling cold from the outstretched fingers of the caster . The frigid fan cut through one third of the circle surrounding the caster out to a distance of three feet ( almost a meter ) . Anyone caught in the arc of effect was pelted with sharp shards of ice and exposed to freezing temperatures . If the victim ( or items ) managed to resist the magic of this spell , the effect was only half as harsh . Higher ranks of priests could inflict progressively more damage with this spell . Early reports of the arcane version were identical to the divine version . More recent reports described the spell with only half the field ( a 60 degree arc instead of 120 degrees ) but the icy blast extended out for 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) from the caster ' s fingertips . Components .

title: Frost folk
description: Frost folk The frost folk were a race of human s that long ago struck a bargain with a cold power . Physical characteristics . Frost folk had the height and weight of typical humans .
description_long: Frost folk The frost folk were a race of human s that long ago struck a bargain with a cold power . Physical characteristics . Frost folk had the height and weight of typical humans . They often had bright blue eyes , pale , snowy skin , and blonde hair so pale as to be almost white . A noticeable chill surrounded them . Abilities . Frost folk were immune to the effects of cold . They had darkvision and innate snowsight . From their left eye frost folk could produce a cone of icy mist to blast the area in front of them . Culture . Frost folk often raided to the far south in dark , cold winters and took plunder and captives . They were disciplined fighters with a keen sense of tactics . They enjoyed bloody slaughter and often set ambushes . History . Frost folk were originally humans from Sossal ( and were thus said to be distant relations of the modern Sossrim ) and traced their origin to the war between Raumathar and Narfell . Many from Sossal allied themselves with the Raumathari and sought power from the " cold outer darkness " ( " i . e . " , ice devil s ) , and so the frost folk were born . Relations with other races .

title: Frost giant
description: Frost giant Frost giants , called isejotunen in their own language , are large giant s that live in caverns or castles in cold , mountainous environments . Description . Almost always evil creatures , these giants stand 15 ' ( 4 .
description_long: Frost giant Frost giants , called isejotunen in their own language , are large giant s that live in caverns or castles in cold , mountainous environments . Description . Almost always evil creatures , these giants stand 15 ' ( 4 . 6m ) tall and weigh around 2800lbs ( 1270kg ) . They have white skin and either blue or dirty yellow hair and wear skins or pelts , along with jewelery they own . Their eye color usually matches their hair color . Combat . In combat , frost giants will hurl rocks and then close in with battleaxe s . They are immune to cold , but particularly vulnerable to fire , and have low - light vision . Their power visual senses extend into a higher end of the visible spectrum , allowing them to see more easily through snow and blizzards than other creatures . They will take prisoners if possible . Society . These giants live up to 250 years in societies led by a " jarl " and often survive by means of hunts and raids , although are not below trading if the need arises . In frost giant society , the most important bond except that of the ordning is the family bond . The ordning is determined by a combination of the individual ' s ability to wrestle and boast .

title: Frost whip
description: Frost whip Frost whip was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced an insubstantial , flexible beam of cold that could be used as a weapon . Effects .
description_long: Frost whip Frost whip was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced an insubstantial , flexible beam of cold that could be used as a weapon . Effects . When cast , a six - foot ( 1 . 8 meter ) beam of frost four inches ( 10 centimeters ) in diameter emitted from the caster ' s hand . It was flexible like a whip but insubstantial , passing through objects and foes alike , attacking all within its reach if swung about . On a successful swing it touched or passed through a creature , chilling the target ( s ) with magical cold . Each opponent had a chance to resist the magic of the spell and , if successful , suffered only half the damage normally inflicted . The wielder could also brandish it in front of his or her body , or wave it across an opening , forcing enemies to try and avoid its touch or charge through it and accept their fate . The " frost whip " lasted long enough to make three consecutive attacks or actions ( higher level casters could extended this duration ) , until it was dismissed , or until the caster began casting another spell , whichever occurred first .

title: Frostbind
description: Frostbind Frostbind is an transmutation spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " frostbind " he or she causes chilling ice to envelop the flesh of a creature within fifty feet , slowing their reactions and injuring them . " Frostbind " is relatively difficult to use for its level of complexity and as such a sorcerer is required to rest at least a few minutes before casting it again .
description_long: Frostbind Frostbind is an transmutation spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " frostbind " he or she causes chilling ice to envelop the flesh of a creature within fifty feet , slowing their reactions and injuring them . " Frostbind " is relatively difficult to use for its level of complexity and as such a sorcerer is required to rest at least a few minutes before casting it again .

title: Frostbite
description: Frostbite Frostbite was a cyricist winter wolf involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Frostbite was recruited by Cyric in 1368 DR when he was part of the monster ' s army that assaulted Zhentil Keep at the god ' s will ; he continued to work with the Church of Cyric even after ; in 1375 DR the high members of the church of Cyric send Frostbite to Shadowdale to observe and eventually gained power by the Zhent occupation of the dale .
description_long: Frostbite Frostbite was a cyricist winter wolf involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Frostbite was recruited by Cyric in 1368 DR when he was part of the monster ' s army that assaulted Zhentil Keep at the god ' s will ; he continued to work with the Church of Cyric even after ; in 1375 DR the high members of the church of Cyric send Frostbite to Shadowdale to observe and eventually gained power by the Zhent occupation of the dale . Arrived in the dale Frostbite quickly gained control of the Moonshadow Pack , a pack of wolves ; Frostbite wanted kill many Banite as possible but they appeared too strong for now . frostbite tried to ruin the alliance between Zhent , Church of Shar and drow of House Dhuurniv but meantime hunted the druids of the Circle of Shadowdale .

title: Frostbite ( spell )
description: Frostbite ( spell ) Frostbite was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It inflicted bone - chilling cold on one creature , causing freezing damage and fatigue from hypothermia . Effects .
description_long: Frostbite ( spell ) Frostbite was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It inflicted bone - chilling cold on one creature , causing freezing damage and fatigue from hypothermia . Effects . This spell could be cast on one creature within 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) . More experience casters could extend this range and cause more harm to the target . In an instant , the victim was subjected to extreme cold , causing frostbite , a numbing of the extremities , and the symptoms of hypothermia , leaving the target with debilitating fatigue as if they had suffered long exposure to frigid temperatures . The damage was unavoidable unless the entire spell was avoided or resisted , but with sufficient fortitude the victim could shake off the aftereffect of fatigue . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast . History . This spell was believed to be recorded in a holy book of Auril called " Revelations of the Icedawn " and was only granted to her clerical and druidic followers .

title: Frostbrand
description: Frostbrand Frostbrand , or frost brand , weapons were designed to fight creatures with an affinity for fire . Powers . These weapons were particularly effective against creatures with a tie to the Elemental Plane of Fire .
description_long: Frostbrand Frostbrand , or frost brand , weapons were designed to fight creatures with an affinity for fire . Powers . These weapons were particularly effective against creatures with a tie to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Magical flames could be extinguished half of the time by using a " frostbrand " . If ambient temperatures fell below freezing , the frostbrand was capable of emitting light just like a torch . " Frostbrands " also provided protection as a " ring of fire resistance " .

title: Frostfell
description: Frostfell Frostfell by Mark Sehestedt is the last book of The Wizards series of standalone novels . The story is continued in the Chosen of Nendawen trilogy . Summary .
description_long: Frostfell Frostfell by Mark Sehestedt is the last book of The Wizards series of standalone novels . The story is continued in the Chosen of Nendawen trilogy . Summary . The story involves the wizard Amira from Cormyr as she allies with two outcasts of the Vil Adanrath lythari clan and attempts to recover her son from a band of slavers in the Endless Wastes . These slavers are led by a group of ice devil s that have been trapped on Toril for centuries in mortal bodies . They survive by capturing and possessing humans of a specific aasimar bloodline , and need new bodies because their old ones are badly deteriorating .

title: Frosthelm
description: Frosthelm Frosthelm was king of Sundabar during the early 15th century DR . Relationships . He was the son of Helm Dwarf - Friend and become the king of Sundabar after his father ' s death .
description_long: Frosthelm Frosthelm was king of Sundabar during the early 15th century DR . Relationships . He was the son of Helm Dwarf - Friend and become the king of Sundabar after his father ' s death . Frosthelm had a son that became the next king of the city , Firehelm , until the War of the Silver Marches .

title: Frostrill
description: Frostrill Frostrill was a small thorp located in the Druarwood , north of the Moonwood and the Cold Wood , in the Silver Marches . Inhabitants . The thorp ' s inhabitants were exclusively arctic dwarves and were led by Unimak Giantskull around 1372 DR .
description_long: Frostrill Frostrill was a small thorp located in the Druarwood , north of the Moonwood and the Cold Wood , in the Silver Marches . Inhabitants . The thorp ' s inhabitants were exclusively arctic dwarves and were led by Unimak Giantskull around 1372 DR . The dwarves strenuously defended their hunting territory from numerous enemies . Arctic dwarves tamed a small number of dire wolverine s , which were used for hunting . They kept themselves as much as possible away from the giant s in the area and they had no scruples about attacking orc s with incredible violence .

title: Frozenfar
description: Frozenfar The Frozenfar was a barren region north of the Spine of the World . Usage . The Frozenfar did not have definable boundaries .
description_long: Frozenfar The Frozenfar was a barren region north of the Spine of the World . Usage . The Frozenfar did not have definable boundaries . The term " Frozenfar " was used by people across Faerûn to include various areas . For example , in Amn and the Inner Sea , the term " Frozenfar " referred to the city of Mirabar ( south of the Spine of the World ) and everything north of Mirabar . Sometimes the term " Frozenfar " also included the island of Ruathym . However , in the North , the term " Frozenfar " referred only to the the lands north of the Spine of the World . That is the most commonly accepted usage and the usage used here . Geography . The Frozenfar was bordered by the Spine of the World to the south and extended west through the Sea of Moving Ice as far as the Purple Rocks . It stretched east to the Valley of Khedrun .

title: Fruitcake
description: Fruitcake Fruitcake was a sweet bread studded with dried fruits and nuts and flavored with rum or brandy made on the Pirate Isles . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Fruitcake Fruitcake was a sweet bread studded with dried fruits and nuts and flavored with rum or brandy made on the Pirate Isles . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Dried fruits used commonly in fruitcakes included dates , citron , currants , raisins , and cherries , as well as nuts such as walnuts , hazelnuts and filberts . It was rumored that , if aged for too long , fruitcakes would become so hard and heavy that they could be used as weapons . When purchased through Aurora ' s Catalogue , fruitcakes were shipped in a decorative tin .

title: Frulam Mondath
description: Frulam Mondath Frulam Mondath was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin , holding the rank of Wearer of the Purple . Relationships . Mondath considered Langdedrosa Cyanwrath , her right - hand and often kept the half - dragon at her side .
description_long: Frulam Mondath Frulam Mondath was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin , holding the rank of Wearer of the Purple . Relationships . Mondath considered Langdedrosa Cyanwrath , her right - hand and often kept the half - dragon at her side . History . She was the leader of the Cult army in the assault on Greenest , and Langdedrosa Cyanwrath usually followed her directives . At the Cult ' s camp near the city , Frulam deferred to the half - dragon Rezmir , who was her superior . When adventurers raided the camp , Frulam fought them but was easily defeated and captured . She hesitantly told the adventurers what she knew about the Cult ' s plan to summon Tiamat , which was minimal . Later , Frulam was held captive by the Harpers for trial .

title: Fu - shora
description: Fu - shora Fu - shora was a geisha in Semmishi on Wa around 1357 DR . History . Fu - shora , born as Ido Fushora , was the youngest daughter of Ido Kunarakuai , chief justice of the executive court .
description_long: Fu - shora Fu - shora was a geisha in Semmishi on Wa around 1357 DR . History . Fu - shora , born as Ido Fushora , was the youngest daughter of Ido Kunarakuai , chief justice of the executive court . After her parents ' divorce in 1347 DR , she ran away from home , eventually becoming a geisha in one of the most sordid pleasure districts in Semmishi . In 1357 DR , Kunoarakuai hired some adventurers to find her , telling them she was an important witness . Nobu Chuya had paid for Fu - shora to be his personal concubine . Personality . Fu - shora adapted herself to her sordid life and did not want to return home . She promised herself she would not forgive her father .

title: Fual al Barasth
description: Fual al Barasth Fual yn Senaor al Barasth was a Calishite sage and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Fual was a minor druzir in the Defenders ' Drudach of Memnon , so his position did not permit him the command of many soldiers , and he let the administrative decisions be made by the qayadin .
description_long: Fual al Barasth Fual yn Senaor al Barasth was a Calishite sage and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Fual was a minor druzir in the Defenders ' Drudach of Memnon , so his position did not permit him the command of many soldiers , and he let the administrative decisions be made by the qayadin . Fual thus had a lot of free time to cultivate his passion for rare and old armor and weapons . He usually traded these items with his fellow Knights and had a considerable collection . Fual acquired the golden " Lion Blade " , one of the two " Royal Masque Blades " of King Strohm IV of Tethyr and informed only Lord Alaric Hembreon and hoped to trade the sword to the Tethyrian Crown in exchange for some Shoon Imperium weapons .

title: Fuantze Wah
description: Fuantze Wah Fuantze Wah was a yakuza participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Relationships . Fuantze Wah was a member of a small yakuza gang .
description_long: Fuantze Wah Fuantze Wah was a yakuza participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Relationships . Fuantze Wah was a member of a small yakuza gang . History . In 1358 DR , he was initiated into a ninja clan . From then on , he started to criticize his yakuza elders . However , they were also secretly the leaders of the ninja clan . The elders ordered Fuantze to participate at the Komite . They knew that participation would teach a lesson of humility to Fuantze .

title: Fugue Plane
description: Fugue Plane The Fugue Plane is a neutral plane within the Astral Sea where the souls of mortals are drawn when they die . The vast majority of this plane is flat , gray , bland and nondescript , with no notable topographical features . The sky overhead is also gray .
description_long: Fugue Plane The Fugue Plane is a neutral plane within the Astral Sea where the souls of mortals are drawn when they die . The vast majority of this plane is flat , gray , bland and nondescript , with no notable topographical features . The sky overhead is also gray . The plane ' s only significant feature is the City of Judgment in the middle of which stands the Crystal Spire where Kelemvor and Jergal reside and it serves as the former ' s dominion . There are only three methods of getting to the Fugue Plane : as a divine servant collecting a deity ' s future petitioners , through non - permanent " portal s " from the Nine Hells or the Abyss , or through death . Petitioners . The petitioners of the City are the servants of Kelemvor and Jergal . The False and the Faithless also inhabit the realm . The servants of Kelemvor and Jergal enact punishments on the False and act as a city militia to protect against tanar ' ri raids and , on rare occasions , attack the Abyss to punish demon s for attacking the city . Kelemvor ' s Agreement .

title: Fukada Shiro
description: Fukada Shiro Fukada Shiro was a samurai lord and ally of the Hiro clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Fukada owned the shoen surrounding the Gobo village .
description_long: Fukada Shiro Fukada Shiro was a samurai lord and ally of the Hiro clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Fukada owned the shoen surrounding the Gobo village . He directly controlled his land . He had at his disposal a company of thirty - six samurai and sixty bushi . Shiro was often called to Hiro castle and in those cases it was his son Fukada Takauji who managed the place . Relationship . Shiro was the head of a very small samurai clan , the Fukada family , allied with the Hiro clan .

title: Fukawa
description: Fukawa Fukawa was a mysterious sage in Shou Lung . Personality . Fukawa spoke all the time , about all kinds of subjects .
description_long: Fukawa Fukawa was a mysterious sage in Shou Lung . Personality . Fukawa spoke all the time , about all kinds of subjects . He was a kind of clown but had truly great knowledge . He loved to eat and drink . Activities . Fukawa was a sage living in Mount Fukawa in Chu ' Yuan province . He was quite famous in the area . History . In 1358 DR , an adventuring party hired by the Emperor to find General Goyat Nagumo met Fukawa , who insisted on accompanying them on the adventure . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Fukawa was an NPC to be used by a Dungeon Master to better direct the adventure and serve as help and comic relief for the players .

title: Fulbar Hardcheese
description: Fulbar Hardcheese Fulbar Hardcheese was a halfling tavern owner in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Fulbar was an adventurer in his youth .
description_long: Fulbar Hardcheese Fulbar Hardcheese was a halfling tavern owner in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Fulbar was an adventurer in his youth . He settled down in Daggerford after he acquired a dragon ' s hoard buried deep under his tavern . Thanks to this treasure , Fulbar became a kind of landlord , with considerable holdings in Baldur ' s Gate and Neverwinter and a farm just outside Daggerford managed by his son Dickon Hardcheese . He wanted to become a quiet power in the North but unknown to him he was watched by the Lords ' Alliance , the Harpers , and , from 1370 DR , also the Zhentarim . Appendix . Notes . In " Under Illefarn " and " Volo ' s Guide to the Sword Coast " , Fulbar ' s race is given as halfling , but " " stats him as a half - elf , which is presumed to be in error against all the other evidence .

title: Fulgath
description: Fulgath Fulgath was a male human merchant from Dagger Falls that owned Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies . He was well known for both his high prices and wide range of equipment . Description .
description_long: Fulgath Fulgath was a male human merchant from Dagger Falls that owned Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies . He was well known for both his high prices and wide range of equipment . Description . Fulgath always appeared to be quietly chuckling to himself when customers arrived . Personality . Widely disliked among the folk of Dagger Falls , Fulgath happily over - charged any patrons who came to his shop , as he knew had a monopoly on caravan goods . Throughout his career , Fulgath had been dishonest and curt in his dealings with others . Activities . Ever dealing in underhand businesses , Fulgath would use whatever means he could to make more coin . He regularly charged a 200 % markup on most of his goods . The merchant was the only individual in town that dealt in stolen goods and even poison s , many of which he would gladly procure from corpses . History . Zhent occupation . During the Zhent occupation of Dagger Falls , much trade to the market square was stifled and gave Fulgath a near - monopoly on many goods . This meant Fulgath was able to easily charge over the odds for his goods and was garnering a markup of 200 % by 1367 DR . Return of Randal Morn .

title: Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies
description: Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies was a large shop in Dagger Falls . Structure . The barnlike shop was a thick stone building with large twin doors .
description_long: Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies was a large shop in Dagger Falls . Structure . The barnlike shop was a thick stone building with large twin doors . Services . Fulgath ' s was arrayed with a medley of goods and service . Anything a travelling merchant need on the open road was available here from saddlery or wainwright services to tools or containers . However all these useful provisions were priced at roughly twice the typical cost elsewhere . Inhabitants . The store was run by a cheerful yet shrewd rogue named Fulgath , who was known to " get his price , one way or another . " He was able to back this up by the constant demand for wagon wheels , chests , horse harnesses and other goods that Fulgath provided . History . Around 1368 DR , Fulgath faced competition and caused his business to dabble in more shady deals .

title: Fulminorax
description: Fulminorax Fulminorax was a blue dragon allied with Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . History . To fulfill the terms of their alliance , Valindra agreed to send Fulminorax into the Feywild to help King Malabog to destroy New Sharandar .
description_long: Fulminorax Fulminorax was a blue dragon allied with Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . History . To fulfill the terms of their alliance , Valindra agreed to send Fulminorax into the Feywild to help King Malabog to destroy New Sharandar . However , Fulminorax was killed by some adventurers .

title: Fulta
description: Fulta Fulta was a halfling criminal in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Fulta was a freelance criminal in Phlan with a group of her fellows acting as her guards .
description_long: Fulta Fulta was a halfling criminal in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Fulta was a freelance criminal in Phlan with a group of her fellows acting as her guards . History . In 1489 DR , Fulta and her guards were hired by Soares to help silence an adventuring party hired to recover some stolen books but they were defeated and killed .

title: Funada Genzo
description: Funada Genzo Funada Genzo was the harbormaster of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Genzo was an efficient harbormaster , commander of the shipyard garrison and supervisor of the shipping in the port .
description_long: Funada Genzo Funada Genzo was the harbormaster of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Genzo was an efficient harbormaster , commander of the shipyard garrison and supervisor of the shipping in the port . Thank of his effort the city flourished and he gained advantage . He managed a system of kickbacks and bribes from foreign merchants , despite not asking too many money and protecting and aiding those who did met his terms History . Genzo in order to protect his half - sister Sumi - ko tried to stop her infatuation of Nagoya Kenko Personality . Genzo was arrogant with a love for money . However his main ambition was died in service of his master , Lord Funada Mitsuhide

title: Funada Hashiba
description: Funada Hashiba Funada Hashiba was an abbott in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hashiba led the Nakamaru temple of the Shining Mountain Sect , a very popular temple leading most ceremonies at the local court , which was a prestigious honor .
description_long: Funada Hashiba Funada Hashiba was an abbott in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hashiba led the Nakamaru temple of the Shining Mountain Sect , a very popular temple leading most ceremonies at the local court , which was a prestigious honor . He arrived at such a high position at a very young age thanks to his family but also to his abilities . However , Hashiba was not fully prepared for his task . Personality . Hashiba was very loyal to his father the daimyo and to the shogun , whom he was a distant nephew to . Usually , Mitsuhide easily browbeated him in any matters relating to the family . Hashiba knew his weaknesses well .

title: Funada Mitsuhide
description: Funada Mitsuhide Funada Mitsuhide was the daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun ( where his wife and young children lived ) .
description_long: Funada Mitsuhide Funada Mitsuhide was the daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun ( where his wife and young children lived ) . During these times was his bother Funada Toyoo to run the city . The two brothers were currently feuding over the next daimyo of Nakamaru , if will be son of Mistuhide of son of Toyoo . Mistuhide was trying to discreetly remove Toyoo from his position of administrator of the town Personality . Mistuhide was a very clever individual but rarely revealed this . He missed nothing . Relationship . He was related to the shogun , as his father was an uncle of Matasuuri Nagahide .

title: Funada Toragi
description: Funada Toragi Funada Toragi was a kuei in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In life , Toragi was the brother of Funada Kazuo , the father of Funada Mitsuhide and Funada Toyoo .
description_long: Funada Toragi Funada Toragi was a kuei in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In life , Toragi was the brother of Funada Kazuo , the father of Funada Mitsuhide and Funada Toyoo . He was falsely accused by Kazuo of a plot against the shogun and executed . In truth , he had agreed to serve the Goshukara clan . However , he rose as kuei in order to prove his innocence . Personality . Toragi wanted desperately to have a body again in order to prove his innocence .

title: Funada Toyoo
description: Funada Toyoo Funada Toyoo was the administrator of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often his brother the daimyo Funada Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun and during these times was Toyoo that run the city .
description_long: Funada Toyoo Funada Toyoo was the administrator of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often his brother the daimyo Funada Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun and during these times was Toyoo that run the city . The two brothers were currently feuding over the next daimyo of Nakamaru , if will be son of Mistuhide of son of Toyoo . Mistuhide was trying to discreetly remove Toyoo from his position of administrator of the town Personality . Toyoo was more sly than Mitsuhide and lack his patience , preferring a swift and decisive victory even if at extreme cost .

title: Funada clan
description: Funada clan The Funada clan were the ruling family in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Funada hold the position of daimyo and of many key city officers , plus some members hold important positions in local temples . They kept a close eye over their vassals house thank to their allegiance with the ninja of Hijo clan and to many lesser samurai families , who wanted improve their own position .
description_long: Funada clan The Funada clan were the ruling family in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Funada hold the position of daimyo and of many key city officers , plus some members hold important positions in local temples . They kept a close eye over their vassals house thank to their allegiance with the ninja of Hijo clan and to many lesser samurai families , who wanted improve their own position . Furthermore , the Funada had the aid of the mysterious wu jen Taichi . The power of the Funada came from their close bond with Shogun Matasuuri Nagahide .

title: Furdah Rustauk
description: Furdah Rustauk Furdah Rustauk was the name of the harbor in Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . The walls surrounding Furdah Rustauk were the oldest in the city , sitting in a state of disrepair .
description_long: Furdah Rustauk Furdah Rustauk was the name of the harbor in Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . The walls surrounding Furdah Rustauk were the oldest in the city , sitting in a state of disrepair . Mud brick was used in their construction , which weathered over time . Many canals ran from the harbor to the rest of the city , feeding small boats that carried cargo and passengers from the larger ships that sat at anchor .

title: Furgis Boltsmelter
description: Furgis Boltsmelter Furgis Boltsmelter was a dwarf criminal in Moonsea . Activities . Furgis was a criminal who could be hired to procure information or objects from people with a skill that was uncanny .
description_long: Furgis Boltsmelter Furgis Boltsmelter was a dwarf criminal in Moonsea . Activities . Furgis was a criminal who could be hired to procure information or objects from people with a skill that was uncanny . He used a " medallion of thoughts " , which allowed him to know the secrets that others held , which then permitted him to blackmail or otherwise use the stolen information to his advantage . History . Furgis committed a numbers of crimes for various employers . In 1491 DR , the drow mage Murssvayas Dhuurniv hired Furgis to obtain the elemental codex from the dwarves of Earthfast . He blackmailed a clan leader using his typical scheme and managed to take the codexm and went to deliver it to the drow . However , Furgis was pursued by the Earthfast dwarves and also by both the Cult of the Crushing Wave and the Cult of the Black Earth m who also wanted the codex . Thus , near Mulmaster in the Moonsea , he hired an adventuring party as bodyguards . Possession . Furgis ' s most precious possession was his " medallion of thoughts " , which he called " Aramesha ' s Wisdom " . Personality .

title: Furifax
description: Furifax Furifax was the most powerful bandit leader in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Furifax was traveling with his parents in the Eastern Shaar when they were killed by bandits .
description_long: Furifax Furifax was the most powerful bandit leader in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Furifax was traveling with his parents in the Eastern Shaar when they were killed by bandits . Furifax was very young and was instead taken in and raised by the bandits . In time , he became their leader . However , during a raid in Unther , Furifax was captured and sold into slavery in Unthalass . There he was destined to face Gilgeam himself in the arena but he escaped before the match . Returning to Eastern Shaar , Fufifax killed some other bandit leaders and became the leader of the largest bandit group in the area . Afterward , he started to send his men into Unther in order to encourage rebellion and spy upon the god - king . He also allied himself with the cult of Tiamat . Activities . Furifax was known for his meticulous plans . Personality . Furifax totally embraced the human side of his nature . He was both brave and ruthless . Furifax was an able and loved leader but always cruel with enemies : for him , the end justified the means . He decided that he would decide the time and place for his contest against Gilgeam .

title: Furlinastis
description: Furlinastis Furlinastis was a shadow dragon who lived in a swamp on the Plane of Shadow . His body was covered in moving shadows which twisted into the faces of the souls that were trapped within it . These souls once kept a shard of Mask ' s divinity which was stolen by Kesson Rel and then trapped within the shadow dragon ' s body .
description_long: Furlinastis Furlinastis was a shadow dragon who lived in a swamp on the Plane of Shadow . His body was covered in moving shadows which twisted into the faces of the souls that were trapped within it . These souls once kept a shard of Mask ' s divinity which was stolen by Kesson Rel and then trapped within the shadow dragon ' s body . Ties with Mask . When Furlinastis met Erevis Cale for the first time , he recognized Cale ' s sword , " Weaveshear " , as the weapon belonging to the " First " of Mask . He then healed Cale and his companions of their wounds and said , " The promise has been fulfilled " , which he refused to elaborate on .

title: Furo
description: Furo Furo was the Padhrasattva of Knowledge within the Path of Enlightenment . Furo ' s teachings took the form of a number of sutra s . Followers of Furo were taught to refrain from strong alcohol ic drinks and eating meat .
description_long: Furo Furo was the Padhrasattva of Knowledge within the Path of Enlightenment . Furo ' s teachings took the form of a number of sutra s . Followers of Furo were taught to refrain from strong alcohol ic drinks and eating meat . The lama Koja of Khazari was a follower of Furo . In his book , " A History of the Tuigan " , he wished to quote a verse of the " Yanitsava " to invoke Furo ' s blessing .

title: Furrowed Mountains
description: Furrowed Mountains The Furrowed Mountains , or Jibal al - Hutut , were a prominent mountain range found in North Zakhara . Geography . The Furrowed Mountains ran inland in a northeast diagonal line roughly parallel to the coast of the Great Sea , effectively separating the Free Cities of Zakhara from the harsh desert of the Haunted Lands , before terminating near the World Pillar Mountains and the Land of the Yak - Men .
description_long: Furrowed Mountains The Furrowed Mountains , or Jibal al - Hutut , were a prominent mountain range found in North Zakhara . Geography . The Furrowed Mountains ran inland in a northeast diagonal line roughly parallel to the coast of the Great Sea , effectively separating the Free Cities of Zakhara from the harsh desert of the Haunted Lands , before terminating near the World Pillar Mountains and the Land of the Yak - Men . Description . Many vital river found their origins within the Furrowed Mountains . Inhabitants . Numerous hill tribes of unenlightened Zakharans could be found along the base of the mountains . These tribes were often the target of mamluk raiding parties from Qudra in search of fresh recruits . Because of this the hill tribes were hostile to any who entered their territory until they were able to prove they had no association with Qudra . Trade . The tribes of the Furrowed Mountains exported , sometimes unwillingly , gem s and slaves to their neighbors .

title: Furthinghome
description: Furthinghome Furthinghome was a trading port city in Aglarond and one of the oldest cities in the nation . Description . Around 1368 DR , it was made up of some buildings in the traditional Aglarondan weathered wood style and others made from stone .
description_long: Furthinghome Furthinghome was a trading port city in Aglarond and one of the oldest cities in the nation . Description . Around 1368 DR , it was made up of some buildings in the traditional Aglarondan weathered wood style and others made from stone . It also contained a large slum where the buildings were simple huts . At the city ' s center was a circular road and a public park called Old Furthing , which acted as a social and financial center . Trade . The port in Furthinghome was small and shallow , which limited the size of vessels that could dock . In 1368 DR , merchants imported spices , textiles , tools , and weapons , and exported fish and a small amount of timber from the Yuirwood , limited in quantity by its half - elf occupants . The city was also known for its horticulture around the same time , particularly for the dahlias , roses , and orchids grown in the glass greenhouses of the wealthier citizens , but also for herbs too . Government . The city was ruled in 1374 DR by Lord Fardyl Albin , a member of the Royal Council of Aglarond . He preferred to stay away from the council where possible and concentrate his efforts on the wealthier merchants of Furthinghome .

title: Fury
description: Fury The Fury was a plague caused by the demon Scour . Victims were infected through the bite of an infected creature and developed oozing sores and strange crimson cystaline growths . Those infected became increasingly aggressive and , if they didn ' t die in a fight , eventually lost their minds .
description_long: Fury The Fury was a plague caused by the demon Scour . Victims were infected through the bite of an infected creature and developed oozing sores and strange crimson cystaline growths . Those infected became increasingly aggressive and , if they didn ' t die in a fight , eventually lost their minds . When victims died , a swarm of mutated vermin often emerged from the victim ' s body . In 1480 DR the plague reached epidemic stage in Luskan although the paladin Kalen Dren and compatriots destroyed Scour , ending the plague .

title: Fury ' s Heart
description: Fury ' s Heart Fury ' s Heart was a Fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the Gods of Fury , Auril , Malar , Talos , and Umberlee until the Spellplague scrambled the cosmos . In the wake of that world - shaping event , it merged with the House of Nature to form the Deep Wilds , except for Talos ' s portion , which the aspect of Gruumsh took with him to Nishrek .
description_long: Fury ' s Heart Fury ' s Heart was a Fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the Gods of Fury , Auril , Malar , Talos , and Umberlee until the Spellplague scrambled the cosmos . In the wake of that world - shaping event , it merged with the House of Nature to form the Deep Wilds , except for Talos ' s portion , which the aspect of Gruumsh took with him to Nishrek . Description . As a Fiendish plane , Fury ' s Heart was host to a segment of the River of Blood which flowed through Malar ' s realm , the Land of the Hunt . A branch of the river also connected to Umberlee ' s Blood Sea . Other than Astral plane travel , the only other known access was via a " portal " somewhere beneath the crashing waves of the Blood Sea , connecting it to the Fated Depths . The Blood Rift randomly became coterminous with this plane , allowing creatures and conflict to spill over into Fury ' s Heart . At first glance , this plane was similar to the Barrens of Doom and Despair , with vast stretches of desolation and weather extremes , but unlike the Barrens , this plane was teeming with life that fought tooth and claw for survival .

title: Fusae
description: Fusae Fusae was a mute businesswoman in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Fusae was the daughter of a famous samurai general but when she was young her father was involved in a plot against the daimyo and in punishment her parents were both executed and Fusae and other members of the family were demoted to the eta caste .
description_long: Fusae Fusae was a mute businesswoman in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Fusae was the daughter of a famous samurai general but when she was young her father was involved in a plot against the daimyo and in punishment her parents were both executed and Fusae and other members of the family were demoted to the eta caste . She decided to move to Aru , where she opened the House of Heavenly Sand . In 1358 DR , a pilgrim was found dead inside Fusae ' s House . She later told an the adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto that she saw three black - suited men delivering the dead body inside her House .

title: Fydor
description: Fydor Fydor was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Fydor was one of the commanders of the fire giant army in the attack on Szith Morcane .
description_long: Fydor Fydor was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Fydor was one of the commanders of the fire giant army in the attack on Szith Morcane . He managed to capture Solom Ned ' razak , the drow archmage leader of the settlement , but some time after he was confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil .

title: Fylo Nelgorn
description: Fylo Nelgorn Fylo Nelgorn was a Zhent diplomat in Nesmé sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Fylo was a priest of Bane who led the Zhentarim delegation in the reconstruction of Nesmé in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR .
description_long: Fylo Nelgorn Fylo Nelgorn was a Zhent diplomat in Nesmé sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Fylo was a priest of Bane who led the Zhentarim delegation in the reconstruction of Nesmé in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR . Secretly , however , Fylo went to deal with the fire giant Gundahella . Gundahella promised the liberation of a Zhent agent prisoner inside Ironslag fortress in exchange for support from the Zhents in stopping good groups like the Lords ' Alliance for interfering with research on a fragment of the Vonindod .

title: Fyndrick Dellmon
description: Fyndrick Dellmon Fyndrick Dellmon was the youngest son of Kerbin Dellmon during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the Dellmon farm .
description_long: Fyndrick Dellmon Fyndrick Dellmon was the youngest son of Kerbin Dellmon during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the Dellmon farm . However , Kerbin refused to abandon his farm and go to Yartar . Fyndrick was worried about the orcs . With the lucky arrival of some adventurers , the Dellmons managed to defend the farm .

title: Fyodor
description: Fyodor Fyodor was a berserker from Rashemen . He was a companion and lover to Liriel Baenre . He was a member of the Black Bear Lodge " fang " in Dernovia .
description_long: Fyodor Fyodor was a berserker from Rashemen . He was a companion and lover to Liriel Baenre . He was a member of the Black Bear Lodge " fang " in Dernovia . Description . Fyodor had thick muscles that made him resemble a tall dwarf , but he wore no beard and had finer features . He had short ( " carelessly cut " ) dark hair . pale skin , and pale blue topaz eyes . He was less than six feet tall , but his berserker rages made him appear closer to seven feet . He carried a three - foot cudgel made of driftwood and a heavy broadsword with a dull blade , which he could not properly wield except during his berserker rages . Despite the dull blade , the sword had been enchanted by his grandmother to cut only those not of Rashemen . In 1361 DR , Fyodor , perhaps because of his proximity to rune magic or other shapeshifters on Ruathym , became a shapeshifter . His shapeshifting form was a large black bear . Like most shapeshifters , he was ravenous after his change . Personality . Fyodor was generally very calm and serious , though he did have a quiet humorous streak . He was a hardworker , but a bit of a dreamer . His favorite adage was , " There are those who think and those who dream .

title: Fyraven
description: Fyraven Fyraven was the oldest human - settled area of Tethyr . Geography . Fyraven was a county of Cape Velen .
description_long: Fyraven Fyraven was the oldest human - settled area of Tethyr . Geography . Fyraven was a county of Cape Velen . It occupied the central stretch of the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula , between counties Firedrake and Greenshores . Government . In 1370 DR , the county was ruled by the young Tanar Keelson , who was only fifteen - years - old at the time . His county seat was at Monguldarath , a haunted estate . Notable Locations . The town of Tulmene was the only settlement of significant size in the county . History . The majority of the original twelve clans of Tethyr originated from this small region . Indeed , their burial sites could still be found throughout the county . Most recognizable were the toroid burial mounds of Clan Fyrson .

title: Fyrefly
description: Fyrefly A fyrefly is a 2 " ( 5cm ) - long flying insect that flickers with flame at night . Diet . The fyrefly eats vegetation .
description_long: Fyrefly A fyrefly is a 2 " ( 5cm ) - long flying insect that flickers with flame at night . Diet . The fyrefly eats vegetation . In Cormanthor ' s rimwood area , it eats the cornflower pollen . Behaviour . The Cormanthor fyreflies gather in massive swarms on clear summer evenings , and this causes scorching and damage to the foliage in the area . This continues until the morning light arrives and they dissipate . If there is an extremely clear night in the Cormanthor forest , the fyreflies will confuse the highly visible stars with an invasion of rival fyreflies , and go into a frenzy , causing extensive damage and igniting many fires .

title: Fyrentennimarr
description: Fyrentennimarr Fyrentennimarr was a powerful red dragon who had her lair in the Snowflake Mountains . Fyrentennimarr was a very powerful and famous red dragon living in the region . History .
description_long: Fyrentennimarr Fyrentennimarr was a powerful red dragon who had her lair in the Snowflake Mountains . Fyrentennimarr was a very powerful and famous red dragon living in the region . History . When Cadderly Bonaduce wanted to destroy the evil magical sentient item Ghearufu in 1362 , a divine inspiration from Deneir informed him that he needed the fire of a dragon . Cadderly went to Fyrentennimarr ' s lair . At first , Fyrentennimarr didn ' t want to help . As last resort , Cadderly used a powerful spell to change the dragon ' s alignment , and the dragon , now a gentle creature , collaborated to destroy the evil Ghearufu . Later , with this powerful ally , but only until the end of the spell , Cadderly decided with his party to assault and destroy Castle Trinity . However , the magic defenses of the castle and the end of Cadderly ' s spell confused the dragon and in the end Fyrentennimarr was killed .

title: Fyrfar Smokebeard
description: Fyrfar Smokebeard Fyrfar Smokebeard was a dwarf and a Master Smith of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Fyrfar forged over a thousand weapons from orcslayer metal over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .
description_long: Fyrfar Smokebeard Fyrfar Smokebeard was a dwarf and a Master Smith of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Fyrfar forged over a thousand weapons from orcslayer metal over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR . The weapons were enchanted by High Old One Turbaern , the human mage Beldossan the Short and the elven sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar .

title: Fyrillicus
description: Fyrillicus Fyrillius was a red dragon in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Fyrillicus patrolled the lands around the gate of the castle of Orcus .
description_long: Fyrillicus Fyrillius was a red dragon in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Fyrillicus patrolled the lands around the gate of the castle of Orcus . History . Fyrillicus was spawned by a long line of red dragons that Orcus had subdued and brought to the Abyss and were larger than Prime Material Plane dragons . Personality . The breeding process devised by Orcus had made Fyrillicus quite stupid . He always used the most direct approach . He was savage and cruel .

title: Fzoul Chembryl
description: Fzoul Chembryl Fzoul Chembryl was the Faerûnian god of service to evil as well as an exarch of Bane . Formerly the mortal Chosen tyrant of his dark overlord , Fzoul was killed while fighting the Shadovar and was granted the status of an exarch as his reward for dying in Bane ' s service . History .
description_long: Fzoul Chembryl Fzoul Chembryl was the Faerûnian god of service to evil as well as an exarch of Bane . Formerly the mortal Chosen tyrant of his dark overlord , Fzoul was killed while fighting the Shadovar and was granted the status of an exarch as his reward for dying in Bane ' s service . History . Fzoul Chembryl , the ambitious Chosen and High Priest of Bane , joined the Zhentarim when Lord Manshoon ( then leader of the Zhentarim ) forged an alliance with him . He served as second - in - command for years , seemingly content with his position , but he schemed with another high - ranking Zhentarim , Lord Orgauth ( the lord of Zhentil Keep who was , in fact , not human as he seemed , but a fell pit fiend ) and eventually ousted Manshoon from power . Fzoul intended to turn the Zhentarim into an arm of the faith of Bane , and forced from the Zhentarim both loyalists to Manshoon ( including Manshoon ' s lieutenant , the powerful mage Sememmon ) and the faithful of the rival deity of Cyric .

title: Gabble Dripskillet
description: Gabble Dripskillet Gabble Dripskillet was the main deep gnome representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Gabble was a merchant and shopkeeper selling salt , gemstones , and rare minerals .
description_long: Gabble Dripskillet Gabble Dripskillet was the main deep gnome representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Gabble was a merchant and shopkeeper selling salt , gemstones , and rare minerals . She was surprised by a duergar attack on her section of the trading post . She was ready to negotiate in order to stop the madness . Relationship . Gabble was on good terms with Yantha Coaxrock .

title: Gabriel
description: Gabriel Gabriel was a solar in the service of Bahamut . History . In 1357 DR , Gabriel was captured by a group of balor s in the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus .
description_long: Gabriel Gabriel was a solar in the service of Bahamut . History . In 1357 DR , Gabriel was captured by a group of balor s in the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus . He was tortured by them until eventually he was freed by Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Gabrielle
description: Gabrielle Gabrielle was a wizard - in - training of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . History . Gabrielle grew up in Bloodstone Village dreaming of becoming a wizard .
description_long: Gabrielle Gabrielle was a wizard - in - training of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . History . Gabrielle grew up in Bloodstone Village dreaming of becoming a wizard . In 1357 DR , she joined Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party as she wanted to study under the party ' s wizard , Emelyn the Gray . In 1359 DR , Gabrielle was the apprentice of Emelyn and a member of the Twilight Riders . Personality . Gabrielle was fond of older men . She dreamed of becoming a wizard , and wanted to become an apprentice to one in order to learn . Gabrielle was chaste and shy but romantic . In 1359 DR , she hoped to become Emelyn ' s wife . Relationship . Gabrielle was the daughter of the village ' s bakers , Benjamin and Anna . She fell in love with Emelyn .

title: Gabulla
description: Gabulla Gabulla was a goblin shaman living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . History . Around 1486 DR , Gabulla was possessed by the pit fiend Baazka and , under his manipulation , convinced her leader Shorg to invade the village of Julkoun , following the suggestion of one of the Red Wizards of Thay .
description_long: Gabulla Gabulla was a goblin shaman living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . History . Around 1486 DR , Gabulla was possessed by the pit fiend Baazka and , under his manipulation , convinced her leader Shorg to invade the village of Julkoun , following the suggestion of one of the Red Wizards of Thay . Later , she was defeated by an adventuring party .

title: Gacholoth
description: Gacholoth Gacholoths serve as the infiltrators and terrorists of the Blood War , causing havoc and spreading panic to all sides . These master betrayers have a fondness for deceit and terror that makes them well - favored by yugoloth commanders . They may spend even centuries serving and ingratiating themselves to a baatezu or tanar ' ri master , serving with the utmost loyalty , all the while planning for the best moment to torture and slaughter their supposed allies .
description_long: Gacholoth Gacholoths serve as the infiltrators and terrorists of the Blood War , causing havoc and spreading panic to all sides . These master betrayers have a fondness for deceit and terror that makes them well - favored by yugoloth commanders . They may spend even centuries serving and ingratiating themselves to a baatezu or tanar ' ri master , serving with the utmost loyalty , all the while planning for the best moment to torture and slaughter their supposed allies . They will not be outdone by other beings with similar talents for deception , and have an intense hatred of creatures such as succubi , erinyes , and cambion s . Gacholoths also have taken an interest in the Material plane . If given the opportunity to enter the land of mortals , they will indulge in a great reign of bloodletting , using their abilities to play with their victims like toys . Physical description . A gacholoth has a roughly humanoid appearance . Their bodies are ebony black , and they have four long and powerful legs , each tipped with three sharp claws to aid in climbing .

title: Gaedynn Ulraes
description: Gaedynn Ulraes Gaedynn Ulraes was a warrior and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . He was primarily known for his superb markmanship as an archer . History .
description_long: Gaedynn Ulraes Gaedynn Ulraes was a warrior and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . He was primarily known for his superb markmanship as an archer . History . Gaedynn was from minor nobility and spent most of his youth as a hostage of the elves of the Yuirwood , who taught him archery and woodcraft . He participated in the Brotherhood ' s war with Szass Tam and traveled with Aoth Fezim to Chessenta . After the Brotherhood foiled a plot by abishai to murder residents of Luthcheq and pin the killings on mage s , Gaedynn was assigned to travel to Threskel with Jhesrhi Coldcreek to investigate rumors of an ancient red dragon in the Skyrider Mountains . There , Gaedynn and Jhesri were captured by Alasklerbanbastos ' minions and taken to Mount Thulbane . They later escaped and continued on to the Skyriders . There , they traveled through a planar rift to the Shadowfell , where they found Tchazzar imprisoned by a blight wyrm . Jhesrhi freed Tchazzar and they traveled back to Luthcheq , where Tchazzar reclaimed his throne .

title: Gaerdal Ironhand
description: Gaerdal Ironhand Gaerdal Ironhand ( " GAIR - dul EYE - urn - hand " ) , was a lawful good deity of the gnome pantheon , led by the Greater deity Garl Glittergold . The sternest and most serious of gnome deities , Gaerdal was the patron of warriors and protectors of gnomish communities . As such , he was honored in some manner by nearly all good - aligned gnomes , and one or two crusaders would be found in most sizable settlements .
description_long: Gaerdal Ironhand Gaerdal Ironhand ( " GAIR - dul EYE - urn - hand " ) , was a lawful good deity of the gnome pantheon , led by the Greater deity Garl Glittergold . The sternest and most serious of gnome deities , Gaerdal was the patron of warriors and protectors of gnomish communities . As such , he was honored in some manner by nearly all good - aligned gnomes , and one or two crusaders would be found in most sizable settlements . His symbol was an iron band , usually worn on the upper left arm , and his preferred weapon was the warhammer Hammersong . He resided in The Golden Hills , inside Dothion , which was found in Bytopia ( " also known as the Twin Paradises " ) . Worshipers . Gaerdal ' s church was organized as a strict military hierarchy . Although temples of Gaerdal Ironhand were rare cleric s built statues of Gaerdal at the entrance of gnomish settlements . Priests of Gaerdal prayed at dawn . Every tenth day was considered a holy day known as a Great Clang and believers would assemble to sing hymns and chants . Relationships . Gaerdal Ironhand had good relations with most of the other gnomish gods with the exception of Urdlen .

title: Gaerradh
description: Gaerradh Gaerradh was an elf ranger and scout in the High Forest and also a member of the Harpers . Description . Gaerradh had long russet hair tied back in a single braid .
description_long: Gaerradh Gaerradh was an elf ranger and scout in the High Forest and also a member of the Harpers . Description . Gaerradh had long russet hair tied back in a single braid . Possessions . The ranger carried a bow and two curved axe s . Activities . The elf was responsible for keeping watch over the northern marches of the wood . Relationships . Gaerradh ' s companion was Sheeril , a large and powerful wolf .

title: Gahlaerd Mossmere
description: Gahlaerd Mossmere Gahlaerd Mossmere was a sarcastic yet witty wizard from Tilverton who spent his time primarily developing , experimenting with , and selling spells of his own creation . He made a comfortable living as his spells were worth tens of thousands of gold . Rumours .
description_long: Gahlaerd Mossmere Gahlaerd Mossmere was a sarcastic yet witty wizard from Tilverton who spent his time primarily developing , experimenting with , and selling spells of his own creation . He made a comfortable living as his spells were worth tens of thousands of gold . Rumours . It has been said that Gahlaerd had a connection with a local group of outlaws known as the Rogues of Tilverton .

title: Gai
description: Gai Gai was a Shou Harper agent near Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gai was watching a puppet show in a tavern near Hillsfar , while his superior Olisara Lightsong hired an adventuring party to investigate some cases of kidnapped farmers in the area , possibly related to the Red Plumes .
description_long: Gai Gai was a Shou Harper agent near Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gai was watching a puppet show in a tavern near Hillsfar , while his superior Olisara Lightsong hired an adventuring party to investigate some cases of kidnapped farmers in the area , possibly related to the Red Plumes .

title: Gailan
description: Gailan Gailan was the commander of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Gailan always saw a military solution to all kind of problems .
description_long: Gailan Gailan was the commander of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Gailan always saw a military solution to all kind of problems . History . In 1357 DR Gailan and his tribe met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . In 1359 DR Gailan was a key member of the Alliance of Belt Watchers with local halfling s and centaur s .

title: Gaitiyah al - Aranib
description: Gaitiyah al - Aranib Gaitiyah al - Aranib was an employee of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tun Hayal , the owner of the Merchant ' s Home , trusted Gaitiyah with managing the affairs of the lavish .
description_long: Gaitiyah al - Aranib Gaitiyah al - Aranib was an employee of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tun Hayal , the owner of the Merchant ' s Home , trusted Gaitiyah with managing the affairs of the lavish . She was able to house several caravans under the same roof without them bickering , which was no small feat considering the boisterous nature of most caravan - masters .

title: Gaius Varro
description: Gaius Varro Gaius Varro was the Lord Marshal of Ravens Bluff from about 1355 DR - - ? Appearance . Gaius is 6 ' 4 " tall and 310 pounds and easily the most recognizable man in the city .
description_long: Gaius Varro Gaius Varro was the Lord Marshal of Ravens Bluff from about 1355 DR - - ? Appearance . Gaius is 6 ' 4 " tall and 310 pounds and easily the most recognizable man in the city . His uniform is ornately decorated with medals and gold braid , he has flowing white hair , and carries a gilded mace as the symbol of his office . Personality . Gaius ' loyalty and dedication to Ravens Bluff are unquestionable but he tends to be very conservative in all matters public and military . Some speculate that age and poor health have made him this way and as a result he has limited effectiveness . He usually speaks lucidly and concisely as he invariably proposes a defensive strategy . If challenged , he gets indignant and cites sources in too much detail , wearing his critics down with verbiage . He is not one to hold a grudge and will throw a banquet to make amends . To his troops he is a strict disciplinarian and intolerant of careless or slovenly soldiers . History . The Lord Marshal was exiled from the Dalelands by Lashan Aumersair of Scardale around 1355 DR and was hired by Lord Mayor Charles Oliver O ' Kane because of Varro ' s reputation .

title: Gak Fixen
description: Gak Fixen Gak Fixen was a surface gnome merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Gak was bloodthirsty and evil , as his appearance showed .
description_long: Gak Fixen Gak Fixen was a surface gnome merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Gak was bloodthirsty and evil , as his appearance showed . He was a follower of Urdlen . Activities . Around 1479 DR , Gak usually sold musical instruments , and he could use all of them .

title: Gaki
description: Gaki Gaki , also called nin - chu - ju - gaki were rumored to be the reincarnated spirits of wicked people . Description . Gaki were horrible humanoid monsters with several different forms .
description_long: Gaki Gaki , also called nin - chu - ju - gaki were rumored to be the reincarnated spirits of wicked people . Description . Gaki were horrible humanoid monsters with several different forms . These gaunt creatures used their sharp fangs and claws to feast on blood . They could only be harmed by spells or magical weapons . They were able to regenerate rapidly . Fire and cold - based attacks had no effect upon them . This was the most common gaki . They looked exactly like jiki - ketsu - gaki . Instead of drinking blood these gaki ate raw flesh . They could regenerate their tissue damage like all gaki . These vile gaki carried deadly diseases within their flesh , making them especially dangerous to fight . Wounds caused by a shikki - gaki often killed unless treated by magical means . They were immune to all disease and poisons . Their regenerating flesh could only be harmed by spells and magical weapons . This form of gaki appeared as a flaming humanoid . They enjoyed smothering their victims with burning fire . Magical weapons were needed to harm them . They regenerated damage but were susceptible to water - based attacks . Combat .

title: Gal - ralan
description: Gal - ralan A gal - ralan was a cold iron armband with long needles on the interior . It was worn by shadar - kai to negate the effects of their shadow curse . It did this by nailing together the shadar - kai ' s body and soul ; however , it also caused constant pain to its wearer .
description_long: Gal - ralan A gal - ralan was a cold iron armband with long needles on the interior . It was worn by shadar - kai to negate the effects of their shadow curse . It did this by nailing together the shadar - kai ' s body and soul ; however , it also caused constant pain to its wearer . Description . The armband was decorated with designs that were abstract and elaborate . The needles inside were 6 inches ( 15 . 24 cm ) long . Crafting . A " gal - ralan " was forged of cold iron by a spellcaster who knew the " resistance " spell and the art of crafting wondrous items . A more powerful spellcaster could craft a more effective " gal - ralan " . Powers . When worn as a bracer or armband , the long needles of the " gal - ralan " pierced the forearm . Naturally , this caused constant pain and injury to the wearer , which could never be healed whilst it remained in place . The benefit was that it fixed the soul to the body , granting greater resistance to all effects that would harm body or mind . It was more effective against death magic , the draining of life energy , and anything that attacked one ' s soul .

title: Galaeron Nihmedu
description: Galaeron Nihmedu Galaeron Nihmedu was an elf shadow adept and a minor noble of Evereska , Lasthaven to the elves of Faerûn . Description . Galaeron was tall and solidly built for a moon elf and had the pale skin and regal features common to his race ; two decades of serving as a Tomb Guard along the Desert Border South have left his face mildly rugged and weather - beaten .
description_long: Galaeron Nihmedu Galaeron Nihmedu was an elf shadow adept and a minor noble of Evereska , Lasthaven to the elves of Faerûn . Description . Galaeron was tall and solidly built for a moon elf and had the pale skin and regal features common to his race ; two decades of serving as a Tomb Guard along the Desert Border South have left his face mildly rugged and weather - beaten . Abilities . He was skilled in both hand - to - hand combat and sorcery , having attended both academies of the College of Magic and Arms . History . Early life . Galaeron was the son of the moon elf Aubric Nihmedu , the Blademajor of the Swords of Evereska and Lord of Treetop in Starmeadow Tower . His mother , a wood elf named Morgwais Nightmeadow ( known to the elves of the High Forest as Morgwais the Red , the Lady of the Wood , and the Red Lady ) , was the ruler of the Sy ' Tel ' Quess ( wood elves ) of the High Forest . Galaeron had a little sister named Keya , turquoise - haired and born in 1364 DR . A third sibling died in childbirth however , causing his mother to return to the High Fortest in grief .

title: Galaghard Obarskyr I
description: Galaghard Obarskyr I Galaghard Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . It is said that a particular moonstone chess set in the royal palace has a good likeness of him . He is Duar Obarskyr ' s only son and heir from his second wife .
description_long: Galaghard Obarskyr I Galaghard Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . It is said that a particular moonstone chess set in the royal palace has a good likeness of him . He is Duar Obarskyr ' s only son and heir from his second wife . Duar remarried after his first wife ' s family betrayed the country . Galaghard only officially ruled Cormyr from 480 DR to 514 DR but his only son died quite late into his reign . Amedahast extended Galaghard ' s life with longevity magics which allowed him to assume the identity of his dead heir . As Galaghard II he had three more male children but all of them rebelled against him and he had to have them all slain . Again , with Amedahast ' s help , he sustained his own life yet further and took the identity of his third son whom he lied was actually still loyal to him . As King Draxius Obarskyr he was king of Cormyr . He was known to be on the throne in 629 DR . He had a dislike of cats on account of their lack of devotion compared to dogs . Possessions . Draxius possessed the war shield Undying Gaze . Background . Draxius passed laws to prevent logging in the King ' s Forest . He also quelled a rebellion in Arabel .

title: Galaghard Obarskyr III
description: Galaghard Obarskyr III Galaghard Obarskyr III was the king of Cormyr from 897 DR to 953 DR and fought against the invading Witchlords of Wyvernwater . History . Born in 873 DR , Galaghard was the first son of Bryntarth I .
description_long: Galaghard Obarskyr III Galaghard Obarskyr III was the king of Cormyr from 897 DR to 953 DR and fought against the invading Witchlords of Wyvernwater . History . Born in 873 DR , Galaghard was the first son of Bryntarth I . He became king in 897 DR . In 900 DR , on the eve of Galaghard ' s Battle with the Witch Lords , the elven court of Othorion Keove ( the last survivor of the court of the Lord of the Scepters ) arrived and both sides in the conflict attended , separately . Othorion refused to help either side , stating that the purpose of his visit was hunting . Galaghard led his army into the battle and was facing defeat until Othorion ' s elves entered the battle . Othorion justified this move by saying that he felt like hunting orc s and goblin s . Relatives . Galaghard was married , and had three children : Rhiigard , Tanalar , and Kathla .
