He was named after his great grandfather , Galaghard I , and his great - great grandfather , Galaghard II , who , strangely enough was in fact the same person and also his grandfather Draxius . Equipment .

title: Galauntar Hawkhelm
description: Galauntar Hawkhelm Galauntar Hawkhelm was the commander of the forces at the Citadel of the Raven prior to and during the invasion of the Zhentarim . He died from wounds he recieved in a battle with a horde of orc s ; his final act was successfully leading the remainder of his forces to safety from these dual dangers . the group would later form the organization known as the Knights of the North .
description_long: Galauntar Hawkhelm Galauntar Hawkhelm was the commander of the forces at the Citadel of the Raven prior to and during the invasion of the Zhentarim . He died from wounds he recieved in a battle with a horde of orc s ; his final act was successfully leading the remainder of his forces to safety from these dual dangers . the group would later form the organization known as the Knights of the North . He originally hailed from Hillsfar before being nominated commander of the Citadel .

title: Galbi
description: Galbi Galbi was the owner of the House of Galbi in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Galbi ' s business practices and his willingness to cater to illicit ventures forced him to flee his native home in Semphar .
description_long: Galbi Galbi was the owner of the House of Galbi in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Galbi ' s business practices and his willingness to cater to illicit ventures forced him to flee his native home in Semphar . He settled in Manass where he returned to business as usual . Though he could not collect enough evidence to support his claims , the governor of Manass was confident that Galbi ' s establishment was conducting illegal activities .

title: Galdel
description: Galdel Galdel was a small city located in central Halruaa . Description . Galdel was a quiet town nestled on the southern banks of Lake Halruaa .
description_long: Galdel Galdel was a small city located in central Halruaa . Description . Galdel was a quiet town nestled on the southern banks of Lake Halruaa . Inhabitants . Several dozen expert electrum smiths lived in Galdel . They were capable of crafting wondrous items that were suitable for enchanting .

title: Galeb duhr
description: Galeb duhr Galeb duhr ( gay - leb DOR ) were magical creatures of stone that appeared almost like animated boulders , with the power to control the rocks around them . Description . When galeb duhr were not moving , they could choose to appear exactly like a boulder , but when they opened their eyes or moved , one could see that they had dark , foreboding eyes , a wide mouth , and two appendages that acted as both hands and feet .
description_long: Galeb duhr Galeb duhr ( gay - leb DOR ) were magical creatures of stone that appeared almost like animated boulders , with the power to control the rocks around them . Description . When galeb duhr were not moving , they could choose to appear exactly like a boulder , but when they opened their eyes or moved , one could see that they had dark , foreboding eyes , a wide mouth , and two appendages that acted as both hands and feet . The makeup of a galeb duhr ' s body always matched the type of stone around which it lived . For example , those from areas with large amounts of quartz deposits might have a more quartz - like composition . Granite - like galeb duhr were the most common variety . Galeb duhr never had bodies made from sandstone or other such sedimentary rock . Galeb duhr ranged in size from four feet ( one meter ) in height to as large as sixteen feet ( five meters ) . They were very slow - moving creatures with a steady gait . It was not possible for them to hold anything in their " hands " while walking , but if they were " sitting " they could manipulate objects with their hands with surprising dexterity . Personality .

title: Galeerie Mulurkrath
description: Galeerie Mulurkrath Galeerie Mulurkrath was a wizard who lived during the 3rd century DR . He held the title of Magister from 246 DR until 249 DR . Personality .
description_long: Galeerie Mulurkrath Galeerie Mulurkrath was a wizard who lived during the 3rd century DR . He held the title of Magister from 246 DR until 249 DR . Personality . Fits of laughter and howling were known to plague Galeerie . Appearance . Galeerie ' s skin had an unhealthy tone . Many considered him to be quite ugly . History . Galeerie stumbled across the title of Magister through pure blind luck when he happened upon Corthas Muhleer following his exhausting battle with Brymmyn Thorl . Galeerie easily slew Corthas with a sword he snatched from the stairs of Brymmyn ' s keep . Given his hideous appearance , Galeerie spent all of his arcane abilities mastering spells that granted him strength and masked his true appearance . His attraction to the opposite sex dominated his every motive . He spent most of his time pursuing any female within reach , utterly indifferent to the feelings of their significant others . One day Galeerie enraged a farmer whose wife was the center of his latest affections . The farmer struck him over the head with a shovel and killed him on the spot .

title: Galen
description: Galen Galen was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Galen was a traveling merchant who bought and sold things along the Sword Coast .
description_long: Galen Galen was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Galen was a traveling merchant who bought and sold things along the Sword Coast . He had regular clients , among them being Daeghun Farlong . During the Harvest Fair in West Harbor in 1374 DR , Galen delivered a bow to Daeghun , in exchange for the furs Daeghun hunted . He also part of the Fair ' s Knave ' s Challenge . Eventually , Galen made it to the Weeping Willow inn . However , he and his bodyguards had to fight bladeling s and duergar that attacked the villagers . Eventually , he was mugged by the same bodyguards , who demanded a bigger payment .

title: Galena Mountains
description: Galena Mountains The Galena Mountains or simply the Galenas ) was a range of mountains that formed a natural border around Vaasa and Damara in Northeast Faerûn . Geography . The range was about 250 mi ( 402 km ) long and not more than about 25 mi ( 40 km ) wide , forming a ring around Vaasa from the west to the east in an anti - clockwise direction .
description_long: Galena Mountains The Galena Mountains or simply the Galenas ) was a range of mountains that formed a natural border around Vaasa and Damara in Northeast Faerûn . Geography . The range was about 250 mi ( 402 km ) long and not more than about 25 mi ( 40 km ) wide , forming a ring around Vaasa from the west to the east in an anti - clockwise direction . The range was extremely jagged and permanently topped with ice and snow . Resources . The mountains were rich in bloodstone , iron and silver . Despite the danger from their hostile inhabitants , people came to the mountains in the hope of mining their way to riches , especially the dwarves , who had set up the Bloodstone Mines , Hillsfar Hall and Ironspur in the area in order to cultivate the ores . There was an ever - present danger of tunneling into the Underdark beneath the mountains and unleashing the evil creatures within . Geographic features . Bloodstone Pass . Due to the extremely impassable terrain that constituted the majority of the mountain range , Bloodstone Pass was the only realistic crossing point for humanoid s , and lead east into neighboring Damara . Galena Snake .

title: Galena Snake
description: Galena Snake The Galena Snake was a winding river that flowed down the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . Geograpy . Its origin was near to the eastern edge of the range , close to Justin ' s Mine , and it flowed south through Kinbrace before turning southeast and joining the Icelace River .
description_long: Galena Snake The Galena Snake was a winding river that flowed down the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . Geograpy . Its origin was near to the eastern edge of the range , close to Justin ' s Mine , and it flowed south through Kinbrace before turning southeast and joining the Icelace River . There was a meltwater surge every spring , but it was otherwise unnavigable . The small river proved invaluable to the farmlands in northern Damara , and it was used for transporting goods to Kinbrace . The Galena Snake served as the border between the Barony of Morov and a small portion of the Duchy of Soravia .

title: Galgadayle
description: Galgadayle Galgadayle oin Meadowhome was a firbolg seer of Hartsvale , who prophesied about the birth of Queen Brianna ' s child . Description . Galgadayle was lanky for a firbolg , looking more like a verbeeg .
description_long: Galgadayle Galgadayle oin Meadowhome was a firbolg seer of Hartsvale , who prophesied about the birth of Queen Brianna ' s child . Description . Galgadayle was lanky for a firbolg , looking more like a verbeeg . He had pale white eyes . His name meant " one who dreams for us . "

title: Galgast
description: Galgast Galgast was the ulitharid leader of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact in 1479 DR . History . Galgast originated from a drow host of House Oblodra in 1358 DR and the psionic powers of his host permitted the birth of an ulitharid .
description_long: Galgast Galgast was the ulitharid leader of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact in 1479 DR . History . Galgast originated from a drow host of House Oblodra in 1358 DR and the psionic powers of his host permitted the birth of an ulitharid . Later in the same year , Methil El - Viddenvelp disappeared in the wake of the drow defeat in the assault on Mithral Hall . It was only natural that Galgast assumed the leadership of the Sept , which he led from that point on . Personality . Galgast considered himself the natural leader of his fellows and used them as subordinates , and this was true : in illithid society , only the elder brain was more revered than an ulitharid . He inherited the will of Methil and was determined to finish his work of creating a new elder brain .

title: Galladel
description: Galladel Galladel was once the king of Shilmista , but was killed by the ogrillon king Ragnor . He once believed the magic of the forest , but lost his beliefs once he tried the ritual and failed his fellow elves . Over the many years of his age , he has became almost human like in thinking and planning during the war of Shilmista .
description_long: Galladel Galladel was once the king of Shilmista , but was killed by the ogrillon king Ragnor . He once believed the magic of the forest , but lost his beliefs once he tried the ritual and failed his fellow elves . Over the many years of his age , he has became almost human like in thinking and planning during the war of Shilmista .

title: Gallard
description: Gallard Gallard was the westernmost of the Border Kingdoms settlements that guarded the Shaar trails . Description . Gallard was a crowded place of winding cobbled streets and gravel alleys .
description_long: Gallard Gallard was the westernmost of the Border Kingdoms settlements that guarded the Shaar trails . Description . Gallard was a crowded place of winding cobbled streets and gravel alleys . Its timbered houses were narrow , steep - roofed , and crowded . It was home to many skilled craftworkers including locksmiths , bootmakers , leatherworkers , and smallsmiths . One of the busiest and most prosperous places in all the " Borders " , but also one of the most grasping and grubby , Gallard was full of close - guarded wealth . The settlement earned the general dislike of other Borderers for being too unfriendly and self - important in their dealings . No grand palaces , manors , or civic buildings were found in Gallard . Business was conducted in shops or at Galardian " firesword houses " , establishments named for the skewers of meat constantly cooking in the hearths situated in the centers of their dining chambers . Government . The closest thing Gallard had to a ruling body was the Galardian Council of Bodyguards and Trustyblades . The council was led by Ulgarth Hithtor , a grizzled old warrior who ran the Risen Dragon Finest Fireswords .

title: Galleon
description: Galleon A galleon was an advanced sailing vessel , the largest used by Cormyr , Impiltur , and Sembia as of the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR . Even in these relatively wealthy countries , the galleon was not a common sight on the Inner Sea . Description .
description_long: Galleon A galleon was an advanced sailing vessel , the largest used by Cormyr , Impiltur , and Sembia as of the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR . Even in these relatively wealthy countries , the galleon was not a common sight on the Inner Sea . Description . Typically 130 ft ( 40 m ) along the keel and 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) across the beam , galleons had three full masts and three decks that could hold a maximum of 800 crew and passengers . With multiple sails and complex rigging , it took a minimum crew of 80 to operate proficiently . The galleon had castles at fore and stern that were usually armed with a total of three large weapons ( ballistae or catapults , for example ) . Galleons were quite seaworthy , but were relatively slow and difficult to maneuver . Because of significant weight in the structures mounted high above the waterline , prudence was required to avoid capsizing .

title: Galley
description: Galley A galley was a large ship used by Sword Coast and Moonsea pirates and other sailors . Although galleys had at least one mast , most relied on oarsmen to propel the ship . Because galleys required a large crew , they usually put into shore to camp at night and rarely ventured far into the ocean .
description_long: Galley A galley was a large ship used by Sword Coast and Moonsea pirates and other sailors . Although galleys had at least one mast , most relied on oarsmen to propel the ship . Because galleys required a large crew , they usually put into shore to camp at night and rarely ventured far into the ocean .

title: Gallowshawk
description: Gallowshawk Gallowshawk , known by all as Slop , was an innkeeper in Skullport . History . Gallowshawk was , in 1355 DR , a lowly scullery cook on board a ship that had arrived in Skullport when the boat was shipwrecked and he was miraculously the only survivor .
description_long: Gallowshawk Gallowshawk , known by all as Slop , was an innkeeper in Skullport . History . Gallowshawk was , in 1355 DR , a lowly scullery cook on board a ship that had arrived in Skullport when the boat was shipwrecked and he was miraculously the only survivor . Not only that , but Gallowshawk also managed also to recover some of the captain ' s treasure . With the money , Slop opened a restaurant / inn , but by 1360 DR he had lost most of his money in bad investments . Around 1370 DR , his was one of the worst restaurant / inns in the city .

title: Gallus
description: Gallus Gallus was a pech in Blingdenstone . History . In 1479 DR , Gallus was the leader of a group of pech miners established in a section of Blingdenstone .
description_long: Gallus Gallus was a pech in Blingdenstone . History . In 1479 DR , Gallus was the leader of a group of pech miners established in a section of Blingdenstone . He was approached by an adventuring party hired by Kargien Dissengulp , who asked for the help of his people in defeating Ogremoch ' s Bane . Personality . Gallus , like all his people , believed that the deep gnome s ' style of mining did damage to the earth , which the pechs needed to repair . However , he was willing to make an agreement with Kargien .

title: Galuil Mountains
description: Galuil Mountains The Galuil Mountains were a small isolated mountain range in the north of the realm of Ulgarth , standing beside the Golden Water , in southeast Faerûn . They were commonly called the Mountains of Gold for their appearance , but might be better termed the Iron Mountains for their primary resource . Description .
description_long: Galuil Mountains The Galuil Mountains were a small isolated mountain range in the north of the realm of Ulgarth , standing beside the Golden Water , in southeast Faerûn . They were commonly called the Mountains of Gold for their appearance , but might be better termed the Iron Mountains for their primary resource . Description . At sunset , sunlight reflected from the Golden Water fell on the peaks of the Galuil Mountains , illuminating them with a yellow sheen , almost as if made of gold — hence their nickname , " the Mountains of Gold " . Furthermore , from the coastal city of Surbar in the southwest , the Galuil Mountains were particularly picturesque at sunrise in spring . Thus travelers knew the Galuil Mountains to be the most beautiful in all the Shining South . Industry . The business of the Galuil Mountains was mining . True to their name , the eastern slopes held gold mines , but a great deal of iron was excavated in the range , such that " Iron Mountains " might be a more appropriate name . These mines were not especially rich , but they were profitable . The gold and iron ran through Ulgarth ' s capital city , Orvyltar .

title: Galuum
description: Galuum Galuum was a mind flayer in the Northdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Galuum lived in Ryxyg .
description_long: Galuum Galuum was a mind flayer in the Northdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Galuum lived in Ryxyg . It was sent by the elder brain to collect slaves near the Waydown . Towards the end of the 1480s DR , it captured and enslaved some duergar coming from Zortagra . However , they proved to be uncontrollable thanks to the influence of a demon ic madness .

title: Galvan
description: Galvan Galvan was the Blue Dragon Wyrmspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin . Personality . Galvan thought very much like a scheming blue dragon .
description_long: Galvan Galvan was the Blue Dragon Wyrmspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin . Personality . Galvan thought very much like a scheming blue dragon . He was also Talis Kasterel ' s mentor and saw Severin as a man of great vision and destiny , and thus would never act against him . History . Galvan was born in Thay and had aspirations to be a Red Wizard but his magic skill was not great enough . He joined the Cult of the Dragon and served for a long time . When Severin entered the Cult , Galvan saw him as a charismatic leader and soon allied with him . He always maintained contacts among the Red Wizards and under Severin ' s leadership Galvan acted as a link between the two groups . There was a secret family connection between him and Rath Modar , the lead Red Wizard allied with the Cult . Galvan also plotted against Valindra Shadowmantle hoping to acquire or destroy her dragon ' s orb . Behind the Scenes . Although Galvan ' s page was present in the Wizard site , he was barely mentioned in " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " and " The Rise of Tiamat " .

title: Galvendo
description: Galvendo Galvendo is a hunter within the city of Mirabar who operates a hunting lodge named after himself . Along with utilizing very aggressive advertising for his lodge , Galvendo claims that no one has ever died on one of his expeditions . The truth however , is that three clients have met a grizzly demise while hunting with Galvendo ( typically by a bear or winter wolf ) .
description_long: Galvendo Galvendo is a hunter within the city of Mirabar who operates a hunting lodge named after himself . Along with utilizing very aggressive advertising for his lodge , Galvendo claims that no one has ever died on one of his expeditions . The truth however , is that three clients have met a grizzly demise while hunting with Galvendo ( typically by a bear or winter wolf ) . These deceased few were then resurrected by Galvendo ' s companion Deathcalm the Loved by means of a " raise dead " spell .

title: Galvin
description: Galvin Galvin was a druid and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Galvin loved open spaces and was uncomfortable in urban environments .
description_long: Galvin Galvin was a druid and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Galvin loved open spaces and was uncomfortable in urban environments . He focused only on the mission and the state of nature around him . History . Galvin was born in Skuld and soon lost his parents , who were two thieves condemned for their crimes . He escaped into the savage wilderness , where he learned to live . Later he joined the Harpers . In 1362 , he and his friend the centaur Wynter were instructed by Brenna Graycloak to infiltrate Thay to uncover some plots . They discovered the evil plans of the Zulkir Maligor and , thanks to the help of the lich Zulkir Szass Tam , defeated him . During that mission , Brenna came to love Galvin but knowing his dislike for her beloved cities , she said goodbye to him after the defeat of Maligor .

title: Gamalon Idogyr
description: Gamalon Idogyr Lord Gamalon Idogyr was the Count of Spellshire and the Court Sage of Tethyr . Formerly , he had been the most powerful wizard living on the Rock of Bral , as well as a famous traveler , explorer , and merchant of magical goods . Description .
description_long: Gamalon Idogyr Lord Gamalon Idogyr was the Count of Spellshire and the Court Sage of Tethyr . Formerly , he had been the most powerful wizard living on the Rock of Bral , as well as a famous traveler , explorer , and merchant of magical goods . Description . Gamalon had old scars across his face and a green gem where his left eye had once been . He had dark skin and , by 1374 DR , a salt - and - pepper beard . with a bald head . He was one of the oldest nobles in Queen Zaranda Star ' s court . Gamalon so commonly had " ioun stones " orbiting his head that he had earned the nickname " Gemhead " . Because he was a landowner , Gamalon was considered a noble of Bral before returning to Tethyr to become a noble there as well . Gamalon was a known expert on magic items , including historical magical artifacts . He also was knowledgeable regarding spelljamming magic . Indeed , even the spacefaring race known as the Arcane dealt with him directly and had taught him some of their spelljamming magic . Personality . Gamalon ' s friendliness disguised the fact that he was an exceptionally powerful wizard . He was tactful and thoughtful to the point of annoyance .

title: Gamo Hidenobu
description: Gamo Hidenobu Gamo Hidenobu was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hidenobu was often involved in questionable duels and vendettas History .
description_long: Gamo Hidenobu Gamo Hidenobu was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hidenobu was often involved in questionable duels and vendettas History . Hidenobu and his brothers may be involved in a plot of Funada Toyoo that can end with their death at hands of Mashida Kowa and Oka Sanai Personality . Hidenobu as eldest brother was the most seasoned and toughened of the lot . He was embarrassed for two missing front teeth and seldom smiled .

title: Gamo Mitsutoshi
description: Gamo Mitsutoshi Gamo Mitsutoshi was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mitsutoshi regularly spitting in public .
description_long: Gamo Mitsutoshi Gamo Mitsutoshi was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mitsutoshi regularly spitting in public . He had traveled a lot and known things from far places . History . Mitsutoshi and his brothers may be involved in a plot of Funada Toyoo that can end with their death at hands of Mashida Kowa and Oka Sanai Personality . Mitsutoshi was a weapon fetichist . He was rude and arrogant , little loved by people he met .

title: Gamo Mochikuni
description: Gamo Mochikuni Gamo Mochikuni was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mochikuni wandered looking like a gaudy tough , wearing loud clothing and swaggering History .
description_long: Gamo Mochikuni Gamo Mochikuni was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mochikuni wandered looking like a gaudy tough , wearing loud clothing and swaggering History . Mochikuni and his brothers may be involved in a plot of Funada Toyoo that can end with their death at hands of Mashida Kowa and Oka Sanai Personality . Being the youngest Mochikuni ' s behavior was heavily influenced by his evil brothers . Lacking even their limited experience , he compensated by bravado and bluster .

title: Gamogan
description: Gamogan Gamogan was a kindly and wise star elf advisor to the nobility of Yuireshanyaar . He was popular among the people as a voice of moderation . In the early days of the construction of Sildëyuir , Gamogan was an outspoken opponent of the plan , claiming that it would strain those relations that had already been made with the human s and the existing allies of Yuireshanyaar .
description_long: Gamogan Gamogan was a kindly and wise star elf advisor to the nobility of Yuireshanyaar . He was popular among the people as a voice of moderation . In the early days of the construction of Sildëyuir , Gamogan was an outspoken opponent of the plan , claiming that it would strain those relations that had already been made with the human s and the existing allies of Yuireshanyaar . He decided to contact the neighboring nations and tell them of the construction of Sildëyuir . Unfortunately , this information was used by a human tribe , who had falsely claimed to want an allegiance with the star elves , to attack an enclave , slaughtering all of its inhabitants and stealing tens of thousands of gold piece s worth of materials that were needed to create the portal s to Sildëyuir . Gamogan , despite his good intentions , was banished from star elf lands and remembered by all as a vile traitor . His example was used by later star elves to always look to security before trusting in the good - will of strangers , which for the most part led to the star elves ' insular standpoint .

title: Gana
description: Gana Gana , the " City of Riches , " ( together with Jumlat ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name because pearl diving was one major source of wealth . Trade . Another source of wealth was from the nearby wasteland to the west called the Realm of Bleeding Trees where and aromatic gum s could be collected .
description_long: Gana Gana , the " City of Riches , " ( together with Jumlat ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name because pearl diving was one major source of wealth . Trade . Another source of wealth was from the nearby wasteland to the west called the Realm of Bleeding Trees where and aromatic gum s could be collected . Trade with these and other commodities gave Gana the well - earned title " City of Riches " as even its lower classes were better off than elsewhere .

title: Gana Bay
description: Gana Bay Gana Bay was nestled in the southeast corner of west Zakhara in the Pearl Cities in 1367 DR . Description . Gana Bay measured approximately 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide by 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length , forming a roughly rectangular shape .
description_long: Gana Bay Gana Bay was nestled in the southeast corner of west Zakhara in the Pearl Cities in 1367 DR . Description . Gana Bay measured approximately 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide by 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length , forming a roughly rectangular shape . Geography . The bay offered natural protection to the important trade city of Gana from the storms of the northern reaches of the Crowded Sea . It was filled with run - off from Al - Sabiya River .

title: Gandalug Battlehammer
description: Gandalug Battlehammer Gandalug Battlehammer was the first and ninth king of Mithral Hall . He was imprisoned by Yvonnel Baenre before he was freed after Yvonnel ' s death in the Battle of Mithral Hall . History .
description_long: Gandalug Battlehammer Gandalug Battlehammer was the first and ninth king of Mithral Hall . He was imprisoned by Yvonnel Baenre before he was freed after Yvonnel ' s death in the Battle of Mithral Hall . History . Gandalug was the first patron of Mithral Hall . As he grew old , he found his closest friend in the battlerager Crommower Pwent , an ancestor of Thibbledorf Pwent , who later became a close friend of King Bruenor Battlehammer . Gandalug eventually gave the kingdom to his son and , with the aid of his companion Crommower , descended into the Underdark for a final journey and adventure . They encountered drow elves , led by Yvonnel Baenre , and there they engaged the drow . Crommower was killed by a drow " death lance " while he was slaying a drow wizard , and Gandalug ' s soul was stolen by Baenre . Baenre tormented him for thousands of years , until the Time of Troubles , during which his soul was freed . He attempted to kill Baenre with her son Berg ' inyon Baenre ' s own sword , but was foiled by an illithid ally .

title: Ganilon
description: Ganilon Ganilon was one of the many Doomguide s who were part of the contingent in the Neverdeath Graveyard in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He and some of his fellows became lost in the graveyard after an assault by undead .
description_long: Ganilon Ganilon was one of the many Doomguide s who were part of the contingent in the Neverdeath Graveyard in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He and some of his fellows became lost in the graveyard after an assault by undead . Ganilon was the last to be rescued by an adventurer recruited to find them .

title: Gannayev - of - Dreams
description: Gannayev - of - Dreams Gannayev , or Gann - of - Dreams , is a hagspawn spirit shaman from Mulsantir who aids the Kalach - Cha during the events of . Personality . As a constant wanderer who had never felt attachment to anyone , Gann can be charming and acerbic all at once .
description_long: Gannayev - of - Dreams Gannayev , or Gann - of - Dreams , is a hagspawn spirit shaman from Mulsantir who aids the Kalach - Cha during the events of . Personality . As a constant wanderer who had never felt attachment to anyone , Gann can be charming and acerbic all at once . He dodges questions with clever remarks , but is nonetheless a trustworthy companion who accompanies the Kalach - Cha in the quest . He enjoys casual banter , and can appear to be quite vain , despite his abilities to " see spirits " . He is very aware of his appeal to the females and uses this to his advantage , but seems to have become a sort of a pariah amongst the Mulsantir farmers with daughters and wives . As a faithless , Gann holds the deities in contempt , seeing them as master manipulators , and has more faith in spirits instead . Despite this , he seems to be greatly troubled when he encounters the Wall of the Faithless . History . Gann ' s history becomes clear during the events of the campaign ; his mother , Gulk ' aush , was a Night hag from Coveya Kurgannis who had betrayed the sisterhood by falling in love with a human male .

title: Ganrahast Aeiulvana
description: Ganrahast Aeiulvana Ganrahast Aeiulvana was the Royal Mage of Cormyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Although his magical abilities did not appear to come close to those of his predecessors , he was a competent and level headed spellcaster .
description_long: Ganrahast Aeiulvana Ganrahast Aeiulvana was the Royal Mage of Cormyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Although his magical abilities did not appear to come close to those of his predecessors , he was a competent and level headed spellcaster . History . In 1479 DR , Ganrahast was imprisoned by one of Manshoon ' s servants in magical stasis in a crypt beneath the Royal Palace in Suzail . Elminster and Vangerdahast ' s shade rescued Ganrahast but he missed King Foril ' s Dragon Council . Relationships . Ganrahast was the son of Myrmeen Lhal and Vangerdahast . . As such , he had two sisters , ( Krystin and his mother ' s lost daughter in Calimshan ) and his niece was Nalara Marliir .

title: Gantar Kraok
description: Gantar Kraok Gantar Kraok was an aquatic elf tyrant in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Gantar was one of the most ruthless , manipulative person on Toril .
description_long: Gantar Kraok Gantar Kraok was an aquatic elf tyrant in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Gantar was one of the most ruthless , manipulative person on Toril . He thank to equal part of determination , arrogance , and foresight , created very complex plans where he double - crossed foes and allies . He always escaped if understood that he had lose . He truly believed that elves must ruled the world , and he was the perfect coronal . History . Gantar Kraok formed the Saratycoron , a group with the objective to made the elves rulers of the world . For this ideas he was exiled from Selu ' Maraar during the Eleventh Serôs War . During that conflict he found and used as weapon the " Alatorin Scepter " . At one point Gantar discovered the Librarian , a living kiira situated in the Hall of Living Memory in a ruined elven city and thank to the Librarian around 1370 Gantar recovered also the lost Wyrmskull Throne and and planned to recover all the remaining lost Scepters of Shanatar .

title: Gantharla Obarskyr
description: Gantharla Obarskyr Gantharla Obarskyr was the older sister of Iltharl Obarskyr and , from 245 DR , the first queen of Cormyr . Appearance . Gantharla had brilliant red hair , worn short .
description_long: Gantharla Obarskyr Gantharla Obarskyr was the older sister of Iltharl Obarskyr and , from 245 DR , the first queen of Cormyr . Appearance . Gantharla had brilliant red hair , worn short . She wore mottled green forester ' s leathers including a hood , and an elven chain shirt tinted green . Relatives . Gantharla ' s father was Boldovar Obarskyr . Her brother was Iltharl Obarskyr . She had an illegitimate son before her coronation , Roderin Obarskyr . Possessions . Gantharla had a sword called Shiningbite . The sword was also known as Drake ' s Tooth , and there was also a Cormyrian ship by that name . Background . Gantharla had patrolled the Western Marches of Cormyr with her foresters . She was recalled to Suzail in 245 DR , much to her initial disgust , by her brother , King Iltharl . She stationed her foresters on Soldier ' s Green near Suzail and marched into Faerlthann ' s Keep , thinking Iltharl was interfering with her plans , but he abdicated the throne to her , making her the first queen of Cormyr .

title: Gaping Maw
description: Gaping Maw The Gaping Maw is the 88th level of the Abyss and the home of Demogorgon , Prince of Demons . It is a vast and savage wilderness filled with those that serve the Prince of Demons , various fiends , and dinosaurs . Reflecting the dual personality of its master , the Gaping Maw is a vast continent covered in a jungle and surrounded an endless ocean and brine flats .
description_long: Gaping Maw The Gaping Maw is the 88th level of the Abyss and the home of Demogorgon , Prince of Demons . It is a vast and savage wilderness filled with those that serve the Prince of Demons , various fiends , and dinosaurs . Reflecting the dual personality of its master , the Gaping Maw is a vast continent covered in a jungle and surrounded an endless ocean and brine flats . Rising from the sea are two towers , topped with enormous fanged skulls that make the fortress Abyss , where Demogorgon rules over his lair . Few can enter without succumbing to madness .

title: Gapolploorg
description: Gapolploorg Gapolploorg was a powerful kuo - toa whip of Sloopdilmonpolop and priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . Personality . Gapolploorg was one of the few relatively sane members of the ruling kuo - toa elite .
description_long: Gapolploorg Gapolploorg was a powerful kuo - toa whip of Sloopdilmonpolop and priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . Personality . Gapolploorg was one of the few relatively sane members of the ruling kuo - toa elite . His focus was on the defense of the city , despite the lack of threats . In fact , after his eventual promotion , he planned to attack the deep gnome s of the Starspire Mountains . History . Gapolploorg was the commander of the Whips , the order of thieves / priests of Sloopdilmonpolop . His main role was to organize the defense of the city . He answered to the aged Oorg - Poolgoop ( the priest - duke of war ) Gibupgagool , but over time the old kuo - toa had ceded most of his authority to his enthusiastic assistant Gapolploorg . All agreed that , at the death of the priest - duke of war , Gapolploorg would likely become his successor .

title: Gar Shatterkeel
description: Gar Shatterkeel Gar Shatterkeel was the Prophet of Water and the leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave . Description . His skin was covered in barnacles , and his left arm was replaced by a large mechanical crab claw .
description_long: Gar Shatterkeel Gar Shatterkeel was the Prophet of Water and the leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave . Description . His skin was covered in barnacles , and his left arm was replaced by a large mechanical crab claw . He wielded a magical trident known as " Drown " . History . Gar was born in a poor fishing village in the Nelanther Isles . When he was young , sahuagin attacked and slaughtered everyone in the village ; soon after , he was conscripted by a Tethyr ian merchant galley and grew up in brutal indentured servitude that was little more than slavery . When the ship was destroyed by pirates , he clung to the wreckage for days until a shark ripped off his left arm . He finally gave up all hope and accepted his imminent death , but a strong current carried him away from the predator to the shores of the Sword Coast . Believing that the sea itself had saved his life , he spent the next several years devoting himself to studying the ocean , learning powerful water magic . His harsh experiences with both the mercenaries and pirates led him to distrust other people , but he came to believe that it was his calling to find others like him and teach them the power of the sea .

title: Garadoc ' s Camp
description: Garadoc ' s Camp Garadoc ' s Camp was a small settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Raven Tribe in the Frost Hills . Activities . A band of Black Raven Uthgardt had established a camp on the top of Dhaemang ' s head , the most southern peak of the Frost Hills .
description_long: Garadoc ' s Camp Garadoc ' s Camp was a small settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Raven Tribe in the Frost Hills . Activities . A band of Black Raven Uthgardt had established a camp on the top of Dhaemang ' s head , the most southern peak of the Frost Hills . From this breathtaking view , the Black Ravens spied on surrounding movements and they were able to make sudden attacks against the people of the south . The Black Ravens hunted in the woods and meadows of the Frost Hills . The camp was the base of operations of a band of raiders . They were mostly warriors with no children ; indeed , the barbarians ' families were hidden in nearby safer villages . Leadership . This camp was ruled by Garamel Talonhand , a female veteran explorer and a bandit who criticized outsiders as weak and decadent .

title: Garagos
description: Garagos Garagos ( pronounced " GAH - rah - gohs " ) , the Lord of War , was a god of war and exarch of Tempus , though he focused more on destruction than war itself . Followers . Clerics of Garagos , known as " Bloodreavers " , spent their days fomenting strife throughout the continent , knowing that each conflict contributed to Garagos ' s continuing rebirth .
description_long: Garagos Garagos ( pronounced " GAH - rah - gohs " ) , the Lord of War , was a god of war and exarch of Tempus , though he focused more on destruction than war itself . Followers . Clerics of Garagos , known as " Bloodreavers " , spent their days fomenting strife throughout the continent , knowing that each conflict contributed to Garagos ' s continuing rebirth . They believed that Garagos eventually would regain his divine strength , unseating the hated Lord of Battles and reclaiming the mantle of Deity of War . They continually created and expanded networks of spies , faithful warriors , and other agents to increase the power of the cult , and the leadership of a cult cell was usually determined by the result of power plays between the agents of rival clerics . Relationships . Though chaotic neutral , the debased , insane Garagos stood on the brink of evil . A nearly elemental force of destruction , the Reaver had no allies in the pantheons of Abeir - Toril — the other gods dealt with Garagos simply by staying away from him . Despite his vacant mind , Garagos still harbored deep resentment against Tempus and his catspaw , the Red Knight .

title: Garbul
description: Garbul Garbul was a hobgoblin warlord in 1489 DR . Garbul was the leader of the Zartruss hobgoblin tribe living in Kryptgarden Forest and the primary agent of the great dragon Claugiyliamatar . History .
description_long: Garbul Garbul was a hobgoblin warlord in 1489 DR . Garbul was the leader of the Zartruss hobgoblin tribe living in Kryptgarden Forest and the primary agent of the great dragon Claugiyliamatar . History . It was his duty to mediate between the old and the new factions of the Cult of the Dragon , both seeking an alliance with his master . At last , he decided to ally with the leader of the new faction , Alandra . However , an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones , who had previously destroyed most of hobgoblin strongholds in the forest , attacked the Zartruss ' s main camp and Garbul was killed in the fighting . Possessions . Garbul possessed the Green Dragon ' s Mask , once part of his master ' s hoard but sold it to Alandra , who sent it to Neronvain .

title: Garda Greenleaf
description: Garda Greenleaf Garda Greenleaf was a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Description . The librarian was a middle - aged man .
description_long: Garda Greenleaf Garda Greenleaf was a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Description . The librarian was a middle - aged man . Personality . The scribe was a senior librarian of Mantor ' s Library with a flawless record of attendance . Possessions . Garda was known to dress in plain grey robes while working in the library . History . In 1489 DR , Garda was killed in the Archives room of Mantor ' s Library by fellow scribe Ellison Berenger , a secret Cult of the Dragon member , in order of acquire a book about Ren o ' the Blade .

title: Garden of Delights
description: Garden of Delights The Garden of Delights was a special domed building located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Garden of Delights was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .
description_long: Garden of Delights The Garden of Delights was a special domed building located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Garden of Delights was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin . Description . This large dome was constructed of black stone . The stone was an illusion conjured by Ibrihim , a deceiver genie . The illusion concealed a beautiful garden enclosed in glassteel . The entrance to the garden was located underground , accessible only through a secret passage found in the Hall of Audience . Though the garden was enhanced by further illusions cast by Ibrihim , it was a paradise to those admitted . Succulent fruit adorned the trees , wondrous animals roamed the garden , and the stream was filled with nectar . A rose - colored pavilion with pillars embedded with lapis lazuli served as a place for sleeping initiates . History . Initiates of the Everlasting were taken to the garden to get a taste of what awaited them after a life of devout service . Beautiful men and women called " huriye " waited on them , fulfilling any desire . Inhabitants .

title: Garden of Rhinda
description: Garden of Rhinda The Garden of Rhinda was a luscious flower garden in Darromar at the base of and surrounding the Ithal Crag , the large hill upon which the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . The garden added color to the otherwise dull granite of the palace walls . To reach the palace , one had to pass along the winding road up the hill and through the garden .
description_long: Garden of Rhinda The Garden of Rhinda was a luscious flower garden in Darromar at the base of and surrounding the Ithal Crag , the large hill upon which the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . The garden added color to the otherwise dull granite of the palace walls . To reach the palace , one had to pass along the winding road up the hill and through the garden .

title: Gareth Cormaeril
description: Gareth Cormaeril Sir Gareth Cormaeril is a fallen paladin of Tyr and retired member of the Knights of Samular who currently resides at the Halls of Justice in Waterdeep serving as Exchequer of the organization . He is distantly related to the Cormaeril noble family of Cormyr . Appearance .
description_long: Gareth Cormaeril Sir Gareth Cormaeril is a fallen paladin of Tyr and retired member of the Knights of Samular who currently resides at the Halls of Justice in Waterdeep serving as Exchequer of the organization . He is distantly related to the Cormaeril noble family of Cormyr . Appearance . Gareth has bright blue eyes and wavy white hair , as well as a disfigured right arm , a wound which he received while saving the life of Hronrulf Caradoon . Background . After saving the life of Hronrulf , Gareth lost the use of his right hand and was forced to retire from the Knights of Samular . It was at this time that he also fell from the grace of Tyr , began to worship the deity Cyric and sabotaged all that he previously strived to uphold . It was his actions that allowed Dag Zoreth of Darkhold to nearly unite the Rings of Samular as well as posess the Kezefbane for the Zhentarim . Despite this , Gareth has never admitted to himself that he no longer worshipes the Maimed God , deluding himself that he is one of the deity ' s faithful . He maintains this rationale with self - delusion and in some cases complete denial .

title: Gareth Dragonsbane
description: Gareth Dragonsbane Gareth Dragonsbane is the paladin king of Damara and a mythic sovereign . History . He was once an adventurer working as a knight of the Order of the Golden Cup and tithed 50 % of his gains to the organization .
description_long: Gareth Dragonsbane Gareth Dragonsbane is the paladin king of Damara and a mythic sovereign . History . He was once an adventurer working as a knight of the Order of the Golden Cup and tithed 50 % of his gains to the organization . Despite this , he became a very wealthy man and established a comfortable homestead on a large estate in the northern part of Damara . The war with the Witch King Zhengyi and the army of Vaasa tore apart Gareth ' s comfortable life . He commanded a brigade of Damarans in the war and achieved every single objective he was tasked with . In retaliation , the Witch King burned down his estate . With his home gone and his men either dead or dispersed , Gareth traveled to the southern baronies of Damara , left as vassal states by the victorious Zhengyi . He was recruited along with six other adventurers , Olwen Forest - Friend , Friar Dugald , Riordan Parnell , Celedon Kierney , Emelyn the Gray and Kane to protect the village of Bloodstone from an army of bandits . After a difficult battle , the heroes prevailed and were next sent to investigate the recently abandoned Bloodstone mines after a series of vicious Worg attacks .

title: Gareth Jadaren
description: Gareth Jadaren Gareth Jadaren was a pirate serving aboard the Orcsblood . In 1460 DR , the Orcsblood attacked a merchant ship and Gareth took a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko from a Githyanki passenger . Unkown to Gareth , the bracelet was linked to an entity named Fandour who was imprisoned in a pocket plane .
description_long: Gareth Jadaren Gareth Jadaren was a pirate serving aboard the Orcsblood . In 1460 DR , the Orcsblood attacked a merchant ship and Gareth took a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko from a Githyanki passenger . Unkown to Gareth , the bracelet was linked to an entity named Fandour who was imprisoned in a pocket plane . Gareth and his shipmate Ivor Beguine became disgusted with the brutality of the Orcsblood ' s captain and the first mate Helgre and they both jumped ship near Mulmaster . After rowing a small boat to shore , they met two deva s , Lakini and Lusk and gave them the location of the Orcsblood . The devas borrowed Gareth ' s boat and rowed out to the Orcsblood and slaughtered the crew although Helgre escaped . While in Mulmaster , Gareth and Ivor met a young apprentice mage named Jandi M ' baren . Ivor and Jandi fell in love and the three left Mulmaster to return to Turmish , Gareth ' s birthland . On the road to Turmish , they chanced upon Giant ' s Fist , a small extinct volcano near Erlkazar that had been home to a clan of dwarves who had long since abandoned the stronghold .

title: Gargauth
description: Gargauth Gargauth ( pronounced " GAR - goth " ) , or The Lord Who Watches , was the lawful evil demigod of betrayal , cruelty , political corruption and powerbrokers . He embodied the inevitable decay and corruption that accompanied all self - serving , greedy , and power - hungry leaders and groups . Gargauth held to the letter of any agreement , not the spirit , and relished betraying anyone with whom he forged a pact by twisting the contract to serve his own ends .
description_long: Gargauth Gargauth ( pronounced " GAR - goth " ) , or The Lord Who Watches , was the lawful evil demigod of betrayal , cruelty , political corruption and powerbrokers . He embodied the inevitable decay and corruption that accompanied all self - serving , greedy , and power - hungry leaders and groups . Gargauth held to the letter of any agreement , not the spirit , and relished betraying anyone with whom he forged a pact by twisting the contract to serve his own ends . Worshipers . The church of Gargauth was a secretive faith , although there were some significant exceptions . Description . Gargauth appeared as a fanged and clawed humanoid with horns and jagged shards of bone jutting out of his face and back .

title: Gargosh Blusterhelm
description: Gargosh Blusterhelm Gargosh Blusterhelm was a dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Gargosh devoted his life to finding the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " , property of King Torhild Flametongue of Besilmer , and presenting it to the elders of Clan Blusterhelm in the hopes of restoring his family ' s lackluster reputation .
description_long: Gargosh Blusterhelm Gargosh Blusterhelm was a dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Gargosh devoted his life to finding the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " , property of King Torhild Flametongue of Besilmer , and presenting it to the elders of Clan Blusterhelm in the hopes of restoring his family ' s lackluster reputation . The clan elders considered this a fool ' s plan , and the Harpers tried to sabotage him , sensing it was better not to recover the weapon , and secretly his cousin Drannin Splitshield plotted to steal the axe from him at the right time . In 1491 DR , despite everything , Gargosh , with the support of the Lords ' Alliance , hired some adventurers to search for the axe in the Halls of the Hunting Axe in the Dessarin Valley . However , soon after , he was kidnapped by Drannin , who replaced him with a doppelganger loyal to him . Afterward the axe was recovered by his adventurers and Drannin was defeated , Gargosh was freed from his prison near Yartar .

title: Gargoyle
description: Gargoyle Gargoyles were vicious predators imbued with magic . Behavior . Their original nature aided them in that they are adept at appearing perfectly still , as if they are still made of stone , and their hides were rough and thick , similar to stone as well .
description_long: Gargoyle Gargoyles were vicious predators imbued with magic . Behavior . Their original nature aided them in that they are adept at appearing perfectly still , as if they are still made of stone , and their hides were rough and thick , similar to stone as well . They favored surprising their opponents , either by moving suddenly from their motionless state or by suddenly swooping down on their prey from a height . Gargoyles also loved to inflict pain . They would torture any victims they could hold helpless , going as far as eating them alive just to hear their screams even though they required no food to survive , but much prefer intelligent races over anything else . Inflicting pain gave the gargoyles pleasure . Sometimes , they worked for an evil master in exchange for some small amount of treasure , though their primary payment was the opportunity to attack intruders . Gargoyles were often hunted for their horns , which had value to potion - brewers as the primary ingredient in potions of invulnerability and are also used in potions of fly ing . They could often be found lairing underground or in ruins with small groups of their kind . Description .

title: Garick Honestone
description: Garick Honestone Garick Honestone was a cleric of Garl Glittergold in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . When Garick first arrived in the town , he started a undertaker ' s service but with little success .
description_long: Garick Honestone Garick Honestone was a cleric of Garl Glittergold in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . When Garick first arrived in the town , he started a undertaker ' s service but with little success . So he decided to also offer a barber ' s service and gained huge success , thanks to his legendary skill with the straight razor .

title: Gariena
description: Gariena Gariena was a druid at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Gariena was one of the many druids deceived by the Cult of the Elemental Flame in order to unwittingly help the Rite of the Wicker Giant .
description_long: Gariena Gariena was a druid at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Gariena was one of the many druids deceived by the Cult of the Elemental Flame in order to unwittingly help the Rite of the Wicker Giant . Personality . Gariena sensed that the rite at the Scarlet Moon Hall would be a great event but wondered why it needed such a long preparation time and why she had never heard before about this rite .

title: Garin
description: Garin Garin was an angel in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . In 1384 DR , Garin was assigned by his friend and superior Micus to act as the jailor of Kaanyr Vhok , who had infiltrated the House of the Triad .
description_long: Garin Garin was an angel in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . In 1384 DR , Garin was assigned by his friend and superior Micus to act as the jailor of Kaanyr Vhok , who had infiltrated the House of the Triad . However , Aliisza and Tauran deceived Garin and freed Kaanyr , believing that they needed his help to capture the more dangerous Zasian Menz , also an infiltrator . For this , Garin was questioned by his superiors . When the Spellplague hit , Garin was one of the commanders of the celestial armies that tried to repel the evil outsiders that arrived in Celestia . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Garl Glittergold
description: Garl Glittergold Garl Glittergold , also known as The Watchful Protector , was a Lawful good Greater deity . He was said to have discovered the first gnomes while exploring a cavern before telling them a joke and leading them into the world . Garl led the Gnomish pantheon as the deity of luck , protection and trickery .
description_long: Garl Glittergold Garl Glittergold , also known as The Watchful Protector , was a Lawful good Greater deity . He was said to have discovered the first gnomes while exploring a cavern before telling them a joke and leading them into the world . Garl led the Gnomish pantheon as the deity of luck , protection and trickery . Followers . Garl was the most popular of the gnomish deities , and honored , in one way or another , by nearly all gnomes . His cleric s , known as Glitterbrights , wore war helms and gold belts . On the 13th day of each month , the Forgotten Folk held the Communion of Laughter in his honour . It consisted of joke telling contests , communal meals , dancing , prayers , and storytelling , and donations of Gold , which Garl ' s Church used to the benefit of the entire community . Relationships . Aside from the other non - evil members of the Gnome Pantheon , Garl was allied with Yondalla , Corellon Larethian and Moradin . His main companion was his intelligent battleaxe , Arumdina the Justifier .

title: Garlen Harlathurl
description: Garlen Harlathurl Garlen Harlathurl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Garlen was a jovial but grasping individual .
description_long: Garlen Harlathurl Garlen Harlathurl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Garlen was a jovial but grasping individual . His failure in Waterdeep made him cynical but he proved to be an attentive tavern - keeper . Activities . Garlen managed the Helm at Highsun tavern along with Justran Daehl . History . Garlen once lived in Waterdeep , where he tried to manage a mercantile venture but with no success , After that failure , Garlen went to Red Larch and with two associates : Justran Daehl and one who later returned to Waterdeep . They bought the Helm at Highsun . In 1491 DR , Garlen noticed some adventurers hired to find a diplomatic caravan that had disappeared near the city .

title: Garlena
description: Garlena Garlena , or Sister Garlena , was a cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . The god Helm gave Garlena and her fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . Knowing it was a difficult mission , her leader , Odren , recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him .
description_long: Garlena Garlena , or Sister Garlena , was a cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . The god Helm gave Garlena and her fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . Knowing it was a difficult mission , her leader , Odren , recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him . Garlena helped Gorion ' s Ward get equipped to enter the keep .

title: Garlokantha
description: Garlokantha Garlokantha was a gold dragon living in the Forest of Tethir as late as 1370 DR . She was saved by the Company of Eight in 1354 DR from the hand of some evil adventurers , including the drow Tleobar . Garlokantha preferred isolation and lived alone in her cave in the northeastern region of the forest , but about once every four years , she would take a humanoid form and travel through Tethyr and Amn to observe other races .
description_long: Garlokantha Garlokantha was a gold dragon living in the Forest of Tethir as late as 1370 DR . She was saved by the Company of Eight in 1354 DR from the hand of some evil adventurers , including the drow Tleobar . Garlokantha preferred isolation and lived alone in her cave in the northeastern region of the forest , but about once every four years , she would take a humanoid form and travel through Tethyr and Amn to observe other races .

title: Garnet ( gem )
description: Garnet ( gem ) Garnet was the generic name for a variety of crystals that had the same properties but came in a wide range of colors . Description . Garnets came in many colors ( see gallery ) but , as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , the violet hue was the most valuable while the other varieties and fallen out of favor and were valued in the fancy stone price range .
description_long: Garnet ( gem ) Garnet was the generic name for a variety of crystals that had the same properties but came in a wide range of colors . Description . Garnets came in many colors ( see gallery ) but , as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , the violet hue was the most valuable while the other varieties and fallen out of favor and were valued in the fancy stone price range . In later years , even the violet hued stones dropped in value . Garnets formed isometric crystals with twelve or twenty four faces , though thirty six or forty eight face versions have been found . They were common across the North and could be found in marble , granite , and other . A typical violet colored specimen once had a base value of 500 gp but eventually joined the red and brownish - green versions at a base value of 100 gp . Powers . If mounted on a weapon and properly enchanted , garnets could double or triple the damage dealing potential of that weapon . The most propitious time of day to begin these weapon enchantments was high morn . Reputation . In some faiths and folklore , garnets were considered the solidified blood of the divine avatars .

title: Garney
description: Garney Garney was a member of the Golden Legion . History . Garney took part in the Maztica n expedition .
description_long: Garney Garney was a member of the Golden Legion . History . Garney took part in the Maztica n expedition . He was one of the two guards at the entrance to Naltecona ' s room in Nexal when Erixitl and Halloran tried to free the Nexalan ruler . During the fighting , Halloran killed Garney .

title: Garos Daunger
description: Garos Daunger Garos Daunger was the chancellor of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . He liked hunting . History .
description_long: Garos Daunger Garos Daunger was the chancellor of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . He liked hunting . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Garos attended the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet . Later Garos went with all the court to Yulash to met a Damara n delegation . Personality . Garos was a shrewd politician willing to do anything to ensure the supremacy of the First Lord over the noble houses . He was very condescending , trying to always show his superiority .

title: Garotte
description: Garotte Garottes were vile weapons that were used to strangle an unsuspecting victim . Uses . Made from a metal wire strung between two wooden handles , a garotte was a brutally efficient weapon when attacking someone from behind .
description_long: Garotte Garottes were vile weapons that were used to strangle an unsuspecting victim . Uses . Made from a metal wire strung between two wooden handles , a garotte was a brutally efficient weapon when attacking someone from behind . The target could be strangled within moments or , if enough pressure was applied , their throat could be cut down to the bone . Garottes were favored by assassin s or particularly vile thieves . Prices . A typical garotte cost 3 silver piece s .

title: Garrandar ( family )
description: Garrandar ( family ) The Garrandar family was an noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .
description_long: Garrandar ( family ) The Garrandar family was an noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities . History . In 1429 DR , the Garrandars commissioned the construction of a castle in the ruins of Darkturret , a stronghold located on the banks of the River Orlaphar . Since nobody knew anything about the original site , historical records credited the Garrandars for building the place . It is believed the Garradars hid in Darkturret wealth stolen from other Twelvefold families . The other families joined forces and swiftly attacked and destroyed Darkturret in revenge . All members of the Garrandar family were killed shortly thereafter .

title: Garrant
description: Garrant Garrant was an officer in the Golden Legion and captain of the Legion ' s swordsmen . Despite being one of the main officers Cordell never consulted him in strategic decision . History .
description_long: Garrant Garrant was an officer in the Golden Legion and captain of the Legion ' s swordsmen . Despite being one of the main officers Cordell never consulted him in strategic decision . History . During the Viperhands ' assault at the start of the Night of Wailing , Garrant led the legionaries in repelling the enemy , while Cordell , in the meantime , was elaborating a strategy in order to escape all alive from the enemy ' s siege . Garrant however no survived the battle and later Cordell regret his death .

title: Garrathmaw
description: Garrathmaw Garrathmaw , also known as Incisor and Insyzor , was a fang dragon dracolich in the Greypeak Mountains and the River Loagrann . Activities . The Incisor ' s hoard was very wealthy with many dwarven treasures from Ammarindar and countless Netherese magic items .
description_long: Garrathmaw Garrathmaw , also known as Incisor and Insyzor , was a fang dragon dracolich in the Greypeak Mountains and the River Loagrann . Activities . The Incisor ' s hoard was very wealthy with many dwarven treasures from Ammarindar and countless Netherese magic items . History . Around 1370 DR , Incisor preyed over the Fallen Lands and the Greyvale .

title: Garret
description: Garret Garret was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Garret was one of Fort Locke ' s soldiers that went with Tann and his men to patrol .
description_long: Garret Garret was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Garret was one of Fort Locke ' s soldiers that went with Tann and his men to patrol . However , they were captured by the shadow priest . Unlike others , Garret was killed by the undead .

title: Garrick
description: Garrick Garrick was a free - spirited bard living in Beregost with a lively outlook on life and love . He could be found in Beregost working for Silke , an employer of dubious nature . Appendix .
description_long: Garrick Garrick was a free - spirited bard living in Beregost with a lively outlook on life and love . He could be found in Beregost working for Silke , an employer of dubious nature . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Garrick is a character in the " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game and is voiced by . He also appears as a minor NPC in " " , in the Temple District , trying to court a female paladin .

title: Garron Ersemm
description: Garron Ersemm Master Garron Ersemm was a skilled horseman and horse breaker and captain of the cavalry under the control of the Countess of Calimmon , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter . He was also her fiancé , having come with her from Waterdeep during the Reclamation Wars . < ref name = " LoI / Tethyr - 79 " > < / ref > Garron was almost perpetually happy and was well - loved by the young horse soldiers of Tethyr ' s cavalry .
description_long: Garron Ersemm Master Garron Ersemm was a skilled horseman and horse breaker and captain of the cavalry under the control of the Countess of Calimmon , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter . He was also her fiancé , having come with her from Waterdeep during the Reclamation Wars . < ref name = " LoI / Tethyr - 79 " > < / ref > Garron was almost perpetually happy and was well - loved by the young horse soldiers of Tethyr ' s cavalry . A worshiper of Torm , Garron joined the Loyal Order of Innocents after its creation by Queen Zaranda in 1369 DR . Garron spent time at least four times a year at Fortress Faithful a Tyr an keep .

title: Garrundar
description: Garrundar Garrundar the Vile was an old black dragon who made its home in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . At one time , the sky pirates of Bartholomew Blackdagger tried to capture Garrundar but they failed spectacularly and the black dragon pursued them back to their hideout .
description_long: Garrundar Garrundar the Vile was an old black dragon who made its home in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . At one time , the sky pirates of Bartholomew Blackdagger tried to capture Garrundar but they failed spectacularly and the black dragon pursued them back to their hideout . Garrundar took control of the lizardfolk that lived there and he weaved a powerful spell that cursed the pirates into undeath and bound them . In 1484 DR , Company Yargo , needing a base and more sky ships , sent an adventurer to confront the dragon . The adventurer fought and killed him .

title: Gartokkar Xundorn
description: Gartokkar Xundorn Gartokkar Xundorn was the leader of the Keepers of the Flame in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Just before the Rage of Demons , Gartokkar found himself in deep trouble because the Gray Ghosts thieves guild stole the red dragon egg that the Keepers of the Flame needed in order to kill and replace Themberchaud in the near future , since Themberchaud had grown too strong .
description_long: Gartokkar Xundorn Gartokkar Xundorn was the leader of the Keepers of the Flame in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Just before the Rage of Demons , Gartokkar found himself in deep trouble because the Gray Ghosts thieves guild stole the red dragon egg that the Keepers of the Flame needed in order to kill and replace Themberchaud in the near future , since Themberchaud had grown too strong . Gartokkar concentrated all of the Keepers ' s resources into finding the egg . They managed to capture and execute the Gray Ghost leader , but he said not a word about the egg ' s location . Gertokkar later singled out the Derro courier Droki as a key pawn to find the egg . He was so fixated about the egg that he dismissed the great disturbance in the whole Underdark that he and his fellow psychics sensed . He also used many of his powers to keep the dragon in line until the crisis ended without Themberchaud suspecting anything .

title: Gartos
description: Gartos Gartos was a male mercenary warrior in service to Prince Belaur Aumar of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Gartos was one of the most trusted men of Belaur , which elevated him to the prince ' s status and permitted him to be ranked above a minor magelord .
description_long: Gartos Gartos was a male mercenary warrior in service to Prince Belaur Aumar of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Gartos was one of the most trusted men of Belaur , which elevated him to the prince ' s status and permitted him to be ranked above a minor magelord . Gartos was sent together with the magelord Eth Junster to Narthil in 234 DR to quell a revolt started by Elminster and Gartos was killed by the young wizard . Possessions . The magelords provided Gartos with a enchanted sword .

title: Garumbelly Hillsafar
description: Garumbelly Hillsafar Garumbelly Hillsafar was the leader of Clan Hillsafar in Vaasa in 1359 DR . Activities . Garumbelly gained his nickname , " Grumble " , for his habit of murmuring to himself .
description_long: Garumbelly Hillsafar Garumbelly Hillsafar was the leader of Clan Hillsafar in Vaasa in 1359 DR . Activities . Garumbelly gained his nickname , " Grumble " , for his habit of murmuring to himself . As leader of a clan of 2 , 000 dwarves , he was a powerful man in Vaasa . Personality . Garumbelly was a generous and compassionate leader despite his gruff appearance . He always said what he thought . Garumbelly was always concerned about the good for his clan and what he could do to help .

title: Garumn ' s Gorge
description: Garumn ' s Gorge Garumn ' s Gorge was a wide chasm located in Mithral Hall . Description . There was a small waterfall that spouted from the wall of the chasm , called Bruenor ' s Falls .
description_long: Garumn ' s Gorge Garumn ' s Gorge was a wide chasm located in Mithral Hall . Description . There was a small waterfall that spouted from the wall of the chasm , called Bruenor ' s Falls . Defenses . There was one bridge leading across it . Part of that bridge collapsed when a lever on the far side of the gorge was pulled . This lever was used to aid escaping dwarves fleeing across the gorge . Location . To the west of the gorge , there was the hall of dwarven kings , and a path to the Undercity of Mithral Hall . To the east lay the eastern gate of Mithral Hall , which opened up onto the River Surbin . History . When Bruenor Battlehammer returned to Mithral Hall to reclaim it , he ran into an army of duergar , who worshiped the shadow dragon Shimmergloom , who had taken the hall hundreds of years before after they had chased the dwarves out . When Bruenor returned to the Hall , Shimmergloom challenged him atop the bridge that crossed Garumn ' s Gorge . Bruenor responded by wildly leaping onto the dragon ' s back with a flaming oil barrel . Bruenor succeeded in destroying the dragon , but suffered the consequences of the hundred - foot tumble to the bottom of the gorge .

title: Garumn Battlehammer
description: Garumn Battlehammer Garumn Battlehammer was the sixth King of Mithral Hall , and grandfather to the legendary Bruenor Battlehammer . History . Garumn was killed fighting duergar in Mithral Hall when his kin mined too deep and released the dragon known as Shimmerglooom .
description_long: Garumn Battlehammer Garumn Battlehammer was the sixth King of Mithral Hall , and grandfather to the legendary Bruenor Battlehammer . History . Garumn was killed fighting duergar in Mithral Hall when his kin mined too deep and released the dragon known as Shimmerglooom . Notes . Although not confirmed , the section of Mithral Hall known as Garumn ' s Gorge was probably named after him .

title: Garwyl Gos
description: Garwyl Gos Zor Garwyl Gos was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Garwyl was a realistic but ruthless person .
description_long: Garwyl Gos Zor Garwyl Gos was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Garwyl was a realistic but ruthless person . His focus was on the family ' s business and he had no time for distractions . His main concern was that scandals involving his siblings could ruin his work . For this reason , Garwyl tried not to become involved with the Hawks or the City Watch , as they might leak information to his rivals . History . Garwyl was the eldest son of Lord Ninyon Gos . Because of his father ' s extreme age , Garwyl ran the family ' s business . His family controlled most of the city ' s forges . In 1491 DR , his brother Andrik Gos became involved in a scandal . Some time later , Garwyl ' s sister Liticia Gos disappeared and he hired an adventuring party to find her . Later together with Dornal Whitebeard of the Lords ' Alliance hired an adventuring party to instigate a mysterious storm scorching the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Around 1492 DR Garwyl was one of the preeminent noble of the city .

title: Gary Gygax
description: Gary Gygax Ernest Gary Gygax ( born July 27 , 1938 , in Chicago , Illinois ; died March 4 , 2008 , Lake Geneva , Wisconsin , aged 69 years ) was best known as the author of " Dungeons & Dragons " ( " D & D " ) , co - created with Dave Arneson and co - published with Don Kaye in 1974 under the company TSR , Inc . . Although not alone in contributing to the origins of the industry , Gygax is generally considered to be the " father " of the modern role - playing hobby .
description_long: Gary Gygax Ernest Gary Gygax ( born July 27 , 1938 , in Chicago , Illinois ; died March 4 , 2008 , Lake Geneva , Wisconsin , aged 69 years ) was best known as the author of " Dungeons & Dragons " ( " D & D " ) , co - created with Dave Arneson and co - published with Don Kaye in 1974 under the company TSR , Inc . . Although not alone in contributing to the origins of the industry , Gygax is generally considered to be the " father " of the modern role - playing hobby . Role - playing games . " " - role - playing elements in the Wild West , with Brian Blume , 1975 Castles & Crusades . For " Castles & Crusades " , the Castle Zagyg series is a planned series of seven sourcebooks based on the Castle Greyhawk from Gygax ' s original campaign . For trademark reasons they are not actually published under the name of Greyhawk .

title: Garyx
description: Garyx Garyx ( pronounced " GAIR - iks " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of fire , destruction , and renewal . He symbolized the sheer power and destructive force of dragonkind , as well as the destructive and cleansing influence of fire . Some believed Garyx was insane as a result of his long residence in the plane of Pandemonium .
description_long: Garyx Garyx ( pronounced " GAIR - iks " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of fire , destruction , and renewal . He symbolized the sheer power and destructive force of dragonkind , as well as the destructive and cleansing influence of fire . Some believed Garyx was insane as a result of his long residence in the plane of Pandemonium . Description . Garyx usually manifested as a huge fire dragon , sometimes red , sometimes gold . Realm . Garyx was reputed to have a lair in the Abyss , and other in Pandemonium . History . In - 26000 DR , Garyx led red dragon s , and then all dragonkind , in a war against the giant empire of Ostoria that lasted one thousand years . Giant traditions had that the god of giantkind , Annam All - Father , made a truce with Garyx by agreeing with him to settle the war with a game of " wah - ree " . So skilled were the two opponents , that game ended in a stalemate , and the war came to an end . Worshipers . Garyx was worshiped by red dragons and by few rogue gold dragon s .

title: Gasbide
description: Gasbide Gasbide was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . A loyal follower of Phylo , Gasbide was corrupted by Zuggtmoy , dreaming of bizarre , elaborate structures no myconids would ever need , inspired by visions of Abyssal palaces .
description_long: Gasbide Gasbide was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . A loyal follower of Phylo , Gasbide was corrupted by Zuggtmoy , dreaming of bizarre , elaborate structures no myconids would ever need , inspired by visions of Abyssal palaces . History . Gasbide was the leader of the Circle of Builders in Neverlight Grove and a follower of Phylo . When , with the Rage of Demons , Zuggtmoy ' s will twisted most of the Circle , Gasbide fell to madness , starting to become curious about buildings on the surface , with the aim of construct , maybe with the help of Araumycos , a tower taller than Yggmorgus that could possibly connect the Underdark to the surface .

title: Gaseous form
description: Gaseous form Gaseous form or wraithform ( originally called Quantoul ' s wraithmorph ) was an arcane transmutation spell that mimicked the supernatural ability of some creatures , ( " e . g . " , oni mage s , several types of genie , and vampire s ) to take on an insubstantial , misty form .
description_long: Gaseous form Gaseous form or wraithform ( originally called Quantoul ' s wraithmorph ) was an arcane transmutation spell that mimicked the supernatural ability of some creatures , ( " e . g .
