" , oni mage s , several types of genie , and vampire s ) to take on an insubstantial , misty form . It was also a divine power granted to cleric s of and to druid s who were members of the Underdark circle . Effects . The subject of the spell and all his or her possessions , upon being touched , were converted into a translucent cloud of gas . Someone in a gaseous form could move through the air , but could not pass through solid objects or water — one did not become incorporeal . Gaseous forms could flow through tiny holes or cracks , however . One in gaseous form could not do anything a literal cloud of gas could not also do . It was very hard to physically damage a creature in gaseous form without the use of magic weapons . It was also challenging to recognize that a gaseous form was not just a simple mist . The effect of the spell would last ten minutes or longer .

title: Gash
description: Gash Gash was a gnoll in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gash was with his fellow gnolls in the Labyrinth until a pack of minotaur s ambushed and killed them .
description_long: Gash Gash was a gnoll in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gash was with his fellow gnolls in the Labyrinth until a pack of minotaur s ambushed and killed them . Gash survived by betraying his kind to the minotaurs . He was so successful that the minotaurs decided to spare Gash , until he continued to send more and more gnolls and other beings into minotaur ambushes . Personality . The abuses of the minotaurs had broken his will and Gash had become a pathetically loyal and willing slave of his masters .

title: Gaspar
description: Gaspar Gaspar was a fishmonger who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The fishmonger was of normal build and dressed grey clothing .
description_long: Gaspar Gaspar was a fishmonger who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The fishmonger was of normal build and dressed grey clothing . Activities . Gaspar sold knucklehead trout to be used by scrimshawers from his warehouse with the help of Churin . Relationships . He had a son , Damien who liked to fish on the banks of Lac Dinneshere . History . During Eleint , 1281 DR , Gaspar ordered supplies from Ilmus Gallaway to aid Easthaven in the coming winter , but the caravan from Caer - Dineval was ambushed by orc raiders lead by an ogre .

title: Gaspar Cormaeril
description: Gaspar Cormaeril Gaspar Cormaeril was a young member of the Cormaeril noble house of Cormyr . Background . In 1369 DR Gaspar met with High Wizard Vangerdahast to discuss the appointment of Vangerdahast as regent .
description_long: Gaspar Cormaeril Gaspar Cormaeril was a young member of the Cormaeril noble house of Cormyr . Background . In 1369 DR Gaspar met with High Wizard Vangerdahast to discuss the appointment of Vangerdahast as regent . Gaspar agreed to give his support on the conditions that Vangerdahast appointed a council of a dozen or so noble houses , mostly at Gaspar ' s selection , with the voting power to overrule Vangerdahast himself , and that Vangerdahast ' s own vote would be directed by the Cormaeril house . Gaspar then assumed control of the house by having Ohlmer Cormaeril assassinated , and also had Sorgar Illance assassinated . Gaspar was himself killed in 1369 DR by Aunadar Bleth to power the Abraxus used in the Abraxus affair .

title: Gasteban
description: Gasteban Gasteban was a pirate in 1359 DR . History . Gasteban was a noble of Chessenta who around 1349 DR was deposed and fled to the Pirate Isles with three ships .
description_long: Gasteban Gasteban was a pirate in 1359 DR . History . Gasteban was a noble of Chessenta who around 1349 DR was deposed and fled to the Pirate Isles with three ships . There , he became one of the competitors to the position of pirate lord and was sponsored by the master of intrigue , Crammar . In truth , Gasteban wanted only to gather an army and go back to reclaim his ancestral land in Chessenta . In 1359 DR , a confrontation between Gasteban and Vurgrom was considered inevitable .

title: Gastyn
description: Gastyn Gastyn was head of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Gastyn was head butler for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , his master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .
description_long: Gastyn Gastyn was head of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Gastyn was head butler for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , his master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel . She decide to use Gastyn and other servants as her own .

title: Gate
description: Gate Gate was a conjuration spell that connected two plane s for two - way travel or the summoning and control of creatures or beings of great power to aid the caster . Older versions of this spell allowed one - way travel for a named entity and requested their help rather than commanding it . Effects .
description_long: Gate Gate was a conjuration spell that connected two plane s for two - way travel or the summoning and control of creatures or beings of great power to aid the caster . Older versions of this spell allowed one - way travel for a named entity and requested their help rather than commanding it . Effects . The early versions of this spell required the caster to call out the name of the being they wished to contact and ask for their aid . The " gate " spell then opened a temporary one - way portal near the named entity allowing them , or perhaps their designated representative , to step through into the presence of the caster . Deities and other uniquely powerful individuals could prevent such portals from opening near them , but they were always aware of the request for help . What stepped through the " gate " and what action it took depended on a great number of factors including the alignment of the caster , the alignment or character of the caster ' s companions , the nature of the threat to the caster , and the exigency of the situation .

title: Gate of Glory
description: Gate of Glory The Gate of Glory was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . This gate was found in the Foundry ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Gate of Glory The Gate of Glory was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . This gate was found in the Foundry ward of the city . Description . The Gate of Glory was the entrance to the Glory Mines – a maze of tunnels running beneath the City of Brass that was inhabited by salamander s .

title: Gate of Heaven
description: Gate of Heaven The Gate of Heaven was the central province and heart of the Yikarian Empire in the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . The Gate of Heaven sat high atop the southern arm of the mighty World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara .
description_long: Gate of Heaven The Gate of Heaven was the central province and heart of the Yikarian Empire in the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . The Gate of Heaven sat high atop the southern arm of the mighty World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara . Description . This province was physically smaller compared to the other seven provinces of the Empire , but it ' s population was much larger because of the capital city of Nathong . It towered above the surrounding plateau of the Enlightened Ring . Despite the extreme altitude , the Gate of Heaven experienced bearable temperatures and a surprisingly long growth season for local flora . Most yikarian s believed this was in direct correlation to the power of the Faceless God . Inhabitants . The Gate of Heaven was the home of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne and his Lotus Court , who all resided in the capital . Defenses . The single mountain pass leading into the Gate of Heaven was guarded by 900 elite Faceless Guards .

title: Gate of Iron
description: Gate of Iron The Gate of Iron was a magical gateway between the Raurin desert and northern Durpar in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located in the Dustwall Mountains , at the very top of a narrow mountain pass at a neck in the range .
description_long: Gate of Iron The Gate of Iron was a magical gateway between the Raurin desert and northern Durpar in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located in the Dustwall Mountains , at the very top of a narrow mountain pass at a neck in the range . Description . The gates themselves stood within a massive stone battlement , offering the only passage through the barrier . Although over four millennia old , the gates remained unblemished well into the mid - 1300s DR . History . Built around roughly −2700 DR ( that is , around 4000 years before the 14th century DR ) during the time of the Imaskar Empire , the battlement was originally constructed as a barrier against the approaching Imaskari forces . It was sited on the only accessible pass between the Raurin and the lands to the south that would later be known as Durpar and Ulgarth ( the easier lower passes were covered by the Scarlet Jungle ) . Working to the instructions of master dwarven architects , the southern folk erected the walls and fortifications , but found the gate itself to be natural weak point in the defense .

title: Gate of Iron Fangs
description: Gate of Iron Fangs The Gate of Iron Fangs was a ruined city in the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . No one really knew who inhabitated and built it since it was already a ruin when the Arkaiun s migrated into this region . The few who explored this ancient site speculated that it might have been a serpent - like race since the ruins showed resemblance to the architecture of Ilimar .
description_long: Gate of Iron Fangs The Gate of Iron Fangs was a ruined city in the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . No one really knew who inhabitated and built it since it was already a ruin when the Arkaiun s migrated into this region . The few who explored this ancient site speculated that it might have been a serpent - like race since the ruins showed resemblance to the architecture of Ilimar . The Gate of Iron Fangs got its name from two towers which flanked the rest of its ancient gates . The rest of the city was long ago overgrown by the plants of the forest . Inhabitants . Within the ruined city lived a tribe of gnoll s who raided the nearby country and passing caravans . They were well organized and the people suspected that the Swagdar had an alliance with them . But the truth was much more troubling since the real schemer behind all of this was a glabrezu known as Quinix . The gnolls thought of him as a representative of Yeenoghu , and he used them with his other demons to bring more chaos upon the country and maybe even conquer it .

title: Gate of Revelations
description: Gate of Revelations The Gate of Revelations was the real entrance into the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Made from marble streaked with pink and red , the Gate of Revelations was even more beautiful than the Grand Gate of Delights .
description_long: Gate of Revelations The Gate of Revelations was the real entrance into the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Made from marble streaked with pink and red , the Gate of Revelations was even more beautiful than the Grand Gate of Delights . Skilled dao were used to manipulate the stone so that the color streaks showed a scene of the first Grand Caliph finding the scrolls of the Loregiver . A pair of towers flanked the gate . Each was domed with solid gold . Defenses . A compliment of 50 mamluk s was stationed at the gate at all times . In addition to these soldiers , mages and priests were also present . Suspicious - looking visitors were usually questioned with magic . Strong magical enchantments protected the gate against all forms of destructive magic , including powerful spells such as " disintegrate " and " earthquake " . A powerful dao would appear to defend the gate in times of crisis . Each of the towers housed crossbowmen who could easily rain bolts down upon any attackers . Additionally , the top floor of each tower was dedicated to a special apparatus that could drop large boulders from above . Inhabitants .

title: Gate of Wealth
description: Gate of Wealth The Gate of Wealth was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The Gate of Wealth was located within the Affluent District of Huzuz .
description_long: Gate of Wealth The Gate of Wealth was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The Gate of Wealth was located within the Affluent District of Huzuz . It was comprised of two smaller gates . Activities . Though caravans and common pilgrims used this gate , the vast majority of individuals passing through the Gate of Wealth were rich young nobles in search of entertainment . At sunset , one of the gates was closed and the other left halfway open in case stumbling nobles needed to get back home during the dead of night . Smuggling activity was common here when compared to the other gates of Huzuz .

title: Gate of the Bulls
description: Gate of the Bulls The Gate of the Bulls was the inner gate leading to the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . Beautiful mosaics depicting winged bulls , sword - bearing lions , and snakes climbing toward to sun adorned this gate .
description_long: Gate of the Bulls The Gate of the Bulls was the inner gate leading to the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . Beautiful mosaics depicting winged bulls , sword - bearing lions , and snakes climbing toward to sun adorned this gate . Inhabitants . Since the Gate of the Bulls was the last checkpoint before Sarahin , six muscled janni were stationed there to question and admit anyone who approached . The Gate of the Bulls also served as a roost for a group of deadly marrash .

title: Gate of the Fallen
description: Gate of the Fallen The Gate of the Fallen was a large monument located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Gate of the Fallen was found within the ward of Castings . Description .
description_long: Gate of the Fallen The Gate of the Fallen was a large monument located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Gate of the Fallen was found within the ward of Castings . Description . Despite its name , the Gate of the Fallen was not a gate or a memorial to the efreeti dead . It was in fact a large decorated archway depicting scenes of the efreet dominating all other races found on the Elemental Plane of Fire .

title: Gate of the Ghost
description: Gate of the Ghost The Gate of the Ghost was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Activities . The Gate of the Ghost was the most heavily used entrance to the city .
description_long: Gate of the Ghost The Gate of the Ghost was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Activities . The Gate of the Ghost was the most heavily used entrance to the city . Caravans departing for Halwa and hordes of pilgrims bound for Huzuz used this gate . Mamluk s were used for security and to help direct the vast flow of traffic passing through the gate . Each morning began with several caravans waiting in line for inspection . During peak afternoon hours , caravans often had to wait for hours before passing through the gate . Rumors and Legends . The name " Gate of the Ghosts " was derived from the large amount of traffic coming from the Haunted Lands . Superstitious Zakharans believed that ghost s and other spirits came with the travelers from the great desert .

title: Gate of the Mamluks
description: Gate of the Mamluks The Gate of the Mamluks was an entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate served as the main entrance and exit to and from the Palace for all of the mamluk s and other guards .
description_long: Gate of the Mamluks The Gate of the Mamluks was an entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate served as the main entrance and exit to and from the Palace for all of the mamluk s and other guards . Security here was just as tight as any of the other gates providing access to the Palace .

title: Gate of the People
description: Gate of the People The Gate of the People was the main entrance for the Public Gardens in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Commoners used this gate the enter the beautiful gardens .
description_long: Gate of the People The Gate of the People was the main entrance for the Public Gardens in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Commoners used this gate the enter the beautiful gardens . Though mamluk s were stationed here , they did not bar entrance to the gardens to any unless specifically instructed to do so .

title: Gate of the Wind
description: Gate of the Wind The Gate of the Wind , or Bab il - Hawa , was the first gate of the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . The Gate of the Wind appeared as an archway framed by two large carvings of desert giant s holding the central portion of the gate aloft .
description_long: Gate of the Wind The Gate of the Wind , or Bab il - Hawa , was the first gate of the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . The Gate of the Wind appeared as an archway framed by two large carvings of desert giant s holding the central portion of the gate aloft . Once beyond the gate , a narrow curving path led to the fortress of Sarahin . Mules and donkeys could easily navigate the path , but horses and larger animals had to be led by hand . Inhabitants . The giant carvings of the gate were actually real desert giants who sprung forward to challenge anyone who approached unbidden . They answered to Mamoud ibn Asra and had a deep hatred for all genie s .

title: Gatekeeper ' s Crystal
description: Gatekeeper ' s Crystal The Gatekeeper ' s Crystal was a powerful magical device , which , according to legend , had been created by a powerful lich . The truth , however , is that it originated from the Outlands , having been carried by a mysterious being called the Gatekeeper , whose sole duty was apparently to guard a crossroads of " gate " s across the planes and spheres , preventing anyone who wished to restrict access to it from blocking the travel of others . It was stolen ( with the assistance of a deity , it was said ) by Iyraclea , a lich and ice - priestess of Auril of the Great Glacier known as the Ice Queen , as part of her attempt to conquer Myth Ondath .
description_long: Gatekeeper ' s Crystal The Gatekeeper ' s Crystal was a powerful magical device , which , according to legend , had been created by a powerful lich . The truth , however , is that it originated from the Outlands , having been carried by a mysterious being called the Gatekeeper , whose sole duty was apparently to guard a crossroads of " gate " s across the planes and spheres , preventing anyone who wished to restrict access to it from blocking the travel of others . It was stolen ( with the assistance of a deity , it was said ) by Iyraclea , a lich and ice - priestess of Auril of the Great Glacier known as the Ice Queen , as part of her attempt to conquer Myth Ondath . Description . When assembled , the device looked like a three - pointed star almost 1 inch ( 30 cm ) in diameter . It was carved from onyx , with a metal no one could identify woven throughout it . Powers . It was made up of three separate shards , each of which were powerful in their own right , but devastating when brought together as a whole .

title: Gates of Doom
description: Gates of Doom The Gates of Doom is the name give to two pillars of rock , with a path between them . They mark the entrance to Oversember Vale in the Thunder Peaks Inhabitants . The Cult of the Dragon inhabits the area , and guards the Gates of Doom .
description_long: Gates of Doom The Gates of Doom is the name give to two pillars of rock , with a path between them . They mark the entrance to Oversember Vale in the Thunder Peaks Inhabitants . The Cult of the Dragon inhabits the area , and guards the Gates of Doom . Any who pass through the gates without leave are attacked with out question or hesitation

title: Gates of the Moon
description: Gates of the Moon Gates of the Moon was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to its attachment to the World Tree , it was Selûne ' s realm in Gladsheim / Ysgard as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Description .
description_long: Gates of the Moon Gates of the Moon was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to its attachment to the World Tree , it was Selûne ' s realm in Gladsheim / Ysgard as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Description . The Spellplague caused the Gates of the Moon to be cast adrift in the Astral Sea and Selûne shared this plane with some allied deities . One thing that all the cosmological models agreed upon was that the Infinite Staircase was based here . Great Wheel Model . On the first layer of Ysgard , magic was altered such that most wizard spells required a school - specific rune to be inscribed on the material components , and if a spell had no material component , the rune had to be incorporated into the verbal component . A visiting wizard would have to learn the correct runes from the local inhabitants , or come by the knowledge some other way , in order to cast any spell other than strength or melee combat spells ( i . e . , " enlarge " , " fly " , " haste " , " jump " , " polymorph " , " stoneskin " , " strength " , etc . all worked as normal without engraved runes ) .

title: Gateway
description: Gateway Gateway was an arcane alteration spell that opened a two - way portal to a location the caster had previously visited . Effects . This spell only worked on the Prime Material Plane of the caster , and only provided passage to locations at which he or she had been physically present at some previous time .
description_long: Gateway Gateway was an arcane alteration spell that opened a two - way portal to a location the caster had previously visited . Effects . This spell only worked on the Prime Material Plane of the caster , and only provided passage to locations at which he or she had been physically present at some previous time . The " gateway " lasted for a minimum of sixteen minutes ; longer for more experienced casters . The portal appeared as an upright disk 10 ft ( 3 m ) in diameter within 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) of the caster . It could not occupy the same space as another object but could be placed against any vertical flat surface . If cast as a free - standing disk , the back side of the portal appeared as a disk of featureless gray . When successfully cast , the " gateway " bridged the two locations like a window , allowing creatures on both sides to look through the portal and see the other side , but keeping the environments separate . For example , if one terminus of the portal was under water and the other on dry land , no water poured out one side , and no air bubbled out of the other .

title: Gathan
description: Gathan Gathan was a lizardfolk chieftain in the Vast Swamp until 1374 DR . History . Gathan was the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe .
description_long: Gathan Gathan was a lizardfolk chieftain in the Vast Swamp until 1374 DR . History . Gathan was the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe . In 1374 DR , the fellow lizardfolk tribe of the Shadowscale allied with the Church of Shar and began to act strangely . They eventually started a war with the Sharptooth . Gathan appeared to be killed during the fighting , but was captured alongside others and they became prisoners of the Church of Shar in the Lost Refuge . An adventuring party that assaulted the keep informed him that he was believed dead and had been replaced as chieftain by the priest Kessessek . In order to avoid problems for Kessessek , Gathan would try to die fighting alongside the adventurers against his Sharran captors .

title: Gatherer Creed
description: Gatherer Creed The Gatherer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . This Creed was different from the other Creeds as it dealt with immigration . They believed that the best way to gather knowledge was to reunite the widely scattered illithid hives .
description_long: Gatherer Creed The Gatherer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . This Creed was different from the other Creeds as it dealt with immigration . They believed that the best way to gather knowledge was to reunite the widely scattered illithid hives . Bases . The Gatherers had a base called the Hall of Melding in Oryndoll . This Creed succeeded in concentrating illithid activity in southwestern Faerûn in Oryndoll .

title: Gathgaer Milomynt
description: Gathgaer Milomynt Gathgaer Milomynt was a cleric of Shar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Gathgaer , on the surface , pretended to be a healer in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep , but in fact he was a slaver , kidnapping people of little influence or profile .
description_long: Gathgaer Milomynt Gathgaer Milomynt was a cleric of Shar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Gathgaer , on the surface , pretended to be a healer in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep , but in fact he was a slaver , kidnapping people of little influence or profile . He sold them to Hlethvagi Anteos in Undermountain .

title: Gathkatra
description: Gathkatra Gathkatra was an ogre mage that masqueraded as a human female and worked as the chatelaine of the Whistling Wizard inn on the outskirts of Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . History . In the late 1350s DR , the Whistling Wizard had become a haven and meeting place for many of the more evilly - inclined religious , mercantile , and political groups in the Moonsea region .
description_long: Gathkatra Gathkatra was an ogre mage that masqueraded as a human female and worked as the chatelaine of the Whistling Wizard inn on the outskirts of Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . History . In the late 1350s DR , the Whistling Wizard had become a haven and meeting place for many of the more evilly - inclined religious , mercantile , and political groups in the Moonsea region . The owner at the time was Ravvas Thurrpurtyn who seemed to tolerate these elements in his establishment , perhaps even courting favor with them . For unknown reasons , Gathkatra was attracted to this activity or atmosphere and arranged an accident to eliminate the current hostess of the Wizard . Then , polymorph ed into a human female , Gathkatra applied for the job and became the new chatelaine . Gathkatra ' s presence at the Whistling Wizard was one of many concerns that worried Zarracee Ambroanye , the spectral harpist that haunted the Wizard Well , located in the cellar of the inn . She eventually called for help , asking that the inn be purged of the many duplicitous characters living there . This precipitated the conflict that became known as the Battle at the Bar .

title: Gattash
description: Gattash Gattash was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area .
description_long: Gattash Gattash was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area . Here , however , the cambion twins , using " fiendish charm " and " alter self " spell s , managed to gain the worship of a tribe of madness - infected kuo - toa , who believed them to be gods . Impressed , Graz ' zt sent the hezrou Toad to serve them . Gattash and Rashara planned to destroy the Red Plumes garrison inside the Waydown and go back to the court of the demon lord . They started sending some octopus es to attack Red Plume patrols . They resided in a luxury room in their new Sanctum of Sin with their kuo - toa minions . However , they were killed by some adventurers hired by Arrizz .

title: Gaucelm Gonfrey
description: Gaucelm Gonfrey Lord Gaucelm Gonfrey was once the ruler of the kingdom of Grimmantle after usurping the throne from its aged king . Personality . Gonfrey had a penchant for the finer things in life , even in undeath he would spare no expense on outfitting his chambers or wardrobe with finery .
description_long: Gaucelm Gonfrey Lord Gaucelm Gonfrey was once the ruler of the kingdom of Grimmantle after usurping the throne from its aged king . Personality . Gonfrey had a penchant for the finer things in life , even in undeath he would spare no expense on outfitting his chambers or wardrobe with finery . Although in battle the Thief - King was fearless , often rushing in to attack with determined sword swings , his vanity was such that he would still hold back his undead powers to maintain his facade . Only unleashing them if sorely pressed . History . In 304 DR , Gaucelm Gonfrey seized upon the opportunity to take the throne of Grimmantle from its elderly king , becoming known afterwards as the " thief - king " by his subjects . However , Gonfrey ' s rule was cut short a year later when he was murdered by the poisoned arrow of an assassin and buried far beneath The Crags . Many centuries passed as Gonfrey rested in death until Myrkul , lord of the dead , decided to bestow the gift of undeath upon him in the months prior to the Time of Troubles . None know what the Lord of Bones had planned for Gonfrey as the Deity perished in Waterdeep soon after Gonfrey ' s rising .

title: Gaulguth
description: Gaulguth Gaulguth was a berserker nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and field commander of the Army of Darkness . History . Gaulguth was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .
description_long: Gaulguth Gaulguth was a berserker nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and field commander of the Army of Darkness . History . Gaulguth was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese . Aldlas set them forth on the task to locate the Nether Scrolls , thought to be somewhere in the elven lands . For three months The Trio Nefarious ravaged the elven lands until they met with the army of Cormanthyr and were captured and imprisoned . Nearly 2 millenia later they escaped and began raising an army that soon descended upon Cormanthyr . On Greengrass , 713 DR , Malimshaer and Gaulguth were attacked by Myth Drannor army and Malimshaer was killed and Gaulguth lost the left eye and one of his left arms Death . On Hammer 29 - Midwinter , 713 DR , in the battle known as Lost Trench Gaulgath was killed by Anthan Narlgold , the half - dwarf heir to Clan Nargold .

title: Gaumahavi
description: Gaumahavi Gaumahavi , also called the Purple Dragon , was a unique greater purple dragon from the Hordelands . Description . Outwardly , Gaumahavi looked very similar to an oriental dragon , possessing a long sinuous body that measured well over a hundred feet long .
description_long: Gaumahavi Gaumahavi , also called the Purple Dragon , was a unique greater purple dragon from the Hordelands . Description . Outwardly , Gaumahavi looked very similar to an oriental dragon , possessing a long sinuous body that measured well over a hundred feet long . Abilities . As the " Great Dragon of the Desert Winds , " Gaumahavi had complete control over the wind within a 500 yd . radius of herself , allowing for awesome displays of power . Her breath weapon was a large cloud of suffocating purple dust . Gaumahavi could take any shape she desired and could revert to an astral form at will . History . Thousands of years in the distant past , Gaumahavi was a pet leopard of Surtava , an Ulgarian prince . Because of her close proximity to the Padhra , she developed her own soul , allowing her to reincarnate herself into different forms including that of the great purple dragon . During the War of the Purple Dragon , Gaumahavi , along with the army of Solon , sacked the city of Kushk located along the Jumpa River near Ra - Khati .

title: Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet A gauntlet was a metal glove worn to protect the hand . They were a standard part of medium and heavy suits of armor . Reputation .
description_long: Gauntlet A gauntlet was a metal glove worn to protect the hand . They were a standard part of medium and heavy suits of armor . Reputation . The cleric s of Bane commonly wore a black gauntlet on a single fist . The favored weapon of the dwarven god Thard Harr was likewise a spiked gauntlet .

title: Gauntlet ( Herald )
description: Gauntlet ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Gauntlet was one of two unique positions ( Green Shield being the other one ) that were temporary . While most Herald offices were a lifetime appointment , Gauntlet was given a four - year term that began just before a Shieldmeet and ended just prior to the next Shieldmeet . Gauntlet was charged with gathering intelligence related to non - state militias , mercenary companies , and adventuring groups , reporting to the High Heralds their strength and effectiveness , the character of their leadership , their clientele , what loyalties they held , what areas they operated in , and how to contact their agents .
description_long: Gauntlet ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Gauntlet was one of two unique positions ( Green Shield being the other one ) that were temporary . While most Herald offices were a lifetime appointment , Gauntlet was given a four - year term that began just before a Shieldmeet and ended just prior to the next Shieldmeet . Gauntlet was charged with gathering intelligence related to non - state militias , mercenary companies , and adventuring groups , reporting to the High Heralds their strength and effectiveness , the character of their leadership , their clientele , what loyalties they held , what areas they operated in , and how to contact their agents . Because of this familiarity , rulers sometimes issued charters , contracts , and " letters patent " through this office in order to keep counterfeiting in check and / or to promote the Warriors ' Code . ( The Warriors ' s Code dealt with the treatment of prisoners , the wounded , peasants , crops , land , and natural resources in areas of conflict , and Gauntlet had the authority to enforce these strictures under threat of losing the recognition of the Heralds and all who trusted their judgement .

title: Gauntlet ( organization )
description: Gauntlet ( organization ) The Gauntlet was a law - enforcement company based in the Tears of Selûne around 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 DR , the Gauntlet were the self - proclaimed law - enforcement agency of the Tears of Selûne .
description_long: Gauntlet ( organization ) The Gauntlet was a law - enforcement company based in the Tears of Selûne around 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 DR , the Gauntlet were the self - proclaimed law - enforcement agency of the Tears of Selûne . They were always busy fighting mind flayer s and neogi .

title: Gauntlets of ogre power
description: Gauntlets of ogre power The Gauntlets of ogre power were found among other objects upon the rescue of the drow / wood elf Zhai , when she had been subdued and captured in the troll mines , among the powerful beads of force and the ring of jumping . These powerful gauntlets give the wearer ( in this case ) the strength of a powerful ogre and furthermore allow him or her to smash the ground with great force , causing great damage to enemies and for the smashing of walls and the removal of obstacles . They where wield by Rannek and used to progress the advance of the party on there journey .

title: Gauntlets of swimming and climbing
description: Gauntlets of swimming and climbing Gauntlets of swimming and climbing were magical gauntlets that bestowed the wearer with the ability to swim as fast as a triton underwater ( or as fast as a merman on the surface ) and to scale vertical surfaces whether climbing upward or downward . Description . These gauntlets appeared normal but would radiate magic if detected .
description_long: Gauntlets of swimming and climbing Gauntlets of swimming and climbing were magical gauntlets that bestowed the wearer with the ability to swim as fast as a triton underwater ( or as fast as a merman on the surface ) and to scale vertical surfaces whether climbing upward or downward . Description . These gauntlets appeared normal but would radiate magic if detected . They fit anyone from a halfling to a large human .

title: Gauntlets of the valorous
description: Gauntlets of the valorous Gauntlets of the valorous were magic al gauntlet s that were created for the heroes of Myth Drannor . Description . These gauntlets were made in a wide variety of appearances , ranging from huge silvery gauntlets that extended to the elbows to five rings for fingers and thumb chain linked by chains to a bracelet .
description_long: Gauntlets of the valorous Gauntlets of the valorous were magic al gauntlet s that were created for the heroes of Myth Drannor . Description . These gauntlets were made in a wide variety of appearances , ranging from huge silvery gauntlets that extended to the elbows to five rings for fingers and thumb chain linked by chains to a bracelet . Powers . A single " gauntlet of the valorous " had the power of a " + 3 gauntlet " . They offered no protective ability , but did not affect spellcasting ability . Typically , only one gauntlet from a pair was located , but when both were found and used together , an additional spell - like power was possible . These were : " chain lightning " , " flame blade " , " heal " , " hold monster " , " polymorph other " , " regenerate " , " repulsion " , " shocking grasp " , " stone to flesh " or " flesh to stone " , or " telekinesis " . A single gauntlet would fetch around 18 , 000 gold piece s , but a pair could increase in value up to around 85 , 000 gold pieces depending on the powers they had .

title: Gauntlgrym
description: Gauntlgrym Gauntlgrym was an ancient dwarven city that fell into ruin . The city was the capital of the Delzoun . Geography .
description_long: Gauntlgrym Gauntlgrym was an ancient dwarven city that fell into ruin . The city was the capital of the Delzoun . Geography . Location . Its location was lost for centuries , alleged to be north of the River Dessarin , near the Valley of Khedrun in the Savage Frontier , though it was actually much farther to the southwest . Entry points . Bruenor Battlehammer rediscovered Gauntlgrym through a cave entrance in a stony ravine in the Crags outside of Neverwinter . This entrance appears to be the closest to the city ' s " front doors . " There existed a river of magma that originated within Mount Hotenow , which , in 1480 DR , was connected to the Great Cavern ( and therefore Gauntlgrym ' s main entrance ) via winding tunnels . The river was guarded by Karrundax , a young red dragon . A number of tunnels in the Underdark , beneath Gauntlgrym , led upwards into the city , many of which bypassed the main entrance . Via the Underdark , Gauntlgrym connected with Deepearth , Nuur Throth , a long and treacherous tunnel to the Great Worm Caverns and an even longer tunnel to Shadowdale . Description .

title: Gauntlgrym ( novel )
description: Gauntlgrym ( novel ) Gauntlgrym is a book in the " Legend of Drizzt " saga by R . A . Salvatore and the first book in the " The Neverwinter Saga " series .
description_long: Gauntlgrym ( novel ) Gauntlgrym is a book in the " Legend of Drizzt " saga by R . A . Salvatore and the first book in the " The Neverwinter Saga " series . Summary . In 1409 DR , Bruenor Battlehammer , the king of the dwarven stronghold of Mithral Hall , mourned with the drow ranger Drizzt Do ' Urden over the deaths of his halfling friend Regis and his adopted daughter , the human woman Catti - brie , both of whom had been lost to the deadly effects of the Spellplague in 1385 DR . Bruenor also grieved for his adopted son , the barbarian warrior Wulfgar , who had returned to his birthplace , Icewind Dale , and had not been heard from in many years . The dwarf king lamented over all that had happened since those terrible events and still regretted never completing his quest to find Gauntlgrym , the ancient homeland of the Delzoun dwarves . However , by signing the Treaty of Garumn ’ s Gorge in 1372 DR , Bruenor had brought relative peace to the Silver Marches , and it had continued when Obould II had inherited the orc kingdom of Many - Arrows after the death of his predecessor .

title: Gaussra Kenafin
description: Gaussra Kenafin Gaussra Kenafin was a member of House Kenafin and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Gaussra had black teeth .
description_long: Gaussra Kenafin Gaussra Kenafin was a member of House Kenafin and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Gaussra had black teeth . History . In 1372 DR , Gaussra was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith . She joined Drisinil Armgo ' s group of conspirators to overthrow Mistress Quenthel Baenre , seeking power and believing that demons attempting to assassinate her were signs of Lolth ' s disfavor with Quenthel . Quenthel discovered the plot and pretended to poison Drisinil in order to have her bring her fellow conspirators to an unused classroom in Arach - Tinilith , where she summoned hordes of spiders that slew them , including Gaussra .

title: Gauth
description: Gauth A gauth , sometimes referred to as a lesser beholder , was a four - foot ( 1 . 42 m ) wide beholderkin that fed on magic as well as flesh . They had six eyestalks , one of which was used to drain magic from items , along with four feeding tendrils that sprouted from the top of its body .
description_long: Gauth A gauth , sometimes referred to as a lesser beholder , was a four - foot ( 1 . 42 m ) wide beholderkin that fed on magic as well as flesh . They had six eyestalks , one of which was used to drain magic from items , along with four feeding tendrils that sprouted from the top of its body . The most obvious feature of a gauth was that its central eye , which stunned and affected the viewer ' s mind , was surrounded by a ridge of flesh and many small eyes used for sight . A gauth was a rapacious and tyrannical creature that sought to exact tribute from anything weaker than itself and often attacked adventurers merely to acquire their wealth . A Gauth had four strong tentacles along its undercarriage . Abilities . The rays of a gauth ' s six eyestalks had effects similar to the spells " dispel magic " , " inflict moderate wounds " , " ray of exhaustion " , " scorching ray " , and " sleep " or " paralysis " . They also possessed the ability of darkvision out to 60 feet ( 18 . 3 m ) .

title: Gauth Grottoes
description: Gauth Grottoes The Gauth Grottoes formed an area of the Underdark distinct from its main regions . The grottoes were located 30 miles south and 7 miles down from Darkhold . They were close to the Northdark , the Buried Realms and the Darklands but had no direct connections to any of these areas .

title: Gauwervyndhal
description: Gauwervyndhal Gauwervyndhal , also known as Gauwer or The Empress Dragon , was the dragon ruler of Skelkor in 1479 DR . Personality . Gauwervyndhal was known for being a brutal mother .
description_long: Gauwervyndhal Gauwervyndhal , also known as Gauwer or The Empress Dragon , was the dragon ruler of Skelkor in 1479 DR . Personality . Gauwervyndhal was known for being a brutal mother . She spawned clutch after clutch of wyrmlings whose lives were short in most cases , as only the strongest of each clutch survived to adulthood . The survivors became known as her " suzerains " , tasked with day to day ruling of Skelkor , and with the protection of the land . She was very interested in the lore her suzerains obtained from their dreams granted by consuming arambar . Description . No mortal in Laerakond , not even her own suzerains , knew to which dragon species belonged Gauwervyndhal . She usually took the form of a gigantic dragon with purple or rose - reddish scales , although she was known for being able to magically change her appearance . Equipment . Dragons of all kinds feared Gauwervyndhal , as she possessed a powerful item known as the Wyrmcrown , that allowed her to poison any dragon related to her , or any dragon whose blood she had tasted . History . Before the Spellplague , in the world of Abeir , Gauwervyndhal founded the Empire of Skelkor .

title: Gavilon Jostins
description: Gavilon Jostins Gavilon Jostins was the ex - adventurer mayor of the city of Elbulder as of 1372 DR . Background . Gavilon Jostins became the mayor soon after Aldorn Thuragar became the ruler of Sespech .
description_long: Gavilon Jostins Gavilon Jostins was the ex - adventurer mayor of the city of Elbulder as of 1372 DR . Background . Gavilon Jostins became the mayor soon after Aldorn Thuragar became the ruler of Sespech . When Chondath an soldier attacked Elbulder with the intention of capturing it , Gavilon dispatched them with " fireball s " and " lightning bolt s " . It was after this amazing display that the citizens of Elbulder came to agree that having wizard s on hand might come in hand now and again .

title: Gavin
description: Gavin Gavin was smith from Cantrev Myrrdale who used to travel selling his wares . He was married to Shareen and had two little girls . Description .
description_long: Gavin Gavin was smith from Cantrev Myrrdale who used to travel selling his wares . He was married to Shareen and had two little girls . Description . Gavin had a booming voice . He was a very large man with a flowing black beard combined with thick , curling hair of the same color . His smile , which made his eyes sparkle , revealed an array of chipped and broken teeth . His garments were heavy and serviceable , albeit worn and grimy . Possessions . Gavin used a great hammer with six feet long haft and a massive head of cold , black iron . History . When coming back from a trip , Gavin found his house flattened and all his family dead after a raid by Grunnarch the Red and his army .

title: Gayar
description: Gayar Gayar was the leader of the dukar Order of Kupavi in Myth Nantar . Personality . A very ancient being Gayar was one of the most soft - spoken individual of the city , surprising people that had had bad meeting with morkoth .
description_long: Gayar Gayar was the leader of the dukar Order of Kupavi in Myth Nantar . Personality . A very ancient being Gayar was one of the most soft - spoken individual of the city , surprising people that had had bad meeting with morkoth . He liked Myth Nantar and all the new energies that grew here ; deeply however Gayar hope to went back to Qatoris one day . History . In alturiak of 1370 DR a xenophobe aquatic elf arrival in Myth Nantar killed Gayar but soon after in penance joined the dukars

title: Gayrlana
description: Gayrlana Gayrlana , also called " Lady Bloodsword " , was a human fighter and rogue , and the leader of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . Description . Gayrlana was a beautiful woman with white hair and dusky skin .
description_long: Gayrlana Gayrlana , also called " Lady Bloodsword " , was a human fighter and rogue , and the leader of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . Description . Gayrlana was a beautiful woman with white hair and dusky skin . Her appearance caused rumors that she was part drow . Personality . When individual members of her company caused problems , Gayrlana went to great efforts to set things right , ensuring the company as a whole remained trustworthy . Abilities . She was amazingly charismatic as well as a tactical genius , so she was able to make full use of the abilities and talents of even her most unusual followers . Gayrlana had some ability in the psionic discipline of telepathy , and her talents included the powers " contact " and " mindlink " . Her telepathy aided her tactical and leadership abilities . She was also a capable fighter , and specialized in the use of the longsword and whipsting . The whipsting was an exotic sword usable as a whip , from the lands south of Unther . Possessions . Gayrlana wielded a longsword or a whipsting in battle .

title: Gazer
description: Gazer Gazers ( also known as eyeballs ) were tiny ( eight - inch wide ) , four - stalked , wild beholderkin . They often served as familiars for evil spellcasters . A gazer was " born " out of a beholder ' s feverish dreams , in which its perception of scale and perspective was warped by its delirium .
description_long: Gazer Gazers ( also known as eyeballs ) were tiny ( eight - inch wide ) , four - stalked , wild beholderkin . They often served as familiars for evil spellcasters . A gazer was " born " out of a beholder ' s feverish dreams , in which its perception of scale and perspective was warped by its delirium . It then followed its creator like an aggressive pet , a fact that beholders considered amusing . Abilities . The four eyestalks of gazers could cause effects similar to the spells " cause fear " , " daze " , " mage hand " , and " ray of frost " . Uses . A gazer ' s eye could be transplanted into a humanoid by a beholder surgeon . The process killed the gazer , in a sense . This was done to turn said creature into an ocular adept , the only divine casters of the Great Mother who weren ' t beholders themselves . Vestiges of the gazer ' s psyche extended some influence on the receiver of this surgery .

title: Geas / Quest
description: Geas / Quest Geas / Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded any subject to undertake a task or suffer possibly fatal pain and sickness . Arcane spellcasters and bards usually called this spell " geas " while divine spellcasters referred to it as " quest " . Effects .
description_long: Geas / Quest Geas / Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded any subject to undertake a task or suffer possibly fatal pain and sickness . Arcane spellcasters and bards usually called this spell " geas " while divine spellcasters referred to it as " quest " . Effects . Like " lesser geas " , this spell could be used to coerce a creature to perform a task or restrain a creature from some course of action . The casting time was 10 minutes ( 24 seconds for the older version ! ) and could not be willfully resisted . The subject had to be alive , conscious , intelligent enough to understand the instructions , and under control of their own mind . The subject could not be ordered to commit suicide , either directly or by actions that led to certain death . The instructions had to be given in a language understood by the subject and have clear conditions to be met for the " geas / quest " to be fulfilled . If the task was left open - ended without an end condition , the spell lasted for one day per experience level of the caster . Otherwise , the spell lasted until the task was complete , regardless of how long it took .

title: Geb
description: Geb Slow to display emotion but appreciative of humor of all varieties , Geb ( pronounced " gheb " ) is the eldest member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known as Gebthant in Thay and Gebakotep in Unther , he is a cautious and even tempered deity . History .
description_long: Geb Slow to display emotion but appreciative of humor of all varieties , Geb ( pronounced " gheb " ) is the eldest member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known as Gebthant in Thay and Gebakotep in Unther , he is a cautious and even tempered deity . History . Geb was the first child of the deities Shu and Tefnut . He wed his sister , Nut , and they had four children . The two were forcibly separated when Geb was ordered to join the Mulhorandi pantheon on Toril . During the First Empire , Geb was considered an Intermediate deity and his church flourished . However , due in part to inaction on the part of his clergy , Geb receives little respect today . Geb led his most faithful followers in building the Golden Forge during the Time of Troubles . This temple serves to prevent the eruption of a volcano that would devastate much of the Unther ' s coastal regions . Relationships . Geb is the father of Isis , Set , Osiris , and Nephthys . Other than in the case of Set , he remains on good terms with all his children . He also counts Flandal Steelskin , Grumbar , and Moradin as friends . Avatar .

title: Gedrin Thalavar
description: Gedrin Thalavar - - Gedrin Thalavar Gedrin Thalavar , sometimes called Shadowbane , was a paladin and the founder of the Eye of Justice , a sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God . History . In 1384 DR , as a child member of the Night Masks , Gedrin had a vision in which the god Helm was slain in a duel with Tyr .
description_long: Gedrin Thalavar - - Gedrin Thalavar Gedrin Thalavar , sometimes called Shadowbane , was a paladin and the founder of the Eye of Justice , a sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God . History . In 1384 DR , as a child member of the Night Masks , Gedrin had a vision in which the god Helm was slain in a duel with Tyr . Helm ' s godhood flowed into Tyr , restoring his sight . When Gedrin awoke from his vision , he held Helm ' s sword , Vindicator . Later , Gedrin dreamed that Tyr was killed by the demon lord Orcus and that Tyr ' s godhood flowed into Torm . After the visions , Gedrin founded the Eye of Justice and recruited his fellow members of the Night Masks to join his church . The Eye of Justice drove the Night Masks from Westgate . The church later became corrupted and Gedrin left Westgate and eventually traveled to Luskan on the Sword Coast by the 1460s DR . He met a young rogue named Kalen Dren begging on the streets and gave him Vindicator , thus recruiting the boy into the Eye of Justice . Possessions . Gedrin wielded Helm ' s own sword , Vindicator until he gave it to Kalen Dren .

title: Geeraugh
description: Geeraugh Geeraugh was a half - ogre bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Geeraugh and his companion Mougra were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid .
description_long: Geeraugh Geeraugh was a half - ogre bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Geeraugh and his companion Mougra were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid . However , the young Pell Mhandyvver saw Mougra and directed some adventurers to the tomb , where they defeated Mougra and Geeraugh .

title: Gehenna
description: Gehenna Gehenna was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between neutral evil and lawful evil . Description . The four layers of Gehenna were infinite planes with gravity at a forty - five degree angle to the ground , making travelers feel as if they were on the side of a mountain with no base or peak .
description_long: Gehenna Gehenna was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between neutral evil and lawful evil . Description . The four layers of Gehenna were infinite planes with gravity at a forty - five degree angle to the ground , making travelers feel as if they were on the side of a mountain with no base or peak . Anyone losing their footing could tumble for miles / kilometers before finding enough purchase on the slope to halt their fall . Nearly all terrain that was not a river of water or lava was slightly slippery to quite slick . All structures were either built onto or carved into the slopes . Heat and light came from the ground , much like Tarterus , but the source was volcanic : lava flows , vents , fumaroles , and mud pots were very common . Earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occurred often , tearing the land apart . On the hotter layers , unprotected flammable items and creatures would catch fire from the glowing ground or superheated gases being ejected . The barriers between layers were always underground , usually in dead end corridors . Khalas .

title: Geildarr Ithym
description: Geildarr Ithym Geildarr Ithym is the Lord Mayor of Llorkh and a member of the Zhentarim . He assumed the title after the Zhents invaded the city and installed him as it ' s new ruler . He commands both the Zhent soldiers that frequent the town and an army of three hundred , purple cloaked , Lord ' s Men that " protects " the city from those who do not appreciate the rule of the Black Network .

The book was held in a tower in Myth Drannor and guarded by a beholder mage until the party of Quenthel Baenre , with the help of Jezz the Lame , retrieved it in 1372 DR for Tzirik of House Jaelre in exchange for more information about the Silence of Lolth .

title: Geirildin Sethomiir
description: Geirildin Sethomiir Geirildin Sethomiir was the coronal of the illythiiri house Sethomiir . He was a dark elf and powerful mage during the time of the Crown Wars . He summoned the balor Wendonai in - 11500 DR to help him against the Aryvandaar i and to help him achieving a leading position among the other dark elven clans .

title: Geiron Hawkwinter
description: Geiron Hawkwinter Lord Geiron Hawkwinter was a Royal Corlann of Faerntarn , the royal palace of Queen Zaranda and King Haedrak III . In this role , he maintained the royal quarters . He was the favorite nephew of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the Countess of Calimmon .
description_long: Geiron Hawkwinter Lord Geiron Hawkwinter was a Royal Corlann of Faerntarn , the royal palace of Queen Zaranda and King Haedrak III . In this role , he maintained the royal quarters . He was the favorite nephew of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the Countess of Calimmon . Personality . Like his aunt Kyrin , Geiron had a strong will , having even snuck away from home to join Prince Haedrak ' s army at only twelve years of age . Activities . In the month of Tarsakh , in 1370 DR , Tethyr sent troops to reinforce Trailstone , which had seceded from Amn the previous month . At only 14 years of age , Geiron was sent along with the troops to serve as a scribe and general aide . Relationships . Geiron was the son of Jornos Hawkwinter , the twin brother of Kyrin Hawkwinter , making Geiron a grandson of Eremoes Hawkwinter of Waterdeep . During the Reclamation Wars , Geiron was tutored by the Lady Perendra Raslemtar , from whom he received high praise . Geiron also sought training in the arcane arts from Gamalon Idogyr , which took some courage on his part , for the lad was afraid of the Court Sage ' s gem eye .

title: Gelatinous cube
description: Gelatinous cube A gelatinous cube was a transparent ooze composed of mindless , gelatinous matter in the shape of a cube . They slid through dungeon corridors , absorbing everything in their path , digesting everything organic and secreting non - digestible matter in their wake . Contact with their exterior could result in a paralyzing electric shock , after which cubes would proceed to slowly digest their stunned and helpless prey .
description_long: Gelatinous cube A gelatinous cube was a transparent ooze composed of mindless , gelatinous matter in the shape of a cube . They slid through dungeon corridors , absorbing everything in their path , digesting everything organic and secreting non - digestible matter in their wake . Contact with their exterior could result in a paralyzing electric shock , after which cubes would proceed to slowly digest their stunned and helpless prey . Lairs . A gelatinous cube was an unusual , mindless predator that laired in ancient crypts and vaults . They roamed the halls of old ruins , scouring the floors and walls of any material in their paths . Organic material was quickly dissolved in the acidic ooze that makes up the body of the cube , while stone and metallic material spend time floating in the body of the creature until eventually expelled . Appearance . The average gelatinous cube measured 10 feet to a side and weighed as much as 15 , 000 pounds . Cubes that fed regularly could grow far larger . It was only the occasional random object floating in a cube ' s body that warned dungeon - delvers of the dangerous presence of a gelatinous cube .

title: Geldenstag ' s Rest
description: Geldenstag ' s Rest Geldenstag ' s Rest was one of the oldest inn s in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located close to Bryn Shander ' s East Gate .
description_long: Geldenstag ' s Rest Geldenstag ' s Rest was one of the oldest inn s in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located close to Bryn Shander ' s East Gate . Interior . Atmosphere . The proprietor , Myrtle , was known to constantly ask her customers about what they were up to each day . Services . The inn ' s accommodations were lackluster , with small rooms and minimal , dirty , furnishing . However , due to Myrtle ' s constant questioning , people who had something to hide often avoided the inn . For that reason , the place was popular among travelers who wished to avoid too much excitement .

title: Geldirth ( lord )
description: Geldirth ( lord ) Lord Geldirth was head of the Geldirth house of Waterdeep , whose main trade was traditionally caravan mustering . Relationships . Geldirth ' s second son and heir was Lord Harthar .
description_long: Geldirth ( lord ) Lord Geldirth was head of the Geldirth house of Waterdeep , whose main trade was traditionally caravan mustering . Relationships . Geldirth ' s second son and heir was Lord Harthar . History . In 1219 DR , Geldirth attempted to increase the family earnings by branching out into direct trading , over and above the existing caravan mustering business .

title: Geldrin Fey
description: Geldrin Fey Geldrin Fey was the weapon master of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . History . At Melee - Magthere , Geldrin was in the same class as Andzrel Baenre .
description_long: Geldrin Fey Geldrin Fey was the weapon master of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . History . At Melee - Magthere , Geldrin was in the same class as Andzrel Baenre . Years later , in 1484 DR , both of them were weapon masters of their respective Houses .

title: Geletha
description: Geletha Geletha was a female frost giant and part of a group of four of her kin who , along with around a hundred orc s , destroyed Clicking Heels in 1370 DR . She was killed by the Companions of the Hall and Tred McKnuckles along with two of her comrades .

title: Gelnur Farland
description: Gelnur Farland Gelnur Farland was a constable of Cormyr . Activities . Gelnur took care of the prisoners of the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate .
description_long: Gelnur Farland Gelnur Farland was a constable of Cormyr . Activities . Gelnur took care of the prisoners of the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate . History . In 1480 DR , Gelnur went to check the body of the dead seneschal Marthin Avathnar and ordered an investigation into the murder . Later , Gelnur asked his subordinate constables Anglur Traelshun and Bradraer Delloak about possible security violations . Some time after Gelnur discovered also the death or disappearance of a squad of War Wizard of Cormyr . Later he met Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave , sent by King Foril Obarskyr I . Quickly later arrived also Nostyn Vandur , claiming to be a special inspector sent by the king to investigate about the death of the seneschal but Gelnur no trusted him . Later Nostyn together with Duth Gulkanun and Imbrult Longclaws tried to stop Gelnur , Lord Delcastle and Amarune ; in the fighting Nostyn was killed but soon Gelnur made an agreement with Gulkanun .

title: Gelroos Hun ' ett
description: Gelroos Hun ' ett Gelroos Hun ' ett , also known Faceless One , was one of the masters at the Sorcere in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Description . When wandering the city , Faceless dressed in a dark cloak to hide his grotesque deformity .
description_long: Gelroos Hun ' ett Gelroos Hun ' ett , also known Faceless One , was one of the masters at the Sorcere in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Description . When wandering the city , Faceless dressed in a dark cloak to hide his grotesque deformity . His once elven features were reduced to a mask of blank white and green goo . Personality . Extremely impatient , the wizard was involved in a magical disaster which melted his face off . History . In 1297 DR , the Faceless One agreed to help House Do ' Urden against House DeVir in hopes of gaining a healing salve from Malice Do ' Urden . Faceless One was slain by his brother and student Masoj Hun ' ett while attempting to to eradicate Alton DeVir with a crossbow .

title: Gelugon
description: Gelugon Gelugons , also called ice devils , were the strategists and masterminds of Hell ' s armies . They made their decisions based on cold , calculated logic , with no thought of the losses of troops . As long as success were possible with their plans , they were willing to sacrifice any number of infernal soldiers .
description_long: Gelugon Gelugons , also called ice devils , were the strategists and masterminds of Hell ' s armies . They made their decisions based on cold , calculated logic , with no thought of the losses of troops . As long as success were possible with their plans , they were willing to sacrifice any number of infernal soldiers . Appearance . Gelugons appeared to be large , insectile devils that stood on bird - like legs . They carried frozen spears that numbed and slowed the bodies of anyone struck by their pointed ends . A gelugon stood twelve feet tall and weighed 700 pounds . In the Realms . A gelugon named Vreesar led an attempt to conquer Toril from a " portal " in the Great Glacier in 1366 DR . He was stopped by a Harper ranger named Martine and a former paladin named Vilheim .

title: Gem dragon
description: Gem dragon Gem dragons were a type of dragon with crystalline scales . They were aloof , solitary , and self - centered . They spent most of their time on the Inner Planes .
description_long: Gem dragon Gem dragons were a type of dragon with crystalline scales . They were aloof , solitary , and self - centered . They spent most of their time on the Inner Planes . Types . Amethyst Dragon . Amethyst dragon s were wise and regal . They could be found serving as intermediaries between warring dragons , and even humanoid civilizations . An amethyst dragon had lavender skin , and its scales were shaped like naturally formed mineral crystals . Crystal Dragon . Crystal dragon s were the friendliest of the gem dragons . They were always curious , so they enthusiastically conversed with willing visitors . Crystal dragons were fond of the Elemental Chaos , but they might sometimes build ice palaces atop high , cold mountain peaks on the Material Plane . Emerald Dragon . Emerald dragon s were inquisitive about local history and customs . Their knowledge of particular areas was often beyond that of the best sage . These dragons were very paranoid and developing relationships with them was often difficult . When not on the Inner Planes , they preferred to stay near partly inhabited areas on the Material Plane , but kept their presence unknown . Sapphire Dragon .

title: Gembomb
description: Gembomb Gembomb is a conjuration spell unique to cleric s with the Gnome and / or Trade domain s . It transforms gems into explosives . Effect .
description_long: Gembomb Gembomb is a conjuration spell unique to cleric s with the Gnome and / or Trade domain s . It transforms gems into explosives . Effect . " Gembomb " converts up to five gems into bombs you ( and only you ) can lob at enemies . You must hold the gems in your hand when casting the spell . Together , the bombs are capable of dealing 1d8 points of force damage per two caster levels ( maximum of 5d8 ) , divided up among the gems as you wish . A 10th - level cleric could create one 5d8 bomb , a 3d8 and 2d8 bomb , five 1d8 bombs , or any combination of five dice of damage and up to five gems . You can toss the bombs up to 100 feet with a range increment of 20 feet . A ranged touch attack roll is required to strike the intended target . A " gembomb " blasts its target with a rainbow - colored shower of magical force . A creature struck by a gembomb can attempt a Reflex save for half damage . Tossing a single " gembomb " counts as an attack for you , so you usually cannot toss a bomb during the turn that you cast the spell . You can only toss one gembomb at a time , but you can toss more than one each round if you have multiple attacks . Material Components .

title: Gemburst
description: Gemburst Gemburst was a powerful alteration and flame spell that was used by skilled members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to literally store a " fireball " within a valuable fire opal .
description_long: Gemburst Gemburst was a powerful alteration and flame spell that was used by skilled members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to literally store a " fireball " within a valuable fire opal . To accomplish this the " gemburst " spell was cast upon the gem followed immediately by casting a " fireball " spell at the gem . The spell would fail if the " fireball " was not fast within one minute of casting " gemburst " . The active gem radiated a faint hint of evocation magic , but appeared to be a normal fire opal . Once triggered , the exploding opal struck all targets within a 20 foot ( 6 m ) radius . Two methods existed for triggering the " gemburst " . The caster could select a command word at the time of the casting that would cause the gem to instantly explode . There was no range limit for this command word to work so long as the caster and gem were on the same plane . The other method involved the gem exploding when a certain set of circumstances was met . These could be as vague or specific as the caster wished .

title: Gemjump
description: Gemjump Gemjump was an arcane alteration or transmutation spell that used a rogue stone as a base for safe teleport ation from anywhere to the location of the gem . Effects . This spell had two parts : attuning oneself to the rogue stone and activating the teleport .
description_long: Gemjump Gemjump was an arcane alteration or transmutation spell that used a rogue stone as a base for safe teleport ation from anywhere to the location of the gem . Effects . This spell had two parts : attuning oneself to the rogue stone and activating the teleport . This spell was cast into a rogue stone and thereafter the caster was inextricably tied to the stone . The bond was strong enough to survive " shapechange " , death and reincarnation or resurrection , or even lichdom , as long as the caster ' s memory and intellect remained intact . At some future time , the caster could activate the " gemjump " and be instantly teleported to the location of the rogue stone , similar to " teleport without error " . This was a one - use , one - way trip that could not be reversed . This spell evolved over time , having different ranges and restrictions due to shifting the general purpose of " gemjump " from the ultimate escape for a caster to a transportation spell . The earliest versions had infinite range across all the planes of existence and teleported only the caster and his or her normal clothing .

title: Gen
description: Gen Gen were small elemental genie s who often served as special familiar s to sha ' ir s in Zakhara . All sha ’ irs needed them to work their magic . As powerful as an individual sha ' ir may be , they were utterly helpless without their loyal gen .
description_long: Gen Gen were small elemental genie s who often served as special familiar s to sha ' ir s in Zakhara . All sha ’ irs needed them to work their magic . As powerful as an individual sha ' ir may be , they were utterly helpless without their loyal gen . Most sha ' irs would even chose to aid their gen over a friend or comrade in arms . Some sha ' irs even believed that gen were the children of genies . Other sha ' irs were convinced that gen were extensions of the sha ' ir ' s " hama " , or spirit . Not surprisingly , when asked about the true nature of gen , the various genie races would not speak of the matter . Various kinds of gen existed including : wind gen ( djinnling s ) , sand gen ( daolani ) , sea gen ( maridan s ) , and flame gen ( efreetikin ) . The names air gen , earth gen , water gen and fire gen were also used , respectively . Appearance . The size of a gen varied greatly depending on which plane their were on . Gen on their native elemental plane were slightly smaller than an average human . In stark contrast , gen visiting the opposing elemental plane of their inherent element shrunk to a fraction of their regular size , often standing only several inches tall .

title: Genasi
description: Genasi Genasi were human - derived planetouched infused with the power of the Elemental Chaos , most often as the result of crossbreeding between humans and the powerful genie races or other elementals that dwell in such planes . Physically powerful and cunning , genasi were a varied race with abilities that varied depending on their lineage and individual experience . Ecology .
description_long: Genasi Genasi were human - derived planetouched infused with the power of the Elemental Chaos , most often as the result of crossbreeding between humans and the powerful genie races or other elementals that dwell in such planes . Physically powerful and cunning , genasi were a varied race with abilities that varied depending on their lineage and individual experience . Ecology . Physical characteristics . Genasi were physically similar to humans in many ways , standing between 5 ' 7 " and 6 ' 2 " on average , just slightly taller than the average human . Weighing between 130 and 225 lbs on average , genasi were often also a fair bit heavier , though not significantly so . In all other ways , genasi were very distinctive from their human cousins . Genasi were in a constant state of elemental energy , having no “ neutral ” state they could fall back on . Each genasi had a native elemental state , known as a “ manifestation , ” which was passed down to them through their ancestry . A few learned to master more than one manifestation . Unlike many planetouched races , genasi generally took pride in their unusual features .

title: Genbudo
description: Genbudo Genbudo was one of the most powerful wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Genbudo was a very troubling wu jen residing in Chimotoge .
description_long: Genbudo Genbudo was one of the most powerful wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Genbudo was a very troubling wu jen residing in Chimotoge . Many nobles and samurai sought his talents from his house near the city . However , he received all visitors concealed by a screen , so nobody had seen his face since he arrived in Chimotoge around 1293 DR . Rumors & Legends . Rumors said that Genbudo was in truth the infamous Goboro the Lame , who disappeared during the 12th century DR in a magic duel .

title: General Tiger
description: General Tiger General Tiger was a high - ranking member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . History . General Tiger was a member of the Animal Kings ' Court , of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy , overseeing the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: General Tiger General Tiger was a high - ranking member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . History . General Tiger was a member of the Animal Kings ' Court , of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy , overseeing the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula . In 1358 DR , he was summoned by the kirin officer Chanii in order to expel Osari Minhiro and an adventuring party he had hired from Qui . He easily sent them into unconsciousness but insulted Chanii for asking his help .

title: Generic City Guard private ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Guard private ( Waterdeep ) A Guardsman or Guardswoman was a junior member of the City Guard of Waterdeep , serving as a private . One was also called a " Trusty " . Activities .
description_long: Generic City Guard private ( Waterdeep ) A Guardsman or Guardswoman was a junior member of the City Guard of Waterdeep , serving as a private . One was also called a " Trusty " . Activities . They typically patrolled the environs of Waterdeep in groups of twelve , with ten privates , one sergeant , and one captain or lieutenant . Possessions . " Circa " 1357 DR , privates of the City Guard typically wore yellow scale armor under green cloaks and and carried a shield . Both tabard and shield bore the symbol of Waterdeep , a crescent moon reflected over a bay , surrounded by seven stars . They wielded longsword s , dagger s , and dart s coated with a paralytic poison . On missions outside , they were also armed with bow s . " Circa " 1372 DR , Guardsmen and women wore a uniform of polished chainmail covered with a tabard in black cloth with gold trim . They carried a steel heavy shield , and carried a masterwork longsword and club , together with a composite shortbow and 20 arrows . However , depending on their posting , they could also have shortspear s , short sword s , and dagger s . They also possessed two " potion s of cure light wounds " and an " oil of magic weapon " .

Regular soldiers of the Guard were outfitted in blue oiled plate mail armor emblazoned with the coat of arms of Tantras : three silver stars over a silver breaking wave on a field of royal blue , called the " blue and silver " .

When multiple units were involved , they took orders from officers .

title: Generic shadow guard
description: Generic shadow guard A shadow guard was one of the temple guards hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Corrupted by the false priests , they had been transformed into dark creature s . Induction .
description_long: Generic shadow guard A shadow guard was one of the temple guards hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Corrupted by the false priests , they had been transformed into dark creature s . Induction . Temple guards who proved obedient , unquestioning , and uncurious were promoted to duties deeper in the temple . Those who were especially obedient and pious underwent the so - called Mystra ' s Sacred Trust themselves and passed through the Shadow Gate . Those who survived having their flesh subsumed by shadow received a " shadow mantle " , and some , whether through multiple crossings or continued close association with the Sharrans , became wholly dark creatures — the shadow guards . Description . As dark creature s , the shadow guards appeared colorless and beshadowed , causing torches near them to dim . Personality . A diary recovered from a guardroom in the temple detailed how one particular shadow guard ' s personality changed .
