After passing through the so - called Mystic Gate , and surviving , yet having no spiritual encounter with Mystra , she felt disappointed and lacking , a failure .

title: Generic temple guard
description: Generic temple guard A temple guard was one of those hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . The temple guards patrolled the walls around the temple and stood watch in the outer courtyard and middle temple areas .
description_long: Generic temple guard A temple guard was one of those hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . The temple guards patrolled the walls around the temple and stood watch in the outer courtyard and middle temple areas . Some were also responsible for feeding and managing petitioners undergoing the Mystra ' s Sacred Trust rite and for maintaining the middle temple . Told to ignore strange noises , they remained oblivious to the true activities of the inner temple . The guards bunked in a guard post located just outside the temple , where they spent their off - hours drinking and gambling . Personality . Some temple guards appeared to have been recruited from the Wheloon Jail , those who chose to repent and perform holy service in exchange for their sentences being commuted . Most trusted to the priests , and some were pious followers of Mystra , ready to risk their lives for the temple . Guards who proved especially obedient , unquestioning , and uncurious were promoted to duties deeper in the temple .

title: Genie
description: Genie Genies were outsider s native to the elemental planes . Genie magic . Genies had a number of inherent magical abilities , but a few among them also trained to gain spellcasting abilities of a sorcerer of its specific element .
description_long: Genie Genies were outsider s native to the elemental planes . Genie magic . Genies had a number of inherent magical abilities , but a few among them also trained to gain spellcasting abilities of a sorcerer of its specific element . They created peculiar magic items and employed a number of , sometimes in the service of a genie - binding sha ' ir . There existed also a path of power for the dao , djinn , efreet and marid , each , which were considered lost paths , i . e . generally unknown to other races . Bound Genies . Genies were sometimes bound to magic item s and forced to serve others . Examples of these items included a " ring of genie summoning " , a " lamp of genie summoning " , and an " astrolabe of entrapment " . All genies resented this kind of enslavement . It was possible to free a genie trapped by this kind of servitude by either destroying the device binding them , or using a " wish " to free the genie . Genies freed from this imprisonment were almost always incredibly grateful to whoever freed them , though they typically did not hang around for long once freed .

title: Genie ' s Turban
description: Genie ' s Turban The Genie ' s Turban was a group of islands off the coast from Muluk in Zakhara . Description . The " turban " of this group of islands comprised two large islands called the Island of Firethorns and the Island of Gardens , or " al - Hada ' iq " .
description_long: Genie ' s Turban The Genie ' s Turban was a group of islands off the coast from Muluk in Zakhara . Description . The " turban " of this group of islands comprised two large islands called the Island of Firethorns and the Island of Gardens , or " al - Hada ' iq " . The " genie ' s face " consisted of three smaller islands on the eastern side of Chaos Bay called The Eyes ( " al - Oyun " ) and The Nose ( " al - Anf " ) of the Marid . Local corsair lore referred to the smaller islets near the Eyes as " the Beauty Marks " . Island of the Firethorns . This island was so named for the abundance of firethorn , or " sea rose " plants that covered the land . Only two settlements were found on the island — a small fishing village called Safe Cove , and the city of Hawa . Island of the Gardens . The Island of Gardens was falsely named in a manner of speaking . Blocked from view by the sea , the arid interior of this island was surrounded by lush , beautiful vegetation . This islands ' villages were located near the coast or along the eastern area of forested elevation called the Comb . Inhabitants . The area of the Genie ' s Turban was entirely peopled with corsairs .

title: Genie contract
description: Genie contract Genie contract was a spell used by genie s to seal a contract that was magically binding to the two parties involved . Both sides had to agree willingly to the terms , and a punishment was defined for anyone transgressing them . Genies employed this spell to all kinds of formal agreements between them and mortals , or between two mortals with the genie as a witness .
description_long: Genie contract Genie contract was a spell used by genie s to seal a contract that was magically binding to the two parties involved . Both sides had to agree willingly to the terms , and a punishment was defined for anyone transgressing them . Genies employed this spell to all kinds of formal agreements between them and mortals , or between two mortals with the genie as a witness . Components . This spell required only verbal components .

title: Genie prison
description: Genie prison Genie prisons were items that could be crafted and used by skilled sha ' ir s to entrap genie s . Uses . These special cells were designed to ensnare a genie against its will .
description_long: Genie prison Genie prisons were items that could be crafted and used by skilled sha ' ir s to entrap genie s . Uses . These special cells were designed to ensnare a genie against its will . The genie would be forced to do the sha ' ir ' s bidding , with freedom being its reward for services rendered . Sha ' irs often used a genie trapped in this manner to force them to do things that they would not normally do , such as grant " wish es " . Genie prisons could also be used simply to imprison a genie who was otherwise interfering with the sha ' ir ' s plans . The genie prison needed to be completely constructed before an attempt was made to trap a genie . Genie prisons could be made from any material , but some kind of metal was often selected for its durability . If a genie prison was physically destroyed , then all of its magic was released , along with an irate genie . Common genie prisons included rings , lamps , bottles , gems , and vials . Once the genie prison was successfully constructed and imbued with magic , the sha ' ir had exactly ten days to capture a genie before the magic from the prison expired .

title: Genie slayer sword
description: Genie slayer sword Genie slayer swords were magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that specialized in harming genie s . Description . Though most commonly found as scimitar s , any type of sword could be enchanted with " genie slaying " properties .
description_long: Genie slayer sword Genie slayer swords were magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that specialized in harming genie s . Description . Though most commonly found as scimitar s , any type of sword could be enchanted with " genie slaying " properties . Powers . " Genie slayer swords " made it much easier for the wielder to strike and harm any opponent . When facing any form of genie this power was amplified even further . Additionally , each " genie slayer sword " was enchanted to cause even more harm to a specific type of genie .

title: Genie wish
description: Genie wish A genie wish was , in many ways , the same as the powerful " wish " spell . The notable difference between the two wishes was that genie s often interpreted the words of the person making the wish into creative , and often dangerous , results . Rules Governing Genie Wishes .
description_long: Genie wish A genie wish was , in many ways , the same as the powerful " wish " spell . The notable difference between the two wishes was that genie s often interpreted the words of the person making the wish into creative , and often dangerous , results . Rules Governing Genie Wishes . Genie wishes could only affect the present . They could not change the past but could change the direct results of something that already occurred . Resurrecting a comrade who perished during a battle was an example of this . Similarly , genie wishes could not determine a future event , though they could certainly influence it . Someone could not ask a genie to make them the victor in an upcoming battle , but they could ask the genie for things or even information that would make the battle much easier to win . A genie could not grant anything abstract such as titles , claims , rank , or authority . A genie wish could be used to make someone appear to have a certain title , but this ruse could become unraveled if other people in power closely examined the situation . The true feelings of a sentient creature could not be altered with a genie wish .

title: Genies ' Anvil
description: Genies ' Anvil The Genies ' Anvil was a barren stretch of land in the High Desert of Zakhara laying between the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams and the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue . Geography / Ecology . Many dangerous obstacles threatened would - be travelers in this land .
description_long: Genies ' Anvil The Genies ' Anvil was a barren stretch of land in the High Desert of Zakhara laying between the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams and the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue . Geography / Ecology . Many dangerous obstacles threatened would - be travelers in this land . Vicious dust storms could blind riders so they could not even see the ears of their camels . Rain rarely fell , and sources of water were practically non - existent . Scorching daytime temperatures could be followed by freezing nights . Inhabitants . Aside from its nasty weather , the Genies ' Anvil was also home to the House of Sihr , a tribe of enlightened jann . Amir Bouladin al - Mutajalli , their leader , had a reputation for ruthlessness .

title: Genies ' Caravan
description: Genies ' Caravan The Genies ' Caravan was a small road found within the High Desert of West Zakhara . Description . The road connected the heart of the Genies ' Anvil with the Aman Oasis near the Spine of the Dog .
description_long: Genies ' Caravan The Genies ' Caravan was a small road found within the High Desert of West Zakhara . Description . The road connected the heart of the Genies ' Anvil with the Aman Oasis near the Spine of the Dog . The route was used to trade with the Jann of the High Desert .

title: Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon
description: Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon The Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon was a flying ghostly , sentient apparition which first appeared in Silverymoon around 1459 DR . The identity of the ghost in life was unknown but many wild theories abounded . The ghost occasionally swooped down and passed through observers who often collapsed but were unharmed other than reporting an intense chill .
description_long: Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon The Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon was a flying ghostly , sentient apparition which first appeared in Silverymoon around 1459 DR . The identity of the ghost in life was unknown but many wild theories abounded . The ghost occasionally swooped down and passed through observers who often collapsed but were unharmed other than reporting an intense chill . Those touched by the ghost received a vision of a location , sometimes one within the city walls . A few of the locations were explored by her " victims " and found to contain treasure caches . Description . The Gentle Ghost appeared as an eladrin woman , bluish - white in color . She wore a cloak and robes and was more solid looking from the waist up . She always floated several feet above the ground .

title: Genzo Taira
description: Genzo Taira Genzo Taira was a samurai adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Genzo was a natural leader , instinctively taking charge of any situation , even despite protests from his companions .
description_long: Genzo Taira Genzo Taira was a samurai adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Genzo was a natural leader , instinctively taking charge of any situation , even despite protests from his companions . He preferred quick action to long planning , and had issues fighting alongside women . He adhered strictly to the bushido code . Nobody could contest his honor , courage , and obedience . Relationship . Genzo was deeply loyal to his daimyo Sugawara . History . Born in Kozakura , Genzo was the youngest man to earn a command from his daimyo , General Takenaka Sugawara . In 1358 DR , Genzo led an attack against the castle of Takenaka Okawa , a rival of his master Sugawara , in Iwari Province . The castle was burned to the ground . In order to save him from ninja sent by Ogawa , Sugawara commanded him to travel to Shou Lung . While in Shou Lung Genzo decided to attend the Komite . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Genzo Taira was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Shou Lung .

title: Geoffrey
description: Geoffrey Geoffrey was a brewer in Caer Corwell . Description . Geoffrey was a huge fat man .
description_long: Geoffrey Geoffrey was a brewer in Caer Corwell . Description . Geoffrey was a huge fat man . Personality . Being an accomplished aleman , Geoffrey sold light and dark , but his Callidyrr mead was prized by his patrons . History . In 1345 DR , the guard Erian entered his tent during the Festival of the Spring Equinox and met Kazgoroth disguised as the peasant , " Meridith " .

title: Georg Redfell
description: Georg Redfell Georg Redfell was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Georg was the mayor of West Harbor and the leader of its militia .
description_long: Georg Redfell Georg Redfell was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Georg was the mayor of West Harbor and the leader of its militia . He watched over the village and hosted its festival , the Harvest Fair . History . When duergar and bladeling s attacked the village in 1374 DR , he defended it and bade farewell to the Kalach - Cha , one of West Harbor ' s inhabitants , who went to Neverwinter . Unfortunately , Georg was slain , along with the rest of the villagers , by Ammon Jerro and his demon s .

title: George MacDonald
description: George MacDonald George MacDonald is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . Career . MacDonald began designing role - playing games while in college .
description_long: George MacDonald George MacDonald is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . Career . MacDonald began designing role - playing games while in college . In 1981 , MacDonald founded . In the late 1980s , MacDonald worked both on Forgotten Realms video games ( Pool of Radiance ) and sourcebooks ( " Curse of the Azure Bonds " ) .

title: Gera
description: Gera Gera was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Gera was first found in Weeping Willow Inn , where asked of Kalach - Cha to rescue her husband , Zachan .
description_long: Gera Gera was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Gera was first found in Weeping Willow Inn , where asked of Kalach - Cha to rescue her husband , Zachan . Once Zachan is rescued , both of them head for Highcliff . The second time Gera is found is in Highcliff , where she and her huband worry about their sons , Alex and Andrew . If the boys were saved from wolves at Highcliff Castle , Zachan admits he told his sons stories to give them more confidence . Nevertheless , he and his wife would reward the Kalach - Cha . The last time Gera is found is on the way to Highcliff once the King of Shadows made his attack . Zachan and Gera would thank the Kalach - Cha and explain what is going on in Highcliff . They were never seen again .

title: Gerak
description: Gerak Gerak was a hunter in Sembia . History . Gerak lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia with his wife Elle .
description_long: Gerak Gerak was a hunter in Sembia . History . Gerak lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia with his wife Elle . He was conscripted into some of the Shadovar ' s wars against Cormyr but always went back . In 1484 DR , Elle announced to Gerak that she had finally become pregnant . Therefore he decided to go to hunt for his growing family . When he went back Gerak found all Fairelm ' s inhabitants slaughtered and Elle with a curse upon her . It was the works of Sayeed and Zeeahd . Later arrived to help Vasen Cale and his squad and Orsin . After witnessing the corruption and the death of Elle Gerak decide to join Vasen ' s party hoping to have vengeance .

title: Gerald Brom
description: Gerald Brom Gerald Brom ( born March 9 1965 in Albany , Georgia ) is a gothic fantasy artist and illustrator . He spent much of his early years on the move , living in many countries such as Japan and Germany . Among others , he has contributed illustrations for the War of the Spider Queen series and reprints of The Avatar Series , and was a key illustrator of the Dark Sun campaign setting .
description_long: Gerald Brom Gerald Brom ( born March 9 1965 in Albany , Georgia ) is a gothic fantasy artist and illustrator . He spent much of his early years on the move , living in many countries such as Japan and Germany . Among others , he has contributed illustrations for the War of the Spider Queen series and reprints of The Avatar Series , and was a key illustrator of the Dark Sun campaign setting .

title: Geran Hulmaster
description: Geran Hulmaster Geran Hulmaster is a powerful human swordmage who was born into the ruling family of Hulburg on the coast of the Moonsea . Geran was formerly a member of the adventuring group The Company of the Dragon Shield . After retiring from adventuring , Geran partnered with a Ghostwise halfling named Hamil to form the Red Sail trading coster in Tantras .
description_long: Geran Hulmaster Geran Hulmaster is a powerful human swordmage who was born into the ruling family of Hulburg on the coast of the Moonsea . Geran was formerly a member of the adventuring group The Company of the Dragon Shield . After retiring from adventuring , Geran partnered with a Ghostwise halfling named Hamil to form the Red Sail trading coster in Tantras . Geran left his position with the Red Sail coster to study sword magic in Myth Drannor under the tutelage of the Gold Elven swordmaster Daried Selsherryn . He was banished permanently from Myth Drannor in 1477 DR for maiming an Elven wizard named Rhovann in a duel over the affections of a moon elf maiden . When Rhovann seized power in Hulburg , Geran was exiled to Thentia with the rest of the Hulmaster clan . Geran engaged in several clandestine missions to destabilize Rhovann ' s rule and was captured by Rhovann while attempting to infiltrate Hulburg . As retribution for his maiming at Geran ' s hand , Rhovann disolved Geran ' s right hand with magical acid .

title: Geremis Dyrr
description: Geremis Dyrr Geremis Dyrr was an old member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Geremis graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time and became an apprentice of the Lichdrow Dyrr .
description_long: Geremis Dyrr Geremis Dyrr was an old member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Geremis graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time and became an apprentice of the Lichdrow Dyrr . During the siege of Dyrr ' s compound for their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Geremis , bald and aging , was called back to his house together with all of Dyrr ' s other wizards to help raise magical defenses .

title: Gerrin I Wyvernspur
description: Gerrin I Wyvernspur Lord Gerrin I Wyvernspur was a member of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Background . Gerrin fought against the red dragon s in the attack on Suzail in 1018 DR , and subsequently pursued Thauglor , who badly burned him , although Thauglor was defeated .
description_long: Gerrin I Wyvernspur Lord Gerrin I Wyvernspur was a member of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Background . Gerrin fought against the red dragon s in the attack on Suzail in 1018 DR , and subsequently pursued Thauglor , who badly burned him , although Thauglor was defeated .

title: Gerti Orelsdottr
description: Gerti Orelsdottr Gerti Orelsdottr was a female frost giant who lived in an ice and rock cavern in the Spine of the World called Shining White . History . She was the sole daughter and heir to Jarl Orel , the frost giant patriarch who united the various families and clans around the Spine of the World to form a unified frost giant populace .
description_long: Gerti Orelsdottr Gerti Orelsdottr was a female frost giant who lived in an ice and rock cavern in the Spine of the World called Shining White . History . She was the sole daughter and heir to Jarl Orel , the frost giant patriarch who united the various families and clans around the Spine of the World to form a unified frost giant populace . With her father on his death bed and no more than a figurehead , Gerti was most likely candidate to assume power as jarl over the frost giants once Jarl Orel died . Physical description . Gerti was over twelve feet ( 3 . 7m ) tall and had blue skin . She was attractive , with dark blue eyes and long golden hair . She had a muscular build and wore a silver wolf fur cloak and boots with a brown leather dress . Her boots were rumoured to be magical and quickened her strides .

title: Gervor
description: Gervor Gervor was an adventurer prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Gervor and his adventuring party were exploring the Sumber Hills when they were attacked by Black Earth cultists .
description_long: Gervor Gervor was an adventurer prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Gervor and his adventuring party were exploring the Sumber Hills when they were attacked by Black Earth cultists . Only Gervor survived , despite being greatly injured . He was put in the Temple of the Black Earth ' s jail until some other adventurers defeated the jailer cultists and freed him .

title: Gestal
description: Gestal Gestal , also known as Lord Divergence , is a demon thrall , or priest , of the demon lord Demogorgon . As the lord of Divergence , he is the first servant of the Prince of Demons and is the self - proclaimed ruler of the area of the Underdark known as the Depths of Madness . Personality .
description_long: Gestal Gestal , also known as Lord Divergence , is a demon thrall , or priest , of the demon lord Demogorgon . As the lord of Divergence , he is the first servant of the Prince of Demons and is the self - proclaimed ruler of the area of the Underdark known as the Depths of Madness . Personality . Gestal appears to have . His other known personality is an innocent young man who calls himself Liet Sagrin , who is unaware of Gestal ’ s existence , though Gestal knows of his . Gestal claims his own personality is the original personality , and he uses this to his advantage , for he is aware of all of Liet ’ s memories and uses Liet as a lure to find a suitable female companion to rule the Depths by his side . Gestal has rather perverse tastes , using candles of human fat and kneeling on blankets of skin when he prays to Demogorgon — demanding power from the demon prince rather than begging , since Demogorgon would give nothing to the weak . His private chamber is filled with a horrid reek , and adorning the walls are murals painted in blood , excrement , offal , and other foul substances depicting human and snakelike figures engaging obscene and depraved activities . Liet Sagrin .

title: Gestaniius
description: Gestaniius Gestaniius was a blue dragon and one of Tiamat ' s chosen . History . He was invested with a third of Tiamat ' s divine power during the Time of Troubles but was devoured , along with Skuthosiin by the bearer of another third , Tchazzar .
description_long: Gestaniius Gestaniius was a blue dragon and one of Tiamat ' s chosen . History . He was invested with a third of Tiamat ' s divine power during the Time of Troubles but was devoured , along with Skuthosiin by the bearer of another third , Tchazzar . During the Dracorage , he was resurrected by Tiamat and sent to the Dragonsword Mountains to create an army for Tchazzar , who was now his ally . In 1479 DR , Gestaniius was attacking High Imaskar and at the same time was involved in the dragon game of Xorvintaal , allied with the mercury dragon Praxasalandos . His attack was repelled by the Brotherhood of the Griffon and he was killed by the paladin Medrash .

title: Gethmedra Darmov
description: Gethmedra Darmov Gethmedra Darmov was a crime lord in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Her arena made Gethmedra popular among the city ' s elite , but she knew that , for her poor birth , she would never move among them .
description_long: Gethmedra Darmov Gethmedra Darmov was a crime lord in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Her arena made Gethmedra popular among the city ' s elite , but she knew that , for her poor birth , she would never move among them . Gethmedra liked to display her power and cruelty , by showing to her guests the head of her last enemy . Activities . Gethmedra was a crime lord in the city . Using the Black Blade and Bloody Boar tavern as cover , she ran a gladiator arena . History . In 1491 DR , an adventuring party approached her in order to question one of her gladiators , Bhùn Ludwakazar the Stone Dwarf , about troubles in a nearby mine .

title: Gethshemeth
description: Gethshemeth Gethshemeth was an ancient Kraken . Description . Gethshemeth was roughly one hundred feet in length , a massive and ancient kraken with a dun - colored hide and large red eyes .
description_long: Gethshemeth Gethshemeth was an ancient Kraken . Description . Gethshemeth was roughly one hundred feet in length , a massive and ancient kraken with a dun - colored hide and large red eyes . Her presence was accompanied by the scent of a thousand rotting fish . After an encounter with the Shou monk Raidon Kane , she was left three tentacles short , having had them severed by the monk . History . Gethshemeth was an ally to the morkoth Arcanum of Olleth . In 1396 DR , she was summoned to Olleth by Nogah and took possession of the Dreamheart .

title: Getsu
description: Getsu Getsu was an unusually intelligent tigbanua buso in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Somehow , a tigbanua buso gained intelligence and named himself Getsu , plotting to destroy the city of Nakamaru .
description_long: Getsu Getsu was an unusually intelligent tigbanua buso in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Somehow , a tigbanua buso gained intelligence and named himself Getsu , plotting to destroy the city of Nakamaru . He planned to infect many humans with his claws transforming them into tagamaling buso , and they would spread the infection further until the tagamaling buso became too numerous to be stopped . History . Getsu was a very ancient creature , a first a servant to humans but at one point he became foul and perverted . In 1357 DR , it decided to target the Worthless Flower yakuza gang to spread his infection . He would start by infecting the oyabun Uruma . Personality . Gestu liked to toy with and torture his victims . He was crueler than most of his fellows .

title: Ghaark Ironseth
description: Ghaark Ironseth Lord Ghaark Ironseth was a human of Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , where he led the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Personality . Lord Ironseth was known as a noisy and insensitive man .
description_long: Ghaark Ironseth Lord Ghaark Ironseth was a human of Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , where he led the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Personality . Lord Ironseth was known as a noisy and insensitive man . Relationships . Ghaark ' s third son was the blacksmith Togar Ironseth .

title: Ghaele
description: Ghaele The ghaeles are a type of noble eladrin who are the embodiment of winter . As such , they are native to the Feywild , but many also live in the celestial planes such as Arvandor and Celestia , where they are the knights - errant of the celestials . They are powerful warriors that delight in the hunting and slaying of evil in all its forms , especially fiend s , dragon s , and undead .
description_long: Ghaele The ghaeles are a type of noble eladrin who are the embodiment of winter . As such , they are native to the Feywild , but many also live in the celestial planes such as Arvandor and Celestia , where they are the knights - errant of the celestials . They are powerful warriors that delight in the hunting and slaying of evil in all its forms , especially fiend s , dragon s , and undead . They are quick to make friends and lovers , but equally quick in the slaying of an enemy . A ghaele appears to be a fey - like humanoid of idealized physical proportions , often clad in shining armor and wielding weapons of great magical power . They can change their forms to appear as a shimmering form of light .

title: Ghaelya
description: Ghaelya Ghaelya is a watersoul genasi from Airspur . She was born into a wealthy family and had a twin sister . Unlike the other members of her family who manifested fire , she manifested the element of water .
description_long: Ghaelya Ghaelya is a watersoul genasi from Airspur . She was born into a wealthy family and had a twin sister . Unlike the other members of her family who manifested fire , she manifested the element of water . In 1479 DR , Ghaelya ' s sister , Tessaeril , became involved with a cult known as The Choir . The cult later kidnapped Tessaeril and took her to their shrine in Tohrepur . Ghaelya hired a half - elf named Brindani to guide her to Tohrepur and he enlisted the help of an old mercenary friend named Uthalion and his companion Vaasurri who lived in the Spur Forest . The four travelled to Tohrepur where they slew Lord Kahult , the leader of The Choir . Unfortunately , Tessaeril had been transformed into an aberration by a Spellplague changed sirine and Ghaelya was forced to kill her sister to end her suffering .

title: Ghald
description: Ghald Ghald was a four - armed sahuagin and a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghald and his partner Unferth were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination .
description_long: Ghald Ghald was a four - armed sahuagin and a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghald and his partner Unferth were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination . He usually did not emerge from his hiding place beneath the docks unless it was dark and rainy . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " . They went back to Yartar with the orb , but just after they put it in the city ' s vaults , Naaren Dhest stole it . After examining it , the Hands of Yartar decided to sell it in an auction at the Wink and Kiss tavern . Hearing this news , Ghald and Unferth decided that the Society needed the orb , so they formed a partnership with Haliyra Ravenfast to obtain it . Ghald , Unferth , and some minions waited in a tomb near the tavern but the intervention of some adventurers ruined their plan and Ghald and Unferth were defeated .

title: Ghaliver Longstocking
description: Ghaliver Longstocking Ghaliver Longstocking was the ruler of Westbridge in 1370 DR . Activities . Ghaliver was a very able businessman : he possessed a farmer ' s market , a stockyard , a walled grain warehouse complex and an inn in Westbridge , and a few houses in Waterdeep .
description_long: Ghaliver Longstocking Ghaliver Longstocking was the ruler of Westbridge in 1370 DR . Activities . Ghaliver was a very able businessman : he possessed a farmer ' s market , a stockyard , a walled grain warehouse complex and an inn in Westbridge , and a few houses in Waterdeep . His current goal was find a mean to protect himself in the years ahead . Personality . Ghaliver was a charming individual , with always a dozen schemes t work . He was a good judge of folk . His dream was to rule the North but knew that for now he had attired only the attentions of the Zhentarim and similar groups .

title: Ghaliyah
description: Ghaliyah Ghaliyah was a nereid living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Enslaved by the Cult of Istishia , Ghaliyah was forced to guard the entrance to the cult ' s lair in Hawa .
description_long: Ghaliyah Ghaliyah was a nereid living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Enslaved by the Cult of Istishia , Ghaliyah was forced to guard the entrance to the cult ' s lair in Hawa . Relationships . Ghaliyah was accompanied by Jsss , a baby sea wyrm .

title: Ghallar Knoll
description: Ghallar Knoll Ghallar Knoll was a small hill said to contain red - colored grass with magical properties . Description . Ghallar Knoll supposedly was found in the western Small Teeth mountains .
description_long: Ghallar Knoll Ghallar Knoll was a small hill said to contain red - colored grass with magical properties . Description . Ghallar Knoll supposedly was found in the western Small Teeth mountains . It was said to be a short , perfectly rounded hill . The hill was covered with brilliant red blades of grass . Inhabitants . A mysterious creature known only as " the Ghallar " protected the Knoll from intrusion , but few had ever actually seen the being to be able to describe it . Rumors . Local legends stated that if one were to eat two blades of the scarlet - colored grass , he or she would be cured of all poisons and would grow ten years younger .

title: Ghalvin Dragonmoor
description: Ghalvin Dragonmoor Ghalvik Dragonmoor was a half - elf member of the Emerald Enclave in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Ghalvik was captured by the minions of Chief Guh and taken to Grudd Haug .
description_long: Ghalvin Dragonmoor Ghalvik Dragonmoor was a half - elf member of the Emerald Enclave in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Ghalvik was captured by the minions of Chief Guh and taken to Grudd Haug . He wanted to return to Goldenfields to report the situation to the abbot , Ellardin Darovik .

title: Ghalyi Shan
description: Ghalyi Shan Ghalyi Shan was the easternmost mountain within the A - Ling Shan range in the Hordelands . Geography . This impressive mountain was part of the A - Ling Shan range .
description_long: Ghalyi Shan Ghalyi Shan was the easternmost mountain within the A - Ling Shan range in the Hordelands . Geography . This impressive mountain was part of the A - Ling Shan range . It formed the eastern border of Yarlhang La . Description . Ghalyi Shan towered over all other nearby mountains standing 19 , 000 ft . ( 5790m ) high . Inhabitants . Ghalyi Shan was inhabited by a me - zu oni named Gyawa Zangpo , sentenced to live at the small hermitage at the mountain until he humbly carried 10 , 000 travelers to the top of the pass .

title: Ghardumn Greenaxe
description: Ghardumn Greenaxe Ghardumn Greenaxe was a swordsman from Cormyr . Relationships . Ghardumn was the captain of the adventuring company known as the Dragonclaw Clan .
description_long: Ghardumn Greenaxe Ghardumn Greenaxe was a swordsman from Cormyr . Relationships . Ghardumn was the captain of the adventuring company known as the Dragonclaw Clan . Possessions . The warrior wore a mighty five - headed hydra helm . History . By Eleint , 1281 DR , Ghardumn was last seen entering the Marsh of Tun in Cormyr and had not returned . His hydra helm was left on display in the Temple of Tempus in Easthaven .

title: Gharnell
description: Gharnell Gharnell was a bard and adventurer in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went with his party into Undermountain .
description_long: Gharnell Gharnell was a bard and adventurer in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went with his party into Undermountain . However , his companions were slaughtered by the goblin and kobold followers of the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr . Gharnell was spared only for his knowledge of the Goblin and Draconic language s . Zarr ordered him to teach Common to the dimmer and most hostile of his supporters .

title: Gharreil
description: Gharreil Gharreil was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The ruins of Gharreil were located under the Great Glacier , in the region of Alpuk , near the Lugsaas Chain and the border of Vaasa , about 100 miles from Castle Perilous .
description_long: Gharreil Gharreil was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The ruins of Gharreil were located under the Great Glacier , in the region of Alpuk , near the Lugsaas Chain and the border of Vaasa , about 100 miles from Castle Perilous . The ruins were protected by a magical dome of force that surrounded the city and kept it from being crushed under the epic grinding forces of the Great Glacier . A one - way portal from the ruins of Choshein within a cavern in the High Ice led to a crevasse outside the dome that surrounded the ruins of Gharreil . The crevasse was so deep that it was almost perpetually in shadow ; however , when the sun was directly overhead , magic runes , written in the ancient tongue of Jotunalder appeared in a great circle , 22 feet ( 7 meters ) in diameter , upon the wall . The runes gave off a transmutation aura . Placing one ' s hand in the center of the circle of runes and saying the blessing , " May the qorrash smile upon it and nurture its mighty works , " would cause the ice to melt away and reveal the entrance to the city . Government .

title: Gharri Delark
description: Gharri Delark Gharri Delark was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Gharri had won the grudging respect of Baron Xhalth .
description_long: Gharri Delark Gharri Delark was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Gharri had won the grudging respect of Baron Xhalth . History . Gharri was an adventurer member of the Company of the Jaded Heart . They went to explore the ruin of Hellgate Keep under orders of the Arcane Brotherhood . However , the daemonfey killed most of them . Gharri and the surviving members pledged their loyalty to the fey ' ri .

title: Ghartii Nung
description: Ghartii Nung Ghartii Nung was a monstrous eel that dwelt in the Yellow Sea off the coast of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was reported to be 100 feet ( 30 meters ) long . The mighty eel was caught by the famous Koryoan fishermen of In ' ani and Ansong .
description_long: Ghartii Nung Ghartii Nung was a monstrous eel that dwelt in the Yellow Sea off the coast of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was reported to be 100 feet ( 30 meters ) long . The mighty eel was caught by the famous Koryoan fishermen of In ' ani and Ansong .

title: Ghassis
description: Ghassis King Ghassis was a lizard king who inhabited the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Ghassis was the leader of the Servants of the Royal Egg mercenary company .
description_long: Ghassis King Ghassis was a lizard king who inhabited the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Ghassis was the leader of the Servants of the Royal Egg mercenary company . He hired out his warriors to anyone who had the coin , charging extra if his troops were to be used as cannon fodder . Ghassis cared little for the other lizard men of the company since he had access to a nearly limitless supply of new warriors . These new recruits were supplied via spelljammer ships from Realmspace .

title: Ghast
description: Ghast Ghasts were a subtype of ghouls . Description . They resembled very closely their undead cousin , except perhaps being just a bit more slender and ghost - like .
description_long: Ghast Ghasts were a subtype of ghouls . Description . They resembled very closely their undead cousin , except perhaps being just a bit more slender and ghost - like . The stench of death and rot lingered around their undead forms . Combat . Ghasts were also far more deadly and cunning than ghouls , with their paralytic touch dangerously affecting their opponents , especially elves . Habitat / Society . They often laired with others of their own kind or acted as the leaders of a group of normal ghouls . Like ghouls , ghasts spoke whatever language they did in life .

title: Ghaulantatra
description: Ghaulantatra Ghaulantatra was a white dragon ghost who fought for ownership of her home lair against the Cult of the Dragon and Thaluul , a beholder ghost . Description . The ghost looked to have the general shape of an enormous white dragon , but made of pale white mist .
description_long: Ghaulantatra Ghaulantatra was a white dragon ghost who fought for ownership of her home lair against the Cult of the Dragon and Thaluul , a beholder ghost . Description . The ghost looked to have the general shape of an enormous white dragon , but made of pale white mist . Personality . Ghaulantatra thought she was a god , and as such , gathered a small following in the Sandskull orc tribe of the Fallen Lands . The tribe , like others in the area , seemed to follow more from fear than faith . Generally , she killed weaker creatures , but occasionally she granted others some of her treasure or magic as a show of her generosity . History . She gained prominence during the Dracorage when , as most of the Cult of the Dragon was dealing with Sammaster , a portion made a deal with Old Mother . They brought her treasure , and she used her power and influence to gain control of numerous orc tribes in the area . This deal gave the Cult a hold in the region . Relationships . Most of the Cult was okay with the deal , but some worked to get rid of the Old Mother by satisfying her greed and dismissing her spirit . The Cult hoped to move a living dragon into the lair .

title: Ghaulathator
description: Ghaulathator Ghaulathator , also known as Wintercloak , was an ancient white dragon slain in the time of Netheril . History . In 3426 NY ( −433 DR ) , Wintercloak flew under the floating city of Lathery , over the Narrow Sea in Netheril , and was teleport ed into one of the city ' s cold storage chambers , as part of its fishing system .
description_long: Ghaulathator Ghaulathator , also known as Wintercloak , was an ancient white dragon slain in the time of Netheril . History . In 3426 NY ( −433 DR ) , Wintercloak flew under the floating city of Lathery , over the Narrow Sea in Netheril , and was teleport ed into one of the city ' s cold storage chambers , as part of its fishing system . Wintercloak tore himself free and broke out into the city streets , and there was confronted by Veridon and the city ' s arcanist s . Wintercloak slayed Veridon and a dozen arcanists with its icy breath , but was slain by the survivors .

title: Ghaunadaur
description: Ghaunadaur Ghaunadaur ( " gone " - ah - dowr ) was a greater deity and the god of abominations . Originally , Ghaunadaur was a member of the drow pantheon but following the War of the Spider Queen he left the pantheon to break off on his own . His portfolio included slimy creatures , outcasts , and rebels .
description_long: Ghaunadaur Ghaunadaur ( " gone " - ah - dowr ) was a greater deity and the god of abominations . Originally , Ghaunadaur was a member of the drow pantheon but following the War of the Spider Queen he left the pantheon to break off on his own . His portfolio included slimy creatures , outcasts , and rebels . Overview . Ghaunadaur was an unpredictable deity . False worshipers were sometimes rewarded by it , occasionally even with permanent magical boons , but they might just as well have been devoured by the Elder Eye without a second thought . Ghaunadaur enjoyed watching large horrible monsters as they hunted and devoured their prey , causing much suffering . When Ghaunadaur left the Inner Planes he was always silent , but some old records mention a gibbering and bestial language being spoken in the god ' s court . When communicating Ghaunadaur used telepathy and kept its conversations blunt and simple . Ghaunadaur was believed to be touched by the Far Realm . Worshipers . The church of Ghaunadaur consisted of cults scattered throughout the Underdark , each dominated by a single individual .

title: Ghauntz
description: Ghauntz Ghauntz , also known as Ghauntz the Cloaked , was a male human cleric of Gargauth who went on to become the vice chairman of the Knights of the Shield . Description . Ghauntz was an old man with a scarred face who always dressed in black with a cape .
description_long: Ghauntz Ghauntz , also known as Ghauntz the Cloaked , was a male human cleric of Gargauth who went on to become the vice chairman of the Knights of the Shield . Description . Ghauntz was an old man with a scarred face who always dressed in black with a cape . History . In adulthood , Ghauntz was a worshiper and a cleric of Gargauth , and it was under the guidance and influence of his god that he rose to the upper echelons of the Knights of the Shield . Most of his peers considered him to be only a crafty moneylender . But his mission was to assist Inselm Hhune in understanding the wishes of Gargauth and take control the organization . He also proselytized to the rest of the Shield Council and slowly converted the whole order to the worship of the Hidden Lord .

title: Ghaurann Rhee
description: Ghaurann Rhee Ghaurann Rhee was a merchant with some understanding of the the Art and a member of the smuggling and slavery ring known as the Tarntar . He sold spell s that enhanced beauty , provided adornment , or embellished the face and figure along with his line of skin - care products and cosmetics . Personality .
description_long: Ghaurann Rhee Ghaurann Rhee was a merchant with some understanding of the the Art and a member of the smuggling and slavery ring known as the Tarntar . He sold spell s that enhanced beauty , provided adornment , or embellished the face and figure along with his line of skin - care products and cosmetics . Personality . Rhee was a smooth - talking salesman who used his good looks and skill with flattery and lies to inveigle his customers into buying his wares . History . Sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Rhee was traveling with a cohort of his partners - in - crime and happened to be in Voonlar staying at the Whistling Wizard inn when two groups of Harper s independently decided to cleanse the inn of some of its inhabitants — creatures that were masquerading as humans . None other than the Simbul recognized them in the common room of the Wizard and taunted the Tarntar elite enough to goad them into a fight . What later became known as the Battle at the Bar destroyed or damaged quite a few rooms and resulted in the deaths of at least three members of the cabal .

title: Ghazneth
description: Ghazneth The seven ghazneths were fell demon s created by Nalavarauthatoryl from prominent members of Cormyr ean royalty and nobility who had betrayed Cormyr in some way . Powers . Even a single ghazneth was incredibly deadly , displaying phenomenal power and lighting - fast speed .
description_long: Ghazneth The seven ghazneths were fell demon s created by Nalavarauthatoryl from prominent members of Cormyr ean royalty and nobility who had betrayed Cormyr in some way . Powers . Even a single ghazneth was incredibly deadly , displaying phenomenal power and lighting - fast speed . A single Ghazneth could easily wipe out even large Purple Dragons patrols and contingents of War Wizards . The ghazneths ' wings were able to shield the ghazneth almost completely from magical attacks , and the ghazneths themselves were able to absorb magical energy , draining magical items and greatly reducing the duration of spells cast upon them . Ghazneths also had the ability to detect magic and could intercept telepathic communication . They used this to great effect by tracking both Princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and Princess Alusair Obarskyr as both were heavily laden with Obarskyr magical items . It was later discovered that the ghazneth actually gathered strength by draining magic , even being able to heal their wounds with captured magic . Finally , each ghazneth had a unique power tied to their mortal life and sins .

title: Ghazrim DuLoc
description: Ghazrim DuLoc Ghazrim DuLoc was the Zhentarim ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghazrim was born to a wealthy family in Amn .
description_long: Ghazrim DuLoc Ghazrim DuLoc was the Zhentarim ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghazrim was born to a wealthy family in Amn . In later life , he joined the Zhentarim and was appointed as their representative in the crucial garrison of Mantol - Derith . During the Rage of Demons , he was the only bulwark against the chaos spreading in the trading post , with duergar and deep gnome s making war on each other and the drow ready to seize total control of the place . However , the drow representative Sirak Mazelor needed Ghazrim ' s approval of her plan in order to act . Personality . Ghazrim had the typically smarmy demeanor of the Amnian aristocracy coupled with a biting sense of humor that he used to diffuse tense situations . He liked a good battle but not with superior enemy troops . Relationships . Ghazrim had with Lorthuun , the leading beholder of the garrison , a relationship like that of a married couple , bickering and insulting each other but knowing both were loyal to the Black Network . Possessions .

title: Ghearufu
description: Ghearufu The Ghearufu was a set of magic items , consisting of a golden - edged mirror on a gold chain that could be hung around the neck and a pair of mismatched gloves , one white and one black . History . Not much was known about the Ghearufu ' s history .
description_long: Ghearufu The Ghearufu was a set of magic items , consisting of a golden - edged mirror on a gold chain that could be hung around the neck and a pair of mismatched gloves , one white and one black . History . Not much was known about the Ghearufu ' s history . The magical items were believed to have been created on the lower plane s millennia before the 14th century DR . The last wielder of the items was the assassin known as Ghost , who had the items in his possession for three centuries . The items were destroyed by the great red dragon Fyrentennimar at the behest of Cadderly Bonaduce . Powers . The magic of the Ghearufu let the wielder switch bodies with their target , transferring their soul and mind to the other ' s body while the victim ' s soul and mind went to the wielder ' s body . The wielder had to have the victim look into the mirror of the set , so they could then establish a psychic link with the victim and take over their body . The magical items transferred with the wielder to the new body .

title: Gheldaneth
description: Gheldaneth Gehldaneth was the only Mulhorandi city to survive the Spellplague although its population was greatly reduced . As of 1479 DR it swore fealty to High Imaskar and the Imaskarians stationed troops in the city to ensure its loyalty . Inhabitants .
description_long: Gheldaneth Gehldaneth was the only Mulhorandi city to survive the Spellplague although its population was greatly reduced . As of 1479 DR it swore fealty to High Imaskar and the Imaskarians stationed troops in the city to ensure its loyalty . Inhabitants . The city was home to many ethnic Mulhorandi who carried on many of their traditions . The city also housed many tiefling s , descendents of slaves who made pacts with dark forces . Geography . Gehldaneth ' s inhabitants lived in relatively new buildings built on top of the many structures destroyed by the Spellplague . Most of the city ' s grand buildings were buried in ruble during the Spellplague ' s upheaval . Notable Locations . Temple of Horus - Re - Ruined temple buried deep under the city .

title: Gheldieg
description: Gheldieg House Gheldieg is an Amn ian house originating from the Gildeggh family of Lord - Magister Ehlemm Gildeggh of Waterdeep . The family was exiled and came to Amn , marrying into its families and gradually transforming into the Gheldieg family . Its power is now controlled by House Tanislove .
description_long: Gheldieg House Gheldieg is an Amn ian house originating from the Gildeggh family of Lord - Magister Ehlemm Gildeggh of Waterdeep . The family was exiled and came to Amn , marrying into its families and gradually transforming into the Gheldieg family . Its power is now controlled by House Tanislove .

title: Ghelryn Foehammer
description: Ghelryn Foehammer Ghelryn Foehammer was a shield dwarf blacksmith of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ghelryn managed the Foehammer ' s Forge .
description_long: Ghelryn Foehammer Ghelryn Foehammer was a shield dwarf blacksmith of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ghelryn managed the Foehammer ' s Forge . He was a very skilled blacksmith . History . In 1485 DR , Ghaelryn often thought about going to fight in the War of the Silver Marches but he couldn ' t abandon his business . In 1484 DR , he made splendid ceremonial armors for the king and queen of Citadel Felbarr , and was later awarded with the title of Royal Armorer . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , he was in search of an apprentice . Personality . Ghelryn had a good heart but hated with passion orc s and giant s . He wanted to be considered the best blacksmith in the area but his hatred always came first . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Ghelryn was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar
description: Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Unlike most drow , Ghenni was a tall and very slim .
description_long: Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Unlike most drow , Ghenni was a tall and very slim . She had snow white hair and ebon skin . Personality . Ghenni ' tiroth was one of the most devoted followers of Lolth in Menzoberranzan . Possessions . In battle , Ghenni ' tiroth used a dagger called Scrag - tooth , which was taken by K ' yorl Odran upon her death . Within the Faen Tlabbar compound , Ghenni used a platinum sacrificial platter known as the Faen Tlabbar communing plate . History . In 1358 DR , Ghenni prayed to Lolth to protect her house from the advances of House Oblodra Death . Near the end of the Time of Troubles , K ' yorl Odran entered the chapel of House Faen Tlabbar and used psychic energy to rip the heart from Ghenni ' tiroth and placed it on the sacred plate . At her death , Ghenni ' tiroth was over 640 years old .

title: Ghenni Tlabbar
description: Ghenni Tlabbar Ghenni Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Ghenni ascended to the position of matron mother before 1372 .
description_long: Ghenni Tlabbar Ghenni Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Ghenni ascended to the position of matron mother before 1372 . In that year , she was targeted by Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin as part of his bargain with House Agrach Dyrr , who wanted Ghenni dead . Nimor infiltrated the Faen Tlabbar complex and killed Ghenni and her favorite daughter , Sil ' zet Tlabbar , who was at her mother ' s side at the wrong time .

title: Ghevel Coalhewer
description: Ghevel Coalhewer Ghevel Coalwhever was a duergar boatman in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . In 1372 DR , Ghevel was hired by the drow party of Quenthel Baenre and Pharaun Mizzrym to travel the Darklake .
description_long: Ghevel Coalhewer Ghevel Coalwhever was a duergar boatman in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . In 1372 DR , Ghevel was hired by the drow party of Quenthel Baenre and Pharaun Mizzrym to travel the Darklake . When duergar authorities tried to arrest the drow group , fearing they had discovered the plan for the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Pharaun magically compelled Ghevel to flee the city . The drow abandoned Ghevel and his boat when they had escaped . It is unknown what happened to him .

title: Ghiirvox
description: Ghiirvox Ghiirvox was the leader of the Scoured Legion in 1479 DR . Personality . Ghiirvox was very reserved and calculating for a tanarukk .
description_long: Ghiirvox Ghiirvox was the leader of the Scoured Legion in 1479 DR . Personality . Ghiirvox was very reserved and calculating for a tanarukk . He suspected rightly that the Grand Bloodreaver Jeervan , a follower of Garagos , would soon move to supplant him as warchief . Description . Unusual for a tanarukk , Ghiirvox had violet - blue skin , suggesting a very particular demon among his ancestors . History . Ghiirvox was a veteran of twelve conflicts in the Underdark . He ascended to his current position when his predecessor succumbed to Araumycos ' s madness . In 1479 DR , his position was threatened by Garagos ' worshipers , who were spreading in the Legion , and their leader Jeervan .

title: Ghilanna Tlabbar
description: Ghilanna Tlabbar Ghilanna Tlabbar was the matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar of Menzoberranzan until her death in 1361 DR . History . Ghilllana won this position due to bloody fights with her seven sisters after her mother and the former heir to the throne were slain in the battle of Mithral Hall in 1358 DR .
description_long: Ghilanna Tlabbar Ghilanna Tlabbar was the matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar of Menzoberranzan until her death in 1361 DR . History . Ghilllana won this position due to bloody fights with her seven sisters after her mother and the former heir to the throne were slain in the battle of Mithral Hall in 1358 DR . Description . Ghilanna Tlabbar was described as " vicious " but she appeared quite delicate .

title: Ghileeda
description: Ghileeda Ghileeda was a maid in the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghileeda worked at the Swinging Sword tavern .
description_long: Ghileeda Ghileeda was a maid in the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghileeda worked at the Swinging Sword tavern . She also spied on citizens , under the orders of her fellow cultist Justran Daehl . History . In 1491 DR , Ghileeda noticed some adventurers hired to find a diplomatic caravan missing near the city . They probably uncovered her secret .

title: Ghindul
description: Ghindul Ghindul was a male kir - lanan and the leader of the Howling Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . His scales were a deep ebony and his eyes were of a notably rich amethyst color .
description_long: Ghindul Ghindul was a male kir - lanan and the leader of the Howling Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . His scales were a deep ebony and his eyes were of a notably rich amethyst color . Personality . Tyrannical and maniacal , Ghindul ruled the Howling Wing with an iron fist and was quick to stamp out any insubordination . Abilities . He was a notably strong and domineering example of his kind and used these talents to keep a tight grip on his subordinates . A powerful fighter , Ghindul had developed an aerobatic combat style that made use of swooping aerial attacks to harass foes . He also coupled this with the use of tanglefoot bag s to further hinder enemies . In addition , Ghindul had developed a degree of talent in sorcery enough to enhance his combat prowess and versatility with spells like " true strike " and " magic missile " . Possessions . Like other members of the Howling Wing , Ghindul carried two tanglefoot bags at all times and two " potion s of inflict serious wounds " . He also wore a set of " bracers of armor + 2 " and a " ring of protection " + 1 . Relationships .

title: Gholam ibn Jubair
description: Gholam ibn Jubair Imam Gholam ibn Jubair was the High Priest of the Mosque of Free Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . As with most priests of Haku , Gholom wore outlandish aba s composed of loud colors .
description_long: Gholam ibn Jubair Imam Gholam ibn Jubair was the High Priest of the Mosque of Free Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . As with most priests of Haku , Gholom wore outlandish aba s composed of loud colors . Personality . Gholam was a very outspoken and free - willed individual ; a trait that often lead him to clash with members of the court . Activities . Imam Gholam supervised nearly 200 priests and other laymen within the mosque . Possessions . Gholam wore a magical turban that granted him " true seeing " and " free action " up to two times per day . He also wore a " ring of fire resistance " , " bracers of defense " , and used a magical mace . Relationships . Imam Gholam had a close relationship with Prince Tannous al - Assad . Tannous used his considerable wealth to help further Gholam ' s career and influence .

title: Ghont Tavvas
description: Ghont Tavvas Ghont Tavvas was one of the Boar ' s Head s of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruitment organization in Amn . Description . Lord Tavvas was a distinguished man who was rarely seen out of his blue uniform .
description_long: Ghont Tavvas Ghont Tavvas was one of the Boar ' s Head s of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruitment organization in Amn . Description . Lord Tavvas was a distinguished man who was rarely seen out of his blue uniform . In 1358 DR , he was the oldest member of the Boar ' s Heads , being nearly 90 years old . His mind was still sharp , even at that age , and he was proud . Activities . Ghont was a leading member of the Order of the Blue Boar who offered strategic advice . In his younger days , he was a great warrior and led infantry companies into battle . As an older man , he hired others to lead his troops . History . Ghont was distantly related to some of the members of the Lions ' Dynasty ' of Tethyr , but he kept this matter a secret , because he was exiled from that kingdom at the end of the 12 century DR for being involved in a brief succession war .

title: Ghost
description: Ghost A ghost was the spirit of a deceased sentient creature . This type of undead was incorporeal in nature and only vulnerable to conventional weapons on the Ethereal Plane . A Ghost Brute was a ghost of an animal , plant , or magical beast that was stuck to the material plane .
description_long: Ghost A ghost was the spirit of a deceased sentient creature . This type of undead was incorporeal in nature and only vulnerable to conventional weapons on the Ethereal Plane . A Ghost Brute was a ghost of an animal , plant , or magical beast that was stuck to the material plane . A ghost was a creature existing on two planes , the material and the Astral Plane . A ghost ' s connection to the material plane was severed when destroyed , but in a few days the ghost would usually come back . Ghosts were a repetitive nuisance for those who lived in one ' s particular haunt . A ghost could also be controlled of wizards , sorcerers , liches , etc . In this case the ghost was finally put to rest when destroyed on the material plane or the master of the ghost died . This was usually uncommon though , because to raise a ghost used a lot more magic than raising a regular undead . A ghost ' s weapons usually consisted of whatever weapons they carried in their mortal life , and maybe a spell or two if they were a wizard or sorcerer .

title: Ghost ( assassin )
description: Ghost ( assassin ) Ghost was an assassin who belonged to the Night Masks . He spent at least three lifetimes perfecting his mastery of the dreaded " Ghearufu " . Appearance .
description_long: Ghost ( assassin ) Ghost was an assassin who belonged to the Night Masks . He spent at least three lifetimes perfecting his mastery of the dreaded " Ghearufu " . Appearance . His most familiar body was that of a weak and puny man , issuing a steady stream of phlegm - filled coughs . He had heavy eye - lids , thick , full lips and no beard or stubble , making his face look too clean and soft to be an adult ' s . . Up until his death at the hands of Cadderly Bonaduce Ghost also used the body of the firbolg Vander to escape any dangerous situations or to perfom his craft . The Ghearufu . Ghost killed by swapping his spirit with his target ' s using a magical device called " Ghearufu " . The " Ghearufu " consists of a small , gold - edged mirror on a golden chain and a pair of mismatching gloves - one white , the other black . After switching bodies Ghost would then use his target ' s body to kill the victim trapped in his original form . The target ' s spirit would then leave the dead body , which could be reclaimed by Ghost ' s spirit after it was repaired by his ring of regeneration .

title: Ghost Holds
description: Ghost Holds The Ghost Holds consisted of some forty ruined castles and mansions spread through the forest in Battledale . Description . It was an outlaw town ruled unofficially by a long - dead past ruler referred to by some as the King of Ghosts .
description_long: Ghost Holds The Ghost Holds consisted of some forty ruined castles and mansions spread through the forest in Battledale . Description . It was an outlaw town ruled unofficially by a long - dead past ruler referred to by some as the King of Ghosts . The Ghost Holds were a meeting place for pirates and where mercenaries could find work . Many things were traded for gold and gem s , including spell s and caged monsters . Rule . The King of Ghosts was bound to this region he once ruled and had no real political motivations . He helped or hindered by whim and prevented anyone who came to the Ghost Holds from mustering an army . He did this for his own entertainment and so wanted to keep it as interesting as possible by encouraging monsters , outlaws , and hunters of others . It was a meeting place for smugglers and ne ' er - do - wells . Fantastical creatures roamed the area , particularly at night . The King of Ghosts used direhelm s , undead created from the spirits of dead warriors , to enforce his interests . Travelers who encountered the King of Ghosts might be tasked with spreading word of the Ghost Holds to other parts of the Realms to attract new outlaws and outcasts .

title: Ghost Knight of Galardoun
description: Ghost Knight of Galardoun The Ghost Knight of Galardoun was a wandering apparition that appeared in various locations throughout the heartlands of Faerûn . Several cults sprang up to venerate the apparition including the True Ghost Knight Faithful in Waterdeep . Description .
description_long: Ghost Knight of Galardoun The Ghost Knight of Galardoun was a wandering apparition that appeared in various locations throughout the heartlands of Faerûn . Several cults sprang up to venerate the apparition including the True Ghost Knight Faithful in Waterdeep . Description . The ghost appeared as a crude great helm illuminated from the inside by a bluish - green glow . The helm usually hovered at a height of about seven feet . Nature . There were two competing theories on the nature of the Ghost Knight . One theory held that the creature was the ghost of an undead hunting paladin , while the other theory claimed the helm was animated by magic . Behavior . The Ghost Knight was known to guide lost travelers to safety and also to lead adventurers to hidden crypts . The ghost was claimed to attack undead and the great mage Elminster believed the apparition fed on the essence of the undead . History . The ghost first appeared near the abandoned village of Galardoun between Scornubel and Triel around 1420 DR . It haunted the general vicinity for about twenty years , after which it began to wander widely with sightings in Waterdeep , Marsember and Sembia .

title: Ghost Leopard
description: Ghost Leopard The Ghost Leopard province was found in the northwest region of the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . This province of the Yikarian Empire was dominated by the World Pillar Mountains on its eastern side and foothills and rugged terrain along the River Ruin in the west and north .
description_long: Ghost Leopard The Ghost Leopard province was found in the northwest region of the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . This province of the Yikarian Empire was dominated by the World Pillar Mountains on its eastern side and foothills and rugged terrain along the River Ruin in the west and north . Inhabitants . Aside from the yak - folk who controlled the region , the Ghost Leopard province was home to a large population of marrash whose eyries were scattered throughout the mountain peaks . These dangerous creatures were close allies with the yak - folk and served as aerial scouts for the area .

title: Ghost Mountains
description: Ghost Mountains The Ghost Mountains , or Jibal al - Taif , were a small group of mountains found within Interior Zakhara . Geography . The Ghost Mountains were situated between the North Quarter of Suq Bay and the burning expanse of the Haunted Lands .
description_long: Ghost Mountains The Ghost Mountains , or Jibal al - Taif , were a small group of mountains found within Interior Zakhara . Geography . The Ghost Mountains were situated between the North Quarter of Suq Bay and the burning expanse of the Haunted Lands . Description . The trio of mountain strips comprising the Ghost Mountains ran roughly parallel to each other in a northeastern slope . Al - Qalil River originated within the peaks of the Ghost Mountains .

title: Ghost Pond
description: Ghost Pond Ghost Pond was a body of water located near the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . It was a large but shallow pool situated beside of the North Road , just north of Sevenecho . It was named for the ghost regularly sighted on or beside its waters by 1367 DR .
description_long: Ghost Pond Ghost Pond was a body of water located near the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . It was a large but shallow pool situated beside of the North Road , just north of Sevenecho . It was named for the ghost regularly sighted on or beside its waters by 1367 DR . Called the Drowned Lady , she was said to have been killed by a lover she spurned , likely by drowning her in the pond later named for her .

title: Ghost armor
description: Ghost armor Ghost armor was a conjuration spell that improved on the " armor " spell by creating an aura of protection around the recipient . Effects . This spell could be cast by touch on one creature of any size up to Huge .
description_long: Ghost armor Ghost armor was a conjuration spell that improved on the " armor " spell by creating an aura of protection around the recipient . Effects . This spell could be cast by touch on one creature of any size up to Huge . " Ghost armor " created a translucent aura around the target that made it appear that he or she was wearing ghostly plate mail over their real clothing or armor , and it afforded the same protection as plate mail . If the recipient was already wearing armor ( magical or otherwise ) equal to or better than plate mail , this spell had no effect except in altering appearance . Magical bonuses on armor being worn did not stack with this spell . The " ghost armor " lasted one minute per experience level of the caster , and was a weightless and completely unencumbering magical force , immune to rust , " heat metal " , and similar effects that affect metal . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , and the material component was a scrap of real battle - worn armor .

title: Ghost mount
description: Ghost mount Ghost mounts were horrifying creatures who wander in the desert and has help lost travelers but for a special fee : those who agree to go with this creatures , themselves become ghosts . These ghosts have two forms their true form and illusory . Their real form is a transparent outline , of what they were in life ( horse , camel , or antelope ) They often look very badly rotting skeletons with big wounds .
description_long: Ghost mount Ghost mounts were horrifying creatures who wander in the desert and has help lost travelers but for a special fee : those who agree to go with this creatures , themselves become ghosts . These ghosts have two forms their true form and illusory . Their real form is a transparent outline , of what they were in life ( horse , camel , or antelope ) They often look very badly rotting skeletons with big wounds . Often to hide their real form they use powerful illusory spells . Combat . A ghost mount can attack the enemy with hooves or teeth , but often prefer to persuade the enemy to ride it , and then suck out all of his life energy . Some wise people may rebel by these spirits and their magic and jump before the spirit rush glop in the open desert , where invariably kill his victim . It is very difficult to subdue these spirits , but still if managed , the person can get the spirit to do whatever he wants at any time summon him . They are not affected by many spells such as sleep , charm , hold , death , and cold - based magic . Killing the ghost also allows the use of the spells of raise the dead or resurrection .

title: Ghost of eventide
description: Ghost of eventide A ghost of eventide was a rogue who had chosen to fight the forces of the revived Netherese Empire around 1479 DR . Learning to use the very shadows that protected and enshrouded Netheril , ghosts of eventide were members of a loosely bound organization whose aim was , above all else , the defeat of Netheril . Silent and deadly killers , " ghosts of death " were often motivated by a sense of vengeance or righteous rage , choosing to fight evil with death and dealing little mercy against their most hated enemies .
description_long: Ghost of eventide A ghost of eventide was a rogue who had chosen to fight the forces of the revived Netherese Empire around 1479 DR . Learning to use the very shadows that protected and enshrouded Netheril , ghosts of eventide were members of a loosely bound organization whose aim was , above all else , the defeat of Netheril . Silent and deadly killers , " ghosts of death " were often motivated by a sense of vengeance or righteous rage , choosing to fight evil with death and dealing little mercy against their most hated enemies . Abilities . In order to face off against the powerful forces of Netheril , ghosts of eventide learned quickly to shield themselves with shadow and other methods of concealment . Even inexperienced ghosts of eventide learned to do this in an instant in moments of peril , diving out of sight just in time to avoid a deadly blow . So well - attuned to stealth were ghosts of eventide that they were exceptionally capable combatants while concealed , far more so than in the open .

title: Ghost pipes
description: Ghost pipes Ghost pipes was a bard spell that caused an instrument to rise into the air and hover , playing itself with no visible musician . Wizard s could cast this spell also , but it was more difficult for them . Effect .
description_long: Ghost pipes Ghost pipes was a bard spell that caused an instrument to rise into the air and hover , playing itself with no visible musician . Wizard s could cast this spell also , but it was more difficult for them . Effect . The caster would hold a working , non - magical musical instrument while casting the spell . Upon completion , the instrument was released to hover at that height , glowing as if outlined in " faerie fire " . The caster did not need knowledge of how to play the instrument , but had to hum or whistle the tune to be repeated by the enchanted instrument . The refrain could be up to one minute long and would repeat continuously until dispelled , or until a living creature touched the animated music maker . Once touched , it stoped playing and slowly settled to the ground as the glow faded away . Components . This spell required a musical instrument in working condition , and the caster to hold the instrument while whistling or humming the tune to be performed . History .

title: Ghost rigging
description: Ghost rigging Ghost rigging was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a ghostly rigging on a sailing vessel that functioned just as normal rigging did .
description_long: Ghost rigging Ghost rigging was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a ghostly rigging on a sailing vessel that functioned just as normal rigging did . This spell was often used to replace damaged rigging while at sea . The ghostly rigging matched the vessel ' s needs . Components . This spell required a bit of canvass and string to cast .

title: Ghost rothé
description: Ghost rothé Ghost rothé , also known as snow rothé or white rothé , were a variety of white rothé . Description . Like other rothé , ghost rothé had shaggy fur , but their coat was a striking white .
description_long: Ghost rothé Ghost rothé , also known as snow rothé or white rothé , were a variety of white rothé . Description . Like other rothé , ghost rothé had shaggy fur , but their coat was a striking white . Abilities . Ghost rothé were able to magically jump and cast " silence " on themselves . They usually did so to escape predators . Combat . Ghost rothé could fight with both their teeth and horns . They were skittish and prone to stampeding , which could be quite dangerous for anyone in their path . Ecology . Ghost rothé were one of the favorite prey animals of remorhaz es and polar bear s . Locations . Ghost rothé dwelt on the surface in cold lands . They were commonly found in northwest Faerûn and in Vaasa .

title: Ghost sound
description: Ghost sound Ghost sound , also known as audible glamer , is a cantrip , or very simple to use spell , learned by all wizard s . " Ghost sound " allows its caster to create the impression of a quiet , whispery sound within fifty feet . However , the sound is not real , but an illusion created by the wizard .
description_long: Ghost sound Ghost sound , also known as audible glamer , is a cantrip , or very simple to use spell , learned by all wizard s . " Ghost sound " allows its caster to create the impression of a quiet , whispery sound within fifty feet . However , the sound is not real , but an illusion created by the wizard .
