Following the Spellplague , " ghost sound " , like all cantrips , became an at - will spell that wizards are capable of casting at any time without preparation . Prior to the Spellplague , " ghost sound " was also cast by bard s and sorcerer s , with much the same purpose . At this time , spells were accessed through the Weave and , as such , " ghost sound " could be cast only a limited number of times . Like other spells of the time , " ghost sound " grew in potency with the experience and power of its caster , growing louder as the caster grew more powerful .

title: Ghosts of Dragonspear Castle
description: Ghosts of Dragonspear Castle Summary . A group of Red Wizards of Thay have constructed a base that contains a quartet of netherese " portal s " that each lead to powerful elemental nodes . In order to access the power of those nodes , they need the portal keys .
description_long: Ghosts of Dragonspear Castle Summary . A group of Red Wizards of Thay have constructed a base that contains a quartet of netherese " portal s " that each lead to powerful elemental nodes . In order to access the power of those nodes , they need the portal keys . A Red Wizard managed to acquire one of the keys by attacking the Floshin Estates but was caught and executed in Daggerford after he passed the key on to an agent . Sir Isteval , a retired paladin from Cormyr , hires a group of adventurers to go on a series of quests that result in acquiring the remaining three keys , taking the group to locations such as the Lizard Marsh and Mount Illefarn before engaging in a climactic battle in the ruins of Dragonspear Castle with vengeful red wizards and the rakshasa who has been manipulating events .

title: Ghostwalk
description: Ghostwalk Ghostwalk is a sourcebook for " Dungeons & Dragons " using the 3rd - edition ruleset published in 2003 . It covers a heavily ghost - themed campaign setting , " Ghostwalk " . Although unrelated to the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting , the book includes suggestions for adapting and placing the " Ghostwalk " setting on Toril .
description_long: Ghostwalk Ghostwalk is a sourcebook for " Dungeons & Dragons " using the 3rd - edition ruleset published in 2003 . It covers a heavily ghost - themed campaign setting , " Ghostwalk " . Although unrelated to the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting , the book includes suggestions for adapting and placing the " Ghostwalk " setting on Toril .

title: Ghostwise halfling
description: Ghostwise halfling Ghostwise halflings were the most uncommon of the three halfling subraces . Description . Ghostwise halflings have the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature within 20 feet that speaks the same language .
description_long: Ghostwise halfling Ghostwise halflings were the most uncommon of the three halfling subraces . Description . Ghostwise halflings have the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature within 20 feet that speaks the same language . Personality . Ghostwise halflings were generally very concerned ( some might say obsessed ) with family and clan . They do not experience as much wanderlust as the other halflings subraces . Society . Ghostwise halflings were very elusive and were generally isolated from the outside world . They often lived a nomadic life in clans . Those who left the clan often carried a token of some important natural feature in their clan ' s territory , such as a stone or a vial of water from a stream . Losing one ' s token was considered a sin and required an act of atonement assigned by the clan leader . History . Hin Ghostwars . Like the other halfling subraces ( lightfoot halfling s and strongheart halfling s ) , ghostwise halflings were one of the original tribes of the Lluirwood in Luiren .

title: Ghoul
description: Ghoul Ghouls were monstrous , undead humanoids who reeked of carrion . Culture . A ghoul was said to be created on the death of a man or woman who savored the taste of the flesh of people ; this was probably derived from the popular connection of the word " ghoul " with persons who delighted in the unsavory .
description_long: Ghoul Ghouls were monstrous , undead humanoids who reeked of carrion . Culture . A ghoul was said to be created on the death of a man or woman who savored the taste of the flesh of people ; this was probably derived from the popular connection of the word " ghoul " with persons who delighted in the unsavory . They not only ate the dead , but also preyed on the unwary living . Ghouls are humanoid undead that fed on the flesh of corpses . They laired within ancient crypts or hid in graveyards where food was plentiful . Whenever possible , a ghoul would attack a living target as a rare opportunity to have fresh meat . People rightfully feared ghouls and their corpse - eating ways . Abilities . Ghouls could paralyze their victims with a touch , though elves were immune . The bite of a ghoul inflicted a terrible disease . Any who died from the illness rose as a ghoul soon afterward . Description . A ghoul appeared to be an emaciated humanoid creature with putrid grey skin . Its teeth had worn away into fangs and it had a long lashing tongue . The fingers and toes of a ghoul ended in sharp claws , blackened from constantly digging up grave dirt .

title: Ghour
description: Ghour The ghours are a race of demon s in the service of ( and possibly / probably created by ) the demon lord Baphomet ; whom is best known as the patron of minotaur s . They are an uncategorized species of demon ; not belonging to either the tanar ' ri , obyrith or loumara demonic subcategories . These monstrosities work their master ' s will among the minotaurs , ogre s and renegade giant s that serve him .
description_long: Ghour The ghours are a race of demon s in the service of ( and possibly / probably created by ) the demon lord Baphomet ; whom is best known as the patron of minotaur s . They are an uncategorized species of demon ; not belonging to either the tanar ' ri , obyrith or loumara demonic subcategories . These monstrosities work their master ' s will among the minotaurs , ogre s and renegade giant s that serve him . Description . Ghours are 20 - foot tall humanoid creatures that resemble a cross between an oversized ogre and a minotaur . Its hide is thick and hairy , its features bestial , and its body powerfully muscled . It has cloven hooves in place of feet ; and two enormous horns jut forwards from its skull . Combat . Ghours charge into combat like rampaging elephant s , pummeling opponents with their fists and goring them with their horns . Ghours have a breath weapon in the form of a cloud of noxious gas they can breathe once per minute . They can also bellow an ear - splitting roar that stuns and deafens nearby opponents . Whenever possible , ghours like to enter combat with a roar , blast of their breath weapon , or both . Society .

title: Ghul - kin
description: Ghul - kin Ghul - kin were creatures related to the great ghuls . They were undead jann that lived in Zakhara . Description .
description_long: Ghul - kin Ghul - kin were creatures related to the great ghuls . They were undead jann that lived in Zakhara . Description . These creatures were shapechangers , and usually assumed the form of an attractive human or demihuman . Their disguises typically had one feature that stood out as being strange , such as brightly colored eyes . In their natural form , ghul - kin stood between 8 and 10 ft tall . Their skin was bone - white and their hair was usually a tangled mess . Their teeth and claws were extremely sharp . Ghul - kin ears were pointed like those of an elf . Their eyes shined with eerie light . Combat . Ghul - kin could attack with either their sharp claws or a powerful bite . All ghul - kin could use the spell - like abilities " invisibility " and " polymorph self " at will . Ghul - kin were immune to all sleep , hold , and charm spells , as well as cold - based magic , paralysis , and poison . They were susceptible to holy water . They could function during daytime but suffered slight effects from the sun . Any jann killed by a ghul - kin rose from death as a new ghul - kin . Ghul - kin were immune to a sha ' ir ' s ability to capture and bind genie s .

title: Ghul Lord
description: Ghul Lord Ghul Lords were strange wizard s from Zakhara who used the Negative Energy plane to fuel their spells . Requirements . Their close association with the Negative Energy plane attracted wild and ruthless individuals to become ghul lords .
description_long: Ghul Lord Ghul Lords were strange wizard s from Zakhara who used the Negative Energy plane to fuel their spells . Requirements . Their close association with the Negative Energy plane attracted wild and ruthless individuals to become ghul lords . The rigorous strains of dealing with negative energy precluded all races save humans from becoming ghul lords . Role . These individuals often carried the stigma of being sinister people who tampered with the dead . This was not entirely true . Ghul lords were simply wizards who chose an abnormal path toward power that most conventional wizards shunned . Ghul lords tended to choose one of two paths based up their reputation . The first was to act as a speaker for the dead , even though they couldn ’ t actually communicate with the dead . The second path embraced their sinister reputation , often becoming hunters of other wizards where their unique abilities suited them rather well . Possessions . Ghul lords were unique among wizards in that they could use a variety of swords . However , like all other wizards , they never wore armor . Benefits .

title: Ghuldur Flagonfist
description: Ghuldur Flagonfist Ghuldur Flagonfist was the duergar ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghuldur was a merchant from Gracklstugh selling armor , arrowheads , locks , mining and smithing equipment , and smoked Darklake fish .
description_long: Ghuldur Flagonfist Ghuldur Flagonfist was the duergar ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghuldur was a merchant from Gracklstugh selling armor , arrowheads , locks , mining and smithing equipment , and smoked Darklake fish . During the Rage of Demons , he was convinced by Krimgol Muzgardt to mount an attack on the deep gnome section of the trading post to capture the wizard Yantha Coaxrock , leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone , who had tricked Krimgol over a gem ( in truth a madness - causing gem from the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu ) . The operation went well but started a civil war in the trading post . Ghuldur and Krimgol then interrogated Yantha in order to understand the whole matter . Relationship . Ghuldur was a good friend of fellow merchant Krimgol Muzgardt . He had a xorn as his " pet " .

title: Ghunayya
description: Ghunayya Ghunayya of the Rose Petal was a human pirate living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya captained a ship known as either the " Djinni ' s Flower " or the " Floating Rose " .
description_long: Ghunayya Ghunayya of the Rose Petal was a human pirate living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya captained a ship known as either the " Djinni ' s Flower " or the " Floating Rose " . She targeted Zakhara n ships owned by her employers ' rivals , stealing the goods and returning them to Bandar al - Sa ' adat where she kept half of the profits . She was respected among the other inhabitants of Masud Jazayir for spreading the wealth from her ventures .

title: Ghunayya min Hakiyuh
description: Ghunayya min Hakiyuh Ghunayya min Hakiyuh was a high priestess of Hakiyah of the Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya was a member of the holy slayer organization called the Soft Whisper .
description_long: Ghunayya min Hakiyuh Ghunayya min Hakiyuh was a high priestess of Hakiyah of the Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya was a member of the holy slayer organization called the Soft Whisper . The basement of the mosque was their headquarters . Ghunayya was loyal to the Grand Caliph . Rumors and Legends . It was rumored that if there was a threat to the Grand Caliph ' s life , the Grand Vizier came to the mosque to pray . The threat to the Grand Caliph was eliminated shortly thereafter .

title: Ghunda
description: Ghunda Ghunda was one of the elders , along with her husband Thurrak , of a stone giant tribe on the eastern shore of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Ghunda did not share the same reticence as others of her kind when dealing with others .
description_long: Ghunda Ghunda was one of the elders , along with her husband Thurrak , of a stone giant tribe on the eastern shore of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Ghunda did not share the same reticence as others of her kind when dealing with others . She was more than willing to express her pessimistic view of the world , albeit after much thought .

title: Ghunnis
description: Ghunnis Ghunnis was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ghunnis was very hard - nosed and unforgiving in her outlook .
description_long: Ghunnis Ghunnis was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ghunnis was very hard - nosed and unforgiving in her outlook . She no liked the Myth Nantar ' s mythal for it unnatural effects on watery environment but can excepted it because Myth Nantar was a beacon of tolerance . Her beliefs were always extreme , so either all was right with the world or all was headed for certain doom unless Ghunnis and Kharal act . Ghunnis hated slavery with passion . History . Ghunnis and Kharal lived with their tribe in the Hmur Plateau . In 1370 DR were reported activities of kuo - toa slavers in nearby area so gunnies and Kharal were sent to resolve the problem . Inside the kuo - toa ' s cavern they met some surface dwellers .

title: Giant
description: Giant Giants are humanoid creatures , usually of great strength and size . Most giants have vision equivalent to that of a human , though some have the capacity to see well in low light or total darkness as well . As a group , they have no other special abilities .
description_long: Giant Giants are humanoid creatures , usually of great strength and size . Most giants have vision equivalent to that of a human , though some have the capacity to see well in low light or total darkness as well . As a group , they have no other special abilities . They are immune to almost all diseases , and have a slight resistance to poison . Dwarves as a race are experienced at fighting giants , so they are more adept in combat with them . Most giants have superior senses to most humans . In general they can see and hear twice as well . The cloud giant , hill giant and stone giant species have a particularly good sense of smell . Physical description . The appearance of giants varies according to the type of giant ( see true giants below ) but they are generally humanoid in appearance , just much larger . Their bone structure is more dense than that of human s , giving them extra toughness but slowing them down a little . Ecology . A female giant has a pregnancy of between nine and fifteen months , depending on the type of giant . Their offspring will reach maturity in around fifty years .

title: Giant ' s Belt Mountains
description: Giant ' s Belt Mountains The Giant ' s Belt Mountains marked the northeastern border of the Beastlands and Durpar . The Aerilpar Forest lay at the foot of this mountain range , as well . The monsters who destroyed Veldorn came from the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , making them the origin point of the Beastlands themselves .
description_long: Giant ' s Belt Mountains The Giant ' s Belt Mountains marked the northeastern border of the Beastlands and Durpar . The Aerilpar Forest lay at the foot of this mountain range , as well . The monsters who destroyed Veldorn came from the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , making them the origin point of the Beastlands themselves .

title: Giant ' s Folly
description: Giant ' s Folly The Giant ' s Folly is a festhall in the village of Reddansyr , southwest of Westgate on the road to Starmantle . It has become known in the Dragon Coast as an information clearing - house , which rather annoys the local chapel of Oghma . The Giant ' s Folly is located inside an overturned boat that was pulled inland by a fire giant to win a bet .
description_long: Giant ' s Folly The Giant ' s Folly is a festhall in the village of Reddansyr , southwest of Westgate on the road to Starmantle . It has become known in the Dragon Coast as an information clearing - house , which rather annoys the local chapel of Oghma . The Giant ' s Folly is located inside an overturned boat that was pulled inland by a fire giant to win a bet .

title: Giant ' s Plain
description: Giant ' s Plain The name of these plains has changed at least twice . The first after the impressive rout of the resident giants by the dwarves of High Shanatar which slaughtered over 5000 of the creatures in - 5350 DR . The general of that successful army was named Karlyn and the area was dubbed Karlyn ' s Vale in his honor .
description_long: Giant ' s Plain The name of these plains has changed at least twice . The first after the impressive rout of the resident giants by the dwarves of High Shanatar which slaughtered over 5000 of the creatures in - 5350 DR . The general of that successful army was named Karlyn and the area was dubbed Karlyn ' s Vale in his honor . In - 2600 DR the last known surviving descendants of that army were killed by human s and the name was lost , though a monument to Karlyn still stands in the Troll Mountains known as the Wailing Dwarf .

title: Giant ' s Run Mountains
description: Giant ' s Run Mountains The Giant ' s Run Mountains were a range of mountains west of the Vilhon Reach in the Shining Plains . They were an outpost for the gold dwarves as of 1372 DR . Geography .
description_long: Giant ' s Run Mountains The Giant ' s Run Mountains were a range of mountains west of the Vilhon Reach in the Shining Plains . They were an outpost for the gold dwarves as of 1372 DR . Geography . The mountains were the northern part of the greater Iltkazar Range , which extended all the way to the Shining Sea in the south . Within the range lay Mount Dodild , beneath which the city of Cairnheim was located . History . According to dwarven legend , the mountains were named after a battle near the end of the Giant Wars known as the Fall of Karlyn ' s Vale . By 1369 DR , the Twisted Rune had placed a magical gate in the area to allow for instantaneous movement to other locations . Inhabitants . As well as goblin s and ogre s , the emerald dragon Behrshimmer made its lair in the range . At least one mine in the mountains was abandoned when tunnels breached the Underdark , releasing drow , illithid s and worse into the area .

title: Giant - kin
description: Giant - kin Giant - kin were large humanoid s related to the true giant s . Any race that could trace its lineage back to Othea ' s relationship with Ulutiu could be considered giant - kin . The mother of all giants , Othea , cheated on her husband Annam All - Father , the father of giants , with Ulutiu , producing the firbolg s , fomorian s , verbeeg s , and the voadkyn .
description_long: Giant - kin Giant - kin were large humanoid s related to the true giant s . Any race that could trace its lineage back to Othea ' s relationship with Ulutiu could be considered giant - kin . The mother of all giants , Othea , cheated on her husband Annam All - Father , the father of giants , with Ulutiu , producing the firbolg s , fomorian s , verbeeg s , and the voadkyn . All true giants considered these types of giant - kin evil because of this act of unfaithfulness . History . Despite the usual reluctance of giant - kin to interact with other giant - kin species , the coming of the Twilight Spirit increased the activity of true giant tribes in the Ice Spires , leading to concerns among giant - kin for their own protection , and some resulting cooperation between the species . Ecology . A typical giant - kin pregnancy was nine months , and the offspring took around eighteen years to reach maturity . Society . Giant - kin did not generally associate with different types of giant - kin . Within their own tribes , they were bound by the ordning ( except firbolg s ) , and when they did interact with other giant species , they were ranked below all others , except ogre s .

title: Giant Wars
description: Giant Wars The Giant Wars were fought between the giant s of Nedeheim and the dwarves of High Shanatar from −5360 to −5350 DR . The dwarves were led by Karlyn of House Kuldever . By the end of the war , more than five thousand giants of Nedeheim had fallen to the dwarves and half of the entire giant population south of the Cloud Peaks was exterminated .
description_long: Giant Wars The Giant Wars were fought between the giant s of Nedeheim and the dwarves of High Shanatar from −5360 to −5350 DR . The dwarves were led by Karlyn of House Kuldever . By the end of the war , more than five thousand giants of Nedeheim had fallen to the dwarves and half of the entire giant population south of the Cloud Peaks was exterminated . The giant realm of Nedeheim was reduced to scattered clanholds .

title: Giant bombardier beetle
description: Giant bombardier beetle The giant bombardier beetle was a variety of giant beetle . Description . Bombardier beetles were generally about 4 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Giant bombardier beetle The giant bombardier beetle was a variety of giant beetle . Description . Bombardier beetles were generally about 4 feet ( 1 . 2 meters ) long . Behavior . Unlike many beetles , bombardier beetles were solely carnivores , feeding mostly on carrion and gathering carcasses as places to lay their eggs . Ecology . Bombardier beetles were often solitary creatures . They dwelt in forests . Bombardier beetles were found in the forest of Cormanthor . They were also found in Dragon ' s Eye in the Spine of the World . Combat . Bombardier beetles were able to expel acid from their rear ends . The sound of the beetle expelling acid could be deafening . They could also emit a fire cloud to protect themselves , a few times per day . Uses . The substances inside the beetle could be retrieved from a dead specimen to create small explosives .

title: Giant cobra
description: Giant cobra Giant cobras were large venomous snakes that inhabited the lands of Zakhara . These dangerous snakes were incredibly long - lived , sometimes surviving for as long as a century . All giant cobras gained intelligence as they aged .
description_long: Giant cobra Giant cobras were large venomous snakes that inhabited the lands of Zakhara . These dangerous snakes were incredibly long - lived , sometimes surviving for as long as a century . All giant cobras gained intelligence as they aged . Description . The back of a giant cobra ’ s hood was patterned with two shapes that resembled large eyes . A typical adult giant cobra reached lengths of 12 — 14 feet . ( 3 . 7 — 7 . 3 meters ) Combat . Capable of striking with blinding speed , these snakes were dangerous combatants . Their venom was capable of killing a man — sized creature within minutes unless immediately treated . This potent venom was coveted by assassins , but degraded rapidly once extracted from the snake , becoming useless after several hours . Giant cobras were capable of charming creatures of low intelligence by swaying their hoods from side to side . They had a debilitating fear of fire and would flee at the first sign of a flame . Habitat / Society . Giant cobras were usually solitary creatures . They would mate once per year and gather in large numbers at specific locations . A female would lay between 2 — 20 eggs within shallow pit they she buried with sand .

title: Giant eagle
description: Giant eagle Giant eagles were large - sized magical beasts that resembled massive eagles . Decription . Eagles were intelligent creatures that stood about 15 feet tall and possessed a wingspan of 30 feet .
description_long: Giant eagle Giant eagles were large - sized magical beasts that resembled massive eagles . Decription . Eagles were intelligent creatures that stood about 15 feet tall and possessed a wingspan of 30 feet . A giant eagle weighed 300 pounds . Behavior . Giant eagles consider themselves to be the defenders of mountaintops and will make fast friends with any who respect and aid them in times of need . Remnis was the god of giant eagles . Ecology . Giant eagles were prized as mounts . They were the sole mounts for the Eagle Knights of Evermeet . Locations . Giant eagles were found in the Nether , Rauvin , and Ice Mountains , as well as the Spine of the World , in northwest Faerûn . They were also found in the Dragonjaw , Thesk , and Sunrise Mountains in northeast Faerûn . Giant eagles nested in Evermeet in the Guardian Trees .

title: Giant fire beetle
description: Giant fire beetle Giant fire beetles were nocturnal giant beetle s . Description . Giant fire beetles were the smallest of all the giant beetles known to scholars .
description_long: Giant fire beetle Giant fire beetles were nocturnal giant beetle s . Description . Giant fire beetles were the smallest of all the giant beetles known to scholars . They grew to be about two to two - and - a - half feet long ( 0 . 6 to 0 . 9 meters . ) The glands of the giant fire beetle were prized by adventurers and miners because of their luminous glands . These glands were located above each eye and near the abdomen and glowed a red color . If removed , the glands would continue glowing for several days . Ecology . Giant fire beetles were omnivores , but their mandibles were still strong enough to cause great injury to a human . Locations . Giant fire beetles could be found in clusters or colonies in warmer flatlands . They lived both above and below ground . Types . An intelligent variation of fire beetles were known to live in the celestial planes . These were often sent in answer to a good cleric s summoning spells .

title: Giant insect
description: Giant insect Giant insect , also known as giant vermin , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to grow centipede s , scorpions , spider s , beetle s , flies , wasp s or similar creatures to much larger than their original size . The reverse of the spell , shrink insect , could reduce giant insects down to normal size . Effects .
description_long: Giant insect Giant insect , also known as giant vermin , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to grow centipede s , scorpions , spider s , beetle s , flies , wasp s or similar creatures to much larger than their original size . The reverse of the spell , shrink insect , could reduce giant insects down to normal size . Effects . Only one type of creature could be affected per casting of these spells . The older version only worked on true insects , not spiders or scorpions which are arachnids . The giant bugs were not hostile toward the spellcaster and could follow simple commands to attack or defend , hold position , follow , etc . Components . Only verbal and somatic components , plus the priest ' s holy symbol were required to cast these spells .

title: Giant language
description: Giant language The giant language , called Jotun by those who speak it , was the ancient language of most giant s . It was one of the oldest active languages . It was believed that the language shared some of its roots with Common and Thorass .
description_long: Giant language The giant language , called Jotun by those who speak it , was the ancient language of most giant s . It was one of the oldest active languages . It was believed that the language shared some of its roots with Common and Thorass . Script . Modern Giant was written with Dethek runes . Grammar . Jotun tended to follow a subject – verb – object order , but there were exceptions . The copula , " er " , was often left out of sentences . Nouns . The plural forms of nouns varied depending on the declension . For example , the plural of " jotun " ( " giant " ) was " jotunen " , while the plural of " huslyd " ( " family " ) was " huslyder " . Verbs . Scholars have determined that verb forms in Jotun were inflected , that is , they changed form depending on the subject of the sentence . For example , the verb " fer " , " to go " , was known to have at least the following forms : The participial form " ferd " derived from the verb and meant " going " or " journey " . The infinitive form , " fer " , was used in commands , " e . g . " , " Fer zu dun heim , " " Go to your home . " Pronouns .

title: Giant mason wasp
description: Giant mason wasp Giant mason wasps were huge versions of a common mason - wasp . They could be found in Zakhara and were viewed as messengers of the gods . Description .
description_long: Giant mason wasp Giant mason wasps were huge versions of a common mason - wasp . They could be found in Zakhara and were viewed as messengers of the gods . Description . Giant mason wasps had a jet - black exoskeletons and mandibles that glowed red with heat . Combat . A bite from these creatures seared the flesh from because of the intense heat . A giant mason wasp ’ s stinger injected a dangerous toxin that caused the victim to pass out and fever . Unconsciousness lasted for a few days and the fever could kill . Those who survived were permantely weakened from the toxin . All kinds of fire was useless against these creatures . They could shoot a cone of fire from their mouths several times a day . Killing a giant mason wasp brought the " evil eye " upon the killer . Habitat / Society . These creatures lived alone in the wild within large structures made from dirt , sand and saliva . The females would mate once a month . After mating , the adult pair hunted down a large animal , paralyzed it , carried it back to her den , and the female would lay eggs on the creature . The female sealed the den to allow the eggs to hatch and feast in peace .

title: Giant owl
description: Giant owl Giant owls were magical creatures that appeared to be abnormally large owl s . Description . In addition to their great size ( 9 feet tall with a wingspan of 20 feet ) , these creatures were intelligent and capable of speech .
description_long: Giant owl Giant owls were magical creatures that appeared to be abnormally large owl s . Description . In addition to their great size ( 9 feet tall with a wingspan of 20 feet ) , these creatures were intelligent and capable of speech . Personality . Giant owls were good - natured and sought to live in harmony with the world . They opposed evil and needless destruction . Combat . Giants owls attacked by gliding above their foes and striking at them with their talons . When possible , giant owls would band together to attack in concert . Ecology . Giant owls could be trained to serve as mounts . Magic items . A number of magic items in Faerûn were able to summon giant owls :

title: Giant pantheon
description: Giant pantheon The giant pantheon ( or Ordning when used with an initial capital ) is the group of titan s worshiped by giant s and giant - kin as deities . While the specifics of worship and religious views vary from species to species and even from tribe to tribe , most giants accept that Annam All - Father , the creator of giants , is the supreme deity . It is believed that the taller the giant , the closer he is to the throne of Annam , and therefore the more superior he is .
description_long: Giant pantheon The giant pantheon ( or Ordning when used with an initial capital ) is the group of titan s worshiped by giant s and giant - kin as deities . While the specifics of worship and religious views vary from species to species and even from tribe to tribe , most giants accept that Annam All - Father , the creator of giants , is the supreme deity . It is believed that the taller the giant , the closer he is to the throne of Annam , and therefore the more superior he is . This is why Hartkiller ' s short stature meant that he was not widely accepted as a giant king . All giant deities are revered but most tribes restrict their actual worship to one or two . Each tribe has its own patron deity . Clergy . Giant priests are rarely the head of their tribes but they have the ability to overrule their tribe ' s leader if they enter into a parley with the priest of another tribe and agree on the will of Annam for any given situation . Priests are served by shamans who occupy a lesser role in giant society . Shamans are generally trained by their priests . Worship .

title: Giant spider
description: Giant spider Giant spiders were quite simply enormous versions of regular spiders . Existing in various types , there was no way to singularly describe their appearance ; with various types ranging in size from that of a dog to a house . Giant versions of tarantulas existed , as did black widows , spitters , spinners , and all manner of others .
description_long: Giant spider Giant spiders were quite simply enormous versions of regular spiders . Existing in various types , there was no way to singularly describe their appearance ; with various types ranging in size from that of a dog to a house . Giant versions of tarantulas existed , as did black widows , spitters , spinners , and all manner of others . Their appearances , habits and environments all varied greatly . Goblin s were known to employ them as mounts . Giant spiders could attack in a variety of ways , typically whatever way their normal counterparts could . Some spun huge webs that prey easily stumbled into , while others spat a deadly poison . Some were capable of walking on ceilings , while others were not . Despite the differences between the types of giant spider , allweare formidable opponents and certainly not foes for any arachnophobes to face . Due to her nature , there were bound to be giant spiders serving the goddess Lolth .

title: Giant wasp
description: Giant wasp A giant wasp is a monstrous version of the common wasp . They attack when hungry or threatened , usually taking the dead bodies of their victims to the hive where it can be consumed by young wasps . Usage .
description_long: Giant wasp A giant wasp is a monstrous version of the common wasp . They attack when hungry or threatened , usually taking the dead bodies of their victims to the hive where it can be consumed by young wasps . Usage . The Fire Knives coated their knives with the poison of giant wasps . An " Amber amulet of vermin " contained a wasp that would be released , at which point it would become a giant wasp . Locations . Giant wasps could be found in the Rimwood of Cormanthor .

title: Giants in Grey
description: Giants in Grey The Giants in Grey , or Chu Jen Yin , were a group of legendary creatures of Shou Lung . Description . The Giants were said to be of great height , standing 4 meters ( 13 .
description_long: Giants in Grey The Giants in Grey , or Chu Jen Yin , were a group of legendary creatures of Shou Lung . Description . The Giants were said to be of great height , standing 4 meters ( 13 . 1 feet ) high or taller , but humanoid in form . They wore flowing leather robes typical of a sohei , and these concealed their appearance . Most distinctively they were entirely gray in both dress and body . They were also surrounded by a thick fog . Legend . A visitation of the Giants in Grey was said to presage the occurrence of an immense tragedy . Within the Faith of the Nine Travelers , appearances of the Giants in Grey were claimed to be miracles worked by the Nine Immortals . A small sect of the faith even worshiped the Giants in Grey themselves , such as at the Temple of the Nine Travelers in Manass in Khazari . Gray - clad giants figured in Wei Tsao Te ' s " Shichi Hsi " , a collection of history , legend , and official history , amidst other fantastical matters . History . The Giants in Grey were first sighted in Shou Lung in Shou Year 703 ( −547 DR ) . A huge earthquake destroyed the province shortly afterwards .

title: Giantspire Mountains
description: Giantspire Mountains The Giantspire Mountains were located on the snowy and rugged borders of Damara and Narfell . Geography . The mountains were north of the Rawlinswood in northeastern Faerûn .
description_long: Giantspire Mountains The Giantspire Mountains were located on the snowy and rugged borders of Damara and Narfell . Geography . The mountains were north of the Rawlinswood in northeastern Faerûn . Inhabitants . Neither the Nar tribes or the people from Damara occupied these lands . The peaks were held by hobgoblin s , bugbear s , and evil cloud giant s . History . Around 1097 DR , the hobgoblins of the Giantspire Mountains assaulted the newly formed Impiltur but were driven back by the might of Warcaptain Imphras of Lyrabar . In 1127 DR , Imphras ' son , King Imbrar I , was lost in the mountains , while leading a campaign to eradicate the hobgoblin tribe . In 1372 DR , the hobgoblins of the Giantspires were led by King Kardobbik . To aid her king , Lady Farkattle animated the corpse of a very old deep dragon to instill fear in Kardobbik ' s subjects and intruders into his realm .

title: Giarrok
description: Giarrok Giarrok , commonly known as Fire - Tongue , was a gnoll sorcerer who was chieftain of the Fire Claws , a small tribe of his kin who lived in the Umar Hills in Amn . Description . As mentioned , Giarrok was almost 8 feet tall , had almost mahogany colored fur and a long black stripe down his left side .
description_long: Giarrok Giarrok , commonly known as Fire - Tongue , was a gnoll sorcerer who was chieftain of the Fire Claws , a small tribe of his kin who lived in the Umar Hills in Amn . Description . As mentioned , Giarrok was almost 8 feet tall , had almost mahogany colored fur and a long black stripe down his left side . Preferring to bare - chested to arrogantly show off his battle - scars , he wore only a ragged loincloth , a bandoleer topped with a gnoll skull and the previous chieftain ' s golden bracers to mark himself as leader . Otherwise he appeared as a typical gnoll . Personality . Having experienced only outstanding successes since his mother ' s murder , Giarrok grew incredibly arrogant . He believed himself to be the chosen of Yeenoghu and took the fear his tribe treated him with for granted , even the fear they reserved for Korrok ! Goals . Giarrok desired to capture human slaves who he would force to rebuild Fire Claw Keep and teach his warriors what they know about combat . Fire Claw Tribe . Giarrok ' s tribe was only small , consisting of 36 gnolls , only 17 of which were warriors ( and 7 of whom were female ) .

title: Gibbering mouther
description: Gibbering mouther Gibbering mouthers were unnatural aberrations , nightmarish blobs of mouths and eyes . Description . These bizarre creatures appeared as large blobs composed entirely of mouths and eyes .
description_long: Gibbering mouther Gibbering mouthers were unnatural aberrations , nightmarish blobs of mouths and eyes . Description . These bizarre creatures appeared as large blobs composed entirely of mouths and eyes . When the eyes and mouths were closed , the gibbering mouther resembled a large lump of earth . Combat . Gibbering mouthers liked to ambush prey by remaining still until their prey was within striking range . The most vulnerable area on a gibbering mouther was the brain , which was located near the center of its mass and could move around , making it difficult to strike . Gibbering mouthers could use a special babbling attack that had the same effect as the " confusion " spell . This attack assaulted potential prey every few moments , making it more difficult for them to resist . Spit from a gibbering mouther would explode with a bright flash once it struck any surface , easily blinding targets for several minutes . A gibbering mouther was able to attack with six different mouths at a time . Each mouth had a chance to latch on to the victim and begin draining their energy .

title: Gibberling
description: Gibberling Gibberlings are small , nocturnal humanoid creatures that inhabit many regions in Faerûn . Their species originates in the Far Realm , a place of madness beyond the known planes . Appearance .
description_long: Gibberling Gibberlings are small , nocturnal humanoid creatures that inhabit many regions in Faerûn . Their species originates in the Far Realm , a place of madness beyond the known planes . Appearance . The first impression of gibberlings is of a writhing mass of fur and flesh . The pandemonium is actually a mass of pale , hunchbacked humanoids , with pointed ears , black manes and grinning faces . Their eyes are black , and shine with a maniacal gleam . Habitat and Society . It is difficult to imagine a gibberling social structure . There is no sense , no organization , and no individuality . Though they clearly have a primitive means of communicating among themselves , they have no discernable language . The only true hope of survival , should a herd of gibberlings be encountered , is to take strategic advantage of their fear of bright light . The gibberlings generally frequent only dense forests and subterranean passages , loathing bright light of all kinds , and are particularly afraid of fire . If found during the day gibberlings awake , but generally cower in fear at the bright light surrounding them . Combat .

title: Gideon Holke
description: Gideon Holke Gideon Holke was a military captain in Mulmaster . Personality . Gideon had recently grown in influence , especially with some of Mulmaster ' s wealthiest and most beautiful women .
description_long: Gideon Holke Gideon Holke was a military captain in Mulmaster . Personality . Gideon had recently grown in influence , especially with some of Mulmaster ' s wealthiest and most beautiful women . He was deeply concerned that something could end all . His rapid career had created a few enemies in the Soldiery . Activities . Gideon was a skilled fighter in Mulmaster ' s Soldiery . History . In 1491 DR , he was promoted to captain with orders to maintain safe trading routes , in order to increasing the city ' s reputation and trade . He did a good job , even considering wealthy visitors ' needs above of those of Mulmaster ' s citizens . However , there was an increase in bandit activities and he hired an adventuring party to clear the area .

title: Gideona
description: Gideona Lochlord Gideona was the leader of the Keepers in Skullport in 1370 DR . Personality . Gideona ' s ambition was that , within the next decade , all overland routes and gates along the River Sargauth would fall under the Keepers ' control , permitting her to control all trade in and around the city .
description_long: Gideona Lochlord Gideona was the leader of the Keepers in Skullport in 1370 DR . Personality . Gideona ' s ambition was that , within the next decade , all overland routes and gates along the River Sargauth would fall under the Keepers ' control , permitting her to control all trade in and around the city .

title: Gifu
description: Gifu Gifu was the shogun capital of Kozakura from 1046 DR . Gifu was in Tairayama Province near the Moro Province border . It was selected because was at center of lands controlled by Hojo clan .
description_long: Gifu Gifu was the shogun capital of Kozakura from 1046 DR . Gifu was in Tairayama Province near the Moro Province border . It was selected because was at center of lands controlled by Hojo clan . after Hojo war however the city fall under total control of Takenaka Okawa

title: Gilded Gown of Selussa
description: Gilded Gown of Selussa The Gilded Gown of Selussa was a tight gauzy dress made of mithral . Abilities . The garment was protected the wearer from wounds and reflected " magic missile " spells back to the casters .
description_long: Gilded Gown of Selussa The Gilded Gown of Selussa was a tight gauzy dress made of mithral . Abilities . The garment was protected the wearer from wounds and reflected " magic missile " spells back to the casters . History . Around 1370 DR , the gown was wore by Sarya Dlardrageth in the ruins of Hellgate Keep .

title: Gilded Palm
description: Gilded Palm The Gilded Palm was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of fruitfulness . The symbol and favored weapon of the Gilded Palm was a dagger that had a coin - encrusted hilt . Activities .
description_long: Gilded Palm The Gilded Palm was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of fruitfulness . The symbol and favored weapon of the Gilded Palm was a dagger that had a coin - encrusted hilt . Activities . The practices of the Guilded Palm almost made them appear as a group of assassins who could be hired . Holy slayers of the Gilded Palms regularly took jobs from merchants and other businessmen , since they believed anything that hindered bounty should be destroyed . Base of Operations . Agents of the Gilded Palm were found throughout Zakhara .

title: Gilded Spur
description: Gilded Spur The Gilded Spur was an inn in Amnwater , Amn . Services . The establishment offered gambling facilities aimed at the passing caravan trade , but this made it less popular with locals .
description_long: Gilded Spur The Gilded Spur was an inn in Amnwater , Amn . Services . The establishment offered gambling facilities aimed at the passing caravan trade , but this made it less popular with locals . Inhabitants . The hostess was Krigar , whose lover was the proprietor , Lord Jhanos Yhliivast . History . As of 1368 DR , it was the largest and the newest inn in Amnwater , owned and operated by the Yhliivast family .

title: Gildenglade
description: Gildenglade Gildenglade was a settlement in the forest area at the foot of the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish . This city was the second - largest within Turmish , composed of dwarves , elves , and half - elves living together in harmony . Its economy was based primarily upon woodcutting and mining .
description_long: Gildenglade Gildenglade was a settlement in the forest area at the foot of the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish . This city was the second - largest within Turmish , composed of dwarves , elves , and half - elves living together in harmony . Its economy was based primarily upon woodcutting and mining . Hierarchy . The elves of the community served as rulers , their skill with preservation allowing them to handle negotiations with the Emerald Enclave . They also were used as a woodcutting force , but they enjoyed their work and were not mistreated . Dwarves of the city mainly concentrated on mining the unusually pure veins of gold underneath Gildenglade . Half - elves served as the physical labor force for their kin ' s forrestry efforts . Recent History . Given the amount of wealth in Gildenglade , it is not surprising that tales of treasure had arisen over the years . By chance , a few of these rumors had been given credence . The most recent occurred when a visitor to Gildenglade followed a phantom who traversed the streets with sacks of gold . The specter turned out to be a crimson death , with the greedy tourist quickly becoming the creature ' s meal .

title: Gildmak Sholapur
description: Gildmak Sholapur Gildmak Sholapur was a prominent halfling businessman in Luiren in 1367 DR . He was the leader of a group of brewers . Activities .
description_long: Gildmak Sholapur Gildmak Sholapur was a prominent halfling businessman in Luiren in 1367 DR . He was the leader of a group of brewers . Activities . Gildmak ' s claim to fame was his brewery in Luiren , which was the largest of its kind throughout the entirety of the Shining South . The brewery specialized in the production of Luiren Stout .

title: Giles Wormack
description: Giles Wormack Giles Wormack was a human boy during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Giles lived with his sister Karolina Wormack in Sundabar .
description_long: Giles Wormack Giles Wormack was a human boy during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Giles lived with his sister Karolina Wormack in Sundabar . They assisted knight - commander Aleina Brightlance with her speech just before the fall of the city .

title: Gilfron Milon
description: Gilfron Milon Gilfron Milon was a merchant in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Gilfron was a friendly and pleasant individual .
description_long: Gilfron Milon Gilfron Milon was a merchant in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Gilfron was a friendly and pleasant individual . However , knowing that the roads were dangerous , he was cautious with every stranger . He pretended to be of a higher class than he was , pretending to speak with a false educated air . Activities . Gilfron was a merchant of tools and lumber from Quivering Forest , traveling along the Iron Route that connected all Moonsea ' s cities . He had many dealings with Lords ' Alliance . History . In 1489 DR , leading a small caravan from Hillsfar to Phlan , he met an adventuring party hired to investigate rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships wandering the area . Gilfron directed them to a suspicious island ferry . Relationship . Gilfron had a ten - year - old son Gilmont Milon who always traveled with him after his wife died of fever in around 1486 DR .

title: Gilgeam
description: Gilgeam Gilgeam , the God - king of Unther , was a demigod and the former leader of the Untheric pantheon . He was known for his jealousy , cruelty and pride . A former intermediate deity , he was reduced to the state of demigod after the Time of Troubles due to his centuries - long abuse of his followers .
description_long: Gilgeam Gilgeam , the God - king of Unther , was a demigod and the former leader of the Untheric pantheon . He was known for his jealousy , cruelty and pride . A former intermediate deity , he was reduced to the state of demigod after the Time of Troubles due to his centuries - long abuse of his followers . He was killed not long after by his life - long nemesis Tiamat . A second incarnation of Gilgeam appeared in the world of Abeir in the century that followed the Spellplague . This incarnation of Gilgeam was brought back to the world of Toril during the Second Sundering . Description . Gilgeam ' s first incarnation avatar was a handsome , tall and muscular human with golden hair and beard . Gilgeam ' s second incarnation had very much the same appearance , with the difference that he was shaved and had no hair in his head . Worshipers . All the people living in Unther , from noble to peasant , was nominally a follower of Gilgeam , even if that wasn ' t actually true . Relationships . Gilgeam was a son of Enlil , and thus a brother of Enki . Gilgeam has had a long and contentious relationship with Tiamat , their avatars having battled with each other numerous times .

title: Gilkriz
description: Gilkriz Gilkriz was a senior member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Gilkriz was chosen by Master Urlryn Khalazza to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .
description_long: Gilkriz Gilkriz was a senior member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Gilkriz was chosen by Master Urlryn Khalazza to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: Gillian ' s Hill
description: Gillian ' s Hill Gillian ' s Hill was a hamlet about a half - day ' s ride south of Daggerford on the Trade Way and about the same distance north of Liam ' s Hold . The hamlet was named for Gillian Cantilar . There was an ancient and dangerous tomb in Gillian ' s Hill that led to the Underdark .
description_long: Gillian ' s Hill Gillian ' s Hill was a hamlet about a half - day ' s ride south of Daggerford on the Trade Way and about the same distance north of Liam ' s Hold . The hamlet was named for Gillian Cantilar . There was an ancient and dangerous tomb in Gillian ' s Hill that led to the Underdark . Formerly held by illithid s , the tomb was cleared by a band of adventurers in the mid - 1300s DR . The tomb was later spell - guarded to warn of entry from below but it was far from safe . Additionally , there was a noted antique shop , Torleth ' s Treasures , in Gillian ' s Hill owned by Torleth Mindulspeer .

title: Gim Blacktongue
description: Gim Blacktongue Gim Blacktongue was a mage and ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Gim Blacktongue was a cunning mage who used treachery to usurp the throne of Doegan . Although the kingdom prospered , it did so under an air of suspicion , and Doegan folk called for a new and trustworthy rule .
description_long: Gim Blacktongue Gim Blacktongue was a mage and ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Gim Blacktongue was a cunning mage who used treachery to usurp the throne of Doegan . Although the kingdom prospered , it did so under an air of suspicion , and Doegan folk called for a new and trustworthy rule . The commander of the Legendary Campaign came to Doegan and attempted to remove Blacktongue from power .

title: Gina bint Kemala
description: Gina bint Kemala Gina bint Kemala was a human mystic and member of the Readers in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Her long black hair began to streak with grey as she approached middle age .
description_long: Gina bint Kemala Gina bint Kemala was a human mystic and member of the Readers in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Her long black hair began to streak with grey as she approached middle age . Her sharp eyes and commanding voice instantly grabbed the attention of anyone with whom she spoke . Gina favored a turquoise blue " aba " . Activities . Gina worshiped Zann and was the leader of the Readers in 1367 . She drew her power from mathematics and practicing " al - jebr w ' al muqabala " , or the art of knitting opposites together . Her collection of algebraic texts was one of the largest in all of the Land of Fate . Some of her prized volumes originated from Afyal , the Haunted Lands , Ruined Kingdoms , and she even owned a few drow textbooks . She spent most of her time within the Mosque of Zann the Wise , but could be found lecturing people in the public gardens . Her pursuit of mathematics often led her to hire experienced adventurers to retrieve texts from dangerous locales . Possessions . Gina owned a " ring of protection + 3 " , a " staff of command " , a " gem of seeing " , and carried a variety of magical scroll s .

title: Ginafae DeVir
description: Ginafae DeVir Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of House DeVir in Menzoberranzan until its destruction in 1297 DR . History . In 1297 DR , Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of the fourth house and thus the youngest matron in the Ruling Council .
description_long: Ginafae DeVir Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of House DeVir in Menzoberranzan until its destruction in 1297 DR . History . In 1297 DR , Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of the fourth house and thus the youngest matron in the Ruling Council . During a drow raid against svirfneblin , she used her clerical powers to aid the deep gnomes ( the drow ' s greatest enemies ) so that they would kill the wizard son of the third house , House DeVir ' s chosen enemy . In doing so , Ginafae lost the favor of Lolth . Her house was subsequently destroyed by House Do ' Urden . Ginafae herself was killed by Zaknafein Do ' Urden , who used his whip to take out her tongue as she tried to cast a spell . After her death , Ginafae ' s ghost was summoned by her son , Alton DeVir , who was attempting to learn the identity of the house that destroyed House DeVir . Before she could answer , however , a yochlol interrupted and revealed that as a fallen priestess , Ginafae was continuously tormented in the Abyss . Relationships . Ginafae had two living daughters in 1297 DR . Alton DeVir was her son .

title: Ginali
description: Ginali Ginali was a servant of the High Imperceptor of Bane , known himself as the High Inquisitor of Bane , and an orthodox Banite . History . In 1357 DR , he was charged with conducting an investigation into the fitness of Fzoul Chembryl to be head of the church in the West Moonsea region .
description_long: Ginali Ginali was a servant of the High Imperceptor of Bane , known himself as the High Inquisitor of Bane , and an orthodox Banite . History . In 1357 DR , he was charged with conducting an investigation into the fitness of Fzoul Chembryl to be head of the church in the West Moonsea region . Once it was clear that Fzoul would not rejoin the orthodox church , the " investigation " became more of a witch hunt , with Ginali torturing and murdering those loyal to Fzoul in an effort to persuade his followers to abandon him . Ginali and his followers briefly took over the Black Altar , while Fzoul was distracted by the attempted capture of Shandril Shessair , but was evicted when Fzoul refocused on the goings - on in the Keep . In response , Ginali ordered the construction of a second temple to Bane within the city that would cleave to orthodox teachings . By 1367 DR , Ginali was missing , presumed dead . Personality . Described in one source as appearing like a " pot - bellied spider at the center of its web " and an " epitome of evil " , all of Ginali ' s overtures of reunification were rejected .

title: Gindrol
description: Gindrol Gindrol was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Gindrol was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee .
description_long: Gindrol Gindrol was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Gindrol was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee . Arriving near the temple , Kâras decided that he , Gindrol , and Talzir should polymorph into deep gnome s , allies of the Crones of Kiaransalee , and infiltrate the temple .

title: Ginella
description: Ginella Ginella was the chief of the staff of Helm Dwarf - Friend in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Ginella was a burly and severe elder woman .
description_long: Ginella Ginella was the chief of the staff of Helm Dwarf - Friend in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Ginella was a burly and severe elder woman . History . In 1373 DR , Ginella greatly suspected the new companion of her lord , and she was right , because it was Aliisza in disguise . Ginella made it her duty to watch her . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Gingerbread
description: Gingerbread Gingerbread was a cake - like bread made with ginger from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Gingerbread Gingerbread was a cake - like bread made with ginger from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . The use of ginger gave a very distinctive flavor to this bread . It was suggested that gingerbred be served topped with whipped cream or rum sauce . When purchased from Aurora ' s Catalogue , gingerbread came in a reusable tin , whose lid was adorned with Aurora ' s company logo .

title: Gingrid
description: Gingrid Gingrid was a strange follower of Myrkul who lived in the Underchasm in 1486 DR . History . Gingrid resided in a castle in Underchasm , just above the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple , waiting for a sign from her presumed - lost god .
description_long: Gingrid Gingrid was a strange follower of Myrkul who lived in the Underchasm in 1486 DR . History . Gingrid resided in a castle in Underchasm , just above the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple , waiting for a sign from her presumed - lost god . In 1486 DR , she met a group of Chosen : Arietta Seasilver , follower of Siamorphe ; Malik el Sami , follower of Cyric ; Joelle Emmeline , follower of Sune ; and Kleef Kenric , paladin follower of the dead god Helm . Gingrid helped them , telling them how to get down to the temple .

title: Giogioni Wyvernspur
description: Giogioni Wyvernspur Giogioni Wyvernspur ( Giogi for short ) is the head of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . He is capable of transforming into a wyvern when he is in possession of the mummified wyvern ' s claw that is an heirloom in his family . Only one in every generation is capable of this transformation .
description_long: Giogioni Wyvernspur Giogioni Wyvernspur ( Giogi for short ) is the head of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . He is capable of transforming into a wyvern when he is in possession of the mummified wyvern ' s claw that is an heirloom in his family . Only one in every generation is capable of this transformation . Relatives . Giogi ' s wife is Cat , one of Finder ' s daughters and sister to Alias . Appearance . Giogi wears leather breeches , a purple shirt with a sash and half - cloak , and battered brown boots . His face is far different from the majority of those of his family , lacking the hawknose , etc . for a softer set of features . Giogi comes across as a bit of a fop , but his muscletone and fighting prowess prove differently .

title: Girallon
description: Girallon Girallons were aggressive , carnivorous apes with four arms . They were incredibly strong and territorial . These beasts lived in groups dominated by the strongest male .
description_long: Girallon Girallons were aggressive , carnivorous apes with four arms . They were incredibly strong and territorial . These beasts lived in groups dominated by the strongest male . An adult girallon was about 8 feet tall and weighed 800 pounds . It appeared to be a four armed ape with thick white fur and curved horns on its head . The exotic appearance of these beasts often attracted big game hunters to seek them out as trophies .

title: Girdle of priestly might
description: Girdle of priestly might Girdles of Priestly Might were magical items that could be found in Halruaa . History . These items only appeared after the Time of Troubles .
description_long: Girdle of priestly might Girdles of Priestly Might were magical items that could be found in Halruaa . History . These items only appeared after the Time of Troubles . Halruaans believed this to be a clear sign that their goddess Mystra had finally regained her powers . The existence of these items was one of the reasons that the worship of Azuth did not gain more support from Halruaa . Description . Each girdle was marked with a symbol of good or evil that was bonded to its front . Someone attempting to wear a girdle that opposed the true nature of their heart was cursed , effectively blocking that priest from receiving all but the most basic spells from their god or goddess until an " atonement " spell was cast upon them . Powers . Three versions of this magical item existed : Girdle of Priestly Might . This item imbued the wearer with the physical strength of a fierce warrior and helped protect them against attacks . Girdle of Priestly Warding . In addition to the powers granted by the Girdle of Priestly Might , this girdle protected the wearer against evil or good . Girdle of Holy Might .

title: Girru
description: Girru Girru was the Untheric god of fire . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was an axe wrapped in flame .
description_long: Girru Girru was the Untheric god of fire . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was an axe wrapped in flame . Description . Girru manifested as a human male . He can shapeshift at will and teleport himself into nearby flames . It was impossible to approach him without taking damage from his intense heat . He fought with a mace that had an unlimited number of poisoned barbs that broke off in the wounds it made . He also fought with an axe . Any weapon that touched his body would disintegrate , though after causing damage . History . Girru presumedly came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " . He was killed by one of the orcish gods in - 1071 DR , and his body was laid to rest in a God - Tomb in Unther .

title: Gisbertus
description: Gisbertus Gisbertus was the bugbear steward and chamberlain of queen Zaranda Star . Personality . Gisbertus fretted over the other servants and often took it upon himself to cook for the queen , being an expert cook .
description_long: Gisbertus Gisbertus was the bugbear steward and chamberlain of queen Zaranda Star . Personality . Gisbertus fretted over the other servants and often took it upon himself to cook for the queen , being an expert cook . His most notable feature was perhaps his articulate and refined manner of speech . History . In Hammer of 1370 DR , master chef Thundaerl returned to Tethyr and offered his services to the queen . This caused a conflict with Gisbertus , who did not want to give up his kitchens . In the end , Thundaerl became the chef of the Great Hall while Gisbertus remained the head chef for the palace of Faerntarn itself .

title: Giselle Malcomb
description: Giselle Malcomb Giselle Malcomb was a Rider of Nesmé . Description . Giselle was strong and solidly built .
description_long: Giselle Malcomb Giselle Malcomb was a Rider of Nesmé . Description . Giselle was strong and solidly built . She had long , dark brown hair and gray eyes , and the skin of her face was ruddy from her time spent riding in the wilds . History . In 1484 DR , Giselle was meeting with Chieftain Targ Keifer of Griffon ' s Nest when the Companions of the Hall arrived . Upon seeing Drizzt Do ' Urden , she became angry with him , blaming him for the existence of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows and the Darkening . She claimed she had heard the orc s speak of Matron Mother Darthiir Do ' Urden . When the Companions left Griffon ' s Nest soon after , she trailed them . When Regis approached her , she reached for an arrow to attack him , but he sedated her with sleep poison . She woke inside the Companions ' wagon with an injured knee . She was further injured when the group was attacked by orcs , but eventually they all arrived in Nesmé in one piece . Some weeks later , after the Companions left Nesmé , the city was overtaken by the orcs of Many - Arrows . The surviving 600 inhabitants , including Giselle , were taken captive .

title: Gisen
description: Gisen Gisen , known in Kozakura as Kuang , was an exiled prince of T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Gisen was born in the royal court of T ' u Lung as the third son of the emperor , tutored by the great sword master Tong Fu Mei .
description_long: Gisen Gisen , known in Kozakura as Kuang , was an exiled prince of T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Gisen was born in the royal court of T ' u Lung as the third son of the emperor , tutored by the great sword master Tong Fu Mei . One day , during a sea trip disguised as a trader captain , he saved a girl from pirates and discovered after falling in love with her that she was the princess of Shou Lung , the eternal rival of T ' u Lung . They loved each other in secret for some time until the traveling minstrel Tam Nong Hikong used their story as the subject of one of her songs . Soon , the Shou Emperor deduced the truth , the princess was exiled far away , and her eldest brother sent assassins against Gisen . Gisen escaped thanks to Tong and started wandering to Kozakura and Wa , hoping to find powerful allies for his cause . In disguise as a young eastern physician , Kuang , he met Doin Sanehiro and The Wanderer just after the Battle of Kiroshima and became his companion in the fight against Jinchin . After the conclusion of that adventure , Gisen decided to to back to T ' u Lung to fight for his princess . Personality .

title: Gith
description: Gith Gith was one of the leaders of the thrall rebellion that toppled the illithid empire thousands of years in the past and the first leader of the githyanki . History . Gith was a native of the planet Pharagos , which was part of the vast illithid empire , although she later led her followers to the Astral Plane after defeating their illithid masters .
description_long: Gith Gith was one of the leaders of the thrall rebellion that toppled the illithid empire thousands of years in the past and the first leader of the githyanki . History . Gith was a native of the planet Pharagos , which was part of the vast illithid empire , although she later led her followers to the Astral Plane after defeating their illithid masters . After the People defeated the illithid empire , Gith , a leader of the rebellion , insisted that all remaining illithids in the multiverse be hunted down and destroyed ; then , the People would be free to conquer all planes of existence . Many of the People ' s hearts shared this goal . However , another leader , Zerthimon , argued that the People were already free and should instead start mending the damage done to their race . He too expressed a goal that was in the hearts of many of the People . Still , Gith insisted that hers was the only path and that they would be " under the same sky " in the matter . Zerthimon then told Gith that there " cannot be two skies .

title: Gith ( race )
description: Gith ( race ) The gith ( they referred to themselves as “ the People ” ) are a group of natural outsider s , descended from human s enslaved by the illithid s . The gith are divided into two different races , the githzerai and githyanki . Additionally , there are gith who went their own ways after the gith split .
description_long: Gith ( race ) The gith ( they referred to themselves as “ the People ” ) are a group of natural outsider s , descended from human s enslaved by the illithid s . The gith are divided into two different races , the githzerai and githyanki . Additionally , there are gith who went their own ways after the gith split . These powerful individualists are not precisely a " race , " but are collectively referred to as githvyrik . History . The gith were once slaves to the illithid s , a race of powerful telepaths who mentally enslaved sentient humanoids to work as the backbone of their vast worlds - spanning empire . It is believed these slaves were originally humans transformed through selective breeding . Eventually , these slaves developed mental resistance to their masters ' mind control and , under the guidance of their leader Gith , revolted , causing the downfall of the illithid empire . Gith , however , was not satisfied with the destruction of the illithids alone , and sought to spread the war to any race that could potentially enslave her people again .

title: Githyanki
description: Githyanki The githyanki were a once - human race of Astral Sea - dwellers . Ecology . All githyanki children possessed minor telekinetic abilities , but only a few worked to develop them .
description_long: Githyanki The githyanki were a once - human race of Astral Sea - dwellers . Ecology . All githyanki children possessed minor telekinetic abilities , but only a few worked to develop them . Githyanki generally preferred magic over psionics . Culture . Githyanki society was martial , with both males and females training heavily in magic and combat . Although they were loyal to each other , they were also fiercely individualistic . Raiding illithid strongholds was considered a rite of passage . Dwelling in the timeless Astral Plane , the githyanki inhabited numerous fortresses constructed from materials imported to the plane as well as cities built atop god - isles , the vast stone corpses of deceased deities . Their capital and largest city , Tu ' narath , was built on the god - isle of a deceased power known only as the One in the Void . The githyanki used a unique form of writing called " tir ' su " . It was an alphabetical set of runes in which words were formed in circles instead of linearly , with the letters of a given word being linked in a ring clockwise from the top . Sentences were formed by a series of these rings .

title: Githyanki hideout
description: Githyanki hideout Githyanki hideout was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Merchant Quarter in Neverwinter , near the Smuggler ' s warehouse .
description_long: Githyanki hideout Githyanki hideout was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Merchant Quarter in Neverwinter , near the Smuggler ' s warehouse . Structure . The hideout was built from wood . Interior . The hideout had many rooms and halls , where the githyanki resided . History . Once the Kalach - Cha defeated the Luskanites at the Sea Ghost , Brelaina tasked him / her to get into the hideout , since they couldn ' t allow assassins to roam Neverwinter . Inside , the Kalach - Cha slayed many githyanki . In one room , a construct appeared and killed some githyanki , then attacked the Kalach - Cha . Once the construct was badly damaged , it retreated back to the portal .

title: Githyanki silver sword
description: Githyanki silver sword Githyanki " silver swords " were weapons given to the knights and leaders of the githyanki race . They were powerful magic al greatsword s that came in two varieties , depending on the wielder ' s rank . Their most notable property was the ability to sever an individual ' s silver cord .
description_long: Githyanki silver sword Githyanki " silver swords " were weapons given to the knights and leaders of the githyanki race . They were powerful magic al greatsword s that came in two varieties , depending on the wielder ' s rank . Their most notable property was the ability to sever an individual ' s silver cord . Cultural Significance . Allegedly based on the " Silver Sword of Gith " , every githyanki ' Knight ' ( warrior champions in service to the Lich Queen ) , was given one of these weapons once they achieved a certain level of power . Leaders of githyanki communities carried even more powerful versions of the weapon that could cut the silver cords of those who had protected themselves from such attacks and were enchanted to increase the likelyhood of decapitating an opponent . No owner of a " silver sword " would ever willingly allow a non - githyanki to hold their weapon . If any ' greater ' " silver sword " found its way into the hands of a non - githyanki , elite squadrons of githyanki were sent by a furious Lich Queen to take it back at any cost . If the squad sent failed to retrieve it , they would be executed .

title: Githzerai
description: Githzerai The githzerai are a once - human race that dwells primarily on the plane of Limbo . Description . Githzerai are naturally possessed of psionics and some magic resistance .
description_long: Githzerai The githzerai are a once - human race that dwells primarily on the plane of Limbo . Description . Githzerai are naturally possessed of psionics and some magic resistance . Combat . They tend to train in martial combat and many fight as monk s . Society . Githzerai society is very monastic and introspective . Many githzerai train as Monks , while others choose to lose their natural magic resistance and become Wizard s . Some multi - talented githzerai become zerth s , blending magic , combat , and psionics into their fighting . The zerths also hold special significance as religious leaders in githzerai society . Like their cousins and enemies , the githyanki , githzerai often form hunting bands for the purpose of seeking out and destroying the hated illithid s . The githzerai dwell mostly in the chaos of Limbo , using their natural psionic abilities and mental focus to form the swirling chaos of the plane into great fortresses and monasteries . There are a number of githzerai settlements located in the Elemental Chaos . History . The Githzerai and the Githyanki were once one race referred to as the People .

title: Glabbagool
description: Glabbagool Glabbagool was an unusual sentient gelatinous cube in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The arrive of the demon lord Juiblex somehow granted Glabbagool intelligence .
description_long: Glabbagool Glabbagool was an unusual sentient gelatinous cube in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The arrive of the demon lord Juiblex somehow granted Glabbagool intelligence . It wanted to avoid fighting , however , and was genuinely curious about the world and the people that inhabited it . History . Glabbagool was a gelatinous cube in the Silken Paths . With the Rage of Demons , it was granted sentience . It may have met and befriended a party of adventurers escaping the drow slavers of Velkynvelve , even offering to travel with them .

title: Glabrezu
description: Glabrezu A glabrezu , also known as a type IV demon , was powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . A glabrezu ' s broad , muscular body was as large as a giant .
description_long: Glabrezu A glabrezu , also known as a type IV demon , was powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . A glabrezu ' s broad , muscular body was as large as a giant . It had two pairs of arms : the small set was humanoid ending in hands , while the other set was monstrous and ended in a pair of crab - like pincers . Its canine head was horned and it had a muzzle full of sharp teeth . Its skin was in the range of deep russet to pitch black . Its intelligent eyes were violet . A glabrezu stood 9 to 15 feet tall and weighed 5 , 500 pounds . Personality . A glabrezu tempted its victims into ruin by luring them with power or wealth . Their imposing stature radiated authority and control , which they use to sway mortals into accepting their gifts . . . for a price . They used lies and deception to destroy the lives of all whom they meet . Despite their physical prowess , glabrezus preferred to work behind the scenes , both on the Prime Material Plane and in the Abyss . They rarely led , but rather acted as advisors , chief lieutenants , and spies for more powerful demons .

title: Glacier of the Dragon
description: Glacier of the Dragon The Glacier of the Dragon was a large glacier located within A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan of the Yehimal . Geography . This glacier had the shape of a serpent if viewed from above , making many believed that this was where its name orginated .
description_long: Glacier of the Dragon The Glacier of the Dragon was a large glacier located within A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan of the Yehimal . Geography . This glacier had the shape of a serpent if viewed from above , making many believed that this was where its name orginated . Inhabitants . White dragon s used the Glacier of the Dragon as a site for a major breeding ground . Miles of honey - combed chambers could be found beneath the surface of the glacier , many used as rookeries for the dragons . In order to increase the protection of their young , the white dragons allowed the presence of other dangerous creatures such as yeti , cave bears , snow leopards , and greater oni .

title: Glacier of the Lost King
description: Glacier of the Lost King The Glacier of the Lost King was located in the western reaches of what was once known as the kingdom of Guge . Description . The glacier rested upon the southwestern rim of the Hollow Crown Mountains .
