description_long: Glacier of the Lost King The Glacier of the Lost King was located in the western reaches of what was once known as the kingdom of Guge . Description . The glacier rested upon the southwestern rim of the Hollow Crown Mountains . Rumors and Legends . Local rumor stated that this was the place where Kalon Doring , the last king of Guge , disappeared after having been driven mad by the gods for challenging the armies of the Celestial Emperor . The spirits , the king , and his men were said to roam the glacier , cursed to hate all life of the " warmlanders " as punishment by the gods .

title: Glacier of the White Worm
description: Glacier of the White Worm The Glacier of the White Worm was a glacier situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in north Faerûn , lying between the Moonsea , Damara , Impiltur , and the Vast . Geography . The glacier was a great river of ice that weaved between the tallest mountains of the Earthspurs .
description_long: Glacier of the White Worm The Glacier of the White Worm was a glacier situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in north Faerûn , lying between the Moonsea , Damara , Impiltur , and the Vast . Geography . The glacier was a great river of ice that weaved between the tallest mountains of the Earthspurs . On the north - west side , it flowed over a high cliff and spilled into the Moonsea . In the east , it flowed into Lake Icemelt , which lay in the mountains between Damara and Impiltur . The ice covered an area of approximately 1200 square miles ( ~ 1040 square kilometers ) . As old histories and maps recorded , it was once a part of the Great Glacier , the much larger icesheet that lay some 400 miles ( 640 kilometers ) to the north . Curiously , the Glacier of the White Worm survived at a much lower latitude than its altitude allowed , suggesting that magic or some other force might be involved . Notable Locations . The Monastery of the Yellow Rose , also known as the Citadel of the White Worm , lay east of the Glacier of the White Worm .

title: Glade
description: Glade The Glade was an area of trees in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . The location contained a small stream and a lake , and was where sylvan races like centaur s and faun s often chose to stay while visiting .
description_long: Glade The Glade was an area of trees in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . The location contained a small stream and a lake , and was where sylvan races like centaur s and faun s often chose to stay while visiting . It was the most peaceful place in the city .

title: Gladiator
description: Gladiator A gladiator was an occupation and prestige class . Summary . Gladiators were creatures , often humanoid , who fought other creatures for the amusement of others .
description_long: Gladiator A gladiator was an occupation and prestige class . Summary . Gladiators were creatures , often humanoid , who fought other creatures for the amusement of others . While gladiatorial contests were forbidden in many civilized lands , as of 1479 DR they remained popular in Calimport , where the Pasha Marod el Arhapan held a large number of games in a floating arena . Due to their size and strength goliath s made perfect gladiators . Slavers were known to steal goliath infants and raise them as brutal fighters for the arena .

title: Gladsheim
description: Gladsheim Gladsheim , also referred to as Ysgard , was the Great Wheel plane straddling the alignments of chaotic good and chaotic neutral . Like the Greek influence on Olympus / Arvandor , much of this plane was heavily dominated by the gods of the Norse pantheon who had little interaction with the people of Toril . The primary exception was Tyr , the Norse god of war and law who became known and widely worshiped as the God of Justice in the Forgotten Realms .
description_long: Gladsheim Gladsheim , also referred to as Ysgard , was the Great Wheel plane straddling the alignments of chaotic good and chaotic neutral . Like the Greek influence on Olympus / Arvandor , much of this plane was heavily dominated by the gods of the Norse pantheon who had little interaction with the people of Toril . The primary exception was Tyr , the Norse god of war and law who became known and widely worshiped as the God of Justice in the Forgotten Realms . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Arvandor , Brightwater , Gates of the Moon , and Jotunheim when that cosmology model became popular . When the Spellplague hit the cosmos , Brightwater merged with the Gates of the Moon which survived , along with Arvandor . Jotunheim was cast into the Elemental Chaos but only parts of it survived as described by the World Axis cosmology model . Description . The three layers of Gladsheim consisted of tremendous rivers of earth and stone that formed cosmic arches through the void , like very tightly packed asteroid belts .

title: Glaedorn
description: Glaedorn Glaedorn was a cave located somewhere in the Howling Mountains section of Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . The cave was full of rich veins of metal ores and huge gem stones . Background .
description_long: Glaedorn Glaedorn was a cave located somewhere in the Howling Mountains section of Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . The cave was full of rich veins of metal ores and huge gem stones . Background . It was believed that there were at least different six entrances to this cave , located in various points of the Howling Mountains . Some also believed that the gemstones were in fact the severed fingers of a primordial , because the gemstones moved on their own accord . History . The cave was named for Glae Dorn , the presumed dwarf that first found the cave in ancient times .

title: Glaemril
description: Glaemril The Glaemril , also known as the Deeping Stream , was a small river that ran through the Dalelands . The river started in the southern spur of the woods of Cormanthor and flowed into the River Ashaba , just before the Pool of Yeven . Uses .
description_long: Glaemril The Glaemril , also known as the Deeping Stream , was a small river that ran through the Dalelands . The river started in the southern spur of the woods of Cormanthor and flowed into the River Ashaba , just before the Pool of Yeven . Uses . The town of Highmoon used the river as its main water source . Fishing . The Glaemril had abundant salmon that was readily caught . Crossing . The river could be crossed at a ford just north of Highmoon .

title: Glaive
description: Glaive A glaive was a reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . The glaive was a pole arm that , in its basic form , was a large knife mounted on a long pole .
description_long: Glaive A glaive was a reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . The glaive was a pole arm that , in its basic form , was a large knife mounted on a long pole . The blade was often augmented with a back spike , perpendicular to the blade or angled forward . An average glaive cost 8gp and weighed 10lbs ( 4 . 5kg ) . Use . The glaive was a two - handed melee weapon with a 10 foot ( 3 meter ) reach . Because it was a pole arm , it couldn ' t be used to attack adjacent foes . They were most effective in large numbers in a phalanx , or when they could be set against a charging opponent . Even though the tip of the blade was sharp and the back spike could be swung to penetrate armor , the glaive was considered a slashing weapon . Realmslore . Bearded devil s were known to carry sawtooth glaives . Notable glaives . The tiefling warrior Havilar carried a glaive she referred to as " Devil Slayer " .

title: Glamered
description: Glamered Glamered armor is quite useful for intrusion , as it can transform itself upon command to take the form of ordinary clothing . Creation . He who would craft " glamered " armor must know the spell " disguise self " .
description_long: Glamered Glamered armor is quite useful for intrusion , as it can transform itself upon command to take the form of ordinary clothing . Creation . He who would craft " glamered " armor must know the spell " disguise self " . Activation . Upon the wearer ' s command , " glamered " armor changes form , taking the shape of a set of ordinary clothing . Its other physical properties , however , such as mass and level of protection , remain the same . When disguised , " glamered " armor can only be revealed as such by a " true seeing " spell or similar magic .

title: Glamered ( armor property )
description: Glamered ( armor property ) Glamered is a quality that can be applied to masterwork armor , granting the wearer the ability to hide his or her armor from sight . If the wearer gives a predetermined command , the armor transmutes itself into outwardly normal clothing . It retains all other properties , including weight , hardness , and so on .
description_long: Glamered ( armor property ) Glamered is a quality that can be applied to masterwork armor , granting the wearer the ability to hide his or her armor from sight . If the wearer gives a predetermined command , the armor transmutes itself into outwardly normal clothing . It retains all other properties , including weight , hardness , and so on . Only " true seeing " or similar magics will reveal the armor ' s true nature . Creation . The creator must cast " disguise self " on the armor to grant the " glamered " property .

title: Glamerie Windbough
description: Glamerie Windbough The current leader of the Chauntea ns in Shadowdale is High Harvestmistress Glamerie Windbough , a calm introspective woman who sees all things as passing in cycles , like the seasons of the year , including the Zhentarim occupation . She spends a lot of time hearing the complaints of the Dalesfolk and attempting to soothe their anger and fears . She also meets regularly with the commanders of the Zhentarim army , who tolerate the Temple of Chauntea , called the House of Plenty , as long as it can encourage bumper harvests .
description_long: Glamerie Windbough The current leader of the Chauntea ns in Shadowdale is High Harvestmistress Glamerie Windbough , a calm introspective woman who sees all things as passing in cycles , like the seasons of the year , including the Zhentarim occupation . She spends a lot of time hearing the complaints of the Dalesfolk and attempting to soothe their anger and fears . She also meets regularly with the commanders of the Zhentarim army , who tolerate the Temple of Chauntea , called the House of Plenty , as long as it can encourage bumper harvests . Some see her as a collaborator , others believe she is working to preserve the Dale and its people until the day comes it can be liberated from the tyranny of the Black Network . Glamerie has two assistants of 6th level and the remaining 14 priests are of lst - 3rd level . In addition , there are 36 women and men who service as lay followers and help in the garden .

title: Glaragama Dunrohiyr
description: Glaragama Dunrohiyr Glaragama Dunrohiyr was a female wizard and archmage from Calaunt in the Vast , of the 13th century DR . History . Glaragama originally came from Calaunt in the Vast .
description_long: Glaragama Dunrohiyr Glaragama Dunrohiyr was a female wizard and archmage from Calaunt in the Vast , of the 13th century DR . History . Glaragama originally came from Calaunt in the Vast . She disguised herself as a man when she apprenticed to the wizard Sharabirt of Calimport . When Sharabirt died , apparently of natural causes , she became the apprentice of Rrestel of Athkatla . She finally revealed her true appearance and nature when she killed a wizard known as Dardren of Memnon and stole all his magic . In her time , Glaragama made herself known as a rogue wizard who killed twenty fellow archmages . She killed the last quite openly , then calmly named and vowed to kill four more . At this point , the Magister Inhil Lauthdryn reluctantly decided to bring Glaragama to justice , or destroy her . He went alone to the lands of the Vast after both her and Muaralygrym the Dark . What happened next was a mystery . A trap had been set for Inhil , and other , unidentified parties were involved . Nevertheless , Inhil battled both foes . Lauthdryn defeated Muaralygrym at the cost of his own life , falling somewhere close to Ravens Bluff , between the city and the mountains .

title: Glass - breakers
description: Glass - breakers The Glass - breakers were a group of fanatical gnomes who lived on an uncharted island in the middle of Yal Tengri . Activities . The sole purpose of the Glass - breakers was to thwart the construction of the Great Spire of the Ice Sea that was being built by a cult of Gond .
description_long: Glass - breakers The Glass - breakers were a group of fanatical gnomes who lived on an uncharted island in the middle of Yal Tengri . Activities . The sole purpose of the Glass - breakers was to thwart the construction of the Great Spire of the Ice Sea that was being built by a cult of Gond . They achieved this by executing nighttime raids on the spire where they damaged the spire , burned factories , and scared the workers . Members . Lurdas Jasperstone organized the group of gnomes who would become the Glass - breakers .

title: Glass cutter
description: Glass cutter A glass cutter was a tool used by some rogue s to by - pass locked windows . Uses . Glass cutters were a viable option for thieves wishing to ignore the time - consuming task of getting through a locked window .
description_long: Glass cutter A glass cutter was a tool used by some rogue s to by - pass locked windows . Uses . Glass cutters were a viable option for thieves wishing to ignore the time - consuming task of getting through a locked window . A diamond - tipped cutting edge attached to an adjustable arm was attached to a suction cup , allowing for circular cuts of various sizes to be made upon a window pane . After making the cut a simple tap would remove the section of window while the suction cup kept the glass from shattering and making a loud noise . Prices . A typical glass cutter could be purchased for 2 gold .

title: Glassteel
description: Glassteel Glassteel was a material that was as strong as steel and as transparent as glass . Properties . Glassteel lacked the normal greenish tint of glass , instead gleaming a dullish and almost translucent gray .
description_long: Glassteel Glassteel was a material that was as strong as steel and as transparent as glass . Properties . Glassteel lacked the normal greenish tint of glass , instead gleaming a dullish and almost translucent gray . It was stronger than iron but only half as heavy . Furthermore , it was fully translucent . Fabrication . It was made with a complex metallurgical and alchemical process that also required extensive knowledge of glass - blowing . This technique was discovered by the sun elves and avariel . Glassteel cost ~ 100 gp per pound ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Application . It was mostly used as a construction material in fantastic castles , but also found common use as a hull plating for Spelljammers . Some also used it to create weapons and armour , though for most , the cost of doing this was prohibitively expensive , especially when crafting armour . Glassteel armour was much lighter than others of its kind , enabling greater ease of movement .

title: Glasya
description: Glasya Lord of the Sixth , Glasya is a Princess of the Nine Hells . She is noted as one of the most powerful and influential of the female devil s and for being the daughter of Asmodeus . Appearance .
description_long: Glasya Lord of the Sixth , Glasya is a Princess of the Nine Hells . She is noted as one of the most powerful and influential of the female devil s and for being the daughter of Asmodeus . Appearance . Adorned in priceless jewelry , silks , and other finery , this humanlike creature is the vision of beauty — except for her copper skin , wings , forked tail , and horns that betray her true nature . Worshipers . Glasya is a minor patron of corruption , growth , and agony . She has a small following of priests and cultists . History . Glasya was once Mammon ' s favoured consort . However , this relationship changed when Mammon sided against Asmodeus in the Reckoning . Mammon slunk back to the Lord of Hell and Glasya was taken from him and appointed Queen of the erinyes , a position she absolutely despised . Since becoming Lord of the Sixth , Glasya has had a thriving friendship with Fierna , which frightens Belial as his ' loving ' daughter may believe she no longer has any use for her manipulative father . Up until very recently , Malbolge was a layer tilted , a place of sliding scree and tumbling rock , its eternal slope nearly impossible to navigate .

title: Glathra Barcantle
description: Glathra Barcantle Glathra Barcantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr and the " de facto " third - in - command . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , when Royal Mage Ganrahast and his second - in - command Vainrence were imprisoned by Manshoon in the palace crypts , Glathra assumed command of the War Wizards and helped to prevent an uprising by disgruntled nobles . Personality .
description_long: Glathra Barcantle Glathra Barcantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr and the " de facto " third - in - command . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , when Royal Mage Ganrahast and his second - in - command Vainrence were imprisoned by Manshoon in the palace crypts , Glathra assumed command of the War Wizards and helped to prevent an uprising by disgruntled nobles . Personality . Glathra could best be described as rude , imperious , and arrogant and was liked by no one . Relationships . Because of her personality , Glathra was disliked by most people she met . She hated Elminster , whom she was convinced was an enemy of Cormyr .

title: Glaur
description: Glaur Glaur , known to its inhabitants as the Dominions of Nehu , was an ancient fortress built by the primordial Nehushta during the Dawn War . It was located in northern Gontal , in the center of the Glaur Barrens . Description .
description_long: Glaur Glaur , known to its inhabitants as the Dominions of Nehu , was an ancient fortress built by the primordial Nehushta during the Dawn War . It was located in northern Gontal , in the center of the Glaur Barrens . Description . Before its destruction , Glaur was a metallic , many - walled building of strange appearance and impossible size . Its largest spire reached the clouds , while its lower chamber was in the Underdark , near Abeir ' s core . After its destruction during the Spellplague , Glaur became a strange plagueland composed of the following features : Brindol ' s Cut . Named for the leader of the surviving genasi of Glaur , Brindol , this miles - long fissure divided Glaur ' s ruins into two separate regions . The sheer canyon walls that composed the fissure opened onto many tunnels and corridors that were once buried basements of the fortress , most of them reaching way down to the Underdark . The southwestern portion of Brindol ' s Cut was the territory of the Dominion of the Burned faction . The Birthing Furnace , a powerful artifact crafted by Nehushta , was located somewhere in this area . Glittering Wall .

title: Glaur ( instrument )
description: Glaur ( instrument ) A glaur was a short curved valved horn , popular among bard s in the Realms . It was similar to a cornucopia and sounded like a trumpet . Description .
description_long: Glaur ( instrument ) A glaur was a short curved valved horn , popular among bard s in the Realms . It was similar to a cornucopia and sounded like a trumpet . Description . The glaur was a more versatile instrument than other trumpets . Its sound was brash and metallic . Glaurs made of brass , silver and electrum were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . A variant of the glaur without the valves was called a gloon and had a more mournful sound .

title: Glaur Barrens
description: Glaur Barrens The Glaur Barrens were the plagueland s that composed most of the northern region of Gontal . Geography . The Glaur Barrens were a mixture of earthmote s and plaguelands filled with strangely regular metallic ruins and areas of rusted iron and sparse vegetation .
description_long: Glaur Barrens The Glaur Barrens were the plagueland s that composed most of the northern region of Gontal . Geography . The Glaur Barrens were a mixture of earthmote s and plaguelands filled with strangely regular metallic ruins and areas of rusted iron and sparse vegetation . A series of underground tunnels that plunged deep into the earth were filled with rich veins of melted gold or platinum . History . The Glaur Barrens were the domains of the Dawn Titan Nehushta before the separation of Abeir and Toril . During the Dawn War , Nehushta constructed the fortress of Glaur on this region to serve as a central front in the conflict . After the primordials were defeated , Nehushta isolated herself in the fortress until the War of Fang and Talon , when she was killed by traitorous dragon s . However , both dragons and humanoids avoided the area out of fear for thousands of years after the war .

title: Glaurachyndaar
description: Glaurachyndaar Glaurachyndaar ( formerly Myth Glaurach , the City of Scrolls ) is a ruined Eaerlann i city situated on the river Starsilver , a tributary of the river Delimbiyr , in the Nether Mountains . It was a garden city with ornate buildings and white domes , built on the ruins of an Aryvandaar an city . History .
description_long: Glaurachyndaar Glaurachyndaar ( formerly Myth Glaurach , the City of Scrolls ) is a ruined Eaerlann i city situated on the river Starsilver , a tributary of the river Delimbiyr , in the Nether Mountains . It was a garden city with ornate buildings and white domes , built on the ruins of an Aryvandaar an city . History . Myth Glaurach was built on top of the pre - existing ruins of an Aryvandaaran city whose name is presumed to be lost . The city was raided by orc s in 864 DR and sacked . The daemonfey of House Dlardrageth moved into the ruins of the ancient city after being freed from their magical prison beneath Nar Kerymhoarth . Sarya Dlardrageth found the mythal stone of the city buried in a deep pit to protect it from attackers , and she used the magic of the stone to summon demon s that could remain permanently in Faerûn . Araevin Teshurr subsequently restored the mythal and altered it in such a way that it can now withstand fiendish intervention . Notable locations . There are a number of portal s beneath the grand mage ' s palace . Mythal .

title: Glavel
description: Glavel Glavel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Glavel was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Chisel in the Disciples of St .
description_long: Glavel Glavel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Glavel was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Chisel in the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . His duty was to act as a brewer and cook for both the monastery and the Guest House . Secretly , he was also a member of the Cult of Howling Hatred . History . Glavel was one of the cultists who infiltrated the monastery in 1491 DR . However , he and Olara were discovered by Lana . Despite being left for dead after their meeting , Lana survived and in Mulmaster reported her discovery to the Order of the Gauntlet , the Lords ' Alliance , and Zor Garwyl Gos , who hired an adventuring party to investigate . When the adventurers arrived at the monastery , they confronted Glavel . Relationship . Glavel was the lover of Olara , a fellow cultist . Personality . Glavel at heart was a selfish sociopath . He joined the Howling Hatred only because they encouraged his hobbies . Glavel was a very good liar and would quickly change sides if his life was in danger .

title: Gleamtail jack
description: Gleamtail jack A gleamtail jack is a type of fish known to live in the Elemental Chaos . Physical description . Gleamtail jacks are albino colored .
description_long: Gleamtail jack A gleamtail jack is a type of fish known to live in the Elemental Chaos . Physical description . Gleamtail jacks are albino colored . They are about the size of a human ' s thumb . Abilities . Gleamtail jacks can swim through any elemental matter and can shift between planes . Realmslore . Information about gleamtail jacks can be found in the Vault of Sages in the city of Silverymoon .

title: Glei Yuindo
description: Glei Yuindo Glei Yuindo was an adventurer active in Koryo in the 1350s DR . In 1357 DR , a band of adventurers headed by Glei Yuindo returned to Pan and it was rumored they had discovered the famous lost fortress of Toranu Ganppo . However , before they could tell their story , they died of a mysterious sickness .

title: Glek
description: Glek " ? Glek " ' was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History .
description_long: Glek " ? Glek " ' was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Glek was one of the goblins who inhabited the caves near Duskwood . He rebelled against the former leader and had some of the goblins follow him into the caves near Duskwood . Gameplay . In order to get the ring for the trial , the Kalach - Cha needed to kill the spiders or slay Glek .

title: Glendar
description: Glendar Glendar was an adventuring wizard who hated medusas and basilisks to such an extent that he was compelled to invent the rod of mirrors . Eventually , Glendar turned evil and became a lich , but he was destroyed by the adventurers he had originally aimed to protect .
description_long: Glendar Glendar was an adventuring wizard who hated medusas and basilisks to such an extent that he was compelled to invent the rod of mirrors . Eventually , Glendar turned evil and became a lich , but he was destroyed by the adventurers he had originally aimed to protect .

title: Glenn Whitmore
description: Glenn Whitmore Glenn Whitmore is a comic book artist who has worked for , , and Comics . His primary role was as colorist . Career .
description_long: Glenn Whitmore Glenn Whitmore is a comic book artist who has worked for , , and Comics . His primary role was as colorist . Career . Whitmore began working on comic books in 1987 and was involved in many popular works , including , , and . Whitmore was also an artist for the Advanced Dungeons and Dragons comic series , which was set in the Forgotten Realms . He has also created his own comic book series entitled " Captain Clockwork " .

title: Glenna Moonsmith
description: Glenna Moonsmith Glenna Moonsmith was a dwarf innkeeper and tavern owner in the Moonsea . Activities . Glenna managed the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop .
description_long: Glenna Moonsmith Glenna Moonsmith was a dwarf innkeeper and tavern owner in the Moonsea . Activities . Glenna managed the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , some of her farmer customers told Glenna about an attack by a new tribe of goblin s . After Arduro and Doster , two human workers , told her that the Arcrus farm had just been attacked , Glenna hired an adventuring party who happened to be in her tavern to go to investigate . Personality . Glenna was a charming and outgoing individual with a good heart . She preferred dealing with locals than with merchants . Glenna knew she was soft - hearted but noted that scared people often told the truth with few embellishments . Glenna lived in fear to be arrested by officials of Hillsfar and never wanted speak about that city .

title: Glevith
description: Glevith Glevith was a criminal in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Glevith did not like the established powers and always fought for the good of the lower class .
description_long: Glevith Glevith was a criminal in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Glevith did not like the established powers and always fought for the good of the lower class . He enjoyed being seen as a hero of the people for his role fighting against the cultists . History . Glevith was a mid - level member of the Welcomer crime syndicate in Phlan . He also had a number of contacts outside the organization , like Aya Glenmiir . He rarely worked with the Harpers . In 1489 DR , during the Cult of the Dragon ' s coup in the city , he became one of the leaders of the resistance against the cultists . Glevith helped some adventurers to perform missions against the cult and even assigned to them a mission ordered by the Harpers . Later he recruited an adventuring party to stop an cultist contingent led by Ixusaxa Terrorsong outside Phlan .

title: Glibness
description: Glibness Glibness was a transmutation spell that altered the caster ' s speech , making his or her elocution much more convincing and believable . Effects . The caster of this spell was blessed with an agility of speech that greatly increased the chance that a bluff would succeed .
description_long: Glibness Glibness was a transmutation spell that altered the caster ' s speech , making his or her elocution much more convincing and believable . Effects . The caster of this spell was blessed with an agility of speech that greatly increased the chance that a bluff would succeed . It even made magical means of detecting or preventing lies , such as " discern lies " , or a " zone of truth " , difficult and more likely to fail . The silver tongue ability lasted for 10 minutes per experience level of the caster . Components . Only a somatic component was required to cast this spell , making it very subtle .

title: Glimmersea
description: Glimmersea The Glimmersea , sometimes called the Sea of the Starry Night , was a vast underground ocean lying in the Underdark of Toril . Geography . The Glimmersea laid some 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) beneath the floor of another large body of water , the Sea of Fallen Stars in central Faerûn .
description_long: Glimmersea The Glimmersea , sometimes called the Sea of the Starry Night , was a vast underground ocean lying in the Underdark of Toril . Geography . The Glimmersea laid some 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) beneath the floor of another large body of water , the Sea of Fallen Stars in central Faerûn . It stretched out underneath most of the Sea of Fallen Stars , with the exception of the Easting Reach and other parts , and extending beneath some adjoining lands , including Altumbel and Aglarond . The Glimmersea consisted of a large body of water filling dozens of huge vaults , some thousands of feet ( hundreds of meters ) high . It was famous for the many ribbon cascades of water that sprayed down from the high ceilings . Its name , " Sea of the Starry Night " , was derived from the luminescent rocks found in the ceilings of some of the vaults of the Glimmersea . Glowing like stars and perfectly reflected in the still waters below , these gave sailors the impression of sailing through a sea of stars , and was a beautiful sight to behold . Inhabitants .

title: Glina
description: Glina Glina was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Glina was a wizard of Neverwinter Academy , who entertained herself with gossips .
description_long: Glina Glina was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Glina was a wizard of Neverwinter Academy , who entertained herself with gossips . Despite her father , Jochris , being the headmaster of the Academy , she was Qara ' s enemy . When Qara burned the stables at the Academy and went off , Hetha and Glina tracked her to Sunken Flagon inn . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha and the companions persuaded the City Watchmen to work with the thieves or stay with the Watch , they would encounter Qara trading insults with Hetha and Glina . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve resolved the matter , causing Hetha and Glina to walk away .

title: Glinda Scatterstar
description: Glinda Scatterstar Glinda Scatterstar was the master of the Mage ' s Guild of Hillsfar and secretly an active rebel against Lord Maalthiir in 1367 DR . Personality . Glinda saw Maalthiir as a ruining influence in her city and she changed the objective of the Guild to actively remove him from power .
description_long: Glinda Scatterstar Glinda Scatterstar was the master of the Mage ' s Guild of Hillsfar and secretly an active rebel against Lord Maalthiir in 1367 DR . Personality . Glinda saw Maalthiir as a ruining influence in her city and she changed the objective of the Guild to actively remove him from power . Activities . In order to advance her plan , although very slowly , Glinda tried to expand the Mage ' s Guild as much as possible , by not only training new wizard s but also molding the minds of their pupils against Maalthiir . She also secretly smuggled into the city a number of elves and half - elves to reinforce her guild . Glinda waited for the inevitable defeat of the Red Plumes by the Zhentarim before she would act .

title: Glister
description: Glister Glister was the only human settlement in Thar . Due to its remote location in an otherwise desolate land , food and timber were its main imports , which were often traded for raw ores including iron , silver and copper . History .
description_long: Glister Glister was the only human settlement in Thar . Due to its remote location in an otherwise desolate land , food and timber were its main imports , which were often traded for raw ores including iron , silver and copper . History . Once the capital of the human kingdom of Thar , Glister was established by Beldoran in 1288 DR when the human warrior vanquished the last Tharkul ( or ogre king ) . Unfortunately , the kingdom floundered under the pressure of continued raids by ogres and other non - human creatures , and was finally overwhelmed in 1303 DR . Although the kingdom of Thar perished , the town of Glister survived and became a powerful force for civilization in the North . Under the protection of the archmage Thusk Tharmuil , with the presence of three small temples , the town was flourishing in 1367 DR . Glister had moved several times during its history , as the permafrost it was built on occasionally warmed and became uninhabitable , while raids by orcs or other hostiles led to its abandonment and reestablishment elsewhere . Locations .

title: Glitterdust
description: Glitterdust Glitterdust ( originally called Fahren ' s glitterdust ) was a conjuration spell from the that created a burst of golden particles that stuck to everything in an area . Effects . Upon completing this spell , the caster created a cloud of glittering dust with a twenty - foot diameter within a medium distance .
description_long: Glitterdust Glitterdust ( originally called Fahren ' s glitterdust ) was a conjuration spell from the that created a burst of golden particles that stuck to everything in an area . Effects . Upon completing this spell , the caster created a cloud of glittering dust with a twenty - foot diameter within a medium distance . The particles stuck to anyone and anything , including invisible creatures or objects , which allowed their outlines to be recognized . In addition to this revelatory effect , the glitter particles could blind some creatures for a short time . Components . To cast this spell required verbal and somatic component s and some ground mica . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Fahren in −1472 DR as one of his blindness - related spells . The spell was indirectly the cause of Fahren ' s murder ten years later , because one of Fahren ' s students had used the spell to blind the guards of one of Fahren ' s rivals and steal from him . When this rival traced the spell back to Fahren , the rival killed Fahren with a " sphere of annihilation " .

title: Glittergold ' s gambit
description: Glittergold ' s gambit Glittergold ' s gambit was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Garl Glittergold that granted a nearby ally another chance at performing a skill or attack in order to improve the outcome . Better or worse , the second outcome was final .
description_long: Glittergold ' s gambit Glittergold ' s gambit was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Garl Glittergold that granted a nearby ally another chance at performing a skill or attack in order to improve the outcome . Better or worse , the second outcome was final .

title: Glizn
description: Glizn Glizn was a quasit in Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Glizn was the quasit that Piri , an apprentice in the College of Mages and acolyte of the skin , bonded to himself using an ancient Ritual of Bonding rediscovered by Q ' arlynd Melarn .
description_long: Glizn Glizn was a quasit in Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Glizn was the quasit that Piri , an apprentice in the College of Mages and acolyte of the skin , bonded to himself using an ancient Ritual of Bonding rediscovered by Q ' arlynd Melarn . In 1379 DR , Glizn managed to gain control of Piri and instigated him into a duel with his fellow Eldrinn Elpragh . Glizn ' s plot was to kill Eldrinn and remove a possible rival for Piri . Q ' arlynd cast a spell to send Glizn back to the Abyss but Piri ' s body also disappeared . Later , it was discovered that Glizn had gained control of Piri ' s body . He was summoned by Streea ' Valsharess Zolond , who asked him about Master Q ' arlynd .

title: Gloaming
description: Gloaming Gloamings were planetouched creatures with heritage from both Toril and the Plane of Shadow . Description . Gloamings were humanoid s typically with pale skin and dark , furry wings , with which they were able to fly .
description_long: Gloaming Gloamings were planetouched creatures with heritage from both Toril and the Plane of Shadow . Description . Gloamings were humanoid s typically with pale skin and dark , furry wings , with which they were able to fly . They were lithe but not very strong . Their catlike eyes appeared metallic in low light ; in full light , they were typically a color of gray . Their skin glowed with a luminescence that could be controlled . Many gloamings carried tattoos that created interesting patterns on their glowing skin . They were frequently mistaken for tiefling s . Gloamings reached adulthood at age 13 and could live to be a maximum of about 300 years old . Personality . Gloamings were usually curious and traveled compulsively . Although individuals were given names as a child , adult gloamings could choose new names for themselves . Society . Although settlements were rare due to gloamings ' wanderlust , gloaming settlements tended to run contrary to the dominant alignment of the area . They shunned all organized religion . Abilities . Gloamings were able to fly and were apt at shadow - based spells . They were also resistant to illusions and psionic attacks .

title: Globe of invulnerability
description: Globe of invulnerability Globe of invulnerability was an arcane abjuration spell that created a protective barrier around the caster . Effects . For up to one minute , as long as the caster kept concentrating , the spell created a shimmering fixed spherical barrier centered on the caster that canceled the effects of any spell that was originally less powerful than " globe of invulnerability " .
description_long: Globe of invulnerability Globe of invulnerability was an arcane abjuration spell that created a protective barrier around the caster . Effects . For up to one minute , as long as the caster kept concentrating , the spell created a shimmering fixed spherical barrier centered on the caster that canceled the effects of any spell that was originally less powerful than " globe of invulnerability " . Components . The spell needed verbal , somatic and material components to e cast . Its material component could be either a glass or a crystal bead that shattered when the spell ended . The material component could be replaced by the use of an arcane focus . History . The spell was developed by Netherese arcanist Trebbe in - 2242 DR , and was originally called " Trebbe ' s invulnerability " .

title: Glooglugogg
description: Glooglugogg Glooglugogg was a kuo - toa whip living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glooglugogg was very loyal to his goddess and his father .
description_long: Glooglugogg Glooglugogg was a kuo - toa whip living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glooglugogg was very loyal to his goddess and his father . He , however , disliked strangers involved in local businesses . History . Glooglugogg lived quietly in the village of Sloobludop on the Darklake , ruled by his father Ploopploopeen . He took care of Blibdoolpoolp ' s temple . At the Rage of Demons , however , his sister had a vision of a new god Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father , ( in truth , demon lord Demogorgon , ) and spread her new religion among the kuo - toa . Soon , she had gathered so many followers that their father Ploopploopeen started to make a plan to reclaim his position . Despite Glooglugogg ' s objections , Ploopploopeen recruited a party of adventurers who had escaped from drow slavers of Velkynvelve as bait . Glooglugogg , Ploopploopeen , some guards , and the adventurers went to Leemooggoogoon ' s temple in the guise of offering sacrifices .

title: Gloomwrought
description: Gloomwrought Gloomwrought was a city in the Shadowfell . Government . The ruler of Gloomwrought was Prince Rolan , a human nobleman .
description_long: Gloomwrought Gloomwrought was a city in the Shadowfell . Government . The ruler of Gloomwrought was Prince Rolan , a human nobleman . Other merchant nobles held power in the city but they cared little for the city itself , only themselves . Hidden organizations also wielded some influence and it was unknown whether the mysterious Keepers held any temporal power or not . Places of Interest . Draygo ' s Manse . Draygo Quick maintained a home in a compound here where he imprisoned Drizzt Do ' Urden for quite some time and petrified Dahlia Sin ' felle and Artemis Entreri . The prisoners were rescued when the compound was assaulted by Bregan D ' aerthe at the bequest of Jarlaxle . In 1469 DR , Draygo Quick was continuing to work with Bregan D ' aerthe ; Kimmuriel Oblodra agreed to share information he gathered from working with the illithids in return for forgiveness for his assault on Quick ' s home .

title: Glorghakt
description: Glorghakt Glorghakt was a mind flayer envoy from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR the illithid of Ryxyg discovered that the fire giant s of Maerimydra had built devastating arcane siege engines that planning to use against Hillsfar and Elventree but the mind flayer discovered also a mean to disable those engine in secret from far .
description_long: Glorghakt Glorghakt was a mind flayer envoy from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR the illithid of Ryxyg discovered that the fire giant s of Maerimydra had built devastating arcane siege engines that planning to use against Hillsfar and Elventree but the mind flayer discovered also a mean to disable those engine in secret from far . So Glorghakt asked to met a rappresentative of the Order of the Gauntlet in the myconid settlement of Sporedome . There it explained that he wanted that an adventuring party find and kill a rogue mind flayer warlock who allied itself with the demon lord Graz ' zt and hid in a place full of madness - infected - faerzress . In exchange it offered to destroy the engines of the giants . Personality . Glorghakt was driven by a desire of knowledge of both the surface world and the future . Only his closest confidant could use its full name . Glorghakt was very direct and matter - of - fact oriented , never hiding informations . Relationship . Xicvizt and Glorghakt were born from the same pool

title: Glorious raiment
description: Glorious raiment Glorious raiment is an abjuration spell that imbues clothing with divine power . Effect . You imbue a robe , priestly garment , or outfit of regular clothing with divine power .
description_long: Glorious raiment Glorious raiment is an abjuration spell that imbues clothing with divine power . Effect . You imbue a robe , priestly garment , or outfit of regular clothing with divine power . The spell bestows the following effects for its duration : Only a good - aligned creature gains the benefits of this spell . Creatures of nongood alignment can wear the " glorious raiment " , but gain no spell benefits from doing so .

title: Glorious servitor
description: Glorious servitor Abilities . Similar in some respects to the divine champion , glorious servitors gained no additional spells , but did gain several useful powers and spell - like abilities , including being able to transform into their deity ' s favored animal . They could even communicate while in this animal form .
description_long: Glorious servitor Abilities . Similar in some respects to the divine champion , glorious servitors gained no additional spells , but did gain several useful powers and spell - like abilities , including being able to transform into their deity ' s favored animal . They could even communicate while in this animal form . Only human s , tiefling s , or deva s who hailed from Mulhorand could be glorious servitors . Glorious servitors could use the following spells or spell - like abilities : " true seeing " , " greater command " , " mass cure serious wounds " , " mass inflict serious wounds " . They were immune to poison , magical " fear " , and enjoyed resistance to spells . Their strength was enhanced by their god . Background . The majority of glorious servitors came from the ranks of paladin s , cleric s , fighter s , and monk s throughout Mulhorand . Of these , most were paladins and clerics because of their religious knowledge . Ranger s and monks also occasionally followed this path , though it could take time for them to develop the required knowledge and diplomatic skills . Rogues and assassin s typically served Set , while arcane spellcasters often followed Thoth .

title: Glorlo
description: Glorlo Glorlo was the cleric of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Instead of speak Glorlo chanted and for him a - week - ago ' s events were like legends of ancient times .
description_long: Glorlo Glorlo was the cleric of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Instead of speak Glorlo chanted and for him a - week - ago ' s events were like legends of ancient times . History . In 1357 DR Glorlo and his tribe met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Glorming
description: Glorming Glorming was a male orc chieftain of the tribes that dwelled in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast . He was a hero to the local orcs , and died fighting in the pass that was named for him — Glorming Pass — some time before 1370 DR .
description_long: Glorming Glorming was a male orc chieftain of the tribes that dwelled in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast . He was a hero to the local orcs , and died fighting in the pass that was named for him — Glorming Pass — some time before 1370 DR .

title: Glorming Pass
description: Glorming Pass Glorming Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The North Road ran through it to connect Sevenecho and Dragon Falls . It was a wild and dangerous place , prone to orc ambushes and haunted by The Phantom Knights .
description_long: Glorming Pass Glorming Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The North Road ran through it to connect Sevenecho and Dragon Falls . It was a wild and dangerous place , prone to orc ambushes and haunted by The Phantom Knights . History . The pass was named for Glorming , a local orc chieftain who died fighting in the pass . At the close of the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , the Vipers bandits began raiding merchant caravans going through the Glorming Pass . They soon made a fearful reputation for themselves by the beginning of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR . Inhabitants . Orc s were highly populous in the mountains on either side of the pass , dwelling in cavern - lairs . Various kinds of monsters were also found in numbers . Usage . Orcs frequently patrolled the pass and monsters of various kinds were commonly sighted . However , despite being so dangerous , the Glorming Pass saw a great deal of traffic along the North Road , as it was one of only two major passes linking the Vast . It was recommended that merchants not risk passage without sufficient numbers to defend themselves .

title: Glormorglulla
description: Glormorglulla Glormorglulla was a beholder . History . Once Glormorglulla was defeated and frozen by Elminster and Dove Falconhand .
description_long: Glormorglulla Glormorglulla was a beholder . History . Once Glormorglulla was defeated and frozen by Elminster and Dove Falconhand . In 1487 DR , Elminster summoned it to Myth Drannor in order to create chaos among the Sembia n mercenaries and bound Glormorglulla to that city . There , however , Glormorglulla met Dove again and tried to have its vengeance but Dove managed to destroy the beholder ' s mind just before dying .

title: Glorst
description: Glorst Glorst was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Glorst was one of the former priests who joined the church of Eilistraee in Shilmista .
description_long: Glorst Glorst was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Glorst was one of the former priests who joined the church of Eilistraee in Shilmista . In 1377 DR , he was arguing with a priestess of Eilistraee about which of their gods had absorbed the other in the duel in 1375 DR when they were approached by Halisstra Melarn . Glorst tried to kill her but was defeated and killed by her .

title: Glory
description: Glory Glory was a tiefling psionicist who was employed by the merchant clan House Serrat for security . Her primary duty was to erase the memories of the clan ' s terazul harvesters so that the family ' s rivals could not learn the location of the plants . Description .
description_long: Glory Glory was a tiefling psionicist who was employed by the merchant clan House Serrat for security . Her primary duty was to erase the memories of the clan ' s terazul harvesters so that the family ' s rivals could not learn the location of the plants . Description . Glory had red skin and purple hair and was considered shapely . She smoked a pipe . Abilities . Glory had the ability to read most minds and was able to wipe the memory of those she encountered . Her ability to wipe memories often resulted in comical situations such as when people would bump into her wagon because they couldn ' t remember where it was located . Personality . Glory was easy going but inherently lazy , preferring to work only when she had to . History . Glory was with the Serrat caravan in the jungles south of Delzimmer when Zaltys Serrat , adopted daughter of one of the clan ' s leaders , ventured into the Underdark in search of her long - lost tribe . Glory elected to remain behind on the surface because she was worried that some denizens of the Underdark such as mind flayer s would be attracted to her psionic energy .

title: Glory Mines
description: Glory Mines The Glory Mines were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Glory Mines were located within the very bedrock upon which the City of Brass was located .
description_long: Glory Mines The Glory Mines were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Glory Mines were located within the very bedrock upon which the City of Brass was located . A salamander guide was needed to navigate the warren without becoming hopelessly lost . Inhabitants . Salamanders infested this warren of the City of Brass .

title: Glory domain
description: Glory domain The Glory domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters glorious spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Glory Domain Powers .
description_long: Glory domain The Glory domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters glorious spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Glory Domain Powers . The cleric ' s ability to turn undead is improved .

title: Glory of the martyr
description: Glory of the martyr Glory of the martyr was a divine abjuration spell for paladin s that granted a protective ward to multiple subjects , transferring some of their wounds to the spellcaster and healing them if the caster should die . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to paladins of other faiths . Users .
description_long: Glory of the martyr Glory of the martyr was a divine abjuration spell for paladin s that granted a protective ward to multiple subjects , transferring some of their wounds to the spellcaster and healing them if the caster should die . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to paladins of other faiths . Users . The spell could be cast by paladin s — originally only those of Ilmater , but later of other faiths . It could also be cast by champions of Gwynharwyf . Effect . The " glory of the martyr " spell functioned like an advanced version of the " shield other " spell , in that it worked on multiple recipients . Like " shield other " , it warded the recipients against harm and forged a mystical link between them and the caster , transferring half of their wounds to the caster . Furthermore , if the caster of " glory of the martyr " died while it was still active , then the spell ended in a burst of positive energy that healed the linked recipients . Components . To function , the spell required each subject and the caster to wear a platinum ring , valued at 50 gp or more . These served as a focus . History .

title: Glouroth
description: Glouroth Glouroth was a mature adult Shadow dragon that resided in the Deep Wastes between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . He made his lair in the Wailing Cliff , an odd place where the Plane of Shadow bled into the Material Plane . Description .
description_long: Glouroth Glouroth was a mature adult Shadow dragon that resided in the Deep Wastes between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . He made his lair in the Wailing Cliff , an odd place where the Plane of Shadow bled into the Material Plane . Description . Ever slinking in the darkness of his lair , Glouroth generally cloaks himself in shadows to mask his appearance . Personality . Beneath a veneer of charm and serenity Glouroth is a being of roiling hatred and rage . When conversing with others the shadow dragon murmurs soothing platitudes in a hissing whisper , all the while consumed with thoughts of gore and death . History . In his younger years Glouroth dallied with a group of Kir - lanan s , even managing to father a daughter from them in the form of the Half - dragon , Phaikkul . In 1372 DR , drow refugees from the beseiged city of Maerimydra called upon an ancient pact they had with the dragon to grant them safe passage past the Wailing Cliff . Relationships . Kir - lanan . Although Glouroth lived with two groups of Kir - lanan , who both payed homage to him in certain ways , he took little notice of them beyond the offerings the occasionaly brought him . Drow .

title: Glow fever
description: Glow fever Glow fever was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by being bitten by the firefly - like insects that lived in the fortress of Glaur in Gontal . In the initial stages , the bodies of those afflicted glowed with a yellow - green bioluminescence similar to that of the of the swarming insects . Victims who died of this disease had their bodies mutated into a new swarm , which usually abandoned the place of their deaths to seek for its fellows in Glaur .
description_long: Glow fever Glow fever was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by being bitten by the firefly - like insects that lived in the fortress of Glaur in Gontal . In the initial stages , the bodies of those afflicted glowed with a yellow - green bioluminescence similar to that of the of the swarming insects . Victims who died of this disease had their bodies mutated into a new swarm , which usually abandoned the place of their deaths to seek for its fellows in Glaur .

title: Glow of Ulban
description: Glow of Ulban Glow of Ulban is a powerful invocation bestowed upon warlock s , particularly those who specialize in pacts with aberrant powers , that flows from the power of the ancient , Far Realm - touched star of Ulban . When a " glow of Ulban " spell is cast , the warlock summons forth burning , blue - white light from Ulban , scorching one creature of the warlock ' s choosing within twenty - five feet . If the warlock specializes in such aberrant power likely also cause the creature ' s instincts for self - preservation to fade away , making them more vulnerable to later attacks .
description_long: Glow of Ulban Glow of Ulban is a powerful invocation bestowed upon warlock s , particularly those who specialize in pacts with aberrant powers , that flows from the power of the ancient , Far Realm - touched star of Ulban . When a " glow of Ulban " spell is cast , the warlock summons forth burning , blue - white light from Ulban , scorching one creature of the warlock ' s choosing within twenty - five feet . If the warlock specializes in such aberrant power likely also cause the creature ' s instincts for self - preservation to fade away , making them more vulnerable to later attacks . " Glow of Ulban " is not easily cast , however , and a short rest of at least a few minutes is required before a warlock can cast it again .

title: Glow ring
description: Glow ring A glow ring was a magical ring that gave off a soft glow , useful in nighttime thieving and other illicit activities . Description . It was a silver ring set with an opal .
description_long: Glow ring A glow ring was a magical ring that gave off a soft glow , useful in nighttime thieving and other illicit activities . Description . It was a silver ring set with an opal . A command word was typically inscribed within the band . Powers . Activated and deactivated by the whispered command word , the opal radiated a cool , dim glow , similar to moonlight , to about 3 inches ( 8 centimeters ) . It was enough to read by or perform detailed work , and could not be seen from far away . It did not work in magical " darkness " . Usage . The " glow ring " was made specifically for rogue s to open locks and conduct spying . Notable owners . Several " glow rings " were known to exist in Faerûn , typically in the possession of leaders of thieves ' guilds . The master thief known as Silverfox had a " glow ring " . History . The Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist wrote details of the " glow ring " in his spellbook " Daltim ' s Tome of Fire " , which he lost in Tethyr in the 1360s DR .

title: Glowrod
description: Glowrod A glowrod was a small metal rod that glowed with bright light . Description . Most glowrods were made of and had a cover to block their light when not in use .
description_long: Glowrod A glowrod was a small metal rod that glowed with bright light . Description . Most glowrods were made of and had a cover to block their light when not in use . Powers . The bright light from a glowrod was normally yellow - white in color . History . Vangerdahast knew how to create a glowrod .

title: Glycamerax
description: Glycamerax Glycamerax was a white dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Glycamerax was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .
description_long: Glycamerax Glycamerax was a white dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Glycamerax was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Glyph of warding
description: Glyph of warding Glyph of warding was an abjuration spell that stored an evocation effect in a magical inscription to prevent intrusion . Effects . A " glyph " could be set on a object or on a suitable area .
description_long: Glyph of warding Glyph of warding was an abjuration spell that stored an evocation effect in a magical inscription to prevent intrusion . Effects . A " glyph " could be set on a object or on a suitable area . An object had to be touched by the caster . An area had to be accessible by the caster to trace the inscription with burning incense , i . e . , not under water or similar conditions at the time of casting . The size of the area depended on the experience of the caster , being 5 ft ( 0 . 46 m ) per level . The optional trigger conditions and optional password were set by the caster at the time of casting . The " glyph " had a perception of sorts and could trigger on characteristics of creatures such as height ( " under 5 ft / 1 . 5 m " ) , weight ( over 400 lb / 182 kg ) , race ( " dwarf " ) , family ( " dogs " ) , genus ( " foxes " ) , species ( " red - tailed foxes " ) , type ( " dragons " ) , subtype ( " metallic dragons " ) , kind ( " brass dragons " ) , or origin ( " fey " , " aberration " ) . The " glyph " could also differentiate between good / evil , lawful / chaotic , or if the individual was a member of the caster ' s religion .

title: Glyphic Shroomlight
description: Glyphic Shroomlight Glyphic Shroomlight was a young deep gnome acolyte of Segojan Earthcaller in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glyphic was very nervous because he knew his position needed an older and more experienced priest .
description_long: Glyphic Shroomlight Glyphic Shroomlight was a young deep gnome acolyte of Segojan Earthcaller in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glyphic was very nervous because he knew his position needed an older and more experienced priest . History . During the Rage of Demons , Glyphic was assigned to run the recently reconsecrated Ruby in the Rough temple .

title: Glyphimhor
description: Glyphimhor Glyphimhor was one of the most powerful lieutenants in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Glyphimhor ruled the metropolis of Orcusgate on the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus .
description_long: Glyphimhor Glyphimhor was one of the most powerful lieutenants in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Glyphimhor ruled the metropolis of Orcusgate on the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus . He knew the workings of the " Wand of Orcus " . Personality . Glyphimhor was a typical balor . He cared nothing for his subordinates but was worried if his city would be damaged . Usually Glyphimhor did not kill personally , preferring to use his " symbol of discord " and " symbol of stunning " or his " telekinesis " powers . Relationship . Orcus trusted Glyphimhor but he was still a demon and if he found a truly successful chance Glyphimhor would betray his lord .

title: Glyth
description: Glyth Glyth was the 6th planet in the Realms ' solar system and had long been a bastion of the Illithid s . A ringed planet approximately 1 , 000 , 000 , 000 miles from the sun . It had 3 satellites and is one of the Five Wanderers , planets that ( from the perspective of Toril ) seemed to defy the normal paths of the stars .
description_long: Glyth Glyth was the 6th planet in the Realms ' solar system and had long been a bastion of the Illithid s . A ringed planet approximately 1 , 000 , 000 , 000 miles from the sun . It had 3 satellites and is one of the Five Wanderers , planets that ( from the perspective of Toril ) seemed to defy the normal paths of the stars . Glyth was a harsh planet , but only because of its inhabitants . What forests they didn ' t have absolute control over they made sure were burned to the ground to prevent their humanoid cattle from hiding in them . This resulted in smoke filling the atmosphere which , in turn , nearly destroyed the atmospheric envelope and caused the planet to precipitate acidic rain constantly . The smoke caused the entire atmosphere to smell like a charnel house . Of course , this didn ' t bother the mind flayers , who almost universally lived underground . 80 % of the surface of Glyth was land while the other 20 % was a strange gelatinous substance containing large amounts of water . The substance was edible and quenched thirst just like water would .

title: Gnoll
description: Gnoll Gnolls are a humanoid race that most closely resemble hyenas that dwell in the eastern parts of Faerûn and are known for their savage culture and warlike ways . Ecology . Physical description .
description_long: Gnoll Gnolls are a humanoid race that most closely resemble hyenas that dwell in the eastern parts of Faerûn and are known for their savage culture and warlike ways . Ecology . Physical description . Gnolls are extremely tall , with the average member of the race standing on average between 7 ' and 7 ' 6 " . Though gnolls are relatively lean for their height , weighing in usually between 280 to 320 lbs , the race cuts an impressive visage . In part because of their height and lean musculature , gnolls are very quick compared with many other races such as human s . Gnoll skin is a greenish - gray , and their furry hide is light or dark brown marked sometimes with spots or stripes . Many gnolls also have a dirty yellow to reddish - gray crest - like mane that stands on end when a gnoll is angry . It is believed by some that gnolls have traces of demon ic blood , which may be evidenced by unusual features found among some of the gnoll bloodlines . These may include talons , gleaming red eyes , or black fur with fiery orange spots . Female gnolls are indistinguishable from males by size , in spite of a reputation for being shorter .

title: Gnollwatch Mountains
description: Gnollwatch Mountains The Gnollwatch Mountains are a medium small mountain range that runs east to west through Dambrath for approximately 700 miles . The range eventually declines and becomes the Hills of Dead Kings in the east . The Gnollwatch are not impressive peaks because of the Muaraghal Mountains to the west but have several moderate peaks over 9000 feet and Mount Hazail is the tallest peak at 11 , 500 feet .
description_long: Gnollwatch Mountains The Gnollwatch Mountains are a medium small mountain range that runs east to west through Dambrath for approximately 700 miles . The range eventually declines and becomes the Hills of Dead Kings in the east . The Gnollwatch are not impressive peaks because of the Muaraghal Mountains to the west but have several moderate peaks over 9000 feet and Mount Hazail is the tallest peak at 11 , 500 feet . The mountains are not particularly sharp , as the peaks have been worn down with the passage of time . Environment . The mountains get snow during the winter months of the year . Below the timberline the mountains are covered with Shadowtop , Suthwood , Pine and patches of mountain meadows . The mountains also have rich deposits of silver which are actively mined every year . Inhabitants . True to their name , the mountains are home to numerous tribes of gnolls living there . Some tribes are belligerent but many maintain trade relations with Dambrath . One leader , Grubash Blacksnout has disciplined the tribes into cohesive units maintaining territories with organized hunts .

title: Gnome
description: Gnome Gnomes , or the Forgotten Folk as they were sometimes known , were small humanoid s known for their eccentric sense of humor , inquisitiveness , and engineering prowess . Having had few overt influences on the world ' s history but many small and unseen ones , gnomes were often overlooked by the powers that be , despite their craftiness and affinity for illusion magic . Description .
description_long: Gnome Gnomes , or the Forgotten Folk as they were sometimes known , were small humanoid s known for their eccentric sense of humor , inquisitiveness , and engineering prowess . Having had few overt influences on the world ' s history but many small and unseen ones , gnomes were often overlooked by the powers that be , despite their craftiness and affinity for illusion magic . Description . Gnomes were very small compared to most other races and , with an average height ranging between 3 ' 0 " – 3 ' 6 " ( 0 . 9 – 1 . 1 meters ) and a weight range of 40 – 45 lbs ( 18 – 20 kg ) , gnomes were generally larger and heavier than halfling s , though forest gnome s , ranging between 2 ' 1 " – 2 ' 10 " in height ( 0 . 6 – 0 . 9 meters ) and 21 – 35 lbs in weight ( 10 – 16 kg ) , tended to be smaller than halflings , leading some scholars to erroneously classify all gnomish races as " smaller than the Hin " . However , while halflings were commonly said to resemble short human s , gnomes were more comparable with elves , with whom they shared pointed ears and high cheekbones , or even dwarves , due to their tendency to grow beards and live underground .

title: Gnome artificer
description: Gnome artificer Gnome artificer is a prestige class whose members are artisans and craftspeople who explore what technologies are available to the people of Faerûn , specifically by creating devices that attempt to reproduce the effects of various arcane spells . While often being competitive with one another , artificers also tend to share information and work with one another on various projects . If not working on their own or in small teams , artificers can often be found as advisors to massive engineering endeavours such as in the construction of bridges and the like .
description_long: Gnome artificer Gnome artificer is a prestige class whose members are artisans and craftspeople who explore what technologies are available to the people of Faerûn , specifically by creating devices that attempt to reproduce the effects of various arcane spells . While often being competitive with one another , artificers also tend to share information and work with one another on various projects . If not working on their own or in small teams , artificers can often be found as advisors to massive engineering endeavours such as in the construction of bridges and the like . While most artificers tend to be gnome s , there are few select humans from Lantan who , while having the same skills as gnome artificers , refer to themselves as Lantanese Artificers .

title: Gnome hooked hammer
description: Gnome hooked hammer The gnome hooked hammer was a two - handed exotic melee weapon . Description . The gnome hooked hammer had a relatively short haft with a hammer on one end and a sharp - pointed hook ( curved only slightly more than a pick ) on the other .
description_long: Gnome hooked hammer The gnome hooked hammer was a two - handed exotic melee weapon . Description . The gnome hooked hammer had a relatively short haft with a hammer on one end and a sharp - pointed hook ( curved only slightly more than a pick ) on the other . An average gnome hooked hammer cost 20 gp and weighed 6 lbs ( 2 . 7 kg ) . Use . Because of the two heads , this weapon could deal either bludgeoning or piercing damage . The gnome hooked hammer was considered a double weapon that could be used as if the wielder were fighting with two separate weapons at the same time , as long as it was wielded two - handed . If used in a one - handed fashion it was treated like a light hammer or a pick , depending on which head was used . The hooked end could be used to trip opponents . Gnome s favored this hammer , because for them it was a martial weapon ; for everyone else it was considered exotic .

title: Gnome language
description: Gnome language The gnomish language , also known as Gnim , was spoken by the gnome s of the Great Spire of Yal Tengri . Gnim has a simple structure and fluid tones . Most gnomes have a truly daunting vocabulary , however , with extremely fine degrees of distinction in , for example , kinds of love or shades of green .
description_long: Gnome language The gnomish language , also known as Gnim , was spoken by the gnome s of the Great Spire of Yal Tengri . Gnim has a simple structure and fluid tones . Most gnomes have a truly daunting vocabulary , however , with extremely fine degrees of distinction in , for example , kinds of love or shades of green . Their language is thus ideal for academic , artistic , and engineering pursuits , and it is widely used in academic circles even among other races . Many sages of many races consider Gnim to be a " scholar ' s language . " Gnim utilizes an adapted version of the Dethek alphabet , and gnomish writings and literature covers a staggering variety of topics .

title: Gnomish cloak
description: Gnomish cloak Gnomish cloaks were special cloaks worn by some rogue s . Uses . These wonderful cloaks were expertly crafted with grey fabrics that created a textured look , allowing a prowling thief to blend into the shadows with more conviction .
description_long: Gnomish cloak Gnomish cloaks were special cloaks worn by some rogue s . Uses . These wonderful cloaks were expertly crafted with grey fabrics that created a textured look , allowing a prowling thief to blend into the shadows with more conviction . While not nearly as grand as cloaks of elvenkind , gnomish cloaks made a find addition to a rogue ' s wardrobe . Prices . A gnomish cloak could be purchased for 10 gold , but one large enough to completely cover a large individual cost 12 gold .

title: Gobidamu
description: Gobidamu Gobidamu was a monk and the retired emperor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Gobidamu was emperor from 1326 DR until 1333 DR when he retired in favor of his son , Gokammu .
description_long: Gobidamu Gobidamu was a monk and the retired emperor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Gobidamu was emperor from 1326 DR until 1333 DR when he retired in favor of his son , Gokammu . Afterward , he became a monk of the Kanchai school at the monastery of Mount Ichi under the name Shoku . Personality . Gobidamu liked his current life meditating and writing poetry , and he would never leave the temple . Despite this , he was greatly involved in the temple ' s politics , granting the temple ' s support to Takenaka Sugawara , as asked by his son Gokammu .

title: Goblin
description: Goblin Goblins are a race of small and numerous goblinoid s common throughout Toril , often living in underground caverns near the surface known as lairs . The race is often , though not always , dominated by other goblinoids , most commonly hobgoblin s . Goblins may have , in fact , been initially created by this related race to serve as scouts and infiltrators .
description_long: Goblin Goblins are a race of small and numerous goblinoid s common throughout Toril , often living in underground caverns near the surface known as lairs . The race is often , though not always , dominated by other goblinoids , most commonly hobgoblin s . Goblins may have , in fact , been initially created by this related race to serve as scouts and infiltrators . Physical Description . Goblins are small goblinoids that many consider little more than a nuisance . They have flat faces , broad noses , pointed ears , and small , sharp fangs . Their foreheads slope back , and their eyes vary in color from red to yellow . Their skin color ranges from yellow through any shade of orange to a deep red ; usually all members of the same tribe share the same colored skin , though they also come in shades of green . Goblins are typically found in dark leathers soiled by poor hygiene and colored in a similar range of tones to their skin . Goblins usually stand between 3 ' 4 " and 3 ' 8 " and weigh about 40 to 55 pounds on average . Goblins breed extremely rapidly compared with many other races , accounting for their large population . Abilities .

title: Goblin War
description: Goblin War The Goblin War occurred from 1370 DR to 1371 DR . The war started when Nalavarauthatoryl , ( an elf - dragon ) massed an army of Orc s , Grodd goblin s , the seven Ghazneths and other monsters to attack the country of Cormyr . Interestingly , although the war is refered to as the Goblin Wars , goblin s only made up a fraction of the army , most of the fighting being done by the Orc s .
