description_long: Gorar al - Aksar Gorar al - Aksar was a famous barber and owner of the Barber Shop of Gorar al - Aksar in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Personality . To say Gorar was popular was an understatement . Even his rival barbers loved him . Activities . This singing barber enjoyed providing customers with horoscope readings , even if they did not want them . His storytelling abilities were renowned , often drawing listeners to his shop . Possessions . Gorar owned a smoking " efreeti bottle " that he kept on display in his shop . History . Gorar was a fixture of the Grand Bazaar for over 40 years .

title: Gorath
description: Gorath The Gorath was the hidden leader of the Royal Vagabonds of Shou Lung around 1357 DR . Activities . The Gorath secretly assisted the Old Man in managing the activities of the Royal Vagabonds against enemies of Shou Lung .
description_long: Gorath The Gorath was the hidden leader of the Royal Vagabonds of Shou Lung around 1357 DR . Activities . The Gorath secretly assisted the Old Man in managing the activities of the Royal Vagabonds against enemies of Shou Lung . In truth , Gorath was for centuries in the service of the Chin dynasty , a task assigned to him by the Undersecretary of the Minister of War in the Celestial Bureaucracy and he did not always work for the good of the Empire . Relations . The Gorath had encountered Lui - hsia Chih of the Many - Hued Peacock Society several times in the past and they were mortal enemies . Sometimes he appeared to direct the Royal Vagabonds cell in Nakamaru in Wa , where he correctly presumed that Lui - hsia Chih was hidden .

title: Gord Roundshield
description: Gord Roundshield Gord Roundshield was a dwarf living in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . History . Gord hailed from Citadel Felbarr but at some point he decided to travel to Neverwinter .
description_long: Gord Roundshield Gord Roundshield was a dwarf living in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . History . Gord hailed from Citadel Felbarr but at some point he decided to travel to Neverwinter . Here , he helped adventurers new to the city and tried to recruit dwarven adventurers to do some secret missions for their race ' s benefit . Behind the Scenes . Gord was involved in storylines for the dwarf player race .

title: Gordon Stakaria
description: Gordon Stakaria Battle - Chaplain Gordon Stakaria was the jaded veteran warrior - priest of the temple fortress of Swordpoint in the city of Archenbridge . He was the Swordmaster of the Shrine of Swords . Personality .
description_long: Gordon Stakaria Battle - Chaplain Gordon Stakaria was the jaded veteran warrior - priest of the temple fortress of Swordpoint in the city of Archenbridge . He was the Swordmaster of the Shrine of Swords . Personality . Dedicated to the service of Tempus through the faithful worship of the soldiers of Archendale , Gordon had little time to waste on other faiths or even the devotees of Tempus who hailed from outside his homeland . He spent much of his time seeking a bold and strong woman as a mate , only to see many potential suitors slain tragically in battle . Activities . In return for healing , Gordon accepted prayers to Tempus along with tasks of hardiness and endurance . Among these were :

title: Gordroun Obarskyr
description: Gordroun Obarskyr Gordroun Obarskyr was listed among the kings of Cormyr although he never actually reigned . He was crowned posthumously by his younger brother King Keldroun Obarskyr . Gordroun was known for killing his traitorous stepbrother and stepfather , who had murdered his older brother and then king Torst .
description_long: Gordroun Obarskyr Gordroun Obarskyr was listed among the kings of Cormyr although he never actually reigned . He was crowned posthumously by his younger brother King Keldroun Obarskyr . Gordroun was known for killing his traitorous stepbrother and stepfather , who had murdered his older brother and then king Torst .

title: Gorge of the Silver Wyrm
description: Gorge of the Silver Wyrm The Gorge of the Silver Wyrm was a canyon in Hartsvale through which the Wyrm River flowed . Description . The gorge was deep and dark .
description_long: Gorge of the Silver Wyrm The Gorge of the Silver Wyrm was a canyon in Hartsvale through which the Wyrm River flowed . Description . The gorge was deep and dark . On one side of the canyon , the walls were sheer granite cliffs , against which the Wyrm River flowed . On the other side was a road full of ruts that led to the mines of Earl Radborne Wynn . Small footpaths led up a steep , rocky slope to the various silver mines from the road . Pine trees used to cover the slope , but were cut down because of the mining . Geography . The gorge was found within the Ice Spires South . History . Silver was discovered in the gorge by the Wynn family early in the history of Hartsvale , and this silver supported the country as its primary export . It was in this canyon , in 1369 DR , that Queen Brianna Burdun and her escorts were ambushed first by fire giant s and then by firbolg s .

title: Gorglak
description: Gorglak Gorglak was a duergar guard in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Gorglak was well - known as one of the most corrupt members of the Stone Guard s .
description_long: Gorglak Gorglak was a duergar guard in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Gorglak was well - known as one of the most corrupt members of the Stone Guard s . He like collect weird weapons and can do anything for took one History . During the Rage of Demons , Gorglak was at the main city ' s gate and , for a good price , permitted a party of adventurers to escape drow slavers of Velkynvelve and to enter the city .

title: Gorgon
description: Gorgon A gorgon is a large magical beast that resembles a bull , covered in dusky metallic scales . Ecology . Behavior .
description_long: Gorgon A gorgon is a large magical beast that resembles a bull , covered in dusky metallic scales . Ecology . Behavior . Gorgons are very aggressive creatures that attack intruders on sight , attempting to trample , gore , or by breathing out a cone of green vapor , turn them into stone . There is no way to calm them as they are impossible to domesticate . They are also unable to swim . Diet . Gorgons love to eat fish . The Cormanthor gorgons flock to the banks of River Ashaba and Elvenflow each spring when they flood , so that they can collect the fish that have been stranded there . Once the supply has been depleted , a few of the gorgons are tempted to venture into the river to get more . Some of them fall in as a result , but their special ability can save them ( see Species , Cormanthor below ) . Species . Cormanthor . The Cormanthor gorgons have a special ability granted by the benevolent Hexad . If they slip into the river , they turn to stone and are saved from drowning because they no longer need oxygen or food .

title: Gorion
description: Gorion Gorion was a monk , a skilled spellcaster , a learned sage and a respected Harper . He lived in the library - fortress of Candlekeep during the times when he wasn ' t adventuring . His perhaps most notable impact on history was his raising two Bhaalspawn children , one of whom especially played a crucial part in the fulfilling of Alaundo ' s prophecy of the Bhaalspawn ( detailed in the Baldur ' s Gate series ) as an adult , being the main protagonist of the stories .
description_long: Gorion Gorion was a monk , a skilled spellcaster , a learned sage and a respected Harper . He lived in the library - fortress of Candlekeep during the times when he wasn ' t adventuring . His perhaps most notable impact on history was his raising two Bhaalspawn children , one of whom especially played a crucial part in the fulfilling of Alaundo ' s prophecy of the Bhaalspawn ( detailed in the Baldur ' s Gate series ) as an adult , being the main protagonist of the stories . According to the novelizations of the videogames , this Bhaalspawn was Abdel Adrian . The other , who was also involved but played a lesser role , was Imoen . Gorion ' s friends among the Harpers included Elminster Aumar , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , Khalid and Jaheira , whom he instructed the protagonist to seek out the last two in case they should become separated from him . Physical Description . Gorion had a thin build and a rigid posture . He was around six feet ( 1 . 83m ) tall . Physically , he appears as a gray - bearded man having long gray hair up in a ponytail and with a friendly old face . Equipment . Gorion wielded an oak staff , a dagger and a dark gray robe . History .

title: Gorion ' s Ward
description: Gorion ' s Ward Gorion ' s Ward was the last Bhaalspawn left alive at the end of the Throne of Bhaal conflict . While his or her true name is disputed , it is known that they were raised as the foster child of the sage Gorion and thusly received this nickname . Early History .
description_long: Gorion ' s Ward Gorion ' s Ward was the last Bhaalspawn left alive at the end of the Throne of Bhaal conflict . While his or her true name is disputed , it is known that they were raised as the foster child of the sage Gorion and thusly received this nickname . Early History . Gorion ' s Ward was raised in Candlekeep , a library fortress on the Sword Coast . The ward , along with Imoen and Sarevok , was found as a baby by the sage . Gorion took the ward and Imoen but left Sarevok behind . All three children were known by Gorion to be Bhaalspawn , the mortal half - god progeny of the dead god Bhaal , who had created an intricate plan to be raised from his unavoidable death by using the souls of his children to resurrect himself . All Bhaalspawn felt the need for conflict to some degree , save for Imoen , whose nature was drowned by a carefree spirit . The Cold war between Amn and Baldur ' s Gate . Gorion believed Candlekeep to be a safe place to hide the children from their bloodthirsty siblings . To Gorion ' s fear , in 1368 DR , Bounty Hunters under the pay of Sarevok infiltrated the keep and made an attempt on the ward ' s life .

title: Goristro
description: Goristro Goristros were a powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . Goristros resembled huge fiendish minotaurs and had horns like a bull .
description_long: Goristro Goristros were a powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . Goristros resembled huge fiendish minotaurs and had horns like a bull . Society . Because of their size and ferocity , goristros often served as living siege engines for demon forces . History . In 1486 DR , Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre successfully summoned a goristro and used it as her personal representative and soldier in Menzoberranzan .

title: Gorlist
description: Gorlist Gorlist was the son of Nisstyre and leader of a drow band pursuing Liriel Baenre . Description . Gorlist had short white hair and a dragon tattoo on his left cheek that glowed if a dragon was in the vicinity .
description_long: Gorlist Gorlist was the son of Nisstyre and leader of a drow band pursuing Liriel Baenre . Description . Gorlist had short white hair and a dragon tattoo on his left cheek that glowed if a dragon was in the vicinity . The color of the glow indicated the color of the dragon . History . In 1361 DR , Gorlist was present when his father , Nisstyre , was killed by Liriel Baenre ' s assault on the Dragon ' s Hoard headquarters in Skullport . He sought revenge on her for the death of his father . He hired the deathsinger Brindlor Zidorion and worked with the former Red Wizard Merdrith and the drow priestess Shakti Hunzrin to pursue Liriel , finally catching up with her in Rashemen , where he was defeated by her and her allies .

title: Gorloun
description: Gorloun Gorloun was a dragon of immense size , might , and age , who founded the first draconic empire of Abeir . History . Gorloun founded its nation some time after the War of Fang and Talon , in the continent of Laerakond .
description_long: Gorloun Gorloun was a dragon of immense size , might , and age , who founded the first draconic empire of Abeir . History . Gorloun founded its nation some time after the War of Fang and Talon , in the continent of Laerakond . Many other dragons followed Gorloun ' s example , ushering the Rule of Dragons .

title: Gorloun Hethel
description: Gorloun Hethel Gorloun Hethel was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Hethel and other five Dragons acted as escorts for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .
description_long: Gorloun Hethel Gorloun Hethel was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Hethel and other five Dragons acted as escorts for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember . However , Hethel was killed by the death knight Targrael , who was acting under the orders of Manshoon .

title: Gorm Gulthyn
description: Gorm Gulthyn Gorm Gulthyn ( " gorm " " gull " - thin ) , also known as Fire Eyes , Lord of the Bronze Mask and the Eternally Vigilant , was a dwarven lesser deity who held the portfolios of defense and watchfulness and was the guardian of all dwarves . Overview . Most dwarven enclaves stand in the path of aggressive Underdark enemies as they are built below the surface .
description_long: Gorm Gulthyn Gorm Gulthyn ( " gorm " " gull " - thin ) , also known as Fire Eyes , Lord of the Bronze Mask and the Eternally Vigilant , was a dwarven lesser deity who held the portfolios of defense and watchfulness and was the guardian of all dwarves . Overview . Most dwarven enclaves stand in the path of aggressive Underdark enemies as they are built below the surface . The protectors of these realms venerated Gorm Gulthyn , the patron of watchfulness and defense . Gorm appeared as a humorless masked warrior with the goal of ensuring the safety of dwarven clanholds . He manifested on the Prime far more often than his companions in the Morndinsamman to defend the dwarven realms . These manifestations kept vigils on battlements , established traps and deadfalls in neighboring passages , and instructed his clerics on plans for a steady and reliable defense . Those who had seen him fight to defend dwarven communities related his stunning battle prowess , but they also commented that his combat maneuvers increasingly showed a growing desperation , as if he believed each battle might be his last . Dying . Gorm Gulthyn was dying .

title: Gormauthator
description: Gormauthator Gormauthator was a skeleton red dragon in 1375 DR . History . Gormauthator was one of the dragon s that assaulted Shadowdale in 1375 DR during a flight of dragons ; Syluné Silverhand fought the three more powerful dragons , among those Gormauthator , at the Tower of Ashaba and destroyed the dragons at the price of her own life .
description_long: Gormauthator Gormauthator was a skeleton red dragon in 1375 DR . History . Gormauthator was one of the dragon s that assaulted Shadowdale in 1375 DR during a flight of dragons ; Syluné Silverhand fought the three more powerful dragons , among those Gormauthator , at the Tower of Ashaba and destroyed the dragons at the price of her own life . In 1375 DR in a effort to terrify the population , the cleric of Shar Esvele Greycastle raised Gormauthator as a skeleton to guard Sylune ' s tomb .

title: Gormstadd
description: Gormstadd Gormstadd the Rerisen was the head of a temple in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Gormstadd Gormstadd the Rerisen was the head of a temple in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Before the Time of Troubles , the temple was the Dark Lord ' s Hand , dedicated to Bane . After the supposed death of Bane , the temple was rededicated to Cyric and was called the Dark God Reformed . Description . Gormstadd had a small head with a narrow face atop a well - built , muscular body that was covered in thick brown hair . His dark brown eyes were nearly black and had a gleam , like pieces of polished flint . When he frowned , his big eyebrows met to form a single line across the top of his face . Personality . As the high priest of a temple dedicated to the Prince of Lies , he reveled in his role , wielding falsehoods like a weapon and eliciting fear from the common folk wherever he went . He referred to most Voonlarrans as " the local filth " and was cruel to those who dared not retaliate . He was even worse to potential rivals and not above spreading incriminating rumors or eliminating them by arranging " accidents " .

title: Gorrunk
description: Gorrunk Gorrunk was a bugbear raider during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . Dressed in hide armor , Gorrunk fought with a morning star and shield in battle .
description_long: Gorrunk Gorrunk was a bugbear raider during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . Dressed in hide armor , Gorrunk fought with a morning star and shield in battle . History . Gorrunk became leader of the Foulwater goblin tribe . In 1489 DR , he led them in a series of raids on farms near Phlan under the orders from a a mysterious patron , who suggested they use the lair of a black dragon recently killed by adventurers as a base . Gorrunk captured many prisoners .

title: Gorstag
description: Gorstag Gorstag was the innkeeper of the Rising Moon inn in Deepingdale and the foster father of Shandril Shessair . History . Gorstag was a battle - axe wielding warrior and one of the best friends of Garthond , a wizard who had often fought the Cult of the Dragon , and Dammasae , an adventurer whom Garthond had rescued from the Cult .
description_long: Gorstag Gorstag was the innkeeper of the Rising Moon inn in Deepingdale and the foster father of Shandril Shessair . History . Gorstag was a battle - axe wielding warrior and one of the best friends of Garthond , a wizard who had often fought the Cult of the Dragon , and Dammasae , an adventurer whom Garthond had rescued from the Cult . After the birth of Shandril , the family decided to move from Elturel when Shandril was old enough to withstand the rigors of travel , in order to foil the Cult ' s pursuers and asked Gorstag for help . The four moved to the east in disguise . But at the Bridge of Fallen Men near Cormyr , the Cult attacked from ambush . Garthond gave his life for the freedom of his wife and daughter . Before he died , Shandril ' s father destroyed nine cult mages and three swordsmen . Gorstag and Dammasae were both wounded , but they fled with Shandril toward Shadowdale . Sadly , Shandril ' s mother did not live to reach their destination . After Dammasae died , Gorstag turned south toward Deepingdale , hoping to leave the infant Shandril with the elves there .

title: Gorstag Helder
description: Gorstag Helder Gorstag Helder was one of Brimstone ' s agents during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Under orders from his draconic master , Gorstag joined a Cult of the Dragon cell in Lyrabar in 1373 DR .
description_long: Gorstag Helder Gorstag Helder was one of Brimstone ' s agents during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Under orders from his draconic master , Gorstag joined a Cult of the Dragon cell in Lyrabar in 1373 DR . He managed to steal a folio of valuable documents written by Sammaster . However , Gorstag was discovered in the act , and in the escape from the cult ' s hideout he was severely wounded . Pursued through the streets by the cultists and their wyvern and zombie minions , Gorstag was saved by his fencing master , Taegan Nightwind , who defeated the attackers . Gorstag soon died of his injuries , but not before giving Taegan the stolen documents and warning him about the dangers posed by Sammaster and the Cult .

title: Gort
description: Gort Gort was a thief of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Activities . He was a professional thief , and known to operate as a " retriever of lost items " for a hefty fee .
description_long: Gort Gort was a thief of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Activities . He was a professional thief , and known to operate as a " retriever of lost items " for a hefty fee . He was notorious for his daring and brazen crimes . History . Gort somehow got his hands on Ellendrin , " the Weeping Blade " . Ellendrin was once one of the magic sword s of the Royal Guard of King Imphras I and King Imbrar I of Impiltur , but had been thought lost since 1127 DR . In the Year of the Behir , 1342 DR , Gort visited the sage Othiiyr Velthrann of Tsurlagol , a noted expert on the Royal Guard ' s swords . Othiiyr identified Ellendrin and offered to buy it , but Gort refused , hinting that a contact in the Moonsea had already contracted him to retrieve it , and that he was leaving for their immediately . Gort left Othiiyr ' s house and that was the last anyone admitted seeing him , his loot , and Ellendrin again .

title: Gorvan Ironheart
description: Gorvan Ironheart Gorvan Ironheart was a dwarven priest of Grumbar in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Gorvan was interested only in money .
description_long: Gorvan Ironheart Gorvan Ironheart was a dwarven priest of Grumbar in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Gorvan was interested only in money . History . Gorvan was a cleric of Grumbar . He was recruited by the Red Wizards of Thay to work in the Doomvault in exchange for a large sum of money . Gorvan helped two Red Wizards to create clay golem s . In 1486 DR , when the heroes from Daggerford arrived , he lied to them and claimed to be a prisoner . If the adventurers believed him , he would accompany the party until he found an opportunity to escape .

title: Gorx
description: Gorx Gorx was a xorn at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while in his home plane , Gorx saw a gate to Toril .
description_long: Gorx Gorx was a xorn at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while in his home plane , Gorx saw a gate to Toril . Intrigued , he passed through and arrived in the Fane . There , Keltar , a member of the Cult of the Black Earth , mistook Gorx for an emissary of the elemental lord Ogrémoch . Taking advantage of this , the xorn enslaved the cultist , saying that Ogrémoch needed tributes to be given to Gorx . However , some adventurers infiltrated the Fane and confronted him . Appendix . Behind the scenes . If the players bribed Gorx , they could pass by without fighting .

title: Gorym Harndrekker
description: Gorym Harndrekker Gorym Harndrekker was a battle priest of Tempus and the acting Priest - General of the Abbey of the Sword as of 1372 DR . Formerly a skilled fighter , his advancing age and an encounter with wraith s greatly diminished his physical prowess . He was best known as a master military strategist .
description_long: Gorym Harndrekker Gorym Harndrekker was a battle priest of Tempus and the acting Priest - General of the Abbey of the Sword as of 1372 DR . Formerly a skilled fighter , his advancing age and an encounter with wraith s greatly diminished his physical prowess . He was best known as a master military strategist .

title: Goryu
description: Goryu Goryu was a shukenja priest in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Goryu was head priest at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama .
description_long: Goryu Goryu was a shukenja priest in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Goryu was head priest at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama . He chose to retire here after a life of wandering . Goryu was assisted by a staff of 25 shukenja and 20 servants . Personality . Goryu complained that he had more work now in his retirement than when he wandered the country . However , he couldn ' t abandon his job . Goryu didn ' t know this when he accepted the position of head priest .

title: Goshukara Akinari
description: Goshukara Akinari Goshukara Akinari was the head of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Akinari was plotting to somehow removed Funada Mitsuhide from power and replaced him with a Goshukara .
description_long: Goshukara Akinari Goshukara Akinari was the head of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Akinari was plotting to somehow removed Funada Mitsuhide from power and replaced him with a Goshukara . To this goal he was supported by the local shrines and allied with ninja Phoenix clan also carefully cultivating ties at court and among the local samurai . Akinari also sought support from the foreign community , however for this he came under scrutiny of the Shou Royal Vagabonds , that planned to use him as their puppet History . Akinari may tried to ruin Mitsuhide by pretending he want insult a special envoy of the shogun , Lord Masago , Chief Archivist and Great Subject of the Grand Perceptorate . Personality . Akinari was a good man but deeply concerned by the welfare of his own family . He was extremely proud of his family ’ s heritage and of his title . Akinari secretly hate Matasuuri Nagahide but in public acted as his friend . He dreamed to one day replaced also the shogun and even the emperor with his relatives

title: Goshukara Sadamoto
description: Goshukara Sadamoto Goshukara Sadamoto was a member of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sadamoto supported his brother Goshukara Akinari in his plots , acting as wild card .
description_long: Goshukara Sadamoto Goshukara Sadamoto was a member of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sadamoto supported his brother Goshukara Akinari in his plots , acting as wild card . He always traveled armed in public believing that the Funada clan would attack him in an instant History . Sadamoto may tried to ruin Funada Mitsuhide by ruining a peace meeting between Mitsuhide and the Big Head yakuza gang . In 1357 born Goshukara Tora , the third son of Sadamoto and he held a great party Personality . Sadamoto was a man of impulse , not good in plots or schemes . He was , like his brother , concerned for the success and survival of the family and was especially desirous for a restoration of its fortunes .

title: Goshukara clan
description: Goshukara clan The Goshukara clan , mostly known as Northern Goshukara , were one of the most powerful families in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Goshukara was a very ancient family , able to trace their ancestry directly to the emperor . Their members had ceremonial offices in the Emperor ' s court .
description_long: Goshukara clan The Goshukara clan , mostly known as Northern Goshukara , were one of the most powerful families in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Goshukara was a very ancient family , able to trace their ancestry directly to the emperor . Their members had ceremonial offices in the Emperor ' s court . Secretly , they planned to supplant the Funada clan as rulers of Nakamaru .

title: Gotha
description: Gotha Gotha was a dracolich who was formerly an ancient red dragon and was transformed by Talos . History . Talos , the god of destruction , had approached Gotha to make a proposal .
description_long: Gotha Gotha was a dracolich who was formerly an ancient red dragon and was transformed by Talos . History . Talos , the god of destruction , had approached Gotha to make a proposal . Talos vowed to keep Gotha from death indefinitely , provided Gotha would perform an unnamed task of destruction at some point in the future , at Talos ' request . Gotha feared the effects of age and his eventual death more than anything else and subsequently agreed . Talos instructed him to fly to the north of Faerûn to an ice cave , where an avalanche trapped him for a total of 237 years , keeping him alive and in constant pain and transforming him into a dracolich .

title: Gothal
description: Gothal Mother Gothal owned a festhall in Amphail . History . Once Gothal was a famed dancer in Baldur ' s Gate until she retired in Waterdeep .
description_long: Gothal Mother Gothal owned a festhall in Amphail . History . Once Gothal was a famed dancer in Baldur ' s Gate until she retired in Waterdeep . There , however , she was chased by some slavers and after defeating the slavers Gothal moved to Amphail , where she opened a successful festhall . She liked hearing people ' s dreams and schemes and often gave wise advise .

title: Gothwan Cooper
description: Gothwan Cooper Gothwan Cooper was a male thief member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Gothwan and his friend Honor Reigh , under orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter .
description_long: Gothwan Cooper Gothwan Cooper was a male thief member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Gothwan and his friend Honor Reigh , under orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter . Unfortunately , some time later , the Dead Rats gang kidnapped Gothwan in order to bargain his life for the Crown , which they wanted for themselves . However , the Nasher leaders had no interest in saving Gothwan ' s life . Luckily for him , an adventurer recruited by Sergeant Knox was searching for the Crown and in the process infiltrated the Dead Rats ' hideout in order to interrogate Gothwan . Grateful for saving his life , Gothwan told the adventurer all he knew about the Crown .

title: Gothyl
description: Gothyl Gothyl was an ancient wizard who resurfaced in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Gothyl lived in Daggerdale in Spiderhaunt Wood long ago with a court of apprentices .
description_long: Gothyl Gothyl was an ancient wizard who resurfaced in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Gothyl lived in Daggerdale in Spiderhaunt Wood long ago with a court of apprentices . At the time , she tried to become a lich but failed and instead she became an arch - shadow and was somehow bonded to the Sword of the Dales created by the wizard Shraevyn , becoming trapped in his tomb . In 1369 DR , Gothyl managed to free herself but was greatly weakened . In order to regain her full power , she captured Randal Morn , rightful heir of the Sword , recently injured by some Zhent ish forces . Afterward , she posed as a spirit of the Sword called Hedistrin , tricked an adventuring party recruited to free Randal Morn , and helped them to fight the Zhentarim . In truth , her plot was to attract the party to her tower and use the spell " magic jar " to permit her apprentices to inhabit the adventurers ' bodies . However , her plot eventually failed and Randal Morn was instead captured by the Zhents . Thus , she continued to help the adventurers .

title: Gotokok
description: Gotokok Gotokok was an Iulutiun village known for its annual weapons trade fair . Geography . Gotokok was in Alpuk , alongside the stream linking the Lugalpgotak Sea to Risuak Lake .
description_long: Gotokok Gotokok was an Iulutiun village known for its annual weapons trade fair . Geography . Gotokok was in Alpuk , alongside the stream linking the Lugalpgotak Sea to Risuak Lake . Trade . Every year , the tiny village of Gotokok hosted a " sukkiruchit " specifically for the trade of weapons . Arctic dwarves were known to travel from Novularond to this fair .

title: Govinda
description: Govinda Govinda lived in the fortress of Luntse Dzong in Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Govinda commanded the forces of Luntse Dzong within Ahs Trango Shan .
description_long: Govinda Govinda lived in the fortress of Luntse Dzong in Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Govinda commanded the forces of Luntse Dzong within Ahs Trango Shan . He utilized 150 warriors and 50 monks to insure the pass into eastern Khazari was secure .

title: Gower
description: Gower Gower was a male dwarf scout living in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was an acquaintance of Durnan and Khelben and guided them , plus Elminster Aumar and the mortal Kelemvor , to a passage to the Fugue Plane located in Undermountain .
description_long: Gower Gower was a male dwarf scout living in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was an acquaintance of Durnan and Khelben and guided them , plus Elminster Aumar and the mortal Kelemvor , to a passage to the Fugue Plane located in Undermountain .

title: Goyat Nagumo
description: Goyat Nagumo Goyat Nagumo was a general in Shou Lung . History . Goyat Nagumo was a young promising general , always promoted by the Minister of War Kwan Chan Sen .
description_long: Goyat Nagumo Goyat Nagumo was a general in Shou Lung . History . Goyat Nagumo was a young promising general , always promoted by the Minister of War Kwan Chan Sen . In 1358 DR , the Emperor sent him to Chu ' Yuan province , that was troubled by mysterious assailants . General Goyat started the campaign but always the assailants eluded his troops . Even after establishing martial law in the province the insurrection no stopped so Goyat began to suspect that the centre of evil was the palace of the provincial Governor Kawabi . Fearing to be unveiled Kawabi escaped after sending letters to the Emperor blaming Goyat . The armies of Kawabi and of Goyat Nagumo clashed near the city of Hui and the general defeated the governor . Kawabi however escaped and Goyat followed him , resolute to made him pay for his treason . The long pursuit and the many difficulties affronted made Goyat half - mad . At last Goyat finally confronted and defeated for good Kawabi at Tempat Larang . Kawabi was executed but Goyat was corrupted by the dark spirit of the citadel and declaring himself a ronin sought to create a new empire with himself as it head .

title: Grabber Forth
description: Grabber Forth Grabber Forth was a deep gnome archmage in service to the yugoloth Maram il Vass in the Deep Wastes during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Grabber worked for Maram il Vass .
description_long: Grabber Forth Grabber Forth was a deep gnome archmage in service to the yugoloth Maram il Vass in the Deep Wastes during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Grabber worked for Maram il Vass . He was custodian of the private rooms of the yugoloth , together with a shield guardian .

title: Grabert
description: Grabert Grabert was a soldier in the Golden Legion around 1361 DR . History . Grabert was a veteran swordsman of the Legion .
description_long: Grabert Grabert was a soldier in the Golden Legion around 1361 DR . History . Grabert was a veteran swordsman of the Legion . He was part of Daggrande ' s squad in Payit when they first fought against the Maztican s . He was injured in the battle and later made his report to Cordell and his command staff .

title: Grace of the Masked Lord
description: Grace of the Masked Lord Grace of the Masked Lord was an ability , a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " grace of the Masked Lord " when they needed to deal with traps .
description_long: Grace of the Masked Lord Grace of the Masked Lord was an ability , a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " grace of the Masked Lord " when they needed to deal with traps . A skulker was expected to be able to deal with mundane traps and locks but in the case a dangerous trap that would threaten the skulker ' s group , this ability was used for additional temporary protection . It consisted of creating a zone inside of which the group gained additional protection and the chance to recuperate immediately from the effects of a trap .

title: Gracklstugh
description: Gracklstugh Gracklstugh , the " City of Blades " , was a duergar city on the shores of the Darklake in the Northdark . Geography . The city was located five miles beneath the Evermoors , as well as beneath the Dessarin River valley and the Uthgardt ancestor mound Flintrock .
description_long: Gracklstugh Gracklstugh , the " City of Blades " , was a duergar city on the shores of the Darklake in the Northdark . Geography . The city was located five miles beneath the Evermoors , as well as beneath the Dessarin River valley and the Uthgardt ancestor mound Flintrock . Gracklstugh was located about 100 miles away from Menzoberranzan across the Darklake and beyond . Access to Gracklstugh could be achieved by the following routes : caves in the Sword Mountains ; tunnels from Beldabar ' s Rest in Yartar ; tunnels from Luskan and Mithral Hall ; and via a major trade route from Skullport through the Labyrinth . Structure . Gracklstugh was a cavern city and subterranean port . It had smelters and foundries mingling among stalagmites . The air smelled acrid and was filled with industrial sounds : fire , steam , and iron ringing . The city was lit by firelight . The cavern sloped down on the eastern side to join the Darklake . Laduguer ' s Furrow , also known as " the Cleft , " split the city in half north - south . Bridges connected the higher city to the lakeside districts . The west side was off - limits to foreigners . History .

title: Grady Moll
description: Grady Moll Grady Moll was a officer of the Soldiery of Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Grady was investigating the lumber merchant Fatell , suspected to be part of the Cult of the Eternal Flame when a fire destroyed Fatell ' s shop .
description_long: Grady Moll Grady Moll was a officer of the Soldiery of Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Grady was investigating the lumber merchant Fatell , suspected to be part of the Cult of the Eternal Flame when a fire destroyed Fatell ' s shop . Grady possibly managed to capture Fatell with to help of some adventurers — members of Lords ' Alliance — hired by Cora Peytir . Around 1492 DR he was promoted to captain . Relationship . Grady was secretly a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Graevelwood
description: Graevelwood Graevelwood was an isolated gnomish clanhold located underneath a rocky crag in the eastern reaches of the Arn Forest in the Silver Marches . Government . Clanlord Mavheran Haerlskeel believed a war with orc s was not something she wanted to get her clan involved with so she kept her community ' s location a secret .
description_long: Graevelwood Graevelwood was an isolated gnomish clanhold located underneath a rocky crag in the eastern reaches of the Arn Forest in the Silver Marches . Government . Clanlord Mavheran Haerlskeel believed a war with orc s was not something she wanted to get her clan involved with so she kept her community ' s location a secret . Trade . The settlement did little trading with Deadsnows and Citadel Adbar , but always with as much secrecy as possible . The traders were always careful to cover up their tracks so their path could not be followed back to the clan . Inhabitants . Many of the folk living in Graevelwood were known for their skill in trapping .

title: Grand Army of the Tuigan
description: Grand Army of the Tuigan The Grand Army of the Tuigan , also simply called the Horde , was a formidable fighting force that was assembled by Yamun Khahan and rose to prominence in the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . Formed mostly of horsemen , Yamun Khahan ' s army was fast , efficient , and lethal .
description_long: Grand Army of the Tuigan The Grand Army of the Tuigan , also simply called the Horde , was a formidable fighting force that was assembled by Yamun Khahan and rose to prominence in the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . Formed mostly of horsemen , Yamun Khahan ' s army was fast , efficient , and lethal . The army was organized as follows : Yamun Kahan ' s army numbered over 300 , 000 strong during the height of its power . However , their main strength lay not in sheer numbers , which they certainly possessed , but in the accountability of each individual soldier . If one man within an " arban " committed a crime , then all 10 men of that " arban " were punished . Similarly , if a single man distinguished himself during combat , then all were praised and honored . This iron - willed mentality transformed simple soldiers into something far greater . Tactics . The Horde always carried four times as many horses as men . This allowed for their swift movement which often made it easy for them to surprise and surround their slower adversaries . All individuals of the various tribes of the Hordelands began their training with horses at a very early age .

title: Grand Bazaar
description: Grand Bazaar The Grand Bazaar was a market in the city of Huzuz . Easily the largest open - air market in Zakhara , the Grand Bazaar even surpassed the great markets of Calimport and the Durpar ian markets at Heldapan . Constant change to the layout of the Grand Bazaar made it a confusing place to shop for those unaccustomed to its methods .
description_long: Grand Bazaar The Grand Bazaar was a market in the city of Huzuz . Easily the largest open - air market in Zakhara , the Grand Bazaar even surpassed the great markets of Calimport and the Durpar ian markets at Heldapan . Constant change to the layout of the Grand Bazaar made it a confusing place to shop for those unaccustomed to its methods . However , there were certain lanes and walkways that remained fixtures . Many well - established merchant houses , mystics , and barber s maintained shops here for years . Trade at the bazaar was conducted from dawn until curfew , aided by special lamps to illuminate the vast area after dark via " continual light " enchantments . Services . Nearly anything could be purchased at the Grand Bazaar , but the main problem was actually finding specific items . In order to save time , many adventurers hired guides to show them where specific vendors could be found . Two notable guides were Parok Mirami and Laksi al - Afyid . Services from porters , guides , torch - bearers , and bodyguards could all be purchased for a fee . Prices . Prices were usually not posted on merchandise of any kind .

title: Grand Bazaar Boulevard
description: Grand Bazaar Boulevard The Grand Bazaar Boulevard was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road ran from the heart of Huzuz near the mosques in the Pilgrims ' District northwest to the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .
description_long: Grand Bazaar Boulevard The Grand Bazaar Boulevard was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road ran from the heart of Huzuz near the mosques in the Pilgrims ' District northwest to the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District . It bordered the entire southern face of the Grand Bazaar , providing ample access to the giant marketplace . The Grand Bazaar Boulevard also passed through the Central District en route to the bazaar .

title: Grand Boulevard
description: Grand Boulevard The Grand Boulevard was a large street in Maerimydra . Geography . Situated in the center of Maerimydra , the Grand Boulevard neatly bisected the city into its northern and southern sections .
description_long: Grand Boulevard The Grand Boulevard was a large street in Maerimydra . Geography . Situated in the center of Maerimydra , the Grand Boulevard neatly bisected the city into its northern and southern sections . It was roughly 750 ft ( 228 . 6 m ) long and 150 ft ( 45 . 7 m ) wide and flanked at either end by long sweeping staircases that led up to the Courtyard of Lolth in the west and Castle Maerimydra in the east . History . The Grand Boulevard had long been the busiest part of Maerimydra , owing to its central position and the political and religious institutions it connected . However , in 1372 DR , during the Silence of Lolth the armies of Kurgoth Hellspawn invaded and took over much of the city , including the boulevard . Afterwards , it became a very dangerous place to travel ; thanks to its openness , it was very hard to move about unnoticed and frequent patrols and campsites would appear along its length . Inhabitants . For much of Maerimydra ' s history , the Grand Boulevard was bustling with drow but after the Silence of Lolth , the street became home to the bugbear s , goblins , fire giant s , and ogre s who had set up campsites along it .

title: Grand Caliph
description: Grand Caliph Grand Caliph was the Midani title for the ruler of all of enlightened Zakhara . The Grand Caliph led the Land of Fate in matters of state as well as faith from his seat , the grand palace in the capital city of Huzuz . The extent of his influence on the more distant parts of his realm , however , often remained in doubt .
description_long: Grand Caliph Grand Caliph was the Midani title for the ruler of all of enlightened Zakhara . The Grand Caliph led the Land of Fate in matters of state as well as faith from his seat , the grand palace in the capital city of Huzuz . The extent of his influence on the more distant parts of his realm , however , often remained in doubt . History . The Grand Caliph in 1367 DR was Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir , the 18th wearer of the title and direct descendant of the first Grand Caliph , an al - Badia boy who found the teachings of the Loregiver and united all lands of Zakhara under the banner of Enlightenment more than 500 years earlier .

title: Grand Gate of Delights
description: Grand Gate of Delights The Grand Gate of Delights was the main entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This gate complex consisted of two gates and a pair of towers that stood 90 ft .
description_long: Grand Gate of Delights The Grand Gate of Delights was the main entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This gate complex consisted of two gates and a pair of towers that stood 90 ft . ( 27 m ) high . One of the gates was made from white marble and the other from fine alabaster . The first gate was decorated with gems and gold depicting a mage flying on a carpet . The second gate was inlaid with silver and white gems showing a djinni flying through the sky . Defenses . As shown by the images adorning the artistic gates , the Grand Gate was protected by both magic and genie s in addition to soldiers . A wizard using a " monocle of magic detection " made note of any visitor radiating a magical aura . The visitor would not necessarily be stopped for carrying magical items , but they would be watched closely . A large gong was used in dire circumstances . If struck , hundreds of additional soldiers and dozens of mages would arrives within moments . Activities . The gates were usually left open , allowing thousands of visitors into the Palace each day . Inhabitants .

title: Grand Grelpin
description: Grand Grelpin Grand Grelpin was a kobold wyrmpriest in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he was leading his tribe in search of a rumored dragon into Undermountain when the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr appeared and killed their chieftain .
description_long: Grand Grelpin Grand Grelpin was a kobold wyrmpriest in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he was leading his tribe in search of a rumored dragon into Undermountain when the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr appeared and killed their chieftain . Most of the kobold believed Zarr the dragon in half - elf ' s form . Grelpin no agreed but said nothing for avoid to be killed . He served Zarr until the mercenary ordered to Grelpin to face a basilisk . Instead he hid in chamber , planning a way to escape . Personality . Grelpin wanted overthrow Zarr and the the alliance with the goblin and procailm himself new chieftain . As tribe ' s priest he couldn ' t abandon his fellow .

title: Grand Hoist
description: Grand Hoist The Grand Hoist was an unfinished lift designed to ferry goods back and forth between Waterdeep and Skullport . The hoist was designed to bypass the dangers of Undermountain and the Lapel Sea . History .
description_long: Grand Hoist The Grand Hoist was an unfinished lift designed to ferry goods back and forth between Waterdeep and Skullport . The hoist was designed to bypass the dangers of Undermountain and the Lapel Sea . History . The grand scheme was conceived by a former leader of the Mandible gang . Two teams began digging the shaft , one under Waterdeep and the second in Skullport . The project was a series of disasters that bankrupted most of its investors . As of 1479 DR , the Mandibles continued work on the project although at a reduced pace .

title: Grand University of Huzuz
description: Grand University of Huzuz The Grand University of Huzuz was a school located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Grand University could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Grand University of Huzuz The Grand University of Huzuz was a school located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Grand University could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Inhabitants . Fanya bint Parigar was the head of the Grand University . She employed teachers and instructors , including Fatima Asad , a language teacher . The Grand University enrolled a few hundred students for a three - year course covering topics such as business , language , history , and etiquette . Activities . Despite its name , the Grand University was actually a small school , though Fanya did have lofty aspirations that it would one day be the most respected school in all of Huzuz .

title: Grandfather Tree
description: Grandfather Tree The Grandfather Tree was an arakhor , an elder form of treant , which appeared as a monstrously large , gnarled oak tree located deep in the heart of the High Forest . Four smaller oak trees marked the corners of the tree ' s roots , along with a few rotted tree stumps , elven works , and totems of the Blue Bear tribe . This arakhor was summoned in −12 , 500 DR by the Elves of Aryvandaar to guard the site , after they discovered the Hall of Mists , which now lay under its roots .
description_long: Grandfather Tree The Grandfather Tree was an arakhor , an elder form of treant , which appeared as a monstrously large , gnarled oak tree located deep in the heart of the High Forest . Four smaller oak trees marked the corners of the tree ' s roots , along with a few rotted tree stumps , elven works , and totems of the Blue Bear tribe . This arakhor was summoned in −12 , 500 DR by the Elves of Aryvandaar to guard the site , after they discovered the Hall of Mists , which now lay under its roots . . The Grandfather Tree was considered hallowed ground to both the barbarian tribes of the north and other inhabitants of the forest . As such , the tree had many natural and magical wards protecting it from evil . The Grandfather Tree was also considered sacred to a number of forest deities . An Uthgardt tribe , the Tree Ghost s , also considered the Grandfather Tree sacred and in 1374 DR had a camp quite close .

title: Grandfather of Assassins
description: Grandfather of Assassins Grandfather of Assassins is the title of the ruling leader of the Citadel of Assassins , based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Grandfather always conceals his face with a mask and is said to be immortal .
description_long: Grandfather of Assassins Grandfather of Assassins is the title of the ruling leader of the Citadel of Assassins , based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Grandfather always conceals his face with a mask and is said to be immortal . In truth once a Grandfather gets old and dies a new one is chosen to take his place . This superstition that the Grandfather cannot die is one of the guilds many terror weapons . Parents local to Vaasa and Damara often threaten naughty children by telling them that the Grandfather will come take them away if they don ' t behave . In 1357 DR , the Grandfather of Assassins , in league with the Witch - King Zhengyi , and priests of Orcus , attacked Bloodstone Village with an army of mainly human brigands and orcs , but also with Wyvern s , giant s , and other monsters . This attack was thwarted by the paladin , Gareth Dragonsbane and his party of adventurers . The current Grandfather of Assassins , as of 1372 DR , is Timoshenko , who plays the political face of the organization . His chief lieutenant , the wizard Knellict , carries out the dirty work .

title: Grankhul
description: Grankhul Grankhul is the bugbear deity of hunting , senses , stealth , and surprise . His symbol is ever - open eyes in darkness . Description .
description_long: Grankhul Grankhul is the bugbear deity of hunting , senses , stealth , and surprise . His symbol is ever - open eyes in darkness . Description . Grankhul appears as a tall , relatively lean bugbear with large , protruding eyes and very long , thin fingers . Relationships . The bugbear pantheon is dominated by Hruggek , though he doesn ' t really rule it . There is more of an understanding among the bugbear gods that no one acts against Hruggek ' s interests , and in return Hruggek leaves the others alone . Hruggek ' s priests often have to keep a wary eye out for the sneakiness of Grankhul ' s priests , however . Other bugbear deities include Skiggaret ; local pantheons often include a god of earth , a god of fertility , and a god of death . Realm . Grankhul shares the realm of Palpitatia on the 241st layer of the Abyss with his fellow bugbear god , Skiggaret . This layer is eternally dark , populated by shadows and spectres , with fear eternally radiating from every inch of the grim terrain . Dogma . Grankhul values dexterity , speed , and at least a modicum of wit . Grankhul is said to have been the god who gifted bugbears with their ability to surprise their prey .

title: Grappling hook
description: Grappling hook A grappling hook was a three pronged hook that was attachable to a rope . Uses . Its intended use was to make climbing easier and safer but thieves took advantage of the tool and it has since become a crucial tool for a thief .
description_long: Grappling hook A grappling hook was a three pronged hook that was attachable to a rope . Uses . Its intended use was to make climbing easier and safer but thieves took advantage of the tool and it has since become a crucial tool for a thief . Variant . A foldable , single - pronged version of the grappling hook was included in a rope set sold by Aurora ' s Emporium in its " Thieves ' Corner " sortiment .

title: Grash Crackbacker
description: Grash Crackbacker Grash Crackbacker was a slow - witted priest of Bhaal . Description . A pale - skinned half - orc , Grash dressed in an intricate red - and - black robe .
description_long: Grash Crackbacker Grash Crackbacker was a slow - witted priest of Bhaal . Description . A pale - skinned half - orc , Grash dressed in an intricate red - and - black robe . Atop his head rested a golden crown with two red gemstones , and his wide - nosed face bore an aggressive scowl . Personality . Grash had an inclination towards cruelty . He was sorely lacking in intelligence , to the extent that it was considered doubtful he would rise further in the clerical hierarchy of Bhaal . Abilities . Grash possessed incredible strength , which he used to his advantage when employing the " bear hug " , his favorite attack . Possessions . Among Grash ' s possessions were a suit of mundane plate mail , as well as an un holy symbol .

title: Grask
description: Grask Grask was the dusk beast companion of Sithierel on the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , Grask loyally served Sithirel , during the Despayr ' s plot , guarding the boat , Necreme .
description_long: Grask Grask was the dusk beast companion of Sithierel on the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , Grask loyally served Sithirel , during the Despayr ' s plot , guarding the boat , Necreme . Eventually , an adventurer party defeated Grask and Sithierel .

title: Grasping shadows
description: Grasping shadows Grasping shadows is an illusion spell learned by newly trained wizard , particularly those that hope to specialize as illusionists . With " grasping shadows " a wizard is able to summon forth magical darkness that reaches out ensnares nearby foes . These shadows effect an area of roughly five feet in diameter , within fifty feet of the wizard .
description_long: Grasping shadows Grasping shadows is an illusion spell learned by newly trained wizard , particularly those that hope to specialize as illusionists . With " grasping shadows " a wizard is able to summon forth magical darkness that reaches out ensnares nearby foes . These shadows effect an area of roughly five feet in diameter , within fifty feet of the wizard . Creatures caught in the shadowy burst suffer great pain and are slowed down for a brief while . The spell lasts only a short time but can be recast at the wizard ' s command after a short rest , necessary to regain the concentration required for the spell ' s casting .

title: Grasping vine
description: Grasping vine Grasping vine was a conjuration spell that summoned a vine capable of pulling creatures toward it . Effects . The spell caused a vine to sprout from the ground that could pull another creature directly towards it .
description_long: Grasping vine Grasping vine was a conjuration spell that summoned a vine capable of pulling creatures toward it . Effects . The spell caused a vine to sprout from the ground that could pull another creature directly towards it . The vine lasted for up to one minute , for as long as the caster concentrated , and could be commanded to pull other creatures . Components . The spell needed verbal and somatic components .

title: Grass
description: Grass Grass is plentiful in many varieties in the " Forgotten Realms " . Varieties . Bluegrass .
description_long: Grass Grass is plentiful in many varieties in the " Forgotten Realms " . Varieties . Bluegrass . Bluegrass grows in the midwood and starwood areas of the forest of Cormanthor . Crabgrass . Crabgrass grows in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Peppergrass . Peppergrass grows in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . In the past , a blaze caused by fyrefly activity incinerated all of the peppergrass east of Hap . Quack . Quack grass grows in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . It has become an alternative food source for the fyreflies . Wiregrass . Wiregrass grows in clumps on hillsides in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Zebra . Zebra grass grows in the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor .

title: Grassland circle
description: Grassland circle The grassland circle was a druid circle associated with the wide open plains and prairies . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Grassland circle The grassland circle was a druid circle associated with the wide open plains and prairies . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Gratus
description: Gratus Gratus was a male human living in Scardale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Gratus was originally the Minister of Propaganda in the regime of Lord Lashan Aumersair .
description_long: Gratus Gratus was a male human living in Scardale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Gratus was originally the Minister of Propaganda in the regime of Lord Lashan Aumersair . When his lord was defeated , he surrendered to the allied forces and for this was not prosecuted like his fellow members of Lashan ' s government . Gratus later become a shoemaker but had some dealings with the underworld of Scardale and knew well the thief Varden . When the god Bane , after the Battle of Shadowdale , ordered the Zhentilar armies to conquer Scardale to use it to then threaten Tantras , Gratus became a leader in the Sembian Resistance , composed of all the forces in the dale fighting the Zhent s . When Varden returned from a mission with the heroes Midnight and Adon , Gratus came to believe that they could cause havoc for Bane , so he offered the help of the Resistance to the heroes .

title: Graul
description: Graul Graul was an orc leader in Dead Orc Pass in the Silver Marches . Description . Graul was a large orc .
description_long: Graul Graul was an orc leader in Dead Orc Pass in the Silver Marches . Description . Graul was a large orc . Personality . Graul was a follower of Gruumsh , but he was not very religious . Nevertheless , he was very crafty and knew how to use his people ' s superstitions against them . History . He raided caravans that came through the Dead Orc Pass , but the blind ranger Montolio Debrouchee often stood in his way . In 1341 DR , Graul had under his command 1 , 000 fighters ( including orcs , worg s , and giant s ) and controlled half of the valley . That year , he was approached by the bounty hunter Roddy McGristle , who convinced him ( through monetary payment ) to mount an attack against Montolio ' s home in Mooshie ' s Grove . The attack failed , and Graul and the survivors turned on McGristle ; he easily escaped , however .

title: Graven Larvoldson
description: Graven Larvoldson Graven Larvoldson was a dwarf blacksmith in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Graven had a workshop in Waterdeep .
description_long: Graven Larvoldson Graven Larvoldson was a dwarf blacksmith in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Graven had a workshop in Waterdeep . History . In 1479 DR , he was kidnapped by the vampire Dayan , who ordered him to create the receptacles Dayan used to hold his life force when he turned to mist . After finishing the work , Graven was left in his cell to die .

title: Gravenhollow
description: Gravenhollow Gravenhollow was a mystic library in the Underdark . Description . The library was a peculiar building for many reasons : it was outside the normal time of Toril , everybody inside it understood all languages , it was bigger on the inside , it prevented works of magic except divination , and nobody could find it without its keeper ' s will .
description_long: Gravenhollow Gravenhollow was a mystic library in the Underdark . Description . The library was a peculiar building for many reasons : it was outside the normal time of Toril , everybody inside it understood all languages , it was bigger on the inside , it prevented works of magic except divination , and nobody could find it without its keeper ' s will . A very peculiar trait of Gravenhollow was that it " remembered " all who had walked its halls , as well as those who would visit the library in the future . People exploring the library found apparitions constantly flicking in and out of existence around them . These were the echoes of those who had come or would come to Gravenhollow in search of knowledge . History . Nobody knew who built Gravenhollow , but is was known to have existed since the dawn of giant - kin .

title: Graveyard ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Graveyard ( Mere of Dead Men ) This unnamed graveyard was a graveyard in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . This graveyard was located near Fort Locke .
description_long: Graveyard ( Mere of Dead Men ) This unnamed graveyard was a graveyard in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . This graveyard was located near Fort Locke . Structure . The graveyard was composed of smaller graves and two stone crypts . Interior . The smaller crypt held some minor magical items . The bigger crypt held many more treasures , but many more undead , led by the shadow priest . History . This graveyard was one of many sites where the King of Shadows clashed with the Neverwinter army . The graveyard was built to contain many dead soldiers , without any names . The graveyard was infested by zombies and skeletons when the shadow priest was ordered to raise an army , by Black Garius ' demands . Commander Tann and his men ( Bruneil , Blaine and Garret ) were captured . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve rescued them ( except Garret , who died ) and lead them out of the graveyard .

title: Graxxygak
description: Graxxygak Graxxygak was a half - dragon troll berserker in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Graxxygak was the half - dragon son of Throstulgrael in the Twilight Marsh .
description_long: Graxxygak Graxxygak was a half - dragon troll berserker in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Graxxygak was the half - dragon son of Throstulgrael in the Twilight Marsh . He was his father ' s last line of defense until he was confronted and killed by an adventuring party sent to recover some items from her father ' s lair .

title: Gray Doom
description: Gray Doom The Gray Doom were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Gray Doom earned a reputation in the Sword Coast for their skill and swiftness in skirmishes .
description_long: Gray Doom The Gray Doom were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Gray Doom earned a reputation in the Sword Coast for their skill and swiftness in skirmishes . During the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep , they sided with the forces of good and were decisive in the victory of the Battle of Thurgabanteth in Chondath . However , they were placed on the blacklists of many evil groups for this . Two years later , the Chill ambushed the Gray Doom and destroyed them .

title: Gray Forest
description: Gray Forest The Grey Forest , also spelled the Gray Forest and also called the Tsurlar Forest , was a forest located between the Vast and the nation of Impiltur , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains . History . Moon elves once lived in the Gray Forest several centuries before the 14th century DR .
description_long: Gray Forest The Grey Forest , also spelled the Gray Forest and also called the Tsurlar Forest , was a forest located between the Vast and the nation of Impiltur , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains . History . Moon elves once lived in the Gray Forest several centuries before the 14th century DR . However , when hobgoblin s and various other creatures began to encroach on their lands , the elves fought a losing war against them . They increasingly lost ground and some were driven out , but the rest were unwilling to give up their homes . The Gray Forest moon elves faced extinction . Thus , their last act was to transform themselves into grand gray - barked trees , so that they would never leave . However , a population of wood elves remained in the Grey Forest . In the Year of the Dawndance , 1095 DR , they joined an alliance with the cities of Impiltur and the dwarves of the Earthfast Mountains . Led by War - Captain Imphras Heltharn , this alliance fought to repel the hobgoblin hordes of the Giantspire Mountains . By 1372 DR , a new leader had risen to organize the hobgoblins of the Gray Forest .

title: Gray Ghosts
description: Gray Ghosts The Gray Ghosts were the only true thieves ' guild of Gracklstugh . They were filled with derro and duergar outcasts and a few escaped slaves . The Gray Ghosts had a special interest in a ruined obelisk they had found that they believed contained " unimaginable power " , so they tried to recollect all the fragments of the obelisk and rebuild it .
description_long: Gray Ghosts The Gray Ghosts were the only true thieves ' guild of Gracklstugh . They were filled with derro and duergar outcasts and a few escaped slaves . The Gray Ghosts had a special interest in a ruined obelisk they had found that they believed contained " unimaginable power " , so they tried to recollect all the fragments of the obelisk and rebuild it . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Gray Ghosts stole a red dragon egg containing the new Wyrmsmith from the Keepers of the Flame . The Keepers used all their strength to eradicate the thieves and captured and executed the Gray Ghosts leader . The guild was then led by a triumvirate of renegade derro savants — Uskvil and the twin sisters Aliinka and Zubriska .

title: Gray Goose Provisioners
description: Gray Goose Provisioners Gray Goose Provisioners was a store in Eshpurta run by Carn Wittsome and his mistress , Nethris Perndle . The Gray Goose carried good trail rations and other small supplies for those that needed or wanted to travel . Prices were very reasonable but sometimes it was awkward interrupting an argument between the two proprietors to make a purchase — the elderly couple bickered constantly on just about every topic .
description_long: Gray Goose Provisioners Gray Goose Provisioners was a store in Eshpurta run by Carn Wittsome and his mistress , Nethris Perndle . The Gray Goose carried good trail rations and other small supplies for those that needed or wanted to travel . Prices were very reasonable but sometimes it was awkward interrupting an argument between the two proprietors to make a purchase — the elderly couple bickered constantly on just about every topic . The shop was located next door to Bhamm ' s Herbs in the southern quarter of the city .

title: Gray Hand enforcer
description: Gray Hand enforcer Gray Hand Enforcers were highly trained elite members of the Gray Hands , the elite fighting force of Waterdeep , serving directly under the employ of the city ' s Lords . Enforcers were known for their loyalty to Waterdeep , their disregard for any formalities and most of all for not fearing death .
description_long: Gray Hand enforcer Gray Hand Enforcers were highly trained elite members of the Gray Hands , the elite fighting force of Waterdeep , serving directly under the employ of the city ' s Lords . Enforcers were known for their loyalty to Waterdeep , their disregard for any formalities and most of all for not fearing death .

title: Gray Hands
description: Gray Hands The Gray Hands were a group of adventurers whose duty it was to defend the city of Waterdeep from immense dangers . Organization . The elite band was small in number but were still quite capable of felling the most dangerous of foes .
description_long: Gray Hands The Gray Hands were a group of adventurers whose duty it was to defend the city of Waterdeep from immense dangers . Organization . The elite band was small in number but were still quite capable of felling the most dangerous of foes . While they answered directly to the Lords of Waterdeep , they were only called upon in the most dire of situations as the collateral damage from the Gray Hands ' excursions could become quite extensive .

title: Gray Hunt
description: Gray Hunt The party must violate a treaty between Loudwater and the Zhentarim in order to prevent the possibility of a greater conflict . Orc migrants from the Loudwater side of the territorial border are raiding Zhent land and Loudwater needs to stop them . .
description_long: Gray Hunt The party must violate a treaty between Loudwater and the Zhentarim in order to prevent the possibility of a greater conflict . Orc migrants from the Loudwater side of the territorial border are raiding Zhent land and Loudwater needs to stop them . . . without anyone knowing that they are doing so .

title: Gray Vale
description: Gray Vale Gray Vale , also seen as Grayvale , was the area centered around Loudwater in 1479 DR . During the 14th century DR the Grayvale was merely a part of the region known locally as the Delimbiyr Crescent but after the Spellplague and the reduction in the region ' s population , the nomenclature appears to have been simplified and the entire valley south of the High Forest as well as the surrounding lands became known as the Grey Vale . It was presumably named after the Graypeak Mountains , which sheltered the area in the east ; the Grey Highlands and the Greyflow river , which joins the Delimbiyr as a major tributary - all of which were local geographical features .
description_long: Gray Vale Gray Vale , also seen as Grayvale , was the area centered around Loudwater in 1479 DR . During the 14th century DR the Grayvale was merely a part of the region known locally as the Delimbiyr Crescent but after the Spellplague and the reduction in the region ' s population , the nomenclature appears to have been simplified and the entire valley south of the High Forest as well as the surrounding lands became known as the Grey Vale . It was presumably named after the Graypeak Mountains , which sheltered the area in the east ; the Grey Highlands and the Greyflow river , which joins the Delimbiyr as a major tributary - all of which were local geographical features .

title: Gray Wolf Tribe
description: Gray Wolf Tribe The Gray Wolf Tribe were Uthgardt barbarian s who had a characteristic every single member shared : under the light of the full moon , they all turned into savage werewolves . History . The legacy of the Gray Wolf Tribe was thought to have begun when they accepted refugees from fallen Gauntlgrym into their fold .
description_long: Gray Wolf Tribe The Gray Wolf Tribe were Uthgardt barbarian s who had a characteristic every single member shared : under the light of the full moon , they all turned into savage werewolves . History . The legacy of the Gray Wolf Tribe was thought to have begun when they accepted refugees from fallen Gauntlgrym into their fold . Guul Shatterneck and his bandits once unwisely attacked members of the Gray Wolf and took them captive , not thinking to study their prey first . Come the next full moon , the Gray Wolf escaped and tore their captors apart . In 1372 DR , the Gray Wolf ancestral mound was the Raven Rock . Religion . The Gray Wolf beast totem mutated the curse over time as they embraced the savagery inherent in it and they all turned into werewolves , despite their ancestors . Any Gray Wolf who did not wish to share the curse would be cured within a year after leaving the tribe .

title: Gray guard
description: Gray guard Among the ranks of paladin s there are some who have seen too much . The archetype of the noble - spirited paladin , resplendent in blessed armor and wielding a holy blade to smite the enemies of goodness , has gotten countless good men and women killed by their enemies ' underhanded tactics . Taking a cue from their foes , certain churches have formed semi - secret groups from their most experienced and hard - hearted paladins and cleric s , and trained them in the shadowy tactics favored by such worthies as the Church of Shar .
description_long: Gray guard Among the ranks of paladin s there are some who have seen too much . The archetype of the noble - spirited paladin , resplendent in blessed armor and wielding a holy blade to smite the enemies of goodness , has gotten countless good men and women killed by their enemies ' underhanded tactics . Taking a cue from their foes , certain churches have formed semi - secret groups from their most experienced and hard - hearted paladins and cleric s , and trained them in the shadowy tactics favored by such worthies as the Church of Shar . These gray guards follow a looser code than the average paladin , and do whatever must be done to protect the innocent and helpless from those who would do them harm . Background . The vast majority of gray guards are paladins . Only the most realistic and dedicated holy warriors join a church ' s order of gray guards , knowing that evil runs rampant in the world , always has , and will not be expunged merely by good example . They join out of necessity , not out of resentment for the code of conduct ; those who chafe at their responsibilities are unfit to be paladins , let alone gray guards . Religion .

title: Gray ooze
description: Gray ooze A gray ooze resembles a thick puddle of gray sludge , roughly 8 " ( 20 cm ) and up to 14 ' ( 4 . 27 m ) across , that closely resembles wet stone or an amorphous rock formation . They consume any organic matter they encounter .
description_long: Gray ooze A gray ooze resembles a thick puddle of gray sludge , roughly 8 " ( 20 cm ) and up to 14 ' ( 4 . 27 m ) across , that closely resembles wet stone or an amorphous rock formation . They consume any organic matter they encounter . Lairs . Gray ooze is a living form of slime that slinks through cold swamps and marshes . They can also be found in caverns and dungeons . They are mindless scavengers who drag themselves around caves and sewers and absorb and digest whatever they come across . Unlike other ooze s , the gray variety cannot move on ceilings or walls , hence it is left to slide its way along subterranean floors . Reperduction . Gray oozes reproduce by breaking small driplets off of them after a meal , which later grow into gray oozes themselves . Combat . While possessing an immunity to magic , fire and cold the gray ooze cannot speak . They attack by striking until its prey is either dead or unconscious , moving on top of them afterwards to digest them from within . Acidic secretions of the gray ooze corrode metal at an alarming rate ; as a result , blacksmiths also sometimes use jarred gray oozes to meld ore into the right shape .

title: Gray portrait
description: Gray portrait The gray portrait is an artifact that halts the natural ageing process . History . The most common myth regarding this artifact tells of Belarian the Beautiful , a follower of Sune who supposedly lived in the seventh century before Dalereckoning .
description_long: Gray portrait The gray portrait is an artifact that halts the natural ageing process . History . The most common myth regarding this artifact tells of Belarian the Beautiful , a follower of Sune who supposedly lived in the seventh century before Dalereckoning . Despite his godess ' edict that beauty is only skin deep , Belarian lived his entire life attempting to enhance and preserve his physical appearance . So obsessed was he that he forsook Sune to petition any power that would listen to make it so his looks never degraded . One such power gave him his wish , granting the " portrait " to Belarian in exchange for his soul . No sage has confirmed the existence of Belarian , nor has anyone done anything more than speculate about his fate but it is known that the " portrait " has existed since the mythologically - stated time of Belarians life . It has been owned by several individuals since then but , as with many items of such power , its location has been lost . Powers . If the portrait remains in the possession of an individual for an entire tenday , an image of that individual appears on the otherwise blank canvas .

title: Gray render
description: Gray render A gray render is a magical beast born from various terrain substances present in swamps and marshes . History . Although many scholars have come to believe that roots of gray renders can be traced back to the Elemental Chaos , the truth of the matter is that gray renders were created thousands of years ago by a small conclave of silver dragon wizards who spent most of their time in elven form and developed gray renders primarily as bodyguards for their loyal minions .
description_long: Gray render A gray render is a magical beast born from various terrain substances present in swamps and marshes . History .
