Its primary function was to provide a place for the elves to keep their horse s while in the city . Inhabitants . There were typically around a hundred moon horse s in the Greenmeadow and they were allowed to freely roam rather than being restricted to a stable .

title: Greenshores
description: Greenshores County Greenshores was at the base of the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula in Tethyr . Geography . Greenshores was the eastern most of the three counties of the of Cape Velen .
description_long: Greenshores County Greenshores was at the base of the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula in Tethyr . Geography . Greenshores was the eastern most of the three counties of the of Cape Velen . It bordered Duchy Noromath to the east . The county benefited from the passage of the Trade Way through its lands . Society . The people of Greenshores were the only human s in Tethyr whom the elves of the Wealdath respected for their ability to live alongside nature without destroying it . As a rule , the citizens of Greenshores preferred a simple life among the trees . This meant that they were often considered a backwater folk by others in the country . Government . In 1370 DR , County Greenshores was ruled by Mosstone local Jordy Gallum . The Count ' s seat of power was at Kirgard .

title: Greenstone
description: Greenstone Greenstone was the Faerûnian name for , a gray - green variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were soft and usually cut or tumbled and polished .
description_long: Greenstone Greenstone was the Faerûnian name for , a gray - green variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were soft and usually cut or tumbled and polished . High quality greenstones could take on a glassy finish and such stones were sometimes called chlorastras . Greenstones were found in solidified lava flows , in nodules of up to three quarters of an inch ( two centimeters ) in diameter . Exceptionally large specimens were made into " greenstone amulet s " . Greenstones were plentiful and easy to work with so a fair amount of fraudulent amulets were created and enchanted with " Nystul ' s magic aura " . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Flawed stones and those too small to be useful were crushed to powder and used as a material component in casting abjuration - type spells that protected the mind . However , certain spells were ruined when this gem was added , making them completely ineffectual . This gemstone was one of the " nine secrets " — minerals that could be enchanted to make an " ioun stone " .

title: Greenwood
description: Greenwood Greenwood was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It temporarily turned a dead or dying tree or a wooden object into a green , leafy plant , vibrant with life . Effects .
description_long: Greenwood Greenwood was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It temporarily turned a dead or dying tree or a wooden object into a green , leafy plant , vibrant with life . Effects . This spell could be cast at one plant or object made from wood , shrubs , or vines up to 150 ft ( 46 m ) away . If the target was an intact plant , such as a dead tree , the spell affected the entire plant . Otherwise , it could alter about 14 cubic feet ( 0 . 4 cubic meters ) of wood or objects made of wood , such as a desk , a pile of wooden shields , or a part of a bridge . The transformation lasted at least 50 minutes . Higher level casters could extend the range and duration of the spell , and increase the volume of plant material affected . " Greenwood " caused the target plant or wooden object to sprout leaves and appear green and healthy . This foliage was typically enough to conceal one medium - sized creature , but not enough to be used for " entangle " . Dry or seasoned wood became fresh , unseasoned wood , and could bend , sag , or snap if put under stress ( like a ship ' s mast or a bridge support ) .

title: Gregor
description: Gregor Brother Gregor was an alchemist dedicated to Oghma who lived in the city of Ormpetarr around 1479 DR . Gregor was touched by wild magic and had a spellscar that allowed him to know the effects that any ingredients would have on a potion . History .
description_long: Gregor Brother Gregor was an alchemist dedicated to Oghma who lived in the city of Ormpetarr around 1479 DR . Gregor was touched by wild magic and had a spellscar that allowed him to know the effects that any ingredients would have on a potion . History . Gregor was apprenticed to an alchemist at an early age . Later in life , he was touched by the Spellplague and acquired a spellscar that gave him abilities that made him one of the best alchemists in Faerûn . In 1478 DR , he had a vision that the Kelemvoran monastery in Impiltur should move to Ormpetarr . He was able to convince the monks to travel to Ormpetarr and begin construction on a new monastery . Gregor was able to develop an elixir that conferred partial immunity to the effects of the Spellplague . The Order of Blue Flame used the potion in their ritual to enlarge the Plaguewrought Land . Gregor was uneasy with the methods of the Order but he believed their goal was to contain areas of wild magic , so he cooperated with the Order ' s plans . After Tyrangal and Duvan disrupted the Order ' s ritual to move the Plaguewrought Land ' s border , Tyrangal imprisoned Gregor and convinced him to conduct research on her behalf .

title: Greigor Kundknoddick
description: Greigor Kundknoddick Greigor Kundknoddick was a frost giant jarl in the late 15th century DR . History . Greigor was the leader of a frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .
description_long: Greigor Kundknoddick Greigor Kundknoddick was a frost giant jarl in the late 15th century DR . History . Greigor was the leader of a frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening . In 1485 DR , during the late stages of the War of the Silver Marches , Greigor was approached by Jarlaxle , who suggested he withdraw his troops in the wake of the imminent defeat of Many - Arrows .

title: Greila Sontoin
description: Greila Sontoin Greila Sontoin was a High Priestess of Mystra in the temple on Mount Talath in Halruaa . Personality . Greila was granted supernatural wisdom by Mystra .
description_long: Greila Sontoin Greila Sontoin was a High Priestess of Mystra in the temple on Mount Talath in Halruaa . Personality . Greila was granted supernatural wisdom by Mystra . Activities . Because of her age and many duties regarding the temple , Greila seldom left the security of Mount Talath . However , even as late as 1373 DR , she was still considered powerful enough to pose a threat to Zalathorm Kirkson . Thankfully , the two were cordial with each other and remained in close contact .

title: Grek
description: Grek Grek was an imperfect galeb duhr in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Grek , while only half - finished , was exiled from the stone giant Lodge of Faces by the elder Daitya .
description_long: Grek Grek was an imperfect galeb duhr in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Grek , while only half - finished , was exiled from the stone giant Lodge of Faces by the elder Daitya . It arrived in Szith Morcane where it witnessed the madness of the fire giant s .

title: Grell
description: Grell Grell were sightless aberrations that resembled giant floating brains with tentacles and a beak . Anatomy . Much like other aberrant creatures , the anatomy of a grell was truly bizarre .
description_long: Grell Grell were sightless aberrations that resembled giant floating brains with tentacles and a beak . Anatomy . Much like other aberrant creatures , the anatomy of a grell was truly bizarre . While some held that these flying , tentacled " brains " were the horrific creation of a parallel world or alternate plane , they actually originated from the Far Realm , where the laws of nature differed wildly from those of the Prime Material Plane . The wrinkled hide of a grell varied from a pale pink - gray to a faint purple - pink in coloration ( with older specimens being darker in color than younger ones ) which , combined with its damp skin that gleamed wetly in poor light , made adventurers mistake the creatures for disembodied brains . This skin was actually surprisingly leathery and tough ; measuring several inches thick on the upper body of a grell . The only other external features of a grell were its ten strong , rubbery tentacles and its hard beak . The tentacles were each 5 - 8 feet long ( with larger grell having longer tentacles ) and made up of hundreds of ring - shaped muscles sheathed in an almost fibrous hide much thinner than the epidermis of the creature ' s body .

title: Grenai Markin
description: Grenai Markin Grenai Markin lived in Luenath in central Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Activities . Herald served as Warchief of Luenath .
description_long: Grenai Markin Grenai Markin lived in Luenath in central Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Activities . Herald served as Warchief of Luenath . He was also the consort to Duchess Merial Luenath . Relationships . His older brother , Herald Markin , served as Warchief in Prastuil .

title: Grendan Baenre
description: Grendan Baenre Grendan Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a tenth - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . He was considered handsome and had a flair for illusion . History .
description_long: Grendan Baenre Grendan Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a tenth - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . He was considered handsome and had a flair for illusion . History . Gredan was one of the Baenre magic - users that Gromph Baenre gathered during the Siege of Menzoberranzan for an attack on Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal .

title: Grengoral Whelshire
description: Grengoral Whelshire Grengoral Whelshire was the leader of Perfectone Mercantile in the north Faerûn . History . Grengoral was an adventurer who became a merchant .
description_long: Grengoral Whelshire Grengoral Whelshire was the leader of Perfectone Mercantile in the north Faerûn . History . Grengoral was an adventurer who became a merchant . He worked six years with the Seven Suns Trading Coster but grew bored of losing around 30 % of his goods to bandits . So he went to his friend the mage Samuel Longspeak to explain a idea for a new kind of business : transporting goods with magic from one city to another . Thanks to Samuel , Grengoral recruited other mages in different cities and created Perfectone Mercantile .

title: Greshlyrr
description: Greshlyrr Greshlyrr was a kobold chief of the Scything Claw tribe in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . Greshlyrr gained his fame among his tribe from an episode : he found in a abandoned den a masterfully crafted figurine of Kurtulmak and only second later he had exit the den collapsed in a earthquake .
description_long: Greshlyrr Greshlyrr was a kobold chief of the Scything Claw tribe in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . Greshlyrr gained his fame among his tribe from an episode : he found in a abandoned den a masterfully crafted figurine of Kurtulmak and only second later he had exit the den collapsed in a earthquake . This was saw as a sign of Kurtulmak ' s blessing to Greshlyrr . Around 1348 DR he became the Scything Claw chief , elevating his tribe to a higher a level of civilization . At same time he started a war with the nearby gnome settlement of Gildenglade that after many years ended with a truce . In 1358 a band of goblin s attacked Greshlyrr ' s tribe and while he and his warriors were away an adventuring party raided his camp . Feeling betrayed by the gnomes Greshlyrr decided to attack Gildenglade . Secretly Yrkhetep amused himself looking about Greshlyrr . Personality . Greshlyrr was a unusual intelligent and cunning kobold . He was cruel and took joy from others ' suffering .

title: Greshrukk
description: Greshrukk Greshrukk , or Red Eye , was an old red dragon turned into a disembodied dracolich . History . Greshrukk was to be the nascent Berdusk an Dragon Cult ' s second attempt at creating a dracolich , at the request of Shhuusshuru .
description_long: Greshrukk Greshrukk , or Red Eye , was an old red dragon turned into a disembodied dracolich . History . Greshrukk was to be the nascent Berdusk an Dragon Cult ' s second attempt at creating a dracolich , at the request of Shhuusshuru . When they first attempted to transform him into a night dragon however , the attempt was unsuccessful , as Harpers attacked just as the ceremony was being completed and slew Red Eye . Red Eye ' s spirit was not transferred into a body as planned , but was believed to reside within his intended phylactery , a glassteel ed ruby set into the pommel of a magic longsword named " Dragonstooth " , which was lost in the fighting that interrupted his transformation . Both the Harpers and the Cult sought the weapon . Eventually , a band of adventurers came across the sword . The Cult got their hands on the adventurers but Greshrukk was not successfully transformed after the ensuing battle and was still trapped in the sword ' s pommel .

title: Grewe
description: Grewe Grewe was a male Northman human and the king of Konigheim in the Utter East in the mid – 7th century DR . In the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR , King Grewe was the first to discover the ancient bloodforge s of the Utter East . These ancient devices of war could mass - produce entire armies of golems , eliminating overnight the cost of mustering and maintaining armed forces .
description_long: Grewe Grewe was a male Northman human and the king of Konigheim in the Utter East in the mid – 7th century DR . In the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR , King Grewe was the first to discover the ancient bloodforge s of the Utter East . These ancient devices of war could mass - produce entire armies of golems , eliminating overnight the cost of mustering and maintaining armed forces . Within tenday s , Ffolk across all the Five Kingdoms had discovered bloodforges of their own , and immediately burst into the Bloodforge Wars .

title: Grey Blossom Regiment
description: Grey Blossom Regiment The Grey Blossom Regiment was a mercenary company based in Nakamaru in Wa . Description . The company was composed of 500 bushi led by officers who were all no - caste Wanese or natives of Wa .
description_long: Grey Blossom Regiment The Grey Blossom Regiment was a mercenary company based in Nakamaru in Wa . Description . The company was composed of 500 bushi led by officers who were all no - caste Wanese or natives of Wa . History . The Grey Blossom Regiment was formed from troops from Shou Lung who defected to Nakamaru ' s daimyo after the Oni War in 251 . In time , they became mostly independent . In 1357 DR , the Regiment operated independently , and only had a samurai liaison officer appointed by the daimyo . For this reason , inside cities they were always watched by an equal numbers of the daimyo ' s soldiers . Despite this , most clans used Grey Blossom soldiers , including the Funada clan . The Many - Hued Peacock Society and the Royal Vagabonds kept an eye on the Grey Blossom Regiment .

title: Grey Fire
description: Grey Fire The Grey Fire was a group of holy slayer s who operated within Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Grey Fire was a javelin that had a grey shaft and red feathers . Activities .
description_long: Grey Fire The Grey Fire was a group of holy slayer s who operated within Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Grey Fire was a javelin that had a grey shaft and red feathers . Activities . Holy slayers of the Grey Fire worshipped Najm , the Zakharan god of adventure and curiosity . In addition to assassination missions , holy slayers of the Grey Fire were quite proficient in exploration , research , and discovery of all kinds . Through an arrangement with the Everlasting , the Grey Fire ' s territories included Huzuz , the Pearl Cities , and South Zakhara . The Grey Fire was responsible for the assassination of the Sultan of Sikak .

title: Grey Riders
description: Grey Riders The Grey Riders ( also Gray Riders ) were a group of around twenty ranger s on horseback who were protectors of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Their primary purpose as of 1368 DR was to guard against monsters and bandits in the forests and woods of the dale . Activities .
description_long: Grey Riders The Grey Riders ( also Gray Riders ) were a group of around twenty ranger s on horseback who were protectors of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Their primary purpose as of 1368 DR was to guard against monsters and bandits in the forests and woods of the dale . Activities . By 1374 DR , the Council of Seven Burghers had recruited twelve Grey Riders to operate from Velartree . History . In 1368 DR , the Grey Riders had no powers of arrest , and their duty was simply to watch for threats , and , if necessary , seek support from other dales . However , by 1374 DR , the Grey Riders had been granted the power of arrest , to keep prisoners , and to transport them to Harrowdale Town for " Council justice " .

title: Greyanna Dhuurniv
description: Greyanna Dhuurniv Greyanna Dhuurniv was the middle Matron Sister of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Greyanna and her sisters allied with the Zhentarim , the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhentilar and the Shar rans .
description_long: Greyanna Dhuurniv Greyanna Dhuurniv was the middle Matron Sister of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Greyanna and her sisters allied with the Zhentarim , the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhentilar and the Shar rans . Greyanna was always fascinated with the Twisted Tower of Ashaba and wanted to discover all its secrets . She also finally found and awoke the lost marshal , Azmaer Dhuurniv .

title: Greyanna Mizzrym
description: Greyanna Mizzrym Greyanna Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . Description . Greyanna Mizzrym was described as handsome except for a scar on the left side of her face .
description_long: Greyanna Mizzrym Greyanna Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . Description . Greyanna Mizzrym was described as handsome except for a scar on the left side of her face . She wielded a mace . History . Greyanna was the eldest daughter of Matron Mother Miz ' ri Mizzrym but she also had a twin sister , Sabal Mizzrym . Throughout her life , Greyanna was favored by her mother and achieved success and status in House Mizzrym , while her sister Sabal met with failure . Greyanna sabotaged Sabal ' s efforts to impress their matron mother , and eventually Sabal was viewed a fool unfit for the simplest of tasks . It was at that point that Pharaun stepped in and began aiding Sabal , helping her rise through the ranks of the house . This infuriated Greyanna , and she vowed revenge upon Pharaun . After chasing him through the house one night in an attempt to kill him , he escaped to the wizard academy Sorcere at Tier Breche , where he was able to obtain a post as a master . Greyanna waited years to get her revenge .

title: Greycloaks of Evereska
description: Greycloaks of Evereska The Greycloaks of Evereska is an organization of investigators and law enforcers based in the hidden elven settlement of Evereska . Named after the Greycloak hills to the north , they are respected by people all over the Western Heartlands and are one of the main reasons why Evereska has never fallen against an enemy . Recently , in 1372 DR the Greycloaks helped defend Evereska against the onslaught of the phaerimm and their mind slaves , after the sharn wall was broken by the Evereskan elf Galaeron Nihmedu and the human and shade Melengaunt Tanthul , a Prince of Shade Enclave .
description_long: Greycloaks of Evereska The Greycloaks of Evereska is an organization of investigators and law enforcers based in the hidden elven settlement of Evereska . Named after the Greycloak hills to the north , they are respected by people all over the Western Heartlands and are one of the main reasons why Evereska has never fallen against an enemy . Recently , in 1372 DR the Greycloaks helped defend Evereska against the onslaught of the phaerimm and their mind slaves , after the sharn wall was broken by the Evereskan elf Galaeron Nihmedu and the human and shade Melengaunt Tanthul , a Prince of Shade Enclave .

title: Greypeak Mountains
description: Greypeak Mountains The Greypeak Mountains were a mountain range in northwest Faerûn . Geography . The mountains separated the Fallen Lands from the Delimbiyr River .
description_long: Greypeak Mountains The Greypeak Mountains were a mountain range in northwest Faerûn . Geography . The mountains separated the Fallen Lands from the Delimbiyr River . History . The mountains were named after the gray - skinned stone giant s who inhabited them . Inhabitants . Many monsters roamed the range including barghest s , goblin s , young dragon s , and worgs .

title: Greyst Seven Cloud
description: Greyst Seven Cloud Greyst Seven Cloud was the last ruler of Ixtzul . History . Greyst was the ruler of Ixtzul in 562 DR and knew that the vale was dying because there were too many people living in it .
description_long: Greyst Seven Cloud Greyst Seven Cloud was the last ruler of Ixtzul . History . Greyst was the ruler of Ixtzul in 562 DR and knew that the vale was dying because there were too many people living in it . He decided to leave the valley with all his people but , with his assistants , one plumaweaver and one hishnashaper , created the Bacar race in order to guard the Star Worm .

title: Greywolf
description: Greywolf Greywolf was a famous bounty hunter in Baldur ' s Gate . History . Greywolf was a fallen ranger who succumbed to the desire of money and celebrity .
description_long: Greywolf Greywolf was a famous bounty hunter in Baldur ' s Gate . History . Greywolf was a fallen ranger who succumbed to the desire of money and celebrity . He was recruited by the Shadow Thieves as a bounty hunter , usually tracking prey in the Forest of Tethir and spying on the local druid ic circles . Oublek mistook Gorion ' s Ward for Greywolf and gave him Greywolf ' s mission to kill the artist Prism . Gorion ' s Ward could choose to kill Prism or do nothing when the true Greywolf arrived to kill the artist , or choose to defend Prism from the bounty hunter .

title: Grguch
description: Grguch Grguch was the powerful ogrillon chieftain of the much feared Clan Karuck . Equipment . Grguch was highly adept at throwing huge javelin s from an atlatl .
description_long: Grguch Grguch was the powerful ogrillon chieftain of the much feared Clan Karuck . Equipment . Grguch was highly adept at throwing huge javelin s from an atlatl . He also carried a huge greataxe named Rampant that was fashioned in the shape of a dragon . Background . Grguch and the powerful Clan Karuck of mighty orc s and ogre s emerged from a lesser section of the Underdark when prompted by three sly orcs to challenge King Obould . Dnark , the leader of the Wolf Jaw tribe , Toogwik Tuk , shaman of Yellow Fang , and elder shaman Ung - thol all deemed Obould ' s complacency on Mithral Hall ' s doorstep to be unsatisfactory to the word of Gruumsh . Due to his half - orc , half - ogre heritage , Grguch was immensely large and powerful . In fact , the chieftain was one of the few warriors to engage King Obould in battle and seemingly gain the upper hand . After turning his attention from the orc king , Grguch also battled King Bruenor for a short while , until Obould stepped in and slew the fellow orc .

title: Grick
description: Grick An adult grick was about eight - feet long from the tips of its tentacles to the end of its body and weighed some 200 lbs . Its body coloration was uniformly dark , with a pale underbelly . This creature had no legs , so it slithered around .
description_long: Grick An adult grick was about eight - feet long from the tips of its tentacles to the end of its body and weighed some 200 lbs . Its body coloration was uniformly dark , with a pale underbelly . This creature had no legs , so it slithered around . It attacked its prey by wrapping it in its tentacles and pulling it into its pinching teeth .

title: Griffin ' s Claw
description: Griffin ' s Claw The Griffin ' s Claw was a tavern found in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the bard Talamic could be found entertaining here , singing such songs as the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .
description_long: Griffin ' s Claw The Griffin ' s Claw was a tavern found in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the bard Talamic could be found entertaining here , singing such songs as the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .

title: Griffon
description: Griffon A griffon was an intelligent beast with the body of a lion and the wings , forelegs , and head of an eagle . Griffons were majestic magical beasts that combine the features of eagles and lions . These creatures were often used as heraldry symbols and mounts by skilled knights .
description_long: Griffon A griffon was an intelligent beast with the body of a lion and the wings , forelegs , and head of an eagle . Griffons were majestic magical beasts that combine the features of eagles and lions . These creatures were often used as heraldry symbols and mounts by skilled knights . Description . A griffon had the body of a lion with the head and wings of an eagle . The forelimbs of the griffon were often like those of an eagle , ending in sharp talons , but this was not always the case . Just as lions and eagles had varying physical characteristics based on where in the world they are found , so too did griffons . An adult griffon was about 8 feet long , with a wingspan of 25 feet . The average griffon weighed about 500 pounds . Behavior . Griffons were intelligent creatures that made their homes in high places in the mountains . They did this so that their young could be safe from those who would seek to steal them and use them as mounts . Due to the fact that these beasts were intelligent , using a griffon as a mount was seen as a form of slavery in some locations . In the wild , they lived in open caverns set in hills and mountain regions .

title: Griffon ' s Grog
description: Griffon ' s Grog The Griffon ' s Grog was a tavern in Waterdeep . As of 1374 DR , its taproom was smoky , and outside , its sign was moldy , showing a carved griffon volant holding a foaming mug in its claws . The owner in 1374 DR was a fat man with a peg leg and only a thumb and forefinger on his right hand .
description_long: Griffon ' s Grog The Griffon ' s Grog was a tavern in Waterdeep . As of 1374 DR , its taproom was smoky , and outside , its sign was moldy , showing a carved griffon volant holding a foaming mug in its claws . The owner in 1374 DR was a fat man with a peg leg and only a thumb and forefinger on his right hand .

title: Griffon ' s Nest
description: Griffon ' s Nest Griffon ' s Nest is a village in an area of grass - cloaked hills west of the Shining Creek . The village is one of the few permanent Uthgardt settlements . The village itself is made up of about 20 thatched log huts that are sealed with baked earth .
description_long: Griffon ' s Nest Griffon ' s Nest is a village in an area of grass - cloaked hills west of the Shining Creek . The village is one of the few permanent Uthgardt settlements . The village itself is made up of about 20 thatched log huts that are sealed with baked earth . These huts are arranged around a couple warehouses and a longhall . The entire village is encircled by a stout log palisade . There are also about a dozen small farms on the outskirts of this palisade . Outsiders are watched closely by the Uthgardt who live around here , and lookouts can call upon groups of javelin - throwing pony - riders swiftly if trouble makes itself clear . Adventurers of all kinds can be found in Griffon ' s Nest . Some of these individuals may be undercover Harper or Zhentarim agents , the Cult of the Dragon , or even Red Wizards of Thay . History . Griffon ' s Nest was once a bandit hold that was controlled by a man named Azglyn and his band of half - orc s . The Uthgardt barbarians moved in and slaughtered them all , claiming the area as their own . Economy . The Griffons here pan for gold , hunt , and trade crafted items with merchants who stop by from the Long Road . Government .

title: Griffon Knights
description: Griffon Knights The forty Griffon Knights are a group of fighter s who are responsible for the safety and security of the town of Alamontyr in the Border Kingdoms . They serve Alamontyr ' s ruler , Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer . They are known for bearing lances to which they sometimes attach magic wands .
description_long: Griffon Knights The forty Griffon Knights are a group of fighter s who are responsible for the safety and security of the town of Alamontyr in the Border Kingdoms . They serve Alamontyr ' s ruler , Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer . They are known for bearing lances to which they sometimes attach magic wands . Red Knight . The Griffon Knights venerate the Red Knight as their patron after an incident around a dozen years ago that they refuse to discuss with anybody . A mansion in Alamontyr is being converted into a small castle and shrine to Red Knight . Victories . When an agent of Zhentil Keep made an attempt to assassinate the Shield Duke , the Griffon Knights dismembered him and the various body parts were sent in packages to different members of the ruling Council of Zhentil Keep . Badge . The badge of the Griffon Knights is a full - face silver shield held aloft by two white wings on a dun background .

title: Griffon Mountains
description: Griffon Mountains The Griffon Mountains were a small mountain range located in the Durpar . Geography . This mountain range rested between the Scarlet Jungle and the River Hiedar .
description_long: Griffon Mountains The Griffon Mountains were a small mountain range located in the Durpar . Geography . This mountain range rested between the Scarlet Jungle and the River Hiedar . Description . Though the surrounding countryside was extremely rocky , the peaks of the Griffon Mountians were not that high . Inhabitants . Flocks of griffons lived in and around the mountain range . Many native Durparians made a living hunting or capturing the griffons .

title: Griffon Tribe
description: Griffon Tribe The Griffon Tribe was led by the charismatic chief Kralgar Bonesnapper . Under his leadership , the tribe has strived toward many greater accomplishments , making them among the most powerful of the Uthgardt barbarian s . History .
description_long: Griffon Tribe The Griffon Tribe was led by the charismatic chief Kralgar Bonesnapper . Under his leadership , the tribe has strived toward many greater accomplishments , making them among the most powerful of the Uthgardt barbarian s . History . In 1372 DR , the Griffon ancestral mound was the Shining White . Goals . They have declared war on the cities of the North , with their eventual goal being the conquest and acquisition of one of the region ' s cities . Scattered , unallied clans that typically seek benefits from these cities have often rather joined the Griffon tribe , increasing their ranks dramatically . So much so that the Griffon ' s Nest , the tribe ' s main encampment , rivals even some of the smaller cities of the north . Relationships . Despite the fact they are perpetually at war , the tribe welcome outsiders , considering all possible potential allies in their quest . Among these allies are orc s that are hungry for plunder , wizard s who hold personal grudges against particular city - dwellers and agents of distant empires seeking chaos in the region for one reason or another .

title: Griffonheight Keep
description: Griffonheight Keep Griffonheight Keep was a keep and barracks in Velprintalar , Aglarond , situated on a hill . As of 1368 DR , it housed 250 foot soldiers and 50 cavalry , under the command of Sir Tyman . By 1374 DR , the number of foot soldiers had increased to 400 , and the cavalry had been replaced by aerial cavalry .
description_long: Griffonheight Keep Griffonheight Keep was a keep and barracks in Velprintalar , Aglarond , situated on a hill . As of 1368 DR , it housed 250 foot soldiers and 50 cavalry , under the command of Sir Tyman . By 1374 DR , the number of foot soldiers had increased to 400 , and the cavalry had been replaced by aerial cavalry . Although it was believed at the time that a Thay an threat had triggered the buildup of troops , the Simbul had detected a threat between the Society of the Verdant Arrow and the Sons of Hoar and wished to be prepared .

title: Griffonwatch Keep
description: Griffonwatch Keep Built by Angar Hulmaster , Griffonwatch glowers over the town of Hulburg , a mile from the harbor , perched atop a rocky spur of the eastern ridge . It is the home of the ruling Hulmaster family , the training and barracks of the Shieldsworn , and a place of refuge when the town is in danger of attack . While it is not very well situated to guard the city against attacks by sea , it faces north , inland , a defense against the savage orc s , ogre s , and other monsters who dwell in the desolate hills and moorlands of Thar .
description_long: Griffonwatch Keep Built by Angar Hulmaster , Griffonwatch glowers over the town of Hulburg , a mile from the harbor , perched atop a rocky spur of the eastern ridge . It is the home of the ruling Hulmaster family , the training and barracks of the Shieldsworn , and a place of refuge when the town is in danger of attack . While it is not very well situated to guard the city against attacks by sea , it faces north , inland , a defense against the savage orc s , ogre s , and other monsters who dwell in the desolate hills and moorlands of Thar . The keep takes advantage of the geology of Hulburg and uses cliffs on three sides as walls . There is a large curtain wall in front of the keep with a causeway leading to the entrance of the complex . History . In 1479 DR , Sergen Hulmaster - a Hulmaster by adoption , rather than blood - summoned a small army of wight s and similar undead to the castle , hoping to kill his family and blame their deaths on Aesperus , the King in Copper , so that he could become lord of the town .

title: Grig
description: Grig Grigs were sprites who loved mischief and light - hearted pranks . They loved playing tricks on larger creatures . Description .
description_long: Grig Grigs were sprites who loved mischief and light - hearted pranks . They loved playing tricks on larger creatures . Description . A grig appeared to be a tiny sylvan creature with elven features . Their legs were like those of a cricket or grasshopper ; these allowed the grig to leap great distances . Leaping was not often necessary , as a grig also had a small pair of gossamer wings . The skin of a grig was light blue , and they often had bright green hair . The average grig stood about 1 feet tall and weighed about one pound . Locations . Grigs were found in the Border Forest in the Dalelands .

title: Griggen Ekmiran
description: Griggen Ekmiran Griggen Ekmiran was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Griggen managed a shop for carpentry and woodworking .
description_long: Griggen Ekmiran Griggen Ekmiran was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Griggen managed a shop for carpentry and woodworking . Most of his clients were taverns and watering holes , which were always in need of repairs . History . In 1367 DR , some rumors claimed that he paid a gang to demolish his customers ' taverns until one of the rumormongers was found dead and the rumors stopped .

title: Grigor Hulmaster
description: Grigor Hulmaster Grigor Hulmaster was once the Harmach ( lord ) of Hulburg . Grigor was forced into exile in Thentia by the shadowmage Rhovann and the merchant council of Hulburg . He was assassinated by Cyric ists in 1480 DR .
description_long: Grigor Hulmaster Grigor Hulmaster was once the Harmach ( lord ) of Hulburg . Grigor was forced into exile in Thentia by the shadowmage Rhovann and the merchant council of Hulburg . He was assassinated by Cyric ists in 1480 DR . Grigor was Geran Hulmaster ' s uncle .

title: Grim Jaws
description: Grim Jaws The Grim Jaws were a collection of four peaks over a mile high in the western Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . They were the tallest mountains in the Starspires . Geography .
description_long: Grim Jaws The Grim Jaws were a collection of four peaks over a mile high in the western Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . They were the tallest mountains in the Starspires . Geography . Each of the four mountains was over 6 , 000 feet ( 1 , 800 meters ) above sea level . They stood to the east of the Trade Way and north of Zazesspur in County Uluran . The high valley between three of the Jaws was known as Three Peaks Vale . Inhabitants . The lower slopes and upper mountain vales of the Grim Jaws were populated by ogre s and gnoll s . History . " Circa " 1250 DR , a stronghold of cleric s and paladin s of Tyr in Three Peaks Vale was destroyed by a horde of ogres , which slaughtered all of Tyr ' s worshipers .

title: Grim Thornbuck
description: Grim Thornbuck Grim Thornbuck was a member of the Knights of the Black Fist in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . He usually became indebted to the wrong people and did all he had to to repay the debts .
description_long: Grim Thornbuck Grim Thornbuck was a member of the Knights of the Black Fist in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . He usually became indebted to the wrong people and did all he had to to repay the debts . History . In 1489 DR , he was in charge of the Black Fist detachment at Sokol Keep . When the quartermaster , Igan Sokol , announced that he had discovered a treasure thanks to a strange ghost , Grim and his fellows were filled with greed . Thus , when they came to the right room of the dungeon , Grim killed Igan . This however angered both the ghost Harae and the undead guardian of the dungeon . Thus Grim and his fellows were trapped and besieged inside the room . In the end , they may have been rescued by some adventurers hired to solve the mystery of the keep , but Grim and his fellows would very probably still need to face justice .

title: Grima al - Auni
description: Grima al - Auni Grima al - Auni min Kor was an ethoist ( conservative ) priest of Kor and member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Grima had black hair and black eyes but appeared stately even though he was a hill giant .
description_long: Grima al - Auni Grima al - Auni min Kor was an ethoist ( conservative ) priest of Kor and member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Grima had black hair and black eyes but appeared stately even though he was a hill giant . Personality . His calm manner blended well with the Council , often providing reason where others sought direct action . Abilities . Grima possessed the common abilities of a priest , but used his " detect lie " spell often while listening to those petitioning him for sanctuary . Activities . Grima enjoyed working with children who sometimes needed protection while growing up in the violent corsair society . He was able to secure funds from the Council to build a mosque dedicated to Kor in Hawa . History . Grima was trained in Huzuz and was on his way to Liham , when he was captured by Jayani al - Jasir and taken to the Corsair Domains . Since then he has found his true calling among the rough inhabitants of Hawa .

title: Grimblades
description: Grimblades The Grimblades were an adventuring company that operated around the Inner Sea lands in the late 13th century DR . The Grimblades were led by Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin . History .
description_long: Grimblades The Grimblades were an adventuring company that operated around the Inner Sea lands in the late 13th century DR . The Grimblades were led by Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin . History . The Grimblades were thought to have plundered a number of ruins in the lands around the eastern Inner Sea . In the late 13th century DR , their leader Kesten came into the possession of a magical short sword and had the sage Arthylmas of Saerloon identify the blade . It was " Sarghathuld " , a legendary relic of Roldilar and Impiltur , and lost since the Year of the Luminar Procession , 1127 DR , a century and a half before . However , barely three seasons later , the Grimblades were all slain by the green dragon Urnalithorgathla in her lair in the Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . Their bones and " Sarghathuld " laid among her treasure hoard for over ninety years .

title: Grimes
description: Grimes Sergeant - Major Grimes was an officer in the Golden Legion and replaced the captain of the Legion ' s cavalry . He was not too smart but loyal to orders . History .
description_long: Grimes Sergeant - Major Grimes was an officer in the Golden Legion and replaced the captain of the Legion ' s cavalry . He was not too smart but loyal to orders . History . After the death of Alvarro , Cordell promoted Grimes as head of the cavalry . He led his cavaliers in furious fighting with the Viperhands at the start of the Night of Wailing in 1361 DR .

title: Grimgnaw
description: Grimgnaw Grimgnaw was a dwarven monk and member of the Monks of the Long Death , an evil monastic order that worshiped the very essence of death , which was personified as the " Silent Lord , " and sought to bring as many living beings to death as possible . History . He was from Clan Battlehammer but left Mithral Hall to pursue initiation into the Order of the Long Death .
description_long: Grimgnaw Grimgnaw was a dwarven monk and member of the Monks of the Long Death , an evil monastic order that worshiped the very essence of death , which was personified as the " Silent Lord , " and sought to bring as many living beings to death as possible . History . He was from Clan Battlehammer but left Mithral Hall to pursue initiation into the Order of the Long Death . Akin to the cult , Grimgnaw had a deep , morbid fascination with death and dying and detested undead , as he believed undeath to be a means of escaping a natural death . In Neverwinter during the Wailing Death in 1372 DR , Grimgnaw was available for hire as a henchman to the Hero of Neverwinter . Later , Grimgnaw was encountered by Drogan Droganson ' s Pupil in Cania . It was said that after the Hero of Neverwinter defeated Morag , Grimgnaw mysteriously vanished , and due to his presence in Cania , apparently died somehow . Grimgnaw said that as Mephistopheles had abandoned Cania , it was necessary for it to have a new ruler , and proclaimed himself this ruler .

title: Grimham
description: Grimham Grimham was a svirfneblin who was captured by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk and prevented from returning to the Underdark . He was tasked with preparing the Khoroshen ' s food , and took the prisoner Chaver Tegarech to the nearby Baeniff Tor on his raft . Grimham possessed a magically enhanced kukri .
description_long: Grimham Grimham was a svirfneblin who was captured by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk and prevented from returning to the Underdark . He was tasked with preparing the Khoroshen ' s food , and took the prisoner Chaver Tegarech to the nearby Baeniff Tor on his raft . Grimham possessed a magically enhanced kukri .

title: Grimlight
description: Grimlight Grimlight was a behir who lived in a cave near a gorge situated near to the Cold Vale . He was a large , clever and vicious behir , well known for his tastes for dwarf flesh and gold . It was defeated on 6 Tarsakh , 1374 DR by the reformed Company of the White Star when they entered the cave looking for a telkiira .
description_long: Grimlight Grimlight was a behir who lived in a cave near a gorge situated near to the Cold Vale . He was a large , clever and vicious behir , well known for his tastes for dwarf flesh and gold . It was defeated on 6 Tarsakh , 1374 DR by the reformed Company of the White Star when they entered the cave looking for a telkiira .

title: Grimlock
description: Grimlock Grimlocks are a race of monstrous humanoid s that live in the Underdark . Grimlocks are savage humanoids that have dwelt within the depths of the world for thousands of years . As such , they have lost their sight in the lightless depths and have replaced their ability to sense the world around them with an acute sense of smell and echolocation .
description_long: Grimlock Grimlocks are a race of monstrous humanoid s that live in the Underdark . Grimlocks are savage humanoids that have dwelt within the depths of the world for thousands of years . As such , they have lost their sight in the lightless depths and have replaced their ability to sense the world around them with an acute sense of smell and echolocation . The underworld is a savage place , and grimlocks are just as primitive . They make crude clothing from the hide of animals and weapons from stone . Physical description . Millennia of living in darkness have left the entire species blind and vulnerable to light . Grimlocks are humanoid creatures and have slightly scaled , gray skin that is usually scarred from hunts through constricted passageways . Perhaps the most striking feature of a grimlock is the complete absence of eyes or eye sockets . Blank skin stretches across the upper face , giving grimlocks a shadowed , masked visage . The average height for a grimlock , male or female , is five to five and a half feet . The average weight is around 180 pounds . Society .

title: Grimmantle
description: Grimmantle Grimmantle was a kingdom in the eastern Crags in northwest Faerûn . History . The northern kingdom was founded by human s in 272 DR to guard against orc attacks .
description_long: Grimmantle Grimmantle was a kingdom in the eastern Crags in northwest Faerûn . History . The northern kingdom was founded by human s in 272 DR to guard against orc attacks . Around 306 DR , Grimmantle was swept away as by the orcs of the Thousand Fangs tribes on their way down to destroy Neverwinter and Illusk .

title: Grimmbold
description: Grimmbold Grimmbold the Gith was a Zhentarim githzerai agent in Skullport . History . Grimmbold lived in Sigil on Concordant Opposition , but the explosion of a portal sent him to Faerûn , near the Citadel of the Raven .
description_long: Grimmbold Grimmbold the Gith was a Zhentarim githzerai agent in Skullport . History . Grimmbold lived in Sigil on Concordant Opposition , but the explosion of a portal sent him to Faerûn , near the Citadel of the Raven . He asked for help from a local and made a bargain with the Zhentarim : a major mission for them in exchange for a way to return to Sigil . Grimmbold in 1369 DR was tasked with the mission of going to Skullport and leading a Zhent cell and discovering everything about the city , Halaster Blackcloak , and Undermountain , then killing the mad archmage and conquering the place . However , the githzerai and his minions had only vague information and soon most of the other members of the cell were slaughtered , devoured , incinerated , or disappeared without a trace . With only two companions , the half - ogre Jom Bovine and the rock gnome illusionist Esten , Grimmbold decided to abandon the mission . Instead , they formed an assassins ' guild . By 1370 DR , the gith ' s assassins had started to acquire a certain reputation , and were growing in number . He also now owned a tavern Personality . Grimmbold hated Skullport and his inability to return to his home .

title: Grimmerfang
description: Grimmerfang Grimmerfang was a male orc and Orc - King of the orcish kingdom of Vastar in the late 6th and early 7th centuries DR . History . After Vastar suffered eight bloody years of civil war following the death of Ologh the Overking , Grimmerfang won the war when he defeated his last rival for the throne , then ceremonially spitted , cooked and devoured them .
description_long: Grimmerfang Grimmerfang was a male orc and Orc - King of the orcish kingdom of Vastar in the late 6th and early 7th centuries DR . History . After Vastar suffered eight bloody years of civil war following the death of Ologh the Overking , Grimmerfang won the war when he defeated his last rival for the throne , then ceremonially spitted , cooked and devoured them . Becoming Orc - King Grimmerfang in the Year of the Loose Coins , 580 DR , he took Ologh ' s court at the Hollow Mountain for himself , which he renamed " Mount Grimmerfang " . With this , he ended warfare amongst the orcs of Vastar , at least for a short time . However , taking advantage of the orcish strife , dwarves were encroaching from the west , spreading underground and applying increasing pressure on the orcs . Meanwhile , Vastar suffered repeated defeats to the elves . Finally , armed with orcslayer blades , the dwarves surged out of the mountains and slaughtered the orcs . Vastar fell in the Year of the Spellfire , 610 DR , and Grimmerfang was slain in his namesake mountain . The orcish survivors were driven north and south into the mountain peaks as the dwarves founded Roldilar .

title: Grimnoshtadrano
description: Grimnoshtadrano Grimnoshtadrano ( called Grimnosh for short ) was a riddle - loving green dragon dwelling in the High Forest . Description . Grimnosh had golden green eyes and was eighty feet long from snout to tail .
description_long: Grimnoshtadrano Grimnoshtadrano ( called Grimnosh for short ) was a riddle - loving green dragon dwelling in the High Forest . Description . Grimnosh had golden green eyes and was eighty feet long from snout to tail . He could change color at will to blend in better with his surroundings . History . Some time during or prior to 1364 DR , Grimnosh destroyed the village of Taskerleigh near Waterdeep . From Taskerleigh he retrieved the Morninglark harp , which he carried with him to his lair . Soon thereafter , he was approached by Iriador Wintermist ( " Garnet " ) , who made a deal : if she could have the Morninglark , she would use it to issue a widely spread challenge for adventurers and riddlemasters to approach Grimnnosh with their best riddles . Grimnosh agreed and received a scroll from Garnet to give to anyone who succeeded at the challenge . Soon , a group of mercenaries and adventurers led by Danilo Thann and Elaith Craulnober , accompanied by the riddlemaster Vartain , sought out Grimnosh in the High Forest . They failed to answer his riddle correctly , but nonetheless incapacitated him with magic and fled with the scroll .

title: Grimoires
description: Grimoires Grimoires , sometimes called greatbooks , are formal , ordered collections of spell s . Description . Greatbooks tend to be locked , guarded , and hidden , either in a secure cache or in a wizard ' s abode .
description_long: Grimoires Grimoires , sometimes called greatbooks , are formal , ordered collections of spell s . Description . Greatbooks tend to be locked , guarded , and hidden , either in a secure cache or in a wizard ' s abode . Most are composed with gilded ornamentation or inks , and they might even have plates of polished ivory or platinum within them , engraved or stamped with arcane writings . They are usually large and often of unusual proportions ( such as very tall for their width ) , and many have metal - bound corners ( ornate protective caps ) and chased or relief - carved covers .

title: Grimslaak
description: Grimslaak Grimslaak was an ultroloth agent of Yrkhetep in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Grimslaak killed and replaced the innkeeper of the Inn of the Five Crown in Arrabar in order to spy on the meeting of the Sisterhood of the Oaks , the Lightblades , the Sunshafts , and the Windriders , where they organized their battle plans against the troops of one of the Yrkhetep ' s minions .
description_long: Grimslaak Grimslaak was an ultroloth agent of Yrkhetep in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Grimslaak killed and replaced the innkeeper of the Inn of the Five Crown in Arrabar in order to spy on the meeting of the Sisterhood of the Oaks , the Lightblades , the Sunshafts , and the Windriders , where they organized their battle plans against the troops of one of the Yrkhetep ' s minions . Eventually he sent three yagnoloth s to kill possible disturbers .

title: Grimwald ' s greymantle
description: Grimwald ' s greymantle Grimwald ' s greymantle was an arcane necromancy spell that prevented healing or regeneration effects from working on a single creature for a short time . Description . The caster imbued the material component of this spell ( a bone , small skull , or small animal skeleton ) with a silver - gray glow which immediately had to come in contact with the target .
description_long: Grimwald ' s greymantle Grimwald ' s greymantle was an arcane necromancy spell that prevented healing or regeneration effects from working on a single creature for a short time . Description . The caster imbued the material component of this spell ( a bone , small skull , or small animal skeleton ) with a silver - gray glow which immediately had to come in contact with the target . If successful , the radiance was transferred to the target and enveloped it like a mantle . While surrounded by this aura , the target could not repair damage or regain health by any means , including healing spells such as " cure light wounds " and " heal " ; a " potion of healing " ; a " staff of curing " ; or regeneration effects such as a " regeneration " spell , a " ring of regeneration " , or a natural ability such as that possessed by troll s . " Grimwald ' s graymantle " lasted for a short time corresponding to the level of the caster . If it expired or was dispelled , any healing or regenerative effect still in place on the target creature began working again . The target got one chance to resist the spell , in which case it faded harmlessly away .

title: Grin Ousstyl
description: Grin Ousstyl Grin Ousstyl was a drow wizard and apprentice of archmage Vizeran DeVir during the Rage of Demons . History . Grin hailed from House Ousstyl of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Grin Ousstyl Grin Ousstyl was a drow wizard and apprentice of archmage Vizeran DeVir during the Rage of Demons . History . Grin hailed from House Ousstyl of Menzoberranzan . He tried to advance his position by joining the Council of Spiders . However he was careless and was nearly executed for his ambition . Exiled from Menzoberranzan , he was taken in by Vizeran , who played the role of the shadowy patron of the council . During the Rage of Demons , Grin supported his master ' s plots , hoping to find a way to reclaim his city from the matron mother s ' tyranny . during the execution of the plan to send back the demon lords Grin reveled to known that his master want to destroy Menzoberranzan in the process and tried to change the location of the desummon place . Personality . Grin was loyal to his master but disliked such a solitary existence . For a long time , he had waited for a chance to return to his city , supporting the idea of a male uprising . Grin would not agree with his master if he found Menzoberranzan was to become a battleground for demon lord s .

title: Grinding Gulf
description: Grinding Gulf The Grinding Gulf was a large cavern underneath Fox Ridge in Shadowdale . The Grinding Gulf was a great chasm where flying boulders cascaded in a magical vertical dance . Elminster and Florin Falconhand once investigated the Grinding Gulf , but decided that it did not present an immediate threat .
description_long: Grinding Gulf The Grinding Gulf was a large cavern underneath Fox Ridge in Shadowdale . The Grinding Gulf was a great chasm where flying boulders cascaded in a magical vertical dance . Elminster and Florin Falconhand once investigated the Grinding Gulf , but decided that it did not present an immediate threat . The Grinding Gulf was an emanation of old , powerful earth magic . It was considered a Class - 3 earth node and bore a strong aura of earth transmutation magic .

title: Grinna Brightbell
description: Grinna Brightbell Grinna Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper and cook in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Grinna was spunky , opinionated , and spoke her mind .
description_long: Grinna Brightbell Grinna Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper and cook in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Grinna was spunky , opinionated , and spoke her mind . She complemented what Hupe lacked . She was very popular in the community and anyone that liked her cooking could have a place in her heart . Activities . Grinna ran the Leaky Bucket inn with her husband Hupe Brightbell in the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community in Quivering Forest just near Phlan . She was an amazing cook .

title: Grinning Lion
description: Grinning Lion The Grinning Lion was a tavern in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Structure . It was a noisy raucous tavern with tattered shield s on its walls and a variety of other weapons and armor on display .
description_long: Grinning Lion The Grinning Lion was a tavern in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Structure . It was a noisy raucous tavern with tattered shield s on its walls and a variety of other weapons and armor on display . Services . The tavern served fried onions , eel s , pitchers of wine , and zzar . Inhabitants . The proprietor of the Lion was Unger Farshal . Dancers of both genders performed to the music in mock armor . Most patrons were nobles accompanied by their personal bodyguards .

title: Grinning Ponies
description: Grinning Ponies The Grinning Ponies was a band of halfling adventurers who traveled along the Trade Way and beyond . Activities . The Grinning Ponies was a halfling band that traveled along the Trade Way from Memnon to Waterdeep and east and back the length of Elturgard .
description_long: Grinning Ponies The Grinning Ponies was a band of halfling adventurers who traveled along the Trade Way and beyond . Activities . The Grinning Ponies was a halfling band that traveled along the Trade Way from Memnon to Waterdeep and east and back the length of Elturgard . History . The name of the band came from the halflings ' mounts ( ponies ) and the name of the year 1481 DR , the Year of the Grinning Halfling . In 1481 DR , Spider Topolino ( the reborn Regis ) joined the Grinning Ponies while they were stationed at Boareskyr Bridge . He rode with them until Eleasis of 1483 DR . Members . In 1481 DR , the band had twelve members , including Doregardo ( the leader ) , Showithal Terdidy , and Spider Topolino ( Regis ) .

title: Grinning Skull
description: Grinning Skull The Grinning Skull was one of two oases found in the Plains of Purple Dust . This oasis was so named because it was shielded from the harsh wind by the skull of a long - dead great dragon . Inhabitants .
description_long: Grinning Skull The Grinning Skull was one of two oases found in the Plains of Purple Dust . This oasis was so named because it was shielded from the harsh wind by the skull of a long - dead great dragon . Inhabitants . In the mid 1300 ' s DR , the Grinning Skull oasis served as the base for a group of bandits called the Desert Wind . They were led by Sheik Ar - Rabi . The bandits forced prisoners to drink water taken from the pools in order to determine if the water was safe . Desert lizards were used if there were no prisoners on hand . History . This well was established during the twilight years of the great Imaskari Empire . The Imaskari decided to turn the only well located in the region into a dangerous trap . The pure water from the well was changed into a poison that was deadly to animal life but harmless to plants . The water from the well was diverted into six separate pools . Five of the pools carried the poisoned water and one remained clean . The water from all of the pools looked and appeared identical to the others . True to their cruelty , the Imaskari cast an enchantment upon the pools so that the safe pool would randomly shift with each sunrise .

title: Grintalalch
description: Grintalalch Grintalalch the Red was an inscrutable spriggan merchant in Deepearth in 1479 DR . Activities . Gintalalch managed a merchant company in Deepearth .
description_long: Grintalalch Grintalalch the Red was an inscrutable spriggan merchant in Deepearth in 1479 DR . Activities . Gintalalch managed a merchant company in Deepearth . Often , however , he did business in the Fugue Plane city in Vaasa . Some said he had a link to the Assassins Guild of the Galenas .

title: Grintharke
description: Grintharke Grintharke was a balor who ruled over Hellgate Keep . History . He and his followers were exiles from the Abyss .
description_long: Grintharke Grintharke was a balor who ruled over Hellgate Keep . History . He and his followers were exiles from the Abyss . If destroyed in the Prime Material Plane , they would slowly reform , only to be exiled once again . Due to this , they were unable to " gate " in demons more powerful than mane s ( which transformed into shadow s and ghast s ) , and because of this , the forces of Hellgate Keep had few actual demons included in their forces . Grintharke constantly sought to appease his masters in one form or another with the hopes of regaining a standing in the Abyss . Grintharke was once a ruler of a city at the base of a volcano on another world , and had brought a number of magically altered pteranodon s with him .

title: Grisella
description: Grisella Grisella was the owner of the Winter ' s Cradle Tavern in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The bartender was a large woman who wore dull gray outfits .
description_long: Grisella Grisella was the owner of the Winter ' s Cradle Tavern in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The bartender was a large woman who wore dull gray outfits . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Grisella had an infestation of beetle s in the cellar of her tavern .

title: Grisha
description: Grisha Grisha was a cultist of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Grisha believed himself to be correct in sensing the power of Yeenoghu in all things — and particularly in the way in which cultists had begun to rise as undead ghoul s after death .
description_long: Grisha Grisha was a cultist of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Grisha believed himself to be correct in sensing the power of Yeenoghu in all things — and particularly in the way in which cultists had begun to rise as undead ghoul s after death . He ruled with an iron fist . History . Grisha was a slave of the drow until he escaped and made his way to the very small village of Filthriddens inside the Labyrinth . There , he lived under constant fear of minotaur raiders . During the Rage of Demons , Grisha saw a minotaur horde march against the village when it was destroyed by the demon lord Yeenoghu . So Grisha devoted himself to the gnoll god and soon the cult of Yeenoghu gained control of Filthriddens with Grisha as leader .

title: Grissen
description: Grissen Grissen was a halfling member of the Emerald Enclave in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Grissen was possibly involved in the case of the disappearance of Halvin Graingle and six other villagers of the Kabel ' s Hill community inside the forest .
description_long: Grissen Grissen was a halfling member of the Emerald Enclave in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Grissen was possibly involved in the case of the disappearance of Halvin Graingle and six other villagers of the Kabel ' s Hill community inside the forest . He advised the adventuring party hired to find the missing people to not disturb the elves , who were on good terms with the Enclave .

title: Gristle Pete
description: Gristle Pete Gristle Pete was a cook working in the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North just before the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Around 1489 DR , Pete worked as a cook for Bog Luck , an agent of the Cult of the Dragon , but did not know his real allegiance .
description_long: Gristle Pete Gristle Pete was a cook working in the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North just before the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Around 1489 DR , Pete worked as a cook for Bog Luck , an agent of the Cult of the Dragon , but did not know his real allegiance .

title: Gritchet
description: Gritchet Gritchet was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Gritchet went to Waterdeep from Amn in search of a job .
description_long: Gritchet Gritchet was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Gritchet went to Waterdeep from Amn in search of a job . Gritchet found no job but Enda Yate offered to let him join in her treasure ' s hunt into Undermountain and he accepted like many others . When they ventured into Undermountain , Gritchet was chosen along with the human lowlife knee - breakers Cobb and Draskar and the half - elf market grifter Tindel to remain to watch their base while all the others led by Enda went deeper . He was shocked when his companions exploring the surrounding area slaughtered some nearby Downshadow folks . Personality . Gritchet was squeamish about killing and always tried to avoid death even among enemies .

title: Grobnar ' s camp
description: Grobnar ' s camp Grobnar ' s camp was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Neverwinter Wood .
description_long: Grobnar ' s camp Grobnar ' s camp was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Neverwinter Wood . Structure . The camp was composed of a campfire and a bedroll . History . When the Kalach - Cha and the companions traveled to Old Owl Well , Grobnar Gnomehands would encounter them and tell his stories . Once the Kalach - Cha and the companions wakes up , Grobnar apologizes for a long story , then joins them .

title: Grobnar Gnomehands
description: Grobnar Gnomehands Grobnar Gnomehands was a gnomish bard of the Sword Coast North best known for his travels with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . A fun - loving and inquistive soul , he was also known for getting into trouble . Description .
description_long: Grobnar Gnomehands Grobnar Gnomehands was a gnomish bard of the Sword Coast North best known for his travels with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . A fun - loving and inquistive soul , he was also known for getting into trouble . Description . Grobnar ' s appearance could probably have been best described as unkempt , though no more so than is typical of gnomes . With wild hair exploding in every direction from his head and a hyperactive mouth , Grobnar exhibited many of the common qualities of gnomes . But while Grobnar often seemed child - like in manner , his physical appearance suggested otherwise . With wrinkles evident along his face , it was clear to observers that Grobnar was far from youthful , in spite of his energy , being well into his middle ages . Grobnar preferred to dress in leather armor or simple clothes , carrying with him often at times a lute or other magic al instrument for use as an implement . He also claimed to have a codpiece with a spring - mounted shield , amongst other oddball devices . Personality .

title: Grodd
description: Grodd Grodd was a demiplane located in close proximity to the Plane of Shadow . The Grodd goblin s who inhabited this plane believed that the entire plane was underground and consisted of subterranean tunnels and caverns . The Hoard and Grodd demiplanes were linked via a " gate " .
description_long: Grodd Grodd was a demiplane located in close proximity to the Plane of Shadow . The Grodd goblin s who inhabited this plane believed that the entire plane was underground and consisted of subterranean tunnels and caverns . The Hoard and Grodd demiplanes were linked via a " gate " .

title: Grodd goblin
description: Grodd goblin Grodd goblin s are a sub - race of goblin s that were trapped in the Grodd demiplane with Nalavarauthatoryl . Due to the demiplane s close proximity to the Plane of Shadow , the Grodd goblin s developed abilities that allowed them to not be harmed by the touch of shadow s . Grodd goblins speak a corrupt form of " Ancient Elven " .
description_long: Grodd goblin Grodd goblin s are a sub - race of goblin s that were trapped in the Grodd demiplane with Nalavarauthatoryl . Due to the demiplane s close proximity to the Plane of Shadow , the Grodd goblin s developed abilities that allowed them to not be harmed by the touch of shadow s . Grodd goblins speak a corrupt form of " Ancient Elven " .

title: Grolantor
description: Grolantor Grolantor is a giant deity , and patron of Hill giant s and ettin s as well as some Frost giant s and ogre s . Grolantor looks like a 25 - foot tall hill giant , wearing several belts of woven dwarf beards . He wields an oversized club named Dwarfcrusher .
description_long: Grolantor Grolantor is a giant deity , and patron of Hill giant s and ettin s as well as some Frost giant s and ogre s . Grolantor looks like a 25 - foot tall hill giant , wearing several belts of woven dwarf beards . He wields an oversized club named Dwarfcrusher . Relationships . Grolantor is one of the third generation of giant gods , disdainfully called the " runts " by their elders - the other is Karontor . His mother is an unnamed sky goddess . He was banished to Fury ' s Heart by his father Annam All - Father for allying himself with treacherous Memnor , but now that Annam has retreated from the rest of the multiverse , the ban no longer applies . He now splits his time between Fury ' s Heart and the Abyss . Grolantor is evil second and stupid first , disowned by his brothers for his foolishness and relative weakness . Some say he created the race of hill giants by collecting and interbreeding the runts of earlier giant broods , then further polluted this stock by mating with various serpents , medusa - like hags , and the goddess Cegilune . The god has had to flee the wrath of his sister Hiatea on many occasions .

title: Gromnir Il - Khan
description: Gromnir Il - Khan Gromnir Il - Khan was a half - orc Bhaalspawn who briefly ruled Saradush while the city was under siege by Yaga - Shura . He and his garrison of soldiers had been brought into the city by Melissan along with other Bhaalspawn , ostensibly to keep them safe . When Yaga - Shura besieged the city in an effort to destroy all the Bhaalspawn within , Gromnir locked himself up in the palace with his closest followers , and while the local militia fought against the invaders , his men were content to bully and exploit the town ' s populace .
description_long: Gromnir Il - Khan Gromnir Il - Khan was a half - orc Bhaalspawn who briefly ruled Saradush while the city was under siege by Yaga - Shura . He and his garrison of soldiers had been brought into the city by Melissan along with other Bhaalspawn , ostensibly to keep them safe . When Yaga - Shura besieged the city in an effort to destroy all the Bhaalspawn within , Gromnir locked himself up in the palace with his closest followers , and while the local militia fought against the invaders , his men were content to bully and exploit the town ' s populace . Gromnir himself was seemingly paranoid about Melissan , thinking she wanted to " turn Bhaalspawn against Bhaalspawn until all are dead . " He turned out to be right , though few others would have suspected it . Ultimately , he was killed by Gorion ' s Ward at her bidding . Gromnir wielded two enchanted morning star s in combat , one of which was the " Ice Star " .

title: Gromph Baenre
description: Gromph Baenre Gromph Baenre was a drow and the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , as well as a very capable diviner . He was also the Master of Sorcere , the arcane school , and the eldest son of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre , which made him the most powerful male in the city . Description .
description_long: Gromph Baenre Gromph Baenre was a drow and the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , as well as a very capable diviner . He was also the Master of Sorcere , the arcane school , and the eldest son of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre , which made him the most powerful male in the city . Description . Gromph was austere yet handsome . He had amber eyes , like his daughter Liriel . Despite his old age ( he was old even by elven standards ) , Gromph appeared eternally youthful due to the effects of a magical amulet in his possession , that contained a piece of a unicorn ' s horn . As a powerful spellcaster and the archmage of the city , Gromph almost always wore the Robe of the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , a ceremonial garment that was heavily enchanted . He also displayed the badge of House Baenre at all times . Interestingly , by 1361 DR , Gromph had not been able to enter elven Reverie for many decades , nor sleep ; presumably , only the power of his brooch of perpetual youth kept him alive . Personality . Gromph was arrogant , surly , and temperamental , with the occasional tendency to focus on petty disputes .

title: Grond Peaksmasher
description: Grond Peaksmasher Grond Peaksmasher was a little - known son of Hiatea and a true demigod - unlike the rest of the giant - kin progenitors - who was worshiped by the firbolg s of the Moonshae Isles . The Moonshae firbolgs believe that Grond carved the Moonshae Isles out of a single piece of rock and that the leftovers became the firbolg , while the rubble became the dwarves . They claim that the dwarves slipped him up and he fell into a crevasse that he ' d cut with his axe and then a sheared - off mountaintop fell on him , trapping him there .
description_long: Grond Peaksmasher Grond Peaksmasher was a little - known son of Hiatea and a true demigod - unlike the rest of the giant - kin progenitors - who was worshiped by the firbolg s of the Moonshae Isles . The Moonshae firbolgs believe that Grond carved the Moonshae Isles out of a single piece of rock and that the leftovers became the firbolg , while the rubble became the dwarves . They claim that the dwarves slipped him up and he fell into a crevasse that he ' d cut with his axe and then a sheared - off mountaintop fell on him , trapping him there . A less apocryphal theory is that his mother Hiatea granted him dominion over the Moonshae firbolgs to teach him responsibility while she concentrated on other matters . It is unknown how he came to be trapped under a glacier on Oman ' s Isle but being incarcerated so left him to drift into a deep slumber . His supplicants devolved into a barbaric race , used as pawns by the powers who attempted to wrest control of the islands away from the Earthmother .

title: Groshin Lor
description: Groshin Lor Groshin Lor was the leader of the Hawks secret police in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Groshin was tortured by Thayan s as a young man .
description_long: Groshin Lor Groshin Lor was the leader of the Hawks secret police in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Groshin was tortured by Thayan s as a young man . In time , he became the leader of the Hawks in Mulmaster , one of the most trusted servants of High Blade Jaseen Drakehorn . He also had dealings with the Lords ' Alliance . In 1491 DR , he hired an adventuring party to discover what had happened to a nearby iron mine , after a previous expedition of soldiers had disappeared .

title: Grounding
description: Grounding Grounding was an abjuration spell that prevented damage from normal electrical discharges and helped insulate against magical electrical attacks , within the area of effect . Effects . This spell operated similarly to " fire purge " but did not prevent electrical discharges as " fire purge " prevented ignition of fires ; instead the electricity was prevented from damaging anything in the protected area .
description_long: Grounding Grounding was an abjuration spell that prevented damage from normal electrical discharges and helped insulate against magical electrical attacks , within the area of effect . Effects . This spell operated similarly to " fire purge " but did not prevent electrical discharges as " fire purge " prevented ignition of fires ; instead the electricity was prevented from damaging anything in the protected area . Magical bolts could still penetrate the barrier or be generated inside the barrier , but their intensity was cut in half and creatures and objects had a better chance of avoiding or resisting their effects . The area of effect was the same as for " fire purge " ( 10 yd / 9 . 1 m square ) which increased exponentially if this spell was cast cooperatively by multiple priests . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the priest ' s holy symbol and a small coil of silver wire .

title: Grove of Corellon
description: Grove of Corellon The Grove of Corellon ( also Corellon ' s Grove ) was a place containing the greatest of Evermeet ' s temples to the deity Corellon Larethian , as well as shrines to many of the other Seldarine . Geography . The grove was located south of the village of Elion , in the middle northern part of the island .
description_long: Grove of Corellon The Grove of Corellon ( also Corellon ' s Grove ) was a place containing the greatest of Evermeet ' s temples to the deity Corellon Larethian , as well as shrines to many of the other Seldarine . Geography . The grove was located south of the village of Elion , in the middle northern part of the island .

title: Growing Mountains
description: Growing Mountains The Growing Mountains were a small isolated mountain range found in the northern regions of the Katakoro Plateau in the Hordelands . Geography . The mountains sat between Nor Tso to the south and the peak of Shan Pi and the eastern arm of Katakoro Shan to the north .
description_long: Growing Mountains The Growing Mountains were a small isolated mountain range found in the northern regions of the Katakoro Plateau in the Hordelands . Geography . The mountains sat between Nor Tso to the south and the peak of Shan Pi and the eastern arm of Katakoro Shan to the north . The Old Caravan Road passed underneath the northern shadow of the Growing Mountains . Description . The presence of sheer rock walls made the Growing Mountains an ideal place for the fortress monastery of Punakha Dzong .

title: Growling Falls
description: Growling Falls Growling Falls is a 200 - foot ( 61 - meter ) waterfall in the Pasocada Basin . Its noise is said to be the roar of an evil bear who could not be defeated because it was sired by a god in animal form . It was eventually defeated by a hero that the Azuposi call Hinchapa but the Dog People call Incholcpa .
description_long: Growling Falls Growling Falls is a 200 - foot ( 61 - meter ) waterfall in the Pasocada Basin . Its noise is said to be the roar of an evil bear who could not be defeated because it was sired by a god in animal form . It was eventually defeated by a hero that the Azuposi call Hinchapa but the Dog People call Incholcpa .

title: Grrothgrrowl
