description: Grrothgrrowl Grrothgrrowl was the most powerful wemic king of the Shining Plains . Activities . Grrothgrrowl ruled the Tenpaw tribe , which comprised more than 12 , 000 members .
description_long: Grrothgrrowl Grrothgrrowl was the most powerful wemic king of the Shining Plains . Activities . Grrothgrrowl ruled the Tenpaw tribe , which comprised more than 12 , 000 members . He managed to command this many thanks to eight chieftains as assistants and an Emerald Enclave advisor , who provided intelligence information . Personality . Grrothgrrowl cared very little for human s , and if they lived outside his territory he was uninterested . Grrothgrrowl required caravans from east and west to pay tribute . He considered the Emerald Enclave a powerful ally but he did not care for the Enclave ' s ideas .

title: Grubkern
description: Grubkern Grubkern was a criminal and grave - robber in the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the months after Rathgar the Raider and his invaders seized control of Doegan , Grubkern was arrested and imprisoned in the castle in the Doegan Capital . He whispered of a gathering army of undead coming to rid Doegan of the invaders .
description_long: Grubkern Grubkern was a criminal and grave - robber in the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the months after Rathgar the Raider and his invaders seized control of Doegan , Grubkern was arrested and imprisoned in the castle in the Doegan Capital . He whispered of a gathering army of undead coming to rid Doegan of the invaders . As fear spread in the capital , Rathgar determined to investigate , threatening to kill Grubkern if he ' d spoken falsely . He did so just in time , finding an undead horde almost at his doorstep . The Howl of Vengeance conflict broke out . If Rathgar ' s forces repelled the invaders , then Rathgar would pardon Grubkern . Grubkern revealed the name of the leader of the undead : Aelric the Avenger , who rallied in the Serpent Valley .

title: Gruen Bleth
description: Gruen Bleth Lord Gruen Bleth was a human man and a member of the Bleth noble family of Cormyr in the 14th century DR . History . Around 1367 DR , Gruen was the leading member of the Bleth family and he controlled the Seven Suns Trading Coster in Cormyr .
description_long: Gruen Bleth Lord Gruen Bleth was a human man and a member of the Bleth noble family of Cormyr in the 14th century DR . History . Around 1367 DR , Gruen was the leading member of the Bleth family and he controlled the Seven Suns Trading Coster in Cormyr . Although he lived at the Bleth Estate in Suzail , he spent much of his time at the Seven Suns yard in the city managing the business . In the late 1360s , Gruen Bleth and Lady Amarsa Bleth were guests of Lord Partic Thistle at his manor , Thistleflame , on the occasion of King Azoun IV ' s birthday . Personality . Gruen Bleth was apparently a gentle person .

title: Grumbar
description: Grumbar Grumbar ( pronounced " GRUM - bar " ) , or the Earthlord , was the elemental embodiment of earth . He was one of the four elemental deities worshiped in Faerûn . Grumbar , like the other elemental deities ( except Kossuth ) had a minimum of followers in Faerûn , and he cared little indeed for most of those worshipers , as his power came from the many elemental devotees in both the Underdark and the Elemental Plane of Earth .
description_long: Grumbar Grumbar ( pronounced " GRUM - bar " ) , or the Earthlord , was the elemental embodiment of earth . He was one of the four elemental deities worshiped in Faerûn . Grumbar , like the other elemental deities ( except Kossuth ) had a minimum of followers in Faerûn , and he cared little indeed for most of those worshipers , as his power came from the many elemental devotees in both the Underdark and the Elemental Plane of Earth . It was recently uncovered in the wake of the Spellplague that Grumbar was not a proper deity at all , but rather a primordial . Nonetheless , he retained worshipers and had power equivalent to that of a god . Worshipers . The church of Grumbar was organized into small sects known as Holds , each comprising seven clerics , seven monks , and seven rangers and as many laity as could be supported . Those who followed the Earthlord could often be found in public preaching against evils of boarding ships and setting sail to uncharted lands , preferring exploration on the continent of Faerûn . Worship in Zakhara . On the continent of Zakhara , Grumbar was called one of the cold gods of the elements .

title: Grumble
description: Grumble Grumble was a quaggoth thonot in Maerimydra . Activities . Grumble was a slave overseer in Maerimydra .
description_long: Grumble Grumble was a quaggoth thonot in Maerimydra . Activities . Grumble was a slave overseer in Maerimydra . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after the initial allied attack on Maerimydra , Grumble was among the minions gathered by the shadow demon Verix for the counterattack .

title: Grumink
description: Grumink Grumink the Renegade was a dwarf at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grumink was a bloodthirsty and callous individual .
description_long: Grumink Grumink the Renegade was a dwarf at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grumink was a bloodthirsty and callous individual . He stopped at nothing to get what he wanted . Grumink delighted in building a reputation of cold - blooded killer , and went out of his way to slay people when doing so might add to his notoriety or attract the attention of the law . He might claim that it wasn ' t personal , but it was . He also did not care about desecrating a Morndinsamman shrine . History . In 1491 DR , Grumink and his mercenary band were hired by the oni Obratu in order to seize control of the Shrine of the Tender Oath , which the oni believed to be an entrance to King Torhild Flametongue ' s tomb . At last , some adventurers went to investigate the shrine and defeated Grumink and Obratu .

title: Grund
description: Grund Grund was simpleton in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grund was a happy dim - witted sort .
description_long: Grund Grund was simpleton in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grund was a happy dim - witted sort . He had a special relationship with the members of the Believers . Activities . Grund always wandered the village ' s market . History . In 1491 DR , the Believers used Grund as an enforcer to keep their secret . When some adventurers began an investigation of secret passages under the village , a secret kept by the Believers , they sent Grund to take care of the adventurers . He fought the adventurers ; however , they defeated him .

title: Grung
description: Grung Grungs were poisonous frog - like amphibious humanoid s that lived in trees . Their society was organized in castes determined by each grung ' s color . Description .
description_long: Grung Grungs were poisonous frog - like amphibious humanoid s that lived in trees . Their society was organized in castes determined by each grung ' s color . Description . Grungs preferred to live in shady areas , and needed to remain in constant proximity to water . Their tadpoles developed in ground pools , already separated by caste . All grungs continuously secreted a poisonous substance that was harmless to them . Combat . In addition to their naturally poisonous nature , grungs also poisoned their weapons . Each color of grung poison caused a different ailment in their victims . Society . Grung society was a rigid caste system , and each grung ' s place was determined by its color : Some mobility was possible between the castes , in cases of valuable contributions and great deeds , by the use of ritual magic and herbal compounds . Grung tribes also made extensive use of slavery , and were always looking for new creatures to enslave . They kept their slaves at bay by poisoning their food in order to inflict lethargy on them . Over extended periods of time , the effects of such poisoning could only be removed by magic .

title: Grunnarch
description: Grunnarch Grunnarch was a northmen king of Norland in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Grunnarch was a fierce and proud man .
description_long: Grunnarch Grunnarch was a northmen king of Norland in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Grunnarch was a fierce and proud man . History . In 1345 DR , Grunnarch the Red brought his host of longship s to Thelgaar Ironhand ' s Iron Keep on Oman ' s Isle to prepare for raiding and pillaging the cities of Caer Corwell and Caer Callidyrr and the Ffolk lands in the Moonshae Isles . . He was in charge of attacking Gwynneth from the Western shores .

title: Grunwald
description: Grunwald Grunwald was a tiny village in the North . It was the headquarters of the Thunderbeast tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . Geography .
description_long: Grunwald Grunwald was a tiny village in the North . It was the headquarters of the Thunderbeast tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . Geography . Grunwald was located in the Lurkwood of northwest Faerûn . Locations . A druid grove and a shrine to Tyr were located near the king ' s lodge . Government . As of the Year of the Staff , 1366 DR , the king of the Thunderbeast tribe was Gundar Brontoskin . Trade . The primary product of Grunwald was timber from the Lurkwood , which was primarily traded with Mirabar and Longsaddle . Dark shanut wood was also a valuable commodity that was in demand in Waterdeep and Sundabar . History . This tiny village was built upon the ruins of a dwarfhold . Most homes were built of stone rubble and timber from the forest . The tunnels beneath the city were known , but considered taboo — off - limits to villagers and foreigners alike .

title: Grushakk
description: Grushakk Grushakk was a powerful glabrezu under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth in 1374 DR . History . During the Battle of the Cwm , Grushakk was the leader of the demon s allied with the fey ' ri .
description_long: Grushakk Grushakk was a powerful glabrezu under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth in 1374 DR . History . During the Battle of the Cwm , Grushakk was the leader of the demon s allied with the fey ' ri . Sarya ordered to him to kill the enemy commanders . Grushakk engaged with Araevin Teshurr , Ilsevele Miritar , Grayth Holmfast , and Maresa Rost , but was quickly brought down and defeated .

title: Gruumsh
description: Gruumsh Gruumsh ( pronounced " " groomsh " " ) was an orc god and a greater deity . He was envisioned with one eye by all who named him a god and was a deity mainly worshipped by orcs and orogs . Worshipers .
description_long: Gruumsh Gruumsh ( pronounced " " groomsh " " ) was an orc god and a greater deity . He was envisioned with one eye by all who named him a god and was a deity mainly worshipped by orcs and orogs . Worshipers . Orc war priests wore a patch over one eye to symbolize their worship of the orc deity . They also dressed in dark red vestments , armored with war helms and black plate mail . Gruumsh ' s sacred animal was the giant rat , his holy day was the new moon , and he was worshiped in orcish lairs where blood was sacrificed to him monthly . Gruumsh was the unblinking god of destruction who unleashed the savage multitudes against outposts of civilization . He was worshiped by orcs and half - orcs and came to dominate some of the other savage humanoids as well . Gruumsh was a brutal god who loathed Corellon Larethian but denied that he lost an eye to the First of the Seldarine . Gruumsh told his worshipers to do the following : Faithful of Gruumsh were called Gruumans . Though Gruumans maintained that their god was born with one eye , the eladrin asserted that he lost an eye in combat with Corellon .

title: Guallidurth
description: Guallidurth Guallidurth was one of the oldest drow city in the southern Underdark . It was situated beneath the Calim Desert in the Middledark of Old Shanatar . Government .
description_long: Guallidurth Guallidurth was one of the oldest drow city in the southern Underdark . It was situated beneath the Calim Desert in the Middledark of Old Shanatar . Government . In the late 14th century DR , it had twenty - one ruling houses . These made up the Ruling Council , but more than 200 Houses vied for power . After the Spellplague , Mistress Mother Fizzri Khaven - Ghell systematically destroyed most of the houses until only twenty four remained . Area of Influence . The city claimed the area south from Wealdath and west of the Alimir Mountains , though their governance wasn ’ t very strict . They also considered Sloopdilmonpolop to be theirs . They were considered at least potential enemies of Iltkazar , Oaxaptupa , Oryndoll and the beholders below the Lake of Steam . Religion . During the 14th century DR , drow of Guallidurth worshiped Lolth , but each House did so in a different way , so many different sects existed throughout the city . Since building a temple to the Spider Queen was seen as the most devotional worship one could do , the city was riddled with different temples and shrines . This gave the city its nickname as the Temple City of Lolth .

title: Guard ( Tantras )
description: Guard ( Tantras ) The Guard was the police and defense force of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base of operations . The Guard were based in the Sea Tower in the city of Tantras , standing on the coast at the southern side of the bay opening .
description_long: Guard ( Tantras ) The Guard was the police and defense force of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base of operations . The Guard were based in the Sea Tower in the city of Tantras , standing on the coast at the southern side of the bay opening . The Sea Tower was the city ' s main fortress , and held armories and training areas for soldiers . The Guard also maintained ballista batteries on the coast and on either side of the entrance of the harbor mouth , together with a chain - boom barrier strung across it , and catapult s mounted on coast towers . The Guard also manned the gates and towers encircling the city . When preparing for war , the Guard would commandeer inns and privately owned buildings around the city for use as army barracks and recruiting posts . Organization . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Guard was commanded by Lassalar Ormitar , who was also head of the Ormitar noble house and a member of the High Council that governed Tantras . Although the Guard was directly responsible to the Council , its loyalties lay with Lassalar , who was more serious about restricting merchant freedoms in favor of law and order .

title: Guardgoyle
description: Guardgoyle Guardgoyles were construct s created by Zhentarim wizard s to protect their treasures . They resembled baby gargoyle s , hence their moniker , and their small stature ( 2 feet tall / long ) allowed them to hide in the wizard ' s posessions , ready to fly out and strike if they sensed a presence in the room it was guarding that wasn ' t it ' s creator or one of the 5 people it could be programmed to not attack . If not destroyed , the magic animating them would last as long as their creator lived .
description_long: Guardgoyle Guardgoyles were construct s created by Zhentarim wizard s to protect their treasures . They resembled baby gargoyle s , hence their moniker , and their small stature ( 2 feet tall / long ) allowed them to hide in the wizard ' s posessions , ready to fly out and strike if they sensed a presence in the room it was guarding that wasn ' t it ' s creator or one of the 5 people it could be programmed to not attack . If not destroyed , the magic animating them would last as long as their creator lived . Any repairs that they needed could be administered with a single stone shape spell . Due to these facts and that they only cost around 1000 gold pieces worth of raw materials to create , guardgoyles were cheap and effective guardians . Greater guardgoyles tended to be between 4 - 6 feet tall and lacked the ability to fly , they were also much more expensive to create and required much more powerful magic to animate them .

title: Guardian
description: Guardian The Guardian , or He Who Guards Those That Sleep , was a yak - man inhabiting a secret complex beneath Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardian was tasked with watching over the helpless bodies of both the Watcher and the Unspeakable while they remained in possession of their victims .
description_long: Guardian The Guardian , or He Who Guards Those That Sleep , was a yak - man inhabiting a secret complex beneath Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardian was tasked with watching over the helpless bodies of both the Watcher and the Unspeakable while they remained in possession of their victims . He was assisted by a pair of earthservant s .

title: Guardian ' s Tear
description: Guardian ' s Tear The Guardian ' s Tear was a major artifact created , quite by accident , during the Time of Troubles by Helm , the god of guardians . Unsurprisingly , the tragic circumstances behind its creation and the sheer amount of power released during it made this relic extremely desirable . .
description_long: Guardian ' s Tear The Guardian ' s Tear was a major artifact created , quite by accident , during the Time of Troubles by Helm , the god of guardians . Unsurprisingly , the tragic circumstances behind its creation and the sheer amount of power released during it made this relic extremely desirable . . . and extremely chaotic and unstable . Description . In most respects this artifact had the appearance of a gemstone , found only infrequently in the Realms , called a " king ' s tear " . Greater in size than any other examples of that jewel , however , it was almost 1 foot in length with a diameter of 8 inches . With exactly the shape suggested by its name , its clear , slightly - azure surface was perfectly polished , beyond the ability of any mundane means to shatter or even crack . What made it truly remarkable , though , was that any who gazed into its depths would see the battle between Mystra and Helm from the Watcher ' s point of view . . . reflected in an endless repetition for eternity . Powers . Thanks to the sheer raw magic contained within it , the Guardian ' s Tear had a number of powers related to the essence of the Art .

title: Guardian daemon
description: Guardian daemon A guardian daemon , also known as a guardian yugoloth , was a type of daemon from the plane of Gehenna . Description . A guardian daemon was a gigantic fiendish creature that spoke with a booming voice .
description_long: Guardian daemon A guardian daemon , also known as a guardian yugoloth , was a type of daemon from the plane of Gehenna . Description . A guardian daemon was a gigantic fiendish creature that spoke with a booming voice . They had a variety of different appearances , but came in three principal types : least , lesser , and greater . The least guardian daemons were often horned and frog - like , while the lesser guardian daemons were generally ape - or boar - like . Greater guardian daemons always appeared as gigantic , winged bear s with ram horns growing from their skulls and eagle talons for hands . One particular guardian daemon had a head and facial features that resembled a snub - nosed bulldog with huge canines . A pair of inward - hooking horns adorned its wide head at the sides . Guardian daemons could be summoned through use of a flaming brazier , which made them appear to be made from smoke , with their arms and hands appearing to be made of smoke , and the fingers of their black hands narrowing to sharp points . They radiated an aura of pure evil . Abilities . Guardian daemons could conjure a cone of fire three times a day .

title: Guardian genie
description: Guardian genie Guardian genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who were sworn to defend specific items or locations . Most of these genies were once efreet who were reshaped over time , but a few were once dao . History .
description_long: Guardian genie Guardian genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who were sworn to defend specific items or locations . Most of these genies were once efreet who were reshaped over time , but a few were once dao . History . Many of the first guardian genies chose to become tasked genies in order to ensure the freedom of family members , to repay a debt , or to serve as punishment for a crime . They often hated the noble dao or noble efreeti who first purchased their services . Description . Guardian genies had two faces , one to watch forward and one to watch their flank . They were completely devoid of hair and had dark red skin . All four of their arms were heavily muscled . Guardian genies stood 10 feet ( 3 meters ) tall and weighed 2 , 700 pounds ( 1 , 225 kg ) . Guardian genies never wore armor , relying instead on their tough skin for protection . Combat . Guardian genies were capable of moving at inhuman speed , lunging and attacking much faster than creatures smaller than them . A guardian genie always attacked enemy wizard s first . They could wield weapons in each of their four hands equally well .

title: Guardian naga
description: Guardian naga Guardian nagas were immortal beings that often protected treasure , magical secrets , items , and lore that would be destructive should they ever fall into the wrong hands . Description . Like all naga s , guardian nagas had snake - like bodies and human - like faces .
description_long: Guardian naga Guardian nagas were immortal beings that often protected treasure , magical secrets , items , and lore that would be destructive should they ever fall into the wrong hands . Description . Like all naga s , guardian nagas had snake - like bodies and human - like faces . They could grow to be 20 ft ( 6 m ) long and weighed up to 500 lb ( 227 kg ) . Their scales had a shimmer and their eyes were bright — hypnotically lit from within . Some had a golden frill that ran the length of their body . Some gave off a scent of sweet flowers . Personality . Guardian nagas were exceptionally wise , intelligent , and usually strictly lawful and good aligned , but they were free - willed creatures and could be of any alignment . Less noble nagas might subjugate creatures , usually a tribe of primitive kobold s , troglodyte s , or lizardfolk , to assist them in their pursuits , always believing they were superior to other creatures . They enjoyed spell research and designing strategies to thwart evil plots . They typically gave warning to intruders and only attacked if provoked . When angered , a guardian naga raised its crest . Combat .

title: Guardian of faith
description: Guardian of faith Guardian of faith was a divine conjuration spell that summoned a spectral guardian that prevented hostile creatures from approaching it . Effects . The spell created a large indistinct guardian that could be identified only by the presence of the symbol of its caster ' s deity on its shield .
description_long: Guardian of faith Guardian of faith was a divine conjuration spell that summoned a spectral guardian that prevented hostile creatures from approaching it . Effects . The spell created a large indistinct guardian that could be identified only by the presence of the symbol of its caster ' s deity on its shield . It lasted for eight hours and damaged any hostile creature that approached it . The guardian could be damaged and even destroyed if attacked with sufficient power . Components . The spell needed only a verbal component to be cast .

title: Guardian sphere
description: Guardian sphere The Guardian sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , crusader s , and monk s that produced zones of protection , often reactive to threats or by way of a semi - sentient creature . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Guardian Sphere in the sourcebook .
description_long: Guardian sphere The Guardian sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , crusader s , and monk s that produced zones of protection , often reactive to threats or by way of a semi - sentient creature . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Guardian Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Guardian trees
description: Guardian trees The Guardian trees were 500 ft ( 152 . 4 m ) tall trees that surrounded the Moonstone Palace in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description .
description_long: Guardian trees The Guardian trees were 500 ft ( 152 . 4 m ) tall trees that surrounded the Moonstone Palace in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . Each tree was over 50 ft ( 15 . 2 m ) in diameter and contained rooms and corridors . Inhabitants . Gold elves were stationed in these trees , and giant eagle s were often found at their tops .

title: Guardians of the Three Fires
description: Guardians of the Three Fires The Guardians of the Three Fires were an elite group of soldiers in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardians of the Three Fires served to protect the Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam and the temples under his control .
description_long: Guardians of the Three Fires The Guardians of the Three Fires were an elite group of soldiers in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardians of the Three Fires served to protect the Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam and the temples under his control . Base of Operations . The Guardians were operated within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . They were active primarily within the Furnace ward of the city .

title: Guards and wards
description: Guards and wards Guards and wards was an arcane abjuration spell that could be used to protect an area or structure with a variety of magical effects and wards . Effects . This spell had numerous effects that operated on an area up to 200 ft ( 18 .
description_long: Guards and wards Guards and wards was an arcane abjuration spell that could be used to protect an area or structure with a variety of magical effects and wards . Effects . This spell had numerous effects that operated on an area up to 200 ft ( 18 . 6 m ) per level of the caster and as much as 20 ft ( 6 m ) tall . Earlier versions could cover a much larger volume . The area could take any contiguous shape the caster desired , even layering the ward on top of itself to cover multiple stories , provided the maximum volume was not exceeded . Numerous magical effects could be triggered within the warded area ; the first of these included the following : Secondly , the caster could choose one of the following effects : " Guards and wards " could not be " dispelled " by anything less than a " Mordenkainen ' s disjunction " spell . A simple " dispel magic " spell could only be used to remove one specific effect within the warded area . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required , plus incense had to be burned along with a small amount of brimstone ( or sulphur ) , oil , a knotted string , and small measure of umber hulk blood .

title: Gudea
description: Gudea Gudea was the ruler of Ssintar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Gudea was a supporter of Gilgeam .
description_long: Gudea Gudea was the ruler of Ssintar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Gudea was a supporter of Gilgeam . However he like many hid from the king how the situation was disperate . He was bargain with Furifax and the cult of Tiamat in order to survive . Personality . Gudea was a natural pessimist , always figuring the worst scenarios . He had no power ambition ' s .

title: Guecubu
description: Guecubu A guecubu resembles a mass of vapor , and is born from dreamstuff tainted by evil . Guecubus can possess and control the body of sleeping humanoids . Once they are in control , they ' ride ' silently , letting their victim go about his or her business .
description_long: Guecubu A guecubu resembles a mass of vapor , and is born from dreamstuff tainted by evil . Guecubus can possess and control the body of sleeping humanoids . Once they are in control , they ' ride ' silently , letting their victim go about his or her business . At some point they take control and lash out , trying to spread death and murder – particularly the victim ' s family and friends . Sometimes the guecubu will conceal its actions even from the victim , letting them believe that they are cursed or jinxed . Guecubus believe that killings form some sort of pattern , and enough spilled blood will eventually reveal the meaning of creation in this pattern . They rarely form groups with other guecubus , preferring to remain hidden and anonymous . However , many of them can be found in the Dreaming Gulf ( 230th layer of the Abyss ) , where they are created spontaneously from the raw , churning chaos of dreams . The " Demonomicon of Iggwilv " speculates that each breed of loumara evolved from the dreams of a different dead god , and that their natures are a corruption of that god ' s portfolio . The guecubus from those of a god of law and peace

title: Guenhwyvar
description: Guenhwyvar Guenhwyvar was a 600 - lb . ( 272 - kg ) black panther who resided on the Astral Plane . She was summoned to the Prime Material Plane by the use of an onyx " Figurine of Wondrous Power " .
description_long: Guenhwyvar Guenhwyvar was a 600 - lb . ( 272 - kg ) black panther who resided on the Astral Plane . She was summoned to the Prime Material Plane by the use of an onyx " Figurine of Wondrous Power " . Description . Guenhwyvar was summoned through a detailed onyx figurine of a panther . When summoned , the figurine emitted a gray mist which quickly solidified into the panther shape . Guenhwyvar herself was described as a " huge black panther . " Uses . This figurine was last in the possession of Drizzt Do ' Urden , who treated Guenhwyvar as his ranger animal companion . She could be summoned to her master ' s side for twelve hours every other day . However , it was possible for her to be away from the astral plane for longer , but this caused her to become incredibly drowsy , barely able to lift her head . Due to her nature as an astral being not of the Prime Material Plane , she was highly resistant to biological poisons and quite resistant to physical injuries as well . History . Creation .

title: Guge
description: Guge Guge was an ancient kingdom situated on the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . At the height of its power , the kingdom of Guge encompassed the entirety of the Katakoro Plateau , stretching as far north as the Hollow Crown Mountains .
description_long: Guge Guge was an ancient kingdom situated on the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . At the height of its power , the kingdom of Guge encompassed the entirety of the Katakoro Plateau , stretching as far north as the Hollow Crown Mountains . Appendix . Notes . Guge was likely named after the real world kingdom of Guge in Western Tibet .

title: Guh
description: Guh Chief Guh was the ruler of the hill giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Guh was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Guh Chief Guh was the ruler of the hill giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Guh was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR after the disappearance of storm giant king Hekaton all giant lords started their path to reshape the ordning . Guh ' s plan was eat all food she can in order to become the largest giant in the world , so the giant pantheon would noticed and elevate her at the top . In order to made her plan working Guh relocating in Grudd Haug took all male hill giant s as her husbands and send them in search of food for her . Usually Guh eats all people that arrived in her den unless they proved to be valuable allies . Personality . Like her fellow Guh was no so smart and her plot was a questionable one . She believes that if she becomes the world ' s biggest giant , none will question her . In addition , Guh is a glutton .

title: Guidance
description: Guidance Guidance , also known as divine fortune , was a cantrip , or a " channel divinity " prayer cast by all cleric s . When the prayer version of " divine fortune " was cast , the cleric using it became , for a moment , more resistant to ill effects while simultaneously gaining additional combat proficiency . After the effects had worn off , " divine fortune " could not be recast , nor could any other " channel divinity " prayer be cast , until the cleric rested for at least a few minutes , in order to regain the concentration needed for the casting .
description_long: Guidance Guidance , also known as divine fortune , was a cantrip , or a " channel divinity " prayer cast by all cleric s . When the prayer version of " divine fortune " was cast , the cleric using it became , for a moment , more resistant to ill effects while simultaneously gaining additional combat proficiency . After the effects had worn off , " divine fortune " could not be recast , nor could any other " channel divinity " prayer be cast , until the cleric rested for at least a few minutes , in order to regain the concentration needed for the casting . The post - spellplague cantrip version had no such limitation . History . Prior to the Spellplague and after the Second Sundering , " divine fortune " was more commonly known as " guidance " and was slightly less powerful , being considered an orison . It could also only be cast a number of times per day equal to the number of times a cleric had prepared for its usage . There was also a similar evocation used by druid s . Intervention .

title: Guiding bolt
description: Guiding bolt Guiding bolt was a light - based divine evocation spell . Effects . The spell caused a beam of light to hit a creature , damaging it and making it glow for a short period of time , temporarily making it an easier target .
description_long: Guiding bolt Guiding bolt was a light - based divine evocation spell . Effects . The spell caused a beam of light to hit a creature , damaging it and making it glow for a short period of time , temporarily making it an easier target . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components .

title: Guiji Yui
description: Guiji Yui Guiji Yui was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Guiji was honest and humorless , believing in strict enforcement of the law .
description_long: Guiji Yui Guiji Yui was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Guiji was honest and humorless , believing in strict enforcement of the law . Activities . Guiji Yui was the shoya of the village of Osata in Fochu Peninsula . History . Guiji was the executioner of the previous shoya Osari Mochikino . After Mochikino ' s death , he was promoted to his position . In 1358 DR , Guiji met Osari Minhiro , the son of Mochikino , and a foreign adventuring party just before he executed a farmer that had violated the Keian no Furegaki ( a set of laws for farmers ) . He welcomed the son of his former superior and his guests , but said that for any infringement of the law from them Minhiro would be dealt with immediately .

title: Guild
description: Guild A guild was an organization composed of like - minded individuals to further and protect their interests . Guilds appeared in many different forms but typically offered benefits such as camaraderie and even financial support to members . Large , powerful guilds could even control an aspect of a city , such as trade in certain goods .
description_long: Guild A guild was an organization composed of like - minded individuals to further and protect their interests . Guilds appeared in many different forms but typically offered benefits such as camaraderie and even financial support to members . Large , powerful guilds could even control an aspect of a city , such as trade in certain goods . Guild membership . Guild membership was generally open to those who possessed some skill in the guild ' s primary activity . In many cases , interested persons needed only to approach the guild and apply for membership . Occasionally , additional entry requirements such as belonging to a certain race were imposed . Some guilds , such as thieves guilds , were secret societies so even learning of the existence of these guilds could be difficult . Guilds normally required an entry fee as well as periodic fees to remain in good standing . Benefits of membership in a guild could include access to the guildhall , discounts on trade materials and possibly financial support in the form of loans . Guild types . Adventurers guilds . In some cities , those who hunted monsters and delved in dungeons banded together to form adventurers guilds .

title: Guild Arcane
description: Guild Arcane A Guild Arcane was a mages ' guild , local to a Calishite city , that totally controlled and regulated the use of magic within that city . Organization . Each of the five Guilds Arcane was led by a caleph arcane , who was the most influential wizard in his or her respective city .
description_long: Guild Arcane A Guild Arcane was a mages ' guild , local to a Calishite city , that totally controlled and regulated the use of magic within that city . Organization . Each of the five Guilds Arcane was led by a caleph arcane , who was the most influential wizard in his or her respective city . The syl - pasha of Calimshan had the unwritten support of the leaders of the Guilds Arcane . Every wizard within the city was assigned a place in the hierarchy of the guild , by which means he or she could be controlled and manipulated if need arose . Activities . The primary way in which a young wizard was taught magic in Calimshan was through one of the Guilds Arcane . Guild members shared spell component s , minor magical item s , and arcane secrets with each other for far cheaper fees than with outsiders to the Guild , making dealing in magic nearly impossible for non - members . Standard fees in most cities for Guild Arcane services were 25 gold pieces per day plus meals to the one providing magical assistance , in addition to reimbursement for whatever spells were actually cast during the hired mage ' s employment .

title: Guild thief
description: Guild thief The guild thief is a prestige class of Faerûn . Simply put , a guild thief is just a member of a city ' s thieves ' guild , as opposed to those lone con men and cat burglars who operate solo or perhaps with a few others . The result of their membership in the thieves ' guild is that a guild thief has access to assets and training that other thieves simply lack , making a Guild Thief considerably more dangerous and resourceful to those his guild may target .
description_long: Guild thief The guild thief is a prestige class of Faerûn . Simply put , a guild thief is just a member of a city ' s thieves ' guild , as opposed to those lone con men and cat burglars who operate solo or perhaps with a few others . The result of their membership in the thieves ' guild is that a guild thief has access to assets and training that other thieves simply lack , making a Guild Thief considerably more dangerous and resourceful to those his guild may target . Those who choose to become a guild thief come from many classes , though typically the rogue is the most common one to choose to join the thieves ' guild of their chosen city . Depending on the attitude of the city however , even arcane spellcasters may choose to join in order to further their own studies .

title: Guildwars
description: Guildwars The Guildwars took place in Waterdeep between 1256 DR and 1262 DR . They were initiated when the death of Open Lord Ahghairon died and the Council of Guildmasters took power . The guildmasters had killed all of the Lords of Waterdeep whose identities they could discover , and afterwards , they turned on one another .
description_long: Guildwars The Guildwars took place in Waterdeep between 1256 DR and 1262 DR . They were initiated when the death of Open Lord Ahghairon died and the Council of Guildmasters took power . The guildmasters had killed all of the Lords of Waterdeep whose identities they could discover , and afterwards , they turned on one another . After six years , all but two guildmasters were dead . The survivors , gemcutter Ehlemm Zoar and shipwright Lhorar Gildeggh , agreed to share power and become the Lords Magister of Waterdeep .

title: Guilmarl
description: Guilmarl Guilmarl was a city located in southern Dambrath . Geography . Guilmarl was the southernmost city in Dambrath located along the coast on the Great Sea .
description_long: Guilmarl Guilmarl was a city located in southern Dambrath . Geography . Guilmarl was the southernmost city in Dambrath located along the coast on the Great Sea . Violent storms assaulted the city for the entire three - month rainy season . Many of the wealthier citizens opted to winter in calmer cities . The close presence of the Great Swamp of Rethild to the west made Guilmarl a hot and stuffy place to live . History . Many pirate and merchant ships harbored in Guilmarl outside of the rainy season , using the city as a launching point for Zakhara , Halruaa , and beyond . The main factor keeping the city from fading away was its superb pearl beds , allowing at least half of the population to earn a living revolving around the pearl trade . Inhabitants . Fewer crinti lived here compared to other cities in Dambrath . Most despised the scent of the Great Swamp and chose to live elsewhere .

title: Guisarme
description: Guisarme A guisarme is a two - handed , martial , melee weapon of the pole arm family . Description . The basic guisarme is a weaponized pruning hook mounted on a long pole .
description_long: Guisarme A guisarme is a two - handed , martial , melee weapon of the pole arm family . Description . The basic guisarme is a weaponized pruning hook mounted on a long pole . It may or may not have a back spike . The convex edge ( outside curve ) is sharpened for slicing all the way up to the point of the hook . An average guisarme costs 9gp and weighs 12lbs ( 5 . 5kg ) . There are some other pole arms that incorporate the guisarme into their design . Use . The guisarme is a pole arm so it requires two hands to wield . It is a reach weapon so it can strike targets 10 feet ( 3 meters ) away but cannot be used against adjacent opponents . The hook may be used to attempt to trip an enemy or pull a rider off a mount . The back spike can be used for parrying or for a sideways swinging attack , but the guisarme is primarily an offensive slashing weapon . This weapon requires training to use and is classified as a martial weapon .

title: Guise of the Yak - Man
description: Guise of the Yak - Man Guise of the Yak - Man was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . The spell made the target appear as a vile yak - man as far as all of the physical senses were concerned .
description_long: Guise of the Yak - Man Guise of the Yak - Man was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . The spell made the target appear as a vile yak - man as far as all of the physical senses were concerned . Only a " true seeing " spell could piece this illusion . This spell could only be dispelled through a " wish " . This illusion was so strong that even creatures , such as undead , that were normally immune to illusions , were affected . While under the guise of a yak - man , the target would never be harmed or hindered by a dao . However , most civilized folk of Zakhara despised the yak - men , so the target could not encounter other humanoid s without being attacked on sight . Components . This spell required a hair from a yak - man to cast .

title: Guise of the faithful
description: Guise of the faithful Guise of the Faithful was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice , owing to the illegality of their own existence in drow society , but also to do their work .
description_long: Guise of the faithful Guise of the Faithful was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice , owing to the illegality of their own existence in drow society , but also to do their work . " Guise of the faithful " was an ability to create a magical disguise for the skulker and another ally . This disguise managed to change how one and one ' s equipment felt , sounded , and looked but had the limitation of only allowing drow disguises . The entire illusion lasted for an hour or until dismissed . It was possible , though hard , to see through .

title: Guk
description: Guk Guk was a female goblin rogue and member of the Hidden in Maerimydra during the Silence of Lolth . Description . She had deep red skin and yellow eyes .
description_long: Guk Guk was a female goblin rogue and member of the Hidden in Maerimydra during the Silence of Lolth . Description . She had deep red skin and yellow eyes . Guk was a notably small goblin . Personality . Although rarely one to speak , Guk would occasionally squeak loudly if frightened . She was considered a receptive pupil . Abilities . Like most goblins , Guk ' s size and instincts made her well - suited to stealth . However , under the tutelage of the Hidden , her natural talents were cultivated to the point that she was considered one of the stealthiest in the group . An especially wary rogue , Guk preferred to strike from a distance , if possible . Possessions . She wore a set of " + 1 studded leather " that allowed her to merge with the shadows around her . In addition , Guk was equipped with a " + 1 venomous short sword " and a well - crafted hand crossbow Relationships . Although she rarely spoke , Guk had made firm allies with the other members of the Hidden and had proved an able pupil to the senior members . History . Goblin slave . Guk had spent much of her early life as a slave in the city of Maerimydra .

title: Guldaeth Grimshield
description: Guldaeth Grimshield Guldaeth Grimshield was an old dwarf adventurer who lived in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . Speaking of dangers and rumors to be found in the Vast , Guldaeth once joked dryly , " Come one , come all , here to the Vast . All the killing ' s happening here , and the next handful of dooms to befall us all are a - hatching here — why wait for them to crawl to you ?
description_long: Guldaeth Grimshield Guldaeth Grimshield was an old dwarf adventurer who lived in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . Speaking of dangers and rumors to be found in the Vast , Guldaeth once joked dryly , " Come one , come all , here to the Vast . All the killing ' s happening here , and the next handful of dooms to befall us all are a - hatching here — why wait for them to crawl to you ? Come to the Vast , and join the slaughter . "

title: Guldagh Ironfist
description: Guldagh Ironfist Guldagh Ironfist was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch . Activities . Guldagh was a notorious thug .
description_long: Guldagh Ironfist Guldagh Ironfist was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch . Activities . Guldagh was a notorious thug . Usually , he recruited criminals in Westgate ' s dirtiest alleys and marched them over Cormyr and Sembia until they arrived in Anauroch , where they thieved incense from the D ' tarig ' s territory . Afterwards , Guldagh traded the incense with other merchants before returning . If followed by some enemies , Guldagh entered the Stonelands , where rumors said he had a secret fortress .

title: Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn
description: Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn The Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn ( previously Gulder ' s Good Grubb Inn ) , was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located on the eastern edge of the city , just near the city wall . Around 1358 DR , it was known as a cozy establishment , typically full of regular patrons year - round , except in the worst of winter .
description_long: Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn The Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn ( previously Gulder ' s Good Grubb Inn ) , was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located on the eastern edge of the city , just near the city wall . Around 1358 DR , it was known as a cozy establishment , typically full of regular patrons year - round , except in the worst of winter . The conditions were good and the prices cheap . However , it was commandeered by the Guard of Tantras for use as an army barracks during the Time of Troubles of that year .

title: Guldor Zauviir
description: Guldor Zauviir Guldor Zauviir was the head of the College of Mages , the College that gathered all non - specialized wizards , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . Relations . Guldor had strong ties with the local church of Lolth , headed by a female of House Zauvirr .
description_long: Guldor Zauviir Guldor Zauviir was the head of the College of Mages , the College that gathered all non - specialized wizards , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . Relations . Guldor had strong ties with the local church of Lolth , headed by a female of House Zauvirr . History . In 1379 DR , in opposition to the proposal to elevate Q ' arlynd Melarn , Master of the Ancient Arcana , as a new member of the Conclave , Guldor proposed T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic , instead . However , after Q ' arlynd Melarn ' s revelation that only Lolth ' s worshipers could practice Bae ' qeshel , his proposal was rejected . Later , he discussed with T ' lar and his aunt Streea ' Valsharess Zauviir , the city ' s high priestess of Lolth , about why their plot had failed . Under orders of the Lady Penitent , T ' lar killed Guldor .

title: Guldred
description: Guldred Guldred was a lizardfolk in Cormanthor ' s Underdark . History . In 1479 DR , Guldred was an outcast of his tribe living in an Underdark lake under the lair of Dretchroyaster .
description_long: Guldred Guldred was a lizardfolk in Cormanthor ' s Underdark . History . In 1479 DR , Guldred was an outcast of his tribe living in an Underdark lake under the lair of Dretchroyaster . He may have helped some adventurers that had infiltrated the lair in exchange for killing his treacherous fellows .

title: Gulf Gate
description: Gulf Gate The Gulf Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Activities . Located south of the Clothiers ' District , this gate was largely used by traders and suppliers .
description_long: Gulf Gate The Gulf Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Activities . Located south of the Clothiers ' District , this gate was largely used by traders and suppliers . It was also the closest gate to the Grand Bazaar . In addition to the craft goods , most of Huzuz ' s food supply entered through this gate . The Gulf Gate was closed during the night .

title: Gulf of Luiren
description: Gulf of Luiren The Gulf of Luiren was created in 1385 DR when the Spellplague completely inundated Luiren , submerging the land beneath the waves . In addition to the creatures one would normally find in a large body of salt water , the gulf was home to Sahuagin , aquatic ogres and trolls and the ghost s of the former halfling residents of Luiren .
description_long: Gulf of Luiren The Gulf of Luiren was created in 1385 DR when the Spellplague completely inundated Luiren , submerging the land beneath the waves . In addition to the creatures one would normally find in a large body of salt water , the gulf was home to Sahuagin , aquatic ogres and trolls and the ghost s of the former halfling residents of Luiren .

title: Gulkin Hammarlin
description: Gulkin Hammarlin Gulkin Hammerlin was a surly carpenter in High Dale . History . Gulkin was for a brief time a mercenary hailing from Daerlun before he settled in High Dale .
description_long: Gulkin Hammarlin Gulkin Hammerlin was a surly carpenter in High Dale . History . Gulkin was for a brief time a mercenary hailing from Daerlun before he settled in High Dale . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Gulkin was a member of the Council of the High Dale . Gulkin hated all usurpers and especially the wizards .

title: Gullykin
description: Gullykin Gullykin was a small settlement located a couple of miles from Durlag ' s Tower , south of the Wood of Sharp Teeth in the Western Heartlands . In Gullykin information about the on - goings in Durlag ' s Tower could be purchased for a small price . Gullykin laid hard up against the overgrown , fallow , rubble field that was once the elven town of Firewine Bridge .
description_long: Gullykin Gullykin was a small settlement located a couple of miles from Durlag ' s Tower , south of the Wood of Sharp Teeth in the Western Heartlands . In Gullykin information about the on - goings in Durlag ' s Tower could be purchased for a small price . Gullykin laid hard up against the overgrown , fallow , rubble field that was once the elven town of Firewine Bridge . The brewery of Gullykin was known to have great vaults , used both for storing casks and growing mushrooms . Rumors had it that they might be connected to underground store rooms of an ancient merchant house of Firewine Bridge , where many treasures guarded by golems still waited to be found . The citizens of Gullykin didn ' t explore the ruins of Firewine Bridge as they believed that doing so invited the misfortune of " those who died and do not sleep " . Baldur ' s Gate . In Baldur ' s Gate , Gullykin is a small halfling village in the Western Heartlands , north of the Firewine Bridge and east of Beregost and the ruins of Ulcaster ' s school . The village is surrounded by a wall and it lies at the edge of deep a gorge . The ruler of the village was , in 1368 DR , the halfling Gandolar Luckyfoot .

title: Gultec
description: Gultec Gultec was the leader of the Jaguar Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Gultec was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos , always close to the ruler Caxal in time of wars .
description_long: Gultec Gultec was the leader of the Jaguar Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Gultec was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos , always close to the ruler Caxal in time of wars . In 1361 DR , Gultec and the priest of Zaltec , Mixtal , were tasked by Nexal high priest Hoxitl with the mission to capture Erixitl from the local temple of Qotal and kill her , despite Mixtal ' s fear of reprisal . They managed to kidnap the girl without anyone noticing , but when Mixtal was ready to deliver the fatal blow , they all saw the arrival of the Golden Legion ' s ships . Erixitl profited from their distraction and escaped . Soon after , Gultex was called by Caxal to a war council , together with Lok , the leader of the Eagle Knights , to discuss how to fight the strangers . Later , Gultec and his men were stationed at the pyramid of Zaltec during the supposed sacrifice of Erixitl ( in truth the Faerûn ian girl Martine ) and were the first to fight the legionaries , more precisely , the squad led by Daggrande . Gultec was defeated , and most of his men were killed . He himself managed to escape . Together with Lok and Caxal , he decided to face the invaders at Ulatos .

title: Gulthmere Forest
description: Gulthmere Forest The Gulthmere Forest marked the boundary between the Dragon Coast and the Vilhon Reach . It was an overgrown forest of pine and cedar that was sacred to the god Nobanion . Geography .
description_long: Gulthmere Forest The Gulthmere Forest marked the boundary between the Dragon Coast and the Vilhon Reach . It was an overgrown forest of pine and cedar that was sacred to the god Nobanion . Geography . The terrain of the forest was hill country , leading up to the Orsraum Mountains in the south . The land had rich mineral deposits and so was coveted by miners .

title: Gumushtekin
description: Gumushtekin Gumushtekin was a noble efreeti who occasionally visited the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . He favored dark black and silver clothing .
description_long: Gumushtekin Gumushtekin was a noble efreeti who occasionally visited the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . He favored dark black and silver clothing . Personality . Like most noble efreeti , he was arrogant and had a fiery temper . Activities . He occasionally visited Atabeg al - Mazdaghani on the island of Al - Zira

title: Gundar Brontoskin
description: Gundar Brontoskin Gundar Brontoskin was the King of Grunwald and the Thunderbeast Tribe . Description . The king was a good looking man who ruled Grunwald with a light touch .
description_long: Gundar Brontoskin Gundar Brontoskin was the King of Grunwald and the Thunderbeast Tribe . Description . The king was a good looking man who ruled Grunwald with a light touch . Possessions . In battle , Gundar used a broadsword , a handaxe , and carried hidden dagger s on his person . Personality . Brontoskin was very diplomatic with the uthgardt barbarians and kept them from raiding many nearby settlements . He was deeply interested in any news from around Faerûn .

title: Gundar Silvershine
description: Gundar Silvershine Gundar Silvershine was an outlander living in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Gundar owned and operated Abas for All .
description_long: Gundar Silvershine Gundar Silvershine was an outlander living in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Gundar owned and operated Abas for All . He possessed the weaving skill to accurately depict dragon s and wyvern s on cloth which was a rare talent in Golden Huzuz . Much of the court found these creature bizarre , so he kept plenty of common aba s for sale as well . Since coming to the Land of Fate , Gundar became Enlightened , following the teachings of Jauhar . History . Originally from a distant land called Cormyr , Gundar served a barbarian king named Azoun . His greed got the better of him and Gundar was forced to flee his homeland when he was caught stealing from the crown .

title: Gundarlun
description: Gundarlun Gundarlun ( pronounced " GOON - der - len " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Icewind Dale in the North . Climate . Although classed as a subarctic climate like the nearby mainland , Gundarlun , like other islands in the area , experienced somewhat different weather , owing to the seas .
description_long: Gundarlun Gundarlun ( pronounced " GOON - der - len " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Icewind Dale in the North . Climate . Although classed as a subarctic climate like the nearby mainland , Gundarlun , like other islands in the area , experienced somewhat different weather , owing to the seas . Gundarlun endured winter for almost eight months of the year , and was regularly locked in sea ice that often reached over 1 mile ( 1 . 6 kilometers ) in extent by the month of Alturiak . When not packed in ice , the island was often blanketed in dense fog that rose late in the day . Summers were particularly cool . The island was lashed by heavy storms off the seas , and continual bitter northwest winter wind was called " Auril ' sbreath " by the islanders . The white dragon Arveiaturace drank from freshwater lakes and cascades on Gundarlun , among other islands of the region . People & Culture . Gundarlun was inhabited largely by Northmen . The people of the island were known as " Gunds " . They were excellent fisherfolk and merchants , and were relatively more devout when it came to the gods than most other Northmen .

title: Gundbarg
description: Gundbarg Gundbarg , called the " Gateway Port " , was a city on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . It was the biggest settlement on the island — indeed , all the islands of the northern Trackless Sea — with a population of 12 , 000 . Economy .
description_long: Gundbarg Gundbarg , called the " Gateway Port " , was a city on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . It was the biggest settlement on the island — indeed , all the islands of the northern Trackless Sea — with a population of 12 , 000 . Economy . The city of Gundbarg had an economy based entirely on fishing , farming , mining , and trading . Almost every ship to cross the Trackless Sea stopped at Gundbarg to take on fresh water and food , make repairs , replace crew , or exchange goods . The city provided all the services required by these seafarers , with inns , taverns , drydocks , sailmakers , and great warehouses , and maintained reasonable prices . The Dragon Turtle Inn by the harbor was known as a place from which to hire captains with ships , as well as a hangout for adventurers . Military . Gundbarg kept a standing army numbering 300 warriors . They served as city guard and crews of the six raker warships commanded by King Olger Redaxe in 1370 DR . History . Erek , the manservant of Amelior Amanitas , had a " reputation " on Gundarlun .

title: Gunder
description: Gunder The Gunders were the historical ruling family of Estagund in the Shining Lands . History . The Gunders ruled Estagund through turbulent times .
description_long: Gunder The Gunders were the historical ruling family of Estagund in the Shining Lands . History . The Gunders ruled Estagund through turbulent times . They usually preferred raiding their neighbors which often got them into trouble . The Gunders were conquered by the Arkaiun under Reinhar I in 551 DR , and a half millenia later were laid to waste by the vengeful crinti of Dambrath after a failed invasion .

title: Gunderman Brewmaster
description: Gunderman Brewmaster Gunderman Brewmaster was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . Activities . Gunderman was a very able brewer , known for the Old Smoke , a beer much appreciated in the Moonsea area .
description_long: Gunderman Brewmaster Gunderman Brewmaster was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . Activities . Gunderman was a very able brewer , known for the Old Smoke , a beer much appreciated in the Moonsea area . That made him a wealthy man but he never forgot pleasant manner .

title: Gundren Rockseeker
description: Gundren Rockseeker Gundren Rockseeker was one of the three dwarf brothers who rediscovered Wave Echo Cave . He was the brother of Tharden Rockseeker , and the older brother of Nundro Rockseeker . He was also a friend to Sildar Hallwinter , a member of the Lords ' Alliance .
description_long: Gundren Rockseeker Gundren Rockseeker was one of the three dwarf brothers who rediscovered Wave Echo Cave . He was the brother of Tharden Rockseeker , and the older brother of Nundro Rockseeker . He was also a friend to Sildar Hallwinter , a member of the Lords ' Alliance . He was captured by the Cragmaw tribe and was held in Cragmaw Castle by King Grol .

title: Gur
description: Gur The Gurs , also known as Selûne ' s Children or the people of the highway , were a nomadic human people . Description . Like their Rashemi kin , Gurs were typically a stout , strong , and sturdy people , with thick black hair , dark eyes , and dusky skin .
description_long: Gur The Gurs , also known as Selûne ' s Children or the people of the highway , were a nomadic human people . Description . Like their Rashemi kin , Gurs were typically a stout , strong , and sturdy people , with thick black hair , dark eyes , and dusky skin . Society & Culture . By the 14 century DR , the Gurs were divided into two distinct cultures , those who traveled throughout the Western Heartlands and those living in the Endless Wastes . A few settled in some of the poorer sections of cities such as Baldur ' s Gate , Elturel , and Iriaebor . The Gurs of the Western Heartlands were arranged by large extended families . A nomadic people , they traveled from settlement to settlement in assorted caravans , picking up random jobs and selling or trading any unwanted goods . Some found work as soothsayers and diviners . Those few who settled in cities struggled to survive in their poorer quarters . Gur culture placed a high value on honor , but they suffered long - standing prejudices from other folk . The Gur of the Endless Wastes were on friendly terms with the Oigur and the Tuigan tribes . Their lands bordered those of the Fankiang and Zamogedi tribes . Religion & Magic .

title: Gurdren Myrinn
description: Gurdren Myrinn Gurdren Myrinn was a female keening spirit and a divine champion of Kiaransalee . She resided in V ' elddrinnsshar in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth alongside Larynda Telenna . Description .
description_long: Gurdren Myrinn Gurdren Myrinn was a female keening spirit and a divine champion of Kiaransalee . She resided in V ' elddrinnsshar in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth alongside Larynda Telenna . Description . Insubstantial and ghostly , Gurdren Myrinn wore heavy armor forged with the likeness of demon ic features . In her hands she clasped a serrated greatsword . Abilities . As a keening spirit , Gurdren could release a baleful wail that afflicted creatures much like the " wail of the banshee " spell . Furthermore , she could rejuvenate from most defeats unless certain conditions were met . Since she had dedicated herself to Kiaransalee as a divine champion , Gurdren Myrinn trained extensively with the dagger ( despite her seeming preference for the greatsword ) , which was the favored weapon of her deity . In addition , she could heal wounds with her touch , if she so wished . Possessions . Gurdren customarily wore a set of " demon armor " and carried a greatsword with a serrated edge . Relationships . Her high status in the church of Kiaransalee meant that she was venerated in some shrines by devotees , such as the divine seeker Paelinn . History .

title: Gurnik Tapfinger
description: Gurnik Tapfinger Gurnik Tapfinger was a priest of Callarduran Smoothhands and a member of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gurnik was at the Speaking Stone sanctuary .
description_long: Gurnik Tapfinger Gurnik Tapfinger was a priest of Callarduran Smoothhands and a member of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gurnik was at the Speaking Stone sanctuary . Here , he hired a party of adventurers ( who were escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve ) to enter the closed Rockblight section of the city and reconsecrate the Steadfast Stone temple .

title: Gurrash
description: Gurrash Gurrash was the war chief of the Ear Seekers tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Gurrash led his orcs against the elves of the Ardeep Forest , but they were defeated .
description_long: Gurrash Gurrash was the war chief of the Ear Seekers tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Gurrash led his orcs against the elves of the Ardeep Forest , but they were defeated . An injured Gurrash guided his fellows in retreat to the Nightstone village .

title: Gurri
description: Gurri Gurri was the language spoken by the nomadic Gur people . Description . Gurri was an nasal language , with long E and I vowels drawn out .
description_long: Gurri Gurri was the language spoken by the nomadic Gur people . Description . Gurri was an nasal language , with long E and I vowels drawn out . Script . In later times , Gurri made use of the Thorass alphabet . History . Although considered a patois or creole tongue of the Imaskari languages group , scholars observed the influence of countless other languages , many of them dead by the 14th century DR . In particular , the dead Halardrim language of the Rashemi had a strong influence ; the Gurs were generally believed to be of Rashemi descent . Among the Imaskari languages , it was most closely related to the Eastern group .

title: Gurum
description: Gurum The Gurum were a tribe of Ogre s and ogre magi who inhabited an area of Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea of southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Gurum lived in dwellings or caves scattered all over the island .
description_long: Gurum The Gurum were a tribe of Ogre s and ogre magi who inhabited an area of Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea of southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Gurum lived in dwellings or caves scattered all over the island . Each dwelling held one family that could have up to twenty members . The different families were usually at odds with each other , usually over hunting territory . Long - standing feuds were common among the Gurum . Three castes developed within Gurum : Ogre Magi . The ogre magi were the most powerful , but least populous of the three castes . Long ago they invaded the island and found it populated by pure ogres . Because of their magical abilities they were able to conquer the native ogres . Pure Ogres . These old families never breed with the invading ogre magi . They were more educated that common ogres . They were responsible for the sacrifices made to Kar ' r ' rga , surrounding them with mystery to protect their traditions . Ogrima . The ogrima were a mixture that arose from breeding between ogres and ogre magi . They were considered to be tainted by the other castes . Ogrima made up the majority of the Gurum . Activities .

title: Gust of wind
description: Gust of wind Gust of wind was an evocation or alteration spell that blew away or knocked down smaller creatures . Effect . This spell created a strong blast of air that originated from the caster and moved in the direction he or she was facing .
description_long: Gust of wind Gust of wind was an evocation or alteration spell that blew away or knocked down smaller creatures . Effect . This spell created a strong blast of air that originated from the caster and moved in the direction he or she was facing . The force of this " gust " instantly extinguished candles , torches , and other unprotected flames , while it made lanterns and other protected flames dance wildly and potentially even extinguish them too . Creatures caught in the area might also be affected . Like any natural sudden wind gust , a " gust of wind " could also whip up a stinging spray of sand or dust ; fan a fire ; blow over light awnings and hangings ; cause a boat to heel ; or disperse gases , clouds , or vapors , at least to the limit of its range . Focus . A tiny leather bellows . History . This spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Tolodine as Tolodine ' s gust of wind in −2386 DR , early in the history of Netheril .

title: Gustin Bone
description: Gustin Bone Gustin Bone was a young wizard of moderate power who specialized in Illusion and Transmutation magic . His combat spells were quite weak . Gustin ' s primary source of income was through scams .
description_long: Gustin Bone Gustin Bone was a young wizard of moderate power who specialized in Illusion and Transmutation magic . His combat spells were quite weak . Gustin ' s primary source of income was through scams . History . The orphaned child of a wizard , Gustin displayed his magical talents early , much to the dismay of his uncle , and subsequently left his farm to seek adventure , fortune , and , possibly , a little romance . He was inspired by a tattered copy of a guide to Waterdeep that he found among his mother ' s possessions . In 1479 DR he ventured from Cormyr to Waterdeep in the hopes of scamming Waterdavians out of their coin . His plan was to pay a sculptor to carve a statue of a warrior . He would then animate the statue and have it walk through the streets of Waterdeep to a room he had rented . Gustin would then claim that the statue was a long - missing paladin who had been turned to stone by some magic and that the paladin used the last of his life force to walk back to his ancestral home . Gustin would of course charge admission to see the " paladin " . He commissioned a member of the Carver family to sculpt the statue .

title: Gustofsen Eller
description: Gustofsen Eller Gustofsen Eller was the most renowned planar expert in the Realms in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Gustofsen witnessed his entire family slaughtered by cultists of Kali , a goddess of another plane .
description_long: Gustofsen Eller Gustofsen Eller was the most renowned planar expert in the Realms in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Gustofsen witnessed his entire family slaughtered by cultists of Kali , a goddess of another plane . Around 1357 DR , Gustofsen proclaimed he had killed the goddess Kali in her layer on the Abyss . An adventuring party was assembled in order to accompany Eller to verify this . Personality . Gustofsen was obsessed with defeating Kali . He was a somewhat arrogant individual . Relationship . Gustofsen taught his second cousin Inata Eller .

title: Gustyl
description: Gustyl Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " was a priest of Oghma . He took on Raegar Stoneblade to unofficially work for him , spying on wizard s in Waterdeep , although he forbade Raegar from spying on Maaril the Dragonmage , or anyone from the Wands clan or Blackstaff Tower . Gustly ' s assistant was Phanar Manthar .
description_long: Gustyl Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " was a priest of Oghma . He took on Raegar Stoneblade to unofficially work for him , spying on wizard s in Waterdeep , although he forbade Raegar from spying on Maaril the Dragonmage , or anyone from the Wands clan or Blackstaff Tower . Gustly ' s assistant was Phanar Manthar . Gustyl died suddenly in 1371 DR .

title: Gutbuster ( drink )
description: Gutbuster ( drink ) Gutbuster was a strong dwarven brew consumed by the dwarves of northwest Faerûn . Description . Gutbuster was a strong drink that only the toughest dwarves and foolhardiest non - dwarves would ever attempt to drink .
description_long: Gutbuster ( drink ) Gutbuster was a strong dwarven brew consumed by the dwarves of northwest Faerûn . Description . Gutbuster was a strong drink that only the toughest dwarves and foolhardiest non - dwarves would ever attempt to drink . However , if the drinker survived it , they were granted immunity to sleep and cold for some time . It was described as the " most foul - tasting concoction ever brewed . " History . The Gutbuster Brigade , the battlerager brigade of Mithral Hall , was named for the gutbuster they would consume before going to battle . Trivia . When Reginald Roundshield was granted a valor wish in 1478 DR , he wished for a trip to Mithral Hall and a keg of gutbuster .

title: Gutbuster Brigade
description: Gutbuster Brigade The Gutbuster Brigade was a famous battlerager squad founded by Thibbledorf Pwent in Mithral Hall . They had their own brand of gung - ho tactics and often disregarded the typical order and discipline in favor of a more direct approach . History .
description_long: Gutbuster Brigade The Gutbuster Brigade was a famous battlerager squad founded by Thibbledorf Pwent in Mithral Hall . They had their own brand of gung - ho tactics and often disregarded the typical order and discipline in favor of a more direct approach . History . The Gutbuster Brigade was formed in 1357 DR , when an army of drow attacked Mithral Hall . Thibbledorf Pwent hand - selected a score of dwarves to train as battleragers - a chaotic form of fighting , with various battlerager guilds having varying styles - Thibbledorf ' s personal ' art ' consisted of putting on a full suit armor full covered in spikes , and throwing himself at the enemy , convulsing violently and shredding them . This turned out to be a highly efficient way of fighting in the narrow underground corridors and the Gutbusters took the drow completely by surprise . After Pwent ' s apparent death , the Gutbusters continued on . In 1484 DR , the leader of the Gutbusters was Bungalow Thump , who , following Pwent ' s service to Bruenor Battlehammer , was the personal bodyguard to King Connerad Brawnanvil .

title: Guth
description: Guth Sir Guth of Ormpetarr was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup from the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . History . " Circa " 1342 DR , the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn returned and committed murder and stole the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church — from the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Calimshan .
description_long: Guth Sir Guth of Ormpetarr was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup from the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . History . " Circa " 1342 DR , the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn returned and committed murder and stole the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church — from the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Calimshan . On his path inland toward Mussum , he attempted to command and coerce Ilmatari who met him . Sir Guth confronted Waelarn at Thorlor ' s Well , a campsite northwest of Ankhwood near Sespech , and challenged him to " holy single combat under the watching eyes of our god . " Waelarn accepted , and promptly used a " cairn " spell to bury Guth . Calmly and cruelly , Waelarn then dug Guth out with a pick , and used an axe to chop off any limb that was revealed . Guth was soon killed and Waelarn left . But that was not the end . Ilmater , the One Who Endures , caused Sir Guth to rise from his grave , but not from the dead . Guth was reassembled as a zombie . Untiring and unrelenting and resisting all spell s hurled at him , Guth tracked Waelarn across Sespech until the rogue priest collapsed of exhaustion outside Elbulder .

title: Guthbert Golthammer
description: Guthbert Golthammer Guthbert Golthammer was the last Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from c . 1368 DR until the dale ' s liberation in 1369 DR . History .
description_long: Guthbert Golthammer Guthbert Golthammer was the last Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from c . 1368 DR until the dale ' s liberation in 1369 DR . History . Guthbert was an ox - brained warrior but a member of both the Zhentarim and the Zhentilar . He started as a military commander of Teshwave , winning his position through the influence of his father . Circa 1368 DR , Guthbert was appointed constable of Dagger Falls , because he fought the Freedom Riders of Randal Morn in Teshendale . In 1369 DR , he was involved in the kidnapping of Randal Morn himself under orders of the Zhent wizard Ilthond . In the end , the situation went bad for the Zhentarim and the Freedom Riders attacked the town , defeating the Zhent soldiers . Guthbert was likely killed in the fighting . Personality . Guthbert was an amiable fellow , fearless in battle but was very slow in thinking . Thus he usually had with him a more capable second - in - command , such as the Cyric ist cleric Asdag in Teshendale and the fighter Toren in Daggerdale .

title: Guts and Garters
description: Guts and Garters The Guts and Garters was an inn in Skullport . Geography . The inn was located off Illithid Way in the Lower Heart district of Skullport near the Feathered Rat , the Thrown Gauntlet , and the Bindle ' s Blade inn .
description_long: Guts and Garters The Guts and Garters was an inn in Skullport . Geography . The inn was located off Illithid Way in the Lower Heart district of Skullport near the Feathered Rat , the Thrown Gauntlet , and the Bindle ' s Blade inn . Interior .
