The Guts and Garters was an inn in fair condition , but the rooms were of poor quality . Services . For a few extra coins , the innkeeper would show patrons a secret passage to the alley near the Feathered Rat pet shop and provide a guard for added protection . History . Around 1370 DR , the inn was owned by Bolton Brimwell , who rented private rooms to those who had coin to spend .

title: Guul Shatterneck
description: Guul Shatterneck Guul Shatterneck was a bandit once active in northwest Faerûn . Guul and his kin were bandits . They used the magical spear s called " black kumades " to overwhelm their victims .
description_long: Guul Shatterneck Guul Shatterneck was a bandit once active in northwest Faerûn . Guul and his kin were bandits . They used the magical spear s called " black kumades " to overwhelm their victims . However , rather unwisely , they attacked members of the Gray Wolf Tribe and took them captive , not thinking to learn more about their victims first . Come the next full moon , the Gray Wolf escaped and tore their captors apart .

title: Guylian Stundter
description: Guylian Stundter Guylian Stundter was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Guylian regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned .
description_long: Guylian Stundter Guylian Stundter was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Guylian regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned . He was a charismatic being , always smiling . History . His partnership with Reyill was very good for Guylian ' s businesses during the years . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Guylian was drinking with his halfling s friends and Reyill at the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . Relationship . Guylian was friend of Narder Ulthub and Roge Applewink . He had good dealing with Reyill Werned .

title: Gwaeron Windstrom
description: Gwaeron Windstrom Gwaeron Windstrom ( pronounced " GWAIR - on WIND - strahm " ) is a neutral good demigod of rangers and tracking . History . Gwaeron roamed the North as a mortal ranger many centuries ago .
description_long: Gwaeron Windstrom Gwaeron Windstrom ( pronounced " GWAIR - on WIND - strahm " ) is a neutral good demigod of rangers and tracking . History . Gwaeron roamed the North as a mortal ranger many centuries ago . He was raised to demigod status by Mielikki after slaying an avatar and several manifestations of Malar in a short period of time . He has served the Lady of the Forests ever since . In the Time of Troubles , Gwaeron pursued Malar out of the North . He is said to sleep in a stand of trees just to the west of the town of Triboar , known as Gwaeron ' s Slumber . Relationships . Along with Lurue and Shiallia , the Master of Tracking serves Mielikki by teaching her rangers the way to read forest signs . He reports indirectly to Silvanus . He has forged alliances with the deities of the elven , gnome , and halfling pantheons whose portfolios most closely match those of Mielikki , Silvanus , and his own . He opposes Malar the Beastlord . Given that his following is so small and so similar to that of Mielikki , he may be accidentally subsumed as an aspect of the Forest Queen or fall prey to Malar if he is not careful . Worshipers . His followers were mainly rangers of the North .

title: Gwelt
description: Gwelt Gwelt was a very ambitious arcanist of Thultanthar . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume Tanthul and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul found that Gwelt was a highly dangerous individual who was plotting to kill all the Princes of Shade .
description_long: Gwelt Gwelt was a very ambitious arcanist of Thultanthar . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume Tanthul and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul found that Gwelt was a highly dangerous individual who was plotting to kill all the Princes of Shade . Later , Gwelt was summoned by the High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who wanted to know him . Happy with Gwelt ' s reactions , the Most High showed Gwelt that the Wards of Candlekeep were gone and ordered him to investigate . Later , Telamont announced to Aglarel Tanthul that Gwelt would become his herald . Thereafter , Gwelt led all the shadovar arcanists in working great " mythal " - draining magic . However , he abandoned the casting just before Larloch shattered the minds of all the collected arcanists . Gwelt went to Manarlume and Lelavdra to discuss how to survive the fighting . Later , among the ruins of the collapsed Thultanthar , the three laughed about the stupidity of the High Prince . Relationships . Gwelt was friends with fellow arcanist Relvrak , who was also his tutor for a time .

title: Gwen
description: Gwen Gwen was a willowy female soldier who traveled with Salen and Jensena . Description . Gwen was a short slender brunette .
description_long: Gwen Gwen was a willowy female soldier who traveled with Salen and Jensena . Description . Gwen was a short slender brunette . Personality . Slim and sexy , Gwen used her feminine wiles to trick and charm her opponents . Possessions . In battle , Gwen armed herself with a sword , a few dagger s , a throwing axe and dressed in chain mail . History . On the 19th of Flamerule , 1340 DR , Gwen drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn with her companions and tried to trick Ren o ' the Blade out of a bagful of coins . Death . On the night of the 28th of Flamerule 1340 DR , Gwen was killed while fighting a troll outside the city walls of Phlan .

title: Gwydion pen Dafwyd
description: Gwydion pen Dafwyd Gwydion pen Dafwyd was the court wizard of Daggerford . History . Once Gwydion was the court wizard of duke Pryden Daggerford but at 1370 DR the court magician was Bronwyn Daggerford in all save the name .
description_long: Gwydion pen Dafwyd Gwydion pen Dafwyd was the court wizard of Daggerford . History . Once Gwydion was the court wizard of duke Pryden Daggerford but at 1370 DR the court magician was Bronwyn Daggerford in all save the name . Gwydion so was free to did his studies in order to find a mean to live more . He had a magic book that show how achieve Lichdom but he not like much this system . Instead he had sent many adventuring parties in search of a good " potion of longevity " but with no results for now . Personality . Gwydion was a very indecisive individual , pondering months before coming to an easily swayed conclusion .

title: Gwynneth
description: Gwynneth Gwynneth was an island in the Moonshae Isles and was the largest of the southern islands . The island was called Sarifal , mainly by its fey inhabitants , and they controlled most of the island . Notable Locations .
description_long: Gwynneth Gwynneth was an island in the Moonshae Isles and was the largest of the southern islands . The island was called Sarifal , mainly by its fey inhabitants , and they controlled most of the island . Notable Locations . Caer Corwell . The former seat of House Kendrick , Caer Corwell was just a ruin by 1479 DR . Citadel Umbra . A castle in the middle of Winterglen that sat at an intersection of Faerûn , the Feywild and the Shadowfell . The castle was home to many dark fey and was ruled by Urphania , a hag who was banished from the Feywild by High Lady Ordalf . Karador . A magical city in the middle of Lake Myrloch that was home to 3 , 000 fey . The city contained a mythal that was capable of transporting the city to the Feywild . Myrloch Vale . A valley that occupied the central part of the island . Sacred Grove of the Earthmother . A druid grove on the eastern shore of Lake Myrloch which contained a Moon Well . Winterglen . A dense forest in the northern part of Gwynneth . Forces loyal to High Lady Ordalf fought dark fey forces for control over the forest .

title: Gwynneth ( person )
description: Gwynneth ( person ) Gwynneth was the second daughter of the Archduke of Ebenfar , Markus Randol . " Circa " 140 DR , she led refugees across the Sea of Swords to the Moonshae Isles , where they established the first human settlement there . She died a year later of consumption .
description_long: Gwynneth ( person ) Gwynneth was the second daughter of the Archduke of Ebenfar , Markus Randol . " Circa " 140 DR , she led refugees across the Sea of Swords to the Moonshae Isles , where they established the first human settlement there . She died a year later of consumption .

title: Gyawa Zangpo
description: Gyawa Zangpo Gyawa Zangpo was a me - zu oni who lived in Takshang on the slopes of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Personality . Like many oni , Gyawa had a short temper , flying into fits of rage at the slightest provocation .
description_long: Gyawa Zangpo Gyawa Zangpo was a me - zu oni who lived in Takshang on the slopes of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Personality . Like many oni , Gyawa had a short temper , flying into fits of rage at the slightest provocation . His odd behavior caused many rumors about him , such as a claim that he had a vast treasure of stolen items hidden in a secret room of his hermitage . Activities . Gyawa served out his sentence on Toril at Takshang . Freedom would only be granted when he carried the bundles of 10 , 000 travelers to the top of the mountain pass . Eager for freedom , Gyawa asked every traveler if he could help them . His hot temper usually scared the travelers away before he could help .

title: Gynosphinx
description: Gynosphinx A gynosphinx was a female sphinx . While not as physically powerful as an androsphinx , the gynosphinx was still a capable combatant and possessed a number of magical powers . The gynosphinx was the sole female sphinx subrace .
description_long: Gynosphinx A gynosphinx was a female sphinx . While not as physically powerful as an androsphinx , the gynosphinx was still a capable combatant and possessed a number of magical powers . The gynosphinx was the sole female sphinx subrace . Gynosphinxes preferred to pursue intellectual ideals . They loved to collect knowledge and ancient lore and delighted in solving riddles , puzzles , and mental challenges . Gynosphinxes were favored by the dwarven deities Dugmaren Brightmantle and Vergadain and the Mulhorandi goddess Isis , who would often send them as messengers to their faithful .

title: Gyrlond
description: Gyrlond Gyrlond was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , the Gyrlonds concerned themselves with methods of farming capable of producing riches relatively quickly .
description_long: Gyrlond Gyrlond was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , the Gyrlonds concerned themselves with methods of farming capable of producing riches relatively quickly . In that same year they held a country estate called Gyrlondposts , situated to the east of Stonewatch .

title: Gythka
description: Gythka A gythka was a type of exotic weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . It was a long , two - handed polearm with a crescent - shaped blade mounted on each end . These dealt deep slashing wounds .
description_long: Gythka A gythka was a type of exotic weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . It was a long , two - handed polearm with a crescent - shaped blade mounted on each end . These dealt deep slashing wounds . A highly trained warrior could fight with both ends at once . It could also be hurled as a spear . It was much more familiar to the thri - kreen , who , with four arms , could wield two gythkas simultaneously . Collectors would buy these weapons if they were in good condition .

title: Gyudd
description: Gyudd Gyudd was a master brewer in Skullport . Personality . Gyudd had been haunted by the Melairkyn ghosts in his dreams for most of his life .
description_long: Gyudd Gyudd was a master brewer in Skullport . Personality . Gyudd had been haunted by the Melairkyn ghosts in his dreams for most of his life . Shaken and overwhelmed by the responsibility , he started to drink heavily , and this quieted the ghosts . Activities . Gyudd ran Gyudd ' s Distillery . In his free time , he was always in a bar drinking . Relationship . Guydd was the last member of the Melairkyn dwarves and a direct descendant of King Melair IV . History . Gyudd arrived in Skullport " circa " 1310 DR and soon started his brewery and distillery . However , some time after the Melairkyn ghost s started to appear , Gyudd tried to silence them by becoming more and more drunk .

title: H ' Catha
description: H ' Catha H ' Catha was one of the planets in Toril ' s solar system , also known as Realmspace . It appeared as an emerald green star in Toril ' s sky . The last of Toril ' s Five Wanderers , H ' Catha , appeared as a crystalline glimmer of white .
description_long: H ' Catha H ' Catha was one of the planets in Toril ' s solar system , also known as Realmspace . It appeared as an emerald green star in Toril ' s sky . The last of Toril ' s Five Wanderers , H ' Catha , appeared as a crystalline glimmer of white . Consisting of a flat disc of 300 - mile thick water with a single mountain in the center , close - up , this world looked like a giant wagon wheel , with the Spindle ( the mountain ) always pointing directly at the sun . Near the base of the mountain , six ports , each owned by a different type of beholder accepted spelljamming traffic from other beholders , ( not ones who lived on H ' Catha , as that would provoke a war , ) and a mysterious humanoid race . Other species were only allowed to land if they had goods to trade and left as soon as they were done . The world was orbited by two satellites , Turnbetl and Lumbe .

title: H ' hoort
description: H ' hoort H ' hoort was a troglodyte consort during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' hoort was the mate of chieftain S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area .
description_long: H ' hoort H ' hoort was a troglodyte consort during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' hoort was the mate of chieftain S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area . During the Rage of Demons , S ' slaar had a disagreement with his war chief H ' slaat about the ownership of a magic sword . Soon a civil war started between S ' slaar ' s and H ' slaat ' s loyalists . H ' slaat ordered to warriors to capture H ' hoort , hoping to bargain her for the sword .

title: H ' slaat
description: H ' slaat H ' slaat was a troglodyte warrior during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' slaat was the war chief and champion of Laogzed in the tribe led by S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area .
description_long: H ' slaat H ' slaat was a troglodyte warrior during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' slaat was the war chief and champion of Laogzed in the tribe led by S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area . During the Rage of Demons , he led a group of his warriors to defeated a drow patrol . The drow leader had a magic sword that was claimed as a trophy by chieftain S ' slaar . H ' slaat disagreed , saying that it was his by right of killing its owner . Soon a civil war started between S ' slaar ' s and H ' slaat ' s loyalists . H ' slaat ordered the capture of H ' hoort , the mate of S ' slaar . Without interruption in the last battle he killed in the fighting S ' slaar and become the next chieftain

title: Haakon Erlich
description: Haakon Erlich Haakon Erlich was a corrupt officer of the Red Plumes in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , he was approached by the sorcerer Breex Vandermast with an idea to become rich : kidnap non - human farmers from around the city and sell them to the Hillsfar Arena .
description_long: Haakon Erlich Haakon Erlich was a corrupt officer of the Red Plumes in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , he was approached by the sorcerer Breex Vandermast with an idea to become rich : kidnap non - human farmers from around the city and sell them to the Hillsfar Arena . Haakon agreed and they captured many people , included the halfling Tinfellow family and the drow Arrizz . At last , Breex and corrupt Red Plumes tried to capture an adventuring party hired by the Harpers to find the kidnapped people . Haakon joined the fight but was defeated by the adventurers . Personality . Haakon was a coward who hid his true nature with a show of violence . He was afraid of Breex and his men knew this .

title: Haask , Voice of Hargut
description: Haask , Voice of Hargut Haask , Voice of Hargut is said to be one of the Seven Lost Gods who bowed before Bane long ago . History . Haask , a monstrous greathorn minotaur , conquered Ironfang Keep in - 981 DR , declaring himself priest - king of the land of Grong - Haap .
description_long: Haask , Voice of Hargut Haask , Voice of Hargut is said to be one of the Seven Lost Gods who bowed before Bane long ago . History . Haask , a monstrous greathorn minotaur , conquered Ironfang Keep in - 981 DR , declaring himself priest - king of the land of Grong - Haap . He ruled Grong - Haap for six hundred years , expanding it to include the modern lands of Thar , the eastern Moonsea , and northern highlands of the Vast . In the Year of Craven Words ( - 350 DR ) , Haask summoned an elder evil to combat a goblinoid horde : Hargut of the Gray Pestilence . Hargut slew tens of thousands , consigning their souls to the Barrens of Doom and Despair , but three humans , the mortals who would become known as Bane , Myrkul , and Bhaal , took advantage of the distraction to attack and nearly slay Haask , revealing his true form as a doppelganger of the elder batrachi race . As Haask lay dying , the Dead Three persuaded him to agree to a ritual that would bind him and Hargut together as one entity under the command of the three adventurers .

title: Haayon
description: Haayon Haayon the Punisher was a cloud giant member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haayon was called along with his fellow cultists to the Dessarin Valley .
description_long: Haayon Haayon the Punisher was a cloud giant member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haayon was called along with his fellow cultists to the Dessarin Valley . Arriving late , he saw the cult in disarray after a serious defeat at the hands of adventurers in Tyar - Besil . He gathered around him as many roaming cultists as possible in order to reconstruct the cult with himself as its new leader . However , Haayon was defeated in turn by some adventurers .

title: Hada Forgebreath
description: Hada Forgebreath Hada Forgebreath was a dwarf smith in Mulmaster . Activities . Hada was a metalsmith of some renown and one of the few dwarves in Mulmaster .
description_long: Hada Forgebreath Hada Forgebreath was a dwarf smith in Mulmaster . Activities . Hada was a metalsmith of some renown and one of the few dwarves in Mulmaster . Relationship . In the past , Hada had some dealings with Furgis Boltsmelter , and knew of the power of his mind - reading amulet , " Aramesha ' s Wisdom " . History . Around 1491 DR , Nada directed Furgis and his adventurer bodyguards to Oster Ironhand at Oster ' s Stables after being pursued by Cult of the Crushing Wave cultists .

title: Hadar
description: Hadar Hadar , also known as the Dark Hunger , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Hadar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .
description_long: Hadar Hadar , also known as the Dark Hunger , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Hadar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description . Hadar was a cinder - red star , barely visible in the night sky . History . Hadar and the other Far Realm - infested stars of Realmspace were somehow related to the Eldest . Hadar was a dying star , slowly burning into annihilation . Because of that it sent its agents , the Heralds of Hadar , to Toril to feed on living creatures in a desperate attempt to avert its demise . Hadar was usually sought out by some warlock s to make a pact with it . To those few Hadar bestowed the ability to use the " arms of Hadar " spell and the more powerful " hunger of Hadar " spell .

title: Hadarr Karayaka
description: Hadarr Karayaka Hadarr Karayaka was a Calishite explorer in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . Personality . Hadarr was an impulsive individual .
description_long: Hadarr Karayaka Hadarr Karayaka was a Calishite explorer in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . Personality . Hadarr was an impulsive individual . Although he liked company , he thought that he worked better alone for his own interests . In truth , he had a heart of gold , always helping others without thinking about it , and for this he was a good friend of Sir Isteval . Possessions . In battle , Hadarr wears dragon skin leather armor and fights with twin silver scimitar s . History . Hadarr went adventuring with Sir Isteval and Jekk Ironfist circa 1476 DR but often abandoned the company if he found something more interesting for him along the way . In Daggerford , he was a folk hero for the Calishite community taking refuge there , as he helped in all ways possible , even thieving from rich people .

title: Haddenbils
description: Haddenbils The Haddenbils brothers of Deepingdale are known for being the first to use dams to solve the local irrigation problems and provide water for their oat fields . The dams were made from giant granite blocks and sealed with clay and giant spider s ' webs . The brothers gained the use of a spade of colossal excavation which they borrowed from a warrior whose identity is not known .
description_long: Haddenbils The Haddenbils brothers of Deepingdale are known for being the first to use dams to solve the local irrigation problems and provide water for their oat fields . The dams were made from giant granite blocks and sealed with clay and giant spider s ' webs . The brothers gained the use of a spade of colossal excavation which they borrowed from a warrior whose identity is not known .

title: Haden Stonehand
description: Haden Stonehand Haden Stonehand was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Haden Stonehand was a hardy soul who made a home in the harsh Serpent Valley . The commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest , came to challenge Haden in a contest of bloodforge warfare .
description_long: Haden Stonehand Haden Stonehand was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Haden Stonehand was a hardy soul who made a home in the harsh Serpent Valley . The commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest , came to challenge Haden in a contest of bloodforge warfare .

title: Hadencourt
description: Hadencourt Hadencourt was a malebranche devil in the service of Szass Tam . Tam sent him to Neverwinter to kill Tam ' s traitorous minion Dahlia Sin ' felle . Dahlia traveled with Drizzt Do ' Urden .
description_long: Hadencourt Hadencourt was a malebranche devil in the service of Szass Tam . Tam sent him to Neverwinter to kill Tam ' s traitorous minion Dahlia Sin ' felle . Dahlia traveled with Drizzt Do ' Urden . In disguise , Hadencourt approached Dahlia and soon the elves were ambushed by many war devils . However , the pair managed to slay all of the devils and Drizzt summoned his magical unicorn Andahar , who impaled Hadencourt . Being banished to his home plane , Hadencourt promised infinite torments to Drizzt at the end of his exile but Drizzt told him to get in line behind Errtu .

title: Hades
description: Hades Hades , also known as the Gray Waste , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model , home of the daemon s . Located at the midpoint of the Lower Planes , it was a plane of evil balanced between Law and Chaos . Description .
description_long: Hades Hades , also known as the Gray Waste , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model , home of the daemon s . Located at the midpoint of the Lower Planes , it was a plane of evil balanced between Law and Chaos . Description . The three layers of Hades were called " glooms " for good reason ; they were realms devoid of emotion , hope , and peace . Gray land and gray sky throughout , with no sun , moon or seasons to break the monotony . Any color other than shades of gray would be obvious against the background but would fade to gray in a week or two . And like bright colors , beings would begin to fade also . At first they would feel the drain of emotions leaving only sadness , ennui , and defeatism . In a tenday or two they would be trapped in Hades and their existence would begin to fade until finally they became larvae . Hades was a unique plane , as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model , because it not only joined to adjacent planes in the Great Wheel , it also held the foundation of Mount Olympus and the roots of Yggdrasil the World Ash .

title: Hadley Erridge
description: Hadley Erridge Hadley Erridge was a human explorer living in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the late 1340s DR , Hadley Erridge was a neighbor of the prosperous and enterprising farmer Del Geery .
description_long: Hadley Erridge Hadley Erridge was a human explorer living in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the late 1340s DR , Hadley Erridge was a neighbor of the prosperous and enterprising farmer Del Geery . Geery had increased the yields of his crops , but they then attracted hordes of rabbit s , which were followed by badger s , wolves and other predators . Unable to curb their numbers , Geery consulted Erridge , who proposed that Geery get a hydra . A hydra , Erridge claimed , would devour or scare off the pests then depart when there was no more prey . The damage to the farm would be more than outweighed by the benefits of getting rid of the burgeoning pest population , Erridge thought . Despite his skepticism , Geery agreed to finance Erridge with 20 , 000 gold piece s for an expedition into the Vast Swamp to capture a live hydra . Erridge and his thirty - man expedition ventured into the feared swamp , and after two months they successfully caught an adult hydra in a cage of iron . Geery based himself in a local cave while Erridge released the hydra . It rampaged about the farm , scaring away all the animals within a few days .

title: Hadra bint Aswiyah
description: Hadra bint Aswiyah Hadra bint Aswiyah was a princess of of Muluk in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the royal heir of Muluk , Hadra was an accomplished sha ' ir who held the rank of Sorcerer - General in Muluk ' s army .
description_long: Hadra bint Aswiyah Hadra bint Aswiyah was a princess of of Muluk in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the royal heir of Muluk , Hadra was an accomplished sha ' ir who held the rank of Sorcerer - General in Muluk ' s army . She led successful attacks against both Umara and Qadib during her time in the army . Relationships . Hadra was the only daughter of Muluk ' s Caliph , Aswiyah al - Muftahir .

title: Hadrhune
description: Hadrhune Hadrhune was an ambitious elven shade who served as the right hand of High Prince Telamont Tanthul , ruler of Thultanthar . Hadrhune fought his way through the ranks of his peers , proving himself to be a capable manipulator as well as a determined and talented mage . With his skills ( and the elimination of his rivals ) , he soon became Telamont ' s top agent and personal emissary .
description_long: Hadrhune Hadrhune was an ambitious elven shade who served as the right hand of High Prince Telamont Tanthul , ruler of Thultanthar . Hadrhune fought his way through the ranks of his peers , proving himself to be a capable manipulator as well as a determined and talented mage . With his skills ( and the elimination of his rivals ) , he soon became Telamont ' s top agent and personal emissary . Using divination spells , he became probably the most knowledgeable shade in the entire city on matters of the world outside of Anauroch , taking particular interest in the realm of Thay and the dungeon of Undermountain . Using resources diverted from the city , his agents scour the ruins he takes interest in , looking for lost Netherese magic . It was also he who suggested the destruction of any settlements near the enclave , seeing that modern - day adventurers could pose a serious threat to his peoples ' plans of world domination . In 1375 DR , Hadrhune plotted with the leader of a hive of hated phaerimm to obtain a set of the " Nether Scrolls " . In exchange for their aid , he taught them the secrets of the Shadow Weave .

title: Hadrogh Prohl
description: Hadrogh Prohl Hadrogh Prohl was an elderly cane - wielding half - drow merchant of Mantol - Derith dealing in slaves . History . Hadrogh was approached by Xandra Shobalar to purchase prey for the Blooding .
description_long: Hadrogh Prohl Hadrogh Prohl was an elderly cane - wielding half - drow merchant of Mantol - Derith dealing in slaves . History . Hadrogh was approached by Xandra Shobalar to purchase prey for the Blooding . Physical description . Hadrogh had white hair and a weathered face and wore a patch over his left eye . Equipment . He carried a wooden cane ornamented with gem s and gilding , and wore a silk tunic and an embroidered cape with a diamond neck clasp .

title: Haedrak I
description: Haedrak I King Haedrak I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the fourth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Haedrak was a first cousin to Kortal , the previous king .
description_long: Haedrak I King Haedrak I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the fourth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Haedrak was a first cousin to Kortal , the previous king . He had at least five sons . History . Haedrak was born in 988 DR , took the throne from his cousin upon the latter ' s death in 1022 DR , and passed the throne to this fifth son Coram on his own death in 1059 DR .

title: Haedrak II
description: Haedrak II King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , was the twelfth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was considered one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Relationships .
description_long: Haedrak II King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , was the twelfth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was considered one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Relationships . Haedrak was the third son of King Coram IV and the half - nephew of King Kymer . He had at least four sons , including Prince Errilam and Toram , and at least four daughters , including Princesses Kessynna , Cyralna , Chynnil , and Pyriiss . He was the grandfather of future king Alemander III . Possessions . The " Sword of Starlight " was Haedrak ' s blade . It was commissioned by his father King Coram and forged for him in 1215 DR . It remained one of two Swords of State for Tethyr . History . Haedrak II was born in the Year of the Baldric , 1199 DR . He grew up to be a seaman and controlled three ships . In 1218 DR , while Prince Haedrak was on a trade mission to Zakhara , his father the king was murdered by his half - uncle Kymer , who became known as the Shade King . Haedrak knew that he did not have the strength at first to depose his wicked uncle , so he instead relied on piracy to weaken Kymer ' s forces , thus gaining the nickname of " Corsair Prince " .

title: Haedrak Rhindaun III
description: Haedrak Rhindaun III His Royal Highness , King Haedrak Errilam Alemander Olosar Lhorik Rhindaun III was the husband of Queen Zaranda of Tethyr and as such was the Monarch ' s Consort . He was also the Duke - Protector of the Crown Lands and Crown Regent for the heir to the throne . He was the first king of the Rhindaun Dynasty .
description_long: Haedrak Rhindaun III His Royal Highness , King Haedrak Errilam Alemander Olosar Lhorik Rhindaun III was the husband of Queen Zaranda of Tethyr and as such was the Monarch ' s Consort . He was also the Duke - Protector of the Crown Lands and Crown Regent for the heir to the throne . He was the first king of the Rhindaun Dynasty . Under the name Lhaeo , Haedrak had been Elminster ' s scribe , yet in 1368 DR he was informed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun that he was also the last living prince of Tethyr . With the help of Zaranda Star , his future wife , he reclaimed that nation in the name of the monarchy and became King Haedrak III a year later . Description . Haedrak was tall , had dark brown hair , and sported a finely trimmed goatee . He had green eyes . Due to a blessing from Siamorphe , in 1370 DR , while in his mid - to late - 30s , he appeared fifteen years younger . During his time as the apprentice Lhaeo , Haedrak intentionally never sat or stood up straight and maintained an effeminate demeanor . He spoke in a lisp in a high voice , but all of this was a facade . Personaility .

title: Haedraline
description: Haedraline Haedraline was a sarrukh who was made a Word Slave bound to the Words of Power . History . The Hero of Neverwinter first met her while searching for the Words of Power , and she offered help in finding them and eventually defeating Morag .
description_long: Haedraline Haedraline was a sarrukh who was made a Word Slave bound to the Words of Power . History . The Hero of Neverwinter first met her while searching for the Words of Power , and she offered help in finding them and eventually defeating Morag . Her help was dubious , however , offering only warnings about Morag and Maugrim , and insisting the Words of Power be found . She offered to tell the heroes about the history of the Creator Races and the Words : the North of Faerûn was once a tropical jungle , ideal for the cold - blooded sarrukh , but as it began to cool the ruler of the sarrukh made the Source Stone and the Words of Power , magical artifacts capable of warming the entire planet . Haedraline explained that the Source Stone , buried beneath Neverwinter in its dormant state , was why the city never experienced harsh winters . Haedraline later presented herself to the rulers of Neverwinter , who imprisoned her , thinking she was aligned with the other members of the sarrukh . She alerted the city to the presence and location of the Source Stone , and told the heroes how to access it to defeat Morag .

title: Hael Darandar
description: Hael Darandar Hael Darandar was a human from Skelkor , Returned Abeir , and the main diplomat of that empire as of 1479 DR . Background . As of 1479 DR , the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal had tasked Darandar to improve the diplomatic and commercial relationships of Skelkor with the other countries of Returned Abeir .
description_long: Hael Darandar Hael Darandar was a human from Skelkor , Returned Abeir , and the main diplomat of that empire as of 1479 DR . Background . As of 1479 DR , the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal had tasked Darandar to improve the diplomatic and commercial relationships of Skelkor with the other countries of Returned Abeir . However , most people didn ' t trust Darandar because of the reputation of the dragon empire .

title: Haela Brightaxe
description: Haela Brightaxe Haela Brightaxe ( " hay " - la " brite " - axe ) , also called the Lady of the Fray or the Luckmaiden , was a dwarven demigod of battle and luck . Overview . Haela Brightaxe was one in spirit with good - aligned dwarves who loved battle and who lived to cleanse Toril of evil monsters .
description_long: Haela Brightaxe Haela Brightaxe ( " hay " - la " brite " - axe ) , also called the Lady of the Fray or the Luckmaiden , was a dwarven demigod of battle and luck . Overview . Haela Brightaxe was one in spirit with good - aligned dwarves who loved battle and who lived to cleanse Toril of evil monsters . Haelan clerics fought monsters whenever they could find them , either to destroy the evil beast , or just for the thrill of battle . Haela , as she was a goddess of luck , took great risks in the battles she fought . Followers . Haela ' s cleric s were called " kaxanar " , which could be translated as " bloodmaidens " . Most of her clergy were females , but the few men who served her didn ' t seem to have a problem with the feminine title . Kaxanar cared little for the rules of dwarven society and built their temples wherever conflict was to be found . Temples were regularly built in the cellars of human ruins , abandoned dwarf holds , or even empty gnome warrens . Most temples also served as armories , and all were trapped with at least one very violent bombastic trap so that no temple could fall into enemy hands .

title: Haeleeya Hanadroum
description: Haeleeya Hanadroum Haeleeya Hanadroum was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and an Emerald Enclave supporter during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Relationship . Since they saved her life , Haeleeya always supported the Enclave , and she shared with them whatever interesting secret talk she heard in the bathhouse .
description_long: Haeleeya Hanadroum Haeleeya Hanadroum was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and an Emerald Enclave supporter during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Relationship . Since they saved her life , Haeleeya always supported the Enclave , and she shared with them whatever interesting secret talk she heard in the bathhouse . Activities . Haeleeya managed the village bathhouse in Red Larch . History . In her youth , Haeleeya became lost in the wilderness but was saved by an Emerald Enclave ranger . She later moved from Amn to Red Larch .

title: Haeler Thommadur
description: Haeler Thommadur Haeler Thommadur was a warrior during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haeler organized a caravan under the orders of Ascaleld Marurryn , who acted as negotiator for the Sembia n Rolling Wheel .
description_long: Haeler Thommadur Haeler Thommadur was a warrior during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haeler organized a caravan under the orders of Ascaleld Marurryn , who acted as negotiator for the Sembia n Rolling Wheel . In truth , Haeler wanted to use the caravan as bait for some bandits operating in the area . With the help of some adventurers , Haeler and his men managed to clear the area .

title: Haelimbrar
description: Haelimbrar Haelimbrar was a Triadic knight and one of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR . Activities . Haelimbrar was one of the Council of Lords , based in Laviguer .
description_long: Haelimbrar Haelimbrar was a Triadic knight and one of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR . Activities . Haelimbrar was one of the Council of Lords , based in Laviguer . He was charged with securing the northern and western borders of the realm , but was often away on secret missions . History . In 1359 DR he disguised had joined the Twilight Riders of Damara in order to spy Gareth Dragonsbane . Haelimbrar performed a series of other missions in disguise for the Lords . In 1374 DR , he was disguised as the lost Imphras V , and posed as a squire at the court of Gareth Dragonsbane in Damara . After the crowning of King Imbrar II Haelimbrar alongside Simgar was one of the few battle - hardened veteran of the kingdom , caring little for diplomacy and power and focusing in training the Warsword of Impiltur .

title: Haelond
description: Haelond Haelond was an abandoned mining outpost located in the Elkannath Mountains , in Gontal . History . Haelond was a mining outpost run by the Elkannath family of the Twelvefold .
description_long: Haelond Haelond was an abandoned mining outpost located in the Elkannath Mountains , in Gontal . History . Haelond was a mining outpost run by the Elkannath family of the Twelvefold . In 1469 DR , Haelond was abandoned when it was overrun by mysterious monsters that swarmed out from the Underdark .

title: Haemir Waelvor
description: Haemir Waelvor Haemir Waelvor was a male elf wizard who was a prominent member of the Waelvor House of Cormanthyr . History . Haemir was part of the Waelvor House , one of the old families fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim .
description_long: Haemir Waelvor Haemir Waelvor was a male elf wizard who was a prominent member of the Waelvor House of Cormanthyr . History . Haemir was part of the Waelvor House , one of the old families fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim . Haemir took an aggressive stance and , with the support of some members of Starym House , tried to kill the just - appointed Mythanthar , the architect of the indispensable " mythal " , in 241 DR . Thanks to a ghostly Elminster Aumar , Haemir and his fellow conspirators were all killed .

title: Haer ' Dalis
description: Haer ' Dalis Haer ' Dalis is a tiefling actor and planewalker , and a member of the planar faction known as the Doomguard . He doesn ' t live anywhere permanently , but most frequently returns to Sigil . He belonged to Raelis Shai ' s theatre troupe at one point , and at least at that time , in 1369 DR , stayed on Toril for some time .
description_long: Haer ' Dalis Haer ' Dalis is a tiefling actor and planewalker , and a member of the planar faction known as the Doomguard . He doesn ' t live anywhere permanently , but most frequently returns to Sigil . He belonged to Raelis Shai ' s theatre troupe at one point , and at least at that time , in 1369 DR , stayed on Toril for some time . Haer ' Dalis is one of the party NPC s in the game and its expansion , and one of the more difficult ones to find in the first . The player ' s party can accept the task to find him from Raelis Shai after witnessing the awful performance Biff the Understudy gives in his place in her play . The quest involves going down into the sewers of Athkatla and from there entering the abode of a wizard holding Haer ' Dalis captive . He will be found within under magical compulsion , which is lifted once the wizard is dead . The player will also be required to acquire from the wizard ' s hiding place an item capable of opening dimensional conduits ; Raelis Shai first claims it was stolen from her by the wizard , but it turns out that it belonged to him and Haer ' Dalis was captured while trying to steal it .

title: Haerinvureem
description: Haerinvureem Shimmergloom is the nickname of Haerinvureem . He was a shadow dragon who arose from the depths of the Underdark after the Battlehammer dwarves of Mithral Hall delved too deep in their mithral mines . History .
description_long: Haerinvureem Shimmergloom is the nickname of Haerinvureem . He was a shadow dragon who arose from the depths of the Underdark after the Battlehammer dwarves of Mithral Hall delved too deep in their mithral mines . History . Haerinvureem was the last survivor of the Jaezred Clan of Shadow dragon s , who conquered the drow city Chaulssin in - 221 DR . After centuries of reigning and enslaving , the dragons were overthrown by their own offspring and most were killed in 634 DR . Only Haerinvureem managed to flee . Shimmergloom in Mithral Hall . In the 1100 ' s DR , Shimmergloom drove the dwarves of Mithral Hall from their ancestral home , forcing them to resettle in the Icewind Dale region , and supplanted them with his Duergar servants . Shimmergloom reigned over the hall for roughly one dwarven generation until 1356 DR when Bruenor Battlehammer , the rightful heir to the throne of Mithral Hall , returned to the hall in his adulthood in order to reclaim it .

title: Haerldoun
description: Haerldoun Haerldoun , also called " Hawkmaster " , was a human man and a professional mercenary and adventurer . He was once the owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . History .
description_long: Haerldoun Haerldoun , also called " Hawkmaster " , was a human man and a professional mercenary and adventurer . He was once the owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . History . Haerldoun was a professional mercenary warrior , and became a veteran of many battles . He was also a member of a chartered adventuring company . In Wheloon in Cormyr , the company bought a store ( formerly a haven for smugglers ) as a sideline investment , which Haerldoun developed as a business importing helms and shields . It was called Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields . His niece , Albhaera Haerldoun , managed it under his supervision . Haerldoun was in Daggerdale battling orc s , bugbear s , and trolls that were in service to the Zhentilar when he suffered a serious injury . He returned to Wheloon and rented a house not far from Helms and Shields , where he recuperated and watched over the business in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR . There he was available to train other warriors . Albhaera later took over from Haerldoun as proprietor of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields by 1369 DR . Abilities . Haerldoun was a veteran warrior .

title: Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields
description: Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields was a shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , near the center of the city . It sold armor , shields , and some weapons . History .
description_long: Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields was a shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , near the center of the city . It sold armor , shields , and some weapons . History . The store was formerly a haven for smugglers , but was later bought by an adventuring band as a sideline investment . One of the adventurers , a mercenary named Haerldoun developed it a business importing helms and shields , while his niece , Albhaera Haerldoun , managed it under his supervision in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR . Albhaera later became an adventurer herself , joining her uncle ' s adventuring band . After that band was utterly destroyed by a beholder and Albhaera fled in terror , she retired from the adventuring life and returned to the business . Becoming its proprietor , she expanded its trade and enjoyed great success by 1369 DR . It was still in operation in 1374 DR . Description . Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields lay by a wharf on the western bank of the Wyvernflow river . It consisted of a shop with a small smithy out back . Services .

title: Haeromos Dothwintyl
description: Haeromos Dothwintyl Haeromos Dothwintyl was the ruler of Port Llast . Description . A retired stonemason , Haeromos carried himself in a proud manner and wore the finest clothing , armor , and weaponry money could buy .
description_long: Haeromos Dothwintyl Haeromos Dothwintyl was the ruler of Port Llast . Description . A retired stonemason , Haeromos carried himself in a proud manner and wore the finest clothing , armor , and weaponry money could buy . The source of this wealth came from the taxes of the people of Port Llast . Possessions . The First Captain wielded a " longsword + 3 " enspelled so it could send a message to the wizard , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun when Haeromos was in danger or the village was attacked . Appendix . Discrepancy . The " " sourcebook stats Haeromos as being a fighter of 0th level while " Volo ' s Guide to the North " states he is 3rd level .

title: Haeshkarr
description: Haeshkarr Haeshkarr was a demon , more than twenty - thousand years ago . Biography . He was a servant of the demon Lolth , who was at that time still a Tanar ' ri and ruled only the Demonweb Pits in the abyss .
description_long: Haeshkarr Haeshkarr was a demon , more than twenty - thousand years ago . Biography . He was a servant of the demon Lolth , who was at that time still a Tanar ' ri and ruled only the Demonweb Pits in the abyss . But Haeshkarr followed some plans for his own and led an orc horde to conquer elven realms on Faerûn in - 24400 DR . They destroyed the city Occidian and with that many elven high mage s of other cities too . Then they tried to capture the city Sharlarion but met strong resistance by the inhabitants there . The cities defensive army was led by the moon elf Kethryllia Amarillis , who wielded the magical sword Dhashara . They defeated the army of orcs at great costs and finally the priest Anarallath banished the demon Haeshkarr . But the demon reached out for him and took the elf with him to the Demonweb Pits . Kethryllia , who was the lover of Anarallath , followed both through the magical portal . She fought the minions of Heashkarr and tried to find him in the unknown territory . Instead of the demon she found the goddess Kiaransalee , who was intrigued by her wish for revenge .

title: Hafayah
description: Hafayah The Free City of Hafayah , located along Al - Kufr River , was characterized by the dark colors of its buildings and the dress of its citizens , who were somber , secretive and suspicious toward strangers . Politically the City of Secrets suffered from the underhanded dealings following the poisoning of the former sultan and most of his family in 1364 DR .
description_long: Hafayah The Free City of Hafayah , located along Al - Kufr River , was characterized by the dark colors of its buildings and the dress of its citizens , who were somber , secretive and suspicious toward strangers . Politically the City of Secrets suffered from the underhanded dealings following the poisoning of the former sultan and most of his family in 1364 DR .

title: Haffa
description: Haffa Haffa was a half - ogre businessman in Skullport . Personality . Haffa was a clever , intuitive , and soft - spoken individual .
description_long: Haffa Haffa was a half - ogre businessman in Skullport . Personality . Haffa was a clever , intuitive , and soft - spoken individual . He was also charismatic with other humanoid s . Haffa did not tolerate laziness : he paid well and his employers had to be efficient their work . His main code was the " bottom line " : nobody under him could cross that line or they would face brutal consequences . Activities . Haffa managed Haffa ' s Flatbacks , a company that supplied porters and delivery service , mostly goblin s or similar creatures .

title: Hafiz al - Milhab
description: Hafiz al - Milhab Hafiz al - Milhab was an efreeti overseer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Hafiz was the overseer of a mine in the Elemental Plane of Fire , where efreet put enslaved azer s to work .
description_long: Hafiz al - Milhab Hafiz al - Milhab was an efreeti overseer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Hafiz was the overseer of a mine in the Elemental Plane of Fire , where efreet put enslaved azer s to work . In 1373 DR , his mine was attacked by Kaanyr Vhok and his allies , who had forged an agreement with azer leaders . Hafiz was killed by Kaanyr despite his promise of a better agreement . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Hafiz bin Watat
description: Hafiz bin Watat Hafiz bin Watat was a dwarven wizard living in the area east of the Nashkel mine . He was also a seer and an astrologer , and when he met Gorion ' s Ward he said that they had met previously in dreams . He also gave some cryptic advice about a future menace .
description_long: Hafiz bin Watat Hafiz bin Watat was a dwarven wizard living in the area east of the Nashkel mine . He was also a seer and an astrologer , and when he met Gorion ' s Ward he said that they had met previously in dreams . He also gave some cryptic advice about a future menace .

title: Hag Countess
description: Hag Countess The Hag Countess was a night hag and once the Lord of the Sixth of the Nine Hells . Personality . As a night hag rather than a devil , she enjoyed no support from any other Lord of the Nine .
description_long: Hag Countess The Hag Countess was a night hag and once the Lord of the Sixth of the Nine Hells . Personality . As a night hag rather than a devil , she enjoyed no support from any other Lord of the Nine . History . Originally a night hag from Hades , the Hag Countess became one of the chief advisers of Moloch , the former Lord of the Sixth . She counseled him to rebel against Asmodeus during the Reckoning of Hell , and when Moloch was overthrown , Asmodeus installed her in his place . However , Asmodeus had only promoted the Hag Countess so that the other Lords of the Nine would not notice his designs . He installed his daughter Glasya as the new Lord of the Sixth and caused the Hag Countess ' body to grow to gargantuan size and rupture , turning the formerly mountainous Malbolge into a realm of decaying flesh .

title: Hagar Hlutwigsson
description: Hagar Hlutwigsson Hagar Hlutwigsson was a hagspawn in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Hagar was the son of Hlutwig Long - throw , last chieftain of the Blue Bear Tribe , and the annis Tanta Hagara , at that time shaman of the tribe .
description_long: Hagar Hlutwigsson Hagar Hlutwigsson was a hagspawn in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Hagar was the son of Hlutwig Long - throw , last chieftain of the Blue Bear Tribe , and the annis Tanta Hagara , at that time shaman of the tribe . Hagara banished her son at a young age and Hagar took to wandering . Over time , he assembled a small gang of followers , both fellow Uthgardt outcasts and half - orc s . Meanwhile , Malar granted Hagar the power of the bear warrior s . Eventually , he and his so - called Bull Elk tribe arrived in Waterdeep , where they established themselves as a criminal gang .

title: Hagarl
description: Hagarl Hagarl was a doppelganger who assumed the form of a human boy in order to feast on the inhabitants of Beliard . Personality . Preying on the weak , Hagarl killed horse s , dog s , and the weakest travelers journeying through Beliard .
description_long: Hagarl Hagarl was a doppelganger who assumed the form of a human boy in order to feast on the inhabitants of Beliard . Personality . Preying on the weak , Hagarl killed horse s , dog s , and the weakest travelers journeying through Beliard . He dumped their bodies in a " kill pit , " which was located at the north end of Beliard ' s garbage dump . Hagarl would bury the remains under hordes of trash , for later feedings . History . Around 1368 DR , Hagarl worked as a stablehand at Halamar ' s Horses and killed at least four spice merchants .

title: Hagen
description: Hagen Hagen was a merchant of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Since bandits and thugs threatened him to give away gold for them , Hagen lost his trust with the Neverwinter Watch .
description_long: Hagen Hagen was a merchant of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Since bandits and thugs threatened him to give away gold for them , Hagen lost his trust with the Neverwinter Watch . If the Kalach - Cha sided with the Watch to dispose of the thieves , Hagen repaired his standing with the Watch . If the Kalach - Cha sided with the thieves , Hagen would still give away the gold . However , he would reappear in front of Caleb and have the Watchmen attack him and the Kalach - Cha .

title: Hagga Shan
description: Hagga Shan Hagga Shan , or the Glittering Spires , was a mountain range located in the northern region of the Hordelands along Yal Tengri . Geography . Hagga Shan sat along the southeastern edge of Yal Tengri .
description_long: Hagga Shan Hagga Shan , or the Glittering Spires , was a mountain range located in the northern region of the Hordelands along Yal Tengri . Geography . Hagga Shan sat along the southeastern edge of Yal Tengri . Description . This small mountain range was covered by snow for most of the year . Inhabitants . A small community of dwarves lived within Hagga Shan , mining tin and selling it to merchants in Sossal . The nomads of the Endless Wastes acquired many natural resources from the mountain as well . Contact between the two groups was rare , so rare that the nomads had a superstitious dread of " little men " in the mountains . The dwarves played on these fears as a joke , and to close deals , only further reinforcing the nomads ' fear of the area .

title: Hagspawn
description: Hagspawn Hagspawn were male hag s produced by human s and hags mating . Society . Though male or female offspring may result from such a coupling , female children inevitably became hags rather than hagspawn .
description_long: Hagspawn Hagspawn were male hag s produced by human s and hags mating . Society . Though male or female offspring may result from such a coupling , female children inevitably became hags rather than hagspawn . Likewise , male children always became hagspawn . Hags usually used charms and / or coercion to get male humans to mate with them as only the most depraved ( and suicidal ) individual would be willing to mate with a hag . Description . Hagspawn resembled large brutish humans at first glance . Tall with long muscular arms , they had a hunched posture . Their hair was usually long and black and their eyes glowed red with malice . Their skin tone was usually that of their mother .

title: Hah Li
description: Hah Li Hah Li was a coombe giant inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hah Li helped lead a band of Tuigan deserters to the Rainbow Monastery which they took as their own .
description_long: Hah Li Hah Li was a coombe giant inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hah Li helped lead a band of Tuigan deserters to the Rainbow Monastery which they took as their own . Abilities . Like all coombe giants , Hah Li possessed impressive dexterity and balance . Because of this it was extremely difficult to knock him down .

title: Haifami
description: Haifami The Haifami were a tribe of human s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Chief only assembled a " court " when major decisions needed to be made .
description_long: Haifami The Haifami were a tribe of human s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Chief only assembled a " court " when major decisions needed to be made . Activities . The humans of the Haifami were aggressive and war - like . They were also rumored to be cannibals . Either a female sea mage or a special cleric called a kahin accompanied any expedition on the sea while fishing and searching for food . These spellcasters also accompanied military expeditions . Base of Operations . Six small villages made up the Haifami tribe . Members . Chief Shafiya ruled the Haifami . He was the third son of the previous chief and rose to power through his impressive martial skill .

title: Hailcone
description: Hailcone Hailcone was an evocation spell used to create dangerous shards of hail . This spell was created by the wizard Aubayreer . Effects .
description_long: Hailcone Hailcone was an evocation spell used to create dangerous shards of hail . This spell was created by the wizard Aubayreer . Effects . This spell caused large bits of hail to rain down into the area of effect . The shards originated roughly 30 feet ( 10 m ) above the area and rained down to strike anything within a 30 foot cone beneath them . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a pinch of dust and several drops of water to cast .

title: Hair shirt of Ilmater
description: Hair shirt of Ilmater A hair shirt of Ilmater , also known as a hair shirt of suffering , was a magical horsehair shirt associated with the faith of the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures . Description . It was , as the name suggested , a thick shirt fashioned of several layers of coarse , brown woven horse hair , making quite a stiff fabric .
description_long: Hair shirt of Ilmater A hair shirt of Ilmater , also known as a hair shirt of suffering , was a magical horsehair shirt associated with the faith of the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures . Description . It was , as the name suggested , a thick shirt fashioned of several layers of coarse , brown woven horse hair , making quite a stiff fabric . These hair shirts were typically quite ragged . Powers . Although the thick and uncomfortable hair shirt impeded the wearer ' s agility , it was thick enough to provide a high degree of protection against attacks to the wearer . Some later , cheaper versions caused no significant impediment , but only provided slight protection . The magical hair shirt allowed the wearer to cast " cure serious wounds " once a day , but only on someone other than the wearer , in accordance with the teachings of Ilmater . Creation . In addition to the woven horsehair , a " hair shirt " required the spell s " barkskin " and " cure serious wounds " . Users . These " hair shirts " were typically only fashioned and worn by the followers of Ilmater . They preferred to use the shirt ' s healing power to alleviate the suffering of others .

title: Hairy spider
description: Hairy spider Hairy spiders were a variety of subterranean spider . Description . Hairy spiders were about the size of a human hand .
description_long: Hairy spider Hairy spiders were a variety of subterranean spider . Description . Hairy spiders were about the size of a human hand . They were hairy and black . They could not spin webs , but they could climb on the webs of other spiders . Combat . Hairy spiders swarmed on their target , infecting them with their poisonous bites and tearing out chunks of flesh . Locations . Hairy spiders dwelt in and around drow settlements in the Underdark , as well as in jungles , tombs , and caverns .

title: Haither Stonehand
description: Haither Stonehand Haither Stonehand was the general of Daggerford ' s militia . The Stonehand clan had lived in the town for generations and Haither ' s mother died in the Second Dragonspear War . Haither considered all her soldiers to be more friends and family than subordinates , gaining their absolute loyalty .
description_long: Haither Stonehand Haither Stonehand was the general of Daggerford ' s militia . The Stonehand clan had lived in the town for generations and Haither ' s mother died in the Second Dragonspear War . Haither considered all her soldiers to be more friends and family than subordinates , gaining their absolute loyalty . She was honest but not well versed in diplomacy . General Stonehand led the Daggerford troops during the around 1368 DR .

title: Hajama
description: Hajama Hajama was the Zakhara n god of bravery . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encouraged his followers to never shy away from any opposition — be it in battle or other circumstances . His followers believed that it is better to try and fail than not to try at all , as even living through a defeat strengthens the spirit .
description_long: Hajama Hajama was the Zakhara n god of bravery . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encouraged his followers to never shy away from any opposition — be it in battle or other circumstances . His followers believed that it is better to try and fail than not to try at all , as even living through a defeat strengthens the spirit . Hajama ' s symbol was a featureless disc or none at all . In tales the god was described as a stocky man with a long , deeply black beard , who wore either a jellaba or lamellar armor the color of midnight . Like other Zakharan gods , he was above such concerns as alignment , as , it was said , " Bravery can be found in the most noble faris and the most black - hearted assassin , and who is Hajama to turn his ear from either of them ? " Hajama ' s faith was especially strong in regions bordering dangerous areas like deserts and mountains . It was on friendly terms with the faith of Najm . In the Cities of the Pantheon , Brave Hajama was said to be the son of Kor and Najm ' s twin . Appendix . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Hajjaj
description: Hajjaj Hajjaj , also called Hajjaj the Intemperate was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Hajjaj served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .
description_long: Hajjaj Hajjaj , also called Hajjaj the Intemperate was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Hajjaj served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan . He controlled his own stronghold , complete with a staff of other efreet and noble efreet as well as a contingent of slaves of various races .

title: Haka Kinnori
description: Haka Kinnori Haka Kinnori was a disguised samurai of Doi No Fugu in 1360 DR . History . Kinnori was a samurai retainer of the Emperor .
description_long: Haka Kinnori Haka Kinnori was a disguised samurai of Doi No Fugu in 1360 DR . History . Kinnori was a samurai retainer of the Emperor . In 1359 sensing the turmoils in Maeshi Province between Michimori clan and Korimori clan the emperor send Kinnori to protect the Doi No Fugu inn . He arrived at the inn posing as a ronin and only to head family Sumitomo Koji told the truth . He remained in the inn from then . Kinnori was befriended by the young Sumitomo Toyo and Sumitomo Skoshi , also teaching them karate . In 1360 he with help of an adventuring party , hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords , fought and defeated a group of ONo Kumi ninja Behind the Scenes . If Kinnori survived but died one or more members of Sumitomos , especially Toyo and Skoshi , there is a chance that he will kill himself , 10 % for one member , 20 % for Toyo , and 40 % for Skoshi .

title: Hakim
description: Hakim Hakim was an efreetikin who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Perhaps because of his master ' s numerous negative dealings with genies , Hakim was quite sullen most of the time .
description_long: Hakim Hakim was an efreetikin who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Perhaps because of his master ' s numerous negative dealings with genies , Hakim was quite sullen most of the time . Relationships . Hakim was the gen familiar of the famed sha ' ir Adnan al - Raqi . Activities . Hakim did as his master asked , which usually involved fetching spells from the various elemental planes .

title: Hakim Sayad
description: Hakim Sayad Hakim Sayad was the owner of Clothes for the Enlightened within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hakim was portly , even for an ogre .
description_long: Hakim Sayad Hakim Sayad was the owner of Clothes for the Enlightened within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hakim was portly , even for an ogre . His smile was hideous even though his intentions were sincere . Hakim always dressed himself in the latest fashions sweeping through the City of Delights . Activities . Hakim owned and operated his shop within the Grand Bazaar , catering to rich clientele and even a few members of the Court of Enlightenment . He purchased all of the fine silk used for making his garments from the House of Al - Kamari .

title: Hakim al - Nasri
description: Hakim al - Nasri Hakim al - Nasri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Hakim was the chief supporter of Imam Jomhur , believing he should be allowed to die in office without retiring .
description_long: Hakim al - Nasri Hakim al - Nasri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Hakim was the chief supporter of Imam Jomhur , believing he should be allowed to die in office without retiring .

title: Hakima
description: Hakima Hakima , or Wise Women , were insightful cleric s in Zakhara . Requirements . All Hakima were female and possessed great wisdom .
description_long: Hakima Hakima , or Wise Women , were insightful cleric s in Zakhara . Requirements . All Hakima were female and possessed great wisdom . Role . Hakima did not provide martial aid , though they were capable of defending themselves if needed . Instead they served as tribal family protectors or even leaders . Possessions . These women owned a wide variety of clothing and other equipment depending on their wealth . Benefits . Hakima excelled at reading the truth in others , extending to being able to detect magical illusions and shapechanging . This ability developed as the hakima progressed and gained wisdom . Hindrances . Hakima could not use magical items and scrolls as well as other clerics . They were only able to use universal magical items . Hakima could not turn undead like other priests .

title: Hakiyah
description: Hakiyah Hakiyah was worshiped as the goddess of truth in the lands of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of honesty and calm examination of the truth . Hakiyah ' s symbol was a cresting wave .
description_long: Hakiyah Hakiyah was worshiped as the goddess of truth in the lands of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of honesty and calm examination of the truth . Hakiyah ' s symbol was a cresting wave . When she appeared as a human , she wore the garb of a city - dweller and guided those around her with the calm voice of reason . Like other Zakharan gods , she was above such concerns as alignment , as truth may be used by a judge to right the wronged or by an evil schemer to bring down his enemies . Hakiyah ' s worshipers valued meditation and methodical , rationalized actions . She counted many merchants among them , especially in the Cities of the Pearl . In the Pantheist League , however , her faith was persecuted . The holy slayer organization known as the Soft Whisper worshiped Hakiyah .

title: Haku
description: Haku Haku was the god of freedom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of personal independence and self - reliance . Haku ' s symbol was a stylized gust of wind .
description_long: Haku Haku was the god of freedom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of personal independence and self - reliance . Haku ' s symbol was a stylized gust of wind . In tales he was described as a proud nomad garbed in flowing desert clothing , wearing a gleaming scimitar . Like other Zakharan gods he was above such concerns as alignment , as a noble desert rider may value independence as highly as a dark - hearted assassin . Worshipers . Free Haku had many worshipers among Al - Badia , the desert nomads of Zakhara . In the Cities of the Pantheon , however , his faith was persecuted . He was also the deity most worshiped by the djinn . Appendix . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Haku ( yakuza )
description: Haku ( yakuza ) Haku was a yakuza assassin in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Haku used a chain and knife .
description_long: Haku ( yakuza ) Haku was a yakuza assassin in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Haku used a chain and knife . History . In 1358 DR , Haku was ordered to kill Toshikazu Wada , the commander of the city Home Guard . Waiting for the right time to scratch Toshikazu Wada with a poisoned needle , Haku observed Wada during a meeting with an adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto .

title: Hala Myrt
description: Hala Myrt Hala Myrt was a Tethyrian human who frequented the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep , working for Orlpar Husteem . She found customers for Orlpar and ses up meetings . She was arrested by the City Watch on many occasions but was never charged due to the actions of Orlpar ' s agents , who were responsible for watching her movements while she was carrying Orlpar ' s money or illegal substances .
description_long: Hala Myrt Hala Myrt was a Tethyrian human who frequented the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep , working for Orlpar Husteem . She found customers for Orlpar and ses up meetings . She was arrested by the City Watch on many occasions but was never charged due to the actions of Orlpar ' s agents , who were responsible for watching her movements while she was carrying Orlpar ' s money or illegal substances . Hala consumed mordayn powder on a regular basis . Description . Hala had a weathered face with brown hair . She usually wore a stained brown frock .

title: Halabankh Ormsarr
description: Halabankh Ormsarr Halabankh Ormsarr was a human man and an illusionist . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .
description_long: Halabankh Ormsarr Halabankh Ormsarr was a human man and an illusionist . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Halabankh was formerly an adventurer in Bellas ' s Band , under Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while Halabankh took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . Activities . Halabankh and the dukes grew increasingly wealthy and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . In all decisions on major policies , Halabankh had one vote while Bellas had two . Halabankh and the Dukes often confiscated property and magic from visitors , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power . They acquired a large collection of magical item s this way , and still sought more . Halabankh had forty apprentices who all served as battle - mages in The Teeth of Calaunt , the city ' s standing army .

title: Halagard
description: Halagard Halagard was a city located in central Halruaa . Description . At 7 , 500 inhabitants , Halagard sported a large population when compared to other Halruaan cities .
description_long: Halagard Halagard was a city located in central Halruaa . Description . At 7 , 500 inhabitants , Halagard sported a large population when compared to other Halruaan cities . The city was located on the Bay of Halruaa at the mouth of the Halagard Channel . Inhabitants . Halagard was governed by the wizard Basel Indoulur . History . Up until the mid 1200 ' s DR , Halagard was the capital city of Halruaa .

title: Halagard Channel
description: Halagard Channel The Halagard Channel was a waterway located in Halruaa . Geography . The Halagard Channel connected Lake Halruaa with the Great Sea .
description_long: Halagard Channel The Halagard Channel was a waterway located in Halruaa . Geography . The Halagard Channel connected Lake Halruaa with the Great Sea . The channel was 3 miles ( 4 . 8 km ) wide for most of its length . Cities and towns lining the Halagard Channel included :

title: Halamar
description: Halamar Halamar was a competent mage specializing in fire magic and a member of the Blue Wyvern Company . In 1479 DR , Halamar and the Blue Wyverns helped Jack Ravenwild recover the Sarkenaegal tome from the ancient dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff . Description .
description_long: Halamar Halamar was a competent mage specializing in fire magic and a member of the Blue Wyvern Company . In 1479 DR , Halamar and the Blue Wyverns helped Jack Ravenwild recover the Sarkenaegal tome from the ancient dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff . Description . Halamar had red hair and a " W " - shaped goatee .

title: Halamar ' s Horses
description: Halamar ' s Horses Halamar ' s Horses was a stable run by Blasko Halamar . Geography . The stables were located on the eastern side of Beliard , east of the Stone Bridge in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn .
description_long: Halamar ' s Horses Halamar ' s Horses was a stable run by Blasko Halamar . Geography . The stables were located on the eastern side of Beliard , east of the Stone Bridge in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . History . Around 1368 DR to 1370 DR , Blasko , an ex - warrior , ran the place with a dozen local boys , including Hagarl , purchasing lame or tired horse s and selling fresh and rested ones as replacements for traveling adventurers . Services . Halamar was known for buying horses and reselling , but he would always try to keep a ten gold piece profit margin for himself between payments and prices .

title: Halana Shauluth
description: Halana Shauluth Halana Shauluth was a baker in the village of Amphail on the Sword Coast North around 1370 DR . She baked hard loaves of wheat and meat - filled buns . Biography .
description_long: Halana Shauluth Halana Shauluth was a baker in the village of Amphail on the Sword Coast North around 1370 DR . She baked hard loaves of wheat and meat - filled buns . Biography . Halana was formerly a mercenary who was in a group with a dozen female dwarves , but she lost her hand after it became infected with gangrene , hence she retired from that career to become a baker . She claimed to have seen the " Ghost of Amphail , " the ghost of Amphail the Just ( after whom the village is named ) and that the ghost rescued her from thieves who were trying to rob her .

title: Halanaestra
description: Halanaestra Halanaestra was an elf of mixed wild elf and moon elf heritage ( and possibly aquatic elf , too ) . History . Around 1368 DR , she was the proprietor of the Green Sword tavern in Leuthilspar , Evermeet .
description_long: Halanaestra Halanaestra was an elf of mixed wild elf and moon elf heritage ( and possibly aquatic elf , too ) . History . Around 1368 DR , she was the proprietor of the Green Sword tavern in Leuthilspar , Evermeet . Prior to this , she was a famous dancer .

title: Halander Hardingdale
description: Halander Hardingdale Halander Hardingdale , also known as Ratshadow , was a young halfling from Baldur ' s Gate . Due to some trouble with certain associates , he and is family had to flee to Waterdeep . While there he joined the Zhentarim , who relocated him to Ten Towns .
description_long: Halander Hardingdale Halander Hardingdale , also known as Ratshadow , was a young halfling from Baldur ' s Gate . Due to some trouble with certain associates , he and is family had to flee to Waterdeep . While there he joined the Zhentarim , who relocated him to Ten Towns . History . Born Halander Hardingdale , " Ratshadow " gained his moniker as a youth by " shadowing " the Rivington Rats gang . He made certain contacts within other gangs which brought down the wrath of the Rivington Rats . He evacuated his mother and sisters to Waterdeep where he later joined them . However before leaving his hideaway in the Undercellers of Baldur ' s Gate , he stole a magic pouch from the kingpin known as the Fetcher . Reuniting his family in Waterdeep , Ratshadow joined the Zhentarim as a front man . They felt his skill at making contacts could be used elsewhere and sent him North to Ten Towns to help establish the Black Network as a regional power .

title: Halani Meliamne
description: Halani Meliamne Halani Meliamne was a slave of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Halani was a princess of the Moonwood elves until , in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , one night several yak folks possessing some moon elf hunters killed her brothers and took her as a slave .
description_long: Halani Meliamne Halani Meliamne was a slave of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Halani was a princess of the Moonwood elves until , in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , one night several yak folks possessing some moon elf hunters killed her brothers and took her as a slave . From then on , she lived as a slave of Chief Kartha - Kaya , learning all about his yak folk tribe .

title: Halarahh
