The more subtle the change , like making a forest appear denser and darker , or increasing the slope of a hill , the less likely those in the area of effect would notice the change . Extreme changes , like a grassy field over a lake , were easily noticed as soon as person interacted with the scenery and fell victim to it . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a stone , a twig , and a blade of grass or piece of a green plant .

title: Halondar
description: Halondar The Halondar , originally called the Turmway , was a road in the Vilhon Reach that stretched from Alaghôn to Hlondeth . Geography . The Halondar ran through the Halondar Valley between the Orsraun Mountains and the Aphrunn Mountains before nearly bisecting Turmish .
description_long: Halondar The Halondar , originally called the Turmway , was a road in the Vilhon Reach that stretched from Alaghôn to Hlondeth . Geography . The Halondar ran through the Halondar Valley between the Orsraun Mountains and the Aphrunn Mountains before nearly bisecting Turmish . Xorhun was a major stopping point at the end of a trail a few miles off the road . History . The road was originally named the Turmway . In 37 DR , the foundation of Hlondeth marked its westernmost end .

title: Halonya
description: Halonya Halonya was the teenaged prophetess of Tchazzar and his high priestess . Although she was Tchazzar ' s proclaimed high priestess , she was incapable of casting divine magic . Halonya was jealous of Jhesrhi Coldcreek and often whispered derogatory comments to Tchazzar behind Jhesrhi ' s back .
description_long: Halonya Halonya was the teenaged prophetess of Tchazzar and his high priestess . Although she was Tchazzar ' s proclaimed high priestess , she was incapable of casting divine magic . Halonya was jealous of Jhesrhi Coldcreek and often whispered derogatory comments to Tchazzar behind Jhesrhi ' s back . After Tchazzar was slain during the Battle of Luthcheq , Halonya went to the building used as Tchazzar ' s temple and attempted to convince the priests to leave with her . Instead , the priests killed Halonya . Appearance . Halonya was very thin and had an acne - scarred face . After her elevation to high priestess of the Cult of Tchazzar , she began wearing ridiculously elaborate red robes .

title: Halric Bonesnapper
description: Halric Bonesnapper Halric Bonesnapper was the ruler of Griffon ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Halric was the grandson of the great Kralgar Bonesnapper Activities .
description_long: Halric Bonesnapper Halric Bonesnapper was the ruler of Griffon ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Halric was the grandson of the great Kralgar Bonesnapper Activities . Halric lived in comfort in his longhouse where he met other chieftains . He sometimes launched bold raids in fear that other chieftains believed his tribe had lost the favor of Uthgar . Personality . Halric once dreamed of wiping out all the cities of the North but his tribe was too small . He lived in fear that he had truly lost Uthgar ' s favor .

title: Halruaa
description: Halruaa Halruaa , as of 1372 DR , was a land of magic , renowned for its electrum mines . Ruled by Netyarch ( wizard - king ) Zalathorm Kirkson in the capital city of Halarahh , the fabled , quiet and wealthy magocracy was justly depicted as full of wonder . Created by archwizard s foreseeing the fall of Netheril , Halruaa combined the peace and harmony of Cormyr with the magic powers of Thay .
description_long: Halruaa Halruaa , as of 1372 DR , was a land of magic , renowned for its electrum mines . Ruled by Netyarch ( wizard - king ) Zalathorm Kirkson in the capital city of Halarahh , the fabled , quiet and wealthy magocracy was justly depicted as full of wonder . Created by archwizard s foreseeing the fall of Netheril , Halruaa combined the peace and harmony of Cormyr with the magic powers of Thay . Nearly all arcane casting Halruaans were wizard s , with one third of the total populace having some sort of magical powers . With such ever - present power , it was likely that their strict laws or perhaps their inherent nature had prevented their entire nation from catastrophic civil wars . During the the Year of Blue Fire , the whole kingdom and the surrounding area was devastated by the Spellplague . To save their realm , Halruaan wizards shifted the kingdom into Abeir , leaving behind the Plaguewrought Land . When the Spellplague ended a century later , Halruaa returned to Toril . Society . Halruaans congregate in numerous villages and cities scattered throughout the country ' s interior . Most are small , cosy settlements with no more than a few hundred inhabitants each .

title: Halruaan ( ethnicity )
description: Halruaan ( ethnicity ) The Halruaans were an ethnic group of human s who made up the vast majority of the population of Halruaa and Nimbral . They also composed a tiny percentage of the population of Lapaliiya and the Shaar . Description .
description_long: Halruaan ( ethnicity ) The Halruaans were an ethnic group of human s who made up the vast majority of the population of Halruaa and Nimbral . They also composed a tiny percentage of the population of Lapaliiya and the Shaar . Description . Most Halruaans were lovers of magic , especially arcane magic . In fact , Halruaans had the strongest magic tradition of any of the human races of Faerûn . Even the poorest commoner could cast simple spells , and it was considered a mark of honor and prestige to excel in the arcane arts . Halruaans tended to be a happy lot , and enjoyed treating each other with all kinds of pleasantries . In contrast , they were often very suspicious of foreigners with anxieties about having their magical secrets stolen . They rarely desired to travel far from their homes . The Crinti were openly disliked by most Halruaans . The average Halruaan was wealthy , and they cared very much about appearances , dressing in flashy , colorful , flamboyant garb and employed magic in their everyday lives , such as for transportation . Similarly , they were keen on exotic pets . Education and literacy were extremely important to a Halruaan . Language .

title: Halruaan Consumption
description: Halruaan Consumption Halruaan Consumption was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by non - spellscared creatures who ventured into the wastelands of Halruaa . In the initial stages of the disease any magical healing spell s cast on the afflicted creature would be less effective . However , arcane attack spells cast by the creature would be more powerful .
description_long: Halruaan Consumption Halruaan Consumption was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by non - spellscared creatures who ventured into the wastelands of Halruaa . In the initial stages of the disease any magical healing spell s cast on the afflicted creature would be less effective . However , arcane attack spells cast by the creature would be more powerful . Some victims recovered spontaneously in the early stages and acquired a spellscar . If a victim didn ' t recover and the disease progressed , the victim would suffer some damage to his body . In the final stage the afflicted disintegrated into luminous blue dust .

title: Halruaan elder
description: Halruaan elder Being just an arcane spellcaster is not enough in Halruaa . One must be able to prove his / her mastery of the Art with unique displays of arcane force and knowledge ; enough to make them famous all across the land . Such individuals that earn this title are granted permission to participate in the revered and prestigious Halruaan Counsil of Elders , the court of Netyarch , the " wizard - king " , where they discuss the official policies and important matters of the country with the head of state .
description_long: Halruaan elder Being just an arcane spellcaster is not enough in Halruaa . One must be able to prove his / her mastery of the Art with unique displays of arcane force and knowledge ; enough to make them famous all across the land . Such individuals that earn this title are granted permission to participate in the revered and prestigious Halruaan Counsil of Elders , the court of Netyarch , the " wizard - king " , where they discuss the official policies and important matters of the country with the head of state . Description . Only arcane casters are eligible to join the ranks of the Halruaan elders , and the vast majority are wizards . Other casters are not respected in Halruaan society , so few of them ever stay in their homeland long enough to attain the level of talent necessary to become a member of the Council . Activities . Tasked with a neverending quest of new spells and magic items , a sizable number of elders rarely appear in the court , choosing instead to venture forth in search of wondrous magic elsewhere in Faerûn . Thus , they are free to travel and experiment as they please , as long as they do not put their country and its citizens at risk .

title: Halruaan language
description: Halruaan language Halruaan ( sometimes spelled Halruan ) was a regional language of South Faerûn and the official language of the magocracy of Halruaa and the island of Nimbral . Speakers . Descendants of the Netheril Empire , the people of Halruaa spoke a language that evolved from ancient Netherese .
description_long: Halruaan language Halruaan ( sometimes spelled Halruan ) was a regional language of South Faerûn and the official language of the magocracy of Halruaa and the island of Nimbral . Speakers . Descendants of the Netheril Empire , the people of Halruaa spoke a language that evolved from ancient Netherese . Other places Halruaan was commonly spoken included the Channath Vale , Dambrath , the Golden Water , Lapaliiya , Luiren , Nimbral , and the Shaar . Among nonhuman races , strongheart halfling s also sometimes spoke this language . Script . Literate speakers of Halruaan used the Draconic alphabet , as their ancestors did with Netherese and Loross . Related languages . Halruaan was essentially a modern dialect of ancient Netherese . It was part of the Ulou language family . Halruaan was in the same linguistic family as Ruathlek , the secret language of Nimbral illusionists of Leira . Examples . Common Halruaan surnames included Avhoste , Darants , Gedreghost , Maurmeril , Stamaraster , and Zorastryl . Common female names included Aithe , Alaethe , Chalan , Oloma , Phaele , Sarade , and Vosthyl .

title: Halruaan skyship
description: Halruaan skyship A Halruaan skyship was a sailing vessel that flew through the air . Physical description . The flying vessel looked much like a normal seagoing sailing ship .
description_long: Halruaan skyship A Halruaan skyship was a sailing vessel that flew through the air . Physical description . The flying vessel looked much like a normal seagoing sailing ship . Typically , they had three masts , square sails , and a broad flat beam . Giant sea turtle shells were often used as armor . History . The original creation of skyships dated back to Netheril and were a secret of Halruaa for centuries . However , in the early 1370s DR , a renegade wizard spread the secret of Halruaan skyships to others . Creation . Although a rare and genius invention , a Halruaan skyship was no more than an expensive magical item . If a spellcaster was proficient with the required magical knowledge and able to find the materials , creating one only took a matter of months . Crafting such an item required : A Halruaan skyship was not a spelljammer vessel , but it was possible to convert a Halruaan skyship into a spelljamming vessel .

title: Halthara Summergarth
description: Halthara Summergarth Halthara Summergarth was a halfling woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1368 DR , Summergarth was a ship - owner and a maker of barrels and crates , and conducted her trade from Summergarth Facilitations in Procampur .
description_long: Halthara Summergarth Halthara Summergarth was a halfling woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1368 DR , Summergarth was a ship - owner and a maker of barrels and crates , and conducted her trade from Summergarth Facilitations in Procampur . She was also an active Harper agent , though she remained based in Procampur .

title: Halueth Never
description: Halueth Never Halueth Never was the sun elf founder of the city of Neverwinter . History . In the Year of Burning Glades , - 10 DR , he led the elves of Iliyanbruen to defeat Illuskan expansion .
description_long: Halueth Never Halueth Never was the sun elf founder of the city of Neverwinter . History . In the Year of Burning Glades , - 10 DR , he led the elves of Iliyanbruen to defeat Illuskan expansion . In 1372 DR , the Hero of Neverwinter came across his tomb buried deep beneath Castle Never . It guarded by the swords of the first Neverwinter Nine .

title: Halvan ' s Keep
description: Halvan ' s Keep Halvan ' s Keep was a keep in Harrowdale , once occupied by then lord of Harrowdale ( Halvan ' s Dale ) , Halvan the Dark . It was described as an old , rambling manor house enclosed by newer walls , and the origin of the manor house is therefore not known . History .
description_long: Halvan ' s Keep Halvan ' s Keep was a keep in Harrowdale , once occupied by then lord of Harrowdale ( Halvan ' s Dale ) , Halvan the Dark . It was described as an old , rambling manor house enclosed by newer walls , and the origin of the manor house is therefore not known . History . After the fall of Halvan the Dark , the Council of Seven Burghers came to power , and instigated a 50 gp per head fine on anyone found entering or leaving the keep , in an attempt to keep vandalism and looting under control . Around 1338 DR , persons entered the old keep and unleashed a guardian creature which began a fight , and an ensuing fire . The fire blackened the keep and left it without a roof , as well as uncovering rooms that previously lay secret , as well as entry to the dungeons , which were found to be occupied by wraith s , believed to be undead incarnations of those locked in the dungeons when the keep was occupied . The keep has been utilised by a number of organisations since its demise as Halvan ' s main residence , including followers of Loviatar and a cabal of smugglers .

title: Halvan the Dark
description: Halvan the Dark Halvan the Dark was an individual who became lord of Harrowdale at some point in the 1180s DR , and renamed it " Halvan ' s Dale " . He also created the Halfaxe Trail , a route through deep woodland to Harrowdale . Character .
description_long: Halvan the Dark Halvan the Dark was an individual who became lord of Harrowdale at some point in the 1180s DR , and renamed it " Halvan ' s Dale " . He also created the Halfaxe Trail , a route through deep woodland to Harrowdale . Character . Halvan ' s personality made him very wealthy but made him many enemies . During his rule of Harrowdale ( Halvan ' s Dale ) , he loaned money to people , and seized the assets of those who could not repay him . He developed a liking for ornate and gem - encrusted armors , and had several made for him over the years . Halvan put on weight as his tastes became more opulent . Halfaxe Trail . Halvan the Dark is widely credited as the creator of the Halfaxe Trail , leading from Harrowdale and linking up with the Moonsea Ride , bringing valuable trade to the dale from the north west . In the 1180s DR , he hired Durl Halfaxe , who acquired a work force , mainly human , to construct the trail . Death .

title: Halvin Graingle
description: Halvin Graingle Halvin Graingle was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Under the orders of his masters , Halvin went to the Quivering Forest posing as a woodworker .
description_long: Halvin Graingle Halvin Graingle was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Under the orders of his masters , Halvin went to the Quivering Forest posing as a woodworker . His mission was to make a new bargain with the dark fey who had helped Cvaal Daoran to save Phlan from the shadovar s ' ire a century before . Thus he started living in the Kabel ' s Hill community , searching for lore about the fey of the forest . In the end , Halvin went out to meet with the hag Jeny Greenteeth , but the negotiation did not go well and she killed him . Relationship . Halvin had an imp familiar called Pypyap .

title: Halwa
description: Halwa Halwa , the City of Solitude , was one of Zakhara ' s " Cities of the Heart " . Geography . Halwa was located about 200 miles ( 320 km ) east of Wasat within the desert of the Haunted Lands along Al - Malih River .
description_long: Halwa Halwa , the City of Solitude , was one of Zakhara ' s " Cities of the Heart " . Geography . Halwa was located about 200 miles ( 320 km ) east of Wasat within the desert of the Haunted Lands along Al - Malih River . Its lonely inland position next to the usually dry bed of Malih gave Halwa the title of City of Solitude . History . Despite its location , Halwa was an active trading city , serving as a meeting point between city - dwellers and desert nomads . Livestock and durable goods were important commodities , as was care for caravans on their way to Hiyal and adventurers looking for riches in the desert . More sinister goods were sold in Halwa ' s underground slave market .

title: Hama
description: Hama Hama this birds spirits who remained on the material plane instead of going to the afterlife . Usually they can not go to the afterlife for the same reasons that other spirits , it ' s either not finished deal that holds the spirit of this world , or revenge . Hama can not speak but their songs and croakings can often guess what they mean .
description_long: Hama Hama this birds spirits who remained on the material plane instead of going to the afterlife . Usually they can not go to the afterlife for the same reasons that other spirits , it ' s either not finished deal that holds the spirit of this world , or revenge . Hama can not speak but their songs and croakings can often guess what they mean . Hama can not talk even if mage use speak with animals spell . Meanwhile Hama can understand any language and dialect . Two of the propagation Hama form , is an owl or an eagle but also may be other forms of birds . Sparrow , nightingale , parrot , falcon , peacock , and even vulture hama have been seen . They can always be distinguished from living birds , they are alvase have translucent shell and fiery bright eyes . Combat . Hama can cause considerable damage with their claws and beak combining these attacks with his wings . Hama almost no feels pain , because it is almost a no material being . Ham also thanks to his ghostly can intimidate many soldiers and travelers . At will the Hama can become incorporeal and seep through walls or other . By concentrating Ham can also fly but any attack can interrupt this process .

title: Hama Sayif
description: Hama Sayif Hama Sayif was a dwarven mystic who ran a small stand within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . For a fee , Hama would give his customers advice or even dance for them .
description_long: Hama Sayif Hama Sayif was a dwarven mystic who ran a small stand within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . For a fee , Hama would give his customers advice or even dance for them . Because of his spirituality , Hama sometimes experienced strange visions about his clients while performing a dance . History . Hama was originally from Al - Akara Mountains where he was one of the Dancing Dwarves , but left home to eventually find his true calling in Huzuz . Relationships . Sika al - Bana and Bara Minora worked for Hama , believing that he would make them rich one day . They handled all of the haggling on Hama ' s behalf .

title: Hamadh
description: Hamadh Hamadh the Unseen was a male drow shadowdancer from Maerimydra . He led a small group of resistance fighters , known as the Hidden , that formed in the wake of Kurgoth Hellspawn ' s invasion . Description .
description_long: Hamadh Hamadh the Unseen was a male drow shadowdancer from Maerimydra . He led a small group of resistance fighters , known as the Hidden , that formed in the wake of Kurgoth Hellspawn ' s invasion . Description . Unusually for a drow , Hamadh dyed his ordinarily white hair black and maintained a short haircut . Dressing in stylish dark greys and blacks , his enchanted studded leather armor made him as inky black as his environs . Personality . Hamadh was not quite as evil as the rest of his kin but was still passionately concerned with the well - being of Maerimydra and the drow to such an extent that he formed the Hidden to oust its invaders . Since creating his band of freedom fighters , he grew uncharacteristically caring towards the group . Abilities . A formidable opponent , Hamadh was noted to move with fluidity and grace in combat , despite wielding an enormous two - handed greatsword , that meant his weapon seemed to be a mere extension of his body .

title: Hamatula
description: Hamatula Hamatulas — also called barbed devils — were the guardians of the Nine Hells , entrusted with important duties such as defending infernal fortresses and prisons , guarding vaults , and serving as bodyguards to the most powerful denizens of the Nine Hells . Description . As their name implies , a barbed devil was covered in a mass of sharp barbs .
description_long: Hamatula Hamatulas — also called barbed devils — were the guardians of the Nine Hells , entrusted with important duties such as defending infernal fortresses and prisons , guarding vaults , and serving as bodyguards to the most powerful denizens of the Nine Hells . Description . As their name implies , a barbed devil was covered in a mass of sharp barbs . Their hands ended in long , razor - sharp claws . A barbed devil was about 7 feet tall and weighed about 300 pounds .

title: Hamayarch
description: Hamayarch A Hamayarch was the title of a mage - advisor and assistant to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast , and leader of the city ' s mage s . Duties . The Hamayarch served as a mage - advisor and assistant to their Thultyrl , and was meant to be very loyal to their ruler and operated with their blessing .
description_long: Hamayarch A Hamayarch was the title of a mage - advisor and assistant to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast , and leader of the city ' s mage s . Duties . The Hamayarch served as a mage - advisor and assistant to their Thultyrl , and was meant to be very loyal to their ruler and operated with their blessing . It was said that " Behind every Thultyrl stood a Hamayarch . " This post was traditionally taken by a mage weaker than the Thultyrl , and was the highest - ranking wizard in the court . The Hamayarch governed and regulated the magic - users of Procampur . History . By the mid - 13th century DR , three generations of Thultyrls had been served by the Pearl as their Hamayarch . In this position , she strictly regulated Procampur ' s magic - users , and largely discouraged the practice . In the Year of Burning Steel , 1246 DR , the current Thultyrl chose to liberate the neighboring city of Tsurlagol from a horde of orc s , goblinoid s and other marauders , led by the orc warlord Fottergrim .

title: Hambergyle
description: Hambergyle Hambergyle , also known as hambergite , was a somewhat rare semi - precious stone . Description . Hambergyle was found in crystal or fragmentary form .
description_long: Hambergyle Hambergyle , also known as hambergite , was a somewhat rare semi - precious stone . Description . Hambergyle was found in crystal or fragmentary form . It was colorless and fairly hard , yielding small , gems . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . If a hambergyle gem was held in a flame and " light " was cast upon it , the gem was consumed but produced a " continual light " at that spot .

title: Hambone Bay
description: Hambone Bay Hambone Bay was a small body of water located on the western end of Luirenstrand in Luiren . Geography . Hambone Bay abutted the central coastline of Luiren .
description_long: Hambone Bay Hambone Bay was a small body of water located on the western end of Luirenstrand in Luiren . Geography . Hambone Bay abutted the central coastline of Luiren . It was bordered on the south by the Krenalir Peninsula and the Mortick Swamp , on the west by the coastal cities of Chethel and Beluir , and to the north by a portion of Luiren ' s central northern coastline .

title: Hames
description: Hames Hames was an undead pirate in service to Garrundar in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . Hames was a commander of the very powerful band of sky pirates led by Bartholomew Blackdagger .
description_long: Hames Hames was an undead pirate in service to Garrundar in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . Hames was a commander of the very powerful band of sky pirates led by Bartholomew Blackdagger . At one time , the sky pirates tried to capture Garrundar but they failed spectacularly and the black dragon pursued them back to their hideout . Garrundar took control of the lizardfolk that lived there and he weaved a powerful spell that cursed the pirates into undeath and bound them to him . In 1484 DR , Company Yargo , needing a base and more sky ships , sent an adventurer to clear the area . The adventurer fought and killed Hames before they arrived at the dragon .

title: Hamid al - Bashshar
description: Hamid al - Bashshar Hamid al - Bashshar was one of the newest members of the Corsair Council of Hawa by 1367 DR . History . Hamid was once a member of the Dutiful Mamluk Society .
description_long: Hamid al - Bashshar Hamid al - Bashshar was one of the newest members of the Corsair Council of Hawa by 1367 DR . History . Hamid was once a member of the Dutiful Mamluk Society . After his village was nearly destroyed by ravagers and he was taken prisoner , Hamid managed to escape and traveled to the Corsair Domains , where he begged to join the corsairs to aid in the fight against his former captors . His desire to remove his tattoos and successfully passing a " detect lie " spell convinced the Corsair Council that he was being truthful . He was given a place on Akura al - Hiyali ' s ship . His keen intellect and hatred for the mamluks showed the Council that Hamid would be more useful to them if provided command of his own ship . Description . Facial scars marred Hamid ' s visage , courtesy of removing the tattoos he was given during his time as a mamluk for the Dutiful . He had wavy black hair and hazel eyes and was once considered handsome . In order to hide his scars , Hamid always wore a veil . Abilities . Hamid was a natural actor . Activities . Secretly , Hamid was a spy for the Dutiful .

title: Hamlar Hills
description: Hamlar Hills The Hamlar Hills were a cluster of foothills of the Cloud Peaks in Amn . Description . People often used the term " Hamlar Hills " to refer to any of the foothills of the Cloud Peaks .
description_long: Hamlar Hills The Hamlar Hills were a cluster of foothills of the Cloud Peaks in Amn . Description . People often used the term " Hamlar Hills " to refer to any of the foothills of the Cloud Peaks . Properly , however , only the southern and western hills of the Peaks belonged to the Hamlar Hills , where Vol Qirger had planted his vineyard . The hills were lightly forested and used for grazing by the farmers of Amn . Inhabitants . The Hamlar Hills were inhabited by many poor people who had been forced out of Amn . They lived among caves in the hills and survived by stealing local sheep . Notable Locations . The small village of St . Carwell ' s Vale included a shrine to Eldath . It was located near the coast in the western hills . History . The hills were named after House Hamlar , which included House Qirger . Sometime before 1330 DR , Lord Qirger had tried to start a vineyard in the hills , using transplants from the Purple Hills in Tethyr . His attempts failed , and within 30 years , the vineyards were overgrown and wild .

title: Hammer
description: Hammer A hammer is an implement ranging in size from tiny jewelery hammers to massive warhammer s . Certain races prefer to wield hammers , especially dwarves who make extensive use of these tools in mining their great caverns . The light hammer may be thrown at a target and is thus considered a ranged weapon as well as a melee weapon .
