title: Hammer Hall
description: Hammer Hall Hammer Hall was a log house and stables , surrounded by a wooden palisade . Built by the Men of Hammer Hall , an adventuring group , to explore the nearby Halls of the Hammer , it became a viable place of refuge in the rugged wilderness of the North .
description_long: Hammer Hall Hammer Hall was a log house and stables , surrounded by a wooden palisade . Built by the Men of Hammer Hall , an adventuring group , to explore the nearby Halls of the Hammer , it became a viable place of refuge in the rugged wilderness of the North .

title: Hammer of Moradin
description: Hammer of Moradin Hammer of Moradin were a special prestige class on Faerûn for the dwarven worshipers of Moradin . Hammers of Moradin were members of an order of holy warriors , defending Citadel Adbar against the enemies of dwarves : goblinoid s , giant s and drow . Rather than simply defend the city walls , they left that work to the regular army of the Iron Guard and actively sought their enemies to destroy them and their homes .
description_long: Hammer of Moradin Hammer of Moradin were a special prestige class on Faerûn for the dwarven worshipers of Moradin . Hammers of Moradin were members of an order of holy warriors , defending Citadel Adbar against the enemies of dwarves : goblinoid s , giant s and drow . Rather than simply defend the city walls , they left that work to the regular army of the Iron Guard and actively sought their enemies to destroy them and their homes . Very often they were helped by the order of explorers of the Underdark , the Deepscouts . To become a hammer of Moradin , a dwarf had to show great fighting skills and some degree of spellcasting ability . Abilities . As they became more powerful , hammers of Moradin gained earth - related abilites and powerful holy strikes . Ex - Hammers of Moradin . Those dwarves who violated their ethical alignment or betrays either Citadel Adbar or the hammers of Moradin as a whole lost all spell - like and supernatural abilities gained from the prestige class . They regained his abilities and advancement potential if they atoned for their actions .

title: Hammer of Thunderbolts
description: Hammer of Thunderbolts The Hammer of Thunderbolts is a powerful dwarven warhammer . History . This mighty weapon is said to have been wielded in the " Battle of the Drowning of Lornak " .
description_long: Hammer of Thunderbolts The Hammer of Thunderbolts is a powerful dwarven warhammer . History . This mighty weapon is said to have been wielded in the " Battle of the Drowning of Lornak " . As of around 1360 DR , the hammer was said to be hidden in Delzoun . Runestones were made in Dethek to give clues to it ' s whereabouts . Baldur ' s Gate II . This warhammer also apears in . It can be found in a lair inhabitated by mind flayers which can be accessed from the sewers underneath the temple district of Athkatla with the sewer key , which can be found in the Windspear Hills dungeon . This weapon can be made even more powerful when bringing this weapon to Cromwell in the Docks District of Athkatla and finding the Gauntlets of ogre strength , Girdle of frost giant strength and the Crom Faeyr scroll .

title: Hammer of Tyr
description: Hammer of Tyr The Hammer of Tyr is a holy relic of the church of Tyr , god of justice . A powerful weapon against evil and the undead , it can cast extraordinarily powerful " turn undead " and " sunray " spells , as well as " heal " allies . The Hammer can be also be used as a + 5 weapon and when thrown returns to the wielder ' s hand .
description_long: Hammer of Tyr The Hammer of Tyr is a holy relic of the church of Tyr , god of justice . A powerful weapon against evil and the undead , it can cast extraordinarily powerful " turn undead " and " sunray " spells , as well as " heal " allies . The Hammer can be also be used as a + 5 weapon and when thrown returns to the wielder ' s hand . Perhaps the Hammer ' s greatest power is to destroy " pools of darkness " when thrown into its waters .

title: Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork
description: Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork was a wainwright and carpentry business owned by Hammerhand Bucko in Shadowdale . History . In 1374 DR , Hammerhand sold and repaired wheeled vehicles .
description_long: Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork was a wainwright and carpentry business owned by Hammerhand Bucko in Shadowdale . History . In 1374 DR , Hammerhand sold and repaired wheeled vehicles . His staff members also worked on carpentry projects ranging from jewelry boxes to large houses .

title: Hammers
description: Hammers The Hammers were the personal guard and advisors of Marchion Elastul Raurym of Mirabar around 1370 DR . Organization . They were four in number and were led by Djaffar .
description_long: Hammers The Hammers were the personal guard and advisors of Marchion Elastul Raurym of Mirabar around 1370 DR . Organization . They were four in number and were led by Djaffar . They consisted of hand - selected elite veteran warriors . Possessions . The Hammers rode heavily armored war - horse s . Activities . Once a year , when the marchion rode south after the meeting of the Council of Sparkling Stones , he took two Hammers with him , and left the other two behind as war captains .

title: Hammers of Grimjaws
description: Hammers of Grimjaws The Hammers of Grimjaws are the highest ranking and most elite order of paladin s who dedicate their lives and services to Tyr . Membership . Members of the Grimjaws are sponsored by existing members from the ranks of only two orders of Tyr , the Knights of Holy Judgment and the Knights of the Merciful Sword .
description_long: Hammers of Grimjaws The Hammers of Grimjaws are the highest ranking and most elite order of paladin s who dedicate their lives and services to Tyr . Membership . Members of the Grimjaws are sponsored by existing members from the ranks of only two orders of Tyr , the Knights of Holy Judgment and the Knights of the Merciful Sword . Vision . The choosing of the Hammers ' members is in part done by Tyr himself , in order to ascend the order ' s ranks , a candidate must pray and receive a vision from Tyr . A vision of Tyr ' s warhammer shows the god ' s favor and permits immediate acceptance into the order . A vision of Tyr ' s sword means that the aspiring Hammer has failed in some way and must atone before entering the ranks . A successful atonement quest allows the aspirant to join the Order as though he had seen the vision of the warhammer . Currently there are less than 12 Hammers in active service , a testament to the purity and power required to become one of the order .

title: Hamsetis
description: Hamsetis Hamsetis was the most powerful fighter in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hamsetis was a member of The Fangs of Set .
description_long: Hamsetis Hamsetis was the most powerful fighter in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hamsetis was a member of The Fangs of Set . History . In youth Hamsetis was a gladiator - slave of the Red Wizards of Thay but he always tried to rebel . At last the clergy of Set bought him but his Red Wizard master maimed him before the selling . The followers of Set healed him , gaining him loyalty . Under orders of Seti , the current incarnation of Set , Hamsetis posed as a hunter of Set ' s followers . Personality . Hamsetis hated the Red Wizards with truly passion and wanted revenge against them . He served Set out of a sense of gratitude . He had no political ambition and was a honorable man . However he enjoyed killing , especially Red Wizards . . Relationship . Thank of his cover work Hamsetis gained the trust of the Mulhorand ' s vizier and of many high - ranking bureaucrats .

title: Hamstrung Giant
description: Hamstrung Giant The Hamstrung Giant was an inn and tavern in Eshpurta . It was located in the southern part of the city where many of the artists , musicians , and sculptors lived , but the clientele was an equal mix of artists , soldiers , and merchants . The Hamstrung Giant had a friendly atmosphere and good food and ale , moderately priced .
description_long: Hamstrung Giant The Hamstrung Giant was an inn and tavern in Eshpurta . It was located in the southern part of the city where many of the artists , musicians , and sculptors lived , but the clientele was an equal mix of artists , soldiers , and merchants . The Hamstrung Giant had a friendly atmosphere and good food and ale , moderately priced . The Hamstrung Giant was located two doors south of Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe and a short walk north and across the street from Bhamm ' s Herbs .

title: Han language
description: Han language Han was a language spoken by the ancient Han people of Kara - Tur . History . Legend told that after the creation of the land of Kara - Tur , the gods themselves handed down the Han language to the Han people .
description_long: Han language Han was a language spoken by the ancient Han people of Kara - Tur . History . Legend told that after the creation of the land of Kara - Tur , the gods themselves handed down the Han language to the Han people . By the 14th century DR , Han was studied and employed only by philosophers and sages of Kara - Tur . Related languages . It was the root tongue for the Koryo , Kozakuran , and Wa - an languages , and possibly others .

title: Han languages
description: Han languages The Han languages were a group of languages spoken in Kara - Tur . It comprised a number of languages descended from the root Han language , including Koryo , Kozakuran , and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an remained closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .
description_long: Han languages The Han languages were a group of languages spoken in Kara - Tur . It comprised a number of languages descended from the root Han language , including Koryo , Kozakuran , and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an remained closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language . There was perhaps 65 % comprehension between the two . Koryo ' s vocabulary comprised many words evolved from the old Han tongue , as well as loanwords from Wa - an and Kao te Shou that had been borrowed over centuries . Koryo ' s vocabulary was very different to that of Kozakuran , but its grammar was very similar . Koryo sounded more like Wa - an than Kao te Shou , but it was as simple to use as Shou . Thus most folk of Shou Lung , Wa , and even Kozakura found the Koryo language relatively easy to pick up , and most Koryoans in turn found Kao te Shou , Wa - an , and Kozakuran easy to learn as well .

title: Han people
description: Han people The Han were an ethnicity of human s who lived in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur in prehistoric times . They were the ancestors of the Koryoan people , and presumably also the Kozakuran and Wanese peoples , owing to a shared linguistic roots . The Han language was the basis for the Koryo , Kozakuran , Wa - an , and other languages , and continued to be used by scholars and philosophers for ages afterward .
description_long: Han people The Han were an ethnicity of human s who lived in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur in prehistoric times . They were the ancestors of the Koryoan people , and presumably also the Kozakuran and Wanese peoples , owing to a shared linguistic roots . The Han language was the basis for the Koryo , Kozakuran , Wa - an , and other languages , and continued to be used by scholars and philosophers for ages afterward . A related people were the Chinhan . History . Han history was largely unknown , pieced together from disconnected legends . The Han people once fled invasion by the forces of Shou Lung . Much later , it was told that they ' d hidden a great hoard of jade somewhere in the Sillan Mountains . Around 1357 DR , jade was discovered at the mountain village of Mu Tong , and some thought it evidence of the ancient Han trove . When the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted , it was said that the very skies over Koryo caught fire . The land was devastated ; the city of Old Bejung , closest to Kanko , was engulfed in poisonous gas that killed all the people , before the city itself was obliterated in a matter of seconds and buried in ash .

title: Hanali Celanil
description: Hanali Celanil Hanali Celanil is the fey aspect of the goddess Sune , serving as the deity of romantic love and beauty within the Seldarine . She lives in the realm of Arvandor . A being of timeless beauty and benign nature , she always forgives minor transgressions and delights in rewarding her followers with the bliss of unexpected love and affection .
description_long: Hanali Celanil Hanali Celanil is the fey aspect of the goddess Sune , serving as the deity of romantic love and beauty within the Seldarine . She lives in the realm of Arvandor . A being of timeless beauty and benign nature , she always forgives minor transgressions and delights in rewarding her followers with the bliss of unexpected love and affection . She embodies romance , beauty , love , and joy in elven spirits , her only flaws being her own mild vanity and flighty nature . Although she rarely appears to her faithful , Hanali delights in seeing the growth of love among elves , and she often acts in secret to protect young lovers . She was thought for many years to be an aspect of Angharradh , the Triune Goddess , before her true identity as Sune was revealed . Worshipers . Hanali ' s clerics are flighty and somewhat vain , given to dancing and wild celebrations . The hierarchy is loosely organized , and clerics are free to join or leave a temple ' s ranks as they wish . They preside over marriage and rites of passage ceremonies for young elves , although they are not required to marry , for Hanali ' s concern is love , not necessarily marriage .

title: Hanamoto Genji
description: Hanamoto Genji Hanamoto Genji was an evil shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hanamoto managed the Red Fog cult , a heretical branch of the Konjo school based in Daidake on Tenmei island .
description_long: Hanamoto Genji Hanamoto Genji was an evil shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hanamoto managed the Red Fog cult , a heretical branch of the Konjo school based in Daidake on Tenmei island . He easily manipulated the shugodai Suzuki Motosune , a Red Fog convert .

title: Hand crossbow
description: Hand crossbow Drow hand crossbows are feared weapons , they are small enough to fit inside of a pocket . They usually contain a knock - out poison . Drizzt Do ' Urden pretended to have one in his pocket and made a duergar give him information , threatening to shoot him with a hand crossbow .
description_long: Hand crossbow Drow hand crossbows are feared weapons , they are small enough to fit inside of a pocket . They usually contain a knock - out poison . Drizzt Do ' Urden pretended to have one in his pocket and made a duergar give him information , threatening to shoot him with a hand crossbow . They are not very powerful therefore they are only used to shoot poison at enemies .

title: Hand of Bane
description: Hand of Bane The Hand of Bane was an artifact created by the priesthood of Bane to enable Bane to be resurrected , should the need arise . Location . The hand was hidden in the city of Sigil , in a former temple to Bane .
description_long: Hand of Bane The Hand of Bane was an artifact created by the priesthood of Bane to enable Bane to be resurrected , should the need arise . Location . The hand was hidden in the city of Sigil , in a former temple to Bane . Appearance . The hand was carved from black obsidian , about the size of an ogre ' s paw . The fingers were curled upwards , with fingernails of red garnet . The hand is also studded with diamond s , giving it a poxy appearance . Destruction . The hand was destroyed by Walinda of Bane in the Astral Plane . The pieces were later scattered throughout the planes .

title: Hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory
description: Hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory A hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory was an item with properties similar to a " hand of glory " except it had five silver rings upon it that each produced a different magic al power . Description . Each " hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory " was a mummified drow hand that wore a silver ring on each finger .
description_long: Hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory A hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory was an item with properties similar to a " hand of glory " except it had five silver rings upon it that each produced a different magic al power . Description . Each " hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory " was a mummified drow hand that wore a silver ring on each finger . Powers . Each of the silver rings upon a " hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory " could manifest a different magical power at the command of the wearer up to once per day each . The powers manifested were " deeper darkness " , " see invisibility " , " ray of enfeeblement " , " chill touch " , and " spectral hand " . However , if any of the rings were removed from the hand , they would be rendered non - magical until returned to the hand . Additionally , if one of the silver rings was replaced with a magic ring then the wearer could gain the benefits of the magic ring just as if she wore it on her own finger ; this property worked just like a " hand of glory " . If this exchange was performed , then the power of that specific silver ring was unavailable until the silver ring was returned . History .

title: Hand of Makti
description: Hand of Makti The Hand of Makti was a standing stone found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate in 1367 DR . Geography . This stone was located deep within the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert .
description_long: Hand of Makti The Hand of Makti was a standing stone found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate in 1367 DR . Geography . This stone was located deep within the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert . History . The Hand of Makti was used to help mark the location of the magical Well of Kashan .

title: Handaxe
description: Handaxe A handaxe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family . Description . The handaxe is similar to a hatchet in size and shape .
description_long: Handaxe A handaxe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family . Description . The handaxe is similar to a hatchet in size and shape . The haft is usually made of wood or sometimes metal and is about a foot and a half long ( 45cm ) . The blade is single - edged and the back side may be unadorned , spiked , or have a peen . Handaxes are heavier than throwing axe s and not balanced for throwing . An average handaxe costs 6gp and weighs 3lbs ( 1 . 4kg ) . Weaponology . Classified as a light weapon , the handaxe can be used while grappling . Some training is required to use the handaxe as an off - hand weapon in conjunction with another weapon , therefore it is considered a martial weapon . For the ranged version of this weapon , see throwing axe . Realmslore . Dwarves favor the handaxe as an off - hand weapon .

title: Handfang
description: Handfang Handfang is a necromancy spell that conjures a mouth in one ' s hand . Effect . You create a fanged , biting mouth in the palm of your hand .
description_long: Handfang Handfang is a necromancy spell that conjures a mouth in one ' s hand . Effect . You create a fanged , biting mouth in the palm of your hand . When you lay your hand upon a creature , the mouth bites it . If the target makes a successful Reflex save , he takes only half damage . If the target fails his Reflex save , you may start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity . If you establish a hold , the fanged mouth sinks its teeth into the target ’ s flesh and continues to bite for additional damage each round until the hold is broken or the spell ends .

title: Handful of Coins
description: Handful of Coins The Handful of Coins regrouped the Zhentil Keep ' s merchants not affiliated with the Zhentarim . They were an informal mutual assistance group , with the objective of protect their members from abuse by the lords and / or the Zhentarim . They also protect themselves from the magistrate and tried to improve foreign trade in the Keep .
description_long: Handful of Coins The Handful of Coins regrouped the Zhentil Keep ' s merchants not affiliated with the Zhentarim . They were an informal mutual assistance group , with the objective of protect their members from abuse by the lords and / or the Zhentarim . They also protect themselves from the magistrate and tried to improve foreign trade in the Keep . Their true power however derived from the sponsorship by some Beholder that protect secretly the Coins from the Zhent ' s assault . The beholder helped them behind the scenes in order to balance the Zhent ' s power , also involving anti - zhent group like Knights of the North . History . The Handful of Coins disbanded after the 1368 DR invasion by the Cyric monstrous army with many of their members dead or fled the city .

title: Hands of Ihbar
description: Hands of Ihbar Hands of Ihbar , also known , particularly in the past , as chilling tentacles , is a spell used by warlock s , most often those who specialize in pacts with aberration s . When " hands of Ihbar " , which draws on the dark power of the star Ihbar , is cast , its caster summons frigid tentacles to a spot occupied by a creature within fifty feet . These tentacles seem to peel out of the creature themselves , causing them vast amounts of pain and slowing their movement with their chilling power , which reduces the blood flow of any living creature within the spell ' s grasps .
description_long: Hands of Ihbar Hands of Ihbar , also known , particularly in the past , as chilling tentacles , is a spell used by warlock s , most often those who specialize in pacts with aberration s . When " hands of Ihbar " , which draws on the dark power of the star Ihbar , is cast , its caster summons frigid tentacles to a spot occupied by a creature within fifty feet . These tentacles seem to peel out of the creature themselves , causing them vast amounts of pain and slowing their movement with their chilling power , which reduces the blood flow of any living creature within the spell ' s grasps . The effect of the spell is momentary in length and is powered largely by the warlock ' s strength of personality . Though resistance to the effects of winter and cold are generally less injured by the spell , warlocks of the star pact know how to reduce the effectiveness of this resistance , their skill in doing so dependent upon their experience . Prior to the Spellplague , " hands of Ihbar " , then known more commonly as " chilling tentacles " was a substantially more powerful spell , which could only be gained through enormous growth in power on the part of its caster .

title: Hanging Tree of Ravencourt
description: Hanging Tree of Ravencourt The Hanging Tree of Ravencourt or the Magistree , was a spectral phenomenon that was localized in the area of Ravencourt , Waterdeep . Description . In appearance it resembled a typical Hangman tree , but it would only react to those who were unpunished for capital crimes , known or unknown .
description_long: Hanging Tree of Ravencourt The Hanging Tree of Ravencourt or the Magistree , was a spectral phenomenon that was localized in the area of Ravencourt , Waterdeep . Description . In appearance it resembled a typical Hangman tree , but it would only react to those who were unpunished for capital crimes , known or unknown . History . The Magistree was actually the spirit of Magister Pallak Nharrelk of House Nharrelk who was slain by the corrupt Guildmasters in 1279 DR . The tree was considered an arm of the King ' s Justice . Three men were judged by it in 1479 DR , after a recess of more than a century .

title: Hangman ' s Knoll
description: Hangman ' s Knoll Hangman ' s Knoll is a small rise where the road from Mirrorman ' s Mill connects to the North Ride in Shadowdale . History . Hangman ' s Knoll takes its name from the days of Lord Joadath , who commissioned gallows here to execute " thieves , highwaymen , and petty followers of all gods .
description_long: Hangman ' s Knoll Hangman ' s Knoll is a small rise where the road from Mirrorman ' s Mill connects to the North Ride in Shadowdale . History . Hangman ' s Knoll takes its name from the days of Lord Joadath , who commissioned gallows here to execute " thieves , highwaymen , and petty followers of all gods . " Recent Events . During the Zhent occupation of Hammer 1375 DR , the Black Network built new gallows upon Hangman ' s Knoll to execute traitors convicted in Mourngrym Amcathra ' s court .

title: Hangman tree
description: Hangman tree The hangman tree is so named for its rope - like appendages . These sinewy vines resemble nooses at their ends and when dropped down appear much as if they were hanging ropes . Hangman trees are deciduous and are found in temperate to subtropical climes .
description_long: Hangman tree The hangman tree is so named for its rope - like appendages . These sinewy vines resemble nooses at their ends and when dropped down appear much as if they were hanging ropes . Hangman trees are deciduous and are found in temperate to subtropical climes . Bio . Their shallow root systems and small numbers of leaves require them to supplement their nutrition by direct ingestion of protein . Thus , each tree traps prey . A hangman tree can move very slowly , its effective movement being but a few feet per day once fully grown . Saplings ' move about 6 feet per hour , mature trees at about one - third that rate . All are solitary . During freezing weather , a taproot is put down and the tree is dormant . A hangman tree has no interest in any sort of treasure , and as each moves constantly , it is unlikely that any treasure will be found near one , although indigestible items will be expelled from the belly - trunk periodically . Encounters . The tree attacks by dropping its noose - like appendages around prey . Although each tree has 6 - 9 appendages , only 3 can be controlled at one time . This is exclusive of damage to the tree proper .

title: Haniah Dales
description: Haniah Dales Haniah Dales was a half - elf who arrived in the village of Hilltop in the Silver Marches in 1372 DR . When kobold s attacked the village , she was forced to handle the aftermath of the attack because the mayor , Veraunt Shuttlescomb , was beyond drunk .
description_long: Haniah Dales Haniah Dales was a half - elf who arrived in the village of Hilltop in the Silver Marches in 1372 DR . When kobold s attacked the village , she was forced to handle the aftermath of the attack because the mayor , Veraunt Shuttlescomb , was beyond drunk .

title: Hank
description: Hank Hank the Double - Bitted was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Hank was the leader of the Champions of Muktar .
description_long: Hank Hank the Double - Bitted was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Hank was the leader of the Champions of Muktar . His weapon of choice was axes , hence his nickname . He was also the commander of the Muktar ' s army . History . Hank was a veteran fighter of the wars in Turmish . In 1358 DR Hank and his fellow Champions arranged the trap inside Fort Blood planned by the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , to eliminate an adventuring party well - known in Golconda . Later he lead the Muktar army in the Battle of Wilma Pass . Rumors . It said that once Hank had killed alone a black dragon .

title: Hanne Hallen
description: Hanne Hallen Hanne Hallen was a young drow wizard during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Hanne was very close to her mother , Zhora Hallen .
description_long: Hanne Hallen Hanne Hallen was a young drow wizard during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Hanne was very close to her mother , Zhora Hallen . She and her family were allies of House Mizzrym . Activities . Hanne was a wizard - in - training in Menzoberranzan . She lived with her mother and the other Dark Hunters , a group of drow explorers that hunted for purple worm eggs in order to sell to wizards in the city . History . During the Rage of Demons , Hanne went on an egg run with the Dark Hunters in the Wormwrithings , but the passage of a purple worm divided her from the group .

title: Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines
description: Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines The Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines was an apothecary located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Hanno Minstrelsong . History .
description_long: Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines The Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines was an apothecary located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Hanno Minstrelsong . History . Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business through " circa " 1369 DR and in 1374 DR . Famed traveler Volothamp Geddarm wrote about the business in " Volo ' s Guide to Cormyr " . Services . Hanno Minstrelsong sold a variety of mundane healing supplies , including herb s , poultices , medicines , and alchemical mixtures , as well as magical potion s . He also bought bulk quantities of powdered and bottled herbs from halfling hamlet s along Cormyr ' s southern coast and eastern farming belt , and sold them to caravan merchants who distributed them in markets in Suzail , Sembia , and Westgate . Nonlethal poison s were available for sale to those who inquired discreetly and appeared trustworthy . However , Hanno didn ' t sell any lethal poisons , and those who asked for them could end up being watched by the Purple Dragons . Among Hanno ' s special mixtures were incredibly powerful anaesthetics .

title: Hanno Minstrelsong
description: Hanno Minstrelsong Hanno Minstrelsong , not his original name , was a half - elf man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines tavern . Personality .
description_long: Hanno Minstrelsong Hanno Minstrelsong , not his original name , was a half - elf man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines tavern . Personality . Hanno was described as always smiling . Activities . Hanno Minstrelsong sold a variety of mundane healing supplies , including herb s , poultices , medicines , and alchemical mixtures , as well as magical potion s . He also bought bulk quantities of powdered and bottled herbs from halfling hamlet s along Cormyr ' s southern coast and eastern farming belt , and sold them to caravan merchants who distributed them in markets in Suzail , Sembia , and Westgate . He even sold nonlethal poison s to those who inquired discreetly and appeared trustworthy . However , Hanno didn ' t sell any lethal poisons , and those who asked for them could end up being watched by the Purple Dragons . History . Once , he was a highly successful thief . He was so successful , in fact , that a whopping six assassin s were individually sent after him . He was forced to flee Amn with magic al assistance .

title: Hanovar
description: Hanovar Hanovar of Ruathym was a barkeep in Nexal . History . Hanovar was one of the renegades living in the human quarter of Nexal in 1362 DR .
description_long: Hanovar Hanovar of Ruathym was a barkeep in Nexal . History . Hanovar was one of the renegades living in the human quarter of Nexal in 1362 DR . That year , after Millos , the barkeep of The Death ' s Head bar , was sacrificed to Zaltec , Hanovar took control of the bar . Afterward , he spoke with Ironspike , a former acquaintance of Millos , and an adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume for the right price . However , soon after , a patrol of Viperhands orc s entered the bar with the intent to kill all people present .

title: Hantanus Tarm
description: Hantanus Tarm Hantarus Tarm was the castellan of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , like all castellans of Goldenfields , Tarm was appointed by the Lords of Waterdeep to lead the defense of the place , despite having no military experience .
description_long: Hantanus Tarm Hantarus Tarm was the castellan of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , like all castellans of Goldenfields , Tarm was appointed by the Lords of Waterdeep to lead the defense of the place , despite having no military experience . His position was a political and ceremonial one and he had no influence outside the gatehouse .

title: Hapdash
description: Hapdash Hapdash was a kobold slinger in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Hapdash was in charge of create the alchemic products for the army of the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr .
description_long: Hapdash Hapdash was a kobold slinger in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Hapdash was in charge of create the alchemic products for the army of the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr . Personality . Hapdash was very zealous in his work . He had lost faith in Zarr and only wanted made more alchemic experiments . Hapdash attacked anyone how tried to touch his laboratory .

title: Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenings
description: Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenings The Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenstance was a temple to Tymora . Geography . The temple was located on a small hilltop in Yartar , and was built like a huge windowed keep with dark and dreary stone walls .
description_long: Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenings The Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenstance was a temple to Tymora . Geography . The temple was located on a small hilltop in Yartar , and was built like a huge windowed keep with dark and dreary stone walls . Inhabitants . Many folk in Yartar called the temple " Two Hap Fort Hall " , or the " Two " . The temple would sponsor adventuring parties to defend it from danger . As of 1366 DR , it was run by High Priestess Velantha Waerdar .

title: Happy Hippocampus
description: Happy Hippocampus The Happy Hippocampus was an inn and tavern found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a noisy place compared to the Silent Sword , but was good quality with cheap prices .
description_long: Happy Hippocampus The Happy Hippocampus was an inn and tavern found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a noisy place compared to the Silent Sword , but was good quality with cheap prices . A number of small " bed - and - beer " houses huddled around it .

title: Happy House of Splendor and Song
description: Happy House of Splendor and Song The Happy House of Splendor and Song was a temple to Milil , Lord of Song , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the biggest temple to Milil on the eastern side of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Location .
description_long: Happy House of Splendor and Song The Happy House of Splendor and Song was a temple to Milil , Lord of Song , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the biggest temple to Milil on the eastern side of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Location . The Happy House of Splendor and Song lay on the east side of the city . History . During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths in the city as " unbelievers " . Nevertheless , the Happy House remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Activities . The temple of Milil provided support and guidance to local members of the Harpers . The temple was considered by some to be a place to contact Those Who Harp . Inhabitants . In 1358 DR , the temple was led by High Mistress of Song Elassuara Narithan , with six priests and eleven lay - followers . These followers were all low - to mid - range bard s .

title: Happy Hunting Grounds
description: Happy Hunting Grounds The Happy Hunting Grounds , also known as the Beastlands , was the Outer plane representing alignments between neutral good and chaotic good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Arvandor and the House of Nature when that cosmology became popular . Arvandor survived the Spellplague while the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model .
description_long: Happy Hunting Grounds The Happy Hunting Grounds , also known as the Beastlands , was the Outer plane representing alignments between neutral good and chaotic good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Arvandor and the House of Nature when that cosmology became popular . Arvandor survived the Spellplague while the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model . Description . The name Happy Hunting Grounds was given to this plane by those that first scried it , assuming the abundant and varied game and wildlife would be a sportsman ' s paradise . But the native inhabitants of this plane were all capable of speech and comparable to human s in range of intelligence . Some of the most intelligent creatures could even wield magic .

title: Harab
description: Harab Harab , also known as the Isle of War , was a large island of the Crowded Sea region south of the Pantheist League . It did not possess any unified government . Trade .
description_long: Harab Harab , also known as the Isle of War , was a large island of the Crowded Sea region south of the Pantheist League . It did not possess any unified government . Trade . Harab exported iron and silver , feathers , teak , spices and musk .

title: Haradan
description: Haradan Haradan the Hermit was a human mage of the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Haradan was a recluse who had remained apart from the world for many years .
description_long: Haradan Haradan the Hermit was a human mage of the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Haradan was a recluse who had remained apart from the world for many years . However , one year , he heard of the disappearances in Vanesci Hamlet . It transpired that the monstrous Redfang , ruler of the Kingdom of Nix , had developed a taste for human flesh and had instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci . Yearly , his harpies swooped down from the air , snatching people unawares to carry back to the cookpot . Unable to ignore this harvest of horror , Haradan decided to investigate and put a stop to it , leading to the Harvest of Horrors . Personality . True to his title , Haradan was a recluse who stayed outside mainstream society . He did not enjoy being feted as a hero . He only sought a solitary lifestyle that did not stop him helping others when necessary .

title: Harae
description: Harae Harae was a ghost in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Harae was frustrated with the limits of her condition as one of the undead .
description_long: Harae Harae was a ghost in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Harae was frustrated with the limits of her condition as one of the undead . She observed Igan from when he was child and saw goodness inside him . When he was killed , Harae was devastated . She was consumed with the need to bring justice to the killers . History . Harae in her mortal life was a priestess of Tyr at the shrine in Sokol Keep until she died during the Dragon Run " circa " 1289 DR . However , she rose again as ghost locked in the keep . She met Igan Sokol and supported his tentative plan to restore the shrine . However , when he was killed by corrupt Knights of the Black Fist , Harae was filled with fury . She extinguished the beacon of the keep in order to lure other people into the keep . She wanted the killers of Igan to be brought before a court of law .

title: Haragh Mnistlyn
description: Haragh Mnistlyn Haragh Mnistlyn was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Haragh was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .
description_long: Haragh Mnistlyn Haragh Mnistlyn was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Haragh was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . He was acting as gatekeeper when he noticed Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr . They looked to be suspicious individuals in his eyes so he cast a " read mind " spell . However , he was instead surrounded by well - trodden grass — a symptom of the Time of Troubles . Haragh remained totally shocked while Elminster subtly made jokes at him . When later an insurrection started against the Zhents , Haragh confronted Elminster and Sharantyr inside the High Castle but they managed to kill him .

title: Harajin
description: Harajin Harajin was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Harajin and seven other fallen angels to remained as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Harajin Harajin was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Harajin and seven other fallen angels to remained as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Harajin was constantly screaming in horror , afflicting people in the vicinity .

title: Haramara ' s bow
description: Haramara ' s bow Haramara ' s bow was a non - magical , masterfully crafted bow , originally belonging to Haramara Alenuath but by 1368 DR in the possession of Thalanil Alenuath . It was an item of great significance to House Alenuath . It was said that Haramara slew the red dragon Skarra with a single arrow from the bow .
description_long: Haramara ' s bow Haramara ' s bow was a non - magical , masterfully crafted bow , originally belonging to Haramara Alenuath but by 1368 DR in the possession of Thalanil Alenuath . It was an item of great significance to House Alenuath . It was said that Haramara slew the red dragon Skarra with a single arrow from the bow .

title: Haramara Alenuath
description: Haramara Alenuath Haramara Alenuath was the founder of the gold elf House Alenuath . Possessions . Haramara was said to have slain the red dragon Skarra with just one arrow from her non - magical bow ( " Haramara ' s bow " ) , which become an item of great significance to the house .
description_long: Haramara Alenuath Haramara Alenuath was the founder of the gold elf House Alenuath . Possessions . Haramara was said to have slain the red dragon Skarra with just one arrow from her non - magical bow ( " Haramara ' s bow " ) , which become an item of great significance to the house .

title: Harammamyl H ' tithet
description: Harammamyl H ' tithet Harammamyl H ' tithet was the main drow delegate in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Harammamyl hid well her disgust for other races and even understood that a little false compassion helped in business .
description_long: Harammamyl H ' tithet Harammamyl H ' tithet was the main drow delegate in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Harammamyl hid well her disgust for other races and even understood that a little false compassion helped in business . History . Harammamyl was a member of the merchant House H ' tithet . In 1372 DR , she became a delegate to Mantol - Derith after assassinating her predecessor , Yyssisiryl H ' tithet . However , the Siege of Menzoberranzan prevented travel to her home city and for the time , Harammamyl , like Kassawar Plickenstint , had very little to do .

title: Harandil Thundersword
description: Harandil Thundersword Harandil Thundersword was a knight and a member of the Thundersword noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was softly spoken . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .
description_long: Harandil Thundersword Harandil Thundersword was a knight and a member of the Thundersword noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was softly spoken . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . They were on a high meadow north of Startop Crag when the knights impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush , and a few were killed . Alusair rallied her forces to defeat the orcs and their dark naga master . When Alusair said warriors cleaned up after themselves , Harandil added that " or they soon die " , agreeing with her plan to clear the Zhentarim threat to the area .

title: Harangor Urlingscar
description: Harangor Urlingscar High Crown Harangor Urlingscar was a dragonborn member of Clan Urlingscar and the king of Relmaur as of 1479 DR . Background . Harangor was considered a stern man by most , but he also was a benevolent ruler .
description_long: Harangor Urlingscar High Crown Harangor Urlingscar was a dragonborn member of Clan Urlingscar and the king of Relmaur as of 1479 DR . Background . Harangor was considered a stern man by most , but he also was a benevolent ruler . During his mandate , he allowed all the prominent Relmorn clans to participate in the government of Relmaur by establishing the Crown Council .

title: Harauna Beltzund
description: Harauna Beltzund Harauna Beltzund was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Harauna was of short stature and her features suggested she may have had some dwarven blood in her ancestry .
description_long: Harauna Beltzund Harauna Beltzund was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Harauna was of short stature and her features suggested she may have had some dwarven blood in her ancestry . Her hands , feet , and nose were all large for her size and her build was strong and husky . Personality . She had a warm personality edged with gruffness , but her kind nature made her likeable by most . She had a temper that could be wound up to a rant and rage at those that crossed her , which may have contributed to people treating her well out of fear of her tongue and hurled objects . All the glassware in the Whistling Wizard was replaced with metal or wooden vessels because they were less likely to shatter during one of her rampages . She was against bringing pets or animals into the inn . She owned a few small pigs which lived outside in the stableyard , but did not like animals indoors . She tolerated small pets and familiars of paying guests , but it was best if they were kept out of sight .

title: Harazos Thelbrimm
description: Harazos Thelbrimm Gauntlet Harazos Thelbrimm was the leader of the Loudwater town guard . History . Harazos Thelbrimm and Kalahar Twohands were the leaders of the Loudwater Guard .
description_long: Harazos Thelbrimm Gauntlet Harazos Thelbrimm was the leader of the Loudwater town guard . History . Harazos Thelbrimm and Kalahar Twohands were the leaders of the Loudwater Guard . Known as the Two Gauntlets , they served under the command of High Lord Nanathlor Greysword . In 1369 DR , Harazos and Kalahar helped defend the city of Loudwater against an invasion of Malar - worshipping lycanthropes . Shortly thereafter , Nanathlor Greysword passed away and Kalahar became the regent of Loudwater , while Harazos remained as leader of the town guard .

title: Harbinger
description: Harbinger The Harbinger was a colossal wight in the service of Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . The Harbinger guided a host of undead in trying to break the wall of Neverwinter , but was defeated by an adventurer newly arrived in the city . Appendix .
description_long: Harbinger The Harbinger was a colossal wight in the service of Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . The Harbinger guided a host of undead in trying to break the wall of Neverwinter , but was defeated by an adventurer newly arrived in the city . Appendix . Behind the scenes . The Harbinger is the first boss the player fights in the game .

title: Harbor District
description: Harbor District The Harbor District was an unofficial designation for a region of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Harbor District included the Trade Harbor and Caliph ' s Harbor , and the surrounding buildings located outside the walls of Huzuz along the south bank of Al - Sarif River north of the city .
description_long: Harbor District The Harbor District was an unofficial designation for a region of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Harbor District included the Trade Harbor and Caliph ' s Harbor , and the surrounding buildings located outside the walls of Huzuz along the south bank of Al - Sarif River north of the city . Inhabitants . This district was populated by sailors , laborers , and travelers from all across the Land of Fate and beyond .

title: Harbor master
description: Harbor master This human was the harbor master of the village of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The harbor master tried to convince a ship captain to remain in the village , but failed , and the ship sailed off .
description_long: Harbor master This human was the harbor master of the village of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The harbor master tried to convince a ship captain to remain in the village , but failed , and the ship sailed off . When the boat was attacked by lizardfolk , the harbor master and his sailors had to rescue them .

title: Harbor moon
description: Harbor moon A harbor moon was a Waterdhavian coin worth fifty gold pieces inside the city , but only thirty gold pieces elsewhere . Description . The coin was shaped like a crescent moon and made of platinum with an electrum inlay .
description_long: Harbor moon A harbor moon was a Waterdhavian coin worth fifty gold pieces inside the city , but only thirty gold pieces elsewhere . Description . The coin was shaped like a crescent moon and made of platinum with an electrum inlay . It had a central hole to allow it to be strung on a string .

title: Harbromm
description: Harbromm King Harbromm was the ruler of Citadel Adbar and was a member of the Council of 12 Peers < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > during the formative stages of the Silver Marches and was currently a Peer on the League of the Silver Marches ' council . Relationships . He had two sons , Bromm and Harnoth , twins born in the wake of the Thunder Blessing .
description_long: Harbromm King Harbromm was the ruler of Citadel Adbar and was a member of the Council of 12 Peers < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > during the formative stages of the Silver Marches and was currently a Peer on the League of the Silver Marches ' council . Relationships . He had two sons , Bromm and Harnoth , twins born in the wake of the Thunder Blessing .

title: Harburk Tuthmarillar
description: Harburk Tuthmarillar Harburk Tuthmarillar was the constable of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis on 1491 DR . Activities . Harburk directed his duties from a shop in the village , where he lived together with the town ' s butcher Jalessa Ornra .
description_long: Harburk Tuthmarillar Harburk Tuthmarillar was the constable of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis on 1491 DR . Activities . Harburk directed his duties from a shop in the village , where he lived together with the town ' s butcher Jalessa Ornra . He also worked in Jalessa ' s shop as a butcher .

title: Hard - Tack
description: Hard - Tack Hard - Tack was a dry unseasoned water - and - flour biscuit . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Hard - Tack Hard - Tack was a dry unseasoned water - and - flour biscuit . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . The biscuits were dry and bland . However , due to its extraordinary resilience , Hard - Tack was a popular choice for long sea voyages .

title: Hardbuckler
description: Hardbuckler Hardbuckler was a small town of gnome s on the Dusk Road , south of Northdark Wood and the Trielta Hills , and just north of the Reaching Woods . Economy . It was a favorite location for traders along the Dusk Road owing the gnomes ' industriousness .
description_long: Hardbuckler Hardbuckler was a small town of gnome s on the Dusk Road , south of Northdark Wood and the Trielta Hills , and just north of the Reaching Woods . Economy . It was a favorite location for traders along the Dusk Road owing the gnomes ' industriousness . The major industry was secure , private storage for any type of goods . The storage facilities were made secure through the work of a wizard named Aldiber Inchtawurn , who created powerful wards protecting the walls and storage facilities of Hardbuckler . Additionally the gnomes exported elaborate locks , sturdy wooden crates , and a distinctive green seam - sealing wax sold in cloth rolls . History . It was named for a dwarf adventurer who won a battle on the site of the town . Government . The town was governed by a council made up of gnome elders . Two were known to be Hammas Isynd and Orival Bundifeather .

title: Hardcastle ( city )
description: Hardcastle ( city ) Hardcastle was a small city strategically built at the crossroads of three major caravan routes . Geography . Little more then a fortified trading camp , Hardcastle sat on the roads between the Great Rift , Unther , and the Vilhon Reach .
description_long: Hardcastle ( city ) Hardcastle was a small city strategically built at the crossroads of three major caravan routes . Geography . Little more then a fortified trading camp , Hardcastle sat on the roads between the Great Rift , Unther , and the Vilhon Reach . Government . Founded in the days of the Kingdom of Peleveria , Hardcastle had no reigning lord until Frego Cordwell arrived . Frego was a caravan master from Chondath who decided taking over the town would be more lucrative and involve less road time . After taking over he managed to convince several businesses to set up in Hardcastle to cater to the caravan traffic along the roads . He hired a number of former business associates , in an attempt to ensure some measure of loyalty , to provide all the usual town services , including law enforcement . Frego borrowed the idea from the Durpari people , who he had dealt with on his travels in the past . This allowed Frego to administer the usage fees without having to worry about any of the logistics involved in actually providing the services . Trade .

title: Hardstones
description: Hardstones Hardstone was a general term for natural substances that can usually be found in large quantities and are valued for their appearance and usefulness in artistic carvings , metallurgy , jewelry , and architecture . The prices listed were for one pound ( a little under a half kilogram ) of the material . Notable hardstones .

The prices listed were for one pound ( a little under a half kilogram ) of the material . Notable hardstones . Some typical hardstones found in the " Realms "

title: Harem Palace
description: Harem Palace The Harem Palace of Calim in the city of Teshyll was a massive palace of the djinn i Calim said to have housed nearly 2 , 000 human and jann slaves and concubines at the height of the Calim Empire . It was known for its extraordinary architecture . After Teshyll ' s destruction in the Era of Skyfire , the " Jhasinnadah " became home to an assortment of bandits and monsters over the centuries .
description_long: Harem Palace The Harem Palace of Calim in the city of Teshyll was a massive palace of the djinn i Calim said to have housed nearly 2 , 000 human and jann slaves and concubines at the height of the Calim Empire . It was known for its extraordinary architecture . After Teshyll ' s destruction in the Era of Skyfire , the " Jhasinnadah " became home to an assortment of bandits and monsters over the centuries . By 1370 DR , only the slightest evidence of its existence remained amongst the ruins .

title: Haresk Malorn
description: Haresk Malorn Haresk Malorn is the current High Councilor and Mistran of the council that rules over Mistledale . He also commands the Riders , Mistledale ' s mounted defenders . Despite this , Haresk is known as more of a wise and compassionate merchant rather than a true warrior .
description_long: Haresk Malorn Haresk Malorn is the current High Councilor and Mistran of the council that rules over Mistledale . He also commands the Riders , Mistledale ' s mounted defenders . Despite this , Haresk is known as more of a wise and compassionate merchant rather than a true warrior . As there have been more attacks from the drow as of late , Haresk feels that he might have to step down for someone with more military experience . Regardless of whether or not this will be the case , Haresk is well liked by the people of Mistledale . The House of the High Councilor is Haresk Malorn ' s residence and it is the largest building in Ashabenford . It is also used by the council a nearly official seat of government .

title: Harginn
description: Harginn Harginns , or flame horrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . All harginns could assume several different forms including a regular bonfire , a pillar of flame , or a bronze d humanoid .
description_long: Harginn Harginns , or flame horrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . All harginns could assume several different forms including a regular bonfire , a pillar of flame , or a bronze d humanoid . When seen on the Prime Material Plane , harginns appeared like humans with flames replacing their legs and lower torso . Harginn eyes glowed with an eerie black light that represented their evil reputation well . They could easily change the color of their flames to suit their mood . Combat . While in combat , harginns preferred to move about quickly and strike with gouts of flame . They made extensive use of their ability to " blink " at will . Some harginns used weapons in combat . Harginns were completely immune to any fire - based spell , and a harginn within 20 ft . of a fire - based spell would automatically dispel it , including spells with permanent effects . This did not affect magical items . Habitat / Society . Harginns organized themselves into guilds composed of a tiered hierarchy where guilds with more power ordered around those beneath them . These orders were not always followed , causing frequent conflict between harginns .

title: Harglast
description: Harglast Harglast was a spartan stone city and one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Government . Harglast was ruled by a Lord Merchant .
description_long: Harglast Harglast was a spartan stone city and one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Government . Harglast was ruled by a Lord Merchant . In 1479 DR , the Lord Merchant was the dragonborn Belror Tethel . Economy . Stonecrafts and dried figs were the major local exports . Architecture . Harglast was mostly composed of stone buildings made by dwarves , that had an sturdy and practical appearance . The city also had an extensive network of catacombs , sewers , and secret passages that served as sanitation , avenues for efficient troop movement , and covert meeting locales . Some of the deepest catacombs were connected to the Upperdark . Inhabitants . Harglast ' s population was mostly made up by dragonborn and dwarves , with a minority of humans . Culture . Religion . Religion was uncommon in Harglast , like in the rest of the Windrise Ports , and the following of minor cults dedicated to the Dawn Titans or to dragon s , as well as general superstition , were more universal than worshiping the gods , that were a novelty introduced in Laerakond since the Blue Breath of Change .

title: Hargleth Forest
description: Hargleth Forest The Hargleth Forest was a large forest located in eastern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . This forest was dotted with countless ancient ruins that dated back to the time when Eskorn was ruled by dragon s .
description_long: Hargleth Forest The Hargleth Forest was a large forest located in eastern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . This forest was dotted with countless ancient ruins that dated back to the time when Eskorn was ruled by dragon s . The area was inhabited only by monsters and outlaws , and all roads and trails in Eskorn faded away in the forest . The forest was good for hunting , either for sport or for food , and hunters from nearby Mistshaws usually hired adventurers to deal with monsters or bandits hiding in the forest .

title: Hargrid Tenslayer
description: Hargrid Tenslayer Hargrid Tenslayer was the Tharchion of Laprendar in Thay in 1357 DR . History . Hargrid was a merchant from Phsant in Thesk but after killing the child of the local ruler he fled to Thay .
description_long: Hargrid Tenslayer Hargrid Tenslayer was the Tharchion of Laprendar in Thay in 1357 DR . History . Hargrid was a merchant from Phsant in Thesk but after killing the child of the local ruler he fled to Thay . He distinguished himself during a disastrous invasion of Rashemen and was made autarch of Falls . When the tharchion of Laprendar died an accidental death by poison , Hargrid was unanimously made his successor . He was heavily involved in the Salamander War .

title: Hariah Highkin
description: Hariah Highkin Hariah Highkin was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . After previous turmoil , Doegan fell into the safe and steady hands of Hariah Highkin . The capital prospered , the borders held firm , and people were happy .
description_long: Hariah Highkin Hariah Highkin was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . After previous turmoil , Doegan fell into the safe and steady hands of Hariah Highkin . The capital prospered , the borders held firm , and people were happy . Nevertheless , on a quest to unify the wartorn Utter East through conquest , the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned and tried to conquer Doegan , no matter the cost to the realm .

title: Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul
description: Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul was the military commander of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Harijo was a valiant adventurer , defeating many monsters .
description_long: Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul was the military commander of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Harijo was a valiant adventurer , defeating many monsters . After retiring , he joined the Bavanese army and rose through the ranks until only the king could command him . Harijo was plotting an anti - pirate operation : he wanted to invade Panjardu to defeat the local pirates , led by his old enemy Wibisono .

title: Harim Gate
description: Harim Gate The Harim Gate was supposedly the only entrance into the Royal Harim within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate was constantly guarded by a contingent of the Honored Mamluk Society .
description_long: Harim Gate The Harim Gate was supposedly the only entrance into the Royal Harim within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate was constantly guarded by a contingent of the Honored Mamluk Society . Each member of the Honored assigned here was a eunuch .

title: Harim servant genie
description: Harim servant genie Harim servant genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who guarded harims and entertained the brides and concubines of elite citizenry . These genie s preferred to work for mortals , where they could feel superior and important , but they also worked for other genies performing more menial tasks . Harim servant genies originated as servants of the jann , working in their harims for so long that they lost the drive to perform any other functions .
description_long: Harim servant genie Harim servant genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who guarded harims and entertained the brides and concubines of elite citizenry . These genie s preferred to work for mortals , where they could feel superior and important , but they also worked for other genies performing more menial tasks . Harim servant genies originated as servants of the jann , working in their harims for so long that they lost the drive to perform any other functions . Noble genie s who possessed harim servant genies were viewed in high status by their peers . Description . Most harim servants were males who possessed tall muscular physiques , though they were usually not attractive in the face . Combat . Harim servants had access to a variety of spells , most of which were used to entertain and serve . They typically carried a pair of great scimitar s , wielding one in each hand with ease because of their size . Habitat / Society . Male harim servants adopted a fatherly role toward their charges , seeking to guide and protect them . Female harim servants brought a strong sense of order to their duty .

title: Harimmon
description: Harimmon Harimmon was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . Harimmon was built around an old , semi - ruined castle .
description_long: Harimmon Harimmon was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . Harimmon was built around an old , semi - ruined castle . Background . As of 1479 DR , Harimmon was a decandent town crowded with shady dealers . The town seemed to attract a lot of sellswords , rumors , and stolen goods .

title: Harjad
description: Harjad Harjad was an half - elven " saka " , or water - bearer , inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Harjad was a crafty and clever matrud .
description_long: Harjad Harjad was an half - elven " saka " , or water - bearer , inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Harjad was a crafty and clever matrud . Activities . He spent his time begging coins from generous travelers who visited the numerous caravanserai throughout Huzuz . Harjad claimed that the water he supplied from a leather sack was obtained directly from the fountains of the Golden Mosque at great personal risk to himself . The water was in fact tepid river water .

title: Hark
description: Hark Hark was the leader of a group of goblin s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hark and his fellow goblins lived in the Ardeep Forest .
description_long: Hark Hark was the leader of a group of goblin s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hark and his fellow goblins lived in the Ardeep Forest . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR the elves managed to expel them from the forest . Hark relocated the goblins to a cave near the Nightstone village . Thanks to the cloud giant s ' bombardment , Hark managed to capture the fleeing villagers . Personality . Hark was a reasonable person . He always preferred to bargain than fight .

title: Hark ' s Finger
description: Hark ' s Finger Hark ' s Finger , or Mount Jiksidur to the Nar , was the most prominent landmark found in the flatlands of central Narfell . Description . The peak jutted from the surrounding flat landscape , serving as a useful beacon to anyone traveling within eyesight .
description_long: Hark ' s Finger Hark ' s Finger , or Mount Jiksidur to the Nar , was the most prominent landmark found in the flatlands of central Narfell . Description . The peak jutted from the surrounding flat landscape , serving as a useful beacon to anyone traveling within eyesight . History . The Nar viewed Mount Jiksidur as a sacred place and a gift from the gods . In truth , Mount Jiksidur was an ancient enclave from Netheril , named Jiksidur , that plummeted from the sky in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR and crashed on the plains below .

title: Harkas Kormallis
description: Harkas Kormallis Harkas Kormallis was the senior paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Harkas was a zealot , interested only in the glory of Tyr and caring nothing about his duties as a member of the Kormallis family .
description_long: Harkas Kormallis Harkas Kormallis was the senior paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Harkas was a zealot , interested only in the glory of Tyr and caring nothing about his duties as a member of the Kormallis family . He believed that paladins must regularly go on quests and assigned them to young Knights . He also strictly governed the behavior of his fellow Knights . Relationship . Harkas acted as a mentor for Morus Brokengulf II , who followed his example of cutting off his right hand . He had a bad opinion of Hykros Allumen , thinking the man was too full of prejudices . Harkas however failed to see the growing evil in the heart of his right - hand man , Gareth Cormaeril . History . Harkas was the eldest son of Lord Helm Kormallis but also a devoted paladin and Tyrran zealot , even cutting off his right hand in sacrifice to Tyr and soon joining the Knights of Samular . In time , he became the leader of the Knights ' chapter in Waterdeep and assumed the title of Tyr ' s Champion , devoting himself to protecting the city ' s Hall of Justice .

title: Harkle Harpell
description: Harkle Harpell Harkle Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . Description . He was a little shorter than average , with long , brown hair that stuck out from his head at odd angles .
description_long: Harkle Harpell Harkle Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . Description . He was a little shorter than average , with long , brown hair that stuck out from his head at odd angles . He wore a set of worn wizard ' s robes and had an air of enthusiasm about him that somehow managed to be unnerving . Personality . While he was friendly to the Companions of the Hall , Harkle was also quite eccentric , which also caused most that knew him to be reluctant to be around him unless it was necessary . Abilities . One of Harkle ' s accident - free successful spells was his " Fog of Fate " , which transported the caster wherever they needed to be to accomplish their goals . Upon casting of the spell , Harkle ended up in the middle of the Sea of Swords , but was saved by Drizzt and the crew of the Sea Sprite . While under the effects of the spell , he magically transported the Sea Sprite and crew to Carradoon . As a drawback of the spell , Harkle had his memory of the previous adventure with Drizzt erased from his mind . History .

title: Harkon Lukas
description: Harkon Lukas Harkon Lukas was the wolfwere Darklord of Kartakass in the Demiplane of Dread who formerly lived in Cormyr . Description . As a shapechanger , Harkon assumed a variety of forms .
description_long: Harkon Lukas Harkon Lukas was the wolfwere Darklord of Kartakass in the Demiplane of Dread who formerly lived in Cormyr . Description . As a shapechanger , Harkon assumed a variety of forms . He could become a dire wolf , take the hybrid form of a wolf lycanthrope or assume the shape of either a male or female human . As a female human , Harkon was an awesomely beautiful woman with black , waist - length hair , dark brown eyes and a mesmerizing smile who often wore a gold vest over a white blouse with scarlet tucked into her boots . As a male human he liked to appear as a 6 ft 2 in ( 1 . 9 m ) well - muscled handsome man with a lion ' s mane of black hair and an expertly trimmed beard with a long , pointed mustache . He tended to wear a gold coat over a white ruffled shirt with blue silk trousers tucked into riding boots . He also favored a blue wide - brimmed hat with a feather stuck in it , a belt with a silver buckle and small pieces of jewellery . All of his costumes were always accompanied by a . Whatever clothes he wore , they were always loose - fitting in case he had to turn into his 7 ft ( 2 . 1 m ) hybrid form . History .

title: Harl
description: Harl Harl was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , after the Night of Wailing , he was one of the chieftains gathered by Luskag to discuss the matter of the goblinoid armies from Nexal .
description_long: Harl Harl was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , after the Night of Wailing , he was one of the chieftains gathered by Luskag to discuss the matter of the goblinoid armies from Nexal . He was the most venerable dwarf there .

title: Harlakh Doroaver
description: Harlakh Doroaver Harlakh Doroaver was a venerated mercenary and " ruler " of the region known as the Realm of the Ready Sword . Personality . Never one to be caught off his guard , Harlakh was always planning in terms of battle .
description_long: Harlakh Doroaver Harlakh Doroaver was a venerated mercenary and " ruler " of the region known as the Realm of the Ready Sword . Personality . Never one to be caught off his guard , Harlakh was always planning in terms of battle . It was under his rule that the realm became safe enough to allow for caravan travel . Activities . Watching vigilantly over his " kingdom " , Harlakh watched the realm from coast - to - coast , maintaining residences at either end . He was also known to frequent inns to hear the word on the street , maintaining his secrecy and calm at all times .

title: Harlesk Knowin
description: Harlesk Knowin Harlesk Knowin was the Silhouette of Assassins in the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Abilities . Harlesk was a master of disguise .
description_long: Harlesk Knowin Harlesk Knowin was the Silhouette of Assassins in the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Abilities . Harlesk was a master of disguise . He maintained more than a score of different identities , all without connection to crime or to his clerical path . He even spread rumors that some of his identities were enemies of others . Harlesk ' s mastery of poisons ensured that nobody survived if they discovered the truth about him . It was even possible that he had also achieved status under one of his false identities in an entirely different part of the Shadow Thieves . Activities . Harlesk usually wandered through the eastern cities , mostly under one of his many disguises .

title: Harlotharaur
description: Harlotharaur Harlotharaur was a black dragon wyrm in Amn . History . Once Harlotharaur waged a campaign of destruction against humanity so Elminster defeated and bound Harlotharaur to a deep mountain cavern on the northern edge of Amn .
description_long: Harlotharaur Harlotharaur was a black dragon wyrm in Amn . History . Once Harlotharaur waged a campaign of destruction against humanity so Elminster defeated and bound Harlotharaur to a deep mountain cavern on the northern edge of Amn . In 1487 DR , Elminster summoned him to Myth Drannor in order to create chaos among the Sembia n mercenaries and bound Harlotharaur to that city instead .

title: Harlshoon
description: Harlshoon Lord Harlshoon was a warrior and former commander of Zhentil troops who ascended to become the first Lord of Zhentil Keep . Relatives . Harlshoon had two sons : Asmuth and Manshoon .
description_long: Harlshoon Lord Harlshoon was a warrior and former commander of Zhentil troops who ascended to become the first Lord of Zhentil Keep . Relatives . Harlshoon had two sons : Asmuth and Manshoon . Background . Harlshoon rose to become a commander in the Zhentil army , and then became the first Lord of Zhentil Keep . Harlshoon ' s chief rival was the mage Calkontor . In 1258 DR , while the sons of Harlshoon and Calkontor were away from home , Calkontor poisoned Harlshoon and taunted him . Harlshoon was able to throw a chair at Calkontor , throwing him out of a window to his death . Harlshoon died from the poison soon after .

title: Harm
description: Harm Harm was a necromancy spell that delivered a charge of negative energy , bringing a creature to near unconsciousness and death . Some versions also inflicted a disease on the victim . The reverse of this spell , heal , cured most ailments and greatly restored lost health .
description_long: Harm Harm was a necromancy spell that delivered a charge of negative energy , bringing a creature to near unconsciousness and death . Some versions also inflicted a disease on the victim . The reverse of this spell , heal , cured most ailments and greatly restored lost health . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient of this spell for it to work . The newer version of this spell had a limit on how much health damage it could deliver , but neither version could completely kill a victim or even knock it unconscious . The older version added insult to injury by giving the victim a disease . If cast in reverse , " heal " brought a living creature back to full health and cured all disease and nearly all other ailments . If either version was successfully cast on an undead creature , it acted like the corresponding " heal " spell .

title: Harmun Rapids
description: Harmun Rapids The Harmun Rapids was a section of rapids on the River Rauvin just south of Sundabar . Geography . The Harmun Rapids was located just downriver ( south ) out of sight of Sundabar , just before the River Icespear joined with the River Rauvin .
description_long: Harmun Rapids The Harmun Rapids was a section of rapids on the River Rauvin just south of Sundabar . Geography . The Harmun Rapids was located just downriver ( south ) out of sight of Sundabar , just before the River Icespear joined with the River Rauvin . Description . The Harmun Rapids consisted of a score of black rocks rising out of the river that appeared as fangs . Travel . When traveling downstream , the rapids could be avoided by steering a small craft with a pole or using tow - teams or skilled steering for larger craft . When traveling upstream , a tow - team or many strong polers were required to make it past the rapids .

title: Harndarr Oryn
description: Harndarr Oryn Harndarr Oryn was the High Mornmaster of the temple of Lathander ' s Light . Description . Harndarr had a short and stocky build such that some believed he might have dwarven blood in his veins .
description_long: Harndarr Oryn Harndarr Oryn was the High Mornmaster of the temple of Lathander ' s Light . Description . Harndarr had a short and stocky build such that some believed he might have dwarven blood in his veins . Although he walked with the assistance of a stick , Harndarr was a confident and melodious orator . Personality .
