Possessed of the wits to use his charm judiciously , Harndarr was one who liked to bring hope and a sense of renewal to the people of Dagger Falls .

title: Harnoth
description: Harnoth Harnoth was , together with his twin brother Bromm , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was son of the famous Harbromm . History .
description_long: Harnoth Harnoth was , together with his twin brother Bromm , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was son of the famous Harbromm . History . During the orc and drow invasion of the Silver Marches , Harnoth and his brother were tricked by the half - drow Doum ' wielle Armgo , who posed as an envoy of the Moonwood . Bromm and a dwarf army were led to an ambush where all the dwarves were killed and Tiago Baenre slew Bromm . Harnoth too died during the War of the Silver Marches but the city ' s elders in fear of turmoil hired a doppelganger to impersonate the king , without nobody noticed .

title: Harnrim Starangh
description: Harnrim Starangh Harnrim Starangh was a Red Wizard of Thay usually disguised as a mercenary wizard of Westgate . He manipulated the Rightful Conspiracy of treacherous Cormyr ean nobles with the secret objective of stealing the new spell that Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was creating . In the end , when the Rightful Conspiracy launched its revolt , Harnrim led a small army of fellow Red Wizards to attack Vangerdahast ' s secret hideout .
description_long: Harnrim Starangh Harnrim Starangh was a Red Wizard of Thay usually disguised as a mercenary wizard of Westgate . He manipulated the Rightful Conspiracy of treacherous Cormyr ean nobles with the secret objective of stealing the new spell that Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was creating . In the end , when the Rightful Conspiracy launched its revolt , Harnrim led a small army of fellow Red Wizards to attack Vangerdahast ' s secret hideout . However , Harnrim ' s plot was ruined by a dragon host that also wanted Vangerdahast ' s new spell , but to destroy it because it was harmful to dragons . When the dragons saw the Red Wizards , they decided that they were more dangerous than the Royal Mage and slaughtered them all . Only Harnrim managed to survive the massacre and quietly fled the country in a magical disguise .

title: Haroistem
description: Haroistem Haroistem was a scholarly priest of Lathander . Description . Bespectacled and clad in blue robes , Haroistem sported a thin mane of white hair .
description_long: Haroistem Haroistem was a scholarly priest of Lathander . Description . Bespectacled and clad in blue robes , Haroistem sported a thin mane of white hair . Possessions . Haroistem carried several magical items : " dust of illusion " , a vial of " Keoghtom ' s ointment " , a " phylactery of faithfulness " , as well as a " lens of detection " . History . Once a gold - clad morninglord , Haroistem opted to pursue more scholarly ways of serving Lathander as he approached retirement . He spent his days documenting the activities of other high - ranking clerics of Lathander .

title: Harone Thar
description: Harone Thar Harone Thar was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Harone Thar was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl .
description_long: Harone Thar Harone Thar was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Harone Thar was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl . Every time the location of Rokthorl changed , the dragonborn also moved Harone Thar to an eastern cavern near the capital ' s current location .

title: Haronstin Garulth
description: Haronstin Garulth Haronstin " Leatherjaws " Garulth was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Close One that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . Haronstin was calm , casual , and carefree .
description_long: Haronstin Garulth Haronstin " Leatherjaws " Garulth was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Close One that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . Haronstin was calm , casual , and carefree . Abilities . Leatherjaws was able to consume copious quantities of alcohol without the usual adverse effects . Activities . He drove carts and sold seeds for the Bounty .

title: Harooga
description: Harooga Harooga was the greater spirit of Akari . History . Harooga was the greater spirit of the island of Akari and the most powerful spirit of all the Prioto islands .
description_long: Harooga Harooga was the greater spirit of Akari . History . Harooga was the greater spirit of the island of Akari and the most powerful spirit of all the Prioto islands . However , at one point , she was captured by the evil Opawang and trapped in a pocket dimension . In 1357 DR , however an adventuring party hired by governor Ko Lei Kho to destroy the ochimo also fought and killed the Opawang , freeing Harooga , who quickly destroyed the lair of the Opawang .

title: Haroun Abd al - Jari
description: Haroun Abd al - Jari Haroun Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Haroun rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .
description_long: Haroun Abd al - Jari Haroun Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Haroun rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan . Possessions . Haroun carried a magic sword that benefited from a " continual light " spell .

title: Haroun ibn Abbak
description: Haroun ibn Abbak Haroun ibn Abbak served as Grand Admiral of Huzuz ' s navy in 1367 DR . Personality . Haroun was flamboyant and extremely well - liked by his crews .
description_long: Haroun ibn Abbak Haroun ibn Abbak served as Grand Admiral of Huzuz ' s navy in 1367 DR . Personality . Haroun was flamboyant and extremely well - liked by his crews . Activities . Grand Admiral Haroun commanded 40 vessels that patrolled the Golden Gulf and Suq Bay .

title: Harp
description: Harp Harps could be found in several varieties across the Realms . Description . Impiltur was known for making high quality wood harps , and Selgaunt produced silver - made harps .
description_long: Harp Harps could be found in several varieties across the Realms . Description . Impiltur was known for making high quality wood harps , and Selgaunt produced silver - made harps . Both were available for purchase in different sizes from " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Harpell
description: Harpell The Harpell family was an eccentric clan of wizard s who , for the most part , lived in the Ivy Mansion in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of northwest Faerûn . Despite their eccentricity and their strange experiments , they were well known for collectively having a vast knowledge of the history and geography of the North . Organization .
description_long: Harpell The Harpell family was an eccentric clan of wizard s who , for the most part , lived in the Ivy Mansion in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of northwest Faerûn . Despite their eccentricity and their strange experiments , they were well known for collectively having a vast knowledge of the history and geography of the North . Organization . They were a kind - hearted clan , but their magic was capricious , sometimes backfiring in peculiar ways . As members of the Lords ' Alliance , they were firm allies of Mithral Hall , despite their unreliability as magicians . Scholarship . After the Harpells interviewed Drizzt Do ' Urden about the drow in 1356 DR , they published a treatise on the drow that was distributed to notable leaders and leading wizards . This was known as the " Harpell treatise " or the " Harkle treatise " . The treatise mentioned that drow liked to eat animals that were still alive because it gave the meat a better flavor . The Ivy Mansion . The Ivy Mansion consisted of three main buildings : two that looked like simple farmhouses and a unique , heavily spired central house .

title: Harper agent
description: Harper agent A Harper agent ( also known as a Harper scout ) is a member of the semi - secret organization known as the Harpers , and members are scattered all across Faerûn . These individuals are dedicated to battling evil , discovering and preserving forgotten lore , and maintaining the balance between nature and civilization . Harper agents are the " field agents " of the Harper organization , acting directly to gather intelligence and eliminate threats to the greater good .
description_long: Harper agent A Harper agent ( also known as a Harper scout ) is a member of the semi - secret organization known as the Harpers , and members are scattered all across Faerûn . These individuals are dedicated to battling evil , discovering and preserving forgotten lore , and maintaining the balance between nature and civilization . Harper agents are the " field agents " of the Harper organization , acting directly to gather intelligence and eliminate threats to the greater good . Equally adept at operating alone or in small groups , agents display a versatility that few others can match . They are one of the five prestige classes connected with the Harpers , the others being Harper paragon , Harper priest , Harper mage and Master Harper . Bard s are the most common candidates for the Harper agent prestige class but they are by no means the only qualified characters . Ranger s , rogue s , sorcerer s , and wizard s all possess the diversity of skill and ability necessary to become Harper agents . Cleric s , especially of Deneir , Lliira , and Tymora , are occasionally found in the ranks of this prestige class , as are druid s and monk s .

title: Harper pin ( greater )
description: Harper pin ( greater ) The greater Harper pin was a heavily enchanted version of the " lesser Harper pin " . The upgrade usually happened after an agent had been in the ranks for a few months or after an especially significant mission . Powers .
description_long: Harper pin ( greater ) The greater Harper pin was a heavily enchanted version of the " lesser Harper pin " . The upgrade usually happened after an agent had been in the ranks for a few months or after an especially significant mission . Powers . This magical brooch provided the wearer with significant protection against specific hazards . First , it shielded the wearer ' s mind from all mind - affecting probes or attacks , greatly improving the chance to resist such magics and granting a permanent " undetectable alignment " spell . Next , it shielded the wearer ' s body from being scryed or detected by magical means , effectively granting a permanent " nondetection " effect . Finally , it protected the wearer ' s body from all " magic missile " and granted a permanent " resist elements " versus electricity .

title: Harper pin ( lesser )
description: Harper pin ( lesser ) Lesser Harper pins were silver brooches that were given to new members of the Harpers . They granted the same abilities as a " ring of mind shielding " . The market price for a lesser pin was 8 , 000 gp .
description_long: Harper pin ( lesser ) Lesser Harper pins were silver brooches that were given to new members of the Harpers . They granted the same abilities as a " ring of mind shielding " . The market price for a lesser pin was 8 , 000 gp . After a few months in service with the Harpers , the pin is upgraded to a " greater Harper pin " .

title: Harper schism
description: Harper schism The Harper schism is an event that occurred in 1370 DR in which the Harpers uncovered apparent dealings between the Zhentarim and one of their highest members , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . This accusation caused a political division to form within the Harpers and heightened paranoia and mistrust , forcing many of its members to choose their loyalties . Council meeting .
description_long: Harper schism The Harper schism is an event that occurred in 1370 DR in which the Harpers uncovered apparent dealings between the Zhentarim and one of their highest members , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . This accusation caused a political division to form within the Harpers and heightened paranoia and mistrust , forcing many of its members to choose their loyalties . Council meeting . In 1370 DR , the Twilight Trio called a meeting of the Harper Council . The trio consisted of Bran Skorlsun , Obslin Minstrelwish and Belhuar Thantarth . Cylyria Dragonbreast , the leader of the Harpers of Twilight Hall , was absent due to illness . They called Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun forward and accused him of treachery by having dealings with the Zhentarim . Khelben admitted his guilt and announced he was quitting the Harpers , along with his wife , Laeral Silverhand . His admission led to speculation that he was guilty of other betrayals , and the Twilight Trio spread word amongst the Harpers that he was a traitor . Repercussions .

title: Harper token
description: Harper token A Harper token is a small brooch , ring , belt buckle or other such item that is typically made of silver or , less frequently , gold . It is often embossed with the symbol of the Harpers , or more simply the image of a tree or musical note . Regardless of it ' s form , Harper tokens are used to identify members of " Those who Harp " .
description_long: Harper token A Harper token is a small brooch , ring , belt buckle or other such item that is typically made of silver or , less frequently , gold . It is often embossed with the symbol of the Harpers , or more simply the image of a tree or musical note . Regardless of it ' s form , Harper tokens are used to identify members of " Those who Harp " . When a token comes in contact with a Harper pin the wearer of the pin can identify the token as being valid , or a fradulent copy .

title: Harpers
description: Harpers The Harpers were a semi - secret organization dedicated to promoting good , preserving history ( including art and music of old ) and maintaining a balance between civilization and nature by keeping kingdoms small and the destruction of plant life to a minimum . They considered the elven empire of Myth Drannor shortly before its fall to be the pinnacle of civilized history and strove to recreate the world in that image . Those Who Harp were led by a council of seven High Harpers , who were responsible for most of the group ' s long - term plans and goals .
description_long: Harpers The Harpers were a semi - secret organization dedicated to promoting good , preserving history ( including art and music of old ) and maintaining a balance between civilization and nature by keeping kingdoms small and the destruction of plant life to a minimum . They considered the elven empire of Myth Drannor shortly before its fall to be the pinnacle of civilized history and strove to recreate the world in that image . Those Who Harp were led by a council of seven High Harpers , who were responsible for most of the group ' s long - term plans and goals . High Harpers were elected through the means of secret ballots among the other High Harpers , with the criteria being long time service and extreme discretion in the implementation of their plans . The Harpers have disbanded several times but after each time , they eventually reformed one way or another . History . The idea behind the Harpers was conceived by several Myth Drannan elven military leaders in collusion with a few trusted human ranger s and druid s . The mage Dathlue Mistwinter agreed to lead such a group in 324 DR at the head of a council which also included a ( relatively ) young Elminster Aumar .

title: Harpers ' Hill
description: Harpers ' Hill Harpers ' Hill was a large , bare hill just east of the village of Shadowdale . History . Throughout history , the hill was used as a meeting place for Harpers and elves from the Elven Court .
description_long: Harpers ' Hill Harpers ' Hill was a large , bare hill just east of the village of Shadowdale . History . Throughout history , the hill was used as a meeting place for Harpers and elves from the Elven Court . A number of revels were also held on the hill . Rumors and Legends . Most shadowfolk avoided the hill . Inhabitants . While no one lived on the hill itself , folk could often be found in the area . Harpers , such as Storm Silverhand used the hill for practice and meditation . Shandril Shessair once practiced her use of Spellfire on the hill .

title: Harpsichord
description: Harpsichord A harpsichord was a large keyboard instrument . Description . Harpsichords were popular in manors and castles alike .
description_long: Harpsichord A harpsichord was a large keyboard instrument . Description . Harpsichords were popular in manors and castles alike . They were versatile instruments that could be played by one or two players and could provide a variety of moods , from cheerful to pensive . Harpsichords crafted by a gnomish master from Selgaunt could be special - ordered through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Prices varied depending on materials , so each order was individualized .

title: Harpy
description: Harpy A harpy was a malign humanoid creature with an avian lower body and a pair of wings . It subdued its prey with its ability to magically sing , inducing a trance in those that heard , drawing them closer , and then tormenting them . Description .
description_long: Harpy A harpy was a malign humanoid creature with an avian lower body and a pair of wings . It subdued its prey with its ability to magically sing , inducing a trance in those that heard , drawing them closer , and then tormenting them . Description . A harpy had the upper body of a humanoid and the lower body of a reptile , with scaly , clawed feet and hands . They had filthy , tangled hair on their heads ; black eyes ; and possessed wings that rendered them capable of flight . Harpies had the appearance of female humanoids with grotesque , avian features . The hands and feet of a harpy ended in long , sharp talons . Most harpies were unclean creatures , who had no regard for their appearance . They tended to wear little or no clothing , so as to not restrict their flying mobility , and what little they did wear usually consisted of baubles and tokens stolen from the corpses of those whom they had slain . The feather coloration of a harpy varied according to the region of Toril that they were native to . Rumors even abounded of beautiful harpies found in tropical lands that boasted the colorful plumage of parrots or other birds of paradise .

title: Harrak
description: Harrak Harrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together .
description_long: Harrak Harrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together . They had the same morality as Devlin but kept an eye on their leader to avoid possible betrayals . History . Harrak and his twin Farrak were evil adventurers and members of the Free Company of the Crescent . In 1479 DR , he went with his fellows to Spellgard , hoping to find Lady Saharel ' s treasures .

title: Harrandave Donohar
description: Harrandave Donohar Harrandave Donohar ( or Harandave Donohar ) was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Chauntea . By 1358 DR , Harandave was the high priest of the Harvest Hall temple in Wheloon , and he still held the position in 1369 DR .
description_long: Harrandave Donohar Harrandave Donohar ( or Harandave Donohar ) was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Chauntea . By 1358 DR , Harandave was the high priest of the Harvest Hall temple in Wheloon , and he still held the position in 1369 DR . Harandave died and was succeeded by his daughter , Katriana Donohar , by 1374 DR . He oversaw the temple and fourteen minor cleric followers , including his daughter Katriana . He had a large number of divine scroll s , which were left to Katriana . Harandave was also a famed paladin .

title: Harried in Hillsfar
description: Harried in Hillsfar Harried in Hillsfar , designed by Shawn Merwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Hillsfar , the village of Elventree s , and the Cormanthor forest . Summary .
description_long: Harried in Hillsfar Harried in Hillsfar , designed by Shawn Merwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Hillsfar , the village of Elventree s , and the Cormanthor forest . Summary . The adventure starts off as adventurers stumble across a madman on the Moonsea Ride , just south of Hillsfar . His ravings prophesy strange occurrences around the city and the Cormanthor forest . Upon investigating the sites mentioned , the adventurers encounter demon ic goats , a diseased drow , a disputed spring , an old outpost of House Dlardrageth , and a neglected church of Waukeen .

title: Harrow Ride
description: Harrow Ride Harrow Ride was the name given to two separate roads leading through Harrowdale , in the Dalelands , one on either side of the dried river bed . At the south east end of the route lay New Velar , and the north west part of the route went through Velarsburg before becoming the Halfaxe Trail at Velartree .
description_long: Harrow Ride Harrow Ride was the name given to two separate roads leading through Harrowdale , in the Dalelands , one on either side of the dried river bed . At the south east end of the route lay New Velar , and the north west part of the route went through Velarsburg before becoming the Halfaxe Trail at Velartree .

title: Harrowdale
description: Harrowdale Harrowdale ( formerly Velarsdale and Halvan ' s Dale ) was the oldest of the surviving Dalelands . It mainly consisted of human inhabitants , as well as some elven and half - elven people . Its main town was also known as Harrowdale .
description_long: Harrowdale Harrowdale ( formerly Velarsdale and Halvan ' s Dale ) was the oldest of the surviving Dalelands . It mainly consisted of human inhabitants , as well as some elven and half - elven people . Its main town was also known as Harrowdale . Name . Harrowdale was originally known as Velarsdale , after its founder . At some point before the 1180s DR , under the rule of Orimmon , it was renamed to Harrowdale and then , by Elmaer Oraun , back to Velarsdale . When ruled by Halvan the Dark in the 1180s DR , he renamed it to Halvan ' s Dale , but it was changed back to Harrowdale after the fall of Halvan . Geography . The dale comprises a river valley , although the river , as of 1372 DR , had long since disappeared , thought to have been lost during Underdark mining . The marshy areas in prior times had , by 1372 DR , mostly been consumed by irrigation of agricultural lands in the dale , although , at that time , many small creeks and ponds remained . The land of Harrowdale was suited to berries and vines .

title: Harshnag
description: Harshnag Harshnag the Grim was a frost giant and member of the Gray Hands . Waterdhavians tended to use Harshnag as an indicator that that their neighborhood was about to become a war zone , and to get out of the area as fast as possible . He was also a key player in the conflict between the storm giant Hekaton and the blue dragon Iymrith .
description_long: Harshnag Harshnag the Grim was a frost giant and member of the Gray Hands . Waterdhavians tended to use Harshnag as an indicator that that their neighborhood was about to become a war zone , and to get out of the area as fast as possible . He was also a key player in the conflict between the storm giant Hekaton and the blue dragon Iymrith . Appendix . Behind the scenes . " " , as well as " Storm King ' s Thunder " lists this character as being named " Harshnag " , while the Heroes ' Lorebook calls him " Harshnagg " .

title: Harthos Zymorven
description: Harthos Zymorven Harthos Zymorven was the commander of Zymorven Hall in Rauvin Vale . Activities . Harthos was the lord of the Zymorven family of Silverymoon .
description_long: Harthos Zymorven Harthos Zymorven was the commander of Zymorven Hall in Rauvin Vale . Activities . Harthos was the lord of the Zymorven family of Silverymoon . His duty was to maintain the keep that watched over the Rauvin Road , which was patrolled by the keep ' s soldiers .

title: Hartkiller
description: Hartkiller Hartkiller was the last son of Annam All - Father and Othea . History . His mother deliberately delayed his birth because she had made a deal with Annam that he could only return once his son called his name , but she was then poisoned by another of her sons , Lanaxis , and died .
description_long: Hartkiller Hartkiller was the last son of Annam All - Father and Othea . History . His mother deliberately delayed his birth because she had made a deal with Annam that he could only return once his son called his name , but she was then poisoned by another of her sons , Lanaxis , and died . When she died , she was in the form of a mountain , and Hartkiller still managed to get out into the open from the " womb cave " . One of his first actions was eating a deer , from which he took his name . Hartkiller soon began the task of restoring Ostoria to its former glory , the reason he had been conceived in the first place . Because of his short stature , his siblings would not believe that he was chosen by Annam for this task and refused to help , so he sought help from the human s instead , in return for protection from the giants . The giant - kin ( those fathered by Ulutiu and not Annam ) took Hartkiller ' s side against the giants in the War of the Hart . The kingdom became known as Hartsvale and the area survived in modern - day Faerûn .

title: Hartsvale
description: Hartsvale Hartsvale was a small human kingdom lying in the Ice Spires in north Faerûn . Geography . The realm lay in a remote valley in the Ice Spires , a range of ever - frozen peaks lying north of the Ice Mountains , west of the High Ice of Anauroch , and south of the Endless Ice Sea .
description_long: Hartsvale Hartsvale was a small human kingdom lying in the Ice Spires in north Faerûn . Geography . The realm lay in a remote valley in the Ice Spires , a range of ever - frozen peaks lying north of the Ice Mountains , west of the High Ice of Anauroch , and south of the Endless Ice Sea . This valley contained low rolling hills , forests of pine , and frozen plains . History . The land was cleared of giant s by Hartkiller for the human inhabitants , triggering the War of the Hart . Its first king was Brun . In the 14th century DR , Hartsvale was rent by a civil war fought between twin princes over who would succeed their late father . Prince Camden allied himself with a tribe of Ice Spire ogre s , but Goboka , the ogre chieftain , demanded Camden ' s firstborn daughter in payment . To this , Camden agreed , having no children yet and knowing his line favored males . With their aid , he won the throne . In time , of course , King Camden had a daughter , Brianna , but he reneged on the deal , declining to surrender her . In the Year of the Staff , 1366 DR , when she was grown , an emissary of the ogres visited his castle to remind him of his dark deal .

title: Hartusk
description: Hartusk Hartusk was an orc warlord in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Hartusk was always a warmonger among the Many - Arrows orcs so it was easy for the drow under Tiago Baenre to manipulate him into ousting the moderate Obould dynasty and started a new war against the Silver Marches .
description_long: Hartusk Hartusk was an orc warlord in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Hartusk was always a warmonger among the Many - Arrows orcs so it was easy for the drow under Tiago Baenre to manipulate him into ousting the moderate Obould dynasty and started a new war against the Silver Marches . In the closing stages of the War of the Silver Marches Hartusk was killed by Bruenor Battlehammer .

title: Hartwick
description: Hartwick Hartwick was a small town on the west bank of the Clear Whirl River in Hartsvale . Description . The town was populated by craftsmen , fishermen , and gatherers , as well as by rich traders and merchants , who lived in large manor houses .
description_long: Hartwick Hartwick was a small town on the west bank of the Clear Whirl River in Hartsvale . Description . The town was populated by craftsmen , fishermen , and gatherers , as well as by rich traders and merchants , who lived in large manor houses . Geography . The village was located just outside of Castle Hartwick on the mainland . The village was the western connection of Coggin ' s Rise , which ran east to the village of Stagwick . Government . The town seems to have been led by a group of " town fathers " . Notable Locations . The only significant site within the town was an ancient mausoleum , older than even Castle Hartwick , by several decades . The mausoleum was dedicated to the hero Veltig , a Blood Rider . Rumors & Legends . In 1366 DR , one of the seals to Veltig ' s mausoleum was discovered to have been broken from the inside , leading to many rumors . Some of the Twilight Omen s observed by the giant s in the region were thought by the town fathers to have been connected to the mausoleum .

title: Harug Shieldsunder
description: Harug Shieldsunder Harug Shieldsunder was a dwarf and member of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep . Personality . Harug was called " most cantankerous dwarf in the city , " but was considered one of the guild ' s best tunnel workers .
description_long: Harug Shieldsunder Harug Shieldsunder was a dwarf and member of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep . Personality . Harug was called " most cantankerous dwarf in the city , " but was considered one of the guild ' s best tunnel workers . Relationships . Harug and Laraelra Harsard were good friends . Harug was the uncle of Dorn Strongcraft .

title: Harun al - Rashid
description: Harun al - Rashid Harun al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Harun and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .
description_long: Harun al - Rashid Harun al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Harun and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham . They used this as a front to mark a for robbery . Relationships . Harun was brother to Ramas al - Rashid and Beyab al - Rashid .

title: Harvas Peltsen
description: Harvas Peltsen Harvas Peltsen was one of the leader of Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Harvas was one of te founders of Teziir and sit on the Teziir City Council .
description_long: Harvas Peltsen Harvas Peltsen was one of the leader of Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Harvas was one of te founders of Teziir and sit on the Teziir City Council . In 1359 Harvas knew that a gift from the Lords of Waterdeep to King Azoun Obarskyr IV pass thought his city .

title: Harvest Hall
description: Harvest Hall The Harvest Hall was a temple of Chauntea in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description . The Harvest Hall was the largest temple in Wheloon , but a modest one .
description_long: Harvest Hall The Harvest Hall was a temple of Chauntea in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description . The Harvest Hall was the largest temple in Wheloon , but a modest one . History . The Harvest Hall had a long history in Wheloon , dating back nearly as far as the Wyvern Ferry . It served generations of Whelunians . By 1358 DR , it was headed by Harandave Donohar , a famed priest of Chauntea . He still held the position in 1369 DR . Following Harandave ' s death , his daughter Katriana Donohar took over as head of the temple . She held the position by 1374 . Inhabitants . The temple was led by Harandave Donohar until his death , after which he was succeeded by his daughter , Katriana Donohar . They had thirteen followers or attendants , all minor priests . Services . In addition to regular services , all were welcomed into the Harvest Hall , and it served as a popular local meeting place . During harvest festivals , the temple gave agricultural produce to the poor of Wheloon . Katriana Donohar was usually at the temple , managing affairs there .

title: Harvest Inn
description: Harvest Inn The Harvest Inn was located in Westbridge . Geography . The inn was the favorite gathering spot for travelers on the Long Road , which traveled between the northern cities of Waterdeep and Mirabar .
description_long: Harvest Inn The Harvest Inn was located in Westbridge . Geography . The inn was the favorite gathering spot for travelers on the Long Road , which traveled between the northern cities of Waterdeep and Mirabar . Structure . The Harvest Inn contained comfortable beds at reasonable prices and it offered Derry ' s Tavern and Eatery , which was a renowned story - swapping bar where on any night of the week a traveler might have found adventurers from regions as varied as Luskan and Sundabar .

title: Harvest of Horrors
description: Harvest of Horrors The Harvest of Horrors was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between the Kingdom of Nix and the folk of Vanesci Hamlet . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location .
description_long: Harvest of Horrors The Harvest of Horrors was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between the Kingdom of Nix and the folk of Vanesci Hamlet . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location . The battles were fought in the town and fields of Vanesci Hamlet , in and around the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau , and up and down the Phantom Pass . History . Causes . The bloodforges were discovered in the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR . These ancient devices of war could mass - produce entire armies of golems , eliminating overnight the cost of mustering and maintaining armed forces . Unrestrained , the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East each manufactured great golem armies and marched them against one another , bursting into the Bloodforge Wars . The monstrous Redfang , ruler of the Kingdom of Nix , had developed a taste for human flesh and instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci Hamlet . Yearly , his harpies swooped down from the air , snatching people unawares to carry back to the cookpot . The folk of Vanesci could do naught but live in fear .

title: Harvester
description: Harvester The Harvester , or He Who Harvests for Hunger , was a sinister yak - man who lived beneath Huzuz in the Lair of the Unspeakable in 1367 DR . Activities . The Harvester hunted human prey on the streets of Golden Huzuz .
description_long: Harvester The Harvester , or He Who Harvests for Hunger , was a sinister yak - man who lived beneath Huzuz in the Lair of the Unspeakable in 1367 DR . Activities . The Harvester hunted human prey on the streets of Golden Huzuz . He performed his hunts weekly accompanied by a single earthservant . His victims were returned to the Lair of the Unspeakable deep underground where they were kept locked in cages until the other yikarians began to hunger .

title: Harvester of Blood
description: Harvester of Blood Harvester of Blood was Sunbright Steelshanks ' longsword . Description . The sword had a blade the length of a human arm and ended with a sharp hook .
description_long: Harvester of Blood Harvester of Blood was Sunbright Steelshanks ' longsword . Description . The sword had a blade the length of a human arm and ended with a sharp hook . Sunbright carried his weapon in a shoulder sheath on his back . Unlike most Rengarth weapons , the sword was forged from steel instead of bronze or iron . History . During the Shadowed Age , the sword belonged to the Raven Tribe shaman Sevenhaunt , but after his death the blade passed down to his son , Sunbright Steelshanks by his mother , Monkberry . Appendix . Discrepancies . On page 19 of " Sword Play " the blade is called a " greatsword " , but on page 34 the sword is quoted as being a " longsword " , since the novel was published during 2nd edition " Dungeons & Dragons " , it would be more likely " Harvester of Blood " was a longsword Steelshanks could wield two handed .

title: Hasan
description: Hasan Hasan was a Grandfather of the Everlasting in Zakhara . History . After the destruction of their base by mamluk s from Qudra , Hasan discovered the existence of the fortress of Sarahin from one of his loyal followers .
description_long: Hasan Hasan was a Grandfather of the Everlasting in Zakhara . History . After the destruction of their base by mamluk s from Qudra , Hasan discovered the existence of the fortress of Sarahin from one of his loyal followers . He carefully planned to claim that fortress for the Everlasting . Though thwarted by the sheikh of Sarahin , Hasan eventually negotiated a clever deal where the sheikh would sell him all of the land that would fit within a single ox hide . After the sheikh agreed to the deal before his entire court , Hasan cut the ox hide into thin strips and surrounded Sarahin with the strips , claiming the fortress for the Everlasting .

title: Hasan ibn al - Din
description: Hasan ibn al - Din Hasan ibn al - Din was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Hasan was a young and inexperienced rubban whom Fate deemed worthy of elevating .
description_long: Hasan ibn al - Din Hasan ibn al - Din was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Hasan was a young and inexperienced rubban whom Fate deemed worthy of elevating . He had a passion for adventure and was willing to learn from the more experienced sailors working under his command . Possessions . Hasan owned a " great scimitar + 2 " , " leather armor + 3 " , a " potion of fire resistance " , and a " scroll of protection from possession " .

title: Hasheth Balik
description: Hasheth Balik Hasheth Balik was a rising noble and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Hasheth was a minor son of the late Pasha Balik of Zazesspur born in 1349 DR .
description_long: Hasheth Balik Hasheth Balik was a rising noble and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Hasheth was a minor son of the late Pasha Balik of Zazesspur born in 1349 DR . He was a very competent schemer and information collector . In 1362 DR , Hasheth enrolled in the School of Stealth to train as an assassin but did not remain long , although he learned some very useful skills . In that time , Hasheth also came into contact with the Harpers Danilo Thann and Arilyn Moonblade . Afterwards , he settled as a landlord in the Venazir Lands , where he bought an estate with his father ' s money . In 1364 DR , Hasheth impressed both Inselm Hhune and Alaric Hembreon by resolving a conflict with the elves of Tethyr in the Trade Way and with this he was sponsored to join the Knights . From there , he acted as an agent and apprentice of Hhune in the Zazesspur area . Sometimes , Hasheth acted as an informant for the Harpers but had no loyalty to them .

title: Hasicor Danali
description: Hasicor Danali Hasicor Danali was a male human cleric of Oghma who ran the Leaves of Learning in Highmoon . Description . Balding , tall , and given to a rather severe appearance , Hasicor Danali rarely appeared outside the Leaves of Learning ; his black " robe of many sigils " woven with mithral threads in the shape of many runes was ever - flapping in the wind .
description_long: Hasicor Danali Hasicor Danali was a male human cleric of Oghma who ran the Leaves of Learning in Highmoon . Description . Balding , tall , and given to a rather severe appearance , Hasicor Danali rarely appeared outside the Leaves of Learning ; his black " robe of many sigils " woven with mithral threads in the shape of many runes was ever - flapping in the wind . Personality . Despite his serious outward appearance , the Learned Father was a jovial man at heart with an appreciation for those of good nature . Abilities . Hasicor was more than capable of defending his cherished Leaves of Learning and always made sure to carry an large assortment of spell s thanks to his " robe of many sigils " . In addition , Hasicor had taken time to become well - versed in his elven longsword . Possessions . The High Atlar wore a magical black robe known as the " robe of many sigils " that was decorated with ornate thread . The thread was woven to create dozens of runes that could be used to store spells , much the same as the inscriptions on a magic scroll .

title: Hasoctl
description: Hasoctl Hasoctl was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Hasoctl gained everything in life thanks to his connection with his great - uncle , the Revered Counselor Caxal .
description_long: Hasoctl Hasoctl was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Hasoctl gained everything in life thanks to his connection with his great - uncle , the Revered Counselor Caxal . He entered into the service of Lord Drakosa but secretly worked for Caxal . In 1362 DR , he was tasked with accompanying an adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume . In truth , he would deliver it instead to his great - uncle . Personality . Hasoctl was always worried about something : his health , his wealth , the respect of others , the place of the gods in the universe , etc . At heart , he was a coward , always escaping from danger . However , he considered himself a practical philosopher , particularly in dealing with others .

title: Hasos Thora
description: Hasos Thora Hasos Thora was the Baron of Soolabax in 1479 DR . Description . Hasos was tall , muscular and long - nosed .
description_long: Hasos Thora Hasos Thora was the Baron of Soolabax in 1479 DR . Description . Hasos was tall , muscular and long - nosed . History . In 1479 DR , due to the war against Threskel , Hasos had to cooperate with Aoth Fezim and the Brotherhood of the Griffon in the war effort . He did so , but grudgingly . During the siege of Soolabax , he fought alongside Gaedynn Ulraes and helped to defeat the threskelian army .

title: Hassan
description: Hassan Hassan was a powerful efreeti who patrolled the halls of the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Possessions . Hassan wielded a massive fiery scimitar .
description_long: Hassan Hassan was a powerful efreeti who patrolled the halls of the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Possessions . Hassan wielded a massive fiery scimitar . Activities . He was sworn to slay any male — aside from the eunuch mamluk s also on guard — found within the Royal Harim . Relationships . Hassan began his service to the Grand Caliph when he was presented to Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir as a gift from Adnan al - Raqi . Over the years , Hassan became rather domesticated by the Grand Caliph ' s wives . They often encouraged him to take long naps during which male visitors could sneak into the harem .

title: Hastammer Orlim
description: Hastammer Orlim Hastammer Orlim was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . He had a carefully cultivated reputation of being so powerful that he conversed with deities and gave them advice . Personality .
description_long: Hastammer Orlim Hastammer Orlim was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . He had a carefully cultivated reputation of being so powerful that he conversed with deities and gave them advice . Personality . Hastammer was an elderly , disciplined man that had little sense of humor or patience for fools . He strategically promulgated his reputation as one who conferred with deities so that he commanded automatic respect from those in his business without having to earn it . History . Sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Hastammer was in Voonlar , lodged at the Whistling Wizard inn with other members of his cabal , enjoying food and wine when Elminster , the Sage of Shadowdale , strode into the common room and started verbally tweaking the noses of the Tarntar . The Old Mage looked at Hastammer and inquired with a cheeky smile about the health of the gods . In the stunned silence that followed , Elminster sat on Hastammer ' s lap and dropped the glamour , revealing that it was none other than the Simbul wearing Elminster ' s form .

title: Haste
description: Haste Haste was a spell that caused the affected target ( s ) to move and act more quickly than normal . Effects . A creature under the effects of a " haste " spell could make quicker attacks and dodge attacks with their enhanced speed .
description_long: Haste Haste was a spell that caused the affected target ( s ) to move and act more quickly than normal . Effects . A creature under the effects of a " haste " spell could make quicker attacks and dodge attacks with their enhanced speed . The amount of ground they can cover doubled . Components . The spell needed verbal , somatic and material components . The material component for a " haste " spell was a shaving of licorice root , which could be replaced by the use of a spellcasting focus . History . The Netherese arcanist Quantoul was given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 2022 DR ; it was originally called " Quantoul ' s fastmorph " . During the Age of Humanity , the spell had the side effect of aging the user one full year . Shortly after the Time of Troubles and the start of the Era of Upheaval , that was no longer the case .

title: Hastor el Khafar
description: Hastor el Khafar Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar ran a fighting school at one of the shrines to Tempus in Memnon . In 1370 DR , Hastor took on a sea elf student named Vyaalis , whom he trained in secret , teaching him how to fight on land in exchange for the latter teaching him how to fight below the waves .
description_long: Hastor el Khafar Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar ran a fighting school at one of the shrines to Tempus in Memnon . In 1370 DR , Hastor took on a sea elf student named Vyaalis , whom he trained in secret , teaching him how to fight on land in exchange for the latter teaching him how to fight below the waves .

title: Hat of difference
description: Hat of difference When worn , the wearer is able to assume the role of a first level character of any profession different from that he or she actually follows . Experience gained in this new role is cumulative as long as the owner retains possession of the hat .
description_long: Hat of difference When worn , the wearer is able to assume the role of a first level character of any profession different from that he or she actually follows . Experience gained in this new role is cumulative as long as the owner retains possession of the hat .

title: Hatch ' net
description: Hatch ' net Hatch ' net was the master of Lore and a trainer at the Academy within the hall of instruction at the Melee Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Personality . All drow warrior s had to go through fifty days learning the heritage of the drow culture , and Hatch taught hate and distrust , helping to create some of the Underdark ' s most vicious killers .
description_long: Hatch ' net Hatch ' net was the master of Lore and a trainer at the Academy within the hall of instruction at the Melee Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Personality . All drow warrior s had to go through fifty days learning the heritage of the drow culture , and Hatch taught hate and distrust , helping to create some of the Underdark ' s most vicious killers . History . In his early training in the Melee Magthere , Drizzt Do ' Urden was trained by Hatch ' net at the Academy , but could do nothing to turn Drizzt away from his morals and values he placed within himself . Hatch ' net was still a master of the Academy in 1479

title: Hathor
description: Hathor Hathor ( pronounced " haa " - thor ) was a kind and compassionate member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Hatharia in Thay and that of Hathelya in Unther , she was seen as a caring mother figure to those that followed her . Relationships .
description_long: Hathor Hathor ( pronounced " haa " - thor ) was a kind and compassionate member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Hatharia in Thay and that of Hathelya in Unther , she was seen as a caring mother figure to those that followed her . Relationships . All members of the Mulhorandi pantheon looked down upon Hathor with the exceptions of Osiris , Isis , and Nephthys . Of the rest of the pantheon , the Nurturing Mother disliked only Set and Sebek . Avatar . Hathor usually appeared as a Mulan woman possessing the head of cow . She typically wore a linen dress and collar , with a moon disk suspended between her curved horns . Powers and abilities . Hathor could heal by touch , as well as cause pregnant woman to give birth to twins . She could charm onlookers with simple words and movements , and create milk that could sustain large crowds . She could calm hostile thought with a simple gaze . Other manifestations . Hathor ' s will was communicated through the actions of animals such as cows , flowing milk , or the words and actions of infants . Church of Hathor . The clergy of the church of Hathor was entirely composed of women of Mulan descent .

title: Hathran
description: Hathran Hathran is a special prestige class of Rashemen . Members of the Wychlaran , also called the Witches of Rashemen , hathrans are an elite class of female spellcasters who rule over Rashemen and protect their people against the invasions of greedy wizards of Thay . They develop a bond with their land that gives them exceptional power , as long as they don ' t leave their homeland .
description_long: Hathran Hathran is a special prestige class of Rashemen . Members of the Wychlaran , also called the Witches of Rashemen , hathrans are an elite class of female spellcasters who rule over Rashemen and protect their people against the invasions of greedy wizards of Thay . They develop a bond with their land that gives them exceptional power , as long as they don ' t leave their homeland . They have to adopt some strict rules , like wearing a mask to conceal their face when traveling outside Rashemen or refusing to craft magic items ( an activity that is restricted to the order of male spellcasters ) . They may use circle magic , speak freely with spirits and even sometime use their bond outside Rashemen as they grow in power .

title: Hatim
description: Hatim Hatim the Righteous was a paladin inhabiting Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Hatim ' s outspoken rants against the corruption of Phannaskul ' s nobles gained momentum with the commoners of the city .
description_long: Hatim Hatim the Righteous was a paladin inhabiting Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Hatim ' s outspoken rants against the corruption of Phannaskul ' s nobles gained momentum with the commoners of the city . He attracted the attention of powerful enemies who searched for a solution to their " problem . "

title: Hatim Sumika
description: Hatim Sumika Hatim Sumika was a gnome scribe who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hatim stood 2 and a half feet tall .
description_long: Hatim Sumika Hatim Sumika was a gnome scribe who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hatim stood 2 and a half feet tall . Activities . Hatim ' s shop was located near the Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods . The close proximity to the bathhouses gave him access to the merchants who frequented the establishment . They used Hatim ' s services for document production . Hatim excelled at copying documents , including spellbooks . His eidetic memory allowed him to produce and forward documents to the city chancellor to review . Hatim loyally served the Grand Caliph by gathering information for him .

title: Hatim al - Rakal
description: Hatim al - Rakal Hatim al - Rakal was an inhabitant of the Elemental Plane of Water in 1367 DR . Activities . As a skilled sea mage , Hatim used his powers to take control of the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls whenever the Great Padishate of the Marid abandoned it in favor of other activities .
description_long: Hatim al - Rakal Hatim al - Rakal was an inhabitant of the Elemental Plane of Water in 1367 DR . Activities . As a skilled sea mage , Hatim used his powers to take control of the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls whenever the Great Padishate of the Marid abandoned it in favor of other activities . He entered the Citadel with a host of water elemental s under his control and dreams of conquest in his mind . During his many occupations of the Citadel , Hatim entertained powerful sha ' ir s while pretending to be the Great Padisha of the Marid . His ultimate goal was to create a brotherhood of sorts comprised of other powerful sea mages , hoping to overpower the noble marid and seize the Citadel for good . However , these plans , and Hatim himself , were swept aside like loose seaweed the second the Padishate returned from their excursions . Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari found Hatim and his antics amusing , choosing to banish him each time .

title: Hatred domain
description: Hatred domain The Hatred domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters hatred spell powers . They gain a brief boost to their combat skills versus a single foe . Hatred Domain Spells .
description_long: Hatred domain The Hatred domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters hatred spell powers . They gain a brief boost to their combat skills versus a single foe . Hatred Domain Spells . Once per day , divine spellcasters with the Hatred domain could cast one domain spell for each spell level they had achieved .

title: Haundrae Duir
description: Haundrae Duir Haundrae Duir was part - owner , cook , brewer , and host at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . A former warrior , tall and strong , but some of his muscle had turned to fat .
description_long: Haundrae Duir Haundrae Duir was part - owner , cook , brewer , and host at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . A former warrior , tall and strong , but some of his muscle had turned to fat . Personality . Haundrae was a great bear of a man , moving slowly and deliberately , with a stern demeanor . He loved cheese and kept the pantry full of as many different varieties as he could get from traders that did business in Voonlar . Abilities . He was still quite strong and very good with a throwing axe . He brewed a heavy , dark ale from nuts that was popular with some guests . Relationships . The Three Elves was a very popular inn throughout the Moonsea region and its owner / operators were highly regarded .

title: Haunted Halls
description: Haunted Halls The Haunted Halls is a legendary dungeon located in Starwater Gorge , north of the Cormyrean town of Eveningstar . The entrance to the Halls is located on the east side of the gorge . History .
description_long: Haunted Halls The Haunted Halls is a legendary dungeon located in Starwater Gorge , north of the Cormyrean town of Eveningstar . The entrance to the Halls is located on the east side of the gorge . History . The Haunted Halls were built by dwarves for the human bandit lord Rivior sometime in the mid 1200s DR . Rivior was then slain by the Warrior - Queen Enchara of Esparin and the Halls were deserted for a time . Soon the Halls became home to monsters and evil mage s , followed quickly by adventurers . The number of violent deaths in the former bandit hold led to a large amount of undead and gave the place its current name . The Knights of Myth Drannor are famous for exploring the Halls in their forays .

title: Haunted Lands
description: Haunted Lands The Haunted Lands were the eastern and greater of the two large deserts that dominated the elevated interior of Zakhara . History . After a distant history of opposing kingdoms , the Haunted Lands were only thinly populated by several enlightened tribes of nomadic herders ( called Al - Badia in Midani ) and a number of small groups of savage nomads with more sinister trades .
description_long: Haunted Lands The Haunted Lands were the eastern and greater of the two large deserts that dominated the elevated interior of Zakhara . History . After a distant history of opposing kingdoms , the Haunted Lands were only thinly populated by several enlightened tribes of nomadic herders ( called Al - Badia in Midani ) and a number of small groups of savage nomads with more sinister trades . Rumors and Legends . Writings in a savage language could be found on the walls of the ruins in the Haunted Lands . Some of it was magically deciphered by scholars and identified as the dead language called Chun .

title: Havarlan
description: Havarlan Havarlan was a silver dragon who devoted herself to Xymor and led the Talons of Justice as its " Barb " . History . In 1373 DR , she send two of her Talons , Azhaq and Moonwing to capture the song dragon Karasendrieth under orders of the King of Justice Lareth for defiance of council ' s decisions about the abnormal Rage of Dragons of that year .
description_long: Havarlan Havarlan was a silver dragon who devoted herself to Xymor and led the Talons of Justice as its " Barb " . History . In 1373 DR , she send two of her Talons , Azhaq and Moonwing to capture the song dragon Karasendrieth under orders of the King of Justice Lareth for defiance of council ' s decisions about the abnormal Rage of Dragons of that year . When the gold dragon King Lareth and his lieutenant Tamarand challenged each other over whether to help humanoid races against the , Havarlan was chosen to be one of the witnesses of the duel , the other being the powerful gold spellcaster , Larendrammagar . After , being decided to help the humanoid races , Havarlan led a metallic dragon s storm to broke the siege of chromatic dragon s to Monastery of the Yellow Rose . In the final battle against Sammaster , Havarlan led all her Talons against the draconic horde of Sammaster and despite the victory Havarlan and most of the Talons died in the fight .

title: Havell
description: Havell Havell was a merchant in Shussel in 1357 DR . History . Havell was unveiled as a fraud by a foreign merchant ( probably from Durpar ) .
description_long: Havell Havell was a merchant in Shussel in 1357 DR . History . Havell was unveiled as a fraud by a foreign merchant ( probably from Durpar ) . In 1357 DR , Havell discovered a cache of magic potions that enabled him to turn ethereal for a time while wielding a non - ethereal object . He used those potions to start a killing spree among the foreign merchants of the city . Personality . Havell hated all foreigners after his humiliation .

title: Havilar
description: Havilar Havilar was a tiefling fighter who grew up in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . As an infant , Havilar and her twin sister Farideh were left in a basket at the village gate and were adopted by a clanless dragonborn warrior named Mehen . In 1477 DR Havilar was in a barn attempting to summon an imp when she accidentally summoned a cambion from Malbolge named Lorcan .
description_long: Havilar Havilar was a tiefling fighter who grew up in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . As an infant , Havilar and her twin sister Farideh were left in a basket at the village gate and were adopted by a clanless dragonborn warrior named Mehen . In 1477 DR Havilar was in a barn attempting to summon an imp when she accidentally summoned a cambion from Malbolge named Lorcan . Her twin Farideh was tricked by Lorcan into entering a warlock pact . When Lorcan returned to his home plane he caused an explosion which leveled the barn and resulted in Havilar , Farideh and Mehen ’ s expulsion from the village . After Havi and her family were kicked out of Arush Vayem , they began working as bounty hunters . While pursuing a bounty on a Tormite priestess on the Sword Coast , they aided a caravan under attack by orc s and befriended a young runaway Tormite acolyte named Brin who was travelling with the caravan to Neverwinter . Brin was the target of Havi ’ s bounty who was attempting to return him to Cormyr . Brin convinced the trio that they should travel to Neverwinter and wait for the priestess to show up at the Tormite temple .

title: Hawa
description: Hawa Hawa , also known as City of Chaos and the City of Stilts , was the only important settlement within the Genie ' s Turban in the Corsair Domains . History . Circa 1357 DR a fleet of the mamluk s of Qudra tries to take control of the city .
description_long: Hawa Hawa , also known as City of Chaos and the City of Stilts , was the only important settlement within the Genie ' s Turban in the Corsair Domains . History . Circa 1357 DR a fleet of the mamluk s of Qudra tries to take control of the city . The attack is beaten back with severe losses to the Qudran navy , an event that is still celebrated every year by Hawa ' s citizens . Around 1367 DR , Grima al - Auni , the hill giant cleric of Kor fought against an increasing number of Istishia cultists in the city . Inhabitants . The city had a reputation as a rough place of independent and sometimes ferocious inhabitants , many of whom were involved in piracy . Despite this reputation , most of Hawa ' s residents considered themselves to be enlightened and civilized . Hawa boasted mosques to Hakiyah , Kor and Najm . Hawa was also called the " City of Stilts " by its residents , for many of its houses were built directly over the water .

title: Hawk
description: Hawk A hawk was a bird with excellent vision and a long tail . Ecology . Hawks were predatory birds that were native to the natural world .
description_long: Hawk A hawk was a bird with excellent vision and a long tail . Ecology . Hawks were predatory birds that were native to the natural world . These animals flew through the sky in search of prey , which included small animals , lizards , snakes , and vermin . Training . Some of the best - trained hawks were trained by the elven House Korianthil . Hawks could be trained as hunting companions if raised from chicks and properly instructed .

title: Hawk ' s Isle
description: Hawk ' s Isle Hawk ' s Isle is a forest - covered island in the Pirate Isles . Its inhabitants are horribly deformed after a plague struck the island at some point in the past . The island has the remains of more than twelve harbours , but the inhabitants only have the ability to use canoes .
description_long: Hawk ' s Isle Hawk ' s Isle is a forest - covered island in the Pirate Isles . Its inhabitants are horribly deformed after a plague struck the island at some point in the past . The island has the remains of more than twelve harbours , but the inhabitants only have the ability to use canoes . Wildlife is abundant . The island takes its name from Hawk , a pirate who used the island as his hold whilst competing with Immurk .

title: Hawk ' s Nest
description: Hawk ' s Nest Hawk ' s Nest was a small watchtower near the top of the Silverymoon Pass . Geography . Travelers on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar were often pressed hard to reach the shelter of the watchtower before nightfall .
description_long: Hawk ' s Nest Hawk ' s Nest was a small watchtower near the top of the Silverymoon Pass . Geography . Travelers on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar were often pressed hard to reach the shelter of the watchtower before nightfall . Defense . The watchtower was usually manned by a dozen Knights in Silver during the months when the Silverymoon Pass was in heavy use .

title: Hawklin
description: Hawklin Hawklin was a noble house of Cormyr active in the 14th and 15th centuries DR . History . Generations of Hawklins served in the Purple Dragons or adventured in service to the Crown of Cormyr .
description_long: Hawklin Hawklin was a noble house of Cormyr active in the 14th and 15th centuries DR . History . Generations of Hawklins served in the Purple Dragons or adventured in service to the Crown of Cormyr . However , they achieved noble status relatively late compared to most other noble families . The Hawklins were ennobled by Azoun III . In the 1360s DR , the then family head Barandos Hawklin was only the third generation of the family to be treated as nobility . Heading Crown - chartered adventuring companies , he had distinguished himself on adventurers in the Stonelands and Hullack Forest . He was a favorite at court thanks to his charm and wit . The Hawklins were a prominent family around 1479 DR . The family was militaristic and advocated increasing military spending to fight a war against Netheril , which they believed was inevitable . Base of Operations . The family was based in Suzail at Hawklin House and had holdings in Thunderstone . Activities . The family lacked estates and businesses that yielded an income , but rumors claimed the vaults of Hawklin House contained much wealth won or looted from adventuring as well as riches gained in rewards .

title: Hawksroost
description: Hawksroost Hawksroost was a village that lay south of Ilinvur in the Ride in north Faerûn . It was once the home of Daern , a warrior who fought alongside the Ilmatari priest Flaergon of Glister and figured highly in the tale of the " Tome of Torment " . After 1299 DR , Hawkroost was destroyed in a series of ogre attacks .
description_long: Hawksroost Hawksroost was a village that lay south of Ilinvur in the Ride in north Faerûn . It was once the home of Daern , a warrior who fought alongside the Ilmatari priest Flaergon of Glister and figured highly in the tale of the " Tome of Torment " . After 1299 DR , Hawkroost was destroyed in a series of ogre attacks .

title: Hawkwing ' s Brook
description: Hawkwing ' s Brook Hawkwing ' s Brook was a tributary of the Sulduskoon River in Tethyr . Geography . The brook began in the Starspire Mountains and flowed down through County Uluran to join the great Sulduskoon .
description_long: Hawkwing ' s Brook Hawkwing ' s Brook was a tributary of the Sulduskoon River in Tethyr . Geography . The brook began in the Starspire Mountains and flowed down through County Uluran to join the great Sulduskoon . History . The brook used to be called Banshee ' s Brook or Tethir Brook until a brave , young elven warrior woman called Hawkwing lost her life here in 1364 DR defending the Forest of Tethir against those corrupting it .

title: Hawthidon Faalwun
description: Hawthidon Faalwun Hawthidon Faalwun was a private in Dagult Neverember ' s army in Neverwinter . History . Hawthidon fought the undead minions of Valindra Shadowmantle ; for this task he recruited an adventurer new to the city .
description_long: Hawthidon Faalwun Hawthidon Faalwun was a private in Dagult Neverember ' s army in Neverwinter . History . Hawthidon fought the undead minions of Valindra Shadowmantle ; for this task he recruited an adventurer new to the city . Later he was part of the contingent gathered to stop the Nashers in the Blacklake District and Hawthidon again recruited the same adventurer to help .

title: Hayfa al - Simbaya
description: Hayfa al - Simbaya Hayfa al - Simbaya was a the Sultana of Simbaya in north Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Hayfa was a beautiful woman who possessed long black hair .
description_long: Hayfa al - Simbaya Hayfa al - Simbaya was a the Sultana of Simbaya in north Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Hayfa was a beautiful woman who possessed long black hair . Personality . She was incredibly vain . Relationships . Hayfa formed a symbiotic relationship with a vizier ' s turban named Saghirah .

title: Haz
description: Haz Haz was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla , Amn . He was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix .
description_long: Haz Haz was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla , Amn . He was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix . Gameplay . If the player sided with the vampires , then Bodhi sent them to kill Haz in order to gain the key for Aran Linvail ' s base . If the player sided with Aran Linvail , Haz would be waiting in the Lower Tombs of the Athkatla Graveyard with a golem , willing to help them defeat Bodhi .

title: Hazamarch
description: Hazamarch Hazamarch was one of the Golden Marches of Tethyr . It was an agriculturally focused county and struggled with competing monster populations . Description .
description_long: Hazamarch Hazamarch was one of the Golden Marches of Tethyr . It was an agriculturally focused county and struggled with competing monster populations . Description . Monster hunters and adventurers were very welcome in Hazamarch . A high population of monsters lived in the area , particularly goblinoid s , and there were few settlements to produce troops to keep them at bay or trade roads for such troops to patrol . Hazamarch produced barley , millet , and cattle . Geography . County Hazamarch was located in the northeast of Tethyr . It was bordered on the west by county Varyth of the Crown Lands . To the north and east were Valashar and county Morninggold on the other side of the River Ith . The River Ith also formed the southern border , and on the other side was the of Suretmarch . The most interesting geological feature in Hazamarch was the Gorge of the Fallen Idol , a steep - walled canyon carved by the River Ith as the river turned west to flow toward the sea . Government . In 1370 DR , the moody paladin of the Order of the Silver Chalice and Marchlord of Tethyr , Rikos Dughol , was the count of Hazamarch . His fortress was Iltarghal Keep .

title: Hazamir al Aktorral
description: Hazamir al Aktorral Hazamir al Aktorral ( also spelled al - Aktorral and el Aktorral ) was a wizard and the Caleph of Calimshan during the Shoon Imperium . Unexpectedly , he became " riqysar " ( regent ) of the empire after Shoon II died in 107 DR , charged with taking care of the realm until Shoon III came of age . Personality .
description_long: Hazamir al Aktorral Hazamir al Aktorral ( also spelled al - Aktorral and el Aktorral ) was a wizard and the Caleph of Calimshan during the Shoon Imperium . Unexpectedly , he became " riqysar " ( regent ) of the empire after Shoon II died in 107 DR , charged with taking care of the realm until Shoon III came of age . Personality . Hazamir was a poor leader of men and appeared to have no interest in his position , preferring instead to increase his magical abilities . History . Hazamir became Caleph of Calimshan at the age of 36 years and held the position for three years . Hazamir was Shoon II ' s companion at the side of his deathbed when he was appointed " riqysar " . The task was beyond him , however , and rather than doing his job , he concentrated on his magical studies while the infant Shoon III was pampered by servants and the military and nobles were allowed to do as they pleased . He only occasionally deigned to " scry " on his political opponents from time to time . He also rejected living in Shoonach and moved his court back to Calimport .

title: Hazaufein Oblodra
description: Hazaufein Oblodra Hazaufein Oblodra was the House Wizard of House Oblodra and Elderboy of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Hazaufein was often mocked by his brother Drizfryn Oblodra , who said that his ability to craft was the result of being part - dwarf , but Hazaufein always accepted these jests with a wan smile .
description_long: Hazaufein Oblodra Hazaufein Oblodra was the House Wizard of House Oblodra and Elderboy of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Hazaufein was often mocked by his brother Drizfryn Oblodra , who said that his ability to craft was the result of being part - dwarf , but Hazaufein always accepted these jests with a wan smile . Powers . Hazaufein was a very good crafter of magic items . Activities . The position of house wizard was often given little consideration among the psionically powered Oblodras . Hazaufein ' s main duty was to create magical arms and armors for the house ' s warriors .

title: Hazirawn
description: Hazirawn Hazirawn was an enchanted and sentient greatsword of Netherese manufacture . It was infamously wielded by the wyrmspeaker , Rezmir , during the the Tyranny of Dragons . Description .
description_long: Hazirawn Hazirawn was an enchanted and sentient greatsword of Netherese manufacture . It was infamously wielded by the wyrmspeaker , Rezmir , during the the Tyranny of Dragons . Description . " Hazirawn " was a dark - colored blade of Netherese design . It sported a curling guard and a pommel embedded with a purple gem . Powers . As an intelligent item , " Hazirawn " had a personality and moral alignment of its own . It could even converse in both the Common and Netherese language s . Once a wielder took up " Hazirawn " , it functioned as a " + 1 greatsword " when used in combat and further infused the weapon ' s attacks with necrotic energy . Additionally , if the wielder of " Hazirawn " managed to successfully attune themselves with the weapon , then its powers doubled in potency and the blade revealed its deeper abilities . Firstly , an attuned wielder could manifest the spells : " detect magic " , " detect evil " , " detect good " , and " detect thoughts " . These spells renewed each night at midnight . Secondly , when attuned to a wielder , " Hazirawn " became an even deadlier weapon and gained the " wounding " property . History .

title: Hazlik
description: Hazlik Hazlik was a Red Wizard who formerly lived in Thay and later became the Lord of Hazlan in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Hazlik was a rising Red Wizard of Thay of the Evocation school .
description_long: Hazlik Hazlik was a Red Wizard who formerly lived in Thay and later became the Lord of Hazlan in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Hazlik was a rising Red Wizard of Thay of the Evocation school . In his rise to power , he became enemy of the necromancer Thantosya . Hazlik coveted her lover , Orliab , but this was the start of his downfall . Orliab , under orders from Thantosya , manipulated Hazlik and lured him into a trap . Captured by his enemies , Hazlik was tattooed with feminine tattoos , making him a pariah among his fellow Red Wizards . Full of rage , he killed Orliab and tortured Thantosya to death . In search of his enemies , he was claimed by the Dark Powers and arrived in the Demiplane of Dread where he become the ruler of his own domain , Hazlan . He also become one of the most powerful spellcasters of Ravenloft .

title: Hazuth
description: Hazuth Hazuth was a city located in eastern Dambrath . Geography . Located north of Melanith Bay where the River Ammath terminated , Hazuth served as a convenient place for depositing bluewood harvested from inland forests .
description_long: Hazuth Hazuth was a city located in eastern Dambrath . Geography . Located north of Melanith Bay where the River Ammath terminated , Hazuth served as a convenient place for depositing bluewood harvested from inland forests . History . 20 , 000 people of various races called Hazuth home . Many docked their ships here during the violent rainy season since the bay offered natural protection . Traders from distant lands such as Westgate and Chondath would travel here to buy horses .

title: Hcarla Bellwind
description: Hcarla Bellwind Hcarla Bellwind was a Zhentarim wizard of power in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Hcarla was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .
description_long: Hcarla Bellwind Hcarla Bellwind was a Zhentarim wizard of power in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Hcarla was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . He was present at the meeting of the Council of the High Dale when Angruin Myrvult explained to the councilors about strange movements ( in truth Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr ) . When Elminster ' s and the Rangers Three ' s actions started an insurrection against the Zhents , Hcarla was one of the last surviving Zhent wizards remaining inside High Castle . However , he decided to win Manshoon ' s favor by killing Elminster , but instead the Old Mage defeated Hcarla .

title: Hea - Rem
description: Hea - Rem Hea - Rem was the chieftain of the White Worm barbarian tribe in Vaasa in north Faerûn around 1359 DR . Hea - Rem was a big and tough veteran warrior of 50 years old at the time . The chieftain was oft - accompanied by a five - strong bodyguard called the " Kura - winther " , meaning " Worm - Victors " , the elite warriors of the tribe .
description_long: Hea - Rem Hea - Rem was the chieftain of the White Worm barbarian tribe in Vaasa in north Faerûn around 1359 DR . Hea - Rem was a big and tough veteran warrior of 50 years old at the time . The chieftain was oft - accompanied by a five - strong bodyguard called the " Kura - winther " , meaning " Worm - Victors " , the elite warriors of the tribe .

title: Head Taker
description: Head Taker The Head Taker was a particularly deadly tasked slayer genie inhabiting the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Description . Foes who proved to be worthy adversaries were rewarded by becoming trophies of the Head Taker .
description_long: Head Taker The Head Taker was a particularly deadly tasked slayer genie inhabiting the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Description . Foes who proved to be worthy adversaries were rewarded by becoming trophies of the Head Taker . He proudly displayed their mummified shrunken heads across a leather baldric strapped to his muscular chest . Activities . The Head Taker served as the bodyguard and personal assassin of Nar - Aidiya . Given the fierce reputation of both Nar - Aidiya and the Brotherhood of the True Flame , the Head Taker reveled in his position because it allowed him to display his violent nature . Possessions . The Head Taker wielded a pair of incredibly powerful magical great scimitar s called " Widowmaker " and " Firefiend " . Despite the size of the weapons , he wielded both one - handed . The claws on his remaining two hands were coated with a deadly contact poison .

title: Headband of the Binder
description: Headband of the Binder A headband of the Binder was a magic item created by bards of Oghma , the Binder of What is Known . It could also be known as a headband of the lorebinder . Description .
description_long: Headband of the Binder A headband of the Binder was a magic item created by bards of Oghma , the Binder of What is Known . It could also be known as a headband of the lorebinder . Description . This item was a metal circlet of blue - green hue with the symbol of Oghma , a blank scroll , embossed on the front . Powers . The wearer of a " headband of the Binder " was able to " read magic " three times a day . This item was created by bards , and if the wearer was a bard , it also greatly increased the retention and recall of bardic knowledge . It also did the same for loremaster s and the lore they studied .

title: Heafstaag
description: Heafstaag Heafstaag was the hereditary king of the Tribe of the Elk of Icewind Dale . His standard bearer was Wulfgar . Description .
description_long: Heafstaag Heafstaag was the hereditary king of the Tribe of the Elk of Icewind Dale . His standard bearer was Wulfgar . Description .
