When the leader of the Legendary Campaign passed through the streets of Vanesci , Hjerik provoked them and publically challenged them to a bloodforge duel — it was common for such upstarts to challenge renowned bloodforge commanders . Unable to ignore the challenge , they waged a bloodforge battle in and around Vanesci Hamlet .

title: Hjurgen
description: Hjurgen Hjurgen was one of the second generation of frost giant s on Toril . Relationships . Hjurgen was a son of Ottar , the father of all frost giants .
description_long: Hjurgen Hjurgen was one of the second generation of frost giant s on Toril . Relationships . Hjurgen was a son of Ottar , the father of all frost giants . He had a brother named Hrotun , who was the first of the frost giant skald s . Hjurgen had a son , Hjurnur , who was a great hero . History . Hjurgen was mentioned in the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " , an epic ballad about his son Hjurnur Wyrmrever and written by his brother . In that tale , Hjurgen is named as the " leveler of Ranauroch " . ( It was not clear to scholars where exactly Ranauroch was located , but many suspected that it was a region of Anauroch . )

title: Hlaavin
description: Hlaavin Hlaavin was the leader of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1372 . History . Hlaavin born in the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in Underdark as one of the mind flayer ' s experiment ; it was considered a successful experiment and the Ulitharid Thalynsar in 1349 DR send Hlaavin in Waterdeep as leader of a druuth , a band of Doppelganger send by illithid to infiltrate enemy cities ; soon after however Ch ' Chitl suffer a crisis caused by the killing of the Elder brain by a githyanki party in 1362 .
description_long: Hlaavin Hlaavin was the leader of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1372 . History . Hlaavin born in the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in Underdark as one of the mind flayer ' s experiment ; it was considered a successful experiment and the Ulitharid Thalynsar in 1349 DR send Hlaavin in Waterdeep as leader of a druuth , a band of Doppelganger send by illithid to infiltrate enemy cities ; soon after however Ch ' Chitl suffer a crisis caused by the killing of the Elder brain by a githyanki party in 1362 . So all forgot Hlaavin and his subordinates . However thank to his half - illithid nature , secret to all , Hlaavin managed to gathered together the other doppelgänger and also recruited new members , founding the Unseen . Hlaavin ' s plan were to subtly and slowly gain control of Waterdeep and after expand to all the Sword Coast . Personality . the half - illithid part of Hlaavin surpass the cowardly nature common to all doppelgänger ; he is a master manipulator , consumed by envy for those that have more powers , moneys and prestige . Alias .

title: Hlal
description: Hlal Hlal ( pronounced " Huh - LAL " ) was the chaotic good dragon goddess of humor , inventiveness , and pleasure . Of all the dragon gods , she was the most friendly to non - dragons , and her symbol , a single white flame , represented the light of wit . In the Outer Planes she was more commonly known by the name of Aasterinian and was often regarded as chaotic neutral in alignment .
description_long: Hlal Hlal ( pronounced " Huh - LAL " ) was the chaotic good dragon goddess of humor , inventiveness , and pleasure . Of all the dragon gods , she was the most friendly to non - dragons , and her symbol , a single white flame , represented the light of wit . In the Outer Planes she was more commonly known by the name of Aasterinian and was often regarded as chaotic neutral in alignment . She was Asgorath ' s messenger , although she was known for being an unreliable messenger . Description . Hlal manifested in whatever form suit her purposes at any given moment . If she wa s not in the process of playing a trick on someone , she usually manifested as a faerie dragon that glowed with a yellowgold aura or as a happy looking copper dragon . As Aasterinian , she always manifested as a huge brass dragon . Realm . Hlal lairs were mostly unknown , the only one known being Brassberg , located in Nidavellir , a region of the plane of Ysgard . She had at least one lair on the planes of Arborea , and Olympus . Personality . Hlal delighted in wordplay and sophisticated humor , and she was playful , stubborn and vain .

title: Hlam
description: Hlam Prior Hlam was a human priest of Tyr in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Prior Hlam assisted Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar as he presided over the Hall of Justice in Neverwinter .
description_long: Hlam Prior Hlam was a human priest of Tyr in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Prior Hlam assisted Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar as he presided over the Hall of Justice in Neverwinter . Hlam ' s duties included training those who worshiped Tyr in both the fields of justice and marshal ability . Gameplay . The Kalach - Cha could bring Khelgar Ironfist to Hlam to become a monk . Hlam would give Khelgar three trials ( making him angry for inconvenience of having to take these tests ) . Khelgar would have to explore the Ironfist keep for Khulmar , be convinced not to view people as stereotypes and learn why he fought ( done once he volunteers to fight Lorne Starling ) . After the trial to determine their guilt in regard to the destruction of Ember , the Kalach - Cha had to visit Hlam to meditate before the trial by combat .

title: Hlang
description: Hlang A hlang was a Chult an oval - shaped , hide shield , most common in the city of Mezro . Description . An oval hlang was two feet wide and between four and six feet tall .
description_long: Hlang A hlang was a Chult an oval - shaped , hide shield , most common in the city of Mezro . Description . An oval hlang was two feet wide and between four and six feet tall . It consisted of animal hide — often dinosaur hide — fitted over a wooden frame . The shield was designed to be collapsible ; the hide could easily be removed , rolled up , and used as a chair or pillow , while the frame could be folded up for easy storage . A hlang was approximately equivalent to a typical large wooden shield in terms of weight and defensive capabilities .

title: Hlarkus Baltreyo
description: Hlarkus Baltreyo Hlarkus Baltreyo was a lich and the Zulkir of Illusion in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Baltreyo dwelt within the Phantasmal Fortress . Relationships .
description_long: Hlarkus Baltreyo Hlarkus Baltreyo was a lich and the Zulkir of Illusion in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Baltreyo dwelt within the Phantasmal Fortress . Relationships . As a zulkir , Baltreyo was a member of the ruling council of Thay . He was also a strong ally of Valindra Shadowmantle . Abilities . Baltreyo was gifted with the ability to adopt illusory forms in order to battle with different abilities . These forms were based on people his foes knew . History . During the assault on the Dread Ring , Sergeant Knox learned from Rath Modar the identity and whereabouts of Baltreyo . To disrupt Valindra Shadowmantle ' s schemes , he sent an adventurer on a quest to go through a " portal " to the City of Thay and slay Baltreyo . Under cover of night , the adventurer invaded the Phantasmal Fortress and made their way past the zulkir ' s minions to battle Baltreyo and attempt to destroy his phylactery .

title: Hlartenth
description: Hlartenth Hlartenth was a human wizard from the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid – 14th century DR . Hlartenth was a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh .
description_long: Hlartenth Hlartenth was a human wizard from the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid – 14th century DR . Hlartenth was a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . He was under a curse that changed him from male to female , or back again , every few hours .

title: Hlath
description: Hlath Hlath was a city of Chondath . Economy . Hlath was a busy port city .
description_long: Hlath Hlath was a city of Chondath . Economy . Hlath was a busy port city . The chief export was lumber , cut from the nearby Nunwood , under the watchful eye of the Emerald Enclave . Hlath was locked into a minor trade war with Iljak . Government . Hlath was ruled by Lord Darvis Shennelm .

title: Hlaungadath
description: Hlaungadath Hlaungadath was one of the three cities that survived " normally " the destruction of Netheril . Geography . Hlaungadath was the remnants of a formerly great Netherese city in the desert of northwestern Anauroch .
description_long: Hlaungadath Hlaungadath was one of the three cities that survived " normally " the destruction of Netheril . Geography . Hlaungadath was the remnants of a formerly great Netherese city in the desert of northwestern Anauroch . The city landed near the High Ice and was eventually abandoned , but the ruins remained largely intact . It was some 40 to 50 miles from either the Graypeak Mountains or Nether Mountains . Hlaungadath was the destination of a hidden portal in the Dangling Tower in Ched Nasad . Description . Hlaungadath ' s architecture was clearly Netherese , with square column bases and pointed arched windows . The city was filled with ruined domes , colonnades , ramparts , and towers . Inhabitants . The ruins of the city were inhabited by lamia s with their thralls : manticore s , asabi , and gargoyle s .

title: Hledh Hellspawn
description: Hledh Hellspawn Queen Hledh Hellspawn was a female fiend ish fire giant ess who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . Description . She was an enormous demon ic fire giantess with six fingers on each hand .
description_long: Hledh Hellspawn Queen Hledh Hellspawn was a female fiend ish fire giant ess who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . Description . She was an enormous demon ic fire giantess with six fingers on each hand . Personality . Fearsome and commanding , Hledh was considered a capable enough leader to have numerous demons serving her . Abilities . Powerful and huge even for a fire giant , Hledh ' s demonic heritage granted her even greater powers that she could pass on to others of her kind . She could conjure a globe of " darkness " and was immune to all poison s . Relationships . Hledh was descended , via Kurgoth Hellspawn , from Graz ' zt the Dark Prince . She considered the demon lord to be her master and readily carried out his wishes . History . At some prior to 1372 DR , the half - fiend fire giant , Kurgoth Hellspawn sired Hledh Eventually , she supplanted Kurgoth as the leader of the demons and fire giants of Maerimydra . By 1479 DR , Hledh was considered the Queen of the Burning City and had rebuilt much of the former drow settlement to suit its giant - sized inhabitants .

title: Hlethvagi Anteos
description: Hlethvagi Anteos Hlethvagi Anteos was the leading cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Only two things made Hlethvagi happy : inflicting pain and being filthy rich .
description_long: Hlethvagi Anteos Hlethvagi Anteos was the leading cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Only two things made Hlethvagi happy : inflicting pain and being filthy rich . Activities . Hlethvagi led a double life : his public face was as a warehouse operator , carter , and moneylender , but in secret he oversaw trade to Undermountain through a secret passage controlled by his minions . History . Hlethvagi was the leading cleric of Loviatar in the city for a long time . Circa 1352 DR , he discovered the Long Dark Stair , a fabled and long - forgotten entrance to Undermountain . Using this exclusive passage , Hlethvagi accumulated a lot of money . With this money , he lived a comfortable life but also financed a temple for Loviatar , and finally in 1368 DR the House of Pain was completed .

title: Hlintar
description: Hlintar Hlintar ( pronounced " Heh - LIN - tar " ) was a town in the Vast , lying on the crossroads of the Hlintar Ride , between Calaunt and Bambryn , and the Cross Road , between Tantras and Thindilar . It was a located a good day ' s ride from Calaunt and from Tantras . History .
description_long: Hlintar Hlintar ( pronounced " Heh - LIN - tar " ) was a town in the Vast , lying on the crossroads of the Hlintar Ride , between Calaunt and Bambryn , and the Cross Road , between Tantras and Thindilar . It was a located a good day ' s ride from Calaunt and from Tantras . History . Around the mid – 13th century DR , when Hlintar was but a village , Master Merchant Marakus Beindold sought to annex the hills east of the town , and thereby expand Hlintar ' s farmland and enrich himself . However , these lands were traditionally occupied by the local dwarves . Therefore , Beindold invited the leaders of the dwarven communities to the Hornmoot trading festival , welcomed them as guests , and put on a feast for them . But the wine was drugged , and Beindold ' s hired mercenaries had already forcibly occupied the village before the dwarves arrived . He had the dwarves brutally murdered in their beds as they slept . A few dwarves escaped , however , and a tenday later they returned , avoided Beindold ' s guards , and caught him in his own bedchamber to return his hospitality . With their hammers , they broke every single bone and joint in his body .

title: Hlintar Ride
description: Hlintar Ride The Hlintar Ride was a road that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dragon Falls . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Hlintar , Bambryn , and Dark Hollow and ended at Dragon Falls . On the way , it linked with Blaern ' s Trail , the Cross Road , Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and the North Road .
description_long: Hlintar Ride The Hlintar Ride was a road that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dragon Falls . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Hlintar , Bambryn , and Dark Hollow and ended at Dragon Falls . On the way , it linked with Blaern ' s Trail , the Cross Road , Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and the North Road .

title: Hlondeth
description: Hlondeth Hlondeth was an independent city - state at the end of the Vilhon Reach which controlled a region of mountainous territory to the southwest of Turmish . The city had a longtime association with serpents , and was ruled by the Extaminos family , with mixed blood that was not quite human . The matriarch of the Extaminos family was Dediana Extaminos who had a snake ' s tail instead of legs .
description_long: Hlondeth Hlondeth was an independent city - state at the end of the Vilhon Reach which controlled a region of mountainous territory to the southwest of Turmish . The city had a longtime association with serpents , and was ruled by the Extaminos family , with mixed blood that was not quite human . The matriarch of the Extaminos family was Dediana Extaminos who had a snake ' s tail instead of legs . She ruled over the city with a light hand . Her mate was First Consort Ssibalentanamas , a spirit naga cleric of Sseth , who was also known as First Keeper of the Sacred Eggs , his main task was guarding the yuan - ti brood chambers . Dediana ' s heir was Dmetrio Extaminos , who has been connected for a few years with Glisena Foesmasher , eldest daughter of Baron Thuragar of Sespech . . Besides serving as Hlondeth ' s ambassador to Sespech , Dmetrio secretly led the Hlondethan cell of the Cult of the Dragon . He used the cult to undermine his mother ' s rule and increase his personal power so that he could one day seize control of Hlondeth and the surrounding region . An attempt to extend the cell ' s influence to Surkh failed , thanks to the Cult of Tiamat active in that city .

title: Hlontar
description: Hlontar Hlontar was a lost realm situated around the river Tesh and reaching as far south as Shadowdale . History . Hlontar was founded by the wizard Alokkair , who came from one of the survivor states of Netheril after they had been swallowed by Anauroch .
description_long: Hlontar Hlontar was a lost realm situated around the river Tesh and reaching as far south as Shadowdale . History . Hlontar was founded by the wizard Alokkair , who came from one of the survivor states of Netheril after they had been swallowed by Anauroch . Alokkair supported the warrior Hlonagh in subduing rival warlords in the region and founding the kingdom of Hlontar in the Year of the Laughing Lich , 536 DR . Alokkair served as Hlonagh ' s court wizard for a time . Finally , Alokkair slew Hlonagh and became wizard - king of Hlontar himself . Alokkair ' s rule was cruel and ruthless . In 569 DR , Alokkair ' s three daughters led a rebellion against him . Only the youngest survived , forcing Alokkair into hiding in a secret refuge in southern Hlontar — a cave in the Fox Ridge of Shadowdale . Alokkair had long - term plans to reinstall himself as ruler of Hlontar and considered the Zhentarim to be squatters in his kingdom even in 1375 DR .

title: Hm - boye
description: Hm - boye Hm - boye was a Kara - Tur an man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . Though his mother apparently came from somewhere in Kara - Tur , Hm - boye only ever remembered living in Procampur .
description_long: Hm - boye Hm - boye was a Kara - Tur an man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . Though his mother apparently came from somewhere in Kara - Tur , Hm - boye only ever remembered living in Procampur . He lived in a poor and dangerous neighborhood in the harbor district , near the wharves . Though he was no criminal , the city guards often tried to arrest him on sight anyway . Skills . Hm - boye was capable of acrobatic martial arts and more traditional weapon techniques . Possessions . He owned a " ring of jumping " . Appendix . Trivia . " Hm - boye " is presumably a pun on .

title: Hoar
description: Hoar Hoar ( pronounced " HORE " ) , also known as The Doombringer , was the vengeful deity of retribution invoked by those who sought to repay an eye for an eye . He was also an exarch of Bane . He was a bitter deity , prone to mood swings and fits of violence .
description_long: Hoar Hoar ( pronounced " HORE " ) , also known as The Doombringer , was the vengeful deity of retribution invoked by those who sought to repay an eye for an eye . He was also an exarch of Bane . He was a bitter deity , prone to mood swings and fits of violence . Ever since the Time of Troubles , the Doombringer was consumed with plotting the downfall of Anhur , the Mulhorandi deity of war , and to a lesser extent , the pantheon that spawned him . History & Relationships . Hoar was actually the ancient Untheric deity worshiped in the eastern Inner Sea lands as Assuran . Centuries past , he was driven from Unther by Ramman , the Untheric god of war , although his cult remained strong in Chessenta . During the Time of Troubles , Hoar stalked the Old Empires , appearing in Akanax , where he took the body of King Hippartes as his avatar . Then he appeared in Thay to obtain a cache of weapons , and he showed up in Unther , where he slew his ancient rival Ramman . However , Anhur stole Ramman ' s unclaimed portfolio before Hoar could act , earning Hoar ' s ire .

title: Hoard ( demiplane )
description: Hoard ( demiplane ) The Hoard was a demiplane created in 116 DR when five wizards of Cormyr trapped Nalavarauthatoryl in the Grodd demiplane . Unlike the Grodd demiplane in which Nalavarauthatoryl was imprisoned , the Hoard demiplane was far more " vivid " . The Hoard demiplane and the Grodd demiplane were linked via a " gate " .

title: Hoard of the Dragon Queen
description: Hoard of the Dragon Queen Hoard of the Dragon Queen is a 2014 " Forgotten Realms " adventure module for the 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " , designed by Kobold Press and the Wizards RPG Team . The module revolves around the Cult of the Dragon ' s plans to free Tiamat , the goddess of chromatic dragon s , from the Nine Hells . " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " is part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline , and received a direct continuation in the adventure module " The Rise of Tiamat " .
