title: Hobart Bracegirdle
description: Hobart Bracegirdle Hobart Bracegirdle was the leader of the Kneebreakers in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Hobart wandered with his companions in search of wrongs needing righting .
description_long: Hobart Bracegirdle Hobart Bracegirdle was the leader of the Kneebreakers in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Hobart wandered with his companions in search of wrongs needing righting . Personality . Hobart was very able to inspire his fellows and was a good leader . He wanted to become a famous hero like Kane or Olwen Forest - Friend .

title: Hobarth
description: Hobarth Hobarth was a cleric of Bhaal living in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Hobarth was a petty , vicious , mean , and cruel individual .
description_long: Hobarth Hobarth was a cleric of Bhaal living in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Hobarth was a petty , vicious , mean , and cruel individual . He indulged all sensory pleasures but his favorite hobby was sacrificing people to his god ; he liked the screams of his victims . He was terrified of water . Hobarth also hated dogs . History . Hobarth had traveled to the Moonshae Isles from Amn . There , in 1345 DR , after the defeat of Kazgaroth , he allied with the wizard Cyndre to conquer the isles . In their plan , Cyndre was to dispose of Tristan Kendrick while Hobarth was to sacrifice Robyn Kendrick to Bhaal . Hobarth magically sabotaged Tristan ' s boat , but the young Kendrick saved himself . Afterward , Hobarth led an army of undead to attack Myrloch Vale , where many druids were killed and only Robyn escaped alive . He remained there while Cyndre led a sahuagin army against the Isles , and so he escaped the defeat of the evil forces . More subtly , Hobarth managed to somehow resurrect the Great Druid Genna Moonsinger as a servant of Bhaal .

title: Hobgoblin
description: Hobgoblin Hobgoblins are a larger , stronger , smarter , and more menacing form of goblinoid s than goblins , but not as powerful as bugbears . It is believed they may have created the latter two races . Psychology .
description_long: Hobgoblin Hobgoblins are a larger , stronger , smarter , and more menacing form of goblinoid s than goblins , but not as powerful as bugbears . It is believed they may have created the latter two races . Psychology . By and large hobgoblins , like their kin , are considered evil creatures and often meet this expectation . While Goblinoid society is cruel and harsh , some individuals escape it to carry on lives of virtue , though fewer such individuals are hobgoblins than true goblins . Those few who do take this risk and succeed often meet cautious praise and acceptance from outsiders . Those that do are , however , continuously plagued by their nature . Though hobgoblins are not necessarily evil they are prone to violence and hot tempers and find it difficult to be truly altruistic . When provoked , which is often easy , hobgoblins are vindictive creatures who take glee in causing pain to those that injured them . Those hobgoblins who overcome this nature often do so because of the rewards they find in serving good , rather than evil . Culture .

title: Hoch Miraz
description: Hoch Miraz Hoch Miraz was a wizard from Calimshan in west Faerûn . History . " Circa " 1330 DR , Hoch Miraz was aboard the " Golden Crown " , a treasure galleon leaving the Calishite mining colony of Berranzo on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea .
description_long: Hoch Miraz Hoch Miraz was a wizard from Calimshan in west Faerûn . History . " Circa " 1330 DR , Hoch Miraz was aboard the " Golden Crown " , a treasure galleon leaving the Calishite mining colony of Berranzo on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . Struck by a storm , the " Golden Crown " sunk off the coast of the island , and Hoch Miraz went down with the vessel . Possessions . Hoch Miraz was said to possess a " staff of the magi " , a " ring of spell turning " , and a " cube of force " , though the latter was thought to have failed , to account for Hoch ' s doom . These were still thought to lay in the sunken ship in 1370 DR .

title: Hochtl
description: Hochtl Hochtl was a scribe in Far Payit in the 13th century DR . History . Hochtl was a scribe of renown , writing many scrolls .
description_long: Hochtl Hochtl was a scribe in Far Payit in the 13th century DR . History . Hochtl was a scribe of renown , writing many scrolls . In 1282 DR , he recorded the history of a dying warrior who had entered the cursed city of Ixtzul . He also wrote a scroll about the Star Worm .

title: Hodkamset
description: Hodkamset Hodkamset was the most powerful wizard in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hodkamset was a member of The Fangs of Set .
description_long: Hodkamset Hodkamset was the most powerful wizard in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hodkamset was a member of The Fangs of Set . He had many spies in all Mulhorand , many contact inside Sampranasz and an alliance with Zhentil Keep . His current plans were replaced the young pharaoh Horustep III with a rakshasa follower of Set in order to create chaos inside the clergy of Horus - Re , hoping to use this to gave the throne to Seti . Hodkamset also sent a team to search for powerful lost artifact s in all Realms in order to use them in the future war to conquer the nation . He always traveled in disguise . History . Once Hodkamset was Sesostris , a wizard in service of Osiris but he had many enemies , especially among the clerics of Horus - Re , that managed to ruin Sesostris ' s reputation . So Sesostris faked his death , changed his face and name and devoted himself to Set . He became the right hand of Seti , the current incarnation of Set . Personality . Hodkamset was very ambitious and little megalomaniac : he truly was to be the one that bring the rule of Set upon Mulhorand . He was also very devious .

title: Hohengroth
description: Hohengroth Hohengroth was a red dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Hohengroth was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .
description_long: Hohengroth Hohengroth was a red dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Hohengroth was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Hojo Haru
description: Hojo Haru Hojo Haru was the mother of shogun Hojo Kawakubo of Kozakura in 1357 DR . < History . Haru was the daughter of Takenaka Okawa and was married at age of twelve with Hojo Todahiro .
description_long: Hojo Haru Hojo Haru was the mother of shogun Hojo Kawakubo of Kozakura in 1357 DR . < History . Haru was the daughter of Takenaka Okawa and was married at age of twelve with Hojo Todahiro . After the end of Hojo War and the exile of Todahiro she acted as guardian for young Kawakubo , manipulating him to advance the goals of Takenaka clan . Haru also became lover of Yamashita Yoichi to advance her father ' s agenda Personality . Haru was a consumate schemer with a calculative mind and an eye for power . She like the power that now possess as mother of shogun and Haru can do anything to not lost her position . For this sometime she hired individuals to damage Takenaka Sugawara ' s allies . Also she not want the return of Todahiro from exile

title: Hojo Kamuri
description: Hojo Kamuri Hojo Kamuri was a former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kamuri ruled as shogun until retired in favor of his son and become a monk at Namikami Temple under the name of Bentori .
description_long: Hojo Kamuri Hojo Kamuri was a former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kamuri ruled as shogun until retired in favor of his son and become a monk at Namikami Temple under the name of Bentori . However his grandson Hojo Todahiro lost the Hojo war in 1349 DR . In 1355 DR Kamuri become a leader inside the temple because the patriarch Futoro injured and soon he took the role of planner of drill of the local Sohei armies . Soon they pledged loyalty to him . He supported his great - grandson Hojo Kawakubo in his plots to undermine Takenaka Okawa . Personality . Kamuri was an able samurai known for his archery skills . However he look like an ordinary monk by those unfamiliar with him .

title: Hojo Kawakubo
description: Hojo Kawakubo Hojo Kawakubo was the shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kawakubo , grandson of Hojo Kikutake , ascended to the position of shogun in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan .
description_long: Hojo Kawakubo Hojo Kawakubo was the shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kawakubo , grandson of Hojo Kikutake , ascended to the position of shogun in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan . In truth , he was a puppet of his grandfather , the shikken Takenaka Okawa , and his mother . Secretly , in 1357 DR , he gathered families loyal to his clan and once - loyal families ruined by Takenaka . He and his allies waited for a mistake by Okawa to act . Personality . Recently , Kawakubo finally understood he was in a very dangerous position , and he had a choice only between early retirement or sudden death . Not interested in either choice , the young Hojo started personal plots in secret to gain more power and free himself from Okawa . Despite his age he became cynical , adept to lies and subterfuges . Kawakubo was also overconfident in his fighting skills

title: Hojo Todahiro
description: Hojo Todahiro Hojo Todahiro was the exiled former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Todahiro was the son of shogun Hojo Kikutake .
description_long: Hojo Todahiro Hojo Todahiro was the exiled former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Todahiro was the son of shogun Hojo Kikutake . In 1341 DR , when Todahiro was seventeen , his father died following a fall from his horse . Immediately thereafter , controversy arose over who should succeed as shogun . Because Todahiro was not yet of age , a shikken regent was required . If he were to succeed his father as shogun , then the shikken would rule for only a short while ; conversely , if Todahiro ' s two - year - old son were to be appointed , then the shikken would be in power for many years . This division soon proved violent , and the Hojo War began in 1342 DR . Following his defeat , Todahiro and his supporters were exiled to the island of Kanshu , and the young Hojo Kawakubo became shogun . Manipulated by his mother Haru and her father , the shikken Takenaka Okawa , the new shogun was from the beginning merely a puppet to the true rulers of Kozakura . Todahiro plotted to reclaim his position , but he was kept under the watch of Lord Betsui Kando , and observed by spies of all factions .

title: Hol Halstrom
description: Hol Halstrom Hol Halstrom was a farmer and an inhabitant of the village Hilltop in the Silver Marches . In 1372 DR , he called Piper a fool for his rantings on the " coming death . " Piper proclaimed Halstrom would be dead within a week .
description_long: Hol Halstrom Hol Halstrom was a farmer and an inhabitant of the village Hilltop in the Silver Marches . In 1372 DR , he called Piper a fool for his rantings on the " coming death . " Piper proclaimed Halstrom would be dead within a week . A few days later , Halstrom ' s corpse was found at the edge of the village , nearly decapitated .

title: Holang
description: Holang Lady Holang was a consort in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Holang was kidnapped from T ' u lung when she was a child and sold as a wife in Motra .
description_long: Holang Lady Holang was a consort in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Holang was kidnapped from T ' u lung when she was a child and sold as a wife in Motra . Thanks to her beauty , she was bought by the Baron Mukow Jian of Pim Tung as a house slave but instead became his third wife . Later , thanks to her southern education , Holang became Mukow ' s most trusted advisor , and even joining his secret army , the Vian - chi , where she learned to fight as a ninja . By 1357 DR , Holang ruled Pim Tung with an iron fist , with the Jo ' nai Gompa full of her spies and the dzong - pon as her puppet . Her son was chosen as Mukow ' s heir and Holang was plotting to make her husband emperor of Tabot . She often conferred with Baron Phen Do .

title: Hold animal
description: Hold animal Hold animal was an enchantment spell that held one animal helpless for a few minutes . Older versions of this spell could paralyze up to four animals for a longer duration . Effects .
description_long: Hold animal Hold animal was an enchantment spell that held one animal helpless for a few minutes . Older versions of this spell could paralyze up to four animals for a longer duration . Effects . " Hold animal " operated in the same fashion as " hold person " , with two exceptions . First , it did not require an arcane focus , and second , it affected animals instead of sentient beings . The subject froze in place , standing helpless . It was aware and could breathe normally but could not take any physical actions , including vocalization . A winged creature being held could not flap its wings and , if flying , fell out of the sky . Swimming creatures could not propel themselves and risked drowning . This spell was effective on natural and giant - sized animals but not monsters or magical creatures . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were necessary to cast this spell .

title: Hold monster
description: Hold monster Hold monster was an enchantment spell that held a targeted creature helpless . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " hold person " , except that it colud be used against any creature who failed to resist to its effect .
description_long: Hold monster Hold monster was an enchantment spell that held a targeted creature helpless . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " hold person " , except that it colud be used against any creature who failed to resist to its effect . For as long as the caster concentrated , up to one minute , the spell caused one or more creatures to be paralyzed . While under its effect , a paralyzed creature could repeatedly try to break free from the spell . Undead creatures were immune to this spell . Components . The spell required verbal , somatic and material components . The material required was one hard metal bar or rod , which could be as small as a three - penny nail , or a small straight piece of iron . It could be replaced by a spellcasting focus . History . The spell was attributed to the Netherese arcanist Prug in - 1864 DR and was originally called " Prug ' s hold being " .

title: Hold person
description: Hold person Hold person was an enchantment spell that could rigidly immobilize one or a few humanoid creatures for a short time . Effects . This spell worked on humanoid creatures only .
description_long: Hold person Hold person was an enchantment spell that could rigidly immobilize one or a few humanoid creatures for a short time . Effects . This spell worked on humanoid creatures only . Older versions of " hold person " were limited to a few man - sized or smaller creatures , but the new version could be cast at any one humanoid regardless of size . While under the influence of this spell , the subject could breathe and be aware of his or her surroundings through their senses , but could not perform any action that required speech or movement due to being rigidly paralyzed . Victims of the older version of this spell had one chance to resist the magical effect or freeze in place for two minutes per experience level of the caster . The odds for resisting increased slightly when " hold person " was cast at more than one creature . The newer version of this spell was more fragile ; the held creature could repeatedly attempt to break the spell every few seconds with a feat of willpower . If cast on multiple targets , they had to be within a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) cube at a range no greater than 120 yd ( 110 m ) .

title: Hold plant
description: Hold plant Hold plant was an enchantment spell that allowed the caster to prevent dangerous plants from moving or making noise . Effects . All forms of vegetation , including fungi and those magically enhanced , could be affected by this spell ( shrieker s , treant s , shambling mound s , " plant growth " , " spike growth " , etc .
description_long: Hold plant Hold plant was an enchantment spell that allowed the caster to prevent dangerous plants from moving or making noise . Effects . All forms of vegetation , including fungi and those magically enhanced , could be affected by this spell ( shrieker s , treant s , shambling mound s , " plant growth " , " spike growth " , etc . ) . However , the more plants in the area of effect , the easier it was for the plants to resist " hold plant " . Plant life under the effects of this spell could not move , expand , contract , grow , or make a sound under their own volition or magical impetus . However , they were still pliable , not frozen , so wind could still make branches bend and leaves rustle for example . " Hold plant " could target up to four individual plants in a 40 ft ( 12 . 2 m ) square , or all small plant growth ( grasses , molds , etc . ) in a square 4 to 16 yd ( 3 . 7 to 14 . 6 m ) on a side . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . Some druids also required the usual mistletoe .

title: Hold poison
description: Hold poison Hold poison was an improved version of " slow poison " that prolonged the onset time of poison in a victim for days . Effects . The recipient of this spell was prevented from any further harm from a poison in their system for the duration of the spell .
description_long: Hold poison Hold poison was an improved version of " slow poison " that prolonged the onset time of poison in a victim for days . Effects . The recipient of this spell was prevented from any further harm from a poison in their system for the duration of the spell . This spell could be renewed before the expiration of the previous casting to grant more days of reprieve , but at an ever - growing chance of spell failure . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required , plus a clove of garlic , either crushed and applied to the wound , or eaten if the poison was originally ingested .

title: Hold vapor
description: Hold vapor Hold vapor was an abjuration spell that allowed the caster to surround and capture any vapor or cloud that was visible and within the range and capacity of the spell . Effects . This spell created a spherical barrier with a radius of 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: Hold vapor Hold vapor was an abjuration spell that allowed the caster to surround and capture any vapor or cloud that was visible and within the range and capacity of the spell . Effects . This spell created a spherical barrier with a radius of 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) plus an additional 10 ft ( 3 m ) for each experience level the caster had attained , at a range of up to 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) per level of the caster . " Hold vapor " could contain breath weapons , " cloudkill " , " fog cloud " , " incendiary cloud " , the choking smoke from " pyrotechnics " , and similar gaseous hazards . Creatures in gaseous form ( e . g . , air elemental s , djinn s , or vampire s ) could also be captured , held , and prevented from transforming out of their vaporous state , but they had repeated opportunities to break out . The caster had to maintain a steady chant to keep the barrier from fading away . " Silence " , interruption for more than one minute , or moving outside the range of the spell would cause the barrier to dissipate . The spell lasted for one hour or until the caster stopped chanting , whichever occurred first .

title: Holfast Harpenshield
description: Holfast Harpenshield Holfast Harpenshield was a retired adventurer who ran the White Hart Inn in Ashabenford , Mistledale , around 1372 DR . He gladly served all good folk who came to the inn . As he enjoyed the company of adventurers , Holfast freely shared information and advice with those passing through his inn .
description_long: Holfast Harpenshield Holfast Harpenshield was a retired adventurer who ran the White Hart Inn in Ashabenford , Mistledale , around 1372 DR . He gladly served all good folk who came to the inn . As he enjoyed the company of adventurers , Holfast freely shared information and advice with those passing through his inn . However , he was known for sporadically throwing out merchants from Sembia or the Moonsea , depending on whether or not he liked their demeanor .

title: Holger
description: Holger Holger was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Holger commanded the gatehouse of Rivergard Keep .
description_long: Holger Holger was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Holger commanded the gatehouse of Rivergard Keep . History . In 1491 DR , Holger was in charge of the gatehouse of Rivergard Keep , disguised as a sellsword under Jolliver Grimjaw . However , he was confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Holivanter
description: Holivanter Holivanter was a wizard who was quite merry . He taught summoned creatures all sorts of songs and chants . He was known to have talking frog s , and even a couple of winged frogs .
description_long: Holivanter Holivanter was a wizard who was quite merry . He taught summoned creatures all sorts of songs and chants . He was known to have talking frog s , and even a couple of winged frogs . Death . Holivanter was killed when the wizard Dasumia used a magical rod to destroy his tower while he was inside it .

title: Hollow Crown Mountains
description: Hollow Crown Mountains The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that sat south of the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs , just outside the Shou Lung Empire . Description . The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that abutted Kara - Tur and the Hordelands , just outside the borders of the Shou Lung Empire , and marked what was the northernmost border of the ancient kingdom of Guge .
description_long: Hollow Crown Mountains The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that sat south of the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs , just outside the Shou Lung Empire . Description . The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that abutted Kara - Tur and the Hordelands , just outside the borders of the Shou Lung Empire , and marked what was the northernmost border of the ancient kingdom of Guge . The mountains ' most famous features were the Glacier of the Lost King , and the bowl - like valley in the center that the mountains formed , which also gave the range its name . This valley was only accessible via hidden passes . Inhabitants . Unknown to the rest of the world , survivors of the ancient spirit folk empire of Guge resided in this valley and were waiting for the time in which they could avenge their ancestors and reclaim their old empire . However , they were unlikely to do so as they had developed a fear of leaving the valley after having spent so much time there .

title: Hollowbold
description: Hollowbold Hollowbold was a ruined dwarven realm located under much of the dragon empire of Skelkor . Background . Hollowbold was composed of several underground dwarf settlements linked by a series of cave networks .
description_long: Hollowbold Hollowbold was a ruined dwarven realm located under much of the dragon empire of Skelkor . Background . Hollowbold was composed of several underground dwarf settlements linked by a series of cave networks . History . As of 1479 DR , Hollowbold had been abandoned for untold centuries . Not even dragons cared about this realm . The few who knew about it rumored about great treasures still unclaimed in the ruined dwarven holds .

title: Holly Harrowslough
description: Holly Harrowslough Holly Harrowslough was a paladin of Lathander and a member of the Order of the Aster . Description . She had dark brown skin and bushy brown hair that she cut short .
description_long: Holly Harrowslough Holly Harrowslough was a paladin of Lathander and a member of the Order of the Aster . Description . She had dark brown skin and bushy brown hair that she cut short . Her dark brown eyes sparkled with life . She had a tall ( 5 ' 10 " ) , sturdy frame and a muscular build . When going into battle she donned full plate armor . History . Holly ' s father was a faris ( a holy warrior ) from Zakhara and her mother a farmer from Daggerdale . Holly ' s father taught her a strong respect for justice and law , and told wonderful tales of the holy and just knight s of his distant homeland , dedicated to his god , Hajama the Courageous . Both Holly ' s mother and father were supporters of Randal Morn ' s rebellion against the occupying forces of Zhentil Keep , which controlled the dale under a puppet ruler . Holly accompanied her father on raids and helped her mother patch the wounds of others from those raids , so that the young woman learned early in life both the martial and healing arts . At fifteen , Holly joined the Order of the Aster , a fellowship of knights dedicated to Lathander ' s church , which held similar beliefs to Hajama ' s .

title: Holman Frostfeather
description: Holman Frostfeather Holman Frostfeather was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Holman Frostfeather Holman Frostfeather was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . Holman found the humor in most situations , usually lightening the mood with a joke or being dismissive of seriousness . He was the most lenient and kind - hearted of the deputies . Possessions . He wore chain mail and carried a shield , but he could don plate mail stored in a few caches around town if needed . He carried a " longsword + 1 " , club , and dagger . History . Holman escaped from a thieves guild in a faraway city and jumped at the chance to be on the right side of the law when the Bron offered him a job . Sometime after moving to Voonlar , he received training from the Zhentilar .

title: Holt Burukhan
description: Holt Burukhan Holt Burukhan was the high priest of Bane in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Burukhan was approached by Kaanyr Vhok , leader of the Scoured Legion , who asked for the help of the local Church of Bane to overthrow Helm Dwarf - Friend .
description_long: Holt Burukhan Holt Burukhan was the high priest of Bane in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Burukhan was approached by Kaanyr Vhok , leader of the Scoured Legion , who asked for the help of the local Church of Bane to overthrow Helm Dwarf - Friend . Burukhan was not fully convinced and waited for a better evaluation of the situation , but his underling Zasian Menz joined Kaanyr . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Holy Hill Farm
description: Holy Hill Farm Holy Hill Farm was a farm related to the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . In the Year of the Leaping Frog , 1266 DR , Holy Hill Farm was the site of a bloody battle between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater . The holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith .
description_long: Holy Hill Farm Holy Hill Farm was a farm related to the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . In the Year of the Leaping Frog , 1266 DR , Holy Hill Farm was the site of a bloody battle between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater . The holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith . On one side were the Mussum priests and the Companions of the Noble Heart paladin order , and on the other were Waelarn , his followers , the Holy Warriors of Suffering , and the Knights of the Bleeding Shield .

title: Holy Mountain of Kus
description: Holy Mountain of Kus The Holy Mountain of Kus was located in the Hordelands on and within Mount Kus and near Kushk . Description . Along with the Tower of Harmony atop the summit , a vast network of twelve tunnels within Mount Kus comprised this temple to Bimasara .
description_long: Holy Mountain of Kus The Holy Mountain of Kus was located in the Hordelands on and within Mount Kus and near Kushk . Description . Along with the Tower of Harmony atop the summit , a vast network of twelve tunnels within Mount Kus comprised this temple to Bimasara . The tunnels spiraled upward through the mountain from its base , emerging halfway up the slopes . Six roads from these tunnels continued up the mountain to the Tower of Harmony . Inhabitants . Priests of Bimasara underwent dangerous tests within the tunnel to prove their worth . The tunnels were abandoned for a long time since the destruction of Kushk during the War of the Purple Dragon . Sinister gaki took up residence within the tunnels after Kushk was sacked .

title: Holy Warriors of Suffering
description: Holy Warriors of Suffering The Holy Warriors of Suffering were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . Base . The Holy Warriors of Suffering were based out of a fortress located on the site of what was later Castle Dasaajk , east of the Purple Hills in Tethyr .
description_long: Holy Warriors of Suffering The Holy Warriors of Suffering were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . Base . The Holy Warriors of Suffering were based out of a fortress located on the site of what was later Castle Dasaajk , east of the Purple Hills in Tethyr . Activities . The Holy Warriors undertook various dangerous missions and expeditions to cull monsters . History . After enchanting the sword " Dornavver " in the Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR , the Church of Ilmater entrusted the blade to the Holy Warriors of Suffering . They desired that it should be used to battle the spread of evil around southwestern Faerûn , particularly fiend s . " Dornavver " was kept and wielded by the Holy Warriors for over a century . Finally , an unnamed paladin of the order took the sword and journeyed north to the realm of Torsil , then under the tyrannical rule of Uldoon , " the Mage of Fangs " , whose armies of summoned fiend s had terrorized the surrounding lands . Wielding " Dornavver " , the paladin battled through the fiends of Torsil and defeated Uldoon .

title: Holy aura
description: Holy aura Holy aura was an abjuration spell that granted protection against evil . It was the counterpart to the evil spell " unholy aura " . Effect .
description_long: Holy aura Holy aura was an abjuration spell that granted protection against evil . It was the counterpart to the evil spell " unholy aura " . Effect . A brilliant divine radiance surrounds the subjects , protecting them from attacks , granting them resistance to spells cast by evil creatures , and blinding evil creatures when they strike the subjects . This abjuration has four effects : First , the warded creatures gain a + 4 deflection bonus to AC and a + 4 resistance bonus to saves . Unlike " protection from evil " , this benefit applies against all attacks , not just against attacks by evil creatures . Second , the warded creatures gain SR 25 against evil spells and spells cast by evil creatures . Third , the abjuration blocks possession and mental influence , just as " protection from evil " does . Finally , if an evil creature succeeds at a melee attack against a warded creature , the offending attacker is blinded ( Fortitude save negates , as blindness / deafness , but against holy aura ' s save DC ) . Focus . A tiny reliquary containing some sacred relic , such as a scrap of cloth from a saint ' s robe or a piece of parchment from a holy text .

title: Holy avenger
description: Holy avenger The Holy avengers are rare blades well - suited to battling evil in all its myriad forms . They are greatly prized by paladin s . Creation .
description_long: Holy avenger The Holy avengers are rare blades well - suited to battling evil in all its myriad forms . They are greatly prized by paladin s . Creation . To forge a Holy avenger , a craftsman must both be of good alignment and have the " holy aura " spell available . He must also be prepared to expend over sixty thousand gold pieces , and a great deal of time and energy . Use . Ordinarily , a Holy avenger is a " cold iron longsword " . Its true might is unleashed only in the hands of a paladin , whereupon it becomes a more powerful " holy cold iron longsword " . In addition , it provides spell resistance to wielder and allies . The paladin can even cast " greater dispelling " once every six seconds .

title: Holy slayer
description: Holy slayer Holy slayers were elite assassin s within Zakhara who meted out justice based on a specific set of principles and beliefs . Often , just the knowledge that a holy slayer was operating nearby was enough to dissuade those who opposed their goals or beliefs . Requirements .
description_long: Holy slayer Holy slayers were elite assassin s within Zakhara who meted out justice based on a specific set of principles and beliefs . Often , just the knowledge that a holy slayer was operating nearby was enough to dissuade those who opposed their goals or beliefs . Requirements . Holy slayers were always thieves . Bard s were not allowed to become holy slayers . These individuals could be male of female , but some of the holy slayer organizations only had members of one sex . The Soft Whisper was an all - female organization , and the Wind of Fate was all male . Examples of other groups were the Wrath of the Old , the Storm Which Destroys , and the Grey Fire . Role . Holy slayers had as many restrictions as paladin s . They were utterly devoted to their organization , literally created to follow the orders of their Grandfather or Grandmother . All holy slayers were expected to sacrifice their lives if called upon to do so . Grandfathers and Grandmothers often used this devotion to show their power by having holy slayers jump off a building to prove their worth . Any holy slayer who disobeyed a direct order became an outcast , and was hunted down and killed .

title: Holy symbol
description: Holy symbol Holy symbols were divinely powered implements used by cleric s and paladin s alike to enhance their prayers or unleash the fury of their god . Holy symbols came in a wide variety of designs , though all shared the common quality of being directly blessed by a god , godlike being , or the servants of the former two for the purpose of aiding agents of the divine . In many ways , holy symbols were to clerics and paladins what sword s were to fighter s or wand s were to some wizard s .
description_long: Holy symbol Holy symbols were divinely powered implements used by cleric s and paladin s alike to enhance their prayers or unleash the fury of their god . Holy symbols came in a wide variety of designs , though all shared the common quality of being directly blessed by a god , godlike being , or the servants of the former two for the purpose of aiding agents of the divine . In many ways , holy symbols were to clerics and paladins what sword s were to fighter s or wand s were to some wizard s .

title: Holy water
description: Holy water Holy water was water blessed by a good deity that could damage undead and evil outsider s . Evil clerics could create a similar substance called unholy water . The priests of Helm called holy water the " Tears of Helm " .
description_long: Holy water Holy water was water blessed by a good deity that could damage undead and evil outsider s . Evil clerics could create a similar substance called unholy water . The priests of Helm called holy water the " Tears of Helm " . Properties . Holy water was infused with positive energy , which gave it its properties . Unholy water , in contrast , was imbued with negative energy . Applications . Holy water acted much like acid against undead creatures and evil beings from other plane s . If contained in a flask , it could be thrown as a grenade weapon against corporeal creatures , or it could be splashed or poured on incorporeal ones . Unholy water instead damaged good outsiders . Holy water was used in the powerful " resurrection " spell , as part of the ceremony to restore life to the dead . Some users employed an instrument known as an aspergillum to spray holy water . A larger version of an aspergillum , the heavy aspergillum , was also used as a weapon . Production . To create a flask of holy water required the flask of water , five pounds ( 2 . 3 kilograms ) of powdered silver , and the ability to bless water . The process took one minute per flask .

title: Holy word
description: Holy word Holy word was an evocation or conjuration spell that could incapacitate or even kill nongood creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The reverse of this spell , which applied to nonevil creatures , was called unholy word and became better known as " blasphemy " . Effects .
description_long: Holy word Holy word was an evocation or conjuration spell that could incapacitate or even kill nongood creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The reverse of this spell , which applied to nonevil creatures , was called unholy word and became better known as " blasphemy " . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell with slightly different interpretations on who or what could be affected and to what extent . Note especially the alignment differences between the two versions as described below . The evocation version of " holy word " compared the target ' s toughness or experience level with the experience level of the caster and had no effect on creatures that were superior to the caster , but the effects were increasingly severe and cumulative for those equal to or inferior . The conjuration / summoning version of this spell based its effectiveness on the toughness or experience level of the targets , regardless of the caster ' s level , which means that even creatures superior to the caster could be effected somewhat .

title: Home of the Happy Dolphin
description: Home of the Happy Dolphin The Home of the Happy Dolphin was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . Located in the Trade Harbor district , this typical inn had twenty tables filling the common room .
description_long: Home of the Happy Dolphin The Home of the Happy Dolphin was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . Located in the Trade Harbor district , this typical inn had twenty tables filling the common room . Wide windows lined the front of the inn , allowing cool breezes from the harbor to circulate through the common room . Activities . The fish stew of this inn was a favorite among locals . Inhabitants . The Home of the Happy Dolphin was owned by Samsi Farlak .

title: Homeland
description: Homeland Homeland is the first book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Homeland Homeland is the first book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book one of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . On the night in 1297 DR that Drizzt Do ' Urden was born to Matron Mother Malice Do ' Urden and the weapons master Zaknafein , House Do ' Urden was in the process of eradicating House DeVir to become the Ninth House in the hierarchy of the underground drow city of Menzoberranzan . Drizzt was the third male child of Malice , and by all drow laws should have been sacrificed to appease Lolth , the Spider Queen , the evil goddess of the dark elves . However , at the time of Drizzt ’ s birth , Dinin , Malice ’ s second son , drove his sword through the heart of Nalfein , the first son , substituting him as the sacrifice and thus sparing Drizzt ’ s life . The newborn Drizzt was found to be unique by having lavender eyes , an extreme rarity among the drow . Meanwhile , as part of House Do ' Urden ’ s elimination plan , the wizard Alton DeVir was attacked by Gelroos Hun ' ett , also known as the Faceless One , one of his masters at Sorcere , the school for mages in Menzoberranzan .

title: Homen Odesseiron
description: Homen Odesseiron Homen Odesseiron is a warmage and tharchion of Surthay . His standard shows axe - and - boar . Appearance .
description_long: Homen Odesseiron Homen Odesseiron is a warmage and tharchion of Surthay . His standard shows axe - and - boar . Appearance . Homen usually wears wizard ' s robes . He usually has a perpetually dour expression on his face . Weapons . His favorite weapons are his sword and lance . Personality . Homen is a very proud man and takes responsibility for his actions as tharchion of Surthay . History . After a failed attempt at conquering a Rashemi town , Homen ' s army was rescued by Szass Tam and Homen thus sided with the lichlord for Szass ' cause of conquering Faerûn .

title: Hommet Shaw
description: Hommet Shaw Hommet Shaw was a human necromancer from Longsaddle . Personality . Hommet was a young , talented , and eager necromancer , but he was not a very detail - oriented person .
description_long: Hommet Shaw Hommet Shaw was a human necromancer from Longsaddle . Personality . Hommet was a young , talented , and eager necromancer , but he was not a very detail - oriented person . Despite the reputation of most necromancers , he sought a mentor who wasn ' t evil or insane . History . Hommet was from the eccentric Harpell family who managed to get exiled for some reason . He wanted to join an adventuring party in order to prove himself but also make some allies in the process . Appendix . Appearances . Hommet will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Homunculus
description: Homunculus Homunculi were tiny constructs created by spellcasters to act as spies and servants . They were created through mysticism and alchemy , using the spellcaster ' s own blood in the procedure . This blood - link provided a special bond between the homunculus and its creator .
description_long: Homunculus Homunculi were tiny constructs created by spellcasters to act as spies and servants . They were created through mysticism and alchemy , using the spellcaster ' s own blood in the procedure . This blood - link provided a special bond between the homunculus and its creator . The construct was completely loyal to its master and could telepathically transmit anything it saw or heard back to its creator . Although they possessed a telepathic link to their creator , homunculi could not verbally speak . Description . The appearance of a homunculus varied based on the will of its creator . Many homunculi appeared to be winged humanoid creatures , similar to gargoyle s or tiny demon s . Some spellcasters made their homunculi appear more human ; vain mages even made these constructs look like themselves . Creation . Creating a homunculus was a lengthy procedure involving creating the construct ' s body from clay and ash and mixing it with the blood of the creator . This blood link allowed the creator to see and hear everything the homunculus experienced . However , there was a drawback in that if the construct was slain , the creator suffered damage .

title: Honlinar Tempest
description: Honlinar Tempest Honlinar Tempest was the mayor of Assam in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Honlinar was a master politician choose as mayor by both Ormath and Lheshayl .
description_long: Honlinar Tempest Honlinar Tempest was the mayor of Assam in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Honlinar was a master politician choose as mayor by both Ormath and Lheshayl . History . Honlinar can did all he wanted in his city until money flowed unobstructed between Assam and the south . However in 1370 some bandits raided a caravan . Honlinar was responsible for quickly assembling a group of trackers to go after bandits who attacked a caravan in the Vilhon Reach area . Although he recovered the caravan and its good , some of the bandits managed to escape .

title: Honor Reagh
description: Honor Reagh " Honor " Reagh was a female soldier and member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Reagh and her friend Gothwan Cooper , under the orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter .
description_long: Honor Reagh " Honor " Reagh was a female soldier and member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Reagh and her friend Gothwan Cooper , under the orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter . An adventurer recruited by Sergeant Knox tried to recover it but was prevented by having to fight the Guardian of the Nine . Later , the adventurer , thanks to Knox ' s advice , found Reagh in a ruined tunnel near Driftwood Tavern and defeated her .

title: Honor mark
description: Honor mark Honor mark was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to mark targets whom they witnessed performing dishonorable actions .
description_long: Honor mark Honor mark was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to mark targets whom they witnessed performing dishonorable actions . Most honor marks appeared as sharp black marks across the target ' s eyes or down the middle of their face . Everyone knew an honor mark when they saw one and treated the target accordingly . Honor marks could only be removed by atoning for the misdeed that gave them the mark . The wizard who cast the honor mark did not need to do anything for the mark to disappear . Wizard ' s who attempted to cast this spell falsely , without having witnessed the target performing a dishonorable action , would be marked instead . The mark would remain on the wizard until they apologized to their intended target and performed an task of atonement stated by the offended party . Components . This spell did not require any physical components to cast .

title: Honored Mamluk Society
description: Honored Mamluk Society The Honored Mamluk Society , also known as the Honored , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization was tasked with protecting the Grand Caliph and his harim .
description_long: Honored Mamluk Society The Honored Mamluk Society , also known as the Honored , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization was tasked with protecting the Grand Caliph and his harim . Organization . The Honored were led by General Ahmahd abd al - Iffa . Mamluks of the Honored were either eunuchs or women . Base of Operations . Since guarding the Grand Caliph was their priority , the Honored were based in Huzuz and actually rarely left the grounds of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne unless they were running errands .

title: Hood of servitude
description: Hood of servitude The hood of servitude was a magical animal hood that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a regular falcon hood .
description_long: Hood of servitude The hood of servitude was a magical animal hood that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a regular falcon hood . Powers . When placed upon the head of any flying creature , the " hood of servitude " charmed the creature so that it would loyally serve the owner of the hood . The hood would instantly grow or shrink to fit the head of the creature . This hood ' s magic worked on avians as well as other flying creatures such as dragon s and even the mighty Zakharan roc s . The hood never failed to charm when used against natural animals , but intelligent creatures did have a chance to resist the hood ' s magic .

title: Hooded One
description: Hooded One The Hooded One was a mind flayer merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . The Hooded One was curious and quite congenial for an inhuman monster .
description_long: Hooded One The Hooded One was a mind flayer merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . The Hooded One was curious and quite congenial for an inhuman monster . It believed that the prophecy in Evarell ' s journal announced the day when the illithids would rule a world locked in darkness , ending the era of humanity . Activities . The Hooded One usually sold gold , silver , and slaves in exchange for art and magical objects . History . Around 1479 DR , the Hooded One had arrived in Mantol - Derith very recently in 1479 DR .

title: Hook horror
description: Hook horror A hook horror ( also known as a vulture beak , hacker , cave dweller ) is a large bipedal subterranean aberration that looks like a vulture - like humanoid with bony hooks in place of hands . It is an invertebrate arthropod . Description .
description_long: Hook horror A hook horror ( also known as a vulture beak , hacker , cave dweller ) is a large bipedal subterranean aberration that looks like a vulture - like humanoid with bony hooks in place of hands . It is an invertebrate arthropod . Description . A hook horror stands about nine feet ( 2 . 7m ) tall and weighs around 400 pounds ( 181kg ) , with a head like a vulture , a neck of crested feathers , and the body of a beetle , whose mottled gray , chitinous exoskeleton is extremely thick and dense and covered with sharp studs . The exoskeleton can be removed from a hook horror and transformed into tough armor . Instead of hands , paws or claws , its front limbs end in 12 inch ( 30cm ) razor - sharp , blade - like gray metallic hooks , surrounded by red feathers . These hooks are the hook horror ' s primary method of combat . Its legs are similar to those of a bird , and its head is shaped like that of a vulture , including the hooked beak . Its eyes are multifaceted like that of an insect . Combat . Hook horrors prefer to ambush their prey from above . They will work together as a group , and if necessary , retreat using their ability to climb .

title: Hooked Knucklehead
description: Hooked Knucklehead The Hooked Knucklehead was a longstanding inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located near the marketplace in the center of town .
description_long: Hooked Knucklehead The Hooked Knucklehead was a longstanding inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located near the marketplace in the center of town . Interior . Atmosphere . The Hooked Knucklehead was mostly frequented by traders from neighboring cities who came to Bryn Shander for business . The owner , Barton , did not interfere with his clients ' affairs . Services . The few private rooms available did not have any hearths , and were freezing cold at night , also due to the building ' s lack of structure to withstand the cold winds . Most customers slept in the large common room close to its stone fireplace .

title: Hoondarrh
description: Hoondarrh Hoondarrh , known as the Red Rage of Mintarn , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Hoondarrh was a cruel and efficient dragon .
description_long: Hoondarrh Hoondarrh , known as the Red Rage of Mintarn , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Hoondarrh was a cruel and efficient dragon . During his life on the Sword Coast he came to understand that his greatest foes were humans , not others dragons , only human can prevail over dragons thanks to their continue trying ; so he keep a close watch over human activities . In truth Hoondarrh was really fascinated with humanity , their plot , counterplot , dealings , love affairs . Draconic life was no so intriguing . Activities . The favorite prey of Hoondarrh were creatures who had tried to cheat or outwit him . He spend many time scrying life in humans cities . He contained his project to recruit a wizard in order to create renovation spells using magic feminine alias . History . Hoondarrh hatched in the east Sword Coast in the late summer of the Year of Scorching Suns ( 460 DR ) . He was from birth large , vigorous , and aggressive and easily slew his siblings . Emboldened , he decided to confront his parents but from that battle Hoondarrh barely escaped with his life .

title: Hoparatu River
description: Hoparatu River The Hoparatu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Hoparatu River began in the Quang Muku Forest then ran through the southern foothills of the Vorkani Mountains .
description_long: Hoparatu River The Hoparatu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Hoparatu River began in the Quang Muku Forest then ran through the southern foothills of the Vorkani Mountains . Joining another river from the Vorkani Mountains , it emptied into the sea at Xi Hulang . Settlements . The town of Goisho stood on the western part of the river , while the capital city of Xi Hulang lay its mouth .

title: Hope Kellar
description: Hope Kellar Hope Kellar was a mayor in the Moonsea . History . Hope was once a sailor until she retired and opened an inn in the village of Hillpicket .
description_long: Hope Kellar Hope Kellar was a mayor in the Moonsea . History . Hope was once a sailor until she retired and opened an inn in the village of Hillpicket . In time , she become the village ' s mayor . Hope was married twice and was searching for a possible third wife at the time of the Rage of Demons . Personality . Hope believed that the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities caused an increase in her business .

title: Hope domain
description: Hope domain The Hope domain was a divine domain that granted hope - themed powers to a divine caster . Theme . The hopes of people took many different forms , like the hope that a current problem would be smoothly resolved for the best ; the hope that the efforts of the current generation would bear fruit for the future ; or the hope that a child would grow up and demonstrate wisdom and kindness .
description_long: Hope domain The Hope domain was a divine domain that granted hope - themed powers to a divine caster . Theme . The hopes of people took many different forms , like the hope that a current problem would be smoothly resolved for the best ; the hope that the efforts of the current generation would bear fruit for the future ; or the hope that a child would grow up and demonstrate wisdom and kindness . Deities with the Hope domain . These hopes were reflected in the deities who granted this domain . Angharradh and Chauntea both had hope in the birth of animals and the planting of seeds , viewing new life as full of majesty and potential . Although Chauntea disliked seeing destruction of the natural world , she nevertheless anticipated its regrowth and renewal . Ilmater ' s teachings focused on hope , in encouraging his followers to help the suffering , to stand up against tyranny , and to possess enormous spiritual faith . Ilmater persevered and endured , overcoming pain to be a beacon of hope to others . Bahamut had hope that righteous behavior , upholding honor and justice , would hold back soul - corrupting darkness . His faith was in the soul and in the spirit . Powers .

title: Horac
description: Horac Horac was a warrior in Hillsfar . Activities . Horac was the chief enforcer for Margery Thrier of the Hillsfar Arena .
description_long: Horac Horac was a warrior in Hillsfar . Activities . Horac was the chief enforcer for Margery Thrier of the Hillsfar Arena . Along with his assistants , his work entailed keeping the prisoners chained until they were scheduled to fight . History . During the Rage of Demons , some prisoners sold by sorcerer Breex Vandermast managed to escape , causing a riot . Relationship . Horac was always attended by three warriors under his orders . Often he walked in the city with Mags Thrier and her goliath slave - bodyguard .

title: Horaldin
description: Horaldin Horaldin was a druid in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1375 DR , Qilué Veladorn asked his help in investigating a gem found in the possession of a Selvetargtlin aranea and thanks to his power he able to explain some of the history of the gem .
description_long: Horaldin Horaldin was a druid in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1375 DR , Qilué Veladorn asked his help in investigating a gem found in the possession of a Selvetargtlin aranea and thanks to his power he able to explain some of the history of the gem . In 1379 DR Qilué ordered to Horaldin to place inside the Promenade a glyph of insanity that would attract the followers of Ghaunadaur ; he was worried about and argued with Qilué . Later Horaldin explained the matter to the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann . Later Horaldin was killed by Qilué under compulsion from Wendonai .

title: Hordelands
description: Hordelands The Hordelands , also known as The Endless Wastes and as Taan by the natives , was once part of the territory of the mighty empire of Imaskar and was populated by horsemen tribes , most notably the Tuigan s . People . The Endless Wastes were occupied by many tribes who controlled loosely defined geographical locations throughout the region .
description_long: Hordelands The Hordelands , also known as The Endless Wastes and as Taan by the natives , was once part of the territory of the mighty empire of Imaskar and was populated by horsemen tribes , most notably the Tuigan s . People . The Endless Wastes were occupied by many tribes who controlled loosely defined geographical locations throughout the region . Common belief stated that all of the people of the Endless Wastes were the same , but this was not true . Each tribe had their own cultural differences , separating them from the others with vivid clarity to one who cared to look closely enough . Listed below are the tribes of the Endless Wastes : Geography . It was bordered on the north by Yal Tengri , on the west by Narfell , Rashemen and Thay , on the south by Murghôm , Semphar and the massive Yehimal mountains and on the east by the empire of Shou Lung . The Endless Wastes was largely a steppe landscape , too variable in temperature , and too infertile for farming , to make cities viable outside the small lakes and oases that dotted the landscape .

title: Horgar Steelshadow IV
description: Horgar Steelshadow IV Horgar Steelshadow IV was the Crown Prince ( sometimes labeled as King ) and ruler of Gracklstugh . Description . Horgar was bald .
description_long: Horgar Steelshadow IV Horgar Steelshadow IV was the Crown Prince ( sometimes labeled as King ) and ruler of Gracklstugh . Description . Horgar was bald . He wore a chain hauberk and a surcoat of black and gold . He wore gold rings on his fingers and a gold circlet on his head . His beard was formed into braids . During war time , the Crown Prince rode in a diligence : an enchanted floating object of iron , 30 feet long and 10 feet wide , spiked for defense . It served as the army ' s command post as well as the prince ' s throne and bedchamber . History . Horgar was involved in Clan Xornbane ' s attack in Ched Nasad with House Zauvirr . In 1372 DR , Horgar led the forces of Gracklstugh to attack Menzoberranzan with the help of Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin , later joined by the tanarukk s of Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scoured Legion . Horgar wanted power and security against his lairds . Horgar was present at the Pillars of Woe during the defeat of the Army of the Black Spider . His forces subsequently participated in the Siege of Menzoberranzan , which ultimately failed . Upon this failure , Horgar was killed by Nimor . Relationships .

title: Horgar Steelshadow V
description: Horgar Steelshadow V Horgar Steelshadow V was the duergar king of Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . He was a ruthless and canny ruler .
description_long: Horgar Steelshadow V Horgar Steelshadow V was the duergar king of Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . He was a ruthless and canny ruler . His style was to have secret meetings with all the city ' s councils and clans in order to keep their members guessing what he was up to , and he handed out favors out of the blue . He let it be known that he would use any trick to maintain his grip on power . Horgar was known to employ assassins like the Empty - Scabbard Killers through third parties to take care of potential troublemakers . Thanks to this strategy , he focused all the factions on war with others and kept them unable to damage the king . History . Horgar ascended the throne in 1372 DR . During the Rage of Demons , Horgar became infected by the madness spread by demon lord s and Shal , a disguised succubus agent of Graz ' zt hid his madness .

title: Hori Chomin
description: Hori Chomin Hori Chomin was a samurai commander of Atarashijo castle in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Chomin was tasked with the mission of building Atarashijo at the southern entrance to the pass between the plain and Nora - ko .
description_long: Hori Chomin Hori Chomin was a samurai commander of Atarashijo castle in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Chomin was tasked with the mission of building Atarashijo at the southern entrance to the pass between the plain and Nora - ko . He led a company of twenty samurai and one hundred bushi . He directed the villagers and some artisans . Relationship . Chomin was the brother of the head of the Hori clan .

title: Hori Gutsu
description: Hori Gutsu Hori Gutsu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan , who ran a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi , plus twenty servants , mostly from the Hori clan .
description_long: Hori Gutsu Hori Gutsu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan , who ran a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi , plus twenty servants , mostly from the Hori clan . Personality . Hori was very proud of his position and took any kind of flaw in the performance of the posthouse as a personal offense . If someone lied about a flaw , then Hori would seek revenge against the slanderer .

title: Horizikaul ' s cough
description: Horizikaul ' s cough Horizikaul ' s cough was a simple cantrip from the evocation school that created a short , loud noise . Effects . By completing this spell , the caster could cause a quick , loud sound to originate nearby a target person or object within close range .
description_long: Horizikaul ' s cough Horizikaul ' s cough was a simple cantrip from the evocation school that created a short , loud noise . Effects . By completing this spell , the caster could cause a quick , loud sound to originate nearby a target person or object within close range . This sound could cause minor injury or even brief deafness . Components . To cast this spell required verbal and somatic component s . History . This was one of several sonic spells attributed to the mage Horizikaul .

title: Horizon Syndicate
description: Horizon Syndicate The Horizon Syndicate was a drow mercantile organization , formed after the Spellplague . History . In the century following the Spellplague , a growing faction of drow divorced themselves from the old ways of their people to follow a new path .
description_long: Horizon Syndicate The Horizon Syndicate was a drow mercantile organization , formed after the Spellplague . History . In the century following the Spellplague , a growing faction of drow divorced themselves from the old ways of their people to follow a new path . They believed the only way to weather the troubles affecting the lands would be to approach their dealings with other intelligent races in a way that did not always result in violence . Rather than taking what they wanted , when resources were already scarce , perhaps they could achieve better results by engaging their enemies in trade , exchanging valuable metals , gemstones , and other goods found exclusively in the Underdark for commodities generally absent from the depths of the earth . In order to facilitate this , they formed a new commercial organization , the Horizon Syndicate . Despite mistrust from others , the organization has spread , enabling trade between surface and Underdark communities . Members .

title: Horizon walker
description: Horizon walker The path of the horizon walker was one taken by adventurers whose goals were to explore and map out the plethora of environments within and even beyond the Prime . Those explorers who had an irresistible sense of curiosity and wanderlust to travel took on the path in order to gain an innate connection to their surroundings , whatever those surroundings might be . As horizon walkers became more experienced , they treated their surroundings as part of themselves , which gave them special abilities and senses to protect them from the dangers of incessant travel .
description_long: Horizon walker The path of the horizon walker was one taken by adventurers whose goals were to explore and map out the plethora of environments within and even beyond the Prime . Those explorers who had an irresistible sense of curiosity and wanderlust to travel took on the path in order to gain an innate connection to their surroundings , whatever those surroundings might be . As horizon walkers became more experienced , they treated their surroundings as part of themselves , which gave them special abilities and senses to protect them from the dangers of incessant travel . Culture . Few things surprised a horizon walker , for there was little that hadn ' t already been experienced by such an individual . The only thing that truly piqued a horizon walker ' s interest was the truly unknown , which unfortunately became harder and harder to find for an experienced seeker of the unknown and untraveled . This knowledge aided those who would seek a horizon walker ' s wisdom , for the horizon walker was an unsurpassed guide and vanguard , which could be the single difference between life and death in the woods of the Feywild or the wastes of the demon - infested Abyss .

title: Horlo Aumrabbar
description: Horlo Aumrabbar Horlo Aumrabbar was a member of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He was the soft - spoken deceiver within the band .
description_long: Horlo Aumrabbar Horlo Aumrabbar was a member of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He was the soft - spoken deceiver within the band . A worshiper of Mask , he influenced Mhair Gulzrabban to act in a more subtle and patient manner . After setting up several caches of wealth throughout the Western Heartlands , Horlo planned several means of betraying Mhair and his lover Sharaera should they ever act too boldly for his taste . One of his plans involved the Red Wizards of Thay . Abilities . Along with all of the other members of the Company of the Cloak , Horlo possessed an immunity to oil of taggit ( which caused memory loss ) . Possessions . Horlo wielded a " keen longsword " and possessed a " candle of truth " and a " chime of opening " .

title: Horn
description: Horn Horns were a type of wind musical instrument . Description . Several variants of horns existed , such as fanfare horn s , hunting horn s , and glaur s .
description_long: Horn Horns were a type of wind musical instrument . Description . Several variants of horns existed , such as fanfare horn s , hunting horn s , and glaur s . Horns were typically made of brass , bronze , horn or shell . The common horn , also known as a valveless trumpet , was traditional to kings ' courts . Trumpets and other horns were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Horn coral
description: Horn coral Horn coral was not a mineral but a highly prized variety of . It was also known as night coral . Description .
description_long: Horn coral Horn coral was not a mineral but a highly prized variety of . It was also known as night coral . Description . The deep black version of horn coral was similar to angelar ' s skin except for its solid color . It was polished and used in jewelry , typically cut cabochon or left in its twig and branch form . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp . Powers . Horn coral had the unique property of granting " water walk " to someone wearing the item . To release this power , the wearer had to touch the horn coral with one of their own tears and call on the ability . The effect lasted up to an hour , after which , the horn coral disintegrated into dust . A few rare specimens did not dissolve and could be reused after about ten minutes . There was no known method of distinguishing which specimens would not be consumed by casting " water walk " except by trial .

title: Horn of Shasphur
description: Horn of Shasphur The Horn of Shasphur , also known as the Shield of Shasphur , was a tavern located in the Market Floor of Djerad Thymar . It was owned by Clan Kepeshkmolik , and it was one of the few taverns in Djerad Thymar were non - dragonborn where allowed to enter . The tavern was named after Shasphur , the founder of Clan Kepeshkmolik .
description_long: Horn of Shasphur The Horn of Shasphur , also known as the Shield of Shasphur , was a tavern located in the Market Floor of Djerad Thymar . It was owned by Clan Kepeshkmolik , and it was one of the few taverns in Djerad Thymar were non - dragonborn where allowed to enter . The tavern was named after Shasphur , the founder of Clan Kepeshkmolik .

title: Horn of Valhalla
description: Horn of Valhalla Horn of Valhalla is a wondrous item that has the power to summon forth the spirits of barbarian s from their afterlife to fight for the summoner . The horns come in four different types which appear to be normal horns until the command word is spoken . In the Forgotten Realms Campaign setting this magic item could correctly be named Horn of Warrior ' s Rest .

title: Hornbill ivory
description: Hornbill ivory Hornbill ivory was not really ivory , it was material from the beak of the hornbill bird . Description . The hornbill bird in the realms was a large bird with gray plumage and a heavy beak .
description_long: Hornbill ivory Hornbill ivory was not really ivory , it was material from the beak of the hornbill bird . Description . The hornbill bird in the realms was a large bird with gray plumage and a heavy beak . The sturdy beak could be carved like ivory , and was used to make personal items like combs or beads . It was also used as an inlay in stone or wooden furniture . A typical price was 7 silver pieces per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Powers . Hornbill ivory could be used as a material component for spells as well as magical items and tokens that pertained to flight .

title: Horned harbinger
description: Horned harbinger The horned harbinger is a special prestige class for worshipers of the dead god Myrkul . All horned harbingers since the Time of Troubles have had contact with an artifact called the Crown of Horns and turned their worship from their previous deity to that of Myrkul , whose personality possesses the Crown of Horns . All horned harbingers are essentially tools of Myrkul , dedicated to aid the personality inhabiting the Crown of Horns in some fashion unknown to outsiders .

title: Hornmoot
description: Hornmoot Hornmoot was the traditional trading festival between the dwarves and human s of the Vast . It took place on the 14th of Kythorn each year , with lesser hornmoots on the 14th of each month until Eleint . At the end of winter , when the dwarves emerged from their subterranean homes , they blew horns from the mountains to alert the humans in the lands below that they coming to trade .
description_long: Hornmoot Hornmoot was the traditional trading festival between the dwarves and human s of the Vast . It took place on the 14th of Kythorn each year , with lesser hornmoots on the 14th of each month until Eleint . At the end of winter , when the dwarves emerged from their subterranean homes , they blew horns from the mountains to alert the humans in the lands below that they coming to trade . Those settlements that wished to trade responded with their own horns , and the dwarves would come to them . Hornmoots marked the first trading day of spring between the two races . Quality axe s and sword s were among the dwarven goods on offer . Hornmoot was more common in the country communities than in the big cities . It was popular with travelling merchants too , and they came from as far away as Amn to buy dwarf - made weaponry . History . Hornmoot began in the days of Roldilar , the Realm of Glimmering Swords , the great dwarven kingdom that dominated the surface lands of the Vast in the 7th century DR . One year in the mid – 13th century DR , Master Merchant Marakus Beindold of Hlintar invited the dwarves of the eastern hills to Hornmoot .

title: Horns of the Earth
description: Horns of the Earth The Horns of the Earth , or the Darkwings , was a large group of gargoyle s within the Sevenfold Mazework and the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The exact numbers of gargoyles within the Horns of the Earth remained unknown .
description_long: Horns of the Earth The Horns of the Earth , or the Darkwings , was a large group of gargoyle s within the Sevenfold Mazework and the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The exact numbers of gargoyles within the Horns of the Earth remained unknown . Estimates placed the numbers between 15 , 000 and 25 , 000 . Activities . These gargoyles patrolled the entire expanse of the Great Dismal Delve . They typically metted out justice to non - genie slaves and workers , but would occasionally apprehend common dao who broke the Khan ' s laws . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Hornung ' s surge selector
description: Hornung ' s surge selector Hornung ' s surge selector was a wild magic spell that gave the caster a limited ability to shape wild surge s their spells produced , either as a side effect or by way of " Nahal ' s reckless dweomer " . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as surge selector . Components .
description_long: Hornung ' s surge selector Hornung ' s surge selector was a wild magic spell that gave the caster a limited ability to shape wild surge s their spells produced , either as a side effect or by way of " Nahal ' s reckless dweomer " . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as surge selector . Components . Proper casting of this spell required verbal and somatic component s and a brass spinner , which was not consumed during casting . Users . As a wild magic spell , " Hornung ' s surge selector " was usable only by wild mage s . Among those it was considered a common spell .

title: Horquine
description: Horquine Horquine is an elven mage known for his attempts to breed a variety of azmyth that would eat the fyreflies in Cormanthor . The fyreflies were causing problems by igniting large parts of the forest , and although the azmyth Horquine bred were able to eat them , they could not digest the abdomens , the source of the flames , and so they were forced to spit them out , causing a fireball .
