title: Horreb
description: Horreb Horreb was an ancient fallen civilization south of Barze . It was known for its potent magical artificers . History .
description_long: Horreb Horreb was an ancient fallen civilization south of Barze . It was known for its potent magical artificers . History . Horreb took part in the defeat of the primordial Maram of the Great Spear in - 357 DR . Horreb artificers created a magic item known as the Horreb ritual cube , whose purpose was to keep Maram locked away in his otherworldly prison . About a year later , Horreb was leveled by Tyranthraxus and his Twisted Ones , who also killed its rulers .

title: Horrid wilting
description: Horrid wilting Horrid wilting , also known as Abi - Dalzim ' s horrid wilting , is a necromancy spell that damages a creature via dehydration . Effect . This spell evaporates moisture from the bodies of all the subject living creatures , causing damage .
description_long: Horrid wilting Horrid wilting , also known as Abi - Dalzim ' s horrid wilting , is a necromancy spell that damages a creature via dehydration . Effect . This spell evaporates moisture from the bodies of all the subject living creatures , causing damage . This spell is especially devastating to water elemental s and plant creatures . Arcane material component . A bit of sponge . History . This spell is not of Netherese origin .

title: Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin
description: Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin was the house wizard and patron ( to Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin ) of House Xorlarrin in 1372 DR . He was killed during the Spellplague . Description .
description_long: Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin was the house wizard and patron ( to Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin ) of House Xorlarrin in 1372 DR . He was killed during the Spellplague . Description . He appeared very old , but that was rumored to be due to a magical experiment gone wrong . History . Horroodissomoth was the leader of a council of mages that governed the magical academy of Sorcere in 1370 DR . He was second only to the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , Gromph Baenre . Horroodissomoth was later driven insane by the Spellplague . He was killed by his own delayed - blast " fireball " , which he had placed in his vest pocket .

title: Horse
description: Horse Horses on Abeir - Toril were used for riding and pulling . Ponies . Ponies were often used as mounts by smaller humanoids like halfling s or small human s .
description_long: Horse Horses on Abeir - Toril were used for riding and pulling . Ponies . Ponies were often used as mounts by smaller humanoids like halfling s or small human s . Other . Donkey breeds include : Special : Training . Some of the best - trained horses were trained by the elven House Korianthil . Horsetail . Horsetail was used by various cultures , including the Azuposi of Maztica , who used it in medicines to treat colds , hay fever , and asthma . Symbolism . A white horse was the symbol for the sun elf house of Evanara . Similar creatures . Animals that resemble horses include pegasi , unicorn s , and nightmares .

title: Horse ( individual )
description: Horse ( individual ) Horse was a hunter in Narfell in 1359 DR . History . Horse was cast out of his tribe because his unbridled savagery .
description_long: Horse ( individual ) Horse was a hunter in Narfell in 1359 DR . History . Horse was cast out of his tribe because his unbridled savagery . They would have killed him but feared he was possessed by some evil spirits . He gained his name for his smell . Activities . Normally , Horse disguised himself as a yeti and surprising and attacking travelers at night . In daytime , he used hit - and - run tactics : his favorite one was to hit one of the riders in a group with a poisoned spear attached by a cord to a nearby rock or stump , causing the rider to be dismounted . Personality . Horse was a very cruel man .

title: Horse Pond
description: Horse Pond Horse Pond was a pond in Amphail on the Sword Coast . Description . It was a muddy pond containing frog s and water lilies , and it was used for drinking and washing water for horses .
description_long: Horse Pond Horse Pond was a pond in Amphail on the Sword Coast . Description . It was a muddy pond containing frog s and water lilies , and it was used for drinking and washing water for horses . Legends . There was a legend that at the bottom of the pond there was a hidden entrance to the tomb of the Maiden King , who ruled the area a long time before the 14th century DR . According to legend , she lay sleeping forever on a stone bed with her magic two - handed sword resting on her chest . Some adventurers entered the pond on several occasions and found nothing , but one band at least never returned . History . In the mid – 14th century DR , there was an incident in which skeleton s ventured out of the pond and ran amok through the village , strangling people before they were destroyed .

title: Horse Prairie
description: Horse Prairie The Horse Prairie is a land area in the Dragon Coast . The Horse Prairie runs from the Castaway Coast on the Dragonmere in the north , to the Giant ' s Run mountains to the south . And from Elversult to the east and Teziir to the west .
description_long: Horse Prairie The Horse Prairie is a land area in the Dragon Coast . The Horse Prairie runs from the Castaway Coast on the Dragonmere in the north , to the Giant ' s Run mountains to the south . And from Elversult to the east and Teziir to the west .

title: Horselords
description: Horselords Horselords , by David Cook , is the first book in The Empires trilogy . Summary . For centuries , the civilized people of the eastern and western realms have dismissed the nomadic inhabitants of the vast middle land as barbarians , but now these nomads are rising with the might to challenge the world .

title: Horseshoe Temple Oasis
description: Horseshoe Temple Oasis Horseshoe Temple Oasis was a large and important oasis located deep inside the Quoya Desert of the Endless Wastes . Description . Located in a box canyon , the Horseshoe Temple Oasis was known to have an ample supply of fresh water that bubbled up from underground .
description_long: Horseshoe Temple Oasis Horseshoe Temple Oasis was a large and important oasis located deep inside the Quoya Desert of the Endless Wastes . Description . Located in a box canyon , the Horseshoe Temple Oasis was known to have an ample supply of fresh water that bubbled up from underground . This underground water supply allowed the oasis to never dry out , even under periods of extreme heat . The bottom of the oasis was covered in grasses , flowers , and streams , and , near the cliff side of the canyon , were pine trees planted there hundreds of years ago by the priests who had carved the many caves in the cliff side . The most prominent feature of the oasis was these caves . Over thirty caves , carved at various heights along the cliff - face , formed a large holy site . Inside one of these caves was the item the oasis got its name from , a large block of sandstone , with an impression of a horseshoe in it . According to legend , it was at this spot that the Heavenly Sage , Hung Te Ping , stopped to rest during his travels between Shou Lung and the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Horus - Re
description: Horus - Re Horus - Re ( pronounced " hore " - us " ray " ) was the leader of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Helcaliant in Thay and that of Hokatep in Unther , he was an honorable deity that opposed change . History .
description_long: Horus - Re Horus - Re ( pronounced " hore " - us " ray " ) was the leader of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Helcaliant in Thay and that of Hokatep in Unther , he was an honorable deity that opposed change . History . Horus was originally a young deity that often sided with Anhur in pressing change to his father , Re . When Re was defeated by Gruumsh during the Orcgate Wars , the failing deity passed his powers and domain to Horus before passing on . Upon gaining this power Horus became Horus - Re , and began exhibiting the personality traits and beliefs of his dead father . Relationships . Horus - Re ' s allies included Isis , Osiris , and Thoth , though all the Mulhorandi pantheon accepted his commands . Lathander also saw Horus - Re in a favorable light . Horus - Re ' s opposition to change often brought him into conflict with Anhur , and he did all he could to thwart the actions of Set . Avatar . Horus - Re usually appeared as a Mulan human possessing the head of a hawk . He rode the airborne galley " Matet " ( or " Semktet " ) and carried a glowing ankh . Powers and abilities . Horus - Re was able to project a ray of damaging light from his eye .

title: Horustep III
description: Horustep III Horustep III was a pharaoh , or king , of Mulhorand . He ascended to the throne in the summer of 1357 DR at the age of 11 after the assassination of his father , Akonhorus II . He approved the Mulhorandi invasion of Unther following the Time of Troubles and the Untheric god - king Gilgeam ' s death at the hand of Tiamat .
description_long: Horustep III Horustep III was a pharaoh , or king , of Mulhorand . title: Hosan Khalid
description: Hosan Khalid Hosan Khalid was in charge of the West Center district of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Hosan was an extremely diligent individual .
description_long: Hosan Khalid Hosan Khalid was in charge of the West Center district of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Hosan was an extremely diligent individual . Activities . Hosan supervised the Suq Gate , Harbor Gate , and the Grand Bazaar . These areas held most of the city ' s tax collectors and merchants , so much of Hosan ' s work revolved around permits .

title: Hoseki
description: Hoseki Hoseki was a disguised sohei follower of the dai - oni in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hoseki was a sohei of the Black Temple .
description_long: Hoseki Hoseki was a disguised sohei follower of the dai - oni in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hoseki was a sohei of the Black Temple . In 1357 DR , Hoseki posed as a farmer living in Myudo village , a village under the dai - oni ' s control , to spy on the inhabitants . He noticed some adventurers who ' d arrived at the village and asked to sleep in his house for night . In the night , Hoseki led his men in trying to kill them but was defeated . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Hoseki would attack the players while they slept if they accepted his hospitality or search them during the night to kill them .

title: Hoshin
description: Hoshin Hoshin was a shukenja adventurer in Kozakura . History . Hoshin ' s early history was shrouded in mystery : some said he was a samurai fleeing his household after a love affair with a clan rival ' s daughter ; he was a pirate and the only survivor after a shipwreck ; he was an impostor searching for a good hiding spot for illegal activities as a yakuza or ninja ; or he might be an illegitimate son of the shogun .
description_long: Hoshin Hoshin was a shukenja adventurer in Kozakura . History . Hoshin ' s early history was shrouded in mystery : some said he was a samurai fleeing his household after a love affair with a clan rival ' s daughter ; he was a pirate and the only survivor after a shipwreck ; he was an impostor searching for a good hiding spot for illegal activities as a yakuza or ninja ; or he might be an illegitimate son of the shogun . The only clear fact was that as a young man he presented himself at the gate of the Floating Cloud Monastery , a temple following the Way of Enlightenment philosophy . He remembered nothing from before that time . Hoshin often traveled Kozakura spreading the teachings of the Way of Enlightenment . One of his goals was to go to Shou Lung to visit the birthplace of Way of Enlightenment . In 1357 DR , Hoshin was among the candidates considered by Ko Mei Kho for a mission in Akari . In 1358 DR , Hoshin was traveling to Shou Lung to visit the Cliffs of Tanghai when he was possibly approached by Ko Ho San . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Hoshin is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari .

title: Hoshtar Xorlarrin
description: Hoshtar Xorlarrin Hoshtar Xorlarrin was a drow ] wizard of Menzoberranzan and cousin to House Wizard Ravel of House Xorlarrin . Description . By the tradition of his house , Hoshtar wore a red veil over his face .
description_long: Hoshtar Xorlarrin Hoshtar Xorlarrin was a drow ] wizard of Menzoberranzan and cousin to House Wizard Ravel of House Xorlarrin . Description . By the tradition of his house , Hoshtar wore a red veil over his face . Personality . Hoshtar could be influenced by those who showed knowledge about arcane matters or fed his ego . He thumped his chest and clapped an employee on the shoulder when he was pleased . History . Hoshtar was his family ' s representative for an alliance with House Melarn and Bregan D ' aerthe in handling a party of adventurer s . They first sent the team to gain power for Lolth ' s Demon Weave scheme . This was a task in which he had spent much effort himself . For the expedition , he asked adventurers loyal to his house to retrieve a letter from the previous party that had been lost on the same mission . The message was a letter that Guannerrae Tlabbar had retrieved in the Underdark , written in Xorlarrin code , with no recipient named . It was written to Faelas Xorlarrin , a master of Sorcere , and its content was about how the Goddess ' s current plan supported the idea of wizards joining the Ruling Council .

title: Host Tower of the Arcane
description: Host Tower of the Arcane The Host Tower of the Arcane was both an academy of magic al training for the Arcane Brotherhood and a political and economic power in the city of Luskan . Description . The tower resembled a tree with four " limbs " ( spires ) .
description_long: Host Tower of the Arcane The Host Tower of the Arcane was both an academy of magic al training for the Arcane Brotherhood and a political and economic power in the city of Luskan . Description . The tower resembled a tree with four " limbs " ( spires ) . The building radiated an aura of magic that many residents found so uncomfortable that they purposely avoided looking at the building . It was said that each apprentice received his or her own alchemical laboratory and meditation chamber . History . The first known account of the Host Tower ' s existence comes from a Northlander oral tradition recorded in 1237 DR by a loremaster of Waterdeep . Erected by the netherese arcanist Melathlar in - 354 DR to protect Illusk from phaerimm attack , the effort cost Melathlar his life . Twenty years later , another arcanist , named Maerin , was involved in creating a magical siphoning system that took seawater from the Sea of Swords and transported it via roots ' grown ' from the Tower to the burgeoning underground settlement of Gauntlgrym , where elemental magic fuelled by the water kept the primordial Maegera under control .

title: Hotun - Shûl
description: Hotun - Shûl Hotun - Shûl is a large underground temple beneath the Ice Spires . It was razed by unknown intruders over 400 years ago . Skrom Jek of Thay wrote a book on the temple before its destruction , named " The Meanderings Upon the Friezes of Hotun - Shûl " .
description_long: Hotun - Shûl Hotun - Shûl is a large underground temple beneath the Ice Spires . It was razed by unknown intruders over 400 years ago . Skrom Jek of Thay wrote a book on the temple before its destruction , named " The Meanderings Upon the Friezes of Hotun - Shûl " . Friezes . The temple contains the friezes , scupltures hewn straight from the rock by the stone giant Illsenstaad .

title: Hound archon
description: Hound archon Hound archons are celestial beings that live primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Hound archons are the well - disciplined soldiers and sentinels of their heavenly realm . They are well - trained in the fight against evil and show no mercy to fiends .
description_long: Hound archon Hound archons are celestial beings that live primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Hound archons are the well - disciplined soldiers and sentinels of their heavenly realm . They are well - trained in the fight against evil and show no mercy to fiends . Against mortals , however , they are loath to use lethal force , even against those dedicated to evil . They believe that mortals should be the judges of their own kind while on the mortal world . Hound archons look like well - muscled humans with canine heads . They can also assume the form of a wolf , dog , or other canine . While on the mortal world , these archons often assume a canine form to subtly help good mortals as a “ clever pet . ” Physical description . Hound archons are powerfully built , red - skinned humanoid s with canine heads . They are quite intelligent and very protective , seeking to defend the innocent and helpless against evil . Combat . Hound archons are able combatants in melee , due to their musculature and meaty fists . They prefer their natural weapons , but have also been known to wield greatsword s to great effect .

title: Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl
description: Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl was a drow and former member of House Tuin ' Tarl in Menzoberranzan . He learned about the Silence of Lolth and conspired with Syrzan to use the weakness of the priestesses to take over Menzoberranzan . Description .
description_long: Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl was a drow and former member of House Tuin ' Tarl in Menzoberranzan . He learned about the Silence of Lolth and conspired with Syrzan to use the weakness of the priestesses to take over Menzoberranzan . Description . Houndaer wore rich silks and velvet garments , and had numerous magical charms and trinkets on his person . He wore crystals in his long , thick hair . He had close - set eyes and a prominent jaw . He wielded a scimitar . History . Houndaer was born to House Tuin ' Tarl at an unknown date . At some point , he trained at Melee - Magthere under Ryld Argith and was proficient enough that Ryld remembered him many years later . Dissatisfied with his place in life , and with the role of males in drow society in general , he joined a group of like - minded individuals who would meet from time to time in an abandoned fortress . One day , he witnessed priestesses die fighting grick s in the Bauthwaf when they should have been able to save themselves with their magic . Realizing what this could mean , Houndaer and his co - conspirators attacked some priestesses to see what they would do and confirmed their suspicions .

title: Hourm
description: Hourm Hourm was a friendly galeb duhr living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Hourm assisted an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , at Gravenhollow , explaining to them the functions and rules of the library .
description_long: Hourm Hourm was a friendly galeb duhr living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Hourm assisted an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , at Gravenhollow , explaining to them the functions and rules of the library . After he finished his task , he went back to being a rock .

title: Hours of the day
description: Hours of the day Most inhabitants of Faerûn divided the day into ten segments . Common names for these divisions of the day are given below : Other divisions in common use included : None of these divisions were precise . Different folk ' s usages might overlap with others .
description_long: Hours of the day Most inhabitants of Faerûn divided the day into ten segments . Common names for these divisions of the day are given below : Other divisions in common use included : None of these divisions were precise . Different folk ' s usages might overlap with others . In general , however , these slots of time ranged between one and four hours . In larger cities , bells were sometimes used to mark the hours . The churches of Gond and Lathander were also particularly interested in accurate timekeeping . In such cases , hours were numbered 1 through 12 twice , with 12 being both highsun and midnight . Magically Auspicious Times . When practicing the Art , the position of the sun could have noticeable effects on the efficacy of certain spell components . These times of day and the item affected , as told by Elminster , are listed below :

title: House Agrach Dyrr
description: House Agrach Dyrr House Agrach Dyrr was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Structure . House Agrach Dyrr was the fifth house in 1372 DR .
description_long: House Agrach Dyrr House Agrach Dyrr was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Structure . House Agrach Dyrr was the fifth house in 1372 DR . The house was located on Qu ' ellarz ' orl and built around nine stalagmites . It was surrounded by adamantine and stone . It had flying buttresses around its spires and a railless bridge across a moat - like chasm . The house had multiple reception halls , as well as a small sitting room with coral , limestone , and kuo - toa motifs . The compound itself formed of concentric circles , with a domed temple to Lolth in the center of the complex . House Agrach Dyrr ' s temple had a sacrificial altar limned in purple faerie fire and candles . There was a large black sculpture of a spider ( a guardian golem ) , which was home to the Lichdrow ' s phylactery . There were high - backed stone benches in the chapel , with weblike curtains , spider motifs , and actual spiders and webs . The house had strong magical wards , many of which were placed by the Lichdrow Dyrr , including the master ward , which activated all wards in the compound in the event the lich ' s phylactery was destroyed . Activities .

title: House Ahmaquissar
description: House Ahmaquissar House Ahmaquissar was an elven house . Activities . It is known for accommodating minstrels , thieves and con artists .
description_long: House Ahmaquissar House Ahmaquissar was an elven house . Activities . It is known for accommodating minstrels , thieves and con artists . Members commonly ventured to Faerûn to ply their roguish trades before returning to Evermeet to evade punishment . Base of operations . The house possessed several estates on Evermeet , but its main estate in Leuthilspar was a wood and marble building .

title: House Alsevir
description: House Alsevir House Alsevir was a very old Cormyrean noble house which rose to the nobility around 200 DR . The family was thought to have died out but a distant branch of the family returned to Cormyr in 1420 DR and took up residence in the old Bleth estate . The family had built a considerable fortune as merchants before returning to Cormyr and , when they arrived in Suzail , began buying their way into high society .
description_long: House Alsevir House Alsevir was a very old Cormyrean noble house which rose to the nobility around 200 DR . The family was thought to have died out but a distant branch of the family returned to Cormyr in 1420 DR and took up residence in the old Bleth estate . The family had built a considerable fortune as merchants before returning to Cormyr and , when they arrived in Suzail , began buying their way into high society . Their penchant for throwing around gold as well as their purchased titles earned them the dislike of House Crownsilver .

title: House Auvryndar ( Ched Nasad )
description: House Auvryndar ( Ched Nasad ) House Auvryndar was a powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . Headquarters . House Auvryndar was located on the second level from the top of the city .
description_long: House Auvryndar ( Ched Nasad ) House Auvryndar was a powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . Headquarters . House Auvryndar was located on the second level from the top of the city . Leadership . In 1370 DR , the drow vampire Shyntlara Auvryndar was matron mother of House Auvryndar . She sat on the Ruling Council of Ched Nasad and was in Lolth ' s favor . She was able to create drow vampires only from drow that had failed the test of Lolth .

title: House Baenre
description: House Baenre House Baenre was the first drow house of Menzoberranzan , and had been for centuries - - as long as anyone in the city could remember . It was the oldest ( around 5 , 000 years old ) , strongest , and most prestigious house in the city . History .
description_long: House Baenre House Baenre was the first drow house of Menzoberranzan , and had been for centuries - - as long as anyone in the city could remember . It was the oldest ( around 5 , 000 years old ) , strongest , and most prestigious house in the city . History . The story of House Baenre ' s ascension to the premier rank in the city was not known to any living drow ; the only person who might have known the true history of the house is Yvonnel Baenre , the former Matron Mother who took power in - 7 DR . To the drow of Menzoberranzan , Baenre just was , and always had been , the First House . History showed that even during periods of strife and political change , House Baenre was always able to retain its position of power . Even with the death of Yvonnel Baenre during the failed invasion of Mithral Hall in 1358 DR , the first house ' s power could not be usurped ; Triel Baenre , the first and most powerful daughter of Yvonnel Baenre , took her mother ' s place as supreme ruler . Soon after the death of Yvonnel , House Baenre was at the weakest it had been for centuries .

title: House Barrison Del ' Armgo
description: House Barrison Del ' Armgo House Barrison Del ' Armgo was a high - ranking noble drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . The house was known for its wizards and warriors ; its might was not based in the clergy .
description_long: House Barrison Del ' Armgo House Barrison Del ' Armgo was a high - ranking noble drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . The house was known for its wizards and warriors ; its might was not based in the clergy . Until 1484 DR , warriors from House Barrison Del ' Armgo and House Melarn trained together ( against the order of the Ruling Council ) in the ruined House Do ' Urden compound . Headquarters . House Barrison Del ' Armgo was originally located in Narbondellyn , but in the late 15th century DR it relocated to Qu ' ellarz ' orl . History . House Barrison Del ' Armgo was the second - youngest house ( in 1484 DR ) of Menzoberranzan , having been formed some eight centuries earlier . Around 1230 DR , it was the 47th house , then it jumped to the 16th house . The house was second house as of 1372 DR and still remained in that position in 1484 DR . Relationships . House Barrison Del ' Armgo was strong but had few allies , preferring to stand by itself . Members . In 1484 DR , House Barrison Del ' Armgo had 1 , 000 soldiers , which formed the backbone of their garrison .

title: House Basadoni
description: House Basadoni Greatest guild of the many in Calimport , a desert port city that is the chosen home of Artemis Entreri . Lead for many years by Basadoni , mentor of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri , House Basadoni was later controlled for a brief period by the opportunistic mercenary Jarlaxle . It became the front for Jarlaxle ' s attempts to widen his band of rogue drow ' s influence to the surface world .
description_long: House Basadoni Greatest guild of the many in Calimport , a desert port city that is the chosen home of Artemis Entreri . Lead for many years by Basadoni , mentor of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri , House Basadoni was later controlled for a brief period by the opportunistic mercenary Jarlaxle . It became the front for Jarlaxle ' s attempts to widen his band of rogue drow ' s influence to the surface world . Artemis served as the figure - head of the house during the ruse . Eventually the two adventurers set off away from the city , following a coup within Bregan Daerthe that left the house in turmoil .

title: House Chûmavh
description: House Chûmavh House Chûmavh was the ruling drow house of Maerimydra , and held the position as ruling house . Base of Operations . Until 1372 DR , House Chûmavh , resided within the impressive Castle Maerimydra which overlooked the city of Maerimydra .
description_long: House Chûmavh House Chûmavh was the ruling drow house of Maerimydra , and held the position as ruling house . Base of Operations . Until 1372 DR , House Chûmavh , resided within the impressive Castle Maerimydra which overlooked the city of Maerimydra . After the city ' s destruction however Tower Chûmavhraele became the new base for the House under the city of Ravens Bluff . History . Rulers of Maerimydra . In 1372 , the Silence of Lolth rendered all the Lolth worshipers in Maerimydra without their ability to cast divine spells . In the wake of this many sought to overthrow the city , including the city ' s Archmage . Although the Archmage Duneth Wharreil and his demon ic allies did not topple the defensive structure of Castle Maerimydra , another enemy did manage to defeat them . The aspiring cult of Kiaransalee , led by Irae T ' sarran , sneaked into the Castle and slew all House Chûmavh ' s Lolth - worshipers . There ended the reign of House Chûmavh in Maerimydra . Beneath Raven ' s Bluff . After the fall of Maermydra , the survivors relocated to Tower Chûmavhraele , beneath Ravens Bluff , under the leadership of Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh .

title: House Cormaeril
description: House Cormaeril House Cormaeril was a noble house of Cormyr . Their estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . It was an enemy of the Illance house .
description_long: House Cormaeril House Cormaeril was a noble house of Cormyr . Their estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . It was an enemy of the Illance house . The Cormaeril ' s had a long - standing rivalry with House Huntcrown . History . After the Fire Knives were driven from Cormyr in 1341 DR , it was revealed that a number of member of the Cormaeril house were in - fact members of the Fire Knives . They were also implicated in the assassination attempt on King Azoun IV in 1369 DR and the crown exiled the family and confiscated their lands . Late in his reign in the 1440 ' s DR King Azoun V restored the Cormaeril ' s titles but not their lands . As of 1479 DR , the family was attempting to restore their reputation through generosity to the poor and patronage of the arts .

title: House Crownsilver
description: House Crownsilver House Crownsilver was a royal noble house of Cormyr whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . As of 1479 DR , the family was one of two remaining royal houses in Cormyr . The Crownsilvers disliked the younger noble houses ' mercantile activities and held House Alsevir , House Goldfeather , and House Marliir in particular disdain .
description_long: House Crownsilver House Crownsilver was a royal noble house of Cormyr whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . As of 1479 DR , the family was one of two remaining royal houses in Cormyr . The Crownsilvers disliked the younger noble houses ' mercantile activities and held House Alsevir , House Goldfeather , and House Marliir in particular disdain . History . The house descended from House Silver . The house existed some time before 245 DR after the split of the Silver family . In 1448 DR , the house opposed the marriage of Crown Prince Irvel Obarskyr to Ospra Goldfeather .

title: House DeVir
description: House DeVir House DeVir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House DeVir was constructed among five floor - to - ceiling , hollow stalagmites in the midst of a mushroom grove on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl .
description_long: House DeVir House DeVir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House DeVir was constructed among five floor - to - ceiling , hollow stalagmites in the midst of a mushroom grove on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl . The house was protected by gargoyle s , traps , glyphs , and wards . Additionally , every fifth mushroom around the compound was a shrieker that would make loud noises when potential attackers approached . History . In 1297 DR , House DeVir was the fourth house and planned to target the third house for destruction . In the plot , Matron Mother Ginafae DeVir used her clerical powers to aid a patrol of svirfneblin so that they would kill the wizard son of the third house . By doing so , Ginafae and her house lost of the favor of Lolth . House Do ' Urden , the tenth house , took advantage of their vulnerable state and destroyed House DeVir . Fifty commoners of the house joined House Do ' Urden . However , despite the apparent fall of the house , one noble lived on in the city : Alton DeVir , a student at Sorcere who survived an attempted assassination by Gelroos Hun ' ett , the " Faceless One " ( so named because a terrible accident had scarred his face ) .

title: House Despana
description: House Despana House Despana is a drow noble house with two major sects . One is located in the Vhaeraun - dominated Rilauven in the north , the other is based in the devoutly Lolth - worshiping Ust Natha further to the south . A third section of the family would be a minor house of Menzoberranzan as said on p .
description_long: House Despana House Despana is a drow noble house with two major sects . One is located in the Vhaeraun - dominated Rilauven in the north , the other is based in the devoutly Lolth - worshiping Ust Natha further to the south . A third section of the family would be a minor house of Menzoberranzan as said on p . 333 of Dissolution by Richard Lee Byers .

title: House Dhuurniv
description: House Dhuurniv House Dhuurniv is the only house to survive the fall of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . This was due in part to the fact that they had holdings outside the city . Following their escape from the city , they fell in with the Zhentarim ' s conquest of Shadowdale .
description_long: House Dhuurniv House Dhuurniv is the only house to survive the fall of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . This was due in part to the fact that they had holdings outside the city . Following their escape from the city , they fell in with the Zhentarim ' s conquest of Shadowdale . History . Prior to the Weeping War , Matron Mother Laele Dhuurniv led the Maerimyran forces who wished to reclaim the Land Under Shadow . She accepted the truce which Aolis Ildacer offered the drow but was killed by Aolis ' s wife Amara Ildacar . After the events of the Weeping War , House Dhuurniv was shunned by the other Drow Houses in Maerimydra for negotiating with the surface elves , despite regaining the Twisted Tower in the process . The three Matron Sisters withdrew largely from Maerimydra and took up residence mostly beneath the Twisted Tower . After the Silence of Lolth the drow of Dhuurniv found themselves left as the most powerful house left of Maerimydra . Despite the deaths of both Kurgoth Hellspawn and Irae T ' sarran by a band of adventurers , House Dhuurniv was unsuccessful at reclaiming the Maerimydra and decided to relocate to Azmaer ' s Folly fully .

title: House Dlardrageth
description: House Dlardrageth House Dlardrageth was originally a sun elf house of Cormanthor and a proud and powerful family in ancient Arcorar until they chose to give themselves to demon s , courting incubi and succubi , in an attempt to strengthen their line to gain the power necessary to seize the throne and rebuild the ruin of Aryvandaar . They were discovered by the Coronal and their house was destroyed , most of the members being imprisoned magically inside Arcorar ' s keep , but some escaped to ancient Siluvanede , where they turned some other houses to evil . The emblem of the House is a dracophoenix .
description_long: House Dlardrageth House Dlardrageth was originally a sun elf house of Cormanthor and a proud and powerful family in ancient Arcorar until they chose to give themselves to demon s , courting incubi and succubi , in an attempt to strengthen their line to gain the power necessary to seize the throne and rebuild the ruin of Aryvandaar . They were discovered by the Coronal and their house was destroyed , most of the members being imprisoned magically inside Arcorar ' s keep , but some escaped to ancient Siluvanede , where they turned some other houses to evil . The emblem of the House is a dracophoenix . Their numbers , amongst others , constitute the daemonfey . The Dlardrageth tower near Myth Drannor has long since been abandoned . History . Over hundreds of years , the house was responsible for the corruption and poisoning of the houses of Reithel , Yesve and others of Siluvanede and the destruction of Sharrven . They were bound and imprisoned after committing these acts , and the last mention of the house was in relation to the Seven Citadels ' War , which the house provoked , but they were found out soon after , being imprisoned beneath Ascalhorn .

title: House Do ' Urden
description: House Do ' Urden House Do ' Urden , also known by its ancient and formal name , Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Upon its destruction in 1339 DR , it was the eighth house . The house was reformed as the eighth house in 1484 DR by Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre .
description_long: House Do ' Urden House Do ' Urden , also known by its ancient and formal name , Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Upon its destruction in 1339 DR , it was the eighth house . The house was reformed as the eighth house in 1484 DR by Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre . Headquarters . Pre - 1339 DR . The Do ' Urden compound was located in the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan . It was in fact built into the wall , with stalagmites forming the posts for the main gate . The two - level cave complex housed most of the house ' s residents . The first level featured a maze of tunnels , residences , training grounds , and a two - story chapel along the back wall . No stairs led to the upper level , restricting entrance only to nobles ( who had levitation abilities ) , who could enter through the chapel or front balcony . The ruling family lived within a set of suites on the upper level . The patron lived in a two - room suite , and the weapon master ' s three - room suite included private quarters , a training area , and the house ' s war room . Post - 1339 DR .

title: House Druu ' giir
description: House Druu ' giir House Druu ' giir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was the seventeenth house in 1328 DR , but by 1480 DR , it had risen to become the tenth house . Headquarters .
description_long: House Druu ' giir House Druu ' giir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was the seventeenth house in 1328 DR , but by 1480 DR , it had risen to become the tenth house . Headquarters . House Druu ' giir occupied a rectangular - shaped compound southeast of the tip of the Westrift . The small compound was fenced by stalagmites . Activities . House Druu ' giir was one of the most powerful mercantile houses , second only to House Baenre . The house controlled nearly all moneylending in the city . Leadership . The house was dominated by elderly male wizard s .

title: House Duskryn
description: House Duskryn House Duskryn was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . They won the charter from House Baenre that allowed them to loot the city of Blingdenstone . Activities .
description_long: House Duskryn House Duskryn was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . They won the charter from House Baenre that allowed them to loot the city of Blingdenstone . Activities . The nobles of the house were known for their cruelty which they enacted seemingly for their own perverse amusement . Duskryn consistently trained some of the best armies in Menzoberranzan for the 3 , 000 years since the house ' s founding . Advancement was awarded for performance , not noble stature as was the norm in most other houses . However , all of the most famous military victories of the house were defensive rather than offensive in nature . History . In the 7th century DR , House Duskryn came under repeated attacks from several other noble houses that were all successfully repelled . Rumors persisted that all of these attacks were planned by Matron Yvonnel Baenre . In 1484 DR , House Duskryn was the ninth house and set to become the eighth house ( and thus part of the Ruling Council ) after the departure of House Xorlarrin to Q ' Xorlarrin . However , Quenthel Baenre restored House Do ' Urden and granted it the eighth place instead . Enemies .

title: House Eroth
description: House Eroth House Eroth was a silver elf house . History . As of 1367 DR , House Eroth was led by the elders and siblings Tanithil Eroth and Anaharae Eroth .
description_long: House Eroth House Eroth was a silver elf house . History . As of 1367 DR , House Eroth was led by the elders and siblings Tanithil Eroth and Anaharae Eroth . Before the Retreat , it was known for its ranger s and scouts , but these services were far less important on Evermeet and many become woodsmen instead . Activities . Eroth was a religious house , worshipping Angharradh , Corellon Larethian and Rillifane Rallathil . The house was noted for its members ' views , which often conflicted with those of the elves as a whole . For example , they did not recognize the authority of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower over the elven people . Base of operations . The house ' s estate consisted of small stone buildings in Leuthilspar connected by underground tunnels .

title: House Faen Tlabbar
description: House Faen Tlabbar House Faen Tlabbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . House Faen Tlabbar was based in a large castle of dark stone .
description_long: House Faen Tlabbar House Faen Tlabbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . House Faen Tlabbar was based in a large castle of dark stone . It was one of the largest houses not on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl . It was located along the southern wall and had tall spires . It was defended by lizard - mounted guards who wielded crossbows and lances . However , the house had a blind spot in its connection to the roof . House Faen Tlabbar was protected by a spell of forbidding . Something that the guards wore allowed them passage . The doors of the house were made of pale zurkhwood . There was a large hall which included studies , parlors , and trophy rooms . The floor was shiny black marble . There was a shrine to Lolth at the end with a large double door ; the shrine itself was a dome encrusted with gems . The chapel had a guardian demon resembling a skeleton covered in green flames with a flowing scimitar . Activities . House Faen Tlabbar was considered to be one of the most fanatical of all the drow houses of Menzoberranzan . History . In 1358 DR , Matron Mother Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar was killed by K ' yorl Odran .

title: House Fajirik Military Camp
description: House Fajirik Military Camp The House Fajirik Military Camp was a relatively permanent outpost of House Fajirik , located west of the Jamal Oasis in the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitants . Soldiers stationed here were often bored , which many traders took advantage of by bringing goods and services for them to spend their money on .
description_long: House Fajirik Military Camp The House Fajirik Military Camp was a relatively permanent outpost of House Fajirik , located west of the Jamal Oasis in the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitants . Soldiers stationed here were often bored , which many traders took advantage of by bringing goods and services for them to spend their money on . Captain Ramad bin Yusif al - Kahn kept men on watch constantly along the southern border of a barren weed field called a " qara ' a " . During peacetime , these soldiers had nothing to do except stare out into the vast emptiness of the desert and wait for any movement from the soldiers of House Ashurim , which was located on the other side of the " qara ' a " . This waiting game had lasted up to 200 years by 1367 DR . Funding for these soldiers was rumored to come from Tajar for House Fajirik , and Qudra for House Ashurim .

title: House Fey - Branche
description: House Fey - Branche House Fey - Branche was the fifth house of the drow city of Menzoberranzan in 1484 DR . Activities . House Fey - Branche served as a lackey to a number of houses , most notably House Baenre , hoping to curry favor with them .
description_long: House Fey - Branche House Fey - Branche was the fifth house of the drow city of Menzoberranzan in 1484 DR . Activities . House Fey - Branche served as a lackey to a number of houses , most notably House Baenre , hoping to curry favor with them . Headquarters . House Fey - Branche was based in a defensive , triangular shaped compound in the Narbondellyn district of Menzoberranzan . The outer part of the compound consisted of a very high adamantine wall and the only entrance was a single gate . Anyone who approached within 30 feet of the walls in any area other than the gate were shot with " lightning bolt " spells . Shrieker s throughout the compound also called out alarms if anyone not wearing the house insignia was seen . Three towers anchored each corner of the compound and were used for defensive purposes . Within the walls were four main sets of buildings : slave pens ( for about 400 slaves ) , a temple to Lolth ( where the noble females lived ) , troop quarters ( for about 200 soldiers ) , and family quarters ( housing the rest of the house ' s commoners and male nobles ) . History .

title: House Freth
description: House Freth House Freth was a decease drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . Before their destruction they started to breed venom ooze s .
description_long: House Freth House Freth was a decease drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . Before their destruction they started to breed venom ooze s . The oozes where made trough experiments , even though the house is destroyed the venom oozes survived and started to multiply through the Underdark . History . The house was one of the lower houses of Menzoberranzan . In 1319 DR , it was attacked and was nearly destroyed by House Teken ' duis . However , some nobles survived the attack . Thus , there were witnesses to this act and the attack was a failure . The Ruling Council of Menzoberranzan decided to destroy House Teken ' duis . The three surviving nobles of House Freth ( two females , the oldest of which had just finished training at Arach - Tinilith , and one male ) were taken to be combined into the house of Yvonnel Baenre . Apparently House Freth was reestablished prior to 1372 DR , when it was the nineteenth house .

title: House Greatgaunt
description: House Greatgaunt House Greatgaunt was a noble house of Cormyr that was elevated to the nobility in the 13th century DR . The family was a voice of moderation among the nobles and disliked the newer noble houses , such as House Alsevir . The Greatgaunts ' wealth came from their extensive land holdings and they were known for their livestock herds .
description_long: House Greatgaunt House Greatgaunt was a noble house of Cormyr that was elevated to the nobility in the 13th century DR . The family was a voice of moderation among the nobles and disliked the newer noble houses , such as House Alsevir . The Greatgaunts ' wealth came from their extensive land holdings and they were known for their livestock herds .

title: House Hawksong
description: House Hawksong House Hawksong was a moon elf house known for its members ' service to Evermeet as riders of eagle s and pegasi . Base of operations . The Hawksong manse was located in the city of Leuthilspar on Evermeet .
description_long: House Hawksong House Hawksong was a moon elf house known for its members ' service to Evermeet as riders of eagle s and pegasi . Base of operations . The Hawksong manse was located in the city of Leuthilspar on Evermeet . It consisted of three towers connected by bridges and no one outside the house was allowed to enter , except members of the Ahmaquissar and Nightstar houses . History . Around 1367 DR , the house was led by Tiatha Hawksong who had not been seen since 1357 DR , but the family ' s official line was she was still alive during this period .

title: House Hawkwinter
description: House Hawkwinter The Hawkwinters ( HAWK - win - ter ) were one of the Noble Families of Waterdeep . Trade & Interests . House Hawkwinter was most often associated with soldiering , garrisons , and guardianship .
description_long: House Hawkwinter The Hawkwinters ( HAWK - win - ter ) were one of the Noble Families of Waterdeep . Trade & Interests . House Hawkwinter was most often associated with soldiering , garrisons , and guardianship . Their net worth was estimated at 35 , 000 gold piece s . Members . In 1372 DR House Hawkwinter contained 41 nobles . The patriarch was Eremoes Hawkwinter . Genos Hawkwinter was to be the next heir after Eremoes . Family tree . The family tree of House Hawkwinter is shown below :

title: House Horlbar
description: House Horlbar House Horlbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . History . Before the Time of Troubles , House Horlbar was the twelfth ruling house in Menzoberranzan , and Jerlys and Ker Horlbar were co - matron mothers .
description_long: House Horlbar House Horlbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . History . Before the Time of Troubles , House Horlbar was the twelfth ruling house in Menzoberranzan , and Jerlys and Ker Horlbar were co - matron mothers . House Horlbar ' s two matrons had been a distinguishing feature for 2000 years and were always either sisters or first cousins . The hatred the two leaders traditionally had for each other was only ever outweighed by their hatred of things not of their house . In 1357 DR , Matron Mother Jerlys Horlbar attacked Artemis Entreri in the alleyways of Menzoberranzan while on a secret mission . Unable to flee her wraith , Entreri killed the matron mother . Structure . The main source of income and power for the house was its lucrative agricultural work and its ambitious trading practices . They were not known for house warfare but were said to never forget a slight , sometimes taking generations to instigate their revenge .

title: House Hunzrin
description: House Hunzrin House Hunzrin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that controlled much of the agriculture within the city . For that reason , the pitchfork was the weapon of choice for the family . Headquarters .
description_long: House Hunzrin House Hunzrin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that controlled much of the agriculture within the city . For that reason , the pitchfork was the weapon of choice for the family . Headquarters . House Hunzrin was stuck in the district of Eastmyr , despite its arrogance and the fact that it controlled most of Menzoberranzan ' s agriculture . House Hunzrin used quaggoth s as shock troops and guards . It also employed a naga named Ssassar . Activities . House Hunzrin was in charge of the lands around Lake Donigarten and the rothe herds , which produced cheese and meat , on the Isle of Rothe within the lake . They employed orc and goblin slaves to care for the herds . In 1361 DR , after many drow and slaves were killed in the attack upon Mithral Hall , the rothe herds were in a poor state . Shakti Hunzrin , on leave from Arach - Tinilith to look after the herds , reported the following dismal numbers : House Hunzrin sometimes replenished its herds with stolen animals , such as one white ram from the Ched Nasad an House Zinard . History . In 1412 DR , Shakti Hunzrin became the Matron mother of House Hunzrin .

title: House Illance
description: House Illance House Illance was a noble house of Cormyr based in Suzail . Holdings . Although the family was based in Suzail it had deep roots in Marsember and owned many properties through a complicated web of small companies bearing the names of others .
description_long: House Illance House Illance was a noble house of Cormyr based in Suzail . Holdings . Although the family was based in Suzail it had deep roots in Marsember and owned many properties through a complicated web of small companies bearing the names of others . The family owned a palatial home in Marsember known as " Iyrinthorn " , and a summer house at Stag Well . Reputation . The family ' s menfolk were notorious womanizers and were frequent patrons of Mask Dancing clubs . The family was involved in some illicit dealings , and persistent local rumors of ongoing slaving operations using their Marsembian based vessels and warehouses plagued the family . The House was an enemy of the House Cormaeril . History . Some members of the family plotted with Luthax against King Draxius in 629 DR and several unnamed members fought with King Galaghard III against the Witch - Lords in 900 DR . House Illance was among those who fought with Arangor and Azoun II against the dragon Thauglor in 1018 DR . One of its houses in Suzail was destroyed during a red dragon attack in 1018 DR .

title: House Jaelre
description: House Jaelre House Jaelre was the biggest drow faction in Cormanthor . In 1372 DR , they accounted for about 11 % of the drow population in the forest . Objectives .
description_long: House Jaelre House Jaelre was the biggest drow faction in Cormanthor . In 1372 DR , they accounted for about 11 % of the drow population in the forest . Objectives . House Jaelre ’ s goal was to find a home for themselves by repopulating the land of Cormanthor that the elves abandoned in the wake of the Retreat . Towards that end , they tried to satisfy the three requirements of a state . Namely , territory , the region around the Elven Court , population , their own members , and power to defend borders and lives of the aforementioned two through modifying elven magic such as the mythals into forms that would protect them . Activities . House Jaelre claimed the territory in and around the abandoned Elven Court before the Eldreth Veluuthra could do so . They generally remained on the upper part of the city for the lower parts were riddled with mortally dangerous traps . House Jaelre reused elven buildings when they could but also created their own , for the elves destroyed their biggest structures in their former capital before they left for Evermeet . They used these houses as forts and camps for defense and places from which to strike against their enemies .

title: House Jysstev
description: House Jysstev House Jysstev was an Amnian house . History . The house backed the Jhannivvar pretender for the throne of Tethyr and subsequently lost its riches , living in near poverty .
description_long: House Jysstev House Jysstev was an Amnian house . History . The house backed the Jhannivvar pretender for the throne of Tethyr and subsequently lost its riches , living in near poverty . It was forced to sell its assets in Athkatla and Murann , and move to Eshpurta . The house remained well ranked , but only through debts of honour .

title: House Karanok
description: House Karanok House Karanok were the insane ruling family of the city of Luthcheq in Chessenta . Organization . They believed that wizard s ( including also sorcerer s , dwarves , and elves ) were evil and must be burned .
description_long: House Karanok House Karanok were the insane ruling family of the city of Luthcheq in Chessenta . Organization . They believed that wizard s ( including also sorcerer s , dwarves , and elves ) were evil and must be burned . They worshiped Entropy , a strange " sphere of annihilation " . In 1370 DR , Tiamat posed as Entropy and granted them clerical spell s . After the Spellplague , Entropy was discovered to be a primordial . Members . In 1357 DR : In 1372 DR : After Spellplague ( 1385 DR ) : History . In 1161 DR , under suspicious circumstances , the Karanoks became the rulers of Luthcheq . Initially , they ruled in a typical Chessentan style . In 1324 DR , however , Luthceq was defeated in a war against Mordulkin and the Karanoks blamed the wizard spies of Mordulkin , starting their crusade against arcane magic . In 1346 DR , from nowhere , Entropy manifested itself inside House Karanok ' s mansion , killing a wizard they were torturing . The Karanoks saw this as an omen and began worshiping Entropy . In 1370 DR , Tiamat started granting clerical powers to the Karanoks in order to manipulated them .

title: House Kenafin
description: House Kenafin House Kenafin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was ranked the tenth house of the city in the year 1361 DR . The females of the house reigned supreme and were famous for taking immense delight in subjugating and terrorizing the house males .
description_long: House Kenafin House Kenafin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was ranked the tenth house of the city in the year 1361 DR . The females of the house reigned supreme and were famous for taking immense delight in subjugating and terrorizing the house males . History . Around 1383 DR , House Kenafin defended House Horlbar against an attack by House Tuin ' Tarl . The two houses subsequently joined forces and formed the new House Melarn .

title: House Korianthil
description: House Korianthil House Korianthil was an elven house on Evermeet . History . In 1367 DR , it was led by the experienced war wizard Hatharal Korianthil .
description_long: House Korianthil House Korianthil was an elven house on Evermeet . History . In 1367 DR , it was led by the experienced war wizard Hatharal Korianthil . It specialized in the training of dog s , hawk s , and horse s . Prior to the Retreat , the animals it trained were considered to be the finest in Faerûn .

title: House Mallyth
description: House Mallyth House Mallyth was a former noble house of Tethyr that rose to prominence several centuries before 1479 DR . Due to their questionable activities , which included blackmail and influence peddling , they were soon stripped of their noble status . After losing their nobility , they left Tethyr for Scornubel , Sembia , Westgate and other cities .
description_long: House Mallyth House Mallyth was a former noble house of Tethyr that rose to prominence several centuries before 1479 DR . Due to their questionable activities , which included blackmail and influence peddling , they were soon stripped of their noble status . After losing their nobility , they left Tethyr for Scornubel , Sembia , Westgate and other cities . The family continued to engage in disreputable activities and reportedly traded demonic goods from the Abyss .

title: House Masq ' il ' yr
description: House Masq ' il ' yr House Masq ' il ' yr is a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . It fell during the wars with House Nasadra when Menzoberranzan was still young . Priest s and priestesses survive as ghauroper s in an underwater temple beneath Donigarten .
description_long: House Masq ' il ' yr House Masq ' il ' yr is a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . It fell during the wars with House Nasadra when Menzoberranzan was still young . Priest s and priestesses survive as ghauroper s in an underwater temple beneath Donigarten . They worship Ghaunadaur .

title: House Melarn ( Ched Nasad )
description: House Melarn ( Ched Nasad ) House Melarn was a drow house in Ched Nasad , which fell during the destruction of Ched Nasad during the Silence of Lolth ( 1372 DR ) . House . House Melarn ' s compound was a huge cyst - like bulge on the second - highest level of the city .
description_long: House Melarn ( Ched Nasad ) House Melarn was a drow house in Ched Nasad , which fell during the destruction of Ched Nasad during the Silence of Lolth ( 1372 DR ) . House . House Melarn ' s compound was a huge cyst - like bulge on the second - highest level of the city . The waiting room at House Melarn was covered in statues and frescos with motifs of spiders , webs , drow , and musical instruments . There was a broken bust of Mathira Melarn in House Melarn ' s great hall . Activities . House Melarn and House Baenre of Menzoberranzan owned the Black Claw Mercantile Company , whose storehouses were operated by House Zauvirr . House Melarn had a secret family tradition : chosen females studied " bae ' qeshel " bardic magic to become " dark minstrels . " History . Prior to its fall , House Melarn had stood for twenty centuries or more . In 1372 DR , Matron Mother Ssipriina Zauvirr hired the duergar mercenary band Clan Xornbane to assist in an attempt to destroy House Melarn . Ssipriina took over the Black Claw storehouses , killing Matron Mother Drisinil Melarn .

title: House Melarn ( Menzoberranzan )
description: House Melarn ( Menzoberranzan ) House Melarn was the sixth house of Menzoberranzan by the end of 1484 DR . Headquarters . The House Melarn compound was located in Lolth ' s Web — webs strung hundreds of feet off the cavern floor — in West Wall in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: House Melarn ( Menzoberranzan ) House Melarn was the sixth house of Menzoberranzan by the end of 1484 DR . Headquarters . The House Melarn compound was located in Lolth ' s Web — webs strung hundreds of feet off the cavern floor — in West Wall in Menzoberranzan . It was constructed after the unification of House Horlbar and House Kenafin with the expertise of drow refugees from Ched Nasad . The webs were lined with " faerie fire " . The compound took the form of a shell , with a shrine to Lolth in the center , nobles ' rooms around that , and other living quarters in the outer rings . The compound was guarded by spider s and drider s , as well as drow guards . Activities . House Melarn was known as one of the Menzoberranyr houses most fanatical to Lolth . Matron Zhindia Melarn believed such fanaticism , including calling out other houses ' apparent blasphemy , would bring Lolth ' s favor upon her . However , most houses resented House Melarn because of their behavior . The house was strong militarily , but did not hire outsiders such as Bregan D ' aerthe for fears concerning their loyalty .

title: House Miritar
description: House Miritar House Miritar was an elven clan on the island of Evermeet . Since the 9th century DR , they looked after the northern fishing town of Elion and its surrounding area . Around 1374 DR , the house occupied by the clan was called Seamist .
description_long: House Miritar House Miritar was an elven clan on the island of Evermeet . Since the 9th century DR , they looked after the northern fishing town of Elion and its surrounding area . Around 1374 DR , the house occupied by the clan was called Seamist . History . Originally from Cormanthor , the Miritars fled Myth Drannor when the city fell .

title: House Mizzrym
description: House Mizzrym House Mizzrym was the fifth drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . Headquarters . House Mizzrym was located on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl .
description_long: House Mizzrym House Mizzrym was the fifth drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . Headquarters . House Mizzrym was located on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl . It was guarded by foulwing s , which some members of the house , including Pharaun Mizzrym , could ride . Activities . Mages of House Mizzrym were well known for their skill at illusion s . History . Founded relatively recently compared to other drow noble houses in −643 DR , House Mizzrym ' s rise to power over the centuries was founded on trade , including with non - drow races . By 1357 DR , the House had cultivated clandestine trade deals with deep gnomes and garnered a great deal of wealth . This allowed it to rise to the position of seventh house of Menzoberranzan . In 1359 DR , House Mizzrym moved up to sixth house when House Oblodra was destroyed during the Time of Troubles by House Baenre . During the Silence of Lolth ( 1372 DR – 1373 DR ) , House Mizzrym climbed the ranks once again to fifth house thanks to the treachery and fall of House Agrach Dyrr . In 1484 DR , House Mizzrym ascended to the fourth house after the departure of House Xorlarrin for Q ' Xorlarrin , replacing House Faen Tlabbar .

title: House Naerhand
description: House Naerhand House Naerhand was a merchant house operating from the Sword Coast to the western Sea of Fallen Stars as of 1479 DR . Although the clan was fabulously wealthy , they avoided joining the ranks of nobles , preferring to work behind the scenes . The family dominated the harness making trade and controlled key rest stops and watering holes along trade routes .
description_long: House Naerhand House Naerhand was a merchant house operating from the Sword Coast to the western Sea of Fallen Stars as of 1479 DR . Although the clan was fabulously wealthy , they avoided joining the ranks of nobles , preferring to work behind the scenes . The family dominated the harness making trade and controlled key rest stops and watering holes along trade routes . The family owned hundreds of properties in Suzail , Athkatla , Saerloon and Waterdeep and placed spies within many noble families in Waterdeep and Cormyr . The Naerhand ' s were known for avenging any wrongs done to the family although they often used indirect means to achieve vengeance . Leadership . The clan was always led by a matriarch . As of 1479 DR , Janszeene Naerhand was the acting matriarch although her mother , Velarra still took an active hand in management of the family ' s business .

title: House Nasadra
description: House Nasadra House Nasadra , formerly of Menzoberranzan , was the most powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . The matron mother of the house was the informal ruler of Ched Nasad until the city ' s destruction in 1372 DR . House .
description_long: House Nasadra House Nasadra , formerly of Menzoberranzan , was the most powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . The matron mother of the house was the informal ruler of Ched Nasad until the city ' s destruction in 1372 DR . House . House Nasadra was located on the first top level of Ched Nasad . It had high balconies from which one could view the city and its stone webs and castles . History . Originally a house in Menzoberranzan , House Nasadra fought against House S ' sril and was exiled , along with others , from the city by House Baenre , which had received the favor of Lolth . After many decades of exile , in - 3843 DR Lolth ' s avatar appeared to House Nasadra and the other exiles , leading them to the current location of Ched Nasad and instructing them to found another city honoring Lolth and remaining friendly with Menzoberranzan . In 1372 DR , during the duergar attack on House Melarn and the city , Matron Mother Aunrae Nasadra and four other matrons summoned a huge guardian spider . They lost control of the spider and it contributed to the city ' s downfall .

title: House Nierdre
description: House Nierdre House Nierdre was a sun elf house orgionally founded in Myth Drannor . Base of Operations . The house ' s estate in Leuthilspar was constructed from a rare and unusual shiny black stone .
description_long: House Nierdre House Nierdre was a sun elf house orgionally founded in Myth Drannor . Base of Operations . The house ' s estate in Leuthilspar was constructed from a rare and unusual shiny black stone . The house symbol was a silhouette of a black dragon . History . During the Weeping War , only two of the house ' s members survived and escaped to the island of Evermeet where the house has gradually replenished its numbers . By 1367 DR , the house was led by Lord Maiele Nierdre .

title: House Nightstar
description: House Nightstar House Nightstar was a moon elf house led in 1367 DR by the twin sisters Halaema Nightstar and Saelihn Nightstar . History . The family moved to Evermeet after the fall of Myth Drannor .
description_long: House Nightstar House Nightstar was a moon elf house led in 1367 DR by the twin sisters Halaema Nightstar and Saelihn Nightstar . History . The family moved to Evermeet after the fall of Myth Drannor . The house ' s estate was in Leuthilspar , constructed in a mix of architectural styles and was grown magically from stone and wood . Some members of the house traversed Faerûn in order to gather information for the good of Evermeet . Organization . The house was one of only two ( the other being House Ahmaquissar ) allowed to enter the Hawksong house in Leuthilspar . The house symbol was a silver eight - pointed star displayed above doorways .

title: House Norjah
description: House Norjah House Norjah was a noble house in the city of Airspur whose mansion was located in Airspur ' s south - facing cliffs . The house was most notable for being almost entirely composed of vampires . House Norjah managed to acquire seven of the twenty - two Whispering Children artifacts .
description_long: House Norjah House Norjah was a noble house in the city of Airspur whose mansion was located in Airspur ' s south - facing cliffs . The house was most notable for being almost entirely composed of vampires . House Norjah managed to acquire seven of the twenty - two Whispering Children artifacts . In 1479 DR , the genasi Riltana stole one of the Whispering Children and Lord Kasdrian sent vampiric assassin s after her although they eventually reached a truce .

title: House Oblodra
description: House Oblodra House Oblodra was a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . Base . House Oblodra ' s compound was located in the district of Duthcloim ( often referred to as Manyfolk ) , where it clung to a cliff face between the two " fingers " of the Clawrift .
description_long: House Oblodra House Oblodra was a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . Base . House Oblodra ' s compound was located in the district of Duthcloim ( often referred to as Manyfolk ) , where it clung to a cliff face between the two " fingers " of the Clawrift . Its compound was small but protected on three sides by the Clawrift and guarded by soldiers on the other side . Most of the Oblodrans ' slaves were kobold s kept in pens and tunnels in the Clawrift . Although the Oblodrans claimed to have only 600 kobolds , the Clawrift was capable of holding ten of thousands more , and many houses suspected they were lying . Although the diamond - shaped compound was small , it was quite spacious relative to the number of inhabitants . Even lower - ranked drow had private chambers . Activities . House Oblodra was gifted in the rare art of psionics and its members were known for their fanaticism to psionics . They were considered reckless and insane by the rest of the city . It was rumored that the house sent its daughters away to train with ( and even breed with ) illithid s . The House of very secretive .

title: House Phull
description: House Phull House Phull was a noble house of Waterdeep and one of the older noble families in the city . Around 1440 DR Mhairdren Phull purchased the original Phull ' s title of nobility from the impoverished family . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son , Blakrho Phull , murdered his elder brother and blamed the crime on his younger brother .
description_long: House Phull House Phull was a noble house of Waterdeep and one of the older noble families in the city . Around 1440 DR Mhairdren Phull purchased the original Phull ' s title of nobility from the impoverished family . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son , Blakrho Phull , murdered his elder brother and blamed the crime on his younger brother . The frame - up was initially believed by the city guard , however , when Mhairdren caught Blakrho beating his mother it became obvious that Blakrho was the culprit . Blakrho fled Waterdeep to pursue a life of banditry in the Southern Sword Coast region .

title: House Serrat
description: House Serrat House Serrat was a large merchant clan from Delzimmer that was best known for controlling trade in the drug terazul . Strictly speaking , the family wasn ' t noble as Delzimmer had no nobility . The family was considered a second - tier merchant house , below the Four Families who ruled Delzimmer .
description_long: House Serrat House Serrat was a large merchant clan from Delzimmer that was best known for controlling trade in the drug terazul . Strictly speaking , the family wasn ' t noble as Delzimmer had no nobility . The family was considered a second - tier merchant house , below the Four Families who ruled Delzimmer . Organization . The clan was divided into three branches : Religion . House Serrat ' s patron deity was the goddess Waukeen . Ethics . House Serrat was somewhat neutral in ethical outlook . Although the clan was loyal to its members and retainers the family was not above employing spies and enforcers against its rivals . The family ' s main source of wealth was trade in the drug terazul , although they informed users of its side effects . The family was also known for operating gambling houses .

title: House Shaelara
description: House Shaelara House Shaelara was a sun elf house on Evermeet . History . As of 1369 DR , the house was led by Uthorim Shaelara ; most of its members were under a hundred years old .
description_long: House Shaelara House Shaelara was a sun elf house on Evermeet . History . As of 1369 DR , the house was led by Uthorim Shaelara ; most of its members were under a hundred years old . The house arrived on Evermeet from Faerûn around 1359 DR and magically grew a building of grey and white stone in Leuthilspar . The house was boisterous in comparison to older houses and was noted for frequently causing trouble , especially with silver elves .

title: House Shobalar
description: House Shobalar House Shobalar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . The house was uncharacteristically reclusive , even by Menzoberranzan standards .
description_long: House Shobalar House Shobalar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . The house was uncharacteristically reclusive , even by Menzoberranzan standards . The house guard was made up of magically bred giant spider s . The house was renowned for its spider cavalry . Shobalar maintaned an outpost , Sezz ' ia , were they conducted arcane researches History . Liriel Baenre was given at a young age to House Shobalar by her father , Gromph Baenre , to be trained in the ways of magic . House Shobalar was destroyed around 1379 DR .

title: House Srune ' Lett
description: House Srune ' Lett House Srune ' Lett was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that was destroyed in the War of the Spider Queen . Description . House Srune ' Lett had a compound in the district of Narbondellyn .
description_long: House Srune ' Lett House Srune ' Lett was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that was destroyed in the War of the Spider Queen . Description . House Srune ' Lett had a compound in the district of Narbondellyn . Priestesses of Srune ' Lett were often known as the " fat sisters " for their stocky build . History . In the late 15th century DR , a building in its compound was used as a meeting place by the Council of Spiders . This resulted in fights between the Council , the Jaezred Chaulssin , and adventurers sent by major powers of the city , threatening to cause another civil war .

title: House T ' sarran
description: House T ' sarran House T ' sarran was a drow house from Maerimydra that worshiped the goddess Kiaransalee . Organization . The house was led by Irae T ' sarran and by her immediate family .
description_long: House T ' sarran House T ' sarran was a drow house from Maerimydra that worshiped the goddess Kiaransalee . Organization . The house was led by Irae T ' sarran and by her immediate family . Like other drow houses , the offspring of the matron mother , Dorina T ' sarran and Zedarr T ' sarran , were the next most influential members , often being given important tasks or preferential treatment by their mother . Dorina T ' sarran ' s nieces , Velina and Velasta T ' sarran , were ranked just below Irae ' s children . The numerous other members of House T ' sarran were drow who were willing to fight for and bear the insignia of the House , and they lay beneath the noble family . Activities . As adherents to Kiaransalee , the House would try to enact her will under the guidance of Irae . Tactics . House T ' sarran was a vengeful house , with a tendency to enact vengeance upon any who crossed them . They were willing to expend the lives of their drow soldiers more readily than other houses ; this was because they believed their foot soldiers could easily be raised as stronger undead later . Base of operations . Originally , House T ' sarran was based in Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes .

title: House Tanor ' Thal
description: House Tanor ' Thal House Tanor ' Thal was the dominant house in the drow city of Karsoluthiyl . This was in no small part due to the large number of slaves the house sold in Skullport . Using a " portal " to their outpost of Kyorlamshin , led by Matron Tanor ' Thal ' s niece of Kesra , they captured any potential slaves that they could and sold them in the bazaars of Skullport .
description_long: House Tanor ' Thal House Tanor ' Thal was the dominant house in the drow city of Karsoluthiyl . This was in no small part due to the large number of slaves the house sold in Skullport . Using a " portal " to their outpost of Kyorlamshin , led by Matron Tanor ' Thal ' s niece of Kesra , they captured any potential slaves that they could and sold them in the bazaars of Skullport . House Tanor ' Thal was , in fact , Skullport ' s most prominent drow slaving organization . Political pressure was being put on Matron Tanor ' Thal back in Karsoluthiyl to allow access to Kyorlamshin ' s " portal " for the other houses of the city . This was a concession the matron mother did not wish to make . A new opportunity opened up in the svirfneblin town of Underhaven , where a lot of displaced drow had recently begun to dwell .

title: House Teken ' duis
description: House Teken ' duis House Teken ' duis was formerly a noble drow house in the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House Teken ' duis resided in a two - stalagmite compound in the northwest part of the city in West Wall .
description_long: House Teken ' duis House Teken ' duis was formerly a noble drow house in the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House Teken ' duis resided in a two - stalagmite compound in the northwest part of the city in West Wall . History . House Teken ' duis was the seventeenth house in 1297 DR . After the elimination of House DeVir , it became the sixteenth house . In 1319 DR , House Teken ' duis attempted to attack and defeat House Freth . However , it failed to eliminate all witnesses of the attack . Thus , all members of the house were executed by the Ruling Council . House Baenre made a public spectacle of this execution : The Mistresses of Arach - Tinilith opened portals to the lower planes , and conjured demon s to aid in the execution . Together with the students and masters of Melee Magthere and Sorcere , they overran the house and slaughtered the entrenched drow . The ruined manor remained abandoned in West Wall .

title: House Teyachumet
description: House Teyachumet House Teyachumet was a deceased drow house of Ched Nasad . History . House Teyachumet was destroyed more than a century before 1366 DR ( that is , sometime before 1266 DR ) .
description_long: House Teyachumet House Teyachumet was a deceased drow house of Ched Nasad . History . House Teyachumet was destroyed more than a century before 1366 DR ( that is , sometime before 1266 DR ) . Bregan D ' aerthe was likely involved in the house ' s downfall .

title: House Thann
