description: House Thann Thann was a noble Waterdhavian house that were known as a leading vintner in the Waterdeep region . Activities . The Thann family owned large plots of land to both the north and south of Waterdeep .
description_long: House Thann Thann was a noble Waterdhavian house that were known as a leading vintner in the Waterdeep region . Activities . The Thann family owned large plots of land to both the north and south of Waterdeep . The house had strong ties to Blackstaff Tower , since Cassandra was publicly known as the sister of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . They also had strong ties with the Vintners ' , Distillers ' and Brewers ' Guild . House Thann were closely allied with the Tethyr ian royal house and were engaged in the Reclamation of Tethyr . The family , originally based in Waterdeep , had actually split into two and the other branch of the family was based in Tethyr . Residence . The Thann family owned a villa in the North Ward of Waterdeep . History . House Thann was originally a Velen ese family that made its fortunes in the slave trade by taking slaves from the Port of Shadow to the south . In 1315 DR , Rhammas convinced his father , Erktos Thann , to abandon the slave trade . They then began focusing on land holdings , wine , and shipping . They continued some work in less reputable trades , however .

title: House Vandree
description: House Vandree House Vandree was the 17th drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1358 DR and therefore one of the minor drow houses in the city . By 1480 DR , it had become the eighth house and thus a member of the Ruling Council . Headquarters .
description_long: House Vandree House Vandree was the 17th drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1358 DR and therefore one of the minor drow houses in the city . By 1480 DR , it had become the eighth house and thus a member of the Ruling Council . Headquarters . House Vandree was located in a huge , walled compound south of House Do ' Urden in the district of West Wall . The compound ' s main walls extended outwards ( to the east ) from the wall , appearing almost like a beak . Another source lists the location of House Vandree in the 15th century DR as in Duthcloim , which may be due to an error or unclear district boundaries , since it seems unlikely that the house would move to an area of lesser prestige . Activities . The members of House Vandree were very interested in Surface affairs and frequently collected trophies from the Surface , from leaves to human skulls . History . An tragic fate came upon one of the daughters of House Vandree around the year 1322 . Sosdrielle Vandree became one of the latest liaisons of the archmage Gromph Baenre and gave birth to his daughter Liriel .

title: House Veruna
description: House Veruna House Veruna is a very large trading company based in Mulmaster , with several enterprising bases in Moonsea cities . History . In the mid 1470s DR , House Veruna commissioned a compound in the frontier town of Hulburg , with large help from Sergen Hulmaster .
description_long: House Veruna House Veruna is a very large trading company based in Mulmaster , with several enterprising bases in Moonsea cities . History . In the mid 1470s DR , House Veruna commissioned a compound in the frontier town of Hulburg , with large help from Sergen Hulmaster . When Sergen made a bid for power in the 1479 DR and tried to have his family killed , he used several House Veruna mercenaries to keep them contained within Griffonwatch Keep , where Sergen ' s minions were doing their dirty work . After the Hulmaster s escaped , Sergen fled Hulburg and House Veruna was banned from the town .

title: House Vyshaan
description: House Vyshaan House Vyshaan were a clan of extremely power hungry sun elves who came to power in ancient Aryvandaar . History . After a time they became corrupt and learned malignant forms of magic from devil s which gave them supreme arcane might .
description_long: House Vyshaan House Vyshaan were a clan of extremely power hungry sun elves who came to power in ancient Aryvandaar . History . After a time they became corrupt and learned malignant forms of magic from devil s which gave them supreme arcane might . In - 10900 DR they gained a secret patron in the fallen solar , Malkizid . They conspired with Malkizid to learn powerful rituals of mythal craft which havent been matched since . They were also the first to use mythal craft in war . They built crystal citadels on some of the lower planes to provide a residence when they were visiting . Their clans also created some of the best armor and war weapons including some of the first elven war golem s . One of the final acts of House Vyshaan was to make the Waymeet , which was originaly developed as a war machine .

title: House Xorlarrin
description: House Xorlarrin House Xorlarrin was a drow house formerly of Menzoberranzan . It had been considered the " most magical " house of that city . The entire house relocated to Q ' Xorlarrin in Gauntlgrym in 1484 DR .
description_long: House Xorlarrin House Xorlarrin was a drow house formerly of Menzoberranzan . It had been considered the " most magical " house of that city . The entire house relocated to Q ' Xorlarrin in Gauntlgrym in 1484 DR . Citadel Xorlarrin . Citadel Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan housed Spelltower Xorlarrin . The citadel was located on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl . One of the major marvels of the city , akin in its awe inspiring majesty to Narbondel slowly marking time in the center of the city , the castle of Xorlarrin was a sight to behold . Although the family that occupied it were only fifth in the Menzoberranyr hierarchy , you would be challenged to find any other locale in all the Underdark ( or the world above for that matter ) that boasted such magnificence . The walls were striped in permanent and ever shifting faerie fire , with floating battlements set atop its high walls . It could be argued that the entire palace was a gigantic magical artifact in that marvels abound and magic was built into the most mundane of attributes both functional and decorative . The fortress loomed into the sky dwarfing the buildings around it , and was composed of a deceptive profile .

title: House Yauntyrr
description: House Yauntyrr House Yauntyrr was a noble house of Eryndlyn until its destruction circa 1362 DR . History . Circa 1362 DR , House Yauntyrr was attacked and defeated .
description_long: House Yauntyrr House Yauntyrr was a noble house of Eryndlyn until its destruction circa 1362 DR . History . Circa 1362 DR , House Yauntyrr was attacked and defeated . Many members of the house were killed ; others were taken in by Ched Nasad ' s houses ( such as Danifae Yauntyrr , who became a battle captive to Halisstra Melarn ) and yet other survivors fled into the Underdark . Zinnirit Yauntyrr , the house wizard , escaped to Sschindylryn , where he began operating a three - portal gatehouse until his death at the hands of Danifae in 1373 DR .

title: House Zauvirr
description: House Zauvirr House Zauvirr was a minor drow house in Ched Nasad . Description . House Zauvirr was a minor merchant house of Ched Nasad .
description_long: House Zauvirr House Zauvirr was a minor drow house in Ched Nasad . Description . House Zauvirr was a minor merchant house of Ched Nasad . It operated the storehouses of the Black Claw Mercantile Company , which was owned by House Melarn and the Menzoberranyr House Baenre . History . In 1372 DR , House Zauvirr attempted to defeat House Melarn . Matron Mother Ssipriina Zauvirr hired the duergar mercenary band Clan Xornbane to assist . She took over the Black Claw storehouses , killing Matron Mother Drisinil Melarn . Ssipriina ' s daughter , Faeryl Zauvirr , also betrayed Quenthel Baenre and her protector Jeggred by leading the two to her mother to be captured . However , Clan Xornbane was given the direction to attack House Melarn prematurely . Their stonefire bombs contributed to chaos in the city . Angry at the disruption to her plans , Ssiipriina turned on them , killing the leader of the clan , Khorrl Xornbane , and causing the rest of the band to flee . However , the duergar ' s stonefire ( as part of a Jaezred Chaulssin plot directed by Zammzt ) rapidly destroyed the city .

title: House of Al - Birar
description: House of Al - Birar The House of Al - Birar was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Through a stroke of cleverness , the House of Al - Birar employed several sha ' ir s and their marid to keep their warehouses cool enough to prevent food spoilage .
description_long: House of Al - Birar The House of Al - Birar was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Through a stroke of cleverness , the House of Al - Birar employed several sha ' ir s and their marid to keep their warehouses cool enough to prevent food spoilage . Though this method was expensive , the Al - Birar family became quite rich . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Birar was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz . History . Al - Birar focused on food and other potable items including wine , fruit , and meat . They supplied many of the popular restaurants and cafes in Huzuz .

title: House of Al - Cinel
description: House of Al - Cinel The House of Al - Cinel was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Cinel was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz .
description_long: House of Al - Cinel The House of Al - Cinel was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Cinel was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz . History . The House of Al - Cinel specialized in procuring larger rare items including statues , fountains , and tapestries . This merchant family was able to acquire a Halruaan skyship . They kept it locked away within a warehouse where only members of the family were allowed to enter . Two elven mage s worked tirelessly to determine how the ship was able to achieve flight , though since they lacked the necessary control rod , their efforts were probably in vain .

title: House of Al - Danafi
description: House of Al - Danafi The House of Al - Danafi was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Khwaja al - Danaf and his wife Perijan were the original founders of their house .
description_long: House of Al - Danafi The House of Al - Danafi was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Khwaja al - Danaf and his wife Perijan were the original founders of their house . Squads of warriors carefully guarded the buildings owned by Al - Danafi . Some of these guards maintained rooftop vigils while others performed mobile patrols of the facilities . Outside of the guards , the House of Al - Danafi employed nearly 1 , 000 individuals with various positions . Activites . The Al - Danafi contacted business relations in Durpar with the hopes of adding exotic items such as fine silk and rare spices to their already impressive array of common goods . Their ships sailed the Golden Gulf and the Crowded Sea , bringing their fine wares to all corners of Zakhara . Khwaja ' s daughter , Tanya was married to the Grand Caliph for a with a dowry of 500 , 000 " dinar s " . Because of their close relationship with the Grand Caliph , the ships of al - Danafi enjoyed unique mooring privileges in the harbors of Huzuz . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Danafi was based within the Warehouse District of Huzuz .

title: House of Al - Dinak
description: House of Al - Dinak The House of Al - Dinak was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . After experiencing a slew of devastating caravan attacks , the House of Al - Dinak began hiring adventurers to guard their caravans .
description_long: House of Al - Dinak The House of Al - Dinak was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . After experiencing a slew of devastating caravan attacks , the House of Al - Dinak began hiring adventurers to guard their caravans . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Dinak was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz . History . The House of Al - Dinak was a sworn enemy of the House of Al - Danafi . They recently closed one of their warehouses , prompting an insultingly low offer from Al - Danafi to purchase the holding . Al - Dinak dealt with a variety of trade goods . The combination of poor decision - making and bad luck on the caravan trails left them dealing with hard times . Their financial situation lead others to believe that their goods possessed poor quality .

title: House of Al - Farif
description: House of Al - Farif The House of Al - Farif was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Mamluk s of the Diligent Mamluk Society and several sha ' ir s and wind mages were employed to protect their warehouse .
description_long: House of Al - Farif The House of Al - Farif was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Mamluk s of the Diligent Mamluk Society and several sha ' ir s and wind mages were employed to protect their warehouse . Their guards were a cut above the common guards found within the Warehouse District of Huzuz . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Farif was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz . History . Al - Farif owned a moderately sized spice warehouse . Though they held fewer and smaller warehouses than many other merchant families , the spices sold by the House of Al - Farif were worth more than their weight in gold .

title: House of Al - Kamari
description: House of Al - Kamari The House of Al - Kamari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . They claimed to make the finest silks in all of Al - Toril . Organization .
description_long: House of Al - Kamari The House of Al - Kamari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . They claimed to make the finest silks in all of Al - Toril . Organization . The House of Kamari owned the six largest storage buildings within the Warehouse District of Huzuz . In addition to this , they owned over a dozen factories within the Clothiers ' District that processed their silk . Mu ' izzi al - Kamar was the head of the Al - Kamari . Mamluk s from the Diligent Mamluk Society were employed to guard their wares . Base of Operations . This merchant family was based out of Huzuz , the City of Delights . History . Silk and other expensive fabrics were the focus of the House of Al - Kamari . The merchant house was able to instill pride in their workers , earning their careful attention to detail when handling the delicate silk . Much of their silk came from large mulberry orchards located south of Huzuz . Silk moths fed on the mulberry until their cocoons were harvested . The Al - Kamari conducted experiments to see if spider silk would be another viable option . The Al - Kamari employed over 1 , 000 people in Huzuz , most of whom were women .

title: House of Al - Klemari
description: House of Al - Klemari The House of Al - Klemari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Klemari was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz .
description_long: House of Al - Klemari The House of Al - Klemari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Klemari was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz . History . The Al - Klemari specialized in the trade of arms and armor . In addition to selling their items , they had skilled artisans who took special commissions for unique weapons or armor . Orders were procured from their agents who were stationed in the Grand Bazaar .

title: House of Al - Thuria
description: House of Al - Thuria The House of Al - Thuria was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Each of their three large factories specialized in making leather goods including leather armor , saddles and tack , and sandals and other common items .
description_long: House of Al - Thuria The House of Al - Thuria was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Each of their three large factories specialized in making leather goods including leather armor , saddles and tack , and sandals and other common items . Jamila al - Thuri was the matriarch of the family . History . This prominent dwarven family specialized in all kinds of leather goods . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Thuria was based in the Clothiers ' District .

title: House of Bhalla
description: House of Bhalla The House of Bhalla was a temple to Chauntea in Immilmar , Rashemen . Structure . The House was a old medium sized stone building near the Iron Lord ' s citadel .
description_long: House of Bhalla The House of Bhalla was a temple to Chauntea in Immilmar , Rashemen . Structure . The House was a old medium sized stone building near the Iron Lord ' s citadel . Inhabitants . Around 1372 DR , the temple was led by Brother Dervarr .

title: House of Firehair
description: House of Firehair The House of Firehair was an enormous fortified cathedral dedicated to Sune that sat atop a pastoral hill in the middle of Daerlun . Structure . Walls surrounded the entire hill that The House of Firehair stood upon , separating it from the rest of Daerlun .
description_long: House of Firehair The House of Firehair was an enormous fortified cathedral dedicated to Sune that sat atop a pastoral hill in the middle of Daerlun . Structure . Walls surrounded the entire hill that The House of Firehair stood upon , separating it from the rest of Daerlun . The central structure was composed of numerous buildings , each connected with those nearby by soaring stone bridges . The House of Firehair maintained a warm and habitable atmosphere even during the winter months and was decorated with hanging plants . The priests raised and tended to the beautiful birds that would perch on the cathedrals creeping plants . Its graceful arches were famed all across Faerûn as the pinnacle of gentle beauty . History . The House of Firehair was older than Daerlun itself , as the city grew up from a small village that was originally founded to serve the temple ' s inhabitants . By 1374 DR the temple still stood . Inhabitants . By 1358 DR , The House of Firehair was led by High Priestess Thauna Maskalar . Serving the high priestess were a total of 48 cleric s , all human s and half - elves , and 336 lay followers .

title: House of Galbi
description: House of Galbi The House of Galbi was a notorious establishment found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Activities . Many illicit activities such as gambling and excessive drinking occurred within the House of Galbi .
description_long: House of Galbi The House of Galbi was a notorious establishment found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Activities . Many illicit activities such as gambling and excessive drinking occurred within the House of Galbi . Rumors surfaced that more heinous tastes could be catered to here as well , but the governor of Manass was not able gather enough proof to close the building down . Inhabitants . Galbi , a native of Semphar , owned the establishment . He was rumored to run a den of skilled thieves from his House as well .

title: House of Glory
description: House of Glory The House of Glory was a temple to Tempus , the Lord of Battles , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Glory lay on the northeastern edge of the city .
description_long: House of Glory The House of Glory was a temple to Tempus , the Lord of Battles , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Glory lay on the northeastern edge of the city . History . During the Time of Troubles of the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths in the city as " unbelievers " . Meanwhile , the House of Glory was damaged in an accidentally started fire . Nevertheless , the House of Glory remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Inhabitants . In 1358 DR , the temple was led by High Battlemaster Thiotar Umbarton , with sixteen priests and twenty - two lay - followers .

title: House of Heroes
description: House of Heroes The temple of Tempus the lord of battles was located in the Sea ward of Waterdeep . Rebuilt in 1346 DR . after the night of temple - fall in 1345 DR .
description_long: House of Heroes The temple of Tempus the lord of battles was located in the Sea ward of Waterdeep . Rebuilt in 1346 DR . after the night of temple - fall in 1345 DR . In the year 1359 the temple complex was led by High Sword Turik Bloodhelm and Prior Maxtilar Rhebbos . This temple has provided services for the various combatants from the nearby Field of Triumph and also supports the Academy of Arms , dedicated to the fighting arts . Occasionally the clergy of Tempus will use the Field of Triumph for matters of honorable combat and contests of martial skill that may seem like gladiatorial matches to visitors . Reference : Waterdeep and the North 1987 , City of Splendors box set 1994 .

title: House of Holy Light
description: House of Holy Light The House of Holy Light was a shrine dedicated to Lathander in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .
description_long: House of Holy Light The House of Holy Light was a shrine dedicated to Lathander in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn . The shrine itself was on the outskirts of town , just south of the Three Elves inn on Dump Road , facing east . Description . The House of Holy Light was an open pavilion with no walls , just stone pillars holding up a shingled roof . Under the roof were a set of angled stones that served to hold sheets of that were positioned to capture the rays of the rising sun and reflect them in all directions . On the floor was a simple stone altar and braziers . Surrounding the shrine were small beds of herbs and spices that anyone could sample as long as they did not take the last specimen of any plant . A sign was posted declaring that anyone breaking this rule would incur the wrath of Lathander . Activities . Gentle Father Erngar Narrowlea and several lay followers took turns tending the shrine and working in the herb garden .

title: House of Holy Suffering
description: House of Holy Suffering The House of Holy Suffering was a temple of Ilmater found in Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . History . The House of Holy Suffering was a major temple in the mid – 13th century DR .
description_long: House of Holy Suffering The House of Holy Suffering was a temple of Ilmater found in Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . History . The House of Holy Suffering was a major temple in the mid – 13th century DR . It was led by Exalted Sufferer Shrymaun Beldaerth . Following the death of the sage Athorton of Nleeth in the Year of the Shattered Altar , 1264 DR , the priestess of Ilmater Beromchess Ilthyn covertly took the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the Ilmatari faith — to the House of Holy Suffering . There , the senior Sage - Priest of the church , known as the Spontaer , studied the " Tome " . The Spontaer prayed to Ilmater for nearly a year , and received visions of powerful magical protections that would render the " Tome " usable only by priests of Ilmater . However , these protections would come at the cost of his life . The Spontaer explicitly requested that the " Tome of Torment " be delivered to the House of the Broken God in Keltar in Calimshan , the greatest temple of Ilmater , before he worked the magic on the " Tome " and sacrificed his own life .

title: House of Hope
description: House of Hope The House of Hope was a temple to Tymora the Luckbringer found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Hope lay on the north side of the Market in the center of Tantras .
description_long: House of Hope The House of Hope was a temple to Tymora the Luckbringer found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Hope lay on the north side of the Market in the center of Tantras . History . During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths as " unbelievers " , and the unlucky House of Hope was left with a dearth of material and spiritual resources . Nevertheless , the House of Hope remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Inhabitants . In 1358 DR , the temple was led by High Priestess Lashaera Thindol , with five priests and eight lay - followers .

title: House of Knowledge ( Neverwinter )
description: House of Knowledge ( Neverwinter ) The House of Knowledge is a temple to Oghma in Neverwinter . It is located at one end of the Dolphin Bridge and is run by Chief Priest Watger Brighthair and Elder Reader Salyndra Shaern , who offer their teachings for free . It is a tall building with many windows and an arched roof .
description_long: House of Knowledge ( Neverwinter ) The House of Knowledge is a temple to Oghma in Neverwinter . It is located at one end of the Dolphin Bridge and is run by Chief Priest Watger Brighthair and Elder Reader Salyndra Shaern , who offer their teachings for free . It is a tall building with many windows and an arched roof .

title: House of Mawli
description: House of Mawli The House of Mawli was an unenlightened tribe inhabiting the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in the 1367 DR . Activities . This tribe was primarily involved in raiding weaker tribes or anyone foolish enough to enter the Haunted Lands without a proper escort .
description_long: House of Mawli The House of Mawli was an unenlightened tribe inhabiting the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in the 1367 DR . Activities . This tribe was primarily involved in raiding weaker tribes or anyone foolish enough to enter the Haunted Lands without a proper escort . They sold captured individuals into slavery as well . Members . Roughly thirty raiders and desert thieves comprised any wandering band from the House of Mawli . Jaffer al - Mawli , the son of the clan leader Rashid al - Mawli , usually led these mobile expeditions . It remained unknown exactly how many raiders comprised this organization . Each sect within the House of Mawli had anywhere between 200 and 500 individuals .

title: House of Moander
description: House of Moander The House of Moander was a temple of Moander near the town of Ylraphon and the Flooded Forest in the Vast . Location . The House of Moander lay north of Ylraphon , amidst the boggy woodlands beside the Flooded Forest , which encroached on the ruined city ' s northeast .
description_long: House of Moander The House of Moander was a temple of Moander near the town of Ylraphon and the Flooded Forest in the Vast . Location . The House of Moander lay north of Ylraphon , amidst the boggy woodlands beside the Flooded Forest , which encroached on the ruined city ' s northeast . Like other temples in this area , it was likely built on raised and drier areas of the swamp . Inhabitants . In its ruined state , the temple was the lair of a number of greater darktentacle s . History . The House of Moander was ruined and destroyed by 1367 DR . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , the Six Spiked Rings adventurers explored the House of Moander . The darktentacles attacked and killed some of their number , but two escaped with treasures won from the temple : a large bag of gems and a sack of metal magic wand s of great age and power .

title: House of Moonlight
description: House of Moonlight The House of Moonlight was a temple to Selûne the Moonmaiden found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Moonlight lay on the far east side of the city .
description_long: House of Moonlight The House of Moonlight was a temple to Selûne the Moonmaiden found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Moonlight lay on the far east side of the city . History . During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths in the city as " unbelievers " . Nevertheless , the House of Moonlight remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Activities . Around 1358 DR , the temple provided healing to all who required it , even those who did not worship the goddess . However , they would not accede to repeated requests . Inhabitants . In 1358 DR , the temple was led by High Priest Pellar Thalangrim , with nine priests and sixteen lay - followers .

title: House of Plenty
description: House of Plenty The House of Plenty is a temple of Chauntea in Shadowdale . This is known by the locals as The Garden for its encircling structure of ordered vegetable patches and orchards . The Temple of Chauntea was founded in Shadowdale immediately following the Time of Troubles .
description_long: House of Plenty The House of Plenty is a temple of Chauntea in Shadowdale . This is known by the locals as The Garden for its encircling structure of ordered vegetable patches and orchards . The Temple of Chauntea was founded in Shadowdale immediately following the Time of Troubles . It originally operated out of Beregon Hillstar ' s barn for its early services but soon gained sufficient support ( and money ) to build its own temple complex . The Temple is built on an area known earlier as the Bog . It was always a swampy marsh , and several buildings erected in its confines fell quickly into ruins . The last major structure on the site was a manor house built by Jyordhan for his lieutenants ( agents of Zhentil Keep , including Lyran the Pretender ) . When Castle Krag fell , the manor house was burned to the ground as well , and its foundations were gone within two winters . With the aid of the Circle , from Druid ' s Grove ( who have since moved on ) , the followers of Chauntea drained most of the bog and stopped the natural spring beneath it . They also destroyed a number of undead creatures who had made the wreckage their home .

title: House of R ' maga
description: House of R ' maga The House of R ' maga was a renowned porter business found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Founded by seven ogre brothers in 1357 DR , the House of R ' maga quickly established a well - earned reputation within the Grand Bazaar .
description_long: House of R ' maga The House of R ' maga was a renowned porter business found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Founded by seven ogre brothers in 1357 DR , the House of R ' maga quickly established a well - earned reputation within the Grand Bazaar . Activities . Though they employed others , the ogre brothers took great pride in offering their personal services to dignitaries during the Zakharan Holy Days and Ascension Day . The names of the individual R ' maga brothers are listed below , with a brief description of their speciality with regards to their business :

title: House of Safe Rest
description: House of Safe Rest The House of Safe Rest was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , within the Harbor District on Al - Sarif River . Activities . Though the Harbor District often held a negative reputation , the House of Safe Rest was known to be an affordable place run by a trustworthy individual .
description_long: House of Safe Rest The House of Safe Rest was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , within the Harbor District on Al - Sarif River . Activities . Though the Harbor District often held a negative reputation , the House of Safe Rest was known to be an affordable place run by a trustworthy individual . Inhabitants . The House of Safe Rest was owned and run by Benji Sadira .

title: House of Scarlet Hooks
description: House of Scarlet Hooks House of the Scarlet Hooks was a temple of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain , in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by Whipmistress Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen . She led twenty - four priests and priestesses , as well as 114 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR .
description_long: House of Scarlet Hooks House of the Scarlet Hooks was a temple of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain , in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by Whipmistress Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen . She led twenty - four priests and priestesses , as well as 114 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR . Among the priests were two Pain s . All were particularly eager to spread the so - called " holy pain " . Description . The House of the Scarlet Hooks was one of two temples that dominated daily Calauntan life . It was an impressive temple . The double - spired House of Scarlet Hooks was one of the few notable landmarks in the city , as were the muffled screams .

title: House of Serpents
description: House of Serpents House of Serpents is a trilogy by Lisa Smedman that tells the story of Arvin , a psionically gifted ropemaker from Hlondeth , who gets caught up in the intrigues of the ruling yuan - ti . House of Serpents . The trilogy was republished as an omnibus edition in 2009 .
description_long: House of Serpents House of Serpents is a trilogy by Lisa Smedman that tells the story of Arvin , a psionically gifted ropemaker from Hlondeth , who gets caught up in the intrigues of the ruling yuan - ti . House of Serpents . The trilogy was republished as an omnibus edition in 2009 .

title: House of Sihr
description: House of Sihr The House of Sihr , also known as the jann of the High Desert , was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . All jann of the House of Sihr were enlightened .
description_long: House of Sihr The House of Sihr , also known as the jann of the High Desert , was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . All jann of the House of Sihr were enlightened . The House of Sihr was comprised of many smaller tribes , each led by a sheikh who answered to Amir Bouladin al - Mutajalli . Base of Operations . The scorching wasteland known as the Genies ' Anvil was the home of the House of Sihr .

title: House of Skilled Hands
description: House of Skilled Hands The House of Skilled Hands was a temple to Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Skilled Hands sat almost at the end of Whistleturn Way , near the city ' s waterfront .
description_long: House of Skilled Hands The House of Skilled Hands was a temple to Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Skilled Hands sat almost at the end of Whistleturn Way , near the city ' s waterfront . History . The House of Skilled Hands was only newly constructed in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , and not yet fully staffed . During the Time of Troubles of that year , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths in the city as " unbelievers " . Nevertheless , the House of Skilled Hands remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Activities . The House of Skilled Hands once installed a series of cargo - lifting cranes in Tantras ' s harbor , and received a copper piece for every load lifted . These allowed the city to quickly move large quantities of freight , and made it a popular trade destination . Such cranes were recent inventions by the mid - 1300s , and were also in use in Baldur ' s Gate and Scardale and other ports . Inhabitants .

title: House of Song
description: House of Song The House of Song was the guildhall of the Council of Musicians , Instrument - Makers , and Choristers in Waterdeep . It was located in the city ' s Trade Ward , on the corner of Coach Lamp Lane and Carter ' s Way . Inside , two adjacent columns were paler blue than the others , and there was an old elven song etched near the ceiling here .
description_long: House of Song The House of Song was the guildhall of the Council of Musicians , Instrument - Makers , and Choristers in Waterdeep . It was located in the city ' s Trade Ward , on the corner of Coach Lamp Lane and Carter ' s Way . Inside , two adjacent columns were paler blue than the others , and there was an old elven song etched near the ceiling here . If the tune was played , a gate to Wyllowwood in Undermountain woukd open between the columns .

title: House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing
description: House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing The House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing was a monastery of Ilmater on the western coast of Calimshan .
description_long: House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing The House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing was a monastery of Ilmater on the western coast of Calimshan . Location . This monastery was located high on the cliffs along the northern stretch of the Coast Trail from Teshburl to Memnon . Structure . The House was a former , like many of the monasteries in Calimshan . Activities . In addition to religious activities , the House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing served as a culinary arts school — from exotic food to shipboard fare . Its patron saint , St . Liwan , believed that food could end suffering . Inhabitants . In 1370 DR , the head abbot was Revered Father Akkabar el Souvlak .

title: House of Stone
description: House of Stone The House of Stone , also known as Stoneturn , was an immense square tower on the eastern edge of the Ardeep Forest . Structure . The keep contained hundreds of rooms , halls , temples and towers locked together in a single huge maze .
description_long: House of Stone The House of Stone , also known as Stoneturn , was an immense square tower on the eastern edge of the Ardeep Forest . Structure . The keep contained hundreds of rooms , halls , temples and towers locked together in a single huge maze . Inhabitants . The ruins were overrun with undead including a great many ghoul s and shadow s . More than one entrance to the Underdark could be found within and its denizens frequently wandered up into the building . History . The House of Stone was built at least a thousand years ago by the dwarves and elves of Illefarn . Originally Stoneturn was built to protect Stoneturn Well located in the heart of the area . Construction was started in 344 DR by Turgo Ironfist of Dardath . In the time of Phalorm , the House was expanded and set up as a massive trap to be used against marauding orc s . Mounted elves would provoke orcs to chase them back to the House , whereupon the orcs would be killed in great numbers as they blundered into trap after trap after trap .

title: House of Tezca
description: House of Tezca The House of Tezca was a large desert found south of Nexal on the continent of Maztica . History . The desert was named after the Matizcan sun god Tezca .
description_long: House of Tezca The House of Tezca was a large desert found south of Nexal on the continent of Maztica . History . The desert was named after the Matizcan sun god Tezca . Description . Aside from a few oases , there was very little water in the desert . However , after the Night of Wailing , a chain of oases appeared in the central part of the desert . The mystical Sunstone was located in the Chical Hills in Tezca . Several desert dwarf clans , isolated from their Faerûn ian kin during the time of the Rockfire Cataclysm , lived in a small settlement in the desert .

title: House of Thorne
description: House of Thorne The House of Thorne was a dilapidated old mansion in Waterdeep ' s Sea Ward . Structure . The home was named for the thorn vines that grew on its walls .
description_long: House of Thorne The House of Thorne was a dilapidated old mansion in Waterdeep ' s Sea Ward . Structure . The home was named for the thorn vines that grew on its walls . History . Around 1079 DR , the House of Thorne was the site on which the Circle of Skulls attempted the ritual of the First Flensing . In 1480 DR , noblewoman and wizard Rilyanna Saerfynn attempted to complete the ritual in the house ' s basement but was killed by Quessahn Uthraebor .

title: House of Wo
description: House of Wo The House of Wo was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This four - story structure was capable of lodging hundreds of occupants at the same time , though typically only the cafe was full .
description_long: House of Wo The House of Wo was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This four - story structure was capable of lodging hundreds of occupants at the same time , though typically only the cafe was full . Activities . Named for its owner , Wo , who was one of the best chefs in the entire city , the House of Wo offered some of the finest dining within the City of Delights . Inhabitants . Wo employed Fayaniz al - Nokar to oversee all non food - related facets of the House of Wo .

title: House of Wonder
description: House of Wonder The House of Wonder was a mage academy and former temple of Mystra located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The temple dedicated to Mystra was located on Flint Street and Pharra ' s Alley , which was named after the first mistress of the temple , Pharra .
description_long: House of Wonder The House of Wonder was a mage academy and former temple of Mystra located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The temple dedicated to Mystra was located on Flint Street and Pharra ' s Alley , which was named after the first mistress of the temple , Pharra . History . Prior to the Spellplague and Mystra ' s demise , the House of Wonder was a temple of Mystra . The temple was erected in 1215 DR and continued to function as a house of worship until 1385 DR . After the Spellplague , the former temple was used to educate young mage s . In 1479 DR , Master Rhinzen Halnian nearly destroyed the entire complex when he cast a " meteor swarm " spell at three apprentices he mistook for devil s during a haepthum - induced stupor . By 1480 DR , the House of Wonder had been rebuilt and a new master installed .

title: House of the Bright Blade
description: House of the Bright Blade The House of the Bright Blade , run by Zespara Alather , is perhaps the most famous shop in Mirabar among human s . It is widely renowned as the best shop to get a sword that seems as if it were custom - forged for it ' s wielder . The main room of the shop glitters in the steel of hundreds of swords and dagger s of all sizes , finishes and prices .
description_long: House of the Bright Blade The House of the Bright Blade , run by Zespara Alather , is perhaps the most famous shop in Mirabar among human s . It is widely renowned as the best shop to get a sword that seems as if it were custom - forged for it ' s wielder . The main room of the shop glitters in the steel of hundreds of swords and dagger s of all sizes , finishes and prices .

title: House of the Broken God
description: House of the Broken God The House of the Broken God was a temple , monastery , and hospital dedicated to Ilmater , located in Keltar in Calimshan . It was the largest temple complex of the Broken God , and the center of his faith in southern Faerûn . Location .
description_long: House of the Broken God The House of the Broken God was a temple , monastery , and hospital dedicated to Ilmater , located in Keltar in Calimshan . It was the largest temple complex of the Broken God , and the center of his faith in southern Faerûn . Location . Although most Ilmatari temples in Calimshan were based in the countryside , owing to wealthy Calishites ' dislike of the poor and the sick , the House of the Broken God was a prime exception , being set within a town . Regardless , it was only a minor , distant town , but having such an important facility within its confines made Keltar famous . The temple complex covered the whole of the Northwest Sabban of Keltar , consisting of three of the town ' s drudach s . Farms and additional facilities spread outside the town to the northwest . Layout . The whole complex was surrounded by a perimeter wall that stood 12 feet ( 3 . 6 meters ) high . This wall abutted the sabban walls , standing some 8 – 9 feet ( 2 . 4 – 2 . 7 meters ) over the sabban wall walkway . In the core of the complex was a monastery , a major temple , and two shrines to local Ilmatari saints .

title: House of the Four Moons
description: House of the Four Moons The House of the Four Moons was a white - domed temple to Selûne in Velprintalar ( now Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . In 1368 DR it was led by High Priestess Dyltharra and served by six other priestesses , who kept contact between the Simbul , the Royal Council of Aglarond and the Harpers .
description_long: House of the Four Moons The House of the Four Moons was a white - domed temple to Selûne in Velprintalar ( now Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . In 1368 DR it was led by High Priestess Dyltharra and served by six other priestesses , who kept contact between the Simbul , the Royal Council of Aglarond and the Harpers .

title: House of the Hand
description: House of the Hand The House of the Hand was a temple of Torm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Clerics of the House of the Hand forged the sword " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " for the paladin Bertold the Seeker , to aid him in his quest to discover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr .
description_long: House of the Hand The House of the Hand was a temple of Torm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Clerics of the House of the Hand forged the sword " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " for the paladin Bertold the Seeker , to aid him in his quest to discover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr . However , they did not inform Bertold of the sword ' s ability to absorb his soul upon his death . The purpose of this was to preserve his knowledge and findings , so that they might be passed on to future seekers of Chalsembyr . By 1357 DR , the House of the Hand was led by High Priest Pallar the Obedient . Pallar was still in charge by 1367 DR . Early in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , priests of Torm ran Calispar Delgorth , a priest of Talona , out of Procampur . In Marpenoth of 1367 DR , when Procampur was struck by the featherlung plague , clerics of Torm treated the sick within the Temple District . When Calispar later dealt with the Shadowkind assassin s in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , he asked them to assassinate the high priest of Torm . Inhabitants .

title: House of the Harmed
description: House of the Harmed The House of the Harmed was a temple of Ilmater found in Aralent , home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan at the House of the Harmed in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers and never made it to Olbedan .
description_long: House of the Harmed The House of the Harmed was a temple of Ilmater found in Aralent , home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan at the House of the Harmed in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers and never made it to Olbedan . The " Tome " was thought lost in the winter snows .

title: House of the Helm
description: House of the Helm The House of the Helm was a shrine dedicated to Tempus in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .
description_long: House of the Helm The House of the Helm was a shrine dedicated to Tempus in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn . The shrine itself was on the outskirts of town , on the North Ride , seen on the left by travelers coming into town from the south . Behind the shrine was open pasture and a cart track that led over the mild hills to a rocky place on the verge of the Greentree ( the local name for the branch of the Cormanthor forest nearby ) where charcoal burners kept huts . Description . The shrine was a pavilion open on all sides . The floor was a raised stone slab with an altar in the center , also made of stone and covered in bloodstains . The roof was another large stone slab held up by four thick pillars , each of which leaned outward slightly from the center , making the shrine look like a truncated pyramid turned upside down . Smaller pillars ( also leaning outward ) like giant stalks of straw about five feet ( 1 . 5 m ) tall jutted out of the floor in the spaces between the large pillars and were used to display helms , weapons , or other spoils of war as offerings .

title: House of the Iron Rose
description: House of the Iron Rose The House of the Iron Rose was a sumptuous boarding house in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Typically , only ranking officers and wealthy adventurers stayed there . The House of the Iron Rose offered the finest quality accommodations to those willing to pay for excellence .
description_long: House of the Iron Rose The House of the Iron Rose was a sumptuous boarding house in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Typically , only ranking officers and wealthy adventurers stayed there . The House of the Iron Rose offered the finest quality accommodations to those willing to pay for excellence .

title: House of the Loregiver
description: House of the Loregiver The House of the Loregiver was a sacred site to Enlightened Zakharans found within the Golden Mosque in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This building could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: House of the Loregiver The House of the Loregiver was a sacred site to Enlightened Zakharans found within the Golden Mosque in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This building could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . The actual physical structure of the House of the Loregiver was not impressive since it was a simple one - room house made from clay . Defenses . Since pilgrims enjoyed taking souvenirs from the house , many magical protections were put in place to protect the remaining structure . A " wall of force " surrounded the house . Those who were able to circumvent the wall were met with a magical feeling of dread . Those who pressed further were confronted with four noble genie s , one for each elemental type . Anyone able to strike the house with malicious intent was instantly paralyzed . Additionally , an honor guard of priests guarded the house at all times . History . Many Zakharans believed that this house was the dwelling of the woman who would become the Loregiver . However , other opinions existed as well . A sect of radical Zannites believed the location was only a house that existed during the time of the Loregiver .

title: House of the Master ' s Shadow ( Telflamm )
description: House of the Master ' s Shadow ( Telflamm ) The House of the Master ' s Shadow is a temple of Mask in Telflamm . The House serves as the headquarters of the local thieves guild , led by the Shadowmasters of Telflamm . The House looks like any other temple in Telflamm , except that it has no locks .
description_long: House of the Master ' s Shadow ( Telflamm ) The House of the Master ' s Shadow is a temple of Mask in Telflamm . The House serves as the headquarters of the local thieves guild , led by the Shadowmasters of Telflamm . The House looks like any other temple in Telflamm , except that it has no locks . There ' s no point in locks considering the worshipers here are Shadowmasters and follow Mask . Everyone else in town know better than to try to take something from this temple .

title: House of the Triad
description: House of the Triad The House of the Triad exemplifies the rule of law upholding the principles of good . It is a resplendent plane of majestic marble halls , gleaming palaces , and heavenly radiance . Inhabitants .
description_long: House of the Triad The House of the Triad exemplifies the rule of law upholding the principles of good . It is a resplendent plane of majestic marble halls , gleaming palaces , and heavenly radiance . Inhabitants . The enormous central mountain , Celestia , is the home of the archon s , ruled by Zaphkiel , and is something of a divine realm itself , though no deity lives there . Many of them live on the other surrounding mountains , serving Helm , Ilmater , Torm , or Tyr . Angel s serve the Triad as well , and take on the bulk of the missions to other planes . Also , formian s live here and serve both Helm and Siamorphe on occasion , but generally they live ordered lives without interruption from the divine . Petitioners . Most of the petitioners here are lantern archon s , who have no planar commitment and can leave the House at will . Those who follow Helm or Siamorphe , or otherwise lean more toward neutrality than good , keep the forms they wore in life . They gain the benefits of immunity to electrical attacks , cannot be petrified , and are able to withstand phyical attacks better than they did in life . Access to the House of the Triad .

title: House of the Wise Unicorn
description: House of the Wise Unicorn The House of the Wise Unicorn is a rental club in Nesmé run by Nistlor Lothlyn , who is assisted by sixteen guards . No spellcasting is allowed within the premises . Services .
description_long: House of the Wise Unicorn The House of the Wise Unicorn is a rental club in Nesmé run by Nistlor Lothlyn , who is assisted by sixteen guards . No spellcasting is allowed within the premises . Services . It costs 5 gold pieces per night to rent a room and the Unicorn offers drinks by the bottle .

title: Hovering road
description: Hovering road Hovering road was a conjuration spell that temporarily created a smooth stone road that hovered above any terrain . Effects . Similar to " clear path " , this spell operated on the 10 ft by 10 ft ( 3 m by 3 m ) area directly in front of the caster and extended outward as the caster moved forward .
description_long: Hovering road Hovering road was a conjuration spell that temporarily created a smooth stone road that hovered above any terrain . Effects . Similar to " clear path " , this spell operated on the 10 ft by 10 ft ( 3 m by 3 m ) area directly in front of the caster and extended outward as the caster moved forward . The road had to be anchored to a solid surface , but otherwise hovered above whatever was below . The road created was about 1 ft ( 30 cm ) thick and resembled black granite in appearance and texture , allowing travel at normal movement rates . The caster could direct the road to slope up or down and turn left or right , creating passage over rivers , treetops , chasms , swamps , etc . When the spell ended , the entire road evaporated into a black mist and anything being held up by the road dropped . The " hovering road " was fairly tough and could not be damaged by normal weapons , but if enough damage was done to any part of the road by magical weapons or magical force of some sort , the spell was negated . The road normally lasted for tens of minutes even if the caster was knocked unconscious or killed . Components .

title: Howard Baker
description: Howard Baker Howard Baker was a halfling who owned and operated a fabulous pastry shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Howard exemplified the ethics of Durparian merchants by never overcharging for a pastry he deemed less than perfect .
description_long: Howard Baker Howard Baker was a halfling who owned and operated a fabulous pastry shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Howard exemplified the ethics of Durparian merchants by never overcharging for a pastry he deemed less than perfect . Activities . Howard employed ten halflings , including his wife and daughter . His culinary skills helped increase the " delight " within the City of Delights as his customers paid handsomely to sample his sweets . Among his specialties were " bouqthi " , a tart and sweet rhubarb pastry , a hot cherry peach pie named " the bubbler , " and an assortment of fruitcakes . History . Howard was part of the notoriously rich Baker family of Durpar . He moved to Zakhara to help his family expand their enterprises even further .

title: Howard Holiday
description: Howard Holiday Howard Holiday was the Deputy Mayor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? .
description_long: Howard Holiday Howard Holiday was the Deputy Mayor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? . Appearance . Howard stands 5 ' 11 " tall and weighs 165 pounds . He wears stylish clothes and is one of the most handsome politicians in Ravens Bluff . He is rarely seen without his signature hat , a fancy broad - brimmed hat decorated with a Hippogriff plume . The hat is a magical Hat of Difference which gives him his Illusionist ability . Personality . Obsessed with details he continually interferes in the work of others , thinking that nothing can be done properly without his assistance . As a result , he is often weeks behind schedule on projects the Lord Mayor assigns him . He is very friendly , outgoing , charismatic , and generous to a fault , which makes it hard for people to refuse his " help " . As he sees it , marriage is not in his near future because he is too busy to become seriously involved with a woman , even though he is one of the most desirable bachelors in town . Background . Howard came to Ravens Bluff around 1347 DR looking for something less dangerous than the life of an adventurer .

title: Howl of Vengeance
description: Howl of Vengeance The Howl of Vengeance was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between those who ' d conquered the kingdom of Doegan and those who sought to liberate it . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location .
description_long: Howl of Vengeance The Howl of Vengeance was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between those who ' d conquered the kingdom of Doegan and those who sought to liberate it . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location . The battles were fought in the Doegan Capital , in the Serpent Valley , and in and around Old Stone Keep in the mountains to the east . History . Causes . The bloodforges were discovered in the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR . These ancient devices of war could mass - produce entire armies of golems , eliminating overnight the cost of mustering and maintaining armed forces . Unrestrained , the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East each manufactured great golem armies and marched them against one another , bursting into the Bloodforge Wars . The kingdom of Doegan was overrun by invaders led by Rathgar the Raider , who laid siege to the capital and plundered the realm of its bounty .

title: Howling Gap
description: Howling Gap The Howling Gap was a passage between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountains , and was the primary trade passage between Semphar and the east . Description . Created by the space between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountain ranges , too broad to be considered a pass , the Howling Gap sat along the the Silk Road that connected Semphar to the lands of Shou Lung , and served as the primary route of travel between the two nations .
description_long: Howling Gap The Howling Gap was a passage between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountains , and was the primary trade passage between Semphar and the east . Description . Created by the space between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountain ranges , too broad to be considered a pass , the Howling Gap sat along the the Silk Road that connected Semphar to the lands of Shou Lung , and served as the primary route of travel between the two nations . History . No one was sure how the Howling Gap got its name , but there were a number of theories , including : It was known that the gap had a history of caravans disappearing within , with others being attacked , and survivors claiming to have been attacked by something in the wind , and entire garrisons stationed there being destroyed mysteriously . Due to all these rumors , no one tried to occupy or settle this region . During the Tuigan invasion of Semphar , the Gap was one of two main routes used by the Tuigan Khan Hubadai to invade the nation . The Tuigan , being a superstitious people , did not attempt to garrison people in the gap . Inhabitants .

title: Howling Mountains
description: Howling Mountains The Howling Mountains were a vast range of mountains located in northern Returned Abeir . The nations of Fimbrul and Relmaur were located within its mountains . Most of the forbidden primordial cults of Returned Abeir operated out in the Howling Mountains .
description_long: Howling Mountains The Howling Mountains were a vast range of mountains located in northern Returned Abeir . The nations of Fimbrul and Relmaur were located within its mountains . Most of the forbidden primordial cults of Returned Abeir operated out in the Howling Mountains . Geographical features . The Howling Mountain range was a wasteland region composed of snow capped mountains , deep chasms and hidden valleys ravaged by terrible blizzards and storms that prevent even dragon s to fly in winter , or giant fog clouds capable to block all vision and distort sounds in summer . The mountains were so vast and maze - like that even primordials could hide in its ranges without fear of being spotted . The hidden high valleys within the mountains were full of oni and their orc s servants , as well as game such as boar s and elk s . Below the Howling Mountains mighty peaks were located giant cavern networks full of meltwater rivers and lakes where most living things in Fimbrul and Relmaur dwelt . Its caverns hold the richest known veins of raw metal ores and gem stones in all of Abeir , and later , in all of Toril as well . History .

title: Howling Wing
description: Howling Wing The Howling Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan called Ghindul . Organization .
description_long: Howling Wing The Howling Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan called Ghindul . Organization . The group was led by Ghindul , a tyrannical kir - lanan who would use both his strength and intimidating demeanor to keep his subordinates in check . Despite this harsh leadership , a number of kir - lanan moved between the Howling Wing and Screeching Wing bands over the years with the two groups operating as a loose collection of followers rather than a unified force . Ultimately , the Howling Wing served the shadow dragon Glouroth who laired near the top of the Wailing Cliff . Activities . At the instruction of the shadow dragon Glouroth , the Howling Wing was responsible for extracting tribute from travelers of the Deep Wastes who sought to pass the Wailing Cliff . Any creatures who approached the base of the cliff and rung the large bell would be greeted by Ghindul and his wing . Depending on the composition of the party approaching , the Howling Wing would generally let Underdark dwellers pass in exchange for goods or coins worth at least 20 gp for each traveler .

title: Hoxitl
description: Hoxitl Hoxitl was the high priest of Zaltec in Nexal . Activities . Hoxitl was the leader of the faith of Zaltec over all Maztica .
description_long: Hoxitl Hoxitl was the high priest of Zaltec in Nexal . Activities . Hoxitl was the leader of the faith of Zaltec over all Maztica . Hoxitl was the most powerful advisor of Naltecona but also the secret leader of the Viperhands cult . History . In 1361 DR , under the orders of the Ancient Ones , he ordered all his priests to find the young girl Erixitl . With the arrival of the Golden Legion in Nexal , Hoxitl conspired with the Ancient Ones in order to have Naltecona put to death and the Viperhands cult take control of the empire . Hoxitl continued to hunt for Erixitl , also obtaining the reluctant help of Shatil , brother of Erixitl and a priest of Zaltec . The vengeance of Lolth against the Ancient Ones — in truth , a group of drow — ruined his plans and during the Night of Wailing he was transformed into a troll . Despite his transformation , Hoxitl remained a servant of Zaltec , albeit a reluctant one , and unleashed the Viperhands monsters upon the human survivors . In time , the transformation started to afflict his mind as well and Hoxitl became more and more bestial .

title: Hrar
description: Hrar Hrar was a bugbear chieftain . History . Hrar was a bugbear chieftain .
description_long: Hrar Hrar was a bugbear chieftain . History . Hrar was a bugbear chieftain . In 1491 DR , he was approached by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred who offered their help in subjugating the area in exchange for his stopping of all visitors to the nearby Monastery of the Yellow Rose . He agreed , and soon he had conquered first the pacifist Shadow Talon goblin tribe and after the village of Tomrav , capturing many hostages . Eventually , an adventuring party hired for a mission at the monastery were convinced by sergeant Sergor to fight Hrar and his minions , and the chieftain was killed .

title: Hrarnok Sharkchum
description: Hrarnok Sharkchum Hrarnok Sharkchum was a lesser seawolf member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Hrarnok was for many years the bosun of the Sembian vessel " Harbor Moon " in the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Hrarnok Sharkchum Hrarnok Sharkchum was a lesser seawolf member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Hrarnok was for many years the bosun of the Sembian vessel " Harbor Moon " in the Sea of Fallen Stars . During a voyage to the Dragon Coast , a powerful storm destroyed the ship . Hrarnok survived but a shark attacked him , taking half of his left leg . Thus he made a new home in Westgate , working as watchman . However , it had been a seawolf that had attacked Hrarnok and thus he became a lycanthrope , hunting sailors on the docks during the full moon . Vyqinak , the ixitxachitl vampire master of smuggling for the Night Masks , discovered his secret and forcibly recruited Hrarnok as an assassin , killing targets aboard ships . In his hybrid form , Hrarnok regained the use of his left leg , gaining a perfect alibi for the lame watchman .

title: Hrimnir
description: Hrimnir Hrimnir was a frost giant living in the Icespire Peak in 1480 DR . History . When the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak discovered the Winterforge artifact and the frozen body of Lakkar , Hriminir dreamed of recreating Lakkar ' s exploits .
description_long: Hrimnir Hrimnir was a frost giant living in the Icespire Peak in 1480 DR . History . When the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak discovered the Winterforge artifact and the frozen body of Lakkar , Hriminir dreamed of recreating Lakkar ' s exploits . Thus he gathered an army of frost creatures and tried to acquire the Winterforge , but in the end was killed by some adventurers .

title: Hrolf
description: Hrolf Hrolf the Unruly was a human captain of the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . The captain was a large , broad - shouldered man with skin tanned by the sun and wind .
description_long: Hrolf Hrolf the Unruly was a human captain of the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . The captain was a large , broad - shouldered man with skin tanned by the sun and wind . His extremely light - colored braided hair was streaked through with light gray . He had blue eyes , a large mustache , and a beard . He apparently had a terrible singing voice . History . In 1361 DR , he was imprisoned in Skullport but he escaped from jail with the help of Liriel Baenre . Hrolf was killed as part of a conspiracy against Ruathym in 1361 DR . His funeral consisted of a large ceremony featuring a funeral bonfire intended to send him and the " Elfmaid " into the halls of Tempus . In honor of him , Liriel changed the figurehead of the " Elfmaid " into a figure of Hrolf . Relationships . Moira . Moira was Hrolf ' s wife . She was short and stout with gray eyes and red cheeks and lived alone on Tetris , a small island in the Moonshaes . She and Hrolf only ever saw each other during his brief stops there , but that suited them both just fine . Xzorsh . When the sea elf Xzorsh was a child , Hrolf saved his life .

title: Hrothgar
description: Hrothgar Hrothgar was a human adventurer from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The soldier was a powerfully built man who wore heavy armor , like plate mail .
description_long: Hrothgar Hrothgar was a human adventurer from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The soldier was a powerfully built man who wore heavy armor , like plate mail . Personality . Hrothgar spent many years traveling and collecting trophies from legendary beasts , such as a gorgon and a mind flayer . He was known for helping anyone in need and had found a strong place in the community of Easthaven . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Hrothgar put together an expedition to travel to the aid of Kuldahar in the Spine of the World . Death . Hrothgar was killed when the expedition was attacked by frost giant s in Kuldahar Pass .

title: Hrotun
description: Hrotun Hrotun was the very first frost giant skald . Relationships . Hrotun was the son of Ottar , making him one of the second generation of giants to live on Toril .
description_long: Hrotun Hrotun was the very first frost giant skald . Relationships . Hrotun was the son of Ottar , making him one of the second generation of giants to live on Toril . He had a brother named Hjurgen , and he was the uncle of the great hero Hjurnur Wyrmrever . Works . Hrotun composed the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " about Hjurnur Wyrmrever , his nephew .

title: Hruggek
description: Hruggek Hruggek was the chief deity of bugbear s , and was the god of violence and combat , as well as an exarch of the greater god Bane . Other gods worshiped by the bugbears included Grankhul , the god of hunting , senses , and surprise ; and Skiggaret , the god of fear . Prior to relocating to Banehold , Hruggek lived in a large cave in Pandemonium called Hruggekolohk .
description_long: Hruggek Hruggek was the chief deity of bugbear s , and was the god of violence and combat , as well as an exarch of the greater god Bane . Other gods worshiped by the bugbears included Grankhul , the god of hunting , senses , and surprise ; and Skiggaret , the god of fear . Prior to relocating to Banehold , Hruggek lived in a large cave in Pandemonium called Hruggekolohk . His home was adorned with the severed heads of his defeated opponents . Description . Hruggek appeared as a massive , powerful bugbear , 12 feet ( 3 . 7m ) tall . He had great fangs and clawed hands and feet , and wielded a 10 - foot long morningstar . Worshipers . Clergy and temples . Hruggek ' s priest s dressed in black and wore skulls on their heads . He was worshiped on the full moon in bugbear cave halls . Bugbears sacrificed the blood of their enemies to Hruggek every month . Shamans of Hruggek could achieve the ability to cast up to 5th level divine spells . Creative origins . Hruggek was created by James M . Ward for the " Deities and Demigods Cyclopedia " ( 1980 ) .

title: Hruk
description: Hruk Hruk was a hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Chief Guh took Hruk from his wife Moog as her own husband , like many others .
description_long: Hruk Hruk was a hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Chief Guh took Hruk from his wife Moog as her own husband , like many others . In Grudd Haug , Hruk was at the main entrance watching the door . Secretly he wanted to go back to Moog but did not dare defy Guh .

title: Hrusse
description: Hrusse Hrusse , usually known as Hrusse of Assuran , was cleric member of the Gray Hands in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hrusse was a vengeful , intense , and driven man .
description_long: Hrusse Hrusse , usually known as Hrusse of Assuran , was cleric member of the Gray Hands in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hrusse was a vengeful , intense , and driven man . He adopted Waterdeep as his new home and showed to the enemies of the city or of the Lords of Waterdeep the same compassion he showed to enemies of Assuran : no mercy . History . Hrusse hailed from Unther but was exiled from the country by the clergy of Gilgeam for his " heretical " worship of Assuran . Eventually , he arrived in Waterdeep , where he settled .

title: Hsao Chronicles
description: Hsao Chronicles Hsao Chronicles was an influential text of the Way written by Hu Ling Do of T ' u Lung in Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) . In prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung . In its pages , " Hsao Chronicles " examined various " Images " of nature , finding within them metaphors and drawing conclusions for the " superior man " who followed the Way .
description_long: Hsao Chronicles Hsao Chronicles was an influential text of the Way written by Hu Ling Do of T ' u Lung in Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) . In prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung . In its pages , " Hsao Chronicles " examined various " Images " of nature , finding within them metaphors and drawing conclusions for the " superior man " who followed the Way . For example , a reed - filled fresh - water spring on the side of a mountain symbolized youth and inexperience , with Hu Ling Do concluding that training and education improved a person ' s nature , that it was better to be confident and correct . In the Image of a lake beneath a mountain , the water evaporated and thus enlarged the mountain — the lake symbolized carefree joy and the mountain stubborn silence , and so one should control temper and stubbornness as well as impulsiveness , instinct , and wild moods . A lake full to the shore beneath the sky represented a limit , and so Hu Ling Do argued one should break down their existence into manageable components , with each appropriately arranged .

title: Hsi Yog
description: Hsi Yog Hsi Yog was a Tuigan shugenja and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hsi used his clerical powers to aid the soldiers of the army under Prince Hubadai Khahan ' s command .
description_long: Hsi Yog Hsi Yog was a Tuigan shugenja and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hsi used his clerical powers to aid the soldiers of the army under Prince Hubadai Khahan ' s command . Abilities . The following spells were available to Hsi : " deflection " , " cure light wounds " , " snake charm " , " hold person " , " levitate " , " snake barrier " , " detect lie " , and " possess " . Possessions . Hsi owned a pair of " bracers of defense " and a magical tetsubo .

title: Hsin Fu Chan
description: Hsin Fu Chan Hsin Fu Chan was a sage of Shou Lung who wrote the " Book of Change " , which detailed a system of divination through the use of trigrams . Legend told that Hsin Fu Chan discerned the trigrams from patterns in the back of a great lizard as it slept .
description_long: Hsin Fu Chan Hsin Fu Chan was a sage of Shou Lung who wrote the " Book of Change " , which detailed a system of divination through the use of trigrams . Legend told that Hsin Fu Chan discerned the trigrams from patterns in the back of a great lizard as it slept .

title: Hsiung chi Kang
description: Hsiung chi Kang Hsiung chi Kang was a samurai in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Hsiung was a young noble indulging in flirtation , strutting , drinking , and gossiping .
description_long: Hsiung chi Kang Hsiung chi Kang was a samurai in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Hsiung was a young noble indulging in flirtation , strutting , drinking , and gossiping . In truth , however , he was an agent of the Imperial Secret Police , using his cover to gather information .

title: Hsskala
description: Hsskala Hsskala ( " nearkill " in the Common tongue ) was a positoxin that would render an undead creature unconscious . It was created by the half - fiend yuan - ti Kharantes , who used to in 1375 DR to render the sarrukh lord , King Oreme , incapacitated . Kharantes plan was foiled shortly thereafter by a group of adventurers seeking King Oreme for his council .
description_long: Hsskala Hsskala ( " nearkill " in the Common tongue ) was a positoxin that would render an undead creature unconscious . It was created by the half - fiend yuan - ti Kharantes , who used to in 1375 DR to render the sarrukh lord , King Oreme , incapacitated . Kharantes plan was foiled shortly thereafter by a group of adventurers seeking King Oreme for his council .

title: Hssthak
description: Hssthak Hssthak ( Eeesss - TAK ) was a sarrukh mummy and believed himself to be the last survivor of the empire of Isstosseffifil . Description . At first glance , Hssthak appeared human under his loose wrappings , but the bony tail and dry , snake - like skin drawn taut over his skeleton quickly dispelled that impression .
description_long: Hssthak Hssthak ( Eeesss - TAK ) was a sarrukh mummy and believed himself to be the last survivor of the empire of Isstosseffifil . Description . At first glance , Hssthak appeared human under his loose wrappings , but the bony tail and dry , snake - like skin drawn taut over his skeleton quickly dispelled that impression . Having been sealed in a tomb for thousands of years , his features were distorted , withered , and dry . Abilities . Hssthak was a " greater " mummy , having volunteered to undergo the mummification process ; thus , he retained all the spell casting abilities he had in life and gained all the abilities of a mummy . In addition , he was enchanted to be fire resistant . With millennia to brood and watch the world through his scrying device , he was generally aware of world events and could converse haltingly in most languages . Possessions . Hssthak had a magic mirror that functioned as a " crystal ball " with " clairaudience " and a scroll inscribed with the " geas " spell . He was the custodian of two powerful " Nether Scrolls " : " awaken intelligence " and " alter beast " . Activities .

title: Hsuan Yu Po
description: Hsuan Yu Po Hsuan Yu Po was a noble of Shou Lung . History . Hsuan was a noble and a general in the province of Chukei .
description_long: Hsuan Yu Po Hsuan Yu Po was a noble of Shou Lung . History . Hsuan was a noble and a general in the province of Chukei .
