There , he raised alone his daughter Hsuan Yu Wu , who inherited most of his qualities . Around 1348 DR , Wu fell in love with Batu Min Ho , a soldier of Tuigan ancestry in Hsuan ' s private army . Hsuan opposed the marriage , hoping for a more suitable man for the daughter of a noble . Hsuan said that he would agree only when Batu became a general in Shou Lung . This was supposed to be a joke but Batu joined the Shou army and rose through the ranks , becoming one of the youngest generals of Shou Lung . Impressed , Hsuan agreed to the marriage and developed a true respect for the military abilities of his son - in - law . In 1359 DR , when Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin and the Minister of State Ju - Hai Chou asked Hsuang ' s opinion if Batu would be the right man to defeat the Tuigan Horde invasion , he guaranteed he was . When Batu was put in charge of the campaign against the Tuigan , Hsuang was chosen to lead the personal armies of the nobles , the Twenty - Five Armies . Batu and Hsuang devised a secret plan to defeat the Tuigan near the city of Shu Kuan .

title: Hu
description: Hu Hu was a sea captain in 1358 DR . Activities . Hu was a Wanese captain in service to the mercantile Ko clan , commanding the " Victorious Morning " ship .
description_long: Hu Hu was a sea captain in 1358 DR . Activities . Hu was a Wanese captain in service to the mercantile Ko clan , commanding the " Victorious Morning " ship . History . In 1358 DR , he was ordered to take Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San to H ' sin - to , at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River in T ' u Lung . Personality . Hu was a hot - tempered individual . A long time living outside his country made him even forget his true Wa - an name .

title: Hu ' i Wing
description: Hu ' i Wing The Hu ' i Wing was an old artifact from Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was said to reveal the future , and was the most valuable relic of the kingdom of Koryo . Description .
description_long: Hu ' i Wing The Hu ' i Wing was an old artifact from Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was said to reveal the future , and was the most valuable relic of the kingdom of Koryo . Description . It took the form of a vast brazier fashioned of copper , some 8 feet ( 2 . 4 meters ) in diameter . The lip of the brazier was ornately carved with sail - finned carp and swimming dragon s . Built into the subterranean fortress beneath Karak , the Hu ' i Wing could not be removed without it being destroyed , and so it would remain there . Powers . To activate the brazier ' s magic , one of course had to start a fire within it , and the hotter the fire the better . As the brazier started to glow with heat , the carved carp and dragons turned cherry - red and began to move and swim around the lip . They swam around it with increasing speed until they were little more than a blur of fire circling the coals inside the brazier . This fire then flashed white as time itself was torn open . An onlooker would see the flames fade into a vision of the future . This would be a big event , like a civil war , a disaster , or assassination , and it would come to pass within the year .

title: Hu Chien
description: Hu Chien Hu Chien was a Shou wu jen in Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hu Chien arrived in Okahira and so impressed the shugo - matadai Kadokawa Shigetada that he became his principal counselor .
description_long: Hu Chien Hu Chien was a Shou wu jen in Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hu Chien arrived in Okahira and so impressed the shugo - matadai Kadokawa Shigetada that he became his principal counselor . Under his suggestions , Kadokawa introduced many reforms . Secretly , however , he was under the orders of the Great Emperor Chin of Shou Lung . Hu Chien plotted to take control of the city for himself and afterward seize the nearby Hiro castle . He had gathered a garrison of 800 Shou bushi disguised as sailors , plus his own bodyguard force of 200 bushi and 10 barbarians . Personality . Only Hu Chien knew he was following his emperor ' s orders .

title: Hu Don
description: Hu Don Hu Don was a bushi in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Hu Don was a bushi in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .
description_long: Hu Don Hu Don was a bushi in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Hu Don was a bushi in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung . In 1358 DR , he became the leader of the local Dragon Claw followers , destroying local martial schools and shrines . Later , Hu Don was confronted and killed by the wu jen Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San .

title: Hu Ling Do
description: Hu Ling Do Hu Ling Do was a writer of T ' u Lung and a follower of the Way . In Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) , Hu Ling Do wrote " Hsao Chronicles " , an influential text of the Way that prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung .
description_long: Hu Ling Do Hu Ling Do was a writer of T ' u Lung and a follower of the Way . In Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) , Hu Ling Do wrote " Hsao Chronicles " , an influential text of the Way that prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung .

title: Huacli
description: Huacli Huacli was a nation in Maztica . It was composed of six city - states , five of which were former vassals of Nexal . With the demise of Nexal as a power , all of the Huacli cities banded together again under the leadership of the Otomis , the people of the only city state never to have been conquered .
description_long: Huacli Huacli was a nation in Maztica . It was composed of six city - states , five of which were former vassals of Nexal . With the demise of Nexal as a power , all of the Huacli cities banded together again under the leadership of the Otomis , the people of the only city state never to have been conquered . The land around the Huacli is barren but with a series of fertile valleys along the west coast of Maztica .

title: Huakal
description: Huakal Huakal was a former Eagle Knight at Kultaka . History . Huakal was a valorous Eagle Knight until he retired because of old age .
description_long: Huakal Huakal was a former Eagle Knight at Kultaka . History . Huakal was a valorous Eagle Knight until he retired because of old age . Around 1351 DR , he bought the young slave Erixitl . In 1361 DR , after an incident between Erixitl and his son , he decided to sell her to Kachin , a priest of Qotal from Payit .

title: Huang Ch ' ung
description: Huang Ch ' ung Huang Ch ' ung was a sohei in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . History . Ch ' ung born in a year of great famine so his clan decided to consecrate him to the Dragon Monastery in Kuo Te ' Lung .
description_long: Huang Ch ' ung Huang Ch ' ung was a sohei in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . History . Ch ' ung born in a year of great famine so his clan decided to consecrate him to the Dragon Monastery in Kuo Te ' Lung . Personality . Ch ' ung had never wanted to be a sohei but thought it was a suitable life for him . He took pride in his martial training . However , he was bored by the lack of temple warfare and welcomed any opportunity for an adventure .

title: Huat Rhu
description: Huat Rhu Huat Rhu was a famed general of the kingdom of Koguryo in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Huat Rhu once led his soldiers on an expedition into the Naktong Moors . They never returned .
description_long: Huat Rhu Huat Rhu was a famed general of the kingdom of Koguryo in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Huat Rhu once led his soldiers on an expedition into the Naktong Moors . They never returned . By the 14th century DR , it was rumored they still wandered the moors , now as peat mummies and zombie s hunting for fresh blood .

title: Hubadai Khahan
description: Hubadai Khahan Prince Hubadai Khahan was a Tuigan warrior and the son of Yamun Khahan during the mid 14th century DR . Personality . Hubadai was a strict commander , making him a challenging enemy .
description_long: Hubadai Khahan Prince Hubadai Khahan was a Tuigan warrior and the son of Yamun Khahan during the mid 14th century DR . Personality . Hubadai was a strict commander , making him a challenging enemy . He was a loyal friend to those whom he trusted . He valued human life less than commanders from other cultures , allowing him to sacrifice troops in order to achieve his goals . He was a capable leader who was not afraid to join the fighting with his men . The driving force behind all of Hubadai ' s actions was the desire to please his father . Activities . Yamun tasked Hubadai with the conquest of Semphar . Possessions . Hubadai owned a suit of magial lamellar armor , a magical sword , a " ring of protection " , a " ring of teleportation " , and a " helm of reflection " .

title: Hudid
description: Hudid Hudid , also called the " City of Humility " , was one of the Cities of the Pantheon . It was famous for its trade in exotic goods and for featuring the most important university in all of Zakhara . Geography .
description_long: Hudid Hudid , also called the " City of Humility " , was one of the Cities of the Pantheon . It was famous for its trade in exotic goods and for featuring the most important university in all of Zakhara . Geography . Hudid was located between I ' tiraf and Mahabba , where Al - Jama River flowed into the Crowded Sea . Trade . In addition to trading widely , Hudid produced glass lenses and telescopes .

title: Hudkin Moadi
description: Hudkin Moadi Hudkin Moadi was the halfling mayor of the city of Krenadir in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . Hudkin hated adventurer s of all types , and sent many to their deaths on foolhardy quests within the Mortick Swamp .
description_long: Hudkin Moadi Hudkin Moadi was the halfling mayor of the city of Krenadir in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . Hudkin hated adventurer s of all types , and sent many to their deaths on foolhardy quests within the Mortick Swamp . History . Hudkin wished to be an adventurer in his youth , but found the hardships of life on the road to be distasteful .

title: Huerbara
description: Huerbara Huerbara was a young able malaugrym with a bad temper in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Huerbara was speaking with Neleyd when the elder Bheloris approached them , proposing to hatch a plan together to increase the chance of their success in the hunt .
description_long: Huerbara Huerbara was a young able malaugrym with a bad temper in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Huerbara was speaking with Neleyd when the elder Bheloris approached them , proposing to hatch a plan together to increase the chance of their success in the hunt . Later , during Dhalgrave ' s absence , she was chosen by the temporary leader Milhvar to go with Kuervyn and Andraut to Silverymoon to kill Lady Alustriel Silverhand . However , they were easily discovered by the palace ' s staff and killed .

title: Hukdon
description: Hukdon Hukdon was a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Hukdon was very ill - mannered but he thought of himself as funny and likeable .
description_long: Hukdon Hukdon was a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Hukdon was very ill - mannered but he thought of himself as funny and likeable . Many underestimated him for his puny appearance . Possession . Somehow Hukdon acquired a pair of " gauntlets of ogre power " . Activities . Hukdon worked for the enforcer and thugs chapter of the guild in Athkatla . His boss usually used him only when a " client " needed punishment , not for mere intimidation work .

title: Hulburg
description: Hulburg Hulburg was a small city on the northeastern shore of the Moonsea of north Faerûn . Description . Griffonwatch Keep , the ancestral home of the Hulmasters , sat on a rocky outcrop on the eastern edge of the city .
description_long: Hulburg Hulburg was a small city on the northeastern shore of the Moonsea of north Faerûn . Description . Griffonwatch Keep , the ancestral home of the Hulmasters , sat on a rocky outcrop on the eastern edge of the city . The city of 1479 DR only occupied a fraction of the area of historical Hulburg and there were many vacant lots in the city . New construction was built on top of the foundations and basements of ruined buildings . In many cases , the old cellars remained intact and formed interconnected underground passages that could be used to travel underground through the city unnoticed . Geography . Hulburg sat on the northeastern shore of the Moonsea and had a fine natural harbor . The city was situated between two rocky headlands , Keldon Head and Easthead . By 1479 DR , Spellplague - changed land was common in the vicinity of Hulburg and unnatural green hills rose just to the east of the city . Additionally , a rock formation known as the Arches jutted into the Moonsea near Hulburg ' s harbor . The Winterspear river ran through the center of the city . Religion . The people of Hulburg were pragmatic and seemed to have little use for gods .

title: Hulda
description: Hulda Hulda was a stone giant who helped Blagothkus in managing the flying Skyreach Castle . Personality . Hulda was very concerned about Blagothkus ' plan to ally with dragon s and the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Hulda Hulda was a stone giant who helped Blagothkus in managing the flying Skyreach Castle . Personality . Hulda was very concerned about Blagothkus ' plan to ally with dragon s and the Cult of the Dragon . As a companion of Wigluf , she supported him in all his decisions . History . Hulda and her companion Wigluf were guests at Skyreach Castle . Hulda protected Wigluf when he tried to use a magic cauldron to interrogate the giant pantheon about Blagothkus ' s plan .

title: Hulgen Proudfist
description: Hulgen Proudfist Hulgen Proudfist was the leader of a large group of half - orc s in the Tower District of Neverwinter , the so - called Proudfist Tribe . Personality . Hulgen led his " tribe " in order to increase the importance of the half - orcs in the city .
description_long: Hulgen Proudfist Hulgen Proudfist was the leader of a large group of half - orc s in the Tower District of Neverwinter , the so - called Proudfist Tribe . Personality . Hulgen led his " tribe " in order to increase the importance of the half - orcs in the city . Relationships . He allied with Vansi Bloodscar to gain more power but the City Watch member Riftel Farsight sent an adventurer to help him change his mind and align with the City Watch .

title: Hullack Forest
description: Hullack Forest The Hullack Forest was once a part of the huge forest of Cormanthor and marks the northeastern border of Cormyr and the Dales . It was the most primeval forest in all of Cormyr , with numerous dark valleys and hidden vales that went unseen for decades and was likely among the most dangerous regions of Cormyr . Legends stated that it was full of ghosts and monsters .
description_long: Hullack Forest The Hullack Forest was once a part of the huge forest of Cormanthor and marks the northeastern border of Cormyr and the Dales . It was the most primeval forest in all of Cormyr , with numerous dark valleys and hidden vales that went unseen for decades and was likely among the most dangerous regions of Cormyr . Legends stated that it was full of ghosts and monsters . Cormyrean wardens and crown scouts often steered adventurers here in hopes of taming this dense wood . By 1372 DR the Hullack Forest , the King ' s Forest and Hermit ' s Wood were almost all that remained of the southern reaches of Cormanthor in Cormyr , having been pushed back significantly during the prosperous reign of Azoun IV .

title: Hullack Trail
description: Hullack Trail The Hullack Trail was a trail running through southeastern Cormyr . Locations . Following the shores of the Thunder River , Wyvernwater , and the Wyvernflow , it linked Thunderstone , Hultail , Juniril , and Wheloon , as well as the Unknown Shrine , via short connecting trails .
description_long: Hullack Trail The Hullack Trail was a trail running through southeastern Cormyr . Locations . Following the shores of the Thunder River , Wyvernwater , and the Wyvernflow , it linked Thunderstone , Hultail , Juniril , and Wheloon , as well as the Unknown Shrine , via short connecting trails . Around 10 miles ( 16 kilometers ) from the Hullack Trail lay a valley where the Golden Ruins were hidden . History . The petitioners and adventurers duped at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR were told to cross the Hullack Trail and go overland to the Unknown Shrine , but they could choose to travel along the trail and go around .

title: Hulmaster
description: Hulmaster The Hulmaster family is the ruling family of the town of Hulburg , on the northeast shores of the Moonsea . The line began with Ivar Nanthon , who changed his surname to Hulmaster after the lich Aesperus ( who was also his uncle ) " granted " him the right to rule in the Year of the Keening Gale .
description_long: Hulmaster The Hulmaster family is the ruling family of the town of Hulburg , on the northeast shores of the Moonsea . The line began with Ivar Nanthon , who changed his surname to Hulmaster after the lich Aesperus ( who was also his uncle ) " granted " him the right to rule in the Year of the Keening Gale .

title: Hulraven Irlingstar
description: Hulraven Irlingstar Hulraven Irlingstar was the patriarch of House Irlingstar in Waterdeep in 1374 . Personality . Hulraven was still a very cunning individual , though the years were starting to tell on him .
description_long: Hulraven Irlingstar Hulraven Irlingstar was the patriarch of House Irlingstar in Waterdeep in 1374 . Personality . Hulraven was still a very cunning individual , though the years were starting to tell on him . History . Circa 1374 , helped by his friend Mistmyr Iroan , he recruited an adventuring party to rescue his wife Nael , who ' d been kidnapped by some agents of the Jaezred Chaulssin for unknown reasons . Relationship . Hulraven genuinely loved his wife , not knowing the truth about her .

title: Hulzimmer Atharn
description: Hulzimmer Atharn Hulzimmer Atharn was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Powers . He specialized in magic that transformed men into monsters , or at least gained for mages a semblance of beast - powers .
description_long: Hulzimmer Atharn Hulzimmer Atharn was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Powers . He specialized in magic that transformed men into monsters , or at least gained for mages a semblance of beast - powers . History . He desired to learn the secret of the dragon shape , first asking the elves of the High Forest and later the Archwizard Shandrath . Shandrath firmly rebuffed him and so Hulzimmer became obsessed with defeating Shandrath . In the end , in 222 DR , his fellow magelords agreed to attack the Wyrm Tower but in the spell - battle both Hulzimmer and Shandrath died .

title: Human
description: Human Humans in Toril are widespread , can be found in most regions and , in general , are fierce and disagreeable , which can sometimes lead certain other races to view them with contempt . They are renowned for their diversity and ambition , and although they lack specialization , they can excel in many areas . History .
description_long: Human Humans in Toril are widespread , can be found in most regions and , in general , are fierce and disagreeable , which can sometimes lead certain other races to view them with contempt . They are renowned for their diversity and ambition , and although they lack specialization , they can excel in many areas . History . The origin of humanity is something yet unknown . Although the Tel - quessir can claim the primal war between Corellon and Gruumsh for their heritage and the dwarves claim to have been forged from the rocks of Abeir - Toril itself , humans have no unifying creation myth . However , they are certainly an ancient race , having originated since before written records exist and they are frequently considered one of the creator race s . More confusing yet is that , while humans indeed are native to Toril they have been found on other worlds as well , with the Mulan i standing out as an example of human immigrants to Toril . Regardless of their precise origins , humans have been undeniably successful . While hardly the only dominant race of Toril , humans are one of them and the most recent to obtain dominance .

title: Humanoid
description: Humanoid A humanoid was a type of creature shaped generally like a human ; with two arms , two legs , one head , or a human - like torso , arms and head . Humanoids were often roughly - human sized though some were enormous , such as titan s , or miniscule like fairies . Most humanoids were capable of speech and had well - developed societies .
description_long: Humanoid A humanoid was a type of creature shaped generally like a human ; with two arms , two legs , one head , or a human - like torso , arms and head . Humanoids were often roughly - human sized though some were enormous , such as titan s , or miniscule like fairies . Most humanoids were capable of speech and had well - developed societies . Giant - kin and monstrous humanoid s were two subsets of the humanoid body type .

title: Humility
description: Humility Bodies are being found in the city of Loudwater with their brains extracted . Considering the trouble with Mind flayer s that has been experienced lately , it is fairly clear what is responsible . High lord Kalahar Twohands also has a spy in the Zhentarim who has suddenly stopped feeding him information .
description_long: Humility Bodies are being found in the city of Loudwater with their brains extracted . Considering the trouble with Mind flayer s that has been experienced lately , it is fairly clear what is responsible . High lord Kalahar Twohands also has a spy in the Zhentarim who has suddenly stopped feeding him information . Considering the recent defeat of the mind flayers ' ally , The Hark , lord Twohands has become worried that the illithid have joined with the Zhentarim and that the silence of his spy is linked to all this . Coupled with this , Mielikki has sent lord Twohands a vision in which Stedd Rein is murdered . The party are quickly given orders to bring Stedd Rein to safety and then to violate Loudwater ' s treaty with the Zhentarim by searching out Kalahar ' s spy .

title: Hun - kho
description: Hun - kho Hun - kho was a legendary war chief of the Kalmyr tribe in the Hordelands . History . Hun - kho was a great conqueror of the steppe nomads , reaching as far as the Dragonwall to the east .
description_long: Hun - kho Hun - kho was a legendary war chief of the Kalmyr tribe in the Hordelands . History . Hun - kho was a great conqueror of the steppe nomads , reaching as far as the Dragonwall to the east . Rumors and Legends . Hun - kho was not buried within Ejen Horo like many other great leaders of the nomads . Instead , his splendid noble tomb was buried somewhere beneath the vast steppe . All who knew of its location were slain upon its completion .

title: Hundelstone
description: Hundelstone Hundelstone was a trade town of 1 , 200 gnome s , dwarves , and human s located at the western edge of the Spine of the World along the Ten Trail . Description . The town ' s buildings were built low to the ground , with the majority of living space consisting of cellar rooms cut into the rock .
description_long: Hundelstone Hundelstone was a trade town of 1 , 200 gnome s , dwarves , and human s located at the western edge of the Spine of the World along the Ten Trail . Description . The town ' s buildings were built low to the ground , with the majority of living space consisting of cellar rooms cut into the rock . In 1366 DR , there were five guesthouses that housed visitors and travelers stuck for the winter because of bad weather in the pass ; these guesthouses specialized in dishes made from the plentiful rock hares in the area , namely jugged hare , hare stew , curried skewered hare , and fried spiced hare . Most of the dwarves and gnomes were miners , while most of the humans served as monster slayers ( gaining a monthly salary of 100 gold piece s plus 25 gold pieces per monster head ) , guides and guards to the caravans , or hunters ( namely of wolves , raptors , crag cats , and the ever - plentiful rock hares ) . Relationships . The neighboring dwarves of Ironmaster blindfolded non - dwarven intruders in their homeland and forced them through underground passages to Hundelstone , releasing them at night in rough , unfamiliar terrain . Trade .

title: Hundred lotus
description: Hundred lotus Hundred Lotus was a sutra that would cause pain to an evil spirit . Realmslore . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the lama Koja of Khazari chanted the Hundred Lotus sutra when confronted by a mysterious woman with a magical feast , to test if she was an evil spirit .
description_long: Hundred lotus Hundred Lotus was a sutra that would cause pain to an evil spirit . Realmslore . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the lama Koja of Khazari chanted the Hundred Lotus sutra when confronted by a mysterious woman with a magical feast , to test if she was an evil spirit . It had no effect , however , for she was neither an evil nor a spirit .

title: Hunger of Hadar
description: Hunger of Hadar Hunger of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . The spell caused a 20 - foot ( 6 - meter ) radius spherical gateway of utter darkness to appear and stay open for one minute , or for as longer as the caster concentrated .
description_long: Hunger of Hadar Hunger of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . The spell caused a 20 - foot ( 6 - meter ) radius spherical gateway of utter darkness to appear and stay open for one minute , or for as longer as the caster concentrated . The beings beyond this rift emanated dark incomprehensible whispers and slurping noises that could be heard on the caster ' s side . Whoever stood within this region of warped space would suffer damage from the cold of space , as well as from attacks by acid ic tentacles from the unknown horrors beyond . Components . The spell required verbal , somatic and material components . The material needed was a pickled octopus tentacle .

title: Hungry Man
description: Hungry Man < / ref > Inn The Hungry Man , also known as the Hungry Man Inn , was a restaurant located in the city of Arabel . Inhabitants . The proprietor was the elderly woman Zehla .
description_long: Hungry Man < / ref > Inn The Hungry Man , also known as the Hungry Man Inn , was a restaurant located in the city of Arabel . Inhabitants . The proprietor was the elderly woman Zehla . Food and drink . The establishment sold watered down ale and wine known as " bullock juice " . A traveler could dine on such meats as spitted fowl , roast beef and . The Hungry Man also provided various cheese s , like Arabellan cheddar and goats ' milk cheese . Customers could dip their snowbread either in the restaurant ' s famous broth or spread brackleberry jam on it . A few other food delights were oatcakes , pan - fried turnips , and spiced flour dumplings .

title: Hungtse River
description: Hungtse River The Hungtse River was one of the largest rivers on Toril , spanning over a thousand miles across both the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . As it neared the territories of the Hordelands , the river was often called the Upper Hungtse River . Geography .
description_long: Hungtse River The Hungtse River was one of the largest rivers on Toril , spanning over a thousand miles across both the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . As it neared the territories of the Hordelands , the river was often called the Upper Hungtse River . Geography . The Hungtse originated in the A - Ling Shan mountains from glacial runoff from the Glacier of the Dragon . It flowed west to east , crossing the large expanse of the Katakoro Plateau and many provinces in Shou Lung before ultimately emptying into the Celestial Sea near the metropolis of Karatin .

title: Hunt Trail
description: Hunt Trail The Hunt Trail ran through the Vast , connecting the towns of Ylraphon and Kurth . From west to east , it began at Ylraphon , passed the Flooded Forest , ran through the Tavilar and Beluar ' s Hunt and ended at Kurth . On the way , it joined the Pass Trail and the North Road .
description_long: Hunt Trail The Hunt Trail ran through the Vast , connecting the towns of Ylraphon and Kurth . From west to east , it began at Ylraphon , passed the Flooded Forest , ran through the Tavilar and Beluar ' s Hunt and ended at Kurth . On the way , it joined the Pass Trail and the North Road . The minstrel Lieshann , traveling from Tavilar to Kurth , took a wrong turning onto the trail to the Mage ' s Tower , having mistaken it for the Hunt Trail .

title: Huntcrown
description: Huntcrown Huntcrown was a noble house of Cormyr whose seat was in Suzail . The Huntcrowns were enobled during reign of King Duar in 429 DR . During the Abraxus affair , the family was apparently among those that favored a ruling council for Cormyr rather than any regency or rule by a female .
description_long: Huntcrown Huntcrown was a noble house of Cormyr whose seat was in Suzail . The Huntcrowns were enobled during reign of King Duar in 429 DR . During the Abraxus affair , the family was apparently among those that favored a ruling council for Cormyr rather than any regency or rule by a female . The family had diverse holdings all over Cormyr and thus often was the best informed of the nation ' s goings - on . The family was known for spreading gossip and rumors and were at the center of the greatest number of scandals of any noble family . The family ' s greatest adversary was once the Cormaeril family , whose members jealously guarded their privacy . However , after the Cormaerils were exiled after the Abraxus affair , the Huntcrowns developed a rivalry with House Emmarask , House Illance and House Marliir .

title: Hunter ' s mercy
description: Hunter ' s mercy Hunter ' s mercy was a transmutation spell granted uniquely to ranger s by their deities . Effects . After a prayer for mercy , a ranger ' s next shot with a bow , if taken quickly , would not miss and had a good chance of inflicting critical damage to its target .
description_long: Hunter ' s mercy Hunter ' s mercy was a transmutation spell granted uniquely to ranger s by their deities . Effects . After a prayer for mercy , a ranger ' s next shot with a bow , if taken quickly , would not miss and had a good chance of inflicting critical damage to its target . Components . To cast this spell required verbal and somatic component s .

title: Huntsilver
description: Huntsilver Huntsilver was a noble house of Cormyr . An " old blood " family , it was considered one of the Royal Houses , owing to its close ties to the Obarskyr royal line . Base .
description_long: Huntsilver Huntsilver was a noble house of Cormyr . An " old blood " family , it was considered one of the Royal Houses , owing to its close ties to the Obarskyr royal line . Base . The family lived in Huntsilver Palace , situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail . They had holdings in Dhedluk and Thunderstone . History . After the Silver family split , the Huntsilvers were formed from a union of the Huntyn and Silver families , and founded by Gavrund Huntyn , brother - in - law of the second king , and was third of the noble families . The Huntsilvers were established by 245 DR . The Huntsilvers chose not to take sides when civil war erupted between Regent Salember and Prince Rhigaerd II . Instead , they equivocated when Salember demanded soldiers and aid . Following King Azoun IV ’ s death in the abraxus incident , the Huntsilvers preferred replacing the monarchy with a ruling council , rather than a regency , in order to free Cormyr from what they saw as Obarskyr tyranny . Personality . The Huntsilver family was seen as aloof in the mid – 14th century . Activities . The Huntsilvers were historically focused on managing Cormyr ' s forests and their resources .

title: Hupe Brightbell
description: Hupe Brightbell Hupe Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hupe was a painfully meek little man .
description_long: Hupe Brightbell Hupe Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hupe was a painfully meek little man . He helped people but only because he was scared of what they might do without his help . So he was kind but people often took advantage of his kindness . Activities . Hupe run the Leaky Bucket inn with his wife Grinna Brightbell in the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community in Quivering Forest just near Phlan .

title: Hurashum
description: Hurashum Hurashum was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Hurashum was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Hurashum Hurashum was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Hurashum was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Hurashum was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Hurbold Duethkatha
description: Hurbold Duethkatha Hurbold Duethkatha , or Scar , was a commander of the Flaming Fist mercenary company . Relationships . He was a close friend of Duke Eltan .
description_long: Hurbold Duethkatha Hurbold Duethkatha , or Scar , was a commander of the Flaming Fist mercenary company . Relationships . He was a close friend of Duke Eltan . Activities . He sent Abdel Adrian and Jaheira to discover evidence that the Seven Suns was involved with the Iron Throne . At the same time they were doing this , Scar was attacked and murdered by two doppleganger s , one of which he killed . After his death , the remaining doppleganger disguised itself as Scar in order to kill Duke Eltan . Eltan later killed the doppleganger .

title: Hurc
description: Hurc Hurc was a confident kobold who participated in the attack on Hilltop in 1372 DR . Hurc and a small band of his fellow kobolds got separated from the main group , and barricaded themselves in the kitchen of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern , taking the chef Mara as hostage .
description_long: Hurc Hurc was a confident kobold who participated in the attack on Hilltop in 1372 DR . Hurc and a small band of his fellow kobolds got separated from the main group , and barricaded themselves in the kitchen of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern , taking the chef Mara as hostage .

title: Hurgan Stoneblade
description: Hurgan Stoneblade Hurgan Stoneblade was a dwarf living in Ulgoth ' s Beard . History . Hurgan recruited Gorion ' s Ward to retrieve the Soultaker dagger from the Durlag ' s Tower .
description_long: Hurgan Stoneblade Hurgan Stoneblade was a dwarf living in Ulgoth ' s Beard . History . Hurgan recruited Gorion ' s Ward to retrieve the Soultaker dagger from the Durlag ' s Tower . Later , he attended the funeral of Lord de ' Arnise , Nalia De ' Arnise ' s father , in Athkatla .

title: Hurm Thiodor
description: Hurm Thiodor Hurm Thiodor was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . He was the local clerk and official of the crown and the unofficial Herald in the late 1360s DR . Activities .
description_long: Hurm Thiodor Hurm Thiodor was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . He was the local clerk and official of the crown and the unofficial Herald in the late 1360s DR . Activities . His primary duty was to handle record keeping and collect reports from adventures on the state of the nearby Hullack Forest and the monster - clearing efforts there . He was a skilled record - keeper . However , he was unable to have an accurate or up - to - date understanding of events in the forest . Oversword Faril Laheralson of the rowdy Purple Dragons contingent largely ignored him . Local folk thought the crown representative was a poor joke , and that Thiodor was weak . A part - time adventurer himself , he sometimes joined bands of adventurers on their missions into the Hullack Forest and Vast Swamp to add a little flavor to his otherwise boring life . Base . Hurm worked and lived out of the Office of the Crown in Thunderstone . He kept it clean , in good repair , and comfortable . Description . Hurm was slender of build and in his early 30s .

title: Hurn
description: Hurn Hurn was a dwarf knight in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hurn was an old and unfriendly individual , only wanting to reach his retirement day .
description_long: Hurn Hurn was a dwarf knight in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hurn was an old and unfriendly individual , only wanting to reach his retirement day . Hurn was not corrupt but did not refuse a bribe either . History . Hurn was a member of the Knights of the Black Fist . He was in charge of a guardpost at one entrance to Sokol Keep . After the refugee from Phlan arrived in Mulmaster Hurn become one of the top advisor of resurrected Aleyd Burral .

title: Husam Alin
description: Husam Alin Husam Alin ran a large tour guide business from the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam employed over 50 youths to guide pilgrims around the popular spots of the City of Delights .
description_long: Husam Alin Husam Alin ran a large tour guide business from the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam employed over 50 youths to guide pilgrims around the popular spots of the City of Delights . He charged 1 sp for a guided tour of the city . A carriage could be hired for 1 dinar to carry customers around . The guides employed by Husam were called " Husam ' s peacocks " because their aba s were embroidered with red peacocks .

title: Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim
description: Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim Great Caliph Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim was the brilliant but flighty ruler of the djinn . Activities . The Great Caliph spent most of his time in the center of his fortress , the Citadel of Ice and Steel , ruling upon legal , political , and strategic issues of the djinn .
description_long: Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim Great Caliph Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim was the brilliant but flighty ruler of the djinn . Activities . The Great Caliph spent most of his time in the center of his fortress , the Citadel of Ice and Steel , ruling upon legal , political , and strategic issues of the djinn . Whenever he decided to tour the Elemental Plane of Air , he made it a procession in grand style . History . Though Husam al - Balil did not leave his court often , he took an active interest in Zakhara n affairs . When the monarch traveled to the Prime Material Plane , his splendor was always announced by a great gust of wind . Legend ascribed to him power akin to that of the gods .

title: Husam al - Jana
description: Husam al - Jana Husam al - Jana was a winged cat who lived in the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam prowled the halls of the harem searching for intruders .
description_long: Husam al - Jana Husam al - Jana was a winged cat who lived in the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam prowled the halls of the harem searching for intruders . He was rarely seen by others . Sometimes he could be glimpsed napping in the harem courtyard . Relationships . He adopted one of the Grand Caliph ' s wives , Halima , as his own . Rumors and Legends . Rumor stated that this creature was once a man who lost a wager to the Grand Caliph . History . Years before , an adventurer named Husam bin Waleed came to the Grand Caliph with a proposal : he would bring the Grand Caliph one of the famed winged cats ( jana - nimr ) if he would be allowed to marry a woman from the Royal Harim . Intrigued , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir brought Husam to view the women of his harem . An elven beauty named Halima stood out above the rest , and Husam selected her . Khalil agreed to the bargain and Husam left in search of the jana - nimar . After finally locating a group of the elusive cats , Husam was accosted by a much larger jana - nimar , who actually spoke to him .

title: Husijo
description: Husijo Husijo was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Husijo managed a small shop in the Zuke village .
description_long: Husijo Husijo was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Husijo managed a small shop in the Zuke village . History . In 1358 DR , Husijo bought from a former member of the Blue Kumi Bandits some items of property of Toshi . Later , he met Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party . Minhiro recognized his ex - wife ' s items .

title: Hustil Benzur
description: Hustil Benzur Hustil Benzur was a Zhentarim agent in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Hustil usually resided at the River Shining Tavern , posing as an agent working for Amn ian investors .
description_long: Hustil Benzur Hustil Benzur was a Zhentarim agent in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Hustil usually resided at the River Shining Tavern , posing as an agent working for Amn ian investors . In truth , he searched for opportunities for business or blackmail that could advance the Zhent agenda .

title: Husuf el Halid
description: Husuf el Halid Husuf yn Harun el Halid was the Nirdey of the Emerald Ward in Calimport for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Husuf was the handsome son of a renowned moneylender of Calimport .
description_long: Husuf el Halid Husuf yn Harun el Halid was the Nirdey of the Emerald Ward in Calimport for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Husuf was the handsome son of a renowned moneylender of Calimport . He liked hosting extravagant parties in his palace . It was rumored that these nearly bankrupted his father . In truth , thanks to the Rundeen , Husuf had no economic problems . He worked for them for all his life and in 1368 DR was promoted to Nirdey of the Emerald Ward . His main opponent was Nasim yn Nasim el Pesarkhal , sultan of the Emerald Ward and nephew of the syl - pasha .

title: Huum
description: Huum Huum was a male mind flayer who resided in Sporedome . Description . Purple - skinned and hairless , Huum ' s tentacles writhed around his mouth .
description_long: Huum Huum was a male mind flayer who resided in Sporedome . Description . Purple - skinned and hairless , Huum ' s tentacles writhed around his mouth . Personality . Huum kept to himself mostly , living something of a hermit existence in Sporedome and only communicating with nearby myconid s . Abilities . Skilled in the psionic arts like most mind flayers , Huum was able to communicate telepathically with ease and even read minds . Despite this , his ability to read minds was not strong enough to pry into the thoughts of Solom Ned ' razak , a powerful drow archmage . Possessions . Huum considered a certain brooch , in the possession of Solom Ned ' razak , to be his . In his abode , Huum had control over a one - way " teleportation " circle to Szith Morcane . Relationships . He was on friendly terms with the myconids of Sporedome but held a dislike for the leader of Szith Morcane , Solom Ned ' razak . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR Huum resided in Sporedome alongside a community of myconids . He sought to acquire a brooch from Solom Ned ' razak , which Huum believed protected the drow archmage from his psionic power .

title: Huzuz
description: Huzuz Located at the narrow straits between the Golden Gulf and Suq Bay , Huzuz was Zakhara ' s greatest city . The spectacular view of its gleaming spires could be seen for miles across the water . It was the place where the first Grand Caliph had the vision of the Loregiver , gaining Fate ' s wisdom and the Law .
description_long: Huzuz Located at the narrow straits between the Golden Gulf and Suq Bay , Huzuz was Zakhara ' s greatest city . The spectacular view of its gleaming spires could be seen for miles across the water . It was the place where the first Grand Caliph had the vision of the Loregiver , gaining Fate ' s wisdom and the Law . The city remained the seat of the Grand Caliph , the centermost hub of the enlightened lands . Its ruler in 1367 DR , Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir , Master of the Enlightened Throne , Most High Sovereign of the Land of Fate , the Worthy of the Gods , Scourge of the Unbeliever , Confidant of the Genies , was the most powerful man in Zakhara and therefore one of the most powerful men on all of Al - Toril . Description . Huzuz was a large city . 800 , 000 permanent residents lived there , and at any time there were an additional 200 , 000 - 800 , 000 visitors , pilgrims , and tourists inhabiting the city as well . Many of Huzuz ' s domed rooves and towers were decked with gold , tile , and inlaid glass , sparkling in the sun . The city positively glowed , giving it the title Huzuz the Golden .

title: Huzza
description: Huzza Huzza was a hill giant pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . History . Huzza originally hailed from the Earthspur Mountains , where he lorded over a tribe of goblin s .
description_long: Huzza Huzza was a hill giant pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . History . Huzza originally hailed from the Earthspur Mountains , where he lorded over a tribe of goblin s . One day , a group of human s arrived by ship in Huzza ' s valley . They screamed when they spotted Huzza , so he devoured them all . After gathering the gold from their ship , Huzza decided to sail the sea in search of more . Huzza eventually became one of the strangest pirates of the Sea of Fallen Stars . He had no plans or direction , preferring to toss his goblin crew at any incoming vessels . However , many goblins missed the ship and drowned . Huzza recruited some other goblin tribes , but they soon learned to despise Huzza ' s system . Personality . Huzza had a simple mind that was driven by the base desire for food and gold .

title: Hyaline
description: Hyaline Hyaline was a milky or white form of and was usually cut as plates for inlays or cut and mounted in a silver setting . Description . The milkiness of these ornamental stones was caused by tiny droplets of water or carbon dioxide trapped in the crystals .
description_long: Hyaline Hyaline was a milky or white form of and was usually cut as plates for inlays or cut and mounted in a silver setting . Description . The milkiness of these ornamental stones was caused by tiny droplets of water or carbon dioxide trapped in the crystals . Some specimens contained flecks of gold . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Hyaline was sensitive to magic and would give off a blue glow whenever magic was activated , triggered , cast , or passed within 20 feet ( 6 . 1 meters ) of a hyaline gem .

title: Hybsil
description: Hybsil Hybsils were small fey creatures native to numerous forests in Faerûn . Description . Hybsils appeared as a cross between a small antelope and a pixie , like a centaur but with the bodies of small deer instead of horses .
description_long: Hybsil Hybsils were small fey creatures native to numerous forests in Faerûn . Description . Hybsils appeared as a cross between a small antelope and a pixie , like a centaur but with the bodies of small deer instead of horses . The color of a hybsil ' s body varied from dark grays and browns to beige and copper . Like normal , hybsils also often had spots or stripes . Hybsils had pointed , elegant ears with a small tuft of hair at the tips . Male hybsils had large forking , and females had smaller antlers that were sometimes spiraled . The male ' s antlers would molt in the middle of winter and grow back in spring . Due to being hunted for their antlers , hybsils developed a knack for finding traps and snares . They were also skilled at moving silently in forests . Their fey origin gave hybsils complete immunity to poisons . Behavior . A typical hybsil diet consisted of fruits , berries , roots , and small mammals . Hybsils commonly lived up to 50 years , but hybsils with arcane abilities were known to live to 70 years of age and well beyond . Combat . Hybsils fought with dagger s , short sword s , and short bow s .

title: Hydee
description: Hydee Hydee was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Hydee was a cleric of Loviatar and acted in a supportive role to a Hand ' s team .
description_long: Hydee Hydee was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Hydee was a cleric of Loviatar and acted in a supportive role to a Hand ' s team . Usually her role was to cast " silence " to the area of action , but often she could not resist entering the fight . Hydee was infatuated with Master Colstan Rhuul , whom she had met a few times , but she was not as beautiful as his usual companions of Colstan . On one occasion , Hydee killed a female wizard whom Colstan chose instead of her .

title: Hydel Pontifax
description: Hydel Pontifax Sir Hydel Pontifax was a deceased adventurer . Personality . He was a devoted follower of Mystra .
description_long: Hydel Pontifax Sir Hydel Pontifax was a deceased adventurer . Personality . He was a devoted follower of Mystra . History . Hydel was a wizard and a citizen of Cormyr , a good friend of Artus Cimber . In 1352 DR , he saved Artus from a prison in Zhentil Keep and together they decided to search for the " Ring of Winter " and were opposed by Kaverin Ebonhand and his Cult of Frost minions . Finally , in 1362 DR , they found the location of the Ring in Chult but when they arrived at the designated spot they found Kaverin . In the subsequent battle , Hydel was killed but he did not go immediately to the Fugue Plane . Instead , he appeared in the Temple of Ubtao in Mezro , where Hydel failed a test and was condemned by the god Ubtao , who ruled over Chult , to become a ghost . However , Mystra , the goddess that Hydel venerated , intervened and reclaimed his soul . Until the two gods resolved the situation , he existed as a spirit and in that form he helped Artus to finish his quest . Afterward , Hydel resided in Artus ' s quarters in Suzail , waiting to know his final destination .

title: Hydia Moonmusk
description: Hydia Moonmusk Hidya Moonmusk was the leader of Blue Bear Tribe allied with the stone giant s . Personality . Hidya , like most of her tribe , agreed with the stone giant thane Kayalithica that civilization must be destroyed .
description_long: Hydia Moonmusk Hidya Moonmusk was the leader of Blue Bear Tribe allied with the stone giant s . Personality . Hidya , like most of her tribe , agreed with the stone giant thane Kayalithica that civilization must be destroyed . Home . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , they lived inside the Deadstone Cleft together with the giants . Hydia lived with three cave bear s in a dry cave tucked under the grassy bulge of the mountains . Relationship . Hidya was the daughter of the Great Chief of the Blue Bear Tribe .

title: Hydra
description: Hydra Hydras were a breed of reptilian magical beast that had anywhere from five to twelve heads . Ecology . Hydras typically lived alone in fetid swamps and waterways and were generally always the most dangerous predator in whatever area they inhabited .
description_long: Hydra Hydras were a breed of reptilian magical beast that had anywhere from five to twelve heads . Ecology . Hydras typically lived alone in fetid swamps and waterways and were generally always the most dangerous predator in whatever area they inhabited . Combat . A hydra was an especially deadly monster , since every time a head was severed , two new ones grew in its place . Behavior . A hydra was not very intelligent , about as much so as an animal . Hydras were usually neutral in alignment . A pregnant hydra preparing to give birth would build a nest for this purpose . It dug a pit beside a pond or body of water , then lined it with sticks and weeds . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed hydras evolved from proto - dragon s . In the late 1340s DR , the explorer Hadley Erridge of Thunderstone in Cormyr suggested to his neighbor , the enterprising and prosperous farmer Del Geery , that he get a hydra to scare off the pests plaguing his crops . Geery agreed to finance Erridge ' s expedition into the Vast Swamp to capture a live hydra . Two months later , they returned with an adult hydra in a , iron cage .

title: Hydrophane
description: Hydrophane Hydrophane was a variety of opal that was highly prized by sailors and the aquatic races of Faerûn because its true beauty was only visible when wet . Description . This semi - precious stone was typically used for inlay work or cut cabochon for jewelry .
description_long: Hydrophane Hydrophane was a variety of opal that was highly prized by sailors and the aquatic races of Faerûn because its true beauty was only visible when wet . Description . This semi - precious stone was typically used for inlay work or cut cabochon for jewelry . It was a rather plain , opaque , ivory or frosty - white color when dry , but when immersed in water it became transparent with a prism - like rainbow iridescence . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Hydrophane was used in various potions and magic items related to water , especially those that allowed control over water elemental s or " water breathing " . If used as an additional material component for the " color spray " spell , it decreased the chance that targets would resist the spell .

title: Hyena
description: Hyena A hyena was a type of pack animal known for its shrewdness and hunting skills and for its disturbing laugh - like call . Description . Hyenas came in different varieties but commonly had stripes on their fur , weighing about 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and measuring a about a yard ( meter ) in length .
description_long: Hyena A hyena was a type of pack animal known for its shrewdness and hunting skills and for its disturbing laugh - like call . Description . Hyenas came in different varieties but commonly had stripes on their fur , weighing about 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and measuring a about a yard ( meter ) in length . Their fur coloration gave them an advantage when hiding within areas of tall grass . Combat . Hyenas fought in packs and were intelligent enough to send some of the members to circle and flank their prey . They were capable of tripping with their sharp jaws . Reputation . Gnoll s , unsurprisingly , had a strong affinity for hyenas , keeping many as pets or guards . The Mulhorand i god Set also favored hyenas , using them as omens for his followers .

title: Hykopgruk
description: Hykopgruk Hykopgruk was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its kayaks . Geography . Hykopgrukwas located in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , on the southwestern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea and north of the Surykyk Range .
description_long: Hykopgruk Hykopgruk was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its kayaks . Geography . Hykopgrukwas located in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , on the southwestern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea and north of the Surykyk Range . Trade . The people of Hykopgruk were skilled boatmakers , especially when crafting kayaks . In 1359 DR they were rumored to be developing a type of boat made wholly from ice .

title: Hykros Allumen
description: Hykros Allumen Hykros Allumen was the high priest of the Hall of Justice of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hykros was a devoted follower of Tyr and a bastion of law in Waterdeep .
description_long: Hykros Allumen Hykros Allumen was the high priest of the Hall of Justice of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hykros was a devoted follower of Tyr and a bastion of law in Waterdeep . He was also a student of early form of the church of Tyr , believing that over time Tyr ' s original message had been diluted . Hykros particularly rejected the notion that Tyr was the latest incarnation of Anachtyr , a common belief in south Faerûn . He was so against this notion that he was prejudiced again non - Northern followers of Tyr . Hykros also believed in a rigid separation between the Tyrran cleric , monk , and paladin paths .

title: Hypersthene
description: Hypersthene Hypersthene , also known as , was a gemstone usually cut . Description . This semi - precious stone was brown and opaque ( sometimes reddish or greenish ) and contained silvery spangles .
description_long: Hypersthene Hypersthene , also known as , was a gemstone usually cut . Description . This semi - precious stone was brown and opaque ( sometimes reddish or greenish ) and contained silvery spangles . It was rare to find an unflawed piece larger than in ( 13 mm ) across , and as a result the stone yielded small gemstones . A typical stone had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Carrying or wearing one of these gemstones made the bearer undetectable by the " wyvern watch " spell . In common parlance this property was known as wyvern warding .

title: Hypnotic pattern
description: Hypnotic pattern Hypnptic pattern was an illusion spell that could incapacitate multiple creatures . Effects . The spellcaster created a pattern of twisting colors that lasted for just a moment .
description_long: Hypnotic pattern Hypnptic pattern was an illusion spell that could incapacitate multiple creatures . Effects . The spellcaster created a pattern of twisting colors that lasted for just a moment . Any creature within range that could see the pattern would be paralyzed for up to one minute , as long as the caster kept concentrating . Creatures could attempt to resist to this effect or be shaken out of it . Components . The spell required somatic and material components . The required materials were either an incense stick or a a crystal vial filled with some phosphorescent material . These materials could be substituted by the use of a spellcasting focus . History . The spell was attributed to Netherese arcanist Hamring in - 1292 DR and was originally called " Hamring ' s hypnopattern " .

title: Hyraken ( lord )
description: Hyraken ( lord ) Lord Hyraken of Hilp was one of the leaders of the Freedom Warriors in the political aftermath of the Goblin War . According to Lady Kestrel Vaylan , he was a cruel man who worked his servants to death and consorted with priestesses of Loviatar . Rumors said that his hatred of Regent Alusair Obarskyr was due to her rejection of a proposal of marriage in the 1360s DR .
description_long: Hyraken ( lord ) Lord Hyraken of Hilp was one of the leaders of the Freedom Warriors in the political aftermath of the Goblin War . According to Lady Kestrel Vaylan , he was a cruel man who worked his servants to death and consorted with priestesses of Loviatar . Rumors said that his hatred of Regent Alusair Obarskyr was due to her rejection of a proposal of marriage in the 1360s DR .

title: Hyuth Kolstaag
description: Hyuth Kolstaag Hyuth Kolstaag was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hyuth was an adventurer until in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR rich he retired and settled in Triboar .
description_long: Hyuth Kolstaag Hyuth Kolstaag was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hyuth was an adventurer until in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR rich he retired and settled in Triboar . However his arrogance gained him no friends in town . Instead he was targeted by many enemies and rivals . After a trio of assassins tried to kill him in his bed , Kolstaag hired four gargoyle s guard .

title: I ' m Quite the Red - Roof Girl
description: I ' m Quite the Red - Roof Girl " I ' m Quite The Red - Roof Girl " was a bawdy song favored in the more disreputable parts of the city of Procampur in the Vast and sung by the mid - 13th century DR . It described the red - roof girls of the city ' s Adventurers ' District . In the Year of Burning Steel , 1246 DR , Ivy of the Siegebreakers learned it from a minstrel in a Procampan military camp .
description_long: I ' m Quite the Red - Roof Girl " I ' m Quite The Red - Roof Girl " was a bawdy song favored in the more disreputable parts of the city of Procampur in the Vast and sung by the mid - 13th century DR . It described the red - roof girls of the city ' s Adventurers ' District . In the Year of Burning Steel , 1246 DR , Ivy of the Siegebreakers learned it from a minstrel in a Procampan military camp . She sung it to annoy Captain Sanval . The song began with " " I ' m quite the red - roof girl , in fact , all the warriors declare … " " . The second verse contained " " Once the men lived for my sighs , but now they want a peek of … " " . Ivy did not dare sing the final three lines before the Forty bodyguards of the Thultyrl .

title: I ' tiraf
description: I ' tiraf The large city of I ' tiraf served as the capital of the federation of Pantheist cities , with the League Conclave located here . Geography . It lay at the banks of Al - Hadi River , directly across the Golden Gulf from the Pearl City of Jumlat .
description_long: I ' tiraf The large city of I ' tiraf served as the capital of the federation of Pantheist cities , with the League Conclave located here . Geography . It lay at the banks of Al - Hadi River , directly across the Golden Gulf from the Pearl City of Jumlat . Society . Like all Cities of the Pantheon , I ' tiraf held to strict moral standards and exclusive belief in the five Gods of the Pantheon . Citizens strongly beliefed in the comparative barbarism of people from outside the Pantheist League , and the city had a reputation for finding out breakers of the law and punishing them swiftly , leading to its title " City of Confessions " . Trade . Apart from priests and sages in religious lore , I ' tiraf exported glassware and crystals .

title: Iados
description: Iados Iados was a tiefling warrior and a companion of the dragonborn paladin Thava . He was an old friend of the monk Kwan Shang - Li and joined forces with him to defeat Caelynna and recover several rare tomes belonging to the Standing Tree Monastery . Appearance .
description_long: Iados Iados was a tiefling warrior and a companion of the dragonborn paladin Thava . He was an old friend of the monk Kwan Shang - Li and joined forces with him to defeat Caelynna and recover several rare tomes belonging to the Standing Tree Monastery . Appearance . Iados had dark red skin , large horns that he could use as a weapon , and a tail . He had shoulder length hair . Equipment . Iados used a sword and shield .

title: Iakhovas
description: Iakhovas Iakhovas was an ancient megalodon . Not much was truly known of his long history but it is known that he was responsible for devastating attacks on coastal cities and was also the instigator of the Twelfth Serôs War . Biography .
description_long: Iakhovas Iakhovas was an ancient megalodon . Not much was truly known of his long history but it is known that he was responsible for devastating attacks on coastal cities and was also the instigator of the Twelfth Serôs War . Biography . Several of the legends and myths of the undersea peoples mention Iakhovas but those of the Locathah are by far the most detailed . The Legend . Locathah legend states that Iakhovas emerged from the sea in human form at the beginning of the Days of Thunder , looking for another like himself . He dared to question the gods of Toril on their design and the gods , curious about the solitary mortal , deigned to answer him . Soon though , he returned to the sea , not finding anything like him as he was a unique creature . It is then that he is said to have travelled with Sekolah , until Sekolah freed the first sahuagin from their imprisonment in a giant clam shell . In lost sahuagin legend , he is thusly known as the " One Who Swims With Sekolah " . All legends agree that during this time in Iakhovas ’ life , he searched for love and acceptance in order to end the constant loneliness he felt .

title: Iallanis
description: Iallanis Iallanis was the giant goddess of love and mercy . She always sought to reunite the giant races under a single banner , with the hopes that they could live in harmony forevermore . Her holy symbol was a garland of flowers .
description_long: Iallanis Iallanis was the giant goddess of love and mercy . She always sought to reunite the giant races under a single banner , with the hopes that they could live in harmony forevermore . Her holy symbol was a garland of flowers . Relationships . As Hiatea ' s younger sister , she counted the farming deity as an ally . Little else was known , but a good guess is that she was also allied to Sune and her aspect Hanali Celanil .

title: Ian Harman
description: Ian Harman Ian Harman was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ian was a member of the militia of West Harbor .
description_long: Ian Harman Ian Harman was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ian was a member of the militia of West Harbor . Strangely , he was usually seen as a coward , who ' d rather flee from a fight than join it . The Kalach - Cha considered asking him to join the fight against the bladeling s and duergar that invaded in 1374 DR . However , whether he fought or not , Ian was killed in the battle .

title: Iarno Albrek
description: Iarno Albrek Iarno Albrek , also known as " Glasstaff " , was a human wizard and the direct leader of the Redbrands bandit gang . He was a short , dark - bearded human wizard that was simply known to most as " Glasstaff " for his weapon of choice , a magic staff made of glass . Iarno was initially a member of the Lords ' Alliance , who was sent to the town of Phandalin to establish constabulary ( as the town did not have a powerful authority ) .
description_long: Iarno Albrek Iarno Albrek , also known as " Glasstaff " , was a human wizard and the direct leader of the Redbrands bandit gang . He was a short , dark - bearded human wizard that was simply known to most as " Glasstaff " for his weapon of choice , a magic staff made of glass . Iarno was initially a member of the Lords ' Alliance , who was sent to the town of Phandalin to establish constabulary ( as the town did not have a powerful authority ) . However , sometime in the 1480s DR , Iarno broke ties with the Lords ' Alliance and created the Redbrands under the guidance of Nezznar . Iarno knew of Nezznar from his contacts in the Lords ' Alliance and negotiated a meeting with the drow , seeing a chance to line his pockets .

title: Ibin Stormrider
description: Ibin Stormrider Ibin Stormrider was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . When the king of the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix was slain , Ibin Stormrider was the most dangerous of the opportunists who gathered around the dead king ' s throne . In order that a goblin might claim the throne , the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned to Nix to drive away Ibin and the rest in bloodforge battle .
description_long: Ibin Stormrider Ibin Stormrider was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . When the king of the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix was slain , Ibin Stormrider was the most dangerous of the opportunists who gathered around the dead king ' s throne . In order that a goblin might claim the throne , the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned to Nix to drive away Ibin and the rest in bloodforge battle .

title: Ibn
description: Ibn Ibn was first mate under Captain Hrolf on the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . Ibn had fair ruddy skin , blue eyes , and a red beard .
description_long: Ibn Ibn was first mate under Captain Hrolf on the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . Ibn had fair ruddy skin , blue eyes , and a red beard . He was nearly six feet tall . Ibn hated elves , particularly Liriel Baenre , whom he tried to kill several times .

title: Ibrandul
description: Ibrandul Ibrandul ( " Ih - BRAN - duhl " ) was a chaotic neutral lesser deity of the Underdark , worshiped in Calimshan and other parts of the Shining South . Worshipers . Ibrandul was worshipped as a deity with power over the underground , darkness and stealth in the Shining South and by the Calishite s .
description_long: Ibrandul Ibrandul ( " Ih - BRAN - duhl " ) was a chaotic neutral lesser deity of the Underdark , worshiped in Calimshan and other parts of the Shining South . Worshipers . Ibrandul was worshipped as a deity with power over the underground , darkness and stealth in the Shining South and by the Calishite s . His worship was popular with adventurers . Relationships . Ibrandul was allied with Mask and Ilmater . He was an enemy of both Lolth and Shar , as both desired his Cavern ( Underdark ) portfolio , as well he was an enemy of Lathander as their portfolios were directly opposed . History . He was killed by Shar in the Underdark beneath Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles , but the goddess of secrets masqueraded as the dead deity for a while , unbeknownst to his followers .

title: Ibtisam bint Latifa
description: Ibtisam bint Latifa Ibtisam bint Latifa was a clothing designer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ibtisam ' s real skill revolved around her ability to pick specific clothing to suit each customer and their particular body shape .
description_long: Ibtisam bint Latifa Ibtisam bint Latifa was a clothing designer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ibtisam ' s real skill revolved around her ability to pick specific clothing to suit each customer and their particular body shape . Customers of hers included nobles from court . She was even invited to consult with members of the royal harim . She charged 10 dinar s for a consultation . Ibtisam ' s small home and shop was located near the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in the Court District .

title: Icasaracht
description: Icasaracht Icasaracht was a white dragon who lived in the northern region of Icewind Dale . She was said to be the matron mother of the white wyrms . History .
description_long: Icasaracht Icasaracht was a white dragon who lived in the northern region of Icewind Dale . She was said to be the matron mother of the white wyrms . History . She was slain by Aihonen ' s ancestor and her soul was trapped in her broken heart at the bottom of Lac Dinneshere , one of the three lakes of Icewind Dale in the Frozenfar of the Sword Coast North , that the Ten Towns clustered around . The blade was later removed , allowing Icasaracht to reincarnate . She was later slain again by the hands of the Heroes of the Ten Towns .

title: Ice Run
description: Ice Run The Ice Run was a network of tunnels and sunken trails in the Great Glacier , beside Vaasa in north Faerûn . Geography . The Ice Run was a network of ice - walled pathways stretching all along the face of the Great Glacier .
description_long: Ice Run The Ice Run was a network of tunnels and sunken trails in the Great Glacier , beside Vaasa in north Faerûn . Geography . The Ice Run was a network of ice - walled pathways stretching all along the face of the Great Glacier . These twisted and winded , making a quite tortuous maze . All in all , they extended several hundred miles in length . Many of these paths were open to the sky , but the sun above reflected off the walls of ice , filling the passages with dazzling light . This could be quite bewildering to explorers , and so the open tops offered no better chance of escape . Inhabitants . The folk of the White Worm tribe saw the Ice Run as their holy ground , and also used it as a defensive retreat . Only they knew how to traverse this hazardous maze , and they most often wandered there . This most unwelcoming of tribes was especially hostile to trespassers . Also roaming the Ice Run were remorhaz es , the white worms held as totems by the barbarians , as well as northern bear s . The Ice Run was naturally very dangerous for explorers .

title: Ice Spire ogre
description: Ice Spire ogre Ice Spire ogres were bigger , smarter , and more dangerous than their more numerous cousins . History . Much of the history of the Ice Spire ogres was unknown to human chroniclers , but some relatively later events were common knowledge .
description_long: Ice Spire ogre Ice Spire ogres were bigger , smarter , and more dangerous than their more numerous cousins . History . Much of the history of the Ice Spire ogres was unknown to human chroniclers , but some relatively later events were common knowledge . A tribe of Ice Spire ogres was once employed by Prince Camden of the human kingdom of Hartsvale . Camden was involved in a civil war with his twin brother over who would succeed their late father as king . The ogres ' aid helped Camden win the war and ascend the throne . The ogres demanded an unusual price for their cooperation however . The tribes ' chieftain and shaman , Goboka , wanted Camden ' s first - born daughter as compensation for his tribes ' aid in the war . As a young prince with no children ( and a family line that strongly favored male children ) , Camden agreed . After Camden became king , he did indeed have a daughter , Brianna . King Camden refused to give her up , however , until an emissary arrived at his castle reminding him of his secret promise . In order to maintain appearances , the King set up an ambush where his now - grown daughter could be kidnapped by the ogres and spirited away .

title: Ice axe ( spell )
description: Ice axe ( spell ) Ice axe was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It created a whirling cloud of ice slivers shaped like a battleaxe that the caster could wield with proficiency . Effects .
description_long: Ice axe ( spell ) Ice axe was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It created a whirling cloud of ice slivers shaped like a battleaxe that the caster could wield with proficiency . Effects . When cast , this spell produced a magical battleaxe made from swirling slivers of ice that appeared in the caster ' s hand . For the next five minutes ( longer for more experienced casters ) it could be wielded as if the caster were proficient with this type of weapon . The strength of the caster was not important because the " ice axe " was magical and nearly weightless . On a successful hit , the " ice axe " did both slashing damage as per a battleaxe , and potentially greater damage by magical coldness . While the caster held the " ice axe " , he or she could not be disarmed of the weapon and it could not be physically damaged . If the caster used the axe hand for some other purpose , like holding another object or grappling with an opponent , the " ice axe " disappeared until the hand was empty and ready to wield it again . This spell lasted until dismissed by the caster or the duration expired , whichever came first . Components .

title: Ice blade
description: Ice blade Ice blade was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced whirling formation of ice crystals in the shape of a sword that the caster could wield with great skill . Effects .
description_long: Ice blade Ice blade was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced whirling formation of ice crystals in the shape of a sword that the caster could wield with great skill . Effects . When cast , a four - foot ( 1 . 2 meters ) force blade , 4 inches ( 10 centimeters ) wide , made up of swirling ice shards grew out of the caster ' s hand to form a sword - like shape . It weighed nothing to the caster and was considered a " + 2 " magical weapon . The flying shards moved around obstacles , like small shield s , parrying weapons , or trees , giving the wielder an exceptionally high chance to hit any creature that it passed through . On a successful attack , it lacerated the target like a blizzard of sharp ice and did additional damage from magical cold . A sweeping maneuver could attack more than one creature in range of the " blade " with no combat penalties . The " ice blade " lasted long enough to make seven consecutive attacks or actions ( higher level casters could extend the duration ) and then faded away . Components .

title: Ice box
description: Ice box An ice box was a quasimagical item invented in Netheril to allow people to preserve food by keeping it cool . Description . An " ice box " was roughly the shape of a coffin and was constructed from a material with about the same thickness and strength as hardened clay .
description_long: Ice box An ice box was a quasimagical item invented in Netheril to allow people to preserve food by keeping it cool . Description . An " ice box " was roughly the shape of a coffin and was constructed from a material with about the same thickness and strength as hardened clay . One weighed about 300 pounds ( 140 kilograms ) . During the height of the Netherese Empire , they typically sold for 225 gold pieces . Abilities . As a quasimagical item , an " ice box " only functioned if within one mile ( one and a half kilometers ) of a " mythallar " . If within a " mythallar ' s " range of effect , an " ice box " maintained a magical conduit to the Paraelemental Plane of Ice , which provided a constant source of cold to keep food frozen .

title: Ice dagger
description: Ice dagger Ice dagger was an evocation spell used by arcane spellcaster in the Forgotten Realms . Effects . Using a few drops of water , the spellcaster would shape a dagger - shaped shard of ice , which would then launch itself inerrantly at a target within close range and explode upon impact , causing cold damage to the target and an area within a five - foot ( one - and - a - half - meter ) radius .
description_long: Ice dagger Ice dagger was an evocation spell used by arcane spellcaster in the Forgotten Realms . Effects . Using a few drops of water , the spellcaster would shape a dagger - shaped shard of ice , which would then launch itself inerrantly at a target within close range and explode upon impact , causing cold damage to the target and an area within a five - foot ( one - and - a - half - meter ) radius . Components . This spell required both verbal and somatic component s , in addition to the drops of water , which must also have originated from melted ice .

title: Ice dragon ' s teeth
description: Ice dragon ' s teeth Ice dragon ' s teeth is conjuration spell used by several young or inexperienced sorcerer s . When " ice dragon ' s teeth " is cast , the dragon causes tooth - like daggers of ice to surge outwards from the body of any creature within a zone of five feet in diameter that is no more than fifty feet from the sorcerer . As a result of this attack , any affected are not only injured , but find their movements slowed slightly for a brief moment .
description_long: Ice dragon ' s teeth Ice dragon ' s teeth is conjuration spell used by several young or inexperienced sorcerer s .
