When " ice dragon ' s teeth " is cast , the dragon causes tooth - like daggers of ice to surge outwards from the body of any creature within a zone of five feet in diameter that is no more than fifty feet from the sorcerer . As a result of this attack , any affected are not only injured , but find their movements slowed slightly for a brief moment . " Ice dragon ' s teeth " requires a short rest of a few minutes or more from its caster before it can be used again .

title: Ice gauntlet
description: Ice gauntlet Ice gauntlet was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It encased one of the caster ' s fists in a spike - covered ball of ice that was an effective melee weapon . Effects .
description_long: Ice gauntlet Ice gauntlet was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It encased one of the caster ' s fists in a spike - covered ball of ice that was an effective melee weapon . Effects . This spell covered one of the caster ' s hands with ice spikes that were as hard as rock , giving the wielder the equivalent of a " + 1 spiked gauntlet " that could be used in melee combat . This spell lasted for one minute ( higher level casters were able to prolong this ) or until it was dismissed , whichever came first . On a successful hit , the gauntlet did physical damage according to the caster ' s size and strength , plus a modicum of cold damage . The physical attack could be mitigated with normal damage reduction techniques , but the cold attack was not affected — some form of resistance was necessary to prevent the damage caused the frigid temperature . While a hand was encased in ice spikes , other actions like climbing or casting a spell that required two hands for the somatic component , were more difficult to impossible . If the wielder of the " ice gauntlet " was subjected to any damage by fire , the spell ended as the gauntlet melted away .

title: Ice genasi
description: Ice genasi An ice genasi , or ice para - genasi , was a sub - race of the genasi . It was a para - genasi , meaning that it was descended from two different elemental outsider s , namely an outsider of elemental air and an outsider of elemental water , forming para - elemental ice . Personality .
description_long: Ice genasi An ice genasi , or ice para - genasi , was a sub - race of the genasi . It was a para - genasi , meaning that it was descended from two different elemental outsider s , namely an outsider of elemental air and an outsider of elemental water , forming para - elemental ice . Personality . They were emotionless and cold to others . They were typically neutral in outlook , observant but uncaring . They preferred to be clad in white or pale blue clothing that was light and loose . Description . These genasi appeared human , but commonly had sharper facial features and a more chiseled look than the average human . They were quite hearty but a bit sluggish . They had pale skin and supernatural traits that hinted to their heritage , such as breath that fogged in any weather or frost appearing in their hair . Abilities . They had an innate ability to resist the harmful effects of cold that grew with experience . They also had the ability to cast the spell " chill metal " once a moon rise .

title: Ice storm
description: Ice storm Ice storm , formerly known as Veridon ' s storm , was an evocation spell that blasted an area with hail . Effect . The spell caused large hailstones to pound down over an area , dealing both impact and cold damage to creatures in their path .
description_long: Ice storm Ice storm , formerly known as Veridon ' s storm , was an evocation spell that blasted an area with hail . Effect . The spell caused large hailstones to pound down over an area , dealing both impact and cold damage to creatures in their path . The storm also slowed their movement and made it harder to hear . Components . The spell required some drops of water and a pinch of dust . History . The spell was created by the arcanist Veridon of Netheril , ruler of the enclave of Lathery . He introduced it in 3396 NY ( −463 DR ) under the name " Veridon ' s storm " . At Lathery , continual " Veridon ' s storm " s were used to chill the cold storage rooms cold and freeze fish . It later became known simply as " ice storm " . " Ice storm " was a common spell in Faerûn in the 1360s DR .

title: Ice troll
description: Ice troll Ice trolls were a type of troll that inhabited the cold north . Society . Like all troll s , they were meat eaters and would gladly consume anything , even humanoid s .
description_long: Ice troll Ice trolls were a type of troll that inhabited the cold north . Society . Like all troll s , they were meat eaters and would gladly consume anything , even humanoid s . What set them apart however was their ability to craft ( and use ) weapons and armor skillfully . They prefer armor made from the scales of remorhaz es or white dragon s . Description . Ice trolls stood about 8 feet tall and weighed around 400 pounds . They had sickly translucent white skin and if someone got close enough without being eaten they could see pale blood coursing underneath an ice troll ' s skin .

title: Icelace Lake
description: Icelace Lake Icelace Lake was a frigid lake in Narfell that was created from runoff from the Great Glacier . Description . The body of Icelace Lake was long and thin , almost resembling a bloated river .
description_long: Icelace Lake Icelace Lake was a frigid lake in Narfell that was created from runoff from the Great Glacier . Description . The body of Icelace Lake was long and thin , almost resembling a bloated river . It stretched across much of northern Narfell , acting as a kind of barrier against the Great Glacier . Activities . Various tribes of Nar braved the frigid waters of the lake in deerskin canoes for the rich salmon and trout teeming in the water . Bears were also drawn to the lake because of the fish , but viewed humans as an easy target for a quick meal .

title: Icelace River
description: Icelace River The Icelace River flowed southwest down from the Great Glacier , through the far western part of Narfell and into central Damara . It flowed fast enough so that it never froze over , even in the harshest of winters and was deadly cold if someone fell in , making it useful for protecting the northeastern border of Damara from aggressive Nar tribes . If the river was needed to repel the tribesmen and blightlords , king Gareth Dragonsbane of Damara would have expanded his borders to better defend the river .
description_long: Icelace River The Icelace River flowed southwest down from the Great Glacier , through the far western part of Narfell and into central Damara . It flowed fast enough so that it never froze over , even in the harshest of winters and was deadly cold if someone fell in , making it useful for protecting the northeastern border of Damara from aggressive Nar tribes . If the river was needed to repel the tribesmen and blightlords , king Gareth Dragonsbane of Damara would have expanded his borders to better defend the river .

title: Icelance
description: Icelance Icelance was an alteration spell that created a magical lance from an existing supply of ice which then flew off to strike a chosen target . Effects . This spell required a supply of approximately 10 lbs ( 4 .
description_long: Icelance Icelance was an alteration spell that created a magical lance from an existing supply of ice which then flew off to strike a chosen target . Effects . This spell required a supply of approximately 10 lbs ( 4 . 5 kg ) of ice , or the remains of an " ice storm " spell or similar effect . The ice particles formed a sharp lance in a few seconds and then propelled itself in a straight line toward whatever target the caster designated . The lance attempted to hit its target with considerably more skill than the caster had , and if successful , did heavy damage and had a chance to stun the target for a few minutes . Regardless if the attack was successful , unsuccessful , or intercepted by a non - intended target , the lance dissolved back into ice particles once the attack was attempted . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components as well as a supply of ice nearby . Realmslore . " Icelance " was one of four unique spells contained in the " Tome of Rathdaen " . By the 1360s DR , " icelance " was an uncommon spell in the Realms .

title: Icelin Tearn
description: Icelin Tearn Icelin Tearn is a human wizard from Waterdeep . She has a spellscar which makes her magic much more powerful than it would otherwise be . However , her magic often runs wild and she has a difficult time controlling the effects of her spells .
description_long: Icelin Tearn Icelin Tearn is a human wizard from Waterdeep . She has a spellscar which makes her magic much more powerful than it would otherwise be . However , her magic often runs wild and she has a difficult time controlling the effects of her spells . Additionally , every time she uses magic , it takes a huge emotional and physical toll . History . Childhood . Icelin ' s parents were scholars from Baldur ' s Gate who were adventuring partners with a gold elf named Cerest Elenithil and a human named Elgreth . They often took her along on expeditions to study the effects of the Spellplague . On one of their expeditions her parents accidentally released dormant blue fire which killed them and left Icelin , Elgreth and Cerest spellscared . Elgreth ' s spellscar gave him the power to detect magic , an extremely useful skill for a treasure hunter . He was concerned that Cerest believed Icelin had the same ability and would attempt to use Icelin ' s power so he took Icelin to live with his brother , Brant , in Waterdeep ' s South Ward . Icelin grew up in Brant ' s dry goods shop . Her birth mother was a wizard and she inherited some of her mother ' s magical ability .

title: Icerim Mountains
description: Icerim Mountains The Icerim Mountains were located in the far northern expanses of the Hordelands bordering Narfell and Rashemen . Geography . These mountains were once part of the Great Glacier , but a recession of the ice over the centuries had separated the Icerim .
description_long: Icerim Mountains The Icerim Mountains were located in the far northern expanses of the Hordelands bordering Narfell and Rashemen . Geography . These mountains were once part of the Great Glacier , but a recession of the ice over the centuries had separated the Icerim . Inhabitants . Many tribes lived within the Icerim Mountains , including the Tark , Chif , and Dagranost .

title: Icewind Dale
description: Icewind Dale Icewind Dale was an arctic region , along the northernmost part of the Sword Coast . History . The region was first populated when Northlander longships reached the region during the last centuries of the Illefarn empire .
description_long: Icewind Dale Icewind Dale was an arctic region , along the northernmost part of the Sword Coast . History . The region was first populated when Northlander longships reached the region during the last centuries of the Illefarn empire . Initially settling on the islands , the northlanders would eventually settle Icewind Dale . Geography . Icewind Dale was an icy tundra and the northernmost explored area of Faerûn . Its only permanent settlements were known as Ten - Towns , a confederation of a number of minor settlements cooperating with each other . On the northern face of Kelvin ' s Cairn , the only mountain in the region , a cave where Drizzt Do ' Urden resided for some time as a ranger and protector of Ten - Towns . Three lakes , whose temperature even in the summer months is cold enough to kill a man , are the only known places to find the Knucklehead trout , a fish whose bones are almost exactly like ivory . Government . The capital of the region was the town of Bryn Shander . Inhabitants .

title: Icewind Dale ( game )
description: Icewind Dale ( game ) Icewind Dale is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios , released in June 2000 . The first game in the " Icewind Dale " series , it features tactical , party - based combat based on 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " . The game ' s story is set in the Icewind Dale region on the northern Sword Coast , several decades prior to the events of the popular Icewind Dale trilogy of novels " Icewind Dale " received two expansion packs : " " and " " , and was followed by the sequel " Icewind Dale II " in 2002 .
description_long: Icewind Dale ( game ) Icewind Dale is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios , released in June 2000 . The first game in the " Icewind Dale " series , it features tactical , party - based combat based on 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " . The game ' s story is set in the Icewind Dale region on the northern Sword Coast , several decades prior to the events of the popular Icewind Dale trilogy of novels " Icewind Dale " received two expansion packs : " " and " " , and was followed by the sequel " Icewind Dale II " in 2002 . In 2014 , a remake was released under the title " " , featuring a number of technical improvements . Plot . The game begins in the town of Easthaven within Icewind Dale during Mirtul , 1281 DR ( Year of the Cold Soul ) . While a group of adventurers are resting in a local pub known as the Winter ' s Cradle Tavern , they are invited by the town ' s leader Hrothgar to take part in an expedition to the town of Kuldahar which has word of strange goings - on .

title: Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter
description: Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter was the expansion pack for the year 2000 game Icewind Dale . Summary . The expansion to Icewind Dale involves stopping the white dragon Icasaracht from causing the possessed barbarian chieftain , Wylfdene to attack the Ten Towns .
description_long: Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter was the expansion pack for the year 2000 game Icewind Dale . Summary . The expansion to Icewind Dale involves stopping the white dragon Icasaracht from causing the possessed barbarian chieftain , Wylfdene to attack the Ten Towns . The party has only one real ally , the shaman Hjollder who is quickly banished by the possessed Wylfdene to an island in the middle of Maer Dualdon reserved for the dead . Once the party rescues him from the undead there and finds the despoiled tomb of an apparently dead Wylfdene , they have to track down The Seer who has been hiding in Gloomfrost , inside the peak of Kelvin ' s Cairn for 10 years , having forseen her death at the party ' s coming . She tells you of Icasaracht and gives you a magical mirror which will drive the dragon ' s spirit out of the corpse of Wylfdene . They do so and the seer is killed after she teleports herself to Wylfdene ' s tent to taunt the dragon ' s spirit .

title: Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster
description: Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster was a downloadable expansion pack for set in the Anauroch desert , rather than the standard locale of the games namesake , Icewind Dale . Summary . Heart of Winter was deemed too short ( especially in comparison to other Black Isle expansions like ) so a free downloadable addition was made called Trials of the Luremaster .
description_long: Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster was a downloadable expansion pack for set in the Anauroch desert , rather than the standard locale of the games namesake , Icewind Dale . Summary . Heart of Winter was deemed too short ( especially in comparison to other Black Isle expansions like ) so a free downloadable addition was made called Trials of the Luremaster . This made available an entirely new adventure set in Anauroch ( and according to in - game canon this was where the party who saved Easthaven left for after they ' d completed their quest ) . A mysterious halfling , Hobart Stubbletoes , promises treasure and teleports the party to Anauroch , where there is a castle , Castle Maluradek . Inside , an undead bard with a knack for rhyming verse challenges the party to prove themselves heroes by granting the castle ' s undead inhabitants eternal rest at last .

title: Icewind Dale II
description: Icewind Dale II Icewind Dale II is the sequel to " Icewind Dale . " It is set around 30 years after the events of the original game . Its plot revolves around a goblin uprising in the North , known as the Legion of the Chimera which threatens to overrun the Ten Towns if not stopped .
description_long: Icewind Dale II Icewind Dale II is the sequel to " Icewind Dale . " It is set around 30 years after the events of the original game . Its plot revolves around a goblin uprising in the North , known as the Legion of the Chimera which threatens to overrun the Ten Towns if not stopped . Gameplay . Icewind Dale II has an upgraded version of Icewind Dale ' s real time D & D Third edition rule set . Backcover blurb . " " The civilised realms are threatened : Goblinoids have united , the Orcs are advancing . Revive this epic battle and protect Ten - Towns . Choose your character among numerous playable races , included Dark Elves , with up to 300 spells and abilities , and defeat the Hordes ! " Story . The game ( set in 1310 DR ) begins as the player ' s group of mercenaries arrives by ship to defend Targos . They report to the town palisade and fend off an assault by the goblin army . After this , the mayor of Targos orders them to start an offensive on the goblin army . The group kills the chieftain of the army , and discovers that he was under the command of a woman named Sherincal . When they return to Targos , the mayor asks them to rendezvous with reinforcements from Neverwinter .

title: Ichi ( korobokuru )
description: Ichi ( korobokuru ) Ichi was a korobokuru yakuza in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ichi was a kobun of the Big Head gang .
description_long: Ichi ( korobokuru ) Ichi was a korobokuru yakuza in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ichi was a kobun of the Big Head gang . He often visited the Winter Sect temple but preferred life among the eta community . History . Ichi was recruited by the monks Kogi and his friend Bupposo to find a girl that could seduce monks . Ichi hired the young maiden O - Shino . Personality . Ichi was a wispy individual , forever cringing and bowing in the presence of others . He played the part of a boastful bully , self - important , and cruel . He had many miserable cronies , but no true friends .

title: Ichi Krijiku
description: Ichi Krijiku Ichi Krijiku was a bushi of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ichi Krijiku led the Soldiers of Iron kabukimono of the village of Seinin in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Ichi Krijiku Ichi Krijiku was a bushi of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ichi Krijiku led the Soldiers of Iron kabukimono of the village of Seinin in Fochu Peninsula . History . Ichi and his group lorded it over Seinin and the shoya Toi Jujishiki did nothing to stop them . In 1358 DR , Ichi and his men met Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party and attacked them but were defeated .

title: Icingdeath
description: Icingdeath Icingdeath was the nickname for Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s main right - hand scimitar . Description . The hilt of this scimitar was black adamantite and the blade was made of silver with a diamond edge .
description_long: Icingdeath Icingdeath was the nickname for Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s main right - hand scimitar . Description . The hilt of this scimitar was black adamantite and the blade was made of silver with a diamond edge . Its handle was shaped like the head of a hunting cat . Powers . Icingdeath was a " + 3 scimitar " . It had the powers of a frost weapon . It was also a " frostbrand " weapon . The weapon absorbed fire and heat , protecting its wielder against fire . It also had the ability to extinguish magical fire . For example , it extinguished a portion of the " wall of fire " conjured by the powerful demon , Errtu . However , it could also be set on fire in order to harm troll s , though this was only when the magic of the blade was being repressed . History . In 1356 DR , Drizzt Do ' Urden , famed hero of the Companions of the Hall , found the blade in the treasure pile of Ingeloakastimizilian the white wyrm , better known as " Icingdeath " , and the weapon ' s namesake . The barbarian Wulfgar and Drizzt killed the dragon and found the scimitar after a dramatic battle .

title: Icy - White
description: Icy - White Ice - White was an ice mephit in the Samek Valley . History . In 1366 DR , Icy - White acted as assistant to the gelugon Vreesar in his plan to conquer the Samek Valley .
description_long: Icy - White Ice - White was an ice mephit in the Samek Valley . History . In 1366 DR , Icy - White acted as assistant to the gelugon Vreesar in his plan to conquer the Samek Valley . He captured the Harper Martine and took her to his master .

title: Icy Claws
description: Icy Claws The Icy Claws of Iyraclea were a group of gelugon s who served the self - proclaimed Ice Queen Iyraclea on the Great Glacier . Description . Each of the Icy Claws was more powerful and better trained then the typical ice devil from Cania would be .
description_long: Icy Claws The Icy Claws of Iyraclea were a group of gelugon s who served the self - proclaimed Ice Queen Iyraclea on the Great Glacier . Description . Each of the Icy Claws was more powerful and better trained then the typical ice devil from Cania would be . Notable Members . The Icy Claw Tosvin , while investigating the ancient giant ruins of Gharreil for Iyraclea , was chosen by the last Prince of Jhothûn to be Gharreil ' s portal guardian .

title: Icy rays
description: Icy rays Icy rays is a spell used by some young or inexperienced wizard s . When cast , " icy rays " causes two bolts of bright , frigid energy to shoot out from the wizard ' s location and towards a spot somewhere within fifty feet of him or her . Bluish - white in color , these rays can strike one or two targets , though only one ray can be used on any one target .
description_long: Icy rays Icy rays is a spell used by some young or inexperienced wizard s . When cast , " icy rays " causes two bolts of bright , frigid energy to shoot out from the wizard ' s location and towards a spot somewhere within fifty feet of him or her . Bluish - white in color , these rays can strike one or two targets , though only one ray can be used on any one target . If the wizard is successful in his casting , he is able to momentarily freeze the target in its place . The spell is relatively easy to cast , though the caster requires a short rest of a few minutes or more before casting it again .

title: Icy terrain
description: Icy terrain Icy terrain is an evocation spell learned by some wizard ly initiates that uses cold terrain to impede the wizard ' s foes . When a wizard casts " icy terrain " he or she fills a small area within fifty feet with a thick layer of ice , which causes any creatures within the area ' s five foot diameter without fast enough reflexes to slip and fall to the ground . For the next few moments the affected terrain provides a small impedement to enemy movement .
description_long: Icy terrain Icy terrain is an evocation spell learned by some wizard ly initiates that uses cold terrain to impede the wizard ' s foes . When a wizard casts " icy terrain " he or she fills a small area within fifty feet with a thick layer of ice , which causes any creatures within the area ' s five foot diameter without fast enough reflexes to slip and fall to the ground . For the next few moments the affected terrain provides a small impedement to enemy movement . The spell is easily learned and easily cast , but it drains its caster enough that a rest of a few minutes is required before the spell can be cast again .

title: Idalia ' s flute
description: Idalia ' s flute Idalia ' s flute was a magical flute that affected a person ' s emotions . Description . Idalia ' s flute was a small and rather ordinary - looking flute carved from a piece of gray driftwood .
description_long: Idalia ' s flute Idalia ' s flute was a magical flute that affected a person ' s emotions . Description . Idalia ' s flute was a small and rather ordinary - looking flute carved from a piece of gray driftwood . It played beautiful , clear music . It was said that Idalia put a key inside this flute to unlock any heart . History . The flute was carved by the monk Idalia of the Yellow Rose . The carving became the focus of his existence and he nearly starved to death completing it . The flute was lost and centuries after Idalia ' s death it fell into the hands of Ilnezhara , a dragon disguised as a human in Heliogabalus . In 1368 DR , Ilnezhara ' s sister , Tazmikella , hired Artemis Entreri and Jarlaxle to retrieve the flute . The task was in fact a ploy for the two dragon sisters to judge the abilities of the pair . They proved themselves worthy and Ilnezhara gave the flute to Artemis , telling him , " Perhaps you will come to better appreciate beauty you cannot yet understand . " For Artemis , playing the flute helped to clear his thoughts . Jarlaxle persuaded him to do so often , believing it would help Artemis free himself of his emotional burdens .

title: Idea
description: Idea Idea was a divination spell that monk s could use to gain a burst of inspiration toward solving a problem . Effects . This spell induced a clarity of thought in the caster that could be used to prompt a memory of a forgotten detail or overlooked clue that was relevant to solving a conundrum .
description_long: Idea Idea was a divination spell that monk s could use to gain a burst of inspiration toward solving a problem . Effects . This spell induced a clarity of thought in the caster that could be used to prompt a memory of a forgotten detail or overlooked clue that was relevant to solving a conundrum . This spell had a cool - down period of six hours before it could be cast again . Components . One gold piece was required to cast this spell , in addition to verbal and somatic components .

title: Identify
description: Identify Identify is a divination spell that determines a single feature of a magic item . Identify is an uncommon spell in the Realms , though not a popular one . Effect .
description_long: Identify Identify is a divination spell that determines a single feature of a magic item . Identify is an uncommon spell in the Realms , though not a popular one . Effect . The spell determines the single most basic function of each magic item , including how to activate that function ( if appropriate ) , and how many charges are left ( if any ) . If a magic item has multiple different functions that are equally basic , " identify " determines the weakest function . Arcane Material Components . A pearl of at least 100 gp value , crushed and stirred into wine with an owl feather ; the infusion must be drunk prior to spellcasting . Arcane History . The Netherese arcanist Trebbe is given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 2271 DR , which back then was called Trebbe ' s scry identify . Divine History . Savras has always granted his priests the use of this spell . Azuth has always granted access to a special version of identify to his priests . The general spell identify has only been known to clerics a couple of years after the Time of Troubles and only to clerics of a god of magic . been known to clerics for as long as there have been god to worship .

title: Ido Kunarakuai
description: Ido Kunarakuai Ido Kunarakuai was a judge in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Ido Kunarakuai was the chief justice of the executive hyojosho court in Uwaji .
description_long: Ido Kunarakuai Ido Kunarakuai was a judge in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Ido Kunarakuai was the chief justice of the executive hyojosho court in Uwaji . He had been in that position for twenty years . He was so totally devoted to his career that he neglected his family . His wife divorced from him in 1347 DR and all his three daughters worked as geisha in Semmishi . Personality . Kunarakuai was a wise and stern man , appreciated by both nobility and commoners for his common sense approach to the law . He greatly regretted the problems with his family .

title: Idolflow
description: Idolflow The Idolflow was a river in eastern Tethyr that fed into the Gorge of the Fallen Idol . Geography . The river was fed by the longer Levast River .
description_long: Idolflow The Idolflow was a river in eastern Tethyr that fed into the Gorge of the Fallen Idol . Geography . The river was fed by the longer Levast River . Both rivers were birthed in the Omlarandin Mountains . The river formed part of the border between County Morninggold and Surkazar . The Idolflow poured into the Gorge of the Fallen Idol and joined the River Ith . History . There was evidence that the river had once been much larger and that a lake once filled the area between its connections with the River Ith and the Levast .

title: Idriane Nethis
description: Idriane Nethis Idriane Nethis was a female human rogue who was an operative for the Shadow Thieves in Beregost . Description . Idriane was tall and thin with shiny black hair and beady dark eyes .
description_long: Idriane Nethis Idriane Nethis was a female human rogue who was an operative for the Shadow Thieves in Beregost . Description . Idriane was tall and thin with shiny black hair and beady dark eyes . Personality . Soft - spoken , Idriane preferred to engage foes indirectly , using distraction and misdirection as her weapons . She was completely loyal to her guild but worried that she would be sacrificed to protect the identity of those she was covering for . Relationships . Her father was noted as being a turnip farmer . Her dusty brown owl familiar was named Xynn and rarely left its perch on her shoulder . History . Idriane was a petty thief living on the outskirts of Soorenar . By her thirteenth winter , she was already the leader of a gang of unscrupulous youths . She later mistook a man as a simple , fat merchant but he turned out to be a Cloakmaster of the Shadow Thieves in disguise ; however , instead of killing her , the Cloakmaster took the young Idriane under his wing and instructed her . Idriane became a foil in Beregost , presenting herself as the lead agent of the Shadow Thieves in that town , but she really only held the rank of Silhouette .

title: Idris
description: Idris Idris was a Netherese necromancer who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . In the village of Ebon Downs on the High Road , she found a powerful artifact known as the Deathknell and with it Idris made pacts with the Barrow Lords of Ebon Downs , seeking to build an army of undead to strike at their Thayan foes . However , the appearance of this undead army alarmed Lord Dagult Neverember , who sent a contingent of his army to stop them , accompanied by Doomguide Vesper Soulhearth .
description_long: Idris Idris was a Netherese necromancer who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . In the village of Ebon Downs on the High Road , she found a powerful artifact known as the Deathknell and with it Idris made pacts with the Barrow Lords of Ebon Downs , seeking to build an army of undead to strike at their Thayan foes . However , the appearance of this undead army alarmed Lord Dagult Neverember , who sent a contingent of his army to stop them , accompanied by Doomguide Vesper Soulhearth . To deal with the situation , Vesper recruited an adventurer to destroy the Deathknell . The adventurer fought and defeated Idris and destroyed the Deathknell , stopping the dead from rising .

title: Ieirithymbul
description: Ieirithymbul Ieirithymbul was a gnome mining village in the western Sword Mountains . Trade . There were rich coal , copper and iron deposits in the area .
description_long: Ieirithymbul Ieirithymbul was a gnome mining village in the western Sword Mountains . Trade . There were rich coal , copper and iron deposits in the area . Defenses . The little - known settlement was guarded by the gold dragon Palarandusk , known as the " Unseen Protector " . Over the years , Ieirithymbul suffered attacks by the Clan Forgebar dwarves , but each time they were defeated by Palarandusk . Inhabitants . In its past , the village had its own heroes : Ardabad , Braeder and Pheldaer .

title: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair
description: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair R . A . Salvatore along with Ed Greenwood , Margaret Weis , and Tracy Hickman had the idea of doing a book together .
description_long: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair R . A . Salvatore along with Ed Greenwood , Margaret Weis , and Tracy Hickman had the idea of doing a book together . Each author would write a novella with their signature characters going through the same challenges . The project never happened , but when Salvatore was offered to write a novella for " " , he was softened to the idea . Summary . Ringo Heffenstone is gathering water for his dwarven companions when he notices a disturbance in the pool . To his peril , he soon comes to find that the disturbance is a large Black dragon rising from the depths . The wyrm Urshula then descended upon the dwarven camp , killing all . Being a dragon , Urshula looted anything valuable from the dwarf corpses . Urshula then looked towards the town of Palischuk and grew enraged that anyone would dare build upon his land . The dragon flew above the city and dived down breathing his acidic breath , drawing a line of devastation on the center of Palischuk before returning to the pool of water and then to his lair . Zhengyi took an interest in Urshula and goes to convince the wyrm to join him .

title: Iftuu
description: Iftuu Iftuu was a drow soldier involved in Vierna Do ' Urden ' s scheme to capture her brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in Mithral Hall . History . In 1357 DR , Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe helped Vierna Do ' Urden track down Drizzt with the aid of Artemis Entreri .
description_long: Iftuu Iftuu was a drow soldier involved in Vierna Do ' Urden ' s scheme to capture her brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in Mithral Hall . History . In 1357 DR , Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe helped Vierna Do ' Urden track down Drizzt with the aid of Artemis Entreri . Death . While on lookout for enemies , Iftuu encountered Thibbledorf Pwent who took a second to decide if the drow was actually Drizzt . Iftuu responded by shooting a hand crossbow at Pwent , causing the battlerager to go into a wild frenzy including biting the dark elf ' s nose and splattering his body against a wall with his spiky armor . As a final touch , Thibbledorf charged the already deceased Iftuu and speared his corpse with his 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) helmet spike .

title: Igan Sokol
description: Igan Sokol Igan Sokol was the quartermaster of Sokol Keep in Phlan until 1489 DR . History . Igan was a scion of the mercantile House Sokol .
description_long: Igan Sokol Igan Sokol was the quartermaster of Sokol Keep in Phlan until 1489 DR . History . Igan was a scion of the mercantile House Sokol . He grew up in Sokol Keep and in time he became the quartermaster of the keep , which serveed as a lighthouse for ships entering Phlan . Harae , a ghost that haunted the keep , somehow befriended Igan . Under Harae ' s hidden suggestions , Igan wanted to restore the shrine to Tyr inside the keep . He also involved in the matter his friend Grim Thornbuck , the leader of the Knights of the Black Fist contingent on the isle in 1489 DR . Out of gratitude , Harae directed Igan , Grim , and fellow Black Fists to a dungeon under the keep that contained treasure . However , when they arrived , Grim and his fellows were filled with greed and Grim killed Igan . This angered both Harae and the undead guardian of the dungeon , which had once been a temple to Dagon . Thus Grim and his fellows were trapped and besieged inside the room . Igan was raised as a zombie to torment Grim until some adventurers hired to solve the mystery of the keep destroyed his mortal remains and sought justice for his homicide . Personality . Igan was a naive individual .

title: Igi Saturo
description: Igi Saturo Igi Saturo was a monk and former samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Saturo was the head of the Igi clan until he retired to become a monk at the Konjo Provincial Monastery .
description_long: Igi Saturo Igi Saturo was a monk and former samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Saturo was the head of the Igi clan until he retired to become a monk at the Konjo Provincial Monastery . Despite being a monk he had three servants for his needs .

title: Igi Tajima
description: Igi Tajima Igi Tajima was the deputy governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Tajima hailed from Igi clan , originally a samurai clan that thanks to good marriage became a branch of the Tsu family .
description_long: Igi Tajima Igi Tajima was the deputy governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Tajima hailed from Igi clan , originally a samurai clan that thanks to good marriage became a branch of the Tsu family . Normally Tajima had to handle the actual civil governing of the province while Tsu Gonsuke was busy with plots in the capital . However , most of his functions were usurped by the shugo - daimyo Niwa Hirotada and Tajima acted as a counselor for Hirotada . For his work , the Niwa head paid him a portion of the taxes from the province . Secretly , Tajima was gathering as many supporters and lands as he could . Personality . Tajima knew well that his power was in constant decline and he had no possibility of opposing Hirotada . His plot was to gather many supporters and lands to one day declare himself an independent daimyo . This ambition had deeply corrupted Tajima . Outwardly , he was very pleasant and trustworthy . Inwardly , he would do anything to reach his goals .

title: Igi clan
description: Igi clan The Igi clan was a samurai clan that became a noble house thanks to a marriage with the Tsu family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They controlled the mokudai position and tried to acquire as many zussho positions as possible . They cared almost nothing about the shogun and shikken , and concentrated their efforts only in Miyama .
description_long: Igi clan The Igi clan was a samurai clan that became a noble house thanks to a marriage with the Tsu family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They controlled the mokudai position and tried to acquire as many zussho positions as possible . They cared almost nothing about the shogun and shikken , and concentrated their efforts only in Miyama .

title: Ignace Dethingeller
description: Ignace Dethingeller Ignace Dethingeller was a Loremaster that is known through his communications to Tethtoril , the First Reader of Candlekeep . In one letter he had journeyed north of Fort Flame to an unnamed island where a the wreckage of a flying ship was discovered . Due to a journal that Dethingeller was able to recover he learned that the ship had been captained by Eartharran Neirdre from Evermeet and that it had crashed after battle with a wing of wyrms .
description_long: Ignace Dethingeller Ignace Dethingeller was a Loremaster that is known through his communications to Tethtoril , the First Reader of Candlekeep . In one letter he had journeyed north of Fort Flame to an unnamed island where a the wreckage of a flying ship was discovered . Due to a journal that Dethingeller was able to recover he learned that the ship had been captained by Eartharran Neirdre from Evermeet and that it had crashed after battle with a wing of wyrms . The journal contained sketches Eartharran Neirdre had made of statues from a floating city that had been abandoned . These statues depicted a race that had both draconic and avian features which Neirdre speculated either belonged to a draconic race that had evolved these features or possibly a race that was a common ancestor to both the dragons and aearee . The city was said to have been protected by a wing of wyrms .

title: Ignar Turc Abolin
description: Ignar Turc Abolin Ignar Turc Abolin was a mage from Kara - Tur who inhabited the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Description . Ignar was gaunt and always garbed in dark robes that shielded his face .
description_long: Ignar Turc Abolin Ignar Turc Abolin was a mage from Kara - Tur who inhabited the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Description . Ignar was gaunt and always garbed in dark robes that shielded his face . Abilities . Ignar was rumored to be a lich and possessed considerable magical power . Possessions . Known magical items in Ignar ' s possession were a " wand of frost " , " ring of free action " , and a " ring of invisibility " . Activities . It was rumored that Ignar was fascinated by flora , particularly roses . It was possible that he was the creator of the mysterious Rose Garden that was located within the Battle of Bones .

title: Ignatia
description: Ignatia Ignatia was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ignatia led the warriors at the temple and commanded the hobgoblin s of the south barracks .
description_long: Ignatia Ignatia was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ignatia led the warriors at the temple and commanded the hobgoblin s of the south barracks . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her .

title: Ignidraco
description: Ignidraco The Ignidraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Ecology . Scholars from Candlekeep theorized that " ignidracos " had an evolved digestive tract that enabled them to regurgitate intestinal gas and ignite it with an enzymatic , hypergolic reaction in the back of their throats , making them capable of breathe out blasts of fire .
description_long: Ignidraco The Ignidraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Ecology . Scholars from Candlekeep theorized that " ignidracos " had an evolved digestive tract that enabled them to regurgitate intestinal gas and ignite it with an enzymatic , hypergolic reaction in the back of their throats , making them capable of breathe out blasts of fire . As the " ignidracos " continued evolving , some of the species began to modify their digestive tracts , developing special gastric enzymes that allowed them to spit acid , exhale corrosive chemicals , and even a chemical substance able to absorb heat to the point of freezing the air and objects around it . History . Scholars believed that " ignidracos " were an evolved strain of the " eodraco " genus . It was theorized that certain species of " ignidracos " developed the first stages of self - awareness and real intelligence , not just the improved animal cunning shown by earlier species of eodracos . A few scholars believed " ignidracos " began to develop the earliest manifestations of the draconic language , although there was not enough evidence to prove anything .

title: Ihtafeer
description: Ihtafeer Ihtafeer was a female rakshasa who posed as Adratha , the potion seller at Druid Grove , after killing the original . She was an enemy of the dao of Khan Zahraa . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward became involved with the dao , who asked him to find and kill Ihtafeer .
description_long: Ihtafeer Ihtafeer was a female rakshasa who posed as Adratha , the potion seller at Druid Grove , after killing the original . She was an enemy of the dao of Khan Zahraa . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward became involved with the dao , who asked him to find and kill Ihtafeer . With the help of the Shadow Thief of Amn Itona , Gorion ' s Ward unveiled Ithafeer ' s true identify and after fighting killed her . Later , Gorion ' s Ward took her head to the dao as proof of her death .

title: Ihundyl
description: Ihundyl Ihundyl was a powerful male wizard who named himself ruler of the Calishar Emirates and was considered one of the most powerful wizards of his age . History . In 223 DR , Ihundyl , the Mad Mage , was exiled from the Calishite city of Volothamp for his monstrous experiments and his inability to control creatures he summoned from the Abyss .
description_long: Ihundyl Ihundyl was a powerful male wizard who named himself ruler of the Calishar Emirates and was considered one of the most powerful wizards of his age . History . In 223 DR , Ihundyl , the Mad Mage , was exiled from the Calishite city of Volothamp for his monstrous experiments and his inability to control creatures he summoned from the Abyss . In 231 DR , the Mad Mage Ihundyl conquered the halfling s of Meiritin and named himself ruler of the Calishar Emirates . The Shoon Empire was unable to send an immediate military response . In the same year , Ihundyl met Elminster Aumar , at the beginning of the young wizard ' s career , and manipulated him in to obtaining for him the magic book of the dead Netherese archmage Ondil . However , thanks to the intervention of Mystra herself , Elminster survived Ihundyl ' s trap but the Mad Mage mocked him . Years later , Elminster , now a powerful wizard , decided to begin his campaign against evil wizards starting with Ihundyl . After a terrible battle , Elminster won but only with the help of Mystra in disguise .

title: Ikemmu
description: Ikemmu Ikemmu was a city located in the Underdark deep under Aglarond . It was unique in that it existed in both the Underdark and the Shadowfell at the same time . There was a portal known as the veil between the Shadowfell and the Prime Material Plane .
description_long: Ikemmu Ikemmu was a city located in the Underdark deep under Aglarond . It was unique in that it existed in both the Underdark and the Shadowfell at the same time . There was a portal known as the veil between the Shadowfell and the Prime Material Plane . The majority of inhabitants in the Underdark section of the city were humans and dwarves while only Shadar - kai or permanent residents were allowed in the Shadowfell section of the city . Because the city was originally built by cloakers it was built vertically rather than horizontally . Since Shadar - kai can teleport through shadows , the vertical layout of the city was not an inconvenience . Ikemmu was first settled by Shadar - kai three generations ago after an unknown catastrophe befell its previous inhabitants . The city ' s current ruler was Uwan . Ikemmu was well - situated to exploit trade between the Underdark and the Shadowfell . There were many shrines to Tempus and a few to Shar throughout the city and Ghaunadaur was worshipped in secret by some residents . The city ' s military consisted solely of Shadar - kai and was led by Uwan . Notable locations .

title: Ikitipsa
description: Ikitipsa Ikitipsa was an evil bent priest ess in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Ikitipsa sent a farastu onto the Sun Trail to stop the Gilded Priest Koyisqatapi , in order to bring down the Azuposi nation .
description_long: Ikitipsa Ikitipsa was an evil bent priest ess in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Ikitipsa sent a farastu onto the Sun Trail to stop the Gilded Priest Koyisqatapi , in order to bring down the Azuposi nation . In 1362 DR , the adventurers of Sozarro ' s expedition defeated the farastu . Later , she conspired with some evil Azuposi and a tribe of ogre s to kill the adventurers .

title: Ilandra Wavemistress
description: Ilandra Wavemistress Ilandra Wavemistress was a half – aquatic elf pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Ilandra was a woman with deeply tanned skin and long , greenish - black hair .
description_long: Ilandra Wavemistress Ilandra Wavemistress was a half – aquatic elf pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Ilandra was a woman with deeply tanned skin and long , greenish - black hair . She usually dressed in a sea - green tunic , with leggings of the same color , and a cape colored deep aqua . Personality . Ilandra was a charismatic leader and a good sailor . She hated Hillsfar for its racist policies and always harassed ships of that city . History . Ilandra was bullied and driven out of Hillsfar for her half - elven heritage , and so she gathered some like - minded people and decided to go into piracy in order to get revenge on the societies that spited them . She become a very good pirate . Her ship was the " Mingledblood " .

title: Ilbaereth
description: Ilbaereth Ilbaereth was an elven house in Neverwinter Woods . Its seal was a pegasus rearing over six wand s . This seal is a combination of the seals of Houses Ealoeth and Ildacer which might suggest a union of these houses created the Ilbaereth line .
description_long: Ilbaereth Ilbaereth was an elven house in Neverwinter Woods . Its seal was a pegasus rearing over six wand s . This seal is a combination of the seals of Houses Ealoeth and Ildacer which might suggest a union of these houses created the Ilbaereth line . Malruthiia Ilbaereth , mother of Tsarra Chaadren , was exiled from the Ilbaereth house on reaching adulthood on account of being an illegitimate child .

title: Ilbratha
description: Ilbratha Ilbratha , also known as the " Mistress of Battles " , Haalorth , the Heir ' s Blade , and " the Warrior ' s Fang " , was an enchanted bronze short sword that had the distinction of being a part of the royal regalia of two kingdoms , to be carried by the heirs of two royal lines : the Forest Kingdom of Cormyr on land and the merfolk kingdom of Eadraal under the sea . It was one of the Cormyrean Swords of State , commissioned by Azoun I and seen as a symbol of his victory over the armies of Shoon . It was also famously wielded by the merfolk princes and princesses of Eadraal for some seven centuries .
description_long: Ilbratha Ilbratha , also known as the " Mistress of Battles " , Haalorth , the Heir ' s Blade , and " the Warrior ' s Fang " , was an enchanted bronze short sword that had the distinction of being a part of the royal regalia of two kingdoms , to be carried by the heirs of two royal lines : the Forest Kingdom of Cormyr on land and the merfolk kingdom of Eadraal under the sea . It was one of the Cormyrean Swords of State , commissioned by Azoun I and seen as a symbol of his victory over the armies of Shoon . It was also famously wielded by the merfolk princes and princesses of Eadraal for some seven centuries . However , the sword was lost to both realms , its whereabouts unknown but still searched for . Description . " Ilbratha " was a bronze short sword and despite many battles , it retained a sharp edge . It had a slightly leaf - shaped blade , a short but ornate cross - guard , and a green hilt . Most distinctively , the blade was inlaid with six matching bloodstone s in its fuller , on the left face . Individually , these bloodstones were worth 70 gold piece s each , and as a set , apart from the sword , they might return 500 – 600 gold pieces .

title: Ilbrost Mythyl
description: Ilbrost Mythyl Ilbrost Mythyl was one of the leading cleric s of Mystra at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ilbrost ' s lack of personal ambition stopped him from rebelling openly against the high priest , Meleghost Starseer .
description_long: Ilbrost Mythyl Ilbrost Mythyl was one of the leading cleric s of Mystra at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ilbrost ' s lack of personal ambition stopped him from rebelling openly against the high priest , Meleghost Starseer . However , he wanted to side with the winning faction , no matter who . Because of this , he monitored the situation closely . Activities . Ilbrost was involved in a conflict in the church over the leadership of Magister Meleghost Starseer , finding himself on the opposing faction .

title: Ilcanorr
description: Ilcanorr Ilcanorr of Luthcheq was a male Turami human and a powerful wizard of Luthcheq who came to reside in the Border Kingdoms realm of Bedorn . Description . He was raven - haired with a handsome appearance and a chin - spike beard .
description_long: Ilcanorr Ilcanorr of Luthcheq was a male Turami human and a powerful wizard of Luthcheq who came to reside in the Border Kingdoms realm of Bedorn . Description . He was raven - haired with a handsome appearance and a chin - spike beard . Personality . Ilcanorr was jaded in his ways . He was known to have a large collection of perfumed and dyed cats . History . Ilcanorr began his career in Luthcheq , and focused on his research and perfecting items known as " sevencirclingwands " , but attacks by rivals and fearful neighbors drove him to move to Bedorn to live a more peaceful life and concentrate on his work . The last pirate landing in the town of Oparl before the mid - 1370s DR was successfully and violently repulsed by Ilcanorr . He sent a flight of gargoyle s out to turn them away .

title: Ildar Orsabbas
description: Ildar Orsabbas Ildar Orsabbas was a famous fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ildar was a stout , fun - loving and somewhat pompous individual .
description_long: Ildar Orsabbas Ildar Orsabbas was a famous fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ildar was a stout , fun - loving and somewhat pompous individual . He enjoyed attending parties in costume as the so - called " Duke of Darkness " , where he could be found making threats , dancing , and seducing others . Activities . Aside from staying in his shop , Orsabbas ' s Fine Imports , Ildar spent most of his time going to parties in costume , where he always wore the guise that earned his namesake . He went to these parties to observe the tapestries , wine , and perfumes , as he specialized in fencing these items . He would buy such things with no questions asked , but if he recognized stolen goods , his prices was very low .

title: Ildibane Nasadra
description: Ildibane Nasadra Ildibane Nasadra was the archmage of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . Ildibane was the twin brother of Aunrae Nasadra .
description_long: Ildibane Nasadra Ildibane Nasadra was the archmage of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . Ildibane was the twin brother of Aunrae Nasadra . When the twins were twelve years old , they forged the Spiderblood Pact . In time , thanks to the pact and his magical power , Ildibane ascended to the position of archmage , becoming the most powerful male of Ched Nasad . In 1372 DR , however , Ildibane was helpless to stop the destruction of his city by the duergar stonefire

title: Ildilyntra Starym
description: Ildilyntra Starym Ildilyntra Starym was the former matriarch of the Starym clan of elves , an old noble house of Cormanthyr . She was a chief opponent of the Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl ' s plan to open Cormanthor to non - elves , and took her own life to form a blood dragon in an attempt to slay the elven ruler . Appearance .
description_long: Ildilyntra Starym Ildilyntra Starym was the former matriarch of the Starym clan of elves , an old noble house of Cormanthyr . She was a chief opponent of the Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl ' s plan to open Cormanthor to non - elves , and took her own life to form a blood dragon in an attempt to slay the elven ruler . Appearance . Ildilyntra was known for her dark eyes that glinted gold when she was full of emotion , and her dark blue - black hair , which she wore unbound and so long it nearly touched the ground . She had perfect blue - white skin that shone brilliantly . Relations . Ildilyntra once had a relationship with the Coronal Eltargrim , though the exact nature of it is not certain , it was likely amorous . Death . Ildilyntra , angered by the Coronal ' s refusal to halt his plans for the Opening ( in which all races could come to Cormanthor and enjoy its beauty ) , took her own life with her honour blade , stabbing herself once in the breast , the neck , and the eye , to form a blood - dragon that would attempt to slay Eltargrim . The Coronal defeated the dragon with magic and her attempt was in vain .

title: Ildomyl
description: Ildomyl Ildomyl was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . He was a friend of Nordryn Spellbinder . History .
description_long: Ildomyl Ildomyl was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . He was a friend of Nordryn Spellbinder . History . In 1358 DR , Ildomyl was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . He was on duty as gate - guardian when he was killed by Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr .

title: Ildool
description: Ildool Lord Ildool was the Crown ' s representative in Marsember , Cormyr . He was widely distrusted because of his alleged dishonesty about taxes , and the Harpers were keeping him in check . Ildool lived at the King ' s Tower .
description_long: Ildool Lord Ildool was the Crown ' s representative in Marsember , Cormyr . He was widely distrusted because of his alleged dishonesty about taxes , and the Harpers were keeping him in check . Ildool lived at the King ' s Tower . He often met with trade delegations from other states such as Sembia , and he was rumoured to be on friendly terms with Thay . Ildool was also rumoured to use the apparently disused shrine to Waukeen as a covert meeting place . He was replaced by Bledryn Scoril after he died sometime between 1368 DR and 1372 DR .

title: Ildriss
description: Ildriss Ildriss , or wind terrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Ildriss were either completely invisible , or they resembled a cloud - like mass with vaporous tentacles and red gleaming eyes .
description_long: Ildriss Ildriss , or wind terrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Ildriss were either completely invisible , or they resembled a cloud - like mass with vaporous tentacles and red gleaming eyes . The color of their cloud form varied slightly . When traveling , ildriss were always invisible . Combat . Ildriss were able to get the initial jump on any creature . When attacking , they transformed into their cloud form , striking out with their tentacles that were hardened by small bits of material . These creatures could only be harmed by magical weapons . Additionally , all air and lightning - based magic was useless against them . Spells of this nature were dispelled when an ildriss came within 50 feet ( 15 m ) of them , including spells with permanent effects . Magical items were immune to this dispelling effect . Habitat / Society . Much like their windy nature , ildriss made and broke relationships with ease . They belonged to dynamic cliques on the Elemental Plane of Air , but were always solitary creatures when encountered on the Prime Material Plane .

title: Ildryn Thallin
description: Ildryn Thallin Ildryn Thallin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was a sly and manipulative magelord .
description_long: Ildryn Thallin Ildryn Thallin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was a sly and manipulative magelord . He agreed with his master Ithboltar to fight together but died in the spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower .

title: Ileuthra
description: Ileuthra Ileuthra was a brass dragon who heeded the call to Protanther ' s council to discuss the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ileuthra was a very ancient dragon , always in search for knowledge and more challenging games .
description_long: Ileuthra Ileuthra was a brass dragon who heeded the call to Protanther ' s council to discuss the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ileuthra was a very ancient dragon , always in search for knowledge and more challenging games . He long wandered the plane s in his research , and legends said that Ileuthra lived for a time with Oghma , the god of knowledge . For his experience , he was chosen to represent his kind in Protanther ' s council . A band of adventurers sent by the Council of Waterdeep convinced him to ally with the humanoid races to stop the Cult ' s plot . Personality . Ileuthra saw good and evil in equal measure among the lesser races . He believed that it was individuals that made the difference between victory and defeat , and a trustworthy individual could be followed , even by dragons .

title: Ilighôn
description: Ilighôn Ilighôn was one of two islands that made up the Eyes of Silvanus on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was situated close to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . It benefited from the protection of reefs and also the magic of the Emerald Enclave .
description_long: Ilighôn Ilighôn was one of two islands that made up the Eyes of Silvanus on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was situated close to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . It benefited from the protection of reefs and also the magic of the Emerald Enclave . The Eyes of Silvanus were formed from mountains when Jhaamdath fell . With the retreat of the waters of the Sea of Fallen Stars , due to the Spellplague , the island became part of mainland Turmish .

title: Ilimitar
description: Ilimitar Ilimitar was an elven Royal Archmage in Cormanthyr at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor . History . When he was young , Ilimitar was an apprentice of the Srinshee .
description_long: Ilimitar Ilimitar was an elven Royal Archmage in Cormanthyr at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor . History . When he was young , Ilimitar was an apprentice of the Srinshee . Later , he became one of the two Supreme Court Wizards in the service of Coronal Eltargrim . However , when Elminster was nominated armathor by the coronal , an insult in his eyes , Ilimitar considered his old master a traitor and tried to kill the Srinshee but after a fierce battle she defeated him .

title: Iliph Thraun
description: Iliph Thraun Illiph Thraun was a lichnee and a lich lord of the Zhentarim involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . Illiph Thraun was a Zhentarim wizard and wielder of the power of " spellfire " .
description_long: Iliph Thraun Illiph Thraun was a lichnee and a lich lord of the Zhentarim involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . Illiph Thraun was a Zhentarim wizard and wielder of the power of " spellfire " . He tried to become a lich to prolong his life but , thanks to his unique condition , the process went awry and Illiph only became a lichnee , a weak form of lich . The wizard Sarhthor tried to use him to subdue Shandril Shessair but she destroyed Illiph Thraun with her " spellfire " .

title: Iliphanar
description: Iliphanar Iliphanar was a trade city in Semphar . Geography . Located at the mouth of the Golden Flow river , this small town drew many who sought their fortune within the Raurin Alta .
description_long: Iliphanar Iliphanar was a trade city in Semphar . Geography . Located at the mouth of the Golden Flow river , this small town drew many who sought their fortune within the Raurin Alta . Appearance . Iliphanar had sheer smooth walls built on a thick earthen ring with a cluster of inns and way - stables surrounding them . Piercing the walls were three gates — Olephzgar ( southeast ) , Parlymzgar ( east ) , and Torrzgar ( northwest ) — that served as both armories and barracks for the Ahrakshar ( the lancers of Iliphanar ) with prison cells below the gate houses . The city had narrow winding streets with four - story " rathra " ( " whitestone " ) buildings connected by " flying bridges " above ground and a " daerath " ( " one - below " ) below ground that served the same purpose . The walls of Iliphanar were built atop a vast series of water reservoirs which are continuously fed by local springs . Economy . Iliphanar lacked the great market of other trade cities ; instead , most business was done in " surroukh " ( restaurants ) or " duthsurouk " ( private restaurants ) located on the lower levels of buildings and common trade is done amongst the shops and carts interspersing them .

title: Iliphar Nelnueve
description: Iliphar Nelnueve Iliphar Nelnueve ( Lord of the Scepters ) was an elven warrior - mage . Appearance . Iliphar had long silver - blond hair , constrained by a circlet with three spikes and an inset amethyst .
description_long: Iliphar Nelnueve Iliphar Nelnueve ( Lord of the Scepters ) was an elven warrior - mage . Appearance . Iliphar had long silver - blond hair , constrained by a circlet with three spikes and an inset amethyst . He has a scar from one temple to his chin , inflicted in combat with the dragon Thauglor . Background . Iliphar ' s powers in battle earned him the respect of the elven House Amaratharr after defeating the dragonkin of Thauglor on numerous occasions . In - 205 DR , Iliphar and a small group of elves met with Thauglor and his seconds Gloriankithsanus and Mistinarperadnacles to settle their differences . Iliphar challenged Thauglor to a Feint of Honor that would become known as The Passing of Power and Thauglor was defeated , causing the elves to lay claim to the Forest Country . In 26 DR , Iliphar brought his elven court to the settlement of Suzail and organised the coronation of Faerlthann Obarskyr , the first king of Cormyr . He appointed Baerauble Etharr as the advisor to the crown . The date of Iliphar ' s death is not known but he died some time before 900 DR . Personality . Iliphar had a quick wit and came across as fearless . Possessions .

title: Iliyanbruen
description: Iliyanbruen Iliyanbruen was an elven survivor - state of Illefarn that encompassed most of Neverwinter Wood . Originally a colony of Illefarn that replaced the vanished Llewyrr colony , it constituted elves who refused to follow their coronal ' s plan to retreat to Evermeet in the face of human ity ' s encroachment on the North . It was known for its help in repelling The Orc Marches from High Vale in - 111 DR and its repelling of Illusk an expansion in - 12 DR before finally falling in 175 DR after spending itself protecting the North against orc s .

title: Iljack
description: Iljack Iljack of the Black Blade was a highwayman of the village of Bambryn in the Vast after the 7th century DR . History . During the early Time of Glorious Fools , after human s first settled the central Vast in the mid – 7th century DR , Iljack of the Black Blade arose to plague the area .
description_long: Iljack Iljack of the Black Blade was a highwayman of the village of Bambryn in the Vast after the 7th century DR . History . During the early Time of Glorious Fools , after human s first settled the central Vast in the mid – 7th century DR , Iljack of the Black Blade arose to plague the area . He robbed itinerant merchants and dwarven metal - dealers , and many sought to trap , ambush , and kill him . But Iljack always escaped , barely avoiding death many times . In retaliation , he would hunt down and assassinate those responsible , no matter how far he had to travel . Finally , Iljack pursued a merchant to Procampur , seeking revenge , but the merchant was to marry a sorceress . Iljack caught his quarry in their bridal bed , but she rose and hurled him out of the window of her tower amid a barrage of " fireball " s . Little more than ashes and a burning sword fell into the water below . Personality . Iljack was a daring and vengeful bandit . Equipment . Iljack wielded a dull black broadsword , from which he gained the moniker " of the Black Blade " . It had magic al powers that somehow allowed Iljack to escape many traps and ambushes .

title: Iljrene Ahbruyn
description: Iljrene Ahbruyn Iljrene Ahbruyn was a drow follower of Qilué Veladorn . Description . Iljrene was described as a " tiny , kitten - soft doll of a priestess " .
description_long: Iljrene Ahbruyn Iljrene Ahbruyn was a drow follower of Qilué Veladorn . Description . Iljrene was described as a " tiny , kitten - soft doll of a priestess " . Activities . Iljrene was a priestess of Eilistraee in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in Skullport . She was also the sub - commander of the Protectors of the Song , the temple guards . History . In 1361 DR , Qiluè agreed to help Liriel Baenre against the Vhaeraun - worshiping Dragon ' s Hoard , sending her warriors , including Iljrene , to attack their headquarters . By 1375 DR Iljrene was one of the sub - commanders of the Protectors of the Song and held the rank of Hand of the Protectors .

title: Ill - Mater
description: Ill - Mater Ill - Mater was a fictional character commonly used by traveling entertainers . Ill - Mater was a clown dressed in a gray costume who was always being whacked , beaten , and pushed over for slapstick entertainment . The Ill - Mater character mocked members of the Church of Ilmater .

title: Illasera
description: Illasera Illasera was one of the group of Bhaalspawn known as the Five . She was the first of them to die by the game ' s protagonist ' s hand after she had been sent to kill them . The game .
description_long: Illasera Illasera was one of the group of Bhaalspawn known as the Five . She was the first of them to die by the game ' s protagonist ' s hand after she had been sent to kill them . The game . Illasera appears right at the beginning of plot of the expansion pack " " . She challenges the player character after a prophecy spoken by the stone heads in the forest . If the player character is accompanied by their party from " " , she will have warriors helping her ; if not , she will attack by herself . Regardless , as the first opponent in the expansion she is not very powerful and only uses relatively weak spells , even though she theoretically knows up to ninth - level ones . Her main mode of attack is by magic . As befits her nickname , she wears the " Baldur ' s Gate " version of Boots of Speed , increasing her movement speed but not her attack speed . She also wears a powerful elven chainmail . Illasera is the only one of the Five who is not indicated as having a small army of her own , though the warriors accompanying her could well be part of one . The novel .

title: Illefarn
description: Illefarn Illefarn was an elven city - state that was founded during the First Flowering in - 22900 DR , survived the Crown Wars , grew into an expansive nation and later fragmented into smaller realms . Geography . Illefarn as a nation at its height , stretched along the Sword Coast , from just south of the settlement of Illusk , itself not far south of the Spine of the World , to the River Delimbiyr .
description_long: Illefarn Illefarn was an elven city - state that was founded during the First Flowering in - 22900 DR , survived the Crown Wars , grew into an expansive nation and later fragmented into smaller realms . Geography . Illefarn as a nation at its height , stretched along the Sword Coast , from just south of the settlement of Illusk , itself not far south of the Spine of the World , to the River Delimbiyr . Its capital was Aelinthaldaar which was built in the shadow of Mount Waterdeep . History . Crown Wars . The city of Illefarn attempted to remain neutral during the turbulent period of the Crown Wars . In - 11800 DR secret safe havens were provided to former Miyeritari citizens by elves of Illefarn . Illefarn managed to survive through the fighting , becoming a powerful realm in the aftermath . The Founding Time . Despite resistance to several orc hordes from out of the Spine of the World mountains , it was the encroachment of humans into Illefarn ' s territory that spurred Syglaeth Audark , Illefarns coronal , to call for a retreat to Evermeet , magically razing Aelinthaldaar in - 1100 DR to remove any proof of its existence .

title: Illistyl Elventree
description: Illistyl Elventree Illistyl Elventree was one of the Knights of Myth Drannor from Shadowdale in 1358 DR . History . Illistyl was born in Shadowdale .
description_long: Illistyl Elventree Illistyl Elventree was one of the Knights of Myth Drannor from Shadowdale in 1358 DR . History . Illistyl was born in Shadowdale . She first met the Knights while they were searching for a weretiger that had killed the thief Alura Durshavin . Doust Sulwood , at that time the Lord of Shadowdale , allowed her to live in the Twisted Tower of Ashaba after her parents died fighting with Zhent forces . She was tutored in the magic arts by Jhessail Silventree and when her teacher became pregnant , Illistyl replaced her among the Knights . After Jhessail ' s child was born , Illistyl quickly stepped down and acted as baby - sitter for the young one while the mother returned to fight . She later took care of the magical needs of the Dalesfolk in place of the deceased Sylune .

title: Illithid body tamer
description: Illithid body tamer The Illithid Body Tamer was a special prestige class of the illithids that focused on martial skill over psionic prowess . Illithid Body Tamers followed a discipline called the " Tamer Creed " which said that only a potent military force would ensure Illithid society ' s future existence . They maintained that only by abstaining from psionics will they strengthen their considerably frail bodies sufficiently enough to become accomplished fighters .

title: Illithocyte
description: Illithocyte Illithocyte were illithid tadpoles that survived the fall of a mind flayer empire , and evolved into a new life form . They crawled about in groups seeking psychic radiation on which to feed . Following the demise of the city of Ch ' Chitl , illithocytes appeared in the surrounding areas of the Underdark as a consequence of the death of the city ' s elder brain .

title: Illitran Starym
description: Illitran Starym Lord Illitran Starym was Lord Speaker of the Starym clan . He infamously forged a pact with Moander in order to fool his Moonblade and retain power over the house . In 523 DR , a branch of moon elven ex - patriate members of the Starym Clan returned to Myth Drannor to reclaim the house and return it to glory .
description_long: Illitran Starym Lord Illitran Starym was Lord Speaker of the Starym clan . He infamously forged a pact with Moander in order to fool his Moonblade and retain power over the house . In 523 DR , a branch of moon elven ex - patriate members of the Starym Clan returned to Myth Drannor to reclaim the house and return it to glory . The return drew the line of succession into question , as the heir at the time , Josidiah Starym , was away on a mission to find the lost Warblade since 500 DR . The Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl demanded that the current Lord Speaker , Illitran , draw his family ' s Moonblade to prove his worthiness and preserve Josidiah ' s heir status . Determined to draw the blade successfully , Illitran set out on a three - month trek through the woods intended to purify his soul and clense his spirit . Unknown to all , he actually visited the ruins of Moander ' s temple in the northern forest , where he forged a pact with the imprisoned god , gaining the ability to cancel the powers of the sword that would deem him unworthy of Lordship .

title: Illius
description: Illius Illius was a sorcerer during the 14th century DR . He used a staff and a formidable array of magical powers , as well as a set of force beads he used in combat . Illius was born into a line of knight s , but when he discovered that he had sorcerous powers he pursued that path instead .
description_long: Illius Illius was a sorcerer during the 14th century DR . He used a staff and a formidable array of magical powers , as well as a set of force beads he used in combat . Illius was born into a line of knight s , but when he discovered that he had sorcerous powers he pursued that path instead . His father disapproved of this and disowned Illius , though it was later discovered that Ygorl had mentally influenced Illius ' father from inside the Demon Stone . Illius adventured with Rhannek and Zhai . Appendix . Behind the scenes . He is voiced by .

title: Illul
description: Illul Illul is a city in the island - kingdom of Lantan . It is situated on the southern shore of the main island . Overview .
description_long: Illul Illul is a city in the island - kingdom of Lantan . It is situated on the southern shore of the main island . Overview . The High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration in Illul is the center of Gond worship in the realms . This monastery is run by Danactar the High Artificer , Most Holy Servant of Gond . Danactar is the highest ranking mortal cleric of Gond . He is the supreme voice in ecclesiastical matters and he serves in Lantan ' s ruling council , the Ayrorch . The church of Gond consists mostly of wandering clerics who travel from settlement to settlement , finding work as artisans and engineers . Settling in one area is only encouraged in centers for innovation that warrant constant observation , such as Zhentil Keep , Waterdeep , Athkatla , and Suzail . The church encourages wealth , as it demonstrates the benefits of following Gond . As they travel , clerics take samples of any inventions they discover and assist innovators they encounter , filing regular reports to their superiors .

title: Illuminated
description: Illuminated The Illuminated were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan led the 50 , 000 soldiers of the Illuminated .
description_long: Illuminated The Illuminated were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan led the 50 , 000 soldiers of the Illuminated . Activities . The Illuminated served as constables for the City of Brass , patrolling the city and enforcing curfews . They walked through the streets each night , pounding drums and announcing the start of the curfew . Curfew violations were punished harshly . First - time offenders were arrested and fined . Offenders caught a second time lost a hand and third - time offenders were executed . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Illuminated .

title: Illumor Sendever
description: Illumor Sendever Illumor Sendever was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and worked at Sendever ' s Stables . In this capacity , he bought and sold horse s , provided veterinary care to them , and rented out stables for them .
description_long: Illumor Sendever Illumor Sendever was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and worked at Sendever ' s Stables . In this capacity , he bought and sold horse s , provided veterinary care to them , and rented out stables for them . Sendever ran his stables by 1358 DR , and was still in business through 1369 DR and in 1374 DR . He was an aging man in 1374 DR .

title: Illusion
description: Illusion The Illusion school includes spells that deceive the senses or minds of others . They cause people to see things that are not there , not see things that are there , hear phantom noises , or remember things that never happened . Among these spells are included " invisibility " and " disguise self " .
description_long: Illusion The Illusion school includes spells that deceive the senses or minds of others . They cause people to see things that are not there , not see things that are there , hear phantom noises , or remember things that never happened . Among these spells are included " invisibility " and " disguise self " . A wizard who specializes in the schools of illusion is referred to as an illusionist .

title: Illusionist
