description: Illusionist An illusionist is a wizard specializing in illusion magic . Illusion spells create false images and other sensory tricks . Illusionists can make ghostly sounds to distract opponents , conjure visionary beasts , or create a wall that does not actually exist .
description_long: Illusionist An illusionist is a wizard specializing in illusion magic . Illusion spells create false images and other sensory tricks . Illusionists can make ghostly sounds to distract opponents , conjure visionary beasts , or create a wall that does not actually exist . Illusionists are a specialty Wizard class . Illusionists write their spells in a secret language called Ruathlek . Spell Potency . The power of an illusionist is that the victim feels , and therefore thinks , the illusion is real . Once the combatant realizes the the illusion is fake it holds no power . This is harder than it sounds though for the images invoke strong feelings that support belief of the illusion . When an illusion is still belived to be real it does the same damage as the real subject of the illusion would do .

title: Illuskan
description: Illuskan Illuskan was the name usually given to human s who lived in the Sword Coast North . They were also known as Northlanders . Illuskans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Physical description .
description_long: Illuskan Illuskan was the name usually given to human s who lived in the Sword Coast North . They were also known as Northlanders . Illuskans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Physical description . Illuskans were tall , fair skinned people . Most had blue or steel gray eyes . Those living on the islands in the Trackless Sea and Icewind Dale had more blonde hair , and slightly less red and brown . Those in the Sword Coast North and surrounding lands had more raven black hair , from their significant Netherese heritage .

title: Illuskan language
description: Illuskan language Illuskan was an ethnic human language spoken in northwest Faerûn , largely by Illuskan s . Speakers . Illuskan was commonly used as a " lingua franca " along the Sword Coast North , in addition to the ubiquitous Common .
description_long: Illuskan language Illuskan was an ethnic human language spoken in northwest Faerûn , largely by Illuskan s . Speakers . Illuskan was commonly used as a " lingua franca " along the Sword Coast North , in addition to the ubiquitous Common . Other regions where it was commonly spoken included Mintarn , the Moonshaes , Ruathym , and among the Uthgardt . Dialects . There were three major dialects of Illuskan . Moonshae was spoken by the Ffolk and the Northlander s of the Moonshae Isles . Ruathen was spoken in Ruathym , and True Luskan was the dialect of the city - state of Luskan . Bothii , the language of the Uthgardt , was treated by some as a dialect of Illuskan . Script . Like the majority of Faerûn ' s human tongues , Illuskan used the Thorass alphabet . History . Illuskan was in the Illuski language group , the same family language as Bothii and Reghedjic . It derived from Old Illuskan and was strongly influenced by Netherese . Examples . Common Illuskan surnames included Brightwood , Helder , Hornraven , Lackman , Stonar , Stormwind , and Winddrivver . Common male names included Ander , Blath , Bran , Frath , Geth , Lander , Luth , Malcer , Stor , Taman , and Urth .

title: Illuski languages
description: Illuski languages The Illuski language group was a linguistic group that included the languages of the Northmen . Illuski languages were spoken in Ruathym and Luskan and from the islands as far north as the Uttersea south to the Moonshae Isles and Mintarn . Languages .
description_long: Illuski languages The Illuski language group was a linguistic group that included the languages of the Northmen . Illuski languages were spoken in Ruathym and Luskan and from the islands as far north as the Uttersea south to the Moonshae Isles and Mintarn . Languages . Illuski languages included the following : Script . Like the majority of other Faerûnian languages , modern Illuski languages made use of the Thorass alphabet , although Old Illuskan had its own script . Appendix . Inspiration . The Illuski language group is based on real - life languages such as , , and .

title: Illusory ambush
description: Illusory ambush Illusory ambush is an illusion spell similar to a simplified and easier to master version of the " phanstasmal killer " spell . " Illusory ambush " is learned by wizard s , particularly those who wish to become illusionists . When cast , " illusory ambush " manifests a small number of illusory assailants at a location within fifty feet of the wizard , who seem to attack an intended target , distracting him or her from their own assault against the wizard .
description_long: Illusory ambush Illusory ambush is an illusion spell similar to a simplified and easier to master version of the " phanstasmal killer " spell . " Illusory ambush " is learned by wizard s , particularly those who wish to become illusionists . When cast , " illusory ambush " manifests a small number of illusory assailants at a location within fifty feet of the wizard , who seem to attack an intended target , distracting him or her from their own assault against the wizard . So realistic is this illusion that those who fail to see through it are actually injured in the process of fighting off the phantasmal attackers . The illusion does not last long but can be recast at any time .

title: Illusory script
description: Illusory script Illusory script , or illusionary script , was an illusion spell that disguised a written message and compelled non - authorized viewers with a brief " suggestion " for a short time . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the message had to be written with a lead - based ink costing no less than 50 gp .
description_long: Illusory script Illusory script , or illusionary script , was an illusion spell that disguised a written message and compelled non - authorized viewers with a brief " suggestion " for a short time . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the message had to be written with a lead - based ink costing no less than 50 gp .

title: Illusory wall
description: Illusory wall Illusory wall or illusionary wall ( originally , Toscudlo ' s illusionary wall ) was a mid - power illusionist spell , that created the false figment of a wall for persons to hide behind . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create a visual illusion of a wall or similar surface , such as a ceiling or floor .
description_long: Illusory wall Illusory wall or illusionary wall ( originally , Toscudlo ' s illusionary wall ) was a mid - power illusionist spell , that created the false figment of a wall for persons to hide behind . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create a visual illusion of a wall or similar surface , such as a ceiling or floor . The illusion was visually perfect , but solid objects passed through it effortlessly . The surface could be placed anywhere within close range and it could have dimensions up to one inch in width by ten feet in length by ten feet in height . Once created , the illusion was permanent unless dispelled . Components . Only verbal and somatic component s were required to cast this spell . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Toscudlo in −1550 DR .

title: Illydia Maethellyn
description: Illydia Maethellyn Illydia Maethellyn was a moon elf cleric of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . She had the markings of lightning damage on her arms .
description_long: Illydia Maethellyn Illydia Maethellyn was a moon elf cleric of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . She had the markings of lightning damage on her arms . Personality . Faith kept her hopeful and focused . Relationships . She had a close friend and defender in Larethar Gulgrin . History . During her life , Illydia saw great suffering , but Sehanine gave her purpose . She used her bow and her divine powers to make up for past mistakes . Appendix . Background . Illydia is a companion in the " Sword Coast Legends " game .

title: Illyth Fleetwood
description: Illyth Fleetwood Illyth Fleetwood is a noblewoman living outside the city of Ravens Bluff at Woodenhall manor , the home of the Fleetwood family . Despite her noble status , Illyth is an accomplished scholar and has an extensive personal library . She is not currently married and delights in activities such as the Game of Masks .
description_long: Illyth Fleetwood Illyth Fleetwood is a noblewoman living outside the city of Ravens Bluff at Woodenhall manor , the home of the Fleetwood family . Despite her noble status , Illyth is an accomplished scholar and has an extensive personal library . She is not currently married and delights in activities such as the Game of Masks . She is also fast friends with Jack Ravenwild .

title: Ilmara
description: Ilmara Ilmara was a queen of Impiltur and the third ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Ilmara was the only daughter of King Imphras I and Queen Sambral .
description_long: Ilmara Ilmara was a queen of Impiltur and the third ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Ilmara was the only daughter of King Imphras I and Queen Sambral . Her elder brother was Imbrar I . In 1167 DR , in her early 40s , Ilmara finally married . Her husband was Rilaun of Sarshel , a man half her age . Their son was named Imphras II . History . Born in 1104 DR , Ilmara was a sorceress like her mother and was tutored under Mhilra of Milvarune . As Princess , Ilmara discovered the Scrying Stones of Myth Drannor . With them , she founded Ilmwatch , from which she watched for any sign of the return of the hobgoblin hordes that had been defeated by her father . The hobgoblins did return . When she saw them through the stones in 1127 DR , her brother , King Imbrar , took an army to the Giantspire Mountains to defeat them . The king , his men , and the hobgoblins were never seen again . Ilmara took the crown with sorrow . Upon the birth of her son from her late marriage in 1169 DR , her husband became angry when she named her new son heir instead of him . He tried to take the throne by force but was killed .

title: Ilmater
description: Ilmater Ilmater ( pronounced " Ihl - MAY - ter " or " ill - " may " - ter " ) was an intermediate deity of the Faerûnian pantheon whose portfolio included endurance , martyrdom , perseverance , and suffering . He was the god of those who suffered , the oppressed , and the persecuted , who offered them relief and support , encouraged them to endure , and who encouraged others to help them , to take their burdens or take their places . He was called the Crying God , the Broken God , the Lord on the Rack , and the One Who Endures .
description_long: Ilmater Ilmater ( pronounced " Ihl - MAY - ter " or " ill - " may " - ter " ) was an intermediate deity of the Faerûnian pantheon whose portfolio included endurance , martyrdom , perseverance , and suffering . He was the god of those who suffered , the oppressed , and the persecuted , who offered them relief and support , encouraged them to endure , and who encouraged others to help them , to take their burdens or take their places . He was called the Crying God , the Broken God , the Lord on the Rack , and the One Who Endures . To the Iulutiun people of the Great Glacier , he was known as Ayuruk , and to the Angulutiun people he was Itishikopak . Description . In avatar form , Ilmater appeared as a short man with a burly build and wearing only a breechcloth , with a plain but kind and comforting face , balding head , and a hairy body . But this body bore the marks of mutilation and torture on the rack , covered with open cuts , closed scars , burns , and a range of other wounds . Ilmater ' s joints were broken , his limbs were ravaged , and his hands were smashed yet still functional . Moving caused him a great deal of pain as he dragged himself around .

title: Ilmater ' s fist
description: Ilmater ' s fist Ilmater ' s fist was a divine evocation spell that conjured an ethereal fist to strike a foe . Effect . The spell produced a spectral fist that flew through the air to strike a chosen foe , delivering as much injury as the caster had suffered in the last minute or so , before disappearing .
description_long: Ilmater ' s fist Ilmater ' s fist was a divine evocation spell that conjured an ethereal fist to strike a foe . Effect . The spell produced a spectral fist that flew through the air to strike a chosen foe , delivering as much injury as the caster had suffered in the last minute or so , before disappearing . It was unavoidable and could go around barriers . It functioned similarly to the " fangs of retribution " spell . History . The " Ilmater ' s fist " spell was naturally associated with the god Ilmater . It appeared within the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the church of Ilmater , which first appeared in the Realms in 848 DR .

title: Ilmeth
description: Ilmeth Ilmeth was the grim , yet fair Lord of Essembra . He was somewhat obsessed with commanding Battledale ' s army known as the Lord ' s Men . Lord Ilmeth barely tolerated adventurers in his presence , so long as they remained out of his way .
description_long: Ilmeth Ilmeth was the grim , yet fair Lord of Essembra . He was somewhat obsessed with commanding Battledale ' s army known as the Lord ' s Men . Lord Ilmeth barely tolerated adventurers in his presence , so long as they remained out of his way . War - Chancellor Ilmeth was an accomplished warrior . He inherited the lordship of Essembra in 1351 DR . Disputes and justice were traditionally resolved by the lord of Essembra . Ilmeth disliked this duty , but tried to be as fair as possible .

title: Ilmeth Waelvur
description: Ilmeth Waelvur Ilmeth Waelvur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Ilmeth was a hard - drinking and sullen man .
description_long: Ilmeth Waelvur Ilmeth Waelvur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Ilmeth was a hard - drinking and sullen man . He cared nothing for the troubles of others . Activities . Ilmeth ran the Waelvur ' s Wagonworks . He was one of the Believers , and his objective was to use the group ' s influence to run his hated rivals of Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys out of business . History . In 1491 DR , one of the carpenters of Ilmeth ' s shop named Stannor noticed his employer and some others sometimes disappear into a hidden tunnel . That same year , under secret suggestions from Larrakh of the Cult of Black Earth , Ilmeth , along with Marlandro Gaelkur and Albaeri Mellikho , killed some people in order to protect the secret of the Believers . After his crimes were discovered by some adventurers , Ilmeth confessed in tears .

title: Ilmra
description: Ilmra Ilmra was a drow apprentice wizard in Ched Nasad . History . Ilmra was one of the few female drow who decided to study as a wizard in the Arcane Conservatory .
description_long: Ilmra Ilmra was a drow apprentice wizard in Ched Nasad . History . Ilmra was one of the few female drow who decided to study as a wizard in the Arcane Conservatory . She was a classmate of Q ' arlynd Melarn . One day , she was about to fail a magic test in reading auras when Q ' arlynd suggested the correct answer to her . However , Ilmra , instead of thanking , Q ' arlynd reported the event to their instructor , admitting her failure as well . In 1379 DR , Q ' arlynd remember her as his first lesson in not trusting anyone .

title: Ilmurk Jongrath
description: Ilmurk Jongrath Ilmurk Jongrath was a miller and rancher in the county of Bardshyr in southwestern Tethyr , owner of Jongrath ' s Mill . Personality . Ilmurk was an honest entrepreneur with a roguish streak .
description_long: Ilmurk Jongrath Ilmurk Jongrath was a miller and rancher in the county of Bardshyr in southwestern Tethyr , owner of Jongrath ' s Mill . Personality . Ilmurk was an honest entrepreneur with a roguish streak . He did not display his modest wealth but rather kept it hidden and even misrepresented some of his assets . Abilities . Jongrath was primarily a miller and could operate and repair his mill with only the help of draft animals , although he had to hire stonemasons to make grinding wheels . He was experienced in animal husbandry and kept livestock . In his spare time , he liked to design and paint heraldic devices and would adorn shields , coach doors , and other non - fabric equipment for a few gold coins . Possessions . Ilmurk owned Jongrath ' s Mill and the adjoining cottage , stables , and the surrounding land . He kept livestock and had heavy draft horses that turned the mill and pumped water from a deep well . He built up a cache of spare millstones and cogwheels that he kept hidden under flour sacks after claiming they were broken .

title: Ilmwatch
description: Ilmwatch Ilmwatch was a large fortress that protected the infamous Buzzard Beak Harbor found on the northern end of the Easting Reach . Activities . Ilmwatch was large enough to easily support several hundred troops .
description_long: Ilmwatch Ilmwatch was a large fortress that protected the infamous Buzzard Beak Harbor found on the northern end of the Easting Reach . Activities . Ilmwatch was large enough to easily support several hundred troops . The soldiers were tasked with protecting merchants traveling to and from Damara as well as those who crossed the Easting Reach to Uthmerg . Patrols regularly scouted the surrounding land , ranging as far as Uthmerg to ensure the safety of the region . Troops of Ilmwatch often accompanied merchants heading south along the Merchant ' s Run and Herald ' s Road to the fortress .

title: Ilneval
description: Ilneval Ilneval ( pronounced " ill " - nev - all ) is a lesser deity of the Orc pantheon . A cunning war leader inspiring great loyalty in his followers , he is very diligent in planning his strategies for victory . He is considered the patron of orc crossbreeds , such as orogs and tanarukks .
description_long: Ilneval Ilneval ( pronounced " ill " - nev - all ) is a lesser deity of the Orc pantheon . A cunning war leader inspiring great loyalty in his followers , he is very diligent in planning his strategies for victory . He is considered the patron of orc crossbreeds , such as orogs and tanarukks . The Church of Ilneval occupies a prominent position in Orc tribal life , second only to the church of Gruumsh , and they work in concert to oppress other faiths in order to ensure that position remains unchallenged . Many members of the clergy are officers in tribal armies , answering only to their chieftain . Although the church of Gruumsh is responsible for the issuing the call to summon the horde , it falls to the temple of Ilneval to marshal the fractious tribes into a horde united against a common foe . Clerics and adepts of Ilneval pray for their spells at dusk in preparations for the nights battles . The church of Ilneval observes few holy days , other than token of obeisance to those honoring Gruumsh in a calculated display of loyalty to the One - Eyed God , for Ilneval is not interested in remembering past victories but plotting new ones to come .

title: Ilnezhara
description: Ilnezhara Ilnezhara was a copper dragon who lived in the Bloodstone Lands . Description . Her human form was that of an attractive woman with a shock of thick , copper - colored hair and huge blue eyes .
description_long: Ilnezhara Ilnezhara was a copper dragon who lived in the Bloodstone Lands . Description . Her human form was that of an attractive woman with a shock of thick , copper - colored hair and huge blue eyes . She was often dressed in the finest of threads . Her figure was straight , tall , and slender . History . The dragon was centuries old by 1368 DR . She had a sister , Tazmikella , with whom she crawled from her egg in the great deserts of Calimshan . She and her sister were once approached by Zhengyi , the Witch - King , with the offer of immortality in lichdom if they served beside his conquering armies . The dragon sisters declined that offer . In 1368 DR , Ilnezhara was operating a shop at Wall ' s Around in Heliogabalus called " Ilnezhara ' s Gold Coins " . In 1484 DR , Ilnezhara was posing as the human " Lady Zee , " the owner of a curiosity shop called A Pocketful of Zzzzs at Wall ' s Around in Helgabal . That year , the drow Jarlaxle approached her and her sister , requesting them to help him in the events surrounding the Darkening and the involvement of several white dragon s . Relationships . For some time she was the lover of the drow mercenary Jarlaxle .

title: Ilnger Obskoth
description: Ilnger Obskoth Ilnger Obskoth was a male priest of Ilmater in the 9th century DR . He was the high priest of the Ilmatari town of Carathryn in the Purple Hills of Tethyr . One morning in the Year of the Vigilant Familiar , 848 DR , the " Tome of Torment " appeared on the altar of Ilmater in Carathryn .
description_long: Ilnger Obskoth Ilnger Obskoth was a male priest of Ilmater in the 9th century DR . He was the high priest of the Ilmatari town of Carathryn in the Purple Hills of Tethyr . One morning in the Year of the Vigilant Familiar , 848 DR , the " Tome of Torment " appeared on the altar of Ilmater in Carathryn . The Ilmatari told the story that Ilmater himself had placed it there . Ilnger Obskoth proclaimed it as " the hand of holy Ilmater made manifest among us " , and it swiftly became the most venerated sacred object in Carathryn .

title: Ilsensine
description: Ilsensine Ilsensine was the patron deity of the illithid s , though not their creator . It was also the patron of evil mage s and psionic ists who dominated the minds of others . Its true appearance was as a disembodied brain of emerald color that trailed countless ganglion - like tentacles .
description_long: Ilsensine Ilsensine was the patron deity of the illithid s , though not their creator . It was also the patron of evil mage s and psionic ists who dominated the minds of others . Its true appearance was as a disembodied brain of emerald color that trailed countless ganglion - like tentacles . Ilsensine was cold and calculating , using magic and its psionic strength in a merciless combination to manipulate events as it saw fit . It used its psionics to gather information as well , pulling it from the minds of all mortals within the Prime Material Plane and beyond . Worshipers . Besides illithids , any who sought to dominate and enslave the minds of others may have felt drawn towards Ilsensine . It offered power and control to those faithful to it , along with access to the Mind domain of divine magic . Its clerics were known as accomplished slavemasters , using both magic and psionics to control living and undead slaves alike . History . Ilsensine made itself known in the Realms immediately following the duergar uprising against the illithids in approximately - 4000 DR .

title: Ilserv
description: Ilserv Ilserv , also known as Ilserv of the Illithids , was a mind flayer sage in Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . History . Ilserv originally acted as an emissary and ambassador of Ch ' Chitl to the surface until , by accident , the beholder crime lord Xanathar petrified him .
description_long: Ilserv Ilserv , also known as Ilserv of the Illithids , was a mind flayer sage in Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . History . Ilserv originally acted as an emissary and ambassador of Ch ' Chitl to the surface until , by accident , the beholder crime lord Xanathar petrified him . For many years , Ilserv was one of the statues in a rock garden near Mirt ' s mansion . However , Ilserv maintained a little awareness and psychic power . Finally , in 1367 DR , Ilserv dominated the mind of a wizard guest of Mirt who reversed the transformation . Immediately , Ilserv returned to Ch ' Chitl , refusing to ever go back to the surface . Thereafter , he was considered the city ' s sage about all surface matters , thanks to knowledge gleaned from reading minds in the garden .

title: Ilsevele Miritar
description: Ilsevele Miritar Lady Ilsevele Miritar is a sun elf spellarcher from the Queen ' s Guard in Evermeet and was the partner and betrothed of Araevin Teshurr until the couple parted ways when Ilsevele fell in love with the resurrected Fflar Starbrow Melruth whom she eventually wed . She has a fine gray destrier named Swiftwind . She worked with her father on the Elven Crusade to Myth Drannor , and after his death took up leadership of the Army of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Ilsevele Miritar Lady Ilsevele Miritar is a sun elf spellarcher from the Queen ' s Guard in Evermeet and was the partner and betrothed of Araevin Teshurr until the couple parted ways when Ilsevele fell in love with the resurrected Fflar Starbrow Melruth whom she eventually wed . She has a fine gray destrier named Swiftwind . She worked with her father on the Elven Crusade to Myth Drannor , and after his death took up leadership of the Army of Myth Drannor . After she defeated the armies of Scyllua Darkhope , she was visited by the Srinshee and granted the Rulers ' Blade , becoming seventh Coronal of the rebuilt realm of Cormanthyr with Fflar as her consort . After the destruction of Myth Drannor in 1487 DR , Ilsevele and Fflar led their people to Semberholme . Appearance . Ilsevele is pale with copper - colored hair . Relatives . Ilsevele ' s mother and father are Ilyyela Miritar and Seiveril Miritar respectively . Both are deceased . Equipment . Ilsevele carries a magical bow crafted from deep red yew . She wears magical leather armor strengthened with steel rings , which is appropriate for a captain of the spellarchers . She also carries a pair of fine elven short sword s .

title: Ilshara Naerthskul
description: Ilshara Naerthskul Ilshara Naerthskul was a thief in the Ten Towns in 1370 DR . Activities . Ilshara was an infamous thief who specialized in working on rooftops , minarets , and chimneys and in the theft of diamond s , coins , magical item s , and any kind of weapon .
description_long: Ilshara Naerthskul Ilshara Naerthskul was a thief in the Ten Towns in 1370 DR . Activities . Ilshara was an infamous thief who specialized in working on rooftops , minarets , and chimneys and in the theft of diamond s , coins , magical item s , and any kind of weapon . History . In 1369 DR , the wizard Orlmar of Baldur ' s Gate caught her . Ilshara escaped and nobody saw her again . By 1370 DR , she had apparently resurfaced , reporting to be living in a villa in Caer - Konig as Istara , wife of a fishmonger and having the abilities of a practiced wizard .

title: Ilstan Narbrace
description: Ilstan Narbrace Ilstan Narbrace was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Narbrace and other five Dragons acted as escort to the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .
description_long: Ilstan Narbrace Ilstan Narbrace was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Narbrace and other five Dragons acted as escort to the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember . Narbrace was the last to be killed by the death knight Targrael , who was under the orders of Manshoon .

title: Ilthan
description: Ilthan Ilthan was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Its natives were cyclops es who herded sheep . Its main feature was a large ruined city at the center of the island .
description_long: Ilthan Ilthan was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Its natives were cyclops es who herded sheep . Its main feature was a large ruined city at the center of the island . A legend told that vengeful gods destroyed it . Pirates used the handful of harbors on the southern shores of the island on a temporary basis .

title: Iltharagh
description: Iltharagh Iltharagh , also known as Golden Night , was a unique topaz dragon dracolich living near Luskan who worked with the Cult of the Dragon in 1370 DR . History . Iltharagh was a very old topaz dragon who laired near the City of the Sails .
description_long: Iltharagh Iltharagh , also known as Golden Night , was a unique topaz dragon dracolich living near Luskan who worked with the Cult of the Dragon in 1370 DR . History . Iltharagh was a very old topaz dragon who laired near the City of the Sails . He fought many aerial battles against the white dragon Arveiaturace , all time reducing both rivals greatly wounded . However the white sightly look more powerful . In despair Iltharagh accept the Cult ' s offer and underwent the ritual to become a dracolich in the Year of the Wave ( 1364 DR ) .

title: Iltharl Obarskyr
description: Iltharl Obarskyr King Iltharl Obarskyr was crowned King of Cormyr in 242 DR . Appearance . Iltharl usually dressed in immaculate robes .
description_long: Iltharl Obarskyr King Iltharl Obarskyr was crowned King of Cormyr in 242 DR . Appearance . Iltharl usually dressed in immaculate robes . He also had a ceremonial bronze breastplate and leg guards , with fantastic beasts in relief . He wore the Crown of Faerlthann , the crown given to Faerlthann Obarskyr by Iliphar Nelnueve . Relatives . Iltharl ' s father was Boldovar Obarskyr . He was married . His sister was Gantharla Obarskyr . Background . Iltharl enjoyed the arts , including sculpture , painting and music . He also enjoyed hosting parties and feasts . This led to the feeling that he did not make enough decisions , nor did he let others make them . He was unable to have a child with his wife . In 245 DR , just three years into his reign , Iltharl became aware of a plot to replace him by marrying his sister Gantharla to Kallimar Bleth and waiting for them to produce a male heir . This led him to reconsider his position as king , and chose to abdicate to Gantharla , making her the first queen of Cormyr , although this was not an easy thing for him to find the courage to do .

title: Ilthond
description: Ilthond Ilthond was a Zhentarim wizard who was one of the leaders of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Ilthond was a wizard in the Zhentarim and an apprentice and loyal follower of Manshoon .
description_long: Ilthond Ilthond was a Zhentarim wizard who was one of the leaders of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Ilthond was a wizard in the Zhentarim and an apprentice and loyal follower of Manshoon . In 1357 DR , he was briefly involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair , helping his wounded master after a fight with Shandril . He also tried to capture Shandril but only barely managed to save himself from her " spellfire " . In later years , he was relocated to Dagger Falls as one of the senior wizard assigned to the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale . In 1369 DR , Ilthond was involved in the kidnapping of Daggerdale ' s rightful heir and freedom fighter leader Randal Morn . Ilthond had a skirmish with the adventurers recruited to free Randal and with the powerful arch - shadow Gothyl . During the final battle for the liberation of the Dale , Ilthond was attacked and consumed by Gothyl .

title: Ilthor
description: Ilthor Ilthor was a sea captain of Aglarond . Activities . Ilthor sailed with her ship , the " Windsinger " , around the Sea of Fallen Stars , in particular from Sembia to Aglarond .
description_long: Ilthor Ilthor was a sea captain of Aglarond . Activities . Ilthor sailed with her ship , the " Windsinger " , around the Sea of Fallen Stars , in particular from Sembia to Aglarond . History . In 1374 DR , Araevin Teshurr ' s party boarded Ilthor ' s ship in order to arrive quickly in Aglarond .

title: Ilthuryn
description: Ilthuryn Ilthuryn was a male elf mage who murdered Lady Alauthshaee . History . Ilthuryn attempted to court the famously wealthy and haughty Lady Alauthshaee , but she rejected him harshly .
description_long: Ilthuryn Ilthuryn was a male elf mage who murdered Lady Alauthshaee . History . Ilthuryn attempted to court the famously wealthy and haughty Lady Alauthshaee , but she rejected him harshly . Enraged , Ilthuryn attacked her with wild spell s as she rode in her flying carriage . It reportedly crashed to earth within Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast . Ilthuryn then buried the carriage , the guards , and Alauthshaee herself alive . An apparent side - effect of Ilthuryn ' s reckless spellcasting was a dead - magic zone over the valley .

title: Iltkazar
description: Iltkazar Iltkazar ( the Mithral Kingdom ) was a subterranean dwarven realm , originally one of the eight sub - kingdoms of Shanatar , and known for its stone carving and engineering . The term " Iltkazar " came to describe more than just the original sub - kingdom , and by - 1900 DR it was used to describe a sub - kingdom of Calimshan . The Shanataran sub - kingdoms of Barakuir , Drakkalor , Holorarar and Ultoksamrin were located in Iltkazar , as well as Zokir , City of Orbs .
description_long: Iltkazar Iltkazar ( the Mithral Kingdom ) was a subterranean dwarven realm , originally one of the eight sub - kingdoms of Shanatar , and known for its stone carving and engineering . The term " Iltkazar " came to describe more than just the original sub - kingdom , and by - 1900 DR it was used to describe a sub - kingdom of Calimshan . The Shanataran sub - kingdoms of Barakuir , Drakkalor , Holorarar and Ultoksamrin were located in Iltkazar , as well as Zokir , City of Orbs . As of 1371 DR , Iltkazar was mainly inhabited by shield dwarves , although populations of humans , rock gnomes , svirfneblin and urdunnirin also existed . In its prime , Iltkazar had an estimated population of 7 , 506 ( mostly shield dwarves ) and was ruled by a silver dragon known as King Mith Barak the Clanless , who spent seventy - five out of every hundred years sitting still as a solid mithral statue on his throne . During this time , the Regency Council of Iltkazar ruled the city . It was probably the best defended city in the Underdark . In 1367 DR King Mith Barak ' s astral form was captured by Tiamat and he was only released in 1477 DR . During his absence the city was ruled by regents .

title: Iltkazar Highlands
description: Iltkazar Highlands The Iltkazar Highlands were the eastern of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Geography . The eastern Highlands sloped upwards to the chain of mountains that included the Snowflake , Omlarandin , and Alimir Mountains .
description_long: Iltkazar Highlands The Iltkazar Highlands were the eastern of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Geography . The eastern Highlands sloped upwards to the chain of mountains that included the Snowflake , Omlarandin , and Alimir Mountains . The land was rough and uneven , a prime example being the Gorge of the Fallen Idol , where the River Ith began . The Upper Highlands were designated as the Golden Marches ; the Lower Highlands made up the Duchy of Suretmarch . Government . The official ruler of the Principality of the Iltkazar Highlands was Prince Coram Rhindaun . As he was still an infant , the Monarch ' s Champion , Vander Stillhawk , ruled in his stead . History . Historically , this region of Tethyr was less civilized than the western areas of that country . Monsters were a problem in the area , and many armies marched through its lands in times past . In the month of Ches , in the Year of the Tankard ( 1370 DR ) , the Amn ian settlements of Trailstone and Riatavin succeeded from Amn to join Tethyr . Since Riatavin was a bustling and rich metropolis , its inclusion in the Upper Highlands boosted the Iltkazar Highlands from the poorest to the richest territory of Tethyr .

title: Iltkazar Range
description: Iltkazar Range The Iltkazar Range was a long chain of five distinct mountain ranges that ran vertically from the Vilhon Reach in the north down to the the Shining Sea in the south and roughly divided west Faerûn from interior Faerûn . The range included , from north to south , the Giant ' s Run Mountains , the Snowflake Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Omlarandin Mountains , and the Alimir Mountains .
description_long: Iltkazar Range The Iltkazar Range was a long chain of five distinct mountain ranges that ran vertically from the Vilhon Reach in the north down to the the Shining Sea in the south and roughly divided west Faerûn from interior Faerûn . The range included , from north to south , the Giant ' s Run Mountains , the Snowflake Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Omlarandin Mountains , and the Alimir Mountains .

title: Iltztran Melarn
description: Iltztran Melarn Iltztran Melarn was the house wizard of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Iltztran was a wizard from Ched Nasad and an arachnomancer .
description_long: Iltztran Melarn Iltztran Melarn was the house wizard of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Iltztran was a wizard from Ched Nasad and an arachnomancer . He survived the destruction of his home city in 1372 and joined House Melarn of Menzoberranzan as house wizard . Personality . Iltztran was always in fear of Menzoberranzan falling like Ched Nasad had fallen , and used all his resource to stabilize the House Melarn complex .

title: Ilva
description: Ilva Ilva was a maid in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Ilva hailed from Phlan but like many others fled her hometown after Vorgansharax began to rule the city .
description_long: Ilva Ilva was a maid in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Ilva hailed from Phlan but like many others fled her hometown after Vorgansharax began to rule the city . She went to Mulmaster , where she started working as a maid at the bar called the Black Blade and Bloody Boar . Ilva befriended the half - elf Mixi . She later became obsessed with a strange dwarf prophet . After Mixi refused to follow her to more of the prophet ' s meetings , Ilva befriended the young noble Sebastian Stoe , who agreed to join her . Activities . In 1491 DR , Ilva worked at the bar the Black Blade and Bloody Boar , in a lower part of the city .

title: Ilvani
description: Ilvani Ilvani is the witch of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell and is the twin sister of Natan , the former high priest of Ikemmu . In 1479 DR , Ilvani was sent on an expedition to scout an area of the Shadowfell north of Ikemmu . Her party was captured by a Shadar - kai enclave and most of the members were tortured to death .
description_long: Ilvani Ilvani is the witch of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell and is the twin sister of Natan , the former high priest of Ikemmu . In 1479 DR , Ilvani was sent on an expedition to scout an area of the Shadowfell north of Ikemmu . Her party was captured by a Shadar - kai enclave and most of the members were tortured to death . Ilvani survived her imprisonment and was rescued by a group lead by the Ikemmu warrior Vedoran . A young Shadar - kai in the rescue party named Ashok was falsely accused of conspiring against Ikemmu by Vedoran . Ilvani destroyed a crucial piece of evidence against Ashok although Ashok was still imprisoned . In 1480 DR , Ilvani began having disturbing visions . In some of the visions , the ghost of a Rashemi witch appeared to her . The visions continued to worsen and whenever Ilvani was near shadow creatures they would go berserk . Along with Ashok , Cree and Skagi , Ilvani travelled with a caravan led by Tatigan Carrlock to Rashemen to seek the source of the visions . The visions were caused by the spirit of a witch named Yaraella who had been murdered by Sree , a Wychlaren . Ilvani confronted Sree and put Yaraella ' s spirit to rest which ended the hauntings .

title: Ilvara Mizzrym
description: Ilvara Mizzrym Ilvara Mizzrym was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The priestess was a very ambitious and cruel individual , wanting to rise in Lolth ' s esteem .
description_long: Ilvara Mizzrym Ilvara Mizzrym was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The priestess was a very ambitious and cruel individual , wanting to rise in Lolth ' s esteem . She considered commanding an outpost as a stepping stone in her ascension . She also knew the posting was temporary , and she intended to wring every advantage from it in the meantime . Ilvara also enjoyed taunting and tormenting enemies and underlings alike . Relationship . Ilvara first had Jorlan Duskryn as a lover , but discarded him after his crippling injuries . She later took Shoor Vandree but cared no more about him than she did about Jorlan . Activities . Ilvara was a drow of Menzoberranzan and a member of House Mizzrym , commanding the Velkynvelve outpost . History . During the Rage of Demons there was a great escape of prisoners . Ilvara decided to personally pursue the fugitive prisoners with her lieutenants but in the end she was killed

title: Ilvarthaele Everstone
description: Ilvarthaele Everstone Ilvarthaele Everstone was a Damaran human woman and a High Herald , as which she was known as the Silver Stag . History . Ilvarthaele Everstone was once a scribe and loremaster in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast .
description_long: Ilvarthaele Everstone Ilvarthaele Everstone was a Damaran human woman and a High Herald , as which she was known as the Silver Stag . History . Ilvarthaele Everstone was once a scribe and loremaster in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . In the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR , Ilvarthaele was selected by the High Heralds to join them as a High Herald herself . She was also permitted to establish a new High Herald office , that of the Silver Stag , which she based in the Stormspire in the town of Songhal in Impiltur near the end of that year . This was the first time a new High Herald post had been created in the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars since the Heralds had been founded in the Year of the Watching Helm , 992 DR . Activities . Ilvarthaele was charged with supporting the practice of heraldry in the lands of Impiltur , Thesk , Damara , and the independent cities of northeast Faerûn . She was also tasked with maintaining and administering heraldry in lands east of the Inner Sea .

title: Ilyana Wyrmmruff
description: Ilyana Wyrmmruff Ilyana Wyrmmruff was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Ilyana was the driving force behind the success of the inn : her organizational skills kept the building running efficiently .
description_long: Ilyana Wyrmmruff Ilyana Wyrmmruff was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Ilyana was the driving force behind the success of the inn : her organizational skills kept the building running efficiently . She was scared of spiders . Ilyana liked her current life but had a yearning for her adventuring days . She knew that her life was passing and waited for the day that the Trollsinge Vanguard would again be full , in the afterlife . Relationship . Ilyana worked alongside her former adventuring companion Eulagad . Activities . Around 1370 DR , Ilyana managed the Burning Troll inn with Eulagad . History . Ilyana was once one of the most talented cat - burglars in Waterdeep . She joined the Trollsinge Vanguard party and they survived many adventures . Like Eulagad , Ilyana retired after the death of her friends and for a long time they managed an inn in Skullport .

title: Ilyich
description: Ilyich Ilyich was a duergar soldier employed by Irenicus in his dungeon . History . Ilych was the chief of the duergar soldier in the Irenicus ' dungeon .
description_long: Ilyich Ilyich was a duergar soldier employed by Irenicus in his dungeon . History . Ilych was the chief of the duergar soldier in the Irenicus ' dungeon . He and his men were also smithies , and were forging knives and tools for torture . The duergar held the acorns of the Fairy Queen of the Windspear Hills , but Gorion ' s Ward needed the acorns and fought and killed Ilyich for them .

title: Ilythiir
description: Ilythiir Ilythiir was a realm of the dark elves during the Dawn Ages and First Flowering ( founded roughly - 27000 DR ) before being destroyed after the Descent of the Drow following the Fourth Crown War . Geography . Ilythiir was an expansionist country , that started in the southern jungles and spread throughout southern Faerûn during the Dawn Age .
description_long: Ilythiir Ilythiir was a realm of the dark elves during the Dawn Ages and First Flowering ( founded roughly - 27000 DR ) before being destroyed after the Descent of the Drow following the Fourth Crown War . Geography . Ilythiir was an expansionist country , that started in the southern jungles and spread throughout southern Faerûn during the Dawn Age . It experienced another period of expansion during the First Flowering , during which it spread across the areas later known as the Shaar and Forest of Amtar . Inhabitants . Ilythiir was founded by dark elves . Its leadership consisted largely of dark elves . According to Ka ' Narlist , this was due to a genetic dominance of the dark elves . If the same was a measure , the dark elves derived a claim for superiority from their trait . Slaves . Ilythiir was a nation that institutionalized slavery . Known slaves included elves , wemic s and minotaur s . After Syòrpiir , Eiellûr and Thearnytaar fell in the face of Ilythiir ' s strength , the moon and wild elves were enslaved . The aforementioned trait of the dark elves included their offsprings as dark elves in one - two generations .

title: Ilyyela Miritar
description: Ilyyela Miritar Ilyyela Miritar was the wife of Seiveril Miritar , leader of the Miritar clan of elves on the island of Evermeet . She was killed in 1371 DR during the war launched by Kymil Nimesin when the Tower of the Sun was destroyed . Seiveril attempted to resurrect her , but she refused to return from Arvandor , telling him that he would fulfill his role in the mortal world before joining her .
description_long: Ilyyela Miritar Ilyyela Miritar was the wife of Seiveril Miritar , leader of the Miritar clan of elves on the island of Evermeet . She was killed in 1371 DR during the war launched by Kymil Nimesin when the Tower of the Sun was destroyed . Seiveril attempted to resurrect her , but she refused to return from Arvandor , telling him that he would fulfill his role in the mortal world before joining her .

title: Ilyykur ' s mantle
description: Ilyykur ' s mantle Ilyykur ' s mantle was an arcane abjuration spell that gave the caster some protection against various types of magical attacks . Effects . This spell gave the caster a protective aura that covered the body in a soft , form - fitting glow .
description_long: Ilyykur ' s mantle Ilyykur ' s mantle was an arcane abjuration spell that gave the caster some protection against various types of magical attacks . Effects . This spell gave the caster a protective aura that covered the body in a soft , form - fitting glow . If the caster had a familiar that was no larger than Small and it maintained contact with the caster , then the familiar was afforded the same magical protection . " Ilyykur ' s mantle " was particularly good at protecting the caster from enchantment / charm spells , but also granted a minimal boost to protection from all other types of spells . One additional feature was that all damage from electrical attacks ( " lightning bolt " , " shocking grasp " , and the like ) was reduced by half . The spell ' s duration was one minute for every experience level of the caster . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a natural , uncut , unpolished gem of any value . History . This spell was published in " Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical " and became generally known to the magical community .

title: Ilztoj A ' Qaran
description: Ilztoj A ' Qaran Ilztoj A ' Qaran was a drow mage in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Ilztoj lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s .
description_long: Ilztoj A ' Qaran Ilztoj A ' Qaran was a drow mage in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Ilztoj lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s . He , along with seven companions , followed Drava T ' syrr to Cormanthor . There , however , Drava fell under the madness of the demon lord Graz ' zt and started to dance and drink . Some adventurers ( members of the Harpers hired by Elanil Elassidil to bring peace to her ancestor Meira Faerenduil ) tried to convinced Drava and her companions to go to a refugee camp , but she never complied and in the end she was defeated . Ilztoj became the new leader and agreed to the adventurers ' proposal . Personality . Ilztoj managed to resist the madness . However , he also started to like living in the forest . He continued to honor the drow social rules and followed Drava , who as a female was in a higher position than him . Relationship . Ilztoj was always at Drava ' s side as her second - in - command .

title: Imaerphil Clovenshield
description: Imaerphil Clovenshield Imaerphil Clovenshield was a female human who led Maalthiir ' s guard in Hillsfar . Abilities . As an experienced fighter , Imaerphil could hold her own in most battles .
description_long: Imaerphil Clovenshield Imaerphil Clovenshield was a female human who led Maalthiir ' s guard in Hillsfar . Abilities . As an experienced fighter , Imaerphil could hold her own in most battles . She was also versed in the skills of a rogue and could operate quietly behind the scenes , if need be . Activities . Imaerphil Clovenshield led Maalthiir ' s 32 elite guards and helped protect the First Lord against any threats . History . By 1372 DR , Imaerphil had risen to the position of leader of Maalthiir ' s guard . This duty meant Imaerphil was personally responsible for protecting the First Lord of Hillsfar .

title: Imani
description: Imani Imani was a wizard and sage in Turmish . History . Imani was a former adventuring wizard from Turmish .
description_long: Imani Imani was a wizard and sage in Turmish . History . Imani was a former adventuring wizard from Turmish . Afterward , he became a sage researching the lost elven kingdom of Uvaeren . In 1479 DR , he discovered that the lost " Diamond Staff of Chomylla " , key to all Uvaeren lore , was in the lair of the dracolich Dretchroyaster . He hired an adventuring party to infiltrate the lair and take it . Personality . Imani was always fascinated by Uvaeren artifacts , and knew that they could not be allowed to fall into evil hands .

title: Imaskar
description: Imaskar The Imaskar Empire ( also known as the Raurin Empire ) was an ancient human nation that ruled lands in the east that came to comprise of the nations of Mulhorand , Thay , and Unther . Its citizens were the Imaskari . Early History .
description_long: Imaskar The Imaskar Empire ( also known as the Raurin Empire ) was an ancient human nation that ruled lands in the east that came to comprise of the nations of Mulhorand , Thay , and Unther . Its citizens were the Imaskari . Early History . The earliest of all known records ( from the steppes , and Var the Golden ) describe the great empire of Imaskar . Ruled by powerful godless human wizard s , this empire was centered in what is now the Raurin Desert . Its borders were vast , reaching from the Endless Wastes to the Golden Water and from the Alamber Sea to the very frontiers of Kara - Tur . In the year - 8350 DR Imaskari tribes began to settle the then - fertile plain of the Raurin Desert . About 230 years later the Imaskari Artificer s created the first permanent extradimensional space . Their fascination with such magics soon transformed Imaskari city design . The following years saw the rise of many grand cities , among them the capital city of Inupras around - 7975 DR . About this time the first Emperor , Umyatin , rose to assume the title of Lord Artificer .

title: Imaskari
description: Imaskari The Imaskari were the citizens of Imaskar , the ancient empire later swallowed by the Raurin Desert and the Plains of Purple Dust . They were vilified by the Mulan , who were the descendants of the slaves the Imaskari artificer s abducted from other worlds using the mighty portal s they crafted . Distribution .
description_long: Imaskari The Imaskari were the citizens of Imaskar , the ancient empire later swallowed by the Raurin Desert and the Plains of Purple Dust . They were vilified by the Mulan , who were the descendants of the slaves the Imaskari artificer s abducted from other worlds using the mighty portal s they crafted . Distribution . At its height , the Imaskari Empire stretched from the Endless Wastes to the Golden Water , and from the Alamber Sea to the edge of Kara - Tur . Ruins of their cities could be found on the Plains of Purple Dust . Language . The Imaskari spoke Roushoum , a precursor of such languages as Durpari , Raumvira , and the various dialects of the Tuigan . The Imaskari alphabet had completely fallen out of use by the 14th century DR ; it was only found inscribed on a few ancient artifacts and the walls of Imaskari ruins . Descendants . The descendants of Imaskar lived on as the Deep Imaskari , a sub - species of human who made their home in the Underdark realm of Deep Imaskar and the new empire of High Imaskar .

title: Imaskari languages
description: Imaskari languages The Imaskari languages were a small family of languages that shared a history in the ancient empire of Imaskar . Language Groups . According to scholars , the following languages and language groups belonged to the Imaskari language family : Appendix .
description_long: Imaskari languages The Imaskari languages were a small family of languages that shared a history in the ancient empire of Imaskar . Language Groups . According to scholars , the following languages and language groups belonged to the Imaskari language family : Appendix . Inspiration . The classification of Imaskari languages were based on the real - life , such as , , and .

title: Imaskari vengeance taker
description: Imaskari vengeance taker The Imaskari vengeance taker is a special prestige class of the deep Imaskari , a race of humans that live in the Underdark . Devoted to law , justice , and revenge , the vengeance takers use a combination of techniques involving magic and investigative skills to track down targets . Few beings are as cold and emotionless as these men and women , all of whom may challenge an assassin in terms of downright deadliness and mercilessness .
description_long: Imaskari vengeance taker The Imaskari vengeance taker is a special prestige class of the deep Imaskari , a race of humans that live in the Underdark . Devoted to law , justice , and revenge , the vengeance takers use a combination of techniques involving magic and investigative skills to track down targets . Few beings are as cold and emotionless as these men and women , all of whom may challenge an assassin in terms of downright deadliness and mercilessness . This secret society is officially called the Lodge of the Retributive Masters , though very , very few know of its existence . It uses contacts that breaches many races and many outlooks in order to keep eyes and ears available for its vengeance takers . These contacts are considered under the Lodge ' s protection , meaning that any attacks against these contacts regardless of their own alignment will send the Lodge into a cold rage of vengeance .

title: Imbralym Skoond
description: Imbralym Skoond Imbralym Skoond was a wizard in Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Imbralym dreamed about the immense wealth he could amass with his magic power .
description_long: Imbralym Skoond Imbralym Skoond was a wizard in Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Imbralym dreamed about the immense wealth he could amass with his magic power . He was an amoral but charming individual . History . Imbralym was a dancing master in Athkatla before he discovered his talent for magic . Soon , he went left home to start his new career . Arriving in Baldur ' s Gate in search of a rich sponsor , Imbralym soon attracted the interest of Grand Duke Torlin Silvershield , who , after proving his suitability , made him one of his subordinates . Duke Silvershield also appointed Imbralym as a member of the Parliament of Peers , and he became his lapdog ever since . In 1479 DR , Imbralym was involved in the crisis that culminated in the resurrection of Bhaal .

title: Imbrar I
description: Imbrar I Imbrar Heltharn I , known as Imbrar the Lost , was the ninth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the second ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Through his father , Imphras I , he was a descendant of a line of paladin s related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III .
description_long: Imbrar I Imbrar Heltharn I , known as Imbrar the Lost , was the ninth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the second ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Through his father , Imphras I , he was a descendant of a line of paladin s related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III . His younger sister , Ilmara , was a sorceress like their mother Sambral and later became queen . Possessions . Most scholars believed that Imbrar bore the magic sword " Dornavver " when he went to war against the hobgoblin s of the Giantspire Mountains . Others claim that he in fact gave the sword to his general , Osper Wellhaven . History . Born in 1098 DR , Imbrar was the eldest son of King Imphras I and Queen Sambral . He was a paladin like his father before him . Imbrar became king in 1122 DR at his father ' s death . His short reign ended in 1127 DR when he vanished during a military campaign against the hobgoblins of the Giantspire Mountains . His sister had observed the hobgoblins rebuilding their forces through one of the Scrying Stones , so the king had marched against them . Neither the army nor the hobgoblins were ever seen again .

title: Imbrar II
description: Imbrar II Imbrar II was the last king of Impiltur . Relationships . He was the second nephew of Soarimbrar the Younger ( who was a descendant of Imphras II ' s fourth son ) , through his older sister .
description_long: Imbrar II Imbrar II was the last king of Impiltur . Relationships . He was the second nephew of Soarimbrar the Younger ( who was a descendant of Imphras II ' s fourth son ) , through his older sister . History . He was crowned on his sixteenth birthday ( Marpenoth 24 , 1374 DR ) . He took the throne from the aged Queen - Regent Sambryl , who herself gained power when Imbrar ' s uncle was killed just before his coronation . Much hope was placed in Imbrar by his subjects that he would reinvigorate Impilturan society . However , he died in 1385 DR , without an heir , the blood of the ill - fated Heltharn Dynasty spent .

title: Imbrult Longclaws
description: Imbrult Longclaws Imbrult Longclaws was a curse - ridden War Wizard of Cormyr . History . During a mission against some outlaws he was cursed by Manshoon riding a black dragon .
description_long: Imbrult Longclaws Imbrult Longclaws was a curse - ridden War Wizard of Cormyr . History . During a mission against some outlaws he was cursed by Manshoon riding a black dragon . In 1480 DR , Longclaws went to Castle Irlingstar with Nostyn Vandur . He tried to stop Lord Steward Gelnur Farland , Arclath Delcastle , and Amarune Whitewave from opening the cells .

title: Imbrus Obarskyr I
description: Imbrus Obarskyr I Imbrus I was a king of Cormyr . Like so many of his relatives , he was murdered by Gorauna . A common - born man named Rathdar Orlenthar next ruled Cormyr until Imbrus ' cousins or son would come of age .
description_long: Imbrus Obarskyr I Imbrus I was a king of Cormyr . Like so many of his relatives , he was murdered by Gorauna . A common - born man named Rathdar Orlenthar next ruled Cormyr until Imbrus ' cousins or son would come of age . All three , however , died in the Purplethroat Plague , and an Obarskyr would not sit on the throne again until 341 DR .

title: Imbrus Obarskyr II
description: Imbrus Obarskyr II Imbrus II , son of Imbrus I , was one of the three " boy kings " of Cormyr while Rathdar Orlenthar ruled as regent . He died in the Purplethroat Plague as did the other boy kings and was succeeded by the granddaughter of Gorauna , " Mad Meurthe " .
description_long: Imbrus Obarskyr II Imbrus II , son of Imbrus I , was one of the three " boy kings " of Cormyr while Rathdar Orlenthar ruled as regent . He died in the Purplethroat Plague as did the other boy kings and was succeeded by the granddaughter of Gorauna , " Mad Meurthe " .

title: Imbryl ' s Cloaks
description: Imbryl ' s Cloaks Imbryl ' s Cloaks is a cloak and garment shop in Amphail , run by Imbryl , a broad - shouldered woman . A group of women from the village gather here to make cloaks , breeches and rainspouts , which are hats with a large brim . The shop provides alterations to garments with a three - day waiting period .
description_long: Imbryl ' s Cloaks Imbryl ' s Cloaks is a cloak and garment shop in Amphail , run by Imbryl , a broad - shouldered woman . A group of women from the village gather here to make cloaks , breeches and rainspouts , which are hats with a large brim . The shop provides alterations to garments with a three - day waiting period .

title: Imbue undead with spell ability
description: Imbue undead with spell ability Imbue undead with spell ability was an arcane necromancy spell that transferred one spell from the caster to one undead creature . Effects . This spell took ten minutes to cast and the caster had to touch the undead creature in order to transfer a spell .
description_long: Imbue undead with spell ability Imbue undead with spell ability was an arcane necromancy spell that transferred one spell from the caster to one undead creature . Effects . This spell took ten minutes to cast and the caster had to touch the undead creature in order to transfer a spell . The oldest version of this spell did not place any restriction on the type or level of spell that could be imbued , but the wizard had to first cast " imbue undead with spell ability " and then immediately cast the spell to be transferred , with all the required verbal , somatic and material components , which was then captured by this spell and given to the target undead creature . The caster was then free to prepare new spells to replace this spell and the one that was imbued . The newer version of this spell could only transfer spells that were lower level than this spell and the caster could not prepare a new spell to replace the imbued spell until the undead creature had discharged the spell or was destroyed . However , no verbal , somatic , or material components were required for imbuing the spell .

title: Imbue with spell ability
description: Imbue with spell ability Imbue with spell ability was a divine evocation or enchantment spell that allowed the caster to bequeath a small number of spells to another creature . Effects . A divine spellcaster with this spell ( or ability , in the case of the divine disciple ) had to touch another creature that had sufficient wisdom and intelligence to hold the divine energies and to cast them effectively .
description_long: Imbue with spell ability Imbue with spell ability was a divine evocation or enchantment spell that allowed the caster to bequeath a small number of spells to another creature . Effects . A divine spellcaster with this spell ( or ability , in the case of the divine disciple ) had to touch another creature that had sufficient wisdom and intelligence to hold the divine energies and to cast them effectively . The enchantment version of this spell was limited to non - spellcasting persons , including ranger s and paladin s who had not yet achieved their spellcasting abilities , and only defensive , informational , or healing spells could be transferred . The evocation version worked on any creature that met the minimum requirements and was limited to spells from the abjuration and divination schools , or the healing subschool of conjuration . Depending on the age or experience of the creature touched , up to two basic spells and one slightly more advanced spell could be transferred from the mind of the caster to the mind of the target . While the spell or spells resided in the mind of the target , there was a void in the mind of the caster where those spells originated .

title: Imdarr Relvaunder
description: Imdarr Relvaunder Imdarr Relvaunder was a priest of Tempus in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Imdarr was a stern man , and keenly interested in news , rumors , and visitors .
description_long: Imdarr Relvaunder Imdarr Relvaunder was a priest of Tempus in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Imdarr was a stern man , and keenly interested in news , rumors , and visitors . Activities . Imdarr , along with Lymmura Auldarhk , took care of the Allfaiths Shrine . Sometimes , he acted for the Gauntlet , sending reports and passing messages History . In 1491 DR , Imdarr was involved in the disappearance of a diplomatic caravan near the city . The Order asked him to support some adventurers hired to solve the matter .

title: Imgig Zu
description: Imgig Zu Imgig Zu was an extraplanar monster and the ruler of his people . History . The Song of Selûne .
description_long: Imgig Zu Imgig Zu was an extraplanar monster and the ruler of his people . History . The Song of Selûne . Imgig Zu ' s history was a matter of legend , set down in the Song of Selûne . It began when the wayward young goddess Selûne traveled to another plane and was smitten by a mysterious and attractive warrior , a lord of his people . The stranger persuaded her to use her father ' s wand of power to transport him and his followers to Toril , where they planned to settle . However , once they landed , he revealed his true form and intentions — he was the monstrous Imgig Zu and he and his people were intent on conquest and ruin . He seized her father ' s wand of power and intended to kill the deceived goddess . Fortunately , a brave young wizard named Ostus Agrivar who was riding by raced to her rescue . Although the wizard was not powerful enough to defeat the monsters , he was capable of causing enough confusion and chaos that Selûne could escape . The goddess , now freed from her subjugation , used the only thing she had left : her own life force .

title: Imix
description: Imix Imix was the evil archomental of fire . He was a primordial older than the world itself . He was known as the Fire Lord Imix , Lord of Hellfire and the Eternal Flame .
description_long: Imix Imix was the evil archomental of fire . He was a primordial older than the world itself . He was known as the Fire Lord Imix , Lord of Hellfire and the Eternal Flame . Personality . Imix was passionate , quick to anger , vain , paranoid and prone to jealousy . He seemed to have an endless supply of energy , which was spent on schemes that were always to the detriment of others . He was noted as a masterful tactician and was very creative but his overconfidence and haughtiness caused him to rush into situations and he easily became frustrated when things didn ' t go according to his plans . He destroyed any who refused to acquiesce to him . Relationships . Imix had enemies in the form of Zaaman Rul and Olhydra , two other archomentals whom he was at war with . Imix could have potentially destroyed Zaaman Rul if he was not fighting a war on two fronts but nonetheless , his servants eventually defeated Zaaman Rul ' s army . Imix also schemed against Kossuth , but such was Kossuth ' s power in comparison , that although Kossuth was wary of Imix , he didn ' t take Imix ' s threat seriously .

title: Imizael
description: Imizael Imizael was a tavern owner in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Imizael was an efficient tavern - keeper , always attentive to patrons ' needs .
description_long: Imizael Imizael was a tavern owner in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Imizael was an efficient tavern - keeper , always attentive to patrons ' needs . However , she did not like to talk with costumers , responding to polite questions and directing all customers wanting speak with her to the waiter , Markoth . History . Imizael was born to a mother obsessed with elves , even giving her a clearly elven name , despite the fact that they were completely human . Imizael managed the Laughing Goblin Inn in Phlan , helped by Markoth . In 1489 DR , she became involved in the Cult of the Dragon ' s coup in the city , as the tavern became the headquarters of the forces fighting against the cultists .

title: Imlon Obarskyr
description: Imlon Obarskyr Imlon " the Touched " was the second king of Cormyr and was crowned in 55 DR . Relatives . Imlon ' s father was the legendary Faerlthann Obarskyr .
description_long: Imlon Obarskyr Imlon " the Touched " was the second king of Cormyr and was crowned in 55 DR . Relatives . Imlon ' s father was the legendary Faerlthann Obarskyr . Imlon also had three younger brothers : Emrus , Eskruis and Rhiiman . He also had a son , Bryndar .

title: Immaero Sraunter
description: Immaero Sraunter Immaero Sraunter was an alchemist in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon managed to discover his hidden secrets and enslaved Sraunter to do his bidding .
description_long: Immaero Sraunter Immaero Sraunter was an alchemist in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon managed to discover his hidden secrets and enslaved Sraunter to do his bidding . He ordered the alchemist to release into the city five death tyrant s . Later Manshoon magically send Srauner inside the sieged Stormserpent Towers . In 1480 DR he was dealing with Lord Danthalus Blacksilver . Later Manshoon decided to use Sraunter as him main body . However later Manshoon was scrying thank to the body of Jarlin Flamtarge inside Castle Irlingstar but at last Rorskryn Mreldrake discovered him and using his new magic power made the head of Manshoon exploded . However was Sraunter that died and Manshoon just transferred himself in the body of Ondrath Everwood .

title: Immerdusk
description: Immerdusk Immerdusk was a noble house of Cormyr . It was based in Arabel . History .
description_long: Immerdusk Immerdusk was a noble house of Cormyr . It was based in Arabel . History . The Immerdusks supported Gondegal when he tried to usurp the kingdom in 1352 DR . During the Abraxus affair , the Immerdusks ( like many noble families with country estates ) favored Vangerdahast as regent instead of a ruling noble council if King Azoun IV died .

title: Immerhand Inn
description: Immerhand Inn The Immerhand Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Chalthos Immer . History .
description_long: Immerhand Inn The Immerhand Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Chalthos Immer . History . The Immerhand Inn was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business " circa " 1369 DR . Famed traveler Volothamp Geddarm wrote about the business in " Volo ' s Guide to Cormyr " . Location . The inn was situated on a waymoot on Wheloon ' s northwestern fringe , a short distance north of Rathool ' s Pond . Description . It was a dark and rustic - looking building , with stables , a muddy wagonyard , and an outhouse . Inside the inn , the furniture was a random and mismatched selection of bought , scavenged , and roughly home - made pieces . Each room had beds , stools , and chests , and was lit by a huge storm lantern such as Chalthos had relied on as a mercenary . Another memento of his career were the paintings he ' d looted from around Faerûn ; one in each room provided the sole decoration . Services . The Immerhand Inn was Wheloon ' s third best inn — out of three . It was a poor quality place that provided no food or drink , do - it - yourself stabling and feeding of mounts , and patrons had to pump their own water for washing .

title: Immil Vale
description: Immil Vale Immil Vale was a deep valley in Rashemen north of the Running Rocks . It was the site of the Battle of Immil Vale in 1360 DR . Description .
description_long: Immil Vale Immil Vale was a deep valley in Rashemen north of the Running Rocks . It was the site of the Battle of Immil Vale in 1360 DR . Description . Immil Vale was a deep narrow valley north of the Running Rocks mountains and the Ashenwood . In the valley it was perpetual springtime due to volcanic activity , with hot spring , green grass , and vents and fumaroles of steam that often filled the valley with mist . A huge , ancient tree stood at a vantage point over the valley . The Watchtower , run by the Witches of Rashemen , stood nearby , and the farthest outpost that could be seen from the valley was the Sisters on the Rookery Peak . The valley was normally filled with spirits , but during the Time of Troubles , the valley was ( temporarily ? ) turned into a dead - magic zone . History . In 1360 DR , the Battle of Immil Vale took place between Rashemi forces and the Tuigan Horde . The Rashemi forces were composed off mounted Rashemi berserker warriors led by the Iron Lord , Hyarmon Hussilthar and witches directed by the wychlaran Zofia Othlor . The Tuigan forces were numerous and mounted on horses .

title: Immilmar
description: Immilmar Immilmar was the capital city of Rashemen and seat of the Iron Lord . At the center of Immilmar was the Lord ' s citadel , built with the help of the mighty Wychlaran . Around the keep was the central part of Immilmar , with farther - out homes built more like regular Rashemi homes .
description_long: Immilmar Immilmar was the capital city of Rashemen and seat of the Iron Lord . At the center of Immilmar was the Lord ' s citadel , built with the help of the mighty Wychlaran . Around the keep was the central part of Immilmar , with farther - out homes built more like regular Rashemi homes . There was also a small temple of Bhalla ( a local aspect of Chauntea ) , which ensured that the worship of the goddess did not stray too far from official doctrine .

title: Immithra Shrae
description: Immithra Shrae Immithra Shrae was the head of the Bounty of the Goddess temple of Chauntea in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1367 DR .
description_long: Immithra Shrae Immithra Shrae was the head of the Bounty of the Goddess temple of Chauntea in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1367 DR . Description . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , Lady Shrae was middle - aged , tall , slender , and very attractive , with black hair that showed no signs of gray . She had a soft , pleasant voice . Personality . Although she insisted on being addressed as Lady Matriarch by those outside the church and Young Matriarch by her fellow clergy , she was generally pleasant , fair , and equitable with everyone . Relationships . Shrae was a good friend of her counterpart in Shadowdale , the High Harvestmistress Glamerie Windbough of the House of Plenty , and usually the two priestesses discussed spiritual matters as well as exchanging useful information about raids on Voonlar and Zhentarim activities . She was known to help good adventurers with healing and even give them shelter on the temple grounds .

title: Immolith
description: Immolith An immolith is an undead demon ic creature that is sometimes created when the spirits of deceased demons have fallen back into the Abyss . Immoliths greatly despise living creatures , and they are often found accompanying other undead such as lich es and vampire s , although they can also be found with other demons such as horde ghoul s , mezzodemon s , and vrock s . Immunity .
description_long: Immolith An immolith is an undead demon ic creature that is sometimes created when the spirits of deceased demons have fallen back into the Abyss . Immoliths greatly despise living creatures , and they are often found accompanying other undead such as lich es and vampire s , although they can also be found with other demons such as horde ghoul s , mezzodemon s , and vrock s . Immunity . Immoliths are immune to all disease , fire and poison . Combat . Immoliths are perpetually surrounded by flames and foes getting too close are likely to catch fire . They attack with their claws , which can also cause foes to catch fire . An immolith can curse enemies which slows them down and causes them to catch fire , and an immolith ' s grab can eliminate enemies ' fire resistance . An immolith can heal itself and any nearby undead creatures .

title: Immortal
description: Immortal Immortals are outsider s native to the Astral Sea and the many plane s that lie within it whose essence is primarily composed from that same fundamental plane . In spite of their name , they are not the only beings capable of immortality , many elemental s and even natural creature s also being capable of something along such lines . However , agelessness and the incapablity of dying a natural death is something that defines all immortals , which is not true of elemental , fey , natural , or shadow creatures .
description_long: Immortal Immortals are outsider s native to the Astral Sea and the many plane s that lie within it whose essence is primarily composed from that same fundamental plane . In spite of their name , they are not the only beings capable of immortality , many elemental s and even natural creature s also being capable of something along such lines . However , agelessness and the incapablity of dying a natural death is something that defines all immortals , which is not true of elemental , fey , natural , or shadow creatures . All immortals are immortal to this extent , though they are capable of being killed by more deliberate means and few immortals feel the need to eat or sleep either . The most powerful of all immortals are the gods , who are challenged only truly by the most powerful aberration s or the mighty primordial s .

title: Immurk
description: Immurk Immurk the Invincible was the legendary first great pirate lord of the Sea of Fallen Stars , who lived during the 12th century DR . As he began his piratical career , he recruited the disaffected sailors of various nations around the Inner Sea , promising them plunder for their loyalty . According to legend , Immurk ' s first great crime was when he stole the new crown for the coronation of King Palaghard I of Cormyr in the Year of Long Shadows , 1164 DR .
description_long: Immurk Immurk the Invincible was the legendary first great pirate lord of the Sea of Fallen Stars , who lived during the 12th century DR . As he began his piratical career , he recruited the disaffected sailors of various nations around the Inner Sea , promising them plunder for their loyalty . According to legend , Immurk ' s first great crime was when he stole the new crown for the coronation of King Palaghard I of Cormyr in the Year of Long Shadows , 1164 DR . The crime was so audacious that Palaghard believed that no one could be so brave , and that the Procampan master jewelers who ' d crafted it must be cheating him instead . He mustered his armies and nearly declared war on Procampur before being corrected . Immurk ' s role was eventually revealed and the crown recovered .
