Immurk recruited the mage Seldzen of Procampur to develop the spell named for him , " Immurk ' s distraction " .

title: Immurk ' s distraction
description: Immurk ' s distraction Immurk ' s distraction was an arcane enchantment spell that prevented people finding concealed objects by causing them to be distracted . It was useful for hiding buried treasure chests and smuggled goods . Effect .
description_long: Immurk ' s distraction Immurk ' s distraction was an arcane enchantment spell that prevented people finding concealed objects by causing them to be distracted . It was useful for hiding buried treasure chests and smuggled goods . Effect . When cast on a particular item that was then concealed , the spell clouded the mind of anyone within 50 feet ( 15 meters ) searching for it and prevented them from finding it . If the item was hidden inside a container or beneath something else , then an affected person would not consider opening the container or looking underneath . If they were ordered to do so by someone unaffected by the spell , then they would still fail to find it . Only an item in plain sight would be discovered . Components . The spell required a mixture of sand and diamond dust ( worth 500 gp ) to be sprinkled over the affected item . History . The spell was developed by the mage Seldzen of the city of Procampur in the the Vast , on behalf of Immurk , the legendary pirate captain of the 12th century DR .

title: Imnescourse Trail
description: Imnescourse Trail Imnescourse Trail was a roadway that ran across central Amn . The western most point of the trail was at the town of Immescar where it met with the Trade Way , then it ran east , through the Umar Hills through the city of Esmeltaran , before turning north and ending at the town of Gambiton at the South Road . Realmslore .
description_long: Imnescourse Trail Imnescourse Trail was a roadway that ran across central Amn . The western most point of the trail was at the town of Immescar where it met with the Trade Way , then it ran east , through the Umar Hills through the city of Esmeltaran , before turning north and ending at the town of Gambiton at the South Road . Realmslore . The section of the Imnescourse Trail that runs though the Umar Hills was very dangerous . The area was full of wovles and possibly a werewolf .

title: Imoen
description: Imoen Imoen was a young female human who was raised in Candlekeep . She was also a Bhaalspawn , though this remained unrevealed for some time even after it was revealed that the other ward of Gorion living in Candlekeep was one . Imoen travelled with them for a time before the prophecy of the Bhaalspawn was fulfilled .
description_long: Imoen Imoen was a young female human who was raised in Candlekeep . She was also a Bhaalspawn , though this remained unrevealed for some time even after it was revealed that the other ward of Gorion living in Candlekeep was one . Imoen travelled with them for a time before the prophecy of the Bhaalspawn was fulfilled . Appearance . Imoen was of slight build , with long hair and pale skin . The Games . Imoen is a party NPC in the computer roleplaying games " Baldur ' s Gate " , " " and " " . She is the protagonist ' s first companion after Gorion ' s murder . Biography . Imoen was the player character ' s closest friend and nearly only peer when they were growing up in Candlekeep . She was brought in much like them , an orphan adopted by Gorion , but ten years later in life . Of her past , even less is ever mentioned than of the protagonist ' s . She was close to Gorion , but preferred the company of the innkeeper Winthrop , possibly due to her own carefree and not very serious nature . She seems to have picked up thief skills even when already living in the citadel ; a remark of hers suggests that she was in the habit of pickpocketing the monks there .

title: Imp
description: Imp Imps are vicious , manipulative fiends that make up the least powerful ranks of the infernal legions . An imp is a minor non - Baatezu devil . They serve as tempters and lackeys to mortals whom devils want groomed to the side of evil .
description_long: Imp Imps are vicious , manipulative fiends that make up the least powerful ranks of the infernal legions . An imp is a minor non - Baatezu devil . They serve as tempters and lackeys to mortals whom devils want groomed to the side of evil . Imps delight in the opportunity to leave Hell and tempt a mortal to evil . Many evil spellcasters can be found with an imp in their company , serving as a “ familiar . ” Appearance . Although they can alter their form into that of any tiny animal , an imp normally appears as a tiny , red - skinned humanoid with a pair of black wings and a long tail ending in a poisonous stinger , containing a deadly poison . An imp stands about 2 feet tall and weighs only 8 pounds . Motives . Imps frequently act as manipulators in mortal lands , tempting the greedy , gullible or foolish into Lawful Evil acts so as to corrupt them , ensuring a continuous supply of souls for their lords in the Nine Hells . While physically weak compared to some lesser Devil forms ( those lower down the form hierarchy ) , lower Devils relish the chance to be promoted to Imp because successfully tempting mortals into evil is one of the surest paths to further promotions .

title: Imperial Cavalry
description: Imperial Cavalry The Imperial Cavalry served within Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Prince Cheddah al - Assad favored applicants who could perform interesting tricks on horseback .
description_long: Imperial Cavalry The Imperial Cavalry served within Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Prince Cheddah al - Assad favored applicants who could perform interesting tricks on horseback . The Imperial Cavalry was used mostly for show during parades and other affairs of state . However , Thokkor managed to give them basic military training . There were 2 , 000 members of the Imperial Cavalry . Members . Prince Cheddah was the ultimate commander of the Imperial Cavalry .

title: Imperishable
description: Imperishable The Imperishable was an elite mamluk order who dedicated their lives to serving the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities . The primary goal of the Imperishable was defending the great fortress of Krak al - Mazhar from all enemies of the Brotherhood .
description_long: Imperishable The Imperishable was an elite mamluk order who dedicated their lives to serving the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities . The primary goal of the Imperishable was defending the great fortress of Krak al - Mazhar from all enemies of the Brotherhood . The ranks were filled with slaves purchased as young children and indoctrinated throughout their lives to serve the Brotherhood . Upon reaching an age of retirement , if they survived that long , a mamluk of the Imperishable began training the younger mamluks of the order . Organization . Unique among other mamluk orders who also tattooed their faces , the crimson tattoos of the Imperishable were actually special tattoos of power , granting them useful resistances to fire . Most of the members of the Imperishable dressed in red scale armor and white " aba s " . They wore yellow silk sashes over one shoulder . Base of Operations . The Imperishable were based in the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar located somewhere in the Great Anvil .

title: Impervious sanctity of mind
description: Impervious sanctity of mind Impervious sanctity of mind was an abjuration spell that granted the caster complete immunity from mind - affecting spells , spell - like effects , and psionic s . Effects . This spell lasted for at least two hours ( longer for higher level casters ) .
description_long: Impervious sanctity of mind Impervious sanctity of mind was an abjuration spell that granted the caster complete immunity from mind - affecting spells , spell - like effects , and psionic s . Effects . This spell lasted for at least two hours ( longer for higher level casters ) . When cast , it prevented all of the following effects : " amnesia " , " awe " , " beguiling " , " charm " , " command " , " confusion " , " domination " , " emotion " , " empathy " , " ESP " , " facination " , " fear " , " feeblemind " , " hold person " , " hypnotism " , " insanity " , " magic jar " , " mind blast " , " phantasmal killer " , " possession " , " rulership " , " sleep " , " soul trap ing " , " suggestion " , " telepathy " , and any form of psionic or telepathic attack or sending . The only exceptions to this protection were artifacts , relic s , or extraordinarily powerful creatures . This spell did not prevent detection or scrying . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a ring made of lead that had been subjected to red dragon breath .

title: Imphras I
description: Imphras I Imphras Heltharn I , known as Imphras the Great , was the eighth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the first ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Imphras Heltharn was a descendant of a line of paladin s who were related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III .
description_long: Imphras I Imphras Heltharn I , known as Imphras the Great , was the eighth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the first ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Imphras Heltharn was a descendant of a line of paladin s who were related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III . Imphras married the sorceress Sambral , with whom he had fought against the hobgoblin horde . They had two children , a son , Imbrar , and a daughter , Ilmara . Both would later sit on the throne . Possessions . Imphras was in possession of a legacy of old treasures , including the " Crown of Narfell " and over 100 magical swords . History . Imphras I was born in 1063 DR . He became a War - Captain of Lyrabar , and in this role , he united the forces of Dilpur , Hlammach , Lyrabar , and Sarshel , the shield dwarves of the Earthfast Mountains , and the wood elves of the Gray Forest against the hobgoblins of the Giantspire Mountains . Despite this , in 1095 DR , his army was driven back by the goblinoid hordes , as far as the Bluefang Water . There , however , he was joined by the powerful mages Soargar , Velgarbrin , and Sambral .

title: Imphras II
description: Imphras II Imphras Heltharn II was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the only heir of Queen Ilmara , and he was crowned as king at birth in 1169 DR .
description_long: Imphras II Imphras Heltharn II was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the only heir of Queen Ilmara , and he was crowned as king at birth in 1169 DR . His father , Rilaun of Sarshel , was angered by this and tried to seize the throne instead , but he was defeated . Ilmara then ruled as regent until Imphras ' sixteenth birthday in 1185 DR . Imphras married one Lasheela of Dilpur , and she bore him two sons , Talryn and Lashilmbrar . She died in 1204 DR , and Imphras immediately married his mistress Rebaera Osterhown . They had four more sons , Kuskar , Velimbrar , Elphras , and Fylraun . History . In 1196 DR , Imphras founded the Most Holy Order of the Sacred Shrike after claiming to have seen a little attack and kill a small demon while on a hunt . This order of knights followed the traditions of the older Order of the Triad and served the throne of Impiltur . During the later part of his reign , shortly after he had taken Rebaera as his second wife , Imphras suffered from mental illness . ( The first signs of it occurred in 1204 DR . ) His oldest son , Talryn , tried to take power , claiming his father was unfit for rule , but he was exiled for this .

title: Imphras III
description: Imphras III Imphras Heltharn III was a crown prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the eldest son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly .
description_long: Imphras III Imphras Heltharn III was a crown prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the eldest son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly . His mother was named Thelmara Rorntarn . His younger brother was Rilimbrar , who would become the next king . History . Imphras III was born in 1276 DR but was assassinated at the age of eighteen years in a staged bandit attack on the king ' s summer residence by Imphras ' step - cousin Prince Thaum , which also slew his father , the king . This made his younger brother the new king and marked Thaum as the next crown prince .

title: Imphras IV
description: Imphras IV Prince Imphras IV was a prince of Impiltur and the husband of Queen Sambryl . Relationships . Imphras was the only son of traitorous Thaum of Telflamm and the great - grandson of Imphras II .
description_long: Imphras IV Prince Imphras IV was a prince of Impiltur and the husband of Queen Sambryl . Relationships . Imphras was the only son of traitorous Thaum of Telflamm and the great - grandson of Imphras II . He was the rightful male heir to the throne after Rilimbrar . Because of this , he was forced to marry the daughter of Rilimbrar , the wizardess Sambryl , his second cousin . Theirs was only a formal marriage , and the " relationship " remained platonic . History . Imphras IV was born in 1277 DR . Sometime after the Year of the Deep Moon , Imphras ' father , Thaum , took him and his army to Filur and took the throne of Impiltur by force , sending King Rilimbrar and his regent , Kuskur , who was also Imphras ' grandfather , into exile . Prince Kuskur , however , sought the aid of Queen Ilione of Aglarond and her apprentice , the Simbul , who restored the throne to Rilimbrar . With his father slain by the Simbul , Imphras IV tried to hold the throne , but by 1296 DR , he was placed under house arrest . Since Rilimbrar had only daughters , Imphras IV was technically the crown prince .

title: Imphras V
description: Imphras V Imphras V was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Imphras was the oldest nephew of King Soarimbrar .
description_long: Imphras V Imphras V was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Imphras was the oldest nephew of King Soarimbrar . His mother was named Ilmara , and he had a younger brother named Imbrar . History . King Imphras V was next in line to be king when his uncle was murdered just before his coronation . Since Imphras was only four years old at the time , Queen - Regent Sambryl continued to reign in his stead . In 1363 DR , however , Imphras died of a wasting disease before he had even come of age . His younger brother , Imbrar became the next king .

title: Impil Street
description: Impil Street Impil Street was an alley in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr , located near the waterfront on the eastern shore of the Wyvernflow River . Services . Impil Street was the site of a number of warehouses , all owned by the Cormyrean Coins Coster .
description_long: Impil Street Impil Street was an alley in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr , located near the waterfront on the eastern shore of the Wyvernflow River . Services . Impil Street was the site of a number of warehouses , all owned by the Cormyrean Coins Coster . They held perishable goods imported by the coster , and were usually well guarded . Description . Impil Street was a cobbled , dead - end alley with uneven sides . The warehouses were typically 20 feet ( 6 meters ) high , were built of wood , and had strong wooden doors . One was marked by brass plaque as 23 Impil Street . History . Following continued efforts to smuggle jewels inside vegetables , operations were shut down in Eleasias of Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , while the Coiners sorted out their legal problems . This left their Impil Street warehouses unoccupied and half - empty . After two weeks , the remaining stock of fruit and vegetables went to waste , and one warehouse was infested by bat s . In early Eleint , the thugs Londal Fen and Smile would potentially use the location to trap and ambush those investigating the local cult of Shar .

title: Impiltur
description: Impiltur Impiltur was a former kingdom and current confederacy of feudal lords in Northeast Faerûn of around 1 . 2 million inhabitants , comprising mainly human s , but also dwarves and halfling s . Geography .
description_long: Impiltur Impiltur was a former kingdom and current confederacy of feudal lords in Northeast Faerûn of around 1 . 2 million inhabitants , comprising mainly human s , but also dwarves and halfling s . Geography . Impiltur was located between the Sea of Fallen Stars in the east and south and the Earthspur and Earthfast Mountains in the west . To the north was the Rawlinswood and Damara . History . Impiltur ' s monarchy was founded with Imphras the Great in 1095 DR . He united four independent cities against advancing hobgoblin hordes from the Giantspire Mountains . Although the Tuigan Horde in 1358 DR did not cross the border of Impiltur , many refugees fleeing its effects did , leading to poverty , starvation , and in some places chaos . However , order and wealth returned to Impiltur over the next twenty years . Government . In 1372 DR , the nation was led by the Council of Lords ( mostly composed of paladins or others of lawful or good alignment ) and Queen Sambryl ( widow of King Imphras IV ) , who generally left all governing affairs to the Council .

title: Impilturan demonslayer
description: Impilturan demonslayer Impilturan demonslayers are heroes of Impiltur and hunters of the demon ic forces that haunt it . Wielding dual weapons , most often two blades , Impilturan demonslayers fearlessly hunt the enemies of Impiltur ' s people , be they demons or horrific plaguechanged monsters . To these bold adventurers , demons are little more than more powerful versions of the more common beast s most ranger s hunt .
description_long: Impilturan demonslayer Impilturan demonslayers are heroes of Impiltur and hunters of the demon ic forces that haunt it . Wielding dual weapons , most often two blades , Impilturan demonslayers fearlessly hunt the enemies of Impiltur ' s people , be they demons or horrific plaguechanged monsters . To these bold adventurers , demons are little more than more powerful versions of the more common beast s most ranger s hunt . In order to slay the mighty abominations , which they hunt , Impilturan demonslayers dabble in the ways of arcane magic , unlike most rangers . In addition to wielding the power of martial training these warriors use a small number of potent spell s in order to lay low the defenses of any demon they fight . Abilities . In order to fight the monstrous forces that Impilturan demonslayers choose to call their enemy those beginning the path learn quickly the ways of their foes and arcane knowledge regarding them . This extra knowledge gives demonslayers a slight edge over the forces of the Abyss , making their attacks more potent .

title: Implosion
description: Implosion Implosion is an evocation spell that kills one subject per round . Effect . You create a destructive resonance in a corporeal creature ' s body .
description_long: Implosion Implosion is an evocation spell that kills one subject per round . Effect . You create a destructive resonance in a corporeal creature ' s body . For each round you concentrate , you cause one creature to collapse in on itself , killing it . ( This effect , being instantaneous , cannot be dispelled . ) You can target a particular creature only once with each casting of the spell . " Implosion " has no effect on creatures in gaseous form or on incorporeal creatures .

title: Impregnable mind
description: Impregnable mind Impregnable mind was an enchantment spell that greatly improved the recipient ' s chances of resisting magical or psionic attacks on the mind . Effects . For ten minutes , more depending on the level of the caster , the recipient of this spell was much less likely to be " beguile d " , " charmed " , " dominated " , " feeblemind ed " , " held " or succumb to similar mind - affecting spells and psionics .
description_long: Impregnable mind Impregnable mind was an enchantment spell that greatly improved the recipient ' s chances of resisting magical or psionic attacks on the mind . Effects . For ten minutes , more depending on the level of the caster , the recipient of this spell was much less likely to be " beguile d " , " charmed " , " dominated " , " feeblemind ed " , " held " or succumb to similar mind - affecting spells and psionics . Even when the odds were hopeless , this spell gave a chance to resist supposedly non - resistible assaults on the mind . Note that magical and psionic attacks that attack the body ( such as telekinesis ) were not prevented by this spell . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Impresk
description: Impresk Impresk was a barony of the monarchy of Erlkazar , which encompassed the territory of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . Impresk was the barony responsible for ensuring that the monster population of the Snowflake Mountains remained low and defending the trade road to Riatavin .
description_long: Impresk Impresk was a barony of the monarchy of Erlkazar , which encompassed the territory of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . Impresk was the barony responsible for ensuring that the monster population of the Snowflake Mountains remained low and defending the trade road to Riatavin . The barony was inhabited by many " hill clans " and contained several farming villages , a few logging and shepherding towns in the foothills , and a single mining town . Geography . Impresk Barony was the northernmost of Erlkazar ' s five baronies . It bordered Carrelath and Shalanar to the south . Shilmista , the Forest of Shadows , was its western border , and Impresk Lake was located at the southeast edge . Government . The leader of Impresk was Baron Jivam Tammsel , who , oddly enough , was a half - steel dragon ranger . He was selected by the hill clans to lead despite his draconic heritage .

title: Impresk Lake
description: Impresk Lake Impresk Lake was a lake in Erlkazar . Geography . The water of Impresk Lake was ice cold .
description_long: Impresk Lake Impresk Lake was a lake in Erlkazar . Geography . The water of Impresk Lake was ice cold . It was fed by a large number of rivers and streams , some flowing off from the Snowflake Mountains and others from the Shining Plains . Impresk Lake drained into the Deepwash by means of the short Shalane River . The lake formed part of the eastern border of the barony of Impresk . Notable Location . The town of Carradoon , the birthplace of Cadderly Bonaduce , was located on the southern shore of the lake on a small peninsula .

title: Imprisoners
description: Imprisoners The Imprisoners were a group of powerful mages working before the Spellplague for Larloch who imprisoned spirits in magic items . The ultimate goal was apparently to preserve some of Larloch ' s power so he could access it later . The items created were known as Blueflame items and had powerful magic contained within .
description_long: Imprisoners The Imprisoners were a group of powerful mages working before the Spellplague for Larloch who imprisoned spirits in magic items . The ultimate goal was apparently to preserve some of Larloch ' s power so he could access it later . The items created were known as Blueflame items and had powerful magic contained within . Mystra ' s clergy became aware of the plot but the goddess refused to allow any interference . The Simbul believed the Blueflame items created by the Imprisoners contained enough of Mystra ' s power to restore the goddess .

title: Imprisonment
description: Imprisonment Imprisonment was an abjuration spell that entombs subjects beneath the earth . Effects . When you cast " imprisonment " and touch an opponent , he is entombed in a state of suspended animation ( see the " temporal stasis " spell ) in a small sphere far beneath the surface of the earth .
description_long: Imprisonment Imprisonment was an abjuration spell that entombs subjects beneath the earth . Effects . When you cast " imprisonment " and touch an opponent , he is entombed in a state of suspended animation ( see the " temporal stasis " spell ) in a small sphere far beneath the surface of the earth . The subject remains there unless a " freedom " spell is cast at the locale where the imprisonment took place . Magical search by a " crystal ball " , a " locate object spell " , or some other similar divination does not reveal the fact that a creature is imprisoned , but " discern location " does . A " wish " or " miracle " spell will not free the recipient but will reveal where it is entombed . The " imprisonment " spell functions only if the target ' s name and some facts about its life are known . The reversed form of this spell , " freedom " , was used to release an " imprisoned " creature from its confinement . Detailed knowledge of the prisoner to free was required , otherwise the caster risked setting loose other entombed creatures . Components . The spell required verbal , somatic and material components .

title: Improved skull watch
description: Improved skull watch Improved skull watch was a permanent - until - triggered version of the " skull watch " spell . Effects . This spell improved on " skull watch " in a number of ways .
description_long: Improved skull watch Improved skull watch was a permanent - until - triggered version of the " skull watch " spell . Effects . This spell improved on " skull watch " in a number of ways . This version of the spell was able to discern creatures of above animal intelligence and would only trigger if an intelligent creature crossed its view . The area of effect remained the same ( a 20 ft / 6 . 1 m wide by 90 ft / 27 m long corridor ) , but the spell lasted until the skull was triggered , deactivated , or destroyed . If triggered , the caster received a vision of what the skull saw . The detail was such that the caster could recognize the race or species and any clothing , armor , and weapons the intruder or intruders may have been carrying . The caster also knew the location of the skull that was triggered . If a skull was deactivated ( by " dispel magic " ) or destroyed ( by physical damage ) , the caster knew a skull was out of commission , but not the method by which it was neutralized . Improved skull watchers could not be turned or moved without setting off the alarm . Once triggered , the skull turned to dust after giving its alarm and visual report .

title: Imrar Roaryl
description: Imrar Roaryl Imrar Roaryl was the Crown Prince of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality .
description_long: Imrar Roaryl Imrar Roaryl was the Crown Prince of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality . Imrar was a hotheaded , proud , and capable warrior who underestimated his younger siblings . Background . As of 1479 DR , Prince Imrar was the heir of Eskorn ' s throne . Relationships . Crown Prince Imrar was the older son of King Ornan Roaryl , and the elder brother of Flandarr and Dlorna Roaryl .

title: Imreera Hethkantan
description: Imreera Hethkantan Queen Imreera Hethkantan was the queen of Gontal as of 1479 DR . By popular account , she seemed more interested in the ruins of the Glaur Barrens than in ruling her own kingdom , and many believed the families of the Twelvefold to be the real power of Gontal . However , that was a facade created by Queen Imreera to mislead her enemies .
description_long: Imreera Hethkantan Queen Imreera Hethkantan was the queen of Gontal as of 1479 DR . By popular account , she seemed more interested in the ruins of the Glaur Barrens than in ruling her own kingdom , and many believed the families of the Twelvefold to be the real power of Gontal . However , that was a facade created by Queen Imreera to mislead her enemies . Activities . Queen Imreera was a wizard of modest talent and inherited wealth who ruled her kingdom with a cunning demeanor . She also had the ability to see into the future through visions and dreams . She used her most loyal agents to hire third - party specialists to thwart the plots of the Twelvefold families while keeping those families at odds , and the specialists never knew they were hired by the Queen herself . She also had a group of loyal spies who kept her informed of noteworthy events in the kingdom . Publicly , Queen Imreera expressed great interest in the ruins of the Glaur Barrens , and she openly hired adventurers and explorers willing to brave the ruins in the hopes of uncovering treasures and ancient lore . Relationships .

title: Imrilsar ( family )
description: Imrilsar ( family ) The Imrilsar family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Imvaernarhro
description: Imvaernarhro Imvaernarho , or Inferno , is an ancient red dragon who has mastered fire magic whose lair rests in the Star Mounts . Legends surrouding the great wyrm have been spread all throughout the Western Heartlands and the Sword Coast North . Although he has typically kept himself isolated from other , Inferno has taken a recent interest in the Silver Marches .
description_long: Imvaernarhro Imvaernarho , or Inferno , is an ancient red dragon who has mastered fire magic whose lair rests in the Star Mounts . Legends surrouding the great wyrm have been spread all throughout the Western Heartlands and the Sword Coast North . Although he has typically kept himself isolated from other , Inferno has taken a recent interest in the Silver Marches . Hoard . Maintaining several hoards of treasure located in various caves throughout the peaks of the Star Mounts , Inferno ' s wealth , in terms of gold coins , has been measured by Elminster to be at least " a dozen million " .

title: In ' ani
description: In ' ani In ' ani was a city on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . In ' ani stood on the northern tip of Saishu , facing the Yellow Sea .
description_long: In ' ani In ' ani was a city on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . In ' ani stood on the northern tip of Saishu , facing the Yellow Sea . History . Around 1357 DR , a pride of sea lion s harassed shipping around In ' ani . Dan Zor , the leader of Saishu , sought adventurers who would destroy the beasts . Inhabitants . The fishermen of In ' ani , along with those of Ansong , were claimed to be the best in the world , having done such things as eliminate the prides of sea lions in the Straits of Koryo and catch the enormous eel Ghartii Nung .

title: In Sylvan Shadows
description: In Sylvan Shadows In Sylvan Shadows is the second book of The Cleric Quintet by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: In Sylvan Shadows In Sylvan Shadows is the second book of The Cleric Quintet by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . Cadderly Bonaduce ventures into Shilmista at the biding of the elven prince Elbereth to help the wild elves push back the invading force sent by Castle Trinity .

title: Inanna
description: Inanna Inanna was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her " daughter " , Ishtar ) . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was a shepherd ' s staff .
description_long: Inanna Inanna was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her " daughter " , Ishtar ) . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was a shepherd ' s staff . Description . Inanna manifested as a beautiful human female . She wielded a small double - bladed brass axe that caused any armor it hit to crumble into dust . Her breast plates negated any damage against heat , cold , fangs , or claws . She drove a chariot pulled by seven flying lions in battle . Relationships . Inanna was once the wife of Enlil , but he set her aside , leaving her to seethe under his rule . The goddess Ishtar was born from Inanna . Once they were the same being , but as Inanna ' s people grew more civilized , her pantheon split in two , with new aspects of the older gods becoming entities in their own right . History . Inanna presumably came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " . She was killed by one of the Orcish gods in - 1071 DR , and her body was laid to rest in a God - Tomb in Unther .

title: Inata Eller
description: Inata Eller Inata Eller was a wizard sage specialized in Outer Planes in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . History . Inata studied under her second cousin , Gustofsen Eller , probably the most renowned planar expert in the Realms .
description_long: Inata Eller Inata Eller was a wizard sage specialized in Outer Planes in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . History . Inata studied under her second cousin , Gustofsen Eller , probably the most renowned planar expert in the Realms . In 1358 she was hired by a gathering of leaders of both Chondath and Turmish to discuss the menace of the arcanaloth Yrkhetep . She advised that had learned from a vision Yrkhetep was building a doomsday device called the Infinity Train , that must to be destroyed . ( In truth the vision was granted by Anthraxus . Inata then guided the Iron Legion to Hades for the last battle with Yrkhetep . Personality . Inata was well known for her integrity . However she was shy and naive .

title: Inayah bint In ' am
description: Inayah bint In ' am Inayah bint In ' am was an elven sha ' ir and resident of note in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Through magic Inayah was able to disguise herself to appear as a bent old woman .
description_long: Inayah bint In ' am Inayah bint In ' am was an elven sha ' ir and resident of note in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Through magic Inayah was able to disguise herself to appear as a bent old woman . Personality . Inayah was secretive , hiding her true powers so no one in Hawa knew her importance to the city . She believed that the mamluk s of Qudra had gained too much power and decided to secretly offer her services to Hawa to help balance things out . Abilities . An accomplished sha ' ir , Inayah had considerable power but was not one to flaunt it . Possessions . Inayah owned several shacks along the docks and would use these to enter while disguised and emerge elsewhere as someone else . She also owned a house near the Free Market where she kept many magical items . Activities . Inayah was the sha ' ir responsible for binding the marid Najit ' aqalat in service as harbormaster . She renegotiated Najit ' s terms of service every 101 days . She spent most of her day in the Free Market selling herbs and spices . Relationships . Beyond their professional relationship , Inayah rewarded Najit with special treasure she thought he would enjoy .

title: Incandescent Eye
description: Incandescent Eye The Incandescent Eye was a powerful magic gem originating from the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This crimson - colored gem was the size of a cherry .
description_long: Incandescent Eye The Incandescent Eye was a powerful magic gem originating from the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This crimson - colored gem was the size of a cherry . Powers . So long as the " Eye " was visible , no creature from the Elemental Plane of Fire could harm the owner . The owner could cast " firefeed " once per day to magically heal themselves when they touched any flame . When using this power , the intensity of the flame was directly related to the amount of healing granted , with stronger flames granting more healing than weaker ones . Any flame used to heal in this manner was immediately extinguished . Once per week the bearer of the " Eye " could summon and command a large fire elemental as if the creature were summoned via a " brazier commanding fire elementals " . Rumors & Legends . It was rumored that Nar - Aidiya was gifted the " Incandescent Eye " after completing a special mission for Kossuth .

title: Incandescent blue ioun stone ( githzerai )
description: Incandescent blue ioun stone ( githzerai ) This incandescent blue ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " created by the githzerai that boosted the wisdom of the bearer . Description . It was a spherical blue stone , weighing 1 lb ( 453 g ) .
description_long: Incandescent blue ioun stone ( githzerai ) This incandescent blue ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " created by the githzerai that boosted the wisdom of the bearer . Description . It was a spherical blue stone , weighing 1 lb ( 453 g ) . Powers . When attuned , the " incandescent blue ioun stone " increased the owner ' s wisdom . History . In a past age , in a realm beyond the Astral Plane , the githzerai craftsman Bashenee created an " incandescent blue ioun stone " for a great githzerai monk , who later fell in battle with githyanki . The stone circulated among the githyanki for many years , until it was given to the mind flayer Oinchack ' olp , who treated it as a prized possession . Around 1311 DR in Icewind Dale , Oinchack ' olp was roaming the Underdark beneath Icewind Dale when he lost the " ioun stone " , and some drider s found it . Oinchack ' olp ordered some passing adventurers to retrieve it from the driders ' lair .

title: Incantation
description: Incantation The school of incantation contained spells that targeted magic itself and the way of casting it . Like other schools of effect , it thus grouped spells not like the traditional nine schools of magic based on their philosophy , but on what they affected . The schools of conjuration / summoning , illusion / phantasm , invocation / evocation and necromancy were considered opposed to incantation .
description_long: Incantation The school of incantation contained spells that targeted magic itself and the way of casting it . Like other schools of effect , it thus grouped spells not like the traditional nine schools of magic based on their philosophy , but on what they affected . The schools of conjuration / summoning , illusion / phantasm , invocation / evocation and necromancy were considered opposed to incantation . Specialists in this school , called incantatrix es ( or incantatars ) , were exceedingly rare . None were known outside of western Faerûn . Subschools . Incantation spells could be divided into four groups :

title: Incantatrix
description: Incantatrix Incantatrix , whose male equivalent is the Incantatar , is a special prestige class whose members are the most skilled practitioners of metamagic . They study and shape spells in their raw effects and can modify the spells of allies , magic items and even active spells cast by another . They dislike extraplanar intrusions of Faerûn , having a particular fondness for magic that thwarts extraplanar beings while seeking out and destroying planar portal s and gates .
description_long: Incantatrix Incantatrix , whose male equivalent is the Incantatar , is a special prestige class whose members are the most skilled practitioners of metamagic . They study and shape spells in their raw effects and can modify the spells of allies , magic items and even active spells cast by another . They dislike extraplanar intrusions of Faerûn , having a particular fondness for magic that thwarts extraplanar beings while seeking out and destroying planar portal s and gates . Someone seems to think that they are not dangerous against normal opponents , but they change their mind as soon as they see the sheer destructive power of some spells modified by a couple of metamagic effects . Most incantatrixes are skilled wizard s or sorcerer s as well as a small number of bard s . Very few cleric s or druid s explore this path as they rely on extraplanar entities , which strongly conflicts with the incantatrix ' s methods .

title: Incendiary cloud
description: Incendiary cloud Incendiary cloud was a conjuration spell that summoned a cloud of smoke and embers . Effects . Prior to the Time of Troubles , for Parwyyd Hanifar at least , an " incendiary cloud " spell evoked a cloud around 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: Incendiary cloud Incendiary cloud was a conjuration spell that summoned a cloud of smoke and embers . Effects . Prior to the Time of Troubles , for Parwyyd Hanifar at least , an " incendiary cloud " spell evoked a cloud around 20 ft ( 6 . 0 m ) to a side and 10 ft ( 3 . 0 m ) high , and it billowed outwards in all directions . After 90 seconds , it caught fire , and after another two minutes it turned to blinding fog . After the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , an " incendiary cloud " spell created a cloud of billowing smoke containing hot embers that obscured sight , similar to a " fog cloud " . The embers had the potential to burn anyone in the cloud . The cloud was 40 ft ( 12 . 1 m ) wide and 20 ft ( 6 . 0 m ) high . The cloud spread slowly out from the point at which it was cast , and the caster had the option to move its point of origin by up to 60 ft ( 18 . 3 meters ) at a time . The smoke was dispersed by wind , and the spell could not be cast underwater . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Parwyyd ' s tower was under siege . His personal assistant Dunstanny suggested that Parwyyd employ an " incendiary cloud " spell , which quickly drove the attackers off .

title: Incendiary sword
description: Incendiary sword Incendiary sword is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those who follow the astral fire path . When it is cast , " incendiary sword " causes the blade of the swordmage casting the spell to erupt into flames , which the swordmage then hurls to a location within twenty - five feet of him or herself . When the blade strikes the ground it erupts again , creating a fiery blast zone of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter , burning any creatures unfortunate enough to be caught within , burning them repeatedly for several minutes even after the fire has dissipated .
description_long: Incendiary sword Incendiary sword is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those who follow the astral fire path . When it is cast , " incendiary sword " causes the blade of the swordmage casting the spell to erupt into flames , which the swordmage then hurls to a location within twenty - five feet of him or herself . When the blade strikes the ground it erupts again , creating a fiery blast zone of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter , burning any creatures unfortunate enough to be caught within , burning them repeatedly for several minutes even after the fire has dissipated . The blade used in the attack disintegrates and reforms within the hand of its wielder nearly instantaneously . " Incendiary sword " can be reused after a short rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Indeema
description: Indeema Indeema was a halfling cleric living on Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . She was the ruler of a tribe of halfings called the Tarangu . Description .
description_long: Indeema Indeema was a halfling cleric living on Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . She was the ruler of a tribe of halfings called the Tarangu . Description . Indeema was overweight and heavily tanned . She had an ample supply of freckles . Activities . Indeema served as the ruler of the Tarangu and a cleric of the crab god Kar ' r ' rga . She supervised all sacrifices made to the god which usually consisted of offerings left along the lagoon . Most of the time these offerings were consumed by animals inhabiting the region , but sometimes Kar ' r ' rga would come ashore and claim the offering and a halfling victim if the mood suited him .

title: Indesm
description: Indesm Indesm was a noble house of Cormyr . Bases . They were situated in Arabel .
description_long: Indesm Indesm was a noble house of Cormyr . Bases . They were situated in Arabel . The Indesms owned the hold of Hawkhar , which lay north - east of the Wyvernwater and northwest of Firefall Vale . History . The Indesms supported the Lost King Gondegal in his brief insurrection in the Year of the Dragon , 1352 DR . Following the death of King Azoun IV during the Abraxus affair , the Indesm family preferred to have Vangerdahast as regent , rather government by a ruling council , as did many families with country estates .

title: Indrila Demaz
description: Indrila Demaz Indrila Demaz was the Queen of Velprin and leader of the human army that invaded the Yuirwood in response to attacks from the half - elves living there . She became queen in 1058 DR . A year later , in 1059 DR , she drove the half - elves further back into the forest .
description_long: Indrila Demaz Indrila Demaz was the Queen of Velprin and leader of the human army that invaded the Yuirwood in response to attacks from the half - elves living there . She became queen in 1058 DR . A year later , in 1059 DR , she drove the half - elves further back into the forest . Eventually , in 1065 DR , Indrila was defeated by Brindor Olósynne at the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm . This triggered the surrender of the humans and the formation of Aglarond .

title: Indrizil
description: Indrizil Indrizil was a female drow priestess of Lolth from Cormanthor . Abilities . As a priestess of Lolth , Indrizil once had the favor of Lolth .
description_long: Indrizil Indrizil was a female drow priestess of Lolth from Cormanthor . Abilities . As a priestess of Lolth , Indrizil once had the favor of Lolth . However , during the Silence of Lolth , Indrizil had lost her powers like others of her kind . Relationships . Indrizil had a close relationship with Rhavauz , a cousin who resided in Szith Morcane after fleeing Maerimydra in 1372 DR . History . Before the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , Indrizil had been a priestess in the favor of Lolth and lived in Cormanthor . By Marpenoth of 1372 DR , Indrizil had been in correspondence with her cousin , Rhavauz , a guard officer who had converted to the cult of Kiaransalee after the fall of Maerimydra .

title: Ineddra
description: Ineddra Ineddra was a high elf member of the Lords ' Alliance in Cormanthor . Activities . Ineddra was a scholar .
description_long: Ineddra Ineddra was a high elf member of the Lords ' Alliance in Cormanthor . Activities . Ineddra was a scholar . She specialized in study planar dynamiches , in particular the treats from other planes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Ineddra discovered that someone in the Allano rothé farm had discovered a secret hideout of House Dlardrageth and went to investigate . There she met an adventuring party .

title: Infernal death
description: Infernal death Infernal death was a rare magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara . Description . This liquid was derived from the of fire elemental s .
description_long: Infernal death Infernal death was a rare magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara . Description . This liquid was derived from the of fire elemental s . Uses . Infernal death was a slow - acting poison that caused death within 12 – 48 hours . This poison was highly reactive and was administered through spicy dishes where it could be ingested . Victims who resisted the poison ' s deadly properties still developed a debilitating rash that lasted for several days . The only means of curing someone affected by this poison was by casting " neutralize poison " and " protection from fire " with a ten - foot radius simultaneously . Thus , two cleric s were needed to cure the victim .

title: Infernal language
description: Infernal language Infernal is the language of the baatezu , a subtype of devil s . Infernal was brought to Toril through contact with evil beings from other planes . It is described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity .
description_long: Infernal language Infernal is the language of the baatezu , a subtype of devil s . Infernal was brought to Toril through contact with evil beings from other planes . It is described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity . Cleric s often take the time to learn it , and the Infernal alphabet is used to transcribe the Thay an dialect of the Mulhorandi language . Castes of Speech . The Infernal tongue is tied closely to the baatezu caste system , being divided into four parts . Though each part uses the same basic foundation , each expresses different concepts and uses different words .

title: Inferno ( spell )
description: Inferno ( spell ) The spell Inferno sets a creature aflame . When a druid casts this spell , the clothing , hair , flesh and items of the target burn with ferocity until the spell ends or the target manages to extinguish the flames . To cast the spell he needs a glob of beeswax .
description_long: Inferno ( spell ) The spell Inferno sets a creature aflame . When a druid casts this spell , the clothing , hair , flesh and items of the target burn with ferocity until the spell ends or the target manages to extinguish the flames . To cast the spell he needs a glob of beeswax .

title: Infestation of maggots
description: Infestation of maggots Infestation of maggots was a necromancy spell used by druid s in the realms . Effects . By touching an opponent , a druid casting this spell would cause an infestation of maggot - like creatures to cover the target creature .
description_long: Infestation of maggots Infestation of maggots was a necromancy spell used by druid s in the realms . Effects . By touching an opponent , a druid casting this spell would cause an infestation of maggot - like creatures to cover the target creature . These maggots would slowly drain one ' s constitution unless resisted or removed by a " remove disease " or " heal " spell . Otherwise , they would naturally die off once the duration of the spell ended . Components . Unlike most druidic spells , this spell required a handful of dessicated flies as a material component , in addition to verbal and somatic component s .

title: Inficedraco
description: Inficedraco The Inficedraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that " inficedracos " were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " ignidraco " genus .
description_long: Inficedraco The Inficedraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that " inficedracos " were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " ignidraco " genus . It was theorized that " inficedraco " had ferocious personalities and acted like solitary predators . " Inficedracos " continued to undergo a series of rapid evolution process until they eventually evolved into the true chromatic dragon s species some time around - 10000 DR . Supporters of the proto - dragon theory believed that chromatic dragons mentioned in historical documents written before that period of time , such as the " Parwiccan Cycle " and other similar documents , were in fact members of the " inficedraco " species . Due to the lack of evidence to prove such claims , however , that theory wasn ' t only not popular enough among scholarly circles and reputed sages , but also often ridiculed , as well as their supporters .

title: Inflict critical wounds
description: Inflict critical wounds Inflict critical wounds , also known as cause critical wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused extreme damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .
description_long: Inflict critical wounds Inflict critical wounds , also known as cause critical wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused extreme damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings . Since undead were powered by negative energy , this spell cured them of a like amount of damage , rather than harming them . The reverse of this spell , " cure serious wounds " , channeled positive energy and had the exact opposite effect ( healed the living , harmed the undead ) .

title: Inflict light wounds
description: Inflict light wounds Inflict light wounds , also known as cause light wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused light damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .
description_long: Inflict light wounds Inflict light wounds , also known as cause light wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused light damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings . Since undead were powered by negative energy , this spell cured them of a like amount of damage , rather than harming them . The reverse of this spell , " cure light wounds " , channeled positive energy and had the exact opposite effect ( healed the living , harmed the undead ) .

title: Inflict minor wounds
description: Inflict minor wounds Inflict minor wounds was a necromancy spell that generally evil clerics learned as an orison . It delivered the minimum noticeable amount of damage to a living creature . Effects .
description_long: Inflict minor wounds Inflict minor wounds was a necromancy spell that generally evil clerics learned as an orison . It delivered the minimum noticeable amount of damage to a living creature . Effects . This spell function much like " inflict light wounds " , requiring the caster to touch the creature being harmed . This spell could be used to do the minimum amount of healing to undead .

title: Inflict moderate wounds
description: Inflict moderate wounds Inflict moderate wounds , also known as cause moderate wounds was a necromancy spell that harmed the living and healed the undead . Effects . On a successful touch , this spell revitalized undead creatures or had a withering effect on the living .
description_long: Inflict moderate wounds Inflict moderate wounds , also known as cause moderate wounds was a necromancy spell that harmed the living and healed the undead . Effects . On a successful touch , this spell revitalized undead creatures or had a withering effect on the living . This spell was about twice as powerful as " inflict light wounds " but otherwise operated in the same manner . The older version of this spell was not as potent as the newer version but could knock back foes with possibly critical results on a successful attack . Plus , it was reversible ( called " cure moderate wounds " ) for use in healing the living .

title: Inflict serious wounds
description: Inflict serious wounds Inflict serious wounds , also known as cause serious wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused heavy damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .
description_long: Inflict serious wounds Inflict serious wounds , also known as cause serious wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused heavy damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings . Since undead were powered by negative energy , this spell cured them of a like amount of damage , rather than harming them . The reverse of this spell , " cure serious wounds " , channeled positive energy and had the exact opposite effect ( healed the living , harmed the undead ) .

title: Influencer Creed
description: Influencer Creed The Influencer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They believed that the best way to obtain knowledge was through indirect means . The Influencers wished to transform the societies of other races by removing important sources of lore .
description_long: Influencer Creed The Influencer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They believed that the best way to obtain knowledge was through indirect means . The Influencers wished to transform the societies of other races by removing important sources of lore . They were well known in illithid hives to be behind the mysterious death of a sage or the secret plundering of a library . Bases . The Influencers had a base called the Pillars of Thought in Oryndoll . In the city , they influenced a part of the military called the Lore Filchers .

title: Infravision
description: Infravision Infravision was a type of vision that many non - human species had , in addition to " normal sight " , in Dungeons & Dragons and Advanced Dungeons & Dragons prior to version 3 . 0 of the game . In 3 .
description_long: Infravision Infravision was a type of vision that many non - human species had , in addition to " normal sight " , in Dungeons & Dragons and Advanced Dungeons & Dragons prior to version 3 . 0 of the game . In 3 . 0 and later , the ability was removed from the game and replaced with darkvision . The primary reason for the change was that , given its name , infravision implied that the creature detected the infrared spectrum of light resulting a variety of special considerations . Like darkvision , infravision allows a creature to see in complete darkness up to a set distance , though not in or through darkness that is magical in origin . Creatures able to use infravision are often able to shift between the normal spectrum of light and that of infravision at will . While making use of the infrared spectrum , their eyes glow red . Creatures known to have infravision include : Spell . " Infravision " was also the name of a wizard spell that bestowed this ability on the target .

title: Ingdal ' s Arm
description: Ingdal ' s Arm Ingdal ' s Arm was a human settlement in the area that would become known as Aglarond . It was settled in 756 DR . The settlement was the site of the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR .
description_long: Ingdal ' s Arm Ingdal ' s Arm was a human settlement in the area that would become known as Aglarond . It was settled in 756 DR . The settlement was the site of the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR . In 1368 DR , Ingdal ' s Arm was a quiet fishing town with a population of around one thousand , made up of roughly half human s and half half - elves . It was the westernmost settlement in Aglarond , and was not far from the edge of the Yuirwood . It bordered Altumbel . The adventurer known as The Masked One made a home in Ingdal ' s Arm .

title: Ingeloakastimizilian
description: Ingeloakastimizilian Ingeloakastimizilian was a white dragon that lived in a region of the Reghed glacier known as Evermelt . Personality . He spent most of his time sleeping on a bed of ice that covered his hoard .
description_long: Ingeloakastimizilian Ingeloakastimizilian was a white dragon that lived in a region of the Reghed glacier known as Evermelt . Personality . He spent most of his time sleeping on a bed of ice that covered his hoard . History . He was killed by Drizzt Do ' Urden and Wulfgar on Eleasis 26 , 1356 DR , after Wulfgar threw his warhammer Aegis - fang into a stalactite that fell and impaled him , so that he would have a trophy that would enable him to challenge the leader of his barbarian tribe to a duel . Interestingly , the trophy was the dragon ' s horns , a part not usually found on white dragons . Notes . The barbarian tribes north of the Spine of the World mountain range called him " Icingdeath " , although this name is more commonly associated with one of Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s scimitars . ( This is due to the fact that Drizzt found the scimitar Icingdeath in the dragon Icingdeath ' s hoard . )

title: Inglor Brathren
description: Inglor Brathren Inglor Brathren was a member of the Zhentarim at Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personailty . Inglor believed that Nalaskur Thaelond was lining his pockets at the expense of the Zhentarim .
description_long: Inglor Brathren Inglor Brathren was a member of the Zhentarim at Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personailty . Inglor believed that Nalaskur Thaelond was lining his pockets at the expense of the Zhentarim . He also suspected that Chalaska Muruin was turning a blind eye to Nalaskur ' s skimming , but he feared Chalaska . History . In 1491 DR , Inglor decided that both Chalaska and Nalaskur needed framing and replacing . Taking advantage of the absence of Nalaskur , he devised a complex plot to frame Chalaska as a thief at the expense of the Zhentarim . However , some adventurers who happened to be at the inn uncovered and defeated him .

title: Inhil Lauthdryn
description: Inhil Lauthdryn Inhil Lauthdryn , nicknamed " Hurler - of - Stars " , was a mage of the 13th century DR and held the position of Magister from 1282 to 1294 DR . Description & Personality . Inhil was a tall man , grim of mood and little spoken .
description_long: Inhil Lauthdryn Inhil Lauthdryn , nicknamed " Hurler - of - Stars " , was a mage of the 13th century DR and held the position of Magister from 1282 to 1294 DR . Description & Personality . Inhil was a tall man , grim of mood and little spoken . However , he was friendly , gentle , and performed many kind deeds . Nevertheless , he also greatly enjoyed enormously destructive magic , huge , swift , blasting spells that could obliterate a castle or crack a mountain . This hobby earned him his nickname , " Hurler - of - Stars " . Despite this , he had little wish to kill or maim anyone , and would sooner destroy an empty keep than one full of people . History . Following the death of Ohland Grethgar , the former Magister , in the Year of Many Mists , 1282 DR , Azuth , god of wizards , offered the position to Inhil Lauthdryn . Inhil accepted the post . In his time , the Hurler - of - Stars destroyed many castles and city walls , leaving them in ruins . These deeds made him widely feared by those who actually owned castles and cities , and ofted spied upon by others .

title: Iniarv
description: Iniarv Iniarv was the Mage Royal of Uthtower and the lich who created the Mere of Dead Men . History . In the early years of the Uthtower realm , Iniarv served as the Mage Royal of Uthtower .
description_long: Iniarv Iniarv was the Mage Royal of Uthtower and the lich who created the Mere of Dead Men . History . In the early years of the Uthtower realm , Iniarv served as the Mage Royal of Uthtower . He built a tower near the High Road about 60 miles from Uthtower and used it as his base , releasing a number of magical beasts and experimental monsters into the wild . However , he disappeared from the public eye , choosing to become a lich and retreating to his tower ' s crypts . His whereabouts were not known until the forces of Phalorm chose the tower as a defensive spot in their fight against the orc invasion of 615 DR . The fighting enraged Iniarv . He emerged from his tower and , upon being requested by King Uth VII to aid the soldiers , called on the ocean to flood the land , turning it into the swamp known as the Mere of Dead Men . His fate after that event was unknown .

title: Iniarv ' s Tower
description: Iniarv ' s Tower Iniarv ' s Tower was a ruined tower near the Mere of Dead Men that belonged to the lich Iniarv . Geography . Iniarv ' s Tower was on the eastern side of the High Road , but it was often considered part of the Mere of Dead Men .
description_long: Iniarv ' s Tower Iniarv ' s Tower was a ruined tower near the Mere of Dead Men that belonged to the lich Iniarv . Geography . Iniarv ' s Tower was on the eastern side of the High Road , but it was often considered part of the Mere of Dead Men . The Uthtower was 60 miles ( 97 kilometers ) west of Iniarv ' s Tower . Description . Iniarv ' s Tower was described as a ruined fortress . Underneath the tower was a crypt of unknown size . Defenses . Trespassers to the tower triggered a spell known " Iniarv ' s unseen voice " , which projected a simulated voice of the tower ' s original owners . If the black dragon Waervaerendor ( thought to be Voaraghamanthar ) was present , he would copy the lich ' s voice to scare intruders . History . Iniarv ' s Tower originally belonged to Iniarv , the Mage Royal of Uthtower . He used the tower as his base and from there released a number of magical beasts and experimental monsters into the wild . Prior to 614 DR , Iniarv had mysteriously disappeared .

title: Inkstain
description: Inkstain Forgemaster Inkstain was a male dwarf and a printer . History . He originally came from Dwarves ' Deep , but later moved to the city of Procampur in the Vast .
description_long: Inkstain Forgemaster Inkstain was a male dwarf and a printer . History . He originally came from Dwarves ' Deep , but later moved to the city of Procampur in the Vast . In the early 1360s DR , he had a shop on Scribes ' Alley in the Merchant District of Procampur , though it was little more than a lean - to against a teamster ' s stable . There he had a printing press , a recent invention which he ' d shipped from Dwarves ' Deep . From his shop , he printed cheap and low - quality pamphlets , handbills and flyers . Perhaps surprisingly for a dwarf , he had an ogre apprentice named Aguul . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the lama Koja of Khazari visited Inkstain to discuss printing his new book , " A History of the Tuigan " . However , Inkstain quoted a price of 10 , 000 gold lion s just for one copy , and 500 lions for extras , which Koja was unable to pay or raise the money for . Fortunately , the god Deneir later appeared to Koja and granted him gem s worth at least 10 , 000 gold pieces to pay for the costs of printing , so Koja planned to have his book printed by Inkstain the next day . Description .

title: Inkwing
description: Inkwing Inkwing was a pixie in the Quivering Forest . Activities . Inkwing was one of the pixies living in the secret village of Thornbud .
description_long: Inkwing Inkwing was a pixie in the Quivering Forest . Activities . Inkwing was one of the pixies living in the secret village of Thornbud . History . During the reclamation of Phlan , some adventurers working under the suggestion of the Emerald Enclave asked the help of the pixies and Inkwing acted as the village ' s spokesman .

title: Inn of the Clowns
description: Inn of the Clowns The Inn of the Clowns was a weak establishment that was once a fine place , located in the village of Bloodstone . The symbol of the inn was a battered sign of a clown juggling bottles of wine . The Inn of the Clowns was once renowned all throughout the Kingdom of Damara .
description_long: Inn of the Clowns The Inn of the Clowns was a weak establishment that was once a fine place , located in the village of Bloodstone . The symbol of the inn was a battered sign of a clown juggling bottles of wine . The Inn of the Clowns was once renowned all throughout the Kingdom of Damara . The inn once housed grand entertainment and hospitality to traders far and wide , even rumored to attract the attention of nobility from far away . By the time of 1357 DR , this was no more . The war with the Kingdom of Vaasa had taken its toll on Bloodstone Village .

title: Inn of the Dragon
description: Inn of the Dragon The Inn of the Dragon was a inn found in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . After human adventurer s slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who ' d laired at the nearby Dragon Falls waterfall , the survivors took possession of the dragon ' s hoard of coins .
description_long: Inn of the Dragon The Inn of the Dragon was a inn found in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . After human adventurer s slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who ' d laired at the nearby Dragon Falls waterfall , the survivors took possession of the dragon ' s hoard of coins . They chose to settle there and constructed themselves a stronghold , while the village grew around it over four generations . By 1370 DR , the stronghold had changed owners and was redeveloped as an inn , called the Inn of the Dragon . Description . As a former stronghold , the Inn of the Dragon was a fortified inn , constructed of stone and fir wood . It dominated the village around it . Inhabitants . The village priest and one of the original adventurers , Keldar of the Forest , lived at the inn .

title: Inn of the Dripping Dagger
description: Inn of the Dripping Dagger The Inn of the Dripping Dagger was the favored bar and home to many adventurers , mercenaries , misfits and soldiers in the city of Waterdeep . the Dripping Dagger ' s prices always seemed to be a bit lower for those who were down on their luck . The inn was best known for its seemingly haunted front door which would utter cryptic and seemingly menacing phrases such as ' His head will be found in a basket on Ship Street .
description_long: Inn of the Dripping Dagger The Inn of the Dripping Dagger was the favored bar and home to many adventurers , mercenaries , misfits and soldiers in the city of Waterdeep . the Dripping Dagger ' s prices always seemed to be a bit lower for those who were down on their luck . The inn was best known for its seemingly haunted front door which would utter cryptic and seemingly menacing phrases such as ' His head will be found in a basket on Ship Street . ' The city guard enlisted the help of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors who investigated the phenomenon . The mage s of the order were unable to reach a conclusion as to the cause of the strange utterances but several theories remained popular ranging from a prank to the belief that a rogue Voice of Oghma was responsible . Geography . The tavern was located in the Trades Ward of Waterdeep just off the High Road . Staff . In 1372 DR the inn was run by the courteous Filiare . In 1479 DR the Lohthuntle family ran the Dripping Dagger .

title: Inn of the Glowing Gem
description: Inn of the Glowing Gem The Inn of the Glowing Gem was an establishment in Yartar . History . Around 1356 DR , a group of adventurers , later known as the Heroes of Ascore , awoke in the morning to find thieves from the Kraken Society had stolen all their possessions .
description_long: Inn of the Glowing Gem The Inn of the Glowing Gem was an establishment in Yartar . History . Around 1356 DR , a group of adventurers , later known as the Heroes of Ascore , awoke in the morning to find thieves from the Kraken Society had stolen all their possessions . Appendix . Behind the scenes . The inn is the starting point for " Gateway to the Savage Frontier " video game .

title: Inn of the Nine Swords
description: Inn of the Nine Swords The Nine Swords , also known as the Inn of the Nine Swords was a high - quality inn found in the village of Swords Pool in the Vast . It stood on the western side of the road , between the North Road and the pond of Swords Pool . History .
description_long: Inn of the Nine Swords The Nine Swords , also known as the Inn of the Nine Swords was a high - quality inn found in the village of Swords Pool in the Vast . It stood on the western side of the road , between the North Road and the pond of Swords Pool . History . The inn was named for the nine sword s of the Nine Swords Company . These were hidden in Swords Pool , the body of water that gave its name to the village . In the mid - 1370s DR , several young blade magic ians of the Vast re - founded the Nine Swords Company . They used the Inn of the Nine Swords . Owners . The Nine Swords inn was owned by the three Mellicot sisters : Melicent , Meliors , and Melusine .

title: Inn of the Sea Bass
description: Inn of the Sea Bass The Inn of the Sea Bass was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This was a small inn that afforded its inhabitants a splendid view of the Caliph ' s Harbor .
description_long: Inn of the Sea Bass The Inn of the Sea Bass was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This was a small inn that afforded its inhabitants a splendid view of the Caliph ' s Harbor . Inhabitants . Keyfa al - Parid lived at the inn so she could be close the her duties at the harbor .

title: Innanig
description: Innanig Innanig was an orc shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orcs and drow on Silver Marches , Innanig led a contingent of troops against Nesme with his fellow goblin shaman Kllug .
description_long: Innanig Innanig was an orc shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orcs and drow on Silver Marches , Innanig led a contingent of troops against Nesme with his fellow goblin shaman Kllug . However , they were deceived by the reborn Regis .

title: Innarlith
description: Innarlith Innarlith occupied the eastern tip of the Lake of Steam . It was a city where anything could be purchased , though how legal the acquisition might be was another story . History .
description_long: Innarlith Innarlith occupied the eastern tip of the Lake of Steam . It was a city where anything could be purchased , though how legal the acquisition might be was another story . History . Around 1372 DR , the ruler of the city was Ransar Pristoleph . Ransar cleaned out all rogue dens and monster dens in the Firesteap Mountains to protect the caravans . Ransar Pristoleph apparently had ties to the church of Cyric . Inhabitants . Innarlith was the home of the Magister Talatha Vaerovree . Because this office was frequently filled by a wizard who had killed the prior Magister however , it was likely difficult if not impossible to find Talatha here .

title: Inner Planes
description: Inner Planes Inner Planes is the collective term for a subset of the known planes of existence in the Great Wheel cosmology model and the World Tree cosmology model . The term refers to the placement of the planes at the center of the concentric spheres that made up the Great Wheel model . The Inner Planes were also called the elemental planes because each one was primarily made up of one type of matter .
description_long: Inner Planes Inner Planes is the collective term for a subset of the known planes of existence in the Great Wheel cosmology model and the World Tree cosmology model . The term refers to the placement of the planes at the center of the concentric spheres that made up the Great Wheel model . The Inner Planes were also called the elemental planes because each one was primarily made up of one type of matter . There were six major and twelve minor elemental planes and they could be reached from the Prime Material Plane by traveling through the Ethereal plane . The six major Inner planes were : The minor of the Inner Planes could be divided into three groups of four : In the World Tree cosmology model , which became popular with some scholars before the Spellplague , the Inner planes were moved to the roots of the World Tree and the more appropriate name elemental planes was used to describe them as a group , but the name " Inner Planes " was still frequently used . After the Spellplague , most of the matter making up the elemental planes collapsed together to become the Elemental Chaos .

title: Inner dragon
description: Inner dragon Inner dragons are specialized dragonborn fighter s who train themselves to unleash their draconic heritage as martial power . These individuals nurture the raw fury of their ancestry into an impressive fighting style , manifesting draconic attributes as they grow in experience and power . Whether acquiring these powers through training by others or personal discovery , inner dragons are a fearsome foe to behold .
description_long: Inner dragon Inner dragons are specialized dragonborn fighter s who train themselves to unleash their draconic heritage as martial power . These individuals nurture the raw fury of their ancestry into an impressive fighting style , manifesting draconic attributes as they grow in experience and power . Whether acquiring these powers through training by others or personal discovery , inner dragons are a fearsome foe to behold . Abilities . Inner dragons hone their body , spirit , and mind to further their inherent abilities as distant kin of the dragon s . Much like dragon disciple s they acquire more and more draconic qualities over time , though they do this through physical training rather than magic . Inner dragons manifest their " dragon breath " more commonly than most dragonborn , sometimes even twice in the same battle , and over time train it to become more potent and long - lasting . Inner dragons also refine the innately powerful fury of their race , turning their own pain into a source of power . With enough training , inner dragons manifest powerful exploit s . Their own draconic blood becomes a weapon , scalding enemies who are splashed by it .

title: Innesdav
description: Innesdav Innesdav was an elderly monk living in Candlekeep . Description . Physically , he was tall and thin .
description_long: Innesdav Innesdav was an elderly monk living in Candlekeep . Description . Physically , he was tall and thin . Activities . He was an important influence in Baylee Arnvold ' s early life and taught him much , and continued to act as his contact in Candlekeep , sometimes receiving important documents from him via a bag that was magically linked to a closet in the citadel .

title: Innovindil
description: Innovindil Innovindil is a moon elf from the Moonvines in the Moonwood and friend and lover of Tarathiel . Physical description . Innovindil is fairly short with yellow hair and strikingly blue eyes .
description_long: Innovindil Innovindil is a moon elf from the Moonvines in the Moonwood and friend and lover of Tarathiel . Physical description . Innovindil is fairly short with yellow hair and strikingly blue eyes . Equipment . Innovindil carries a bow , a slender sword and a dirk . Appearances . She first appeared in the 2002 novel " The Thousand Orcs " , by R . A . Salvatore . She is also in the two subsequent novels of " The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy " and accompanies Drizzt to bury Ellifain in the short story " Comrades at Odds . " Her latest appearance is in " The Orc King " . Plot . In " The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy " , Innovindil and her partner Tarathiel notice a pair of dwarves around a campfire in their home , the Moonwood . The two take the dwarves , Ivan and Pikel Bouldershoulder , prisoner until discovering that their intentions are not to harm their woodland home . After realizing that the two dwarves plan on representing the priest Cadderly Bonaduce at the coronation of Bruenor Battlehammer in Mithral Hall , Innovindil and Tarathiel realize that the dark elf Drizzt Do ' Urden will be returning to the area .

title: Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess
description: Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess The Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa .
