The majority of the kuo - toa who pick up this prestige class are monitors ( monk s ) who have been charged with the duty to protect their communities from internal dangers such as insurgence and betrayal to outside forces . They do this with great ability , using their skills at intimidation , detection of falsehoods , and martial skill to end any danger to the lawful authorities .
description_long: Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess The Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa . The majority of the kuo - toa who pick up this prestige class are monitors ( monk s ) who have been charged with the duty to protect their communities from internal dangers such as insurgence and betrayal to outside forces . They do this with great ability , using their skills at intimidation , detection of falsehoods , and martial skill to end any danger to the lawful authorities . Inquisitors are utterly devoted , believing it a holy duty to keep the status quo and prevent any chaotic elements from gathering sufficient strength to wreck havoc . Only their church and the goddess Blibdoolpoolp have any control over the actions of these elite few .

title: Inri
description: Inri Inri is an elven sorcerer and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Inri has hair like gold and a golden complexion .
description_long: Inri Inri is an elven sorcerer and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Inri has hair like gold and a golden complexion . Her eyes are a pink and red hue . She normally wears a robe and veils that shift color in the light She wears silver bracers on her arms . Personality . Inri is the companion and lover of Thard of the Sky Ponies . Inri rides her horse sidesaddle . Magic . Inri ' s Familiar is a black raven named Anthas . Anthas can speak perfect Elvish . History . Inri was a member of the Moor Runners for years . In 1364 DR she was killed by Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma , who in human form beheaded Inri with her Katana .

title: Insanity
description: Insanity Insanity , also known as descent into madness , was an enchantment spell that drove a subject permanently insane . Effects . The enchanted creature was under the constant effect of a " confusion " , causing them to act and erratically .
description_long: Insanity Insanity , also known as descent into madness , was an enchantment spell that drove a subject permanently insane . Effects . The enchanted creature was under the constant effect of a " confusion " , causing them to act and erratically . The " insanity " spell could not be removed with " remove curse " , but only with " greater restoration " , " limited wish " , " miracle " , and " wish " .

title: Insect plague
description: Insect plague Insect plague was a conjuration spell that could summon swarms of locust s to attack all creatures in an area . Effects . The summoned insects blanketed the area of effect , biting and stinging every creature relentlessly , reducing visibility down to 10 ft ( 3 m ) , and preventing all spellcasting .
description_long: Insect plague Insect plague was a conjuration spell that could summon swarms of locust s to attack all creatures in an area . Effects . The summoned insects blanketed the area of effect , biting and stinging every creature relentlessly , reducing visibility down to 10 ft ( 3 m ) , and preventing all spellcasting . Armor did not protect and invisibility was useless to avoid the swarms . Small creatures and anything with failing morale would move at top speed in a random direction until they were well away from the plague . The insects did not pursue fleeing targets but remained in the spot they were summoned for the duration of the spell . Sustained large fires and smoke , or strong winds were effective in driving the insects away but a blast from a " fireball " would only clear an area briefly . Components . Newer versions of this spell require only verbal and somatic components plus the priest ' s divine focus or holy symbol . Older versions also required a pinch of sugar , a few kernels of grain , and a smear of fat .

title: Inselm Hhune
description: Inselm Hhune Duke Inselm Hhune was a male human merchant who rose to become the leader of the Knights of the Shield but was under the influence of Gargauth , the Hidden Lord . He was also duke of Kamlann Duchy and Lord Watch Chancellor of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description .
description_long: Inselm Hhune Duke Inselm Hhune was a male human merchant who rose to become the leader of the Knights of the Shield but was under the influence of Gargauth , the Hidden Lord . He was also duke of Kamlann Duchy and Lord Watch Chancellor of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description . Inselm was an obese , black - haired , mustached man with a conspiratorial mind like no other . Despite his constant conniving , he was skilled at covering his tracks and was highly respected by most of his subjects for doing good things for his duchy . As he was careful to never be caught in a lie , only a select few ever suspected him . Holdings . While his official estate was in Kamlann , just outside Zazesspur , Inselm secretly owned property in many places , including Athkatla , Murann , Myratma , and Baldur ' s Gate . It was at his manse in Baldur ' s Gate where the Knights of the Shield made their headquarters . His official seat as Duke of Kamlann was located in the Starspire Mountains and was named Tresper Hall . History . Duke of Kamlann . Inselm was an ordinary merchant who happened to be at the right place at the right time during the Tethyrian Interregnum .

title: Inspired aim
description: Inspired aim Inspired aim is an enchantment spell that makes it easier for allies to hit targets with ranged attacks . Effect . You inspire allies within 40 feet to focus their minds on hitting their intended targets .
description_long: Inspired aim Inspired aim is an enchantment spell that makes it easier for allies to hit targets with ranged attacks . Effect . You inspire allies within 40 feet to focus their minds on hitting their intended targets . All affected allies gain insight into their opponents movements , making it easier to hit them .

title: Inspiring reaction
description: Inspiring reaction Inspiring reaction was a warlord exploit that brought immediate aid to a wounded ally . Effects . Any wound received by the warlord or an ally could initiate this exploit .
description_long: Inspiring reaction Inspiring reaction was a warlord exploit that brought immediate aid to a wounded ally . Effects . Any wound received by the warlord or an ally could initiate this exploit . Immediately after receiving injury , the warlord could reach out and touch a close ally and heal some of his or her wounds . The warlord could choose to heal himself or herself instead .

title: Instruments of the Bards
description: Instruments of the Bards The Instruments of the Bards were magical masterwork musical instruments that were extremely effective in the hands of bard s . Description . They were in every way superior to their ordinary counterparts .
description_long: Instruments of the Bards The Instruments of the Bards were magical masterwork musical instruments that were extremely effective in the hands of bard s . Description . They were in every way superior to their ordinary counterparts . Their powers could only be effectively used by bards , and in fact any non - bard that attempted to use one of these instruments ran the risk of injury . Powers . Bards wielding an Instrument of the Bards had their charming abilities greatly amplified by their magic . All Instruments of the Bards had the capability of storing spells . Besides the specific spells that each individual instrument could hold , a bard playing any one such instrument could invoke the spells " fly " , " invisibility " , " levitate " , and " protection from evil and good " , once a day , until the next dawn . History . The first of the Instruments of the Bards were created by a legendary bard in the Moonshae Isles named Falataer . He used the instruments to test and reward the students of each of the seven levels of his bardic college , which came to be regarded individually as legendary bard colleges in their own right .

title: Instruments of the jann
description: Instruments of the jann The instruments of the jann referred to a legendary collection of extraordinary magical musical instruments created by members of the major genie races . History . The various instruments were created to honor the ascension of each new jann chieftain of the High Desert .
description_long: Instruments of the jann The instruments of the jann referred to a legendary collection of extraordinary magical musical instruments created by members of the major genie races . History . The various instruments were created to honor the ascension of each new jann chieftain of the High Desert . With each new ascension , the genie races collaborated to create a full " takht " of instruments including an " ' ud " , " nay " , " rababah " , " riqq " , and " qanun " . It was widely believed that the genies undertook marvelous quests in order to obtain the rare materials needed to craft the magical instruments . During the jann ascension ceremony , these special instruments were played by the most skilled mortals in Zakhara . Some of the musicians volunteered , but others were sometimes taken against their will if their skill was great enough . The music performed by the " takht " was said to be so awe - inspiring that the mortal musicians , as well as any other mortal within hearing range , ran the risk of becoming deaf for the next decade .

title: Insulation
description: Insulation Insulation was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . " Insulation " provided temporary resistance to electrical damage to the caster .
description_long: Insulation Insulation was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . " Insulation " provided temporary resistance to electrical damage to the caster . Components . This spell required 1 " ( 2 . 54 cm ) square piece of rubber to cast . The rubber needed to be placed between the caster ' s foot and the ground and remain in contact with the caster ' s skin at all times for the spell to work .

title: Insurrection
description: Insurrection Insurrection by Thomas M . Reid is the second book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Plot .
description_long: Insurrection Insurrection by Thomas M . Reid is the second book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Plot . The band of drow led by Quenthel Baenre — Pharaun Mizzrym , Ryld Argith , Jeggred Baenre , Valas Hune , and Faeryl Zauvirr — travel from Menzoberranzan to the city of Ched Nasad in order to determine the city ' s status and retrieve trade goods belonging to House Baenre . In order to quicken their pace , they travel through Ammarindar , the domain of Kaanyr Vhok , who sends his tanarukk s under the leadership of the alu - fiend Aliisza to intercept them . The drow band refuses to meet with Vhok and Aliisza , intrigued , allows them to defeat her minions and continue on to Ched Nasad . Gromph Baenre continues to monitor the group via a communication spell with Pharaun . When the travelers arrive , Ched Nasad appears to be in a state of chaos . They sneak into the city in order to lay low , but the lower levels of the city are swarming with rabble and apparent refugees constantly mobbing others .

title: Intellect devourer
description: Intellect devourer Intellect devourers resembled walking brains on a set of bestial legs . They were servants of the mind flayer s and took over their victims ' minds on their behalf . Ecology .
description_long: Intellect devourer Intellect devourers resembled walking brains on a set of bestial legs . They were servants of the mind flayer s and took over their victims ' minds on their behalf . Ecology . Illithids bred intellect devourers by subjecting the brain of a creature ( usually a thrall ) to a ritual in which the brain started sprouting legs . During this process , the newly created aberration passed through a larval form called ustilagor before reaching its final adult form .

title: Intelligent item
description: Intelligent item Intelligent items or sentient items were magical item s that possessed a degree of intelligence and sentience . A tiny fraction ( less than one percent ) of the magical items created throughout history had actual intelligence . They had alignment s , could bestow additional powers on their user , and could even have enough of an ego ( a key quality of these creations ) to choose who was worthy to use them .
description_long: Intelligent item Intelligent items or sentient items were magical item s that possessed a degree of intelligence and sentience . A tiny fraction ( less than one percent ) of the magical items created throughout history had actual intelligence . They had alignment s , could bestow additional powers on their user , and could even have enough of an ego ( a key quality of these creations ) to choose who was worthy to use them .

title: Interior Faerûn
description: Interior Faerûn With the exception of the Shining Plains , the interior lands of Faerûn lie along the irregular western coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . In the north the Dragonmere arm of the sea extends far to the west , ending close to the Western Heartlands . To the south , the Vilhon Reach forms a second arm leading to the southwest .
description_long: Interior Faerûn With the exception of the Shining Plains , the interior lands of Faerûn lie along the irregular western coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . In the north the Dragonmere arm of the sea extends far to the west , ending close to the Western Heartlands . To the south , the Vilhon Reach forms a second arm leading to the southwest . Regions . Chondath . On the southern shore opposite Turmish is this once - powerful nation of city - states . The warlike people of this land are generally manipulative and inscrutable by nature , and distrust magic and its practitioners . The region is bordered to the south by the extensive Chondalwood , along the east by the region of Chessenta , and to the southwest by Sespech . Notable port cities are Arrabar , Reth , Hlath , and Iljak . Cormyr . This is a prosperous , civilized land that lies at the western end of the Sea of Fallen Stars , to the south of the Anauroch desert and the Dalelands . Along its eastern border is the merchant nation of Sembia , and to the west are the broad Western Heartlands . Cormyr is a unified monarchy with its capital at the port city of Suzail .

title: Interior Zakhara
description: Interior Zakhara Vast interior Zakhara , like its Zakharan population , was divided into two distinct parts : the dry and barren landlocked elevation of the Haunted Lands took up its north and east and were the dwelling place of hardy desert nomads , genie s , and the remnants of more bountiful days . Its south and west , at the shores of Suq Bay and the Golden Gulf , contained great centers of civilization in the incomparable Cities of the Heart and the devout Cities of the Pantheon . Geographic limits .
description_long: Interior Zakhara Vast interior Zakhara , like its Zakharan population , was divided into two distinct parts : the dry and barren landlocked elevation of the Haunted Lands took up its north and east and were the dwelling place of hardy desert nomads , genie s , and the remnants of more bountiful days . Its south and west , at the shores of Suq Bay and the Golden Gulf , contained great centers of civilization in the incomparable Cities of the Heart and the devout Cities of the Pantheon . Geographic limits . Towards the northwest , interior Zakhara was separated from the Free Cities of Zakhara of the north by the length of the Furrowed Mountains , where trade and travel were made difficult by savage hill tribes . In the northeast , the Haunted Lands slowly rose until they abutted the edge of the World Pillar Mountains , where the evil yak - men had their mysterious domain . The hills at the eastern edge of the Haunted Lands and , further south , the eastern - most ridges of the Mountains of Creation and the Mountains of Desolation separated interior Zakhara from the jungles of the east .

title: Intermediate deity
description: Intermediate deity An intermediate deity was a type of deity who was less powerful than a greater deity . They were , however , above lesser deities , demigod s , and dead power s in the ranking of powers . Intermediate deities had hundreds of thousands of worshipers .
description_long: Intermediate deity An intermediate deity was a type of deity who was less powerful than a greater deity . They were , however , above lesser deities , demigod s , and dead power s in the ranking of powers . Intermediate deities had hundreds of thousands of worshipers .

title: Inthracis
description: Inthracis Inthracis was an ultroloth necromancer who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Description .
description_long: Inthracis Inthracis was an ultroloth necromancer who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Description . Inthracis was a clone and kept clones of himself in reserve for his death . History . In 1373 DR , according to the reckoning of Toril , Inthracis was approached by the god Vhaeraun , who demanded that Inthracis kill the three priestesses who were candidates to become the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) : Quenthel Baenre , Danifae Yauntyrr , and Halisstra Melarn . As a reward Vhaeraun promised Inthracis a higher position . Inthracis reached the Demonweb Pits at the Pass of the Soulreaver and there battled Quenthel , Danifae , Halisstra , Jeggred Baenre , and Pharaun Mizzrym . They defeated the regiment , however , and Inthracis was killed by Pharaun . His death was not permanent , however , as he had another clone body to revive in . Relationships . Inthracis ' s main rival was Kexxon the oinoloth , Archgeneral of the Blood Rift . One of Inthracis ' s lieutenants was Nisviim , an arcanaloth enchanter . Inthracis had power over him because he knew his true name ( " Gorgalisin " ) .

title: Introduction to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
description: Introduction to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " Imagine you have entered a fantasy realm with monsters , treasures and daring deeds to be done ! Play a heroic fighter or cunning wizard . Explore old castles and chart the depths of mysterious dungeons .
description_long: Introduction to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " Imagine you have entered a fantasy realm with monsters , treasures and daring deeds to be done ! Play a heroic fighter or cunning wizard . Explore old castles and chart the depths of mysterious dungeons . The Advanced Dungeons & Dragons game has no limits . Your character can do anything you can imagine ! "

title: Inum
description: Inum Inum was a famous Iulutiun philosopher . Description . Inum was one of the " kiam " ( elders ) of the " iquemelum " ( village council ) of the village of Gronne in Alpuk on the Great Glacier .
description_long: Inum Inum was a famous Iulutiun philosopher . Description . Inum was one of the " kiam " ( elders ) of the " iquemelum " ( village council ) of the village of Gronne in Alpuk on the Great Glacier . He was widely considered one of the wisest men of all Alpuk , and folk would travel from all around to hear his wisdom . By 1359 DR , Inum was a frail old man of nearly 70 years of age . He had many wrinkles and only a few remaining teeth . He walked with a cripple . Personality . Despite his physical feebleness , Inum was of good spirits and never pessimistic . Abilities . Inum was exceptionally perceptive . He was knowledgeable on a wide array of topics , ranging from boating to poetry to marriage . He was also a riveting teller of stories . Possessions . Inum bore a typical iuak common to many Ulutiun s . Activities . Inum would offer lectures to those who would travel to Gronne to hear his wisdom . History . At some point in his life , Inum was attacked by a polar bear , which left him crippled in his left leg . He also suffered from several diseases over the course of his life that affected his breathing and the strength of his muscles .

title: Invadiah
description: Invadiah Invadiah was the most powerful erinyes in the Nine Hells and was the leader of Glasya ' s elite Erinyes guard , the Pradixikai . She had fifty - eight erinyes daughters , one cambion daughter and a cambion son named Lorcan whom she regarded as worthless . In 1478 DR , Invadiah sought to carry out Glasya ' s plot to trick Asmodeus into fighting the Abolethic Sovereignty .
description_long: Invadiah Invadiah was the most powerful erinyes in the Nine Hells and was the leader of Glasya ' s elite Erinyes guard , the Pradixikai . She had fifty - eight erinyes daughters , one cambion daughter and a cambion son named Lorcan whom she regarded as worthless . In 1478 DR , Invadiah sought to carry out Glasya ' s plot to trick Asmodeus into fighting the Abolethic Sovereignty . Unfortunately for her , the plot unraveled , primarily due to betrayal by the succubus Rohini . As punishment for her failure , Invadiah was " demoted " to succubus and her holdings given to her daughter Sairche .

title: Inverted Tower
description: Inverted Tower The Inverted Tower was the center for the study of arcane magic in Szith Morcane . Structure . The stronghold was so named because of its unusual construction of rooms branching off from a tall , octagonal cavern .
description_long: Inverted Tower The Inverted Tower was the center for the study of arcane magic in Szith Morcane . Structure . The stronghold was so named because of its unusual construction of rooms branching off from a tall , octagonal cavern . Without stairs connecting the various levels only those with capability to " levitate " or climb the smooth walls could navigate the Inverted Tower effectively . Among the connecting rooms was a chamber for instructing students in the art of spellcraft and a room dedicated to the summoning of extraplanar creatures . Defences . Boasting a complement of wizard fighter s known as the Arcane Guard , the tower had additional protection in the form of a contingent " guards and wards " spell . This was keyed to activate whenever any creature entered the spire without speaking the password , " " B ' zadaara " " . History . Despite the fall of House Morcane in 1372 DR and the decline of drow in the region after the Silence of Lolth , the Inverted Tower ' s insular community remained largely unaffected by the turmoil .

title: Invisibility purge
description: Invisibility purge Invisibility purge was an abjuration spell that disabled invisibility effects within a small area . Effects . Invisible objects and creatures that entered the protected area immediately became visible .
description_long: Invisibility purge Invisibility purge was an abjuration spell that disabled invisibility effects within a small area . Effects . Invisible objects and creatures that entered the protected area immediately became visible . If the cause of their invisibility was still in effect , they would return to invisibility upon leaving the protected area . While inside the area , spells , potions , and natural abilities for turning invisible simply failed to function at all . " Invisibility purge " did not have any effect on creatures that were naturally invisible or had no visible form . Creatures already invisible inside the area before the spell was cast were also not affected unless they turned visible and then tried to turn invisible again , or exited the area and then re - entered . The area of effect for this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) square . This spell could be cast cooperatively by multiple priests , in which case an additional square per priest could be protected , plus the duration increased with each additional caster . Components . Verbal , somatic , and material components were required to cast this spell , including a small ( no bigger than 3 in / 7 .

title: Invisible College
description: Invisible College The Invisible College was a place of study for djinni sorcerers within the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Defenses . Layer upon layer of illusions were constantly changing within and around the College , leading most sages to agree that it did not really exist .
description_long: Invisible College The Invisible College was a place of study for djinni sorcerers within the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Defenses . Layer upon layer of illusions were constantly changing within and around the College , leading most sages to agree that it did not really exist . Inhabitants . The vast majority of djinni sorcerers , along with their bound deceiver genie s , called the Invisible College home .

title: Invisible stalker
description: Invisible stalker Invisible stalkers were solitary creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Uses . They were sometimes summoned by mage s to perform tasks .
description_long: Invisible stalker Invisible stalkers were solitary creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Uses . They were sometimes summoned by mage s to perform tasks . Abilities . Stalkers had the innate ability to remain invisible even in combat . Stalkers attacked by using gusts of wind to pummel their opponent . Killing an invisible stalker anywhere other than its home plane dismissed the stalker back to its home . Personality . Invisible stalkers were elemental beings from the Plane of Air . They were composed entirely of solidified air , but unlike a normal air elemental , they were not tempestuous beings . Their calm demeanor made them invisible to normal sight . This invisibility made the stalker a perfect creature for summoners that wished to perform clandestine missions . The fact that they were so frequently summoned to the natural world made invisible stalkers hostile towards creatures on the Material Plane . Many invisible stalkers would obey their masters to the letter of their commands , and seek any way they could to subvert their magical shackles .

title: Invoker
description: Invoker Invokers , are divine spellcasters who gain their power through the direct touch of a deity , carrying with them a fragment of the god ' s divine power . This is unlike avenger s , cleric s , or paladin s , who channel their prayer s carefully through holy symbol s . Invokers have no need for such tools , however , and their prayers come directly from their god and none of their power is lost through transition .
description_long: Invoker Invokers , are divine spellcasters who gain their power through the direct touch of a deity , carrying with them a fragment of the god ' s divine power . This is unlike avenger s , cleric s , or paladin s , who channel their prayer s carefully through holy symbol s . Invokers have no need for such tools , however , and their prayers come directly from their god and none of their power is lost through transition . Invokers use these powers to control the battlefield , smite foes from a distance , or empower their allies , making them quite versatile . Braeden is a well - known invoker of Tiamat . Culture . Invokers are an unusual sort . While most divine agents draw their power through religious rites and careful training , invokers find this power to come with far greater ease than others . The divine equivalent of sorcerer s , invokers come naturally , instinctively to their abilities , leading some scholars to believe they perhaps have immortal ancestry hidden in their family bloodline . Others believe invokers are all the results of particular forms of training or perhaps chosen by a god for some divine purpose .

title: Iokharic
description: Iokharic Iokharic was the name of a script used by the Draconic language , as well as by the Auran , Ignan , and some . It consisted of runic characters equivalent to letters and numbers in human scripts . Alphabet and punctuation .
description_long: Iokharic Iokharic was the name of a script used by the Draconic language , as well as by the Auran , Ignan , and some . It consisted of runic characters equivalent to letters and numbers in human scripts . Alphabet and punctuation . To give emphasis to important concepts , Iokharic employed a special character consisting of five lines radiating outwards , similar to a star or an asterisk ( * ) , or the five heads of Tiamat . When this character was written , the word was spoken with both the first and last syllables stressed . History . Dragon s believed Iokharic was created by the dragon god Asgorath so his creations could record their impressions of the world he hoped they would inherit . Non - dragon scholars believed Iokharic was likely created long after its spoken form was standardized , as dragons had little need to write like other races . The script was believed to have been influenced by the dwarven runes , but dragons themselves dismissed such a connection . Elven scholars had the theory that kobold s , rather than dwarves , were the ones who actually created Iokharic , as it was widely believed that the earliest kobolds served dragons , learning dragon ways .

title: Iol
description: Iol Iol , also known as violet stone , was the name by which ( ) was commonly known in the Realms . Description . This semi - precious stone was predominately blue in hue , but the stone ' s color changed with viewing angle , from dark blue to straw - yellow .
description_long: Iol Iol , also known as violet stone , was the name by which ( ) was commonly known in the Realms . Description . This semi - precious stone was predominately blue in hue , but the stone ' s color changed with viewing angle , from dark blue to straw - yellow . Small specimens could be transparent but larger stones tended to have inclusions which could cause a star - like effect or , in the case of trapped hematite crystals , a flash of golden color much like sunstones . Iols were usually to best display the stone ' s color change . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Iol stones were the best component for use in making " ioun stone s " . Rumors and legends . Faerûnian legends said this gemstone had a strong affinity for magic , but few knew of its connection to " ioun stones " .

title: Ioma
description: Ioma Ioma was a small island in the Nelanther Isles to the west of Amn . The island had only one town , Ioma Town , with a population of 800 in 1479 DR . Most of the island was occupied by a mountain of the same name , which contained a large vein of Iomic crystal at its peak .
description_long: Ioma Ioma was a small island in the Nelanther Isles to the west of Amn . The island had only one town , Ioma Town , with a population of 800 in 1479 DR . Most of the island was occupied by a mountain of the same name , which contained a large vein of Iomic crystal at its peak . By the late 15th century DR , the island had become a competitor of Skaug ' s , although its port was only half as large . The island was protected by a small cadre of Cowled Wizards from Amn .

title: Iomic crystal
description: Iomic crystal Iomic crystal was a purple crystal found on the island of Ioma in the Nelanther Isles . After the Spellplague , the mineral was believed to have anti - magic properties and the Amnish mined it and turned it into amulets to ward off wild magic . It was later found that the crystal had no special properties but the Amnish continued to mine and sell the stones as amethyst .
description_long: Iomic crystal Iomic crystal was a purple crystal found on the island of Ioma in the Nelanther Isles . After the Spellplague , the mineral was believed to have anti - magic properties and the Amnish mined it and turned it into amulets to ward off wild magic . It was later found that the crystal had no special properties but the Amnish continued to mine and sell the stones as amethyst .

title: Iorg Brokenjaw
description: Iorg Brokenjaw Iorg Brokenjaw was a dwarf jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Despite what he did , Iorg was a man of his word , and he always respected his words .
description_long: Iorg Brokenjaw Iorg Brokenjaw was a dwarf jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Despite what he did , Iorg was a man of his word , and he always respected his words . He was a well - spoken individual using brief and terse sentences . History . In 1489 DR , he was bribed to free the Gray Patriots ' s member Rathene Fel . In order to do this , he instigated a prison break in order to distract the other jailers and free Rathene . However , thanks to an adventuring party there to interrogate her , his plan backfired . Out of desperation , he took Ukharim Grimshackle hostage . The adventurers somehow resolved the situation .

title: Iorn Ludwakazar
description: Iorn Ludwakazar Iorn Ludwakazar was a dwarf king of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Iorn was a shrewd but stubborn ruler .
description_long: Iorn Ludwakazar Iorn Ludwakazar was a dwarf king of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Iorn was a shrewd but stubborn ruler . With death near , he understood the futility of his sibling feud and he yearned to reconcile with his brother . History . Iorn lived with his brother Bhùn Ludwakazar and the rest of his clan in the Earthspur Mountains , acting as custodians of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones . In his youth , he had a bad argument with his brother about a sword they had found hidden in the mine . In the end , Bhùn was exiled . In time , Iorn had a daughter , Lherzona Ludwakazar . In 1491 DR , after a recent mining excavation by miners from Mulmaster , a medusa and her gargoyle minions took control of the Chamber . In a battle , King Iorn was mortally wounded . Lherzona and the others remained to await the death of Iorn , keeping out intruders . Then an adventuring party hired to clear the mine arrived . After the adventurers solved the matter , Iorn finally died and Lherzona was crowned queen of her people . Iorn also had the chance to reconcile with Bhùn thanks to the adventurers .

title: Ioulaum
description: Ioulaum Ioulaum was a great archwizard of Netheril , a beloved champion of his people and the inventor of both the mythallar and the flying enclaves of his empire . When Ioulaum abandoned Netheril to escape the " life drain " dweomers of the phaerimm in - 339 DR , panic spread at the news of his disappearance , leading to Karsus casting his spell " Karsus ' s avatar " . < ref name = " N : EoM / WoN - p11 - 12 " > < / ref > Since the fall of Netheril , Ioulaum has survived as an elder brain ( the central brain of an illithid community ) lich .
description_long: Ioulaum Ioulaum was a great archwizard of Netheril , a beloved champion of his people and the inventor of both the mythallar and the flying enclaves of his empire . When Ioulaum abandoned Netheril to escape the " life drain " dweomers of the phaerimm in - 339 DR , panic spread at the news of his disappearance , leading to Karsus casting his spell " Karsus ' s avatar " . < ref name = " N : EoM / WoN - p11 - 12 " > < / ref > Since the fall of Netheril , Ioulaum has survived as an elder brain ( the central brain of an illithid community ) lich . Activities . Under the guise of the Oracle of Ellyn ' taal , Ioulaum extracted a terrible price for the information he provided - the voluntary , permanent loss of some portion of the questioner ' s sanity or the knowledge of a powerful spell that Ioulaum did not yet know . History . Early life and The Excursion Into Extinction . Born in Seventon in - 3315 DR , Ioulaum soon rose to prominence when in - 3145 DR he led a major battle known as the Excursion into Extinction , bringing thousands of Netherese spellcasters and warriors to mount an attack against the largest concentration of orcs in Netheril ' s land at the time .

title: Ioulaum ' s longevity
description: Ioulaum ' s longevity This spell was developed by the powerful archwizard Ioulaum of Netheril " circa " the Year of Dwarves Besieged , – 674 DR ( 3185 NR , during Netheril ' s Shadowed Age ) to extend his lifespan over the centuries . Effects . " Ioulaum ' s longevity " dealt massive damage to every creature within its area of effect .
description_long: Ioulaum ' s longevity This spell was developed by the powerful archwizard Ioulaum of Netheril " circa " the Year of Dwarves Besieged , – 674 DR ( 3185 NR , during Netheril ' s Shadowed Age ) to extend his lifespan over the centuries . Effects . " Ioulaum ' s longevity " dealt massive damage to every creature within its area of effect . Any creature slain by this spell was reduced to dust . The spell also damaged construct s , objects , and undead , but only living creatures could contribute to the longevity of the caster . Each living creature destroyed by this spell extended the life of the caster by one year . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components to cast , but without live creatures within the radius of effect there would have been no longevity benefit .

title: Ioun stone
description: Ioun stone Ioun stones , originally called Congenio ' s pebbles and Ioun ' s stones , were magical stones that floated around a bearer ' s head and granted a range of enhancements or powers to a creature . Description . They were small , crystalline stones , coming in a wide range of colors and shapes that determined their powers .
description_long: Ioun stone Ioun stones , originally called Congenio ' s pebbles and Ioun ' s stones , were magical stones that floated around a bearer ' s head and granted a range of enhancements or powers to a creature . Description . They were small , crystalline stones , coming in a wide range of colors and shapes that determined their powers . Unattended " ioun stones " tended to hover and drift about by themselves . They were known to glow and occasionally to emit faint , musical sounds , sounding rather like chimes or a harp , in single notes or longer chords . Function . " Ioun stones " hovered permanently in the air , but otherwise remained motionless . When one acquired a stone and wished to receive its benefits , they had to first hold it firmly for a brief time in order to attune themselves and imprint their own magnetic aura into its structure , and then release it or toss it in the air . Thereafter , when functioning , the " ioun stone " orbited the bearer ' s head at a distance of 1 – 3 ft ( 30 – 91 cm ) , or else trailed after the bearer as they walked .

title: Iphegor Nath
description: Iphegor Nath Iphegor Nath was the High Flamelord of the church of Kossuth , residing in the Flaming Brazier . Appearance . Iphegor was tall and craggy and burly of build .
description_long: Iphegor Nath Iphegor Nath was the High Flamelord of the church of Kossuth , residing in the Flaming Brazier . Appearance . Iphegor was tall and craggy and burly of build . He wore bright orange vestments . His eyes were orange as well with a fiery light inside inside them . Sometimes small flames crawled on his shoulders , arms and shaved scalp without burning his clothes or harming his skin . He had an air of sardonic composure around him .

title: Irae T ' sarran
description: Irae T ' sarran Irae T ' sarran was a female drow high priestess of Kiaransalee who attempted to exact her goddess ' s vengeance upon the surface lands by raising an army of undead beneath the Dalelands . Description . Irae was striking for a drow , as she was an albino , a seldom seen variant known as a szarkai .
description_long: Irae T ' sarran Irae T ' sarran was a female drow high priestess of Kiaransalee who attempted to exact her goddess ' s vengeance upon the surface lands by raising an army of undead beneath the Dalelands . Description . Irae was striking for a drow , as she was an albino , a seldom seen variant known as a szarkai . An eerily beautiful elf , Irae had white skin and a hairless head whilst her body seemed to be wrapped in a glowing green mist that surrounded her shoulders and chest , then rose up behind her head like a cloak . Posessions . Irae carried few items , but those she did possess were potent indeed . On her right hand was a fine metal guantlet known as the " claw of the revenancer " and in her left she held a long black rod , that spurted pale green flame from one end , known as the " rod of the twisted Weave " . Lastly , she wore the " eyes of the spider " , a silver plate studded with a row of rubies that adorned her head like a tight - fitting helm and extended down to cover her left eye as well . History . Early life . During Irae T ' sarran ' s youth , she was a young noble of House T ' sarran in Maerimydra .

title: Iraska
description: Iraska Iraska , who was known to her derro subjects as the Slime King was a yuan - ti pureblood who ruled a clan of derro in the Underdark . Description . With the exception of canine teeth which looked like fangs , Iraska appeared as an elderly human female .
description_long: Iraska Iraska , who was known to her derro subjects as the Slime King was a yuan - ti pureblood who ruled a clan of derro in the Underdark . Description . With the exception of canine teeth which looked like fangs , Iraska appeared as an elderly human female . Abilities . Iraska learned to open portals to the Far Realm , an ability which ingratiated her to the Far Realm obsessed derro . History . Iraska was born into a small tribe of yuan - ti in the jungles of Southern Faerûn . Because she was pureblood , she was nearly human in appearance and she was sent to the human city of Delzimmer as a spy . Decades before 1479 DR she was abducted by derro of the Underdark and enslaved . She manipulated her way to the top of the derro hierarchy and eventually became their leader , adopting the honorary title of Slime King . In 1362 DR she ordered the derro to attack and enslave her former tribe out of spite . In 1479 DR her great - great - grandaughter , Zaltys Serrat and Zaltys ' cousin Julen journeyed to the derro settlement with the intent of freeing Zaltys ' birth clan . Iraska revealed Zaltys ' true nature as a yuan - ti pureblood and attempted to poison Julen .

title: Iraun
description: Iraun Iraun was a mage , and along with Srivven , they were the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Iraun and Srivven traveled Faerûn , plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards .
description_long: Iraun Iraun was a mage , and along with Srivven , they were the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Iraun and Srivven traveled Faerûn , plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards . Iraun had no actual right to rule over Adearglast , although he and Srivven believed that the gods had appointed them this task . They had resisted several attacks and , due to the strong magic in Adaerglast , had protected themselves by setting up many very powerful spellwebs .

title: Iraun Thelder
description: Iraun Thelder Iraun Thelder was a one - eyed mercenary at the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Iraun worked as a guard , and stayed at the Swinging Sword tavern when he had no work .
description_long: Iraun Thelder Iraun Thelder was a one - eyed mercenary at the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Iraun worked as a guard , and stayed at the Swinging Sword tavern when he had no work . He reported to fellow cultists all that happened during his work . History . In 1491 DR , Iraun was at the Swinging Sword tavern when some adventurers were hired to find a diplomatic caravan that had gone missing near the city . They probably uncovered him .

title: Iriador Wintermist
description: Iriador Wintermist Iriador Wintermist , known as Garnet , was a half - elven spellsinger and former Harper . Description . Iriador had red hair and was over 300 years of age , although she was able to use magic to make herself appear somewhat younger .
description_long: Iriador Wintermist Iriador Wintermist , known as Garnet , was a half - elven spellsinger and former Harper . Description . Iriador had red hair and was over 300 years of age , although she was able to use magic to make herself appear somewhat younger . History . Iriador was a member of the Harpers who fell during the Harpstar Wars . She was rescued by a druid and learned spellsong . She spent 200 years with wood elves . In 1364 DR , Iriador ( using the alias Garnet ) retrieved the Morninglark harp from the green dragon Grimnoshtadrano in order to place a curse on the Harpers in revenge ( or , in her mind , justice ) for their meddling and lack of attention to lorekeeping . She used the harp to change bards ' songs without their awareness , blight the crops around Waterdeep , and turn popular opinion against the Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and the Lords of Waterdeep . Her plans were thwarted by Harper Danilo Thann and company , which included Elaith Craulnober , as well as by Grimnoshtadrano , who carried her away just before her moment of triumph . Relationships . An asperii served Iriador .

title: Iriaebor
description: Iriaebor Iriaebor , also known as the Overland City and the City of a Thousand Spires , was a large city in Sunset Vale in the Western Heartlands region of west Faerûn . Geography . The city stood on a sprawling ridge above the north fork of the river Chionthar .
description_long: Iriaebor Iriaebor , also known as the Overland City and the City of a Thousand Spires , was a large city in Sunset Vale in the Western Heartlands region of west Faerûn . Geography . The city stood on a sprawling ridge above the north fork of the river Chionthar . The ridge itself was known locally as the Tor . Government . In the 14th century DR , Lord Bron ruled the city , and carefully followed the dictates of a forty - person voting merchant council . Trade . Iriaebor carried the caravan trade on The Dusk Road over the rapids and rough water of the upper Chionthar river , and linked up with the Trader ' s Road . Defense . The Shield of Iriaebor was the name of the armed forces of the city . They acted to both police the city and patrol the surrounding lands . They were well - armed . Notable Locations . The city was split into three sections : the Docks , at the bottom of the ridge on the river Chionthar ; the Old City , built on the ridge itself ; and the Lower City , on the flat lands on top of the ridge . Space was limited in the city , so the locals simply built upwards . Many - storied towers rose from all over the city , joined to one another by bridges .

title: Iriaeboran North Brew
description: Iriaeboran North Brew Iriaeboran North Brew was a local brew from Iriaebor and was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This beer was appreciated by the commoners more than those with more refined palettes .
description_long: Iriaeboran North Brew Iriaeboran North Brew was a local brew from Iriaebor and was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This beer was appreciated by the commoners more than those with more refined palettes . It had a dark amber color combined with a bitter aftertaste . Iriaeborans called this the " " bite of the north winds " . " Prices . Iriaeboran North Brew could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Iridescent Peacock Society
description: Iridescent Peacock Society The Iridescent Peacock Society was a secret society in Kozakura . Description . The Iridescent Peacock Society was the only society composed by normally solitary evil wu jen .
description_long: Iridescent Peacock Society The Iridescent Peacock Society was a secret society in Kozakura . Description . The Iridescent Peacock Society was the only society composed by normally solitary evil wu jen . The Society had regular magical practices among its members , and offered training , protection , and aid to members in need of such assistance . The society did anything to keep its existence secret : secret recognition signs , dangerous tests for prospective joiners , and an organization of cells of limited membership . History . The Iridescent Peacock Society , knowing that evil wu jen prospered in time of warfare , supported the return of Hojo Todahiro . Meanwhile , the wu jen associates worked independently to do anything to start war in Kozakura .

title: Iris Well Spring
description: Iris Well Spring Iris Well Spring was a small oasis and village located just east of Semphar in the Hordelands . Description . This area was a dreary place for much of the year , but each spring the dormant dwarf irises bloomed , surrounding the area with beautiful blue flowers .
description_long: Iris Well Spring Iris Well Spring was a small oasis and village located just east of Semphar in the Hordelands . Description . This area was a dreary place for much of the year , but each spring the dormant dwarf irises bloomed , surrounding the area with beautiful blue flowers . Inhabitants . Atabeg Ali al - Mustasib and his daughter Dura lived on a small farm here .

title: Iris agate
description: Iris agate Iris Agate was a low - grade agate that came in large pieces , usually sold by the pound ( kilogram ) as a building material . Description . Iris agate looked white in normal lighting conditions , but when cut into thin slabs and illuminated from behind , its swirling mix of colors was strikingly visible .
description_long: Iris agate Iris Agate was a low - grade agate that came in large pieces , usually sold by the pound ( kilogram ) as a building material . Description . Iris agate looked white in normal lighting conditions , but when cut into thin slabs and illuminated from behind , its swirling mix of colors was strikingly visible . Iris agate was often used in temples for this effect . A typical price for large quantities of this hardstone was 2 gp per pound ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Powers . A sufficiently large slab , screen , or statue made of iris agate reflected all spells cast upon it back at the caster . Treasure vault doors or other areas that might come under magical attack were sometimes lined with iris agate or had iris agate statues strategically placed for defense .

title: Irisroth
description: Irisroth Irisroth was a half - elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Irisroth was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .
description_long: Irisroth Irisroth was a half - elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Irisroth was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments . More specifically , she was the chosen of Loviatar . Irisroth was freed from her chains by the heroes of Daggerford .

title: Iritar
description: Iritar Iritar " the Dark " was a human man and a wizard . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . He was also the " Night Hood " of the Shadowcloaks thieves guild .
description_long: Iritar Iritar " the Dark " was a human man and a wizard . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . He was also the " Night Hood " of the Shadowcloaks thieves guild . History . Iritar was formerly an adventurer in Bellas ' s Band , under Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while Iritar took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . Personality . Iritar the Dark was cold - hearted and sadistic , and infamous for inventively butchering those apprentices who failed to satisfy him . Activities . Iritar and the dukes grew increasingly wealthy and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . In all decisions on major policies , Iritar had one vote while Bellas had two . Iritar and the Dukes often confiscated property and magic from visitors , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power .

title: Irithyl
description: Irithyl Irithyl was a royal gold elven family that ruled over the Empire of Cormanthyr , a great kingdom of elves in the forest of Cormanthor , from the nation ' s founding in - 4000 DR onward through 661 DR . The Irithyl clan was an old founding family of Arcorar and among the first Twelve Houses of Cormanthyr . History .
description_long: Irithyl Irithyl was a royal gold elven family that ruled over the Empire of Cormanthyr , a great kingdom of elves in the forest of Cormanthor , from the nation ' s founding in - 4000 DR onward through 661 DR . The Irithyl clan was an old founding family of Arcorar and among the first Twelve Houses of Cormanthyr . History . In the year - 4000 DR , the Coronal of Jhyrennstar , Oacenth , spoke a prophecy that the elves of the nations of the forest of Arcorar would unify together and form one great nation . It was at this time that the Elfblades were created to determine its rulers , and the competing elven clans sent their leaders forth to draw the blades as part of the ritual of Blade - rite . The Ruler ' s Blade , which determined the Coronal of Cormanthyr , was drawn by the first of the Irithyl line , Kahvoerm , and so began the first Rysar of Cormanthyr . Kahvoerm is remembered for also having founded the city of Cormanthor , which later became Myth Drannor , in the year - 3983 , and raising the Rule Tower as part of Castle Cormanthor , the seat of power of the empire . Kahvoerm ruled for over a thousand years .

title: Irixis
description: Irixis Irixis the Sorcerorb was a powerful elder orb beholder spellcaster of Ooltul in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Irixis officially acted as an assistant to Scalmarael the Sage , a phaerimm and member of Triumvirate that ruled Ooltul .
description_long: Irixis Irixis the Sorcerorb was a powerful elder orb beholder spellcaster of Ooltul in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Irixis officially acted as an assistant to Scalmarael the Sage , a phaerimm and member of Triumvirate that ruled Ooltul . Secretly , it conspired to undermine the phaerimm and install a new regime , with itself in command . Irixis had many contacts in Teshendale among exiled beholders but spent at least as much time foiling the plots of its rival exiled beholders as trying to destroy the phaerimm . In truth , the Triumvirate knew all about its schemes and permitted it to act only because it amused them . In 1372 DR , however , Irixis , this time actually unknown to the phaerimm , devised a revolutionary plot using a slave revolt led by former orc captain Kronnak Eyebiter .

title: Irl
description: Irl Irl was a village that lay just west of the River Rith , due north of The Realm of the Mount . The village ' s main claim to fame was in the form of jewlers and their gem s . Governmental rulings were made by the Eight - sided Stone , a covert council whose members were the elders of the most powerful Irlian families .
description_long: Irl Irl was a village that lay just west of the River Rith , due north of The Realm of the Mount . The village ' s main claim to fame was in the form of jewlers and their gem s . Governmental rulings were made by the Eight - sided Stone , a covert council whose members were the elders of the most powerful Irlian families . Irl had an inn called The Bold Ki - rin . It was a large , three - story , half - timbered mansion with many chimneys . The inn ' s dining room was famous for roasts , wine s , and succulent sauces and its stables were second to none . The owner and keeper of the Rin was the jovial ex - adventurer Brelmere Baerith . Where the village main street curved around the front of The Bold Ki - rin , there was a row of six well - established jewelry shops . The jewelers of Irl were reputed to be among the richest and most powerful humans in all Faerûn . They were secretive and reclusive and their behind - the - scenes influence could move merchants of Sembia , the Zulkirs of Thay and nobles of Waterdeep to do things they would rather not .

title: Irlin Stonestable
description: Irlin Stonestable Irlin Stonestable was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Stonestable noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Irlin gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .
description_long: Irlin Stonestable Irlin Stonestable was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Stonestable noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Irlin gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war . Relationship . Irlin was part of the cabal that supported Marlin Stormserpent .

title: Irmakul
description: Irmakul Irmakul " Bloodthews " was a priest of Ilmater from Memnon , Calimshan , of the 3rd century DR . Irmakul was an Archsufferer in the Church of Ilmater and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History .
description_long: Irmakul Irmakul " Bloodthews " was a priest of Ilmater from Memnon , Calimshan , of the 3rd century DR . Irmakul was an Archsufferer in the Church of Ilmater and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil . To this end , the sword " Dornavver " was completed in the Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR . As recorded in " Relics of the Righteous " , the senior clergy of Ilmater took the sword and gathered at Allyn ' s Anvil in the Alimir Mountains east of Calimshan . Irmakul was present , along with Revered Brother Filithan and Exalted Servant Volshur the Crooked and many others of the church . There they conducted a holy ritual in which their impassioned prayers and howls of suffering enchanted the sword .

title: Irmar Graycloak
description: Irmar Graycloak Irmar Graycloak was an adventurer and leader of the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company in the early 1340s DR . Irmar Graycloak and Graycloak ' s Wolves were in the city of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach in the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , when they were requested to deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the most holy book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers .
description_long: Irmar Graycloak Irmar Graycloak was an adventurer and leader of the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company in the early 1340s DR . Irmar Graycloak and Graycloak ' s Wolves were in the city of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach in the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , when they were requested to deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the most holy book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers . The " Tome " was thought lost in the winter snows .

title: Iron
description: Iron Iron was a non - precious metal mined widely on Toril . Mining . The Galena Mountains in northeast Faerûn were rich in iron ore and human s and dwarves established mining communities there .
description_long: Iron Iron was a non - precious metal mined widely on Toril . Mining . The Galena Mountains in northeast Faerûn were rich in iron ore and human s and dwarves established mining communities there . Uses . Particularly dark - colored iron was used in the construction of " shoonring s " that had combat or defensive properties .

title: Iron Crucible
description: Iron Crucible The Iron Crucible was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Iron Crucible was a large fountain of liquid metal located near the Sevenfold Mazework .
description_long: Iron Crucible The Iron Crucible was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Iron Crucible was a large fountain of liquid metal located near the Sevenfold Mazework . This fiery vein of ore connected the Elemental Plane of Earth to the lava tube located beneath the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Travelers using the Iron Crucible were met by efreet ships floating on the lava that carried them to the City of Brass . This elemental vortex allowed travel both ways , but efreet travelling to the Elemental Plane of Fire often ran into yakmen who attempted to collect ridiculous tolls before allowing their passage .

title: Iron Dragon Mountain
description: Iron Dragon Mountain Iron Dragon Mountain was a mountain in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , between Impiltur and the Vast . It was a legendary hidden peak and home to greatest temple of Deneir in the Realms . History .
description_long: Iron Dragon Mountain Iron Dragon Mountain was a mountain in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , between Impiltur and the Vast . It was a legendary hidden peak and home to greatest temple of Deneir in the Realms . History . The mist dragon Ouranalathra the Mistmaiden once laired at the mountain , before she moved to the Lake of Mists in the Endless Wastes . Afterwards , it gained the name of " Iron Dragon Mountain " . Afterwards , it gained the name of " Iron Dragon Mountain " and became the site of the Master ' s Library , a temple of Deneir with the greatest collection of books in the world . Appendix . Notes . It is implied that the mountain is named for Ouranalathra . This is explained in George Krashos ' s unpublished , non - canonical article , " Ouranalathra , " the Mistmaiden " " , which tells the history of Ouranalathra and the Master ' s Library .

title: Iron Helm of Heroes
description: Iron Helm of Heroes The Iron Helm of Heroes was an artifact and minor relic of Ilmater the Broken God and his church . Description . The " Iron Helm of Heroes " was unremarkable in appearance .
description_long: Iron Helm of Heroes The Iron Helm of Heroes was an artifact and minor relic of Ilmater the Broken God and his church . Description . The " Iron Helm of Heroes " was unremarkable in appearance . It was a simple , bowl - shaped headpiece fashioned from bronze and of ancient construction . There was no ornamentation bar the holy symbol of Ilmater over the forehead : two human hands crossed and bound at the wrist . Powers . If worn by a being of good heart , the " Iron Helm " granted them the ability to cast divine spell s as a high - level cleric with access to the Healing and Necromantic sphere s . However , these spells could only have a beneficial , curative effect , and could not harm or inflict suffering . Typical spells were " aid " , " breath of life " , " cure blindness or deafness " , " cure disease " , " cure critical wounds " , " cure light wounds " , " cure serious wounds " , " fortify " , " heal " , " neutralize poison " , " raise dead " , " regenerate " , " reincarnate " , " restoration " , " resurrection " , and " slow poison " .

title: Iron Legion
description: Iron Legion The Iron Legion was a disbanded mercenary company by 1358 DR . History . The Iron Legion was the combined army that fought the arcanaloth Yrkhetep in his home plane of Hades .
description_long: Iron Legion The Iron Legion was a disbanded mercenary company by 1358 DR . History . The Iron Legion was the combined army that fought the arcanaloth Yrkhetep in his home plane of Hades . Most of its members died in the decisive battle . Only two of the many groups that composed the Legion remained active : the Windriders and the Sisterhood of the Oaks .

title: Iron Lord
description: Iron Lord The Iron Lord , or Huhrong , was the highest - ranking male ruler of Rashemen . He was expected to rule wisely in the best interests of the people of Rashemen . His duties included keeping travel between settlements relatively safe , securing the frontier lands , controlling raiding monsters from the wilder parts of Rashemen , and serving as supreme warlord during times of war .
description_long: Iron Lord The Iron Lord , or Huhrong , was the highest - ranking male ruler of Rashemen . He was expected to rule wisely in the best interests of the people of Rashemen . His duties included keeping travel between settlements relatively safe , securing the frontier lands , controlling raiding monsters from the wilder parts of Rashemen , and serving as supreme warlord during times of war . At a local level , each settlement was ruled over by a " fyrra " who only controlled the armed forces under his command . A " fyrra " ' s rule could be compared to that of a mayor . Each " fyrra " reported to the Iron Lord . The real power , however , lies with the Wychlaran . They picked the Iron Lord and could change him whenever they felt it necessary . In 1372 DR , Volas Dyervolk was the current Iron Lord of Rashemen .

title: Iron Ring
description: Iron Ring The Iron Ring was a consortium of the most powerful slavers in Skullport . Activities . The Iron Ring ' s primary interest was slaving and protecting the slave trade in Skullport and Undermountain .
description_long: Iron Ring The Iron Ring was a consortium of the most powerful slavers in Skullport . Activities . The Iron Ring ' s primary interest was slaving and protecting the slave trade in Skullport and Undermountain . To that effect , they prevented poaching by guarding unsold slaves , limiting the influence of foreign slavers , and attempting to keep the Lords of Waterdeep out of their business . Independent and rival slavers who refused to join the consortium were ruthlessly eliminated . History . The Iron Ring was founded in 1363 DR in Skullport by two powerful slavers ( who happened to hate each other ) , the yuan - ti abomination Zstulkk Ssarmn and the priest of Loviatar Quinan Varnaed . The alliance was very profitably and grew quickly until in less than ten years ' time it came to control most of the slave trafficking in Skullport and Undermountain . Headquarters . The Iron Ring was based in Skullport and operated throughout the city and in Undermountain . Leadership . The five leaders of the Iron Ring were known as as the " Lords of Iron . " Each of them was the leader of their own slave organization .

title: Iron Throne
description: Iron Throne The Iron Throne was a mysterious merchant organization . Little was known of its history or the identity of its backers . It apparently operated independently of any government .
description_long: Iron Throne The Iron Throne was a mysterious merchant organization . Little was known of its history or the identity of its backers . It apparently operated independently of any government . History . The Iron Throne was well over twenty years old . Their founding date was unknown , but they were first heard of in 1356 DR . The iron crisis . A recent operation ( in 1368 DR ) of the Iron Throne came close to causing a war between Amn and Baldur ' s Gate . They orchestrated an iron shortage in the Baldur ' s Gate area , sabotaging the mines at Nashkel and hiring bandits to disrupt trade , blaming all of this on Amn . The Iron Throne would gain political influence in Baldur ' s Gate and supply the city with iron from their hidden mine in Cloakwood . However , for Sarevok , a leading member of the Baldur ' s Gate branch of the Iron Throne and a Bhaalspawn , this plan was nothing but a means for causing a war , which he believed he could use to his advantage to ascend to divinity as the new Lord of Murder . Both plans were ultimately foiled by Abdel Adrian . Known members . The Iron Throne operated through agents , mostly thugs and brigands .

title: Iron Tower
description: Iron Tower The Iron Tower was the massive tower - fortress located in the hellish Iron City of Dis . The Tower served as the headquarters of the Archdevil of the 2nd realm of hell , where the city was located , Dispater . The tower was heavily guarded and crawled with deadly and wicked traps , all set in place to protect Dispater , who was extremely , and perhaps wisely , paranoid .
description_long: Iron Tower The Iron Tower was the massive tower - fortress located in the hellish Iron City of Dis . The Tower served as the headquarters of the Archdevil of the 2nd realm of hell , where the city was located , Dispater . The tower was heavily guarded and crawled with deadly and wicked traps , all set in place to protect Dispater , who was extremely , and perhaps wisely , paranoid . The tower acted not only his Headquarters , but also his residence , as he almost never left its iron walls , running his city and domain from afar . He was completely untouchable within its iron walls . His skill and cunning in the game of Hell ' s Great Court , a long with the tower ' s protection , have kept Dispater in power , and made him one of the most powerful Archdevils .

title: Iron Wastes
description: Iron Wastes The frigid Iron Wastes are home to the dullard lord Kostchtchie , the malformed demon - giant who claims all frost giants as his protected kin . A place of unrelenting blizzards and icy rifts , the inhospitable layer might have been avoided by most Abyssal inhabitants if not for the presence of one of the most coveted gates in the Abyss , a rime - encrusted stone monolith arch leading to Jotunheim on Ysgard , near the frost giant town of Utgardt . More importantly , the gate opens near the roots of the Great Wheel - spanning Yggdrasil Tree , a major transplanar thoroughfare leading to locales throughout the Upper Planes .
description_long: Iron Wastes The frigid Iron Wastes are home to the dullard lord Kostchtchie , the malformed demon - giant who claims all frost giants as his protected kin . A place of unrelenting blizzards and icy rifts , the inhospitable layer might have been avoided by most Abyssal inhabitants if not for the presence of one of the most coveted gates in the Abyss , a rime - encrusted stone monolith arch leading to Jotunheim on Ysgard , near the frost giant town of Utgardt . More importantly , the gate opens near the roots of the Great Wheel - spanning Yggdrasil Tree , a major transplanar thoroughfare leading to locales throughout the Upper Planes . Demons from all corners of the Abyss therefore congregate in the Iron Wastes in hopes of moving through this gate , but Kostchtchie ' s fierce protection of his home realm results in de facto protection of the Yggdrasil , making the Prince of Wrath one of the most hated demons in the Abyss , despised by good and evil alike . The Prince of Wrath nonetheless enjoys strong support from his chosen people , tribes of frost giants from the Material Plane who have sworn themselves to Kostchtchie in return for eternal life in the Iron Wastes .

title: Iron Worm
description: Iron Worm The Iron Worm was a unique anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Iron Worm was a gargantuan worm - like anaxim with an articulated metallic body that stretched over a hundred feet ( 300 meters ) in length .
description_long: Iron Worm The Iron Worm was a unique anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Iron Worm was a gargantuan worm - like anaxim with an articulated metallic body that stretched over a hundred feet ( 300 meters ) in length . Its metallic scales were mostly rusted and worn out but were several feet thick and constantly sparked with small lightning discharges . Although the Iron Worm didn ' t seemed to possess eyes , ears , a mouth , or any other method to interact with and sense the world , it moved with uncanny precision both in the surface or burrowing underground . Ecology . It was believed that the Iron Worm possessed the ability to communicate psychically with those it deemed worthy , although such individuals were very rare . The Iron Worm was usually innocuous , but it crushed any creature that attempted to block its movement or that attacked it , even other anaxims . History . As of 1479 DR , the Iron Worm was believed to be hundreds of years old by the explorers of the Glaur Barrens .

title: Iron body
description: Iron body Iron body was a transmutation spell that turned the subject ' s body to living iron which , in turn , granted powerful resistances and new abilities . Effects . While under the effects of this spell , the target experienced the following effects : Material components .
description_long: Iron body Iron body was a transmutation spell that turned the subject ' s body to living iron which , in turn , granted powerful resistances and new abilities . Effects . While under the effects of this spell , the target experienced the following effects : Material components . This spell required a small piece of iron that was once part of an iron golem , a hero ’ s armor , or a war machine to cast .

title: Iron circlet
description: Iron circlet The iron circlet was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . History . The iron circlet worn by the grinning statue of Byubo , the Padhrasattva of " nyum " , found within the Rainbow Monastery .
description_long: Iron circlet The iron circlet was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . History . The iron circlet worn by the grinning statue of Byubo , the Padhrasattva of " nyum " , found within the Rainbow Monastery . Description . This simple crown emitted a magical aura detectable by spells . Powers . The iron circlet aided in protecting its wearer from physical attacks . However , if a single word of pride was said while wearing the circlet , it instantly became a cursed item , making it easier for the wearer to be struck by physical attacks . The cursed version of the iron circlet could only be removed with a " remove curse " spell or a " wish " .

title: Iron crisis
description: Iron crisis The Iron Crisis was an event occurring in 1368 DR in which the Iron Throne plotted to destroy the iron supply of the Sword Coast by poisoning the iron from the mines of Nashkel with alchemy , having groups of bandits steal all of the untainted iron all along the coast and infiltrating rival trading companies with doppelganger s so as to drive them into financial ruin . This was so they would have a monopoly on iron in the region using a secret iron mine they had found in the Cloakwood , fueled by slave labour . Rumours were put around that it was the nation of Amn that was causing the iron shortage , helped by several important figures in Baldur ' s Gate being assassinated and having the insignias of the Shadow Thieves dropped at the murder sites .
description_long: Iron crisis The Iron Crisis was an event occurring in 1368 DR in which the Iron Throne plotted to destroy the iron supply of the Sword Coast by poisoning the iron from the mines of Nashkel with alchemy , having groups of bandits steal all of the untainted iron all along the coast and infiltrating rival trading companies with doppelganger s so as to drive them into financial ruin . This was so they would have a monopoly on iron in the region using a secret iron mine they had found in the Cloakwood , fueled by slave labour . Rumours were put around that it was the nation of Amn that was causing the iron shortage , helped by several important figures in Baldur ' s Gate being assassinated and having the insignias of the Shadow Thieves dropped at the murder sites . All of this helped spark threats of war against Amn from Baldur ' s Gate , despite Amn ' s claims of innocence . Rieltar Anchev , the Iron Throne leader ' s foster son Sarevok would then become Grand Duke of the city and formally declare war . The Iron Throne would then sell their untainted iron to make weapons and make a huge amount of gold .

title: Iron golem
description: Iron golem Whereas most other golems are created as guards , iron golems are usually created as mindless soldiers of war . These behemoths are unstoppable engines of destruction . They wade into melee with powerful blows from their fists and expel a corrosive poisonous gas onto the battlefield .
description_long: Iron golem Whereas most other golems are created as guards , iron golems are usually created as mindless soldiers of war . These behemoths are unstoppable engines of destruction . They wade into melee with powerful blows from their fists and expel a corrosive poisonous gas onto the battlefield . The most basic iron golem appears to be massive suit of heavy plated armor in a general humanoid form . Some golem crafters take special delight in their work and will fashion a mold for their iron golem before pouring in the magically treated molten iron . The average iron golem is about 12 feet tall and weighs 5 , 000 pounds . As the name suggests , iron golems are constructs made entirely out of iron . These iron behemoths are very powerful due to their magic immunity , poisonous breath attack , and the fact that they can take a hero ' s head off with a swipe of their arm . These near - invulnerable guardians are often stationed as sentries and guards for wizard s and powerful cleric s , usually to guard treasures hoards .

title: Iron vanguard
description: Iron vanguard Iron vanguards are mighty warriors trained to prime physical condition and who are ruthless in obtaining victory . Few , if any , defend their allies as well as an iron vanguard . Abilities .
description_long: Iron vanguard Iron vanguards are mighty warriors trained to prime physical condition and who are ruthless in obtaining victory . Few , if any , defend their allies as well as an iron vanguard . Abilities . Iron vanguards possess many abilities specific to their training , as well as the exploits and features typical of fighter s . Many of the iron vanguards ' abilities center around their incredible capability for endurance . When an iron vanguard defeats a foe he or she is invigorated by the little victory , pushing him or her onwards through further battles . Similarly , when about to be felled themselves iron vanguards often are able to lash out quickly and ferociously , dealing a last blow before they lose consciousness . Iron vanguard attacks are also deadly and when one knocks their enemy prone , he or she fuels his or her impressive vitality into the strike , making it even more crippling . Inexperienced iron vanguards can also force their enemy around the battlefield , throwing them backwards or pushing them out of the way .

title: Iron vigil
description: Iron vigil Iron vigil was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to forgo food , drink and sleep , and be immune to the effects of normal environmental conditions for a week or even longer . Effects . While under the effects of this spell , the caster required no food or water and felt no ill effects from hunger , thirst , fatigue , dehydration , or the discomforts of exposure to normal climate conditions .
description_long: Iron vigil Iron vigil was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to forgo food , drink and sleep , and be immune to the effects of normal environmental conditions for a week or even longer . Effects .
