While under the effects of this spell , the caster required no food or water and felt no ill effects from hunger , thirst , fatigue , dehydration , or the discomforts of exposure to normal climate conditions . Sleep was not necessary , but watchful meditation had to be substituted instead , which made the caster slightly more susceptible to surprise attack . At the end of the vigil , the caster had to eat and drink or slowly fall into a coma and die . For each day of no food , drink , or sleep , the caster had to rest for at least four hours before engaging in normal activity . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Ironbark
description: Ironbark Ironbark was a treant in Cormanthor . History . In 1459 DR , Ironbark and two other treants were captured by the dracolich Dretchroyaster , who considered them a delicacy .
description_long: Ironbark Ironbark was a treant in Cormanthor . History . In 1459 DR , Ironbark and two other treants were captured by the dracolich Dretchroyaster , who considered them a delicacy . In time , the dracolich slowly drained them of their life force . By 1479 DR , only a half - mad Ironbark was still alive . That year , some adventurers infiltrated the lair and met the treant . Personality . The long period of privation and fear had made him quite insane .

title: Ironcloak
description: Ironcloak Ironcloak was a ruined town in central Turmish , near the Alaoreum River . It was a brutal example of how the Emerald Enclave dealt with those who damaged the environment . History .
description_long: Ironcloak Ironcloak was a ruined town in central Turmish , near the Alaoreum River . It was a brutal example of how the Emerald Enclave dealt with those who damaged the environment . History . In the 13th century DR , Ironcloak was a town ruled by Lord Ironcloak , a rich and powerful noble merchant . Not long after the creation of Turmish ' s Assembly of Stars in the Year of the Cockatrice , 1248 DR , Lord Ironcloak petitioned the fledgling government for logging rights around his town . Although some assemblymen protested , Lord Ironcloak got his way . He quickly turned Ironcloak into a busy logging town , but he was ruthless and reckless in his pursuit of wealth , cutting down trees at a shocking speed and dumping rubbish in the Alaoreum River . All this soon drew the attention of the druid s of the Emerald Enclave , who warned Lord Ironcloak against polluting the river , though he ignored them . A druid then arrived and ordered him to cease operations immediately or they would take actions against him . Lord Ironcloak promptly murdered the messenger and hired mercenaries to defend the town .

title: Ironcloak ( lord )
description: Ironcloak ( lord ) Lord Ironcloak was a man of Turmish in the 13th century DR . He was the ruler of the town of Ironcloak . History .
description_long: Ironcloak ( lord ) Lord Ironcloak was a man of Turmish in the 13th century DR . He was the ruler of the town of Ironcloak . History . Lord Ironcloak was a wealthy merchant and powerful noble lord of his town . Not long after the creation of Turmish ' s Assembly of Stars in the Year of the Cockatrice , 1248 DR , Lord Ironcloak petitioned the fledgling government for logging rights around his town . Although some assemblymen protested , Lord Ironcloak got his way . He quickly turned Ironcloak into a busy logging town , but he was ruthless and reckless in his pursuit of wealth , cutting down trees at a shocking speed and dumping rubbish in the Alaoreum River . All this soon drew the attention of the druid s of the Emerald Enclave , who warned Lord Ironcloak against polluting the river , though he ignored them . A druid then arrived and ordered him to cease operations immediately or they would take actions against him . Lord Ironcloak promptly murdered the messenger and hired mercenaries to defend the town . Two days later , the druids delivered their final warning , attached to numerous arrows , declaring the town would be destroyed at dawn . Lord Ironcloak mocked their threats .

title: Ironfang Keep
description: Ironfang Keep Ironfang Keep was an ancient keep in northern Faerûn . Geography . The stronghold lay in the northernmost parts of the Earthspur Mountains at the cascades where the White River fell into the Moonsea .
description_long: Ironfang Keep Ironfang Keep was an ancient keep in northern Faerûn . Geography . The stronghold lay in the northernmost parts of the Earthspur Mountains at the cascades where the White River fell into the Moonsea . History . The Keep was so old , that even the oldest elves remembered their grandparents talking about it . There were legends among dragon s which indicated that Ironfang Keep already existed around - 25000 DR It got its name due to massive iron deposits near the Keep . But no one dared to mine them , because most feared the presence of the Keep and its inhabitants . Ironfang Keep was originally one of twelve fortresses constructed by the fire giant s of Helligheim on its southern border . During the Thousand Year War between Ostoria and the draconic forces of Garyx , Ironfang Keep was the only one of these fortresses to survive being destroyed by the dragons before the First Rage of Dragons ended the war . The Keep was sealed by giant runecaster s when the inhabitants of Helligheim decided to retreat to the north a century or two after the end of the war .

title: Ironfell
description: Ironfell Ironfell was a magical ore mined from the constantly regenerating body of the fallen primordial Telos . It had a crystalline structure but was as hard as steel after being worked by skilled hands . It was used to make weapons , magic items , armor , and golem - like constructs called shardsoul s .
description_long: Ironfell Ironfell was a magical ore mined from the constantly regenerating body of the fallen primordial Telos . It had a crystalline structure but was as hard as steel after being worked by skilled hands . It was used to make weapons , magic items , armor , and golem - like constructs called shardsoul s .

title: Ironford
description: Ironford Ironford was a bridge which crossed the river Dessarin . It was a part of the Iron Road . History .
description_long: Ironford Ironford was a bridge which crossed the river Dessarin . It was a part of the Iron Road . History . Around 1370 DR , the fate of the original old wooden bridge was somewhat hazy . It appeared a group of adventurers emptied a wand of fireballs into a group of troll s that were charging out of the water toward them . By the time the smoke and flames cleared , the bridge was gone . Notable locations . The Bargewright Inn was located at Ironford . While not truly a village , it was a collection of businesses serving the needs of travelers , farmers , and ranchers who settled along the western bank of the Dessarin .

title: Ironhar
description: Ironhar Ironhar was the biggest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Ironhar was home to several wealthy collectors , who often hired adventurers to explore old ruins in eastern Eskorn , and to retrieve old relics for them .
description_long: Ironhar Ironhar was the biggest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Ironhar was home to several wealthy collectors , who often hired adventurers to explore old ruins in eastern Eskorn , and to retrieve old relics for them .

title: Ironlord
description: Ironlord Ironlord was the title of the ruler of Earthfast , a dwarven city in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark Powers . The ironlord was the sole leader of Earthfast , and it was a hereditary position . The ironlord led the army and maintained law and order .
description_long: Ironlord Ironlord was the title of the ruler of Earthfast , a dwarven city in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark Powers . The ironlord was the sole leader of Earthfast , and it was a hereditary position . The ironlord led the army and maintained law and order . It was equivalent to a king . History . In the late 1350s DR , the ruler was Ironlord Torg mac Cei , but he died in battle in 1360 DR .

title: Ironmaster
description: Ironmaster Ironmaster was an isolated towered city built into the rocky walls of a valley in the Frozenfar . Ironmaster was inhabited by mountain dwarves . The coat of arms for Ironmaster was a red anvil on a diamond - shaped field of gray .
description_long: Ironmaster Ironmaster was an isolated towered city built into the rocky walls of a valley in the Frozenfar . Ironmaster was inhabited by mountain dwarves . The coat of arms for Ironmaster was a red anvil on a diamond - shaped field of gray . Description . Many storage chambers and passages were carved into the permanent ice , blending the city into the earth . Geography . The steep cliffs of the Cold Run , running northeast from Icefang Point and west of Fireshear , were broken by Ironmaster Vale . The city of Ironmaster filled the valley and surrounding ice . Ironmaster sat along the Shaengarne River where it flowed from Icewind Dale into the Sea of Moving Ice . The crafty dwarves used a tunnel and viaduct system to siphon water from the river . Spill basins and other diversions were used to insure spring runoff did not flood the neighboring city . Food was provided from several sources including deep caverns for mushrooms and hunting and fishing along the Shaengarne . The dwarves traded for anything else that they needed . Inhabitants . Ironmaster housed 9 , 000 dwarves in 1370 DR . The dwarves were somewhat reclusive , barring all non - dwarves from entering the city .

title: Ironseth
description: Ironseth The Ironseth family was a human family of horse and mercenary trainers in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . Members . The family was led by [ Ghaark Ironseth | Lord Ghaark Ironseth ] ] and around 1368 DR it owned about half the land around Amnwater .
description_long: Ironseth The Ironseth family was a human family of horse and mercenary trainers in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . Members . The family was led by [ Ghaark Ironseth | Lord Ghaark Ironseth ] ] and around 1368 DR it owned about half the land around Amnwater . Ghaark ' s third son was Togar Ironseth .

title: Ironstar mace
description: Ironstar mace The Ironstar mace was the signature weapon of Clan Ironstar constructed from their secret alloy , darksteel . Description . The mace s were the size of a footman ' s mace yet weighed less than 1 lb ( 0 .
description_long: Ironstar mace The Ironstar mace was the signature weapon of Clan Ironstar constructed from their secret alloy , darksteel . Description . The mace s were the size of a footman ' s mace yet weighed less than 1 lb ( 0 . 5 kg ) , and were very difficult to shatter .

title: Irooukudel
description: Irooukudel The Irooukudel were a group of Tuigan priests who lived within the vale of Ejen Horo in the Hordelands . Activities . The main responsibility of the Irooukudel was to watch over the bodies of the honored dead of the Tuigan who were buried in Ejen Horo .
description_long: Irooukudel The Irooukudel were a group of Tuigan priests who lived within the vale of Ejen Horo in the Hordelands . Activities . The main responsibility of the Irooukudel was to watch over the bodies of the honored dead of the Tuigan who were buried in Ejen Horo . They were quite fanatical and willing to die for their cause . Khans or other wealthy Tuigans were buried in tombs marked with statues . However , most of those interred in Ejen Horo were given a wind burial .

title: Irphiina
description: Irphiina Irphiina was a shade human who worked for Lord Telamont of the Shadovar . Description . Appearing human , Irphiina had dusky gray skin , a dour expression , and shadows that seemed to cling to her skin .
description_long: Irphiina Irphiina was a shade human who worked for Lord Telamont of the Shadovar . Description . Appearing human , Irphiina had dusky gray skin , a dour expression , and shadows that seemed to cling to her skin . She wore crimson and purple robes that were both elaborate and exotic .

title: Irreph Mulmar
description: Irreph Mulmar Irreph Mulmar was the high constable of High Dale in 1368 DR . History . In youth Irreph was a hero and an adventurer that in senior years was choose as high constable of his dale .
description_long: Irreph Mulmar Irreph Mulmar was the high constable of High Dale in 1368 DR . History . In youth Irreph was a hero and an adventurer that in senior years was choose as high constable of his dale . Around 1358 DR Irreph was ousted from his position by a secret Zhent occupation army but thank to Elminster Aumar and the Rangers Three led an insurrection that free the dale . However he resumed his role only around 1368 under popular pressure . Relationship . Irreph had a daughter Ylyndaera Mulmar .

title: Irtios
description: Irtios Irtios was the common name for in the Realms . It was found as natural crystals when mined from deep formations , or as tumbled stones in streambeds and among deposits of water - born gravel . Description .
description_long: Irtios Irtios was the common name for in the Realms . It was found as natural crystals when mined from deep formations , or as tumbled stones in streambeds and among deposits of water - born gravel . Description . This semi - precious stone was a hard gemstone that yielded gems of middling size . Irtios crystals were pale yellow or colorless and either transparent or translucent . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Irtios crystals prevented mold , mildew , and rot from forming on all organic substances , living , dead , or undead , with which they were in continuous direct contact . These gemstones were often mounted on sword sheaths and wizard staves , for example . This protection even worked against mummy rot , yellow mold , and fungus - based diseases , but had to be in direct contact with the skin continuously until the threat was removed .

title: Iruladoon
description: Iruladoon Iruladoon was a quasi - extraplanar forest that was located on the eastern bank of Lac Dinneshere in Icewind Dale . It was created by Mielikki specifically for her apparent Chosen , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in order to house and instruct his friends , the Companions of the Hall , prior to their reincarnations . Catti - brie and Regis were the first to arrive here after their deaths in 1385 DR .
description_long: Iruladoon Iruladoon was a quasi - extraplanar forest that was located on the eastern bank of Lac Dinneshere in Icewind Dale . It was created by Mielikki specifically for her apparent Chosen , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in order to house and instruct his friends , the Companions of the Hall , prior to their reincarnations . Catti - brie and Regis were the first to arrive here after their deaths in 1385 DR . Although in the outside world they spent nearly eight decades there , it seemed to them as mere tendays . Catti - brie spent her time dancing and singing , gaining instruction from the goddess Mielikki . Wulfgar was next to arrive after his own death , and then Bruenor Battlehammer in 1462 DR . Catti - brie explained to them that Drizzt was going to be in trouble , so they had the opportunity to be reincarnated to meet him in 21 years on Kelvin ' s Cairn in Icewind Dale . Although Regis was eager to help his friend , Wulfgar and Bruenor were more reluctant . Wulfgar decided to move on to the afterlife waiting for him ( although it is later revealed that he changed his mind ) , but the other three were reborn on Toril in the year 1463 DR .

title: Iryklathagra
description: Iryklathagra Irklathagra was a blue great wyrm who had long plagued the lands of Amn , Calimshan , and Tethyr and was the long - standing nemesis of Shoon VII . Description . Irklathagra was the perfect example of a blue dragon in her prime , sporting impressive frilled ears and an enormous horn typical of her kind .
description_long: Iryklathagra Irklathagra was a blue great wyrm who had long plagued the lands of Amn , Calimshan , and Tethyr and was the long - standing nemesis of Shoon VII . Description . Irklathagra was the perfect example of a blue dragon in her prime , sporting impressive frilled ears and an enormous horn typical of her kind . Due to her long absence from desert environs , her azure scales lacked the usual gloss that those of her breed normally had . Her over - sized fangs were perhaps her most prominent feature and were what earned her the moniker " Sharpfangs " . Personality . Iryklathagra ' s success was mostly due to her cunning and patient nature , eschewing much of the arrogance that is the downfall of younger dragons . Although she was well aware that she was not indestructible , she would stop at little when it came to revenge . It was this type of disproportionate retaliation to any slight against her that had deterred many from moving against the infamous dragon . Possessions . Over a millennia of amassing items and wealth for her hoard , Irylathagra grew to possess one of largest dragon hoards in Faerûn .

title: Isabeau Thione
description: Isabeau Thione Isabeau Thione was a female human thief in Waterdeep and the daughter of Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune of Tethyr . Appearance . Isabeau was 5 feet 3 inches ( 1 .
description_long: Isabeau Thione Isabeau Thione was a female human thief in Waterdeep and the daughter of Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune of Tethyr . Appearance . Isabeau was 5 feet 3 inches ( 1 . 6 meters ) tall , slim but with a bountiful chest and wide hips . When she wore her dark , shaggy hair long , it stretched down past her knees , though it was just barely past her shoulders when she worked as a tavern wench . She had a hook nose , large dark eyes , full lips and light brown skin . Isabeau had a scar on her thigh made by her mother when Isabeau was a baby just in case Lucia ever decided that she needed to find her daughter . Isabeau made sure that she wore clothes and accessories that showed off her body : tightly fitting bodices , low - cut gowns , and necklaces that drew the eye to her breast were the norm while living in Waterdeep , all accentuated with jewels . In her former life , she used similar tactics with whatever simple clothes she had . History . Isabeau was still an infant when the Ten Black Days of Eleint forced her mother , Lucia Thione to flee for Waterdeep before an angry mob could murder her for her connection to the Tethyr ian royal family .

title: Isair and Madae
description: Isair and Madae Description . Being half - elf and half - devil , Isair and Madae have elfin and devilish characteristics . They both stand at around six and a half feet tall and are bipedal .
description_long: Isair and Madae Description . Being half - elf and half - devil , Isair and Madae have elfin and devilish characteristics . They both stand at around six and a half feet tall and are bipedal . They have dark red skin , broad , leathery wings , twisted legs and tails . Isair is a powerful Wizard with some Fighter training , and carries a large scimitar , known as the The Sword of the Soulless . Madae is a powerful Cleric of Iyachtu Xvim and wields a powerful scimitar and a mace . Possessions . Little of either Isair or Madae ' s equipment is known . Upon their defeat their bodies were dragged into the Limbo Plane , and their equipment with them . It is most likely that Isair carried a greater version of the Iyachtu Xvim ' s scimitar . History . Isair and Madae were born in the town of Kuldahar in Icewind Dale about a year after the troubles with the devil general Belhifet . Belhifet had launched a campaign to take over the Ten Towns and one of his evil acts had involved seeding many human and elven females with his own spawn .

title: Isakkhu
description: Isakkhu Isakkhu was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s dwelling in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast in north Faerûn . Description . The deity took the form of a mountain .
description_long: Isakkhu Isakkhu was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s dwelling in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast in north Faerûn . Description . The deity took the form of a mountain . Personality . Isakkhu was dependable and reliable . Worshipers . At the end of each day , cleric s of Isakkhu asked him to return the sun the next morning and he never failed to deliver .

title: Isendraug
description: Isendraug Isendraug was a white dragon enslaved by the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Isendraug lived with her mate Cryovain in Svarborg .
description_long: Isendraug Isendraug was a white dragon enslaved by the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Isendraug lived with her mate Cryovain in Svarborg . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , frost giant minions of Jarl Storvald reclaimed the place during an absence of Isendraug and Cryovain and took the opportinity to steal all their eggs . Storvald blackmailed the two white dragons into obeying his orders or face the destruction of their eggs . Isendraug was always plotting a means of freeing herself and making the giants paying for their crimes .

title: Isfizari ibn - Atash
description: Isfizari ibn - Atash Isfizari ibn - Atash was an outland priest and fanatic of Kossuth inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Frequent violent communes with his god left Isfizari ' s body horribly burned and disfigured .
description_long: Isfizari ibn - Atash Isfizari ibn - Atash was an outland priest and fanatic of Kossuth inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Frequent violent communes with his god left Isfizari ' s body horribly burned and disfigured . He hid these injuries behind hand and face wraps . Activities . Isfizari lived to spread the word of mighty Kossuth . On a weekly basis Isfizari tasked Ayesha al - Rumi and Qirmiz min Hudid with bringing him an enemy of his faith . The victim was burned alive during a special ceremony and their ashes were added to large pile containing the remains of previous victims .

title: Ishal Karanok
description: Ishal Karanok Ishal Karanok was a member of House Karanok who came to control all of Chessenta in the years following the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He gained the trust of the people after he repelled the armies of aberration s sent by the Abolethic Sovereignty in 1399 DR .
description_long: Ishal Karanok Ishal Karanok was a member of House Karanok who came to control all of Chessenta in the years following the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He gained the trust of the people after he repelled the armies of aberration s sent by the Abolethic Sovereignty in 1399 DR .

title: Ishaldra
description: Ishaldra Ishaldra was a dryad princess and a powerful fey of Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . Activities . She advised her companion prince Whitchthorn , balancing his evil inclinations with her good nature .
description_long: Ishaldra Ishaldra was a dryad princess and a powerful fey of Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . Activities . She advised her companion prince Whitchthorn , balancing his evil inclinations with her good nature . History . In 1489 DR , the arrival of Claugiyliamatar corrupted Ishaldra and her treant bodyguard . The corruption , coming in the form of poisoned waters , paralyzed Ishaldra and drove her treant mad . Eventually , an adventuring party hired to defeat Old Gnawbones freed them from corruption and in exchange they were directed to King Whitchthorn .

title: Ishenalyr
description: Ishenalyr Ishenalyr was an ancient green dragon who was one of the agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Abilities . Ishenalyr was a type of draconic mystic called hidecarved .
description_long: Ishenalyr Ishenalyr was an ancient green dragon who was one of the agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Abilities . Ishenalyr was a type of draconic mystic called hidecarved . History . In 1373 DR , he was part of the chromatic dragon force at the siege of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . However , thanks to a deception by the bronze dragon Chatulio , Ishenalyr provoked the red dragon Malazan and they soon fought a duel to the death , which saw Malazan the victor and Ishenalyr dead .

title: Ishi Barasume
description: Ishi Barasume Ishi Barasume was a crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Ishi hailed from Kozakura in Kara - Tur .
description_long: Ishi Barasume Ishi Barasume was a crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Ishi hailed from Kozakura in Kara - Tur . She was trained as a warrior . Later , however , she was chosen to receive special training and was sent on a mysterious mission out of Kozakura . While in T ' u Lung , she helped Dwalimar Omen in dealing with a local wu jen . Omen was impressed and offered her a position in his crew and Ishi accepted . Personality . Ishi truly lived for her honor , she preferred death than dishonor to her or her family . Ishi always had perfect manners with strangers but with her friends she was open and playful . She always respected skilled warriors . Relationship . In time , Ishi fell in love with the paladin Priam Agrivar .

title: Ishtar
description: Ishtar Ishtar was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her progenitor , Inanna ) . She departed the world of Toril soon after Enlil did . In her place , she left her portfolio and the right to use her name and appearance to the Mulhorandi goddess Isis .
description_long: Ishtar Ishtar was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her progenitor , Inanna ) . She departed the world of Toril soon after Enlil did . In her place , she left her portfolio and the right to use her name and appearance to the Mulhorandi goddess Isis . Her holy symbol was a female hand clutching a rod of blue crystal . Description . Ishtar was portrayed as a beautiful human female with blonde hair and blue eyes . She could change her shape at will , but never appeared in any shape save that of a beautiful woman . She wore the " headdress of love and war " , which forced any male she was truly interested in to fall passionately in love with her , and gave her the same powers as whatever enemy she fought . She drove a flying chariot pulled by seven enchanted lions . When in the chariot , nothing made of metal could touch Ishtar . Relationships . Ishtar was born from the goddess Inanna . Once they were the same being , but as Inanna ' s people grew more civilized , her pantheon split in two , with new aspects of the older gods becoming entities in their own right . Realm . Ishtar dwelled in the City of the Star on the first layer of Elysium .

title: Ishtiyam
description: Ishtiyam Ishtiyam was the term used to describe a pilot or navigator of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Not every ship in Zakhara had an " ishtiyam " on board at all times , but it was common practice to hire one when departing for a long voyage or as a backup when sailing through particularly dangerous waters .
description_long: Ishtiyam Ishtiyam was the term used to describe a pilot or navigator of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Not every ship in Zakhara had an " ishtiyam " on board at all times , but it was common practice to hire one when departing for a long voyage or as a backup when sailing through particularly dangerous waters .

title: Isimud
description: Isimud Isimud was the wizard leader of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Isimud was a very old wizard , relying on magical means to move .
description_long: Isimud Isimud was the wizard leader of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Isimud was a very old wizard , relying on magical means to move . Activities . Isimud was in search of some powerful artifact s of the Old Unther Empire in order to prevent them falling into the hands of the god - king Gilgeam or the cult of Tiamat or someone worse . Personality . Isimud was frustrated that no benign group wanted to try to rule Unther . He was disposable to totally supporting a group of this kind .

title: Isis
description: Isis Isis ( pronounced " eye " - sys ) is a kind deity that takes joy in revealing new discoveries to her followers . She is known as Isharia in Thay , and by the name Ishtar in Unther . History .
description_long: Isis Isis ( pronounced " eye " - sys ) is a kind deity that takes joy in revealing new discoveries to her followers . She is known as Isharia in Thay , and by the name Ishtar in Unther . History . Isis , with the assistance of Nephthys , resurrected Osiris when he was murdered by Set Relationships . Isis is the daughter of Geb and Nut . She is the sister of Thoth and wife of Osiris , as well as the mother of Horus ( now Horus - Re ) . Isis and Nephthys are twins . The nonevil members of the Mulhorandi pantheon are allies of Isis , as is Sharess . The Bountiful Lady considers Chauntea a confidant and friend . Due to their similar portfolios and differing alignments , Isis often finds herself in conflict with Sebek . Avatar . Isis appears as a Mulan woman in a white linen dress and sandals . She also wears an ornate headdress and jewelry . Powers and abilities . Isis can fly and communicate with other members of the Mulhorandi pantheon over great distances . Her voice charms those that hear it , and her will can stun those around her . She can harm her enemies with a simple touch . Those who have known love of another cannot harm the Lady of all Love . Other manifestations .

title: Iskander
description: Iskander Iskander was a wizard member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons second - in - command of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Iskander was a wizard long time member of the Cult , being a strong dracolich traditionalist he did not like the new direction of the Cult under Severin . At one point just before Tyranny of Dragons Iskander was nominated second - in - command of the just conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists .
description_long: Iskander Iskander was a wizard member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons second - in - command of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Iskander was a wizard long time member of the Cult , being a strong dracolich traditionalist he did not like the new direction of the Cult under Severin . At one point just before Tyranny of Dragons Iskander was nominated second - in - command of the just conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists . He noticed the unusual demise of many young promising member of the Cult before reaching their full potential ; so Iskander start to think that in the Severin ' s Cult was in act a policy of advancement through assassination and / or the killing of too ambitious underling . Soon Iskander believed that he will be the next in the assassination ' s list . When he experiment a stomach affliction Iskander believe was a poison ' s attempt ; so he decided to betray the Cult sending a message to the Council of Waterdeep praising to send agents to the Xonthal ' s Tower to free he in exchange for the " Blue dragon mask " currently there .

title: Iskh Lammarask
description: Iskh Lammarask Iskh Lammarask , known as Motherlass Longfingers to her patrons , was an old human inn owner in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Iskh had gold eyes under fierce black brows .
description_long: Iskh Lammarask Iskh Lammarask , known as Motherlass Longfingers to her patrons , was an old human inn owner in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Iskh had gold eyes under fierce black brows . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Iskh managed the Iskh ' s Rest " inn " . She also served as a sort of mother - like figure to the people of Blackhold . In her young days , she was also a dancer .

title: Iskor
description: Iskor Iskor was a water wraith from Elemental Plane of Water . Activities . Iskor acted as a broker of information acting on the behalf of a water god worshiped in the Inner Planes and by sea creatures of Faerûn .
description_long: Iskor Iskor was a water wraith from Elemental Plane of Water . Activities . Iskor acted as a broker of information acting on the behalf of a water god worshiped in the Inner Planes and by sea creatures of Faerûn . She however wanted more power for herself . History . The illithid Vestress of Ascarle bargained an agreement with Iskor and she provided the illithid with some extraplanar creatures like some nereid s . In 1361 DR , the archmage Gromph Baenre summoned Iskor and convinced Shakti Hunzrin to bargain an agreement with her in order to locate Liriel Baenre . Shakti agreed . Using the water ways , Iskor went to Ascarle and reported the conversation to Vestress , proposing to add the drow to the agents of the Kraken Society . Vestress liked the idea and Iskor explained that Shakti was in search of a renegade drow wizard , the same girl who was causing trouble to Vestress too . During the attack on Ruathym , Iskor was sent to attack some water elemental s . Relationships . Iskor had to obey to Gromph Baenre because he knew her true name . She was a trusted ally of Vestress of Ascarle . Powers .

title: Island giant
description: Island giant Island giants were malevolent giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Island giants communicated via a broken form of Midani that was mostly unintelligible by others who spoke Midani . Description .
description_long: Island giant Island giants were malevolent giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Island giants communicated via a broken form of Midani that was mostly unintelligible by others who spoke Midani . Description . Island giants varied greatly in their appearance , but all were horrific . They were humanoid in shape , possessing bestial features that could include tails , horns , monstrous appendages , and a single cyclopian eye . These behemoths stood 18 ft . ( 5 . 5 m ) tall and weighed 8 , 000 pounds ( 3600 kg ) . They usually dressed in rags crafted from the sails of ships they had wrecked . Combat . Like many giants , island giants were adept at tossing boulders . They used this skill to deter anything from following them and to sink ships . They were also skilled at catching any similar objects thrown in their direction . Since they were not skilled craftsmen , they used their fists for close combat . Island giants enjoyed luring ships into carefully placed traps so that they could feed for an extended period of time as opposed to just sinking a ship outright . Female island giants could " shapechange " into any human or humanoid form at will .

title: Island of Gardens
description: Island of Gardens The Island of Gardens , or al - Haba ' iq , was located within the Genie ' s Turban of the Corsair Domains off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Geography . The coast of this island was covered with lush foliage , giving the island its name .
description_long: Island of Gardens The Island of Gardens , or al - Haba ' iq , was located within the Genie ' s Turban of the Corsair Domains off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Geography . The coast of this island was covered with lush foliage , giving the island its name . The island ' s elevation rose steadily along the eastern and southeastern faces , capping at a cliff 2 , 500 ft . ( 762 m ) above sea level . Twin waterfalls located on the southern end of the island were visible at sea from up to 16 miles ( 25 . 8 km ) away . The River of Gold originated at the top of a steep cliff on the island . Several villages were located near the coast or along the eastern area of forested elevation called the Comb .

title: Island of the Free
description: Island of the Free The Island of the Free was a small settlement located on an earthmote in eastern Tethyr near the Omlarandin Mountains . History . It was founded in approximately 1462 DR by the escaped slave and former gladiator Azad the Free .
description_long: Island of the Free The Island of the Free was a small settlement located on an earthmote in eastern Tethyr near the Omlarandin Mountains . History . It was founded in approximately 1462 DR by the escaped slave and former gladiator Azad the Free . The settlement ' s primary source of income and only claim to fame was the gladiatorial arena Azad constructed . When Cephas returned to the island he freed the gladiators , many of whom decided to leave the settlement .

title: Islands of the Utter South
description: Islands of the Utter South The Islands of the Utter South , also simply called the Utter South , was a series of unexplored islands found south of the known regions of the Crowded Sea . Geography . Situated south of the Djinni ' s Claws , the Steaming Isles , and Bariya , the Islands of the Utter South sprawled east to west for over a thousand miles across waters that most sailing vessels wisely avoided .
description_long: Islands of the Utter South The Islands of the Utter South , also simply called the Utter South , was a series of unexplored islands found south of the known regions of the Crowded Sea . Geography . Situated south of the Djinni ' s Claws , the Steaming Isles , and Bariya , the Islands of the Utter South sprawled east to west for over a thousand miles across waters that most sailing vessels wisely avoided . Description . The various islands were clumped into a roughly linear chain . Many of the islands were forested , but as of 1367 DR no Zakharan had dared explore the region .

title: Isle of Devils
description: Isle of Devils The Isle of Devils was the largest of the Outer Isles of Wa . Devil s that had once wandered the mainland were banished here by the Spirit of Wa . A man had to agree to take the place of a devil before it could leave .
description_long: Isle of Devils The Isle of Devils was the largest of the Outer Isles of Wa . Devil s that had once wandered the mainland were banished here by the Spirit of Wa . A man had to agree to take the place of a devil before it could leave .

title: Isle of Gargantuas
description: Isle of Gargantuas The Isle of Gargantuas was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur , and home to gigantic monsters , called gargantua s . Description . The island was often rent by volcanic eruptions and earthquakes , which devastated the landscape .
description_long: Isle of Gargantuas The Isle of Gargantuas was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur , and home to gigantic monsters , called gargantua s . Description . The island was often rent by volcanic eruptions and earthquakes , which devastated the landscape . The air was humid , bearing the stink of sulfur and coal and dense with explosions . Deep granite pits dotted the island , forming traps for the gargantuas . History . Around Wa Year 1765 ( 1347 DR ) , two krakentua had a titanic battle with more powerful spirits of the ocean . Badly wounded , they escaped to the Isle of Gargantuas to heal and recuperate . One krakentua stayed to rule the island and its monsters by Wa Year 1775 ( 1357 DR ) , while the other went to the Fochu Peninsula , seeking human s to worship her . Around Wa Year 1776 ( 1358 DR ) , the second krakentua would inflict a vision of a battle on the Isle of Gargantuas on adventurers who visited her at Shinkintin . Inhabitants . The insectoid and reptilian gargantua s battled each other relentlessly . There were also humanoid gargantua s , who also got in on the action .

title: Isle of One Thousand Pines
description: Isle of One Thousand Pines The Isle of One Thousand Pines was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur . It was considered part of Jasuga Province . It was a densely forested place , hence its name .
description_long: Isle of One Thousand Pines The Isle of One Thousand Pines was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur . It was considered part of Jasuga Province . It was a densely forested place , hence its name . The island was the site of a prison colony for Wa , until the prisoners were relocated to Ibhei , a larger island . The prison was abandoned and left to fall to ruins . Kazuo Tokuri was the last prisoner to be held on the Isle . He was nephew to the former shogun , Matasuuri Shogoro , and had been framed for planning a coup . He died there , and his spirit was said to still linger in the ruins of the prison by 1357 DR .

title: Isle of Quelthiir
description: Isle of Quelthiir The Isle of Quelthiir , also known simply as Quelthiir or Passion Island , was an island that separated the Luirenstrand bay from the open waters of the Great Sea off the coast of Luiren . Geography . The Isle of Quelthiir was located off the southern coast of Luiren , a straight shot southeast from Shoun .
description_long: Isle of Quelthiir The Isle of Quelthiir , also known simply as Quelthiir or Passion Island , was an island that separated the Luirenstrand bay from the open waters of the Great Sea off the coast of Luiren . Geography . The Isle of Quelthiir was located off the southern coast of Luiren , a straight shot southeast from Shoun . It separated the Luirenstrand bay from the open waters of the Great Sea . Description . The island was 100 miles long and 10 miles wide . It appeared to be a large sandbar , with low hills and sea grass with only the occasional stunted tree . In part because of its location and low elevation , periodic storms from the ocean beat down on it . Rumors and legends . It was said that pirates , led by Jape " One - Eye " Belson , buried a fortune of pearls and silver in a heavily protected vault somewhere on the island .

title: Islif Lurelake
description: Islif Lurelake Islif Lurelake was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Islif was born in the village of Espar to the trader Buckman Lurelake .
description_long: Islif Lurelake Islif Lurelake was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Islif was born in the village of Espar to the trader Buckman Lurelake . She was tutored in the way of sword by the old warrior and hunter Skuldi Wolfspear . Islif went to search of fortune with Florin Falconhand , Doust Sulwood , and Semoor Wolftooth . Later , Doust asked her to marry him when he was nominated Lord of Shadowdale and she agreed , serving her husband as captain of the militia and giving birth to a son , Jhaok Sulwood , while fighting against drow , Zhentarim , and Lashan Aumersair . When Doust retired and gave the lordship to Mourngrym Amcathra , she and her family retired to Arabel to live quietly .

title: Islik Herlingson
description: Islik Herlingson Islik Herlingson was a dwarf and leader of the Herlinga Clan in the Hordelands . Description . Like all Herlinga dwarves , Islik was red - bearded .
description_long: Islik Herlingson Islik Herlingson was a dwarf and leader of the Herlinga Clan in the Hordelands . Description . Like all Herlinga dwarves , Islik was red - bearded . Activities . Islik led the Herlinga dwarves from Sossal into the Hordelands where he discovered the Glittering Spires during the mid - 1000s DR .

title: Issacortae
description: Issacortae The Issacortae people inhabited the western part of the wild lands of Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Description . The barbaric Issacortae were medium build and muscular with black curly hair .
description_long: Issacortae The Issacortae people inhabited the western part of the wild lands of Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Description . The barbaric Issacortae were medium build and muscular with black curly hair . Tribes of Issacortae hunters and gatherers wandered from one place to another chasing herds of deer and other animals . Agriculture was practically nonexistent and fishing was little applicability . Many Issacort enjoyed dancing , singing , and running . Combat . The weapons used by the tribes were usually axe s , bow s , spear s and club s . Society . Ruled by their king , the Issacort were the most civilized tribe union in northern lands . The Issacortae were not one tribe , but a union of many tribes who obeyed the king . Each tribe was ruled by a chieftain , a diplomat , and military commander . The eight tribes formed a union that followed the laws of their High King and High Queen . Religion . Usually religion had a very large impact on the tribes . They commonly practiced and . Shaman s could be both men and women . Shamans often were treated with great respect and awe around the population .

title: Issacortae language
description: Issacortae language Issacortae , also spelled Isacorte , was a language spoken by the Issacortae people of the northwestern Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Issacortae was related to Pazruki and Wu - haltai , other languages in the Amaese languages group .
description_long: Issacortae language Issacortae , also spelled Isacorte , was a language spoken by the Issacortae people of the northwestern Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Issacortae was related to Pazruki and Wu - haltai , other languages in the Amaese languages group . Issacortae was considered to be " only vaguely related " to the Eastern Imaskari languages group . It comprised a family of dialects descending from a common ancestral tongue . The Issacortae nation had little writing or centralization , so the language developed independently of the other nations .

title: Issani
description: Issani Issani was a messanger of Waterdeep . Biography . Issani was sent from Waterdeep to negotiate with Neverwinter .
description_long: Issani Issani was a messanger of Waterdeep . Biography . Issani was sent from Waterdeep to negotiate with Neverwinter . However , orcs captured this emissary and was tortured . The Luskans wanted Issani to enter Neverwinter and act as a spy . Gameplay . Whether working with the thieves or the Watch , the Kalach - Cha and the companions had to rescue Issani from the orcs . They would meet an emissary in Bonegnasher Lair , but that emissary is a fraud , who worked with the orcs . Instead , Issani would be found in Eyegouger Lair and would be transported to Neverwinter .

title: Issayk
description: Issayk Issayk was the most infamous forger in Skullport . Activities . Issayk could forge the most perfect false documents in the Realms .
description_long: Issayk Issayk was the most infamous forger in Skullport . Activities . Issayk could forge the most perfect false documents in the Realms . Thanks to his web of contacts across Faerûn , he was always informed of coming changes in the bureaucracy of a particular kingdom . Issayk also obtained wax pressings of seals of the governments of Calimport , Luskan , Waterdeep , Cormyr , and Sembia . Obviously , his prices were very high but the true mystery was what happened to all the money Issayk earned , as nobody ever saw him with more than petty cash .

title: Issem
description: Issem Issem was a vampire in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Issem was a vampire who , in ancient times , was cursed to be bound to the Red Wizards of Thay and specifically to the Doomvault dungeon .
description_long: Issem Issem was a vampire in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Issem was a vampire who , in ancient times , was cursed to be bound to the Red Wizards of Thay and specifically to the Doomvault dungeon . In 1486 DR , he was in charge of the main upper level , also guarding the prisoner Shalendra Floshin . Personality . In truth , Issem hated the Red Wizards and it was only the curse that obliged him to work for them . Thus , adventurers could potentially persuade him to help them ruin the Red Wizards ' plans .

title: Isteval
description: Isteval Sir Isteval was a paladin from Cormyr . Personality . A noble , retired paladin who gathers adventurers to his cause .
description_long: Isteval Sir Isteval was a paladin from Cormyr . Personality . A noble , retired paladin who gathers adventurers to his cause . History . Sir Isteval , was a retired Paladin of Amaunator who viewed his god in an outmoded light as Lathander . He lived a retired life in Daggerford until he felt that others needed to follow the shining example that was his homeland so he gathered individuals with the same ideals and set forth to combat evil and chaos . Isteval ’ s place of birth was the Cormyrian town of Eveningstar . He joined the Purple Dragons while still a teenager , and was noted for his impeccable character . His desire to bring justice and defend his country brought him into conflict with many enemies in various locations . Some of his more battles were against the vicious orc bands of the Stonelands , dispatched Zhentarim agents along the western frontier , and making a valiant stand in Thunder Gap against Sembian raiders . Later , he led at least three groups of adventurers on missions in an effort to bring justice , goodness , and spread Cormyr ’ s influence . The first company of adventurers went to the Western Heartlands .

title: Isthana Ro
description: Isthana Ro Isthana Ro was the guild master of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar . Activities . Isthana managed the Rogue ' s Guild , the official thieves ' guild of Hillsfar .
description_long: Isthana Ro Isthana Ro was the guild master of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar . Activities . Isthana managed the Rogue ' s Guild , the official thieves ' guild of Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Isthana agreed to work with the Harpers in order to arrange a political change in the city ' s politics . She helped to smuggle an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil into the city using the sewers . She told the adventurers about the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet . Spies had reported to Isthana that some agents from Maerimydra had infiltrated the First Lord ' s court . It was also reported that the Lord was planning a rare trip outside of the city walls for a trade meeting with Damara n leaders in the city of Yûlash . Personality . Isthana was very smart and cared only about her guild . However , she also had amazingly acute business sense and the ability to think ahead . Isthana decided that supporting the Harpers was the best for her guild , instead seeing Torin Nomerthal as the biggest problem in the city .

title: Istishia
description: Istishia Istishia ( pronounced " is - TISH - ee - ah " ) , also known as King of Water Elementals , is the neutral primordial deity of elemental water and purification . Worshipers . Istishia is worshiped by Sailors , Pirates , Water Elementals , Water Genasi , some Aquatic Elves , and others who feel a bond with the Ocean ' s destructive power .
description_long: Istishia Istishia ( pronounced " is - TISH - ee - ah " ) , also known as King of Water Elementals , is the neutral primordial deity of elemental water and purification . Worshipers . Istishia is worshiped by Sailors , Pirates , Water Elementals , Water Genasi , some Aquatic Elves , and others who feel a bond with the Ocean ' s destructive power . Worship in Zakhara . On the continent of Zakhara , Istishia is called one of the cold gods of the elements . As those are seen as uncaring for human affairs , they are considered opposed to the Land of Fate ' s pervasive culture of Enlightenment . Only a few Zakharans are willing to worship a cold god in order to gain power . Relationships . Istishia allies are those deities with a relation to water , like Deep Sashelas , Eldath , Valkur , and Umberlee , but they are not strong relationships . He opposes Kossuth in every way . Istishia sits back and watches the struggle of the archomentals of water , Ben - Hadar and Olhydra ; presumably he would intervene if one would achieve a real chance to get control of elemental water . Publication history . Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 1st edition ( 1977 - 1988 ) .

title: Isyio
description: Isyio Isyio was a wizard in Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Once Isyio was an apprentice of the Simbul but after he embarrassed her the Simbul sent him away in order to mature .
description_long: Isyio Isyio was a wizard in Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Once Isyio was an apprentice of the Simbul but after he embarrassed her the Simbul sent him away in order to mature . In 1359 he was in Teziir doing magic research and teaching magic to the children of the Teziir City Council ' s members . He was till hurt by the Simbul ' s words and his goal was proved his sincerity and went back to Aglarond .

title: It ' s All in the Blood
description: It ' s All in the Blood It ' s All in the Blood , designed by Dave Olson , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on the village of Elventree , drow , and the Maerimydra . Summary .
description_long: It ' s All in the Blood It ' s All in the Blood , designed by Dave Olson , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on the village of Elventree , drow , and the Maerimydra . Summary . The adventure starts off with adventurers being invited to a shadowed cave outside of Elventree by Murssvayas Dhuurniv . Here the drow wizard asks for their assistance against the fire giant s of Maerimydra . In order to do so , they must help recover the drow alchemist , Xaven Tanor ' this . Following Murssvayas ' instructions , the adventurers descend into the Deep Wastes , eventually reaching the Howling Pits , where they battle past various denizens and dangers of the Underdark . Eventually , they find the Den of the Whispered Word where the yugoloth , Maram il Vass , holds Xaven . After either negotiating or fighting for the drow ' s release , the adventurers make their way to Sporedome , where the displaced drow of Szith Morcane , led by Solom Ned ' razak , reside . Xaven and Solom resolve to create a ritual to remove the demon ic taint from their enemies .

title: Item of cloaked wizardry
description: Item of cloaked wizardry An item of cloaked wizardry was any magic item that , in addition to possessing a regular enchantment , was also undetectable as a magic item from spells . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers .
description_long: Item of cloaked wizardry An item of cloaked wizardry was any magic item that , in addition to possessing a regular enchantment , was also undetectable as a magic item from spells . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . " Items of cloaked wizardry " revealed nothing when a " detect magic " spell was cast upon them . However , other divination spells such as " identify " would reveal the magical enchantment inherent in the item .

title: Items for the Immortals
description: Items for the Immortals Items for the Immortals was a shop located in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Items for the Immortals was located within the Court District since only the residents of that lavish section of Huzuz could afford the price of most of the items sold by the shop .
description_long: Items for the Immortals Items for the Immortals was a shop located in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Items for the Immortals was located within the Court District since only the residents of that lavish section of Huzuz could afford the price of most of the items sold by the shop . Inhabitants . Essafah al - Jamila owned and operated this shop , selling goods needed by both genie s and sha ' ir s .

title: Ithal Bridge
description: Ithal Bridge The Ithal Bridge was a large and ancient bridge over the River Ith at the exact center of the city of Darromar on the Ithal Road ( or Star Street ) . It was constructed by dwarves during the kingdom of Shanatar . The bridge was four wagons wide and was the only safe means of crossing the River Ith for hundreds of miles .
description_long: Ithal Bridge The Ithal Bridge was a large and ancient bridge over the River Ith at the exact center of the city of Darromar on the Ithal Road ( or Star Street ) . It was constructed by dwarves during the kingdom of Shanatar . The bridge was four wagons wide and was the only safe means of crossing the River Ith for hundreds of miles . In 1370 DR , the toll for crossing the bridge was one " donsar " per cart or two " donsar " per wagon .

title: Ithal Crag
description: Ithal Crag The Ithal Crag was a large hill in the Royal Quarter of Darromar where the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . Geography . The Ithal Crag was a rocky headland overlooking the River Ith to the south .
description_long: Ithal Crag The Ithal Crag was a large hill in the Royal Quarter of Darromar where the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . Geography . The Ithal Crag was a rocky headland overlooking the River Ith to the south . Sites . The lower portion of the hill was surrounded by the Garden of Rhinda . A winding path from led up the hill and through the garden to the buildings at the top . On the top of the hill rested the two main buildings of the palace complex , the main keep and the garrison building , along with other buildings , all surrounded by a granite wall . One of the city ' s four Watchtowers sat on the hill as well . History . In - 221 DR , sixteen - year - old Darrom Ithal defeated the Calishite s at this location , bringing freedom to Ithmong — and ultimately Tethyr — again . The hill was named after him . The first royal palace was built on the site in 843 DR , after the coronation of Queen Alisande , and the palace of Faerntarn made use of the same structure .

title: Ithal Road
description: Ithal Road The Ithal Road was a major trade road from Zazesspur to Saradush and Ithal Pass . It also passed through the center of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr , within which it was called Star Street . In Darromar , the road divided the city north to south , while the River Ith , which was crossed at the Ithal Bridge , divided the city east to west .
description_long: Ithal Road The Ithal Road was a major trade road from Zazesspur to Saradush and Ithal Pass . It also passed through the center of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr , within which it was called Star Street . In Darromar , the road divided the city north to south , while the River Ith , which was crossed at the Ithal Bridge , divided the city east to west . Two large markets , the Queen ' s Market and the Wheel Market were located west and east of the road , respectively . In the east of Tethyr , the road split at the fortress of Barakmordin with separate forks leading to Saradush and Ithal Pass . History . The Ithal Road was completed during the time of the Shoon Imperium under the leadership of the vassal kings of Tethyr .

title: Ithana Redstave
description: Ithana Redstave Ithana Redstave was an ambitious Zhentarim wizard in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Ithana lead the Zhent garrison in the city .
description_long: Ithana Redstave Ithana Redstave was an ambitious Zhentarim wizard in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Ithana lead the Zhent garrison in the city . She was busy with plotting the conquest of Scardale for the Black Network by trying to make Myrian Beechwood a puppet . History . Around 1368 DR , Ithana was trying to frame the Hillsfar garrison for some murders .

title: Ithboltar
description: Ithboltar Ithboltar was a male wizard who was the leader of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . Ithboltar was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , most of the magelords began as apprentices of him : first Neldryn Hawklyn , later Kadeln Olothstar and Seldinor Stormcloak .
description_long: Ithboltar Ithboltar was a male wizard who was the leader of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . Ithboltar was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , most of the magelords began as apprentices of him : first Neldryn Hawklyn , later Kadeln Olothstar and Seldinor Stormcloak . Thus Ithboltar was the closest to a leader of the magelords as possible . However , when Elminster Aumar began his insurrection , his students appeared too disunited to fight together against the rebels . In the end , Elminster with a powerful spell destroyed Ithboltar and the few remaining magelords agreed to fight together .

title: Ithimir Isle
description: Ithimir Isle Ithimir Isle was a small island off the coast of Akanûl . The island was originally in Abeir and fell into the Sea of Fallen Stars at the time of the Spellplague . The island was notable for being the only source of arambarium ore in Faerûn .
description_long: Ithimir Isle Ithimir Isle was a small island off the coast of Akanûl . The island was originally in Abeir and fell into the Sea of Fallen Stars at the time of the Spellplague . The island was notable for being the only source of arambarium ore in Faerûn .

title: Ithmonn
description: Ithmonn County Ithmonn was an agricultural region in central Tethyr . Geography . Ithmonn was located in the Crown Lands north of the River Ith and bordering the Purple Marches in the west .
description_long: Ithmonn County Ithmonn was an agricultural region in central Tethyr . Geography . Ithmonn was located in the Crown Lands north of the River Ith and bordering the Purple Marches in the west . The county was the agricultural center of Tethyr and was blanketed with crops of all varieties and farms containing all manner of livestock . Government . The Count of Ithmonn in 1370 DR was Malcor Grannox , who was also the Law Chancellor of Tethyr . He ruled from Loranse , a manor just west of Darromar along the river .

title: Ithraides
description: Ithraides High Spellstar Ithraides was a moon elf wizard and the High Spellstar of Arcorar who inscribed three telkiira , the first of which came into the possession of Araevin Teshurr . His subjects Kaeledhin , Morthil and Sanathar each took one of the telkiira . After his death and journey to Arvandor he left most of his tomes and treasures to the star elf Morthil .
description_long: Ithraides High Spellstar Ithraides was a moon elf wizard and the High Spellstar of Arcorar who inscribed three telkiira , the first of which came into the possession of Araevin Teshurr . His subjects Kaeledhin , Morthil and Sanathar each took one of the telkiira . After his death and journey to Arvandor he left most of his tomes and treasures to the star elf Morthil .

title: Ithvar Wordkiller
description: Ithvar Wordkiller Lord Ithvar Wordkiller was a wizard and businessman in Skullport . Personality . Ithvar ' s ruin was his temper , he was too ready to fight without thinking for a second .
description_long: Ithvar Wordkiller Lord Ithvar Wordkiller was a wizard and businessman in Skullport . Personality . Ithvar ' s ruin was his temper , he was too ready to fight without thinking for a second . He was also very ambitious and did not trust other wizards . He knew that Ysele would betray him in the future , but for the time they collaborated . History . Born into power and privilege as the son of an illustrious family of Cormyr , Ithvar from a young age showed an incredible talent in magic . Tutored by the best teacher available , he soon become a great mage and joined the War Wizards of Cormyr . However , thanks to his hot blood , he killed a superior during a dispute . His family ' s connections got him out of jail or a death penalty , but it was suggested that it would be better if he left the country . Ithvar wandered for a time until he settled in Skullport . There , he joined the also recently arrived Aurin . They formed the Hired Horrors business with Chantos Graybeard and Ysele the Cat . Being the major investor , Ithvar believed he should be the boss but Aurin , who ' d captured the deepspawn , contested this .

title: Ito - Jo
description: Ito - Jo Ito - Jo was a cursed castle in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Ito - Jo was the ancestral home of the Ito family in Maeshi , build on a small island near the coastline .
description_long: Ito - Jo Ito - Jo was a cursed castle in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Ito - Jo was the ancestral home of the Ito family in Maeshi , build on a small island near the coastline . Its misfortunes started when in 639 DR the lordship of Ito went to Ito Saburo , a greedy man secretly manipulated by a demon spirit , the krakentua . Saburo was in a feud with the Nambu family , a branch of the Ito family that had split from the main branch in 546 DR , over the governorship of Maeshi . In order to destroy his enemies , Saburo agreed to sacrifice one of the Seven Swords to the Krakentua in 646 DR . However , in 647 DR , despite the extinction of the Nambu clan , the sohei of the Sun Temple burned the castle to the ground on the Night of Burning Flowers and all the Ito family and their retainers were slain . Sensing the evil inside , the sohei placed an " ancient curse " over the castle ' s ruins . Some years afterward , it was discovered that the site was haunted by people who had died in the Night of Burning Flowers .

title: Ito Chomei
description: Ito Chomei Ito Chomei was a cursed shukenja in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Chomei was a retainer of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .
description_long: Ito Chomei Ito Chomei was a cursed shukenja in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Chomei was a retainer of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR . Thanks to an " ancient curse " and a krakentua ' s influence , he did not truly die and instead lingered to haunt the castle as fifth of the seven weapon masters of the castle . Finally , in 1360 DR , an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed him .

title: Ityak - Ortheel
description: Ityak - Ortheel Ityak - Ortheel , commonly called the Elf Eater , is a monstrous creature that dwells in the Abyss , waiting for the god Malar , the Beastlord , to summon it to Faerûn to destroy life . Physical description . The Elf Eater is a thirty - foot - tall monstrosity that stands on three enormous , trunk - like legs .
description_long: Ityak - Ortheel Ityak - Ortheel , commonly called the Elf Eater , is a monstrous creature that dwells in the Abyss , waiting for the god Malar , the Beastlord , to summon it to Faerûn to destroy life . Physical description . The Elf Eater is a thirty - foot - tall monstrosity that stands on three enormous , trunk - like legs . Its flesh is tannish - brown , and its midsection is a flat , round blob of flesh with an extremely hard , domed resting atop it . The midsection is surrounded by forty tentacles , each a hundred feet long and lined by large suckers . Ityak - Ortheel can re - grow severed tentacles and legs . It can also instantly reattach a severed leg by holding it to the stump . On Ityak - Ortheel ’ s underside , protruding from between its three legs , is an enormous maw . The maw is toothless and constantly emits a slurping sound , with wet flaps of skin sucking in and out of the darkness within . The mouth is the color of blood and can expand to a great width or extend downward into a long snout similar to that of an . Within the mouth , hard plates of constantly grind together .

title: Itza
description: Itza The Itzas were a human people of Far Payit in the southeast of Maztica . They were a sub - grouping of the Payit race . Description .
description_long: Itza The Itzas were a human people of Far Payit in the southeast of Maztica . They were a sub - grouping of the Payit race . Description . The name " Itza " came from the name of their greatest city , Tulom - Itzi . These people were known for their learned and peaceful culture . In fact , anyone who performed an act of violence was banished from society . In ages past , the Itzas produced great works of architecture , including observatories for the study of the sky above . They were skilled in the working of gold and jade . They delighted in the creation of water fountains , which made use of pluma magic . Even a small Itza village might include such a fountain . The Itzas loved colors , both in fabric and in feathers , and were especially interested in colors not found in nature . As an offshoot of the Payit race , the Itzas were a stout folk . Despite their muscular appearance , they tended to be weaker than other humans , yet they were quite dexterous and more intelligent and wise than other races . Language . The Itzas spoke the Payit language . Society . Most Itzas lived in communal villages with no central form of government and organized by clan .

title: Iuak
description: Iuak An iuak was a blade made of bone or stone that resembled a machete , common in the Great Glacier . Description . An iuak was about two - feet - long and six - inches - wide .
description_long: Iuak An iuak was a blade made of bone or stone that resembled a machete , common in the Great Glacier . Description . An iuak was about two - feet - long and six - inches - wide . It had a flat tip , and weighed about four pounds ( two kilograms ) . In some lands , it could sell for as much as twelve gold pieces . Usage . It was primarily used for carving snow blocks for snow houses , but it could also be used as a weapon . However , Iuaks tended to break if employed in combat by someone not skilled in their usage . Notable Owners . Nearly every Iulutiun hunter carried an iuak . Iuaks were less popular among the Angulutiun s , and only about half of their hunters bore this weapon . The weapon was rare among the Nakulutiun s . The great explorer Sharra Frohm carried an iuak as did the famous Iulutiun philosopher Inum . Najass , a master Iulutiun hunter , fought with a custom - made , two - handed iuak made from tirichik bone .

title: Iulutiun
description: Iulutiun The Iulutiuns ( EE - oo - LOO - shee - uns ) were a human people living in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were one of the ethnicities collectively known as the Ulutiun s and the most numerous of all human tribes living on the Glacier . Description .
description_long: Iulutiun The Iulutiuns ( EE - oo - LOO - shee - uns ) were a human people living in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were one of the ethnicities collectively known as the Ulutiun s and the most numerous of all human tribes living on the Glacier . Description . Iulutiuns were short and stocky and had round and flat facial features . They rarely were taller than five feet ( 150 cm ) . Males usually weighed between 130 and 260 pounds ( 60 – 120 kg ) , and females were about 35 pounds ( 16 kg ) lighter . They had short and thick legs with stubby fingers and toes . Their ears and nose were tiny , and they had especially wide teeth . They had light yellow or brown skin , dark brown eyes , and black hair . Iulutiuns had more fat under their skin than other humans and extra blood vessels in their extremities . Males could not grow facial hair . These adaptations gave them a special resistance to living in the frigid cold weather of their native lands . Iulutiuns tended to have greater strength and fortitude than other human races but , with their stubby fingers and shorter legs , lacked the speed and dexterity of other humans .

title: Iurnan Chall
description: Iurnan Chall Iurnan Chall was a mercenary in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company and the company ' s magic - user .
description_long: Iurnan Chall Iurnan Chall was a mercenary in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company and the company ' s magic - user . History . In 1358 DR , the Sailors of the Crimson Sea were marching to the city of Timindar in Chondath , having been hired by Lord Reland Tymin , when they were ambushed by unknown enemies who killed the company ' s leader and destroyed their food supply . Afterward , Iurnan went with the acting commander Lhrek Jarsyn and all the high - ranking members of the company went into Chondalwood in search of more food . However , after killing a deer , they were captured by the druid Variath and his treant s , who put them on trial . Iurnan tried to put all the blame on Lhrek . Later he became involved in the Battle of Thurgabanteth . Personality . Iurnan considered himself a better choice as leader of the company and tried to undermine Lhrek at any opportunity , but only with words .

title: Ivan Bouldershoulder
description: Ivan Bouldershoulder Ivan Bouldershoulder was a dwarf , brother to Pikel Bouldershoulder . Description . Ivan had a long yellow beard , square shoulders , and dark eyes .
description_long: Ivan Bouldershoulder Ivan Bouldershoulder was a dwarf , brother to Pikel Bouldershoulder . Description . Ivan had a long yellow beard , square shoulders , and dark eyes . He had a long , wide nose . History . Ivan and his brother Pikel were born and raised in Vaasa , in the rugged Galena Mountains . They resided at Spirit Soaring , a temple to Deneir , with Cadderly Bonaduce and his wife Danica . At one point , Ivan and Pikel fought alongside elves in Shilmista against orcs and goblins . In 1370 DR , Ivan and Pikel set out from Carradoon to attend the coronation of King Bruenor Battlehammer in Mithral Hall . They were captured by the moon elves of the Moonwood ( specifically Innovindil and Tarathiel ) and held captive for a few days . Upon the elves ' determining that they meant no harm to the elves or the forest , the two were released and proceeded to Mithral Hall . In DR , Ivan ' s mind was taken over by the dracolich Yharaskrik . Ivan later regained control of his body and escaped into the tunnels of the mountains . In 1484 DR , Ivan was serving as a commander in Helgabal . Possessions . Ivan wore plate mail in combat , with a metal helm adorned with deer antlers .

title: Ivold Nakarof
description: Ivold Nakarof Ivold Nakarof was a priest of Bane , serving in Zhentil Keep . Ivold ' s older brother died in the Battle of Falling Wasps at the hands of the Red Plumes and in 1373 DR he decided to enact his vengeance upon them . After traveling to a cemetery near the road between Hillsfar and Yulash , Ivold started casting " animate dead " to raise an army of fallen soldiers with the intention to unleash them on the Red Plume forces .
description_long: Ivold Nakarof Ivold Nakarof was a priest of Bane , serving in Zhentil Keep . Ivold ' s older brother died in the Battle of Falling Wasps at the hands of the Red Plumes and in 1373 DR he decided to enact his vengeance upon them . title: Ivor Beguine
description: Ivor Beguine Ivor Beguine served as a sailor on the pirate ship " Orcsblood " . History . In 1460 DR , Ivor and his friend Gareth Jadaren became disgusted with the brutality of their captain and abandoned ship near Mulmaster .
description_long: Ivor Beguine Ivor Beguine served as a sailor on the pirate ship " Orcsblood " . History . In 1460 DR , Ivor and his friend Gareth Jadaren became disgusted with the brutality of their captain and abandoned ship near Mulmaster . They chanced upon two deva s and gave them the location of the " Orcsblood " and the devas attacked and destroyed the ship . While in Mulmaster , Ivor met a young apprentice mage named Jandi M ' baren and the two fell in love . Ivor traveled south with Jandi and Gareth toward Turmish . Along the road , they passed the abandoned dwarven stronghold known as Giant ' s Fist and Gareth became convinced the location would be ideal to settle in . However , the former first mate of the " Orcsblood " , Helgre , had tracked the trio and killed Jandi in revenge for Gareth and Ivor ' s betrayal . Ivor went on to found the powerful Beguine merchant family in Turmish .

title: Ivory
description: Ivory Ivory , also known as , was the primary substance that makes up the teeth or tusks of all mammals and some other creatures . It was carved for artistic ornaments and also many practical uses . Description .
description_long: Ivory Ivory , also known as , was the primary substance that makes up the teeth or tusks of all mammals and some other creatures . It was carved for artistic ornaments and also many practical uses . Description . Pure ivory was a bright white color , but acquired stains , discolorations , and patterns during use by the animal from which it came . Some animals that grew large teeth or tusks were behemoth , boar , elephant , hippopotamus , mammoth , narwhal , umber hulk , walrus , and the cachalot whale . Larger specimens were used for carving while smaller pieces were used for buttons or ornamentation on clothing , accouterments , and even buildings . The price of raw ivory depended on the hardness , the color or mottling of colors , how well it polished , and current preferences . A typical price range was 1 to 5 gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Carved and polished ivory items had a base value of 10 gp . Fossilized ivory was found in small quantities , being the result of prehistoric elephant , mastodon , and smilodon teeth being buried for millennia , causing parts of its structure to be replaced by minerals .

title: Ivory Plague
description: Ivory Plague The Ivory Plague was a disease that was prevalent in Kara - Tur . Outbreaks . Shou Lung .
description_long: Ivory Plague The Ivory Plague was a disease that was prevalent in Kara - Tur . Outbreaks . Shou Lung . In Shou Lung , an outbreak of the ivory plague decimated the population of Hai Sheng , then the Imperial Capital , in Shou Year 859 ( −391 DR ) . The first Emperor Chin of the Hai Dynasty and his household all died of the plague , with only his sister and grandson surviving . The plague continued for several years , until finally a huge ki - rin visited the city . It ordered the surviving Imperial family to flee and ended the outbreak , saving the remaining populace . Afterward , Hai Sheng was renamed Kirin in its honor and the folk there believed the city was protected by the Celestial Emperor . However , the Imperial Capital was moved to Kuo Te ' Lung . Descendants of those who dealt with the ki - rin bore great resistance to common diseases thereafter . It was said that the Giants in Grey , whose appearance presaged immense tragedy , warned of the Ivory Plague , having appeared in the Imperial Compound the previous year , Shou Year 858 ( −392 DR ) . Koryo .

title: Ixan
description: Ixan Ixan was a Weaver of the Purple wizard and a traditionalist leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . He remained loyal to the old traditions of the Cult , in opposition to the majority of the Cult that had shifted to Severin Silrajin ' s vision .
description_long: Ixan Ixan was a Weaver of the Purple wizard and a traditionalist leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . He remained loyal to the old traditions of the Cult , in opposition to the majority of the Cult that had shifted to Severin Silrajin ' s vision . In order to increase the power of his faction , in 1489 DR he sought the power hidden in a village on a small isle near Phlan . He had his kobold minions attack the village , but they were defeated by an adventuring party hired to investigate rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships wandering the area , as well as the villagers , who has mastered fiend ish powers . Soon after , Ixan ' s ship was attacked both by the adventurers and fiendish pirates accidentally summoned by the villagers . In the battle , Ixan and his crew were presumably killed .

title: Ixilthetocal
description: Ixilthetocal Ixilthetocal was a mad sahuagin king in the Sea of Swords . History . Ixilthetocal ruled the City of Caverns .
