description_long: Ixilthetocal Ixilthetocal was a mad sahuagin king in the Sea of Swords . History . Ixilthetocal ruled the City of Caverns . However , Prince Villynaty started a civil war in order to dethrone Ixilthetocal . Eventually Gorion ' s Ward arrived in the City of Caverns and Ixilthetocal met him , asking to them to kill Villynaty .

title: Ixtzul
description: Ixtzul Ixtzul is a lost city deep within the jungles of Far Payit on the continent of Maztica . Although the city was abandoned hundreds of years ago , it remains in very good condition because of the caretakers created by the city ' s last ruler , Greyst . Before he died , Greyst used Hishna magic to create a colony of giant , intelligent ants .
description_long: Ixtzul Ixtzul is a lost city deep within the jungles of Far Payit on the continent of Maztica . Although the city was abandoned hundreds of years ago , it remains in very good condition because of the caretakers created by the city ' s last ruler , Greyst . Before he died , Greyst used Hishna magic to create a colony of giant , intelligent ants . These ants have worked to keep the pyramids and other major builings in good repair . They also work to renew the wards that keep the Star Worm bound in his lair .

title: Ixusaxa Terrorsong
description: Ixusaxa Terrorsong Ixusaxa Terronsong was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ixusaxa ' s main objective was the power to command true dragons , if someone can offer to her something related to it , she can betray her current masters , otherwise she followed loyally her duty , hoping to rise the rank .
description_long: Ixusaxa Terrorsong Ixusaxa Terronsong was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ixusaxa ' s main objective was the power to command true dragons , if someone can offer to her something related to it , she can betray her current masters , otherwise she followed loyally her duty , hoping to rise the rank . Ixusaxa considered all being with a sorter life than her just garbage History . Ixusaxa hailed from Myth Drannor but was made outcast at early age ; she decided to join the Cult after seeing the devastation unlashed by a red dragon Alongside Farnvik , Ixusaxa was one of the main leaders of the cultists that took over Phlan in 1489 DR . When it was reported that the resistance ' s leaders had likely tried to escape the city through the sewers , thanks to some adventurers , she decided to solve the matter herself . With her two wyvern s and shield guardian , she managed to ambush the escaping group . However , in the fighting , the adventurers with the support of Ector Brahms managed to kill her and her minions .

title: Ixzan
description: Ixzan The ixzan were a semi - amphibious race , closely related to the ixitxachitl . Habitats . Like ixitxachitl , they resembled manta rays , but unlike their cousins they lived only in Underdark .
description_long: Ixzan The ixzan were a semi - amphibious race , closely related to the ixitxachitl . Habitats . Like ixitxachitl , they resembled manta rays , but unlike their cousins they lived only in Underdark . It was a strange fact that , even though there existed saltwater lakes in the Underdark and freshwater lakes on surface , ixitxachitl were never to be found underground and ixzan were never to be found on the surface History . The true history of the ixzan was lost in the mists of times . About their origin , there were three main theories . The most common told that the ixzan were simply a subterranean offshoot of the ixitxachitl , similar to the kinship of drow and duergar to elves and dwarves . The second told the opposite , that there was an ancestral race in the Underdark long ago from which derived ixzan , ixitxachitl , cloaker s , lurker s , mantari , miners ( forest trapper s ) , and possibly even sinister s ( which many considered a kind of bat ) . After ixitxachitl and miners migrated out of Underdark , all the other races , including ixzan , remained in the same terrain .

title: Iyachtu Xvim
description: Iyachtu Xvim Iyachtu Xvim , also known as Godson , was the half - demonic son of Bane and for a time , the lawful evil lesser deity of Fear , Hatred , and Tyranny . Iyachtu Xvim was consumed in 1372 DR when his father used his body to re - emerge from death , taking Xvim ' s portfolios as his own . Description .
description_long: Iyachtu Xvim Iyachtu Xvim , also known as Godson , was the half - demonic son of Bane and for a time , the lawful evil lesser deity of Fear , Hatred , and Tyranny . Iyachtu Xvim was consumed in 1372 DR when his father used his body to re - emerge from death , taking Xvim ' s portfolios as his own . Description . A bone - thin man with scaly brown skin , unclothed and wielding a scimitar . Worshipers . The Legion of the Chimera . " The legion , led by Isair and Madae , held Iyachtu Xvim in high regard , and often gave his statue gifts in the hope that he would come in avatar form . Isair even forged The Sword of the Soulless , a replica of Iyactu ' s Sword of Souls . " Relationships . Iyachtu does not hold many relationships with other gods , but his relationship with The Legion of the Chimera made him form a relationship with the church of his father , Bane . At the time , Bane was alive , and Xvim held little godly power . History . In 710 DR Iyachtu Xvim emerged from a portal above the city of Westgate and backed by a large army of tiefling warrior s and demons , seizes the Westgate throne .

title: Iyawaei
description: Iyawaei Iyawaei of Konghani was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . He ruled his ship with an iron fist and his crew feared him .
description_long: Iyawaei Iyawaei of Konghani was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . He ruled his ship with an iron fist and his crew feared him . Iyawaei was good humored but with a quick temper . His biggest flaw was speaking with a strong accent and using many incomprehensible foreign words and phrases in conversation .

title: Iyelle Tlabbar
description: Iyelle Tlabbar Iyelle Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Iyelle like many others priestesses strongly believed that the Demon Weave was a bad idea , fearing that male would challenge their power .
description_long: Iyelle Tlabbar Iyelle Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Iyelle like many others priestesses strongly believed that the Demon Weave was a bad idea , fearing that male would challenge their power . History . Iyelle in 1479 DR was among the people gathered to inspect the lost outpost of Sezz ' ia alongside priestesses Guannerrae Tlabbar , Myaral Tlabbar and warrior Thezz Tlabbar among others . However Iyelle turned traitor and attacked her fellows during a battle with some monsters . Later Iyelle retreated inside the outpost with three hobgoblin s slaves where was confronted by adventurers hired by House Xorlarrin , House Melarn and Bregan D ' aerthe .

title: Iymrith
description: Iymrith Iymrith was a very powerful sorcerer blue dragon . Activities . Iymrith tirelessly explored all ancient Netherese ruins in the Ascore area in search of magic .
description_long: Iymrith Iymrith was a very powerful sorcerer blue dragon . Activities . Iymrith tirelessly explored all ancient Netherese ruins in the Ascore area in search of magic . In her lair , she was always protected by her gargoyle servants . She experimented often with new spell s , sometimes with catastrophic results , especially with the goal of transferring her sentience from draconic body to body in order to obtain a transcendent state of existence as a disembodied , mist - like flying spirit . History . Iymrith was first recorded in 570 DR when she destroyed a Bedine camp . Soon after , she challenged an old dragon in the High Moor but was defeated . Iymrith crashed into some Netherese ruins in the Forgotten Forest . There , she somehow gained some powerful magical abilities . The most convincing theory was that she had become the servant of an archmage who ' d magically altered her body . Together , Iymrith and a skeletal figure raided villages and caravans in the Delimbiyr Vale and the Sword Coast . Some time after , Iymrith was exploring some ruins in Anauroch when she first met the phaerimm and barely escaped with her life .

title: Iyraclea
description: Iyraclea Iyraclea , or simply the Ice Queen , was a female human cleric , divine disciple , and hierophant of Auril the Frostmaiden living within the Great Glacier . Ancient and mighty , she was the self - proclaimed Ice Queen of the glacier . She was the Chosen of Auril by 1373 DR .
description_long: Iyraclea Iyraclea , or simply the Ice Queen , was a female human cleric , divine disciple , and hierophant of Auril the Frostmaiden living within the Great Glacier . Ancient and mighty , she was the self - proclaimed Ice Queen of the glacier . She was the Chosen of Auril by 1373 DR . History . Formerly of Halruaa , Iyraclea settled in the Great Glacier some time before the 6th century DR , proclaiming herself to be the most powerful cleric of Auril even then and styling herself " the Ice Queen " . In time , she constructed an ice castle and assembled a monstrous army , including some ice devil s . Eventually , out of Myth Ondath , a city renowned for peace and harmony between races , came explorers who provoked the rage of the Ice Queen . She sent her armies against the pacifist city countless times , but the magical defenses of the " mythal " always turned aside her spells . Seeking a way to bypass these wards , she learned of a powerful artifact from another plane . Apparently with the assistance of Auril herself , Iyraclea stole the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " from the hands of the Gatekeeper in the Outlands .

title: Iyrauroth
description: Iyrauroth Iyrauroth , also called " the Wyrm of the Peaks " , was a male great wyrm black dragon that laired in the steppes of Thar and in Mount Grimmerfang in the Vast . History . In fear of his older sister , Embrurshaile , Iyrauroth spent centuries of his life hiding on other continents .
description_long: Iyrauroth Iyrauroth , also called " the Wyrm of the Peaks " , was a male great wyrm black dragon that laired in the steppes of Thar and in Mount Grimmerfang in the Vast . History . In fear of his older sister , Embrurshaile , Iyrauroth spent centuries of his life hiding on other continents . During this time , he sired sixteen sons and daughters . Embrurshaile ' s death caused a magical backlash in the Weave that notified her brother of her demise . He immediately set off with his children to conquer her territory in the Galena Mountains and Thar , joining the Dark Alliance in the process and helping to lay waste to Northkeep . He later went on to destroy Tharniir , shattering the power of the Ogres of Thar . In the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR , Iyrauroth killed with claw and fang the orc Ologh , the Overking of Vastar , plunging the orcish kingdom into civil war . Iyrauroth later fell into a deep slumber under the steppes of Thar that lasted for centuries . A Cult of the Dragon cell operating north of Glister in the Galena Mountains awoke Iyrauroth by 1369 DR . They attempted to persuade him to undergo the transformation into a dracolich , and gave him offerings .

title: Iyvdanya
description: Iyvdanya Madame Iyvdanya was a diviner in Skullport . Activities . Iyvdanya predicted destinies for the notoriously superstitious outlaws and pirates passing for the Port of Shadow .
description_long: Iyvdanya Madame Iyvdanya was a diviner in Skullport . Activities . Iyvdanya predicted destinies for the notoriously superstitious outlaws and pirates passing for the Port of Shadow . If she sensed bad fortune on them , a very frequent happening , she suggested a remedy based on folk traditions . Powers . Iyvdanya had some wild psionic powers .

title: Izac Uthor
description: Izac Uthor Izac Uthor was a goblin commander who rose to power during the turmoil that wracked goblinkind near the lands bordering western Anauroch before the Battle of Bones occurred . Personality . Izac was brutish and ambitious .
description_long: Izac Uthor Izac Uthor was a goblin commander who rose to power during the turmoil that wracked goblinkind near the lands bordering western Anauroch before the Battle of Bones occurred . Personality . Izac was brutish and ambitious . He recognized the potential benefit of uniting a horde of goblins against a common " enemy . " Activities . In the winter of 1089 DR , Izac gathered his army near the abandoned village of Thandril near the northwestern portion of the Goblin Marches . His horde included 200 , 000 goblins and tens of thousands of orcs and other goblin kin . This army called itself the Thugs of Uthor .

title: Izhkin
description: Izhkin Izhkin was a derro rogue also known as " Lord of the Dark " . Personality . He seemed incomprehensible and was content with great acts of violence to keep ruling his realm .
description_long: Izhkin Izhkin was a derro rogue also known as " Lord of the Dark " . Personality . He seemed incomprehensible and was content with great acts of violence to keep ruling his realm . Relationships . He had an assistant by the name of Golgamann who only spoke to him . History . Claiming to be Lord of the Dark and a ruler of a realm , he appeared as an assassin or thief who had no problem threatening others to speak too well of him . With a talent for traversing the Underdark , he could be a good if untrustworthy guide . He was skilled with his blades and used venom on them . He had contacts in the black markets of the Underdark , which made him able to gain many items that others would not touch . Appendix . Appearances . Izhkin will appear as a companion in the upcoming " Sword Coast Legends " video game .

title: J ' Nah
description: J ' Nah J ' Nah is a half - fiend elf who appears in the first chapter of " " as an antagonist . She had made a deal with the white dragon Tymofarrar to acquire the four relics in the keeping of Drogan Droganson . In her betrayal , she sent a group of gnoll s under her control to attack Tymofarrar ' s kobold s ( who were sent in ahead of time because Tymofarrar wished to see the artifacts for himself first ) who were returning from Hilltop with the artifacts .
description_long: J ' Nah J ' Nah is a half - fiend elf who appears in the first chapter of " " as an antagonist . She had made a deal with the white dragon Tymofarrar to acquire the four relics in the keeping of Drogan Droganson . In her betrayal , she sent a group of gnoll s under her control to attack Tymofarrar ' s kobold s ( who were sent in ahead of time because Tymofarrar wished to see the artifacts for himself first ) who were returning from Hilltop with the artifacts . Due to this betrayal , Tymofarrar wants her dead and will offer an item which will aid in killing her . J ' Nah is working in the service of Heurodis in trying to acquire the Tower Statue which contains within it a mythallar .

title: J . E . Sawyer
description: J . E . Sawyer Joshua " J .
description_long: J . E . Sawyer Joshua " J . E . " Sawyer is a video game designer for Obsidian Entertainment . Formerly , he worked for . Education . Sawyer received his B . A . degree in history from . Projects . Sawyer was the lead designer for the Icewind Dale II video game and also had a role in the design of Neverwinter Nights 2 .

title: J . Robert King
description: J . Robert King J . Robert King is a novelist and game designer who has contributed to a variety of sourcebooks from TSR , Inc .
description_long: J . Robert King J . Robert King is a novelist and game designer who has contributed to a variety of sourcebooks from TSR , Inc . Career . King has written over twenty novels , including three of the books in the Double Diamond Triangle Saga . He also contributed to " Monstrous Compendium Forgotten Realms Appendix II " and " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " in addition to other campaign settings from TSR .

title: Jaal
description: Jaal Jaal was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Stonespeaker Hgraam could possibly have sent Jaal to guide an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , to the mystic library of Gravenhollow .
description_long: Jaal Jaal was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Stonespeaker Hgraam could possibly have sent Jaal to guide an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , to the mystic library of Gravenhollow . Powers . Jaal had a mystical connection to the Underdark rocks .

title: Jabal Turab
description: Jabal Turab Jabal Turab , or the Mount of Dust , was a mountain that housed an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . Located 80 miles ( 128 .
description_long: Jabal Turab Jabal Turab , or the Mount of Dust , was a mountain that housed an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . Located 80 miles ( 128 . 8 km ) from the City of Brass , the Mount of Dust belched forth a great plume of white smoke that served as a gateway from the Elemental Plane of Fire to the Elemental Plane of Air . The elemental vortex terminated outside of the Djinni Caliphate . This elemental vortex was used by the efreet to launch invasions on the djinn . The efreet kept it under constant guard to prevent the djinn from attacking .

title: Jabal al Gaunrahl
description: Jabal al Gaunrahl Jabal al Gaunrahl was a jewel thief in Calimport and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jabal was the son of an elven slave and a struggling gem cutter in the Mjôm Sabban of the Jewel Ward of Calimport .
description_long: Jabal al Gaunrahl Jabal al Gaunrahl was a jewel thief in Calimport and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jabal was the son of an elven slave and a struggling gem cutter in the Mjôm Sabban of the Jewel Ward of Calimport . His mother died in childbirth , and Jabal lived with his father until he was killed during the Darkstalker Wars . Jabal lived as a pickpocket for many years until he found a job as a guard in the Four Bezels , the Guildhall of the Society of Diligent Gemcutters , but he earned the ire of a pasha , who falsely accused him of thievery and sold him into slavery . Jabal , however , was rescued by the Knights , who had been fellows of his father , and they gave to him his father ' s holdings and his position in the Knights . Afterward , he became a nearly unstoppable gem thief for the Knights . Jabal gained his namesake from the theft of a priceless double - star sapphire intended for the syl - pasha . The Shadow Thieves even offered him a place among their number after this exploit .

title: Jabbrawuk
description: Jabbrawuk A jabbrawuk was a type of dragon of fantastical appearance and a long neck . The name " jabbrawuk " was used by some sage s . Statues of jabbrawuks were among the statues of gargoyle s , gremlin s , satyr s , and wyvern s that adorned Oldstone Hall and its walls , in Wheloon in Cormyr .
description_long: Jabbrawuk A jabbrawuk was a type of dragon of fantastical appearance and a long neck . The name " jabbrawuk " was used by some sage s . Statues of jabbrawuks were among the statues of gargoyle s , gremlin s , satyr s , and wyvern s that adorned Oldstone Hall and its walls , in Wheloon in Cormyr .

title: Jacinth
description: Jacinth Unique to the Realms , jacinth , also known as hyacinth and flamegem , was a gemstone similar to sapphire . Description . This rare jewel had a fiery orange hue and was as hard and durable as sapphire and ruby .
description_long: Jacinth Unique to the Realms , jacinth , also known as hyacinth and flamegem , was a gemstone similar to sapphire . Description . This rare jewel had a fiery orange hue and was as hard and durable as sapphire and ruby . Each stone had a heart of fire that flickered like a candle — bright enough to be seen in the dark but not enough to illuminate even nearby objects . This property made it highly prized for adornment on cloaks and gowns worn by the well - to - do . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp Powers . Powdered jacinth was used in potions and in the immersions used for the creation of magic items that provided protection against fire . Whole jacinths were used in the ornamentation of such devices , " e . g . " , a " ring of fire resistance " .

title: Jack Ravenwild
description: Jack Ravenwild Jack Ravenwild was a rogue who was born in and resided in Ravens Bluff . He was most noted for recovering the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal from Sarbreen and for his one hundred year imprisonment in the mythal below Ravens Bluff . Description .
description_long: Jack Ravenwild Jack Ravenwild was a rogue who was born in and resided in Ravens Bluff . He was most noted for recovering the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal from Sarbreen and for his one hundred year imprisonment in the mythal below Ravens Bluff . Description . Jack was a small man , with a wiry build and a round , friendly face that was perpetually split by a jester ' s mocking smile . Dark eyes glittered gleefully over an impish nose , a wide mouth , and a thin trace of beard along his jawline . Abilities . Jack was a mediocre swordsman but was a wildfire sorcerer who was capable of casting illusion ary spells . Although he was a sorcerer , Jack was capable of learning at least some ritual s . Jack ' s wild magic was tied in some manner to the mythal and its destruction in 1479 DR resulted in Jack losing his magical abilities . Relationships . His acquaintances included Anders Aricssen , Tharzon Brewhammer , Ontrodes the Sage , Zandria , and Illyth Fleetwood . Jack and Seila Norwood were romantically attracted and Seila ' s father Marden Norwood seemed to have a grudging respect for Jack . Jack and Myrkyssa Jelan had a love - hate relationship . History .

title: Jack the Gnome
description: Jack the Gnome Jack the Gnome was a moderately powerful spellcaster who appeared in the novel " The Orc King " . History . Jack lived in the Underdark for centuries and was at one time a student of illithid s and demon s in his search for greater magical knowledge .
description_long: Jack the Gnome Jack the Gnome was a moderately powerful spellcaster who appeared in the novel " The Orc King " . History . Jack lived in the Underdark for centuries and was at one time a student of illithid s and demon s in his search for greater magical knowledge . The illithids in particular taught him to escape the bounds of the corporeal and of the mortal . Apparently , Jack was highly skilled at shape changing . He often took the form of a winged snake ( a Jaculi ) to carry on his mischief and manipulations of the shamans of the half - orc , half - ogre tribe Clan Karuck , who resided beneath the Spine of the World in the upper reaches of the Underdark . A century before the war started by Obould , Jack had made some undetailed slight against Lady Alustriel that installed a deep fear in the often arrogant gnome . During the war after spotting the Lady of Silverymoon he pleaded with his host to flee , claiming that she would recognize him and use all her might to destroy him . Jack the Gnome was slain by Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Jackal ( kit )
description: Jackal ( kit ) Jackals were wizard s in Zakhara who venerated their namesake , preferring to steal spells from others instead of going through the hard work of studying them and learning like other wizards . Requirements . Because their nature involved stealing spells from others , Jackals were never lawful individuals .
description_long: Jackal ( kit ) Jackals were wizard s in Zakhara who venerated their namesake , preferring to steal spells from others instead of going through the hard work of studying them and learning like other wizards . Requirements . Because their nature involved stealing spells from others , Jackals were never lawful individuals . Role . Jackals were magical thieves , satisfying their arcane needs by taking them from others . . They did everything within their power to hide their true nature , often carrying equipment and gear completely unrelated to their profession . A jackal who was discovered by other wizards was not treated kindly . Possessions . Jackals carried the same gear as wizards , and many carried a variety of unrelated gear to disguise their true nature . Benefits . Jackals stole spells , literally right out of another wizard ' s mind . They were able to select any spell they wanted while within a wizard ' s mind . The chance of successfully stealing a spell increased or decreased if the target ' s mental prowess was lower or higher than that of the jackal . Jackals could only steal one spell from any one target . Powerful spells took longer to steal than weaker ones .

title: Jackal ward
description: Jackal ward Jackal ward was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected a wizard from a jackal wizard attempting to steal their spells .
description_long: Jackal ward Jackal ward was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected a wizard from a jackal wizard attempting to steal their spells . The spell was cast upon a small coin that the caster carried with them . When a jackal wizard tried to steal a spell , the coin warmed quickly , warning the caster of the attempted theft . This spell always foiled the first attempt to steal a spell . Every attempt thereafter , for the spell ' s duration , failed half of the time . Components . This spell required a small coin to cast .

title: Jackals
description: Jackals The Jackals were a vicious organized force found in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The wicked salamander s of the Jackals were used to violently quell unrest or riots among the poor citizens of the city .
description_long: Jackals The Jackals were a vicious organized force found in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The wicked salamander s of the Jackals were used to violently quell unrest or riots among the poor citizens of the city . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Jackals , specifically the Long Castle within Ashlarks .

title: Jaculi
description: Jaculi Jaculis was a tree - dwelling creature that resembled a snake . Description . Jaculis looked like snakes with mauve to dark purple scales and an arrow - shaped head topped with sharp , forward - pointing horns .
description_long: Jaculi Jaculis was a tree - dwelling creature that resembled a snake . Description . Jaculis looked like snakes with mauve to dark purple scales and an arrow - shaped head topped with sharp , forward - pointing horns . Habitat . Jaculis could live in nearly any environment , but were most often found in warm forests . Abilities . Jaculis could change the color of their skin to match their surroundings . They were talented climbers and swimmers . Combat . Jaculis lured in their prey with " animal trance " , then attacked with its sharp horns and its ability to constrict . If a foe proved too troublesome , jaculis jumped from tree to tree to escape , then swung around and pursued the prey for a better opportunity .

title: Jada Marlserpent
description: Jada Marlserpent Jada Marlserpent , also known as Jada Harimdor , was one of the fabled dragonheir s , and the last surviving member of Clan Marlserpent as of 1479 DR . History . Jada was born in 1459 DR in the village of Wandering Stones , and as her mother died in childbirth , Jada became the last survivor of her bloodline .
description_long: Jada Marlserpent Jada Marlserpent , also known as Jada Harimdor , was one of the fabled dragonheir s , and the last surviving member of Clan Marlserpent as of 1479 DR . History . Jada was born in 1459 DR in the village of Wandering Stones , and as her mother died in childbirth , Jada became the last survivor of her bloodline . When she was less than a year old , Jada was adopted by a Swordlander merchant named Shander Harimdor , who was obsessed with the legend of the dragonheirs and wanted to ensure the survival of the last one of Clan Marlserpent . Jada was raised as Shander ' s own daughter , but she didn ' t like to live as a merchant . Craving for a love her surrogate family was unable to give her , Jada eventually joined the military forces of Harimmon and made a name for herself as an accomplished warrior . When Shander died , in 1479 DR , he left Jada the book " Dragonheir Clans " as her inheritance . The book contained the history and known genealogy of the dragonheirs , including Jada ' s true bloodline , as well as directions to locate the village of Wandering Stones .

title: Jadaren Hold
description: Jadaren Hold Jadaren Hold was a stronghold built into an extinct volcano near Erlkazar . Before it was claimed by Gareth Jadaren , it was known as Giant ' s Fist and was home to a clan of dwarves who carved an extensive series of tunnels and chambers under the mountain . Gareth claimed Giant ' s Fist in 1461 DR and had his friend Jandi M ' baren use the Rythanko to place powerful wards on the stronghold .
description_long: Jadaren Hold Jadaren Hold was a stronghold built into an extinct volcano near Erlkazar . Before it was claimed by Gareth Jadaren , it was known as Giant ' s Fist and was home to a clan of dwarves who carved an extensive series of tunnels and chambers under the mountain . Gareth claimed Giant ' s Fist in 1461 DR and had his friend Jandi M ' baren use the Rythanko to place powerful wards on the stronghold .

title: Jadd Ala ' i
description: Jadd Ala ' i Jadd Ala ' i was a human sha ' ir living in Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Activities . Jadd was the closest advisor to his wife and leader of Madinat al - Mumin , Jaddat Jamila .
description_long: Jadd Ala ' i Jadd Ala ' i was a human sha ' ir living in Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Activities . Jadd was the closest advisor to his wife and leader of Madinat al - Mumin , Jaddat Jamila . He generally preferred a cautious approach to solving problems . Relationships . Jadd was married to Jaddat Jamila .

title: Jaddat Jamila
description: Jaddat Jamila Jaddat Jamila was the human ruler of Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Appearance . Jaddat Jamila was an aged woman .
description_long: Jaddat Jamila Jaddat Jamila was the human ruler of Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Appearance . Jaddat Jamila was an aged woman . She was very lean and had gray hair . Jaddat never wore jewelry of any kind , believing it to be a sign of vanity . Activities . She spent most of her time discussing town matters with citizens since Madinat al - Mumin did not have a formal court . Possessions . Jaddat owned a mahogany cane that she used as a walking aid . Relationships . Jaddat was a direct descendant of Jamila the Virtuous . She was married to Jadd Ala ' i .

title: Jade
description: Jade Jade was the generally accepted name for a class of stones found in the Realms that included and . Description . When jade was freshly mined , it was found in shades of light to dark green , and white .
description_long: Jade Jade was the generally accepted name for a class of stones found in the Realms that included and . Description . When jade was freshly mined , it was found in shades of light to dark green , and white . As it aged , jade turned a warm brown hue . If buried for long periods of time , jade turned a dark red or brown and was known as tomb jade . Jade had a waxy appearance when polished and was easily carved . This stone was completely opaque unless carved thin enough for light to filter through , giving it a warm glow . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . Powdered jade had an affinity for illusion / phantasm spells and was the ingredient of choice when mixing magic inks to scribe such spell scrolls . It was also necessary in immersions for items intended to create illusions . The best time of day for mixing jade dust into a magical preparation was candleglass time . Reputation . Bard s and other musicians in the Realms wore jade for luck as it was said to improve musical talent .

title: Jade Gate Spring
description: Jade Gate Spring Jade Gate Spring was a small town located along the Dragonwall bordering the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . Description . The gate through the Dragonwall in this town led to the Horseshoe Temple Oasis and Merket Oasis .
description_long: Jade Gate Spring Jade Gate Spring was a small town located along the Dragonwall bordering the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . Description . The gate through the Dragonwall in this town led to the Horseshoe Temple Oasis and Merket Oasis . Jade Gate Spring was heavily fortified on all sides . History . Many caravans used this town as a starting point during the past , but recent years saw the town activity fade . During the threat from Yamun Khahan , the magistrate of Jade Gate Spring ordered that all of the barbarians living outside the walls were to be killed . He deemed it better to be safe than sorry . Many of these barbarians escaped and later served the Khahan as scouts and spies . The corrupt magistrate used seized funds to create his own mercenary army . Inhabitants . Most of the inhabitants of Jade Gate Spring were Shou , but some barbarians from the Hordelands were also allowed . A tiny colony of korobokuru lived in isolation within the town as well .

title: Jade spider
description: Jade spider Jade spiders were construct s of the drow . Description . The spiders got their name because of the sharp - tipped mandibles and saw - edged legs which were made of a particular sort of magically - treated jade .
description_long: Jade spider Jade spiders were construct s of the drow . Description . The spiders got their name because of the sharp - tipped mandibles and saw - edged legs which were made of a particular sort of magically - treated jade . Umber hulk s were nauseated and repelled by the presence of this substance which was corrosive to their scaly hides , and did not willingly approach jade spiders within 60 feet , or try to win past them . The hulks almost always retreated to hunt elsewhere . Abilities . Such constructs are fearless and unthinking . Therefore they will carry out their assigned orders even in the face of certain destruction . Ecology . Drow city gates , and the entrances to drow temples , vaults , and the dwellings of rich nobles and powerful wizards , were often guarded by gigantic spider statues , known as jade spiders . Construction . Many drow knew the secrets of jade spider construction , but drow communities took care to keep this and other magical secrets well - hidden . Only the most aged , infirm wizards were taught all the details ; they and their written records typically stayed inside their wizardly academies and inner House chambers until death or lichdom came .

title: Jadethread
description: Jadethread Jadethread was a human thief who specialized in procuring difficult treasure . Description . Jadethread was a tan - skinned man with shoulder - length brown hair and blue eyes .
description_long: Jadethread Jadethread was a human thief who specialized in procuring difficult treasure . Description . Jadethread was a tan - skinned man with shoulder - length brown hair and blue eyes . He was dressed in all black , and his identity was hidden by a black domino mask . Personality . Even though he was a successful thief , Jadethread ' s inclination to spend his riches on parties and women kept him from amassing a fortune . Possessions . Jadethread owned a " rope of climbing " . Activities . When preying on noblemen , Jadethread ' s signature was leaving a single strand of green thread in place of their valuables .

title: Jadger
description: Jadger Jadger was a deep gnome ghost burrow warden in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Secretly , some young deep gnomes gathered around the ghostly Jadger to learn the ways of the burrow warden .
description_long: Jadger Jadger was a deep gnome ghost burrow warden in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Secretly , some young deep gnomes gathered around the ghostly Jadger to learn the ways of the burrow warden . He was grooming his brightest student , Trisk Adamantelpiece , to command the new burrow wardens . History . In life , Jadger was an expert burrow warden , knowing much about Underdark denizens and how to fight them . With the arrival of the settlers reclaiming Blingdenstone , Jadger took the opportunity to reestablish the burrow wardens , training in secret a handful of enthusiastic young gnomes . During the Rage of Demons , a new generation of burrow wardens were ready and Jadger wanted them to be led by Trisk . He announced their existence to the Diggermattocks and demanded they be recognized as the new Burrow Wardens of Blingdenstone . Jadger also tried to clear the city of most of the wandering ghost s .

title: Jaemas Xorlarrin
description: Jaemas Xorlarrin Jaemas Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in 1373 DR . History . Jaemas was a competent Xorlarrin wizard .
description_long: Jaemas Xorlarrin Jaemas Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in 1373 DR . History . Jaemas was a competent Xorlarrin wizard . During the Siege of Menzoberranzan , he was called to help the blind archmage Gromph Baenre to perform an eye transplant from a prisoner who was a member of House Agrach Dyrr .

title: Jaerathindryl
description: Jaerathindryl Jaerathindryl , or " Malachite " , was a wyrm - aged female green dragon who laired in the forests south of Mulmaster in the lands of the Moonsea in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Malachite was waging a feud with the much younger black dragon Velvet , who lived in the Flooded Forest to the south .
description_long: Jaerathindryl Jaerathindryl , or " Malachite " , was a wyrm - aged female green dragon who laired in the forests south of Mulmaster in the lands of the Moonsea in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Malachite was waging a feud with the much younger black dragon Velvet , who lived in the Flooded Forest to the south . Velvet sought to move in on Malachite ' s territory . Malachite still lived by 1374 DR . Allies . Malachite was supported by a Cult of the Dragon cell based near Mulmaster . The cell was large but chaotic and divisive , struggling amongst themselves for power , wealth and Malachite ' s attention . They feuded with Velvet ' s own Cult cell .

title: Jaezred Chaulssin
description: Jaezred Chaulssin The Jaezred Chaulssin was a secret patriarchal organization based in Chaulssin primarily consisting of skilled shadow dragon - blooded drow assassin s bent on ending the drow race ’ s slavery to Lolth . Objectives . The Jaezred Chaulssin ’ s objective was to free the drow from Lolth ’ s and her priestesses ’ oppression .
description_long: Jaezred Chaulssin The Jaezred Chaulssin was a secret patriarchal organization based in Chaulssin primarily consisting of skilled shadow dragon - blooded drow assassin s bent on ending the drow race ’ s slavery to Lolth . Objectives . The Jaezred Chaulssin ’ s objective was to free the drow from Lolth ’ s and her priestesses ’ oppression . Their chosen way of doing so was to violently tearing down the system that allowed the Church of Lolth ' s theocracy to exist . They fully understood that doing this would cause a power vacuum that would make their people suffer weakness and enslavement for a time measured in centuries , but were wiling to risk it for their " salvation " . Their goal was not of altruistic nature . It involved the Jaezred Chaulssin becoming the guiding force in reconstructing a society and then the rulers . Activities . The Jaezred Chaulssin were an assassins ’ guild . They took jobs in the field of spying and assassination . The guild generally tried to be hidden and managed to remain out of sight and mind of Lolth ’ s clergy despite dealing numerous successful attacks against the church .

title: Jafar el Uabar
description: Jafar el Uabar Jafar el Uabar was the Nirdey of Volothamp for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Jafar grew up in Volothamp with his uncle Tulmon , a wealthy pearl diver .
description_long: Jafar el Uabar Jafar el Uabar was the Nirdey of Volothamp for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Jafar grew up in Volothamp with his uncle Tulmon , a wealthy pearl diver . Recently , his uncle estranged him after a disagreement about the family business , so Jafar joined with the Rundeen in order to maintain his lifestyle . He acted as mediator between merchants and smugglers and often worked with Syan al Derak of the Knights of the Shield . Jafar greatly disliked the " Gem Caleph " Adnan el Huzal , ruler of the Pearl Diver ' s Guild and would do anything to ruin him . He saw this as a method to reconcile with his uncle and started considering even the use of assassin s in order to accomplished the goal .

title: Jagged Dagger
description: Jagged Dagger The Jagged Dagger was a tavern built in 1372 DR . It was a frequent place of interest of the Red Dragon Trading Post . Inhabitants .
description_long: Jagged Dagger The Jagged Dagger was a tavern built in 1372 DR . It was a frequent place of interest of the Red Dragon Trading Post . Inhabitants . Many of the patrons were adventurer s looking to join the company . One noticeable patron was Gertrude Messer , who later took the tavern ' s name and used it in her own company located in Neverwinter , called the Jagged Daggers .

title: Jagre
description: Jagre Jagres are extremely powerful humanoids who were created by Zaltec during the Night of Wailing . High ranking Jaguar Knights were transformed into ogre s and a few were later turned into jagres . Jagres are leaders of the orc s and ogres who now live in the Valley of Nexal .
description_long: Jagre Jagres are extremely powerful humanoids who were created by Zaltec during the Night of Wailing . High ranking Jaguar Knights were transformed into ogre s and a few were later turned into jagres . Jagres are leaders of the orc s and ogres who now live in the Valley of Nexal . They are usually found in the company of orc or ogre servants . Jagres wear magic al armor made from the skin of displacer beast s which allows them to transform into the beasts . Some jagres go through a special ritual which bonds the displacer beast skin to their bodies so that it can ' t be removed . Physical attributes . Jagres are huge , brutish humanoids . All jagres have the mark of the Viperhand branded on their chests . Combat . Jagres may wield huge maca s or engage in unarmed combat . In displacer beast form the jagre is able to attack with it ' s two tentacles or its claws and bite .

title: Jaguar Guard
description: Jaguar Guard The Jaguar Guard was a mercenary company based in Tethyr . History . The Jaguar Guard were composed of Jaguar Knights from Kultaka in Maztica .
description_long: Jaguar Guard The Jaguar Guard was a mercenary company based in Tethyr . History . The Jaguar Guard were composed of Jaguar Knights from Kultaka in Maztica . After the Golden Legion conquest , the leaders of Kultaka sent a group to Faerûn to learn more about this new continent . Encouraged by Gar Hollan , a Myratma n merchant , they went to Tethyr to fight as mercenaries for the Council of Myratma . After nearly the entire Council was assassinated by the Four in the rise to power of Yusuf Jhannivvar , more than half of the Guard were also slain . Their leader , Miquiztl Manik , had his warriors join the Loyalist Army of Zaranda Star . After the end of the Reclamation Wars , the Jaguar Guard moved to garrisons around the ancient ruins of Shoonach and help defend Tethyr against that evil place . Organization . Membership . All members were from the Kultakan elite order of Jaguar Knights . Tactics . They usually used guerrilla tactics and , as a wild card , used their ability to change into jaguar s . If they fought in a regular battle , they always offered opponents the option to be taken as prisoners . Contracts .

title: Jaguar lord
description: Jaguar lord Jaguar lords were huge , evil , intelligent jaguar s living in the jungles of Maztica . Jaguar lords hated couatl s and would attack one on sight . Combat .
description_long: Jaguar lord Jaguar lords were huge , evil , intelligent jaguar s living in the jungles of Maztica . Jaguar lords hated couatl s and would attack one on sight . Combat . These creatures preferred to use trickery and often ambushed their prey . Many Jaguar Lords were able to use Hishna magic and some were priests of Zaltec . Ecology . All Jaguar Lords were male and had to find a female tabaxi to mate with . Some Jaguar Lords took leadership of tabaxi clans . Jaguar Lords were even known to assume leadership of wild halfling clans .

title: Jahed
description: Jahed Jahed is a weretiger who now serves his god in the Demiplane of Dread . Biography . Jahed began life as part of a group of gypsies in the Dalelands .
description_long: Jahed Jahed is a weretiger who now serves his god in the Demiplane of Dread . Biography . Jahed began life as part of a group of gypsies in the Dalelands . His parents were entertainers who stole from the people they met . His father was a cruel man who enjoyed the suffering of others and often compounded it . His mother was timid & sickly , due to her husband ' s near - constant abuse , starting long before Jahed was born . When he was a teenager , Jahed started a romance with a local girl named Milissa . His father , Mercurio , noticed his frequent disappearances from camp and followed him to where the couple were meeting . Mercurio attacked his son , knocking him to the ground and proceeded to insult Milissa . When he tried to attack her too , she avoided the blow and transformed into a tiger . Source . Ravenloft Monstrous Compendium : Appendix II

title: Jaheira
description: Jaheira Jaheira was a half - elf , druid , warrior , a member of the Harpers , and a friend of Gorion . She and her husband Khalid , who was later killed , were sent to investigate the iron crisis , and she traveled with Gorion ' s ward during that time and for some time after . The games .
description_long: Jaheira Jaheira was a half - elf , druid , warrior , a member of the Harpers , and a friend of Gorion . She and her husband Khalid , who was later killed , were sent to investigate the iron crisis , and she traveled with Gorion ' s ward during that time and for some time after . The games . Jaheira was born to a noble family in Tethyr during the civil war , and soon orphaned as her parents were killed in it . She was taken in by a community of druids and became one herself , worshiping Silvanus . She grew up to be very headstrong and to believe that the only way to affect things in the world was to take an active role . She joined the Harpers and at some point met and fell in love with Khalid , another half - elf ( and , at least later , Harper ) with a very different temperament to her own . The two married and , in spite of their differences , always cared deeply for each other . Through the Harpers , they were also friends of Gorion and acquainted with such people as Elminster . In 1368 DR , Jaheira and Khalid were sent on behalf of the Harpers to investigate the iron crisis and the Nashkel mines .

title: Jaheira ( genie )
description: Jaheira ( genie ) Jaheira was a tasked artist genie serving the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jaheira dressed herself in the latest fashions of Huzuz , usually before they become popular with others .
description_long: Jaheira ( genie ) Jaheira was a tasked artist genie serving the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jaheira dressed herself in the latest fashions of Huzuz , usually before they become popular with others . Personality . Like most artist genies , Jaheira was very sensitive about her work . Any criticism was enough to keep her from working for at least a week . Activities . Jaherira performed all of the finest weaving done by the House of Al - Kamari . Since the Al - Kamari were aware that happy artist genies produced greater works of art , anything she required for her creations was acquired without question .

title: Jahlah
description: Jahlah The jahlah ( jah - LAH ) was a small simplistic Zakharan drum . Description . A " jahlah " was a basic clay pot that was played by beating it with both hands .
description_long: Jahlah The jahlah ( jah - LAH ) was a small simplistic Zakharan drum . Description . A " jahlah " was a basic clay pot that was played by beating it with both hands . It could also be filled with small stones and used as a rattle . History . The " jahlah " was found in the southeastern regions of the Land of Fate and was used primarily by fishermen and pearl divers .

title: Jaipur chaka
description: Jaipur chaka The Jaipur chaka was a successful chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Jaipurs owned thousands of acres of farmland in Var the Golden .
description_long: Jaipur chaka The Jaipur chaka was a successful chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Jaipurs owned thousands of acres of farmland in Var the Golden . However , the majority of their financial success came from their sea trade . They were second to none within the Shining Lands in delivering goods across the Shining South and beyond , including two successful ventures to distant Maztica . As of 1367 DR , they hoped to supplant the Baroda chaka with one of their members for the fifth seat on the Council of Merchants . Base of Operations . The Jaipur chaka was based out of Myrmyr in eastern Var the Golden .

title: Jak Errins
description: Jak Errins Jak Errins was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Trusted Sword . He was the seneschal of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard Jak was getting on in years and two underpriests , Battlelady Peris Whallnsor and Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap , were contending for his position .
description_long: Jak Errins Jak Errins was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Trusted Sword . He was the seneschal of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard Jak was getting on in years and two underpriests , Battlelady Peris Whallnsor and Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap , were contending for his position .

title: Jak Fleet
description: Jak Fleet Jak Fleet was a halfling cleric / thief who was an adventuring companion and the best friend of Erevis Cale . Relationships . Jak was thought by Cale to be his conscience personified as he was always a shoulder to lean on , and a true friend who always managed to pull Cale from the brink of darkness when he needed it .
description_long: Jak Fleet Jak Fleet was a halfling cleric / thief who was an adventuring companion and the best friend of Erevis Cale . Relationships . Jak was thought by Cale to be his conscience personified as he was always a shoulder to lean on , and a true friend who always managed to pull Cale from the brink of darkness when he needed it . History . He was born in Hillsfar but soon his family escaped and relocated to Mistledale . In his early career , Jak served in the semi - secret organization known as the Harpers . He joined the Harpers because he really wanted to help people , but when Cale was in trouble and Jak asked for their help , he was refused . He left the Harpers soon after out of his undying loyalty to Cale . Jak Fleet died at the hands of a death slaad named Dolgan when fighting alongside Cale and Drasek Riven . They were thrust into a plot put together by the god Mask to steal a temple of Cyric , which resulted in a confrontation that ended his life . As a result , Cale never forgave Mask for the loss of his friend . Deity . Jak Fleet was a devout cleric of the trickster god Brandobaris . Appearance .

title: Jak Timberline
description: Jak Timberline Jak Timberline was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description & Personality .
description_long: Jak Timberline Jak Timberline was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description & Personality . Jak was an old man , with gray , thinning hair and a wrinkled , tanned face . He said he did not care about a person ' s race , and took the effort to pronounce Drizzt ' s name correctly . History . In the winter of the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Jak was at the bar of the local inn when Drizzt Do ' Urden arrived . Jak wasn ' t afraid of the drow elf like Aganis the barkeep , and said he had heard stories of Drizzt ' s good deeds at Mithril Hall . He also informed Drizzt that Nojheim , whom the drow had recaptured , was a slave of Rico Pengallen .

title: Jaka Sculi
description: Jaka Sculi Jaka Sculi was a rash young man in the town of Auckney , nestled in the Spine of the World . Description . Jaka was rather self - centered and felt he was better than everyone else .
description_long: Jaka Sculi Jaka Sculi was a rash young man in the town of Auckney , nestled in the Spine of the World . Description . Jaka was rather self - centered and felt he was better than everyone else . He " fell in love " with Meralda Ganderlay only after learning of Lord Feringal Auck ' s interest in her . He spent a lot of time away from the town cursing his lot and life , particularly when it came to his " love . " History . Jaka originally came from Luskan but moved to Auckney with his mother in 1365 DR . He and his mother were distant descendants of the mercenary princes of the Blade Kingdoms . Around 1369 DR , he fathered one child but died before it was born by committing public suicide by jumping off the sea cliffs while proclaiming his ( insincere ) love for Meralda . Later , Meralda wedded the Lord of Auckney , Feringal Auck , in order to save her mother ' s life . The child was named Colson after being adopted by Wulfgar and Delly Curtie .

title: Jalandyl o ' Stars
description: Jalandyl o ' Stars Jalandyl o ' Stars was an agent of the Harpers who posed as a dancer at the Drunken Lion alehouse in Archenbridge . Description . While scarred somewhat by her travels and adventures , she was easily the most attractive of the Lion ' s ladies .
description_long: Jalandyl o ' Stars Jalandyl o ' Stars was an agent of the Harpers who posed as a dancer at the Drunken Lion alehouse in Archenbridge . Description . While scarred somewhat by her travels and adventures , she was easily the most attractive of the Lion ' s ladies . Abilities . Jalandyl also possessed an incredible knowledge of the mountain areas surrounding Archendale , often selling maps of the region to explorers . Relationships . Often coming to the aid of those who were harmed within the city , Jalandyl ' s permanence and anonymity were ensured by the twenty - thousand - gold - piece debt the owner of the Drunken Lion , Meerkun Habalar , owed her . While they neither trusted nor enjoyed each other ' s presence , their partnership lasted over twenty years . Jalandyl and Jalia Mossgreen of the Old Stonebows Inn knew each other well , including keeping secret each other ' s hidden lives , while both spied for and helped one another .

title: Jalanthar
description: Jalanthar Jalanthar was a hamlet located on the trail between Everlund and Sundabar and was once a stop on the Rauvin River situated between the Moon Pass and Everlund . Description . The buildings were half - buried in the ground and looked like as green hills .
description_long: Jalanthar Jalanthar was a hamlet located on the trail between Everlund and Sundabar and was once a stop on the Rauvin River situated between the Moon Pass and Everlund . Description . The buildings were half - buried in the ground and looked like as green hills . Many of the new buildings were built directly into the hillside and were covered with turf to resist burning . Additionally , they had strong doorways to resist battering . Most of the inhabitants of Jalanthar knew the surrounding area and many of them also had experience of clashes with orc s and other raiders . A council of elders administered the village and the entire community was very kind to his fellow citizens . Most of the inhabitants were trappers and hunters . In addition to the fur trade , they hired themselves out as guides . History . By 1372 DR , the hamlet had recently relocated from the south bank of the river to the foothills north of the river after repeated orc raids . The hamlet was overrun on multiple occasions , but the inhabitants retreated to safety into the mountains . In 1372 DR , the defenses were boosted by a troop of the Argent Legion camping in the old ruins .

title: Jalanvaloss
description: Jalanvaloss Jalanvaloss was a steel dragon in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Jalanvaloss was a vigilant observer of even the smallest details and this helped her in the many intrigues and deception she was a part of .
description_long: Jalanvaloss Jalanvaloss was a steel dragon in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Jalanvaloss was a vigilant observer of even the smallest details and this helped her in the many intrigues and deception she was a part of . Jalanvaloss was a consummate actress ; she liked to scheme and manipulate others . Thanks to her age , Jalanvaloss could recall most of the genealogies of Waterdeep ' s families , as well as the histories , relationships , and alliances of all families , cabals , and other groups .

title: Jalap
description: Jalap Jalap was a plant found in the deserts of Maztica . Uses . Wild jalap was used by the Azuposi people of Maztica in order to protect against rattlesnake bites .
description_long: Jalap Jalap was a plant found in the deserts of Maztica . Uses . Wild jalap was used by the Azuposi people of Maztica in order to protect against rattlesnake bites . Appendix . Background . In the real world , jalap is a drug that can be extracted from the roots of the " ipomoea purga " plant , also called " jalap " .

title: Jalarkh Ohngate
description: Jalarkh Ohngate Jalarkh Ohngate was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .
description_long: Jalarkh Ohngate Jalarkh Ohngate was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR . Personality . Jalarkh was born a mute and did not often take the initiative , but rather followed orders well . Abilities . Jalarkh was incredibly strong and he spent much of his time practicing and training in various weapons . He was a specialist with the scimitar . Possessions . He wore chain mail but he could don plate mail stored in a few caches around town if needed . He carried a " scimitar + 1 " , club , and dagger . History . At some point in his life , he was trained by the Zhentilar and was chosen to be a deputy in Voonlar .

title: Jalassra Dawningdown
description: Jalassra Dawningdown Jalassra Dawningdown was a noble in Suzail . History . Around 1480 DR , she hired Drounan Harbrand and his partner Andarphisk Hawkspike to go to Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr to free her son Jeresson Dawningdown , a traitor and murderer .
description_long: Jalassra Dawningdown Jalassra Dawningdown was a noble in Suzail . History . Around 1480 DR , she hired Drounan Harbrand and his partner Andarphisk Hawkspike to go to Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr to free her son Jeresson Dawningdown , a traitor and murderer . Later , she was confronted by Lady Rensharra Ironstave about the income tax she needed to pay to the King . Believing herself offended by Rensharra ' s attitude , Lady Dawningdown later sent two men to beat her .

title: Jalaunther Ithbreeiur
description: Jalaunther Ithbreeiur Jalaunther Ithbreeiur was the unofficial but true leader of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 . Personality . Jalaunther was a very ambitious man with a network of agents in all major cities in the " Realms " .
description_long: Jalaunther Ithbreeiur Jalaunther Ithbreeiur was the unofficial but true leader of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 . Personality . Jalaunther was a very ambitious man with a network of agents in all major cities in the " Realms " . His major plot was to gain total control of Telflamm then take over Thesk , Aglarond , Great Dale and possibly Impiltur . Relationships . While not the leader of the House of the Master ' s Shadow , the local temple of Mask in Uthmere , or of the Shadowmasters , Jalaunther was the driving force behind the guild . During Jalaunther ' s magic research , he discovered the unique " shadow walk " method used by the Shadowmasters . History . Under Ithbreeiur ' s orders , Shadowmasters defeated the pirates of the Sea of Fallen Stars that menaced Telflamm .

title: Jalavaerra Ishtra
description: Jalavaerra Ishtra Jalavaerra Ishtra was a retired fighter and adventuress from Westgate who owned and managed the adventurers ' club The Fine Gold Chain in Memnon . Description . Jalavaerra was tall and willowy and " famously beautiful " , with long blonde hair and large , dark , purple eyes .
description_long: Jalavaerra Ishtra Jalavaerra Ishtra was a retired fighter and adventuress from Westgate who owned and managed the adventurers ' club The Fine Gold Chain in Memnon . Description . Jalavaerra was tall and willowy and " famously beautiful " , with long blonde hair and large , dark , purple eyes . Personality . She was a crafty investor and was also adept at arranging business deals . Rumors and Legends . Her club was named after her own nickname , which she received from an incident where she stole a mile - long chain from a dragon ' s horde by wrapping it around her body .

title: Jalboun of the Two Blades
description: Jalboun of the Two Blades Jalboun of the Two Blades is a mercenary and a fence who operates out of the Cutlass in Luskan . Very skilled with both axe - throwing and in the use of dagger s , Jalboun will often belt out drinking songs and will always join in a fight that erupts within his favorite watering hole . Possessions .
description_long: Jalboun of the Two Blades Jalboun of the Two Blades is a mercenary and a fence who operates out of the Cutlass in Luskan . Very skilled with both axe - throwing and in the use of dagger s , Jalboun will often belt out drinking songs and will always join in a fight that erupts within his favorite watering hole . Possessions . Jalboun gets his title from the dual scimitar s he customarily wields , both of which are swords of dancing .

title: Jaleigh Johnson
description: Jaleigh Johnson Jaleigh Johnson lives at the edge of a corn field in the Midwest , in a yellow house with a lot of windows . On the long road to publication , she ' s written ad copy ; gaming material ; Gen Con diaries ; horror fiction ; science fiction ; fiction for children ; fiction for adults ; fiction for small , furry animals and gnomes ; etc . She tries very hard to be serious at all times ; unfortunately the world is too absurd and thwarts almost every attempt she makes to take it seriously .
description_long: Jaleigh Johnson Jaleigh Johnson lives at the edge of a corn field in the Midwest , in a yellow house with a lot of windows . On the long road to publication , she ' s written ad copy ; gaming material ; Gen Con diaries ; horror fiction ; science fiction ; fiction for children ; fiction for adults ; fiction for small , furry animals and gnomes ; etc . She tries very hard to be serious at all times ; unfortunately the world is too absurd and thwarts almost every attempt she makes to take it seriously . Mostly , she blames reality TV , but also , laughter is more fun . When not writing , Jaleigh enjoys gardening , biking , gaming , and movies . By “ movies , " she means theaters . Surround sound , sticky cupholders , butter - slathered popcorn clutched in a fist , theater - going experiences . She can ' t get enough of them . Just don ' t talk during the movie . She ' ll crawl over the back of her seat and maim you . Once upon a time , she met Ed Greenwood at the Gen Con gaming convention in Milwaukee . Thirteen years later , she ' s still stalking him , but he lets her play around in the Forgotten Realms anyway . She is very happy about this .

title: Jalessa Ornra
description: Jalessa Ornra Jalessa Ornra was the butcher of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Jalessa managed a shop in the village , where she lived together with her husband , the town ' s constable Harburk Tuthmarillar .
description_long: Jalessa Ornra Jalessa Ornra was the butcher of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Jalessa managed a shop in the village , where she lived together with her husband , the town ' s constable Harburk Tuthmarillar . History . In 1491 DR , after the Believers and their crimes were uncovered , Jalessa was most likely chosen as the new mayor of the city .

title: Jalessa Windstone
description: Jalessa Windstone Jalessa Windstone was a high - ranking member of the court of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Jalessa took care of the protocol of the Royal Palace .
description_long: Jalessa Windstone Jalessa Windstone was a high - ranking member of the court of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Jalessa took care of the protocol of the Royal Palace . Around 1479 DR , she was one of the designated member of the Council of the Dragon .

title: Jalia Mossgreen
description: Jalia Mossgreen Jalia Mossgreen was the most prominent of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Jalia as Black Sword supervised the Archendale militia .
description_long: Jalia Mossgreen Jalia Mossgreen was the most prominent of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Jalia as Black Sword supervised the Archendale militia . In public role she owned and managed the Old Stonebows inn . History . In 1368 Jalia was the oldest of the Swords and was semi - retired from the role .

title: Jalless
description: Jalless Jalless was a deep gnome healer in Blingdenstone . History . Jalless in 1479 DR was one of the healers and the most outspoken critic of Kargien Dissengulp .
description_long: Jalless Jalless was a deep gnome healer in Blingdenstone . History . Jalless in 1479 DR was one of the healers and the most outspoken critic of Kargien Dissengulp . Personality . Jalless disliked Kargien because she believed he wanted the crown despite not being of royal descent . Relationship . Jalless always worked with fellow healer Krell .

title: Jalma
description: Jalma Jalma was a female elf in the 1350s DR who lived near Waterdeep . Jalma lived in a small house with two other elven women . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they provided lodging for the night to Cybriana of Shadowdale , who was journeying to Waterdeep .
description_long: Jalma Jalma was a female elf in the 1350s DR who lived near Waterdeep . Jalma lived in a small house with two other elven women . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they provided lodging for the night to Cybriana of Shadowdale , who was journeying to Waterdeep . That night , chasme broke into their house and attacked , carrying away all four women , under orders from Imgig Zu to seize magic - users . Although Cybriana was rescued , Jalma and her sisters were taken to Imgig Zu ' s tower to be tested for magical ability in a spell - battle with the drow woman Kilili . Jalma had red - brown hair and wore a purple dress .

title: Jalynfein
description: Jalynfein Jalynfein was a male drow wizard from Menzoberranzan , and was perhaps the most powerful spellcaster in the city . He carefully cultivated a reputation of insanity and zealous devotion to Lolth , but truly hated the tyranny of the Spider Queen and opposed all forms of slavery . However , he was far too intelligent and skilled in the magical arts to ever betray these inner thoughts .
description_long: Jalynfein Jalynfein was a male drow wizard from Menzoberranzan , and was perhaps the most powerful spellcaster in the city . He carefully cultivated a reputation of insanity and zealous devotion to Lolth , but truly hated the tyranny of the Spider Queen and opposed all forms of slavery . However , he was far too intelligent and skilled in the magical arts to ever betray these inner thoughts . From his position of seclusion , he was able to use scrying spells to spy on events in the city , and would sometimes sell information if offered enough magical items , gems , or gold . Sorcere . Jalynfein maintained a private tower in Sorcere , the arcane school of Tier Breche . His tower was heavily protected by spells of great power , and stocked with all of the wealth of the Spider Mage . This included many magical items , caches of gems and gold ( usually around 16 , 000 gp worth ) , and numerous healing potions . While in this secluded sanctuary , Jalynfein was virtually untouchable by any would - be attackers . Appearance . Jalynfein had a disfigured face , which he covered with a featureless grey cloth mask .

title: Jamad
description: Jamad Father Jamad was the head priest of St . Faelar ' s Cloisters in 1370 DR . Under Jamad ' s leadeship , the monks and ranger s of the Cloisters traded many escaped slaves in survival skills in the foothills of the Marching Mountains .
description_long: Jamad Father Jamad was the head priest of St . Faelar ' s Cloisters in 1370 DR . Under Jamad ' s leadeship , the monks and ranger s of the Cloisters traded many escaped slaves in survival skills in the foothills of the Marching Mountains . History . In Kythorn of 1370 , the Cloister suffered an attack of arson , and Father Jamad was one of the survivors and witnesses . He claimed that he saw a " heavily cloaked wizard " cast and control a " flaming sphere " while laughing . Some suggested this wizard was Tara el Viilam , but Jamad was unable to identify her conclusively .

title: Jamal
description: Jamal Jamal the Thespian was a bard in Westgate in . History . Around 1370 DR , Jamal was secretly a member of the Harpers , watching over the city .
description_long: Jamal Jamal the Thespian was a bard in Westgate in . History . Around 1370 DR , Jamal was secretly a member of the Harpers , watching over the city . Jamal was once an adventurer and joined the Harpers because of Finder Wyvernspur before he become a god , but retired from adventuring when she grew too old . Later , she directed a group of streets actors who performed around and for poor people . Jamal was a strong ally of Lady Thistle Thavalar in her battle for more democracy .

title: Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid
description: Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamal ran a thieves guild in the Rookery ward of the city .
description_long: Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamal ran a thieves guild in the Rookery ward of the city . Jamal never broke the law , but was adept at convincing others to commit crimes that served his interests and those of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . In order to gain favor with the city guard , Jamal would often turn thieves or escaped slaves over to their hands . His outward actions against thievery made him very popular with both the wealthy and poor of the city . He was well connected with agents of the Octagon , using those contacts to acquire additional thieves for his operation , arranging for their escape from the prison on occasion .

title: Jamal Oasis
description: Jamal Oasis The Jamal Oasis was one of the most hospitable and well known oases in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The presence of a mud - brick large enough for a small army made this oasis extremely convenient .
description_long: Jamal Oasis The Jamal Oasis was one of the most hospitable and well known oases in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The presence of a mud - brick large enough for a small army made this oasis extremely convenient . Enlightened travelers could worship the Zakharan gods at the Jamal temple . Though blasted by the sands of time , one carved phrase could still be read : " " How can any man born of earth claim to divine true purposes of the gods ? " " Djinn would sometimes appear on the darkest summer nights to debate the meaning of this phrase . Any human who brought fresh apples for the djinn was allowed to join the debate . There was a chance that those with perceptive insights into the debate would be granted a wish , while those with blunt observations were slapped . Ecology . The Jamal Oasis had waters so clear that travelers could count the pebbles on the bottom of the pool . " Baitan - jan " , a leafy eggplant , also grew here in abundance , providing an ample food source . Pack animals also feasted on the primrose - covered hills to the north of the oasis .

title: Jamala Abd al - Raffa
description: Jamala Abd al - Raffa Jamala Abd al - Raffa was a mamluk inhabiting the League of the Pantheon in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamala was the leader of the Exalted Mamluk Society and named Most Respected Warrior .
description_long: Jamala Abd al - Raffa Jamala Abd al - Raffa was a mamluk inhabiting the League of the Pantheon in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamala was the leader of the Exalted Mamluk Society and named Most Respected Warrior . She was a moralist who shared the views of the Pantheon that all of Zakhara should be more civilized and law - abiding .

title: Jamala al - Mutajalli
description: Jamala al - Mutajalli Jamala al - Mutajalli was a janni of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Jamala ' s blood ran hot , urging her to seek adventure whenever possible .
description_long: Jamala al - Mutajalli Jamala al - Mutajalli was a janni of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Jamala ' s blood ran hot , urging her to seek adventure whenever possible . Skills . Her ability to " shapechange " allowed Jamala to travel with non - janni in disguise . She was also an accomplished vizier . Relationships . Jamala was the eldest daughter of Amir Bouladin al - Mutajalli .

title: Jambiya
description: Jambiya Jambiyas were sharply curved daggers common to Calimshan and Zakhara . Etymology . The word for " dagger " in Alzhedo was " jambiya " , yet when most people used the term " jambiya " , they were referring specifically to the style of curved dagger found among Calishite s and Zakharan s .
description_long: Jambiya Jambiyas were sharply curved daggers common to Calimshan and Zakhara . Etymology . The word for " dagger " in Alzhedo was " jambiya " , yet when most people used the term " jambiya " , they were referring specifically to the style of curved dagger found among Calishite s and Zakharan s . Description . A " jambiya " was a sharply curved dagger , almost like a hook . They tended to leave long , narrow wounds in an opponent . Popularity . Nearly every Calishite male bore a " jambiya " at his side .

title: James Lowder
description: James Lowder James Lowder is an award - winning editor and author of the fantasy and horror genres . Education . Lowder grew up in .
description_long: James Lowder James Lowder is an award - winning editor and author of the fantasy and horror genres . Education . Lowder grew up in . He received his BA with honors in English and History from in 1985 and a Masters in Literary Studies from the University of in 1999 . Work . Lowder has worked as an editor for TSR , , and CDS Books . As an author , he has written several novels , including the award - winning " Prince of Lies " ( for the Forgotten Realms ) and " Knight of the Black Rose " , along with several short - fiction anthologies and scripts for . He has also written hundreds of review articles for books , games , and movies .

title: James Ward
description: James Ward James Ward is a fantasy author and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . He was one of Gary Gygax ' s original players . He introduced deities into Dungeons & Dragons and created the first ever science fiction role - playing game , .
