He introduced deities into Dungeons & Dragons and created the first ever science fiction role - playing game , . Works . In addition to many sourcebooks for TSR , Ward also authored several novels , including The Pools trilogy .

title: Jamid abd - Balduro
description: Jamid abd - Balduro Jamid abd - Balduro was an elven warrior who traveled across the deserts of Zakhara with her father ' s caravan around 1367 DR . Description . Jamid was a muscular woman with very long , black hair .
description_long: Jamid abd - Balduro Jamid abd - Balduro was an elven warrior who traveled across the deserts of Zakhara with her father ' s caravan around 1367 DR . Description . Jamid was a muscular woman with very long , black hair . She had tall cheekbones , dark lips , and an earring in her right ear . She wore a golden helmet and red dragonscale armor . Possessions . In addition to her dragonscale armor , Jamid owned a " scimitar of wyrm - slaying " . History . Jamid fell in love with a human caravan worker . When her father , Balduro , discovered the romance , he killed the man out of anger . Fearful for her life , Jamid killed her own bodyguard and fled the caravan .

title: Jamila al - Thuri
description: Jamila al - Thuri Jamila al - Thuri was the dwarven matriarch of the House of Al - Thuria in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though elderly , Jamila ruled her family with iron resolve .
description_long: Jamila al - Thuri Jamila al - Thuri was the dwarven matriarch of the House of Al - Thuria in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though elderly , Jamila ruled her family with iron resolve . She spent most of her time within the family estates in the Clothiers ' District .

title: Jamila al - Zahab
description: Jamila al - Zahab Jamila al - Zahab was a mercenary who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Strong and exotic , Jamila ' s demeanor transcended the norm of Zakhara n society .
description_long: Jamila al - Zahab Jamila al - Zahab was a mercenary who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Strong and exotic , Jamila ' s demeanor transcended the norm of Zakhara n society . Activities . Jamila was a werelion who protected the leader of the Loyalists , Yusuf bin Ayyub . Relationships . It was rumored that Jamila and Yusuf were lovers .

title: Jamina al - Mubarak
description: Jamina al - Mubarak Jamina al - Mubarak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamila served as the ambassador Extraordinary of the Brotherhood of the True Flame within the efreeti city .
description_long: Jamina al - Mubarak Jamina al - Mubarak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamila served as the ambassador Extraordinary of the Brotherhood of the True Flame within the efreeti city . As such , she handled the business of the Brotherhood within the City of Brass when the Bonfire was not present , which was most of the time . Her main focus was recruiting new talent from the efreeti into the Brotherhood . Relationships . The efreet tolerated Jamila ' s presence but largely resented her , viewing her as nothing more than a foreigner despite her great power over flame magic . Rumors & Legends . Jamila was believed to be involved in a romantic relationship with her assistant Sefer al - Raq .

title: Jamison
description: Jamison Jamison was the fletcher of the Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Jamison was very popular with the ladies and always friendly .
description_long: Jamison Jamison was the fletcher of the Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Jamison was very popular with the ladies and always friendly . He was a regular customer of the Inn of the Clowns and had good connections with the woodmen . However , in truth , he was a bandit spy . History . In 1357 DR , when Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party arrived at the village , Jamison tried to gather as much information about the adventurers as possible . That night , he went out of the village to send a falcon with a report about the adventurers to the Grandfather of Assassins . In answer , the Grandfather ordered Jamison to kill the adventurers .

title: Jamna Gleamsilver
description: Jamna Gleamsilver Jamna Gleamsilver was a gnome assassin and a member of the Zhentarim . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR Jamna was tasked with a mission to investigate the recent uprising of the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Jamna Gleamsilver Jamna Gleamsilver was a gnome assassin and a member of the Zhentarim . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR Jamna was tasked with a mission to investigate the recent uprising of the Cult of the Dragon . She deduced that they were gathering treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen and boarded a caravan full of hidden cultists that transported parts of the hoard to the final destination . During the journey , Jamna killed a too - curious cultist disguised as a caravan guard . Gameplay . After the assassination , adventurers could discover Jamna and needed to decide what do with her . She would potentially offer her help against their common enemy . Appendix . Behind the scenes . After the PC ' s arrive in Waterdeep Jamna expresses her desire to stick with the party until they find the treasure ' s destination .

title: Jan Duursema
description: Jan Duursema Jan Duursema is a comic book artist know for her work on comics . Education . Duursema was trained as an artist at in New Jersey .
description_long: Jan Duursema Jan Duursema is a comic book artist know for her work on comics . Education . Duursema was trained as an artist at in New Jersey . Career . Duursema has worked for , , and and has contributed to , , and many comics set in the Star Wars universe . She was also the lead artist for the Advanced Dungeons and Dragons comic series , which was set in the Forgotten Realms . She is primarily a penciller and inker , and has won several awards for her work .

title: Jan Jansen
description: Jan Jansen Jan Jansen was a gnome inventor , illusionist , and dishonest businessman in Athkatla . Activities . Jan could be found in the Government District Athkatla , peddling his wares , which in actuality were dangerous weapons in their own right .
description_long: Jan Jansen Jan Jansen was a gnome inventor , illusionist , and dishonest businessman in Athkatla . Activities . Jan could be found in the Government District Athkatla , peddling his wares , which in actuality were dangerous weapons in their own right . Personality . Like most gnomes , he was very eccentric , and loved to ramble on with stories that never got to the point . He had a habit of telling bizarre stories about his supposed relatives and the like at the drop of a hat . He liked to use his own inventions on adventures , and to sell them even though they might be illegal . He wanted to steal Boo from Minsc , and it was likely if he ever succeeded , he wouldn ' t live long afterwards . Abilities . An expert in crossbow s , Jan was capable of fashioning his own unique ammunition . His own weapon , a special crossbow entitled " Flasher Launcher " was so complicated that only he could use it . Jan was also a proficient thief . Appendix . Background . Jan is one of the party NPC s in , voiced by Jack Roth .

title: Jana - nimr
description: Jana - nimr Jana - nimr , also called greater winged cats , were mysterious felines that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were prized by zookeepers or as pets . The " jana - nimr " were intelligent felines that used their own unique language .
description_long: Jana - nimr Jana - nimr , also called greater winged cats , were mysterious felines that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were prized by zookeepers or as pets . The " jana - nimr " were intelligent felines that used their own unique language . Additionally , some could speak the language of sphinx es or other cat - like species . Description . The " jana - nimr " were the size of an average hunting cat , measuring 6 – 7 ft . ( 1 . 8 – 2 . 1 m ) in length . Most of these cats were colored with short gray , black , or sandy - colored fur . However , rare individuals with black - striped gray or yellow fur were spotted from time to time . Their large wings spanned 15 ft . ( 4 . 5 m ) when fully spread . The wing color tended to match that of the " jana - nimr ' s " body fur . Combat . Though they were peaceful creatures , the " jana - nimr " were fearsome when hunting . They preferred to attack from the air with tooth and claw . Once engaged , they would only retreat from combat if severely threatened . Even then , the " jana - nimr " remembered the incident and often took its revenge years later . " Habitat / Society .

title: Jana - qitat
description: Jana - qitat The jana - qitat , also called lesser winged cats or fluttercats , were smaller cousins of the " jana - nimr " . They were usually found within cities . Description .
description_long: Jana - qitat The jana - qitat , also called lesser winged cats or fluttercats , were smaller cousins of the " jana - nimr " . They were usually found within cities . Description . These creatures looked like house cats that sported a pair of wings from their back . The color of their fur varied greatly , though medium brown with a dark face , paws , wings and tail was the rarest coloration . Combat . Similar to their larger cousins , these cats only attacked if threatened , flying through the air attempting to rake their targets . Mothers fiercely defended their young . Habitat / Society . An enclosed lair above ground was the preferred nest of a " jana - qitat " . They bore litters of 1 – 3 cubs who lived with the mother for several months before they learned how to fly . " Jana - qitat " had a lifespan of 20 years . Ecology . Fluttercats controlled the vermin population wherever they lived . They were prized as pets and were quite loving toward a master who cared for them . Lucky wizard s were known to have a fluttercat as a familiar .

title: Janath Rendaer
description: Janath Rendaer Janath Rendaer was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Janath was a sarcastic individual who was one of the first magelords to join Belaur Aumar .
description_long: Janath Rendaer Janath Rendaer was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Janath was a sarcastic individual who was one of the first magelords to join Belaur Aumar . However , he was the only magelord to befriend any of the Athalantan knights or arms - men . He died in the magelords ' assault on the Wyrm Tower in 222 DR .

title: Janci al - Kriman
description: Janci al - Kriman Janci al - Kriman was a camel trader within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janci procured livestock for many of the animal dealers in the City of Delights .
description_long: Janci al - Kriman Janci al - Kriman was a camel trader within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janci procured livestock for many of the animal dealers in the City of Delights . Though he specialized in camels , he branched out into other beasts of burden as well . If a customer had 10 , 000 dinar they could even purchase one of Janci ' s rare hippogriff s . Janci always turned thieves over to the authorities , earning him a reputation that kept most from thinking twice about attempting the act . Rare among merchants , Janci extended lines of credit to his buyers if they required it . Possessions . Janci owned an " amulet of animal control " that allowed him complete control of any animal he touched . His possession of this amulet was the only reason Janci extended credit to his buyers , knowing that he could recall one of his animals at any time , even from great distances , if the buyer was delinquent . He also used the amulet to return animals mistreated by their owners since they were warned that this would happen before the sale .

title: Jandather
description: Jandather Jandather was a human evoker of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Personality . The wizard was a dashing wannabe adventurer looking to earn himself a reputation .
description_long: Jandather Jandather was a human evoker of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Personality . The wizard was a dashing wannabe adventurer looking to earn himself a reputation . History . Around 1358 DR , he was one of the more notable Procampur mages of the time . >

title: Jander Sunstar
description: Jander Sunstar Appearance . Jander was 5 ' 9 " and weighed 130 pounds . He had angular features but retained the noble countenance of an elf .
description_long: Jander Sunstar Appearance . Jander was 5 ' 9 " and weighed 130 pounds . He had angular features but retained the noble countenance of an elf . Jander kept his wheat - coloured hair long enough to reach his shoulder blades and it almost hid his ears . His skin was the colour of pale gold and he had expressive silver eyes . His left hand was withered and appeared burnt due to contact with the Holy symbol of Ravenkind . He would go about in public disguised as a leprous beggar in filthy cloaks , coating himself in stinking garbage to keep people away . He always wore gloves , both to hide his disfigured hand and so that his bare flesh would not touch plant life . Biography . Jander Sunstar was born to gold elf parents on the island of Evermeet . He was struck by wanderlust and headed to mainland Faerûn in search of adventure . He found more than he ' d expected . Whilst in Merrydale , the original pack of vampire s which infested the area for years to come attacked . Jander was betrayed by a friend who had been transformed in the first battle between the dalesmen and the vampires .

title: Jandi M ' baren
description: Jandi M ' baren Jandi M ' baren was an apprentice mage from Mulmaster whose primary skill was in setting and defeating magical wards . In 1460 DR , she met Gareth Jadaren and Ivor Beguine when they hired her master to determine the nature of a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko . She fell in love with Ivor and left her master ' s employment to travel with Gareth and Ivor to Turmish .
description_long: Jandi M ' baren Jandi M ' baren was an apprentice mage from Mulmaster whose primary skill was in setting and defeating magical wards . In 1460 DR , she met Gareth Jadaren and Ivor Beguine when they hired her master to determine the nature of a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko . She fell in love with Ivor and left her master ' s employment to travel with Gareth and Ivor to Turmish . While on the way to Turmish , they found an abandoned dwarven stronghold known as Giant ' s Fist in an extinct volcano near Erlkazar . Gareth wanted to settle down in the stronghold and he convinced Jandi to use her knowledge of wards and the Rythanko to create impregnable wards on the mountain . In 1461 DR , Gareth and Ivor ' s former firstmate , Helgre , tracked them to Giant ' s Fist and strangled Jandi , making it look as though Gareth was responsible . Upon her death , Jandi was met by an agent of Sune who offered her the choice of continuing on to Brightwater or lingering on the Prime . Over the years , the tree Jandi had died under came to be called " Jandi ' s Oak " , and boasted a small shrine where Gareth ' s descendants left small offerings .

title: Janessar
description: Janessar The Janessar were a group of warriors and priests throughout Calimshan , all worshiping The Triad of Torm , Tyr , and Ilmater , who opposed the slave trade and protected travelers from bandits . Organization . The Janessar were active in loose collections of small groups of between four and twelve .
description_long: Janessar The Janessar were a group of warriors and priests throughout Calimshan , all worshiping The Triad of Torm , Tyr , and Ilmater , who opposed the slave trade and protected travelers from bandits . Organization . The Janessar were active in loose collections of small groups of between four and twelve . These groups always included skilled warriors and riders — fighters , priests , and crusaders . The Janessar included a good number of escaped slaves who continued the cause that freed them . Because they did not gather together in large numbers outside of their enclaves , their total numbers were hard to estimate . Janessar enclaves were controlled by a captain or lord who was often a cleric of one of the members of the Triad . In 1370 DR , the Janessar as a whole were led by three elderly priests who no longer rode nor fought , each worshiping a different member of the Triad : These three men remained hidden in the Tower of the Three in the Khanall enclave . Activities . In general , the Janessar sought for the betterment of the common folk of Calimshan . This most often involved the rescuing of travelers from bandits and the freeing or protection of slaves .

title: Jang
description: Jang Jang was a watchman of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . History . Jang was part of a contingent of Marsember Watch and House Seasilver guards who accompanied Arietta Seasilver ; Kleef Kenric , a paladin follower of the dead god Helm ; and two Chosen , Malik el Sami , follower of Cyric , and Joelle Emmeline , follower of Sune , out of Marsember in order to fulfill their mission .
description_long: Jang Jang was a watchman of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . History . Jang was part of a contingent of Marsember Watch and House Seasilver guards who accompanied Arietta Seasilver ; Kleef Kenric , a paladin follower of the dead god Helm ; and two Chosen , Malik el Sami , follower of Cyric , and Joelle Emmeline , follower of Sune , out of Marsember in order to fulfill their mission . During their sea voyage , he was the only watchman to stay behind when all the other watchmen tried to deceive Prince Yder Tanthul and his men into believing that the Eye of Gruumsh was with them . With the shadovar busy , Kleef and the others , including Jang , assaulted the shadovar ' s ship , the " Wave Wyvern " . Afterward , Jang and the other watchmen were tasked with taking Arietta ' s mother , who had been the shadovar ' s prisoner , to safety .

title: Janik Darni
description: Janik Darni Janik Darni was the proprietor of the Darni House in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janik catered to wealthy merchants and caravan - masters by offering an assortment of fine food and skilled services .
description_long: Janik Darni Janik Darni was the proprietor of the Darni House in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janik catered to wealthy merchants and caravan - masters by offering an assortment of fine food and skilled services . History . Once a servant of Jisan at a mosque , Janik was allowed to leave the mosque to pursue his passion for business . Janik remained a devote follower of Jisan and even kept a small mosque devoted to the goddess of plenty within his .

title: Jann of the Haunted Lands
description: Jann of the Haunted Lands The Jann of the Haunted Lands was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Compared to jann found elsewhere in the Land of Fate , many of the Jann of the Haunted Lands were impulsive and vindictive genie s .
description_long: Jann of the Haunted Lands The Jann of the Haunted Lands was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Compared to jann found elsewhere in the Land of Fate , many of the Jann of the Haunted Lands were impulsive and vindictive genie s . This behavior , combined with their great power , made them a particularly dangerous group . Raids against humans and other races were quite common . However , not all of the jann inhabiting the Haunted Lands behaved this way . Many were still allied with other races . As a group , the Jann of the Haunted Lands pledged their allegiance to the current Grand Caliph ' s , fourteen predecessors . However , as of 1367 DR , no emissary had been sent from the jann to renew the support . This was largely believed to be in direct relation to the failing health of their leader , Amir Heidar Qan . The reality of the situation was far worse — Heidar Qan had not been seen by anyone , jann or otherwise , for over 50 years ; resulting in the increased chaotic behavior of the Jann of the Haunted Lands . Organization . Up until 1317 DR , the Jann of the Haunted Lands were ruled by Amir Heidar Qan .

title: Janni
description: Janni Jann , singular janni , were the weakest of all genie s . Unlike other genies , jann were not intimately bonded to one particular element or native of a singular elemental plane , instead they were natives of the Prime Material Plane . The jann of Toril resided in great numbers within Zakhara , the Land of Fate .
description_long: Janni Jann , singular janni , were the weakest of all genie s . Unlike other genies , jann were not intimately bonded to one particular element or native of a singular elemental plane , instead they were natives of the Prime Material Plane . The jann of Toril resided in great numbers within Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Jann resembled powerfully built human s or half - elves . Members of both sexes were usually quite attractive . The average janni stood between six and seven feet ( 180 to 210 centimeters ) tall . Their skin was the color of golden sand or earth , allowing them to mingle unnoticed among the dark - skinned Zakharans , and they were often mistaken for the humans they resembled . Their eye color varied greatly , but always held a supernatural intensity . Compared to humans , jann were intellectual geniuses . Jann were composed of all four of the elements , air , earth , fire , and water . A janni could live to be 300 years old . While they did not have a dual nature — that is , their souls and bodies were not divided – because of their connection to the Material Plane , they could still be resurrected if they died of unnatural causes . Personality .

title: Jannti
description: Jannti Jannti was the language of the genie s , including the djinn , efreet , marid , dao , and jann . Whether Jannti was a single tongue with several dialects or four different elemental tongues was a matter of some debate , though it was effectively a single language . Jannti was one of the roots of the Midani language .

title: Janol Famisso
description: Janol Famisso Janol Famisso , commonly known as Pinch , was the king of Ankhapur and a former crime lord . Personality . Despite his warm feelings for his closest companions , he would not hesitate to sacrifice one of them if it served his goals .
description_long: Janol Famisso Janol Famisso , commonly known as Pinch , was the king of Ankhapur and a former crime lord . Personality . Despite his warm feelings for his closest companions , he would not hesitate to sacrifice one of them if it served his goals . Janol despised first of all hypocrites , especially plotters . He preferred common people . One of his advantageous qualities was keeping his head cool under any circumstance , even the most dangerous . He saw this as an opportunity to show his ability to improvise . He liked the adrenaline rush caused by danger . Pinch was a cynic at heart ; to him , respect meant nothing . The only thing important was power and the fear that he could instill in his enemies . Pinch was always suspicious , had a very manipulative mind , and could usually convince others easily to do what he wanted . He was especially good at deceiving priests . Janol could elaborate a plan even with very little information . He would rather listen than speak . Pinch always venerated both Tymora and Mask . After his rescue by Lissa , he started to respect Lathander . Activities . King Janol was actively trying to widen the Ankh Road to increase traffic to his city .

title: Janos
description: Janos Janos the Lichbreaker was most veteran Knight of the Weave in 1374 DR . He had trained three other Knights by this time . His main concern was the plots of the Shadovar and he patrolled the Anauroch near Thultanthar , hoping to stop all possible Shadovar plots before they could disturb the Weave , especially those involved the Shadow Weave .
description_long: Janos Janos the Lichbreaker was most veteran Knight of the Weave in 1374 DR . He had trained three other Knights by this time . His main concern was the plots of the Shadovar and he patrolled the Anauroch near Thultanthar , hoping to stop all possible Shadovar plots before they could disturb the Weave , especially those involved the Shadow Weave .

title: Janszeene Naerhand
description: Janszeene Naerhand Janszeene Naerhand was the leader of House Naerhand , a powerful merchant family that was active from the Sword Coast to Cormyr as of 1479 DR . Relationships . Janszeene didn ' t trust her sister Malarrla who was considered unfit to ever lead the family .
description_long: Janszeene Naerhand Janszeene Naerhand was the leader of House Naerhand , a powerful merchant family that was active from the Sword Coast to Cormyr as of 1479 DR . Relationships . Janszeene didn ' t trust her sister Malarrla who was considered unfit to ever lead the family . She had Malarrla closely watched to prevent a coup attempt . Abilities . Janszeene could throw poisoned daggers with deadly accuracy and had taken small doses of poison for years to build up immunity . Possessions . She collected an arsenal of magic items to use in case she was ever attacked by a wizard .

title: Jantoo
description: Jantoo Jantoo was the greatest philosopher alive in 1358 DR . Activities . Two of her most famous pamphlets told about free will .
description_long: Jantoo Jantoo was the greatest philosopher alive in 1358 DR . Activities . Two of her most famous pamphlets told about free will . One proved that mankind had free will , the other proved the opposite . Jantoo publicly said that she would marry a man who could defeat her in a debate . She accepted or refused questions depending on her whim .

title: Janxar Dhoarn
description: Janxar Dhoarn Janxar Dhoarn was a male half - elf fighter of Alaghôn in Turmish . He was the richest mercenary captain in the city and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Description .
description_long: Janxar Dhoarn Janxar Dhoarn was a male half - elf fighter of Alaghôn in Turmish . He was the richest mercenary captain in the city and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Description . Janxar was an always - smiling broad - shouldered giant of a man . Personality . Janxar was well known for his honesty and integrity , which made him stand out in a land like Turmish , where disloyalty seemed commonplace . Activities . He could gather an army at once if needed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun for the Moonstars . One of his primary jobs for the Moonstars was to train new agents in fighting techniques .

title: Janya bint Khalil
description: Janya bint Khalil Janya bint Khalil was a the eldest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Janya spent the first three years of her life within the Royal Harim but was moved to a secret location deep within Al - Akara Mountains for her own protection .
description_long: Janya bint Khalil Janya bint Khalil was a the eldest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Janya spent the first three years of her life within the Royal Harim but was moved to a secret location deep within Al - Akara Mountains for her own protection . She was to live within the mountains until Khalil fathered a male heir , or named her heir , or until she was of an age to be married . She was able to visit her parents in Huzuz regularly . Janya and her sister , Dalia were protected by both jann and elite agents of the Soft Whisper . Relationships . Janya was the child of Khalil and his most favored wife Tanya bint Perijan . Her name honored both her mother and grandmother .

title: Janzobur
description: Janzobur Janzobur of the Snow Cats was a barbarian in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Janzobur was a member of the Uthgardt Red Tiger Tribe .
description_long: Janzobur Janzobur of the Snow Cats was a barbarian in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Janzobur was a member of the Uthgardt Red Tiger Tribe . He first came to Waterdeep in 1357 DR in search of a warrior - princess for his tribe . Unfortunately his first candidate , a mercenary from Athkatla , was killed by a remorhaz . In disgrace with his people , Janzobur went back to Waterdeep to find a new candidate . Instead , he put his efforts into survey all the brews in the taverns of the South and Dock Wards . At the urging of his friend Myrnd Gundwynd , he joined the Black Boar mercenary group .

title: Jaod
description: Jaod A jaod was an unintelligent , parasitic creature that could be molded into the shape of a humanoid face or body part . The creature got its name from a sage from Cimbar known as Rinthrin Jaod . Ecology .
description_long: Jaod A jaod was an unintelligent , parasitic creature that could be molded into the shape of a humanoid face or body part . The creature got its name from a sage from Cimbar known as Rinthrin Jaod . Ecology . The creatures could be made to adhere to a face and the wearer could shape the jaod into facial features . Air passed freely through the creature so that the wearer could breathe while wearing the jaod . There were no harmful effects to the wearer . They could also be molded into the shape of blossoms or a digit or limb . Jaods absorbed alcohol and poisons in the host ' s body and gave off a scent that repelled some insects . They could be removed by applying alcohol directly to the jaod ' s body . Forceful removal from the host resulted in minor injury to the host . Description . In the wild , Jaod ' s resembled a hunk of humanoid flesh .

title: Japheth Donard
description: Japheth Donard Japheth Donard is a warlock of a fey pact with the archfey Neifion . Appearance . Japheth has black hair and black eyes .
description_long: Japheth Donard Japheth Donard is a warlock of a fey pact with the archfey Neifion . Appearance . Japheth has black hair and black eyes . He is almost always seen wearing his mysterious cloak , which seems to have strange powers itself . History . Japheth Donard was an acolyte librarian at Candlekeep . It was at Candlekeep that he found the book " Fey Pacts of Ancient Days " He summoned Neifion to save him from the death that traveler ' s dust brings . Neifion sealed the Fey Pact with an emerald pendant . Japheth is an agent of Behroun Marhana who hired thieves to steal the emerald pendant . In 1396 DR Malyanna destroyed his fey pact stone . Japheth subsequently lost his fey - granted powers and then made a pact with the elder evil Caiphon , becoming a star - pact warlock . Relationships . Japheth is quite taken by the young woman Anusha Marhana . At first denying the relationship due to his past , and present situation , he comes to realize Anusha has claimed his heart . Miscellaneous . Japheth is addicted to traveler ' s dust .

title: Jaqon
description: Jaqon Jaqon was a devil who lived on Avernus , the first hell of Baator , where he was exiled by Asmodeus for a great betrayal . Asmodeus changed Jaqon ' s name to Dagon , so that if someone tried to summon him , they would instead summon the powerful demon lord ' s aspect . Activities .
description_long: Jaqon Jaqon was a devil who lived on Avernus , the first hell of Baator , where he was exiled by Asmodeus for a great betrayal . Asmodeus changed Jaqon ' s name to Dagon , so that if someone tried to summon him , they would instead summon the powerful demon lord ' s aspect . Activities . Jaqon led his followers in a battle against Asmodeus , becoming an archdevil in the process . In order to disrespect Asmodeus and his name , Jaqon behaved in a goodly manner unheard of among devils .

title: Jarda
description: Jarda Jarda was a halfling sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Jarda was a shrewd professional who distrusted others until they proved otherwise .
description_long: Jarda Jarda was a halfling sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Jarda was a shrewd professional who distrusted others until they proved otherwise . Because of her paranoia she frequently dressed as a male to make it harder for anyone tracking her . Description . Because of her craving for sweets , which she often stole while roaming the city , Jarda developed a bit of a paunch . Possessions . Jarda owned a pair of " bracers of defense + 5 " , a magical short sword , a " philter of glibness " , and an assortment of thieving tools . Rumors & Legends . Though she was a successful adventurer in her own right , Jarda was actually a trusted agent of Prince Tannous al - Assad and frequently ran special errands for him .

title: Jardwim
description: Jardwim Jardwim was the leader of the Gray Hands adventuring company who helped guard the city of Waterdeep . Appearance . He had a stocky , muscular build and shoulder length black hair .
description_long: Jardwim Jardwim was the leader of the Gray Hands adventuring company who helped guard the city of Waterdeep . Appearance . He had a stocky , muscular build and shoulder length black hair . His skin was a grayish hue . Personality . He was a follower of Mielikki . He was ruthless and indomitable . Jardwim felt that resistance should be met by lethal force and his concentration was legendary . Relationships . Jardwim had two blink dog s . As leader of the Gray Hands , he reported to Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Behind the scenes . His name was an anagram of , and may be a reference to , another character " Drawmij " , itself a reference to Jim Ward .

title: Jarekos
description: Jarekos Jarekos was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Jarekos was among the first to see the arrive of Cordell and his forces in 1361 DR .
description_long: Jarekos Jarekos was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Jarekos was among the first to see the arrive of Cordell and his forces in 1361 DR . Under the influx of foreigners , she opened a stall in her village , inside the land owned by Lord Drakosa . Jarekos supported all the newcomers . Personality . Jarekos believed that the arrival of the Golden Legion had changed the lives of all in positive ways . She appreciated the attitude of the newcomers towards women . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Jarekos is a pre - generated Maztican PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Jareth Grim
description: Jareth Grim Jareth Grim was the apparent leader of the Blackdagger Bandits on the High Road . History . Jareth Grim was a prominent member of the Blackdagger Bandits .
description_long: Jareth Grim Jareth Grim was the apparent leader of the Blackdagger Bandits on the High Road . History . Jareth Grim was a prominent member of the Blackdagger Bandits . Jareth was so loyal that Traven Blackdagger himself decided to put him in charge of raiding operations for a time because the two Blackdagger brothers were busy with other matters , and after the Red Wizard necromancer Kallos Tam transformed them into undead they were too scary to lead the bandits . Jareth Grim ' s end came when an adventurer recruited by the Harpers , who had spies in the bandits ' ranks , infiltrated the bandits ' stronghold of Grimstorm Keep . Here the adventurer fought and defeated Jareth .

title: Jargoon
description: Jargoon Jargoon was a rare variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . Jargoons were valued for their resemblance to deep red rubies in color and luster .
description_long: Jargoon Jargoon was a rare variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . Jargoons were valued for their resemblance to deep red rubies in color and luster . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . One powerful use of this gemstone was as a " magic missile " enhancer . The caster held a jargoon in a hand and cast " magic missile " through it . This caused the jargoon to explode , but the number of missiles was doubled with no alteration in targets , damage , range , " etc . " The drawback was that the explosion damaged the caster ' s hand as if struck by a single particularly strong " magic missile " . Rumors and Legends . An unproven legend stated that a jargoon could prevent a lycanthrope from changing out of human form .

title: Jargus Holenhond
description: Jargus Holenhond Jargus Holenhond was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Jargus Holenhond rose to a position of leadership in the Order of the Golden Cup by the 1260s DR .
description_long: Jargus Holenhond Jargus Holenhond was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Jargus Holenhond rose to a position of leadership in the Order of the Golden Cup by the 1260s DR . Around 1265 DR , Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith . The Mussum priests and the Companions of the Noble Heart attacked Waelarn and his followers , labeling them " false clerics " and " subverted by evil " . An angry Waelarn summoned the Order of the Golden Cup , as well as the Holy Warriors of Suffering and Knights of the Bleeding Shield , to his side and vowed holy war against the " unclean ones of Mussum " and their allies . The war saw the violent clashes of Holy Hill Farm in 1266 DR and Bronsheir ' s Charge and Weeping Rock in 1267 DR . Jargus Holenhond was among those Golden Cup paladins who fought in the war .

title: Jarhild Stoneforge
description: Jarhild Stoneforge Jarhild Stoneforge was a shield dwarf fighter and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Jarhild was a trained soldier who was always ready for a fight .
description_long: Jarhild Stoneforge Jarhild Stoneforge was a shield dwarf fighter and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Jarhild was a trained soldier who was always ready for a fight . With toughness , sturdiness , and strategic knowledge , she was a force to be feared . She had taken down orc s and even held her own against a dragon , so she was not afraid to do battle anywhere , whether it be giant s or tavern patrons . When not in combat , she drank with other veterans of battle . She was also a member of the Burning Dawn as she felt it was a way to do good and get paid . She did not like to be insulted about her appearance or abilities , and she delivered great pain to the ones whom she felt should experience it . She found it very motivating to defend people she cared for , and she would feel anger if they were threatened . Appendix . Appearances . Jarhild will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Jarlaxle Baenre
description: Jarlaxle Baenre Jarlaxle ( born Jarlaxle Baenre ) was a drow mercenary and leader of the Bregan D ' aerthe mercenary company . He was one of a small number of male drow who actually had significant power in a Lolth - worshiping city , although he increasingly spent little time in the city itself as he adventured on the Surface . Description .
description_long: Jarlaxle Baenre Jarlaxle ( born Jarlaxle Baenre ) was a drow mercenary and leader of the Bregan D ' aerthe mercenary company . He was one of a small number of male drow who actually had significant power in a Lolth - worshiping city , although he increasingly spent little time in the city itself as he adventured on the Surface . Description . Slender , handsome , and tightly muscled , Jarlaxle was the dandy of Menzoberranzan . He chose the brightest colors for his clothes and wore a cape that shone in every color in both the visible and infrared spectra . He commonly wore high boots and bracelets that could be made to be clack loudly or be silent at his discretion . He also wore a magical eye patch that protected his mind from magical and psionic intrusions and allowed him to see through walls and other solid objects . He often shifted the patch from eye to eye to keep others guessing as to its powers . Another staple item was his wide - brimmed hat , plumed with a diatryma feather and worn atop his clean - shaven scalp , which was a symbol of his refusal to conform to society ' s expectations in Menzoberranzan , a society where rank and position were reflected by hair style .

title: Jarlin Flamtarge
description: Jarlin Flamtarge Jarlin Flamtarge was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Flamtarge was on patrol on the Orondstars Road with fellow War Wizards and some Purple Dragons when Manshoon appeared .
description_long: Jarlin Flamtarge Jarlin Flamtarge was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Flamtarge was on patrol on the Orondstars Road with fellow War Wizards and some Purple Dragons when Manshoon appeared . He slew all except Jarlin , whom he mind - wiped instead . Later , Manshoon send Flamtarge , by now only a body with Manshoon ' s conscience inside , to Castle Irlingstar , but the discovery of the mysterious magic killer that operated inside the castle forced Manshoon to change his plans . He abandoned Jarlin ' s body in order to escape the killer . When at last the killer was identified as Rorskryn Mreldrake , Manshoon , using the body of Jarlin , sent an eyeball spy .

title: Jarmik
description: Jarmik Jarmik , the Thirsty Jann , was a local god of Zakhara . The symbol of Jarmik was a jann sitting on his knees near a well . Personality .
description_long: Jarmik Jarmik , the Thirsty Jann , was a local god of Zakhara . The symbol of Jarmik was a jann sitting on his knees near a well . Personality . Worshipers of Jarmik valued generosity and sharing . History . The sacred well located at the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann was said to be the very spot where Jarmik left Zakhara to be with the gods .

title: Jarthon Drael
description: Jarthon Drael Jarthon Drael was a male half - elf werebadger from the Moonwood and was the Bloodmaster for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Personality . Clear of thought and adaptable , Jarthon takes great relish in battle and stealth and out - witting his foes alike .
description_long: Jarthon Drael Jarthon Drael was a male half - elf werebadger from the Moonwood and was the Bloodmaster for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Personality . Clear of thought and adaptable , Jarthon takes great relish in battle and stealth and out - witting his foes alike . Although he is ruthless in combat , often prone to flying in a rage when injured , Jarthon is not above fleeing an unnecessary battle if it could mean his death . Abilities . As a werebadger , Jarthon can assume the form of a dire badger when pressed in combat . Jarthon ' s skills as a hunter were also accomplished enough to earn him leadership of the Moonwood tribe of the People of the Black Blood . Possessions . Jarthon was spartanly equipped , usually with only his mithral chain shirt , magic longsword , dagger and crossbow ( albeit with a few silver - tipped bolt s ) for protection . However , Jarthon had amassed a small stash of gold , gem s and a couple of potion s of " cure moderate wounds " back in Claw Hollow . History .

title: Jaseen Drakehorn
description: Jaseen Drakehorn Jaseen Drakehorn was the High Blade of Mulmaster . History . Jaseen quietly ruled Mulmaster , supported by the Church of Bane , until 1491 DR .
description_long: Jaseen Drakehorn Jaseen Drakehorn was the High Blade of Mulmaster . History . Jaseen quietly ruled Mulmaster , supported by the Church of Bane , until 1491 DR . Selfaril Uoumdolphin , the High Blade who ruled until 1375 DR , resurfaced in 1491 DR to challenge her dominion over the city . Selfaril gained support among the citizens of Mulmaster and challenged Jaseen to a public duel . Personality . Jaseen was a devoted follower of Bane .

title: Jashnil Zolond
description: Jashnil Zolond Streea ' Valsharess Jashnil Zolond was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1379 DR . History . In 1379 DR Jashnil Zolond was choose as the new Streea ' Valsharess after the demise of Ilharess Laele Zauviir .
description_long: Jashnil Zolond Streea ' Valsharess Jashnil Zolond was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1379 DR . History . In 1379 DR Jashnil Zolond was choose as the new Streea ' Valsharess after the demise of Ilharess Laele Zauviir . Under the orders of T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , she summoned the quasit demon Glizn , who was previously bonded to Piri , to ask about Q ' arlynd Melarn .

title: Jasmal
description: Jasmal Jasmal was a gemstone found in the Thunder Peaks and the Spine of the World mountains . Description . Jasmals were usually found in small veins of ore .
description_long: Jasmal Jasmal was a gemstone found in the Thunder Peaks and the Spine of the World mountains . Description . Jasmals were usually found in small veins of ore . Very rarely , a large deposit was found in a seam . This clear and colorless gem was extremely hard and durable , even able to hold a sharp edge for use in small , non - metallic weapons , or mounted on a larger blade and enchanted ( see below ) . Typically , jasmals were cut cabochon and polished to bring out their optical properties when worn as adornments on cloaks and clothing . Polished jasmals absorbed sunlight or light from fires and torches and gave off a nimbus of amber or orange that surrounded the stones even though the jasmals remained colorless and transparent . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 to 3 , 000 gp . Powers . Crushed to powder , jasmal was the ingredient of choice for enchanted immersions used to make magical armor and in the recipe for the ink used to scribe scrolls of " Veladar ' s vambrace " . Whole jasmals could accept complex enchantments or many simple enchantments and were thus mounted in a row along a blade to deliver their effects when a strike was successful .

title: Jasmar ' n Shadewidow
description: Jasmar ' n Shadewidow Jasmar ' n Shadewidow was a small - time crime lord in Skullport . Personality . Jasmar ' n was cold and emotionless .
description_long: Jasmar ' n Shadewidow Jasmar ' n Shadewidow was a small - time crime lord in Skullport . Personality . Jasmar ' n was cold and emotionless . She usually never departed from her shop , instead operating through underlings . Relationships . She had a vulture familiar called Gakk . History . Once Jasmar ' n was a talented apprentice chirurgeon in Waterdeep until she was discovered performing necromantic rites on bodies in the City of the Dead . Abandoned by her master , she continued her experiments until found a " gate " to Skullport . Once there , Jasmar ' n joined the Cryptkey Facilitations organization , trading her knowledge of secret and little - used access routes into many nearby tombs and the location of the gate for training in necromancy from the facilitators . Soon she rose to become the leader of the group .

title: Jasmine
description: Jasmine Jasmine was both a spelljamming and planewalking adventurer . She was a member of Finder ' s Band . She was notable for her wings .
description_long: Jasmine Jasmine was both a spelljamming and planewalking adventurer . She was a member of Finder ' s Band . She was notable for her wings . Description . Jasmine ' s appearance was that of a woman in her mid - to - late twenties , with black hair and brown eyes . She was of average height and was quite muscular . Sprouting from her back were magical wings that changed appearance depending on the plane she was in ; for example , they resembled grayish bird ' s wings on the Prime Material Plane and a leathery triangular single wing in Gehenna . When she fell under the influence of a dark - stalker persona ( actually her grief and guilt combined with a slight glitch in her wings ' magic ) , her skin was entirely covered in hard black feathers with a green crest on her forehead , her eyes turned green , and her hands and feet become taloned . History . Jasmine ' s parents were spelljamming paladin s of Tymora whose last known spelljamming journey was from Krynn ( where Jasmine was born ) to Abeir - Toril . After her parents where slain somewhere during her early teens by assassins , she was taken in by her relatives for a while .

title: Jasper
description: Jasper Jasper was a semi - precious form of or chalcedony found in the Realms . Description . Mostly found in opaque shades of red , brown , or solid black , very rare specimens of these semi - precious stones were blue or had bands of blue superimposed over the other colors .
description_long: Jasper Jasper was a semi - precious form of or chalcedony found in the Realms . Description . Mostly found in opaque shades of red , brown , or solid black , very rare specimens of these semi - precious stones were blue or had bands of blue superimposed over the other colors . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Jasper had strong anti - poison properties . Crushed to powder , it could be substituted for any solid ingredient when making antidotes or magical potion s and items that neutralized poison or bestowed protection from poison . Because of its reputation and properties , jasper was the stone of choice for making both periapts of foul rotting and proof against poison . If stored for at least 24 hours in a container made from jasper , consumable liquids were purified of all taint . This was standard practice in the royal palace in Suzail and many other courts .

title: Jasper Dimmerchasm
description: Jasper Dimmerchasm Jasper Dimmerchasm was a shield dwarf member of the Zhentarim and prisoner of the fire giant s in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Jasper went to negotiate with Duke Zalto .
description_long: Jasper Dimmerchasm Jasper Dimmerchasm was a shield dwarf member of the Zhentarim and prisoner of the fire giant s in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Jasper went to negotiate with Duke Zalto . However , the lord of Ironslag decided he did not need the Zhent ' s help and captured him . Zalto put the shield dwarf inside the head of his iron maul weapon .

title: Jasrya Aelorothi
description: Jasrya Aelorothi Jasrya Aelorothi was a high - ranking daemonfey bladesinger . In 1374 DR , she was one of the captains of Sarya Dlardrageth in the Cormanthor War . She died during the battle at the Vale of Lost Voices , killed by multiple arrows fired by Dalesfolk archers .
description_long: Jasrya Aelorothi Jasrya Aelorothi was a high - ranking daemonfey bladesinger . In 1374 DR , she was one of the captains of Sarya Dlardrageth in the Cormanthor War . She died during the battle at the Vale of Lost Voices , killed by multiple arrows fired by Dalesfolk archers .

title: Jasrya Ilviiri
description: Jasrya Ilviiri Jasrya Ilviiri was a tall female fey ' ri who served Sarya Dlardrageth . Her skin was covered with diamond - shaped scales and she had marilith heritage . She was given control of the houses of Ilviiri , Aelorothi and Dhaorothi against the wood elves of the High Forest , along with Sarya ' s son , Xhalph .
description_long: Jasrya Ilviiri Jasrya Ilviiri was a tall female fey ' ri who served Sarya Dlardrageth . Her skin was covered with diamond - shaped scales and she had marilith heritage . She was given control of the houses of Ilviiri , Aelorothi and Dhaorothi against the wood elves of the High Forest , along with Sarya ' s son , Xhalph .

title: Jatham Villore
description: Jatham Villore Jatham Villore was a wheezing weaver in High Dale and secretly a Red Wizard of Thay . History . Jatham was a very able weaver in High Dale .
description_long: Jatham Villore Jatham Villore was a wheezing weaver in High Dale and secretly a Red Wizard of Thay . History . Jatham was a very able weaver in High Dale . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Jatham was a member of the Council of the High Dale . Constable Heladar Longspear believed him a pest and far wiser than he pretended to be . In truth Jatham , not wanting a dale ruled by the Zhentarim , secretly used his spells to help Elminster and Sharantyr went unnoticed by the Zhent .

title: Jathrin ' s Jump
description: Jathrin ' s Jump Jathrin ' s Jump ( also known as the Jump ) was a virtually lawless town in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . Somewhere in or near to the town , were some high cliffs .
description_long: Jathrin ' s Jump Jathrin ' s Jump ( also known as the Jump ) was a virtually lawless town in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . Somewhere in or near to the town , were some high cliffs . Trade . Jathrin ' s Jump was full of lawless travellers and lawless residents . The town ' s economy relied heavily on trading stolen goods and goods that were illegal in most other civilised places . History . At some point in the town ' s early history an outlaw named Jathrin was executed at the nearby cliffs . This event earned the town it ' s name . Jathrin ' s capture and execution also lead to the phrase , " a person s gotta be smarter than your average Jathrin " . Rumors and Legends . As of 1370 DR , there were reports of a ghost that haunted the cliff where Jathirn was executed . The spirit appears as a slim human male wearing tattered leather armor and carrying a torch . Inhabitants . The inhabitants of Jathrin ' s Jump didn ' t care much for the law and traded black market goods in broad daylight .

title: Jaufan
description: Jaufan Jaufan was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Since 1348 DR , Jaufan had worked as an enforcer for a criminal yakuza gang .
description_long: Jaufan Jaufan was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Since 1348 DR , Jaufan had worked as an enforcer for a criminal yakuza gang . In 1358 DR , believing that street fights had taught him more lessons than practice in a dojo , Jaufan went to participate at the Komite in Suijeng . He told everyone he had a 12th - degree black belt in kung fu .

title: Jauhar
description: Jauhar Jauhar was the goddess of wealth of Zakhara . She was technically only a local goddess , but probably the most influential of those , as she was worshiped in a number of cities . In the Cities of the Pantheon , she was seen as a Great Goddess and took the place of Jisan there .
description_long: Jauhar Jauhar was the goddess of wealth of Zakhara . She was technically only a local goddess , but probably the most influential of those , as she was worshiped in a number of cities . In the Cities of the Pantheon , she was seen as a Great Goddess and took the place of Jisan there . She preached the importance of hard work to acquire riches . As such Jauhar was above such concerns as alignment , as wealth could be acquired to feed the hungry or to oppress the poor . Jauhar ' s symbol was a gold dinar . Old images showed the goddess as a beautiful dancer adorned with coins , but efforts had been made by her pantheist worshipers to destroy all such pictures as blasphemous . They instead describe her garbed in a chador , a garment covering a woman from head to foot , but with a gold dinar on her forehead . Jauhar had many worshipers among merchants and craftsmen and filled a similar role in the Land of Fate as Waukeen did in Faerûn .

title: Javelin
description: Javelin A javelin is a simple , thrown , ranged weapon , similar to a shortspear . Description . A javelin is a light , flexible spear designed primarily as a throwing weapon .
description_long: Javelin A javelin is a simple , thrown , ranged weapon , similar to a shortspear . Description . A javelin is a light , flexible spear designed primarily as a throwing weapon . It is usually constructed of wood and may taper to a sharp point at one or both ends . Alternatively , it may be tipped with a small metal spearhead . The shaft is much thinner than a spear intended for melee combat . An average javelin with a metal head costs 1gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . The javelin is a ranged weapon , intended to be thrown . Javelins are not sturdy enough for most melee combat and if wielded in this way will perform poorly . Normal maximum range of a javelin is 150 feet ( 49 meters ) .

title: Javor
description: Javor Javor was an old chieftain of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In life , Javor was a great Uthgardt chieftain .
description_long: Javor Javor was an old chieftain of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In life , Javor was a great Uthgardt chieftain . His remains were buried in a mound near the Nettlebee ranch . In 1491 DR , Wiggan and Bertram Nettlebee , under the orders of Cult of the Black Earth leaders , set a trap for some adventurers who had defeated the earth cultists at the Sacred Stone Monastery . They burnt Javor ' s mound , attracting the adventurers with rumors of a " fire witch " in their fields . When the adventurers came to investigate the mound , Wiggan summoned an earth elemental to destroy the mound and kill all inside . However , this awoke Javor . Javor rose as a revenant wanting revenge against Wiggan and Bertram . He was helped by an Uthgardt war group led by the berserker Fennor . Somehow the adventurers resolved the situation and Javor went back to the afterlife . Personality . Javor was an honorable man , even in undeath . He tried to find and kill only the true culprits , but had no mercy for those that protected them .

title: Jawali
description: Jawali Jawali was a dwarf faris living on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Personality . Jawali was fierce and rarely socialized with others .
description_long: Jawali Jawali was a dwarf faris living on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Personality . Jawali was fierce and rarely socialized with others . He never smiled , constantly reminded of the scar upon his honor . Activities . At one time , Jawali was once the head of security for the treasure in a temple in Jumlat . The Temple of Najm was robbed under his watch , forever scarring his honor .

title: Jawzah
description: Jawzah A jawzah ( jauh - ZAH ) was a stringed fiddle - like Zakharan instrument . Description . A " jawzah " resembled a thin spiked fiddle with four strings connected to a small soundbox made from a hollowed - out coconut shell .
description_long: Jawzah A jawzah ( jauh - ZAH ) was a stringed fiddle - like Zakharan instrument . Description . A " jawzah " resembled a thin spiked fiddle with four strings connected to a small soundbox made from a hollowed - out coconut shell . A bow made from horsehair was used to play the instrument . History . Since coconuts were used for the soundbox of a " jawzah " , these instruments were popular among the sailors and travelers of the Golden Gulf and the ports surrounding it .

title: Jaxanaedegor
description: Jaxanaedegor Jaxanaedegor was an ancient green vampiric dragon who lived on Mount Thulbane in Threskel . Appearance . Jaxanaedegor was described as having scales of alternating light and dark green and yellow eyes .
description_long: Jaxanaedegor Jaxanaedegor was an ancient green vampiric dragon who lived on Mount Thulbane in Threskel . Appearance . Jaxanaedegor was described as having scales of alternating light and dark green and yellow eyes . He was so big that even towered blue dragon s . History . In 1479 DR , he was Alasklerbanbastos ' s lieutenant during Threskel ' s war with Chessenta . He was also a " taaldarax " of Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . In one of the most important battles in the war , he switched sides and betrayed Alasklerbanbastos .

title: Jay Batista
description: Jay Batista Jay Batista is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . He is known primarily for his work on the Kara - Tur setting . Education and Career .
description_long: Jay Batista Jay Batista is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . He is known primarily for his work on the Kara - Tur setting . Education and Career . Batista has a masters degree and has worked as a professor and an engineer for various radio stations . He became interested in Asian cultures at a young age , and worked on multiple sourcebooks involving Kara - Tur .

title: Jayani al - Jasir
description: Jayani al - Jasir Jayani al - Jasir was a ranking member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and a legend among corsair s . Description . Jayani had an angular face and trim but muscular physique .
description_long: Jayani al - Jasir Jayani al - Jasir was a ranking member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and a legend among corsair s . Description . Jayani had an angular face and trim but muscular physique . Personality . Her bold attitude and knowledge of the sea were only surpassed by her striking beauty . Possessions . Jayani was able to procure just about any normal item that she wanted . Known magical items in her possession included : " Ring of youth , Short Sword of Quickness , Jambiya + 2 , Bracers of Defence AC 3 . " Jayani owned most of the taverns in Hawa , and those that she didn ' t own paid her tribute . Activities . Retired from active corsair life , Jayani was once a scourge of the Free Cities of Zakhara . During her pirating days , her base of operations for a decade was the back of a zaratan . This lasted until Qudra ' s mamluk s attacked and spooked the giant turtle . She was considered the unofficial head of the Corsair Council . She ran an extensive spy network in Hawa , who communicated with her by special " message ring s " . Relationships . Jayani ' s favorite male companion was an outland corsair from Waterdeep named Turn bin Trevor .

title: Jaylee Clammath
description: Jaylee Clammath Jaylee Clammath was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was tall and quite overweight .
description_long: Jaylee Clammath Jaylee Clammath was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was tall and quite overweight . Personality . Jaylee was a cheerful person who liked to joke and laugh . Abilities . She was an excellent cook . Relationships . The Three Elves was a very popular inn throughout the Moonsea region and its owner / operators were highly regarded .

title: Jayne Nettlebee
description: Jayne Nettlebee Jayne Nettlebee was the wife of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jayne was a no - nonsense lady who knew how to handle Wiggan , Bertram , and other loudmouths .
description_long: Jayne Nettlebee Jayne Nettlebee was the wife of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jayne was a no - nonsense lady who knew how to handle Wiggan , Bertram , and other loudmouths . She was afraid however and most concerned for her children . She did not know her husband ' s true allegiance . History . In 1491 DR , she was unwittingly involved in a trap set by her family for some adventurers who had defeated the Cult of the Black Earth at the Sacred Stone Monastery . At the end of the tragedy , she assumed the role of the new matriarch of the Nettlebee clan .

title: Jazayir al - Sartan
description: Jazayir al - Sartan Jazayir al - Sartan , the Isles of the Crab , formed a crab - shaped archipelago in the eastern part of the Crowded Sea of Zakhara , south of Ajayib . Poorly explored and marginally settled by enlightened Zakharans , it was the home to a large number of monsters as well as savage tribes of halfling s , human s , ogre s and ogre magi . Even the waters were avoided due the strange crab - like monsters .
description_long: Jazayir al - Sartan Jazayir al - Sartan , the Isles of the Crab , formed a crab - shaped archipelago in the eastern part of the Crowded Sea of Zakhara , south of Ajayib . Poorly explored and marginally settled by enlightened Zakharans , it was the home to a large number of monsters as well as savage tribes of halfling s , human s , ogre s and ogre magi . Even the waters were avoided due the strange crab - like monsters . Geography . Four major groups of islands were usually recognized within the archipelago : the larger Jazirat al - Sadaf ( the " Island of the Shell " ) and Jazirat al - Qraidis ( " Shrimp Island " ) , the long chain called Jazayir al - Alfar ( the " Islands of the Claws " ) extending north and south of Jaziat al - Sadaf , and the smaller Uyun al - Sartan ( " Eyes of the Crab " ) in the center around the so - called Batihat al - Saji , the " Lagoon of the Brave " .

title: Jazirat al - Sadaf
description: Jazirat al - Sadaf Jazirat al - Sadaf , also known as the Island of the Shell , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island was surrounded on all sides by imposing cliffs made from volcanic rock , proving especially treacherous to approaching vessels .
description_long: Jazirat al - Sadaf Jazirat al - Sadaf , also known as the Island of the Shell , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island was surrounded on all sides by imposing cliffs made from volcanic rock , proving especially treacherous to approaching vessels . Inhabitants . The Island of the Shell was the largest of the archipelago . Inhabitants from the other islands said it was only populated by monsters , cannibals , and other vile things . One savage tribe called this place home , the Gurum .

title: Jazirat al - Sayyad
description: Jazirat al - Sayyad Jazirat al - Sayyad , or the Hunter , was an elongated island located in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Geography . Jazirat al - Sayyad had extremely rocky shores , marking it as dangerous sailing territory for mariners .
description_long: Jazirat al - Sayyad Jazirat al - Sayyad , or the Hunter , was an elongated island located in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Geography . Jazirat al - Sayyad had extremely rocky shores , marking it as dangerous sailing territory for mariners . Stormy swells and whirling waters threatened to shatter any approaching ship against the rocks . Inhabitants . This island was the home of the magnificent Sayyad bloodline of horses , making it a tempting destination for brave or greedy sailors . The herds were carefully watched over by Herdsman genie s who were bound long ago by a powerful sha ' ir . Buying a horse from the genie s often required an extraordinary payment and only buyers possessing admirable qualities were considered .

title: Jazirian
description: Jazirian Jazirian is the couatl deity of community , peace , learning , and parenthood . The couatls believe Jazirian to be the embodiment of supreme purpose and fate , the invisible force that moves the strings upon which all other gods move . They think themselves uniquely fortunate to be able to apprehend Jazirian where other races cannot , and give humble thanks for this gift .
description_long: Jazirian Jazirian is the couatl deity of community , peace , learning , and parenthood . The couatls believe Jazirian to be the embodiment of supreme purpose and fate , the invisible force that moves the strings upon which all other gods move . They think themselves uniquely fortunate to be able to apprehend Jazirian where other races cannot , and give humble thanks for this gift . They are driven by this sense to help improve the lot of others . Jazirian ' s symbol is a couatl with its tail in its mouth . Description . Jazirian manifests as a vast , rainbow - colored couatl simultaneously winding through the air and forming a circle with his / her tail in his / her mouth . Couatl s see Jazirian as hermaphroditic and sexless at once , though nagas see Jazirian as male . Jazirian is a wise and contemplative being . Relationships . Couatls believe Jazirian is a perfected manifestation of the World Serpent archetype ; other serpent gods , such as Io , Merrshaulk , and Shekinester ( and perhaps Beltar ) are less perfect or immature manifestations of the same greater concept . Even the toad - god Ramenos is considered to be an ( extremely corrupted ) aspect of the World Serpent .

title: Jazzomyn Gheldieg
description: Jazzomyn Gheldieg Jazzomyn Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and head of the Eshpurta Gheldiegs , which gave her a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was the niece of Curkon Gheldieg ( a former Namarch of the Council of Six ) and the cousin of Lady Vyma ( Gheldieg ) Tanislove , both of Athkatla .
description_long: Jazzomyn Gheldieg Jazzomyn Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and head of the Eshpurta Gheldiegs , which gave her a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was the niece of Curkon Gheldieg ( a former Namarch of the Council of Six ) and the cousin of Lady Vyma ( Gheldieg ) Tanislove , both of Athkatla . Her ambition was to get her family to increase their share of the art and collectables market .

title: Jazzt Dyrr
description: Jazzt Dyrr Jazzt Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . Description . Jazzt was small and scarred .
description_long: Jazzt Dyrr Jazzt Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . Description . Jazzt was small and scarred . History . Jazzt was the second cousin of Matron Mother Yasraena Dyrr . During the Silence of Lolth , when the duergar and tanarukk armies marched against Menzoberranzan , he was ordered by his matron mother to escort the disguised Nimor Imphraezl to Rhazzt ' s Dilemma .

title: Jearth Xorlarrin
description: Jearth Xorlarrin Jearth Xorlarrin was the weaponsmaster of House Xorlarrin . He was one of the most powerful weaponsmasters in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History .
description_long: Jearth Xorlarrin Jearth Xorlarrin was the weaponsmaster of House Xorlarrin . He was one of the most powerful weaponsmasters in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History . Jearth accompanied the expedition led by Ravel Xorlarrin to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . Relationships . Ravel considered Jearth his closest ally .

title: Jed
description: Jed Jed , also known as Old Jed , was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The aged fisherman was of normal build and dressed in a yellow tunic and dark breeches .
description_long: Jed Jed , also known as Old Jed , was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The aged fisherman was of normal build and dressed in a yellow tunic and dark breeches . Personality . Over the years , Old Jed became a alcoholic who needed wine in order to fish the banks of Lac Dinneshere . The owner of the Winter ' s Cradle Tavern , Grisella refused to sell liqueur to Jed because he kept falling out of his boat while fishing . Relationships . While being a drunkard , Old Jed had a kind soul and believed those who were kind to him belonged in the Eternal Brotherhood o ' Fishermen . History . Around 1279 DR , Pomab Ak ' azmjir , owner of Pomab ' s Emporium , refused to sell Jed any more wine , so the angry fisherman tossed the Calishite into Lac Dinneshere . In Eleasis , 1281 DR , Old Jed fell out of his own fishing boat and nearly drown in the freezing waters of Lac Dinneshere until some townsfolk pulled his ashore . By Eleint of that same year , Old Jed was still barred from buying liquor from Pomab .

title: Jedea
description: Jedea House Jedea was the royal family of the city - state of Mordulkin in Chessenta . The city was a family enclave and traditionally the most powerful mage of the family became king or queen . History .
description_long: Jedea House Jedea was the royal family of the city - state of Mordulkin in Chessenta . The city was a family enclave and traditionally the most powerful mage of the family became king or queen . History . The Jedea family had ruled the city since the rebellion against the Unther ic empire in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . The first ruler of the liberated city was Soldim Jedea , who also founded the Jedea Academy . In the Year of the Twelverule , 1117 DR , Mordulkin defied the king of Cimbar . This act led to the break - up of the Union of Chessenta into a number of feuding city - states , The Jedean kings of Mordulkin claimed the title " Overlord of Chessenta " , a title they happened to share with the rulers of Akanax and Cimbar . In the mid - to late 14th century DR , King Hercubes Jedea ruled Mordulkin and steered the city through that tumultuous age . In the Year of the Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , the red dragon king Tchazzar of Cimbar had returned and was working to bring the other city - states into his fold , through covert negotiations and threats ; Mordulkin was likely among those discreetly negotiating its re - admittance to the empire .

title: Jedea Academy
description: Jedea Academy The Jedea Academy was a school for magic located in the residential district of city of Mordulkin in Chessenta . Description . The Jedea Academy was a two - story complex , built of white stone that shone brilliant in the sun , but was otherwise austere and unornamented .
description_long: Jedea Academy The Jedea Academy was a school for magic located in the residential district of city of Mordulkin in Chessenta . Description . The Jedea Academy was a two - story complex , built of white stone that shone brilliant in the sun , but was otherwise austere and unornamented . At each of the four corners stood four square towers . The sloping roof was tiled in slate , gray as twilight . The entrance was an ornate oaken door . Inside was a well - stocked library and carpeted floors . There were also corridors leading to a number of offices and other rooms , with metal stairways to the next floor . The grounds of the Jedea Academy were tidy green lawns , with a white granite path leading from the street to the entrance . The school was extensive , although it was not as big as the college of mages in Cimbar . History . The school was founded by Soldim Jedea , the first ruler of the city after its revolt against the Unther ic empire in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . It would become the oldest school for magic in the city . Over its centuries of operation , the Jedea Academy produced many capable wizards loyal to Mordulkin , boosting its arcane resources .

title: Jeff Easley
description: Jeff Easley Jeff Easley is a fantasy artist who was born in Nicholasville , Kentucky and studied at Murray State University , graduating in 1976 . He was hired by TSR , Inc . in 1982 and did much of the artwork during the 1980s .
description_long: Jeff Easley Jeff Easley is a fantasy artist who was born in Nicholasville , Kentucky and studied at Murray State University , graduating in 1976 . He was hired by TSR , Inc . in 1982 and did much of the artwork during the 1980s . Some of his notable works include the cover art of the 1st and 2nd edition " Player ' s Handbook " , 1st and 2nd edition " Dungeon Master ' s Guide " and the " Monstrous Manual " .

title: Jeff Grubb
description: Jeff Grubb Jeff Grubb is the author of several Forgotten Realms novels with his wife Kate Novak . Among these are The Finder ' s Stone trilogy which features the popular character Alias . Works .
description_long: Jeff Grubb Jeff Grubb is the author of several Forgotten Realms novels with his wife Kate Novak . Among these are The Finder ' s Stone trilogy which features the popular character Alias . Works . Novels . All of the following books were co - authored with Kate Novak .

title: Jeggred Baenre
description: Jeggred Baenre Jeggred Baenre was a draegloth - - the offspring of a drow and a demon - - and the son of Matron Mother Triel Baenre . He followed her every command , and served as her personal bodyguard . He was viewed by the drow as a sign of Lolth ' s favor upon Triel .
description_long: Jeggred Baenre Jeggred Baenre was a draegloth - - the offspring of a drow and a demon - - and the son of Matron Mother Triel Baenre . He followed her every command , and served as her personal bodyguard . He was viewed by the drow as a sign of Lolth ' s favor upon Triel . Description . Jeggred was 8 ' 1 " ( 2 . 46 m ) tall and had goat legs . and his eyes were blood red . He had a beastlike face that looked like a drow , and silver hair covering his chest , shoulders , and loins . He had four arms : The upper arms ended in long , sharp claws ; the lower were humanoid hands . He had yellowed fangs , as well as rows of teeth as sharp as needles . He had particularly foul breath . Jeggred did not perform Reverie ; he slept . Personality . Jeggred was not known for his intelligence , though he was far from stupid as Jeggred delighted in bloodshed and had a coldly murderous mind that found glee in malice . However , he was extremely loyal - - as long as his mistress was a powerful priestess . If she weakened , he would defer to the next most powerful female . History . Born in 1362 DR to Triel Baenre , Jeggred quickly grew to maturity due to his Draegloth heritage .

title: Jehokim
description: Jehokim Jehokim was a businessman in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Jehokim was an adventurer in his youth but after finding a great treasure he retired and opened several inns across Unther .
description_long: Jehokim Jehokim was a businessman in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Jehokim was an adventurer in his youth but after finding a great treasure he retired and opened several inns across Unther . In time , there was a Grey Chimera inn in each major city of Unther and Mulhorand . The rebellion in 1357 DR was a threat to his business and he agreed to cooperate with the clergy of Gilgeam to end it , even telling the priests of known traitors .

title: Jekk Ironfist
description: Jekk Ironfist Jekk Ironfist was a shield dwarf acquaintance of Sir Isteval in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Jekk was born to Kellack Ironfist , a slave - gladiator in the Hillsfar arenas , and in time he followed in his father ' s stead .
description_long: Jekk Ironfist Jekk Ironfist was a shield dwarf acquaintance of Sir Isteval in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Jekk was born to Kellack Ironfist , a slave - gladiator in the Hillsfar arenas , and in time he followed in his father ' s stead . He was saved from the arena by Isteval and the Company of the Sunlit Sea but it was too late for Kellack . Freed , Jekk joined the Company until it later disbanded . Alone for a while , Jekk reflected on his dwarven ancestry , discovering that Ironfist was the name of a true dwarven clan , not just a moniker . So he went to Daggerford , where his clan ' s ancestral home was situated . In 1485 DR , in the dwarven fortress of Firehammer Hold , Jekk was captured by some duergar in service to the Red Wizards of Thay but some adventurers recruited by Isteval casually saved him . In 1486 DR , he was ready to get some payback on the Red Wizards still in Daggerford .

title: Jelde Asturian
description: Jelde Asturian Jelde Asturian was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jelde was born as Semoor Wolftooth in Espar village .
description_long: Jelde Asturian Jelde Asturian was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jelde was born as Semoor Wolftooth in Espar village . He went to search of fortune with Florin Falconhand , Doust Sulwood , and Islif Lurelake .
