During their adventures , he found his vocation as a cleric of Lathander and in order to follow the god ' s dogma , he renamed himself " Jelde Asturian " . Later , he served as seneschal of the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale and fought against drow , Zhentarim , and Lashan Aumersair . After this last adventure , Jelde retired to Eveningstar to serve his god .

title: Jelvus Grinch
description: Jelvus Grinch Jelvus Grinch was a merchant from Neverwinter . History . He was selling his goods in Waterdeep when Mount Hotenow exploded in 1451 DR , destroying his native city .
description_long: Jelvus Grinch Jelvus Grinch was a merchant from Neverwinter . History . He was selling his goods in Waterdeep when Mount Hotenow exploded in 1451 DR , destroying his native city . He returned immediately , putting both his gold and his muscles to work helping to save the city in those chaotic early days . He was recognized among the survivors as a leader , and referred to by many as the " First Citizen of Neverwinter . " In later years , Jelvus worked with the Shadovar representative Herzgo Alegni in the rebuilding of the town . Herzgo also nominated him captain of the White Guard , the Neverwinter city guard organized by the Shadovar . When Dagult Neverember arrived to rebuild the city , he recognized Jelvus as an important person to bring over to his side . Neverember recognized Jelvus ' s leadership and accomplishments by making him New Neverwinter ' s sheriff , reporting to General Sabine .

title: Jenila
description: Jenila Jenila was a noble marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Jenila spent a good deal of time within the White Agate ' s Tower , associating with the White Agate and helping him guard his possessions .
description_long: Jenila Jenila was a noble marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Jenila spent a good deal of time within the White Agate ' s Tower , associating with the White Agate and helping him guard his possessions . Relationships . She enjoyed spending time with the White Agate because she believed him to be one of the few humans who approached her level of intelligence . They were close friends because of this . Rumors and Legends . It was widely rumored among the students of the tower that the White Agate and Jenila were lovers .

title: Jensena
description: Jensena Jensena was a strong female soldier who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Jensena was tall , attractive , and had powerful muscles .
description_long: Jensena Jensena was a strong female soldier who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Jensena was tall , attractive , and had powerful muscles . Personality . Bawdy and tough , Jensena was straight forward and could tangle with any man . Possessions . Like her friends , Salen and Gwen , Jensena fought with a sword , a few dagger s , a throwing axe , and wore chain mail . History . On the 19th of Flamerule , 1340 DR , Jensena challenged Ren o ' the Blade to a contest of strength , but loss to Ren ' s sly actions . Nine days later , Jensena lost her companions in a battle with a raging troll outside the city walls and was saved by Ren .

title: Jeny Greenteeth
description: Jeny Greenteeth Jeny Greenteeth was a green hag in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeny was a personification of malice and hate .
description_long: Jeny Greenteeth Jeny Greenteeth was a green hag in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeny was a personification of malice and hate . She hated humanity with all her being and acted to made human lives miserable . Jeny was however also a great actress , acting like a sweet and loving grandmother . History . Jeny lived in the Quivering forest for a long time . She was responsible of the pact between dark fey and Cvaal Daoran that saved Phlan from the shadovar s ' ire in 1380 DR . She also had some arguments with Lord Protector Talaric Daoran when he sent some men to chop down some trees . When Halvin Graingle went to make a new bargain , the negotiations did not go well and she killed him . Enraged by the intermission and believing the pact totally broken , Jeny ambushed five other villagers who went to search for Halvin . She killed two of them , captured two others , and sent Rerk back with horrible injuries after torturing him . After Jeny was confronted by an adventuring party hired to find the missing people , she was at last was defeated in a fight .

title: Jeordros
description: Jeordros Jeordros was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Jeordros ruled over the largest territory .
description_long: Jeordros Jeordros was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Jeordros ruled over the largest territory . In his territory ' s restricted areas , human s were instantly sent to the slave market . Personality . Jeordros dreamed of one day challenging Hoxitl . He was fanatical about clearing out the ruins in the hopes of gaining control of the sacred square of Azatl .

title: Jeorug Khalaga
description: Jeorug Khalaga Jeorug Khalaga was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Jeorug was born to a family that had provided eighteen consecutive generations of lama s .
description_long: Jeorug Khalaga Jeorug Khalaga was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Jeorug was born to a family that had provided eighteen consecutive generations of lama s . He was very able in the choir horal , a kind of religious debate where lamas challenged each other . By 1357 DR , the rulers of Li - Raz had recently started to no longer tolerate the lamas and Jeorug reinvented himself as a guide , thanks to his encyclopedic knowledge about the Plains .

title: Jera al - Farif
description: Jera al - Farif Jera al - Farif was the owner of Sculptures for the Elite within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Jera was one of the most skilled sculpturers in all of Huzuz .
description_long: Jera al - Farif Jera al - Farif was the owner of Sculptures for the Elite within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Jera was one of the most skilled sculpturers in all of Huzuz . Obsidian and marble were his materials of choice , though he used gems to enhances his projects . If Jera was not completely satisfied with his work at any point during its construction , he would smash the object to bits and begin again . He charged 500 dinar s for a life - sized sculpture , and 100 for smaller ones . His piece depicting the Grand Caliph even adorned the Palace of the Enlightened Throne . He outright refused to take an order for a piece depicting any kind of genie . Rumors and Legends . Unbeknownst to the population of Huzuz , Jera was actually a markeen masquerading as a Zakharan . It was unknown what happened to the original Jera .

title: Jeradeem
description: Jeradeem Jeradeem was a wealthy merchant from Durpar during the 11th century DR . History . Since he was the most successful merchant throughout Durpar , Jeradeem was selected by the Council of Merchants to travel to Estagund with the task of settling a dispute with that nation so that trade would no longer get interrupted .
description_long: Jeradeem Jeradeem was a wealthy merchant from Durpar during the 11th century DR . History . Since he was the most successful merchant throughout Durpar , Jeradeem was selected by the Council of Merchants to travel to Estagund with the task of settling a dispute with that nation so that trade would no longer get interrupted . Estagund was vunerable at that time , having recently been violently repelled after a failed invasion attempt into Dambrath . In retaliation , the crinti slew most of the abled - bodied men of Estagund . Famine was prevalent throughout the country , putting added pressure on their king to find a solution quickly . After days of arguing the advantages of the Durparian way of life , Jeradeem was able to " buy " the country of Estagund from its king and nobles for 24 precious gems . In exchange , Estagund was promised Durpar ' s protection and resources in introducing them to the way of life in the Shining Lands .

title: Jeralla
description: Jeralla Jeralla was a dragonborn sorcerer of red dragon ancestry who was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeralla believed herself to be a Chosen of Tiamat but this was a false claim .
description_long: Jeralla Jeralla was a dragonborn sorcerer of red dragon ancestry who was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeralla believed herself to be a Chosen of Tiamat but this was a false claim . She intended to gather treasures to fund the Hoard of the Dragon Queen . History . In Thar , Jeralla gathered an army of kobold followers of Tiamat and formed the Claws of Tiamat bandit group . Jeralla led the Claws into the Moonsea to raid caravans . She drew the attention of many others . The Cult of the Dragon sent a spy , Sharrak , to infiltrate the group , which they considered heretical . The Gray Patriots bandit group offered an alliance . Some merchants hired an adventuring party to clear the Iron Route of all the outlaws . Jeralla agreed to meet the Gray Patriots , but the meeting place was attacked both by the adventurers and a cultist war band . In the fighting , Jeralla was killed .

title: Jerbollah
description: Jerbollah Jerbollah was a dwarven cleric of Moradin in Mithral Hall . Personality . Bruenor Battlehammer awarded Jerbollah a seven out of ten for his brewing of mead dwarven holy water .
description_long: Jerbollah Jerbollah was a dwarven cleric of Moradin in Mithral Hall . Personality . Bruenor Battlehammer awarded Jerbollah a seven out of ten for his brewing of mead dwarven holy water . While Jerbollah was strong in magic , many of the other clerics of Mithral Hall poked fun at him and enjoyed slapping him on the back of this head . History . In 1358 DR , King Bruenor held trials to replace the deceased Cobble as Holy Cleric of the Hall . With the coming of the Time of Troubles , Jerbollah turned his face red instead of casting a red light spell .

title: Jeremi Laski
description: Jeremi Laski Jeremi Laski was a wine and spirits vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jeremi was a large man , standing 6 and a half feet tall .
description_long: Jeremi Laski Jeremi Laski was a wine and spirits vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jeremi was a large man , standing 6 and a half feet tall . Personality . Jeremi never carried a weapon because he could talk his way out of nearly any situation . He enjoyed proposing drinking contests in which he was unbeatable . Activities . Jeremi owned a few stalls in the Grand Bazaar and a small storage facility in the Warehouse District of Huzuz . His main shop , however , was located in the Court District . His vineyards were located south of the city proper . His wines and brandies were popular among the wealthy of Huzuz . Much of this was due to Jeremi ' s dealings with winemaker genie s . Jeremi excelled at making Heart of Wine .

title: Jergal
description: Jergal Jergal ( pronounced " JER - gull " ) , also referred to as The Lord of the End of Everything , is the seneschal of the Lord of the Dead who keeps records on the final disposition of all the spirits of the dead . Jergal is unfeeling and excessively formal , he never angers and always speaks in a disembodied , chilling voice . He cares little for anything besides an orderly accounting of the fate of the world as it slowly sinks into death , and he now serves Kelemvor as he previously served Cyric and Myrkul before him .
description_long: Jergal Jergal ( pronounced " JER - gull " ) , also referred to as The Lord of the End of Everything , is the seneschal of the Lord of the Dead who keeps records on the final disposition of all the spirits of the dead . Jergal is unfeeling and excessively formal , he never angers and always speaks in a disembodied , chilling voice . He cares little for anything besides an orderly accounting of the fate of the world as it slowly sinks into death , and he now serves Kelemvor as he previously served Cyric and Myrkul before him . In ethos , Jergal is colder and more inhumane than his master , sanctioning the use and creation of undead by his followers , provided they serve the cause of advancing death in the world . He is not evil or malicious , but impassively records the death of all things . Worshipers . Church . The church of Jergal is small and secretive , a rigidly organized , almost monastic order of scribes known as the Scriveners of Doom .

title: Jeriah Chronos
description: Jeriah Chronos Jeriah Chronos was born in - 2207 DR in Netheril . He was known to the Netherese as Chronomancer after creating his first time - oriented spell in - 2158 DR . He was a haughty and determined young man who was constantly concerned about appearances .
description_long: Jeriah Chronos Jeriah Chronos was born in - 2207 DR in Netheril . He was known to the Netherese as Chronomancer after creating his first time - oriented spell in - 2158 DR . He was a haughty and determined young man who was constantly concerned about appearances . A running joke around the arcanists was that if he ever made a mistake in public , he ' s simply go back in time and correct it . Since time travel didn ' t work like this - a fact known by the other arcanists - such joke merely served to make the spellcaster even more self - conscious . His concern about appearance made him always looking for " potions of longevity " and other aging remedies . Like many archwizards , he considered aging to be a " curse placed on the Netherese by the gods that served to prevent arcanists from discovering the source of the gods ' power and usurping them . " Despite his haughty attitude toward the gods , he did care enough for the nation of Illusk to give his life to the cause . Standing nearly alone before a massive orc assault , Chronos was grievously injured and died eight years later . Had he accepted healing from the gods , he probably would have lived .

title: Jerlys Horlbar
description: Jerlys Horlbar Jerlys Horlbar was the drow matron mother of House Horlbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Jerlys was a beautiful female elf with smooth long legs and she would use her feminine wiles to seduce and manipulate her victims .
description_long: Jerlys Horlbar Jerlys Horlbar was the drow matron mother of House Horlbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Jerlys was a beautiful female elf with smooth long legs and she would use her feminine wiles to seduce and manipulate her victims . Possessions . As a priestess of Lolth , Jerlys fought with an 8 ft ( 2 . 4 m ) red three tentacle rod , which she could use with deadly force . Like many drow , she wore drow chainmail . History . House Horlbar was the twelfth ruling house in Menzoberranzan , and Jerlys Horlbar was one of two high priestesses of Lolth , the Spider Queen . In 1357 DR , Artemis Entreri encountered Jerlys in the back alleyways of the drow city while he was appearing as a member of Bregan D ' aerthe . He didn ' t want to kill Jerlys , who was a cleric of Lolth , but he had to defend himself . Later , Jarlaxle found out and used this information to strengthen his hold over Artemis within the Bregan D ' aerthe .

title: Jermander
description: Jermander Jermander was a tiefling swordsman and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Jermander was a swordsman and the leader of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden .
description_long: Jermander Jermander was a tiefling swordsman and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Jermander was a swordsman and the leader of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden . However , in the the first skirmish against the pair of elves , Jermander and most of his squad were killed by Dahlia and Drizzt . Jermander perished in single combat against Artemis Entreri , who came to Dahlia ' s rescue at the last second .

title: Jerold Keegan
description: Jerold Keegan Sir Jerold Keegan was a paladin of Selûne , a dragonslayer , and a knight of Cormyr in 236 DR . History . Sir Keegan was a renowned dragonslayer .
description_long: Jerold Keegan Sir Jerold Keegan was a paladin of Selûne , a dragonslayer , and a knight of Cormyr in 236 DR . History . Sir Keegan was a renowned dragonslayer . He was knighted by King Tharyann Obarskyr himself , who gave him the magic sword Aecris . When the shadow dragon Shadraxil began to attack Cormyrian frontier outposts , it was Sir Keegan ' s duty to stop the dragon . He led a small force of armed men and War Wizard s and created a magical trap within one of the keeps in order to ensnare Shadraxil and bind him in the Plane of Shadow . Afterwards , Sir Keegan became the lord of that outpost , charged to keep Shadraxil sealed in the Shadow Rift . The keep was consecrated to the goddess Selûne and renamed Keegan ' s Keep . The town of Winterhaven was founded nearby , likely for the keep ' s protection . It was said that some time after Shadraxil ' s banishment , Keegan became a crazed madman and slew all of his family and friends , cursing the keep forever . All of this was in fact due to Shadraxil , still locked away in the Plane of Shadow but nonetheless able to exert his dark power over Keegan ' s mind .

title: Jerrod
description: Jerrod Jerrod was a barbarian shaman who fought against the archmage Arakon and united the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes after the battle . History . The wizard Arakon attacked Icewind Dale with a army of mercenaries .
description_long: Jerrod Jerrod was a barbarian shaman who fought against the archmage Arakon and united the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes after the battle . History . The wizard Arakon attacked Icewind Dale with a army of mercenaries . Banding together the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes fought back until the archmage opened a gate to the Lower planes . Death . After seeing a vision of Tempos , Jerrod sacrificed himself by leaping into the portal to Baator and creating Jerrod ' s stone which sealed the passageway .

title: Jerrod ' s stone
description: Jerrod ' s stone Jerrod ' s stone was a stone disc created by the barbarian shaman Jerrod when he sacrificed himself to seal a gate to the Lower Planes . History . When the forces of the archmage Arakon attacked Icewind Dale , the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes banded together to defeat the common foe .
description_long: Jerrod ' s stone Jerrod ' s stone was a stone disc created by the barbarian shaman Jerrod when he sacrificed himself to seal a gate to the Lower Planes . History . When the forces of the archmage Arakon attacked Icewind Dale , the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes banded together to defeat the common foe . On the brink of victory , Arakon opened a portal to Baator . To save the inhabitants of Faerûn , Jerrod leaped into the passageway and stopped the demon horde . Around 1281 DR , Everard of Easthaven , devotee of Tempus , saved Toril from the baatezu Belhifet by using his body to close the portal to the plane s .

title: Jesper
description: Jesper Jesper was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Jespers contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .
description_long: Jesper Jesper was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Jespers contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Jess Lebow
description: Jess Lebow Jess Lebow ( pen name T . H . Lain ) is a fantasy author and storyteller who has written Forgotten Realms novels including " Master of Chains " from The Fighters series and " Obsidian Ridge " from The Citadels series .
description_long: Jess Lebow Jess Lebow ( pen name T . H . Lain ) is a fantasy author and storyteller who has written Forgotten Realms novels including " Master of Chains " from The Fighters series and " Obsidian Ridge " from The Citadels series . He has also written other novels and short stories for Wizards of the Coast . He was World Designer and writer for massively multiplayer game " " and is currently the Lead Writer and Content Designer for massively multiplayer game " " . Background . Jess began writing in the third grade and his first piece of published writing was a poem entitled " Lindsey has Community Hair " . He wrote a literary magazine called " Demos " . It was around this time that he discovered " " which later led to a job as editor for " Magic : The Gathering " novels for Wizards of the Coast . He graduated from with a degree in creative writing .

title: Jesse Decker
description: Jesse Decker Jesse Decker is a game designer who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . He also served as editorial assistant for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines and later chief editor for " Dragon " . He was one of the main developers for the fourth edition of Dungeons & Dragons .
description_long: Jesse Decker Jesse Decker is a game designer who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . He also served as editorial assistant for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines and later chief editor for " Dragon " . He was one of the main developers for the fourth edition of Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Jesse Hearthe
description: Jesse Hearthe Jesse Hearthe was a mage who lived in Vanesci Hamlet in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Jesse Hearthe was a popular mage who commanded great political influence at all levels in the Utter East . Although she had retired to Vanesci Hamlet for a number of years , she still manipulated matters behind the scenes .
description_long: Jesse Hearthe Jesse Hearthe was a mage who lived in Vanesci Hamlet in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Jesse Hearthe was a popular mage who commanded great political influence at all levels in the Utter East . Although she had retired to Vanesci Hamlet for a number of years , she still manipulated matters behind the scenes . She denounced the Legendary Campaign , which aimed to unify the war - torn Utter East through conquest . To defend their honor , the commander of the campaign faced Hearthe in a bloodforge battle .

title: Jester ' s Green
description: Jester ' s Green Jester ' s Green ( formerly Soldier ' s Green ) is a piece of land northwest of Suzail , Cormyr . It had originally been a settlement in the time before Cormyr existed , but it was wiped out by goblin s . It is used to drill the palace guards and marshal the militia .
description_long: Jester ' s Green Jester ' s Green ( formerly Soldier ' s Green ) is a piece of land northwest of Suzail , Cormyr . It had originally been a settlement in the time before Cormyr existed , but it was wiped out by goblin s . It is used to drill the palace guards and marshal the militia . Keolan Dracohorn claimed to have slain a blue dragon at this site , gaining the family name , but he had found a dead young dragon and falsely laid claim to the kill . Gantharla Obarskyr stationed her foresters here during her return to Suzail in 245 DR when she took the throne .

title: Jestra
description: Jestra Jestra was a human woman of Arabel in Cormyr and an independent wizard specializing in the transmutation school of magic . Around 1369 DR , she resided in Arabel , Cormyr , owned properties in Arabel and utilized her magic to increase the attractiveness of her clients as well as to improve various objects brought to her by enhancing the object ' s appearance and usefulness .
description_long: Jestra Jestra was a human woman of Arabel in Cormyr and an independent wizard specializing in the transmutation school of magic . Around 1369 DR , she resided in Arabel , Cormyr , owned properties in Arabel and utilized her magic to increase the attractiveness of her clients as well as to improve various objects brought to her by enhancing the object ' s appearance and usefulness .

title: Jestry Rallevin
description: Jestry Rallevin Jestry was a skilled zealot of Asmodeus in the service of Sylora Salm . He was in his twenties when he was turned to Lady Sylora´s closes advisor and laiter her champion . He has large shoulders , dark hair and brooding dark eyes .
description_long: Jestry Rallevin Jestry was a skilled zealot of Asmodeus in the service of Sylora Salm . He was in his twenties when he was turned to Lady Sylora´s closes advisor and laiter her champion . He has large shoulders , dark hair and brooding dark eyes . Little is know about Jestry ' s past but what is know is that he once lived near a lake with his twin sisters and his mother and father the later of which was a fisherman . How Jestry came to become a follower of Asmodeus or so adept at combat is a unknown , but he is fearless in combat and always eager for a battle just like the rest of the zealots of Asmodeus . After his battle prowess is reveled to Sylora after the battle of Gauntlgrym he was elevated to fill in as her champion after the desertion of Dahlia Sin ' felle . As her champion he was secretly in love with her and wanted her but she denied him love stating the " Truth that they know , that which makes them strong " : " There is no love , only lust . " Then his mistress forced him to deny his love for her and claim that he only want to posses her . Transformation .

title: Jet
description: Jet Jet was a variant of bituminous coal that could be cut into fancy stones . Description . Jet was a deep black gemstone that was hard enough to take facets and was often used in simple pendants or as part of a larger setting .
description_long: Jet Jet was a variant of bituminous coal that could be cut into fancy stones . Description . Jet was a deep black gemstone that was hard enough to take facets and was often used in simple pendants or as part of a larger setting . In the wealthy commercial centers of Amn , Calimshan , and Sembia , jet was worn to represent sorrow and mourning . This custom was also practiced in Waterdeep and Westgate . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . Jet was the material of choice for " magic jar s " and could be made to release the captive life force within by means of certain treatments , or accidentally trigger the release by casting specific spells in close proximity to the " magic jar " . If this were to happen , a person or creature near the " magic jar " would have their life essence sucked into the " jar " and the captive entity would be released to inhabit their body . Being in possession of a " magic jar " rarely gave any control or influence over the entity stored within . Legends and Rumors .

title: Jewel Box
description: Jewel Box The Jewel Box was a drow tavern in Menzoberranzan . Geography . The building was located just outside the accepted border of the main marketplace , the Bazaar ( so as not to be subject to the rules that require its places of business to move at least once every 66 years ) , and was owned and run by Nym , an old retired battle wizard with only one leg .
description_long: Jewel Box The Jewel Box was a drow tavern in Menzoberranzan . Geography . The building was located just outside the accepted border of the main marketplace , the Bazaar ( so as not to be subject to the rules that require its places of business to move at least once every 66 years ) , and was owned and run by Nym , an old retired battle wizard with only one leg . Structure . Despite having no signboards or external advertisements , the Jewel Box still managed to attract a steady stream of shoppers and merchants . The main room of the tavern had a low roof and featured sweet and slightly intoxicating smells . Patronage . The Jewel Box ' s principal customers were traders and merchants from the Bazaar , but it was also a favorite spot for disreputable males , particularly of the lower houses . Females very rarely made an appearance there , largely due to the higher status they possessed in the matriarchal city . The Jewel Box never turned away potential customers , however , and all were welcome ( provided they had wealth to spend ) . Entertainment .

title: Jewelfish
description: Jewelfish Jewelfish were a tiny , silvery fish found in the oceans and rivers of Faerûn . Ecology . Jewelfish were inedible by humanoid s .
description_long: Jewelfish Jewelfish were a tiny , silvery fish found in the oceans and rivers of Faerûn . Ecology . Jewelfish were inedible by humanoid s . They were susceptible to changes in weather ; if it became too warm , they would die in large groups . History . It was once fashionable to dye jewelfish various colors . The practice died out , but details of it could be found in old books in Waterdeep , Neverwinter , Memnon , and Esmeltaran .

title: Jezgar Skentzin
description: Jezgar Skentzin Jezgar Skentzin was a seawolf pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . Activities . Jezgar was an audacious pirate with a very bloody approach .
description_long: Jezgar Skentzin Jezgar Skentzin was a seawolf pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . Activities . Jezgar was an audacious pirate with a very bloody approach . His raids were well known for the high death toll both among his victims and his own crew . In time , only the most bloodthirsty pirates joined his crew . However , Jezgar had a secret : one day , he had saved a shipwreck victim who turned out to be a seawolf . Jezgar killed him but not before he infected Jezgar and his crew . From that day on , they were seawolf pirates . However , they hid their secret very well and nobody realized that they now sought blood rather than booty . During day , Jezgar and his men visited pirate harbors but always sailed out before night .

title: Jezz the Lame
description: Jezz the Lame Jezz the Lame was one of the leaders of the Vhaeraun - worshipping House Jaelre , commanding the drow of his house who warred with the elves of Myth Drannor . Description . Jezz had smooth , black skin and pale white hair .
description_long: Jezz the Lame Jezz the Lame was one of the leaders of the Vhaeraun - worshipping House Jaelre , commanding the drow of his house who warred with the elves of Myth Drannor . Description . Jezz had smooth , black skin and pale white hair . He was slightly shorter and slimmer than a human . He wore supple black leather armor and carried an exotic - looking kukri . He also wore a green asp around his arm . His right leg was lame and held in a leather and iron brace / harness , which he limped around in , giving him the nickname " Jezz the Lame . " Personality . Given his charisma and the respect his followers give him , if House Jaelre gained a foothold in Cormanthor , Jezz was to be presented as a speaker to the outside world . He was involved in dealing with the tenuous alliance with the Clan Auzkovyn as well . History . Jezz was once a scout for his tribe as they wandered the Underdark after leaving their home city of Menzoberranzan . At one point , he got into a fight with an umber hulk , which resulted in the cavern ceiling coming crashing down . Believing Jezz was slain , his company left .

title: Jhaam
description: Jhaam Jhaam was the warrior - king of an ancient human folk living around - 5800 DR . He led his people in a series of minor wars against neighbouring villages . Through this , he wanted to secure his realm from attack .
description_long: Jhaam Jhaam was the warrior - king of an ancient human folk living around - 5800 DR . He led his people in a series of minor wars against neighbouring villages . Through this , he wanted to secure his realm from attack . When he died , his successors established the capital city Naarkolyth and with it the realm Jhaamdath . It is known that Jhaam was also the greatest psionic warrior of his people and the founder of the Dath Dynasty .

title: Jhaamdath
description: Jhaamdath Jhaamdath was the first and only psiocracy in the history of the human nations of Toril . Made up of the Twelve Cities of the Sword - Naarkolyth ( the capital and First City ) , Porrenath , Jhouram , Gharrent , Golmuth , Lirremar , Tuoxent , Hollinth , Jhirrent , Inixrien , Corrant , and Mirrindith - this ancestor of present - day Chondath was founded circa – 5800 DR and destroyed in – 255 DR by elven high mages of Nikerymath . History .
description_long: Jhaamdath Jhaamdath was the first and only psiocracy in the history of the human nations of Toril . Made up of the Twelve Cities of the Sword - Naarkolyth ( the capital and First City ) , Porrenath , Jhouram , Gharrent , Golmuth , Lirremar , Tuoxent , Hollinth , Jhirrent , Inixrien , Corrant , and Mirrindith - this ancestor of present - day Chondath was founded circa – 5800 DR and destroyed in – 255 DR by elven high mages of Nikerymath . History . Around - 5800 DR , a tribe of human warriors established a small realm in the fertile lands between the forest of Nikerymath ( now the Chondalwood ) and the shores of the Inner Sea . Led by the warrior - king Jhaam , this tiny kingdom soon conquered the surrounding villages , not as an act of imperialistic expansion , but as a means to secure the realm from attack . Jhaam fell before this establishment was complete , but his heirs were successful in founding the country of Jhaamdath - so named for their famed progenitor - with the great city of Naarkolyth as its capital .

title: Jhaamdathan language
description: Jhaamdathan language Jhaamdathan was the language of the old Jhaamdath an Empire . Jhaamdathan was also known as " Old Chondathan " , and as this name suggests , it was the direct precursor of the Chondathan language . The original " Common " tongue , Thorass ( " Old Common " ) , came about as a mixture of Jhaamdathan and Alzhedo , and thus , Jhaamdathan was a progenitor of modern Common as well .
description_long: Jhaamdathan language Jhaamdathan was the language of the old Jhaamdath an Empire . Jhaamdathan was also known as " Old Chondathan " , and as this name suggests , it was the direct precursor of the Chondathan language . The original " Common " tongue , Thorass ( " Old Common " ) , came about as a mixture of Jhaamdathan and Alzhedo , and thus , Jhaamdathan was a progenitor of modern Common as well . Jhaamdathan ' s progenitors included Jotun , the language of giants .

title: Jhaartael Ealoeth
description: Jhaartael Ealoeth Jhaartael Ealoeth was a male fey ' ri fighter / sorcerer bladesinger , and one of the daemonfey around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , while posing as a moon elf from Evermeet , Jhaartael wandered the North in order to lure adventurers into the High Forest , where his fellow fey ' ri ambushed and killed them .
description_long: Jhaartael Ealoeth Jhaartael Ealoeth was a male fey ' ri fighter / sorcerer bladesinger , and one of the daemonfey around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , while posing as a moon elf from Evermeet , Jhaartael wandered the North in order to lure adventurers into the High Forest , where his fellow fey ' ri ambushed and killed them . In 1372 DR , he was in the daemonfey ' s hideout in the northern High Forest , under the command of Teryani Ealoeth .

title: Jhachalkhyn
description: Jhachalkhyn Jhachalkhyn was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . It wasn ' t very clear where exactly Jhachalkhyn lay but it was far in the south from Menzoberranzan but not as far from the City of Spiders as Maeralyn was , in fact it was so near that it was considered reasonable to assume that refugees from the city would flee to Menzoberranzan , once it was destroyed .
description_long: Jhachalkhyn Jhachalkhyn was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . It wasn ' t very clear where exactly Jhachalkhyn lay but it was far in the south from Menzoberranzan but not as far from the City of Spiders as Maeralyn was , in fact it was so near that it was considered reasonable to assume that refugees from the city would flee to Menzoberranzan , once it was destroyed . History . At some point around 1136 DR , Jhachalkhyn was infiltrated by the Jaezred Chaulssin , who posed as minor nobility . Some time around 1360 DR , Jhachalkhyn was destroyed by another drow city called Maeralyn . Its citizens were assumed to flee towards Menzoberranzan . Despite the destruction and defeat at an enemy ' s hand , Jhachalkhyn ' s political system and infrastructure proved to be rather resilient . It was still ruled by Lolth ' s matriarchy and had a functional merchant class . During the Silence of Lolth , Jhachalkhyn ' s matriarchy lost its spells . The loss of power was exploited by the Jaezred Chaulssin fosterage under Xorthaul Barriath in the form of a streak of assassinations .

title: Jhaele Silvermane
description: Jhaele Silvermane Jhaele Silvermane is the proprietor of The Old Skull Inn in Shadowdale . As of 1375 DR Jhaele ' s husband died decades ago , and her her eldest son , Durgo now performs most of the day to day administration of the Inn . Jhaele ' s other children , daughters Belestar and Raith and sons Purn and Braun , have left Shadowdale as adventurers and merchants .
description_long: Jhaele Silvermane Jhaele Silvermane is the proprietor of The Old Skull Inn in Shadowdale . As of 1375 DR Jhaele ' s husband died decades ago , and her her eldest son , Durgo now performs most of the day to day administration of the Inn . Jhaele ' s other children , daughters Belestar and Raith and sons Purn and Braun , have left Shadowdale as adventurers and merchants . Appearance . Jhaele once possesed a powerful physique , but has since fallen victim to the passage of years . Personality . Despite her age Jhaele has a sharp tongue and no - nonsense demeanor that are still just as strong as from her youth . She is also an unflappable , keen judge of character .

title: Jhalanessa Brithlar
description: Jhalanessa Brithlar Jhalanessa Brithlar was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . She had a bit of a wild spirit that led to mischievousness and deep , passionate feelings about many things .
description_long: Jhalanessa Brithlar Jhalanessa Brithlar was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . She had a bit of a wild spirit that led to mischievousness and deep , passionate feelings about many things . Abilities . Watchful Sister Jhalanessa was a horticulturist that specialized in herbalism for both humans and farm animals .

title: Jhamanthra Tsathree
description: Jhamanthra Tsathree Jhamanthra Tsathree was the proprietor of Tsathree ' s Comforts , a shop on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep . Activities . Sometime around the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Jhamanthra invented a new scented facial wash she named Waterfall Kiss and began selling it in her shop .
description_long: Jhamanthra Tsathree Jhamanthra Tsathree was the proprietor of Tsathree ' s Comforts , a shop on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep . Activities . Sometime around the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Jhamanthra invented a new scented facial wash she named Waterfall Kiss and began selling it in her shop . Unbeknownst to her ( she claimed ) , her secret formula caused skin to glow a bright green color hours after certain cosmetics were applied to the same area .

title: Jhandlatha Taskloath
description: Jhandlatha Taskloath Jhandlatha Taskloath is the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Peieyrie Taskaloath . History . Jhandlatha is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , The Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Jhandlatha Taskloath Jhandlatha Taskloath is the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Peieyrie Taskaloath . History . Jhandlatha is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , The Arcane Brotherhood . Jhandlatha inherited unknown magical items from her father . Personality . Jhandlatha is elderly and earthy . She and her sister love to hear tales of adventure and pranks . Jhandlatha will defend herself with " fireball s " and " lightning bolt s " if she must .

title: Jhaniloth Puiral
description: Jhaniloth Puiral Jhaniloth Puiral was a lich and member of the Twisted Rune . Before that , she was a wizardess of Silverymoon . Background .
description_long: Jhaniloth Puiral Jhaniloth Puiral was a lich and member of the Twisted Rune . Before that , she was a wizardess of Silverymoon . Background . Jhaniloth had a hatred for Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun after he foiled a number of her plots and exiled her from Silverymoon , Secomber and Waterdeep . She joined forces with fellow Twisted Rune member Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk in order to form a plot to take over the Undermountain in order to get back at Khelben . In 1330 DR , while in her lair , Jhaniloth was destroyed by Prince Rythan of Tethyr . Following her death , the Twisted Rune set up Mulsparkh and used its armies to kill Rythan in the Battle of Nightflames in 1334 DR .

title: Jhannas Errlyk
description: Jhannas Errlyk Jhannas Errlyk was a merchant of Amn and a disgraced member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jhannas was the head of a family mercantile business in Myratma and a member of the Shadow Thieves , smuggling poisons and other goods for the guild .
description_long: Jhannas Errlyk Jhannas Errlyk was a merchant of Amn and a disgraced member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jhannas was the head of a family mercantile business in Myratma and a member of the Shadow Thieves , smuggling poisons and other goods for the guild . However , in 1366 DR , the Buckleswashers , a company of halfling s acting as Jhannas ' s agents in Waterdeep , accused him of smuggling . The humiliation forced him to flee the city , abandoning many lucrative business deals and losing his chance to join the Knights . In time , however , Jhannas regained his status , becoming the second - in - command of the Guild of Fences , Pirates and Smugglers and approached the Knights again . In order to gain Inselm Hhune ' s favor , Jhannas also betrayed the Shadow Thieves , telling the Knights all he knew about the thieves ' business . Meanwhile , he plotted his revenge against Bungobar Talltankard , leader of the Buckleswashers .

title: Jhanos Yhliivast
description: Jhanos Yhliivast Lord Jhanos Yhliivast was a male human who , as of 1368 DR , was the head of the Yhliivast family and the most powerful man in Amnwater , Amn . He was the proprietor of The Gilded Spur inn and his lover ( and hostess at the inn ) was Krigar .
description_long: Jhanos Yhliivast Lord Jhanos Yhliivast was a male human who , as of 1368 DR , was the head of the Yhliivast family and the most powerful man in Amnwater , Amn . He was the proprietor of The Gilded Spur inn and his lover ( and hostess at the inn ) was Krigar .

title: Jhanra Merlistar
description: Jhanra Merlistar Jhanra Merlistar was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Jhanra was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Keryth Adofaer .
description_long: Jhanra Merlistar Jhanra Merlistar was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Jhanra was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Keryth Adofaer . Taranath placed three selu ' kiira upon their brows , sending the students into comas while the gems force - feed the knowledge of millennia into their brains . Jhanra and his fellow awaked only in tarskath 1 of 1369 DR in order to help in the Twelfth Serôs War . Jhanra and his fellow helped their masters in the war and in the great spell that sent Iakhovas to the Outer Planes . After Yrlimn and Taranath exhaust died and Keryth and Jhanra replaced them as new High Mages Activiities . Jhanra used most of her time helping the injured and displaced merfolk . She devoted herself to the project to teach them wizards ' magic , despite evidence that was an impossible task . Personality . Jhanra was a magical prodigy for her age . She felt perfectly comfortable with all the non - elven in the city .

title: Jhartos Illance
description: Jhartos Illance Jhartos Illance was a young nobleman who lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport . Relationships . Jhartos was the fourth son of the Illance noble family and the younger cousin of Mallik , third in line to his father ' s position .
description_long: Jhartos Illance Jhartos Illance was a young nobleman who lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport . Relationships . Jhartos was the fourth son of the Illance noble family and the younger cousin of Mallik , third in line to his father ' s position . He enjoyed the decadence of Calimport but did not have the business sense of his cousin .

title: Jharvex Krimmevol
description: Jharvex Krimmevol Jharvex Krimmevol was a human male and the head of the Krimmevol mercantile family in Eshpurta , and held a seat on the Shield Council from before the Year of the Lion ( 1340 DR ) to at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Lord Aernos Krimmevol of Crimmor was his nephew . Jharvex got rid of his youngest brother Cahorl and acquired his share of land by framing him for the murder of a young girl from the Zoar family .
description_long: Jharvex Krimmevol Jharvex Krimmevol was a human male and the head of the Krimmevol mercantile family in Eshpurta , and held a seat on the Shield Council from before the Year of the Lion ( 1340 DR ) to at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Lord Aernos Krimmevol of Crimmor was his nephew . Jharvex got rid of his youngest brother Cahorl and acquired his share of land by framing him for the murder of a young girl from the Zoar family .

title: Jhassalan
description: Jhassalan Jhassalan was an arcane devotee of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Jhassalan hailed from Silverymoon in Luruar but departed to become an adventurer .
description_long: Jhassalan Jhassalan was an arcane devotee of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Jhassalan hailed from Silverymoon in Luruar but departed to become an adventurer . With the Guild of the Just , a party of Tyrrans , he attacked the House of Pain , a temple of Loviatar in Undermountain , in order to free captives , but they were ambushed by the Loviatans . Jhassalan escaped only after the intervention of Muiral the Misshapen . From that time , he devoted himself fully to Tyr and led the spellcasting forces of the Hall of Justice in Waterdeep . Personality . Jhassalan retained his hatred for the local Church of Loviatar , hoping one day to uncover the source of their funds . His namesake derived from his predilection for electricity spells .

title: Jhasso
description: Jhasso Jhasso was a merchant from the city of Baldur ' s Gate in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . He originally owned Jhasso ' s Wagons , a fast - haul transport company . However , Jhasso partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster .
description_long: Jhasso Jhasso was a merchant from the city of Baldur ' s Gate in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . He originally owned Jhasso ' s Wagons , a fast - haul transport company . However , Jhasso partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves . Jhasso ' s own small merchant company was converted into a regional base for the coster . Jhasso and the Seven Suns were in business by 1358 DR , and still going by 1374 DR . Jhasso was based in Baldur ' s Gate , where he managed the Seven Suns ' regional base there .

title: Jhastar Belnold
description: Jhastar Belnold Jhastar Belnold was a ranger from Secomber and an active Harper . Description . Jhastar stood 6 ft 2 in ( 188 cm ) and weighed 211 lb ( 96 .
description_long: Jhastar Belnold Jhastar Belnold was a ranger from Secomber and an active Harper . Description . Jhastar stood 6 ft 2 in ( 188 cm ) and weighed 211 lb ( 96 . 4 kg ) and had brown hair and intense gray eyes . Personality . Jhastar Belnold tended to be stern and taciturn with a sense of humor hiding somewhere behind his grim facade . He was kind to people in need and merciless to evildoers and evil creatures . He drove away hunters who killed merely for sport and woodcutters that did not take care of the forests they harvested . Jhastar preferred the life of a loner , but would readily join forces with other Harpers , if they could find him . Abilities . He was proficient in the use of many weapons , including the longsword , spear , battleaxe , dagger , flail , and longbow . He could swim , ride a horse or other such mounts , determine direction easily , and even fight in limited visibility situations . As a ranger , he was also a superb tracker . He could also dance with considerable grace and could sing . Possessions . He wore " chain mail + 1 " and carried a magical " shield + 1 " and " longsword + 2 " .

title: Jhatli
description: Jhatli Jhatli was a boy in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .
description_long: Jhatli Jhatli was a boy in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing . He and other young boys decided to act as scouts for the column of refugees , checking the advance of the Viperhands army . Jhatli alone survived to report the rapid advance of the monsters .

title: Jhegaan
description: Jhegaan Jhegaan the Maestro was an employee of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Jhegaan adventured with Aurora across much of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Jhegaan Jhegaan the Maestro was an employee of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Jhegaan adventured with Aurora across much of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur . When Aurora started her business , Jhegaan agreed to work with her and found that he was good at it too . Once , he and Aurora had been lovers , but they remained very close friends .

title: Jhembryn Durrock
description: Jhembryn Durrock Jhembryn Durrock , or simply Durrock , was a male human assassin and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Durrock was an elite assassin in service to the church of Bane based in Scardale during the Time of Troubles .
description_long: Jhembryn Durrock Jhembryn Durrock , or simply Durrock , was a male human assassin and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Durrock was an elite assassin in service to the church of Bane based in Scardale during the Time of Troubles . He was tasked by his god with the mission to capture the wizard Midnight but in end he was killed .

title: Jherek
description: Jherek Jherek was an agent for the Harpers who helped in stopping Eldrith the Betrayer , Mordoc SeLanmere and the Zhentarim ( under leadership of Karne ) from gaining control of the Onyx Tower . Activites . Jherek was in charge of the Harper activity in Baldur ' s Gate , the Western Heartlands , and along the Sword Coast .
description_long: Jherek Jherek was an agent for the Harpers who helped in stopping Eldrith the Betrayer , Mordoc SeLanmere and the Zhentarim ( under leadership of Karne ) from gaining control of the Onyx Tower . Activites . Jherek was in charge of the Harper activity in Baldur ' s Gate , the Western Heartlands , and along the Sword Coast .

title: Jherek Wolf ' s - get
description: Jherek Wolf ' s - get Jherek Wolf ' s - get was the young man famous for playing a major role in defeating Iakhovas during the Twelfth Serôs War . Description . As a young man , Jherek was leanly built with deeply tanned skin .
description_long: Jherek Wolf ' s - get Jherek Wolf ' s - get was the young man famous for playing a major role in defeating Iakhovas during the Twelfth Serôs War . Description . As a young man , Jherek was leanly built with deeply tanned skin . He had broad shoulders and bore many scars from his job as a sailor . He had sun - bleached brown hair and was always clean - shaven . He preferred to dress in breeches with a loose shirt and boots , typical of many sailors . Personality . Jherek ' s childhood filled him with insecurity . He was especially insecure in his relationships with women , not truly understanding them . He was friendly with all kinds of people . Abilities . Jherek was an accomplished swimmer and frequently used a hook along with his cutlass in battle . Relationships . Jherek was the son of the infamous pirate Bloody Falkane the Wolf . One of his first friend was the unique phantom Malorrie . History . Jherek escaped from his vicious father Falkane and went to Velen when he was only twelve years old . For a time he did all kinds of jobs , even thieving sometimes , until he was hired by the half - elf diviner Madame Iitaar . She helped him find work as a sailor .

title: Jherremor
description: Jherremor Jherremor was a ghirrash living in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Jherremor was a ghirrash living in Plane of Shadow near the Dusk Lord ' s Passage ; in 1374 DR he was recruited by the Church of Shar to guard the passage to the Lost Refuge in exchange for not useful prisoners .
description_long: Jherremor Jherremor was a ghirrash living in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Jherremor was a ghirrash living in Plane of Shadow near the Dusk Lord ' s Passage ; in 1374 DR he was recruited by the Church of Shar to guard the passage to the Lost Refuge in exchange for not useful prisoners . Eventually he was defeated by an adventurers party intent to ruin the Sharran ' s plot

title: Jhesiyra Kestellharp
description: Jhesiyra Kestellharp Jhesiyra Kestellharp was one of Halaster ' s seven apprentices who accompanied him to Undermountain as one of the Seven . She is noted as the primary source of information on Halaster as she was the only one of the seven ever recorded leaving those halls . History .
description_long: Jhesiyra Kestellharp Jhesiyra Kestellharp was one of Halaster ' s seven apprentices who accompanied him to Undermountain as one of the Seven . She is noted as the primary source of information on Halaster as she was the only one of the seven ever recorded leaving those halls . History . She traveled to Myth Drannor where she studied magic among the elves before she became Magister in 658 DR after the electrocution of Dathchaunt Sandrach . She experimented with the creation of sentient spells , basing her research on the elven theory of arcanaweaves , re - invigorating their research with her human passion and binding herself into the magic . In 667 DR , in an incident neither Azuth nor Mystra were willing to speak of , the mantle of Magister passed from Jhesiyra to Nerren Prentiyuel - Jhesiyra apparently having transformed herself into a particularly powerful living spell . Jhesiyra disappeared , seemingly nowhere to be found anywhere in Faerûn , though some theorized that she had been abducted by her former master , Halaster . This theory was true , but concerns about her death were unfounded . Halaster had abducted and imprisoned Jhesiyra to create living spells for him .

title: Jhesrhi Coldcreek
description: Jhesrhi Coldcreek Jhesrhi Coldcreek was a powerful mage and a member of the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Although Jhesrhi was capable of casting spells in other schools of magic most of her magic was elemental in nature . She had a special affinity with the wind and was able to command air spirits to aid her .
description_long: Jhesrhi Coldcreek Jhesrhi Coldcreek was a powerful mage and a member of the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Although Jhesrhi was capable of casting spells in other schools of magic most of her magic was elemental in nature . She had a special affinity with the wind and was able to command air spirits to aid her . History . Early Life . Born in Luthcheq to respectable merchants , Jhesrhi demonstrated magical aptitude at an early age . Because mages were despised in Chessenta at that time her parents were embarrassed by their daughter ' s abilities and forbade her to practice the arts . As a youth , Jhesrhi was riding with her parents in a caravan travelling to Threskel when they were attacked by a group of ogre mage s . Her parents offered Jhesrhi to the ogres as ransom in order to prevent the ogres from plundering the caravan . Jhesrhi spent the remainder of her youth as a captive of the ogres who taught her elemental magic . Her mistreatment at the hands of the ogres caused Jhesrhi to acquire a phobia that causes her to loathe the touch of another humanoid . Brotherhood of the Griffon . Jhesrhi was recruited into the Brotherhood of the Griffon by Aoth Fezim .

title: Jhessail Greycastle
description: Jhessail Greycastle Jhessail Greycastle was the commander of the exiled Knights of the Black Fist . Personality . Jhessail was despite all loyal to her city and was totally shocked by the Vorgansharax ' s coup and the betrayal of her fellows .
description_long: Jhessail Greycastle Jhessail Greycastle was the commander of the exiled Knights of the Black Fist . Personality . Jhessail was despite all loyal to her city and was totally shocked by the Vorgansharax ' s coup and the betrayal of her fellows . Jhessail was a firebrand sworn to reclaim her city or die trying . History . Jhessail was a high - ranking member of the Knights of the Black Fist . She exemplified the corruption and cruelty that was synonymous with organization and prospered . In 1489 DR Jhessail lead a rebellion against Vorgansharax but was betrayed by her fellow officers and captured . She was freed by an adventuring party hired by the resistance and managed to escape Phlan . Around 1492 DR , Jhessail led an alliance to reclaim Phlan .

title: Jhessail Silventree
description: Jhessail Silventree Jhessail Silventree was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jhessail was born in Espar in Cormyr to two foresters who were friends of elves .
description_long: Jhessail Silventree Jhessail Silventree was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jhessail was born in Espar in Cormyr to two foresters who were friends of elves . Always fascinated by magic , Jhessail was tutored by elves and the wizard Hezom . She went to adventure with Florin Falconhand , Doust Sulwood , Jelde Asturian , and Islif Lurelake . During one of their first adventures , hopwever , Martess , a fellow apprentice of Hezom , died and this hurt the young sorcerer but helped her to mature , becoming a mother figure for her companions . Jhessail flirted with Jelde but later fell in love with the elf Merith Strongbow , who asked for her hand in marriage in front of all the Elven Court . From the marriage , Jhassail gave birth to the half - elf Veluthil Silverbow . Veluthil was baby - sat by Illistyl Elventree when Jhessail ' s magic was needed by fellow Knights . Trivia . Jhessail was originally played by Jenny Greenwood , Ed Greenwood ' s wife , but her character was taken over by Anita Buttemer , an accomplished violin / viola player and teacher .

title: Jhingleshod
description: Jhingleshod Jhingleshod was the former man - at - arms to the wizard Wulgreth of Ascalhorn , and became an undead knight . Also known as The Iron Axeman , Jhingleshod once had another name , but no longer remembered it . Description .
description_long: Jhingleshod Jhingleshod was the former man - at - arms to the wizard Wulgreth of Ascalhorn , and became an undead knight . Also known as The Iron Axeman , Jhingleshod once had another name , but no longer remembered it . Description . He was covered from head to toe in exotic plate mail and draped himself in an old forest green tunic and cloak . Up close , one could see he was an undead creature appearing to be a cross between a corpse and an animated suit of armor . His skin was formed of rusting overlapping plates of iron . He easily wielded an axe that most men could not lift . Personality . Since his own lifeforce was connected to Wulgreth , Jhingleshod could only truly die and be at rest when Wulgreth was no more . History . In 883 DR , Jhingleshod left Hellgate Keep with his master , Wulgreth , who was fleeing from the influx of fiend s . They traveled to the ruins of Karse where Wulgreth hoped to gain power from the petrified body of Karsus . While in the midst of casting a powerful spell , Jhingleshod slew his master to prevent him from summoning more fiends .

title: Jhonen
description: Jhonen Jhonen was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young fisherman dressed in faded and worn clothing .
description_long: Jhonen Jhonen was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young fisherman dressed in faded and worn clothing . Relationships . The sea spirit Elisia spoke of Jhonen resembling the great hero Aihonen , whom she loved , but could not tell Jhonen these feelings for risk of dissolving into water . History . Around 1181 DR , Jhonen ' s ancestor Aihonen fought the white dragon Icasaracht on Lac Dinneshere and slew the beast . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Jhonen had strange dreams of a blue - skinned woman , but discovered the lady loved his ancestor and wanted Jhonen to have the shards of the Blade of Aihonen .

title: Jhorganni
description: Jhorganni Jhorganni was a female drider vampire and a cleric of Kiaransalee who resided in Maerimydra . Description . Her legs knotted in sticky strands of web , Jhorganni appeared as a drider with glowing red eyes .
description_long: Jhorganni Jhorganni was a female drider vampire and a cleric of Kiaransalee who resided in Maerimydra . Description . Her legs knotted in sticky strands of web , Jhorganni appeared as a drider with glowing red eyes . Personality . Bitter and hateful , Jhorganni readily embraced the vengeful teachings of Kiaransalee after she failed the Test of Lolth . She delighted in creating arachnoid creatures and spreading her vampiric curse among other driders . In battle , she was confident and fearless as she felt few could penetrate ( or even find ) her lair . If able , Jhorganni took particular fondness in trapping and draining the blood of weak foes . Abilities . While she exhibited all the potent abilities of other drider vampire s , Jhorganni also possessed great insight and force of personality , which enabled her to rise to a prominent position among the church of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra . She would actively seek out other driders to infect with her vampiric curse . She was a skilled cleric who was made only stronger by her transformation into a drider and by her embrace of vampirism after her conversion to Kiaransalee .

title: Jhothûn
description: Jhothûn Jhothûn was an ancient empire of giant s located in the far northern cold regions of Faerûn . Description . While not large , Jhothûn was a powerful empire of giantkind .
description_long: Jhothûn Jhothûn was an ancient empire of giant s located in the far northern cold regions of Faerûn . Description . While not large , Jhothûn was a powerful empire of giantkind . Its people mastered great magics , which allowed them to keep their lands in perpetual cold . Portal s connected the four major cities of the empire . Geography . Jhothûn was located in the north of Faerûn , from the Yal Tengri in the east to the Sea of Moving Ice in the west . Its capital , also called Jhothûn , was located somewhere in the region of the Endless Ice Sea . It had three provinces . The first was located in the area of the Sea of Moving Ice and claimed Karffbadh as its capital . The second province was in the vicinity of the High Ice and had Choshein for a capital . Gharreil was the provincial seat of the Great Glacier region . Government . The emperor of Jhothûn reigned supreme and under him were three provincial rulers , called satraps , in similar manner to ancient Calimshan . Jhothûn society included a strange relationship with ice genie s called qorrash . The qorrash served as advisers , titled as " princes of Jhothûn " . Inhabitants .

title: Jhothûn ( city )
description: Jhothûn ( city ) Jhothûn was the capital of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Description . Jhothûn was once an impressive city full of towers of crystal .
description_long: Jhothûn ( city ) Jhothûn was the capital of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Description . Jhothûn was once an impressive city full of towers of crystal . Geography . The city was located somewhere in the Endless Ice Sea , built within a valley carved from the solid ice . Government . The city was ruled by the emperor of Jhothûn with the assistance of the princes of Jhothûn , who were each qorrashi advisers . History . The city of Jhothûn flourished as the capital of its empire long before the first kingdoms of elves . Inhabitants . The city was once populated by the ancestors of the frost giant s , who , with the help of the qorrash , developed great magics , even shaping the weather to remain cold to their liking . By 1372 DR , the only inhabitant of the once great city was the last remaining Prince of Jhothûn . Notable Locations . The royal palace of the Emperors was the only building to last into the fourteenth century DR . Within the palace , which was guarded by the last Prince of Jhothûn , were three portal s , one to each of the three seats of the of the empire — Karffbadh , Choshein , and Gharreil .

title: Jhuild
description: Jhuild Jhuild ( also known as Rashemi firewine , Rashemaar firewine , or thrallwine ) was considered to be the national drink of Rashemen . Description . " Jhuild " was a thick , dark reddish - brown alcoholic beverage that created the sensation of fire in the imbiber ' s belly , thus earning its name .
description_long: Jhuild Jhuild ( also known as Rashemi firewine , Rashemaar firewine , or thrallwine ) was considered to be the national drink of Rashemen . Description . " Jhuild " was a thick , dark reddish - brown alcoholic beverage that created the sensation of fire in the imbiber ' s belly , thus earning its name . " Jhuild " was an extremely potent and spicy wine , and was reputed to have medicinal qualities . The Witches of Rashemen grew the herbs , grapes , and fruits that were used in distilling the wine in the magic - laced soil of the Urlingwood . It was often used as part of in a berserker warrior ' s ritual of invoking the berserker rage . Price . Jhuild was usually served in tall glasses , and as of 1372 DR , its average price was set at around 120 gold piece s per bottle outside of Rashemen ' s borders . In Rashemen , " jhuild " was fairly affordable , costing 1 gold piece per pint . A diluted form of " jhuild " , which is made using ale , was also much more affordable at 15 gold pieces per bottle .

title: Jhuvik
description: Jhuvik Jhuvik , usually known as Jhuvik of the Seven Gems , was an elven thief and cleric of Mystra in Milvarune , and a senior member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Jhuvik venerated Khelben Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand for their status as Chosen of Mystra but he rarely spoke about this .
description_long: Jhuvik Jhuvik , usually known as Jhuvik of the Seven Gems , was an elven thief and cleric of Mystra in Milvarune , and a senior member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Jhuvik venerated Khelben Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand for their status as Chosen of Mystra but he rarely spoke about this . His personal thief ' s code was to steal magic items and knowledge from people that abused the Art and give it to Mystra ' s faithful . History . Jhuvik lived in Milvarune , Thesk . His main exploit , from which he received his nickname , was stealing seven large gem s from the headdress of a Thayan zulkir while it was still being worn . At one point Jhuvik was recruited into the Moonstars .

title: Jhyak
description: Jhyak " Bold Jhyak " was a very old , retired adventurer who owned a bar by the same name in Teshburl in 1370 DR . Jhyak hired a couple mercenaries to tell stories of their battle scars to patrons , which increased his business in an otherwise sea - focused town .
description_long: Jhyak " Bold Jhyak " was a very old , retired adventurer who owned a bar by the same name in Teshburl in 1370 DR . Jhyak hired a couple mercenaries to tell stories of their battle scars to patrons , which increased his business in an otherwise sea - focused town .

title: Jhyndara Thiolstar
description: Jhyndara Thiolstar Jhyndara Thiolstar was a High Priestess , or High Luck Priestess , of Tymora in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Jhyndara was the ranking priestess in the Ladysluck Tower .
description_long: Jhyndara Thiolstar Jhyndara Thiolstar was a High Priestess , or High Luck Priestess , of Tymora in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Jhyndara was the ranking priestess in the Ladysluck Tower . She oversaw 34 other priests and priestesses of Tymora . A congregation of 71 followers filled the temple to worship .

title: Jierdan
description: Jierdan Jierdan was a soldier of Luskan . History . He assisted Dendybar ' s apprentice Sydney along with Artemis Entreri in their quest to find both Regis and the crystal shard Crenshinibon .
description_long: Jierdan Jierdan was a soldier of Luskan . History . He assisted Dendybar ' s apprentice Sydney along with Artemis Entreri in their quest to find both Regis and the crystal shard Crenshinibon . However , Catti - brie , in an attempt to help the Companions of the Hall , persuaded Jierdan that Sydney and Entreri would dispose of him once he was of no more use . Eventually , Jierdan confronted Entreri near the entrance of Mithral Hall . Jierdan proved to be an equal match during the beginning of the fight , although he noted that he would tire long before Entreri . Jierdan attempted to use the unconscious Sydney as an excuse to halt his fight with Entreri , and was promptly killed by Entreri ' s vampiric dagger .

title: Jierta
description: Jierta Jierta was a female frost giant warrior in the late 15th century DR . History . Jierta was one of the warriors in Jarl Greigor Kundknoddick ' s tribe , who allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .
description_long: Jierta Jierta was a female frost giant warrior in the late 15th century DR . History . Jierta was one of the warriors in Jarl Greigor Kundknoddick ' s tribe , who allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening . In 1485 DR , during the late stages of the War of the Silver Marches , Jierta reported to Greigor that an army from Silverymoon had defeated their orc allies . Soon after , Gregor was approached by Jarlaxle , who suggested he withdraw his troops in the wake of the imminent defeat of Many - Arrows .

title: Jiksidur
description: Jiksidur Jiksidur was a Netherese enclave of Netheril ruled by the Sorcerer - King Larloch . History . Larloch rose to become Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in Netheril .
description_long: Jiksidur Jiksidur was a Netherese enclave of Netheril ruled by the Sorcerer - King Larloch . History . Larloch rose to become Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in Netheril . He used the Death Moon Orb to charm and mentally control the members of his court and spy on his enemies . It did so successfully , and Larloch ruled for many years , gaining great power . In the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR , Larloch had Jiksidur hovering high over east Faerûn to spy on the rival empires of Narfell and Raumathar . A contingency spell warned Larloch that Jiksidur was facing impending doom , and he fled the city riding a dragon . Very soon after , Netheril suffered Karsus ' s Folly , all magic failed , and Jiksidur fell from the sky . It flipped over in its descent and crashed upside down into the earth , utterly destroyed under its own weight . Jiksidur had landed in the plains of Narfell . Soon after its fall , agents of the Nentyarch tunneled into the mountaintop and excavated the ruins , seeking whatever treasures they could salvage . Some of these ultimately ended up in the tombs of Nar demonbinders .

title: Jimjar
description: Jimjar Jimjar was a deep gnome gambler during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was a reckless rogue with a devil - may - care attitude , a fondness for coin , and an obsession with betting on virtually anything and everything .
description_long: Jimjar Jimjar was a deep gnome gambler during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was a reckless rogue with a devil - may - care attitude , a fondness for coin , and an obsession with betting on virtually anything and everything . However , he was a man of word and remembered all debts and credits , which he always honored . Jimjar also possessed an amazing ability to secret significant wealth on his person . History . Jimjar was exiled by his people because of his gambling obsession , which other deep gnomes saw as a sign of deep madness . During the Rage of Demons , he was captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Jinchin
description: Jinchin Jinchin was an evil shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Jinchin was originally Ieyasu Sabanada , the eldest son of a samurai family that became counselors to the Imperial Court .
description_long: Jinchin Jinchin was an evil shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Jinchin was originally Ieyasu Sabanada , the eldest son of a samurai family that became counselors to the Imperial Court . However , after the death of his father , Ieyasu entered into a feud with his eldest brother for the control of the Sabanada Clan . Defeated and stripped of everything , he entered the distant Temple of Kagaii as a monk , taking the name Jinchin . In the years at the monastery , his ambition grew and soon Jinchin started gathering an army , first of loyal monks at the monastery , then later ronin and rebellious samurai and at last attracting also oni , tengu , and legions of undead gakken . Finally , Jinchin was approached by the Earth Spider , who offered his power to him in exchange for his services . He agreed , becoming the Spider ' s avatar in Toril . In 1356 DR , he attacked the Kanazaki Province , first clashing with Doin Sanehiro at the Battle of Kiroshima , where to defeat the samurai Jinchin had to send his most powerful oni to kill him .

title: Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn
description: Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn ( Jinn ) was a 4 , 000 year old deva who originally served the Mulhorandi pantheon . He resided in Waterdeep in 1480 DR . History .
description_long: Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn ( Jinn ) was a 4 , 000 year old deva who originally served the Mulhorandi pantheon . He resided in Waterdeep in 1480 DR . History . Jinn was originally in service to the gods of Mulhorand , deities who have long since vanished from Toril . Several hundred years ago , he lived in the High Forest with his elven wife Quessahn Uthraebor but his peace was short lived as he was killed the following year . In the years after the spellplague , he hunted down and killed members of the Vigilent Order , a sect of Asmodeus worshipers in Waterdeep . He had nearly eradicated the Order when he stumbled on a plot to finish the First Flensing , a ritual that would allow Asmodeus to enter Waterdeep . Jinn agreed to help a Watch Captain friend solve a series of grusome murders in Sea Ward . While following leads , Jinn and his companions , the night hag Maranyuss and Quessahn , spent an evening at the Storm ' s Front Tavern . The dark angel Sathariel materialized on the second floor and started a fire which killed the Watch Captain and burned the tavern to the ground .

title: Jinutt
description: Jinutt Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the small village of Jinutt , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants .
description_long: Jinutt Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the small village of Jinutt , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants . The inhabitants were fishermen who traded their catch for other goods and services to Sahu ' s second village , Misbahd .

title: Jiraad
description: Jiraad Jiraad was the most well - known genie throughout all of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . As a noble marid , Jiraad stood as tall as a giant at 22 feet ( 6 .
description_long: Jiraad Jiraad was the most well - known genie throughout all of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . As a noble marid , Jiraad stood as tall as a giant at 22 feet ( 6 . 7 m ) . Personality . Jiraad was quite introspective and tolerant for a marid . However , his temper flared on several instances — causing a monsoon and the worst flooding of Al - Sarif River in over a century . Since then , those who worked directly with the mighty marid learned never to disagree with him regarding naval policy . Activities . Jiraad served the Grand Caliph , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir , as an ambassador and advisor . At the end of the day Jiraad enjoyed relaxing and swimming in his own private pool within the compound of the Palace . The pool was 100 ft . ( 30 m ) deep and was decorated with beautiful coral artwork along the bottom . Though the pool was reserved for Jiraad alone , many young nobles of the Court District considered it a rite of passage to take a dip in the pool when Jiraad was not around . Jiraad resented this deeply and cursed anyone he caught to only be able to breathe water for a week straight .

title: Jirozu no Nakamaru
description: Jirozu no Nakamaru Jirozu no Nakamaru was the oyabun of Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Jirozu collected odd and unusual weapons and will payed honest prices for such things ( particularly gaijin items ) .
description_long: Jirozu no Nakamaru Jirozu no Nakamaru was the oyabun of Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Jirozu collected odd and unusual weapons and will payed honest prices for such things ( particularly gaijin items ) . History . Jirozu risen the ranks starting from being a poor waterfront laborer In 1357 during the feud against Black Mist gang he was invited to a peace meeting organized by daimyo Funada Mitsuhide . Hoping to ruin Mitsuhide Goshukara Sadamoto targeted for death Jirozu sending Phoenix clan Ninja to kill him framing Funada clan Personality . Jirozu was very aware of both his power and his social position . He possessed a charming and crafty personality , always appearing friendly . In truth he evaluated and judged all opportunities of any situations .

title: Jisan
description: Jisan Jisan is the goddess of fruitfulness of Zakhara , who stands for fertility and productivity .
