She is one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encourages hard work and diligent planning in order to harvest the riches of the world . Jisan ' s symbol is a rain cloud , a relic of her long - gone origins as a storm - goddess who provides the monsoon rains necessary for the fertility of the land .
description_long: Jisan Jisan is the goddess of fruitfulness of Zakhara , who stands for fertility and productivity . She is one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encourages hard work and diligent planning in order to harvest the riches of the world . Jisan ' s symbol is a rain cloud , a relic of her long - gone origins as a storm - goddess who provides the monsoon rains necessary for the fertility of the land . There are no tales in which Jisan takes any physical form . Like other Zakharan gods she is above such concerns as alignment , as hard work may be put into an honest life or aim to subjugate others for personal gain . Jisan ' s faith is present in all parts of society , but is most prevalent among merchants . She is not worshipped in the Cities of the Pantheon , where her role is taken by the local goddess Jauhar . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Jivex
description: Jivex Jivex was a faerie dragon from the Gray Forest and a member of the mixed human and draconic group that defeated Sammaster . Abilities . Jivex was skilled in the arts of illusion , preferring to deceive and trick his opponents rather than blast them into little bits and pieces .
description_long: Jivex Jivex was a faerie dragon from the Gray Forest and a member of the mixed human and draconic group that defeated Sammaster . Abilities . Jivex was skilled in the arts of illusion , preferring to deceive and trick his opponents rather than blast them into little bits and pieces . Appearance . Like all faerie dragons , Jivex was extremely small by dragon standards , no more than the length of a man ' s arm from snout to tail . His scales had an iridescent hue .

title: Jivvin golhyrr
description: Jivvin golhyrr Jivvin Golhyrr , meaning " amusing trick " , was a fighting style used by sadistic drow who found their purpose in humiliating their enemies . Description . The name " amusing trick " wasn ' t given because it was amusing to look at but because it was " amusing to the sadist who happened to be the practitioner " .
description_long: Jivvin golhyrr Jivvin Golhyrr , meaning " amusing trick " , was a fighting style used by sadistic drow who found their purpose in humiliating their enemies . Description . The name " amusing trick " wasn ' t given because it was amusing to look at but because it was " amusing to the sadist who happened to be the practitioner " . The style itself resembled the " kyorlin plynn " style , users of one style tended to learn the other to some degree , in its defensive nature and the focus on non - lethal techniques , which didn ' t mean that users didn ' t kill . The style itself was about fighting defensively until the enemy showed an opening . This opening was then exploited by tripping the enemy . It was done to easier allow follow - up attacks but also to force the enemy into a humiliating position , akin to those slaves were forced into , which was found amusing by the cruel drow hence the name . Training . Users needed to be able to put up a good defenses and be effective trippers . Reputation . As mentioned above , the style was for sadists and thus was favored by cleric s of Lolth . Appendix . Background . The style was based on the Expertise and Trip feat chain in 3 .

title: Jo Stick of the White Tree
description: Jo Stick of the White Tree The Jo Stick of the White Tree was a pure white jo stick , carried by Grandmaster Kane . It was formed from a branch of the white tree that grew in the courtyard of Gareth Dragonsbane ' s Castle in Bloodstone Village on the shore of Lake Midai . This tree was called the Tree - Gem of Bloodstone .
description_long: Jo Stick of the White Tree The Jo Stick of the White Tree was a pure white jo stick , carried by Grandmaster Kane . It was formed from a branch of the white tree that grew in the courtyard of Gareth Dragonsbane ' s Castle in Bloodstone Village on the shore of Lake Midai . This tree was called the Tree - Gem of Bloodstone . It was said that in the hands of Kane , this white stick was as hard as adamantine and could shatter stone . Also , it never got dirty or dusty from use as a walking stick .

title: Joadath
description: Joadath Joadath was Lord of Shadowdale between 1273 DR and his death in 1300 DR . He was an agnostic who believed that the deities held no power . This was a belief that led , in 1297 DR , to the massacre of Tyr ists on Watcher ' s Knoll .
description_long: Joadath Joadath was Lord of Shadowdale between 1273 DR and his death in 1300 DR . He was an agnostic who believed that the deities held no power . This was a belief that led , in 1297 DR , to the massacre of Tyr ists on Watcher ' s Knoll . Joadath died in 1300 DR when an unknown individual brought a beast from the nether planes to Shadowdale .

title: Joatra Stelmar
description: Joatra Stelmar Joatra Stelmar was a druid and an agent of the Knights of the North in 1374 DR . Personality . Joatra first and foremost loved all kinds of birds and nobody could harm one of them in her presence , especially her knights .
description_long: Joatra Stelmar Joatra Stelmar was a druid and an agent of the Knights of the North in 1374 DR . Personality . Joatra first and foremost loved all kinds of birds and nobody could harm one of them in her presence , especially her knights . She had free command over her sky sentinels but was uninterested in the political decisions of the Knights . History . Joatra originally was just a druid with a good feeling for dire hawk s in the Dragonspine Mountains . One day , she saved a group of the Knights of the North from a Zhentarim ambush , thanks to her hawks . So , they offered Joatra a position in the Knights and she accepted . She came to lead the Moonsea skysentinel s , a division of the Knights specifically created to counter the Zhentarim skymage s .

title: Jochris
description: Jochris Jochris was the headmaster of the Neverwinter Academy around 1374 DR . History . After Qara ' s fight with Ashni , with the Kalach - Cha and companions , Jochris would approach Qara .
description_long: Jochris Jochris was the headmaster of the Neverwinter Academy around 1374 DR . History . After Qara ' s fight with Ashni , with the Kalach - Cha and companions , Jochris would approach Qara . Seeing his students being hurt by Qara , Jochris summoned Sydney Natale to his quarters , as he wanted revenge on Qara . After a while , Jochris gave Sydney some thread from Qara ' s robe and some of her hair , as well as his blood , to power a ritual . Sydney summoned an animus elemental , which would track Qara and attack her .

title: Joei
description: Joei Joei the Aged was a wu jen merchant in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In the city of Kuda , Joei managed a very lucrative business of importing exotic items under licenses by both the emperor and the shogun .
description_long: Joei Joei the Aged was a wu jen merchant in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In the city of Kuda , Joei managed a very lucrative business of importing exotic items under licenses by both the emperor and the shogun . He often disappeared for months or even years searching for items with his ship . Even when Joei was in the city , nobody knew his true activities . Many thieves met their end entering his warehouse . People spread rumors that Joei acquired his licenses by doing illegal deeds for the emperor and shogun . Relationship . Joei had always at his side his Shou clerk Lu and three bodyguards : two Hordelands barbarians and the small Saigo .

title: Joelle Emmeline
description: Joelle Emmeline Joelle Emmeline was a jewel thief from Berdusk and a Chosen of Sune in 1486 DR . Activities . In 1486 DR , Joelle was tasked by her goddess with the mission of taking the Eye of Gruumsh to the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple in the Underchasm .
description_long: Joelle Emmeline Joelle Emmeline was a jewel thief from Berdusk and a Chosen of Sune in 1486 DR . Activities . In 1486 DR , Joelle was tasked by her goddess with the mission of taking the Eye of Gruumsh to the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple in the Underchasm . Strangely accompanied by the Chosen of Cyric Malik el Sami , Joelle stole the sacred relic from the Hidden Temple of Nishrek in the orc stronghold of Big Bone Deep in the Stonelands . Pursued by shadovar and vengeful orcs , Joelle and Malik sought refuge in Marsember , where they met Arietta Seasilver , who believed herself to be the Chosen of Siamorphe , and Kleef Kenric , a paladin follower of the dead god Helm . With their new companions , Joelle and Malik managed to escape their pursuers and continue their mission . Joelle knew from her goddess that , in order to fulfill the last ritual , someone who was completely in love with another person would have to willingly sacrifice themself . So Joelle began to seduce Arietta . At the final moment in Grumbar ' s temple , knowing that her sacrifice would ruin Shar ' s , plot Arietta accepted her role as sacrifice , and Joelle discovered in herself feelings for Arietta .

title: Jogaoh
description: Jogaoh Jogaoh was a fire elemental who was trapped in the form of a dwarf and bound to Toril . Jogaoh was well known as a magical smith on the Sword Coast . History .
description_long: Jogaoh Jogaoh was a fire elemental who was trapped in the form of a dwarf and bound to Toril . Jogaoh was well known as a magical smith on the Sword Coast . History . Jogaoh was forcibly transported from his home plane to the world of Toril by the extraplanar being Imgig Zu . Employing a Lockstone , Imgig Zu then trapped the powerful fire elemental in the form of a weak dwarf , which in turn bound him to Toril , and furthermore used his " staff of withering " to drain the strength from Jogaoh ' s limbs . Nevertheless , Jogaoh was able to escape . Imgig Zu placed the Lockstone atop Stoner ' s Needle in the Sword Coast lands with a frozen greater basilisk as guardian . The Lockstone also proved the key to Jogaoh ' s release . Its conditions were the passing of two centuries and to be touched by a living creature . Once these were met , it would restore withered or lost limbs to the one who touched it and transform them back to their original form , but also awake the greater basilisk guardian . Jogaoh feared the basilisk too much to make the climb up and take the Lockstone . Jogaoh fashioned for himself a pair of enchanted gauntlets that gave him fresh strength .

title: John Nephew
description: John Nephew John Nephew is an author for roleplaying games . Biography . John Nephew started his career as an author for RPGs with writing articles for the RPG - magazine " Dragon " .
description_long: John Nephew John Nephew is an author for roleplaying games . Biography . John Nephew started his career as an author for RPGs with writing articles for the RPG - magazine " Dragon " . With the money he earned there and the ( financial ) support of Jerry Corrick ( the owner of the Atlas Games Shops ) , Nephew founded the game publishing company Atlas Games . John Nephew studied philosophy at the Carleton College ( BA ) . Publishings . His publishings include :

title: Joiifericus
description: Joiifericus Joiifericus was a succubus nursemaid in Maerimydra during the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR . Activities . Joiifericus ' duty was to take care of the many children of demon lord Graz ' zt .
description_long: Joiifericus Joiifericus was a succubus nursemaid in Maerimydra during the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR . Activities . Joiifericus ' duty was to take care of the many children of demon lord Graz ' zt . She spent hours every day feeding them and teaching them the finer points of evil . However , she would seek escape if attacked and would only fight if someone tried to abduct one of the children . Personality . Joiifericus enjoyed her work .

title: Jolen Firth
description: Jolen Firth Jolen Firth was the First Speaker of Nesmé in the late 15th century . Description . Jolen was a sturdy man .
description_long: Jolen Firth Jolen Firth was the First Speaker of Nesmé in the late 15th century . Description . Jolen was a sturdy man . He was quite reasonable , in comparison to his forefathers . Relationships . Jolen Firth ' s grandfather ' s grandfather ( great - great - grandfather ) was Galen Firth , another prominent man in the history of the city . History . In 1484 DR , Jolen Firth was serving as the First Speaker of Nesmé when his city was cast under siege by the orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . The Companions of the Hall aided him and his forces in defending the city , but soon after the Companions ' departure , the city was overcome by the orc forces and the white dragon Arauthator . All but 600 of the inhabitants were killed ; the rest were taken prisoner . The drow Tiago and Saribel Baenre were named Duke and Duchess of Nesme .

title: Jolliver Grimjaw
description: Jolliver Grimjaw Jolliver Grimjaw was a wereboar member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jolliver Grimjaw was a sullen , suspicious , and humorless individual .
description_long: Jolliver Grimjaw Jolliver Grimjaw was a wereboar member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jolliver Grimjaw was a sullen , suspicious , and humorless individual . Grimjaw had little patience for administration , asking very direct questions . Activities . Grimjaw and his men traded with some smugglers and led attacks on river boats that refused to pay protection money . They also actively recruited thugs and monsters to join the Cult . History . In 1491 DR , Grimjaw and his minions posed as mercenaries and occupied the Rivergard Keep . Soon after , however , some adventurers infiltrated the keep and in the end confronted and defeated Grimjaw .

title: Jomhur
description: Jomhur Imam Jomhur was the High Priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Jomhur supervised around 200 priests and other laymen within the mosque .
description_long: Jomhur Imam Jomhur was the High Priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Jomhur supervised around 200 priests and other laymen within the mosque . Jomhur widely opposed the infamous group of holy slayer s called the Everlasting who also worshipped Hajama .

title: Jomo Shanbaeren
description: Jomo Shanbaeren Jomo " the Cutlass " Shanbaeren was a retired pirate who owned a tavern . Background . Jomo stowed away on the Dragon ' s Claw when he was seventeen years old but was discovered by its female captain , who offered him passage .
description_long: Jomo Shanbaeren Jomo " the Cutlass " Shanbaeren was a retired pirate who owned a tavern . Background . Jomo stowed away on the Dragon ' s Claw when he was seventeen years old but was discovered by its female captain , who offered him passage . She taught Jomo to play chess .

title: Jon Irenicus
description: Jon Irenicus Joneleth Irenicus , commonly referred to as Jon Irenicus or simply Irenicus , is the primary antagonist in " " , a role - playing game set in Amn . Personality . At first , Irenicus appears to be a simple , if surreal , villain with a keen interest in torturing the protagonist with unusual magic at the very beginning of " Shadows of Amn " .
description_long: Jon Irenicus Joneleth Irenicus , commonly referred to as Jon Irenicus or simply Irenicus , is the primary antagonist in " " , a role - playing game set in Amn . Personality . At first , Irenicus appears to be a simple , if surreal , villain with a keen interest in torturing the protagonist with unusual magic at the very beginning of " Shadows of Amn " . However , minutes into the game , he reveals that his apparent motive for said torture is to unlock his victim ' s latent ' power ' , thereby benefiting from them in the long run . His obsession with a woman he ' d previously maintained a relationship with reveals a much more human ( or elven ) side to him . It becomes apparent later in the game that Irenicus ' s embarking on his dark path came about partly from love . His possessive nature eventually became too much for his partner to bear , and unable to let go , Irenicus turned to pursuit of power and revenge , which in turn led to him becoming utterly twisted . However , not only love was responsible for his downfall . Physical Description .

title: Jon Pickens
description: Jon Pickens Jon Pickens is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . Background .
description_long: Jon Pickens Jon Pickens is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . Background . Pickens met Gary Gygax as a teenager in 1968 , and the latter introduced the former to gaming conventions . Education . Pickens received his bachelor ' s degree in English and Economics from in 1976 . Career . After college , Pickens wrote articles for " Dragon " magazine before eventually applying for a job at TSR . He was hired as an editor . During his time with TSR , he contributed to a large number of Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks and assisted many other authors on their research for gaming products .

title: Jonathan Tweet
description: Jonathan Tweet Jonathan Tweet is a game designer who has been involved in the development of the role - playing games " " , " " , " " , " " and the third edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . He currently works at Wizards of the Coast . He has many short cultural and political essays on his website with a particular focus on religion and atheism .
