He currently works at Wizards of the Coast . He has many short cultural and political essays on his website with a particular focus on religion and atheism .

title: Jongrath ' s Mill
description: Jongrath ' s Mill Jongrath ' s Mill was a " waterless " grain mill in Tethyr , known locally as Stump Hill , owned and operated by Ilmurk Jongrath . On the property was the working mill , a cottage that could be rented , livestock , and a large horse stable . It was in operation around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR Location .
description_long: Jongrath ' s Mill Jongrath ' s Mill was a " waterless " grain mill in Tethyr , known locally as Stump Hill , owned and operated by Ilmurk Jongrath . On the property was the working mill , a cottage that could be rented , livestock , and a large horse stable . It was in operation around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR Location . Jongrath ' s Mill was located about a day ' s ride east of Krennasar in rural Bardshyr county in the Duchy of the Purple Marches , Tethyr . Structure . There were three main buildings all surrounding a millrun where draft horses were harnessed to the spokes of a large wheel . The mill itself was tall enough to house the shaft - and - gear mechanism — a thick horizontal shaft made from tree trunks held up by tripods so the horses could walk beneath — that turned the millstone . There was also a secondary shaft that was used to pump water from a deep well . All doors and windows were adorned with " snap - traps " of Jongrath ' s own design to keep vermin from spoiling his grain and flour . Jongrath slept in the millhouse to guard his valuables and left the house available for renters .

title: Joon Tsao Choo
description: Joon Tsao Choo Joon Tsao Choo was an emperor of Shou Lung of ancient times History . Joon Tsao Choo was a great emperor that strongly ruled for many years , expanding the Empire . Many nobles feared the Empire ' s expansion over the Shao Mountains , a land outside their control , and the most rebellious of them formed the Black Maut Cult in order to ruin Joon Tsao and regained their power .
description_long: Joon Tsao Choo Joon Tsao Choo was an emperor of Shou Lung of ancient times History . Joon Tsao Choo was a great emperor that strongly ruled for many years , expanding the Empire . Many nobles feared the Empire ' s expansion over the Shao Mountains , a land outside their control , and the most rebellious of them formed the Black Maut Cult in order to ruin Joon Tsao and regained their power . The Black Maut Cult sent to the Emperor the concubine Meilan , a woman of great beauty and cleverness , enhanced by a thousandfold by evil enchantments in order to made her irresistible to any men . Soon Joon Tsao fall in love for her , no longer caring for the government of the Empire . Under Meilan ' s suggestion Joon Tsao sent his wife and many of his advisors in prison and also exiled Ahp Hijan , his Minister of State and dearest friend . The Emperor renamed too his capital Kuo Meilan , where he indulged in debauchery and wild revels with Meilan . Meantime the nobles reasserted their power over population . At one point the Celestial Empire sent a huge dragon to warn Joon Tsao to amend his ways in 100 days or he will suffer deathly consequence but the emperor only laughed about this .

title: Jordy Gallum
description: Jordy Gallum Lord Jordy Gallum was the Count of Greenshores in Tethyr and that kingdom ' s Sheriffs ' Chancellor . Personality . Jordy Gallum had been described as " the epitome of a Greenshores man " .
description_long: Jordy Gallum Lord Jordy Gallum was the Count of Greenshores in Tethyr and that kingdom ' s Sheriffs ' Chancellor . Personality . Jordy Gallum had been described as " the epitome of a Greenshores man " . He was thoughtful and peaceful but could become aggressive if his people were threatened . He loved the outdoors . Relationships . Jordy was longtime friends with both Tardeth Llanistaph and Marilyn Haresdown of the Company of Eight . He served with the latter while in the army of Tethyr before the Tethyrian Interregnum and was the one who introduced Marilyn to Tardeth . Jordy was married to a woman from Mosstone named Shaern . His younger brother , Emmakk took over for him as constable of Mosstone after Jordy ' s promotion to count . Activities . As Sheriffs ' Chancellor of Tethyr , Lord Gallum was responsible for the oversight of all law - enforcement in the kingdom . Holdings . Jordy ruled from Kirgard , which had formerly been used to garrison troops for Mosstone and Port Kir . Neither Jordy nor his wife were comfortable living in the manor , since they had lived in Mosstone for over 40 years . History . Jordy was born and brought up in the town of Mosstone .

title: Jorgen Pawl
description: Jorgen Pawl Jorgen Pawl was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons commander of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Like most people at Xonthal ' s Tower , Jorgen was a strong dracolich traditionalist . Just before the Tyranny of Dragons , he was nominated as commander of the recently conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists .
description_long: Jorgen Pawl Jorgen Pawl was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons commander of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Like most people at Xonthal ' s Tower , Jorgen was a strong dracolich traditionalist . Just before the Tyranny of Dragons , he was nominated as commander of the recently conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists . As a compromise with Cult ' s traditionalists the reformist leader Severin gave the " Blue dragon mask " to Jorgen to examine ; however the crazy Xonthal ' s second - in - command Iskander betray the Cult to the Council of Waterdeep . Jorgen understood Iskander ' s felling but he not ready to be traitor for these ; so when Iskander ' s treachery was unveiled Jorgen ordered his death ; probably he was soon killed by an adventurers ' band sent by the Council in response to a message from Iskander .

title: Jorhat Shan
description: Jorhat Shan The Jorhat Shan were a pair of tall mountains located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located between Solon in the Raurin Desert , and Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range , sat the twin mountains of Jorhat Shan .
description_long: Jorhat Shan The Jorhat Shan were a pair of tall mountains located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located between Solon in the Raurin Desert , and Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range , sat the twin mountains of Jorhat Shan . The Jorhat Shan , which meant " Two Brothers Mountains " , was considered one of the major landmarks of the Endless Wastes . The mountains themselves rose 14 , 389 feet above sea level and were known to be barren and rocky , with few trees or plants growing on their slopes . Notable Locations . Located on the Jorhat Shan was an ancient fortress known only as the Fortress of Jorhat . Most people hurried past this location , due to rumors of the site being haunted by those killed there .

title: Jorid
description: Jorid Jorid was a barkeep in in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Jorid owned the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth in northeastern Tethyr .
description_long: Jorid Jorid was a barkeep in in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Jorid owned the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth in northeastern Tethyr . History . Before the Black Days , Jorid trained in the Tethyrian army . On Uktar 10 , 1370 DR , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered his taproom , seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . When Bramas Thorntree accused some of the other patrons of stealing it , this triggered a tavern brawl . Jorid was one of the ones who tried to separate and calm the brawlers .

title: Jorik
description: Jorik Jorik was a human who owned the Weeping Willow Inn near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Jorik came to the Mere of Dead Men and found a lone building .
description_long: Jorik Jorik was a human who owned the Weeping Willow Inn near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Jorik came to the Mere of Dead Men and found a lone building . He discovered it had once been part of a village that had been destroyed by the King of Shadows , so he re - established it as a tavern . When the Kalach - Cha and Khelgar Ironfist came to the inn in 1374 DR , Jorik asked them to defeat the invaders and if they did he would trade with them and give information about Neverwinter .

title: Joril
description: Joril Joril was a mighty frost giant , who lived in the Spine of the World with his clan . His magical dagger was lost , when he was killed by a group of adventurers . Some time later the dagger reapeared in Kuldahar and was reforged there , so that it can now be used by human s and human - sized creatures as a two - handed sword .
description_long: Joril Joril was a mighty frost giant , who lived in the Spine of the World with his clan . His magical dagger was lost , when he was killed by a group of adventurers . Some time later the dagger reapeared in Kuldahar and was reforged there , so that it can now be used by human s and human - sized creatures as a two - handed sword .

title: Jorildyn
description: Jorildyn Jorildyn was a half - elf battlemage and a member of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Description . The half - elf had a grey - streaked beard .
description_long: Jorildyn Jorildyn was a half - elf battlemage and a member of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Description . The half - elf had a grey - streaked beard . History . In Alturiak 1374 DR , Jorildyn survived the attack on the Tower Reilloch . After fighting alongside elves on many occasions , Jorildyn joined up with Seiveril Miritar in traveling to Faerûn to combat the daemonfey invasion . In the final battle against the daemonfey at the Vale of Lost Voices Jorildyn tried to kill Malkizid himself but was instead killed by the fallen solar .

title: Jorin Kell Harthan
description: Jorin Kell Harthan Jorin Kell Harthan was a captain of the Simbul ' s Guard in the 1370s DR History . In 1374 DR , Jorin went to Araevin Teshurr explaining that he must go to the royal palace escorted by Jorin . Later the regent Phaeldara ordered to Jorin to help the Araevin ' s party to arrive in Sildeyuir .
description_long: Jorin Kell Harthan Jorin Kell Harthan was a captain of the Simbul ' s Guard in the 1370s DR History . In 1374 DR , Jorin went to Araevin Teshurr explaining that he must go to the royal palace escorted by Jorin . Later the regent Phaeldara ordered to Jorin to help the Araevin ' s party to arrive in Sildeyuir . Later he joined Araevin ' s party in their search of the Gatekeeper crystal despite showing a false reluctance . .

title: Jorlan Duskryn
description: Jorlan Duskryn Jorlan Duskryn was a drow warrior of House Duskryn during the Rage of Demons . History . Jorlan was a drow of Menzoberranzan living in the Velkynvelve outpost .
description_long: Jorlan Duskryn Jorlan Duskryn was a drow warrior of House Duskryn during the Rage of Demons . History . Jorlan was a drow of Menzoberranzan living in the Velkynvelve outpost . Thank to his skill and his charm , he quickly became the field commander and lover of the leader of the outpost , Ilvara Mizzrym . However , during a routine patrol , he was attacked by a black pudding , which severely injured him . Ilvara saved his life , but his face was totally ruined . So Ilvara discarded him and took as a new lover the young Shoor Vandree . Personality . Jorlan had a talent for inflicting pain that he employed in his fighting skills . He believed Lolth favored him , or at least that his charm had deflected her malice , until his injury . Relationship . Jorlan was Ilvara ' s lover until he was injured . After being discarded , a virulent hatred for llvara and Shoor slowly grew in him . He knew that the sympathy the priestess Asha Vandree showed him was an attempt to manipulate him , but he was willing to play along for the time being , hoping to draw Asha closer and potentially use her against llvara when the time was right .

title: Jorunhast
description: Jorunhast Jorunhast was High Wizard of Cormyr . He was broad - shouldered and muscular . He was the pupil of Thanderahast .
description_long: Jorunhast Jorunhast was High Wizard of Cormyr . He was broad - shouldered and muscular . He was the pupil of Thanderahast . Background . Jorunhast fought against the red dragon s who invaded Suzail in 1018 DR . He rescued a young lady from a window in the burning Castle Obarskyr , but he fell out of favour with Azoun II who had been courting her . He pursued Thauglor and battled him in the King ' s Forest . Although Jorunhast panicked when faced with Thauglor and tried to prevent Azoun from attacking ( Azoun laid the decisive blow ) , Azoun forgave him and the pair were subsequently on better terms . When king Azoun III died , prince Rhigaerd was only six years old , so Azoun III ' s brother Salember Obarskyr took the throne of Cormyr as regent . However in 1286 DR the regent Salember plotted to kill Rhigaerd and take the throne , leading Cormyr into civil war . During a parlay , Salember attacks Rhigaerd but Jorunhast stepped in and slayed the regent . Although grateful for saving his life , Rhigaerd felt he must exile Jorunhast for killing a member of the royal family . Jorunhast built the Tower of Stars on Traitor ' s Isle , an island in Prespur on the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Jorus Azuremantle
description: Jorus Azuremantle Jorus Azuremantle was a half - elven wizard and the leader of the Spellguard , assuming the title after Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade . He was also a member of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Personality .
description_long: Jorus Azuremantle Jorus Azuremantle was a half - elven wizard and the leader of the Spellguard , assuming the title after Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade . He was also a member of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Personality . Noted as being both reserved and powerful , Jorus was very meticulous about selecting any Spellguard that served under him . Relationships . Jourus was Taern Hornblade ' s nephew . History . In 1369 DR , when Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade became the High Mage of Silverymoon , Jorus was appointed as the new Lord Warder and leader of the Spellguard . By 1370 DR , Jorus sat on the the Council of 12 Peers to help Alustriel Silverhand form the the League of the Silver Marches .

title: Josef Linkletter
description: Josef Linkletter Josef Linkletter was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1479 DR , serving as soldier in Lord Dagult Neverember ' s army before became involved in the plots of Rhazzad . History . Josef was a native - born of Neverwinter who had been born in the grim years after the Spellplague .
description_long: Josef Linkletter Josef Linkletter was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1479 DR , serving as soldier in Lord Dagult Neverember ' s army before became involved in the plots of Rhazzad . History . Josef was a native - born of Neverwinter who had been born in the grim years after the Spellplague . In 1473 DR , he was a journeyman stone mason when he met the architect Dorothea Nacht . Dorothea and Josef soon fell in love and married . Meanwhile , after a brush with the law , Josef was recruited into the guard by Sergeant Knox . Josef soon made a name for himself as a principled and fair man who could talk sense to even the most desperate outlaw , and fought with distinction against the Many - Arrows orcs and the Blackdagger Bandits . However , in 1479 , illness clouded the Linkletters ' happiness : Dorothea became afflicted by the Spellplague and the malady kept the formerly outgoing woman in her home for months . Out of desperation , Dorothea and Josef approached the unorthodox wizard Rhazzad , known for studying the matter . He gave Dorothea a potion that apparently controlled the illness .

title: Joser Minstrelwish
description: Joser Minstrelwish Joser Minstrelwish was an halfling from Arabel and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Cormyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Joser owned the Minstrelwish Chains , Belts , and Scabbards shop in Arabel .
description_long: Joser Minstrelwish Joser Minstrelwish was an halfling from Arabel and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Cormyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Joser owned the Minstrelwish Chains , Belts , and Scabbards shop in Arabel . He was a former Harpers and was recruited in the Moonstars for control the region .

title: Josidiah Starym
description: Josidiah Starym Josidiah Starym was an honorable and noble - born elf born in the elven empire of Cormanthyr . A bladesinger and adventurer , he was known for finding the " Artblade " and returning it to Myth Drannor , where he later served on the Council of Twelve and as Spell - Major . He was also known for being the first owner of Guenhwyvar , a magical figurine of power .
description_long: Josidiah Starym Josidiah Starym was an honorable and noble - born elf born in the elven empire of Cormanthyr . A bladesinger and adventurer , he was known for finding the " Artblade " and returning it to Myth Drannor , where he later served on the Council of Twelve and as Spell - Major . He was also known for being the first owner of Guenhwyvar , a magical figurine of power . Description . Josidiah had long golden hair and bright blue eyes . History . Josidiah was born in 101 DR to a sun elf father and Ysmyrl ' da Starym , his moon elf mother . He largely inherited his father ' s features , save for his mother ' s blue eyes , which made him a unique noble elf at the time . Being a member of the Starym clan of elves in the city of Myth Drannor , Josidiah was meant to defend the kingdom like his Lord Protector uncle , Taleisin Starym , who disagreed with the decision of Eltargrim Irithyl , Coronal of Cormanthyr , to allow " other goodly races " into the fabled city . In the year 253 DR , Josidiah was granted a gift from Anders Beltgarden , a human wizard who settled in Cormanthyr .

title: Jott
description: Jott Jott was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster . Activities . In 1491 DR , Jott and his brother Rolo were the main agents of Thylius , running for him the Yellow Breath Chapter House .
description_long: Jott Jott was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster . Activities . In 1491 DR , Jott and his brother Rolo were the main agents of Thylius , running for him the Yellow Breath Chapter House . However , an adventuring party hired to find some missing noblewomen entered the house and defeated Jott .

title: Jouka
description: Jouka Jouka was a gnome inhabiting the Samek Valley who helped defeat the ice devil Vreesar in 1366 DR . Possessions . Jouka wore a strange " badger - fighting suit " , which was a sort of spiked body armor .
description_long: Jouka Jouka was a gnome inhabiting the Samek Valley who helped defeat the ice devil Vreesar in 1366 DR . Possessions . Jouka wore a strange " badger - fighting suit " , which was a sort of spiked body armor . With it , he would damage enemies by embracing them . History . Jouka was one of the few who offered help to the Harper Martine in her fight against the Burnt Fur gnoll tribe led by the ice devil Vreesar .

title: Joy
description: Joy Joy is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . Joy was brought up by priests of Lathander together with her twin sister , Light of Heavens .
description_long: Joy Joy is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . Joy was brought up by priests of Lathander together with her twin sister , Light of Heavens . She is a dancer who takes pride in bringing happiness and light to the people and can be found at the Merchant ' s District in Neverwinter during Act III . Joy can be recruited to Crossroad Keep to serve at the inn to fulfill a quest given by Sal , the tavern keeper at the Keep .

title: Joyella
description: Joyella Joyella was a gnome and active member of the Zhentarim in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Joyella was a member of a Zhent party in the Underdark .
description_long: Joyella Joyella was a gnome and active member of the Zhentarim in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Joyella was a member of a Zhent party in the Underdark . They tried to rob an underground drow caravan but failed , and a bounty was placed on her . She was tracked and captured by two duergar bounty hunters . The duergar later tracked another bounty , the traitorous drow Arrizz , to the Goodroot farm in the Moonsea , but were killed by some adventurers .

title: Jozul Piniago
description: Jozul Piniago Duke Jozul Piniago was a human man and a noble of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . He held the title of " Duke " among Procampan nobility .
description_long: Jozul Piniago Duke Jozul Piniago was a human man and a noble of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . He held the title of " Duke " among Procampan nobility . When King Azoun IV launched his crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Duke Piniago sold supplies to the army , and profiteered off the campaign . He took little other part in the war , yet felt unjustly proud of his involvement . He considered the Tuigan to be little more than barbarian bandits , however . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , Piniago hosted a banquet at his palace , to which he invited some 22 guests , including his courtesan , the Hierarch Orn Thavil of the local temple of Tymora , and the lama Koja of Khazari , the former grand historian of Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde . Koja requested money from the Duke to fund the mass - printing of his next work , " A History of the Tuigan " . However , the amount was more than Piniago was willing to pay , and he only desired a single copy to hoard his own library . Piniago ' s consort insulted Koja , and the lama excused himself . Personality . Piniago was blunt , boorish , and coarse - mannered .

title: Ju - Hai Chou
description: Ju - Hai Chou Ju - Hai Chou was the Minister of State of Shou Lung around 1358 DR . Personality . Ju - Hai Chou was the model of a perfect career mandarin : subtle , clever and learned .
description_long: Ju - Hai Chou Ju - Hai Chou was the Minister of State of Shou Lung around 1358 DR . Personality . Ju - Hai Chou was the model of a perfect career mandarin : subtle , clever and learned . He used his skills to hold his ministry together . However , if needed , he would use force without hesitation . Activities . Ju - Hai Chou ably managed all fifteen departments of his ministry , plus all the Shou ambassadors to foreign lands . He also received ambassadors and emissaries from other countries . In time , he had managed to gain contacts and allies in most of the provincial and foreign ruling families . He often worked with Governor Kawabi of Chou ' Yuan province . History . Ju - Hai Chou had , for a long time , ruled the most powerful ministry of Shou Lung . Around 1350 DR , he managed to install his protege Ting Mei Wan as the new head of the Ministry of State Security . This movement permitted Ju - Hai Chou to use the State Security ' s resources as his own . However , he did not fully trust Ting Mei ; instead , he put a ninja in place as her secretary with an order to spy on her , and assassinate her if need be .

title: Jub
description: Jub Jub was a half - drow half - orc fisherman in Skullport . History . Jub was originally a slave saved from his slavers by Elkantar Iluim and his men .
description_long: Jub Jub was a half - drow half - orc fisherman in Skullport . History . Jub was originally a slave saved from his slavers by Elkantar Iluim and his men . Out of gratitude he sometimes act as spy for Qilué Veladorn . Around 1375 DR , Jub was torn apart by a dracolich while spying the Selvetargtlin ' s attack on the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . Leliana Vrinn resurrected him , but as an emotionless being . In 1379 DR , Jub was fishing with his companions when he happened to meet Leliana again as she was investigating a wizard ' s construct . During the Ghaunadaur ' s followers attack to the Promenade Jub was casually there and was put inside the Pit together with Naxil by the Ghaunadaur ' s priests that was trying to awoke the avatar of their god .

title: Jubal
description: Jubal Doctor Jubal was a businessman in the Moonsea . Activities . Doctor Jubal managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .
description_long: Jubal Doctor Jubal was a businessman in the Moonsea . Activities . Doctor Jubal managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities . He was always in his wagon counting his money or dealing with the day - to - day running of the carnival . He never asked questions of his workers . History . Doctor Jubal had managed his carnival for almost ten years . At one point , he bought a strange mirror maze in Waterdeep . At the start of the Rage of Demons , he hired the doppelganger Tak , promising to help her against the Great Law of Humanity in Hillsfar . However , he did not truly care about it and when Tak discovered this , she subdued Jubal and took his position . Jubal was imprisoned inside the mirror maze together with Berl Cuttler , Aelia , Weet Greenspen , and others . Rumors . Some said that Jubal was a wizard from Hillsfar who had lost his magic or else a member of the Red Plumes .

title: Judarin
description: Judarin Judarin , also called the Sot , was an elven bard / sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Judarin was rude and lacked respect for authority and any organized religion .
description_long: Judarin Judarin , also called the Sot , was an elven bard / sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Judarin was rude and lacked respect for authority and any organized religion . Description . Judarin was a drunk who always appeared disheveled . His " dolman " was stained with wine . Activities . He spent much of his time reciting poetry and verses detailing his agnostic beliefs and general lack of faith for the Enlightened gods , an act for which he would probably be executed as a heretic if even taken before a " qadi " . However , Judarin seemed doomed , or blessed , to forever remain surrounded by obscurity .

title: Judgment of Abd Hikmat
description: Judgment of Abd Hikmat The Judgment of Abd Hikmat was an item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item was a simple scroll with nonmagical script .
description_long: Judgment of Abd Hikmat The Judgment of Abd Hikmat was an item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item was a simple scroll with nonmagical script . Powers . This scroll was the judgment of Abd Hikmat , a long - dead " qadi " whose name literally meant " slave of wisdom , " concerning ownership rights to the pearl banks of Jumlat and Gana . Abd Hikmat ruled that Jumlat broke the Law and awarded more of the banks to Gana .

title: Jugicha
description: Jugicha Jugicha was a city in the Plain of Horses in Kara - Tur . It lay at the foot of the Chigidi Mountains , beside the Chukei Plains . It was the home and capital of the Tsu - tsu tribe .
description_long: Jugicha Jugicha was a city in the Plain of Horses in Kara - Tur . It lay at the foot of the Chigidi Mountains , beside the Chukei Plains . It was the home and capital of the Tsu - tsu tribe . History . Around the mid - 800s DR , a band of rebels split from the Fankiang city of Li - Raz . They desired to found their own community , and so settled Jugicha . This triggered a realignment of the " hsing " ( clans ) , of the Plain of Horses , ultimately giving rise to the Tsu - tsu . " Circa " 1337 DR , the " qaghan " ( ruler ) of the Tsu - tsu and Jugicha was Shajji Ghoiji . Ghoiji was corrupt and his government fell into chaos and finally rebellion . Ghoiji ' s " apa qaghan " , his assistant and brother Shajji Hoijarek , stepped in , gathering capable advisors to his side and becoming " qaghan " in his place . Over the next two decades , Hoijarek worked to reestablish order in Jugicha and revive Tsu - tsu prosperity . Hoijarek remained as " qaghan " of Jugicha and the Tsu - tsu around 1357 DR . Description . Jugicha held a number of temples staffed by lama s , for the various faiths known in the Plain of Horses . People .

title: Jui - jung Nu Nam
description: Jui - jung Nu Nam Jui - jung Nu Nam was a traveling cook in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Jui - jung Nu Nam sold his noodle soup to visitors , claiming that his was the best soup in all Shou Lung .
description_long: Jui - jung Nu Nam Jui - jung Nu Nam was a traveling cook in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Jui - jung Nu Nam sold his noodle soup to visitors , claiming that his was the best soup in all Shou Lung . In truth , his soup was terrible but Jui - jung believed that customers lacked taste .

title: Juiblex
description: Juiblex Juiblex ( pronounced " JOO - ee - blex " ) , known as the Faceless Lord , was a demon lord and lord of ooze s and shapeless things . He was a lesser deity and one of the triumvirate of the Lost Gods of the Underdark ( the other two being the Elder Elemental God and the Dark God . Description .
description_long: Juiblex Juiblex ( pronounced " JOO - ee - blex " ) , known as the Faceless Lord , was a demon lord and lord of ooze s and shapeless things . He was a lesser deity and one of the triumvirate of the Lost Gods of the Underdark ( the other two being the Elder Elemental God and the Dark God . Description . The Faceless Lord often appeared to be a 9 - foot - tall cone of slime striped with black , green , brown , yellow , and gray . At other times , he was nothing more than a pool of animated ooze . In all forms , Juiblex was covered in pulsating red eyes that could look in any and all directions . Spawn of Juiblex were the look - alikes of the demon lord himself . Personality . Juiblex was the least complicated of the demon lords in that his only plans were destruction and ruin and he cared little for intrigue . Combat . Juiblex could crush and absorb those he caught up in his acidic pseudopods . His amorphous body was difficult to damage . Most weapons barely harm him and blunt weapons were just useless . Worse though was his powerful acid that consumed or ruined nearly everything that touches him .

title: Juju zombie
description: Juju zombie A juju zombie was an exceptionally powerful type of zombie . Created by potent magics , they were stronger , faster , and more cunning than the basic shambling corpse . Unlike a normal zombie , juju zombies retained their consciousness and the awareness of their undead state made them horribly vicious and cruel .
description_long: Juju zombie A juju zombie was an exceptionally powerful type of zombie . Created by potent magics , they were stronger , faster , and more cunning than the basic shambling corpse . Unlike a normal zombie , juju zombies retained their consciousness and the awareness of their undead state made them horribly vicious and cruel . For this reason , juju zombies were popular among Red Wizards and could be found in greater numbers in Thay . To create a juju zombie required a " create undead " spell cast by a powerful spellcaster or the touch of the blightspawned .

title: Jukum
description: Jukum Jukum was the second - largest Iulutiun settlement . Geography . Jukum was located on southeastern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea , west of the Cuccu Stream .
description_long: Jukum Jukum was the second - largest Iulutiun settlement . Geography . Jukum was located on southeastern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea , west of the Cuccu Stream . Layout . Unlike most Ulutiun settlements , Jukum was laid out in an organized manner . It was divided into four districts . The north district contained a fresh - water pool and small canals brought water to the homes of the villagers . The east district was the location of the yearly " sukkiruchit " market . The southern district was divided off for games and feasts , and the western district for the butchering of animals . The western district contained twelve separate " ukujik " for this purpose . Snowhouse s were constructed in straight rows , and the entire village was surrounded in a circle by a dozen " quaggi " for communal meals . Government . Like most large Iulutiun villages , Jukum was overseen by a village council , or " iquemelum " . Culture . The culture of Jukum was one that strongly encouraged excellence in the arts . The village was full of beautiful ice sculptures , children learned from an early age how to play music on bone flutes , and choirs sang epic , poetic tales at the end of feasts .

title: Julain De ' Spri
description: Julain De ' Spri Julain De ' Spri was a ghost noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In his past , Julain was a magistrate in Waterdeep .
description_long: Julain De ' Spri Julain De ' Spri was a ghost noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In his past , Julain was a magistrate in Waterdeep . He was buried in Undermountain after his death with his wife Amori De ' Spri . In 1479 DR , the vampire Dayan resurrected Julain as a ghost during an experiment . Julain wandered alone inside his tomb . Meanwhile , Amori had been resurrected as a living being by Dayan and moved to another location . He was concerned about Amori but urged her to continue to live without him protecting their family .

title: Julani Baenre
description: Julani Baenre Julani Baenre was a drow wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan and the Master of Evocation at Sorcere . History . Along with the other mages of House Baenre , Julani aided Gromph Baenre in attacking Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal during the Siege of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Julani Baenre Julani Baenre was a drow wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan and the Master of Evocation at Sorcere . History . Along with the other mages of House Baenre , Julani aided Gromph Baenre in attacking Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal during the Siege of Menzoberranzan . However his " magic missile " spell was reflected back on Julani , killing him .

title: Julen Serrat
description: Julen Serrat Julen Serrat was a young rogue and member of the Guardians branch of House Serrat of Delzimmer . As the youngest son of his branch of the Serrats , Julen stood to inherit very little . His father Ramul intended to apprentice him to one of his brothers who traded with drow and dwarves in the Underdark .
description_long: Julen Serrat Julen Serrat was a young rogue and member of the Guardians branch of House Serrat of Delzimmer . As the youngest son of his branch of the Serrats , Julen stood to inherit very little . His father Ramul intended to apprentice him to one of his brothers who traded with drow and dwarves in the Underdark . Abilities . Julen was trained by his family in skills such as lockpicking and poisoning . Julen had some immunity to poisons because he took small doses of poisons daily from age four . He was an accomplished knife fighter . Relationships . Julen had a crush on his older cousin Zaltys and secretly wished to marry her , which , because Zaltys was adopted , would have been legal according to Serrat family rules . History . In 1479 DR Julen was sent into the jungles of Southern Faerûn with the Travelers branch of the Serrat clan to assist with the terazul harvest . While in the jungle , Zaltys , a ranger and accomplished archer , taught him some of the basics of forest craft . Zaltys learned that her birth clan may not have been slaughtered but rather imprisoned in the Underdark and decided to venture underground to find survivors .

title: Julia Ravensblood
description: Julia Ravensblood Julia Ravensblood was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Julia was a research wizard in Murann .
description_long: Julia Ravensblood Julia Ravensblood was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Julia was a research wizard in Murann . While she was researching a " sleep " spell , her lover Allon traveled to Maztica . Julia decided to meet him in Helmsport , but discovered that he had died at the hands of some Viperhand monsters . Julia wanted to explore this new world and study Hishna and Pluma magic , and hoped to kill some Viperhand monsters as well . Personality . Julia decided to remain in Maztica in order to avenge the death of her lover . However , she became fascinated by all of the new magic she discovered . She understood that she was one of the few wizards on the entire continent . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Julia Ravensblood is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Julnar bint Bahija
description: Julnar bint Bahija Julnar bint Bahija was a holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar was selected for a special mission and agreed to have her body permanently polymorphed to appear as a beautiful elf .
description_long: Julnar bint Bahija Julnar bint Bahija was a holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar was selected for a special mission and agreed to have her body permanently polymorphed to appear as a beautiful elf . She was tasked with infiltrating the Mosque of Bountiful Jisan in Huzuz and assassinating Imam Moral , who disagreed with the Gilded Palm ' s methods .

title: Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi
description: Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi supervised Huzuz ' s Foreign Bureau in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar reported to Ambassador Jiraad , but she directly managed the bureaus of local relations , Zakhara n relations , and distant relations .
description_long: Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi supervised Huzuz ' s Foreign Bureau in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar reported to Ambassador Jiraad , but she directly managed the bureaus of local relations , Zakhara n relations , and distant relations . She was a competent ambassador and bureaucrat .

title: Julthoon Street
description: Julthoon Street Julthoon Street was a street in Waterdeep that ran east to west . The Sea Ward was north of the street and the Castle Ward was south . Prior to 1255 DR , the city walls were outside this street .
description_long: Julthoon Street Julthoon Street was a street in Waterdeep that ran east to west . The Sea Ward was north of the street and the Castle Ward was south . Prior to 1255 DR , the city walls were outside this street . At the western end of the street , the 27m ( 90ft ) Walking Statue stood .

title: Jumlat
description: Jumlat The large city of Jumlat , the " City of Multitudes , " ( together with Gana ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name : It ' s most important source of income was the harvest and trade of pearl s . Outside harvest time , many inhabitants of this unprepossessing and crowded city turned to begging .
description_long: Jumlat The large city of Jumlat , the " City of Multitudes , " ( together with Gana ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name : It ' s most important source of income was the harvest and trade of pearl s . Outside harvest time , many inhabitants of this unprepossessing and crowded city turned to begging .

title: Jump
description: Jump Jump is a transmutation spell used by young or inexperienced wizard s that enhances the capacity of its target to jump . When " jump " is cast on a creature , they became half again as likely to succeed in any jump . The spell is not particularly complex , but drains the mental faculties of a wizard enough that it cannot be cast again until the wizard has rested briefly , perhaps a few minutes , to refocus himself .
description_long: Jump Jump is a transmutation spell used by young or inexperienced wizard s that enhances the capacity of its target to jump . When " jump " is cast on a creature , they became half again as likely to succeed in any jump . The spell is not particularly complex , but drains the mental faculties of a wizard enough that it cannot be cast again until the wizard has rested briefly , perhaps a few minutes , to refocus himself . Prior to the Spellplague " jump " was also used by sorcerer s and a similar evocation was used by druid s and ranger s . During this time " jump " , like all spells , could only be used a number of times per day equal to the number of times a wizard had prepared to use it or a sorcerer had energy left for spellcasting .

title: Jumpa River
description: Jumpa River The Jumpa River , or Jumpa Muren , was one of the largest rivers in all of Toril . Geography . Located in the Hordelands and northeast Faerûn , the Jumpa River originated within Katakoro Shan in Khazari , flowing past A - Ling Shan , where it joined the Gaya at the Great Pass within the southern region of the majestic Yehimal mountains .
description_long: Jumpa River The Jumpa River , or Jumpa Muren , was one of the largest rivers in all of Toril . Geography . Located in the Hordelands and northeast Faerûn , the Jumpa River originated within Katakoro Shan in Khazari , flowing past A - Ling Shan , where it joined the Gaya at the Great Pass within the southern region of the majestic Yehimal mountains . Description . Over time the large quantity of water flowing down the Jumpa River eroded the great channel known as the Jumpa River Gorge . This impressive feature lined the entire western edge of the mountain ranges along the river , forming the western borders of several nations , including Khazari and Ra - Khati . The average depth of the gorge was 1 , 000 ft . ( 305 m ) . Yearly glacial run - off filled the Jumpa River with frigid water that was capable of carrying away nearly anything in its path . The only known crossing point of the Jumpa River and the gorge was the Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati .

title: Jumpa River Gorge
description: Jumpa River Gorge The Jumpa River Gorge was one of the largest canyons in all of Toril . Geography . Formed from the churning waters of the mighty Jumpa River , the gorge stretched along Katakoro Shan passed the countries of Khazari and Ra - Khati before entering the lands of East Faerûn .
description_long: Jumpa River Gorge The Jumpa River Gorge was one of the largest canyons in all of Toril . Geography . Formed from the churning waters of the mighty Jumpa River , the gorge stretched along Katakoro Shan passed the countries of Khazari and Ra - Khati before entering the lands of East Faerûn . Description . The Jumpa River Gorge was steep . The cliff faces lining the gorge on either side average a height of 1 , 000 ft . ( 305 m ) . The only known crossing of the Jumpa River Gorge was the Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati .

title: Jumping
description: Jumping Jumping is a quality that can be applied to weapons . It gives the wielder abilities like a ring of feather falling , and once every twelve seconds , the wielder can gain the ability to make an extremely accurate jump . Creation .
description_long: Jumping Jumping is a quality that can be applied to weapons . It gives the wielder abilities like a ring of feather falling , and once every twelve seconds , the wielder can gain the ability to make an extremely accurate jump . Creation . To forge a " jumping " weapon , a spellcaster must have " jump " and " mage hand " available .

title: Jungle avatar
description: Jungle avatar Jungle avatar was a potent divine magic spell available to priest s of the Zakhara n savage goddess Ragarra , and some specialized kahin s . It temporally changed the caster into a greater segarran . Effects .
description_long: Jungle avatar Jungle avatar was a potent divine magic spell available to priest s of the Zakhara n savage goddess Ragarra , and some specialized kahin s . It temporally changed the caster into a greater segarran . Effects . This dangerous spell physically transformed a priest into a huge crocodile - headed divine minion of the goddess Ragarra called a greater segarran , but kept their magic items , their wits , and most of their spellcasting ability intact . If the priest was powerful enough , the magic also provided bat - like wings to fly . When an enemy was slain by this form , the segarran was compelled to consume the victim at once . The priest could change back before the spell had run its course , but if no opponent had been overwhelmed and devoured , the lethal danger of the shapechange was increased , showing Ragarra ' s disfavor . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the use of specially blessed water , some blood , bitter herbs , and ground scales from a giant crocodile , mixed and drunk by the priest .

title: Jungle giant
description: Jungle giant Jungle giants subsist on a diet composed entirely of meat . Jungle giants roam the jungles of Zakhara quickly hunting all the prey in an area before quickly moving on to the next stretch of jungle . Jungle giants stand 18 ’ tall and can weigh up to 3 , 000 pounds .
description_long: Jungle giant Jungle giants subsist on a diet composed entirely of meat . Jungle giants roam the jungles of Zakhara quickly hunting all the prey in an area before quickly moving on to the next stretch of jungle . Jungle giants stand 18 ’ tall and can weigh up to 3 , 000 pounds . Male jungle giants typically stand shorter than females . Jungle giants can live to 200 years old . With light green hair and yellow skin , their lean but powerful frames blend easily into the jungles they call home . Every jungle giant carries all necessities required for life in the jungle , as well as any valuables they possess with them . They speak their own language plus those of any nearby humanoids . Some jungle giants will tattoo themselves , file their teeth to points and wear feathered headdresses to appear as frightening as possible . Jungle giants wear little clothing to provide ease of movement when fighting or stalking in the jungle . They will camouflage themselves when hunting dangerous prey . Combat . Jungle giants craft 15 ’ long bows with 6 ’ long arrows and are capable of firing them rapidly . They dip the arrowheads in a paralyzing poison . Jungle giants prefer to strike from hiding .

title: Juni
description: Juni Juni was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Juni ' s husband disappeared and Juni thought that the lizardlings have captured him .
description_long: Juni Juni was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Juni ' s husband disappeared and Juni thought that the lizardlings have captured him . Mayne did not want to make a search for him , so the Kalach - Cha could find him . William , Juni ' s husband , was hiding away from his wife near Highcliff Castle , as he does not want any more responsibilites . The Kalach - Cha could persuade him to come back or let him go . Coming back to Juni , the Kalach - Cha could also tell her the truth or lie .

title: Junyu
description: Junyu Junyu was one of the greatest swordsmen in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Junyu was once one of the most talented duelists in Kozakura , tutoring many students , but sensing a void in his life he decided to become a priest in a Konjo temple .
description_long: Junyu Junyu was one of the greatest swordsmen in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Junyu was once one of the most talented duelists in Kozakura , tutoring many students , but sensing a void in his life he decided to become a priest in a Konjo temple . Junyu still accepted a few pupils but now his lessons to them were harder and more philosophical . His current pupil was Miyoshi .

title: Jurina Plem
description: Jurina Plem Jurina Plem was an art seller in Mulmaster . Personality . She considered Andrik Gos a genius and a true artist , not caring for the monetary value of his paintings .
description_long: Jurina Plem Jurina Plem was an art seller in Mulmaster . Personality . She considered Andrik Gos a genius and a true artist , not caring for the monetary value of his paintings . History . Jurina was hired by Zor Faltyn Gos to manage the Ironheart Gallery , a new art gallery owned Faltyn and Tiega Gos . She mostly sold the paintings of Andrik Gos .

title: Jurisk Ulhammond
description: Jurisk Ulhammond Jurisk Ulhammond was a human man of Waterdeep . He was a moneylender as well as the leader of the Trades Ward cell of the Red Sashes in Waterdeep . He was one of only two members of the Sashes , along with Naneatha Lharilstar , that knew the true identity of their secretive leader , known only as " The One " .
description_long: Jurisk Ulhammond Jurisk Ulhammond was a human man of Waterdeep . He was a moneylender as well as the leader of the Trades Ward cell of the Red Sashes in Waterdeep . He was one of only two members of the Sashes , along with Naneatha Lharilstar , that knew the true identity of their secretive leader , known only as " The One " . Death . After running into a greater doppelganger called Ptola , who was a member of the Unseen , Jurisk fell and his identity was stolen by the shapeshifter . Hlaavin , the leader of the Unseen , was undecided about what to do with their new - found position .

title: Jurth
description: Jurth Jurth was an orog member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Jurth was at the Sacred Stone Monastery .
description_long: Jurth Jurth was an orog member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Jurth was at the Sacred Stone Monastery . Soon after , however , some adventurers infiltrated the monastery and in the end confronted and defeated Jurth and his minions . Activities . Jurth led two other orogs and the ogre Drool in acting as subterranean guards and jailers at the monastery .

title: Just chancellor
description: Just chancellor A just chancellor , or the Lord Just Chancellor , of Tethyr was the primary legal authority of the kingdom . Hierarchy . The Lord Just Chancellor was superior to four sub - chancellors : The Just Chancellor also directed a group of judges known as High Justicars and Justicars .
description_long: Just chancellor A just chancellor , or the Lord Just Chancellor , of Tethyr was the primary legal authority of the kingdom . Hierarchy . The Lord Just Chancellor was superior to four sub - chancellors : The Just Chancellor also directed a group of judges known as High Justicars and Justicars . Duties . The Just Chancellor and his four subordinates oversaw the magistrates and sheriffs , the writing of laws , and the issues of noble succession and inheritance . Only the Justicars , High Justicars , the Just Chancellor , or the queen herself was permitted to make rulings in matters of " High Justice " , cases where capital punishment against nobility was involved . History . In earlier times , the king or queen held ultimate legal power in Tethyr , but when Queen Zaranda Star came to power , she established the courtly title of Just Chancellor to provide a balance of powers . In 1370 DR , the Lord Just Chancellor of the kingdom of Tethyr was former adventurer and Duke of Suretmarch , Tardeth Llanistaph .

title: Justicar ( sword )
description: Justicar ( sword ) Justicar is the powerful longsword wielded by the former god of justice , Tyr . It was gifted to him either by Ao or Tyr ' s predecessor . Mystra aided in its creation .
description_long: Justicar ( sword ) Justicar is the powerful longsword wielded by the former god of justice , Tyr . It was gifted to him either by Ao or Tyr ' s predecessor . Mystra aided in its creation . Since Tyr ' s death fighting off a demonic invasion of Celestia , the sword is stuck in a white stone in the hearth of Martyrdom , Ilmater ' s Dominion in Celestia . Abilities . In " Faiths and Pantheons " , Justicar is depicted as a " + 5 vorpal longsword " . Other abilities are unknown . In " Faiths & Avatars " , it was an unnamed + 3 Sword of Sharpness that can detect lies , alignment , invisible things , & characters with levels in the Rogue class .

title: Justice blade
description: Justice blade A justice blade was a magic sword made by the church of Tyr . Many of them had been forged . Description .
description_long: Justice blade A justice blade was a magic sword made by the church of Tyr . Many of them had been forged . Description . It appeared to be made from bronze that had been magically hardened . It was inscribed with the holy symbol of Tyr , a hammer and scales . Powers . It was a " + 1 holy mighty cleaving longsword " . The blade gave off a white light to about 20 ft ( 6 m ) when drawn .

title: Justice domain
description: Justice domain Justice can come as the fight for what is just ' until the right has been wronged or the halls of law and order reaching a conclusion . All the deities that claim the justice domain have different views on how justice is best served . The keeper of law , Amaunator looks upon justice as law followed to the very letter and that there are extremely rare times when one can stray from the path of law .
description_long: Justice domain Justice can come as the fight for what is just ' until the right has been wronged or the halls of law and order reaching a conclusion . All the deities that claim the justice domain have different views on how justice is best served . The keeper of law , Amaunator looks upon justice as law followed to the very letter and that there are extremely rare times when one can stray from the path of law . To Bahamut , the god of dragons , justices is nothing like Amaunator . The platinum dragon considers that the greater justice is fighting evil and taking down oppressive regimes . Power of Justice Domain . Any divine caster that worships a deity who claims the justice domain may choose to channel the deities powers within the domain , when a caster has this domain chosen she will become more insightful . And when she casts a offensive ability associated with the domain , when it hits the target , all her wounded allies near by will be granted more damage for a short time from the divinity of the domain channeling trough the caster .

title: Justice of weald and woe
description: Justice of weald and woe Justice of Weald and Woe is a prestige class that originated within the ranks of elven nationalist group called Eldreth Veluuthra , though there are no known members who have expanded from that organization . Justices are the agents of elven lords hired to slay men . They do so by becoming skilled hunters who wield their bow s with expertise .
description_long: Justice of weald and woe Justice of Weald and Woe is a prestige class that originated within the ranks of elven nationalist group called Eldreth Veluuthra , though there are no known members who have expanded from that organization . Justices are the agents of elven lords hired to slay men . They do so by becoming skilled hunters who wield their bow s with expertise . Membership . Members of Eldreth Veluuthra enlist would - be Justices from among the ranks of skilled rogue s , ranger s and druid s who share the ideology of the organization and take it upon themselves to act on these ideals . They often begin by being the skilled archer in a party of Eldreth Veluuthra wizard s and sorcerer s .

title: Justiciar of Tyr
description: Justiciar of Tyr A Justiciar of Tyr was a member of a special prestige class of law - enforcers , magistrates , and judges . The Justiciars acted as the elite servants of Tyr , the living embodiment of their patron god ' s portfolio . To become a Justiciar , one was required to show combat prowess , spellcasting abilities , skill at diplomacy , and great knowledge about laws and religions .
description_long: Justiciar of Tyr A Justiciar of Tyr was a member of a special prestige class of law - enforcers , magistrates , and judges . The Justiciars acted as the elite servants of Tyr , the living embodiment of their patron god ' s portfolio . To become a Justiciar , one was required to show combat prowess , spellcasting abilities , skill at diplomacy , and great knowledge about laws and religions . They defended the calm and the orderly , detected chaos and lies , and punished anarchists .

title: Justran Daehl
description: Justran Daehl Justran Daehl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Justran managed the Helm at Highsun tavern along with Garlen Harlathurl .
description_long: Justran Daehl Justran Daehl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Justran managed the Helm at Highsun tavern along with Garlen Harlathurl . He also spied on citizens with the aid of fellow cultist Ghileeda . History . In 1491 DR , Justran noticed some adventurers hired to find a diplomatic caravan that had disappeared near the city . They probably uncovered him .

title: Juz ' la
description: Juz ' la Juz ' la was an independent spy on Waterdeep in c . 1372 . Juz ' la born on Skullport and in her youth , she survived as a spy , selling secrets to the highest bidder .
description_long: Juz ' la Juz ' la was an independent spy on Waterdeep in c . 1372 . Juz ' la born on Skullport and in her youth , she survived as a spy , selling secrets to the highest bidder . After crossing road with the slaver Zstulkk Ssarmn however she was captured , transformed in a Tainted one and trained as sorcerer ; after she was send by Zstulkk Ssarmn as his personal spy among the followers of Cyric . She after time she really covert to the Dark Sun ' s faith and for some time Juz ' la worked as double - agent . When his master discovered the duplicity she managed to escape in the surface . Now she work as spy lord for various guilds and merchants of Waterdeep .

title: Juzimura rebellion
description: Juzimura rebellion The Juzimura rebellion was the revolt and subsequent slaughter of thousands of " radical " worshipers of Chantea and their displaced ronin mercenaries by the government forces of Wa around 1337 DR . The followers of the oft - distrusted western goddess Chantea had gathered at Juzimura Castle in the south of Tsukishima , presumably to protest the xenophobic rule of the new Shogun , Matasuuri Nagahide , who had come to power the year before . The shogun sent his troops to purge the castle of its inhabitants and thousands were slaughtered .
description_long: Juzimura rebellion The Juzimura rebellion was the revolt and subsequent slaughter of thousands of " radical " worshipers of Chantea and their displaced ronin mercenaries by the government forces of Wa around 1337 DR . The followers of the oft - distrusted western goddess Chantea had gathered at Juzimura Castle in the south of Tsukishima , presumably to protest the xenophobic rule of the new Shogun , Matasuuri Nagahide , who had come to power the year before . The shogun sent his troops to purge the castle of its inhabitants and thousands were slaughtered . Subsequently , the shogun declared the worship of Chantea punishable by execution .

title: Jymahna
description: Jymahna Overview . Jymahna is a female human Lich and member of the Twisted Rune . She was once a concubine of Shangalar before he made her into a lich .
description_long: Jymahna Overview . Jymahna is a female human Lich and member of the Twisted Rune . She was once a concubine of Shangalar before he made her into a lich . She wears a magical silver mask with unknown properties . She has ties to many caravans which makes her an important source of news about remote lands .

title: Jyordhan
description: Jyordhan Jyordhan was a Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale between 1339 DR and his death in 1345 DR . Background . When Aumry was assassinated by Zhentarim agents in 1339 DR , Jyordhan captured and killed these assassins , claiming the " Pendant of Ashaba " and presenting himself as the new lord , to which the people of Shadowdale agreed .
description_long: Jyordhan Jyordhan was a Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale between 1339 DR and his death in 1345 DR . Background . When Aumry was assassinated by Zhentarim agents in 1339 DR , Jyordhan captured and killed these assassins , claiming the " Pendant of Ashaba " and presenting himself as the new lord , to which the people of Shadowdale agreed . Jyordhan moved the seat of power in Shadowdale from the traditional Twisted Tower of Ashaba to Castle Krag , and the location was soon full of Zhentarim agents . A revolt by the people triggered the dispatch of peacekeeping forces from Zhentil Keep , and although Syluné Silverhand was aware of Jyordhan ' s true nature , she sought to maintain order in the dale rather than try to overthrow him . Jyordhan was killed in 1345 DR when he ambushed Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun on leaving Shadowdale , although official accounts state that Jyordhan was visiting Khelben in Waterdeep when he passed away from an illness . Jyordhan had nominated Lyran of Melvaunt as a successor to the lordship , but without the " Pendant of Ashaba " no claim could be made .

title: Jyzrill
description: Jyzrill Jyzrill was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Jyzrill was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of wizards of Sshamath and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .
description_long: Jyzrill Jyzrill was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Jyzrill was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of wizards of Sshamath and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: K ' yorl Odran
description: K ' yorl Odran K ' yorl Odran was the matron mother of House Oblodra in the drow city of Menzoberranzan from 961 DR until the house ' s destruction in 1358 DR . Description . K ' yorl was a small and physically weak drow .
description_long: K ' yorl Odran K ' yorl Odran was the matron mother of House Oblodra in the drow city of Menzoberranzan from 961 DR until the house ' s destruction in 1358 DR . Description . K ' yorl was a small and physically weak drow . She wore simple clothing and was rather unremarkable . Personality . K ' yorl always seemed to emit an air of supreme confidence . She was always arrogant and even hostile to others . She wore an infamous grin that revealed that she was lying but didn ' t care who knew it . She was devoted to the pleasures of the mind . She used her powers for petty revenge at times . Despite being a priestess of Lolth , she did not appear at all devout , and even appeared blasphemous at time . Despite that , she remained in Lolth ' s favor until her demise . History . Earlier years . K ' yorl became matron mother of House Oblodra in 961 DR . Her house used its wild talents to ascend to the third house of Menzoberranzan by 1297 DR , obliterating many of the houses that stood in their way . Despite having smaller forces than houses behind them , K ' yorl ' s wiliness in politics , as well as her skill in psionics , kept the house secure in its position .

title: Ka ' Narlist
description: Ka ' Narlist Ka ' Narlist was a dark elf and ilythiiri . He was also the archmage and ruler of Atorrnash . His home was known as Ka ' Narlists Keep and dominated the city .
description_long: Ka ' Narlist Ka ' Narlist was a dark elf and ilythiiri . He was also the archmage and ruler of Atorrnash . His home was known as Ka ' Narlists Keep and dominated the city . He was also a worshiper of the elemental evil , the god Ghaunadaur . Biography . He lived in the Dawn Age at the time when the first gold elves came to Faerûn . Nearly 300 years after the elves of Tintageer came to the north of Faerûn he was visited by Sharlario Moonflower and his son Cornaith . During this event he gave the younger moon elf a small dagger as a gift . But it was also magically enhanced to enable the dark elf to scry on the elves in the north . He had the ambitions to spread war between the elven races and profit from this . He also wanted to get some Avariel to create magical flying troops of winged dark elves . Centuries later the dagger was a precious part of the treasures of Sharlarion . It was wielded by Kethryllia Amarillis defending the city against an army of orcs . The orcs were led by the demon Haeshkarr , a servant of Lolth .

title: Ka ' ioa ' Tara
description: Ka ' ioa ' Tara Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a free spirit , rejecting all conventions of her people .
description_long: Ka ' ioa ' Tara Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a free spirit , rejecting all conventions of her people . Her upbringing gave her more freedom and self - confidence to choose her own path . Many believed her destined to a high - ranking position in shalarin society but Ka ' ioa ' Tara believed her place was among the Dukars and the Nantarn Alliance . History . Ka ' ioa ' Tara was one of the few shalarin born and raised inside Myth Nantar and from this derived her independent mind . Ka ' ioa ' Tara become one of the first new Dukars of the Order of Maalirn . In 1370 DR , Ka ' ioa ' Tara , with her companions Dinam and Paxas , were guiding ships attacked by Myth Nantar ' s " mythal " away from the city and toward the Shipwreck Plains . In one of the ships they discovered surface dwellers . Relationship . Ka ' ioa ' Tara was totally oblivion of the Ri ' ola ' kirk ' s attraction for her .

title: Kaanyr Vhok
description: Kaanyr Vhok Kaanyr Vhok was a cambion , leader of the Scoured Legion ( sometimes seen as Scourged Legion ) , and Master of Hellgate Keep . Description . As the son of a marilith and a human father , Vhok appeared mostly humanoid , but with light olive - colored skin and silver hair .
description_long: Kaanyr Vhok Kaanyr Vhok was a cambion , leader of the Scoured Legion ( sometimes seen as Scourged Legion ) , and Master of Hellgate Keep . Description . As the son of a marilith and a human father , Vhok appeared mostly humanoid , but with light olive - colored skin and silver hair . Most believed him to be an aging half - elf due to his pointed ears . Beneath his rich clothes , Vhok ' s chest , arms , and legs were covered with deep green scales that showed his tanar ' ri heritage . His skin was finely scaled and he had strong features . He had pointed teeth . He was tall and had the strength of a stone giant . He had red skin that was hot and hard enough to turn a blade . He was also handsome , despite his black teeth . He could fly at will and was resistant to fire . Vhok ' s symbol was a scepter in a gauntleted hand . Personality . Vhok was very charismatic . He had a regal bearing and carried himself with elegance and dignity despite his demonic heritage . When dealing with others Vhok was cultured and polite , but this charm was all for show . He could be very ruthless when taking actions to increase his power . Vhok viewed everyone around him as an enemy .

title: Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil
description: Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil was the powerful ruler of the dao . < br > Activities . Much less athletic than the usual noble dao , he had shrewd mind for schemes and business of all sorts , and was always open to new ideas and technologies to improve the empire of the dao , called the Great Dismal Delve , and his personal wealth .
description_long: Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil was the powerful ruler of the dao . < br > Activities . Much less athletic than the usual noble dao , he had shrewd mind for schemes and business of all sorts , and was always open to new ideas and technologies to improve the empire of the dao , called the Great Dismal Delve , and his personal wealth . The Great Khan governed the affairs of his people ( and their many slaves ) from the Hidden Fulcrum of the Dao , the secret audience chamber in the center of the Sevenfold Mazework , the capital of the dao on the Elemental Plane of Earth . History . Though Kalil Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil did not leave his palace often , he took an active interest in Zakhara n affairs . When the monarch traveled to the Prime Material Plane , his splendor was always announced by earthquakes . Legend ascribed to him power akin to that of the gods . It was also rumored that the Great Khan of the Dao was once bested by the Faceless God of the Yak - men , forcing the dao to serve those enemies of Enlightenment .

title: Kachin
description: Kachin Kachin was the high priest of Qotal in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Kachin led the most powerful temple in Ulatos .
description_long: Kachin Kachin was the high priest of Qotal in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Kachin led the most powerful temple in Ulatos . In 1361 DR , he discovered that the young slave Erixitl would be decisive in the plan for the return of his god . He went to Kultaka and bought her from her master , transporting her to Payit with the idea of making Erixitl a high priestess . Kachin taught her all about the faith of Qotal , but because of the plots of the worshipers of Zaltec she was instead decisive in starting the war between the Golden Legion and the Payits . Meanwhile , Kachin and Erixitl befriended the young stranger Halloran but some time after they were attacked by one of the Ancient Ones , Spirali . They managed to kill him only thanks to the arrival of the Nexalan Eagle Knight Poshtli but it was too late for Kachin .

title: Kadar
description: Kadar Kadar was a fallen empire of Zakhara , that lay in the jungles of the Nogaro and the adjacent river valleys , southeast of the Haunted Lands and south of World Pillar Mountains and Jungle of Monsters . Some sages believed that Kadarasto was once its capital . Its language was Kadari .
