title: Kadar al Ilmater
description: Kadar al Ilmater Kadar al Ilmater was a Calishite human monk of Ilmater , a member of the Order of St . Uzurr , the Abbot of the Cloister of St . Uzurr , and leader of the city of Uzurr in Lapaliiya " circa " 1372 DR .
description_long: Kadar al Ilmater Kadar al Ilmater was a Calishite human monk of Ilmater , a member of the Order of St . Uzurr , the Abbot of the Cloister of St . Uzurr , and leader of the city of Uzurr in Lapaliiya " circa " 1372 DR . History . Sometime " circa " 1370 DR , Kadar learned of the cruel process by which yuan - ti transformed humans into tainted one s and broodguard s . Seeing a terrible suffering , he focused on finding a means to undo the process and restore victims to full humanity . Though still unsuccessful , a spy for the yuan - ti House Eselemas operating within his Order reported that he was nearing a solution . In response , yuan - ti pureblood s began infiltrating Uzurr on Eleasias 1 , the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR , with the aim of assassinating Kadar .

title: Kadarasto
description: Kadarasto The city of Kadarasto sat atop a bluff above the Nogaro River , about 100 mi ( 160 . 93 km ) up the flow from Dihliz . Structure .
description_long: Kadarasto The city of Kadarasto sat atop a bluff above the Nogaro River , about 100 mi ( 160 . 93 km ) up the flow from Dihliz . Structure . The city ' s appearance was dominated by an unusual lightless and angular architecture . Kadarasto ' s long history was present in many ruins in the city and the surrounding countryside , which was believed to have once been the old kingdom of Kadar . Religion . The Enlightenment came late to this part of Zakhara , and its natives had a reputation of secretiveness , savagery , and idolatry giving Kadarasto the title " City Most Sinister " . Trade . Most of the populace was believed to derive its income from rice and more notably the antiquities trade , such as tomb robbing .

title: Kadeln Olothstar
description: Kadeln Olothstar Kadeln Olothstar was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Kadeln was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , second only to Neldryn Hawklyn , together with Seldinor Stormcloak .
description_long: Kadeln Olothstar Kadeln Olothstar was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Kadeln was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , second only to Neldryn Hawklyn , together with Seldinor Stormcloak . His demise came when Elminster returned to Athalantar and fought the magelord Taraj Hurlymm . Taraj was a close ally of Kadeln and summoned him , but Elminster and his allies killed the two mages .

title: Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi
description: Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi , or Kadin of the Silver Throat , was a half - elf rawun living in the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Possessions . Kadin owned a magical short sword , a lap zither , and his spellbook .
description_long: Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi , or Kadin of the Silver Throat , was a half - elf rawun living in the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Possessions . Kadin owned a magical short sword , a lap zither , and his spellbook .

title: Kadokawa Shigetada
description: Kadokawa Shigetada Kadokawa Shigetada was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and shugo - matadai of Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kadokawa lived in Okahira , where he had his office .
description_long: Kadokawa Shigetada Kadokawa Shigetada was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and shugo - matadai of Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kadokawa lived in Okahira , where he had his office . He led a council that took care of affairs when Hiro Yoshitoki was away . Recently , however , he had fallen under the influence of the Shou wu jen Hu Chien and under his suggestion Kadokawa introduced many reforms . Personality . Kadokawa was totally in thrall of Hu Chien and never listened to people that opposed him .

title: Kadokawa Yori
description: Kadokawa Yori Kadokawa Yori was a samurai who assisted in running a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , Kadokawa assisted Hori Gutsu as his second - in - command .
description_long: Kadokawa Yori Kadokawa Yori was a samurai who assisted in running a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , Kadokawa assisted Hori Gutsu as his second - in - command .

title: Kadorr
description: Kadorr Kadorr was a Zhentarim wizard apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Kadorr was a devious individual with great ambition .
description_long: Kadorr Kadorr was a Zhentarim wizard apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Kadorr was a devious individual with great ambition . He hated people who did not give him the correct respect and wanted revenge for also the minor slights . Also , Kadorr became infatuated by Ashemmi and was insanely jealous of both Sememmon and Dag Zoreth . History . Kadorr was the star pupil of Ashemmi for his magic ability and his ruthlessness . Many at Darkhold ignored him , thinking he was a teacher ' s pet but Kadorr took names of all of those people for future revenge .

title: Kadran Gordeon
description: Kadran Gordeon Kadran Gordeon was a lieutenant of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport in 1364 . He was the leader of the guild ' s army and a good fighter . Kadran was insanely jealous of Artemis Entreri , whom all considered the best fighter of Calimport , a title Kadran wanted for himself .
description_long: Kadran Gordeon Kadran Gordeon was a lieutenant of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport in 1364 . He was the leader of the guild ' s army and a good fighter . Kadran was insanely jealous of Artemis Entreri , whom all considered the best fighter of Calimport , a title Kadran wanted for himself . When Entreri returned to the city and Basadoni offered him a place in the guild , Kadran thought his position was at risk and used all resources of the guild to kill Entreri . However , thanks to the intervention of Bregan D ' aerthe Entreri survived , and in the end the assassin easily killed Kadran and gained control of the whole guild .

title: Kae Deverell
description: Kae Deverell Kae Deverell was a male human Purple Dragon commander of the Cormyrean stronghold of High Horn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was possessed by Bhaal . History .
description_long: Kae Deverell Kae Deverell was a male human Purple Dragon commander of the Cormyrean stronghold of High Horn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was possessed by Bhaal . History . Deverell was a lazy and dull Purple Dragon commander stationed in the Cormyrean stronghold of High Horn during the Time of Troubles . He helped the then - human Kelemvor and Midnight , who were pursued by Cyric and his men . Later , the fortress was attacked by the avatar of Bhaal , but thanks to the growing power of Midnight , they captured him . Against all prudence , Deverell wanted to put the god of the assassins on trial , and the delay caused by this permitted Bhaal to escape . In a twist of irony , Bhaal chose Deverell as his new avatar . At last , Bhaal was killed by Cyric and Deverell died with him . However , Deverell ' s spirit was not destroyed , and searching for an entrance to the Fugue Plane in Kanaglym , he met Midnight and apologized to her for his stupidity .

title: Kaedlaw Burdun
description: Kaedlaw Burdun Prince Kaedlaw Burdun was the son of Queen Brianna Burdun of Hartsvale . Description . In his natural form , Kaedlaw was a rather normal - looking child , although he was extremely large for his age .
description_long: Kaedlaw Burdun Prince Kaedlaw Burdun was the son of Queen Brianna Burdun of Hartsvale . Description . In his natural form , Kaedlaw was a rather normal - looking child , although he was extremely large for his age . He had gray eyes , a cleft chin , straight nose , and curly , black hair . However , due to the strange circumstances of his conception , when he was first born , he appeared to different people as they expected to see him — either as an extremely handsome child with the features of Tavis Burdun or an extremely ugly , even hideous or monstrous child . Relationships . Kaedlaw ' s mother was Brianna , a descendant of Brun , son of Hartkiller , which made both her and her son descendants of Annam All - Father . As a child of prophecy and carrying the blood of Annam All - Father , Kaedlaw had a unique and miraculous parentage — he literally had two fathers , the ettin Arno and Julian and the firbolg hero Tavis Burdun . In this way , he had three different lines of giant s in his ancestry . History . In 1366 DR , his mother , Brianna was magically drugged and raped by Arno and Julian in disguise as an attractive human prince and under orders from the Twilight Spirit .

title: Kael
description: Kael Kael was the half - drow son of the alu - fiend Aliisza and drow wizard Pharaun Mizzrym . He was a paladin of Torm . Description .
description_long: Kael Kael was the half - drow son of the alu - fiend Aliisza and drow wizard Pharaun Mizzrym . He was a paladin of Torm . Description . Kael had dusky gray skin , short white hair , an " aquiline face , " and garnet - colored eyes . Aliisza thought that he had " Pharaun ' s smug smirk . " Personality . Kael ' s personality was generally that of a calm , silent , and dedicated servant of the House of the Triad . His " quarter - demon " heritage sometimes overcame him when challenged or mocked , leading him to showing a sort of tempered rage . He loyalty to Torm came from his upbringing and having convinced himself not the question the gods , only to serve . History . Aliisza conceived Kael at the end of 1372 DR or the beginning of 1373 DR during her dalliances with Pharaun Mizzrym in and around Menzoberranzan . However , she was not aware of the pregnancy for quite a while , and when she was made aware , she believed the child was that of Kaanyr Vhok . Vhok , aware of the pregnancy ( but not that the child wasn ' t his ) , arranged for Aliisza to be captured by angel s and taken to the House of the Triad to be judged .

title: Kaeledhin
description: Kaeledhin Kaeledhin was the recipient of one of Ithraides ' s " telkiira " . It was taken by Sarya Dlardrageth who , over five thousand years later , concealed it on the body of Philaerin after he was killed , and was subsequently taken up by Araevin Teshurr .

title: Kaelen Sarssir
description: Kaelen Sarssir Kaelen Sarssir was a inhabitants of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Kaelen was an actor that casually inherited the Talking Troll tavern but he had no interest in managing it well .

Instead his dream was transformed the building in a theater , if somehow he find the moneys , and the ambition , to start the project

title: Kaelyn
description: Kaelyn Kaelyn the Dove was a half - celestial cleric of Ilmater . She fought alongside the Kalach - Cha during his / her adventures in the Unapproachable East . Behind the scenes .
description_long: Kaelyn Kaelyn the Dove was a half - celestial cleric of Ilmater . She fought alongside the Kalach - Cha during his / her adventures in the Unapproachable East . Behind the scenes . Kaelyn was voiced by . Despite being a former doomguide , she has none of the prerequisites for that class and no levels in it . ( Of course , doomguide wasn ' t available as a class until " Storm of Zehir " . ) If she stands on the dais in the mirror puzzle at the Academy of Shapers and Binders , the mirror form of her that appears at the other end has the wings of an erinyes .

title: Kaer ' lic Suun Wett
description: Kaer ' lic Suun Wett Kaer ' lic Suun Wett was a drow priestess of Lolth and part of a band of four along with Ad ' non Kareese , Donnia Soldou and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Kaer ' lic lost her right eye in a battle almost a hundred years ago before 1371 DR , and she replaced it with a black eye from a giant spider .
description_long: Kaer ' lic Suun Wett Kaer ' lic Suun Wett was a drow priestess of Lolth and part of a band of four along with Ad ' non Kareese , Donnia Soldou and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Kaer ' lic lost her right eye in a battle almost a hundred years ago before 1371 DR , and she replaced it with a black eye from a giant spider . Although she claimed that she could see with the spider eye , her comrades knew that this was not true . History . Kaer ' lic was once a member of House Suun Wett of Ched Nasad . She was killed by King Obould Many - Arrows when he tore out her throat with his teeth in retribution for her sabotage of his armor during his fight with Drizzt Do ' Urden , and her subsequent attempt to kill him in a magically - conjured earthquake when her sabotage failed . Relationships . She was the part - time lover of Tos ' un , although she was not particularly interested in having a partner .

title: Kaeth
description: Kaeth Kaeth , also known as coffee , was a brewed beverage made from ground beans . Considered a rare delicacy in areas north of Calimshan , kaeth was relatively common in more southerly lands , as well as in larger cities such as Athkatla , Waterdeep , and Westgate . Production .
description_long: Kaeth Kaeth , also known as coffee , was a brewed beverage made from ground beans . Considered a rare delicacy in areas north of Calimshan , kaeth was relatively common in more southerly lands , as well as in larger cities such as Athkatla , Waterdeep , and Westgate . Production . Kaeth was primarily produced in Maztica , the Anauroch desert , and areas to the south and east of Durpar . Around 1367 DR , it was claimed that coffee grew only in the Shining Lands of Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden , and coffee was the Shining Lands ' most profitable export . However , coffee sold in Halruaa was said to come from Ulgarth , the land beyond Durpar , and it was said Ulgarth was where the only true coffee was grown . Kaeth beans were harvested from short trees in mountainous areas , then sun - dried on rocks . When dried , the beans would be stuffed into cloth sacks , then the sacks would be stacked inside wooden crates for ease of transport . The flat , sunny plains of the Shining Lands were also suitable for growing coffee and other crops . History . Previously enjoyed only in southeast Faerûn , Durpari traders began large - scale export of Durpar - grown coffee around 1367 DR .

title: Kaff
description: Kaff Kaff , or the Palm , was the northernmost island of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Mariners considered Kaff to be the safest island to sail near . Inhabitants .
description_long: Kaff Kaff , or the Palm , was the northernmost island of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Mariners considered Kaff to be the safest island to sail near . Inhabitants . Kaff ' s position along a major trade route , combined with its safe harbors and fresh supply of water , made it a haven for a unique group of pirates . These Kaffia pirates were actually undead ghoul s , lacedon s , and ghast s . They raided ships not for treasure , but for flesh to sate their ravenous appetites . The undead pirates were created long ago by the necromancer Alim Baybars .

title: Kaggen Entreri
description: Kaggen Entreri Kaggen Entreri was a young Warlock Knight in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Kaggen was sent with his platoon to investigate a relic from the Witch - King Zhengyi .
description_long: Kaggen Entreri Kaggen Entreri was a young Warlock Knight in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Kaggen was sent with his platoon to investigate a relic from the Witch - King Zhengyi . Personality . Kaggen was a natural leader and a forceful swordsman . Relationship . Unknown to everyone , including himself , Kaggen was the last heir of the Dragonsbane s , being a secret son of Brianne Dragonsbane .

title: Kahin
description: Kahin Kahins ( females were sometimes called kahinas ) were the practitioners of an unusual and ancient faith in the burning land of Zakhara . Also called idol priests , they saw divinity not only in the gods but in all things , and saw a divine force at work in the universe as a whole . They did not , however , necessarily believe that this force worked toward a discernible goal .
description_long: Kahin Kahins ( females were sometimes called kahinas ) were the practitioners of an unusual and ancient faith in the burning land of Zakhara . Also called idol priests , they saw divinity not only in the gods but in all things , and saw a divine force at work in the universe as a whole . They did not , however , necessarily believe that this force worked toward a discernible goal . Kahins strove for balance and moderation both for themselves and the world around them . Together with the fact that they were often wandering , this attitude often led them to take the role of mediators , especially in Al - Badia society . Each kahin channeled the power of the universe in a different way , through worship of a particular idol , holy site , or local god . Despite their name , idol priests considered the worship of living idol s as savage and opposed their cults . Kahins were very loosely organized , usually traveling without others of their faith , but recognized and helped each other whenever the need arose . Very experienced idol priests formed the Circle of Aged Masters and took upon themselves the instruction of like - minded youths .

title: Kahvoerm Irithyl
description: Kahvoerm Irithyl Kahvoerm Irithyl was the first Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 4000 DR to his death in - 2900 DR , having been the first elf clan leader to draw the Rulers ' Blade . At the wish of the dying Coronal Oacenth of Jhyrennstar , and with the support of the nobles and the Council of Trees he united the realms of Semberholme , Jhyrennstar , and Elven Court into the empire of Cormanthyr . Kahvoerm spent the first part of his rysar seeking a spot for the new empire ' s capital .
description_long: Kahvoerm Irithyl Kahvoerm Irithyl was the first Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 4000 DR to his death in - 2900 DR , having been the first elf clan leader to draw the Rulers ' Blade . At the wish of the dying Coronal Oacenth of Jhyrennstar , and with the support of the nobles and the Council of Trees he united the realms of Semberholme , Jhyrennstar , and Elven Court into the empire of Cormanthyr . Kahvoerm spent the first part of his rysar seeking a spot for the new empire ' s capital . According to the legend of the " Founding Song " , after years of wandering through the woods of Cormanthor and visiting settlement , village and tree - dwelling of the elves in his domain ( including a foray into old Elven Court ) , he came upon a hillock under a shadowtop tree , where he entered into reverie . He wandered into the air and up among branches through the canopy before coming to a glade . There , atop a hill , he saluted the sun and drove his Rulers ' Blade into the earth amid a circle of flowers . Sunlight poured from the sword , and when he drew it , the hill rose rather than yield the blade .

title: Kai Chiang Lung
description: Kai Chiang Lung Kai Chiang Lung was a chiang lung dragon in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Kai was a chiang lung dragon residing at the bottom of Lake Sari .
description_long: Kai Chiang Lung Kai Chiang Lung was a chiang lung dragon in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Kai was a chiang lung dragon residing at the bottom of Lake Sari . He could be summoned on nights of a full moon . If the summoners offered a treasure , Kai would fulfill a request . He preferred painters , writers , and scholars . Kai took his vigilance over the lake very seriously and was angered at anyone who violated the beauty of his lake . During summer days , Kai " polymorph ed " himself into human in a drifting rowboat and indulged in philosophical discussions with boaters .

title: Kai Tsao Shou Chin
description: Kai Tsao Shou Chin Kai Tsao Shou Chin was the emperor of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR History . Kai Tsao was born as the eight son of emperor Hsiao Chin , the Seventh Emperor of the Chin Dynasty . However , early in his life , his mother fell into a disagreement with the emperor and she fled with him from the Great Court , starting a new life in far Kao Shan .
description_long: Kai Tsao Shou Chin Kai Tsao Shou Chin was the emperor of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR History . Kai Tsao was born as the eight son of emperor Hsiao Chin , the Seventh Emperor of the Chin Dynasty . However , early in his life , his mother fell into a disagreement with the emperor and she fled with him from the Great Court , starting a new life in far Kao Shan . Here , he lived like a simple noble until he ascended the Jade Throne in the year of 1339 DR , taking the name of Kai Tsao Shou , or He Who Rebuilds the Dragon . With his first official proclamation , he established the Gathering of the Pearls , creating many new ministries devoted to recovering what had been lost by the weak and foolish dynasties before him . He commissioned great public works and revived the navy . In 1357 DR his greatest concern was the romantic involvement of Princess Mei Ling with a young prince of T ' u Lung In 1358 Kai Chin ' s main concern was Chu ' Yuan province , troubled by mysterious assailants . The Emperor send General Goyat Nagumo to pacify the area but he went missing .

title: Kai Tyran Uviel
description: Kai Tyran Uviel Kai Tyran Uviel was a bandit in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kai was a member of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek .
description_long: Kai Tyran Uviel Kai Tyran Uviel was a bandit in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kai was a member of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek . During a meeting with another bandit group , the Claws of Tiamat , he acted as sentry at the meeting of the two leaders of the outlaws . However , an adventuring party hired to clear the Iron Route of outlaws killed him .

title: Kaia
description: Kaia Kaia were aberration s that lived in the Spur Forest near the Akanamere . Description . These horrid creatures used darkvision and tremorsense to hunt prey .
description_long: Kaia Kaia were aberration s that lived in the Spur Forest near the Akanamere . Description . These horrid creatures used darkvision and tremorsense to hunt prey . Ecology . A mature kaia mother reproduced asexually , birthing up to a dozen kaia spawn at a time . Then the mother would devour all things in its path , including the spawn . History . The genasi Ghaelya once told tales of kaia in 1479 DR , that were told to her by her mother . She later leaned against a tree in the Spur and mumbled an old rhyme that asked the nightmares to leave her alone and remove her name from the trees . Rumors and legends . Folklore had it that the kaia was an ancient beast from an other plane . It was to have been a serpent charged by foul gods to devour the children of the genasi . However , it was afraid of the light , which a clever child exploited to frighten it and it retreated into the deep forest . When the Blue Breath of Change ( the Spellplague ) . The kaia was thought to be the cause of the nightmares that Ghaelya and other children experienced , so as to test their courage .

title: Kaian
description: Kaian Kaian was a old Tsuyoi - no - kami monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kaian commonly strode through the temple on one errand after another .
description_long: Kaian Kaian was a old Tsuyoi - no - kami monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kaian commonly strode through the temple on one errand after another . He always talked with himself . History . Anchin and Kaian were temped by the young maiden O - Shino , acting under the orders of monks Kogi and Bupposo of the Winter Sect temple , as part of a good prank Personality . Despite not being high - ranking or powerful a powerful Kaian was respected by his fellows for his piety and dedication .

title: Kaitlin ' s weed
description: Kaitlin ' s weed Kaitlin ' s weed was a plant found growing within the prairie lands surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls , located slightly southwest of the southern border of the great desert Anauroch . Uses . Often confused with another weed called dragon ' s breath , which was poisonous , Kaitlin ' s weed was used as a natural balm treatment for common sunburn .

Uses . Often confused with another weed called dragon ' s breath , which was poisonous , Kaitlin ' s weed was used as a natural balm treatment for common sunburn .

title: Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk
description: Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk Lady Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk was the leader of the group of Red Knight faithful known as the Order of the Red Falcon . History . During the Time of Troubles , Lady Bloodhawk became the avatar for the Red Knight and led an adventuring band to Tethyr and routed an invading horde of monsters from the region .
description_long: Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk Lady Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk was the leader of the group of Red Knight faithful known as the Order of the Red Falcon . History . During the Time of Troubles , Lady Bloodhawk became the avatar for the Red Knight and led an adventuring band to Tethyr and routed an invading horde of monsters from the region . After this she and her companions gained much fame and gratitude from the Tethyrian people .

title: Kaitlynn
description: Kaitlynn Kaitlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Kaitlynn was born with Anithlynn and Briglynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .
description_long: Kaitlynn Kaitlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Kaitlynn was born with Anithlynn and Briglynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth . The triplets were taught from birth the mysteries of mystics . By their thirteenth birthday , Celya had died . In 1379 DR her friend Laeral Silverhand went with the then - immaterial Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann to met Kaitlynn and thank to her healed Cavatina . Personality . Kaitlynn was the middle of the triplets and the most responsible , always mediating between the capricious Anithlynn and the sometimes - sullen Briglynn . At heart , she was , like their mother Celya , compassionate and utterly devoted to the Earthmother . Kaitlynn was also kind and charitable . Activities . Kaitlynn managed with her sisters the Sisters Three Waxworks . She was very capable of making non - magical love potions .

title: Kal Clewsoro
description: Kal Clewsoro Kal Clewsoro ran a camp near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Clewsoro started as a soldier , later becoming a teamster and rising to become a merchant prince .
description_long: Kal Clewsoro Kal Clewsoro ran a camp near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Clewsoro started as a soldier , later becoming a teamster and rising to become a merchant prince . In 1477 DR , he traveled to Spellgard seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel . He did not trust the Monastery of the Precipice and established a private camp near the ruin . Personality . Clewsoro considered all fellow seekers possible rivals and did not trust strangers . He loved talking about himself .

title: Kalach - Cha
description: Kalach - Cha The Kalach - Cha , also known as the Knight - Captain , was an adventurer who , among other major feats , battled the King of Shadows . The name Kalach - Cha , which is a " nom de guerre " , was coined by the Kalach - Cha ’ s githyanki enemies , in whose language the words " Kalach - Cha " mean " shard bearer , " referring to the close connection between the hero and the " Silver Sword of Gith " . Biography .
description_long: Kalach - Cha The Kalach - Cha , also known as the Knight - Captain , was an adventurer who , among other major feats , battled the King of Shadows . The name Kalach - Cha , which is a " nom de guerre " , was coined by the Kalach - Cha ’ s githyanki enemies , in whose language the words " Kalach - Cha " mean " shard bearer , " referring to the close connection between the hero and the " Silver Sword of Gith " . Biography . The Kalach - Cha was born in the village of West Harbor in the Mere of Dead Men shortly before or during the village ' s destruction . His / her mother , Esmerelle , was killed during the battle , while protecting him / her from the blast resulting from the destruction of the " Sword of Gith " in the battle and both were impaled by a shard of the Sword . Although the Kalach - Cha was badly wounded , the injury healed rather quickly and miraculously , sealing the shard behind it . Suspecting that the shard was the cause of this recovery , no one dared remove it . Unfortunately , Esmerelle was not so fortunate and she died from her wounds . Before she did , she entrusted her child with a close friend and former adventuring companion named Shayla .

title: Kalach - Cha ' s construct
description: Kalach - Cha ' s construct The Kalach - Cha ' s construct , often called simply the Construct by the hero and their companions , was a blade golem manufactured by the Illefarn ese several centuries in the past . Reactivated by agents of the King of Shadows the blade golem would eventually be neutralized and salvaged by the Kalach - Cha and their companions and used against its former owners . Physical description .
description_long: Kalach - Cha ' s construct The Kalach - Cha ' s construct , often called simply the Construct by the hero and their companions , was a blade golem manufactured by the Illefarn ese several centuries in the past . Reactivated by agents of the King of Shadows the blade golem would eventually be neutralized and salvaged by the Kalach - Cha and their companions and used against its former owners . Physical description . At over eight feet tall , the Kalach - Cha ' s construct was an impressive sight , though typical for a blade golem . Made up of an assortment of weapons and armor , the Construct was a dangerous enemy and a valuable ally . The right arm of the golem was as long as the average grown human and thick plate armor with magical enchantments gave it a great degree of protection against enemy attacks . This armor had a strangely blue color to it and this , along with its unusual aesthetics , was a sign of its origin as a weapon of war in ancient Illefarn . History . Other than its creation by the Illefarnese , little about the early history of the Kalach - Cha ' s construct can be determined for sure .

title: Kalah
description: Kalah Kalah was a gnome illusionist who worked in a circus that toured at least Amn and Tethyr . He grew bitter at being made fun of and , when the circus stopped at Waukeen ' s Promenade in Athkatla , used powers he had gained from an unknown source to turn the inside of the circus tent into an unreasonably large world of illusions in the middle of his act . Some people trapped within were killed , others seemingly turned into various monsters .
description_long: Kalah Kalah was a gnome illusionist who worked in a circus that toured at least Amn and Tethyr . He grew bitter at being made fun of and , when the circus stopped at Waukeen ' s Promenade in Athkatla , used powers he had gained from an unknown source to turn the inside of the circus tent into an unreasonably large world of illusions in the middle of his act . Some people trapped within were killed , others seemingly turned into various monsters . The illusionary world was also populated by shadows and werewolves , some of which were real enough to hurt people they attacked and others of which only became so if they were attacked back . Kalah himself appeared as an ogre - sized figure more impressive than his usual self . Two named characters trapped within the circus were Aerie and Quayle . If the player in chooses to enter the tent , they may save some of the characters trapped within and defeat Kalah , turning everything back to normal except for those people who seem to have simply disappeared after dying . Before dying , Kalah uttered his disappointment by shouting : " This is not what was promised to me ! " .

title: Kalahar Twohands
description: Kalahar Twohands Kalahar Twohands was a half - elf and the well - respected High Lord of Loudwater , formerly the " Gauntlet of the Western Marches " . Background . In 1347 DR Kalahar was the current Green Regent and led his Scions against a Tempest summoned by Talassan priests which had been terrorizing Llorkh and Orlbar .
description_long: Kalahar Twohands Kalahar Twohands was a half - elf and the well - respected High Lord of Loudwater , formerly the " Gauntlet of the Western Marches " . Background . In 1347 DR Kalahar was the current Green Regent and led his Scions against a Tempest summoned by Talassan priests which had been terrorizing Llorkh and Orlbar . After fierce fighting , Kalahar reversed the spell that had summoned it and earned himself the respect of the Delimbiyr Vale . After he became the High Lord , succeeding Nanathlor Greysword who died of old age in 1369 DR , Kalahar had to issue several difficult edicts . The mass migration of the High Forest orc s in 1372 DR led to a " Decree of Reception " which gave any orcs who entered Loudwater legal rights similar to citizens . Though none in Loudwater ever openly denounced him , Kalahar was not nearly as popular as he once was . Family . Velvred Twohands was Kalahar ' s son .

title: Kalam Bloodsword
description: Kalam Bloodsword Kalam Bloodsword was a veteran Zhentilar warrior in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Kalam was one of the Zhentilar lieutenants in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .
description_long: Kalam Bloodsword Kalam Bloodsword was a veteran Zhentilar warrior in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Kalam was one of the Zhentilar lieutenants in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . When an insurrection started thanks to Elminster Aumar the the Rangers Three ' s actions , Kalam led a company of lancemen and tried to order the rioters to go home . However , the Dalesfolk lead by Irreph Mulmar attacked the Zhents and Itharr killed Kalam .

title: Kalassyn
description: Kalassyn Kalassyn was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Kalassyn and his fellow Mrinden had fought in Daggerdale .
description_long: Kalassyn Kalassyn was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Kalassyn and his fellow Mrinden had fought in Daggerdale . In 1358 DR , Kalassyn was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . Together with his fellow Mrinden and a group of Zhentilar soldiers , he found a " gate " and a dead guard . They entered the gate but suddenly a meteor — a symptom of the Time of Troubles — hit their squad , killing most of them , including Mrinden . Still burning , Kalassyn managed to re - enter the " gate " and go back to High Dale . Kalassyn thought he would die but instead he alone survived and two nearby guards helped him to go to the castle to heal .

title: Kalb Bahriy Sahr
description: Kalb Bahriy Sahr Kalb Bahriy Sahr , or the Shark Reef , was a island chain formed from coral reefs . This reef was located in the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography .
description_long: Kalb Bahriy Sahr Kalb Bahriy Sahr , or the Shark Reef , was a island chain formed from coral reefs . This reef was located in the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography . These small islands were composed of coral and rock . No known charts existed for safely navigating them , making most sailors give them a wide berth . Dangerous waves and powerful storms surrounding the reef regularly dashed ships against the islands if they got too close . Inhabitants . As the name implied , the waters surrounding these islands were teeming with sharks of all sizes represented by many different species .

title: Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari
description: Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari was a noble marid and the Great Padishah of the Marid in 1367 DR , who ruled her subjects from her court in the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls on the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Different descriptions gave Kalbari two alternate appearances , either with skin of darkest black and hair of corraline red piled up in the shape of a turban , or skin of shimmering white with black hair .
description_long: Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari was a noble marid and the Great Padishah of the Marid in 1367 DR , who ruled her subjects from her court in the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls on the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Different descriptions gave Kalbari two alternate appearances , either with skin of darkest black and hair of corraline red piled up in the shape of a turban , or skin of shimmering white with black hair . She usually wore golden , silver , or blue - coloured robes , which gave hints of even richer garments beneath . Personality . The Great Padishah Kalbari was both whimsical and shrewd , conscious of political maneuverings and the sensitivities of her subjects , and displayed generosity and honorable behavior . She was fond of flattery and beautiful gifts , and loved to demonstrate her power over the watery element to visitors . She preferred to leave her court only rarely . Influence and interactions . The Great Padishah managed her ruling position with great political skill and preserved a sense of unity among the divergent marids both through manipulation and exemplary behavior .

title: Kalda Purefist
description: Kalda Purefist Kalda Purefist was a dwarf paladin in the Moonsea . Activities . Kalda was a paladin and an officer of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast .
description_long: Kalda Purefist Kalda Purefist was a dwarf paladin in the Moonsea . Activities . Kalda was a paladin and an officer of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast . History . In 1491 DR , after Furgis Boltsmelter stole the elemental codex from Earthfast , Kalda was chosen to lead a Hammer squad to purse him and retake the item . Near Mulmaster , she and her squad confronted Furgis and his adventuring party bodyguards when the Cult of the Black Earth attacked both groups . In the battle against earth cultists , Kalda and most of her men died . Personality . Kalda was guided by her vows to Moradin . She knew that not everyone held the same values that she did and did not expect that others lived up to her standards . Kalda respected all people with a strong personal code and disliked those who changed their mind for money .

title: Kaled bin Zafir
description: Kaled bin Zafir Kaled bin Zafir was a Zakharan inventor in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Kaled was an eccentric man , and a genius in his field .
description_long: Kaled bin Zafir Kaled bin Zafir was a Zakharan inventor in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Kaled was an eccentric man , and a genius in his field . He was usually haughty but recently a profound fear had pervaded him . The slightest sound made him jump , and he couldn ' t stop looking over his shoulder . History . Kaled was born and raised in Zakhara . He left Zakhara for Faerûn and trained with the famed gnome inventor Nadul DaRoni . He settled in Mulmaster . At one point , he wrote the acclaimed " Codex of Ingenious Contraptions " . In 1491 DR , his research attracted the interest of both Zor Aleksi Drejkov , secretly of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , and the Brotherhood of the Cloak . After the killing of Zel Tregarthen , the City Watch conducted a raid on his laboratory .

title: Kaleil
description: Kaleil Kaleil was a druid of Maiden ' s Glade near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , Kaleil transformed himself into a bear , but was not able to change back .
description_long: Kaleil Kaleil was a druid of Maiden ' s Glade near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , Kaleil transformed himself into a bear , but was not able to change back . The shadows in the Mere caused him to go mad , causing the animals of Maiden ' s Glade to grow berserk . The Kalach - Cha and Elanee could ' ve defeated him . If they did , Kaleil would warn Elanee of the threat before dying .

title: Kalen Dren
description: Kalen Dren - - Kalen Dren Kalen Dren was a human Paladin who believed in the Threefold God and was the primary crusader of the Eye of Justice . He lead a dual life as a member of an elite Waterdeep guard unit and vigilante crime fighter . Kalen suffered from a spellscar which numbed his body .
description_long: Kalen Dren - - Kalen Dren Kalen Dren was a human Paladin who believed in the Threefold God and was the primary crusader of the Eye of Justice . He lead a dual life as a member of an elite Waterdeep guard unit and vigilante crime fighter . Kalen suffered from a spellscar which numbed his body . The lack of feeling aided him when fighting but he did not experience pleasurable sensations as others did . Kalen believed his spellscar will eventually kill him . Description . Kalen had dark hair and colorless pupils . Although he had the ability to heal himself , he refused to use divine magic whenever he accidentally shed the blood of an innocent . Because of this , his body was covered with old scars . Abilities . Like the other wielders of Vindicator , Kalen could recall the sword to his hand , no matter where the sword was . Kalen was able to summon grey spiritual armor to surround his body . Possessions . Kalen wore leather armor and carried the epic bastard sword Vindicator , a blade once used by the god Helm . He wore a helmet to hide his identity as Shadowbane and had magic boots which allow him to run faster and jump farther than normal humans can . Relationships .

title: Kalia
description: Kalia Kalia was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Kalia was a member of the Champions of Muktar .
description_long: Kalia Kalia was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Kalia was a member of the Champions of Muktar . She was also a high priestess of Myrkul . Kalia commanded too the Maneuver Brigade of the Muktar ' s army . History . In 1358 DR Kalia and his fellow Champions arranged the trap inside Fort Blood planned by the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , to eliminate an adventuring party well - known in Golconda . Later she commanded her brigade in the Battle of Wilma Pass . Personality . Kalia liked show her face to the sacrificed victims she made to her god .

title: Kalian
description: Kalian The Kalian , which literally meant the Pipe or the smoking pipe , was a market located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Kalian was found in the Rookery ward of the city . Activities .
description_long: Kalian The Kalian , which literally meant the Pipe or the smoking pipe , was a market located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Kalian was found in the Rookery ward of the city . Activities . The Kalian was one of the largest markets within the city . Smoke vendors abounded here , selling incense , tobacco , smoked foods , and other aromatic luxuries .

title: Kaliesh ' erai
description: Kaliesh ' erai The Kaliesh ' erai was an organization of psionic elves based in the city of Evereska in the Western Heartlands . Activities . The majority of the members spent their time in serene mediation and contemplation of their powers , but there were some who ' d grown fascinated by psionic items .
description_long: Kaliesh ' erai The Kaliesh ' erai was an organization of psionic elves based in the city of Evereska in the Western Heartlands . Activities . The majority of the members spent their time in serene mediation and contemplation of their powers , but there were some who ' d grown fascinated by psionic items . They sought to acquire any such items they could , and gladly bought or bartered them from visitors to Evereska . Thus Evereska was a good place to find a buyer for a psionic curiosity . The Kaliesh ' erai were thus the most prolific collectors of psionic lore in the surface lands , and likely only second to the illithids in the Underdark . Base of Operations . The Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai in Evereska was the headquarters of the organization . A subbasement area contained a number of laboratories and vaults holding the group ' s collection of psionic items . This represented the largest collection of psionic lore and knowledge in Faerûn . History . Thanks to their long elven life - spans , many members of the Kaliesh ' erai had spent centuries training their minds and practicing their psychic powers , making them the top experts in psionic lore by 1373 DR .

title: Kalil yi Tulmon
description: Kalil yi Tulmon Kalil yi Tulmon was a pirate in service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Kalil usually acted as first mate on pirate ships of the Rundeen fleet out of Almraiven , Suldophor , and Theymarsh .
description_long: Kalil yi Tulmon Kalil yi Tulmon was a pirate in service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Kalil usually acted as first mate on pirate ships of the Rundeen fleet out of Almraiven , Suldophor , and Theymarsh . He was loyal first and foremost to the Rundeen , sometimes over the ship ' s captain . Kalil was also a cruel men , deceiving sailors to convince them to surrender and afterward cruelly killing them in front of their fellows . Sometimes he was specifically chosen to " teach a lesson " to a particular merchant .

title: Kalin Abd al - Bas
description: Kalin Abd al - Bas Kalin Abd al - Bas was the general and commander of the Valiant Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Description . Kalin had a streak of white running through her hair ; a trait that was identical to a hero of the Valiant .
description_long: Kalin Abd al - Bas Kalin Abd al - Bas was the general and commander of the Valiant Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Description . Kalin had a streak of white running through her hair ; a trait that was identical to a hero of the Valiant . Activities . Kalin was the youngest member of the Mamluk Council , earning her support from many of the younger mamluk s of Qudra . She trained the Valiant extensively to perfect their lightning attack techniques .

title: Kalkan Swordbreaker
description: Kalkan Swordbreaker Kalkan was a fallen deva who was transformed into a rakshasa and was the arch - nemesis of the deva Demascus . History . Like Demascus , Kalkan died many times only to be resurrected .
description_long: Kalkan Swordbreaker Kalkan was a fallen deva who was transformed into a rakshasa and was the arch - nemesis of the deva Demascus . History . Like Demascus , Kalkan died many times only to be resurrected . Kalkan killed many of Demascus ' incarnations . Kalkan helped Murmur revive the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye in Akanûl in 1479 DR . Kalkan ambushed Demascus at the tomb of Demascus ' s last incarnation but Demascus was able to kill Kalkan . Description . Kalkan had a bestial face and large cat - like ears . His breath smelled like carrion . Equipment . Kalkan possessed Damos , an artifact of great power that allowed him to see into the future . The fact that Damos killed anyone who used it did not trouble Kalkan because he always rose again in a new incarnation .

title: Kallicl
description: Kallicl Kallicl was a priest of Zaltec in Nexal , Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , he was the right - hand man of high priest Hoxitl .
description_long: Kallicl Kallicl was a priest of Zaltec in Nexal , Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , he was the right - hand man of high priest Hoxitl . He conspired with him to kill Erixitl . During the Viperhands attack at the start of the Night of Wailing , he reported to Hoxitl on the situation of the battle .

title: Kallos Tam
description: Kallos Tam Kallos Tam was a Red Wizard of Thay , a necromancer , and the true menace behind the Blackdagger Bandits that raided the High Road . History . Kallos Tam was an ambitious Red Wizard , one of the many agents of Thay sent to the Neverwinter region in 1479 DR .
description_long: Kallos Tam Kallos Tam was a Red Wizard of Thay , a necromancer , and the true menace behind the Blackdagger Bandits that raided the High Road . History . Kallos Tam was an ambitious Red Wizard , one of the many agents of Thay sent to the Neverwinter region in 1479 DR . When he discovered the Blackdagger Bandits operating along the High Road near the ruins of Cragmire Keep , he saw an opportunity . Kallos offered to Traven and Malus Blackdagger the power of undeath and they were receptive to his offer . Of course , Kallos Tam had no intention of putting the army fully at the command of the Blackdagger brothers . He intended to keep control of it for himself , ensuring that he would hold the real power in the joint venture between himself and the Blackdagger brothers . However , Traven did not trust the Thayan and decided to remained close to him to control his movements . The Harpers discovered the plot and recruited an adventurer to destroy the bandits . The adventurer infiltrated the bandits ' stronghold of Cragmire Keep and fought and defeated Malus first . The adventurer later found Kallos and Traven in a dungeon and killed them both .

title: Kalnak
description: Kalnak Kalnak was the leader of the Jaguar Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Kalnak was chosen by Naltecona to lead an ambush against the Golden Legion at Palul .
description_long: Kalnak Kalnak was the leader of the Jaguar Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Kalnak was chosen by Naltecona to lead an ambush against the Golden Legion at Palul . Following the plan , Kalnak welcomed the Golden Legion to Palul and offering a great party , while secretly his elite army waited hidden . However , the mage Darien discovered the plan thanks to her magic and informed Cordell , who was at Kalnak ' s side . Quickly Cordell surprised and killed Kalnak .

title: Kalon Doring
description: Kalon Doring Kalon Doring was the last King of Guge in the Hordelands . Rumors and Legends . It was widely rumored that the gods drove Kalon mad because he dared to challenge the might of the Celestial Emperor .
description_long: Kalon Doring Kalon Doring was the last King of Guge in the Hordelands . Rumors and Legends . It was widely rumored that the gods drove Kalon mad because he dared to challenge the might of the Celestial Emperor . With an army numbering 10 , 000 , Kalon marched onto a frozen glacier searching for the Emperor ' s forces . Kalon and his army were never seen again , though many claimed they haunted the glacier which was later named the Glacier of the Lost King .

title: Kalugin
description: Kalugin Kalugin was an officer of the City Watch of Mulmaster . Personality . Kalugin was a rigid applier of the law .
description_long: Kalugin Kalugin was an officer of the City Watch of Mulmaster . Personality . Kalugin was a rigid applier of the law . He believed himself above good and evil , taking no sides with regard to lawbreakers and offering no leniency . History . In 1491 DR , Kalugin and his patrol found Zel Tregarthen dead near an adventuring party . Believing them the criminals , he pursued them .

title: Kalzareinad
description: Kalzareinad Kalzareinad was the dragon demigod of dragon magic , in particular the selfish , uncaring , or evil application of it . Relationships . Before his death , Kalzareinad was on somewhat friendly terms with Null .
description_long: Kalzareinad Kalzareinad was the dragon demigod of dragon magic , in particular the selfish , uncaring , or evil application of it . Relationships . Before his death , Kalzareinad was on somewhat friendly terms with Null . History . Kalzareinad is said to have aided Sammaster in creating the first dracolich . In 1358 DR , the dragon goddess Kereska subsumed the enterity of his portfolio and worshipers . Kalzreinad ' s corpse appeared on the Astral Plane shortly thereafter . Null may have been gifted with the secrets of creating dracoliches after Kalzareinad ' s passing .

title: Kama
description: Kama A kama is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The kama is similar to the sickle or a small scythe and bears a strong resemblance to a heavy pick but without the backside peen .
description_long: Kama A kama is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The kama is similar to the sickle or a small scythe and bears a strong resemblance to a heavy pick but without the backside peen . It has a straight haft about the same size as a handaxe . The blade has less curvature than a sickle and starts out broader at the base before tapering to a sharp tip . An average kama costs 2gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Use . It takes special training to use the light kama effectively in melee combat , therefore it is considered an exotic weapon . The relatively long , curved blade allows the kama to be used for tip attacks . Unarmored monk s can take full advantage of this quick , slashing weapon .

title: Kamal
description: Kamal A kamal was a nautical tool used by Zakharan sailors . Uses . This device was used in navigation .
description_long: Kamal A kamal was a nautical tool used by Zakharan sailors . Uses . This device was used in navigation . A kamal was made from a rectangle of wood with rope through the center . The rope was knotted at various lengths depicting specific ports . Taking a sighting on a pole star during the evening allowed a navigator to determine which direction they were currently sailing or if they were sailing along the same latitude of a port knotted on the string . Price . Kamals could be purchased at any port city in Zakhara for less than one piece of gold .

title: Kame - Renn
description: Kame - Renn Kame - Renn was a sea dragon member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Kame - Renn was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .
description_long: Kame - Renn Kame - Renn was a sea dragon member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Kame - Renn was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Kame - Renn oversaw about the scaly animals of the water . He ruled Qui during the Season of the Turtle . He governed directing 30 giant crabs , of which 10 always on patrol . He delegated most of the affairs to his lieutenants .

title: Kamlann
description: Kamlann Duchy Kamlann was the small , mountainous duchy north of the Sulduskoon River in the central western part of Tethyr . It was mostly hill country and pipeweed plantations , but it also contained Zazesspur , the largest and richest city of Tethyr . Geography .
description_long: Kamlann Duchy Kamlann was the small , mountainous duchy north of the Sulduskoon River in the central western part of Tethyr . It was mostly hill country and pipeweed plantations , but it also contained Zazesspur , the largest and richest city of Tethyr . Geography . Kamlann encompassed the Starspire Peninsula and the land of the Starspire Mountains . It was divided into two counties , Starspur and Uluran . Government . The duchy was under the control of Lord Inselm Hhune , who was also the Lord Watch Chancellor of Tethyr and a leader of the Knights of the Shield . The official ducal castle was Tresper Hall , located in the mountains , though Hhune lived at his estate south of Zazesspur .

title: Kammarth
description: Kammarth Kammarth was a magical drug concocted from a rare surfrace root and a subterranean fungus . Description . It was taken as a powder or as a beige jelly and was either eaten or taken through skin contact , the former was a more effective way to experience its effects .
description_long: Kammarth Kammarth was a magical drug concocted from a rare surfrace root and a subterranean fungus . Description . It was taken as a powder or as a beige jelly and was either eaten or taken through skin contact , the former was a more effective way to experience its effects . Whiel it was a magical drug , the producer didn ' t need to be able to cast magic . Uses . Kammarth made one feel good and energetic but it had also real effects . First , the magical effect of the drug consisted in being one of few ways for non - spellcasters to obtain the effects of the spell " expeditious retreat " , the duration of the magical effect was a few minutes . After about a minute after the initial effect kicked in , Kammarth heightened the base agility and reflexes of its user until the spell effect ended . Overdosing with Kammarth was easy . When a person took a two doses in an 8 - hour period , he suffered physical damage and was paralyzed for a time measured in minutes . When one made the mistake of taking more than three doses , the drug caused serious damage to the body and paralyzed the person for a time measured in hours .

title: Kamo Ti
description: Kamo Ti Kamo Ti was a shopkeeper in Shou Lung . Activities . Kamo Ti lived in the city of Pasar , the largest city in the Shao Mountains .
description_long: Kamo Ti Kamo Ti was a shopkeeper in Shou Lung . Activities . Kamo Ti lived in the city of Pasar , the largest city in the Shao Mountains . He sold fish , often spoiled . However as brother - in - law of the city ' s magistrate the militia never acted against him .

title: Kamon
description: Kamon Kamon was a short and stocky human mercenary who was killed in a fight with Abdel Adrian in 1368 DR . Kamon had previously worked with Abdel in 1367 DR , guarding a warehouse in Athkatla . Kamon had blue eyes and liked to wield two axe s simultaneously .
description_long: Kamon Kamon was a short and stocky human mercenary who was killed in a fight with Abdel Adrian in 1368 DR . Kamon had previously worked with Abdel in 1367 DR , guarding a warehouse in Athkatla . Kamon had blue eyes and liked to wield two axe s simultaneously . Death . In combat with Abdel Adrian in 1368 DR , Kamon had been dispossessed of one of his two axes , and swung low at Abdel with his other axe . Abdel dodged a blow from the halberd of Eagus , which struck Kamon on the head , killing him .

title: Kamoth Kastelmar
description: Kamoth Kastelmar Kamoth Kastelmar was a member of a minor noble family of Hillsfar . Possessions . The " Kraken Queen " was equipped with a magical device created by Red Wizards known as a starry compass that allowed it to sail high into the air , even as high as Selûne .
description_long: Kamoth Kastelmar Kamoth Kastelmar was a member of a minor noble family of Hillsfar . Possessions . The " Kraken Queen " was equipped with a magical device created by Red Wizards known as a starry compass that allowed it to sail high into the air , even as high as Selûne . Activities . The Black Moon s created a base on one of Tears of Selûne out of which they operated . History . Kastelmar married into the ruling Hulmaster family of Hulburg through his marriage to Terena Hulmaster . In 1466 DR , Kamoth attempted to seize power but was thwarted and forced into exile . After his exile , Kamoth engaged in piracy on the Moonsea and eventually took command of the Black Moon pirate company , where he commanded the pirate vessel " Kraken Queen " . In 1479 DR Kamoth lead the Black Moons in an attack on Hulburg .

title: Kamus el Tarshaj
description: Kamus el Tarshaj Kamus yn Tasyn el Tarshaj was one of the many pashas of Calimport and rulers of Calimshan during its Fifth Age . Kamus el Tarshaj was remembered in history for his gift of the territory later known as Ankaram to King Silvam of Tethyr for his assistance in the Eye Tyrant Wars . This occurred in the Year of Recompense , - 150 DR .
description_long: Kamus el Tarshaj Kamus yn Tasyn el Tarshaj was one of the many pashas of Calimport and rulers of Calimshan during its Fifth Age . Kamus el Tarshaj was remembered in history for his gift of the territory later known as Ankaram to King Silvam of Tethyr for his assistance in the Eye Tyrant Wars . This occurred in the Year of Recompense , - 150 DR . On the surface , it appeared an act of generosity , but in reality , the pasha hoped to nullify rumors that Tethyr was planning to conquer all of Calimshan during one of its weakest hours .

title: Kanaglym
description: Kanaglym Kanaglym was an abandoned dwarven town . Located entirely underground and reachable by a series of caves located under Dragonspear Castle , the town was the site of the Fountain of Nepenthe , a watery portal to the Fugue Plane . History .
description_long: Kanaglym Kanaglym was an abandoned dwarven town . Located entirely underground and reachable by a series of caves located under Dragonspear Castle , the town was the site of the Fountain of Nepenthe , a watery portal to the Fugue Plane . History . The town was built when the High Moor was warm and fertile . However , a year after construction was completed , the town well ran dry . The well shaft was deepened and eventually struck water . However the source of this water was actually the Waters of Forgetfulness . A month later the town was abandoned .

title: Kanari Taro
description: Kanari Taro Kanari Taro was a korobokuru yakuza adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro lived on the streets from when he was child , never knowing about his family .
description_long: Kanari Taro Kanari Taro was a korobokuru yakuza adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro lived on the streets from when he was child , never knowing about his family . At one point , he was adopted by a small yakuza gang . However , some years after , in 1357 DR , just after becoming a regular yakuza , Taro killed a yakuza of a rival gang over an offense . For this , he was obligated to become a matatabi , a wandering yakuza . His oyabun suggested to Taro that he go to Miyama to serve oyabun Ebi . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Kanari Taro was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Kane
description: Kane Kane was a male human monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains south of Damara in the Bloodstone Lands . He was a high - ranking member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred , following Ilmater the Broken God and St .
description_long: Kane Kane was a male human monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains south of Damara in the Bloodstone Lands . He was a high - ranking member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred , following Ilmater the Broken God and St . Sollars . He rose to fame during the Bloodstone Wars of 1357 DR , being among the heroes who inspired a folk uprising against marauders . He slew with his bare hands the current Grandfather of Assassins and later delivered the blow that once - and - for - all destroyed Zhengyi , the Witch - King who had long menaced the land . He eventually became the Grand Master of Flowers of the Order of the Yellow Rose . He was reckoned by some to be " the most dangerous man in all of the Bloodstone Lands " . Description . Kane was wiry and very thin of build but still well - muscled . He dressed in simple rags and wore no jewelry other than a pair of magical rings he later acquired . His belt was but a length of rough rope , his sandals were worn and thin , and he oft - leaned on his sturdy walking stick . His appearance was just as befitted an ascetic .

title: Kang Bay
description: Kang Bay Kang Bay was a bay between the two branches of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Locations . It held a number of islands , large and small , the greatest of which were Quelpart and Kanko , it was actually a volcano that emerged from the sea .
description_long: Kang Bay Kang Bay was a bay between the two branches of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Locations . It held a number of islands , large and small , the greatest of which were Quelpart and Kanko , it was actually a volcano that emerged from the sea . Anticlockwise around the bay lay the Koryoan settlements of Tu Pe and its floating city ; Xi Hulang on the mouth of the Hoparatu River , which flowed into the bay ; Koje ; Xai Chung ; and Bejung , closest to Kanko . The bay bordered the Sea of Kozakura . History . In ancient times , when the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted , it was said that the very skies over Koryo caught fire . The land was devastated ; the city of Old Bejung , closest to Kanko , was engulfed in poisonous gas that killed all the people , before the city itself was obliterated in a matter of seconds and buried in ash . According to legend , the entire Han clan sought shelter in the vast Dang Caverns .

title: Kangaxx
description: Kangaxx Kangaxx was a powerful demilich residing in Athkatla . Personality . Kangaxx was an intensely evil man even prior to undeath .
description_long: Kangaxx Kangaxx was a powerful demilich residing in Athkatla . Personality . Kangaxx was an intensely evil man even prior to undeath . History . A group of Netheril mages defeated Kangaxx at some point after he became a demilich . Unable to fully destroy him , they were forced to become lich es themselves in order to imprison him . In 1369 DR , Gorion ' s Ward encountered the imprisoned demilich , who tricked the Ward into freeing him . In the ensuing battle , Gorion ' s Ward emerged as the victor .

title: Kani
description: Kani Kani was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kani lived in a barren seashore with his friends Rabbit and Tanuki .
description_long: Kani Kani was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kani lived in a barren seashore with his friends Rabbit and Tanuki . In 1357 DR , however , out of curiosity he decided to go explore the human world . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Kani was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Kanishta
description: Kanishta Kanishta was a root found in the Cold Lands , specifically Narfell . Description . " Kanishta " was a dark - colored root .
description_long: Kanishta Kanishta was a root found in the Cold Lands , specifically Narfell . Description . " Kanishta " was a dark - colored root . Uses . Though extremely bitter tasting , when chewed this root helped alleviate the effects of exposure to the cold weather of northeast Faerûn , infusing strength and warmth into the user .

title: Kanjentellequor Biri
description: Kanjentellequor Biri Kanjentellequor Biri was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther and a member of Clan Kanjentellequor . She was also a member of the Lance Defenders and the lover of Balasar . Description .
description_long: Kanjentellequor Biri Kanjentellequor Biri was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther and a member of Clan Kanjentellequor . She was also a member of the Lance Defenders and the lover of Balasar . Description . Biri was a rare albino dragonborn , with snow - white scales . History . In 1479 DR , Biri was one of the wizards under the command of Kriv . She studied Nala ' s documents , and discovered Skuthosiin was the one controlling the ash giants . She later assisted Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon and the Platinum Cadre during the siege of Ashhold . When Khouryn Skulldark returned to Tymanther and warned them about Tchazzar plan ' s to invade the dragonborn nation , Medrash was assigned to a mission to destroy Gestaniius and liberate High Imaskar from her forces , so the Imaskari would lend their aid to the thymari . After killing Gestaniius , Biri and her friends were sent to Luthcheq to escort ambassador Perra , who wanted to reinstate the diplomatic relations between Tymanther and Chessenta . However , when they reached the city , the Battle of Luthcheq had already began . Biri took part in the battle .

title: Kanko
description: Kanko Kanko was a volcano island in Kang Bay at the end of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . History . In ancient times , the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted ; it was said that the very skies over Koryo caught fire .
description_long: Kanko Kanko was a volcano island in Kang Bay at the end of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . History . In ancient times , the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted ; it was said that the very skies over Koryo caught fire . The land was devastated ; the city of Old Bejung , closest to Kanko , was engulfed in poisonous gas that killed all the people , before the city itself was obliterated in a matter of seconds and buried in ash . According to legend , the entire Han clan sought shelter in the vast Dang Caverns .

title: Kao Dynasty
description: Kao Dynasty The Kao Dynasty ( meaning " the High Dynasty " ) was a dynasty of the empire of Shou Lung that lasted from Shou Year 1025 ( – 225 DR ) to Shou Year 2050 ( 800 DR ) . " Kao Dynasty " was also a byword for this period of Shou Lung ' s history . History .
description_long: Kao Dynasty The Kao Dynasty ( meaning " the High Dynasty " ) was a dynasty of the empire of Shou Lung that lasted from Shou Year 1025 ( – 225 DR ) to Shou Year 2050 ( 800 DR ) . " Kao Dynasty " was also a byword for this period of Shou Lung ' s history . History . In Shou Year 1025 ( – 225 DR ) , Wo Mai , a noble who claimed descent from the first emperor Nung Fu himself , retrieved the Emblems of Imperial Authority from the crypts under the Imperial City . He rallied the armies and nobles to his cause and put down rebellions in the outer provinces of Shou Lung . Wo Mai was coronated as the first Emperor Chin of the Kao Dynasty , thus ending the Black Cycle of Years . Wo Mai , now called Chin Hu , opted to expunge various records of the past dynasty , as was a dynastic founder ' s prerogative . Chin Hu was quoted by scribes as saying " All knowledge must come from my rule , as all streams come from the mountain fastness . " In Shou Year 1072 ( – 178 DR ) , the second Emperor Chin of the Kao Dynasty was crowned and decreed the Spreading of Knowledge , also called the Opening of Wa . This demanded that the people of Wa be pacified and instilled with Shou customs .

title: Kao Shan Ten
description: Kao Shan Ten Kao Shan Ten was the Imperial Wu Jen of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kao Shan Ten had assisted and protected Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin since he was very young .
description_long: Kao Shan Ten Kao Shan Ten was the Imperial Wu Jen of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kao Shan Ten had assisted and protected Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin since he was very young . He was a master of White Chung Tao . In 1358 , only Kao Shan Ten knew that the Emperor had sent an adventuring party to find General Goyat Nagumo under the suggestion of a dream . Personality . He was a simple and loyal man , with a deep intellect .

title: Kaorti
description: Kaorti The kaorti were an alien , emaciated people from the Far Realm who wished to transform the Prime Material Plane into a place more to their liking . History . During the Dawn Ages , elves created the " Vast Gate " in an attempt to make travel anywhere instantaneous and to see what lay beyond the works of the gods .
description_long: Kaorti The kaorti were an alien , emaciated people from the Far Realm who wished to transform the Prime Material Plane into a place more to their liking . History . During the Dawn Ages , elves created the " Vast Gate " in an attempt to make travel anywhere instantaneous and to see what lay beyond the works of the gods . In doing so , the " Vast Gate " created a tiny opening into the Far Realm that allowed for an invasion from that plane ' s inhabitants . The " Vast Gate " was sealed forever , but the opening into the Material Plane from the Far Realm remained and slowly grew . A group of Imaskari wizard s who called themselves the Quin ( the Roushoum word for ' entitled ' ) , discovered ancient tablets detailing the elves ' quest for reality beyond reality . Working from what little magic al lore remained on these tablets , the Quin created the Quinspire in a much - publicized attempt to bring new magic from the other reality back to Imaskar . The Quin succeeded but within minutes of their arrival , they had attracted the attention of a vast elder evil known to the aboleth s as Zurguth .

title: Kappiyan Flurmastyr
description: Kappiyan Flurmastyr Kappiyan Flurmastyr was a wizard and loremaster in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Together with his wife , Kappiyan sold potions in order to fund his Mystra - blessed magic research .
description_long: Kappiyan Flurmastyr Kappiyan Flurmastyr was a wizard and loremaster in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Together with his wife , Kappiyan sold potions in order to fund his Mystra - blessed magic research . However , he did not like repeat customers who interrupted his studies more than once in a few months . History . Circa 1372 DR , Kappiyan married his long - time apprentice Shalara Malarrkin

title: Kar ' r ' rga
description: Kar ' r ' rga Kar ' r ' rga was a savage god worshipped by the non - Enlightened natives of Jazayir al - Sartan in Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea - human and non - human alike . Its special servants , also called its children , were the monstrous sartani , which appeared just like their god : a giant humanoid with the head of a crab . < br > The lagoon called Batihat al - Saji in the center of the island group was sacred to Kar ' r ' rga .
description_long: Kar ' r ' rga Kar ' r ' rga was a savage god worshipped by the non - Enlightened natives of Jazayir al - Sartan in Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea - human and non - human alike . Its special servants , also called its children , were the monstrous sartani , which appeared just like their god : a giant humanoid with the head of a crab . < br > The lagoon called Batihat al - Saji in the center of the island group was sacred to Kar ' r ' rga . Here offerings were placed by his followers , while trespassing non - believers were said to be destroyed . The truth of the matter was that at the bottom of the lagoon a vortex could open to Pandemonium , where the crab god resided .

title: Kara - Tur
description: Kara - Tur The large landmass of Kara - Tur lies east of Faerûn on Toril . Between Kara - Tur and Faerûn stretches the Hordelands for hundreds of miles . At the far South East of it lies the mysterious continent of Osse .
description_long: Kara - Tur The large landmass of Kara - Tur lies east of Faerûn on Toril . Between Kara - Tur and Faerûn stretches the Hordelands for hundreds of miles . At the far South East of it lies the mysterious continent of Osse . Trade , characters and artifact s occasionally arrive from Kara - Tur via the Golden Way , but beyond that there is little interaction between the continents . Countries . The various countries of Kara - Tur include : Shou Lung . The vast human empire of Shou Lung is undoubtedly the most powerful nation on the face of Abeir - Toril . The empire was started by a simple peasant known as Nung Fu who was invested with the Emblems of Imperial Authority by the semi - legendary Nine Travelers ( although it was his great grandson that would be the first Emperor of the Li Dynasty ) . The Empire of Shou Lung has the longest history in Kara - Tur second only to the Empire of Wa . It has had six dynasties so far starting with Li Dynasty ( Dynasty of Might ) , Ho Dynasty ( Dynasty of Peace ) , Hai Dynasty ( Dynasty of the Oceans ) , Kao Dynasty ( The High Dynasty ) , La Dynasty ( Wax Dynasty ) and the Kuo Dynasty ( Dynasty of the Nation ) .

title: Kara - Tur calendar
description: Kara - Tur calendar The Kara - Tur calendar was the calendar by which the civilized lands of Kara - Tur measured the months of the year . It was devised by one of the emperors of Shou Lung . Appendix .
description_long: Kara - Tur calendar The Kara - Tur calendar was the calendar by which the civilized lands of Kara - Tur measured the months of the year . It was devised by one of the emperors of Shou Lung . Appendix . Notes . " Oriental Adventures " , page 107 , says that the first day of the year coincided with some time in modern - day February or March . These correspond to the months of Alturiak and Ches in Faerûn ' s Calendar of Harptos .

title: Kara - Turan languages
description: Kara - Turan languages The Kara - Turan languages were a family of languages spoken by the majority of human s on the continent of Kara - Tur . Languages . The following language groups belonged to the Kara - Turan language family : In addition , the following languages were also among this family : The Chuchian language from the Imaskari languages family was also found among the languages of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Kara - Turan languages The Kara - Turan languages were a family of languages spoken by the majority of human s on the continent of Kara - Tur . Languages . The following language groups belonged to the Kara - Turan language family : In addition , the following languages were also among this family : The Chuchian language from the Imaskari languages family was also found among the languages of Kara - Tur .

title: Kara Chermosk
description: Kara Chermosk Kara Chermosk was the commander for the Zhentarim forces of the Tethyamar Fortress , nestled in the western Dalelands amid the Desertsmouth Mountains . Personality . Kara earned much respect from her soldiers for her iron - handed rule and severe manner , which brooked no dissent .
description_long: Kara Chermosk Kara Chermosk was the commander for the Zhentarim forces of the Tethyamar Fortress , nestled in the western Dalelands amid the Desertsmouth Mountains . Personality . Kara earned much respect from her soldiers for her iron - handed rule and severe manner , which brooked no dissent . Her time among the caravans of the Black Road gave her a great skill in negotiation , allowing her to form alliances with creatures that would normally shun her kind . Possessions . For her exceptional service , Kara Chermosk was granted a Banesword from the vaults of Zhentil Keep by Scyllua Darkhope . Relationships . Commander Chermosk harbored a secret lover in the form of her second - in - command , Captain Sergoi Meristaak . Sergoi adored Kara and stayed by her side at all times in battle . History . Raised by Zhentarim merchants in Zhentil Keep , Kara Chermosk grew up under the yoke of the Black Network ' s rule . In time , she decided to become a soldier among the Zhentarim and spent many years working as a caravan guard , making her way back and forth across the Black Road of the Anauroch .

title: Kara Hulmaster
description: Kara Hulmaster The ranger Kara Hulmaster is the cousin of Geran Hulmaster and was the current , as of 1480 DR , regent of Hulburg . In addition to her skills as an excellent warrior , Kara was a competent strategist and battle master . Appearance .
