description_long: Kara Hulmaster The ranger Kara Hulmaster is the cousin of Geran Hulmaster and was the current , as of 1480 DR , regent of Hulburg . In addition to her skills as an excellent warrior , Kara was a competent strategist and battle master . Appearance . Kara was touched by the Spellplague and carries a single spellscar . Her eyes burn with an azure fire and she has markings on her body .

title: Karador
description: Karador Karador was a small city located in the middle of Lake Myrloch on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the city was ruled by the fey queen High Lady Ordalf as the capital of Sarifal although her son Prince Araithe handled the day - to - day running of the government . Inhabitants .
description_long: Karador Karador was a small city located in the middle of Lake Myrloch on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the city was ruled by the fey queen High Lady Ordalf as the capital of Sarifal although her son Prince Araithe handled the day - to - day running of the government . Inhabitants . Most residents of Karador were Llewyrr elves , wood elves , gnomes or banshrae although a few humans lived in the city . Visitors to the city were uncommon . Military . The city was protected by a powerful mythal which could shift the city to and from the Feywild . The few leShay fey who lived in the city were powerful arcanists , more powerful than elven high mages . History . Around the time of the Spellplague High Lady Ordalf moved the city through a portal from the Feywild and it rose from the depths of Lake Myrloch . The fey forces soon routed the High King ' s troops and took control of the entire island of Gwynneth .

title: Karak
description: Karak Karak was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea . History .
description_long: Karak Karak was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea . History . Karak was once under Kozakura n rule , and they built a subterranean fortress beneath the city . Some ten generations before 1357 DR , Kozakuran forces stole the Hu ' i Wing , a sacred relic in the town of Goisho , and carried it off to Karak . They built it into the fortress . Around the year 1200 by Koryoan reckoning , many refugees of Karak sailed along the coast to Tu Pe and moored their to the city ' s famous Long Pier . The ensuing traffic jam grew and grew until it became the notorious Floating City . In 1357 DR , Karak was at the center of an ongoing war for territory between the kingdom of Koryo and advance forces of Kozakura . The war left many innocent people injured , and around a thousand people fled north to Singye and camped outside that city . One morning , the bodies of fifteen black - clad ninja were discovered in the streets of Karak , and they were seen as evidence of Kozakuran encroachment . King Wanang Sun considered dispatching more soldiers to the area . Locations .

title: Karakil chaka
description: Karakil chaka The Karakil chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . This chaka focused on foresting and the milling of harvested timber .
description_long: Karakil chaka The Karakil chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . This chaka focused on foresting and the milling of harvested timber . They owned many sawmill factories in Morvar which were used to process the lumber taken from the Ajmer Forest to the north . The River Lesh was used to transport the lumber downstream . Base of Operations . The Karakil chaka was based out of Morvar in eastern Durpar .

title: Karasendrieth
description: Karasendrieth Karasendrieth was a female adult song dragon who lived in Impiltur around 1374 DR . Description . As a song dragon , Kara was able to take the form of a beautiful , willowy , silver - haired human .
description_long: Karasendrieth Karasendrieth was a female adult song dragon who lived in Impiltur around 1374 DR . Description . As a song dragon , Kara was able to take the form of a beautiful , willowy , silver - haired human . In her draconic form , she was a slender dragon with silvery blue scales . Relationships . She and Dorn Graybrook became lovers . History . She participated in the effort to rid Faerûn of Sammaster ' s Rage of Dragons during 1373 DR .

title: Karatin
description: Karatin Karatin was a seaport city at the mouth of the Hungtse River . It was built on a swamp , but partly settled on a cleared - out jungle . History .
description_long: Karatin Karatin was a seaport city at the mouth of the Hungtse River . It was built on a swamp , but partly settled on a cleared - out jungle . History . It was founded during the Hai Dynasty in 830 . It was one of the first cities to have a unified architectural theme . It had northern facing buildings and wide paved stone streets with the Great Palace of the Sea Lords in the center of the city . Notable locations . Karatin also had the Temple of the Jade Empress , a beautiful temple erected by the Sea Lords around a statue of the Empress Ti Hai Chin , wife of the Hai Dynasty ' s founder . The harbor was deep and well dredged . Ships constantly came here for silk , rice and to learn advanced sciences . It was a busy port , where people could acquire almost any type of goods , and meet folk from all over Kara - Tur . This was also the port to which most foreigners came when they visited Kara - Tur .

title: Karazikar
description: Karazikar Karazikar was a beholder living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Like all of its kind , Karazikar was arrogant , hateful , and paranoid .
description_long: Karazikar Karazikar was a beholder living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Like all of its kind , Karazikar was arrogant , hateful , and paranoid . It plotted to seize the Maze Engine . Relationship . Karazikar had a mad but loyal human servant named Shedrak . History . Karazikar was a typical beholder until it met the last Great Modron March . Karazikar captured a pentadrone modron and discovered that the reality - shifting Maze Engine was somewhere in the Underdark . So its goal became to find and seize the engine . For this , Karazikar tried to capture as many modrons and similar creatures as possible . At one point , it captured an adventuring party , killed many of them . The survivor , Shedrak , became his favorite slave . During the Rage of Demons , Karazikar was killed by an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of the demon lord s . They were in need of the central eye of a beholder for a rite to banish the demon lords .

title: Kardann
description: Kardann Kardann was an official of the government of Amn in 1361 DR . History . In 1361 DR , Kardann was assigned to the Golden Legion for their Maztica n expedition .
description_long: Kardann Kardann was an official of the government of Amn in 1361 DR . History . In 1361 DR , Kardann was assigned to the Golden Legion for their Maztica n expedition . He was tasked with safeguarding Amnian interests during the journey . Soon after the battle near Payit , he conspired with some legionaries to return to Faerûn in order to secure the first partition of gold . In order to stop Kardann ' s plot and avoid more complications , Cordell decided to burn the ships . Kardann was disliked by most of the legionaries . His only other action of note occurred during the Legion ' s stop in Nexal , when he found the lost gold treasure of Axalt . He quickly betrayed Cordell to side with Don Vaez , saying that it was the best interests of Amn , but in truth for the promise to sail back to Faerûn . When Cordell regained control of Helmsport Kardann escaped alone in the jungle . At last while in the jungle he met a very hungry jaguar lord in search of food .

title: Kardhel Terov
description: Kardhel Terov Kardhel Terov is a fellthane among the Warlock Knights and an ambitious merchant . Background . In the Year of the Ageless One , Terov approached Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe , offering the warchief his own kingdom of Thar in exchange for an oath of fealty and an agreement not to endanger cities under Kardhel ' s protection .
description_long: Kardhel Terov Kardhel Terov is a fellthane among the Warlock Knights and an ambitious merchant . Background . In the Year of the Ageless One , Terov approached Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe , offering the warchief his own kingdom of Thar in exchange for an oath of fealty and an agreement not to endanger cities under Kardhel ' s protection . Wanting to have a protected trade route from Vaasa to the Moonsea , he provided the chieftain with arms and armaments and the loyalty of several other Thar ran tribes , which Mhurren then used to march on Glister and then Hulburg , where the army was defeated . Appearance . Kardhel is a tall human with pale skin , hair of iron gray , and a normally clean - shaven face . As a result of his forming the pact with Telos that all Warlock Knights take , his eyes are a deep , bloody crimson . When he may be going into danger , Kardhel wears ebon plate mail with a black helm fitted with gilded ram ' s horns curling from the sides . Possessions . Among Terov ' s possessions is a heavy iron band carved with dire runes , which encircles his ring finger .

title: Karel Mahorne
description: Karel Mahorne Karel Mahorne was a human cleric of Mielikki who dedicated her life to the curing of lycanthrope s and who was the leader of the Silver Stake , an organization with this goal . Activities . Because of her by then considerable age , during the years following the Time of Troubles , she worked exclusively from the company ' s compound near Baldur ' s Gate .
description_long: Karel Mahorne Karel Mahorne was a human cleric of Mielikki who dedicated her life to the curing of lycanthrope s and who was the leader of the Silver Stake , an organization with this goal . Activities . Because of her by then considerable age , during the years following the Time of Troubles , she worked exclusively from the company ' s compound near Baldur ' s Gate . History . Early in her life , Karel ' s husband and child were slain by a werewolf pack . She went on to form the Silver Stake with Dram Kallen and they were joined by others who had a similar cause .

title: Karen Wynn Fonstad
description: Karen Wynn Fonstad Karen Wynn Fonstad was a geographer and cartographer know for designing the atlases of a number of fictional settings , including and D & D ' s and Forgotten Realms setting . Education . Fonstad earned her B .
description_long: Karen Wynn Fonstad Karen Wynn Fonstad was a geographer and cartographer know for designing the atlases of a number of fictional settings , including and D & D ' s and Forgotten Realms setting . Education . Fonstad earned her B . S . in Physical Therapy from the , but then changed fields and continued on to receive her Masters degree in cartography from the same university . Career . Fonstad was the Director of Cartographic Services for the and also served on the City Planning Commission for Oshkosh . She created many fictional atlases , notably " The Forgotten Realms Atlas " , which was published in 1990 .

title: Karffbadh
description: Karffbadh Karffbadh was the capital of one of the satrapies of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography . The city of Karffbadh once sat on the tip of a penisula extending west from what would later be called Icewind Dale .
description_long: Karffbadh Karffbadh was the capital of one of the satrapies of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography . The city of Karffbadh once sat on the tip of a penisula extending west from what would later be called Icewind Dale . Description . While once a great city , by 1372 DR , all that remained was a shrine of five green standing stones . These stones acted as a portal to Choshein , a sister city of the Empire , and to the capital of Jhothûn . Activating the portal required simply touching one of the stones . The default destination was Choshein , but one could travel to the city of Jhothûn by speaking its name . When activated , a web of green energy appeared among the stones , and persons could step into this web of energy to be transported to one of the other cities . When the destination was changed to Jhothûn , the web was purple in color . As late as 1372 DR , the portal was still functioning , yet its power was dangerously weak , and it could only be activated once a day . Sometimes , it flickered just as one was stepping into the energy web , which would cause the user to plummet into a sinkhole located in the middle of the stones . Government .

title: Kargien Dissengulp
description: Kargien Dissengulp Kargien Dissengulp was a deep gnome burrow warden in Blingdenstone . History . Kargien was a burrow warden who had escaped from Blingdenstone in 1371 DR .
description_long: Kargien Dissengulp Kargien Dissengulp was a deep gnome burrow warden in Blingdenstone . History . Kargien was a burrow warden who had escaped from Blingdenstone in 1371 DR . Circa 1439 DR . he led the first expedition back to the ruins of the city and started reconstruction . In 1479 DR , he was busy trying to clear the city from all hostile factions and so hired adventurers . Personality . Kargien liked to be the chief .

title: Karigulzu
description: Karigulzu Karigulzu was the nominal ruler of Red Haven in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Karigulzu was sent as a sacrificial lamb to the most dangerous town of Unther .
description_long: Karigulzu Karigulzu was the nominal ruler of Red Haven in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Karigulzu was sent as a sacrificial lamb to the most dangerous town of Unther . Personality . Karigulzu believed himself to be smarter than he truly was . He believed that one day he would be the most powerful man in the land but was too stupid to betray the god - king Gilgeam .

title: Karim Ben Aziz
description: Karim Ben Aziz Karim Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Karim served as the captain of the marketplace guards in Bandar al - Sa ' adat .
description_long: Karim Ben Aziz Karim Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Karim served as the captain of the marketplace guards in Bandar al - Sa ' adat . All of the guardsmen serving under him were also close family members . Relationships . Karim was the younger brother of Mahmud Ben Aziz .

title: Karis
description: Karis Karis was the mad wife of Elden Vargas in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . History . Karis was a storm sorceress of Rashemen .
description_long: Karis Karis was the mad wife of Elden Vargas in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . History . Karis was a storm sorceress of Rashemen . Before the Spellplague , during a diplomatic mission , Karis met and fell in love with the War Wizard of Cormyr , Elden Vargas . They remained always together . However , when it was discovered that Elden had entered into a pact with Asmodeus in order to augment his psychic powers , he was attacked by his fellows . In the battle , Karis tried to protect him and was hit by Ganrahast Aeiulvana and lost her mind . After moving to Neverwinter , Karis suffered a collapse and , thanks to Mordai Vell , Elden took her to Helm ' s Hold . She regained a little of her mind in the Cathedral , where Elden conducted a ritual to cure her by absorbing into her a storm . He was defeated by adventurers however , and it was not clear if Karis was cured or not .

title: Karl
description: Karl Karl , commonly known as Dumb Karl , was a dwarf farmer in the Moonsea . Personality . Karl was a homely individual but despite his appearance and nickname he was actually quite bright .
description_long: Karl Karl , commonly known as Dumb Karl , was a dwarf farmer in the Moonsea . Personality . Karl was a homely individual but despite his appearance and nickname he was actually quite bright . Activities . Karl was a hill dwarf farmer who provided much of the grain sold to Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , his business declined because the Merchants Guild of Hillsfar started to boycott non - human farmers . Plus , some Red Plumes decided to make money kidnapping farmers around the city and selling them to duergar slavers . So Karl joined a bandit group in order to attack a caravan protected by corrupt Red Plumes . An adventuring party caught in the middle dealt justice and Reginald and his surviving men had to face a tribunal .

title: Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen
description: Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen was the head priest of Gond in Skullport . History . Karl was the main proponent of building a water clock with his clergy and the gnome twins Tykkyl Burrwarden and Tohkkal Burrwarden .
description_long: Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen was the head priest of Gond in Skullport . History . Karl was the main proponent of building a water clock with his clergy and the gnome twins Tykkyl Burrwarden and Tohkkal Burrwarden . In 1370 DR , the clock was finished but was so delicate that it always needed the constant supervision of three priests , who rotated their management duties .

title: Karl Waller
description: Karl Waller Karl Waller is a comic book and fantasy artist . Education . Waller graduated from the in 1987 .
description_long: Karl Waller Karl Waller is a comic book and fantasy artist . Education . Waller graduated from the in 1987 . Career . Waller illustrated many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks between 1988 and 1998 . He also illustrated for a large number of other role - playing and collectible card games . He also illustrated one of the comic prequels for the movie .

title: Karma curse
description: Karma curse Karma curse was a powerful clerical spell from the charm sphere . Users . Only clerics and priests without evil in their hearts could use this spell .
description_long: Karma curse Karma curse was a powerful clerical spell from the charm sphere . Users . Only clerics and priests without evil in their hearts could use this spell . On Toril , it was typically only used by priests of the Padhran religion , though it was not impossible for another deity to grant it to one of their own priests if they had specific need of it . Effects . A cleric who used this spell was guaranteed that the target of the spell would never behave unethically toward them . Upon casting the spell , the caster determined the precise nature of ethics from which he would be guarded , namely theft , murder , truth , or breaking a promise . That is , a target placed under a " theft " " karma curse " could never steal from the caster , one under a " murder " " curse " could not slay the caster , one under a " truth " " curse " could not lie to them , and one under a " promise " " curse " could not break a promise they ' d made to the caster . If the target attempted to violate these conditions , the " curse " would be activated and they would rapidly lose experience and understanding , and indeed , karma , until they ceased .

title: Karne
description: Karne Karne , also called Kharne was an agent for the Zhentarim . He was formerly a sellsword operating in Nashkel and the mortal enemy of the vampire king of the Battle of the Bones , Mordoc SeLanmere . Karne was quick to ascend through the ranks of the Black Network and was likely a direct advisor to Fzoul Chembryl .
description_long: Karne Karne , also called Kharne was an agent for the Zhentarim . He was formerly a sellsword operating in Nashkel and the mortal enemy of the vampire king of the Battle of the Bones , Mordoc SeLanmere . Karne was quick to ascend through the ranks of the Black Network and was likely a direct advisor to Fzoul Chembryl . Bio . Sellsword . Karne had operated out of Nashkel , though it is unkown if he is from Amn . In Nashkel he had first fought the Harper Jherek and it appears they both had a long fight which ended in both believing to let the other have lived . Karne then encountered Mordoc SeLanmere who very quickly became his mortal enemy . Mordoc defeated Karne , though it was apparent that Karne faked his own death , something Mordoc soon figured out . Karne soon gained a reputation as a sellsword and being able to fake his own death . Zhentarim . Karne was then recruited by the Zhentarim and his skills proved of great use to them . Karne and his partner , the Lizardman , Sleyvas then hatched a plan that could restore the Zhentarim to their former glory . They were to remove Eldrith the Betrayer from the status as ruler of the Onyx Tower and give it to the Zhentarim .

title: Karolina Wormack
description: Karolina Wormack Karolina Wormack was a woman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow next assault on the Silver Marches , Karolina lived with her brother Giles Wormack in Sundabar .
description_long: Karolina Wormack Karolina Wormack was a woman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow next assault on the Silver Marches , Karolina lived with her brother Giles Wormack in Sundabar . They assisted in a speech made by knight - commander Aleina Brightlance just before the fall of the city .

title: Karontor
description: Karontor Karontor was one of the sons of Annam All - Father , the Father of all true giant s . His brothers were Grolantor , Stronmaus , Skoraeus , Memnor , Surtr , and Thrym . His sisters were Hiatea , Iallanis , and Diancastra .
description_long: Karontor Karontor was one of the sons of Annam All - Father , the Father of all true giant s . His brothers were Grolantor , Stronmaus , Skoraeus , Memnor , Surtr , and Thrym . His sisters were Hiatea , Iallanis , and Diancastra . History . Karontor was known as the patron deity of the twisted fomorian s and verbeeg s . Karontor was a purely evil deity . He resided in the plane of Tarterus , ruling a frozen plain of ice , where ever - hungry winter wolves awaited his orders to hunt across the land . It was rumored among the formorians and verbeegs that at one point in time , Karontor was a great and beautiful being . But his greed and jealousy of Stronmaus caused his form to become twisted and deformed .

title: Karr
description: Karr Karr was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Karr had a bald head and sported a curly brown beard .
description_long: Karr Karr was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Karr had a bald head and sported a curly brown beard . he had brown skin . He was stocky , looking somewhat like a tall dwarf . History . Karr hailed from a village near the Forest of Mir like all his companions . On Uktar 8 , 1370 DR , the Shields of the Highland lost two of their members while guarding a caravan . Unexpected cold weather led to snow , and a band of fourteen gnoll s were able to track them and attack them , killing two of them during the ensuing battle . At dusk two days later , Karr and the other three survivors went to the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth to grieve their loss . Karr wailed over the death of his friends and drank a lot , becoming very inebriated . They found a bard in the tavern , calling himself Fylson Tarasp , and demanded that he compose a dirge for their two fallen friends . They had no idea that this man was actually a secret agent of the sea elf Gantar Kraok .

title: Karrlon
description: Karrlon Karrlon was a male wemic ranger and paladin of Nobanion . He was a scout in the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and the founder of the Legion of Lions , a militant religious order devoted to Nobanion the Lion King . History .
description_long: Karrlon Karrlon was a male wemic ranger and paladin of Nobanion . He was a scout in the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and the founder of the Legion of Lions , a militant religious order devoted to Nobanion the Lion King . History . Shortly after the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Karrlon founded the Legion of Lions , a militant order of Nobanion - worshiping wemics . In the 1360s DR , Karrlon went with the Mindulgulph Company to the Eastern Shaar , where they took an extended contract with the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . Their purpose was to study the chances of war in the local Underdark . They were still here at the end of 1367 DR . During this time , Karrlon joined his commander , Gayrlana , and a loxo named Floshwa on a scouting expedition in the Shaar . Karrlon later left the Mindulgulphs to devote himself fully as a crusader of the Legion of Lions . He was still in the Legion in 1374 DR .

title: Karrundax
description: Karrundax Karrundax the Red was a young red dragon living in the Caverns of Karrundax within Mount Hotenow in Neverwinter Wood . History . Karrundax made his lair in Mount Hotenow in a cave near the river of pure elemental fire at some point before 1479 DR .
description_long: Karrundax Karrundax the Red was a young red dragon living in the Caverns of Karrundax within Mount Hotenow in Neverwinter Wood . History . Karrundax made his lair in Mount Hotenow in a cave near the river of pure elemental fire at some point before 1479 DR . Neverwinter games . In 1484 DR , Karrundax made an alliance with Gommoth and his fire - worshiper cult . It is believed Karrundax was killed by some adventurers not long after .

title: Karse
description: Karse Karse was a city built at the base of a " tall butte of red stone " . History . Like many other settlements in the High Forest , Karse was abandonded after the fall of Ascalhorn .
description_long: Karse Karse was a city built at the base of a " tall butte of red stone " . History . Like many other settlements in the High Forest , Karse was abandonded after the fall of Ascalhorn . In 1362 DR , legend has it the lich , Wulgreth lived there for over a thousand years .

title: Karselridrith
description: Karselridrith Karselridrith , also known as Brightstrike , was a blue wyrm whose lair was near Wreathe in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age and around - 1859 DR , Karselridrith was slain in her lair by more than fifteen adventurers .
description_long: Karselridrith Karselridrith , also known as Brightstrike , was a blue wyrm whose lair was near Wreathe in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age and around - 1859 DR , Karselridrith was slain in her lair by more than fifteen adventurers . In - 544 DR , her three ancient blue dragon children descended upon Wreathe and savagely destroyed the city in less than two weeks of breath weapon bombardments .

title: Karsev
description: Karsev Karsev ( pronounced KAR - seff ) was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Possessions . In battle , Karsev wore a suit of scalemail and fought with a hand fork and shield .
description_long: Karsev Karsev ( pronounced KAR - seff ) was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Possessions . In battle , Karsev wore a suit of scalemail and fought with a hand fork and shield . Relationships . Karsev was the right - hand of fellow cultist , the marel Shelavassa . History . In 1491 DR , they managed to capture the aquatic elf prince Ulatha Mesavir in order to use him as sacrifice to create a " devastation orb " to unleash over Mulmaster . However , Karsev and his minions were confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired to destroy the cultist group for their bandit activities near River Lis .

title: Karsoluthiyl
description: Karsoluthiyl Karsoluthiyl was a drow city located beneath the Trackless Sea , west of the mouth of the River Chionthar . Two prominant houses were House Tanor ' Thal and House Lysaen . Both houses were big players in the slave trade of Skullport .
description_long: Karsoluthiyl Karsoluthiyl was a drow city located beneath the Trackless Sea , west of the mouth of the River Chionthar . Two prominant houses were House Tanor ' Thal and House Lysaen . Both houses were big players in the slave trade of Skullport . Geography . Karsoluthiyl is located in a region of the Underdark known as the Swordsea Depths , which lies underneath the Sword Coast . They are engaged in a struggle for supremacy with Aboleths , Svirfneblin , and Thaalud who also call the area home . It is connected by long and arduous tunnel routes to Undermountain to the north , Sshamath to the east , and the realms of Deep Shanatar to the south . In addition it is at the end of a series of portals which link from Karsoluthiyl to sea caves in Ruathym , from there to caverns in the Crags near Neverwinter , to the Undermountain , another set of caves in Ruathym , and back to Karsoluthiyl . History . Although some claim that Karsoluthiyl was founded by House Tanor ' Thal in - 105 DR , the Year of the Bloody Goad , Drow from the city were identified as being at war with Clan Melairkyn as early as - 677 DR ( Year of Fervent Glances ) .

title: Karsus
description: Karsus Lord Karsus was the Netherese creator and caster of the " Karsus ' s avatar " spell that triggered the Fall of Netheril . History . Early life .
description_long: Karsus Lord Karsus was the Netherese creator and caster of the " Karsus ' s avatar " spell that triggered the Fall of Netheril . History . Early life . Karsus was born about 3 , 100 years after the nation ' s founding , in - 696 DR . He was able to cast his first spell at the age of two , and by the age of twenty - two had become the youngest arcanist to ever create his own floating city . Gifted with magic , but lacking the necessary discipline that comes with hard work and research , he founded a school of magic on his enclave and encouraged the attendance of radical thinkers and those interested in taboo projects . One of his students , now known only as Lord Shadow , wrote a treatise on the exploration and exploitation of other planes , such as the Plane of Shadow , which garnered initial criticism but was eventually embraced as the key to an infinite source of shadow - creatures as slave laborers as well as a dumping ground for unwanted garbage . Creation of " Karsus ' s avatar " . In - 345 DR , Arthindol the Terraseer appeared before Karsus and stated , " Mystryl was about to face her greatest challenge - one that could alter the perception of magic for all time .

title: Karsus ' s Folly
description: Karsus ' s Folly Karsus ' s Folly was a climactic event which caused the end of the Netherese empire in - 339 DR . History . After decades of war with the Phaerimm , the homeland of Netheril was quickly becoming a wasteland , partly due to the strange help the Netheril got from the Sharn .
description_long: Karsus ' s Folly Karsus ' s Folly was a climactic event which caused the end of the Netherese empire in - 339 DR . History . After decades of war with the Phaerimm , the homeland of Netheril was quickly becoming a wasteland , partly due to the strange help the Netheril got from the Sharn . The spells of the sharn altered the very geography of the land when it came in contact with the phaerimm ’ s magic drain and life drain spells , transforming mountains into rolling hills or increasing the spread of the desert . When suddenly Ioulaum disappeared panic surged through Netheril . Karsus feeling the responsibility for Netheril ’ s future on his shoulders , felt that it was his duty to weld the nation back together . Therefore he tried to wrest the mantle of divinity from Mystryl using the spell " Karsus ' s avatar " . Immediately after he cast the spell his body swelled with the sudden influx of godly power , and his mind filled with unimaginable knowledge . But he instantly realized the horrible mistake he had made . Mystryl was the only being with the experience to fix the damage that the war between the Netherese and the Phaerimm was causing to the Weave .

title: Karsus ' s avatar
description: Karsus ' s avatar Karsus ' s avatar was a very powerful spell which altered the very disposition of reality . Effects . The spell was even capable of allowing its user to become a god of their choosing , replacing a current god with themselves the moment the spell was completed .
description_long: Karsus ' s avatar Karsus ' s avatar was a very powerful spell which altered the very disposition of reality . Effects . The spell was even capable of allowing its user to become a god of their choosing , replacing a current god with themselves the moment the spell was completed . Components . It was so complex that the wizard had to put a stone - filled gizzard of a gold dragon into a mixture of tarrasque blood and 12 - headed hydra bile to just enchant one of the material components of the spell . It had a casting time of six hours . History . The creation of this spell was finished by " the " Netherese archwizard , Karsus , in - 340 DR , and fatefully used the one and only time the following year , causing the Fall of Netheril . Karsus ' s original notes regarding its creation were never found . Whether the gods were able to defend against the spell , or were aware of its casting , are unknown . Karsus spent well over a decade researching this spell . It was believed Mystra , the reincarnated form of Mystryl , snatched the spell information from the ruins of Karsus ' s enclave and sent it on an eternal journey to the ends of the universe . Appendix . Notes .

title: Kartak Spellseer
description: Kartak Spellseer Kartak Spellseer is a lich , member of the Twisted Rune and bane of his mortal family . Description . Kartak looks as if he is still mortal , and young - looking for the age he died at ( 54 years old ) too .
description_long: Kartak Spellseer Kartak Spellseer is a lich , member of the Twisted Rune and bane of his mortal family . Description . Kartak looks as if he is still mortal , and young - looking for the age he died at ( 54 years old ) too . He carries an air of dignity and has been mistaken for royalty in the past . Personality . Kartak is proud and desires to be recognized for his noble bearing and self - imposed importance . He refuses to associate himself with other undead unless it is necessary to , such as in his dealings with his fellow Twisted Rune members . He is also an unashamed psychopath . History . A distant cousin from the main branch of the family known as Spellseer , he still carried the family name and lived in the family castle . He became involved in Spellseer business when , amidst false accusations from rival Amn ian traders , he was accused of gruesomely murdering and experimenting on 14 young local men & women in order to perform a foul necromantic rite . The evidence was completely fabricated , but ironically the charges were all totally true . He was arrested at the castle in 830 DR , tried and sentenced to hang .

title: Kartha - Kaya
description: Kartha - Kaya Kartha - Kaya was the chief of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kartha - Kaya lived with his fellow and his two wives Imberu and Nahala near Ironslag forge .
description_long: Kartha - Kaya Kartha - Kaya was the chief of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kartha - Kaya lived with his fellow and his two wives Imberu and Nahala near Ironslag forge . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Duke Zalto of the fire giant s forged a kind of nonaggression pact with Kartha - Kaya . Usually he welcomed all guests to his village but secretly drugged them in order to keep them as slaves .

title: Karzon Kul
description: Karzon Kul Karzon Kul was a ruffian dwarf from Loudwater in 1479 DR . Description . Karzon ' s head was shaved , and he had tattoos across his body .
description_long: Karzon Kul Karzon Kul was a ruffian dwarf from Loudwater in 1479 DR . Description . Karzon ' s head was shaved , and he had tattoos across his body . Personality . Karzon Kul was a local ruffian who usually hanged out at the Fisher ' s Friend Pub in Loudwater , and had a reputation for starting fights with other patrons . Relationships . Karzon was an ally of the Lady of Shadows , leader of the crime gang in Loudwater in the late 15th century .

title: Karzov
description: Karzov Karzov was the deputy leader of the Nasher in Neverwinter and an Uthgardt fighter . History . In 1484 DR , Karzov had become the the second - in - command of the Nasher rebel group , answering only to Arlon Bladeshaper .
description_long: Karzov Karzov was the deputy leader of the Nasher in Neverwinter and an Uthgardt fighter . History . In 1484 DR , Karzov had become the the second - in - command of the Nasher rebel group , answering only to Arlon Bladeshaper . He was the mastermind of the heist of the Crown of Neverwinter , intending to use it to assert the Nasher ' s control upon the city . Unfortunately , many other groups also wanted the Crown and in the end it was recovered by an adventurer recruited by Sergeant Knox of Lord Dagult Neverember ' s army . Karzov went onto Neverember ' s black - list so he was chased all over the city by Knox ' s adventurer until they finally located him in a building in the Blacklake district . In the end , the adventurer defeated him .

title: Kasad
description: Kasad Kasad , or One - Eye Kasad , was a disfigured human sergeant of the watch in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . A bar fight during his youth left Kasad with a ghastly facial injury and the loss of an eye .
description_long: Kasad Kasad , or One - Eye Kasad , was a disfigured human sergeant of the watch in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . A bar fight during his youth left Kasad with a ghastly facial injury and the loss of an eye . Personality . Kasad ' s greed meant that he was easily bribed as a guard . Activities . Since his disfigurement left his social life rather lacking , Kasad always seemed to be on duty at one of the gates or participating in civil patrols . He bore his fate well , attacking his work with stoic determination . Possessions . Kasad wore " lamellar " armor and wielded a magical scimitar . " "

title: Kashada
description: Kashada Kashada the Nightwraith was a shadow mystic ( probably a shadow adept ) and an aspect of Shar . Description . Kashada was tall .
description_long: Kashada Kashada the Nightwraith was a shadow mystic ( probably a shadow adept ) and an aspect of Shar . Description . Kashada was tall . She wore a cloak , a veil of cloth and shadow , and tight black assassin ' s garb . Powers . She was able to turn herself into shadow and enter the Plane of Shadow . History . In 1373 DR , Kashada was allied with Zasian Menz , a priest of Cyric in Sundabar . She wanted to raise a Sharran temple in Sundabar to take her revenge on the North . She disguised herself as " Ansa " ( who was in fact Aliisza in disguise ) and replaced her in the Master ' s Hall in Sundabar . Some time later she was captured by Tauran and Micus , astral deva servants of Tyr , and imprisoned in a sphere of light with no shadows , which drove her insane . Twelve years later she was freed by Zasian with the help of Myshik Morueme . She regained her sanity and journeyed with Zasian and Myshik to Dweomerheart , where they were able to cause a distraction and steal Azuth ' s staff . Kashada was revealed to be an aspect of Shar , and plunged a dagger into Zasian ' s back . Cyric subsequently used Azuth ' s staff to slay Mystra . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Kashghun
description: Kashghun The Kashghun were a tribe of nomadic human s living on the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . Territory . The Kashghun lived in the eastern regions of the Endless Waste .
description_long: Kashghun The Kashghun were a tribe of nomadic human s living on the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . Territory . The Kashghun lived in the eastern regions of the Endless Waste . Their territory bordered the lands of the Fankiang , Quirish , Oigur , and Tsu - tsu tribes . Society . They spoke the Kashghun dialect of the Chuchian tongue . The Kashghun were enemies with the Commani and friends with the Dalat . History . Long ago , during a " couralitai " , a grand council of the " khans " ( princes of the villages ) , all the tribes were in attendance . During a heated argument at the council , the " khan " of the Commani and his sons were assassinated . The murderers were never discovered , but the Commani suspected the Kashghun . This led to hatred between the two groups , which lasted even into the 14 century .

title: Kashik
description: Kashik The Kashik were an elite organization from the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . 10 , 000 men comprised the Kashik .
description_long: Kashik The Kashik were an elite organization from the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . 10 , 000 men comprised the Kashik . They were formed from the most elite members of the army . Description . Only members of the Kashik were allowed to wear special black kalat s , easily making them stand out from the common soldiers . Activities . The Kashik served as the personal bodyguard of the Great Khan . Day and night shifts helped prevent any assassination attempts on their lord . Day guards were called " turguts " and night guards were called " kebtuts " .

title: Kasidikal
description: Kasidikal Kasidikal was a mature adult black dragon and a member of House Orogoth . Her lair was in the ruins of Orogoth on the High Moor of the Western Heartlands , just north of the Serpent Hills . Relationships .
description_long: Kasidikal Kasidikal was a mature adult black dragon and a member of House Orogoth . Her lair was in the ruins of Orogoth on the High Moor of the Western Heartlands , just north of the Serpent Hills . Relationships . She was the great - granddaughter of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the daughter of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the sister of the black dragons Woklef , Cheleen and Awsidorg .

title: Kasnchil
description: Kasnchil Kasnchil was the baron of the city of Surbar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Kasnchil was the most corrupt and greedy of Ulgarth ' s barons , and this affected his legal judgments . He permitted all kinds of trade through Surbar , which made it a popular port and a prosperous city , but this knew no limits : even Dambrath an pirates could dock there to resupply and refit .
description_long: Kasnchil Kasnchil was the baron of the city of Surbar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Kasnchil was the most corrupt and greedy of Ulgarth ' s barons , and this affected his legal judgments . He permitted all kinds of trade through Surbar , which made it a popular port and a prosperous city , but this knew no limits : even Dambrath an pirates could dock there to resupply and refit . However , the serfs thought he made the city prosper .

title: Kaspar
description: Kaspar Kaspar was a city lying on the eastern side of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Kaspar was a thriving city of 10 , 000 people , called " Kasparians " .
description_long: Kaspar Kaspar was a city lying on the eastern side of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Kaspar was a thriving city of 10 , 000 people , called " Kasparians " . It was surrounded by fertile farmland growing the spice mingari , with many more farms lying to the west growing foodstuffs . These farms were called the breadbasket of Ulgarth , and Kaspar was thought to be one of the prettiest cities in the kingdom . Government . Around 1367 DR , Kaspar was led by one Baron Montar Kaspar , meaning " defender of Kaspar " , a name he chose for himself . Trade . Folk here actually preferred to trade with the barbarians of the eastern plains . Defenses . Despite this preference for trade , the city of Kaspar also had the responsibility of defending the realm against the barbarian Horde . It maintained an excellent army to guard against raids and be alert to threats . They also protected the vital western farmlands . Baron Kaspar commanded his own barony ' s army , the only baron to do so around 1367 DR . He led his forces into battle himself , which earned him the appreciation of his troops .

title: Kassawar Plickenstint
description: Kassawar Plickenstint Kassawar Plickenstint was the main deep gnome delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Kassawar was the representative of Blingdenstone in the merchant outpost of Mantol - Derith .
description_long: Kassawar Plickenstint Kassawar Plickenstint was the main deep gnome delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Kassawar was the representative of Blingdenstone in the merchant outpost of Mantol - Derith . After 1371 DR , he was chosen as the representative of Luruar , but the deep gnomes there produced a smaller portion of goods than before . So Kassawar had little to do and spent a lot of his time just staring at nothing . Personality . Kassawar greatly suffered for the loss of his home city and spent most of his time in mourning .

title: Kastighur
description: Kastighur A kastighur was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss or the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Wicked and sadistic , kastighurs acted as prison wardens and hunters among demonkind . They teleported around the field of battle and used their devastating charges to stun and horrify their enemies .
description_long: Kastighur A kastighur was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss or the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Wicked and sadistic , kastighurs acted as prison wardens and hunters among demonkind . They teleported around the field of battle and used their devastating charges to stun and horrify their enemies . Description . A kastighur was huge , standing somewhere between 15 and 20 feet tall ( 4 . 6 – 6 . 1 meters ) and it could weigh up to 10 , 000 pounds ( 4 . 5 metric tons ) . Ancient , veteran kastighurs could grow to even greater sizes , however . In form , the demon was roughly humanoid , with a body rippling with muscles under a tough blue hide , powerful legs standing on cloven hooves , and thick arms ending in strong claws . Its visage was hideous , its head large and weight , bearing long horns . Their horns grew slowly but continually , and they adorned them with carvings of symbols or words . For further protection , a kastighur " wore " armor , of a fashion — enormous steel pieces bolted directly to its body . A helm was bolted to its neck , a breastplate to its torso , and other pieces to its shins , forearms , and shoulders . Personality .

title: Kata Brizik
description: Kata Brizik Kata Brizik was a businesswoman and dancer in Mulmaster . History . Kata was a very talented dancer who opened the festhall the Wave and Wink with her husband Urdun Brizik .
description_long: Kata Brizik Kata Brizik was a businesswoman and dancer in Mulmaster . History . Kata was a very talented dancer who opened the festhall the Wave and Wink with her husband Urdun Brizik . Soon it became one of the most popular festhalls in the city . In 1491 DR , however , during a party celebrating the birthday of Zara Tiega Gos , Kata saw a painting of Andrik Gos and inexplicably had the impulse of burn Tiega . Personality . Her talents in dance and business greatly outmatched those of her husband Urdun , but Kata grew frustrated with the need to focus all her time on managing the day - to - day operations of the festhall . She was jealous of Urdun ' s flirtatious tendencies . Kata hoped that the recent interest of the nobles in the arts would permit her to switch roles with her husband .

title: Katakoro Glacier
description: Katakoro Glacier The Katakoro Glacier was a large glacier located within Katakoro Shan , bordering both Ra - Khati and Khazari . Geography . This large glacier covered hundreds of square miles .
description_long: Katakoro Glacier The Katakoro Glacier was a large glacier located within Katakoro Shan , bordering both Ra - Khati and Khazari . Geography . This large glacier covered hundreds of square miles . Inhabitants . Many dangerous creatures lived on the glacier , but most were kept out of the neighboring kingdoms by the steep mountains of Katakoro Shan .

title: Katakoro Plateau
description: Katakoro Plateau The Katakoro Plateau was the only large plateau in the entire Hordelands . Geography . The roughly triangular Katakoro Plateau was enclosed by the Kun - Yen Shan range to the south , the A - Ling Shan range to the west , and the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs to the east .
description_long: Katakoro Plateau The Katakoro Plateau was the only large plateau in the entire Hordelands . Geography . The roughly triangular Katakoro Plateau was enclosed by the Kun - Yen Shan range to the south , the A - Ling Shan range to the west , and the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs to the east .

title: Katakoro Shan
description: Katakoro Shan Katakoro Shan was an enormous mountain range located in the Hordelands . It was part of the larger Yehimal mountains . Geography .
description_long: Katakoro Shan Katakoro Shan was an enormous mountain range located in the Hordelands . It was part of the larger Yehimal mountains . Geography . Katakoro Shan formed part of the borders of the nations of Khazari and Ra - Khati , and also provided a formidable boundary between them and the Katakoro Plateau . Description . Rugged peaks that reached an elevation of 19 , 000 ft . dominated this mountain range . Several glaciers of note could be found nestled between the high peaks , including the Katakoro Glacier . Inhabitants . Many dangerous creatures inhabited the land surrounding Katakoro Shan , but the steep peaks kept them out of neighboring Khazari and Ra - Khati .

title: Katana
description: Katana Description . The katana is an eastern - style sword with a slightly curved , single - edge blade on the outside edge of the curve and a tanto tip . Typical designs carry blade lengths anywhere from 24 to 29 inches ( 60 .
description_long: Katana Description . The katana is an eastern - style sword with a slightly curved , single - edge blade on the outside edge of the curve and a tanto tip . Typical designs carry blade lengths anywhere from 24 to 29 inches ( 60 . 9 to 73 . 6 cm ) depending upon their era in real - world history . They exhibit many of the same design characteristics as other swords including a blade , crossguard , and handle with one notable difference ; the pommel is distinctly smaller if not lacking entirely . The reason is the weapon is crafted with such precise balance as to minimize if not negate the need for a large counterbalance . Weaponology . The katana is the pinnacle of the swordmaker ' s art . Even a poor quality katana can be equal to a well - made weapon from another part of the world . The elegant curve of the blade is the result of the methods of forging and quenching used in its making . By using folded , composite steels , it can be used in combat with a greatly reduced chance of the blade bending or succumbing to brittleness and shattering . The tanto - style tip is a design feature of most Japanese - style swords that is similar to a blade fuller in western - style swords .

title: Katar
description: Katar A katar was a punching dagger common to Calimshan and Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Etymology . The word for " knife " in Alzhedo was " katar " , yet when most people used the term " katar " , they were referring specifically to the punching dagger used by Calishite s .
description_long: Katar A katar was a punching dagger common to Calimshan and Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Etymology . The word for " knife " in Alzhedo was " katar " , yet when most people used the term " katar " , they were referring specifically to the punching dagger used by Calishite s . Description . A " katar " was a dagger with the handle perpendicular to the length of the triangular blade . It was used for thrusting instead of slashing . It put more force from one ' s punch behind it , making it capable of deadly attacks . Notable Users . A punching dagger was the favored weapon of clerics of the Mulhorandi goddess Isis .

title: Katashaka
description: Katashaka Katashaka was a distant continent southwest of Faerûn and was the original home of several human tribes , including the Eshowe , Tabaxi , and Thinguth . Inhabitants . A being known as Olurobo — and its children , the " nyama - nummo " — was worshiped by the Tabaxi tribes before they converted to the worship of Ubtao and their subsequent migration to the Jungles of Chult .
description_long: Katashaka Katashaka was a distant continent southwest of Faerûn and was the original home of several human tribes , including the Eshowe , Tabaxi , and Thinguth . Inhabitants . A being known as Olurobo — and its children , the " nyama - nummo " — was worshiped by the Tabaxi tribes before they converted to the worship of Ubtao and their subsequent migration to the Jungles of Chult .

title: Kate Kenkichi
description: Kate Kenkichi Kate Kenkichi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family who run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse in a cool and shaded hollow inside a Niwa shoen , he led a company of one samurai ( his brother Kate Akiie ) and ten bushi .
description_long: Kate Kenkichi Kate Kenkichi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family who run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse in a cool and shaded hollow inside a Niwa shoen , he led a company of one samurai ( his brother Kate Akiie ) and ten bushi . Personality . Kate greatly disliked the Niwa clan and secretly permitted bandits and opponents of the Niwa to use his posthouse . He had received his position thanks to particular favors .

title: Katharine Marie Moorland
description: Katharine Marie Moorland Katharine Marie Moorland was the Lord Speaker of the Council of Lords of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .
description_long: Katharine Marie Moorland Katharine Marie Moorland was the Lord Speaker of the Council of Lords of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance . Lady Katharine is 5 ' 4 " tall and weighs 105 pounds . She is astonishingly beautiful with green eyes and red hair and looks very youthful due to her elven heritage . Her slim build belies her toughness and she is frequently underestimated due to her size , her beauty , or both . In town she favors a simple fine linen dress cinched at the waist by a belt of leather and gold on which she carries a magical dagger with a jeweled pommel . In cold weather she adds a lambskin cloak held by a silver brooch in the form of her family coat of arms . Her long red hair is worn loosely . Outside town she wears high soft boots and buckskin breeches , a linen shirt , a heavy plain traveling cloak and a leather hat into which she tucks her hair to keep it out of the way . Personality . Katharine is an open , friendly , adventurous woman , an expert rider , a skilled archer , and even dabbles in the arcane arts . She likes to spend time listening to tales of exotic creatures , far - away lands , and mystical powers .

title: Katheera Urdo
description: Katheera Urdo Katheera Urdo was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Katheera was the scion of the noble House Urdo of Westgate and joined the Night Masks only to indulge in her depraved interests .
description_long: Katheera Urdo Katheera Urdo was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Katheera was the scion of the noble House Urdo of Westgate and joined the Night Masks only to indulge in her depraved interests . Her fellow assassins knew her only as " the Succubus " , because her preferred method of killing was to kiss her target with poisoned lips .

title: Katl
description: Katl Katl was an Eagle Knight in Maztica . History . In late 1361 DR , Katl was one of the many officers in the assorted column of refugee led by Cordell .
description_long: Katl Katl was an Eagle Knight in Maztica . History . In late 1361 DR , Katl was one of the many officers in the assorted column of refugee led by Cordell . When the survivors arrived in Ulatos and discovered that the place was under the control of Don Vaez , an old rival of Cordell , Katl tried to kill Don using his eagle form but was defeated and severely injured . Put in prison with all the officers of the Golden Legion , he was near death but Cordell offered Don Vaez all his gold in order to have a cleric save him .

title: Katriana Donohar
description: Katriana Donohar Katriana Donohar was a Tethyrian human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a priest of Chauntea . History .
description_long: Katriana Donohar Katriana Donohar was a Tethyrian human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a priest of Chauntea . History . She was the daughter of the famed priest of Chauntea , Harandave Donohar , high priest of the Harvest Hall in Wheloon . She followed him into the priesthood and served as one of his assistant clerics by 1367 DR . Following Harandave ' s death , Katriana took over from her father as head of the temple . She held the position by 1374 . By Eleint of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Katriana met the priests of the new temple of Mystra in Wheloon , finding them polite but not particularly friendly . She put this down to big - city inter - temple rivalry . When adventurers revealed it to be a false temple and a front for followers of Shar and Cyric , Katriana would offer her healing spells for free . Activities . Katriana Donohar was usually at the temple , managing affairs there . She had a large number of divine scroll s , dating back to Harandave ' s day , which she sold to those she believed would use them for good deeds . She had thirteen followers or attendants , all minor priests .

title: Katsuhara Omitsu
description: Katsuhara Omitsu Katsuhara Omitsu was a spirit folk shugo - daimyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Katsuhara was the daimyo of Dosaki Province and the main overseer of the construction of the imperial shipyards at Renkyu and the controlled exploitation of the Waturi Forest .
description_long: Katsuhara Omitsu Katsuhara Omitsu was a spirit folk shugo - daimyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Katsuhara was the daimyo of Dosaki Province and the main overseer of the construction of the imperial shipyards at Renkyu and the controlled exploitation of the Waturi Forest . Personality . Katsuhara was an outgoing and popular individual with a great talent for diplomacy . He was also a respected strategist .

title: Kavayah II
description: Kavayah II Kavayah II was the novice - prince of the Kuong Kingdom in Malatra . History . Around 1357 DR , Kavayah was totally absorbed with his training to become the next king - priest .
description_long: Kavayah II Kavayah II was the novice - prince of the Kuong Kingdom in Malatra . History . Around 1357 DR , Kavayah was totally absorbed with his training to become the next king - priest . He spent much of his time studying in the temple , exploring his talent for magic to include the study of clerical spells .

title: Kaverin Ebonhand
description: Kaverin Ebonhand Kaverin Ebonhand was the leader of the Cult of Frost . Personality . Kaverin was a ruthless , vindictive , and obsessive individual .
description_long: Kaverin Ebonhand Kaverin Ebonhand was the leader of the Cult of Frost . Personality . Kaverin was a ruthless , vindictive , and obsessive individual . His goal was to achieve immortality and he would do any kind of evil to obtain it . History . Kaverin was born in Tantras . He became the most powerful crime lord in the city , feared across all the Dragon Reach . This was until 1357 DR when Artus Cimber and Hydel Pontifax put him on trial for ordering the murder of the Harper Rallo Scarson . However , the judge in Ravens Bluff condemned him to only lose his hands ( which were quickly replaced by artificial ones ) . Freed , Kaverin spent the next three years trying to get his vengeance against Artus and Hydel . In 1360 DR , in Tantras , they found Kaverin off - guard and killed him . Kaverin did not stay dead , however , thanks to a deal he made with the god Cyric . However , from that day on , two fiend s visited him every night , taunting him with all the tortures that awaited him in the afterlife . At this point , like his enemies , Kaverin started searching for the " Ring of Winter " .

title: Kawabi
description: Kawabi Kawabi was a governor in Shou Lung . Relationship . Kawabi was the sixth cousin of the Emperor .
description_long: Kawabi Kawabi was a governor in Shou Lung . Relationship . Kawabi was the sixth cousin of the Emperor . History . Kawabi was for many years the governor of Chu ' Yuan province and under his rule the land prospered . Kawabi , however , was an evil man and he searched for a means to achieve more power . At last , in 1358 DR , he found in uncharted lands near Chu ' Yuan the damned citadel of Tempat Larang , a colony of Anok - Imaskar destroyed long ago by the Immortal Nung Chiang . There , Kawabi found an army of stone spirit s ready to command . To avoid suspicion in the meantime , he spread chaos in his province , sending raiders to attack villagers and caravans . However , the Emperor decided to send General Goyat Nagumo to help him pacify the area . Soon , Goyat discovered the treason of Kawabi . The armies of Kawabi and of Goyat Nagumo clashed near the city of Hui and the general defeated the governor . Kawabi , however , escaped and Goyat followed him , resolute to make him pay for his treason . At last , Goyat confronted and defeated Kawabi at Tempat Larang .

title: Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id
description: Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Kawthar ruled the sea elves inhabiting Chaos Bay with her husband .
description_long: Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Kawthar ruled the sea elves inhabiting Chaos Bay with her husband . Possessions . She owned a set of bracers of defense and carried a magical jambiya . Relationships . Kawthar was the mother of Ra ' id bint Kawthar .

title: Kayalithica
description: Kayalithica Thane Kayalithica was the ruler of the stone giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kayalithica was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Kayalithica Thane Kayalithica was the ruler of the stone giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kayalithica was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the disappearance of storm giant king Hekaton , all giant lords started their path to reshaping the ordning . Kayalithica ' s plan was to seek divine illumination from the giant god Skoraeus Stonebones and destroying all the small folks ' settlements built upon the ruins of ancient Ostoria . In order to accomplished her project , Kayalithica allied with the similarly - minded Uthgardt Blue Bear Tribe and her minions destroyed the nearby Orlbar and Llorkh . Activities . Usually , Kayalithica was at the temple of Skoraeus Stonebones , meditating in front of the Steinfang stalactite , which she believed whispered the will of Skoraeus . In truth , she was deceived and the Steinfang housed a fragment of the earth primordial Draunn , who wanted only to create havoc .

title: Kayl Moorwalker
description: Kayl Moorwalker Captain Kayl Moorwalker is both the First Elder of the Council of Elders and the High Captain of Everlund , in 1372 DR . Kayl was an intelligent military commander who preferred to look after the interests of the nobility rather than commoners and merchants . As a result of this , he was looked upon favourably by the elves of the Council of Elders .
description_long: Kayl Moorwalker Captain Kayl Moorwalker is both the First Elder of the Council of Elders and the High Captain of Everlund , in 1372 DR . Kayl was an intelligent military commander who preferred to look after the interests of the nobility rather than commoners and merchants . As a result of this , he was looked upon favourably by the elves of the Council of Elders .

title: Kaylessa Irkell
description: Kaylessa Irkell Kaylessa Irkell was the owner of the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Kaylessa was the fortyish matriarch of her family and a pleasant , sturdy woman .
description_long: Kaylessa Irkell Kaylessa Irkell was the owner of the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Kaylessa was the fortyish matriarch of her family and a pleasant , sturdy woman . She was increasingly worried about strange phenomena in Red Larch and brought up her concerns with any likely adventurers who stopped by . Activities . Kaylessa managed the Swinging Sword tavern . History . In 1491 DR , Kaylessa told some adventurers hired to find a diplomatic caravan missing near the city her suspicions about something dark in the village .

title: Kaylinn
description: Kaylinn Kaylinn was a cleric of Kelemvor in the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . Description . Kaylinn was short , with wide hips and full breasts .
description_long: Kaylinn Kaylinn was a cleric of Kelemvor in the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . Description . Kaylinn was short , with wide hips and full breasts . Her head was shaven , except for a characteristic sidelock of auburn hair wrapped in thin white leather straps that went down past her shoulder . At the base of her skull where it met the spine was a blue outlined inked tattoo depicting the sign of Kelemvor , a skeletal hand holding a set of scales . History . In 1479 DR , she served as high priestess in Ormpetarr .

title: Kaz Hanar
description: Kaz Hanar Kaz Hanar was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kaz Hanar patrolled the plaza outside of the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil with his wyvern mount .
description_long: Kaz Hanar Kaz Hanar was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kaz Hanar patrolled the plaza outside of the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil with his wyvern mount . While on patrol , he was confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Kazgaroth
description: Kazgaroth Kazgaroth ( sometimes Kazgoroth ) was an aspect of Malar , who was a powerful , intelligent , evil beast opposed to the balance and the influence of the Earthmother on the Moonshae Isles . It would periodically ravage the land until it was defeated , only to return several years later . Kazgaroth ' s natural form was of a huge " Tyrannosaurus rex " , but it could shape - change to other forms , including those of people whom it might kill and devour before impersonating .
description_long: Kazgaroth Kazgaroth ( sometimes Kazgoroth ) was an aspect of Malar , who was a powerful , intelligent , evil beast opposed to the balance and the influence of the Earthmother on the Moonshae Isles . It would periodically ravage the land until it was defeated , only to return several years later . Kazgaroth ' s natural form was of a huge " Tyrannosaurus rex " , but it could shape - change to other forms , including those of people whom it might kill and devour before impersonating . . It served Bhaal , corrupting the eponymous moonwell , enabling his avatar to enter the Moonshaes . Activities . Kazgaroth took several guises . The first few were a cow , which attracted a bit too much attention , and a woman named Meridith , who drew too much attention because Kazgaroth used its powers to make the body of the latter guise more attractive . His first victim was a man named Erian who was a guard for the prince Tristan Kendrick of the Moonshaes . Afterwards , he changed into a dryad in order to lure Trahern of Oakvale .

title: Kazit Gul
description: Kazit Gul Kazit Gul was the Red Wizard of Thay demilich master of the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Centuries before , Kazit Gul was a Red Wizard necromancer obsessed with dungeons .
description_long: Kazit Gul Kazit Gul was the Red Wizard of Thay demilich master of the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Centuries before , Kazit Gul was a Red Wizard necromancer obsessed with dungeons . He studied many dungeons across Faerun and decided to create a dungeon for himself near Thaymount : the Doomvault . The construction took a long time , so Kazit transformed himself into a lich in order to complete the work . After it was finished , he installed himself in the deepest level , waiting for the souls of adventurers to consume . However , over time , the Doomvault was forgotten and Kazit went without souls and regressed to a demilich . Szass Tam eventually rediscovered the Doomvault and thought it was perfect as a laboratory . Thus Tam bound Kazit to his will and entrusted to him custody of the phylacteries of his most loyal liches . During the Second Sundering , Tam used the Doomvault as the main base for his experiments on captured Chosen . In 1486 DR , aided by the Thayan Resurrection led by Syranna , the heroes of Daggerford entered the Doomvault , slaying most of the Red Wizards there and freeing the prisoners .

title: Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian
description: Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian or Urshula was a former Black dragon . Circa 1368 DR , he was a Dracolich spirit found in a phylactery concealed in a Book of Creation , a relic of the Witch - King Zhengyi . History .
description_long: Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian or Urshula was a former Black dragon . Circa 1368 DR , he was a Dracolich spirit found in a phylactery concealed in a Book of Creation , a relic of the Witch - King Zhengyi . History . Urshula laired in a large chamber in the lower parts of a Castle Perilous replica , built when a Zhengyi ' s relic , a book of creation , was activated . He was fought by a party made of Artemis Entreri , Jarlaxle , Athrogate , and a few others , eventually losing the battle . Urshula ' s half - decomposed draconic body was mostly destroyed by a magical dragon pendant , designed to be hung over doorways as a defensive ward , owned by Artemis Entreri ( gifted to him by Jarlaxle ) . Once more , Urshula ' s spirit got trapped in the dragon phylactery , one of two ( similarly working ) phylacteries in Jarlaxle ' s possesion , in 1368 DR .

title: Kazook Pickshine
description: Kazook Pickshine Kazook Pickshine was a notorious deep gnome alchemist in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kazook helped create the " spell gem s " used in the city ' s defense .
description_long: Kazook Pickshine Kazook Pickshine was a notorious deep gnome alchemist in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kazook helped create the " spell gem s " used in the city ' s defense . History . During the Rage of Demons , in Mantol - Derith , Kazook met the duergar merchant Werz Saltbaron and the two started a gem business behind their superiors ' backs .

title: Kazra
description: Kazra Kazra was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kazra happened to spy the Cult of the Howling Hatred .
description_long: Kazra Kazra was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kazra happened to spy the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Captured by some Feathergale Knights , she was taken to the Fane , where she remained a prisoner of some air cultists and a nycaloth . Some adventurers infiltrated the Fane , killing the cultist , and freed her .

title: Kazrith
description: Kazrith A Kazrith was an aquatic demon that could be found prowling murky lakes , underground waterways , and flooded tunnels . Abilities . A kazrith used tremorsense to detect enemies ; after locating a target , it surfaced and attacked , poisoning its victim .
description_long: Kazrith A Kazrith was an aquatic demon that could be found prowling murky lakes , underground waterways , and flooded tunnels . Abilities . A kazrith used tremorsense to detect enemies ; after locating a target , it surfaced and attacked , poisoning its victim . The demon waited until the prey was weak from the poison , then resurfaced and finished it off . This demon was also a skilled burrower , using the acid in its pores to excrete a trail of acid in the tunnels it made . Ecology . Most kazriths dwelled in the Elemental Chaos , but some occasionally found natural gates leading into Toril . Kazriths created vast networks of flooded tunnels between lakes and other bodies of water . They could then travel easily from habitat to habitat . These tunnels were usually not far below ground , so the monsters could sense potential prey walking above them . Society . These demons were often found in the company of other sinister aquatic monsters .

title: Keane
description: Keane Keane was a wizard in the Moonshae Isles . History . Keane was the royal tutor of the two young princesses Alicia Kendrick and Deirdre Kendrick , posing as a failed wizard as ordered by King Tristan Kendrick .
description_long: Keane Keane was a wizard in the Moonshae Isles . History . Keane was the royal tutor of the two young princesses Alicia Kendrick and Deirdre Kendrick , posing as a failed wizard as ordered by King Tristan Kendrick . He followed Alicia in all her adventures , helping battle her many foes , destroying a dracolich , fighting the Ityak - Ortheel and traveling to Evermeet . At last , he confessed his feelings to Alicia , which seemed to be reciprocated . Personality . Keane was a quiet , observant , and studious individual . Under that facade , however , he was a powerful wizard , always ready to personally fight evil . He fell in love with Alicia and married her in 1366 DR .

title: Keefe
description: Keefe Keefe was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Keefe was a young priest of Kelemvor who with his fellows guarded the Valhingen Graveyard in the city .
description_long: Keefe Keefe was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Keefe was a young priest of Kelemvor who with his fellows guarded the Valhingen Graveyard in the city . Secretly , he was also an agent of the Lords ' Alliance . He came to believe that one of the dead , Xandria Welltran , was in truth a " polymorph ed " green dragon and hired some adventurers to help him unveil the mystery . The result was that Xandria was indeed a dead dragon and someone had tried to resurrect her as a dracolich .

title: Keen
description: Keen Keen is a magical effect that can be added to any bladed weapon . It allows the wielder of the weapon to make wounding , critical cuts . A weapon with this effect has the same power granted by the " keen edge " spell .
description_long: Keen Keen is a magical effect that can be added to any bladed weapon . It allows the wielder of the weapon to make wounding , critical cuts . A weapon with this effect has the same power granted by the " keen edge " spell . Creation . Applying the " keen " property requires the spell " keen edge " .

title: Keening spirit
description: Keening spirit A keening spirit was a type of ghost , created specifically from the spirit of an evil female elf . Known for its constant weeping and groaning , the creature was sometimes referred to as a " groaning spirit " . A drow keening spirit was known as a " kiaranshee " , after the drow goddess of the undead , Kiaransalee .
description_long: Keening spirit A keening spirit was a type of ghost , created specifically from the spirit of an evil female elf . Known for its constant weeping and groaning , the creature was sometimes referred to as a " groaning spirit " . A drow keening spirit was known as a " kiaranshee " , after the drow goddess of the undead , Kiaransalee . Abilities . Although a keening spirit shared many of the qualities of a ghost , its most dreaded weapon was its wail or keen . This ability functioned like the " wail of the banshee " spell .

title: Keep of the Lizard King
description: Keep of the Lizard King King Amiskal rules the lizardfolk and muckdwellers of the Serpent Hills from an ancient Anaurian tomb that , once plundered , was converted into living quarters . The former crypt is carved into a hillside in the northern reaches of the Serpent Hills , and Amiskal ’ s throne rests atop the dais where the sepulcher once lay . A secret portal somewhere in the crypt connects with the portal network centered on the Dungeon of Swords .
description_long: Keep of the Lizard King King Amiskal rules the lizardfolk and muckdwellers of the Serpent Hills from an ancient Anaurian tomb that , once plundered , was converted into living quarters .
