A secret portal somewhere in the crypt connects with the portal network centered on the Dungeon of Swords .

title: Keep on the Shadowfell
description: Keep on the Shadowfell Behind the scenes . While " Keep on the Shadowfell " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting for 4th edition D & D , alterations to the adventure made in an article of Dungeon magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " . These changes included changing the focus on Orcus to that of Shar and relocating Winterhaven to a geographical location in Faerûn between Cormyr and Sembia .
description_long: Keep on the Shadowfell Behind the scenes . While " Keep on the Shadowfell " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting for 4th edition D & D , alterations to the adventure made in an article of Dungeon magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " . These changes included changing the focus on Orcus to that of Shar and relocating Winterhaven to a geographical location in Faerûn between Cormyr and Sembia . In April 2009 , the adventure was released online at Wizards of the Coast ' s official website for download .

title: Keeper of the Key ( Ito - Jo )
description: Keeper of the Key ( Ito - Jo ) Keeper of the Key was a cursed sohei in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Keeper was a retainer of Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .
description_long: Keeper of the Key ( Ito - Jo ) Keeper of the Key was a cursed sohei in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Keeper was a retainer of Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR . Thanks to an " ancient curse " and a krakentua ' s influence , he did not truly die and instead lingered to haunt the castle as seventh of the seven weapon masters of the castle . Finally , in 1360 DR , an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed him .

title: Keeper of the Old Faith
description: Keeper of the Old Faith The " Keeper of the Old Faith " was the title of the senior Sage - Priest , the official historian , of the Church of Ilmater in the late 13th century DR . The Keeper of the Old Faith succeeded the previous senior Sage - Priest , the Spontaer , after his sacrifice " circa " 1265 DR .
description_long: Keeper of the Old Faith The " Keeper of the Old Faith " was the title of the senior Sage - Priest , the official historian , of the Church of Ilmater in the late 13th century DR . The Keeper of the Old Faith succeeded the previous senior Sage - Priest , the Spontaer , after his sacrifice " circa " 1265 DR .

title: Keepers of the Flame
description: Keepers of the Flame The Keepers of the Flame were an order of psionic cleric s of Laduguer in Gracklstugh with the duty of keeping quiet the existence of the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh , the red dragon who used his fire breath to temper the legendary steel blades of the city in exchange for contributions to his hoard . They also had the responsibility of slaying the current Wyrmsmith before he grew too strong , and replacing him with a new red hatchling . Later , the Keepers gained the duty of protecting the Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V from the plots of the derro Council of Savants .
description_long: Keepers of the Flame The Keepers of the Flame were an order of psionic cleric s of Laduguer in Gracklstugh with the duty of keeping quiet the existence of the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh , the red dragon who used his fire breath to temper the legendary steel blades of the city in exchange for contributions to his hoard . They also had the responsibility of slaying the current Wyrmsmith before he grew too strong , and replacing him with a new red hatchling . Later , the Keepers gained the duty of protecting the Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V from the plots of the derro Council of Savants . History . During the Rage of Demons conflict , the Keepers were in great danger , because the Gray Ghosts thieves ' guild stole the red dragon egg containing the new Wyrmsmith , and Themberchaud , the current Wyrmsmith , started considering conquering the whole city for himself .

title: Keesha
description: Keesha Keesha was one of the finest archers of Tulom - Itzi . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the lieutenants of Gultec in trying to delay the Darien ' s army of giant ant s in order to protect the column of the refugee .
description_long: Keesha Keesha was one of the finest archers of Tulom - Itzi . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the lieutenants of Gultec in trying to delay the Darien ' s army of giant ant s in order to protect the column of the refugee .

title: Keevosen Nihili
description: Keevosen Nihili Keevosen Nihili was a shadovar spy in restored Myth Drannor in 1375 DR . History . Keevosen established herself near the restored Myth Drannor in the old house of the Blackthorn family with a group of People of the Black Blood werewolves at her service .
description_long: Keevosen Nihili Keevosen Nihili was a shadovar spy in restored Myth Drannor in 1375 DR . History . Keevosen established herself near the restored Myth Drannor in the old house of the Blackthorn family with a group of People of the Black Blood werewolves at her service . On the surface , she was friendly with the elves , helping to slay the remaining monsters and occasional invaders , but in truth she spied for her shadovar masters . In 1375 DR , after the second battle of Shadowdale , she set an ambush for a group of adventurers who , with the help of Darcassan , were investigating the theft of the " Nether Scrolls " from Windsong Tower . However the adventurers defeated Keevosen and her werewolf minions . Relationship . She had as a familiar a crow called Medar .

title: Keffiyeh
description: Keffiyeh Keffiyeh were the traditional headcloths worn by inhabitants of Zakhara , Calimshan , and the Arnaden region . Description . A keffiyeh covered the head and hung down the neck .
description_long: Keffiyeh Keffiyeh were the traditional headcloths worn by inhabitants of Zakhara , Calimshan , and the Arnaden region . Description . A keffiyeh covered the head and hung down the neck . It was secured in place by a skullcap or turban , which in Zakhara was called an " agal " . A keffiyeh served the practical purpose of protecting the head from the sun and the wind . Length , color , and style varied considerably between tribes , cities , and even families . Price . Price varied depending on quality : simple cloth keffiyeh sold for 3 cp and fine silk ones sold for up to 10 gp .

title: Kei Bot Li
description: Kei Bot Li Kei Bot Li was a general in the army of Shou Lung . History . Kei Bot Li was the competent general of the provincial Army of Hungtze .
description_long: Kei Bot Li Kei Bot Li was a general in the army of Shou Lung . History . Kei Bot Li was the competent general of the provincial Army of Hungtze . In 1359 , War Minister Kwan Chan Sen choose Kei Bot Li as one of the five generals that would help General Batu Min Ho in the campaign against the Tuigan Horde . Kei Bot Li often vehemently disagreed with Batu ' s unorthodox tactics . Finally , during the siege of Shou Kuan , without Batu ' s orders , Kei Bot Li and two other generals ordered a suicidal charge that killed most of their army . Batu considered Kei Bot Li a traitor and quickly executed him himself .

title: Keinen
description: Keinen Keinen was a paladin in the service of Waterdeep ' s temple of Torm . Description . Keinen was an elderly man with long locks of white hair , sporting a significant beard that nearly reached his waist .
description_long: Keinen Keinen was a paladin in the service of Waterdeep ' s temple of Torm . Description . Keinen was an elderly man with long locks of white hair , sporting a significant beard that nearly reached his waist . Underneath his armor he wore a lengthy , green gambeson . Personality . Although his goal was to become the leader of Torm ' s Waterdhavian priesthood , Keinen knew deep inside that a quiet clerical life was not for him . His true passion was the art of combat , and he therefore chose to compromise by becoming a paladin . Possessions . Keinen wore a suit of banded mail . In combat he rode a brown warhorse with chain barding , and wielded a lance and shield .

title: Kelazzan
description: Kelazzan Kelazzan was a coastal city located in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Kelazzan had the distinction of being both the westernmost and southernmost settlement of Ulgarth .
description_long: Kelazzan Kelazzan was a coastal city located in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Kelazzan had the distinction of being both the westernmost and southernmost settlement of Ulgarth . It bore the brunt of the winter storms off the Great Sea as a result . Government . Through the mid – 14th century DR , Kelazzan was governed by Baron Larid Herokimal , a war hero and paladin . Herokimal was dedicated to law and order and good and fair justice for all . He also felt everyone should enjoy the fruits of their own efforts as far as possible , and no one should be exploited or restricted . His policies kept life in Kelazzan quite pleasant . Defenses . With the kingdom ' s naval shipyards in Kelazzan , the city was well defended by sea , with up to twenty warships ready to set sail when the need arose . However , its land forces were few — only 500 guardsmen who patrolled the city in twenty troops of 25 . Trade . Around 1367 DR , the majority of citizens were traders or farmers working the eastern mingari farms , which provided most of Kelazzan ' s wealth . Baron Herokimal ' s policies allowed trade to flourish and the city to prosper .

title: Keld
description: Keld Keld was a stone giant carver at the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Keld and all his fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue .
description_long: Keld Keld was a stone giant carver at the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Keld and all his fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue . Keld became very impatient , a very strange behavior for a stone giant .

title: Keldar of the Forest
description: Keldar of the Forest Keldar of the Forest was a Human male priest of Silvanus who lived in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . Keldar was a member of the band of adventurer s that slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who once rampaged across the Vast .
description_long: Keldar of the Forest Keldar of the Forest was a Human male priest of Silvanus who lived in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . Keldar was a member of the band of adventurer s that slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who once rampaged across the Vast . Keldar and the survivors took possession of the dragon ' s hoard of coins and decided to settle near the location of her lair , the Dragon Falls waterfall . They constructed themselves a stronghold and the village of Dragons Fall grew around them over four generations . By 1370 DR , Keldar was still living at the stronghold , though it was under new ownership and operating as the Inn of the Dragon . Activities . Keldar was Dragon Falls ' s resident priest . He maintained a shrine to Silvanus that stood at the head of the falls though he more often ignored it .

title: Kelddath Ormlyr
description: Kelddath Ormlyr In 1368 DR , Kelddath Ormlyr was the Most Radiant of Lathander and high priest of the temple of Lathander known as the Song of the Morning , located in Beregost . Before becoming high priest Kelddath had once been a merchant . He was typically regarded as the governor of Beregost , though he left the day - to - day activities to the town council .
description_long: Kelddath Ormlyr In 1368 DR , Kelddath Ormlyr was the Most Radiant of Lathander and high priest of the temple of Lathander known as the Song of the Morning , located in Beregost . Before becoming high priest Kelddath had once been a merchant . He was typically regarded as the governor of Beregost , though he left the day - to - day activities to the town council . He was a strong supporter of local improvement and often loaned money and advice to locals .

title: Keldith Oericel
description: Keldith Oericel Keldith Oericel was one of the captains of Leuthilspar ' s infantry who had joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade . In 1374 DR , he replaced the dead Celeilol Fireheart as leader of the Leuthilspar contingent and was one of the captains summoned by Seiveril to plan the Cormanthor War .
description_long: Keldith Oericel Keldith Oericel was one of the captains of Leuthilspar ' s infantry who had joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade . In 1374 DR , he replaced the dead Celeilol Fireheart as leader of the Leuthilspar contingent and was one of the captains summoned by Seiveril to plan the Cormanthor War .

title: Keldor Hannith
description: Keldor Hannith Keldor Hannith was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He was a wizard who sold scroll s and potion s , and performed spellcasting services for a fee . Hannith was described as a quiet and careful man , but was one of the more notable Procampan mages of his day .

title: Keldorn ( family )
description: Keldorn ( family ) The Keldorn family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Keldorn Firecam
description: Keldorn Firecam Sir Keldorn Firecam is a human paladin of Torm and a respected senior member of the Order of the Radiant Heart living in Athkatla . Dedicated to his work and cause , he was often absent from his family even near retirement , at least temporarily alienating them . In 1369 DR , he was sent to investigate the Cult of the Eyeless .
description_long: Keldorn Firecam Sir Keldorn Firecam is a human paladin of Torm and a respected senior member of the Order of the Radiant Heart living in Athkatla . Dedicated to his work and cause , he was often absent from his family even near retirement , at least temporarily alienating them . In 1369 DR , he was sent to investigate the Cult of the Eyeless . Keldorn is a party NPC in the " " computer game and its expansion " " . He is found fighting some undead in the sewers of Athkatla under the Temple District , where the base of the Cult of the Eyeless can be accessed . He will accost the player ' s party and can join their cause , at first to root out the cult . Later , when the player enters the Government District , Keldorn will ask to visit his estate where his wife and children live . Since he has been constantly absent from home , however , the reception he receives is somewhat cold , and eventually it is revealed that his wife has been alleviating her loneliness in the company of another man . Keldorn is devastated and angry , but the player can decide whether he will turn her in to the authorities as he feels he should .

title: Keledon
description: Keledon Keledon was a ghost revealed to be the husband of the elven songstress of the Elfsong Tavern . Appearance . Keledon was located though a door in the onyx tower and could be seen as a ghostly apparition .
description_long: Keledon Keledon was a ghost revealed to be the husband of the elven songstress of the Elfsong Tavern . Appearance . Keledon was located though a door in the onyx tower and could be seen as a ghostly apparition . He appeared to be wearing a tattered green cloak . His hair , though only properly visible on the sides , was white . His head , body and limbs all resembled skeletal structures . Keledon often floated above the ground . History . Keledon was a soldier of the Westering Sun , under Eldrith ' s command . Becasue of her treachery , Keledon met his fate in the Marsh of Chelimber , along with the rest of his men . Keledon was knowledgeable about the story of the elven maiden who sang in the Elfsong tavern . He left his wife within the walls of Baldur ' s Gate were she would be safe . He described her as the most beautiful elven maid and after , revealing that the voice in the elfsong tavern was his wife , who sang in lament for him . Both spirits could not rest until Eldrith was defeated and they can reunit .

title: Kelemvor
description: Kelemvor Kelemvor ( pronounced " KELL - em - vor " ) , formerly Kelemvor Lyonsbane , also known as the Lord of the Dead and Judge of the Damned , was the god of death and the dead , and master of the Crystal Spire in the Fugue Plane . In his mortal days , Kelemvor was a skilled mercenary , with the heart of a noble paladin , concealed under rude manners and thwarted by his mysterious family curse . Fair yet cold , Kelemvor was the god of death and the dead — the most recent deity to hold this position , following in the footsteps of Jergal , Myrkul , and Cyric .
description_long: Kelemvor Kelemvor ( pronounced " KELL - em - vor " ) , formerly Kelemvor Lyonsbane , also known as the Lord of the Dead and Judge of the Damned , was the god of death and the dead , and master of the Crystal Spire in the Fugue Plane . In his mortal days , Kelemvor was a skilled mercenary , with the heart of a noble paladin , concealed under rude manners and thwarted by his mysterious family curse . Fair yet cold , Kelemvor was the god of death and the dead — the most recent deity to hold this position , following in the footsteps of Jergal , Myrkul , and Cyric . Unlike these other deities , whose rule as gods of the dead made the afterlife an uncertain and fearful thing , Kelemvor urged knowledge that death was a natural part of life and should not be feared as long as it was understood . As a result of his deep respect for life and death , he holds the undead in the uttermost contempt . Worshipers . The death clergy as they were known had many duties , most involve tending to the last wishes of the dying and providing burial services to those who die alone . They also set out to cure diseases and defend people from monsters so that folk did not die before their time .

title: Kelemvor ' s Garden
description: Kelemvor ' s Garden Kelemvor ' s Garden , previously known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , was a graveyard in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . The graveyard was originally known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , but Lorelei Gravesower renamed it when she became caretaker in the 1360s DR .
description_long: Kelemvor ' s Garden Kelemvor ' s Garden , previously known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , was a graveyard in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . The graveyard was originally known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , but Lorelei Gravesower renamed it when she became caretaker in the 1360s DR . Services . Most of the dead of Thunderstone were buried in this cemetery , as well as slain adventurers whose bodies were brought back to town . Purple Dragons and those who ' d displayed great heroics in life or immediately prior to death were buried in The Honor Field , which lay in one corner of the graveyard . It was said that anyone interred there would be favored in the afterlife . " Working in the Garden " became a euphemism for death among adventurers operating in the area . A cleric of Kelemvor , Lorelei Gravesower ' s task was to provide counselling and advice to the grieving and conduct maintenance on the cemetery . She had a small house on the grounds . Rumors .

title: Kella Darkhope
description: Kella Darkhope Kella Darkhope was a Zhentarim agent in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Kella went to Nightsone posing as an itinerant monk .
description_long: Kella Darkhope Kella Darkhope was a Zhentarim agent in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Kella went to Nightsone posing as an itinerant monk . In truth she planned to occupy the village in name of the Zhent , driving away the Lionshield Coster and bullying Lady Velrosa Nandar . For this she had recruit the help of the Seven Snakes group . However a cloud giant s bombardment ruined Kella ' s plan . She remained hidden in the village ' s tavern while the goblin raiding the various buildings . Relationship . Xolkin Alassandar , leader of the Seven Snakes , was in love with Kella although she did not harbour the same feelings towards Xolkin .

title: Kellesar
description: Kellesar Kellesar was a settlement near the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It lay at the southern end of Barbarians ' Road , which formed the border between Ulgarth and the barbarian lands of the east , amidst the Stony Waste . Appendix .
description_long: Kellesar Kellesar was a settlement near the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It lay at the southern end of Barbarians ' Road , which formed the border between Ulgarth and the barbarian lands of the east , amidst the Stony Waste . Appendix . Notes . Kellesar is known only from its appearance on the maps on page 53 and 73 of " The Shining South " ( 1993 ) . Kelazzan is described as Ulgarth ' s southernmost city , suggesting that Kellesar is either not a city or not a part of Ulgarth . This article only places Kellesar geographically in Ulgarth for organizational purposes . At Candlekeep ' s unofficial errata , Simon Gibbs argues that Kellesar and Kaspar should be swapped on the maps , as the description of Kaspar better fits the southern location . This article remains with the canon version , however .

title: Kellindil
description: Kellindil Kellindil was an elven archer and a member of Dove Falconhand ' s traveling party . Kellindil tied Roddy McGristle up to have him tried for his crimes in Sundabar , mainly against Montolio Debrouchee and Drizzt Do ' Urden , as he was the one who lead an army of orc s and winter wolves against them in Mooshie ' s Grove . Tephanis cut Roddy ' s bindings and Roddy strangled the elf with his bare hands .
description_long: Kellindil Kellindil was an elven archer and a member of Dove Falconhand ' s traveling party . Kellindil tied Roddy McGristle up to have him tried for his crimes in Sundabar , mainly against Montolio Debrouchee and Drizzt Do ' Urden , as he was the one who lead an army of orc s and winter wolves against them in Mooshie ' s Grove . Tephanis cut Roddy ' s bindings and Roddy strangled the elf with his bare hands . Then he buried him and whatever supplies he couldn ' t carry .

title: Kelnozz
description: Kelnozz Kelnozz was a commoner drow warrior of House Kenafin of Menzoberranzan . History . Kelnozz was classmates with Drizzt Do ' Urden at Melee - Magthere , the fighters ' academy .
description_long: Kelnozz Kelnozz was a commoner drow warrior of House Kenafin of Menzoberranzan . History . Kelnozz was classmates with Drizzt Do ' Urden at Melee - Magthere , the fighters ' academy . Their class , which began circa 1317 DR was unusually large ; it began with 25 students and ended with 22 . Kelnozz was Drizzt ' s first " friend . " They partnered during the first Grand Melee , but Kelnozz turned on Drizzt , leaving him in eighth place and revealing to him the wicked nature of the drow .

title: Kelpie
description: Kelpie A kelpie was a creature that resembled a mass of seaweed . It could alter its form to appear as a woman , a hippocampus , or a green horse , then charm a person into thinking it was in trouble and needed rescuing . Upon the person attempting to rescue the person , the kelpie grappled the victim and held it in the water until it drowned .
description_long: Kelpie A kelpie was a creature that resembled a mass of seaweed . It could alter its form to appear as a woman , a hippocampus , or a green horse , then charm a person into thinking it was in trouble and needed rescuing . Upon the person attempting to rescue the person , the kelpie grappled the victim and held it in the water until it drowned . History . In 1361 DR , the illithid Vestress used the human Dagmar to plant kelpies in the water in her attempt to conquer the island of Ruathym .

title: Kelson Darktreader
description: Kelson Darktreader Kelson Darktreader was a half - elf hunter in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . Personality . Kelson was a man of very few words .
description_long: Kelson Darktreader Kelson Darktreader was a half - elf hunter in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . Personality . Kelson was a man of very few words . He really like being a guide for the dukes ' s hunts or teaching the secrets of the wild to young rangers . His decision to go against the Thayan s had less to do with fighting evil but more with protecting Shalendra Floshin and showing her that his half - elf blood was worth more than she once thought . Kelson , however , also couldn ' t resist the idea of a last mission against the forces of evil . History . Kelson was the grandson of Elorfindar Floshin and a nephew of Darfin Floshin . He worked as hunt master for the dukes of Daggerford for generations , starting with Duke Pryden Daggerford . Nobody knew the Misty Forest and High Moor better than him . On a number of occasions , Kelson helped Sir Isteval . In 1486 DR , he agreed to a last mission against the Red Wizards of Thay based in Daggerford .

title: Keltar
description: Keltar Keltar , one of the oldest cities in Faerûn , was located in Calimshan and was famous for being the site of the House of the Broken God . Geography and Layout . Keltar was located at the eastern edge of the Calim Desert along the deepest point of the Calim River .
description_long: Keltar Keltar , one of the oldest cities in Faerûn , was located in Calimshan and was famous for being the site of the House of the Broken God . Geography and Layout . Keltar was located at the eastern edge of the Calim Desert along the deepest point of the Calim River . The majority of the city was on the west side of the river , but the cattle processing centers were on the east side . It was one of the smaller cities of Calimshan — a town by usual Calishite standards — and contained eight sabban s composed of 24 drudach s . Unlike with other Calishite cities , Keltar ' s sabbans were named after the eight points of the compass . The city contained a massive to divert the waters of the Calim River and boasted many canals flowing through its easternmost sabbans . In Northeast Sabban , these canals turned waterwheels to power mills and also giant fans , which were designed to blow the smell of cattle pens , slaughterhouses , and away . In other areas of the city , they were used for fishing and swimming or for travel in . The House of the Broken God ( see below ) encompassed the entire Northwest Sabban .

title: Keltar ( individual )
description: Keltar ( individual ) Keltar was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Keltar believed Gorx was an emissary of Ogrémoch . History .
description_long: Keltar ( individual ) Keltar was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Keltar believed Gorx was an emissary of Ogrémoch . History . In 1491 DR , Keltar was at the Fane when a gate to the Elemental Plane of Earth disgorged Gorx . Keltar quickly pledged himself to what was , in his eyes , the holy envoy of Ogrémoch . He did all Gorx demanded of him , but remained to patrol the Black Earth Hall . However , some adventurers infiltrated the fane and confronted him .

title: Kelthann
description: Kelthann Kelthann was an island in the Pirate Isles . It had few true pirates , owing to its close proximity to Sembia , but it acted as a smuggling port , where goods could be transferred freely between parties without regulation or taxation . The human and halfling natives here worshiped Grumbar .

title: Keltormir
description: Keltormir Keltormir was a moon and green elf realm established circa - 17800 DR to avoid the strife of the other elven nations . . Geography .
description_long: Keltormir Keltormir was a moon and green elf realm established circa - 17800 DR to avoid the strife of the other elven nations . . Geography . The forests of the realm encompassed the areas known later as Amn , Tethyr , Erlkazar , and Calimshan . History . Giant s came to the forests of Keltormir and Shantel Othreier , seeking to establish their own realm and started felling trees in large numbers . The elves learned that this would provoke the dragon s in the region into attacking the giants , but they wanted their lives to stay peaceful , so took a neutral stance . The dragons did indeed attack the giants . In - 11700 DR their breath cut a fiery swathe through the forests . In an attempt to protect his fellow elves , the soon - to - be hero Tethir sacrificed himself to slay two ancient red dragon s . This act created the first elven dragonslayer and earned the elves the grudging respect of the dragons . The northern edge of Keltormir was renamed the Forest of Tethir in his honour . . Giants and human s settled the areas where dragonfire and giant woodcutters had cleared the forest . This prevented the elves from restoring their trees .

title: Kelvhan Olortynnal
description: Kelvhan Olortynnal Kelvahn Olortynnal was Arms - Major of the Akh ' Velahr in the years of the Weeping War . The Arms Major and his friend , Hachaam Selorn , died defending Myth Drannor on Kythorn 26 , 714 D . R .
description_long: Kelvhan Olortynnal Kelvahn Olortynnal was Arms - Major of the Akh ' Velahr in the years of the Weeping War . The Arms Major and his friend , Hachaam Selorn , died defending Myth Drannor on Kythorn 26 , 714 D . R . He was the last wielder of the Bane Blade " Keryvian " before the hero Fflar recovered it from his body during the battle at Crownfrost Towers .

title: Kelvin ' s Cairn
description: Kelvin ' s Cairn Kelvin ' s Cairn was a mountain in Icewind Dale . Description . Kelvin ' s Cairn was a free - standing 1 , 000 - foot - tall mountain fronted by a river valley about as deep as the mount was high .
description_long: Kelvin ' s Cairn Kelvin ' s Cairn was a mountain in Icewind Dale . Description . Kelvin ' s Cairn was a free - standing 1 , 000 - foot - tall mountain fronted by a river valley about as deep as the mount was high . The mountain top was always capped with snow and ice even through the short summer . The mountain was the only peak within a thousand miles , even though it appeared as merely a pile of loose boulders . Dwarven Valley . Stretching South South West for several miles from the south face of the Cairn is a deep trench known locally as the Dwarven Valley . It consisted mostly of underground mining tunnels and relatively austere living quarters made from expended mining tunnels . Bruenor ' s Climb . Bruenor ' s Climb was a 15 - foot - high column of stone that offered a vantage point over Termalaine and Maer Dualdon . It was a favorite place of reflection of Bruenor Battlehammer and Drizzt Do ' Urden . . It was located four miles south of Kelvin ' s Cairn , on the east bank of the valley . The Climb was destroyed in 1356 DR but the dwarves reconstructed it in Bruenor ' s honour . Bruenor ' s " Temple " .

title: Kelvin ' s Comfort
description: Kelvin ' s Comfort Kelvin ' s Comfort was a tavern in Bryn Shander . Location . The tavern was located next to Bryn Shander ' s market square .
description_long: Kelvin ' s Comfort Kelvin ' s Comfort was a tavern in Bryn Shander . Location . The tavern was located next to Bryn Shander ' s market square . Services . The tavern was famous for its signature drink known as Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy . It also served mead from Good Mead and liquors imported from Mirabar . Inhabitants . Kelvin ' s Comfort was owned by shield dwarf Ogden Flamebeard sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . A frequent patron was Baric Nylef while he searched for Dwarven criminal Worvil Forkbeard , who was known to be addicted to Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy .

title: Kemarn Darkthrush
description: Kemarn Darkthrush Kemarn Darkthrush was a wizard from Nesmé who , in 1374 DR , attempted to kill Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Background . Raegar Stoneblade inadvertently exploded the side of Blackstaff Tower on 28 Uktar 1374 DR , causing Khelben to be wounded .
description_long: Kemarn Darkthrush Kemarn Darkthrush was a wizard from Nesmé who , in 1374 DR , attempted to kill Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Background . Raegar Stoneblade inadvertently exploded the side of Blackstaff Tower on 28 Uktar 1374 DR , causing Khelben to be wounded . Raegar tried to flee by shrouding the street in fog , and Kemarn took his opportunity to strike . He cast a spell to unleash four huge black wolves that began attacking Khelben . A battle ensued between Kemarn and the defenders of the tower , who included Khelben , Elkord , Triam , Jalarra , Sarshel , Fhaornik , Maeralya and Pikar Salibuck . After Khelben ' s apprentices were able to dispel the wolves , Kemarn used a red fist - sized globe to summon a nishruu , which began attacking Khelben and the other defenders . A sun elf apprentice , Fhaornik , attempted to use a " rod of absorption " to kill the nishruu , but it did not stop the creature . Kemarn threatened Raegar with death unless he handed over his sword , but Raegar stabbed him in the shin and caused him to fall from a roof . Raegar then escaped with the sword .

title: Kemil Abd al - Jasir
description: Kemil Abd al - Jasir Kemil Abd al - Jasir was a general and commander of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Kemil usually followed the lead of senior members of the military council since he was only a minor member .
description_long: Kemil Abd al - Jasir Kemil Abd al - Jasir was a general and commander of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Kemil usually followed the lead of senior members of the military council since he was only a minor member . Any group or individual supporting exploration or other goals of the Dauntless usually had his vote .

title: Kempfana
description: Kempfana Kempfana was a barghest whelp from the plains of Gehenna . Description . Kempana was a huge , scarlet - skinned goblinlike creature .
description_long: Kempfana Kempfana was a barghest whelp from the plains of Gehenna . Description . Kempana was a huge , scarlet - skinned goblinlike creature . When excited , his eyes would glow orange . . Personality . Of the two , Kempfana was the weaker , Ulgulu having claimed dominance , eating the stronger of their victims . History . Sent to the Material Plane to eat and grow , Kempfana and his brother Ulgulu made their home in the cave of the hill giant , Lagerbottoms , where they could safely mature before returning to their home plane . Around 1340 DR , the barghests sent their main force of gnoll s to capture the human father and eldest son from the Thistledown farm , but raiders never returned . Ulgulu and his brother sent Nathak to scout out what happened and he returned reporting their raiding party of five gnolls were dead . . After that Ulgulu sent his quickling ally , Tephanis , to discover exactly what had happened . When Tephanis returned , he told them a newly - surfaced drow , Drizzt Do ' Urden , had slain the monsters . In rage , Ulgulu asked the quickling steal one of Drizzt ' s scimitar s .

title: Kenai al - Afriz
description: Kenai al - Afriz Kenai al - Afriz was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Kenai ' s real dao name was Shahraman . Personality .
description_long: Kenai al - Afriz Kenai al - Afriz was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Kenai ' s real dao name was Shahraman . Personality . Kenai spoke with a sly voice that contained a hint of conspiracy behind it . Activities . Kenai was one of two dao who operated the ferry that ushered people across the mighty Al - Sarif River that bisected Huzuz . Kenai enjoyed exchanging tales of gossip with travelers on the ferry , especially if the stories marred the reputations of others . History . Kenai was forced to serve as a ferryman because of an unknown crime committed on the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Kendar Morn
description: Kendar Morn Kendar Morn was the constable of Daggerdale . Personality . Kendar loved his work .
description_long: Kendar Morn Kendar Morn was the constable of Daggerdale . Personality . Kendar loved his work . He did not trust people from Mulmaster , Darkhold , or old Zhentil Keep . History . Kendar , a member of the Morn family , was chosen as constable of Dagger Falls . In 1479 DR , after an increase in raids by gnoll s , he discussed with the mayor the option of hiring a group of Zhent mercenaries to clear the area . Secretly , Kendar did not trust the Zhents and hired an adventuring party to investigate the raids .

title: Kendrin Feldarr
description: Kendrin Feldarr Kendrin Feldarr was a merchant during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kendrin usually sold exotic animals all around the Sword Coast North .
description_long: Kendrin Feldarr Kendrin Feldarr was a merchant during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kendrin usually sold exotic animals all around the Sword Coast North . History . In 1491 DR , during a stop at the Bargewright Inn , he became involved in a plot by Inglor Brathren to discredit both Chalaska Muruin and Nalaskur Thaelond .

title: Kenku
description: Kenku Kenkus were a race of flightless avian humanoid s . They tended to be selfish and secretive in nature and were often engaged in plots to acquire wealth and power . They operated in small gangs and often lived in large human cities , especially in southern Faerûn , where they worked as spies , assassins , or thieves .
description_long: Kenku Kenkus were a race of flightless avian humanoid s . They tended to be selfish and secretive in nature and were often engaged in plots to acquire wealth and power . They operated in small gangs and often lived in large human cities , especially in southern Faerûn , where they worked as spies , assassins , or thieves . Description . Although they evolved from avians , kenkus had no wings or capacity for flight . Instead , they had arms in place of wings and bird - like talons for hands and feet . They retained bird - like features , however , with black and beady eyes and a long dark - hued beak . Head and torso were covered with soft feathers , a dark russet - brown color , while their scrawny limbs were bare and scaled like a bird ' s . They most resembled raven s . Kenkus tended to be slightly smaller than the average human , standing at around 5 feet ( 1 . 5 meters ) . Because they had partially hollow bones , they were lighter than most creatures their height , averaging only 75 pounds ( 34 kilograms ) . They were therefore not as strong , but they were more agile and dexterous . They typically wore nondescript brown robes , under which they concealed tools and weaponry .

title: Kenku ( winged )
description: Kenku ( winged ) Kenku were a race of winged avian humanoid s . Description . The kenku had a human - like frame , standing 5 – 7 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Kenku ( winged ) Kenku were a race of winged avian humanoid s . Description . The kenku had a human - like frame , standing 5 – 7 feet ( 1 . 5 – 2 . 1 meters ) tall on bird - like legs , with arms ending in claws and bearing the head of a hawk with bright yellow eyes . They were covered all over with brown feathers , with white underfeathers and facial markings . They had a pair of wings , which , when folded over their backs , might be mistaken for a backpack or bundle . They wore local human attire . Powers . In addition to being natural thieves and warriors , kenku were masters of disguise . Even with their hawk - like heads , they could pass among humans half the time , albeit with unusually large noses . Elder and experienced kenku acquired increasing arcane powers . First , they learned one basic spell , often " magic missile " , and once a month they could " shape change " and keep a shape for up to seven days . Later , they mastered another basic spell , typically " shocking grasp " , and could turn invisible at will for as long as they wished .

title: Kenniwick
description: Kenniwick Kenniwick was a merchant visiting the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Kenniwick visited the new Temple of Mystra and was among a group of people who partook in the three - day - long ritual of Mystra ' s Sacred Trust that the priests there were pushing , alongside eleven others : Durgen Glintstone , Kareem Hastith , Smote , Tholwick Styles , Dava , Mendios , Zephan , Veera Wavecrest , Halish , Duncan , and Amnic Basult .
description_long: Kenniwick Kenniwick was a merchant visiting the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Kenniwick visited the new Temple of Mystra and was among a group of people who partook in the three - day - long ritual of Mystra ' s Sacred Trust that the priests there were pushing , alongside eleven others : Durgen Glintstone , Kareem Hastith , Smote , Tholwick Styles , Dava , Mendios , Zephan , Veera Wavecrest , Halish , Duncan , and Amnic Basult . In the end , Starweaver Deinyn Fembrys " dominated " all of them with the " Starry Gnosis " , abducting them as part of a secret Shar ran plot . However , Kenniwick either resisted the effect or was deemed unsuitable , lacking any magical ability . Kenniwick , Duncan , and Amnic were tortured to death on a rack by Fembrys , then beheaded and had their heads stuffed and mounted in the mad priest ' s room . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , investigators found their bodies and identified them by their possessions .

title: Kensei
description: Kensei Kensei , sometimes called kensai , were fighter s trained in an ancient school of martial fighting that refined the skills of an individual warrior in their weapon of choice . These fighters , as a result , often became unrivaled amongst all other warriors as the master of their chosen weapon , whatever it may be . In Shou Lung , these fighters were called chujen ( " master " ) .
description_long: Kensei Kensei , sometimes called kensai , were fighter s trained in an ancient school of martial fighting that refined the skills of an individual warrior in their weapon of choice . These fighters , as a result , often became unrivaled amongst all other warriors as the master of their chosen weapon , whatever it may be . In Shou Lung , these fighters were called chujen ( " master " ) . Abilities . Kensei were trained to refine their skills in a particular melee weapon of their choice and were often incredibly disciplined as a result , recovering from would - be failures easily . When wielding their weapon of choice kensei exhibited an uncanny amount of control and finesse , striking deadly accurate blows . However , in spite of this strength of focus kensei could , and sometimes did , choose an alternative weapon , though they lost the benefits of their training until re - accustoming themselves to the new weapon through meditation , rest , and training . The exploit s of a kensei were incredibely deadly , particularly when the kensei used their weapon of choice .

title: Kensidan
description: Kensidan Kensidan was the son of Rethnor , the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . History . Kensidan came to prominence in 1377 DR when Captain Deudermont tried to free Luskan from the rule of the High Captains and the Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Kensidan Kensidan was the son of Rethnor , the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . History . Kensidan came to prominence in 1377 DR when Captain Deudermont tried to free Luskan from the rule of the High Captains and the Arcane Brotherhood . Kensidan , a very scheming individual , convinced his father that at first they should make no move against Deudermont in fighting against the Host Tower . Later , when Deudermont had won and was elected governor , Kensidan made an agreement with Bregan D ' aerthe for assistance , and his father fomented the fury of the people against the governor for a famine that plagued the city . Finally , Rethnor died , probably helped along by Kensidan . Kensidan started a open revolt that took control of Luskan and Kensidan himself killed Deudermont . Thus Luskan became , as Kensidan had always wanted , a true free port where it was possible buy all kind of tools , including slaves and drugs . Possessions . The nickname of Kensidan originated with the " Cloak of the Crow " , a magical cape that could polymorph a man into a giant crow .

title: Keolan Dracohorn
description: Keolan Dracohorn Keolan Dracohorn was the founder of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . History . He found a dead young blue dragon on the site that would become known as Soldier ' s Green , and claimed to have killed it , which was the origin of the family name .
description_long: Keolan Dracohorn Keolan Dracohorn was the founder of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . History . He found a dead young blue dragon on the site that would become known as Soldier ' s Green , and claimed to have killed it , which was the origin of the family name .

title: Kepeshkmolik Ashoka
description: Kepeshkmolik Ashoka Kepeshkmolik Ashoka was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik . She was the last living daughter of Kepeshkmolik Thymara in 1486 DR . Description .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Ashoka Kepeshkmolik Ashoka was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik . She was the last living daughter of Kepeshkmolik Thymara in 1486 DR . Description . Ashoka had one dark eye and one silver eye . Her scales were pale coppery - brown , and she had white plumes . History . In 1486 DR , Ashoka requested to talk with Farideh , in order to give her the Black Axe of the Moon ' s Champion , and in doing so , fulfilling the promise her mother had done to Selûne .

title: Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi
description: Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik and was a direct descendant of Shasphur . He was also the Chosen of Enlil . Description .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik and was a direct descendant of Shasphur . He was also the Chosen of Enlil . Description . Dumuzi had dark gray scales . Abilities . Dumuzi could breathe lightning . History . Dumuzi was the son of Verthisathurgiesh Arjhani and Kepeshkmolik Uadjit , and originally a member of Clan Verthisathurgiesh . He was returned to Clan Kepeshkmolik because he was unable to withstand Verthisathurgiesh Pandjed ' s abuses . In his youth , he was also part of the Liberators of the Steel Sky , although he didn ' t agreed with their beliefs . In 1486 DR , Dumuzi was sent by Clan Verthisathurgiesh to find Mehen and convince him to return to Djerad Thymar . It took him months , but eventually he was able to find Mehen and convinced him to return . During his time traveling , Dumuzi helped the Cormyr ian guard during the siege of Suzail . When he returned to Djerad Thymar , be began to have strange dreams about a bearded warrior who talked to him in a language Dumuzi couldn ' t understand .

title: Kepeshkmolik Narghon
description: Kepeshkmolik Narghon Kepeshkmolik Narghon was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Kepeshkmolik in 1486 DR . He was the father of Kepeshkmolik Uadjit . Description .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Narghon Kepeshkmolik Narghon was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Kepeshkmolik in 1486 DR . He was the father of Kepeshkmolik Uadjit . Description . Narghon had tarnished brass , green and dark scales History . Narghon always resented Mehen for having spurned his daughter Uadjit . In 1486 DR , Narghon was investigating a series of murders in the Catacombs of Djerad Thymar .

title: Kepeshkmolik Tarhun
description: Kepeshkmolik Tarhun Kepeshkmolik Tarhun was a dragonborn warlord member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p301 " > < / ref > and the Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1479 DR , who maintained the dragonborn ' s hardline agenda of dragon hatred . Description . Tarhun was a hulking dragonborn , bulkier than any common dragonborn .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Tarhun Kepeshkmolik Tarhun was a dragonborn warlord member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p301 " > < / ref > and the Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1479 DR , who maintained the dragonborn ' s hardline agenda of dragon hatred . Description . Tarhun was a hulking dragonborn , bulkier than any common dragonborn . Square bits of gold studded the green hide under his eyes like teardrops . Abilities . He was capable of breathe lightning . History . Tarhun and Mehen served at the same time on the Lance Defenders when they were young . They even patrolled together , but never became friends . In 1479 DR , although Tarhun was frustrated about potentially losing Chessenta as an ally after ambassador Perra was banished from that nation , and even more because he cannot help them in the war against Threskel and his ruler , Alasklerbanbastos , he did not had a choice but to focus all of his efforts to protect Tymanther , that was being besieged by ash giants . In order to improve their odds in the conflict , Tarhun hired Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon to train his troops in dwarven battle techniques .

title: Kepeshkmolik Thymara
description: Kepeshkmolik Thymara Kepeshkmolik Thymara was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , and a direct descendant of Shasphur . She was the founder of Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 - 294 " > < / ref > History .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Thymara Kepeshkmolik Thymara was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , and a direct descendant of Shasphur . She was the founder of Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 - 294 " > < / ref > History . Thymara was one of the dragonborn of Tymanchebar who survived the catastrophe that transported their nation from Abeir to Faerûn during the Spellplague . At the time she was pregnant and had little opportunity to survive against the horrors unleashed by the Spellplague . While she was fighting for her life , the goddess Selûne contacted her and guided her to the tomb of a bearded warrior , so Thymara could have her eggs in safety . At the next day , Selûne gave Thymara the warrior ' s weapon , the Black Axe of the Moon ' s Champion , to help her to find other surviving dragonborn . In exchange for her help , Selûne asked Thymara only that the dragonborn race had to thrive in the new world and that , when the time was right , she or her descendants had to give the Axe to its rightful owner .

title: Kepeshkmolik Uadjit
description: Kepeshkmolik Uadjit Kepeshkmolik Uadjit was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . She was a direct descendant of Shasphur . and the mother of Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi .
description_long: Kepeshkmolik Uadjit Kepeshkmolik Uadjit was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . She was a direct descendant of Shasphur . and the mother of Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi . Description . Uadjit had dark eyes and sleek , gray - green scales . History . Around 1450 DR , Uadjit was chosen to be Mehen ' s wife , but he spurned her because he had a relationship with his clanmate , Verthisathurgiesh Arjhani . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p29 - 30 " > < / ref > When Mehen was exiled , Arjhani was chosen by Clan Verthisathurgiesh as the new husband for Uadjit . In 1486 DR , Uadjit was the scion of Clan Kepeshkmolik < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p211 " > < / ref > and the ambassador of Tymanther in High Imaskar . However , she returned to Tymanther when Mulhorand declared their war against the Imaskari . Uadjit was Clan Kepeshkmolik ' s candidate for the elections to chose the new Vanquisher , that were expected to be celebrated in 1487 DR . She was the candidate with the strongest claim to the title . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p256 " > < / ref >

title: Kerbin Dellmon
description: Kerbin Dellmon Kerbin Dellmon was the patriarch of the Dellmon family and a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kerbin managed a great farm in the valley .
description_long: Kerbin Dellmon Kerbin Dellmon was the patriarch of the Dellmon family and a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kerbin managed a great farm in the valley . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the Dellmon property . However , Kerbin refused to abandon his farm and go to Yartar . So he remained with his workers and family to defend it . With the lucky arrival of some adventurers , he was able to defend the farm .

title: Keren Donnell
description: Keren Donnell Keren Donnell was the most famous bard in the Ffolk - inhabited Moonshae Isles . Possessions . Keren used a longbow as tall as a man made of black Callidyrr yew .
description_long: Keren Donnell Keren Donnell was the most famous bard in the Ffolk - inhabited Moonshae Isles . Possessions . Keren used a longbow as tall as a man made of black Callidyrr yew . It was one of a dozen or so weapons that were crafted by the High King ' s own bowyer . He had a falcon companion named Sable . History . While visiting Gwynneth on official business for the High King of the Moonshaes in 1345 DR , he helped Tristan Kendrick and his companions in a fight against a band of firbolg s . They led him to Caer Corwell so he could speak to King Kendrick . On his way back to Caer Callidyrr , he was captured by a band of firbolgs and then rescued by Tristan , alongside Finellen the dwarf .

title: Kereska
description: Kereska Kereska ( pronounced " Kuh - RES - kah " ) was the chaotic neutral dragon goddess of magic , specifically dragon magic and magical creativity . Description . Kereska always manifested in the form of a dragon , although she was able to take on many draconic forms as she wanted to , and specific details about her natural form were unknown .
description_long: Kereska Kereska ( pronounced " Kuh - RES - kah " ) was the chaotic neutral dragon goddess of magic , specifically dragon magic and magical creativity . Description . Kereska always manifested in the form of a dragon , although she was able to take on many draconic forms as she wanted to , and specific details about her natural form were unknown . However , she was always surrounded by a pulsating aura of magical power . Realm . It was believed Kereska had her lair in the plane of Limbo . Abilities . Kereska was reputed to have the ability to cast spell s as many times per day as she wanted to , and as she was the font of magical creativity , she was able to create any new spell - like power with a moment ' s effort . She also had the ability to empower any draconic creature with whatever level of spellcasting ability she wished , and often bestowed her followers with the ability to cast new spells and spell - like abilities if they had pleased her . History . According to draconic myths , it was Kereska who first taught dragonkind how to wield magic . In 1358 DR , Kereska entirely subsumed the worship and portfolio of the demigod Kalzareinad . Kalzareinad died shortly thereafter .

title: Kerim Najar
description: Kerim Najar Kerim Najar was a powerful dwarven sha ' ir who lived in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Kerim was famous in the Court District for building his tower in a single night , an event that sparked many bets on exactly how many genie s were used to construct the tower so quickly .
description_long: Kerim Najar Kerim Najar was a powerful dwarven sha ' ir who lived in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Kerim was famous in the Court District for building his tower in a single night , an event that sparked many bets on exactly how many genie s were used to construct the tower so quickly .

title: Kerima al - Zahir
description: Kerima al - Zahir Kerima al - Zahir was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Personality . Kerima ' s short temper matched her passion for her torrid magical specialization , leading her to challenge many lesser wizard s to personal combat , usually to the death .
description_long: Kerima al - Zahir Kerima al - Zahir was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Personality . Kerima ' s short temper matched her passion for her torrid magical specialization , leading her to challenge many lesser wizard s to personal combat , usually to the death . History . Kerima only lost two personal challenges against other wizards . Both of those wizards were slain by holy slayer s shortly after their duels .

title: Kerinda Lynnrenno
description: Kerinda Lynnrenno Kerinda Lynnrenno was a member of the Shadow Council of Shadow Thieves and the Shade of Baldur ' s Gate around 1370 DR . History . Kerinda was a former sellsword before joining the Shadow Thieves , where she made a career until ascending to the Shadow Council .
description_long: Kerinda Lynnrenno Kerinda Lynnrenno was a member of the Shadow Council of Shadow Thieves and the Shade of Baldur ' s Gate around 1370 DR . History . Kerinda was a former sellsword before joining the Shadow Thieves , where she made a career until ascending to the Shadow Council . Personality . Kerinda was a nondescript but strong woman . Activities . Kerinda ' s public face was running a small festhall in Baldur ' s Gate . Here , she met many visitors , some friends from her past as a sellsword but many others her Shadow Thieves agents . Thank to her contacts and what her employees learned , nothing that happened in the Sword Coast escaped her knowledge .

title: Kern Desanea
description: Kern Desanea Kern Miltiades Desanea was born in 1352 DR and was named the Hammerseeker before his birth on the day the Hammer of Tyr was lost to the evil god Bane and his dark servant , the Hammerwarder . Abilities . Due to his mother Shal Bal casting many powerful spells while pregnant with Kern , Kern became " anti - magic " , meaning that most magic would have no effect on him unless he concentrated on having his anti - magic barrier lowered .
description_long: Kern Desanea Kern Miltiades Desanea was born in 1352 DR and was named the Hammerseeker before his birth on the day the Hammer of Tyr was lost to the evil god Bane and his dark servant , the Hammerwarder . Abilities . Due to his mother Shal Bal casting many powerful spells while pregnant with Kern , Kern became " anti - magic " , meaning that most magic would have no effect on him unless he concentrated on having his anti - magic barrier lowered .

title: Keros
description: Keros Keros the Wanderer was an outcast triton hero . History . Born in 1354 DR , Keros joined the clergy of Persana .
description_long: Keros Keros the Wanderer was an outcast triton hero . History . Born in 1354 DR , Keros joined the clergy of Persana . However , during the Twelfth Serôs War , during the morkoth attack on Abydos to steal artifacts , he inadvertently acquired the " Claw of Xynakt " on himself , thwarting the plans of Axar Xyrl . However , Keros was considered impure by his fellow tritons and cast out of Abydos . He started wandering Serôs in order to avoid his morkoth pursuers . Keros resurfaced during the final battle at Myth Nantar , where he saved the life of the merfolk princess Arina . After the war , he remained for a time in the city but the " mythal " ' s influence made it hard for Keros to control the Claw , so in 1370 DR he left Myth Nantar . Legends . Some believed Keros was the chosen of his god , " Persana ' s Blade " . Relationship . Keros always traveled with his loyal hippocampus Swiftide . During the war , he gained some friends and enemies . Among the former were some dukar s and Princess Arina .

title: Kerrenderit
description: Kerrenderit Kerrenderit were coin - sized ice crystals of exceeding sharpness that could be magically enhanced to form deadly arrowheads . Kerrenderit were nurtured by the arctic dwarves in caves carved into the Great Glacier and they took a long time to form . The word " Kerrenderit " came from the Kurit dialect of Dwarvish .
description_long: Kerrenderit Kerrenderit were coin - sized ice crystals of exceeding sharpness that could be magically enhanced to form deadly arrowheads . Kerrenderit were nurtured by the arctic dwarves in caves carved into the Great Glacier and they took a long time to form . The word " Kerrenderit " came from the Kurit dialect of Dwarvish .

title: Kerrie
description: Kerrie A kerrie was a shaped club weighted for throwing , used primarily in Chult . Description . These throwing clubs were usually crafted out of a hard wood , such as iron wood .
description_long: Kerrie A kerrie was a shaped club weighted for throwing , used primarily in Chult . Description . These throwing clubs were usually crafted out of a hard wood , such as iron wood . They had a long , straight shaft that ended in a flattened , rounded knob , usually about the size of a fist .

title: Kerrigan
description: Kerrigan Kerrigan was a human Masked Lord of Waterdeep . He was the only Lord known to have betrayed Waterdeep . After murdering three other Lords in an attempt to gain sole power in the city , his betrayal was discovered by Open Lord Ahghairon , and a spell battle ensued .
description_long: Kerrigan Kerrigan was a human Masked Lord of Waterdeep . He was the only Lord known to have betrayed Waterdeep . After murdering three other Lords in an attempt to gain sole power in the city , his betrayal was discovered by Open Lord Ahghairon , and a spell battle ensued . The battle ended when Kerrigan was killed in the Southern Ward .

title: Kerrilla Gemstar
description: Kerrilla Gemstar Kerrilla Gemstar was a female shield dwarf and a cleric of Marthammor Duin , the Finder - of - Trails , from Deadsnows in the Silver Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Activities . Around 1370 DR , she was a member of the Council of 12 Peers , and the Observer of the Hospice of Marthammor .
description_long: Kerrilla Gemstar Kerrilla Gemstar was a female shield dwarf and a cleric of Marthammor Duin , the Finder - of - Trails , from Deadsnows in the Silver Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Activities . Around 1370 DR , she was a member of the Council of 12 Peers , and the Observer of the Hospice of Marthammor . This was an often - full hospice and refectory for needy travelers , and Kerrilla led a dozen other clerics , seven monk s , ten friars , and a dozen more guards . She provided healing for good folk , but at a price of a service or favor for the abbey , such as by maintaining law and order in the town or defending it in the city militia . This could also involve investigating some troubling matter . Kerrilla was a close colleague of Morninglord Ashnar . They spoke often on matters important to the community , and their advice and assistance were much sought after by Deadsnows locals . History . In the Year of the Wild Magic , 1372 DR , a dead dwarven prospector named Bromgart found on the road was brought back to Hospice .

title: Keryjek Wars
description: Keryjek Wars The Keryjek Wars were the only serious conflict to occur on the Great Glacier among the Ulutiun peoples . Location . Most of the fighting occurred in the vicinity of the Keryjek Ridge of mountains , which gave the fifty - year conflict its name .
description_long: Keryjek Wars The Keryjek Wars were the only serious conflict to occur on the Great Glacier among the Ulutiun peoples . Location . Most of the fighting occurred in the vicinity of the Keryjek Ridge of mountains , which gave the fifty - year conflict its name . The final battle of the conflict took place in Ertyky Valley . History . Causes . The war began after an especially bitter winter in −963 DR left many Iulutiun villages hungry and suffering . In response , a number of them gathered together and formed a large raiding party . They crossed into Angulutiun territory and targeted the large caribou herds those tribes tended . This act started the war , which would result in fifty years of fighting between the two groups of Ulutiuns . Battle . The final battle between the two tribes within the Ertyky Valley took place in in −913 DR and resulted in the loss of hundreds of warriors on each side . Aftermath . The fighting finally ceased , a treaty was signed , and with this treaty was established the custom of " koatulit " , in which persons from the opposite tribes were invited to live as guests for an extended time period of feasting and games .

title: Keryth Adofaer
description: Keryth Adofaer Keryth Adofaer was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Keryth was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Jhanra Merlistar .
description_long: Keryth Adofaer Keryth Adofaer was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Keryth was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Jhanra Merlistar . Taranath placed three selu ' kiira upon their brows , sending the students into comas while the gems force - feed the knowledge of millennia into their brains . Keryth and his fellow awaked only in tarskath 1 of 1369 DR in order to help in the Twelfth Serôs War . Keyth and his fellow helped their masters in the war and in the great spell that sent Iakhovas to the Outer Planes . After Yrlimn and Taranath exhaust died and Keryth and Jhanra replaced them as new High Mages Activiities . Keryth was a protege of the high mage Pharom Ildacer . He , totally fascinated by Myth Nantar , wandered the city in search of new details to eventually excavate . He hope than in 1371 DR he and his fellow High Mages can clean all the city from corals , restoring it to life .

title: Keryvian
description: Keryvian Keryvian ( also known as Foebane or Demron ' s Bane ) is a Baneblade of Demron and a mighty hand - and - a - half broadsword , or one - handed bastard sword . It was once carried by Fflar Starbrow Melruth . As of 1368 DR it was in the ruins of Myth Drannor , but Seiveril Miritar recovered it some time after this and it was residing at Seamist in northern Evermeet where it decorated a wall for a time , until Fflar was resurrected and took up the sword once more .
description_long: Keryvian Keryvian ( also known as Foebane or Demron ' s Bane ) is a Baneblade of Demron and a mighty hand - and - a - half broadsword , or one - handed bastard sword . It was once carried by Fflar Starbrow Melruth . As of 1368 DR it was in the ruins of Myth Drannor , but Seiveril Miritar recovered it some time after this and it was residing at Seamist in northern Evermeet where it decorated a wall for a time , until Fflar was resurrected and took up the sword once more . " Keryvian " was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , and is considered the greatest of his series of Baneblades . The blade was used by a thief to kill Demron , hence the name " Demron ' s Bane " . " Keryvian " ' s blade glows with a blue fire when drawn , which is light enough to read by , and the hilt bears the likeness of a blue dragon with “ teeth ” clutching the blade . Only a capable warrior of good heart may take up " Keryvian " .

title: Keshna Finlothleer
description: Keshna Finlothleer Keshna Finlothleer was the Guildmaster of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Keshna was a small , driven woman .
description_long: Keshna Finlothleer Keshna Finlothleer was the Guildmaster of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Keshna was a small , driven woman . She was a devotee of Mask and she was always careful about any possible menace to her power from her underlings . History . Keshna grew up as a beggar on the streets of Telflamm until at , the age of nine , the former Guildmaster Vollodan recruited her into the organization . When the guild was shaken by the conflict with the local church of Tempus , Keshna chose as her master and mentor the surviving Veteran Thief Praskin Finlothleer . To honor him , she took his family name after he was killed . Thanks to a combination of talent , influence , and money , she was a Master Thief by the age of seventeen and in 1368 DR Keshna became Guildmaster when her predecessor retired . She proposed to Jalaunther Ithbreeiur to eliminate the Pirates of the Fallen Stars .

title: Kesra Tanor ' Thal
description: Kesra Tanor ' Thal Kesra Tanor ' Thal was House Tanor ' Thal ' s representative in Skullport . Personality . Kesra was a free spirit ready to show her skill in arms and priest magic .
description_long: Kesra Tanor ' Thal Kesra Tanor ' Thal was House Tanor ' Thal ' s representative in Skullport . Personality . Kesra was a free spirit ready to show her skill in arms and priest magic . She was haughty , headstrong , and truly believed herself to be favored by Lolth and destined for greatness . Kesra was an efficient slaver with an ambitious approach . Activities . Kesra managed the slaving operations of her House in Skullport in order to send more and more slaves to her hometown . History . In Karsoluthiyl , Kesra proved to be very efficient for her House , her city and Lolth , impressing her Matron Mother , who decided to choose her as the new representative of her House in Skullport , not trusting Malakuth Tabuirr any more . Arriving in the Port of Shadow , Kesra quickly solidified the Tanor ' Thal ' s influence , mostly disturbing Malakuth ' s businesses . Relationship . Kesra was the niece and representative of Matron Mother Haelra Tanor ' Thal . Her older cousins , Ilmra Tanor ' Thal and Olorae Tanror ' Thal , saw her success as a threat and planned for her removal . Malakuth despised her , more for her House ' s crimes than personally .

title: Kessessek
description: Kessessek Kessessek was a lizardfolk cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss who became the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr in 1374 DR . Abilities . Kessessek wielded the divine magic of a cleric , commanding the Animal and Scalykind domain s .
description_long: Kessessek Kessessek was a lizardfolk cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss who became the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr in 1374 DR . Abilities . Kessessek wielded the divine magic of a cleric , commanding the Animal and Scalykind domain s . He was strong at turning undead with strength of faith , and was very self - sufficient . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , the Sharptooths were attacked by a new tribe — the Shadowscale s , shadow - shrouded undead lizardfolk allied with the church of Shar . The Sharptooths could not resist them ; many were slain , and more were captured and carried off to a ruined keep called the Lost Refuge . Worse , those who were captured eventually came back as Shadowscales themselves , attacking their own kin . In one raid before autumn , the Shadowscales captured a number of Sharptooth lizardfolk , including Kessessek ' s mate Ashala and even the Sharptooths ' old chieftain , Gathan . They were missing and thought dead .

title: Kesson Rel
description: Kesson Rel Kesson Rel is a former Chosen of Mask . Given a sliver of divinity from his patron deity , he was driven insane , eventually driving him away from Mask and into the arms of Shar . Separated from that same spark of divinity by a group of priests serving Mask , who bound it into the shadow dragon Furlinastis and then hid it from him , Kesson spent millennia searching for it .
description_long: Kesson Rel Kesson Rel is a former Chosen of Mask . Given a sliver of divinity from his patron deity , he was driven insane , eventually driving him away from Mask and into the arms of Shar . Separated from that same spark of divinity by a group of priests serving Mask , who bound it into the shadow dragon Furlinastis and then hid it from him , Kesson spent millennia searching for it . He eventually grew so weak that he couldn ' t leave the Plane of Shadow for long , then only the portion of that plane known as the Adumbral Calyx , and finally his spire within that pocket . Eventually , Mask chose new Chosen , Erevis Cale and Drasek Riven , who sought to return the sliver of Mask ' s divinity to their god , and they traveled to the Plane of Shadow . There , Kesson tricked them into freeing that portion of him residing in Furlinastis , and he was made whole again . Known associates . Erevis Cale Mask Shar Elyril Notes . The third edition sourcebook , " Faiths and Pantheons " , depicted Kesson Rel ( known there as Volumvax ) as a traitor to Mask who received his quasi - divinity after millennia of loyally serving Shar .

title: Kessynna
description: Kessynna Princess Kessynna was remembered in Tethyr ian history for how her five daughters were horribly murdered , serving as a common example for why the number five was cursed in Tethyr . History . Kessynna was one of the daughters of King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , of the Lions ' Dynasty .
description_long: Kessynna Princess Kessynna was remembered in Tethyr ian history for how her five daughters were horribly murdered , serving as a common example for why the number five was cursed in Tethyr . History . Kessynna was one of the daughters of King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , of the Lions ' Dynasty . The manner of her death is not recorded , but she passed away some time before 1274 DR , and she had five surviving daughters . Sometime in 1274 , these five daughters and three of their aunts , Kessynna ' s sisters Cyralna , Chynnil , and Pyriiss , traveled to Waterdeep , because Cyralna was married to a noble of Waterdeep , Ortaal Emveolstone , and their first child was due . After a month in Waterdeep , Cyralna and her newborn child died in labor . Shortly thereafter , all seven princesses were murdered in their sleep by mimic grubs disguised as pillows . Within a tenday , it was discovered that the two responsible were Kyvan Emveolstone , Cyralna ' s brother - in - law , and Prince Toram , Cyralna and Kessynna ' s own brother . When Cyralna ' s father , King Haedrak , heard the news , he dropped dead .

title: Kesten Orthalin
description: Kesten Orthalin Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin was a warrior and adventurer of the 13th century DR . He was the leader of the Grimblades adventuring company . History .
description_long: Kesten Orthalin Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin was a warrior and adventurer of the 13th century DR . He was the leader of the Grimblades adventuring company . History . Kesten and the Grimblades were thought to have plundered a number of ruins in the lands around the eastern Inner Sea . In the late 13th century DR , Kesten came into the possession of a magical short sword and had the sage Arthylmas of Saerloon identify the blade . It was " Sarghathuld " , a legendary relic of Roldilar and Impiltur , and lost since the Year of the Luminar Procession , 1127 DR , a century and a half before . However , barely three seasons later , Kesten and the Grimblades were slain by the green dragon Urnalithorgathla in her lair in the Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . Their bones and " Sarghathuld " laid among her treasure hoard for over ninety years .

title: Kestin
description: Kestin Kestin was the best tailor in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Kestin ran Buttons , Boots , and Rags , a shop repairing and selling used clothing .
description_long: Kestin Kestin was the best tailor in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Kestin ran Buttons , Boots , and Rags , a shop repairing and selling used clothing . Usually Kestin gained the dresses from the Iron Ring slavers , and if a customer caused trouble they could be sent to his slaver friends .

title: Kestor
description: Kestor Kestor was a half - elf merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Kestor was an able merchant in Baldur ' s Gate , and also a prominent member of the Merchant ' s League .
description_long: Kestor Kestor was a half - elf merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Kestor was an able merchant in Baldur ' s Gate , and also a prominent member of the Merchant ' s League . Kestor owned a merchant fleet that traded spices and silks with many exotic countries , like Halruaa , Balduran , Chult , Dambrath , Nimbral , and the Tashalar . He was one of the few non - Calishite proponents of the idea that the Knights needed to work with the Rundeen . Kestor had a very long history of rivalry with Aldeth Sashenstar and used all of his and the Knights ' resources to try to ruin his rival . He invested a great deal of money in the colony of Fort Flame , losing it all when the sahuagin destroyed it in 1369 DR .

title: Kesymys
description: Kesymys Kesymys was a ghost in Cormanthor . Personality . The elven ghost was curious about the world in this new era .
description_long: Kesymys Kesymys was a ghost in Cormanthor . Personality . The elven ghost was curious about the world in this new era . History . Kesymys was a priest of Labelas Enoreth in Cormanthor . In 1344 DR , at the start of the Retreat , Kesymys agreed to remain in Faerûn to protect the Eventide Abbey like Meira Faerenduil . Like her her oath was so strong that , after the natural end of her life , Kesymys rose as a ghost to continue to protect the ruins of the abbey , but she became trapped in a mural . She remained in that state until the Rage of Demons , when she met an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil to bring peace to Meira ' s spirit .

title: Kethryllia Amarillis
description: Kethryllia Amarillis Kethryllia Amarillis also known as Flame - Flower was a moon elf who founded House Amarillis . Her body resides in the Hall of the Ancients in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She lived long before the Crown Wars as the archmage of Sharlarion .
description_long: Kethryllia Amarillis Kethryllia Amarillis also known as Flame - Flower was a moon elf who founded House Amarillis . Her body resides in the Hall of the Ancients in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She lived long before the Crown Wars as the archmage of Sharlarion . When the city was attacked by an orc horde , she lead its army in battle . Two nights before that she finished in creating the magical sword Dharasha and she took the dagger with her , which centuries before was a gift from Ka ' Narlist for Cornaith Moonflower . During the battle she fought together with her consort Anarallath . It was this priest who banished the leader of the orc horde , the demon Haeshkarr . Before the demon was thrown back to the abyss he got hold of the priest and took him with him . Kethryllia followed them and landed in the Demonweb Pits . She fought the minions of Haeshkarr and met the godess Kiaransalee .
