The evil goddess was intrigued by the wish for revenge and helped her to find Haeshkarr and her lost love , if she would only hail to Corellon Larethian for each kill . At least she managed to kill the hunted demon and freed Anarallath .

title: Ketjap
description: Ketjap Ketjap was an exotic food found in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Ketjap Ketjap was an exotic food found in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Ketjap was made by combining mingari from Ulgarth with rare fruits from Maztica . This spicy sauce had a unique flavor , making it a prized commodity in the Shining South .

title: Ketsarra Shadowscale
description: Ketsarra Shadowscale Ketsarra Shadowascale was a half - black dragon commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Ketsarra was a lizardfolk half - dragon of black dragon descent and also a cleric of Shar , transformed in a shadowslain , a Shar kind of undead .
description_long: Ketsarra Shadowscale Ketsarra Shadowascale was a half - black dragon commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Ketsarra was a lizardfolk half - dragon of black dragon descent and also a cleric of Shar , transformed in a shadowslain , a Shar kind of undead . She was the right - hand of Thieraven at the Lost Refuge and the driving force beneath the submission of the Shadowscale tribe to the Church of Shar . Eventually the plot was ruined and Ketsarra was killed by a party of adventurers .

title: Kevin Olwynson
description: Kevin Olwynson Kevin Olwynson was the baron of the city of Dralpur in Ulgarth around 1367 DR , known as a crafty leader . He was a former ranger who once wandered the realm of Ulgarth , the Utter East , and the Dustwall Mountains , before he became baron . He secured the loyalty and skills of the 500 warriors who defended the town by paying them well with gold .
description_long: Kevin Olwynson Kevin Olwynson was the baron of the city of Dralpur in Ulgarth around 1367 DR , known as a crafty leader . He was a former ranger who once wandered the realm of Ulgarth , the Utter East , and the Dustwall Mountains , before he became baron . He secured the loyalty and skills of the 500 warriors who defended the town by paying them well with gold .

title: Kevrin
description: Kevrin Kevrin was a male Chondathan human sorcerer who dwelled at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . Kevrin whiled away his days in his quarters , which he shared with Shan Thar , idly reading books on outdated magical theory and nursing strong liquor .
description_long: Kevrin Kevrin was a male Chondathan human sorcerer who dwelled at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . Kevrin whiled away his days in his quarters , which he shared with Shan Thar , idly reading books on outdated magical theory and nursing strong liquor . In the evenings , he assisted in the nightly stargazing ceremonies in the temple ' s outer courtyard , casting " silent image " to create illusions of brightened stars and animated constellations overheard as Shan Thar named and revered the astronomical bodies . History . Kevrin was a man who did ill in his past , and to soothe his conscience he offered his services to the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon . Personality . Kevrin had a rather dour and resigned personality , but was a devout follower of Mystra and greatly trusting of the priests at the temple . He was rather tough . Description . Kevrin had a rather haggard appearance and wore dark grey robes .

title: Key to Phantoms ' Cloister
description: Key to Phantoms ' Cloister The annual haunting of a ghost in the streets of Loudwater is interrupted by a groundling attack . Their burrowing reveals a previously undiscovered reliquary containing a tangible shard of pure light . Following clues , the party makes their way to the ruin of Phantom ' s Cloister where they find Zhentarim battling creatures under the control of a vicious quasit .
description_long: Key to Phantoms ' Cloister The annual haunting of a ghost in the streets of Loudwater is interrupted by a groundling attack . Their burrowing reveals a previously undiscovered reliquary containing a tangible shard of pure light . Following clues , the party makes their way to the ruin of Phantom ' s Cloister where they find Zhentarim battling creatures under the control of a vicious quasit .

title: Keyfa al - Parid
description: Keyfa al - Parid Keyfa al - Parid was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Keyfa was extremely honest and had a deep love of the sea .
description_long: Keyfa al - Parid Keyfa al - Parid was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Keyfa was extremely honest and had a deep love of the sea . Activities . Keyfa was personally appointed by the Grand Caliph to oversee the harbormasters of the Caliph ' s Harbor and Trade Harbor . She lived in a small inn called the Inn of the Sea Bass . History . In her past Keyfa had the opportunity to ask for a " wish " from an imprisoned dao . Because of her love of the sea , she wished to " never be in danger from drowning . " The dao granted the wish for Keyfa , but used to opportunity to cruelly twist the meaning of the wish so that she could never leave dry land . Since that day , Keyfa would magically teleport back to land if she strayed into the water or spent time on a ship that was not docked . Possessions . Keyfa owned a magical scimitar and a " telescope of true vision " .

title: Keymaking set
description: Keymaking set Keymaking sets were used by some rogue s to replicate keys . Uses . In lieu of picking a lock , a skillful thief could make an exact copy of a borrowed key after taking a wax imprint of the key .
description_long: Keymaking set Keymaking sets were used by some rogue s to replicate keys . Uses . In lieu of picking a lock , a skillful thief could make an exact copy of a borrowed key after taking a wax imprint of the key . The process was time consuming and required skillful hands . Prices . A complete keymaking set cost 40 gold .

title: Kezef
description: Kezef Kezef the Chaos Hound is a powerful primordial , feared by gods and mortals alike . He is a unique being who roams the Outer Planes constantly hunting the Faithful , which are the souls of those who have chosen to venerate one god above all others . He has no taste for the Faithless or the False and is sickened by the taste of the unripened spirits of the still - living .
description_long: Kezef Kezef the Chaos Hound is a powerful primordial , feared by gods and mortals alike . He is a unique being who roams the Outer Planes constantly hunting the Faithful , which are the souls of those who have chosen to venerate one god above all others . He has no taste for the Faithless or the False and is sickened by the taste of the unripened spirits of the still - living . When Kezef destroys one of the Faithful , the maggots that make up his pelt swarm away from his jet - boned skeleton to devour the corpse . The gorged creatures then mill slowly over Kezef ’ s body , making him appear bloated . Any of the Faithful who are eaten in this fashion are forever and truly destroyed , beyond even the recall of the gods . The Ravager of the Heavens relishes the scent of hatred , and he sometimes pauses and becomes substantial so that he can savor a particularly juicy emotional scent . In his wake , he leaves screaming nightmares particularly cherished by Dendar the Night Serpent . He is nauseated by the scent of cloying , reckless happiness . Appearance . Kezef appears as a huge mastiff with unearthly malevolent , red eyes and a ratty tail .

title: Khadiga
description: Khadiga Khadiga was a human sha ' ir living on Al - Zabdiyat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khadiga and her giant sea snake pet , Shipwrecker , were the only known inhabitants of the entire island .
description_long: Khadiga Khadiga was a human sha ' ir living on Al - Zabdiyat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khadiga and her giant sea snake pet , Shipwrecker , were the only known inhabitants of the entire island . Khadiga enjoyed her privacy and discouraged visitors by sending inhuman messengers . Ships that ignored her warnings were never seen again . Rumors and Legends . Khadiga was rumored to be constructing a large domed mausoleum made from clear crystal in the middle of her lagoon .

title: Khaerbaal
description: Khaerbaal Khaerbaal was a city located in Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . Located on the southern coast of Halruaa , Khaerbaal was sheltered from pirates and rough ocean currents by the Bay of Taertal .
description_long: Khaerbaal Khaerbaal was a city located in Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . Located on the southern coast of Halruaa , Khaerbaal was sheltered from pirates and rough ocean currents by the Bay of Taertal . Inhabitants . Khaerbaal was ruled by the wizard Grozalum . History . This city served as one of two bases for Halruaa ' s navy , housing 50 ships and 20 skyships . Most of the population of Khaerbaal were preoccupied with shipping and trading . The naval base was located on the nearby isle of Rulasuu .

title: Khafaz ibn Dahz
description: Khafaz ibn Dahz Khafaz ibn Dahz was a trader and caravan master in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Khafaz had handsome features and appeared well groomed .
description_long: Khafaz ibn Dahz Khafaz ibn Dahz was a trader and caravan master in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Khafaz had handsome features and appeared well groomed . Though in his mid - 40s , his lean frame made him appear much younger . Personality . Khafaz was a devious man . He often blamed others for misfortunes . Possessions . His basic equipment included leather armor , a dagger , some darts , and a short sword . Khafaz owned a valuable brooch shaped like a camel ' s head and two silver bracelets . He also carried a flask that had two doses of a " potion of healing " . History . Khafaz learned his skills as a teenager on the streets of Tajar . He eventually saved enough money to purchase ships to carry goods to Huzuz and send caravans across the High Desert . He was very knowledgeable with the geography of the High Desert .

title: Khai Khmun
description: Khai Khmun Khai Khmun was a Red Wizard of Thay loyal to Araman . History . After Araman led a coup against Nefris , the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders , he sent his loyal mage Khai Khmun to kill Lienna and Safiya .
description_long: Khai Khmun Khai Khmun was a Red Wizard of Thay loyal to Araman . History . After Araman led a coup against Nefris , the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders , he sent his loyal mage Khai Khmun to kill Lienna and Safiya . Khai managed to kill Lienna in Aglarond but crossed paths with the Kalach - Cha , who became forcibly involved in the matter . Thus , when Khai tried to kill Safiya , she allied with the Kalach - Cha in search of answers and the two killed Khai Khmun .

title: Khala
description: Khala The Khala were a race of human s said to have inhabited Imaskar in east Faerûn in ancient times . Legend . Brother Delf , a priest of Deneir from Verdusk , put to paper a tale concerning the Khala , apparently relating an ancient legend .
description_long: Khala The Khala were a race of human s said to have inhabited Imaskar in east Faerûn in ancient times . Legend . Brother Delf , a priest of Deneir from Verdusk , put to paper a tale concerning the Khala , apparently relating an ancient legend . He told that the Khala had been an evil people who ' d committed many acts of wickedness and had worshiped the god Bane , the Black Lord . As punishment for their crimes , they were cursed by five gods of law . Lathander , god of the dawn , said " You have been swift as an eagle in your flight from justice , so I curse you each of you with the body of the eagle . " Mystra , goddess of magic , said " Fierce as a wolf have you been in your persecution of the innocent , so I curse you with the teeth of the wolf . " Torm , god of duty , said " Foolish as a stag in rut have you been as you shunned what is true and good , so I curse you all to bear the head and horns of the stag . " Ilmater , god of suffering , said " You have tormented and torn heart and soul from your victims , so I curse you with unnatural appetites , so that you may only live and prosper after devouring the hearts of your prey .

title: Khalab
description: Khalab Khalab was a small fishing village located in Murghôm . Location . Khalab sat on the western banks of Gbor Nor .
description_long: Khalab Khalab was a small fishing village located in Murghôm . Location . Khalab sat on the western banks of Gbor Nor . Inhabitants . Though the village was unremarkable , some considered the long trip to Khalab well worth the effort with the hopes of training under Salid Dhuzma , a bard of great renown .

title: Khaless
description: Khaless Khaless was a game played by the drow of House Oblodra in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1358 DR , the members of House Oblodra used this game to test courage .
description_long: Khaless Khaless was a game played by the drow of House Oblodra in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1358 DR , the members of House Oblodra used this game to test courage . Rules . In the game , Khaless , two drow would cast darkness and silence over the chasm known as Clawrift . The twin challengers would cast levitation and enter the globes . The drow who exited first would be the loser and in many cases both drow would fall to their deaths when their spells ran out . Notes . The name of the game derives from the drow word , Khaless which means " trust " .

title: Khalia
description: Khalia Khalia is a diplomat for the Red Wizards of Thay who posesses a calm , yet passionate demeanor . Extremely cautious in how she conducts her work , she visits foreign nations of behalf of the Red Wizards to further the expansion of their power base through the construction of their enclaves . Along with negotiating profits and establishing cordial relationsips , she is often used in the presentation of gifts to various heads of state .
description_long: Khalia Khalia is a diplomat for the Red Wizards of Thay who posesses a calm , yet passionate demeanor . Extremely cautious in how she conducts her work , she visits foreign nations of behalf of the Red Wizards to further the expansion of their power base through the construction of their enclaves . Along with negotiating profits and establishing cordial relationsips , she is often used in the presentation of gifts to various heads of state . As she needs to be in order to fulfill her duties , Khalia is among the most restrained and reasoning of the Red Wizards .

title: Khalid
description: Khalid Khalid was a half - elf from Calimshan and a Harper . He was married to Jaheira , another half - elf and Harper . He was a friend of Gorion , and was investigating the iron crisis with his wife at the time of Gorion ' s death ( in 1368 DR ) .
description_long: Khalid Khalid was a half - elf from Calimshan and a Harper . He was married to Jaheira , another half - elf and Harper . He was a friend of Gorion , and was investigating the iron crisis with his wife at the time of Gorion ' s death ( in 1368 DR ) . Some of Gorion ' s last instructions to his adopted child had been to look for Khalid and Jaheira at the Friendly Arm Inn , where they found them soon after . The three became travelling companions until the time of Khalid ' s untimely death . The novel . In the novelization of " Baldur ' s Gate " , Khalid ' s personality is not explored much . As well as having cheated on his wife himself , he was jealous about her obvious attraction to Gorion ' s ward , Abdel Adrian . In addition , he knew Adrian was a Bhaalspawn and was ready to cynically manipulate Adrian on behalf of the Harpers , although how he was going to do that is never shown or told . Khalid and Jaheira accompanied Adrian , as well as , at various points , Montaron , Xzar and Xan , from the Friendly " Arms " Inn to Nashkel and its mines and then to Beregost in search for answers about the iron crisis .

title: Khalil
description: Khalil Khalil was a half - elf sha ' ir living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khalil owned a ship that was in a poor state of repair .
description_long: Khalil Khalil was a half - elf sha ' ir living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khalil owned a ship that was in a poor state of repair . Along with his rubban and crew , he sailed to dangerous destinations . Possessions . Khalil carried a " jambiya " " + 2 " , various magical scrolls , a " ring of mind shielding " , a " ring of water walking " , a " scarab of deception " , and a " pearl of the sirines " . Relationships . Khalil ' s bound gen was a maridan .

title: Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir
description: Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR , and the eighteenth of his line . Description . Khalil was still strong and lean into middle age thanks to his time spent adventuring .
description_long: Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR , and the eighteenth of his line . Description . Khalil was still strong and lean into middle age thanks to his time spent adventuring . Personality . During his frequent excursions through the city while disguised , Khalil was known to shower lavish gifts on those who treated him well . Possessions . Khalil possessed many items both mundane and magical including : " bracers of defense " , " cloak of protection " , " boots of striding and springing " , " ring of free action " , " ring of spell storing " , " rod of leadership " , and his favorite scimitar named " Breeze Across the Desert Sands " that was a " scimitar of sharpness " . History . Khalil became Grand Caliph at the age of 18 when his father died . Thoroughly unprepared for the demands of court , the young caliph rebelled against the suggestions of his advisers and viziers , often slipping outside of the palace in disguise or disappearing for months at a time on adventures .

title: Khalleshyr
description: Khalleshyr The Khalleshyr was one of the rivers of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . The Khalleshyr was a major tributary of the Amstel River .
description_long: Khalleshyr The Khalleshyr was one of the rivers of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . The Khalleshyr was a major tributary of the Amstel River . It joined with that body of water at Trollford after flowing for 100 miles . The river began in the Qadim Hills of the Troll Mountains with the joining of the Fireflow and Trollstooth Run . Flora & Fauna . The river was full of dionnel , a rare , golden - colored fish that was considered a delicacy to the west in Athkatla . They were very difficult to catch .

title: Khamsin
description: Khamsin Khamsin was a potent magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Wind of Fate in Zakhara . Description . Khamsin smelled like honey .
description_long: Khamsin Khamsin was a potent magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Wind of Fate in Zakhara . Description . Khamsin smelled like honey . Uses . Khamsin was a contact poison that was often applied to dart s . A deceitful way to use the poison was to apply it to the hilts of weapon s and offer them as gifts . Once skin contact with this poison was made , the victim literally turned to dust within minutes .

title: Khamtar Raofal
description: Khamtar Raofal Khamtar Raofal was a ship captain from Caer Callidyrr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the Moonshae Isles , Lantan and Ruathym in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Originally from Callidyrr , Khamtar was captain of the " Raven ' s Eye " , a ship that sailed the Sword Coast from Lantan to Luskan .
description_long: Khamtar Raofal Khamtar Raofal was a ship captain from Caer Callidyrr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the Moonshae Isles , Lantan and Ruathym in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Originally from Callidyrr , Khamtar was captain of the " Raven ' s Eye " , a ship that sailed the Sword Coast from Lantan to Luskan . At one point he was recruited into the Moonstars .

title: Khanduq
description: Khanduq A khanduq was a walled enclosure found within many Calishite towns and cities . It served as a central trade center for the marketplaces that sprung up around it . Khanduqs often included bars , inns , warehouses , guild halls , guard houses , moneychangers , or other such amenities .
description_long: Khanduq A khanduq was a walled enclosure found within many Calishite towns and cities . It served as a central trade center for the marketplaces that sprung up around it . Khanduqs often included bars , inns , warehouses , guild halls , guard houses , moneychangers , or other such amenities . Description . Every sabban in a Calishite city had a khanduq . While basic markets surrounded the outside of a khanduq , more expensive wares were stored and sold within the khanduq ' s walls . Most khanduqs had gates on opposite ends with a road between them to increase traffic through them . The gates were heavily guarded and would be open from sunrise till sunset . A typical khanduq had two floors . It would have a square courtyard with a public well and troughs for animals . Roofs covered the rooms along the outer walls . There were several stalls for holding animals and several warehouse rooms for rent to merchants . The khanduq owner ' s house would be within the confines of the complex . The second floor would have a covered balcony where guildmasters and pasha s would discuss business and overlook the shopping below .

title: Kharal
description: Kharal Kharal was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Kharal no spoke much but remained always calm .
description_long: Kharal Kharal was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Kharal no spoke much but remained always calm . He was the only being capable to calm his mate Ghunnis when she was angry . He was excited only hunting his hated merrow or frolicking with dolphins . History . Ghunnis and Kharal lived with their tribe in the Hmur Plateau . In 1370 DR were reported activities of kuo - toa slavers in nearby area so gunnies and Kharal were sent to resolve the problem . Inside the kuo - toa ' s cavern they met some surface dwellers .

title: Kharantes
description: Kharantes Kharantes was a yuan - ti half - fiend who usurped control of Oreme in 1375 DR . Personality . A child of the Abyss , Kharantes was the offspring of a female yuan - ti abomination and a male demon .
description_long: Kharantes Kharantes was a yuan - ti half - fiend who usurped control of Oreme in 1375 DR . Personality . A child of the Abyss , Kharantes was the offspring of a female yuan - ti abomination and a male demon . After reaching maturity , he found his way to Faerûn . His hubris led him to believe his destiny was rulership over all the serpentfolk of the world , and then by extension , the world itself . History . Kharantes learned about the history of the sarrukh while on Faerûn . Feeling an instant connection to the yuan - ti , he studied texts preserved since the ancient days and came to the conclusion that the sarrukh had squandered their position of dominance in the world . The yuan - ti ' s subsumed leadership of the Mhairshaulk Empire , on the Chultan peninsula far to the south , a sarrukh kingdom that the progenitors grew tired of and disinterested in , ingrained in him his notion that the yuan - ti were entitled to the mantle of ultimate rulership . Kharantes discovered that , far to the north in the area that would become known as Anauroch , the sarrukh established the Isstosseffifil Empire . The city of Oreme was the capital of that realm .

title: Khareesa H ' kar
description: Khareesa H ' kar Khareesa H ' kar was a drow elf slaver of House H ' kar in Menzoberranzan . Description . The drow female was very beautiful with fine facial features , shapely legs , and thick white hair .
description_long: Khareesa H ' kar Khareesa H ' kar was a drow elf slaver of House H ' kar in Menzoberranzan . Description . The drow female was very beautiful with fine facial features , shapely legs , and thick white hair . Personality . Like most drow , Khareesa was wicked and enjoyed making other creatures , such as goblin s suffer her wrath . Possessions . In battle , Khareesa , clad in suit of drow chainmail , used a fine sword and whip . History . In 1357 DR , Drizzt Do ' Urden journeyed into the Underdark and returned to Menzoberranzan . The drow ranger joined a band of slavers , led by Khareesa , and entered the city . Shortly after returning to Menzoberranzan , Bregan D ' aerthe soldiers spied Drizzt and traveled to the Isle of Rothé to interrogate Khareesa about the drow renegade . After revealing Drizzt ' s name , the soldiers backstabbed Khareesa through the kidney , cut her head off , and tossed it at Drizzt when he arrived back on the island .

title: Kharran Fel
description: Kharran Fel Kharran Fel was a large muscly human fighter . He was the child of druids from the Forgotten Forest and although he loved the wilderness , he lacked the inclination to learn to become either a ranger or a druid . He did , however , pick up some healing and herbalism skills and also the tracking abilities of a ranger .
description_long: Kharran Fel Kharran Fel was a large muscly human fighter . He was the child of druids from the Forgotten Forest and although he loved the wilderness , he lacked the inclination to learn to become either a ranger or a druid . He did , however , pick up some healing and herbalism skills and also the tracking abilities of a ranger . Appearance . Kharran was 6 ' 3 " ( 1 . 9 m ) tall with long brown hair and a beard . Equipment . Kharran carried three hand axe s , using two of them at once in combat , but also carried a battle axe if he encountered stronger foes . He wore leather armor and wore a " ring of protection + 2 " . History . Kharran moved from one adventuring band to another in the Western Heartlands until he came across the injured werewolf Arahnar , felt pity for her and fell in love with her .

title: Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin
description: Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin was a drow and a master of Sorcere before he turned himself into a lich . Description . In life , Kharza - kzad was described as thin with protruding eyes .
description_long: Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin was a drow and a master of Sorcere before he turned himself into a lich . Description . In life , Kharza - kzad was described as thin with protruding eyes . He lived in the Spelltower in the Citadel of Xorlarrin . History . During his lifetime , he was famous for creating battle wands and being a master of Sorcere . He was also the last unofficial tutor of Liriel Baenre . In 1361 DR , soon after Liriel left the city , he was attacked in the Spelltower by Nisstyre , leader of the Dragon ' s Hoard . He was brought to the top of an active volcano , where he was to die , but before he was gone , he used one of his own creations , a wand of lichdom . With this , he was turned into a lichdrow and was therefore too powerful for the other mage . Nisstyre fled the duel , leaving the lich undestroyed . Relationships . Relatives . Kharza - kzad was the brother of matron mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin . Liriel Baenre . He had a relationship with his student Liriel Baenre that was atypical of most drow , since he seemed to truly care about her welfare .

title: Khaspere Drylund
description: Khaspere Drylund Khaspere Drylund was a noble in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Khaspere was the proprietor of the " Golden Goose " , a riverboat housing a gambling hall .
description_long: Khaspere Drylund Khaspere Drylund was a noble in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Khaspere was the proprietor of the " Golden Goose " , a riverboat housing a gambling hall . He was secretly a member of the Kraken Society and was plotting to become the new water baron of the city . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Khaspere was a high - ranking member of the Krakenar , and he knew the location where the missing storm giant king Hekaton was chained . Personality . Khaspere was a little man . If someone cornered and threatened him , he revealed everything about his criminal business . Powers . He had a telepathic link to Slarkrethel , which was constantly active if they remained on the same plane . The kraken could harm Khaspere and even kill him instantly if it so desired .

title: Khass
description: Khass Khass was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s of the Eastern Shaar . Description . The deity was a cloud god with multiple limbs and palm trees were said to be his fingers .
description_long: Khass Khass was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s of the Eastern Shaar . Description . The deity was a cloud god with multiple limbs and palm trees were said to be his fingers . Worshipers . Khass was a frustrating god to worship , because he would ignore his worshipers ' pleas for rain for months , and then send heavy downpours to drench them for weeks at time .

title: Khassidi
description: Khassidi The Khassidi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the northwestern regions of the Endless Waste .
description_long: Khassidi The Khassidi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the northwestern regions of the Endless Waste . Their territory bordered the lands of the Commani and Tuigan tribes . Society . They spoke the Khassidi language , a language influenced by the Raumatharan Empire . n History . The Khassidi were allies with the Commani tribe , whose territory was to the south , sharing a common history with them at many points .

title: Khassidi language
description: Khassidi language Khassidi was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the western Hordelands . Description . Khassidi , like other languages in the same region , had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds .
description_long: Khassidi language Khassidi was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the western Hordelands . Description . Khassidi , like other languages in the same region , had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds . Speakers . This tongue was spoken by the nomadic Khassidi tribe . Script . Khassidi did not have a written form . History . It was considered to be one of the Northern Imaskari languages and was strongly influenced by the empire of Raumathar .

title: Khault
description: Khault Lord Khault was the leader of The Choir , a cult in Tohrepur that worshipped a spellplague changed Sirine . Prior to 1473 DR , Khault was a farmer in the village of Caidris in Akanûl . When the mercenaries fighting for the Keepers of the Cerulean Sign made a stand against the Abolethic Sovereignty in his village , he allowed a group of soldiers led by the mercenary Uthalion to take shelter in his home .
description_long: Khault Lord Khault was the leader of The Choir , a cult in Tohrepur that worshipped a spellplague changed Sirine . Prior to 1473 DR , Khault was a farmer in the village of Caidris in Akanûl . When the mercenaries fighting for the Keepers of the Cerulean Sign made a stand against the Abolethic Sovereignty in his village , he allowed a group of soldiers led by the mercenary Uthalion to take shelter in his home . His wife and sons were killed by the Aboleths but Khault survived . Sometime after Caidris was destroyed , Khault became corrupted by a plaguechanged sirine and was changed into an aberration . He became the leader of the sirine ' s cult and sent members to Airspur to recruit . The Choir kidnapped several residents of Airspur including the twin sister of a genasi named Ghaelya who the cult believed to be a prophetess . With the help of Uthalion and a few of his friends , Ghaelya travelled to Tohrepur where one of her friends killed Khault . Appearance . Khault resembled a human in basic form but had tentacles and sharp spikes for teeth .

title: Khayar Ironfist
description: Khayar Ironfist Khayar Ironfist was a member of Ironfist clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khayar was an older dwarf , who went to explore the Ironfist stronghold .
description_long: Khayar Ironfist Khayar Ironfist was a member of Ironfist clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khayar was an older dwarf , who went to explore the Ironfist stronghold . However , he was captured by bugbear s . Gameplay . Khelgar Ironfist and the Kalach - Cha could have encountered Khayar while he was imprisoned by the bugbears . Once the bugbears were defeated , Khayar would be freed and the Kalach - Cha could have gained influence with Khelgar , so long as there was no mention of Khelgar deserting the clan .

title: Khazari
description: Khazari Khazari was a country in the Hordelands . Environment . Khazari was a small mountain valley nation , formed by the encircling arms of the Katakoro Shan .
description_long: Khazari Khazari was a country in the Hordelands . Environment . Khazari was a small mountain valley nation , formed by the encircling arms of the Katakoro Shan . The land of the valley was considered poor , and the nation had few natural resources . The landscape of Khazari was bleak and mountainous , with granite - spired mountains crusted with glaciers . It snowed in winter but was generally dry and cold . The Jumpa and Shyok rivers passed through the nation . History . The Tuigan Horde under Yamun Khahan conquered Khazari . The lama Koja of Khazari served as Yamun ' s emissary , advisor , and historian . There , he advised that Jadaran , Yamun ' s son , be appointed governor of Alashan . Places . The cities of Khazari were ordered and tidy ; the city of Procampur in the Vast in Faerûn reminded Koja of Khazari of home . Notable cities included : Culture . The people of Khazari ate simply , dining on rice , tsampo porridge , yak butter and butter tea , and kumiss . There were a number of isolated monasteries in which lama s sought enlightenment . One was the Red Mountain Temple . They followed the Path of Enlightenment and Furo , with the " Yanitsava " as a holy book .

title: Khazari language
description: Khazari language Khazari was the language spoken by the people of Khazari in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Ra - Khati language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages .
description_long: Khazari language Khazari was the language spoken by the people of Khazari in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Ra - Khati language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages .

title: Khazid ' hea
description: Khazid ' hea Khazid ' hea was a sentient and magical sword . " Khazid ' hea " meant " Cutter " in the Drow language , and it was often referred to as such . Description .
description_long: Khazid ' hea Khazid ' hea was a sentient and magical sword . " Khazid ' hea " meant " Cutter " in the Drow language , and it was often referred to as such . Description . " Khazid ' hea " was a finely crafted longsword that could cut through flesh , bone , armor , and even rock . The edge of its blade glowed with a barely - perceptible line of red light . It was able to change its pommel to appeal to a prospective wielder . The sword itself was sentient , and could project its " thoughts " into the user ' s head and even affect his or her reasoning . On some occasions , users went into battle against impossible numbers without realizing it until their enemies lay dead before them . In the process , they often got hurt , but didn ' t notice . Distance was the only true way to escape from " Khazid ' hea ' s " influence , although if the wielder and sword had spent many years together , a kind of vague telepathic connection remained between them . " Khazid ' hea " was always hungry for blood and battle , and it was never sated . Khazid ' hea had one desire : to be held by the greatest warrior . It would even accept its ' wielders death in the pursuit of a better wielder . History .

title: Khelben ' s warding whip
description: Khelben ' s warding whip Khelben ' s warding whip was an arcane abjuration spell that directly countered movable magical force spells , particularly the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . The spell created a whip of magical force that had a range of 10 yd ( 9 .
description_long: Khelben ' s warding whip Khelben ' s warding whip was an arcane abjuration spell that directly countered movable magical force spells , particularly the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . The spell created a whip of magical force that had a range of 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) centered on the caster . " Khelben ' s warding whip " lasted for one minute per the caster ' s level and while it was in effect it could be directed to attack or parry at will , but the caster could not use other weapons or cast other spells . This spell granted the caster complete immunity to the " push " spell and it destroyed or dissipated low - level force spells , such as " battering gauntlet " , " fantastic fencers " , " shield " , " strangling grip " , and " Tenser ' s floating disk " on contact . " Bigby ' s interposing hand " was also destroyed on contact but at a possible risk of the " whip " being destroyed . As the strength of the " Bigby ' s hand " spell increased , the chance of the " hand " being destroyed decreased while the chance of the " whip " being destroyed increased .

title: Khelben Arunsun
description: Khelben Arunsun Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ( 414 DR – 1374 DR , aged 960 years , although rumors are he may still be alive being a Chosen of Mystra ) was the Lord Mage of Waterdeep , a masked Lord of Waterdeep , and powerful archmage . He resided in Blackstaff Tower until his death . One of the few spellcasters to become one of Mystra ' s Chosen , and the last survivor of House Maerdrym , Khelben was a serious , imposing wizard , and a grim proponent of law and order whose methods of achieving the ultimate good were often highly questionable in the eyes of the righteous .
description_long: Khelben Arunsun Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ( 414 DR – 1374 DR , aged 960 years , although rumors are he may still be alive being a Chosen of Mystra ) was the Lord Mage of Waterdeep , a masked Lord of Waterdeep , and powerful archmage . He resided in Blackstaff Tower until his death . One of the few spellcasters to become one of Mystra ' s Chosen , and the last survivor of House Maerdrym , Khelben was a serious , imposing wizard , and a grim proponent of law and order whose methods of achieving the ultimate good were often highly questionable in the eyes of the righteous . Description . Khelben stood just over 6 feet ( 1 . 83 meters ) tall and was well - muscled . He usually dressed in robes , wielding his trademark Blackstaff . As of 1374 DR , he had a full beard ; black hair with silver streaks , including a prominent one through his beard ; and a distinguished , imposing manner . He often dressed in black with a silver torque and a cape lined in gray fur . Personality . Often thought to be humorless and grave , Khelben was actually neither . He simply found it easier to deal with people if they were intimidated by or even frightened of him .

title: Khelben Arunsun the Younger
description: Khelben Arunsun the Younger Khelben Arunsun the Younger is a human born to Zelphar Arunsun and Lhestyn in Waterdeep in 1302 DR . Although most people know him as the " Blackstaff , " he actually left Faerûn to travel the planes , and was replaced by his grandfather , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun the Elder .
description_long: Khelben Arunsun the Younger Khelben Arunsun the Younger is a human born to Zelphar Arunsun and Lhestyn in Waterdeep in 1302 DR . Although most people know him as the " Blackstaff , " he actually left Faerûn to travel the planes , and was replaced by his grandfather , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun the Elder .

title: Kheldell
description: Kheldell Kheldell was a thorp on the northern brim of the Westwood in the foothills of the Sword Coast Spires . The only way into the village was on trail to Red Larch . The village itself was a small cluster of log homes .
description_long: Kheldell Kheldell was a thorp on the northern brim of the Westwood in the foothills of the Sword Coast Spires . The only way into the village was on trail to Red Larch . The village itself was a small cluster of log homes . Government . All decisions were made by consensus but the most influential people were Ghelkyn and Shala Thaeral , the Voice of the Circle . Economy . The economy of the village centered around logging and the horse - powered sawmill . The leader of the loggers was a wizard named Ghelkyn who levitate d the cut timber to waiting horse teams . Loggers only took the trees that local druids , the Dusk Circle told them to . They also planted more trees than they took .

title: Kheldrivver
description: Kheldrivver Kheldrivver was small hamlet at the southeastern edge of the Troll Hills . History . Founded as monastic community worshiping Oghma , the village was destroyed several times until abandoned around 1166 DR .
description_long: Kheldrivver Kheldrivver was small hamlet at the southeastern edge of the Troll Hills . History . Founded as monastic community worshiping Oghma , the village was destroyed several times until abandoned around 1166 DR . Later , several adventuring bands searched the site seeking riches but were either killed or driven off by the hordes of troll s which took over the ruins . Finally , the warrior Kheldrivver organized a force to deal with the trolls .

title: Khelessa Draga
description: Khelessa Draga Khelessa Draga was a spy of the Lords ' Alliance in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Khelessa was a high elf from Silverymoon .
description_long: Khelessa Draga Khelessa Draga was a spy of the Lords ' Alliance in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Khelessa was a high elf from Silverymoon . She joined the Lords ' Alliance and was tasked with the mission of infiltrating Menzoberranzan disguised as a drow . At the start of Rage of Demons , she stopped contacting her superiors . Later , however , she approached an expedition led by some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord and told them about an ambush of a drow battalion against them .

title: Khelgar Ironfist
description: Khelgar Ironfist Khelgar Ironfist was a dwarven fighter of Clan Ironfist who teamed up with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War and who afterwards took up temporary stewardship of Crossroad Keep . Description . Standing just under five feet tall , Khelgar Ironfist was immediately identifiable by his manners or , quite often , lack thereof .
description_long: Khelgar Ironfist Khelgar Ironfist was a dwarven fighter of Clan Ironfist who teamed up with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War and who afterwards took up temporary stewardship of Crossroad Keep . Description . Standing just under five feet tall , Khelgar Ironfist was immediately identifiable by his manners or , quite often , lack thereof . In spite of his size , Khelgar acted with next to little subtlety and was easily provoked by insults and threats , though perhaps less out of a concern for dignity or safety than because he actually took delight in such attacks , seeing it as another chance to prove his skills in combat , either armed or unarmed . Khelgar was , of course , more than willing to return the favor and was often foul - mouthed and ill - tempered . This behavior was not without its cost , however , and though Khelgar was in many ways handsome by dwarven standards , due in large part to his impressive musculature , the constant battles waged a physical cost on the dwarf . Covering Khelgar from foot to head were a collection of cuts and bruises , which , along with his missing teeth , recounted the shield dwarf ' s countless encounters with a wayward foot or fist .

title: Khemal Serist
description: Khemal Serist Khemal Serist was a member of the Cult of the Shattered Peak . Personality . Khemal preferred distracting seekers of Netherese lore rather than killing them outright .
description_long: Khemal Serist Khemal Serist was a member of the Cult of the Shattered Peak . Personality . Khemal preferred distracting seekers of Netherese lore rather than killing them outright . He was flexible in his tactics . History . Khemal rose quickly within the cult after proving his skill and effectiveness over several missions .

title: Khirad
description: Khirad Khirad was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Khirad didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description .
description_long: Khirad Khirad was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Khirad didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description . Khirad was a blue star . History . Khirad , and the other Far Realm - infested stars of Realmspace , were somehow related to the Eldest . Wherever an apocalypse of some sort happened in Realmspace , Khirad was the most brilliant star in the sky . Sometimes , Khirad radiance revealed secrets and gruesome insights . Khirad was one of the stars the warlock Japheth Donard sought out in 1396 DR , after having lose his pact with the archfey Neifion .

title: Khnarek
description: Khnarek Khnarek was a senior member of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1370 DR . Personality . The doppelganger was a reluctant ally of Hlaavin , often acting autonomously , such as when it forged an alliance with Priamon Rakesk of the Twisted Rune .
description_long: Khnarek Khnarek was a senior member of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1370 DR . Personality . The doppelganger was a reluctant ally of Hlaavin , often acting autonomously , such as when it forged an alliance with Priamon Rakesk of the Twisted Rune . Alias . Khnarek had various identities . It was also known as Terl Fadesmar , a watch - wizard in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep ; Ulik Frescem , a member of City Guard patrolling the City of the Dead ; Respen , a priest of Selûne ; and Enris the Gray , a halfling member of Mask ' s Conscripts .

title: Khochen
description: Khochen Khochen was a young Tuigan Harper thief agent . Activities . Khochen posed as an itinerant merchant .
description_long: Khochen Khochen was a young Tuigan Harper thief agent . Activities . Khochen posed as an itinerant merchant . She was the head Harper spymaster in Westgate . History . In 1486 DR , Khochen and her fellow Vescaras were on a mission to Westgate . Afterward , they went to Waterdeep to make a report to Dahl Peredur and Tam Zawad . Later she and Dahl talked about their personal problems . Later she and Vescaras were choose to help , and survey , Mehen in the research of the missing Farideh , that Vescaras believed to be a shadovar agent . Personality . Knochen was a very manipulative individual . He befriended all people but manipulate their friendship for the mission ' s goal . Her main weakness was gossip .

title: Kholzourl
description: Kholzourl Fire - Speaker Kholzourl was the leader of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym " circa " 1480 DR . He was an unholy warrior of Asmodeus who interpreted the signs and omens sent by the god of Nine Hells . Only Kholzourl knew the reason why his god ordered his mission .
description_long: Kholzourl Fire - Speaker Kholzourl was the leader of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym " circa " 1480 DR . He was an unholy warrior of Asmodeus who interpreted the signs and omens sent by the god of Nine Hells . Only Kholzourl knew the reason why his god ordered his mission .

title: Khondar Naomal
description: Khondar Naomal Khondar " Ten Rings " Naomal was a human wizard and the guildmaster of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep . His nickname referred to the ten rings he wore at all times , only two of which were magical at any given time . Description .
description_long: Khondar Naomal Khondar " Ten Rings " Naomal was a human wizard and the guildmaster of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep . His nickname referred to the ten rings he wore at all times , only two of which were magical at any given time . Description . Khondar was bald and had a " scarecrow frame . " He had a salt and pepper mustache and goatee , as well as a unibrow . He always wore ornate rings on each of his fingers . Personality . Khondar had an explosive personality and was quick to anger . He liked his magical toys and became very reliant on his magical rings . He hated the smaller , " weaker " races , especially gnomes and halflings . History . Khondar served as the guildmaster of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in 1479 DR . He claimed that many years previously , he had killed Markall Silverspur in Yhaunn after Silverspur blackmailed and stole from the guild . In 1479 DR Khondar and his son Centiv killed the Blackstaff Samark Dhanzscul in a bid to become Blackstaff and replace the Lords of Waterdeep with a council of mages .

title: Khopesh
description: Khopesh A khopesh was a one - handed slashing weapon wielded like a sword or an axe . Physical description . The khopesh typically had a handle like a knife rather than a hilt like a sword .
description_long: Khopesh A khopesh was a one - handed slashing weapon wielded like a sword or an axe . Physical description . The khopesh typically had a handle like a knife rather than a hilt like a sword . The handle was about 6 in ( 15 cm ) long with optional . The blade extended straight for 8 in to 2 ft ( 21 to 60 cm ) and then curved like a sickle with a sharp convex edge . The end of the blade was shaped to form a hook . An average khopesh cost 10 gp and weighed 7 lb ( 3 . 2 kg ) . or 20 gp and weighed 12 lb ( 5 . 4 kg ) . Weaponology . The khopesh was a specialized weapon used in a slashing fashion like a sword or an axe . In fact , the khopesh probably evolved from the , which was a type of bardiche . The 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) blade was long and heavy , making this weapon slow to recover especially after a missed swing . Like battleaxe s , which were slightly smaller , khopeshes could be wielded with either one or two hands by creatures of roughly human size , dealing more damage when wielded with two , though at the cost of defense . Khopeshes were more brutal than most weapons dealing at least minor wounds whenever it hit .

title: Khopet - Dag
description: Khopet - Dag The Khopet - Dag , also known as the Spiderhaunt Peaks , was a mountain range located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of the Shalhoond sat the Khopet - Dag mountain range , most famous for its large number of giant spider s , which gave it its nickname " Spiderhaunt Peaks " .
description_long: Khopet - Dag The Khopet - Dag , also known as the Spiderhaunt Peaks , was a mountain range located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of the Shalhoond sat the Khopet - Dag mountain range , most famous for its large number of giant spider s , which gave it its nickname " Spiderhaunt Peaks " . Rocky and dry on the north side , and wooded on the south , the mountain ' s environment was ideal for the many spider s that lived there . The silk of these giant spiders was highly prized for its use in making clothing and ropes that were lighter and stronger then normal , but also far more expensive . Yaqubi , people who collected the valuable giant spider silk for a living , frequented the mountains , guarding the secret locations of their web harvesting grounds , and the secrets behind the tools used to harvest the sticky spider web .

title: Khorl Krissellian
description: Khorl Krissellian Khorl Krissellian was a sun elf sorcerer and farseer , and a member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath in the year 1377 DR . History . Khorl was four centuries old by the late 14th century DR , and had lived for a long time in the Underdark .
description_long: Khorl Krissellian Khorl Krissellian was a sun elf sorcerer and farseer , and a member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath in the year 1377 DR . History . Khorl was four centuries old by the late 14th century DR , and had lived for a long time in the Underdark . In 1377 DR , he was the senior member of the College of Divination sent to join the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee that planned to attack the main temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Khoroshen
description: Khoroshen The Khoroshen was a tribe of lizardfolk who inhabited the low marshes of the Evermoors . In 1372 DR , First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin of the city of Nesmé recruited the tribe to help defend the city against troll and giant attacks . The tribe was led by Uhndek , and most only spoke Draconic .
description_long: Khoroshen The Khoroshen was a tribe of lizardfolk who inhabited the low marshes of the Evermoors . In 1372 DR , First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin of the city of Nesmé recruited the tribe to help defend the city against troll and giant attacks . The tribe was led by Uhndek , and most only spoke Draconic . The Viperkin were a group of Khoroshen who carried shields adorned with a snake - like design , from which they derived their name .

title: Khorrl Xornbane
description: Khorrl Xornbane Khorrl Xornbane was a duergar who was the head of Clan Xornbane , a mercenary band in the Northdark . Description . Khorrl was bald and wielded an orc double axe .
description_long: Khorrl Xornbane Khorrl Xornbane was a duergar who was the head of Clan Xornbane , a mercenary band in the Northdark . Description . Khorrl was bald and wielded an orc double axe . History . In 1372 DR , Clan Xornbane was hired by the Ched Nasad an drow House Zauvirr through a liaison named Zammzt ( secretly an agent of the Jaezred Chaulssin ) . The band was to fight and destroy House Melarn . However , Zammzt instructed them to attack too early . They successfully killed Matron Mother Drisinil Melarn but House Zauvirr ' s captives escaped and the duergar contributed to the chaos in Ched Nasad that led to its ultimate destruction . Matron Mother Ssipriina Zauvirr attacked Khorrl , killing him ; the band fled the city .

title: Khouryn Skulldark
description: Khouryn Skulldark Khouryn Skulldark is a dwarven fighter and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Khouryn fought in the Brotherhood ' s war against Szass Tam ' s forces in Thay and participated in the Brotherhood ' s foray into Impiltur . He travelled with the Brotherhood to Chessenta when they were hired by a noble to investigate a series of supernatural murders in Luthcheq .
description_long: Khouryn Skulldark Khouryn Skulldark is a dwarven fighter and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Khouryn fought in the Brotherhood ' s war against Szass Tam ' s forces in Thay and participated in the Brotherhood ' s foray into Impiltur . He travelled with the Brotherhood to Chessenta when they were hired by a noble to investigate a series of supernatural murders in Luthcheq . Khouryn travelled with the dragonborn paladin Medrash and his warrior friend Balasar to Tymanther where he helped to train recruits to fight Tymanther ' s war with the Ash giants . While fighting on the side of the Tymantherans he became close friends with Medrash and Balasar . He travelled with Medrash and Balasar to High Imaskar to enlist of the aid of the Imaskari in the looming war with Chessenta . The Imaskari were under attack by creatures from the Plains of Purple Dust and would not agree to join forces with Tymanther until the threat was ended . Khouryn and friends travelled through a network of caves under the Dragonsword Mountains in an attempt to locate the source of the attacks .

title: Khrulis
description: Khrulis Khrulis was the ruler of Airspur in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Khrulis led his half - orc fellows in a revolt against the previous theocracy of the priests of Bhaelros and became the leader of the military council that thereafter ruled the city .
description_long: Khrulis Khrulis was the ruler of Airspur in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Khrulis led his half - orc fellows in a revolt against the previous theocracy of the priests of Bhaelros and became the leader of the military council that thereafter ruled the city . In order to manipulate the citizenry , he blamed all the problems of the city on the priests of Bhaelros . Personality . Khrulis was a greedy but pragmatical ruler .

title: Khulmar Ironfist
description: Khulmar Ironfist Khulmar Ironfist was a male dwarf and a member of Ironfist Clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khulmar was a scout of the Ironfist Clan .
description_long: Khulmar Ironfist Khulmar Ironfist was a male dwarf and a member of Ironfist Clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khulmar was a scout of the Ironfist Clan . He went with some dwarves to explore the Ironfist Stronghold , but they were stopped by bugbear s . Gameplay . Khelgar Ironfist and the Kalach - Cha could have encountered Khulmar , but he would refuse their help , as he viewed Khelgar as deserting to pursue his own ideas . Khelgar and the Kalach - Cha could have explored the Stronghold themselves and found the " Gloves of Ironfist " , then returned to Khulmar to report their findings .

title: Khumarr
description: Khumarr Khumarr was a male drow blackguard and divine champion of Kiaransalee who served as an important lieutenant of Irae T ' sarran in Castle Maerimydra . Description . A tall male drow , he was rather handsome and seemed to wear a constant smile on his face .
description_long: Khumarr Khumarr was a male drow blackguard and divine champion of Kiaransalee who served as an important lieutenant of Irae T ' sarran in Castle Maerimydra . Description . A tall male drow , he was rather handsome and seemed to wear a constant smile on his face . Khumarr wore armor carved with the semblance of demon ic features ; the gaping maw of the armor could be lifted to reveal his face . Personality . Khumarr took great pleasure in the finery of the rich and noble of drow society , especially since much of his life had been spent living as a lowborn drow . He had a particularly relaxed and even slothful demeanor outwardly but this belied his true alertness . Confident among others or in battle , Khumarr was almost always smiling whether out of pure amusement or twisted cruelty . Abilities . Strong and deceptively quick , Khumarr was a powerful warrior who could deftly parry , and possibly sunder , attacks whilst swinging his two - handed greatsword . In battle , he would even bring the claws of his " demon armor " to bear , if needed .

title: Khuralosothantar
description: Khuralosothantar Khuralosothantar , or in short Khuralos , was a bronze dragon in Seros . History . Born in 612 DR Khuralos laired within the slopes of Mount Halaath .
description_long: Khuralosothantar Khuralosothantar , or in short Khuralos , was a bronze dragon in Seros . History . Born in 612 DR Khuralos laired within the slopes of Mount Halaath . On few occasion the dukar s of Myth Nantar asked his counsel but most he slept . He was awaking by the catastrophic end of the Twelfth Serôs War . Soon he kept an eye to the situation , especially in Myth Nantar , quietly eliminating some sahuagin groups . In 1370 DR Khuralos was pondering what was the best to do to help together with the city ' s paragons that knew his presence . Personality . Khuralos loved eat sahuagin for the challenge to eat something that can fight back . He was curious and amiable dragon but sometimes his curiosity overcome him and Khuralos " borrowed " interesting things . Relationship . Khralos had met Elminster Aumar

title: Khuur
description: Khuur Khuur was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Nmalk , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .
description_long: Khuur Khuur was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Nmalk , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History . In the Year of the Deep Wound , 582 DR , Tarag , a chieftain of the sea ogre s , used the powers of the sword " Ilbratha " and his own battle strategies to conquer the western frontiers of the merfolk realm of Hmurrath . There , Tarag founded the two Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . The Axe Kingdoms and Hmurrath fell to fighting in the Year of the Killing Blow , 653 DR , beginning the Ninth Serôs War . The merrow suffered a major defeat in the Battle of the Haunted Plains in the Year of the Coveted Briars , 654 DR . Following their defeat , four - fifths of all merrow in Serôs were forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall . The rest survived on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains . Three years of conflict culminated in the destruction of the Axe Kingdoms and the fall of the merrow to the merfolk of Hmurrath in the Year of the Volanth , 655 DR . This saw the end of merrow " civilization " in Serôs .

title: Khuur ( instrument )
description: Khuur ( instrument ) The khuur was a stringed musical instrument used by the nomads of the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Description . A typical " khuur " was made from wood with horsehide stretched tightly over the front .
description_long: Khuur ( instrument ) The khuur was a stringed musical instrument used by the nomads of the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Description . A typical " khuur " was made from wood with horsehide stretched tightly over the front . Two strings were fitted from the long neck to the base of the instrument and played with a bow . The " khuur " was usually played while sitting cross - legged . History . The musicians of the steppes , called " kaychi " , believed each instrument carried its own spirit , prompting them to make offerings in their honor . Because of this all " khuur " were handled with care and treated with honor .

title: Khwaja
description: Khwaja Khwaja , called the Mad , was a demented dwarven beggar living on the streets of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he appeared to be nothing more than a pathetic beggar , Khwaja was actually one of the most useful informants for Sa ' id Firdawsi , the spymaster for Prince Tannous al - Assad .
description_long: Khwaja Khwaja , called the Mad , was a demented dwarven beggar living on the streets of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he appeared to be nothing more than a pathetic beggar , Khwaja was actually one of the most useful informants for Sa ' id Firdawsi , the spymaster for Prince Tannous al - Assad . He specialized in gaining information by getting into the households of rich families who took pity on him while they were hosting lavish parties with distinguished guests . While begging for food in the kitchens of these households , Khwaja often overheard useful bits of information from the loose - tongued serving staff . Sa ' id often had Khwaja follow important targets because of his ability to travel unnoticed .

title: Khwaja al - Danaf
description: Khwaja al - Danaf Khwaja al - Danaf was the head of the House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR , though he was more of a figurehead because his wife , Perijan was the real reason for their success . Description . Khwaja was a middle - aged man who dressed in fine cloth often sewn with pearls .
description_long: Khwaja al - Danaf Khwaja al - Danaf was the head of the House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR , though he was more of a figurehead because his wife , Perijan was the real reason for their success . Description . Khwaja was a middle - aged man who dressed in fine cloth often sewn with pearls . Activities . The patriarch busied himself with expanding his empire and finding new seaborne trade routes , especially to the countries found north of Zakhara . History . Khwaja began his career in trade with a failed business in Gana . A dream revealed him traveling to Jumlat and discovering a horde of wealth , so he promptly sailed to the distant city . Upon his arrival he overheard a pair of " sa ' luk s " planning to rob a wealthy merchant ' s home . Trusting in Fate , Khwaja decided to join the thieves . He fell and broke his leg while scaling the outer wall to the merchant ' s home . His screams from the pain alerted the household and his companions abandoned him to his fate . When taken before a " qadi " for judgment , Khwaja was granted leniency after relating his story of his dream .

title: Ki
description: Ki Ki was the Untheric goddess of nature . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was the .
description_long: Ki Ki was the Untheric goddess of nature . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was the . Description . Ki manifested as a beautiful , petite woman with delicate features . She could not be touched by anything thrown through the air at her , and at will she could change her shape into any non - monstrous form . She could summon up to one hundred of any creature of the beast type , though only one species at a time and no species could be summoned more than once per week . She took half damage from any attack . Relationships . Ki helped maintain relationships between the other Untheric powers and between such gods of earth as Silvanus and Mielikki . Priesthood . Ki ' s priests were druid s . History . Ki came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " . She was killed by one of the orcish gods in - 1071 DR , and her body was laid to rest in a God - Tomb in Unther .

title: Ki - rin
description: Ki - rin Ki - rins were noble creatures native to the celestial planes who either worked for good - aligned deities in direct opposition to the forces of evil or served as protectors of large areas of the mortal world . They were regarded as harbingers of good fortune , and days when a ki - rin was sighted were considered blessed . Description .
description_long: Ki - rin Ki - rins were noble creatures native to the celestial planes who either worked for good - aligned deities in direct opposition to the forces of evil or served as protectors of large areas of the mortal world . They were regarded as harbingers of good fortune , and days when a ki - rin was sighted were considered blessed . Description . A ki - rin was similar to a unicorn in some respects , as it was a noble equine creature with a single horn . It had a stag - like body , but it was covered in golden scales instead of fur . Its horn and hooves were pinkish in color , and it had a thick golden mane of hair . Its eyes were deep violet . Abilities . Ki - rins could fly without wings and they had several other powerful spell - like innate abilities , including the ability to read the minds of those around it . They were extremely resistant to magic . Combat . Ki - rins almost always avoided combat . If forced to fight , they would try to render their opponents unconscious . Society . Ki - rins tended to ally mostly with Torm , as well as Tyr and Ilmater . Ki - rins themselves worshiped their patron deity Koriel , though they had no priest s among their ranks .

title: Ki Bohr
description: Ki Bohr Ki Bohr was the head priest of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Bohr took care of the shrine to the Path of Enlightenment in the town of Tai Ko .
description_long: Ki Bohr Ki Bohr was the head priest of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Bohr took care of the shrine to the Path of Enlightenment in the town of Tai Ko . When the ochimo started to spread terror , he tried to stop him through offerings , and also went to Wa to investigate but with no results . Bohr was blamed by Governor Ko Lei Kho for his failure . Personality . Bohr wanted to help stop the evil but was too scared to leave Tai Ko .

title: Ki Hiar
description: Ki Hiar Ki Hiar was a queen of the kingdom of Saishu in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Queen Ki Hiar was once affected by a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest and fell in love with a pirate from Wa .
description_long: Ki Hiar Ki Hiar was a queen of the kingdom of Saishu in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Queen Ki Hiar was once affected by a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest and fell in love with a pirate from Wa .

title: Ki Mor Sha
description: Ki Mor Sha Ki Mor Sha was a shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Mor Sha was mayor of Tai He town and governor Ko Lei Kho ' s brother - in - law .
description_long: Ki Mor Sha Ki Mor Sha was a shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Mor Sha was mayor of Tai He town and governor Ko Lei Kho ' s brother - in - law . Personality . Mor Sha affronted the ochimo treat very seriously and this was appreciated by his people .

title: Kiaransalee
description: Kiaransalee Kiaransalee ( " kee " - uh - " ran " - sa - lee ) was a drow lesser deity , also known as the Lady of the Dead , The Revenancer or The Vengeful Banshee . Her portfolio included vengeance and the undead . Kiaransalee was a cruel , twisted and vengeful deity .
description_long: Kiaransalee Kiaransalee ( " kee " - uh - " ran " - sa - lee ) was a drow lesser deity , also known as the Lady of the Dead , The Revenancer or The Vengeful Banshee . Her portfolio included vengeance and the undead . Kiaransalee was a cruel , twisted and vengeful deity . The Lady of the Dead became insane ages ago ; however , she managed to keep her cunning and she could still clearly remember every slight or insult towards her , whether it was real or imagined . Kiaransalee was swift to anger , powerful , and against all who have wronged her she plotted a dark revenge . The Lady of the Dead preferred company from the mindless undead she could manipulate at will , over sentient beings that are possessed of independent thought . She rarely trusted anyone else to do justice to her vision and thus preferred to settle her problems herself . Worshipers . Kiaransalee ' s clergy comprised of orderly regimented cells , but the faith lacked in overall organization . The Revenancer ' s cleric s were mostly found in small drow communities or in special enclaves , and acted constantly in secret . Her clerics were agents of vengeance who plotted against anyone who ever slighted the faith .

title: Kidera Takeshi
description: Kidera Takeshi Kidera Takeshi was the head of the Kidera clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Takeshi really want lived according to the “ old ways .
description_long: Kidera Takeshi Kidera Takeshi was the head of the Kidera clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Takeshi really want lived according to the “ old ways . ” He was always be an ally of Funada clan . Outside his family ' s duties his only hobby were only his garden and his meditation . History . In 1322 DR during a minor skirmish the young Takeshi was saved by the heroic Ueda Umaki , that always remembered that act . In 1357 DR Umaki ' s son Ueda Teishi , a supported of Goshukara clan , was framed and in verge to being exiled from Nakamaru . Before went exile Teishi want revenge against those he believed framed him , especially Tsuga Mosuke , a strong supporter of Funada Toyoo . Teishi asked the help of Takeshi in memory of his father Personality . Takeshi always showed a great dignity . He was an harsh and authoritarian man with absolute control over his family . Takeshi always used great formality and proper etiquette to conduct affairs . He must supported Funada Mitsuhide but in his heart he considered his true lord Funada Toyoo Currently Takeshi was torn between his loyalty to Funada and his need to fulfill the debt he owed Teishi .

title: Kidera Ujisato
description: Kidera Ujisato Kidera Ujisato was the commander of the sohei of the Winter Sect in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ujisato always tried to maintain the neutrality of the temple in the conflicts between the city ' s clans .
description_long: Kidera Ujisato Kidera Ujisato was the commander of the sohei of the Winter Sect in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ujisato always tried to maintain the neutrality of the temple in the conflicts between the city ' s clans . Personality . Ujisato inherited many of the qualities of his father . He was lean and wiry , balancing being correct and proper with acting cheerful and friendly . He was respected by his men and was a good commander . He trusted others but remained vigilant for deception and duplicity . When he was absorbed by a problem , he used to suck on his lower lip . Despite ancient ties between his family and the Goshukara clan , Ujisato was personally loyal to the Funada clan .

title: Kier Thunsonn
description: Kier Thunsonn Kier Thunsonn was a male dwarf who lived in Eartheart near the East Rift . He was Torrin Ironstar ' s adopted nephew and was very close to Torrin . History .
description_long: Kier Thunsonn Kier Thunsonn was a male dwarf who lived in Eartheart near the East Rift . He was Torrin Ironstar ' s adopted nephew and was very close to Torrin . History . In 1480 DR , Kier stole a griffon and flew it to an earthmote hovering over the rift . Inside the mote , he found a cache of gold bars . Unfortunately , the bars were contaminated with the stoneplague , which Kier contracted . In order to save Kier ' s life , Torrin bought magical ointment that placed Kier into suspended animation until the stoneplague curse could be lifted . Torrin was killed destroying the duergar magic that caused the stoneplague . However , many years later , Moradin reincarnated Torrin ' s soul and he was re - born as Kier ' s son .

title: Kieren
description: Kieren Kieren was a Chosen in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Kieren was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .
description_long: Kieren Kieren was a Chosen in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Kieren was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments . More specifically , he was the chosen of Ilmater . Kieren was freed from his chains by the heroes of Daggerford .

title: Kierkan Rufo
description: Kierkan Rufo Kierkan Rufo was originally a cleric at the Edificant Library , a colleague and rival of Cadderly Bonaduce . Outward Appearance . Rufo is 6 ft tall , bone - skinny and always standing at an angle tilting to the side .
description_long: Kierkan Rufo Kierkan Rufo was originally a cleric at the Edificant Library , a colleague and rival of Cadderly Bonaduce . Outward Appearance . Rufo is 6 ft tall , bone - skinny and always standing at an angle tilting to the side . He has stringy black hair and penetrating black eyes in a pale face . History . Jealous of the attention Cadderly , a fellow devotee of Deneir , received , Rufo was easily manipulated by the priest of Talona , Barjin , who hypnotized him in an effort to unleash the chaos curse . So affected by the curse he was overtaken by his hatred for Cadderly and his lust for Danica Maupoissant that he became quite violent . Eventually he was subdued and freed from the effects of the curse . Later on , Rufo became repentant , seeking to redeem himself for his actions . He accompanied Cadderly , Danica and the wild elf prince Elbereth to Shilmista , which had come under assault from the ogrillon Ragnor , a mighty ogre - orc half - breed and a member of Castle Trinity . Once again , Rufo found himself manipulated , forced to obey the wizard Dorigen from Castle Trinity and her imp ally Druzil .

title: Kierstaad
description: Kierstaad Kierstaad , or Kierstaad the Swift , was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Like his father , Kierstaad had a secret desire to experience " civilized life " in the cities of the Sword Coast .
description_long: Kierstaad Kierstaad , or Kierstaad the Swift , was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Like his father , Kierstaad had a secret desire to experience " civilized life " in the cities of the Sword Coast . History . Kierstaad was born in 1347 DR to Revjak , king of the tribe until 1364 DR . Kierstaad did not like the new king Berkthgar for his strict views but never challenged him openly . Kierstaad proved himself decisive in the conflict between the Companions of the Hall and demon lord Errtu . He was the first after Wulfgar ' s apparent death to be able to use the hammer " Aegis - fang " . For his valor in later years , Kierstaad became king of the tribe until his death .

title: Kiira
description: Kiira Lore gems ( " Kiira " ) were elven magic items that could only be worn by elves . They were semi - intelligent and acted as repositories of knowledge gathered by its wearer . This knowledge could be accessed by future wearers of the gem .
description_long: Kiira Lore gems ( " Kiira " ) were elven magic items that could only be worn by elves . They were semi - intelligent and acted as repositories of knowledge gathered by its wearer . This knowledge could be accessed by future wearers of the gem . They were mostly worn by elven nobles , with their color and clarity acting as a status symbol among Elven Houses . They were not limited to a specific type of gem , but were never larger than an elvish pinky finger . They tended to be polished smooth with a slight mound shape , without any facets . The color of the gem became accented and deepened with each new mind - meld . A number of Elder Houses had gems that were nearly black in hue , depicting the vast amount of knowledge the gem contained . Only elves of high intelligence could wear these gems . If these requirements were not met , the violator could become feebleminded . Even those who met the requirements and wore the gem of their own House did not find it easily controlled . Lore accessible via the gem was not immediately available to a wearer after surviving the transfer .

title: Kiirma Blackmane
