description: Kiirma Blackmane Kiirma Blackmane was the cloakmaster of Riatavin for the Shadow Thieves . She was also a senior agent of the Moonstars ( Tel ' Teukiira ) in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description .
description_long: Kiirma Blackmane Kiirma Blackmane was the cloakmaster of Riatavin for the Shadow Thieves . She was also a senior agent of the Moonstars ( Tel ' Teukiira ) in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description . Kiirma posed as an ordinary wealthy widow and businesswoman . Abilities . She was an accomplished thief and a highly trained wizard . She was a former apprentice of Khelben Arunsun . Possessions . Kiirma Blackmane owned several taverns , boarding houses , and festhalls in the town of Riatavin which gave her income as well as being a front for more shady activities . She kept her spellcasting abilities secret by being very discreet and using her " ring of translocation " which allowed her to choose the point of origin for any spells she cast , up to 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) away from her . Activities . Kiirma was the cloakmaster of Riatavin in the Shadow Thieves , an organized crime syndicate which in 1370 DR had a monopoly on the criminal activity in the town . Unbeknownst to them , she was also a senior agent for the Tel ' Teukiira . Relationships .

title: Kila Odani
description: Kila Odani Kila Odani was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kila was in charge of the spice warehouse of the House of Al - Farif within the Warehouse District of Huzuz .
description_long: Kila Odani Kila Odani was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kila was in charge of the spice warehouse of the House of Al - Farif within the Warehouse District of Huzuz . She portrayed pure genius in her ability to properly handle and recognize the plethora of spices that passed through the warehouse .

title: Kili bint Farud
description: Kili bint Farud Kili bint Farud was a dao who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kili was an enslaved genie who worked on the docks of the Trade Harbor .
description_long: Kili bint Farud Kili bint Farud was a dao who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kili was an enslaved genie who worked on the docks of the Trade Harbor . She assisted in hauling ships to and from the docks . She despised her job .

title: Kilij
description: Kilij Kilij was a male halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Kilij was a member of the Gilded Palm .
description_long: Kilij Kilij was a male halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Kilij was a member of the Gilded Palm . He worked for the Ben Ayyub merchant house . Relationships . Kilij and Maneira formed a matched team of assassin s .

title: Kilili
description: Kilili Kilili was a female drow magic - user . She was in fact the embodiment of a dark spirit extracted from the body of Cybriana , and was her dark , other self . She plotted with the extraplanar monster Imgig Zu to release his people from the " Selûne ' s Eye " gem to overrun and conquer the Realms .
description_long: Kilili Kilili was a female drow magic - user . She was in fact the embodiment of a dark spirit extracted from the body of Cybriana , and was her dark , other self . She plotted with the extraplanar monster Imgig Zu to release his people from the " Selûne ' s Eye " gem to overrun and conquer the Realms . Kilili and Cybriana ultimately merged into a single being , Kyriani Agrivar , the famed adventuress of Waterdeep . History . Origin . Kilili came into the world in a very strange way . Her story began with Cybriana , whose father had been a young mage who wore a gem known as " Selûne ' s Eye " . He had been foraging for components for cures and potions outside Shadowdale when he ' d met and been seduced by a " wicked " woman , a drow sorceress of the region . Shortly after her birth , her mother took her to an elf village in Shadowdale and abandoned her , leaving her in the care of an elderly elven woman . Cybriana was a typical half - elf baby , marred only by a strange dark birthmark in the center of her torso . The mark swelled as she grew older , developing into a horrid growth , one that bore an evil face .

title: Killian Kreel
description: Killian Kreel Killian Kreel was the self - exiled son of the Nanther family within Melvaunt and cleric of Loviatar . Description . Killian ' s face and body was covered in self - inflicted scars , a practice that began long before his induction into the church .
description_long: Killian Kreel Killian Kreel was the self - exiled son of the Nanther family within Melvaunt and cleric of Loviatar . Description . Killian ' s face and body was covered in self - inflicted scars , a practice that began long before his induction into the church . He also wore a black mask at all times , not to hide these scars , but his true identity as a member of the mercantile family . History . The priest was once a bright and joyous child of the Nanther family of Melvaunt , showing signs of promise within the family ' s business . Despite this appearance , he was prone to inflicting pain on himself and others , even torturing small animals from the neighborhood . As he grew older , this malice spread over into his professional life , a warning sign which was obvious to all but his family . As they ignored these signs of trouble , the situation grew from grave to worse however as Killian discovered the church of Loviatar , joining its ranks and forsaking his previous life .

title: Killoren
description: Killoren Killoren were a relatively new and uncommon race of fey . It was unknown whether they were created by a deity or were spontaneously created by nature itself . Society .
description_long: Killoren Killoren were a relatively new and uncommon race of fey . It was unknown whether they were created by a deity or were spontaneously created by nature itself . Society . Killoren had no kingdoms of their own and lived in scattered settlements . Killoren could live in nearly any climate and their dwellings blended into the surrounding natural world . They had no concept of land ownership , rather they believed that land belonged to nature itself . Killoren communities were usually governed by a council of druids or wizards . Abilities . Killoren had the ability to manifest one of three aspects of nature : The Ancient , The Destroyer , or The Hunter . They could change their aspect daily if they chose . When manifesting the aspect of The Ancient , a Killoren gained knowledge of the natural world . The aspect of the Destroyer allowed a Killoren to do more damage to an opponent . The aspect of The Hunter sharpened a Killoren ' s senses . Killoren were sensitive to cold iron and were at a disadvantage when wielding cold iron weapons . Like other fey , Killoren were immune to charm or hold creature spells and were also immune to sleep spells . Appearance .

title: Kilmaruu Swamp
description: Kilmaruu Swamp The Kilmaruu Swamp was a stretch of swamp and marshland located in southeast Halruaa . Description . The swamp was the site of a ruined city .
description_long: Kilmaruu Swamp The Kilmaruu Swamp was a stretch of swamp and marshland located in southeast Halruaa . Description . The swamp was the site of a ruined city . Undead constantly roamed the swamp and aging ruins , making appropriate defense forces in nearby towns and cities a necessity . The Kilmaruu Swamp was a popular destination for adventurer s and treasure - seekers . Both groups hoped to stumble upon lost treasures buried by the murky swamp waters .

title: Kiltzi
description: Kiltzi Kiltzi was the Maztica n goddess of love , both romantic and lustfull , and fertility . Kiltzi did not require material sacrifices , rather the act of love between a man and woman was considered a form of devotion to the goddess . Appearance .
description_long: Kiltzi Kiltzi was the Maztica n goddess of love , both romantic and lustfull , and fertility . Kiltzi did not require material sacrifices , rather the act of love between a man and woman was considered a form of devotion to the goddess . Appearance . Kiltzi appeared as a beautiful pregnant woman with extremely long hair she used to clothe her body .

title: Kim - un - guru
description: Kim - un - guru Kim - un - guru was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kim - un - guru took care of the Korobokuru Shrine , dedicated to Raven the spirit god .
description_long: Kim - un - guru Kim - un - guru was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kim - un - guru took care of the Korobokuru Shrine , dedicated to Raven the spirit god . He often openly voiced his opinions , wandered drunk , and embarrassed others in public . Personality . Kim - un - guru liked drinking , singing the " old songs , " and dancing . He played the role of the barbaric outsider , being intentionally outrageous and insulting . He became a popular figure in the area , doing things that locals could not because of their social rules .

title: Kim Mohan
description: Kim Mohan Kim Mohan is an author , editor , and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . He was a long - time editor of " Dragon " magazine .
description_long: Kim Mohan Kim Mohan is an author , editor , and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . He was a long - time editor of " Dragon " magazine . Career . Mohan began his career as a newspaper journalist before he came to work for TSR , where he became an editor for " Dragon " magazine , a role that lasted for ten years . He also worked on several Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks , including authoring the " Wilderness Survival Guide " . He was one of the lead editors for the 3 edition . Mohan retired from Wizards of the Coast in 2013 .

title: Kimmuriel Oblodra
description: Kimmuriel Oblodra Kimmuriel Oblodra was a powerful psionicist of Menzoberranzan and one of the few survivors of the destruction House Oblodra . A He often served as the de facto leader of Bregan D ' aerthe while Jarlaxle romped around the surface world . Description .
description_long: Kimmuriel Oblodra Kimmuriel Oblodra was a powerful psionicist of Menzoberranzan and one of the few survivors of the destruction House Oblodra . A He often served as the de facto leader of Bregan D ' aerthe while Jarlaxle romped around the surface world . Description . Kimmuriel had an expressionless face that Jarlaxle often referred to as " soulless . " Personality . In stark contrast to other members of his family , Kimmuriel was unemotional , usually stony - faced and very difficult to get even the slightest of smiles out of , much less a laugh . His humor was very dry but often superbly clever . Kimmuriel revealingly said of himself , " Little of what I do or say is opinion . " He had no patience or respect for other ' s mental privacy and was likely to dive right in with his psionic powers . He had an " arrogant dislike " for the arcane arts , but he was willing to work with wizard s . Originally , Kimmuriel ' s stance was that he would much rather improve his psionic powers or study illithid s than look after Bregan D ' aerthe . As such , whenever he got the chance , he tried to persuade Jarlaxle to come back to Menzoberranzan so that he could get back to his own work .

title: Kin Elbhaz
description: Kin Elbhaz Kin Elbhaz is a pueblo settlement of 500 in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It always receives above average yields from its crops and rarely suffers from diseases or pestilence because nearby brownie s ensure it , in exchange for unlimited grain from the pueblo ' s store , via a secret passage . There are rumours that the villagers have made a pact with evil forces in order to ensure their own prosperity .
description_long: Kin Elbhaz Kin Elbhaz is a pueblo settlement of 500 in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It always receives above average yields from its crops and rarely suffers from diseases or pestilence because nearby brownie s ensure it , in exchange for unlimited grain from the pueblo ' s store , via a secret passage . There are rumours that the villagers have made a pact with evil forces in order to ensure their own prosperity . Notable inhabitants . The settlement is led by matriarch Lokoshin . The pueblo priest is Hopala , and the sunwatcher is Pokoso . The leader of the brownies that interact with the settlement is Dubilitop .

title: King ' s Forest
description: King ' s Forest The King ' s Forest was located in western Cormyr . It was once home to elves , as the westernmost fragment of Cormanthor , but they abandoned the forest to humankind . The King ' s Forest was so named because it was the property of the crown .
description_long: King ' s Forest The King ' s Forest was located in western Cormyr . It was once home to elves , as the westernmost fragment of Cormanthor , but they abandoned the forest to humankind . The King ' s Forest was so named because it was the property of the crown . After the Goblin War ended in 1371 DR , the forest became infested with orc s . Previous to this it had been free of evil creatures . No ruins were known to be located inside the King ' s Forest . History . The King ' s Forest was probably a remnant of the Forest Country ( also known as the Forest Kingdom ) which was a forest basin southeast of the Stormhorns in the area then known as Cormyr .

title: King ' s Reach
description: King ' s Reach King ' s Reach , also called the High Reach , was a town in the Vast , lying by the River Vesper on North Road between Swords Pool and Three Trees Pass , at the intersection with the Long Reach trail from Sendrin . History . There were various explanations for the name of King ' s Reach , but sages agreed that the oldest and most likely story was that this was the spot where Deep King Tuir Stonebeard of Roldilar declared that human s would reach this far and no further into dwarven lands .
description_long: King ' s Reach King ' s Reach , also called the High Reach , was a town in the Vast , lying by the River Vesper on North Road between Swords Pool and Three Trees Pass , at the intersection with the Long Reach trail from Sendrin . History . There were various explanations for the name of King ' s Reach , but sages agreed that the oldest and most likely story was that this was the spot where Deep King Tuir Stonebeard of Roldilar declared that human s would reach this far and no further into dwarven lands . The name remained even after the fall of Roldilar in 649 DR . The nickname " the High Reach " was later applied to distinguish the town from the Dragon Reach . Throughout its history , King ' s Reach was a base for prospectors and miners operating in the neighboring Troll Mountains ( until they were worked out ) , Giantspike and Earthspur Mountains . These miners were originally dwarves , but over time they became predominantly human . Description . King ' s Reach was a fortified town located near the River Vesper , at a crossing that was the highest navigable point upstream . Beyond this point , the river was a series of cascades and falls .

title: King ' s Tower
description: King ' s Tower The King ' s Tower was a smooth - sided fortified construction on the west side of Marsember . Structure . The building ' s cobbled terrace was the largest open public space in the city .
description_long: King ' s Tower The King ' s Tower was a smooth - sided fortified construction on the west side of Marsember . Structure . The building ' s cobbled terrace was the largest open public space in the city . Inhabitants . The tower was the home of the Crown ' s representative in the city which in 1367 DR was Bledryn Scoril and housed the city ' s 3000 Purple Dragons .

title: King - Killer Star
description: King - Killer Star The King - Killer Star was a reddish cometary body , visible from Toril , once linked to the Dracorage mythal . Its periodic appearance in the skies of Abeir - Toril caused dragon s to go mad with rage , destroying and killing without reason . History .
description_long: King - Killer Star The King - Killer Star was a reddish cometary body , visible from Toril , once linked to the Dracorage mythal . Its periodic appearance in the skies of Abeir - Toril caused dragon s to go mad with rage , destroying and killing without reason . History . An attempt was made around - 3500 DR by dragonkind to destroy the King - Killer Star . The missed shot nicked Selûne and created the Tears .

title: King Oreme
description: King Oreme King Oreme was the name given to the ruling sarrukh lich of Oreme . Organization . Sixty sarrukh liches rotated as the leader of the city .
description_long: King Oreme King Oreme was the name given to the ruling sarrukh lich of Oreme . Organization . Sixty sarrukh liches rotated as the leader of the city . Every four years one would awaken and assume leadership , taking on the title King Oreme , while the remaining fifty nine liches hibernated .

title: King of Doegan
description: King of Doegan The king of the realm of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) saw his kingdom fall . History . Doegan was overrun by invaders led by Rathgar the Raider , who plundered the realm and laid siege to the capital .
description_long: King of Doegan The king of the realm of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) saw his kingdom fall . History . Doegan was overrun by invaders led by Rathgar the Raider , who plundered the realm and laid siege to the capital . Finally , Rathgar came for the crown itself , and confronted the king and princess in their own throne room , wondering the ruler . However , with his dying breath , the defiant king cursed him , declaring " For so long as you rule , a curse upon you . The dead will arise , to ensure your demise . " Escaping the invaders , the princess of Doegan looked for a way to make her father ' s prophecy come true . She went to Old Stone Keep and there met Aelric , and enlisted his aid . Description . The king of Doegan appeared to be a mage . He dressed in black , with a purple robe and high collar . He had a goatee and black hair streaked with white . When he cursed Rathgar , the symbol over his throne — a fiendish long - horned skull and ankh — glowed green .

title: King of Justice
description: King of Justice His ( or Her ) Resplendence , the King of Justice ( or the Queen of Justice ) was a title used by the ruler of gold dragon society . The title was created because the gold dragons , the most lawful of the dragon species , felt the necessity to create the most orderly of societies . The King of Justice was usually the oldest and most powerful gold dragon of a given region .
description_long: King of Justice His ( or Her ) Resplendence , the King of Justice ( or the Queen of Justice ) was a title used by the ruler of gold dragon society . The title was created because the gold dragons , the most lawful of the dragon species , felt the necessity to create the most orderly of societies . The King of Justice was usually the oldest and most powerful gold dragon of a given region . Although the dragons held official elections when it was necessary to fill the position , the King of Justice was almost always chosen by acclamation . If the two most promising candidates of a given election were male and female , then , instead of elections , they took the Oath of Concord ( the dragon equivalent of marriage ) and shared responsibilities and authorities equally . Unlike most human kings , His Resplendence ( or Their Resplendences , in the case mentioned above ) didn ' t actually rule gold dragon society . Instead , they acted as advisors , giving guidance to those who sought them for their wisdom , and only took decisions when a situation affected the race as a whole .

title: King of Shadows
description: King of Shadows The King of Shadows ( originally known only as the Guardian ) was a dark creature who was both born of the Illefarn empire , as well as the reason for its destruction . History . Not much is known about the King ' s early days , save that he was a talented human magic user who was trained for twenty years by the elf Master Isym in the arcane arts .
description_long: King of Shadows The King of Shadows ( originally known only as the Guardian ) was a dark creature who was both born of the Illefarn empire , as well as the reason for its destruction . History . Not much is known about the King ' s early days , save that he was a talented human magic user who was trained for twenty years by the elf Master Isym in the arcane arts . Fiercely patriotic to his homeland , the Second Illefarn empire , the King was one of the hundred who answered the call by the priest Annaeus to sacrifice himself to become a weapon against Illefarn ' s enemies : the orc tribes to the north , and Netheril to the east . After he was selected out of all the candidates , the King underwent a 100 - day long , extremely painful ritual in which Annaeus merged the man with the Weave . When the ritual had passed , the man had lost all traces of his former self ; he was now known as " the Guardian , " a perfect weapon with only two goals : to protect Illefarn and destroy its enemies . Fearing this Guardian , even Netheril dared not attack Illefarn , and so the empires co - existed for a time .

title: Kingdom of Nix
description: Kingdom of Nix The Kingdom of Nix was a goblin realm lying in the western Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . Geography . The Kingdom of Nix lay upon the high Forbidden Plateau , beside a glacier in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal .
description_long: Kingdom of Nix The Kingdom of Nix was a goblin realm lying in the western Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . Geography . The Kingdom of Nix lay upon the high Forbidden Plateau , beside a glacier in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal . The only way to reach it was through the elusive Phantom Pass , but even then , Nix only appeared once a year , around harvest - time . Vanesci Hamlet , a human settlement , lay near the entrance in Konigheim , many miles from Nix . Description . The alien landscape of the Forbidden Plateau around Nix was covered in what appeared to be slabs of gray stone and greenish swamps . The trees were weirdly formed , with bulbous shapes and above - ground roots . The buildings of Nix were mostly flat and rectangular blocks , built of some white material with round doorways and windows , some with chimneys and pale - blue roofing . Larger buildings were built all of this white material but were rounded and organic , almost if melted or grown . A thick city wall of similar make ringed the settlement . The inhabitants kept trees and gardens within the walls , but of the same strange plants as outside the city .

title: Kings ' tears
description: Kings ' tears Kings ' tears ( also seen as king ' s tears ) were extremely rare jewels unique to the Realms . They were sometimes called frozen tears or lich weepings . Description .
description_long: Kings ' tears Kings ' tears ( also seen as king ' s tears ) were extremely rare jewels unique to the Realms . They were sometimes called frozen tears or lich weepings . Description . These rare stones were transparent , colorless , teardrop - shaped with a smooth surface , and incredibly hard . No mundane means were known that could break , chip , cut , etch , fracture , or even scuff one of these jewels — they were always found in this perfect state . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp . Powers . Each specimen contained a sharply detailed , life - like image or scene that could be viewed by gazing deeply into the stone . Some contained an image of a person ; some contained a panoramic view of a landscape or a battle in a place long forgotten or ravaged by time ; and some held unfathomable dream - like scenes . What these images portrayed and what relationship they had with each other remained unknown , but sage s fervently studied them .

title: Kinterly
description: Kinterly Kinterly ran a magic shop in Zhentil Keep in 1357 DR . Activities . Kinterly ran Kinterly ' s Magics , one of the few recognized magic shops in the Realms .
description_long: Kinterly Kinterly ran a magic shop in Zhentil Keep in 1357 DR . Activities . Kinterly ran Kinterly ' s Magics , one of the few recognized magic shops in the Realms . Usually he tried to buy genuine magic item s while claiming they were mundane , and sold almost - empty and non - functional magic items as if they were full - powered . Relationship . Kinterly had two fire giant assistants and a very good relationship with the Zhentil Keep guard .

title: Kinyel Druu ' giir
description: Kinyel Druu ' giir Kinyel Druu ' giir was a drow assassin in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Kinyel was an assassin of House Druu ' giir in Menzoberranzan but she was exiled to Mantol - Derith after failing to kill a house rival There , during the Rage of Demons , she became smitten with a gargoyle who had given her a madness - causing gem created by the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu Affected by the madness , Kinyel decided she must kill the Zhentarim beholder Lorthuun .
description_long: Kinyel Druu ' giir Kinyel Druu ' giir was a drow assassin in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Kinyel was an assassin of House Druu ' giir in Menzoberranzan but she was exiled to Mantol - Derith after failing to kill a house rival There , during the Rage of Demons , she became smitten with a gargoyle who had given her a madness - causing gem created by the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu Affected by the madness , Kinyel decided she must kill the Zhentarim beholder Lorthuun . Kinyel infiltrated the staff of Sirak Mazelor when the drow representative went to met the Zhent delegate Ghazrim DuLoc , waiting for the right occasion to strike , but was stopped by some adventurers . Personality . Kinyel believed in her madness that killing the beholder would gain her the pardon of her house .

title: Kipp
description: Kipp Kipp is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Background . Not much is known about him , except that he is reported to sometimes steal things and throw acorns at militiamen on drill ( Bevil Starling in particular ) .
description_long: Kipp Kipp is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Background . Not much is known about him , except that he is reported to sometimes steal things and throw acorns at militiamen on drill ( Bevil Starling in particular ) . In Kipp ' s companion dialogue , it is implied that Kipp ' s father was a Shadow Thief from somewhere in the south ( probably Amn ) . Kipp ' s parents attempted to make their home in the swamp , but they were killed by lizardfolk . After this , Kipp went to live with the Lannons , but he disliked all the rules , so he ran away . Now Kipp claims to survive by his wits , stealing whatever food and supplies he needs . He apparently owns two pet frogs ; among his many thefts were a set of basilisk eyelashes for them , which he " acquired " from Tarmas ' workshop . ( It is unknown why the frogs needed eyelashes . ) Appendix . External links .

title: Kipper Harpell
description: Kipper Harpell Kipper Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their oldest member in the late 15th century , and he was known to be well versed in transportation magic . History . In 1479 DR , Kipper was the oldest sage of the clan .
description_long: Kipper Harpell Kipper Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their oldest member in the late 15th century , and he was known to be well versed in transportation magic . History . In 1479 DR , Kipper was the oldest sage of the clan . Despite not liking to leave his house , he was , like all his family , involved in the war started by the drow with the Darkening .

title: Kiputytto
description: Kiputytto Kiputytto was a demigoddess of disease slain by Talona . In - 33 DR Kiputytto attacked Talona , a deity who shared a portfolio with hers . Their chosen battleground was city of Asram , one of the four remaining cities of Netheril .
description_long: Kiputytto Kiputytto was a demigoddess of disease slain by Talona . In - 33 DR Kiputytto attacked Talona , a deity who shared a portfolio with hers . Their chosen battleground was city of Asram , one of the four remaining cities of Netheril . Talona gained the upper hand by plaguing the city , forcing the inhabitants to pray to her . Kiputytto struck back with similar method , however her plagues overcame the curative resources of the city and left the population dead in less than a month . In the aftermath , Talona slew Kiputytto . Kiputytto was described as a black skinned , twisted old crone with a scarred face .

title: Kir - lanan
description: Kir - lanan Kir - lanan were gargoyle - like creatures that appeared on Faerûn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Ecology . Physical Characteristics .
description_long: Kir - lanan Kir - lanan were gargoyle - like creatures that appeared on Faerûn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Ecology . Physical Characteristics . Appearing similar to the more common gargoyle , kir - lanan had huge bat - like wings and a humanoid form . Muscular and about 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) tall , they tended to weigh roughly 220 lbs ( 99 . 7 kg ) and were covered in fine scales . Although they tended to wrap their bodies in tight cloth , with various ivory , metal and stone adornments , much of their thick skin was visible along their arms and wings . Generally varying in hue from midnight blue , through deep violet , to black , kir - lanan could sometimes be found with skin colors of brown , gray , green , or even dark red . Strikingly , the kir - lanan had hard , pointed teeth and claws with short horns cresting their temples . Abilities . Kir - lanan preferred to fight with their claws rather than weapons , though they were sometimes known to enter battle with them . As negative energy infused their bodies , kir - lanan could administer deadly attacks with the merest touch . Psychology .

title: Kira
description: Kira Kira was an elven wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Kira was the great - granddaughter of Elorfindar Floshin and had both sun elf and wood elf blood in her veins .
description_long: Kira Kira was an elven wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Kira was the great - granddaughter of Elorfindar Floshin and had both sun elf and wood elf blood in her veins . She was a talented member of Maelwyn ' s adventuring party , saving the group on many occasions .

title: Kirenkirsalai
description: Kirenkirsalai Kirenkirsalai , also known as Kire , was a vampire lord who lived in an abandoned temple of Garagos in Westgate . History . He was obsessed with the young mage Myrin Darkdance and was the person behind the bounty for her capture in Luskan .
description_long: Kirenkirsalai Kirenkirsalai , also known as Kire , was a vampire lord who lived in an abandoned temple of Garagos in Westgate . History . He was obsessed with the young mage Myrin Darkdance and was the person behind the bounty for her capture in Luskan . In 1480 DR , Kire enlisted the help of Vaelis , a young paladin of Hoar and one of the claimants to the Shadowbane title , and also had Eye of Justice member Hessar in his employ . Relationships . Kire was obsessed with Myrin although the nature of his interest was never clear . It may have been related to family ties to House Darkdance or may have been due to Myrin ' s powerful spellscar . Appearance . Kire resembled a dark - skinned half - elf .

title: Kiril Duskmourn
description: Kiril Duskmourn Kiril Duskmourn was a star elf warrior and a Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . Personality . The star elf was known for her foul mouth , purposeful baiting of others , and derision .
description_long: Kiril Duskmourn Kiril Duskmourn was a star elf warrior and a Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . Personality . The star elf was known for her foul mouth , purposeful baiting of others , and derision . Possessions . Kiril wielded the sword Angul and carried a magical bronze flask of endless whiskey . History . Kiril was a warden of Stardeep from 1360 DR to 1365 DR . In 1365 DR , while under a magical compulsion , she slaughtered a number of half - elf children who strayed too close to Stardeep . Later , she went to work as bodyguard for the dwarf geomancer Thormud Horn . In 1374 DR , Kiril helped the Deep Imaskari wizard Ususi Manaallin to keep the body and mind of the Elder Evil Pandorym imprisoned in the Celestial Nadir and the Palace of the Purple Emperor . In 1375 DR , she returned to Stardeep and fought beside Raidon Kane , Delphe , and others against the traitorous Keeper of the Cerulean Sign Telarian . Shortly after 1385 DR , Kiril entered the Vilhon Wilds and disappeared .

title: Kirioshi
description: Kirioshi Kirioshi was a Shoya in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kirioshi was shoya of a quarter of a unnamed city of Kozakura .
description_long: Kirioshi Kirioshi was a Shoya in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kirioshi was shoya of a quarter of a unnamed city of Kozakura . In 1357 his drunken grandson and his friends started a brawl with a adventuring party . Kirioshi arrived to placate the situation with his militiamen but considered the adventurers the instigators of the brawl and want from them a very high fine . All changed however when was approached by a rappresentative of merchant Ko Mei Kho and Kirioshi considered close the matter . Personality . Kirioshi know that was his grandson the drunk one but his pride not permitted to punish him and considered a insult if someone told him the truth .

title: Kiros
description: Kiros Kiros was the leader of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Kiros was a kind of sage about history , warfare , and nature .
description_long: Kiros Kiros was the leader of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Kiros was a kind of sage about history , warfare , and nature . He was always terribly formal and precise . History . In 1357 DR Kiros and his fellow met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . Later he joined the council that ruled the Barony . In 1359 DR Kiros and his fellow had joined the Alliance of Belt Watchers with local halfling s and Dwarves . Personality . Kiros had a grizzled , slow - talking but powerful personality .

title: Kirsoph Vinson
description: Kirsoph Vinson Kirsoph Vinson was the first Dahaunarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1333 DR to 1342 DR , and the Lord of House Vinson from 1299 DR . Always impatient , in 1342 DR , Kirsoph ordered his agent to kill the Pommarch in order to rise through the ranks but the Pommarch bribed Kirsoph ' s agents to betray and kill their master . He was known as the " Kobold Lord " for his stinginess .
description_long: Kirsoph Vinson Kirsoph Vinson was the first Dahaunarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1333 DR to 1342 DR , and the Lord of House Vinson from 1299 DR . Always impatient , in 1342 DR , Kirsoph ordered his agent to kill the Pommarch in order to rise through the ranks but the Pommarch bribed Kirsoph ' s agents to betray and kill their master . He was known as the " Kobold Lord " for his stinginess .

title: Kiser Jhaeri
description: Kiser Jhaeri Kiser Jhaeri was an infamous thief and assassin in Saradush . History . During The Five ' s siege of Saradush , Kiser was ready to open the gates to the enemy .
description_long: Kiser Jhaeri Kiser Jhaeri was an infamous thief and assassin in Saradush . History . During The Five ' s siege of Saradush , Kiser was ready to open the gates to the enemy . To cover up his plot , he framed an innocent , Mateo , blackmailing the chief witness , Mirnielle Santele , by kidnapping her son Ardic Santele . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward became involved in the investigation , and at first Kiser proclaimed his innocence . After Gorion ' s Ward discovered the capture of Ardic , Kiser tried to frame the mage Errard for the kidnapping . At last , Gorion ' s Ward saw through Kiser ' s lies and he fought and defeated Kiser . Rumors . Count Oon Santele and Mayor Tanithe Beyross had suspicions that Kiser was the secret leader of the Cat ' s Claw assassin guild .

title: Kisha Yunoko
description: Kisha Yunoko Kisha Yunoko was the concubine of the emperor of Wa around 1357 DR . History . Yunoko was the adopted daughter of daimyo Matasuuri Ieysuna and granddaughter of the shogun .
description_long: Kisha Yunoko Kisha Yunoko was the concubine of the emperor of Wa around 1357 DR . History . Yunoko was the adopted daughter of daimyo Matasuuri Ieysuna and granddaughter of the shogun . She was trained as geisha starting from when she took her first step . In 1354 DR Yunoko was invited by the shogun at the Imperial Palace and quickly the emperor fall for her . Yunoko became one of the emperor ' s geisha and later his concubine , always reporting emperors ' s words she listened to the shogun . Secretly Yunoko started a relationship with Tekinjo Yojairo , the military governor in residence at the palace . Personality . Yunoko was a delicate and gentle girl . She want leave the emperor but fear the ire of her grandfather . at first she enjoyed the luxury life in the Imperial Palace but recently feel guilty to betray the emperor ' s trust . She greatly fear also if someone discovered her love story with Yojairo . Now she was disperate to find any kind of choice to exit from this situation .

title: Kishimoto Endai
description: Kishimoto Endai Kishimoto Endai was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Kan - oji in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kan - oji , he led a company of three samurai and ten bushi .
description_long: Kishimoto Endai Kishimoto Endai was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Kan - oji in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kan - oji , he led a company of three samurai and ten bushi . He was at the time busy with emergencies . An infestation of evil hengeyokai , goblin s , and bakemono plagued the village . Kishimoto had begun to be suspicious about it . Personality . Kishimoto was not a good administrator and was not loved by the yakusho .

title: Kishiria
description: Kishiria Kishiria was a human warrior who worked for the Red Wizards of Thay in the southern part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Description . She had sharp facial features dotted with freckles , and curly , orange hair , cropped short .
description_long: Kishiria Kishiria was a human warrior who worked for the Red Wizards of Thay in the southern part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Description . She had sharp facial features dotted with freckles , and curly , orange hair , cropped short . She wore a black cloak , and was dressed in a blue shirt underneath her armor . Possessions . In addition to her breastplate , Kishiria owned a large claymore sword . Activities . Stories circulated about Kishiria ' s prowess with her claymore . Notably , she was known to have beheaded three men in a single stroke in battle .

title: Kishkoman
description: Kishkoman A kishkoman , or whistle - knife was a unique weapon found in the Cold Lands . Description . A " kishkoman " looked like a small animal horn only slightly longer than a child ' s hand .
description_long: Kishkoman A kishkoman , or whistle - knife was a unique weapon found in the Cold Lands . Description . A " kishkoman " looked like a small animal horn only slightly longer than a child ' s hand . The broader base of the horn served as the handle and was perforated with small holes . When blown , the " kishkoman " emitted a high - pitched sound that only elves could hear . This sound was used to call for aid to any within hearing range of the whistle . History . These items were made from the horn of a small swiftstag buck . Mothers typically gave them to children when they reached an age where they could go off on their own .

title: Kisonraathiisar
description: Kisonraathiisar Kisonraathiisar was a topaz dragon and the first king of Westgate . He founded Westgate in an effort to build a kingdom that would survive the effects of the King - Killer Star . History .
description_long: Kisonraathiisar Kisonraathiisar was a topaz dragon and the first king of Westgate . He founded Westgate in an effort to build a kingdom that would survive the effects of the King - Killer Star . History . He was slowly destroyed by Saldrinar " of the Seven Spells " , a Netherese wizard , in - 349 DR . Saldrinar then became the first human king of Westgate . Kisonraathiisar ' s corpse was kept in a secret subbasement below Castle Thalavar in Westgate .

title: Kissikit ' a
description: Kissikit ' a Kissikit ' a was a thri - kreen of the Krakk ' t tribe dwelling in the Rushing Hills on the Shining Plains . In Tarsakh in 1370 DR , Kissikit ' a was the representative of the Krakk ' t to the annual meeting with representatives of the human cities of Assam , Lheshayl , and Ormath ; the Emerald Enclave ; and the centaur and wemic tribes of the Shining Plains , held on the Hill of Memories . There were reportedly tense moments between Kissikit ' a and the ruler of Lheshayl , Entawanata , but they and the other rulers mostly discussed trade routes , local monsters , and so on .

title: Kit
description: Kit A character kit or simply kit was an optional additional layer in character creation used in 2nd edition , allowing for a variety of subtypes within the usual character classes . Each kit provided a specific role and a set of requirements , limitations and benefits to give a character its own twist . Usually , these kits where specific to a character class .

Each kit provided a specific role and a set of requirements , limitations and benefits to give a character its own twist . Usually , these kits where specific to a character class . The variation from the standard class a kit provided ranged from slight to very profound . The Al - Qadim campaign required a kit for every character . Appendix . See also . title: Kitashi
description: Kitashi Kitashi was a yakuza in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi was a yakuza spy in a town in Kozakura , where resided Ko Mei Kho .
description_long: Kitashi Kitashi was a yakuza in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi was a yakuza spy in a town in Kozakura , where resided Ko Mei Kho . In 1357 rumors said that Ko clan was involved in a great enterprise and Kitashi went to spy Ko Mei Kho , discovering that he had just hired an adventuring party to solve a matter in far Akari island . Personality . Kitashi was a very able spy . She not want die for her mission and if captured told all her known , hoping for a next occasion to escape .

title: Kittenlord
description: Kittenlord The " kittenlord " , also called the " cat child " , was a werecat boy and the heir to the role of catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the existing Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord .
description_long: Kittenlord The " kittenlord " , also called the " cat child " , was a werecat boy and the heir to the role of catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the existing Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord . He decided that this new catlord must prowl beside cats in the towns and cities , not in the jungles as he once did . Thus , he chose an apparently respectable human to teach his heir the ways of civilization , and gave the boy over to him . Unfortunately , unfamiliar with the ways of civilization and believing being respectable meant being civilized , the Catlord had chosen the cruel and ruthless Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka . Duum had wicked intentions for the boy and promised him to Malar the Beastlord once he was through with him . Learning of Duum ' s aims , the Catlord came and rescued the boy , but Malar pounced upon him as he fled . Then the rogue Conner appeared , claiming to be on a mission from a god to take the child to safety . The Catlord agreed , and , fighting Malar , bought time for Conner to carry the child away .

title: Kixa To ' u
description: Kixa To ' u Kixa To ' u was a great wu jen who lived in Koryo several centuries before 1357 DR . Kixa To ' u fashioned a magical staff of eldritch power , the " Ky Trencha Ukang " . But he came to fear what he had wrought and split the staff apart , transforming it into five magical scroll reels .

But he came to fear what he had wrought and split the staff apart , transforming it into five magical scroll reels .

title: Kixitiloc
description: Kixitiloc Kixitiloc was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Kixitiloc lived in a small Payit village that was destroyed during a battle against another village .
description_long: Kixitiloc Kixitiloc was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Kixitiloc lived in a small Payit village that was destroyed during a battle against another village . Kixitiloc was taken as a slave . In 1361 DR , he arrived in Ulatos the same day as Cordell ' s forces arrived . He soon became a slave of the Golden Legion . Being a troublemaker , however , he was sold many times until he arrived in Lord Drakosa ' s plantation . He hoped to improve himself to attain a better life . Personality . Kixitiloc was a taciturn man with a bad temperament . He desperately wanted to be free but at heart he dreamed of becoming a master with his own land and slaves . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Kixitiloc is a pre - generated Maztican PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Kiyosu Kuroda
description: Kiyosu Kuroda Kiyosu Kuroda was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Kuroda was sent to lead a patrol of bushi near Ito - Jo in order to stop an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to took the Seven Swords to Uemon .
description_long: Kiyosu Kuroda Kiyosu Kuroda was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Kuroda was sent to lead a patrol of bushi near Ito - Jo in order to stop an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to took the Seven Swords to Uemon . He found and fought the adventurers but was defeated . Personality . Kuroda was a honorable man , not wanting unnecessary victims . He cared for his men . In his current mission he only wanted recover the relics or harry and weaken the enemies .

title: Kizzlok
description: Kizzlok Kizzlok was a Maztican drow . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .
description_long: Kizzlok Kizzlok was a Maztican drow . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History . In 1361 DR , during the Night of Wailing , Kizzlok was one of the drow sent to take Darien to Mount Zatal . During the fighting with the Golden Legion , Kizzlok was one of the few survivors . He was with Darien and the Ancestor during the meeting to discuss the next strategy to kill Erixitl .

title: Klaire Gatewood
description: Klaire Gatewood Klaire Gatewood was a famed artist of Cormyr . A book of sketches by Klaire Gatewood was in the possession of Lady of Mystery Naedaenya Arthas at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . It was worth 200 gp to the right buyer .

title: Klarz
description: Klarz Klarz was a hobgoblin sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Klarz was the captain of the " Koalith " .
description_long: Klarz Klarz was a hobgoblin sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Klarz was the captain of the " Koalith " . History . Once Klarz and a Emerald Enclave ' s ranger were stranded together in a monster - infested isle of the Korinn Archipelago and the ranger save his life , a debt that Klarz promise to repay . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR eventually Klarz repayed his debt to the Emerald Enclave traveling in search of the " Morkoth

title: Klauth
description: Klauth Klauth , also known as Old Snarl , was supposedly one of the eldest dragons alive who had not been turned into a dracolich . Personality . He was thoroughly evil , especially to his own kind , though he did have a few redeeming factors such as granting boons to creatures he considered no threat , crushing the odd orc horde on a whim and the fact that he has avoided the advances of the Cult of the Dragon .
description_long: Klauth Klauth , also known as Old Snarl , was supposedly one of the eldest dragons alive who had not been turned into a dracolich . Personality . He was thoroughly evil , especially to his own kind , though he did have a few redeeming factors such as granting boons to creatures he considered no threat , crushing the odd orc horde on a whim and the fact that he has avoided the advances of the Cult of the Dragon . Activities . For such an active dragon of his age , he had lived much longer than his race ' s life expectancy would normally allow without the aid of the cult ' s methods . This is because he has developed a magical process in which he can use the eggs of red dragons to increase his own size , health and vigor . Lair . Klauth makes his lair in the northern Sword Coast , in a narrow winding valley dubbed Klauthen Vale in the mountains west of Mirabar . From here Old Snarl uses his powerful scrying spells and abilities to learn as much as possible about the other inhabitants of the Sword Coast ; this means the old wyrm is rarely caught off guard by intruders . History .

title: Klavikus
description: Klavikus Klavikus was a glabrezu in service of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Klavikus was a powerful and ambitious demon at the court of demon lord Orcus .
description_long: Klavikus Klavikus was a glabrezu in service of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Klavikus was a powerful and ambitious demon at the court of demon lord Orcus . Sensing him a menace Orcus ordered to Klavikus to kept custody of Castle Perilous for 500 years . Klavikus used all his centuries of servitude to Zhengyi to read all the books of the lich ' s library . He started to sent some of the tomes in his original house in Abyss . Personality . Klavikus wanted rule the Abyss but Orcus tricked him in servitude . He loved reading and could be bride with a good book .

title: Kleve
description: Kleve Kleve was a slaad in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kleve acted as the loyal bodyguard of archmage Vizeran DeVir , thanks to a control gem the drow possessed .
description_long: Kleve Kleve was a slaad in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kleve acted as the loyal bodyguard of archmage Vizeran DeVir , thanks to a control gem the drow possessed . He was always at his master ' s side and obeyed all his orders .

title: Klibdoloogut
description: Klibdoloogut Klibdoloogut was a kuo - toa whip cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . History . Klibdoloogut was a whip and , during the Rage of Demons , quickly become one of the first followers of the new god Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father , ( in truth , demon lord Demogorgon .
description_long: Klibdoloogut Klibdoloogut was a kuo - toa whip cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . History . Klibdoloogut was a whip and , during the Rage of Demons , quickly become one of the first followers of the new god Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father , ( in truth , demon lord Demogorgon . ) He was choosen for the duty of keeping the altar in the new Leemooggoogoon ' s temple , deciding who could access the prophet Bloppblippoodd . He permitted to Ploopploopeen , former ruler of the village and Bloppblippoodd ' s father , and his minions access in order to offer as sacrifices a party of adventurers who had escaped from drow slavers of Velkynvelve . However , this was all a plan to infiltrate the temple to cut off the head of the cult . At this point , " Leemooggoogoon " , along with dozens of ixitxachitl , rose from Darklake and started to destroy Sloobludop , killing all present , including Bloppblippoodd , Klibdoloogut , and their cultists .

title: Kllug
description: Kllug Kllug was a goblin shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orc and drow on the Silver Marches , Kllug and his fellow orc shaman Innanig led troops to an assault of Nesmè .
description_long: Kllug Kllug was a goblin shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orc and drow on the Silver Marches , Kllug and his fellow orc shaman Innanig led troops to an assault of Nesmè . However , Kllug and Innanig were deceived by reborn Regis .

title: Klonalogh Umesker
description: Klonalogh Umesker Klonalogh Umesker was an inhabitant of the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Klonalogh was the foreman of a corps of engineers and stonemasons paid by the civic authorities of both Ravens Bluff and Tantras to maintain the massive multi - span bridge over the Fire River in Mossbridges . They could never be persuaded to risk or sabotage the bridge .
description_long: Klonalogh Umesker Klonalogh Umesker was an inhabitant of the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Klonalogh was the foreman of a corps of engineers and stonemasons paid by the civic authorities of both Ravens Bluff and Tantras to maintain the massive multi - span bridge over the Fire River in Mossbridges . They could never be persuaded to risk or sabotage the bridge . However , they were corrupt in other areas . For a hefty bribe , they would conceal bodies , treasure , and telltale items in the bridge pilings , where they might remain for a good long time . Klonalogh was head of this operation too . The foreman ' s office could be found three doors north of The Blushing Gynosphinx , past two rooming houses , on the east side of the road .

title: Klurichir
description: Klurichir A klurichir is a variant of guardian tanar ' ri , one of the most powerful and respected demons of the Abyss . It is said that even a mighty balor will give a klurichir a wide berth . They often serve and act as a right hand to a demon lord , usually as generals just as balor are .
description_long: Klurichir A klurichir is a variant of guardian tanar ' ri , one of the most powerful and respected demons of the Abyss . It is said that even a mighty balor will give a klurichir a wide berth . They often serve and act as a right hand to a demon lord , usually as generals just as balor are . They are incredibly strong , and are very aware of this . The act of summoning one of these creatures requires either great strength or boundless foolishness . Description . A klurichir stands 30 feet tall . Its broadly muscled body is covered in skin of the blackened color normally associated with a corpse that dies due to extreme cold . Monstrous , red batlike wings flare from its back , and its four arms constantly twitch and flex as if seeking fresh prey to crush and destroy . Its face resembles a cross between a mule and a snarling orc , and spines cover its face , neck , and upper shoulders . The creature ’ s most hideous feature is located in the middle of its abdomen : a large , gaping mouth filled with a slobbering tongue and rows of blunt , powerful , grinding teeth . Just above this obscene maw sits a pair of massive , sharp pincers the size of large scythe blades .

title: Knarr
description: Knarr A knarr was a small ship used mainly in the North for transporting cargo . Description . A typical knarr was 60 ft ( 18 m ) long at the keel and 15 ft ( 4 .
description_long: Knarr A knarr was a small ship used mainly in the North for transporting cargo . Description . A typical knarr was 60 ft ( 18 m ) long at the keel and 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) wide at the beam . It had one mast that mounted one square sail and had a flat bottom for easy beaching and sailing on rivers . If needed , a few oars could be mounted fore and aft to increase speed or in case of calm winds . It had a minimum crew size of eight and could go as high as fourteen . The knarr carried no weapons and could not be equipped with a ram . A small knarr was one of a few vessels that could be constructed from the ( mostly ) undamaged corpse of a dragon .

title: Knee - Cracker
description: Knee - Cracker Knee - Cracker was a cider crafted in Faerûn . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Knee - Cracker Knee - Cracker was a cider crafted in Faerûn . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Made from windfall apples , Knee - Cracker cider possessed a heavy sediment . It was suggested to let a container of Knee - Cracker sit for three days upon receipt to allow the sediment to settle . This cider was a flavorful cloudy beverage that was stronger than ale but weaker than wine . Prices . Knee - Cracker could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Kneebreakers
description: Kneebreakers The Kneebreakers were a vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Kneebreakers were a group of young halfling s riding war - pigs in search of a thrill in their peaceful existence .
description_long: Kneebreakers The Kneebreakers were a vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Kneebreakers were a group of young halfling s riding war - pigs in search of a thrill in their peaceful existence . They were a group of able warriors who had no problem with retreating if the situation went wrong .

title: Knellict
description: Knellict Knellict the archmage of the Citadel of Assassins . History . Knellict is of great , but unknown age , generally assumed to be in his second or third century .
description_long: Knellict Knellict the archmage of the Citadel of Assassins . History . Knellict is of great , but unknown age , generally assumed to be in his second or third century . Before the first Zhengyi driven war between Vaasa and Damara , Knellict was an advisor to the king of Vaasa . The king feared Knellict ' s power and tried to have him assassinated . After the attempt on his life , Knellect left the service to the king of Vaasa and joined the Citadel of Assassins which quickly came under the sway of Zhengyi . During this time Knellict became the principle advisor to Zhengyi , himself . After Zhengyi ' s fall at the hands of Gareth Dragonsbane and party , Knellict remained with the Citadel of Assassins , second only to Timoshenko . In some ways Knellict is the real power within the Citadel since Timoshenko generally follows all of Knellict ' s advice , such as forming ties to the thieves guild Tightpurse in Heliogabalus , and since Knellict has free reign to do as he pleases . In 1372 DR , the Citadel of Assassins was once again brought under the influence of another power . This time it was the mercenary band , Bregan D ' aerthe from Menzoberranzan .

title: Knesha
description: Knesha Knesha was a bard in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Knesha was the greatest non - divine expert in lost relics and artifact s in south Mulhorand .
description_long: Knesha Knesha was a bard in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Knesha was the greatest non - divine expert in lost relics and artifact s in south Mulhorand . She spent all her free time studying about places where ancient magic item s disappeared . History . Once Knesha was a scribe in Skuld until a mistake in her calculations caused a loss of taxes . She was imprisoned but managed to escape and settled in Outer Sultim , where nobody respected Skuld ' s laws . There she found her true vocation as a bard specializing in satirical poems . Personality . Knesha had grown bored of her work as a bard and dreamed of going on adventures .

title: Knight ' s Detente
description: Knight ' s Detente The Knight ' s Detente was a boisterous festhall with rooms for rent in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . It was a place for soldiers to carouse , flirt , gamble , laugh , and spend their pay on poor quality but overpriced food and drink . Non - military were not welcome , although it was said that a person could gain entrance if they could last more than five seconds arm - wrestling the burly half - orc bouncer , Xom .
