title: Knight ' s move
description: Knight ' s move Knight ' s move was a divine transmutation or alteration spell similar to " blink " that teleported the caster diagonally for a surprise attack or a surprise escape , making it a favorite of Red Knight ist cleric s . Effects . When cast , this spell caused the caster to instantaneously transit the Astral Plane and reappear a short distance away , in the manner of a knight - errant chess move — in a spot two - thirds the total distance in one direction and the remaining third in a perpendicular direction .
description_long: Knight ' s move Knight ' s move was a divine transmutation or alteration spell similar to " blink " that teleported the caster diagonally for a surprise attack or a surprise escape , making it a favorite of Red Knight ist cleric s . Effects . When cast , this spell caused the caster to instantaneously transit the Astral Plane and reappear a short distance away , in the manner of a knight - errant chess move — in a spot two - thirds the total distance in one direction and the remaining third in a perpendicular direction . The maximum linear distance that could be teleported was 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) , broken into two steps : 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) in one direction and 10 ft ( 3 m ) in a perpendicular direction . Higher level casters could extend this range but the movement was always in two - thirds / one - third proportion . If the point of arrival was already occupied by a solid object , the spell fizzled . An earlier version of this spell allowed the caster to make more than one " knight ' s move " as desired , but in lieu of any other action , before the spell expired .

title: Knight commander
description: Knight commander A knight commander is a specific variety of warlord that has learned to command by example and forceful authority and who specialize in the use of heavy armor . Like battle captain s , knight commanders tend to lead from the front , protected by their cuirass and shield . Many knight commanders are , as the name implies , sworn to honor and chivalry , though they are not required to be knight s .
description_long: Knight commander A knight commander is a specific variety of warlord that has learned to command by example and forceful authority and who specialize in the use of heavy armor . Like battle captain s , knight commanders tend to lead from the front , protected by their cuirass and shield . Many knight commanders are , as the name implies , sworn to honor and chivalry , though they are not required to be knight s . Abilities . Bold and charismatic , knight commanders are an inspiration to behold , leading through natural ability and sworn dedication to honorable behavior that can be good for the morale of those following them . Even the most inexperienced knight commanders can inspire those fighting alongside them to competence and through their courage and valiant actions , knight commanders can literally enhance the effectiveness of their allies ’ self - defense . More experienced knight commanders are still more effective , learning to , through their reassuring presence and encouraging words , increase the deadliness of blows dealt to disadvantaged foes .

title: Knight of Iron
description: Knight of Iron The Knight of Iron advances in his , Gaerdal Ironhand ' s , service through prayer , fasting , and meditation . When a knight commits a serious transgression , he ( or she ) must seek out the nearest higher - level Knight of Iron , and atone with a quest of that knight ' s ( and Gaerdal ' s ) choice . Gaerdal ' s knights are expected to defend their people against any threat , even at cost of their lives .
description_long: Knight of Iron The Knight of Iron advances in his , Gaerdal Ironhand ' s , service through prayer , fasting , and meditation . When a knight commits a serious transgression , he ( or she ) must seek out the nearest higher - level Knight of Iron , and atone with a quest of that knight ' s ( and Gaerdal ' s ) choice . Gaerdal ' s knights are expected to defend their people against any threat , even at cost of their lives . They are typically served by one or more fighters in the service of Gaerdal , and will occasional build and maintain stone forts on the borders of gnomish lands . Failed Knights of Iron are still welcomed by their people , but are shunned by all in Gaerdal ' s service .

title: Knight of the Blue Moon
description: Knight of the Blue Moon The Knight of the Blue Moon is a special prestige class of Waterdeep . Knights of the Blue Moon draw upon the influence that the moon has over the Weave , their offensive and defensive skills changing in response to the waxing and waning of Selûne . The Knights of the Blue Moon call upon both arcane and divine magic .
description_long: Knight of the Blue Moon The Knight of the Blue Moon is a special prestige class of Waterdeep . Knights of the Blue Moon draw upon the influence that the moon has over the Weave , their offensive and defensive skills changing in response to the waxing and waning of Selûne . The Knights of the Blue Moon call upon both arcane and divine magic . Individuals with sorcerous skill are favoured due to the matter with which the Knights cast their spells , though bards are also found among their numbers . All members of the Knights of the Blue Moon , being good and drawn to the power of the moon , choose either Selûne or Mystra as their patron deity .

title: Knight of the Flying Hunt
description: Knight of the Flying Hunt Knight of the Flying Hunt is a prestige class of Faerûn whose members act as the defenders of Nimbral . While protecting Nimbral , these noble soldiers answer to the mysterious Nimbral Lords . They dedicate themselves to the inhabitants of Nimbral while enforcing the lands local laws .
description_long: Knight of the Flying Hunt Knight of the Flying Hunt is a prestige class of Faerûn whose members act as the defenders of Nimbral . While protecting Nimbral , these noble soldiers answer to the mysterious Nimbral Lords . They dedicate themselves to the inhabitants of Nimbral while enforcing the lands local laws . Most knights are human s who were previously fighter s or ranger s . A few cleric s and paladin s manage to the join the ranks of the Flying Hunt , but they are extremely uncommon because of the religious overtones .

title: Knight of the Weave
description: Knight of the Weave The Knight of the Weave is a prestige class of Faerûn . Whereas most individuals worship Mystra , Azuth , or Savras , Knights of the Weave worship the Weave itself , believing it to serve every living creature and give life a depth and experience that it would lack otherwise . Knights of the Weave believe themselves to be the protectors of the Weave and therefor go to great lengths to defend the Weave against any who would wish to abuse or destroy what the Knights of the Weave believe to be a gift to be used equally by all .
description_long: Knight of the Weave The Knight of the Weave is a prestige class of Faerûn . Whereas most individuals worship Mystra , Azuth , or Savras , Knights of the Weave worship the Weave itself , believing it to serve every living creature and give life a depth and experience that it would lack otherwise . Knights of the Weave believe themselves to be the protectors of the Weave and therefor go to great lengths to defend the Weave against any who would wish to abuse or destroy what the Knights of the Weave believe to be a gift to be used equally by all . While similiar to paladins in many respects , they are considerably less organized than a society of paladins . The chief point of interest about the Knights of the Weave is that they draw their power from arcane magic , not from the divine might of a specific deity .

title: Knights in Silver
description: Knights in Silver The Knights in Silver were the army of Silverymoon and it was their duty to patrol and defend the city against orc s and other dangers . History . The Knights in Silver were led by Besnell of Silverymoon , an elven fighter up until his death in the war between Mithral Hall and Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Knights in Silver The Knights in Silver were the army of Silverymoon and it was their duty to patrol and defend the city against orc s and other dangers . History . The Knights in Silver were led by Besnell of Silverymoon , an elven fighter up until his death in the war between Mithral Hall and Menzoberranzan . After the war was won he was replaced by his second in command Terrien Doucard , a half - elf soldier from Silverymoon . Later , Terrien led Stumpet Rakingclaw , the dwarven high priestess of Mithral Hall to save the injured Lady Alustriel higher up on the slopes of Keeper ' s Dale . In 1372 DR , the commander of the Knights in Silver was Sernius Alathar . Geography . A dozen Knights in Silver guarded Hawk ' s Nest , the watchtower near the top of Silverymoon Pass during the months when the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar was in heavy use protecting the road ' s traffic from monsters and bandits . Allies . They were aided by many wizard s and contingents of Harper agent s . Recruitment . There were two ways of becoming a Knight in Silver : volunteering , or receiving a commission from the High Mage . The former was by far the more common method .

title: Knights of Holy Judgment
description: Knights of Holy Judgment The Knights of Holy Judgment were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the lawful tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of the Merciful Sword , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .
description_long: Knights of Holy Judgment The Knights of Holy Judgment were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the lawful tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of the Merciful Sword , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .

title: Knights of Ilmater
description: Knights of Ilmater The Knights of Ilmater were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God Description . The order comprised fifty paladins who fought together under a red - and - grey banner bearing a holy symbol of Ilmater . An ultra - heavy cavalry unit , they were an incredibly dangerous force on the battlefield .
description_long: Knights of Ilmater The Knights of Ilmater were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God Description . The order comprised fifty paladins who fought together under a red - and - grey banner bearing a holy symbol of Ilmater . An ultra - heavy cavalry unit , they were an incredibly dangerous force on the battlefield . Activities . The Knights journeyed constantly from battle to battle , always seeking a worthy cause to fight for . They had no bases or homes , choosing to live without this security or comfort , as per their faith . History . Under the leadership of the suicidally brave Korr of Ilmater , in the Year of the Wyvern , 1373 DR , the Knights of Ilmater came to Daggerford ' s side and joined its alliance during the Second Dragonspear War against the forces of Dragonspear Castle .

title: Knights of Myth Drannor
description: Knights of Myth Drannor The Knights of Myth Drannor adventuring company came to prominence as the rulers of Shadowdale with their successful defiance of Zhentil Keep . They were also instrumental in the defeat of Lashan of Scardale . History .
description_long: Knights of Myth Drannor The Knights of Myth Drannor adventuring company came to prominence as the rulers of Shadowdale with their successful defiance of Zhentil Keep . They were also instrumental in the defeat of Lashan of Scardale . History . The Knights began in Espar as a nameless band of youths who had grown up together . One of their number , Florin Falconhand , rescued Azoun of Cormyr from an assassination attempt . In gratitude , Azoun granted a charter to them allowing them to bear arms . This royal assent included a strong recommendation that the party explore and clean out the Haunted Halls , a bandit hold north of the village of Eveningstar . As with almost any beginning group , the Knights had within their ranks members who were uncooperative and attempted to slay or steal from their fellows . Two such Knights , fighters Agannor Wildsilver and Bey Freemantle , met with swift and brutal ends . During their adventures , the party discovered a curious feature common to many ancient ruins in the Realms : permanent " gate s " linking distant locations to each other . One such " gate " took them to the city of Waterdeep , where they met with Khelben Arunsun .

title: Knights of Samular
description: Knights of Samular The Knights of Samular are an order of paladins in the service of Tyr who tend to focus on the supremacy of law . They are a well respected order in the Northlands with their base of operations in the Summit Hall while also maintaining a base in Waterdeep . History .
description_long: Knights of Samular The Knights of Samular are an order of paladins in the service of Tyr who tend to focus on the supremacy of law . They are a well respected order in the Northlands with their base of operations in the Summit Hall while also maintaining a base in Waterdeep . History . Formed in 952 DR after the Second Troll War , the Knights of Samular traced its roots to three brothers who became champions of the war , Samular Caradoon , Renwick Caradoon and Amphail the Just . While successfully stopping the siege of troll s through the use of the Rings of Samular and the magical siege engine known as the Kezefbane , Amphail and Renwick were killed around the end of the war ( though the latter would become an archlich entombed at the Sumber Hills ) . The invading trolls were eventually routed by Samular and his growing group of Tyrran paladins . These knights would eventually come to be known as the Knights of Samular . After routing the warlord Brunyundar Margaster from the keep , the knights made Thornhold as their chapterhouse . The Knights lost their headquarters to the Zhentarim thanks to the treachery of Dag Zoreth .

title: Knights of the Black Gauntlet
description: Knights of the Black Gauntlet The Knights of the Black Gauntlet were a group of over 7000 banite crusaders who kept their faith , even after Bane ' s death at the hands of Torm during the Time of Troubles . The Knights were led by Teldorn Darkhope , a mad priest of Bane who led the group of warriors and helmed horror s . Followers of Iachtu Xvim were also accepted within the ranks .
description_long: Knights of the Black Gauntlet The Knights of the Black Gauntlet were a group of over 7000 banite crusaders who kept their faith , even after Bane ' s death at the hands of Torm during the Time of Troubles . The Knights were led by Teldorn Darkhope , a mad priest of Bane who led the group of warriors and helmed horror s . Followers of Iachtu Xvim were also accepted within the ranks . In 1369 DR the Knights invaded and conquered the city of Mintar . Teldorn fostered a strong alliance with the Zhentarim . With their assistance , Teldorn hoped to spread the word of Bane by conquering the Lake of Steam region after first retrieving the magical items that he hoped to find underneath Kzelter . Apart from Kzelter , commands were awaited from Fzoul Chembryl for the go - ahead to invade other nearby places .

title: Knights of the Bleeding Shield
description: Knights of the Bleeding Shield The Knights of the Bleeding Shield were a knightly order devoted to the Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . History . Around 1265 DR , Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced the Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith , and declared them degenerate , mentally ill heretics .
description_long: Knights of the Bleeding Shield The Knights of the Bleeding Shield were a knightly order devoted to the Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . History . Around 1265 DR , Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced the Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith , and declared them degenerate , mentally ill heretics . The Mussum priests and the Companions of the Noble Heart attacked Waelarn and his followers , labeling them " false clerics " and " subverted by evil " . An angry Waelarn summoned the Knights of the Bleeding Shield , as well as the Holy Warriors of Suffering and the Order of the Golden Cup , to his side and vowed holy war against the " unclean ones of Mussum " and their allies . The war saw the violent clashes of Holy Hill Farm in 1266 DR and Bronsheir ' s Charge and Weeping Rock in 1267 DR .

title: Knights of the Merciful Sword
description: Knights of the Merciful Sword The Knights of the Merciful Sword were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the " good " tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of Holy Judgment , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .
description_long: Knights of the Merciful Sword The Knights of the Merciful Sword were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the " good " tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of Holy Judgment , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .

title: Knights of the Mystic Fire
description: Knights of the Mystic Fire The Knights of the Mystic Fire was an order of paladin s dedicated to Mystra , goddess of magic . A member of the order was known as a Mystic Fire Knight . Organization .
description_long: Knights of the Mystic Fire The Knights of the Mystic Fire was an order of paladin s dedicated to Mystra , goddess of magic . A member of the order was known as a Mystic Fire Knight . Organization . The Knights of the Mystic Fire were sponsored by the church of Mystra . They were closely allied with , or even a parent organization to , the Order of the Shooting Star . The number of members in the order was at least five hundred . However , they worked in small groups ; it was rare to find more than a dozen in any one place . Activities . The Mystic Fire Knights regularly joined priests of Mystra on missions to find and uncover lost stores of ancient magic . They also served as guardians at large Mystran temples and at magical workshops , usually as leaders of regular defenders . Powers . Mystra granted divine magic to the paladins of the order . However , they also studied arcane magic , and the paladins could train freely as wizard s . They could even double as guild wizards of Waterdeep . As such , the Mystic Fire Knights had a closer affinity with arcane magic , potentially being able to cast arcane spell s and having an increased capacity for magic .

title: Knights of the North
description: Knights of the North The Knights of the North are a semi - secret group of adventurers and soldiers from the Moonsea who are dedicated to the destruction of the Zhentarim . Through various hit - and - run tactics and relative secrecy of their identities , the Knights disrupt Zhent trade and attempts to foil their plots and machinations at every turn . History .
description_long: Knights of the North The Knights of the North are a semi - secret group of adventurers and soldiers from the Moonsea who are dedicated to the destruction of the Zhentarim . Through various hit - and - run tactics and relative secrecy of their identities , the Knights disrupt Zhent trade and attempts to foil their plots and machinations at every turn . History . In 1355 DR , Zhentarim forces from Zhentil Keep attacked the then - united Moonsea forces of the Citadel of the Raven in an event which would shape the founding of the Knights of the North . While the main army of the Citadel , led by Galauntar Hawkhelm , were engaging a horde of orc s in battle , Zhent spies and wizard s attacked the defenseless Citadel with poison and magic , claiming the fortress for their own . As the Citadel forces battled the horde , they were soon forced to retreat , returning to their home in which they were routed and shut out . With the orc horde approaching and the Zhentarim waiting at the Citadel , Galauntar took the remainder of his forces into the mountains and in hiding , though he would die from the wounds he received in battle .

title: Knights of the Shield
description: Knights of the Shield The Knights of the Shield are expert wielders and manipulators of information who pose as a group of merchants and nobles interested in mercantile activities . Though they are based primarily in Baldur ' s Gate , Amn and Tethyr , the realm of influence of the Knights reach from Calimshan to Waterdeep , though they have little influence in the latter anymore thanks to a failed coup against the Lords of Waterdeep . The Knights of the Shield were a secret society , said to have worked for the archdevil - turned - deity , Gargauth .
description_long: Knights of the Shield The Knights of the Shield are expert wielders and manipulators of information who pose as a group of merchants and nobles interested in mercantile activities . Though they are based primarily in Baldur ' s Gate , Amn and Tethyr , the realm of influence of the Knights reach from Calimshan to Waterdeep , though they have little influence in the latter anymore thanks to a failed coup against the Lords of Waterdeep . The Knights of the Shield were a secret society , said to have worked for the archdevil - turned - deity , Gargauth . History . The Knights of the Shield were originally founded in the time of the Tyrant Eye Wars in - 170 DR for gathered exceptional minds for defend the kingdom of Tethyr ; they adopted this name from the legendary Shield of Silvam , a magic artifact supposedly created by the wizard Bardson - Ithal . After three thousand years and the disappearance of the magic shield the order was officially disbanded when his members were falsely accused of the murder of the king Leodom IV .

title: Knights of the Unicorn
description: Knights of the Unicorn The Knights of the Unicorn was both a mercenary company and an adventuring party around 1358 DR . History . The Knights originated as an adventuring party in the Sword Coast .
description_long: Knights of the Unicorn The Knights of the Unicorn was both a mercenary company and an adventuring party around 1358 DR . History . The Knights originated as an adventuring party in the Sword Coast . Recently by 1358 DR , to defeat a heavily defended pirate stronghold , they gathered a small mercenary unit . They won and decided to continue to act as a mercenary group but always with the approach of an adventuring party .

title: Knock
description: Knock Knock was a transmutation spell that could open locked , barred , or stuck doors with only the spoken word . Cleric s who had access to the greed domain could also cast this spell as a divine power . " Knock " was one of the spells granted to the wearer of the commander ' s ring s worn by the leaders of the War Wizards of Cormyr .
description_long: Knock Knock was a transmutation spell that could open locked , barred , or stuck doors with only the spoken word . Cleric s who had access to the greed domain could also cast this spell as a divine power . " Knock " was one of the spells granted to the wearer of the commander ' s ring s worn by the leaders of the War Wizards of Cormyr . It was also a power of a rod of displacement , which was a magical item from Myth Drannor , or of a staff of open doors or a staff of the magi . The spell had a reverse form called lock . Effects . This spell would instantaneously unlock or unstick a number of doors within a range of at least 100 feet , depending on the power of the spellcaster . Bars holding doors shut would be lifted , and padlocks closing an item would become unlocked . Secret doors could be unlocked as well , but they still had to be found to be passed through . Magical locks could be unlocked — unless they had been protected by the " secure " spell — but they would relock after ten minutes . The spell had a number of limitations . It only affected doors , boxes , or chests or other such things that could be opened .

title: Know bloodline
description: Know bloodline Know bloodline is a divination spell available to cleric s . By casting this spell a cleric was able to determine the ancestry and racial type of the target . History .
description_long: Know bloodline Know bloodline is a divination spell available to cleric s . By casting this spell a cleric was able to determine the ancestry and racial type of the target . History . Know bloodline was commonly used by Mulhorandi priests to determine the worthiness of Mulan humans following the path to becoming a glorious servitor .

title: Know customs
description: Know customs Know customs was a divination spell that allowed the caster to acquire knowledge about local laws and customs from a local resident . Effects . The caster had to be within 30 yd ( 27 m ) of a person who had the knowledge being sought .
description_long: Know customs Know customs was a divination spell that allowed the caster to acquire knowledge about local laws and customs from a local resident . Effects . The caster had to be within 30 yd ( 27 m ) of a person who had the knowledge being sought . The person could be asleep or unconscious , but not an infant , insane , or dead . If the target did not resist the spell , the caster gained general knowledge of how to navigate the social waters of the tribe , village , town , or settlement to which the target belonged . In addition to local laws , customs , and the practice of etiquette , the caster could learn about important festivals or holy days , and specific but widely known things like the password to tell the guards at the main entrance to a city . After successfully gleaning local knowledge , the caster was granted a slightly more favorable reaction by any indigenous people encountered . Components . This spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Know direction
description: Know direction Know direction was a divination spell that allowed the caster to immediately know which direction was north . Effects . This spell worked in any environment ( underground , underwater , in " darkness " , etc .
description_long: Know direction Know direction was a divination spell that allowed the caster to immediately know which direction was north . Effects . This spell worked in any environment ( underground , underwater , in " darkness " , etc . ) that had a distinguishable north direction . Infinite or self - contained planes might not have a north , for example . Components . The cantrip / orison version of this spell required only verbal and somatic components to cast . The older version required a scrap of parchment from a 100 - year old ( or more ) map .

title: Know school
description: Know school Know School was a divination spell known to the magic - using community in Faerûn . Effects . By means of this spell , a curious mage could find out the school another wizard specialized in , if any .
description_long: Know school Know School was a divination spell known to the magic - using community in Faerûn . Effects . By means of this spell , a curious mage could find out the school another wizard specialized in , if any . This was mainly used to determine if a spell caster was a bone fide representative of , or expert in , his or her school of magic . Nothing was learned if the target was not a specialist in their school , or was a priest , or had no spell casting ability . This spell could be cast on a subject without them noticing , but most mages would be offended if they found out they were being spied upon . Components . Verbal and somatic components were necessary , as well as a small tube made of paper or vellum .

title: Knower of Names
description: Knower of Names The Knower of Names , has knowledge of all . After seducing her , Mephistopheles used her to expose the treacherous nature of the devil generals who served him . He then bound each of them beneath the ice of Cania and imprisoned the Knower to protect himself from the power of his true name .
description_long: Knower of Names The Knower of Names , has knowledge of all . After seducing her , Mephistopheles used her to expose the treacherous nature of the devil generals who served him . He then bound each of them beneath the ice of Cania and imprisoned the Knower to protect himself from the power of his true name . The Knower can reveal the true name of several major characters , including the protagonist and their henchmen ( the protagonist ' s name being based on their alignment ) . In order to learn Mephistopheles ' s true name , the protagonist must ask for the Knower ' s true name first ( Pyreshi the Knower ) .

title: Knowledge domain
description: Knowledge domain The Knowledge domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the field of knowledge . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Knowledge Domain Spells .
description_long: Knowledge domain The Knowledge domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the field of knowledge . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Knowledge Domain Spells . During the latter part of the Era of Upheaval , priests who chose this domain had access to the following spells as they advanced in level . After the Second Sundering , clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Knox
description: Knox Sergeant Knox was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR , serving as officer in the army of Lord Dagult Neverember . He together with warlock Makos and a female cleric defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . He was one of the first to meet a new adventurer arriving in the city .
description_long: Knox Sergeant Knox was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR , serving as officer in the army of Lord Dagult Neverember . He together with warlock Makos and a female cleric defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . He was one of the first to meet a new adventurer arriving in the city . Knox assigned to the new adventurer many missions in defense of the city against its various enemies . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Makos and Knox are the first named characters to appear in the Neverwinter four - part cinematic trailer " The Siege of Neverwinter " and one of the first characters the player meets at the entrance of the city . Knox is the first quest - giver the player meets in the game and an important NPC for all of the First Act .

title: Ko Dun Kin
description: Ko Dun Kin Ko Dun Kin was a Shou merchant in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Ko Dun Kin was a merchant , representative of the mercantile Ko clan in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .
description_long: Ko Dun Kin Ko Dun Kin was a Shou merchant in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Ko Dun Kin was a merchant , representative of the mercantile Ko clan in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung . In 1358 DR , he welcomed his cousin Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San . He helped them with their journey to H ' sin - to , at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River . Possibly they were attacked by Dragon Claw followers trying to scare Ko Dun Kin .

title: Ko Ho San
description: Ko Ho San Ko Ho San was a powerful Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko Ho San was a member of mercantile Ko clan and a powerful wu jen .
description_long: Ko Ho San Ko Ho San was a powerful Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko Ho San was a member of mercantile Ko clan and a powerful wu jen . He was said once to had buried an entire town in a mudslide for a offense by the mayor s son to a Ko grandniece . In 1358 after one of his brothers Ko Lei Kho , governor of Akari island , told him about the menace of the Opawang defeated the year before he started investigating about the Black Leopard Cult together with his grandson Ko La Ko . Thank to a suggestion of La Ko , Ho San individuated as central spot H sin - to , at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River in T ' u Lung . So he hired some adventurers to accompany Ko La Ko to there in order to investigate . Personality . Ko Ho San was kindly and polite to a fault person unless people crossed his path

title: Ko La Ko
description: Ko La Ko Ko La Ko was a promising Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko La Ko was a young member of mercantile Ko clan ; sensing his talent his grandfather the great wu jen Ko Ho San took him as apprentice .
description_long: Ko La Ko Ko La Ko was a promising Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko La Ko was a young member of mercantile Ko clan ; sensing his talent his grandfather the great wu jen Ko Ho San took him as apprentice . Together with Ho San he investigated about the Black Leopard Cult . Together with some adventurers hired by Ko Ho San he went to search in H sin - to , at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River in T ' u Lung . During travel they met Monkey in his traveling island that offered them to teach his own martial style In T ' u Lung they fought and defeated the Dragon Claw . As reward the Monkey offered them to become their monk disciple and Ko La Ko ready accepted , wending to new adventures with his new master . Personality . Ko La Ko was a kindly individual that had not yet expose his true potential . He was unfit to merchant life .

title: Ko Lei Kho
description: Ko Lei Kho Ko Lei Kho was the shou governor of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Lei Kho was a member of mercantile Ko clan that led the first colony in Akari .
description_long: Ko Lei Kho Ko Lei Kho was the shou governor of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Lei Kho was a member of mercantile Ko clan that led the first colony in Akari . He ruled from Tai Ko town . The colony prospered until in 1357 the settlers started to being terrorized by ochimo . He asked help to his clan and Ko Mei Kho send him an adventuring party to resolve the matter . Personality . Lei Kho was always suspicious of all , modest and self - effacing .

title: Ko Mei Kho
description: Ko Mei Kho Ko Mei Kho was a shou merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mei Kho was a merchant , rappresentative of mercantile Ko clan in a town of Kozakura .
description_long: Ko Mei Kho Ko Mei Kho was a shou merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mei Kho was a merchant , rappresentative of mercantile Ko clan in a town of Kozakura . In 1357 under request of his cousin the colonial governor at Akari , Ko Lei Kho , he hired an adventuring party to investigate about an ochimo in Akari . Personality . Mei Kho was honest to the point of tactlessness , like tradition in Ko clan , and honored any agreement struck .

title: Ko Mihn Gi
description: Ko Mihn Gi Ko Mihn Gi was a Shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mihn Gi was a member of the mercantile Ko clan , the younger brother of Ko Lei Kho .
description_long: Ko Mihn Gi Ko Mihn Gi was a Shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mihn Gi was a member of the mercantile Ko clan , the younger brother of Ko Lei Kho . He was mayor of the town of Shu Lan . Personality . Mihn Gi thought that Lei Kho was confronting the ochimo treat too mildly but family loyalty prevented him from protesting .

title: Kobold
description: Kobold Kobolds are aggressive , inward , yet industrious small humanoid creatures . They are noted for their skill at building traps and preparing ambushes , and mining . Kobolds are distantly related to dragons and urd s and are often found serving the former as minions .
description_long: Kobold Kobolds are aggressive , inward , yet industrious small humanoid creatures . They are noted for their skill at building traps and preparing ambushes , and mining . Kobolds are distantly related to dragons and urd s and are often found serving the former as minions . Physical description . Kobolds are reptilian humanoids . A kobold stands between 2 ' and 2 ' 6 " ( 60cm – 75cm ) tall , weighing 35 to 45 pounds ( 16 – 20kg ) . They have skin between reddish brown and black in color , with burnt orange to red eyes . Their legs are sinewy and digitigrade . They have long , clawed fingers and a jaw like a crocodile . Small white or tan horns protrude from their head , and they have rat - like tails . Kobolds smell of wet dog and stagnant water . They like to wear red or orange garments , which are usually ragged . Culture . Kobolds live in the dark , ideally underground or thick forest , in tribal societies . Their lairs are often overcrowded , although when one tribe becomes too numerous , it splits . The overcrowding has eliminated the concept of privacy , so kobolds sleep in communal areas , and nudity is not regarded as shameful or offensive , even to the opposite sex .

title: Koda Yoshiuji
description: Koda Yoshiuji Koda Yoshiuji was a samurai who ran a posthouse or waystation in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . It was a very unhealthy posthouse .
description_long: Koda Yoshiuji Koda Yoshiuji was a samurai who ran a posthouse or waystation in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . It was a very unhealthy posthouse . He led the posthouse with two servants . Personality . Koda fell from grace and was sent to the posthouse , a place to send people out of favor , because he was a fanatical supporter of the Igi clan .

title: Kogi
description: Kogi Kogi was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kogi was a good instructor at the monastery .
description_long: Kogi Kogi was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kogi was a good instructor at the monastery . Often he secretly went out with his friend Bupposo . History . Kogi and his friend Bupposo elaborated a good prank against Tsuyoi - no - kami monks : they payed Ichi the Korobokuru yakuza to find a girl that can seduce the rival monks . So the young maiden O - Shino , acting under the orders of monks temped Anchin and Kaian Personality . Kogi like his instructor ' s task . Kogi was easy guy , friendly to all who meet him . He known that his irresistible taste for mischief failed him as monk and lamented that it will keep him from reaching spiritual perfection but also made life more interesting . He not care for his spirit heritage

title: Koguryo
description: Koguryo Koguryo was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a province of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Koguryo lay in the south - western " toe " of the boot - like shape of the Koryo Peninsula , centered around the Ziyero Ridge .
description_long: Koguryo Koguryo was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a province of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Koguryo lay in the south - western " toe " of the boot - like shape of the Koryo Peninsula , centered around the Ziyero Ridge . It was bordered in the north - east along the Tumen River by the kingdom of Silla and flanked on both sides of the peninsula by the Straits of Koryo and the Dragon ' s Teeth straits . Sites within Koguryo were the Dang Caverns , Naktong Moors , and the Tumen River and Ziyero Ridge . Locations . The kingdom included the city of Pyong Do . The later province of Koguryo included the settlements of Ansong , Konang Pen , Mo ' ki , Ojy - do , Paektu - san , Pan , Pyong Do , and Taiku . History . A famed general of Koguryo named Huat Rhu once led his soldiers on an expedition into the Naktong Moors . They never returned . By the 14th century DR , it was rumored they still wandered the moors , now as peat mummies and zombies hunting for fresh blood . In the early 14th century , the rival kingdom of Silla was at war with Koguyro , under the then king of Silla .

title: Koh Nur
description: Koh Nur Koh Nur , or the Mountain of Light , was a giant opal kept in the heart of the Great Khan ' s palace in the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Description . The light emitted from Koh Nur was the method of timekeeping with the Sevenfold Mazework and the entire expanse of the Great Dismal Delve .
description_long: Koh Nur Koh Nur , or the Mountain of Light , was a giant opal kept in the heart of the Great Khan ' s palace in the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Description . The light emitted from Koh Nur was the method of timekeeping with the Sevenfold Mazework and the entire expanse of the Great Dismal Delve . The light also illuminated the entire area . Twice a day Koh Nur would change color , from light orange to rich purple . The beginning of morning was marked by the orange light trickling from the Mountain of Light and lasted for approximately 13 hours , at which point the light changed to purple and lasted for the same amount of time . All light from Koh Nur was reflected from other strategically placed gemstones located throughout the entire region of the Great Dismal Delve , synchronizing the entire dao nation on the same time schedule . Rumors and Legends . Tampering with or destroying one of the gemstones reflecting light from Koh Nur was punishable by a fine a 500 gp and a year of servitude to the Great Khan .

title: Koja
description: Koja Koja was a human man and a lama of Khazari . He became advisor to Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde . History .
description_long: Koja Koja was a human man and a lama of Khazari . He became advisor to Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde . History . Early life . He came from Khazari and served as a lama at the Red Mountain Temple . Tuigan Horde . Koja was chosen to be Khazari ' s emissary to Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde , but betrayed his nation when Yamun offered him the position of Grand Historian to the Tuigan Empire . Although he was forsaken by his god for this act , he served loyally and ably as one of the Khahan ' s major advisers , even while the Tuigan conquered his homeland . There , he advised that Jadaran , Yamun ' s son , be appointed governor of Alashan . During the Tuigan invasion of Shou Lung , Koja was the only historian with Yamun . He recommended that the renegade Shou General Batu Min Ho seek a position as one of Yamun ' s advisors . While they were staying with the Tuigan , Koja advised the adventurers who would later destroy Solon on Tuigan customs . He also stated that to truly defeat Tan Chin , they would require the " Stone Scepter of Shih " and recommended that if they wanted more information they should go to the Red Mountain Monastery .

title: Koje
description: Koje Koje was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the eastern side of Kang Bay . History .
description_long: Koje Koje was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the eastern side of Kang Bay . History . A giant dragon turtle once threatened Koje , before Xax Chung saved the city . He also slew the tengu Kwi ' asp and tamed the witch Zartalla . Around 1357 DR , some twenty townsfolk were healed by a wandering shukenja . Although the healer did not give their name , the people erected a monument in thanks regardless . Locations . Merquam Pang , one of the most prosperous merchants of Koryo , who lived in Xi Hulang , owned a shop in Koje . It was heavily guarded by his hirelings . A prominent local landmark was Jisziat ' s tower . Xax worked to have the tower cast to the ground . Notable inhabitants . The warrior Xax Chung was feted as the " hero of Koje " for his efforts in protecting the people of the city . He lived at a large ranch about 1 mile ( 1 . 6 km ) north of Koje with his family .

title: Kola bint Fayala
description: Kola bint Fayala Kola bint Fayala was a retired thief and locksmith who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Kola was a young gnome who had a harassed look about her .
description_long: Kola bint Fayala Kola bint Fayala was a retired thief and locksmith who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Kola was a young gnome who had a harassed look about her . Activities . Kola setup up shop in the Warehouse District where she made locks that the wealthy merchants used for both their homes and places of business . Kola made mundane locks , but also used her magical abilities to craft special locks . One of her favorites yelled the word " Thief ! " twelve times if the lock was ever opened without using the key . Another of her styles was equipped with spring - loaded needles that could be poisoned . One of her locks was so mechanically complex that all but the most skilled thieves were unable to open it . Lastly , she made a lock that did not have a keyhole , opening only when the correct command word was spoken .

title: Kolbaz
description: Kolbaz Kolbaz was an old and cantankerous mage and a member of the Harpers in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Kolbaz lived in a villa owned by the Harpers in Yartar .
description_long: Kolbaz Kolbaz was an old and cantankerous mage and a member of the Harpers in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Kolbaz lived in a villa owned by the Harpers in Yartar . His duty was to protect one of " teleportation circle s " of Krowen Valharrow ' s network . He always cast a " hallucinatory terrain " spell in order to frighten away strangers .

title: Komar al - Anni
description: Komar al - Anni Komar al - Anni was a historical inhabitant of Zakhara . History . Komar bravely sacrificed his life to save a group of pilgrim ' s from a group of bloodthirsty jann .
description_long: Komar al - Anni Komar al - Anni was a historical inhabitant of Zakhara . History . Komar bravely sacrificed his life to save a group of pilgrim ' s from a group of bloodthirsty jann . After his death , the Shrine of the Brave was erected along the Pilgrims ' Route to honor his memory . Rumors and Legends . Komar ' s spirit was said to send useful visions to warriors who stayed at the shrine , offering valuable advice on future battles .

title: Komite
description: Komite The Komite , or Imperial Tournament was a martial arts tournament held in Shou Lung . Reputation . For many martial artists , the Komite was the supreme contest , allowing them to confront the greatest fighters in all styles from across the empire and abroad .
description_long: Komite The Komite , or Imperial Tournament was a martial arts tournament held in Shou Lung . Reputation . For many martial artists , the Komite was the supreme contest , allowing them to confront the greatest fighters in all styles from across the empire and abroad . They competed in the Komite for the challenge , glory , and honor . The Komite received thousands of competitors , but only a very select group , a few dozen at most , could really expect to win , and only one would see success . The champion and immediate runners - up were famed across Kara - Tur . People heaped praises upon them , poets would write about their courage and skill , temples and schools would welcome them , and they would receive respect everywhere . This honor and prestige spread to their families , friends , schools , teachers , fellow students , and so on . Such prestige was more sought after than the prize money , 2 , 000 ch ' ien . Rules . Fighting to the death was not required , participants could surrender or forfeit any time , but all the same , many contestants perished . Location .

title: Konang Pen
description: Konang Pen Konang Pen was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It stood west of the Tumen River and east of the Naktong Moors . Industry .
description_long: Konang Pen Konang Pen was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It stood west of the Tumen River and east of the Naktong Moors . Industry . The people of Konang Pen dug peat from the perilous Naktong Moors . History . In 1357 DR , a great fire struck Konang Pen , razing large parts of the city . Desperate to rebuild important structures such a defences , housing , and storage facilities , the city authorities pressed even travellers passing into the reconstruction effort .

title: Konigheim
description: Konigheim Konigheim , one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East , was a country located between Doegan , the Kingdom of Nix , and the Land of the Yak - Men . The town of Vanesci Hamlet lay in eastern Konigheim , lying upriver of the main part of the kingdom . Beyond it , the Phantom Pass led to the Kingdom of Nix .
description_long: Konigheim Konigheim , one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East , was a country located between Doegan , the Kingdom of Nix , and the Land of the Yak - Men . The town of Vanesci Hamlet lay in eastern Konigheim , lying upriver of the main part of the kingdom . Beyond it , the Phantom Pass led to the Kingdom of Nix .

title: Konishi Ieyasu
description: Konishi Ieyasu Konishi Ieyasu was the head of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ieyasu lived in Dojyu as a bushi named Kumorigawa Ieyasu who had retired from service to a korobokuru lord in distant Haso Province , but in truth he led the deathliest ninja clan in Kozakura .
description_long: Konishi Ieyasu Konishi Ieyasu was the head of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ieyasu lived in Dojyu as a bushi named Kumorigawa Ieyasu who had retired from service to a korobokuru lord in distant Haso Province , but in truth he led the deathliest ninja clan in Kozakura . Ieyasu , despite his age preventing him from acting himself , planned and supervised the most sensitive assignments undertaken by his ninja , while his youngest daughter , Konishi Seichi , oversaw all other family business . His presumed korobokuru ties allowed the ninja family to maintain a stance of neutrality in local politics , and ensured that bushi of " better breeding " payed little attention to their affairs .

title: Konishi Seichi
description: Konishi Seichi Konishi Seichi was a member of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Seichi lived in Dojyu as a wu jen named Kumorigawa Seichi with her father Konishi Ieyasu .
description_long: Konishi Seichi Konishi Seichi was a member of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Seichi lived in Dojyu as a wu jen named Kumorigawa Seichi with her father Konishi Ieyasu . She acted as main lieutenant of her father during the ninja missions . Seichi was one of the few to knew about the Iridescent Peacock Society even though she is not a member . Often she was away from Dojyu perfuming some ninja missions . Personality . Seichi was authoritative and ruthless . Also she had a sadistic vein during interrogations .

title: Kor
description: Kor Kor was the god of wisdom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached that wisdom stemmed from age , and wisdom brought strength . Kor ' s symbol was a sunburst .
description_long: Kor Kor was the god of wisdom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached that wisdom stemmed from age , and wisdom brought strength . Kor ' s symbol was a sunburst . In parables he was described as an old and grey - haired but strong man , whose advice was sought by gods and mortals alike . Like other Zakharan gods he was above such concerns as alignment , as wisdom was sought by an altruistic healer as well as by an evil leader of holy slayer s . His faith placed value in stability , order and tradition . Seeking the advice of one ' s elders and learning from one ' s mistakes were very important to his followers . Old Kor was mainly venerated by ethoist s . Centers of his worship were the cities of Dihliz , Halwa , Huzuz , Jumlat , Liham , Muluk , Qadib , Rog ' osto , Umara and Wasat . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Kora Shan
description: Kora Shan The Kora Shan was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Starting at the edge of the Quoya Desert , and ending just before reaching the Hagga Shan , the Kora Shan was a narrow range of mountains that cut the central Hordelands in two .
description_long: Kora Shan The Kora Shan was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Starting at the edge of the Quoya Desert , and ending just before reaching the Hagga Shan , the Kora Shan was a narrow range of mountains that cut the central Hordelands in two . The mountains featured greatly in the history and legends of the nomadic tribes of the steppe , as they divided the tribes as they did the lands . A number of oases and springs were located along the base of the range , and served as battlefields for a number of raids and wars between the tribes who used them .

title: Koraboros
description: Koraboros Koraboros is a pit fiend who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when Baalbisan convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven . Once he returned to Baator , Koraboros began to plot revenge upon Jerro for imprisoning him .
description_long: Koraboros Koraboros is a pit fiend who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when Baalbisan convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven . Once he returned to Baator , Koraboros began to plot revenge upon Jerro for imprisoning him . Eventually he was able to lure Jerro to the ruined farm his granddaughter Shandra had once owned . Koraboros appeared before Jerro and attacked him , but Jerro was able to overcome the pit fiend with the assistance of his new found ally , the Kalach - Cha . The Kalach - Cha later journeyed to the academy of shapers and binders in Thay , where 2 pit fiends , Oronock and Thael ' ka , informed him / her that Koraboros had suffered a painful ' demotion ceremony ' for his failure to defeat Jerro .

title: Korai Anteki
description: Korai Anteki Korai Anteki was a machi - yakko leader in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Anteki was the son of Korai Urushi , a modest rice merchant in Iiso .
description_long: Korai Anteki Korai Anteki was a machi - yakko leader in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Anteki was the son of Korai Urushi , a modest rice merchant in Iiso . However , when Anteki was young , customers mysteriously stopped going to his father ' s shop . Ruined , Urushi sold his business to Osahichiro Yoto , Iiso ' s largest rice trader . Anteki became convinced that the ruining of his father ' s business was a government plot and joined a machi - yakko group . In time , he became the leader of the group thanks to his skills and started a private war against the local businessmen , especially Yoto .

title: Korak
description: Korak Korak was a marginally intelligent and curiously friendly ghoul , who instead of attacking people to devour them , wanted to join Abdel Adrian ' s party and actually helped him on occasion . Appendix . Notes .
description_long: Korak Korak was a marginally intelligent and curiously friendly ghoul , who instead of attacking people to devour them , wanted to join Abdel Adrian ' s party and actually helped him on occasion . Appendix . Notes . In the " Baldur ' s Gate " video game , Korak was called " Korax " . He had somehow been " dire charm ed " into being friendly towards the living . He followed the protagonist until the spell wore out and his hunger for mortal flesh consumed him once more . His status as an undead creature made him invaluable in fighting the nearby basilisk s under the control of Mutamin .

title: Korat Minial
description: Korat Minial Korat Minial owned Lights in the Dark within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Korat ' s shop specialized in offering lamps and lanterns that gave off different colors of light .
description_long: Korat Minial Korat Minial owned Lights in the Dark within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Korat ' s shop specialized in offering lamps and lanterns that gave off different colors of light . He claimed that certain colors complimented different occasions better than others . Whether or not this was true was irrelevant , since it attracted customers and made for interesting conversation . Korat employed two craftsmen who made all of the lamps sold by the store .

title: Korax ( shukenja )
description: Korax ( shukenja ) Korax of Manchar was a human male shukenja and follower of the Way from the town of Manchar in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was a holy man who wandered northern Koryo , and was famous for his kindness . Activities .
description_long: Korax ( shukenja ) Korax of Manchar was a human male shukenja and follower of the Way from the town of Manchar in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was a holy man who wandered northern Koryo , and was famous for his kindness . Activities . Korax commonly wandered the lands of northern Silla in Koryo , between Foo Nakar and Koje , doing his holy work . Known for his great kindness , Korax often healed ill and wounded people whom he encountered , but departed before anyone could thank him . Rarely , he even resurrected a fallen warrior , provided they were of lawful good nature and had died in a battle against evil . King Wanang Sun regularly met with Korax , asking for his sage advice on magic and other matters . Description . Korax was tall and had long silvery hair , which he tied back with a leather thong . He wore the garb of the common folk of Koryo , namely an all - white work smock . Unusually , however , he belted it with an heavy leather girdle , a wide belt worked with colorful dyes and shimmering threads . He also bore a heavy iron ring on his right index finger . Possessions .

title: Korbus Brightjewel
description: Korbus Brightjewel Korbus Brightjewel is the owner and proprieter of Korbus ' s Jewelry and Fine Ornaments in Daggerford . An expert jeweler , Korbus could easily have found work at the higher - class venue of Waterdeep but prefers the life that can only be found in a small town . He is also an expert at identifying all , magical or otherwise .

title: Koresh
description: Koresh Koresh was the leader of a criminal band of mercenaries operating in a desert . Description . Koresh was a tan , dark - haired and dark - bearded man with a prominent nose .
description_long: Koresh Koresh was the leader of a criminal band of mercenaries operating in a desert . Description . Koresh was a tan , dark - haired and dark - bearded man with a prominent nose . He wore black clothing , and a black turban . Personality . Along with his mercenary band , Koresh was willing to trade or steal anything to increase his personal wealth . His ferocity was such that none of his many enemies dared oppose him openly . Possessions . In addition to an assortment of dagger s ( including a " dagger of venom " ) and poison s , Koresh owned a " carpet of flying " , a " sword of wounding " , as well as a pair of " bracers of defense " . Appendix . Background . The artwork for Koresh on the AD & D Trading Card # 558 ( 1991 ) is taken from the cover of the novel " The Parched Sea " , which is set in the Anauroch desert , suggesting Koresh is a Bedine . However , Koresh is not a named character in that novel , and artwork is regularly reused , so it is difficult to say for sure .

title: Korgan Bloodaxe
description: Korgan Bloodaxe Korgan Bloodaxe was an evil dwarf companion of the Bhaalspawn . Gameplay . Korgan is considered one of the best fighters in the game for an evil party , probably even better than Minsc , save for the low intelligence attribute that makes Korgan very susceptible to mind flayers .
description_long: Korgan Bloodaxe Korgan Bloodaxe was an evil dwarf companion of the Bhaalspawn . Gameplay . Korgan is considered one of the best fighters in the game for an evil party , probably even better than Minsc , save for the low intelligence attribute that makes Korgan very susceptible to mind flayers . Korgan ' s uncompassionate ( mildly psychotic ) attitude causes conflicts with good - aligned party members , except for Mazzy , who it seems he has feelings for , making him a difficult ally for those who wish to complete the game as " the good guy . " Found as a mercenary in the Slums District , Korgan has a quest involving obtaining the " Book of Kaza " from the Graveyard District and follows the player character indefinitely after completing it . Voice acting . Korgan is voiced by in " . " Quotes . " Let ' s see what yer guts be lookin ' like ! " " Aye , now this be more like it ! The first t ' disobey me orders gets an axe in their skull . " " Be aware , Mazzy , I ' ve something long , hard and low to the ground ye ' re free to touch and fondle . Child , no need to glare ! ' Twas me axe I were referring to . " " Well , that ' s one fine mess that I done cleaned up .

title: Kori
description: Kori Kori was a barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Kori had black hair and walked with a limp .
description_long: Kori Kori was a barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Kori had black hair and walked with a limp . Activities . Kori was the wife of Jorid and helped him run the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth , a village in northeastern Tethyr . She had a special relationship with all animals but disliked malcontent patrons , whom she always pitched out of the door . History . Kori was an adventurer during her youth . On Uktar 10 , 1370 DR , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered her husband ' s taproom , seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . When Bramas Thorntree accused some of the other patrons of stealing it , this triggered a tavern brawl . Kori was one of the ones who tried to separate and calm the brawlers .

title: Korial Quintara
description: Korial Quintara Korial Quintara was a captain in Maztica . Personality . Quintara was a quiet old man .
description_long: Korial Quintara Korial Quintara was a captain in Maztica . Personality . Quintara was a quiet old man . Possessions . In battle , Korial wielded a longsword . History . Quintara was the captain of the " Helm ' s Choice " , a small cog sailing from Helmsport to other places in Maztica . In 1362 DR , he transported the adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume , Ironspike , and Hasoctl .

title: Korienna Redarm
description: Korienna Redarm Korienna Redarm was a human female bandit leader in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . She was originally an officer , as indicated by her full plate armor and shield , but deserted the Army and chose a lawless life . She led a small band of about a dozen other deserters and they marauded up and down the South Road between Eshpurta and Hillfort Keshla , and perhaps beyond , attacking travelers and stealing their horses and other valuables .
description_long: Korienna Redarm Korienna Redarm was a human female bandit leader in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Possessions . Korienna was known to carry " Mordemar " , a magic longsword that was particularly good against undead creatures . It was a gift from her grandfather .

title: Koril Benshay
description: Koril Benshay Koril Benshay was a captain of the Freedom Riders of Daggerdale in 1369 DR . He was a good friend of fellow captain Ariton Delmis and when Koril was captured just before the decisive battle in Dagger Falls , Ariton tasked adventurers he had recruited to free Randal Morn to also enter Zhent headquarters and liberate Koril .

title: Korinn Archipelago
description: Korinn Archipelago The Korinn Archipelago was a chain of islands at the northernmost region of the Moonshae Isles and home primarily to humanoids such as orcs and goblins . Travel amongst the islets of the area wasn ' t easy due to rough water and reefs . Notable Locations .
description_long: Korinn Archipelago The Korinn Archipelago was a chain of islands at the northernmost region of the Moonshae Isles and home primarily to humanoids such as orcs and goblins . Travel amongst the islets of the area wasn ' t easy due to rough water and reefs . Notable Locations . Jacaman . The largest and most populous of the islands . As of 1479 DR the isle was ruled by a disguised devil known as Roquern . He enslaved creatures and forced them to work on his spice plantations . Pandira . One of the northernmost isles , Pandira was best known as a haven for pirates . Appendix . Notes . The Korinn Archipelago was a region featured in the D & D module " Treasure Hunt " . What made this module unique from most others was that the characters started at zeroth level . Special game rules were developed to reflect this transition from ordinary folks into heroes . Unlike other " Forgotten Realms " modules , this one did not bear the " Forgotten Realms " logo , having preceded the release of the original campaign setting .

title: Korkan
description: Korkan Korkan was a hobgoblin slave in Szith Morcane . History . Korkan was the head slave in the noble house led by Rilira .
description_long: Korkan Korkan was a hobgoblin slave in Szith Morcane . History . Korkan was the head slave in the noble house led by Rilira . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after the fire giant s occupied the outpost , Korkan and all the goblinoid s were seen as the lowest - ranked slaves . This greatly enraged Korkan .

title: Kormoroth
description: Kormoroth Kormoroth of Westgate was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Kormoroth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I .
description_long: Kormoroth Kormoroth of Westgate was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Kormoroth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I . He was supported by a Westgate - aligned cabal . He and his minions attacked the mansion of his rival Andranth Glarvreth but in the fighting the bodyguard Burrath killed Kormoroth .

title: Kornah
description: Kornah Kornah " The Crazy " is a member of the Harpers who poses as a crazed guide of Zhentil Keep . Home . Kornah ' s house , in keeping with her disguise , is a disheveled mess .
description_long: Kornah Kornah " The Crazy " is a member of the Harpers who poses as a crazed guide of Zhentil Keep . Home . Kornah ' s house , in keeping with her disguise , is a disheveled mess . This is all for appearances , though , as it in actuality serves as a safehouse for any Harpers in the region .

title: Kornerupine
description: Kornerupine Kornerupine was a rare fancy stone usually found in stream beds , eskers , or ridge - pit gravel . Description . Kornerupine came in green or brown translucent crystals that were hard and yielded solid faceted gems up to medium size .
description_long: Kornerupine Kornerupine was a rare fancy stone usually found in stream beds , eskers , or ridge - pit gravel . Description . Kornerupine came in green or brown translucent crystals that were hard and yielded solid faceted gems up to medium size . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . The green variety of kornerupine had a most unusual magical ability to record sounds . When all but the last word of a " magic mouth " spell was cast upon one of these gemstones , the kornerupine became primed to record . It would remain in this state indefinitely until the the caster touched the gem and spoke the last word of the incantation . Instead of a " magic mouth " appearing , the gemstone recorded all audible sounds within 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) for the next four minutes . This audible archive was permanently stored in the gemstone and could not be removed , altered , or silenced without destroying the gem , but could be played back on demand an unlimited number of times .

title: Korobokuru
description: Korobokuru Korobokuru were dwarf - like humanoids who lived in the barren lands of Kara - Tur , away from people and civilization . Society . They lived in small villages and engaged in hunting and farming .
description_long: Korobokuru Korobokuru were dwarf - like humanoids who lived in the barren lands of Kara - Tur , away from people and civilization . Society . They lived in small villages and engaged in hunting and farming . Most korobokuru tried to avoid other races , but there were rare korobokuru travelers . Personality . The people of Kara - Tur had a pretty poor opinion of the tribes of korobokuru , assuming they were wild , rude , and boastful . Typically , this stereotype , while sometimes true , was mostly wrong . Korubokuru didn ' t like it when someone said bad things about their society . Most korobokuru did not even leave their village . Korobokuru usually told stories around the campfire about other people and they gathered treasures in their daily lives . Description . Korobokoru usually reached about 4 ft ( 120 cm ) in height , while their hands and legs were disproportional to their bodies . They were usually bowlegged and had big blue - , green - , or brown - colored eyes . Their ears and noses were small , with large round nostrils . Most often , they had thick blond or light brown hair and males also grew small beards .

title: Korock
description: Korock Korock was an orc warrior during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Korock was guiding a contingent of troops .
description_long: Korock Korock was an orc warrior during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Korock was guiding a contingent of troops . Regis used the name of this orc in order to deceive the shamans Kllug and Innanig , who were marching toward Nesmé . He said that Korock had angered their drow allies .

title: Korona Caramitru
description: Korona Caramitru Korona Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Korona was a dour person to the point of being puritanical .
description_long: Korona Caramitru Korona Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Korona was a dour person to the point of being puritanical . Zora Korona had no time for frivolity . She knew her husband and her son had telepathic powers . Family . Korona was the wife of Julios Caramitru , a minor noble working in the city ' s bureaucracy . History . In 1491 DR , she was interrogated about her son Thylius Caramitru .

title: Korr
description: Korr Korr of Ilmater was a knight of Ilmater circa 1363 DR . History . Korr led a company of fifty fellow knights devoted to Ilmater , called simply the Knights of Ilmater .
description_long: Korr Korr of Ilmater was a knight of Ilmater circa 1363 DR . History . Korr led a company of fifty fellow knights devoted to Ilmater , called simply the Knights of Ilmater . They came to Daggerford ' s side and joined its alliance during the Second Dragonspear War . Personality . Korr was practically manic about his faith . He was brave and reckless to the point of being suicidal .

title: Korr Odahn
description: Korr Odahn Korr Odahn was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Whilst crossing the high mountains of the Utter East , Legendary Campaign forces found themselves enveloped in a mysterious fog . As it lifted , they found themselves in Phantom Pass and being threatened with a grisly fate by an angry Korr Odahn , whom they faced in bloodforge battle .
