title: Korred
description: Korred Korreds were fey that resembled small satyrs , and were said to be descended from warped gnome s . They were fun - loving forest - dwellers who valued hair and items that most would consider too mundane to warrant interest . Korreds took great offense about people cutting their hair .
description_long: Korred Korreds were fey that resembled small satyrs , and were said to be descended from warped gnome s . They were fun - loving forest - dwellers who valued hair and items that most would consider too mundane to warrant interest . Korreds took great offense about people cutting their hair . Korreds had grey skin and hooves . Korreds usually worshiped the god Tapann the Undying . Homes . Korreds once dwelt in Brynwood in the Vast , but came into conflict with the local satyrs over territory . In the ensuing strife , both races fell before monstrous creatures . Afterwards , few of the korreds remained .

title: Kortal
description: Kortal King Kortal of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the third king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Kortal was the second son of King Nearel .
description_long: Kortal King Kortal of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the third king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Kortal was the second son of King Nearel . History . Kortal was born in 968 DR and took the throne in 997 DR , the Year of the Fearful Harper . After the deaths of the families of former Bormul King Teremir ' s two oldest sons , who died during reign of his father Nearel , Kortal was left to deal with the remaining daughter of Teremil and her descendants as challengers to his throne . He succeeded at slaying her entire family , with the exception of her grandson Teremir II . King Kortal died in 1022 DR and was followed in line by his cousin Haedrak .

title: Kortolt Rushtyn
description: Kortolt Rushtyn Kortolt Rushtyn was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach , who preached near Hlondeth in the early 1340s DR . History . Kortolt Rushtyn was a young underpriest at the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , " circa " 1342 DR , when he received visions from the god Ilmater directing him to the hidden " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith .
description_long: Kortolt Rushtyn Kortolt Rushtyn was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach , who preached near Hlondeth in the early 1340s DR . History . Kortolt Rushtyn was a young underpriest at the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , " circa " 1342 DR , when he received visions from the god Ilmater directing him to the hidden " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith . However , rather than take it back to Mussum or its traditional home of the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Kortolt took it to Raven ' s Rack , an isolated shrine to the god west of Hlondeth , on Tanarspear Hill . Here , Kortolt made use of the " Tome " to aid both believers and non - believers , and to preach about Ilmater . The people of Hlondeth came to see Kortolt as a gift from the gods , one who kept them safe and well when they were sick or injured . However , in winter of the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , Kortolt was killed by bandits . They attempted to sell the " Tome " in Hlondeth , only to be killed themselves by a mob angry at the death of the much - loved priest .

title: Kortyl Rowanmantle
description: Kortyl Rowanmantle Kortyl Rowanmantle was a knight and a member of the Rowanmantle noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was a brash youth . History .
description_long: Kortyl Rowanmantle Kortyl Rowanmantle was a knight and a member of the Rowanmantle noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was a brash youth . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s . They were on a high meadow north of Startop Crag when the knights impetuously pursued the orcs into an ambush , and a few were killed . Alusair rallied her forces to defeat the orcs and their dark naga master . Afterward , Kortyl teased Brace Skatterhawk over stories he was the illegitimate son of King Azoun IV . He claimed not to be afraid that Alusair might be listening , and lost his nerve when it turned out she was . She pushed him over to much laughter .

title: Koryo
description: Koryo Koryo , formerly known as Choson , was a loose association of three kingdoms all descended from the Han people . The kingdom was ruled by a strong king , the warlord , Wanang Sun . Names & Etymology .
description_long: Koryo Koryo , formerly known as Choson , was a loose association of three kingdoms all descended from the Han people . The kingdom was ruled by a strong king , the warlord , Wanang Sun . Names & Etymology . The land was formerly known as " Choson " , a name that translated to " morning calm " . After King Wanang Sun reformed the Sillan Empire into the Empire of Koryo , the land became known as simply " Koryo " . Language . Koryoans spoke the Koryo language , which descended from the ancient Han language , with many loanwords from Wa - an and Kao te Shou borrowed over centuries . Owing to its similarities with other languages , it was easy to find Koryoan translators for many languages , though few learned Kozauran , owing to enmity between the peoples . Environment & Geography . The land of Koryo stood isolated on the two prongs of the very southern end of the great Koryo Peninsula , which swept down from northeastern Kara - Tur to the rugged islands claimed by Wa and Kozakura . The terrain was rough and mountainous , dominated by the Vorkani Mountains that arced around the end of the peninsula . On the right flank spread the great Quang Muku Forest .

title: Koryo Peninsula
description: Koryo Peninsula The Koryo Peninsula was a large stretch of land in the northeast Kara - Tur . The realm of Koryo lay at its southern end . Geography .
description_long: Koryo Peninsula The Koryo Peninsula was a large stretch of land in the northeast Kara - Tur . The realm of Koryo lay at its southern end . Geography . It was a roughly boot - shaped expanse of land that divided the Yellow Sea from the Eastern Sea . It began northeast of the Ama Basin and circled around the northern shore of the Yellow Sea before extending southwards . The Koryo Peninsula was a rough land with a great mountainous spine running its full length . On either side , between the mountains and the seas , the forests that began in the Ama Basin grew all the way down the peninsula . At the very southern end , the peninsula divided into two prongs , one short , one long , giving the shape of a boot . This area was dominated and defined by the Vorkani Mountains . Between these prongs lay Kang Bay and the Kanko volcano . Breaking away from the end of the Koryo Peninsula were a series of rugged islands formed from extinct volcanos . The biggest were Kozakura and Wa , while the island of Saishu lay north the " toe " of the peninsula . These archipelagoes continued southward back towards central Kara - Tur . Inhabitants .

title: Koryo language
description: Koryo language Koryo was a language spoken by the Koryoan people , inhabitants of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Koryo descended from the ancient Han language , as did Kozakuran and Wa - an , and possibly others . Its vocabulary comprised many words evolved from the old Han tongue , as well as loanwords from Wa - an and Kao te Shou that had been borrowed over centuries .
description_long: Koryo language Koryo was a language spoken by the Koryoan people , inhabitants of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Koryo descended from the ancient Han language , as did Kozakuran and Wa - an , and possibly others . Its vocabulary comprised many words evolved from the old Han tongue , as well as loanwords from Wa - an and Kao te Shou that had been borrowed over centuries . Koryo ' s vocabulary was very different to that of Kozakuran , but its grammar was very similar . Koryo sounded more like Wa - an than Kao te Shou , but it was as simple to use as Shou . Thus most folk of Shou Lung , Wa , and even Kozakura found the Koryo language relatively easy to pick up , and most Koryoans in turn found Kao te Shou , Wa - an , and Kozakuran easy to learn as well . Thus it was easy to find Koryoan translators for many languages , though few learned Kozakuran , owing to enmity between the peoples . The basics of Koryo could be taught in four to six weeks , and fluency could be acquired in three months if one was dedicated .

title: Kossaandar
description: Kossaandar Kossaandar was the lizardfolk war chief of Shadowscale tribe in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Kossaandar war the war leader of the lizardfolk gathered by Ketsarra Shadowscale called Shadowscale tribe .
description_long: Kossaandar Kossaandar was the lizardfolk war chief of Shadowscale tribe in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Kossaandar war the war leader of the lizardfolk gathered by Ketsarra Shadowscale called Shadowscale tribe . Like all his fellow was trasformed in a shadowslain , a kind of Shar undead . For his position he resided in a keep of Plane of Shadow instead of his ancestral home in Vast Swamp . Eventually an adventurers party defeated him and with his death the Shadowsacle tribe crush for good .

title: Kossuth
description: Kossuth Kossuth ( pronounced " koh - SOOTH " ) , or the Lord of Flames is the primordial of elemental fire . Kossuth is symbolized by the holy symbol of a twining red flame and his portfolio covers elemental fire and purification through fire . He is , however , not a true god but actually an elemental primordial , a being whose power rivals that of a true deity .
description_long: Kossuth Kossuth ( pronounced " koh - SOOTH " ) , or the Lord of Flames is the primordial of elemental fire . Kossuth is symbolized by the holy symbol of a twining red flame and his portfolio covers elemental fire and purification through fire . He is , however , not a true god but actually an elemental primordial , a being whose power rivals that of a true deity . Worshipers . The church of Kossuth is rather hierarchical and mostly impersonal . The Church ' s aims tend to revolve around the acquisition of land , power and wealth . The followers and clerics are often of the lawful neutral alignment . Compared to the many other gods of Faerûn , Kossuth and the three other Elemental Primordials are well known for their relative silence when it comes to communication with their worshipers . However , of the four , Kossuth is the most active and vocal . Many Red wizard s of Thay worship Kossuth and the Flaming Brazier of Eltabbar is supposedly the largest temple of Kossuth in all the realms . After death , bodies of worshipers are cremated . Monkish Orders within the Church of Kossuth . Kossuth ' s church had three different traditions of monk .

title: Kossuth ' s Eyes
description: Kossuth ' s Eyes Kossuth ' s Eyes were a pair of dormant volcanoes in the Small Teeth mountains . Description . These two volcanoes were located on the far eastern end of the mountain range .
description_long: Kossuth ' s Eyes Kossuth ' s Eyes were a pair of dormant volcanoes in the Small Teeth mountains . Description . These two volcanoes were located on the far eastern end of the mountain range . History . The volcanoes were last active during the founding of the dwarven kingdom of Shanatar . However , just two miles east of the Eyes was the site of another more recent volcanic eruption that buried the city of Xandar during the time of the Korrunhel Dynasty of Tethyr in 260 DR .

title: Kostchtchie
description: Kostchtchie Kostchtchie , known as the Prince of Wrath , was a demon lord and a patron of frost giant s and rage . Relationships . By establishing himself as a deity of frost giants , Kostchtchie directly encroached upon the domain of Thrym , though that titan did not take direct action against the demon lord .
description_long: Kostchtchie Kostchtchie , known as the Prince of Wrath , was a demon lord and a patron of frost giant s and rage . Relationships . By establishing himself as a deity of frost giants , Kostchtchie directly encroached upon the domain of Thrym , though that titan did not take direct action against the demon lord . The dwarven deity Clangeddin Silverbeard considered Kostchtchie , as well as the other evil giant deities , a hated enemy . Deeds . Around - 160 DR , Kostchtchie ' s " hortha " was summoned by summoners of Narfell . Frost giant s gathered under this " hortha " and fought on Narfell ' s side . It wasn ' t clear what exactly a " hortha " was , but given that " urhortha " meant avatar , chances were that " hortha " meant an aspect of the demon lord .

title: Kostil
description: Kostil Kostil was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , regarding the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Kostil joked to the younger malaugrym , provoking them to attack the human wizard without preparation .
description_long: Kostil Kostil was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , regarding the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Kostil joked to the younger malaugrym , provoking them to attack the human wizard without preparation . The young Taernil accepted Kostil ' s challenge . Kostil later suggested they kidnap Elminster , instead of killing him , and take him to the Castle of Shadows . However , Dlagim reminded Kostil that last time El had gone to the Castle of Shadows he slew forty malaugrym and only Dlagim and two others survived .

title: Kotaro Taro
description: Kotaro Taro Kotaro Taro was a kensai adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro born in Kotaro clan as first son and scion .
description_long: Kotaro Taro Kotaro Taro was a kensai adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro born in Kotaro clan as first son and scion . He from early years training with chijiriki . He occasionally clashed with local dam - builders if I thought that their actions would extensively weaken the power of his family . In 1355 DR a drought put in danger his family and they saved only thank to Ko Mei Kho In 1357 DR Taro was among the candidates values by Ko for the mission in Akari . In 1358 thank to Ko clan his land was saved and Taro , as the leading son , was expected to ease the debt the family owed the Kos . Taro also wished to use that debt to eventually travel to the continent and see the mighty rivers that flow there when was possibly approached by Ko Ho San Behind the scenes . Kotaro Taro is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari . He was presented again upgraded for adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Koumiss
description: Koumiss Koumiss ( pronounced KOO - miss ) was an extremely potent drink in Zakhara made from fermented mare ' s milk . It was forbidden in areas controlled by moralist s . Prices .
description_long: Koumiss Koumiss ( pronounced KOO - miss ) was an extremely potent drink in Zakhara made from fermented mare ' s milk . It was forbidden in areas controlled by moralist s . Prices . A half gallon ( 1 . 89 liter ) pitcher of koumiss sold for 3 sp .

title: Koyisqatapi
description: Koyisqatapi Koyisqatapi was the Azuposi ruler in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Koyisqatabi was elected as the new Gilded Priest and like all his predecessors he went to Dunobo Springs and ventured onto the Sun Trail in order to meet Masauwu and have his blessing .
description_long: Koyisqatapi Koyisqatapi was the Azuposi ruler in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Koyisqatabi was elected as the new Gilded Priest and like all his predecessors he went to Dunobo Springs and ventured onto the Sun Trail in order to meet Masauwu and have his blessing . However , he was attacked by a farastu and escaped , believing himself to have lost the protection of Masauwu . He tried many times to walk the Sun Trail again but always encountered the farastu . At last , in 1362 DR , thanks to the actions of Yenisha , Koyisqatapi asked for the help of Sozarro ' s expedition . With the adventurers ' help , he managed to defeat the gehreleth and finally met his god in the Beastlands . However , Masauwu was greatly enraged by Koyisqatapi ' s laziness , complacency , and dependence on gods , and ordered him to learn from the adventurers how to be audacious .

title: Koyoss
description: Koyoss Koyoss was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its sled dogs . Geography . Koyoss was located in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier , alongside a stream flowing between the Uppuk River and the Lugalpgotak Sea .
description_long: Koyoss Koyoss was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its sled dogs . Geography . Koyoss was located in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier , alongside a stream flowing between the Uppuk River and the Lugalpgotak Sea . Trade . The inhabitants of Koyoss raised sled dogs of every breed native to the Great Glacier , which included the heteff , mukteff , and okteff breeds .

title: Kozah ' s Needle
description: Kozah ' s Needle Kozah ' s Needle was a retractable magic staff that could turn into a triple bar with chains ( a dire threshing flail ) . It was the primary weapon used by Dahlia Sin ' felle , one of many users of the staff and seemingly the most proficient . Kozah ' s Needle built up an electric charge as it was used , and it could unleash electricity , even channeling it through an opponent ' s metal weapon .
description_long: Kozah ' s Needle Kozah ' s Needle was a retractable magic staff that could turn into a triple bar with chains ( a dire threshing flail ) . It was the primary weapon used by Dahlia Sin ' felle , one of many users of the staff and seemingly the most proficient . Kozah ' s Needle built up an electric charge as it was used , and it could unleash electricity , even channeling it through an opponent ' s metal weapon . In addition , if Dahlia charged the staff enough , it could burn a hole into an opponent and lay them low with a large blast of lightning .

title: Kozakura
description: Kozakura Kozakura is an archipelago nation composed of four large islands and dozens of smaller ones , the largest of which stretches fourteen hundred miles from tip to tip . It is a land where constant political power struggles are fought , and the central government in the Imperial Capital only has power within its immediate reach . Political intrigue is common as the great families of Kozakura seek to outmanoeuvre each other in their bid for power and wealth .
description_long: Kozakura Kozakura is an archipelago nation composed of four large islands and dozens of smaller ones , the largest of which stretches fourteen hundred miles from tip to tip . It is a land where constant political power struggles are fought , and the central government in the Imperial Capital only has power within its immediate reach . Political intrigue is common as the great families of Kozakura seek to outmanoeuvre each other in their bid for power and wealth . Geography . An archipelago nation , Kozakura consists of many islands . There are four large islands as well as dozens of smaller ones that make up the entirety of Kozakuran territory . The largest island , which is roughly fourteen hundred miles across its length , is named Shinkoku and is the location for the current imperial capital , Dojyu . It is also the centre of Kozakuran population and culture , and is the most widely settled of the four major islands . The other three islands are roughly the same size , at around two hundred miles across , and are Tenmei ( to the North of Shinkoku ) , and Mikedono and Hinomoto ( both to the south of Shinkoku .

title: Kozakuran language
description: Kozakuran language Kozakuran was a language spoken by the Kozakuran people , inhabitants of the realm of Kozakura in Kara - Tur . Kozakuran descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .
description_long: Kozakuran language Kozakuran was a language spoken by the Kozakuran people , inhabitants of the realm of Kozakura in Kara - Tur . Kozakuran descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language . There was perhaps 65 % comprehension between the two . It was considered a sophisticated language , thanks to the high level of literacy in Kozakura and the frequent publication of poetry and plays there . Popular plays regularly introduced new accents and phrases — within a few weeks , a popular new play could change common greetings across the country , which could just as quickly be replaced .

title: Kraanfhaor ' s Door
description: Kraanfhaor ' s Door Kraanfhaor ' s Door was an ancient elven magic college in Talthalaran in the High Moor . It was one of the most ancient colleges , dating to millennia before the Descent of the drow . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn found a clue to its location inside a " kiira " found in the High Moor .

title: Kradazuur
description: Kradazuur Kradazuur was a blue dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Kradazuur was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Krailash
description: Krailash Krailash , sometimes known as Krai was a dragonborn fighter who served as guard captain and chief of security for the Travelers of the merchant House Serrat . Description . Krailash was huge , standing nearly seven feet ( 2 meters ) tall and weighing 300 lbs .
description_long: Krailash Krailash , sometimes known as Krai was a dragonborn fighter who served as guard captain and chief of security for the Travelers of the merchant House Serrat . Description . Krailash was huge , standing nearly seven feet ( 2 meters ) tall and weighing 300 lbs . ( 136 kg . ) . He had rust colored scales . History . In 1462 DR , Krailash was in the jungle guarding House Serrat ' s terazul harvesters . He decided to investigate old ruins said to be inhabited by yuan - ti and he found an apparently human infant in the jungle vegetation . Believing the infant to be the last survivor of a massacre of a human tribe , he took her back to House Serrat ' s camp and the child was adopted by Alaia Serrat and named Zaltys . Later , in 1479 DR , when Zaltys was nearly full grown , she learned that her tribe may have been enslaved by derro of the Underdark and she decided to enter the Underdark with her cousin Julen to find her people . Zaltys and Julen were attacked by derro and Zaltys sent a psychic plea for help to Krai . Krailash led a small party into the Underdark to find Zaltys .

title: Krak al - Mazhar
description: Krak al - Mazhar Krak al - Mazhar was the secretive base of operation for the Brotherhood of the True Flame in 1367 DR . Description . Krak al - Mazhar was found within an ancient volcano deep within the Great Anvil of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara .
description_long: Krak al - Mazhar Krak al - Mazhar was the secretive base of operation for the Brotherhood of the True Flame in 1367 DR . Description . Krak al - Mazhar was found within an ancient volcano deep within the Great Anvil of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara . Inhabitants . Nar - Aidiya , the Bonfire , executed all of his plots and master schemes for the Brotherhood from this fortress .

title: Krak al - Nayyiran
description: Krak al - Nayyiran Krak al - Nayyiran , or the Castle of Sun and Moon , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This keep was found in the Plume district of the city . Activities .
description_long: Krak al - Nayyiran Krak al - Nayyiran , or the Castle of Sun and Moon , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This keep was found in the Plume district of the city . Activities . The finest of the Sultan ' s military units were trained within the castle of Krak al - Nayyiran . Additionally , the most elite of troops from those units were awarded quarters here .

title: Krak al - Tawil
description: Krak al - Tawil Krak al - Tawil , or the Long Castle , was a keep located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The castle was found in the Ashlarks ward of the city . Activities .
description_long: Krak al - Tawil Krak al - Tawil , or the Long Castle , was a keep located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The castle was found in the Ashlarks ward of the city . Activities . Krak al - Tawil served as the base of operation for the Jackals , a notorious group of salamander s .

title: Krak al - Yinangi
description: Krak al - Yinangi Krak al - Yinangi , also called the Castle of Conveyance , was a fortress located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . This beautiful but stout bridge - like fortress was designed to appear to float upon the lagoon where it sat .
description_long: Krak al - Yinangi Krak al - Yinangi , also called the Castle of Conveyance , was a fortress located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . This beautiful but stout bridge - like fortress was designed to appear to float upon the lagoon where it sat . Activities . Anyone wishing to visit the grand palace needed to first pass through the Castle of Conveyance .

title: Krak al - Zinad
description: Krak al - Zinad Krak al - Zinad , or the Keep of Fire Striking Steel , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Keep was located in the Cindersweeps ward of the city . Activities .
description_long: Krak al - Zinad Krak al - Zinad , or the Keep of Fire Striking Steel , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Keep was located in the Cindersweeps ward of the city . Activities . Krak al - Zinad housed soldiers that protected the harbors of the City of Brass . Additionally , all of the marines , and others who used specialized seaborne weaponry , were trained here .

title: Kraken
description: Kraken Krakens , called lopok by the locathah , were large , ocean - dwelling magical beast s . They are akin to squids except larger in size , almost 80 ' ( 24 m ) long ; they have a similar body , with a ring of tentacles surrounding a mouth connected to a conical central body . Two of its ten tentacles are longer than the rest and have deadly barbs .
description_long: Kraken Krakens , called lopok by the locathah , were large , ocean - dwelling magical beast s . They are akin to squids except larger in size , almost 80 ' ( 24 m ) long ; they have a similar body , with a ring of tentacles surrounding a mouth connected to a conical central body . Two of its ten tentacles are longer than the rest and have deadly barbs . The kraken has very large eyes , and fins protrude from the upper part of its elongated central body . Krakens cannot speak the languages of surface dwelling races , but might speak Aquan , or a language of their own similar to that of whales . Krakens are feared across the known world . They are creatures that dwell in the depths of the ocean and come to the surface to prey upon ships and their crews . While the kraken itself is quite powerful , many never see the creature ’ s body . It hides below the surface of the water , where it can be protected from any attacks by a ship ’ s defenders . The kraken instead , sends forth is massive tentacles to catch crewmen and draw them below the water , where the beast can devour the unfortunate souls in one gulp . Appearance .

title: Kraken Society
description: Kraken Society The Kraken Society was a secret society of thieves , assassin s and mage s in the Savage Frontier . Its purpose was to maintain an information network throughout the North , and it was secretly led by the the kraken , Slarkrethel . It had its headquarters in the Purple Rocks , and their main fortress in the ruins of Ascarle .

title: Krakentua ( Isle of Gargantuas )
description: Krakentua ( Isle of Gargantuas ) " The krakentua " was the krakentua ruler of the Isle of Gargantuas in the Outer Isles of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Around Wa Year 1765 ( 1347 DR ) , the krakentua had a titanic battle with more powerful spirits of the ocean .
description_long: Krakentua ( Isle of Gargantuas ) " The krakentua " was the krakentua ruler of the Isle of Gargantuas in the Outer Isles of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Around Wa Year 1765 ( 1347 DR ) , the krakentua had a titanic battle with more powerful spirits of the ocean . Badly wounded , he escaped to the Isle of Gargantuas to heal and recuperate . There , he contented himself with watching the insectoid and reptilian gargantua s in their never - ending conflicts , and planning what next he would do . In time , he managed to assert his control over the gargantuan creatures living on the isle , and installed himself as ruler of the Isle of Gargantuas . In Wa Year 1775 ( 1357 DR ) , the krakentua was approached in a dream by Shiz - ti , a powerful wu jen who dominated Paikai . Shiz - ti offered all the islands in the south of Wa for the krakentua to rule in exchange for the krakentua ' s help . The krakentua agreed but on a tentative basis and waited for further details about Shiz - ti ' s plot . Activities .

title: Krakentua ( Ito - Jo )
description: Krakentua ( Ito - Jo ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua lairing beneath Ito - Jo in Kozakura in 1359 DR . History . The krakentua lived in the deep oceans until it fled the more powerful guardian spirits of the deep .
description_long: Krakentua ( Ito - Jo ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua lairing beneath Ito - Jo in Kozakura in 1359 DR . History . The krakentua lived in the deep oceans until it fled the more powerful guardian spirits of the deep . It took refuge in the caves deep below the castle of Ito - Jo . Here , it was found by the wu jen Ungu Yakana , who tried to convince it to serve him by threatening it with the enmity of the Sun Temple sect . However , the krakentua not only enslaved the wu jen but also became the secret counselor of Ito Saburo , causing the decline of the Ito family . In around 646 DR , to humiliate Saburo , it decided to collect all the Seven Swords , the first traded by Saburo in exchange for the death of Nambu Akinari . The fall of Ito in 647 DR also harmed the krakentua , who , thanks to the " ancient curse " remained trapped inside the castle . Despite everything that year , it collected the second sword . Around 811 DR , after it was broken in a duel somehow , the krakentua recovered the third sword . The fourth was recovered around 923 DR in the confusion of the conflict of Honda Mototsune against invaders from Wa .

title: Krakentua ( Shinkintin )
description: Krakentua ( Shinkintin ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua who posed as the goddess of the village of Shinkintin on the Fochu Peninsula of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Several centuries before , she was attacked and defeated by Za - Jikku , a pan lung dragon and rogue officer of the Celestial Bureaucracy who caused much destruction in Kara - Tur .
description_long: Krakentua ( Shinkintin ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua who posed as the goddess of the village of Shinkintin on the Fochu Peninsula of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Several centuries before , she was attacked and defeated by Za - Jikku , a pan lung dragon and rogue officer of the Celestial Bureaucracy who caused much destruction in Kara - Tur . Za - Jikku also took one of her tentacles , which had been severed during the fight . The krakentua could not find her way to Qui to recover the valuable member . Later , around Wa Year 1765 ( 1347 DR ) , the krakentua had a titanic battle with more powerful spirits of the ocean . Badly wounded , she escaped to the Isle of Gargantuas to heal and recuperate . Around Wa Year 1776 ( 1358 DR ) , she left the Isle and went to the Fochu Peninsula , seeking human s to worship her . There she enslaved the village of Shinkintin , where the shoya , a powerful wu jen transformed a stream to flow with cherry tree milk for her . But a rebellion quickly emerged and the krakentua destroyed the village . The surviving villagers offered their total devotion .

title: Krakk ' t
description: Krakk ' t The Krakk ' t was a tribe of thri - kreen who dwelled in the Rushing Hills on the Shining Plains . Their territory extended into the plains themselves and southwest to outside the city of Surkh . Organization .
description_long: Krakk ' t The Krakk ' t was a tribe of thri - kreen who dwelled in the Rushing Hills on the Shining Plains . Their territory extended into the plains themselves and southwest to outside the city of Surkh . Organization . The tribe only numbered about fifty or so members and was nomadic within their territory . The tribe was further split into three distinct packs , for which reason outsiders called them " tri - kreen " . Activities . They hunted rabbit s , Plainsteed s , and other herd animals that entered their territory . They considered horse a delicacy . They rarely attacked travelers in the area , but the chances of an attack rose if there were elves in the group , as elf - meat was also a delicacy for thri - kreen . The fire drake s of the Deepwing Mountains hunted for food in the Rushing Hills , and occasionally attacked the thri - kreen there . History . After the founding of Assam in 715 DR , the three cities of the Shining Plains — Assam , Lheshayl , and Ormath — spent the next three centuries in skirmishes and minor battles with the thri - kreen and centaur s of the plains , before they learned to live in peace .

title: Kral
description: Kral Kral was a bard and Harpers agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The bard was little paranoid and preferred to be underestimated by his enemies .
description_long: Kral Kral was a bard and Harpers agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The bard was little paranoid and preferred to be underestimated by his enemies . Despite this , he was a joking and personable individual . History . In 1489 DR , after Vorgansharax ' s coup , Kral helped the Lord Sage of Phlan to unveil the mysteries of Denlor ' s Tower . Publicly , he acted as the Lord ' s servant .

title: Kralgar Bonesnapper
description: Kralgar Bonesnapper Kralgar Bonesnapper was the chieftain of the Uthgardt Griffon tribe who ruled Griffon ' s Nest . Activities . He endlessly struggled to fulfill his goal of conquering and ruling one of the great cities of the North .
description_long: Kralgar Bonesnapper Kralgar Bonesnapper was the chieftain of the Uthgardt Griffon tribe who ruled Griffon ' s Nest . Activities . He endlessly struggled to fulfill his goal of conquering and ruling one of the great cities of the North . Kralgar would most likely be happiest enthroned in Silverymoon , but would be just as pleased to rule Everlund if the city were a bit larger and more fortified , even settling for Neverwinter , Mirabar , Sundabar or Everlund . While he didn ' t believe that magic was strong enough to rout the barbarian s of the Griffon tribe , Kralgar became interested in acquiring enchanted items for his own use .

title: Kraljaom Distillery
description: Kraljaom Distillery The Kraljaom Distillery was a famous producer of ales , beers , ciders , wines , and other alcohol , located in the western half of the city of Myratma . Notable Products . Many of the distillery ' s wares were known throughout Faerûn , as they were sold both locally and through Aurora ' s Emporium .
description_long: Kraljaom Distillery The Kraljaom Distillery was a famous producer of ales , beers , ciders , wines , and other alcohol , located in the western half of the city of Myratma . Notable Products . Many of the distillery ' s wares were known throughout Faerûn , as they were sold both locally and through Aurora ' s Emporium . Among them were Purple Hills Cider , Shanale lagers , and wines made from grapes found only in County Calimmon .

title: Kranum
description: Kranum Kranum was a stone giant shaman in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kranum was exiled by his tribe for being too kind to lesser races .
description_long: Kranum Kranum was a stone giant shaman in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kranum was exiled by his tribe for being too kind to lesser races . Wandering the Moonsea , he settled near the Frostfur goblin tribe , protecting them from peryton s . After the fall of a meteor , he went to see the crater , which held the recreated Pool of Radiance . Intrigued , Kranum touched the strange liquid and was immediately possessed by Tyranthraxus . Under Tyranthraxus ' s control , he subdued the perytons and offered an alliance to the Burning Banner tribe led by Narle Shieldbiter . When a Cult of the Dragon contingent sent by Vorgansharax arrived in the area , Tyranthraxus released Kranum from his control in order to wait to possess the green dragon ruler of Phlan . An adventuring party hired to stop Vorgansharax ' s cultists foiled his plan . Kranum regained his senses after being abandoned by the spirit possessor and woke up , not remembering anything of what he did whilst under possession . Personality . Kranum was a gentle individual . He was inquisitive , contemplative , and soft - spoken .

title: Krashos Morueme
description: Krashos Morueme Krashos Morueme was a blue dragon of the legendary Morueme dragon clan . He resided in Ched Nasad under the alias of Quevven Jusztiirn , professing to be a venerable drow mage . Abilities .
description_long: Krashos Morueme Krashos Morueme was a blue dragon of the legendary Morueme dragon clan . He resided in Ched Nasad under the alias of Quevven Jusztiirn , professing to be a venerable drow mage . Abilities . In addition to the formidable abilities that other blue dragons of his age can muster . Krashos Morueme was a skilled spellcaster , able to hide his true form under the guise of a drow with his magic for over 50 years . History . Early Life . A few decades after the Year of the Dracorage , 1018 DR , Krashos ' mother was driven from the rest of the clan when she reached maturity . Krashos began visiting Ched Nasad in the 1320 ' s DR to search for Netherse artifacts but quickly became enamoured with city of shimmering webs , so much so that he remained there . Adopting the alias of Quevven Jusztriin , an elderly drow , Krashos professed to have fled the sectarian unrest in Eryndlyn . The Fall of Ched Nasad . On 3 Uktar 1372 DR , Ched Nasad was destroyed by the Stonefire bomb s of the Duergar of Gracklstugh . During the collapse , Krashos was on the bottomost layer of the city and was subsequently buried by the falling ruins .

title: Krehlan Arunsun
description: Krehlan Arunsun Krehlan Arunsun was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand and the fourth Blackstaff . Description . Krehlan was silver - haired from birth .
description_long: Krehlan Arunsun Krehlan Arunsun was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand and the fourth Blackstaff . Description . Krehlan was silver - haired from birth . Personality . Laeral noted in " Lifelong with Regrets " ( published 1391 DR ) that Krehlan had his father ' s temper . History . Laeral was pregnant with Krehlan by the end of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . < ref name = " Blackstaff / MMP342 - 343 " > < / ref > Unlike his parents , Krehlan was not a Chosen of Mystra , but was still a highly skilled spellcaster , sufficient to become a Blackstaff . Krehlan became Blackstaff in the Year of Lost Ships , 1400 DR . In the 1415 DR , Krehlan and the Grand Mages of Rhymanthiin dissipated the " kiira n ' vaelhar " , which held the spirit - templates and combined knowledge of Khelben Arunsun , Tsarra Chaadren , and Kyriani Agrivar , and bound its magic to Blackstaff Tower and its twin in Rhymanthiin , N ' Vaerymanth . Around 1424 DR , Krehlan was killed by Chartham Dellenvol . His successor was Ashemmon of Rhymanthiin .

title: Krenadir
description: Krenadir Krenadir ( also seen as Krenalir ) was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Krenadir was located on the coast of Luirenstrand in the Great Sea .
description_long: Krenadir Krenadir ( also seen as Krenalir ) was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Krenadir was located on the coast of Luirenstrand in the Great Sea . It was located some miles east of Mortick Swamp . A road around the swamp connected the city to Beluir and the rest of Luiren . History . Krenadir was founded in 218 DR . In 1105 DR , the city received widespread damage from a storm over the Great Sea . Armed Forces . During the height of the harvest season 100 warders protected the city and surrounding land . Many of these Warder ' s were laid - off during the winter season and spent their time patrolling the Long Forest for Fasruil and Crimel .

title: Kreodo
description: Kreodo Kreodo was the leader of the Wraith of the Inner Sea mercenary company in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Kreodo initially was a slave of the Flaming Spike orc s but escaped and arrived in Reth .
description_long: Kreodo Kreodo was the leader of the Wraith of the Inner Sea mercenary company in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Kreodo initially was a slave of the Flaming Spike orc s but escaped and arrived in Reth . Later , in Mordulkin , she joined the local thieves ' guild but , being fascinated by the sea , she decided to become a pirate . Personality . Kreodo was very cruel but normally treated well people that surrendered to her .

title: Kresselack
description: Kresselack Kresselack the black wolf was a Barbarian King who conquered a vast kingdom during his youth . He described himself after his death as evil itself . Spirit of Kresselack , 1281 DR , the Vale of Shadows Everard , 1281 DR Once he grew old and realized that he would die and be dead forever , he knew fear for the first time of his life .
description_long: Kresselack Kresselack the black wolf was a Barbarian King who conquered a vast kingdom during his youth . He described himself after his death as evil itself . Spirit of Kresselack , 1281 DR , the Vale of Shadows Everard , 1281 DR Once he grew old and realized that he would die and be dead forever , he knew fear for the first time of his life . Spirit of Kresselack , 1281 DR , the Vale of Shadows He tried to earn a place at the side of the lord of the dead Myrkul by constructing a special tomb in The Vale of Shadows in Icewind Dale and sacrificing himself , but instead he became cursed to haunt his tomb for eternity . The tomb was guarded by his most loyal followers whom he had sacrificed and a servant of Myrkul ( his Sending ) who had been raised from the dead .

title: Krestung
description: Krestung The Krestung was a breed of monstrous flying creature that lurked in the depths of the Vorkani Mountains in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It resembled a great vulture with a long neck like a snake and the head of a wolf of hideous and evil aspect . Packs of these creatures raided even the best - guarded caravans , snatching away horse s and human s alike .
description_long: Krestung The Krestung was a breed of monstrous flying creature that lurked in the depths of the Vorkani Mountains in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It resembled a great vulture with a long neck like a snake and the head of a wolf of hideous and evil aspect . Packs of these creatures raided even the best - guarded caravans , snatching away horse s and human s alike . Folk of Koryo knew them from pictures .

title: Krieger
description: Krieger Krieger was a deep gnome councilor of the city of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . Before becoming a councilor , he was a burrow warden . Personality .
description_long: Krieger Krieger was a deep gnome councilor of the city of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . Before becoming a councilor , he was a burrow warden . Personality . Krieger was a very independent individual , even for a former burrow warden and indulged in unorthodox strategies . His former work made Krieger very conscious of all the dangers of the Underdark and his skills were very useful for his later position as councilor , especially because of the threat of vengeance by the Menzoberranzan drow after their war against Mithral Hall . History . For a time , he was a burrow warden until he become a councilor for the city after the war with the drow of Menzoberranzan .

title: Kriknar
description: Kriknar Kriknar was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Kriknar usually traveled around the city heavily cloaked and painted , in order to pass as an ugly half - orc .
description_long: Kriknar Kriknar was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Kriknar usually traveled around the city heavily cloaked and painted , in order to pass as an ugly half - orc . Kriknar and the other members of its tribe ( who worked on different teams ) worked as slavers for the Guild , not for money but for the chance to hunt intelligent beings . Often , they were given useless slaves or purchased their own with the money they were paid and hunted the slaves for fun . Kriknar enjoyed its job and would never quit . Abilities . It learned to use a sword instead of its claws .

title: Krilelyn H ' Kar
description: Krilelyn H ' Kar Krilelyn H ' Kar was an elite warrior of Bregan D ' aerthe in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to stop the threat of the demon lord s , arrived in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Krilelyn H ' Kar Krilelyn H ' Kar was an elite warrior of Bregan D ' aerthe in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to stop the threat of the demon lord s , arrived in Menzoberranzan . Krilelyn was instructed by Jarlaxle to invite them to a meeting with him in the ruins of the House Do ' Urden complex . Personality . Krilelyn was a charming and devilishly sarcastic male from House H ' kar .

title: Krimgol Muzgardt
description: Krimgol Muzgardt Krimgol Muzgardt was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Krimgol was an ale merchant from Gracklstugh .
description_long: Krimgol Muzgardt Krimgol Muzgardt was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Krimgol was an ale merchant from Gracklstugh . During the Rage of Demons , during one of his travels to Mantol - Derith , he found Fraz - Urb ' luu ' s gem . Convinced by the gem that he was without honor , Krimgol hired the wizard Yantha Coaxrock , leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone , to set the gem in an item of jewellery . However , Yantha too succumbed to the gem ' s influence and lied to Krimgol about the value of the gem . Suspecting treachery , he demanded the gem back , but it was secretly stolen by Flink Thunderbonk . Krimgol did not believe Yantha ' s story and , with the support of Ghuldur Flagonfist , the duergar representative , attacked the deep gnome section of the city and kidnapped the wizard , starting a civil war in the trading post . Ghuldur and Krimgol than interrogated Yantha in order to understand the whole matter . Personality . The gem caused Krimgol to believe himself to be a calassabrak — a duergar without honor . Relationship . Krimgor was a good friend of Ghuldur Flagonfist , the duergar representative in Mantol - Derith .

title: Krimmon Amethystall
description: Krimmon Amethystall Count Krimmon Amethystall was the Fleet Chancellor of Tethyr and the ruler of County Vintor in the Purple Marches in 1370 DR . Description . Count Amethystall was short , even for a halfling .
description_long: Krimmon Amethystall Count Krimmon Amethystall was the Fleet Chancellor of Tethyr and the ruler of County Vintor in the Purple Marches in 1370 DR . Description . Count Amethystall was short , even for a halfling . Personality . Krimmon was a grumpy halfling man who lost his temper easily . He was greedy to a fault , but his diligence and talent for handling large sums of money made him well - suited for his job as the country ' s Fleet Chancellor . Despite being in charge of the navy ' s finances , Krimmon was phobic of water and could not swim . He was extremely disliked by King Haedrak ' s pseudodragon familiar , Purlakhonthiis . Activities . As Fleet Chancellor , Krimmon was responsible for the management of the finances of the royal navy . Krimmon was bothered by that only one halfling sat on the queen ' s Privy Council in 1370 , while the elves had three seats , despite that five times as many halflings lived in Tethyr as did elves . He was hoping to be appointed a seat to improve his social status . Krimmon had been unable to find a wife suitable to his stringent tastes after two years of actively searching .

title: Krinth
description: Krinth Krinth were humanoid s native to the Plane of Shadow . They composed the bulk of the armies of the returned Netherese city of Thultanthar . Description .
description_long: Krinth Krinth were humanoid s native to the Plane of Shadow . They composed the bulk of the armies of the returned Netherese city of Thultanthar . Description . Krinth were tall humanoids with dusky gray skin , black hair , and black eyes . They weighed between 150 and 250 pounds ( 70 and 110 kilograms ) and were between five and seven feet ( 150 and 210 centimeters ) tall . Their appearance varied depending on whether their non - demonic ancestor was human , dwarf , orc , or some other humanoid . Dwarf - related krinth were not as short as dwarves but were taller than other varieties of krinth . A krinth had great endurance and strength . There were actually two kinds of krinth . Demonspawn krinth were the direct offspring of a shadow demon and some race of humanoid . The trueborn , or full , krinth descended from two krinth parents . Physiology . Krinth children matured more quickly than did humans , but they reached adulthood around 20 years of age and lived to be between 100 and 125 years old . Personality . A krinth was typically grumpy and humorless , with a short temper .

title: Kriv
description: Kriv Kriv was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther . Description . Kriv had yellow eyes and bronze scales flecked with black .
description_long: Kriv Kriv was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther . Description . Kriv had yellow eyes and bronze scales flecked with black . History . In 1479 DR , Kriv was one of the wizards Vanquisher Tarhun sought to study the dragonspawn - controlling orb s created by Nala . Under Kriv ' s leadership , the thymari mages were able to devise a counterspell to disable the orbs , giving an edge to Tymanther military forces .

title: Krivvin Shamblestar
description: Krivvin Shamblestar Krivvin Shamblestar was the stocky yet soft - spoken tavernmaster of the Stag - Horned Flagon in Amphail . Along with being an exceptional knife - thrower , Krivvin had an extensive memory for the faces of his clientele and the favored drinks that go with them . He also made sure that he knew most of the business that went on within his bar , whether the patrons realized it or not .
description_long: Krivvin Shamblestar Krivvin Shamblestar was the stocky yet soft - spoken tavernmaster of the Stag - Horned Flagon in Amphail . Along with being an exceptional knife - thrower , Krivvin had an extensive memory for the faces of his clientele and the favored drinks that go with them . He also made sure that he knew most of the business that went on within his bar , whether the patrons realized it or not . Using this knowledge to serve as a watchman for both the Harpers and the Lords of Waterdeep , he kept in regular contact with Mirt the Moneylender , who was an old friend .

title: Kromlech Bruenghor
description: Kromlech Bruenghor Kromlech was a shield dwarf of the Sunset Mountains , who sought adventure and glory in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Having been waylaid and robbed by thieves almost immediately , his first instinct was to track down the ones who robbed him and seek vengeance . Little did he know that this would mean becoming involved in some of the greatest events to shape the future of Baldur ' s Gate for years to come .
description_long: Kromlech Bruenghor Kromlech was a shield dwarf of the Sunset Mountains , who sought adventure and glory in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Having been waylaid and robbed by thieves almost immediately , his first instinct was to track down the ones who robbed him and seek vengeance . Little did he know that this would mean becoming involved in some of the greatest events to shape the future of Baldur ' s Gate for years to come . He was regarded as one of the Heroes of Baldur ' s Gate . Biography . Born and raised in the town of Easting in the Sunset Mountains , Kromlech was the baby of his family . He was the youngest and treated with the most care even though he was a very skilled fighter . Kromlech left the Sunset Mountains for Baldur ' s Gate . He arrived in the city with two other adventurers , Vahn and Adrianna , and the three were attacked by thieves . War against the thieves . After being attacked by the thief Karne , Kromlech paired up with Vahn , a human arcane archer , and Adrianna , a moon elf , to get his gold back . After foiling various attempts of the guild to weaken Baldur ' s Gate , Kromlech and his friends were recruited into the Harpers .

title: Kromm Kadar
description: Kromm Kadar Kromm Kadar was a silent blacksmith in High Dale . History . Kromm was once a Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale as blacksmith but always collaborated with the Zhent s .
description_long: Kromm Kadar Kromm Kadar was a silent blacksmith in High Dale . History . Kromm was once a Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale as blacksmith but always collaborated with the Zhent s . When in 1358 DR , a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , the wizard Angruin Myrvult killed a member of the Council of the High Dale spying for Sembia and placed Kromm in the empty seat .

title: Krondac
description: Krondac Krondac was a baron in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Krondac was called to a meeting of prominent citizens gathered by Lord Fior Botpur to discuss the menace of a barbarian army from Kara - Tur .
description_long: Krondac Krondac was a baron in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Krondac was called to a meeting of prominent citizens gathered by Lord Fior Botpur to discuss the menace of a barbarian army from Kara - Tur . He proposed Pohidge Plam serve as the main commander and to attack the enemy before they reached the city . He took part in the defense of the city . Personality . Krondac was a very poor strategist . He wanted Pohidge as leader only because he believed he could manipulate him .

title: Krondorl Waeglossz
description: Krondorl Waeglossz Krondorl Waeglossz was the head of the College of Invocation and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , he participated in the debate about elevating the College of Ancient Arcana or the College of Bae ' qeshel Magic as the new eleventh official college of the city .
description_long: Krondorl Waeglossz Krondorl Waeglossz was the head of the College of Invocation and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , he participated in the debate about elevating the College of Ancient Arcana or the College of Bae ' qeshel Magic as the new eleventh official college of the city .

title: Krote Word - Maker
description: Krote Word - Maker Krote Word - Maker was a gnoll cleric of the Burnt Fur tribe . Description . Compared to other gnolls , Krote was very thin , with a sunken snout and eyes .
description_long: Krote Word - Maker Krote Word - Maker was a gnoll cleric of the Burnt Fur tribe . Description . Compared to other gnolls , Krote was very thin , with a sunken snout and eyes . He had mustard - colored skin and tattered ears . Possessions . Krote usually wore a dirty scarf around his head . He fought with spear and longbow and wore a " ring of teleportation " , which was a gift from Martine and used to be owned by Jazrac . Relationships . Krote became a lifelong friend of the Harper Martine , and he accompanied her on her travels . History . Krote was a shaman of the god Gorelikk in the Burnt Fur gnoll tribe living in the Samek Valley . He was banished from the tribe in 1366 DR for not submitting to the ice devil Vreesar . He joined Martine and , with help of the hermit Vilheim and the gnome outcast Jouka , helped her fight against Vressar . Krote was decisive in the killing of the devil . Afterward , Krote decided to travel with Martine .

title: Krowen Valharrow
description: Krowen Valharrow Krowen Valharrow was an archmage member of the Harpers in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Krowen lived in Moongleam Tower with the company of dozens of tressym and a handful of apprentices .
description_long: Krowen Valharrow Krowen Valharrow was an archmage member of the Harpers in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Krowen lived in Moongleam Tower with the company of dozens of tressym and a handful of apprentices . He offered to people that he liked to bequeath one ( and only one ) of his tressym . Secretly Krowen managed a secret network of teleportation circle s that connected Everlund to Yartar , Neverwinter , Loudwater , Mirabar and Waterdeep .

title: Krydle
description: Krydle Krydle ( " Cry dull " with a quick L ) was a half - elf thief and poet who lived in Baldur ' s Gate , estranged from his father Coran . He hated the politics of the city and the schism between upper and lower cities . He joined Minsc and Delina ' s quest .
description_long: Krydle Krydle ( " Cry dull " with a quick L ) was a half - elf thief and poet who lived in Baldur ' s Gate , estranged from his father Coran . He hated the politics of the city and the schism between upper and lower cities . He joined Minsc and Delina ' s quest . Personality . A man with a mischievous nature and want for unique experiences , he might have seemed shallow but in truth he looked for close friends and adventure as his surrogate family . History . The son of Coran , the famous patriarch of Baldur ' s Gate , Kyrdle grew estranged to his father and thus hated the politics of the city . Krydle was apparently at some point a member of the city ' s criminal underground , obtaining allies , training as a thief , learning thieves ' cant , and finding a hidden underground safehouse . At some point , he met the halfling ally Shandie who became a trusted friend . Running into Minsc and Delina and finding them at odds with the city watch , Krydle felt compelled him to aid them , taking them to his hidden safehouse .

title: Kryll
description: Kryll Kryll was a female necromancer who was a one - time companion of Dorn Il - Khan until she betrayed him to Luskan ' s guards . Eventually , with the help of Gorion ' s Ward , Dorn found Kryll near Nashkel and killed her in revenge .
description_long: Kryll Kryll was a female necromancer who was a one - time companion of Dorn Il - Khan until she betrayed him to Luskan ' s guards . Eventually , with the help of Gorion ' s Ward , Dorn found Kryll near Nashkel and killed her in revenge .

title: Kryptgarden Forest
description: Kryptgarden Forest Kryptgarden Forest was located east of the Sword Mountains . It lay just west of the Long Road , and north of Waterdeep . In 1489 DR , the Green Dragon Mask was recovered from the lair of Claugiyliamatar in Kryptgarden Forest .
description_long: Kryptgarden Forest Kryptgarden Forest was located east of the Sword Mountains . It lay just west of the Long Road , and north of Waterdeep . In 1489 DR , the Green Dragon Mask was recovered from the lair of Claugiyliamatar in Kryptgarden Forest . Old Gnawbone herself was injured while blows were struck against Thay , the Cult of the Dragon , and the Zartruss hobgoblin clan .

title: Kuda
description: Kuda Kuda was the second - largest city and the former capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city around 7 , 000 people divided into two wards . Kuda was the provincial capital under the emperor ' s rule but the shogun moved the capital to Tamanokuni .
description_long: Kuda Kuda was the second - largest city and the former capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city around 7 , 000 people divided into two wards . Kuda was the provincial capital under the emperor ' s rule but the shogun moved the capital to Tamanokuni .

title: Kuda no Nito
description: Kuda no Nito Kuda no Nito was a weapons merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , while traveling to sell his goods with his two assistants , Nito was attacked by some evil sohei who killed his assistants and robbed him .
description_long: Kuda no Nito Kuda no Nito was a weapons merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , while traveling to sell his goods with his two assistants , Nito was attacked by some evil sohei who killed his assistants and robbed him . Only great luck saved his life . Later , Nito told some adventurers what had happened .

title: Kueh - Ku
description: Kueh - Ku Kueh - Ku was an assassin and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The assassin was a very vicious and evil person .
description_long: Kueh - Ku Kueh - Ku was an assassin and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The assassin was a very vicious and evil person . She would kill anyone for no other reason than being paid . Possession . During a mission , Kueh - Ku acquired a strange black gem that somehow burrowed its way into her flesh , buried in the center of her left palm . This gem absorbed all magic cast against Kueh - Ku but also made her unable to use magic items . Nobody knew if the gem was a sort of " ioun stone " and would burn out or if it was a permanent power . History . The half - elf worked as an assassin for the Shadow Thieves . Once during an assassination , she acquired her strange magic - absorbing gem . Initially , she tried to get it removed but soon found it very useful . Kueh - Ku was considered by the guild a key agent in their plots against the Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Kukri
description: Kukri A kukri is a light , martial , melee weapon . Description . The kukri looks like a short machete with a bent blade .
description_long: Kukri A kukri is a light , martial , melee weapon . Description . The kukri looks like a short machete with a bent blade . The blade becomes gradually wider from the hilt to the end where it quickly tapers to a sharp point . The cutting edge is all along the inside of the curved blade up to the tip . There is no cross - guard on the typical kukri and the hilt is that of a knife . An average kukri costs 8gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Use . The kukri is a basic utility knife that makes a great weapon . The extra weight at the wide end of the blade lets it chop like a machete . The kukri is not very good for defense due to the lack of a cross - guard , but offensively it is very threatening . Realmslore . The kukri is roughly the size of a sickle , that can be used much like a dagger , particularly in the hands of trained rogue s , who use it almost identically . Like daggers , kukris make excellent off - hand weapons for individuals who prefer dual - wielding two melee weapons .

title: Kukul
description: Kukul Kukul was the father of all Maztica n gods and the husband of the deity Maztica . The Maztican creation myth holds that Kukul created humans by cutting off his fingers and dropping them to the earth . Kukul died of grief after Maztica was killed by their son Zaltec .
description_long: Kukul Kukul was the father of all Maztica n gods and the husband of the deity Maztica . The Maztican creation myth holds that Kukul created humans by cutting off his fingers and dropping them to the earth . Kukul died of grief after Maztica was killed by their son Zaltec .

title: Kuldahar
description: Kuldahar Kuldahar was a settlement in the northern reaches of the Spine of the World mountains . History . In the early days of the world of Toril , the god of nature Silvanus planted a simple acorn in the northern foothills of the freezing Spine of the World mountain chain .
description_long: Kuldahar Kuldahar was a settlement in the northern reaches of the Spine of the World mountains . History . In the early days of the world of Toril , the god of nature Silvanus planted a simple acorn in the northern foothills of the freezing Spine of the World mountain chain . The tree grew continuously for millennia , reaching an extraordinary girth and size . Silvanus nurtured this tree , named Kuldahar , embedding within it a connection to the primal power of the world so that it would throw off heat and create a haven in the frigid subarctic mountains for all forms of life . Around 1220 DR , a Silvanite archdruid was traveling through the Spine of the World ’ s foothills when he stumbled upon the massive Kuldahar oak and immediately realized that this was a place sacred to the Oakfather . Beneath the boughs of the great tree , the archdruid created a small shrine to Silvanus . Soon , other druid s from druid circles in the North flocked to the holy oak , where it was said they could bathe in the primal power of the world and feel the touch of their god on the mortal plane .

title: Kuldahar Pass
description: Kuldahar Pass Kuldahar Pass was a vale between Easthaven and Kuldahar in the Spine of the World . Geography . On the outskirts of the pass was a small mill , which was often used as a base for marauding goblin s .
description_long: Kuldahar Pass Kuldahar Pass was a vale between Easthaven and Kuldahar in the Spine of the World . Geography . On the outskirts of the pass was a small mill , which was often used as a base for marauding goblin s . History . In 1281 DR , a band of adventurers lead by Hrothgar were ambushed by frost giant s in the pass on their way to Kuldahar .

title: Kuldin Peaks
description: Kuldin Peaks The Kuldin Peaks were a small cluster of mountains in the country of Erlkazar at the border with Tethyr . Geography . The Kuldin Peaks fell within the borders of the barony of Carrelath in Erlkazar .
description_long: Kuldin Peaks The Kuldin Peaks were a small cluster of mountains in the country of Erlkazar at the border with Tethyr . Geography . The Kuldin Peaks fell within the borders of the barony of Carrelath in Erlkazar . They were the middle peaks of the Iltkazar Range , which ran north to the Giant ' s Run Mountains and south to the Alimirs . The mountains were surrounded by foothills . The mountains themselves were steep and snow - covered for most of the year , and the tree line ended about half way up most of the peaks . Swimstar Creek began in these peaks , and its waters fed the Shining Stream , which in turn fed the River Ith . Inhabitants . Shield dwarves were known to live in these mountains , as were ogre s , gnoll s , and troll s . The Starrock goblin tribe lived there also . The red dragon Charvekannathor laired in the Kuldin Peaks and kept them free from orc s . Kartak Spellseer , a powerful lich and member of the Twisted Rune lived in the Kuldin Peaks within an abandoned dwarven mine . Trails & Byways . The Kuldin Peaks were largely unexplored and no major road passed through them , because of how abruptly the peaks rose from among the foothills .

title: Kuldus Droum
description: Kuldus Droum Kuldus Droum was a male human werebear from the Moonwood and was a cleric for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Kuldus was a strong , large , and quiet man .
description_long: Kuldus Droum Kuldus Droum was a male human werebear from the Moonwood and was a cleric for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Kuldus was a strong , large , and quiet man . He had been a werebear since his birth . Kuldus possessed the physical strength necessary to challenge Jarthon Drael , but he recognized a lack of leadership within himself . Possessions . Kuldus was usually equipped with his heavy mace , crossbow , and hide armor and a large shield for protection .

title: Kultaka
description: Kultaka The nation of Kultaka occupies a fertile coastal plain and its surrounding mountains . Despite being a coastal nation , large salt marshes that stretch along the coast separate the people from the sea . Kultaka is populated by humans .
description_long: Kultaka The nation of Kultaka occupies a fertile coastal plain and its surrounding mountains . Despite being a coastal nation , large salt marshes that stretch along the coast separate the people from the sea . Kultaka is populated by humans . History . Kultaka fought many wars with Nexal but was never conquered . The Golden Legion defeated Kultaka in 1361 DR but since the city had very little gold Cordell moved on to Nexal . 20 , 000 Kultakan warriors joined Cordell ' s expedition .

title: Kulwarth
description: Kulwarth Marshal Kulwarth was a scarred barbarian Zhentilar officer in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , during the Cormanthor War , Kulwarth was the aide - de - camp of the castellan Scyllua Darkhope .
description_long: Kulwarth Marshal Kulwarth was a scarred barbarian Zhentilar officer in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , during the Cormanthor War , Kulwarth was the aide - de - camp of the castellan Scyllua Darkhope . With Kulwarth ' s help , Scyllua won a great battle against the Red Plumes . Later , they were besieging Hillsfar when Kulwarth informed Scyllua that Fzoul Chembryl needed to see her .

title: Kumade
description: Kumade A kumade was a type of multi - purpose tool and weapon used in Kara - Tur , and was favored by ninja . Description . It was 6 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Kumade A kumade was a type of multi - purpose tool and weapon used in Kara - Tur , and was favored by ninja . Description . It was 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) long and weighed 15 lbs ( 6 . 8 kg ) , with a wooden shaft and a pointed , pronged rake - head at one end . Uses . A kumade could be used as a rake or a climbing tool . One could hook the prongs in a crack or on a ledge or sill and scale the pole . It could also be wielded one - handed as a weapon , though it was only as damaging as a dagger . As it could be carried as part of a disguise without raising too much suspicion , and thanks to its use as a climbing tool , many ninja used kumades .

title: Kumed Hahpret
description: Kumed Hahpret Kumed Hahpret replaced the murdered Aznar Thrul by 1385 DR as zulkir of Evocation . Importance . Kumed supported the council of zulkirs in their war against the lich Szass Tam , who proclaimed himself regent of all Thay .
description_long: Kumed Hahpret Kumed Hahpret replaced the murdered Aznar Thrul by 1385 DR as zulkir of Evocation . Importance . Kumed supported the council of zulkirs in their war against the lich Szass Tam , who proclaimed himself regent of all Thay . He was supposedly killed by Nevron in 1385 DR before all remaining zulkirs left Bezantur in flight of Szass Tam ' s undead forces .

title: Kumen
description: Kumen The Kumen , or Ancient Gate , was a gateway on the Dragonwall . Geography . This particular gateway was located at the southern end of the wall near Khazari .
description_long: Kumen The Kumen , or Ancient Gate , was a gateway on the Dragonwall . Geography . This particular gateway was located at the southern end of the wall near Khazari . History . The Kumen , and a large portion of the surrounding wall , was obliterated when the Tuigan invaders were able to release the dragon spirit from the Dragonwall . The opening created by the spirit ' s release allowed the invaders to flow into Shou Lung .

title: Kumiss
description: Kumiss Kumiss was alcohol ic beverage made from soured or fermented horse milk . It could be stored in leather bags . Geography .
description_long: Kumiss Kumiss was alcohol ic beverage made from soured or fermented horse milk . It could be stored in leather bags . Geography . It was drunk in Khazari and the Hordelands . The lama Koja said it warmed the blood and purged cooling humors . Uses . It could be used as a component in the Sunlight After Storm sutra .

title: Kun - Yen Shan
description: Kun - Yen Shan The Kun - Yen Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . The Kun - Yen Shan formed the northern rim of the sprawling Yehimal mountains , stretching from the A - Ling Shan in the west all the way to the province of Tabot and Kao Shan in Shou Lung to the east .
description_long: Kun - Yen Shan The Kun - Yen Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . The Kun - Yen Shan formed the northern rim of the sprawling Yehimal mountains , stretching from the A - Ling Shan in the west all the way to the province of Tabot and Kao Shan in Shou Lung to the east . It was classed as one of the " high peaks " ranges of the Hordelands . Description . The Kun - Yen Shan towered over the southern portion of the Katakoro Plateau , ascending steeply from the low valley there . The range had jagged peaks rising 23 , 000 ft . ( 7000 m ) into the sky . Small glaciers could be seen filling some of the gaps between the towering peaks of the Kun - Yen Shan . Green , densely forested valleys that were free of glaciers were isolated and hidden deep within the mountains . Inhabitants . Though most of the mountain range was bereft of life , the lush valleys supported deer , monkey s , leopard s , and tiger s . Rugged human s were scattered throughout the Kun - Yen Shan as well , seeking remoteness from civilization .

title: Kung Pu Mok
description: Kung Pu Mok Kung Pu Mok was the High Priest of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR Activities . Kung Pu Mok plotted to replace the Emperor with a theocracy . He also sought to marry Kai Tsao Shou Chin ' s third daughter , Princess Pai .
description_long: Kung Pu Mok Kung Pu Mok was the High Priest of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR Activities . Kung Pu Mok plotted to replace the Emperor with a theocracy . He also sought to marry Kai Tsao Shou Chin ' s third daughter , Princess Pai . In order to fulfill his dream , he forged ties with Black Chung Tao . He had an uneasy truce with Minister of Faith Yui Min Li . History . In 1358 DR , Kung Pu Mok was busy with a tour of the monasteries in Wa K ' an . Personality . Kung Pu Mok was a vain and stubborn individual .

title: Kuo - toa
description: Kuo - toa Kuo - toa were a debased monstrous humanoid fish - like race that dwelt in the Underdark . They had human - like bodies and fish - like heads . Religion .
description_long: Kuo - toa Kuo - toa were a debased monstrous humanoid fish - like race that dwelt in the Underdark . They had human - like bodies and fish - like heads . Religion . Most kuo - toas worshiped the goddess Blibdoolpoolp , though a few remote tribes worshiped Dagon . Blibdoolpoolp was the focus of the kuo - toas ' lives , and even had her own monstrous , deformed kuo - toa breed : the giant kuo - toa leviathan . Society . Their priests could cast magic , due to the fervent belief they held in their gods manifesting itself into raw power . " Whip " was the name given to cleric s of Blibdoolpoolp . " Monitor " was the name given to those that had trained to fight with nothing but their bodies since birth . Kuo - toans maintained friendly relations with drow , their Underdark neighbours . They often raided seaside settlements for human victims , which they would often sacrifice . One of their cities was Sloopdilmonpolp , the City of Pools . Others were Looblishar and Olleth . Kuo - toa almost never wore armor , as they disliked the feel of it on their bodies .

title: Kuong Kingdom
description: Kuong Kingdom Kuong Kingdom is the southernmost state in Malatra and almost all his territory are huge wild jungle . It is thanks to this jungle Kueng always ensured by a tree . As in Laothan main terrain consists of rolling hills and steep ridges mixed with jungle .
description_long: Kuong Kingdom Kuong Kingdom is the southernmost state in Malatra and almost all his territory are huge wild jungle . It is thanks to this jungle Kueng always ensured by a tree . As in Laothan main terrain consists of rolling hills and steep ridges mixed with jungle . In the south Kuong Kingdom bordered by Himsala Mountains . The folk of the Kuong are racially akin to the Purang hill tribes . They also have brown skin and wavy hair than they differ from the more northern states . Their language is also unique and very different from those spoken around Kara - Tur . Even theirs character and manner of dress differ from other nations . Their clothes are usually light and airy so men and womans wear sarongs , wide trousers and a variety of jewelry . It is also worth noting , that the native population is much more hospitable than other nations in Malatra and unconditionally obeys to theirs government . Architecture . In the Kuong Kindom most of the buildings in villages made of wood or bamboo , and raised above the ground for protection from wild animals and monsters .

title: Kuong language
description: Kuong language Kuong was a language spoken by the people of Kuong in Malatra . Coming from a different linguistic stock to the Laothan and Purang languages also spoken in Malatra , Kuong was distinctly unlike all other languages spoken in Kara - Tur . Because it was so unique , the Kuong people believed it to be specially blessed .
description_long: Kuong language Kuong was a language spoken by the people of Kuong in Malatra . Coming from a different linguistic stock to the Laothan and Purang languages also spoken in Malatra , Kuong was distinctly unlike all other languages spoken in Kara - Tur . Because it was so unique , the Kuong people believed it to be specially blessed . However , most linguists observed that it was highly complex , followed no logic , and thought it weird . It was difficult to learn for even the most gifted minds .

title: Kupuk
description: Kupuk Kupuk , also known as walrus dogs , were creatures native to the Great Glacier and domesticated by the Ulutiun s to serve as sled - pullers . Description . At first glance , a kupuk appeared to be a cross between a walrus and a dog .
description_long: Kupuk Kupuk , also known as walrus dogs , were creatures native to the Great Glacier and domesticated by the Ulutiun s to serve as sled - pullers . Description . At first glance , a kupuk appeared to be a cross between a walrus and a dog . They were thick - bodied , with leathery skin , which had a gray , yellowish , or tan color to it . They were mostly hairless , but had a thick mane around their heads and hair on their long tails . They had two large tusks , about six inches ( fifteen centimeters ) each , and a canine face . A kupuk had four paws that were webbed and flat , with sharp claws . These allowed it to tread easily atop snow and let it swim with ease . A kupuk had a prehensile , furred tail , which it usually kept curled up in a spiral .
