The tail was five inches ( thirteen centimeters ) thick and , when fully extended , five feet ( 150 centimeters ) long . The tail also had a sharp , bony point at the tip , which could be used as a weapon by the animal . Kupuk had strong senses of smell and could track prey from up to 300 feet ( 90 meters ) away . They were so adapted to cold environments that not even magical cold effects would cause them harm .

title: Kura
description: Kura Kura was a kobun of the Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . After an attack by Black Mist yakuza on a shrine protected by Big Heads , Kura gathered around thirty like - minded yakuza to attack the Black Mist headquarters in revenge ( an attack that would probably end in tragedy ) .
description_long: Kura Kura was a kobun of the Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . After an attack by Black Mist yakuza on a shrine protected by Big Heads , Kura gathered around thirty like - minded yakuza to attack the Black Mist headquarters in revenge ( an attack that would probably end in tragedy ) . Personality . Kura was a hot - head with a charming and magnetic personality . Despite being very rash , his eloquence often convinced others to join him .

title: Kuraulyek
description: Kuraulyek Kuraulyek was the patron deity of urd s . Description . Kuraulyek appeared as a blue - skinned dragonwrought kobold or as a blue - skinned urd with feathered wings .
description_long: Kuraulyek Kuraulyek was the patron deity of urd s . Description . Kuraulyek appeared as a blue - skinned dragonwrought kobold or as a blue - skinned urd with feathered wings . Personality . Kuraulyek was deeply cowardly and would never send his single avatar outside his plane unless his chosen race was in deadly peril . More often , he would send a huge mobat to aid one of his priests instead . Relationships . Kuraulyek was said to have been raised to divinity by the dragon god Asgorath . The kobold deity Kurtulmak swore vengeance against Kuraulyek for abandoning the kobold race in their time of greatest need . Realm . Kuraulyek ' s realm was known as Urdsrest . He hid in this gloomy cave in the Barrens of Doom and Despair , seldom leaving his dismal home for fear of Kurtulmak ' s wrath . The lair was defended by a force of monstrous mobats . Worshipers . Kuraulyek ' s priests were required to help protect their and oppose those urds who worshiped Kurtulmak . They had no other specific duties .

title: Kurgoth Hellspawn
description: Kurgoth Hellspawn Kurgoth Hellspawn was a half - fiend fire giant who led the assault upon the drow city of Maerimydra and with the aid of Duneth Wharreil managed to sack the entire city . Although the drow of Maerimydra suffered from Lolth ' s Silence , leading his army of ogre s , fire giants and demon s to victory is an impressive feat nonetheless . Description .
description_long: Kurgoth Hellspawn Kurgoth Hellspawn was a half - fiend fire giant who led the assault upon the drow city of Maerimydra and with the aid of Duneth Wharreil managed to sack the entire city . Although the drow of Maerimydra suffered from Lolth ' s Silence , leading his army of ogre s , fire giants and demon s to victory is an impressive feat nonetheless . Description . Whilst other fire giants have fire colored hair or beards , Kurgoth ' s was literally made of fire with smouldering eyes to match . Outfitted with coal - black full plate armour and enormous bat - like wings , Kurgoth strikes an imposing figure . Possessions . Kurgoth carried an enormous flaming greatsword . History . In 1372 DR the Archmage of Maerimydra , Duneth Wharreil , devised a plan to overthrow the ruling clerics in the wake of Lolth ' s withdrawal . On Elient 3 , Duneth contacted Kurgoth and 20 days later Kurgoth attacked the city with his army swiftly taking the beleaguered city . Unfortuantely for both parties a complication arose , one that was fatal for Kurgoths partner Duneth .

title: Kuri Ironspike
description: Kuri Ironspike Kuri Ironspike was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Ironspike was originally a warrior from Amn who ' d fought wyvern s and gnoll s in the Snowflake Mountains .
description_long: Kuri Ironspike Kuri Ironspike was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Ironspike was originally a warrior from Amn who ' d fought wyvern s and gnoll s in the Snowflake Mountains . After venturing to Maztica , he entered into the service of Lord Drakosa but secretly worked for Captain Alanza DaNosta . In 1362 DR , he was tasked with accompanying an adventuring party hired by Drakosa to find the Cloak of One Plume . In truth , in exchange for a passage back to Faerûn , he would deliver it instead to DaNosta . Personality . Ironspike was always ready , believing all situations to be possible traps and all creatures possible dangers . He believed the Maztican s were like children in need of strong leadership , or were savages little better than orc s .

title: Kurken Garshorn
description: Kurken Garshorn Kurken Garshorn was an exiled duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Kurken ' s status as an exile caused him serious trouble with other duergar .
description_long: Kurken Garshorn Kurken Garshorn was an exiled duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Kurken ' s status as an exile caused him serious trouble with other duergar . He believed that Mantol - Derith was the only place where he could live in peace . History . Around 1479 DR , Kurken sold armor in Mantol - Derith .

title: Kurkle
description: Kurkle Kurkle was a haraknin ( hell hound canomorph ) who served as a guide and scout in the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Kurkle ' s natural form was a hell hound , but as a canomorph he could change into humanoid form .
description_long: Kurkle Kurkle was a haraknin ( hell hound canomorph ) who served as a guide and scout in the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Kurkle ' s natural form was a hell hound , but as a canomorph he could change into humanoid form . His humanoid form resembled a half - orc , with rusty red hair and a beard . In this form , he wore gray and black clothing and wielded a large scimitar . History . In 1373 DR , Kurkle was hired by Kaanyr Vhok and Zasian Menz , accompanied by Myshik Morueme , to serve as their guide through the Elemental Plane of Fire to the City of Brass . When Myshik turned on his companions , he killed Kurkle and trapped Vhok and Zasian in an extraplanar mansion .

title: Kuroda Saga
description: Kuroda Saga Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan who commanded Awa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He led ten samurai and thirty bushi at Awa village , controlling the shoen , despite the fact that the land was administrated directly from nearby Tamanokuni .
description_long: Kuroda Saga Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan who commanded Awa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He led ten samurai and thirty bushi at Awa village , controlling the shoen , despite the fact that the land was administrated directly from nearby Tamanokuni .

title: Kurplarhagoon
description: Kurplarhagoon Kurplarhagoon was the kuo - toa leader of the Blib - sanvu in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 Personality . Unfortunately , Kurplarhagoon had succumbed to the madness that affected most of the kuo - toa of Sloopdilmonpolop .
description_long: Kurplarhagoon Kurplarhagoon was the kuo - toa leader of the Blib - sanvu in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 Personality . Unfortunately , Kurplarhagoon had succumbed to the madness that affected most of the kuo - toa of Sloopdilmonpolop . His insanity manifested as a limited monomania , producing an obsessive fixation on certain individuals he believed were violent or insane . History . Kurplarhagoon was the leader of the elite Blib - sanvu , an elite order of celibate kuo - toa monitors . His duty was to control and eventually suppress all violent or insane kuo - toa in the city . His own insanity , however , caused the Blib - sanvu to sometimes spend months hunting individuals who were possibly no longer even in the city , while ignoring dangerously insane kuo - toa currently in the city .

title: Kurr
description: Kurr Kurr was a fang of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Kurr suffered from a peculiar form of demon lord – spread madness : he felt guilty for all the people he had killed .
description_long: Kurr Kurr was a fang of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Kurr suffered from a peculiar form of demon lord – spread madness : he felt guilty for all the people he had killed . He hoped to find someone who could kill him and his pack . History . At the start of the Rage of Demons , Kurr led his pack of hyena s into the Labyrinth searching for Yeenoghu . He had them feast on the corpses of his slain victims , transforming them into gnolls . They wandered the area and Kurr succumbed to madness .

title: Kurth
description: Kurth Kurth ' was the leader of Ship Kurth and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1367 DR . Due to the traditions of the High Captains , his real name was rarely used but it is highly likely that he is not the first High Captain Kurth . Along with his peers he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate .
description_long: Kurth Kurth ' was the leader of Ship Kurth and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1367 DR . Due to the traditions of the High Captains , his real name was rarely used but it is highly likely that he is not the first High Captain Kurth . Along with his peers he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate . Description . Kurth had a black beard and was hot - tempered . Relationships . Ironically , Kurth was also a former friend of Nasher before the two became bitter enemies . According to rumors , their fallout was largely due to the two ' s mutual affection for Ophala Cheldarstorn .

title: Kurth ( adventurer )
description: Kurth ( adventurer ) Kurth " Banditslayer " was an adventurer of the Vast . History . Kurth was an adventurer who earned a reputation of killing bandits , hence the nickname , and founded the town of the same name .
description_long: Kurth ( adventurer ) Kurth " Banditslayer " was an adventurer of the Vast . History . Kurth was an adventurer who earned a reputation of killing bandits , hence the nickname , and founded the town of the same name . Personality . Kurth was grim and watchful , much like the town . However , Kurth was friendly to the local dwarves and loved by them in turn . Possessions . Kurth wielded an axe .

title: Kurth ( town )
description: Kurth ( town ) Kurth , known as " Pirates ' Rest " , was a town in the Vast , located at the intersection of the Cross Road and the North Road , between Maskyr ' s Eye , Blanaer , and King ' s Reach , and at the end of the Hunt Trail from Tavilar . It sat at the northern entrance to Three Trees Pass , and east of the Beluar ' s Hunt hills . History .
description_long: Kurth ( town ) Kurth , known as " Pirates ' Rest " , was a town in the Vast , located at the intersection of the Cross Road and the North Road , between Maskyr ' s Eye , Blanaer , and King ' s Reach , and at the end of the Hunt Trail from Tavilar . It sat at the northern entrance to Three Trees Pass , and east of the Beluar ' s Hunt hills . History . The town was founded by the adventurer Kurth " Banditslayer " , who gave it its name . Kurth grew to be a large town , but its people were unable to fully defend the length of its walls , exposing them to raids by orc s . The inhabitants constructed another set of walls closer in , leaving the new " Tweenwalls " district to go to ruin . A mage in Kurth using a scrying spell was one of only two surviving witnesses to a rampage by a stag - horned lich in the Beluar ' s Hunt hills , around 1350 DR , the other being another scrying mage in Tavilar . The adventurer Feljack built the mansion of Feljack ' s Hall in the Tweenwalls area around 1347 DR . A sudden fire destroyed it one night , " circa " 1357 DR ; Feljack was not found and was thought dead .

title: Kurtulmak
description: Kurtulmak Kurtulmak was the patron deity of the kobolds , and they claimed he gave them life . After Kurtulmak created the kobolds and taught them the skills of thieving and pillaging , the gnome s entered into an eternal conflict with his creations , angering him . According to other myths , he stole the gift of sorcery from a dragon deity to give to his people .
description_long: Kurtulmak Kurtulmak was the patron deity of the kobolds , and they claimed he gave them life . After Kurtulmak created the kobolds and taught them the skills of thieving and pillaging , the gnome s entered into an eternal conflict with his creations , angering him . According to other myths , he stole the gift of sorcery from a dragon deity to give to his people . Relationships . Kurtulmak was the sworn enemy of Garl Glittergold and the other gnome gods . He was also a sworn enemy of the urd god Kuraulyek , and he was elevated to divinity by the dragon god Asgorath . History . The " Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants " recounts that in around - 24500 DR , Kurtulmak was created by the green dragon Caesinsjach as the first of the kobolds and their first leader . When the kobolds began enslaving the newly created gnome s and stealing the gemstones that contained their unborn souls , Garl Glittergold intervened by collapsing the mountain that contained the first kobold nation , Darastrixhurthi ( and this collapsed mountain eventually became known as the Shadow Sea in Netheril ) .

title: Kurush el Nayet
description: Kurush el Nayet Archdruid Kurush yn Arib el Nayet was the son of a Calishite naval captain who became a follower of Silvanus and founded the Golden Grove in Memnon with Silvanus ' miraculous blessing . History . Kurush was the son of Rysal Arib el Nayet , but not wanting to follow in his father ' s footsteps as a man of the sea , he fled as a youth to the north and became an adventurer .
description_long: Kurush el Nayet Archdruid Kurush yn Arib el Nayet was the son of a Calishite naval captain who became a follower of Silvanus and founded the Golden Grove in Memnon with Silvanus ' miraculous blessing . History . Kurush was the son of Rysal Arib el Nayet , but not wanting to follow in his father ' s footsteps as a man of the sea , he fled as a youth to the north and became an adventurer . During his adventuring days , he even explored the infamous ruins of Myth Drannor . Falling in love with the lush , green trees of the north , so different from those of his native Calimshan , he became a follower of the nature god Silvanus , a god who was then nearly unheard of in that southern land . Desiring to share his new patron with his countrymen , he returned to his home in Memnon , to his grandfather ' s estate . When he entered the garden of that villa , a miracle awaited him ; when he touched the golden sculptures of trees there , they became living trees . Kurush dedicated the garden to Silvanus and named it the Golden Grove .

title: Kurzen Brewhammer
description: Kurzen Brewhammer Kurzen Brewhammer was a dwarven fighter and member of the Blue Wyvern Company . When not adventuring , Kurzen helped his father , Tharzon Brewhammer , run the Smoke Wyrm tavern . Kurzen was knowledgeable about the ancient dwarven ruins of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff , knowledge that proved invaluable during the Blue Wyvern ' s quest to retrieve the Sarkenaegal .
description_long: Kurzen Brewhammer Kurzen Brewhammer was a dwarven fighter and member of the Blue Wyvern Company . When not adventuring , Kurzen helped his father , Tharzon Brewhammer , run the Smoke Wyrm tavern . Kurzen was knowledgeable about the ancient dwarven ruins of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff , knowledge that proved invaluable during the Blue Wyvern ' s quest to retrieve the Sarkenaegal .

title: Kushk
description: Kushk Kushk , also called the Deserted City of Kushk or Purple Kushk , was located on the west bank of the mighty Jumpa River in the Hordelands . Geography . The ruins of Kushk sat in the shadow of Mount Kus where the Old Iron Road crossed the Jumpa River through the Katakoro Shan range .
description_long: Kushk Kushk , also called the Deserted City of Kushk or Purple Kushk , was located on the west bank of the mighty Jumpa River in the Hordelands . Geography . The ruins of Kushk sat in the shadow of Mount Kus where the Old Iron Road crossed the Jumpa River through the Katakoro Shan range . The Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati was connected to the city for a long time until it fell into disrepair . Description . Kushk was divided into three sections . The first section nearest the Jumpa River was reserved for merchants from Ra - Khati who entered through a small eastern gate . Foreign traders entered Kushk through the western gate and stayed on that side of the city . The third section , located at the base of Mount Kus , was where the " unclean " priests of Bimasara resided . All three sections of Kushk were encircled by solid walls which joined to enclose the entire city . The merchant sections for Ra - Khati and foreign traders were separated by a large arcade . History . Kushk was actually an outpost of Ra - Khati , serving as a major trade city for the country by connecting it to the western regions of the Hordelands .

title: Kuskur
description: Kuskur Crown Prince Kuskur Heltharn was a regent ruler of Impiltur . Relationships . Kuskur was the third son of King Imphras II through the king ' s second wife , Rebaera Osterhown .
description_long: Kuskur Crown Prince Kuskur Heltharn was a regent ruler of Impiltur . Relationships . Kuskur was the third son of King Imphras II through the king ' s second wife , Rebaera Osterhown . He had two older step - brothers , Talryn and Lashilmbrar , and three younger brothers — the twins Velimbrar and Elphras and Fylraun . Kuskur was married to Elthinda Balindre , who was the daughter of Telflamm ' s merchant prince , and together they had a single son , named Thaum . History . Kuskur was born in the Year of Seven Trinkets , 1205 DR . After he came of age , he married his wife and moved to her home city of Telflamm . Their son was born while they were living there . Unbeknownst to Prince Kuskur , his son had aspirations to the throne of Impiltur and secretly orchestrated the murders of King Lashilmbrar ( Kuskur ' s step - brother ) , Queen Thelmara , Crown Prince Imphras III , and Prince Rilimbrar in the Year of the Deep Moon , 1294 DR . Only Rilimbrar escaped death . While Thaum failed to become king , the deaths left Rilimbrar , Thaum ' s step - cousin , as the new king of Impiltur and promoted Kuskur to become the new Crown Prince .

title: Kusphia
description: Kusphia Kusphia was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . In battle , Kusphia wore leather armor and fought with a scimitar .
description_long: Kusphia Kusphia was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . In battle , Kusphia wore leather armor and fought with a scimitar . The cultist had a silver Cult of the Dragon symbol worth 40 gp . History . Around 1489 DR , the dragonclaw was a cultist and head assistant of Talis Kasterel , at her master ' s side in the Cult ' s occupied hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains . She was devoted to Talis to the point of dying for her .

title: Kuthe
description: Kuthe Kuthe was one of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Kuthe led a patrol of the Riders .
description_long: Kuthe Kuthe was one of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Kuthe led a patrol of the Riders . He was joined by Jhessail Silventree , one of the Knights of Myth Drannor , in their effort to stop the Zhentilar armies converging on Shadowdale under the orders of Bane .

title: Kwachow
description: Kwachow Kwachow , known as the City of Melons , was the largest settlement of the Merket Depression in the Hordelands . Description . The settlement of Kwachow sat where several streams met in the otherwise dry Quoya Desert , and was famous for the large , sweet melons grown there .
description_long: Kwachow Kwachow , known as the City of Melons , was the largest settlement of the Merket Depression in the Hordelands . Description . The settlement of Kwachow sat where several streams met in the otherwise dry Quoya Desert , and was famous for the large , sweet melons grown there . Most the melons grown in the town were sent to Shou Lung , where they were highly prized among chefs for their flavor , and were even served at the Emperor ' s banquets . Despite its fame , the town was a dull place , and the winds of the Quoya Desert made the town dusty . There was little rainfall for most of the year , most of it coming from the spring storms that caused the streams to flood . Water was diverted into cisterns for use throughout the year , and was carefully rationed between the people and the fields . When water was short , the fields were given higher priority over the people of the town . Although located outside the Shou Lung empire ' s boundaries , the town was governed by a Shou Lung magistrate , his bailiffs , and a small garrison of 100 soldiers , who ruled the city from a large blockhouse located in the middle of the city .

title: Kwalu
description: Kwalu " Negus " ( Prince ) Kwalu was the son of King Osaw I and a member of the " bara e " , the seven " super - paladins " sworn to protect the holy city of Mezro in Chult before its destruction during the Spellplague . Description . Kwalu was a handsome man .
description_long: Kwalu " Negus " ( Prince ) Kwalu was the son of King Osaw I and a member of the " bara e " , the seven " super - paladins " sworn to protect the holy city of Mezro in Chult before its destruction during the Spellplague . Description . Kwalu was a handsome man . He had square features and deep eyes . He often dressed in a tobe of purple that had green triangles around his heart . In the 1360s DR , Kwalu was over 100 years old , yet , like all " barae " , he was immortal . Personality . Kwalu had a very intense personality and took very seriously his role of protector of Mezro . He admired true bravery . Abilities . Like all " barae " , Kwalu had been granted special powers from Ubtao , which included the following : If within the Temple of Ubtao , he could also cast the following spells : In addition , Kwalu possessed the terrifying power to control vast swarms of locusts . Provided he had a single locust to begin with , he could summon a cloud of the insects more than 200 yards ( 180 meters ) in width that would consume anything in their path . Possessions . Kwalu never went anywhere without being armed . His weapon of choice was usually his " kerrie " , or war club .

title: Kwan Chan Sen
description: Kwan Chan Sen Kwan Chan Sen was the Minister of War of Shou Lung . History . Kwan Chan Sen served as the head of Shou Lung ' s military , being the second most powerful man of the Empire .
description_long: Kwan Chan Sen Kwan Chan Sen was the Minister of War of Shou Lung . History . Kwan Chan Sen served as the head of Shou Lung ' s military , being the second most powerful man of the Empire . Despite his age , Kwan Chan still personally led his men in battle . He gained numerous victories against T ' u Lung , earning him the title of reincarnation of Wo Mei . He had power also over the Minister of the Sea . In time he promoted Goyat Nagumo numerous times . In 1358 DR , when the Emperor asked to him to recommend a general to pacify Chu ' Yuan province , Kwan Chan selected Goyat Nagumo . In 1359 DR Kwan Chan plotted with the Minister of State , Ju - Hai Chou , to have Yamun Khahan killed . Kwan Chan provided the hu - hsian assassin for the task . The plot failed and Yamun decided to invade Shou Lung . Kwan Chan led the first Shou army in battle against the Grand Army of the Tuigan , but was defeated at Tsen - Ching , a tributary of the Sheng - Ti river . After the Emperor replaced him with the general Batu Min Ho , of Tuigan ancestry , Kwan Chan tried to sabotage Batu . He also used his secret connections with Ju - Hai Chou , but was unsuccessful .

title: Kwan Ching Lo
description: Kwan Ching Lo Kwan Ching Lo was the Minister of Public Works of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kwan Ching Lo was appointed Minister of Public Works around 1328 DR .
description_long: Kwan Ching Lo Kwan Ching Lo was the Minister of Public Works of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kwan Ching Lo was appointed Minister of Public Works around 1328 DR . For many years , he was embarrassed by the success of Governor Kawabi of Chu ' Yuan province , who demonstrated a great ability in managing public works in his province . At last , in 1358 DR , he understood the true potential of the Gathering of the Pearls proclamation and started sending adventuring party to all uncharted areas of the Empire and supported rebuilding projects . His dream became to restore the cursed city of Kuo Meilan , an idea most of the Mandarinate were adverse to .

title: Kwan Shang - Li
description: Kwan Shang - Li Kwan Shang - Li was a young Shou monk belonging to the Standing Tree monastic order . Kwan ' s mother was an elven ranger whom his father married against his family ' s wishes . Kwan learned woodcraft and his devotion to the goddess Mielikki from his mother .
description_long: Kwan Shang - Li Kwan Shang - Li was a young Shou monk belonging to the Standing Tree monastic order . Kwan ' s mother was an elven ranger whom his father married against his family ' s wishes . Kwan learned woodcraft and his devotion to the goddess Mielikki from his mother . When Kwan was fourteen , his mother was killed by pirate s . Kwan felt great affection for his father , Kwan Yung , but their relationship was often tense and they tended to verbally spar with each other . In addition to his skills as a monk , Kwan was a respected scholar . History . Kwan and his father traveled together in the area around the Sea of Fallen Stars for many years . The monastery sent them on a mission to recover two rare and dangerous books written by Liou Chang that revealed the secret of opening teleportation gates . The books were believed to have been on the Grayling when it went down in 1399 DR . In order to locate the wreck of the Grayling , Kwan broke into the wizard Ravel Kouldar ' s tower on Pirate Isle and stole the Grayling ' s log . Kwan narrowly escaped with his life and then traveled with his father to Westgate on a ship owned by the monastery .

title: Kwan Wan Lo
description: Kwan Wan Lo Kwan Wan Lo was a kensai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Kwan Wan Lo was an aged and revered kensai who had devoted all his life to martial arts .
description_long: Kwan Wan Lo Kwan Wan Lo was a kensai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Kwan Wan Lo was an aged and revered kensai who had devoted all his life to martial arts . Around 1328 DR , he attained the title of grandmaster of the elegant and ancient style of Norayu . In 1358 DR , Kwan Wan Lo went to participate at the Komite , fulfilling a lifelong dream .

title: Kwan Yung
description: Kwan Yung Kwan Yung was a Shou monk from the Standing Tree Monastery and the father of Kwan Shang - Li . He was considered to be a great scholar . Description .
description_long: Kwan Yung Kwan Yung was a Shou monk from the Standing Tree Monastery and the father of Kwan Shang - Li . He was considered to be a great scholar . Description . Kwan Yung was short , standing only as high as his son ' s shoulder . History . As a young man he traveled all over Faerûn . He fell in love with an elven ranger and married her against his family ' s wishes . After his wife was killed by pirates , Kwan Yung traveled around the Sea of Fallen Stars on various missions for his monastery . In 1479 DR , he helped his son to recover two rare and dangerous tomes from Caelynna .

title: Ky Trencha Ukang
description: Ky Trencha Ukang The Ky Trencha Ukang was a magical staff of eldritch power from Koryo in Kara - Tur , separated into five enchanted scroll cases . History . The " Ky Trencha Ukang " was fashioned by the great wu jen Kixa To ' u several centuries before 1357 DR .
description_long: Ky Trencha Ukang The Ky Trencha Ukang was a magical staff of eldritch power from Koryo in Kara - Tur , separated into five enchanted scroll cases . History . The " Ky Trencha Ukang " was fashioned by the great wu jen Kixa To ' u several centuries before 1357 DR . But he came to fear what he had wrought and split the staff apart , transforming it into five magical scroll reels . Four of these scroll cases became lost over time . For over five centuries , only one was known to still be in existence . This was in the possession of the wu jen Yuraka of Singye in 1357 DR . Description . Separated , the staff appeared as five scroll reels , each in enameled scroll cases . Powers . The staff . The " Ky Trencha Ukang " had a variety of arcane powers . It could cast " bind " and " disguise " at will ; " fire enchantment " , " polymorph other " , and " wall of fire " each three times a day ; " wall of iron " twice a day ; and " major creation " only once a day . It could also cast " aura " once a week and " power word : stun " once a month . However , its main power was to cast " call " without the usual restrictions .

title: Kybor
description: Kybor Kybor was a sorcerer member of the Fire Knives in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities . Kybor was a member of the Fire Knives cell refuge in Tilverton and a lieutenant of Radatha .
description_long: Kybor Kybor was a sorcerer member of the Fire Knives in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities . Kybor was a member of the Fire Knives cell refuge in Tilverton and a lieutenant of Radatha . History . He , together with Radatha , agreed to join the New Alliance in order to finally kill King Azoun Obarskyr IV using the adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds . However , Kybor decided to do some research about their new allies and Tyranthraxus decided to kill him .

title: Kyjal Stardancer
description: Kyjal Stardancer Kyjal Stardancer was a Star elf who became the most promising apprentice of Mourel Duskwalker . Kyjal was the only survivor of the defeat of his master . He fell into the sea below Tir ' in ' tiral and was presumed dead .
description_long: Kyjal Stardancer Kyjal Stardancer was a Star elf who became the most promising apprentice of Mourel Duskwalker . Kyjal was the only survivor of the defeat of his master . He fell into the sea below Tir ' in ' tiral and was presumed dead . Once that part of Sildëyuir was cut off and became the Night Realm , Kyjal found his master ' s corpse and extracted his brain . He placed the brain in a jar of embalming fluid and then the jar into a chest cavity he had made in a Girallon . Then , using a technique Mourel had been working on , Kyjal animated the brain . Kyjal helped his master animate all of the corpses in the Night Realm and aided with Mourel ' s experiments for the rest of his life before trying to make himself a lich so he could serve Mourel forever . The process succeeded in killing him , but he didn ' t come back as a lich . Instead , he became a Deathlock with absolutely no memory of his past . Carving a hole in his head , he placed the remains of his spellbook , a partially shattered King ' s Tear inside so that he could still cast spells , but spent most of his time in a maceration vat .

title: Kymas Nahpret
description: Kymas Nahpret Kymas Nahpret was a vampire Red Wizard of Thay and a necromancer . History . In 1486 DR , together with Umara Ankhlab , Kymas was tasked by Szass Tam with the mission of finding the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .
description_long: Kymas Nahpret Kymas Nahpret was a vampire Red Wizard of Thay and a necromancer . History . In 1486 DR , together with Umara Ankhlab , Kymas was tasked by Szass Tam with the mission of finding the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn . When Umara and the pirate captain Anton Marivaldi finally decided to instead help Stedd in his mission for Lathander , Kymas tried to stop them but was instead killed .

title: Kymil Nimesin
description: Kymil Nimesin Kymil Nimesin is a sun elf who has earned a spotless reputation as one of the finest teachers of swordsmanship and as an eminent person at the Elven Court . History . Kymil is over 600 years old and has borne witness to the fall of Myth Drannor and the rise of the House Moonflower rulers of Evermeet .
description_long: Kymil Nimesin Kymil Nimesin is a sun elf who has earned a spotless reputation as one of the finest teachers of swordsmanship and as an eminent person at the Elven Court . History . Kymil is over 600 years old and has borne witness to the fall of Myth Drannor and the rise of the House Moonflower rulers of Evermeet . The latter event he regards as an abomination that never should have happened , considering the sun elves to be the true rulers of elvenkind . He has spent much of his life toiling endlessly to come up with a plan to kill off the royal family of Evermeet and restore the Council of Elders , which was the form of government in the days of Myth Drannor . Towards this end , he employed numerous agents and resources , including a group of gold elves he referred to as his Elite Guard , treasure taken from a dragon ' s hoard and even the dark elven goddess Lolth . His efforts had almost succeeded , and all members of the royal family but three were dead , including King Zaor Moonflower and Princess Amnestria , the mother of Arilyn Moonblade .

title: Kyone veldrin
description: Kyone veldrin Kyone Veldrin , meaning " alert in the shadows " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that was about drawing maximum advantage out of their ability to cast " darkness " . Description . As the name " alert in the shadows " suggested , the fighting style was keeping one ' s senses in shadows , in this case a drow ' s natural ability to cast " darkness " .
description_long: Kyone veldrin Kyone Veldrin , meaning " alert in the shadows " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that was about drawing maximum advantage out of their ability to cast " darkness " . Description . As the name " alert in the shadows " suggested , the fighting style was keeping one ' s senses in shadows , in this case a drow ' s natural ability to cast " darkness " . It was special because it wasn ' t about the usage of specific moves or weapons . Drow in general used their " darkness " ability for deception and battlefield control purposes during combat . A user of this style fought within the " darkness " while remaining more alert and aware about the surrounding than an enemy , thus limiting the own disadvantages to fight in the " darkness " while mitigating the advantages of the enemy in a fight in the sightless field . User of this style often cooperated with users of the " luth alur " style forming entire teams . The " kyone veldrin " users fought in the " darkness " and the " luth alur " users shot those who left down . Training . As the name suggested , would - be users needed to be more alert to pinpoint the location of enemies while being blind .

title: Kyorli
description: Kyorli Kyorli was the female rat familiar of Gromph Baenre , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Gromph and Kyorli were relatively close and affectionate with one another .
description_long: Kyorli Kyorli was the female rat familiar of Gromph Baenre , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Gromph and Kyorli were relatively close and affectionate with one another . She had a rat ' s intelligence , however , and was easily distracted . Abilities . Kyorli couldn ' t see well in the dark ( at least compared to a drow ) and was colorblind . Gromph could communicate with her mentally . , and even concentrate to see through her eyes . History . In 1372 DR , Kyorli aided Gromph in escaping from the lichdrow Dyrr ' s " imprisonment " spell . She temporarily acted as Gromph ' s eyes after he was blinded by his attack on Nimor Imphraezl . When Gromph received an eye transplant , Gromph forced Kyorli to eat out his blind eyes so that Jaemas Xorlarrin could cast a spell to transplant the newly retrieved eyes to Gromph . Appendix . Notes . Kyorli ' s name may have come from the Drow word " kyorl " , meaning " to watch . "

title: Kyorlin plynn
description: Kyorlin plynn Kyorlin plynn , meaning " watch and take " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was used to defeat enemies without killing them . Description .
description_long: Kyorlin plynn Kyorlin plynn , meaning " watch and take " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was used to defeat enemies without killing them . Description . As the name " watch and take " suggested , the fighting style was about fighting defensively and then disarming the enemy . The purpose of this style was to fight defensively but efficiently to buy time and reduce the fighting power of the enemy . This was done with the goal of capturing the enemy alive ; for example , for interrogation . Users were employed in practically in every drow combat group . Their role was to fight the strongest enemy and to keep that one busy through disarming , all to buy time for the others to defeat all other enemies and then join forces in defeating the strongest enemy . Training . Users of this style often learned the " jivvin golhyrr " style , another style that focused on defeating an enemy but not necessarily killing them . Reputation . The style was learned by two kinds of drow — conservative fighter s and cleric s of Lolth — but their motivations for learning it were different from the ground up .

title: Kyra
description: Kyra Kyra was an adventurer who had just arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Kyra was a laconic individual with great combat and survival skills .
description_long: Kyra Kyra was an adventurer who had just arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Kyra was a laconic individual with great combat and survival skills . She did not agree at all with Florio ' s style of command . Relationships . Kyra was a human ranger who , with her friends the Turami warrior Florio , dwarven cleric Rorik Ironheart , and elven druid Nualion Galanodel , decided to form an adventuring party in Selgaunt . History . In 1491 DR , they went to Mulmaster with the intention of exploring some dwarven ruins in the Earthspur Mountains , but the city watch sergeant , Audra Maskyr , hired them to explore the city ' s sewers instead . During the exploration , they fought some large rat s and lost Rorik Ironheart in a flood . At that point , Kyra and the others met another adventuring party sent by Sergeant Maskyr , and , with their help , Kyra and her companions exited from the sewers .

title: Kyriani Agrivar
description: Kyriani Agrivar Kyriani Agrivar was a half - drow wizard of Waterdeep . She was a member of the Moonstars , a Lord of Waterdeep , and the third Blackstaff . < ref name = " Cite book / BT - p ?
description_long: Kyriani Agrivar Kyriani Agrivar was a half - drow wizard of Waterdeep . She was a member of the Moonstars , a Lord of Waterdeep , and the third Blackstaff . < ref name = " Cite book / BT - p ? ? " > < / ref > Personality . The first Kyriani was a wholly good being , denying the natural dark side of her being . Kyriani didn ' t like to see her friends get hurt , nor would she leave them to face danger , even if there was a greater need . The second Kyriani was more accepting of her dark side , and felt able to choose her destiny . Description . Around 1357 DR , Kyriani appeared to be a tall and slender half - elf woman , quite beautiful , with pointed ears and pale skin , despite her drow heritage . Other details of her appearance varied with her incarnation . The first incarnation of Kyriani had a large mane of long , curly , light - brown hair , with violet or blue eyes . The second had even longer hair , night black and filled with stars , with a streak of white hair in front . Her eyes were blue . By 1372 DR , Kyriani had darker - hued skin and gray eyes and was considered very attractive . She had long silver - white hair that she generally wore pulled away from her face .

title: Kyrill Nederlok
description: Kyrill Nederlok Kyrill Nederlok was an officer of the Flaming Fist . He first joined the group as a mercenary at the group ' s founding in 1345 DR . In time , he rose through the ranks and was promoted to marshal around 1362 DR .
description_long: Kyrill Nederlok Kyrill Nederlok was an officer of the Flaming Fist . He first joined the group as a mercenary at the group ' s founding in 1345 DR . In time , he rose through the ranks and was promoted to marshal around 1362 DR . Marshal Nederlok led the Flaming Fist troop during the around 1368 DR .

title: Kyrin Hawkwinter
description: Kyrin Hawkwinter Her Excellency , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter was the Countess of Calimmon in Tethyr and Horselady of Her Majesty ' s Cavalry . She was known as a superb rider , horse breeder , and military strategist , with a strong will . History .
description_long: Kyrin Hawkwinter Her Excellency , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter was the Countess of Calimmon in Tethyr and Horselady of Her Majesty ' s Cavalry . She was known as a superb rider , horse breeder , and military strategist , with a strong will . History . While Tethyrian by descent , Kyrin was not of noble Tethyrian blood and in fact was born and raised outside of Tethyr in the city of Waterdeep . She was a member of that cities ' Hawkwinter Clan , being its sixth child and second daughter . In 1360 DR , Kyrin met the future queen of Tethyr , Zaranda Star , and fought with her against the Tuigan Horde . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , when Prince Haedrak III entered Waterdeep and was announced as Tethyr ' s rightful heir , Kyrin was one of those who joined his army and took control of its cavalry , many of whom were provided by Lord Zelphar Thann . After the Reclamation Wars , Queen Zaranda granted her and her descendants the county of Calimmon . As Horselady , the commander of Tethyr ' s cavalry , Kyrin served under Lady Vajra Valmeyjar , the Royal Warlady of Tethyr . Holdings . Kyrin ' s home was " el Daraqadim " , which she preferred to call " the Cliff " .

title: Kyriusho
description: Kyriusho Kyriusho was a greater spirit of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Kyriusho was an aloof and arrogant individual but fair - minded in truth .
description_long: Kyriusho Kyriusho was a greater spirit of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Kyriusho was an aloof and arrogant individual but fair - minded in truth . Activities . Kyriusho was the spirit of the volcano of Fochu Peninsula . He used to meditate inside the crater . History . In ancient times villagers of Fochu Peninsula occasionally offered sacrifices to Kyriusho win his favor . In 1358 DR , he was disturbed by the arrive of the wu jen Setsu Iki . At first he believed him an un - request sacrifice . In truth Setsu wanted use the power of the volcano to end the menace of Za - Jikku .

title: Kyrlraun
description: Kyrlraun Kyrlraun was a paladin of Ilmater and the leading member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . He was in effect the true ruler of Impiltur because the Queen - Regent Sambryl always sought Kyrlraun ' s advice in state affairs .
description_long: Kyrlraun Kyrlraun was a paladin of Ilmater and the leading member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . He was in effect the true ruler of Impiltur because the Queen - Regent Sambryl always sought Kyrlraun ' s advice in state affairs . His biggest concern was the situation in Damara . Personality . Kyrlraun had a lot in common with Gareth Dragonsbane , as both were paladins with a great understanding of common people and with great tolerance .

title: Kyrnill Melarn
description: Kyrnill Melarn Kyrnill Melarn ( formerly known as Kyrnill Kenafin ) was formerly the matron mother of House Kenafin in Menzoberranzan and later the First Priestess of House Melarn . History . Starting before 1361 DR and lasting until 1383 DR , Kyrnill Kenafin served as the matron mother of House Kenafin .
description_long: Kyrnill Melarn Kyrnill Melarn ( formerly known as Kyrnill Kenafin ) was formerly the matron mother of House Kenafin in Menzoberranzan and later the First Priestess of House Melarn . History . Starting before 1361 DR and lasting until 1383 DR , Kyrnill Kenafin served as the matron mother of House Kenafin . When House Kenafin and House Horlbar merged to form House Melarn , Kyrnill allowed Zhindia Horlbar to assume leadership of the house , expecting that Zhindia would die in a power struggle . Zhindia survived , however , and as First Priestess , Kyrnill found great pleasure in seeing Zhindia ' s power undermined .

title: Kysaer Whitemantle
description: Kysaer Whitemantle Kysaer Whitemantle , also known as the Rider in White , was the most famous assassin in the Sea of Fallen Stars and secretly a member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Possessions . Kysaer was known to use " Elquillar " , the famed " Sword of Many Faces " .
description_long: Kysaer Whitemantle Kysaer Whitemantle , also known as the Rider in White , was the most famous assassin in the Sea of Fallen Stars and secretly a member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Possessions . Kysaer was known to use " Elquillar " , the famed " Sword of Many Faces " . History . As an independent agent , Kysaer was hired by most of the governments of the Inner Sea , usually to kill evil people . This he kept his association with the Night Masks a very closely guarded secret . Despite this , he managed to develop a network of local contacts . Kysaer had an technical approach to killing , instead of a brutal one .

title: Kyuss
description: Kyuss Kyuss , also known as the Worm that Walks , was an Elder evil prophesied to usher in the " Age of Worms " , a time when the undead will rise and destroy the world . Description . The Worm that Walks was a 30 feet ( 9 meters ) tall giant composed of a shifting mass of maggots and worms filled with the psychic imprint of a former demigod named Kyuss .
description_long: Kyuss Kyuss , also known as the Worm that Walks , was an Elder evil prophesied to usher in the " Age of Worms " , a time when the undead will rise and destroy the world . Description . The Worm that Walks was a 30 feet ( 9 meters ) tall giant composed of a shifting mass of maggots and worms filled with the psychic imprint of a former demigod named Kyuss . History . The true story of the being known as the Worm that Walks was a mystery to scholars . The only known fact all agreed on was that the Worm that Walks was originally a demigod called Kyuss , who had lived in the ancient past as a mortal necromancer and created many aberrant undead creatures , such as the Spawn of Kyuss that plagued the Underdark . Eventually , Kyuss wickedness made his contemporaries to exile him to the fringes of society . Rather than languishing as an outcast , he became the prophet of a wicked cult who believed in the dreaded Age of Worms . During this time Kyuss discovered the ruins of a dead civilization in an island near Maztica , known as the Wormcrawl Island by the elves of Evermeet , and claimed the site as its own , where he ruled as a god - king .

title: Kâras
description: Kâras Kâras was a drow divine seeker and priest of Vhaeraun and a member of the Hidden from Maerimydra . After Vhaeraun ' s death , he switched his allegiance to Eilistraee . He died while under her employment , but somehow revived at some point around the Second Sundering .
description_long: Kâras Kâras was a drow divine seeker and priest of Vhaeraun and a member of the Hidden from Maerimydra . After Vhaeraun ' s death , he switched his allegiance to Eilistraee . He died while under her employment , but somehow revived at some point around the Second Sundering . He then resumed his position among the Hidden and among the followers of Vhaeraun . Description . Thin yet muscular , Karas ' left side of his face was badly scarred . Personality . Karas was a thoroughly evil individual while he venerated Vhaeraun and viewed others he worked alongside as merely handy pawns . He presented an amiable face when dealing with most people , all the while furthering his own plans . He was the owner of a strong mental that allowed him to conduct passive resistance . During his days as a member of the church of Eilistraee , he conducted passive resistance against eilistraeean sexist and elitist mind set .

title: LaValle
description: LaValle LaValle was a competent wizard who was one of the lieutenants of Pasha Pook in Calimport . Personality . LaValle explained to both Drizzt Do ' Urden and Artemis Entreri that his loyalty was first and foremost to the organization itself , not to a particular leader , so he served loyally someone that cared about the guild .
description_long: LaValle LaValle was a competent wizard who was one of the lieutenants of Pasha Pook in Calimport . Personality . LaValle explained to both Drizzt Do ' Urden and Artemis Entreri that his loyalty was first and foremost to the organization itself , not to a particular leader , so he served loyally someone that cared about the guild . He had no more ambition , and considering that he survived longer than most members of Calimport ' s criminal networks this seemed a good strategy . History . LaValle was a lieutenant in Pasha Pook ' s guild for a long time and knew Artemis Entreri very well . Under the orders of his boss , he was involved in fighting with the Companions of the Hall searching for Regis . Thank to his powerful magical artifact , the Taros Hoop , LaValle sent the heroes to the plane of Tarterus . To his great surprise , Drizzt Do ' Urden and his friends came back , smashing the Taros Loop in the process . LaValle surrendered . Later , LaValle became a lieutenant of the new guildmaster , Regis . Some years later , Artemis again met LaValle , now a lieutenant of a new guildmaster . LaValle told Enteri that his new boss was a good man .

title: Laal
description: Laal Laal was a flumph living in the Underdark beneathe Mulmaster . Personality . Laal was a polite and truthful creature .
description_long: Laal Laal was a flumph living in the Underdark beneathe Mulmaster . Personality . Laal was a polite and truthful creature . She greatly loved her companion Xol and was shocked by his death . History . Laal lived with her companion Xol in the Underdark below Earthspur Mountains . In 1491 DR , Xol noticed a group of troglodyte s moving to Mulmaster ' s sewers . He convinced Laal to follow them in order to warn others about this menace . While following the troglodytes , Xol singled out the mind of a particularly evil human . Xol tried to follow this man but was killed in an ambush . His body fell into the sewers and ended up being carried to the surface where it was discovered by some children . Laal tried to mentally contact first one of the children and afterwards the adventurer Florio but with little success . At this point , Laal was attacked by some lacedon s , but an adventuring party hired by the city watch sergeant Audra Maskyr then arrived . They had been sent to investigate the appearance of Xol ' s body .

title: Laaqueel
description: Laaqueel Laaqueel was the malenti priestess of Sekolah who freed Iakhovas . History . Laaqueel was a malenti born with a very unusual pink skin , resembling a surface elf rather than a sea elf .
description_long: Laaqueel Laaqueel was the malenti priestess of Sekolah who freed Iakhovas . History . Laaqueel was a malenti born with a very unusual pink skin , resembling a surface elf rather than a sea elf . For this reason , the leader of her sahuagin colony , Baron Huaanton , decided not to train her as spy . Instead , Laaqueel joined the clergy of Sekolah under Senior Priestess Ghaataag . While Laaqueel traveled on surface world , she discovered the legend of the One Who Swims with Sekolah . She devoted herself to finding the truth behind the legends , and finally in 1354 DR , she found Iakhovas in Chult . She agreed to ally with Iakhovas and took him to her colony , where he infiltrated the colony as a normal sahuagin . Always with Laaqueel at his side , Iakhovas rose within the ranks of sahaugin society , even manipulating Huaanton . Laaqueel was considered Iakhovas ' high priestess . However in the last part of the Twelfth Seros War Laaqueel discovered that she had blessed by Eldath , no by Sekolah , and was Eldath ' s voice that had guided her choices . Personality . Laaqueel was a true believer in Sekolah . The Shark God granted her a place and a purpose .

title: Lab
description: Lab Lab was a she - mule and the constant companion of Saleem the architect in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Relationships . Lab and Saleem were inseparable .
description_long: Lab Lab was a she - mule and the constant companion of Saleem the architect in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Relationships . Lab and Saleem were inseparable . Saleem talked constantly with his hoofed companion while walking around the city . Though quite a few citizens of Huzuz thought Saleem was insane , some speculated that Lab was actually his " polymorphed " lover or even a genie disguised as a mule . Personality . Lab was a quiet individual .

title: Labak Craumerdaun
description: Labak Craumerdaun Labak Craumerdaun was the commander of the Amnian Council Army garrison in Eshpurta , and because of this he also held an advisory position with the ruling body of Eshpurta , the Shield Council . With his forceful personality and desire for what was best for his troops , he often got what he wanted out of the Shield Council , most of whom did not want to lose favor with the commander - in - chief of 18 , 000 troops within the city walls .
description_long: Labak Craumerdaun Labak Craumerdaun was the commander of the Amnian Council Army garrison in Eshpurta , and because of this he also held an advisory position with the ruling body of Eshpurta , the Shield Council . With his forceful personality and desire for what was best for his troops , he often got what he wanted out of the Shield Council , most of whom did not want to lose favor with the commander - in - chief of 18 , 000 troops within the city walls .

title: Labelas Enoreth
description: Labelas Enoreth Labelas Enoreth , or the Lord of the Continuum , was the chaotic good elven deity who governed the orderly passage of time and guarded against those who would alter the path of history . Together with Sehanine Moonbow , he oversaw the long life span of the elves and their lives after they had left the mortal realms . His symbol was the setting sun .
description_long: Labelas Enoreth Labelas Enoreth , or the Lord of the Continuum , was the chaotic good elven deity who governed the orderly passage of time and guarded against those who would alter the path of history . Together with Sehanine Moonbow , he oversaw the long life span of the elves and their lives after they had left the mortal realms . His symbol was the setting sun . Description . Labelas manifested as an androgynous elf with silver - colored hair and a single misty gray eye - the other was covered by an eyepatch . He wore multi - colored robes of blue , gray , green and white . On rare occasions , he appeared as a mist that aged or , more commonly , revitalized creatures and objects he enveloped . Personality . He was a philosopher , a patient teacher , and an instructor who gave wisdom and knowledge to young and old alike . Labelas showed his desires through subtle means and rewarded those who pleased him with rare gems and valuable stones . Realm . Labelas ' s divine realm was known as the Vanishing Tower . For the vast majority of the time , the Vanishing Tower was not visible on Arvandor .

title: Labyrinth
description: Labyrinth The Labyrinth was an ancient maze of tunnels in the Northdark . Geography . The Labyrinth covered a large area of the Upperdark and Middledark beneath the Dessarin River and beyond .
description_long: Labyrinth The Labyrinth was an ancient maze of tunnels in the Northdark . Geography . The Labyrinth covered a large area of the Upperdark and Middledark beneath the Dessarin River and beyond . It connected the northern region of the Underdark to elsewhere in the south . The Labyrinth was located some 100 miles south and west of the Darklake and Gracklstugh . . Description . The Labyrinth was a network of lava tubes tunnels made of cold black basalt . There were some paths and bridges . Depending on who was describing it , the tunnels either spanned 100 miles north to south and more than 50 miles east to west , or 200 miles north to south and almost 100 mile east to west . Runes were carved into the tunnels to guide travelers , but few could read them . There were a number of rifts that cut through the Labyrinth , so many tunnels emptied into massive chasms or dead - ended . Some staircases have been carved into stone to overcome these chasms .

title: Lac Dinneshere
description: Lac Dinneshere Lac Dinneshere was one of the three lakes of Icewind Dale in the Frozenfar of the Sword Coast North that the Ten Towns clustered around . Geography . Most of the shoreline of Lac Dinneshere was rocky bluffs and barren tundra .
description_long: Lac Dinneshere Lac Dinneshere was one of the three lakes of Icewind Dale in the Frozenfar of the Sword Coast North that the Ten Towns clustered around . Geography . Most of the shoreline of Lac Dinneshere was rocky bluffs and barren tundra . All year round , the waters of Lac Dinneshere were cold enough to kill in minutes anyone entering the lake . Inhabitants . Lac Dinneshere was one of three known places where the knucklehead trout live , the other two being the lake of Maer Dualdon and Redwaters .

title: Ladies of the Green Shield
description: Ladies of the Green Shield The Ladies of the Green Shield was an adventuring company that operated in the Vast in the 1360s DR . The Ladies of the Green Shield were all slain outside the city of Calaunt in Mirtul of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Some believed they ' d happened upon a band of drow one evening , perhaps the same drow spotted lurking on the streets of Calaunt at nights .
description_long: Ladies of the Green Shield The Ladies of the Green Shield was an adventuring company that operated in the Vast in the 1360s DR . The Ladies of the Green Shield were all slain outside the city of Calaunt in Mirtul of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Some believed they ' d happened upon a band of drow one evening , perhaps the same drow spotted lurking on the streets of Calaunt at nights .

title: Ladok
description: Ladok Ladok was an efreetikin who worked within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ladok assisted his master , the sha ' ir Wadi ' a bint Sali , in her duties to the Grand Vizier .
description_long: Ladok Ladok was an efreetikin who worked within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ladok assisted his master , the sha ' ir Wadi ' a bint Sali , in her duties to the Grand Vizier . Relationships . Ladok was Wadi ' a ' s familiar .

title: Laduguer
description: Laduguer Laduguer , also known as The Exile , the Gray Protector and Master of Crafts was the lawful evil dwarven deity of the duergar . Ever since he was cast out from the rest of the Mordinsamman , Laduguer has harboured a bitter resentment , viewing the rest of the pantheon as layabouts more concerned with outdated tradition than with progress . However , his doctrine taught obedience to one ' s leader , empowerment through the exploitation of slaves , enrichment through the creation of magical weapons and protection through an unforgiving military program .
description_long: Laduguer Laduguer , also known as The Exile , the Gray Protector and Master of Crafts was the lawful evil dwarven deity of the duergar . Ever since he was cast out from the rest of the Mordinsamman , Laduguer has harboured a bitter resentment , viewing the rest of the pantheon as layabouts more concerned with outdated tradition than with progress . However , his doctrine taught obedience to one ' s leader , empowerment through the exploitation of slaves , enrichment through the creation of magical weapons and protection through an unforgiving military program . He was xenophobic , urging his followers to avoid contact with other races save for limited trade and slave raids . Worshipers . The duergar did not differentiate between secular and religious authority , so Laduguer ' s clergy served as the nominal rulers of society . They were known as the " thuldor " - a dwarven term meaning " those who endure " and they kept the race united and powerful against the other races of the Underdark . They were expected to serve in the military . Many temples included large stables used to care for and breed steeders - large , monstrous riding spiders . Relationships .

title: Lady ' s Hall
description: Lady ' s Hall The Lady ' s Hall was a temple of Tymora in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . The temple of Lady Luck was run by the human cleric , Chanthalas Ulbright and the congregation consisted of twenty - four clerics and sixty - nine followers .
description_long: Lady ' s Hall The Lady ' s Hall was a temple of Tymora in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . The temple of Lady Luck was run by the human cleric , Chanthalas Ulbright and the congregation consisted of twenty - four clerics and sixty - nine followers .

title: Lady ' s Hand Monastery
description: Lady ' s Hand Monastery The Lady ' s Hand Monastery was a temple dedicated to Loviatar on Ladypeak . History . In the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR , the tower of Lady ' s Hand collapsed under the attacks of a Morueme dragon , which was later torn asunder mid - flight by the monks ' Netherese magic .
description_long: Lady ' s Hand Monastery The Lady ' s Hand Monastery was a temple dedicated to Loviatar on Ladypeak . History . In the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR , the tower of Lady ' s Hand collapsed under the attacks of a Morueme dragon , which was later torn asunder mid - flight by the monks ' Netherese magic . After that , more Morueme dragons destroyed most of the buildings in the monastery but were unable to wipe out the monks who , in the meantime , retreated into the caves . The Moruemes then sent a small army of hobgoblin s to execute the final assault , but the monks prevailed once again . However , winter likely drove the monks out . Activities . About ninety priests ( human and half - elf ) resided in this fortified temple and in the caves under the abbey . These monk s were able to repel attacks by orc s and other monsters using ancient Netherese magic . The monks had a bad reputation in the surrounding area , because travelers passing by tended to disappear mysteriously . After the dragon assault , High Whipmistress Lorthalae Shamrass ruled a clergy just over forty strong , who were involved in rebuilding the fortress .

title: Lady ' s Happy Hall
description: Lady ' s Happy Hall The Lady ' s Happy Hall was a temple of Tymora in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Organization . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Priest Orn Thavil , with 24 subordinate priests and 16 lay - followers .
description_long: Lady ' s Happy Hall The Lady ' s Happy Hall was a temple of Tymora in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Organization . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Priest Orn Thavil , with 24 subordinate priests and 16 lay - followers . The high priest was referred to as " Hierarch " . The priesthood of The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho were under the authority of the Lady ' s Happy Hall temple . History . In Marpenoth of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , when Procampur was struck by the featherlung plague , Thavil worked with High Priest Baniya Dolester of Lliira and set up auxiliary shrines in the District of the Poor to treat the sick there . Though their actions halted the spread of the disease , the Thultyrl reprimanded both high priests for breaking Procampur ' s district rules , and were reminded that the city and its laws were older than a number of deities . Around Kythorn of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , a convoy secretly transported the " torque of faith " , a holy item of Tymora , to The Lady ' s Favor temple in Sevenecho .

title: Lady Quallem
description: Lady Quallem Lady Quallem was a female human and once the head of the Quallem family before she arose as a ghost in the Dordrien crypts . Description . Lady Quallem had a regal look about her and dressed in gowns both elegant and long .
description_long: Lady Quallem Lady Quallem was a female human and once the head of the Quallem family before she arose as a ghost in the Dordrien crypts . Description . Lady Quallem had a regal look about her and dressed in gowns both elegant and long . Abilities . Although not any great threat in life , she became quite a potent ghost in undeath . Any who viewed her were open to her horrific appearance that could weaken even hardy heroes . In addition , as a ghost , Lady Quallem had the power to possess and animate a statue bearing her likeness in her tomb , which she could put to crushing affect against would - be tomb robbers . History . Some time during the rule of Dordrien before its fall in - 75 DR , Lady Quallem rose to prominence as the head of the Quallem family . Eventually , she died and her body was interred in the family crypts amid the Dagger Hills along with her eccentric son , a noted wizard . However , Lady Quallem later rose as a restless spirit , prevented from passing on to the afterlife until her last descendant was buried beside her . Even as late as 1372 DR , her crypt had not been broken into thanks to a rather potent death - dealing spell trap .

title: Laele Dhuurniv
description: Laele Dhuurniv Laele Dhuurniv was a female drow and the Matron mother of House Dhuurniv of Maerimydra . History . Prior to the Weeping War , matron mother Laele Dhuurniv led the Maerimyra n forces who wished to reclaim the Land Under Shadow .
description_long: Laele Dhuurniv Laele Dhuurniv was a female drow and the Matron mother of House Dhuurniv of Maerimydra . History . Prior to the Weeping War , matron mother Laele Dhuurniv led the Maerimyra n forces who wished to reclaim the Land Under Shadow . Weeping War . In 712 DR , she accepted the Spider ' s Truce which Aolis Ildacer offered the drow . However after battling alongside the elves in numerous battles against the Army of Darkness , Laele was eventually killed in 713 DR by Aolis ' s wife , Amara Ildacar , thereby ending the truce . After her death , her three daughters , Aunrae , Greyanna and Xullrae , took over leadership of House Dhuurniv .

title: Laele Zauviir
description: Laele Zauviir Laele Zauviir , most knew as Streea ' Valsharess Zauviir , was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . In 1379 DR Streea ' Valsharess together with her nephew Guldor Zauviir and T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl devised a scheme to gain more power in the Conclave of Sshamath but failed .
description_long: Laele Zauviir Laele Zauviir , most knew as Streea ' Valsharess Zauviir , was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . In 1379 DR Streea ' Valsharess together with her nephew Guldor Zauviir and T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl devised a scheme to gain more power in the Conclave of Sshamath but failed . Later they discussed about why their plot failed . T ' lar killed Guldor and vanished and the blame for the killing fell to Streea ' Valsharess . After T ' lar killed also Streea ' Valsharess and took control of her temple .

title: Laelran Aelorothi
description: Laelran Aelorothi Laelran Aelorothi was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Laelran had a quasit familiar , Noxit , who helped him in his deception .
description_long: Laelran Aelorothi Laelran Aelorothi was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Laelran had a quasit familiar , Noxit , who helped him in his deception . History . In 1370 DR , Laelran posed as a human wizard called Sorndyrn Scarlethsash and joined the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan in order to keep an eye inside the organization .

title: Laeral ' s dancing dweomer
description: Laeral ' s dancing dweomer Laeral ' s dancing dweomer was an illusion / phantasm that obfuscated magic auras , confusing any attempt to use " detect magic " spells or abilities . Effects . This spell created twenty false magic auras that flickered from object to object within the effected area , creating or masking auras on items as they went .
description_long: Laeral ' s dancing dweomer Laeral ' s dancing dweomer was an illusion / phantasm that obfuscated magic auras , confusing any attempt to use " detect magic " spells or abilities . Effects . This spell created twenty false magic auras that flickered from object to object within the effected area , creating or masking auras on items as they went . Attempting to " detect magic " revealed that all items in the area had a magic aura that winked on and off , making true determination impossible . The spell could cover a sphere of 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) radius and be cast at a range of 20 yd ( 18 . 3 m ) plus increments of 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) according to the experience of the caster . The spell lasted for a minimum of 50 minutes and longer for more experienced casters . It was possible for a seeker to overcome this spell with sufficient resistance and it did not fool " true sight " . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components to cast , as well as a pinch of dust tossed in the air for the material component .

title: Laeral ' s spell shield
description: Laeral ' s spell shield Laeral ' s spell shield was a magical shield named after the creator of the first item of this type , Laeral Silverhand . It was a " + 1 large steel shield " that gave its bearer a moderate resistance against force - based spells . It costed 9170 gold piece s .
description_long: Laeral ' s spell shield Laeral ' s spell shield was a magical shield named after the creator of the first item of this type , Laeral Silverhand . It was a " + 1 large steel shield " that gave its bearer a moderate resistance against force - based spells . It costed 9170 gold piece s .

title: Laeral ' s storm armor
description: Laeral ' s storm armor Laeral ' s storm armor is a magic full plate armor made from an unknown non - metallic material , rumoured to be from another plane . It gives its wearer resistance to electricity and fire , and an immunity to the movement effects caused by strong winds . It can sell for in excess of 60 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Laeral ' s storm armor Laeral ' s storm armor is a magic full plate armor made from an unknown non - metallic material , rumoured to be from another plane . It gives its wearer resistance to electricity and fire , and an immunity to the movement effects caused by strong winds . It can sell for in excess of 60 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Laeral ' s tears
description: Laeral ' s tears Laeral ' s tears was the Realms name for , named after the famous sorceress Laeral Silverhand . Description . This gemstone was soft and brittle but deposits often produced large crystals which could be facet cut into impressive colorless gems that held a glossy , lustrous shine .
description_long: Laeral ' s tears Laeral ' s tears was the Realms name for , named after the famous sorceress Laeral Silverhand . Description . This gemstone was soft and brittle but deposits often produced large crystals which could be facet cut into impressive colorless gems that held a glossy , lustrous shine . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 to 200 gp . Powers . It was a little known fact that this fancy stone was one of the " nine secrets " that could be turned into an " Ioun stone " . Of the nine gems , Laeral ' s tears was the rarest . The upper echelons of the witches of Rashemen had a secret use for this gem . Through a complicated process of treatment and spellcasting , Laeral ' s tears could instantaneously heal wounds sustained in battle . The subject had to be wearing the gem for the protection to work , and once it healed its quota of damage , the stone shattered and became useless .

title: Laeral Silverhand
description: Laeral Silverhand Laeral Silverhand was known as the Lady Mage of Waterdeep . Together with her partner Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun they lead the Moonstars , a dissident faction of the Harpers , which sought to arrange the destiny of the cities and nation of the North . Appearance .
description_long: Laeral Silverhand Laeral Silverhand was known as the Lady Mage of Waterdeep . Together with her partner Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun they lead the Moonstars , a dissident faction of the Harpers , which sought to arrange the destiny of the cities and nation of the North . Appearance . Like all of the Seven Sisters , Laeral was enchantingly beautiful . She was roughly six feet tall , thin and had long silver hair which she kept out of her face with a silver circlet . Large , emerald green eyes completed her gorgeous features and she was liable to blush profusely when paid an honest compliment on her appearance . She was equally comfortable wearing leathers , roughspun , the latest and most extravagant fashions or even nothing at all . Biography . After their mother died , Laeral , Dove and Storm were placed into the care of Elminster until they came of age . When her sisters left the Old Sage , Laeral elected to stay with him as his apprentice . When she had finished her studies , she left to join the Harpers . Laeral left the Harpers early and , at the age of 41 , Laeral was a self - styled queen , ruling the realm of Stornanter from Port Llast .

title: Laerekh
description: Laerekh Laerekh was a male drow sorcerer and the Chief Necromancer of the cult of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra . Description . Taller than most male drow , Laerekh was almost as tall as a surface elf .
description_long: Laerekh Laerekh was a male drow sorcerer and the Chief Necromancer of the cult of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra . Description . Taller than most male drow , Laerekh was almost as tall as a surface elf . Handsome and perfumed with a sweet , musty scent , Laerekh wrapped himself in an ample robe . His clothing strongly favored blues : over his shoulders hung a cloak of midnight blue ; around his neck was an amulet crafted from a glittering blue dragon scale ; and both the " ring " and bracers he wore were decorated with lapis lazuli . Personality . He bore a formidable presence that could make those around him visibly shake . Laerekh was particularly focused when it came to his necromantic studies and tolerated no interruptions . If disturbed , he could easily fly into an unrelenting fury . On the rare occasions he ventured away from his study chambers , Laerekh was decidedly more cowardly and had little desire to risk his life . Abilities . A talented sorcerer with a strong focus on necromancy , Laerekh was able to cast spells such as " circle of death " , " finger of death " , " Grimwald ' s graymantle " quite readily .

title: Lagiluri
description: Lagiluri Lagiluri was a small village located in Ra - Khati . Geography . Lagiluri was located near the mighty Jumpa River in the foothills of the Katakoro Shan range in northwestern Ra - Khati .
description_long: Lagiluri Lagiluri was a small village located in Ra - Khati . Geography . Lagiluri was located near the mighty Jumpa River in the foothills of the Katakoro Shan range in northwestern Ra - Khati . Description . The only buildings in the village were a dozen white - washed houses and a three - story red monastery . The monks of the village cultivated fields of green peas and golden barley . The farmland was fed by numerous streams from the river . Inhabitants . Abbot Thongi SamBhota was the spiritual leader of the village .

title: Lahnis
description: Lahnis Lahnis was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lahnis ' s faith in Szass Tam had begun to flag ; he was no longer certain that Tam ' s plot was the best for Thay .
description_long: Lahnis Lahnis was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lahnis ' s faith in Szass Tam had begun to flag ; he was no longer certain that Tam ' s plot was the best for Thay . He was intrigued by the Thayan Resurrection rebel group but never joined them . He was too scared that Tam ' s faithful controlled him . History . Lahnis was a Red wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault under Thaymount . He was tasked with training the Thayan warriors there . When , in 1486 DR , the heroes of Daggerford arrived , Lahnis at first thought they were troublemaker agents sent by Szass Tam to test his loyalty . Eventually , the heroes persuaded him to defect to the Thayan Resurrection and Lahnis helped defeat his former subordinates . He later told the adventurers about the dungeon .

title: Lai Angesstun
description: Lai Angesstun Lai Angesstun was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lai was fixated with money .
description_long: Lai Angesstun Lai Angesstun was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lai was fixated with money . He talked only about how much he would make , how he spent it , and how others would envy him . He was selfish and never used his money to help someone else . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR in order to travel to Waterdeep , he joined a great caravan with his scented cooking oil and perfumes . Unknown to him , the caravan was full of agents of the Cult of the Dragon transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Lailuu Gyrrite
description: Lailuu Gyrrite Lailuu Gyrrite was the governor of Zalasuu in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Lailuu spent less time governing her city and more time making preparations for Halruaa ' s defense .
description_long: Lailuu Gyrrite Lailuu Gyrrite was the governor of Zalasuu in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Lailuu spent less time governing her city and more time making preparations for Halruaa ' s defense . The close proximity of Zalasuu to the Kilmaruu Swamp gave her ample opportunities to test her defenses . Lailuu was also a high ranking priestess of Mystra , and a member of the Council of Elders .

title: Lair of the Hidden
description: Lair of the Hidden The Lair of the Hidden was once an inn in Maerimydra until it was turned into a hidden base for the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Location . Located in the north - eastern end of Maerimydra , the Lair of the Hidden was about 200 ft ( 60 .
description_long: Lair of the Hidden The Lair of the Hidden was once an inn in Maerimydra until it was turned into a hidden base for the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Location . Located in the north - eastern end of Maerimydra , the Lair of the Hidden was about 200 ft ( 60 . 9 m ) south of the Shattered Tower . It adjoined a clothier ' s shop . Structure . Exterior . The Lair of the Hidden was a large building , originally rising multiple stories above street level .
