These upper stories were ravaged by fire during the invasion of Kurgoth Hellspawn in 1372 DR , leaving only the ground floor and basement intact . The windows had been smashed in by looters during the occupation . Interior . Inside , the Lair of the Hidden was a more or less intact ground floor , albeit with furniture thrown into the street , which included a large pillared room and a kitchen . A narrow flight of stairs connected to the cellar via the kitchen . The basement level was large and had a secret trapdoor that connected to the clothier ' s shop next door . Services . Prior to the fall of Maerimydra , the Lair of the Hidden was an inn that catered to the many merchants that visited the city from across the Underdark .

title: Lair of the Night Masters
description: Lair of the Night Masters The Lair of the Night Masters was the secret lair of Manshoon and his vampire associates during the time he led the Night Masks in the guise of Orbakh . Geography . The lair was located in Westgate ' s sewers and could only be entered through the secret back entrance in a trapped tunnel .
description_long: Lair of the Night Masters The Lair of the Night Masters was the secret lair of Manshoon and his vampire associates during the time he led the Night Masks in the guise of Orbakh . Geography . The lair was located in Westgate ' s sewers and could only be entered through the secret back entrance in a trapped tunnel . Structure . The lair had several coffins which were fakes designed to fool thieves and to cower lower - ranking Night Masks . A trapped teleporter led to Orbakh ' s audience chamber . History . The main entrance had been destroyed around 1391 DR by the Eye of Justice .

title: Lair of the Unspeakable
description: Lair of the Unspeakable The Lair of the Unspeakable was a secret yikarian location nestled deep beneath the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The lair was actually a large artificially - made cavern located underground .
description_long: Lair of the Unspeakable The Lair of the Unspeakable was a secret yikarian location nestled deep beneath the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The lair was actually a large artificially - made cavern located underground . " Continual light " spells were used to illuminate much of the cavern . Activities . This lair was the hideout of the Unspeakable , a yak - man high priest of considerable power . The Unspeakable had a group of dao servants dig out his lair in under a week . Inhabitants . The Unspeakable used this cavern to store the bodies of both himself and the Watcher . The bodies were cared for and guarded by other servants of the Unspeakable in addition to a pair of dao . Three other yak - men , called the Harvester , the Guardian , and the Destroyer , also used the cavern .

title: Lakataki
description: Lakataki Lakataki was an azer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Lakataki was the seneschal of the azer Everash Tribe in the Elemental Plane of Fire , acting as an advisor to Lord Cripakolus .
description_long: Lakataki Lakataki was an azer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Lakataki was the seneschal of the azer Everash Tribe in the Elemental Plane of Fire , acting as an advisor to Lord Cripakolus . However , most of his fellows were enslaved by the efreet Hafiz al - Milhab to work in his mine . Thus , in 1373 DR , when the azers captured Kaanyr Vhok and his allies , Cripakolus bargained with Kaanyr , offer to release them and show them a passage to the City of Brass in exchange for them destroying the efreet mine . Lakataki heavily supported this agreement . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Lake Ashane
description: Lake Ashane Lake Ashane , also known as the Lake of Tears , was a large , glacial lake that formed the western border of Rashemen . Geography . Lake Ashane was located on the eastern borders of Narfell and Ashanath , and it was the western border of Rashemen .
description_long: Lake Ashane Lake Ashane , also known as the Lake of Tears , was a large , glacial lake that formed the western border of Rashemen . Geography . Lake Ashane was located on the eastern borders of Narfell and Ashanath , and it was the western border of Rashemen . The lake was somewhat boomerang - shaped and cradled around Immil Vale and Ashenwood . The lake was fed from glaciers in the Icerim Mountains far to the north and the Sunrise Mountains and Lake Tirulag to the east . The southern part of the lake narrowed before it opened up into Lake Mulsantir , which formed part of the border between Rashemen and Thay . Notable Rashemi cities on the shores of Lake Ashane included Immilmar in the northeast and Mulsantir in the southeast ; additionally , the village of Dernovia was near the lake . Kront and Two Stars in Ashanath were also not far from the lake . Description . The lake was surrounded by mountains covered in dense pine forests and deciduous trees bordering those forests . The overall smell in the vicinity of the lake was that of red juniper berries . The lake was home to many aquatic creatures , including nixie s and nereid s .

title: Lake Donigarten
description: Lake Donigarten Lake Donigarten was a lake in Menzoberranzan . The lake and its island , the Isle of Rothe , were managed by House Hunzrin , which provided rothé cheese and meat to the city . Geography .
description_long: Lake Donigarten Lake Donigarten was a lake in Menzoberranzan . The lake and its island , the Isle of Rothe , were managed by House Hunzrin , which provided rothé cheese and meat to the city . Geography . The lake was located in the eastern end of the great cavern housing Menzoberranzan . The land in and around Donigarten produced most of the agriculture of Menzoberranzan and housed moss fields , giant mushrooms , fungus farms , rothé herds , and fish . There were nine tunnels between Lake Donigarten and the edge of the Qu ' ellarz ' orl plateau . There was a subterranean tributary of the Surbrin flowing into Lake Donigarten . The lake was said to be the source of much treasure but that it was inhabited by dangerous creatures who lurked under the water . Unbeknownst to all , underneath the lake was a long - abandoned and flooded temple to Ghaunadaur , which was constructed by House Masq ' il ' yr , one of the founding houses of Menzoberranzan . The house was destroyed and the secret of the temple was lost . However , a number of priests and priestesses of the house were transformed into ghauroper s that lurked in the water , guarding the temple . Description .

title: Lake Esmel
description: Lake Esmel Located on the eastern half of Amn and southeast of the city Esmeltaran for which the lake and the River Esmel are named after , Lake Esmel was a way - point that connected the Sea of Swords to the Snakewood and the Troll Mountains . Description . The lake was unusually deep .
description_long: Lake Esmel Located on the eastern half of Amn and southeast of the city Esmeltaran for which the lake and the River Esmel are named after , Lake Esmel was a way - point that connected the Sea of Swords to the Snakewood and the Troll Mountains . Description . The lake was unusually deep . Lake Esmel was home to several hot mineral springs and , according to local legend , a powerful dragon . Around two - thirds of the population lived west of Lake Esmel .

title: Lake Halruaa
description: Lake Halruaa Lake Halruaa was located toward the center of Halruaa . Geography . Filled by the Rivers Halar , Maeru and Aluar , Lake Halruaa dominated the center of the Halruaan landscape .
description_long: Lake Halruaa Lake Halruaa was located toward the center of Halruaa . Geography . Filled by the Rivers Halar , Maeru and Aluar , Lake Halruaa dominated the center of the Halruaan landscape . Wind blowing down from the mountains made navigating Lake Halruaa tricky , but it did offer a slight respite from the blazing temperatures that most of the country experienced year round .

title: Lake Lhespen
description: Lake Lhespen Lake Lhespen was a medium - sized lake found amid the sprawling plains of the Shaar . Geography . The lake sat several hundred miles inland from the Shining Sea , marking the rough midpoint between Sheirtalar and the Great Rift .
description_long: Lake Lhespen Lake Lhespen was a medium - sized lake found amid the sprawling plains of the Shaar . Geography . The lake sat several hundred miles inland from the Shining Sea , marking the rough midpoint between Sheirtalar and the Great Rift . The River Shaar flowed into the lake on its northeastern rim and exited on the southern end to eventually join the River Talar to the south . Notable Locations . The town of Lhesper sat on Lake Lhespen ' s northern shore .

title: Lake Maeru
description: Lake Maeru Lake Maeru was a small body of water found in eastern Halruaa . Geography . Lake Maeru was nestled at the foot of the Muaraghal Mountains .
description_long: Lake Maeru Lake Maeru was a small body of water found in eastern Halruaa . Geography . Lake Maeru was nestled at the foot of the Muaraghal Mountains . The River Maeru flowed south then west from the lake before meeting Lake Halruaa near the center of the country . Notable Locations . The small town of Mithtar was found along the shore of Lake Maeru .

title: Lake Midai
description: Lake Midai Lake Midai was a small but vital freshwater lake found in Bloodstone Barony . Geography . Lake Midai sat at the foot of the Galena Mountains on the western end of the barony .
description_long: Lake Midai Lake Midai was a small but vital freshwater lake found in Bloodstone Barony . Geography . Lake Midai sat at the foot of the Galena Mountains on the western end of the barony . Description . The lake stretched from north to south for several miles , but was only a mile wide . Though small , the lake was incredibly deep . Activities . The plunging depths of Lake Midai provided ample fishing opportunities for the people of Bloodstone Village .

title: Lake Mogador
description: Lake Mogador Lake Mogador was a crucial central location in Damara for both commercial and political reasons . Geography . Lake Mogador was literally situated in the center of Damara bordering several major baronies or duchies .
description_long: Lake Mogador Lake Mogador was a crucial central location in Damara for both commercial and political reasons . Geography . Lake Mogador was literally situated in the center of Damara bordering several major baronies or duchies . Four major rivers converged here , meaning that all goods leaving Damara passed through the lake at some point . Activities . To protect their interests , Morov , Ostel and Polten all maintained heavily armed vessels on the lake in addition to their regular commercial ships .

title: Lake Mulsantir
description: Lake Mulsantir Lake Mulsantir was a lake that made up the border of Thesk , Rashemen , and Thay . Geography . Lake Mulsantir was connected to Lake Ashane via the wide River Mulsantir ; together the two lakes made up the western and southern borders of Rashemen .
description_long: Lake Mulsantir Lake Mulsantir was a lake that made up the border of Thesk , Rashemen , and Thay . Geography . Lake Mulsantir was connected to Lake Ashane via the wide River Mulsantir ; together the two lakes made up the western and southern borders of Rashemen . Lake Mulsantir was surrounded by Rashemen to the north and Thay to the south . The lakes were located in deep rifts between the high plateaus of Ashanath , Thay , and the North Country . East of Lake Mulsantir was the Gorge of Gauros , through which the River Gauros flowed . Three rivers drained into the lake from the south : River Sur , River Thay , and River Gauros . The waters of the lake itself moved north through the River Mulsantir to Lake Ashane . Description . Lake Mulsantir was a freshwater lake . Its waters were dangerously turbulent and murky , but housed great numbers of fish , since it was warmer than the neighboring waters of Lake Ashane . The lake was inhabited by crossbreeds created by the Red Wizards of Thay , but these monsters tended to stick to the southern shores . Rashemi " witchboat s " piloted by hathran s patrolled the lake . History .

title: Lake Sember
description: Lake Sember Lake Sember was a medium sized freshwater lake in the southwest of Cormanthyr . It was drained by the Semberflow to the east . The elven community of Semberholme was the on the northern shore of the lake .
description_long: Lake Sember Lake Sember was a medium sized freshwater lake in the southwest of Cormanthyr . It was drained by the Semberflow to the east . The elven community of Semberholme was the on the northern shore of the lake . There was a community of sea elves living in the lake . They migrated there in the Year of the Ringed Moon .

title: Lake Weng
description: Lake Weng Lake Weng ( originally called the Lake of Amin ) was a lake in the Cloud Peaks region of Amn . Geography . Lake Weng was a freshwater lake formed by a rocky ridge of the Cloud Peaks stretching from near the city of Crimmor to the city of Amnwater .
description_long: Lake Weng Lake Weng ( originally called the Lake of Amin ) was a lake in the Cloud Peaks region of Amn . Geography . Lake Weng was a freshwater lake formed by a rocky ridge of the Cloud Peaks stretching from near the city of Crimmor to the city of Amnwater . It was fed by the rivers Amnurflow and Wengwater and emptied by Alandor River . The lake was surrounded by four tiny villages , Minsor Vale , Ideepton , Edive , and Shatar , which were all once cities of the theocracy of Minsorran . By 1370 DR , the people living among the ruins survived by fishing in the lake and growing root crops . History . In 300 DR , a series of conclaves from the churches of Lathander , Mystra , Selûne , and Shar were formed along the shores of the lake and became the theocracy of Minsorran . In 347 DR , the emperor Shoon VII gave governorship of the region around the lake to Thealnak of Memnon as a reward for creating the " Codex Thealnakkar " . The four settlements around the lake were destroyed in 600 DR , when a blizzard buried them in snow for months and all the citizens were eaten by a white dragon .

title: Lake Woe
description: Lake Woe Lake Woe was a large lake in the North . Description . The lake was full of ice and covered in a thick mist that drifted down from the massive mountain at its center .
description_long: Lake Woe Lake Woe was a large lake in the North . Description . The lake was full of ice and covered in a thick mist that drifted down from the massive mountain at its center . Geography . The lake was located south of the Ice Spires South and north of the Ice Mountains . The lake fed the Clear Whirl River . Mount Woe , one of the tallest mountains in northern Faerûn , was at its center .

title: Lake Woe mountain
description: Lake Woe mountain Lake Woe mountain was one of the tallest mountains in northern Faerûn and the home to a steading of storm giant s . Description . The peak rose high above most cloud cover yet was constantly bombarded by lightning storms .
description_long: Lake Woe mountain Lake Woe mountain was one of the tallest mountains in northern Faerûn and the home to a steading of storm giant s . Description . The peak rose high above most cloud cover yet was constantly bombarded by lightning storms . It was one of the hardest mountains to climb among all of the Ice Spires ; only expert mountaineers stood a chance at summiting it . Geography . The mountain rose from Lake Woe , south of the Ice Spire mountains and north of the Ice Mountains . Flora & Fauna . Thousands of birds visited the mountain peak on those rare days when there were not thunderstorms . Inhabitants . The mountain was the home to a steading of storm giants who had played a significant role in the War of the Hart .

title: Lake of Blood
description: Lake of Blood The Lake of Blood was a red - tinged lake in Maerimydra . Geography . The Lake of Blood was located in the south - eastern section of Maerimydra , between the slave district and the southern gates .
description_long: Lake of Blood The Lake of Blood was a red - tinged lake in Maerimydra . Geography . The Lake of Blood was located in the south - eastern section of Maerimydra , between the slave district and the southern gates . Description . Roughly 400 ft ( 121 . 9 m ) west - to - east and about 600 ft ( 182 . 8 m ) north - to - south , the Lake of Blood was the largest body of water in Maerimydra . A red tinge and an acrid smell gave the lake a blood - like appearance . A pair of small streams wound their way towards the lake ; generally drinkable water could only be drawn from the streams rather than the lake itself . History . Shortly after the founding of Maerimydra , rebels in the city tried to overthrow the rulership but were eventually defeated . The bodies of the dead rebels were thrown into the lake and reputedly thereafter tainted the waters .

title: Lake of Mists
description: Lake of Mists The Lake of Mists was the second largest freshwater lake in the Endless Waste . The lake was fed by the heated waters from the Firepeaks and underground thermal springs . Environment .
description_long: Lake of Mists The Lake of Mists was the second largest freshwater lake in the Endless Waste . The lake was fed by the heated waters from the Firepeaks and underground thermal springs . Environment . The water of the Lake of Mists was warmer than normal . The difference in temperature caused thick fogs and damp mists throughout most of the fall , winter , and spring . The Lake of Mists had always been a place of mystery . Once part of the mighty Raumathar Empire , the lake was surrounded by settlements and ruins from that age . Most notable of these was Almorel . However , many of the other small settlements had burial mounds and ruined keeps that were shunned by the locals . Stranger still were the creatures rumored to be living in the lake , somewhere near the bottom of its immense depths . Trade . The settlements around the lake relied on the fishing and lumber industries for their trade . The lake was rich with sturgeon , salmon , and other fine game fish . The fishermen , in small boats of two to three men , went out every day to bring in their catch .

title: Lake of Shadows
description: Lake of Shadows The Lake of Shadows was a large body of fresh water located in the Middledark beneath the Dagger Hills in the extreme northwest of Cormanthor . Geography . The Lake of Shadows was a tenday from Lake Thoroot , to which it was connected by a river which flowered towards Lake Thoroot .
description_long: Lake of Shadows The Lake of Shadows was a large body of fresh water located in the Middledark beneath the Dagger Hills in the extreme northwest of Cormanthor . Geography . The Lake of Shadows was a tenday from Lake Thoroot , to which it was connected by a river which flowered towards Lake Thoroot . The Fireflow was also tenday from the Lake of Shadows . Description . The Lake of Shadows was huge , some 60 mi ( 80 . 47 km ) in its longest dimension . The cavern arched from 50 ft ( 15 . 24 m ) to 100 ft ( 30 . 48 m ) above the surface of the lake at its highest point , and the lake itself reached a depth of 100 ft ( 30 . 48 m ) . The lake was named for its bats and for its gate to the Plane of Shadows . Chimneys opened up above the lake . Inhabitants . The lake was the domain of a fiend ish kraken , which ruled the lake as an iron - fisted tyrant . The kraken ' s subjects included hundreds of kuo - toa who worshiped the kraken as a manifestation of Umberlee . Although a brood of aboleth s also resided in the lake , they too acknowledged the kraken ' s dominance . On the eastern shore , a small tribe of stone giant s lived under the guidance of their elders Ghunda and Thurrak .

title: Lake of Steam
description: Lake of Steam The Lake of Steam , also known as Arnaden , was a region in south Faerûn . Despite its name , the Lake of Steam was in fact an inland sea connected to the Shining Sea . Geography .
description_long: Lake of Steam The Lake of Steam , also known as Arnaden , was a region in south Faerûn . Despite its name , the Lake of Steam was in fact an inland sea connected to the Shining Sea . Geography . With the Shaar on the east , it separated the Shining South from the rest of Faerûn . On its shores was a collection of free cities , mainly on the northern and western sides . The southern side , by contrast , was a collection of kingdoms collectively named the Border Kingdoms . At the center of the lake was the Arnrock . History . By 1369 DR , the Twisted Rune placed a magical gate in the area to allow for instantaneous movement to other locations . As of 1479 DR , the Lake of Steam was about half the size it was before the Spellplague . The Arnrock was in the eastern half of the sea rather than the center , and the eastern portion of the sea ended about thirty miles short of the town of Derlusk , where Derlusk was once on the southeastern coast of the sea . A large lake was separated from the main body of the sea and lay near the ruins of Innarlith . The Qurth Forest was a small fraction of its former size , and the Duskwood was completely gone . Suldolphor was also in ruins .

title: Lake of the Emerald Eye
description: Lake of the Emerald Eye The Lake of the Emerald Eye was located in the Land of the Yak - Men within the dominating heights of the World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The lake was found within the Red Goat province near the heart of the Yikarian Empire .
description_long: Lake of the Emerald Eye The Lake of the Emerald Eye was located in the Land of the Yak - Men within the dominating heights of the World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The lake was found within the Red Goat province near the heart of the Yikarian Empire . Due to the extreme elevation , the water of the lake was ice - cold . History . The Lake of the Emerald Eye was a site favored for performing water sacrifices to the Faceless God of the yak - folk .

title: Lake of the Ghuls
description: Lake of the Ghuls The Lake of the Ghuls was a small body of water found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . This lake was located in the High Desert , specifically in the northern section of the notorious valley known as the Pit of the Ghuls .
description_long: Lake of the Ghuls The Lake of the Ghuls was a small body of water found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . This lake was located in the High Desert , specifically in the northern section of the notorious valley known as the Pit of the Ghuls . Description . The Lake of the Ghuls was filled with salty water that was not potable .

title: Lake of the Snake
description: Lake of the Snake The Lake of the Snake is a small lake in the Dragon Coast . The lake is south of the Horse Prairie and east of the Giant ' s Run mountains . The river Reddan feeds the lake .
description_long: Lake of the Snake The Lake of the Snake is a small lake in the Dragon Coast . The lake is south of the Horse Prairie and east of the Giant ' s Run mountains . The river Reddan feeds the lake . The town of Wyrm ' s Hamlet sits on the lake shore .

title: Lakkar
description: Lakkar Lakkar was a frost giant living in the Sword Mountains in the past . He was a loyal follower of the god Thrym and Thrym gifted to Lakkar an artifact known as the Winterforge , which channeled the power of the icy realms within the Elemental Chaos . With this power , Lakkar started a unstoppable war of conquest until he fought the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak .
description_long: Lakkar Lakkar was a frost giant living in the Sword Mountains in the past . He was a loyal follower of the god Thrym and Thrym gifted to Lakkar an artifact known as the Winterforge , which channeled the power of the icy realms within the Elemental Chaos . With this power , Lakkar started a unstoppable war of conquest until he fought the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak . In difficulties , Lakkar absorbed the Winterforge into himself , growing to an immense size and declaring himself a god . This however angered Thrym , who then helped the dwarves to defeat him . In death , his titanic body was frozen solid atop Icespire Peak .

title: Laksi al - Afyid
description: Laksi al - Afyid Laksi al - Afyid was was a merchant - rogue and business woman in Huzuz . Abilities . She possessed a natural talent for catering to the rich and powerful .
description_long: Laksi al - Afyid Laksi al - Afyid was was a merchant - rogue and business woman in Huzuz . Abilities . She possessed a natural talent for catering to the rich and powerful . Clients could relax in her shop in comfort while her servants collected their request from the Bazaar . Activities . Instead of offering guide services like others in Huzuz , Laksi preferred to offer procurement services where clients told her what they needed . She operated her shop , Services for Nobles , out of a lavish house located near the Grand Bazaar and Court District .

title: Lalaskra
description: Lalaskra Lalaskra of Ormpetarr , also known as " Leatherskin " , was a priestess of Loviatar from Ormpetarr in Sespech , living in the 12th century DR . History . Soon after Bredisker stole the " Tome of Torment " in the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , he sold the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater to Lalaskra , an enemy of the church .
description_long: Lalaskra Lalaskra of Ormpetarr , also known as " Leatherskin " , was a priestess of Loviatar from Ormpetarr in Sespech , living in the 12th century DR . History . Soon after Bredisker stole the " Tome of Torment " in the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , he sold the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater to Lalaskra , an enemy of the church . She wore the tome ' s hairshirt form constantly . Finally , with Lalaskra having removed it during a ritual in the Year of the Crimson Crag , 1211 DR , the " Tome " was stolen by an unknown thief , who also managed to make off with the tome ' s covers , stored in a backroom in Lalaskra ' s quarters in a nearby temple . Incensed , Lalaskra whipped her Loviatan minions into a frantic search for the " Tome " all across the southern Vilhon Reach lands , though without success . After some ten years , Lalaskra was the center of a feud between two lovelorn wizard s . They battled for her hand in marriage , but Lalaskra was killed in the cross - fire . Lalaskra ' s followers soon abandoned the search for the " Tome " . Activities . Lalaskra wore the " Tome of Torment " ' s barbed hairshirt form at all times in order to receive the spells it granted .

title: Lalibela
description: Lalibela Lalibela was a demigoddess of the nixie s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Lalibela lived in a small lake inside The Mines of Bloodstone .
description_long: Lalibela Lalibela was a demigoddess of the nixie s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Lalibela lived in a small lake inside The Mines of Bloodstone . She manifested herself to pure paladins giving them the magic sword Crusader , particular lethal against demon s . History . In 1357 DR she granted the sword to Gareth Dragonsbane .

title: Lallara Mediocros
description: Lallara Mediocros Lallara Mediocros was the zulkir of abjuration within the ranks of the Red Wizards of Thay . Description . Lallara was seemingly pale and vital but her age showed in the lines at the corners of her eyes , mouth , and soft flesh beneath her chin .
description_long: Lallara Mediocros Lallara Mediocros was the zulkir of abjuration within the ranks of the Red Wizards of Thay . Description . Lallara was seemingly pale and vital but her age showed in the lines at the corners of her eyes , mouth , and soft flesh beneath her chin . She wore several rings on her fingers . Personality . A particularly decadent and extremely unreliable woman , she counted herself among the allies of Szass Tam . Lallara was a sort of creative artist in the field of torture and collected unusual magical items .

title: Lalondra Worul
description: Lalondra Worul Lalondra Worul reigned for decades as Shar ' s high priestess . Biography . Lalondra was a young Sharran when she began receiving visions in her dreams from her goddess of the location of a sacred relic , " Gorothir ' s Girdle " .
description_long: Lalondra Worul Lalondra Worul reigned for decades as Shar ' s high priestess . Biography . Lalondra was a young Sharran when she began receiving visions in her dreams from her goddess of the location of a sacred relic , " Gorothir ' s Girdle " . Circa 617 DR , Lalondra took the " Girdle " from its former owner , whom Shar had turned into a tortured undead thing . With the power and authority that the " Girdle " provided , Lalondra created the True Servants of Shar , whose members , all capable devotees of Shar , came to rule her clergy all along the Sword Coast for the next eighty years . Lalondra had used powerful magic to bind the True Servants lives to her own and when she successfully pursued lich dom in 697 DR , that magic snuffed out their life forces , effectively leaving their followers leaderless . Riots ensued in twelve cities as the directionless minions of the church saw their power disappear in a short space of time . The authorities in those cities violently quelled the rioting but not before King Davyd of Delimbiyran was killed .

title: Lamellar
description: Lamellar Lamellar was a type of armor used in Zakhara . Description . Lamellar was similiar to scale armor .
description_long: Lamellar Lamellar was a type of armor used in Zakhara . Description . Lamellar was similiar to scale armor . It was made by overlapping metal plates called lamellas connected via metal links . Lamellar was lighter in weight than standard scale mail and cost less to produce . This armor was one of the more favored heavy armor variants in Zakhara .

title: Lamet
description: Lamet Lamet was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Lamet once lived in Port Llast but one day was arrested for the theft of a bottle of wine .
description_long: Lamet Lamet was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Lamet once lived in Port Llast but one day was arrested for the theft of a bottle of wine . Four years later , he was released from jail but exiled from the town with all his family . His household excommunicated him and so Lamet went alone to Daggerford . In 1370 DR , he was considering opening a small shop as knife sharpener .

title: Lamia
description: Lamia Lamias were dangerous monstrosities that lived to bring strife and suffering into the world . They were cruel and seductive beings who lured their victims closer to doom with illusions of beauty . Description .
description_long: Lamia Lamias were dangerous monstrosities that lived to bring strife and suffering into the world . They were cruel and seductive beings who lured their victims closer to doom with illusions of beauty . Description . A typical lamia stood over six feet ( 1 . 8m ) tall , measured eight feet ( 2 . 4m ) long , and weighed about 650 pounds ( 295kg ) . Most lamias appeared to be beautiful women from the waist up but had the bodies of powerful lions from the waist down . However , these were the weakest forms of lamia . Lamia noble s had the lower bodies of serpents , which often led to them being confused with naga or medusa s . The most powerful of lamias could change their lower bodies as easily as a mortal being changed their clothes . The lower body of a lamia could also resemble other animals such as goats and deer . The upper body of a lamia was that of a human torso that did not have animalistic features such as scales , horns , or fur . Characteristics and Habits . Lamias were sinister creatures who lived in desert ruins . They sustained themselves by eating human flesh .

title: Lammasu
description: Lammasu A lammasu is a noble and stern magical beast that looks like a cross between a lion and an eagle . Lammasus seek to promote goodness throughout the world , living in isolated ruins and abandoned temples . They speak Celestial , Common and Draconic .
description_long: Lammasu A lammasu is a noble and stern magical beast that looks like a cross between a lion and an eagle . Lammasus seek to promote goodness throughout the world , living in isolated ruins and abandoned temples . They speak Celestial , Common and Draconic . Description . A lammasu has the body of a lion , the wings of a giant eagle , and the face of a human . They are capable of flight . The average lammasu is 2 . 4 m ( 8 ft ) long and weighs about 225 kg ( 500 lbs ) . Personality . Lammasus are noble and stern creatures who prefer isolation , but concern themselves with the well - being of good creatures in general . They are cordial in nature towards other good creatures and they are often willing to assist in combating evil . Although not immediately apparent , Lammasus are occasionally capable of compassion . Magic . A lammasu can cast spells as though it were a cleric , and can cast from the good , healing , knowledge , and law domains . Combat . Lammasus will almost always join a fight if a good creature is in danger . They will attack evil creatures on sight . They possess sharp front claw .

title: Lamorak Tanthul
description: Lamorak Tanthul Prince Lamorak Tanthul was appointed by his father to oversee the Determinists ' Guild in 1362 DR . It was Lamorak and his fellow Determinist s who administered the tests to each shadovar in order to determine how they may have best served the City of Shade . Lamorak was also in charge of the closely guarded process of selecting and transforming deserving shadovars into shade s .
description_long: Lamorak Tanthul Prince Lamorak Tanthul was appointed by his father to oversee the Determinists ' Guild in 1362 DR . It was Lamorak and his fellow Determinist s who administered the tests to each shadovar in order to determine how they may have best served the City of Shade . Lamorak was also in charge of the closely guarded process of selecting and transforming deserving shadovars into shade s . Political View . The prince ' s opinions on the city ' s politics did not sway particularly in one direction or another , however , he did think that it might be more wise for his father to manipulate , rather than fight with , the city ' s enemies . Lore . Prince Lamorak ' s personal sigil was a white skull outlined in black on a light gray field . Relationships . Lamorak had two sons , Draethren Tanthul , the younger son , was the most skilled sorcerer of the city , and his elder brother , Tantoras Tanthul . Tantoras died in a supposed accident , but in truth he had been killed by the High Prince for his treasonous plots against Telamont .

title: Lamoth
description: Lamoth King Lamoth was the ruler of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate .
description_long: Lamoth King Lamoth was the ruler of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate . Lamoth sought to bolster the legitimacy of his line by marrying his children to the royal families of Cormyr , Milvarn , Westgate , and others around the Inner Sea , often by sending them to visit their royal courts . Lamoth ' s Royal Constabulary discovered the notorious pirate Urthag the Knife carousing in Chessagol and tried to arrest him . He escaped , but not before losing the sword Galathos , a magic blade that turned out to have been forged in the ancient empire of Raumathar and lost during its fall . Galathos was given to King Lamoth . Finally , Lamoth successfully arranged a marriage between his daughter Elthia and Prince Bellodar III of Impiltur . Bellodar became king of Impiltur , and Elthia queen , in the Year of Sifting Sands , 642 DR . Galathos was part of Elthia ' s dowry , and eventually became the traditional sword of the princes of Impiltur . Associates & Activities .

title: Lamp of Devotion
description: Lamp of Devotion The Lamp of Devotion was a sacred flame for the holy slayer s of the Everlasting within the fortress of Sarahin . History . Located within the Tower of the Dawn , the flame was tended so it burned brightly during all hours of the day , signifying the Everlasting ' s honor of Hajama .
description_long: Lamp of Devotion The Lamp of Devotion was a sacred flame for the holy slayer s of the Everlasting within the fortress of Sarahin . History . Located within the Tower of the Dawn , the flame was tended so it burned brightly during all hours of the day , signifying the Everlasting ' s honor of Hajama .

title: Lamp of the four winds
description: Lamp of the four winds Lamps of the four winds were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special lamps were only used by Holy slayer s . Powers .
description_long: Lamp of the four winds Lamps of the four winds were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special lamps were only used by Holy slayer s . Powers . These lamps could be used to summon one to three wind walker s every three days . The wind walkers were required to obey their master for the duration of the three day period , or until a specific task was carried out .

title: Lamris Kholl
description: Lamris Kholl Lamris Kholl was a cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Lamris had a vivacious and unpredictable personality .
description_long: Lamris Kholl Lamris Kholl was a cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Lamris had a vivacious and unpredictable personality . She was capricious and irresponsible but remained a true worshiper of Tymora . For a long time , she toyed with Adama Miiralin ' s emotions but after volunteered his help , she began to develop feelings for him . History . Lamris hailed from Llorkh but escaped the Zhent tyranny there . After settling in Waterdeep , she started making plans to rescue her entire family from the city . Circa 1372 DR , with the help of Adama , Lamris finally managed to free her family .

title: Lamruil Moonflower
description: Lamruil Moonflower Prince Lamruil Moonflower was the youngest son of the late King Zaor Moonflower and Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He was the current bearer of the " King ' s Blade " , the most powerful elven moonblade and heir apparent to the throne of Evermeet . Description .
description_long: Lamruil Moonflower Prince Lamruil Moonflower was the youngest son of the late King Zaor Moonflower and Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He was the current bearer of the " King ' s Blade " , the most powerful elven moonblade and heir apparent to the throne of Evermeet . Description . He was strikingly handsome , even for an elf . He had the eyes of a Moonflower — deep , bright blue flecked with golden lights — and possessed his father ' s great height and muscular form , topping six feet . History . He traveled with Kymil Nimesin in looking for the lost Moonflower children . Under Kymil , he studied the arts of swordcraft , though he often showed more interest in drinking and wenching . Lamruil , despite his early habits , successfully drew the " King ' s Sword " . He then undertook the task of planting the Tree of Souls given to by Queen Amlaruil on the mainland . Once planted , it would create a gradually enlarging sphere protected by ancient High Magic , and thus establish a new elven kingdom , a new haven for the elven people .

title: Lana
description: Lana Lana was monk , serving as a scribe at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in 1491 DR . Personality . Lana was an honest and stubborn but somewhat shy woman , preferring to observe others .
description_long: Lana Lana was monk , serving as a scribe at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in 1491 DR . Personality . Lana was an honest and stubborn but somewhat shy woman , preferring to observe others . However , once she became engaged in a conversation , especially about themes for which she felt strongly , she tended to ramble on and talk too much . History . Lana worked as a scribe in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . In 1491 , she casually discovered that a secret cult had infiltrated the monastery and caused a strange storm that plagued the area . She was then attacked by these cultists and left for dead . She survived , however , and went to Mulmaster to ask for help . There in the city , her information convinced the Order of the Gauntlet , the Lords ' Alliance , and Zor Garwyl Gos to hire an adventuring party to investigate . When she met the adventurers , she explained to them all she knew .

title: Lana Mara
description: Lana Mara Lana Mara was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lana was a member of the Champions of Muktar .
description_long: Lana Mara Lana Mara was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lana was a member of the Champions of Muktar . She was also a Deputy Brigade Commander in the Muktar ' s army . History . Lana was the latest , and possible greatest , apprentice of the famed illusionist Yhelva the Wicked . In 1358 DR Lana and his fellow Champions arranged the trap inside Fort Blood planned by the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , to eliminate an adventuring party well - known in Golconda . Later she took part in the Battle of Wilma Pass .

title: Lanaxis
description: Lanaxis Lanaxis was a titan of great size and strength and the origin of the titan race . He and Othea claimed the vast cold plains of Faerûn , where Lanaxis constructed the citadel of Voninheim . Relationships .
description_long: Lanaxis Lanaxis was a titan of great size and strength and the origin of the titan race . He and Othea claimed the vast cold plains of Faerûn , where Lanaxis constructed the citadel of Voninheim . Relationships . Lanaxis was the son of Annam All - Father and Othea . History . When Ulutiu ' s amulet began to freeze northern Faerûn , Lanaxis ' s citadel of Voninheim was put under threat , but Othea , his mother , forbade him to go after it . He immediately summoned his siblings and planned to go after the amulet anyway , but Dunmore refused to help . Lanaxis changed his plan , attempting to poison Othea , and inadvertently poisoned all of his siblings too , except Dunmore and Arno and Julian . Before Othea succumbed to the poison , she cursed Lanaxis to lose his immortality if he ever left her shadow . The sons of Lanaxis , the titans , fled to the plane of Arborea . The fate of Lanaxis was for a long time unkown . After the War of the Hart , an apparition of unknown identity , called the Twilight Spirit began appearing in Twilight Vale once a year , attracting a pilgrimage of giant s who believe it to speak a prophecy concerning the return of Annam All - Father to Abeir - Toril .

title: Lance Defenders
description: Lance Defenders The Lance Defenders were the core of Tymanther military forces , a highly trained army of dragonborn soldiers gathered from every clan , who were specialized in fighting with lances and other weapons , both on foot and in aerial combat , mounted on giant bats . Their primary task was to defend Djerad Thymar from dragon attacks , and , because of that , the Lance Barracks , their headquarters , was located in the highest place of the City - Bastion along with the Lance Roost that served as the giant bat stables . Although few thymari dragonborn had a knack for spellcasting , the Lance Defenders maintained a number of spellcaster s among their ranks .
description_long: Lance Defenders The Lance Defenders were the core of Tymanther military forces , a highly trained army of dragonborn soldiers gathered from every clan , who were specialized in fighting with lances and other weapons , both on foot and in aerial combat , mounted on giant bats . Their primary task was to defend Djerad Thymar from dragon attacks , and , because of that , the Lance Barracks , their headquarters , was located in the highest place of the City - Bastion along with the Lance Roost that served as the giant bat stables . Although few thymari dragonborn had a knack for spellcasting , the Lance Defenders maintained a number of spellcaster s among their ranks . Most dragonborn served in the Lance Defenders for two years , but only a small percentage remained after that period and became permanent soldiers . If a Lance Defender was able to get enough promotions , there was the possibility that he or she was deemed fit to be elected as a Vanquisher . Their giant bats were highly prized by the dragonborn , and only members of the Lance Defenders or important guests were permitted to use them , though they were exclusively for use of the Lance Defenders in wartime .

title: Lance of Faerûn
description: Lance of Faerûn A lance of Faerûn is a magic + 2 holy lance . They are mostly heavy lance s but one in ten is a light lance . The lances are made from hardwood with a steel tip and they are created for followers of Torm who use mounts .
description_long: Lance of Faerûn A lance of Faerûn is a magic + 2 holy lance . They are mostly heavy lance s but one in ten is a light lance . The lances are made from hardwood with a steel tip and they are created for followers of Torm who use mounts . If used by a follower of Torm , it is bane against evil outsider s . Regardless of the user , the lance allows the user to make a spirited charge . They are worth around 100 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Lance of faith
description: Lance of faith Lance of faith , also known as searing light , is a sun domain prayer used by many cleric s , particularly devoted clerics . Focusing holy power like a ray of the sun , a cleric casting " lance of faith " projects a blast of light from their implement or open palm towards a target within twenty - five feet , searing them with painful rays of divine brilliance . Additionally , one ally of the cleric visible becomes more likely to strike true in their next attack .
description_long: Lance of faith Lance of faith , also known as searing light , is a sun domain prayer used by many cleric s , particularly devoted clerics . Focusing holy power like a ray of the sun , a cleric casting " lance of faith " projects a blast of light from their implement or open palm towards a target within twenty - five feet , searing them with painful rays of divine brilliance . Additionally , one ally of the cleric visible becomes more likely to strike true in their next attack . The power of " lance of faith " increases as the cleric grows more powerful and can be used at any time . Otherwise , the strength of " lance of faith " is proportional to the wisdom and clarity of thought that the cleric casting it is capable of . Before the Spellplague , " lance of faith " was more commonly called " searing light " and was more difficult to learn . The prayer also had a greater range of about fifty feet , and no side effect on an ally . Otherwise , however , the effects were much the same .

title: Lances of Leilon
description: Lances of Leilon The Lances of Leilon was a group of soldiers that defended the town of Leilon . Organization . This force of about 200 men was always on patrol trying to minimize orc s and goblin s in the area .
description_long: Lances of Leilon The Lances of Leilon was a group of soldiers that defended the town of Leilon . Organization . This force of about 200 men was always on patrol trying to minimize orc s and goblin s in the area . Possessions . The Lances of Leilon were skilled at firing crossbow s from horseback . While clad in chain mail , each lancer carried a shield . In battle , they fought with lance s , light crossbow s , sword s , axe s , and dagger s .

title: Lancilon Seenabuck
description: Lancilon Seenabuck Lancilon Seenabuck was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Lancilon was a thief until he tried to steal arquebuse s from the temple of Gond in Lantan but was discovered .
description_long: Lancilon Seenabuck Lancilon Seenabuck was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Lancilon was a thief until he tried to steal arquebuse s from the temple of Gond in Lantan but was discovered . In order to escape , he hid aboard a ship , not knowing it was sailing to Helmsport . Lancilon found himself in a strange new world where he knew nothing . He needed gold to go back home . Having heard about Nexal , he thought it was a good place where he could find gold . Personality . Lancilon was totally confused by Maztican customs . He desperately to wanted go home . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Lancilon Seenabuck is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Maztica .

title: Land Under Eternal Ice
description: Land Under Eternal Ice The Land Under Eternal Ice was the goddess Auril ' s domain within the Deep Wilds . It was an eternally frozen land , possibly even the coldest place on any plane . Auril dwelt in the Winter Hall , which floated slowly above the landscape .
description_long: Land Under Eternal Ice The Land Under Eternal Ice was the goddess Auril ' s domain within the Deep Wilds . It was an eternally frozen land , possibly even the coldest place on any plane . Auril dwelt in the Winter Hall , which floated slowly above the landscape .

title: Land of Fate
description: Land of Fate The boxed set contains a 128 - page book entitled Adventurer ' s Guide to Zakhara which is for players and DMs alike and gives a general overview of the continent , its cities , inhabitants and customs . The second book is 64 pages and is entitled Fortunes and Fates and contains information on running an Al - Qadim campaign , intended for the DM .
description_long: Land of Fate The boxed set contains a 128 - page book entitled Adventurer ' s Guide to Zakhara which is for players and DMs alike and gives a general overview of the continent , its cities , inhabitants and customs . The second book is 64 pages and is entitled Fortunes and Fates and contains information on running an Al - Qadim campaign , intended for the DM .

title: Land of stability
description: Land of stability Land of stability was an abjuration spell that protected an area from natural disasters . Effects . The area that could be protected was a cube whose sides were no bigger than the caster ' s level times 10 ft ( 3 m ) .
description_long: Land of stability Land of stability was an abjuration spell that protected an area from natural disasters . Effects . The area that could be protected was a cube whose sides were no bigger than the caster ' s level times 10 ft ( 3 m ) . Once protected , the effects of natural disasters could not breach the barrier set up by " land of stability " . Water from floods , winds and objects carried by windstorms , debris and snow from avalanche , and even lava and ash from a volcano were diverted around the protected area . Earth movement , vibrations , and fissures from earthquakes were also prevented from disturbing the protected area . Protection lasted for one day per level of the aster . " Land of stability " did not prevent damage from calamities already in progress , nor did it prevent magically generated or simulated disastrous events . Components . The material components of this spell were the priest ' s holy symbol and a pinch of volcanic ash . Verbal and somatic components were also required .

title: Land of the Yak - Men
description: Land of the Yak - Men The Land of the Yak - Men was the term for the geographical region controlled by the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The southwestern arm of the World Pillar Mountains extended south into Zakhara from the junction of the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with the Land of Fate .
description_long: Land of the Yak - Men The Land of the Yak - Men was the term for the geographical region controlled by the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The southwestern arm of the World Pillar Mountains extended south into Zakhara from the junction of the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with the Land of Fate . Most , if not all , of this arm of the vast mountain range fell under the domain of the Yikarian Empire . Additionally , their reach extended down the slopes of the mountains into the far northeastern reaches of Zakhara at the border with Konigheim and the Utter East . From a Zakharan ' s standpoint , the Land of the Yak - Men abutted the forbidding desert wasteland known as the Haunted Lands . Due east it abutted the Jungle of Monsters . Inhabitants . In addition to the yak - folk who dominated the land , several other creatures could be found wandering the terrain . These included snow leopards , yeti s , mountain goats , musk oxen , and even a few humans .

title: Lander
description: Lander Lander was a Harper ranger . Personality . Lander was a practical man with a strong focus on his mission .
description_long: Lander Lander was a Harper ranger . Personality . Lander was a practical man with a strong focus on his mission . He was truly devoted to the Harpers ' cause and suffered for excessive formalism . As a ranger , his favorite place was forests . He thought that deserts were only an empty place . He was a devoted follower of Mielikki . History . Lander was born in Sembia to a merchant father . His mother was a covert Zhentarim spy . Nobody knew Lander ' s mother ' s true allegiance until his teenage days when his father became suspicious after his mother insisted on going with them to a merchant meeting in Archendale . His father discovered the truth and warned Archendale about the Zhentish plot . His mother managed to find Lander and offered him a place among the Zhents , but in response he killed her Zhent companions , but not her . So his mother arranged the death of Lander ' s father . Later , a Harper approached Lander , informing him that his mother had died . Lander decided to join the Harpers and stop the Zhents at any opportunity . In 1360 DR , Florin Falconhand sent him to Anauroch to warn the Bedine of an imminent attack from the Zhents and Asabi .

title: Landon Bhentyl
description: Landon Bhentyl Landon Bhentyl was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a former member of the War Wizards and proprietor of Wheloon Tack & Leather . History .
description_long: Landon Bhentyl Landon Bhentyl was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a former member of the War Wizards and proprietor of Wheloon Tack & Leather . History . Landon was once a member of the War Wizards of Cormyr until he almost died of poison ed wounds . He retired from the War Wizards , and went on to run Wheloon Tack & Leather , selling leather products . Activities . It was a point of pride that he always kept everything in stock so a customer was never left needy . He remained a staunch defender of law and order . To guard his store against thieves , Landon kept a set of wand s handy in his belt . But instead of drawing his wand of " magic missile " or " paralyzation " , he often accidentally produced his " wand of wonder " . The ensuing chaos earned him the nickname " Wonderwand " . Landon Bhentyl also wore " boots of levitation " , and avoided dangerous foes by levitating into the air , where he cast spells or used his wands in safety . He experienced in their use and able to maintain his balance with ease . Description . By 1369 DR , he was an elderly man with a white beard and a limp .

title: Landrise
description: Landrise The Landrise was a large , sprawling cliff that speared through the middle of the Shaar , effectively cutting the region into two halves . Geography . The Landrise originated in the north on the eastern edge of the Firesteap Mountains .
description_long: Landrise The Landrise was a large , sprawling cliff that speared through the middle of the Shaar , effectively cutting the region into two halves . Geography . The Landrise originated in the north on the eastern edge of the Firesteap Mountains . It stretched southward through the plains of the Shaar for many hundreds of miles , curving both east and west along the way . The River Shaar cascaded down the Landrise near the Great Rift and Trader ' s Way crossed the Landrise south of the river . The Landrise leveled - out within the Forest of Amtar near Dambrath .

title: Landswith Meilin
description: Landswith Meilin Landswith Meilin was a female half - elf warrior - priest of Tyr the Just and an adventuring knight of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Activities . Landswith Meilin was the quintessential knight in shining armor — she wandered the kingdom in search of noble quests she could undertake , good deeds to do , and wrongs to right .
description_long: Landswith Meilin Landswith Meilin was a female half - elf warrior - priest of Tyr the Just and an adventuring knight of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Activities . Landswith Meilin was the quintessential knight in shining armor — she wandered the kingdom in search of noble quests she could undertake , good deeds to do , and wrongs to right . History . In her time , Landswith had journeyed far to the south , beyond the borders of Ulgarth and into the Utter East , lands she came to know better than anyone else in her kingdom . She fought the Horde barbarians of the east in their most recent big raid on Kaspar by 1367 DR . In 1367 DR , she made her way north to Suormpar , expecting to fight in the coming war against the gray orc s of the Dustwall Mountains . Personality . Landswith was atypical in her profession as , in Ulgarth , very few women of the kingdom and fewer half - elves became knights , and she was both . She was also perhaps the only Ulgarthan knight to wear full plate mail armor , in a hot and humid climate that would make this unbearable to the point of being lethal .

title: Langdarma
description: Langdarma Langdarma was a very isolated and mysterious country hidden deep within the Yehimal Mountains . Geography . Langdarma was a valley located in the heart of the Yehimal range , surrounded on all sides by high mountain peaks and covered above by thick glacial ice .
description_long: Langdarma Langdarma was a very isolated and mysterious country hidden deep within the Yehimal Mountains . Geography . Langdarma was a valley located in the heart of the Yehimal range , surrounded on all sides by high mountain peaks and covered above by thick glacial ice . The land was consistently described as an earthly paradise — pure glacial waters cascaded down cliff - side waterfalls in many places , several of which were at least a mile high . Geographical features . The residents of Langdarma split their nation roughly in half , calling the highlands formed from the Shang Po mountain basin " Upper Langdarma " and the lowlands of the valley " Lower Langdarma " . Government . The ultimate authority in Langdarma was the Sannyasi , a movanic deva who cared for the entire valley and its people from his palace in Lower Langdarma . Trade . Langdarma was entirely self - sufficient . It did not trade with any of its neighbors . Defenses . The only access to Langdarma was through magical " gate s " , the locations of which moved among the surrounding mountain trails .

title: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath
description: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath Langdedrosa Cyanwrath was a half – blue dragon member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Description . Cyanwrath was seven feet tall with bright blue scales .
description_long: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath Langdedrosa Cyanwrath was a half – blue dragon member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Description . Cyanwrath was seven feet tall with bright blue scales . He had draconic features and sharp claws . Personality . While the half - dragon had a strong sense of honor , he could be driven to wrathful rage . Possessions . In battle , Langdedrosa wore splint mail and fought with greatsword or spear . Relationships . Cyanwrath is the right hand of Frulam Mondath . History . Around 1489 DR , Langdedrosa was one of the leaders in the assault on Greenest . During the battle , he challenged Sergeant Markguth , one of the strongest of the defenders of the town , to a duel , promising to spare the lives of Greenest ' s people in exchange . A few days later , he was at the Cult ' s camp near the city in the Greenfields . During an attack on the dragon hatchery , Cyanwrath was killed with a group of his guards in the shrine to Tiamat .

title: Lanniver Strayl
description: Lanniver Strayl Lanniver Strayl was a fighter member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Lanniver was a very respected fighter for the army of good in Faerûn .
description_long: Lanniver Strayl Lanniver Strayl was a fighter member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Lanniver was a very respected fighter for the army of good in Faerûn . History . During the Rage of Demons , Lanniver was the Order of the Gauntlet delegate to King Bruenor Battlehammer of Gauntlgrym to discuss the madness spreading in the Underdark . Personality . Lanniver had seen all kinds of things and it seemed that few things surprised him . He had a fatalistic approach to life with a bit of sarcasm , for him things would always go bad , and it was at that point that good people took action . Relationships . He always had with him his squire Rhiele Vannis .

title: Lannon siblings
description: Lannon siblings Lannon siblings were villagers of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . These teenagers were contestants of the Harvest Fair brawl .
description_long: Lannon siblings Lannon siblings were villagers of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . These teenagers were contestants of the Harvest Fair brawl . The Kalach - Cha , aided by Bevil Starling and Amie Fern , needed to defeat them to pass to next round .

title: Lanseril Snowmantle
description: Lanseril Snowmantle Lanseril Snowmantle was a druid and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . Description . Lanseril was six feet , two inches tall .
description_long: Lanseril Snowmantle Lanseril Snowmantle was a druid and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . Description . Lanseril was six feet , two inches tall . He had dark hair , delicate features and blue eyes . He wore simple robes . Personality . He was generally friendly , but could sometimes come across as condescending . He was known to have a somewhat bad aim and had sometimes hit friendly folks with magical lightning . Lanseril bitterly hated wolves . History . He was born in the tiny village of Snowmantle . His father was Raunaeril , one of the " lost " elves of the Border Forest . Lanseril ' s father and mother were killed when he was six years old by raiders from the Citadel of the Raven . He was taken in and taught the ways of druids by Haemfaest Sarthun . A year later , Haemfaest was killed by wolves and Lanseril fled south to Deepingdale . There , Lanseril found work as a runner , errand boy , and animal keeper for the local merchant Braun . Lanseril served Braun for twelve years , until the ranger Briadorn brought him to Shadowdale . Abilities . Lanseril could take the form of an eagle .

title: Lantan
description: Lantan Lantan was an island - nation in the Trackless Sea north of the Chultan peninsula , known for its advanced technology and the population ' s devout worship of Gond . Geography . It consisted of three separate islands : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil .
description_long: Lantan Lantan was an island - nation in the Trackless Sea north of the Chultan peninsula , known for its advanced technology and the population ' s devout worship of Gond . Geography . It consisted of three separate islands : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil . The islands were rocky and covered in lush jungle . The inhabitants of Lantan were rock gnome s and human s called the Lantanna . History . After captain Cordell from Amn discovered Maztica , the Lantanna , being the westernmost extension of Faerûn along with the reclusive Evermeet and the enigmatic Nimbral , also claimed some lands . When the Spellplague erupted in 1385 DR , the sudden shifting of continental bodies sent tsunamis all along the island and coastal regions of Faerûn , devastating them all . Lantan was hit harder than most , the entirety of its islands flooding , killing all the inhabitants and cleaning away their advanced technology . The size of the island of Lantan is now greatly reduced ; the eastern island of Orlil is completely submerged , and the southern island of Suj has become two much smaller islands .

title: Lantanese language
description: Lantanese language Lantanese , also known as Lantanna , was the official language of Lantan . Speakers . Other regions where Lantanese was commonly spoken included the Nelanther Isles and Tethyr .
description_long: Lantanese language Lantanese , also known as Lantanna , was the official language of Lantan . Speakers . Other regions where Lantanese was commonly spoken included the Nelanther Isles and Tethyr . Script . Literate Lantanese speakers used the Draconic alphabet . Scholars suspected that the Lantanna people learned of this language through trade with early Halruaa n or Nimbral i traders . Related Languages . Some scholars classified Lantanna as an Imaskari language , but this was far from accepted by everyone . Examples . Common female names in Lantanese were Avilda , Bersace , Charissa , Melsany , Phaerilda , Ravace , and Umbrasy . Male names might be Eberc , Fodoric , Koger , Lambrac , Midoc , Norbert , Samber , or Tibidoc . Common Lantanese surnames included Angalstrand , Decirc , Lamstrand , SeKorc , SeLangstra , and SeMilderic .

title: Lantanna
description: Lantanna The Lantanna were the native human race of the islands of the nation of Lantan . Description . The Lantanna were one of the more recognizable human ethnic groups with their copper - red hair , large , green eyes , and pale , parchment - hued skin tones .
description_long: Lantanna The Lantanna were the native human race of the islands of the nation of Lantan . Description . The Lantanna were one of the more recognizable human ethnic groups with their copper - red hair , large , green eyes , and pale , parchment - hued skin tones . They were rarely seen outside of their three native islands , except as merchants on trading vessels . Language . The Lantanna spoke their own language . Strangely , they used the Draconic alphabet to write . Scholars speculated that they borrowed this script from Halruaa n or Nimbral i traders of the past . When speaking Common , they tended to speak quickly and melodically with a thick accent that others called " human elvish " . Religion . Most Lantanna venerated Gond and believed that he entered the Faerûnian pantheon from their people .

title: Lantern Inn and Boathouse
description: Lantern Inn and Boathouse The Lantern Inn and Boathouse , previously the Lanthorn Inn and the Lantern Inn and Boat Rental , was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Staephon Gylesman , who also rented small boats and barges to guests . History .
description_long: Lantern Inn and Boathouse The Lantern Inn and Boathouse , previously the Lanthorn Inn and the Lantern Inn and Boat Rental , was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Staephon Gylesman , who also rented small boats and barges to guests . History . The Lanthorn Inn , as it was known , was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business in 1369 DR , when it was called the Lantern Inn and Boat Rental . By 1374 DR , it was called the Lantern Inn and Boathouse . Location . The Lantern Inn and Boathouse lay at the eastern end of the Wyvern Ferry over the Wyvernflow River , opposite its rival , the Wyvern Watch Inn . Services . The Lantern Inn and Boathouse was a nearly typical roadhouse . Though not a bad inn , it was a little too expensive for what it offered , and much more so than the Wyvern Watch Inn . Thus , most patrons went to the Wyvern first , and those who missed out grudgingly crossed the river to try the Lantern . However , large traveling groups preferred the Lantern because it offered them large suites of rooms , with their own hearths , private dining rooms , and a baths . These suites could also be barred from within .

title: Lantern archon
description: Lantern archon Lantern archons were celestial beings that appeared as floating balls of light glowing about as brightly as a torch . Only their destruction could extinguish the glow , though they could try to hide it . Lantern archons were friendly beings who were curious about mortals and the mortal world .
description_long: Lantern archon Lantern archons were celestial beings that appeared as floating balls of light glowing about as brightly as a torch . Only their destruction could extinguish the glow , though they could try to hide it . Lantern archons were friendly beings who were curious about mortals and the mortal world . Most lantern archons never left the heavenly realm from which they originated , always serving as custodians and guides for mortal souls that had passed into the heavens . A few found their way to the mortal world , either by being summoned forth or through a random planar gate . Despite their " lowly " status , lantern archons were content with their existence . They loved to help those in need and worked well with others . The bravery of these creatures often led them to be promoted into other forms of archons . Notes . A lantern archon could not only hover but was fully capable of flight and could teleport as well .

title: Lantern light
description: Lantern light Lantern light is an evocation spell that fires divine light from the caster ' s eyes , dealing damage . Effect . Rays of holy light flash from the caster ' s eyes .
description_long: Lantern light Lantern light is an evocation spell that fires divine light from the caster ' s eyes , dealing damage . Effect . Rays of holy light flash from the caster ' s eyes . He can fire one ray per 2 caster levels , but no more than 1 ray per round . He must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit a target . The target takes damage from each ray . Abstinence Component . The caster must abstain from sexual intercourse for 24 hours before casting this spell .

title: Lanther Maerown
description: Lanther Maerown Lanther Maerown , also known as " Smokethroat " for his raspy voice , was the stablemaster of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Lanther had thinning gray hair and a gray mustache .
description_long: Lanther Maerown Lanther Maerown , also known as " Smokethroat " for his raspy voice , was the stablemaster of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Lanther had thinning gray hair and a gray mustache . His body was short and stout with many raised white scars crisscrossing his sun - darkened , hairy forearms . Personality . Smokethroat did not suffer fools gladly and had no compunction about taking posturing bullies down a notch . Abilities . Large beasts of burden and horses were his specialty . He was a good judge of quality animals and was able to care for them when they were sick . Activities . Smoakthroat was in charge of nine other stable hands . They cared for guests ' oxen and horses , put them away at night , stored carts and wagons in the sheds , and harnessed them up again the next morning , for example . Relationships . Lanther was well known by most people who traveled up and down the Shind Road from Voonlar to Yûlash as having a good eye for horses and beasts of burden and being able to nurse them back to health when they were sick . History .

title: Lao Chin - Mao
description: Lao Chin - Mao Lao Chin - Mao was the most influential scholar in all Shou history . History . Born in 531 Shou Years ( −719 DR ) , Lao spent all his life studying how to improve the behavior and morals of his fellow Shou .
description_long: Lao Chin - Mao Lao Chin - Mao was the most influential scholar in all Shou history . History . Born in 531 Shou Years ( −719 DR ) , Lao spent all his life studying how to improve the behavior and morals of his fellow Shou . He wrote the " Book of Heaven " , a guide to a moral life . In his old age , Lao become Court Advisor to the Eleventh Emperor Chin of the Ho Dynasty , using his influence to shape the growing bureaucracy in a new social class devoted to his principles . This led to the creation of the Mandarinate , a upper class of scholars and gentlemen who were the intellectual elite of Shou Lung . Description . Lao was known to always dress in old - fashioned robes and a conical hat . Appendix . Background . Lao Chin - Mao appears to be based on the Chinese philosopher known as .

title: Laothan language
description: Laothan language Laothan was a language spoken by the people of Laothan in Malatra . When the Laothan tribes came into contact with neighboring civilizations , they borrowed words and phrases for concepts and things they as yet had no words for . Most of these came from the T ' u Lung language , but as the Laothan pronunciation deviated significantly from the form , it was almost impossible for T ' u Lung speakers to recognize them .

title: Lapaliiya
description: Lapaliiya Lapaliiya ( also known as the Lapal League ) consisted of the land between the Delphin Mountains and the Sheir Peninsula , bounded by the Mhair Jungles , the North Wall of Halruaa , the Bandit Wastes and the Dun Hills . The Cities of the Seabreeze were sometimes misunderstood to describe Lapaliiya , but this phrase also included other cities , such as Narubel , Tashluta , Ormpur , and Procalith . The city of Sheirtalar hosted a Shou Town ( source ) Lapaliiya in 1478 : The confederacy of Lapaliiya crumbled during the Spellplague due to spellfire spreading through a newly formed gap in Halruaa ' s north wall .
description_long: Lapaliiya Lapaliiya ( also known as the Lapal League ) consisted of the land between the Delphin Mountains and the Sheir Peninsula , bounded by the Mhair Jungles , the North Wall of Halruaa , the Bandit Wastes and the Dun Hills . The Cities of the Seabreeze were sometimes misunderstood to describe Lapaliiya , but this phrase also included other cities , such as Narubel , Tashluta , Ormpur , and Procalith . The city of Sheirtalar hosted a Shou Town ( source ) Lapaliiya in 1478 : The confederacy of Lapaliiya crumbled during the Spellplague due to spellfire spreading through a newly formed gap in Halruaa ' s north wall . The remnants were occupied by wild elf tribes and the region was known as Elfharrow . The city of Ormpur survived .

title: Lapis lazuli
description: Lapis lazuli Lapis lazuli , incorrectly called in the South , was an ornamental stone found in the Realms . Description . Lapis lazuli was an opaque gem ranging in color from sky blue to dark blue , usually bespeckled with gold .
description_long: Lapis lazuli Lapis lazuli , incorrectly called in the South , was an ornamental stone found in the Realms . Description . Lapis lazuli was an opaque gem ranging in color from sky blue to dark blue , usually bespeckled with gold . These ornamental stones were typically cut and polished to enhance the look of the gold flecks . Lapis cabochons were often carved into more artistic shapes , such as griffon s , scarab s , or unicorn s . The deep blue specimens were the most in demand and commanded the highest prices . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . A lapis gemstone could be used as substitute for a ruby in the making of a " periapt of health " . Lapis lazuli was also crushed and used as an ingredient in making " potions of heroism " and " super - heroism " .

title: Laraelra Harsard
description: Laraelra Harsard Laraelra Harsard was a human sorceress with minor magic al powers . As of 1479 DR , she was the Blackstaff ' s Heir under Vajra Safahr . Description .
description_long: Laraelra Harsard Laraelra Harsard was a human sorceress with minor magic al powers . As of 1479 DR , she was the Blackstaff ' s Heir under Vajra Safahr . Description . Laraelra was very thin and had long black hair . Personality . Laraela was an idealist who cared deeply for Waterdeep and its inhabitants . She championed the causes of underdogs , including dwarves in the Cellarers ' and Plumbers ' guild who were discriminated against . Despite her independence , however , she was insecure and feared her father ' s disapproval . History . In 1479 DR , while exploring the sewers with her hired bodyguard Meloon Wardragon , Laraelra heard a woman ' s screams . She was able to track the source to a house owned by Renaer Neverember . Laraelra , Meloon , Renaer , and two of his friends rescued the woman , who turned out to be the Blackstaff ' s Heir , Vajra Safahr , who had been kidnapped after the secret murder of Blackstaff Samark Dhanzscul . Laraelra and friends were forced to leave Waterdeep for a short time after Khondar " Ten - Rings " Naomal framed the group for Vajra ' s supposed murder .

title: Laragunt
description: Laragunt Laragunt of Threskel was an archmage . History . Laragunt was a wizard from Threskel .
description_long: Laragunt Laragunt of Threskel was an archmage . History . Laragunt was a wizard from Threskel . Around 1487 DR , he went in search of the Lost Spell at the Oldspire mansion , like many other archmages . When a spellstorm hit the place , Laragunt and a Red Wizard of Thay tried to escape but the magic energies made them insane .

title: Larajin
description: Larajin Larajin was the unacknowledged half - elf daughter of Thamalon Uskevren and the wild elf Trisdea of the Tangled Trees . She was also the twin sister of Leifander . Religion .
description_long: Larajin Larajin was the unacknowledged half - elf daughter of Thamalon Uskevren and the wild elf Trisdea of the Tangled Trees . She was also the twin sister of Leifander . Religion . Larajin was a cleric of two goddesses ; one human , one elven , in a reflection of her half - elven nature . She worshiped both Sune and Hanali Celanil .

title: Larak Dardulkyn
description: Larak Dardulkyn Larak Dardulkyn was considered the most powerful independent wizard in Suzail . He was also the richest , acquiring his wealth by working as a freelance mage for noble houses . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , the young noble Arclath Delcastle went to Larak ' s mansion and attempted to hire him to find the noble who controlled the blueflame ghost s .
description_long: Larak Dardulkyn Larak Dardulkyn was considered the most powerful independent wizard in Suzail . He was also the richest , acquiring his wealth by working as a freelance mage for noble houses . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , the young noble Arclath Delcastle went to Larak ' s mansion and attempted to hire him to find the noble who controlled the blueflame ghost s . Instead , Larak imprisoned Arclath . When Elminster , Storm Silverhand , and Mirt came to Arclath ' s rescue , Elminster ' s spirit possessed Arclath and cast spells that destroyed most of Larak ' s mansion .
