After Larak ' s home was reduced to a smoking ruin , Manshoon dominated Larak ' s mind and moved his beholder s to the mansion ' s basement .

title: Laral Kroul
description: Laral Kroul Laral Kroul was the main delegate for surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Laral was a cunning and mean individual .
description_long: Laral Kroul Laral Kroul was the main delegate for surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Laral was a cunning and mean individual . He liked to appear as a hostile stranger , but was an aggressive dealer and one of the most efficient merchants in the outpost . Nobody knew where he had all his contacts . History . Around 1372 DR , Laral was the representative of surface - dwellers in the merchant outpost .

title: Larala Dumian
description: Larala Dumian Larala Dumian was a female half - drow fang of Lolth who degenerated into insanity during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Before Larala underwent her transformation as a fang of Lolth , she had dusty grey skin , but after adopting the " fang scarab " her skin became inky black with numerous tufts of hair covering it .
description_long: Larala Dumian Larala Dumian was a female half - drow fang of Lolth who degenerated into insanity during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Before Larala underwent her transformation as a fang of Lolth , she had dusty grey skin , but after adopting the " fang scarab " her skin became inky black with numerous tufts of hair covering it . Another notable product of her transformation was her elongated digits and limbs along with huge , multifaceted eyes . Additionally , she grew very sharp and long fangs . These physical changes , coupled with her black studded leather armor , made her seem to almost merge with the darkness around her . Personality . Following the Silence of Lolth , Larala became highly paranoid and utterly convinced that the worshipers of Kiaransalee were responsible for Lolth ' s absence . Usually accompanied by the incessant whispers of Lolth , Larala became increasingly insane without them and would replace Lolth ' s whispers with quiet murmurings of her own . Abilities . As a fang of Lolth , Larala had numerous abilities related to her transformation via the " fang scarab " . However , during the Silence of Lolth , these abilities disappeared . Possessions .

title: Laranadda
description: Laranadda The Laranadda family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Laranaddas were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Tithlin , and Vandover families .
description_long: Laranadda The Laranadda family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Laranaddas were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Larch deJuan
description: Larch deJuan Larch deJuan was a young stable hand in Mulmaster . Personality . Larch was a boy with a good heart and happy with his life .
description_long: Larch deJuan Larch deJuan was a young stable hand in Mulmaster . Personality . Larch was a boy with a good heart and happy with his life . He dreaded becoming a paladin of Tyr . Relationships . Larch was a stablehand under Elize , a paladin of Tyr . He was the brother of Nelvon deJuan , a Brotherhood of the Cloak member . History . In 1491 DR , at a great party in the Astrid Saj villa , Larch was kidnapped by the Kron family , who wanted revenge against his brother . However , Nelvon hired an adventuring party who happened to be present and they eventually saved Larch .

title: Larendrammagar
description: Larendrammagar Larendrammagar , more commonly known as Nexus , was a great wyrm gold dragon that had a role in the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Larendrammagar was one of the oldest gold dragons and reputed to be the most talented spellcaster among the metallic dragon s .
description_long: Larendrammagar Larendrammagar , more commonly known as Nexus , was a great wyrm gold dragon that had a role in the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Larendrammagar was one of the oldest gold dragons and reputed to be the most talented spellcaster among the metallic dragon s . However , he slept for centuries in the gold ' s hideout in Galena Mountains . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon King Lareth and his lieutenant Tamarand challenged each other over whether to help humanoid races against the Rage , Nexus was awoken to be one of the witnesses of the duel , the other being the captain of the Talons of Justice , Havarlan . After the duel , Nexus agreed to help Dorn Graybrook and his companions in researching the " Dracorage mythal " . Using lore from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , the great wyrm managed to reconstruct the elven high magic rite used to curse dragonkind and devise a counterspell that would wipe the enchantment away , but only if cast in the right place . After the defeat of Sammaster , who had used an ancient elf citadel as his headquarters , Nexus cast the spell that stopped the Rage .

title: Lareth
description: Lareth His Resplendence , Lareth , the King of Justice , was once the ruler of gold dragon s He was killed in 1373 DR . Death . In 1373 DR , Lareth was slain in battle by the gold dragon , Tamarand .
description_long: Lareth His Resplendence , Lareth , the King of Justice , was once the ruler of gold dragon s He was killed in 1373 DR . Death . In 1373 DR , Lareth was slain in battle by the gold dragon , Tamarand . Tamarand , Lareth ' s deputy and close friend , challenged Lareth for leadership of all goodly dragons after Lareth ' s reasoning and judgment had been corrupted . Lareth , teetering on the edge of madness as a result of the Rage that was plaguing all dragon - kind at the time , eagerly accepted , intent on destroying this obviously power - hungry , traitorous " friend " , who must surely covet the position of King of Justice . At first , Tamarand tried to subdue Lareth , using only spells to disable not destroy , but finally Tamarand was forced to deliver a fatal blow . As required by the protocols of the Ptarian Code , the gold dragon Larendrammagar ( " Nexus " ) and the silver dragon Havarlan bore witness to the battle . Legacy . After Lareth ' s death , magical daggers were made from his fangs . Called a " Dragontooth of Lareth " , these daggers are given to elite members of the Talons of Justice , and were supposed to contain a part of the wisdom of the former King of Justice .

title: Larethar Gulgrin
description: Larethar Gulgrin Larethar Gulgrin was a gold dwarf rogue from Luskan . Relationships . His closest ally was Illydia Maethellyn .
description_long: Larethar Gulgrin Larethar Gulgrin was a gold dwarf rogue from Luskan . Relationships . His closest ally was Illydia Maethellyn . History . Larethar was a rude , drinking , cut - purse who had gained the honor of travel with Illydia , an honor he never took for granted . With the moon elf , his life took on another meaning as he became a hero — a hero with a sharp tongue to all except Illydia . Appendix . Trivia . His tattoo says " From Rock " in Dethek . Appearances . Larethar will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Larga Bloodhand
description: Larga Bloodhand Larga Bloodhand was a orog warlord in Thar near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went with her bodyguards to meet the black dragon Throstulgrael , who had recently settled near Twilight Marsh .
description_long: Larga Bloodhand Larga Bloodhand was a orog warlord in Thar near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went with her bodyguards to meet the black dragon Throstulgrael , who had recently settled near Twilight Marsh . She hoped that the dragon would sponsored her in her rise to power , but one of her bodyguards inadvertently insulted the dragon and they became his captives . Eventually , she was freed by an adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair .

title: Laric
description: Laric Laric was the Captain of the Bloodriders , the personal guard of Grunnarch the Red . History . In 1345 DR , Laric accompanied Grunnarch the Red to Oman ' s Isle to the council before attacking the Ffolk cities in the southern cities of the Moonshae Isles .
description_long: Laric Laric was the Captain of the Bloodriders , the personal guard of Grunnarch the Red . History . In 1345 DR , Laric accompanied Grunnarch the Red to Oman ' s Isle to the council before attacking the Ffolk cities in the southern cities of the Moonshae Isles .

title: Larid Herokimal
description: Larid Herokimal Larid Herokimal was a human paladin , a war hero , and the baron of the city of Kelazzan in Ulgarth around 1367 DR and 1373 DR . Personality . Herokimal was a devoutly religious paladin .
description_long: Larid Herokimal Larid Herokimal was a human paladin , a war hero , and the baron of the city of Kelazzan in Ulgarth around 1367 DR and 1373 DR . Personality . Herokimal was a devoutly religious paladin . However , he did not try to push his beliefs onto his subjects , insisting only that they obey his laws whilst within his barony . He considered his laws fair and just , and he had no tolerance of crime , instead dedicating a great amount of resources to fighting crime in all its forms . He was thus seen as a firm but just ruler . On the other hand , he also felt everyone should enjoy the fruits of their own efforts as far as possible , and that no one should be exploited or restricted in taking advantage of the opportunities available . His policies kept life in Kelazzan quite pleasant and prosperous . Residence . Herokimal had a manor in Kelazzan .

title: Larikal Dyrr
description: Larikal Dyrr Larikal Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Larikal was the third daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr .
description_long: Larikal Dyrr Larikal Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Larikal was the third daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr . During the siege at Dyrr ' s compound for their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Larikal happened across the archmage Gromph Baenre , who had infiltrated the compound in order to destroy the Lichdrow Dyrr ' s phylactery . Gromph , mistaking her for her mother , immediately killed her . After Gromph used her disguise to better infiltrate the Dyrr house temple

title: Larion Keenblade
description: Larion Keenblade Larion Keenblade was a member of Severin ' s reformed Cult of the Dragon . History . He was forcibly conscripted into the Cult and not very happy about his situation .
description_long: Larion Keenblade Larion Keenblade was a member of Severin ' s reformed Cult of the Dragon . History . He was forcibly conscripted into the Cult and not very happy about his situation . He was part of the Cult ' s army in the assault on Greenest . Later , he was at the Cult ' s camp near the city . Gameplay . Adventurers could potentially befriend him and convince him to betray the Cult , providing them with very useful information .

title: Larissa Neathal
description: Larissa Neathal Larissa Neathal was a courtesan and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Larissa had red hair .
description_long: Larissa Neathal Larissa Neathal was a courtesan and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Larissa had red hair . However , she was very skilled in using cosmetics and magic to alter her appearance . Personality . In the public sphere , Larissa was superficial and empty - headed . However , she used that persona as a front to allow her to gain information from the many public officials she lured into her hands . History . In 1364 DR , Larissa was beaten and badly wounded by agents of the Knights of the Shield working for Iriador Wintermist . She was found by Mirt in her home and slowly nursed back to health . Residence . Larissa lived in a house on Mulgomir ' s Way in the Castle Ward , where she had a maidservant named Marta until she was killed in 1364 DR . Possessions . Larissa always wore a distinctive " periapt of proof against poison " necklace that was shaped like a golden phoenix rising from a cluster of rubies . Relationships . Larissa was one of the " Like - Minded Lords " in 1364 DR ( the others were Mirt , Khelben , Durnan , Kitten , and Brian ) , who frequently met up to enjoy each other ' s company ) . Durnan was her closest friend .

title: Larloch
description: Larloch Larloch , called the Shadow King , was a Netherese male human and a lich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in ancient Netheril and later the master of the Warlock ' s Crypt and Shadow King of its undead inhabitants . He was one of the oldest non - draconic beings in Faerûn and one of the most powerful mages .
description_long: Larloch Larloch , called the Shadow King , was a Netherese male human and a lich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in ancient Netheril and later the master of the Warlock ' s Crypt and Shadow King of its undead inhabitants . He was one of the oldest non - draconic beings in Faerûn and one of the most powerful mages . Description . As a lich of such extreme age , Larloch ' s body was greatly decayed , with his flesh entirely gone and leaving only his white - boned skeleton . In his empty eye - sockets were two orbs of red light in place of eyes . On occasion , streaks of emerald energy moved about his body , and were a side - effect of his defensive curses . He wore fine clothes that hung off and partially covered his skeleton . At least two dozen " ioun stone " s floated around his skull . Personality . Larloch possessed incredible power and was a superintelligent genius . Over two thousand years , he ' d composed perfect plans to deal with nearly every possible situation , and even for things he was not prepared for , he could come up with an almost - perfect response in moments .

title: Larloch ' s minor drain
description: Larloch ' s minor drain Larloch ' s minor drain was an arcane necromancy spell that drained the life of a target creature . Effects . The spell drained a small portion of life from a target creature and transferred it to the caster , healing them of any injuries they add .
description_long: Larloch ' s minor drain Larloch ' s minor drain was an arcane necromancy spell that drained the life of a target creature . Effects . The spell drained a small portion of life from a target creature and transferred it to the caster , healing them of any injuries they add . If they had no injuries , then they received a brief boost to their life force instead . History . The spell was attributed to Larloch the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt , but it went on to be commonly used in Faerûn through the 13th and 14th centuries DR . A scroll of " Larloch ' s minor drain " was in the Black Wolf Temple in the Vale of Shadows in Icewind Dale in 1281 DR . Copies of " Larloch ' s minor drain " could be bought from the High Hedge in Beregost , Sorcerous Sundries in Baldur ' s Gate , Waukeen ' s Promenade in Athkatla , and the Arcana Archives in Saradush in 1368 DR . The imp Cespenar , operating from Cespenar ' s Forge in the Abyssal Fortress , was able to combine the sword Foebane and Fflar ' s Scabbard , such that the sword inflicted " Larloch ' s minor drain " every time it struck a foe .

title: Larmon Greenboot
description: Larmon Greenboot Larmon Greenboot was a shepherd in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Larmon led his sheep to graze in the Sumber Hills .
description_long: Larmon Greenboot Larmon Greenboot was a shepherd in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Larmon led his sheep to graze in the Sumber Hills . History . During a trip to the Hills in 1491 DR , Larmon noticed some mysterious freshly dug graves . Greatly shocked , he told the story many times at Marlandro Gaelkur ' s barbershop . Some adventurers hired to find a missing diplomatic delegation from Mirabar listened in and , checking the area , discovered the corpses of some members of the delegation and an Elemental Evil cultist .

title: Laroun
description: Laroun Laroun or Lauroun was a human Warlord of the " Free City of Waterdeep " ( later known simply as Waterdeep ) and the city ' s first female Warlord . Description . Laroun had cerulean eyes , a hawklike nose , and a strong brow .
description_long: Laroun Laroun or Lauroun was a human Warlord of the " Free City of Waterdeep " ( later known simply as Waterdeep ) and the city ' s first female Warlord . Description . Laroun had cerulean eyes , a hawklike nose , and a strong brow . History . Laroun ruled the settlement from 974 DR , the year Castle Waterdeep was completed , up until her death in 1026 DR . During her rule , she established a naval guard in 998 DR , the same year construction work began on fortifications for the harbour and Deepwatch Isle . The fortifications were finished in 1010 DR , which is when the settlement took on the name " Free City of Waterdeep . " Laroun was killed in 1026 DR by archers during raids on the city by Black Claw orcs . Ahghairon honored her final wish to always be able to protect Waterdeep by binding a part of her departing soul in the magical axe " Azuredge " . Laroun was succeeded as Warlord by Rhaulor . Relationships . Laroun was one of the members of Clan Wardragon , which was dispersed across northwest Faerûn . In 1479 DR , her descendant Meloon Wardragon successfully retrieved " Azuredge " from the Nameless Haunt in the Pellamcopse Woods and was granted the privilege of wielding it .

title: Larrakh
description: Larrakh Larrakh was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Red Larch who was in contact with the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The priest hoped to redeem himself in the eyes of his cultist masters by conquering Red Larch .
description_long: Larrakh Larrakh was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Red Larch who was in contact with the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The priest hoped to redeem himself in the eyes of his cultist masters by conquering Red Larch . His plot was to transform the Believers into a nefarious organization and afterward unveil and defeat them , becoming a hero in the eyes of the citizens . Relationships . Larrakh was a Black Earth priest in disgrace for failing some missions . History . Around 1491 DR , he went to Red Larch , where he began to influence the Believers into becoming more dark and evil . He was defeated by some adventurers who were investigating in the village .

title: Larrana Vestel
description: Larrana Vestel Larrana Vestel was a human explorer and guide who operated throughout Gontal , mainly in the Glaur Barrens . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Larrana was renowned in Gontal for her skills as an adventuress and for being brave enough to explore the Glaur Barrens .
description_long: Larrana Vestel Larrana Vestel was a human explorer and guide who operated throughout Gontal , mainly in the Glaur Barrens . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Larrana was renowned in Gontal for her skills as an adventuress and for being brave enough to explore the Glaur Barrens . She charged rather high fees to her customers , but her skill with the bow and her knowledge of Gontal ' s lands and dangers were worth the coin . Larrana was also one of the few individuals in all Laerakond who had first hand knowledge about the Dominions of Nehu .

title: Larry Elmore
description: Larry Elmore Larry Elmore is a prolific fantasy illustrator , who has produced work for many settings . He was the author of " SnarfQuest Tales " , a comic series of " Dragon " magazine . Education .
description_long: Larry Elmore Larry Elmore is a prolific fantasy illustrator , who has produced work for many settings . He was the author of " SnarfQuest Tales " , a comic series of " Dragon " magazine . Education . Elmore received his Bachelor of Fine Arts degree from Western Kentucky . Career . After doing freelance work for various fantasy magazines , Elmore was hired by TSR , Inc . in 1981 to illustrate sourcebook covers . He also illustrated novel covers for the Dragonlance setting . In 1987 , Elmore returned to freelance work and has contributed art for the covers of books , magazines , and video games published by a wide range of companies . He has also authored some of his own works , such as " Runes of Autumn " and the " Sovereign Stone " series .

title: Larva
description: Larva Abyssal larvae , also called soul larvae , are not unlike grubs or rot grubs . When people are corrupted by chaos and evil , these chaotic evil mortal souls flow to the Abyss . Larvae can , if given enough time become demon lords .
description_long: Larva Abyssal larvae , also called soul larvae , are not unlike grubs or rot grubs . When people are corrupted by chaos and evil , these chaotic evil mortal souls flow to the Abyss . Larvae can , if given enough time become demon lords . sources . Demonomicon page 15

title: Larynda Telenna
description: Larynda Telenna Larynda Telenna was the high priestess of Kiaransalee in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth beneath Vaasa . She was also the leader of Kiaransalee ' s cult across the entirety of Faerûn . History .
description_long: Larynda Telenna Larynda Telenna was the high priestess of Kiaransalee in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth beneath Vaasa . She was also the leader of Kiaransalee ' s cult across the entirety of Faerûn . History . In 1337 DR , Larynda Telenna brought with her a group of acolytes who aided her in constructing the Acropolis of Thanatos in the ruins of the city V ' elddrinnsshar . Among those who resided with her in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth was the keening spirit Gurden Myrinn .

title: Lasaonar
description: Lasaonar Lasaonar was a drow swordmaster living in Ust Natha . Activities . He was known to participate in duels in the local tavern ' s fighting pit .
description_long: Lasaonar Lasaonar was a drow swordmaster living in Ust Natha . Activities . He was known to participate in duels in the local tavern ' s fighting pit . History . In 1367 DR , Gorion ' s Ward , when disguised as a drow , had the chance to watch Lasaonar fight four people at once in the tavern . After this , Gorion ' s Ward and their party could engage Lasaonar in a duel themselves , getting challenged by belittling his performance . If they won , his patron — a priestess — would challenge them next . This would then lead to mage duels . Possessions . Lasaonar wore drow - made " + 5 adamantine full plate armor " and carried two enchanted swords that were similarly made of adamantine . Whereas one of these was an ordinary drow - made " + 3 longsword " , as carried by several other drow , the other was actually the " Blade of Searing " , a " + 3 bastard sword " that struck with fire and was made of a special alloy that would endure the sunlight once taken back to the surface , unlike other drow - made items . He would gave this sword to Gorion ' s Ward if defeated by them .

title: Lasfelro
description: Lasfelro Lasfelro the Silent was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lasfelro usually remained silent , hence his moniker , but sometimes he broke into merry song or short bouts of joke - telling .
description_long: Lasfelro Lasfelro the Silent was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lasfelro usually remained silent , hence his moniker , but sometimes he broke into merry song or short bouts of joke - telling . He was a reasonably good singer and his jokes were quite funny . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR Lasfelro attached his wagon to a great caravan that , unknown to him , was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Lashan Aumersair
description: Lashan Aumersair Lashan Aumersair was the ruler of Scardale until he attempted a war of conquest in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , to unite the Dalelands under his rule . History . A direct descendant of Elminster ( the Aumersair name was a corruption of " Aumar ' s heir " ) , Lashan was descended from a long line of Purple Dragons and Harpers .
description_long: Lashan Aumersair Lashan Aumersair was the ruler of Scardale until he attempted a war of conquest in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , to unite the Dalelands under his rule . History . A direct descendant of Elminster ( the Aumersair name was a corruption of " Aumar ' s heir " ) , Lashan was descended from a long line of Purple Dragons and Harpers . After his defeat in 1356 , he ventured into the ruins of Myth Drannor where he fell in battle against the lich Azimer , who transformed him into a Larva and imprisoned him beneath the earth . Sometime later , a night hag in service of Shar freed him , and when the Sharran decided to conquer Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR , Shar elevated Lashan to a nycaloth to use him in the conquest .

title: Lashilmbrar
description: Lashilmbrar Lashilmbrar the Sly was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Lashilmbrar was the second son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur .
description_long: Lashilmbrar Lashilmbrar the Sly was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Lashilmbrar was the second son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur . He had an older brother , Talryn , and four step - brothers — Kuskar , Velimbrar , Elphras , and Fylraun — from his father ' s second wife , Rebaera Osterhown . Lashilmbrar married Thelmara Rorntarn , and they had two sons together , Imphras III and Rilimbrar . History . Lashilmbrar was born in the Year of the Poisoned Quill , 1190 DR . Shortly after his father married his second wife , Lashilmbrar ' s father grew mentally unstable and left the rule of his kingdom to his advisors . Lashilmbrar secretly allied himself with some of these advisors , and when his older brother , Prince Talryn , sought to remove their father from power in 1208 DR , Lashilmbrar betrayed him and had him accused of treason , but he escaped and fled into exile to Urdogen . Since Talryn was still the rightful heir , Lashilmbrar made further attempts to have him killed . First , he set up a ruse with the court advisors to destroy " Urdogen ' s pirates " , which he claimed were threatening Impiltur ' s ships .

title: Lashrael
description: Lashrael Lashrael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Lashrael and his fellow Felarathael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann .
description_long: Lashrael Lashrael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Lashrael and his fellow Felarathael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann . They explained to her that from that point all the followers of Eilistraee had been transformed into dark elves and allowed back into Arvandor , where she was then led by the solars .

title: Lashyrr Maerdrymm
description: Lashyrr Maerdrymm Lashyrr Maerdrymm was the leader of the dukar Order of Numos in Myth Nantar . Activiities . Lashyrr was the most visible of the dukar paragons , despite her status .
description_long: Lashyrr Maerdrymm Lashyrr Maerdrymm was the leader of the dukar Order of Numos in Myth Nantar . Activiities . Lashyrr was the most visible of the dukar paragons , despite her status . She relished re - establishing contacts with fellow elves after centuries of isolation . Relashionship . Lashyrr believed herself to be the last of her House . In truth she was a cousin of Khelben Arunsun .

title: Lasishal Ama
description: Lasishal Ama Lasishal Ama was the greatest spirit in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . She was the most powerful river spirit , famous for assisting many legendary heroes , and punishing those who had sought to despoil the land . She was presumed to live inside the Ama River .
description_long: Lasishal Ama Lasishal Ama was the greatest spirit in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . She was the most powerful river spirit , famous for assisting many legendary heroes , and punishing those who had sought to despoil the land . She was presumed to live inside the Ama River . It was likely that the many spirit folk in the area had descended from her .

title: Laspar
description: Laspar Laspar was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Description . Laspars appeared similar to " squat cedar s " .
description_long: Laspar Laspar was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Description . Laspars appeared similar to " squat cedar s " . Their flat needles were olive green , giving the tree the appearance that it was dead . The needles grew in clusters called " shags " at the end of each branch . Laspar trunks had a dusty green bark covering golden - colored wood . Usage . Laspar wood did not serve well for fires because it had large amounts of pitch that caused sputtering sparks . However , laspar needles were often used in candles and torches . The needles were also used for their scent . Locations . Laspars grew as far east as Thay and as far south as the Forest of Tethir . In the North , they were particularly common in Turnstone Pass , Delimbiyr Vale , and the Far Forest .

title: Laspeera Inthré
description: Laspeera Inthré Laspeera Inthré ( sometimes informally called Speera , Mother , and Mother Laspeera ) was a human female and warden of the War Wizards of Cormyr . Biography . Born Laspeera Naerinth , she was married to Aundable Inthré , a fellow War Wizard of Cormyr , and was second - in - command of that group under the leadership of Caladnei .
description_long: Laspeera Inthré Laspeera Inthré ( sometimes informally called Speera , Mother , and Mother Laspeera ) was a human female and warden of the War Wizards of Cormyr . Biography . Born Laspeera Naerinth , she was married to Aundable Inthré , a fellow War Wizard of Cormyr , and was second - in - command of that group under the leadership of Caladnei . She also owned a school for girls known as the House of Grace and was granted lands in Cormyr by King Azoun IV . When Caladnei became leader of the War Wizards , her discomfort with official matters quickly became clear so Laspeera offered to take on most of her duties for her . This led to Laspeera becoming the fourth most powerful individual in Cormyr for twelve years , only answering to the regent , the queen and Caladnei . She once shocked the entire Council of Mages during a meeting by going into labour . At the time no one in court even suspected she was pregnant as she had concealed the fact with magic . Appearance . Although beautiful , at the time Laspeera became Warden , her mouth was beginning to show lines at its edges . She wore clear crystal spectacles held in front of her eyes by magic and had a sharp nose . Family .

title: Lassalar Ormitar
description: Lassalar Ormitar Lassalar Ormitar was a male human fighter in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , he was head of the Ormitar noble house , a member of the High Council that governed Tantras , and commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city . Although the Guard was directly responsible to the Council , its loyalties lay with Lassalar , who was more serious about restricting merchant freedoms in favour of law and order .
description_long: Lassalar Ormitar Lassalar Ormitar was a male human fighter in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , he was head of the Ormitar noble house , a member of the High Council that governed Tantras , and commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city . Although the Guard was directly responsible to the Council , its loyalties lay with Lassalar , who was more serious about restricting merchant freedoms in favour of law and order .

title: Last judgment
description: Last judgment Last judgment is a necromancy spell that strikes evil creatures dead and banishes their souls to the Lower Planes . Effects . Reciting a list of the targets ’ evil deeds , you call down the judgment of the heavens upon their heads .
description_long: Last judgment Last judgment is a necromancy spell that strikes evil creatures dead and banishes their souls to the Lower Planes . Effects . Reciting a list of the targets ’ evil deeds , you call down the judgment of the heavens upon their heads . Creatures with weak wills are struck dead and bodily transported to the appropriate Lower Plane to suffer their eternal punishment . Creatures that succeed nevertheless suffer severe mental damage as guilt for their misdeeds overwhelms their minds . This spell affects only humanoid s , monstrous humanoid s , and giant s of evil alignment . A " true resurrection " or " miracle " spell can restore life to a creature slain by this spell normally . A " resurrection " spell works only if the creature ’ s body can be recovered from the Lower Planes before the " resurrection " is cast .

title: Lastraeya Indomurr
description: Lastraeya Indomurr Lastraeya Indomurr was a human woman of Chessenta who moved to the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , she held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat . History .
description_long: Lastraeya Indomurr Lastraeya Indomurr was a human woman of Chessenta who moved to the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , she held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat . History . Lastraeya Indomurr hailed from Chessenta before relocating to Ravens Bluff in the Vast . She was once a tavern dancer before she worked in Ravens Bluff ' s Regency of City Works , in quite a low - ranking and little - known position by 1370 DR . This changed when the then - current Regent of City Works , Bundrigo Dalastarra , was murdered in the summer of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Scandal erupted as Bundrigo ' s crimes were uncovered — he had operated a huge and well - oiled system of bribery , kickbacks , and informers , the greatest ever known in Ravens Bluff . He paid his hardworking officials well , though some believed the money ultimately came from pirates . Lord Chancellor Arvin Kothonos had a difficult time finding anyone in the Regency with any experience who wasn ' t tainted by Bundrigo ' s web of corruption .

title: Latar
description: Latar Latar was a male troglodyte cleric who roamed the Deep Wastes leading raids for his tribe . Description . Latar wore breastplate armor and wielded an oversized morningstar .
description_long: Latar Latar was a male troglodyte cleric who roamed the Deep Wastes leading raids for his tribe . Description . Latar wore breastplate armor and wielded an oversized morningstar . He typically wrapped himself in a cloak . Personality . He approached situations with a shrewd mind - set and was astute enough to delay his often over - eager subordinates . If a raid turned badly , the cleric was even willing to risk " planar travel " to escape . Latar ' s sojourns were often motivated by the allure of acquiring treasure from those his band defeated . Abilities . A shrewd leader , Latar was an experienced cleric and traveler in the Underdark . He was quite adept at organizing the tactics of his subordinates during raids . In combat , although not overly strong , Latar would enhance his natural toughness and skill with his magic before using powerful " slay living " or " chaos hammer " spells to weaken his foes . Eventually , he would advance into close - quarters wielding an oversized morningstar with deadly effect , thanks to his preparatory blessings , interspersing vicious swipes of his claw between his morningstar ' s blows .

title: Lateu ' quor
description: Lateu ' quor Lateu ' quor , the Forest Communion of the Crescent Moon , was a religious ceremony in which the elven deity Corellon was praised by his followers and his gift of creativity honored . It was held once per lunar month , when the moon was in its quarter phase , a crescent , and softly illuminating the night sky . Followers of the elven deity Corellon gathered in moonlit glades , where they praised their Creator through music , song , and dance and offerings of beautiful artwork .
description_long: Lateu ' quor Lateu ' quor , the Forest Communion of the Crescent Moon , was a religious ceremony in which the elven deity Corellon was praised by his followers and his gift of creativity honored . It was held once per lunar month , when the moon was in its quarter phase , a crescent , and softly illuminating the night sky . Followers of the elven deity Corellon gathered in moonlit glades , where they praised their Creator through music , song , and dance and offerings of beautiful artwork . The art was not destroyed ; sometimes it was physically transferred to Arvandor for elves to enjoy in the afterlife , while other times it was used to decorate Corellon ' s temples and shrines for elves to enjoy in life . On rare and special occasions , Corellon himself would play a role , and the very landscape of the glade was reshaped into a work of art , becoming sacred to the god . Other times , his magic would form an item of unearthly beauty , such as a sword , longbow , cloak and boots , a suit of elven mail armor , or a musical instrument . These treasures were then enchanted by senior priests of the faith , and were considered holy relics .

title: Lathander
description: Lathander Lathander ( pronounced " lah - THAN - der " ) , whose title was The Morninglord , was a deity of creativity , dawn , renewal , birth , athletics , spring , self - perfection , vitality and youth . He favored those who dispelled the undead and blessed those who planted new life . Lathander was also the god called upon to bless birth and fertility related ceremonies .
description_long: Lathander Lathander ( pronounced " lah - THAN - der " ) , whose title was The Morninglord , was a deity of creativity , dawn , renewal , birth , athletics , spring , self - perfection , vitality and youth . He favored those who dispelled the undead and blessed those who planted new life . Lathander was also the god called upon to bless birth and fertility related ceremonies . Some saw him as the neutral good aspect of Amaunator but the two were considered separate deities again after the Second Sundering . History . Lathander was the central figure in the Dawn Cataclysm , an ill - fated attempt by the Morninglord to reshape the Faerûnian pantheon in his own image . Several deities were killed in the events that followed , including the goddess Murdane , a death for which Helm never forgave Lathander . The Morninglord believed that his efforts went so wrong because of the interference of agents of Shar , and secretly began working on a second attempt at reforming the pantheon .

title: Lathander ' s Light
description: Lathander ' s Light Lathander ' s Light was the local temple to the Morninglord in Dagger Falls . Location . Situated within the walls on the east side of town this solid stone building faced the rising sun .
description_long: Lathander ' s Light Lathander ' s Light was the local temple to the Morninglord in Dagger Falls . Location . Situated within the walls on the east side of town this solid stone building faced the rising sun . Structure . Exterior . Lathander ' s Light was a square and solid stone building with a tiled roof . Even after it reconstruction in 1369 DR , however , it still retained a number of scorch marks from the fire that destroyed it in 1359 DR . Interior . Although spartanly appointed , the halls were lit with a rose - red network of " continual flame " spells cast by the clergy . The temple was known before it burnt down for its bubbling marble fountain that many families used for cooking or drinking water . Beneath the temple lay cellars and the crypts . Services . Before the destruction of the temple in 1359 DR , Lathander ' s Light created its own wine , dubbed Lathander ' s red . The temple provided healing potion s at a high price to help raise funds . In addition , it was particulary active in sponsering stalls and trader in the market of Dagger Falls . Even going so far as to establish a mounted escort group of merchants called the Morning Shields . History .

title: Lathander ' s red
description: Lathander ' s red Lathander ' s Red was a variety of wine brewed by the priest s of Lathander in Dagger Falls . Description . A valuable red wine , it was typically kept in small casks below Lathander ' s Light .
description_long: Lathander ' s red Lathander ' s Red was a variety of wine brewed by the priest s of Lathander in Dagger Falls . Description . A valuable red wine , it was typically kept in small casks below Lathander ' s Light . History . In 1359 DR , the temple of Lathander ' s Light was burnt down by Eragyn the Dark . Despite this , many casks of Lathander ' s Red survived the fire because they were stored in the wine cellar below ground . Appendix . Appearances . Doom of Daggerdale

title: Lathery
description: Lathery Lathery , also written Lachery , was a Netherese enclave of Netheril that specialized in fishing , using its " mythallar " to do so . It was found hovering over the Narrow Sea , moving along its shoreline . Economy .
description_long: Lathery Lathery , also written Lachery , was a Netherese enclave of Netheril that specialized in fishing , using its " mythallar " to do so . It was found hovering over the Narrow Sea , moving along its shoreline . Economy . Lathery mainly fished the Narrow Sea , using the magic of its " mythallar " to " teleport " fish ( and anything else ) that passed under the enclave into special cold storage chambers . These were kept constantly chilled by the spell " Veridon ' s storm " . The frozen fish were then exported to other cities . This technique was later fine - tuned , being able to separate , for example , crawfish and lobsters from ordinary fish and teleport them into different holding tanks . However , the determination was unscientific , and while certain creatures were teleported to particular areas , all others went to another . History . The city was elevated to enclave status in 3357 NY ( −502 DR ) by Veridon . By 3400 NY ( −459 DR ) , Veridon had improved upon Lathery ' s fishing " mythallar " such that it could distinguish between certain creatures and send some to different holding tanks .

title: Lathtarl ' s Lantern
description: Lathtarl ' s Lantern Latherl ' s Lantern is a small fishing village on the Sword Coast at the mouth of the Winding Water . It is close to the Warlock ' s Crypt . History .
description_long: Lathtarl ' s Lantern Latherl ' s Lantern is a small fishing village on the Sword Coast at the mouth of the Winding Water . It is close to the Warlock ' s Crypt . History . Roughly 300 years ago , a pirate named Lathtarl crash ashore here fleeing the navy of Evermeet . With his ship destroyed , crew much reduced and himself crippled , he improvised a plan to crash other unsuspecting vessels against the rocky shore . Word quickly spread among other pirates and slavers that this was a safe harbor . The pirates no longer crash ships there after threats from merchants and the Lords of Waterdeep . The marsh at the mouth of the Winding Water also has rumors of two dead kings who perished there . A rebel lord from Tethyr named Ring Tredarath and a Beverdaur of Cortryn .

title: Latifa ibn Morim
description: Latifa ibn Morim Latifa ibn Morim was a half - elf sand mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Latifa served as one of the Grand Vizier ' s assistants .
description_long: Latifa ibn Morim Latifa ibn Morim was a half - elf sand mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Latifa served as one of the Grand Vizier ' s assistants . Her prime responsibility was security within the palace guard .

title: Latovenomer
description: Latovenomer Latovenomer was a green dragon who lived within the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Latovenomer had a lair hidden deep beneath the waters of the swamp .
description_long: Latovenomer Latovenomer was a green dragon who lived within the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Latovenomer had a lair hidden deep beneath the waters of the swamp . He slept for decades at a time before waking to wreak havoc upon the surrounding land .

title: Laughing Goblin Inn
description: Laughing Goblin Inn The Laughing Goblin Inn was not necessarily Phlan ' s fanciest inn , but the inn was definitely Phlan ' s busiest . History . One busy night in 1340 DR , Ren o ' the Blade challenged three female human fighter s to lift and carry a serving tray from their table to the bar , but the tray turned out to be an old heavy shield and the ranger tricked Salen , Jensena , and Gwen out of a bagful of gold .
description_long: Laughing Goblin Inn The Laughing Goblin Inn was not necessarily Phlan ' s fanciest inn , but the inn was definitely Phlan ' s busiest . History . One busy night in 1340 DR , Ren o ' the Blade challenged three female human fighter s to lift and carry a serving tray from their table to the bar , but the tray turned out to be an old heavy shield and the ranger tricked Salen , Jensena , and Gwen out of a bagful of gold . Later , Ren stopped working at the Laughing Goblin Inn when he was sent to Sokol Keep on Thorn Island out in the Bay of Phlan with his friends , Shal Bal of Cormyr and Tarl Desanea of Vaasa . Geography . The inn was located in the city of Phlan , which was on the northwestern coast of the Moonsea . The inn was located in the heart of the town in the civilized portion that was not over run by evil humanoid monsters like kobold s , goblin s , and orc s . Structure . Outside the inn , a stable was located to cover travelers ' horses and above the stable was a loft used by Ren , the barkeeper . Interior . The double doors entered into the great room of the tavern .

title: Laughing hare
description: Laughing hare The laughing hare was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a hare . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Laughing hare The laughing hare was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a hare . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . During a full moon only , a person who drunk saki from the " laughing hare " would find their hearing and eyesight doubled in range for half a day . More importantly , they could conjure a single earth elemental in that time . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " laughing hare " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . However , it was later lost .

title: Laughingflow
description: Laughingflow The Laughingflow , also known as the Trollflow in Nesmé , was a river located in the Evermoors . Description . The clear , fast - flowing river had a gravel bottom and banks lined with felsul , laspar , and a few blueleaf trees .
description_long: Laughingflow The Laughingflow , also known as the Trollflow in Nesmé , was a river located in the Evermoors . Description . The clear , fast - flowing river had a gravel bottom and banks lined with felsul , laspar , and a few blueleaf trees . Its water was drinkable but had a sharp mineral tang . Inhabitants . The river was home to many edible crab s , a few shalass , many schools of the small brown lout , and also slimy but edible black - and - green rock eel s that inhabited the river bottom .

title: Lauratha Delrym
description: Lauratha Delrym Lauratha Delrym was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Lauratha had dark hair and plain features .
description_long: Lauratha Delrym Lauratha Delrym was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Lauratha had dark hair and plain features . Personality . She maintained a prim and proper decorum , choosing to be quiet and observant , which disguised her boundless curiosity about people and their activities . Relationships . She knew everyone in Voonlar and kept up to date on how they spent their time .

title: Lauren DeVillars
description: Lauren DeVillars Lady Lauren DeVillars was an influential noble in Ravens Bluff , and a retired member of the Cleric Circle from ? – ? Appearance .
description_long: Lauren DeVillars Lady Lauren DeVillars was an influential noble in Ravens Bluff , and a retired member of the Cleric Circle from ? – ? Appearance . Lady Lauren stood 5 ' 9 " tall and weighed 135 pounds . She had fine - boned features and wore elegant clothing made from costly fabrics in the latest styles . Her clothing and jewelry were decorated with symbols of the goddess Waukeen . She was seldom seen in public but her appearances were always an event to the local populace . Her retinue consisted of a few servants and at least one scribe to take notes . Personality . A force to be reckoned with , Lady Lauren was the head of the oldest and wealthiest family in Ravens Bluff and regarded the entire city as her personal fief , but generally supported the Lord Mayor and worked with the government to improve her city . She was philanthropic , sponsoring many civic projects , and she paid for and equipped units of the city ' s military and naval forces . Background . The DeVillars family had lived in the Ravens Bluff area for more than ten generations and had been devoted to the service of Waukeen , the goddess of trade and money .

title: Lauryn Shavvyrstar
description: Lauryn Shavvyrstar Lauryn Shavvyrstar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Chyndrie Stormwind , Noelin Tlestlin .
description_long: Lauryn Shavvyrstar Lauryn Shavvyrstar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Chyndrie Stormwind , Noelin Tlestlin . However , the four women got along well with one another , and commonly named Beliot as " the chief adventurer in our band " . They even referred to him as " Chief Adventurer " when speaking to patrons of the inn , instead of more proper terms like " innkeeper " , " master of the house " , or " hostler " , which led to some confusion . Appendix . Notes . As noted in the source , one person in Sevenecho , likely one of the chambermaids , is an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay , making a small chance that this is Lauryn .

title: Lauzoril
description: Lauzoril Lauzoril was the Zulkir of Enchantment and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . Personality . Laurozil was a relatively young man for his level and was always very charming to anyone he talks to .
description_long: Lauzoril Lauzoril was the Zulkir of Enchantment and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . Personality . Laurozil was a relatively young man for his level and was always very charming to anyone he talks to . Even when he seemed to be about to order one ' s immediate execution , he was charming . People he had ordered slain in their presence went to the executioner smiling . History . Lauzoril was not known outside of Thay as a Zulkir , however his position as a leader of the Imperialist party had garnered the attention of the Harpers and in turn attracted Lauzoril to them . Lauzoril had no liking for the meddling Harpers and spent much of his time scheming to destroy them . One of his schemes led him to to create a magical scimitar called Shazzellim and sent a guardsman to kill Dove Falconhand of the Harpers . That plan went amiss . Shazzelim since landed in the hands of Zhentil Keep and could yet fulfill its purpose .

title: Lava missile
description: Lava missile Overview . The Lava Missile spell shoots forth a missile of lava , striking unerringly a designated target that has less than total cover . When the target is unable to thwart the missile , the scorching hot lava will ignite whatever clothing or armor the spellcaster ' s opponent wears .
description_long: Lava missile Overview . The Lava Missile spell shoots forth a missile of lava , striking unerringly a designated target that has less than total cover . When the target is unable to thwart the missile , the scorching hot lava will ignite whatever clothing or armor the spellcaster ' s opponent wears . The more experienced the caster is , the more lava missiles he can summon sprouting from his fingertips with one single spell . Caution . Beware of casting this spell , when targeting firenewts since the effects of this spell don ' t damage the creatures but actually heals them . This spell originated from the firenewts and was first used by firenewt clerics of Kossuth .

title: Lava splash
description: Lava splash Lava splash was a divine conjuration spell that created a wave of lava . Effect . The lava wave splashed over a designated area some 40 feet ( 12 .
description_long: Lava splash Lava splash was a divine conjuration spell that created a wave of lava . Effect . The lava wave splashed over a designated area some 40 feet ( 12 . 2 meters ) wide and 20 feet ( 6 . 1 meters ) high . Creatures standing in the area were hurt by the scorching hot lava that poured over them . The more experienced the caster , the more damage the lava would deal to their opponents . " Lava splash " acted as a " cure moderate wounds " spell to firenewt s . Components . One needed a fist - sized chunk of volcanic rock as a focus for the spell to be cast . History . The " lava splash " spell was first employed by firenewt cleric s of Kossuth .

title: Laviguer
description: Laviguer Laviguer was a mining town in the kingdom of Impiltur in northeast Faerûn . Geography . It lay in the Uplands of northwestern Impiltur , at the foot of the Earthspur Mountains , at the end of the Prince ' s Road .
description_long: Laviguer Laviguer was a mining town in the kingdom of Impiltur in northeast Faerûn . Geography . It lay in the Uplands of northwestern Impiltur , at the foot of the Earthspur Mountains , at the end of the Prince ' s Road . Description . Laviguer was a hub for the mining industry in the Earthspur Mountains , working in competition with the neighboring town of Vordric Dun . The mining trade here was very profitable for the kingdom . However , they were rough and rowdy places . People . Laviguer was full of hard - working , hard - living , and hard - drinking men and women who worked the mines . Government . War - Captain Haelimbrar , one of the Council of Lords , was based in Laviguer . He was charged with securing the northern and western borders of the realm , but was often away on secret missions . Law & Order . The Warswords of Impiltur , and through them the Council of Lords , policed Laviguer heavily , with crackdowns on criminal activity and regularly placing it under " daggerbond " , a martial law that forbade the open wearing of weapons within the town . They were flexible with the miners , though , owing to the riches they brought to the realm . Notable inhabitants .

title: Lavok Corthala
description: Lavok Corthala < / ref > Lavok Corthala was a powerful human wizard living in Athkatla , Amn , in the 1360s DR . History . Lavok was a mighty wizard , with an interest in necromancy .
description_long: Lavok Corthala < / ref > Lavok Corthala was a powerful human wizard living in Athkatla , Amn , in the 1360s DR . History . Lavok was a mighty wizard , with an interest in necromancy . He was known for his creation of the Planar Sphere artifact . After some time , Lavok decided to travel across the plane s for a time . He was already 200 years old when he left Amn in his sphere . Lavok came back to Amn 100 years later . His plan was to use the body of his descendent , Valygar Corthala , as host for his mind , granting him an extended life but in the end he was defeated by Gorion ' s Ward and his own descendant . When defeated , he seemed to bitterly regret his actions , stating that a dark shadow was controlling him , and that he had to fight it , in order to protect the secret of the Sphere .

title: Law of the Loregiver
description: Law of the Loregiver The Law of the Loregiver was a set of universal beliefs based on the teachings of the Loregiver that united a continent , literally transforming the burning land of Zakhara into the " Land of Fate . " History & Legend . Legend stated that the Loregiver transcribed the Law for the benefit of all Zakharans .
description_long: Law of the Loregiver The Law of the Loregiver was a set of universal beliefs based on the teachings of the Loregiver that united a continent , literally transforming the burning land of Zakhara into the " Land of Fate . " History & Legend . Legend stated that the Loregiver transcribed the Law for the benefit of all Zakharans . However , at that time the population of the Burning Land was not ready for such radical adjustment , so the Loregiver hid the scrolls containing the Law within a cave where they waited for centuries until they were found by a young man . The man , recognizing the potential benefit for all mankind presented on the scrolls , decided to share them with the people of Zakhara , unifying them under its doctrines and eventually becoming the first Grand Caliph . The House of the Loregiver , within the Golden Mosque of Huzuz , contained lacquered wood displaying the oldest known transcription of the original scrolls containing the Law of the Loregiver . The Grand Caliph would typically give similar transcriptions to new mosques for them to display with honor within their halls .

title: Law sphere
description: Law sphere The Law sphere was a group of spells granted to lawful crusader s . This sphere is the counterbalance to the sphere of chaos , promoting obedience , order , and the power of cooperation . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .
description_long: Law sphere The Law sphere was a group of spells granted to lawful crusader s . This sphere is the counterbalance to the sphere of chaos , promoting obedience , order , and the power of cooperation . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Law Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Lawantha Silendia
description: Lawantha Silendia Dutchess - Consort Lawantha Silendia Blackthorn was a Calishite sorceress and member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Personality . Lawantha had no interest in the politics of Tethyr but was deeply loyal to the Company of Eight ; however , in typical Calishite fashion , she did not hide her disinterest well .
description_long: Lawantha Silendia Dutchess - Consort Lawantha Silendia Blackthorn was a Calishite sorceress and member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Personality . Lawantha had no interest in the politics of Tethyr but was deeply loyal to the Company of Eight ; however , in typical Calishite fashion , she did not hide her disinterest well . She was very interested in botany , especially in fungi . Abilities . Lawantha was proficient with staff and dagger . She knew how to ride , swim , tie various knots , and use herbal healing treatments . She was especially good at recognizing different species of fungi , and she was experienced with the mushroom - hunting dogs of the town of Brost . Possessions . As an adventuress , Lawantha wore a " cloak of protection " and favored " wand s of lightning bolt s " . She bore a magic dagger and " bracers of armor " . Relationships . Lawantha came from a large merchant family , and she had friends and relatives all over Calimshan , especially in Almraiven and Volothamp in the east . Her cousin Thiel Ralmun was a member of the Company of Eight before his death .

title: Lawful evil
description: Lawful evil Lawful evil is the methodical , intentional , and frequently successful devotion to a cruel organized system . In 4th edition mechanics for " " lawful evil is found under the umbrella of the evil alignment . A lawful evil character methodically takes what he wants within the limits of his personal code of conduct without regard for whom it hurts .
description_long: Lawful evil Lawful evil is the methodical , intentional , and frequently successful devotion to a cruel organized system . In 4th edition mechanics for " " lawful evil is found under the umbrella of the evil alignment . A lawful evil character methodically takes what he wants within the limits of his personal code of conduct without regard for whom it hurts . He cares about tradition , loyalty , and order but not about freedom , dignity , or life . He plays by the rules but without mercy or compassion . He ' s comfortable in a hierarchy and would like to rule , but is willing to serve . He is loath to break promises , and he is therefore very cautious about giving his word unless a bargain is clearly in his favour . This reluctance comes partly from his nature and partly because he depends on order to protect himself from those who oppose him on moral grounds . Some lawful evil villains have particular taboos , such as not killing in cold blood ( but having underlings do it ) or not letting children come to harm ( if it can be helped ) . They feel these personal morals put them above unprincipled villains .

title: Lawful good
description: Lawful good A lawful good character upholds society and its laws , believing that these laws are created to work for the good and prosperity of all . He is both honest and benevolent . He will work within the established system to change it for the better , and strives to bring order to goodness that other good - aligned characters might pool their resources to better the world .
description_long: Lawful good A lawful good character upholds society and its laws , believing that these laws are created to work for the good and prosperity of all . He is both honest and benevolent . He will work within the established system to change it for the better , and strives to bring order to goodness that other good - aligned characters might pool their resources to better the world . A lawful good character combines a commitment to oppose evil with discipline . Most lawful good characters live by a strict code of honor , or by the rules of conduct set down by their deity . They will generally selflessly act by these codes even at the cost of their own life . It must however be stressed that blind obedience to local laws is not required by the lawful good alignment . A paladin is not in violation of his alignment if he decides to take up arms against a usurper on behalf of the rightful king , for example , even if that means going against the sedition laws instated by the usurper . It should be noted that a lawful good character does not actually have to obey laws , as intimated above .

title: Lawful neutral
description: Lawful neutral A lawful neutral character is directed by law , logic , tradition , or a personal code . Order and organization are paramount to him . He may believe in personal order and live by a code or standard , or he may believe in order for all and favor a strong , organized government .
description_long: Lawful neutral A lawful neutral character is directed by law , logic , tradition , or a personal code . Order and organization are paramount to him . He may believe in personal order and live by a code or standard , or he may believe in order for all and favor a strong , organized government . In 4th edition mechanics for " " lawful neutral is found under the umbrella of the " unaligned " alignment . Lawful neutral combines reliability and honor without moral bias . Note that this does not mean that a lawful neutral character is amoral or immoral , or does not have a moral compass , but that moral considerations - - the good or evil of the action - - come a distant second to what the character ' s code , tradition , law , or logic dictate . A functionary , soldier , or employee who follows orders without question regardless of the result , an arms dealer who sells his wares to the highest bidder , whatever that bidder may do with them , and an impartial jurist who sticks rigidly to the rule book are all examples of lawful neutral characters .

title: Laws of Cormyr
description: Laws of Cormyr In 1368 DR , the following laws are posted at all major entry points to Cormyr . When this started or was / if discontinued is unknown Laws of Cormyr Regal Rules . Only someone with Obarskyr blood may assume the crown .
description_long: Laws of Cormyr In 1368 DR , the following laws are posted at all major entry points to Cormyr . When this started or was / if discontinued is unknown Laws of Cormyr Regal Rules . Only someone with Obarskyr blood may assume the crown . This means that , for example , Queen Filfaeril Obarskyr could not assume the crown . Maritime law . Cormyrian maritime law governs the activities of Cormyrian ships on the Sea of Fallen Stars . Captains of ships on which individuals commit crimes will usually imprison the individual in question in the ship ' s brig until making landfall in Cormyr where local authorities will deal with the case . Mutiny is usually a hanging offence , although there are a small number of cases in Cormyr where mutineers have been spared . Piracy is dealt with harshly : upon the first offence , the pirate has one hand cut off . Upon a subsequent offence , the pirate is put to death . Fishermen must pay the local authorities for the right to fish in Cormyrian waters .

title: Lawyers !
description: Lawyers ! " Lawyers ! " is the 23rd issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by .
description_long: Lawyers ! " Lawyers ! " is the 23rd issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Tom Mandrake ( credited as guest artist ) , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin . Appendix . Reprints . This issue was reprinted in the Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 3 trade paperback by in June 2012 .

title: Lawyers ( Waterdeep )
description: Lawyers ( Waterdeep ) Commonly called the lawyers , a band of legal professionals briefly tried to establish themselves in Waterdeep in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR . Membership . The lawyers wore dark robes and strange hats .
description_long: Lawyers ( Waterdeep ) Commonly called the lawyers , a band of legal professionals briefly tried to establish themselves in Waterdeep in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR . Membership . The lawyers wore dark robes and strange hats . One needed a law degree and to be " a member of the bar " before one could practice as a lawyer or attorney . History . While Khelben Arunsun was away consulting Elminster , the lawyers approached Open Lord Piergeiron of Waterdeep with an offer . As the city had grown , so too had civil disputes , and handling these took up increasing amounts of the Lord ' s Court ' s time . The lawyers promised to streamline these and pushed Piergeiron for an agreement . Unwisely , he quickly agreed , signing a contract between the lawyers and the city . Under it , the lawyers would handle civil disputes and enforce the judgements they secured . Furthermore , magical assaults on them were enjoined , and Piergeiron had his own attorney . For these services , the lawyers charged hefty fees . However , the lawyers proved to be more interested in the strict letter of the law than in its spirit or the circumstances of a case .

title: Lay of the Purple Dragons
description: Lay of the Purple Dragons The Lay of the Purple Dragons was a ballad about King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . The " Lay " embellished the historical account for added heroism , adding extra dragon s , knight s , and magic . At one point , even the god s appear before King Azoun to bless his crusade .
description_long: Lay of the Purple Dragons The Lay of the Purple Dragons was a ballad about King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . The " Lay " embellished the historical account for added heroism , adding extra dragon s , knight s , and magic . At one point , even the god s appear before King Azoun to bless his crusade . The bard Talamic sang the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " at the Griffin ' s Claw in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . A young scribe at the temple of Deneir preferred it to the more accurate " The History of the Tuigan " he was working on , prompting its author , Koja , to attempt to have his own work mass - published to counter the " Lay " and other populist versions of the war .

title: Layers of the Abyss
description: Layers of the Abyss Each layer of the Abyss is different from all the others , the only apparent similarity being that the plane seems to try and inflict as much harm on travelers with each layer as possible . It might even be said that the plane is as varied and evil as the demons who inhabit it . Even deities dwell in the Abyss , like Umberlee and Merrshaulk , as well as Demon Lords that are mostly worshiped by one kind of species , such as Sess ' innek , the lord of lizardfolk who makes his home on the seventh layer , " Phantom Plane , " and Vaprak , patron of ogre s , ogre mage s and troll s .
description_long: Layers of the Abyss Each layer of the Abyss is different from all the others , the only apparent similarity being that the plane seems to try and inflict as much harm on travelers with each layer as possible . It might even be said that the plane is as varied and evil as the demons who inhabit it . Even deities dwell in the Abyss , like Umberlee and Merrshaulk , as well as Demon Lords that are mostly worshiped by one kind of species , such as Sess ' innek , the lord of lizardfolk who makes his home on the seventh layer , " Phantom Plane , " and Vaprak , patron of ogre s , ogre mage s and troll s . Vaprak is located on the layer of Shatterstone . Lolth used to occupy the 66th layer as the Demonweb Pits , but during the Silence of Lolth , she moved her domain from the Abyss to a plane of her own making , leaving the 66th layer a desolate wasteland , bereft of any life , mortal or otherwise . The uppermost layer of the Abyss , known alternately as the Plane of Infinite Portals , Pazunia , The Plain of Yawning Pits , The Palace of 1001 Closets , The Wasteland of Gates , etc . , is a barren wasteland of unrelenting heat and blistering winds , cut through by the infamous River Styx .

title: Lazlo Buckman
description: Lazlo Buckman Lazlo Buckman was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . After Georg Redfell died , Laszlo became the new mayor of West Harbor .
description_long: Lazlo Buckman Lazlo Buckman was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . After Georg Redfell died , Laszlo became the new mayor of West Harbor . History . Neverwinter Nights 2 . Lazlo was a member of the West Harbor militia , who fought against the bladeling s and duergar in 1374 DR . Despite the military career , he also brewed the famous Harvest Mead . Storm of Zehir . Lazlo survived the Second War of the Shadow and returned back to West Harbor . While he repaired the damage with the other surviving villagers , undead attacked them . To keep the village safe , he bribed a black dragon to stop the attacks . Once he ran out of mead , the dragon became angry , capturing Tarmas . Lazlo tasked adventurers with freeing Tarmas , and then to attack the dragon .

title: Lazlo Lunk
description: Lazlo Lunk Lazlo Lunk was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lazlo was a member of the Champions of Muktar .
description_long: Lazlo Lunk Lazlo Lunk was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lazlo was a member of the Champions of Muktar . His weapon of choice was his cursed sword . His companions gave him a wide berth in battle . He was also the commander of the Heavy Brigade of the Muktar ' s army . History . Lazlo in a game of change acquired a cursed sword . In 1358 DR Lazlo and his fellow Champions arranged the trap inside Fort Blood planned by the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , to eliminate an adventuring party well - known in Golconda . Later he lead his brgade in the Battle of Wilma Pass . Personality . Lazlo continued to use the cursed sword because suited his battle - hungry personality .

title: Lazy Moon Inn
description: Lazy Moon Inn The Lazy Moon Inn was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast , owned by Faress . It was well located in the city , lying on Shendle Street . Around 1358 DR , it was always busy , a good quality establishment with only middling prices .
description_long: Lazy Moon Inn The Lazy Moon Inn was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast , owned by Faress . It was well located in the city , lying on Shendle Street . Around 1358 DR , it was always busy , a good quality establishment with only middling prices .

title: Le ' Quella
description: Le ' Quella House Le ' Quella is a moon elf house known for its unconventional dress sense and the contentious ( but friendly ) relations between its members . As of 1368 DR it is led by Huquethae Le ' Quella . Its estate is in Leuthilspar , on Evermeet , and consists of a magically grown building of wood and leaves .
description_long: Le ' Quella House Le ' Quella is a moon elf house known for its unconventional dress sense and the contentious ( but friendly ) relations between its members . As of 1368 DR it is led by Huquethae Le ' Quella . Its estate is in Leuthilspar , on Evermeet , and consists of a magically grown building of wood and leaves . The house colours are orange , red and yellow , and its symbol depicts a triangle of each of these colours displayed on a white background .

title: LeShay
description: LeShay A leShay was an immortal , albino , elf - like fey creature of extraordinary magical power . Some scholars believe that the leShay were one of the creator race s . Description .
description_long: LeShay A leShay was an immortal , albino , elf - like fey creature of extraordinary magical power . Some scholars believe that the leShay were one of the creator race s . Description . LeShay were tall and thin and looked like albino elves . However , instead of the red eyes common to true albinos , leShay had deep black eyes ; even the whites of their eyes were black . They had pointed ears , but they were not quite so pointed as an elf ' s . LeShay were immortal ; they could only die if killed . Abilities . LeShay had a vast array of magical powers inherent to themselves . Most notable among such powers were their ability to charm other creatures by simply looking at them and the strange power of forming weapons out of nothing by power of thought alone . These " leShay weapons " were formed from the essence of each individual leShay as if they were extensions of his or her own body . LeShay could also change form , teleport , turn invisible , and breathe underwater with their magics , among other things . The minds of leShay are particularly geared towards the learning of language ; that is , all leShay are essentially .

title: Leahon Woumar
description: Leahon Woumar Leahon Woumar was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a miller and proprietor of Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill . History .
description_long: Leahon Woumar Leahon Woumar was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a miller and proprietor of Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill . History . Leahon took over the mill once operated by his father , prior to 1358 DR . Leahon made several improvement ' s to his father mill , such as including separate runs for simultaneous milling and pulping of different products . He still operated the mill in 1369 DR . Personality . Leahon Woumar was a cheerful , good - humored and friendly sort , who chatted with everyone who came by . He was full of gossip , local opinions and rumors , but he never revealed who said what to him . For many Whelunians , he was a trusted confidant . Even the local Purple Dragons went to Leahon for information , to learn what folk really thought of royal decrees and the judgments of Lord Sarp Redbeard .

title: Leap for the Throat
description: Leap for the Throat The Leap for the Throat was a pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . Activities . Almari bint - Kafira was the captain of the " Leap for the Throat " .
description_long: Leap for the Throat The Leap for the Throat was a pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . Activities . Almari bint - Kafira was the captain of the " Leap for the Throat " . The waters of Suq Bay were her hunting grounds and fat merchant vessels her favored prey . Crew . In addition to the corsairs who manned the vessel , several notable mages lent magical support during raids . Michal Bluestar , Fayiz Mikali , and Safana al - Sitar proved to be a deadly asset at sea .

title: Leaping Hart Tavern
description: Leaping Hart Tavern The Leaping Hart Tavern was the most popular tavern in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . It also served as an inn and a gambling hall , and was the center of gossip in the city . Services .
description_long: Leaping Hart Tavern The Leaping Hart Tavern was the most popular tavern in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . It also served as an inn and a gambling hall , and was the center of gossip in the city . Services . The tavern served fine drinks and foods , and also allowed patrons to engage in gambling games . The most popular game was named Liar ' s Dice . Inhabitants . The proprietor of the Leaping Hart was an affable woman named Thelia Ondertos .

title: Leaping fish
description: Leaping fish The leaping fish was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a fish with its open mouth serving as the cup .
description_long: Leaping fish The leaping fish was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a fish with its open mouth serving as the cup . Powers . When a bearer filled the vessel with fine oil and lit it like an oil lamp , it glowed pale blue . They could make one " wish " that would be granted , as if cast by a great wu jen . History .
