As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " leaping fish " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . The shukenja Pitalla used a " wish " from the " leaping fish " to cure the settlement of Mo ' ki of the ivory plague . He was believed to have then taken it to the island of Su ' un and left it there . It remained lost by the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Leather Market
description: Leather Market The Leather Market was a semi - annual fair held in the spring and fall seasons in Duirtanal , Semphar . Activities . Each Leather Market was held for one week at a time .
description_long: Leather Market The Leather Market was a semi - annual fair held in the spring and fall seasons in Duirtanal , Semphar . Activities . Each Leather Market was held for one week at a time . During this period merchants from all over the Hordelands and eastern Faerûn gathered to examine and trade fine goods made from leather . The fabulous Duir leather was always a highlight . Prices during the Leather Market were posted daily by the Tanner ' s Guild of Duirtanal . These prices were based upon sales from the previous day . The Leather Market also attracted traders of wool , livestock , and edible products such as coffee . Additionally , entertainers flocked here to amuse the large crowds . Due to the mass influx of people attracted by the Leather Market , extra guards were posted to ensure that everyone behaved . The cost for the added security was billed to the Tanner ' s Guild .

title: Leather armor
description: Leather armor Leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Leather armor was made from leather .
description_long: Leather armor Leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Leather armor was made from leather . The armor covering the shoulders and chest were often boiled in oil to make them stiffer . The rest of the armor was softer and more flexible . It provided a small amount of protection .

title: Leaves of Green
description: Leaves of Green The Leaves of Green was a divine spellbook and a holy book of Silvanus . Description . It appeared to be a flat oval - shaped piece of fissured dark gray bark with a triangle of three circles scratched on its inner surface .
description_long: Leaves of Green The Leaves of Green was a divine spellbook and a holy book of Silvanus . Description . It appeared to be a flat oval - shaped piece of fissured dark gray bark with a triangle of three circles scratched on its inner surface . To change it to its true appearance , one of the names of Silvanus had to be spoken aloud while the speaker pressed on the wood inside all of the three rings . This made the bark grow into a book with pages that were lush , square , waxy green leaves . Each of its sixteen pages bore a single spell . Contents . It contained the following spells :

title: Leaves of Learning
description: Leaves of Learning The Leaves of Learning was a temple dedicated to Oghma in Highmoon in the Dalelands and contained one of best libraries in Faerûn . Location . Situated at the southern end of Highmoon Hill , the Leaves of Learning towered over the streets of Highmoon in Deepingdale .
description_long: Leaves of Learning The Leaves of Learning was a temple dedicated to Oghma in Highmoon in the Dalelands and contained one of best libraries in Faerûn . Location . Situated at the southern end of Highmoon Hill , the Leaves of Learning towered over the streets of Highmoon in Deepingdale . Structure . The Leaves of Learning was surrounded by a large outer wall , inscribed with all manner of runes , and a large duskwood door was the only public entrance . Taller than even the Tower of the Rising Moon , the central tower , known as the Tower of Tomes , was made of stout stone . This Tower rose a full six stories high and was capped by a spired tower , reaching 30 feet ( 9 . 1 meters ) above a parapet . Either side of the Tower of Tomes were a set of cloisters , each carved with intricate scrollwork and vines . These cloisters faced towards a forested inner court that was encircled by the outer walls of the temple . The forested garden was dominated by a large variety of trees and flowers native to the Dalelands and Cormanthor , such as helmthorn s , phandar s , weirwood s , and even a transparent chime oak .

title: Leda Widris
description: Leda Widris Leda Widris was a mercenary just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Leda was an honest and courageous woman .
description_long: Leda Widris Leda Widris was a mercenary just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Leda was an honest and courageous woman . She wanted to experience what a real cold wind felt like . History . Leda worked for many years as a mercenary in south Faerun . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR in exchange for passage to north Faerun , Leda acted as a guard for a great caravan , which unknown to her was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Leech
description: Leech Leech was a healer in Skullport . History . During his youth , Leech studied under a crackpot Calishite chirurgeon .
description_long: Leech Leech was a healer in Skullport . History . During his youth , Leech studied under a crackpot Calishite chirurgeon . Thanks to his master ' s tutelage , he could heal most injuries without the use of magic , assuming his fee was paid . Leech could also remove poisons using giant leech es . Around 1370 DR , if someone unfortunately died under Leech ' s care , he took the body to Mhaug .

title: Leevoth
description: Leevoth Leevoth was the captain of the guard of the city of Thultanthar and a powerful Shadovar . History . At first , Leevoth studied to be a wizard , but soon realized his love for war and fighting and decided to train as warrior .
description_long: Leevoth Leevoth was the captain of the guard of the city of Thultanthar and a powerful Shadovar . History . At first , Leevoth studied to be a wizard , but soon realized his love for war and fighting and decided to train as warrior . Leevoth proved skillful and efficient , and eventually he became the captain of the city ' s guard . His duty was to maintain order in the city and he eventually suppressed any kind of dissent in the streets , from thieves to crazy arcanists . Personality . Leevoth was a very zealous individual and stoically served all Princes of Shade and Hadrhune with the same loyalty . Possessions . Leevoth possessed a powerful magic sword , the " Ironfang " , particularly lethal against shades . It was rumored that it was created by a prince , later killed by Hadrhune for an unknown reason .

title: Lefeber ' s mark
description: Lefeber ' s mark Lefeber ' s mark was an inventive arcanist spell of small power . It was developed by inventor Lefeber in 1725 NY ( - 2134 DR ) during Netheril ' s Golden Age . Knowledge of its effect was lost in later ages , but given its name and comparable power it is possible that " Lefeber ' s mark " was the Netherese name for the spell " wizard mark " .
description_long: Lefeber ' s mark Lefeber ' s mark was an inventive arcanist spell of small power . It was developed by inventor Lefeber in 1725 NY ( - 2134 DR ) during Netheril ' s Golden Age . Knowledge of its effect was lost in later ages , but given its name and comparable power it is possible that " Lefeber ' s mark " was the Netherese name for the spell " wizard mark " .

title: Legacy of the Drow
description: Legacy of the Drow The Legacy of the Drow is the third series of novels about Drizzt Do ' Urden written by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Legacy of the Drow The Legacy of the Drow is the third series of novels about Drizzt Do ' Urden written by R . A . Salvatore . It was written after the Dark Elf trilogy , but chronologically it follows the Icewind Dale trilogy . It precedes the Paths of Darkness series . Editions . The series is available in full as the Legacy of the Drow Gift Set ( individual volumes ) and as the Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition ( omnibus ) .

title: Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition
description: Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore . It was published in hardcover in January 2001 , and again in paperback in January 2003 .

title: Legacy of the Green Regent
description: Legacy of the Green Regent Legacy of the Green Regent was an RPGA campaign based mostly in the Delimbiyr Vale . 28 modules were supposedly written over 3 years to be distributed to registered Dungeon Masters and played at events such as GenCon and Winter Fantasy . These modules were then supposed to be made commercially available .
description_long: Legacy of the Green Regent Legacy of the Green Regent was an RPGA campaign based mostly in the Delimbiyr Vale . 28 modules were supposedly written over 3 years to be distributed to registered Dungeon Masters and played at events such as GenCon and Winter Fantasy . These modules were then supposed to be made commercially available . Five modules were never published and a 29th module never got off the drawing board . None of them were ever sold commercially . As part of the RPGA Network , the Legacy of the Green Regent adventures were made available in print ; being black and white booklets , sometimes with poster maps and stats cards . description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate Legends of Baldur ' s Gate is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by as part of the " Tyranny of Dragons " storyline . It is continued in the series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Summary .
description_long: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate Legends of Baldur ' s Gate is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by as part of the " Tyranny of Dragons " storyline . It is continued in the series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Summary . After accidentally bringing the Rashemi berserker Minsc back to life , the wild mage Delina and her newfound companion find themselves fighting to stop a Cult of the Dragon plot against the city of Baldur ' s Gate .

description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 2 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 2 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .
description_long: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 2 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 2 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber . Product Description . MINSC IS BACK ! And he ' s got a new quest : a young sorceress named Delina is on the hunt for her missing brother . But to find him , the unlikely duo of heroes needs to avoid the Watch , bargain with thieves , and navigate the twisted politics of Baldur ' s Gate . What could go wrong ? The story so far . In the legendary city of Baldur ' s Gate , a young moon elf ( and wild mage ) named Delina is pursued by stone gargoyles . Casting a spell to fight these monsters , Delina inadvertently brings to life the statue of the Beloved Ranger — Minsc and his hamster , Boo , are back ! Unfortunately , the Watch thinks Delina and Minsc are responsible for the deaths the now - smashed gargoyles caused . . . Running out of escape paths , the group is confronted by two mysterious strangers — thieves !

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 3
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 3 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 3 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .
description_long: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 3 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 3 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber . Product Description . A knockdown brawl at a noble party , a frantic chase along the rooftops , kidnapping , extortion , and monsters aplenty … Yup , just another day in Baldur ’ s Gate . The story so far . In the legendary city of Baldur ’ s Gate , a young moon elf ( and wild mage ) named Delina teams with the newly revived ranger Minsc , his hamster Boo , and thieves Krydle and Shandie . To find Delina ’ s missing brother , Krydle makes a deal with The Fetcher – in exchange for the brother ’ s location , Krydle must deliver a letter to a member of the Parliament of Peers . Learning the Peer in question is his old friend ( and Krydle ’ s father ) Coran , Minsc leaps into action – and hijinks are about to ensue …

Can Minsc , Boo , and their new friends stop the dragon cult before their magical ritual destroys the city ? Less talk , more fight ! In the legendary city of Baldur ’ s Gate , a young moon elf ( and wild mage ) named Delina teams with the newly revived ranger Minsc ; his hamster , Boo ; and thieves Krydle and Shandie . To find Delina ’ s missing brother , Krydle makes a deal with The Fetcher — but in the ensuing action , Delina is captured by a member of a Dragon Cult . . . who reveals himself to be her brother !

title: Legion of the Chimera
description: Legion of the Chimera The Legion of the Chimera was an evil organization which operated in the Severed Hand , an elven citadel within the Spine of the World . History . Founding .
description_long: Legion of the Chimera The Legion of the Chimera was an evil organization which operated in the Severed Hand , an elven citadel within the Spine of the World . History . Founding . The Legion was started by half - demon twins Isair and Madae . They started the legion to make a safe haven for abominations and to work out a treaty with the Ten Towns to stop any violence between the two groups . Conflicts . On an emmisary mission , representatives from Targos , Bryn Shander , and all the other Ten Towns traveled to the Severed Hand , an ancient elven fortress on the edges of the Fields of Slaughter , the headquarters of the Legion . The mayor of Bryn Shander sent his representaive with finely crafted cakes and pastries , secretly baked with holy water . The representative offers the treats to Isair and Madae , twin brother and sister half - demons , who unknowingly eat the cakes . Of course , the water badly burns the naturally evil creatures throats , and the twins declare war upon the towns . The representative is imprisoned , despite having no idea that the cakes were baked in such a way . Ten Towns fights back . Isair and Madae are furious .

title: Lehtinan
description: Lehtinan Lehtinan was the owner of the Copper Coronet tavern in the city of Athkatla , Amn . Personality . He was involved in many criminal dealings , primarily prostitution and gambling on slave pit - fights .
description_long: Lehtinan Lehtinan was the owner of the Copper Coronet tavern in the city of Athkatla , Amn . Personality . He was involved in many criminal dealings , primarily prostitution and gambling on slave pit - fights . History . Eventually Gorion ' s Ward met him while trying to free Hendak , one of Lehtinan ' s slaves . Once free , Hendak went immediately to kill Lehtinan .

title: Leilon
description: Leilon Leilon was a small mining town that served as a convenient resting place for weary travelers on the High Road between Neverwinter and Waterdeep . Politics . The town was a member in good standing with the Lords ' Alliance , thanks to the efforts of its leader Lord Pelindar Filmarya .
description_long: Leilon Leilon was a small mining town that served as a convenient resting place for weary travelers on the High Road between Neverwinter and Waterdeep . Politics . The town was a member in good standing with the Lords ' Alliance , thanks to the efforts of its leader Lord Pelindar Filmarya . Trade . Trade via sea was dangerous , as the nearby shore was a shallow mudflat and the method used to transfer cargo from ships at sea to the land was very risky ( consisting of a series of magically reinforced barges that were poled out to meet the boats , whereupon cargo was transferred via rickety cranes that were impossible to use in high winds ) . Instead of relying on this form of trade , most of Leilon ' s imports came via caravan out of Waterdeep . Defense . The Leilon military , known as the Lances of Leilon , was composed of as many as 200 soldiers . In times of need , citizens were incorporated into the militia . Rumors and Legends . Despite the high quality of law and order in the town , there had long been rumors of both the Cult of the Dragon and the Zhentarim operating within the town ' s walls .

title: Leira
description: Leira Leira ( LAIR - ah or LAIR - uh ) , also known as The Lady of Deception or The Lady of the Mists , was the goddess of deception and illusion s and patroness of illusionists and liars . Personality . She was an enigma , never telling the truth when falsehood would do .
description_long: Leira Leira ( LAIR - ah or LAIR - uh ) , also known as The Lady of Deception or The Lady of the Mists , was the goddess of deception and illusion s and patroness of illusionists and liars . Personality . She was an enigma , never telling the truth when falsehood would do . Everything she did and said was shrouded in layers of illusion and lies . She believed that truth was worthless and that misbelief and falsehood were what gave life meaning . Worshipers . Leira had quite a small following . Her priests , known as Leirans , or Worshipers of the Mistshadow , wore silver masks and often disguised themselves to deceive those around them . Leirans would speak the truth only to other Leirans . High - level cleric s of the Leiran faith were called Mistcallers . Every morning , and on every moonlit night , Leirans lay face down and prayed to the Lady of the Mists . If there was any mist , Leirans would walk through it and pray . The most revered act in the Leiran faith was the " " Unmasking " " , a purification ritual performed when new followers entered the faith . The highest concentration of Leira ' s followers could be found on the island of Nimbral and its vassal state Samarach .

title: Lelavdra Tanthul
description: Lelavdra Tanthul Lelavdra Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Lelavdra and her sister Manarlume Tanthul were summoned by the High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont .
description_long: Lelavdra Tanthul Lelavdra Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Lelavdra and her sister Manarlume Tanthul were summoned by the High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont . The Most High hinted that he knew about the ambitions of both Manarlume and Lelavdra and that new princesses could be easily sired . After Larloch shattered the minds of most of the shadovar arcanists , Gwelt went to Manarlume and Lelavdra , saying that he loved them both . They started discussing how to survive the fighting . Later , among the ruins of the collapsed Thultanthar , the three laughed about the stupidity of the High Prince . Relationships . Lelavdra was a daughter of Dethud Tanthul like her sister Manarlume .

title: Leldon
description: Leldon Leldon was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Leldon was one of the thieves in Neverwinter .
description_long: Leldon Leldon was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Leldon was one of the thieves in Neverwinter . Once , he was allied with Neeshka and both stole a lot of money . Leldon thought he was the mastermind and took a lot of items from Neeshka . However , Neeshka stole a lot of gold back , which she used for a lot of services . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha and Neeshka encountered Leldon ' s thugs , they needed to ask Ophala Cheldarstorn for the location of Leldon ' s hideout . If they did , they could have gotten into the hideout and battled many bandits . Once they found the vault , Leldon would confront them and if hurt enough , he would disappear in a puff of smoke . Later , a messenger came to Neeshka and the Kalach - Cha , informing them that Leldon was after the Collector , who had many riches in his vault . If they opened the vault door with a key from the fireplace , a key from the Collector , and a code for the vault ( which was 513 ) , the door would ' ve opened , but Leldon came along as well . If Leldon was defeated , then he let Neeskha know he would expect her in the hells before he died .

title: Leleanor
description: Leleanor Leleanor was a descendant of Aurora of Aurora ' s Emporium . History . Leleanor was a businesswoman who wanted to regrow the business of her ancestor , which was at that time limited to a few outlets in major cities like Waterdeep , Baldur ' s Gate , and Westgate .
description_long: Leleanor Leleanor was a descendant of Aurora of Aurora ' s Emporium . History . Leleanor was a businesswoman who wanted to regrow the business of her ancestor , which was at that time limited to a few outlets in major cities like Waterdeep , Baldur ' s Gate , and Westgate . In 1491 DR , she discovered a map among her ancestors ' possessions detailing a mine in the Underdark near Mulmaster . With the help of the Lords ' Alliance and the Church of Tymora , she quietly secured access to the mine . Later , at Mulmaster ' s Underdark outpost of Fort Iron , Leleanor hired an adventuring party to explore the nearby mines for her .

title: Lelia
description: Lelia Imam Lelia , also known as the Voice of the Beautiful Moon , was the High Priest of the Mosque of Beauteous Selan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . As of 1367 Lelia ' s blue eyes sparkled with the vigor of youth .
description_long: Lelia Imam Lelia , also known as the Voice of the Beautiful Moon , was the High Priest of the Mosque of Beauteous Selan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . As of 1367 Lelia ' s blue eyes sparkled with the vigor of youth . Her long , curly hair nearly touched the floor . Personality . Lelia ' s melodious voice was said to charm stars down from the sky . Activities . Imam Lelia oversaw over 200 priests of Selan , clerical brethren , and laymen . Leila orchestrated a unique project where she attempted to create a grand work of art for the Grand Caliph for his Ascension Day celebration . Included in the project were her associates from the mosque , sha ' ir s , and other hired mages . Her goal was to create a crystal rose bush that would yield real roses , fruit , or valuable gem s whenever the Grand Caliph wished . The enchantments involved were difficult , and some of the items needed were exceedingly rare , including a large emerald from Shou Lung , so Lelia hired others to perform much of the required footwork .

title: Leliana Vrinn
description: Leliana Vrinn Leliana Vrinn was a drow priestess of Eilistraee , a protector of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden and the mother of Rowaan Vrinn , the head priestess of the Misty Forest shrine . Together with Qilué Veladorn and Cavatina Xarann she is one of the main characters among the priestesses of Eilistraee in The Lady Penitent Trilogy . Along with the other followers of Eilistraee and drow of Miyeritari descent without Wendonai ´s taint , she was transformed into a dark elf during Flamerule 1379 DR by Q ' arlynd Melarn ´s High Magic and the grace of Eilistraee .
description_long: Leliana Vrinn Leliana Vrinn was a drow priestess of Eilistraee , a protector of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden and the mother of Rowaan Vrinn , the head priestess of the Misty Forest shrine . Together with Qilué Veladorn and Cavatina Xarann she is one of the main characters among the priestesses of Eilistraee in The Lady Penitent Trilogy . Along with the other followers of Eilistraee and drow of Miyeritari descent without Wendonai ´s taint , she was transformed into a dark elf during Flamerule 1379 DR by Q ' arlynd Melarn ´s High Magic and the grace of Eilistraee . Grief - stricken about the death of Eilistraee at the hands of Halisstra Melarn , she killed the Lady Penitent with her ( now silent ) singing sword .

title: Lemure
description: Lemure Lemures were among the weakest devils . Lemures are the shock troops and laborers of the devils . The most selfish , cruel , and evil mortals that die and come to Hell become lemures .
description_long: Lemure Lemures were among the weakest devils . Lemures are the shock troops and laborers of the devils . The most selfish , cruel , and evil mortals that die and come to Hell become lemures . The only things lower in the devilish hierarchy than lemures are nupperibos , which are strange gangly - limbed bloated creatures with no minds or eyes . Description . A lemure is a hideous creature , appearing as nothing more than a lump of man - sized blobs of molten stinking flesh and a permanent expression of anguish , that oozes across the ground as it moves . They stand about 5 feet tall and weigh about 100 pounds . Their soft bodies regenerate quickly , making them convenient victims of torture for the devils . A lemure is about as tough as a typical human zombie . History . After a mortal soul has been thoroughly tortured for an untold time , its soul is wracked with pain and infused with hatred . It is at this time that the devils then transform the soul into one of their own . The mortal soul is corrupted with infernal power and turned into the least powerful of the devils : a lemure . Combat . These mindless fiends make up the rank - and - file of the infernal legions .

title: Lendarn
description: Lendarn Lendarn was an evil wizard who , together with an ogre , led a group of kobold s in attacking the halfling village of Gullykin . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward chose to help the halflings kill the kobolds and in the end , Gorion ' s Ward defeated Lendarn .
description_long: Lendarn Lendarn was an evil wizard who , together with an ogre , led a group of kobold s in attacking the halfling village of Gullykin . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward chose to help the halflings kill the kobolds and in the end , Gorion ' s Ward defeated Lendarn .

title: Lendys
description: Lendys Lendys ( pronounced " LEN - dis " ) was the lawful neutral dragon god of justice and the judge of dragons in life instead of after death . He was the consort of Tamara , and was commonly worshiped alongside her and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description .
description_long: Lendys Lendys ( pronounced " LEN - dis " ) was the lawful neutral dragon god of justice and the judge of dragons in life instead of after death . He was the consort of Tamara , and was commonly worshiped alongside her and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description . In his natural form , Lendys was a huge , wingless platinum dragon with tarnished scales , and his eyes gleamed with brilliant beams of light so no one could hide from his gaze . Some said that he cared more about judging others than himself . Realm . Lendys had a lair in the plane of Nirvana . Worshipers . Lendys was worshiped mostly by lawful dragons , but they usually tried to balance his implacability with mercy of their own . Clergy . Lendys ' s clergy served as judges among dragonkind . In some cases , towns even asked a cleric of Lendys to parcel out justice . Temples . There were few temples to the dragon god of Justice . Most dragons often had small shrines to him in their lairs . Other races had a small shrine engraved with his holy symbol set up in a courtroom or courthouse . Dogma . Lendys was justice personified .

title: Leneka Jheth
description: Leneka Jheth Leneka Jheth was a Zhent lich . Biography . Leneka was a powerful lich .
description_long: Leneka Jheth Leneka Jheth was a Zhent lich . Biography . Leneka was a powerful lich . At some point , someone defeated Leneka and transformed the lich into a grisgol . This grisgol survived the siege of Zhentil Keep by the forces of Cyric in 1368 – 1369 DR and proved a bane to adventurers trying to plunder the ruins .

title: Lennithon
description: Lennithon Lennithon was a adult blue dragon allied with the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Lennithon helped the cultists in the assault on Greenest but with little enthusiasm . He was last seen attacking a traitor to the Cult of the Dragon at Xonthal ' s Tower .
description_long: Lennithon Lennithon was a adult blue dragon allied with the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Lennithon helped the cultists in the assault on Greenest but with little enthusiasm . He was last seen attacking a traitor to the Cult of the Dragon at Xonthal ' s Tower . Appendix . Behind the scenes . If the adventures fought well in Greenest , then the dragon became bored of the situation and decided to fly away from the battle .

title: Lenta Moore
description: Lenta Moore Lenta Moore was a member of the Watch of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . History . Lenta was the daughter of an Upper City rich merchant member of the Parliament of Peers .
description_long: Lenta Moore Lenta Moore was a member of the Watch of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . History . Lenta was the daughter of an Upper City rich merchant member of the Parliament of Peers . She wanted join the Flaming Fists but her father rejected the idea , as Lenta might be sent off to die in places like the Calim Desert . So instead she joined the Watch and in time was promoted to captain thanks to her sword - mastery . However , Grand Duke Torlin Silvershield demoted her to sergeant in 1479 DR .

title: Leomund ' s secure shelter
description: Leomund ' s secure shelter Leomund ' s secure shelter is a conjuration spell that creates a sturdy cottage . It was presumably developed by Leomund . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as secure shelter , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Leomund ' s secure shelter Leomund ' s secure shelter is a conjuration spell that creates a sturdy cottage . It was presumably developed by Leomund . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as secure shelter , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effect . You conjure a sturdy cottage or lodge made of material that is common in the area where the spell is cast - stone , timber , or ( at worst ) sod . The floor is level , clean , and dry . In all respects the lodging resembles a normal cottage , with a sturdy door , two shuttered windows , and a small fireplace . The shelter has no heating or cooling source ( other than natural insulation qualities ) . Therefore , it must be heated as a normal dwelling , and extreme heat adversely affects it and its occupants . The dwelling does , however , provide considerable security otherwise - it is as strong as a normal stone building , regardless of its actual material composition . The dwelling resists flames and fire as if it were stone . It is impervious to normal missiles ( but not the sort cast by siege machinery or giant s ) .

title: Leonal ' s roar
description: Leonal ' s roar Named for leonal guardinal s , leonal ' s roar is an evocation spell that kills , paralyzes , or weakens non - good subjects , and deals sonic damage . Effect . This spell has the effect of a " holy word " , and it additionally deals moderate sonic damage to nongood creatures in the area .
description_long: Leonal ' s roar Named for leonal guardinal s , leonal ' s roar is an evocation spell that kills , paralyzes , or weakens non - good subjects , and deals sonic damage . Effect . This spell has the effect of a " holy word " , and it additionally deals moderate sonic damage to nongood creatures in the area . A creatures with strong fortitude can resist the sonic damage , but not the other effects of the spell .

title: Leopard
description: Leopard Leopards were big cats . They dwelt in forested mountains , hills , and plains . They had rosettes similar to those of the jaguar , but the leopard ' s rosettes were smaller and more densely packed , and did not usually have central spots .
description_long: Leopard Leopards were big cats . They dwelt in forested mountains , hills , and plains . They had rosettes similar to those of the jaguar , but the leopard ' s rosettes were smaller and more densely packed , and did not usually have central spots . Realmslore . Snow leopards were the main predator in the wilds of the World Pillar Mountains of Zakhara and the Leopard Shan of the Hordelands . Trivia . Several features of the Realms bore the name of the great cat :

title: Leopard Shan
description: Leopard Shan The Leopard Shan , or the Mountain of the Leopard , was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Howling Gap , the lone peak of the Leopard Shan stood as a prominent landmark in the Hordelands .
description_long: Leopard Shan The Leopard Shan , or the Mountain of the Leopard , was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Howling Gap , the lone peak of the Leopard Shan stood as a prominent landmark in the Hordelands . The ruins of an old monastery , Leopard Stupa , founded by monks from Khazari , stood at the base of the peak . The monastery was once the westernmost influence of the Path of Enlightenment , and stood for several centuries , providing shelter to travelers along the Silk Road , only to be abandoned during the war between Solon and Ra - Khati . As of 1359 DR , travelers still used the ruins of the monastery for shelter , and kept them well preserved , often leaving supplies for the next traveler . An old Sempharan saying “ He ’ s gone east of the leopard ” was used to describe people who passed by the mountain while fleeing the country , usually to avoid being arrested . Though free of monsters , bandits were a known problem in the region . Inhabitants . The mountain was well known for the snow leopards that inhabited the upper portion of its peak .

title: Leosin Erlanthar
description: Leosin Erlanthar Leosin Erlanthar was a monk from Berdusk and a member of the Harpers who researched the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Leosin noted the unusual actions of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons and decided to investigate the matter .
description_long: Leosin Erlanthar Leosin Erlanthar was a monk from Berdusk and a member of the Harpers who researched the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Leosin noted the unusual actions of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons and decided to investigate the matter . In Greenest , he permitted the cultists to capture him in order to examine them more closely .

title: Lerek
description: Lerek Lerek was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . Lerek was one of the cultists that dealt with Red Wizard of Thay necromancer Zaralda .
description_long: Lerek Lerek was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . Lerek was one of the cultists that dealt with Red Wizard of Thay necromancer Zaralda . However , one day in 1489 DR , a ghost elf who had escaped Zaralda ' s control attacked the cultists and the Thayan s . In fear , Lerek escaped just as the camp was assaulted by an adventuring party hired to defeat Claugiyliamatar , helped by the archfey Whitchthorn . Lerek was presumably spared by the adventurers and ran away .

title: Lernaean hydra
description: Lernaean hydra The hydra of legend was extremely deadly . The creature was poisonous in every way . Its bite was poisonous ; as was its blood .
description_long: Lernaean hydra The hydra of legend was extremely deadly . The creature was poisonous in every way . Its bite was poisonous ; as was its blood . It could even breathe clouds of gas that were poisonous . The lernaean hydras of legend possessed nine heads , it was also supposed to have a immortal head , i . e . one that continued to bite and move no matter if it wasn ' t attached to body any longer .

title: Lessa Amyselnar
description: Lessa Amyselnar Lessa Amyselnar was a human female priest ess of Tymora at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . Lessa ' s father was a priest of Tymora , instilling his faith into daughter since she was young .
description_long: Lessa Amyselnar Lessa Amyselnar was a human female priest ess of Tymora at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . Lessa ' s father was a priest of Tymora , instilling his faith into daughter since she was young . Lessa followed him into the priesthood . She became a priestess at the temple of The Lady ' s Favor , which was built in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , under high priest Randolph dul Umast . On the Eleint 1 in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , one of the hamlet ' s wells was poison ed , killing a few villagers and sickening twenty - two more . Lessa joined the other priests of Tymora in treating them but found that their magic could do nothing to identify or cure the poison , and they were forced to rely on non - magical treatments . Lessa trusted that Tymora and Umast would heal the sick . Abilities . Lessa was a priestess of Tymora . Description . Lessa had strawberry blonde hair , long enough to reach her waist , and dark blue eyes , but an otherwise unremarkable appearance . She was 5 feet and 7 inches ( 1 . 7 meters ) tall . Possessions . In combat , Lessa wore chainmail and fought with a footman ' s mace .

title: Lessen gravity
description: Lessen gravity Lessen gravity was an alteration spell used to weaken gravity ' s pull within a targeted area . This spell was created by Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .
description_long: Lessen gravity Lessen gravity was an alteration spell used to weaken gravity ' s pull within a targeted area . This spell was created by Darsson Spellmaker . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to reduce the pull of gravity to a quarter of it ' s normal force within an area . The area of effect was determined by the skill of the caster . Flying creatures passing through the area typically experienced trouble compensating for the change in force . The inertia of missiles passing through the area caused them to remain unaffected , but missiles fired from within the area traveled at a much higher speed . This spell could be cast by multiple casters for a cumulative effect , with three castings creating a weightless environment . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components to cast .

title: Lesser deity
description: Lesser deity A lesser deity was a type of deity ranked below an intermediate deity or a greater deity . They were , however , above demigod s in the ranking of powers . Follower Base .
description_long: Lesser deity A lesser deity was a type of deity ranked below an intermediate deity or a greater deity . They were , however , above demigod s in the ranking of powers . Follower Base . A lesser deity had thousands to ten thousands of followers , this was a general rule of thumb for the two factors , that determined a deity ' s status was not only the number but the devotion of the followers Abilities . Being a lesser deity gave some abilities among others immortality . Lesser Deities could granted spells to their divine spellcasters , and gave the cleric s access to the abilities and spells of their domain s . They were also capable of casting the spells of these domains as often as they wanted and also to use the abilities of these for a certain number of times . Senses . Lesser deities could use their mundane senses to sense things over a distance of several miles . They were also capable of sensing , regardless of planar boundaries , that and where an event that concerned their portfolios and at least five hundred people was happening but not what exactly , and retained the sense for a number of tendays . Once sensed , they could remotely sense what exactly was happening .

title: Lesser ironguard
description: Lesser ironguard Ironguard was an arcane spell that used the opposing schools of abjuration and alteration to temporarily render one creature immune and intangible to non - magical metal . After an improved version was developed , this spell became known as lesser ironguard . Effects .
description_long: Lesser ironguard Ironguard was an arcane spell that used the opposing schools of abjuration and alteration to temporarily render one creature immune and intangible to non - magical metal . After an improved version was developed , this spell became known as lesser ironguard . Effects . Upon casting this spell , the caster or one creature touched by the caster became completely immune to common , unenchanted metal . Metal weapons would pass through the individual without causing harm . Likewise , the target of this spell could pass through metal barriers such as iron bars , grates , or portcullises . This spell presumably applied to clothing being worn , but did not apply to items carried or attached to the " ironguarded " creature . Thus , an individual under the effects of this spell could not hold metal coins or use a weapon with a metal grip with their bare hands , but attacking with bare hands or natural weapons such as claws and fangs ignored any metal armor being worn by the victim . Properties carried by a metal object were not negated by this spell .

title: Lesser planar binding
description: Lesser planar binding Lesser planar binding is a conjuration spell that traps an outsider until it performs a task . Effect . Casting this spell attempts a dangerous act : to lure a creature from another plane to a specifically prepared trap , which must lie within the spell ' s range .
description_long: Lesser planar binding Lesser planar binding is a conjuration spell that traps an outsider until it performs a task . Effect . Casting this spell attempts a dangerous act : to lure a creature from another plane to a specifically prepared trap , which must lie within the spell ' s range . The called creature is held in the trap until it agrees to perform one service in return for its freedom . To create the trap , you must use a " magic circle " spell , focused inward . The type of creature to be bound must be known and stated . If it has a specific , proper , or given name , this must be used in casting the spell . The target creature must attempt a Will saving throw . If the saving throw succeeds , the creature resists the spell . If the saving throw fails , the creature is immediately drawn to the trap ( spell resistance does not keep the creature from being called ) . The creature can escape from the trap with a successful SR roll , dimensional travel , or a successful Charisma check ( DC 15 + 1 / 2 its level + its Charisma modifier ) . It can try each method once per day . If it breaks loose , it can flee or attack you .

title: Lesser restoration
description: Lesser restoration Lesser restoration , and a more limited version known as restore strength , were conjuration and necromancy spells ( respectively ) that removed a temporary handicap caused by certain creature attacks , poisons , and magical effects . Effects . The necromantic version of this spell , " restore strength " , could only alleviate temporary losses of strength , whereas the conjuration version returned lost strength , constitution , dexterity , intelligence , wisdom , or charisma ( only one of these characteristics per casting of " lesser restoration " ) .
description_long: Lesser restoration Lesser restoration , and a more limited version known as restore strength , were conjuration and necromancy spells ( respectively ) that removed a temporary handicap caused by certain creature attacks , poisons , and magical effects . Effects . The necromantic version of this spell , " restore strength " , could only alleviate temporary losses of strength , whereas the conjuration version returned lost strength , constitution , dexterity , intelligence , wisdom , or charisma ( only one of these characteristics per casting of " lesser restoration " ) . Using strength loss as an example , these spells could restore some or all of the losses due to " chill touch " , " ray of enfeeblement " , " ray of fatigue " , the excretion of a roper , the touch of a shadow , spider venom , and similar debilitating effects . The conjuration version also alleviated fatigue or revitalized an exhausted state to be merely fatigued . Permanent losses , or losses due to a physical injury , disease , or other natural causes were not restored by these spells . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast these spells .

title: Lesser shadow tentacle
description: Lesser shadow tentacle Lesser shadow tentacle is an abjuration spell that transmutes a nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle . Effect . You can animate any nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle .
description_long: Lesser shadow tentacle Lesser shadow tentacle is an abjuration spell that transmutes a nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle . Effect . You can animate any nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle . The target shadow transforms into a thick , ropy tentacle . One end of the shadow tentacle remains rooted to the location where it fell on the floor , wall , ceiling , et cetera , while the opposite end can attack and curl about a target . The animated shadow tentacle extends 5 feet per level of the caster ( up to 50 feet ) from its anchoring point . The caster directs the shadow tendril , indicating a target for it to attack . The tentacle makes a melee touch attack using the caster ' s attack bonus . The tentacle does not inflict damage , but can be used to entangle an opponent . A successful melee touch attack means that the tentacle has entangled its victim . The shadow tentacle is anchored , so it can hold its victim motionless if the caster desires ; otherwise , the entangled victim can move at half speed up to the length of the animated tentacle . The shadow tentacle can be damaged with weapons and spells , and can also be burst with brute strength .

title: Lestra Urmbrusk
description: Lestra Urmbrusk Lestra Urmbrusk was the master of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Quarren Urmbrusk , the lord of the House , abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure .
description_long: Lestra Urmbrusk Lestra Urmbrusk was the master of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Quarren Urmbrusk , the lord of the House , abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure . He granted the control of the House to Lestra also granting her the custody of his son Rutherford Urmbrusk . Quarren then gathered an adventuring party and went to Undermountain . However Lestra bribed the Quarren ' s companions in order to kept sure that he never went back from the dungeon . Nobody of that group went back . However in 1479 DR a voice like the one of Quarren started whispered to Rutherford ' s ears . Rutherford went to Undermountain for a rescue mission and disappeared . Lestra started worried that Quarren was alive and knew of her betrayal . So she hired an adventuring party to went in search of her nephew .

title: Leucrotta
description: Leucrotta The leucrotta is a magical beast ; a ugly mix of a stag ' s body and legs , a lion ' s tail and a wedge shapped head much like a giant badger ' s . They constantly emit a noxious stench and their oily skin appears , and smells , rancid . They do not actually have teeth , but rather a jagged bony ridge as strong as adamantine .
description_long: Leucrotta The leucrotta is a magical beast ; a ugly mix of a stag ' s body and legs , a lion ' s tail and a wedge shapped head much like a giant badger ' s . They constantly emit a noxious stench and their oily skin appears , and smells , rancid . They do not actually have teeth , but rather a jagged bony ridge as strong as adamantine . Leucrottas speak Common , Draconic and Giant . Leucrotta are creatures that hunt far more than they need to eat . They have an incredible ability at mimicry , and often make the sounds of wounded humanoids to draw in unwary adventures . They hunt both alone and in packs , preferring ambushes or advantageous terrain for their attacks . Their loathsome behavior keeps them isolated in barren lands , but a large number can found in Skullport , where they are allies of the Unseen . In the last four years ( 1368 DR to 1372 DR ) unprecendented numbers of leucrotta ' s have been seen around Silverymoon and Everlund . In 1372 DR bounties have been paid for leucrotta ears in Silverymoon and Everlund for many years . Society . Leucrotta identify each other via their scents , which are apparently unique to every individual .

title: Leuthilspar
description: Leuthilspar Leuthilspar was the capital of the island of Evermeet and lay on the east coast , situated at the mouth of the River Ardulith . An area of grassland known as the Greenmeadow lay north of the city , across the river . The elves believed that if Leuthilspar were to fall , it would bring an end to elves on Toril .
description_long: Leuthilspar Leuthilspar was the capital of the island of Evermeet and lay on the east coast , situated at the mouth of the River Ardulith . An area of grassland known as the Greenmeadow lay north of the city , across the river . The elves believed that if Leuthilspar were to fall , it would bring an end to elves on Toril . Buildings . Most buildings were constructed magically , using materials from the ground to " grow " them . Some were made from alabaster or glass . Stone buildings were usually crafted from a single piece of rock . Those made from wood had roofs of magically created bark or leaves . Otherwise roofs were typically made from crystal or , causing them to glitter in sunlight . Notable buildings included the Hall of the Ancients , the Fountain of Stars , the Temple of the Seldarine , the Shrine of the Black Sword and the Moonstone Palace . Taverns included The Green Sword and Throleatha ' s Public House . Harbour . Leuthilspar ' s deep sheltered harbour was filled by the River Ardulith . It was guarded by the leviathan Hamnuatha . A chain could be raised across its entrance to hinder the approach of hostile vessels .

title: Levast River
description: Levast River Levast River was a river in eastern Tethyr that was a tributary of the Idolflow . Etymology . The river was believed to have been named after a dwarven clansman .
description_long: Levast River Levast River was a river in eastern Tethyr that was a tributary of the Idolflow . Etymology . The river was believed to have been named after a dwarven clansman . Geography . Levast River fed the shorter Idolflow . Like the Idolflow , it began in the Omlarandin Mountains . Rumors & Legends . Some dwarves believed that an offshoot of the river broke off and became subterranean , perhaps even entering the ancient realm of Shanatar .

title: Levia Shadewalker
description: Levia Shadewalker Levia Shadewalker was the half - elven spymistress of the Eye of Justice in Westgate . Levia was Gedrin Thalavar ' s apprentice and she considered herself his adopted daughter . Description .
description_long: Levia Shadewalker Levia Shadewalker was the half - elven spymistress of the Eye of Justice in Westgate . Levia was Gedrin Thalavar ' s apprentice and she considered herself his adopted daughter . Description . Levia had slightly pointed ears due to her elven heritage . She wasn ' t pretty , a fact she was painfully aware of . Possessions . Levia owned a magical ring that slowed time . She wore brigandine armor and wielded a mace . History . In 1470 DR , Kalen Dren journeyed to Westgate and revealed to the Eye of Justice that he was the heir to the blade Vindicator , Gedrin ' s sword that was once wielded by the god Helm . Kalen became Levia ' s apprentice and she trained him in spycraft and martial skills . In 1480 DR , Rhetegast Hawkwinter , the heir to the Shadowbane title , journeyed to Westgate to train with Levia . She groomed him to be the new Shadowbane and he crusaded throughout the city . Later that year , Kalen showed up in Westgate , looking for Rhett but Levia didn ' t reveal Rhett ' s whereabouts .

title: Leviathan
description: Leviathan The leviathan was a huge whale and child proxy of the Earthmother of the Moonshae Isles . Description . A great black - skinned whale , the leviathan was larger than any whale naturally found on Toril .
description_long: Leviathan The leviathan was a huge whale and child proxy of the Earthmother of the Moonshae Isles . Description . A great black - skinned whale , the leviathan was larger than any whale naturally found on Toril . Fully 360 ft ( 109 . 7 m ) long , the beast ' s tail was 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) wide and the creature had a mouth full of razor - sharp teeth . Abilities . The leviathan was mortal and could grow old and die like any other natural creature . Though it was immortal in a sense , its spirit would be reborn in time after it died . History . The behemoth slumbered for centuries until awakened by the Goddess in 1345 DR . The leviathan was killed by several poisoned poles attached to the ships in which Kazgoroth , disguised as Thelgaar Ironhand , led an army of northerners against the Ffolk of the southern Moonshae Isles .

title: Levitate
description: Levitate Levitate was a transmutation spell or supernatural ability that allowed the caster to move a creature or object vertically as desired . Some races native to Faerûn , such as the air genasi , had the innate ability to levitate . During the religious ceremony of the Dance of the Swirling Winds , the elven goddess Aerdrie Faenya would sometimes grant her worshipers who could not fly the power to levitate .
description_long: Levitate Levitate was a transmutation spell or supernatural ability that allowed the caster to move a creature or object vertically as desired . Some races native to Faerûn , such as the air genasi , had the innate ability to levitate . During the religious ceremony of the Dance of the Swirling Winds , the elven goddess Aerdrie Faenya would sometimes grant her worshipers who could not fly the power to levitate . Levitation played a key role in the drow game khaless . Effects . The caster could choose to levitate him - or herself or a creature or object within a close range . The weight of the creature or object lifted depended on the power of the caster but at a minimum , the spell could lift anything under 200 pounds . Only a willing creature could be lifted . Levitated persons or objects could be moved mentally at a speed of 200 feet per minute but only in the up or down direction . It was difficult to maintain one ' s balance if attempting to engage in combat while levitating . The effects of this spell lasted for several minutes , depending on the power of the caster . Components .

title: Lewy Jons
description: Lewy Jons Lewy Jons was a male human inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy was a farmer of the West Harbor .
description_long: Lewy Jons Lewy Jons was a male human inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy was a farmer of the West Harbor . Once , he took a bard into the swamp , who did not return . In the Harvest Fair , Lewy attempted to win at the hog contest , cheating by using magic to enlarge his pig . Orlen had doubts and tasked the Kalach - Cha to investigate ; Lewy was prepared to bribe the Kalach - Cha to avoid being exposed . After the Harvest Fair , however , Lewy and his hog were killed by the duergar and bladeling s .

title: Lewy Jons ' hog
description: Lewy Jons ' hog Lewy Jons ' hog was a pig of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy Jons was a farmer of the West Harbor .
description_long: Lewy Jons ' hog Lewy Jons ' hog was a pig of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy Jons was a farmer of the West Harbor . In the Harvest Fair , he attempted to win at the hog contest , cheating by using magic to enlarge his pig . Orlen had doubts and tasked the Kalach - Cha to investigate ; Lewy was prepared to bribe the Kalach - Cha to avoid being exposed . After the Harvest Fair , however , Lewy and his hog were killed by the duergar and bladeling s .

title: Lhaaril
description: Lhaaril Lhaaril was the shadovar seneschal to Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Lhaaril announced to Brennus that his father Telamont Tanthul had just arrived in Sakkors to speak with Brennus .
description_long: Lhaaril Lhaaril was the shadovar seneschal to Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Lhaaril announced to Brennus that his father Telamont Tanthul had just arrived in Sakkors to speak with Brennus . Later he introduced to his master a scout with important news to tell . Some time after Brennus ordered to him to gathered a loyal platoon to went to the Abbey of the Rose to capture Vasen Cale .

title: Lhargloroth
description: Lhargloroth Lhargloroth was a dragon who lived in Oroth , in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Lhargloroth was experimenting in Oroth , using living creatures to create strange monsters , most of them gibbering mouther s or rare sterile beasts , although a few of those were able to breed true .
description_long: Lhargloroth Lhargloroth was a dragon who lived in Oroth , in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Lhargloroth was experimenting in Oroth , using living creatures to create strange monsters , most of them gibbering mouther s or rare sterile beasts , although a few of those were able to breed true . History . Lhargloroth was a former servant who fled from Melauthaur at some point in the past and installed himself in Oroth . He was still there as of 1479 DR .

title: Lherzona Ludwakazar
description: Lherzona Ludwakazar Lherzona Ludwakazar was a dwarf of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . History . Lherzona lived with her father King Iorn Ludwakazar and the rest of her clan in the Earthspur Mountains , acting as custodians of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones .
description_long: Lherzona Ludwakazar Lherzona Ludwakazar was a dwarf of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . History . Lherzona lived with her father King Iorn Ludwakazar and the rest of her clan in the Earthspur Mountains , acting as custodians of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones . However , after mining excavations , a medusa and her gargoyle s minions took control of the Chamber . In a battle , King Iorn was mortally wounded . Lherzona and the others remained to await the death of Iorn , guarding against intruders , until an adventuring party hired to clear the mine arrived . After the adventurers solved the matter , Iorn finally died and Lherzona was crowned queen of her people .

title: Lheshayl
description: Lheshayl Lheshayl was a small city in the Shining Plains . Geography . The city sat on the southwestern side of the Shining Plains and was the only city on the west side .
description_long: Lheshayl Lheshayl was a small city in the Shining Plains . Geography . The city sat on the southwestern side of the Shining Plains and was the only city on the west side . Government . Lheshayl was ruled by a long line of chiefs and in 1372 DR , the city was lead by Chief Entawanata . Trade . The small city produced high - quality horses , much finer than those from Ormath and Assam put together .

title: Lhestyn
description: Lhestyn Lhestyn ( the Masked Lady ) was a human and one of the Open Lords of Waterdeep . Relatives . Lhestyn was the child of Baeron and Shilarn , two other Lords of Waterdeep .
description_long: Lhestyn Lhestyn ( the Masked Lady ) was a human and one of the Open Lords of Waterdeep . Relatives . Lhestyn was the child of Baeron and Shilarn , two other Lords of Waterdeep . Her husband was Zelphar Arunsun , son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Background . Lhestyn was born in Waterdeep in 1276 DR and became the Open Lord in 1308 DR . In 1298 DR , she infiltrated the outlawed Shadow Thieves and exposed them , causing the death of many , and causing the others to leave the city . Lhestyn married Zelphar Arunsun in 1300 DR . She died in 1314 DR .

title: Lhoris
description: Lhoris Lhoris was a fiery - tempered boy from Fireshear . Appearance . Lhoris had flaming red hair .
description_long: Lhoris Lhoris was a fiery - tempered boy from Fireshear . Appearance . Lhoris had flaming red hair . At the age of fifteen , he was not very muscly . Background . Originally from Fireshear , Lhoris was brought to the Blackstaff Tower at the age of ten . He was schooled by Tsarra Chaadren , who attempted to steer his abilities in sorcery and wizardry away from any magic that his temper could use to cause harm .

title: Lhrek Jarsyn
description: Lhrek Jarsyn Lhrek Jarsyn was a mercenary in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company .
description_long: Lhrek Jarsyn Lhrek Jarsyn was a mercenary in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company . History . In 1358 the Sailors of the Crimson Sea were in march to the city of Timindar in Chondath hired by Lord Reland Tymin when they were ambushed by unknown enemies that killed the company ' s leader and destroyed their food ' s supply . After Lhrek , nominated acting - commander , and all the high - ranking members of the company went inside Chondalwood in search of more food . However after killing a deer they were captured by the druid Variath and his treant s that put them on trial . Later he became involved in the Battle of Thurgabanteth .

title: Lhuvenhead
description: Lhuvenhead Lhuvenhead was a village in the Rauvin Vale within Luruar . Geography . Lhuvenhead was located along the River Rauvin , forty miles upriver from Everlund along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar .
description_long: Lhuvenhead Lhuvenhead was a village in the Rauvin Vale within Luruar . Geography . Lhuvenhead was located along the River Rauvin , forty miles upriver from Everlund along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar . The village was near the communities of Rauvincross , High Hold , and Rivermoot . Trade . As a lucrative river town with decrepit docks , Lhuvenhead was crowded with barge s and keelboat s all year long . A number of inns , taphouses , and festhalls catered to the riverfolk who worked on the Rauvin . History . On Flamerule 1 , 1485 DR , Lhuvenhead was destroyed by the orc forces of Many - Arrows led by Hartusk as they approached Everlund . The village had already been abandoned so there were no casualties , but all the docks and buildings were burned or torn down , with the debris sent floating down the river . Inhabitants . The village served as a summer retreat for the nobility of Sundabar .

title: Li Kao - teh
description: Li Kao - teh Li Kao - teh was a shou who lived within the town of Ansi within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Li owned a caravansary where an assortment of regular goods could be acquired .
description_long: Li Kao - teh Li Kao - teh was a shou who lived within the town of Ansi within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Li owned a caravansary where an assortment of regular goods could be acquired . He was an agent for Shou Lung and reported any suspicious activity back to his superiors in the Chukei province .

title: Li Kit Su
description: Li Kit Su Li Kit Su was an old shen lung living near the town of Aru in Wa . Lair . Li Kit Su lived for more than a millennium in the Yama - san river , spending most of time sleeping .
description_long: Li Kit Su Li Kit Su was an old shen lung living near the town of Aru in Wa . Lair . Li Kit Su lived for more than a millennium in the Yama - san river , spending most of time sleeping . History . In 1358 DR , Li Kit Su ' s sleep was disturbed by a dam built by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto .

title: Li Koi
description: Li Koi Li Koi was a librarian in Kesasar Valley in Shou Lung . Activities . Li Koi was the head librarian of the legendary Great Library of Perpustakaan .
description_long: Li Koi Li Koi was a librarian in Kesasar Valley in Shou Lung . Activities . Li Koi was the head librarian of the legendary Great Library of Perpustakaan . He checked that visitors followed all the rules of the library . He asked all visitors to help fund repairs to the library .

title: Liam Lenter
description: Liam Lenter Liam Lenter was a human bard and the " High Wheel " ( town leader ) of Amnwater , Amn as of 1368 DR . Activities . His official job was to maintain the welfare and defense of the town , but the position was largely powerless being easily influenced by the three most powerful families in the town .
description_long: Liam Lenter Liam Lenter was a human bard and the " High Wheel " ( town leader ) of Amnwater , Amn as of 1368 DR . Activities . His official job was to maintain the welfare and defense of the town , but the position was largely powerless being easily influenced by the three most powerful families in the town . History . Around 1318 DR , Lenter was elected as the High Wheel of Amnwater .

title: Liam Sunmist
description: Liam Sunmist Liam Sunmist was a cleric of Lathander in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Liam managed the biggest religious center of the duchy , the Moonglow Tower , and was directly supported by the duke .
description_long: Liam Sunmist Liam Sunmist was a cleric of Lathander in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Liam managed the biggest religious center of the duchy , the Moonglow Tower , and was directly supported by the duke . Liam was the only priest in the duchy capable of casting a " raise dead " spell . He wanted no money for that service , but elite citizens such as the duke and his family received a higher priority .

title: Liar ' s Dice
description: Liar ' s Dice Liar ' s Dice was a popular gambling game in Harglast , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . Liar ' s Dice was a very random game .
description_long: Liar ' s Dice Liar ' s Dice was a popular gambling game in Harglast , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . Liar ' s Dice was a very random game . It involved the gamblers rolling five dice in a cup and covering the results with the cup . Each player then peeked at their dice roll ( under their cup ) and bet against other players based on what they had rolled . Winning the game was largely dependent upon the gamblers bidding on the dice under their cup , bluffing , and reading the " tells " of others at the table .

title: Library of Tarchamus
description: Library of Tarchamus The Library of Tarchamus was a secret library hidden deep inside a mountain in ancient Netheril in a location a few days journey from present day Everlund . The library was built by the legendary arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding both as a repository for his knowledge and as a trap for his Netherese rivals . Many Netherese arcanists fell victim to traps or Tarchamus ' mummy while searching the library for his secrets .
description_long: Library of Tarchamus The Library of Tarchamus was a secret library hidden deep inside a mountain in ancient Netheril in a location a few days journey from present day Everlund . The library was built by the legendary arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding both as a repository for his knowledge and as a trap for his Netherese rivals . Many Netherese arcanists fell victim to traps or Tarchamus ' mummy while searching the library for his secrets . The library had three levels and was said to have housed over 100 , 000 volumes . The central level had a huge domed ceiling and was lit by mage lights . 120 bookcases radiated out from the center of this level . The lower level contained a pit where Tarchamus ' mummy resided as well as air vents which could be used as an escape route . Powerful wards were placed throughout the library to prevent scrying . There were also traps , although most were illusion s . The library was destroyed in 1478 DR by the warlock Farideh and her cambion master Lorcan and allies in order to prevent Shadovar from gaining access to the library ' s knowledge . Inhabitants .

title: Lich
description: Lich Liches were an almost universally evil form of undead spellcaster of great power , usually wizards , but they could also be sorcerers or clerics . They were feared by mortal beings for their malign magic , their intelligence and their willingness to embrace undeath for a chance to live forever ( or rather , " exist " forever ) . Physical description .
description_long: Lich Liches were an almost universally evil form of undead spellcaster of great power , usually wizards , but they could also be sorcerers or clerics . They were feared by mortal beings for their malign magic , their intelligence and their willingness to embrace undeath for a chance to live forever ( or rather , " exist " forever ) . Physical description . Liches were generally gaunt and skeletal with withered flesh stretched tight across horribly visible bones , but could vary greatly in appearance depending on their age . Some appeared as skeletons dressed in regal finery , yet others might appear to be nothing more than lepers . Bright pinpoints of crimson light burned in the empty sockets of those whose eyes had been destroyed or otherwise lost or were so old they had simply rotted away . They were often clad in dark , tattered robes . When moving , they seemed to glide as if floating on water . Liches often did not have lips or the necessary organs to produce natural speech , but they had the ability to project speech from their mouths magically , moving the jaw ( if present ) to aid the illusion . Activities .

title: Lich touch
description: Lich touch Lich touch was an arcane necromancy spell that temporarily granted the caster the power of a lich ' s chilling touch as well as immunity from most lich - like abilities and effects . Effects . By means of this spell , a necromancer gained the painful paralyzing touch of a lich .
description_long: Lich touch Lich touch was an arcane necromancy spell that temporarily granted the caster the power of a lich ' s chilling touch as well as immunity from most lich - like abilities and effects . Effects . By means of this spell , a necromancer gained the painful paralyzing touch of a lich . " Lich touch " lasted for a number of minutes equal to the caster ' s level and could not be prematurely terminated . While this spell was active , the caster ' s hands glowed with an eerie greenish radiance , and anyone successfully touched by the caster was subject to the damage and paralysis inflicted by a true lich , unless they could resist the magic of this spell . If paralyzed , the victim remained immobile for up to eight hours , or until a sufficient " dispel magic " or " remove paralysis " was applied . The caster also gained immunity to all fear and paralysis spells and effects , including those of a lich , until the " lich touch " expired . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a drop of the caster ' s blood and a sample of rancid meat or fish . History .

title: Lichen
description: Lichen Lichen can be found in various places in the " Forgotten Realms " , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Types of lichen . Medquat .
description_long: Lichen Lichen can be found in various places in the " Forgotten Realms " , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Types of lichen . Medquat . This crimson lichen is found in hollow logs in the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . It tastes like lemons and is highly prized in Cormyr . Scorpions are attracted to it . Fire Lichen . While many Underdark plants get their energy from magic or rotting organic matter , the fire lichen obtains its energy from warmth . Given that fact , fire lichen usually grows in areas of heat , and is sometimes confused with the more dangerous fire fungus . Fire lichen can be mashed into a spicy paste , or fermented into a hot liquor . Wisp Lichen . This white lichen native to the Underdark is dangerous . It secretes an adhesive that can hold large creatures and paralyze them . It then slowly , painfully digests them . The true danger of the white lichen , however , is the fact that many dangerous Underdark predators and scavengers can be found lurking near wisp lichens , hoping to get a free meal .

title: Lichling
description: Lichling A lichling was a creature spawned from a demilich . Description . It resembled a cockroach with a pair of insect - like wings , two pairs of human - like arms , a pair of human - like legs , and a human skull for a head , containing razor - sharp fangs .
description_long: Lichling A lichling was a creature spawned from a demilich . Description . It resembled a cockroach with a pair of insect - like wings , two pairs of human - like arms , a pair of human - like legs , and a human skull for a head , containing razor - sharp fangs . Its body was chitinous and greasy . It began as a 6 ″ ( 15 cm ) - long creature , but could grow up to 80 ' ( 24 m ) when mature . Society . A demilich could magically transform itself into a husk that acted as an incubator for lichlings , which grew from the brain cells of the former demilich . The incubation period was between ten and forty years , after which time the lichlings sprang forth and the demilich returned to normal . The lichlings had a close loyalty to their creator . If this demilich was destroyed , they might be taken into the service of another powerful entity like a wizard . Lichlings travelled in hordes of up to 100 , never making a permanent home . They fed on the fear and trauma of their victims , somehow converting this into physical nourishment , and did not require food .

title: Lidahan
description: Lidahan Lidahan was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the jungles and valleys of the Shao Mountains of southwestern Kara - Tur . The nine largest valleys each had their own dialect , the most sophisticated and developed of which was that of the Mahasiswa people of the Kesasar Valley . Appendix .
description_long: Lidahan Lidahan was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the jungles and valleys of the Shao Mountains of southwestern Kara - Tur . The nine largest valleys each had their own dialect , the most sophisticated and developed of which was that of the Mahasiswa people of the Kesasar Valley . Appendix . Notes . " Ronin Challenge " provides a list of common Lidahan words , but these are all taken from . The Bavanese and Bertanese language s are also suggested to be based on Indonesian ( or ) , suggesting a possible , hypothetical connection between them .

title: Lieko
description: Lieko A lieko was a gold coin minted and used as currency in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Very much like the standard gold piece , liekos bore images of King Caladorn the Wise ( the front ) and a mounted knight ( the back ) .
description_long: Lieko A lieko was a gold coin minted and used as currency in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Very much like the standard gold piece , liekos bore images of King Caladorn the Wise ( the front ) and a mounted knight ( the back ) .

title: Liela
description: Liela Liela was a bureaucrat in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Liela ' s heart beat only for business .
description_long: Liela Liela was a bureaucrat in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Liela ' s heart beat only for business . Everything in her office was placed to make her job more efficient . She spoke brusquely . History . Liela was an employee of House Sokol at the administrative office that allowed access to Sokol Keep .

title: Lieshann
description: Lieshann Lieshann was a female minstrel from Ordulin in Sembia . History . Lieshann once journeyed through the Vast , travelling from Tavilar to Kurth .
description_long: Lieshann Lieshann was a female minstrel from Ordulin in Sembia . History . Lieshann once journeyed through the Vast , travelling from Tavilar to Kurth . However , she took the wrong trail and came upon the Mage ' s Tower . She only saw it from a distance , however , and left . Afterwards , Lieshann regularly sang about the mysterious tower when performing an inn s and tavern s . She told that the tower was an entrance to the lair or kingdom of a gold dragon or some other , even more powerful dragon . According to her , this dragon shapechanged into another form to enter and descend to the subterranean realm . However , those who ' d actually managed to enter the tower called this story " bardish moonshine " . Lieshann admitted she ' d only seen it from a distance , but still sang her version of the story .

title: Life - stealer
description: Life - stealer Life - stealers are among the most terrifying of those warlock s who parlay with devil s . From their literally infernal dealings these powerful arcane spellcaster s obtain the ability to become vampire s of a sort , though not literally so , for life - stealers have learned to harness the power of life itself . Sapping away at the animus or “ life force ” of their enemies , life - stealers are deadly predators .
description_long: Life - stealer Life - stealers are among the most terrifying of those warlock s who parlay with devil s . From their literally infernal dealings these powerful arcane spellcaster s obtain the ability to become vampire s of a sort , though not literally so , for life - stealers have learned to harness the power of life itself . Sapping away at the animus or “ life force ” of their enemies , life - stealers are deadly predators . Sometimes , this power becomes intoxicating , and some life - stealers crave the life of their foes as much as a vampire thirsts for blood . Abilities . Life - stealers gain from their unusual talents some powerful abilities . Among the most basic of these is the ability to cast magic al fire with the most basic of attacks , but it also includes the nominal power to steal life from a foe . The precise benefits gained from this sapping of the animus varies from creature to creature . Aberration s grant life - stealers protection from harm , as do immortal s through increasing a life - stealer ’ s resistance to pain , while elemental creature s make life - stealer attacks more deadly .

title: Life among the Tuigan
description: Life among the Tuigan Life among the Tuigan was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR .
