Following King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Koja was a guest of Azoun , living in Suzail in Cormyr for over a year . While there , on the king ' s request , he wrote up an account of his experiences with the Tuigan and their culture .
description_long: Life among the Tuigan Life among the Tuigan was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR . Following King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Koja was a guest of Azoun , living in Suzail in Cormyr for over a year . While there , on the king ' s request , he wrote up an account of his experiences with the Tuigan and their culture . He was aided in this by Thom Reaverson , who worked on a similar project and provided Koja with translations and guidance . The finished work was entitled " Life among the Tuigan " and gave an accurate and unbiased account of his experiences with the Tuigan people and the Horde . Despite Koja ' s skills as a military historian , the " Life " said little about how the Tuigan breached the Dragonwall , suggesting that magic was used . Koja dismissed it as an incomplete collection of notes about Tuigan customs , and felt that Reaverson put in an equal amount of work . He began work expanding his notes into " A History of the Tuigan " .

title: Life domain
description: Life domain Berronar Truesilver , Chauntea and Silvanus were the deities most attuned to the life domain . To the revered mother of dwarfs , kinship was the most essential part of life , and a new life was an extension of the family . The Forest Father and The Great Mother both strongly encouraged the birthing of new life , though Silvanus cared foremost about life in the wilderness and was known to unleash his wrath if someone attempted to harm the lush beauty of nature , while Chauntea had respect and love for all living things .
description_long: Life domain Berronar Truesilver , Chauntea and Silvanus were the deities most attuned to the life domain . To the revered mother of dwarfs , kinship was the most essential part of life , and a new life was an extension of the family . The Forest Father and The Great Mother both strongly encouraged the birthing of new life , though Silvanus cared foremost about life in the wilderness and was known to unleash his wrath if someone attempted to harm the lush beauty of nature , while Chauntea had respect and love for all living things . Power of life . Any divine caster who worshiped a god of the life domain could use it to channel the power of the deity . If a divine spellcaster chose this domain , he or she became more skilled at healing . When they used a power of the domain that struck an enemy , an ally near the caster gained temporary health . As the caster increased in power , so did the temporary health granted by this domain . The powers of the domain are : Pulse of life . To use the power of the life domain one must be able to channel the divinity of their deity . With this ability , the spellcaster gained the " pulse of life " .

title: Life of Rebrum
description: Life of Rebrum The Life of Rebrum was a bawdy autobiography of the life of the travelling merchant Rebrum of Sheirtalar . It was written around 1210 DR and was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark .
description_long: Life of Rebrum The Life of Rebrum was a bawdy autobiography of the life of the travelling merchant Rebrum of Sheirtalar . It was written around 1210 DR and was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark . Here , Rebrum mentioned a group of drow traders , sent by their matrons , who attempted to barter the " Chanting Chain " , a holy relic of Talos the Destroyer , to another group of drow from a distant city .

title: Life water
description: Life water Life water was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This wondrous spell transformed any liquid into a magical serum capable of healing wounds , curing blindness , disease , poison , rot , feeblemindedness , etc .
description_long: Life water Life water was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This wondrous spell transformed any liquid into a magical serum capable of healing wounds , curing blindness , disease , poison , rot , feeblemindedness , etc . Severed limbs could be regenerated after applying the liquid . This serum could not bring life back to a dead body and it could not revert a transformed creature back to its original form . A gallon ( 3 . 79 l ) of this serum completely cured a man - sized creature . A water skin of this serum would cure only one ailment . The serum was applied to the skin and absorbed where its healing effects took place . Components . This spell required any liquid to cast .

title: Lifeproof
description: Lifeproof Lifeproof was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Lifeproof safely removed a vital portion of the target ' s life , even through solid objects .
description_long: Lifeproof Lifeproof was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Lifeproof safely removed a vital portion of the target ' s life , even through solid objects . The removed essence was called the " Shadow of the Heart " and was placed within a glass container or crystal . The " Shadow of the Heart " appeared as a transparent image of the target ' s heart . The target was able to sustain nearly any form of physical damage as long as their " Shadow of the Heart " remained safely within the container . The target would even function normally beyond the point of " death " when their body would normally have given up . Severe damage made the target appear as one of the undead , but the target was able to heal from this damage over time . Severed limbs functioned normally and could be reattached . Though immune to physical and magical harm , the target was still vulnerable to magic such as the " death spell " . Poison and venom could also kill the target . The container holding the " Shadow of the Heart " needed to be within sight when the spell was cast . After a successful casting , the container could be removed to any distance from the target .

title: Lifesurge
description: Lifesurge Lifesurge was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by ghul lord s . Effects .
description_long: Lifesurge Lifesurge was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by ghul lord s . Effects . Ghul lords could only cast this spell on a willing target , creating a negative energy field within the target that resulted in an increase of physical capabilities . The target gained more durability , mental acuity , and could even read spell scrolls that were previously beyond their comprehension . The target would be harmed by the negative energy leaving their body when the spell expired . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Lifferlas
description: Lifferlas Lifferlas was was an awakened tree in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . A druid of the Emerald Enclave gave life to Lifferlas .
description_long: Lifferlas Lifferlas was was an awakened tree in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . A druid of the Emerald Enclave gave life to Lifferlas . In time , he entertained children with tales of heroes and legends about gods . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , he was the oldest living being in the place . He was in the town when giant s attacked the city . Personality . He loved children and was truly happy when they carved their names into his body or hung from his boughs .

title: Light
description: Light Light was a very common spell learned by most spellcasters . Depending on how the caster was trained , " light " was either a cantrip or a first - level spell . In some spellcasting traditions this spell was reversible and called darkness when reversed .
description_long: Light Light was a very common spell learned by most spellcasters . Depending on how the caster was trained , " light " was either a cantrip or a first - level spell . In some spellcasting traditions this spell was reversible and called darkness when reversed . Effects . The area illuminated by all versions of this spell was roughly 20 to 25 ft ( 6 . 1 to 7 . 6 m ) in radius . The range and duration of this spell varied with the spellcasting tradition . Post - Spellplague , it could be cast at - will , creating a bright light on a nearby object or in a nearby unoccupied space , and lasted until dispelled or a new " light " was cast elsewhere . Pre - Spellplague , the cantrip version required the caster to touch an object to make it glow like a torch , and the spell lasted for ten minutes to a few hours depending on the caster ' s prowess . For those that learned " light " as a first - level spell , it could be thrown 120 yards ( 110 m ) away and last one hour to many hours . The ranged version of this spell that could target an object allowed the caster a chance to blind a creature by successfully casting the spell centered on its visual organs .

title: Light Tube
description: Light Tube The Light Tube was an invention by Cadderly Bonaduce . Design . The tube itself was a foot - long cylinder two inches in diameter .
description_long: Light Tube The Light Tube was an invention by Cadderly Bonaduce . Design . The tube itself was a foot - long cylinder two inches in diameter . It consisted of two parts , with one end covered by a metal cap . A disk was inserted in the tube , which had been enchanted by Histra , a priestess of Sune , with a dweomer of light as bright as pure sunlight . Use . The metal cap on the tube shielded the light . When popped off , a focused beam of light was projected . The light beam can be adjusted by a twist of the upper part of the cylinder .

title: Light burst
description: Light burst Light burst weapons produced a blinding flash of light on a severe hit to the target . Creation . A spellcaster who wished to enchant a weapon with the " light burst " property had to have the " daylight " spell available .
description_long: Light burst Light burst weapons produced a blinding flash of light on a severe hit to the target . Creation . A spellcaster who wished to enchant a weapon with the " light burst " property had to have the " daylight " spell available . Activation . When a " light burst " weapon scored a severe hit , it unleashed a dazzling burst of light , leaving the unfortunate subject partially blind and dazed for approximately a minute . Those with particular sensitivity to light , such as drow or kobold s , also suffered the effects of a " daylight " spell for about six seconds , " then " had to endure being dazzled . The wielder of the weapon did not suffer the effects .

title: Light domain
description: Light domain The Light domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the aspect of light . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Light domain The Light domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the aspect of light . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Light hammer
description: Light hammer A light hammer is a light , martial melee weapon of the hammer family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . The light hammer is a small sledge hammer , usually with a haft made of wood about one and a half feet long ( 45cm ) .
description_long: Light hammer A light hammer is a light , martial melee weapon of the hammer family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . The light hammer is a small sledge hammer , usually with a haft made of wood about one and a half feet long ( 45cm ) . Later versions of this weapon added a pick on the back of the hammer head . An average light hammer costs 1gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . Classified as a light weapon , the light hammer can be used while grappling . Some training is required to use this weapon , especially for throwing , therefore it is considered a martial weapon . Normal maximum range of a light hammer is 100ft ( 30m ) . Realmslore . Light hammers are favored by dwarves . Other Editions . The 1st edition represents the light hammer ( called just " hammer " ) as both a melee and hurled weapon . The 2nd edition presents the " hammer " only as a missile weapon .

title: Light mace
description: Light mace A light mace is a simple melee weapon , much like a small club made from metal . Description . A light mace is little more than a metal club with flanges , knobs , or ridges of metal placed symmetrically around the head .
description_long: Light mace A light mace is a simple melee weapon , much like a small club made from metal . Description . A light mace is little more than a metal club with flanges , knobs , or ridges of metal placed symmetrically around the head . A light mace is slightly smaller than a short sword in length but about twice the weight , with much of the weight concentrated in the head . An average light mace costs 5gp and weighs 4lbs ( 1 . 8kg ) . Use . The mace is the natural development of the club and is made completely out of metal , making it a heavy but difficult to break weapon . This weapon is intended to be used one - handed and is simple enough for most character classes to use without any training . Mounted horsemen often use maces with slightly longer hafts to reach both mounted and unmounted opponents .

title: Light of Heavens
description: Light of Heavens Light of Heavens is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . During the evacuation of Neverwinter in Act III , the Kalach - Cha encountered the Light of Heavens in the Merchant ' s District , where the deva tried to get a feel for now - Knight - Captain of Crossroad Keep .
description_long: Light of Heavens Light of Heavens is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . During the evacuation of Neverwinter in Act III , the Kalach - Cha encountered the Light of Heavens in the Merchant ' s District , where the deva tried to get a feel for now - Knight - Captain of Crossroad Keep . She challenged the PC to a duel to test his / her resolve in the fight against the shadows . When the Kalach - Cha beat her , she leaves , but not before telling the PC that she will challenge him / her two more times . The Kalach - Cha and companions next encountered Light of Heavens at Port Llast , where she revealed how she got the name " Light of Heavens " . When she was born , the priests that delivered her exclaimed " light of heavens " ( for reasons not revealed ) , and they decided to name her that . She then challenged the Kalach - Cha again , this time using a larger portion of her strength . Again , the Kalach - Cha defeated her . Light of Heavens then made her way to Crossroad Keep . There she challenged the Kalach - Cha again , this time at full strength ; again , the hero bested her .

title: Light pick
description: Light pick A light pick is a smaller version of the heavy pick , classified as a light , martial melee weapon . Description . Similar to a modern day geologist ' s hammer , a light pick has a metal head with a thick , slightly curved spike backed by either a smaller spike or a hammer head .
description_long: Light pick A light pick is a smaller version of the heavy pick , classified as a light , martial melee weapon . Description . Similar to a modern day geologist ' s hammer , a light pick has a metal head with a thick , slightly curved spike backed by either a smaller spike or a hammer head . The haft is about 2 ft ( 60 cm ) long and made of wood or metal . An average light pick costs 4 gp and weighs 3 lb ( 1 . 4 kg ) . Weaponology . The light pick is also known as a footman ' s pick because they were wielded by infantry soldiers in hand to hand combat . Because this is a light weapon it can be used while grappling . Picks are intended to pierce plate armor but can get stuck if swung too hard . Some training is required to wield effectively , therefore the light pick is classified as a martial weapon . Notes . Other editions . The second edition player ' s handbook does not mention picks , but first edition and 3 . 5 edition do .

title: Lighten load
description: Lighten load Lighten load was an alteration spell that reduced the weight of burdens by half . Effects . This spell could be cast on a pile of non - magical objects — organic , inorganic , alive , or dead — and it temporarily reduced the weight of those objects by half .
description_long: Lighten load Lighten load was an alteration spell that reduced the weight of burdens by half . Effects . This spell could be cast on a pile of non - magical objects — organic , inorganic , alive , or dead — and it temporarily reduced the weight of those objects by half . Once the items were enchanted , they could be divvied up among separate carriers . Magic items were not affected by this spell . The pile of objects could be no bigger than a 10 ft ( 3 m ) cube , and the spell lasted for a few hours . More experienced priests could stretch it out for hours longer . No other physical property ( size , mass , strength , hardness , etc . ) of the objects was modified by this spell — it was as if gravity were cut in half for the affected objects . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , as well as a feather and a piece of paper moistened by a soap bubble .

title: Lightfoot halfling
description: Lightfoot halfling Lightfoot halflings are the most common type of halfling s seen in the world , in large part due to their famous wanderlust , which sets them apart from the relatively sedentary ghostwise and strongheart halfling s . Lightfoots are most comfortable living alongside other cultures , even adopting their cultural practices , right down to their deities . Physical characteristics .
description_long: Lightfoot halfling Lightfoot halflings are the most common type of halfling s seen in the world , in large part due to their famous wanderlust , which sets them apart from the relatively sedentary ghostwise and strongheart halfling s . Lightfoots are most comfortable living alongside other cultures , even adopting their cultural practices , right down to their deities . Physical characteristics . A typical lightfoot halfling stands around four feet tall and weighs around 80 pounds . Their skin colors range from light pink to slightly reddish or bronze , and their hair color is typically auburn , brown or black . Males usually wear their hair short on the sides , often with a mullet or bowl cut . Facial hair among males is rare except for extremely old halflings . Females rarely allow their hair to grow beyond shoulder length . When not adventuring or entertaining others , halflings prefer simple , well - made clothes that are comfortable to wear yet look attractive . Psychology . The impression a lightfoot halfling always tries to project is that of a mirthful , friendly individual who is always interested in making new friends .

title: Lightning Dragon Dojo
description: Lightning Dragon Dojo The Lightning Dragon Dojo was a martial arts academy founded by the Shou Duc - Sum Li . The school was located in the Shou district of Xiousing in Marsember and was named after Master Li ' s fighting style . When Li became too old to spar , his son Chang Li took over operation of the dojo .
description_long: Lightning Dragon Dojo The Lightning Dragon Dojo was a martial arts academy founded by the Shou Duc - Sum Li . The school was located in the Shou district of Xiousing in Marsember and was named after Master Li ' s fighting style . When Li became too old to spar , his son Chang Li took over operation of the dojo . Shou from all over Faerûn traveled to the dojo to learn from Li .

title: Lightning bolt
description: Lightning bolt Lightning bolt was an evocation spell that caused arcs of lightning to emanate from the caster ' s fingertips . Effects . The searing bolt of electricity traveled in a straight line emanating from the caster .
description_long: Lightning bolt Lightning bolt was an evocation spell that caused arcs of lightning to emanate from the caster ' s fingertips . Effects . The searing bolt of electricity traveled in a straight line emanating from the caster . Older versions of this spell struck all in its path , while newer versions were aimed at a particular creature and then , with skill , could be forked to hit one or two other creatures . The bolt from the older versions was powerful enough to blast a wooden door to cinders , set fire to combustible materials , splinter a hand - depth of stone , or melt soft metals such as gold , silver , copper , lead , or bronze . Components . Older versions of this spell required verbal , somatic , and material components including a tuft of fur and a small rod made of amber , crystal , or glass . To inscribe this spell on a magic scroll , arcane scribes often used ink made from the horn of a behir . Notable uses . The wizard Parwyyd Hanifar used a forked version of " lightning bolt " to blast a number of kenku s and gargoyles in aerial combat in 1357 DR .

title: Lightning breath
description: Lightning breath Lightning breath is a spell used by many sorcerer s , most often dragon sorcerer s . When a sorcerer casts " lightning breath " they exhale a blast of electrically charged air , injuring nearby foes , more so if the sorcerer is a dragon sorcerer . Regardless of whether or not the attack succeeds , " lightning breath " forces back any foes caught within its blast zone , which is roughly fifteen feet in diameter , a distance of five feet .
description_long: Lightning breath Lightning breath is a spell used by many sorcerer s , most often dragon sorcerer s . When a sorcerer casts " lightning breath " they exhale a blast of electrically charged air , injuring nearby foes , more so if the sorcerer is a dragon sorcerer . Regardless of whether or not the attack succeeds , " lightning breath " forces back any foes caught within its blast zone , which is roughly fifteen feet in diameter , a distance of five feet . If the sorcerer focuses , they may be able to maintain this repelling force even after the lightning itself stops . The spell is not one that comes easily and " lightning breath " can only be cast once per day .

title: Lightning clash
description: Lightning clash Lightning clash is a somewhat basic spell of the evocation school used by several inexperienced swordmage s . When a swordmage casts " lightning clash " a bolt of rippling electrical energy sprouts from a creature struck by their sword , leaping through the air to strike another creature within twenty - five feet of the original target . Like most swordmage spells the precise power of the lightning ' s charge depends upon the swordmage ' s mental processing power .
description_long: Lightning clash Lightning clash is a somewhat basic spell of the evocation school used by several inexperienced swordmage s . When a swordmage casts " lightning clash " a bolt of rippling electrical energy sprouts from a creature struck by their sword , leaping through the air to strike another creature within twenty - five feet of the original target . Like most swordmage spells the precise power of the lightning ' s charge depends upon the swordmage ' s mental processing power . " Lightning clash " is relatively easy to cast and requires only a few minutes of rest in order to be recharged .

title: Lightning lure
description: Lightning lure Lightning lure is among the most basic swordmage spell s , used most commonly by shielding swordmage s . When cast " lightning lure " lashes a creature of the swordmage ' s choosing within fifteen feet with a whip - like bolt of painful lightning , which the swordmage can use to pull the target towards them . " Lightning lure " does not work , however , if there is no clear path between the swordmage and his or her target .
description_long: Lightning lure Lightning lure is among the most basic swordmage spell s , used most commonly by shielding swordmage s . When cast " lightning lure " lashes a creature of the swordmage ' s choosing within fifteen feet with a whip - like bolt of painful lightning , which the swordmage can use to pull the target towards them . " Lightning lure " does not work , however , if there is no clear path between the swordmage and his or her target . The spell , which relies , like virtually all swordmage spells , upon its caster ' s intellect for power , increases in deadliness as the swordmage gains more experience . As a very basic and easy to learn spell , " lightning lure " can be cast at will .

title: Lights in the Dark
description: Lights in the Dark Lights in the Dark was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Located on the edge of the bazaar , this shop was easily noticed due to the variety of colored lanterns that were lit every day at dusk .
description_long: Lights in the Dark Lights in the Dark was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Located on the edge of the bazaar , this shop was easily noticed due to the variety of colored lanterns that were lit every day at dusk . Activities . This shop sold lanterns and lamps . Their specialty revolved around illumination devices that gave off different colors . Red and blues were recommended to enhance romance , business transactions required yellow or white , green for religious events , and either purple or mauve for meals . Inhabitants . Korat Minial owned and operated this establishment .

title: Liham
description: Liham Liham , located at the mouth of the Al - Sari River , was the most southerly of Zakhara ' s Free Cities " circa " 1367 DR . It also lay nearest to powerful Qudra , which , together with the presence of several mamluk units , gave the larger city enormous influence on Liham ' s politics . The large military led to the title " City of Soldiers " , but it was also called Liham the Red , because the citizens enjoyed wearing clothing in various shades of crimson .
description_long: Liham Liham , located at the mouth of the Al - Sari River , was the most southerly of Zakhara ' s Free Cities " circa " 1367 DR . It also lay nearest to powerful Qudra , which , together with the presence of several mamluk units , gave the larger city enormous influence on Liham ' s politics . The large military led to the title " City of Soldiers " , but it was also called Liham the Red , because the citizens enjoyed wearing clothing in various shades of crimson .

title: Lilarcor
description: Lilarcor Lilarcor was a sword in the " " computer role - playing game . As an enchanted talking sword , it serves as a , with its various wisecracking comments , as well as its insatible thirst for blood , battle , and glory . History .
description_long: Lilarcor Lilarcor was a sword in the " " computer role - playing game . As an enchanted talking sword , it serves as a , with its various wisecracking comments , as well as its insatible thirst for blood , battle , and glory . History . Its backstory refers to an exceptionally stupid man named Lawrence Lilarcor who once fought an " epic " battle against a tree he thought to be an evil treant ; it is said to be suspected , but not confirmed , that his spirit has been transferred into the sword . Physical description . According to the Gamespy interview , Minsc has said that his preferred weapon is one that actually enjoys fighting evil as much as Minsc , Lilarcor ( although Lilarcor simply enjoys fighting , period ) . Lilarcor will only talk if he is wielded by a character , or alternately if a character asks him for advice . It is voiced by . Lilarcor can be found in the sewers of Athkatla , in a section accessed from the Copper Coronet ( or the slaver compound in the slums ) . It is found after solving a riddle whose creator is not made clear .

title: Lilianviaten Dlardrageth
description: Lilianviaten Dlardrageth Lilianviaten Dlardrageth , who usually went by Lilten , was a gold elf , Beshaba ' s high priest and chosen , a Masked Lord of Waterdeep , and last prince of House Dlardrageth . He resided in Waterdeep . He took a fiend ( possibly a fey ' ri ) as a mate and she bore him a daughter named Fayne .
description_long: Lilianviaten Dlardrageth Lilianviaten Dlardrageth , who usually went by Lilten , was a gold elf , Beshaba ' s high priest and chosen , a Masked Lord of Waterdeep , and last prince of House Dlardrageth . He resided in Waterdeep . He took a fiend ( possibly a fey ' ri ) as a mate and she bore him a daughter named Fayne . History . Lilten was formerly a cleric of Erevan Ilesere , a deity of the Seldarine . At some point , he betrayed his god and began worshiping Beshaba , possibly because Ereven lost his power during the Spellplague . Around the beginning of the 15th century DR , Lilten became involved with a demoness and she produced a tiefling daughter whom they called Fayne . An eladrin named Ilira Nathalan , who happened to be Lilten ' s estranged wife , tracked down Lilten ' s demon lover and killed her , permanently scarring Fayne in the process . Waterdeep . In 1479 DR , Lilten became aware of a young wizard named Myrin Darkdance , who had a very powerful spellscar . He enlisted the help of his daughter Fayne and hired a dwarven monk named Rath to kidnap her . Lilten ' s plot was foiled by the paladin Kalen Dren , though Lilten ' s involvement wasn ' t discovered . Luskan .

title: Lilinuk
description: Lilinuk Lilinuk was the largest settlement on the Great Glacier . Geography . Lilinuk was located on a plateau south of the Nakalpgotak Sea , about 150 feet ( 46 meters ) above the shore , and west of the Novularond mountains .
description_long: Lilinuk Lilinuk was the largest settlement on the Great Glacier . Geography . Lilinuk was located on a plateau south of the Nakalpgotak Sea , about 150 feet ( 46 meters ) above the shore , and west of the Novularond mountains . Description . Access to the village was afforded by a series of ramps of ice that spiraled up to the top of the plateau on which the village was built . North of the plateau , at the shore of the sea within a bay , the village maintained a small fleet of kayaks and larger " umiaks " . Pens made of ice blocks held herds of caribou and muskoxen for food . Everything in Lilinuk was meticulously kept in good condition . Even snowhouse s were rebuilt every year . The villagers stored a year ' s worth of food in pits in the ice . Even the dogs and kupuk lived in relative luxury , having their own snowhouses , called " jititip " , in which to live . The center of the village was a large area with space dedicated for the yearly " sukkiruchit " festival . It included five communal feasting houses ( " quaggi " ) and a large two - domed " rewqugi " , where visitors could warm themselves by fire . Government .

title: Lilit Pass
description: Lilit Pass Lilit Pass was the name of a narrow chasm in the Aphrunn Mountains . It led from the Halondar to Daroush . History .
description_long: Lilit Pass Lilit Pass was the name of a narrow chasm in the Aphrunn Mountains . It led from the Halondar to Daroush . History . In 145 DR , a small segment of the army of Dempster Turmish accidentally took Lilit Pass and ended up in Daroush . The confused troops captured the village with ease .

title: Lilith
description: Lilith Lilith was a member of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . Personality . Lilith was a quick - witted individual who used humor to disarm others ' mistrust .
description_long: Lilith Lilith was a member of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . Personality . Lilith was a quick - witted individual who used humor to disarm others ' mistrust . History . In 1489 DR , Lilith was the Zhentarim delegate sent to help a hired adventuring party to defeat the great dragon Claugiyliamatar of Kryptgarden Forest . The Zhentarim ' s main objectives were to investigate some Red Wizards of Thay inside the new faction of the Cult of the Dragon , recover stolen cargo , and to stop a possible alliance of the fey lords of the forest with hobgoblin s . Lilith revealed that a recently joined cultist , Yalek Snurd , was a Zhent spy .

title: Lily Pad Inn
description: Lily Pad Inn The Lily Pad Inn was a three - story floating inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember , owned by the Shou known as Shiau Chen . The inn was built on a floating platform on the large pond known as the Zhao . Chen ran a rickshaw service out of the inn .
description_long: Lily Pad Inn The Lily Pad Inn was a three - story floating inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember , owned by the Shou known as Shiau Chen . The inn was built on a floating platform on the large pond known as the Zhao . Chen ran a rickshaw service out of the inn . Food . Among other dishes , the inn served fried vegetable rolls , boiled dumplings and duck - stuffed sweet buns . Drink . The inn offered hot tea free of charge to all its patrons . Entertainment . The inn was the performance venue of the renowned Shou twins Ping and Ling Chiang . Ping played a string instrument known as the erhu and Ling performed a fan dance .

title: Limbo
description: Limbo Limbo was an Outer plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model that embodied the chaotic neutral alignment . The plane of Warrior ' s Rest in the World Tree cosmology was similar to Limbo in many ways but not quite as morphic . The batrachi formed a realm in Limbo called the Supreme Throne which became its own plane in the World Tree cosmology model .
description_long: Limbo Limbo was an Outer plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model that embodied the chaotic neutral alignment . The plane of Warrior ' s Rest in the World Tree cosmology was similar to Limbo in many ways but not quite as morphic . The batrachi formed a realm in Limbo called the Supreme Throne which became its own plane in the World Tree cosmology model . Limbo was lost during the Spellplague and may have fallen into the Elemental Chaos . Description . This plane was supreme chaos , a twisting , quicksilver place filled with bits and pieces of rocks , trees , the four elements , entire landscapes , strong winds , and random pockets of liquid , solid , or gas . Sentient beings could dampen down the chaos to livable levels and produce a safe environment as long as they maintained concentration . The size of a safe zone was directly related to the intelligence of the individual controller . Demigod s and more powerful beings did not have this burden and indeed could create realms that survived even if they left Limbo . Gravity operated only between solid objects that touched each other and had about the same strength as on most Prime Material Plane s .

title: Limited wish
description: Limited wish Limited wish is a universal spell that alters reality , within limits . Effect . With the restriction that the effects listed must be of decreasing power than the one listed before it , the possible effects the caster can create with a " limited wish " spell are to : duplicate a moderately - powerful sorcerer or wizard spell , provided they have experience casting spells from that school of magic ; duplicate any non - sorcerer or - wizard spell , with the same restriction ; duplicate any sorcerer or wizard spell from any school of magic ; or duplicate the effects of any type of spell .
description_long: Limited wish Limited wish is a universal spell that alters reality , within limits . Effect . With the restriction that the effects listed must be of decreasing power than the one listed before it , the possible effects the caster can create with a " limited wish " spell are to : duplicate a moderately - powerful sorcerer or wizard spell , provided they have experience casting spells from that school of magic ; duplicate any non - sorcerer or - wizard spell , with the same restriction ; duplicate any sorcerer or wizard spell from any school of magic ; or duplicate the effects of any type of spell . If the spell duplicated requires a material component , the caster must provide that component . " Limited wish " can also be used to undo the harmful effects of many other spells , such as " geas / quest " or " insanity " .

title: Lin Kwan Shu
description: Lin Kwan Shu Lin Kwan Shu was a famous female martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Lin Kwan Shu was a woman living in the city of Ping Chow in Wang Kuo province .
description_long: Lin Kwan Shu Lin Kwan Shu was a famous female martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Lin Kwan Shu was a woman living in the city of Ping Chow in Wang Kuo province . She was the master of the Five Stars School , which she taught in the back of a bathhouse . Her style of martial art was very adaptable for young women and was based on five styles of movements . Lin Kwan Shu accepted only students who were brought in by a previous high - level student . The final test of a Five Star student was incredibly simple in theory : they only needed to pluck a shiny blue stone from the Master ' s open palm . Very few passed the exam . Description . Lin Kwan Shu was a slender woman with startling blue eyes , a trait inherited from an ancestor from Faerûn .

title: Linal Alprin
description: Linal Alprin Linal Alprin was the harbormaster of the city of Tantras in the Vast during the Time of Troubles . History . Alprin was a good man and an efficient city worker , married to Moira .
description_long: Linal Alprin Linal Alprin was the harbormaster of the city of Tantras in the Vast during the Time of Troubles . History . Alprin was a good man and an efficient city worker , married to Moira . However , in 1358 , he sensed that something was bad in the high spheres of the city ' s council and the church of the god Torm beause one of his friends , who had asked too many questions , disappeared in the night . Alprin lived in fear that he would meet the same end . Later , Alprin met and befriend the hero Kelemvor Lyonsbane , just arrived in the city searching for the Tablets of Fate . He gave a lot of information to Kelemvor and hinted about his suspicions . When Kelemvor came back to his house , he found Alprin and his wife dead with their house in flames .

title: Linan Swift
description: Linan Swift Linan Swift was a human female commoner in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personality . As a mother , Linan would fight to the death to save her children and her husband .
description_long: Linan Swift Linan Swift was a human female commoner in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personality . As a mother , Linan would fight to the death to save her children and her husband . Possessions . To protect her children , Swift was known to fight with a round shield and a worn spear . History . Around 1489 DR during a battle with the Cult of the Dragon in the Tyranny of Dragons , Linan , her husband Cuth Swift , and their children were pursued by some kobold s until they were saved by some adventurers . After the fight , the commoners asked to be taken to the safety of the Keep .

title: Line of protection
description: Line of protection Line of protection was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a field of force between two or more priests , or two or more stationary objects , that harmed all creatures passing through it , particularly evil and undead creatures . The reverse of this spell , line of destruction , was particularly painful to paladin s and good - aligned creatures . Effects .
description_long: Line of protection Line of protection was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a field of force between two or more priests , or two or more stationary objects , that harmed all creatures passing through it , particularly evil and undead creatures . The reverse of this spell , line of destruction , was particularly painful to paladin s and good - aligned creatures . Effects . Two or more priests were required to cast this spell and had to decide during casting if the effect would be stationary or movable . If stationary , each priest drew a magical sigil on facing surfaces ; opposite walls , two tree trunks , or facing supports of an arch or portcullis , for example . If the effect was to be mobile , then each priest became an endpoint ( or an intermediate point , like a fence post ) of the field of force . The distance between two adjacent sigils or priests was a maximum of 90 ft ( 27 . 4 m ) , and once cast , could not be shortened or lengthened , forming a piecewise linear barrier . The shimmering , translucent field of force extended from the ground to a height of 10 ft ( 3 . 1 m ) and made objects on the other side hazy and indistinct .

title: Ling Li Te Hsin
description: Ling Li Te Hsin Ling Li Te Hsin was a famous martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Ling Li worked as a cartographer for the Ministry of Public Works in Kuo Te ' Shou .
description_long: Ling Li Te Hsin Ling Li Te Hsin was a famous martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Ling Li worked as a cartographer for the Ministry of Public Works in Kuo Te ' Shou . He was also the master of the Iron Hand School , where he taught his personal style of martial art , assisted by his numerous relatives and disciples . Ling Li accepted only students who had previously mastered another form of kung fu and his training was very hard in order to made the body as hard as iron . Despite this , fighting was consider the last resort for Ling Li , as martial arts were a way of personal betterment .

title: Linu La ' neral
description: Linu La ' neral Linu La ' neral was a female moon elf cleric of the elven goddess Sehanine Moonbow . She hailed from the city of Evereska . Linu was clumsy ( some said unfortunate ) , often causing accidents in her wake .
description_long: Linu La ' neral Linu La ' neral was a female moon elf cleric of the elven goddess Sehanine Moonbow . She hailed from the city of Evereska . Linu was clumsy ( some said unfortunate ) , often causing accidents in her wake . She had a somewhat naive worldview but was well liked by many people for her constantly positive outlook and her kindheartedness to others . She had a great deal of humorous lines and stories , including how she met her ( later deceased ) husband . Appendix . Gameplay . Linu was the easiest male romance option in " Neverwinter Nights " , as long as the player completes her quests and helps her discover what happened to her husband ( who died in a cave near Neverwinter ) . She could also become attached to player characters in the first chapter of " " . She reappeared as a quest - giver in the " Tyranny of Dragons " expansion of the " Neverwinter " MMORPG , assisting the player in the defense of Toril against the evil dragon deity Tiamat . She also participates in the final battle .

title: Lion
description: Lion Lions were powerful feline predators that traveled and hunted in large groups , known as prides . Male lions had large manes of golden fur . They were responsible for defending the pride against any attackers .
description_long: Lion Lions were powerful feline predators that traveled and hunted in large groups , known as prides . Male lions had large manes of golden fur . They were responsible for defending the pride against any attackers . Female lions , who had no manes , were the hunters of the pride . They used group tactics to hunt and provide food for the entire pride . Description . A male lion was 5 to 8 feet long and weighed 330 to 550 pounds . Females were slightly smaller . Culture . The symbol of a lion was used in heraldry across the Realms . It was used in organization names , such as the Army of the Lion of Aglarond ) and the Tribe of the Black Lion of Beorunna ' s Well ) . The golden lion served as the currency of Cormyr . Numerous locations in Faerûn were named after lions : Nobanion was considered the deity of lions .

title: Lion ' s Mouth
description: Lion ' s Mouth The Lion ' s Mouth was a secret ritual held in the Lion ' s Shrine of the fortress of Sarahin . History . Holy slayer s of the Everlasting undertook this ritual to prove their courage to their superiors .
description_long: Lion ' s Mouth The Lion ' s Mouth was a secret ritual held in the Lion ' s Shrine of the fortress of Sarahin . History . Holy slayer s of the Everlasting undertook this ritual to prove their courage to their superiors . The ritual occurred in a pit housing a fully - grown lioness , though the exact nature and events of the ritual were a secret .

title: Lion ' s Shrine
description: Lion ' s Shrine The Lion ' s Shrine was a mosque dedicated to Hajama that was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Lion ' s Shrine was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .
description_long: Lion ' s Shrine The Lion ' s Shrine was a mosque dedicated to Hajama that was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Lion ' s Shrine was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin . Description . This mosque of Hajama , and the surrounding minarets , were decorated with beautiful green tile . A pair of griffon statues sat on either side of the main stair leading to the shrine ' s entrance . Farouk Abd al - Bazan stored his gritty phoenix powder poison within a hidden compartment located under the wing of the northernmost statue . While invisible , he checked on his cache daily to make sure it was secure . A lion pit housing a grown lioness stood in the courtyard of the mosque . The pit was the site of the Lion ' s Mouth , a test of courage for holy slayers . The main altar of the mosque held the Heart of the Lion , the most cherished relic of the Everlasting . Activities . Daily prayers were held at the Lion ' s Shrine . The sacred texts of Hajama were stored within , but only the most devout of holy slayer s were allowed to enter . Guards from the Courageous were stationed at the entrance at all times to prevent intruders .

title: Liongirt Tower
description: Liongirt Tower Liongirt Tower was the home of Onsilur Maerdrathom , a Magister during the 4th century DR . Location . The tower was located in the capital of Lapaliiya , Sheirtalar .
description_long: Liongirt Tower Liongirt Tower was the home of Onsilur Maerdrathom , a Magister during the 4th century DR . Location . The tower was located in the capital of Lapaliiya , Sheirtalar . Description . Walled gardens surrounded the tower . Hungry lion s prowled the gardens at all times . Defenses . Liongirt Tower was guarded by many magical wards , as dozens of unfortunate wizards discovered when they tried to raid the tower after Onsilur ' s disappearance . Hidden " teleport " links and random spell - triggers were scattered throughout the tower . The entire tower actually crumbled when the central library was finally breached .

title: Lions ' Dynasty
description: Lions ' Dynasty The Lions ' Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr . It was largely to blame for the political instability and chaos leading up to the Tethyrian Interregnum period . Dynastic Seal .
description_long: Lions ' Dynasty The Lions ' Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr . It was largely to blame for the political instability and chaos leading up to the Tethyrian Interregnum period . Dynastic Seal . The symbol and name of the dynasty derive from a tale told in which Prince Nearel used a magic horn to summon a pack of sea cat s , or " sea lions " , to defend against a band of assassins that where pursuing him . History . The dynasty was established in 959 DR by Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded , when he took the throne from King Teremir I of the Bormul Dynasty by force . Mhoaran was succeeded by his seventeenth son Nearel , and afterwards by Kortal , Haedrak I , Coram I , and Coram II . The line of rule was briefly interrupted in 1070 DR , when Teremir II of the Bormul Dynasty slew Coram II in a duel and briefly reestablished the Bormul ' s on the throne . When Alemander I killed Teremir II the next year , power returned to the Lions ' Dynasty . In 1145 DR , Coram III , Alemander ' s great - grandson , officially changed the family ' s name from " House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul " to simply " House Tethyr " . Alemander II and Coram IV followed in line .

title: Lionshields
description: Lionshields The Lionshields were a merchant company based in the fortified city of Yartar in the Savage Frontier . The Lionshields ' symbol was a blue lion painted on a wooden shield . The merchant company were able to ship finished goods , such as supplies of armor and weapons , to small settlements and towns all throughout the northwestern region of Faerûn .
description_long: Lionshields The Lionshields were a merchant company based in the fortified city of Yartar in the Savage Frontier . The Lionshields ' symbol was a blue lion painted on a wooden shield . The merchant company were able to ship finished goods , such as supplies of armor and weapons , to small settlements and towns all throughout the northwestern region of Faerûn . One such settlement was the newly settled frontier town of Phandalin near the Triboar Trail and the Sword Mountains , however the outpost was hit hard by banditry .

title: Lipo
description: Lipo Lipo was a yikarian city located along the coast of Pearl Bay near the edge of Zakhara ' s northern border in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Lipo was the seat of power for the Coral Princess , the yikarian governor of the Sun ' s Eye province .
description_long: Lipo Lipo was a yikarian city located along the coast of Pearl Bay near the edge of Zakhara ' s northern border in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Lipo was the seat of power for the Coral Princess , the yikarian governor of the Sun ' s Eye province . The city received many pilgrims eager to commune with the Faceless God at the Shrine of the Jade Monolith , or at least to have a yak - men intercede on their behalf . Activities . Given Lipo ' s distance from the heart of the Yikarian Empire , and their closer proximity to other cultures , the yak - folk of Lipo were not viewed with as much disdain as their mountainous brethren . Because of this , Lipo was able to trade freely with barbarians from the north and other traders sailing the Great Sea . Lipo also served as the only naval base for the Empire , docking just five ships . Despite its size , the yikarian navy was quite powerful . They patrolled the coastal waters for smugglers and transported their kin to the barbarian lands to the north , as well as to secret locations along the coast of the Free Cities of Zakhara and as far south as Qudra .

title: Liquid earth
description: Liquid earth Liquid earth was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Liquid earth Liquid earth was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell turned a hemisphere of any earth - like substance into a thick fog . Any creature that was not a native of the Elemental Plane of Earth could move through this fog as if moving through water . The spell also allowed creatures passing through the fog to breathe normally . It should be noted that this spell did not create any light , so if cast deep underground , the fog area would be utterly dark unless an additional light source was provided . The hemisphere created by this spell had a 15 foot ( 4 . 5 m ) radius . It lasted several hours depending on the skill of the caster . Components . In addition to verbal components , this spell required a bent tube of nickel that was worth 100 gold to cast .

title: Lirela Drumsinger
description: Lirela Drumsinger Lirela Drumsinger was a human woman from the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a bard and a member of the Harper s . History .
description_long: Lirela Drumsinger Lirela Drumsinger was a human woman from the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a bard and a member of the Harper s . History . Lirela was a daughter of a respected merchant family of Procampur . Her parents ' coster transported goods from Mulmaster in the north , by road through the Vast , and then across the Sea of Fallen Stars . Lirella was well - loved by her parents , and displayed an early music al talent . Not long after turning 12 , Lirela happily joined her father and older siblings on a trading expedition to Mulmaster , and was inspired by the itinerant bards they met on the way . However , in Mulmaster , her parents refused to accept an unfair deal that would harm both them and fellow Procampan merchants . By making this stand , they offended some powerful and dangerous people in Mulmaster , including a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak . Therefore , the Mulmasterite merchants decided to make an example of them . On the way back , barely a day out from Mulmaster , a powerful wizard and a horde of bandits assaulted the family caravan , killing the guards by spell or blade in seconds before slaying the rest .

title: Liriel Baenre
description: Liriel Baenre Liriel Baenre ( born Liriel Vandree ) was a rogue drow mage , fighter , and magic user trained by Gromph Baenre the Archmage of Menzoberranzan who was a noble of House Baenre , the first house of Menzoberranzan . She was forced to flee Menzoberranzan when she obtained the Windwalker amulet and began traveling with Fyodor . Description .
description_long: Liriel Baenre Liriel Baenre ( born Liriel Vandree ) was a rogue drow mage , fighter , and magic user trained by Gromph Baenre the Archmage of Menzoberranzan who was a noble of House Baenre , the first house of Menzoberranzan . She was forced to flee Menzoberranzan when she obtained the Windwalker amulet and began traveling with Fyodor . Description . Liriel was described as slender and delicate , with a height of 5 feet 3 inches ( 1 . 60 m ) . Like most drow , she had black skin and thick white hair . Her eyes were unusual - - the color of amber - - and revealed her intelligence and fondness for mischief . Her face was expressive and often flickered from one emotion to the next . She was described as one of the most beautiful drow females in Menzoberranzan . In Menzoberranzan , she was fond of fancy dresses . In Skullport , she wore a piwafwi , tight black leathers and black chainmail . Personality . Liriel had a sardonic and witty personality , with a fondness for practical jokes . The rare moments where she adopts a serious demeanour is when she is in combat and is forced to become a deadly warrior - mage . Abilities .

title: Lisa Smedman
description: Lisa Smedman Lisa Smedman is the author of several novels and co - author of many sourcebooks . She has had a number of short science fiction and fantasy stories published in various magazines and anthologies , and has had two of her plays produced . In 1993 she was a finalist in the Writers of the Future contest .
description_long: Lisa Smedman Lisa Smedman is the author of several novels and co - author of many sourcebooks . She has had a number of short science fiction and fantasy stories published in various magazines and anthologies , and has had two of her plays produced . In 1993 she was a finalist in the Writers of the Future contest . Formerly a magazine editor , she now splits her week between working as a reporter / editor at a weekly newspaper and writing fiction . When not working or gaming , she enjoys hiking and camping with a women ' s outdoor club and collects stamps that illustrate the space race . She lives in Vancouver with her partner and spends much of her time catering to the needs of their " blended family " of cats .

title: Lissa
description: Lissa Lissa was a cleric of Lathander at the temples to Lathander in both Elturel and Ankhapur . She became an ally of Pinch . Personality .
description_long: Lissa Lissa was a cleric of Lathander at the temples to Lathander in both Elturel and Ankhapur . She became an ally of Pinch . Personality . Lissa was a good person but very gullible . History . In 1366 DR , she was tasked with the mission of recovering a recently stolen artifact , the " Amulet of the Dawnbreaker " . Lissa followed clues of the thief to Ankhapur , where Pinch convinced her that he ' d found the amulet . Lissa was decisive in the defeat of the lich Manferic III , thanks to her powers .

title: Lissa ( Red Plumes )
description: Lissa ( Red Plumes ) Lissa was a member of the Red Plumes in the Moonsea . Activities . Lissa was one of the soldiers assigned to the garrison in the Waydown .
description_long: Lissa ( Red Plumes ) Lissa was a member of the Red Plumes in the Moonsea . Activities . Lissa was one of the soldiers assigned to the garrison in the Waydown . Secretly , she was also an agent of the Lords ' Alliance . History . During the Rage of Demons , a wizard named Olon disappeared inside the Waydown and Lords ' Alliance asked Lissa to investigate . Possibly , she gained the help of an adventuring party in disguise hired by Felratha and Arrizz . At last the adventurers discovered that Olon was killed by some albino giant octopus .

description: List of armor This is a list of armors that were non - magical and common in the realms . For a collection of unique sets of armor and magical armors see . List of armors .

title: List of minor Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide characters
description: List of minor Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide characters A list of minor characters appearing in " " . Belpheron . Belpheron was a fearsome lich .
description_long: List of minor Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide characters A list of minor characters appearing in " " . Belpheron . Belpheron was a fearsome lich . His mummified hand somehow ended up in the posession of Drogan Droganson , and was stolen by a band of kobold s for the dragon Tymofarrar . The hand had the ability to point to other artifacts of power . Isande . Isande was an elven warrior of Ascalhorn who was buried in a crypt near the village Hilltop . At one point , his sword was stolen from his grave , leaving the weakened spirit of Isande in a state of unrest . Kipper . Kipper is , along with , the second in command ( being the leader ) of the kobold s who attacked Hilltop in 1372 DR on mission from . Nilmaldor . Nilmaldor was a Knight - Gallant of Ascalhorn . After his death , Nimaldor ' s spirit guarded the Ascalhorn crypt in which he was buried , and even fought and defeated a wraith at one point , although this weakened him greatly . No longer able to guard the crypt , it was soon overrun by rat s and giant spider s . Urko . Urko is the leader of the kobold s who attacked Hilltop in 1372 DR on order from .

title: Litchi fruit
description: Litchi fruit Litchi was an exotic fruit from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " Description . The unusual fruit was very sweet and tender and was usually served in the courts of Shou Lung .
description_long: Litchi fruit Litchi was an exotic fruit from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " Description . The unusual fruit was very sweet and tender and was usually served in the courts of Shou Lung . When purchased through " Aurora ' s " , litchi could be ordered either in dried form , resembling Imnescarian date s , or preserved in syrup , in order to retain some of its fresh properties .

title: Lithocentric pendulum
description: Lithocentric pendulum Lithocentric pendulums were simple magic item s used to navigate on the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . This device was a simple string with a stone attached to one end .
description_long: Lithocentric pendulum Lithocentric pendulums were simple magic item s used to navigate on the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . This device was a simple string with a stone attached to one end . Powers . When held and spun while on the Elemental Plane of Earth , this item would move briefly before pointing in the direction of the Sevenfold Mazework . This item was useless while within the Sevenfold Mazework or on any other plane of existence .

title: Liticia Gos
description: Liticia Gos Liticia Gos was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Liticia was a very naive girl .
description_long: Liticia Gos Liticia Gos was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Liticia was a very naive girl . She loved the greatest , newest thing and believed that " newer " was always a synonym for " better " . She had a bad relationship with her older brother Garwyl Gos . Relationships . Liticia was the daughter of Lord Ninyon Gos and sister of Garwyl Gos and mad Andrik Gos . She spent most of her time with her two best friends , Stefan Rowick and Rahaiel Kakulska . Liticia also often stayed with other noble scions : Elred Korsinchev and Orym Illustriana . History . With her noble friends , she spent time first with the Theorists , and later fell under the control of Thylius Caramitru and the Yellow Breath philosophy . She ran away from home to live in the Yellow Breath Chapter House , where she became Thylius ' s first disciple . At last , she was found and subdued by an adventuring party hired by her brother .

title: Little Erik
description: Little Erik Little Erik was a bandit thug in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Erik believed that a hag had cursed him and he would die when he heard a screeching cry .
description_long: Little Erik Little Erik was a bandit thug in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Erik believed that a hag had cursed him and he would die when he heard a screeching cry . Thus tis sound often paralyzed him fear . History . Little Erik was one of the two lieutenants of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek . During a meeting with another bandit group , the Claws of Tiamat , an adventuring party hired to clean the Iron Route of outlaws caused havoc and in fighting Little Erik was killed .

title: Little Fox
description: Little Fox The Little Fox was the youngest member of the Seven Sages inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Little Fox was appointed to govern the Ghost Leopard province in the northwest region of the Yikarian Empire .
description_long: Little Fox The Little Fox was the youngest member of the Seven Sages inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Little Fox was appointed to govern the Ghost Leopard province in the northwest region of the Yikarian Empire . Her close ties with a multitude of marrashi eyries allowed her to easily monitor all traffic through the foothills of the River Ruin .

title: Little Stone Bridge
description: Little Stone Bridge The Little Stone Bridge was found just outside of the city of Manass in Khazari . Description . The bridge straddled a small river that flowed by Manass on the south and west sides of the city , allowing road access to Manass from the west .
description_long: Little Stone Bridge The Little Stone Bridge was found just outside of the city of Manass in Khazari . Description . The bridge straddled a small river that flowed by Manass on the south and west sides of the city , allowing road access to Manass from the west . Rumors & Legends . Natives of Manass believed that a powerful oni used to live beneath the bridge . The oni would attack any travelers crossing the bridge during the cover of darkness . Tsikapasmatra was believed to have defeated the oni in combat . The oni ' s treasure was rumored to be buried somewhere near the bridge , but was never discovered . However , this did not stop the locals of Manass from selling treasure maps for the area .

title: Little Wing
description: Little Wing Little Wing was an assassin member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Moonsea . Personality . Little Wing was a merciless servant of the Prince of Evil Aerial Creatures .
description_long: Little Wing Little Wing was an assassin member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Moonsea . Personality . Little Wing was a merciless servant of the Prince of Evil Aerial Creatures . He delighted in taunting his enemies during combat . In his madness , Little Wing believed that he hosted inside himself the spirit of a great roc so that it may continue its hunt . History . Once in Kara - Tur , Little Wing was one of a shogun ' s deadliest ninja assassins . All changed when a giant roc ate him whole , and then died with him trapped inside its gut . When Little Wing believed he would die , Yan - C - Bin appeared in front of him and offered a warlock ' s pact . Thus he survived and became the leader of the assassins of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . In 1491 DR , after many schemes in Mulmaster were ruined , the high leaders of the cult decided to send Little Wing and his assassins to wipe out Aleksi Drejkov ' s cell . He first killed Niko Sevek . Afterward , he murdered the Cloak Zel Tregarthen , who was close to discovering the cell . The City Watch falsely accused an adventuring party — who at that time were being interrogated by Zel — of committing the crime .

title: Liveoak
description: Liveoak Liveoak was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned one nearby oak tree into a treant guardian . Effects . The tree to be transformed had to be alive and healthy and preferably of Huge size .
description_long: Liveoak Liveoak was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned one nearby oak tree into a treant guardian . Effects . The tree to be transformed had to be alive and healthy and preferably of Huge size . The older enchantment version of this spell could be cast on smaller oaks and produced correspondingly smaller treants . The tree had to be growing in an area sacred to the caster like a grove of trees , near an ancestral spring , or even a forest under the druid ' s protection . Outside of such an area , the tree had to be within 300 ft ( 91 m ) of something the caster needed guarded or protected . Only one " liveoak " spell could be active at a time — the caster could not recast this spell until the previous one expired . When " liveoak " was cast , very brief conditions and instructions were given to the tree that determined when the treant became active and what it was supposed to do . The higher the level of the caster , the more complex the instructions could be . The tree would then remain dormant but watchful for as many days as the caster had levels , or until the triggering conditions were met , whichever came first .

title: Living Gate
description: Living Gate The Living Gate was a portal that connected reality with the Far Realm . It was located in the Feydark , beneath the ruined city of Cendriane . Description .
description_long: Living Gate The Living Gate was a portal that connected reality with the Far Realm . It was located in the Feydark , beneath the ruined city of Cendriane . Description . The Living Gate was a tiny portal , so small that its diameter was measured in eyelashes . It was made of a fleshy substance , and seeped an oozing substance that transformed the surrounding world into a nightmare . History . The Living Gate was sealed in the ancient past of the Feywild , and the seal was protected by eladrin knights appointed themselves by Queen Titania for the task . At some point in the past , a piece of the Living Gate was used in a failed attempt to free Tharizdun from its prison . Sometime after the Spellplague , Soveliss , nephew of Queen Titania and leader of the eladrin wardens , destroyed the seal for unknown reasons , releasing the horrors of the Far Realm into the world . The half - orc druid Haggart and his wife , the shiere knight eladrin Astriana , were able to re - seal the gate , but most of the guards of the Living Gate were destroyed in the attempt .

title: Living construct
description: Living construct Living constructs were beings who were exactly the same as other construct s in form and origin but who were otherwise alive in a manner much like that of magical beast s or humanoid s . Living constructs had a soul , and while they did not require organic sustenance they did require rest equivalent , though not identical , to that of sleep and were not immune to magic that targeted the living . Warforged were examples of living constructs .
