Living constructs had a soul , and while they did not require organic sustenance they did require rest equivalent , though not identical , to that of sleep and were not immune to magic that targeted the living . Warforged were examples of living constructs .

title: Living idol
description: Living idol Living idols were animated , semi - intelligent statues of stone , presumably created to serve as foci of ancient religions in Zakhara . As of 1367 DR , they were sometimes worshiped by small cults , who empowered the idols with sacrifices appropriate to the type of living idol . All living idols were considered opposed to Zakhara ' s predominant culture of Enlightenment .
description_long: Living idol Living idols were animated , semi - intelligent statues of stone , presumably created to serve as foci of ancient religions in Zakhara . As of 1367 DR , they were sometimes worshiped by small cults , who empowered the idols with sacrifices appropriate to the type of living idol . All living idols were considered opposed to Zakhara ' s predominant culture of Enlightenment . Combat . Physically powerful , living idols could both take and deal a lot of damage by attacking with a stony appendage . They were immune to mundane and lowly enchanted weapons as well as many spells , while they are especially vulnerable against magic attacking stone . They possessed the ability to " charm " nearby creatures , and each variety had a different major magical power . Animal idol . These most common of living idols were shaped like an animal , usually some kind of vermin ( e . g . , rat or scorpion ) . Given sacrifices of small valuables , these idols granted protection from the type of pest they depict to the worshipping community . Its major power supposedly also benefited its cultists , but was not known to outsiders .

title: Liza
description: Liza Liza was a female human refugee in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Liza was one of a group of people that traveled around the Mere of Dead Men in 1374 DR .
description_long: Liza Liza was a female human refugee in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Liza was one of a group of people that traveled around the Mere of Dead Men in 1374 DR . They were attacked by bandits . She and others escaped , while the bandits took some people into their camp . She asked the Kalach - Cha to find those people and rescue them .

title: Lizard
description: Lizard Lizards are reptilian animals that range all over the world ( except in arctic climates ) . Unlike snakes , lizards have legs and ears . They otherwise have no distinguishing characteristics .
description_long: Lizard Lizards are reptilian animals that range all over the world ( except in arctic climates ) . Unlike snakes , lizards have legs and ears . They otherwise have no distinguishing characteristics . Wall - crawling is one of the lizard ' s prominent abilites . Appearance . There are thousands of different types of lizards , ranging in a variety of appearances and sizes . The smallest lizards include chameleon s and gecko s that are only a few inches long .

title: Lizardfolk
description: Lizardfolk Lizardfolk , also known as lizard men , were a race of reptilian humanoid s native to Toril . Description . Lizardfolk were semi - aquatic reptilian humanoids .
description_long: Lizardfolk Lizardfolk , also known as lizard men , were a race of reptilian humanoid s native to Toril . Description . Lizardfolk were semi - aquatic reptilian humanoids . Their skin was covered in scales and varied in color from dark green through to shades of brown and gray . Taller than humans and powerfully built , lizardfolk were often between 6 and 7 feet ( 1 . 8 – 2 . 1 m ) tall and weighed between 200 and 250 pounds ( 90 . 7 – 113 kg ) . Lizardfolk had non - prehensile muscular tails that grew to three or four feet in length , and these were used for balance . They also had sharp claws and teeth . Although non - reptilians struggled to tell the difference between males and females , lizardfolk could easily distinguish themselves . Lizardfolk had to keep their skin relatively moist and needed to wet their bodies regularly if they were in dry climates . For this reason they were particularity fearful of desert landscapes . Abilities . Lizardfolk were strong and hardy beings , and their thick scaly hides protected against attack . They could hold their breaths far longer than humans could , up to twice as long as an equivalent human .

title: Lizel
description: Lizel Lizel was a vendor employed by Master Velsin in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Aliisza , while in disguise , saw Lizel treated rudely by Yrudis Gregan and somehow sensed that her father , a city guard , was killed some nights before by some tanarukk .
description_long: Lizel Lizel was a vendor employed by Master Velsin in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Aliisza , while in disguise , saw Lizel treated rudely by Yrudis Gregan and somehow sensed that her father , a city guard , was killed some nights before by some tanarukk . Later in the House of the Triad , Tauran allowed Alissza inside Lizel ' s mind . She discovered that she was a follower of Ilmater and had two younger sisters , Kaiga and Sadil , who needed new clothes . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Llandrydd ' s Steel
description: Llandrydd ' s Steel Llandrydd ' s Steel was a mercenary company based in Vilhon Reach and active also in the Sea of Fallen Stars around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into two units : the Steel , 150 fighters led by Llandrydd ; and the Auxiliary , 80 pike wielders .
description_long: Llandrydd ' s Steel Llandrydd ' s Steel was a mercenary company based in Vilhon Reach and active also in the Sea of Fallen Stars around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into two units : the Steel , 150 fighters led by Llandrydd ; and the Auxiliary , 80 pike wielders . Tactics . In battle , the Steel often wrapped around the Auxiliary . Contracts . The Company preferred time periods – specific jobs ; if the time expired but the job was not finished , they asked to renegotiate or they left . They normally charged 500 gold piece s per day for their services , half in advance . History . The Llandrydd were founded by Llandrydd Wyvernheart , a recruiter who decided to form a standing company after an extended period of action . They were decisive in the battle against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .

title: Llandrydd Wyvernheart
description: Llandrydd Wyvernheart Llandrydd Wyvernheart was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Llandrydd led the Llandrydd ' s Steel company .
description_long: Llandrydd Wyvernheart Llandrydd Wyvernheart was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Llandrydd led the Llandrydd ' s Steel company . In 1358 DR , he joined the Company of the Singing Dawn and Enhanen ' s men to investigate rumors of a legion following the tactics of the old Chessentan Empire . He faced the undead army led by the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric . Personality . Llandrydd was a man of authority . He was known for his speed in battle and his lethal sting , from which derived his epithet .

title: Lleddew of Selûne
description: Lleddew of Selûne Lleddew of Selûne is a high priestess of Selûne and a former adventurer , currently known as Mother Lleddew . History . Originally , she was an adventurer , a companion of Cole Wyvernspur .
description_long: Lleddew of Selûne Lleddew of Selûne is a high priestess of Selûne and a former adventurer , currently known as Mother Lleddew . History . Originally , she was an adventurer , a companion of Cole Wyvernspur . She adventured with him to gain treasure to complete the building of a temple to Selûne on Spring Hill . House of the Lady . The House of the Lady is a simple , yet elaborate temple at the top of Spring Hill in Immersea . The temple is more like a shrine . A circle of pillars supports a domed roof , inset with diamonds . There are no walls and a spring - fed pool occupies the center of the structure . The temple is guarded by a Shard . The Immer Stream issues from the hill and flows down in cascades , known as Selûne ' s Stair . It is said that if you climb to the top of the cataracts in the full moonlight , you will gain your hearts desire .

title: Llemgradac
description: Llemgradac Llemgradac was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Llemgradac was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .
description_long: Llemgradac Llemgradac was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Llemgradac was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " . He was one of the dragons Alasklerbanbastos sought out to attack Luthcheq and destroy the Brotherhood of the Griffon after the dracolich and Brimstone discovered Aoth Fezim attempts to disrupt the " xorvintaal " . During the Battle of Luthcheq , Llemgradac was freed of the compulsion of the " xorvintaal " by the dragonborn paladin Medrash , and he turned against Alasklerbanbastos and Tchazzar . He was killed by Alasklerbanbastos in the ensuing battle .

title: Llewan Aspenwold
description: Llewan Aspenwold Llewan Aspenwold was a priestess of Mystra in 1368 DR . History . In 1368 Llewan opened a temple of Mystra in the dale .
description_long: Llewan Aspenwold Llewan Aspenwold was a priestess of Mystra in 1368 DR . History . In 1368 Llewan opened a temple of Mystra in the dale . However she made very few converts and most dalelands simply ignored her . Llewan wondered to do something great to arrite attention .

title: Llewellyn Longhand
description: Llewellyn Longhand Llewellyn Longhand was the military commander of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Llewellyn in 1363 DR hired some adventurers to led the Daggerford army against the Hordes of Dragonspear Activities .
description_long: Llewellyn Longhand Llewellyn Longhand was the military commander of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Llewellyn in 1363 DR hired some adventurers to led the Daggerford army against the Hordes of Dragonspear Activities . Llewellyn was the leader of the army of Daggerford . Once he had dreamed of ruling the duchy but changed his mind and as of 1370 DR he was loyal to Duke Pwyll Greatshout .

title: Llewyrr
description: Llewyrr The Llewyrr were a race of elves that once held sway over the isle of Gwynneth and perhaps others of the Moonshaes but as human s began to colonize the islands the Llewyrr decided to retreat to Synnoria and isolate themselves . The Llewyrr are very similar to those called the high elves and it is suspected the they were the descendants of the survivors of a shipwrecked elven vessel that was on a pilgrimage to Evermeet , but only the Llewyrr can know for sure . Long before the humans arrived in the Moonshaes , dwarves began to immigrate and lived in peace with the Llewyrr mostly due to the fact that they did not compete for resources .
description_long: Llewyrr The Llewyrr were a race of elves that once held sway over the isle of Gwynneth and perhaps others of the Moonshaes but as human s began to colonize the islands the Llewyrr decided to retreat to Synnoria and isolate themselves . The Llewyrr are very similar to those called the high elves and it is suspected the they were the descendants of the survivors of a shipwrecked elven vessel that was on a pilgrimage to Evermeet , but only the Llewyrr can know for sure . Long before the humans arrived in the Moonshaes , dwarves began to immigrate and lived in peace with the Llewyrr mostly due to the fact that they did not compete for resources . The dwarves lived underground and in barren and rocky terrain in which the Llewyrr had no interest . When the Beast in the form of Kazgoroth rose to threaten the Balance by calling the firbolg s to kill and pillage , the Llewyrr and the dwarves , aided by the children of the goddess ( Leviathan , Kamerynn , and The Pack ) fought them for decades . Eventually the allies drove the firbolgs into small corners of the isles and balance was restored for a few centuries .

title: Lliira
description: Lliira Lliira ( pronounced " LEER - ah " ) , also known as Our Lady of Joy , was a good exarch ( formerly a lesser deity ) of Sune responsible for the sphere of joy , and for the domain s of chaos , charm , family , good and travel . Worshipers . Priests and priestesses of Lliira , called " Joydancers " , were the apple of her eye .
description_long: Lliira Lliira ( pronounced " LEER - ah " ) , also known as Our Lady of Joy , was a good exarch ( formerly a lesser deity ) of Sune responsible for the sphere of joy , and for the domain s of chaos , charm , family , good and travel . Worshipers . Priests and priestesses of Lliira , called " Joydancers " , were the apple of her eye . They were entrusted with leadership and tasked as plan - makers of festivals . Followers of Lliira were called Lliirans and wore brightly colored outfits , and adorned themselves with rubies and sapphire s . These stones were sacred to Lliira and any seen wearing them were blessed by passing clergy . They were known for always having a smile on their lips ; it was unheard of to see one with a frown . The Lady of Joy abhorred violence at celebrations , and would withhold her blessing from any celebration marred by it . The only weapons drawn at a festival must be ceremonial and never lead to bloodshed . Orders . Scarlet Mummers References .

title: Lliira ' s laugh
description: Lliira ' s laugh Lliira ' s laugh was an enchantment spell that heartened good creatures and demoralized evil ones . Effects . The caster released a joyous , boisterous laugh that strengthened the resolve of good creatures and weakened the resolve of evil creatures .
description_long: Lliira ' s laugh Lliira ' s laugh was an enchantment spell that heartened good creatures and demoralized evil ones . Effects . The caster released a joyous , boisterous laugh that strengthened the resolve of good creatures and weakened the resolve of evil creatures . Good creatures within the spell ' s area gained benefits to morale , less fear , and an increase in vitality . Evil creatures within the spell ' s area that lacked willpower lost morale and were more prone to fear . Creatures had to hear the laugh to be affected by the spell . Neutral creatures were unaffected by " Lliira ' s laugh " . Components . This spell could be cast verbally with no somatic or material components required .

title: Llimark
description: Llimark Llimark was a gold dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , the song dragon Karasendrieth and others disagreed , instead proposing to search for a cure .
description_long: Llimark Llimark was a gold dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , the song dragon Karasendrieth and others disagreed , instead proposing to search for a cure . Lareth sent Llimark to detain the dragon bard for her rebellious actions in defiance of the conclave ' s decision . On the streets of Lyrabar , Llimark intercepted Kara but after a vicious fight she battled and subdued Llimark , despite sustaining heavy injuries .

title: Llombaerth Starym
description: Llombaerth Starym Llombaerth Starym , sometimes known as the Masked , was a male elf wizard and the Lord Speaker of the Starym House of Cormanthyr . History . Llombaerth was one of the most prominent members of Starym House and was fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim .
description_long: Llombaerth Starym Llombaerth Starym , sometimes known as the Masked , was a male elf wizard and the Lord Speaker of the Starym House of Cormanthyr . History . Llombaerth was one of the most prominent members of Starym House and was fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim . He soon started to conspire to stop the project . At the same time , Llombaerth tutored the human Elminster Aumar and the half - elf Nacacia in the ways of elven High Magic , in order to use them as his instruments . In 261 DR , he finally found the hiding place of Mythanthar , the architect of the indispensable " mythal " . In a complex plot , he used his apprentices and even some drow to kill the mage . When Llombaerth later appeared before the coronal and framed Elminster for the assassination , he was exposed by the Srinshee and the still - alive Mythanthar . Llombaerth summoned his forces and started a battle , intending to kill the coronal and all his allies but in the end was killed . Possessions . He derived his nickname from his constant use of the magical " Mask of Andrathath " .

title: Llorkh
description: Llorkh Llorkh was a human town to the northeast of Loudwater in the Gray Vale . History . Establishment & Expansion .
description_long: Llorkh Llorkh was a human town to the northeast of Loudwater in the Gray Vale . History . Establishment & Expansion . Llorkh was founded by the Netherese fleeing the downfall of their kingdom . Later on , further settlement occurred by pioneers from Waterdeep , sponsored by Waterdhavian families . Llorkh became an important mining town of approximately 2 , 000 humans and 300 dwarves . Zhentarim Control . Around the time that iron and silver production from the nearby hills started to wane , Zhentarim agents began to arrive . Soon thereafter , in 1353 DR , the last of the old Lords , Phintarn Redblade , was found dead at the base of Lord ' s Keep . Overnight , the Zhentarim installed their own man , Geildarr Ithym , in the Lord ' s Keep . Four hundred " Lord ' s Men " arrived and slaughtered all of the militia under the pretext that they were trouble - makers . A significant number of townsfolk left Llorkh , along with the dwarves . As soon as control over the town was consolidated , Zhentarim caravans began to arrive from the Anauroch .

title: Lluirwood
description: Lluirwood The Lluirwood , or the Long Forest , was a forest in Luiren . Geography . Lluirwood made up the northern border of Luiren .
description_long: Lluirwood The Lluirwood , or the Long Forest , was a forest in Luiren . Geography . Lluirwood made up the northern border of Luiren . The Lluirwood spanned 300 miles ( 480 km ) east to west across Luiren and was roughly 90 miles ( 145 km ) wide . It sat on a ridge in the shadow of the Toadsquat Mountains , making it more temperate to other forests in the Shining South . Description . The Lluirwood was a dense forest . Originally , it covered more of the land , but after the Hin Ghostwar ended in - 65 DR , the strongheart halfling s cleared parts of it to make room for permanent settlements . History . The Lluirwood was the original homeland of all three subraces of halfling . Those three tribes ( lightfoots , stronghearts , and ghostwise ) lived nomadic lifestyles in the forest and shared its resources among themselves . Around - 100 DR , a ghostwise halfling cleric named Desva began leading the ghostwise in the worship of Malar and violence , causing the forest to become a savage place and beginning the Hin Ghostwar . The war ended in - 65 DR when Desva was slain and the ghostwise imposed exile on themselves to the Chondalwood .

title: Llurth Dreir
description: Llurth Dreir Llurth Dreier was a drow city located about 10 miles under Shaar and to the west of the Great Rift . It wasn ' t clear what but its denizens did something to offend Lolth in ways that caused her to completely forsake it . Religion .
description_long: Llurth Dreir Llurth Dreier was a drow city located about 10 miles under Shaar and to the west of the Great Rift . It wasn ' t clear what but its denizens did something to offend Lolth in ways that caused her to completely forsake it . Religion . After Lolth left , Eilistraee ' s , Kiaransalee ' s and Vhaeraun ' s faiths tried to fill the demand for divine help but they couldn ' t compete with Ghaunadaur ' s . This development further accelerated when an avatar of the slime deity appeared and led to the others to be driven out . The City and Government . The city ' s condition could be most easily described as a giant squalor . Nominally the drow Houses ruled but they did a poor job at it . For example , the city had no real law enforcement and citizens who weren ' t able to pay tribute were forced to look out for themselves . The ruling Houses frequently fought with each other , unlike in other drow city they didn ' t fight over political power but over goods to sacrifice to Ghaunadaur , slaves or even necessities like food . To add more , the Houses weren ' t even the real power holders . Aboleth psions and clerics of Ghaunadaur were the real rulers of the city .

title: Loaradden Derviir
description: Loaradden Derviir Loaradden Deviir was a sinister Magister who held the title for two years from 319 DR to 321 DR before his actions finally earned the wrath of Mystra . Personality . Loaradden was cold and calculating , caring for nothing but the pursuit of magical power .
description_long: Loaradden Derviir Loaradden Deviir was a sinister Magister who held the title for two years from 319 DR to 321 DR before his actions finally earned the wrath of Mystra . Personality . Loaradden was cold and calculating , caring for nothing but the pursuit of magical power . History . After helping Iolaeden Stonehallow vanquish her foes for several years , Loaradden turned to his own goals that revolved around raiding temples and slaying any practitioner of the Art in search of arcane might . Mystra initially tried to thwart Loaradden by erecting " walls of force " before him whenever he approached a temple . While blocked from entering the temples , he turned his attentions to attacking any mage he could find regardless of their skill level in the Art . Outraged by this affront , Mystra took Loaradden ' s magic while he was plowing his way through a group of guards en route to the vault of Onsilur Maerdrathom in Sheirtalar . Loradden ' s magic abandoned him during the use of a flight spell , causing him to tumble into the courtyard below where Onsilur easily blasted his broken body .

title: Lob
description: Lob Lob was a hill giant who , together with Ogg , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together .
description_long: Lob Lob was a hill giant who , together with Ogg , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of chief Guh , Lob and Ogg went in search of food for Guh . After wandering , they led a giant contingent to Goldenfields . However , they were defeated by some adventurers .

title: Locate animals or plants
description: Locate animals or plants Locate animals or plants , also known as detect animals or plants , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to discover the direction , distance , and approximate number of one type of animal or plant desired . Effects . The caster picked a direction and one type of animal or plant , and then concentrated for a short time to discover if the desired plant or animal was within the range of the spell .
description_long: Locate animals or plants Locate animals or plants , also known as detect animals or plants , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to discover the direction , distance , and approximate number of one type of animal or plant desired . Effects . The caster picked a direction and one type of animal or plant , and then concentrated for a short time to discover if the desired plant or animal was within the range of the spell . For the older versions of this spell , the area of scrutiny was a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) wide corridor that extended out 100 yd ( 91 m ) and more depending on caster level . The newer version divined in a cone - shaped area that extended out 400 ft ( 123 m ) and more . If the caster concentrated long enough , details about the condition of the specimens found could be gleaned . The caster could then pick a new direction to examine , provided the spell did not expire . This spell could penetrate barriers , but 1 ft ( 30 cm ) of stone , 1 in ( 2 . 5cm ) of common metal , a thin sheet of lead , or 3 ft ( 1 m ) of wood or dirt blocked it . The oldest version of this spell was actually two spells .

title: Locate creature
description: Locate creature Locate creature was a divination spell that allowed the caster to sense the location and movement of a well - visualized creature . Effects . Similar to " locate object " , this spell could find a creature familiar to the caster within a radius of at least 560 ft ( 171 m ) — the range increased with the experience level of the caster but would not cross running water .
description_long: Locate creature Locate creature was a divination spell that allowed the caster to sense the location and movement of a well - visualized creature . Effects . Similar to " locate object " , this spell could find a creature familiar to the caster within a radius of at least 560 ft ( 171 m ) — the range increased with the experience level of the caster but would not cross running water . " Locate creature " could also find a creature by race or species ( such as an elf or an umber hulk ) as long as the caster had previously met or at least seen one from a distance of 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) or less . This spell could not locate objects and could be fooled by " mislead " , " nondetection " , and " polymorph " spells . Components . The material component for this spell was a tuft of fur from a bloodhound . The spell also had a verbal component and part of the somatic component was to turn slowly around in a circle until the desired creature was sensed .

title: Locate object
description: Locate object Locate object was a divination spell that let one sense the direction to an object . Effect . The caster sensed the direction to a well - known or clearly visualized object .
description_long: Locate object Locate object was a divination spell that let one sense the direction to an object . Effect . The caster sensed the direction to a well - known or clearly visualized object . The spell located such objects as apparel , jewelry , furniture , tools , weapons , or even a ladder . The caster could search for general items such as a stairway , a sword , or a jewel , in which case he or she located the nearest one of its type if more than one was within range . Attempting to find a specific item , such as a particular piece of jewelry , required a specific and accurate mental image ; if the image was not close enough to the actual object , the spell failed . The caster could not specify a unique object unless he or she had observed that particular item first hand ( not through divination ) . The spell was blocked by lead . Creatures could not be found by this spell . " Polymorph any object " fooled the spell . The reversed form , " obscure object " , shielded an object from magical divination . Arcane focus . A forked twig .

title: Locathah
description: Locathah The locathah were a fish - like humanoid race also known as fish - men , gill - men or kaparl ( " slave " in the kuo - toa n language ) . Description . In Serôs , they have fine scales covering their bodies that range from olive green to ocre in colour although their stomach scales instead range from sea green to pale yellow .
description_long: Locathah The locathah were a fish - like humanoid race also known as fish - men , gill - men or kaparl ( " slave " in the kuo - toa n language ) . Description . In Serôs , they have fine scales covering their bodies that range from olive green to ocre in colour although their stomach scales instead range from sea green to pale yellow . They have fish - like heads with large eyes , either all - black or all - white ( which is viewed as a good omen ) , toothless mouths and small fins where ears would normally be . Instead of hair , they have a dorsal fin and flukes Characteristics . The locathah have been dealt a bad hand in terms of their racial history , having been enslaved by nearly every race of the Sea of Fallen Stars , especially by the Kuo - toa and Ixitxachitl . Although there are still some locathah slaves dotted around the deeper oceans , most are now free and living in more shallow waters as nomads . The reason for their enslavement , in their minds , was that their enemies took advantage of periods when the locathah were at odds with their allies or each other and thus , fragmented .

title: Lockpicks
description: Lockpicks Lockpicks , or thieves ' picks were one of the most indispensible tools for a rogue . Uses . A complete set of lockpicks included wires , angled wrenches , rods , oil , a small hammer , a magnifying glass , chisels , and acid .
description_long: Lockpicks Lockpicks , or thieves ' picks were one of the most indispensible tools for a rogue . Uses . A complete set of lockpicks included wires , angled wrenches , rods , oil , a small hammer , a magnifying glass , chisels , and acid . Prices . A good set of lockpicks cost 30 gold , though sets of considerably inferior quality could be purchased for much less .

title: Lockstone
description: Lockstone A Lockstone was a magical gem that triggered a few set spells when certain conditions were met . They were commonly used as wards and traps . Reputation .
description_long: Lockstone A Lockstone was a magical gem that triggered a few set spells when certain conditions were met . They were commonly used as wards and traps . Reputation . The Lockstone was thought to be native to several Outer Planes . They were quite rare . Description . A Lockstone typically resembled an orb or egg fashioned of crystal or metal . Powers . A Lockstone could store up to three spells that would be triggered if up to two predetermined conditions were met . Once these spells were cast , the stone would turn dormant for a year , but would reactivate after that time , with the same function as did before . The spells and conditions of a Lockstone could only be set or altered by a high - level wizard . Uses . Lockstones were commonly used to ward valuable treasures and to trap extraplanar beings . History . Prior to the 1350s DR , only three Lockstones were ever reported in the North . The extraplanar being Imgig Zu somehow employed a Lockstone to trap the fire elemental Jogaoh on the world of Abeir - Toril , having transformed the elemental into the form of a dwarf and withered his limbs with the " staff of withering " .

title: Lod
description: Lod Lod was a bone naga from the world of Abeir , and the founder of the Eminence of Araunt . Activities . Although the Eminence of Araunt believed that all members were equal , Lod was an exception , as he served as the leader of the Eminence .
description_long: Lod Lod was a bone naga from the world of Abeir , and the founder of the Eminence of Araunt . Activities . Although the Eminence of Araunt believed that all members were equal , Lod was an exception , as he served as the leader of the Eminence . History . Around five hundred years before the Spellplague , Lod founded the Eminence of Araunt in a dragon tomb located in Nornglast . He also wrote the tome known as the " Codex of Araunt " , prophesying the expansion of its kingdom over the centuries .

title: Lodar
description: Lodar Lodar is the cheerful tavernmaster of the Bubbling Cauldron in the village of Hilltop . In 1372 DR , after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Lodar ' s chef Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a band of kobolds , led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main group .
description_long: Lodar Lodar is the cheerful tavernmaster of the Bubbling Cauldron in the village of Hilltop . In 1372 DR , after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Lodar ' s chef Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a band of kobolds , led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main group .

title: Loene
description: Loene Loene was a former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . Description . Loene had dark blond hair and hazel eyes .
description_long: Loene Loene was a former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . Description . Loene had dark blond hair and hazel eyes . She was beautiful and a skilled fighter . She had henna - tipped fingers . History . Loene was a slave when she was rescued by Nain Keenwhistler , a member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . After she was freed , she adventured with them for a time . In 1361 DR , Loene was living in a townhouse in the Castle Ward near Castle Waterdeep . She dwelt there with her servant , Elliot Graves , who was killed that year by the Harper Assassin . The house was also guarded by two mastiffs . Possessions . Loene had a " ring of spell storing " , which had been given to her by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Relationships . Arilyn Moonblade and Loene were well acquainted .

title: Log of everburning
description: Log of everburning Log of everburning was an enchantment spell that could keep a wood fire burning brightly for many hours without consuming the fuel . Effects . This spell had to be cast on a wooden object no larger than 1 ft ( 0 .
description_long: Log of everburning Log of everburning was an enchantment spell that could keep a wood fire burning brightly for many hours without consuming the fuel . Effects . This spell had to be cast on a wooden object no larger than 1 ft ( 0 . 03 m ) per level of the caster ( a torch , chair , or wooden chest , for example ) . The object then had to be ignited either before or after being enchanted with " log of everburning " . Once lit , it burned brightly and gave off twice the normal amount of heat for an hour per level of the caster , not showing signs of being consumed until the spell expired , whereupon the object crumbled to ash . Components . Only verbal and somatic components , plus a wooden object , were required to cast this spell . History . " Log of everburning " dates back to the time of the first Netherese empire and was a first - level druid spell of the terrestial winds . It was also available to specialty priests of Amaunator and Moander .

title: Logala Thenduk
description: Logala Thenduk Logala Thenduk was a female drow wererat rogue and a member of the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Although a drow , Logala spent much of her time in her dire rat form to avoid detection .
description_long: Logala Thenduk Logala Thenduk was a female drow wererat rogue and a member of the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Although a drow , Logala spent much of her time in her dire rat form to avoid detection . Personality . Inquisitive and sneaky , much like a rat , Logala was always hungry for information . Abilities . As both a drow and a wererat , Logala ' s innate aptitude for stealth was particularly impressive . This was further enhanced thanks to her ability to transform into a dire rat and move unnoticed around the Underdark . In combat , Logala relied on attacking an opponent from the shadows and darting away again to deadly effect . Possessions . Logala traveled lightly as she depended on the natural abilities of her wererat forms most of the time . However , she was equipped with a fine light crossbow , 20 bolt s , and a rapier at least . Relationships . As a member of the Hidden , Logala worked closely with its other members to try and restore Maerimydra . She also had a large number of rat allies to assist her . History .

title: Logram Eyegouger
description: Logram Eyegouger Logram Eyegouger was a barbarian orc and chieftain of the Eyegouger clan , the dominant clan under which all other orc clans surrounding the Old Owl Well served . At one point , Logram allied with Black Garius and razed Neverwinter ' s caravans . In the end , Logram ' s orcs captured a Waterdhavian emissary and the Kalach - Cha was sent to retrieve him .
description_long: Logram Eyegouger Logram Eyegouger was a barbarian orc and chieftain of the Eyegouger clan , the dominant clan under which all other orc clans surrounding the Old Owl Well served . At one point , Logram allied with Black Garius and razed Neverwinter ' s caravans . In the end , Logram ' s orcs captured a Waterdhavian emissary and the Kalach - Cha was sent to retrieve him . Logram was killed in the fighting .

title: Lok
description: Lok Lok was the leader of the Eagle Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Lok was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos .
description_long: Lok Lok was the leader of the Eagle Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Lok was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos . He was always close to the ruler Caxal during times of war . In 1361 DR , soon after the arrival of the Golden Legion ' s ships , Lok was called by Caxal to a war council with the leader of the Jaguar Knights , Gultec , to discuss how to fight the strangers .

title: Lokoshin
description: Lokoshin Lokoshin was the female Azuposi human spokesperson for the settlement of Kin Elbhaz in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica in the 1360s DR . Personality . She had led the community for a decade and was strong - minded .
description_long: Lokoshin Lokoshin was the female Azuposi human spokesperson for the settlement of Kin Elbhaz in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica in the 1360s DR . Personality . She had led the community for a decade and was strong - minded . She favored change and put in place numerous small projects to maintain this state of change . She was distrustful of strangers , but harbored curiosities about any she encountered . Appearance . Lokoshin was around 5 ' 5 " ( 1 . 65 m ) tall and weighed around 140 lbs . ( 64 kg ) . She had graying hair and a weathered face , with sparkling , youthful eyes . Equipment . Lokoshin used a club in times of combat .

title: Lolth
description: Lolth Lolth ( pronounced " LOALTH " ) , or Lloth in Menzoberranzan , was the major goddess the Queen of Spiders or Queen of the Demonweb Pits was the major goddess of the drow and the leader of the Dark Seldarine . She drove the drow under the pretense of culling the weak into heavy infighting . All for the sake of having fun , while at the same time limiting the growth of drow power and influence to ensure that she remained the only accessible power source to them .
description_long: Lolth Lolth ( pronounced " LOALTH " ) , or Lloth in Menzoberranzan , was the major goddess the Queen of Spiders or Queen of the Demonweb Pits was the major goddess of the drow and the leader of the Dark Seldarine . She drove the drow under the pretense of culling the weak into heavy infighting . All for the sake of having fun , while at the same time limiting the growth of drow power and influence to ensure that she remained the only accessible power source to them . Her sacred animals were arachnids . She considered them valuable enough to kill those who mistreated them . Worshipers . Lolth ’ s follower base was very varied . Primarily it consisted of drow but also of aranea , chitin s draegloth s and deep dragon s . She also attracted some surface elves . She tried to get more of them by assuming the aspect of Moander , a deity of rot , who was more attractive to elves than herself . Cleric s . Lolth ’ s clerics normally wore spider motifs . Her rituals required them to wear darker clothes or no clothing at all . Her clergy sacrificed the living and treasure to her glory . Relationships . Dark Seldarine .

title: Lolth ' s Web
description: Lolth ' s Web Lolth ' s Web was a neighborhood of the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan that was suspended from the ceiling and walls by calcified spider silk . Description . Lolth ' s Web was located in West Wall next to the district of Narbondellyn .
description_long: Lolth ' s Web Lolth ' s Web was a neighborhood of the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan that was suspended from the ceiling and walls by calcified spider silk . Description . Lolth ' s Web was located in West Wall next to the district of Narbondellyn . It consisted of hundreds of strands of calcified spider silk stretching from the ceiling to the ground in a dense latticework . Hollow , cocoon - like structures , both on top of and below the webs , provided living space . Narrow ladders connected the levels for those without the ability to levitate . History . Lolth ' s Web was constructed by survivors of the destruction of Ched Nasad , which fell in 1372 DR . Over the next hundred years , the survivors based Lolth ' s Web on the structure of their home city , using magical techniques to weave the web .

title: Lomaraj
description: Lomaraj Lomaraj was a Metahel human settlement on the Pasocada River , home to around 1 , 000 individuals . Geography . The town was located a few miles from Great Raven Pueblo , an Azuposi settlement , and acted as the main point of trade between the two peoples .
description_long: Lomaraj Lomaraj was a Metahel human settlement on the Pasocada River , home to around 1 , 000 individuals . Geography . The town was located a few miles from Great Raven Pueblo , an Azuposi settlement , and acted as the main point of trade between the two peoples .

title: Londal Fen
description: Londal Fen Londal Fen was a male Chondathan human fighter in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . In 1374 DR , Londal and his partner , Smile , were employed by Lady Arthas of the Temple of Mystra .
description_long: Londal Fen Londal Fen was a male Chondathan human fighter in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . In 1374 DR , Londal and his partner , Smile , were employed by Lady Arthas of the Temple of Mystra . If adventurers investigating the strange behavior of the cleric s of Mystra there attacked the temple , then she would pay the pair 830 gp to ambush them . Londal and Smile would lure the adventurers into an ambush among the waterfront warehouses at 23 Impil Street , or otherwise keep tabs on them to ambush and murder them out of sight . Description . Londal was a large man . Before battle , he painted his skin and armor entirely gray , leaving the whites of his eyes to stand out . Equipment . Londal wielded a " + 1 greatsword " , wore full plate armor , and carried three " potion s of bull ' s strength " . Abilities . Londal was a specialist in the greatsword , and a powerful , brutal fighter with it . Personality . He was a fanatical follower of Shar , willing to fight to the death .

title: Lonely Tower
description: Lonely Tower The Lonely Tower was a tower located somewhere in the Moonlands near the eastern border of the Moonwood forest in the Silver Marches . Description . This mysterious tower , made of white stone , had an incredibly light and frail structure compared to where it stood .
description_long: Lonely Tower The Lonely Tower was a tower located somewhere in the Moonlands near the eastern border of the Moonwood forest in the Silver Marches . Description . This mysterious tower , made of white stone , had an incredibly light and frail structure compared to where it stood . Without a doubt , the surroundings of the tower were quite unusual . The surrounding area was perfectly circular , strewn with volcanic rock and dotted with deep cracks , which differed considerably from the nearby hills , as if the tower had been built elsewhere and then moved to this place , along with all its environment for about one kilometer . History . The wizard Ssessibil Istahvar lived in this place . He was not a native of Faerûn , and spent much of his time away from the tower , in areas that required his attention in other planes of existence far away . During his last absence from the tower , which lasted about thirty years , Arbane the wizard was able to overcome the defenses of the Lonely Tower , and after stealing Ssessibil ' s treasure , he proclaimed himself master of the tower .

title: Lonelywood
description: Lonelywood Lonelywood was a town in Ten Towns within the cold region of Icewind Dale . It was known as being the " first choice " for rogues seeking a refuge in Icewind Dale . Geography .
description_long: Lonelywood Lonelywood was a town in Ten Towns within the cold region of Icewind Dale . It was known as being the " first choice " for rogues seeking a refuge in Icewind Dale . Geography . This northernmost town was surrounded by the Lonely Woods with Maer Dualdon on the west side and the Bryn Shander Trail on the east . History . Before Drizzt Do ' Urden journeyed to Icewind Dale , Regis was the " leader " of the town , but in 1351 DR after Wulfgar ' s people raided Ten Towns , Regis retired as council spokesman , although the city continued to use him to " market " the town . Even after his move to Mithral Hall , he maintained a home there for some time . Muldoon became the next town spokesman in 1351 DR . He was originally from Waterdeep , but came to Lonelywood with his father when his father was kicked out of Waterdeep ( although he later returned ) . Muldoon became a successful merchant and council spokesman . Regis returned to Lonelywood in 1483 DR and once again purchased a house there , spending time " fishing " in Maer Dualdon . In the forest not far from his house , Catti - brie built a small garden shrine to Mielikki . Defenses .

title: Long Canyon
description: Long Canyon The Long Canyon was a ninety - mile - long ( 145 km ) canyon in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica , through which the Pasocada River ran . It was between a mile ( 1 . 6 km ) and ten miles ( 16 km ) wide .
description_long: Long Canyon The Long Canyon was a ninety - mile - long ( 145 km ) canyon in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica , through which the Pasocada River ran . It was between a mile ( 1 . 6 km ) and ten miles ( 16 km ) wide . The ruins of Esh Alakar lay within the canyon , and the canyon was home to a tribe of hill giant s .

title: Long Jing
description: Long Jing Long Jing , also known as West Lake Dragon Tea , was a green tea found around the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . The tea was grown only in the mythical Zhejiang province in only a couple of tea gardens .
description_long: Long Jing Long Jing , also known as West Lake Dragon Tea , was a green tea found around the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . The tea was grown only in the mythical Zhejiang province in only a couple of tea gardens . Long Jing was imported and shipped from the far east at great expense .

title: Long Reach
description: Long Reach The Long Reach , also called the Centaur Trail , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the village of Orlimmin and the town of King ' s Reach . From west to east , it began at Orlimmin , ran through Bambryn and Sendrin and ended at King ' s Reach . On the way , it linked with the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , Blaern ' s Trail , and the North Road .
description_long: Long Reach The Long Reach , also called the Centaur Trail , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the village of Orlimmin and the town of King ' s Reach . From west to east , it began at Orlimmin , ran through Bambryn and Sendrin and ended at King ' s Reach . On the way , it linked with the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , Blaern ' s Trail , and the North Road .

title: Longbow
description: Longbow A longbow is a two - handed , martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The longbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 4 to 6 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Longbow A longbow is a two - handed , martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The longbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 4 to 6 feet ( 1 . 2 to 1 . 8 meters ) long with the ends connected by strong cord or a gut string that is a little shorter than the shaft , causing the wood to bend and keep the string under tension . For a composite longbow , the shaft is made from laminated materials ( again , horn , wood or bone ) and fashioned with a recurve , meaning the bow remains bow - shaped even when unstrung . A typical longbow costs 75gp and weighs 3lbs ( 1 . 4kg ) . A composite longbow costs around 100gp and weighs about the same . Weaponology . The length of a longbow can vary up to about the height of the archer but it quickly becomes unwieldy , getting caught on things or tripping the user . Composite bows are stronger than normal bows and therefore can translate more of the archer ' s strength into range and damage . Bows require two hands to fire and a good amount of practice in order to hit a target . Therefore , the longbow is considered a martial weapon .

title: Longhorn
description: Longhorn A longhorn was a type of Faerûn ian flute that was commonly found in civilized regions , or in elven communities . Description . Longhorns were considered to be amongst the most lyric of musical instruments .
description_long: Longhorn A longhorn was a type of Faerûn ian flute that was commonly found in civilized regions , or in elven communities . Description . Longhorns were considered to be amongst the most lyric of musical instruments . They were also very portable and easy to play , as well as elegant . These traits made longhorns as popular as yarting s among musicians . Since longhorns were very sophisticated instruments , difficult to make , they could only be found in areas that held skilled artisans such as big cities and elven communities . There were two types of longhorn : the common longhorn , whose range covered middle to upper tones , and the tenor ( or treble ) longhorn , which had a very high and piercing tone , similar to the chirping of bird s . Both were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Longsaddle
description: Longsaddle Longsaddle was a hamlet on the Long Road in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Geography . Situated east of the Crags and west of the Evermoors , Longsaddle surrounded the magical home of the Harpell family .
description_long: Longsaddle Longsaddle was a hamlet on the Long Road in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Geography . Situated east of the Crags and west of the Evermoors , Longsaddle surrounded the magical home of the Harpell family . History . Longsaddle was founded in 1042 DR by Shardra Harpell , an escaped Calishite slave . In 1376 DR , two separate sects of the Malar ite faith wanted to set up churches by the waterfront of a magically created lake . The two churches immediately began fighting each other and the Harpells had to step in . Unfortunately , they couldn ' t get rid of them so instead they imposed a severe punishment on the more dangerous individuals : transmuting them permanently into harmless rabbit s . By 1479 DR , the forest around Longsaddle was inhabited by werewolf descendants of Bidderdoo Harpell . These werewolves were called " the Bidderdoos " and although the townsfolk feared them , they provided some measure of protection for the town . From 1479 DR until the end of 1482 DR , the reincarnated Catti - brie , under the name of Delly Curtie , dwelt at the Ivy Mansion in Longsaddle , learning magic from the Harpells . Inhabitants .

title: Longship
description: Longship A longship was a square - sailed , oared ship with a single mast that could be removed . Description . The longship was similar to the drakkar but much smaller — typically 70 to 80 ft .
description_long: Longship A longship was a square - sailed , oared ship with a single mast that could be removed . Description . The longship was similar to the drakkar but much smaller — typically 70 to 80 ft . ( 21 to 24 m ) along the keel and 15 to 20 ft . ( 4 . 6 to 6 . 1 m ) across the beam . With 20 oars on each side , the minimum crew size was 40 plus three watchmen and could carry a maximum crew of between 60 and 200 including rowers . Longships could sail , assuming moderate , favorable winds and calm seas , at a maximum speed of 16 nautical miles per hour with sail and between two and ten while propelled by oars . Longships were capable of plying the open seas . Their open , aphract ( without deck or armor ) , relatively light hulls were built with overlapping planks held together by rivets . This kind of hull allowed the ship to sail over the waves , instead of having to force its way through them , but was in danger of being swamped by high seas . Its small size allowed it to also enter rivers or land directly on beaches . Normally , longships carried no weapons , but some versions mounted a couple light weapons , one large weapon ( such as a catapult or ballista ) , or a ram .

title: Longspear
description: Longspear The longspear is a simple , two - handed melee reach weapon of the pole arm family . Description . Just as the name implies , a longspear is a longer version of the spear .
description_long: Longspear The longspear is a simple , two - handed melee reach weapon of the pole arm family . Description . Just as the name implies , a longspear is a longer version of the spear . Longspears range in length from about 8 to 15 feet ( 2 . 4 to 4 . 5 meters ) , any spear longer than this is called a pike in the classification system described in pole arm s . The shaft is almost certainly made of wood and of a relatively small diameter to keep the weight down . The shaft may be sharpened to a point or may be tipped with a wide variety of spearheads , commonly made of metal . An average longspear with metal spearhead costs 5gp and weighs 9lbs ( 4 . 1kg ) . Weaponology . Longspears require two hands to maneuver and control on the battlefield . They are simple weapons to use but when grouped in a phalanx precise training is required to increase effectiveness . Longspears are reach weapon s which can attack an opponent 10 feet ( 3 meters ) away but cannot be brought to bear on adjacent enemies . When set against a charging opponent , a longspear can do double the damage of a regular melee attack .

title: Longsword
description: Longsword The longsword is an extremely common and very versitle weapon . It is typically of western design , though all Faerûn ian cultures exhibit weapons of similar design and intent . The classic , straight blade is a favorite of many paladin s .
description_long: Longsword The longsword is an extremely common and very versitle weapon . It is typically of western design , though all Faerûn ian cultures exhibit weapons of similar design and intent . The classic , straight blade is a favorite of many paladin s . It is generally laid out in a cruciform pattern with four major sections ; the blade , the crossguard , the handle , and the pommel . It has a long , straight , double - edged blade and is typically wielded with one hand by creatures of roughly human size . Some varying designs have a handle large enough for two hands , or at least most of the second hand , which allows warriors who use two hands to wield a longsword to put additional attack power behind their blows . Weaponology . Though primarily designed to attack opponents by slashing at them with the edges of its blade , the versatile nature of the longsword cannot be disputed . Various combat manuals and the design of historical , real - world weapons lend credence to the thought that the entire sword was considered a weapon .

title: Loobamub
description: Loobamub Loobamub was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Loobamub was the leader of the Circle of Hunters in Neverlight Grove .
description_long: Loobamub Loobamub was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Loobamub was the leader of the Circle of Hunters in Neverlight Grove . When , with the Rage of Demons , Zuggtmoy ' s will twisted most of the Circle , Loobamub and the Circle resisted the evil ' s influence . Thank to the cooperation of a party of adventurers escaped from drow slavers of Velkynvelve Basidia led Rasharoo , Loobamub and their followers out of the Grove before was too late Personality . A loyal follower of Basidia , Loobamub shared its leader ' s concerns about the strange behavior of Phylo and its followers . Loobamub kept its opinions to itself , but its wariness spread to the other hunters when they melded , cementing their loyalty to Basidia . Loobamub ' s main concern was redirecting the spore servant s and " awaken ed " zurkhwood s Phylo created away from its circle ' s territory .

title: Lopango
description: Lopango Lopango , also known as the Land of Fire , was a land on the southern end of Maztica . It was covered in forest or jungle and high mountains . Some maps depicted archers with longbow s there .
description_long: Lopango Lopango , also known as the Land of Fire , was a land on the southern end of Maztica . It was covered in forest or jungle and high mountains . Some maps depicted archers with longbow s there . Places in Lopango included Pichu Umu , Apu Roca , and Mt . Cuzcalac . History . Lopango was once part of Merrouroboros , the ancient super - continent that eventually broke up into Faerûn , Kara - Tur , Maztica , and Zakhara . Lopango was known for its active volcanoes around the time of the height of the Batrachi empire , " circa " – 31 , 500 DR in the Days of Thunder . Appendix . Background . Lopango is a land that has only been mentioned on maps of Maztica in the " Maztica Campaign Set " . Almost nothing is known about it , but based on its place names , fans have speculated that it is similar to the culture of .

title: Lorabelios
description: Lorabelios Lorabelios was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Lorabelios and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Lorabelios Lorabelios was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Lorabelios and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Personality . Despite its situation , Lorabelios had hope .

title: Loranse
description: Loranse Loranse was the manor home of Count and Countess Malcor and Shyrr Grannox and the county seat of Ithmonn in Tethyr . Location . Loranse was located just west of the capital , along the northern banks of the River Ith and south of Ithal Road .
description_long: Loranse Loranse was the manor home of Count and Countess Malcor and Shyrr Grannox and the county seat of Ithmonn in Tethyr . Location . Loranse was located just west of the capital , along the northern banks of the River Ith and south of Ithal Road . History . The palace was the former home of the old count of Ithmonn before the Interregnum . It was damaged during the turmoil of that time . Malcor Grannox , who was one of the richest Tethyr ians of his day , purchased the manor along with many other abused or ruined properties to have them restored , long before Queen Zaranda rose to power and appointed him the count . He personally worked on the carpentry needed for its restoration .

title: Loravyre Impkith
description: Loravyre Impkith Loravyre Impkith was a tiefling wizard who inhabited Fort Precipice in the Chasm within the Ebon Downs in 1484 DR . History . She recruited a tiefling adventurer to recover some strange items in possession of some Ashmadai - related devils in the Chasm .
description_long: Loravyre Impkith Loravyre Impkith was a tiefling wizard who inhabited Fort Precipice in the Chasm within the Ebon Downs in 1484 DR . History . She recruited a tiefling adventurer to recover some strange items in possession of some Ashmadai - related devils in the Chasm . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Loravyre can be approached only to player with tiefling as base race .

title: Lorcan
description: Lorcan Lorcan was a cambion and the sole son of the succubus ( formerly erinyes ) Invadiah . Personality . To amuse himself , and possibly to gain bargaining power with higher - ranking devils , Lorcan collected warlock s and had a complete set of the Toril thirteen warlocks .
description_long: Lorcan Lorcan was a cambion and the sole son of the succubus ( formerly erinyes ) Invadiah . Personality . To amuse himself , and possibly to gain bargaining power with higher - ranking devils , Lorcan collected warlock s and had a complete set of the Toril thirteen warlocks . History . In 1477 DR , a young tiefling named Havilar from Tymanther was experimenting with magic when she accidentally summoned Lorcan from Malbolge . Lorcan decided Havilar ' s twin sister Farideh would make a better warlock so he tricked her into entering into a warlock pact . The barn in which the summoning took place exploded after Lorcan was dismissed back to Hell and the villagers discovered what had happened and expelled the twins and their dragonborn father from the village . After their exile from the village , the trio went on the road to work as bounty hunters . Lorcan occasionally dropped in on Farideh to teach her new spells and give her advice . In 1478 DR , the twins and their father were pursuing a bounty on the Sword Coast and journeyed to the city of Neverwinter .

title: Lord Dheolur
description: Lord Dheolur Lord Dheolur was the head of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . He married Threena Cormaeril . His sister was Pella Dheolur .
description_long: Lord Dheolur Lord Dheolur was the head of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . He married Threena Cormaeril . His sister was Pella Dheolur . He wore a suit of black chased and fluted plate armor with a helm , from Chondath , and bore a long slightly curved blade . In 432 DR , Dheolur was killed by King Duar Obarskyr after his house had defected against Cormyr to side with Magrath the Minotaur . Duar severed Dheolur ' s head from his body with the sword Orbyn .

title: Lord Helmstone
description: Lord Helmstone Lord Helmstone was the lord of the Helmstone noble family of Cormyr around 1372 DR . He believed Laspeera should be Royal Mage and that the still - living members of the Obarskyr royal family to be decadent . He may have been plotting against the Obarskyrs or the current Royal Mage .
description_long: Lord Helmstone Lord Helmstone was the lord of the Helmstone noble family of Cormyr around 1372 DR . He believed Laspeera should be Royal Mage and that the still - living members of the Obarskyr royal family to be decadent . He may have been plotting against the Obarskyrs or the current Royal Mage . Caladnei . He had his son approach Laspeera , but he handled the encounter clumsily .

title: Lord Sage of Phlan
description: Lord Sage of Phlan The Lord Sage of Phlan was a sage in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The Lord was a taciturn and reserved individual .
description_long: Lord Sage of Phlan The Lord Sage of Phlan was a sage in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The Lord was a taciturn and reserved individual . He was slow to show his emotions but despised troubles in his library . Activities . The Lord Sage was the caretaker of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan . In his free time he studied Denlor ' s Tower History . In 1489 DR , two newly hired scribes , Spernik and Tibeem , were discovered stealing books from the Lord ' s private chambers . Tibeem killed one of the summoned Knights of the Black Fist and was captured , but Spernik escaped . So the Lord Sage hired an adventuring party to find the thief and the stolen books . After the coup of Vorgansharax in conjuration with Harpers he sent adventurers to explore the Yarash ' s pyramid . Later Vorgansharax trapped the Lord Sage inside his library in Phlan but he knew too much . Thank to an adventuring party hired by the resistance he managed to escape Phlan .

title: Lord Wolf
description: Lord Wolf " Lord Wolf " was the title adopted by a brigand who once ruled over the area of Highbank Forest in the Vast . History . Styling himself as " Lord Wolf " , he laid claim to the area and the ruined keep atop the local hill and set himself up as its ruler .
description_long: Lord Wolf " Lord Wolf " was the title adopted by a brigand who once ruled over the area of Highbank Forest in the Vast . History . Styling himself as " Lord Wolf " , he laid claim to the area and the ruined keep atop the local hill and set himself up as its ruler . He lived in hiding in an outlying cottage , and only rallied his followers at the keep prior to a raid . For many years , Lord Wolf and his gang preyed upon caravans , until the cities of Ravens Bluff and Tantras together raised an army to crush the bandit lord . Later , the villagers of Highbank Forest mistakenly remembered the keep as the base of Lord Wolf .

title: Lords ' Alliance
description: Lords ' Alliance The Lords ' Alliance , also known as the Council of Lords , is a partnership of merchant cities , founded in 1325 DR . Its members are from the North and Western Heartlands , Waterdeep , Silverymoon , and Neverwinter , as well as other free cities and towns in the region , which make up the bulk of the organization . It was formed to oppose the growing influence of the Black Network in the North , as well as the Shadow Thieves of Amn who have clawed out a foothold for themselves in Waterdeep once more .
description_long: Lords ' Alliance The Lords ' Alliance , also known as the Council of Lords , is a partnership of merchant cities , founded in 1325 DR . Its members are from the North and Western Heartlands , Waterdeep , Silverymoon , and Neverwinter , as well as other free cities and towns in the region , which make up the bulk of the organization . It was formed to oppose the growing influence of the Black Network in the North , as well as the Shadow Thieves of Amn who have clawed out a foothold for themselves in Waterdeep once more . The alliance has hired adventurers to work for them in the past for tasks ranging from gathering simple information , or even for use in raids against Zhentarim strongholds and outposts . Local adventurers can quickly gain status , as well as powerful friends by helping the alliance , but can just as easily make enemies of the sinister Zhentarim as a result . During the Cult of the Dragon plot , The Tyranny of Dragons , the Alliance was one of the many factions who rose up to oppose Tiamat ' s attempt at freedom . Member Towns and Cities . They include the following cities ( not a complete list ) : Alliance Members and Leaders in 1488 DR .

title: Lords of Waterdeep
description: Lords of Waterdeep The Lords of Waterdeep are the ruling council who have ruled the city of Waterdeep for the most of the last 300 years . Throughout that time , there have been between 50 and 80 lords , four of whom have reigned as Open Lord . The Lords come from all walks of life and while predominantly comprised of human s , has had members of various races throughout the Realms .
description_long: Lords of Waterdeep The Lords of Waterdeep are the ruling council who have ruled the city of Waterdeep for the most of the last 300 years . Throughout that time , there have been between 50 and 80 lords , four of whom have reigned as Open Lord . The Lords come from all walks of life and while predominantly comprised of human s , has had members of various races throughout the Realms . While no other Lords are formally named , some individuals become the subject of widespread rumors that can even become a general consensus . The penalty for impersonating a Lord , whether by dressing in a set of their indentical clothing or by a false claim is punishable by the imposter ' s immediate execution . The Lords only appear in public when deliberating on high crimes or when asked to by the lower court but even then only four generally appear and one is always the Open Lord : Piergeiron . All save him wear black formless masks and robes and speak through the Open Lord , Piergeiron , to keep their identities secret . Open Lord . The Open Lord of Waterdeep is the sole member of the Lords of Waterdeep whose identity is publicly known .

title: Lords of the Golden Hills
description: Lords of the Golden Hills The Lords of the Golden Hills was the collective name given to the gnome pantheon . It consisted of the gnomish god s that resided on the plane of the Golden Hills , and Urdlen . The pantheon , led by Garl Glittergold , consisted of : Legends speak of the existence of several goddesses in the gnomish pantheon , but their stories are long lost to history .
description_long: Lords of the Golden Hills The Lords of the Golden Hills was the collective name given to the gnome pantheon . It consisted of the gnomish god s that resided on the plane of the Golden Hills , and Urdlen . The pantheon , led by Garl Glittergold , consisted of : Legends speak of the existence of several goddesses in the gnomish pantheon , but their stories are long lost to history . There was a tradition among gnomish youth to claim divine inspiration to go in search of the Ladies of the Golden Hills , rather than admit that adventure was calling them to leave their close - knit gnomish families .

title: Lords of the Nine Heavens
description: Lords of the Nine Heavens The Lords of the Nine Heavens were members of the Lotus Court , the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . In reality , only two members of the Lords of the Nine Heavens amounted to anything more than lackeys of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne .
description_long: Lords of the Nine Heavens The Lords of the Nine Heavens were members of the Lotus Court , the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . In reality , only two members of the Lords of the Nine Heavens amounted to anything more than lackeys of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne . These were the Emperor ' s consort and his most skilled general .

title: Lords of the Tempest
description: Lords of the Tempest The Lords of the Tempest were an rumored organization of wizard s that served the god Talos . Known only in rumor , the Lords of the Tempest were a mysterious group . They were said to be wizard s who specialized in elemental magic in exotic combinations .
description_long: Lords of the Tempest The Lords of the Tempest were an rumored organization of wizard s that served the god Talos . Known only in rumor , the Lords of the Tempest were a mysterious group . They were said to be wizard s who specialized in elemental magic in exotic combinations .

title: Loregiver
description: Loregiver The Loregiver , also called the Handmaiden of Fate or the Maiden of Beauty , was one of the most prominent figures in Zakharan history , though some believed her to be nothing more than a myth . History . Fate chose a beautiful young girl upon whom to bestow her knowledge .
description_long: Loregiver The Loregiver , also called the Handmaiden of Fate or the Maiden of Beauty , was one of the most prominent figures in Zakharan history , though some believed her to be nothing more than a myth . History . Fate chose a beautiful young girl upon whom to bestow her knowledge . This girl , who was later called the Loregiver , penned the sacred scrolls that would one day become the basis for the Law of the Loregiver . She hid the scrolls within a cave in the desert , knowing full well that the people of Zakhara were not ready to receive the wisdom of Fate . The scrolls were found centuries later by a young man who eventually united Zakhara and became the first Grand Caliph .

title: Lorelei Gravesower
description: Lorelei Gravesower Lorelei Gravesower was a female half - elf cleric of Kelemvor who tended the Kelemvor ' s Garden cemetery in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . Lorelei became caretaker of the graveyard in the 1360s DR , renaming it from the " Thunderstone Cemetery " .
description_long: Lorelei Gravesower Lorelei Gravesower was a female half - elf cleric of Kelemvor who tended the Kelemvor ' s Garden cemetery in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . Lorelei became caretaker of the graveyard in the 1360s DR , renaming it from the " Thunderstone Cemetery " . Activities . Living out of a small house on the grounds of the cemetery , Lorelei ' s task was to provide counselling and advice to the grieving and conduct maintenance on the cemetery . Rumors . A scurrilous rumor told that a woman dwelling in a hut beside the cemetery ( perhaps Lorelei herself ) would sell her favors to a man for a night , but this was a lie .

title: Loremaster
description: Loremaster The loremaster is a prestige class . Spellcasters who have a love for uncovering lost knowledge and gathering huge amounts of eclectic information choose to become loremasters in order to enhance their ability to use this knowledge to its maximum effect . As a loremaster becomes experienced in gathering and using the knowledge he has obtained , he gains the ability to speak additional languages , remember tiny tidbits of helpful information , and enhance his own abilities .

Spellcasters who have a love for uncovering lost knowledge and gathering huge amounts of eclectic information choose to become loremasters in order to enhance their ability to use this knowledge to its maximum effect . As a loremaster becomes experienced in gathering and using the knowledge he has obtained , he gains the ability to speak additional languages , remember tiny tidbits of helpful information , and enhance his own abilities .

title: Loretaker Creed
description: Loretaker Creed The Loretaker Creed was not one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They advocated a long - term strategy of gathering all forms of information and slowly depleting information held by other races . They did not care about how useful the information was .
description_long: Loretaker Creed The Loretaker Creed was not one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They advocated a long - term strategy of gathering all forms of information and slowly depleting information held by other races . They did not care about how useful the information was . This strengthened their community while weakening rival communities . Bases . The Loretakers were unique to the illithid metropolis of Oryndoll . In Oryndoll , the Loretakers had many places throughout lower Oryndoll named Scriptoriums . History . They were formed in the chaos that erupted in Oryndoll as a result of the duergar uprisings around - 4000 DR . Oryndoll followed the Loretakers strategy to force other races into barbarism for thousands of years after these events . By 1370 DR , they were the second - most powerful Creed in the city , following only the Venerator Creed . The city was nearly united under these two Creeds . They even held influence over their own branch of the military , the Minders . By this year they had also renewed their assaults on surface lorehouses .

title: Lorgru
description: Lorgru Lorgru was an orc and a prince of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . In 1484 DR , Lorgru was the eldest son and heir of the king of Many - Arrows and , like all his dynasty , a moderate who favored peace with human s .
description_long: Lorgru Lorgru was an orc and a prince of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . In 1484 DR , Lorgru was the eldest son and heir of the king of Many - Arrows and , like all his dynasty , a moderate who favored peace with human s . However , Tiago Baenre and Ravel Xorlarrin abducted him and replaced him with a drow assassin who killed the king of Many - Arrows . Framed for the murder , Lorgru was exiled to the Spine of the World , but this exile was short lived . After Bruenor Battlehammer defeated the last of Chief Hartusk ' s forces , Lorgru ' s exile was revoked and he was restored to power as the ruler of Dark Arrow Keep .

title: Lorhanna
description: Lorhanna Lorhanna was a priest of Tempus of Yulash . Activities . Lorhanna took care of the shrine to Tempus in the Red Plumes accampanent in Yulash .
description_long: Lorhanna Lorhanna was a priest of Tempus of Yulash . Activities . Lorhanna took care of the shrine to Tempus in the Red Plumes accampanent in Yulash . History . Lorhanna was exiled from Hillsfar by Torin Nomerthal because disagreed use of non - human s in the arena . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR during the visit of Torin Nomerthal to the city Lorhanna possibly joined an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil to tried to remove from power the First Lord . She spoke to gain the support of the soldiers . Personality . Lorhanna believed dishonorable forced untrained warrior to fight to the death for the amusement of others .

title: Lorien Dawnbringer
description: Lorien Dawnbringer Lorien Dawnbringer was a priestess of Sune in Waterdeep . She was a very good friend of Ilira Nathalan and the two were rumored to be lovers although it ' s doubtful they had a physical relationship because Ilira ' s spellscar prevented her from touching another person . Lorien spent time skulking around Downshadow , healing adventurers who had taken on more than they could handle .
description_long: Lorien Dawnbringer Lorien Dawnbringer was a priestess of Sune in Waterdeep . She was a very good friend of Ilira Nathalan and the two were rumored to be lovers although it ' s doubtful they had a physical relationship because Ilira ' s spellscar prevented her from touching another person . Lorien spent time skulking around Downshadow , healing adventurers who had taken on more than they could handle . In 1479 DR in an attempt to gain a measure of revenge on Ilira , Beshaba ' s high priest , Lilten , had Lorien killed by one of his minions , the dwarf Rath .

title: Lorn Tauth
description: Lorn Tauth Lorn Tauth was a cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Alfun Deeprock discovered the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron .
description_long: Lorn Tauth Lorn Tauth was a cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Alfun Deeprock discovered the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron . They organized an expedition before the rightful owner of the mine , Leleanor , could claim it . However , as Alfun and Lorn found the Seed , they were confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired by Leleanor to explore the mine for her .

title: Lorne Starling
description: Lorne Starling Lorne Starling was a fighter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War and the older brother of Bevil Starling . History . Lorne was the older brother of Bevil Starling and son of Retta Starling .
description_long: Lorne Starling Lorne Starling was a fighter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War and the older brother of Bevil Starling . History . Lorne was the older brother of Bevil Starling and son of Retta Starling . He was once the undisputed champion of the West Harbor Harvest Brawl for three years and a good friend of Cormick . However , Cormick also wanted to become the Harvest champion . Knowing he had no chance of winning if he took on Lorne head - on , Cormick instead waited and bided his time until Lorne let his guard down and then , with a flurry of blows , knocked Lorne out . After the defeat , Lorne felt that Cormick had cheated him and became more reclusive .
