After Cormick left the village to enter the Neverwinter City Watch , Lorne also went to the city , joining the Greycloaks army , seeing this as his opportunity to shine . But the war against Luskan left Lorne greatly embittered for the many friends dead and the jealously of his captain . Afterward , Lorne disappeared , and he became a member of the Circle of Blades , a secret Luskan assassination squad . He was recruited by the ambassador Torio Claven and later worked directly under Black Garius .

title: Loross
description: Loross Loross was the Netherese noble tongue and one of the languages of the people of the City of Shade . Speakers . During the empire of Netheril , the Netherese people were divided by class .
description_long: Loross Loross was the Netherese noble tongue and one of the languages of the people of the City of Shade . Speakers . During the empire of Netheril , the Netherese people were divided by class . The nobles lived in High Netheril , in the floating cities above , while most commoners and the middle class lived in Low Netheril on the ground below . The nobles spoke Loross , while the commoners and inhabitants of Low Netheril spoke its sister language Netherese . High Netheril fell in - 339 DR , and the majority of Loross ' speakers died in that catastrophe . By 1372 DR , Loross was considered a dead language . It was considered unlikely that anyone alive at that time knew its proper pronunciation . However , in that same year , the City of Shade returned from the Plane of Shadow . ( " Thultanthar " meant " shade " in Loross . ) Its inhabitants were remnants of the ancient Netherese city of Thultanthar , so presumably , its rulers , who became the shade s , spoke Loross . In addition to the shades , all members of the Cult of the Shattered Peak , a secret society dedicated to preventing Netherese magic from being rediscovered , were required to speak Loross . Script .

title: Lorragauth
description: Lorragauth Lorragauth , the Chained Wyrm , was a gargantuan black dragon who lived in Neverwinter Wood centuries prior to 1479 DR . He lived a long life as a dragon , amassing a great hoard . However , when Lorragauth sensed the coming of the end of his days , he tried to destroy all the lands in his domain in malice and spite .
description_long: Lorragauth Lorragauth , the Chained Wyrm , was a gargantuan black dragon who lived in Neverwinter Wood centuries prior to 1479 DR . He lived a long life as a dragon , amassing a great hoard . However , when Lorragauth sensed the coming of the end of his days , he tried to destroy all the lands in his domain in malice and spite . Unfortunately for him , in his path of destruction , he spotted the amethyst dragon Eldenser . Lorragauth charged at the younger Eldenser , who veered away and almost tore off one of Lorragauth ' s wings . Lorragauth crashed into the Neverwinter Wood and died . Many centuries later , circa 1480 DR , Valindra Shadowmantle planned to raise Lorragauth as a dracolich in order to conquer the city of Neverwinter .

title: Lorthio Bukbukken
description: Lorthio Bukbukken Lorthio Bukbukken was a duergar alchemist in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Until the Rage of Demons , Lorthio had dealings with the corrupt Gorglak .
description_long: Lorthio Bukbukken Lorthio Bukbukken was a duergar alchemist in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Until the Rage of Demons , Lorthio had dealings with the corrupt Gorglak . Activities . Lorthio was an alchemist of Clan Bukbukken and a member of the Gray Ghosts . History . During the Rage of Demons , Lorthio was waiting for a delivery from Droki .

title: Lorthuun
description: Lorthuun Lorthuun was a beholder Zhentarim in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Lorthuun joined the Zhentarim and was appointed to the crucial garrison of Mantol - Derith .
description_long: Lorthuun Lorthuun was a beholder Zhentarim in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Lorthuun joined the Zhentarim and was appointed to the crucial garrison of Mantol - Derith . At one point , it battled a behir , which greatly injured it , losing four of its eyestalks . During the Rage of Demons , it assisted Ghazrim DuLoc in keeping the situation in the trading post under control . It was targeted by the madness - possessed drow assassin Kinyel Druu ' giir . Relationships . Lorthuun had with Ghazrim DuLoc , the main delegate of the garrison , a relationship like that of a married couple , bickering and insulting each other but knowing both were loyal to the Black Network .

title: Losifan Urdo
description: Losifan Urdo Losifan Urdo was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Losifan was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .
description_long: Losifan Urdo Losifan Urdo was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Losifan was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate . He was responsible for discipline and training together with Mannin . Losifan was kind of a dandy . History . In his youth , Losifan was a duelist . Initially , he joined the Guild as a recruit but impressed Palla so much that she hired him permanently .

title: Lost Dragon of Waterdeep
description: Lost Dragon of Waterdeep The Lost Dragon of Waterdeep was a painting owned by Lord Narrovan Eagleshield of Waterdeep . The painting was tied to the Legend of the Lost Dragon which claimed a blue or white dragon was trapped in some object inside the city . Description .
description_long: Lost Dragon of Waterdeep The Lost Dragon of Waterdeep was a painting owned by Lord Narrovan Eagleshield of Waterdeep . The painting was tied to the Legend of the Lost Dragon which claimed a blue or white dragon was trapped in some object inside the city . Description . The painting was a lifelike depiction of four young humans in a wooded garden gazing at a statue of a dragon . History . During a noble revel at Lord Eagleshield ' s mansion in 1479 DR , several nobles reported the painting spoke to them . The Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors was alerted to the phenomenon and investigated but claimed the painting could not be the Lost Dragon because the real Lost Dragon hung in a chamber in Piergieron ' s Palace .

title: Lost Lovers ' Pool
description: Lost Lovers ' Pool Lost Lovers ' Pool was a pool hidden within a cave in Shalanar Barony in Erlkazar . Description . The pool was located hidden within a coastal cave along Shalane Lake , north of the city of Llorbauth .
description_long: Lost Lovers ' Pool Lost Lovers ' Pool was a pool hidden within a cave in Shalanar Barony in Erlkazar . Description . The pool was located hidden within a coastal cave along Shalane Lake , north of the city of Llorbauth . History . The pool was so named because of a legend about a newlywed couple who mysteriously vanished in the pool and were never seen again .

title: Lost Messenger
description: Lost Messenger The Lost Messenger was a ghost that could be found wandering the Battle of Bones . Description . The Lost Messenger appeared as a transparent young boy .
description_long: Lost Messenger The Lost Messenger was a ghost that could be found wandering the Battle of Bones . Description . The Lost Messenger appeared as a transparent young boy . Activities . Each night at the three o ' clock hour , the Lost Messenger wandered both sides of the battlefield for five minutes before disappearing , almost as if he was still trying to deliver his fateful message . History . Though his real name remained unknown , the Lost Messenger served as a messenger between commanders of the human army during the actual Battle of Bones in 1090 DR . Minutes before the initial clash of forces , the young boy became lost in the darkness and wavered in front of the assembled mass of Izac Uthor ' s horde of goblin s and orcs . Claiming first blood of a battle was very important to the goblinkind . The boy was run down as Uthor ' s army surged forward . Rumors and Legend . The Lost Messenger appeared on occasion in the court of King Azoun IV of Cormyr . Vangerdahast was confused by these seemingly random visits , but the priest s of Tyr believed the Messenger appeared seeking to blame Artur Blevin , or one of his living ancestors , for his death .

title: Lost Peaks
description: Lost Peaks The Lost Peaks were two mountains located in the High Forest . Description . These mountains full of forests dominated the north - western area of the High Forest .
description_long: Lost Peaks The Lost Peaks were two mountains located in the High Forest . Description . These mountains full of forests dominated the north - western area of the High Forest . Many fey lived nearby . A large tribe of centaur s kept away the hunters coming from Olostin ' s Hold . A dwarven fortress lay for a long time under the Lost Peaks . A thousand years ago , a curse or an epidemy occurred in this area , exterminating the entire population whose remains were found next to their forge and in their homes .

title: Lost Refuge
description: Lost Refuge The Lost Refuge was a Cormyr ean keep placed near the border of the Vast Swamp . It was built in 1227 DR . It supported a town as well but in the mid – 13th century DR , the combination of the expanding swamp and an orc attack killed the garrison and Cormyreans subsequently forgot all about the place .
description_long: Lost Refuge The Lost Refuge was a Cormyr ean keep placed near the border of the Vast Swamp . It was built in 1227 DR . It supported a town as well but in the mid – 13th century DR , the combination of the expanding swamp and an orc attack killed the garrison and Cormyreans subsequently forgot all about the place . It was shortly thereafter conquered by hobgoblin s but more recently fell into the hands of Sharran cultists . Legend has it that the Dusk Lord of Sessrendale opened up a planar rift to the Plane of Shadow in this keep after fleeing from his former homeland .

title: Lost Temple of the Fey Gods
description: Lost Temple of the Fey Gods Lost Temple of the Fey Gods , designed by Bill W . Baldwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the Yuirwood , fey , and the Cult of Voldini .
description_long: Lost Temple of the Fey Gods Lost Temple of the Fey Gods , designed by Bill W . Baldwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the Yuirwood , fey , and the Cult of Voldini . Summary . The adventure starts off in the village of Halendos , where adventurers investigate accounts of problems with fey creatures in the area . Upon venturing into the nearby woods , the adventurers encounter a group of pixie s , who playfully test the group to either entertaining them or their pet ogre . When midnight falls , the Temple of the Yuir Gods emerges and the adventurers must battle past its guardians to gain access to the inner sanctum . There they find a dying dryad , Nimiwi , and eventually confront the source of the fey troubles , the Cult of Voldini .

title: Lostmauth
description: Lostmauth Lostmauth was a red dragon living on the isle of Tuern in the Trackless Sea . History . The Cult of the Dragon sent their leader , Severin himself , to bargain with Lostmauth for the red dragon mask .
description_long: Lostmauth Lostmauth was a red dragon living on the isle of Tuern in the Trackless Sea . History . The Cult of the Dragon sent their leader , Severin himself , to bargain with Lostmauth for the red dragon mask . Severin also convinced the mighty dragon to lay waste to the city of Neverwinter , but Lostmauth was slain by adventurers before he could do so .

title: Losvius Longnose
description: Losvius Longnose Losvius Longnose was a teamster on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Losvius ' s surname derived not from his big nose but from his overpowering thirst for gossip about other people .
description_long: Losvius Longnose Losvius Longnose was a teamster on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Losvius ' s surname derived not from his big nose but from his overpowering thirst for gossip about other people . Losvius was fixated on uncovering others ' embarrassing secrets . History . Around 1489 DR , Losvius acted as a teamster for a great caravan that , unknown to him , was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Lothan Durncaskyn
description: Lothan Durncaskyn Lothan Durncaskyn was a lord of Cormyr . Activities . Lothan was the lord of Immerford in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr .
description_long: Lothan Durncaskyn Lothan Durncaskyn was a lord of Cormyr . Activities . Lothan was the lord of Immerford in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr . He was also the liaison between Castle Irlingstar and the king . History . Lothan was a veteran Purple Dragons that had often proved his loyalty and his ability . . In 1480 DR , Lothan was informed of the death of seneschal Marthin Avathnar inside Castle Irlingstar but he had no War Wizards to send as reinforcements . Plus , he had three other troubles in his land : a group of outlaws preying upon caravans , an unseen thief , and a possible crazy wizard in Hullack Forest . Some time later , Mirt and the tax collector Rensharra Ironstave asked for his help and protection . At last , Storm Silverhand and some of her new Harper agents delivered to Lord Durncaskyn all he needed to clear the region of it problems . Relationship . Lothan had the absolute trust of King Foril and of Crown Prince Irvel . .

title: Lothan Maergh
description: Lothan Maergh Lothan Maergh was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Abilities . Watchful Brother Lothan was a horticulturist that specialized in the production and storage of bulbs and seeds as well as grafting techniques .
description_long: Lothan Maergh Lothan Maergh was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Abilities . Watchful Brother Lothan was a horticulturist that specialized in the production and storage of bulbs and seeds as well as grafting techniques .

title: Lothen of the Silver Spires
description: Lothen of the Silver Spires Lothen of the Silver Spires was a set of ruins of an ancient elven city located in the western side of the High Forest . Description . The ancient city once marked the southern boundary of Siluvanede , which was a sun elven kingdom .
description_long: Lothen of the Silver Spires Lothen of the Silver Spires was a set of ruins of an ancient elven city located in the western side of the High Forest . Description . The ancient city once marked the southern boundary of Siluvanede , which was a sun elven kingdom . It wasn ' t very far from the dwarf ruin known as Hall of Four Ghosts . The city was overrun by orc s of the Sharpspike , Tanglethorn , and Horned Lord tribes . These tribes were the largest orc community surviving in the High Forest . These orcs were Malar worshipers and their leaders were vicious ranger s and druids .

title: Lotil
description: Lotil Lotil was a blind featherworker in Palul . History . Lotil was the father of both Erixitl and Shatil and a featherworker of renown .
description_long: Lotil Lotil was a blind featherworker in Palul . History . Lotil was the father of both Erixitl and Shatil and a featherworker of renown . In 1361 DR , he met Erixitl again after she ' d spent years as a slave in Kultaka , when she and Halloran went to Palul on the road to Nexal . He survived the Night of Wailing by hiding in his house , and kept safe Coton , the patriarch of Qotal . He and the priest met Erixitl and Halloran again in Tewacha , where at last the god Qotal reappeared . At last in Twin Visages ' s pyramid he sacrificed himself in order to attract all the drider s out of the pyramid , killing all them .

title: Lotus Court
description: Lotus Court The Lotus Court was the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . History . The Lotus Court was comprised of nobles from among the population of yak - folk inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in the Land of the Yak - Men .
description_long: Lotus Court The Lotus Court was the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . History . The Lotus Court was comprised of nobles from among the population of yak - folk inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in the Land of the Yak - Men . The most powerful group within the Lotus Court , and therefore the closest to the emperor ' s ear , were the Lords of the Nine Heavens . Activities . Though the Lotus Emperor had the final say in anything regarding the Empire , the Lotus Court offered him council and advice on a multitude of issues .

title: Loudwater
description: Loudwater Loudwater was a city that sat on the confluence of the Delimbiyr and Greyflow rivers . Much reduced since its heyday , it still offered a well - defended rest stop for caravans and riverboats despite the ruination of its neighbours after the Spellplague . History .
description_long: Loudwater Loudwater was a city that sat on the confluence of the Delimbiyr and Greyflow rivers . Much reduced since its heyday , it still offered a well - defended rest stop for caravans and riverboats despite the ruination of its neighbours after the Spellplague . History . The great dwarven craftsman Iirikos Stoneshoulder of Ammarindar built an ornate bridge across the Delimbiyr River in 149 DR for some elven friends of his . These elves , who were members of two moon elf families who followed Labelas Enoreth , built a school of philosophy on the north bank of the river . Constructing homes around the school , which they named the Velti ’ Enorethal , the site grew into a small town . The population grew again when Earlann i sun elves applied to join the school . Later , humans descended from the survivors of Netheril discovered the town and built their own houses , bringing human ideals to the expanding settlement . Though most of the humans lived separately from the elves on the south bank of the river , their influence still upset the elven natives and in 1100 DR , the elves began slowly leaving their homes for Evereska .

title: Loumara
description: Loumara The loumaras are a relatively new demon ic race , much younger than the tanar ' ri . They are still centuries old , but this is still recent in a place like the Abyss , where time doesn ' t mean the same thing it does on the Material Plane . As a result , few loumaras have yet become powerful enough to be recognized as demon lord s ; Sifkhu , who has been captured by the succubus queen Malcanthet , is perhaps the only one .
description_long: Loumara The loumaras are a relatively new demon ic race , much younger than the tanar ' ri . They are still centuries old , but this is still recent in a place like the Abyss , where time doesn ' t mean the same thing it does on the Material Plane . As a result , few loumaras have yet become powerful enough to be recognized as demon lord s ; Sifkhu , who has been captured by the succubus queen Malcanthet , is perhaps the only one . Loumaras are usually immaterial or invisible demons that are more like ghosts or undead than demons . Most of them possess living creatures or objects in order to more effectively work their evil . The loumara race resulted from the Abyss ' s attempts to digest the dreams and memories of a pantheon of dead gods . This pantheon , a territorial bunch , was killed eons ago by the Abyss itself , when Demogorgon baited them into destroying the layer of one of his rivals ; as the angry gods ripped an entire layer free from the Abyss , the Abyss lashed back , slaying them all so that only their thoughts remained .

title: Love candle
description: Love candle A love candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to be " charmed " by and possibly enamored with the first creature they saw after the candle was extinguished . Description .
description_long: Love candle A love candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to be " charmed " by and possibly enamored with the first creature they saw after the candle was extinguished . Description . This was the first candle that a mystic learned to make when they began their practice of candle magic . The " love candle " was red in color and was intended to be burnt in ten - minute intervals . The longest - lasting candle that could be made burned for ninety minutes . Powers . After burning for the desired amount of time and then being extinguished ( either by blowing , snuffing , dousing , or reaching the end of its wick ) , the " love candle " caused an effect similar to a highly potent " philter of love " . The subject ( s ) became " charmed " by the first creature they saw and remained " charmed " one day for every ten minutes the " love candle " was allowed to burn . This effect worked flawlessly on human s , elves , half - elves , demihumans , humanoid s , and fey , even if they were normally immune or resistant to " charm " .

title: Love domain
description: Love domain There are three deities whom after the Spellplague lay claim to the love domain . One of them was Sheela Peryroyl who represents romantic love and courtship , especially among halfling s of whom she was the prominent deity . She was more connected to natural beauty rather than to the aesthetics of art .
description_long: Love domain There are three deities whom after the Spellplague lay claim to the love domain . One of them was Sheela Peryroyl who represents romantic love and courtship , especially among halfling s of whom she was the prominent deity . She was more connected to natural beauty rather than to the aesthetics of art . Sune , was the second deity whom called to her followers to find and collect beauty in all forms and things . Love must be shown daily . Many nobles in cities followed the teachings of lady firehair who thrived on her followers love . And lastly there was Kiltzi the Maztica n goddess of love , lust , and fertility . She did not desire material gifts from her followers , rather loving acts between a man and a woman was considered a form of devotion . Power Of Love domain . Any divine caster that worshipped a god that claimed the love domain may use the Love Domain . As the divine caster whom chooses to channel the love domain will become more diplomatic .

title: Loviatar
description: Loviatar Loviatar ( pronounced " loh - VEE - a - tar " ) , also known as The Maiden of Pain and The Willing Whip , was the evil goddess of agony and was both queen and servant to the greater god Bane . Loviatar was a cold - hearted bully , calculating and despotic ; she was the master of inflicting physical and psychological suffering and her portfolio included Pain , Hurt and Torture . Her symbol was a nine - stranded whip , with barbed strands .
description_long: Loviatar Loviatar ( pronounced " loh - VEE - a - tar " ) , also known as The Maiden of Pain and The Willing Whip , was the evil goddess of agony and was both queen and servant to the greater god Bane . Loviatar was a cold - hearted bully , calculating and despotic ; she was the master of inflicting physical and psychological suffering and her portfolio included Pain , Hurt and Torture . Her symbol was a nine - stranded whip , with barbed strands . Worshipers . Bringing pain and suffering was the aim of all Loviatans , either through physical torture or sometimes more subtly and psychologically . Beauty , intelligence and acting were useful attributes of a Loviatan , but the ability to fully understand someone was the best skill a Loviatan could acquire , as knowing someone fully could help a Loviatan inflict maximum pain , one way or another . Loviatar ' s followers were encouraged to wipe Ilmater ' s followers from the face of the Realms . Loviatans often engaged in self - flagellation , often in the morning when praying for spells .

title: Low - light vision
description: Low - light vision Low - light vision extends the distance a creature can see in conditions of low light , rather than allowing vision in no light like darkvision . In previous editions , low - light and dark visions were known as infravision and was used to describe the ability to detect infrared signatures .
description_long: Low - light vision Low - light vision extends the distance a creature can see in conditions of low light , rather than allowing vision in no light like darkvision . In previous editions , low - light and dark visions were known as infravision and was used to describe the ability to detect infrared signatures .

title: Low Ulutim languages
description: Low Ulutim languages The term " Low Ulutim " described a grouping of closely related Ulou languages spoken by small populations of people in various Faerûn ian locales . Languages . The Low Ulutim languages were spoken at lower latitudes than the High Ulutim languages .
description_long: Low Ulutim languages The term " Low Ulutim " described a grouping of closely related Ulou languages spoken by small populations of people in various Faerûn ian locales . Languages . The Low Ulutim languages were spoken at lower latitudes than the High Ulutim languages . The following were Low Ulutim languages :

title: Lower planes
description: Lower planes The lower planes ( sometimes Lower Planes ) is a collective term used in the Great Wheel cosmology model to represent the Outer planes of Evil alignment , located across the bottom of the Great Wheel . These are Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium . The only other thing these planes have in common is the river Styx which flows through at least one level of each Evil plane .
description_long: Lower planes The lower planes ( sometimes Lower Planes ) is a collective term used in the Great Wheel cosmology model to represent the Outer planes of Evil alignment , located across the bottom of the Great Wheel . These are Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium . The only other thing these planes have in common is the river Styx which flows through at least one level of each Evil plane . The World Tree cosmology model rearranged , renamed , and reorganized the lower planes into the Fiendish Planes but some people still use the older term to describe the evil - aligned planes .

title: Loxo
description: Loxo Loxos appear as large humanoid elephants with two trunks and bluish - gray skin . They roam the Shaar in hunter - gatherer groups . Peaceful in nature , Loxos prefer to be left alone and have little contact with other sentient races .
description_long: Loxo Loxos appear as large humanoid elephants with two trunks and bluish - gray skin . They roam the Shaar in hunter - gatherer groups . Peaceful in nature , Loxos prefer to be left alone and have little contact with other sentient races . They often worship the giant deity Hiatea . Loxos first appeared in Faerûn in the 12th century DR , possibly arriving from another world . Combat . Loxos can attack with their trunks although they often use traditional weapons as well . They also have the ability to trample smaller opponents and may go beserk if a clan member is seriously harmed .

title: Loy Ho - dun
description: Loy Ho - dun Loy Ho - dun was a kensai adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Loy Ho - dun had a great natural talent for swordsmanship .
description_long: Loy Ho - dun Loy Ho - dun was a kensai adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Loy Ho - dun had a great natural talent for swordsmanship . He studied more than twelve different styles and mastered two before developing his own personal style , the Dragon Swarm . Afterward , Ho - dun opened his school in the hills north of Shangtou in the Ch ' ing Tung province to teach Dragon Swarm style , and students begged to enroll . However , he was often away , duel against other kensai in order to learn more . In 1358 DR , Ho - dun decided to attend the Komite . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Loy Ho - dun was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Shou Lung .

title: Loyalists
description: Loyalists The Loyalists were a faction of the holy slayer organization known as the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Activities . The Loyalists were the only faction within the Everlasting to truly remain faithful to the Shadow Caliph , hence their name .
description_long: Loyalists The Loyalists were a faction of the holy slayer organization known as the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Activities . The Loyalists were the only faction within the Everlasting to truly remain faithful to the Shadow Caliph , hence their name . If the Shadow Caliph were to die , the Loyalists would not hesitate to consolidate as much power as they could . Members . As of 1367 DR , 142 members of the Loyalists dwelt within the fortress of Sarahin . Yusuf bin Ayyub was the leader of the Loyalists .

title: Lu - che
description: Lu - che Lu - che , also known as Sensei Lu - che , was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Activities . Lu - che , training under Master Taembak Duahl in Shou Tu ' lung , earned a 6th - degree black belt in the Four Keys style of kung fu .
description_long: Lu - che Lu - che , also known as Sensei Lu - che , was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Activities . Lu - che , training under Master Taembak Duahl in Shou Tu ' lung , earned a 6th - degree black belt in the Four Keys style of kung fu . Lu - che acted as the commander of the sohei detachment at the Temple of True Enlightenment in Suijeng . As was the custom of the temple , Lu - che and his men taught martial arts to local people for a modest fee . From this practice , Lu - che became known across the province as Sensei Lu - che . History . In 1358 DR , Lu - che went to participate at the Komite , which was held on the grounds of his temple . He had many advantages by fighting in a familiar place and knowing well the tournament ' s rules , but many would expect his victory , putting Lu - che under tremendous pressure . Lu - che managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists .

title: Luc Sunbright
description: Luc Sunbright Luc Sunbright was a priest of Amaunator in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Luc led the worship of Amaunator at the Morninglow Tower .
description_long: Luc Sunbright Luc Sunbright was a priest of Amaunator in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Luc led the worship of Amaunator at the Morninglow Tower . Personality . Luc was a self - important and blustery individual . He was very conscious about class differences and always dismissed farmers and merchants from the tower if more wealthier folk needed it .

title: Lucan Greenharrow
description: Lucan Greenharrow Lucan Greenharrow was an elf wizard who resided at the Hosttower of the Arcane in Luskan , before stealing lore from the tower and relocating to Neverwinter to begin a new life , where he co - founded the Waterclock Guild . Background . Lucan discovered tendrils of magic beneath the tower , and found that they appeared to pull elemental power from the sea itself , and channel it to the south .
description_long: Lucan Greenharrow Lucan Greenharrow was an elf wizard who resided at the Hosttower of the Arcane in Luskan , before stealing lore from the tower and relocating to Neverwinter to begin a new life , where he co - founded the Waterclock Guild . Background . Lucan discovered tendrils of magic beneath the tower , and found that they appeared to pull elemental power from the sea itself , and channel it to the south . Upon learning this , and also learning that he appeared to be alone in this knowledge , he relocated to Neverwinter to begin a new life and attempt to uncover the mystery further . In Neverwinter , Lucan became acquainted with a waterclock maker named Saborn Rendel . They founded the Waterclock Guild , in which Lucan used his magic to create clocks that were both accurate and beautiful . Lucan constructed the crypts beneath the guild , expanding them with the magic he had learned , until it became a sprawling dungeon . The walls of the dungeon contained translucent veins through which sea water flowed .

title: Lucia Thione - Hhune
description: Lucia Thione - Hhune Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune was a female human who went on to become a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield , due in part to her being the wife of Inselm Hhune , the Duke of Kamlann and the First Lord of the Shield . Description . Lucia was a pretty , chestnut - haired lady , though cold .
description_long: Lucia Thione - Hhune Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune was a female human who went on to become a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield , due in part to her being the wife of Inselm Hhune , the Duke of Kamlann and the First Lord of the Shield . Description . Lucia was a pretty , chestnut - haired lady , though cold . Activities . In addition to being duchess - consort of Kamlann , Lucia was one of eight Councilors of the city of Zazesspur , representing the Ships District ( though her manor was in the Garden District ) . In this role , she bore a strong influence on politics in the city . She was also second - in - command of the Shippers ' Guild of Zazesspur . History . Lucia was a distant cousin of the Tethyr ian royal family and was very young when she entered the Knights of the Shield . Lucia had been a long - time resident of Waterdeep and joined the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield when she convinced that group that she was a Masked Lord of that city .

title: Luenath
description: Luenath Luenath was the second - largest city in Dambrath . Geography . Situated on the west bank of the River Caraguir where it emptied into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins , Luenath was a prime port city that easily supported the bulk of Dambrath ' s navy .
description_long: Luenath Luenath was the second - largest city in Dambrath . Geography . Situated on the west bank of the River Caraguir where it emptied into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins , Luenath was a prime port city that easily supported the bulk of Dambrath ' s navy . Description . Wide , open streets lined the city . Luenath did not have a protective wall . History . Many of the ships that harbored in Luenath were pirate vessels or privateers . The steady influx of treasure from these ships strengthened Luenath ' s market with a wide range of goods . Luenath was a favorite location for wealthy crinti to enjoy the fabulous Dance of the Dolphins during the winter months . Armed Forces . Luenath supported a cavalry of 2 , 000 soldiers . Ten warships patrolled the harbor at any given time . Inhabitants . Luenath was home to the Duchess Merial of clan Luenath .

title: Lufala
description: Lufala Lufala was a tasked harim servant genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Lufala was described as being matronly .
description_long: Lufala Lufala was a tasked harim servant genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Lufala was described as being matronly . Activities . She ran the kitchen within the Royal Harim . She prepared many exotic dishes for the Grand Caliph ' s wives and concubines .

title: Lugalpgotak Sea
description: Lugalpgotak Sea The Lugalpgotak Sea was the largest body of water on the Great Glacier and the resting place of the slumbering god Ulutiu . Geography . The Lugalpgotak Sea was located in the center of Alpuk .
description_long: Lugalpgotak Sea The Lugalpgotak Sea was the largest body of water on the Great Glacier and the resting place of the slumbering god Ulutiu . Geography . The Lugalpgotak Sea was located in the center of Alpuk . It was just short of 200 miles ( 320 kilometers ) wide and nearly 800 feet ( 240 meters ) deep . The waters of the sea were contained by high and sheer walls of glacier ice . The sea bed was composed of a 100 - foot ( 30 meter ) layer of rocky debris , beneath which was 500 yards ( 460 meters ) of thick glacier ice . The northern shores of sea were the feet of the Lugalpgotak Range of mountains , but the southern and western shores were flat and suitable locations for settlements . About half of its surface was permanently covered in pack ice . These ice floes ranged in size from a few yards ( meters ) in diameter to massive bodies large enough to carry entire settlements . In winter , the ice cover was so thick that in some of the narrower regions , one could cross the entire lake by hopping from one iceberg to another . The northern and eastern shores contained floating walls hundreds of feet high .

title: Lugh
description: Lugh Lugh was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark History . Lugh was among the 2000 dwarves that accompanied Ironlord Torg mac Cei to join the Army of the Alliance to crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . Following the First Battle of the Golden Way on the 3rd of Flamerule , Princess Alusair Obarskyr of Cormyr detailed Lugh and three other dwarves to escorted the captured commander Batu Min Ho .
description_long: Lugh Lugh was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark History . Lugh was among the 2000 dwarves that accompanied Ironlord Torg mac Cei to join the Army of the Alliance to crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . Following the First Battle of the Golden Way on the 3rd of Flamerule , Princess Alusair Obarskyr of Cormyr detailed Lugh and three other dwarves to escorted the captured commander Batu Min Ho . However , Batu stole a sword , killed Lugh , and then killed himself . Lugh was buried in the dwarves ' communal cairn on the battlefield .

title: Lugsaas Chain
description: Lugsaas Chain The Lugsaas , or " Southern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the south of the Great Glacier , which formed the border with the Cold Lands to the south . Geography . The Lugsaas Chain formed the border between Damara and Vaasa in the south and the Alpuk region in the north .
description_long: Lugsaas Chain The Lugsaas , or " Southern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the south of the Great Glacier , which formed the border with the Cold Lands to the south . Geography . The Lugsaas Chain formed the border between Damara and Vaasa in the south and the Alpuk region in the north . The Lugsaas was the longest and tallest of the three " Saas " , " Shields " , that surrounded and protected the Great Glacier and divided it off from the rest of Toril . This Southern Shield was longer than 1 , 200 miles , stretching from the Tuutsaas Chain northeast of the Tortured Land to the Angsaas Chain and Sossal . There were only a few passes through the Lugsaas , in the lower elevations , and they were both dangerous and narrow . Flora & Fauna . Wild packs of kupuk roamed the lower elevations of the Lugsaas Chain . The peaks were swarming with remorhaz , living in tunnels underneath the ice of the mountains . A rare , silver - colored moss known as ring moss grew within crevasses in the mountains . History .

title: Lui - hsia Chih
description: Lui - hsia Chih Lui - hsia Chin was a wu jen leader of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He led the sixteen members of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru .
description_long: Lui - hsia Chih Lui - hsia Chin was a wu jen leader of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He led the sixteen members of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru . Lui - hsia Chin was gathering forces in Nakamaru , awaiting the day when the society could operate in the light . The Society revived , fostered , and promoted old alliances with the ruling families of the province . Lui - hsia disguised the Society ' s meetings as a literary club studying the classics of Shou Lung . He had made contact with the Black Mist yakuza gang . History . Lui - hsia Chin was one of the founders of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in 857 DR and remained as one of the members of the Inner Council of the Society . In 900 DR , he first fought against Gorath , the hidden leader of Shou Lung ' s Royal Vagabonds . From that time , Lui - hsia had destroyed many of Gorath ' s plots , some against the Society by the emperor ' s command but others more sinister . At the celebration of the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , Lui - hsia Chih sensed something strange coming from the merchant Yin - kung T ' o ( in truth , Gorath in disguise ) .

title: Luiren
description: Luiren Luiren was known as the land of the halfling s since its population was almost completely comprised of their race . It was a small kingdom with a population of about 840 , 000 inhabitants in 1372 DR ruled by the halfling theocrat Faran Ferromar . Travelers to Luiren were often surprised to find the locals adventurous and bold as opposed to the fat and quiet halflings one could find elsewhere .
description_long: Luiren Luiren was known as the land of the halfling s since its population was almost completely comprised of their race . It was a small kingdom with a population of about 840 , 000 inhabitants in 1372 DR ruled by the halfling theocrat Faran Ferromar . Travelers to Luiren were often surprised to find the locals adventurous and bold as opposed to the fat and quiet halflings one could find elsewhere . The capital city of Luiren was Beluir , a coastal city of 27 , 210 souls in 1372 DR in the longitudinal center of the realm . During the Spellplague , the entirety of Luiren was submerged in the Great Sea and was called the Gulf of Luiren . After the Spellplague ended , the waters began to recede , revealing that some halfling communities had survived as island redoubts . Halflings of Luiren spoke Luiric . Geography . Luiren was a coastal country with about 600 miles of coastline on the Great Sea . Most of the coastal area was made up of plains , but heavy forests took up the northern , north eastern and western areas . During the summer months the temperatures in Luiren could exceed 38°C ( 100°F ) and in the winter months it was near constantly raining .

title: Luiren ' s Best
description: Luiren ' s Best Luiren ' s Best was a beer brewed in Luiren by the Smokardin clan . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Luiren ' s Best Luiren ' s Best was a beer brewed in Luiren by the Smokardin clan . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Luiren ' s Best was a heavy stout beer . It was jet - black and had a thick consistency . Luiren ' s Best had a sweet aftertaste . It was the favored beer in Luiren , Halruaa , and the Shining South . Sembia was able to acquire limited quantities on occasion . Prices . Luiren ' s Best could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Luiren spring cheese
description: Luiren spring cheese Luiren spring cheese or cheeeese was a type of cheese that acted as a drug to halfling s . Effect . Foxilon Cardluck described cheeeese as " special , like black opium or booze " .
description_long: Luiren spring cheese Luiren spring cheese or cheeeese was a type of cheese that acted as a drug to halfling s . Effect . Foxilon Cardluck described cheeeese as " special , like black opium or booze " . The drug appeared to affect the halflings similarly to strong wine . The drug was highly addictive , and ex - users had a high chance of relapsing , even for a Hin who knew its horrible effects . The drug would cause sluggishness of body and mind in 4 oz ( 113 g ) use . In use of lb ( 227 g ) or more it could cause fainting , but the Halflings who tried to rid themselves of the addiction got hit with strong cravings for more . If the person couldn ' t get their hands on more in a day the individual would suffer greatly physically , and begin to suffer from cramps and hallucinations . History . It was unknown where cheeeese came from but it was distributed in Luiren and Saerloon , or in Waterdeep with written consent from Piergeiron , Khelben or the leader of a recognised temple . The case in Luiren involved a human named Joribel , who created a dependency amongst halflings to then use them as thieves , robbers , murderers , and sex slaves .

title: Lumachella
description: Lumachella Lumachella , also known as fire marble , was a hardsone found in the Realms . Description . Lumachella was a rare type of dark brown marble that contained tiny fossilized snails with iridescent shells .
description_long: Lumachella Lumachella , also known as fire marble , was a hardsone found in the Realms . Description . Lumachella was a rare type of dark brown marble that contained tiny fossilized snails with iridescent shells . A typical price for large quantities of this hardstone was 26 sp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Powers . Lumachella powder was a substitute material component for the " airy water " and " water breathing " spells . It could also be used in the ink mixture for making scrolls of both spells .

title: Lumalia
description: Lumalia Lumalia was an astral deva prisoner in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lumalia ' s long imprisonment deeply affected her ( she also changed from neutral good to chaotic good ) .
description_long: Lumalia Lumalia was an astral deva prisoner in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lumalia ' s long imprisonment deeply affected her ( she also changed from neutral good to chaotic good ) . She regretted all the time she spent in stasis . Lumalia wanted to bring justice to the Thayan s for their crimes but in the fury of battle she could succumb to a thirst for revenge . History . Centuries before , the Red Wizard Kazit Gul had summoned Lumalia and bound her to the Doomvault . He put her in stasis and compelled her to slay each time she awoke . She sensed the death of Mystra during Spellplague and succumbed to despair . Awoken in 1486 DR at the arrival of heroes from Daggerford , Lumalia sensed something different , she felt the celestial spheres shifting . With this , Gul ' s power over her was broken . She offered her aid to the heroes .

title: Luna
description: Luna Luna was a female human who managed the Selûne ' s Smile tavern in Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . Luna was in truth an avatar of the goddess Selûne , the Moonmaiden , who dwelled among mortals occasionally . History .
description_long: Luna Luna was a female human who managed the Selûne ' s Smile tavern in Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . Luna was in truth an avatar of the goddess Selûne , the Moonmaiden , who dwelled among mortals occasionally . History . The Song of Selûne . Luna ' s past was a part of legend , told in the Song of Selûne . The story began with Selûne as a youthful and beautiful goddess , residing in a mystic realm populated by deities . Turning aside from a life of ease , she was impulsive and grew tired of life in her own plane . Thus , she " borrowed " a wand of power from a god known only as " her father " and used the wand to fly away in a bubble of force , so that she might experience life in other realms . In time , she traveled to a plane with a forbidding blood moon palely glowing over a barren land . There , Selûne was smitten by a mysterious and attractive warrior , a lord of his people . The stranger persuaded her to use the wand to transport him and his followers to Toril , riding upon winged beasts , where they planned to settle . However , once they landed , he revealed his true form and intentions — he was the monstrous Imgig Zu .

title: Lung Jua
description: Lung Jua Lung Jua , colloquially known as the Dragon Claw , was a petty demon of the Celestial Bureaucracy in T ' u Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he approached the Celestial Emperor , saying he had seen in T ' u Lung too many martial arts schools led by poor teachers and the Emperor agreed .
description_long: Lung Jua Lung Jua , colloquially known as the Dragon Claw , was a petty demon of the Celestial Bureaucracy in T ' u Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he approached the Celestial Emperor , saying he had seen in T ' u Lung too many martial arts schools led by poor teachers and the Emperor agreed . So Lung Jua made his proposal : an agent ( obviously himself ) would test all mortal schools and only the worthy ones should survive the challenge . The Emperor considered this a good proposal and granted Lung Jua his blessing , ordering all in the Celestial Bureaucracy not to stop him . However , Lung Jua secretly wished to spread his own martial style , which magically enslaved to his will all martial arts experts who chose to study it , creating a huge army in T ' u Lung . He also stole the life energies of all his slaves in order to power himself . He established himself with all his most loyal followers in Panchengjuduohuh , at the place where a temple of the Black Leopard Cult had fallen into the Underdark a long time before .

title: Luntse Dzong
description: Luntse Dzong Luntse Dzong was a fortress located in eastern Khazari . Location . Nestled within the rocky confines of Ahs Trango Shan , Luntse Dzong was the larger of two fortresses that guarded the entrance into Khazari from the east .
description_long: Luntse Dzong Luntse Dzong was a fortress located in eastern Khazari . Location . Nestled within the rocky confines of Ahs Trango Shan , Luntse Dzong was the larger of two fortresses that guarded the entrance into Khazari from the east . Structure . The fortress was built on a rock shelf 600 ft ( 183 m ) above the floor of the mountain pass , offering splendid views of the surrounding terrain . Luntse Dzong stood three stories high . The upper two stories had windows and wooden balconies . The roofs were wood held down by rocks . Interior . The interior of the fortress housed an armory , barracks , storerooms , a hostel for travelers , and a temple for the Yellow Mountain Sect . Defenses . Luntse Dzong was surrounded on three sides by steep cliffs . A single narrow winding trail was the only way for a sizable force to approach the stronghold . Inhabitants . Five hundred soldiers were stationed at Luntse Dzong , tasked with the security of the pass and the Silk Road that passed through Khazari . A man named Govinda was their commander .

title: Lupe Berrypip
description: Lupe Berrypip Lupe Berrypip was a halfling girl in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Lupe lived with her father , Ombul Berrypip , who was sent to the mine in the Earthspurs as a cook .
description_long: Lupe Berrypip Lupe Berrypip was a halfling girl in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Lupe lived with her father , Ombul Berrypip , who was sent to the mine in the Earthspurs as a cook . When a medusa and her gargoyle minions took control of the mine , Lupe managed to hide herself until an adventuring party hired to clear the mine found and rescued her .

title: Lupinaxe
description: Lupinaxe The Lupinaxe was an enchanted axe whose head resembled a wolf . Powers . It could summon a dire wolf .
description_long: Lupinaxe The Lupinaxe was an enchanted axe whose head resembled a wolf . Powers . It could summon a dire wolf . On contact with a foe , the axe emitted a howling noise like a wolf . If thrown , after contact , the axe would teleport back to the hand of its wielder . History . The axe was used notably by Arun Maerdrym in 464 DR in the Sword of Anauroch to strike the Duskstaff of Sarael . This act killed him and his son Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and eliminated their phaerimm enemies in the process , leaving a crater of glass behind .

title: Luposphinx
description: Luposphinx Luposhinxes were sphinx es with the heads of wolves , found in wooded areas . Description . The luposphinx ' s body was about 7 ft ( 2 .
description_long: Luposphinx Luposhinxes were sphinx es with the heads of wolves , found in wooded areas . Description . The luposphinx ' s body was about 7 ft ( 2 . 1 m ) in length , closest in size to the hieracosphinx . Luposphinxes had canine heads , but like all sphinxes they had feline bodies . The hair on its body ranged from dark gray to light brown . Behavior . Luposphinxes were carnivores and had a taste for elves and halfling s over other humanoid prey . Luposphinxes sometimes liked to travel with humanoid servants . Combat . The luposphinx usually howled once before a battle to disorient its foes , then began with melee attacks .

title: Lurdas Jasperstone
description: Lurdas Jasperstone Lurdas Jasperstone was a member of the Glass - breakers on the Great Spire of the Ice Sea during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Lurdas believed that all of Toril would be immersed in fire , and the greater glory of Gond , if the tower on the island being constructed by a cult of Gond was completed .
description_long: Lurdas Jasperstone Lurdas Jasperstone was a member of the Glass - breakers on the Great Spire of the Ice Sea during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Lurdas believed that all of Toril would be immersed in fire , and the greater glory of Gond , if the tower on the island being constructed by a cult of Gond was completed . Lurdas led missions against the cultists , doing anything within his power to harm the tower or harass their daily work .

title: Lure of Jaws
description: Lure of Jaws Created for the ancient green dragon Aglaraerose , The Lure of Jaws was a lair built by a band of dwarves that were forced to construct it for the she dragon . The lair itself was filled with numerous traps and after its construction rumors were spread by the dwarven builders that a great treasure lied deep within its halls . Leading to the death of countless adventurers .
description_long: Lure of Jaws Created for the ancient green dragon Aglaraerose , The Lure of Jaws was a lair built by a band of dwarves that were forced to construct it for the she dragon . The lair itself was filled with numerous traps and after its construction rumors were spread by the dwarven builders that a great treasure lied deep within its halls . Leading to the death of countless adventurers .

title: Lureene Dundragon
description: Lureene Dundragon Lureene Dundragon was a Zhentarim agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Lureene was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair .
description_long: Lureene Dundragon Lureene Dundragon was a Zhentarim agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Lureene was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair . The Zhent ' s objective was to recover a set of trade maps of the Moonsea from the dragon ' s hoard .

title: Luriyl
description: Luriyl Luriyl , also known as , was a semi - precious stone widespread and popular in the Realms . Description . Found in crystals , luriyl often yielded attractive gem s of vivid yellow , green , yellow - green , and ( rarely ) blue and purple .
description_long: Luriyl Luriyl , also known as , was a semi - precious stone widespread and popular in the Realms . Description . Found in crystals , luriyl often yielded attractive gem s of vivid yellow , green , yellow - green , and ( rarely ) blue and purple . It was a soft stone and easily worked without specialized tools or extensive knowledge and experience , so it was widely used throughout the Realms for ornamentation . Large specimens of blue or purple were in great demand and mostly included in necklaces , pendants , belts , and insets in gowns or cloak s . A typical yellow or green specimen had a base value of 50 gp , blue and purple stones were priced up to six times higher than the other colors . Powers . Luriyl gems were sensitive to scry ing and would give off a soft glow and a gentle vibration when subjected to magical probes such as " clairaudience / clairvoyance " .

title: Lurker cloak
description: Lurker cloak A lurker cloak was a mottled gray cloak that almost looked like it was made out of stone . Upon speaking the cloak ' s command word , the wearer could turn themselves into a lurker for seven minutes . This ability could be used twice a day .
description_long: Lurker cloak A lurker cloak was a mottled gray cloak that almost looked like it was made out of stone . Upon speaking the cloak ' s command word , the wearer could turn themselves into a lurker for seven minutes . This ability could be used twice a day .

title: Lurking regard
description: Lurking regard The lurking regard was a theory supported by a few spellcaster s and scholars . According to this theory , some spell s were self - aware , with consciousness granted by unknown entities . This theory was used to " explain " why some spells sometimes seemed to either aid or thwart certain spellcasters or other creatures that used those spells .
description_long: Lurking regard The lurking regard was a theory supported by a few spellcaster s and scholars . According to this theory , some spell s were self - aware , with consciousness granted by unknown entities . This theory was used to " explain " why some spells sometimes seemed to either aid or thwart certain spellcasters or other creatures that used those spells . Background . According to Elminster Aumar , this theory was based on truth , although it had been exaggerated . The " consciousnesses " that were classified as the " lurking regard " were in fact the same ones that existed within intelligent item s and the so - called living spell s . It was believed by some scholars that an individual named Estel Orvraunt was able to detect and talk to the " lurking regard " of some spells .

title: Lurkwood
description: Lurkwood Lurkwood was a great forest located south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The forest was located north of Grunwald , where the Thunderbeast tribe dwelled within the wood .
description_long: Lurkwood Lurkwood was a great forest located south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The forest was located north of Grunwald , where the Thunderbeast tribe dwelled within the wood . To the east of the wood lay Mithral Hall , the mining community of Mirabar was west , and the town of Nesmé was to the south - east . The edges of Lurkwood were logged by human s , but its shadowy depths were largely mysterious ; plagued with legends of bottomless bogs and deadly quicksand . Inhabitants . A bad reputation fell over the forest due to its inhabitants . The southern area of Lurkwood was safe and attracted loggers , hunters , woodsmen from the neighboring communities of Mirabar , Nesmé , and Longsaddle . The rest of the wood was overrun with evil creatures , such as orc s . Other monsters preyed on those who entered the forest , like ettin s and giant s . Several Uthgardt barbarian tribes lived within the forest as well , such as the Elk , Griffon and Sky Ponies . In the eastern parts of Lurkwood toward Fell Pass , the Gray Wolf Tribe lived and hunted , numbering more than fifty lycanthropes .

title: Luros
description: Luros Luros was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Luros and his fellow cultists observed a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .
description_long: Luros Luros was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Luros and his fellow cultists observed a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node . In a room in the node ' s complex under the monastery , thanks to the elemental forces , Luros switched bodies with a monk , Marren . Later , he met an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find missing monks . The adventurers managed to put Luros back in his body , but he tried to double - crosse them and was killed .

title: Luruar
description: Luruar Luruar , also commonly known as the Silver Marches , was a confederation of cities in the north of Faerûn , under the leadership of Alustriel Silverhand , former ruler of Silverymoon . It consisted of Silverymoon , Citadel Adbar , Deadsnows , Jalanthar , Quaervarr , Citadel Felbarr , Everlund , Mithral Hall , and Sundabar , and its goal was to protect the North against the growing horde of orc s in the mountains . The nation was also a member of the Lords ' Alliance .
description_long: Luruar Luruar , also commonly known as the Silver Marches , was a confederation of cities in the north of Faerûn , under the leadership of Alustriel Silverhand , former ruler of Silverymoon . It consisted of Silverymoon , Citadel Adbar , Deadsnows , Jalanthar , Quaervarr , Citadel Felbarr , Everlund , Mithral Hall , and Sundabar , and its goal was to protect the North against the growing horde of orc s in the mountains . The nation was also a member of the Lords ' Alliance . It was bordered by the Anauroch desert to the east , the High Forest to the south , the Savage Frontier to the west and the Spine of the World mountain range to the north . It also shared a border with the kingdom of Many - Arrows . Moonwood . A large , dense forest dominated by evergreens , shadowtops , and duskwoods , the Moonwood was home to few natural predators and no orcs or goblinoids . Its southern fringes were peaceful enough home to small bands of moon elves and wood elves who roamed its green depths and fair meadows , as well as the rustic homes of woodcutters and trappers .

title: Lurue
description: Lurue Lurue ( pronounced " luh - RUE " ) , also known as the Unicorn Queen or the Queen of Talking Beasts , is a chaotic good archfey who is often worshiped as a goddess of intelligent and talking beasts . Lurue teaches that life is there to be lived , and one should live it with zest and flair . Adventures and quests should be taken on a whim and life should be filled with good times and laughter .
description_long: Lurue Lurue ( pronounced " luh - RUE " ) , also known as the Unicorn Queen or the Queen of Talking Beasts , is a chaotic good archfey who is often worshiped as a goddess of intelligent and talking beasts . Lurue teaches that life is there to be lived , and one should live it with zest and flair . Adventures and quests should be taken on a whim and life should be filled with good times and laughter . She is worshiped by many unicorns , pegasi , and other intelligent non - humanoid creatures , as well as by romantic and swashbuckling adventurers . Although preferring adventure and exploration instead of battle , if forced into a fight she is an intractable foe . Worshipers . Priests of Lurue are often chaotic neutral , neutral good , or chaotic good in alignment and pray for their spells at midnight , most often in a moonlit glade . They are usually adventurers who traverse the land , seeking to better themselves by experiencing new things and righting wrongs . Lurue is said to use a unicorn horn as her weapon . Relationships . Lurue is often said to be the daughter of Selûne , and believed to be the daughter of Eachthighern as well .

title: Luskag
description: Luskag Luskag was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , Luskag saved the life of Poshtli in the House of Tezca and accompanied him to Sunhome .
description_long: Luskag Luskag was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , Luskag saved the life of Poshtli in the House of Tezca and accompanied him to Sunhome . Along the way , he explained the ancient history of his people to Poshtli . Poshtli spent time in Sunhome learning the ways of Luskag ' s tribe . After being granted a vision by the Sunstone , Poshtli departed Luskag and his tribe . After the Night of Wailing he and his fellow Tatak were checking a new water source when they were attacked by a Viperhands ogre . Tatak died but inside Luskag rose the ancient hatred against goblinoid s and he killed the ogre . Later he convoked a meeting of all desert dwarves chieftain to discuss the matter of the goblinoid armies from Nexal . They together decided to went to the Sunstone to gain a vision and the answer was to be ready for war . Later they lead an expedition to check Tewacha . There Luskag and his fellow saved at the last moment the party of Halloran from the monsters and decided to join them .

title: Luskan
description: Luskan Luskan , also known as the City of Sails , was a port city at the mouth of the River Mirar on the Sword Coast North . Luskan , despite the presence of the Ten Towns is considered by many to be civilization ' s farthest reach . Although once a bustling city , in the days prior to the Spellplague , the city would suffer greatly at the hands of Arklem Greeth .
description_long: Luskan Luskan , also known as the City of Sails , was a port city at the mouth of the River Mirar on the Sword Coast North . Luskan , despite the presence of the Ten Towns is considered by many to be civilization ' s farthest reach . Although once a bustling city , in the days prior to the Spellplague , the city would suffer greatly at the hands of Arklem Greeth . The resulting disaster would allow the Spellplague to nearly decimate the city , with it having only a fraction of its former populace . Geography . As of 1370 DR , the city was split into northern and southern halves by the River Mirar , and these were connected by the bridges Dalath ' s Span , Harbor Cross , and the Upstream Span . Other than the Host Tower of the Arcane , the city was dominated by two - and three - story buildings . Two inhabited islands sat in the mouth of the river : the island upon which lay the Host Tower of the Arcane ( connected to both sides of the river by bridges ) and Closeguard Island , which housed Ship Kurth ( connected to the southern bank by a bridge ) . Northern bank . The northern section was walled and was almost entirely made up of warehouses .

title: Luspeel
description: Luspeel Luspeel was the Realms name for a hardstone known as or lodestone . Description . Luspeel was naturally magnetic and was occasionally used in the floors of temples to subtly encourage piety - - a kneeling worshiper felt his or her weapons and armor being gently stuck to the floor .
description_long: Luspeel Luspeel was the Realms name for a hardstone known as or lodestone . Description . Luspeel was naturally magnetic and was occasionally used in the floors of temples to subtly encourage piety - - a kneeling worshiper felt his or her weapons and armor being gently stuck to the floor . A typical price for large quantities of this hardstone was 3 gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Powers . Luspeel was generally useful in the manufacture of magical items , and especially necessary for tempering swords that were intended to be bound with multiple enchantments .

title: Lustrum
description: Lustrum The Lustrum was a mithral mine outside of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Lustrum was located 20 miles from the Pillars of Woe .
description_long: Lustrum The Lustrum was a mithral mine outside of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Lustrum was located 20 miles from the Pillars of Woe . Description . The Lustrum was a rich mithral mine . It was a wedge - shaped vault hundreds of feet high , with a narrow and cramped floor . History . The rich ore lodes and gem caches of the Lustrum were discovered by the drow circa 1360 DR . It was mined by slaves and soldiers of House Xorlarrin , who hired Bregan D ' aerthe to help protect the mines . They believed that should Mithral Hall learn of the mine , their lust would cause another war with Menzoberranzan . The highest - ranking members of House Xorlarrin were aware that three gemstone golems - - Mulhorandi constructs - - were found intact in a silver vein in the Lustrum , though how they got there was a mystery . The mine was abandoned ( at least temporarily ) in 1372 DR during the duergar invasion of Menzoberranzan . At this time , Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin staged negotiations here with Horgar Steelshadow of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok to determine how much of the war ' s spoils would go to each party .

title: Lute
description: Lute A lute was a stringed instrument with a neck and a wooden soundboard which was often oval or shaped as a teardrop . Lutes were often used by bard s of the Realms . Description .
description_long: Lute A lute was a stringed instrument with a neck and a wooden soundboard which was often oval or shaped as a teardrop . Lutes were often used by bard s of the Realms . Description . Lutes typically had a round back , so they rested easily on the player ' s stomach . They were also popular instruments to be played in courts and were known to be played as far north as Sundabar . Several types of double - stringed lutes built by Calishite craftsmen were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Luth alur
description: Luth alur Luth Alur , meaning " superior shooting " , was a fighting style taught among drow and was shooting enemies with ranged weapons . Description . As the name " superior shooting " suggested , the idea behind this fighting style was to shoot down the enemy in an ambush , before they had the chance to strike back .
description_long: Luth alur Luth Alur , meaning " superior shooting " , was a fighting style taught among drow and was shooting enemies with ranged weapons . Description . As the name " superior shooting " suggested , the idea behind this fighting style was to shoot down the enemy in an ambush , before they had the chance to strike back . It made justice to the fact that drow were elves , in other words frail people . Mastering this style was as good as a guarantee for steady employment in every drow society . At least two users were employed in the majority of drow combat groups and when real war occurred , entire squadrons consisting of them were formed . Users often worked with users of the " kyone veldrin " style , who fought while being shrouded in " darkness " while those enemies who went out of the " darkness " were shot down by the " luth alur " style users . Training . As the name suggested , would - be users needed to learn to shoot with a ranged weapon . They learned how to shoot enemies in a more effective manner . Some drow adapted this style with bows and added the ability to rapidly fire many arrows against their enemies .

title: Lutha
description: Lutha Lutha was an ogre around 1485 DR . Possessions . The ogre wore hide armor and wielded a greatclub .
description_long: Lutha Lutha was an ogre around 1485 DR . Possessions . The ogre wore hide armor and wielded a greatclub . History . Lutha was beaten with injuries so deep that she became little smarter than a beast . When in that state , she was found by Sezibul , a young orc shaman . The orc decided to heal her and took Lutha as his pet . When he no longer had need her , Sezibul chained Lutha .

title: Luthax
description: Luthax Luthax was a war wizard of Cormyr and senior officer to Thanderahast . Elmariel Emmarask was a trusted friend . Appearance .
description_long: Luthax Luthax was a war wizard of Cormyr and senior officer to Thanderahast . Elmariel Emmarask was a trusted friend . Appearance . Luthax had a protruding belly under his robes . He had a furrowed face and a large nose , a bald head and a well - groomed beard . His legs are underdeveloped , so he depends largely on his wings to pick up decent running speed . Background . In 629 DR , Luthax conspired with Elmariel Emmarask , who had brought back a magical beast from the ruins of Netheril . They aimed to kill King Draxius Obarskyr , but their plot was foiled when Thanderahast alerted the king . Amedahast found the conspirators and detonated her magical staff , killing Elmariel , Amedahast and the others in the room . It is unclear whether Luthax was also killed in this explosion , because he was seen by Thanderahast in the Battle with the Witch Lords nearly 300 years later , in 900 DR . He did die at some point as he was the fifth Ghazneth , but it remained unknown what tree he was buried under or when he died .

title: Luthcheq
description: Luthcheq Luthcheq was the capital city of Chessenta . Formerly a port city located on the Bay of Chessenta , as of 1479 DR the city was miles from what remained of the bay . Because it was only a few miles from the River Adder , Luthcheq maintained its status as a maritime city .
description_long: Luthcheq Luthcheq was the capital city of Chessenta . Formerly a port city located on the Bay of Chessenta , as of 1479 DR the city was miles from what remained of the bay . Because it was only a few miles from the River Adder , Luthcheq maintained its status as a maritime city . Culture . Like most of Chessenta , Luthcheq had a martial culture that valued physical fitness and the military arts . Prior to Tchazzar ' s return in 1479 DR , mage s were persecuted and forced to live in their own ghetto . At the urging of his adviser Jhesrhi Coldcreek , Tchazzar enacted laws protecting magic users . Religions . A gigantic sphere of annihilation known as Entropy was worshiped as a god in Luthcheq .

title: Luthic
description: Luthic Luthic ( " looth " - ick ) is the orc goddess of caves and the mate of Gruumsh . She is often referred to as the Cave Mother . Appendix .
description_long: Luthic Luthic ( " looth " - ick ) is the orc goddess of caves and the mate of Gruumsh . She is often referred to as the Cave Mother . Appendix . Luthic is the orc deity of fertility , medicine , females and servitude . She is the wife of Gruumsh and mother of Bahgtru . Her sacred animal is the cave bear . Her symbol is an orcish rune meaning " home . " Luthic embodies the orcish feminine ideal , subordinate to male orcs but still protecting the cohesion of orcish society . Luthic is described as a matronly orc with very long claws . She fights bare - handed with her claws because only the males of the community are allowed to wield a weapon . She may also use powerful spells , as such arts are not considered manly in orcish culture . Luthic was first detailed in Roger E . Moore ' s article " The Half - Orc Point of View , " in " Dragon " # 62 ( TSR , 1982 ) . In " Dragon " # 92 ( December 1984 ) , Gary Gygax indicated this as one of the deities legal for the Greyhawksetting . She also appeared in the original " Unearthed Arcana " ( 1985 ) . Luthic was detailed in the book " Monster Mythology " ( 1992 ) , including details about her priesthood .

title: Luthvaerynn
description: Luthvaerynn Luthvaerynn was a possibly female malaugrym in 1479 DR in Telflamm . It was involved in both licit and illicit businesses in that city using trade and the black market . All its identities were female and it liked the humanoid form more than its original form , and maintained it even when threatened .
description_long: Luthvaerynn Luthvaerynn was a possibly female malaugrym in 1479 DR in Telflamm . It was involved in both licit and illicit businesses in that city using trade and the black market . All its identities were female and it liked the humanoid form more than its original form , and maintained it even when threatened .

title: Luvon Greencloak
description: Luvon Greencloak Luvon Greencloak was the former emissary of the Elven Court in Cormanthyr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the region in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He was an old associate of Khelben Arunsun . He was in 1374 among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor .
description_long: Luvon Greencloak Luvon Greencloak was the former emissary of the Elven Court in Cormanthyr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the region in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He was an old associate of Khelben Arunsun . He was in 1374 among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor . Personality . Despite his sun elf heritage Luvon believe in the Moonstars idea of unity of humans and elves . Appendix . Appearances . " Blackstaff ( novel ) "

title: Lycanthropy
description: Lycanthropy Lycanthropy was a disease ( for afflicted lycanthropes ) and a hereditary condition ( for natural lycanthropes ) that caused humanoid s and giant s to change form , usually into a hybrid humanoid - animal state . A lycanthrope was an individual who possessed this condition . They were called " nightwalkers " by some .
description_long: Lycanthropy Lycanthropy was a disease ( for afflicted lycanthropes ) and a hereditary condition ( for natural lycanthropes ) that caused humanoid s and giant s to change form , usually into a hybrid humanoid - animal state . A lycanthrope was an individual who possessed this condition . They were called " nightwalkers " by some . Society . Some lycanthropes were in control of their ability to transform and others were not . Most lycanthropes had some empathy with animals with which they shared their forms . Most lycanthropes were human s or elves , but orc and goblin lycanthropes also existed . Most natural lycanthropes viewed their condition as a gift , whereas afflicted lycanthropes were more likely to be horrified by it and attempt a cure , using belladonna or magical means . However , all lycanthropes were usually secretive about their condition because of the social stigma attached to it and many ended up as lonely adventurers . History . Some said that thousands of years ago , the god Malar used barbaric human tribes to create the original lycanthropes , providing them with qualities of the predatory animals they admired .

title: Lylorn
description: Lylorn Lylorn was a port city and the largest , wealthiest , and most dominant of the confederation of the Dusk Ports on Returned Abeir . Background . The Lylar were proud people reputed as the boldest of Abeir an sailors and for easily drawing their swords for insults , imagined or real .
description_long: Lylorn Lylorn was a port city and the largest , wealthiest , and most dominant of the confederation of the Dusk Ports on Returned Abeir . Background . The Lylar were proud people reputed as the boldest of Abeir an sailors and for easily drawing their swords for insults , imagined or real . Lylar pirates were a staple of Abeiran folklore . Lylorn prosperity was achieved by sacrificing a large number of its own citizens to appease the green dragon Orlarrakh . Government . Lylorn was ruled by a lord , usually an elderly and conservative male , elected by the seventeen Lylar noble houses . They elected an elder man because , should Orlarrakh eat him , at least the old man could have enjoyed a long life . In 1479 DR , the Lord of the city was the elderly dragonborn Khorinn Hekesh . Defenses . Lylorn was protected by the " Draconian Militiamen " , self - appointed enforcers , all human s or dwarves , who answered only to the Lord of Lylorn and the Green Duchess herself . They served the Green Duchess out of fear , but their military skills were rather poor . They wore dark green tunics with yellow dragon - eye patches , and usually carried short sword s .

title: Lymmura Auldarhk
description: Lymmura Auldarhk Lymmura Auldarhk was a priestess of Sune in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Lymmura was a sympathetic ear and guide to all the citizens .
