description_long: Lymmura Auldarhk Lymmura Auldarhk was a priestess of Sune in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Lymmura was a sympathetic ear and guide to all the citizens . She was widely loved and trusted in the village . Activities . Lymmura Auldarhk , along with Imdarr Relvaunder , took care of the Allfaiths Shrine . She usually celebrated the marriages in the village .

title: Lynn Abbey
description: Lynn Abbey Lynn Abbey ( born September 8 , 1948 ) is an American author born in Peekskill , New York . Lynn began publishing in 1979 with novels and short stories . She began writing for TSR around 1994 while continuing to write novels and editing anthologies .
description_long: Lynn Abbey Lynn Abbey ( born September 8 , 1948 ) is an American author born in Peekskill , New York . Lynn began publishing in 1979 with novels and short stories . She began writing for TSR around 1994 while continuing to write novels and editing anthologies . Her works for TSR include stories set in the Forgotten Realms and the Dark Sun setting .

title: Lynx eye
description: Lynx eye Lynx eye was the Realms name for a variety of known as that exhibited a green flash . Description . These ornamental stones were pale to dark gray with large flakes of colored reflections .
description_long: Lynx eye Lynx eye was the Realms name for a variety of known as that exhibited a green flash . Description . These ornamental stones were pale to dark gray with large flakes of colored reflections . This " flash " could be of all shades , but only the green flash labradorite was called lynx eye on Toril . Lynx eye was usually cut , but it was brittle so most stones were less than 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Lynx eye stones could be dissolved in catoblepas tears or griffon blood to make a solution that could be the foundation of any healing potion or beneficial necromantic potion . This solution also could be substituted for a key ingredient of " Keoghtom ' s ointment " .

title: Lyra Sunrose
description: Lyra Sunrose Lyra Sunrose ( also known as " Little Miss Lemon " ) was a female half - elf ranger who lived in the forest of Cormanthor . History . Childhood .
description_long: Lyra Sunrose Lyra Sunrose ( also known as " Little Miss Lemon " ) was a female half - elf ranger who lived in the forest of Cormanthor . History . Childhood . She was born and raised by her mother in the village of Alyssim , after her human father was sentenced to a decade of hard labour for procreating with an elf ( frowned upon in Alyssim ) . Lyra did not consider herself accepted in Alyssim and this , combined with her annoyance at the villagers for her perceived mistreatment , caused her to leave for a life in the forest , choosing animal companionship over her own kind . Although it is not certain at what age Lyra began her solitary life , she says it was " as soon as I was old enough to lace my own boots " . Lyra chose to worship what her mother referred to as the " Sacred Hexad " of Rillifane Rallathil , Chauntea , Silvanus , Mielikki , Eldath and Aerdrie Faenya as this was the same choice as her mother , despite being against Alyssim ' s customary single - deity worship of Rillifane Rallathil . Adulthood .

title: Lyrabar
description: Lyrabar Lyrabar was a port city in Impiltur . When the Spellplague struck in 1385 DR and the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the city ' s port was left dry , disrupting trade until the port was rebuilt closer to the water . Lyrabar was known for its criminal organizations , which made secret arrangements with the city guard .
description_long: Lyrabar Lyrabar was a port city in Impiltur . When the Spellplague struck in 1385 DR and the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the city ' s port was left dry , disrupting trade until the port was rebuilt closer to the water . Lyrabar was known for its criminal organizations , which made secret arrangements with the city guard . Geography . The city was long and narrow , stretching over a mile along the coast .

title: Lyran Nanther
description: Lyran Nanther Lyran Nanther was an inhabitant of Melvaunt who was nominated by the Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale , Jyordhan , to succeed him . Because Jyordhan was killed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was dispossessed of the " Pendant of Ashaba " , Lyran was left with no claim to the lordship and did not become the new lord . Biography .
description_long: Lyran Nanther Lyran Nanther was an inhabitant of Melvaunt who was nominated by the Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale , Jyordhan , to succeed him . Because Jyordhan was killed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was dispossessed of the " Pendant of Ashaba " , Lyran was left with no claim to the lordship and did not become the new lord . Biography . Born to the influential Nanther family of Melvaunt , at some point in his life he became a lieutenant of the Zhentarim agent Jyordhan . Not having any support , nor the " Pendant of Ashaba " , Lyran did not attempt to claim lordship when he was named Jyordhan ' s successor in 1345 DR , beginning the Time of No Lords in Shadowdale . Zhentil Keep eventually lent him an army of Zhentilar and Banite priests in 1356 DR , however , and Lyran led it to defeat in the First battle of Shadowdale . When Melvaunt ' s Council of Lords discovered Lyran ' s association with Zhentil Keep after this defeat , they immediately had him executed for consorting with their traditional enemy upon his return . His branch of the Nanther family was then banished from Melvaunt .

title: Lyrene
description: Lyrene Lyrene was a half - elf in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf dreamed of joining the Zhentarim like her ancestors .
description_long: Lyrene Lyrene was a half - elf in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf dreamed of joining the Zhentarim like her ancestors . History . Lyrene and her family lived near Zhentil Keep , where her father worked for the Zhentarim . She trained as a warrior . After that city ' s destruction , they transferred to Mulmaster , where her older sister began working as a maid and her father as a mason . In 1491 DR , she was offered a chance to join the Zhents by Equarz if she could find a lost treasure at the bottom of the Lost Drop lake . An adverting party hired by her sister Dylohra saved her from some strange monsters inside the lake .

title: Lysalis
description: Lysalis Lysalis was a female fey ' ri wizard in service to Kaanyr Vhok , the leader of the Scoured Legion at the time of the Legion ' s assault on Sundabar . History . During the attack in 1385 DR , Lysalis helped Vhok to enter unseen into the town but was later killed fighting some dwarven guards .
description_long: Lysalis Lysalis was a female fey ' ri wizard in service to Kaanyr Vhok , the leader of the Scoured Legion at the time of the Legion ' s assault on Sundabar . History . During the attack in 1385 DR , Lysalis helped Vhok to enter unseen into the town but was later killed fighting some dwarven guards . She was secretly replaced by a half - dragon named Myshik Morueme .

title: Lysan
description: Lysan Lysan was a manipulative cleric of Auril in Icewind Dale . History . Her primary mission was to open the tomb of the barbarian king Kresselack to the cold winds and cleanse out the light and sources of warmth within that tomb .
description_long: Lysan Lysan was a manipulative cleric of Auril in Icewind Dale . History . Her primary mission was to open the tomb of the barbarian king Kresselack to the cold winds and cleanse out the light and sources of warmth within that tomb . To do so , she infiltrated the society of Kuldahar , acting as a waitress at the local tavern . She spread stories convincing the people of Kuldahar , including the wise Archdruid Arundel , that there was a threat within the Vale of Shadows were Kresselack was entombed . Adventurers were recruited by Arundel to investigate the Vale of Shadows . They eventually slew all the undead guardians of Kresselack ' s tomb , making it possible for Lysan to carry out her mission . The risen Kresselack recruited the party to slay Lysan ; afterwards , he told the party that there was no one threatening Kuldahar in the Vale . Abilities . Lysan was a cleric of seemingly low power . She somehow cursed the entire Vale of Shadows and raised the dead as shadow s to scare the people of Kuldahar . She believed that it was the power of the goddess Auril herself that was within her . Physical description . Lysan was blond woman wearing blue clothing with ice - colored edges .

title: Lysander Il ' Argad
description: Lysander Il ' Argad Lysander Il ' Argad was an individual at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Lysander was bored and inquisitive .
description_long: Lysander Il ' Argad Lysander Il ' Argad was an individual at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Lysander was bored and inquisitive . He did not enjoy the spartan rooms of the monastery and the lack of excitement found in the place . History . Lysander was one of the guests at the monastery in 1491 DR . His job was to use the monastery ' s libraries to research various subjects for some Damaran nobles .

title: Lythari
description: Lythari Lythari ( originally Ly - tel - quessir ) are good - aligned elven lycanthropic wolves , similar in appearance to werewolves and often mistaken as such . Lythari differ from werewolves in that they have no hybrid form and are friendly and companionable when in lupine form . Although much less numerous than werewolves , a lot of Lythari are sponsored by the church of Selûne .
description_long: Lythari Lythari ( originally Ly - tel - quessir ) are good - aligned elven lycanthropic wolves , similar in appearance to werewolves and often mistaken as such . Lythari differ from werewolves in that they have no hybrid form and are friendly and companionable when in lupine form . Although much less numerous than werewolves , a lot of Lythari are sponsored by the church of Selûne . Ecology . Lythari are true lycanthropes . They are born as were - creatures to lycanthrope parents . Lythari packs are almost exclusively found in wood elf lands or on the isle of Evermeet . Lythari propagate using a ritual of bonding that will turn the other party into a lythari . This ritual only works if both parties agree to the transformation . It leaves a permanent scar on the transformed , which resembles a wolf bite . Combat . Physical combat is abhorrent to lythari . If they aid in warfare at all it would be in a scouting capacity or as a messenger , using their speed to their advantage . However , if cornered or forced to defend their kin , they have a powerful bite which they can use to great effect .

title: Lytin
description: Lytin Lytin was a member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Lytin was one of the many Eternal Flame cultists disguised as druid s who waited to take part in the Rite of the Wicker Giant .
description_long: Lytin Lytin was a member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Lytin was one of the many Eternal Flame cultists disguised as druid s who waited to take part in the Rite of the Wicker Giant . She waited with her three guardians Biart , Orm , and Malin , but they were confronted and defeated by some adventurers .

title: Lyzandra Calderos
description: Lyzandra Calderos Lyzandra Calderos , or Lyzzie , was the third - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Lyzzie was with four magmin s until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her .
description_long: Lyzandra Calderos Lyzandra Calderos , or Lyzzie , was the third - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Lyzzie was with four magmin s until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her .

title: M ' tarl
description: M ' tarl History . In 1358 DR , while traveling through the deadly streets of Menzoberranzan seeking valuable information to help the organization ' s cause , Jarlaxle and M ' tarl encountered Gromph Baenre . To have a private conversation with Jarlaxle , Gromph transported M ' tarl to an extra - dimensional realm .
description_long: M ' tarl History . In 1358 DR , while traveling through the deadly streets of Menzoberranzan seeking valuable information to help the organization ' s cause , Jarlaxle and M ' tarl encountered Gromph Baenre . To have a private conversation with Jarlaxle , Gromph transported M ' tarl to an extra - dimensional realm . After their meeting ended , Gromph told Jarlaxle his lieutenant perished .

title: Ma
description: Ma Ma was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Ma was loyal to her customers and staff but for some gold she agreed to talk .
description_long: Ma Ma was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Ma was loyal to her customers and staff but for some gold she agreed to talk . She had a raspy voice after a half - century of smoking a pipe . Ma seldom cursed but possessed a forthright honest and a homespun wit . Activities . In 1491 DR , Ma managed the bar called the Black Blade and Bloody Boar in a lower part of the city .

title: Ma Chung - ying
description: Ma Chung - ying Ma Chung - ying was a shou inhabiting the Bitter Well Oasis within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ma was the only permanent resident of Bitter Well Oasis .
description_long: Ma Chung - ying Ma Chung - ying was a shou inhabiting the Bitter Well Oasis within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ma was the only permanent resident of Bitter Well Oasis . He ran a small inn that he would have otherwise abandoned had the Shou government not supplied him with wine and food in return for information on a travelers passing through the small town .

title: Maalirn ' s Walk
description: Maalirn ' s Walk Maalirn ' s Walk was a north – south road bordering the eastern side of the Dukar Quarter of Myth Nantar . Geography . The road arched in places with links to the Dukars ' Academy , and was popular with younger merfolk who enjoyed racing along it , despite the hazards .
description_long: Maalirn ' s Walk Maalirn ' s Walk was a north – south road bordering the eastern side of the Dukar Quarter of Myth Nantar . Geography . The road arched in places with links to the Dukars ' Academy , and was popular with younger merfolk who enjoyed racing along it , despite the hazards .

title: Maalthiir
description: Maalthiir Maalthiir was a merchant and a wizard who came to rule the city of Hillsfar . Biography . Maalthiir was an unknown quantity in the Moonsea .
description_long: Maalthiir Maalthiir was a merchant and a wizard who came to rule the city of Hillsfar . Biography . Maalthiir was an unknown quantity in the Moonsea . Few knew much more about him other than the fact that he was a particularly shrewd merchant and a mage . During the winter of 1356 / 57 DR , Maalthiir overthrew the potentially corrupt Council of Hillsfar using blackmail and threats of harm . In 1460 DR , Maalthiir attempted to make the transformation into undeath as a lich . His attempt went awry however , and he died . Personality . Maalthiir was a greedy , sadistic individual who had a distinct devotion to mercantile power . He regularly arranged for random executions and torture within his realm . Relationships . Maalthiir was noted as having a single friend from before his rise to power : Wak Rathar . Maalthiir fostered a wizard apprentice , Mordak Brelliar , who acted as Maalthiir ' s chief advisor and second - in - command .

title: Maarika
description: Maarika Maarika was a unusual frost giant druid in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Description . Maarika was a relatively small giant , compared to others in Great Glacier .
description_long: Maarika Maarika was a unusual frost giant druid in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Description . Maarika was a relatively small giant , compared to others in Great Glacier . Personality . Maarika greatly disliked her people ' s culture . She believed her fellow frost giants were only good for fighting , drinking , and more fighting . Maarika still respected strength , combat prowess , and bravery , but there was more to life than only those things . She was also a cynic , always quick to give her opinion — and she had an opinion about everything . Maarika was very competent with elemental magic . As follower of both Auril and Talos , she enjoyed the spectacular destruction she saw caused by nature . History . Maarika left her tribe , intending to live alone in the Glacier . Instead , she ended up joining the Emerald Enclave . Eventually , in 1491 , an adventuring party sought her out for her knowledge of elemental magic . They asked for her help in regards to a strange storm that had plagued the area . She explained that it was the side effect of an elemental rite performed to create an elemental node inside the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .

title: Maaril
description: Maaril Known chiefly as the mage who owned the Dragon Tower in the 14th century DR , Maaril possessed the Dragonstaff of Ahghairon , a powerful magic item that allowed any dragon who touched it to avoid the negative effects of Waterdeep ' s dragonward . As owner of the Dragonstaff , Maaril was able to control which dragons entered Waterdeep , a power he used to his advantage . Relationship .
description_long: Maaril Known chiefly as the mage who owned the Dragon Tower in the 14th century DR , Maaril possessed the Dragonstaff of Ahghairon , a powerful magic item that allowed any dragon who touched it to avoid the negative effects of Waterdeep ' s dragonward . As owner of the Dragonstaff , Maaril was able to control which dragons entered Waterdeep , a power he used to his advantage . Relationship . Maaril was on good terms with Meleghost Starseer of the House of Wonder . History . Maaril was fostered at the House of Wonder when it was a temple of Mystra . Once he became powerful enough , he summoned a demon to kill his mentor and framed a rival apprentice for the murder . He stole the Dragonstaff from his master and took over her tower . In 1374 DR , he was among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the High Mages of the lost city of Miyeritaar and cleanse that part of the High Moor . He lived in Waterdeep as an eccentric mage until he disappeared after the Spellplague . Appearance . Maaril was handsome with dark eyes and liked to wear dark green or purple robes . He had a pointy black beard .

title: Maas
description: Maas Maas was a male drow vampire and the leader of Maerimydra ' s force of assassins . Description . He was a handsome male who typically wore only dark trousers , gloves , and bracers of elaborate design .
description_long: Maas Maas was a male drow vampire and the leader of Maerimydra ' s force of assassins . Description . He was a handsome male who typically wore only dark trousers , gloves , and bracers of elaborate design . Maas kept his white hair cropped close to his head and was particularly broad and muscular . Personality . A fearless devotee of Kiaransalee , Maas had little fear of defeat as he knew his vampiric powers allowed him to return to life . Despite his hunger for blood , Maas was the lover of the Cabrath Nelinderra while she was alive and took no small amount of pleasure in watching her eat . Abilities . Maas was an extremely agile and mentally disciplined individual , and as a vampire these traits were only amplified . His vampiric toughness , regeneration , and life - sapping attacks all complemented his monk training , such that he eschewed weapons in combat . Trained as a monk , Maas was a skilled martial artist whose defensive combat style allowed him to maneuver his enemy into position to be disarmed . Honed reactions let him deflect arrows mid - flight and dodge even effects that encompassed a large area .

title: Maastik
description: Maastik Maastik was a drow priestess of Ghaunadaur who lived in the Underdark . Description . Maastik had a mane of white hair that contrasted with her night - black skin .
description_long: Maastik Maastik was a drow priestess of Ghaunadaur who lived in the Underdark . Description . Maastik had a mane of white hair that contrasted with her night - black skin . She wore a black robe with orange and purple details . Possessions . She owned a " wand of fear " , as well as a " cloak of protection " . Activities . As part of Ghaunadaur ' s clergy , Maastik could control slime s and similar creatures that fell under her god ' s portfolio . She often took part in live sacrifices in honor of Ghaunadaur .

title: Maatsuki
description: Maatsuki Maatsuki was a hengeyokai wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Maatsuki was an evil and scheming wu jen member of the Iridescent Peacock Society in Dojyu .
description_long: Maatsuki Maatsuki was a hengeyokai wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Maatsuki was an evil and scheming wu jen member of the Iridescent Peacock Society in Dojyu . Often however she wandered far from the capital , creating havoc and searching for suitable wu jen to recruit in the society .

title: Mabad
description: Mabad Mabad was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Mabad served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants .
description_long: Mabad Mabad was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Mabad served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants . He commanded fellow bandits , raiding local tribes on the Plains of Purple Dust and southern Murghôm . Relationships . Though he was loyal to Ar - Rabi , Mabad harbored personal ambitions as well .

title: Mac - Fuirmidh cittern
description: Mac - Fuirmidh cittern A Mac - Fuirmidh cittern was a masterwork magic cittern and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Mac - Fuirmidh citterns " were pear - shaped citterns similar to lute s , superior in every way to ordinary citterns .
description_long: Mac - Fuirmidh cittern A Mac - Fuirmidh cittern was a masterwork magic cittern and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Mac - Fuirmidh citterns " were pear - shaped citterns similar to lute s , superior in every way to ordinary citterns . Like other Instruments of the Bards , they could only be used properly by bard s , and could be dangerous if anyone else attempted to play or even carry them . Powers . Bards wielding a " Mac - Fuirmidh cittern " had their charming abilities greatly amplified by their magic . Like all Instruments of the Bards , these citterns had the capability of storing spells . A bard playing a " Mac - Fuirmidh cittern " could invoke the spells " Fly " , " Invisibility " , " Levitate " , " Protection from evil and good " , " Barkskin " , " Cure wounds " and " Fog cloud " each once a day , until the instrument recharged its magic at the next dawn . History . The first " Mac - Fuirmidh citterns " were created by a legendary bard in the Moonshae Isles named Falataer .

title: MacBec Maclyon
description: MacBec Maclyon MacBec Maclyon was an evil wizard in the Savage Frontier . Activities . MacBec had occupied the Castle of Illusion with his orc retinue .
description_long: MacBec Maclyon MacBec Maclyon was an evil wizard in the Savage Frontier . Activities . MacBec had occupied the Castle of Illusion with his orc retinue . By 1372 DR , Malcyon had been summoning powerful demons and coming to terms with the dark powers to get a wider magical knowledge . Some devil s were protecting his castle and patrolling the surrounding land , while others taught him black magic . The evil wizard was not aware he was on his way to building a second Hellgate Keep .

title: Maccath
description: Maccath Maccath , also known as Maccath the Crimson , was a tiefling member of the reformed Arcane Brotherhood . Description . Maccath had very conspicuous tiefling traits , especially extremely red skin .
description_long: Maccath Maccath , also known as Maccath the Crimson , was a tiefling member of the reformed Arcane Brotherhood . Description . Maccath had very conspicuous tiefling traits , especially extremely red skin . She usually wore a blazing red cloak . History . Maccath was a member of the Arcane Brotherhood in Luskan . She was always interested in dragon lore and relics and she traveled to the Host Tower of the Arcane to learn about dragon magic . She soon discovered that for advancement in this field , Maccath needed to talk to a real dragon . Remembering the sacking of the Host Tower by the white dragon Arauthator during the Rage of Dragons in the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR , Maccath decided to seek out Arauthator . " Circa " the Year of the Nether Mountain Scrolls , 1486 DR she lead an expedition to the Sea of Moving Ice and found the dragon ' s lair . Arauthator normally killed intruders but he saw that Maccath could be useful in two ways : she could explain to the dragon all the lore he looted from the Host Tower , and her company would help his mate Arveiaturace overcome the grief of the loss of her wizard rider .

title: Mace
description: Mace A mace is a simple bludgeoning weapon resembling a metal club . The haft can be of varying lengths and thicknesses , but for game purposes maces come in two sizes , the light mace and the heavy mace . Both are intended to be used in one hand .
description_long: Mace A mace is a simple bludgeoning weapon resembling a metal club . The haft can be of varying lengths and thicknesses , but for game purposes maces come in two sizes , the light mace and the heavy mace . Both are intended to be used in one hand . The striking head of the mace is symmetrically arrayed with flanges , knobs , or high ridges designed to inflict damage on an armored opponent . Maces can also fulfill a ceremonial role , being used or wielded by cleric s or those in positions of power .

title: Mace ( half - orc )
description: Mace ( half - orc ) Mace was a half - orc cleric of Bane in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Mace led a group of orc s that had occupied the temple of II - Mater until an adventuring party hired by Dirtan killed him and his minions .
description_long: Mace ( half - orc ) Mace was a half - orc cleric of Bane in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Mace led a group of orc s that had occupied the temple of II - Mater until an adventuring party hired by Dirtan killed him and his minions .

title: Mace of the Darkchildren
description: Mace of the Darkchildren A mace of the darkchildren was a heavy mace that gave its wielder power over undead . Description . A mace of the darkchildren had a haft of blackened metal resembling a human femur bone .
description_long: Mace of the Darkchildren A mace of the darkchildren was a heavy mace that gave its wielder power over undead . Description . A mace of the darkchildren had a haft of blackened metal resembling a human femur bone . The mace - head was shaped like a skull with three screaming faces in each direction . It was forged of adamantine . Powers . A mace of the darkchildren could be either a + 1 or a + 2 weapon . It was forged of adamantine , with all the strength of that metal . In particular , the mace gave its wielder enhanced powers against undead , making them easier to control or rebuke , if the wielder was capable of that divine power . It also allowed them to control more undead than normal .

title: Mackester Claypipe
description: Mackester Claypipe Mackester Claypipe was a halfling assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Mackester on the surface was the houndsmaster of House Thalavar and the most skilled canine expert of Westgate , loved both by her masters and the city ' s halfling community . However , she was secretly also a Night Mask assassin .
description_long: Mackester Claypipe Mackester Claypipe was a halfling assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Mackester on the surface was the houndsmaster of House Thalavar and the most skilled canine expert of Westgate , loved both by her masters and the city ' s halfling community . However , she was secretly also a Night Mask assassin . Mackester was in fact also a member of a small cult of worshipers of Urogalan who believed that the god needed sacrifices , and she always remained confident in this doctrine . For this , Mackester always interred her victims underground as a sacrifice to Urogalan .

title: Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons
description: Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Services / Merchandise . This shop offered rare and magical items for purchase to those who " looked like they needed to be able to do anything .
description_long: Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Services / Merchandise . This shop offered rare and magical items for purchase to those who " looked like they needed to be able to do anything . " In reality , many of the nicer looking magical items were cursed . Inhabitants . Aja Pelima , or Mad Aja , ran this shop . He often used displays of magic as a sales pitch to attract customers .

title: Madame Darkness
description: Madame Darkness Madame Darkness was a fortune teller in the Moonsea . Activities . Madame Darkness was the fortune teller in the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .
description_long: Madame Darkness Madame Darkness was a fortune teller in the Moonsea . Activities . Madame Darkness was the fortune teller in the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities . Her prevision were always vague but after twilight ' s time her responses had a hint of menace . History . Madame Darkness escaped Underdark at the Rage of Demons ' s time and joined the Carnival . She sensed something strange from the new mirror maze attraction .

title: Madeiron Sunderstone
description: Madeiron Sunderstone Madeiron Sunderstone was the bodyguard of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Madeiron was near fearless but not very smart .
description_long: Madeiron Sunderstone Madeiron Sunderstone was the bodyguard of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Madeiron was near fearless but not very smart . History . Madeiron hailed from Hartsvale , a small kingdom near the Silver Marches . There , he was a distant cousin of the queen and his lineage went back to Brun I , son of Hartkiller . Madeiron left his home for a life as an adventurer . Finally , circa 1352 DR , he settled in Waterdeep , where he joined the City Guard . In time , he rose through the ranks to become the bodyguard and personal champion of Piergeiron .

title: Madinat
description: Madinat Madinat , or the Round City , was the name of the main sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . Madinat sat next to the harbor of Furdah Rustauk .
description_long: Madinat Madinat , or the Round City , was the name of the main sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . Madinat sat next to the harbor of Furdah Rustauk . It was considered to be the heart of Dhaztanar . As the nickname of the Round City implied , Madinat formed a perfect circle . Surrounded by a moat and a strong outer and inner wall , Madinat was the most fortified section of the city . An open courtyard stretched behind the outer walls until it reached a third inner wall . This wall protected the houses of notable citizens , gardens , temples , and the palace of the caliph . Four gates in the walls , known as the Grand Bab , led to the Caliph ' s palace , the Dar al - Kalif .

title: Madinat al - Mumin
description: Madinat al - Mumin Madinat al - Mumin , or The City of the Faithful , was a small settlement located on the Steaming Isles within the Crowded Sea of southern Zakhara . Inhabitants . Each and every one of the inhabitants of this town lived for the Law of the Loregiver , firmly believing that as long as the Law was practiced within Madinat al - Mumin , that it would never cease to exist regardless of what happened to the rest of the Land of Fate Defenses .
description_long: Madinat al - Mumin Madinat al - Mumin , or The City of the Faithful , was a small settlement located on the Steaming Isles within the Crowded Sea of southern Zakhara . Inhabitants . Each and every one of the inhabitants of this town lived for the Law of the Loregiver , firmly believing that as long as the Law was practiced within Madinat al - Mumin , that it would never cease to exist regardless of what happened to the rest of the Land of Fate Defenses . A militia of 28 individuals could be assembled if needed , but the citizens of Madinat al - Mumin were peaceful , learned folk who could call upon Fate to aid them . Description . Madinat al - Mumin gleamed like a wealthy city of a larger size . All of the buildings were white - washed , and many possessed fabulous architecture . The town boasted a grand palace that seemed out of place for such a small settlement . History . Madinat al - Mumin was founded by Jamila the Virtuous and her husband . Together they discovered the descendants of Nog and Kadar and guided them to Enlightenment .

title: Madislak Pemsk
description: Madislak Pemsk Madislak Pemsk was one of the druid rulers of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Madislak was a leader in the druid council that ruled Sossal .
description_long: Madislak Pemsk Madislak Pemsk was one of the druid rulers of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Madislak was a leader in the druid council that ruled Sossal . In 1373 DR , his nation was weakened by sustained attacks by enraged dragon s . Later , the Ice Witch , Iyraclea , and the white dragon dracolich Zethrindor invaded Sossal with a potent army . They quickly conquered the northern regions of the country . Madislak issued an order to all his forces to gather south for a counterattack . In that time , the high druid met Dorn Graybrook and his allies , agreeing to help them travel to Thentia while they joined his army . However , Zethrindor ' s army executed a surprise attack , catching Madislak ' s contingent before he met the others . In the face of superior enemy numbers , Dorn proposed a duel between the commanders . In the vicious duel between the white dracolich and Dorn ' s party , plus Madislak and two of his warriors , Zethrindor managed to kill Madislak but the weakened dracolich was later destroyed by his own conscripted troops .

title: Madness domain
description: Madness domain The Madness domain was a deity domain that granted madness - related spells to a cleric or certain divine spellcasters devoted to a god of madness . Once the gods Cyric , Ghaunadaur , and Tharizdun laid claim , the madness domain began spreading their blessing to their followers . Cyric " The mad god " was an ever lasting void of madness .
description_long: Madness domain The Madness domain was a deity domain that granted madness - related spells to a cleric or certain divine spellcasters devoted to a god of madness . Once the gods Cyric , Ghaunadaur , and Tharizdun laid claim , the madness domain began spreading their blessing to their followers . Cyric " The mad god " was an ever lasting void of madness . His insanity grew indefinitely , sometimes seeming to bring him back to what might be sanity , thus cementing the depth of his madness . Ghaunadaur resided alone in the Dismal Caverns , letting insanity claim him . In his madness , he released abominations that carried madness wherever they appeared . Mortals wanted to keep Tharizdun ' s very name from their minds out of fear . His followers were given to extreme actions and inner torment , as their god existed to bring about the end of all things . Once a day , a devoted spellcaster could gain the clarity of madness and become more wise or strong willed . Power Of Madness domain . Any divine caster that worshipped a god that claimed the madness domain could channel the madness Domain . Divine casters who chose to channel the madness domain were more skilled at deception .

title: Madri
description: Madri Madri was a human woman and an important official in Halruaa . History . Prior to the Spellplague , she became lovers with the deva Demascus .
description_long: Madri Madri was a human woman and an important official in Halruaa . History . Prior to the Spellplague , she became lovers with the deva Demascus . Unfortunately for Madri , Demascus was ordered by an unknown god to assassinate her , which he did by strangulation . Around the year 1479 DR , some power called Madri ' s spirit back from the dead . The entity known as Fossil claimed her soul was linked to Demascus ' sword Exorcessum and it was the sword ' s power that called her spirit . She made common cause with Fossil to hurry the reincarnation of the Rakshasa Kalkan , Demascus ' s arch enemy . She spied on Demascus in Airspur , apparently hoping to watch his demise at the hands of enemies . However , when Demascus was trapped by a cave - in on Ithimir Isle , Madri gave him a teleportation device that extricated him and saved his life . Relationships . Madri hated her former lover and killer Demascus , even going so far to ally with his enemies . However , her heart later softened and it she seemed to continue to hold some affection for the deva . Powers .

title: Madwave
description: Madwave Captain Madwave was the human captain and owner of the Gontese merchant ship " Argus Treader " . Background . Captain Madwave was one of the few gontese ship owners who didn ' t worked for the Twelvefold .
description_long: Madwave Captain Madwave was the human captain and owner of the Gontese merchant ship " Argus Treader " . Background . Captain Madwave was one of the few gontese ship owners who didn ' t worked for the Twelvefold . She had the reputation of never having lost a cargo , a member of her crew , or a bet .

title: Mae ' Var
description: Mae ' Var Mae ' Var was the leader of a guildhall of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . He employed Gorion ' s Ward in some missions until he ordered him to kill his superior Renal Bloodscalp in order to ascend in the thieves ' ranks . Eventually , Renal sent Gorion ' s Ward back to kill him .
description_long: Mae ' Var Mae ' Var was the leader of a guildhall of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . He employed Gorion ' s Ward in some missions until he ordered him to kill his superior Renal Bloodscalp in order to ascend in the thieves ' ranks . Eventually , Renal sent Gorion ' s Ward back to kill him .

title: Maea Dulgussir
description: Maea Dulgussir Maea Dulgussir was a wizard in the village of Eveningstar in the kingdom of Cormyr . She owned and operated The Low Lantern , a tavern , dance hall and theater . She kept her magical skills concealed , and few if any knew that she could work magic .
description_long: Maea Dulgussir Maea Dulgussir was a wizard in the village of Eveningstar in the kingdom of Cormyr . She owned and operated The Low Lantern , a tavern , dance hall and theater . She kept her magical skills concealed , and few if any knew that she could work magic .

title: Maegera
description: Maegera Maegera the Inferno was a fiery primordial , whose immense heat was harnessed to power the Great Forge of the dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Description . Similar to other fire elemental s , Maegera ' s 50 - ft ( 15 .
description_long: Maegera Maegera the Inferno was a fiery primordial , whose immense heat was harnessed to power the Great Forge of the dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Description . Similar to other fire elemental s , Maegera ' s 50 - ft ( 15 . 2 m ) tall body was comprised primarily of living flame . Distinctively , the primordial had great smouldering black pits for eyes and many tendril - like limbs . Abilities . A great being of fire , Maegera ' s body continuously exuded heat and and was similarly unharmed by it . Merely being within 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) of the primordial was enough to set most creatures and flammable objects ablaze . Non - magical weapons that struck Maegera were invariably destroyed . Maegera ' s power was such that it could extend its influence by separating parts of itself into distinct fire elemental s under its control . Additionally , it could even burn creatures that were normally immune to the effects of fire . History . After the last conflict in - 31000 DR between god s and primordials , Maegera , tired of fighting and uninterested in following its fellow primordials to the world of Abeir , entered in a comma - like sleep beneath the Crags in Northwest Faerûn .

title: Maelephant
description: Maelephant The maelephant is a denizen of the Nine Hells and a powerful guardian used to protect the treasures of greater fiend s and evil archmage s . It is humanoid in shape , standing nine feet tall and weighing eight hundred pounds . Its oversized hands are tipped with vicious claws , and its head is just like that of a small elephant .
description_long: Maelephant The maelephant is a denizen of the Nine Hells and a powerful guardian used to protect the treasures of greater fiend s and evil archmage s . It is humanoid in shape , standing nine feet tall and weighing eight hundred pounds . Its oversized hands are tipped with vicious claws , and its head is just like that of a small elephant . Generally , they are in service to baatezu lords or have escaped service , traveling the lower planes alone — driven still by the urge to protect and guard something . A maelephant will fight to the death to protect its territory or its charge and generally will not pursue intruders . Some make their homes on the Demiplane of Nightmares .

title: Maelestor Rex
description: Maelestor Rex Maelestor Rex was an ancient black dragon in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Maelestor Rex made a bargain with the cornugon Vesarius in order to learn some unique spell s .
description_long: Maelestor Rex Maelestor Rex was an ancient black dragon in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Maelestor Rex made a bargain with the cornugon Vesarius in order to learn some unique spell s . In exchange , Vesarius only wanted one of his horns . However , in 1363 DR , Vesarius made an incantation upon the horn to enslave Maelestor and forced him to join the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Storm , a group composed of 100 bugbear s and 100 ogre s plus Maelestor Rex . In 1374 DR , Maelestor was living in the High Moor .

title: Maelgot
description: Maelgot Maelgot was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . While working as a guard , Maelgot usually kept around 20 gp on his person .
description_long: Maelgot Maelgot was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . While working as a guard , Maelgot usually kept around 20 gp on his person . History . Maelgot was a cultist and , alongside Sorvic , one of the bodyguards of Talis Kasterel , at his master ' s side in the Cult ' s occupied hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains .

title: Maelin
description: Maelin Maelin was the fiery daughter of Talbot Uskevren ' s valet , Eckert . Sometime in the winter between 1370 and 1371 DR , she was kidnapped by Radu Malveen , who held her in the Malveen s ' former home . Guarded by Radu ' s vampire brother , Stannis , she was kept for months while Radu ransomed Eckert ' s knowledge of the Uskevren s for his daughter ' s life .
description_long: Maelin Maelin was the fiery daughter of Talbot Uskevren ' s valet , Eckert . Sometime in the winter between 1370 and 1371 DR , she was kidnapped by Radu Malveen , who held her in the Malveen s ' former home . Guarded by Radu ' s vampire brother , Stannis , she was kept for months while Radu ransomed Eckert ' s knowledge of the Uskevren s for his daughter ' s life . She was rescued by Talbot , Chaney Foxmantle , Darrow , and Feena Archwood in Tarsakh of 1371 DR , though Chaney lost his life in the process .

title: Maelin Rascalin
description: Maelin Rascalin Maelin Rascalin was a former bandit who became a general and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth . History . Maelin Rascalin was once one of the most notorious and dangerous bandits in the kingdom of Ulgarth , until at last he was captured with great effort .
description_long: Maelin Rascalin Maelin Rascalin was a former bandit who became a general and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth . History . Maelin Rascalin was once one of the most notorious and dangerous bandits in the kingdom of Ulgarth , until at last he was captured with great effort . Convicted of banditry , Maelin elected to serve out his sentence through military service , as Ulgarthan law permitted . After he ' d done his time , Maelin chose to remain in the army . Quickly promoted , he soon came to lead the kingdom ' s entire east defense force and became one of its greatest generals ever . Repeatedly , he repelled invading barbarian hordes from the east , including resisting an attack over a thousand barbarians . For his service , Maelin was ennobled by the king and awarded the barony of Suormpar . His example encouraged later convicts to choose military service , with some being ennobled themselves and earning titles for valor . Relations . Maelin ' s grandson was Redinald Rascalin , baron of Suormpar around 1367 DR and a paladin of Torm . The Rascalins were the staunchest supporters of King Drasna Bluemantle .

title: Maelos Karanok
description: Maelos Karanok Maelos Karanok was the figurehead ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Maelos saw magic in every corner and knew only one way to deal with it : destruction .
description_long: Maelos Karanok Maelos Karanok was the figurehead ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Maelos saw magic in every corner and knew only one way to deal with it : destruction . Personality . By 1372 DR , Maelos was nearly senile , understanding little about House Karanok ' s plans .

title: Maelstrom
description: Maelstrom Maelstrom was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen , and to others that followed a deity associated with the ocean . It created a whirlpool in a body of water that sucked in creatures and objects . Effects .
description_long: Maelstrom Maelstrom was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen , and to others that followed a deity associated with the ocean . It created a whirlpool in a body of water that sucked in creatures and objects . Effects . This spell was only viable when cast upon a body of water that was at least 60 ft ( 18 m ) deep in a cylinder at least 120 ft ( 37 m ) in diameter — the size of the " maelstrom " . It could be cast at a point on the surface up to 420 ft ( 128 m ) away ( even farther for more experienced casters and for the newer version of the spell ) . The effect only lasted a short time , but was extremely dangerous and deadly as the water swirled rapidly and formed a vortex that pulled everything within 50 ft ( 15 m ) of the edges of the " maelstrom " down into a watery grinder . Creatures with enough strength or swimming ability could slow their descent and perhaps avoid the worst of the buffeting . Only the sturdiest sailing vessels and experienced crews could hope to avoid being sucked in and swamped .

title: Maelstrom ( Zakharan version )
description: Maelstrom ( Zakharan version ) Maelstrom was a spell used by powerful wizard s in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . When cast upon a large body of water , this spell created a hole through the Prime Material Plane into the Elemental Plane of Water , creating a huge whirlpool for the duration of the spell .
description_long: Maelstrom ( Zakharan version ) Maelstrom was a spell used by powerful wizard s in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . When cast upon a large body of water , this spell created a hole through the Prime Material Plane into the Elemental Plane of Water , creating a huge whirlpool for the duration of the spell . The mouth of the whirlpool was 300 ' ( 91 . 4 m ) wide and sucked down ships unless they were controlled by the best sailors . Living creatures sucked through the portal either drowned on the Elemental Plane of Water or were enslaved by marid s . Components . This spell required a diamond worth at least 1 , 000 gold pieces to cast .

title: Maelstrom ( storm giants )
description: Maelstrom ( storm giants ) The Maelstrom was the main stronghold of the storm giant s , where lived their kings . Location . The Maelstrom lay on the floor of the Trackless Sea , 3 , 000 feet beneath the surface at a point between Ruathym , the Whalebones , and the Korinn Archipelago .
description_long: Maelstrom ( storm giants ) The Maelstrom was the main stronghold of the storm giant s , where lived their kings . Location . The Maelstrom lay on the floor of the Trackless Sea , 3 , 000 feet beneath the surface at a point between Ruathym , the Whalebones , and the Korinn Archipelago . Until his disappearance in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , it was ruled King Hekaton .

title: Maeluth
description: Maeluth Maeluths were planetouched , native outsider s descended from the breeding of dwarves and devil s . Description . Maeluths descended from fiends and dwarves , so they could have some fiend ish features , including red eyes , abnormally long fingers , or almost hairless bodies .
description_long: Maeluth Maeluths were planetouched , native outsider s descended from the breeding of dwarves and devil s . Description . Maeluths descended from fiends and dwarves , so they could have some fiend ish features , including red eyes , abnormally long fingers , or almost hairless bodies . Like dwarves , maeluths had darkvision , which was limited to 60 ft . ( 18 m ) . Abilities . Maeluths had better innate social skills than their pure - blood kin and commonly used them to attain positions of power . Due to their diabolic heritage , they were able to cause melee weapons gain an unholy power .

title: Maenoth Silversword
description: Maenoth Silversword Maenoth Silversword was a member of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a fighter and thief of the cult and a member of the ruling council . In truth , Maenoth was also a mage and a member of the Harper s .
description_long: Maenoth Silversword Maenoth Silversword was a member of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a fighter and thief of the cult and a member of the ruling council . In truth , Maenoth was also a mage and a member of the Harper s .

title: Maer Dualdon
description: Maer Dualdon Maer Dualdon was a cold lake in Icewind Dale . Geography . The lake was located in the western Ten Towns region .
description_long: Maer Dualdon Maer Dualdon was a cold lake in Icewind Dale . Geography . The lake was located in the western Ten Towns region . It was a major source of knucklehead trout , whose bones were used in the art of scrimshaw . Notable locations . Settlements . The towns of Bremen , Targos , Termalaine , and Lonelywood were situated on its silvery banks .

title: Maera
description: Maera Maera was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Maera was a lithe half - elven woman .
description_long: Maera Maera was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Maera was a lithe half - elven woman . She was exceptionally skilled with a whip . Personality . Maera was passionate and liked to be at the center of attention . Relationships . Maera was the partner of Bramas Thorntree and , thanks to this , also the second - in - command of the Company . Her brother was Merap , also a member of the group . History . Meara and her brother Merap were old allies of Bramas Thorntree , like all in the Company of the Anvil . In 1370 DR , she joined the Company , and together they recovered the " Sondarr Scepter " from a long - forgotten dwarven tomb in the Starspire Mountains . They had been ordered to maintain a low profile and , on their return journey on Uktar 10 , stopped at the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth for drink . Later that night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . However , the dwarves accidentally engaged in a brawl with the Shields of the Highland adventuring company .

title: Maeragra Duskwinter
description: Maeragra Duskwinter Maeragra Duskwinter was the junior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Maeragra had red hair that framed a beautiful , sharply defined face atop a slight , wiry frame .
description_long: Maeragra Duskwinter Maeragra Duskwinter was the junior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Maeragra had red hair that framed a beautiful , sharply defined face atop a slight , wiry frame . Personality . She had a sharp voice that she used only when necessary and never resorted to using vulgarities . Her wit and forceful personality let her direct staff and guests alike in an iron - hard but velvet - covered manner . Abilities . Maeragra retained some of her acrobatic and climbing abilities that served her well in her previous career as a thief . Activities . She was the night - shift chatelaine . She interfaced with guests and directed chambermaids , cooks , and footmen to provide first - rate service . She occasionally used her leaping and acrobatic skills to scale the outside of the Sign of the Shield and enter a guest room via the window when a guest barricaded themselves in a room and refused to leave . Relationships .

title: Maerdrym
description: Maerdrym Maerdrym was a powerful moon elven house of Myth Drannor . Headquarters . House Maerdrym was based in a four - story villa in Myth Drannor .
description_long: Maerdrym Maerdrym was a powerful moon elven house of Myth Drannor . Headquarters . House Maerdrym was based in a four - story villa in Myth Drannor . History . House Maerdrym was the first senior elven house of Myth Drannor to accept a half - elf ( Arun Maerdrym ) as one of its members . That same half - elf sired Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , who was not accepted as part of the house . Insignia . The seal of the house was " four gray roses entwined and growing up around three black wizards ' staves on a white field . " The colors of the house were black , charcoal gray , white , and olive green .

title: Maerhult
description: Maerhult Maerhult was a male bard . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , he visited The Drunken Dragon tavern in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . There he met the adventurer Shaless , who was displaying a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s that she ' d apparently looted from devil s in Myth Drannor .
description_long: Maerhult Maerhult was a male bard . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , he visited The Drunken Dragon tavern in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . There he met the adventurer Shaless , who was displaying a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s that she ' d apparently looted from devil s in Myth Drannor . Maerhult examined two of her harps and pronounced them to be genuine works of old Myth Drannor , and to be rare magical items .

title: Maerimydra
description: Maerimydra Maerimydra was a large drow city located below the Dalelands in the Deep Wastes . Geography . Maerimydra was situated in the Middledark , roughly ten miles below the southern border of Mistledale .
description_long: Maerimydra Maerimydra was a large drow city located below the Dalelands in the Deep Wastes . Geography . Maerimydra was situated in the Middledark , roughly ten miles below the southern border of Mistledale . It resided in a cavern roughly three quarters of a mile from north to south and half a mile from east to west with many smaller caverns surrounding the city itself . Numerous plateaus separated the city , with the highest level being in the north - west corner . Connections to the Surface . Winding away from the city were Underdark passages , some of which led to the surface . There are noted connections to the surface that connect to Maerimydra ; one within the Dordrien crypts in Daggerdale ; one near the Elven Court in Cormanthor ; one beneath Haptooth Hill in Battledale ; and one that leads into the sewers of Zhentil Keep . It should also be noted there are underdark connections to the Shadowdark beneath the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale , though since 1367 DR this entrance has been sealed off by Mourngrym Amcathra . Trade . Prior to its fall , Maerimydra was still actively trading with duergar in the Underdark near Zhentil Keep .

title: Maernos
description: Maernos The Maernos ( MAY - er - noz ) family was a human noble family in Waterdeep . It concerned itself with financial activities such as banking and moneylending . Its coat of arms consisted of a pair of hands with green sleeves and three silver spear heads on a blue field .
description_long: Maernos The Maernos ( MAY - er - noz ) family was a human noble family in Waterdeep . It concerned itself with financial activities such as banking and moneylending . Its coat of arms consisted of a pair of hands with green sleeves and three silver spear heads on a blue field . As of 1370 DR the family head was Lord Ultas Maernos , whose wife and children all died in an Amn ian plague in 1345 DR . With no heirs , Ultas agreed that upon his death , the family home in Waterdeep would be converted into a place of worship for non - human inhabitants of the city . As of 1370 DR , Ultas had already started this conversion , buying art such as painting and statues appropriate for non - human races . The family villa in Waterdeep , as of 1374 DR , had lion statues adnorning the walls .

title: Maerstar
description: Maerstar Maerstar was a town in the Vast , situated at the point where Helve ' s Trail from High Haspur ended at the North Road between Procampur and Sevenecho . It lay near the Earthfast Mountains and south of the Brynwood . History .
description_long: Maerstar Maerstar was a town in the Vast , situated at the point where Helve ' s Trail from High Haspur ended at the North Road between Procampur and Sevenecho . It lay near the Earthfast Mountains and south of the Brynwood . History . During the Time of Troubles , 1358 DR , many of merchants of Procampur and Tsurlagol fled to take refuge in their country houses in Maerstar . However , refugees from Tantras , Calaunt and even Mulmaster also came through Maerstar , and looting mobs of them harassed the wealthy merchants . Some were slain by the mobs . When a well in the neighboring hamlet of Sevenecho was poisoned on the 1st Eleint in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Maerstar was unwilling to send aid , fearing that they too would be attacked by those responsible . Economy . The town made its living in quarrying and horse s . The town was a center for breeding horses , and had a number of well - used paddocks . In particular , the people of Maerstar bred a large , black , sleek - coated horse that was highly sought after all around the Inner Sea . Description .

title: Maeruhal
description: Maeruhal Maeruhal was a small city located in eastern Halruaa . Description . Maeruhal was a small settlement located within close proximity to the famed electrum mines of Halruaa .
description_long: Maeruhal Maeruhal was a small city located in eastern Halruaa . Description . Maeruhal was a small settlement located within close proximity to the famed electrum mines of Halruaa . Defenses . Five skyships were permanently docked in Maeruhal . All of them belonged to Halruaan Elders . In addition to the skyships , Maeruhal boasted two companies of elite dwarven warriors . Inhabitants . The renowned craftsman , Boronuil Ironfist made his home in Maeruhal

title: Maerun Stoutbold
description: Maerun Stoutbold Maerun Stoutbold was a merchant in Suzail , Cormyr around 1367 DR . He ran a shipbuilding company out of both Suzail and Marsember that dealt in the repair and sale of ships , nets , and masts . He had not been found to have broken the law but he was well known to be the person to speak to for silent passage on a ship .
description_long: Maerun Stoutbold Maerun Stoutbold was a merchant in Suzail , Cormyr around 1367 DR . He ran a shipbuilding company out of both Suzail and Marsember that dealt in the repair and sale of ships , nets , and masts . He had not been found to have broken the law but he was well known to be the person to speak to for silent passage on a ship . Although Maerun was caught by a War Wizard with two bound females , he hired a Sembia n mage to claim they were creatures polymorphed into human form for safe transportation . Maerun spent his winters in Marsember .

title: Maeryln
description: Maeryln An apprentice who was lost to time and history , all that is known of Maeryln is that she was a human who specialized in absorption of arcane powers , memories , and souls . It is rumored that Halaster took her on due to her resistance to the Spellplague that he somehow knew was coming . She was consumed by her own experiments when she summoned a lifedrinker specter that slowly drained away her memories and life - force .
description_long: Maeryln An apprentice who was lost to time and history , all that is known of Maeryln is that she was a human who specialized in absorption of arcane powers , memories , and souls . It is rumored that Halaster took her on due to her resistance to the Spellplague that he somehow knew was coming . She was consumed by her own experiments when she summoned a lifedrinker specter that slowly drained away her memories and life - force . She existed only as a ghost for a long period of time and was tortured by said specter until recently " freed " by adventurers .

title: Maeshi Province
description: Maeshi Province The Maeshi Province was a small and isolated province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Geography . Maeshi was on a small northern peninsula on the west coast of Shinkoku and was bordered by several of the highest peaks in Kozakura , among them including Two Peak Mountain .
description_long: Maeshi Province The Maeshi Province was a small and isolated province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Geography . Maeshi was on a small northern peninsula on the west coast of Shinkoku and was bordered by several of the highest peaks in Kozakura , among them including Two Peak Mountain . History . It was famous for the cursed Ito - Jo castle and the Doi No Fugu inn .

title: Maestro
description: Maestro Maestro by R . A . Salvatore is the second book of the Homecoming series .
description_long: Maestro Maestro by R . A . Salvatore is the second book of the Homecoming series . It was released on April 5 , 2016 . Summary . Demons abound in the Underdark surrounding Menzoberranzan after Gromph Baenre ' s accidental summoning of Demogorgon to the drow city . Yvonnel Baenre , meanwhile , has advanced her magic and her body ' s physical age forward by two decades as she plots to bring more chaos to Menzoberranzan . In Gauntlgrym , Catti - brie discovers that the ancient magic that seals in the primordial is weakening and so the Host Tower of the Arcane must be rebuilt . As she embarks on a task to bring together architects of a restored Host Tower , Jarlaxle requests Drizzt ' s help in returning to Menzoberranzan with Artemis Entreri to rescue Dahlia , who remains in a perpetually confused state as Matron Mother of House Do ' Urden . Back in Menzoberranzan , High Priestess Kiriy Xorlarrin plots alongside House Hunzrin and House Melarn to serve her own ends : replace House Do ' Urden with a restored House Xorlarrin under her rule .

title: Maffizo Vailentarne
description: Maffizo Vailentarne Maffizo Vailentarne was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Maffizo was a minor wizard living in Q ' xorlarrin .
description_long: Maffizo Vailentarne Maffizo Vailentarne was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Maffizo was a minor wizard living in Q ' xorlarrin . During the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , he , along his old associate Epricante , was part of a Xorlarrin reinforcement army sent to help the orc warlord Hartusk after an orc defeat near Mithril Hall . However , thanks to the plotting of Gromph Baenre and Kimmuriel Oblodra , Hartusk believed that Epricante and his army were traitors and attacked and destroyed them .

title: Maforie Chûmavh
description: Maforie Chûmavh Maforie Chûmavh was a drow slave in Maerimydra . History . Maforie lived all her life in slavery of the fire giant s rulers of her city .
description_long: Maforie Chûmavh Maforie Chûmavh was a drow slave in Maerimydra . History . Maforie lived all her life in slavery of the fire giant s rulers of her city . As of 1491 DR Maforie was at the entrance to the Undying Temple . Personality . Unlike most of drow female Maforie was shy , quiet and distrustful of others . Relationship . Maforie was unknown to herself the last heiress of House Chûmavh .

title: Magadon Kest
description: Magadon Kest Magadon Kest was a tiefling psionicist ( or " mind mage " ) who was sired by Mephistopheles , Archduke of Cania , and a human woman . Close friend of the late Erevis Cale and the exarch Drasek Riven , he was instrumental in the struggle against the returned Netherese who were led by Shar - worshiper Rivalen Tanthul . History .
description_long: Magadon Kest Magadon Kest was a tiefling psionicist ( or " mind mage " ) who was sired by Mephistopheles , Archduke of Cania , and a human woman . Close friend of the late Erevis Cale and the exarch Drasek Riven , he was instrumental in the struggle against the returned Netherese who were led by Shar - worshiper Rivalen Tanthul . History . After the return of the Netherese city of Sakkors , Magadon was captured by the Shadovar and force to link his mind with the quasi - sentient Mythallar known as the Source . As a result , Magadon is " addicted " to the Source . His power when linked to it was increased greatly but , the addiction made him a puppet for the Netherese lords , which used the Mythallar to create soldiers for the upcoming Shadowstorm . Working with Cale and Riven , he was eventually freed from his link with the Source but continued to struggle with the addiction . Magadon confronted his father , with the aid of Riven and Cale , in Cania , after the Archduke succeeded in facilitating the release of Mag ' s devilish nature . Though Mephistopheles had lured the three companions through Magadon , he engaged them in battle .

title: Mage ' s Tower
description: Mage ' s Tower The Mage ' s Tower was a mysterious tower standing on the edge of the Flooded Forest between the lands of the Vast and the Moonsea in north Faerûn , lying west of Kurth and at the end of a trail north from Tavilar . Structure . The Mage ' s Tower was a lone tower some 70 feet ( 21 meters ) high with a spired top .
description_long: Mage ' s Tower The Mage ' s Tower was a mysterious tower standing on the edge of the Flooded Forest between the lands of the Vast and the Moonsea in north Faerûn , lying west of Kurth and at the end of a trail north from Tavilar . Structure . The Mage ' s Tower was a lone tower some 70 feet ( 21 meters ) high with a spired top . It was built of massive blocks of stone . There was no visible door , but it had three large , arched windows at the top . Interior . Inside were only empty and dusty corridors and rooms , apparently uninhabited . However , the windows showed it was sometimes lit . Defenses . The base of the tower was guarded by a stone golem . This attacked anyone who tried to touch or climb the walls , or who tried to levitate or fly within 40 feet ( 12 meters ) of the tower . It kept attacking until trespassers were either dead or unmoving , or until they retreated to over 200 feet ( 70 meters ) away . It left went beyond this range . For those who made it to the windows , three enormous gargoyle s flew out to assault them and chase them away . These gargoyles or their smaller kin patrolled the tower against anyone gaining access via tunneling or magic .

title: Mage ' s disjunction
description: Mage ' s disjunction Mage ' s disjunction is a magical spell that radiates outward in a 40 by 40 ft . radius and all magical effects and magic items within the radius , except the items that you are carrying or presently touching are taken away / dispelled . Thus " disjoining " the spell with items , things , etc .
description_long: Mage ' s disjunction Mage ' s disjunction is a magical spell that radiates outward in a 40 by 40 ft . radius and all magical effects and magic items within the radius , except the items that you are carrying or presently touching are taken away / dispelled . Thus " disjoining " the spell with items , things , etc . Disjoining can also be used to destroy magical artifacts / relics and can even be used to remove magical possession over beings .

title: Mage Who Never Dies
description: Mage Who Never Dies The Mage Who Never Dies was the mysterious master of the Flooded Forest in the Vast and the Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . The title was given by folk around Ylraphon , but whoever or whatever this being was remained unknown . The Mage Who Never Dies was said to have claimed the southern part of the Flooded Forest as his domain .
description_long: Mage Who Never Dies The Mage Who Never Dies was the mysterious master of the Flooded Forest in the Vast and the Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . The title was given by folk around Ylraphon , but whoever or whatever this being was remained unknown . The Mage Who Never Dies was said to have claimed the southern part of the Flooded Forest as his domain . This included the duskwood forests at its southern edge and the Mage ' s Tower , with the village of Tavilar lying at the southern border . Some folk in Ylraphon rumored that certain evil groups and orc s , who regularly stocked up on supplies in Ylraphon before venturing into the Flooded Forest , served the Mage Who Never Dies .

title: Mage armor
description: Mage armor Mage armor ( originally called General Matick ' s armor and later simply armor ) was a common conjuration spell used by arcane casters to create an armor for themselves out of magical force . Deities of magic , such as Azuth , Mystra , Savras , and Thoth , also granted some of their cleric s this power . Effects .
description_long: Mage armor Mage armor ( originally called General Matick ' s armor and later simply armor ) was a common conjuration spell used by arcane casters to create an armor for themselves out of magical force . Deities of magic , such as Azuth , Mystra , Savras , and Thoth , also granted some of their cleric s this power . Effects . Upon casting the spell , whomever the caster touched was enveloped in an invisible force field that protected the target in much the same way as mundane armor , yet without any of its penalties , such as restricted movement or weight . Because it was a force field , incorporeal creatures or objects could not pass through it . This magic force armor would last for at least an hour , its ultimate duration dependent on the power of the caster . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic component s , the spell required that the caster hold unto a fragment of cured leather while casting . History . The spell was supposedly invented by the Netherese arcanist and warrior General Matick in −1575 DR , but many scholars believed that he had only commissioned its invention . Notable Users .

title: Mage hand
description: Mage hand Mage hand is a cantrip , or low complexity spell , learned by all wizard s . When a wizard uses " mage hand " he or she conjure s a magical , ghost - like hand within twenty - five feet , which they can use to interact with objects weighing twenty pounds or less . The hand has the equivalent speed of a dwarf and can easily drop items or , given a moment , pick up new ones .
description_long: Mage hand Mage hand is a cantrip , or low complexity spell , learned by all wizard s . When a wizard uses " mage hand " he or she conjure s a magical , ghost - like hand within twenty - five feet , which they can use to interact with objects weighing twenty pounds or less . The hand has the equivalent speed of a dwarf and can easily drop items or , given a moment , pick up new ones . With a little bit of effort , a wizard can keep the hand conjured indefinitely , though if he or she stops attempting to do so it will dissipate within a moment of its being cast . " Mage hand " ' can be recast at any time however . Before the Spellplague , " mage hand " was a cantrip also castable by bard s and sorcerer s . Although it could only be cast a limited number of times per day during this era , its effects were otherwise the same .

title: Magebane
description: Magebane Magebane was an intelligent + 2 bastard sword made of one piece of an unusual and unidentified black metal . It allowed its wielder to " detect magic " at will . History .
description_long: Magebane Magebane was an intelligent + 2 bastard sword made of one piece of an unusual and unidentified black metal . It allowed its wielder to " detect magic " at will . History . The sword Magebane was crafted for a mameluk of Calimshan during the realm ' s seventh age . It was used primarily to hunt down wizard s .

title: Magefair
description: Magefair A magefair , or the Magefair , was a private gathering of wizard s for the purposes of demonstrating magical powers and general enjoyment . Magefairs could be useful for learning new spells . History .
description_long: Magefair A magefair , or the Magefair , was a private gathering of wizard s for the purposes of demonstrating magical powers and general enjoyment . Magefairs could be useful for learning new spells . History . Originally , the town of Sendrin in the Vast was a mecca for wizard s . Here , they could talk shop , share spells , and practice their magic far from inhabited areas . Some also took the opportunity to play up , party all night , mess around with magic for lewdness and vandalism , and generally get away with what they couldn ' t at home . However , when Azuth defeated Savras and supplanted him as god of magic , Azuth ' s followers sacked and destroyed the temple of Savras in Sendrin . The wizards stopped coming , and those who ' d serviced them — scribes , component sellers , tailors , healers , escorts — gradually left . But the community they ' d made went mobile , becoming the travelling Magefair . Organization . The Magefair was held annually in various remote locations . Rules . There were certain rules to prevent total chaos breaking out , and sentinels prevented the entrance of non - magicians , challenging them to cast spells to prove their worth .

title: Magelord
description: Magelord Magelord was a special prestige class on Faerûn whose members were arcane spellcasters who studied an ancient magical practice known for its distinctive style : extremely fast and versatile . Magelords typically believed they had the right to get respect , wealth and power through the use and threat of arcane strength . In reality though , they used their power to dominate and intimidate less talented individuals .
description_long: Magelord Magelord was a special prestige class on Faerûn whose members were arcane spellcasters who studied an ancient magical practice known for its distinctive style : extremely fast and versatile . Magelords typically believed they had the right to get respect , wealth and power through the use and threat of arcane strength . In reality though , they used their power to dominate and intimidate less talented individuals . Despite theis tendency there were a select few who studied magelord lore in hopes of using their power for more benevolent purposes . The magelord tradition was been passed down over the centuries from one practitioner to another . As few magelords gave away such knowledge , prospective practitioners had to either bribe a magelord in order to learn his secrets or undertake years of research to discover their methods . Magelords in Athalantar . While magelords were somewhat scarce in the Realms , some magelord societies have arisen over the years , most notably in Athalantar . Athalantar wizard s were cruel and quite talented , and many served as high officials of the realm , ruling the kingdom in secret .

title: Magemask
description: Magemask Magemasks were leather halfmasks with crystal lenses fitted within the eye openings . Powers . Anyone wearing a " magemask " viewed their surroundings as if under the active effects of a " detect magic " spell , allowing them to easily spot magic items , hidden runes , and other wizardly writings .
description_long: Magemask Magemasks were leather halfmasks with crystal lenses fitted within the eye openings . Powers . Anyone wearing a " magemask " viewed their surroundings as if under the active effects of a " detect magic " spell , allowing them to easily spot magic items , hidden runes , and other wizardly writings . Additionally , the wearer also enjoyed " infravision " and " read magic " abilities , though those unskilled in the magical arts would only be able to discern the general nature of the magic . A " magemask " could not be worn with any other mask or spectacle .

title: Mages of Saruun
description: Mages of Saruun The Mages of Saruun was a merchant wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Seven - Pillared Hall in Cormyr . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . Their operations were considered illegal , as they weren ' t officially sanctioned by the Forest Kingdom .
description_long: Mages of Saruun The Mages of Saruun was a merchant wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Seven - Pillared Hall in Cormyr . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . Their operations were considered illegal , as they weren ' t officially sanctioned by the Forest Kingdom . History . In 1454 DR , three wizard s discovered the ruins of Saruun Khel in the Thunderspire Mountain , while seeking forgotten treasures . Among the magic items they recovered were several magic amulets , which allowed them to control the bronze warders , minotaur constructs built in the city ' s heyday . The wizards used the bronze warders to clear the upper level of the ruins , establishing a stronghold there — the Seven - Pillared Hall , and founded the order of the Mages of Saruun . Activities . The Mages of Saruun only cared about their profitable business with the merchants of the Underdark .

title: Mageweaver
description: Mageweaver Mageweavers were wizard s in Zakhara who imbued artistic creations , such as tapestries and silk scarves , with magical power . Requirements . Mageweavers did not have any special requirements other than possessing the skill needed to craft the artistic vessel where they intended to store their magic .
