description_long: Mageweaver Mageweavers were wizard s in Zakhara who imbued artistic creations , such as tapestries and silk scarves , with magical power . Requirements . Mageweavers did not have any special requirements other than possessing the skill needed to craft the artistic vessel where they intended to store their magic . Role . These wizards were masters at storing their spells within their creations . Though technically weaker than other wizards in Zakhara , mageweavers had access to a much wider variety of spells . Possessions . Like other wizards , mageweavers never wore armor and were very limited in the kind of weapon they could use . In place of a spellbook , many mageweavers carried silken creations on their person that were carefully protected within tubes or cylinders . Benefits . Mageweavers did not use spellbooks . Instead , all of their spells were magically stored within their creations . They could use spells from any magical province , and could use more of those spells compared to other wizards . Stronger spells required more space on their creation to store . Simple spells only required a small space of 6 square inches .

title: Maggarl Helck
description: Maggarl Helck Maggarl Helck was a Red Plumes commander in the Moonsea . Activities . Maggarl managed the Waydown garrison .
description_long: Maggarl Helck Maggarl Helck was a Red Plumes commander in the Moonsea . Activities . Maggarl managed the Waydown garrison . He also led a smuggling ring . Only he had the key to the Waydown and knew the magic word to stop the golem guardian . Usually he did nothing , relying on his sergeants to handle most of the garrison ' s affairs . History . Maggarl rose through the Red Plumes ' ranks thanks to his father . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Maggarl replaced Vuhm Yestral as commander of the garrison at the entrance of the Waydown . He used his position to become rich off smuggling . At one point , however , a giant octopus attacked one of his river expeditions and dragged away two mercenaries , which worried Maggarl . So Maggarl greatly enjoyed Felratha ' s proposal to hold a performance by her minstrels to raise the morale of his men . Felratha instead planned to smuggle goods to Szith Morcane without Maggarl ' s knowledge . She and the adventuring party she had hired silently entered his quarters at night in order to find the key and the magic word . Possibly under the auspices of the Order of the Gauntlet , they may have also tried to find proof of his corruption .

title: Magic
description: Magic Magic was the ability possessed by some individuals to manipulate the ambient energies of the world to produce desired results . In the Realms , arcane magic was commonly referred to as " the Art " , while divine magic was referred to as " the Power " . The goddess Mystra controlled the Weave which was the main medium for channeling the arcane energies of Abeir - Toril .
description_long: Magic Magic was the ability possessed by some individuals to manipulate the ambient energies of the world to produce desired results . In the Realms , arcane magic was commonly referred to as " the Art " , while divine magic was referred to as " the Power " . The goddess Mystra controlled the Weave which was the main medium for channeling the arcane energies of Abeir - Toril . The goddess Shar controlled the Shadow Weave which flows in - between the normal weave and enables the use of Shadow Magic . Divine magic was drawn from specific deities and is not influenced by either Mystra or Shar as evidenced by the fact it continued to work when arcane magic ceased to function . Historically this made it the most reliable form of magic . History . Lord Ao created the universe . At first it was nothing but energy , with neither light nor dark , heat nor cold . Eventually the energy created two deities – Selûne and Shar . Together they created heavens and Chauntea , the embodiment of the world of Toril . Chauntea begged for light and warmth so that she could create life on the new world , but Shar opposed this vehemently .

title: Magic aura
description: Magic aura A magic aura or magical aura was a type of aura , an invisible property that indicated the strength and nature of the magic possessed by a magical item or a spell , and by certain mages . The " detect magic " spell allowed a spellcaster to examine magical auras in their vicinity . Arcane spellcasters could also possess a magic aura , and this revealed their nature and make - up to other mages .
description_long: Magic aura A magic aura or magical aura was a type of aura , an invisible property that indicated the strength and nature of the magic possessed by a magical item or a spell , and by certain mages . The " detect magic " spell allowed a spellcaster to examine magical auras in their vicinity . Arcane spellcasters could also possess a magic aura , and this revealed their nature and make - up to other mages . Such auras could also be passed down through family lines . For example , the wizard Kyriani Agrivar bore the magic aura of her father , the renowned wizard Ostus Agrivar . This allowed Kyriani to control the Great Door that Ostus had created and only he and co - creator Parwyyd Hanifar could control . Parwyyd described Kyriani ' s magic aura as " odd " , owing to her complex origin as a re - merger of the divided being Cybriana and Kilili . When split up again , Ostus ' s magic aura went with Kilili , who ' d been born of the essence of the dark side of Ostus and his magic . When Cybriana and Kilili re - merged into a new Kyriani , she retained the necessary aura and was able to close the Door .

title: Magic circle against chaos
description: Magic circle against chaos Magic Circle against Chaos was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from chaotic creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from chaos " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonlawful summoned creature .
description_long: Magic circle against chaos Magic Circle against Chaos was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from chaotic creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from chaos " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonlawful summoned creature . Components . See the description of the components at " magic circle against evil " .

title: Magic circle against evil
description: Magic circle against evil Magic Circle against Evil , also known as Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from evil creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on good creatures . Effects .
description_long: Magic circle against evil Magic Circle against Evil , also known as Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from evil creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on good creatures . Effects . This spell conferred the same benefits as " protection from evil " to the creature touched , except the aura extended to a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius sphere around the creature , and warded all those within the area of effect . The barrier prevented nongood summoned creatures from entering unless they managed to resist the spell . If the creature touched was too large to fit completely within the sphere , then the spell acted as a " protection from evil " spell for that creature . The " protection " lasted for tens of minutes to a few hours , depending on the experience of the caster . The newer version of this spell could be inverted to prevent nongood summoned creatures from leaving the circle drawn to cast the spell ( see Components below ) .

title: Magic circle against good
description: Magic circle against good Magic Circle against Good , also known as Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from good creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on evil creatures . Effects .
description_long: Magic circle against good Magic Circle against Good , also known as Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from good creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on evil creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from good " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonevil summoned creature . Components . See the description of the components at " magic circle against evil " .

title: Magic circle against law
description: Magic circle against law Magic Circle against Law was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from lawful creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from law " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonchaotic summoned creature .
description_long: Magic circle against law Magic Circle against Law was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from lawful creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from law " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonchaotic summoned creature . Components . See the description of the components at " magic circle against evil " .

title: Magic fang
description: Magic fang Magic fang is a transmutation spell that improves a creature ' s natural weapons ( teeth , claws , etc . ) . Effect .
description_long: Magic fang Magic fang is a transmutation spell that improves a creature ' s natural weapons ( teeth , claws , etc . ) . Effect . Magic fang gives one natural weapon of the subject a + 1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls . The spell can affect a slam attack , fist , bite , or other natural weapon . ( The spell does not change an unarmed strike ' s damage from subdual damage to normal damage . ) If you ' re a good druid , the natural weapon is considered blessed , which means it has special effects on certain creatures .

title: Magic jar
description: Magic jar Magic jar , which was originally called Jarm ' s magic jar , was a necromancy spell used to trap one ' s soul in a gem or crystal . Effects . Upon completing this powerful spell , the caster ' s soul leaves his or her body and enters a selected gemstone , the " magic jar " , somewhere within medium range .
description_long: Magic jar Magic jar , which was originally called Jarm ' s magic jar , was a necromancy spell used to trap one ' s soul in a gem or crystal . Effects . Upon completing this powerful spell , the caster ' s soul leaves his or her body and enters a selected gemstone , the " magic jar " , somewhere within medium range . The caster ' s body at this point appears to be dead . For up to nine hours or more , the caster ' s soul in the magic jar can attempt to possess any nearby sentient creature , swapping souls with the target ' s body , such that the caster ' s soul controls the new body and the target ' s soul becomes trapped in the magic jar . A sentient creature up to 90 feet or more away from the gemstone could be possessed , depending on the power of the caster . If a target had the willpower to resist possession , the caster ' s soul would remain in the gem . The caster could sense the presence of nearby lifeforms and had a sense of whether they were positive or negative energy beings and a relative idea of the strength of their life forces . A caster could shift from any possessed body back to the magic jar and could then attempt to possess a new body .

title: Magic match
description: Magic match A magic match was a one - use magic item that produced a small flame on demand . Description . It was an ordinary copper rod some 3 inches ( 7 .
description_long: Magic match A magic match was a one - use magic item that produced a small flame on demand . Description . It was an ordinary copper rod some 3 inches ( 7 . 6 centimeters ) long . They were typically sold in batches of 20 and stored in small , engraved , wooden boxes . Powers . A brief command word caused a small flame to ignite at one end , which could be used to burn or ignite . It could not be extinguished by wind or water , but burned only briefly and worked only onced . History . In Faerûn , it was believed that " magic matches " had been invented in Kara - Tur . Certainly , the first of them arrived in Faerûn at around the time of the Tuigan Horde invasion in 1359 – 1360 DR . Afterward , Daltim Flamefist and other Faerûnian mages studied the " magic matches " and reverse - engineered a means of making them . Daltim wrote details of the " magic match " in his spellbook " Daltim ' s Tome of Fire " , which he lost in Tethyr in the 1360s DR .

title: Magic missile
description: Magic missile A magic missile was a spell that cast bolts of pure force from its caster ' s fingertips . Effect . Originally , " magic missile " grew in power as its spellcaster did , so that more experienced wizards or sorcerers cast more bolts with a single spell than those with less training .
description_long: Magic missile A magic missile was a spell that cast bolts of pure force from its caster ' s fingertips . Effect . Originally , " magic missile " grew in power as its spellcaster did , so that more experienced wizards or sorcerers cast more bolts with a single spell than those with less training . Like nearly all spells of the time , it required careful preparation before its casting and a sorcerer or wizard could only cast the spell as many times as they had prepared it for the day before the memory of how to cast the spell fell from the mind of its caster . Before the Spellplague , the " missile " manifested itself as a silvery bolt of energy and while the spell was simple , it could be deadly to weaker opponents . " Magic missile " was so simple that it required little concentration or preparation on the part of the wizard casting it . Very powerful wizards were able to cast a " magic missile " of twice the equivalent power of inexperienced mages . " Magic missile " could be cast over a distance of about 100 feet . The appearance of a " magic missile " could vary greatly .

title: Magic mouth
description: Magic mouth Magic mouth , originally known as Carbury ' s mouth , was an illusion spell , that created the glamer of a mouth upon a creature or object that would deliver a message when a trigger event occurred . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create an illusion of a speaking mouth upon a chosen object or creature within close proximity .
description_long: Magic mouth Magic mouth , originally known as Carbury ' s mouth , was an illusion spell , that created the glamer of a mouth upon a creature or object that would deliver a message when a trigger event occurred . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create an illusion of a speaking mouth upon a chosen object or creature within close proximity . The spell would remain in effect until the triggering event occurred , which could be any visual or audible trigger chosen by the caster that took place within a limited distance , which depended upon the power of the caster but was at least fifteen feet . When triggered , the mouth would appear and speak a recorded message of 25 words or fewer in any language , but such a message was incapable of acting as a trigger for another spell or magical item or as a verbal component . Components . Verbal and somatic component s were required to cast this spell , along with a small amount of honey and jade dust . Amethyst could be used as a substitute for jade . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Carbury in −871 DR , the same year in which he also created his " spectral force " spell .

title: Magic stone
description: Magic stone Magic stone , also called magical stone , was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned some nearby stones into projectiles . Effects . Up to three small stones no larger than sling bullets could be enchanted to become magical projectiles that could be used in a ranged attack .
description_long: Magic stone Magic stone , also called magical stone , was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned some nearby stones into projectiles . Effects . Up to three small stones no larger than sling bullets could be enchanted to become magical projectiles that could be used in a ranged attack . The dweomer lasted 30 minutes before the pebbles reverted back to normal . Whomever used the stones had to make a normal range attack , either by throwing or slinging , but with the added bonus due to the magic on the stones , it was a bit easier and worked on targets that only magic weapons could strike . The transmuted bullets were particularly effective against undead , potentially doing double damage . Components . Verbal and somatic components and the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus were required , plus the three stones . The enchantment version of this spell required the pebbles be untouched by tool or magic as a prerequisite .

title: Magic tinderbox
description: Magic tinderbox A magic tinderbox was a tinderbox enchanted for better reliability . It was invented by the Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist . Description .
description_long: Magic tinderbox A magic tinderbox was a tinderbox enchanted for better reliability . It was invented by the Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist . Description . A " magic tinderbox " resembled a perfectly ordinary tinderbox , being a set of typical tools for making a fire , including a piece of flint and steel and dry materials to burn . These were kept inside an engraved wooden box to keep them dry . Powers . The tools of a " magic tinderbox " were used in the same way as those of a traditional tinderbox . The flint - and - steel was enchanted to always create sufficient sparks to ignite a fire . This worked in wind and rain , though extreme conditions such as a gale or torrential downpour were too great for proper functioning . History . The Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist developed the " magic tinderbox " in the 1360s DR . His technique circulated in Faerûn , and " magic tinderboxes " came to be used by several well - equipped adventuring companies . Daltim wrote details of the " magic tinderbox " and notes for creating one in his spellbook " Daltim ' s Tome of Fire " , which he lost in Tethyr in the 1360s DR .

title: Magic vestment
description: Magic vestment Magic vestment , and an older version called magical vestment , were transmutation or enchantment spells respectively , that improved the armor value of clothing , a shield , or a suit of armor . Effects . Though similar in effect , the two versions of this spell were different in practice .
description_long: Magic vestment Magic vestment , and an older version called magical vestment , were transmutation or enchantment spells respectively , that improved the armor value of clothing , a shield , or a suit of armor . Effects . Though similar in effect , the two versions of this spell were different in practice . The transmutation version could be cast on anyone ' s clothing , armor , or a shield as long as the caster could touch the targeted vestment . The enchantment version only worked on the caster . The transmutation version lasted for hours while the enchantment version lasted for only 25 to 100 minutes or so . However , the improvement in armor was better in most cases for the enchantment version . Starting with plain clothes or robes , the enchantment version immediately granted protection equivalent to chain mail and increased up to field plate armor as the level of the caster increased . For the transmutation version , the lowest level improvement was equivalent to donning padded armor and increased up to chain mail as the level of the caster increased .

title: Magic weapon
description: Magic weapon Magic weapon is a widespread transmutation spell that boosts a given weapon ' s usefulness in combat . Effects . " Magic weapon " gives a weapon a + 1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .
description_long: Magic weapon Magic weapon is a widespread transmutation spell that boosts a given weapon ' s usefulness in combat . Effects . " Magic weapon " gives a weapon a + 1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls . If you ' re a good cleric , the cleric of a good deity , or a paladin , the weapon is considered blessed , which means it has special effects on certain creatures .

title: Magical Legion
description: Magical Legion The Magical Legion was an elite unit of specialized aerial soldiers found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Grand Vizier Alyana al - Azzazi ran the Magical Legion , though since she detested dealing with Prince Cheddah al - Assad ' s orders , she often deferred the guidance of the Magical Legion to the White Agate who proved more than capable of handling the demands .
description_long: Magical Legion The Magical Legion was an elite unit of specialized aerial soldiers found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Grand Vizier Alyana al - Azzazi ran the Magical Legion , though since she detested dealing with Prince Cheddah al - Assad ' s orders , she often deferred the guidance of the Magical Legion to the White Agate who proved more than capable of handling the demands . Activities . The Magical Legion performed various duties for the city of Huzuz including reconnaissance , special parades , and aerial patrols .

title: Magical sand
description: Magical sand Magical sand referred to the various types of magical sandy substances found throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Similar to magical dusts , magical sand was often found in a sack or jar .
description_long: Magical sand Magical sand referred to the various types of magical sandy substances found throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Similar to magical dusts , magical sand was often found in a sack or jar . Typically , an entire handful of magical sand was required in order to activate the sand ' s enchantment . A sack or jar of magical sand held 11 - 20 handfuls , making them relatively heavy and cumbersome . Powers . The magical powers of magical sand varied greatly , but all had an effective throwing range of about 20 feet ( 6 m ) and acted upon an area no wider than 10 feet ( 3 m ) .

title: Magister
description: Magister The Magister was the personal champion of Mystra , existing to promote the Art in her name . The role of Magister was created in the wake of the Dawn Cataclysm . A man named Azuth gained the office , but passed it on once he himself gained divinity .
description_long: Magister The Magister was the personal champion of Mystra , existing to promote the Art in her name . The role of Magister was created in the wake of the Dawn Cataclysm . A man named Azuth gained the office , but passed it on once he himself gained divinity . Only Mystra herself knew the full roster of Magisters but many made their names known by their deeds during their tenure in the office . Elminster and Laeral Silverhand passed on their knowledge of the Magister ' s abilities and responsibilities to various sages . If they hadn ' t , then only Mystra , Azuth and the current Magister would know any of the pertinent details .

title: Maglubiyet
description: Maglubiyet Maglubiyet , known as The Mighty One or The High Chieftain was the chief deity of goblin s and hobgoblin s as well as an exarch of Bane . He was a god of war and leadership who ruled over the goblin pantheon with an iron fist . As a god of war and a great general he was also known as The Battle Lord .
description_long: Maglubiyet Maglubiyet , known as The Mighty One or The High Chieftain was the chief deity of goblin s and hobgoblin s as well as an exarch of Bane . He was a god of war and leadership who ruled over the goblin pantheon with an iron fist . As a god of war and a great general he was also known as The Battle Lord . Another of his aliases might be The Iron One , an aspect worshiped by the Grodd goblin s . Description . Maglubiyet appeared as a 11 feet ( 3 . 4m ) tall , black - skinned goblin with flaming eyes , powerfully - muscled arms and sharp talons . He wielded a mighty coal - black battleaxe that constantly dripped blood . Realm . Maglubiyet ' s divine realm was Clangor , located on the plane of Acheron . His capital was a fortress city called Grashmog , which translated from the goblin tongue meant the " Heart of Battle . " The mightiest goblin city in Clangor was Shetring , a fortification with five bridges spanning the River Lorfang . Maglubiyet lived at the bottom of a waterfall of the river in a cavern of magnificently carved steel dripping with moisture .

title: Magnar
description: Magnar Magnar the Bear was a primal spirit of the Yuirwood . History . An ancient spirit of Yuirwood , Magnar was revered by the primitive human inhabitants of the forest .
description_long: Magnar Magnar the Bear was a primal spirit of the Yuirwood . History . An ancient spirit of Yuirwood , Magnar was revered by the primitive human inhabitants of the forest . When the wild elves settled in Yuirwood in - 9800 DR , the spirits of the forest merged with the Seldarine and Magnar became an aspect of Rillifane Rallathil and was almost totally subsumed .

title: Magocracy
description: Magocracy A magocracy is a form of government where only those with ability in arcane magic have a voice in government . Power is often limited to the few who have the wealth and education , or magical heritage . Magocracies are commonly , but not always , where wizard s share power in government .
description_long: Magocracy A magocracy is a form of government where only those with ability in arcane magic have a voice in government . Power is often limited to the few who have the wealth and education , or magical heritage . Magocracies are commonly , but not always , where wizard s share power in government .

title: Magrath the Minotaur
description: Magrath the Minotaur Magrath the Minotaur was a pirate lord who briefly ruled over the city of Suzail . Biography . Fleeing from a Chondathan mercenary army that had invaded the pirate city of Westgate , Magrath landed in Cormyr and purchased the city of Suzail from Melineth Turcassan for 500 sacks of gold in 429 DR .
description_long: Magrath the Minotaur Magrath the Minotaur was a pirate lord who briefly ruled over the city of Suzail . Biography . Fleeing from a Chondathan mercenary army that had invaded the pirate city of Westgate , Magrath landed in Cormyr and purchased the city of Suzail from Melineth Turcassan for 500 sacks of gold in 429 DR . Magrath then plundered the city ' s treasury and took over as its ruler , seeking to expand his influence within Cormyr , and put a price on King Duar Obarskyr ' s head , higher than what he had paid for Suzail . In 432 DR , Magrath was killed by King Duar after an attack on the traitorous house Dheolur . Equipment . Magrath wielded a battleaxe with a thick ironwood haft .

title: Magros
description: Magros Magros was a misfortune devil in the service of Levistus . History . In 1486 DR , Magros was plotting with Sairché to use Farideh to acquire some divine sparks from the Chosen s captured by the shadovar in the Lost Peaks .
description_long: Magros Magros was a misfortune devil in the service of Levistus . History . In 1486 DR , Magros was plotting with Sairché to use Farideh to acquire some divine sparks from the Chosen s captured by the shadovar in the Lost Peaks . He had a spy inside the village . However he also bargained with the Red Wizards of Thay Zahnya when Lorcan approached Magros offering to trade . Magros played with both Lorcan and Sairché until at last he obtained from Zanhya the nar scepter of Alzrius , that was his true objective and went back in Hell .

title: Magurk
description: Magurk Magurk was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . A former soldier of the Purple Dragons , Magurk was proprietor of the store called One - Armed Magurk ' s . History .
description_long: Magurk Magurk was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . A former soldier of the Purple Dragons , Magurk was proprietor of the store called One - Armed Magurk ' s . History . After he lost his arm in battle , Magurk retired from the Purple Dragons and opened up his shop , buying and selling — no questions asked — goods looted by adventurers from ruins and dungeons found around Thunderstone . As Magurk was a former soldier of the Purple Dragons , the local contingent kept a close watch on him and his store . The Wolfmasters adventuring company stopped at Magurk ' s store seeking potion s that could somehow control black dragon s before they ventured into the Vast Swamp . However , Magurk had no such thing , and came to despise the obnoxious Sembia n adventurers and their excessive haggling . Personality . He was a shrewd dealer , and one could not take advantage of him . Possessions . Impressively , Magurk owned a " + 3 vorpal short sword " , which he kept under the counter .

title: Magusta
description: Magusta Magusta was a powerful female malaugrym that was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR . At the end , she managed to get close to the girl posing as her dwarf friend Delg Hammerhand but was killed by Torm of the Knights of Myth Drannor that Elminster had sent to find and stop the malaugrym .
description_long: Magusta Magusta was a powerful female malaugrym that was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR . At the end , she managed to get close to the girl posing as her dwarf friend Delg Hammerhand but was killed by Torm of the Knights of Myth Drannor that Elminster had sent to find and stop the malaugrym .

title: Mahabba
description: Mahabba The city of Mahabba on the banks of Al - Musammas River lay in the south - east of the League of the Pantheon at the edge of the Al - Sayaj Mountains bordering the area of the Ruined Kingdoms . It was also the latest to join the Pantheist Cities , and though centuries passed , military forces kept occuping the city against the rebellions of the pre - Pantheon cult of the goddess Bala . Because of the resulting oppressive atmosphere , Mahabba recently has been called City of Silence more often than its former title , City of Charity .
description_long: Mahabba The city of Mahabba on the banks of Al - Musammas River lay in the south - east of the League of the Pantheon at the edge of the Al - Sayaj Mountains bordering the area of the Ruined Kingdoms . It was also the latest to join the Pantheist Cities , and though centuries passed , military forces kept occuping the city against the rebellions of the pre - Pantheon cult of the goddess Bala . Because of the resulting oppressive atmosphere , Mahabba recently has been called City of Silence more often than its former title , City of Charity .

title: Mahamsaratsu Shan
description: Mahamsaratsu Shan Mahamsaratsu Shan , meaning Mountain of the Sweet - Voiced Goddess , was a peak located in the A - Ling Shan mountain range . Geography . Mahamsaratsu Shan was the most recognizable peak of the A - Ling Shan range with an elevation approaching 24 , 000 ft .
description_long: Mahamsaratsu Shan Mahamsaratsu Shan , meaning Mountain of the Sweet - Voiced Goddess , was a peak located in the A - Ling Shan mountain range . Geography . Mahamsaratsu Shan was the most recognizable peak of the A - Ling Shan range with an elevation approaching 24 , 000 ft . ( 7 , 300 m ) . Description . Covered with ancient glaciers , Mahamsaratsu Shan was a sprawling peak that was frozen year - round . The mountain was feared by the people around it as being home to an evil spirit that would lure men to their deaths during blizzards with her irresistible voice . To protect themselves , the villagers built shrines along the roads that go near the peak , and left animal sacrifices to appease the evil spirit . The evil spirit of the mountain was actually a manggus named Quarasas , who lived in a palace near the top of the mountain .

title: Maharishi
description: Maharishi Maharishi , mostly known simply as the Seer of Procalith , was a sage in serpentfolk matters in 1372 DR . Activities . Maharishi made her life ' s goal to study all about sarrukh and yuan - ti , particularly their history and magic .
description_long: Maharishi Maharishi , mostly known simply as the Seer of Procalith , was a sage in serpentfolk matters in 1372 DR . Activities . Maharishi made her life ' s goal to study all about sarrukh and yuan - ti , particularly their history and magic . She laired in the ruined Tashalan city of Procalith . Often adventurers in need of knowledge about the yuan - ti asked for her help : the normal procedure was to camp out for a night in the ruined city , writing their questions on papyrus or displaying the item that needed studu without attempting to scry on the naga . If Maharishi was interested , she appeared in front of the adventurers .

title: Mahatnartorian
description: Mahatnartorian Mahatnartorian was a great red wyrm . He was killed by Prince Durothil . Background .
description_long: Mahatnartorian Mahatnartorian was a great red wyrm . He was killed by Prince Durothil . Background . Death . Durothil was planning to let his tame silver dragon Silverywing free from magical confinement , and sent Sharlario Moonflower to the top of a mountain in preparation . Mahatnartorian appeared and attacked Sharlario . Silverywing emerged from the magical pocket dimension , ridden by Durothil , and attacked Mahatnartorian , but she was not powerful enough to defeat him . The fight was over quickly and resulted in the deaths of Silverywing , Mahatnartorian and Durothil himself . Ghaunadaur had his sacrifice .

title: Mahavidi
description: Mahavidi Mahavidi was the Padhrasattva of Erudition within the Padhran religion . History . Historically , Mahavidi was the personal Padhrasattva of the Dalai Lama .
description_long: Mahavidi Mahavidi was the Padhrasattva of Erudition within the Padhran religion . History . Historically , Mahavidi was the personal Padhrasattva of the Dalai Lama . He was considered to be the highest of the Padhra ' s incarnations . An enormous 30 ton statue made from pure gold depicting Mahavidi was located within the Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars in the Potala of Saikhoi .

title: Mahmud
description: Mahmud Mahmud was a carpet merchant living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Mahmud spent much of his time at a local tavern when he was not selling carpets in the market .
description_long: Mahmud Mahmud was a carpet merchant living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Mahmud spent much of his time at a local tavern when he was not selling carpets in the market . Rumors and Legends . Grima al - Auni suspected Mahmud of being the leader of a slave ring operating in Hawa .

title: Mahmud Ben Aziz
description: Mahmud Ben Aziz Mahmud Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a small town called Bandar al - Sa ' adat . Activities .
description_long: Mahmud Ben Aziz Mahmud Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a small town called Bandar al - Sa ' adat . Activities . Mahmud ruled with a relaxed grip . Some thought his decisions were corrupt , but he knew how to keep the important individuals of the town happy . Mahmud approached the law as a business and sold it to those who paid . He created posts to deal with the daily affairs and ease his schedule . Relationships . Mahmud was the older brother of Karim Ben Aziz and father of Halima Aziz , both of whom lived in Banda al - Sa ' adat .

title: Mahmud Biinazol
description: Mahmud Biinazol Lord Mahmud Biinazol was one of the four Cloakmasters of Myratma for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Mahmud had a fantastic intellect and a knack for acting , and he was uninterested in the dirty work of his trade .
description_long: Mahmud Biinazol Lord Mahmud Biinazol was one of the four Cloakmasters of Myratma for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Mahmud had a fantastic intellect and a knack for acting , and he was uninterested in the dirty work of his trade . He had an obsessive love for the game of chess . History . Mahumd , under the alias Halfran , began by organizing a small group of thugs into a racketeering operation that became highly profitable . Soon he joined the Shadow Thieves and was made guildmaster of racketeers for the local chapter . After that , Mahmud was promoted to Cloakmaster . Activities . Mahmud was a minor Tethyrian noble but also one of the four Cloakmasters of Myratma of the Shadow Thieves . They were so capable that only one of them was suspected of any criminal activities .

title: Mai Lan
description: Mai Lan Mai Lan was a Shou human woman and the wife of Merquam Pang , one of the most prosperous merchants of Koryo around 1357 DR . She was beautiful and he was intensely jealous of her , and kept her cloistered in his mansion in Xi Hulang .
description_long: Mai Lan Mai Lan was a Shou human woman and the wife of Merquam Pang , one of the most prosperous merchants of Koryo around 1357 DR . She was beautiful and he was intensely jealous of her , and kept her cloistered in his mansion in Xi Hulang .

title: Maiden ' s Glade
description: Maiden ' s Glade Maiden ' s Glade , also known as Eridis in the language of Illefarn , was a glade near the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast North . Geography . Located between Fort Locke and Highcliff , Maiden ' s Glade was a clearing and a retreat for druid s , ranger s , animal s , or any traveler .
description_long: Maiden ' s Glade Maiden ' s Glade , also known as Eridis in the language of Illefarn , was a glade near the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast North . Geography . Located between Fort Locke and Highcliff , Maiden ' s Glade was a clearing and a retreat for druid s , ranger s , animal s , or any traveler . Inhabitants . The inhabitants were druid s , ranger s , and animals , who protected this place . History . Around 1374 DR , the glade was where druids and rangers would protect the land from intruders . However , the King of Shadows ' influence had an impact on the land , causing the local druid Kaleil to be trapped and enraged in the form of a bear , allowing the animals to attack travelers and intruders . The Kalach - Cha , paired with Elanee , could attack Kaleil and learn of the shadow presences in the Mere of Dead Men before Kaleil died . Appendix . Trivia . Later in the game , the option to visit Maiden ' s Glade is disabled . However , the Crossroad Keep is located at the exact same spot for some reason .

title: Maiden ' s Tongue
description: Maiden ' s Tongue " Maiden ' s Tongue " was a secret language used in ceremonies by Crinti priestesses of Loviatar . It was a language in the Central Thorass subgrouping , being related to Thorass . However , the tongue was unique enough that someone fluent in other Central Thorass languages could still not understand " Maiden ' s Tongue " .
description_long: Maiden ' s Tongue " Maiden ' s Tongue " was a secret language used in ceremonies by Crinti priestesses of Loviatar . It was a language in the Central Thorass subgrouping , being related to Thorass . However , the tongue was unique enough that someone fluent in other Central Thorass languages could still not understand " Maiden ' s Tongue " .

title: Maignith Baenre
description: Maignith Baenre Maignith Baenre was a member of House Baenre circa 1373 DR . She was a captain in the guard of the Baenre Compound . History .
description_long: Maignith Baenre Maignith Baenre was a member of House Baenre circa 1373 DR . She was a captain in the guard of the Baenre Compound . History . Maignith commanded the guards during the Silence of Lolth . In 1373 DR , she died in a Jaezred Chaulssin assassination attempt on Matron mother Triel Baenre .

title: Maimun
description: Maimun Maimun was a bard and reknowned pirate who sailed up and down the entirety of the Sword Coast . As a baby , Maimun ' s village was destroyed by agents of the cambion named Asbeel who was obsessed with finding both the Stone of Tymora and the mortal whom the stone had chosen as it ' s wielder . Maimun was that mortal .
description_long: Maimun Maimun was a bard and reknowned pirate who sailed up and down the entirety of the Sword Coast . As a baby , Maimun ' s village was destroyed by agents of the cambion named Asbeel who was obsessed with finding both the Stone of Tymora and the mortal whom the stone had chosen as it ' s wielder . Maimun was that mortal . His mother had hid him in the wine cellar of his home . A piece of the burning cellar ceiling had fallen , missing the babe by an extremely narrow margin , but it ' s flames kept it warm through the night . The next day , he was rescued from there by a mysterious rider and taken to live with the druid ess Elbeth of the High Forest in her grove . Elbeth named him Lucky Child . Exactly six years after that event ( which Maimun has since referred to as his birthday ) , Asbeel found the two of them , but , not wanting to face Elbeth in her grove , set fire to the surrounding trees , drawing her out . Elbeth hid him in the tallest boughs of a pine tree and told him to follow the road at dawn . He was woken by a man with whom he fled the forest . The man was called Perrault and was the same mysterious rider who had taken him from the ruins of his first home .

title: Majnun
description: Majnun Majnun was a janni of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Majnun ' s whereabouts remained unknown .
description_long: Majnun Majnun was a janni of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Majnun ' s whereabouts remained unknown . His brethren of the Jann of the Haunted Lands believed he stole from Amir Heidar Qan or poisoned him , depending on who was asked . Majnun fled into the vast desert in fear of his life . Majnun traveled disguised as a mystic , but was wary around genie s , especially other jann . A great reward was offered for his capture .

title: Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe
description: Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe was a general store in the southern quarter of Eshpurta run by Cargunn , a retired member of the Shield Militia . The Shoppe carried all manner of adventuring gear , weapons , armor , and supplies up to a top price of 500 gp ; from sturdy clothing to bronze plate mail , from knives to greatsword s , bow s and pole arm s of all varieties , camping equipment , tack and harnesses , and even a few musical instruments . The Shoppe was located two doors north of the Hamstrung Giant .
description_long: Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe was a general store in the southern quarter of Eshpurta run by Cargunn , a retired member of the Shield Militia . The Shoppe was located two doors north of the Hamstrung Giant .

title: Major image
description: Major image Major image , also known as spectral force or , originally , Carbury ' s spectral force , was an illusion spell , that created the visual figment of an object , creature , or force . Some creatures with innate powers of illusion , such as deceiver genie s , could also duplicate the effects of this spell . Effects .
description_long: Major image Major image , also known as spectral force or , originally , Carbury ' s spectral force , was an illusion spell , that created the visual figment of an object , creature , or force . Some creatures with innate powers of illusion , such as deceiver genie s , could also duplicate the effects of this spell . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create an illusion that included sound , visual imagery , smell , and even temperature . The spectral image could be positioned at a great distance from the caster , and it could occupy a volume of 9 , 000 cubic feet or greater , depending on the power of the spellcaster . The caster could control its movement by concentrating , and the illusion would remain for a short time after the caster ceased concentrating . If an opponent attacked the illusion , it would fade away , unless the caster were able to make the figment respond believably . Components . Verbal and somatic component s and a bit of fleece as a spell focus were required to cast this spell . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Carbury in −871 DR , the same year in which he also created his " mouth " spell .

title: Majuvix
description: Majuvix Majuvix was a Maztican native and one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Majuvix agreed to go to Faerûn and lived two years in Waterdeep .
description_long: Majuvix Majuvix was a Maztican native and one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Majuvix agreed to go to Faerûn and lived two years in Waterdeep . Around 1369 DR , she went back to Maztica as one of the new Lords of the Borderlands thank to her understanding of both worlds .

title: Makbulla bint Dalmar
description: Makbulla bint Dalmar Makbulla bint Dalmar was a dwarf trader who frequented Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though she posed as a trader , Makbulla was in fact a dangerous pirate who sailed the Golden Gulf in search of prey on her sambuk , " The North Wind ' s Fury " .
description_long: Makbulla bint Dalmar Makbulla bint Dalmar was a dwarf trader who frequented Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though she posed as a trader , Makbulla was in fact a dangerous pirate who sailed the Golden Gulf in search of prey on her sambuk , " The North Wind ' s Fury " . Her favorite hunting grounds were near the Pearl Cities and the League of the Pantheon . The waters of the Sea of Caravans were too heavily patrolled for her taste . Makbulla often resupplied in Huzuz . She also recruited new members to sail with her , preferring dwarves but taking other races if they seemed like a good fit . Personality . Though she was friendly on land , Makbulla was an iron - willed captain while at sea , tolerating no insubordination from her crew . She was honorable though and provided equal shares of the booty . Possessions . Makbulla wore a pair of " bracers of defense AC 4 " and wielded a " Cutlass of the Golden Gulf . "

title: Makin al - Mutrattab
description: Makin al - Mutrattab Chancellor Makin al - Mutrattab was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR , and a member of the royal family . Personallity . Chancellor Makin possessed a strong sense of right and wrong .
description_long: Makin al - Mutrattab Chancellor Makin al - Mutrattab was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR , and a member of the royal family . Personallity . Chancellor Makin possessed a strong sense of right and wrong . Activities . Makin was in charge of the Footmen , the city watch of Huzuz . One day he was invited to a meeting with members of the House of Al - Hakar to discuss back taxes . The meeting was just a ruse and Makin was kidnapped by a pair of earthservant s working for a sinister yikarian called the Unspeakable . The Unspeakable had the Watcher , a fellow yikarian , possess Makin ' s mind and body , allowing him close access to the Grand Caliph . As of 1367 DR , the ruse had been going on for several years without anyone within the palace noticing the possession . History . During the adventuring days of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir , before he became the Grand Caliph , Makin always accompanied his cousin on daring expeditions . The two were quite close from childhood through adulthood .

title: Makk Fireseed
description: Makk Fireseed Makk Fireseed was an elven priest of Rillifane Rallathil . Activities . He convinced his followers that the deity ' s favorite creature was the Duathamper canary , a type of canary that nested in the butternut trees on the River Duathamper .
description_long: Makk Fireseed Makk Fireseed was an elven priest of Rillifane Rallathil . Activities . He convinced his followers that the deity ' s favorite creature was the Duathamper canary , a type of canary that nested in the butternut trees on the River Duathamper . The canary ' s yellow feathers were symbolic of the sun , and its green throat represented the leaves of trees .

title: Maklin Mucklar
description: Maklin Mucklar Maklin Mucklar was a gnome alchemist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Maklin sold his alchemical products inside the Yawning Portal inn with the permission of Durnan .
description_long: Maklin Mucklar Maklin Mucklar was a gnome alchemist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Maklin sold his alchemical products inside the Yawning Portal inn with the permission of Durnan . History . In 1479 DR , a male human arrived at the Yawning Portal accusing Maklin of selling to him years ago in Baldur ' s Gate a poisoned healing potion that caused the death of his companion . Relationship . Durnan really appreciated the kickbacks that Maklin gave him . Personality . Maklin was a distant and aloof individual . Many considered him quite odd but Durnan believed him an honest guy .

title: Makos
description: Makos Makos was a tiefling warlock who lived in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . He , together with Sergeant Knox and a female cleric , defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . Makos performed the magic that bound the dracolich ' s soul and prevented its return .
description_long: Makos Makos was a tiefling warlock who lived in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . He , together with Sergeant Knox and a female cleric , defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . Makos performed the magic that bound the dracolich ' s soul and prevented its return . Makos was one of the first to met a new adventurer who arrived in the city . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Makos and Knox are the first named characters to appear in the " Neverwinter " four - part cinematic trailer " The Siege of Neverwinter " and one of the first characters the player meets at the entrance of the city .

title: Malabog
description: Malabog Malabog was the king of the fomorian giants in the Feywild in 1484 DR . History . Malabog was a powerful fomorian giant in the Feywild who at some point became the king of his race .
description_long: Malabog Malabog was the king of the fomorian giants in the Feywild in 1484 DR . History . Malabog was a powerful fomorian giant in the Feywild who at some point became the king of his race . He established his court in a fallen fey castle , served by a cadre of loyal fomorian warriors and started to expand his dominion . Soon , Malabog decided to enslave the elves of New Sharandar . With this objective in mind , Malabog allied himself in Toril with the lich Valindra Shadowmantle and thanks to this pact he gained the services of the blue dragon Fulminorax , whom added to his troops . At last , the Iliyanbruen elves recruited an adventurer native of Toril to stop the foul fomorian king . The adventurer defeated the fomorian army and finally entered Malabog ' s Castle and fought and defeated Malabog and his allies .

title: Malachite
description: Malachite Malachite was an ornamental stone related to azurite and often used in inexpensive jewelry . Description . Malachite was distinguished by its green stripes of many shades .
description_long: Malachite Malachite was an ornamental stone related to azurite and often used in inexpensive jewelry . Description . Malachite was distinguished by its green stripes of many shades . Striking in appearance and inexpensive , these ornamental stones were usually tumbled smooth or cut and polished for jewelry among those that could not afford fancier gems . A typical specimen had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Malachite was a spell component for some divine spells of the elemental sphere and arcane spells that dealt with cold , heat , ice , or fire . It was crushed into powder for use in magical immersions for items that promoted warmth , cold resistance , or fire resistance . Rumors and Legends . Malachite was reputed to prevent falls and therefore was often used on devices like " rings of feather falling " as part of the adornment . However , this was just catering to public demand because malachite had no gravitational intervention powers .

title: Malacon
description: Malacon Malacon was a variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones could produce large brown faceted gems that were hard but fragile , so they were not generally used in jewelry that was frequently subject to impact , like rings , but they were often used in room decorations .
description_long: Malacon Malacon was a variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones could produce large brown faceted gems that were hard but fragile , so they were not generally used in jewelry that was frequently subject to impact , like rings , but they were often used in room decorations . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Malacon gems could be used to store a spell and release it at a later time , making them ideal for pranks , surprises , defenses , or death traps to those who knew the modifications necessary to cast a spell into this gem . The spell could be released in one of three ways : by physically breaking the gem , either by striking , dropping , or crushing ; by the caster touching the gem and exerting his or her will to call forth the spell ; or when a predetermined interval , set during the original casting of the spell , had passed . In the first case , the caster had no control of the spell , it went off with the gem as the origin or center of the spell . In the second case , the caster had full control of the spell as if he or she had just cast it from memory .

title: Malaeragoth
description: Malaeragoth Malaeragoth was a sapphire dragon living under the Greypeak Mountains in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Malaeragoth enjoyed solitude , usually walking slowly in the tunnels of his home and murmuring to himself his thoughts , comments , and unfolding schemes .
description_long: Malaeragoth Malaeragoth was a sapphire dragon living under the Greypeak Mountains in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Malaeragoth enjoyed solitude , usually walking slowly in the tunnels of his home and murmuring to himself his thoughts , comments , and unfolding schemes . For an unknown reason , he payed attention to news about Sembia and the Cult of the Dragon . Thanks to many scry ing mirrors , he could spy outside his realm and on the surface . Lair . Malaeragoth had a lair called the Realm of Stone and Shadow . It was divided into many chambers with various uses : one for example was full of water , and another housed many sparkling magical gems called beljuril s . He had several skeleton s and zombie s at his service for his needs .

title: Malaerigo Harsard
description: Malaerigo Harsard Malaerigo Harsard was the guildmaster of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Description . Malaerigo had unkempt black hair and a line of moles down his right cheek .
description_long: Malaerigo Harsard Malaerigo Harsard was the guildmaster of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Description . Malaerigo had unkempt black hair and a line of moles down his right cheek . He was a cheapskate , so he never wore expensive or fine clothes . Relationships . Malaerigo had a daughter , Laraelra Harsard . She argued with him over key issues and he disapproved somewhat of her sorcery .

title: Malagdorl Armgo
description: Malagdorl Armgo Malagdorl Armgo was the weapon master of House Barrison Del ' Armgo . Personality . Malagdorl was greatly fascinated by the most powerful warrior of his House , Uthegentel Del ' Armgo , and dreamed of surpassing his ancestor ' s exploits .
description_long: Malagdorl Armgo Malagdorl Armgo was the weapon master of House Barrison Del ' Armgo . Personality . Malagdorl was greatly fascinated by the most powerful warrior of his House , Uthegentel Del ' Armgo , and dreamed of surpassing his ancestor ' s exploits . History . In 1484 DR , Malagdorl was the weapon master and elderboy of the Second House . In the early stages of the Rage of Demons , he armed himself with the weapons of Uthegentel Del ' Armgo and fought the invading demon lord s . Thanks to the plotting of Lolth , Malagdorl appeared to defeat Marilith . Relationship . Malagdorl was the grandson of matron mother Mez ' Barris Armgo .

title: Malaggar Tlabbar
description: Malaggar Tlabbar Malaggar Tlabbar was a drow of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan and head instructor of Melee - Magthere . History . Malaggar was the First Sword of Melee - Magthere in 1372 DR and so the nominal head of the martial school .
description_long: Malaggar Tlabbar Malaggar Tlabbar was a drow of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan and head instructor of Melee - Magthere . History . Malaggar was the First Sword of Melee - Magthere in 1372 DR and so the nominal head of the martial school . In that year , he coordinated with Matron Quenthel Baenre and the heads of the other schools to use their students to quell a slave uprising plotted by Syrzan .

title: Malaggar Xarann
description: Malaggar Xarann Malaggar Xarann was the head of the College of Enchantment and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that the College of Enchantment ruled the city ' s slave market .
description_long: Malaggar Xarann Malaggar Xarann was the head of the College of Enchantment and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that the College of Enchantment ruled the city ' s slave market .

title: Malakuth Tabuirr
description: Malakuth Tabuirr Malakuth Tabuirr was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring as well as the leader of the Dark Dagger cell in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Malakuth was originally a caravan leader and first born of a merchant house in Karsoluthiyl .
description_long: Malakuth Tabuirr Malakuth Tabuirr was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring as well as the leader of the Dark Dagger cell in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Malakuth was originally a caravan leader and first born of a merchant house in Karsoluthiyl . His house supported House Thanor ’ Thal in a house war but was betrayed and destroyed by it after the noble house was victorious . All of his family members were executed and he survived due to him being away from the city on caravanning duties in Skullport . After being disenfranchised , he settled in Skullport and named himself Tabuirr . At some point after his exile , he took up the faith of Vhaeraun and became affiliated with the Dark Dagger cell in Skullport . After the cell ’ s near destruction in the wake of the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR , he became the leader of the cell and successfully reestablished it as a major power , especially in the field of smuggling . He also became a leading member of the Iron Ring , a slaver ring for mutual protection .

title: Malanthor Drymm
description: Malanthor Drymm Malanthor Drymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was an arrogant and very self - confident magelord .
description_long: Malanthor Drymm Malanthor Drymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was an arrogant and very self - confident magelord . He was one of the magelords forcibly summoned to the spell - battle in 240 DR in Ithboltar ' s tower in Athalgard and died there .

title: Malanthus Stormstaern
description: Malanthus Stormstaern Malanthus Stormstaern was a mage of the 2nd century DR and held the position of Magister from 154 to 177 DR . History . In the Year of the Jealous Hag , 154 DR , Malanthus Stormstaern was one of a number of mages who banded together against Flaerivus Grevauldyn , the current Magister , in an effort to stop him acquiring yet more power .
description_long: Malanthus Stormstaern Malanthus Stormstaern was a mage of the 2nd century DR and held the position of Magister from 154 to 177 DR . History . In the Year of the Jealous Hag , 154 DR , Malanthus Stormstaern was one of a number of mages who banded together against Flaerivus Grevauldyn , the current Magister , in an effort to stop him acquiring yet more power . Flaerivus and many of his attackers were destroyed in a magical backlash . Among the surviving lesser mages who claimed victory , Malanthus stood forth and named himself Magister . The god Azuth soon met with him , and after Malanthus survived the encounter , he was confirmed as Magister . Malanthus grew powerful with magic , and none could challenge him . He defeated dozens of rival mages , slayed dragon s with ease , and seduced the wives of kings who dared not retaliate . He operated without fear as he traveled widely and shared magic . In his time , Malanthus grew famous among the great cities of the southern and eastern coasts of the Inner Sea , and fathered many children , earning him the monicker " the Tireless " .

title: Malar
description: Malar Malar ( pronounced " MAHL - arr " ) , The Beastlord , was the lesser deity of the hunt , evil lycanthropes , bestial savagery and bloodlust . His dogma concerned savage hunts , the spreading of the curse of lycanthropy , and general contempt for civilization . After the events of the Spellplague , he was an exarch of Silvanus .
description_long: Malar Malar ( pronounced " MAHL - arr " ) , The Beastlord , was the lesser deity of the hunt , evil lycanthropes , bestial savagery and bloodlust . His dogma concerned savage hunts , the spreading of the curse of lycanthropy , and general contempt for civilization . After the events of the Spellplague , he was an exarch of Silvanus . History . At some point in the 1350s DR , Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka had fortuitously been granted guardianship of the kittenlord , heir to the power of the cat lord , a minor power of felines . However , Duum desired to corrupt and dominate the child , and therefore made a deal with the mightier power Malar to keep the vengeful old Catlord off his back . Duum wished to use the cat lord ' s power of planar travel to journey into the Outer Planes and , using the Claw of Malar , even challenge Tyr , god of justice , and gain awesome power . In exchange , when he was done with the boy , Duum would give him to the Beastlord . Learning of Duum ' s wicked intentions for the boy , the Catlord came and rescued him , but Malar pounced upon the Catlord as he fled .

title: Malark Himbruel
description: Malark Himbruel Malark Himbruel was a wizard and a Weaver of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in 1357 DR , during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . Malark was the last remaining Cult ' s archmage who tried to capture Shandril , after she destroyed Shargrailar . Malark also wanted vengeance for the death of Symgharyl Maruel , his underling , but Shandril defeated him also .
description_long: Malark Himbruel Malark Himbruel was a wizard and a Weaver of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in 1357 DR , during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . Malark was the last remaining Cult ' s archmage who tried to capture Shandril , after she destroyed Shargrailar . Malark also wanted vengeance for the death of Symgharyl Maruel , his underling , but Shandril defeated him also . With that , the Cult decided to stop hunting her .

title: Malark Springhill
description: Malark Springhill Malark Springhill was a monk of the long death and for sometime a servant of Szass Tam . Appearance . Originating from the Moonsea area , Malark is not of Mulan descent but since he moved to Eltabbar he started to shave his head and put on tattoos like a Mulan born .
description_long: Malark Springhill Malark Springhill was a monk of the long death and for sometime a servant of Szass Tam . Appearance . Originating from the Moonsea area , Malark is not of Mulan descent but since he moved to Eltabbar he started to shave his head and put on tattoos like a Mulan born . He is compactly built and has a small wine - red birthmark on his chin . He doesn ' t look overly impressive or dangerous until one notices his graceful movements or the cool calculation in his striking green eyes . . Personality . Malark detests the undead , probably because of his attitude towards death . Since his decades with the Monks of the Long Death Malark believes death is a gift ; that all deaths are desirable but some are better than others . He believes that in his duty as assassin , the really good deaths must take a form appropriate to the victim ' s life and come to him in the proper time . Malark believes it to be a duty and highest form of art to arrange such passings as opportunity allows . Combat . Malark ' s weapons of choice are his own hands . At times when more is needed , he also uses his oaken enchanted baton s which he usually wears strapped to his thighs .

title: Malathon
description: Malathon Malathon was a half - orc cleric of Bane who helped in the attack on Shadowdale . Powers . His cleric domains were Destruction and Evil .
description_long: Malathon Malathon was a half - orc cleric of Bane who helped in the attack on Shadowdale . Powers . His cleric domains were Destruction and Evil . History . During the Zhent occupation of Shadowdale in Hammer , 1375 DR , High Priest Malathon was charged with rebuilding the temple of Bane in Castle Krag . Equipment . The Dark Doom wore " + 3 full plate " that provided him with resistance to spell s in battle , and wielded an enchanted " + 2 morningstar " . For additional protection , Malathon carried a " ring of counterspells " and an " amulet of proof against petrification " .

title: Malatra
description: Malatra Malatra was a jungle land in the south of Kara - Tur . In these lands there existed political states which were quite different in their culture and inhabitants from the rest of Kara - Tur . There were three states Purang , Laothan and the Kuong Kingdom .
description_long: Malatra Malatra was a jungle land in the south of Kara - Tur . In these lands there existed political states which were quite different in their culture and inhabitants from the rest of Kara - Tur . There were three states Purang , Laothan and the Kuong Kingdom . Boundaries in these lands were irrelevant and many hapless adventurers and merchants met death here . In the dense jungles , swamps and misty mountains , are found a lot of terrible creatures and native wild tribes did not know the meaning of mercy . In these lands even experienced locals did not go far from the cities , and did not know what was happening in the heart of these wild lands . The Land . In these lands there were three organized states . Purang , Laothan , and Kuong . The first represented a semi - primitive tribe much more developmentally advanced than other tribes . The second was strongly reminiscent of the culture and customs of the northern states of Shou Lung and T ' u Lung . The third had its own unique culture and history , and was located in the deep jungle . Geography . Malatra was practically covered by deep jungle but there are also existed small hilly areas .

title: Malatran Plateau
description: Malatran Plateau Created and protected by ancient alien magic , the Malatran Plateau rose thousands of feet above the rest of Malatra . Geography . Like the rest of Malatra , the Malatran Plateau was covered mostly by jungle .
description_long: Malatran Plateau Created and protected by ancient alien magic , the Malatran Plateau rose thousands of feet above the rest of Malatra . Geography . Like the rest of Malatra , the Malatran Plateau was covered mostly by jungle . In the north west and the north east however , there were large swathes of land that didn ' t have significant tree cover . Rayana Savanna . Elephants , gazelles , lions , and zebras lived on these rolling grasslands and watering holes were plentiful . Nubari plainsmen had tilled a few fields where the jungle met the grass and the aarakocra maintained all of their low - land villages in the middle of the savanna . Yaku Plains . Also known as the Plains of Ash , the Yaku Plains were once hilly savannah populated with Nubari but became a blasted wasteland covered in grey ash . Vegetation failed to grow here despite being surrounded on all sides by thick jungle and many cultures viewed this land as taboo .

title: Malaug
description: Malaug Malaug , before knew as Maulagadorn , was a male warrior and wizard who created the malaugrym . History . In the early days of the North , Maulaugadorn was a great warrior who created for himself a kingdom in these lands , worshiping Tempus .
description_long: Malaug Malaug , before knew as Maulagadorn , was a male warrior and wizard who created the malaugrym . History . In the early days of the North , Maulaugadorn was a great warrior who created for himself a kingdom in these lands , worshiping Tempus . One day , however , his sister Alandalorne was caught by a strange illness . Maulaugadorn invoked his god and Tempus explained that his sister was a sorcerer and her powers were starting to reveal . Thus Maulaugadorn wanted to learn magic , in his mind a new kind of weapon . At last Mystra decided to reveal to him explaining how to become a wizard . In time , he become a great wizard , eventually creating the malaugrym . He was the first human exploring the Plane of Shadow and gained from this great mastery over shadow magic . At the same he become an inhuman abomination ( a proto - malaugrym ) . During his exploration of the Plane of the Shadow he built the Castle of Shadows . Later Malaug stated wandering the planes and with his new powers impersonated many beings and his offsprings were the first generation of the malaugrym .

title: Malaugrym
description: Malaugrym Malaugryms , also known as Shadowmasters , were evil shapeshifter s . Combat . These shapeshifters were , both physically and mentally , superior to many , if not most other races .
description_long: Malaugrym Malaugryms , also known as Shadowmasters , were evil shapeshifter s . Combat . These shapeshifters were , both physically and mentally , superior to many , if not most other races . They possessed an uncanny , malicious intelligence and a remarkable charismatic presence , despite the abhorrent appearance of their natural form . They were also astoundingly agile , far beyond the ken of the regular human , as well as , to a lesser extent , being stronger and more hardy than one . Fast Healing . Malaugrym were notoriously quick to recover from wounds , which , with time , seal up on their own . Damage Reduction . Malaugrym were immune to all weapons , save for those that were magical or made from silver . Magic weapons behaved as regular ones would , harming them , and ones of silver were particularly devastating , and left wounds the malaugrym could not heal naturally , but required magical attention . Poison Immunity . These creatures were immune to all poisons . Spell Resistance . A malaugrym had the ability to resist magical attack , particularly from less experienced casters .

title: Malauth
description: Malauth Malauth was the " most sinister " goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the central southern foothills of the Rauvin Mountains .
description_long: Malauth Malauth was the " most sinister " goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the central southern foothills of the Rauvin Mountains . Government . In 1372 DR , Queen Nargharab was the recognized leader of Malauth . However , Nargharab was known to be the puppet of seven priests of Maglubiyet known as the Malauthar . The Malauthar used rituals and signs to instill fear in the realm ' s inhabitants , who began suspecting that the Malauthar made up those signs and meanings at whim .

title: Malavon Despana
description: Malavon Despana Malavon Despana is a drow wizard of some power , who currently serves as the Archmage of the Underdark city of Rilauven . He led a group of anti - Lolth ite revolutionaries to a successful coup in the city , changing the Lolth venerating , matriarchal society into a relatively egalitarian oligarchy , led by a council of representatives from the cities acadamies . The coup was relatively bloodless .
description_long: Malavon Despana Malavon Despana is a drow wizard of some power , who currently serves as the Archmage of the Underdark city of Rilauven . He led a group of anti - Lolth ite revolutionaries to a successful coup in the city , changing the Lolth venerating , matriarchal society into a relatively egalitarian oligarchy , led by a council of representatives from the cities acadamies . The coup was relatively bloodless . Malavon now appears to be the most powerful being in the city , which is rare in most drow societies as males are generally considered to be inferior to females . Malavon is a powerful mage , having created at least one spell himself : " Malavon ' s Rage " , which is a destructive spell of some potency . His sister also notes that he is a skilled diviner , and capable enough with other forms of magic to wipe out an entire cavern of driders .

title: Malavos Drunn
description: Malavos Drunn Malavos Drunn is a retired warrior and the current barkeep of the Horn and Hoof tavern in Longsaddle . He fences stolen goods , with enough skill so as to not draw any uneccessary attention . Possessions .
description_long: Malavos Drunn Malavos Drunn is a retired warrior and the current barkeep of the Horn and Hoof tavern in Longsaddle . He fences stolen goods , with enough skill so as to not draw any uneccessary attention . Possessions . Drunn carries a cudgel and a wand of magic missiles which he uses to keep order within his establishment .

title: Malazan
description: Malazan Malazan was an old colossal red dragon who was one of the primary agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , under Sammaster ' s orders , Malazan led a horde of goblinoid s to conquer the fortress at the Vaasan Gate .
description_long: Malazan Malazan was an old colossal red dragon who was one of the primary agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , under Sammaster ' s orders , Malazan led a horde of goblinoid s to conquer the fortress at the Vaasan Gate . Later , Malazan led a force of chromatic dragon s at the siege of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Thanks to a deception by the bronze dragon Chatulio , she was forced to duel to the death and kill her fellow green dragon Ishenalyr . When the metallic dragon army led by Dorn Graybrook attacked from behind , the chromatics the evil dragons were defeated and Dorn , together with the song dragon Karasendrieth and silver dragon s Azhaq and Moonwing , managed to kill Malazan .

title: Malcanthet
description: Malcanthet Malcanthet was a demon lord . She was also called Queen of Succubi . Description .
description_long: Malcanthet Malcanthet was a demon lord . She was also called Queen of Succubi . Description . Malcanthet was described as an incredibly beautiful human - like female with bat - wings , horns , and a long prehensile tail tipped with a spike - like stinger . Relationships . Malcanthet was the current holder of the title of Succubus Queen ; other demon lords aspiring to the position included Lady Lynkhab , the currently imprisoned Shami - Amourae , and the exiled Xinivrae . Other rivals existed elsewhere in the Abyss , but they ultimately posed little or no threat to Malcanthet . Malcanthet was among the first of the succubi to come into being in the Abyss . She obtained her current title after years of waging wars and committing savage betrayals upon her fellow " sister " succubi and former paramours . As a result of her ruthless climb to the top , she has cultivated a long list of enemies , which includes Graz ' zt , Yeenoghu , and Baphomet .

title: Malchior
description: Malchior Malchior , usually know as Malchior of Darkhold , was a cleric of Cyric and a member of the Zhentarim in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Malchior ' s first and foremost loyalty was to himself , his god a distant second .
description_long: Malchior Malchior , usually know as Malchior of Darkhold , was a cleric of Cyric and a member of the Zhentarim in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Malchior ' s first and foremost loyalty was to himself , his god a distant second . His greed was matched only by his cunning . Malchior was a master manipulator who loved twisting others to his will . Relationship . Machior had great influence over Dag Zoreth and Gareth Cormaeril thanks to a combination of blackmail and charisma . History . Malchior was a Zhent of Darkhold sent to Waterdeep . By 1372 DR , he rarely went back to his home , where the Church of Bane had become more and more dominant .

title: Malchor Harpell
description: Malchor Harpell Malchor Harpell was a human wizard of the Harpell family who dwelt in the Tower of Twilight , which rested east of the Neverwinter Wood . Personality . Even though Malchor was Khelben ' s second most powerful follower , other than Laeral Silverhand , he was also the most skeptical of the Moonstars .
description_long: Malchor Harpell Malchor Harpell was a human wizard of the Harpell family who dwelt in the Tower of Twilight , which rested east of the Neverwinter Wood . Personality . Even though Malchor was Khelben ' s second most powerful follower , other than Laeral Silverhand , he was also the most skeptical of the Moonstars . While in his tower , Malchor disliked interruptions but rewarded his students ' patience , as well as loyal friends and faithful followers , with praise , shelter , gifts , and magical aid . He could be somewhat brusque and arrogant , but he also had a sense of humor . Although Malchor was a Harpell , he did not share the eccentric ways of his cousins and deigned to live away from Longsaddle . History . Malchor was a member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . In 1356 DR , he gave the drow renegade Drizzt Do ' Urden , the scimitar Twinkle . Around 1370 DR , Malchor , who was a student of Khelben Arunsun and defected from the Harpers to the Moonstars . In 1356 DR , Malchor had a teenaged apprentice who was the son of wealthy family .
