Malchor made him take a vow of silence , which he believed would help teach him the discipline needed for his studies of magic .

title: Malco
description: Malco Malco was the personal servant of Sozarro in 1362 DR . History . Malco was a Payit who believed Maztica conquered by the Amn ians in 1361 DR and offered his services to them .
description_long: Malco Malco was the personal servant of Sozarro in 1362 DR . History . Malco was a Payit who believed Maztica conquered by the Amn ians in 1361 DR and offered his services to them . He became the servant of the legionary Sozarro . Malco escaped with his master from Helmsport but did not know the whole truth about him . Personality . Malco was so impressed by the magic and might showed by the Golden Legion that he believed the conquest inevitable . He believed that Sozarro had the potential for true greatness . He looked the other way whenever Sozarro acted illegally .

title: Maldobar
description: Maldobar Maldobar was a small village north of Sundabar . Geography . Maldobar was located 50 miles north up the Dead Orc River from Sundabar .
description_long: Maldobar Maldobar was a small village north of Sundabar . Geography . Maldobar was located 50 miles north up the Dead Orc River from Sundabar . A hundred miles to the north of Maldobar was the Coldwood . Description . Maldobar was a small village . On the western outskirts of the village , against the mountain slopes , were the home and barn of the Thistledown family . Inhabitants . The village inhabitants were human farmers . Usually one family lived in one house for many generations . The only threats to the village were the goblin s and gnoll s in the area who occasionally came to raid . History . In 1340 DR , the Thistledown family were found gruesomely murdered in their house and barn . The culprit was believed to be the drow Drizzt Do ' Urden , owing to the presence of his scimitar at the scene . However , the true culprit was Ulgulu the barghest . Drizzt avenged the Thistledowns by slaying Ulgulu , but despite the belief of Dove Falconhand and her band that Drizzt was innocent , Roddy McGristle continued to pursue Drizzt and defame his name for years and across many borders . Notable inhabitants . In 1340 DR :

title: Maldridge House
description: Maldridge House Maldridge House was a stately old mansion located on Macintyre Path in Ravens Bluff . The mansion was best known as Jack Ravenwild ' s temporary residence after he rescued Seila Norwood from enslavement by dark elves . The mansion burned to the ground in 1479 DR during a drow attempt to recapture Jack .
description_long: Maldridge House Maldridge House was a stately old mansion located on Macintyre Path in Ravens Bluff . The mansion was best known as Jack Ravenwild ' s temporary residence after he rescued Seila Norwood from enslavement by dark elves . The mansion burned to the ground in 1479 DR during a drow attempt to recapture Jack .

title: Maldrithor
description: Maldrithor Maldrithor , known to history as " the Sarbreenar Wyrm " , was a male wyrm green dragon that once laired at Sarbreenar in the Vast . History . Maldrithor grew to be a dragon of tremendous size .
description_long: Maldrithor Maldrithor , known to history as " the Sarbreenar Wyrm " , was a male wyrm green dragon that once laired at Sarbreenar in the Vast . History . Maldrithor grew to be a dragon of tremendous size . When he chose to lair at the settlement of Sarbreenar , the people there fled . Maldrithor demolished the old dwarven keep and roosted upon its ruins , so large that his tail dangled down a broken tower and none dared even approach . From here , Maldrithor watched and preyed upon travelers on the road . But in time , people stopped using the road and Maldrithor went hungry . He was forced to fly south for food , and raided the city of Procampur . There he ripped the roofs from houses and ate the people he caught inside . He made two such raids on the city , but , by the third , the angry and frightened people had hired a wizard to fight Maldrithor off . On Maldrithor ' s third raid , the wizard was ready with exploding " swordball " spells that bloodily tore Maldrithor apart . The dragon crashed down dead in the harbor . People returned to Sarbreenar but found orc s had moved in instead .

title: Malduir
description: Malduir Malduir was a city located in Dambrath . History . Reinhar IX and his attempted expansion of Dambrath was repelled by drow forces during a brutal war that lasted three decades .
description_long: Malduir Malduir was a city located in Dambrath . History . Reinhar IX and his attempted expansion of Dambrath was repelled by drow forces during a brutal war that lasted three decades . Reinhar ' s forces were eventually trapped at Malduir . A group of half - elven priestesses of Loviatar appeared to come to the aid of Reinhar , but betrayed him to the drow , resulting in the death of Reinhar and the defeat of the arkaiun .

title: Maldwyn Daggerford
description: Maldwyn Daggerford Maldwyn Daggerford was the duke of Daggerford . Personality . Maldwyn was more interested in being admired and respected than truly ruling his duchy .
description_long: Maldwyn Daggerford Maldwyn Daggerford was the duke of Daggerford . Personality . Maldwyn was more interested in being admired and respected than truly ruling his duchy . He was an arrogant man . Activities . Maldwyn enjoyed the luxuries of his role , focusing in being an expert in the finest food and wine . He had never had an adventure and considered it a too dangerous situation . History . In 1485 DR , Maldwyn became infatuated by the courtesan Natyssa and took her as his lover . Thank to Pencheska the pit fiend Baazka managed to possess Maldwyn in order to kill some adventurers and usurp the duke ' s throne but the adventurers defeated them freeing the duke .

title: Malebranche
description: Malebranche Malebranches , or war devils , were the champions of the Nine Hells . Activities . Malebranches only obey pit fiend s and archdevil s .
description_long: Malebranche Malebranches , or war devils , were the champions of the Nine Hells . Activities . Malebranches only obey pit fiend s and archdevil s . They also led lesser devils in skirmishes against those who opposed their masters ' plans . Malebranches on the Prime Material Plane sometimes rose as warmasters or generals , leading the armies of evil tyrannical mortals .

title: Maliantor
description: Maliantor Maliantor , also known as Blackstaff ' s Eyes and Maliantor of Waterdeep , was a member of the Gray Hands adventuring company . Description . Maliantor had long , braided brown hair , sea - green eyes , and an impish smile .
description_long: Maliantor Maliantor , also known as Blackstaff ' s Eyes and Maliantor of Waterdeep , was a member of the Gray Hands adventuring company . Description . Maliantor had long , braided brown hair , sea - green eyes , and an impish smile . She favored practical clothing and was often found stuffed with scrolls . History . In 1416 DR , Maliantor published " " , which included a history of Tsarra Chaadren . It was considered the " definitive tome on life in Blackstaff Tower in the 14th century . " Relationships . A former student of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , Maliantor was known as " Blackstaff ' s Eyes " . She was rumored to be his sole agent who worked outside of the Moonstars .

title: Malice Do ' Urden
description: Malice Do ' Urden Malice Do ' Urden was matron mother of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until her death . She was a strong high priestess of Lolth , although her fall was in losing the favor of Lolth . Description .
description_long: Malice Do ' Urden Malice Do ' Urden was matron mother of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until her death . She was a strong high priestess of Lolth , although her fall was in losing the favor of Lolth . Description . Malice was slender and deceptively small , around 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) , but she was very strong . Her eyes appeared red in the infrared spectrum , like most drow ' s , but appeared deep green in the light . Personality . Malice ' s amorous exploits with the males of House Do ' Urden ( and many others ) was legendary in Menzoberranzan . History . Malice was the daughter of Vartha Do ' Urden , the former matron mother of House Do ' Urden . Vartha died unexpectedly when Malice was about 100 years old ( around the eleventh century DR ) and Malice ascended to the head of House Do ' Urden , where she ruled successfully for four centuries . In 1297 DR , Malice used the agony of childbirth to increase her clerical power in an attack against House DeVir , which was destroyed .

title: Maligor
description: Maligor Maligor was the Zulkir of Alteration in Thay until 1362 DR . Description . The Zulkir was a bald , pale , thin man with a tattoo atop his skull demonstrating his devotion to Myrkul .
description_long: Maligor Maligor was the Zulkir of Alteration in Thay until 1362 DR . Description . The Zulkir was a bald , pale , thin man with a tattoo atop his skull demonstrating his devotion to Myrkul . Personality . Reckless and evil , the wizard enjoyed the suffering of his victims . Like all Red Wizard s , Maligor constantly plotted the downfall of his fellow wizards . Possessions . Maligor owned a pair of " bracers of defense " , along with a " cloak of protection " and a " ring of flying " . He wielded a " staff of the magi " , and wore a " robe of the archmagi " . Relationships . The Zulkir of Alteration built an army of 300 human troops and 1200 battle - hardened gnoll s which he wished to unleash upon Thay . Using his magical talents , the Red Wizard created a multitude of darkenbeast s to comprise his second force . Aiding Maligor in controlling his empire was the spirit naga Asp , who fed off her master ' s desire for power . History . Maligor was a Red Wizard and a Zulkir for many years until 1362 DR , when he plotted to seize control of both Thay and then Aglarond .

title: Malik al - Samawat
description: Malik al - Samawat Malik al - Samawat was a noble djinni who lived atop the highest peak on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Personality . Malik was incredibly haughty and easily distracted .
description_long: Malik al - Samawat Malik al - Samawat was a noble djinni who lived atop the highest peak on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Personality . Malik was incredibly haughty and easily distracted . Activities . Malik enjoyed relaxing in a field of golden clouds within his home .

title: Malik el Sami
description: Malik el Sami Malik el Sami yn Nasser was a human former merchant from Calimshan and the Seraph of Lies and Chosen of Cyric . History . Malik lived as a merchant in Calimport until the first prince of the local caliph took a liking to his wife , and frequently visited Malik ' s household .
description_long: Malik el Sami Malik el Sami yn Nasser was a human former merchant from Calimshan and the Seraph of Lies and Chosen of Cyric . History . Malik lived as a merchant in Calimport until the first prince of the local caliph took a liking to his wife , and frequently visited Malik ' s household . One day , the caliph received a letter from Zhentil Keep relating the story of the " Cyrinishad " and requested loyal spies to be dispatched to watch over the temples of Oghma ( and his servant gods Gond , Milil and Deneir ) , Mystra ( and her servants Azuth , Savras and Velsharoon ) , and Kelemvor . The spies were to watch for the appearance of the stolen " Cyrinishad " , which would be carried by the champion of Torm , Gwydion Fleetfoot . Malik was sent by the caliph , leaving his wife in the tender care of the prince , and traveled the Western Heartlands for years disguised as a humble beggar . Finally , he discovered Gwydion outside Candlekeep and sent word to the church to send an army to lay siege to the old library - fortress .

title: Malimshaer
description: Malimshaer Malimshaer was a scout nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and strategist of the Army of Darkness . History . Malimshaer was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .
description_long: Malimshaer Malimshaer was a scout nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and strategist of the Army of Darkness . History . Malimshaer was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese . Aldlas set them forth on the task to locate the Nether Scrolls , thought to be somewhere in the elven lands . For three months The Trio Nefarious ravaged the elven lands until they met with the army of Cormanthyr and were captured and imprisoned . Nearly 2 millenia later they escaped and began raising an army that soon descended upon Cormanthyr . Malimshaer was noted to kill alone a black dragon and subjugated the orc tribe in the service of the dragon Death . On Greengrass , 713 DR , Malimshaer and Gaulguth were attacked by Myth Drannor army and Gaulguth lost the left eye and one of his left arms ; Malimshaer tried to capture the Chosen of Mystra Symrustar Auglamyr but she killed him with Spellfire .

title: Malkarion
description: Malkarion Malkarion was a male Damaran human paladin turned blackguard , formerly devoted to Tyr before turning to Shar . He led the Sharran cultists ' activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow , serving the black dragon Despayr . Description .
description_long: Malkarion Malkarion was a male Damaran human paladin turned blackguard , formerly devoted to Tyr before turning to Shar . He led the Sharran cultists ' activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow , serving the black dragon Despayr . Description . He wore shining black full plate armor . As a dark creature , he appeared more gray and black than a regular human . Abilities . Although Malkarion had lost the holy powers he had as a paladin , he gained in return the unholy powers of a blackguard , such as the ability to smite good creatures , find them with " detect good " , and use poison without risk . At some point , Malkarion became a dark creature , partially of shadow . He was able to see in the dark , could move swiftly , was highly resistant even to intense cold , and could move stealthily , and able to disappear into the shadows even whilst observed . Possessions . In battle , Malkaron wore shining black " + 1 full plate " armor , wielded a " + 1 bastard sword " , and carried a " + 1 heavy steel shield " . He also had three masterwork dagger s , oft - poisoned with shadow essence . He was equipped with " gauntlets of ogre power " .

title: Malkizid
description: Malkizid Malkizid was a powerful fallen solar and former archdevil who resided in the Blood Rift . He was also called " The Branded King " , because of the constantly bleeding wound on his forehead given to him by Corellon Larethian . History .
description_long: Malkizid Malkizid was a powerful fallen solar and former archdevil who resided in the Blood Rift . He was also called " The Branded King " , because of the constantly bleeding wound on his forehead given to him by Corellon Larethian . History . Malkizid was a high solar in the service of the Seldarine . Around - 30 , 000 DR , he was seduced into betraying Corellon by Araushnee ( Lolth ) , but was cast into the Nine Hells and branded for his betrayal when Araushnee ' s rebellion failed . There he quickly rose in the hierarchy of the Hells and soon controlled his own dominion . At some point , thousands of years ago , Malkizid earned the disfavor of Asmodeus and was then exiled from Nine Hells . A small host of devils followed Malkizid where he setup his infernal realm in the Blood Rift , the native plane of yugoloth s . He was a yugoloth lord and archdevil in exile , and therefore had baatezu and yugoloth minions . Around - 10900 DR he was secretly the patron of the Vyshaan lords of Aryvandaar and taught them powerful magic . He also encouraged them to aggression against the other elven realms of the First Flowering .

title: Malkyn Grenefeld
description: Malkyn Grenefeld Malkyn Grenefeld was the chamberlain of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Malkyn was the city ' s chamberlain and the court ' s mage .
description_long: Malkyn Grenefeld Malkyn Grenefeld was the chamberlain of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Malkyn was the city ' s chamberlain and the court ' s mage . History . A member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster , Malkyn abandoned her city and was chosen to join the First Lord ' s court just before the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 . During the Rage of Demons that same year , she attended the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet . She possibly checked an adventuring party ( who had been hired by Elanil Elassidil to infiltrate the masquerade ) who had been hired as servers by Torgrave Needlebaum . During the ballet Torin started a speech and an elf assassin tried to kill the First Lord but hit only Thessaly . Quickly Malkyn arrived to Torin and the two disappeared thank to an invisibility spell and she took the Lord to a safe place . Later during the trip of the First Lord to Yulash Malkyn lead a group of Red Plumes to capture Elanil Elassidil of Elventree . She discovered that the elven bard briefly stopped at the the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop and decided to check all the customers . Personality . Malkyn was totally loyal to Torin Nomerthal .

title: Malla ' s soul stone
description: Malla ' s soul stone Malla ' s soul stone was a unique " ioun stone " imprisoning the soul of Malla , daughter of Marlowe . Description . It was a small tear - shaped star sapphire , weighing 1 lb ( 907 g ) .
description_long: Malla ' s soul stone Malla ' s soul stone was a unique " ioun stone " imprisoning the soul of Malla , daughter of Marlowe . Description . It was a small tear - shaped star sapphire , weighing 1 lb ( 907 g ) . Powers . When attuned , the stone provided several benefits to its bearer : increased agility and dexterity , a stronger constitution , and the power to use " neutralize poison " once each day . However , the knowledge that the stone trapped the soul of an innocent person made it too terrible for good - hearted folk to use . History . In 1368 DR , the lich Vongoethe stole Malla ' s soul and placed it in this gem , because her father , Marlowe , had refused to give up his own soul after making a deal with the lich for twenty years of prosperity as a merchant . In Amkethran in Amn , Marlowe sought an adventurer like Gorion ' s Ward to deal with the lich . Vongoethe kept the stone with him in his lair in the Cave of the Dead in Amkethran .

title: Mallag
description: Mallag Mallag was a derro from Ravagestone . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mallag was exiled from his town for being too insane even for derro standards .
description_long: Mallag Mallag was a derro from Ravagestone . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mallag was exiled from his town for being too insane even for derro standards . He fell in league with Sacred Seer , a mutated myconid follower of the demon lord Zuggtmoy . The Sacred Seer sent Mallag to Sporedome to gather treasures and spore servants to her cause . However , Mallag was killed by some fungi mutated by the madness - infected " faerzress " .

title: Mallik Illance
description: Mallik Illance Captain Mallik Illance of the Illance family , elder cousin of Jhartos , was seventh in line for the clan ' s lordship and was one of the clan ' s few ship owners . He lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport but hated the city and remained only because it was his duty . He established trade ties with honest merchants .
description_long: Mallik Illance Captain Mallik Illance of the Illance family , elder cousin of Jhartos , was seventh in line for the clan ' s lordship and was one of the clan ' s few ship owners . He lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport but hated the city and remained only because it was his duty . He established trade ties with honest merchants .

title: Mallin
description: Mallin Mallin was a lich and one of the lovers — and skulls — of Tashara of the Seven Skulls . After Azuth defeated Tashara , her seven skulls split apart , and went in many directions . The skull of Mallin that took residence in a shattered tower in Myth Rhynn , where he collected and studied magic .
description_long: Mallin Mallin was a lich and one of the lovers — and skulls — of Tashara of the Seven Skulls . After Azuth defeated Tashara , her seven skulls split apart , and went in many directions . The skull of Mallin that took residence in a shattered tower in Myth Rhynn , where he collected and studied magic . He sent visions via magic and spread rumors of great treasure to lure adventurers to him , so he might steal their magic .

title: Malphys Maraphiir
description: Malphys Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was an elf and the brother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Malphys ' s mother was the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar and his father was the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir .
description_long: Malphys Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was an elf and the brother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Malphys ' s mother was the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar and his father was the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir . His sister was Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) . History . Soon after Ashemmi ' s birth in Silverymoon , the family moved to live with the wood elves in the Neverwinter Wood , and were taken in by the Ilbaereth house . Malphys gained an apprenticeship under Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Using the knowledge he gained in magic , he taught his sister Ashemmi , beginning from when she was around 80 years old .

title: Malruthiia Chaadren
description: Malruthiia Chaadren Malruthiia Chaadren was a female sylvan elf and the half - sister of Yaereene Ilbaereth . She was born out of wedlock to a high - ranking clan in the Neverwinter Woods , and was exiled upon reaching adulthood . Relatives .
description_long: Malruthiia Chaadren Malruthiia Chaadren was a female sylvan elf and the half - sister of Yaereene Ilbaereth . She was born out of wedlock to a high - ranking clan in the Neverwinter Woods , and was exiled upon reaching adulthood . Relatives . Malruthiia married Taalmuth Chaadren , who was a human ranger . Their child was Tsarra Chaadren . Her elder half - sister was Yaereene Ilbaereth . Background . Malruthiia was born in the Neverwinter Woods , an illegitimate child . Despite her heritage as an Ilbaereth , she was exiled upon reaching adulthood and set out to make her own way . She met Taalmuth Chaadren in Waterdeep , a rival hunter , and the couple married in 1337 DR . The couple became guides for hunting trips and parties around Waterdeep . While on a hunt in the Ardeep Forest in 1357 DR , Taalmuth became involved in a spell battle against a suspected lich ( the true identity of the assailant was not known ) and was killed . His entire body was burned by a " fireball " spell , and there were charred areas on nearby trees , destroyed skeleton s , a pile of stones from an arcane ritual , and a scrap of maroon cloth , which all pointed to a lich as the culprit .

title: Malu River
description: Malu River The Malu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Malu River began high in the Sillan Mountains , then ran south alongside the Vorkani Mountains .
description_long: Malu River The Malu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Malu River began high in the Sillan Mountains , then ran south alongside the Vorkani Mountains . It then turned east through the Quang Muku Forest and emptied into the sea at Foo Nakar . Settlements . The largest settlement on the Malu River was the city of Foo Nakar , which lay at its mouth . Lying near the headwaters of the Malu was the village of Mu Tong . History . In the mid – 14th century DR , pirates plying the Malu River once raided Foo Nakar . They were routed in a defense led by Pouri Lam , mistress of the city .

title: Malus Blackdagger
description: Malus Blackdagger Malus Blackdagger was an infamous bandit leader on the High Road , together with his brother Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .
description_long: Malus Blackdagger Malus Blackdagger was an infamous bandit leader on the High Road , together with his brother Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan . In the years just after the Spellplague of 1385 DR , they began their bandit careers with only a handful of men , but their ruthlessness and keen eye for opportunity earned them great success . The Blackdagger Bandits , as they were now called , gained some measure of fame , and criminals flocked to join them . With the rebuilding of Neverwinter and the subsequent increase in trade , the Blackdagger Bandits saw even greater increases , both to their income and to their ranks . After Neverwinter put a bounty or their heads , the two brothers disappeared for a time and started rumors that they had been killed and someone else led the Blackdagger Bandits . The truth was more nefarious ; the Red Wizard necromancer Kallos Tam transformed them into undead in order to use them and their forces to attack the city of Neverwinter .

title: Malus Blackiron
description: Malus Blackiron Malus Blackiron was a duergar specter priest of Deep Duerra and a member of Clan Blackiron at the small duergar settlement of Fort Iron in the Underdark under Mulmaster in the Moonsea . History . Over time , most of Malus ' s fellow duergar went mad as a result of the influence of the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch .
description_long: Malus Blackiron Malus Blackiron was a duergar specter priest of Deep Duerra and a member of Clan Blackiron at the small duergar settlement of Fort Iron in the Underdark under Mulmaster in the Moonsea . History . Over time , most of Malus ' s fellow duergar went mad as a result of the influence of the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch . Malus ' s cleric powers protected him but , circa 1486 DR , the seed directed against him a purple worm and in the battle they slew each other . Malus however rose again as a specter . He remained in the mine until 1491 DR , when an adventuring party hired by Leleanor to explore the mine found and defeated him . Personality . As a specter , Malus had a mental connection to the seed that tormented him . He felt as though he was a germ trapped inside a great restless beast and he felt all of its pain . He frequently rambled his lamentations and was prone to violent outbursts .

title: Malvag
description: Malvag Malvag was a powerful drow priest of Vhaeraun in Cormanthor in 1375 DR . History . Malvag gathered some of the most loyal followers of Vhaeraun , among them Jezz the Lame , from both House Jaelre and Clan Auzkovyn in order to cast a spell he had found in the ruins of ancient Ilythiir in order to summon their god undetected .
description_long: Malvag Malvag was a powerful drow priest of Vhaeraun in Cormanthor in 1375 DR . History . Malvag gathered some of the most loyal followers of Vhaeraun , among them Jezz the Lame , from both House Jaelre and Clan Auzkovyn in order to cast a spell he had found in the ruins of ancient Ilythiir in order to summon their god undetected . He explained his plot : to allow the god to enter the realm of Eilistraee and assassinate her . However , most of the assembled people followed Jezz ' s words and did not trust Malvag much to cooperate in such a great design and left . However , soon after , Malvag was attacked and defeated by Halisstra Melarn . Malvag managed to survive . Malvag summoned his loyal Szorak , Urz , and Valdar , each carrying the soul of an Eilistraeen priestess , to a designated place to cast the spell but , instead of Szorak , Q ' arlynd Melarn arrived in disguise and managed to kill Urz before being killed , ruining the rite that needed three spellcasters to participate . Resurrecting and forcing Q ' arlynd to cooperate , Malvag and Valdar cast the spell successfully . However , just after , and to his great surprise , he was able to cast moonfire .

title: Malver Tulbard
description: Malver Tulbard Malver Tulbard was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Malver was investigating Sraunter , so Manshoon sent his mind - controlled War Wizard Ondrath Everwood to kill him .
description_long: Malver Tulbard Malver Tulbard was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Malver was investigating Sraunter , so Manshoon sent his mind - controlled War Wizard Ondrath Everwood to kill him . Malver was eating his beloved buttered snails at Gocklin ' s dining place when he was attacked by Ondrath . However , the intervention of Lord Tauntshaw saved his life .

title: Malvin Draga
description: Malvin Draga Malvin Draga was on the Council of Elders in the city of Everlund , appointed as the " Keeper of the Bridges " , as of 1374 DR . He was a human rogue and fighter . He had a scheming personality and aimed to gain wealth by controlling customs in the city through corruption of the city watch .
description_long: Malvin Draga Malvin Draga was on the Council of Elders in the city of Everlund , appointed as the " Keeper of the Bridges " , as of 1374 DR . He was a human rogue and fighter . He had a scheming personality and aimed to gain wealth by controlling customs in the city through corruption of the city watch .

title: Malyanna
description: Malyanna Malyanna was a noble eladrin and follower of the Abolethic Sovereignty . She wished to open a portal to the Far Realm in order to unleash god - like elder evil s upon Toril . Description .
description_long: Malyanna Malyanna was a noble eladrin and follower of the Abolethic Sovereignty . She wished to open a portal to the Far Realm in order to unleash god - like elder evil s upon Toril . Description . Malyanna had slender limbs and a graceful pose . Her white skin glowed like moonlight and her eyes were black . Her hair was dark blue - black and she had pointed ears .

title: Malydren
description: Malydren Malydren was a city in the Underdark and the main capital of the race of the ixzan , the subterranean cousins of the ixitxachitl and the center of the worship of their god Ilxendren . History . It was founded in the year 602 DR .
description_long: Malydren Malydren was a city in the Underdark and the main capital of the race of the ixzan , the subterranean cousins of the ixitxachitl and the center of the worship of their god Ilxendren . History . It was founded in the year 602 DR . Geography . It lay near the center of the Lake of Radiant Mists , directly beneath the Rift of Dhalnadar over the Malydas Atoll , one of the isles of the lake .

title: Malygris
description: Malygris Malygris was a powerful dracolich on Toril . Description . He was originally a very old Blue dragon that lived in Anauroch .
description_long: Malygris Malygris was a powerful dracolich on Toril . Description . He was originally a very old Blue dragon that lived in Anauroch . History . Malygris was previously a servant of the Cult of the Dragon , but later served of Telamont Tanthul , the ruler of Thultanthar . Malygris killed Sussethilasis , the suzerain of approximately 20 blue dragons that resided within the borders of the Great Sand Sea , after becoming a dracolich .

title: Malyk
description: Malyk Malyk was allegedly from a far - distant branch of the House of Morn , the historic rulers of Daggerdale . His loyalty to the Black Network of the Zhentarim prompted them to instill rebellion , eliminate the House of Morn and install Malyk as the Lord of Daggerdale . The surviving heir to the house was the adventurer Randal Morn who fled into the hills to raise a resistance force .
description_long: Malyk Malyk was allegedly from a far - distant branch of the House of Morn , the historic rulers of Daggerdale . His loyalty to the Black Network of the Zhentarim prompted them to instill rebellion , eliminate the House of Morn and install Malyk as the Lord of Daggerdale . The surviving heir to the house was the adventurer Randal Morn who fled into the hills to raise a resistance force . Malyk ruled as a puppet leader for the Zhentarim until 1353 DR when he was killed in an attack lead by Randal Morn and his followers .

title: Malyk ( demipower )
description: Malyk ( demipower ) Malyk was an aspect of Talos created in the wake of the Time of Troubles to take advantage of areas of wild magic , created after Mystra ' s death at the hands of Helm . Due to the nature of his followers though , these were usually restricted to areas in the Underdark . History .
description_long: Malyk ( demipower ) Malyk was an aspect of Talos created in the wake of the Time of Troubles to take advantage of areas of wild magic , created after Mystra ' s death at the hands of Helm . Due to the nature of his followers though , these were usually restricted to areas in the Underdark . History . Malyk was a drow lich of increasing power who lived in the Underdark beneath the Dalelands . During the Time of Troubles - after Mystra ' s death but before Midnight ' s apotheosis - he came across a powerful area of wild magic beneath Castle Crag . Somehow , he managed to steal a part of Mystra ' s divine essence from the zone . Tempus , upon learning of Malyks actions descended into the Underdark and destroyed the lich , hoping to take some of Mystra ' s power for himself . Unfortunately for him it seems Ao decided to grant Talos that power instead . Though no one save the new Mystra would ever know that was the case . Worshipers . Malyk had no priests per se , instead he granted a few divine spells to the wild mage s who followed him . Most of his worshipers were drawn from young drow spellcasters who had been experimenting with wild magic .

title: Mamaod
description: Mamaod Mamaod was a djinni and inhabitant of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Gifted to the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , by Jiraad , Mamaod guarded her within her personal quarters .
description_long: Mamaod Mamaod was a djinni and inhabitant of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Gifted to the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , by Jiraad , Mamaod guarded her within her personal quarters . Relationships . Mamaod swore to serve Alyana for 100 years plus one day .

title: Mamblat
description: Mamblat Mamblat , nicknamed " Happy " , was a minstrel from the city of Hillsfar by the Moonsea . Around 1370 DR , Happy Mamblat was one of the more well - known itinerant minstrels wandering the Vast . Mamblat was a friendly and good - humored figure , loved by many .
description_long: Mamblat Mamblat , nicknamed " Happy " , was a minstrel from the city of Hillsfar by the Moonsea . Around 1370 DR , Happy Mamblat was one of the more well - known itinerant minstrels wandering the Vast . Mamblat was a friendly and good - humored figure , loved by many .

title: Mameluks
description: Mameluks The mameluks , also known as the slave - kings , were a group of slave - soldiers in the Seventh Age of Calimshan who rose to power after the fall of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . During the reign of the mameluks , slavery was ( naturally ) outlawed in Calimshan .
description_long: Mameluks The mameluks , also known as the slave - kings , were a group of slave - soldiers in the Seventh Age of Calimshan who rose to power after the fall of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . During the reign of the mameluks , slavery was ( naturally ) outlawed in Calimshan . They also ended the hunting of wizards by the government that had been the case during the Shoon rule . Base of Operations . The slave - kings ruled Calimshan from Manshaka over a period of four decades . There were 29 mameluk rulers in all . History . In general , the Alzhedo term " mameluk " referred to any slave trained as a warrior . During the Sixth Age of Calimshan , it became common practice for rich nobles to pay for the training of slaves to serve in their and their families ' places in the army . These " mameluks " were thus educated and well - trained in combat . Many mameluks rose to positions of lower or middle officers in the army , and so many understood means of leadership . After the turmoil from the fall of the Shoon Imperium , three pashas ruled Calimshan for a brief time , until in 533 DR the mameluks easily took control .

title: Mamluk
description: Mamluk Taken from unenlightened tribes as children , mamluks were individuals who grew up as slaves in Zakhara . Activities . These children were brought to enlightenment and schooled in various areas including warfare , discipline and administration .
description_long: Mamluk Taken from unenlightened tribes as children , mamluks were individuals who grew up as slaves in Zakhara . Activities . These children were brought to enlightenment and schooled in various areas including warfare , discipline and administration . Organization . Children were matched with whatever mamluk organization paired best with his or her natural talents . Mamluks were supervised by superior officers . The Grand Caliph in Huzuz ultimately supervised all mamluks since they were technically his property . Mamluk soldiers were the most elite fighting force in Zakhara . The different mamluk groups had special facial tattoos they used to identify members . More elaborate tattoos denoted a higher rank . Attempts to mimic mamluk tattoos was a crime in Zakhara .

title: Mamluk Council
description: Mamluk Council Several mamluk organizations in Qudra had seats on the cities ' military council and were called the Mamluk Council . Mamluk Council . The Dauntless .
description_long: Mamluk Council Several mamluk organizations in Qudra had seats on the cities ' military council and were called the Mamluk Council . Mamluk Council . The Dauntless . Commanded by General Kemil Abd al - Jasir , mamluks in the Dauntless specialized in exploration and recovering magical artifacts . General al - Jasr was just a minor member of the military council and favored whichever group gave priority to exploration . The Defenders . As the name implied , the Defenders oversaw the defense of Qudra . Their leader was Akir Abd al - Himaya . The different mamluk groups rotated turns monitoring the walls of the city , but the Defenders were solely responsible for her defense when the other groups were away . The Dutiful . This group was the most influential mamluk society in Qudra , and the most powerful in all of Zakhara . Commanded by the dwarven emir of Qudra , Hatit Abd al - Wajib , the Dutiful were actually represented by his protege General Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib since Hatit ' s duties as emir required him to show fairness to all . Ekuriyah was favored to be the next emir of Qudra . The Faithful .

title: Mamluk sword of obedience
description: Mamluk sword of obedience The Mamluk swords of obedience were magical swords that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These swords were available in a wide variety of sword types .
description_long: Mamluk sword of obedience The Mamluk swords of obedience were magical swords that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These swords were available in a wide variety of sword types . Powers . These weapons enhanced a wielder ' s fighting skill , but their main power was over all human , demihuman , and humanoid creatures . When struck by the sword , these creatures were charmed unless they were able to resist . Charmed creatures immediately surrendered to the wielder and behaved as if under a " charm person " or " charm monster " spell . The wielder did not have to be a mamluk to use the sword ' s power .

title: Mammon
description: Mammon Mammon is the archduke of Minauros , the third layer of the Nine Hells , and the patron of greed and lust . He is a baatezu . Despised by his peers , no one trusts Mammon thanks to his record for duplicity .
description_long: Mammon Mammon is the archduke of Minauros , the third layer of the Nine Hells , and the patron of greed and lust . He is a baatezu . Despised by his peers , no one trusts Mammon thanks to his record for duplicity . Condemned to his stinking mire , he dreams of one day throwing off Asmodeus ' s curse and attaining his rightful place , with Glasya at his feet . Fully aware that he has exhausted any hopes of gaining allies from the other Lords , he has abandoned the political maneuverings in Hell to focus on subverting mortals to his cause . He invites those who prove themselves loyal to attend him in his court . The service is disgusting , and one must suffer Mammon ' s vile attentions , but the riches and power to be gained are beyond imagination . Mammon ' s cults on the Prime Material Plane are widespread and wealthy . Having gained their station from dirty deals , extortion , and coercion , they are invested in the highest ranks of society . Mammon is also popular among nonhumanoids . Among his servants he includes beholder s and mind flayer s , but none are as beloved as the evil dragon s he subverts — something Tiamat most keenly resents . Appearance .

title: Mamood
description: Mamood Mamood lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamood owned a large tent in the Pilgrims ' District which he rented out to travelers and pilgrim ' s , providing them with a safe place to sleep for only one bit per night .
description_long: Mamood Mamood lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamood owned a large tent in the Pilgrims ' District which he rented out to travelers and pilgrim ' s , providing them with a safe place to sleep for only one bit per night . Mamood did not provide food , but did employ a few mercenaries to ensure his guests slept soundly .

title: Mamood ' s
description: Mamood ' s Mamood ' s was a large tent located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Mamood ' s could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mamood ' s Mamood ' s was a large tent located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Mamood ' s could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Inhabitants . Mamood ' s was owned and operated by Mamood . He offered the tent as a place to sleep for pilgrim ' s visiting the city for a mere one bit per night . Several mercenaries stood guard to allow his guests to sleep soundly .

title: Mamood Kalin
description: Mamood Kalin Mamood Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Mamood ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded .
description_long: Mamood Kalin Mamood Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Mamood ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded . Mamood carried hatred for the Grand Caliph and his misuse of justice since the day of his father ' s execution . Activities . Mamood used his magical abilities on raids against caravans traveling along Dihl al - Taif . He delighted in slaying as many living targets as possible , a behavior that often riled Fasim Kaldur who believed the animals should be left alive for use or resale . Relationships . Mamood ' s brother was Ala ' i Kalin .

title: Mamoud ibn Asra
description: Mamoud ibn Asra Mamoud ibn Asra was a dwarven faris who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamoud was a a confidant of Batina al - Shaat , the leader of the Preachers .
description_long: Mamoud ibn Asra Mamoud ibn Asra was a dwarven faris who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamoud was a a confidant of Batina al - Shaat , the leader of the Preachers . He served as her prime enforcer for both the human and dwarven warriors . Mamoud also served as the commander of both the Courageous and the Eagles . Possessions . Mamoud owned a magical shield and lamellar " armor of the desert evening " .

title: Mana Forge
description: Mana Forge The Mana Forge was a small realm within Bhaal ' s realm in the Lower Planes , created for the purpose of focusing his scattered essence from his Bhaalspawn children after his death . It consisted of only a few relatively small , circular platforms that floated in nothingness , although gravity operated normally on top of them . Four smaller platforms existed just to feed energy into the larger central one , where it was focused on a column of green light .
description_long: Mana Forge The Mana Forge was a small realm within Bhaal ' s realm in the Lower Planes , created for the purpose of focusing his scattered essence from his Bhaalspawn children after his death . It consisted of only a few relatively small , circular platforms that floated in nothingness , although gravity operated normally on top of them . Four smaller platforms existed just to feed energy into the larger central one , where it was focused on a column of green light . Amelyssan , in her attempt to absorb the power into herself , would float within the column . The four platforms were each protected by different , summoned guardians , some of them extremely powerful , such as elemental princes and a fallen solar . The Mana Forge is the stage of the final confrontation in " " . The player ' s party moves there after dissolving the Pocket Plane , and will have to fight Amelyssan several times , after each of which she retreats back into the pillar of energy to recover . Cutting off the lesser energy sources one by one forces her out again , until she has none left and fights one final time .

title: Manarech Eskwuin
description: Manarech Eskwuin High Priest Manarech Eskwuin is a priest of Tymora in the services of the royalty of Cormyr . In 1369 DR he was attempting to treat the stricken Duke Bhereu Obarskyr when the Duke vomited black viscous bile on him , causing him to flee in terror .
description_long: Manarech Eskwuin High Priest Manarech Eskwuin is a priest of Tymora in the services of the royalty of Cormyr . In 1369 DR he was attempting to treat the stricken Duke Bhereu Obarskyr when the Duke vomited black viscous bile on him , causing him to flee in terror .

title: Manarlume Tanthul
description: Manarlume Tanthul Manarlume Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul were summoned by High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont .
description_long: Manarlume Tanthul Manarlume Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul were summoned by High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont . The Most High hinted that he knew about the ambitions of both Manarlume and Lelavdra and that new princesses could be easily sired . Later , she went to report that she and her sister had found a very dangerous arcanist , Gwelt , who plotted to kill all Princes of Shade . After Larloch shattered the minds of most of the shadovar arcanists , Gwelt went to Manarlume and Lelavdra , saying that he loved them both . They started discussing how to survive the fighting . Later , among the ruins of the collapsed Thultanthar , the three laughed about the stupidity of the High Prince . Relationships . Manarlume was a daughter of Dethud Tanthul like her sister Lelavdra .

title: Manasowar
description: Manasowar Manasowar was a large lake found in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . Located deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Manasowar sat just north of the capital city of Saikhoi .
description_long: Manasowar Manasowar was a large lake found in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . Located deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Manasowar sat just north of the capital city of Saikhoi . It was fed by a smaller tributary of the Gogrus River to the west , and flowed into the Akundi River to the east .

title: Manass
description: Manass Manass , or the City of White Walls , was one of the Five Great Cities of Khazari , though it was the smallest of them . Geography . Manass was located in northern Khazari along a pass found halfway up the Katakoro Shan mountains .
description_long: Manass Manass , or the City of White Walls , was one of the Five Great Cities of Khazari , though it was the smallest of them . Geography . Manass was located in northern Khazari along a pass found halfway up the Katakoro Shan mountains . Description . Though small by most standards , Manass was heavily guarded against attack from outside forces . Manass was roughly square - shaped , with each side measuring nearly half a mile . The streets were arranged in a grid facing the cardinal directions . All of the buildings of Manass were made from carefully stacked stone that was plastered with mud then white - washed . Fields of barley and millet surrounded the land around Manass . History . Manass ' s fortifications were built to protect against invasion from Kao Dynasty Shou Lung during the 600s DR . Throughout the years , it was destroyed several times but was always rebuilt . Manass was conquered by Yamun Khahan ' s Horde during the mid – 14th century DR . Defenses . City walls that stood 30 ft . ( 9 m ) high helped protect Manass . Guard towers which overhung the walls were placed evenly around the city , allowing archers to rain arrows down upon enemies below .

title: Manchar
description: Manchar Manchar was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the eastern arm of the Vorkani Mountains . Around 1357 DR , the town was the home of the wandering holy man Korax of Manchar . It was also the base of the Vi ' oontu ninja clan .
description_long: Manchar Manchar was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the eastern arm of the Vorkani Mountains . Around 1357 DR , the town was the home of the wandering holy man Korax of Manchar . It was also the base of the Vi ' oontu ninja clan .

title: Mandible
description: Mandible The Mandible was the most powerful gang operating in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . Next to the Skulls of Skullport The Mandible was the closest thing to a government the town had . The gang took its name from a sword known as " Dragon ' s Tooth " which was found in the ruins of the old town .
description_long: Mandible The Mandible was the most powerful gang operating in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . Next to the Skulls of Skullport The Mandible was the closest thing to a government the town had . The gang took its name from a sword known as " Dragon ' s Tooth " which was found in the ruins of the old town . The sword served as a badge of office for the gang ' s leader and , since gang members bickered frequently amongst themselves , possession of the sword changed hands often .

title: Mandolin
description: Mandolin Mandolins were small pear - shaped string instruments . Description . When played as accompanying instruments , mandolins provided a delicate fluttering sound .
description_long: Mandolin Mandolins were small pear - shaped string instruments . Description . When played as accompanying instruments , mandolins provided a delicate fluttering sound . They were also performed as solo instruments . Mandolins produced in Calimshan were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Mandrake Deepwise
description: Mandrake Deepwise Mandrake Deepwise was a human explorer of the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Mandrake was a legendary member of the Guild of Underdark Guides , having performed some difficult explorations .
description_long: Mandrake Deepwise Mandrake Deepwise was a human explorer of the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Mandrake was a legendary member of the Guild of Underdark Guides , having performed some difficult explorations . However , he disappeared during one expedition , so his friend Davlin Hoth sent an adventurer to find him . In truth , he was captured by a drow raiding party under the command of Relonagh Xorlarrin and later given to Thlorrog ' s sect of mind flayer s , who performed experiments upon him . When the adventurer freed Mandrake from some drow , he asked to be left alone , because the illithids had implanted something inside his head ( that is , ceremorphosis ) . Davlin later told the story that Mandrake had died . Relationships . Mandrake was a leading figure in the Guild of Underdark Guides and was a good friend of the fellow Guild explorer Davlin Hoth .

title: Mandrake Trollbane
description: Mandrake Trollbane Mandrake Trollbane was a skilled within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mandrake specialized in making custom wagons for his customers .
description_long: Mandrake Trollbane Mandrake Trollbane was a skilled within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mandrake specialized in making custom wagons for his customers . Due to the precise catering to his client ' s needs , Mandrake ' s wagons easily sold for twice the normal asking price . Mandrake built water - tight wagons used for river crossings , wagons sporting special springs for those carrying delicate cargo , and he could even add secret compartments used for smuggling or in case a caravan was attacked by bandits . Customers who had the coin could expect their custom wagon within one week . History . Originally from the distant barbarian north , Mandrake moved to Huzuz in the early 1360s DR .

title: Mandron Saldar
description: Mandron Saldar Mandron Saldar was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Saldar and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .
description_long: Mandron Saldar Mandron Saldar was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Saldar and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember . However , Saldar and Berent Thallowood were quickly killed by the death knight Targrael under the orders of Manshoon .

title: Mane
description: Mane A mane was a tanar ' ri demon formed when a chaotic evil soul died and was sent to the Abyss . Manes were considered the " fodder " of the Abyss . Description .
description_long: Mane A mane was a tanar ' ri demon formed when a chaotic evil soul died and was sent to the Abyss . Manes were considered the " fodder " of the Abyss . Description . Manes were generally three feet tall . They had white eyes and pale , bloated flesh that was often in the process of being eaten by maggots . Combat . Manes fought with their nails and teeth . Abilities . Manes could not speak , but they could understand simple language . Like other tanar ' ri , manes could summon other tanar ' ri . A mane could potentially travel up the food chain of demonic evolutions and become a demon lord , though this was very rare . Ships of chaos were tied together with strands of the spirits of manes . Such ships could also be powered by eating manes . History . Along with other demons , manes roamed the streets of Menzoberranzan in 1485 – 1486 DR .

title: Mane ' s Band
description: Mane ' s Band Mane ' s Band was a group of ten adventures , led by the warrior Mane . History . In 1344 DR the band almost met their death ' s in the Yuirwood and disbanded for a time .
description_long: Mane ' s Band Mane ' s Band was a group of ten adventures , led by the warrior Mane . History . In 1344 DR the band almost met their death ' s in the Yuirwood and disbanded for a time . By 1345 DR Mane ' s Band had reformed and added in the defense of Shadowdale during that dale ' s Time of No Lords . In 1356 DR Mane ' s Band took part in the defeat of Lashan Aumersair . Afterwords the band moved east to Hillsfar and then to Mulmaster where nothing more was heard from them . The fate of Mane ' s Band remains unknown .

title: Mane ' s Manor
description: Mane ' s Manor Mane ' s Manor was a house in the town of Shadowdale belonging to Mother Tara . Structure . The manor was a two - story house located just west of the festhall .
description_long: Mane ' s Manor Mane ' s Manor was a house in the town of Shadowdale belonging to Mother Tara . Structure . The manor was a two - story house located just west of the festhall . Mother Tara occasionally rented out Mane ' s Manor for large parties or to adventurers staying in Shadowdale for long periods of time . The guest would have to provide their own food and cannot cause the neighbors to complain . Atmosphere . Given all the complaints about strange sounds within the house and a leaky roof which needed fixing , Mother Tara would have sold the manor if the right buyer offered a reasonable price . History . Around 1367 DR , Mother Tara held the deed to Mane ' s Manor because Mane left it to her in his will . In 1374 DR , Zhent forces took control of the vale of Shadowdale and used the building for overflowed crowds from Mother Tara ' s Festhall .

title: Maneira
description: Maneira Maneira was a female halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Maneira was a member of the Gilded Palm .
description_long: Maneira Maneira was a female halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Maneira was a member of the Gilded Palm . She worked for the Ben Ayyub merchant house . Relationships . Maneira and Kilij formed a matched team of assassin s .

title: Manferic III
description: Manferic III Manferic III was the king of Ankhapur . Personality . Manferic ' s goal was immortality but for his vanity he also wanted to maintain a good appearance and continue ruling his city .
description_long: Manferic III Manferic III was the king of Ankhapur . Personality . Manferic ' s goal was immortality but for his vanity he also wanted to maintain a good appearance and continue ruling his city . History . Manferic ruled Ankhapur with an iron hand and a touch of sadism . In 1366 DR , he become a lich and started a plot to obtain the body of his bastard son Janol Famisso to inhabit . However , in the end , Janol proved to be more capable than him and Manferic was destroyed by Janol and his allies .

title: Manfred Arbustle
description: Manfred Arbustle Manfred " Manny " Arbustle was a druid member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . With noticeable freckles , Manfred appeared very boyish and younger than his actual age .
description_long: Manfred Arbustle Manfred " Manny " Arbustle was a druid member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . With noticeable freckles , Manfred appeared very boyish and younger than his actual age . He had sandy - colored hair and blue eyes . He dressed in olive - green or brown hooded robes , which he wore over leather . Most people called him Manny , but he hated that nickname . Personality . Manfred had a strong love of nature . The forest and all of its wonders gave him comfort in times of stress . Manfred wanted to prove his valor to his fellow companions . He was insecure in his status as the youngest member of the Company and feared that others saw him as a child . For this Manfred sometimes acted sullen or rebellious . Abilities . Manfred was proficient in the use of the quarterstaff and sling . He was a good horse rider and knew much about animals and plants . Possessions . Manfred carried no magical items , his main " weapon " being an uncured sapling that he used as a staff . He wore leather armor and carried throwing dagger s and a sling . Relationships .

title: Manggus
description: Manggus A manggus was an evil spirit that lived on the steppes of the Hordelands . They used their power to frighten others and demand sacrifices . Description .
description_long: Manggus A manggus was an evil spirit that lived on the steppes of the Hordelands . They used their power to frighten others and demand sacrifices . Description . A manggus stood as tall as an ogre , but its skin hung in flaps about its body . They had bloodshot eyes and wept tears of blood . Four large fangs dominated its mouth . All manggus were capable of shapechanging . Combat . During a rare occurrence when a manggus fights in its natural form , they attack with a bite and hand - held weapon , typically a large maul . Manggus fight with ferocity , but will retreat if they feel the battle has turned against them . Manggus are generally found in the form of a human , though they were able to shapechange into any creature that they had seen . All manggus could use the following spell - like abilities : " ESP " , " comprehend languages " , " cause fear " . They could also cause disease per touch . They were immune to charm and hold spells and cold - based magic . Damage from fire caused a manggus to revert back to its natural form . Magical weapons were needed to harm them . Habitat / Society . Most manggus lived alone or in pairs .

title: Mangobarl Lorren
description: Mangobarl Lorren Mangobarl Lorren was the baker of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . He ran his shop in that village . Relationship .
description_long: Mangobarl Lorren Mangobarl Lorren was the baker of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . He ran his shop in that village . Relationship . He was a staunch and discreet ally of the Zhentarim , thanks to some of his distant relatives who were in that organization . He told them all about what he heard in the village . Personality . He loved to gossip and knew all kinds of wild tales , few of them true . History . In 1491 DR , he heard about Pell Mhandyvver ' s scare at the Haunted Tomb and went to look for himself , discovering a goblin .

title: Manitou
description: Manitou A manitou manifests , in its true form , as a tangle of ghostly vines , each tipped with a fanged maw . Manitous can possess any animal , plant , or fey . In their incorporeal form , they can literally tear apart the natural world with the invisible forces at their command .
description_long: Manitou A manitou manifests , in its true form , as a tangle of ghostly vines , each tipped with a fanged maw . Manitous can possess any animal , plant , or fey . In their incorporeal form , they can literally tear apart the natural world with the invisible forces at their command .

title: Mannin
description: Mannin Mannin the Stout was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Mannin was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .
description_long: Mannin Mannin the Stout was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Mannin was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate . He was responsible for discipline and training , together with Losifan Urdo . Mannin was a pragmatical and harsh commander . History . In his youth , Mannin was a duelist . He joined the Guild as a recruit but impressed Palla so much that she hired him permanently .

title: Manshaka
description: Manshaka Manshaka was a city ( a town by Calishite standards ) in Calimshan , most well - known for its Blood Arenas and slavery . A home for gamblers and smugglers , such was its disrepute that more euphemistic aliases existed for this city than any other in Calimshan . It was the second - largest gambling center in all Faerûn , next to Calimport .
description_long: Manshaka Manshaka was a city ( a town by Calishite standards ) in Calimshan , most well - known for its Blood Arenas and slavery . A home for gamblers and smugglers , such was its disrepute that more euphemistic aliases existed for this city than any other in Calimshan . It was the second - largest gambling center in all Faerûn , next to Calimport . Geography and Layout . Manshaka was located on the coast south of Calimshan ' s central plain , on a north – south stretch of shore of the Shining Sea . The city contained eight sabban s composed of a total of 36 drudach s . It was split into two halves by Drudach Street , which led from the city ' s only gate to the coast . Appearance . The of Manshaka were fully glazed and made from red bricks . Local legends claimed that these Red Minarets of Manshaka were once white but had been stained red by the blood of slaves who died there . Defenses . The Red Minarets had archers stationed on them , who would often " shoot first and ask questions later " regarding any disturbances in the city below .

title: Manshoon
description: Manshoon Manshoon was the founder of the Zhentarim , also known as the Black Network , until he was " slain " by Fzoul Chembryl , his ally , and Lord Orgauth in 1370 DR . However , it transpired that Manshoon had created a dozen or more clone s that the murderous duo then found themselves facing . Only one of these clones survived into the late 1370s DR and once more headed the evil organization known as the Zhentarim .
description_long: Manshoon Manshoon was the founder of the Zhentarim , also known as the Black Network , until he was " slain " by Fzoul Chembryl , his ally , and Lord Orgauth in 1370 DR . However , it transpired that Manshoon had created a dozen or more clone s that the murderous duo then found themselves facing . Only one of these clones survived into the late 1370s DR and once more headed the evil organization known as the Zhentarim . Personality . For years Manshoon was the lord of Zhentil Keep and leader of the Zhentarim . Completely fitting the archetype of the sly - tongued , sinister and decadent master spellcaster , Manshoon ruthlessly crushed revolts within his own ranks of the Black Network , easily slaughtered his rivals and weeded the weak out of the ranks of the young and ambitions by sending upstarts on nigh - impossible suicide missions . Hated and mistrusted by Fzoul , Manshoon manipulated him much as he did all others - remaining arrogant , untouchable in his power and faintly amused by it all . History . Early Life . Manshoon was born in Zhentil Keep in 1229 DR to Harlshoon , the first lord of Zhentil Keep .

title: Manticore
description: Manticore A manticore was a large , magical beast with the body of a lion , dragon - like wings , and a somewhat humanoid head . Its long tail had a cluster of deadly spikes , which the creature could launch at its foes as weapons . It had dagger - like claws and fangs .
description_long: Manticore A manticore was a large , magical beast with the body of a lion , dragon - like wings , and a somewhat humanoid head . Its long tail had a cluster of deadly spikes , which the creature could launch at its foes as weapons . It had dagger - like claws and fangs . Personality . Manticores were known to be savage man - eaters and allies of evil creatures . Manticores were intelligent creatures and often worked beside other evil beings to bring strife and suffering to the world . Description . Manticores were true monsters . They were giant beasts with the bodies of lions , the wings of a dragon , the head of a man , and a tail that ended in a mass of deadly spikes . The mouth of a manticore was full of rows and rows of razor - sharp teeth , similar to a great white shark . It used these teeth to feed upon any creature the manticore could catch , be it animal or human . Combat . Some manticores had tail spikes that carried lethal or paralytic venom . Often , these manticores would have tails that were similar in appearance to that of a scorpion ' s stinger . Diet .

title: Mantle
description: Mantle The Mantle were a serie of passages and side - caverns in the Dark Dominion of Menzoberranzan . The Eastways : These tunnels lead to Driders ' Chasm , east to the Fardrimm and the dwarf - claimed tunnels of fallen Delzoun . In this tunnels were the caves Ablonsheir ' s Cave , named for Ablonsheir U lu ' ar , one - time Arch mage of Menzoberranzan , Cavern of the Severed Tentacles , named for a fail invation of I llithids from Phanlinksal , Pit - Warrens a jail for violators .
description_long: Mantle The Mantle were a serie of passages and side - caverns in the Dark Dominion of Menzoberranzan . The Eastways : These tunnels lead to Driders ' Chasm , east to the Fardrimm and the dwarf - claimed tunnels of fallen Delzoun . In this tunnels were the caves Ablonsheir ' s Cave , named for Ablonsheir U lu ' ar , one - time Arch mage of Menzoberranzan , Cavern of the Severed Tentacles , named for a fail invation of I llithids from Phanlinksal , Pit - Warrens a jail for violators . The Masterways : These tunnels north of the Clawrift lead nowhere , and due to this isolation represent one of the safest regions of the Dark Dominion . Many nobles use the Masterways for " sport hunting " . In this tunnels were the Cavern of the Masters where the wizards of House Xorlarrin and House Barrison Del ' Armgo did rituals to help Lolth in her creation of the Demon Weave and Masters of Sorcere did experimentation , Glowstones , an area with natural luminescent rocks . The Wanderways : Many centuries ago Menzoberranzan was being threatened by an invading force thus the Archmage of Menzoberranzan did a ritual of misdirection throughout these northeastern tunnels of the Mangle .

title: Mantle stone of Vhyridaan
description: Mantle stone of Vhyridaan The mantle stone of Vhyridaan was an " ioun stone " that held and protected against magical spells . It held the soul of Vhyridaan the Mad . History .
description_long: Mantle stone of Vhyridaan The mantle stone of Vhyridaan was an " ioun stone " that held and protected against magical spells . It held the soul of Vhyridaan the Mad . History . An exile of Myth Drannor , the half - elf mage Vhyridaan the Mad was self - taught in the ways of High Magic . He tried to store his knowledge in a " kiira " , but failed — the stone absorbed not only his knowledge but his body and soul completely , as well as the one magic item he had with him , a " ring of spell turning " . His soul remained trapped inside the stone thereafter . The " mantle stone " eventually came into the possession of Laummas , the Lich - King of Hlondath . Laummas fell in the battle of Twilight ' s Falling in 712 DR , part of the Weeping War against Myth Drannor . It was snatched up by his minion , the treacherous Nezras , who had it but briefly before giving it up to Aulmpiter , the nycaloth commander of the Army of Darkness . The " mantle stone " remained with Aulmpiter until the Fall of Myth Drannor in 714 DR . There , in the Bane ' s Duel , Aulmpiter dueled Captain Fflar Starbrow Melruth to the death .

title: Mantol - Derith
description: Mantol - Derith Mantol - Derith was a trading city situated in an underground cavern three miles below the surface . Geography . Its exact location was not known by many .
description_long: Mantol - Derith Mantol - Derith was a trading city situated in an underground cavern three miles below the surface . Geography . Its exact location was not known by many . It was located on the shores of the Darklake , on the other side of which was the duergar city of Gracklstugh . The nearest drow settlement was Menzoberranzan , or Ched Nasad before that city ' s destruction . Structure . Mantol - Derith was located in a twisted cavern 60 – 70 feet tall and twice as wide . The city was heavily guarded and protected by strong magic . The cavern was naturally formed by water because of its proximity to the Darklake , and was filled with waterfalls , pools , and streams . Its walls were filled with multicolored crystals and gem s . Bridges across the various streams were carved from crystal . The city itself primarily comprised trade caravans and campsites . History . In 1372 DR , the city was was very quiet because of the problems during the Silence of Lolth in Menzoberranzan and elsewhere . The drow group led by Quenthel Baenre stayed here while they worked to gain access to Gracklstugh across the Darklake . Inhabitants .

title: Manual of the Planes 4th edition
description: Manual of the Planes 4th edition Contents . The " Manual of the Planes " is the authoritative guide to the new cosmology presented in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game . Like previous versions of the book the 4th edition of the " Manual of the Planes " ( MotP ) is primarily a lore book , focusing on background information on each plane it covers rather than introducing new rules .
description_long: Manual of the Planes 4th edition Contents . The " Manual of the Planes " is the authoritative guide to the new cosmology presented in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game . Like previous versions of the book the 4th edition of the " Manual of the Planes " ( MotP ) is primarily a lore book , focusing on background information on each plane it covers rather than introducing new rules . At the end of the book , however , rule mechanics are presented for new , , and ritual s . Information in the " Manual of the Planes " is considered canon ical to the 4th edition variant of the " Forgotten Realms " insofar as it does not directly contradict other 4th edition " Realms " sources . For instance , the details of Arvandor are canon but the details on Shom , which does not exist in FR ' s version of the Astral Sea , are not . Similarly , the Feywild and Shadowfell sections are " mostly " apocryphal , since each campaign setting ' s variant of the parallel plane s is a reflection of each setting ' s Prime Material Plane rather than having details wholly unique to itself . The book is divided into seven chapters , as follow :

title: Manxam
description: Manxam Manxam was the oldest and most powerful beholder living in the Western Heartlands . He was a member of the Zhentarim , and also acted also as the ruler of Teshwave . He was the most prominent of the exiled beholder of Ootlul Activities .
description_long: Manxam Manxam was the oldest and most powerful beholder living in the Western Heartlands . He was a member of the Zhentarim , and also acted also as the ruler of Teshwave . He was the most prominent of the exiled beholder of Ootlul Activities . He was barely involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair when she attacked Zhentil Keep . He prefered Fzoul Chembryl as leader of the Zhentarim over Manshoon . In later years he supported Fzoul in his schemes contributing to the downfall of Manshoon . As of 1489 DR , Manxam appeared to be among the senior leadership of Darkhold , then - headquarters of the Zhentarim .

title: Many - Arrows
description: Many - Arrows The Kingdom of Many - Arrows was an orc kingdom founded by Obould Many - Arrows in 1371 DR and recognized as a sovereign realm by several of the Silver Marches signatories the following year . It stretched from Mithral Hall in the west to the Moonwood in the east and to the Evermoors in the south . A glimpse into the future made it known that the kingdom would last at least 100 years to the reign of King Obould VI , but even then , renegade shamans of Gruumsh attempted to return to the old orc ways and wished to attack their neighbors instead of continuing to foster peaceful relations with them .
description_long: Many - Arrows The Kingdom of Many - Arrows was an orc kingdom founded by Obould Many - Arrows in 1371 DR and recognized as a sovereign realm by several of the Silver Marches signatories the following year . It stretched from Mithral Hall in the west to the Moonwood in the east and to the Evermoors in the south . A glimpse into the future made it known that the kingdom would last at least 100 years to the reign of King Obould VI , but even then , renegade shamans of Gruumsh attempted to return to the old orc ways and wished to attack their neighbors instead of continuing to foster peaceful relations with them . History . The Obould dynasty reigned almost uninterrupted since the kingdom ' s founding . Although there were some civil wars , peace was maintained since the Year of the Malachite Shadows , 1460 DR . The orcs of Many - Arrows occasionally raided southern lands but open conflict between Luruar and Many - Arrows had been completely averted as of 1479 DR . Open conflict between Many - Arrows and the Uthgardt of the region however was rife since the realm ' s inception .

title: Many - Hued Peacock Society
description: Many - Hued Peacock Society The Many - Hued Peacock Society was a secret society plotting the ruin of Shou Lung . Description . The Many - Hued Peacock Society was known for their centuries - long plots .
description_long: Many - Hued Peacock Society The Many - Hued Peacock Society was a secret society plotting the ruin of Shou Lung . Description . The Many - Hued Peacock Society was known for their centuries - long plots . This derived also from the fact that most of the members of the Inner Council were more than 100 years old . History . The Many - Hued Peacock Society was the oldest secret society in Shou Lung . Curiously , in its pursuit of its goals of destroying the Empire ' s bureaucracy , the Many - Hued Peacock Society had been indirectly and directly responsible for saving the Empire from destruction more than once . In their conflict with Shou Lung ' s Royal Vagabonds , they ruined some of plots of the Gorath , who had menaced the integrity of the Empire .

title: Many - Windowed Tower
description: Many - Windowed Tower The Many - Windowed Tower was a slender tower , 6 or 7 stories tall , on the southwestern shores of the Yal Tengri in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . The tower was the abode of a lich named Demchungchumrub who kidnapped and killed sailors along Yal Tengri to crew his spelljammer ship , a great galley known as " Delras " .
description_long: Many - Windowed Tower The Many - Windowed Tower was a slender tower , 6 or 7 stories tall , on the southwestern shores of the Yal Tengri in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . The tower was the abode of a lich named Demchungchumrub who kidnapped and killed sailors along Yal Tengri to crew his spelljammer ship , a great galley known as " Delras " .

title: Manyfins
description: Manyfins Manyfins was a name given to a type of found in north Faerûn in the Vast . Description . It was very small in size , characterized by its number of fins , and had a sharp taste .
description_long: Manyfins Manyfins was a name given to a type of found in north Faerûn in the Vast . Description . It was very small in size , characterized by its number of fins , and had a sharp taste . Ecology . They were called " manyfins " by Melicent , Meliors , and Melusine Mellicot . They stocked Swords Pool with manyfins and trout around 1370 DR . Although they discouraged fishing , some people did it anyway on dark nights .

title: Map House
description: Map House The Map House , also known as the Heralds ' House because it was owned by the Heralds of Faerûn , was a library and repository for geographical maps and genealogies of noble houses . In 1371 DR it became part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . Location .
description_long: Map House The Map House , also known as the Heralds ' House because it was owned by the Heralds of Faerûn , was a library and repository for geographical maps and genealogies of noble houses . In 1371 DR it became part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . Location . The Map House was located on the north bank of the River Rauvin in the city of Silverymoon , in the former Vault of the Sages building . Structure . The building was a four - story stone edifice that resembled the innermost structure of a strong castle . Services .
