The Map House was a library of many geographical maps as well as a lexicon of genealogical records for nobles and commoners , many of which were copies of the originals kept in Herald ' s Holdfast . Interested customers could pay a fee to view these documents or have a scribe make a copy . After the Map House changed hands and became part of the university these services were continued , but for students , the fees were included in their tuition . As Master of the House , Esklindrar Iol had authority over what materials were allowed to be copied and disseminated . History .

title: Mar ( ethnicity )
description: Mar ( ethnicity ) The Mar were a race of human s dwelling in the Utter East . History . The Mar were the indigenous inhabitants of the Utter East ; they had settled along the coastline in past ages .
description_long: Mar ( ethnicity ) The Mar were a race of human s dwelling in the Utter East . History . The Mar were the indigenous inhabitants of the Utter East ; they had settled along the coastline in past ages . Their histories told they had known only oppression since that time . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , Moonshaes Ffolk arrived on the shores of the Utter East , where they chose to settle . They were later joined by Northmen settlers . The native Mar welcomed the Ffolk , who spoke of peace and brotherhood between the two races . Indeed , relations were friendly for the first few years . However , Ffolk soon turned greedy , and they seized Mar lands for their own , and then subjugated and enslaved the Mar tribes themselves . They carved these stolen lands into their Five Kingdoms . The Ffolk discovered the bloodforge s in the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR and burst into the Bloodforge Wars . The Mar could only be helpless witnesses , recording events for posterity . A decade of unending warfare devastated the Utter East , leaving the ancestral lands of the Mar despoiled .

title: Mara
description: Mara Mara was the chef of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern in the village of Hilltop . History . In 1372 DR after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a small group of kobolds led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main attack force .
description_long: Mara Mara was the chef of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern in the village of Hilltop . History . In 1372 DR after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a small group of kobolds led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main attack force .

title: Mara al - Gurab Sakir
description: Mara al - Gurab Sakir Mara al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Mara was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master .
description_long: Mara al - Gurab Sakir Mara al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Mara was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master . She was more confident than her sister Safia . Decription . Mara had shiny black hair and dark eyes . Activities . Mara served as one of Akim al - Kalass ' s apprentices , learning the mystical ways of the sha ' ir .

title: Marakus Beindold
description: Marakus Beindold Marakus Beindold was a Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar in the Vast in the 13th century DR . History . Around the mid – 13th century DR , Marakus Beindold was Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar when he sought to annex the hills east of the town , and thereby expand Hlintar ' s farmland and enrich himself .
description_long: Marakus Beindold Marakus Beindold was a Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar in the Vast in the 13th century DR . History . Around the mid – 13th century DR , Marakus Beindold was Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar when he sought to annex the hills east of the town , and thereby expand Hlintar ' s farmland and enrich himself . However , these lands were traditionally occupied by the local dwarves . Therefore , Beindold invited the leaders of the dwarven communities to the Hornmoot trading festival , welcomed them as guests , and put on a feast for them . However , the wine was drugged , and Beindold had hired mercenaries to forcibly occupy the village before the dwarves arrived . He had the dwarves brutally murdered in their beds as they slept . A few dwarves escaped , however , and a tenday later they returned , avoided Beindold ' s guards , and caught him in his own bedchamber to return his hospitality . With their hammers , they broke every single bone and joint in his body . Beindold was discovered the next morning , hideously beaten and crippled in a pool of his own blood .

title: Maraloi
description: Maraloi The Maraloi , or Ancient Lords , were a mysterious race inhabiting northern Kara - Tur . Name . The word ' " maraloi " meant " ancient lords " in the Pazruki language .
description_long: Maraloi The Maraloi , or Ancient Lords , were a mysterious race inhabiting northern Kara - Tur . Name . The word ' " maraloi " meant " ancient lords " in the Pazruki language . Race . The ancestry of the Maraloi was unknown to outsiders . Some thought them human , others that they were a form of spirit folk . In fact , they were an archaic eastern branch of the elf race and were counted as being spirit beings as Kara - Turans knew them . Description . The Maraloi were known to be tall and fair of skin and hair . Magic & Technology . Maraloi wielded tools and weaponry forged of bronze , because iron was apparently poisonous to them . Thus they never used implements of iron . They were said to command a potent and alien magic . History . Legend told that , millennia before the 14th century DR , the Maraloi ruled the lands known as the Northern Wastes . They opposed the ogre magi , oni , and lesser humanoid races , and maintained their dominance until the use of iron became widespread in the Ama Basin , and thereafter fell into decline . To outsiders , the ultimate fate of the Maraloi remained unknown .

title: Maram il Vass
description: Maram il Vass Maram il Vass was a powerful ultroloth yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Activities . Maram had found a better approach than warmongering .
description_long: Maram il Vass Maram il Vass was a powerful ultroloth yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Activities . Maram had found a better approach than warmongering . Instead , he developed a refuge on the Prime Material Plane from which to trade his trade and his secrets . Personality . Maram was cunning and had a painstaking attention to detail , yet was extremely charming , a trait he knew how to use . History . Maram was once an ultroloth living in Gehenna . At one point , he worked for the demon lord Graz ' zt in the Outer Planes , distinguishing himself in his service , and the two separated on good terms . However , after becoming bored of war , Maram constructed a refuge in the Deep Wastes in Toril ' s Underdark . There , he worked to expand his collections of exotic things and beings . During the Rage of Demons , with the arrival of Graz ' zt in the Underdark , Maram renewed his partnership with the demon lord . At the same time , he used this connection to add to his collection . Queen Hledh Hellspawn of Maerimydra granted him the drow alchemist Xaven Tanor ' this of Szith Morcane . Later , an adventuring party hired by Murssvayas Dhuurniv went to Maram ' s lair to free Xaven .

title: Maram il Vass ' s servant
description: Maram il Vass ' s servant Maram il Vass ' s servant attended the yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Personality . The long years of servitude had completely conditioned him into unquestioningly serving the yugoloth .
description_long: Maram il Vass ' s servant Maram il Vass ' s servant attended the yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Personality . The long years of servitude had completely conditioned him into unquestioningly serving the yugoloth . He had even lost his name . History . During the Rage of Demons , the servant welcomed the guests of his master at the door of his lair .

title: Maram of the Great Spear
description: Maram of the Great Spear Maram of the Great Spear was a primordial , confined to the Elemental Chaos by the Monuments of the Ancients . . It was also one of the " Seven Lost Gods " .
description_long: Maram of the Great Spear Maram of the Great Spear was a primordial , confined to the Elemental Chaos by the Monuments of the Ancients . . It was also one of the " Seven Lost Gods " . Vassals . Maram was served by an elemental prince that was also his herald , a lesser primordial known as Pyricus . History . Maram , an ancient primordial , was released into the world of Toril in the fifth century before the Dale Reckoning calendar began by archwizards of Netheril , who were seeking to counter an invasion from the Outer Planes , beginning the Seven Sigils War . After a century they managed to contain or banish most of the immortal and elemental beings who they had allowed into Toril , but one , Maram of the Great Spear , escaped . Maram subjugated the primitive human tribes in Rystall Wood . His human slaves worshiped him as a god for a time , but in - 357 DR , the Year of the Sycophants , a coalition of many peoples and races led by three mortals who would one day become known as the Dead Three managed to bind Maram and seal him back in the Elemental Chaos .

title: Maran
description: Maran Maran or Mari was a language spoken by the Mar people of the Utter East . It was categorized in the Midani subgroup of the Untheric group of the Rauric languages family , and was most closely related to the languages of Zakhara . Sounding strange yet melodious to Atreus Eleint ' s ears , Maran was composed of many short syllables and employed throaty or guttural clicks .
description_long: Maran Maran or Mari was a language spoken by the Mar people of the Utter East . It was categorized in the Midani subgroup of the Untheric group of the Rauric languages family , and was most closely related to the languages of Zakhara . Sounding strange yet melodious to Atreus Eleint ' s ears , Maran was composed of many short syllables and employed throaty or guttural clicks . The Maran people often spoke it quite rapidly . The people of Langdarma spoke a dialect that was comparatively soft and delicate , and seemingly more ancient . The phrase " " Ekc ' kta reeto " " apparently meant " She is telling the truth " in Maran , but when Atreus tried it and could not manage the throat click , it came out as " The yaks are very honest . " However , since he had the deceitful Rishi Saubhari as a translator , it is hard to say for sure what either phrase truly meant . Mar writers used the word " parshan " to refer to the foreigners ( Ffolk ) who ' d settled their lands in 621 DR . " " was an honorific used in Maran .

title: Marance Talendar
description: Marance Talendar Marance Talendar was a wizard in Nine Hells . Relationships . Marance in Selgaunt was always in company of his brother Nuldrevyn Talendar .
description_long: Marance Talendar Marance Talendar was a wizard in Nine Hells . Relationships . Marance in Selgaunt was always in company of his brother Nuldrevyn Talendar . History . Marance was a powerful wizard member of Talendar house in Selgaunt around 1250 DR . He with his brother Nuldrevyn was among the most gifted heirs of the Talendar . However when Thamalon Uskevren went back in city to reestablished Uskevren house Marance and Nuldrevyn decided to stop Thamalon . However Thamalon fought back and in a skirmish Thamalon killed Marance . Marance ' s spirit went to Nine Hells . After some time of torments Marance was admitted to the court of the archfiend ruler of Dis . In years Marance become one of the most powerful wizard in Hells and probably the only non - baatezu to arrive so high . However Marance was obsessed with vengeance against Thamalon . At last in 1372 DR the archfiend granted permission to Marance to went back to Prime Material Plane in order to fulfill his vengeance . Quickly he was back in Selgaunt and reforged contact with Nuldrevyn . Personality . Marance always prided himself with his composure . He had a iron will .

title: Marangor
description: Marangor Marangor , also known as the City of Dragon s , was a fortress - city and the capital of the empire of Skelkor on Returned Abeir . Government . Marangor was ruled by the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal since many centuries before the Spellplague .
description_long: Marangor Marangor , also known as the City of Dragon s , was a fortress - city and the capital of the empire of Skelkor on Returned Abeir . Government . Marangor was ruled by the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal since many centuries before the Spellplague . Inhabitants . The bulk of Marangor ' s population was composed by humanoid slaves , most of them dragonborn , halfling s and human s , with a minority of genasi . Dragons composed the higher caste , but only few lived in the city . As of 1479 DR , only 800 adult dragons and 400 wyrmlings lived in Marangor . Architecture . The city was built by dragonborn slaves , who expanded it over the years . It was a fortress the size of a mountain with concentric stone walls rising in the center to provide its dragon inhabitants with well protected lairs . In the subterranean levels of the fortress was located the Clutch Nursery , a network of caves where the children of Gauwervyndhal born and struggled to reach adulthood , and the caves that Gauwervyndhal used as her hoard vaults . History . During the Wailing Years , many dragonborn clans rebelled after having found enough quantities of dragonbane amber to kill many dragons .

title: Marantha
description: Marantha Marantha was a mute cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Marantha was the cleric of a unidentified nature goodness .
description_long: Marantha Marantha was a mute cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Marantha was the cleric of a unidentified nature goodness . However , a powerful curse robbed from her her voice . She couldn ' t regain it even with the help of Khelben Arunsun , Alustriel , and two others of the Seven Sisters . Alustriel supposed the curse was the work of Malar .

title: Marantine Delcastle
description: Marantine Delcastle Marantine Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the lady of House Delcastle . History . In 1479 DR , following the request of her son Arclath Delcastle , Marantine agreed to house Amarune Whitewave and Elminster Aumar ' s party in her house for a time .
description_long: Marantine Delcastle Marantine Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the lady of House Delcastle . History . In 1479 DR , following the request of her son Arclath Delcastle , Marantine agreed to house Amarune Whitewave and Elminster Aumar ' s party in her house for a time . She also told them about the Imprisoners and the creation of the Blueflame ghost s , which she knew of thanks to her family dealings with the church of Mystra . In 1480 DR in order to lure out Elminster after the matter of Castle Irlingstar Manshoon sent a contingent of his death tyrant s and several of his magically - dominated nobles to attack Delcastle Mansion . In the fighting lady Maratine was fatally injured . She died soon after seeing his son a last time . Relationships . Arclath had a frosty relationship with his mother , who seemed more interested in being pleasured by young men than in the family business .

title: Maranyuss
description: Maranyuss Maranyuss was a night hag who was personally kicked out of the Nine Hells by Asmodeus himself . She found herself in Waterdeep and set up a bookshop called Curious Pages that specialized in esoteric books . At some point , she met the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn and since they both hated Asmodeus , they entered into an uneasy alliance .
description_long: Maranyuss Maranyuss was a night hag who was personally kicked out of the Nine Hells by Asmodeus himself . She found herself in Waterdeep and set up a bookshop called Curious Pages that specialized in esoteric books . At some point , she met the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn and since they both hated Asmodeus , they entered into an uneasy alliance . Mara helped Jinn stop the ritual of the First Flensing , which would have allowed Asmodeus to enter Waterdeep . Appearance . Mara normally wore an illusion of beauty which made her appear as a dark - haired woman . In her natural form , she was a hideous purple hag .

title: Marash Rashi
description: Marash Rashi Marash Rashi was a barbarian merchant in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Rashi was the best trader of Chegoyui .
description_long: Marash Rashi Marash Rashi was a barbarian merchant in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Rashi was the best trader of Chegoyui . Usually he made multiple bargains with each customer , one for each service the costumer needed . Rashi was specialized in horse s and other livestock . Rashi was the brother - in - law of the yagbhu , guaranteeing him that his debtors must pay or they would face the guards .

title: Maratimmir
description: Maratimmir Maratimmir was the seat of Ankaram and the official home of Duchess Vajra Valmeyjar of Tethyr , though she spent most of her time at the royal palace of Faerntarn . Location . Maratimmir was located about 30 miles east of the city of Myratma along the southern bank of the River Ith within the confines of County Calimmon .
description_long: Maratimmir Maratimmir was the seat of Ankaram and the official home of Duchess Vajra Valmeyjar of Tethyr , though she spent most of her time at the royal palace of Faerntarn . Location . Maratimmir was located about 30 miles east of the city of Myratma along the southern bank of the River Ith within the confines of County Calimmon . Structure . The fortified palace was built in Calishite style . Some of the buildings on the grounds had been destroyed during the Reclamation Wars . History . The palace was the former home of the duke of Ankramir before the Interregnum .

title: Maraunth Torr
description: Maraunth Torr Maraunth Torr was an evil archmage in 1487 DR . Personality . Maraunth Torr was a young and ambitious archmage .
description_long: Maraunth Torr Maraunth Torr was an evil archmage in 1487 DR . Personality . Maraunth Torr was a young and ambitious archmage . He despised the shadovar for their haughtiness about non - Netherese . He was an expert poisoner . History . He was one of the archmages who competed for possession of the Lost Spell during a spellstorm . Maraunth killed the rival Harper wizard Alastra Hathwinter but was ultimately killed by Shaan the Serpent Queen in a fight . Elminster considered him like a young Manshoon .

title: Marble
description: Marble Marble was a hardstone widely used in the Realms as a building material . Marble was sometimes called because that was its primary ingredient . Description .
description_long: Marble Marble was a hardstone widely used in the Realms as a building material . Marble was sometimes called because that was its primary ingredient . Description . Marble was highly prized in construction because of its strength , weight , and beauty . It came in many colors , including black , gray , pink , and white , and polished to a reflective smooth finish . This material was extremely heavy but was easy to quarry to exact specifications . A typical price was 3 gp per pound ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Powers . No magical use for marble has been found .

title: Marcabruk
description: Marcabruk Marcabruk was the leader of the hybsil Autnak Tribe in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Marcabruk and his tribe in 1358 joined the Company of the Singing Dawn , the Llandrydd ' s Steel group and Enhanen ' s men in fighting the undead army led by the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric .
description_long: Marcabruk Marcabruk was the leader of the hybsil Autnak Tribe in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Marcabruk and his tribe in 1358 joined the Company of the Singing Dawn , the Llandrydd ' s Steel group and Enhanen ' s men in fighting the undead army led by the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric .

title: Marchas
description: Marchas Vanguard Marchas was a leader of a steading of cloud giant s . History . In the late 1200s DR , during Marchas ' time as vanguard of the his tribe , he chose to ban the high priest of Memnor , Abram , from the contests at which cloud giants often compete , because Abram had shown himself to be cruel and careless with the lives of innocent persons involved .
description_long: Marchas Vanguard Marchas was a leader of a steading of cloud giant s . History . In the late 1200s DR , during Marchas ' time as vanguard of the his tribe , he chose to ban the high priest of Memnor , Abram , from the contests at which cloud giants often compete , because Abram had shown himself to be cruel and careless with the lives of innocent persons involved . Abram rallied support in protest against Marchas , and Marchas suggested that Abram challenge his spot in the " ordning " . Abram did so and defeated Marchas in one of their games . Even so , Abram chose not to replace Marchas as head of the giants of the tribe , instead he established a parallel " ordning " to that of Marchas ' , which included the more evil cloud giants of the steading . Marchas continued to rule the good giants living on the cloud .

title: Marching Mountains
description: Marching Mountains The Marching Mountains were a heavily forested mountain range on the northern border of Calimshan . Geography . The Marching Mountains ran east to west and , together with the River Agis , which flowed west from its peaks , formed the Calishite border with Tethyr .
description_long: Marching Mountains The Marching Mountains were a heavily forested mountain range on the northern border of Calimshan . Geography . The Marching Mountains ran east to west and , together with the River Agis , which flowed west from its peaks , formed the Calishite border with Tethyr . Geographical Features . The mountains were surrounded by foothills , and these southern hills were the site of many manors ; due to the cooler temperatures at higher elevation , rich Calishite s would rest here during the hot summers . The tallest mountain in the range ( Mount Gommat ) was 8 , 500 feet , while the average was just below a mile . The taller peaks , ( all those above 6 , 500 feet , ) were in the interior of the range , and the lower mountains were broad . The variation in elevations was wide , so the Marching Mountains were full of many hidden valleys and ravines . The mountains contained iron of a particularly dark hue , and this was used to craft " shoonring s " with combat or defensive properties . In the winter , snow would cover the tops of the higher mountains , but only exceedingly rarely would the snow ever reach below 6 , 600 feet .

title: Marco Volo
description: Marco Volo Marcus Wands , better known as Marco Volo was a Waterdhavian noble nuisance and a minor thief who adopted this moniker after stealing an artifact and blaming the real Volo . Personality . Marco comes off as an annoying , persistent and brazen fellow .
description_long: Marco Volo Marcus Wands , better known as Marco Volo was a Waterdhavian noble nuisance and a minor thief who adopted this moniker after stealing an artifact and blaming the real Volo . Personality . Marco comes off as an annoying , persistent and brazen fellow . All this is bravado though as beneath this facade he is a timid man who just wants to be liked for something other than his noble heritage . Despite his lack of real social skill , he can be likable if one gets to know him . History . Born into the Wands noble family of Waterdeep , Marcus quickly grew bored of his life . He was too full of energy and fancy ideas about himself . He rebelled against his family and took up the life of a rogue . He thought of himself as a dashing and handsome outlaw , constantly on the run and beloved by the ladies . These thoughts weren ' t entirely accurate though . He " was " constantly on the run from the law , but only because of his lack of skill at thievery . He also had several furious ex - girlfriends . One day though , ' Marco ' stumbled upon the hidden retreat of the wizard Sabbar , pocketing the most obvious item he found in Sabbar ' s study before fleeing .

title: Marco Wildfeet
description: Marco Wildfeet Marco Wildfeet was the unofficial leader of Soravia in Damara in 1359 DR . History . Marco led his people in the opposition to Zhengyi .
description_long: Marco Wildfeet Marco Wildfeet was the unofficial leader of Soravia in Damara in 1359 DR . History . Marco led his people in the opposition to Zhengyi . Activities . Marco was the leader of the Soravian Talebringers . Personality . Marco wanted to do his duty to his people and afterward go back into the shadows . He planned to name Olwen Forest - Friend as the new Duke of Soravia . He was a humble man who did not like being at the center of attention .

title: Marcos Craumerdaun
description: Marcos Craumerdaun Marcos Craumerdaun was a human male and the head of the Craumerdaun mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Marcos was a cavalry trainer and had a good eye for quality horses , but did not deal as well with people in competitive business dealings .
description_long: Marcos Craumerdaun Marcos Craumerdaun was a human male and the head of the Craumerdaun mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Marcos was a cavalry trainer and had a good eye for quality horses , but did not deal as well with people in competitive business dealings . He only kept his Council position due to the influence of his nephew , General Labak Craumerdaun who was the advisor and " de facto " leader of the Shield Council .

title: Marcus
description: Marcus Marcus was a potter in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Marcus was a priest of Chauntea in Secomber but an argument with the high priest stripped him of his powers and rank .
description_long: Marcus Marcus was a potter in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Marcus was a priest of Chauntea in Secomber but an argument with the high priest stripped him of his powers and rank . He relocated in Daggerford as potter and secret agent for the duke , spying over the Farmers ' Quarter and acting as courier for import ants documents . He dreamed to made vengeance against the church of Chauntea but his moral objection always had stopped him .

title: Marcus Vinlander
description: Marcus Vinlander Marcus Vinlander was a shopkeeper of Tuns and Tubs in Skullport . History . The Vinlander family had always been in the vine business and Marcus at first wanted to manage a distillery .
description_long: Marcus Vinlander Marcus Vinlander was a shopkeeper of Tuns and Tubs in Skullport . History . The Vinlander family had always been in the vine business and Marcus at first wanted to manage a distillery . After a terrible incident that cost him his left arm , Marcus found his true vocation as a designer . By 1370 DR , he oversaw the production of all kinds of containers .

title: Marcus of Shadowdale
description: Marcus of Shadowdale Marcus of Shadowdale was killed and then reincarnated as a dog . He made his way to Ravens Bluff and has endeared himself to the local population who named him King . Appearance .
description_long: Marcus of Shadowdale Marcus of Shadowdale was killed and then reincarnated as a dog . He made his way to Ravens Bluff and has endeared himself to the local population who named him King . Appearance . As a human , Marcus of Shadowdale is 5 ' 11 " tall and weighs 165 pounds . He is lean and hard - muscled with a handsome face . His clothes are fine quality but show the wear and tear of a ranger ' s life . In battle he favors chain mail armor . As a dog , he looks exactly like a little mixed - breed terrier . Personality . King the dog has only vague memories of his former life as a ranger and no ability to communicate so he tends to hang around local adventurers and wander the town looking for familiar things from his former life . He lives off of handouts from the townspeople who mostly treat him as a minor hero . He has foiled quite a few robberies and pickpocket attempts by barking or biting the thieves and even saved a child from drowning once . His taste in food is noticeably different than a typical dog and he is fond of approaching pretty girls . He often accompanies Ambassador Carrague around town and stays with him in his underground home during inclement weather .

title: Mardeiym Reithel
description: Mardeiym Reithel Lord Mardeiym Reithel was a fey ' ri under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth . He was a veteran of the Seven Citadels ' War and was given control of the houses of Reithel , Floshin , Ulvaerren , Ursequarra and Almyrrtel against the city of Evereska . Later Sarya chosen him as the general of her army .
description_long: Mardeiym Reithel Lord Mardeiym Reithel was a fey ' ri under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth . He was a veteran of the Seven Citadels ' War and was given control of the houses of Reithel , Floshin , Ulvaerren , Ursequarra and Almyrrtel against the city of Evereska . Later Sarya chosen him as the general of her army . He died in the final battle of the Cormanthor War inside Myth Drannor . Equipment . In combat , Mardeiym wore a black mithral breastplate embossed with a dragon and a war helm .

title: Marden Norwood
description: Marden Norwood Marden Norwood , aka Lord Norwood , was the patriarch of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . Description . Norwood had silver hair .
description_long: Marden Norwood Marden Norwood , aka Lord Norwood , was the patriarch of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . Description . Norwood had silver hair . Relationships . Lord Norwood was extremely protective of his daughter Seila . He initially had warm feelings toward Jack Ravenwild until he learned Jack wasn ' t really a noble . History . In 1479 DR , Lord Norwood ' s daughter , Seila was captured by the slaver Fetterfists and sold into slavery to the drow who lived beneath Ravens Bluff . Seila was rescued by Jack Ravenwild who returned her to Lord Norwood . Norwood richly rewarded Jack with a 5 , 000 gold piece line of credit at a local counting house as well as the use of Maldridge House , a mansion in Ravens Bluff . Jack passed himself off as a minor noble from the Vilhon Reach , an area that had been devastated by the spellplague . Lord Norwood hired sages to investigate Jack ' s claim and found it to be impossible . After learning of Jack ' s deceit , Norwood ordered Jack out of the mansion and told him to keep away from Seila . Later , a noble revel attended by Lord Norwood and his daughter was attacked by Fetterfists and his gang .

title: Mardikan
description: Mardikan Mardikan was a human priest of House Helcaliant who worshiped Horus - Re in Mulhorand within the Old Empires . Description . The cleric was a strong and tall man with powerful religious and political ties .
description_long: Mardikan Mardikan was a human priest of House Helcaliant who worshiped Horus - Re in Mulhorand within the Old Empires . Description . The cleric was a strong and tall man with powerful religious and political ties . Personality . Mardikan was an irrational and sometimes vengeful individual who cared deeply for his fellow clerics . Relationships . As a priest of Horus - Re , Mardikan fought with his rival the vizier of Mulhorand Rezim to stop the clerics of Anhur from gaining favor with the pharaoh Horustep III . History . Around 1357 DR , Mardikan feared the involvement of the Red Wizards of Thay or the followers of Set becoming involved in the political struggles in Mulhorand .

title: Mardivec Gentlecut
description: Mardivec Gentlecut Mardivec Gentlecut was an incubus servant of Graz ' zt in the Moonsea . Relationships . Mardivec was an old friend of the goblin cambion Agrak .
description_long: Mardivec Gentlecut Mardivec Gentlecut was an incubus servant of Graz ' zt in the Moonsea . Relationships . Mardivec was an old friend of the goblin cambion Agrak . He always had with him his dretch servant Noisome . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Mardivec was forcibly summoned to Faerûn from Azzagrat , together with his master the demon lord Graz ' zt . He and Noisome , decided to join Lord Agrak . He resided inside the prison of the Skullspike tribe , enjoying the madness spreading among the goblin s . Personality . Mardivec liked his devilish form , unlike his fellows .

title: Marduk
description: Marduk Marduk was an aspect of the lesser dragon god Bahamut , worshiped in Unther as the greater god of cities , wind , thunder , storms , and rain . Description . Marduk was one of the few members of the Untheric pantheon who had an inhuman appearance .
description_long: Marduk Marduk was an aspect of the lesser dragon god Bahamut , worshiped in Unther as the greater god of cities , wind , thunder , storms , and rain . Description . Marduk was one of the few members of the Untheric pantheon who had an inhuman appearance . He had the form of a humanoid with red skin , four eyes and four ears , shooting flames from his mouth when he speak . Realm . Marduk had a realm in Arcadia called also Marduk , a city of marble and adobe located on the center of an arid land of sun and sky . The rivers Luar and Kath flowed through the realm and the city , keeping it cool even on the hottest days . Outsiders to the realm were watched carefully , but left to their own devices as long as they respected the law . He usually left the rule of his city to mortals , just to see how they would adapt to his precepts . As a member of the Untheric pantheon , he also had a realm on Zigguraxus . Personality . Marduk was concerned with justice and law , and he always opposed the schemes of Tiamat , the Nemesis of the Gods . History . In - 2087 DR the Untheric pantheon was brought to Toril when former Imaskari slaves founded the Unther ic empire .

title: Marek
description: Marek Marek was a male human thief active before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Marek was a high - ranking member of the thieves ' guild of Zhentil Keep and was a mentor to the young human Cyric .
description_long: Marek Marek was a male human thief active before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Marek was a high - ranking member of the thieves ' guild of Zhentil Keep and was a mentor to the young human Cyric . However , Cyric later escaped from Zhentil Keep and tried to live a more honest life . During the Time of Troubles , Marek traveled to Shadowdale to persuade Cyric to rejoin the guild and abandon the people of the Dalelands to Bane . Cyric refused firmly and to fully embrace his freedom he killed Marek .

title: Marek the Shank
description: Marek the Shank Marek the Shank was a hobgoblin of Ship Rethnor in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Marek used a longsword and shield , or wielded a shortbow in battle .
description_long: Marek the Shank Marek the Shank was a hobgoblin of Ship Rethnor in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Marek used a longsword and shield , or wielded a shortbow in battle . History . Marek was a hobgoblin fighter member of Ship Rethnor in Luskan . He and his friend Slim were the main leaders of the Rethnor men that followed Vaelish Gant in Icewind Dale . They started a protection racket in Bryn Shander and supported Vaelish in his political plot . In Eleint 20 , they stole silver weapons ordered by the Harper Aarun from Dunavan ' s warehouse . On Highharvestide , Silm and Marek kidnapped the Speaker of Bryn Shander , Duvessa Shane , on the day of an election and Vaelish proposed himself as a substitute while pretending to be reluctant . Appendix . Gameplay . In order to fight Akar Kessell and Hedrun Arnsfirth , the adventurers could potentially allow Vaelish to succeed in his plan .

title: Marel
description: Marel Marels were a distinct evil aquatic elven race worshiping Umberlee . Description . These pale skin elves had blackish green hair and green eyes which had an phosphorescent glow .
description_long: Marel Marels were a distinct evil aquatic elven race worshiping Umberlee . Description . These pale skin elves had blackish green hair and green eyes which had an phosphorescent glow . History . They were normal aquatic elves until they refused to help the human city of Northkeep in 400 DR and were banned , much like the drow were , by the gods , and their appearance changed .

title: Maresa Rost
description: Maresa Rost Maresa Rost was a tall genasi - human crossbreed . Appearance . Maresa had very pale skin , large violet eyes , a pointed chin , and a heart - shaped face .
description_long: Maresa Rost Maresa Rost was a tall genasi - human crossbreed . Appearance . Maresa had very pale skin , large violet eyes , a pointed chin , and a heart - shaped face . She moved gracefully , and she had long silver - white hair . Maresa wore the star - shaped pendant given to her mother by Araevin Teshurr after she left the Company of the White Star . Relatives . Maresa ' s mother was Theleda Rost . When Theleda was murdered , Maresa hunted down her assassin and killed him , then killed the assassin ' s employer . Equipment . Maresa wore a suit of dark crimson studded leather armor and carried a rapier and a crossbow .

title: Margery Thrier
description: Margery Thrier Margery Thrier , also known as Mags , was a businesswoman in Hillsfar . History . Mags managed the finances of the Hillsfar Arena .
description_long: Margery Thrier Margery Thrier , also known as Mags , was a businesswoman in Hillsfar . History . Mags managed the finances of the Hillsfar Arena . During the Rage of Demons , she bought many non - human prisoners from sorcerer Breex Vandermast Relationship . Mags always walked with her lieutenant Horac and a goliath slave - bodyguard .

title: Mari Agneh
description: Mari Agneh Mari Agneh was the former tharchion of Priador , a region and town of Thay . History . Mari was deposed by the zulkir Aznar Thrul , who then proclaimed himself tharchion of Priador .
description_long: Mari Agneh Mari Agneh was the former tharchion of Priador , a region and town of Thay . History . Mari was deposed by the zulkir Aznar Thrul , who then proclaimed himself tharchion of Priador . Mari appealed to Szass Tam and his allied zulkirs to help her keep her position , but they declined . When Thrul learned of her petition , he took her prisoner to abuse as his slave and sexual plaything . The blood fiend Tsagoth was sent to find her . When he did , he transformed her into a blood fiend – like creature and convinced her to slay Aznar Thrul . During his next attempt at abusing her , Mari revealed her new identity to Thrul and turned into a savage being without conscience . She killed Thrul only to be slain shortly after by the tharchion ' s Red Wizards .

title: Mari Al ' maren
description: Mari Al ' maren Mari Al ' maren was a Harper bard . Personality . Mari was quick to laugh and to anger but also sarcastic like Caledan Caldorien .
description_long: Mari Al ' maren Mari Al ' maren was a Harper bard . Personality . Mari was quick to laugh and to anger but also sarcastic like Caledan Caldorien . She treated people like they treated her , with calm and patience if they were kind to her , and with rudeness if were bad to her . Mari had found a purpose in life in the Harpers . History . Mari was born in Elturel and was raised by a Harper bard . In 1357 DR , on one of her first missions as a Harper , she met Caledan Caldorien in Iriaebor just after a Zhentarim army led by Ravendas had conquered the place and captured Caledan ' s son Kellen Caldorien . With the help of Caledan and his friends from the Dreaming Dragon party , Mari managed to defeat Ravendas , who was summoning the Shadowking . Caledan destroyed the Shadowking using his shadow magic . In 1360 DR , a new Shadowking started growing inside Caledan , who disappeared . Mari and the Dreaming Dragon party managed to find him and defeated the Shadowking again without consequence to Caledan . Afterward , Mari decided to form a family with Caledan and Kellen .

title: Mari bint Sadita
description: Mari bint Sadita Mari bint Sadita ran a small stall within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Mari was quiet and her pleasant attitude made customers feel at ease .
description_long: Mari bint Sadita Mari bint Sadita ran a small stall within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Mari was quiet and her pleasant attitude made customers feel at ease . Activities . As a newer addition to the Grand Bazaar , Mari only had a small stall , which consisted of a carpet loaded with the coffee and tea she sold . Her quality wares attracted more and more customers in the few weeks since she had set up shop . She offered free samples to prospective customers .

title: Mariabronne
description: Mariabronne Mariabronne the Rover was a human ranger , famous throughout the lands of Damara , often called The Tamer of Vaasa . Description . At about 40 years of age , Mariabronne ' s face showed the hardship that came with more than 20 years of battles .
description_long: Mariabronne Mariabronne the Rover was a human ranger , famous throughout the lands of Damara , often called The Tamer of Vaasa . Description . At about 40 years of age , Mariabronne ' s face showed the hardship that came with more than 20 years of battles . His fairly long and thick brown locks were usually unkempt and covered his ears and neck , complementing his scruffy beard . Still , he was considered quite handsome with his brown eyes shining with a luster of youth more fitting of a man half his age . His grin could be both commanding and mischievous . His lean but finely muscled body was often covered by dirty garbs . Personality . As a nomadic warrior , he often talked to himself for he was often alone . He wanted no partners in hunting or life unless in the form of a temporary arrangement or a warm , soft body beside him in a warm soft bed . Mariabronne viewed his responsibilities as beyond the call of his personal desires . His visions and aspirations were rooted in the hope of an entire nation — to tame wild Vaasa . Being acquainted with King Gareth Dragonsbane , Mariabronne knew how to behave at court .

title: Maribar Island
description: Maribar Island Maribar Island was located off of the eastern coast of the Pearl Cities region of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Maribar Island covered roughly 900 sq .
description_long: Maribar Island Maribar Island was located off of the eastern coast of the Pearl Cities region of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Maribar Island covered roughly 900 sq . miles ( 1450 sq . km ) of land . The town of Samak was the only settlement of any considerable size found on the island , though numerous pirate hideouts were probably scattered across the island ' s coast as well . Geography . The island was located in the Golden Gulf approximately 30 miles ( 48 km ) northeast of the city of Sikak on the mainland . The Bountiful Shoals separated Maribar Island from the coast of West Zakhara .

title: Marid
description: Marid Marids ( sometimes pluralized as " marid " ) were powerful genie s native to the Elemental Plane of Water . They were also prevalent throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Most Zakharans revered marids as the most wondrous and powerful of all geniekind .
description_long: Marid Marids ( sometimes pluralized as " marid " ) were powerful genie s native to the Elemental Plane of Water . They were also prevalent throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Most Zakharans revered marids as the most wondrous and powerful of all geniekind . Description . The average marid stood a towering sixteen to eighteen feet ( five and a half meters ) tall , looking down upon all other genies . Marids were beautiful genies whose skin matched all of the hues of the vast ocean . While usually blue , in fact , marids changed their skin color to reflect their current mood , with darkest shades of blue indicating anger . Most marids had blue - black or dark gray hair , though white - haired marids did exist . Generally speaking , the white - haired marids were the most turbulent of their kind . While on the Elemental Plane of Water , or in seas or oceans , marids usually wore scant clothing or went bare . On land they preferred colorful flowing robes or large pantaloons . Others would wear clothing made from finely woven seaweed inlaid with coral or pearls .

title: Marid ' s Mouth
description: Marid ' s Mouth The Marid ' s Mouth , also known as al - Gawwar , al - Hazan , or Maut Ahmar , was a large whirlpool located in the waters of the southern region of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Description . The mouth of Maut Ahmar spanned several leagues , striking fear into the heart of any sailor within sight because the whirlpool moved around in random patterns , making it nearly impossible to safely navigate around .
description_long: Marid ' s Mouth The Marid ' s Mouth , also known as al - Gawwar , al - Hazan , or Maut Ahmar , was a large whirlpool located in the waters of the southern region of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Description . The mouth of Maut Ahmar spanned several leagues , striking fear into the heart of any sailor within sight because the whirlpool moved around in random patterns , making it nearly impossible to safely navigate around .

title: Maridan
description: Maridan Maridans , or sea gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Sea gen resembled their element with greenish skin and blue hair and eyes .
description_long: Maridan Maridans , or sea gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Sea gen resembled their element with greenish skin and blue hair and eyes . Seaweed and other flotsam was often tangled in their hair . Maridans enjoyed wearing decorations from the sea such as pearls or beautiful shells . Personality . Maridans were wild and playful creatures . A sha ' ir ran the risk of hurting their maridan ' s feelings if they did not play along with their pranks and playfulness .

title: Marilith
description: Marilith Mariliths , also known as type V demon s , were a type of powerful tanar ' ri demon . Mariliths were the tacticians of Abyssal hordes and queens of the Abyssal realms . They served as the generals and advisors to the demon lords of the Abyss .
description_long: Marilith Mariliths , also known as type V demon s , were a type of powerful tanar ' ri demon . Mariliths were the tacticians of Abyssal hordes and queens of the Abyssal realms . They served as the generals and advisors to the demon lords of the Abyss . They sought strategies that brought the most destruction in whatever realm they were in . Description . Mariliths appeared from the waist up as humanoid women with six arms . From the waist down , they appeared to have the body of a giant snake . They were seen as quite beautiful and flaunted it , wearing only jewelry on their nude torsos and arms . Mariliths stood around 9 feet tall and measured 20 feet from head to tip of tail . They weighed 4 , 000 pounds . Personality . Mariliths were very intelligent and served as talented generals and tacticians . They were proud of their martial skills and often kept the weapons of their defeated foes as trophies . Combat . Mariliths eagerly joined melee combat given the chance . They carefully sized up the situation first and plotted to use any terrain and vulnerabilities to their advantage . They could attack with a weapon in each of their six hands , typically longsword s or scimitar s .

title: Marilyn Haresdown
description: Marilyn Haresdown The Lady High Ambassador Duchess Marilyn Haresdown was the duchess of the Purple Marches in Tethyr and a former member of the adventuring band the Company of Eight . Description . Duchess Haresdown had relatively short , blonde hair .
description_long: Marilyn Haresdown The Lady High Ambassador Duchess Marilyn Haresdown was the duchess of the Purple Marches in Tethyr and a former member of the adventuring band the Company of Eight . Description . Duchess Haresdown had relatively short , blonde hair . Her eyes were green . Personality . Marilyn Haresdown was a very zealous patriot for her homeland of Tethyr , as an adventuress and member of the Company of Eight , as a participant in the Reclamation Wars , and later as a duchess and ambassador of a new unified Tethyr . Her perseverance served her well in foreign politics , and her skill in diplomacy served her both in foreign courts and when she turned down the many suitors that had sought her out . She had an energetic personality and was very fond of archery and horseback - riding as pastimes . Abilities . Marilyn specialized in combat with the broadsword , and she was also proficient with bow , battleaxe , and dagger . She knew how to craft her own bows and arrows and was skilled at horseback - riding and natural healing measures . Possessions . When in the Company of Eight , Marilyn was armored in scale male and fought with a " + 3 shield " and a " + 3 dancing broadsword " .

title: Marim Tem
description: Marim Tem Marim Tem was a half - elf entertainer and musician in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . His growing fame had a bad effect on Marim .
description_long: Marim Tem Marim Tem was a half - elf entertainer and musician in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . His growing fame had a bad effect on Marim . He became pompous and arrogant and prone to throwing a tantrum if he didn ' t get his way . However , he was very competent , knowing nearly every song from every culture across Faerûn . History . Marim was an entertainer and musician in Mulmaster , together with his band . In 1491 DR , the Blade s of the city competed with each other over the arts , and Marim became a top pawn in their proxy war , gaining great fame . One day , he was invited to play at a party hosted by Zor Faltyn Gos .

title: Marimmar
description: Marimmar Marimmar , also known as Marimmar the Magnificent , was the wizard master of the young Narm Tamaraith . History . Marimmar was a good but slow magic teacher who over - estimated his powers .
description_long: Marimmar Marimmar , also known as Marimmar the Magnificent , was the wizard master of the young Narm Tamaraith . History . Marimmar was a good but slow magic teacher who over - estimated his powers . At one point , he started tutoring the young Narm in the magic arts . In 1357 DR , he decided against all prudence to travel to the ruined Myth Drannor to acquire magical treasure but Marimmar was quickly killed by the devil s there .

title: Marion Hexbane
description: Marion Hexbane Marion Hexbane was a high - ranking member of the Blackdagger Bandits in Neverwinter . Personality . Marion resented her spellscar , despite the fact that it increased her power .
description_long: Marion Hexbane Marion Hexbane was a high - ranking member of the Blackdagger Bandits in Neverwinter . Personality . Marion resented her spellscar , despite the fact that it increased her power . Marion seemed to hate everyone in the world . Relationships . She respected only Traven Blackdagger and his brother for their ambitions . History . Around 1480 DR , Marion was involved in an extortion plot against the merchant Melkhor Goldseeker .

title: Marius
description: Marius Marius the Valiant was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish . Activities . Marius was a recruiter based in Alaghôn .
description_long: Marius Marius the Valiant was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish . Activities . Marius was a recruiter based in Alaghôn . He with a month of time can recruit a very efficient infantry unit but he can also hired companies of scouts , ambushers , pikes , and archers . He accepted to recruit cavalry only if the employer provided the very good horses . Personality . Marius always choose employers that agreed with his politic ideas to support . He was a master tactician , he had never lost a battle . History . Once Marius was a slave - gladiator in arenas of Old Empires and around the Vilhon Reach until in a small isle of the Sea of Fallen Stars he led a slave revolt . Marius and his fellow soon after formed the Free mercenary company . They fought well for many years until a small city - state offered them a home as well as a job . All outside Marius settled . Marius become a recruiter , hoping to save more slaves .

title: Mark Anthony
description: Mark Anthony Mark Anthony ( born 1966 ) is an American fantasy author known beyond the Realms for his " The Last Rune " series . His first novel was " Crypt of the Shadowking " in The Harpers series . His works include novels for the Forgotten Realms , the Dragonlance and the Ravenloft settings , as well as several short stories .
description_long: Mark Anthony Mark Anthony ( born 1966 ) is an American fantasy author known beyond the Realms for his " The Last Rune " series . His first novel was " Crypt of the Shadowking " in The Harpers series . His works include novels for the Forgotten Realms , the Dragonlance and the Ravenloft settings , as well as several short stories .

title: Mark Nelson
description: Mark Nelson Mark Nelson is a professor and artist who has illustrated role - playing games and comic books . Education . Nelson received his Master of Arts degree from the .
description_long: Mark Nelson Mark Nelson is a professor and artist who has illustrated role - playing games and comic books . Education . Nelson received his Master of Arts degree from the . Career . Nelson was employed as a professor at , where he also taught Tom Braxa , another artist known for his Dungeons & Dragons illustrations . Nelson later worked for as a concept artist , before starting his own art studio with his wife Anita . Works . In addition to many other projects , Nelson is known for his illustrations of many Dungeons & Dragons products , including " Dragon " magazine .

title: Markao Jaitzen
description: Markao Jaitzen Markao Jaitzen was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Markao Jaitzen was a sohei at the Temple of True Enlightenment in Suijeng , training under sensei Lu - che .
description_long: Markao Jaitzen Markao Jaitzen was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Markao Jaitzen was a sohei at the Temple of True Enlightenment in Suijeng , training under sensei Lu - che . In 1358 DR , Markao Jaitzen went to participate at the Komite . However , he knew it was not possible for him to win . He only wanted to honor his teacher and get practice against strong adversaries .

title: Markeen
description: Markeen Markeen , or “ genie doubles , ” were a lesser form of genie that were isolated from most of their kind . At birth , these creatures were cursed to resemble exactly a human from Zakhara . Other than their looks , markeen did not share any kind of bond with their human counterpart other than both were born at the exact same moment .
description_long: Markeen Markeen , or “ genie doubles , ” were a lesser form of genie that were isolated from most of their kind . At birth , these creatures were cursed to resemble exactly a human from Zakhara . Other than their looks , markeen did not share any kind of bond with their human counterpart other than both were born at the exact same moment . Markeen were typically only the genie doubles of famous or infamous humans . Most true genies ignored the markeen , considering them to be vulgar creatures who were not worth their time . Since markeen lacked the inherent magical abilities of genies , sha ' ir s had no power over them . Description . Markeen resembled humans in every aspect . Combat . Markeen could use the following spells once per day : " flame blade " , " dust devil " , " invisibility " , and " gust of wind " . Though they rarely used the ability around humans , all markeen could fly . Habitat / Society . Markeen formed secret societies among humans . Markeen went through several rituals as they grew older . The first was a search for their human counterpart .

title: Market Floor ( Djerad Thymar )
description: Market Floor ( Djerad Thymar ) The Market Floor was a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The Market Floor was an open bazaar where the city ' s commerce was held , located above the foundation of the city .
description_long: Market Floor ( Djerad Thymar ) The Market Floor was a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The Market Floor was an open bazaar where the city ' s commerce was held , located above the foundation of the city . The district was inside the pyramid that composed the city , and was made up by hundreds of massive stone pillars , each 50 feet ( 15 meters ) in diameter , that supported the upper City Bastion . In the open spaces between the pillars shops , stalls , taverns , offices , and other establishments were organized in a series of agorae that looked like rings around the pillars . The enormous War Drums stood in the open end of the market , near the entrance of Djerad Thymar . Those drums were used to either call for the Lance Defenders to defend the city , or to welcome warriors who returned from successful missions . Farmers and traders from other lands were permitted to sell their goods in this district alongside native dragonborn traders . The Market Floor also served as the festival hall , site of monthly Grand Balls . Visitors were always welcomed to attend such celebrations .

title: Markguth
description: Markguth Markguth was a human guard and the sergeant of the guards in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . History . During the battle with the Cult of the Dragon , Markguth was among the defenders of the keep .
description_long: Markguth Markguth was a human guard and the sergeant of the guards in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . History . During the battle with the Cult of the Dragon , Markguth was among the defenders of the keep . When he saw that Langdedrosa Cyanwrath had captured his sister and her children , he offered to be the the city ' s champion against the half - dragon .

title: Markham Southwell
description: Markham Southwell Markham Southwell was the sheriff of Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Markham was at the town hall when giant s attacked the city .
description_long: Markham Southwell Markham Southwell was the sheriff of Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Markham was at the town hall when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Markham was a man of few words with the mission to protect his citizens . He judged people only by their actions . He never showed his emotions . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Markham was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Marking the Years
description: Marking the Years Years ( winters ) are referred to by names , each name consistent across the Realms . Each kingdom or city - state numbers years differently , usually to measure the reign of a dynasty or the current monarch , or since the founding of the country . The result is a hodgepodge of overlapping numbers that serve to confuse the ordinary person and frustrate the sage .
description_long: Marking the Years Years ( winters ) are referred to by names , each name consistent across the Realms . Each kingdom or city - state numbers years differently , usually to measure the reign of a dynasty or the current monarch , or since the founding of the country . The result is a hodgepodge of overlapping numbers that serve to confuse the ordinary person and frustrate the sage . The widespread differing year dates include the following : Methods of reckoning . Dalereckoning ( DR ) . Dalereckoning is taken from the Year of Sunrise , when the Standing Stone was raised by the elves of Cormanthyr and the human Dalesfolk . Since this time , humans were permitted by the Elven Court to settle in the more open regions of the forests . In some texts , primarily those which do not have direct ties to Dales history , Dalereckoning is called Freeman ' s Reckoning ( FR ) . The calendar is widely used in Faerûn but has not spread beyond its shores . Cormyr Reckoning ( CR ) . Cormyr Reckoning begins at the foundation of House Obarskyr , the dynasty that still rules that land . The 25 - year gap between Cormyr Reckoning and Dalereckoning has caused much of the confusion regarding elder days .

title: Markoth Hasselpond
description: Markoth Hasselpond Markoth Hasselpond , usually known as Fat Mar , was a waiter in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Markoth was a rotund man who sweated profusely .
description_long: Markoth Hasselpond Markoth Hasselpond , usually known as Fat Mar , was a waiter in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Markoth was a rotund man who sweated profusely . Personality . Markoth had a sharp tongue and a foul mouth . He disliked his nickname but not the fact that everyone knew him . He was the principal fount of gossip inside the city . History . Markoth worked at the Laughing Goblin Inn in Phlan , helping the tavern owner Imizael . In 1489 DR , he became involved in the Cult of the Dragon ' s coup in the city , as the tavern became the headquarters of the forces fighting against the cultists .

title: Marks
description: Marks Marks was a male human thief who was the proprietor of the Broken Pike tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . He was short and mousy .
description_long: Marks Marks was a male human thief who was the proprietor of the Broken Pike tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . He was short and mousy . Activities . He had a habit of looking the other way when his regulars plotted their crimes in his tavern . In addition to running the tavern , Marks occasionally operated as a fence for the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild and was a crony of his regular patron and fellow fence , Thurn Blackskull . He was also reputed to be one of the few humans in Skullport who knew how to contact the Unseen .

title: Marlandro Gaelkur
description: Marlandro Gaelkur Marlandro Gaelkur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Marlandro ran a barber shop and a shop of used tools .
description_long: Marlandro Gaelkur Marlandro Gaelkur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Marlandro ran a barber shop and a shop of used tools . He also managed a counterfeiting business and sometimes bought shady items with no questions asked . He was one of the Believers . History . Once Marlandro was an assistant jeweler in Baldur ' s Gate . In 1491 DR , one of his clients , Larmon Greenboot , told and retold a story about mysterious freshly dug graves in the Sumber Hills . That same year , under secret suggestions from Larrakh of the Cult of Black Earth , Marlandro , along with Ilmeth Waelvur and Albaeri Mellikho , killed some people in order to protect the secret of the Believers . Discovered his crimes by some adventurers Marlandro , fearing Ilmeth ' s confession , tried to escape the town

title: Marlgate
description: Marlgate Marlgate was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This warehouse district of the City of Brass was largely abandoned .
description_long: Marlgate Marlgate was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This warehouse district of the City of Brass was largely abandoned . Inhabitants . Alongside the vermin found throughout Marlgate , private armies of dao merchants could be found here as well .

title: Marliir
description: Marliir House Marliir was a noble house of Cormyr , based in Suzail . The family were always outsiders at the Royal Court and had extensive landholdings and businesses in the Arabel area . The Marliirs and the Huntcrown s hated each other and were close to open conflict in the late 15th century DR .
description_long: Marliir House Marliir was a noble house of Cormyr , based in Suzail . The family were always outsiders at the Royal Court and had extensive landholdings and businesses in the Arabel area . The Marliirs and the Huntcrown s hated each other and were close to open conflict in the late 15th century DR . History . The Marliirs led the Marsemban infantry fighting with King Galaghard against the Witch - Lords in 900 DR . The house fought against Dhalmass Obarskyr in Marsember and was part of the Redlance Rising , and was in tax trouble since that time . The house also backed the regent Salember in a civil war . However , the family remained loyal to Azoun IV when Gondegal attempted to seize the throne in 1352 DR . The Marliirs were at one time the largest noble house in Arabel but this changed in 1396 DR when King Azoun V married Nalara Marliir and the house moved to Suzail . In the 15th century DR , the family ' s fortunes waned .

title: Marlin Stormserpent
description: Marlin Stormserpent Marlin Stormserpent was a young noble from Suzail and the only surviving male member of his family . History . In 1479 DR , Marlin schemed with Manshoon , whom he thought was a palace courtier named Lothrae , to acquire as many of the artifacts of The Nine as possible .
description_long: Marlin Stormserpent Marlin Stormserpent was a young noble from Suzail and the only surviving male member of his family . History . In 1479 DR , Marlin schemed with Manshoon , whom he thought was a palace courtier named Lothrae , to acquire as many of the artifacts of The Nine as possible . The spirits of several of The Nine were bound to objects and could be called forth by the objects ' owner to do his bidding . The Stormserpent family owned the " Flying Blade " and Marlin ' s older brother had stolen the " Wyverntongue Chalice " as a drunken prank and hid it in the Chamber of Wyms Ascending in the palace . Marlin retrieved the chalice from the palace with the help of his hirelings and , when he had possession of both items , called forth the spirits of Treth Halonter and Relve Langral and ordered them to kill a rival noble . The two spirits cut a bloody swath through Suzail much to the amusement of Manshoon . Marlin fled Suzail when the War Wizards discovered he was the noble controlling the Blueflame ghost s . He was slain by Cymmarraa at a hunting lodge and she took his Blueflame relics . Equipment .

title: Marlos Urnrayle
description: Marlos Urnrayle Marlos Urnrayle was the Prophet of Earth and the leader of the Cult of the Black Earth . Personality . He was genteel and well - spoken , but took pleasure in mocking others and could be driven to fits of blind , unreasoning jealousy .
description_long: Marlos Urnrayle Marlos Urnrayle was the Prophet of Earth and the leader of the Cult of the Black Earth . Personality . He was genteel and well - spoken , but took pleasure in mocking others and could be driven to fits of blind , unreasoning jealousy . Possessions . He wielded a magical war pick known as " Ironfang " . History . Marlos was born into a wealthy Cormyr ean family , but squandered his family ' s wealth on indulgence and luxury . His estate became known for the most depraved forms of entertainment , as well as outrageous masquerades — Marlos ' s vanity led him to require all guests to don hideous masks to ensure that none would be more beautiful than himself . As he got older , he sought to preserve his youth and looks with magic , eventually finding a ring containing the stolen vitality of a fey creature . So long as he wore the ring , his imperfections vanished and none could resist his charms . One day , however , the ring suddenly transformed Marlos into a medusa . Driven mad by his fate , he fled his family ' s home with his mask collection .

title: Marlowe
description: Marlowe Marlowe was a man living in the desolate town of Amkethran in Tethyr . He was once a merchant of Calimshan who desired wealth . He sought out the lich Vongoethe and struck a bargain with him : if Marlowe was given wealth and fortune , Marlowe would give Vongoethe his soul after a designated time .
description_long: Marlowe Marlowe was a man living in the desolate town of Amkethran in Tethyr . He was once a merchant of Calimshan who desired wealth . He sought out the lich Vongoethe and struck a bargain with him : if Marlowe was given wealth and fortune , Marlowe would give Vongoethe his soul after a designated time . But Marlowe , fearing for his life , fled with his daughter after his wife ' s death at Vongoethe ' s order . Gorion ' s Ward could meet Marlowe in the tavern in Amkethran , where Marlowe would ask them to meet him in his house atop the cliff . Marlowe tried to persuade the Gorion ' s Ward to kill Vongoethe , who had Marlowe ' s daughter ' s soul in his possession .

title: Marlspire of Najara
description: Marlspire of Najara The Marlspire of Najara , a crown given to the Najara n naga by the yuan - ti of the Hss ' tafi tribe in - 320 DR as a symbol of loyalty , was worn by Terpenzi and all successive kings through the reign of Jarant . Abilities . Far from being a mere symbol of office , the Marlspire had powerful magical capabilities ( some of which only functioned when it was worn by a reptile .
description_long: Marlspire of Najara The Marlspire of Najara , a crown given to the Najara n naga by the yuan - ti of the Hss ' tafi tribe in - 320 DR as a symbol of loyalty , was worn by Terpenzi and all successive kings through the reign of Jarant . Abilities . Far from being a mere symbol of office , the Marlspire had powerful magical capabilities ( some of which only functioned when it was worn by a reptile . ) If a non - reptile wore the Marlspire , that creature found itself more vulnerable to the attacks of reptiles .

title: Marlyn Lurraxol
description: Marlyn Lurraxol Marlyn " Luxor " Lurraxol was a human female and a barmaid at the Fierce Flumph tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . She was the niece of a member of the Lurraxol family of Athkatla , but was an outcast for some reason ( perhaps related to her arcane talent ) . She relocated to Eshpurta and was known to the locals as Luxor .
description_long: Marlyn Lurraxol Marlyn " Luxor " Lurraxol was a human female and a barmaid at the Fierce Flumph tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . She was the niece of a member of the Lurraxol family of Athkatla , but was an outcast for some reason ( perhaps related to her arcane talent ) . She relocated to Eshpurta and was known to the locals as Luxor . She was an ally of Sable , the Herald of Crimmor , Mikaal Krimmevol .

title: Marni Sobor
description: Marni Sobor Marni Sobor was a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Marni was studying as a wizard when in 1370 DR her mother was killed in a robbery and she inherited the shop .
description_long: Marni Sobor Marni Sobor was a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Marni was studying as a wizard when in 1370 DR her mother was killed in a robbery and she inherited the shop . Personality . Marni wanted nothing more than to go back to her magical studies and abandon the shop . However , she loved her brother and her sister and knew that they needed a good amount of money in order for them to live comfortably until she finished her three - year wizard training .

title: Marod el Arhapan
description: Marod el Arhapan Marod el Arhapan was the Pasha of Calimport in 1479 DR . His favorite pastime was staging gladiatorial games in his arena , an activity he preferred to actually ruling Calimport . The Pasha had a lavish floating palace that floated high above the arena .
description_long: Marod el Arhapan Marod el Arhapan was the Pasha of Calimport in 1479 DR . His favorite pastime was staging gladiatorial games in his arena , an activity he preferred to actually ruling Calimport . The Pasha had a lavish floating palace that floated high above the arena . History . Marod married an Earthsoul genasi named Valandra who had manifested as an Airsoul . She bore him a son whom they named Cephas . Valandra later angered Marod and he tricked his champion gladiator ( Azad ) into killing her in the arena . Azad later escaped Calimport with Cephas . Corvus Nightfeather discovered Cephas ' location and rescued him from Azad . He sent word to both Marod and the archmage el Jhotos that he had discovered the long lost heir of Calimport . Marod ' s vizar Shahrokh sent a troop of elite minotaur warriors to capture Cephas but they were defeated by Corvus and his allies . Later , Cephas and his friends were travelling through the Calim Desert when they were captured by Shahrokh and taken to Calimport . Marod reunited with Cephas and gave him a suite of rooms at the palace . Later , Cephas easily killed Marod and destroyed his palace and the arena .

title: Maroon Prince
description: Maroon Prince The Maroon Prince was a unique red dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Description . The Maroon Prince was a rare three headed dragon .
description_long: Maroon Prince The Maroon Prince was a unique red dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Description . The Maroon Prince was a rare three headed dragon . History . The Maroon Prince was a friend of the Green Duchess Orlarrakh , and she usually invited him to " dine " in Tarsith , one of the cities of the Dusk Ports . In 1479 DR , the Maroon Prince may have been killed , or at least poisoned and crippled with dragonbane amber , by a group of adventurers allied with the Scions of Amber and the Shadowkiss .

title: Maroth Marstel
description: Maroth Marstel Leader of the Marstel trading house , Maroth was the Harmach of Hulburg in 1479 DR . The shadowmage Rhovann dominated Maroth ' s will and turned him into his puppet . When Maroth ' s mind became too enfeebled for him to function as the Harmach , Rhovann killed Maroth and replaced him with a construct .
