title: Mass jump
description: Mass jump Mass jump was an arcane alteration spell that gave a group of creatures the ability to leap great distances for a short time . Effects . All creatures within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of the caster received this ability when " mass jump " was cast .
description_long: Mass jump Mass jump was an arcane alteration spell that gave a group of creatures the ability to leap great distances for a short time . Effects . All creatures within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of the caster received this ability when " mass jump " was cast . For the next few minutes , they could leap 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) straight up or forward in a low arc . Backward jumps were limited to 10 ft ( 3 m ) . Landing safely or grabbing onto something was the responsibility of the jumper . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the hind leg of a grasshopper to be broken at the time of casting . History . This spell was associated with the pirates roaming the Sea of Fallen Stars where they used it in boarding actions , jumping from ship to ship before they were close enough to grapple and heave to , giving the element of surprise against those that hadn ' t seen the maneuver before .

title: Mass sanctuary
description: Mass sanctuary Mass sanctuary ( alternately , " sancturary , mass " ) is an abjuration spell that prevents multiple subjects from attacking and from being attacked . It functions in the same manner as " sanctuary " . Only cleric s with the Balance domain can use this spell .
description_long: Mass sanctuary Mass sanctuary ( alternately , " sancturary , mass " ) is an abjuration spell that prevents multiple subjects from attacking and from being attacked . It functions in the same manner as " sanctuary " . Only cleric s with the Balance domain can use this spell .

title: Mass snowshoes
description: Mass snowshoes Mass snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It cast the " snowshoes " spell on a group of creatures . Effects .
description_long: Mass snowshoes Mass snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It cast the " snowshoes " spell on a group of creatures . Effects . This spell could be cast at a creature or group of creatures up to 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) away ( higher level casters could extend this range ) . It affected a number of creatures determined by the caster ' s level , and that fit within a 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) diameter circle or other regular shape as long as no two individuals were more than 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) apart . The recipients were able to travel unhindered over icy or snowy terrain for a few hours as per the " snowshoes " spell . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . History . This spell was believed to be recorded in a holy book of Auril called " Revelations of the Icedawn " and was granted to her cleric s , druid s , and ranger s .

title: Master ' s Library
description: Master ' s Library The Master ' s Library was a temple of Deneir on Iron Dragon Mountain in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the greatest depository of books on Abeir - Toril and the site where the Metatext was pieced together . History .
description_long: Master ' s Library The Master ' s Library was a temple of Deneir on Iron Dragon Mountain in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the greatest depository of books on Abeir - Toril and the site where the Metatext was pieced together . History . Iron Dragon Mountain was once the lair of the mist dragon Ouranalathra the Mistmaiden , but later became the site of the Master ' s Library . Inhabitants . The Master ' s Library was home to about sixty High Librarian s , the highest ranking and most ancient members of the Deneirrath clergy . In the late 1360s and 1370s DR , they were led by Librarian Supreme Haliduth Orspriir . He and the other High Librarians could read any known written language . The greatest number of truenamer s devoted to Deneir could also be found here . Many of them worked on the Metatext . Defense . The location of both Iron Dragon Mountain and the Master ' s Library was generally unknown . It was supported by the Reading Room , a small stronghold far to the south that most pilgrims visited .

title: Master Harper
description: Master Harper Master Harper is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn , whose members are elite agents of the Harpers . They study spells and develop many skills to help them in their duties of preserving lore by imparting it to others , raising morale and aiding other members of the Harpers as well as others who promote similar aims . Many master Harpers are bard s , but by no means all are .
description_long: Master Harper Master Harper is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn , whose members are elite agents of the Harpers . They study spells and develop many skills to help them in their duties of preserving lore by imparting it to others , raising morale and aiding other members of the Harpers as well as others who promote similar aims . Many master Harpers are bard s , but by no means all are . Ranger s , sorcerer s , wizard s , loremaster s , and Harper agent s often also become master Harpers . All have a love of accurate information ( particularly old or secret lore ) and of verifying , changing and sharing it . Not all longtime Harpers are master Harpers and rank within the Harpers doesn ' t depend on class or level , but many senior Harpers have at least one level in the master Harper prestige class . Abilities . Master Harpers could communicate by mean of a special sign language known as harpspeak . Ex - Masters . It is possible for Master Harpers to violate the code of the Harpers or intentionally turn away from the society . Such an individual quickly gains a bad reputation among other Harpers and can no longer use any of the divine blessings ( such as Oghma ' s Echo ) .

title: Master Tactician
description: Master Tactician Master Tactician : Spells from the Church of the Red Knight is a web enhancement for the Forgotten Realms about a tactics manual cum spellbook that adds three new cleric and paladin spells . Description of " Master Tactician " . " Master Tactician " is considered a holy text by the Red Fellowship ( the official name of the Red Knight ' s church ) .
description_long: Master Tactician Master Tactician : Spells from the Church of the Red Knight is a web enhancement for the Forgotten Realms about a tactics manual cum spellbook that adds three new cleric and paladin spells . Description of " Master Tactician " . " Master Tactician " is considered a holy text by the Red Fellowship ( the official name of the Red Knight ' s church ) . For the most part it is a manual of tactics , and it was made to resemble " The Red Book of War " , a holy text of the church of Tempus .

title: Master Wraith
description: Master Wraith The Master Wraith was a powerful undead wraith that lived in the Forest of Mir and fed on the souls of the living . Though it was a formidable opponent in combat and commanded a number of lesser undead , it could also use its shapechanging and telepathic abilities to psychologically weaken its prey , to persuade them to surrender . The Master Wraith was destroyed in 1369 DR when it confronted Gorion ' s Ward in front of an old temple of Bhaal in the forest .
description_long: Master Wraith The Master Wraith was a powerful undead wraith that lived in the Forest of Mir and fed on the souls of the living . Though it was a formidable opponent in combat and commanded a number of lesser undead , it could also use its shapechanging and telepathic abilities to psychologically weaken its prey , to persuade them to surrender . The Master Wraith was destroyed in 1369 DR when it confronted Gorion ' s Ward in front of an old temple of Bhaal in the forest . It took on the deceased Gorion ' s form and accused his foster child of forgetting his teachings , asking them to willingly give up their life . When this plan failed , the Wraith and its minions were forced to attack head - on , and were destroyed in the ensuing combat .

title: Master infiltrator
description: Master infiltrator Master infiltrators are rogue s highly trained at , as their name implies , sneaking into and out of locations or situations . Master infiltrators might serves as spies , assassin s , scout s , or sniper s , moving silently through and out of peril unnoticed . In order to assist them in this , master infiltrators take on a variety of abilities that make them elusive prey and deadly predators .
description_long: Master infiltrator Master infiltrators are rogue s highly trained at , as their name implies , sneaking into and out of locations or situations . Master infiltrators might serves as spies , assassin s , scout s , or sniper s , moving silently through and out of peril unnoticed . In order to assist them in this , master infiltrators take on a variety of abilities that make them elusive prey and deadly predators . Abilities . Infiltrating takes more than stealth and guile , though these are undoubtedly important , and master infiltrators have a number of other abilities to help them in their chosen line of work . This includes an aptitude for acrobatics and athletic pursuits as well as for stealth , which help to get an infiltrator out of - or into - sticky situations . Early on master infiltrators learn to keep moving , never staying still for long if they can help it , so as to avoid detection . With more advanced training , master infiltrators learn to become effectively , if not " actually " , invisible , disappearing from sight immediately after dealing a deadly blow , frustrating their remaining foes . The exploit s learned by master infiltrators have a similar purpose .

title: Master undead
description: Master undead Master undead was an arcane necromancy spell that took precise control over one or more undead creatures , allowing them to perform complex tasks . This spell was once known by the name control undead but that name has come to belong to another spell , similar to but less powerful than " master undead " . Effects .
description_long: Master undead Master undead was an arcane necromancy spell that took precise control over one or more undead creatures , allowing them to perform complex tasks . This spell was once known by the name control undead but that name has come to belong to another spell , similar to but less powerful than " master undead " . Effects . The earliest version of this spell had a minimum range of 180 ft ( 55 m ) and the caster could control a number of undead creatures equal to his or her caster level . If there were more than that available within range , which creatures became minions was a matter of chance . The undead had multiple chances to resist the magic of this spell , but were at a tremendous disadvantage to do so at first . As time went on , each minion was increasingly likely to break control , until they ultimately did , or the spell expired . This version of the spell lasted at least 18 minutes . The later version of " master undead " had the same range as the previous one , but worked on all undead in a 50 - ft ( 15 - m ) cube within that range .

title: Mastering of Amahl V
description: Mastering of Amahl V Mastering of Amahl V was the name given to a " shoonring " that was part of the treasure hoard of the great blue wyrm Iryklathagra . It may have been one of the " Qysari Rings " made for members of the Shoon Dynasty . Description .
description_long: Mastering of Amahl V Mastering of Amahl V was the name given to a " shoonring " that was part of the treasure hoard of the great blue wyrm Iryklathagra . It may have been one of the " Qysari Rings " made for members of the Shoon Dynasty . Description . The name came from Qysara Shaani who offered the ring and many other treasures from the vaults of the Shoon Imperium to Iryklathagra in order to placate the dragon . Powers . This ring was reportedly a " ring of efreeti calling " which summoned an efreet just as a " ring of djinni calling " summoned a djinn . If this ring had additional powers , they were not generally known . If other powers were to be discovered , then this ring would certainly live up to the title of " Qysari Ring " . History . This ring was attributed to Amahl Shoon V but only one " Mastering " was generally known and it was made for his brother Amahl Shoon IV and was lost at the time of his death . This ring was given to the blue wyrm Iryklathagra as part of a bargain made between the dragon and the scions of the Shoon Dynasty .

title: Mastraero
description: Mastraero Mastraero was a mage from the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Mastraero once played chess with an unwashed sailor in The Salty Dog tavern in Ravens Bluff — and lost . In his rage , he turned every witness into a snail , but missed his opponent , who turned out to be Ambassador Carrague of Ravens Bluff .
description_long: Mastraero Mastraero was a mage from the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Mastraero once played chess with an unwashed sailor in The Salty Dog tavern in Ravens Bluff — and lost . In his rage , he turned every witness into a snail , but missed his opponent , who turned out to be Ambassador Carrague of Ravens Bluff . Carrague promptly restored everyone ' s proper forms , and they got their revenge , forcing Mastraero to consume 10 pounds ( 0 . 45 kilograms ) of salt . Mastraero survived the experience , albeit in poor health .

title: Masud Jazayir
description: Masud Jazayir Masud Jazayir , or the Fortunate Isles , was a group of islands located along the northern tip of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . This group of islands represented the farthest outpost of Zakhara ns into the Crowded Sea . Geography .
description_long: Masud Jazayir Masud Jazayir , or the Fortunate Isles , was a group of islands located along the northern tip of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . This group of islands represented the farthest outpost of Zakhara ns into the Crowded Sea . Geography . All of the islands within this group were low , rolling rock formations . Streams and natural springs fed their fertile vales . Many small settlements dotted the coast of Masud Jazayir . Inhabitants . Many of the islands ' inhabitants were descendants of outlaws , rebels , and other malcontents . They still followed the Law of the Loregiver , but abided by looser interpretations . Natives were call " Masudi . " Trade . Inhabitants of Masud Jazayir produced almonds , sesame seeds , dates , sugar cane , grapes , pomegranates , citrons , figs , and cotton . Livestock was also kept in the form of goats , sheep , and cattle .

title: Masudi
description: Masudi Masudi was a Semphari caravan master traveling the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Personality . Because of his belief in the set of laws known as muhjari , Masudi was a strict individual .
description_long: Masudi Masudi was a Semphari caravan master traveling the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Personality . Because of his belief in the set of laws known as muhjari , Masudi was a strict individual . He fully believed in the practice of abstinence , fasting , and avoiding all physical pleasure . As such , he expected any who traveled with his caravan to follow the same rules . He would not tolerate others to worship " false gods " in his presence . History . Masuid made his home in Dhaztanar .

title: Masulk ' s Tomb
description: Masulk ' s Tomb Masulk ' s Tomb was the burial place of Masulk the Magnificent located in the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tomb was hidden by trees , shrubs and climbing plants , so it was hard to locate .
description_long: Masulk ' s Tomb Masulk ' s Tomb was the burial place of Masulk the Magnificent located in the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tomb was hidden by trees , shrubs and climbing plants , so it was hard to locate . History . Masulk was a vizar stricken by a terrible and incurable disease . After he died , Masulk ' s servants dug the tomb as ordered by the master himself , where his flying carpet came to rest . Masulk wanted to be buried with no coins , but with all the magic he ' d accumulated during his lifetime .

title: Masyr
description: Masyr Masyr was a wizard and businessman of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . Though he owned both the Green Sash Tavern & Pleasure House and the Green Rings Trading Company , Masyr was always short on coin .
description_long: Masyr Masyr was a wizard and businessman of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . Though he owned both the Green Sash Tavern & Pleasure House and the Green Rings Trading Company , Masyr was always short on coin . As a skilled invoker , he tutored students in order to supplement his income .

title: Matasuuri Nagahide
description: Matasuuri Nagahide Matasuuri Nagahide was the ruling shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Nagahide was the most successful shogun of Wa .
description_long: Matasuuri Nagahide Matasuuri Nagahide was the ruling shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Nagahide was the most successful shogun of Wa . He ruled over a pacified land using a subtle approach instead of resolving all issues with the sword like his grandfather , Matasuuri Shogoro . His ruling style was all analysis and hidden control . He suffered from headaches and he brooded incessantly , however . Personality . Nagahide was a cunning strategist , a brilliant general , and a spellbinding speaker . He was a patient , decisive , and utterly humorless individual . He believed his headaches were the gods ' punishment for having thoughts not specifically pertaining to the welfare of the state . Nagahide was obsessed with order and showed no mercy to anyone .

title: Matasuuri Unteki
description: Matasuuri Unteki Matasuuri Unteki was the younger brother of the shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Unteki was the daimyo of Iiso and one of the Three House daimyos , being so one of the most powerful man in Wa .
description_long: Matasuuri Unteki Matasuuri Unteki was the younger brother of the shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Unteki was the daimyo of Iiso and one of the Three House daimyos , being so one of the most powerful man in Wa . Unteki was also one of the most hated . He was known in all Wa for his crazed edicts , like the one for honor the dead of his dog . However the land prospered thank to the bureaucrats send by Matasuuri Nagahide in Unteki ' s administration , Unteki not took care of public affairs . He was too busy producing and performing in kabuki and noh plays . Personality . Unteki was shaggy - haired , pencil - thin , neurotic , pompous , greedy , and ruthless . His politics were driven by paranoia rather than reason . Unteki was prone to wild mood swings ; the song of a child sends him into giggling ecstasy , the sight of a dead fly reduced him to sobbing despair . However Unteki considered himself an artistic type .

title: Mather Ukkhemn
description: Mather Ukkhemn Mather Ukkhemn was a merchant and a member of the Knights of the Shield in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mather was an egoistical individual .
description_long: Mather Ukkhemn Mather Ukkhemn was a merchant and a member of the Knights of the Shield in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mather was an egoistical individual . He strongly advocated for the Knights to take a more proactive role in Waterdeep ' s businesses but was soon in fear that his bosses would discover his role in the demise of Nindil Jalbuck . History . Mather was a merchant and occasional slaver from Tethyr and often in Waterdeep for business . Once , he stayed at the Yawning Portal with a pair of slaves , thus earning the ire of Durnan . From that time on , Mather adopted a low profile in his visits to the city . For a long time , he tried to convince fellow Knights to put one of their own among the Lords of Waterdeep . Finally , First Shield Lord Inselm Hhune told him the name of a probable Lord : Nindil Jalbuck . However , Bly Ruldegost , Mather ' s immediate superior in Waterdeep , forbade him to act against Nindil . So Mather sold the Lord ' s name to the Unseen for money . Afterward , he was terrified that Bly or Hlune would discover his treasonous act .

title: Matherly Harpell
description: Matherly Harpell Matherly Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . He made a mistake in a magical experiment and ended up becoming petrified . By 1356 DR , Matherly was one of the statues of the Ivy Mansion .
description_long: Matherly Harpell Matherly Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . He made a mistake in a magical experiment and ended up becoming petrified . By 1356 DR , Matherly was one of the statues of the Ivy Mansion .

title: Mathira Melarn
description: Mathira Melarn Mathira Melarn was an Eilistraee an sword dancer from Ched Nasad who wielded the Crescent Blade . History . Mathira Melarn was a member of the Ched Nasadan House Melarn .
description_long: Mathira Melarn Mathira Melarn was an Eilistraee an sword dancer from Ched Nasad who wielded the Crescent Blade . History . Mathira Melarn was a member of the Ched Nasadan House Melarn . There was a broken bust of Mathira in House Melarn ' s great hall . At some point , she joined the worshipers of Eilistraee and became a sword dancer . She wielded the Crescent Blade , a sword said to be created by Eilistraee for the purpose of destroying Lolth . Mathira was last seen in Harrowdale , making her way to Black Feather Bridge . She was burned to death on the Cold Field by acid from a black dragon . She then became a ghost , who appeared to her descendant , Halisstra Melarn , in 1373 DR as she sought the Crescent Blade .

title: Mathlin
description: Mathlin The Mathlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mathlins were allied with the Aldimer and Uruthkurt families .
description_long: Mathlin The Mathlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mathlins were allied with the Aldimer and Uruthkurt families .

title: Matliedun
description: Matliedun Matliedun was a cambion priest in Maerimydra . Activities . Matliedun was responsible for the temple security but was usually busy gambling .
description_long: Matliedun Matliedun was a cambion priest in Maerimydra . Activities . Matliedun was responsible for the temple security but was usually busy gambling . History . As of 1491 DR , Matliedun was the master of the Undying Temple and served under Squallocks , the vrock advisor to Graz ' zt . When the allied factions attacked Maerimydra , Matliedun led a patrol of drow warriors to reinforce the defenses if the alarm sounded . Relashionship . Matliedun was a son of the demon lord Graz ' zt and one of his concubines .

title: Matrud
description: Matrud Matruds were outcast thieves of the desert in Zakhara . They lived for revenge and survival . Requirements .
description_long: Matrud Matruds were outcast thieves of the desert in Zakhara . They lived for revenge and survival . Requirements . Only thieves could be matruds . Role . Matruds could be found anywhere in Zakhara . Those inhabiting the deserts were typically horse thieves . Most matruds were transients , moving from place to place hoping to find work that would also let them steal . Possessions . Matruds usually only owned what they could carry on their back . Hindrances . These individuals were outcasts , and their plight was obvious to nearly all who interacted with them . While in the desert , other individuals often looked down at them . This did not happen as much when they were within urban settings .

title: Matruda al - Muhif
description: Matruda al - Muhif Matruda al - Muhif was a holy slayer and member of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Matruda separated herself from the other members of the Fellowship , gaining well - earned infamy throughout the Land of Fate .
description_long: Matruda al - Muhif Matruda al - Muhif was a holy slayer and member of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Matruda separated herself from the other members of the Fellowship , gaining well - earned infamy throughout the Land of Fate . Relationships . Matruda was a close ally of Kerima al - Zahir of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Skills . In addition to her martial prowess , Matruda was a master of disguise .

title: Matsue Fusu
description: Matsue Fusu Matsue Fusu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and overseer of Gomen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Gomen , the largest fishing village of the Tara - gawa Basin area , he led a company of five samurai and fifteen bushi .
description_long: Matsue Fusu Matsue Fusu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and overseer of Gomen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Gomen , the largest fishing village of the Tara - gawa Basin area , he led a company of five samurai and fifteen bushi . Fusu oversaw a strategic area , bordered by a shoen of the Hori clan and one of the Tsu family .

title: Matt James
description: Matt James Matt James is an award - winning game designer and current freelancer for Wizards of the Coast , producing articles , content , and game design for the Forgotten Realms . He has been a contributing author to many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks and has done work for Open Design ( Kobold Quarterly ) as well as Pathfinder RPG ( Paizo ) . Matt is the younger brother of Brian R .
description_long: Matt James Matt James is an award - winning game designer and current freelancer for Wizards of the Coast , producing articles , content , and game design for the Forgotten Realms . He has been a contributing author to many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks and has done work for Open Design ( Kobold Quarterly ) as well as Pathfinder RPG ( Paizo ) . Matt is the younger brother of Brian R . James , a fellow Realmslore guru . Both are very active members of the community and have been dedicated fans of Forgotten Realms since its first publication . Matt James ' s first Forgotten Realms piece was published in Dungeon Magazine # 170 with the adventure titled " Monument of the Ancients " . This Moonsea North adventure is based around Phlan and is designed for 13th level characters . The adventure is credited with having a lot of small references to the original SSI computer game Pool of Radiance . Since its publication , Matt has contributed to a variety of articles for both Dungeon Magainze and Dragon Magazine , and has co - authored several Dungeons & Dragons source - books .

title: Mattias Farseer
description: Mattias Farseer Mattias Farseer was a ranger and long - time companion of the wyvern Trill . He travelled for many years with the Kenku assassin Corvus Nightfeather and his Circus of Wonders . Corvus considers Mattias to be one of the best archers who ever lived .
description_long: Mattias Farseer Mattias Farseer was a ranger and long - time companion of the wyvern Trill . He travelled for many years with the Kenku assassin Corvus Nightfeather and his Circus of Wonders . Corvus considers Mattias to be one of the best archers who ever lived . History . Mattias was born in north Faerûn and received an education at various schools in the Silver Marches . He decided to become a ranger rather than a scholar and was assisting villagers whose livestock were poached by a wyvern when he shot and killed the beast from a great distance . While walking through the forest later he came upon the wyvern ' s nest and the young fledgling . The little wyvern attacked him but he didn ' t kill it , instead preferring to subdue it with his bare hands . He was grieviously wounded in the battle but after he recovered he began feeding the baby wyvern . They became close friends and Mattias rode the wyvern in his act in Corvus ' circus . Corvus travelled with Corvus and Cephas to Almraiven where he helped Cephas ' and his friends escape the city .

title: Mattick Tanthul
description: Mattick Tanthul Prince Mattick Tanthul of Thultanthar , the City of Shade , was the twin brother of Prince Vattick Tanthul . Relationships . He was two minutes elder than his brother .
description_long: Mattick Tanthul Prince Mattick Tanthul of Thultanthar , the City of Shade , was the twin brother of Prince Vattick Tanthul . Relationships . He was two minutes elder than his brother . Both had black hair and eyes and were perfect replicas of one another — only their parents could distinguish one from the other . Mattick and Vattick used this to perpetrate innumerable conspiracies and jokes , some benign and others much less so , on the royal household since their early childhood . They were inseparable and were rarely found at great distance from one another . Mattick and Vattick divided their time between research at the academy of alchemy and helping Brennus Tanthul seek out clues to the locations of old Netherese sites . Personality . Mattick and Vattick sided with Brennus and Hadrhune in supporting the swift destruction off all threats to Shade´s rule . Lore . Prince Mattick ' s personal sigil was a pair of interlocking gold rings , outlined in purple on a charcoal gray field .

title: Maugrim Korothir
description: Maugrim Korothir Servant of Morag ( second in command ) , Maugrim unleashed the Wailing Death upon Neverwinter and , being one of Morag ' s elites , plays a large role in the masterminding of the attack on Neverwinter . The main character defeats him in " Neverwinter Nights " shortly after he performs a ritual to bring his mistress Morag out of her magical stasis . This results in his banishment to Cania .
description_long: Maugrim Korothir Servant of Morag ( second in command ) , Maugrim unleashed the Wailing Death upon Neverwinter and , being one of Morag ' s elites , plays a large role in the masterminding of the attack on Neverwinter . The main character defeats him in " Neverwinter Nights " shortly after he performs a ritual to bring his mistress Morag out of her magical stasis . This results in his banishment to Cania . The hero of the expansion campaigns has to kill him in " " when Maugrim is encountered as one of Grimgnaw ' s followers during Grimgnaw ' s attempt at conquering that realm .

title: Mauj
description: Mauj Mauj was a reef giant living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Mauj was short for his race standing 15 ft .
description_long: Mauj Mauj was a reef giant living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Mauj was short for his race standing 15 ft . ( 4 . 6 m ) tall . He had the look of a terrifying monster which contradicted his intelligent and wise nature . Activities . Mauj worked as an enforcer for the moneylenders of Gana . He preferred to solve problems without bloodshed .

title: Maul
description: Maul A maul ( or mall ) is a heavy , long - handled hammer used for splitting a piece of wood along its grain , or as a two - handed , martial , melee weapon . Description . One side of it is similar to a warhammer and the other side is much like an axe .
description_long: Maul A maul ( or mall ) is a heavy , long - handled hammer used for splitting a piece of wood along its grain , or as a two - handed , martial , melee weapon . Description . One side of it is similar to a warhammer and the other side is much like an axe . A typical maul for wood splitting will have a head weighing in the region of 20lbs ( 9kg ) and an overall length comparable to a greataxe . An average maul can be bought for 15gp . Weaponology . Mauls have a wedge - shaped head and the cutting side resembles an axe but with a thicker , blunter blade . For splitting wood , this tool is much better than a typical axe . The weight of it is more advantageous and due to its width , it ' s difficult for it to become stuck in the wood . When used in combat , this heavy weapon is wielded in two hands . Realmslore . Mauls are known to be favored by dwarves .

title: Maulygh
description: Maulygh Maulygh was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Maulygh was a master wizard from Unther who was hired by the prince Felodar Aumar in Calimshan to fight the magelords of Athalantar .
description_long: Maulygh Maulygh was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Maulygh was a master wizard from Unther who was hired by the prince Felodar Aumar in Calimshan to fight the magelords of Athalantar . However , Maulygh quickly joined the ranks of the magelords instead . In a fatal dinner in Hastarl in 229 DR , he was one of the magelords killed by the Magister together with Neldryn Hawklyn .

title: Maurezhi
description: Maurezhi The maurezhi are horrifying demon s that consume the souls of mortal creatures and have the ability to take the forms of those they ' ve consumed . Thus , they make perfect spies and assassins , usually . Unfortunately ( or fortunately ) , most maurezhi never make it out of the Abyss and never get a chance to feed on any hapless mortal creatures , thus most of them never get a chance to become the perfect spy or assassin before the babau or the molydeus ship them off to the Blood War frontlines .
description_long: Maurezhi The maurezhi are horrifying demon s that consume the souls of mortal creatures and have the ability to take the forms of those they ' ve consumed . Thus , they make perfect spies and assassins , usually . Unfortunately ( or fortunately ) , most maurezhi never make it out of the Abyss and never get a chance to feed on any hapless mortal creatures , thus most of them never get a chance to become the perfect spy or assassin before the babau or the molydeus ship them off to the Blood War frontlines . Those maurezhi that do manage to get out of the Abyss to eat some mortals , usually return to become small abyssal powers or specialized servants of the Blood War effort . Maurezhi are 6 foot tall and weigh 180 pounds . Physical Description . In its natural form , a maurezhi strongly resembles an ordinary ghoul . Its hunched and gaunt body has the pallor of death . Its ears are long and pointed , and its mouth is full of serrated teeth for rending flesh . Its elongated fingers end in wicked claws , and its muscular legs , which resemble those of a big cat , allows it to run quickly and pounce on its prey . Combat .

title: Mauzzkyl Jaezred
description: Mauzzkyl Jaezred Mauzzkyl Jaezred was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron grandfather of the Jaezred Chaulssin as well as its founder . Description . Mauzzkyl preferred use the drow form , appearing as hale old man with broad shoulders , a wide chest , and thinning hair forming a widow ' s peak .
description_long: Mauzzkyl Jaezred Mauzzkyl Jaezred was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron grandfather of the Jaezred Chaulssin as well as its founder . Description . Mauzzkyl preferred use the drow form , appearing as hale old man with broad shoulders , a wide chest , and thinning hair forming a widow ' s peak . His daughter Nurvureem was explicitly described as a black dragon with ties to the Shadowfell , making her father Mauzzkyl ' s dragon form also that of a black dragon . Personality . As a member , actually the leader , of the Jaezred Chaulssin , he gave reverence to Vhaeraun . While he did refer to the deity as his master and also seemed to put some value to Vhaeraun ' s favor , religion never ruled over him . Mauzzkyl at his core was a rebel , he couldn ’ t tolerate any person , organization , or even deity who would claim power over him . This part of his personality showed in his hatred for his shadow dragon ancestors , who enslaved him and his people until 634 DR , and in his hatred towards Lolth , and also his refusal to turn the Jaezred Chaulssin into a private army of assassins of the church of Vhaeraun .

title: Mavin ' s create volcano
description: Mavin ' s create volcano Mavin ' s create volcano was a 10th - level Arcanist spell created in the days of Netheril . Effects . Casting " Mavin ' s create volcano " caused a minor earthquake to erupt in the desired area .
description_long: Mavin ' s create volcano Mavin ' s create volcano was a 10th - level Arcanist spell created in the days of Netheril . Effects . Casting " Mavin ' s create volcano " caused a minor earthquake to erupt in the desired area . After a week ’ s time , ash and smoke exploded from the earth and , within a month , the mountain site would erupt into a powerful volcano . Drawbacks . The spell was never cast in Netheril ‚ but every arcanist sought the knowledge to conjure a devastating volcano , but they were stilted due to the terrifying effects the spell would have had on the ground - dwelling creatures , such as dwarves and elves . Components . The components needed for this spell were a mantle of sewn diamond s which acted like a ring of fire resistance , a helm of brilliance , and a mythallar , which was placed at the location of the volcano . History . The spell was created by Mavin around - 601 DR ( 3258 NY ) . This spell could no longer be cast due to the restrictions placed on magic by Mystra after the near cataclysmic destruction of the Weave by the casting of " Karsus ' s avatar " in - 339 DR ( 3520 NY ) .

title: Mavin ' s earthfast
description: Mavin ' s earthfast Mavin ' s earthfast was a 10th - level Arcanist spell used in the days of Netheril . Effects . The spell was originally created to allow continued mining of areas that would otherwise be too dangerous to mine .
description_long: Mavin ' s earthfast Mavin ' s earthfast was a 10th - level Arcanist spell used in the days of Netheril . Effects . The spell was originally created to allow continued mining of areas that would otherwise be too dangerous to mine . A casting of " Mavin ' s earthfast " made large areas of underground tunnels impervious to cave - ins and similar disasters . Its use was later adapted to preserve important areas of cities . Components . The components needed for this spell were a stone of controlling earth elementals , six chardalyn s ( each imbued with transmute mud to rock ) , and an earth elemental . History . The spell was created by Mavin around - 510 DR ( 3349 NY ) However , after the near - cataclysmic destruction of the Weave caused by the casting of " Karsus ' s avatar " in - 339 DR ( 3520 NY ) and the subsequent restrictions placed on magic by Mystra , the spell could no longer be cast .

title: Maw of stone
description: Maw of stone Maw of stone is a transmutation spell unique to cleric s with the Cavern domain . It animates a natural opening or chamber . Effect .
description_long: Maw of stone Maw of stone is a transmutation spell unique to cleric s with the Cavern domain . It animates a natural opening or chamber . Effect . You cause a single natural opening or natural chamber to become animated . The opening or chamber cannot move , but it can attack . You can order it to attack any creature , or a specific type of creature . You also can order it to attack under a specific circumstance , such as when creatures try to leave or when they touch something . An animated opening can only attack creatures that try to move through it . An animated chamber can attack every creature inside . Only one " maw of stone " can be in effect on a particular opening or chamber at a time . The animated opening or chamber has a Strength score of 30 and an attack bonus equal to your level + your Wisdom modifier + 7 for its Strength . If it has any single dimension ( height , length , or width ) of 8 feet or more , it has a - 1 size penalty on attack rolls for being Large . An animated opening can make one grapple attack each round against a creature passing through .

title: Maw of the God Swallower
description: Maw of the God Swallower The Maw of the God Swallower was an oblong - shaped region of utter annihilation in southern Chessenta in the late 15th century DR . Along the edges , the ground crumbled away and the sky was dark . In the interior of the region , the land fell away into a void and the primordial Entropy hung in the exact center of the void .
description_long: Maw of the God Swallower The Maw of the God Swallower was an oblong - shaped region of utter annihilation in southern Chessenta in the late 15th century DR . Along the edges , the ground crumbled away and the sky was dark . In the interior of the region , the land fell away into a void and the primordial Entropy hung in the exact center of the void .

title: Maxer Hlarr
description: Maxer Hlarr Maxer Hlarr , the Defender of Suzail , was a wizard who lived in Cormyr ' s captial in 1367 DR . Personality . Maxer was a recluse who enjoyed peace and quiet .
description_long: Maxer Hlarr Maxer Hlarr , the Defender of Suzail , was a wizard who lived in Cormyr ' s captial in 1367 DR . Personality . Maxer was a recluse who enjoyed peace and quiet . Activities . Maxer ' s passion revolved around building unique magical constructs which he sent into dungeons and ruins in search of magical items . History . King Azoun Obarskyr IV personally awarded Maxer his title after the wizard successfully defended Suzail against four dragon s who attacked at the same time . Maxer ' s attacks tilted the battle , saving Suzail ' s failing mages so they were able to defeat the dragons . Possessions . Due to the impressive success of his magical constructs , Maxer had access to a veritable horde of magical items , making him particularly dangerous if threatened .

title: Maximanus Tholl
description: Maximanus Tholl Maximanus Tholl was a Chondathan human male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a captain of the Purple Dragons contingent there . History . Maximanus Tholl was a warrior of the Purple Dragons of Cormyr .
description_long: Maximanus Tholl Maximanus Tholl was a Chondathan human male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a captain of the Purple Dragons contingent there . History . Maximanus Tholl was a warrior of the Purple Dragons of Cormyr . Although young and inexperienced , he rose to the rank of constal and became the captain of the 150 - strong Purple Dragon contingent in Wheloon by 1374 DR . Early in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , a new temple of Mystra was constructed in Wheloon . Following reports of unusual lights and sounds there , the Purple Dragons made a cursory inspection . In early Eleint , Tunaster Dranik , a priest of Mystra , spoke to Constal Tholl about his suspicions about the temple , but he said he found no problem . Tunaster suspected that Maximanus was reluctant to delve deeper as Lord Sarp Redbeard enjoyed the revenue from the temple too much . When adventurer s uncovered Shar ran cultists operating in the temple instead , Tholl had his Purple Dragons conduct a more thorough investigation . He then escorted the adventurers to an audience with Lord Redbeard . Personality .

title: May T ' ang Lien
description: May T ' ang Lien May T ' ang Lien was a hengeyokai wu jen adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Lien ' s goal was knowledge , she wanted to know all .
description_long: May T ' ang Lien May T ' ang Lien was a hengeyokai wu jen adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Lien ' s goal was knowledge , she wanted to know all . This for Lien would be also a demonstration of the equality of men and women , a idea she firmly believed . However , Lien posed as an poor and innocent female to trick her enemies . History . May T ' ang Lien born among the mountain of Arakin province . She first studied wu jen arts alone in Mount Dowmai but in time Lien understood the need of good teachers . She studied with many experience wu jen and for a time she was even student of the ancient and powerful Nan Wu of the Tsui Tong . In 1358 DR , Lien decided to attent the Komite . Appendix . Behind the scenes . May T ' ang Lien was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Shou Lung .

title: Maya Do ' Urden
description: Maya Do ' Urden Maya Do ' Urden was the youngest daughter of Malice Do ' Urden and a priestess of Lolth in House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Maya was slender but strong , stronger than her brother Drizzt .
description_long: Maya Do ' Urden Maya Do ' Urden was the youngest daughter of Malice Do ' Urden and a priestess of Lolth in House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Maya was slender but strong , stronger than her brother Drizzt . History . Maya was the youngest of the three daughters of Malice Do ' Urden . In 1297 DR , when House Do ' Urden attacked House DeVir , Maya was connected to her brother Nalfein Do ' Urden and felt the moment he died . She notified her family , thus saving newborn Drizzt Do ' Urden , who was about to be sacrificed due to his status as the third living son . However , with Nalfein ' s death , Drizzt was spared , as he was then the second living son . Maya was involved in Drizzt ' s first test to teach him the way of the drow : Maya brought her " champion , " Byuchyuch ( a goblin transformed into a drow warrior ] ] , to challenge Drizzt . Drizzt defeated Byuchyuch easily , but was forced to kill him . Maya then attacked him with her mace ; he struck her back and was severely punished because males were not allowed to ever strike females . Possessions . Maya wielded a mace and shield . Relationships .

title: Mayne
description: Mayne Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff when the lizardmen attacked the boats .
description_long: Mayne Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff when the lizardmen attacked the boats . He tasked the Kalach - Cha to resolve the situation . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve defeated the lizard tribe ( when Slaan leads the Kalach - Cha to the cave they inhabit ) , or persuade the tribe to stop the attacks and join Highcliff . If the tribe was persuaded to join Highcliff , after the King of Shadows began his attack , the lizardmen occupied the town . Mayne asked of Kalach - Cha to save the village , to speak with the lizardmen ' s shaman .

title: Maze
description: Maze Maze is a conjuration spell that traps the subject in an extradimensional maze . Effects . You conjure up an extradimensional labyrinth of force planes , and the subject vanishes into it .
description_long: Maze Maze is a conjuration spell that traps the subject in an extradimensional maze . Effects . You conjure up an extradimensional labyrinth of force planes , and the subject vanishes into it . If the subject attempts to escape , the time it takes to find the way out depends on its Intelligence score : If the subject doesn ' t attempt to escape , the maze disappears after 10 minutes , forcing the subject to leave . On leaving the maze , the subject reappears in the spot it had been in when the " maze " spell was cast . If this spot is filled with a solid object , the subject appears nearby . Spells and abilities that move a creature within a plane , such as " teleport " and " dimension door " , do not help a creature escape a " maze " spell , although a " plane shift " spell allows it to exit to whatever plane is designated in that spell . Minotaur s are not affected by this spell .

title: Maze Engine
description: Maze Engine The Maze Engine was a powerful artifact capable of reshaping reality itself . Modron s called it The Orderer , as its function was to bring order to chaos . It resembled an enormous working model of the Great Wheel .
description_long: Maze Engine The Maze Engine was a powerful artifact capable of reshaping reality itself . Modron s called it The Orderer , as its function was to bring order to chaos . It resembled an enormous working model of the Great Wheel . Powers . As it was capable of altering the fabric of reality , its possible uses were virtually infinite . Some examples of its effects included destroying magical item s , transporting creatures back in time , restoring the dead to life , summoning extraplanar beings such as slaad s , creating gem stones , casting the " disintegrate " spell , playing music , and more . Once activated , it could be shut down by a successful " dispel magic " spell or by coming into contact with an " antimagic field " . History . The Maze Engine lay deep within the Labyrinth in the Northdark , and was sought by the beholder Karazikar after the creature learned about it from a captured modron . During the Rage of Demons in 1486 DR , the Maze Engine became damaged when a chasm opened up beneath it . Soon after , it was found by the demon lord Baphomet . He subsequently put the nalfeshnee Slaughtertusk to guard it while he went hunting for his rival , Yeenoghu .

title: Maze of mirrors
description: Maze of mirrors Maze of mirrors is a spell of the illusion school learned by some wizard s , particularly those interested in illusions as a speciality . When cast , " maze of mirrors " appears to create a tiny labyrinth of mirrors over an area five feet in diameter , somewhere within 100 feet of the wizard . Any creatures caught within might be fooled by the illusion and left unable to escape until the illusion dissipates a moment later , enough time for a wizard or their allies to take advantage of the situation .
description_long: Maze of mirrors Maze of mirrors is a spell of the illusion school learned by some wizard s , particularly those interested in illusions as a speciality . When cast , " maze of mirrors " appears to create a tiny labyrinth of mirrors over an area five feet in diameter , somewhere within 100 feet of the wizard . Any creatures caught within might be fooled by the illusion and left unable to escape until the illusion dissipates a moment later , enough time for a wizard or their allies to take advantage of the situation . The " maze of mirrors " spell is complex enough that wizards cannot cast it more than once between rests of a few minutes or more in length .

title: Mazeer
description: Mazeer Mazeer was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Mazeer was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .
description_long: Mazeer Mazeer was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Mazeer was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack . Later , she was the first to arrive at the place where the temple was located but was attacked by an undead . Mazeer slowly lost her mind and unintentionally killed herself .

title: Mazrol
description: Mazrol Mazrol was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Mazrol was one of the many priests of Vhaeraun who joined the Church of Eilistraee after 1375 DR .
description_long: Mazrol Mazrol was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Mazrol was one of the many priests of Vhaeraun who joined the Church of Eilistraee after 1375 DR . Mazrol however actually agreed with Valdar Jaelre ' s idea that it was Vhaeraun who had killed Eilistraee and was playing a deception plot . In 1379 DR , Mazrol , alongside Valdar and others , plotted to help Ghaunadaur ' s followers attack the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . However , he , together with Naxil and Jub , was put inside the Pit by the priests of Ghaunadaur who were trying to awaken the avatar of their god . The ooze god consumed Mazrol .

title: Maztica
description: Maztica Maztica , referred to by its inhabitants as The True World , was a large continent west of Faerûn . Maztica was a land of jungles and mystery . During the Spellplague , the continent of Mazitca was replaced by a continent that came to be known as Returned Abeir .
description_long: Maztica Maztica , referred to by its inhabitants as The True World , was a large continent west of Faerûn . Maztica was a land of jungles and mystery . During the Spellplague , the continent of Mazitca was replaced by a continent that came to be known as Returned Abeir . The continent apparently returned with the sundering . Geography . North of Maztica was Anchorome and south of it were Lapongo then Katashaka . History . Early in the continent ' s history it was a land fought over by the gods Qotal ( the Plumed Serpent ) and his brother Zaltec . For a crime against his sister , Qotal retreated from Maztica for an age but returned in recent times . Maztica was also the name of the elder goddess who embodied the land of Maztica . Killed by her own son Zaltec , she was the wife of dead Kukul , but unlike her husband , continued to live on in the continued existence of the continent . Maztica was ' discovered ' by Amnian explorers led by Captain - general Cordell and his Golden Legion in 1361 DR .

title: Maztica ( goddess )
description: Maztica ( goddess ) Maztica was the ancient mother of the maztican pantheon before she was killed by her son Zaltec . Description . She was the epitome of fertile womanhood and therefore she was shown as a lush and full woman with a round and always smiling face .
description_long: Maztica ( goddess ) Maztica was the ancient mother of the maztican pantheon before she was killed by her son Zaltec . Description . She was the epitome of fertile womanhood and therefore she was shown as a lush and full woman with a round and always smiling face . Maztica was also the land itself and a huge goddess , maybe greater than her husband Kukul . When she died , she became the world itself and survived in a kind of way in the land Maztica . Worship . Since she died she is ignored by most Mazticans of the more civilized type , let ' s say those living in cities . But she is still worshiped through lakes , streams , plants and those things who are earth - based even if they are the territory of other gods now . Her priests are similar to druid s and have much the same powers and spells . Today her worshipers are mostly found among the shamans of the small tribes living in the wilderness . But they are widely spread over the True World . These tribes can be found from the deserts and among the Dog People in the north to the small villages in the jungles of Far Payit .

title: Maztica trilogy
description: Maztica trilogy The Maztica trilogy is a series of books set in the " Forgotten Realms " on the continent of Maztica at the time of its " discovery " by Cordell of Amn . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The main character is Erixitl , a priestess of Qotal and former slave .
description_long: Maztica trilogy The Maztica trilogy is a series of books set in the " Forgotten Realms " on the continent of Maztica at the time of its " discovery " by Cordell of Amn . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The main character is Erixitl , a priestess of Qotal and former slave .

title: Maztican
description: Maztican " Maztican " was a collective term used by Faerûn ians for any of the inhabitants of Maztica . When most folk in Faerûn used the term , they were most likely referring to Nexalan s , as that was the only people group of Maztica for which individuals had traveled to the east . In truth , there were seven separate ethnicities of humans in Maztica :

When most folk in Faerûn used the term , they were most likely referring to Nexalan s , as that was the only people group of Maztica for which individuals had traveled to the east . In truth , there were seven separate ethnicities of humans in Maztica :

title: Maztican Dragon
description: Maztican Dragon The Maztican dragon , also known as the Rain serpent or Tlalocoatl is a dragon unique to the continent of Maztica . The feature that most distinguishes Maztican dragons from their kin in Faerûn is the fact that these dragons have two heads and no tail . One head is the head of a serpent and the other is a jaguar head .
description_long: Maztican Dragon The Maztican dragon , also known as the Rain serpent or Tlalocoatl is a dragon unique to the continent of Maztica . The feature that most distinguishes Maztican dragons from their kin in Faerûn is the fact that these dragons have two heads and no tail . One head is the head of a serpent and the other is a jaguar head . These dragons are usually bluish in color and have turquoise scales on the upper part of their bodies . Combat . Each head of the Maztican dragon has a breath weapon . The serpent head may breathe a cone of ice crystals and the jaguar head breathes a cloud of water vapor which can be scalding steam . Maztican dragons can also wrap themselves around an opponent to cause constriction damage . In addition to their other abilities , Maztican dragons have limited spellcasting capabilities . Ecology . Maztican dragons aren ' t as covetous as other dragons but do appreciate valuable objects including cocoa beans , coral and gold dust . These dragons are often servants of the rain god Azul and help to bring rain to Maztica .

title: Mazzy Fentan
description: Mazzy Fentan Mazzy Fentan was a halfling warrior and servant of Arvoreen . She was the closest thing to a halfling paladin of Arvoreen at a time when such a thing was unheard of , possessing divine - granted abilities similar to those of a paladin . Appendix .
description_long: Mazzy Fentan Mazzy Fentan was a halfling warrior and servant of Arvoreen . She was the closest thing to a halfling paladin of Arvoreen at a time when such a thing was unheard of , possessing divine - granted abilities similar to those of a paladin . Appendix . Background . Mazzy is one of the playable characters in . Mazzy is voiced by , who also voiced Dynaheir in " Baldur ' s Gate " .

title: Mead
description: Mead Mead was a slightly sweet alcoholic beverage made of fermented honey . It was commonly brewed in the Northlands . Mead from the gardens of Neverwinter was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .
description_long: Mead Mead was a slightly sweet alcoholic beverage made of fermented honey . It was commonly brewed in the Northlands . Mead from the gardens of Neverwinter was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Mead was considerably rarer and more difficult to produce than wine , due to its slow fermentation and its sensitivity to temperature and the amount of yeast . When successfully brewed , it resulted in a delicate and sweet beverage .

title: Mechanical disruption
description: Mechanical disruption Mechanical disruption was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell served as a paralysis spell when cast at mechanical creations , keeping them from moving or performing any function until the spell ended .
description_long: Mechanical disruption Mechanical disruption was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell served as a paralysis spell when cast at mechanical creations , keeping them from moving or performing any function until the spell ended . If placed within a mechanical upon its creation , there was a chance that the creation would fall to pieces . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Mechezarin
description: Mechezarin Mechezarin was a great wyrm dragon . The dragon lived in a large room carved out underneath Durlag ' s Tower , along with other magical beasts that Durlag kept in his bestiary . The massive beast eventually died , but its vast skeleton continued to rest deep underneath Durlag ' s Tower .
description_long: Mechezarin Mechezarin was a great wyrm dragon . The dragon lived in a large room carved out underneath Durlag ' s Tower , along with other magical beasts that Durlag kept in his bestiary . The massive beast eventually died , but its vast skeleton continued to rest deep underneath Durlag ' s Tower . It was guarded by numerous wyvern s .

title: Mechnik
description: Mechnik Mechnik was the title given to the leader of the Gospoda in the city of Almorel in the Hordelands . Activities . The Mechnik served as the head of the ruling council of Almorel .
description_long: Mechnik Mechnik was the title given to the leader of the Gospoda in the city of Almorel in the Hordelands . Activities . The Mechnik served as the head of the ruling council of Almorel . They moderated meetings of the Gospoda while serving the general welfare of the city .

title: Medallion of elemental summoning
description: Medallion of elemental summoning Medallions of elemental summoning were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were golden medallions with a stone inset depending on the type of elemental it could summon : blue for water , brown for earth , red for fire , and clear for air .
description_long: Medallion of elemental summoning Medallions of elemental summoning were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were golden medallions with a stone inset depending on the type of elemental it could summon : blue for water , brown for earth , red for fire , and clear for air . Powers . Any type of person could use these medallions to control a powerful elemental for up to one month at a distance of up to half a mile ( 0 . 8 km ) . Detailed instructions needed to be given to the elemental . The medallions could not be used more than five times .

title: Medina al - Afyal
description: Medina al - Afyal Medina al - Afyal , the capital and only real city on Afyal , was beyond compare . While lacking the blue tilework of most Zakharan cities , it featureed polished marble and gleaming hardwoods in magnificient style . Perhaps due to strong influence from Bharata and southeast Kara - Tur , a rigid caste system prevailed on this island .
description_long: Medina al - Afyal Medina al - Afyal , the capital and only real city on Afyal , was beyond compare . While lacking the blue tilework of most Zakharan cities , it featureed polished marble and gleaming hardwoods in magnificient style . Perhaps due to strong influence from Bharata and southeast Kara - Tur , a rigid caste system prevailed on this island . While the concepts of station and honor were important throughout the Land of Fate , they were extremely strong on the Isle of the Elephant . Another peculiarity were Afyal ' s elephants : They showed more intelligence and were easier to train than others of their kind . To protect this asset , the strongest laws forbid the killing of an elephant , dating all the way back to the island ' s first padishah , Alon .

title: Medium spider venom
description: Medium spider venom Medium spider venom was a poison extracted from a medium - sized monstrous spider . Effect . Inflicted via wounding , medium spider venom sapped the strength of a victim , but they could recover from it with time .
description_long: Medium spider venom Medium spider venom was a poison extracted from a medium - sized monstrous spider . Effect . Inflicted via wounding , medium spider venom sapped the strength of a victim , but they could recover from it with time . Users . A dark stalker operating at the Tomb of Chonis in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , coated his arrows in medium spider venom .

title: Medusa
description: Medusa Medusae were monstrous beings with bodies that are covered in scales and rather than hair , they had a writhing mass of serpents growing from their scalp . Abilities . The eyes of a medusa were feared , because to look in their eyes was to invite death .
description_long: Medusa Medusae were monstrous beings with bodies that are covered in scales and rather than hair , they had a writhing mass of serpents growing from their scalp . Abilities . The eyes of a medusa were feared , because to look in their eyes was to invite death . A female ' s gaze would instantly transform living flesh into lifeless stone , while a male ' s gaze would daze and weaken . Society . Medusae prefered to live alone in small groups , but they desired treasures and dominance over other races most of all .

title: Medusanna Mhairdaul
description: Medusanna Mhairdaul Medusanna Mhairdaul was the high priestess of the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Medusanna was a female yuan - ti abomination with a snake - like body and a human head with a mass of poisonous snake s instead of hair on her head .
description_long: Medusanna Mhairdaul Medusanna Mhairdaul was the high priestess of the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Medusanna was a female yuan - ti abomination with a snake - like body and a human head with a mass of poisonous snake s instead of hair on her head . Personality . Medusanna was the epitome of yuan - ti society and vainly decorated her residence chambers with mirrors of various shapes and sizes . Possessions . Behind a secret door in her chambers , she kept a " portal " to a place called the Pit of Vipers in the Black Jungles on the northwestern shore of the Lapal Sea . Activities . Although the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was dedicated to the beast cult of Varae , it was tacitly understood that Varae was an aspect of Sseth . Medusanna administrated the Cathedral and kept ceremonies to Varae / Sseth , including ritual sacrifices , a constant activity on the main floor of the Cathedral . She was one of only two individuals that knew the extent of a large - scale breeding program going on in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral , the other being Ssibalentanamas , the First Keeper of the Sacred Eggs .

title: Meenlock
description: Meenlock Meenlocks were deformed fey that originated from intense fear . They had no purpose other than to destroy good and beauty , and resorted to telepathic torture in order to terrify and corrupt other creatures . Someone who succumbed to this torture would then magically transform into a meenlock as well .
description_long: Meenlock Meenlocks were deformed fey that originated from intense fear . They had no purpose other than to destroy good and beauty , and resorted to telepathic torture in order to terrify and corrupt other creatures . Someone who succumbed to this torture would then magically transform into a meenlock as well .

title: Meera
description: Meera Meera was an unusual cleric of Cyric and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Velen around 1370 DR . Personality . Meera worshiped Cyric in his nonviolent aspects .
description_long: Meera Meera was an unusual cleric of Cyric and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Velen around 1370 DR . Personality . Meera worshiped Cyric in his nonviolent aspects . She disliked violence but was okay with setting someone up for an ambush by her fellow Shadow Thieves . She would probably never become an assassin . Activities . Meera used her clerical powers and beauty to spy for the local chapter of the spies guild division of Shadow Thieves in Velen .

title: Meerschaum
description: Meerschaum Meerschaum , also known as , was a hardstone found in the Realms used for carving . Description . Meerschaum was a white , compact , porous , clay - like stone used for pipes and small carvings .
description_long: Meerschaum Meerschaum , also known as , was a hardstone found in the Realms used for carving . Description . Meerschaum was a white , compact , porous , clay - like stone used for pipes and small carvings . It was light and easily quarried and transported in large quantities . A typical price for this raw material was 2 gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Powers . Using a unique spell called " stretchbone " , meerschaum could be transformed to look like real bone , suitable for replacing missing bones in a skeleton . The " animate dead " spell required skeletons to be mostly intact to be effective , and as long as there was at least one real bone in the skeleton , the rest could be made of meerschaum and it would still animate . Rumors and Legends . Meerschaum was the subject of various repulsive rumors due to its association with necromancy , but none were ever proven to be true . It was also said that certain wizard s new how to prepare a sample of this material so they could later cast " wizard eye " and " clairaudience " through it from a distance .

title: Mefraset
description: Mefraset Mefraset was a wizard member of the cult of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hodkamset ordered Mefraset and some of her fellows to infiltrate a city in west Faerûn .
description_long: Mefraset Mefraset was a wizard member of the cult of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hodkamset ordered Mefraset and some of her fellows to infiltrate a city in west Faerûn . However , there Mefraset happened to put a " ring of reverse alignment " on her finger , becoming good . She believed herself to be an enemy of the cult of Set gathering information . However , her fellow cultists understood the situation and decided to kidnap her in order to heal her . Personality . Mefraset was a loyal agent of Hodkamset and knew much about his plots to conquer Mulhorand .

title: Mehen
description: Mehen Thrikominaki ( clanless ) Mehen , formerly a member of Clan Verthisathurgiesh , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p18 " > < / ref > was a clanless dragonborn warrior who at one point found a home in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . Description . Mehen was a tall and powerfully built dragonborn , with dull - ocher scales and scars where he once had his clan piercings .
description_long: Mehen Thrikominaki ( clanless ) Mehen , formerly a member of Clan Verthisathurgiesh , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p18 " > < / ref > was a clanless dragonborn warrior who at one point found a home in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . Description . Mehen was a tall and powerfully built dragonborn , with dull - ocher scales and scars where he once had his clan piercings . Abilities . He was capable of breathe lightning . History . Tarhun and Mehen served at the same time on the Lance Defenders when they were young . They even patrolled together , but never became friends . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p301 " > < / ref > Around 1450 DR , Mehen was exiled from his clan because he had a gay relationship with his clanmate , Verthisathurgiesh Arjhani , and didn ' t wanted to marry with Kepeshkmolik Uadjit . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p29 - 30 " > < / ref > In 1460 DR , Mehen adopted the infant tiefling twin sisters Havilar and Farideh , who were left in a basket at gate of the village of Arush Vayem . In 1477 DR , Havilar was in a barn attempting to summon an imp when she accidentally summoned a cambion from Malbolge named Lorcan .

title: Mehmet al - Nassar
description: Mehmet al - Nassar Mehmet al - Nassar was an elven theologian who lived in Hilm , the City of Kindness . History . Mehmet was an outspoken lecturer who condemned the actions of holy slayer s .
description_long: Mehmet al - Nassar Mehmet al - Nassar was an elven theologian who lived in Hilm , the City of Kindness . History . Mehmet was an outspoken lecturer who condemned the actions of holy slayer s . News of his preaching reached the ears of the Grandfather of the Everlasting , who decided to put an end to the heresy . A holy slayer disguised himself as a student , enrolling at the university where Mehmet taught . One day , the holy slayer confronted Mehmet in his private office under the pretense of discussing an issue . The slayer drew a knife and threatened to end Mehmet ' s life . After a brief struggle , Mehmet pleaded for his life to be spared . The slayer , seeing an opportunity , decided to spare Mehmet ' s life . A deal was struck between the two where the holy slayer would pay Mehmet on a yearly basis if he started preaching the positive aspects of brave Hajama , and Mehmet ' s life would also be spared for every year so long as he never condemned the holy slayers again .

title: Mei Li Mao
description: Mei Li Mao Mei Li Mao was a yakuza in Shou Lung . Activities . Around 1357 DR , Mei Li Mao owned the Imperial Phoenix restaurant in Kuo Te ' Lung , a very popular meeting point for secret societies .
description_long: Mei Li Mao Mei Li Mao was a yakuza in Shou Lung . Activities . Around 1357 DR , Mei Li Mao owned the Imperial Phoenix restaurant in Kuo Te ' Lung , a very popular meeting point for secret societies . She also sometimes acted as a fence .

title: Meira Faerenduil
description: Meira Faerenduil Meira Faerenduil was a ghost knight of Myth Drannor . History . Meira was a knight in Cormanthor and a follower of Labelas Enoreth .
description_long: Meira Faerenduil Meira Faerenduil was a ghost knight of Myth Drannor . History . Meira was a knight in Cormanthor and a follower of Labelas Enoreth . She fought in the Crown against Scepters Wars in 538 DR . In 1344 DR , at the start of the Retreat , Meira agreed to remain in Faerûn to protect the Eventide Abbey . Her oath was so strong that , after the natural end of her life , Meira rose as a ghost to continue to protect the ruins of the abbey . She remained in that state until the Rage of Demons , when Elanil Elassidil hired an adventuring party to face Meira — her ancestor — in a false battle while disguised as Netherese in order to bring peace to her spirit . At last the adventurers managed to fight Meira and so she fulfilled her oath and finally died for good Relationship . Meira was ancestor of Elanil Elassidil , herald of Elventree

title: Meirgin Windtalon
description: Meirgin Windtalon Meirgin " Daggers " Windtalon was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Meirgin was tall and thin , with smouldering good looks .
description_long: Meirgin Windtalon Meirgin " Daggers " Windtalon was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Meirgin was tall and thin , with smouldering good looks . When he spoke , it was obvious that he was well educated , speaking rapidly with very little hesitation in his phrasing . His nickname came from the the way he looked at people who displeased him , giving them sidelong glances that dripped with poison . Personality . He was a very organized and patient person that never forgot a slight . He was often successful at manipulating merchants or adventurers that passed through town into doing something that improved his standing or was detrimental to his enemies . His specialty was whimsically inveigling intoxicated people into attacking a person , place , or thing that he disliked , until the Dark Patriarch Gormstadd rebuked him for being unsubtle . Abilities . In the temple , Meirgin was a master of ceremony , courtesy , and ritual , performing all his duties with flair .

title: Mekrath
description: Mekrath Mekrath was a powerful elven wizard in Athkatla , Amn . History . Mekrath was not very tolerant of visitors , especially thieves , and when he found Haer ' Dalis thieving in his lair , he enslaved him .
description_long: Mekrath Mekrath was a powerful elven wizard in Athkatla , Amn . History . Mekrath was not very tolerant of visitors , especially thieves , and when he found Haer ' Dalis thieving in his lair , he enslaved him . However , Gorion ' s Ward arrived and freed him . Gameplay . Gorion ' s Ward could kill Mekrath or perform a task for him to free Haer ' Dalis .

title: Mel Odom
description: Mel Odom Mel Odom ( born 1957 ) wrote several novels in the Forgotten Realms series , including the The Threat from the Sea trilogy , and two short stories as yet . He has gained renown beyond the Realms with his The Rover and Left Behind Apocalypse series , and two novels for the NCIS franchise . He lives in Oklahoma and is the father of five children .
description_long: Mel Odom Mel Odom ( born 1957 ) wrote several novels in the Forgotten Realms series , including the The Threat from the Sea trilogy , and two short stories as yet . He has gained renown beyond the Realms with his The Rover and Left Behind Apocalypse series , and two novels for the NCIS franchise . He lives in Oklahoma and is the father of five children .

title: Mela Basult
description: Mela Basult Mela Basult was a female Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . Relationships . Mela was the wife of Amnic Basult , the proprietor of Basult ' s Books .
description_long: Mela Basult Mela Basult was a female Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . Relationships . Mela was the wife of Amnic Basult , the proprietor of Basult ' s Books . The two were heard to have loud arguments , but Mela firmly believed her husband still loved her . History . Early in the month of Eleint in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Amnic went missing . Mela was distraught and sought someone to help , but the militia of the Wheloon Watch did not investigate such cases . Neighbors , meanwhile , rumored Amnic had left his wife , either taking a few days away or taking up with another woman . Mela , meanwhile , tried to manage the bookshop in Amnic ' s absence . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , adventurers discovered that the new Temple of Mystra in town was actually a front for priests of Shar and Cyric to kidnap magic - users and spirit them away to the Vast Swamp for some nefarious purpose . Investigators found Amnic ' s body along with two others in a torture chamber beneath the false temple , identified by his possessions . To quell his suspicions , the false priests or their agents had evidently kidnapped Amnic .

title: Melabrauth
description: Melabrauth Melabrauth , also known as the Jungle Empire , was the oldest dragon empire of Returned Abeir . Description . There were no known settlements or roads in Melabrauth .
description_long: Melabrauth Melabrauth , also known as the Jungle Empire , was the oldest dragon empire of Returned Abeir . Description . There were no known settlements or roads in Melabrauth . Its many rivers were navigable but were infested by fierce and dangerous monsters . Inhabitants . The only known inhabitants of Melabrauth were dragons and their dragonspawn servants . A few human s and dragonborn were allowed to live in Melabrauth , but only to serve as amusement for its dragon inhabitants . Government . Melabrauth was ruled by Melauthaur the Undying One , a powerful dracolich . Melauthaur chose twenty dragons to be the " overdragons " , dragon lords who ruled over their brethren and were tasked with the protection of the land . If an " overdragon " became reckless or ambitious , Melauthaur commanded other " overdragons " to kill it before that dragon could do anything . Otherwise , Melauthaur allowed his " overdragons " to pursue their own goals , which often included hunting humans and dragonborn for sport . After a dragonborn rebellion during the Wailing Years , Melabrauth forbade the " overdragons " to have dragonborn slaves . The Dusk Ports were a vassal state to Melabrauth .

title: Melair I
