description: Melair I King Melair I ( then known only as Melair ) first discovered mithral ore beneath Mount Waterdeep in - 1288 DR and set about rallying together shield dwarves who would eventually create Melairbode and form Clan Melairkyn on that site . Although he passed away at an unknown time in the distant past , his ghost still occupies the royal crypt deep within the Undermountain and he firmly believes Clan Melairkyn is still a living clan .
description_long: Melair I King Melair I ( then known only as Melair ) first discovered mithral ore beneath Mount Waterdeep in - 1288 DR and set about rallying together shield dwarves who would eventually create Melairbode and form Clan Melairkyn on that site . Although he passed away at an unknown time in the distant past , his ghost still occupies the royal crypt deep within the Undermountain and he firmly believes Clan Melairkyn is still a living clan .

title: Melairbode
description: Melairbode Melairbode was the home of the Melairkyn , an ancient dwarven clan that was later wiped out . Their vast network of caverns and chambers was later known as Undermountain . Melairbode was frequently raided by drow .
description_long: Melairbode Melairbode was the home of the Melairkyn , an ancient dwarven clan that was later wiped out . Their vast network of caverns and chambers was later known as Undermountain . Melairbode was frequently raided by drow . Despite their best efforts , the dwarves succumbed in 211 DR .

title: Melandrach
description: Melandrach King Melandrach was the king of the wild elves of the Misty Forest and the elves leading the delegation to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Melandrach was the king of the Misty Forest long before 1344 DR .
description_long: Melandrach King Melandrach was the king of the wild elves of the Misty Forest and the elves leading the delegation to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Melandrach was the king of the Misty Forest long before 1344 DR . For a long time he opposed the Retreat , thinking it was a rash decision . His cautious nature proved a problem in his rapport with his more impetuous sons Neronvain and Alagrthas that ended with his son Neronvain being exiled . It was his prudence , however , that convinced the elves of his kingdom and of the High Forest kingdom to send him as their main delegate to the Council in Waterdeep . Personality . Melandrach was a very cautious and reflective ruler . True to his elven ancestry , he spent a long time thinking and pondering all options before making a decision .

title: Melanith
description: Melanith Melanith ( also spelled Melinith ) was a Queen of Dambrath during the mid 11th century DR . Relationships . Queen Melanith took a crinti named Sadalar as her consort .
description_long: Melanith Melanith ( also spelled Melinith ) was a Queen of Dambrath during the mid 11th century DR . Relationships . Queen Melanith took a crinti named Sadalar as her consort . She had a daughter named Ausitil . After Sadalar perished during the attack of Aventine , Melanith took Nym Inthigg as her consort . They had four children together . Activities . Melanith became queen of Dambrath when her aunt Cathakay Shintar perished while fighting a gold dragon . One of her firsts acts as queen was to decree that men would be responsible for the defense of the kingdom against growing threats from Unther , Mulhorand , or other nations . Though Dambrath had been ruled by females for more than 200 years , the complete split between men and women occurred during Melanith ' s reign when she announced that men would only have power over other men . Her decree was backed by the priestesses of Loviatar . Melanith ruled Dambrath for 156 years . Her daughter became queen upon her death . Rumors and Legends . Queen Melanith was once saved from drowning by dolphins in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins . After that harrowing experience she decreed that dolphins were a protected species within Dambrath .

title: Melann Brandish
description: Melann Brandish Melann Brandish was one of the cleric s of Chauntea at the Bounty of the Goddess in Archendale . Description . She had long dark hair , tied away from her face .
description_long: Melann Brandish Melann Brandish was one of the cleric s of Chauntea at the Bounty of the Goddess in Archendale . Description . She had long dark hair , tied away from her face . She wore a leather and a brown cloak for protection while traveling . She was never found without her wooden holy symbol to Chauntea around her neck on an amulet . She had a small , crude mace with a wooden haft and a lead - covered head . Relationships . Melann had a single sibling , her brother Whitlock Brandish .

title: Melauthaur
description: Melauthaur Melauthaur , also known as The Undying One , was the emperor of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . He was a very old and powerful dracolich , and formerly a black dragon . Activities .
description_long: Melauthaur Melauthaur , also known as The Undying One , was the emperor of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . He was a very old and powerful dracolich , and formerly a black dragon . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Melauthaur was more focused on ruling his lands than anything else . He left the day - to - day government to his " overdragons " , dragon lords who he had elevated over their brethren . However , he was also interested in obtaining a powerful relic known as the Shadow of Ao , and he usually sent his dragon servants to search for it across Returned Abeir . History . During the Wailing Years , Melauthaur had to endure a fierce dragonborn rebellion on his lands that nearly killed a quarter of the dragon population of Melabrauth . Melauthaur had to intervene , and using powerful magic he learned from the Dawn Titans he was able to destroy Djerad Kusold and thwart the rebellion . Since then , he forbade his servants to have dragonborn slaves .

title: Meld
description: Meld Meld was a cooperative enchantment spell that allowed a priest to temporarily transfer his or her persona to another priest of the same faith who was willing to be a host for the caster ' s essence . Effects . This spell could only be cast on a willing priest of the same religion as the caster .
description_long: Meld Meld was a cooperative enchantment spell that allowed a priest to temporarily transfer his or her persona to another priest of the same faith who was willing to be a host for the caster ' s essence . Effects . This spell could only be cast on a willing priest of the same religion as the caster . After performing the 10 minute ritual , the caster ' s body slumped and became inert as the caster ' s essence joined with the host in a form of cooperative possession . For 12 hours , the caster and the host shared one body ; the caster experiencing everything that the host experienced through all five senses . The caster and the host were able to communicate telepathically , but a thin sheet of lead between the caster and the host ' s body could break the bond and therefore the spell . At any time , the caster could take over the host , dominating him or her almost completely such that the caster ' s abilities , proficiencies , personality , and spells replaced those of the host ; essentially becoming the caster controlling the host ' s body .

title: Meld into stone
description: Meld into stone Meld into stone is a transmutation spell that causes the caster and his gear to merge with stone . Effect . " Meld into stone " enables you to meld your body and possessions into a single block of stone .
description_long: Meld into stone Meld into stone is a transmutation spell that causes the caster and his gear to merge with stone . Effect . " Meld into stone " enables you to meld your body and possessions into a single block of stone . The stone must be large enough to accommodate your body in all three dimensions . When the casting is complete , you and not more than 100 pounds of nonliving gear merge with the stone . If either condition is violated , the spell fails and is wasted . While in the stone , you remain in contact , however tenuous , with the face of the stone through which you melded . You remain aware of the passage of time and can cast spells on yourself while hiding in the stone . Nothing that goes on outside the stone can be seen , but you can still hear what happens around you . Minor physical damage to the stone does not harm you , but its partial destruction to the extent that you no longer fit within it expels you and deals you 5d6 points of damage . The stone ' s complete destruction expels you and slays you instantly unless you succeed at a Fortitude save ( DC 18 ) .

title: Melder Crownrood
description: Melder Crownrood Melder Crownrood was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Crownrood noble house . Activities . Melder was the chancellor of King Foril Obarskyr I .
description_long: Melder Crownrood Melder Crownrood was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Crownrood noble house . Activities . Melder was the chancellor of King Foril Obarskyr I . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon tried to enslave his mind but Melder had a very efficient retinue of wizard bodyguards . However , using the diversion of killing one of Melder ' s wizards , Manshoon managed at last to enslave him . During the fighting started by the apparition of a Blueflame ghost at the start of the Council of the Dragon Melder saved his life only because Manshoon possessed his mind . In 1480 DR Manshoon ordered him to gathered a meeting of Lords , amog them Naeryk Andolphyn , Relgadrar Loroun , and Danthalus Blacksilver , all Manshoon ' s mind thralls , to discuss the future of the kingdom . Personality . Melder was a treacherous and scheming individual . he plotted to destroy the Obarskyr and exiled old families like the Illance s , the Crownsilver s , and the Huntcrown in order to become the new king .

title: Melder Rythtin
description: Melder Rythtin Melder Rythtin of the Healing Hand was a priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1369 DR . Melder was renowned for his accurate diagnoses and miraculous treatments of those afflicted with suffering .
description_long: Melder Rythtin Melder Rythtin of the Healing Hand was a priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1369 DR . Melder was renowned for his accurate diagnoses and miraculous treatments of those afflicted with suffering .

title: Melee - Magthere
description: Melee - Magthere Melee - Magthere was the warrior school for the drow of Menzoberranzan . It was part of the Tier Breche academy . Notably , Drizzt Do ' Urden spent time here in training .
description_long: Melee - Magthere Melee - Magthere was the warrior school for the drow of Menzoberranzan . It was part of the Tier Breche academy . Notably , Drizzt Do ' Urden spent time here in training . Structure . Melee - Magthere was a pyramidal structure in the eastern part of the Tier Breche cavern . It was in fact nicknamed the " Pyramid . " Schooling . Melee - Magthere was one of the three schools that noble male children of the drow were expected to attend . Their education usually began at 10 years old and continued on for another 10 more years . Graduates of warrior ' s academy did not hold as high a prestige as those who graduated from the wizard or cleric s school , but still held a greater distinction than those who were normal citizenry . One of the events of training there was the Grand Melee , in which Zaknafein Do ' Urden was the victor seven years running , three times against older more advanced students . Drizzt Do ' Urden followed in his father ' s footsteps by doing the same and every year after his third year , competing against students three years ahead of him and still ending up the top in his class .

title: Melegaunt Tanthul
description: Melegaunt Tanthul Prince Melegaunt Tanthul was one of the youngest Princes of Shade . Personality . He had a knack for deception , combined with a talent of false empathy , that made him a formidable manipulator .
description_long: Melegaunt Tanthul Prince Melegaunt Tanthul was one of the youngest Princes of Shade . Personality . He had a knack for deception , combined with a talent of false empathy , that made him a formidable manipulator . There were few people outside the royal family that he could not win over with his combination of charm , good looks , and seeming sincerity . Indeed , he practically made it his life ' s work . It was believed that he tricked Galaeron Nihmedu into opening the Sharn Wall in Evereska , thus unleashing an army of Phaerimm on Faerûn . Relationships . Melegaunt had twelve brothers , but among them , only Dethud Tanthul favored his policy of manipulation . Activities . Melegaunt was a spy from Thultanthar , also referred to as the City of Shade . He had a barely above average aptitude in the magical arts , but was trained exactly like the rest of the princes and the secret kept safe on pain of death by order of his father , Telamont . What Melegaunt lacked in arcane aptitude , however , he made up for in guile . He died in battle against the lich Wulgreth of Ascalhorn within a pyramid in Karse Butte .

title: Meleghost Starseer
description: Meleghost Starseer Meleghost Starseer was the high priest of the House of Wonder , the temple to Mystra in Waterdeep , in 1372 DR . Personality . Meleghost was a cruel but polite individual .
description_long: Meleghost Starseer Meleghost Starseer was the high priest of the House of Wonder , the temple to Mystra in Waterdeep , in 1372 DR . Personality . Meleghost was a cruel but polite individual . He was fiercely devoted to Mystra . Meleghost professed that he respected all faithful but his dealings with the Red Magic Enclave alienated many worshipers . Relationship . Meleghost had a good relationship with Maaril and the leaders of Eltorchul family , and troubled relations with Khelben Arunsun and the members of the Wands clan . He maintained a cold but polite relationship with Naneetha Suaril but was nearly hostile to Xale of the Starry Glen of the Order of the Blue Moon . Despite the advice of his allies in the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors , he started dealings with members of the Red Magic Enclave .

title: Melf ' s minute meteors
description: Melf ' s minute meteors Melf ' s minute meteors was a fire - based evocation spell . Effects . The spell created six tiny meteors that orbited the caster for up to 10 minutes , until released upon a target or until the caster stopped concentrating .
description_long: Melf ' s minute meteors Melf ' s minute meteors was a fire - based evocation spell . Effects . The spell created six tiny meteors that orbited the caster for up to 10 minutes , until released upon a target or until the caster stopped concentrating . When released , the meteors exploded on impact . The effects of " Melf ' s minute meteors " could also be achieved by accident through the misuse of opal s as components of magical items that evoked both fire and lightning . Components . The spell needed somatic and verbal components , as well as niter , sulfur and a bead of pine tar for materials .

title: Melia Ceralle
description: Melia Ceralle Melia Ceralle was a female human operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Melia was a member of the Neverwinter Nine .
description_long: Melia Ceralle Melia Ceralle was a female human operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Melia was a member of the Neverwinter Nine . After the lords were slaughtered , Lord Nasher Alagondar sent her to watch over Lord Cyran Tavorick . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha and companions entered Tavorick ' s mansion , they would see Tavorick sending Melia away to the Moonstone Mask . When the Kalach - Cha and companions arrived at the Moonstone Mask , they saw Melia and her female soldiers being slain by the warlock , who took her shard away .

title: Melicent Mellicot
description: Melicent Mellicot Melicent Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melicent was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Meliors and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .
description_long: Melicent Mellicot Melicent Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melicent was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Meliors and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment . The Mellicot sisters stocked the pond of Swords Pool with trout and a type of fish they called " manyfins " . They discouraged fishing , but some people did it anyway on dark nights .

title: Melineth Turcasson
description: Melineth Turcasson Melineth Turcassan was the father - in - law of King Duar Obarskyr of Cormyr . History . When Duar took an army north to battle the orc invaders in the King ' s Forest , Melineth sold the city of Suzail to pirates for 500 sacks of gold .
description_long: Melineth Turcasson Melineth Turcassan was the father - in - law of King Duar Obarskyr of Cormyr . History . When Duar took an army north to battle the orc invaders in the King ' s Forest , Melineth sold the city of Suzail to pirates for 500 sacks of gold . After fleeing from Cormyr , it was unknown what happened to him . Eventually he died and was interred underneath a buckeye tree where he became the fourth Ghazneth . Relatives . Melineth Turcasson was King Duar ' s father - in - law . Powers . As a Ghazneth , Melineth had the power of decay . He was able to cause extreme decay with a single touch , causing muscle to melt away , and instantly causing living matter to decay to the point of death .

title: Melino Richtoes
description: Melino Richtoes Melino Richtoes was the mayor of Shoun in 1367 DR . Personality . Melino was an exceedingly greedy person before he found religion .
description_long: Melino Richtoes Melino Richtoes was the mayor of Shoun in 1367 DR . Personality . Melino was an exceedingly greedy person before he found religion . Activities . In addition to holding the title of mayor , Melino was the richest merchant in the city thanks to his lucrative dairy business . He enjoyed adventuring when his duties allowed it . History . Melino was a common thief during his youth , but changed his ways to the teachings of Yondalla , though he still used some of his rogue skills later in life to deal with political rivals . Possessions . Melino owned a magical dagger .

title: Meliors Mellicot
description: Meliors Mellicot Meliors Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Meliors was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .
description_long: Meliors Mellicot Meliors Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Meliors was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment . The Mellicot sisters stocked the pond of Swords Pool with trout and a type of fish they called " manyfins " . They discouraged fishing , but some people did it anyway on dark nights . Appendix . Background . Meliors may be named after Melior , the sister of the mermaid - like of medieval legend in one tale .

title: Melisende Baybars
description: Melisende Baybars Melisende Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Melisende was as near to physical perfection as most mortals could come .
description_long: Melisende Baybars Melisende Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Melisende was as near to physical perfection as most mortals could come . Personality . Her personality was the polar opposite of her striking beauty , filling her with a cold heart and twisted thoughts . Her evil nature was often masked by false courtesy . Skills . Melisende was a formidable opponent , possessing martial and magical skills . Possessions . Melisende owned a pair of " bracers of defense + 5 " , a magical sword , and a " wand of magic missiles " . Relationships . She was the daughter of Alim Baybars . Her mother , and namesake , was from the strange lands far west of the borders of Zakhara . Only her fear of his power kept Melisende from killing her father .

title: Melkar
description: Melkar Melkar of Mirabar was a mage who tried to breach the protections around Ahghairon ' s Tower in 1271 DR ( although his identity was not public knowledge ) . He failed , having misjudged the number of keys needed by half . His skeleton remained hanging inside the protections as a warning .
description_long: Melkar Melkar of Mirabar was a mage who tried to breach the protections around Ahghairon ' s Tower in 1271 DR ( although his identity was not public knowledge ) . He failed , having misjudged the number of keys needed by half . His skeleton remained hanging inside the protections as a warning . In 1479 DR , Melkar ' s journal was retrieved by Samark " the Blackstaff " Dhanzscul from the tomb of Khelben Arunsun . It fell into the hands of Samark ' s killers , Khondar and Centiv Naomal , who used it to determine the number of keys needed to enter the tower .

title: Melkatka
description: Melkatka Melkatka was a drow commoner who served House Xorlarrin as slavemaster and torturer . He was part of the first expedition to establish Q ' Xorlarrin . When , in 1484 DR , the drow captured the Companions of the Hall and put them into slavery , it was Melkatka who supervised them .
description_long: Melkatka Melkatka was a drow commoner who served House Xorlarrin as slavemaster and torturer . He was part of the first expedition to establish Q ' Xorlarrin . When , in 1484 DR , the drow captured the Companions of the Hall and put them into slavery , it was Melkatka who supervised them . However , he was soon killed by the vampire dwarf Thibbledorf Pwent who wanted free his friends .

title: Melkhor Goldseeker
description: Melkhor Goldseeker Melkhor Goldseeker was a dwarf businessman in the Blackdagger Ruins in 1484 DR . Relationships . He had a niece to whom was very attached .
description_long: Melkhor Goldseeker Melkhor Goldseeker was a dwarf businessman in the Blackdagger Ruins in 1484 DR . Relationships . He had a niece to whom was very attached . History . Melkhor was an enterprising dwarf ; he discovered some abandoned mines near Neverwinter that still had some minerals and bought them . However , he was ruined by some Blackdagger Bandits guided by Marion Hexbane , who had kidnapped his niece . This was until an adventurer intent on destroying the Blackdagger band arrived to help him .

title: Mellast Ormblade
description: Mellast Ormblade Mellast Ormblade was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Ormblade noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Mellast gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .
description_long: Mellast Ormblade Mellast Ormblade was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Ormblade noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Mellast gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war . Relationship . Mellast was part of the cabal that supported Marlin Stormserpent .

title: Mellochrysos
description: Mellochrysos Mellochrysos was a variety of zircon found in large crystals in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones were an intense yellow hue and very resistant to chipping in natural form .
description_long: Mellochrysos Mellochrysos was a variety of zircon found in large crystals in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones were an intense yellow hue and very resistant to chipping in natural form . As such , they were seldom cut , but rather polished and mounted in metal claw settings , typically for rings , brooches , and knife hilts . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Mellochrysos crystals had an unusual property after being the target of a " light " spell : within one day of being a magical light source , the crystal could be briefly held in an open flame and would ignite , giving off a single flame like a candle . The stone would fuel this flame , being consumed very slowly , for up to 12 hours . The flame could not be extinguished by wind or water , even magically generated air or water effects , but spells such as " quench fire " and the property of phenalope were effective . The mellochrysos flame was hot enough to ignite flammable materials .

title: Mellomir
description: Mellomir Mellomir was a wizard who lived in Arabel in Cormyr in 1367 DR . Personality . Mellomir was dry and dapper , but widely respected across Faerûn .
description_long: Mellomir Mellomir was a wizard who lived in Arabel in Cormyr in 1367 DR . Personality . Mellomir was dry and dapper , but widely respected across Faerûn . Description . He kept his steadily whitening hair and beard neatly trimmed . Activities . In addition to being a powerful wizard , Mellomir was a sage specializing in history , prophecy , and divination . He accurately predicted the fall of Bhaal and Myrkul during the Time of Troubles , as well as the return of the " Ring of Winter " . Due to various kidnap attempts , Mellomir cast a unique personal protection spell warding his body against many forms of attack .

title: Mellyth Echorn
description: Mellyth Echorn Elder star Mellyth Echorn was a cleric of Corellon Larethian and the highest ranking priest of the deity in Evermeet after Seiveril Miritar . Personality . Political views .
description_long: Mellyth Echorn Elder star Mellyth Echorn was a cleric of Corellon Larethian and the highest ranking priest of the deity in Evermeet after Seiveril Miritar . Personality . Political views . Strongly conservative , Mellyth was nominated to replace Seiveril Miritar on the Council of Evermeet by Selsharra Durothil .

title: Melody Mount Walk
description: Melody Mount Walk Melody Mount Walk was a magically lit tunnel in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep that ran west up to the cliffs on which the New Olamn barding college was situated . The tunnel contained a little - known portal between Waterdeep and the keep in Rassalantar .
description_long: Melody Mount Walk Melody Mount Walk was a magically lit tunnel in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep that ran west up to the cliffs on which the New Olamn barding college was situated . The tunnel contained a little - known portal between Waterdeep and the keep in Rassalantar .

title: Meloon Wardragon
description: Meloon Wardragon Meloon Wardragon was a human sellsword who hailed from northern Faerûn . Description . Meloon was a very tall young man with broad shoulders , blond hair , and pale blond scruff on his face .
description_long: Meloon Wardragon Meloon Wardragon was a human sellsword who hailed from northern Faerûn . Description . Meloon was a very tall young man with broad shoulders , blond hair , and pale blond scruff on his face . He carried a tattoo of his family ' s crest ( the Wardragon crest , which was a serpentine dragon wrapped vertically around a downward - pointing sword . History . Meloon traveled to Waterdeep around 1477 DR . He may have previously lived in Loudwater . At the Mysticslake tavern in Waterdeep , he was once pickpocketed but won the fight that resulted . In Nightal 1479 DR , Meloon was working as a hired blade in Waterdeep when Laraelra Harsard hired him as a bodyguard to accompany her into the sewers to rescue a trapped dwarven worker . While in the sewers , they heard a woman ' s screams and were able to use Laraelra ' s knowledge of the tunnel system to determine which house the screams came from . They contacted the house ' s owner , Renaer Neverember , who with his friends escorted Meloon and Laraelra to the house .

title: Melori Ostur
description: Melori Ostur Melori Ostur ( pronounced MEH - lore - ee OH - stir ) was a sergeant of the City Watch . History . Around 1491 DR , Melori led a City Watch patrol that arrived at the Wave and Wink dance hall after an arson attack on Zora Tiega Gos .
description_long: Melori Ostur Melori Ostur ( pronounced MEH - lore - ee OH - stir ) was a sergeant of the City Watch . History . Around 1491 DR , Melori led a City Watch patrol that arrived at the Wave and Wink dance hall after an arson attack on Zora Tiega Gos . He immediately arrested Kata Brizik and forcibly shut the Wave and Wink down . Personality . Melori was willing to arrest a woman without investigating , just to show off to nobles and impress his superiors in the watch .

title: Melusine Mellicot
description: Melusine Mellicot Melusine Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melusine was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Meliors . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .
description_long: Melusine Mellicot Melusine Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melusine was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Meliors . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment . The Mellicot sisters stocked the pond of Swords Pool with trout and a type of fish which they called " manyfins " . They discouraged fishing , but some people did it anyway on dark nights . Appendix . Background . Melusine may be named after the mermaid - like of medieval legend . One tale has Melusine as one of three sisters , another of whom is called Melior .

title: Melvaunt
description: Melvaunt Melvaunt ( pronounced " MELL - vont " ) was a city that sat on the northern coast of the Moonsea , adjacent to Thar . It was a city of smithing and mercantile services , serving as the port of entry to many travelers coming to the region . The city itself was cold and gray , with a mist that rose from the Moonsea seeming to cover it entirely .
description_long: Melvaunt Melvaunt ( pronounced " MELL - vont " ) was a city that sat on the northern coast of the Moonsea , adjacent to Thar . It was a city of smithing and mercantile services , serving as the port of entry to many travelers coming to the region . The city itself was cold and gray , with a mist that rose from the Moonsea seeming to cover it entirely . Government . A Council of Lords ruled over the city of Melvaunt , though they were more often concerned with affairs that could line their coffers . All members were required to be merchants of some kind and vacant seats could be purchased for for at least 100 , 000 gp while a new one could be created starting at a sum of 2 , 000 , 000 gp . In 1373 DR , there were 21 seats on the council , with one vacant . Four positions in the council had more influence than others . The " Lord Chancellor " was Chairman of the Council , Treasurer and also Last Speaker . The " First Envoy " was the Council ' s First Speaker and Diplomat . The " Lord of the Keys " was the General of Melvaunt ' s army while the " Lord of the Waves " was the Admiral of it ' s navy and Chief Inspector of the city ' s docks .

title: Memnon
description: Memnon Memnon , a key port of trade for Calimshan , was the former capital of the efreet i kingdom of Memnonnar and the birthplace of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri . Geography and Layout . Memnon was situated on the northern border of the Calim Desert , at the mouth of the River Agis , and along the Trade Way .
description_long: Memnon Memnon , a key port of trade for Calimshan , was the former capital of the efreet i kingdom of Memnonnar and the birthplace of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri . Geography and Layout . Memnon was situated on the northern border of the Calim Desert , at the mouth of the River Agis , and along the Trade Way . Government . While the official ruler of the city in 1370 DR was Sultan Arin yn Kahar el Sujil , the real power was in the hands of his vizar , Anders el Gnurlbrach . Despite being a half - orc , since at least 1357 DR , Anders was very popular both with the general populace of Memnon and with the syl - pasha of Calimshan . This was in part because he established an elected city council . Military . Memnon served as the northernmost naval base for the " Qysanallojal " , Calimshan ' s navy . The ships docked here were the smallest and fastest in the fleet , designed for scouting and anti - piracy purposes . In 1357 DR , the navy was growing so quickly , that fishermen were being forced to find new docks . Trade . Memnon was a key trade city for Calimshan .

title: Memnon ( efreeti )
description: Memnon ( efreeti ) The Great Pasha Memnon was a noble efreeti lord who founded the country of Memnonnar and fought a great war against the djinni Calim . His spirit was trapped for millennia in the Calim Desert , where it still warred against Calim , being the legendary cause of the desert ' s very existence . Description .
description_long: Memnon ( efreeti ) The Great Pasha Memnon was a noble efreeti lord who founded the country of Memnonnar and fought a great war against the djinni Calim . His spirit was trapped for millennia in the Calim Desert , where it still warred against Calim , being the legendary cause of the desert ' s very existence . Description . Memnon ' s appearance was not recorded in history , though many desert travelers described his manifestations as Memnon ' s Crackle . When Memnon ' s consciousness was present in the desert ground , several things were noticeable . First , there was rapid rise in temperature . In response , the ground would calcify and " crackle " . Memnon ' s crackle was extremely dangerous , as desert travelers could find themselves in a situation much like quick sand , as formerly hardened ground became loose sand . It would take a number of days for the ground to harden back to its usual barren flatness . At times , Memnon could gather enough power to shape the sands into an image of his old self , a mournful face within a 70 - foot - wide ( 21 meters ) sand dune . At other times , he would manifest as a 50 - foot - tall ( 15 meters ) column of blazing hot sand and flame .

title: Memnonnar
description: Memnonnar Memnonnar was the remains of the city center of Memnon from the time when it was the capital city of the kingdom of Memnonnar under the Great Pasha Memnon . A portal to the Elemental Plane of Fire still existed deep below the ruins as late as 1374 DR .
description_long: Memnonnar Memnonnar was the remains of the city center of Memnon from the time when it was the capital city of the kingdom of Memnonnar under the Great Pasha Memnon . A portal to the Elemental Plane of Fire still existed deep below the ruins as late as 1374 DR .

title: Men of the Basilisk
description: Men of the Basilisk The Men of the Basilisk was a society of wealthy merchants and nobles with a thirst for adventure . History . The society was rigorously all - male , and the name of the group came from the admission ritual that consisted in looking in the eyes of a basilisk .
description_long: Men of the Basilisk The Men of the Basilisk was a society of wealthy merchants and nobles with a thirst for adventure . History . The society was rigorously all - male , and the name of the group came from the admission ritual that consisted in looking in the eyes of a basilisk . The Men of the Basilisk had chapters in Cormyr , Sembia , Westgate , and Iriaebor . They usually met in large feasts one or more times each winter in Teziir in order to discuss their plans for the next year and make business . They preferred using subtle methods , like assassination , bribes , torture , and fear . In 1370 DR , the Cormyrian chapter was seriously decimated by the War Wizards of Cormyr , forcing the surviving members into hiding . On the other hand , the Sembian chapter grew greatly , thanks to their new local leader Harlyn Grimmerhand . In Westgate , the Men , which had been long stopped in their business by the power of the Night Masks , increased their activities during the lack of leadership in the guild . In Iriaebor , the chapter had recently recovered after a setback by Lord Bron and the Harpers .

title: Menes Azludde
description: Menes Azludde Menes Azludde was the lead priest of Cyric in Skullport . Personality . Menes was a charismatic but very ambitious individual .
description_long: Menes Azludde Menes Azludde was the lead priest of Cyric in Skullport . Personality . Menes was a charismatic but very ambitious individual . His goal was to rule not only Skullport , but Waterdeep and after the whole North . History . Around 1370 DR , Menes plotted to turn the people of Skullport to devotion to the Black Sun , using a web of dozens of beings working individually on separate , seemingly unrelated tasks . His aim was to cause people to lose faith in the status quo and choose the Church of Cyric as the new authorities of the city . However , Menes ' s plan attracted the ire of the Agents of the Eye , the Dark Dagger , the Harpers , the Iron Ring , the Keepers , and , most importantly , the Skulls of Skullport , hinting that soon he would fall .

title: Mennek Ariz
description: Mennek Ariz Mennek Ariz was a traitorous Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford . Personality . Mennek , as an enchanter , greatly despised the preeminence of the necromancers over his land and secretly aligned with rebels who sought to overthrow Szass Tam and the necromancers from control of Thay .
description_long: Mennek Ariz Mennek Ariz was a traitorous Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford . Personality . Mennek , as an enchanter , greatly despised the preeminence of the necromancers over his land and secretly aligned with rebels who sought to overthrow Szass Tam and the necromancers from control of Thay . History . Mennek was an enchanter in his home of Thay and secretly a member of the rebels known as the Thayan Resurrection . He volunteered for a mission to Daggerford . Here , Mennek tried to find an opportunity to turn his situation around and this opportunity arrived in the form of a pit fiend named Baazka . Baazka tried to possess him but failed . Mennek sensed the event and made a bargain with the pit fiend . Using Baazka ' s knowledge , he rose to prominence among his fellows in Bloodgate . He helped adventurers sent by Sir Isteval to ruin some Red Wizard plots in Daggerford in 1485 DR . In early 1486 DR , he was captured by Daggerford ' s militiamen thanks to information from Baazka through Shalendra Floshin . Mennek knew the pit fiend ' s plot and agreed . The goal of Mennek and his fellow rebels was to destroy Bloodgate Keep in order to show the weakness of Red Wizard necromancers .

title: Mentalism domain
description: Mentalism domain The Mentalism domain ( not to be confused with the Mind domain of Ilsensine ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters mentalism spell powers . They can temporarily ward their minds against external effects . Deities with the Mentalism domain .
description_long: Mentalism domain The Mentalism domain ( not to be confused with the Mind domain of Ilsensine ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters mentalism spell powers . They can temporarily ward their minds against external effects . Deities with the Mentalism domain . Only two deities remain that sponsor the Mentalism domain , both of whom are favored by psion s .

title: Mentor
description: Mentor The Mentor was a mysterious human archmage who lived for some time in Cormanthyr . He lived for many years in the elf city perfectly disguised as an elf . He only revealed himself in 261 DR for the creation of the " mythal " of Myth Drannor , offering his help in the creation .
description_long: Mentor The Mentor was a mysterious human archmage who lived for some time in Cormanthyr . He lived for many years in the elf city perfectly disguised as an elf . He only revealed himself in 261 DR for the creation of the " mythal " of Myth Drannor , offering his help in the creation .

title: Menzoberra
description: Menzoberra Menzoberra was a drow high priestess of Lolth , who founded the city of Menzoberranzan . History . After decades of infighting among the drow of Golothaer , and at the behest of the Spider Queen , who gave her the title " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen one ) , Menzoberra the Kinless led seven drow families from their southern holdings of Great Bhaerynden into the Northdark .
description_long: Menzoberra Menzoberra was a drow high priestess of Lolth , who founded the city of Menzoberranzan . History . After decades of infighting among the drow of Golothaer , and at the behest of the Spider Queen , who gave her the title " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen one ) , Menzoberra the Kinless led seven drow families from their southern holdings of Great Bhaerynden into the Northdark . By - 3917 DR , after several years in the dark deeps of the Underdark , the refugees came to a giant cavern inhabited by a swarm of spider s and the legendary beholder , Many Eyes . After a long battle with many losses for the drow , Menzoberra laid the final blow on the beholder . When the battle was over , a yochlol appeared in front of the surviving drow proclaiming the cavern was to be their new home : " Menzoberranzan " in recognition of Menzoberra ' s service to Lolth .

title: Menzoberranzan
description: Menzoberranzan Menzoberranzan , the City of Spiders , was a large underground drow city - state in the Upper Northdark . Menzoberranzan was possibly the most well known drow city in Faerûn . It was the home of Drizzt Do ' Urden , and many of his early adventures dealt with the political intrigue and characters of the city .
description_long: Menzoberranzan Menzoberranzan , the City of Spiders , was a large underground drow city - state in the Upper Northdark . Menzoberranzan was possibly the most well known drow city in Faerûn . It was the home of Drizzt Do ' Urden , and many of his early adventures dealt with the political intrigue and characters of the city . It was located in the Upper Northdark , about 3 . 2km ( 2 miles ) below the Surbrin Valley , between the Moonwood and the Frost Hills . It was quite close to Mithral Hall and was connected through tunnels to that settlement . Other tunnels led to the surface , namely in the Moonwood and on the western edge of the High Forest . Drygully Tunnel was a tunnel leading from the Underdark near Menzoberranzan to the surface . The deep gnome city Blingdenstone was located about 45 miles to the west of Menzoberranzan . Ched Nasad was some distance to the southwest on the other side of Araumycos , a journey of several tendays from Menzoberranzan . The path through Ammarindar was the quickest journey between Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad , but it was less traveled because of the danger that lurked there . Structure .

title: Menzoberranzan ( game )
description: Menzoberranzan ( game ) Menzoberranzan was developed by DreamForge Internainment , Inc . in 1994 and published by SSI , who also published other titles of the Forgotten Realms Setting , like Al - Qadim - The Genies Curse . It was a first person role - playing game in a similiar style like Ultima Underworld or the Might and Magic games of that time .
description_long: Menzoberranzan ( game ) Menzoberranzan was developed by DreamForge Internainment , Inc . in 1994 and published by SSI , who also published other titles of the Forgotten Realms Setting , like Al - Qadim - The Genies Curse . It was a first person role - playing game in a similiar style like Ultima Underworld or the Might and Magic games of that time . The player started with two heros in a small village , which is under attack of evil drow . They follow them into the Underdark to the mighty drow - city Menzoberranzan . Plot . The game begins in a small town in Icewind Dale where the two player heroes return from a adventure to the greetings and cheers of the locals . But as the festivities carry on late at night the town is raided by a drow party . The drow capture a group of villagers and escape with them , and the heroes are charged with the quest to retrieve them . As the heroes take their steps out of the town tavern to aid in the defense against the lingering drow , they also have to put out the fire that was started in the village store . As the invaders have been repelled and the fire put out the heroes will be given a special helmet by the town ' s innkeeper .

title: Meo
description: Meo The Meo family was a noble family based in the city of Xai Chung in Koryo . They had an ancestral mansion there . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered the children of Meo Yungdo — Meo Cha and Meo Li — be kidnapped and sold into slavery .
description_long: Meo The Meo family was a noble family based in the city of Xai Chung in Koryo . They had an ancestral mansion there . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered the children of Meo Yungdo — Meo Cha and Meo Li — be kidnapped and sold into slavery . His reason remains unknown ; it may have been for leverage against Yungdo , or in cruel revenge over some perceived offense . Fortunately , Meo Cha and Meo Li were reunited and managed to escape . They eventually returned safely to Koryo , where the tyrant king had abdicated and their father became advisor to the new king , Wanang Sun , by 1357 DR .

title: Meo Cha
description: Meo Cha Meo Cha was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Cha was the son of Meo Yungdo and brother of Meo Li .
description_long: Meo Cha Meo Cha was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Cha was the son of Meo Yungdo and brother of Meo Li . Activities . Meo Cha studied at the Do Jang of Won Kwang , a prestigious military academy in the city of Pyong Do . There he was educated and trained in the arts of war and the history and lore of Koryo . History . Meo Cha ' s father sent him to the Do Jang of Won Kwang at the age of 6 . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered Meo Cha ( then aged 19 ) and Meo Li to be kidnapped and sold into slavery . His reason remains unknown ; it may have been for leverage against Yungdo , or in cruel revenge over some perceived offense . Meo Cha was visiting the city of Tu Pe when he was robbed and captured . Fortunately , Meo Cha and Meo Li were reunited and managed to escape . They stowed away on a ship that , rather than being bound for Xai Chung as they ' d thought , was in fact part of the king ' s own secret invasion fleet , now underway for Kozakura . But a tsunami wrecked the whole armada and the siblings were lost at sea .

title: Meo Li
description: Meo Li Meo Li was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Li was the daughter of Meo Yungdo and sister of Meo Cha .
description_long: Meo Li Meo Li was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Li was the daughter of Meo Yungdo and sister of Meo Cha . Activities . Meo Li had spent her whole life in Xai Chung , raised at the family ' s ancestral mansion . She was kept cloistered with the women of the household : her mother and her maiden aunt , female servants , and tutors . She was taught the skills of calligraphy , poetry , languages , and courtly etiquette . She learned many stories of the realm and its creatures . History . Although sheltered , when she was 14 , she saw three dead bodies of members of Koryo ' s " night brotherhoods " in Lu Chan Street " circa " 1347 DR , apparently having slain each other for dark secrets . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered " nameless ones " of one of these brotherhoods to kidnap Meo Li ( then only 17 ) and Meo Cha and sell them into slavery . His reason remains unknown ; it may have been for leverage against Yungdo , or in cruel revenge over some perceived offense . The ninja swung down from the rooftops , used magic sleep powder on her , and whisked her away from her guards .

title: Meo Yungdo
description: Meo Yungdo Meo Yungdo was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo . He was governor of Xai Chung and advisor to King Wanang Sun around 1357 DR . Relations .
description_long: Meo Yungdo Meo Yungdo was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo . He was governor of Xai Chung and advisor to King Wanang Sun around 1357 DR . Relations . Meo Yungdo had two children . His son , Meo Cha , he sent to the Do Jang of Won Kwang , a prestigious military academy in Pyong Do . His daughter , Meo Li , remained at the family ' s ancestral mansion in Xai Chung . History . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered " nameless ones " to kidnap Meo Yungdo ' s children and sell them into slavery . His reason remains unknown ; it may have been for leverage against Yungdo , or in cruel revenge over some perceived offense . Meo Cha and Meo Li managed to escape and ultimately returned home , while the tyrant king abdicated . By around 1357 DR , Yungdo had been appointed advisor to the new king , Wanang Sun .

title: Mephasm
description: Mephasm Mephasm was an pit fiend polymorph ed into the form of an elderly half - elf , who was in the service of Ammon Jerro . History . Mephasm was probably the most powerful of devil s and demon s in service to Jerro .
description_long: Mephasm Mephasm was an pit fiend polymorph ed into the form of an elderly half - elf , who was in the service of Ammon Jerro . History . Mephasm was probably the most powerful of devil s and demon s in service to Jerro . Previously he was a servant of Prince Levistus , ruler of Stygia in the Nine Hells . Mephasm helped save Shandra Jerro from the githyanki and later met the Kalach - Cha within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . However , he broke free when Baalbisan convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the fiends to the haven , the last before Ammon killed Shandra . Personality . Unlike the other fiends Jerro had in his haven , Mephasm remained relatively cordial and polite , even to Ammon . He seemed to be the most helpful to the party , even warning of possible danger to Shandra . As the fiends were freed by Shandra ' s actions , he commented to her that what she did was brave and foolish . When Ammon killed her in his rage , instead of taunting him , he simply chided him for the deed , seemingly disappointed by his rash assault .

title: Mephistopheles
description: Mephistopheles Mephistopheles , also known as the Lord of No Mercy and the Cold Lord , is the lord of Cania , the eighth of the Nine Hells . He was the main opponent of Baalzebul during the Reckoning of Hell , and still holds a claim to his own layer . He seeks to take Baalzebul ' s layer away from him , that he may gain enough power to one day challenge Asmodeus for rulership of all the Nine Hells .
description_long: Mephistopheles Mephistopheles , also known as the Lord of No Mercy and the Cold Lord , is the lord of Cania , the eighth of the Nine Hells . He was the main opponent of Baalzebul during the Reckoning of Hell , and still holds a claim to his own layer . He seeks to take Baalzebul ' s layer away from him , that he may gain enough power to one day challenge Asmodeus for rulership of all the Nine Hells . Mephistopheles is something of a walking contradiction . Unstable and thoroughly wicked , he presents multiple faces to those he meets . On the one hand , he can be charming , erudite , and civil . But beneath the veneer of respectability is a vicious temper and unchecked ambition . He is patient and cunning , yet when alone , he flies into a fury , screaming and shrieking , tearing at his skin and destroying everything around him in a thunderous explosion of hellfire and devastating magic . He has one goal , one reason for existence : He covets Asmodeus ’ s throne . It is , in his mind , his destiny to rule the Nine Hells . So confident is he that he has told this to Asmodeus himself .

title: Mephit
description: Mephit Mephits were extraplanar , outsider creatures similar to imps . They were not native to the material plane as they are somewhat linked to various elemental or quasi - elemental planes of existence . Mephits were roughly humanoid in appearance and somewhat small ; approximately 4 feet ( 1 .
description_long: Mephit Mephits were extraplanar , outsider creatures similar to imps . They were not native to the material plane as they are somewhat linked to various elemental or quasi - elemental planes of existence . Mephits were roughly humanoid in appearance and somewhat small ; approximately 4 feet ( 1 . 2 meters ) in height . Their disposition depended on their plane of origin , though they were rarely endearing . Each type of mephit had some form of breath weapon , which could usually do minor elemental damage , though it was mostly intended to ward off would - be attackers .

title: Merah
description: Merah Merah was a chiang lung dragon in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Merah resided at the bottom of the lake .
description_long: Merah Merah was a chiang lung dragon in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Merah resided at the bottom of the lake . He must asked for forgiveness to all people that entered the cave History . The Celestial Bureaucracy created the Guar - Sar Caves as epitome of heaven . When a tribe of hai nu and a tribe of wong gua both asked to the gods to live inside the Celestial Emperor ruled that they must divided the area and Merah was chosen to oversaw about and settled any disputes between the tribes . In 1358 thank to the evil deeds of Governor Kawabi the hai nu and the wong gua went in war each others ; the Celestial Bureaucracy tried to warn Merah but he was asleep at the bottom of the lake . Enraged the gods destroyed the two races and Merah was transformed in a ghost condemned to oversaw for all eternity this unholy place .

title: Meralaine
description: Meralaine Meralaine was a young human necromancer from Luthcheq . After Tchazzar lifted restrictions on mage s , Meralaine joined the Chessenta n army during the war with Threskel . She angered Tchazzar , who had a strong dislike for the undead , when she raised the dead during a battle .
description_long: Meralaine Meralaine was a young human necromancer from Luthcheq . After Tchazzar lifted restrictions on mage s , Meralaine joined the Chessenta n army during the war with Threskel . She angered Tchazzar , who had a strong dislike for the undead , when she raised the dead during a battle . After the war she joined the Brotherhood of the Griffon and fell in love with the wizard Oraxes . Description . Meralaine is dimunitive and has a snub nose .

title: Meralda Ganderlay
description: Meralda Ganderlay Meralda Ganderlay , also known as Meralda Auck , was a human woman from the fiefdom of Auckney near the Spine of the World . Relationships . She was the daughter of Dohmi and Biaste Ganderlay , who were farmers on the side of Maerlon Mountain .
description_long: Meralda Ganderlay Meralda Ganderlay , also known as Meralda Auck , was a human woman from the fiefdom of Auckney near the Spine of the World . Relationships . She was the daughter of Dohmi and Biaste Ganderlay , who were farmers on the side of Maerlon Mountain . The young lord Feringal Auck fell in love with her . She eventually married him , but not before she conceiving a child ( Colson ) by Jaka Sculi . The child was adopted by Wulfgar , despite ( or perhaps due to ) her having accused him of rape . Wulfgar returned Colson to her mother in Auckney after the death of his wife , Delly Curtie .

title: Merap
description: Merap Merap " Dead - eyed " was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Merap received his nickname " Dead - eyes " from his ugly appearance .
description_long: Merap Merap " Dead - eyed " was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Merap received his nickname " Dead - eyes " from his ugly appearance . His head was bald . Personality . Merap smiled a lot but always with a cold emotionless smile . Possessions . Merap wore throwing dagger s on his belt . Relationships . Merap was the brother of Maera , the second in command of the Company . History . Merap and his sister were old allies of Bramas Thorntree , like all in the Company of the Anvil . In 1370 DR , he joined the Company , and together they recovered the " Sondarr Scepter " from a long - forgotten dwarven tomb in the Starspire Mountains . They had been ordered to maintain a low profile and , on their return journey on Uktar 10 , stopped at the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth for drink . Later that night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . However , the dwarves accidentally engaged in a brawl with the Shields of the Highland adventuring company . Merap joined in the brawl .

title: Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate
description: Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate The Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate was a mercenary recruitment organization based in Westgate around 1358 DR . Membership . The Guild was proud to recruit only from the best merchant families of Westgate .
description_long: Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate The Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate was a mercenary recruitment organization based in Westgate around 1358 DR . Membership . The Guild was proud to recruit only from the best merchant families of Westgate . Tactics . Usually , the Guild used cavalry attacks , despite their recruits sometimes being too untrained to use them efficiently . Contracts . The Guild charged 250 gold piece s per week for services of 100 men , with more money needed if the employers wanted something more . With the presence of Palla in the field , they needed to pay double . History . The Guild operated exclusively in the Western Heartlands . They defeated pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars , orc s in the Hullack Forest , and fought together with the Dalefolk against Lashan Aumersair .

title: Mercenary barbarian
description: Mercenary barbarian Mercenary barbarians were a special type of warrior found in Zakhara . In some ways they were the counterparts to mamluk s . Requirements .
description_long: Mercenary barbarian Mercenary barbarians were a special type of warrior found in Zakhara . In some ways they were the counterparts to mamluk s . Requirements . There were no special requirements for mercenary barbarians , but all hailed from the hills , jungle , or plains . Role . Those who didn ' t have slave warriors ( mamluks ) often hired mercenary barbarians to do their fighting for them . As such , these warriors were considered a necessary evil . These warriors were awkward when associating with anyone not of their homeland . They were often strong fighters , but not as adept at fighting as a single unit as mamluks were . Possessions . Mercenary barbarians had an unlimited amount of choice when selecting their equipment , as long as their purse could back up their selections . Special Benefits . These warriors were especially intimidating toward other human or humanoid natives of Zakhara . Special Hindrances . Their bad reputation hindered these warriors when dealing with all not from their native homeland .

title: Merchant ' s Home
description: Merchant ' s Home The Merchant ' s Home was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . The Merchant ' s Home was regarded by many as being the finest caravanserai in all of Golden Huzuz . Description .
description_long: Merchant ' s Home The Merchant ' s Home was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . The Merchant ' s Home was regarded by many as being the finest caravanserai in all of Golden Huzuz . Description . This five - story structure held a paved central court . Activities . Due to its reputation , reservation for lodging at the Merchant ' s Home needed to be made at least a year in advance . Several upstanding merchants held regular rooms here . The Merchant ' s Home often hired famous entertainers and even a skilled illusionist to dazzle their patrons . Barber s and rawun s could find gainful employment here since the proprietor was always looking to extend the comfort level of his guests . Though all caravanserai boasted that they offered everything a caravan needed , none could fulfill that promise compared to the Merchant ' s Home . In addition to offering fine dining , splendid lodging , and grand entertainment , the Merchant ' s Home could enlist outside help for fulfilling needs such as acquiring new horses or even hiring mercenaries or adventurers as caravan guards . Inhabitants . Tun Hayal owned the Merchant ' s Home .

title: Merchant ' s League
description: Merchant ' s League The Merchant ' s League was an organization based in Baldur ' s Gate that promoted safety among the caravan routes throughout the region surrounding the city . The League began to decline in the mid - fourteenth century Dalereckoning due to many other local costers being formed . Under the leadership of Dabron Sashenstar and with the backing of the Dukes of Baldur ' s Gate , the Merchant ' s League began to challenge the Iron Throne for the weapons trade in the Western Heartlands .
description_long: Merchant ' s League The Merchant ' s League was an organization based in Baldur ' s Gate that promoted safety among the caravan routes throughout the region surrounding the city . The League began to decline in the mid - fourteenth century Dalereckoning due to many other local costers being formed . Under the leadership of Dabron Sashenstar and with the backing of the Dukes of Baldur ' s Gate , the Merchant ' s League began to challenge the Iron Throne for the weapons trade in the Western Heartlands .

title: Merchant - rogue
description: Merchant - rogue Merchant - rogues were businessmen and - women in Zakhara who also stole from their clients from time to time . Requirements . Only thieves could be merchant - rogues .
description_long: Merchant - rogue Merchant - rogues were businessmen and - women in Zakhara who also stole from their clients from time to time . Requirements . Only thieves could be merchant - rogues . Role . Merchant - rogues were traders first and thieves second . Business was their lifeblood . They could be found all over the entire continent of Zakhara . They often dealt in stolen goods . Possessions . As soon as they could afford it , merchant - rogues usually flaunted their wealth with extravagant clothing and other equipment . Skills . Merchant - rogues were able to buy in bulk from suppliers , gaining product at a much cheaper price than the commoner . Owning a business provided them with somewhat steady income compared others , though they did have to pay taxes and deal with corrupt tax collectors . Business was their lifeblood .

title: Merchant prince
description: Merchant prince Merchant Prince , or Merchant Princess , is a prestige class whose members either acquired their business through inheritence or earned their coin on their own . Merchant princes affect much of the economies throughout Faerûn and their mercantile holdings are often quite vast . Becoming a merchant prince .
description_long: Merchant prince Merchant Prince , or Merchant Princess , is a prestige class whose members either acquired their business through inheritence or earned their coin on their own . Merchant princes affect much of the economies throughout Faerûn and their mercantile holdings are often quite vast . Becoming a merchant prince . Most merchant princes are either rogue s or bard s , although a few ranger s and fighter s are known have the necessary skills . Cleric s of Waukeen and Shaundakul are not uncommon among the ranks of the merchant princes .

title: Merchants ' Avenue
description: Merchants ' Avenue Merchants ' Avenue was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Merchants ' Avenue branched off of the Road to Enlightenment near the juncture of the South District , Peasants ' District , and Pilgrims ' District .
description_long: Merchants ' Avenue Merchants ' Avenue was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Merchants ' Avenue branched off of the Road to Enlightenment near the juncture of the South District , Peasants ' District , and Pilgrims ' District . The road traveled northwest toward the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District , serving as a boundary between the Central District and Peasants ' District for much of its length .

title: Merchants ' District
description: Merchants ' District The Merchants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in northwest Huzuz , this district served as the prime location for trade and business transactions between vendors , or large - scale merchant families , and their customers .
description_long: Merchants ' District The Merchants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in northwest Huzuz , this district served as the prime location for trade and business transactions between vendors , or large - scale merchant families , and their customers . The Merchants ' District was bordered by the Northwest District on the west , the Warehouse District on the east , and the Peasants ' District and Central District to the south . The famous Grand Bazaar dominated the southern portion of the Merchants ' District , serving as the ultimate destination for many major roads within Huzuz ; including the Fishers ' Road , the Grand Bazaar Boulevard , the River Road , the Clothiers ' Way , the Farmers ' Road , and the Merchants ' Avenue . Inhabitants . Merchants of all sorts could be found within the Merchants ' District . Tax collectors were also present to ensure the crown received their share of the profits . This district was constantly patrolled by guards , making it a relatively safe place to conduct business .

title: Merdrith
description: Merdrith Merdrith the Mad was a former zulkir of the Red Wizards until his self - imposed exile to the High Forest . Description . Merdrith had head tattoos marking him as a Red Wizard and his beard was dyed red .
description_long: Merdrith Merdrith the Mad was a former zulkir of the Red Wizards until his self - imposed exile to the High Forest . Description . Merdrith had head tattoos marking him as a Red Wizard and his beard was dyed red . He appeared as a hermit in plain and bedraggled clothes . History . About 1360 DR , a group of Red Wizards with Merdrith in tow attacked the Watchtower in Rashemen and gained the Windwalker amulet and a magical ebony staff . Merdrith killed all of his companions in order to seize the treasure for himself , effectively ensuring he could never again return to Thay . He used the ebony staff to control a magical hut with chicken legs . While he was out , a Rashemi named Fyodor raided the hut to retrieve the Windwalker , which he needed to fulfill a quest . Merdrith retired to a new home in the High Forest ( where he lived close to Eilistraee ans , which he hated ) . He was recruited by the drow Gorlist and Brindlor Zidorion to aid in their pursuit of Liriel Baenre ( who , unbeknownst to Merdrith , was traveling with Fyodor , who had been the one to raid his house ) and the Windwalker .

title: Mere of Dead Men
description: Mere of Dead Men The Mere of Dead Men ( or Merdelain , meaning " Slow Marching Court " in Elvish ) was a swampy area located along the Sword Coast North . Etymology . The name " Mere of Dead Men " referred to the thousands of dwarves , elves , and human s of the Fallen Kingdom who were slain here during the invasion of an orc army .
description_long: Mere of Dead Men The Mere of Dead Men ( or Merdelain , meaning " Slow Marching Court " in Elvish ) was a swampy area located along the Sword Coast North . Etymology . The name " Mere of Dead Men " referred to the thousands of dwarves , elves , and human s of the Fallen Kingdom who were slain here during the invasion of an orc army . Geography . The Mere was located along the Sword Coast on the Sea of Swords between Neverwinter and Waterdeep . The High Road skirted its eastern edges on its way through the foothills of the Sword Mountains to the east . The nearest significant settlement was Leilon to the north . Description . The Mere of Dead Men was a cold saltwater swamp roughly 100 miles ( 160 km ) long by 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide along the shore . It was a desolate place full of monsters and few members of the civilized races . The swamp constantly grew over time , swallowing homes and property located close to its boundaries . It was believed that the eastern boundary of the Mere was magically bound to the High Road ( perhaps via a " wish " spell from the Mere ' s creator ) , since attempts to reroute the road were futile and only caused the expansion of the swamp .

title: Merfolk
description: Merfolk Merfolk are aquatic humanoids that have the upper body , arms , and head of a fair - featured human from the waist up and instead of legs it has a fish - like tail from the hips down . Males are called " Mermen " , while females are called " Mermaids " . Their humanoid features are fey - like , more similar to elves than humans .
description_long: Merfolk Merfolk are aquatic humanoids that have the upper body , arms , and head of a fair - featured human from the waist up and instead of legs it has a fish - like tail from the hips down . Males are called " Mermen " , while females are called " Mermaids " . Their humanoid features are fey - like , more similar to elves than humans . Merfolk are capable of interacting with surface folk , as they can survive outside of the water . They do so rarely , however , as they cannot walk on land . Society . Merfolk live in cities and isolated settlements within shallow seas and coral reefs , where protection and food is abundant . They train aquatic animals to serve as their guardians , similar to the way humans train dogs and horses . Merfolk ' s only natural enemy is the Sahuagin . ( Sahuagin are a fish - like , monstrous - humanoid species that live in oceans , seas , underground lakes , and underwater caves . ) Merfolk worshipped the god Eadro . Locations . There were merfolk that dwelt in the Trackless Sea and Sea of Swords .

title: Mergandevinasander
description: Mergandevinasander Mergandevinasander was a black dragon that resided in Chult . Description . Mergandevinasander had purple eyes .
description_long: Mergandevinasander Mergandevinasander was a black dragon that resided in Chult . Description . Mergandevinasander had purple eyes . History . Mergandevinasander was hatched in 659 DR in Zakhara . While still a wyrmling , he was cast out from his mother ' s lair . He wandered the south for decades before he settled in the Chultan Peninsula . There he terrorized the inhabitants for hundreds of miles around him . After reading of Mergandevinasander in a book of dragon lore , Drizzt Do ' Urden used the color of Mergandevinasander ' s eyes to briefly fool Hephaestus into believing that Drizzt was Mergandevinasander trapped in drow form , thanks to the drow ' s own violet eyes . Mergandevinasander was alive as of 1374 DR .

title: Merial Luenath
description: Merial Luenath Duchess Merial Luenath was the ruler of Luenath in Dambrath and the head of Clan Luenath . Activities . Merial was one of the most powerful figures in Dambrath , second only to Queen Yenandra .
description_long: Merial Luenath Duchess Merial Luenath was the ruler of Luenath in Dambrath and the head of Clan Luenath . Activities . Merial was one of the most powerful figures in Dambrath , second only to Queen Yenandra . The cities of Luenath , Hethar , and Prastuil were completely loyal to her . She felt that she should be queen instead of Yenandra , but the daily strain of managing the affairs of three large cities consumed most of her time . Possessions . The duchess wore a [ [ ring of sleeplessness ] that she used often in order to have time to attend all of her duties . Appendix . References .
