title: Merinid Dalael
description: Merinid Dalael Merinid Dalael was a drow assassin member of Jaezred Chaulssin in Menzoberranzan in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 Merinid penetrated in the abandoned House Srune ' Lett compound , , one of the lairs used by members of the Council of Spiders .
description_long: Merinid Dalael Merinid Dalael was a drow assassin member of Jaezred Chaulssin in Menzoberranzan in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 Merinid penetrated in the abandoned House Srune ' Lett compound , , one of the lairs used by members of the Council of Spiders . There he killed the Council ' s elder Raelaryn Xorlarrin and captured Hoshtar Xorlarrin , Raelaryn ' s cousin . Appendix . Gameplay . During " Council of Spiders " , Merinid could threaten to kill Hoshtar to force the adventurers to surrender . However , the official summary states that they successfully saved him .

title: Merith Baenre
description: Merith Baenre Merith Baenre was a drow priestess of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . History . Merith once was the daughter of a street sweeper but her considerable clerical powers convinced Yvonnel Baenre to adopt Merith as her daughter .
description_long: Merith Baenre Merith Baenre was a drow priestess of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . History . Merith once was the daughter of a street sweeper but her considerable clerical powers convinced Yvonnel Baenre to adopt Merith as her daughter . Around 1361 DR , Merith was the second - most - powerful priestess of her House and Matron Mother Triel Baenre considered her for the next Mistress of Arach - Tinilith . However , Merith ' s poor capacity for protocol and intrigue and her extreme sadism changed Triel ' s mind and the Matron Mother searched for another candidate .

title: Merith Strongbow
description: Merith Strongbow Merith Strongbow was an elven fighter mage and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . His familiar was a black cat named Shadowclaw . Appearance .
description_long: Merith Strongbow Merith Strongbow was an elven fighter mage and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . His familiar was a black cat named Shadowclaw . Appearance . Merith was tall , standing five feet ten inches . He had dark black hairand one blue colored eye and one green colored eye . He wore both wands and his sword on his belt . History . Merith was born to Laerune and Lianthorn Strongbow on the banks of the river Duathamper in 1161 DR

title: Meritid Archneie
description: Meritid Archneie Meritid Archneie was the Dread High Trident of Umberlee living in the Queenspire within Waterdeep . Personality . While Meritid was a faithful follower of Umberlee , he was also an agent of the Kraken Society , who operated out of the city .
description_long: Meritid Archneie Meritid Archneie was the Dread High Trident of Umberlee living in the Queenspire within Waterdeep . Personality . While Meritid was a faithful follower of Umberlee , he was also an agent of the Kraken Society , who operated out of the city . History . In 1369 DR , Metritid discovered a magic abalone shell floating in Waterdeep harbor which he thought was the mythical " Orglara " , an ancient text of the Bitch Queen . Taking his find as a good omen , Archneie petitioned the Lords of Waterdeep to allow him to construct a temple to Umberlee within the city . The Lords agreed and as of 1372 DR , the Queenspire was still under construction .

title: Merket Oasis
description: Merket Oasis The Merket Oasis , also known as the Merket Depression , was a large valley located in the Quoya desert in the Hordelands . Description . Unlike a typical oasis , the Merket Oasis was not green or very rich in plant life .
description_long: Merket Oasis The Merket Oasis , also known as the Merket Depression , was a large valley located in the Quoya desert in the Hordelands . Description . Unlike a typical oasis , the Merket Oasis was not green or very rich in plant life . However , due to most of the streams in the Quoya Desert draining into it , the area had more plant life than the rest of the desert . The area was well known in Shou Lung for its vineyards and melons . The grapes grown here were made into sweet wines , and fine raisins , popular at the banquets of the nobility . Despite being outside the Dragonwall , and the borders of Shou Lung , the empire kept a magistrate and a small garrison in the region , at the town of Kwachow , in order to protect the valuable foods grown here .

title: Merle Pariso
description: Merle Pariso Merle Pariso was a battle - mage in Calimport in 1364 . He was considered one of the most lethal killers of the city and often worked for House Basadoni . In 1364 DR , Kadran Gordeon secretly hired him to kill Artemis Entreri .
description_long: Merle Pariso Merle Pariso was a battle - mage in Calimport in 1364 . He was considered one of the most lethal killers of the city and often worked for House Basadoni . In 1364 DR , Kadran Gordeon secretly hired him to kill Artemis Entreri . Entreri fought well against Merle but Merle ' s magical abilities eventually overwhelmed Enteri . However , when the assassin was at Merle ' s mercy , the timely arrival of Bregan D ' aerthe saved Enteri ' s life and Merle was killed by the drow .

title: Merothrax
description: Merothrax Merothrax the Greedy was a white dragon living on the slopes of Icespire Peak . Personality . Described as being " as stupid as he is greedy , " the Cult of the Dragon acquired his aid by giving him some of the mithral they were stealing from the local Icehammer dwarves .
description_long: Merothrax Merothrax the Greedy was a white dragon living on the slopes of Icespire Peak . Personality . Described as being " as stupid as he is greedy , " the Cult of the Dragon acquired his aid by giving him some of the mithral they were stealing from the local Icehammer dwarves .

title: Merquam Pang
description: Merquam Pang Merquam Pang was a human male fighter and a merchant based in the city of Xi Hulang in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was one of the most prosperous merchants in the kingdom . Description .
description_long: Merquam Pang Merquam Pang was a human male fighter and a merchant based in the city of Xi Hulang in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was one of the most prosperous merchants in the kingdom . Description . Merquam was middle - aged and of stocky build . He was missing an ear after losing it in a knife - fight , but suffered no loss of hearing . Personality . Merquam was intelligent and a shrewd businessman , but had no regard for morality or ethics in his trade nor who he worked with , caring only for profit . He was intensely jealous of his wife , and bore an irrational hatred of beggars . Activities . To advance his business interests , Merquam dealt in person with the leaders of a number of underworld organizations and yakuza clans . Holdings . Merquam owned a mansion in Xi Hulang , an estate in the farmlands north of Bejung , shops in Koje and Tu Pe , and an inn and a pawn shop in the floating city moored at Tu Pe . He also owned a fleet numbering twelve ships . Relationships . His wife was Mai Lan , a beautiful woman of Shou heritage , and he kept her cloistered in his Xi Hulang mansion .

title: Merring
description: Merring Brother Merring was a villager of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North around 1374 DR . History . Originally from Neverwinter , Merring came to the village of West Harbor .
description_long: Merring Brother Merring was a villager of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North around 1374 DR . History . Originally from Neverwinter , Merring came to the village of West Harbor . He preached about Lathander ' s teachings ( thinking it would unite the villagers ) , but the villagers worshiped Chauntea . He healed the fighters in the Harvest Brawl , and later the warriors who stood in the defense of West Harbor during the battle against bladeling s and duergar in 1374 DR .

title: Merrow
description: Merrow Merrow were undersea merfolk - like monsters from the Abyss who terrorized the waters . Demogorgon often sent his merrow to the Material Plane to bully life there . Society .
description_long: Merrow Merrow were undersea merfolk - like monsters from the Abyss who terrorized the waters . Demogorgon often sent his merrow to the Material Plane to bully life there . Society . Merrow on the Material Plane lived in undersea caves . They filled their abodes with treasures and used the rotted corpses of dead creatures tied to kelp to mark their territory . Combat . A merrow was often armed with a harpoon . It also fought with its sharp claws and its fanged bite . History . Merrow were created when a tribe of merfolk found an idol to Demogorgon that drove them all insane . The king of this tribe demanded a blood sacrifice to the idol that opened a rift to the Abyss . The corrupted merfolk slowly transformed into the monsters now known as merrow over multiple generations there .

title: Merrow ( ogre )
description: Merrow ( ogre ) Merrow , also known as sea ogres or aquatic ogres , were a breed of ogre adapted to aquatic environments . Description . Merrow living in freshwater environs were more violent and quicker than land ogres .
description_long: Merrow ( ogre ) Merrow , also known as sea ogres or aquatic ogres , were a breed of ogre adapted to aquatic environments . Description . Merrow living in freshwater environs were more violent and quicker than land ogres . They had green , scaled skin , green eyes , and seaweed - green , slimy hair . They had black teeth and nails ; webbed hands and feet ; long , thick necks ; underbites ; and sloping shoulders . One in ten merrow had ivory horns , especially the most powerful males . Merrow enjoyed tattooing their bodies . Females , especially , were often found covered in depictions of death and destruction all over their bodies . Merrow were carnivorous with voracious appetites , preying on all who entered their territory . Personality . Merrow were ignorant and superstitious brutes ; their only skills were plundering and murder . Merrow enjoyed gold and jewels and often overlooked dull magical items in favor of glittering prizes . Society . Merrow lived in shallow freshwater caves about 50 to 250 feet below the surface . They sometimes kept company with scrags ( aquatic trolls ) .

title: Meryl
description: Meryl Meryl was the halfling cook of Qilué Veladorn at the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Meryl had been Qilué ' s cook for decades and knew well all the inhabitants of the Promenade .
description_long: Meryl Meryl was the halfling cook of Qilué Veladorn at the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Meryl had been Qilué ' s cook for decades and knew well all the inhabitants of the Promenade . In 1379 DR , she spoke with Cavatina Xarann , expressing her worries about Qilué ' s mental health , because the lady had acted very strangely in recent times . However , soon after , Cavatina understood that Meryl had been replaced by a dretch and raised the alarm . Later the real Meryl was found unharmed .

title: Message
description: Message Message is a transmutation spell that lets one converse in whispers at a distance . The spell is language - dependent . Effect .
description_long: Message Message is a transmutation spell that lets one converse in whispers at a distance . The spell is language - dependent . Effect . The caster can whisper messages and receive whispered replies with little chance of being overheard . The caster points his or her finger at each creature to be included in the spell effect . When the caster whisper , the whispered message is audible to all of the targeted creatures who are within range . Magical " silence " , 30 cm ( 1 ft ) of stone , 2 . 5 cm ( 1 in ) of common metal ( or a thin sheet of lead ) , or 1 m ( 3 ft ) of wood or dirt blocks the spell . The message , however , does not have to travel in a straight line . It can circumvent a barrier if there is an open path between the caster and the subject , and the path ’ s entire length lies within the spell ’ s range . The creatures who receive the message can whisper a reply that can be heard by the caster . The spell transmits sound , not meaning . It doesn ' t transcend language barriers . Focus . A short piece of copper wire .

title: Message plate
description: Message plate A message plate was a magic item that could be used to send a message . Description . One message plate resembled a gold - hued disc , wide enough to rest on one ' s hand , with studs around the side .
description_long: Message plate A message plate was a magic item that could be used to send a message . Description . One message plate resembled a gold - hued disc , wide enough to rest on one ' s hand , with studs around the side . A glowing , colorless , animated image of the one who sent the message was projected above it . It made a " plink " sound when deactivated . Another was a silver plate with a mirrored inner part and runes running around the border . The recipient could touch certain runes to prove their identity and activate it . It played only a voice message . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , the wizard Parwyyd Hanifar sent a message plate with a false image of Priam Agrivar to lure Kyriani Agrivar to the site of the Great Door on the outskirts of Waterdeep . Kyriani believed it had been sent by Priam . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Court Magician Vangerdahast posed as the poisoned King Azoun IV when he placed a voice message on a message plate intended for Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He had Laspeera Inthré deliver the message plate to Alusair .

title: Message ring
description: Message ring Message rings were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These rings were used to record and send messages .
description_long: Message ring Message rings were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These rings were used to record and send messages . A user spoke a command and could record any message lasting up to 60 seconds . When the command word was repeated , often by someone else , the speaker ' s face appeared on the ring ' s facet , and the message was spoken aloud . A message could be repeated three times before being emptied , upon which time a new message could be created . Command words could be changed by the speaker when creating a new message . Notable Owners . Prince Tannous al - Assad and his spymaster , Sa ' id Firdawsi , made use of these rings with informants within their network of spies in Huzuz , as did Jayani al - Jasir of the Corsair Council in Hawa .

title: Messanth
description: Messanth Messanth was a bronze shadow dragon in Szith Morcane . History . The Archmage of Szith Morcane , Solom Ned ' razak , at one point captured the bronze dragon Messanth and imprisoned him inside a pocket of Shadowfell .
description_long: Messanth Messanth was a bronze shadow dragon in Szith Morcane . History . The Archmage of Szith Morcane , Solom Ned ' razak , at one point captured the bronze dragon Messanth and imprisoned him inside a pocket of Shadowfell . The shadow energies changed Messanth into a shadow dragon that lashed out at anything he saw . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , the Order of the Gauntlet asked adventurers affiliated with them to find Messanth . Relashionship . Messanth had good dealings with the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Messenger genie
description: Messenger genie Messenger genies were tasked genie s who were once djinn . These genie s served all of geniekind equally , traveling between the planes delivering a wide assortment of messages and gifts as required by their masters . Description .
description_long: Messenger genie Messenger genies were tasked genie s who were once djinn . These genie s served all of geniekind equally , traveling between the planes delivering a wide assortment of messages and gifts as required by their masters . Description . Appropriate for their hasty nature , messenger genies were lithe creatures who were constantly on the move . They preferred to wear tighter - fitting clothing than other genies and they seldom wore jewelry of any kind . An average messenger genie was 4 ft . ( 1 . 2 m ) tall . Combat . Flight was a messenger genie ' s preferred choice of action when faced with threats . If unable to flee , their quick reflexes often gave them an advantage over their opponents . Their weapons of choice were thrown dart s and dagger s , which were often coated with a rare paralytic genie poison called " bardan ruqad " . Messenger genies could use the following spell - like abilities : " aura of comfort " , " clear path " , " lighten load " , " dimensional folding " , " invisibility " , " haste " , " distance distortion " , and " shadow door " . Habitat / Society . Messenger genies rarely stopped moving .

title: Mester Rauvaraudo
description: Mester Rauvaraudo Mester Rauvaraudo was the majordomo of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was known as Master Mester to everyone that knew him . Description .
description_long: Mester Rauvaraudo Mester Rauvaraudo was the majordomo of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was known as Master Mester to everyone that knew him . Description . Mester ' s most prominent feature was his sad , deep - set brown eyes . His hair was also brown and he sported a beard and mustache that was fading with age . He had small hands and delicate features . Personality . Master Mester was a mild man , but scurried about with alacrity as he supervised the dozens of people working in the inn . Abilities . Rauvaraudo was a natural sorcerer but not very advanced . He only used his magic in front of other people in response to extreme emergencies . Possessions . He owned a " wand of hold person " and a " ring of the ram " that he utilized when the rare brawl broke out , or a guest became completely unruly . Activities .

title: Mestin Durmark
description: Mestin Durmark Mestin " Troll " Durmark was a ranger and a high - ranking member of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . Description . As her nickname suggested , Mestin was not a dainty female .
description_long: Mestin Durmark Mestin " Troll " Durmark was a ranger and a high - ranking member of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . Description . As her nickname suggested , Mestin was not a dainty female . She was above average height for a woman , and had a muscular build . Her hair was cut short to make it more manageable in the wild , and she wore mannish clothes . History . Mestin was next to Ariton Delmis as the most high - ranking member of the Riders under Randal Morn . When Randal disappeared , she helped Ariton to organize the liberation army in the Dagger Hills .

title: Mestrel Hawkmantle
description: Mestrel Hawkmantle Mestrel Hawkmantle was an Harper bard . History . Mestrel in 1357 DR was very busy : he worked as guard for a caravan carrying Harpers messages from Baldur ' s Gate to Iriaebor , found a Thay spy in Iriaebor and foiling his salving operation following the spy until Westgate , where Mestrel identified the spy ' s master and with help of a fellow Harper wizard from Suzail read the mind of the superior before killing him .
description_long: Mestrel Hawkmantle Mestrel Hawkmantle was an Harper bard . History . Mestrel in 1357 DR was very busy : he worked as guard for a caravan carrying Harpers messages from Baldur ' s Gate to Iriaebor , found a Thay spy in Iriaebor and foiling his salving operation following the spy until Westgate , where Mestrel identified the spy ' s master and with help of a fellow Harper wizard from Suzail read the mind of the superior before killing him . Thank from the informations gained Mestrel ruined a slaving operation thank to the adventuring party of the Shining Shield Band , some fellow novice Harpers and the deceived Pirates of the Fallen Stars , taking the free slaves to Yhaunn . Later in Sembia Mestrel saved a priestess of Tymora from robbery , helped fix a wagon , beat a bully and paid the debt of a veteran of the war against Lashan Aumersair , saving from debtors a widow in Saerb masquerading as her dead husband . Later he robbed and ticked a Cult of the Dragon cell , forcing them to battle the Zhentarim . later sold some Zhent agents in Hillsfar to Lord Maalthiir , unveiling a plot of Maalthir to capture some Harpers agents .

title: Metahel
description: Metahel The Metahel were a group of people who lived along the lower banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society .
description_long: Metahel The Metahel were a group of people who lived along the lower banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society . The Metahel tribes lived on the Pasocada below Raven Falls and along the coast where the river reached the ocean . They were extremely skilled at fishing and whaling . Early in their history , they constructed buildings of logs , but later they used mud and stone . Their largest settlement was Lomaraj , near the border of Azuposi territory . Language . The Metahel language was noticeably distinct from that of other tribes in the region . Trade . The Metahel traded their dried fish , whale oil , and shells to the Azuposi in exchange for their turquoise and grain . History . The Metahel moved to their current region a number of centuries ago . They had previously lived further northwest . At some point after migrating , they were at war with the Azuposi , but afterward a state of trade existed and the Azuposi influenced Metahel architecture , especially in Lomaraj .

title: Metal domain
description: Metal domain The Metal domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters metal - related spell powers . They also gained proficiency with a chosen kind of hammer weapon . Deities with the Metal domain .
description_long: Metal domain The Metal domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters metal - related spell powers . They also gained proficiency with a chosen kind of hammer weapon . Deities with the Metal domain . The following deities offered the Metal domain to their cleric s : Dumathoin , Flandal Steelskin , Gond , Grumbar , and Laduguer .

title: Metallic dragon
description: Metallic dragon Metallic dragons were a type of dragon distinguished typically by the color and composition of their scales , that was like that of various metals , hence the name . They were generally good , altruistic , and righteous creatures . Despite their relatively benign nature , metallic dragons were also aggressive when threatened or challenged .
description_long: Metallic dragon Metallic dragons were a type of dragon distinguished typically by the color and composition of their scales , that was like that of various metals , hence the name . They were generally good , altruistic , and righteous creatures . Despite their relatively benign nature , metallic dragons were also aggressive when threatened or challenged . They usually worshiped Bahamut , whom they regarded as their king . It was believed by scholars from Candlekeep that all species of metallic dragons evolved from the proto - dragon species of the ferrodraco genus . Types . Although there were many metallic dragon species , the following are the ones known by sages of Faerûn :

title: Metalmaster
description: Metalmaster Also known as a sword slug , the metalmaster was a carnivore that could magnetically attract , repulse and crudely manipulate metal objects . Description . The metalmaster was an amorphous creature with slimy purple skin , four eyes on stalks , and a round mouth of sharp teeth .
description_long: Metalmaster Also known as a sword slug , the metalmaster was a carnivore that could magnetically attract , repulse and crudely manipulate metal objects . Description . The metalmaster was an amorphous creature with slimy purple skin , four eyes on stalks , and a round mouth of sharp teeth . Pieces of metal adhered to its skin and smaller metallic bits formed a rusty entourage as it moved . Personality . Sword slugs were not much for conversation and tended to be rather single - minded about their next meal . Combat . Metalmasters could detect a pound ( 0 . 45 kg ) of metal within 60 ft ( 18 m ) and know its general direction . It could then magnetically attract or repel them , making weapons feel like they were entangled or deflecting them from hitting . Metal shields and armor that could not be dropped quickly pulled or pushed their owners with a strong constant force . The metal shards stuck to its body formed additional armor for the creature , but it could also be used to create a storm of razor - like shrapnel that swirled in a 20 ft ( 6 m ) radius . This removed the extra armor plating , making the sword slug easier to hit but more difficult to approach .

title: Metamagic
description: Metamagic Metamagic was a group of skills used by spellcasters , including wizard s , sorcerer s , illusionist s and other casters focusing exclusively on arcane magic for their survival and livelihood . Metamagic allowed casters to transcend the normal rules of magic and create effects that could be devastatingly powerful . The term metamagic was also used for a that affected the workings of other spells to the same purpose .
description_long: Metamagic Metamagic was a group of skills used by spellcasters , including wizard s , sorcerer s , illusionist s and other casters focusing exclusively on arcane magic for their survival and livelihood . Metamagic allowed casters to transcend the normal rules of magic and create effects that could be devastatingly powerful . The term metamagic was also used for a that affected the workings of other spells to the same purpose . The Purpose of Metamagic . Metamagic allowed spellcasters to augment their abilities in amazing ways . Metamagic Skills . Quicken Spell . Spellcasters with this skill could cast spells quicker , allowing them to cast more spells during the same time period , or cast a single spell before performing another action . Still Spell . This skill allowed the caster to cast a spell without having to move their hands . Silent Spell . Silent Spell allowed spellcasting by willpower alone . Spell Mastery . By sacrificing access to a stronger spell , the caster could cast a weaker spell without needing to consult their spellbook . Innate spell .

title: Metatext
description: Metatext In 1385 DR , Mystra was assassinated by Cyric , with the aid of Shar . With the death of the Goddess of Magic , the Weave began to collapse . Deneir , in an attempt to stabilize the Weave , somehow wrote himself and the Metatext into the Weave and were presumably destroyed .
description_long: Metatext In 1385 DR , Mystra was assassinated by Cyric , with the aid of Shar . With the death of the Goddess of Magic , the Weave began to collapse . Deneir , in an attempt to stabilize the Weave , somehow wrote himself and the Metatext into the Weave and were presumably destroyed .

title: Meteor swarm
description: Meteor swarm Meteor swarm was a spell that caused four meteors to fly forward and explode like " fireball s " . It had a range of over 400 ' ( 120 m ) . History .
description_long: Meteor swarm Meteor swarm was a spell that caused four meteors to fly forward and explode like " fireball s " . It had a range of over 400 ' ( 120 m ) . History . As far as any spell of such power could be called common , " meteor swarm " was commonly known and used by the magical community by 1358 DR .

title: Meth
description: Meth The Meth was a breed of light warhorse known for its short legs and sturdy disposition . Meths were first bred in Unther near the border to Chessenta around 1000 DR . They were used for pulling chariots in the Old Empires .
description_long: Meth The Meth was a breed of light warhorse known for its short legs and sturdy disposition . Meths were first bred in Unther near the border to Chessenta around 1000 DR . They were used for pulling chariots in the Old Empires . A Meth was usually gray or other solid colors . A Meth was stronger , tougher , and wiser than most light horses , but it ran a little more slowly , owing to its compact build . Meths were popular in the Vilhon Reach and cost about 45 platinum pieces .

title: Methegrist
description: Methegrist Methegrist was home to a small group of paladin s centuries before the Spellplague , known as the Moonwatchers . They were dedicated to Helm , and were appointed as protectors of the Moonlands . Methegrist was destroyed by a devil infiltrating the ranks of the Moonwatchers , and tricking Jahar to be the first to strike a fellow knight .
description_long: Methegrist Methegrist was home to a small group of paladin s centuries before the Spellplague , known as the Moonwatchers . They were dedicated to Helm , and were appointed as protectors of the Moonlands . Methegrist was destroyed by a devil infiltrating the ranks of the Moonwatchers , and tricking Jahar to be the first to strike a fellow knight . His ghost was seen passing through Quaervaar , forced into unrest by the imp Fortenesti .

title: Methil El - Viddenvelp
description: Methil El - Viddenvelp Methil El - Viddenvelp was an illithid from Phanlinksal who served Yvonnel Baenre , and later Quenthel Baenre , as a secret advisor in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . He was also the founder of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact . Descriptions .
description_long: Methil El - Viddenvelp Methil El - Viddenvelp was an illithid from Phanlinksal who served Yvonnel Baenre , and later Quenthel Baenre , as a secret advisor in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . He was also the founder of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact . Descriptions . Methil was about 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) . His head was slimy and resembled a squid with pure white eyes . By 1484 DR , Methil had become extremely powerful , existing more in mind than in body . By that point , he was also insane , either from his injury or great power , or perhaps from both . History . Background . Methil was originally from the illithid city of Phanlinksal , where he was born from the host of a human sorcerer . He quickly became one of the most influential members of the city . When House Baenre , the ruling house of Menzoberranzan , threatened the illithids , Methil agreed to serve as an advisor to Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre in order that the settlement be spared . It was also believed that he was a " double agent " keeping tabs on the drow city .

title: Methrammar Aerasumé
description: Methrammar Aerasumé High Lord Methrammar Aerasumé was a half - elf fighter and wizard and the High Lord of the Silver Marches as well as the ruler of Silverymoon . High Marshal of the Argent Legion , the army of the League of the Silver Marches . He lead 400 soldiers at Rauvinwatch Keep , about 15 miles west of Silverymoon , where a lot of time was spent training .
description_long: Methrammar Aerasumé High Lord Methrammar Aerasumé was a half - elf fighter and wizard and the High Lord of the Silver Marches as well as the ruler of Silverymoon . High Marshal of the Argent Legion , the army of the League of the Silver Marches . He lead 400 soldiers at Rauvinwatch Keep , about 15 miles west of Silverymoon , where a lot of time was spent training . Equipment . Methrammar had a bow named Swiftflight which was made for him as a parting gift by Tyresia before he left to return to his family . He armed it with + 2 magical arrows and he also carried a magical + 3 bastard sword . He wears a + 3 mithral shirt and a + 2 amulet of natural armor . Childhood . Methrammar ' s upbringing was one of high expectations because of the status of his mother . He showed skills with both magic and armed combat and it was the latter which allowed him to rise through the ranks of the Argent Legion . Personality . Methrammar was soft - spoken and humble , honest and forthright . Although he would appear to be the ideal candidate for a paladin , he favored no specific deity , and dedicated himself to Silverymoon instead . Familiar .

title: Methwood
description: Methwood The Methwood was , as of 1372 DR , a dense forest in Unther inhabited by chimera s , druid s and the green dragon Skuthosiin . It was rumoured that a potentially ancient city of the Turami was lost in the forest . As of 1374 DR , a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra , led by Talindra Amalith of the Vel ' Nikeryma , operated in the forest .
description_long: Methwood The Methwood was , as of 1372 DR , a dense forest in Unther inhabited by chimera s , druid s and the green dragon Skuthosiin . It was rumoured that a potentially ancient city of the Turami was lost in the forest . As of 1374 DR , a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra , led by Talindra Amalith of the Vel ' Nikeryma , operated in the forest .

title: Mev Flintknapper
description: Mev Flintknapper Mev Flintknapper was a deep gnome fighter in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mev was attacked by two gelatinous cube s in one of Blingdestone ' s grottoes , but was saved by a party of adventurers escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve .
description_long: Mev Flintknapper Mev Flintknapper was a deep gnome fighter in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mev was attacked by two gelatinous cube s in one of Blingdestone ' s grottoes , but was saved by a party of adventurers escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Mez ' Barris Armgo
description: Mez ' Barris Armgo Mez ' Barris Armgo was the matron mother of House Barrison Del ' Armgo , second house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Mez ' Barris Armgo was unusually tall and powerful .
description_long: Mez ' Barris Armgo Mez ' Barris Armgo was the matron mother of House Barrison Del ' Armgo , second house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Mez ' Barris Armgo was unusually tall and powerful . She was also brilliant and had a vicious cunning . She was a fierce warrior who loved single combat . History . Mez ' Barris became matron of her house prior to 1361 DR and remained in that position in 1372 DR . In 1372 DR , Mez ' Barris held nominal command of the Army of the Black Spider . At time of Rage of Demons she controlled the largest number of trained wizards and mercenaries - for - hire Possessions . Mez ' Barris had a pair of enchanted gloves that gave her great strength . Her weapons were magical maces named " Qu ' lith " ( " Blood " ) and " Qu ' uente " ( " Guts " ) . Relationships . Mez ' Barris had five daughters . Uthegental Armgo was her patron .

title: Mezro
description: Mezro Before its destruction in the Spellplague , Mezro was the largest civilized population center in Chult . It was a holy place to the Tabaxi people , being founded by their god Ubtao . Geography and Layout .
description_long: Mezro Before its destruction in the Spellplague , Mezro was the largest civilized population center in Chult . It was a holy place to the Tabaxi people , being founded by their god Ubtao . Geography and Layout . Mezro was built along the River Olung , which served as its southern and western borders . Thick jungle was found on the east and north . The city was circular and divided into four quarters by wide avenues stemming from the Temple of Ubtao at the center . Agricultural Quarter . This quarter was located in the southeast . It was divided up into farms , fields , and groves for growing bananas , berries , cassavas , nuts , papayas , plantains , sorghum , yams , and various medicinal plants . Honey was also produced here . The land was magically enhanced to ensure fertile crops . Small dinosaurs were common in this area of the city . Residential Quarter . This quarter was located in the southwest . It was a literal maze of simple , one - story , adobe - style houses . Most Mezroans lived here . The byways were of sand with rushes . Market Quarter . This quarter was located in the northwest . Here were found craftsmen , hostels , inns , and various smiths .

title: Mezzoloth
description: Mezzoloth Mezzoloths were the most common type of yugoloth encountered in the lower planes . Description . They looked like humanoid insects covered in great chitinous plates .
description_long: Mezzoloth Mezzoloths were the most common type of yugoloth encountered in the lower planes . Description . They looked like humanoid insects covered in great chitinous plates . They had long , lanky arms and legs and wide , armored skulls . Mezzoloths had long , sharp claws that could cut through most non - magical substances . They had a limited form of telepathy . Combat . Mezzoloths were of a highly magical nature and had a natural affinity for magical items . They would prefer to use magical weapons and shields in combat , but would resort to their powerful claws if none were available . Their forms were muscular , and their hides could only be hurt by magical items of a decently powerful enchantment . They were naturally immune to the affects of paralysis and poison , could not be charmed , and possessed infravision . Habitat . They were the lowest of the yugoloths . Higher yugoloths had no regard for these soldiers and used them at the front lines in battle . Due to their lack of intelligence , mezzoloths accepted their lot . Mezzoloths tended to wander the lower planes , especially the Abyss , in search of souls to torment .

title: Mhaernos Falconstar
description: Mhaernos Falconstar Mhaernos Falconstar was a human man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the owner of Falconstar Wayshipping . He was in this position by 1358 DR , and still held it in 1369 DR .
description_long: Mhaernos Falconstar Mhaernos Falconstar was a human man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the owner of Falconstar Wayshipping . He was in this position by 1358 DR , and still held it in 1369 DR . Mhaernos was a slim man with a black beard . He was cultured and had pretensions to nobility .

title: Mhair
description: Mhair Mhair was a Tethyrian human fighter who worked as a boatman at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . History . By Eleint of 1374 DR , Mhair was working at the temple , having a key role in transporting kidnapped petitioners and followers of Mystra out of the city .
description_long: Mhair Mhair was a Tethyrian human fighter who worked as a boatman at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . History . By Eleint of 1374 DR , Mhair was working at the temple , having a key role in transporting kidnapped petitioners and followers of Mystra out of the city . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , an adventuring party recruited by Tunaster Dranik to investigate the temple discovered the truth , that it was a front for the church of Shar . Activities . Acting under the orders of Lady Naedaenya Arthas , Mhair ’ s role at the temple was to smuggle the abducted , mentally dominated petitioners out of the temple and out of the city . Once a month , during the night , he loaded the captives onto a special catamaran and rowed them out through a river - cave beneath the temple , through a concealed entrance , and out into the Wyvernflow river . When the coast was clear , he pilot the catamaran across the river and deposited them on the opposite riverbank . There , he gave them a map and told them to journey to the Lost Refuge in the Vast Swamp , and there meet with Starweaver Bestra Mornscroll , whom they were to obey .

title: Mhair Gulzrabban
description: Mhair Gulzrabban Mhair Gulzrabban was the founder and leader of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Description . Mhair was a stout small man with tiny dark eyes .
description_long: Mhair Gulzrabban Mhair Gulzrabban was the founder and leader of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Description . Mhair was a stout small man with tiny dark eyes . Personality . The wizard was always in control , seeking power above all else and wanting to do as he pleased . He was always on the lookout for new ways to exploit a weakness or two in order to gain a profit . Abilities . Mhair , along with all of the other members of the Company of the Cloak , possessed an immunity to oil of taggit ( which causes memory loss ) . Relationships . Sharaera Duthtue was Mhair ' s lover and apprentice . He was prepared for her eventual turn on him . Over the years , Gulzrabban made contacts with the Zhentarim , the Red Wizards of Thay , and the Shadow Thieves and set his organization up as " adventurer killers " . History . Gulzrabban began the Company of the Cloak in 1357 DR in the city of Scornubel within the Western Heartlands . Recruiting cutthroats and brigands , Mhair assembled a band to hunt down buried treasure and forgotten lore . As time passed , he faced mutiny and dissatisfaction within his company until deciding to stalk fellow adventurers .

title: Mhair Szeltune
description: Mhair Szeltune Mhair Szeltune was the leader of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mhair was a serene yet persistent and efficient lady with an iron will .
description_long: Mhair Szeltune Mhair Szeltune was the leader of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mhair was a serene yet persistent and efficient lady with an iron will . She was an uncanny judge of character and was never mistaken about someone involved in the guild politics of Waterdeep . Activities . Mhair often wandered the city while magically disguised as an old crone , in order to check the attitudes of people toward her .

title: Mhairdren Phull
description: Mhairdren Phull Mhairdren Phull was the patriarch of House Phull of Waterdeep . Around 1440 DR , Lord Phull purchased a title of nobility from the impoverished original Phulls . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son Blakrho murdered his older brother and blamed the crime on a younger brother .
description_long: Mhairdren Phull Mhairdren Phull was the patriarch of House Phull of Waterdeep . Around 1440 DR , Lord Phull purchased a title of nobility from the impoverished original Phulls . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son Blakrho murdered his older brother and blamed the crime on a younger brother . The City Guard initially believed Blakrho but Mhairdren caught his son beating his mother and was thrown down a flight of stairs and gravely injured . Blakrho fled Waterdeep with most of Mhairdren ' s coin and his best wine .

title: Mhairshaulk
description: Mhairshaulk Mhairshaulk was the second sarrukh realm . It was contained on the Chultan Peninsula . History .
description_long: Mhairshaulk Mhairshaulk was the second sarrukh realm . It was contained on the Chultan Peninsula . History . Around - 34800 DR , Mhairshaulk was founded by the sarrukh . Around - 33500 DR , the yuan - ti gain control of the realm . Races . It was believed that the Mhairshaulkans created many races , some of which later became extinct . Those that had survived to modern times included :

title: Mhandyvver ' s Poultry
description: Mhandyvver ' s Poultry Mhandyvver ' s Poultry is a poultry shop owned by Oskler Mhandyvver , in the town of Red Larch . Mhandyvver ' s Poultry produces fowl , fresh eggs , and chicks for raising . The fowl include turkeys , chickens , and clip - wing ducks .
description_long: Mhandyvver ' s Poultry Mhandyvver ' s Poultry is a poultry shop owned by Oskler Mhandyvver , in the town of Red Larch . Mhandyvver ' s Poultry produces fowl , fresh eggs , and chicks for raising . The fowl include turkeys , chickens , and clip - wing ducks . Notes . Oskler and the other poultry shop owners in Red Larch frequently hire boys armed with bows to protect their produce from foxes , hawks , owls , weasels , etc . This has generated enough archery practice that the town now has about 100 skilled bowmen that protect the town from orc raids .

title: Mhaorathil
description: Mhaorathil Mhaorathil was a Baneblade of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , being the second of his series of Baneblades , designed to be used by the dwarven defenders of the city .
description_long: Mhaorathil Mhaorathil was a Baneblade of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , being the second of his series of Baneblades , designed to be used by the dwarven defenders of the city . Description . It was a medium - sized short sword designed to be wielded by dwarves . It emitted a bright orange light when drawn . Powers . " Mhaorathil " had the powers of a " + 4 holy , evil outsider and undead bane short sword " . In addition to the standard baneblade abilities , " Mhaorathil " allowed its wielder to " cure light wounds " , " remove disease " , and use " disrupting weapon " once each per day . Its light could be suppressed by the wielder ' s thought .

title: Mhaug
description: Mhaug Mhaug was an annis hag shopkeeper in Skullport . Personality . For a hag , Mhaug was cordial but her mind was focused on business .
description_long: Mhaug Mhaug was an annis hag shopkeeper in Skullport . Personality . For a hag , Mhaug was cordial but her mind was focused on business . History . Around 1370 DR , Mhaug produced most of the undead labor force in Skullport for the right price . Her business greatly increased after the death of Shradin Mulophor in 1369 DR .

title: Mhaumask
description: Mhaumask Mhaumask of Mordulkin was a human wizard from the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta in the mid – 14th century DR , and a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as the most powerful mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh .
description_long: Mhaumask Mhaumask of Mordulkin was a human wizard from the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta in the mid – 14th century DR , and a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as the most powerful mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh .

title: Mhezenter Mirilar
description: Mhezenter Mirilar Mhezenter Mirilar was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was worked at Rallogar Hardware but was also a thief . Description .
description_long: Mhezenter Mirilar Mhezenter Mirilar was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was worked at Rallogar Hardware but was also a thief . Description . Mhezenter was a thin man with a beak - like nose . He feigned deafness . Activities . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , Mhezenter worked for Zendaros Rallogar at Rallogar Hardware , loading crates of goods . He slept in the store ' s attic at nights . However , he was also a thief , and spent his nights usually robbing local warehouses and caravans passing through . He was available to train other thieves , if they could catch him and survive a duel with him , for a sufficient payment . Mhezenter shrugged off attempts to blackmail him , then attacked and fled those who might threaten him . Possessions . Mhezenter wielded a slim , rapier - like short sword and dart s , both of which he took to poison ing if he felt threatened . The poison induced sleep , but was old and lost a little of its effectiveness . He also possessed a " necklace of fireballs " ( with a single use left in 1358 DR ) , and a " ring of the ram " , which he hid elsewhere in Wheloon , though he retrieved if in danger .

title: Mhiilamniir
description: Mhiilamniir Mhiilamniir was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement on the Old Road in the High Forest . History . It was formerly the seat of power for the priests of the Seldarine in the kingdom of Eaerlann .
description_long: Mhiilamniir Mhiilamniir was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement on the Old Road in the High Forest . History . It was formerly the seat of power for the priests of the Seldarine in the kingdom of Eaerlann . The settlement was destroyed in the demon ic uprising from Hellgate Keep , and most of it was overgrown with moss and ivy , but the female green dragon Chloracridara has lived in the partially standing ruins of the temple to Corellon Larethian for the past six hundred years . By 1372 DR her offspring ' s hunting made the surrounding area quite dangerous . Inhabitants . A male half - elf , half - dragon woodsman was known to claim that he could grant an audience with Chloracridara for a fee .

title: Mhoaran
description: Mhoaran King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the first king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Description . Mhoaran was a thick and tall man and a powerful warrior .
description_long: Mhoaran King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the first king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Description . Mhoaran was a thick and tall man and a powerful warrior . Personality . King Mhoaran was known for his powerful temper , but he was also a shrewd ruler . Relationships . Mhoaran was a great - grandson of Queen Sybille the Great and the son of the only brother of Cyriana the Great , Prince Atann . Because of so many assassination attempts on his family , Mhoaran lost three wives and was the father of more than 40 children , as he attempted to produce an heir . History . Mhoaran was born in 919 DR , the Year of the Chase . He and his father , Prince Atann , believed him to have a more legitimate claim to the throne , as Atann should have been the male heir of Sybille rather than the line having passed through Queen Cyriana to Queen Teresa the Great as it did . For this reason , Mhoaran built up an army and staged a military coup to take the throne from King Teremir , Teresa ' s son . When Teremir refused to step down from the throne , Mhoaran ' s army attacked , and Mhoaran himself slew King Teremir . The year was 959 DR .

title: Mhodi Shan
description: Mhodi Shan Mhodi Shan was a prominent peak of the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The peak was found in the southeast corner of Khazari in the branch of Katakoro Shan that formed the southern border of the country .
description_long: Mhodi Shan Mhodi Shan was a prominent peak of the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The peak was found in the southeast corner of Khazari in the branch of Katakoro Shan that formed the southern border of the country . Description . Easily the highest peak in Khazari , Mhodi Shan rose to an elevation of 19 , 251 feet ( 5870 m ) .

title: Miba sitt Lelia
description: Miba sitt Lelia Miba sitt Lelia was in charge of the Gulf Gate of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Miba was the mother of the current imam of the mosque of Selan .
description_long: Miba sitt Lelia Miba sitt Lelia was in charge of the Gulf Gate of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Miba was the mother of the current imam of the mosque of Selan . She was also a devoted servant to Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s father .

title: Mica Foebreaker
description: Mica Foebreaker Mica Foebreaker was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Mica led a cell of her fellow cultists on a mission to observe a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .
description_long: Mica Foebreaker Mica Foebreaker was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Mica led a cell of her fellow cultists on a mission to observe a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node . They planned to seize the Howling Hatred ' s prize at the right time . However , she was killed with all her companions .

title: Michaca
description: Michaca Michaca , also known as the City of Gold , was a city of Azuposi situated in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . The concept of Michaca was conceived by Chief Tapeyzin when he saw that men had been corrupted by personal greed caused by the abundance of gold in the area , and he set about using the excess wealth to create a fitting tribute to the gods in the shape of a city , rather than for personal gain .

title: Michael Fleisher
description: Michael Fleisher Michael Fleisher was a comics writer who worked for DC Comics during the 1970s and 1980s . In 1988 , Fleisher wrote the first four issues of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics , with artist Jan Duursema as co - plotter . Together they introduced all the heroes of the series : Cybriana of Shadowdale , Onyx the Invincible , Timoth Eyesbright , Vajra Valmeyjar , as well as Priam Agrivar .

title: Michal Bluestar
description: Michal Bluestar Michal Bluestar was an elven ajami crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . Michal added his magical power to the raids committed by Almari bint - Kafira and her pirate fleet .
description_long: Michal Bluestar Michal Bluestar was an elven ajami crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . Michal added his magical power to the raids committed by Almari bint - Kafira and her pirate fleet . History . Michal initially came to Zakhara on a foreign trading ship . While sailing the waters of Suq Bay , the merchants were accosted by Almari and her pirates . Michal noticed the shoddy artistry on the pirate flag and , defiant to Almari ' s authority , yelled out that she was the " Dreaded Porpoise . " Impressed with his bravery , Almari offered to spare Michal ' s life if he agreed to design a new flag for her . Michal agreed and became one of Almari ' s crewmembers since that time .

title: Michitl
description: Michitl Michitl was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Michitl ruled over a territory of Azatl .
description_long: Michitl Michitl was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Michitl ruled over a territory of Azatl . He reinforced its walls in Amn ite fashion , making his palace a true fortress . Personality . Michitl knew he was the weakest of the three leaders of Azatl and tried to find any means of increasing his status .

title: Microcline
description: Microcline Microcline , sometimes referred to as amazonstone ( ) in the " Realms " , was a variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were found in deep green to blue - green hues and cleaved easily so it took a skilled to handle properly .
description_long: Microcline Microcline , sometimes referred to as amazonstone ( ) in the " Realms " , was a variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were found in deep green to blue - green hues and cleaved easily so it took a skilled to handle properly . Typically they are tumbled or cut cabochon . Polished microcline had a shimmer due to tiny cleavage cracks that reflected light . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Microcline could be used to make a substitute for squid and octopus ink that was the basis for many magical inks by grinding a microcline stone to powder and mixing it with the sap of a deciduous tree .

title: Micus
description: Micus Micus was an astral deva servant of Tyr . He was a high - ranking member of the Court of Tyr and one of Tauran ' s closest friends . Description .
description_long: Micus Micus was an astral deva servant of Tyr . He was a high - ranking member of the Court of Tyr and one of Tauran ' s closest friends . Description . Micus had close - cropped dark hair . History . In 1373 DR , Micus and Tauran captured Kashada the Nightwraith in Sundabar and imprisoned her in a permanently glowing sphere . In 1385 DR , when Mystra was killed , magical forces melded Micus with the draconic hobgoblin Myshik Morueme , turning them into a dragon - hobgoblin - deva abomination . Micus - Myshik became insane and was captured by the marilith Vhissilka . When Kaanyr Vhok joined forces with Vhissilka , she gave Vhok a metal cuff to wear that dominated Micus - Myshik ; Vhok subsequently used him to taunt Tauran . Micus - Myshik was then slain by Kael , a knight of Torm , after the drow wizard Pharaun Mizzrym was able to trap him in a spell . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Midani language
description: Midani language Midani was the common tongue of Zakhara . It was spoken by all " enlightened " citizens of that region as well as by most unenlightened savages of that land . A version of Midani , known as Uloushinn by some scholars , was also spoken by the Bedine .
description_long: Midani language Midani was the common tongue of Zakhara . It was spoken by all " enlightened " citizens of that region as well as by most unenlightened savages of that land . A version of Midani , known as Uloushinn by some scholars , was also spoken by the Bedine . Variants . Zakhara had five regional dialects . In Qudra and the Free Cities , Midani was spoken with a sharp , precise rhythm , with the ends of sentences frequently clipped . In the Pearl Cities , most voices were more melodious . In the Pantheist League , consonants were trilled , seemingly at random . In eastern Zakhara , Midani was spoken with a nasal accent . In Huzuz and Hiyal , the accent sounded flat and mechanical compared to other Midani speakers . The latter , of course , believed that they spoke the " true " Midani tongue , which was known as the " Golden " dialect . The Bedine spoke a dialect of Midani . They had no name for their own language , but some linguists called it Uloushinn , and some even went so far as to categorize it among the Low Ulutim languages because of the influence of Netherese and related languages on the dialect .

title: Midnight ' s Mask
description: Midnight ' s Mask Midnight ' s Mask is the third book in the Erevis Cale trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary .
description_long: Midnight ' s Mask Midnight ' s Mask is the third book in the Erevis Cale trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary . Book Description < br > Release date : November 1 , 2005 | Series : Forgotten Realms : The Erevis Cale Trilogy , Book 3 ( Book 3 ) The shadows deepen in every corner of the Realms . The sun no longer shines on a man who has embraced the darkness within him . The day ' s opposite finds Erevis Cale so far along the path away from his own humanity , he may never again walk as a man . In the end , to be Chosen by a god like Mask is more curse than blessing . . .

title: Midnight Men
description: Midnight Men The Midnight Men were a mercenary company in the Stonelands . History . The Midnight Men earned some notoriety from Waterdeep to Thay .
description_long: Midnight Men The Midnight Men were a mercenary company in the Stonelands . History . The Midnight Men earned some notoriety from Waterdeep to Thay . They retired around 1338 DR . However in 1358 DR , some unknown force hunted the former members of the Midnight Men and turned them into undead .

title: Midnight Mosque
description: Midnight Mosque The Midnight Mosque was a mosque dedicated to Hajama in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The Midnight Mosque had a splendid view over Al - Sari River .
description_long: Midnight Mosque The Midnight Mosque was a mosque dedicated to Hajama in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The Midnight Mosque had a splendid view over Al - Sari River . A single narrow trail was the only way into the mosque . Structure . This mosque was made from black granite , providing ample shielding from Zakhara ' s punishing heat . The interior of the mosque was decorated with basalt statues that drew visitors . Black marble inlaid with onyx and black jade covered the floor . Inhabitants . The vast majority of priests worshiping here were ethoist s . A few pragmatist s gained the beneficial attention of the caliph .

title: Midsummer
description: Midsummer Midsummer was a festival that celebrated love and music through feast . It occurred between 30 Flamerule and 1 Eleasis on the Calendar of Harptos . It was a time when love advanced , and it was said the deities themselves took a hand to ensure good weather .
description_long: Midsummer Midsummer was a festival that celebrated love and music through feast . It occurred between 30 Flamerule and 1 Eleasis on the Calendar of Harptos . It was a time when love advanced , and it was said the deities themselves took a hand to ensure good weather . If bad weather was experienced on this night it was considered an extremely bad omen . Shieldmeet occurred the day after Midsummer on leap years .

title: Midwinter
description: Midwinter Midwinter ( also known as Deadwinter Day ) was a festival to mark the midpoint of winter in the Calendar of Harptos . It occured on a special day between Hammer 30 and Alturiak 1 . Amongst nobles and monarchs it was known as " Midwinter " and was traditionally used to make or renew alliances , although the common people called it Deadwinter Day , a reference to the cold and hard times that remained before the spring .
description_long: Midwinter Midwinter ( also known as Deadwinter Day ) was a festival to mark the midpoint of winter in the Calendar of Harptos . It occured on a special day between Hammer 30 and Alturiak 1 . Amongst nobles and monarchs it was known as " Midwinter " and was traditionally used to make or renew alliances , although the common people called it Deadwinter Day , a reference to the cold and hard times that remained before the spring . On Midwinter Day the Red Fellowship of the Deity known as the Red Knight observes the Retreat . This solemn ceremony consists of an assembly wherein the clergy discuss the previous year ' s campaigns . Strategies are discussed , battles analyzed , and the accumulated lore integrated into the church ' s teachings . The holiest day of the year for the Church of Shevarash is Midwinter Night , during which the Dark Court Slaughter is remembered . Inductions into the ranks of the clergy occur at this time . Each new cleric screams vows of vengeance into the night air and swears neither to laugh nor smile until the Spider Queen and her followers are no more .

title: Mielikki
description: Mielikki Mielikki ( pronounced " my - LEE - kee " ) , also referred to as the Forest Queen , was the neutral good goddess of autumn , druids , dryads , forests , forest creatures and rangers . Her symbol was a gold - horned , blue - eyed , unicorn ' s head facing left and she resides in the Grove of the Unicorns , located within the House of Nature . Worshippers .
description_long: Mielikki Mielikki ( pronounced " my - LEE - kee " ) , also referred to as the Forest Queen , was the neutral good goddess of autumn , druids , dryads , forests , forest creatures and rangers . Her symbol was a gold - horned , blue - eyed , unicorn ' s head facing left and she resides in the Grove of the Unicorns , located within the House of Nature . Worshippers . The clergy of Mielikki included clerics , druids ( Forestarms ) and rangers ( Needles ) . Generally , druids of Mielikki took on the abilities of rangers and unlike other druids , who were not allowed to wear metal armor , could use all kinds of armor usable by rangers . Divine spellcasters following Mielikki prayed for spells in either the morning or evening , but were required to observe both events . Once a month , cleric s and druids were required to perform the Song of Trees , calling forth a dryad or treant and performing odd jobs for it for a day . Mielikkians also held the equinoxes and solstices as holy days , called the Four Feasts . Relationships . Mielikki was daughter of Silvanus and sister of Eldath . She was the mistress of Gwaeron Windstrom , Shiallia and Lurue .

title: Mifru
description: Mifru Mifru was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Mifru was the right - hand of Stormgale in their second plan to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .
description_long: Mifru Mifru was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Mifru was the right - hand of Stormgale in their second plan to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . They kidnapped some monks , planning to use them as a sacrifice to open a " gate " to the Elemental Plane of Air . At last , however , an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks ruined their plan and Mifru was defeated . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Mifru appears only if the players previously killed Bloodwind . If Bloodwind survived , then he is the right - hand of Stormgale .

title: Mighty cleaving
description: Mighty cleaving Mighty cleaving was a magical enchantment that could be added to a weapon . It allowed a trained warrior to make another attack after knocking out one foe . Creation .
description_long: Mighty cleaving Mighty cleaving was a magical enchantment that could be added to a weapon . It allowed a trained warrior to make another attack after knocking out one foe . Creation . To craft a " mighty cleaving " weapon , a spellcaster had to have the spell " divine power " available .

title: Miglin Crackedquartz
description: Miglin Crackedquartz Miglin Crackedquartz was a deep gnome in Blingdenstone . Activities . When not acting as a guide , Miglin wandered the city making , notes about the caverns and passages .
description_long: Miglin Crackedquartz Miglin Crackedquartz was a deep gnome in Blingdenstone . Activities . When not acting as a guide , Miglin wandered the city making , notes about the caverns and passages . History . In 1479 DR , Kargien Dissengulp sent Miglin to act as a guide for an adventuring party he ' d hired in tunnels toward the Wormwrithings . Personality . Miglin was a gruff and acerbic individual . He was more interested in gemstones than people , even offering to the people that employed him reports about the various properties of every rock he saw .

title: Miilal Hydcont
description: Miilal Hydcont Miilal Hydcont was a noble of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Miilal was the eldest sister of Lord Toben Rosznar and widow of the late Lord Hydcont , meaning that she controlled all the fortunes of House Hydcont , the Amnian branch of House Rosznar .
description_long: Miilal Hydcont Miilal Hydcont was a noble of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Miilal was the eldest sister of Lord Toben Rosznar and widow of the late Lord Hydcont , meaning that she controlled all the fortunes of House Hydcont , the Amnian branch of House Rosznar . Miilal was also the unofficial ruler of the city of Imnescar , which she controlled thanks to her money and personality . Miilal was also involved in the slave and poison trade . Thanks to the power of the Knights , and considerable bribes , Miilal avoided most of the destruction caused by the Sothillisian War in early 1370 DR . She then got busy rebuilding her city but did not abandon her hatred of Lady Estrip Rosznar of Waterdeep , hoping to regain that noble title for her branch of the family .

title: Miirphys Irithyl
description: Miirphys Irithyl Miirphys Irithyl was fourth Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1338 DR to - 791 DR after Sinaht Irithyl , and a priest of Sehanine Moonbow and the only moon elf Coronal to rule that empire . He did lots of work sending ships into Realmspace to prevent the incursions of Netherese spelljammers from expanding into his domain . He was also known for having imprisoned the Trio Nefarious , a band of nycaloths that one day returned and caused the downfall of his empire , and for raising the Crescent Court , a temple of his deity ( which he was rumoured to haunt after his death ) .
description_long: Miirphys Irithyl Miirphys Irithyl was fourth Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1338 DR to - 791 DR after Sinaht Irithyl , and a priest of Sehanine Moonbow and the only moon elf Coronal to rule that empire . He did lots of work sending ships into Realmspace to prevent the incursions of Netherese spelljammers from expanding into his domain . He was also known for having imprisoned the Trio Nefarious , a band of nycaloths that one day returned and caused the downfall of his empire , and for raising the Crescent Court , a temple of his deity ( which he was rumoured to haunt after his death ) . Lastly , Miirphys was involved in the binding of House Dlardrageth ( a clan of elves that consorted with demons ) to their villa in Myth Drannor . The elves mostly destroyed themselves , but later returned in the fourteenth century DR to attempt to take the city . He had his moon elf mother ' s unique blue hair and silver eyes .

title: Miirym
description: Miirym Miirym , known as the Sentinel Wyrm , was the most peculiar guardian of Candlekeep . Personality . Miirym was a very lonely being and her main aspiration was to finally fly again in the blue sky .
description_long: Miirym Miirym , known as the Sentinel Wyrm , was the most peculiar guardian of Candlekeep . Personality . Miirym was a very lonely being and her main aspiration was to finally fly again in the blue sky . She was cynical of people that promised to help her , as she had seen too many fail in her long existence . In life , Miirym loved green growing things and enjoyed jokes . Her sanity was not strong , however , and if someone tried to trick or ambush her she unleashed all her fury upon them . Activities . Miirym passed her endless days patrolling the tunnels and passages under Candlekeep , searching for possible intruders . She desperately wanted to chat with someone , and when she met intruders she first tried speaking to them in order to understand their intentions . She always wanted to know what was happening in Faerun . However , if visitors had books with them , she insisted that they give the books to her so she could put in their " rightful " place in Candlekeep — in her mind " all " books belonged to Candlekeep . Sometimes , as an especially cruel and unusual punishment , a monk was sent to spent some time with Miirym . History .

title: Mijayrah
description: Mijayrah The mijayrah ( mih - JAY - rah ) was a basic recorder from Zakhara . Description . These simple instruments were made from reeds .
description_long: Mijayrah The mijayrah ( mih - JAY - rah ) was a basic recorder from Zakhara . Description . These simple instruments were made from reeds . History . Because they were relatively easy to make , " mijayrahs " were used by both the urban Al - Hadhar and the nomadic Al - Badia . They had a short range but created a pleasant , breathy tone . Musicians typically hummed while playing a " mijayrah " .

title: Mikaal Dannihyr
description: Mikaal Dannihyr Mikaal Dannihyr was a human male and the head of the Dannihyr mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Mikaal was the aging grandson of Rhinnom Dannihyr , the Iltarch ( chief intelligence officer ) of Amn , whom most of the family believed to be dead .
description_long: Mikaal Dannihyr Mikaal Dannihyr was a human male and the head of the Dannihyr mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Mikaal was the aging grandson of Rhinnom Dannihyr , the Iltarch ( chief intelligence officer ) of Amn , whom most of the family believed to be dead . The Dannihyr family was in a weak position because of honor debts to the Vymmar family , which held deeds to half the Dannihyr clan ' s holdings .

title: Mikal Canos
description: Mikal Canos Mikal Canos was the Tharchion of Delhumide in Thay in 1357 DR and brother of fellow tharchion Thessaloni Canos . History . Mikal commanded one of the most largest thayan army in order to keep control of the ruins of the ancient Delhumide and mean time suppress the many slave uprising in the slave - farms in his Tharch and the sometime raids from Rashemen warriors .
description_long: Mikal Canos Mikal Canos was the Tharchion of Delhumide in Thay in 1357 DR and brother of fellow tharchion Thessaloni Canos . History . Mikal commanded one of the most largest thayan army in order to keep control of the ruins of the ancient Delhumide and mean time suppress the many slave uprising in the slave - farms in his Tharch and the sometime raids from Rashemen warriors . With the Salamender ' s War most of his troops were relocated in the battlefields and he had now very few soldiers .

title: Mike Breault
description: Mike Breault Mike Breault is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . Breault was trained as a physicist from in 1980 .
description_long: Mike Breault Mike Breault is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . Breault was trained as a physicist from in 1980 . As a freshman , he joined a role - playing game club . He attended graduate school at , during which time he also worked as an editorial intern . Career . Breault joined TSR as an editor in September of 1984 . He worked on several 1 - edition sourcebooks and on 2 - edition works as well . He was co - designer of the Pool of Radiance video game .

title: Mike Pondsmith
description: Mike Pondsmith Mike Pondsmith is a prolific game designer — including role - playing , video , and board games — who has written sourcebooks for both the Forgotten Realms and Oriental Adventures settings . Background . Pondsmith graduated from with a Bachelor of Arts degree in graphic design and a Bachelor of Science degree in behavioral psychology .
description_long: Mike Pondsmith Mike Pondsmith is a prolific game designer — including role - playing , video , and board games — who has written sourcebooks for both the Forgotten Realms and Oriental Adventures settings . Background . Pondsmith graduated from with a Bachelor of Arts degree in graphic design and a Bachelor of Science degree in behavioral psychology . He started out in the video game industry before moving into pen - and - paper games . He founded , a role - playing company in 1985 . He contributed to TSR , Inc . products for a brief period a few years after that .

title: Miki - san
description: Miki - san Miki - san was the leader of the yakuza gang of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , Miki - san ' s men acted as a peacekeeping force , while the bushi of the jito Mushakoji Nariakira were busy managing the adjacent central Niwa clan shoen .
description_long: Miki - san Miki - san was the leader of the yakuza gang of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , Miki - san ' s men acted as a peacekeeping force , while the bushi of the jito Mushakoji Nariakira were busy managing the adjacent central Niwa clan shoen . Miki - san ' s men protected villagers from strangers , seamen , and merchants for a price . They also managed a small gambling house . There very few incidents between yakuza and samurai , but they always resolved these with agreements , at least at the moment . Personality . Miki - san was only the alias of the oyabun , nobody know his true name .

title: Mikkaalgensis
description: Mikkaalgensis Mikkaalgensis , also known as the Harper Dragon , was an male adult silver dragon living in Myth Drannor during the time of the Weeping War . History . The Harper Dragon was slain in the war ' s twelfth campaign known as the Dragons ' Last Dive while destroying a gate in Aglarond ' s Yuirwood , which was being used by the invading Army of Darkness
description_long: Mikkaalgensis Mikkaalgensis , also known as the Harper Dragon , was an male adult silver dragon living in Myth Drannor during the time of the Weeping War . History . The Harper Dragon was slain in the war ' s twelfth campaign known as the Dragons ' Last Dive while destroying a gate in Aglarond ' s Yuirwood , which was being used by the invading Army of Darkness

title: Miklos Selkirk
description: Miklos Selkirk Miklos Selkirk was an ex - adventurer and the founder and commander of the Silver Ravens . Abilities . Miklos was known as a skilled negotiator , diplomat , and exceptional sword fighter .
description_long: Miklos Selkirk Miklos Selkirk was an ex - adventurer and the founder and commander of the Silver Ravens . Abilities . Miklos was known as a skilled negotiator , diplomat , and exceptional sword fighter . All of these skills came to play during the many duels of wit that Miklos engaged in , most often with Mirabeta , his father ' s cousin and his fiercest rival . Forming the Ravens after being unable to fully let go of his adventuring days , he spent most of his time directing their actions . Occasionally though , Miklos was called to the Sembian Council to peacefully negotiate with the drow , a race he had come to understand through their diplomatic styles . History . Miklos Selkirk had adventured around the Sea of Fallen Stars and the Moonsea , as well as in the Underdark . In 1374 DR he was assigned as observer to the Sembian expedition led by Borstag Duncastle went to assist the disguised Sarya Dlardrageth . Possessions . Among Miklos ' s possessions were a " + 2 keen rapier " , a " + 2 defending dagger " , a pair of " boots of striding and springing " , a " ring of mind shielding " , and a " ring of protection + 1 " . Family .

title: Milhvar
description: Milhvar Milhvar was an audacious elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In Acheron in 1358 DR , just before the start of the Time of Troubles , Milhvar took from the mind of the god Bane some secret information .
description_long: Milhvar Milhvar was an audacious elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In Acheron in 1358 DR , just before the start of the Time of Troubles , Milhvar took from the mind of the god Bane some secret information . Using it , he formed an alliance with the Shadowmaster High Dhalgrave in an audacious plot . He created the Cloak of Shadows , an artifact that made the wielder invisible from the Chosen of Mystra . Milhvar used his fellow malaugrym as guinea pigs to test the artifact against Alustriel Silverhand and Khelben Arunsun . Later , he was among the malaugrym that welcomed the Rangers Three when they managed to arrive at the Castle of Shadows .

title: Milil
description: Milil Milil ( pronounced " mil - LILL " ) , also known as the One Who Watches While Music is Alive and the Guardian of Singers and Troubadours , is a good exarch of Oghma . He is depicted in religious art and song as a handsome male human or elf with a charismatic manner and a haunting , melodic voice . He is venerated by human , elf , and half - elf , bards .
description_long: Milil Milil ( pronounced " mil - LILL " ) , also known as the One Who Watches While Music is Alive and the Guardian of Singers and Troubadours , is a good exarch of Oghma . He is depicted in religious art and song as a handsome male human or elf with a charismatic manner and a haunting , melodic voice . He is venerated by human , elf , and half - elf , bards .
