Milil is the ultimate performer : self - confident , inspired , possessed of total recall or anything he sets a mind to remember , able to improvise facilely out of desire or necessity , well - educated in general theories of conduct and broad areas of knowledge , and masterful in all sorts of performance technique ( including a passing knowledge of disguise derived from costume theory ) , especially within his sphere of knowledge — music , poetry , and elegant speech . However , he is also self - centered and egotistical and likes to be the center of attention . When he is not the center of attention , he bores easily , and his mind wanders or he leaves . He is also given to flirtation with both deities and mortals for his own enjoyment , to deep annoyance of more sober powers .

title: Millek
description: Millek Millek the Thrush was a halfling in the Monastery of the Precipice . Activities . Millek was a thief who , in 1479 DR , traveled to Spellgard , seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel to answer a simple question : where she could find a lost treasure ?
description_long: Millek Millek the Thrush was a halfling in the Monastery of the Precipice . Activities . Millek was a thief who , in 1479 DR , traveled to Spellgard , seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel to answer a simple question : where she could find a lost treasure ? Millek resisted the temptation of thieving from the most vulnerable seekers .

title: Millivent Moss
description: Millivent Moss Millivent Moss was a farmer of Twilight Marsh near Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Millivent ran a peat farm from a bog near Phlan with her husband Haldred Moss , her daughters Alleena Moss and Kithian Moss and her sons Quayle Moss and Vollian Moss .
description_long: Millivent Moss Millivent Moss was a farmer of Twilight Marsh near Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Millivent ran a peat farm from a bog near Phlan with her husband Haldred Moss , her daughters Alleena Moss and Kithian Moss and her sons Quayle Moss and Vollian Moss . One day a group of goblin s attacked the farm and captured all the family members except Millivent . So she went to the city searching for help . At last , Millivent hired some adventurers at the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle and they resolved the situation . Later she transferred to Kabel ' s Hill ' s community near Quivering Forest .

title: Millston
description: Millston Millston was a mercenary . History . Millston served under Cordell of the Golden Legion in the war against the pirates of Akbet - Khrul .
description_long: Millston Millston was a mercenary . History . Millston served under Cordell of the Golden Legion in the war against the pirates of Akbet - Khrul . In 1361 DR , he was a member of Don Vaez ' s expedition . However , following the imprisonment of Cordell and all the Legion ' s officers , Millston agreed to conspire with Rodolfo and others to free Cordell .

title: Milsantos Daramos
description: Milsantos Daramos Milsantos Daramos was the tharchion of Thazalhar in Thay . Abilities . He was a seasoned warrior and had a reputation for being the canniest commander in Thay .
description_long: Milsantos Daramos Milsantos Daramos was the tharchion of Thazalhar in Thay . Abilities . He was a seasoned warrior and had a reputation for being the canniest commander in Thay . Description . In his later years , Daramos was an old man with a lined face and shaggy white brows . He always wore his plate armor adorned with magical runes . A kite - shield , helmet , and broadsword or lance , magically enchanted as well , completed his combat gear . History . In the years 1375 DR to 1382 DR , Daramos took part in the war of Thay as an ally of the council of zulkir s . He died in 1382 DR of old age .

title: Milshoun ' s Stronghouses
description: Milshoun ' s Stronghouses Milshoun ' s Stronghouses was a collection of three stone warehouses in Beliard around 1368 DR . Inhabitants . The warehouses were owned by Ahbhaer Mhilshoun , who provided storage facilities per day , tenday , or month .
description_long: Milshoun ' s Stronghouses Milshoun ' s Stronghouses was a collection of three stone warehouses in Beliard around 1368 DR . Inhabitants . The warehouses were owned by Ahbhaer Mhilshoun , who provided storage facilities per day , tenday , or month . Milshoun ' s Stronghouses were protected by a dozen guards , who hunted game in the hills to the north during their spare time . Appendix . Discrepancy . On page 37 of " Volo ' s Guide to the North " , the establishment is named " Milshoun ' s Warehouses " , but the owner ' s name is given as " Ahbhaer Mhilshoun " , which is a different spelling .

title: Miltiades
description: Miltiades Miltiades , although not specifically referred to as a death knight , was a skeletal undead paladin . Miltiades grew up in the city of Turell . He was its steward and champion .
description_long: Miltiades Miltiades , although not specifically referred to as a death knight , was a skeletal undead paladin . Miltiades grew up in the city of Turell . He was its steward and champion . Due to his service , he was given the Holy Shield of Tyr , a magical war helm , and a runic sword of Tyr . For fifty years , he faithfully guarded the city , until the battlemage Zarl attacked . Turell was besieged for a year , during which he personally slew many of Zarl ' s greatest warriors . Zarl never challenged Miltiades , so Miltiades sneaked into Zarl ' s camp one night and murdered him dishonorably . Miltiades was then slain by all of Zarl ' s men , and Turell was sacked and destroyed without its protector . Tyr refused to allow Miltiades to die and rest in honor , leaving his spirit to wander . A thousand years later , Tyr tasked the half - dead Miltiades with finding the lost city of Phlan , which had been captured by Bane ' s minions , the red wizard Marcus and the pit fiend Tanetal . Upon his resurrection , Miltiades met Ren o ' the Blade , Evaine and her familiar Gamaliel , and the druid cousins Androlson and Talenthia .

title: Mimic
description: Mimic Mimics were strange aberrations that assumed the form of mundane furnishings and household objects . Description . Most mimics were the relative size of a human , assuming the form of small beds , chests , and wardrobes .
description_long: Mimic Mimics were strange aberrations that assumed the form of mundane furnishings and household objects . Description . Most mimics were the relative size of a human , assuming the form of small beds , chests , and wardrobes . Rumors persisted of mimics far larger — even those that were the size of houses and assumed the form of such . Combat . They maintained their forms for days at a time and lay in wait for unsuspecting prey to interact with them . Once the victim touched the mimic , the aberration would spring to life , revealing a large mouth to quickly bite and consume its prey before it could escape . The mimic was aided by a chemical adhesive that it naturally exuded over its entire form .

title: Mimph
description: Mimph Mimph was a coastal city of Sespech . It could only be reached by sea or overland travel as no road led to this city . Despite this limitation , it still saw a fair amount of overland trade .
description_long: Mimph Mimph was a coastal city of Sespech . It could only be reached by sea or overland travel as no road led to this city . Despite this limitation , it still saw a fair amount of overland trade . Military and Government . Baron Aldorn Thuragar commanded that a navy be built based out of Mimph . The city was ruled by Overlord Admiral Kalisa Tauno .

title: Mina Neyman
description: Mina Neyman Mina Neyman was an acolyte of Kelemvor in Neverdeath Graveyard within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Description . The priest had blond hair and a scar on the right side of her face .
description_long: Mina Neyman Mina Neyman was an acolyte of Kelemvor in Neverdeath Graveyard within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Description . The priest had blond hair and a scar on the right side of her face . Relationships . She served in a contingent under Volahk with the mission of clearing the city ' s graveyard of undead .

title: Minak al - Zafyi
description: Minak al - Zafyi Minak al - Zafyi ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Minak was a tall and handsome elf .
description_long: Minak al - Zafyi Minak al - Zafyi ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Minak was a tall and handsome elf . Activities . Minak sold exotic animals within the Grand Bazaar from his small tent . Customers could purchase monkey s , songbirds , falcon s , partridges , cat s , dog s , and peacocks . His most prized animal was a young elephant bird . Though he only kept smaller animals in his tent , he boasted that he could acquire any animal that a customer asked about . He judged people based upon how his animals reacted to them . Thus , anyone well - received by his animals usually got a better deal . Possessions . Minak owned a " ring of mammal control " and a " net of ensnarement " .

title: Minauthkeep
description: Minauthkeep Minauthkeep was the ruins of a former elven stronghold and base of operations for the drow House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Geography . Minauthkeep was located in the forest of Cormanthor .
description_long: Minauthkeep Minauthkeep was the ruins of a former elven stronghold and base of operations for the drow House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Geography . Minauthkeep was located in the forest of Cormanthor . From a portal in Cormanthor leading to the Labyrinth , it was five days west to a small river , and from there , a day ' s journey south to Minauthkeep . Structure . Minauthkeep ' s ruined structures and crumbling foundations were covered in green vines and included a collapsed iron gate . They were made to look abandoned despite the inhabitants . Minauthkeep castle had a secret chamber behind a bronze mask of Vhaeraun . History . Minauthkeep was settled by House Jaelre between 1322 DR and 1372 DR after their exodus in the Underdark . They desired to take over the ruined Elven Court and use its mythal s to ward off enemies .

title: Mind blank
description: Mind blank Mind blank is an abjuration spell that renders the subject immune to mental / emotional magic and scrying . Effects . The subject is protected from all devices and spells that detect , influence , or read emotions or thoughts .
description_long: Mind blank Mind blank is an abjuration spell that renders the subject immune to mental / emotional magic and scrying . Effects . The subject is protected from all devices and spells that detect , influence , or read emotions or thoughts . This spell protects against all and effects as well as information gathering by divination spells or effects . " Mind blank " even foils " limited wish " , " miracle " , and " wish " when they are used in such a way as to affect the subject ' s mind or to gain information about him . In the case of scrying that scans an area that the creature is in , such as " arcane eye " , the spell works but the creature simply isn ' t detected . Scrying attempts that are targeted specifically at the subject do not work at all .

title: Mind bond
description: Mind bond Mind bond was a divination spell that allowed a paladin and her mount to communicate telepathically and coordinate their attacks . Effect . The paladin temporarily strengthened the mental bond with her special mount , allowing them to predict each other ' s movements and gain a significant edge in combat .
description_long: Mind bond Mind bond was a divination spell that allowed a paladin and her mount to communicate telepathically and coordinate their attacks . Effect . The paladin temporarily strengthened the mental bond with her special mount , allowing them to predict each other ' s movements and gain a significant edge in combat . The odds of hitting an opponent flanked by mount and paladin were boosted by double the normal amount . Furthermore , the mount was more likely to hit targets as long as it remained in range of the spell .

title: Mind domain
description: Mind domain Not to be confused with the Mentalism domain , the Mind domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters Mind spell powers . In terms of game mechanics , a cleric with this domain gains a + 2 bonus on Bluff , Diplomacy , and Sense Motive checks , along with a + 2 bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects . Deities with the Mind domain .
description_long: Mind domain Not to be confused with the Mentalism domain , the Mind domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters Mind spell powers . In terms of game mechanics , a cleric with this domain gains a + 2 bonus on Bluff , Diplomacy , and Sense Motive checks , along with a + 2 bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects . Deities with the Mind domain . Currently the only Forgotten Realms god that sponsors the Mind domain is the illithid god Ilsensine .

title: Mind flayer
description: Mind flayer An illithid , also called a mind flayer , was an evil and sadistic being , humanoid in appearance , but with a four - tentacled octopus - like head . These beings were feared throughout the Underdark for their telepathic abilities and usually were not without two or more slaves , mentally bound to each individual mind flayer . Although they cooperated to achieve a goal , they would back away at the first sign that something was not profitable to themselves .
description_long: Mind flayer An illithid , also called a mind flayer , was an evil and sadistic being , humanoid in appearance , but with a four - tentacled octopus - like head . These beings were feared throughout the Underdark for their telepathic abilities and usually were not without two or more slaves , mentally bound to each individual mind flayer . Although they cooperated to achieve a goal , they would back away at the first sign that something was not profitable to themselves . They were capable of speaking Undercommon , but preferred telepathic communication and would attempt to mentally dominate any non - slave , non - illithid they met . They fed on the brains of sentient creatures and were thus feared . Their natural psionic abilities also made them respected in the eyes of the drow , beholders , duergar , and the other dominant races of the Underdark . History . Some theorized mind flayers to be aliens from the future ( as stated in The Sargmne Prophecies ) , who had come back in time to prevent the end of the world . Facing extinction , they sent the greatest spelljamming fleet in history back in time .

title: Mind fog
description: Mind fog Mind fog is an enchantment spell that summons a magical fog to muddle the subject ( s ) mind ( s ) . Effect . " Mind fog " produces a bank of fog that weakens the mental resistance of those caught in it .
description_long: Mind fog Mind fog is an enchantment spell that summons a magical fog to muddle the subject ( s ) mind ( s ) . Effect . " Mind fog " produces a bank of fog that weakens the mental resistance of those caught in it . Creatures in the mind fog suffer a - 10 competence penalty to all Wisdom checks and Will saves . ( A creature who successfully saves against the fog is not affected and need not make further saves even if it remains in the fog . ) Affected creatures suffer the penalty as long as they remain in the fog and for 2d6 rounds thereafter . The fog itself is stationary and lasts for 30 minutes ( or until dispersed by wind ) . The fog is thin and does not significantly hamper vision .

title: Mind ream
description: Mind ream Mind Ream is a spell unique to the War Wizards of Cormyr that allows the mage to extract information from a person ' s mind . The spell often leaves the victim ' s mind in ruins . With the changes to the magical weave after the Spellplague , the spell often destroys the mind of the caster as well as the victim .
description_long: Mind ream Mind Ream is a spell unique to the War Wizards of Cormyr that allows the mage to extract information from a person ' s mind . The spell often leaves the victim ' s mind in ruins . With the changes to the magical weave after the Spellplague , the spell often destroys the mind of the caster as well as the victim . Terminally ill War Wizards sometimes volunteer to cast the Mind Ream spell as a last service to Cormyr .

title: Minda Obarskyr
description: Minda Obarskyr Minda Obarskyr ( born Minda Bleth ) was the sister of Mondar Bleth and settled on the land that would become known as Suzail in 15 DR . She had a secret relationship with Ondeth Obarskyr after his wife had left him that was eventually exposed . Appearance .
description_long: Minda Obarskyr Minda Obarskyr ( born Minda Bleth ) was the sister of Mondar Bleth and settled on the land that would become known as Suzail in 15 DR . She had a secret relationship with Ondeth Obarskyr after his wife had left him that was eventually exposed . Appearance . Minda had very dark hair and a pretty face . She was quite tall . Relatives . Minda had a brother , Mondar Bleth , who was killed by elves in 16 DR . Her nephew was Mondar ' s youngest son , Arphoind Bleth . History . Minda came to the new settlement on the future site of Suzail in 15 DR . She began a secret relationship with Ondeth Obarskyr , and this saved her life in 16 DR . She was in bed with him instead of at home when the elves raided her farmstead and killed its occupants , including her brother Mondar . She later married Ondeth .

title: Minder
description: Minder Minder was an iron golem crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Minder was a dwarf who joined Dwalimar Omen in his mission to acquire the Astrolabe of Nimbral .
description_long: Minder Minder was an iron golem crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Minder was a dwarf who joined Dwalimar Omen in his mission to acquire the Astrolabe of Nimbral . However , in the battle against the crystalgriff guardian of the object , Minder fell . Omen managed to transfer Minder ' s spirit into the body of a golem . Later an artisan crafted for her a more suitable golem body . Minder followed loyally Omen in all his adventures . Personality . Minder missed the air of her homeland and the taste of good food . Still , she was a wise warrior , always in control of a situation . Relationship . Minder was the confidant and best friend of Omen . She found her soulmate in Onyx the Invincible . Powers . As a golem , Minder had no need to eat , sleep , or breath . Normally she fought with her bare hands .

title: Mindstalker Wars
description: Mindstalker Wars The Mindstalker Wars , also known as the War of Cloven Thoughts , were a series of wars fought between the illithid s of Oryndoll and the dwarves of Shanatar . They began when the illithids attacked the eastern subkingdoms of Shanatar in - 8100 DR . The war lasted until - 8080 DR .
description_long: Mindstalker Wars The Mindstalker Wars , also known as the War of Cloven Thoughts , were a series of wars fought between the illithid s of Oryndoll and the dwarves of Shanatar . They began when the illithids attacked the eastern subkingdoms of Shanatar in - 8100 DR . The war lasted until - 8080 DR .

title: Mindulgulph Castle
description: Mindulgulph Castle Mindulgulph Castle was a large keep or castle in the hills south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . It sat atop a pinnacle that overlooked the town . It became the base of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company .
description_long: Mindulgulph Castle Mindulgulph Castle was a large keep or castle in the hills south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . It sat atop a pinnacle that overlooked the town . It became the base of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company . History . In the early 1340s DR , an adventuring company including Gayrlana raided Mindulgulph Castle and discovered a number of intelligent , " monstrous " , creatures dwelling inside . However , rather than slaying them as many adventurers would , they instead recruited the majority of them to their side . Gayrlana soon reformed the group into the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , and they took the castle as their base . In the 1360s DR , Gayrlana led much of her company hundreds of miles from home to the Eastern Shaar , where they took an extended contract with the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . The remainder of the company remained in Priapurl and guarded Mindulgulph Castle . Defenses . It was well guarded by a number of the company ' s more monstrous members .

title: Mindulgulph Mercenary Company
description: Mindulgulph Mercenary Company The Mindulgulph Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Mindulgulph Castle outside Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and operated throughout the Heartlands and the southern lands of Faerûn . It was famous for its many monstrous and otherwise non - humanoid members , and was commanded by Gayrlana , nicknamed " Lady Bloodsword " . History .
description_long: Mindulgulph Mercenary Company The Mindulgulph Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Mindulgulph Castle outside Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and operated throughout the Heartlands and the southern lands of Faerûn . It was famous for its many monstrous and otherwise non - humanoid members , and was commanded by Gayrlana , nicknamed " Lady Bloodsword " . History . In the early 1340s DR , an adventuring company including Gayrlana raided Mindulgulph Castle near Priapurl and discovered a number of intelligent , " monstrous " , creatures dwelling inside . However , rather than slaying them as many adventurers would , they instead recruited the majority of them to their side . Gayrlana soon reformed the group into the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , and they took the castle as their base . The company was fully established and well known by 1356 DR . In the 1360s DR , Gayrlana led much of her company hundreds of miles from home to the Eastern Shaar , where they took an extended contract with the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . Their purpose was to study the chances of war in the local Underdark . They were still here at the end of 1367 DR .

title: Mindwitness
description: Mindwitness Mindwitnesses were flying nightmares of eyes and tentacles created by mind flayers by inserting one of their tadpoles into a beholder . Description . A mindwitness greatly resembled its beholder " parent " ; an orb - shaped being 6 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Mindwitness Mindwitnesses were flying nightmares of eyes and tentacles created by mind flayers by inserting one of their tadpoles into a beholder . Description . A mindwitness greatly resembled its beholder " parent " ; an orb - shaped being 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) in diameter , with a large central eye on its body , and ten smaller eyes on stalks emerging from the top . However , a mindwitness ' s mind flayer influence made an already horrifying creature arguably even more so ; its fanged mouth was replaced with one more akin to that of a , and this maw was surrounded by four large octopus - like tentacles . Abilities . A mindwitness ' s body was , like that of a beholder , naturally buoyant , allowing it to fly and granting it effects much like that of a feather fall spell . Its many eyes granted it 360 degree vision , preventing it from being flanked and making it generally very difficult to avoid being spotted by one . Mindwitnesses also had an innate resistance to spells and were able to project an antimagic field in a cone in front of them .

title: Miner genie
description: Miner genie Miner genies were one of the newest kinds of tasked genie . Though employed by the dao extensively , miner genies were originally created by the yak - folk from dao slaves . Compelled to work and toil within mine shafts , miner genies were hulking creatures driven not only by their need to dig and move stones , but by their burning shame and hatred as well .
description_long: Miner genie Miner genies were one of the newest kinds of tasked genie . Though employed by the dao extensively , miner genies were originally created by the yak - folk from dao slaves . Compelled to work and toil within mine shafts , miner genies were hulking creatures driven not only by their need to dig and move stones , but by their burning shame and hatred as well . Description . Miner genies presented a somewhat bizarre appearance , being as wide as they were tall . Their shape was ideal for moving through tunnels with ease . Thick muscular arms and legs combined with elongated hardened claws for nails made them perfect digging machines . Their fingernails actually prevented them from using their hands to consume food , forcing them to rummage with their nose and mouth like animals . Miner genies were entirely hairless and their heads were cone - shaped . The average miner genie stood 8 ft . ( 2 . 4 m ) tall and wide . Combat . Miner genies could not utilize weapons or tools because of their claws . However , their claws tore through stone and hardened earth with ease , providing all the weapons needed .

title: Mingari
description: Mingari Mingari was a rare and exotic spice exported from Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Description & Uses . This strong spice was similar to cinnamon in flavor .
description_long: Mingari Mingari was a rare and exotic spice exported from Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Description & Uses . This strong spice was similar to cinnamon in flavor . When blended with fruit from Maztica , delicious ketjap was created . It needed to be blended , and was typically stored and sold in jars . Sources . Mingari was farmed in eastern Ulgarth , particularly around Kaspar and east of Kelazzan . It was traded through Orvyltar to Durpar , where the Karikal chaka in Morvar had a primary interest in the mingari trade . The Durpari shipped the mingari across the Shining South . Throughout all of Toril , mingari was only grown and blended in Ulgarth , who only traded it to Durpar , giving those countries a nice monopoly on the supply of the favored spice , which was just being discovered by wider Faerûn around 1367 DR . It was Ulgarth ' s primary export .

title: Mini - blade
description: Mini - blade The mini - blade was a tiny blade that was easily concealed between the knuckles . Uses . Mini - blades practically gave the cutpurse their name , allowing a brash thief to slice the strings of an unwary victim ' s coin purse with ease .
description_long: Mini - blade The mini - blade was a tiny blade that was easily concealed between the knuckles . Uses . Mini - blades practically gave the cutpurse their name , allowing a brash thief to slice the strings of an unwary victim ' s coin purse with ease . Prices . Mini - blades could be purchased for 1 Silver .

title: Miniature giant space hamster
description: Miniature giant space hamster A miniature giant space hamster was , according to Minsc , a that had been miniaturized . These creatures were apparently quite intelligent and had the ability to talk in whispers , though most of the time they just made normal hamster squeaks . The only known miniature giant space hamster in Realmspace was named Boo and was the animal companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc ever since his first head wound .
description_long: Miniature giant space hamster A miniature giant space hamster was , according to Minsc , a that had been miniaturized . These creatures were apparently quite intelligent and had the ability to talk in whispers , though most of the time they just made normal hamster squeaks . The only known miniature giant space hamster in Realmspace was named Boo and was the animal companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc ever since his first head wound . However , as Minsc is quite addled , it is unclear whether or not his claims are true .

title: Minnitha
description: Minnitha Minnitha was a dragonborn of white dragon heritage in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Minnitha planned to search for treasure in the mountains near the city , but in fear of bandits she used a disguise and the name Halda in town to visit her family .
description_long: Minnitha Minnitha was a dragonborn of white dragon heritage in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Minnitha planned to search for treasure in the mountains near the city , but in fear of bandits she used a disguise and the name Halda in town to visit her family . One day , Minnitha went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle . She was briefly interrogated by adventurers hired by Buhrell Caah about a missing dangerous magic item and used her cover identity .

title: Minolin Fey
description: Minolin Fey Minolin Fey , also known as Minolin Fey - Branche and Minolin Fey - Baenre , was a Mistress of Arach - Tinilith in Menzoberranzan and wife of Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Minolin had an inner strength and independence that was belied by her servitude to Quenthel Baenre .
description_long: Minolin Fey Minolin Fey , also known as Minolin Fey - Branche and Minolin Fey - Baenre , was a Mistress of Arach - Tinilith in Menzoberranzan and wife of Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Minolin had an inner strength and independence that was belied by her servitude to Quenthel Baenre . History . Minolin was a fifth - year novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . She later served as a mistress of Arach - Tinilith , a position she held in 1484 DR . In this position , she handled administrative work under Mistress Quenthel Baenre and was served by Myrineyl Baenre . While serving Quenthel Baenre at Arach - Tinilith , Minolin developed an ally in Gromph Baenre , Quenthel ' s brother . She became pregnant with his child in 1484 DR ; in the same year , the two were married . Their child was to be named Yvonnel and was expected to become the successor of Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre . Relationships . Minolin served Quenthel Baenre , who viewed her as weak and a fool . However , Minolin developed a relationship with Gromph Baenre as her ally and advisor , a relationship Gromph intended to use to subvert his sister ' s power .

title: Minotaur
description: Minotaur Minotaurs were a strong and combative race of monstrous humanoids resembling bull – human hybrids that were rare in Faerun . Description . Minotaurs were evil giant muscular humanoids with fur - covered bodies and bull - like heads .
description_long: Minotaur Minotaurs were a strong and combative race of monstrous humanoids resembling bull – human hybrids that were rare in Faerun . Description . Minotaurs were evil giant muscular humanoids with fur - covered bodies and bull - like heads . It was once believed that all minotaurs were male ; actually cursed humans that had been altered by the gods or a demon lord to become a minotaur . That legend proved false as female minotaurs became more prevalent over the years . Personality . Minotaurs were carnivores , but preferred the taste of human flesh . They loved to dwell within maze - like caverns or ruins , where their innate sense of direction prevented them from getting lost . They lured travelers into their maze - like homes , where the minotaurs had the advantage over their unfortunate prey . Many minotaurs couldn ' t be trusted with non - minotaur races at times , since most humanoids were their meal , and they would do anything for a quick bite out of a sleeping party member , slave owner , or wandering villager . They were not welcomed in any cities , and received an immediate death sentence , or a stoning if caught .

title: Minroe
description: Minroe Minroe was a town in Cormyr located west of the King ' s Forest . History . It was a mining town for many years but by 1370 DR the mines were no longer profitable and the population dwindled to about 100 souls .
description_long: Minroe Minroe was a town in Cormyr located west of the King ' s Forest . History . It was a mining town for many years but by 1370 DR the mines were no longer profitable and the population dwindled to about 100 souls . It became known for its mushrooms , which grew in some of the old mines . During the reign of King Foril I , mining resumed and the population expanded fivefold . Minroe was reputed to have high quality jewelers and gunsmiths who provided their products at affordable rates . It also remained known for it ' s mushrooms which still grew in some of the mines . Appendix . References . Dragon 365 " Backdrop Cormyr " ( pg 48 ) . " Volo ' s Guide to Cormyr " tsr9486 , 1995 , ( pg 125 ) .

title: Minsc
description: Minsc Minsc is a kind - hearted , but rather addled warrior known for his habit of talking to a hamster . He believes that the animal , called Boo , is a Miniature Giant Space Hamster , but no - one else ever sees any evidence of this . The Novel .
description_long: Minsc Minsc is a kind - hearted , but rather addled warrior known for his habit of talking to a hamster . He believes that the animal , called Boo , is a Miniature Giant Space Hamster , but no - one else ever sees any evidence of this . The Novel . In the of Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn , Minsc is encountered in Irenicus ' s dungeon ( for unknown reasons ) and escapes it along with Abdel Adrian . He has red hair and does not play a significant role in the rest of the story . The Games . Minsc appears in all the games in the Baldur ' s Gate series and is voiced by . He ' s first encountered in Nashkel in " Baldur ' s Gate " , where he is looking for heroes to help him save his charge Dynaheir who has been captured by gnolls . The pair of them have both left their homeland of Rashemen to perform their respective rites of passage , he acting as her bodyguard and she as his " witch " . It is up to the player to decide what to do about this quest , but it ' s possible to rescue Dynaheir and recruit both characters in one ' s party . Refusal to help will result in Minsc ' s attacking , as he is somewhat unstable .

title: Minser
description: Minser Minser was a peddler in Sembia . History . Minser lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia .
description_long: Minser Minser was a peddler in Sembia . History . Minser lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia . In 1480 DR he went to the Abbey of the Rose to ask to heal a ill uncle of him , becoming a follower of Amaunator . In 1484 DR , Minser traveled to the Dalelands and Cormyr before going back to Fairelm . However , Sayeed and Zeeahd arrived in the village and when they discovered he knew about the Abbey they unleashed their pack of spined devil s to slaughter all the inhabitants except Minser and Elle in order to force Minser to show them the right way . Afterward , he out of fear agreed to show to Sayeed and Zeeahd the right way . So they decided to no need him more and unlashed the spines devils that killed him

title: Minsker Halbar
description: Minsker Halbar Minsker Halbar was a human male wizard from Calaunt in the Vast . He was the proprietor of Halbar ' s Bookshop around 1358 DR . He was an old and quiet man , but one of the most accomplished wizards among Calaunt ' s oppressed mages .
description_long: Minsker Halbar Minsker Halbar was a human male wizard from Calaunt in the Vast . He was the proprietor of Halbar ' s Bookshop around 1358 DR . He was an old and quiet man , but one of the most accomplished wizards among Calaunt ' s oppressed mages .

title: Mintar
description: Mintar Mintar was a large city located on the Lake of Steam . History . In 1362 DR , Mintar was conquered by an army of the church of Bane led by Teldorn Darkhope and aided by a beholder named Vaxall .
description_long: Mintar Mintar was a large city located on the Lake of Steam . History . In 1362 DR , Mintar was conquered by an army of the church of Bane led by Teldorn Darkhope and aided by a beholder named Vaxall . . Mintar then conquered the isolated Tethyrian town of Kzelter in 1370 DR .

title: Mintarn
description: Mintarn The island of Mintarn lay 400 miles ( 640km ) southwest of Waterdeep , in the Sea of Swords . Mintarn was a popular safe haven for those fleeing the authorities as well as neutral ground for conflicting parties to come to accord . This beautiful island asked no questions and turned no one away .
description_long: Mintarn The island of Mintarn lay 400 miles ( 640km ) southwest of Waterdeep , in the Sea of Swords . Mintarn was a popular safe haven for those fleeing the authorities as well as neutral ground for conflicting parties to come to accord . This beautiful island asked no questions and turned no one away . Rule . Piracy . Pirates and other fugitives from justice held business transactions in Mintarn . Legendary taverns and festhalls were famous for both their food and service , and the high level of inherent danger found within . Tyranny . Tarnheel Embuirhan ruled Mintarn , beginning around 1357 DR . His skill as a warrior was reputed to be a major contributing factor to his rise to power . Though technically a tyrant , his rule was open - minded and he preferred to let much of the island govern itself . While he ended the frequent conflicts with neighbouring Orlumbor which had been raising the hackles of the Lords ' Alliance , he also would not hesitate to use brutal force to restore order or keep pirates in check . Tarnheel styled himself as a ' tyrant ' and people had to refer to him as ' His Tyrancy ' .

title: Mintassan the Magnificent
description: Mintassan the Magnificent Mintassan the Magnificent ( also known as the Sage or the Mad ) is a planewalker and sage of the planes that lives in the city of Westgate . His sigil is a stylized sideview of a four - legged beast that vaguely resembles the letter ' M ' . Personality .
description_long: Mintassan the Magnificent Mintassan the Magnificent ( also known as the Sage or the Mad ) is a planewalker and sage of the planes that lives in the city of Westgate . His sigil is a stylized sideview of a four - legged beast that vaguely resembles the letter ' M ' . Personality . Whimsical and impulsive , Mintassan loves adventuring . Equipment . He is known to have several magical items , including a staff of the undead . Rumors . He has been romantically linked with Alias . The sage Mintassan has the unique ability communicate with all other planes of existence simultaneously and pull beings from one to another . Apparently a magical experiment in planar travel splintered his being into pieces of himself across the planes , each communicating with the other . Mintassan was captured by the Black guardsmen of the Arch - Lich , Mystenaculis The Black Bard and tortured in the Ministry of Truth in Westgate . He was freed in a rescue attempt by the Threshold Adventurer ' s Guild . He is now residing amongst the insurgents in Threshold to the South . Home . Mintassan ' s townhouse is located in the southern section of Westgate .

title: Minthra Mhandyvver
description: Minthra Mhandyvver Minthra Mhandyvver , usually known as Minny , was a shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Personality . Minny had the demeanor of a kindly , old dodderer , but she was very sharp .
description_long: Minthra Mhandyvver Minthra Mhandyvver , usually known as Minny , was a shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Personality . Minny had the demeanor of a kindly , old dodderer , but she was very sharp . She , among other things , knew the identities of most of the Believers members but believed them harmless . Activities . Minny managed a poultry shop with her three grown children in the village . History . In 1491 , Minny was worried for her adventurous young granddaughter , Pell Mhandyvver , who had had an unpleasant adventure in the Haunted Tomb .

title: Mintiper Moonsilver
description: Mintiper Moonsilver Mintiper Moonsilver was a bard whose works were collected in Silverymoon and compiled into " Mintiper ' s Chapbook " . Appearance . Mintiper ' s eyes were usually blue but whose brightness fluctuated with his mood , growing darker when angered or shining when excited .
description_long: Mintiper Moonsilver Mintiper Moonsilver was a bard whose works were collected in Silverymoon and compiled into " Mintiper ' s Chapbook " . Appearance . Mintiper ' s eyes were usually blue but whose brightness fluctuated with his mood , growing darker when angered or shining when excited . He had shoulder - length black hair and a distinctive burn mark lay on the back of his right hand . Mintiper stood tall at 6 ft 2 in ( 1 . 9 m ) but was noted to weigh only 142 lb ( 64 . 4 kg ) . His left shoulder bears Alyniria ' s silver lip impression . He tended to wear non - descript clothing in earthy tones . Biography . Mintiper ' s childhood was a mystery to all . He was out on his own , living solely on the merit of his skills at a very young age . Mirt claimed that his father was a waterdhavian while his mother ( Mintiper himself said her name was Maralen ) was a moon elf from Ardeep Forest , though Mirt accepts that his claim could be wildly erroneous . Mintiper ' s sometime use of the surname Silverhand could also link him to the family of Dornal Silverhand , father of the Seven Sisters .

title: Mir - Jhaamdath War
description: Mir - Jhaamdath War The Mir - Jhaamdath War broke out in - 5032 DR when Jhaamdath got into contact with the realm of Mir . Mir lost some battles and had to made an alliance with Coramshan in - 5007 DR . The war ended in - 5005 DR and both sides had to give up their intentions to get hold on the land around the Lake of Steam .
description_long: Mir - Jhaamdath War The Mir - Jhaamdath War broke out in - 5032 DR when Jhaamdath got into contact with the realm of Mir . Mir lost some battles and had to made an alliance with Coramshan in - 5007 DR . The war ended in - 5005 DR and both sides had to give up their intentions to get hold on the land around the Lake of Steam . Mir and Coramshan united to the present realm of Calimshan .

title: Mira Roper
description: Mira Roper Mira Roper was a guard in the Moonsea . Activities . Mira was one of the few guards on the payroll of the Red Plumes in the village of Hillpicket .
description_long: Mira Roper Mira Roper was a guard in the Moonsea . Activities . Mira was one of the few guards on the payroll of the Red Plumes in the village of Hillpicket . History . Mira , during the time of the Rage of Demons , was concerned about the arrival of the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities . Personality . Mira did not agree with the ideology of the Red Plumes and her work in the rural areas proved to her that non - human s were good people . She was concerned about Aelia ' s theory about the Carnival .

title: Mira Satra
description: Mira Satra Mira Satra owned some boarding houses in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Mira managed the Blue Roan , a complex of four boarding houses in Cormyr ean style with well - kept stables .
description_long: Mira Satra Mira Satra owned some boarding houses in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Mira managed the Blue Roan , a complex of four boarding houses in Cormyr ean style with well - kept stables . History . In 1358 DR , Mira Satra was called to a meeting of prominent citizens gathered by Lord Fior Botpur to discuss the menace of a barbarian army from Kara - Tur . Personality . Mira was an able businessman , his prices were high but his places were comfortable . He hated war but never fled from an enemy .

title: Mira Zawad
description: Mira Zawad Mira Zawad was a scholar , antiquarian , and relic hunter in league with the Zhentarim . She was the only child of the Harper Tam Zawad . History .
description_long: Mira Zawad Mira Zawad was a scholar , antiquarian , and relic hunter in league with the Zhentarim . She was the only child of the Harper Tam Zawad . History . Mira grew up rarely seeing her father , who was the head priest for a cell of Harpers operating on the southern Sword Coast . She apprenticed to antiquarians in Baldur ' s Gate as a teenager . At some point , she became involved with the Zhentarim because they gave her access to ruins she could never find on her own . In 1478 DR , Mira was posing as a mercenary guard for a Waterdavian merchant who possessed a page from a magical Netherese book . After the page was sold to an agent of the Shadovar , Mira helped her father steal the page and was able to locate the ancient Netherese library the page came from . Mira traveled to the library with her father and the tiefling sisters Farideh and Havilar and recovered the book . During their adventure , they destroyed the library and the undead within . By the 1486 DR Mira had secretly joined the Harpers and acted as their spy inside the Zhent .

title: Mira al - Mikam
description: Mira al - Mikam Mira al - Mikam ran a barber shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Young and beautiful , Mira exemplified elven grace .
description_long: Mira al - Mikam Mira al - Mikam ran a barber shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Young and beautiful , Mira exemplified elven grace . Activities . Mira was well - respected as a barber and singer . She decorated her shop with crystal vases and flowers . History . Mira ' s first adventure as a younger elf led to the death off all her companions . She carried a distaste for adventuring with her ever since that tragic event .

title: Mirabar
description: Mirabar Mirabar was a mining city of great wealth located on the Sword Coast . As of 1368 DR it was the richest city north of Waterdeep . In 1370 DR , the city was occupied by 1600 shield dwarves who lived underground near to their workshops , which produced metal goods for export in the region and beyond .
description_long: Mirabar Mirabar was a mining city of great wealth located on the Sword Coast . As of 1368 DR it was the richest city north of Waterdeep . In 1370 DR , the city was occupied by 1600 shield dwarves who lived underground near to their workshops , which produced metal goods for export in the region and beyond . The humans above cooperated with the dwarves to handle the mining , move the ore to market and defend the city against magical threats . Mirabar was ruled by a hereditary marchion , Elastul Raurym , but the true power was in an elected assembly called the Council of Sparkling Stones , a dwarven and human group that met once a year to determine production quotas and whether or not to threaten current clients with reduced output . It was led by the dwarven cleric of Dumathoin , Agrathan Hardhammer . Mirabar also had an elected sceptrana , Shoudra Stargleam in 1370 DR . Description . Mirabar stands on a knoll on the north banks of the River Mirar . On the surface , Mirabar is populated with squat stone buildings and a few stone towers . It is arranged in such a way as to provide great efficiency .

title: Mirabar District
description: Mirabar District The Mirabar District ( also known as the Mirabar Shield ) was a district on the north bank of the city of Luskan , and was dedicated to the warehouses used by Mirabarran merchants operating in the city . As of 1370 DR , companies such as Anvilfist Banner , the Golden Hand , and Thalorin ' s Manymetals traded in this district . These companies operated up to 90 guards to prevent " accidental " injuries from the Luskan militia , who were known to fire into the district for " blood money " .
description_long: Mirabar District The Mirabar District ( also known as the Mirabar Shield ) was a district on the north bank of the city of Luskan , and was dedicated to the warehouses used by Mirabarran merchants operating in the city . As of 1370 DR , companies such as Anvilfist Banner , the Golden Hand , and Thalorin ' s Manymetals traded in this district . These companies operated up to 90 guards to prevent " accidental " injuries from the Luskan militia , who were known to fire into the district for " blood money " .

title: Mirage wall
description: Mirage wall Mirage wall was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an illusionary wall wherever the caster could see .
description_long: Mirage wall Mirage wall was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an illusionary wall wherever the caster could see . The wall was not confined to a rectangular shape and could be of any shape the caster desired . The wall could be used to cloak living creatures or to create any kind of scene the caster wished . The mirage wall would disappear if the caster willed it , a " dispel magic " or similar spell was cast upon it , or if a living creature walked through it . Components . This spell required an eyelash , a pinch of sand , and some sweat to cast .

title: Miraj Vizann
description: Miraj Vizann Miraj Vizann was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Miraj was a very rational and deliberate individual .
description_long: Miraj Vizann Miraj Vizann was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Miraj was a very rational and deliberate individual . He joined the earth cult only to deepen his understanding of elemental magic . He believed that enemies could be bribeed or persuaded , such as to attack instead fire cultists . For his practice of both earth and water magic , Miraj called himself a " mud sorcerer " . He was a perfectionist . He was so focused on his magical research that he had no interest in challenging Marlos Urnrayle for leadership . History . Miraj hailed from Calimshan . In 1491 DR , Miraj oversaw the Black Earth temple in Tyar - Besil .

title: Mirandos
description: Mirandos Mirandos was a priest of Helm who was sent to Maztica to convert the native population of Payit and Far Payit . Until she went rogue , Mirandos was considered an excellent missionary . One of Mirandos ' s duties was to burn heretical native texts and while engaged in this activity she stumbled upon books that referenced the ruined city of Ixtzul and its guardian the Star Worm .
description_long: Mirandos Mirandos was a priest of Helm who was sent to Maztica to convert the native population of Payit and Far Payit . Until she went rogue , Mirandos was considered an excellent missionary . One of Mirandos ' s duties was to burn heretical native texts and while engaged in this activity she stumbled upon books that referenced the ruined city of Ixtzul and its guardian the Star Worm . Mirandos became convinced she could use magic al means to control the Star Worm and turn it into a tool for Helm ' s greater glory . She went missing with a small group of Payit warriors and Bishop Devane commissioned a group of adventurers to track down her whereabouts and bring her back if possible . In 1362 DR , she resided in Ixtzul and was attempting to complete the rite to wake the Star Worm .

title: Miraun
description: Miraun Miraun was a male human enchanter and the " diplomat at large " for Zhentil Keep and the Zhentarim in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . As required in his job , Miraun was an intelligent and charming person .
description_long: Miraun Miraun was a male human enchanter and the " diplomat at large " for Zhentil Keep and the Zhentarim in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . As required in his job , Miraun was an intelligent and charming person . Although he was quite competent , Fzoul Chembryl disliked him , and as Fzoul rose in power , Miraun ' s position declined . Miraun couldn ' t think why Manshoon tolerated Fzoul in the Zhentarim . He considered doing more work with Darkhold . Activities . Miraun usually traveled as an ambassador for Zhentil Keep , in which capacity he reported to various heads of state the official position of the Zhentarim . History . Miraun was a long - standing member of the Zhentarim and was their official envoy . In 1370 DR , his position began to decline as a result of Fzoul ' s dislike and own rise in status . Only his competent ambassadorial service shielded him from the worst consequences .

title: Miresella
description: Miresella Miresella was a scout from Baldur ' s Gate . History . Miresella was following a caravan when she happened to discover the secret Cult of the Dragon village of Parnast .
description_long: Miresella Miresella was a scout from Baldur ' s Gate . History . Miresella was following a caravan when she happened to discover the secret Cult of the Dragon village of Parnast . She was captured and transported to the Cult ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains , under the care of Talis Kasterel , who deeply scared her .

title: Mirg Isle
description: Mirg Isle Mirg Isle was an island and a pirate stronghold in the Pirate Isles . It had two ports . History .
description_long: Mirg Isle Mirg Isle was an island and a pirate stronghold in the Pirate Isles . It had two ports . History . The island was originally under the control of Xenz , a pirate allied with Zhentil Keep , but Vurgrom the Mighty seized power by defeating Xenz in combat . A whirlpool sank twenty - five of Vurgrom ' s ships and significantly lowered the power he exerted on the island . Vurgrom ' s alliance with Iakhovas has caused his power to be diminished to the point where he is no longer in control of the island , and some of its inhabitants speculate that the true ruler is once again Xenz .

title: Mirkazar
description: Mirkazar Mirkazar was a protectorate of the Kingdom of Tethyr that contained most of the Forest of Mir . Geography . The Mir Protectorate was located in the of Suretmarch , south of counties Alonmarch and Surkazar .
description_long: Mirkazar Mirkazar was a protectorate of the Kingdom of Tethyr that contained most of the Forest of Mir . Geography . The Mir Protectorate was located in the of Suretmarch , south of counties Alonmarch and Surkazar . It was the only region of Tethyr where humans were in control of large forests — at least in name . Government . The druid Yuldar Llistiin was lord protector and count of Mirkazar , both before and after the Interregnum . He lived in Mistletoe Keep . During the Interregnum , however , the Mir Protectorate was ruled by Thenas Haddarm , former mayor of Kzelter , who captured Mistletoe Keep ( then called Yuldar ' s Keep ) , soon after the Ten Black Days of Eleint . After Queen Zaranada came to power , he was beheaded , and control of Mirkazar was returned to Yuldar . History . Since the time of Strohm II , this region had historically been a military holding , for the greater defense of Tethyr . The soldiers there kept the monsters and dangers of the Forest and the Marching Mountains at bay . With the fall of Kzelter in 1370 DR , this put a strain on the number of troops able to keep watch on the woods . Notable Locations .

title: Mirol
description: Mirol Mirol was the merfolk prince of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1345 DR as Prince Mirol III he was a bookish cleric of Eadro until after the Twelfth Serôs War with the king Vhaemas ' s injury Mirol was choose as temporary regent .
description_long: Mirol Mirol was the merfolk prince of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1345 DR as Prince Mirol III he was a bookish cleric of Eadro until after the Twelfth Serôs War with the king Vhaemas ' s injury Mirol was choose as temporary regent . Thank also to the help of his sister Arina he did a good job but at 1370 DR was still trying to recover Voalidru , Eadraal ' s capital , from monstrous hands . Activities . Mirol managed very well the necessities of his exiled people , despite he preferred care about the church of Eadro . Despite objections by some people Mirol was firm in maintain the Nantarn Alliance in respect for his father ' s decisions . Personality . Mirol at hearth was a shy and nervous individual . He managed to work well thank to the support of his wife and children . Powers . With his appointment as regent Mirol gained the ability to unlash electrical touch .

title: Miros Xelbrin
description: Miros Xelbrin Miros Xelbrin was was an innkeeper ins Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Miros managed the Northfurrow ' s End inn .
description_long: Miros Xelbrin Miros Xelbrin was was an innkeeper ins Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Miros managed the Northfurrow ' s End inn . He was a member of the Waterdeep ' s Fellowship of the Innkeepers guild and a supporter of the Emerald Enclave . History . Miros was born to Lathan and Melantha xelbrin . In youth Miros was a carnival attraction for his barrel - shaped body and his white hairs covering most of his body . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR he ran a inn . He was at his inn when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Miros totally agreed with the Emerald Enclave ' s goals . For him was okay joked about himself but no about his inn or his employers . In case he descended in rage . Behind the scenes . Miros was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Mirran
description: Mirran Mirran was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Mirran was the eldest daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Mirran Mirran was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Mirran was the eldest daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In opposite to her mothers and her youngest sister Serissa Mirran and her sister Nym had an evil hearth but Hekaton knowing this appointed Serissa as his heir . Mirran and Nym were greatly angered incorrectly blaming their mother Neri for this decision but no act until at the giants ' court arrived Iymrith , disguised as a giant lady . With Iymrith ' s help in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR the two storm giants princesses plotted the assassination of their mother and the kidnapping of their father . Mirran and Nym were entrained several giants ambassadors arrived in search of news about princess Serissa ' s plans for the future . Personality . Mirran was a spoiled brat totally unpredictable . She wanted for herself the power of the Wyrmskull Throne , that she believed was destinate to her as the eldest daughter . Mirran believed her a chosen one to rule and that all giants would kneel before her . She planned to resurrect the ancient empire of Ostoria , destroying the small folks .

title: Mirror
description: Mirror Mirror was a ghost that manifested in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . Appearance . Mirror was usually perceived as a phosphorescence floating through the air , which sometimes assumed a manlike shape and could momentarily take on the semblance of a nearby person or sculpture .
description_long: Mirror Mirror was a ghost that manifested in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . Appearance . Mirror was usually perceived as a phosphorescence floating through the air , which sometimes assumed a manlike shape and could momentarily take on the semblance of a nearby person or sculpture . During the years he spent at Bareris Anskuld ' s side , he apparently remembered more of his past and sometimes showed a wavering semblance of what had been his own living face : a lean visage with a big hooked nose and a drooping mustache . He even began to speak occasionally . Combat . Mirror was once a master swordsman and at most times carried the semblance of a sword in his hand . He could not be hurt by normal weapons or even most magical attacks . Sometimes , he wore something resembling a round shield or targe affixed to his free forearm . Unlike other undead creatures , Mirror seemed to be unaffected or harmed by sunlight . Abilities . When Mirror remembered that he once was a knight bestowed with god - given powers , he was able use these powers though they seemed to be a drain on his very substance . On the first occasion , he cured Aoth Fezim ' s spellplague - affected sight .

title: Mirror image
description: Mirror image Mirror image allows the caster to bring several illusions of him or herself into being in the caster ' s immediate surroundings . The images behave and look exactly like the caster , and the caster is able to merge with , or split from , any of the images at will . If an image is struck , such as with a weapon , it disappears for good .
description_long: Mirror image Mirror image allows the caster to bring several illusions of him or herself into being in the caster ' s immediate surroundings . The images behave and look exactly like the caster , and the caster is able to merge with , or split from , any of the images at will . If an image is struck , such as with a weapon , it disappears for good . Notably , the Cormyr ean state sword " Ilbratha " allows its wielder to cast " mirror image " on him or herself ( and the sword ) once per day .

title: Mirror of perfection
description: Mirror of perfection The mirror of perfection was a magic item in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Around 607 DR , the " mirror of perfection " was hidden in the Caves of Ghazz on the island of Saishu off the coast of Koryo . It was thought to still be there by 1357 DR , but the exact location of the caves was unknown .
description_long: Mirror of perfection The mirror of perfection was a magic item in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Around 607 DR , the " mirror of perfection " was hidden in the Caves of Ghazz on the island of Saishu off the coast of Koryo . It was thought to still be there by 1357 DR , but the exact location of the caves was unknown . This was one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who would seek out the caves for him .

title: Mirrorman ' s Mill
description: Mirrorman ' s Mill Mirrorman ' s Mill was an old millhouse in Shadowdale . Geography . The mill was located south of the village at the confluence of the Duckrace and the Millpond .
description_long: Mirrorman ' s Mill Mirrorman ' s Mill was an old millhouse in Shadowdale . Geography . The mill was located south of the village at the confluence of the Duckrace and the Millpond . History . In the years leading up to 1375 DR , Lord Mourngrym used the mill to house troops from the Twisted Tower of Ashaba as a service to the community during harvest time .

title: Mirt
description: Mirt Mirt " the Moneylender " was a fat , wheezing old rogue , and retired adventurer . He made his fortune as an adventurer in Undermountain after a colorful career as a mercenary general . During this time Mirt , then known as Mirt the Merciless or the Old Wolf or Lord Walrus .
description_long: Mirt Mirt " the Moneylender " was a fat , wheezing old rogue , and retired adventurer . He made his fortune as an adventurer in Undermountain after a colorful career as a mercenary general . During this time Mirt , then known as Mirt the Merciless or the Old Wolf or Lord Walrus . made many enemies all over the Sword Coast , but also a few friends , notably Durnan a fellow adventurer and Undermountain explorer . Post Spellplague . At some time in late middle - age , Mirt was imprisoned within a magical hand axe . In 1479 DR a Cormyran noble named Marlin Stormserpent stole the axe from another noble family , mistakenly believing it was an artifact of The Nine . He called Mirt out of the axe and Mirt escaped into Suzail . Personality . Outwardly Mirt appeared to be a loud , tipsy braggart , but only a foreigner to Waterdeep would underestimate his agility and cunning . These qualities made him far richer late in life , as an investor and business man , than his years as an adventurer ever did , despite his being one of the few adventurers to emerge alive with wealth from Undermountain . Relationships .

title: Mirthal Aendryr
description: Mirthal Aendryr Mirthal Aendryr was Duke of Durmista and the Suldusk elves , Scoutlord of Tethyr , and a former member of the Company of Eight . Description . Mirthal was a wild elf ( green elf ) of the Suldusk tribe of the eastern Forest of Tethir , known as Durmista .
description_long: Mirthal Aendryr Mirthal Aendryr was Duke of Durmista and the Suldusk elves , Scoutlord of Tethyr , and a former member of the Company of Eight . Description . Mirthal was a wild elf ( green elf ) of the Suldusk tribe of the eastern Forest of Tethir , known as Durmista . He was very short for an elf , standing only five feet tall . He also had a quiet , melodic voice , which seemingly conflicted with his great skill as a powerful warrior . Personality . Mirthal had a great talent for diplomacy , often able to avoid conflict more quickly with his words than with his dagger or wizard spells . His views were less extreme than those of Count Sylvanus Moondrop , which was in part why he was chosen for his position as one of three representatives of the elves of Tethyr . Relationships . Mirthal was a member of Clan Aendryr , one of the three remaining Suldusk families . His cousin was Tarasynora Aendryr , who had been tasked with teaching the elven children of Durmista magic . The clan was small and not considered a great tribe among the other " Sy ' Tel ' Quessir " . Mirthal was married for 40 years , and he and his wife had twin daughters in 1363 DR .

title: Misbahd
description: Misbahd Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the village of Misbahd , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants .
description_long: Misbahd Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the village of Misbahd , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants . The majority of the inhabitants were concerned with piracy and dealing with goods gained that way . Defenses . Misbahd was also protected by fortifications and a number of allied ships .

title: Mischa Waymeet
description: Mischa Waymeet Mischa Waymeet was one of Drogan Droganson students in Hilltop . Description . Mischa had shoulder length blonde hair , fair skin and green eyes .
description_long: Mischa Waymeet Mischa Waymeet was one of Drogan Droganson students in Hilltop . Description . Mischa had shoulder length blonde hair , fair skin and green eyes . She often wore her plate mail armor with blue embellishments and , during her time as an apprentice and adventurer in training , had a practice greatsword . Personality . As a paladin , Mischa tended to be rather serious and focused , but her lack of experience resulted in her being somewhat naive . She also had a very clear - cut ideals and morale about what constituted good and evil . This on at least one occasion lead to her failing a test set by Drogan . However , she continued to be eager to get to her final test at the school and start her life of adventuring , leaving her rather disappointed that she could not go help retrieve stolen artifacts after the kobold attack . Possessions . Drogan ' s apprentices all possessed a ring which allowed them to teleport themselves to Drogan ' s location at the cost of focus crystals . Relationships . Mischa did not get on well with her fellow apprentice , Xanos Messarmos , as he often mocked her abilities and they had very different views about the world .

title: Misdirection
description: Misdirection Misdirection was an illusion spell that could confuse divination spells trying to read the auras of a person or an object . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .
description_long: Misdirection Misdirection was an illusion spell that could confuse divination spells trying to read the auras of a person or an object . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . Another person , creature , or object had to be nearby the subject to be obfuscated .

title: Mishtan
description: Mishtan Mishtan was just one of many villages within the Great Vale of Mulhorand , but stood out from others because it was the gateway to the Land of the Dead — the resting place for pharaohs and their families . Description . Tombs and other construction projects were a never - ending occurrence in Mishtan .
description_long: Mishtan Mishtan was just one of many villages within the Great Vale of Mulhorand , but stood out from others because it was the gateway to the Land of the Dead — the resting place for pharaohs and their families . Description . Tombs and other construction projects were a never - ending occurrence in Mishtan . Inhabitants . The temple of Osiris ruled Mishtan . Mishtan ' s regular population in 1357 DR was 2 , 000 but could easily swell to 30 , 000 if a large construction project was taking place .

title: Misikin
description: Misikin Misikin was a feng - huang member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Misikin was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .
description_long: Misikin Misikin was a feng - huang member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Misikin was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Misikin oversaw the feathered animals . She ruled Qui during the Season of the Phoenix . She commanded 30 giant eagle s and 10 human slaves , of which 10 eagles were always on patrol . She interacted directly with intruders and asked for tribute to her . History . In 1358 DR , one of her human slaves was the body of Setsu Iki .

title: Miska the Wolf - Spider
description: Miska the Wolf - Spider Miska , the Wolf - Spider , is a demon lord who was once the Prince of Demons . He was imprisoned in Pandemonium by the Wind Dukes of Aaqa . The Queen of Chaos utterly destroyed the prince of demons , Obox - ob , and gave the title to Miska .
description_long: Miska the Wolf - Spider Miska , the Wolf - Spider , is a demon lord who was once the Prince of Demons . He was imprisoned in Pandemonium by the Wind Dukes of Aaqa . The Queen of Chaos utterly destroyed the prince of demons , Obox - ob , and gave the title to Miska .

title: Misker
description: Misker Misker the Pirate Tyrant was a beholder smuggler king in Skullport . Personality . Misker was known to have a very creative mind in developing his smuggling routes .
description_long: Misker Misker the Pirate Tyrant was a beholder smuggler king in Skullport . Personality . Misker was known to have a very creative mind in developing his smuggling routes . His long memory ensured that nobody who cheated him could escape his revenge . Activities . Misker managed most of the smuggling operations in Skullport . Powers . Misker ' s nickname derived from two of his eyestalks , which were always covered by eyepatches . Those eyestalks had unique abilities , which nobody knew for sure . History . Misker had directed his smuggling operations for a very long time . In 1370 DR , just after the death of his major competitor , the beholder Seirtych Xantaun , who was killed at the hands of the Xanathar , Misker retreated from most of his operation . He left it in the hands of his trusted underlings , and acted only as an advisor . He said he had decided to go into semi - retirement because he had enough money .

title: Mislead
description: Mislead Mislead is an illusion spell that turns the caster invisible and creates an illusory double . Effect . An illusory double of the caster ( a figment ) appears , and at the same time , the caster becomes invisible ( as improved invisibility , a glamer ) .
description_long: Mislead Mislead is an illusion spell that turns the caster invisible and creates an illusory double . Effect . An illusory double of the caster ( a figment ) appears , and at the same time , the caster becomes invisible ( as improved invisibility , a glamer ) . The caster is then free to go elsewhere while his or her double moves away . The double appears within range but thereafter moves according to the caster ' s intent at the time of casting . The caster can make the figment appear superimposed perfectly over his or her own body so that observers don ’ t notice an image appearing and him or her turning invisible . The caster and the figment can then move in different directions . The double moves at the caster ' s speed , can talk and gesture as if it were real , and even smells and feels real . The double cannot attack or cast spells , but it can pretend to do so .

title: Missile mastery
description: Missile mastery Missile mastery was an arcane alteration spell that allowed the caster to alter the trajectory of a missile . Effects . This spell had a duration of 4 minutes , and during that time the caster could stop or reflect a single mundane or enchanted physical missile , such as a rock , a crossbow bolt , a javelin , a throwing axe , an " arrow + 1 " , a vial of " holy water " , or a flask of oil .
description_long: Missile mastery Missile mastery was an arcane alteration spell that allowed the caster to alter the trajectory of a missile . Effects . This spell had a duration of 4 minutes , and during that time the caster could stop or reflect a single mundane or enchanted physical missile , such as a rock , a crossbow bolt , a javelin , a throwing axe , an " arrow + 1 " , a vial of " holy water " , or a flask of oil . A single " magic missile " could also be targeted , but was simply canceled with no chance at reflection . If the missile was reflected back to its source , " missile mastery " granted a significant improvement to the original sender ' s chance to hit . Concentration on this spell was not required , so the caster could move and fight , but targeting a missile or casting another spell terminated " missile mastery " . There were range and size limitations on the missile , and enchanted missiles had a chance to resist being affected . To be a viable target for this spell , the missile had to pass through a sphere centered on the caster of radius 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) per experience level of the caster .

title: Misstyre
description: Misstyre Misstyre was a drow wizard and merchant who lead a tribe of a hundred or so of his brethren in the western region of the High Forest . Personality . The drow ' s group would capture female elves from the nearby area under Misstyre ' s leadership .
description_long: Misstyre Misstyre was a drow wizard and merchant who lead a tribe of a hundred or so of his brethren in the western region of the High Forest . Personality . The drow ' s group would capture female elves from the nearby area under Misstyre ' s leadership . To maintain a strong military presence , Misstyre would order his men to regularly waylay nearby travelers and woodsmen .

title: Mist cheese
description: Mist cheese Mist cheese was a rich cheese crafted in Loudwater Vale within the Savage Frontier . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Mist cheese Mist cheese was a rich cheese crafted in Loudwater Vale within the Savage Frontier . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Mist cheese , or " Ethereal cheese " , was a soft white cheese that was translucent if sliced thin enough . Prices . Mist cheese could be purchased in the following sizes :

title: Mist of the goddess
description: Mist of the goddess Mist of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It created a holy mist that could return one unfortunate soul to full health , blessed vitality , and mental acuity , or it could be used to reincarnate one or more beings . Effects .
description_long: Mist of the goddess Mist of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It created a holy mist that could return one unfortunate soul to full health , blessed vitality , and mental acuity , or it could be used to reincarnate one or more beings . Effects . This spell created a green , glowing mist in the shape of a conical tent with its apex 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) above a circular base . The base could be specified as small as 10 ft ( 3 m ) to as large as 280 ft ( 85 m ) in diameter . The center of the base could be placed up to 210 ft ( 64 m ) away . The range of casting and the size of the base could be even larger for more experienced casters . Solid objects ( walls , ceiling ) could block the mist , but otherwise it expanded to the size chosen by the caster . The recipient of this spell , chosen by the caster , had to be touched by the mist for the spell to take effect . If the recipient was a corpse , then it was first " resurrected " , followed by " restoration " , " regeneration " , " heal " , " remove curse " , and " cure disease " .

title: Mistdown Marauders
description: Mistdown Marauders The Mistdown Marauders were a famed adventuring company that operated in the Vast . They were based out of The Stag and Viper inn at Viperstongue Ford . History .
description_long: Mistdown Marauders The Mistdown Marauders were a famed adventuring company that operated in the Vast . They were based out of The Stag and Viper inn at Viperstongue Ford . History . The Mistdown Marauders gained some fame for their exploits . They were believed to have earned a fortune in coin , gem s , jewellery , and magical armor . When they attempted to loot treasure belonging to a ghost , they met a grisly end . Their bodies were found stripped of their own wealth and treasure , apparently claimed by the ghost . They buried amongst trees north - east of Viperstongue Ford . Afterwards , local legend held that , buried with the Marauders , were cryptic clues to the location of the ghost ' s treasure . It was also said that some of the Marauders had risen as undead to guard their graves .

title: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco
description: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco , or Mist for short , was a red dragon famous for killing an abomination of the god Moander . Personality . Though she ate living creatures and kept a hoard of a treasure that she coveted like any other red dragon , she didn ' t enjoy killing just for the sake of killing or the joy of inspiring terror .
description_long: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco , or Mist for short , was a red dragon famous for killing an abomination of the god Moander . Personality . Though she ate living creatures and kept a hoard of a treasure that she coveted like any other red dragon , she didn ' t enjoy killing just for the sake of killing or the joy of inspiring terror . She also valued entertainment more than her gold , gems and magic . History . Mistinarperadnacles ' first recorded appearance in history was as part of the Flight of the Dragons , though she didn ' t have anything to do with Syluné Silverhand ' s death personally . She also accompanied Thauglor to The Passing of Power in - 205 DR . She fled in terror when Thauglor ' s throat exploded . Mist learned that destruction on such a scale was not the way she liked to do things . She retreated to a lair in the Storm Horns , killing the younger , male red dragon to whom it belonged .
