From that base she launched attacks on merchants heading from Suzail to Waymoot for food and treasure for her hoard . On one of these caravans traveled a halfling bard named Olive Ruskettle .

title: Mistledale
description: Mistledale Mistledale was one of the regions that made up the Dalelands . It consisted mainly of a grassy vale in the midst of the elven forest , allegedly created by a falling star . This was among the more peaceful of the Dales , although as of 1372 DR , drow incursions from the forest began causing serious problems .
description_long: Mistledale Mistledale was one of the regions that made up the Dalelands . It consisted mainly of a grassy vale in the midst of the elven forest , allegedly created by a falling star . This was among the more peaceful of the Dales , although as of 1372 DR , drow incursions from the forest began causing serious problems . Geography . Mistledale covered a large stretch of land , reaching over 100 miles east to west and roughly 30 miles wide . Flatter than the neghbouring dales ; the land was an area of rolling plains and open grasslands since the early days of Cormanthyr . Defenses . The first line of defense in Mistledale were the Riders of Mistledale who patrolled the dale and protected the people from outside incursions . These Riders were supplemented by a local and well - armed militia , who numbered about 200 active members and at least 600 more that can be made available , if needed . Both the Riders of Mistledale and the militia were based in Ashabenford Due to the widely spread settlements of dale , each hamlet was equipped with special bells that could raise messages of alarm or inquiry with nearby settlements .

title: Mistledale Mount
description: Mistledale Mount Mistledale Mount was a large hill southwest of the village of Shadowdale . The mountain received its name from the local legend that on a clear day you could see the smoke from fires in distant Mistledale . Features .
description_long: Mistledale Mount Mistledale Mount was a large hill southwest of the village of Shadowdale . The mountain received its name from the local legend that on a clear day you could see the smoke from fires in distant Mistledale . Features . Sporadic clearings of trees for lumber had taken place on Mistledale Mount . A burned area at the base of Mistledale Mount marked the spot where Syluné Silverhand died in 1356 DR .

title: Mistmaster
description: Mistmaster The Mistmaster was a very powerful illusionist and cleric of Leira living in the Citadel of the Mists in the High Forest and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . History . Almost nothing was known about the Mistmaster and his dealings with Khelben Arunsun ; some speculated that it was under Khelben ' s orders that the Mistmaster destroyed Hellgate Keep with the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " .
description_long: Mistmaster The Mistmaster was a very powerful illusionist and cleric of Leira living in the Citadel of the Mists in the High Forest and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . History . Almost nothing was known about the Mistmaster and his dealings with Khelben Arunsun ; some speculated that it was under Khelben ' s orders that the Mistmaster destroyed Hellgate Keep with the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " . What was sure was that the Mistmaster oversaw the treant Turlang and reported to Khelben all news about activities in the High Forest and its surroundings . In 1374 DR , he was among the many powerful mages whom Arunsun brought together in order to restore the High Mages of the lost city of Miyeritaar and cleanse part of the High Moor .

title: Mistmyr Iroan
description: Mistmyr Iroan Mistmyr Iroan was a sorcerer and tavern keeper in Waterdeep in 1374 DR . Personality . Mistmyr talked very loudly , especially when he was very excited or nervous .
description_long: Mistmyr Iroan Mistmyr Iroan was a sorcerer and tavern keeper in Waterdeep in 1374 DR . Personality . Mistmyr talked very loudly , especially when he was very excited or nervous . History . Mistmyr worked as a wizard - for - hire for a decade , raising himself from bitter poverty , until a dead friend left him a tavern . He proved to be a good tavern owner and at the same time met and befriended Lord Hulraven Irlingstar . In 1374 DR , Lord Hulraven asked Mistmyr to use his magic help to find the kidnappers of his wife .

title: Mistshaws
description: Mistshaws Mistshaws was one of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Located near Hargleth Forest , Mistshaws was renowned for its talented singers , minstrels , and instrument - makers .
description_long: Mistshaws Mistshaws was one of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Located near Hargleth Forest , Mistshaws was renowned for its talented singers , minstrels , and instrument - makers . Hunting for sport and food in the forest was particularly good near Mistshaws , and its local hunters often hired adventurers to deal with monster problems or outlaws . History . As of 1479 DR , Mistshaws had become a center of vandalism and banditry , and the locals often blamed the wealthy families of hiring outsider bandits and ruffians , although there were no solid proof to back those claims .

title: Mistshore
description: Mistshore Mistshore was the name given to the dilapidated north shore of Waterdeep ' s harbor . After the Spellplague , Waterdeep went into a decline and maintenance of the harbor was neglected . Many ships sank or were scuttled in the northern harbor and eventually Waterdeep ' s outcasts created a small community on the wrecked ship hulls .
description_long: Mistshore Mistshore was the name given to the dilapidated north shore of Waterdeep ' s harbor . After the Spellplague , Waterdeep went into a decline and maintenance of the harbor was neglected . Many ships sank or were scuttled in the northern harbor and eventually Waterdeep ' s outcasts created a small community on the wrecked ship hulls . The harbor water was polluted and smelled horribly . Mistshore was considered so dangerous that the City Watch refused to send patrols into the area .

title: Misty Forest
description: Misty Forest The Misty Forest was located just west of the High Moor , just south of the river Delimbiyr . Flora . The Misty Forest was full of pine trees and other types of evergreen trees .
description_long: Misty Forest The Misty Forest was located just west of the High Moor , just south of the river Delimbiyr . Flora . The Misty Forest was full of pine trees and other types of evergreen trees . Inhabitants . Ranger s were known to patrol the area , and several druid s had groves in the forest . A small community of wild elves dwelt somewhere within the forest . Wood elves were also known to live in the forest , as were hybsil s . Deer lived in the Misty Forest . Barbarian s from the High Moor used the Misty forest as a source of food and wood , and the orc s of the High Moor used it as a place to hide and strike travelers and caravans on the Trade Way .

title: Misty Vale
description: Misty Vale The Misty Vale was a valley and temple to Eldath located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . It laid a league ( 5 . 5 kilometers ) northeast of Dura ' s Vale .
description_long: Misty Vale The Misty Vale was a valley and temple to Eldath located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . It laid a league ( 5 . 5 kilometers ) northeast of Dura ' s Vale . History . The Green Lady , a druid of Eldath , settled in the Misty Vale around 1349 DR . She went into semi - retirement and lived there in seclusion . On 28th Eleasis of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Dura Gerathu , a ranger friend of the Lady , visited the vale to tell her how he ' d discovered the Vipers ' Nest , before he left to watch it further . However , the Vipers bandits slew Dura and came to the vale to kill the Lady for what she knew about their hideout . Forewarned and aided by the sprites she lived with , she conjured obscuring mists and " hallucinatory forest s " to confuse and drive the terrified bandits off . Calispar Delgorth , the leader of the assault , vowed to return and finish her later . Afterwards , the Lady sent two sprites to check on Dura , who reported his death . At the sad news , she fell into deep mourning , not eating , sleeping , or speaking . She waited the return of the Vipers to kill her too . Inhabitants .

title: Mita
description: Mita Mita was the raccoon familiar of No Ziar , a notorious wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Mita could swell to twice its natural size in a fight . It enjoyed eating fresh fish , namely the people that No Ziar transformed into fish .
description_long: Mita Mita was the raccoon familiar of No Ziar , a notorious wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Mita could swell to twice its natural size in a fight . It enjoyed eating fresh fish , namely the people that No Ziar transformed into fish .

title: Mitbiq
description: Mitbiq The mitbiq ( miht - BEEQ ) was an interesting Zakharan wind instrument that appeared to be two instruments in one . Description . " Mitbiqs " were double clarinets made from reed tubes .
description_long: Mitbiq The mitbiq ( miht - BEEQ ) was an interesting Zakharan wind instrument that appeared to be two instruments in one . Description . " Mitbiqs " were double clarinets made from reed tubes . Each of the clarinet tubes was complimented by a smaller tube that vibrated to create sound . History . A " mitbiq " required a great deal of practice to master because it involved inhaling on one clarinet and then exhaling on the other , allowing for continuous tone production .

title: Mithann
description: Mithann Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . History . Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator and an adventurer from Cormyr .
description_long: Mithann Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . History . Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator and an adventurer from Cormyr . When she became too old to fight evil , Mithann retired to Icewind Dale . However , she did all she could for good - hearted people of Icewind Dale . In 1484 DR , facing multiple threats to the dale , Mithann recruited adventurers to perform some missions for her .

title: Mithbarakaz
description: Mithbarakaz Mithbarakaz , usually known as Mith Barak , was the king of Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR and 1479 DR . History . Mithbarakaz was a silver dragon who disguised itself as a dwarf with silvery blue skin and a silver beard called " Mith Barak the Clanless " in 66 DR .
description_long: Mithbarakaz Mithbarakaz , usually known as Mith Barak , was the king of Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR and 1479 DR . History . Mithbarakaz was a silver dragon who disguised itself as a dwarf with silvery blue skin and a silver beard called " Mith Barak the Clanless " in 66 DR . He was proclaimed heir by the last dying Deep King of Iltkazar just hours before his death . It was said that on the Coronation Day , the god Dumathoin himself appeared to crown the new king , eliminating all questions of successorship . From that year , Mith ruled the dwarven kingdom with justice and wisdom . His only peculiarity was that for seventy - five years out of every hundred the Mithral Shield sat upon his throne as a solid statue and all attempts to contact him failed . But as regularly as a Neverwintan water clock , he awakened after exactly seventy - five years and ruled for the successive twenty - five years before he went asleep again . These periods were called the Great Sleeps and during those times the kingdom was ruled by the Regency Council of Iltkazar , formed after the first Great Sleep of the year 92 DR .

title: Mithertul
description: Mithertul The Mithertul family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mithertuls were allied with the Baraedin , Onsil , and Naskurl families .
description_long: Mithertul The Mithertul family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mithertuls were allied with the Baraedin , Onsil , and Naskurl families .

title: Mithral
description: Mithral Mithral , also known as mithril , was a precious metal produced from ore found in mountain ranges in certain areas of Faerûn and in the Underdark . Description . Mithral was produced through a process similar to that of steel - smelting .
description_long: Mithral Mithral , also known as mithril , was a precious metal produced from ore found in mountain ranges in certain areas of Faerûn and in the Underdark . Description . Mithral was produced through a process similar to that of steel - smelting . Items cast from mithral weighed only half as much as similar items forged from steel . Since pieces of armor made from this valuable metal were very light , they allowed the wearer to make better use of their natural agility and were less restrictive on spellcasting . Rumors and legends . Among some bard ic circles it was said that mithral combined with steel could create adamantine , but according to dwarves , this was laughable .

title: Mithral Hall
description: Mithral Hall Mithral Hall ( sometimes spelled " Mithril Hall " ) was a dwarven stronghold beneath Fourthpeak Mountain in the Frost Hills , part of the Spine of the World . It was one of the best known dwarven strongholds in Faerûn . Originally a mithral mine belonging to Clan Battlehammer , this underground town became a safe haven for various dwarf families and even some persons of other races .
description_long: Mithral Hall Mithral Hall ( sometimes spelled " Mithril Hall " ) was a dwarven stronghold beneath Fourthpeak Mountain in the Frost Hills , part of the Spine of the World . It was one of the best known dwarven strongholds in Faerûn . Originally a mithral mine belonging to Clan Battlehammer , this underground town became a safe haven for various dwarf families and even some persons of other races . Mithral Hall had a long history of tragedy and triumph , and was the making and breaking of countless individuals . Geography . Set amongst the longest mountain range in Faerûn , Mithral Hall was one of the northernmost settlements on the continent . Settlestone . An ancient village south of Mithral Hall , Settlestone was one of the few dwarven settlements built entirely above ground . Originally known as " Dwarvendarrow " , the settlement was built with huge slabs of rock laid against one another . These sturdy structures withstood the elements for years and even survived several centuries after the village was abandoned .

title: Mithral bells
description: Mithral bells Mithral bells were a small chain of eleven mithral bells , each of which could be thrown as a grenade weapon to detonate with a " sound burst " effect . The bell would explode after 40 feet if it did not strike something first . While worn as a bracelet , the wearer would find greater success at attempted artistic performances , provided at least three bells remained on the mithral chain .
description_long: Mithral bells Mithral bells were a small chain of eleven mithral bells , each of which could be thrown as a grenade weapon to detonate with a " sound burst " effect . The bell would explode after 40 feet if it did not strike something first . While worn as a bracelet , the wearer would find greater success at attempted artistic performances , provided at least three bells remained on the mithral chain . Mithral bells could only be crafted by bard s .

title: Mithril Legion
description: Mithril Legion The Mithril Legion , or Mithral Legion , was a dwarven army that quested to recover the lost Mines of Tethyamar in the 1360s DR . History . Borlin inspired a large number of dwarven warriors to form the Mithril Legion and embark on a quest to reclaim the Mines of Tethyamar .
description_long: Mithril Legion The Mithril Legion , or Mithral Legion , was a dwarven army that quested to recover the lost Mines of Tethyamar in the 1360s DR . History . Borlin inspired a large number of dwarven warriors to form the Mithril Legion and embark on a quest to reclaim the Mines of Tethyamar . They marched out of Tilverton in the Year of the Wave , 1364 DR , heading north - west , and vanished , their fate unknown . Some claimed that Borlin and the Mithril Legion had successfully retaken part of the Mines , and sent a report of such to King Ghellin via magic , but this was only speculation . In fact , Borlin and the Legion made a successful assault against one of gates into Tethyamar , but ran into an orc - fashioned " portal " . This transported them deep into the mines , far from the entrance . Steadily , they fought their way through the orcs and back to the surface , but fell one - by - one . Borlin was the last , but he died in sight of Tethyamar ' s doors . Leadership . The Mithril Legion was led by Borlin , blood of Ghellin , Axe of the Iron House , of the exiled royal court of the Mines of Tethyamar .

title: Mithril Mountain
description: Mithril Mountain The Mithril Mountain , or the Crescent , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . Three thousand light infantry archers made up the Mithril Mountain .
description_long: Mithril Mountain The Mithril Mountain , or the Crescent , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . Three thousand light infantry archers made up the Mithril Mountain . Activities . Recruited from the households of noble dao atamen and hetamen , the Mithril Mountain was not the most reliable combat unit . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Mival
description: Mival Mavil was a hermit monk in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Personality . Mavil was a very typical hermit , disliking others and having trouble interacting with them .
description_long: Mival Mavil was a hermit monk in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Personality . Mavil was a very typical hermit , disliking others and having trouble interacting with them . He showed himself to be a bit insane , constantly muttering , openly discussing things with himself , and commenting on others . Mavil was also nervous and jumped if people invaded his personal space . However , he was also a caring man . History . Mavil was a monk who , after training himself to endure the cold , decided to live as a hermit in the Glacier . He , however , had some friends in the nearby Monastery of the Yellow Rose , including Lana . In 1491 , Mavil saved Lana ' s life after she was injured by cultists who had infiltrated the monastery . He persuaded her to go to Mulmaster to seek help . Some time later , an adventuring party hired to solve the matter asked for his help to enter the monastery without being noticed by cultists . He agreed only if the adventurers could pass a test .

title: Miverra
description: Miverra Miverra was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . History . Miverra was a priestess of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .
description_long: Miverra Miverra was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . History . Miverra was a priestess of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . In 1377 DR , she was sent to ask for an audience with the Conclave of Sshamath , rulers of the city of Sshamath . However Q ' arlynd Melarn , a fellow devotee of Eilistraee , recommended to Miverra to trust only Seldszar Elpragh , the Master of the College of Divination and his patron , when discussing about a strange magical phenomena that had affected both wizards and priests . So Miverra and Seldszar spoke about the magic phenomena that involved disturbance in the faerzress spreading from the main temple of Kiaransalee . At last they decided that a joint - force of Eilistraee ' s priests and wizards of the Divination ' s College would scout the temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Mixi
description: Mixi Mixi ( pronounced " MIX - ee " ) was a half - elf waitress in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Mixi was usually very gentle and professional .
description_long: Mixi Mixi ( pronounced " MIX - ee " ) was a half - elf waitress in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Mixi was usually very gentle and professional . She cared deeply for her friends . History . Mixi was a pirate on the Moonsea until a storm destroyed her ship . She decided to change her life and went to Mulmaster , where she began working as a maid . At the bar called the Black Blade and Bloody Boar , she befriended Ilva , a refugee from Phlan . Mixi became very worried about Ilva ' s strange behavior . Activities . In 1491 DR , Mixi worked at the bar called the Black Blade and Bloody Boar in a lower part of the city .

title: Mixtal
description: Mixtal Mixtal was the high priest of Zaltec in Payit . History . In 1361 DR , Mixtal and the Jaguar Knight Gultec were tasked by Nexal high priest Hoxitl with the mission to capture and to kill Erixitl from the local temple of Qotal , despite Mixtal ' s fear of reprisal .
description_long: Mixtal Mixtal was the high priest of Zaltec in Payit . History . In 1361 DR , Mixtal and the Jaguar Knight Gultec were tasked by Nexal high priest Hoxitl with the mission to capture and to kill Erixitl from the local temple of Qotal , despite Mixtal ' s fear of reprisal . They managed to kidnap the girl without anyone ' s notice , but when Mixtal was ready to deliver the mortal blow , they all saw the arrival of the Golden Legion ' s ships . Erixitl profited from their distraction and escaped , injuring Mixtal ' s eyes in the process . He hunted for Erixitl in the jungle behind the pyramid , gaining also the help of a column of warriors , but because of his poor eyesight and a hidden spell by Chitikas , Mixtal captured and sacrificed not Erixitl but Martine , the daughter of Domincus , the cleric of the Golden Legion . Soon , however , the pyramid was attacked by a squad of legionaries led by Daggrande and guided by Erixitl , causing Mixtal to go into confusion about how the girl was live again and why the strangers were attacking him . At this point , one of the Ancient Ones , Spirali , appeared and killed Mixtal for failing at his task .

title: Miyagi - ko
description: Miyagi - ko Miyagi - ko was the concubine of Funada Toyoo in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Miyagi - ko was the mother of Toyoo ’ s favorite son , having so a great amount of power inside Toyoo ' s household , more than Toyoo ’ s First Wife .
description_long: Miyagi - ko Miyagi - ko was the concubine of Funada Toyoo in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Miyagi - ko was the mother of Toyoo ’ s favorite son , having so a great amount of power inside Toyoo ' s household , more than Toyoo ’ s First Wife . She was carefully to destroy any possible rivals History . Miyagi - ko became Toyoo ' s concubine in 1340 DR when she was only seventeen . In 1357 her son became focus of the rivalry between Toyoo and his brother the daimyo Funada Mitsuhide Personality . Miyagi - ko was graceful and charming . Her greatest fear was that her son will lose Toyoo ’ s favor . She constantly watching to avoid this

title: Miyama Province
description: Miyama Province The Miyama Province was one of the most wealthy and populated provinces in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Miyama was at the exact center of the isle of Shinkoku . It was composed of two very fertile plains divided by woods and the mountains of Kurisammyaku .
description_long: Miyama Province The Miyama Province was one of the most wealthy and populated provinces in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Miyama was at the exact center of the isle of Shinkoku . It was composed of two very fertile plains divided by woods and the mountains of Kurisammyaku . It also had two lakes , Nora - ko and Uji - ko , and three large cities : the capital Tamanokuni , the former capital Kuda , and the northern city of Okahira .

title: Miyeritar
description: Miyeritar Miyeritar was an ancient dark elven empire in the north western parts of Faerûn . History . The realm of Miyeritar was founded by green and dark elves around - 18000 DR in the area later known as the High Moor and Misty Forest .
description_long: Miyeritar Miyeritar was an ancient dark elven empire in the north western parts of Faerûn . History . The realm of Miyeritar was founded by green and dark elves around - 18000 DR in the area later known as the High Moor and Misty Forest . The gold elven realm Aryvandaar became their greatest threat . In - 14700 DR the rulers of this realm began attempting to diplomatically and peacefully annex Miyeritar into their realm . Despite these troubles with their powerful neighbors , in - 13900 DR the realm of Miyeritar developed into the center of elven Art and High Magic in Faerûn . But Aryvandaar did not let up and in - 13200 DR skirmishing and trade interference started between both realms . It was only a question of time until a real war broke out between them . That happened in - 12000 DR when the rulers of Aryvandaar lost their patience and attacked . This was the beginning of the first Crown War . In - 11800 DR the Aryvandaaran seemed to have won and militarily occupied and annexed the realm Miyeritar . But a number of Miyeritari clans and strongholds resisted and continued to fight .

title: Miyoshi
description: Miyoshi Miyoshi was a spirit folk kensai in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Miyoshi was the current pupil of the great swordsman Junyu .
description_long: Miyoshi Miyoshi was a spirit folk kensai in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Miyoshi was the current pupil of the great swordsman Junyu . Personality . Miyoshi was a good fighter but had a wild temperament . He never truly mastered the techniques taught by Junyu , but was so talented that the master was very reluctant to send him away . He never spoke about his past .

title: Miz ' ri Mizzrym
description: Miz ' ri Mizzrym Miz ' ri Mizzrym was the matron mother of House Mizzrym in 1372 DR . Description . She was considered comely but perpetually wore an ugly scowl .
description_long: Miz ' ri Mizzrym Miz ' ri Mizzrym was the matron mother of House Mizzrym in 1372 DR . Description . She was considered comely but perpetually wore an ugly scowl . History . Miz ' ri was matron mother of her house in 1361 DR and 1372 DR . At time of Rage of Demons she dominated the city ' s slave trade Relationships . She had two twin daughters : Greyanna and Sabal . She favored Greyanna , the eldest , until Greyanna ' s death in 1372 DR at the hands of her brother Pharaun .

title: Mizferac
description: Mizferac Mizferac is a glabrezu who was summoned by Cadderly to determine the whereabouts of Jarlaxle . Appearance and Personality . Mizferac was described as stupid by the imp who provided his name to Cadderly .
description_long: Mizferac Mizferac is a glabrezu who was summoned by Cadderly to determine the whereabouts of Jarlaxle . Appearance and Personality . Mizferac was described as stupid by the imp who provided his name to Cadderly . History . Mizferac was summoned on a regular basis by Cadderly for a tenday until he brought news of Jarlaxle , Artemis Entreri and Crenshinibon coming to see the priest . Immediately after , he was banished for a hundred years by Cadderly after threatening Cadderly ' s family . He was later summoned again by Cadderly , rescinding the banishment .

title: Mlarraun
description: Mlarraun The mlarraun , also known as a " spitting snake " or a " stone snake " , was a snake - like magical creature , classified as both a Scaled One and a , native to Faerûn south of the Inner Sea . They were notorious for spitting poison and assuming a pliable stone - like torpor . Physical description .
description_long: Mlarraun The mlarraun , also known as a " spitting snake " or a " stone snake " , was a snake - like magical creature , classified as both a Scaled One and a , native to Faerûn south of the Inner Sea . They were notorious for spitting poison and assuming a pliable stone - like torpor . Physical description . A mlarraun was a snake with dark brown to black scales and a head shaped like a thin arrowhead . Behavior . They passed the day sleeping , sunbathing , or hunting . When hunting , they would stalk their prey and could kill up to several herd animals or other big creatures at once , saving them for later consumption . A mlarraun could eat fresh meat , rotting carrion , and food contaminated by its own poison . Mlarrauns were not intelligent , lacked cunning , and were incapable of expecting danger . Quite a number were inadvertently trampled by hooved beasts . They could climb and swim as well as crawl . Combat . Mlarrauns could bite or spit a poison that caused blindness for a number of hours . This did not need to contact the eyes to be effective . They had the strange ability to fall into deep torpor state when specifically targeted by a magical effect .

title: Mlorgathyn
description: Mlorgathyn Mlorgathyn of Selgaunt was a merchant around 1479 DR . History . Mlorgathyn was a dealer in fine wines , scents , and sauces based in Selgaunt .
description_long: Mlorgathyn Mlorgathyn of Selgaunt was a merchant around 1479 DR . History . Mlorgathyn was a dealer in fine wines , scents , and sauces based in Selgaunt . However his business was an obstacle to both Lord Sardasper Halaunt and Manshoon , so they collaborated on swindling Mlorgathyn and all his family .

title: Mo ' ki
description: Mo ' ki Mo ' ki , also written as mo ' Ki , was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .
description_long: Mo ' ki Mo ' ki , also written as mo ' Ki , was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo . It stood north of Mo ' ki Bay . History . Mo ' ki was once afflicted by the ivory plague until the shukenja Pitalla used the " leaping fish " to cure it . Around 1357 DR , Mo ' ki Bay was dominated by the pirate Crow Dz Pong , who terrorized coastal settlements like Mo ' ki .

title: Mo ' ki Bay
description: Mo ' ki Bay Mo ' ki Bay or mo ' Ki Bay was a bay in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki Bay lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .
description_long: Mo ' ki Bay Mo ' ki Bay or mo ' Ki Bay was a bay in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki Bay lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo . The settlement of Mo ' ki lay on the north side . History . Around 1357 DR , Mo ' ki Bay was dominated by the pirate Crow Dz Pong , who was known as " the wu jen of mo ' Ki Bay " . He terrorized sailors and coastal settlements from Pyong Do to the Ziyero Ridge , such as Mo ' ki . He was theorized to have a hidden fortress somewhere south of Mo ' ki Bay , concealed with magic and full of his loot .

title: Mo Kin
description: Mo Kin Mo Kin was the abbot of Pokarr in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Mo Kin ruled over the Pokarr monastery and was a member of the Lon Chen , the chief ministers who advised the High Lama .
description_long: Mo Kin Mo Kin was the abbot of Pokarr in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Mo Kin ruled over the Pokarr monastery and was a member of the Lon Chen , the chief ministers who advised the High Lama . Mo Kin , leading a large militia , was also responsible for patrolling the eastern border north of Mount E ' kwong . Often , despite his old age , he traveled to other northern monasteries to enjoy their festival celebrations . Personality . Mo Kin was a devout follower of the High Lama . He was a quiet and thoughtful man , known for his slow decisions , extreme patience , and sound advice . He was a good and fair administrator

title: Moander
description: Moander Moander ( pronounced " moe - AN - der " ) was an ancient deity of rot , corruption , and decay . The " Darkbringer " never had a large following , but various cults had venerated Moander since before the rise of Netheril . Moander was alternately referred to as he , she , or it in the ancient texts and the deity ' s gender remains unknown to this day .
description_long: Moander Moander ( pronounced " moe - AN - der " ) was an ancient deity of rot , corruption , and decay . The " Darkbringer " never had a large following , but various cults had venerated Moander since before the rise of Netheril . Moander was alternately referred to as he , she , or it in the ancient texts and the deity ' s gender remains unknown to this day . The Darkbringer was generally a cruel , controlling tyrant , delighting in the torment and destruction of lesser beings and seeking to corrupt any who refused to bow down to it . Worshipers . Many lonely folk , adrift in the world at large , were drawn to the Darkbringer for the firm direction It gave their life . Servants of Moander were required to endure a ceremony to join the cult that involved the absorption of a ' seed of Moander . ' If worthy , the seed gradually grew in the in the initiate ' s body until the entire internal structure was replaced with rotting plant matter . A small flowered tendril protruding from the ear and wound through the hair was the only visible indication of the change . At this stage , whenever it wished , Moander could assume complete direct mental and physical control of the recipient .

title: Mocking Maiden
description: Mocking Maiden The Mocking Maiden was an inn and tavern in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . It was a merry and busy place , but of excellent quality for only moderate prices . The staff focused on good food and on keeping adventuring patrons happy .
description_long: Mocking Maiden The Mocking Maiden was an inn and tavern in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . It was a merry and busy place , but of excellent quality for only moderate prices . The staff focused on good food and on keeping adventuring patrons happy .

title: Mod ' Vensis Tlabbar
description: Mod ' Vensis Tlabbar Mod ' vensis Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Mod ' Vensis was a Faen Tlabbar priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .
description_long: Mod ' Vensis Tlabbar Mod ' vensis Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Mod ' Vensis was a Faen Tlabbar priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith . She taught the young Shakti Hunzrin .

title: Modron
description: Modron Modrons were a race of immortal s known for their zealous adherence to the principles of law and order above all else . Just as fiend s were considered the embodiment of evil and celestial s the embodiment of good , so were modrons the embodiment of the universal principle of order . Ecology .
description_long: Modron Modrons were a race of immortal s known for their zealous adherence to the principles of law and order above all else . Just as fiend s were considered the embodiment of evil and celestial s the embodiment of good , so were modrons the embodiment of the universal principle of order . Ecology . There were fourteen types of modrons : monodrone s , duodrone s , tridrone s , quadrone s , pentadrone s , decaton s , nonaton s , octon s , septon s , hexton s , quinton s , quarton s , tertian s , and secundi . Each type had a corresponding shape ; the higher ranking the modron , the more complex . For example , monodrone bodies were spherical , whilst quadrones were cubical . The modrons served Primus , godlike ruler of Mechanus . All modrons were immune to mind - affecting , emotion - affecting , and magic that drew upon the Positive Energy or the Negative Energy plane . They were resistant to cold , fire , and acid . Culture . Modron culture was simple . Each modron obeyed all commands given to it by any modron one rank higher . These commands were obeyed without question .

title: Mogion
description: Mogion Mogion was the leader of the Survivors of Moander cult in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . The daughter of a Sembia n noble , Mogion joined the cult of Moander and rose to the position of high priestess .
description_long: Mogion Mogion was the leader of the Survivors of Moander cult in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . The daughter of a Sembia n noble , Mogion joined the cult of Moander and rose to the position of high priestess . In 1357 DR , Mogion , for the first time , received a call from her god summoning her to Yûlash . Soon Mogion settled in the ruined city and despite her god ' s avatar having been destroyed by Alias ' s party , Mogion grew in power and clerical abilities until she was named the next Mouth of Moander . Soon she contacted Radatha of the Fire Knives in order to start the New Alliance . When the adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds arrived in Yùlash , Mogion started preparations for a ritual to awaken Moander . However , something went wrong during the ritual and Moander fused himself with Mogion , creating a mindless monster of destruction but the adventurers destroyed her before it was too late .

title: Mohrg
description: Mohrg Mohrgs were undead that were the risen forms of mass - murderers that died before they could atone for their crimes . Mohrgs existed to bring more death and destruction to the world , delighting in the screams of the dying . Description .
description_long: Mohrg Mohrgs were undead that were the risen forms of mass - murderers that died before they could atone for their crimes . Mohrgs existed to bring more death and destruction to the world , delighting in the screams of the dying . Description . Mohrgs were sometimes mistaken for skeleton s or zombie s . They appeared to be skeletal humanoids with fleshy internal organs wrapped around their form . These organs were animated and capable of lashing out and entangling any they touched . Furthermore , they secreted a paralytic slime that allowed the mohrg to slowly kill its victims while they watched helplessly . Combat . Those slain by a mohrg arose soon afterward as a zombie . A rise in the undead population was often a sign of a mohrg in the area .

title: Moirah
description: Moirah Moirah was a worker at the Jewel tavern in Ormpetarr . Appearance . Moirah was a slight woman with a small build and dark , raven - colored hair .
description_long: Moirah Moirah was a worker at the Jewel tavern in Ormpetarr . Appearance . Moirah was a slight woman with a small build and dark , raven - colored hair . She wore jasmine perfume and gauzy blue and purple silks to wrap her body , layering them enticingly to hide her desirable parts . She left her navel exposed , below which was her nearly translucent spellscar . Abilities . Moirah ' s spellscar gave her control over another person ' s wild passions .

title: Moire
description: Moire Moire was a female half - elf who was a high - ranking member of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Moire was a notorious gang leader in Neverwinter ' s Docks district , part of the Shadow Thieves chapter under Axle Devrie .
description_long: Moire Moire was a female half - elf who was a high - ranking member of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Moire was a notorious gang leader in Neverwinter ' s Docks district , part of the Shadow Thieves chapter under Axle Devrie . Unlike Axle , she was known to be vicious and ruthless and she sought to hold the streets of Neverwinter in her grip . History . She could have met the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . The Kalach - cha could have come into contact with Moire while trying to gain entrance to the Blacklake district . If the Kalach - Cha and companions sided with the Watch , then they ruined many of Moire ' s activities . During the rescue of the informant Fihelis , Moire herself showed up to kill the spy but was defeated . If the Kalach - Cha and companions sided with the thieves , then they needed to help advance Moire ' s activities , by working under her . Finally , the Kalach - Cha rose to work directly for Axle Devrie , the true leader of Neverwinter ' s Shadow Thieves and a more diplomatic individual than Moire .

title: Moktessa
description: Moktessa Moktessa was a wine that could only be found within the kingdom of Dambrath . Description . Made from rich white grapes , Moktessa was enjoyed by humans and drow .
description_long: Moktessa Moktessa was a wine that could only be found within the kingdom of Dambrath . Description . Made from rich white grapes , Moktessa was enjoyed by humans and drow . This fine wine was hard to come by even in Dambrath because of the high demand . It was virtually unknown outside of Dambrath .

title: Mold touch
description: Mold touch Mold touch was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath and cleric s of Mielikki and Silvanus . It gave the caster a handful of brown mold spores that could be transferred to a target by touch . Effects .
description_long: Mold touch Mold touch was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath and cleric s of Mielikki and Silvanus . It gave the caster a handful of brown mold spores that could be transferred to a target by touch . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell that differed slightly in some aspects . The older version , when cast , turned the material component of this spell into brown mold spores held safely in one of the caster ' s hands . If the caster successfully touched another creature with this hand within six minutes , the mold was transferred to that creature and the spellcaster was free of it . If no creature was touched within the time limit , the spores disappeared harmlessly . For the newer version , the mold could be placed anywhere the caster could touch , but the caster only had one chance to touch an unwilling target . For the older version of " mold touch " , the first creature touched , whether friend or foe , became infected with brown mold but could not transfer the infection to others . As the brown mold began to absorb the body heat of the victim , it did a large amount of freezing damage in the first minute .

title: Molnir
description: Molnir Molnir the Mighty was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . Molnir fell to his death from the bridge into the Clearflow River far below , but not before killing many enemies .
description_long: Molnir Molnir the Mighty was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . Molnir fell to his death from the bridge into the Clearflow River far below , but not before killing many enemies . Activities . Though rarely seen , Molnir haunted Dead Dwarf Bridge as a specter , appearing only at night as a drowned dwarf . He attacked any spellcaster attempting to cross the bridge , but left others alone .

title: Moloch
description: Moloch Moloch is a Lord of the Nine Hells and arch - devil of Hell ( Baator in later editions of the game ) , and once served as the viceroy of Baalzebul . Description . Moloch is a great , square - bodied creature with red - orange skin .
description_long: Moloch Moloch is a Lord of the Nine Hells and arch - devil of Hell ( Baator in later editions of the game ) , and once served as the viceroy of Baalzebul . Description . Moloch is a great , square - bodied creature with red - orange skin . His limbs are short and thick , and his hands and feet are huge and square , with horns on his feet . His head is also horned , and huge with slanting fiery eyes and a gaping mouth . His monstrous body conceals a genius - level intellect . History . Like many of the oldest lords of Hell , Moloch was once an angel created by the powers of Law to battle the demons of the Abyss in the Age Before Ages , before the Battle of Pesh and the subsequent realignment of the planes . Of all the warriors in the legions serving Asmodeus , it is said that Moloch was the greatest . He was eventually rewarded for his prowess and loyalty with rulership of the sixth plane of Hell , Malbolge , replacing Beherit , the previous ruler of that layer . In order to check his power , however , Asmodeus made Moloch the vassal of Baalzebul , serving as the Lord of the Flies ' viceroy on the layer he controlled .

title: Molten Throne
description: Molten Throne The Molten Throne was a magic throne used by Nar - Aidiya within Krak al - Mazhar — the secret fortress of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . The Throne sat upon a stone column in the Infernal Hall that measured 10 feet in diameter and usually sat 10 feet above the ground .
description_long: Molten Throne The Molten Throne was a magic throne used by Nar - Aidiya within Krak al - Mazhar — the secret fortress of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . The Throne sat upon a stone column in the Infernal Hall that measured 10 feet in diameter and usually sat 10 feet above the ground . The height of the column could be altered at any time by a mere thought from the Throne ' s occupant . The column could also rotate a full 360 degrees by using basalt studs found on the throne ' s arms . A blazing moat filled with ever - burning " walls of fire " surrounded the base of the column . The Throne itself was a translucent pillar of flame that appeared to be frozen in time . History . The " Molten Throne " was created by a tasked artist genie at the request of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan , to given as a gift to Nar - Aidiya . Powers . Whoever was seated upon the Throne was completely immune to all forms of fire . The occupant could cast " ESP " , " chastise " , and " flame of justice " at will . Once per day the Throne could be used as a " rod of rulership " , forcing the occupant ' s will upon their servants .

title: Molvayas Armgo
description: Molvayas Armgo Molvayas Armgo was a member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Molvayas was an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .
description_long: Molvayas Armgo Molvayas Armgo was a member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Molvayas was an instructor at Arach - Tinilith . During the Silence of Lolth her niece Drisinil Armgo started a coup against Matron Mistress Quenthel Baenre , who in her eyes had lost Lolth ' s favor . Drisinil profited off the opportunity to kill Molvayas , saying to fellow conspirators that she had surely betrayed them to Quenthel .

title: Molvayas Philiom
description: Molvayas Philiom Molvayas Philiom was a fanatic high priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . History . Malvayas was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir .
description_long: Molvayas Philiom Molvayas Philiom was a fanatic high priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . History . Malvayas was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir . In 1379 DR , he met Kâras in Llurth Dreir , but when he discovered that he had joined the Church of Eilistraee , Molvayas tried to kill him and only the arrival of Valdar Jaelre saved Kâras ' s life .

title: Molydeus
description: Molydeus When Tharizdun discovered the shard of utter evil and buried it in the elemental chaos , he charged seven angels with the protection of his treasure . The celestial beings were naturally , obedient , to the wishes of the god , but were unsure if they were doing what they should in listening to the scheming Deity . This left them frustrated and angry .
description_long: Molydeus When Tharizdun discovered the shard of utter evil and buried it in the elemental chaos , he charged seven angels with the protection of his treasure . The celestial beings were naturally , obedient , to the wishes of the god , but were unsure if they were doing what they should in listening to the scheming Deity . This left them frustrated and angry . Proximity to the shard caused their forms to violently wrench apart , turning them into the powerful two - headed demons known as the Molydeus . Physical appearance . A Molydeus is a Giant sized humanoid with a light shade of red - orange skin . It has pawlike , three - toed feet and clawed hands , and is extremely muscular . When remade by the evil of the shard , their skull changed to resemble that of a wolf ' s or jackal ' s , symbolizing their rage and fighting ability . From the back of their heads sprouted a serpent with a curiously spined head , symbolizing the angels mistrust of their master and uncertainties about their given task . Encounters . A Molydeus is typically found alone or with only a small entourage of lesser demons typically marilith s , which the ex - angels enjoy working with .

title: Moment of clarity
description: Moment of clarity Moment of clarity is an abjuration spell that lets a paladin help the subject clear or effects from his mind . Effect . When the paladin casts this spell and touch a creature that is under the influence of a mind - affecting spell or effect , that creature immediately attempts to break free of the effect .
description_long: Moment of clarity Moment of clarity is an abjuration spell that lets a paladin help the subject clear or effects from his mind . Effect . When the paladin casts this spell and touch a creature that is under the influence of a mind - affecting spell or effect , that creature immediately attempts to break free of the effect . If the spell or effect did not originally permit the subject to break free on its own , this spell has no effect .

title: Monastery of St . Fanal
description: Monastery of St . Fanal The Monastery of St . Fanal was a monastery , school , and library dedicated to Ilmater the Broken God .
description_long: Monastery of St . Fanal The Monastery of St . Fanal was a monastery , school , and library dedicated to Ilmater the Broken God . It lay in the hills west of the Alimir Mountains in Calimshan , on the Pevadaas Trail . History . Saint Fanal , although a priest of Ilmater dedicated to alleviating suffering , believed that knowledge of the past would limit suffering in the present , and that educating oppressed peoples would expand their opportunities and capabilities . Thus he devoted himself to learning , preserving , and teaching history , and founded the monastery that bore his name late in the first century before Dalereckoning . Around 1374 DR , the Monastery was headed by Brother Bedon . Bedon instated a policy that no one who came to the monastery seeking knowledge could be denied . Activities . Following the principles of St . Fanal , the Monastery operated as a center for academic learning , history , and art . There was a school for scribes and sages , training them to be objective in observation and investigation , so that they might be effective historians .

title: Monastery of the Yellow Rose
description: Monastery of the Yellow Rose The Monastery of the Yellow Rose , also known as the Citadel of the White Worm , was a monastery dedicated to St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred and Ilmater , the Broken God . It was situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in Damara , overlooking the Glacier of the White Worm .
description_long: Monastery of the Yellow Rose The Monastery of the Yellow Rose , also known as the Citadel of the White Worm , was a monastery dedicated to St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred and Ilmater , the Broken God . It was situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in Damara , overlooking the Glacier of the White Worm . It was the most well known of the facilities belonging to the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . Geography . The Monastery was a difficult place to reach , as the trails leading there were hard to find and follow . Furthermore , it was an arduous climb up a mountain pass to reach the entrance . It was a very solitary and remote place . Located high in the Earthspur Mountains , the monastery lay east of the Glacier of the White Worm . Overlooking the glacier , it was built into the rocky side of a jagged mountain peak , one of the tallest in the Earthspurs , and upon a high plateau . Structure . The Citadel of the White Worm was an immense and sprawling fortress . From the outside , it projected many turrets , balconies , and windows . The top of the highest structure was a crenulated tower . There were also extensive tunnels into the mountain below .

title: Monastic Servants of Auppenser
description: Monastic Servants of Auppenser Note . No lore was ever officially established on the monastic servants , but Ed Bonny , creator of the psionic deity Auppenser , and co - author of Lost Empires of Faerûn , posted a full write up of the unofficial prestige class here .

title: Mondar Bleth
description: Mondar Bleth Mondar Bleth was the owner of a small farmstead about a mile from Suzail , which he and his family had settled shortly after Ondeth Obarskyr settled in the area . He was killed along with most of his family by elves in 16 DR and his farmstead was razed . Mondar wielded a large heavy - hafted sword that would later become known as Ansrivarr .
description_long: Mondar Bleth Mondar Bleth was the owner of a small farmstead about a mile from Suzail , which he and his family had settled shortly after Ondeth Obarskyr settled in the area . He was killed along with most of his family by elves in 16 DR and his farmstead was razed . Mondar wielded a large heavy - hafted sword that would later become known as Ansrivarr . Appearance . Mondar was a very large man with an aggressive temper . He was balding by 16 DR but had a very long beard , almost to his belt . He had deep lines on his forehead . Relatives . Minda Obarskyr , originally Minda Bleth , was Mondar ' s sister , and Mondar had a son , Arphoind Bleth . Mondar ' s wife died while giving birth to their son . History . Mondar came to the land that would become known as Suzail in 10 DR , but did not want to settle in the confines of the main village , instead choosing a glade a mile to the northwest , although Ondeth disagreed with this decision . He and Ondeth eventually became good friends , but he did not like Baerauble Etharr . In 16 DR , during the night , the elves burned his farmstead to the ground and killed all of its occupants .

title: Mongrelfolk
description: Mongrelfolk Mongrelfolk , or mongrelmen , were the result of an experiment by an accomplished wizard . The wizard had wanted to find a good replacement for dopplegangers , one that could be controlled easily . His experiment succeeded , and the mongrelmen infiltrator s were born .
description_long: Mongrelfolk Mongrelfolk , or mongrelmen , were the result of an experiment by an accomplished wizard . The wizard had wanted to find a good replacement for dopplegangers , one that could be controlled easily . His experiment succeeded , and the mongrelmen infiltrator s were born . They were able to take the shape of any being they ate , only the wizard didn ' t think far enough ahead for his experiments . The mongrelmen infiltrators were unable to reproduce with their natural genes , and instead their children were born with pieces of creatures they had shifted to throughout their services . Their offspring were also unable to shift their form . The wizard ' s name has been lost to time . Mongrelmen did not have one defined shape . They were known to have pieces from many different species at the same time such as ; bugbears , bullywugs , dwarves , elves , gnolls , hobgoblins , humans , ogres , orcs as well as crabmen , goblins , lizardfolk , minotaurs , and even satyrs . Their culture revolved around secretively worshiping a deity they called " The Hidden God " . This was actually a twisted and warped image of their creator , the unnamed wizard .

title: Monica Langin
description: Monica Langin Monica Langin was a concubine in Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s Royal Harim in Huzuz . Description . Monica had fiery red hair and was so beautiful that she caught Khalil ' s eye and was asked to join the harem .
description_long: Monica Langin Monica Langin was a concubine in Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s Royal Harim in Huzuz . Description . Monica had fiery red hair and was so beautiful that she caught Khalil ' s eye and was asked to join the harem . Activities . After being invited to join the harem , Monica was unsure if life in the harem would be too much of a lifestlye change for the ranger inside of her . She finally accepted Khalil ' s offer , but was unable to fully adapt to that lifestyle . Khalil released her from her obligations six months after she joined the harem . She would stop by periodically and visit . History . Monica lived originally far away north from Huzuz .

title: Monk
description: Monk Monks were spiritual ascetics and practitioners of a mystical energy known as " ki " , the magical essence which flows through all living things . Monks utilized this energy to augment their own physical abilities , granting them extraordinary speed and strength . Monks could also use their own ki to alter the energy flow in other living creatures , for both defensive and offensive purposes .
description_long: Monk Monks were spiritual ascetics and practitioners of a mystical energy known as " ki " , the magical essence which flows through all living things . Monks utilized this energy to augment their own physical abilities , granting them extraordinary speed and strength . Monks could also use their own ki to alter the energy flow in other living creatures , for both defensive and offensive purposes . Monks ' ability to manipulate ki was often ( but not always ) mediated by their own psionic ability . Sabuti Shanardanda was a notable monk from Amn during the Era of Upheaval . Danica Maupoissant was another notable monk studying at Spirit Soaring ( Edificant Library ) . Grandmaster Kane was an incredibly powerful monk of the order of Ilmater , one of the companions of Gareth Dragonsbane who assisted him in defeating the evil witchking Zhengyi . Culture . Monastic traditions appear to have originally arisen in Amn and Calimshan simultaneously , though traditions from Kara - Tur and other material planes immigrated to Faerûn and may have originated earlier .

title: Monk of the long death
description: Monk of the long death Monks of the long death belong to the Order of the Long Death monastic order . These monks study the nature of death , and are particularly interested by the moment of passing . They don ' t bother about the afterlife or nature of the soul .
description_long: Monk of the long death Monks of the long death belong to the Order of the Long Death monastic order . These monks study the nature of death , and are particularly interested by the moment of passing . They don ' t bother about the afterlife or nature of the soul . The ceremony of introduction is filled with hideous acts meant to test the resolve of initiates . As they become more powerful , they gain limited abilities related to death and study alchemy , poisons , and resistance to death effects . Though the organization known as the Monks of the Long Death is strongest in Thay , it does have monasteries in several other parts of Faerûn , including the Silver Marches . Some two dozen members of the order dwell in a hidden stronghold built long ago by unknown hands in the Turnstone Hills , not far from where the pass is blocked by a gigantic landslide . From here the monks pursue their one abiding interest : death . These monks seek for the secrets of life by studying death . It is the condition of being dead that concerns them most , and not what lies beyond : The afterlife holds little interest for them .

title: Monkberry
description: Monkberry Monkberry was the Rengarth mother of Sunbright Steelshanks . Description . The Rengarth woman used her hair to make bowstrings .
description_long: Monkberry Monkberry was the Rengarth mother of Sunbright Steelshanks . Description . The Rengarth woman used her hair to make bowstrings . Personality . The strong - willed human female was an outcast in the Raven Tribe because she only bore one child . History . During the Shadowed Age , Monkberry raised Sunbright after the death of her husband , Sevenhaunt , and granted him his father ' s greatsword , Harvester of Blood . When the shaman Owldark prophesied that Steelshanks would betray his people , Monkberry aided her son in fleeing from the tribe .

title: Monkey
description: Monkey Monkeys were tree - dwelling primates . Unlike other primates , some monkeys had tails . They were mostly found in warm forests and jungles but a few species could also live in tundras .
description_long: Monkey Monkeys were tree - dwelling primates . Unlike other primates , some monkeys had tails . They were mostly found in warm forests and jungles but a few species could also live in tundras . While some monkeys were vicious in groups , most would attempt to flee from a fight , climbing a tree to escape any predators .

title: Monkey ( Hu Sen )
description: Monkey ( Hu Sen ) Monkey , also known as Mad Monkey and Hu Sen , was a unique being from the Outer Planes who was banished to Toril . Description . Though capable of shapechanging , Monkey ’ s natural form was that of a man with the face of a monkey .
description_long: Monkey ( Hu Sen ) Monkey , also known as Mad Monkey and Hu Sen , was a unique being from the Outer Planes who was banished to Toril . Description . Though capable of shapechanging , Monkey ’ s natural form was that of a man with the face of a monkey . He wore silk robes that were finer than anything found in Shou Lung . Though he enjoyed playing tricks , Monkey was always polite and well - mannered . Skills and Powers . Monkey possessed an incredible amount of power and always humiliated those who thought to best him in combat . Magical weapons were needed to harm him and he could regenerate at a rate that would make a troll green with envy . Impressive as he was in martial combat , Monkey ’ s most amazing power was that he could cast any spell with the exception of a ‘ ’ wish ’ ’ . Activities . Banished to a small island in the Hordelands , Monkey spent his time helping travelers if they gave him useful information . He was capable of answering virtually any question regarding anything about Toril . History . Monkey served as an official for the Celestial Bureaucracy until he was banished by the Celestial Emperor because of his fondness for mischief .

title: Monksblade
description: Monksblade Monksblade was a village in Cormyr known for its fine food and accommodation , making it a popular stop for people traveling to Sembia . Location . Monksblade was located along the Way of the Manticore between Dreamer ' s Rock and Battlerise .
description_long: Monksblade Monksblade was a village in Cormyr known for its fine food and accommodation , making it a popular stop for people traveling to Sembia . Location . Monksblade was located along the Way of the Manticore between Dreamer ' s Rock and Battlerise . History . Monksblade got its name from the fact that it was built on the foundations of four ruined monasteries : Mother Chauntea ' s House , the Towers of War , the Lady ' s House , and the House of the Seas , which all coexisted with each other at one point . Unfortunately , thieving mage s , bandits , lizardmen raiders from the Vast Swamp , and Sembian infiltrators depopulated the buildings until they stood empty and eventually fell to ruin . Eventually , at the urging of the king , who needed an eastern watchpost but lacked the resources to create a fort , homesteaders resettled the site , creating the village . Coastal settlements drew business away over time but the village remained attractive owing to its picturesque location , with the boughs of huge trees shading overgrown gardens .

title: Monocle of Bagthalos
description: Monocle of Bagthalos The monocle of Bagthalos was a holy artifact of Helm . Worn over one eye , it gave its user magically enhanced eyesight . The " monocle " was crafted by Bagthalos Deszhummer , Archpriest of Helm , in the 1100s DR , and was imbued with his spirit , which could also curse any who wore the " monocle " .
description_long: Monocle of Bagthalos The monocle of Bagthalos was a holy artifact of Helm . Worn over one eye , it gave its user magically enhanced eyesight . The " monocle " was crafted by Bagthalos Deszhummer , Archpriest of Helm , in the 1100s DR , and was imbued with his spirit , which could also curse any who wore the " monocle " . Description . The " monocle " consisted of a clear , circular lens of crystal surrounded by an adamantine frame that was studded with six loops . Fastened in these loops were six colorful ribbons , allowing the wearer to securely hold the " monocle " over their eye , even in the face of physical turmoil . Powers . The " monocle " gave its user constant " true seeing " , and caused immunity to gaze attacks and any form of hypnotism , whether magic al or psionic in nature . Three times per day , the monocle - wearer could cast " searing light " . Furthermore , the " monocle " allowed its wearer to " analyze dweomer " at will . Bagthalos ' s spirit , trapped within the relic , whispered regrets , guilt , and sorrow into the wearer ' s mind . A careless user could find themselves magically compelled by the " monocle " to rectify a past wrong .

title: Monrativi Teshy Mir
description: Monrativi Teshy Mir Monrativi Teshy Mir was Alzhedo for the " First Kingdom of Mir " . It was the term used by the Calishites to refer to a piece of land in Monteshi that was contested between Calimshan and the kingdom of Tethyr . Shoonach , the capital of the Shoon Imperium was located there .
description_long: Monrativi Teshy Mir Monrativi Teshy Mir was Alzhedo for the " First Kingdom of Mir " . It was the term used by the Calishites to refer to a piece of land in Monteshi that was contested between Calimshan and the kingdom of Tethyr . Shoonach , the capital of the Shoon Imperium was located there .

title: Monsoon Legion
description: Monsoon Legion The Monsoon Legion was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 1 , 000 heavily armed elite djinni bodyguards served in the Monsoon Legion .
description_long: Monsoon Legion The Monsoon Legion was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 1 , 000 heavily armed elite djinni bodyguards served in the Monsoon Legion . Activities . The Monsoon Legion was responsible for the safety of the Great Caliph . They attacked and flew in formation . Base of Operations . The Citadel of Ice and Steel within the Elemental Plane of Air served as base of all djinni military organizations .
