title: Monster Manual 4th edition
description: Monster Manual 4th edition Contents . The 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " ruleset revamps the mechanics of monsters substantially and it is this subject that the " Monster Manual " covers . Like previous iterations of the book , the " Monster Manual " is a compendium of basic lore , game mechanics , and imagery on the various monsters which make up the core bestiary of the D & D game .
description_long: Monster Manual 4th edition Contents . The 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " ruleset revamps the mechanics of monsters substantially and it is this subject that the " Monster Manual " covers . Like previous iterations of the book , the " Monster Manual " is a compendium of basic lore , game mechanics , and imagery on the various monsters which make up the core bestiary of the D & D game . Each monster present in the 4th edition ruleset , however , unlike in previous editions , is considered an inhabitants of the " Forgotten Realms " . The book consists of only four chapters , though the first chapter composes most of the book . The chapters are as follow :

title: Monster mount
description: Monster mount Monster mount was an enchantment spell that could charm creatures into being mounts or pack animals for a few hours . Effects . This spell worked on a limited number of live ( not undead ) creatures of low intelligence .
description_long: Monster mount Monster mount was an enchantment spell that could charm creatures into being mounts or pack animals for a few hours . Effects . This spell worked on a limited number of live ( not undead ) creatures of low intelligence . If the creatures were not able to resist the charm , they became domesticated and obedient and could be used as basic mounts or pack animals for the duration of the spell . The creatures had to be of appropriate size to carry the intended burdens . Each " monster mount " creature had to stay within 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) of the caster or another affected creature to maintain the spell , i . e . , the mounts could form a group , train , or phalanx as long as no creature got too far away from the caster or another affected creature . Creatures charmed by this spell would only carry riders or burdens . They would not fight except to defend themselves and would not knowingly endanger themselves . Any hostile action by the caster or a rider toward an enchanted creature broke the enchantment for all creatures .

title: Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix
description: Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix Contents . The Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix consisted of 64 5 - hole punched loose - leaf pages , unnumbered , and included a " How To Use This Book " page with an alphabetical index , a one - page index of appropriate monsters for the Al - Qadim setting from other books of the " Monstrous Compendium " - series , 2 pages of random encounter charts , and a sheet with the compiled game statistics , with the remainder consisting of the descriptions of the fictional monsters . Also included were 4 full - page illustrations on heavier card stock .
description_long: Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix Contents . The Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix consisted of 64 5 - hole punched loose - leaf pages , unnumbered , and included a " How To Use This Book " page with an alphabetical index , a one - page index of appropriate monsters for the Al - Qadim setting from other books of the " Monstrous Compendium " - series , 2 pages of random encounter charts , and a sheet with the compiled game statistics , with the remainder consisting of the descriptions of the fictional monsters . Also included were 4 full - page illustrations on heavier card stock .

title: Monstrous humanoid
description: Monstrous humanoid Monstrous humanoids are differentiated from humanoid s by their monstrous or animalistic features . Not all of them are technically " humanoid " in body form . They often have different types of supernatural or extraordinary abilities .
description_long: Monstrous humanoid Monstrous humanoids are differentiated from humanoid s by their monstrous or animalistic features . Not all of them are technically " humanoid " in body form . They often have different types of supernatural or extraordinary abilities . All monstrous humanoids have darkvision out to 60 feet ( 20m ) . As a group , they have no other special abilities or immunities . D & D Edition Specific Information . 3rd Edition . Monstrous humanoids are a Size and Type 4th Edition . Monstrous humanoids are not represented .

title: Monstrous scorpion
description: Monstrous scorpion Monstrous scorpions or giant scorpions were a breed of arachnids known for their poisonous stingers . They were found in a variety of climates , but are most numerous in deserts . Description .
description_long: Monstrous scorpion Monstrous scorpions or giant scorpions were a breed of arachnids known for their poisonous stingers . They were found in a variety of climates , but are most numerous in deserts . Description . Giant scorpions are the size of horses . They were perfectly content with attacking whatever prey was smaller than themselves , including humans . Combat . Scorpions were active hunters . They tracked their prey with their keen senses and then grasped it with their scissor - like pincers . Once in the scorpion ' s grasp , the prey was stung repeatedly until it stopped moving . It was then consumed by the arachnid , whether or not it was still living . Lairs . Scorpions lived in underground burrows . As such , giant scorpions were often encountered in underground ruins or crypts .

title: Montar Kaspar
description: Montar Kaspar Montar Kaspar was a half - elf cavalier and the baron of the city of Kaspar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . He chose the name " Montar Kaspar " for himself , it meant " defender of Kaspar " . Activities .
description_long: Montar Kaspar Montar Kaspar was a half - elf cavalier and the baron of the city of Kaspar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . He chose the name " Montar Kaspar " for himself , it meant " defender of Kaspar " . Activities . Baron Kaspar governed the barony and city of Kaspar and also had the responsibility of defending the realm against the barbarians of the eastern plains . He also commanded his own barony ' s army , the only baron to do so around 1367 DR . He led his forces into battle himself , which earned him the appreciation of his troops . He kept their morale high through a mix of trust , harsh discipline , and indulging their greed , by sharing the loot of a battle and captured horses fairly among the troops . In particular , Baron Kaspar led an elite cavalry company , mounted on the superb Dambraii horse s that he personally had imported from Dambrath . These made them the swiftest cavalry company in the kingdom , able to easily pursue or retreat from barbarian hordes . Personality . He also loved horses with passion . His own mount was Firefiex , reputed to be the swiftest steed in the kingdom .

title: Montaron
description: Montaron Montaron was a halfling member of the Zhentarim who was sent with Xzar to the Sword Coast during the iron crisis . He appears in both the game and novel versions of the Baldur ' s Gate series , of which only the latter is considered canonical . The Novel .
description_long: Montaron Montaron was a halfling member of the Zhentarim who was sent with Xzar to the Sword Coast during the iron crisis . He appears in both the game and novel versions of the Baldur ' s Gate series , of which only the latter is considered canonical . The Novel . In the novel , Montaron and Xzar saved Abdel Adrian from a horde of gibberling s and accompanied him as he traveled to the " Friendly Arms Inn " and later to the mines of Nashkel . Montaron also helped Adrian out at the inn by planting the purses he had stolen on a man whom Adrian had just killed , thus freeing him from some of the blame for what " would have been murder otherwise " . Montaron and Xzar were also secretly working for Sarevok , who later slaughtered them . Games . In " Baldur ' s Gate " , Montaron can be found along with Xzar on the road near the place where Gorion was killed . He ' s a member of the Zhentarim dispatched along with Xzar to find out who ' s to blame for the iron crisis , since their organization actually has nothing to do with it in spite of rumors to the contrary .

title: Monte Cook
description: Monte Cook Monte Cook has been a professional game designer since 1988 , working primarily on role - playing games . Much of his early work was for . During this period , he attracted fan and critical attention with the popular multi - genre setting .
description_long: Monte Cook Monte Cook has been a professional game designer since 1988 , working primarily on role - playing games . Much of his early work was for . During this period , he attracted fan and critical attention with the popular multi - genre setting . Eventually he took a job at TSR Hobbies , where he was a major contributor to the product line . Shortly thereafter , TSR encountered financial difficulties and was purchased by Wizards of the Coast . Under Wizards of the Coast , Cook was given the project that is now probably his main claim to fame - working as one of the three primary authors , along with Skip Williams and Jonathan Tweet , of the third edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " ( and thus the as well ) . Cook contributed mainly to this edition ' s " Dungeon Master ' s Guide " , of which he is the credited author . Cook left Wizards of the Coast in 2002 and started to write material for the independently . Malhavoc ' s first product , " The Book of Eldritch Might " , was an immediate success and is widely credited with demonstrating the viability of PDF publishing within the role - playing industry .

title: Monteshi
description: Monteshi County Monteshi was a county in Tethyr . The ruined and haunted city of Shoonach resided there . Geography .
description_long: Monteshi County Monteshi was a county in Tethyr . The ruined and haunted city of Shoonach resided there . Geography . Together with Calimmon to its west , Monteshi made up the duchy of Ankaram and served as Tethyr ' s border with the kingdom of Calimshan to the south . This county was a strange amalgam of rural pastureland and the dangerous ruins of ancient kingdoms . The site of Shoonach , the former capital of the Shoon Imperium , was here , and roughly half of the county ' s territory was disputed . Calimshan claimed that the region it called " Monrativi Teshy Mir " was rightfully theirs . The county contained a well - manned fortress , Fort Teqlar to guard against monster attacks from Shoonach or threats from Calimshan . Government . In 1369 DR , a pious hin , Count Oxsal Keeneyes ruled and defended Monteshi . Officially , his seat of power was the manor house of Pelmarin , but he spent the majority of his time at Fort Teqlar .

title: Montolio Debrouchee
description: Montolio Debrouchee Montolio Debrouchee ( also spelled DeBrouchee ) , better known as " Mooshie , " was a ranger of great renown , having dedicated himself to the defense of all living things not evil in nature , and total dedication to the goddess of the forest , Mielikki , at an early age . Description . In his last year of life , Montolio was tall , straight , and frail - looking .
description_long: Montolio Debrouchee Montolio Debrouchee ( also spelled DeBrouchee ) , better known as " Mooshie , " was a ranger of great renown , having dedicated himself to the defense of all living things not evil in nature , and total dedication to the goddess of the forest , Mielikki , at an early age . Description . In his last year of life , Montolio was tall , straight , and frail - looking . He had long gray hair with a huge , bristling gray mustache . His eyes were white . Personality . Montolio had a pragmatic view on life . He was not averse to lying if it suited his needs . Orc s were his " particular unfavorites " ( and likely his chosen enemy ) . He loved animals the best . History . Early career . Montolio learned archery and the way of a ranger from Mistress Dilamon , who was so skilled with her bow that she never missed . Montolio served as a ranger for many years , often as a scout for large armies , or working with small groups of rangers or by himself . He claimed to have fought in a dozen wars , spent a winter trapped on a mountain with a broken leg , killed a giant with a dagger , and befriended every animal within 5 , 000 steps of where he lived . Blindness .

title: Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne
description: Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne The Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne was a tower located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This splendid tower housed halls honoring the Grand Caliph s of Zakhara ' s past .
description_long: Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne The Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne was a tower located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This splendid tower housed halls honoring the Grand Caliph s of Zakhara ' s past . History . Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir commissioned this extravagant project to honor his forebears . A special group of dwarves and ogre s , led by a skilled architect genie , were used to build the structure . Artists were used to decorate the walls with historic scenes of the various accomplishments of the Grand Caliphs . Naturally , the current Grand Caliph gave more attention to his father ' s and grandfather ' s deeds . The project was still under construction as of 1367 DR with the hopes that it would be completed for the Grand Caliph ' s next Ascension Day .

title: Moo Kalai
description: Moo Kalai Moo Kalai was a hengeyokai carp man in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Moo lived with his family in a deep lake in Nam Tso .
description_long: Moo Kalai Moo Kalai was a hengeyokai carp man in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Moo lived with his family in a deep lake in Nam Tso . Moo occasionally visited the markets of Bidnop So to trade his people ' s lake rice and opals for a variety of items the carp people couldn ' t make themselves .

title: Moog
description: Moog Moog was a lonely hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Moog lived in a decrepit old tower somewhere near the Dessarin Valley where she wallowed in self - pity .
description_long: Moog Moog was a lonely hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Moog lived in a decrepit old tower somewhere near the Dessarin Valley where she wallowed in self - pity . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Chief Guh took Moog ' s husband , Hruk as her own , like many others . This event destroyed Moog .

title: Mook
description: Mook Mook was a thief and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . She was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix .
description_long: Mook Mook was a thief and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . She was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix . Gameplay . If the player sided with the vampires , then Bodhi sent them to kill Mook . If the player sided with Aran Linvail , then Aran sent the player to protect Mook . However , just after the player arrived and spoke to Mook , Bodhi ' s emissary Lassal appeared and killed her .

title: Moon ' s Twelve
description: Moon ' s Twelve The Moon ' s Twelve were an adventuring company operating in Cormyr in the 1350s DR . History . " Circa " 1357 DR , the Moon ' s Twelve embarked on an expedition into the notorious Vast Swamp of eastern Cormyr .
description_long: Moon ' s Twelve The Moon ' s Twelve were an adventuring company operating in Cormyr in the 1350s DR . History . " Circa " 1357 DR , the Moon ' s Twelve embarked on an expedition into the notorious Vast Swamp of eastern Cormyr . It was to be their last . Amidst the flooded forest , they were said to have discovered a complex of ruined structures as old and as extensive as the famous Myth Drannor . This too was of elven architecture , with carvings and murals illustrating elven kings and mages , all of which seemed to point to a heretofore unknown and forgotten elf kingdom that had once stood in the lands where the Vast Swamp now lay . However , the Moon ' s Twelve were then ambushed by a shocking great number of mind flayer s , who were seemingly allied with a few powerful beholder s . Pursued by these monstrosities , the Moon ' s Twelve fled the ruins and the swampland . Only one member of the band , Sylara , survived and made it back to something like civilization , meeting Brother Twick , a cleric of Chauntea . Delirious with a fever contracted in the marshes , Sylara raved about their discoveries and the disaster that had befallen them , before she died .

title: Moon ( coin )
description: Moon ( coin ) " The moon " ( or a " moon " ) refers to crescent shaped coins minted by the city of Silverymoon . A " moon " was originally a shining blue crescent - shaped electrum coin , valued at 2 ep ( 1 gp ) in the city of Silverymoon . and 1 ep elsewhere .
description_long: Moon ( coin ) " The moon " ( or a " moon " ) refers to crescent shaped coins minted by the city of Silverymoon . A " moon " was originally a shining blue crescent - shaped electrum coin , valued at 2 ep ( 1 gp ) in the city of Silverymoon . and 1 ep elsewhere . Later coins were shining gold crescents known as " the moon " , and accepted throughout the Silver Marches at a value of 2 gp . Around the late 1480s and the early 1490s DR the original shining blue crescent - shaped electrum coin was in circulation again , valued at 2 unicorns ( platinum pieces ) in Silverymoon , and 1 platinum piece elsewhere . At the same time , along with this coin , there was also the eclipsed moon , which consisted of a moon stamped with a silver wedge to complete its round form . It was worth 5 unicorns in Silverymoon , or 2 unicorns elsewhere . References . Notes . The " Silver Marches " does not mention the older electrum " moon " , but implies that the city of Silverymoon , only minted the gold coin at the time .

title: Moon - horse
description: Moon - horse Moon - horses , also called teu ' kelytha in Elvish , were intelligent , magic - using horse s found on Evermeet . Description . Moon - horses had coats that ranged from white to silvery gray .
description_long: Moon - horse Moon - horses , also called teu ' kelytha in Elvish , were intelligent , magic - using horse s found on Evermeet . Description . Moon - horses had coats that ranged from white to silvery gray . Their manes could be any color between white and black . Behavior . Moon - horses were highly intelligent and resembled elves in personality . They willingly served elves as mounts and cavalry . When they roamed free , they often joined up in herds . Combat . Moon - horses were used by elven knights in combat . They had the ability to cast one arcane spell per day . The spells they were known to use were " color spray " , " magic missile " , " shield " , " sleep " , " wall of fog " , " knock " , " ray of enfeeblement " , " stinking cloud " , " summon swarm " , and " web " . Moon - horses were immune to special attacks by undead . Locations . Moon - horses were found all over Evermeet . Moon - horse mounts were not stabled but instead allowed to run free in common herds . Large common herds could be found in Greenmeadow , Drelagara , Ty ' athalael , and Horsefields . Dreglagara was the center of moon - horse breeding and training . History .

title: Moon - spinners
description: Moon - spinners The Moon - spinners were a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The symbol of the Moon - spinners was a long white scarf , which they used to whip or strangle their victims . Activities .
description_long: Moon - spinners The Moon - spinners were a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The symbol of the Moon - spinners was a long white scarf , which they used to whip or strangle their victims . Activities . Holy slayers from the Moon - spinners were obsessed with making Selan the most - worshiped deity on the Isle of the Elephant . They were in direct opposition with followers of the Lost One . Base of Operations . The Isle of the Elephant was the domain of the Moon - spinners .

title: Moon Daggers
description: Moon Daggers The Moon Daggers were a gang organized by Myrkyssa Jelan in 1479 DR shortly after she escaped her imprisonment in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff . The gang attempted to recover the Sarkenaegal tome in the ruined dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff but were slightly slower than Jack Ravenwild and his hirelings , the Blue Wyvern Company , who beat the Moon Daggers to the book . Later , Myrkyssa and the Moon Daggers helped to defeat an attack by the slaver Fetterfists and his drow allies on a noble revel .
description_long: Moon Daggers The Moon Daggers were a gang organized by Myrkyssa Jelan in 1479 DR shortly after she escaped her imprisonment in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff . The gang attempted to recover the Sarkenaegal tome in the ruined dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff but were slightly slower than Jack Ravenwild and his hirelings , the Blue Wyvern Company , who beat the Moon Daggers to the book . Later , Myrkyssa and the Moon Daggers helped to defeat an attack by the slaver Fetterfists and his drow allies on a noble revel .

title: Moon Knights
description: Moon Knights The Moon Knights are a military order of the temple of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . They number around eighty and consist of cleric s of Sehanine Moonbow , all of whom are trained swordsmen .
description_long: Moon Knights The Moon Knights are a military order of the temple of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . They number around eighty and consist of cleric s of Sehanine Moonbow , all of whom are trained swordsmen . Some members possess skills in healing . They are under the command of Ferryl Nimersyl . Moon Knights favor the use of splint mail armor .

title: Moon Pass
description: Moon Pass The Moon Pass was an ancient gorge through which the River Rauvin flowed , splitting the eastern and western section of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The trail between Everlund and Sundabar passed through the Moon Pass .
description_long: Moon Pass The Moon Pass was an ancient gorge through which the River Rauvin flowed , splitting the eastern and western section of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The trail between Everlund and Sundabar passed through the Moon Pass . Description . Despite the Nether Mountains dominated on both its sides , the Moon Pass was a world unto itself . The meltwater filtered through the mountains congealed itself during the winter . Then thawed itself and began to slide down once again , year after year , by digging deep caves on both sides of the pass . Each of these caves dug in the rock , were like vertical labyrinths . The caves were wet and there grew mushrooms of all species ( glowing , edible and poisonous ones ) . There were also many links to the Underdark . It was a land of nobody , crossed with great caution by human s , orc s , dwarves , duergar s , drider s , and even drow . There had been encountered also aballin s and yuan - ti . A group of Illithid s dwelt in the vicinity . The attacks were frequent , while equipment and goods dropped by the victims were scattered everywhere .

title: Moon domain
description: Moon domain The Moon domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters spell powers related to the Moon , perception and lycanthrope s . The spellcaster gains the ability to turn and destroy such shapechanger s as a good cleric turns undead . Moon Domain Spells .
description_long: Moon domain The Moon domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters spell powers related to the Moon , perception and lycanthrope s . The spellcaster gains the ability to turn and destroy such shapechanger s as a good cleric turns undead . Moon Domain Spells . Once per day , divine spellcasters with the Moon domain could cast one domain spell for each spell level they had achieved .

title: Moon elf
description: Moon elf Moon elves , also known as Teu - tel - quessir in their own language , or as silver elves are the most common of all the eladrin subraces . More tolerant of human s than other eladrin , moon elves are the ancestors of most half - eladrin . Ecology .
description_long: Moon elf Moon elves , also known as Teu - tel - quessir in their own language , or as silver elves are the most common of all the eladrin subraces . More tolerant of human s than other eladrin , moon elves are the ancestors of most half - eladrin . Ecology . Description . Like all eladrin , the " Teu - tel - quessir " are tall , close to humans in height , but more slender and beautiful . Moon elf skin is pale , often with an icy blue hue . Moon elf hair is commonly black , blue , or silvery white , although human - like colors are heard of as well , though very rare . Moon elf eyes , like those of other eladrin , are very commonly green , although some are blue as well . All exhibit a characteristic best described as golden flecks speckled through the iris . Male moon elves are typically taller than females . Personality . Of all the eladrin races , moon elves are the most impulsive , with a strong distaste for complacency or isolation . Moon elves long to be on the road , traveling and exploring the untamed wilderness that lies between cities and nations .

title: Moonbar
description: Moonbar Moonbars were rare gemstone unique to the Realms that were found in desert and tropical regions on Toril . Description . Moonbars were usually found in large crystals , typically 1 ft ( 30 cm ) long by 4 in ( 10 cm ) wide , which were rectangular with rounded corners .
description_long: Moonbar Moonbars were rare gemstone unique to the Realms that were found in desert and tropical regions on Toril . Description . Moonbars were usually found in large crystals , typically 1 ft ( 30 cm ) long by 4 in ( 10 cm ) wide , which were rectangular with rounded corners . Milky white and opaque with a nacreous sheen , moonbars had a naturally smooth surface and , once washed clean , required no further alteration . Cutting was only necessary if the crystals were broken . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000gp . Moonbars were considered sacred to Kiaransalee by her followers — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Powdered moonbar was useful as a substitute component in the formulation of necromancy spells . It was also used to make inks , potions , and as a spell component for items that created , controlled , or healed undead creatures , including binding together parts from disparate corpses . Wands that cast " calling " spells ( a subschool of conjuration ) could be improved by fashioning them using an unbroken moonbar . Rumors and Legends .

title: Moonbeam
description: Moonbeam Moonbeam was an evocation spell that fired a movable beam of light that penetrated darkness and forced lycanthropes to change shape . Effects . The " moonbeam " was cone - shaped and originated from the caster ' s hand .
description_long: Moonbeam Moonbeam was an evocation spell that fired a movable beam of light that penetrated darkness and forced lycanthropes to change shape . Effects . The " moonbeam " was cone - shaped and originated from the caster ' s hand . Once each minute of the spell ' s duration , the caster could choose a different direction in which to point the beam . It was the intensity of the full moon and any lycanthropes caught in the cone of moonlight would involuntarily change into their animal form unless they could muster the will to prevent it . Likewise , were - creatures in the moonlit area already in animal form had to exert willpower to change back . " Darkness " spells of higher level blocked " moonbeam " but those of equal or lower level did not . Unlike " light " spells , " moonbeam " did not dispel or counter magical darkness of equal or lower level . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required . The divine version worked off the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus , while the arcane version required a pinch of white powder .

title: Moonblade
description: Moonblade A moonblade was a hereditary magical longsword passed down in elf lineages . Description . Moonblades were named in part because of the moonstone s found in the of each sword but also for the moon elves that wielded them , with the only exception of the half - elf assassin , Arilyn Moonblade .
description_long: Moonblade A moonblade was a hereditary magical longsword passed down in elf lineages . Description . Moonblades were named in part because of the moonstone s found in the of each sword but also for the moon elves that wielded them , with the only exception of the half - elf assassin , Arilyn Moonblade . According to Ethlando , the mage responsible for conception and creation of the largest collection of moonblades , the other elves , such as sylvan elves and sun elves were not prohibited from claiming a blade , it was just highly unlikely . Abilities . Each wielder contributed a power to the sword , which would be absorbed through the moonstone in the blade ' s hilt . However , the wielder could not be separated from the sword for any length of time and expect to live . Each moonblade was unique , as were the powers given to them . History . Each moonblade was tied to the elven bloodline that first claimed the blade and was passed from descendant to descendant until there were no more worthy heirs . Every elf in the family had a choice to attempt to bond with the blade .

title: Moonclaw
description: Moonclaw The Moonclaw were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar . They were secretly financed by King Belaur Aumar . History .
description_long: Moonclaw The Moonclaw were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar . They were secretly financed by King Belaur Aumar . History . In 229 DR , the Moonclaw made their sudden appearance in the streets of Hastarl , well equipped and armed . They soon gained control of many illegal affairs in the city and recruited many members . This was a big problem for many independent thieves , so two of the the most notorious , Farl and Eladar the Dark , convinced many of the remaining independent thieves to form a rival guild , the Velvet Hands . They suspected that the Moonclaw were agents of some powerful government officers or of a Magelord . Despite their resources and the complicity of the guards , the Moonclaw gradually lost to the Velvet Hands . In 240 DR , the guild was finally destroyed . It was discovered that the leader of the Moonclaw , Isparla the Winding , was in fact one of the mistresses of the king . This confirmed the connection between the Moonclaw and the government .

title: Moondeep Sea
description: Moondeep Sea The Moondeep Sea was a subterranean lake approximately 240 miles ( 386 km ) wide found in the Underdark beneath the Galena Mountains . Geography . The cavern which contained it was known as the Vault of Gnashing Teeth , so named for the countless animated skulls stuck to the cavern ' s ceiling .
description_long: Moondeep Sea The Moondeep Sea was a subterranean lake approximately 240 miles ( 386 km ) wide found in the Underdark beneath the Galena Mountains . Geography . The cavern which contained it was known as the Vault of Gnashing Teeth , so named for the countless animated skulls stuck to the cavern ' s ceiling . The Moondeep Sea was known for its giant aquatic spider s and the city of V ' elddrinnsshar , which lay on a mile - wide island dominated by a plateau in the middle of the lake .

title: Moonfire ( person )
description: Moonfire ( person ) Lady Moonfire was a light - hearted half - elf and leader of Loudwater as of 1479 DR . Physical Appearance . Lady Moonfire tended to wear a black gown , decorated with patterns threaded in silver .
description_long: Moonfire ( person ) Lady Moonfire was a light - hearted half - elf and leader of Loudwater as of 1479 DR . Physical Appearance . Lady Moonfire tended to wear a black gown , decorated with patterns threaded in silver . She also wore a silver amulet and ornate rings . Personality . Lady Moonfire was very upbeat , usually smiling or laughing . Even when she was Loudwater ' s leader , she was carefree and showed little interest in her duties . Moonfire was far more interested in adventure , although she had never been on any .

title: Moongleam Tower
description: Moongleam Tower Moongleam Tower was the base of operations for the Harpers in Everlund . Structure . Built around 1172 DR , the hard black stone keep was visible from almost every part of Everlund .
description_long: Moongleam Tower Moongleam Tower was the base of operations for the Harpers in Everlund . Structure . Built around 1172 DR , the hard black stone keep was visible from almost every part of Everlund . Comprising of four narrow , cylindrical towers joined together , its roof was crowned by a open turret where a signaling mirror shaped like a crescent moon stood . Moongleam Tower was surrounded by a dry moat although this could be quickly filled by a system of cisterns and pumps .

title: Moonhoney
description: Moonhoney Moonhoney was made from the feces of ground - dwelling worms that dwelled in the Abyss . Its color and consistency resembled that of honey and when exposed to moonlight it developed a sweet flavor that was highly prized by human s and many demihuman s . Moonhoney didn ' t spoil so it was ideal travel food .
description_long: Moonhoney Moonhoney was made from the feces of ground - dwelling worms that dwelled in the Abyss . Its color and consistency resembled that of honey and when exposed to moonlight it developed a sweet flavor that was highly prized by human s and many demihuman s . Moonhoney didn ' t spoil so it was ideal travel food . When swallowed , it would cure any poison in a person ' s system .

title: Moonlands
description: Moonlands Moonlands was a region that was located east of the River Surbrin and north of River Rauvin in the Silver Marches . Description . The southern part of this region was densely populated , but away from the river , the landscape soon turned into a real wild land .
description_long: Moonlands Moonlands was a region that was located east of the River Surbrin and north of River Rauvin in the Silver Marches . Description . The southern part of this region was densely populated , but away from the river , the landscape soon turned into a real wild land . The landscape was characterized by meadows interspersed by rolling hills and thick stands of woods . History . The Moonlands were the territory of the Uthgardt . The ancestral mounds of the Black Lion Tribe and Red Tiger Tribe were near Beorunna ' s Well , up in the north , while the Sky Pony Tribe was located in the environs of the One Stone down in the south . There were some disputes in this region since Uthgardt ' s Sky Pony tribe attacked many caravans of dwarves directed from Citadel Felbarr to Silverymoon . Hot - head dwarves of Felbarr , who were brave stalwart defenders , were considering driving the Sky Pony barbarian s away from the area ; this would surely cause both sides to suffer many losses .

title: Moonlight
description: Moonlight Moonlight was one of three ninja in the service of Daisake Mayazato in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Moonlight trained in the ninja arts in the Warazama clan together with Smoke and Snake , until that clan was destroyed by internal dissent .
description_long: Moonlight Moonlight was one of three ninja in the service of Daisake Mayazato in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Moonlight trained in the ninja arts in the Warazama clan together with Smoke and Snake , until that clan was destroyed by internal dissent . He and his fellows entered into the service of Daisake Mayazato to repay him for previous services .

title: Moonlight ' s Triumph
description: Moonlight ' s Triumph Moonlight ' s Triumph was a battle that occurred when the Nethertide Horde of the Nether Mountains threatened both Everlund and Silverymoon in Year of the Boot , 1343 DR . Preparation . The Moonlight Men mercenaries had reached Turnstone Pass before the orc s , who were approaching from the north .
description_long: Moonlight ' s Triumph Moonlight ' s Triumph was a battle that occurred when the Nethertide Horde of the Nether Mountains threatened both Everlund and Silverymoon in Year of the Boot , 1343 DR . Preparation . The Moonlight Men mercenaries had reached Turnstone Pass before the orc s , who were approaching from the north . Archers were positioned at the south end of the pass in ambush while spellcasters took the high ground of the hills that the pass penetrated . Piles of heavy rocks were also stacked up on the hills ready to drop from above . The entire mercenary force was then concealed behind " invisibility " spells until the orcs had committed their forces . Battle . The vast majority of the orcs went through the pass , while a small number of them diverted to their left . When the bulk of the orcs were in position , thousands of arrows were let loose and rockslides were triggered . Then the spellcasters rained destructive spells down upon the orcs — however , they had not accounted for the horde ' s magical protections , talismans made from agate , silver , and dragon bone , which turned much of the magic back on its casters .

title: Moonlight Men
description: Moonlight Men The Moonlight Men were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Moonlight Men were a mercenary company of ten years ' experience that gained a great reputation .
description_long: Moonlight Men The Moonlight Men were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Moonlight Men were a mercenary company of ten years ' experience that gained a great reputation . They usually guarded caravan roads around Sundabar , Silverymoon , and Everlund . Their last battle was the defense of Turnstone Pass against a huge orc horde . They managed to crush the orcs but only six Moonlight Men , include Mintiper Moonsilver , survived . Mintiper went to wander south , while the others possibly joined the army of Silverymoon .

title: Moonlit Tower
description: Moonlit Tower The Moonlit Tower was a mysterious tower situated on a crag northwest of the town of Maerstar in the Vast in north Faerûn . Structure . It only appeared when the moon was full and its rays illuminated the crag .
description_long: Moonlit Tower The Moonlit Tower was a mysterious tower situated on a crag northwest of the town of Maerstar in the Vast in north Faerûn . Structure . It only appeared when the moon was full and its rays illuminated the crag . Then there would appear a small and slender tower , glowing blue - gray as though it were constructed of tangible moonlight . Interior . Adventurers were able to enter the tower and describe the interior . Inside , there were seven rooms and a rooftop floor . These were connected by a spiral stair of stone treads that floated without any visible means of support , and with no rail either . Magic spell s cast within the Tower had unusual effects . History . There were many different tales about what was found within . At times , the Tower was either empty or inhabited by rare or bizarre monsters ; for example , an argos , or beholder s , steel shadow s , watchghost s , and strange , unknown creatures . Sometimes there was treasure , sometimes there was not . On occasion , explorers returned with a disease , eggs that hatched into dangerous monsters , or statuettes that reverted to living monsters . Rumors .

title: Moonsea
description: Moonsea The Moonsea was a region in north Faerûn . The region was dominated by the large titular sea that was connected to the Sea of Fallen Stars to the south by the River Lis . The shoreline was a wild , frontier area that was home to several city states dominated by despots .
description_long: Moonsea The Moonsea was a region in north Faerûn . The region was dominated by the large titular sea that was connected to the Sea of Fallen Stars to the south by the River Lis . The shoreline was a wild , frontier area that was home to several city states dominated by despots . The region did not have a capital . The Moonsea was not necessarily a safe place to live and its settlers were driven and independent as a result . The most notable of the city - states were Zhentil Keep at the western end , the greatest base of operations of the once - secret society of the Zhentarim ; Hillsfar lay in the southwest and Mulmaster in the southeast ; and Melvaunt rested on the northern side along with Phlan . Many ruins were found in the Moonsea , the most notable being Northkeep . West of the Moonsea was the northernmost of the Dales : Teshendale . The Dragonspine Mountains were northwest of the sea . Weather . The Moonsea climate could be described as harsh and cold . While not as cold as the Silver Marches , the weather was significantly foul ; enough to cause the seas to freeze over during the winter .

title: Moonsea ( lake )
description: Moonsea ( lake ) The Moonsea , originally known as the Dragon Sea , was a deep natural lake just north of the Dalelands . The Moonsea gave its name to the whole Moonsea region , as the name Moonsea applied to both the lake and the lands around the lake .
description_long: Moonsea ( lake ) The Moonsea , originally known as the Dragon Sea , was a deep natural lake just north of the Dalelands . The Moonsea gave its name to the whole Moonsea region , as the name Moonsea applied to both the lake and the lands around the lake .

title: Moonsea Ride
description: Moonsea Ride The Moonsea Ride was a road that ran from Arabel , through Tilverton north of Cormyr , in a northeasterly direction , cutting through the Rimwood and Midwood areas of the forest of Cormanthor , until it reached Hillsfar on the southern shores of the Moonsea . In Cormyr , it was called the Mountain Ride . From Arabel , it ran past Castle Crag ( near where it joined Dragon Trail ) and through Gnoll Pass in the Storm Horns .
description_long: Moonsea Ride The Moonsea Ride was a road that ran from Arabel , through Tilverton north of Cormyr , in a northeasterly direction , cutting through the Rimwood and Midwood areas of the forest of Cormanthor , until it reached Hillsfar on the southern shores of the Moonsea . In Cormyr , it was called the Mountain Ride . From Arabel , it ran past Castle Crag ( near where it joined Dragon Trail ) and through Gnoll Pass in the Storm Horns .

title: Moonsea skysentinel
description: Moonsea skysentinel The Moonsea Skysentinel is a prestige class of the Moonsea region of Faerûn . Moonsea Skysentinels serve as the lookouts , spies , and scouts for the Knights of the North , a small organization of individuals who wish to see the destruction of the Zhentarim . Moonsea Skysentinels ride their dire hawk mounts in search of enemy movement , communication between cells of their organization , and a variety of other tasks they are uniquely suited to .
description_long: Moonsea skysentinel The Moonsea Skysentinel is a prestige class of the Moonsea region of Faerûn . Moonsea Skysentinels serve as the lookouts , spies , and scouts for the Knights of the North , a small organization of individuals who wish to see the destruction of the Zhentarim . Moonsea Skysentinels ride their dire hawk mounts in search of enemy movement , communication between cells of their organization , and a variety of other tasks they are uniquely suited to .

title: Moonshadow Hall
description: Moonshadow Hall Moonshadow Hall is the temple of Selûne located in the city of Yhaunn in the nation of Sembia . Layout . The high priestess ' s rooms are located on the second floor of the temple , furthest from the ram that leads down to the ground floor .
description_long: Moonshadow Hall Moonshadow Hall is the temple of Selûne located in the city of Yhaunn in the nation of Sembia . Layout . The high priestess ' s rooms are located on the second floor of the temple , furthest from the ram that leads down to the ground floor . A grass covered cloister is found in the middle of the temples inner courtyard , where a low stone wall surrounds a sacred pool of water .

title: Moonshae Isles
description: Moonshae Isles The Moonshae Isles were a group of islands that formed a roughly circular archipelago with the Sea of Moonshae in the center . They lay roughly 400 miles ( 644 km ) west of the region of Amn and to the southwest of the Sword Coast . As of 1371 DR , the majority of the Moonshae Isles were ruled by High Queen Alicia Kendrick , who ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr on Alaron .
description_long: Moonshae Isles The Moonshae Isles were a group of islands that formed a roughly circular archipelago with the Sea of Moonshae in the center . They lay roughly 400 miles ( 644 km ) west of the region of Amn and to the southwest of the Sword Coast . As of 1371 DR , the majority of the Moonshae Isles were ruled by High Queen Alicia Kendrick , who ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr on Alaron . After the Spellplague , House Kendrick lost much of their control over the isles . In 1479 DR , much of the isle of Alaron was ruled by House Kendrick , although the King ' s forces did not control the entire island . The Isle of Snowdown was controlled by the vampire Lady Erliza Daressin , who was loyal to Amn . The Isle of Gwynneth was controlled by the Kingdom of Sarifal , which was ruled by High Lady Ordalf . A tribe of fomorian s crossed from the Feywild into Faerûn after the Spellplague and took control of the island of Oman . The isle of Moray was under the control of Malar ite lycanthropes . Geography . The islands that made up the Moonshae Isles were as follows : Societies . Native Societies .

title: Moonshae trilogy
description: Moonshae trilogy The Moonshae trilogy was the first series of books set in the Forgotten Realms . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The series is followed by the Druidhome trilogy .
description_long: Moonshae trilogy The Moonshae trilogy was the first series of books set in the Forgotten Realms . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The series is followed by the Druidhome trilogy . Douglas Niles also wrote a short story about the early days of the Moonshae Isles called " The First Moonwell " . It is included in " Realms of Magic " anthology .

title: Moonsilver House
description: Moonsilver House Moonsilver House was a temple of Selûne in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by High Priestess Wyndra Syrylstone , who was known as " Moon Mistress " . She led twenty - two priestesses , as well as 229 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR .
description_long: Moonsilver House Moonsilver House was a temple of Selûne in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by High Priestess Wyndra Syrylstone , who was known as " Moon Mistress " . She led twenty - two priestesses , as well as 229 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR . Moonsilver House was one of two temples that dominated daily Calauntan life , at least for those of a more kindly nature .

title: Moonstalker
description: Moonstalker Moonstalkers are shifter s who have a closer bond with their lycanthropic ancestors . They assault their enemies using bone - chilling howls and feral instincts . Also , they have the ability to take the form of a wolf or a tiger , depending on what kind of shifter they are .
description_long: Moonstalker Moonstalkers are shifter s who have a closer bond with their lycanthropic ancestors . They assault their enemies using bone - chilling howls and feral instincts . Also , they have the ability to take the form of a wolf or a tiger , depending on what kind of shifter they are .

title: Moonstar agent
description: Moonstar agent Moonstar agents , also referred to as Teukiir , was a special prestige class on Faerûn . They were all members of the organization known as the Moonstars which was founded by Khelben Arunsun . Ex - Moonstar Agents .
description_long: Moonstar agent Moonstar agents , also referred to as Teukiir , was a special prestige class on Faerûn . They were all members of the organization known as the Moonstars which was founded by Khelben Arunsun . Ex - Moonstar Agents . Whether intentional or otherwise , any agent who went against the code of the Tel Teukiira to the point of endangering a fellow agent or left the group would quickly garner a reputation among the group . As such they could not progress any further as an agent or use any special ability granted from such . Only a petition to Khelben or an " atonement " spell could bring an agent back in the group ' s good graces .

title: Moonstars
description: Moonstars The Moonstars ( also known as the Tel ' Teukiira , the Silverstars or the Twelvestars ) were a highly secretive group of individuals formed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun with the aim of unifying the human s and other races ( especially elves ) against the forces of evil . Outlook . The Moonstars sought to preserve life and knowledge .
description_long: Moonstars The Moonstars ( also known as the Tel ' Teukiira , the Silverstars or the Twelvestars ) were a highly secretive group of individuals formed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun with the aim of unifying the human s and other races ( especially elves ) against the forces of evil . Outlook . The Moonstars sought to preserve life and knowledge . They had a similar outlook to the Harpers , but dedicated themselves to Mystra , Oghma , and Sehanine Moonbow . Their leader , Khelben , was very much in tune with the beliefs and motivations of the Harpers , but preferred to keep tighter control of the agents under his control . He felt that he sacrificed much for the Harpers during his time in their service and was unfairly treated by the Twilight Trio . Prophecy . A passage from Amagal ' s Tome ( an ancient elven text from Cormanthor ) declared : It was believed that only Khelben understood the relevance of these words . History . The Moonstars were officially formed in 1370 DR , but this was only a step in a much larger plan by the organization ' s founder , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , who had sought to create his own evil - fighting organization for centuries before .

title: Moonstone
description: Moonstone Moonstone was an opaque white form of found in the Realms . Description . Moonstones took on a milky bluish sheen when polished and were usually cut cabochon for jewelry and ornamentation .
description_long: Moonstone Moonstone was an opaque white form of found in the Realms . Description . Moonstones took on a milky bluish sheen when polished and were usually cut cabochon for jewelry and ornamentation . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Moonstones were considered sacred by followers of Corellon , Eilistraee , Hathor , Sehanine Moonbow , Selûne , and Sharindlar — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Moonstones captured light and would glow faintly in darkness after nearby light sources were extinguished . The sorcerer Pelathyon Hawkryn of Impiltur ( whose family owned lucrative moonstone mines ) was a proponent of what he called " moonstone magic " — the ability of moonstone dust to substitute for other non - organic components of spells , specifically various abjuration spells , such as walls and barriers , and certain evocation spells where powdered moonstone provided storage of magical energy and the quick release of that energy in a new direction . Careful research was required to determine the optimal amount of moonstone required for each substitution .

title: Moonstone Palace
description: Moonstone Palace The Moonstone Palace ( also Moonflower Palace ) is the home of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower on the island of Evermeet . It is a huge white structure made from marble , alabaster and crystal , surrounded by the Guardian trees , and situated above the city of Leuthilspar . Its features are slender towers , flying buttresses and sky bridges .
description_long: Moonstone Palace The Moonstone Palace ( also Moonflower Palace ) is the home of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower on the island of Evermeet . It is a huge white structure made from marble , alabaster and crystal , surrounded by the Guardian trees , and situated above the city of Leuthilspar . Its features are slender towers , flying buttresses and sky bridges . Areas . Dome of Stars . The throne room is a high and vaulted round chamber ringed with galleries and with a huge glass dome at its top . The dome is made of theurglass and is composed of a mosaic of stained panels , which turn clear by night in order to give a view of the stars . The room has a dark marble floor . The throne itself is gilded and hovers six feet from the floor . Grounds . The grounds of the palace are very large , containing hedge mazes , gardens , parks and lakes . The gardens are said to be blessed by the Seldarine . Accommodation . The rooms of the palace are expansive and offer very good views of Leuthilspar and the ocean and forest . Inhabitants . Apart from Queen Amlaruil herself , the Council of Matrons may frequent the palace , as well as Amlaruil ' s top magicians , who have their own towers .

title: Moonveil
description: Moonveil Moonveil was a divine magic spell available to certain priests of Bhaal , and later , Bane , that corrupted and blocked a moonwell — sacred pools scattered around the Moonshae Isles and dedicated to the Earthmother , with magical properties and possibly a " portal " — from operating . It was a ritual that took nine minutes to cast and could be assisted by up to seven additional followers . Effects .
description_long: Moonveil Moonveil was a divine magic spell available to certain priests of Bhaal , and later , Bane , that corrupted and blocked a moonwell — sacred pools scattered around the Moonshae Isles and dedicated to the Earthmother , with magical properties and possibly a " portal " — from operating . It was a ritual that took nine minutes to cast and could be assisted by up to seven additional followers . Effects . The caster and up to seven assistants had to chant and dance all around the moonwell in a rough circle . Every minute , for nine minutes , a creature had to be sacrificed and its blood spilled upon the ground and into the pool . When the ritual was completed , a black mist rose from the moonwell , covering it with a roiling veil of death and destruction . All beneficial properties and effects of the moonwell were negated and the influence of the Goddess upon the local area was weakened to the point where she could not awaken or consciously direct her children ( Kamerynn the unicorn and the Pack ) .

title: Moonwater
description: Moonwater The Moonwater was a temple of Selûne in the town of Ylraphon in the Vast . Organization . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was quite a small temple , tended to by only five cleric s , including their leader , Catalan Bree .
description_long: Moonwater The Moonwater was a temple of Selûne in the town of Ylraphon in the Vast . Organization . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was quite a small temple , tended to by only five cleric s , including their leader , Catalan Bree . Features . The Moonwater housed a number of magic item s related to the moon , mostly gifted by elves leaving the area in the 14th century DR or dating back to when Ylraphon was an elven city .

title: Moonwing
description: Moonwing Moonwing was a silver dragon and a leader of the Talons of Justice during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but they were defeated after Dorn Graybrook ' s team helped Kara in the battle .
description_long: Moonwing Moonwing was a silver dragon and a leader of the Talons of Justice during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but they were defeated after Dorn Graybrook ' s team helped Kara in the battle . After the metallic dragon s changed their minds and decided to join the fight against Sammaster , Azhaq and Moonwing helped break the chromatic dragon s ' siege of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . After an attempt to break the magical shield of the citadel that held the secret of the " Dracorage mythal " , Moonwing was killed .

title: Moonwood
description: Moonwood The Moonwood was a large forest north of Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . By about 1460 DR , the Moonwood had grown together with the Cold Wood and the larger forest was known as the Glimmerwood , although the elves still referred to it as the Moonwood . Geography .
description_long: Moonwood The Moonwood was a large forest north of Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . By about 1460 DR , the Moonwood had grown together with the Cold Wood and the larger forest was known as the Glimmerwood , although the elves still referred to it as the Moonwood . Geography . The Moonwood was located between Silverymoon and Mithral Hall and was bound by the River Surbrin to the west and the River Redrun to the northeast . Directly to the north of the Moonwood was the Druarwood ; across the Redrun were the Night Trees forest groves and , beyond them , the Coldwood . These three woods grow together and the resulting one forest is known as Glimmerwood . Flora . The Moonwood was dominated by , shadowtop s , and duskwoods . Inhabitants . Although the Moonwood was known to be free of orc s and other goblinkind , orc tribes frequently raided the outer edges of the forest for lumber . The forest was known to be the haunt of many lycanthrope s , primarily in the northern reaches . Many of these lycanthropes were members of the People of the Black Blood , while others were members of the Eldreth Veluuthra .

title: Mooshie ' s Grove
description: Mooshie ' s Grove Mooshie ' s Grove was the home of Montolio Debrouchee ( " Mooshie " ) and was a diamond - shaped grove of trees and piled stone walls in the Rauvin Mountains near the Coldwood . Structure . The grove featured elevated walkways and beautifully designed huts .
description_long: Mooshie ' s Grove Mooshie ' s Grove was the home of Montolio Debrouchee ( " Mooshie " ) and was a diamond - shaped grove of trees and piled stone walls in the Rauvin Mountains near the Coldwood . Structure . The grove featured elevated walkways and beautifully designed huts . It was surrounded by tall pine s and emitted a magical aura . History . Drizzt . Mooshie ' s grove was the site of Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s ranger training . Pikel . As a test , the elf Tarathiel took Pikel Bouldershoulder , the dwarf druid from the Spirit Soaring , to the grove , where they encountered a unicorn , symbolic of the nature goddess Mielikki . Pikel befriended the unicorn , and Tarathiel considered him to have passed the test .

title: Mooshie ' s Longbow
description: Mooshie ' s Longbow Mooshie ' s longbow was a finely crafted longbow . It was given to Drizzt Do ' Urden by Montolio Debrouchee at the end of Drizzt ' s ranger training . Appearances .
description_long: Mooshie ' s Longbow Mooshie ' s longbow was a finely crafted longbow . It was given to Drizzt Do ' Urden by Montolio Debrouchee at the end of Drizzt ' s ranger training . Appearances . Mooshie ' s longbow is featured in the novel " Sojourn " , by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Morada Topolino
description: Morada Topolino Morada Topolino was a mansion and assassin / thieves ' guild located in Delthuntle , Aglarond . Business . Morada Topolino was involved in much of the crime of Delthuntle .
description_long: Morada Topolino Morada Topolino was a mansion and assassin / thieves ' guild located in Delthuntle , Aglarond . Business . Morada Topolino was involved in much of the crime of Delthuntle . It also ran a lucrative business in pink pearl s , aided by the deep diving skills of Spider Parrafin and the divination magic of Wigglefingers . Guildhouse . The Morada Topolino mansion in Delthuntle was described as " fabulous " and well - appointed . It was lavishly decorated inside and out . Leadership . Morada Topolino was led by Pericolo Topolino , the " Grandfather of Assassins " until his death in 1481 DR . His captains were his old friend Wigglefingers the mage and his granddaughter Donnola Topolino .

title: Moradin
description: Moradin Moradin , pronounced ( " mor " - uh - din ) , was the lawful good god of the dwarves and the chief deity in their pantheon . A harsh but fair judge , he was strength and force of will embodied . Moradin inspired dwarven inventions and constantly sought to improve that race , encouraging their good nature , intelligence , and harmonious existence with other good races while battling their pride and isolationist tendencies .
description_long: Moradin Moradin , pronounced ( " mor " - uh - din ) , was the lawful good god of the dwarves and the chief deity in their pantheon . A harsh but fair judge , he was strength and force of will embodied . Moradin inspired dwarven inventions and constantly sought to improve that race , encouraging their good nature , intelligence , and harmonious existence with other good races while battling their pride and isolationist tendencies . Moradin ' s holy day was on the crescent moon and he was worshipped at forges and hearths . Followers . Moradin ' s cleric s , known as " Sonnlinor " , were usually drawn from family lines , like most dwarven occupations ; they wore earthy colors , with chain mail and silver ed helms . Moradin charged his followers with the task of wiping out the kingdoms of orc s and wiping out the followers of Gruumsh . The church of Moradin had an active role in guiding the morals of dwarven communities ; they emphasized his hand in everyday dwarven activities such as mining , smithing , and engineering , and invoked his blessing when these tasks began . They led the push to found new dwarven kingdoms and increase their status among surface communities .

title: Moradin ' s Vein
description: Moradin ' s Vein The Moradin ' s Vein , also called River of Gold , was a magical river of molten gold that flowed wherever the dwarven god Moradin willed it . The river was actually Moradin ' s lifeblood and could be used for magical travel . In 1480 DR , duergar from Drik Hargunen used rune magic to contaminate the river with the Stoneplague disease .
description_long: Moradin ' s Vein The Moradin ' s Vein , also called River of Gold , was a magical river of molten gold that flowed wherever the dwarven god Moradin willed it . The river was actually Moradin ' s lifeblood and could be used for magical travel . In 1480 DR , duergar from Drik Hargunen used rune magic to contaminate the river with the Stoneplague disease . Several unscrupulous dwarves mined the contaminated river , which spread the Stoneplague among the dwarves of East Rift who handled the contaminated bullion . The plague was ended when the human hero Torrin Ironstar journeyed to Drik Hargunen and destroyed the rune .

title: Morag
description: Morag Morag is the main antagonist in the original " Neverwinter Nights " campaign . Ten thousand years before the events of the campaign , Morag was a queen of the sarrukh , a powerful and cruel reptilian race from whom the present lizardfolk and yuan - ti are descended . At that time , the continent of Faerûn was a jungle , but after an ice age dawned upon Faerûn , the sarrukh were all but wiped out .
description_long: Morag Morag is the main antagonist in the original " Neverwinter Nights " campaign . Ten thousand years before the events of the campaign , Morag was a queen of the sarrukh , a powerful and cruel reptilian race from whom the present lizardfolk and yuan - ti are descended . At that time , the continent of Faerûn was a jungle , but after an ice age dawned upon Faerûn , the sarrukh were all but wiped out . In order to sustain themselves , Morag and a handful of her subjects entered an alternate dimension via a magical device known as the Source Stone , which protected them from the cold . Ten millennia later , at the time that the campaign has taken place , the city of Neverwinter has been constructed over the area where the Source Stone lies . Morag desires to regain her power and turn the continent of Faerûn into a jungle once more , over which she shall rule as of old . One day Maugrim , who had heard rumors of the Source Stone , encounters it while on a search , and triggers the plague , which is a defense system of the Source Stone . Though infected and dying , Morag uses her power to heal Maugrim and tells him of her ambitions .

title: Morak Ur ' gray
description: Morak Ur ' gray Morak Ur ' gray was a innkeeper in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Morak managed an inn in the Nightstone village .
description_long: Morak Ur ' gray Morak Ur ' gray was a innkeeper in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Morak managed an inn in the Nightstone village . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR when the cloud giant s started their bombardment against Nightstone Morak gathered many villagers as possible and guided them in escape . Refereeing in nearby caves Morak and his fellow were captured by goblin s of Boss Hark . Personality . Morak was a natural leader , always optimist . He thought that sure Lady Velresa Nandar would send help for them .

title: Moral
description: Moral Imam Moral was the High Priest of the Mosque of Bountiful Jisan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Moral oversaw over 200 priests of Jisan , clerical brethren , and laymen .
description_long: Moral Imam Moral was the High Priest of the Mosque of Bountiful Jisan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Moral oversaw over 200 priests of Jisan , clerical brethren , and laymen . He was also one of the richest people in Huzuz , owning over 50 houses and business . He was involved with a nasty dispute with the mosque of Jisan in Hiyal because of their involvement with the Gilded Palm , a notorious group of holy slayer s . Three attempts on his life were made , but he survived them all . He suspected that members of the Gilded Palms were able to infiltrate his clergy . Possessions . Moral wore " chain mail of the desert evening " , and owned a " ring of spell storing " , " sandals of striding and leaping " . He always carried a " lens of appraisal " . His recent acquisitions included a " ring of regeneration " and a " staff of striking " .

title: Moralist
description: Moralist Moralists or Clerics of the Faith Moral , were militant priests in Zakhara who served as the heart and fire of their church . Requirements . Moralists priests could be male or female of any race .
description_long: Moralist Moralists or Clerics of the Faith Moral , were militant priests in Zakhara who served as the heart and fire of their church . Requirements . Moralists priests could be male or female of any race . Males and females were usually segregated into separate buildings and sometimes even separate temples . All moralists were lawful individuals . Role . These priests were zealots . This distinction often led others to view them as dangerous . All rules governing a moralist ' s life were derived from their god . They tolerated ethoist s and pragmatist s of their own religion , but still believed they were not living their lives properly . They disliked other priests and despised magic - users . Unless approved by their god , all earthly distractions were avoided by moralists . They only mingled with non - moralists if given a direct order by their superiors . Moralists were stern and serious individuals at all times . They kept precise records of their accounts and actions in case they were ever called upon to defend themselves . Possessions . Moralists always wore the official uniform of their church . Chainmail armor was usually worn underneath their uniform . Benefits .

title: Moray
description: Moray Moray was the western most settlement of the Ffolk and the most wild of the southern Moonshae Isles . By 1479 DR the Black Blood Tribe of lycanthropes controlled most of the island . Notable Locations .
description_long: Moray Moray was the western most settlement of the Ffolk and the most wild of the southern Moonshae Isles . By 1479 DR the Black Blood Tribe of lycanthropes controlled most of the island . Notable Locations . Breasal Marsh . A marsh home to Lizardfolk . Caer Moray . This small port village of 1 , 500 was one of the few remaining outposts of humanity on Moray . Dennin ' s Delve . A ruined dwarven stronghold that contained an inactive portal to Alaron isle . Dynnegall . This small village on the edge of Lac Dynnegall was known primarily as a place to harvest peat . Kork . A village on the eastern shore of Moray , the population was supported by Amn . The village was too far from the island ' s moonwells to attract much attention from the Black Blood Tribe . History . As of the late 1400s , the southern half of the Moray was under the influence of the Black Blood Tribe , a sect of the People of the Black Blood . Geography . Moray lay to the south of Norland , west of Gwynneth , and north of Flamsterd .

title: Morbeoth
description: Morbeoth Morbeoth was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Morbeoth was a proud and prickly individual .
description_long: Morbeoth Morbeoth was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Morbeoth was a proud and prickly individual . He felt that his mastery of arcane power put him above anyone weaker . He resented that a mere druid was chosen to serve as the Prophet of Water , and that an ugly monster like a sea hag served as the cult ' s second - in - command . He would waste no time agreeing to help kill the leadership of the cult in order to later emerge as its new leader . Activities . Morbeoth was a great experimenter in the field of elemental magic . History . In 1491 DR , Morbeoth was in charge of the western part of the temple , where he had his workshop with some minions . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated him and his minions .

title: Mordai Vell
description: Mordai Vell Mordai Vell was a tiefling and the leader of the Ashmadai cult in New Neverwinter . Personality . He was charming and manipulative and had a hand in many of the goings - on in Neverwinter .
description_long: Mordai Vell Mordai Vell was a tiefling and the leader of the Ashmadai cult in New Neverwinter . Personality . He was charming and manipulative and had a hand in many of the goings - on in Neverwinter . Description . Mordai had golden eyes which was uncommon for tieflings .

title: Mordak Brelliar
description: Mordak Brelliar Mordak Brelliar is the current apprentice of First Lord Maalthiir , often serving the role as his most prolific agent . Mordak believes that the powers of Hillsfar should align with the Zhentarim , believing their combined power capable of reigning over the entire Moonsea . Appearance .
description_long: Mordak Brelliar Mordak Brelliar is the current apprentice of First Lord Maalthiir , often serving the role as his most prolific agent . Mordak believes that the powers of Hillsfar should align with the Zhentarim , believing their combined power capable of reigning over the entire Moonsea . Appearance . It has been said that Mordak resembles a younger , less charismatic version of Khelben Arunsun . History . Despite the possibilities of Mordak ' s ambitious scheme , his master did not share this view , not wanting to bow to Manshoon and the other Zhents . Mordak planned for years to eventually overthrow the First Lord , though he eventually caught wind of the plans . When the time came for Mordak to enact his treacherous coup , Maalthiir stopped his apprentice and reversed the attack . Maalthiir ' s powerful magics put Mordak directly under his control ; among these were " dominate person " , " geas " and " suggestion " . Mordak is now unwillingly and unwaveringly faithful to his master , unable to progress by any of his own means .

title: Mordenkainen
description: Mordenkainen Mordenkainen was a prolific archmage from the world of Oerth who was responsible for many powerful and useful spells . Description . His hair and beard were both long , black and peppered with grey streaks .
description_long: Mordenkainen Mordenkainen was a prolific archmage from the world of Oerth who was responsible for many powerful and useful spells . Description . His hair and beard were both long , black and peppered with grey streaks . When mad , his eyes crackled with eldritch power . Personality . Typically stubborn and one who doesn ' t suffer fools gladly , Mordenkainen can be difficult even with his friends . While suffering from his madness , he was convinced that enemies were everywhere and he was being constantly watched by evil agents . Relationships . Mordenkainen was an acquaintance of Elminster Aumar ; the two met on numerous occasions at Ed Greenwood ' s house on Earth to exchange spells and lore . History . Although Mordenkainen resided primarily on Oerth , by at least 1367 DR , his spells were not uncommon among spellbooks in Faerûn . Mordenkainen later traveled to Barovia in an attempt to free the local population from its vampire darklord Strahd . However , he underestimated Strahd ' s power and , after barely surviving a confrontation with him , he lost his spellbook and his staff , eventually losing his memory and being driven to the brink of madness .

title: Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound
description: Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound is a conjuration spell that summons a phantom dog for defense and attack . It was presumably developed by the mage Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as faithful hound , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound is a conjuration spell that summons a phantom dog for defense and attack . It was presumably developed by the mage Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as faithful hound , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effect . You conjure up a phantom watchdog that is invisible to everyone but yourself . It then guards the area where it was conjured . The phantom watchdog immediately starts barking loudly if any Small or larger creature approaches within 30 feet of it . ( Those already within 30 feet of the hound when it is conjured may move about in the area , but if they leave and return , they activate the barking . ) The hound sees invisible and ethereal creatures . It does not react to figments , but it does react to shadow illusion s . It is stationary . If an intruder approaches to within 5 feet of the watchdog , the dog stops barking and delivers a vicious bite ( + 10 attack bonus , 2d6 + 3 points of damage ) once per round . The dog also gets the bonuses appropriate to an invisible creature .

title: Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion
description: Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion is a conjuration spell that creates a door leading to an extradimensional mansion . It is one of many spells presumably developed by the prolific Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as magnificient mansion , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion is a conjuration spell that creates a door leading to an extradimensional mansion . It is one of many spells presumably developed by the prolific Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as magnificient mansion , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects . You conjure up an extradimensional dwelling that has a single entrance on the plane from which the spell was cast . The entry point looks like a faint shimmering in the air that is 4 feet wide and 8 feet high . Only those you designate may enter the mansion , and the portal is shut and made invisible behind you when you enter . You may open it again from your own side at will . Once observers have passed beyond the entrance , they are in a magnificent foyer with numerous chambers beyond . The atmosphere is clean , fresh , and warm . You can create any floor plan you desire to the limit of the spell ' s effect . The place is furnished and contains sufficient foodstuffs to serve a nine - course banquet to a dozen people per caster level .

title: Mordoc SeLanmere
description: Mordoc SeLanmere Mordoc SeLanmere , also known as the Pale Knight or the White Prince , was the self - proclaimed first and utmost powerful vampire king in all of Toril . Mordoc was the disciple of Eldrith the Betrayer , he , however , was not a loyal servant to her . He did provide to her slaves and members for her army .
description_long: Mordoc SeLanmere Mordoc SeLanmere , also known as the Pale Knight or the White Prince , was the self - proclaimed first and utmost powerful vampire king in all of Toril . Mordoc was the disciple of Eldrith the Betrayer , he , however , was not a loyal servant to her . He did provide to her slaves and members for her army . Bio . Battle of Bones and Keep of Pale Night . Mordoc , after becoming the king of the Vampires , led his army of Vampires , Nightwalker s and Nightshades into the Battle of Bones where they began to thrive . Just outside , or at the edge , of the Battle , Mordoc built the Keep of Pale Night where his Vampire Servants lived with him . At a time , the assassin Karne was sent to kill him , however , Mordoc defeated Karne in battle and appeared to kill him . Karne however , had found his mortal enemy and had feigned his death . Mordoc then pledged his alligence to Eldrith the Betrayer , though his true masters lay in Mulhorand . Mordoc ' s ultimate goal was the destroy the city of Baldur ' s Gate and through Eldrith , he hoped to achieve this . He assisted Eldrith by supplying the troops of the Dark Alliance .

title: Mordoc Torsilley
description: Mordoc Torsilley Mordoc Torsilley was the captain of the elite Company of the White Dragon of the City Guard of Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . When the hordes of Myrkul invaded the city , he was ordered by Piergeiron to enlist the help of Khelben Arunsun and fight the undead .
