title: Mordulkin
description: Mordulkin Mordulkin was a wealthy mage - ruled city - state on the Bay of Chessenta in Chessenta in the Old Empires . Geography . Mordulkin stood upon the eastern shore of the Bay of Chessenta , a short distance north of the polluted Jade River that flowed down out of the Riders to the Sky Mountains .
description_long: Mordulkin Mordulkin was a wealthy mage - ruled city - state on the Bay of Chessenta in Chessenta in the Old Empires . Geography . Mordulkin stood upon the eastern shore of the Bay of Chessenta , a short distance north of the polluted Jade River that flowed down out of the Riders to the Sky Mountains . History . Early history . Formerly a possession of the empire of Unther , Mordulkin was among the cities that rebelled and formed the Alliance of Chessenta under the leadership of the warlord Tchazzar of Cimbar . Driving Untheric forces from the land , they seceded from Unther in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . The first ruler of the liberated city was Soldim Jedea , the most capable mage of the Jedea family , a practice that continued ever since . Soldim later founded the Jedea Academy , a school for magic . Thereafter , Mordulkin stood as a part of the Union of Chessenta , a confederation of city - state that swelled into the Chessentan Empire ruled by Tchazzar . However , with Tchazzar ' s death or disappearance in the Year of the Dracorage , 1018 DR , the Empire broke apart and declined .

title: Morgalla
description: Morgalla Morgalla , known as Morgalla the Mirthful , was a dwarven entertainer from Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains . She was an artist specializing in satirical cartoons . Description .
description_long: Morgalla Morgalla , known as Morgalla the Mirthful , was a dwarven entertainer from Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains . She was an artist specializing in satirical cartoons . Description . Morgalla was young and beardless . She had brown eyes and russet braids . She was about four feet tall and usually wore simple clothes . Relationships . Morgalla was a member of Clan Chistlesmith and the daughter ( or " darl " ) of Olam Chistlesmith and Thendara Spearsinger , a captain of the hearth guard of Earthfast . History . Born around 1310 DR , growing up in orc - besieged Earthfast , Morgalla said her mother taught her to fight with a staff almost as soon as she could stand . Morgalla took an apprenticeship in the Chistlesmith trade of woodcarving , but retained an interest in songs and stories , and had a desire for adventure . On the rare occasion the dwarves gathered in the great clan hall for entertainments , Morgalla earned fame for singing , storytelling , and dancing . Finally , in mid - autumn of the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR , the rogue princess Alusair Obarskyr came to the Earthfast Mountains and found Earthfast .

title: Morgan Ildacer
description: Morgan Ildacer Morgan Ildacer was the aquatic elf captain of the High Mages ' guard in Sylkiir and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Morgan was an ill - tempered and over - arrogant elf .
description_long: Morgan Ildacer Morgan Ildacer was the aquatic elf captain of the High Mages ' guard in Sylkiir and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Morgan was an ill - tempered and over - arrogant elf . He respected only power and martial skills . So , inside the Council , he was influenced only by Nalos and the shalarin Ri ' ola ' kirk . He hated the Lusos clan . Activities . Despite Morgan ' s objections , Myth Nantar was garrisoned also with troops from other Selu ' Maraar ' s military units .

title: Morganis Andropoea
description: Morganis Andropoea Morganis Andropoea was a medusa shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Morganis lived with her husband Holmyrr until , in 1340 DR , an adventuring party ambushed them and killed Holmyrr .
description_long: Morganis Andropoea Morganis Andropoea was a medusa shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Morganis lived with her husband Holmyrr until , in 1340 DR , an adventuring party ambushed them and killed Holmyrr . Morganis managed to escape to Skullport , where she started a shop selling the statues she created . Morganis usually bought slaves at the slavers market and petrified them , ready to be sold .

title: Morglon - Daar
description: Morglon - Daar Morglon - Daar was a city near the Blood Rift in the Abyss . History . For years , a human merchant Oroch controlled a portal which linked Scornubel to Morglon - Daar , but after disappearing on an adventure , Tarnrose , a drow wizard and her gang took up residence over the gateway .

title: Morgur ' s Mound
description: Morgur ' s Mound Morgur ' s Mound was the ancestor mound of the Thunderbeast tribe of the Uthgardt . It was believed to be the burial site of Morgur , Uthgar ' s mortal brother . Atop the mound was the skeleton of a long - dead dinosaur , known as a " thunderbeast " by the Uthgardt .
description_long: Morgur ' s Mound Morgur ' s Mound was the ancestor mound of the Thunderbeast tribe of the Uthgardt . It was believed to be the burial site of Morgur , Uthgar ' s mortal brother . Atop the mound was the skeleton of a long - dead dinosaur , known as a " thunderbeast " by the Uthgardt . Rumors said that Thunderbeast shamans could animate the apatosaurus when their tribe was in dire need of protection . When the Thunderbeast visited the mound for Runemeet late in the 15th century DR , they found that the mound had been dug up , both skeletons and the treasure within stolen .

title: Morhion Gen ' dahar
description: Morhion Gen ' dahar Morhion Gen ' dahar was known to many as the greatest wizard in the city of Iriaebor . Appearance . Morhion was tall , regal and handsome , with a long mane of golden hair .
description_long: Morhion Gen ' dahar Morhion Gen ' dahar was known to many as the greatest wizard in the city of Iriaebor . Appearance . Morhion was tall , regal and handsome , with a long mane of golden hair . On the palm of his left hand he had an old scar , a mark known as the Rune of Magic .

title: Moria Chantel
description: Moria Chantel Moria Chantel was an evil mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Moria Chantel had a practice of kidnapping travellers near Phantom Pass , for use in a ceremony that bestowed immortality on the mage . After hearing a haunting tale of this , the commander of the Legendary Campaign decided to deal with Moria .
description_long: Moria Chantel Moria Chantel was an evil mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Moria Chantel had a practice of kidnapping travellers near Phantom Pass , for use in a ceremony that bestowed immortality on the mage . After hearing a haunting tale of this , the commander of the Legendary Campaign decided to deal with Moria . They timed their arrival in Phantom Pass to suit the needs of the ceremony and disguising themselves as suitable victims , only to confront the mage in bloodforge battle .

title: Moriann Obarskyr
description: Moriann Obarskyr King Moriann Obarskyr was king of Cormyr before Tharyann Obarskyr . Moriann took the throne in 147 DR after the death of his father Irbruin and older brother Faerlthind . He and all of his heirs perished in a battle with goblin s from Hlundadim in 201 DR .

title: Morik the Rogue
description: Morik the Rogue Morik the Rogue is a friend of Wulfgar , living in the town of Luskan . He is nearly executed by the Luskan authorities for a crime not committed , the murder of Deudermont . Despite his small stature , Morik rose through the ranks of criminals on the streets of Luskan , eventually becoming feared and respected as both a thief and a fighter .
description_long: Morik the Rogue Morik the Rogue is a friend of Wulfgar , living in the town of Luskan . He is nearly executed by the Luskan authorities for a crime not committed , the murder of Deudermont . Despite his small stature , Morik rose through the ranks of criminals on the streets of Luskan , eventually becoming feared and respected as both a thief and a fighter . He prefers to fight using two daggers , wielding one in each hand . Role in the Story . Morik ' s first appearance is in The Silent Blade . After Wulfgar fights with Tree - Block Breaker , the toughest fighter on Half Moon Street , Morik attempts to kill him off with a glass of poison . His attempt is foiled by Delly Curtie , Wulfgars future wife . Not long after this , Morik is approached by the drow elf Kimmuriel Oblodra , lieutenant of the mercenary group Bregan D ' aerthe . He pays Morik to keep an eye on Wulfgar . Morik next appears in The Spine of the World . He and Wulfgar are now good friends . The book starts with two drinking near the docks when two would - be muggers come along . Morik and Wulfgar quickly defeat the two and leave the scene .

title: Morissa Thornion
description: Morissa Thornion Morissa Thornion was an archivist in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Morissa managed the Thornion archives in the city of Timindar .
description_long: Morissa Thornion Morissa Thornion was an archivist in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Morissa managed the Thornion archives in the city of Timindar . Often Lord Reland Tymin asked her help in settle disputes . History . Morissa in 1358 hid her sister Durissa Thornion , went back in Timindar full of revenge . Later under advise of Durissa she left the city Personality . Moriisa was a very kind individual , the most trusted person of the village , no able to harm even a fly . Her only weakness was talked too much about her preferred topics , one of them was the legend about the Black Skull . Relationship . Morissa and Durissa Thornion were the daughter of the town mage . She protected always Durissa despite all .

title: Morista Malkin
description: Morista Malkin Morista Malkin was a scout and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Rage of Demons . History . Morista hailed from Luruar but responded to Bruenor ' s call to liberate Gauntlgrym from evil in 1485 DR .
description_long: Morista Malkin Morista Malkin was a scout and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Rage of Demons . History . Morista hailed from Luruar but responded to Bruenor ' s call to liberate Gauntlgrym from evil in 1485 DR . After the victory , she acted as an adviser to King Bruenor . She also trained elite scouts to move in the dark recesses of the Underdark . Morista was chosen as the Emerald Enclave ' s delegate to King Bruenor Battlehammer to discuss the madness spreading in the Underdark . Personality . Morista always tried to balance her loyalties to her people and king and to nature . She believed her duty was to protect dwarves from the dangers of the Underdark , but she also reminded them of its natural beauty . Morista admired and respected King Bruenor .

title: Morkai the Red
description: Morkai the Red Morkai the Red was a powerful wizard and the guardian of the North Tower of the Host Tower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan . He was murdered by his apprentice Akar Kessel on the command of Dendybar the Mottled and his associates in the Host Tower . Morkai the Red now dwells on the spirit plane .

title: Morkoth
description: Morkoth Morkoths were known as wraiths of the deep , a cruel and evil race of aquatic predators with hypnotic powers . Description . Early descriptions of morkoths were vague and suggested they were humanoid , but as these mysterious creatures got involved in the affairs of other races , a more accurate picture emerged .
description_long: Morkoth Morkoths were known as wraiths of the deep , a cruel and evil race of aquatic predators with hypnotic powers . Description . Early descriptions of morkoths were vague and suggested they were humanoid , but as these mysterious creatures got involved in the affairs of other races , a more accurate picture emerged . Most morkoths had a wide mouth with many sharp teeth visible even when the mouth was closed . A few had beaks like a squid , which was one reason why some descriptions were inconsistent . Adding to the confusion , they had legs like a lobster protruding from their midsection and eight octopus - like tentacles making up the lower half of their body . Down the center of their back was a dorsal fin and they had large , bulging eyes . Young adult morkoths were about 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) long , but older specimens could grow larger . Their skin was black with patches of luminescence that glowed faintly in the deep gloom . Personality . Morkoths were generally solitary and viewed most other races with disdain , suspicion , or complete indifference . They valued almost nothing except food .

title: Morligul Downdagger
description: Morligul Downdagger Morligul Downdagger was a wizard - for - hire in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Morligul together with his partner Scarmar Heldeth was searching around Lord Helderstone ' s rooms .
description_long: Morligul Downdagger Morligul Downdagger was a wizard - for - hire in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Morligul together with his partner Scarmar Heldeth was searching around Lord Helderstone ' s rooms . However Elminster Aumar found them and recognizing Downdagger decided to capture him . quickly Morligul escaped . El at last found Morligul at a meeting with Lord Traevyn Illance . Elminster managed to knock down Morligul and posing as him met the noble .

title: Morlith ( family )
description: Morlith ( family ) The Morlith family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Mornbryn ' s Shield
description: Mornbryn ' s Shield Mornbryn ' s Shield was a hamlet on the north bank of the River Surbrin and the Laughingflow . The hamlet was named for the ranger Mornbryn and its location — the village sat on a natural rampart enclosing the west and south sides of the settlement .

title: Morndin
description: Morndin The Morndin ( Son of Moradin , in Dwarvish ) were dwarves that , according to tradition , were reincarnated in members of other humanoid races after they died , in order to fulfill specific tasks Moradin could not entrust to a member of the dwarven races . Notable Members . The only known Morndin were members of Clan Ironstar .

title: Morndin Gloomstorm
description: Morndin Gloomstorm Morndin Gloomstorm was the high cleric of Laduguer in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR and 1372 DR History . Morndin was born to Clan Bukbukken , as the son of Kildor and blood of Balgor , in Shimmergloom ' s Run in Mithral Hall . Morndin lived under the shadow dragon Shimmergloom ' s rule until the shield dwarves of Clan Battlehammer reclaimed their ancestral home .
description_long: Morndin Gloomstorm Morndin Gloomstorm was the high cleric of Laduguer in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR and 1372 DR History . Morndin was born to Clan Bukbukken , as the son of Kildor and blood of Balgor , in Shimmergloom ' s Run in Mithral Hall . He was one of the few surviving members of his clan to manage to escape to Gracklstugh . There , Morndin become high priest of the local temple of Laduguer .

title: Morndinsamman
description: Morndinsamman Morndinsamman ( dwarven : " shield brothers on high " or " high dwarves " ) was the collective name of the fourteen deities that formed the dwarven pantheon . The members were : The majority of the Morndinsamman resided in Dwarfhome ( when it was still located on Mount Celestia ) under the leadership of Moradin , creator of the dwarves . Duerra and Laduguer lived in Hammergrim , having been exiled by Moradin .
description_long: Morndinsamman Morndinsamman ( dwarven : " shield brothers on high " or " high dwarves " ) was the collective name of the fourteen deities that formed the dwarven pantheon . The members were : The majority of the Morndinsamman resided in Dwarfhome ( when it was still located on Mount Celestia ) under the leadership of Moradin , creator of the dwarves . Duerra and Laduguer lived in Hammergrim , having been exiled by Moradin . In 1383 DR , Moradin led the Morndinsamman on a crusade against the dark powers of Hammergrim , slaying Duerra and Laduguer , but at the cost of Gorm and Haela . As of 1479 DR , only Moradin , Berronar , Clangeddin , Dugmaren , Marthammor , Thard and Vergadain remains in Dwarfhome . Abbathor is serving Bane as an exarch and the status of Dumathoin and Sharindlar is unknown .

title: Morning Halls
description: Morning Halls The Morning Halls was a temple to Lathander , the Morninglord , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The Morning Halls lay in the northern part of the city , on Ember Lane .
description_long: Morning Halls The Morning Halls was a temple to Lathander , the Morninglord , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The Morning Halls lay in the northern part of the city , on Ember Lane . History . During the Time of Troubles of the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , the deity Torm resided at his temple in Tantras . Torm ' s zealous priests began persecuting followers of other faiths in the city as " unbelievers " . Although normally very busy , the Morning Halls was almost completely deserted as a result of the divine strife in the Realms . Nevertheless , the Morning Halls remained active through to 1367 DR and past 1370 DR . Inhabitants . In 1358 DR , the temple was led by High Morninglord Alansyn Ambrilar , with fourteen priests and twenty - one lay - followers .

title: Morning star
description: Morning star A morning star ( also " morningstar " ) is a simple , one - handed melee weapon , essentially a large , spiked club . Description . The morning star is very similar to a spiked club but with refinements .
description_long: Morning star A morning star ( also " morningstar " ) is a simple , one - handed melee weapon , essentially a large , spiked club . Description . The morning star is very similar to a spiked club but with refinements . The shaft is usually made of wood and longer than a heavy mace . The head is typically round and covered in metal set with about twenty spikes radiating like a star . The biggest spike extends straight from the top of the weapon . An average morning star costs 8gp and weighs 6lbs ( 2 . 7kg ) . Use . The morning star normally used one - handed and does both bludgeoning and piercing damage . It is a simple weapon that does not require any training for most character classes . Realmslore . Few , if any , deities use the morning star as their favored weapon today , although the dead power Girru once did .

title: Morningdawn Hall
description: Morningdawn Hall Even Lathander might blush at the ostentation of his temple in the town of Shadowdale . The building is a miracle of unbreakable rose - tinted glass blown into the shape of a giant phoenix facing west with outstretched wings greeting the dawn . Its wings become two great turrets which command a view of the surrounding area .
description_long: Morningdawn Hall Even Lathander might blush at the ostentation of his temple in the town of Shadowdale . The building is a miracle of unbreakable rose - tinted glass blown into the shape of a giant phoenix facing west with outstretched wings greeting the dawn . Its wings become two great turrets which command a view of the surrounding area . The head and neck of the great bird contain sleeping rooms and offices . Its back ( eastern side ) is translucent , rose - tinted glass that allows the morning light to stream into the great Hall during services . History . Bane himself destroyed the first version of Morningdawn Hall during the Time of Troubles . Lathander ’ s zealous clergy then recreated it in every detail – to the private dismay of Shadowdale ’ s residents , who think highly of Lathander himself but not so well of the priests who have raised this gaudy monstrosity in their town . A couple of days after the Zhentarim invasion in Hammer of 1375 DR , Morningdawn Hall was once again destroyed . This time in a great fire . The clergy of Lathander were all killed or forced to flee the village of Shadowdale .

title: Morninggold
description: Morninggold Morninggold was the easternmost county of Tethyr , located within the Golden Marches . Geography . County Morninggold was located in the western foothills of the Kuldin Peaks and was bordered in the north and west by the Shining Stream and in the south by the Idolflow and its tributary , the Levast River .
description_long: Morninggold Morninggold was the easternmost county of Tethyr , located within the Golden Marches . Geography . County Morninggold was located in the western foothills of the Kuldin Peaks and was bordered in the north and west by the Shining Stream and in the south by the Idolflow and its tributary , the Levast River . Its neighboring counties were Valashar , Hazamarch , and Surkazar . Government . In 1362 DR , the county was ruled , until the end of the Tethyrian Interregnum , by Zaranda Star . When she became queen of all Tethyr in 1369 DR , power over the county passed to Aalangama Gulderhorn , who was also Title Chancellor of the kingdom . However , her power over the region was not strong , and at times it seemed that the monster races of the area — gnoll s , ogre s , and troll s — had more control . History . The county , which used to belong to the Gulderhorn family , was purchased from the Order of the Silver Chalice in 1362 DR or 1364 DR by Zaranda Star . The order was nearly wiped out during the First Siege of Myratma .

title: Morninglark
description: Morninglark The Morninglark was a magical elven harp that could only be operated through spellsong . Description . The Morninglark a 20 - stringed harp was made of dark wood marked with carvings of elven origin .
description_long: Morninglark The Morninglark was a magical elven harp that could only be operated through spellsong . Description . The Morninglark a 20 - stringed harp was made of dark wood marked with carvings of elven origin . Of particular note was a carving of a morninglark , which moved to the music played on the harp . History . Some time during or prior to 1364 DR , the Morninglark was in the hands of an elven bard named Ingrival who was in the village of Taskerleigh near Waterdeep when it was attacked by the green dragon Grimnoshtadrano , who carried the harp to his lair . Ingrival was the sole survivor of the attack , but went mad in the process . Soon thereafter , the harp was sought by the half - elven sorceress Iriador Wintermist ( " Garnet " ) , who used it to place a curse intended to take revenge on the Harpers . The curse consisted of the following elements : 1 ) Changing the songs of bards without their awareness , 2 ) causing crops to wither and die , 3 ) controlling monsters who used music for a weapon , and 4 ) influencing crowds through song .

title: Morninglord
description: Morninglord Morninglords , formerly known as morninglords of Lathander , are a priestly order of Faerûn . The morninglords of Amaunator and his aspect Lathander are among the Sun Lord ' s most elite priest s . They are dedicated to heal , advise , protect people and destroy the undead .
description_long: Morninglord Morninglords , formerly known as morninglords of Lathander , are a priestly order of Faerûn . The morninglords of Amaunator and his aspect Lathander are among the Sun Lord ' s most elite priest s . They are dedicated to heal , advise , protect people and destroy the undead . Very often they are travelling preachers who bring the glory of the sun in all dark places of the world and increase people ' s respect of their church . Culture . Morninglords were initially known as the Morninglords of Lathander , reflecting their devotion to Lathander , at the time believed a god rather than his true form , an aspect of the Netherese greater god Amaunator . Since the Spellplague the truth has been revealed but the effects of Amaunator ' s time as Lathander have left their mark , both on the god and his followers . In addition to the Sunmaster s who have devoted themselves since the beginning to Lathander as Amaunator , the Morninglords continue to venerate their god as they always have , carrying on the traditions of their god ' s " youth . " More than Sunmasters , Morninglords draw on the optimistic spirit of Amaunator ' s Lathander aspect .

title: Morningmist Hall
description: Morningmist Hall Morningmist Hall was a temple to Lathander in Marsember , Cormyr . Inhabitants . It was led by High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen and was served by 16 priests and 12 other staff members .
description_long: Morningmist Hall Morningmist Hall was a temple to Lathander in Marsember , Cormyr . Inhabitants . It was led by High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen and was served by 16 priests and 12 other staff members . Description . It was described by Orblin of Hlondeth as " a bright light of hope in the dark heart of decadent Marsember . " It was situated on one of the city ' s sandy islands near its centre . The walls of the hall were constantly lit by magical " faerie fire " .

title: Morningstar Hollows
description: Morningstar Hollows Morningstar Hollows used to be a quiet village until the continual flooding of the Alaoreum River caused its inhabitants to abandon it and move to nearby Velorn ' s Valor . The land where the village is situated is now very boggy and it is believed to be inhabited by around three dozen lizardfolk .
description_long: Morningstar Hollows Morningstar Hollows used to be a quiet village until the continual flooding of the Alaoreum River caused its inhabitants to abandon it and move to nearby Velorn ' s Valor . The land where the village is situated is now very boggy and it is believed to be inhabited by around three dozen lizardfolk .

title: Morntel
description: Morntel Morntel was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was named after his father in Athkatla and inherited both his fortune and his membership of the Knights in 1356 DR .
description_long: Morntel Morntel was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was named after his father in Athkatla and inherited both his fortune and his membership of the Knights in 1356 DR . He was an able caravan leader and weapons merchant based in Crimmor . In his continuous travels up and down the Sword Coast , Morntel gathered a lot of useful information for the Knights , was appreciated by both Pehllus Tanislove and Barasta Cleeith . Despite being an employee of House Zoar , Morntel acted as the ears and eyes of Lady Zharnn Ophal in Crimmor but in truth he hoped to influence local politics in order to increase the power of the Knights . Strangely , in 1369 DR , Morntel repeatedly visited the Blais House in Westgate , a fact noted by his fellow Knight Piyrathur . The truth was that Morntel ' s father contacted him and explain to him to had faked his death in 1356 in order to escape from a group of slavers Knights that menace his life . By 1369 Morntel the Elder , now based in Sigil , was ready to have his revenge and the son loyally collaborated to his father ' s plots .

title: Morntel the Elder
description: Morntel the Elder Morntel the Elder was a merchant of Amn and an ex - member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was a wealthy merchant in Athkatla , working for House Redolo .
description_long: Morntel the Elder Morntel the Elder was a merchant of Amn and an ex - member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was a wealthy merchant in Athkatla , working for House Redolo . In 1356 DR , he was reported to have been killed by a magic attack or by a demonic creature , but unknown to most , this was only a ruse . In truth , Morntel had discovered some Knights involved in the slave traffic to Calimshan and tried to stop the slaving operation , which was too cruel for his tastes . However , the only result was that the slaver Knights threatened to kill him . So he faked his death and fled to Sigil in Concordant Opposition . It was only in 1369 DR that Morntel reestablished contact with his son , also called Morntel , meeting at the Blais House in Westgate , where they started making plans for his revenge .

title: Morok Ulgren
description: Morok Ulgren Morok Ulgren was an orc blacksmith in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . Activities . Morok was the most highly skilled orcish blacksmith in the entirety of Many - Arrows , making him the most prominent trade figure in the kingdom .
description_long: Morok Ulgren Morok Ulgren was an orc blacksmith in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . Activities . Morok was the most highly skilled orcish blacksmith in the entirety of Many - Arrows , making him the most prominent trade figure in the kingdom . He was trained by dwarf blacksmiths in Sundabar , and stood as a living testament to the growth that could come from peace between the orcs and other races . He was a staunch advocate of Obould XVII and Lorgru ' s plans for continued peace , and provided their personal guard with iron weapons and armor .

title: Mortal Consequences
description: Mortal Consequences Mortal Consequences is the third book in the Netheril trilogy by Clayton Emery . Summary . Sunbright has been banished long enough .
description_long: Mortal Consequences Mortal Consequences is the third book in the Netheril trilogy by Clayton Emery . Summary . Sunbright has been banished long enough . He decides to return to his people and face his accusers , even if it means his death . Yet , ironically , he can ' t find his people for the longest while . And when he does , they ' re in such dire straits he can ' t abandon them , but must sacrifice his wishes to drag them kicking and screaming to a better place . It ' s courageous to fight bad guys . It ' s more courageous to face up to the bullies of your youth . But it ' s the ultimate in courage to put all your feelings aside , forgive your most undeserving enemies , and do what ' s right for your people . It doing that , Sunbright morphs from a mere warrior to something far greater - a leader .

title: Morthil
description: Morthil Morthil was the recipient of one of Ithraides ' s telkiira . Later he become the Grand Mage of Yuireshanyaar becoming a key player in that kingdom for several centuries . He also founded a long - standing society of wizards known as the Seneirril Tathyrr , or the Mooncrescent Order
description_long: Morthil Morthil was the recipient of one of Ithraides ' s telkiira . Later he become the Grand Mage of Yuireshanyaar becoming a key player in that kingdom for several centuries . He also founded a long - standing society of wizards known as the Seneirril Tathyrr , or the Mooncrescent Order

title: Mortick Swamp
description: Mortick Swamp The Mortick Swamp ( also spelled Mortik Swamp ) was the only swamp in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . The Mortick Swamp was located in southern Luiren , just to the southeast of Chethel .
description_long: Mortick Swamp The Mortick Swamp ( also spelled Mortik Swamp ) was the only swamp in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . The Mortick Swamp was located in southern Luiren , just to the southeast of Chethel . It lay along Luirenstrand in the Great Sea . A road skirted the swamp ' s land boundaries to connect Chethel to Krenadir . Inhabitants . The forest was inhabited by monsters , namely merrow and scrag s , which often raided nearby lands . History . In 148 DR , merrow from Mortick Swamp attacked the halfling settlement of Chethel , destroying half of the city . In 1372 DR , an ogre shaman known as the Bog King led the merrow and used the scrags for his own purposes .

title: Mortuth Baldreth
description: Mortuth Baldreth Mortuth Baldreth was a traveling merchant that dealt in wagons , wagon wheels , cart wheels , lanterns , and large tools such as pick s , woodcutting axe s , and shovels . Abilities . Mortuth was extremely strong and a specialist with the longsword .
description_long: Mortuth Baldreth Mortuth Baldreth was a traveling merchant that dealt in wagons , wagon wheels , cart wheels , lanterns , and large tools such as pick s , woodcutting axe s , and shovels . Abilities . Mortuth was extremely strong and a specialist with the longsword . Possessions . His possessions included his wares and other business property . He wore splint mail and carried a shield when he felt the need to protect himself . Activities . Mortuth was an agent of the Zhentarim that traveled to Voonlar as part of his itinerary . He gathered intelligence and kept an eye on Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl and his deputies , occasionally making suggestions that were carried out like orders .

title: Morueme ' s Cave
description: Morueme ' s Cave Morueme ' s Cave was the home of the blue dragon clan the Blood of Morueme located in the Nether Mountains . Geography . The cave was located on the edge of the Anauroch Desert on the mountain known as Dragondoom .
description_long: Morueme ' s Cave Morueme ' s Cave was the home of the blue dragon clan the Blood of Morueme located in the Nether Mountains . Geography . The cave was located on the edge of the Anauroch Desert on the mountain known as Dragondoom . Description . Nearly five dragon s occupied the caves . Each dragon protected his own treasure sided by their faithful hobgoblin servants . The Caves had many traps , carefully placed to deal with human s . Most were rockfalls , in which rocks were linked together with chains . Moreover , the caves had some sharp bends where the Moruemes took advantage of cover . History . The caves have been the home for the clan for at least a thousand years . For many years , the Moruemes were ruled by Kizilpazar , the ancient blue patriarch of the clan . In 1371 DR , his ambitious sons , Nahaunglaroth and Roraurim , betrayed and destroyed him .

title: Morus Brokengulf II
description: Morus Brokengulf II Morus Brokengulf II was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Morus II was , from the age of 16 , a devoted paladin and Tyrran zealot , even cutting off his right hand in sacrifice to Tyr and soon joining the Knights of Samular .
description_long: Morus Brokengulf II Morus Brokengulf II was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Morus II was , from the age of 16 , a devoted paladin and Tyrran zealot , even cutting off his right hand in sacrifice to Tyr and soon joining the Knights of Samular . After a long time hunting evil throughout the Sword Coast , the death of Lord Morus Brokengulf I forced Morus II to become the next patriarch of the Brokengulf family . However , after some months of work , Morus II was greatly frustrated and turned over day - to - day operations of the family business to fellow Knight Gareth Cormaeril , and again set out to fight evil . Morus II sometimes returned to the city but spent most of his time fighting monsters and hunting Claugiyliamatar , the old enemy of his family .

title: Morvar
description: Morvar Morvar was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Morvar was located along the west bank of the River Lesh where it emptied into the Golden Water in eastern Durpar near the base of the Gryphon Mountains .
description_long: Morvar Morvar was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Morvar was located along the west bank of the River Lesh where it emptied into the Golden Water in eastern Durpar near the base of the Gryphon Mountains . Description . Morvar was filled with smithies and weaving warehouses . All cotton grown south of the Ajmer Forest was brought to Morvar for production . Additonally , lumber from the forest made its way here as well . Inhabitants . Morvar had of population of 20 , 000 , including the most racially mixed blend of inhabitants in any city of the Shining Lands . The city had strong trade relationships with the Ulgarthian city of Surbar across the Golden Water .

title: Morvian
description: Morvian Morvian was a magic al greatsword and one of the Baneblades of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , and was the third of his series of Baneblades .
description_long: Morvian Morvian was a magic al greatsword and one of the Baneblades of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , and was the third of his series of Baneblades . Uses . When drawn from its scabbard , this Baneblade of Demron glowed with a fierce yellow light like that of the sun . Morvian had the standard properties of all baneblades , and it was also an axiomatic weapon that allowed its wielder to use the " daylight " spell . Notes . Unlike its predecessors , Morvian was not limited to users of a single race . The only restriction upon its use was the wielder must be of lawful good alignment .

title: Morwen Daggerford
description: Morwen Daggerford Morwen Daggerford was the sister of the duke of Daggerford around 1485 DR and later duke herself the following year . Activities . Morwen usually trained with the militia and paid regular visits to the shrine of Tempus .
description_long: Morwen Daggerford Morwen Daggerford was the sister of the duke of Daggerford around 1485 DR and later duke herself the following year . Activities . Morwen usually trained with the militia and paid regular visits to the shrine of Tempus . She was the Master of Arms of the duchy and the military commander of the castle but many believed her a better duke than Maldwyn Daggerford . History . Around 1486 DR , Morwen inherited the title from Maldwyn when the practice of primogeniture was suspended in the town of Daggerford . Personality . On the surface , Morwen was not an amiable person but in truth she had a noble heart . People believed her to be a more capable leader than Maldwyn and blamed the laws or primogeniture , but Morwen was content with her position .

title: Mosque of Beauteous Selan
description: Mosque of Beauteous Selan The Mosque of Beauteous Selan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Beauteous Selan The Mosque of Beauteous Selan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . Since Selan ' s worship was centered in Afyal , her mosque in Huzuz was one of the smaller houses of the great gods of Zakhara . Many of Selan ' s followers were gardeners and artists , making her mosque truly beautiful . Hanging plants and flowers decorated the temple walls . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Lelia was the head of the mosque . She supervised over 200 lesser ranking priests of Selan and other laymen . Activities . Skilled musicians contributed to Selan ' s religious ceremonies . Each month , during the full moon , the dome of the mosque would turn transparent . The moonlight flowing inside was concentrated on the main worship area , engulfing a statue of a pear tree . The statue would blossom and flower before releasing its fruit . The fruit would float off of the tree , touching followers gathered for the ceremony . All those who were touched received a blessing of Selan , increasing their artistic ability . The effects of this blessing lasted until the next full moon .

title: Mosque of Blistering Atonement
description: Mosque of Blistering Atonement The Mosque of Blistering Atonement was located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Mosque of Blistering Atonement The Mosque of Blistering Atonement was located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description . As a dedicated shrine to Imix , a terrifying archomental of fire , the entire building was covered with corroded copper , creating a disquieting scene . Activities . Since Imix was a primordial prince of sinister creatures of fire , many efreeti and their legions revered him .

title: Mosque of Blood
description: Mosque of Blood The Mosque of Blood was the second - most - noticeable feature of the Zakhara n city of Qudra . Location . This crimson - covered mosque was the largest temple in the entire Land of Fate used to worship the warrior - god Vataqatal .
description_long: Mosque of Blood The Mosque of Blood was the second - most - noticeable feature of the Zakhara n city of Qudra . Location . This crimson - covered mosque was the largest temple in the entire Land of Fate used to worship the warrior - god Vataqatal . Structure . The walls of this mosque were made of regular sandstone but were coated regularly with henna to honor those who shed their blood in battle .

title: Mosque of Bountiful Jisan
description: Mosque of Bountiful Jisan The Mosque of Bountiful Jisan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Bountiful Jisan The Mosque of Bountiful Jisan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . This mosque was one of the most lavish of all the temples to Zakhara ' s great gods . Valuable tapestries , statues , and other symbols of wealth decorated the interior . The vault contained a veritable dragon ' s hoard of treasure . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Moral was the head of the mosque . He supervised over 250 lesser ranking priests of Jisan and other laymen . A tasked guardian genie and a dao watched over the mosque ' s vault . Activities . The mosque of Jisan lent money to well - qualified applicants . All visitors to the mosque were expected to make a donation to honor Jisan . Generous donations guaranteed one a fine seat for a ceremony . The bounty of Jisan concluded every ceremony . Priests summoned rain to moisten the faithful before servants brought food and wine for a feast . Proper form included only eating a little food during the feast . The faithful were encouraged to take food to give to beggars on their way home .

title: Mosque of Brave Hajama
description: Mosque of Brave Hajama The Mosque of Brave Hajama was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Brave Hajama The Mosque of Brave Hajama was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . The first floor of the mosque was the main worship area . This area was decorated with a pair of lions that were chained to the main door . It was widely rumored that the lions would attack anyone with fear in their heart . In truth , the lions were bored most of the time . The basement of the mosque housed the clerical brethren . The dome of the mosque opened to the sky , allowing the faithful a splendid view of the sunset . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Jomhur was the head of the mosque . He supervised around 200 lesser - ranking priests of Hajama and laymen . Activities . Since Hajama was a popular god in Huzuz , services in his mosque were well - attended .

title: Mosque of Free Haku
description: Mosque of Free Haku The Mosque of Free Haku was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Free Haku The Mosque of Free Haku was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . The mosque of Haku was open to the wind on the first floor , honoring Haku ' s preaching of freedom . This mosque did not have a dome , allowing worshipers to sleep on the roof where they could enjoy the nightly breezes . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Gholam ibn Jubair was the head of the mosque . He supervised around 200 lesser - ranking priests of Haku and other laymen .

title: Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest
description: Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest The Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest The Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Defenses . The entire structure of the mosque was enchanted so that one could not enter under false pretenses , including invisibility or wearing illusions . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Kerim was the head of the mosque . He supervised over 200 lesser ranking priests of Hakiyah and other laymen . Activities . Much of the worship and meditation that occurred in this mosque took place in smaller chambers as opposed to a large central worship area . The Soft Whisper used the basement of the mosque to plan their actions to protect the life of the Grand Caliph .

title: Mosque of Kor the Old
description: Mosque of Kor the Old The Mosque of Kor the Old was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Kor the Old The Mosque of Kor the Old was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . As with most mosques in Huzuz , the Mosque of Kor had two floors above ground and a basement below ground . The second floor was topped with a grand dome . The ground floor served as the main area of worship . Displays from the dancing dervish es were common here . Seats were present for other worshipers , but all true believers of Kor joined in the dance . A huge tapestry hung from the wall showing Kor bestowing wisdom upon the other Zakharan gods . All of the clerical brethren of the mosque were quartered in the basement . Laymen lived outside of the mosque . The second floor was open to the dome , providing an excellent view of an enchanted chandelier that hung from the top of dome . The chandelier was capable of playing music on command , though only the high priests were taught how to command the chandelier . Additionally , the chandelier would chime if an unenlightened individual entered the mosque . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Gogal was the head of the mosque .

title: Mosque of Kossuth
description: Mosque of Kossuth The Mosque of Kossuth was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Mosque of Kossuth The Mosque of Kossuth was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description . This mosque was made from beaten bronze . Activities . Since the efreet had discouraged the worship of Kossuth since the mosque ' s erection , the building had fallen into a state of disrepair . However , they efreet would never dare destroy the mosque for fear of angering the primordial .

title: Mosque of Najm the Adventurous
description: Mosque of Najm the Adventurous The Mosque of Najm the Adventurous was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Najm the Adventurous The Mosque of Najm the Adventurous was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . A large worship area allowed worshipers of Najm to regale other followers with tales of adventure . Showrooms housed rare treasures brought back from these adventures . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Effat was the head of the mosque . He supervised around 200 lesser ranking priests of Najm and other laymen . Activities . Followers of Najm were encouraged to explore the world and bring back tales of their exploits . Items held in the showrooms included a spelljammer helm , an emerald from a palace from Kara - Tur , a stuffed beholder , a shield of a Purple Dragon , a red robe from a land called Thay , and a statue of a wizard named Elminster . Divination magic was practiced here and could be cast for a fee . Followers of Najm were encouraged to prove their faith by crossing a small pit on a walkway that was only several inches wide . True followers performed the feat while blind - folded .

title: Mosque of Zann the Wise
description: Mosque of Zann the Wise The Mosque of Zann the Wise was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .
description_long: Mosque of Zann the Wise The Mosque of Zann the Wise was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights . Structure . The lowest level of the mosque was a designated lecture hall . The uppermost level housed an impressive library . Inhabitants . High Priest Imam Renn min Zann was the head of the mosque . He supervised over 200 lesser ranking priests of Zann and other laymen . His trusted second was Imam Samia al - Risik . The mosque of Zann was a good place to find many of the sage s of Huzuz . The Readers maintained a strong presence within the mosque . Activities . Clergymen of the mosque performed research for those who came seeking answers . The fee charged depended on the kind of questions that needed to be solved and how long it took to find the correct information .

title: Mosque of a Thousand Fountains
description: Mosque of a Thousand Fountains The Mosque of a Thousand Fountains was a temple dedicated to Zann found in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . The mosque actually straddled a large section of the city walls .
description_long: Mosque of a Thousand Fountains The Mosque of a Thousand Fountains was a temple dedicated to Zann found in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . The mosque actually straddled a large section of the city walls . Activities . This mosque was not only a house of worship for Zann , but also served as a small university for the wealthy elite of Muluk . A well - documented library was accessible by the public six days per week . Much of its contents dealt with Muluk ' s rich history .

title: Mosque of the Irreducible
description: Mosque of the Irreducible The Mosque of the Irreducible was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .
description_long: Mosque of the Irreducible The Mosque of the Irreducible was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description . The Mosque of the Irreducible was constructed from silver that was polished to a mirror shine . Activities . This temple was dedicated to Freyal — the efreeti name for Freya , an " ajami " goddess of love , passion , and fertility .

title: Mosque of the Revealed
description: Mosque of the Revealed The Mosque of the Revealed was a mosque dedicated to Najm in Liham , in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Many citizens from Liham came to the mosque to blow off steam , verbally venting their frustration with any number of issues .
description_long: Mosque of the Revealed The Mosque of the Revealed was a mosque dedicated to Najm in Liham , in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Many citizens from Liham came to the mosque to blow off steam , verbally venting their frustration with any number of issues . This was usually a peaceful occurrence , but riots spawned from heated arguments once in awhile . The priests of the mosque were pragmatist s or ethoist s .

title: Mosque of the Thirsty Jann
description: Mosque of the Thirsty Jann The Mosque of the Thirsty Jann was a religious structure dedicated to the worship of Jarmik , a local god . Description . This small mosque was located along the Pilgrims ' Route between Zayir and Hilm .
description_long: Mosque of the Thirsty Jann The Mosque of the Thirsty Jann was a religious structure dedicated to the worship of Jarmik , a local god . Description . This small mosque was located along the Pilgrims ' Route between Zayir and Hilm . At full capacity , the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann could accommodate 100 worshipers . Inhabitants . The mosque was staffed by 10 priests and 22 laymen . Tufala min - Jarmik led the priests . Activities . The servants of Jarmik provided food and water to the large multitude of pilgrims passing through the area . A sacred well provided water that cured disease and rejuvenated the body , but only if cupped into the hands and consumed . The water lost all of its magical properties if it touched anything other than flesh .

title: Moss agate
description: Moss agate Moss agate was one of many forms of agate found in the " Realms " . Description . Impurities of formed grayish green fern - like patterns that resembled moss embedded in these pink to yellow - white semi - transparent or translucent ornamental stones .
description_long: Moss agate Moss agate was one of many forms of agate found in the " Realms " . Description . Impurities of formed grayish green fern - like patterns that resembled moss embedded in these pink to yellow - white semi - transparent or translucent ornamental stones . Moss agate took a bright polish and was occasionally used for inlay work on coffers and other fine furniture . If the moss pattern formed a significant design , like an eye or a circle , this stone might be used in a ring or pendant in a polished . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Moss agate enhanced serenity and increased stability so it was used in powdered form in sleeping draughts and in all manner of potions to assist the mixing of components that might otherwise clash . Its powers were such that it could be safely added to any potion and even failed attempts did not explode or turn poisonous .

title: Mossbridges
description: Mossbridges Mossbridges was a town in the Vast , lying where the Coast Road between Ravens Bluff and Tantras crossed the Fire River , over the bridge of the same name . Feldar ' s Trail began at Mossbridges and joined to Highbank Forest . History .
description_long: Mossbridges Mossbridges was a town in the Vast , lying where the Coast Road between Ravens Bluff and Tantras crossed the Fire River , over the bridge of the same name . Feldar ' s Trail began at Mossbridges and joined to Highbank Forest . History . The bridge over the Fire River was built during the kingdom of Roldilar , a dwarven surface realm founded in 610 DR . The bridge lay a few miles upstream of the secure trading center of Sarbreen at the mouth of the river . Although Roldilar and Sarbeen fell to orc s in 649 DR , the bridge survived . As human s began to settle the coastline of the Vast , Sarbreen remained dangerous but the river remained useful . So local farmers and merchants gathered instead at the Fire River Bridge , as they called it , where they traded their goods and coin . A settlement grew , and bridge and community came to be known as Mossbridges . Sarbreen was eventually resettled , becoming the city of Ravens Bluff in 1222 DR . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , Ravens Bluff was working to establish a regional government in the Vast , by taking a number of neighboring towns and villages under its control .

title: Mosstone
description: Mosstone Mosstone was a walled town in Tethyr on the Trade Way near the Wealdath forest that was known primarily as a caravan stop . The town was self - governing and residents reached decisions through consensus . History .
description_long: Mosstone Mosstone was a walled town in Tethyr on the Trade Way near the Wealdath forest that was known primarily as a caravan stop . The town was self - governing and residents reached decisions through consensus . History . Mosstone was founded by King Strohm II , who was also its first druid .

title: Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud
description: Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud The Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud was an organization of embalmers , gravediggers , and other cemetery workers and craftsfolk in service to the church of Kelemvor , Lord of the Dead . Membership in the Order was kept secret by the church . Those in the order identified each other with a number of secret signs .
description_long: Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud The Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud was an organization of embalmers , gravediggers , and other cemetery workers and craftsfolk in service to the church of Kelemvor , Lord of the Dead . Membership in the Order was kept secret by the church . Those in the order identified each other with a number of secret signs . Their task was to keep the church informed of undead sightings and gravesite desecrations .

title: Mother
description: Mother Mother was a monstrous spawn of Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . In 1491 DR Graz ' zt entrusted Mother to the derro of Ravagestone .
description_long: Mother Mother was a monstrous spawn of Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . In 1491 DR Graz ' zt entrusted Mother to the derro of Ravagestone . There she ate derro , myconid s and fungus , growing enormous . After Mother decided to join her father in Maerimydra , and she arrived during the allied assault to the city . Mother and her derro minions inflicted a heavy tribute to the invading troops . At last she was killed by an adventuring party . Relashionship . Mother was the daughter of the demon lord Graz ' zt and of an unknown , unspeakable creature . Powers . Mother could spawned various fiend s , including succubi , vrock ] s and bar - lgura s

title: Mother Mauler
description: Mother Mauler The Mother Mauler was a unique infamous anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Mother Mauler was squat , squarish " mauler " - type anaxim , as big as a large shack .
description_long: Mother Mauler The Mother Mauler was a unique infamous anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Mother Mauler was squat , squarish " mauler " - type anaxim , as big as a large shack . It had a cavernous mouth full of whirring blades that served as its teeth , and its metallic mandibles reached from each side of its body and served it as arms . The Mother Mauler had massive metallic legs with splayed feet that allowed it to move in any kind of terrain . History . As of 1479 DR , the Mother Mauler was hundreds of years old . Many explorers of the Glaur Barrens believed the Mother Mauler was the original anaxim that served as the inspiration for the creation of the smaller " mauler " - type anaxims .

title: Mother Millstone
description: Mother Millstone Mother Millstone was the highest - ranking priest of the Faceless God among the vile yak - folk of the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Mother Millstone oversaw the largest temple dedicated to the Faceless God .
description_long: Mother Millstone Mother Millstone was the highest - ranking priest of the Faceless God among the vile yak - folk of the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Mother Millstone oversaw the largest temple dedicated to the Faceless God . She was also the appointed governor of the Yak ' s Horn province and a member of the Seven Sages . Her territory overlapped into the fringes of the Haunted Lands , granting her access to a wide array of strange creatures . Rumors & Legends . It was rumored that Mother Millstone found a way to harness the bizarre spirits of the desert in the lowlands of the Haunted Lands bordering the World Pillar Mountains .

title: Mother Tara
description: Mother Tara Mother Tara was a cheery halfling from the Vilhon Reach , who owned Mother Tara ' s Festhall in Shadowdale . Description . Tara had dark curly hair which was graying .
description_long: Mother Tara Mother Tara was a cheery halfling from the Vilhon Reach , who owned Mother Tara ' s Festhall in Shadowdale . Description . Tara had dark curly hair which was graying . Personality . She held the deed on a house next to her festhall known as Mane ' s Manor , and would rent the place out to adventurers or other large parties . In all her operations , Mother Tara managed aboveboard and honest establishments , keeping her reputation intact . History . Around 1374 DR , the Zhentarim took control of Shadowdale and all establishments , including Tara ' s festhall and manor .

title: Mother Tara ' s Festhall
description: Mother Tara ' s Festhall Mother Tara ' s Festhall was a banquet hall in the town of Shadowdale . Geography . Located on the western side of the Shadowdale Trail , Mother Tara ' s Festhall was situated between Mane ' s Manor and Hammerhand Bucko ' s house .
description_long: Mother Tara ' s Festhall Mother Tara ' s Festhall was a banquet hall in the town of Shadowdale . Geography . Located on the western side of the Shadowdale Trail , Mother Tara ' s Festhall was situated between Mane ' s Manor and Hammerhand Bucko ' s house . Atmosphere . The two - story dwelling specialized in fine wine s , good food , gaming , and sundry other " divertissements " for the traveler or the merchant . Prices were ten gold for an evening , which included a sumptuous banquet , dancing , singing , and the opportunity spend additional money at the gaming tables , or the hired help . While the Zhent occupation , the festhall became a dirty brothel and most of the frequent occupants area mid level officers , who spent their time and money gambling . Staff . The festhall was owned and operated by the halfling , Mother Tara , who kept a honest establishment and was proud of her reputation . She was backed up by Briig , who was said to be a flesh golem with an illusion spell placed upon him , which was a lie , but one that Mother Tara used to her advantage . Most of the gold earned from customers was repaid to the Zhentarim in the form of heavy taxes . History .

title: Mother of pearl
description: Mother of pearl Mother of Pearl was the name in the Realms for small , cut and polished , trochus and turbo shells . Description . They were used for making buttons etc .
description_long: Mother of pearl Mother of Pearl was the name in the Realms for small , cut and polished , trochus and turbo shells . Description . They were used for making buttons etc . and for inlay work . Unpolished , they were sold for as little as 5cp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) . Cut and polished shells had a base value of 5sp per pound .

title: Motoharu Kaijitsu
description: Motoharu Kaijitsu Motoharu Kaijitsu was a ninja / yakuza adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kaijitsu was always able to balance his ninja life under the name Ito with his yakuza one , using the one to have an alibi for the other and vice versa .
description_long: Motoharu Kaijitsu Motoharu Kaijitsu was a ninja / yakuza adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kaijitsu was always able to balance his ninja life under the name Ito with his yakuza one , using the one to have an alibi for the other and vice versa . He managed to help both his ninja family and his yakuza gang to prosper . His greatest fear was being discovered as a ninja , losing everything from his yakuza life , and dying . In 1357 DR , Kaijitsu was among the candidates chosen by Ko Mei Kho for a mission in Akari . In 1358 Kaijitsu during a a yakuza family gathering made a particularly messy incident resulting in a severe loss of personal honor and his exile from the family . He was in search for a method to regain honor when was possibly approached by Ko Ho San Appendix . Behind the scenes . Motoharu Kaijitsu is a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Akari . He was presented again upgraded for adventure in T ' u Lung .

title: Motsegai
description: Motsegai Motsegai was a shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Motsegai was the abbot at the Kanchai school monastery of Mount Ichi , where the former emperor Gobidamu retired to .
description_long: Motsegai Motsegai was a shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Motsegai was the abbot at the Kanchai school monastery of Mount Ichi , where the former emperor Gobidamu retired to . Motsegai was a member of the noble Ikeda clan and had strong ties with court nobility .

title: Mougra
description: Mougra Mougra was a goblin bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Mougra and his companion Geeraugh were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid .
description_long: Mougra Mougra was a goblin bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Mougra and his companion Geeraugh were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid . However , the young Pell Mhandyvver saw Mougra and directed some adventurers to the tomb , where they defeated Mougra and Geeraugh .

title: Mount
description: Mount A mount is an creature that is used to transport another creature . Typically , mounts used by humanoids are large and can move much faster then the humanoid could on foot . The vast majority of mounts have only low , animal level intelligence , though some creatures of greater intelligence willing serve as mounts .
description_long: Mount A mount is an creature that is used to transport another creature . Typically , mounts used by humanoids are large and can move much faster then the humanoid could on foot . The vast majority of mounts have only low , animal level intelligence , though some creatures of greater intelligence willing serve as mounts .

title: Mount ( spell )
description: Mount ( spell ) Mount , which was originally called Jarm ' s mount , was a summoning spell to conjure an equine to carry a rider . Effects . To within close range of the caster , this spell summoned a pony or light horse , which was willing an able to carry a rider .
description_long: Mount ( spell ) Mount , which was originally called Jarm ' s mount , was a summoning spell to conjure an equine to carry a rider . Effects . To within close range of the caster , this spell summoned a pony or light horse , which was willing an able to carry a rider . The mount was summoned with riding gear , such as bit and bridle and saddle , already equipped . The duration of the summons depended on the power of the spellcaster but was at least two hours . Components . A strand of horse hair was required to cast this spell , in addition to verbal and somatic component s . History . The spell was invented by the Netherese arcanist Jarm in −1964 DR .

title: Mount Abbalayat
description: Mount Abbalayat Mount Abbalayat was an isolated peak in the western Marching Mountains famous for being the home of the race of oracles called the Abbalaya r . Description . Abbalayat was an extremely steep mountain , with cliffs for lower slopes .
description_long: Mount Abbalayat Mount Abbalayat was an isolated peak in the western Marching Mountains famous for being the home of the race of oracles called the Abbalaya r . Description . Abbalayat was an extremely steep mountain , with cliffs for lower slopes . It was surrounded by taller mountains , with a three - mile wide , jagged ravine between . The peak seemed always surrounded by clouds , and dangerous winds rushed through the " moat " around the mountain . Notable Locations . The mountain itself was filled with caverns . The top of the mountain was the site of the holy city of Ul ' sahab . Notable Inhabitants . The Abbalayar , a race of oracles and prophets lived within the city of Ul ' sahab , which was magically hidden from sight . History . The caverns within Mount Abbalayat were used as shelters for the earliest human tribe living in the region . Not even elven scholars knew the name of this lost tribe , but they became the ancestors to the Abbalayar . When djinn ruled the land that later became Calimshan , they gave the Abbalyar full control of the mountain .

title: Mount Cormanda
description: Mount Cormanda Mount Cormanda was an active volcano located in southern Skelkor , Returned Abeir . History . When the Spellplague transported Returned Abeir to Toril , the demon lord Cormanda went to explore the new continent .
description_long: Mount Cormanda Mount Cormanda was an active volcano located in southern Skelkor , Returned Abeir . History . When the Spellplague transported Returned Abeir to Toril , the demon lord Cormanda went to explore the new continent . However , a burst of Spellplague hit Cormanda and fused it with the volcano , which was later renamed after the demon lord . As of 1479 DR , the demon lord was still trapped inside Mount Cormanda ' s lava tube .

title: Mount Gommat
description: Mount Gommat Mount Gommat was the tallest peak in the Marching Mountains . It was the site of the famous Axemarch Stone . Description .
description_long: Mount Gommat Mount Gommat was the tallest peak in the Marching Mountains . It was the site of the famous Axemarch Stone . Description . Mt . Gommat was one of the interior mountains of the range . Its summit was 8 , 500 feet above sea level , and it was devoid of trees after 7 , 200 feet . In winter , the snows would rarely descend below 6 , 600 feet . History . " Circa " −5960 DR , dwarves summited the mountain and placed the Axemarch Stone at the founding of the High Shanatar .

title: Mount Grimmerfang
description: Mount Grimmerfang The Hollow Mountain , later called Mount Grimmerfang was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the capital of both the orc kingdom of Vastar and the dwarf kingdom of Roldilar . History .
description_long: Mount Grimmerfang The Hollow Mountain , later called Mount Grimmerfang was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the capital of both the orc kingdom of Vastar and the dwarf kingdom of Roldilar . History . The mountain was originally known as the " Hollow Mountain " . At some point , the monstrous orc Ologh rose to the position of Overking of Vastar , and created a throne for himself , holding court from the Hollow Mountain . When Ologh the Overking was killed by the black dragon Iyrauroth in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR , the throne was left vacant and Vastar descended into civil war . Eventually , Grimmerfang defeated his last rival and seized the throne in the Year of the Loose Coins , 580 DR . Orc - King Grimmerfang renamed the Hollow Mountain after himself , to Mount Grimmerfang . However , dwarves invaded and Vastar fell in the Year of the Spellfire , 610 DR . The dwarves took Mount Grimmerfang from the orcs and slew Grimmerfang himself at the mountain . He was left entombed there . The same year , the dwarves founded the kingdom of Roldilar , under Deep King Tuir Stonebeard .

title: Mount Hazail
description: Mount Hazail Mount Hazail was the highest peak of the Gnollwatch Mountains in Dambrath . Description . Mount Hazail had an elevation of 11 , 500 ft .
description_long: Mount Hazail Mount Hazail was the highest peak of the Gnollwatch Mountains in Dambrath . Description . Mount Hazail had an elevation of 11 , 500 ft . ( 3 , 500 m ) , standing several thousand feet above the rest of the Gnollwatch Mountians in central Dambrath .

title: Mount Hotenow
description: Mount Hotenow Mount Hotenow ( pronounced " HOE - teh - NOW " ) , was a volcano amid the Crags mountain range , situated to the northeast of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North , deep in Neverwinter Wood . It was home to a large population of fire elemental s , warming the Neverwinter River to the point where it never froze over , even in the heart of winter ( hence the city ' s name ) . The volcano also had a tendency to attract creatures like fire giant s and red dragon s to make their homes near it .
description_long: Mount Hotenow Mount Hotenow ( pronounced " HOE - teh - NOW " ) , was a volcano amid the Crags mountain range , situated to the northeast of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North , deep in Neverwinter Wood . It was home to a large population of fire elemental s , warming the Neverwinter River to the point where it never froze over , even in the heart of winter ( hence the city ' s name ) . The volcano also had a tendency to attract creatures like fire giant s and red dragon s to make their homes near it . A shadowy reflection of Mount Hotenow also existed in the Shadowfell . Unlike its Toril ian counterpart , the Mount Hotenow of the Shadowfell was always spilling rivers of lava , that flowed to the city of Evernight . Description . After its eruption , Mount Hotenow looked like a serrated teeth many described as a " door to the Nine Hells " ( or the Elemental Chaos , according to others ) . A river made of pure elemental fire followed a serpentine path throughout Hotenow ' s interior and underneath the surrounding mountains and hills of the Crags . History .

title: Mount Ieldroun
description: Mount Ieldroun Mount Ieldroun was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named for a long dead orc chieftain .
description_long: Mount Ieldroun Mount Ieldroun was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named for a long dead orc chieftain . Geography . Ieldroun stood halfway between Stone Stand and the site of Hellgate Keep . Between Mount Ieldroun and Mount Thorog was Telkoun ' s Tower , a stronghold of a little - known wizard and protected by peryton s .

title: Mount Kahdas
description: Mount Kahdas Mount Kahdas was the second tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Kahdas was one of the central Alimirs .
description_long: Mount Kahdas Mount Kahdas was the second tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Kahdas was one of the central Alimirs . Its elevation was 7 , 800 feet ( 2 , 400 meters ) above sea level . It was located north of Mount Ulaarn and Azure Falls . Mount Kahdas was visible from 50 miles outside of Almraiven . It had sheared sides facing to the west that — together with the similar face of nearby Mount Phevos — were known as the Eye Tyrant Cliffs . Three enormous beholders were carved on the cliffs of Mt . Kahdas , portrayed as warring with humans on the opposing cliffs of Phevos . History . The carvings on Mount Kahdas celebrated the victory of the beholder s against the human s of Calimshan during the Third Age .

title: Mount Kus
description: Mount Kus Mount Kus was located in the Hordelands near the Katakoro Shan range . Geography . Situated on the western bank of the Jumpa River , Mount Kus stood above the city of Kushk where the Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati met the Old Iron Road .
description_long: Mount Kus Mount Kus was located in the Hordelands near the Katakoro Shan range . Geography . Situated on the western bank of the Jumpa River , Mount Kus stood above the city of Kushk where the Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati met the Old Iron Road . Description . The temple Bimasara , called the Holy Mountain of Kus , was built within Mount Kus and atop its peak in the form of the Tower of Harmony . Inhabitants . As of the mid 14th century DR , only gaki inhabited the mountain .

title: Mount Phevos
description: Mount Phevos Mount Phevos was the tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Mt .
description_long: Mount Phevos Mount Phevos was the tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Mt . Phevos was in the central Alimir Mountains . Its elevation was 8 , 500 feet ( 2 , 600 meters ) above sea level . It was located south of Mount Ulaarn and Azure Falls . The towering peak was visible from 50 miles outside of Almraiven . Its west - facing cliffs were half of the carvings known as the Eye Tyrant Cliffs . A horde of life - size human warriors and wizard s were portrayed battling three enormous beholder s carved on the cliffs of Mount Kahdas to the north . History . The carvings on Mount Phevos celebrated the victory of the eye tyrants against the Calishites during the Third Age of Calimshan .

title: Mount Sarengard
description: Mount Sarengard Mount Sarengard was one of the tallest peaks in the eastern Marching Mountains . It was the location of the holiest site to Vhaeraun . Description .
description_long: Mount Sarengard Mount Sarengard was one of the tallest peaks in the eastern Marching Mountains . It was the location of the holiest site to Vhaeraun . Description . Sarengard was located in the far east of the Marching Mountains , east of Minthrux Vale . Notable Locations . A mile below the mountain in a 1 , 000 - foot cavern , the Vault of Cloaked Midnight was found . It was the holiest temple to Vhaeraun in the Realms . The entrance was in the lower slopes of the mountain . Notable Inhabitants . Shangalar the Black lived in an inverted pyramid balancing 200 feet above the plateau between Minthrux Vale and the summit of Mount Sarengard .

title: Mount Sklagarra
description: Mount Sklagarra Mount Sklagarra was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn where the Heralds maintained their secret headquarters . It was east of the Smokespire volcano in the far west of the mountain range . The mountain contained a vast underground lake with an island in the center surrounded by a large complex of caverns known as the Swordmere .
description_long: Mount Sklagarra Mount Sklagarra was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn where the Heralds maintained their secret headquarters . It was east of the Smokespire volcano in the far west of the mountain range . The mountain contained a vast underground lake with an island in the center surrounded by a large complex of caverns known as the Swordmere .

title: Mount Speartop
description: Mount Speartop Mount Speartop was the tallest mountain of the Cloud Peaks . Description . Mount Speartop was located near the coast on the southwestern corner of the Cloud Peaks .
description_long: Mount Speartop Mount Speartop was the tallest mountain of the Cloud Peaks . Description . Mount Speartop was located near the coast on the southwestern corner of the Cloud Peaks . To the northwest were the Hamlar Hills and St . Carwell ' s Vale . Mount Speartop ' s summit was 14 , 500 feet ( 4 , 400 meters ) above sea level , making it one of the 20 tallest peaks in southern Faerûn . It was so tall that it could be seen from Athkatla , 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) away , on clear days . Recreation . Speartop was a popular climbing site for mountaineers , because while a very challenging and tall climb , it was not a relatively dangerous one , provided the climber was not foolish in proper preparation . The exception to this generalization was the northeast face of the mountain , which was especially precarious and was also home to a dragon . Notable Inhabitants . A white wyrm named Icehauptannarthanyx lived on Mount Speartop , 750 feet ( 230 meters ) below the summit on the northeast face . His lair was a nearly inaccessible cave , but he preferred to never leave it . Rumors . In addition to Icehaupt , the mountain was said to be the home of several other gigantic sleeping dragon s .

title: Mount Talath ( town )
description: Mount Talath ( town ) Mount Talath was a small town located near the summit of the mountain with the same name in Halruaa . It was little more than a collection of homes for the staff and priests who worked within the High Temple of Mystra built into the mountains slopes .
