description_long: Mount Talath ( town ) Mount Talath was a small town located near the summit of the mountain with the same name in Halruaa . It was little more than a collection of homes for the staff and priests who worked within the High Temple of Mystra built into the mountains slopes .

title: Mount Thalagbror
description: Mount Thalagbror Mount Thalagbror was a mountain in Archendale . Geography . The mountain was the starting point for the River Arkhen in the Thunder Peaks .
description_long: Mount Thalagbror Mount Thalagbror was a mountain in Archendale . Geography . The mountain was the starting point for the River Arkhen in the Thunder Peaks . History . The mountain was named after a ogre mage named Thalagbror . Around 1372 DR , worshipers of Mielikki and Chauntea would journey up the mountain to Arkhen Falls in search of pegasi .

title: Mount Thargill
description: Mount Thargill Mount Thargill was an extinct volcano and the easternmost peak of the Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . The ancient lava tube of Mt . Thargill was known as the Wyrmwell .
description_long: Mount Thargill Mount Thargill was an extinct volcano and the easternmost peak of the Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . The ancient lava tube of Mt . Thargill was known as the Wyrmwell . It and the tunnels around it were used as one of the lairs for the red wyrm Balagos and as prisons for the brown dragon Altagos and the black dragon Auroxas .

title: Mount Thorog
description: Mount Thorog Mount Thorog was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named after a deceased orc chieftain .
description_long: Mount Thorog Mount Thorog was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named after a deceased orc chieftain . Geography . Thorog was located between Stone Stand and the stronghold of Hellgate Keep . Guarded by peryton s , Telkoun ' s Tower was a fortress located between Mount Ieldroun and Mount Thorog .

title: Mount Tolzrin
description: Mount Tolzrin Mount Tolzrin was a mountain located in the Rauvin Mountains . Geography . The mountian was located near Mount Jaws , just west of Faerang ' s Doom .
description_long: Mount Tolzrin Mount Tolzrin was a mountain located in the Rauvin Mountains . Geography . The mountian was located near Mount Jaws , just west of Faerang ' s Doom . History . It was named after the human prospector Tolzrin , who discovered many big gold nuggets there .

title: Mount Turbold
description: Mount Turbold Mount Turbold was a mountain in the Kuldin Peaks of Erlkazar . History . Long before the kingdom of Erlkazar came into existence , an ancient battle between giant s and dwarves from Shanatar took place on this mountain and in the valley to the north .
description_long: Mount Turbold Mount Turbold was a mountain in the Kuldin Peaks of Erlkazar . History . Long before the kingdom of Erlkazar came into existence , an ancient battle between giant s and dwarves from Shanatar took place on this mountain and in the valley to the north . The mountain and the valley were named after the leader of the dwarves , Turbold . Rumor ' s . Turbold ' s burial site was supposedly located in a crypt hidden somewhere in the mountain , containing his treasures and those of the dwarves he led who were also buried there . Turbold ' s Golden Axe was the most famous artifact said to be resting there .

title: Mount Ulaarn
description: Mount Ulaarn Mount Ulaarn was a peak in the central Alimir Mountains . Description . This mountain was located in the central Alimirs between Mounts Kahdas and Phevos .
description_long: Mount Ulaarn Mount Ulaarn was a peak in the central Alimir Mountains . Description . This mountain was located in the central Alimirs between Mounts Kahdas and Phevos . It was famous for being the site of Azure Falls , the start of the Maridflow . History . 7 , 000 years before the late fourteenth century DR , two marid s , Haj and Luar , were slain here , and their deaths caused a rift in Mount Ulaarn that led to the formation of the falls .

title: Mount Waterdeep
description: Mount Waterdeep Mount Waterdeep was the name of the mountain on and around which the city of Waterdeep was built . It was a rough , rocky mountain and stood some 1 , 500 feet ( 457m ) above the sea level , to the west of the city . Beneath the mountain was the notorious Undermountain .
description_long: Mount Waterdeep Mount Waterdeep was the name of the mountain on and around which the city of Waterdeep was built . It was a rough , rocky mountain and stood some 1 , 500 feet ( 457m ) above the sea level , to the west of the city . Beneath the mountain was the notorious Undermountain . The whole of Mount Waterdeep was considered to be in the Castle Ward . History . There was a ballad that spoke an ancient city sunk into the sea and the gods raised a head stone for it to mark the grave . That was Mount Waterdeep . Mount Waterdeep was once home to the underhalls of Melairbode , a shield dwarf hold . Lore . Mount Waterdeep shielded the city from the worst coastal storm winds . Rumor . It was thought that the Harpers have a secret base somewhere on the mountainside .

title: Mount Wolf
description: Mount Wolf Mount Wolf was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It lay in the Giantspike Mountains , by the Earthspur Mountains , and towered over the North Road , south of Maskyr ' s Eye . It marked the proper border of the lands of the Vast .
description_long: Mount Wolf Mount Wolf was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It lay in the Giantspike Mountains , by the Earthspur Mountains , and towered over the North Road , south of Maskyr ' s Eye . It marked the proper border of the lands of the Vast . Once , packs of gray wolves made their lairs close to the peak , but they competed with local hunters for the highly valued stags in the area . The hunters culled many wolves and reduced their numbers significantly . The sage Elminster of Shadowdale estimated that Mount Grimmerfang was the first peak north - east of Mount Wolf . However , he ' d not investigated this himself to confirm .

title: Mount Zatal
description: Mount Zatal Mount Zatal was Zaltec ' s sacred mountain in Maztica . A volcanic mountain , it overlooked the now ruined city of Nexal . The Ancient Ones manipulated the priests of Zaltec from the sacred Highcave on top of the mountain .
description_long: Mount Zatal Mount Zatal was Zaltec ' s sacred mountain in Maztica . A volcanic mountain , it overlooked the now ruined city of Nexal . The Ancient Ones manipulated the priests of Zaltec from the sacred Highcave on top of the mountain . During the Night of Wailing , Mt . Zatal exploded and destroyed most of Nexal .

title: Mount of Forgiveness
description: Mount of Forgiveness The Mount of Forgiveness was a necropolis located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . Located just outside of the walls on the southeast side of the city , this artificial mount was covered with artistic tombs and sepulchers .
description_long: Mount of Forgiveness The Mount of Forgiveness was a necropolis located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . Located just outside of the walls on the southeast side of the city , this artificial mount was covered with artistic tombs and sepulchers . Activities . The Mount of Forgiveness was the resting place for the honored dead of Muluk , including past caliphs and royal families . Rumors & Legends . The citizens of Muluk whispered that the undead of the Mount of Forgiveness tunneled out a maze of catacombs within the earth . The clergy of Muluk ' s mosques insisted this was a simple lie instigated by jealous rivals of the city .

title: Mountain Crusher
description: Mountain Crusher Mountain Crusher was a + 5 composite longbow belonging to Tavis Burdun , the First Defender of Hartsvale . Tavis was a firbolg and his weapon was reinforced with the rune - etched ribs of a glacier bear , allowing him to use his incredible strength to best effect without risking snapping the weapon .
description_long: Mountain Crusher Mountain Crusher was a + 5 composite longbow belonging to Tavis Burdun , the First Defender of Hartsvale . Tavis was a firbolg and his weapon was reinforced with the rune - etched ribs of a glacier bear , allowing him to use his incredible strength to best effect without risking snapping the weapon .

title: Mountain Prince
description: Mountain Prince The Mountain Prince was a skilled yikarian warrior inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Description . The Mountain Prince carried scars from his many battles .
description_long: Mountain Prince The Mountain Prince was a skilled yikarian warrior inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Description . The Mountain Prince carried scars from his many battles . Activities . As one of the Seven Sages , the Mountain Prince ruled over one of the large provinces of the Yikarian Empire — the Bronze Falcon . Given the Bronze Falcon ' s location near the dense forests found east of the World Pillar Mountains , the Mountain Prince was mostly responsible for eliminating any threats to the Empire from that direction . He often rode at the head of his army into battle . History . The Mountain Prince personally taught the Lotus Emperor how to use a sword . He was believed to have the Emperor ' s confidence .

title: Mountain circle
description: Mountain circle The mountain circle was a druid circle associated with grand terrain that reached for the sky . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Mountain circle The mountain circle was a druid circle associated with grand terrain that reached for the sky . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Mountain giant
description: Mountain giant Mountain giants were a breed of brutish giant s given to acts of cruelty . Description . Often living to be 100 years old , mountain giants resembled hill giants , standing over fourteen feet ( four meters ) tall , and weighing over 1 , 000 pounds ( 500 kilograms ) .
description_long: Mountain giant Mountain giants were a breed of brutish giant s given to acts of cruelty . Description . Often living to be 100 years old , mountain giants resembled hill giants , standing over fourteen feet ( four meters ) tall , and weighing over 1 , 000 pounds ( 500 kilograms ) . Their skin tones ranged from tan to reddish brown , their bulbous faces covered with greasy , straight , black hair . The males had heavy beards but no mustaches , and they had large pot bellies . They were typically clothed in rough hides or skins and carried huge clubs as weapons . The stale reek of a mountain giant could be detected several hundred feet downwind . While shorter than hill giant s , mountain giants were about as strong as fire giant s . Personality . They especially enjoyed crushing people under boulders . They spoke Jotunhaug and Jotun . Society . Typically mountain giants lived alone in in their mountain ranges and volcanoes . Despite often resenting intruders , they would occasionally keep a few dwarves or humans as pets . If found in groups , they were usually a pair of mates with children .

title: Mountain of Iron
description: Mountain of Iron The Mountain of Iron was located in the far northern reaches of the Hordelands near the western fringes of the Ama Basin . Geography . The Mountain of Iron was part of the Ulhai Shan range .
description_long: Mountain of Iron The Mountain of Iron was located in the far northern reaches of the Hordelands near the western fringes of the Ama Basin . Geography . The Mountain of Iron was part of the Ulhai Shan range . Description . This low , rugged peak did not possess any distinguishing features when viewed from a distance . However , as travelers got closer to the peak , they became aware of the mountains powerful magnetic properties . History . Many believed the Mountain of Iron to be a mere myth , a fanciful tale to entertain that possessed no merit . In reality , the mountain housed a considerable amount of lodestone , giving it strong magnetic properties that were rumored to pull weapons from men ' s hands as they neared the peak . Travelers encased in metal armor could be pinned to the mountain where they eventually died of thirst or starvation if they were not able to remove their armor in time . This snared many explorers , contributing to the mountain ' s secrecy and myth . Inhabitants . A large colony of gnoll s lived on the mountain . The gnolls actually revered the mountain as a god because of its mystical properties .

title: Mountain orc
description: Mountain orc The mountain orcs of the North and the Spine of the World comprise the oldest and most numerous of the various orc subraces active on Faerûn . In fact , many people assume that all orcs are like the savage warmongers found in these regions , and do not identify gray orcs or even half - orcs as separate races . Physical description .
description_long: Mountain orc The mountain orcs of the North and the Spine of the World comprise the oldest and most numerous of the various orc subraces active on Faerûn . In fact , many people assume that all orcs are like the savage warmongers found in these regions , and do not identify gray orcs or even half - orcs as separate races . Physical description . A mountain orc is quite obviously a monstrous creature to most of the civilized folk of Faerûn . Mountain orcs look vaguely like primitive humans but are a fair bit taller at seven or more feet in height ; a rare few exceed eight feet in height . They have stocky , powerful necks , and their bestial heads seem to sit directly on their massive shoulders . Their eyes are always a deep shade of red , and their faces are dominated by porcine snouts and large tusks . Mountain orcs often weave braids and tiny bones into their thick matted hair , which is usually black . Their clothing is crude and primitive , often composed of unpleasant colors like blood red , mustard yellow , yellow - green , and deep purple . They are far from the cleanest race on Faerûn and delight in decorating their bodies with scars and warpaint . Culture .

title: Mountains of Copper
description: Mountains of Copper The Mountains of Copper were a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . The Mountains of Copper were a small mountain rage that formed the northern border of Murghôm , and were known for the large amount of copper ore found within .
description_long: Mountains of Copper The Mountains of Copper were a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . The Mountains of Copper were a small mountain rage that formed the northern border of Murghôm , and were known for the large amount of copper ore found within . Having been mined for hundreds of years , the mines in the mountain were deep and extensive , with some shafts going on for miles , many breaking into even older abandoned shafts , and forming a maze - like system of galleries . The centuries of frequent mining resulted in large numbers of mine shafts being unmapped , and improperly taken care of , making collapses frequent . The lack of supervision on these old mines also allowed creatures of the Underdark , as well as bandits , to move into many of the tunnels . On the surface , the ages of mining resulted in many slopes becoming deforested , as well as toxic chemicals from old mines to leech into the rivers and streams , making the water unfit to drink . Several peaks were covered in clouds of black smoke from the numerous smelters . The settlements of the region were small , and covered in soot and dirt from the smelters .

title: Mountains of Forgotten Dreams
description: Mountains of Forgotten Dreams The Mountains of Forgotten Dreams were located southeast of the Genies ' Anvil within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . This mountain range boasted peaks as high as 5 , 000 ft .
description_long: Mountains of Forgotten Dreams The Mountains of Forgotten Dreams were located southeast of the Genies ' Anvil within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . This mountain range boasted peaks as high as 5 , 000 ft . ( 1 , 500 m ) , many of which were former volcanoes . Ash and chalky rock could be found along the foothills surrounding the mountains . Travel through the mountain range was relatively easy because of the many wide passes that could be found every few miles .

title: Mountains of the Alaoreum
description: Mountains of the Alaoreum The Alaoreum were a collection of northern peaks in the Orsraun Mountains set apart from the rest of the range by Treefall Pass . The peaks overlooked the Gulthmere Forest . The Mountains of the Alaoreum were notable for containing the volcano Mount Andrus , which was sacred to the god Talos , and the dwarven mine of Ironfang Deep .
description_long: Mountains of the Alaoreum The Alaoreum were a collection of northern peaks in the Orsraun Mountains set apart from the rest of the range by Treefall Pass . The peaks overlooked the Gulthmere Forest . The Mountains of the Alaoreum were notable for containing the volcano Mount Andrus , which was sacred to the god Talos , and the dwarven mine of Ironfang Deep .

title: Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue
description: Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue The Mountains of Lizard ' s Tongue was a prominent geographical feature of West Zakhara , fully dominating the landscape in the northwest region of the High Desert . Geography . The mountain range stretched for hundreds of miles across this region of the Land of Fate , running northeast to southwest .
description_long: Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue The Mountains of Lizard ' s Tongue was a prominent geographical feature of West Zakhara , fully dominating the landscape in the northwest region of the High Desert . Geography . The mountain range stretched for hundreds of miles across this region of the Land of Fate , running northeast to southwest . It effectively separated the scorching High Desert from the refreshing waters and cool breezes of Bahr al - Kibar . It eventually terminated in the northeast at Bahr al - Dahil , the Sea of Caravans .

title: Mountainside
description: Mountainside Mountainside was a district in Waterdeep located on the eastern and southeastern slope of Mount Waterdeep . History . Mountainside was settled in the 15th century DR by the rich and up - and - coming , who were attempting to avoid the Second Pestilars by rising above the masses and seeking cleaner air .
description_long: Mountainside Mountainside was a district in Waterdeep located on the eastern and southeastern slope of Mount Waterdeep . History . Mountainside was settled in the 15th century DR by the rich and up - and - coming , who were attempting to avoid the Second Pestilars by rising above the masses and seeking cleaner air .

title: Mourel Duskwalker
description: Mourel Duskwalker Mourel Duskwalker was a Star elf wizard who was corrupt and hungry for power . From his citadel of glass Tir ' in ' tiral in the demi - plane of Sildëyuir , Mourel marshalled evil forces to conquer the Star elves but was eventually defeated . He was interred in Tir ' in ' tiral and it , plus all of the towers connecting it were cut off from Sildëyuir to become a separate Demi - Plane known as the Night Realm and eventually relegated tales of " The Duskwalker " to stories for frightening children .
description_long: Mourel Duskwalker Mourel Duskwalker was a Star elf wizard who was corrupt and hungry for power . From his citadel of glass Tir ' in ' tiral in the demi - plane of Sildëyuir , Mourel marshalled evil forces to conquer the Star elves but was eventually defeated . He was interred in Tir ' in ' tiral and it , plus all of the towers connecting it were cut off from Sildëyuir to become a separate Demi - Plane known as the Night Realm and eventually relegated tales of " The Duskwalker " to stories for frightening children . Unbeknownst to the mages who cut it off , a " portal " that conected the Night Realm to the Yuirwood still existed , though was inactive . Also , Mourel ' s apprentice Kyjal Stardancer , who was the only survivor of Mourel ' s defeat , had managed to extract the brain of his master and had placed it a jar of embalming fluid which was then placed in the chest cavity of a Girallon zombie . A nilshai sorceror Tolg ' byri found and reactivated the " portal " to get to the Night Realm in order to gather an army with which he could launch his own attacks on Sildëyuir .

title: Mourmyd Jacerryl
description: Mourmyd Jacerryl Mourmyd Jacerryl was a pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars loyal to Evendur Highcastle during the Second Sundering . History . In 1486 DR , under orders from Evendur , Mourmyd took his ship , the " Octopus " , out in search of the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .
description_long: Mourmyd Jacerryl Mourmyd Jacerryl was a pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars loyal to Evendur Highcastle during the Second Sundering . History . In 1486 DR , under orders from Evendur , Mourmyd took his ship , the " Octopus " , out in search of the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn . His men located Stedd and his companions near the wilds of Gulthandor . Mourmyd tried to capture them , but they escaped into the wilds . He decided to inform Evendur of the boy ' s location . After speaking with Mourmyd , Evendur specifically ordered Mourmyd to take control of the Turmish an village of Morningstar Hollows , assuming that anyone journeying east through the northern reaches of Gulthandor would naturally head there . He followed the instructions . Stedd and his companions saw that the village was occupied by pirates and they managed to kill Mourmyd and all his men .

title: Mourner ' s armor
description: Mourner ' s armor Mourner ' s armor was a form of magical lamellar armor that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , and was created by a great ghul sha ' ir . Description . The black plates of this armor were often decorated with bright colors .
description_long: Mourner ' s armor Mourner ' s armor was a form of magical lamellar armor that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , and was created by a great ghul sha ' ir . Description . The black plates of this armor were often decorated with bright colors . Powers . When worn , " mourner ' s armor " offered complete protection from all normal ranged weapons . It also made it much more difficult for the wearer ' s opponents to strike them . The remaining powers of the armor were considered a curse by most , or at least a mixed blessing . Once the wearer suffered substantial physical harm during battle , they no longer felt pain of any kind . When even more damage was suffered the wearer was filled with a sense of invincibility , continuing to fight well beyond the point of death after suffering additional wounds that would fell a normal man . If " fatal " wounds were sustained during battle , the wearer would die several days later as the armor consumed their life force . All magical forms of healing used on the wearer had no effect . Non - fatal wounds could only be healed by natural means .

title: Mourngrym Amcathra
description: Mourngrym Amcathra Mourngrym Amcathra was the lord of Shadowdale from 1353 DR until 1375 DR . Appearance . Mourngrym was a 6 ' 4 " ( 1 .
description_long: Mourngrym Amcathra Mourngrym Amcathra was the lord of Shadowdale from 1353 DR until 1375 DR . Appearance . Mourngrym was a 6 ' 4 " ( 1 . 9m ) tall , athletic man with neatly trimmed brown hair and a similarly maintained mustache . Personality . Mourngrym was a cautious but shrewd leader and able diplomat . He was authoritative and had abundant foresight . While he liked to think of himself as benevolent and protective , he came off more smothering and overly paternalistic as well as condescending . Possessions . In 1358 DR , Mourngrym typically wore a suit of plate mail armor and a " ring of protection + 1 " . In addition he carried a " broadsword + 3 " , a " shield + 1 " and a knife that was enchanted to transform into a short sword on command . By 1375 DR , he tended to wear " mithral chainmail + 1 " instead of the heavier plate mail . Furthermore , he bore a " greatsword + 1 " and well - crafted composite longbow instead of his former sword and shield . History . Early Life . Mourngrym was born to the noble Amcathra family of Waterdeep . As a child , he had everything he ever needed as well as lots of friends and a good knowledge of how Waterdeep worked .

title: Mouth of Song
description: Mouth of Song The Mouth of Song was a small shrine to Eilistraee located in the south central portion of the Moonwood , approximately a day ' s travel north of Quaervarr . Geography . The shrine was located in a cave mouth beneath a treeless hill , atop which the dark elven worshipers and a few half - elven and elven faithful from Silverymoon danced in a great ring on moonlit nights .
description_long: Mouth of Song The Mouth of Song was a small shrine to Eilistraee located in the south central portion of the Moonwood , approximately a day ' s travel north of Quaervarr . Geography . The shrine was located in a cave mouth beneath a treeless hill , atop which the dark elven worshipers and a few half - elven and elven faithful from Silverymoon danced in a great ring on moonlit nights . Inhabitants . The area was frequented by followers of Eilistraee , the goodly drow goddess . The good drow ( mostly females ) danced and sang under the moon , and performed other ceremonies atop the hill where a small shrine to Eilistraee stood .

title: Move dune
description: Move dune Move dune was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to lift and move a large heap of sand , dust , or gravel .
description_long: Move dune Move dune was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to lift and move a large heap of sand , dust , or gravel . The spell was only able to move non - living matter . Stronger casters were able to move more material . If dropped , the matter created an effect similar to a " sand shield " . Components . This spell required a pinch of sand to cast .

title: Move earth
description: Move earth Move earth is a transmutation spell that digs trenches and builds hills . Effects . " Move earth " moves dirt ( clay , loam , sand ) , possibly collapsing embankments , moving hillocks , shifting dunes , etc .
description_long: Move earth Move earth is a transmutation spell that digs trenches and builds hills . Effects . " Move earth " moves dirt ( clay , loam , sand ) , possibly collapsing embankments , moving hillocks , shifting dunes , etc . However , in no event can rock formations be collapsed or moved . The area to be affected determines the casting time . For every 150 - foot square ( up to 10 feet deep ) , casting takes 10 minutes . The maximum area , 750 feet by 750 feet , takes 4 hours and 10 minutes to move . This spell does not violently break the surface of the ground . Instead , it creates wavelike crests and troughs , with the earth reacting with glacier - like fluidity until the desired result is achieved . Trees , structures , rock formations , and such are mostly unaffected except for changes in elevation and relative topography . The spell cannot be used for tunneling and is generally too slow to trap or bury creatures . Its primary use is for digging or filling moats or for adjusting terrain contours before a battle . Material components . A mixture of soils ( clay , loam , and sand ) in a small bag , and an iron blade .

title: Move sand
description: Move sand Move sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Move sand Move sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . With this spell the caster could control the movement of sand in a small area . Only areas with loose sand were affected . Components . A handful of sand was needed to cast this spell .

title: Mozah
description: Mozah Mozah was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Mozah was a villager who tasked an adventurer to get him some money .
description_long: Mozah Mozah was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Mozah was a villager who tasked an adventurer to get him some money . However , the adventurer did not come back . The Kalach - Cha could investigate into the matter . Upon returning with Mozah with his pay ( which was located in Highcliff Castle , held by one of the zombies near the shadow priest ) , the Kalach - Cha could lie nothing was found and keep the money . Otherwise , the Kalach - Cha could give the money back and get half as a reward .

title: Mozgriken
description: Mozgriken A mozgriken was the result of an illithid tadpole being inserted into a svirfneblin gnome and then subjected to a dangerous psionic ritual . The ritual involved channeling energy straight from the Plane of Shadow into the ceremorph , as svirfneblin implantation normally means both the svirfneblin and the larvae die . These three - tentacled ceremorphs were despised by the svirfneblin , owing to the hatred they had for the brain - eating illithids , and also by the illithids , because of their imperfections .
description_long: Mozgriken A mozgriken was the result of an illithid tadpole being inserted into a svirfneblin gnome and then subjected to a dangerous psionic ritual . The ritual involved channeling energy straight from the Plane of Shadow into the ceremorph , as svirfneblin implantation normally means both the svirfneblin and the larvae die . These three - tentacled ceremorphs were despised by the svirfneblin , owing to the hatred they had for the brain - eating illithids , and also by the illithids , because of their imperfections . Regardless , their aptitude for stealth and psionic powers of shape changing made them useful spies for the illithids . Description . Their heads resembled the heads of normal illithids , except they only had three tentacles instead of four , and lacked a mouth . Because of this , they could only consume the fluids of the brain rather than the brain itself . Their tentacles faded in and out of the shadows and their skin was pitch black . Society . Mozgriken culture took elements from both their svirfneblin and illithid ancestries . Within illithid hives , these creatures were extremely meek as a result of their treatment by the illithids .

title: Mreeiel Klintar
description: Mreeiel Klintar Mreeiel Klintar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , Chyndrie Stormwind , and Noelin Tlestlin .
description_long: Mreeiel Klintar Mreeiel Klintar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , Chyndrie Stormwind , and Noelin Tlestlin . However , the four women got along well with one another , and commonly named Beliot as " the chief adventurer in our band " . They even referred to him as " Chief Adventurer " when speaking to patrons of the inn , instead of more proper terms like " innkeeper " , " master of the house " , or " hostler " , which led to some confusion . Appendix . Notes . As noted in the source , one person in Sevenecho , likely one of the chambermaids , is an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay , making a small chance that this is Mreeiel .

title: Mreskan Haundle
description: Mreskan Haundle Mreskan Haundle was the seneschal of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Description . Mreskan was an old but kind man .
description_long: Mreskan Haundle Mreskan Haundle was the seneschal of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Description . Mreskan was an old but kind man . Activities . When King Ornan Roaryl was traveling across the kingdom , Mreskan was left in charge of the rule of Eskorn . He used the Seeing Stones to communicate with the king whenever was needed .

title: Mreyelundar
description: Mreyelundar Mreyelundar was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was the most decadent of all the Dusk Ports . Background .
description_long: Mreyelundar Mreyelundar was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was the most decadent of all the Dusk Ports . Background . Mreyelundar was known for its wealth , decadence , lawlessness , and illicit practices . Gangs dominated the city and gained great wealth after having paid the green dragon Orlarrakh her due . The free people of Mreyelundar loathed dragon s , having suffered first hand the depredations of the Green Duchess . In desperation , most of them turned to the cults of the Dawn Titans for succor . The Order of the Dawn , founded some years before 1479 DR , gained enough influence to be considered a real force behind Mreyelundar ' s closed doors . Government . Mreyelundar was ruled by a Gate Lord . In 1479 DR , the Gate Lord was Trusk Rantyne . However , he had no real power in the city , who was truly ruled by a mysterious thief known as Narnorn . Economy . The foremost goldsmiths and gemcutters in all of Returned Abeir lived and worked in Mreyelundar .

title: Mrinabnahor
description: Mrinabnahor Mrinabnahor was a black dragon who laired in the mountains west of the Moonsea . In 590 DR , he battled and killed Arms - Major Pirphal of Myth Drannor , along with most of his patrol . Pirphal ' s sword , " Dragathil " , was added to Mrinabnahor ' s hoard and remained lost for the next four centuries .
description_long: Mrinabnahor Mrinabnahor was a black dragon who laired in the mountains west of the Moonsea . In 590 DR , he battled and killed Arms - Major Pirphal of Myth Drannor , along with most of his patrol . Pirphal ' s sword , " Dragathil " , was added to Mrinabnahor ' s hoard and remained lost for the next four centuries .

title: Mrinden
description: Mrinden Mrinden was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Mrinden fought with his companion Kalassyn in Daggerdale .
description_long: Mrinden Mrinden was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Mrinden fought with his companion Kalassyn in Daggerdale . In 1358 DR , Mrinden was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . Together with Kalassyn and a group of Zhentilar soldiers , he found a " gate " and a dead guard . They entered the " gate " but suddenly a meteor — a symptom of the Time of Troubles — hit their squad , killing most of them , including Mrinden .

title: Mu ' izzi al - Kamar
description: Mu ' izzi al - Kamar Mu ' izzi al - Kamar was the head of the House of Al - Kamari in 1367 DR . Activities . As of 1367 , Mu ' izzi had been the head of the family for two decades .
description_long: Mu ' izzi al - Kamar Mu ' izzi al - Kamar was the head of the House of Al - Kamari in 1367 DR . Activities . As of 1367 , Mu ' izzi had been the head of the family for two decades . Rumors and Legends . Unbeknownst to his family , Mu ' izzi was possessed by a high priest of the yak - men called the Unspeakable . History . During the mid - 1340 ' s DR , Mu ' izzi undertook an expedition to discover a new trade route through the Haunted Lands to Utaqa . This trip forever changed his life . The caravan was scattered by a violent sandstorm and Mu ' izzi was captured by a pair of dao slaves who delivered the patriarch into the hands of the yikarians . The leader of that group of yikarians , a powerful creature named the Unspeakable possessed Mu ' izzi ' s mind and body , controlling the patriarch for decades . Mu ' izzi could still see and hear through his body , but was unable to do anything about the possession . The ordeal eventually drove him insane .

title: Mu Tong
description: Mu Tong Mu Tong was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay near the headwaters of the Malu River , high in the Sillan Mountains . Jade was discovered near Mu Tong in 1357 DR .
description_long: Mu Tong Mu Tong was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay near the headwaters of the Malu River , high in the Sillan Mountains . Jade was discovered near Mu Tong in 1357 DR . Folk believed that these finds were evidence of a massive hoard of jade said to be hidden somewhere in the mountains by the ancient Han people , ancestors of the Koryoans , when they ' d fled invasion by the forces of Shou Lung .

title: Muaraghal Mountains
description: Muaraghal Mountains The Muaraghal Mountains were a range of mountains in the Shining South that formed the eastern border of Halruaa . Geography . This mountain ranged formed the eastern border of Halruaa , offering natural protection .
description_long: Muaraghal Mountains The Muaraghal Mountains were a range of mountains in the Shining South that formed the eastern border of Halruaa . Geography . This mountain ranged formed the eastern border of Halruaa , offering natural protection . The Azhal Pass cut through the mountains , but was not an easy land route for any sizable force . Fauna . Many dangerous species were known to inhabit the region closer toward the Nath along the outside edge of the mountains . These included Cyclopskin , Manticore s , Roc s , Cockatrice s , and Medusae .

title: Mucknuggle
description: Mucknuggle Mucknuggle was an elderly duergar who worked in Mithral Hall , during the reign of Haerinvureem . Description . The dwarf had a long gray beard .
description_long: Mucknuggle Mucknuggle was an elderly duergar who worked in Mithral Hall , during the reign of Haerinvureem . Description . The dwarf had a long gray beard . Relationships . Mucknuggle was a member of Clan Bukbukken under the command of the shadow dragon . Possessions . When on patrol , the guard wore mithral chainmail and fought with a broadsword and shield . History . In 1356 DR , Mucknuggle encountered Drizzt Do ' Urden and Artemis Entreri in the lower tunnels of Mithral Hall . In a later skirmish , Mucknuggle was killed when the assassin put a dagger through his eye when Drizzt showed the dwarf mercy .

title: Mud armor
description: Mud armor Mud armor armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Mud armor is a crude form of armor made from drying mud on the skin of the wearer .
description_long: Mud armor Mud armor armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Mud armor is a crude form of armor made from drying mud on the skin of the wearer . Only certain types of mud are suited to this purpose , and the armor will crumble into uselessness after a day or two . It takes around ten minutes to apply or wash off mud armor , and it weighs around 8 lb ( 4 kg ) . The only creatures known to use mud armor as of 1372 DR were wild dwarves .

title: Mudflow
description: Mudflow The Mudflows were strange rivers of warm mud that were more common in the eastern and southern regions of the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . The mudflows released dangerous gases that caused dizziness or , with prolonged exposure , even death .
description_long: Mudflow The Mudflows were strange rivers of warm mud that were more common in the eastern and southern regions of the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . The mudflows released dangerous gases that caused dizziness or , with prolonged exposure , even death . The waters of the mudflows eventually cooled and later detonated in strange storms of mud that blew up ores of strange metals in the surrounding areas . Swordlanders sought out the mudflows because of that .

title: Muhjari
description: Muhjari Muhjari was a set of faith - based laws followed by many in Semphar and surrounding lands . These laws promoted the idea that activities such as drinking , gambling , sexual proclivity and other vices were sinful and should be avoided . Adherence to these laws was most common among the poor but enforcement varied from place to place .
description_long: Muhjari Muhjari was a set of faith - based laws followed by many in Semphar and surrounding lands . These laws promoted the idea that activities such as drinking , gambling , sexual proclivity and other vices were sinful and should be avoided . Adherence to these laws was most common among the poor but enforcement varied from place to place . There was at least one extremist sect of Muhjari followers who rejected all forms of pleasure and practiced fasting , even going as far to reject priests of their gods who did not follow Muhjari . Breaking the laws of Muhjari in Dhaztanar was not a good idea as the Caliph , Abu Bakr maintained that he was a devout follower of Muhjari and to demonstrate this , he strictly prohibited alcohol inside the walls of the Medinat and his troops were tasked with finding and shutting down establishments that trafficed in ale , wine and spirits . He imposed particularly harsh punishments on those caught doing so . In contrast , Port Ghaast in Murghôm , although predominantly populated by followers of Muhjari , saw drinking , gambling and womanizing as common activities .

title: Mujibur
description: Mujibur Mujibur was tasked slayer genie who lived within the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Activities . Muhibur served Nar - Aidiya and the Brotherhood of the True Flame guarding and tending the Great Garden of the fortress .
description_long: Mujibur Mujibur was tasked slayer genie who lived within the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Activities . Muhibur served Nar - Aidiya and the Brotherhood of the True Flame guarding and tending the Great Garden of the fortress . A quartet of copper automaton s worked beneath him .

title: Muki Nobi
description: Muki Nobi Muki Nobi was the daimyo of Chozawa around 1357 DR . History . Muki was the son of Toyo Nobi , a key military advisor and the close personal friend of shogun Matasuuri Nagahide ' s father .
description_long: Muki Nobi Muki Nobi was the daimyo of Chozawa around 1357 DR . History . Muki was the son of Toyo Nobi , a key military advisor and the close personal friend of shogun Matasuuri Nagahide ' s father . However , when Muki was 11 , his whole family , including his father , were killed by bandits . That night , he silently entered the bandits ' camp and killed all them in their sleep . All this was observed by a tengu tribe that was impressed by the young Muki that they invited him to their village . Muki remained with the tengu for two years , learning much about military warfare and guerrilla tactics . Afterward , he went back to civilization and soon Nagahide appointed him as daimyo of Chozawa and one of the Three House daimyos . Personality . Muki was a soldier at heart , always waiting for the next time to led his men in a battle . He was also brutal and unforgiving , adorning his land with the impaled decapitated heads of state enemies .

title: Mukteff
description: Mukteff A mukteff was a rare breed of sled dog native to Nakvaligach , in the Great Glacier . Description . Like all sled dogs , mukteff had short snouts and bright eyes .
description_long: Mukteff A mukteff was a rare breed of sled dog native to Nakvaligach , in the Great Glacier . Description . Like all sled dogs , mukteff had short snouts and bright eyes . They had very thick gold fur and black paws . Their paws were broad to make running on snow easier . A mukteff weighed between 80 and 100 pounds ( 36 to 45 kilograms ) . Society . In the wild , mukteff lived in packs of between a half and two dozen dogs . They ate any type of animal parts and were excellent pack hunters with superb senses of smell , being able to recognize prey from as far as 10 miles ( 16 kilometers ) away by scent . When domesticated , mukteff could communicate specific types of prey to their owners by using distinct tones of barks or growls . A sled dog would fight to the death to defend its owner , so loyal they were . Availability . Outside of Nakvaligach , mukteff could also be purchased from the tiny village of Koyoss in Alpuk .

title: Mulahey
description: Mulahey Mulahey was a half - orc cleric of Cyric who was sent by Tazok to sabotage the Nashkel mines on behalf of Sarevok and the Iron Throne . He set up his headquarters below the third level of the mine , and started sending kobold minions up to poison the iron from the mine with mineral poison provided by his superiors , helping to orchestrate an iron shortage the Iron Throne would take advantage of . Against orders given to Tazok , the kobolds took to attacking and killing the miners , though Mulahey still remained undetected for a time , hidden so deep down few dared to venture there .
description_long: Mulahey Mulahey was a half - orc cleric of Cyric who was sent by Tazok to sabotage the Nashkel mines on behalf of Sarevok and the Iron Throne . He set up his headquarters below the third level of the mine , and started sending kobold minions up to poison the iron from the mine with mineral poison provided by his superiors , helping to orchestrate an iron shortage the Iron Throne would take advantage of . Against orders given to Tazok , the kobolds took to attacking and killing the miners , though Mulahey still remained undetected for a time , hidden so deep down few dared to venture there . Nevertheless , his superiors were displeased with his performance , and by the time he was finally uncovered and killed by Gorion ' s Ward , he was living in fear of assassins sent after him .

title: Mulahid
description: Mulahid Mulahid was an efreeti of Zakharan folklore . History . Mulahid fell in love with the Grandmother of the Everlasting — a woman said to be so fierce that even lion s would get out of her way .
description_long: Mulahid Mulahid was an efreeti of Zakharan folklore . History . Mulahid fell in love with the Grandmother of the Everlasting — a woman said to be so fierce that even lion s would get out of her way . Unable to snare her heart by conventional means , Mulahid threatened to kill the Grandmother ' s followers if she did not submit to his cravings . The Grandmother agreed to spend the night with Mulahid if he released her followers and promised not to harm them . The two met in a remote cave beneath the World Pillar Mountains . The beguiling Grandmother turned Mulahid ' s lust against him , binding the efreeti with chains of affection . Mulahid promised to serve the Grandmother by ensuring the faithfulness of her followers . This historical event marked the creation of the first oathbinder genie .

title: Mulan
description: Mulan The Mulan were a human ethnic group non - native to Toril . Appearance . Mulan were typically tall and thin with a sallow skin tone and brown or hazel eyes .
description_long: Mulan The Mulan were a human ethnic group non - native to Toril . Appearance . Mulan were typically tall and thin with a sallow skin tone and brown or hazel eyes . Lower class Mulan of Thay , Mulhorand , and Unther frequently had significant Rashemi or Turmish blood , resulting in darker complexions . Pure Mulan features were rare in Chessenta due to mixing with the nearby Chondathan s . Mulan often had little body hair , ranging in color from black to dark brown , and all nobles and many other Mulan of both genders shaved any hair they did have . Mulan generally preferred simple , unadorned clothing , particularly those that worshipped the god - kings , so as not to outshine them . Other differences in appearance varied by region ; for example , Mulan Red Wizards of Thay were often heavily tattooed . Regions . The Mulan had controlled the eastern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars since the fall of ancient Imaskar . They had been the ruling elite in many different nations throughout their long history , including Ashanath , Chessenta , the Eastern Shaar , Mulhorand , Murghom , Rashemen , Semphar , Thay , Thesk , Unther , and the Wizard ' s Reach cities south of the Yuirwood .

title: Mulani languages
description: Mulani languages The Mulani languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in East Faerûn by the Mulan people . Subgroups . The Mulani languages were further subdivided into the Mulhorandi and Muhjuri branches .
description_long: Mulani languages The Mulani languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in East Faerûn by the Mulan people . Subgroups . The Mulani languages were further subdivided into the Mulhorandi and Muhjuri branches . History . The Mulani languages derived in part from a slave argot of one or more of the Imaskari languages . Over the millennia , the Mulani tongues remained more similar to their Rauric roots than did the Untheric languages . Appendix . Inspiration . The grouping of the Mulani languages was inspired by the real - life languages , such as , , and .

title: Mulcaster Emmarask
description: Mulcaster Emmarask Mulcaster Emmarask was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of Emmarask noble family . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Mulcaster proposed a plan for an eleven - person council , comprised entirely of members of old families like the Illance s and the Emmarasks .
description_long: Mulcaster Emmarask Mulcaster Emmarask was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of Emmarask noble family . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Mulcaster proposed a plan for an eleven - person council , comprised entirely of members of old families like the Illance s and the Emmarasks . He said it was once the will of Alusair Obarskyr , Filfaeril Obarskyr , and Caladnei . However , the ghost of Alusair arrived and proclaimed his claim to be false .

title: Muldiver
description: Muldiver Muldiver was a master shipwright of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Muldiver worked out of a shipyard in Tantras ' s harbor . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , Muldiver was kept very busy with the city ' s preparations for war against Zhentil Keep .
description_long: Muldiver Muldiver was a master shipwright of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Muldiver worked out of a shipyard in Tantras ' s harbor . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , Muldiver was kept very busy with the city ' s preparations for war against Zhentil Keep .

title: Mule
description: Mule Mules were pack animals specifically bred for labor . They were a cross between horse s and donkey s , intended to share the best traits of both animals . They were more sure - footed , hardy , and longer - lived than horses , and faster and more intelligent than donkeys .
description_long: Mule Mules were pack animals specifically bred for labor . They were a cross between horse s and donkey s , intended to share the best traits of both animals . They were more sure - footed , hardy , and longer - lived than horses , and faster and more intelligent than donkeys . Mules were infertile .

title: Mulgor
description: Mulgor Mulgor of Tyr was a diligent yet patient tax collector within the city of Waterdeep as well as a member of the City Watch . He also served in ceremonies at the temple of Tyr known as the Halls of Justice and could occasionally be found at the Elfstone Tavern .
description_long: Mulgor Mulgor of Tyr was a diligent yet patient tax collector within the city of Waterdeep as well as a member of the City Watch . He also served in ceremonies at the temple of Tyr known as the Halls of Justice and could occasionally be found at the Elfstone Tavern .

title: Mulhorand
description: Mulhorand Mulhorand ( muhl - HOH - rand ) was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Mulhorandi were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , Ao contacted Ptah who led a part of the Mulhorandi pantheon to Toril .
description_long: Mulhorand Mulhorand ( muhl - HOH - rand ) was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Mulhorandi were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , Ao contacted Ptah who led a part of the Mulhorandi pantheon to Toril . Ironically , their rival in the millennia to come was another human tribe captured by the Imaskari at the same time , which founded the empire of Unther . Mulhorand was destroyed by the Spellplague and the empire of High Imaskar came to comprise its former territories . After the Chosen of the Mulhorandi gods appeared around the time of the First Sundering , however , they and the wizard Nezram rallied the Mulan to overthrow the Imaskari once more , driving them into the Plains of Purple Dust . People and culture . The populace of Mulhorand is primarily composed of humans of three primary ethnic factions : the Mulan , the Turami , and slaves from Thay known as Tethens . Other races proved hesitant to follow the Mulhorandi pantheon upon the nation ' s founding , and were exiled at that time ; the non human population remains low as a result .

title: Mulhorandi language
description: Mulhorandi language Mulhorandi was a regional tongue of East Faerûn , and the official language of Mulhorand and Thay . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Murghôm , Semphar , and Chessenta . In most areas where Mulhorandi was spoken , it used the Celestial alphabet ; however , Thay used the Infernal alphabet instead .
description_long: Mulhorandi language Mulhorandi was a regional tongue of East Faerûn , and the official language of Mulhorand and Thay . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Murghôm , Semphar , and Chessenta . In most areas where Mulhorandi was spoken , it used the Celestial alphabet ; however , Thay used the Infernal alphabet instead . Common Mulhorandi surnames included Ankhalab , Anskuld , Fezim , Hahpet , Nathandem , Sepret , and Uuthrakt .

title: Mulhorandi languages
description: Mulhorandi languages The Mulhorandi languages were a sub - grouping of the Mulani languages and members of the Rauric languages family . Languages . This sub - grouping included the tightly related languages Mulhorandi and Thayan .
description_long: Mulhorandi languages The Mulhorandi languages were a sub - grouping of the Mulani languages and members of the Rauric languages family . Languages . This sub - grouping included the tightly related languages Mulhorandi and Thayan . Some scholars did not recognize these two languages as distinct and only recognized a single Mulhorandi language . Grammar . The Mulhorandi languages were highly inflected , and word order was of only minor importance . The languages sounded thick and slow to speakers of many other languages . Scripts . In their earliest forms , the Mulhorandi languages used a of writing , which included pictographs to represent concepts . Over the millennia , the written form of the languages were simplified yet still contained tens of thousands of pictographs . By the late 14 century DR , speakers of Mulhorandi proper tended to use the Celestial alphabet instead , which was taught to them by the god Thoth , while those speaking Thayan utilized Infernal in their writing . History . It has been theorized that priestly rituals played a strong role in the sound and cadence of these languages .

title: Mulhorandi pantheon
description: Mulhorandi pantheon The Mulhorandi pantheon consisted of the deities worshiped in Mulhorand . Their domain was Heliopolis . When the Imaskar i captured the Mulan people and brought them to Toril , the slaves also brought the worship of their deities .
description_long: Mulhorandi pantheon The Mulhorandi pantheon consisted of the deities worshiped in Mulhorand . Their domain was Heliopolis . When the Imaskar i captured the Mulan people and brought them to Toril , the slaves also brought the worship of their deities . With help from Ao , these deities were able to follow their worshipers and end their servitude . After the destruction of Mulhorand by the Spellplague , the Mulhorandi pantheon disappeared .

title: Mullivan
description: Mullivan Mullivan was a former adventurer and mind - thrall in Oryndoll in 1370 DR . History . Mullivan was a ranger and leader of an adventuring party from Almraiven .
description_long: Mullivan Mullivan was a former adventurer and mind - thrall in Oryndoll in 1370 DR . History . Mullivan was a ranger and leader of an adventuring party from Almraiven . His mission soon became cleansing Calimshan and Tethyr from mind flayer influence . Finally , in the Forest of Mir , they discovered caves to the Underdark . Incautiously , Mullivan lead his comrades down and they arrived at the gates of Oryndoll . Mullivan sacrificed his own life to permit to a handful of his friends to escape . Afterward , the survivors of that expedition renamed themselves the Scimitars of Mullivan and started a war against Oryndoll , directing many adventuring parties against illithids and continuing their cleansing of the surface from mind flayer influence . Unknown to his friends , however , Mullivan was alive — he was resurrected by illithids using a new psionic science similar to a " raise dead " spell . Thereafter , the illithids used Mullivan as a mind - thrall , but unknown to his illithid masters , the resurrection gave Mullivan some kind of psionic immunity and he kept a degree of free will . Mullivan then waited for the right time to escape .

title: Mulmaster
description: Mulmaster Mulmaster was a city located in the rugged area west of the Earthspur and Galena Mountains in the eastern part of the Moonsea region . After years of opposition , the city finally joined the Zhentarim , becoming a decadent sprawl riddled with crime and corruption . The buildings nearest the docks were the most dilapidated and dangerous , full of poverty and rife with crime .
description_long: Mulmaster Mulmaster was a city located in the rugged area west of the Earthspur and Galena Mountains in the eastern part of the Moonsea region . After years of opposition , the city finally joined the Zhentarim , becoming a decadent sprawl riddled with crime and corruption . The buildings nearest the docks were the most dilapidated and dangerous , full of poverty and rife with crime . The rich area of the city resided further up the mountainside , imposing its will over the rest of Mulmaster . A person from Mulmaster was known as a Mulmasterite . The lands surrounding Mulmaster were treacherous to cross and boasted many dangers to its inhabitants . The majority of the land traffic through Mulmaster came from the south , intersecting with Cormanthor , The Vast and the eastern region of the Dragon Reach . With the exception of Ironfang Keep , there were few settlements near Mulmaster in the eastern Moonsea . Government . The grand city of Mulmaster was ruled by the governing council known as the Blades , lead by High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin .

title: Mulmaster Beholder Corps
description: Mulmaster Beholder Corps The Mulmaster Beholder Corps were a group of beholder s in Mulmaster . History . All started circa 1384 DR when an eye tyrant clan ship crash - landed into a deep ravine in the Dragonspine Mountains .
description_long: Mulmaster Beholder Corps The Mulmaster Beholder Corps were a group of beholder s in Mulmaster . History . All started circa 1384 DR when an eye tyrant clan ship crash - landed into a deep ravine in the Dragonspine Mountains . Of the thirty - five beholder passengers , only fifteen survived . They used their eye rays to tunnel deeper in order to escape from the crashed ship and at last emerged in Mulmaster ' s sewers . They remained there , plotting their next move , and dreaming of maybe conquering the city . However , an adventuring party discovered their lair and caused the cavern to collapse on both adventurers and beholders . Only three beholders , Xorack , Xamott , and Xanshin survived . The three waited for a century , trying to come up with plan after plan to seize power while slowly tunneling their way out of their underground prison with their disintegration eyes . Finally , they emerged with a plan : summon a dozen spectator s in order to impersonate the other beholders . So the newly assembled Mulmaster Beholder Corps became a notable organization in the city , with everyone opposing them believing they had to face fifteen beholders together .

title: Muln Horan
description: Muln Horan Muln Horan was a dwarf soldier in Neverwinter . Activities . Muln was a top advisor to General Sabine , and remained in control of a part of the city when the general was busy in other places .
description_long: Muln Horan Muln Horan was a dwarf soldier in Neverwinter . Activities . Muln was a top advisor to General Sabine , and remained in control of a part of the city when the general was busy in other places . Personality . Muln hid his feeling for his general with violence . History . In 1479 DR , he investigated cases of kidnapping . He was with his men at the Beached Leviathan tavern intimidating an adventuring party that came to be involved in the matter when some Ashmadai and a bound devil attacked . It was only thanks to the adventurers that Muln defeated the enemies . He however died in the chaos of the subsequent Night of the Madness .

title: Mulnis Lenz
description: Mulnis Lenz Mulnis Lenz was a caravan leader and warehouse owner in 1359 DR . History . In 1359 Mulnis led a caravan from Waterdeep to Cormyr with a stop in Teziir .
description_long: Mulnis Lenz Mulnis Lenz was a caravan leader and warehouse owner in 1359 DR . History . In 1359 Mulnis led a caravan from Waterdeep to Cormyr with a stop in Teziir . Secretly he was transporting a gift from the Lords of Waterdeep to King Azoun Obarskyr IV .

title: Mulsantir
description: Mulsantir Mulsantir was a large city in southwest Rashemen . It was located on the northern shore of the River Mulsantir , just west of Lake Mulsantir . History .
description_long: Mulsantir Mulsantir was a large city in southwest Rashemen . It was located on the northern shore of the River Mulsantir , just west of Lake Mulsantir . History . Mulsantir sprung up as a re - provisioning point on the caravan route along the Golden Way . In 1372 , a Thayan emissary named Khalia arrived in Mulsantir desiring the creation of a Thayan enclave . She was refused permission , but allowed to leave the city alive . People . Mulsantir was populated with a variety of people , witches were a rather common sight here and they were feared for their powers , warlocks drifted in and out of the city , and many people spoke of a nearby Citadel . Fishermen netted sturgeon from the nearby lake and farmers from the surrounding land sold food the the caravans that pass through Mulsantir . Defenses . The city was protected by extensive solid stone walls . The defenders of the city , The Urphong ' s Host , numbered over 400 strong and were made up of barbarians and warriors .

title: Mulser
description: Mulser Mulser was a male warrior and a member of the Zhentilar in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Mulser was part of a secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .
description_long: Mulser Mulser was a male warrior and a member of the Zhentilar in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Mulser was part of a secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale . However , his patrol was attacked and defeated by Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr . Before he died , Elminster pretended to be a Zhentarim lord and interrogated him to discover all the details of the Zhent plot against the dale .

title: Multon Weny
description: Multon Weny Multon Weny was a magic - user in Hades in 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 Multon went in Hades in search of his brother Drado Weny but like his brother was enslaved by the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .
description_long: Multon Weny Multon Weny was a magic - user in Hades in 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 Multon went in Hades in search of his brother Drado Weny but like his brother was enslaved by the arcanaloth Yrkhetep . He was choose to lead an unit of skeleton s and an unit of zombie in the Yrkhetep ' s army .

title: Muluk
description: Muluk Muluk , located on the mouth of Al - Zalim River , was one of the Free Cities of Zakhara . Renowned as a trading city , Muluk specialized in many goods including regal purple dye . Its established unbroken line of rulers gave it the name " City of Kings " .
description_long: Muluk Muluk , located on the mouth of Al - Zalim River , was one of the Free Cities of Zakhara . Renowned as a trading city , Muluk specialized in many goods including regal purple dye . Its established unbroken line of rulers gave it the name " City of Kings " . It was located between the cities of Umara to the south and Qadib to the north . Inhabitants . Muluk was the base for the Respected Mamluk Society .

title: Mummy
description: Mummy A mummy is an undead creature , usually of lawful evil alignment , created from a preserved corpse that have been animated by the dark gods of the desert . These horrid creatures are often marked with symbols of the dire gods they serve . While other undead often stink of carrion , the herbs and powders used to create a mummy give off a sharp , pungent odor like that of a spice cabinet .
description_long: Mummy A mummy is an undead creature , usually of lawful evil alignment , created from a preserved corpse that have been animated by the dark gods of the desert . These horrid creatures are often marked with symbols of the dire gods they serve . While other undead often stink of carrion , the herbs and powders used to create a mummy give off a sharp , pungent odor like that of a spice cabinet . Mummies cause fear in the living on sight , and any creature they touch is affected by a rotting curse called mummy rot . Inhabiting great tombs or temple complexes they maintain a timeless vigil and destroying would - be grave robbers . Mummies are the undead guardians of tombs and vaults of honored dead ( such as kings or nobility of the ancient world ) . They patrol their homes with dedication , remaining alert for signs of tomb robbers or others who would desecrate their assigned lair . Creation . The creation of a mummy is a long and gruesome process , involving separating the internal organs of the prepared body . The body is then wrapped in expensive linens and anointed with sacred oils . When the tomb is finally sealed , the mummy awakens in an undead state . Combat .

title: Mummy rot
description: Mummy rot Mummy rot was a condition inflicted upon victims by the touch of a mummy . It was usually fatal unless cured . Mummy rot was a disease that occurred in various strains and could be natural or magical ( like a curse ) in nature , which required different methods to cure .
description_long: Mummy rot Mummy rot was a condition inflicted upon victims by the touch of a mummy . It was usually fatal unless cured . Mummy rot was a disease that occurred in various strains and could be natural or magical ( like a curse ) in nature , which required different methods to cure . Acquisition . The primary way to contract this disease was to be successfully touched by a mummy . There was also a necromancy spell called " mummy touch " that gave the caster the ability to bestow a form of the disease on a victim by touch , while rendering the caster immune to mummy rot for the duration of the spell . Effects . Mummy rot came in different strains . One version immediately prevented all magical " cure " spells and slowed normal healing , requiring a recuperative period ten times the normal duration for a wound to heal . As the disease progressed , it slowly rotted parts of the victim ' s body until they sloughed off or fell off , permanently disfiguring them , and it was ultimately fatal in one to six months . Upon death , either by mummy rot or by mummy violence , the victim completely rotted away in one hour .

title: Mummy touch
description: Mummy touch Mummy touch was a necromancy spell that gave the caster temporary immunity to mummy rot and imbued him or her with a mummy ' s ability to inflict the disease on others by touch . Effects . " Mummy touch " lasted one minute per experience level of the caster .
description_long: Mummy touch Mummy touch was a necromancy spell that gave the caster temporary immunity to mummy rot and imbued him or her with a mummy ' s ability to inflict the disease on others by touch . Effects . " Mummy touch " lasted one minute per experience level of the caster . During that time , the caster was immune to the touch of a mummy and all creatures touched by the caster had a chance to contract mummy rot . ( See the mummy rot page for a description of the disease . ) Creatures normally immune to mummy rot , like an iron golem or xorn for example , were unaffected by this spell . " Mummy touch " could not be granted to someone other than the caster . Mummy rot could not be placed on a weapon or used to contaminate food or drink in order to transfer the disease ; it could only be conferred by touch . The disease created by this spell could be remedied by " cure disease " and stronger spells that performed the same function . It did not have the property that corpses of mummy victims rotted away in an hour . If the spell was active at the time the caster was slain , his or her corpse did not rot .

title: Munaa el Tarshaj
description: Munaa el Tarshaj Munaa yr Shunnari el Tarshaj was the fifth daughter of Syl - Pasha Kadar el Tarshaj of Calimport . She became the second wife of Akkabar Shoon the Elder on Midsummer of −78 DR . As a wedding gift , her father made Akkabar the Elder the Syl - Vizar and ruler of Memnon .
description_long: Munaa el Tarshaj Munaa yr Shunnari el Tarshaj was the fifth daughter of Syl - Pasha Kadar el Tarshaj of Calimport . She became the second wife of Akkabar Shoon the Elder on Midsummer of −78 DR . As a wedding gift , her father made Akkabar the Elder the Syl - Vizar and ruler of Memnon . Seven months after his marriage , Akkabar secretly had nearly all the members of Munaa ' s family murdered and took the throne of Calimshan from his father - in - law .

title: Muni - Ku
description: Muni - Ku Muni - Ku was a elder storyteller in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Once Muni - Ku was a cook in service of of the daimyo of Tifuido like her mother and her grandmother .
description_long: Muni - Ku Muni - Ku was a elder storyteller in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Once Muni - Ku was a cook in service of of the daimyo of Tifuido like her mother and her grandmother . One day she noticed that the head cook had prepared a soup for the daimyo accidentally using poisoned mushrooms . Nodoby believed to Muni - Ku that as last resort ate herself the soup , saving the daimyo and condemning herself . In the hour of her death Muni - Ku was visited by the dwarf god Suku - nabiko that thank to a ghostly mouth insured in her mouth saved her , also granting to Muni - Ku a great knowledge of world . From that day Muni - Ku traveled for all Wa telling stories and legends . Now at 80 years she continued her travels in perfect health . Nobody truly understood from where Muni - ku gained her health and knowledge .

title: Mur ' i bint Fatima
description: Mur ' i bint Fatima Mur ' i bint Fatima was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Mur ' i was responsible for collecting taxes from caravans and merchants passing through the Gate of Wealth .
description_long: Mur ' i bint Fatima Mur ' i bint Fatima was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Mur ' i was responsible for collecting taxes from caravans and merchants passing through the Gate of Wealth . Relationships . New to her post , Mur ' i recognized Farim ' s corrupt ways . Since the mamluk s under Farim ' s command remained loyal to him , there was not much that she could do about it .

title: Mur - zhagul
description: Mur - zhagul The Mur - zhagul ( or demon trolls ) are planetouched creatures descended from the cross - breeding of trolls and demon s . Description . Mur - zhagul appear as normal trolls in posture and shape .
description_long: Mur - zhagul The Mur - zhagul ( or demon trolls ) are planetouched creatures descended from the cross - breeding of trolls and demon s . Description . Mur - zhagul appear as normal trolls in posture and shape . Their skin however is red - orange and covered in fine scales . Personality . These monsters combine the savageness of normal trolls with the cunning of demons to a deadly end for many would - be adventurers . While they have enough intelligence to wear armor and carry weapons , most forego the weapons and use their claws to rip opponents to bloody shreds .

title: Muradi Lighthouse
description: Muradi Lighthouse The Muradi Lighthouse was a lighthouse standing at the very southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in the 14th century DR . History . In 1308 DR , Bosturo came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse .
description_long: Muradi Lighthouse The Muradi Lighthouse was a lighthouse standing at the very southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in the 14th century DR . History . In 1308 DR , Bosturo came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse . With dedicated service , he had held this position for 49 years by 1357 DR . At one point , he received a scroll of commendation from the ex - king of Silla , and displayed it proudly in his studio . Services . Atop the lighthouse was a huge oil lamp . Its purpose was to warn of the flaming seas that lay off the coast to the south . The lighthouse keeper , Bosturo , was also a noted scholar on the flora and fauna of Koryo , and gave his advice for a fee or a conversation .

title: Muragh Brilstagg
description: Muragh Brilstagg Muragh Brilstagg was a former cleric of Lathander in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Muragh in life was a very pretentious and critical person so a wizard , exasperated by him , curse d him : his soul never went to the Fugue Plane after his death but remained in his body .
description_long: Muragh Brilstagg Muragh Brilstagg was a former cleric of Lathander in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Muragh in life was a very pretentious and critical person so a wizard , exasperated by him , curse d him : his soul never went to the Fugue Plane after his death but remained in his body . A sailor severed Muragh ' s skull from his body and sunk it to the harbor . Somehow Muragh ' s skull ended in the hands of a wizard of the City Watch ( Waterdeep ) , that used him as watchdog in the wizard ' s library . One day however some thieves thieved him taking him to Undermountain . Even though adventurers on more than one occasion had taken Muragh from a chamber of the dungeon , the skull has somehow ended up in the same room again . Personality . Muragh truly wanted saw the sun again . However he still was a irascible and fussy individual very sarcastic with others . He never acknowledged Amaunator as his new god , losing all his clerical powers .

title: Murann
description: Murann Murann , known as the Sailors ' City , was a port city and the second - largest city of Amn . Geography . Murann was located in Tarseth Bay along the Sea of Swords .
description_long: Murann Murann , known as the Sailors ' City , was a port city and the second - largest city of Amn . Geography . Murann was located in Tarseth Bay along the Sea of Swords . Trade . Murann was located at the western end of the Tethir Road . The city ' s economy was based on sea trade , including shipbuilding and whaling . By 1369 DR , Murann had well - established transoceanic trade with Maztica . Defenses . The city was defended by the Harbor Guard ( 3 , 000 strong ) . History . Murann was established in 212 DR . In 1338 , the Murann Spice War occurred between the Ophal and Ulvax family holdings . In 1345 DR , the Cost Plague infected Murann , as well as other settlements in the area , killing 20 % of the population . In 1369 DR , three ships of the Vemmil clan returned from Zakhara . In Eleasis 1370 DR , the armies of Sothillis and Cyrvisnea attacked and laid siege to Murann . By Midsummer of 1371 DR , Murann fell to their forces .

title: Muranndin
description: Muranndin Muranndin was a kingdom in the Lands of Intrigue in western Faerûn . Geography . The monster kingdom of Muranndin bordered Amn in the north via the Small Teeth Mountains , Tethyr ' s northern Wealdath forest in the east , and west with the Dragon ' s Head peninsula .
description_long: Muranndin Muranndin was a kingdom in the Lands of Intrigue in western Faerûn . Geography . The monster kingdom of Muranndin bordered Amn in the north via the Small Teeth Mountains , Tethyr ' s northern Wealdath forest in the east , and west with the Dragon ' s Head peninsula . This left the independent duchy of Velen isolated from the rest of Faerûn . Government . The monarch of this kingdom was called the Great Mur which usually was the chieftain of the strongest tribe . The Great Mur was responsible for essentially keeping the other tribes and bandits together and prevent infighting between them . Muranndin also collected tolls on all traffic along the Trade Way and its marauders roamed all nearby lands . Trade . Slavery was the status quo since the foundation of the kingdom . The conquerors of the Murann city enslaved thousands of Amnians back in the 1370s and the descendants of those slaves served the ogre s , orc s , and brigands of the area . A slave in Muranndin could fight his way out by showing martial skill or usefulness enough to impress either his owner or one of the chieftains . Inhabitants .

title: Murdane
description: Murdane Murdane was a lesser deity of pragmatism and reason . Relationships . She was the lover of Helm the Watcher , god of guardians .
description_long: Murdane Murdane was a lesser deity of pragmatism and reason . Relationships . She was the lover of Helm the Watcher , god of guardians . History . During the divine event known as the Dawn Cataclysm , Lathander the Morninglord set into motion events that indirectly led to the death of Murdane . Murdane was drowned in the watery embrace of Umberlee , Queen of the Depths . This event was linked to the destruction of the empire of Jhaamdath beneath an enormous tsunami in the Year of Furious Waves , – 255 DR . However , cause and effect were unclear , whether Jhaamdath ' s flooding led to or was caused by Murdane ' s drowning was unknown . This caused Helm the Vigilant One to view Lathander with ill will .

title: Muren Khi
description: Muren Khi The Muren Khi , meaning River of Earth , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Beginning at the Nor Yudol lake in the Katakoro Plateau , and flowing east into Shou Lung , the Muren Khi formed the lower half of the Muren Tso river .
description_long: Muren Khi The Muren Khi , meaning River of Earth , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Beginning at the Nor Yudol lake in the Katakoro Plateau , and flowing east into Shou Lung , the Muren Khi formed the lower half of the Muren Tso river . The river got its name from the brown , silt infested , water it carried from the lake .
