The water of the river was otherwise normal , however , if properly gathered , and the correct prayers said , the water became a useful ingredient in healing potions . Due to these unique properties , several temples had built small shrines alongside the river to gather its water , and sometimes hired others to desecrate the shrines of rival temples .

title: Muren Tso
description: Muren Tso The Muren Tso , or the River of the Sky , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Fed by glaciers in the Katakoro Shan and A - Ling Shan mountain ranges , the Muren Tso river flowed across the Katakoro Plateau until it reached the Nor Yudol lake , continuing on as the Muren Khi .
description_long: Muren Tso The Muren Tso , or the River of the Sky , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Fed by glaciers in the Katakoro Shan and A - Ling Shan mountain ranges , the Muren Tso river flowed across the Katakoro Plateau until it reached the Nor Yudol lake , continuing on as the Muren Khi . The water of the river was clear and looked fresh , yet minerals from the mountains made the water bitter and mildly poisonous . Those who drank the water suffered from stomach cramps , nausea , and muscle pain . The nomads of the steppe were known to " forget " to tell travelers of the river ' s properties .

title: Murghôm
description: Murghôm Prior to the spellplague , Murghôm was an inland nation of farmers and horsemen in East Faerûn north of Brightstar Lake . It was theoretically a subjugated territory of Mulhorand . Inhabitants are referred to as Murghômi ; their second largest city is Phannaskul with another major town being the heavily militarized Port Ghaast .
description_long: Murghôm Prior to the spellplague , Murghôm was an inland nation of farmers and horsemen in East Faerûn north of Brightstar Lake . It was theoretically a subjugated territory of Mulhorand . Inhabitants are referred to as Murghômi ; their second largest city is Phannaskul with another major town being the heavily militarized Port Ghaast . The leaders of the Murghômi were called Ataman , and the people are known for their skill with horses . With their position beside Taan , the state as a series of semiautonomous communities that gather into collective government only in times of war . Along with the the Mulhorandi , Murghômi are ethnic Mulani known to be speakers of Mulhorandi and believers in the Mulhorandi pantheon . The city of Zindalankh hosted a Shou Town ( source ) . Post - spellplague the city states of Murghôm were ruled by dragons .

title: Murial
description: Murial Murial " the Misshapen " was an apprentice of Halaster Blackcloak , the Mad Mage of Undermountain . A capable fighter in his youth , Murial was recruited by Halaster as bodyguard but soon he started studied under Halaster and learned to magically graft materials together . When Halaster broke off all contact he descended into madness , grafting his torso unto the body of a giant scorpion to better engage in combat .
description_long: Murial Murial " the Misshapen " was an apprentice of Halaster Blackcloak , the Mad Mage of Undermountain . A capable fighter in his youth , Murial was recruited by Halaster as bodyguard but soon he started studied under Halaster and learned to magically graft materials together . When Halaster broke off all contact he descended into madness , grafting his torso unto the body of a giant scorpion to better engage in combat .

title: Muriel
description: Muriel Muriel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Muriel and some other monks were kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .
description_long: Muriel Muriel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Muriel and some other monks were kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node . In a room of the node ' s complex under the monastery , she met an adventuring party hired by Grandmaster Perrywinkle Shin to find the missing monks . The adventurers saved her from poison gas .

title: Murkolk Szolt
description: Murkolk Szolt Murkolk Szolt was the main duergar delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Murkolk become the representative of Gracklstugh in 1371 DR after his predecessor Gradoc Rockhand was thrown into the Darklake for his use of a " thought medallion " .
description_long: Murkolk Szolt Murkolk Szolt was the main duergar delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Murkolk become the representative of Gracklstugh in 1371 DR after his predecessor Gradoc Rockhand was thrown into the Darklake for his use of a " thought medallion " . Personality . Murkolk had a poker face , slept only four hours a night and hid his emotions very well .

title: Murmur
description: Murmur Murmur was a demon who was leader of the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye . He was able to turn nightmares into flesh and blood and was also capable of possessing people when they slept . He possessed one of the officers of the Firestorm Cabal and use her to recruit members of the cabal into the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye .
description_long: Murmur Murmur was a demon who was leader of the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye . He was able to turn nightmares into flesh and blood and was also capable of possessing people when they slept . He possessed one of the officers of the Firestorm Cabal and use her to recruit members of the cabal into the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye . Murmur was destroyed in 1479 DR in a fight with the deva Demascus and his friends . Demascus believed Murmur was from a reality outside Toril ' s universe . This proved to be correct , as Murmur was in fact a fragment of the Voidharrow , a dead universe that served as the prison of Tharizdun . Appearance . In his true form Murmur had black limbs and strange liquid crystal blood .

title: Murssvayas Dhuurniv
description: Murssvayas Dhuurniv Murssvayas Dhuurniv was a drow wizard and a former member of House Dhuurniv in Szith Morcane . History . In 1491 DR , his home was besieged by demon s and their fire giant minions from Maerimydra .
description_long: Murssvayas Dhuurniv Murssvayas Dhuurniv was a drow wizard and a former member of House Dhuurniv in Szith Morcane . History . In 1491 DR , his home was besieged by demon s and their fire giant minions from Maerimydra . He identified the elemental codex in Earthfast as a powerful weapon that could defeat the invading army . So he went to ask the dwarves for the codex , but was immediately rejected . Afterward , Murssvayas hired Furgis Boltsmelter to get it by illegal means . The criminal dwarf traveled to meet Murssvayas , but was pursued by the Earthfast dwarves and also by both the Cult of the Crushing Wave and the Cult of the Black Earth . At last , Murssvayas met Furgis and / or his adventuring party bodyguards in the Underdark , but at that time earth cultists led by Yegor tried one last time to kill all present and take the codex , but they were defeated . Later , after the fall of Szith Morcane , he was chosen by the archmage Solom Ned ' razak as his representative to hire an adventuring party in Elventree to save the drow alchemist Xaven Tanor ' this .

title: Mus
description: Mus Mus was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He was the head of a family of ogre mages . Activities .
description_long: Mus Mus was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He was the head of a family of ogre mages . Activities . The ogre planned to unleash a horde of sartani on the other islanders of Jazayir al - Sartan . He was able to summon the sartani by using special magical shells gifted to him by Kar ' r ' rga . Possessions . Mus had a collection of magical shells that could be used to summon and control sartani once dropped into sea water .

title: Musanna
description: Musanna Musanna was an aquatic elf warrior - priestess in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . In 1491 DR , Musanna led a patrol of her fellows in order to rescue her prince , Ulatha Mesavir , who had been kidnapped by the Cult of the Crushing Wave .
description_long: Musanna Musanna was an aquatic elf warrior - priestess in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . In 1491 DR , Musanna led a patrol of her fellows in order to rescue her prince , Ulatha Mesavir , who had been kidnapped by the Cult of the Crushing Wave . Musanna and her fellows inspected the ruined Fort Dalton , where they defeated some cultists and met an adventuring party hired to destroy a bandit group active near River Lis — in truth , the same cultists . Musanna likely joined the adventurers in their mission .

title: Mushakoji Nariakira
description: Mushakoji Nariakira Mushakoji Nariakira was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and the jito of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi .
description_long: Mushakoji Nariakira Mushakoji Nariakira was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and the jito of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi . Thanks to the growth of the village and the necessity of also managing the adjacent central Niwa shoen , he had to recruit fifteen more bushi but was sure to need more .

title: Mushigoto Tada
description: Mushigoto Tada Mushigoto Tada was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Mushigoto Tada was the shoya of the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Mushigoto Tada Mushigoto Tada was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Mushigoto Tada was the shoya of the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula . History . In 1358 DR , Tada was worried about a bajang living near the village . So when Yusuke T ' ing went back to the village with Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party , he asked the adventurers to kill the bajang .

title: Music of the spheres
description: Music of the spheres Music of the spheres was an enchantment spell that could prevent creatures from attacking the caster and make them more susceptible to other charms . Effects . Using a set of small silver bows , the magic of this spell produced heavenly music with such intricate harmonies and complex textures that the listeners were entranced with respect to the caster .
description_long: Music of the spheres Music of the spheres was an enchantment spell that could prevent creatures from attacking the caster and make them more susceptible to other charms . Effects . Using a set of small silver bows , the magic of this spell produced heavenly music with such intricate harmonies and complex textures that the listeners were entranced with respect to the caster . Those who were not able to resist the allure of the dulcet tones could not harm the caster for at least 13 minutes ( longer for more experienced casters ) and were much more vulnerable to spells such as " charm person " , " suggestion " , " hypnotism " , etc . for the duration of the spell . Those that managed to shake off the spell were unaffected and could attack as normal . Conditions had to be conducive to hearing the unearthly music for this spell to work . If the atmosphere was such that normal speech would not be heard , such as during a hurricane , a tumultuous battle , or in an area with a high level of background noise , then the spell would be practically useless . The listeners had to be intelligent enough to recognize music and be physically able to hear it .

title: Musil al - Samik
description: Musil al - Samik Musil al - Samik was a broker who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Musil acquired fabulous manors for wealthy pilgrims who traveled to Huzuz .
description_long: Musil al - Samik Musil al - Samik was a broker who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Musil acquired fabulous manors for wealthy pilgrims who traveled to Huzuz . Over the years he developed relationships with many members of the court . History . Musil initially traveled to Huzuz in 1347 DR as a pilgrim and priest of Zann . He discovered a talent for real estate and decided to pursue this new profession .

title: Mussum
description: Mussum Mussum was an abandoned city in Chondath , lying on the southeast shore of the Vilhon Reach . It was a plague - ridden ruin , but also home to the House of Holy Suffering , a major temple to Ilmater . History .
description_long: Mussum Mussum was an abandoned city in Chondath , lying on the southeast shore of the Vilhon Reach . It was a plague - ridden ruin , but also home to the House of Holy Suffering , a major temple to Ilmater . History . Mussum had risen as a city by 50 DR , together with Arrabar and Samra , all lying on the trade routes of the Vilhon Reach . Over the next century , Mussum and Samra came to compete with the existing city of Iljak for trade . This culminated in war in the Year of the King ' s Destiny , 137 DR . On Flamerule 12 , on the Sandshore outside Mussum , Iljak ' s army met Mussum ' s forces in battle . They fought for a whole fortnight , yet neither side could win the upper hand . Finally , early in Eleasias , the army of Samra sacked the city of Iljak then came to Mussum to assault the Iljak army ' s undefended flank . The Iljak army surrendered to Mussum and Samra , who then sold the survivors into slavery as their city was razed . By 139 DR , logging in the Chondalwood was well under way . Lumber came through the newly established city of Shamph and was dispersed through Arrabar , Samra , and Mussum .

title: Mustapha
description: Mustapha Mustapha was human physician inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Mustapha was a secretive individual .
description_long: Mustapha Mustapha was human physician inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Mustapha was a secretive individual . Activities . Mustapha was once a prominent healer known throughout Golden Huzuz . Due to financial ruin , he spent his twilight years roaming the bazaars and less savory areas of Huzuz , offering his services to any in need . Relationships . Mustapha abandoned his wife Bassorah one night after she used his money to host a lavish party .

title: Musukosan no Hashi
description: Musukosan no Hashi Musukosan no Hashi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hashi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District .
description_long: Musukosan no Hashi Musukosan no Hashi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hashi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District . He led around 300 yakuza . His main business was managing gambling houses and harassing local merchants and shippers . Hashi ' s main income came from the price that all must pay to dock in the port unless they wanted their ship destroyed . History . Hashi arrived in the city in 1354 DR and soon gathered around him the most violent yakuza . In 1357 DR , they came into conflict with Ebi ' s gang . They frequently fought in the streets . The situation reached the point that only one of the two gangs could survive .

title: Mutamin
description: Mutamin Mutamin was a gnome mage , possibly mad , who resided in an area known as Mutamin ' s Garden north of the halfling village of Gullykin . Activities . The gnome had trained the local basilisk population to attack and petrify wandering humanoids , but not to eat them , as Mutamin wanted to keep the statues of their victims as " art " .
description_long: Mutamin Mutamin was a gnome mage , possibly mad , who resided in an area known as Mutamin ' s Garden north of the halfling village of Gullykin . Activities . The gnome had trained the local basilisk population to attack and petrify wandering humanoids , but not to eat them , as Mutamin wanted to keep the statues of their victims as " art " . History . Mutamin was said to have died in 1368 DR at the hands of adventurers .

title: Mutamin ( NWN )
description: Mutamin ( NWN ) Mutamin was a retired adventurer who , using his funds left over from adventuring , built the Green Griffon Inn on the road just south of Luskan . Mutamin kept some unusual clientelle , but kept something even stranger underneath his tavern . He had gathered several monsters , extraplanar creatures and undead and placed them in a dungeon of his own devising , built underneath the inn and charged adventurers 500 gold pieces to try and overcome what was known as ' Mutamin ' s Challenge ' in an effort to earn themselves a full half of all the gold Mutamin earned during his adventuring career .
description_long: Mutamin ( NWN ) Mutamin was a retired adventurer who , using his funds left over from adventuring , built the Green Griffon Inn on the road just south of Luskan . Mutamin kept some unusual clientelle , but kept something even stranger underneath his tavern . He had gathered several monsters , extraplanar creatures and undead and placed them in a dungeon of his own devising , built underneath the inn and charged adventurers 500 gold pieces to try and overcome what was known as ' Mutamin ' s Challenge ' in an effort to earn themselves a full half of all the gold Mutamin earned during his adventuring career .

title: Muthoth
description: Muthoth Muthoth is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . Muthoth has sharp , haughty features .
description_long: Muthoth Muthoth is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . Muthoth has sharp , haughty features . During a fight with the bard Bareris Anskuld , Muthoth lost the fingers of his right hand . Importance . Muthoth was often accompanied by his fellow necromancer So - Kehur . Both played a key role during the battle at the Keep of Sorrows by killing the enemy warriors with the help of their dark craft and raising them as undead to add to Szass Tam ' s forces .

title: My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars
description: My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars was a book written by Nelve Harssad of Tsurlagol . It detailed the author ' s experiences while traveling on the Sea of Fallen Stars , and provided a great deal of lore about the area . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR .
description_long: My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars was a book written by Nelve Harssad of Tsurlagol . It detailed the author ' s experiences while traveling on the Sea of Fallen Stars , and provided a great deal of lore about the area . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR . References .

title: Myconid
description: Myconid Myconids , or " Fungus men , " are insidious fungal menaces from the Feywild caverns polluted by the fomorian s . Myconids strive only to spread across their territories , contaminating those places with its presence . The Oasis of the Stone King , where Drizzt Do ' Urden once dwelt , was home to a small community of myconids .
description_long: Myconid Myconids , or " Fungus men , " are insidious fungal menaces from the Feywild caverns polluted by the fomorian s . Myconids strive only to spread across their territories , contaminating those places with its presence . The Oasis of the Stone King , where Drizzt Do ' Urden once dwelt , was home to a small community of myconids . The myconids communicate telepathically , using spores which they blow from their mouths . Variants of these spores can also be used offensively , although they are not violent creatures and have , in fact , been known to share their territory . A group of about 370 myconids dwell in the Lowerdark city of Fluvenilstra under the leadership of Meln , their sovereign . Although the myconids appear to do nothing , they actually control the city ' s defense force of shambling mound s , phantom fungi , assassin vine s and other plant monsters . Colonies of myconids are also known to make their homes within the giant fungus known as Araumycos .

title: Mycontil
description: Mycontil Mycontil was an archmage who lived in Halruaa during ages past . Activities . Mycontil oversaw the destruction of a large group of barbarian invaders from Dambrath , valiantly giving his life to defend Halruaa against the enemy .
description_long: Mycontil Mycontil was an archmage who lived in Halruaa during ages past . Activities . Mycontil oversaw the destruction of a large group of barbarian invaders from Dambrath , valiantly giving his life to defend Halruaa against the enemy . Mycontil ' s force of only 500 was able to utterly repel the invading force of over 40 , 000 .

title: Mycontil ' s last resort
description: Mycontil ' s last resort Mycontil ' s last resort was a spell unique to Halruaa . History . This spell was rumored to by used by Mycontil himself during his final stand against the Dambraii invaders .
description_long: Mycontil ' s last resort Mycontil ' s last resort was a spell unique to Halruaa . History . This spell was rumored to by used by Mycontil himself during his final stand against the Dambraii invaders . Effects . This spell converted every spell memorized by a wizard into pure magical energy , allowing for an extremely deadly strike to every creature standing with 30 ft . ( 10 m ) of the caster . This spell even affected creatures with magical resistance , but with less power . The caster risked their life when casting this spell . If they were able to resist the deadly magic , then the caster was permanently weakened , often falling into a prolonged coma for several weeks . Components . This spell required a finger bone of an archmage to cast . Before casting , the finger bone needed to be prepared using a special ritual that lasted several days . Materials needed for the ritual included :

title: Mydianchlarus
description: Mydianchlarus Mydianchlarus was briefly the Oinoloth , ruler of the Wasting Tower of Khin - Oin . History . Mydianchlarus overthrew its predecessor , Anthraxus , at some point between 1357 DR and 1369 DR not through violence , but by Mydianchlarus whispering a secret in Anthraxus ' s ear so profound and disturbing that he was compelled to leave Khin - Oin and move on .
description_long: Mydianchlarus Mydianchlarus was briefly the Oinoloth , ruler of the Wasting Tower of Khin - Oin . History . Mydianchlarus overthrew its predecessor , Anthraxus , at some point between 1357 DR and 1369 DR not through violence , but by Mydianchlarus whispering a secret in Anthraxus ' s ear so profound and disturbing that he was compelled to leave Khin - Oin and move on . In approximately 1379 DR , however , Anthraxus marched on the Wasting Tower and challenged Mydianchlarus for control of the Siege Malicious . Though Mydianchlarus was slain , Anthraxus was thwarted in his attempt to wholly destroy his hated foe . The Sepulcher of Mydianchlarus now lingers as a burning reminder of Anthraxus ' s broken reign .

title: Myir
description: Myir The Myir were a tribe of people living in the town of Nathoud between Rashemen and the Hordelands . Activities . Famed for their prized Nathoudi stallion s , the Myir were not known for anything other than horse - breeding .
description_long: Myir The Myir were a tribe of people living in the town of Nathoud between Rashemen and the Hordelands . Activities . Famed for their prized Nathoudi stallion s , the Myir were not known for anything other than horse - breeding . History . Originally part of the Nar nation , the Myir adapted to the harsh life outside of Narfell . They abandoned their nomadic ways in favor of becoming sedentary farmers since they were not able to compete with the fierce Khassadi people of the region . As of the mid – 14th century DR , the Myir had been living a stationary existence for several centuries , but they were still poor in resources and technology compared to their neighbors .

title: Mykaro
description: Mykaro Mykaro , also known as , was a massive gemstone found in many hues as crystals or as crusts up to 2 in ( 5 cm ) thick in rock cavities . Description . These semi - precious stones were soft and durable when found as a crust , but brittle in crystal form .
description_long: Mykaro Mykaro , also known as , was a massive gemstone found in many hues as crystals or as crusts up to 2 in ( 5 cm ) thick in rock cavities . Description . These semi - precious stones were soft and durable when found as a crust , but brittle in crystal form . The varieties of color included yellow , straw yellow , pale brown , reddish brown , green , blue , and blue - green . It was usually cut , particularly if it was patterned with thick bands of varying colors , but was sometimes . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . These stones , regardless of color , were part of an unusual cure for blindness that worked even if the eyeballs had been destroyed . A mykaro stone was ground to powder and added to any nonalcoholic beverage . Then a wizard able to cast " wizard eye " immersed the invisible sensory organ created by that spell into the mixture and then removed it . If the afflicted person consumed the magically charged drink within 10 minutes , their blindness was cured in a matter of a few seconds . If the eyeballs were missing , they regenerated in about 10 minutes , at which time the person ' s vision was restored .

title: Mykros
description: Mykros Mykros was the commander of the army of Arcata in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Mykros was the right - hand man of Duke William Horgath .
description_long: Mykros Mykros was the commander of the army of Arcata in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Mykros was the right - hand man of Duke William Horgath . He was also in league with the Barony of Bloodstone . Personality . Mykros was a quiet and observant man . His loyalty was directed to the kingdom as a whole . For this he supported King Gareth Dragonsbane .

title: Mynda Idogyr
description: Mynda Idogyr Lady Mynda Idogyr was the wife of Lord Gamalon Idogyr , the Count of Spellshire in Tethyr . Activities . Because Gamalon was often busy at Faerntarn , the royal palace of Tethyr , Mynda controlled much of the administration of Spellshire .
description_long: Mynda Idogyr Lady Mynda Idogyr was the wife of Lord Gamalon Idogyr , the Count of Spellshire in Tethyr . Activities . Because Gamalon was often busy at Faerntarn , the royal palace of Tethyr , Mynda controlled much of the administration of Spellshire . Relationships . Mynda met her future husband on her home on the Rock of Bral in the Tears of Selûne , where she had grown up as a merchant ' s daughter . She ignored Gamalon for four years and thought he was odd - looking and boyish in appearance . Eventually , she warmed to his advances , and the two were happily married for 30 years and had a daughter named Lara . Mynda had served as hostess on some of Elminster and his scribe Lhaeo ' s visits to Bral , when she had lived there . She appreciated that he brought her gifts such as Calishite spices , but she despised his pipe - smoking habit . Her daughter , Lara enjoyed listening to Lhaeo ' s many stories . History . When the family moved to Toril to the lands of Gamalon ' s family , she had trouble adapting to the weather and the court intrigue in Faerûn . She did , however , enjoy her new courtly title and the benefits in livelihood that had come with that .

title: Myndlar
description: Myndlar Myndlar was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Myndlar hailed from Athkatla but settled in Candlekeep .
description_long: Myndlar Myndlar was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Myndlar hailed from Athkatla but settled in Candlekeep . In 1487 DR , Elminster Aumar , disguised as Andannas Dalkur , spoke to him about Orold Archemusk ' s writings . Personality . Myndlar believed that dragon s sought to steer human thought by writing books , purporting to be human women , and by sending dreams to humans who ' d established reputations as writers .

title: Mynteer
description: Mynteer Mynteer , also known as , was a hard , clear , and rare gemstone found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones occurred in crystals , usually with inclusions so that it yielded only small gems .
description_long: Mynteer Mynteer , also known as , was a hard , clear , and rare gemstone found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones occurred in crystals , usually with inclusions so that it yielded only small gems . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . This stone was powdered and mixed to make magical ink to inscribe scrolls for casting spells related to the movement of objects via levitation , telekinesis , or magical force , such as " unseen servant " , " Tenser ' s floating disc " , " etc . "

title: Myratma
description: Myratma Myratma was one of the most important cities in Tethyr , known around Faerûn for the quality of its textiles , owing to the output from the Tethyr Mills outside its walls . It was once called Artrimmar . Geography and Layout .
description_long: Myratma Myratma was one of the most important cities in Tethyr , known around Faerûn for the quality of its textiles , owing to the output from the Tethyr Mills outside its walls . It was once called Artrimmar . Geography and Layout . Myratma was located in County Elemetar in the Purple Marches at the intersection of the Red River and the River Ith . The city was divided into a total of six districts . Ten percent of the city was occupied by the former estate of the Jhannivvar clan , which was surrounded by its own wall in the northeast quadrant of the city . Architecture . The city was ancient and still bore signs of Calishite and even Dwarven architecture well into the 1370s DR . Ruined dwarven stonework could still be seen in the city walls and streets . Defenses . Myratma had three gates to defend entry into the city : Westgate , Southgate ( or " Trader ' s Gate " ) , and Eastgate . Each gate contained a contingent of 20 guards . Bridges crossed the rivers to reach Southgate and Westgate . Government . Officially , the city was ruled by the Myratman Town Council , which consisted of one Councilor for each of the six districts .

title: Myrddin Viligoth
description: Myrddin Viligoth Myrddin Viligoth was a former Red Wizards of Thay , now fighting for the good of Damara at the behest of god Ilmater History . Myrddin born in Thay with attitude to magic ; like all similar gifted children of that land he was enrolled in the tower of a Red Wizard to learn all about magic . He was a good student and become a powerful wizard in time ; but his heart was not filled with evil like all his fellow red wizards .
description_long: Myrddin Viligoth Myrddin Viligoth was a former Red Wizards of Thay , now fighting for the good of Damara at the behest of god Ilmater History . Myrddin born in Thay with attitude to magic ; like all similar gifted children of that land he was enrolled in the tower of a Red Wizard to learn all about magic . He was a good student and become a powerful wizard in time ; but his heart was not filled with evil like all his fellow red wizards . So Myrddin , having finally understanding the evil of the red wizards ways , gave the courage to escape Thay . He arrived in Damara just after the demise of Zhengyi , hoping to teach the Damaran about evilness of Thay . First he was welcomed with suspects and doubts but finally the wizard Emelyn the Gray took Myrddin under his wings . The two founded the Twilight Riders , a group of wandering heroes that travel the south of Damara solving problems and fighting evil . Personality . Myrddin was a very private person ; only recently he converted to the Ilmater faith and was very enthusiast about his new god . He tolerate different religions path , unless conduct to evil .

title: Myrian Beechwood
description: Myrian Beechwood Myrian Beechwood was the provisional lord of Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Myrian needed to subject most of his actions to the Parliament of Advisors , composed of representatives of the occupying powers .
description_long: Myrian Beechwood Myrian Beechwood was the provisional lord of Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Myrian needed to subject most of his actions to the Parliament of Advisors , composed of representatives of the occupying powers . History . Once Myrian was an adventurer priest of Waukeen . After Lashan Aumersair ' s demise , he did so much for the poor people of the dale that the occupying forces offered him the provisional lordship . To the surprise of all , himself included , he remained in office until 1368 DR , despite growing tired and angry from the conflict in the Parliament .

title: Myrin Darkdance
description: Myrin Darkdance Myrin Darkdance , whose birth name was Maerlyn , was a young spellscar red human wizard originally from Westgate . Myrin ' s father was a half - drow and her mother was of Mulhorandi descent . Abilities .
description_long: Myrin Darkdance Myrin Darkdance , whose birth name was Maerlyn , was a young spellscar red human wizard originally from Westgate . Myrin ' s father was a half - drow and her mother was of Mulhorandi descent . Abilities . Myrin had one of the most powerful spellscars known to exist . She was able to absorb and use the magical abilities and memories of any creature she came into contact with ( similar to the power of a spellthief ) . She can also absorb and contain harmful spellscars such as those that plagued Kalen Dren and Ilira Nathalan . Fayne hinted that part of Mystra might be trapped inside Myrin and she believed Myrin would eventually bring about the destruction of the world by siphoning and then accidentally unleashing the magic of an extremely powerful being . This may have been the motivation of Lilten when he attempted to kidnap Myrin because as a follower of Beshaba , the ultimate misfortune he could cause the world would be its destruction . History . Early Life . Myrin was born into the noble House Darkdance of Westgate in 1358 DR . In her youth , she apprenticed to wizards all over Faerûn , even apprenticing under Manshoon while he was in the guise of Orbakh .

title: Myrineyl Baenre
description: Myrineyl Baenre Myrineyl Baenre was the First Priestess of House Baenre circa 1484 DR . Personality . Myrineyl had been groomed from infancy to rule .
description_long: Myrineyl Baenre Myrineyl Baenre was the First Priestess of House Baenre circa 1484 DR . Personality . Myrineyl had been groomed from infancy to rule . However , she developed a sadistic side . She had a strange fascination with surface elves and had always at her side a slave attendant of this race . These attendants , however , rarely survived long and always needed to be replaced . Powers . Myrineyl was equally talented in divine and arcane magic . History . Myrineyl was the firstborn of matron mother Quenthel Baenre . In 1480 DR , she was in her last year in Arach - Tinilith . In later years , she and Quenthel ' s sister Sos ' Umptu Baenre competed for the title of First Priestess . The appointment of her aunt as matron mother of the restored House Do ' Urden probably granted the First Priestess position to Myrineyl .

title: Myrkul
description: Myrkul Myrkul , also known as the Lord of Bones , was one of the Dead Three and " the god of the dead " , as opposed to " the god of murder " , which was the province of Bhaal or " the god of death " which was Kelemvor . His portfolio , and his home , the Bone Castle , were both usurped by Cyric after the Lord of Bones was destroyed atop Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles by Midnight . Later Myrkul ' s portfolio passed to Kelemvor when Cyric was driven from the City of Strife by an alliance of deities and denizens .
description_long: Myrkul Myrkul , also known as the Lord of Bones , was one of the Dead Three and " the god of the dead " , as opposed to " the god of murder " , which was the province of Bhaal or " the god of death " which was Kelemvor . His portfolio , and his home , the Bone Castle , were both usurped by Cyric after the Lord of Bones was destroyed atop Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles by Midnight . Later Myrkul ' s portfolio passed to Kelemvor when Cyric was driven from the City of Strife by an alliance of deities and denizens . Myrkul had a cold , malignant intelligence , and spoke in a high whisper . He was always alert , never slept , and was never surprised . He was never known to lose his temper or be anything other than coldly amused when a mortal succeeded in avoiding his directives or chosen fates . His influence in Faerûn was imposed through fear , and he was a master of making mortals terrified of him through his words and deeds . At times , just to remain unpredictable , he seemed almost kind and caring . His cowled skull head was known in nightmares all over Faerûn , and he was the one deity that almost all human mortals could picture clearly .

title: Myrkul ' s Wrath
description: Myrkul ' s Wrath Myrkul ' s Wrath was a powerful scythe with various magic properties . Crafting . To craft " Myrkul ' s Wrath " , one had to have a broken scythe from Myrkul ' s vault and the essence of the dead god ' s soul .
description_long: Myrkul ' s Wrath Myrkul ' s Wrath was a powerful scythe with various magic properties . Crafting . To craft " Myrkul ' s Wrath " , one had to have a broken scythe from Myrkul ' s vault and the essence of the dead god ' s soul . Once combined , they became the formidable scythe . Description . The weapon appeared as a black scythe , with a stone - like texture and darkness emanating from it . Abilities . The scythe channeled the spirit of the god of death , and as a result was teeming with evil energy . " Myrkul ' s Wrath " was deadly to those of good alignment . The weapon also weakened its wielder in the hope that they would come to a gruesome death themselves .

title: Myrkyssa Jelan
description: Myrkyssa Jelan Myrkyssa Jelan was a regional warlord and not much was known about her except that she was female , extremely ambitious , had multiple identities , and threatened the city of Ravens Bluff twice between the years of 1337 and 1347 DR . Her first attempt , using diverse forces such as orc s , ogre s , and giant s , as well as mercenary companies , failed largely because of the caliber of citizens inhabiting Ravens Bluff . Her army went down in defeat at the Battle of Fire River , and she disappeared , not appearing again until two years later .
description_long: Myrkyssa Jelan Myrkyssa Jelan was a regional warlord and not much was known about her except that she was female , extremely ambitious , had multiple identities , and threatened the city of Ravens Bluff twice between the years of 1337 and 1347 DR . Her first attempt , using diverse forces such as orc s , ogre s , and giant s , as well as mercenary companies , failed largely because of the caliber of citizens inhabiting Ravens Bluff . Her army went down in defeat at the Battle of Fire River , and she disappeared , not appearing again until two years later . Her second attempt at the conquest of Ravens Bluff was decidedly more subtle than her first . Through unknown means , she recreated herself as a citizen of Ravens Bluff , duping the residents and officials , gaining the status of Lady Mayor under the name Amber Lynn Thoden . Around the same time , she created the personality of beautiful , confident , and deadly swordswoman , Elana . It was in this guise that she contracted the services of one Jack Ravenwild to retrieve a book called the " Sarkonagael : Secrets of the Shadewrights " . The title suggests that it was a spellbook , likely containing spells using the Shadow Weave .

title: Myrlochar
description: Myrlochar The Myrlochar , also known as a soul spider , was a demon creature of Lolth . Description . The monstrous myrlochars resembled giant brown - green spiders with a round body with eight legs and a fiendish head with eight red eyes .
description_long: Myrlochar The Myrlochar , also known as a soul spider , was a demon creature of Lolth . Description . The monstrous myrlochars resembled giant brown - green spiders with a round body with eight legs and a fiendish head with eight red eyes . Ecology . These foul servants of the Spider Queen could be summoned by the drow favored priests of the goddess .

title: Myrmeen Lhal
description: Myrmeen Lhal Myrmeen Lhal was the Lady Lord of the Cormyrean city of Arabel , a skilled ranger , and revered member of the Moonstars . History . Myrmeen was born in a poor section of Calimport into a life of obscurity .
description_long: Myrmeen Lhal Myrmeen Lhal was the Lady Lord of the Cormyrean city of Arabel , a skilled ranger , and revered member of the Moonstars . History . Myrmeen was born in a poor section of Calimport into a life of obscurity . At the age of six her mother lost a child during a storm , claiming a group called the Night Parade had taken the baby ' s spirit to a better place . Despite her mother ' s words she was plagued by nightmares throughout her childhood . She married a man named Dak at the age of twenty and they were to have a baby together . On the night of the birth there was another bad storm and Myrmeen lost consciousness . When she awoke , Dak said the baby was " gone " , implying that it was stillborn . A year later , they divorced . Myrmeen left Calimshan and became an adventuring Harper , traveling all over Faerûn , including Evermeet . Myrmeen married Haverstrom Lhal , a cousin of King Azoun IV . They were happy together , much happier than she ever was with Dak , but unfortunately Haverstrom died in an ambush not long after they wed .

title: Myrmith Splendon
description: Myrmith Splendon Myrmith Splendon was a fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Myrmith acted as a " captain - at - arms " , a kind of tutor to fighters , teaching bladed weapons and polearms .
description_long: Myrmith Splendon Myrmith Splendon was a fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Myrmith acted as a " captain - at - arms " , a kind of tutor to fighters , teaching bladed weapons and polearms . He did not try to master any particular weapon himself , but instead preferred to learn all kinds of different weapons . Myrmith was an excellent teacher and was usually busy at his house in Spindle Street teaching students .

title: Myrmyr
description: Myrmyr Myrmyr was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Myrmyr was located near the western coast of the " mouth " of the Golden Water .
description_long: Myrmyr Myrmyr was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Myrmyr was located near the western coast of the " mouth " of the Golden Water . Activites . This small city helped protect the Golden Water from pirates and raiders , ensuring they were able to ship large quantities of grain through the Shining South . The grain fields of Myrmyr were second only to those of Pyratar . The nearby Ship Isle bustled with activity from ship yards owned by the Sholapur chaka . Inhabitants . Myrmyr hosted a population of 10 , 000 residents .

title: Myrra
description: Myrra Myrra was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Myrra was extremely cruel and liked to toy with her opponents even when she was losing .
description_long: Myrra Myrra was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Myrra was extremely cruel and liked to toy with her opponents even when she was losing . History . Myrra was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault located under Thaymount . She was one of the most loyal and fanatical followers of Szass Tam and was tasked with the custody of the Chosen of Ghaunadaur Therzt in the deepest levels of the dungeon . Heroes from Daggerford fought and defeated her in 1486 DR .

title: Myrthos Shyllantham
description: Myrthos Shyllantham Myrthos Shyllantham was a member of the Harpers who petitioned High Lady Alustriel Silverhand to restore the Foclucan bard college . History . Around 1370 DR , Shyllantham saw the rise in influence of the New Olamn bards ' college in Waterdeep and wanted to spread the knowledge to Silverymoon .
description_long: Myrthos Shyllantham Myrthos Shyllantham was a member of the Harpers who petitioned High Lady Alustriel Silverhand to restore the Foclucan bard college . History . Around 1370 DR , Shyllantham saw the rise in influence of the New Olamn bards ' college in Waterdeep and wanted to spread the knowledge to Silverymoon .

title: Myshik Morueme
description: Myshik Morueme Myshik Morueme was half – blue dragon half - hobgoblin and a member of Clan Morueme . Description . Myshik had blue leathery wings with which he could glide but not fly .
description_long: Myshik Morueme Myshik Morueme was half – blue dragon half - hobgoblin and a member of Clan Morueme . Description . Myshik had blue leathery wings with which he could glide but not fly . Abilities . Myshik was able to use a breath weapon of electricity . He could apparently ride a giant fly . History . In 1373 DR , Myshik was sent by his uncle , Nahaunglaroth the blue dragon , to follow and defeat Kaanyr Vhok , who was encroaching on the territory of Clan Morueme . In exchange , he would receive the honor of the clan . Myshik met up with Vhok and Zasian Menz , a priest of Cyric , in Sundabar during an assault of the Scoured Legion and joined them as they traveled through the Elemental Plane of Fire . One night as they rested in an extradimensional mansion ( activated by an archway given to Vhok by Nahaunglaroth ) , Myshik slew their guide , Kurkle , and stole the mansion , trapping Vhok and Zasian inside . They escaped , however , and Myshik intercepted them at the City of Brass just as they passed through a portal to the House of the Triad .

title: Mystic
description: Mystic Mystics were a special kind of priest found mainly in the rural and wilder areas of the Realms . Typically , only human s , halfling s , elves , and half - elves chose to become mystics . These clergy had great personal charisma and above average wisdom and intelligence with a strong individualistic streak that caused them to shun structure and order in favor of finding their own path to enlightenment , and helping others find theirs .
description_long: Mystic Mystics were a special kind of priest found mainly in the rural and wilder areas of the Realms . Typically , only human s , halfling s , elves , and half - elves chose to become mystics . These clergy had great personal charisma and above average wisdom and intelligence with a strong individualistic streak that caused them to shun structure and order in favor of finding their own path to enlightenment , and helping others find theirs . They were usually adept herbalists , able to brew potions and infuse ointments , concoct poisons and create antidotes , and practice a unique form of the Art known as candle magic . Mystics sought out deities whose circle of influence dealt with emotions such as love and joy ; self - centered ideals such as beauty , charisma , hedonism , individualism , self - perfection , fortune , and misfortune ; art forms such as dance and music ; skill with poisons and antidotes ; and natural influences such as darkness , disease , the moon , fertility , birth , motherhood , and the seasons .

title: Mystic ( Zakhara )
description: Mystic ( Zakhara ) Mystics were bizarre priests in Zakhara whose powers were rumored to move both men and mountains . Mystics often gained spiritual awareness or revelations through dance , meditation , or other eccentric means . Requirements .
description_long: Mystic ( Zakhara ) Mystics were bizarre priests in Zakhara whose powers were rumored to move both men and mountains . Mystics often gained spiritual awareness or revelations through dance , meditation , or other eccentric means . Requirements . Men and women of all races could become mystics , though most of them were possessed of wild and chaotic natures . Role . As free priests , mystics could worship any god they chose without conforming to the hierarchical society that other Zakharan priests were part of . This method often left them in direct opposition with moralists . Dervishes . These mystics only gained their clerical powers after completing a chaotic dance . Anchorites & Hermits . Meditation and peaceful solitude granted clerical powers to anchorites and hermits , often in the form of simple tasks or hobbies such as singing or taking a long walk . Possessions . Most mystics were very poor when they first began their unique spiritual journeys but amassed and enjoyed wealth as their powers increased . Benefits . Mystics attracted followers who were fanatically loyal to them as well as their religion . Hindrances .

title: Mystic of Nog
description: Mystic of Nog Mystics of Nog , or Nogian mystics , were special wizard s in Zakhara who learned to master the art of storing magical energy within their bodies . History . The art these wizards practiced was perfected in the ancient empire of Nog .
description_long: Mystic of Nog Mystics of Nog , or Nogian mystics , were special wizard s in Zakhara who learned to master the art of storing magical energy within their bodies . History . The art these wizards practiced was perfected in the ancient empire of Nog . When Nog was a true power in Zakhara , these wizards were a feared presence on the battlefield . Some sages even attributed the fall of Nog to betrayal by these mystics . As of 1367 DR , only a few hundred Nogian mystics remained , most of whom lived reclusive lives in their homeland , spending their time perfecting their craft . Requirements . Mystics of Nog were passionate individuals of strong convictions . Possessions . Initially , a Mystic of Nog could use the same limited variety of weapons that all wizards could use . As their powers increased , they were able to become proficient in a much wider range of weaponry . Benefits . Mystics of Nog could use spells from any school , though they preferred to spend their magical energy augmenting their body . These wizards were able to enhance their body with magical energy . These abilities were powerful , but had a limited duration .

title: Mystic theurge
description: Mystic theurge Mystic theurges blurred the line between divine and arcane , drawing power from divine sources and ancient tomes alike . While most spellcasters chose one path to magical power , mystic theurges were able to simultaneously master spells common to clerics and wizards . Mystic theurges tended to be fascinated with magic in whatever form it took .
description_long: Mystic theurge Mystic theurges blurred the line between divine and arcane , drawing power from divine sources and ancient tomes alike . While most spellcasters chose one path to magical power , mystic theurges were able to simultaneously master spells common to clerics and wizards . Mystic theurges tended to be fascinated with magic in whatever form it took . They were often obsessed with magical lore , traveling to the ends of the earth to learn some new arcane secret or divine insight . Sharn s often were mystic theurges . Mystic theurges were rare but not unknown within the City of Splendors . They were common among human s of Halruaan ancestry . Mystic Theurge Abilities . Mystic theurges had unparalleled diversity of spells . While they did not have the uninterrupted spell advancement that a cleric or wizard had , they made up for this with versatility .

title: Mystic transfer
description: Mystic transfer Mystic transfer was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to receive the effect of a cast spell from another priest of the same religion and redirect it , thus greatly extending the range of the transferred spell . Effects . " Mystic transfer " took one minute to cast and for the next nine minutes the caster could be the target of spells from one or more priests of the same religion .
description_long: Mystic transfer Mystic transfer was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to receive the effect of a cast spell from another priest of the same religion and redirect it , thus greatly extending the range of the transferred spell . Effects . " Mystic transfer " took one minute to cast and for the next nine minutes the caster could be the target of spells from one or more priests of the same religion . Instead of experiencing the effects of a spell , " mystic transfer " channeled the spell into the receiver who could then immediately pick a new target . If the new target was another priest with an active " mystic transfer " aura , then that priest received the spell , and so on in rapid bucket - brigade fashion until the last priest chose a normal target . The effect of the transferred spell was as if the original caster was standing at the end of the chain , i . e . , if a 10th - level priest cast " flame strike " 60 yd ( 27 . 4 m ) away at a 3rd - level priest wrapped in " mystic transfer " , the 3rd - level priest could then direct the " flame strike " at any target within 60 yd and it would hit as if cast by a 10th - level priest .

title: Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam
description: Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam The Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam was the title given to the efreeti priest who oversaw the temples to Agni , Imix , Kossuth , Freyal , Surtr , and Hastsezini . All of these temples were located near the Charcoal Palace within the City of Brass . The Legate was protected by his own contingent of elite soldiers called the Guardians of the Three Fires .
description_long: Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam The Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam was the title given to the efreeti priest who oversaw the temples to Agni , Imix , Kossuth , Freyal , Surtr , and Hastsezini . All of these temples were located near the Charcoal Palace within the City of Brass . The Legate was protected by his own contingent of elite soldiers called the Guardians of the Three Fires .

title: Mystra
description: Mystra Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , was a greater deity and the second incarnation of the goddess of magic after her predecessor Mystryl sacrificed herself to protect the Weave from Karsus ' s Folly . Mystra was destroyed by Helm when she defied the will of Ao the overgod and attempted to leave the Prime Material Plane during the Time of Troubles . At the conclusion of the Godswar , Ao offered the position of Goddess of Magic to the wizard Midnight , who reluctantly accepted and took Mystra ' s name in order to smooth the transition after so much chaos .
description_long: Mystra Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , was a greater deity and the second incarnation of the goddess of magic after her predecessor Mystryl sacrificed herself to protect the Weave from Karsus ' s Folly . Mystra was destroyed by Helm when she defied the will of Ao the overgod and attempted to leave the Prime Material Plane during the Time of Troubles . At the conclusion of the Godswar , Ao offered the position of Goddess of Magic to the wizard Midnight , who reluctantly accepted and took Mystra ' s name in order to smooth the transition after so much chaos . Description . The only known description of the mortal that became Mystra was of a " beautiful peasant girl " who was just beginning her studies of the Art . As a goddess , Mystra could " shape change " at will and mortals who saw her reported she changed constantly . Others described her appearing in a form resembling a multicolored will - o ' - wisp . When Mystra revealed herself to Midnight just before the gods were forced to walk the land of Toril , she was at first just a dark figure surrounded by an aura of blue - white light .

title: Mystra ' s Ban
description: Mystra ' s Ban Mystra ' s Ban is a decree that the goddess Mystra made about the mortal use of powerful magic . Magic before the Ban . Before Mystra ' s Ban , there was no practical limit to the ways magic could be used .
description_long: Mystra ' s Ban Mystra ' s Ban is a decree that the goddess Mystra made about the mortal use of powerful magic . Magic before the Ban . Before Mystra ' s Ban , there was no practical limit to the ways magic could be used . Any being with enough skill , intelligence and willpower could use magic , with very little effort . Beings could tap the weave directly and use its magical energy . There was no limit on the amount of magical power that could be channeled into a spell . Magic after the Ban . The first effect of the ban was to limit spellcasting to spells of a maximum of 9th level , with some special Epic Spells being more powerful than that . The second effect was that all spellcasters had to spend time memorizing spells and were limited to holding a certain number of magical spells in their head at any one time . Epic magic was not affected by Mystra ' s Ban .

title: Mystra ( Midnight )
description: Mystra ( Midnight ) Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , formerly known as Midnight , was once a greater goddess who guided the magic that enveloped Toril and its surrounding space . Mystra tended to the Weave constantly , making possible all the miracles and mysteries wrought by magic and users of magic . She was believed to be the embodiment of the Weave and of magic itself ( though this was known to be false in the wake of the Spellplague ) .
description_long: Mystra ( Midnight ) Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , formerly known as Midnight , was once a greater goddess who guided the magic that enveloped Toril and its surrounding space . Mystra tended to the Weave constantly , making possible all the miracles and mysteries wrought by magic and users of magic . She was believed to be the embodiment of the Weave and of magic itself ( though this was known to be false in the wake of the Spellplague ) . Mystra ' s symbol was a ring of seven stars surrounding a rising red mist , spiraling to the heavens . Mystra ruled over the divine dominion of Dweomerheart . Worshipers . The church of Mystra preserved magical lore so that magic would continue and flourish in the future even if the dominant races of Faerûn were to fall . Its members also sought out those skilled in magic or who had the potential to use it , keeping a close eye on those who were likely to become skilled . Her cleric s were encouraged to explore magical theory and create new spells and magic items . Sites dedicated to the goddess were enhanced by the Weave to allow any spell cast by her clerics while in them to be affected by metamagic .

title: Mystryl
description: Mystryl Mystryl ( MISS - trihl ) , the Lady of Mysteries , was a greater deity and the first incarnation of the goddess of magic . Later incarnations of the goddess were named " Mystra " . Mystryl was most notably known as the being who embodied the Weave , the primary source of magic in the cosmos .
description_long: Mystryl Mystryl ( MISS - trihl ) , the Lady of Mysteries , was a greater deity and the first incarnation of the goddess of magic . Later incarnations of the goddess were named " Mystra " . Mystryl was most notably known as the being who embodied the Weave , the primary source of magic in the cosmos . She supplied and regulated magical energy to all , making possible spells and magical effects . But her portfolio also included knowledge and energy , invention and creativity , song , time , and the season of spring . Description . Mystryl manifested herself in many ways through many conduits , but her followers usually described her as a beautiful human woman with intense blue eyes that wore gracefully refined blue - white robes of fine , thick silk . Her skin glowed and her hair was every color of the rainbow . When being mysterious , she was depicted as a swarm of rainbow - colored will - o ' - wisp s in the vague shape of a humanoid female . But usually a subtle manifestation was all that was necessary : her trademark blue - white aura pulsing on the person , place , or thing she wished to illuminate .

title: Mytela Halvasyn
description: Mytela Halvasyn Lady Mytela Halvasyn was a half - elf noble with considerable influence in the city of Velprintalar . Her house , a palace - like structure , Mytela Halvasyn ' s house , later became the base of operations for her descendants , who operated the Society of the Verdant Arrow , an anti - human organization .
description_long: Mytela Halvasyn Lady Mytela Halvasyn was a half - elf noble with considerable influence in the city of Velprintalar . Her house , a palace - like structure , Mytela Halvasyn ' s house , later became the base of operations for her descendants , who operated the Society of the Verdant Arrow , an anti - human organization .

title: Mytela Halvasyn ' s house
description: Mytela Halvasyn ' s house Lady Mytela Halvasyn ' s house was a palace - like house in Velprintalar , Aglarond , once occupied by Lady Mytela Halvasyn , but , as of 1368 DR , was occupied by her descendants , who formed an anti - human organization called the Society of the Verdant arrow .
description_long: Mytela Halvasyn ' s house Lady Mytela Halvasyn ' s house was a palace - like house in Velprintalar , Aglarond , once occupied by Lady Mytela Halvasyn , but , as of 1368 DR , was occupied by her descendants , who formed an anti - human organization called the Society of the Verdant arrow .

title: Myth Adofhaer
description: Myth Adofhaer Myth Adofhaer was a mythal - cloaked Silvuanede nn city . It was sent away from Faerûn around - 5300 DR by the Eaerlann i , but shortly prior to 1374 DR , information was found in a ruined Eaerlanni library that revealed how to bring it back . This information was of particular interest to Eldreth Veluuthra , the organisation that sought the removal of all human s from Faerûn .
description_long: Myth Adofhaer Myth Adofhaer was a mythal - cloaked Silvuanede nn city . It was sent away from Faerûn around - 5300 DR by the Eaerlann i , but shortly prior to 1374 DR , information was found in a ruined Eaerlanni library that revealed how to bring it back . This information was of particular interest to Eldreth Veluuthra , the organisation that sought the removal of all human s from Faerûn . In - 4300 DR , Silvuanedenn High Mages put Myth Adofhaer into magical statis in order to emerge in the far future , thus avoiding the taint of the fey ' ri houses .

title: Myth Drannor
description: Myth Drannor Myth Drannor , formerly known as ( the city of ) Cormanthor , the City of Song , or the City of Love , as well as many other names , was an elven city of around 10 , 000 ( as of 1479 DR ) in Cormanthor , which had been rebuilt after the original had laid in ruins since it fell in 714 DR . It was one of four old communities and capital of Cormanthyr ( the others being the Elven Court , Semberholme , and the Tangled Trees ) . At its height , it represented the peak of eladrin civilization and craftsmanship .
description_long: Myth Drannor Myth Drannor , formerly known as ( the city of ) Cormanthor , the City of Song , or the City of Love , as well as many other names , was an elven city of around 10 , 000 ( as of 1479 DR ) in Cormanthor , which had been rebuilt after the original had laid in ruins since it fell in 714 DR . It was one of four old communities and capital of Cormanthyr ( the others being the Elven Court , Semberholme , and the Tangled Trees ) . At its height , it represented the peak of eladrin civilization and craftsmanship . It fell to demons during the Weeping War and was in ruins , a dangerous place full of monsters and forgotten treasures , for many centuries , until reclaimed by Evermeet ' s Elven Crusade led by Seiveril Miritar . As of 1479 DR it is ruled by Coronal Ilsevele Miritar . Magic . While it was in ruins , the powerful magic of Myth Drannor still leaked out from the ruin , affecting Cormanthor in several ways , such as the weather being milder than it should have been , with cooler summers and warmer winters , and there being far more plant and animal species in Cormanthor than any other woodland of its kind .

title: Myth Nantar
description: Myth Nantar Myth Nantar ( the City of Destinies ) was an underwater city about 56 - 64km ( 35 - 40 miles ) west of the Whamite Isles , and about 64km northwest of Voalidru . The city contained a mythal , a magical protective barrier . After the Spellplague the Sea of Fallen Stars receded and part of the city was exposed to air .
description_long: Myth Nantar Myth Nantar ( the City of Destinies ) was an underwater city about 56 - 64km ( 35 - 40 miles ) west of the Whamite Isles , and about 64km northwest of Voalidru . The city contained a mythal , a magical protective barrier . After the Spellplague the Sea of Fallen Stars receded and part of the city was exposed to air . As of 1369 DR , the city glowed slightly when seen from a distance , and coral has grown everywhere within , seen by its inhabitants as a beautiful effect , but three quarters of the city was covered either with coral or reef . As of 1369 DR , Myth Nantar had 1 , 900 permanent residents of many different races . Law . As of 1369 DR , the Dukar s operated the legal system in Myth Nantar , although there was no written legal system at this time . The laws were similar to other elven realms such as Myth Drannor . Crime was punishable by the Dukars and their judge , Qos . Lesser offences might have commanded a labour - based punishment , usually involving clearing reef or coral , but serious offences were punished with banishment or death . Government .

title: Myth Ondath
description: Myth Ondath Myth Ondath , formerly known as Yrlaancel and Ondathel , was a ruined city located in the Tortured Land of north Faerûn . Geography . Myth Ondath was located at the western end of the White Peaks that spanned the northern border of the Ride .
description_long: Myth Ondath Myth Ondath , formerly known as Yrlaancel and Ondathel , was a ruined city located in the Tortured Land of north Faerûn . Geography . Myth Ondath was located at the western end of the White Peaks that spanned the northern border of the Ride . To its northeast lay the Tortured Land , to its west the great desert of Anauroch , and to its southwest the Border Forest ( then known as Rystall Wood ) . History . The city which would one day become a jewel of peace in the North had its beginnings in the far distant past , in the days after the end of the final Crown War and the fall of the elven kingdom of Keltormir . In - 8210 DR , the non - gold sylvan elf clans of the realm of Ilodhar , in order to escape the depredations of ogre s and orc s , relocated to Rystall Wood , and after eighty years they had there built the city of Yrlaancel . For centuries , this peaceful settlement stood as a bastion , surviving the destruction of the Twelve Nights of Fire that separated Rystall Wood from the rest of Cormanthor , the fall of Illefarn and Siluvanede , drow raids , and the rise and fall of great human kingdoms such as Netheril .

title: Myth Rhynn
description: Myth Rhynn Myth Rhynn is an ancient elven tomb city deep in the forest of Wealdath . Even the elves themselves are unsure of when it was built , but it was some time during the height of the realm of Keltormir . It ' s mythal has long since been corrupted .
description_long: Myth Rhynn Myth Rhynn is an ancient elven tomb city deep in the forest of Wealdath . Even the elves themselves are unsure of when it was built , but it was some time during the height of the realm of Keltormir . It ' s mythal has long since been corrupted . Undead are known to haunt this place . Myth Rhynn is known to be home to the lich Mallin .

title: Mythal
description: Mythal A mythal was a powerful magical effect , created by a group of spellcasters to protect and ward a large area with numerous powerful enchantments . The earliest mythals were created by a circle of elven High Mages . Mythals could permanently alter The Weave to create an area wherein the normal rules of magic no longer applied .
description_long: Mythal A mythal was a powerful magical effect , created by a group of spellcasters to protect and ward a large area with numerous powerful enchantments . The earliest mythals were created by a circle of elven High Mages . Mythals could permanently alter The Weave to create an area wherein the normal rules of magic no longer applied . A typical mythal prevented certain schools of magic from being employed while empowering others . It could restrict access to the warded area to certain classes of beings . For example , Silverymoon ' s mythal excluded evil dragons . Creation of a mythal sometimes required the willing sacrifice of the lead caster ' s life , a result that led to the first mythal ' s being named after its creator . In addition , many mythal spells corroded over time , and if not maintained could become corrupted . This had occurred in Myth Drannor and resulted in the state of that city until 1374 DR The god of mythals , Mythrien Sarath , was said to have invested much of his divine power helping elven high mages erect their mythals . Mythal Definitions .

title: Mythal recovery
description: Mythal recovery Mythal recovery is an abjuration spell used by some swordmage s to rid themselves of negative effects placed upon them by enemies . When a swordmage casts " mythal recovery " he or she turns their magic al wardings inward , giving them a chance to cast off a hindering effect left upon them by some enemy or other obstacle . The spell is not terribly complex and can be used again after a short rest of a few minutes or more .

When a swordmage casts " mythal recovery " he or she turns their magic al wardings inward , giving them a chance to cast off a hindering effect left upon them by some enemy or other obstacle . title: Mythallar
description: Mythallar A mythallar was a Netherese device that allowed access to vast amounts of raw magic . Description . This magical device looked much like a crystal ball but was about 150 feet in diameter .
description_long: Mythallar A mythallar was a Netherese device that allowed access to vast amounts of raw magic . Description . This magical device looked much like a crystal ball but was about 150 feet in diameter . The globe shed a very bright light — similar to the disc of the sun — with dimmer shadows and shapes moving across its surface . An ornate stand kept the perfectly spherical device in place . History . Created in 845 NY ( - 3014 DR ) by Ioulaum , the " mythallars " allowed arcanists to create quasimagical item s without draining their lifeforce . This allowed for a rising trade with the middle class . The first large scale application , the floating city , appeared in the year 866 NY ( - 2954 DR ) , Ioulaum ' s Enclave , named Xinleal . By - 2811 DR ( 1048 NY ) , thirteen had been constructed . By - 2207 DR ( 1652 NY ) , Netheril began lifting one enclave into the sky per year . Sakkors ' High Arcanist Xolund the Maker improved on " mythallar " design by infusing his enclave ' s " mythallar " with a rudimentary sentience , giving it self - awareness and also increasing the " mythallar ' s " powers .

title: Mythrellan
description: Mythrellan Mythrellan was the Zulkir of Illusion and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . She lived in the Serpent Tower , in the city of Bezantur . She was known to have only mindless servants .
description_long: Mythrellan Mythrellan was the Zulkir of Illusion and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . She lived in the Serpent Tower , in the city of Bezantur . She was known to have only mindless servants . Appearance . Mythrellan virtually changed her appearance as often as other noblewomen change their gowns — at times having golden eyes and sky blue skin or her body patterned in brown and tan diamonds like snakeskin . Personality . She preferred isolation and devoted most of her time to study . Mythrellan despised everybody else on the council of zulkirs . History . Mythrellan had been the Zulkir of Illusion for several years , even before Aznar Thrul was born . Some time before 1320 DR , Mythrellan took the young man Lailomum Zerad as an apprentice .

title: Mythrien Sarath
description: Mythrien Sarath Mythrien Sarath was one of several elven god s of magic in danger of losing their deific status due to lack of worshipers . As Mystra once delegated certain aspects of magic to other , lesser deities , so too did Corellon Larethian before her . Mythrien held dominion over protective magic and aided High mage s in the erection of mythal s .
description_long: Mythrien Sarath Mythrien Sarath was one of several elven god s of magic in danger of losing their deific status due to lack of worshipers . As Mystra once delegated certain aspects of magic to other , lesser deities , so too did Corellon Larethian before her . Mythrien held dominion over protective magic and aided High mage s in the erection of mythal s . History . It is unknown exactly how many mythals Mythrien played a part in creating , though it is known , according to lore kept safe on Evermeet , that he did not help with the one around Myth Drannor . He poured some of his divine essence into every mythal that he helped create ; unfortunately this had the effect of leading to a decline in his overall power level . In an attempt to restore himself to his previous power , he began work on creating the relic known as " Mythrien ' s Ring " . In avatar form , Mythrien secreted himself in a hidden dungeon ( said to be somewhere under what is now the Wood of Sharp Teeth ) and began the long , complex process of creating it .

title: Myudo Ichiro
description: Myudo Ichiro Myudo Ichiro was an old man living in Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ichiro lived with his aged wife , his daughter , and the husband of the daughter .
description_long: Myudo Ichiro Myudo Ichiro was an old man living in Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ichiro lived with his aged wife , his daughter , and the husband of the daughter . In 1357 DR , Myudo village fell under the control of the dai - oni master of the Black Temple and his minions . Six months later , Ichiro met at the village ' s gate some adventurers . He invited them to his home at night . At his home , Ichiro told them all about the oppression of the dai - oni .

title: N ' Safa
description: N ' Safa N ' Safa was the leader of the yuan - ti Se ' Sehen tribe around 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , N ' Safa led her tribe in betraying Sseth , instead pleading their allegiance to the new god Zehir .
description_long: N ' Safa N ' Safa was the leader of the yuan - ti Se ' Sehen tribe around 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , N ' Safa led her tribe in betraying Sseth , instead pleading their allegiance to the new god Zehir . So the Se ' Sehen destroyed the orthodox Sauringar tribe and took control of the Temple of World Serpent . There , N ' Safa started a ritual to summon Zehir and started her plot for world domination , sending disguised yuan - ti spies over all Faerûn . However , the surviving Sauringar princess Sa ' Sani manipulated the Hero of Neverwinter into ruining the Se ' Sehen ' s plots and at last into attacking the Temple during the last ritual performed by N ' Safa . The Hero killed N ' Safa .

title: NPC
description: NPC NPC stands for a non - player character in a role - playing game . The term can mean two different things , though both meanings stand in opposition to the meaning of " player character " . Firstly , in role - playing games in general , it can refer to any character who is not controlled by a player ( but rather the computer or the DM ) .
description_long: NPC NPC stands for a non - player character in a role - playing game . The term can mean two different things , though both meanings stand in opposition to the meaning of " player character " . Firstly , in role - playing games in general , it can refer to any character who is not controlled by a player ( but rather the computer or the DM ) . Secondly , in computer role - playing games like Baldur ' s Gate , it can refer to the characters who can join the player ' s party and be controlled by them , but are not created by the player and do not represent the player personally . In the latter case , the player usually has full control of the NPCs for most of the time , but they may exhibit scripted free will at specific plot points , for example withdrawing cooperation when the player makes a particular choice that the NPC finds especially objectionable , or starting a fight with another NPC ( in either sense of the term ) . It should be noted that though the second meaning of NPC as potential party members is often used when talking " about " the " Baldur ' s Gate " games , their own manuals use the term in the first , broader sense .

title: Naahal
description: Naahal Naahal was a whale bard until 1369 DR . History . Born in 613 DR , Naahal become the leader of the largest pod of humpback whale s .
description_long: Naahal Naahal was a whale bard until 1369 DR . History . Born in 613 DR , Naahal become the leader of the largest pod of humpback whale s . His main duty was to lead the whalesongs of Serôs . In Eleasias of 1369 DR , during the Twelfth Serôs War , in order to gain the total trust of his sahuagin subjects , Iakhovas hunted and killed Naahal . His death was deeply mourned by his fellow whales .

title: Naaman al - Rima
description: Naaman al - Rima Naaman al - Rima was a halfling and the chief cook who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naaman directed the actions of dozens of other cooks .
description_long: Naaman al - Rima Naaman al - Rima was a halfling and the chief cook who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naaman directed the actions of dozens of other cooks . Preparing food within the Palace was quite the challenge . One day a feast could be need for hundreds of mamluk s , while the next day a fine meal might be needed for the Grand Caliph himself . Though she was extremely busy , Naaman personally inspected all of the Grand Caliph ' s meals .

title: Naaren Dhest
description: Naaren Dhest Naaren Dhest was a thief and a member of the Hand of Yartar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " .
description_long: Naaren Dhest Naaren Dhest was a thief and a member of the Hand of Yartar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " . They went back to Yartar with the orb , but just after they put it in the city ' s vaults , Naaren stole it . After examining it , the Hands of Yartar decided to sell it in an auction at the Wink and Kiss tavern . Protected by some bodyguards , Naaren managed the auction but the interventions of some adventurers and of the Kraken Society ruined the sale .

title: Nabeirion
