description: Nabeirion Nabeirion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . Activities . Nabeirion ' s duty was to always recite the Endless Chant of Alaundo .
description_long: Nabeirion Nabeirion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . Activities . Nabeirion ' s duty was to always recite the Endless Chant of Alaundo . History . In 1487 DR , Nabeirion , despite being saved from shadovar and Moonstars , would not agree to participate in Larloch ' s plan to rebuild the Weave . Despite his objections Elminster Aumar entered his mind , forcing Nabeirion to collaborate with Larloch .

title: Nabil al - Rashad
description: Nabil al - Rashad Nabil al - Rashad was a horse trader who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he did not own a stall or stable , Nabil could be found nearly everywhere within Huzuz selling horses .
description_long: Nabil al - Rashad Nabil al - Rashad was a horse trader who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he did not own a stall or stable , Nabil could be found nearly everywhere within Huzuz selling horses . The quality of his stock ranged from poor to excellent , but the vast majority of them were stolen . He catered to questionable clientele . Many of his clients rode out from Huzuz only to encounter a group of desert rider s who were eager to retrieve their property . These customers typically did not survive long enough to return to Huzuz and complain to Nabil .

title: Nacacia
description: Nacacia Nacacia was a female half - elf slave in Myth Drannor , in service to the Masked of Cormanthyr in years between c . 238 and 261 . History .
description_long: Nacacia Nacacia was a female half - elf slave in Myth Drannor , in service to the Masked of Cormanthyr in years between c . 238 and 261 . History . Nacacia was a young half - elf in Cormanthyr before the Opening ; she was bought by the Masked . He tutored Nacacia and the human Elminster Aumar in the ways of the Elven High Magic , in order to use them as his instruments . Nacacia appeared to be slain in an attack on the hidden place of Mythanthar but was later revealed to be alive , as was Mythanthar . They helped Elminster to break free from the Masked ' s magic . Later , Nacacia helped to raise the " mythal " .

title: Nacre
description: Nacre Nacre is the substance that pearls are made of and is also found in turbo and trochus shells . Similar to mother of pearl , the smaller specimens of these shells that exhibit a fiery luster are cut and polished and sold as " nacre " at a base value of 1gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) .
description_long: Nacre Nacre is the substance that pearls are made of and is also found in turbo and trochus shells . Similar to mother of pearl , the smaller specimens of these shells that exhibit a fiery luster are cut and polished and sold as " nacre " at a base value of 1gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) .

title: Nada
description: Nada Nada , also known as Juto , was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Nada used a ninja - to .
description_long: Nada Nada , also known as Juto , was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Nada used a ninja - to . History . In 1358 DR , Nada was ordered to scare an adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto . Calling himself Juto , Nada told the adventurers that bad karma would descend over them if they continued their investigation .

title: Nada al - Hazan
description: Nada al - Hazan Nada al - Hazan was an island chain in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara . Among the wild archipelagos of the sea , it was the island chain best explored and most settled by enlightened Zakharans . Located south of the Golden Gulf , between Jazayir al - Sartan , the island of Harab , and the Steaming Isles , Nada al - Hazan was a convenient entryway into the Crowded Sea , giving it the title the " Silver Road " .
description_long: Nada al - Hazan Nada al - Hazan was an island chain in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara . Among the wild archipelagos of the sea , it was the island chain best explored and most settled by enlightened Zakharans . Located south of the Golden Gulf , between Jazayir al - Sartan , the island of Harab , and the Steaming Isles , Nada al - Hazan was a convenient entryway into the Crowded Sea , giving it the title the " Silver Road " . The islands were mainly rocky outcrops of the sea with low vegetation . Geography . From the northernmost group of islands , the Masud Jazayir or " Fortunate Isles " , with the main port of Bandar al - Sa ' adat , civilization became declined down the island chain . Following were al - Zabdiyat ( " the Bowl " ) ; Tawil ( " Long " ) ; Dirs ( " Jaw - tooth " ) , lying apart from the main chain to the northeast ; and Jazirat al - Sayyad ( " The Hunter " ) . At the end lay Jazirat al - Gawwar ( " Island of the Whirlpool " ) , which was inaccessible by ship as an unpredictable whirlpool could appear anywhere around the island to doom mariners , giving the whole island chain its second sobriquet , the Strait of Sorrow . Inhabitants .

title: Nadlok Bormul
description: Nadlok Bormul Nadlok Bormul was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Nadlok grew up in Crimmor in Amn but sold all his holdings to the Crytrappers and moved to Athkatla in 1366 DR .
description_long: Nadlok Bormul Nadlok Bormul was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Nadlok grew up in Crimmor in Amn but sold all his holdings to the Crytrappers and moved to Athkatla in 1366 DR . There , Nadlok made much money , becoming one of the richer tavern and festhall owners in the city . However , bored by money , he greatly enjoyed his role in the Knights of the Shield and soon rose through the ranks to the Shield Council .

title: Nado Tori
description: Nado Tori Nado Tori was a samurai ronin in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Nado lived at the Shrine of the Spring , despite being a follower of the Konjo school .
description_long: Nado Tori Nado Tori was a samurai ronin in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Nado lived at the Shrine of the Spring , despite being a follower of the Konjo school . He had helped to protect the shrine in the past . Nado helped the local sohei commander in the training of his men . He had attracted the attentions of the spirit protector of the shrine , who fell in love with him for his devotion . Personality . Nado still honored the memory of his lord , not wanting to enter into the service of a new one . He was attracted to the beautiful woman he sometimes met in the shrine , but did not yet understand her true spirit nature .

title: Nadrathen
description: Nadrathen Nadrathen , usually know as The Rebel Chosen , was a powerful male wizard . He was once one of the Chosen of Mystra but he decided to follow only his will against his goddess and for this he was destroyed by Elminster Aumar . History .
description_long: Nadrathen Nadrathen , usually know as The Rebel Chosen , was a powerful male wizard . He was once one of the Chosen of Mystra but he decided to follow only his will against his goddess and for this he was destroyed by Elminster Aumar . History . Nadrathen , under the name Ilgrist , became the Court Wizard of King Baerimgrim of Galadorna . On the king ' s death in 764 DR , faced with the feuds between the kingdom ' s barons , he nominated himself king . However , he was soon after destroyed by Elminster and Dasumia .

title: Nadul DaRoni
description: Nadul DaRoni Nadul DaRoni was a gnomish artist and inventor who lived as a hermit near High Horn . He was undoubtedly a genius , but also quite possibly a madman ( which may be one of the factors involved in his natural ingenuity ) . Some of these inventions were not always foolproof and some were quite risky to use .
description_long: Nadul DaRoni Nadul DaRoni was a gnomish artist and inventor who lived as a hermit near High Horn . He was undoubtedly a genius , but also quite possibly a madman ( which may be one of the factors involved in his natural ingenuity ) . Some of these inventions were not always foolproof and some were quite risky to use . His furnace wagon , for instance , had a one - in - ten chance of spontaneously combusting per hour of constant use . He sketched portraits on commission and had drawn Elminster , Azoun IV , and Aurora ( a copy of whose portrait appeared on the cover of her catalogue ) . If someone sent him their name and location , he would eventually come and find them .

title: Nadyra ' s Glory
description: Nadyra ' s Glory Nadyra ' s Glory ( also known as the Lost Princess ) was the bridal ship of Princess Aliia of Impiltur , which sank in mysterious circumstances on the Sea of Fallen Stars in 926 DR after leaving Hlammach . Aliia was on the way to marry Crown Prince Rhiigard I of Cormyr . The ship was loaded with treasure and displayed purple sails in honour of Cormyr , and its aim ( and the aim of the marriage ) was to unite Cormyr and Impiltur .
description_long: Nadyra ' s Glory Nadyra ' s Glory ( also known as the Lost Princess ) was the bridal ship of Princess Aliia of Impiltur , which sank in mysterious circumstances on the Sea of Fallen Stars in 926 DR after leaving Hlammach . Aliia was on the way to marry Crown Prince Rhiigard I of Cormyr . The ship was loaded with treasure and displayed purple sails in honour of Cormyr , and its aim ( and the aim of the marriage ) was to unite Cormyr and Impiltur . The ship sank about 48km ( 30 miles ) off its course , on a direct line between Tsurlagol and Wayrock . The wreck came to rest on its right side , and was quickly scavenged of its valuables by nearby undersea creatures , including koalinth s and scrag s . Amongst the treasures on board were the " Great Sword of Impiltur " and " Kimeltaar " , the Demonsbane Shield .

title: Naedaenya Arthas
description: Naedaenya Arthas Naedaenya Arthas was a female Chondathan human cleric of Shar . She was the leader of a group of clerics of Shar posing as clerics of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History .
description_long: Naedaenya Arthas Naedaenya Arthas was a female Chondathan human cleric of Shar . She was the leader of a group of clerics of Shar posing as clerics of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . Masquerading as a priestess of Mystra , Lady Arthas arrived in Wheloon in around Ches of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR and soon convinced Lord Sarp Redbeard to host a temple to Mystra for the good of the city ' s economy . She persuaded him that it would become a destination for the trade of magical items , components , and knowledge . She requested tax breaks for the temple during construction , and also passed him a hefty bribe to finalize the deal . She chose the ruins of an old citadel north of town as the site for the new temple . Using it as a foundation , and employing magic - aided construction techniques , she had the temple complete and operating in only a few months . In truth , Arthas followed Shar and was part of Esvele Graycastle ' s and Despayr ' s plan to use the life energies of magic - users and worshipers of Mystra to tear a hole in the Weave .

title: Naer Tlarra
description: Naer Tlarra Naer Tlarra was a human man and a wizard of the lands that became Chessenta , who lived around the 4th or 5th century DR . His tomb was a subject of treasure tales . After he died , Naer ' s tomb was built in Elvenblood Pass in the Earthfast Mountains of the Vast , and either buried or heavily overgrown somewhere there .
description_long: Naer Tlarra Naer Tlarra was a human man and a wizard of the lands that became Chessenta , who lived around the 4th or 5th century DR . His tomb was a subject of treasure tales . After he died , Naer ' s tomb was built in Elvenblood Pass in the Earthfast Mountains of the Vast , and either buried or heavily overgrown somewhere there . He rested inside a 10 - foot - long ( 3 meter ) stone coffin , too heavy to carry away by means that could negotiate the pass . It was supposedly protected against thieves by bound creatures and several spells . No story suggested Naer entered some state of undeath , however . Among the treasures thought to be buried with him were his spellbook s , staff , and wand s . There was also said to be a magical twelve - spired crown that allowed one to simultaneously use up to twelve magical ring s , mounted on the spires . A magical ring apparently still sat on each one , with at least two particularly rare and powerful rings .

title: Naergoth Bladelord
description: Naergoth Bladelord Naergoth Bladelord was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the warrior lord of the cult and the leader of the ruling council . He usually resided in Saerloon .
description_long: Naergoth Bladelord Naergoth Bladelord was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the warrior lord of the cult and the leader of the ruling council . He usually resided in Saerloon . He was one of the leaders that ordered the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR . By 1479 DR , Naergoth had become a death knight and the co - ruler of the Well of Dragons . During the Tyranny of Dragons , he was the sole commander of the Well of the Dragon and the oldest living member of the Cult . Although he did not like the new direction of the Cult under Severin Silrajin , he served loyally . Appendix . Canon Conflict . In 4th edition sourcebook was called a death knights , but in Rise of Tiamat adventure was clearly stated as wight .

title: Naerlus
description: Naerlus Naerlus was a shadovar spy inside Candlekeep . History . Naerlus went to infiltrate Candlekeep .
description_long: Naerlus Naerlus was a shadovar spy inside Candlekeep . History . Naerlus went to infiltrate Candlekeep . He killed and replaced the monk Andannas Dalkur . In 1487 DR , after receiving a pass - phrase , he killed a person but was uncovered by Elminster Aumar , also disguised as Dalkur . Elminster interrogated him but with little success . Soon after , Naerlus managed to free himself and tried to kill the Old Mage but instead he died .

title: Naeros Karanok
description: Naeros Karanok Naeros Karanok was the son of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Naeros usually wandered with his retinue watching people run away .
description_long: Naeros Karanok Naeros Karanok was the son of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Naeros usually wandered with his retinue watching people run away . Personality . Naeros believed that thank to the power of his family he can did anything he wanted and nobody could kill him . He was cruel and arrogant . He liked disfiguring his victims before burning them . Relationship . Naeros had been badly spoiled by his father and his grandfather .

title: Naeryndroth
description: Naeryndroth Naeryndroth was an adult black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Naeryndroth was cunning and able to deceive many foes with his acting skills .
description_long: Naeryndroth Naeryndroth was an adult black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Naeryndroth was cunning and able to deceive many foes with his acting skills . Equipment . Naeryndroth had a cache of magic item s that granted him many illusion and enchantment spell s .

title: Nafay Mizz ' rynturl
description: Nafay Mizz ' rynturl Nafay Mizz ' rynturl was a drow traitor priestess of Guallidurth in 1378 DR . Activities . Nafay was a noble of House Mizz ' rynturl of the city of Guallidurth but secretly also a traitor priestess of Vhaeraun .
description_long: Nafay Mizz ' rynturl Nafay Mizz ' rynturl was a drow traitor priestess of Guallidurth in 1378 DR . Activities . Nafay was a noble of House Mizz ' rynturl of the city of Guallidurth but secretly also a traitor priestess of Vhaeraun . History . She arranged a meeting with a mute wild elf who knew about a very ancient temple to Lolth on the surface . There , however , she was attacked and killed by her old childhood friend T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , under orders of the Velkyn Velve , the assassin branch of the new Temple of the Black Mother .

title: Nafir
description: Nafir The nafir ( nah - FEER ) was a Zakharan wind instrument similar to a trumpet . Description . " Nafirs " resembled long , thin trumpets and were made from metal .
description_long: Nafir The nafir ( nah - FEER ) was a Zakharan wind instrument similar to a trumpet . Description . " Nafirs " resembled long , thin trumpets and were made from metal . History . Though less common in south Zakhara , the " nafir " was used widely in both Qudra and the Free Cities as a signalling device and to send military orders into the field .

title: Nafyrra Dyrr
description: Nafyrra Dyrr Nafyrra Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1372 . History . Nafyrra commanded a contingent of 80 warriors , mostly of her house , at the Rhazzt ' s Dilemma outpost in order to detect enemies arriving during the Silence of Lolth .
description_long: Nafyrra Dyrr Nafyrra Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1372 . History . Nafyrra commanded a contingent of 80 warriors , mostly of her house , at the Rhazzt ' s Dilemma outpost in order to detect enemies arriving during the Silence of Lolth . Duergar s and tanarukk bypassed Nafyrra and her troops and captain Zhayemd later reported that she and her soldiers were all killed . However , this was all a lie because the truth was that House Dyrr had allied with the invaders .

title: Naga
description: Naga Nagas are a race of intelligent snake - like immortal s with widely differing abilities and alignments . They resemble giant snakes , some with humanoid heads and some with more snake - like heads , both of which have a certain amount of spell casting power . They have also been known to eat the flesh of humans , orcs , and other races .
description_long: Naga Nagas are a race of intelligent snake - like immortal s with widely differing abilities and alignments . They resemble giant snakes , some with humanoid heads and some with more snake - like heads , both of which have a certain amount of spell casting power . They have also been known to eat the flesh of humans , orcs , and other races . Nagas were created , along with yuan - ti , by the reptilian Creator Race , the sarrukh . Society . Most nagas worship the naga creator goddess Shekinester and her son Parrafaire , except for dark naga s , who venerate Sess ' innek . Combat . Nagas favor spells over other forms of combat . Because they are almost always found in places that they have guarded for many years and know well , they can usually arrange encounters to suit their wishes . Nagas in the Forgotten Realms . Nagas of every subspecies are found across the length and breadth of Faerûn . Most favor ancient ruins of long - fallen empires as lairs . Dark nagas are most common in the Serpent Hills and the Dalelands region , whereas guardian nagas favor lost ruins along the Sword Coast and the northern shore of the Shining Sea .

title: Naga ( yakuza )
description: Naga ( yakuza ) Naga was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naga recently became known for his many unorthodox ideas , which were not really appreciated by his fellows .
description_long: Naga ( yakuza ) Naga was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naga recently became known for his many unorthodox ideas , which were not really appreciated by his fellows . History . Naga was a yakuza with some followers . In 1358 DR , he plotted to kidnap Sono , the servant and lover of Buntaro Ostato , in order to blackmail Buntaro . Despite the veto of his elders , he proceeded with his plan .

title: Naga Crawls
description: Naga Crawls The Naga Crawls were a series of caverns in the Deep Wastes noted as the lair of a trio of spirit naga . Geography . The Naga Crawls were located 52 .
description_long: Naga Crawls The Naga Crawls were a series of caverns in the Deep Wastes noted as the lair of a trio of spirit naga . Geography . The Naga Crawls were located 52 . 5 miles ( 84 . 4 km ) east of Szith Morcane at the end of a branch of tunnels through the Deep Wastes . Description . A roughly 150 - ft - deep ( 45 . 7 m ) set of caverns , the ceiling of the Naga Crawls was about 8 ft ( 2 . 4 m ) in height at the entrance and only 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) high further in . Cold streams of water wound their way through the Crawls , trickling into shallow pools at the deepest parts of the cavern . A single rusted iron ladder provided the only means of entrance from the tunnels of the Deep Wastes to the narrow caverns above , the stream pouring down the ladder in a cold waterfall . History . At some point before 1372 DR , a trio of spirit naga made these caverns their home . They lured many creatures to their deaths here , earning the cavern its moniker . During the Silence of Lolth , they managed to coax a stone giant deep into their lair , where they could feast on its trapped corpse . Inhabitants . A trio of spirit naga laired here circa 1372 DR .

title: Naga Plains
description: Naga Plains The Naga Plains are a grouping of tall grasslands located between the Golden Road and the Nagawater , in the nation of Sespech . Recent History . There are persistant rumors that naga s live among the grasses .
description_long: Naga Plains The Naga Plains are a grouping of tall grasslands located between the Golden Road and the Nagawater , in the nation of Sespech . Recent History . There are persistant rumors that naga s live among the grasses . Though there has never been a reported attack , travelers to the region still tend to avoid the plains .

title: Nagaflow
description: Nagaflow The Nagaflow was a river in the country of Sespech in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The source of the Nagaflow lay in the depths of of the Chondalwood .
description_long: Nagaflow The Nagaflow was a river in the country of Sespech in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The source of the Nagaflow lay in the depths of of the Chondalwood . The river was described as long and lazy . After linking with the Wintercloak River , it widened into a deep , freshwater lake called the Nagawater , then finally drained into the Vilhon Reach near Nimpeth . Inhabitants . Naga s from the Nagawater often swam down the Nagaflow . The river ' s upper stretch was a spawning ground for all breeds of naga . Furthermore , Phelriss , a yuan - ti anathema , made its lair in the area . It was venerated as a god by a cult of dark and spirit naga s .

title: Nagamat
description: Nagamat Nagamat was a dragon general of Tiamat during the Time of Dragons . History . In −30000 DR , Nagamat was in charge of the siege of the aearee kingdom of Shara , destroying its hatcheries and claiming the realm as his own .
description_long: Nagamat Nagamat was a dragon general of Tiamat during the Time of Dragons . History . In −30000 DR , Nagamat was in charge of the siege of the aearee kingdom of Shara , destroying its hatcheries and claiming the realm as his own . He was soon drawn into religious conflicts between the factions of the draconic gods , and in −29500 DR , he was killed at the hands of followers of Xymor . His death sparked the Dragonfall War , a conflict between the followers of Bahamut and Tiamat , which persisted for thousands of years .

title: Nagawater
description: Nagawater The Nagawater was formerly a large , deep lake located in Sespech . It was named for the large number of water naga s that lived in the southern region of the lake . A line of buoys lit with continual flame spells marked the boundry between the north half of the lake that human s inhabited and the southern part left for the naga s .
description_long: Nagawater The Nagawater was formerly a large , deep lake located in Sespech . It was named for the large number of water naga s that lived in the southern region of the lake . A line of buoys lit with continual flame spells marked the boundry between the north half of the lake that human s inhabited and the southern part left for the naga s . The spellplague completely obliterated the lake and the area formerly occupied by the lake is now part of the Plaguewrought Land .

title: Naglatha
description: Naglatha Naglatha , alias the Black Flame , was Red Wizard of Thay residing in Selgaunt in Sembia . Description . Naglatha in 1357 DR was a young , black - haired woman with a grim face .
description_long: Naglatha Naglatha , alias the Black Flame , was Red Wizard of Thay residing in Selgaunt in Sembia . Description . Naglatha in 1357 DR was a young , black - haired woman with a grim face . Personality . Naglatha quickly rose through the ranks of the Red Wizards thanks to her fanatical zeal and her ruthlessness . However , she was loyally devoted to the god Azuth . History . Naglatha arrived in Selgaunt early in 1357 DR with a very deep cover ; even Alzegund was unaware of her identity as a Red Wizard of Thay . Everyone in the Dragon Reach area thought she was only a merchant with a preference for extravagant tools from south Faerûn . She even ran a small curiosity shop in Selgaunt . In truth , using the alias " the Black Flame " , she was recruiting valorous men to Thay ' s cause . She always used a black mask in her mission in order to disguise her identity . Once a year she went " to the South " for three months , in truth traveling to Thay to receive new instructions . Later she rose through the ranks thanks to the death of Alzegund in 1364 DR .

title: Nagoya Hatano
description: Nagoya Hatano Nagoya Hatano was the head of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hatano withdrawn into his own family to avoid people ' s suspects .
description_long: Nagoya Hatano Nagoya Hatano was the head of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hatano withdrawn into his own family to avoid people ' s suspects . Hatano want only to maintain its current level of prosperity in the upcoming troubles which he foresaw . His policy was a careful neutrality . History . Hatano born from a minor samurai in the service of Lord Toragi and a beautiful wood spirit . Through mysterious circumstances the two were wed and Hatano was born but soon after , equally mysteriously , Hatano ’ s mother disappeared . Hatano know nothing about the illicit romance between his son Nagoya Kenko and Sumi - ko but if he discovered the young Kenko will be in deep trouble Personality . Hatano known people were suspect about his heritage and so withdrawn into his own family . He was bitter and sullen , given to saying little .

title: Nagoya Kenko
description: Nagoya Kenko Nagoya Kenko was the heir of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kenko usually spend more than he can afford on clothes .
description_long: Nagoya Kenko Nagoya Kenko was the heir of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kenko usually spend more than he can afford on clothes . He was fascinated by mirrors , but only when he is reflected in them . History . At a a moon - viewing party Kenko met the young Sumi - ko , daughter of Funada Toyoo . She fall in love for Kenko and they soon started a illicit romance . However Funada Genzo discovered the matter and in order to protect his half - sister payed a visit to Kenko menacing him but this only made Kenko angry Personality . Kenko was a spoiled child that grow to became a pompous , and openly disrespectful individual . He secretly resented his father for his unnatural heritage and profited of his father ' s love . He was an utter and complete cad . Kenko not love Sumi - ko but his vanity was pleased by her attention . = = Appendix = =

title: Nahal ' s reckless dweomer
description: Nahal ' s reckless dweomer Nahal ' s reckless dweomer was an arcane spell that used wild magic on a most basic level . The caster invoked a surge of magical energy in order to create the effect of any one spell known to him . Often however , the release of energy created a completely unpredictable result .
description_long: Nahal ' s reckless dweomer Nahal ' s reckless dweomer was an arcane spell that used wild magic on a most basic level . The caster invoked a surge of magical energy in order to create the effect of any one spell known to him . Often however , the release of energy created a completely unpredictable result . Thus this simple spell , which only required verbal and somatic component s , carried both great potential and great risk , and therefore was usually used when no other route was open to the caster . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as reckless dweomer . Users . As a wild magic spell , " Nahal ' s reckless dweomer " was usable only by wild mage s . Among those it was considered a common spell .

title: Nahopaca
description: Nahopaca The Nahopaca were a group of people living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society .
description_long: Nahopaca The Nahopaca were a group of people living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society . Unlike the Dog People , the Nahopaca disliked the arid desert environment and so migrated to a less harsh area further north , living among the brush of the Pasocada Basin . They were hunter - gatherers , using their nomadic lifestyle to find the most plentiful source of food at any one time . They were not above raiding humanoid civilizations such as the Azuposi , but they would not go near the ruins of Esh Alakar , because of a Nahopacan myth about evil forces being imprisoned there . The Nahopaca spoke their own language . Combat . Nahopaca fought with bows and arrows . History . The Nahopaca were distantly related to the Dog People .

title: Naib ibn - Sodar
description: Naib ibn - Sodar Naib ibn - Sodar was an elven sorcerer who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naid was in charge of the wizard s who guarded the Grand Gate of Delights leading into the Palace .
description_long: Naib ibn - Sodar Naib ibn - Sodar was an elven sorcerer who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naid was in charge of the wizard s who guarded the Grand Gate of Delights leading into the Palace . She organized the shifts of mages , sorcerers , and elemental mage s into 8 - hour shifts to add magical support to the mamluk s guarding the gate . Possessions . As with all mages stationed at the Grand Gate of Delights , Naib owned a " wand of paralyzation " .

title: Naican
description: Naican The Naican were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the southwestern region of the Endless Waste .
description_long: Naican The Naican were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the southwestern region of the Endless Waste . Their territory bordered the lands of the Commani , Tuigan , and Dalat tribes . Society . The Naican spoke their own language , which was influenced by the Raumatharan Empire and the language of Muhjuri . The Naican were friendly with the Commani , Zamogedi , and Tuigan tribes , and opposed to the Oigur and the Dalat . The Naican sometimes raided with the Commani to the south in Semphar . History . Before the rise of the Tuigan to dominance , there were many marriages between the the Naican and the Zamogedi , solidifying the friendship between these two people groups . For many ages , the Dalat had raided Naican territory , and the conflicts only grew worse over the years , resulting in blood feuds and nearly open warfare . This feud with the Dalat led to a feud with the Oigur , as that tribe would sometimes join with the Dalat in the raids . At one point in history , the Naican shared the same pasture lands as the Tuigan .

title: Naican language
description: Naican language Naican was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Naican had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds .
description_long: Naican language Naican was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Naican had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds . Many of its consonant sounds were harsh , such as C and K . The sound of L was heavily aspirated . Its grammar had a subject – object – verb order . Speakers . This tongue was spoken by the nomadic Naican tribe . Script . Naican did not have a written form . History . It was a hybrid language derived from both the Northern and Southern Imaskari language groups . It was influenced by the empire of Raumathar and also the language of Muhjuri .

title: Nain Keenwhistler
description: Nain Keenwhistler Nain Keenwhistler is a human wizard from Waterdeep . He has been resurrected more times than anyone else in the city . He lives at Naingate in the Sea Ward , his own personal tower .
description_long: Nain Keenwhistler Nain Keenwhistler is a human wizard from Waterdeep . He has been resurrected more times than anyone else in the city . He lives at Naingate in the Sea Ward , his own personal tower . Description . Nain had blonde hair that has now turned white and he has black eyes , although he has a healthy complexion . Possessions . Nain owns a magical + 1 dagger , and a " decanter of endless water " . Personality . Nain is shy and retiring . He worships Mystra and Tymora . History . Nain is an ex - member of the Company of Crazed Venturers and in their service , died many times , each time being resurrected again . Notably , he fought Iyachtu Xvim , son of the deity Bane . He has since become friends with Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and Durnan , and Malchor Harpell is his colleague . He maintains a strong friendship with Sharest Tanthalar after they met at one of Mirt ' s parties . After retiring from the company , he used the wealth he had accumulated to construct Naingate , a tower in the Sea Ward , where he resides .

title: Naingate
description: Naingate Naingate is the wizard tower of Nain Keenwhistler , wizard and former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . It is located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep , at the intersection of Grimwald ' s Way and Seawatch Street . It is used by Nain as a home , as well as a base for his research .
description_long: Naingate Naingate is the wizard tower of Nain Keenwhistler , wizard and former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . It is located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep , at the intersection of Grimwald ' s Way and Seawatch Street . It is used by Nain as a home , as well as a base for his research .

title: Najara
description: Najara Najara , a large kingdom in the Western Heartlands , was inhabited by a wide variety of serpentfolk . It comprised parts of the High Moor , the Forest of Wyrms , and the Marsh of Chelimber , with the Serpent Hills existing in the center . It not functioning as a typical government , its status as a kingdom is a disputed subject .
description_long: Najara Najara , a large kingdom in the Western Heartlands , was inhabited by a wide variety of serpentfolk . It comprised parts of the High Moor , the Forest of Wyrms , and the Marsh of Chelimber , with the Serpent Hills existing in the center . It not functioning as a typical government , its status as a kingdom is a disputed subject . History . Before the Spellplague , the Marsh of Chelimber was one of many areas ruled by the Zhentarim . Due to the effects of this event , they lost control of some of these lands , and the marsh was taken over by Najara ' s naga , though lizardfolk , undead , and minotaurs still lived as the majority there . In 1497 DR , Terpenzi returned in his undead form , bound to the Marlspire of Najara . The King of Snakes — the monarch ruling Najara — was Jarant , who had killed the previous king Ebarnaje and made Najara more relevant to Elturgard and Evereska due to the prior civil war . Due to more nations gaining knowledge of Najara , it became a subject of interest for its many ancient ruins , including some from the Netherese empire and the kingdom of Boareskyr . Religion .

title: Najeeya
description: Najeeya Najeeya was a student inhabiting the White Agate ' s Tower in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to her studies , Najeeya met with callers who came seeking answers from her master .
description_long: Najeeya Najeeya was a student inhabiting the White Agate ' s Tower in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to her studies , Najeeya met with callers who came seeking answers from her master . She would hold follow - up meetings a week later and return with the desired answers . She had her own room on the top floor of the tower . Relationships . Najeeya was the most trusted pupil of the famous White Agate . As such , she was privileged to secret information regarding the vast treasures of the tower . Rumors and Legends . The White Agate kept a " clone " of Najeeya within his treasure vault in case she met an untimely end .

title: Najib al - Dhi ' b
description: Najib al - Dhi ' b Najib al - Dhi ' b was the leader of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . His duties kept Najib at court for much of his time , where he took orders directly from the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir .
description_long: Najib al - Dhi ' b Najib al - Dhi ' b was the leader of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . His duties kept Najib at court for much of his time , where he took orders directly from the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir .

title: Najib al - Samsi
description: Najib al - Samsi Najib al - Samsi was the ruler of Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Najib was a skinny , balding man who had heavily weathered skin from time spent outdoors .
description_long: Najib al - Samsi Najib al - Samsi was the ruler of Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Najib was a skinny , balding man who had heavily weathered skin from time spent outdoors . Activities . Najib held court once a week to spend time gossiping or to settle any new disputes . The court was attended by fellow captains and friends .

title: Najit ' aqalat
description: Najit ' aqalat Najit ' aqalat was a bound marid who served as harbormaster of Hawa within the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Abilities . Najit ' aqalat possesed all of the impressive abilities common to marids .
description_long: Najit ' aqalat Najit ' aqalat was a bound marid who served as harbormaster of Hawa within the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Abilities . Najit ' aqalat possesed all of the impressive abilities common to marids . Activities . Najit ' aqalat collected a small fee from every ship entering the harbor of Chaos Bay . He would then physically pull the ships into the docking area . Relationships . Bound in service by the sha ' ir Inayah bint In ' am , his contract was renegotiated every 101 days . Most marids distasted dealing with mortals , but Najit enjoyed the verbal sparring with Inayah .

title: Najm
description: Najm Najm was the dashing god or goddess of adventure and curiosity of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and wanted his followers to venture forth an make the unknown known . Najm ' s symbol was a single arrow pointed upward .
description_long: Najm Najm was the dashing god or goddess of adventure and curiosity of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and wanted his followers to venture forth an make the unknown known . Najm ' s symbol was a single arrow pointed upward . Najm was alternatively described as female or male . Like other Zakharan gods , she was above such concerns as alignment , as curiosity may drive an adventurer to seek out the corners of the earth to help those in need or a necromancer to defile the living and dead . Her church sought the hinterlands and heathen parts to spread Enlightement . Further Reading . Related information can be found here :

title: Nakamaru
description: Nakamaru Nakamaru was a city in Wa known to maintain the largest quarter for the residences of foreign merchants and dignitaries , through special dispensation of the Empress Bishkammon . Nakamaru was the original home province of the Marasuuri family . Geography .
description_long: Nakamaru Nakamaru was a city in Wa known to maintain the largest quarter for the residences of foreign merchants and dignitaries , through special dispensation of the Empress Bishkammon . Nakamaru was the original home province of the Marasuuri family . Geography . It was on the coast of the northernmost province of Tsukishima .

title: Nakata
description: Nakata Nakata was an ancient spirit of Rashemen , a wolf - telthor friend of Okku . She lived in Okku ' s barrow and served the God of Bears . There is little known about her .
description_long: Nakata Nakata was an ancient spirit of Rashemen , a wolf - telthor friend of Okku . She lived in Okku ' s barrow and served the God of Bears . There is little known about her . It was only said , that " her howls led an army of beasts across the groaning ice of Tirulag , where she was struck down by an eater of souls " . Soon after that she become a telthor and slept in Okku ' s home for many centuries . In 1374 DR Nakata ' s soul was eaten by the Spirit - eater ( the Kalach - Cha ) and she was the first victim of his curse .

title: Nakhuda
description: Nakhuda Nakhuda ( pl . nawakhid ) was the term used to describe someone who owned a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities .
description_long: Nakhuda Nakhuda ( pl . nawakhid ) was the term used to describe someone who owned a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . These individuals did not have to be the captain of a ship , but the person who held the papers of ownership for the vessel . " Nakhuda " typically did not issue orders regarding the daily activities , but determined the ultimate goals of the ship and its passengers or crew . Most of their work was typically done while in port .

title: Nako Nang
description: Nako Nang Nako Nang was a merchant in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Nako owned a shop in Talung but was often out with caravans .
description_long: Nako Nang Nako Nang was a merchant in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Nako owned a shop in Talung but was often out with caravans . He had traveled all over Tabot and most of T ' u Lung . He was an able guide and a true adventurer .

title: Naktong Moors
description: Naktong Moors The Naktong Moors were a tract of moorland in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . They lay west of the settlement of Konang Pen . Trade .
description_long: Naktong Moors The Naktong Moors were a tract of moorland in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . They lay west of the settlement of Konang Pen . Trade . Local folk from Konang Pen dug peat out of the moor to use as fuel . Inhabitants . It was said that magical beast s dwelled upon the moors , including unicorn s and the notorious s ' domo rhan , a giant beetle that could disguise itself as a beautiful woman . There were undead , too , such as zombie s and peat mummies that had been preserved in the bogs . History . Huat Rhu , the famed general of Koguryo , once led his soldiers on an expedition into the Naktong Moors . They never returned . By the 14th century DR , it was rumored they still wandered the moors , now as peat mummies and zombies hunting for fresh blood .

title: Nakulutiun
description: Nakulutiun The Nakulutiuns were a reclusive people residing in the Nakvaligach region of the Great Glacier , the most inhospitable area of that frozen wilderness . They were the smallest ( only 5 % ) of the tribes collectively called the Ulutiun s . Description .
description_long: Nakulutiun The Nakulutiuns were a reclusive people residing in the Nakvaligach region of the Great Glacier , the most inhospitable area of that frozen wilderness . They were the smallest ( only 5 % ) of the tribes collectively called the Ulutiun s . Description . Nakulutiuns were short like all Ulutiuns , having round and flat facial features , but they were thinner . They rarely were taller than five feet ( 150 cm ) . Males usually weighed between 130 and 260 pounds ( 60 – 120 kg ) , and females were about 35 pounds ( 16 kg ) lighter . They had short and thick legs with stubby fingers and toes . Their ears and nose were tiny , and they had especially wide teeth . They had light yellow or brown skin , dark brown eyes , and black hair , but they tended to have hollow eyes . Nakulutiuns had more fat under their skin than other humans and extra blood vessels in their extremities . Males could not grow facial hair . These adaptations gave them a special resistance to living in the frigid cold weather of their native lands .

title: Nakvaligach
description: Nakvaligach Nakvaligach , also called the " Northern Barrens " , was the most dangerous region of the Great Glacier . Geography . Nakvaligach , the smallest of the three regions of the Glacier , was located north of Alpuk , across the Uppuk River .
description_long: Nakvaligach Nakvaligach , also called the " Northern Barrens " , was the most dangerous region of the Great Glacier . Geography . Nakvaligach , the smallest of the three regions of the Glacier , was located north of Alpuk , across the Uppuk River . It was bordered on the west and east by the Tuutsaas Chain and the Keryjek Ridge respectively . Unlike the two " Basins " , Alpuk and Angalpuk , Nakvaligach was covered with mountainous terrain and treacherous crevasses . This played a role in the architecture of the region , where Nakvaligach residents made use of stones in their constructions . It also affected the ease of transportation ; sleds were not of great use here . The ice depth was usually between 200 and 500 feet ( 60 – 150 m ) , though it thinned to as little as five to ten feet ( one and a half to three meters ) in central areas . In the northern mountains , the ice layer was nearly a mile ( one and a half kilometers ) thick . There was very little potable water in the region . Weather .

title: Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn
description: Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn was the unusual drider weapon master of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Nal ' dorltyrr was appointed as weapon master in 1469 DR after the elder boy and previous weapon master was killed at a party .
description_long: Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn was the unusual drider weapon master of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Nal ' dorltyrr was appointed as weapon master in 1469 DR after the elder boy and previous weapon master was killed at a party . This was a scandal in the city because no drider had ever before had such a powerful position . However , Nal ' dorltyrr proved that his ability with weapons was unrivaled in his house . He was constantly challenged by rivals but Nal ' dorltyrr had defeated them all .

title: Nala
description: Nala Nala , formerly a member of Clan Yrjixtilex , was a dragonborn priest ess of Tiamat and a servant of Skuthosiin , who posed as a cleric of Bahamut in order to infiltrate and corrupt the Platinum Cadre . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Nala was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .
description_long: Nala Nala , formerly a member of Clan Yrjixtilex , was a dragonborn priest ess of Tiamat and a servant of Skuthosiin , who posed as a cleric of Bahamut in order to infiltrate and corrupt the Platinum Cadre . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Nala was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description . Nala had brown scales speckled with gold , and scars were she once wore her clan ' s piercings . Unlike most female dragonborn , Nala had a lithe body . Abilities . Nala was able to breathe fire . Thanks to her connection with Tiamat , she was able to maker her breath more powerful and could use it more often than normal dragonborn . Relationships . She was the lover of Patrin , the leader of the order . History . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Nala had been casted out of her clan . In 1479 DR , she was part of the group of members of the Platinum Cadre that went to the Black Ash Plain to exterminate as many ash giants as they could . Nala initiated new members of the order into the mysteries of Tiamat , all the while claiming that it was really Bahamut ' s power she was channeling .

title: Nalaskur Thaelond
description: Nalaskur Thaelond Nalaskur Thaelond was an innkeeper of the Bargewright Inn and a member of the Zhentarim during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . From his inn , Nalaskur was able to keep tabs on all travelers .
description_long: Nalaskur Thaelond Nalaskur Thaelond was an innkeeper of the Bargewright Inn and a member of the Zhentarim during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . From his inn , Nalaskur was able to keep tabs on all travelers . The Zhentarim also used Nalaskur ' s inn as a meeting place and a point for storing illicit goods on route to Waterdeep .

title: Nalavarauthatoryl
description: Nalavarauthatoryl Nalavarauthatoryl or Nalavara , formerly the elven wizard Lorelei Alavara , was an elf - dragon . History . She swore vengeance on the Obarskyr name and all humans in Cormyr after a member of the Obarskyr family slew her lover .
description_long: Nalavarauthatoryl Nalavarauthatoryl or Nalavara , formerly the elven wizard Lorelei Alavara , was an elf - dragon . History . She swore vengeance on the Obarskyr name and all humans in Cormyr after a member of the Obarskyr family slew her lover . In 116 DR , a group of five human Cormyr ean wizards cast binding spells , specifically keyed to the elf - dragon , and imprisoned her in the Grodd demiplane . In the casting , two of the wizards gave their lives to empower the final words of the spell . In the process , several of Nalavara ' s companions were also cast into a parallel dimension . She was later freed by the magic of Vangerdahast , Cormyr ' s Royal Wizard . She brought with her the Grodd goblin s , a tribe of goblin s from the city of Grodd . She was also responsible for the creation of ghazneth s from the long - dead members of the royal family who had betrayed Cormyr in some way . She was the primary force behind the Goblin War . In 1371 DR , Nalavara and King Azoun IV fought and finally killed each other .

title: Nalfein Do ' Urden
description: Nalfein Do ' Urden Nalfein Do ' Urden was the elderboy and house wizard of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until his death . History . Nalfein studied wizardry at Sorcere , the drow academy for wizards in Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Nalfein Do ' Urden Nalfein Do ' Urden was the elderboy and house wizard of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until his death . History . Nalfein studied wizardry at Sorcere , the drow academy for wizards in Menzoberranzan . In 1297 DR , Nalfein participated in House Do ' Urden ' s attack on House DeVir . During the battle , Dinin Do ' Urden , the secondboy of House Do ' Urden , distracted Nalfein and put a sword in his back . Maya Do ' Urden , melded to Nalfein , sensed his death and announced it , thus sparing newborn Drizzt ' s life from being sacrificed to Lolth as the third living son . Relationships . Nalfein was the elder brother of Dinin and Drizzt Do ' Urden . Nalfein was the long - time enemy of Ozomar Do ' Urden ( formerly of House Druu ' giir ) , who defected from his house and became the house wizard of House Do ' Urden after Nalfein ' s death .

title: Nalfeshnee
description: Nalfeshnee Nalfeshnees , also known as Type IV demon s , were a powerful type of demon . They were the judges of the Abyss . Description .
description_long: Nalfeshnee Nalfeshnees , also known as Type IV demon s , were a powerful type of demon . They were the judges of the Abyss . Description . Nalfeshnees were 20 feet tall and weighed 8 , 000 lbs . They had small , feathered wings ; despite their flimsy appearance , the wings enabled nalfeshnees to fly . Their bodies were " corpulent " and they stood on their back legs as a humanoid . Personality . Nalfeshnees acted as the servitors of the Abyss . In their minds , nalfeshnees saw themselves enacting the " justice of the universe " by bringing about the destruction of everything . Combat . Nalfeshnees were often disdainful of battle , but were unable to resist their blood lust . They were most fond of their " smite " ability , which dazed enemies and allowed the nalfeshnee to attack unhindered . Like other tanar ' ri , they could summon fellow tanar ' ri to aid them when needed .

title: Nalia de ' Arnise
description: Nalia de ' Arnise Nalia de ' Arnise is a young Amnian noblewoman of a particularly charitable bent . She has learnt some rogue skills in the process of sneaking out of her home to help out those less well off , something her guardians did not much approve of , especially as her mother had died of an illness contracted during such charity . Besides of this , she is a capable mage .
description_long: Nalia de ' Arnise Nalia de ' Arnise is a young Amnian noblewoman of a particularly charitable bent . She has learnt some rogue skills in the process of sneaking out of her home to help out those less well off , something her guardians did not much approve of , especially as her mother had died of an illness contracted during such charity . Besides of this , she is a capable mage . Nalia lived in her family castle with her father and aunt until it was attacked by troll s and yuan - ti . Her father was killed during the attack , leaving her as a female heir little chance to legally inherit the castle without finding someone suitably martially inclined to act as its new lord ( or lady ) . Nalia is one of the potential party NPC s in " " ( and , consequently , in " " as well ) . She can be found in the Copper Coronet , pleading others to help her as she has helped them , looking for someone to help her defend her castle against an attack . She will recognize the player character ' s party as adventurers and ask them for help , although she won ' t reveal the attackers are troll s until after reaching the castle .

title: Nalifarn
description: Nalifarn Nalifarn was an durzagon alchemist and chieftain around 1485 DR . History . Nalifarn led a clan of duergar .
description_long: Nalifarn Nalifarn was an durzagon alchemist and chieftain around 1485 DR . History . Nalifarn led a clan of duergar . In 1485 DR , he was approached by the pit fiend Baazka , who offered an alliance with his Red Wizard masters . Nalifarn accepted and , with the Red Wizards ' help , took control of the Firehammer Hold . In exchange , the durzagon started managing weapons for the Thayan s . Nalifarn planned to make the Hold a permanent duergar outpost . Later , he was killed by an adventuring party hired to search for Jekk Ironfist .

title: Naloc
description: Naloc Naloc was the high priest of Zaltec at Kultaka and one of the closest advisors of the Kultakan ' s ruler Takamal . History . In 1361 DR , he was with Takamal during the battle against the Golden Legion , when , in order to turn the destiny of the conflict , the mage Darien levitate d to them and killed first Naloc and then Takamal .
description_long: Naloc Naloc was the high priest of Zaltec at Kultaka and one of the closest advisors of the Kultakan ' s ruler Takamal . History . In 1361 DR , he was with Takamal during the battle against the Golden Legion , when , in order to turn the destiny of the conflict , the mage Darien levitate d to them and killed first Naloc and then Takamal .

title: Nalos
description: Nalos Nalos of Pumanath was the triton centurion of the sixth squad of Abydos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Initially during the Twelfth Serôs War , Nalos was skeptical about his mission and his position but , by 1370 DR , he had come to appreciated the shallow waters .
description_long: Nalos Nalos of Pumanath was the triton centurion of the sixth squad of Abydos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Initially during the Twelfth Serôs War , Nalos was skeptical about his mission and his position but , by 1370 DR , he had come to appreciated the shallow waters . His only concern was his brother ' s situation after the latter ' s acquisition of " Claw of Xynakt " ; however his contacts among the dukar s reassured Nalos . Activities . Monthly Nalos reported to his emperor via hippocampus courier on the progress of the Council .

title: Naltecona
description: Naltecona Naltecona was the last ruler of Nexal in 1361 DR . He was governed by superstition , as were most Nexalans , and the High Priest of Zaltec , Hoxitl , had a strong influence over his actions . He was the most brilliant general during the rule of his father Axalt .
description_long: Naltecona Naltecona was the last ruler of Nexal in 1361 DR . He was governed by superstition , as were most Nexalans , and the High Priest of Zaltec , Hoxitl , had a strong influence over his actions . He was the most brilliant general during the rule of his father Axalt . When Naltecona heard of Cordell ' s victories over the Kultaka ns and Payit s , he decided to meet Cordell ' s Golden Legion in the town of Palul . Rather than face the Legion in the field as had the Kultakans and Payits , he decided to lay an ambush for Cordell during a feast in his honor . Cordell learned of the ambush from his mage Darien and attacked the Nexalan warriors without warning . The resulting massacre nearly annihilated the Nexalan army and destroyed the town . Naltecona then welcomed Cordell into Nexal as an honored guest but Cordell took him prisoner inside his own palace . He was assassinated by Darien , an event that triggered the Night of Wailing .

title: Nalynaul
description: Nalynaul Nalynaul the Shriveled was an alhoon who commanded a small clan of wererat s in Yartar in 1372 DR . History . Nalynaul was originally based in the depths of Gauntlgtym , where it commanded a " druuth " , a community of doppelganger servants .
description_long: Nalynaul Nalynaul the Shriveled was an alhoon who commanded a small clan of wererat s in Yartar in 1372 DR . History . Nalynaul was originally based in the depths of Gauntlgtym , where it commanded a " druuth " , a community of doppelganger servants . Around 1340 DR , Nalynaul transformed itself into an illithilich and left the community , leaving it to its own devices provided they continued to pass information to it . However , most of the doppelgangers were soon destroyed by the vengeful illithids of Gauntlgtym . Nalynaul made a new base in the catacombs beneath Yartar , where it commanded a new group of servants , wererats . Relationships . Two doppelgangers of the " druuth " survived , Gondyl Ilitheeum and Semmonemily . Semmonemily , a Kraken Society agent and secret leader of the Hand of Yartar thieves ' guild , continued to work with Nalynaul , to their mutual advantage and a decline in rivalries between the wererats and the thieves .

title: Namarra
description: Namarra Namarra , also known as The Sword That Never Sleeps , is a unique magic + 2 keen longsword that glows light purple and can be commanded by its owner to cast " silence " at any time . It floats on water , and white sparks fly from it when it strikes metal . Both sides of the blade are engraved , one with " Namarra " and the other with " Never sleeps .
description_long: Namarra Namarra , also known as The Sword That Never Sleeps , is a unique magic + 2 keen longsword that glows light purple and can be commanded by its owner to cast " silence " at any time . It floats on water , and white sparks fly from it when it strikes metal . Both sides of the blade are engraved , one with " Namarra " and the other with " Never sleeps . " The only reason for its alternate name is this inscription , and it does not convey any powers of alertness . Nothing is known of the sword ' s history or creation , but it is worth around 30 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Namaxil
description: Namaxil Namaxil was a Jaguar Knight in Maztica . History . Naxamil was born in Qoral .
description_long: Namaxil Namaxil was a Jaguar Knight in Maztica . History . Naxamil was born in Qoral . When the village grew into a large city , thanks to the estate of Governor Cordell , he became one of the head workers involved in building warehouses . However , in 1370 DR Naxamil and two friends started a terrorist campaign trying to destroy the new settlement . They burned warehouses and freed some Payit slaves . One night , one of Namaxil ' s group tried to kill Cordell . The assassin failed but managed to escape .

title: Namble Swiftleg
description: Namble Swiftleg Namble Swiftleg was a human male and Squad Leader in the Second Battalion of the Amnwater Blues Regiment , in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Namble was a robust , active , honest , and sociable man who commanded the complete loyalty of his squad of soldiers , two men and two women . Possessions .
description_long: Namble Swiftleg Namble Swiftleg was a human male and Squad Leader in the Second Battalion of the Amnwater Blues Regiment , in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Namble was a robust , active , honest , and sociable man who commanded the complete loyalty of his squad of soldiers , two men and two women . Possessions . Namble was in possession of a magic longsword called " Blackflame " that was superbly good against undead . The entire sword became enveloped in cold , harmless black flames , as a warning to its owner , whenever it was near ( 10 ft or 3 m ) an undead creature . Appendix . Appearances . Namble Swiftleg appears in the 2nd edition adventure module Castle Spulzeer and offers the party a side quest to help a young girl in the tiny village of Moonhearth . If the party manages to save the girl , he gives them " Blackflame " .

title: Nameless ( tressym )
description: Nameless ( tressym ) Nameless was the tressym familiar of Tsarra Chaadren . Description . Nameless was jet black , with one blue eye and one green .
description_long: Nameless ( tressym ) Nameless was the tressym familiar of Tsarra Chaadren . Description . Nameless was jet black , with one blue eye and one green . History . From 1364 DR , Nameless was the familiar of Tsarra Chaadren , who became the second Blackstaff . The Spellplague merged Nameless and Tsarra ' s husband , the human Raergar , forming the Nameless Haunt . The location where they were merged was on the eastern side of Mount Waterdeep . Their merging created a permanent cat ' s head mark on the cobblestones , which remained no matter how many times they were replaced .

title: Nameless Haunt
description: Nameless Haunt The Nameless Haunt was a legendary cat - man creature that inhabited and guarded the Pellamcopse Woods north of Waterdeep . Description . The Nameless Haunt ' s body was shaped as a man , but he had huge black wings , a cat ' s head , and white sigils on his torso .
description_long: Nameless Haunt The Nameless Haunt was a legendary cat - man creature that inhabited and guarded the Pellamcopse Woods north of Waterdeep . Description . The Nameless Haunt ' s body was shaped as a man , but he had huge black wings , a cat ' s head , and white sigils on his torso . He retained at least some of the memories of his former selves , but was driven by a compulsion to protect the forest on behalf of the Blackstaff . History . The Nameless Haunt was formed by the Spellplague merging the tressym Nameless and the human Raergar . Nameless was the familiar of Tsarra Chaadren , a Blackstaff . Raergar was Tsarra ' s husband . The location where they were merged was on the eastern side of Mount Waterdeep . Their merging created a permanent cat ' s head mark on the cobblestones , which remained no matter how many times they were replaced .

title: Nameless One
description: Nameless One The main character of is a nameless human with a unique form of immortality . Rather than being protected from injury , his specific brand of unending life allows him to raise from the dead due to regeneration abilities , like a troll . However , with each rising , he loses large chunks of his memory , leaving him little clue as to what he was doing or even where he is .
description_long: Nameless One The main character of is a nameless human with a unique form of immortality . Rather than being protected from injury , his specific brand of unending life allows him to raise from the dead due to regeneration abilities , like a troll . However , with each rising , he loses large chunks of his memory , leaving him little clue as to what he was doing or even where he is . To counter this disorientation , the Nameless One had important facts tattooed on his back in large runes . These become hard to read , as the other side - effect of this immortality is to always bear the scars of combat . By the time of the opening of , the Nameless One is heavily scarred , a testament to how many times he has " died . " In the special version of , it is possible to buy items from a merchant in the city of Athkatla that mention the Nameless One .

title: Nameless One ( Shar )
description: Nameless One ( Shar ) The Nameless One was a shadovar girl and a high - ranking priestess and Chosen of Shar . History . She resided in Sakkors with her parents until it was destroyed around 1484 DR and her parents died in the fall .
description_long: Nameless One ( Shar ) The Nameless One was a shadovar girl and a high - ranking priestess and Chosen of Shar . History . She resided in Sakkors with her parents until it was destroyed around 1484 DR and her parents died in the fall . In 1486 DR , the Nameless One went to check the shadovar ' s secret village full of captive Chosen built by wizard Adolican Rhand . Later she asked to speak with Farideh . When Farideh ' s party made their escape , the Nameless One tried to stop them but was defeated by the just - arrived Mehen . She died during the destruction of the village .

title: Nameless Swamp
description: Nameless Swamp The Nameless Swamp is a small marsh located in the Dragon Coast . Geography . Located south of Elversult , the Nameless Swamp is west of the Giant ' s Run mountains .
description_long: Nameless Swamp The Nameless Swamp is a small marsh located in the Dragon Coast . Geography . Located south of Elversult , the Nameless Swamp is west of the Giant ' s Run mountains . Inhabitants . The swamp is noted for being the former home of the dracolich , Cypress .

title: Nammna
description: Nammna Nammna was a merchant from the city of Milvarune in Thesk in the 14th century DR . Nammna partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .
description_long: Nammna Nammna was a merchant from the city of Milvarune in Thesk in the 14th century DR . Nammna partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves . Nammna ' s own small merchant company was converted into a regional base for the coster . Nammna and the Seven Suns were in business by 1358 DR , and still going by 1374 DR .

title: Nan - kuo
description: Nan - kuo Nan - kuo was a monk member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nan - kuo was forced to abandon his monastery in T ' u Lung due to war .
description_long: Nan - kuo Nan - kuo was a monk member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nan - kuo was forced to abandon his monastery in T ' u Lung due to war . He started wandering Kara - Tur in search of enlightenment but with no fortune . At last , he arrived in Nakamaru . After a celebration of the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , Lui - hsia Chih sent Nan - kuo and Yench ' eng Tzu Yu to read the aura of Yin - kung T ' o . Activities . Nan - kuo tried to teach himself by recreating the particular chains of thought of his ancient masters . Personality . Nan - kuo was a lonely and unhappy man . His travels had greatly changed his mind , giving him wisdom and pain , as he could only see the world from more than point of view .

title: Nanathlor Greysword
description: Nanathlor Greysword Nanthalor Greysword was a fighter and the High Lord of Loudwater . Description . In 1358 DR , Nanathlor had a gray beard and long flowing gray hair .
description_long: Nanathlor Greysword Nanthalor Greysword was a fighter and the High Lord of Loudwater . Description . In 1358 DR , Nanathlor had a gray beard and long flowing gray hair . He wore a bastard sword on his back . History . Originally from Nimbral , Nanthalor was the son of a displaced noble and left his home ca 1307 DR to found his own land in the savage North . In 1315 DR he was the newest recruit in a group of skilled mercenary hunters hired by Pasuuk Rensha , the lord of Delimbiyr Vale , to capture the horn of a unicorn . After weeks of searching , the group captured a unicorn and Nanathlor was ordered to strike the killing blow . Unable to kill such a magnificent beast , Nanathlor vowed to his comrades to protect it against anyone trying to despoil it and together with twelve of his fellow hunters he overthrew his captain . Upon doing so , the unicorn revealed itself as an exarch of Mielikki and proclaimed that Nanathlor was the new Green Regent , the symbolic ruler of Delimbiyr Vale . Nanathlor and his comrades was asked to rid the vale from the rule of the Renshas .

title: Nandrel Gostur
description: Nandrel Gostur Nandrel Gostur was one of the richest inhabitants of the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports . Activities . Unknown for most people , Nandrel was a head member of the criminal organization " Shadowkiss " .
description_long: Nandrel Gostur Nandrel Gostur was one of the richest inhabitants of the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports . Activities . Unknown for most people , Nandrel was a head member of the criminal organization " Shadowkiss " . Although he was not a full supporter of the Scions of Amber ' s cause , since Father Thorn saved his son from a dragon attack in 1479 DR , Nandrel sent some of his agents to watch and help the aging dragonborn .

title: Naneatha Lharilstar
description: Naneatha Lharilstar Naneatha Lharilstar is a courtesan at Piergeiron ' s Palace as well as the leader of the Castle Ward cell of the Red Sashes . She is one of the two members of the Sashes who knows the true identity of the " One . " Appearance .
description_long: Naneatha Lharilstar Naneatha Lharilstar is a courtesan at Piergeiron ' s Palace as well as the leader of the Castle Ward cell of the Red Sashes . She is one of the two members of the Sashes who knows the true identity of the " One . " Appearance . A noticeably beautiful woman , Naneatha has black hair , striking green eyes and an olive complexion .

title: Nanfoodle Buswilligan
description: Nanfoodle Buswilligan Nanfoodle Buswilligan is a gnome alchemist around three and a half feet ( 1 . 1m ) tall . He has a little knowledge of illusion ism .
description_long: Nanfoodle Buswilligan Nanfoodle Buswilligan is a gnome alchemist around three and a half feet ( 1 . 1m ) tall . He has a little knowledge of illusion ism . He is a long - term personal friend of Shoudra Stargleam and was hired by Marchion Elastul Raurym to work his alchemy in Mirabar . Appearance . Nanfoodle is around three and a half feet tall with a long crooked nose . He is bald other than a semicircle of white hair on the back of his head from ear to ear . Background . Nanfoodle created a process whereby existing metals were enhanced with adamantine flakes . He had previously attempted to get the same result using lead , but found that this only weakened the original metal . Marchion Elastul was disappointed at this result , not noticing any benefits over creating an alloy . Since his arrival in Mirabar , Nanfoodle has attempted to avoid involvement in the politics of the city . Mithral Hall . In 1370 DR , Nanfoodle was ordered by Marchion Elastul Raurym to travel to Mithral Hall with Shoudra Stargleam in order to sabotage the industry there . He refused to do so and started helping Bruenor on his adventures .

title: Nanhu Oasis
description: Nanhu Oasis Nanhu Oasis , meaning South Lake Oasis in the language of the horsemen , was an oasis in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Teyla Shan mountain range , Nanhu Oasis was a small , shallow , lake covered in reeds .
description_long: Nanhu Oasis Nanhu Oasis , meaning South Lake Oasis in the language of the horsemen , was an oasis in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Teyla Shan mountain range , Nanhu Oasis was a small , shallow , lake covered in reeds . Due to the shortage of wells and other oasis in the region , Nanhu Oasis was an important stop for the caravans that went through the Fergana Pass out of Semphar to reach the Silk Road . During the summer , the lake was known to sometimes dry up , though water could often still be found by digging a little below the surface . No settlements were located along the lake due to its inconstant water supply . An ubbe lived at the lake around 1359 DR .

title: Nanna - Sin
description: Nanna - Sin Nanna - Sin was the Untheric god of the moon . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a black axe over a moon .
description_long: Nanna - Sin Nanna - Sin was the Untheric god of the moon . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a black axe over a moon . He was resurrected as non - god immortal by Asmodeus in 1487 DR . Description . Nanna - Sin manifested as a human male bathed in blue light that " beguiled " all who came within ten feet of it . At will , he could negate any heat , cold , electricity , light , or darkness effects . In battle he wielded the Black Axe of the Moon ' s Champion , a jet - black axe . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 - 294 " > < / ref > History . Nanna - Sin presumedly came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " . He was killed by one of the orcish gods in - 1071 DR , and his body was laid to rest in a God - Tomb in Unther . His tomb was destroyed by the fall of a dragonborn " djerad " during the Spellplague . The dragonborn Thymara , one of the survivors of the catastrophe , was guided to Nanna - Sin ' s tomb by the goddess Selûne , where she laid her eggs in safety .

title: Nanteuil
description: Nanteuil Nanteuil was a dwarf cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Nanteuil was always drunk until he accidentally killed a young half - elf woman .
description_long: Nanteuil Nanteuil was a dwarf cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Nanteuil was always drunk until he accidentally killed a young half - elf woman . He was sentenced to 85 years of hard work for his crime . To made amends , he stopped drinking and wanted all around him to also stop . He tried many times to convince the duke to ban alcohol from Daggerford and the militia suspected him of the attempted arson of one of the local taverns .

title: Naoki Katasube
description: Naoki Katasube Naoki Katasube was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Bingo village in a Niwa shoen , he controlled affairs from a beautiful house served by 20 servants .
description_long: Naoki Katasube Naoki Katasube was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Bingo village in a Niwa shoen , he controlled affairs from a beautiful house served by 20 servants . Naoki led one samurai and thirty bushi . Secretly , he used his position as ship inspector to steal goods to pay his debts . Personality . Naoki was indolent , always preferring to live in luxury than risk his life . He had huge debts with yakuza of Okahira and no idea to how fix the situation .

title: Naomi ( Wa )
description: Naomi ( Wa ) Naomi was a consort in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naomi on the surface looked like a mild and introverted woman but deep down she was strong - willed and intelligent .
description_long: Naomi ( Wa ) Naomi was a consort in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naomi on the surface looked like a mild and introverted woman but deep down she was strong - willed and intelligent . She loved Benju but refused his orders if she considered them foolish . Afterward , Benju always agreed with her reasoning . Activities . Naomi was the favorite consort of the daimyo Benju Matsumoto . Despite being born into a samurai family , she had no fighting training .

title: Naqqarah
description: Naqqarah The naqqarah ( nah - KAR - rah ) was a small Zakharan drum often worn at the side . Description . The " naqqarah " was fixed with a leather thong worn over the shoulder .
description_long: Naqqarah The naqqarah ( nah - KAR - rah ) was a small Zakharan drum often worn at the side . Description . The " naqqarah " was fixed with a leather thong worn over the shoulder . The body of the drum was made of fire - hardened clay with hide stretched over the head . It was played with a pair of thin sticks . History . " Naqqarahs " were popular among messengers and criers throughout the Land of Fate .

title: Nar ' ysr
description: Nar ' ysr El Nar ' ysr , which means " The Phoenix " in Alzhedo , was one of the most prolific prophets ever to live on Toril , with greater divinatory power than even Alaundo the Seer , famous for many thousands of predictions later recorded in a multi - volume work entitled " The Phoenix Prophecies " . Description . The Nar ' ysr , whose real name was lost to history , was one of the Abbalayar , a group of human s so unique to be considered a different race altogether .
description_long: Nar ' ysr El Nar ' ysr , which means " The Phoenix " in Alzhedo , was one of the most prolific prophets ever to live on Toril , with greater divinatory power than even Alaundo the Seer , famous for many thousands of predictions later recorded in a multi - volume work entitled " The Phoenix Prophecies " . Description . The Nar ' ysr , whose real name was lost to history , was one of the Abbalayar , a group of human s so unique to be considered a different race altogether . He had reddish skin and golden - colored hair . Personality . The Phoenix was a quiet man who rarely spoke , but when he felt a prophecy coming upon him , he spoke with boldness . Relationships . The Nar ' ysr was known to have had descendants , though only a few of these inherited his prophetic powers or distinct physical traits . History . The Nar ' ysr lived in the time of Calimshan ' s ancient past before even the end of the Calim Empire . During his life , he gave thousands of cryptic prophecies . His prophecies were recorded sometime in the tenth century DR by the Herald Swordswreath .

title: Nar - Aidiya
description: Nar - Aidiya Nar - Aidiya , or The Bonfire , was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description .
