Though he kept his true physical appearance hidden from nearly everyone , including members of the Brotherhood , Nar - Aidiya appeared to be a man in his mid - 40s with piercing black eyes , shining black hair , and a trimmed goatee .
description_long: Nar - Aidiya Nar - Aidiya , or The Bonfire , was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Though he kept his true physical appearance hidden from nearly everyone , including members of the Brotherhood , Nar - Aidiya appeared to be a man in his mid - 40s with piercing black eyes , shining black hair , and a trimmed goatee . He wore a scintillating scarlet " aba of the elements " paired with a white sash and white turban . His turban was pinned in place by a unique magic item called the " Incandescent Eye " . Activities . The Bonfire ruled the Brotherhood of the True Flame with an iron fist . He did not care if he was liked , so long as he was obeyed . Fear and respect were the tools of his trade . Most of his decisions were made from the Molten Throne in the Infernal Hall of Krak al - Mazhar , the secret fortress of the Brotherhood located deep within the Great Anvil of the Haunted Lands . Nar - Aidiya ordered the destruction of desert oases and the execution of all enemies of the Brotherhood . The fortress was rumored to be protected from genie s and other elemental mage s alike .

title: Nar Kerymhoarth
description: Nar Kerymhoarth Nar Kerymhoarth ( the Sleeping Citadel ) was an underground fortress known by most as the Nameless Dungeon . Description . The Eaerlann knew its true name but refused to speak it .
description_long: Nar Kerymhoarth Nar Kerymhoarth ( the Sleeping Citadel ) was an underground fortress known by most as the Nameless Dungeon . Description . The Eaerlann knew its true name but refused to speak it . It was located below a stone bluff in the High Forest near to Elven Port and at its entrance was a nearly impenetrable magically protected stone door . It was linked to Elven Port and Mhiilamniir by the Old Road . The site was guarded against intrusion by elven patrols , who wear a diamond - shaped brooch . History . In Alturiak , 1369 DR , the Scoured Legion of Hellgate Keep and a powerful band of naga s , yuan - ti and other serpents both invaded the site , driving off the garrison . The latter group arrived through a portal . They were in competition for control . On 16 Alturiak , 1374 DR , Sarya Dlardrageth used the complete Gatekeeper ' s Crystal to utterly dispel all of the magical protection and gained access . This freed the fey ' ri imprisoned within for the past five thousand years , who numbered almost two thousand .

title: Nar demonbinder
description: Nar demonbinder Nar Demonbinder is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Master of the black art of demon summoning , keeping alive the old , sinister traditions of the Empire of Narfell . Though it was thousands of years ago that the empire grew mighty on the strength of unholy wizard s and cruel priest - lords , this conjuring of demons contributed to its eventual downfall .
description_long: Nar demonbinder Nar Demonbinder is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Master of the black art of demon summoning , keeping alive the old , sinister traditions of the Empire of Narfell . Though it was thousands of years ago that the empire grew mighty on the strength of unholy wizard s and cruel priest - lords , this conjuring of demons contributed to its eventual downfall . Secrets of the ancient Nar lore still draw unscrupulous spellcasters who plunder the buried vaults of the long - vanished land in search of knowledge and power . Demonbinders are most often cleric s , sorcerer s or wizards . Only these classes retain the spells necessary to call up and command fiendish creatures , as a fair amount of skill with magic is demanded simply to qualify . They are also required to speak Abyssal .

title: Nar fiendbond
description: Nar fiendbond Nar fiendbond was a transmutation spell that transformed a person into a half - fiend . It was presumably developed by the Nars . Effects .
description_long: Nar fiendbond Nar fiendbond was a transmutation spell that transformed a person into a half - fiend . It was presumably developed by the Nars . Effects . The spell imbued a volunteer or victim with the essence of the fiendish planes , granting them powers as if they were the offspring of a full - blooded fiend . Components . The spell required a fortune in gem s .

title: Naralis Analor
description: Naralis Analor Naralis Analor ( sometimes seen as Naris Analor ) was a lesser member of the Seldarine and took the role of the elvish god of suffering , healing , and death . Unlike other gods with death in their portfolio , Naralis was caring and benevolent which made him a popular deity among those who risked death . Description .
description_long: Naralis Analor Naralis Analor ( sometimes seen as Naris Analor ) was a lesser member of the Seldarine and took the role of the elvish god of suffering , healing , and death . Unlike other gods with death in their portfolio , Naralis was caring and benevolent which made him a popular deity among those who risked death . Description . Naralis appeared as a male elf about 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) tall with blue - gray eyes and silver hair . He usually wore robe of white and gray with silver trim , sometimes with a design . Abilities . He was immune to psionics , all harmful or evil necromantic spells , and any spell that caused death . Possessions . Naralis wore an iron ring set with a black jewel on his left hand . With this ring he could cast " harm " once every minute . On his right hand he wore a mithril ring set with a clear jewel that glowed . With this ring he could cast " heal " once every minute . In battle , he carried a " longsword + 4 " that had a special draining ability against evil beings that had acted without reason or provocation to harm a good or neutral elf within the past year . Activities .

title: Nararoot
description: Nararoot Nararoot was a tuber that was used as birth control throughout Faerûn . Much cheaper than cassil herbs , nararoot shavings were taken by women . Nararoot could be diluted and steeped into tea for a more pleasant flavor .
description_long: Nararoot Nararoot was a tuber that was used as birth control throughout Faerûn . Much cheaper than cassil herbs , nararoot shavings were taken by women . Nararoot could be diluted and steeped into tea for a more pleasant flavor . Ingesting nararoot rendered the drinker infertile for a week or two .

title: Narbeck Horn
description: Narbeck Horn Narbcek Horn was the shield dwarf commander of Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narbeck commanded the local garrison of 150 veterans and responded directly to the marchion of Mirabar using a sending stone in order to inform the city of any menace .
description_long: Narbeck Horn Narbcek Horn was the shield dwarf commander of Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narbeck commanded the local garrison of 150 veterans and responded directly to the marchion of Mirabar using a sending stone in order to inform the city of any menace .

title: Narbondel
description: Narbondel The Narbondel was a huge stalagmite in the city of Menzoberranzan and served as a clock for its inhabitants . History . At one time , the drow Zaknafein Do ' Urden found Menzoberra ' s tomb within Narbondel and took the " Dagger of Menzoberra " back to the city .
description_long: Narbondel The Narbondel was a huge stalagmite in the city of Menzoberranzan and served as a clock for its inhabitants . History . At one time , the drow Zaknafein Do ' Urden found Menzoberra ' s tomb within Narbondel and took the " Dagger of Menzoberra " back to the city . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , the clocktower was bathed in searing flames that blinded those who looked upon it with darkvision . Structure . Narbondel was the only unshaped piece of stone within the boundaries of the city cavern and it was used as a clock . At the end of every day , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan cast magic upon the stone to heat it . The heat from the Archmage ' s spell formed a band around it and moved up . When the end of the glow was at the pillar ' s top , the day was almost done . When the pillar was completely dark , it was called " Narbondel ' s Black Death " ( effectively midnight ) . Tomb of Menzoberra . Besides being the clock of Menzoberranzan , the stone pillar housed a much greater secret . Within the stalagmite , the ancestors built the tomb of the legendary founder of the city itself , Menzoberra the Kinless .

title: Narbondellyn
description: Narbondellyn Narbondellyn was a district of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The district of Narbondellyn was located next to Narbondel , the city ' s enchanted clock pillar .
description_long: Narbondellyn Narbondellyn was a district of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The district of Narbondellyn was located next to Narbondel , the city ' s enchanted clock pillar . A mushroom forest separated it from the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl . Description . Narbondellyn was an elegant district with broad streets , fine homes , chic cafes and taverns , and expensive shops . It housed manors , theaters , an arena , and two of the ruling houses . Multicolored faerie fire highlighted the stone carvings on mansions and illuminated shop signs . It was the home of the wealthy up - and - coming drow houses and no less than seven existing powerful noble houses . Several of the most luxurious and profitable of businesses were located in this neighborhood as well . The best gems and perfumes could be found here , as well as the city ' s moneylenders . Inhabitants . Drow were by far the most numerous folk in Narbondellyn . Richly - dressed drow shopped and sampled the fares . City guards mounted on large lizards or giant slugs made frequent rounds . Goblin s could be found as personal servants , dwarf slaves repaired fine metal items , and minotaur s acted as guards .

title: Narder Ulthub
description: Narder Ulthub Narder Ulthub was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Narder regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned .
description_long: Narder Ulthub Narder Ulthub was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Narder regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned . He was a troublemaker liking provoking reactions . History . His partnership with Reyill was very good for Narder ' s businesses during the years . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Narder was drinking with his halfling s friends and Reyill at the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . Relationship . Narder was friend of Roge Applewink and Guylian Stundter . He had good dealing with Reyill Werned .

title: Naren Dafyre
description: Naren Dafyre Naren Dafyre was a merchant residing in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . He was a lesser lord of the Mandible gang , a position he believed was too low for him . History .
description_long: Naren Dafyre Naren Dafyre was a merchant residing in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . He was a lesser lord of the Mandible gang , a position he believed was too low for him . History . One of Naren ' s ancestors was the original owner of the Dragon ' s Tooth sword , the sword that The Mandible ' s leader held as a badge of office . Years prior to 1479 DR the sword compelled Naren to leave Waterdeep and journey to Skullport where he lived ever since . He clawed his way up the Mandible ' s hierarchy in an attempt to reclaim his ancestral sword .

title: Narfell
description: Narfell Narfell is a country in the eastern part of Faerûn . It lies in the Cold Lands region but was once the heart of a vast empire that stretched from the Giantspire Mountains to Lake Ashane which included the Great Dale , much of Thesk , part of the Plateau of Thay , what would become Impiltur , and other lands . History .
description_long: Narfell Narfell is a country in the eastern part of Faerûn . It lies in the Cold Lands region but was once the heart of a vast empire that stretched from the Giantspire Mountains to Lake Ashane which included the Great Dale , much of Thesk , part of the Plateau of Thay , what would become Impiltur , and other lands . History . In its height of power , Narfell was ruled by evil priests . They maintained their power through horrid blood - pacts with demon lords , gaining the control of demonic armies . This once great civilization fell over 1 , 500 years ago in a terrific battle with its ancient enemy , Raumathar . In - 970 DR , the Nentyarch of Tharos built his capital at Dun - Tharos and forged the artifact known as the Crown of Narfell . He then began to conquer the surrounding Nar kingdoms , bringing them under his rule . In - 946 DR , the nentyarch ' s armies destroyed Shaundaular , the capital of Ashanath , and all of the Nar kingdoms were united into the new empire of Narfell . Circa - 900 DR , both the Nar and Raumathari Empires rose to prominence . In −623 DR ( the Year of Clipped Wings ) , Narfell attempted to invade both Mulhorand and Unther by sea , which failed .

title: Narfelli language
description: Narfelli language Narfelli was the original language of the Nar people of the ancient Narfell i Empire . It was strongly influenced by the Abyssal language , as much of that empire ' s history was influenced by devil s and demon s . By 1372 DR , Narfelli was a dead language , and the survivors of the Narfelli Empire , the Nars , spoke Damaran and Naric .
description_long: Narfelli language Narfelli was the original language of the Nar people of the ancient Narfell i Empire . It was strongly influenced by the Abyssal language , as much of that empire ' s history was influenced by devil s and demon s . By 1372 DR , Narfelli was a dead language , and the survivors of the Narfelli Empire , the Nars , spoke Damaran and Naric . The language also had a strong influence on the modern Dambrathan language .

title: Nari al - Farif
description: Nari al - Farif Nari al - Farif was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nari was the Dean of the College of Fine Arts .
description_long: Nari al - Farif Nari al - Farif was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nari was the Dean of the College of Fine Arts . She often attended lectures by her instructors to ensure their competency . She would not hesitate to remove those whom she deemed unfit . Nari was fluent in every language taught by her college . Relationships . Nari was the niece of the head of the House of Al - Farif , a prominent merchant family in Huzuz .

title: Naric
description: Naric Naric was a language spoken by the Nars , from Icelace Lake in the north to Rawlinswood in the south , and from the Giantspire Mountains in the west to the Icerim Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages . It was presumably derived from the ancient language of Narfelli .
description_long: Naric Naric was a language spoken by the Nars , from Icelace Lake in the north to Rawlinswood in the south , and from the Giantspire Mountains in the west to the Icerim Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages . It was presumably derived from the ancient language of Narfelli . Most Nars also spoke Damaran .

title: Narim Sandir
description: Narim Sandir Narim Sandir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Narim was the dean of the College of Combat Technique .
description_long: Narim Sandir Narim Sandir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Narim was the dean of the College of Combat Technique . He would train students and traveling adventurers alike so long as they had the coin to cover the steep tuition costs . In addition to his duties with the college , Narim enjoyed smithing and was quite accomplished .

title: Narla Gulmaern
description: Narla Gulmaern Narla Gulmaern was a spellscar red tiefling tavern owner in Gontal City . Abilities . Narla ' s spellscar gave her the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence .
description_long: Narla Gulmaern Narla Gulmaern was a spellscar red tiefling tavern owner in Gontal City . Abilities . Narla ' s spellscar gave her the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence . She was also a highly skilled poison maker . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Narla managed the Night Kiss tavern .

title: Narle Shieldbiter
description: Narle Shieldbiter Narle Shieldbiter was an orog chieftain of the Burning Banner tribe in Thar and a mercenary in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Narle was persuaded by Sharrak ' s words to help the Cult of the Dragon and believed that his tribe was chosen to serve the soon - to - be dragon kings .
description_long: Narle Shieldbiter Narle Shieldbiter was an orog chieftain of the Burning Banner tribe in Thar and a mercenary in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Narle was persuaded by Sharrak ' s words to help the Cult of the Dragon and believed that his tribe was chosen to serve the soon - to - be dragon kings . They changed their artwork of war to honor dragons . Narle ' s model was Obould of Many - Arrows and he dream to one day rivaled the feats of that great king but in truth he not have the demeanor or discipline for it . He was also vain and greedy . History . Narle was hired by Sharrak , a cultist spy who had infiltrated the Claws of Tiamat bandit group . Sharrak instructed Narle to wait for a signal to attack and destroy a meeting between the Claws and another bandit group , the Gray Patriots . Narle led the attack , but in the fighting was defeated by an adventuring party hired to clear the Iron Route of outlaws . However he survived and allied with the stone giant shaman Kranum ( unknown to anyone possessed by Tyranthraxus ) in order to entered together at the service of new ruler of Phlan green dragon Vorgansharax .

title: Narm
description: Narm Narm was a large half - orc fighter and the leader of the Blue Wyvern Company of Ravens Bluff . In 1479 DR , Narm agreed that the Blue Wyverns would help Jack Ravenwild recover a tome of shadow magic from Sarbreen in exchange for 500 gold pieces per member of the company .
description_long: Narm Narm was a large half - orc fighter and the leader of the Blue Wyvern Company of Ravens Bluff . In 1479 DR , Narm agreed that the Blue Wyverns would help Jack Ravenwild recover a tome of shadow magic from Sarbreen in exchange for 500 gold pieces per member of the company .

title: Narm Tamaraith
description: Narm Tamaraith Narm Tamaraith was a young apprentice mage who become the lover and later the husband of the wielder of " spellfire " , Shandril Shessair . History . Narm decided to become a mage after he saw a battle between two wizard s that killed his parents .
description_long: Narm Tamaraith Narm Tamaraith was a young apprentice mage who become the lover and later the husband of the wielder of " spellfire " , Shandril Shessair . History . Narm decided to become a mage after he saw a battle between two wizard s that killed his parents . He became the apprentice of the wizard Marimmar the Magnificent , a good but slow magic teacher . The pair went to the ruined Myth Drannor to acquire magical treasure but Marimmar was quickly killed by the devil s there . Trying to escape , Narm met Shandril , on the run from the Cult of the Dragon . The two helped each other and in the continuous fighting against all the evil organizations that hunted Shandril , Narm and Shandril became more and more close until they fell in love with each other . In their escape , Narm was also briefly tutored in the magical arts by powerful wizards like Elminster Aumar and Khelben Arunsun . In the end , however , after a bloody battle Narm was fatally injured . Shandril thought this was her fault ( although this was not true ) and used her last " spellfire " to heal Narm . She decided to sacrifice herself to stop the hunt and told Narm to fall in love again with another girl .

title: Narmitra Stormserpent
description: Narmitra Stormserpent Narmitra Stormserpent was a noble in Cormyr and a lady of the Stormserpent noble house . Relationships . Narmitra was the mother of Marlin Stormserpent .
description_long: Narmitra Stormserpent Narmitra Stormserpent was a noble in Cormyr and a lady of the Stormserpent noble house . Relationships . Narmitra was the mother of Marlin Stormserpent . History . Around 1479 DR , she refused access to her mansion to King Foril Obarskyr I ' s envoys when they were searching her son on charges of treason .

title: Narnorn
description: Narnorn Narnorn was mysterious thief who ruled Mreyelundar in 1479 DR . Background . Narnorn was a thief of legendary status in Returned Abeir , and its true identity was unknown .
description_long: Narnorn Narnorn was mysterious thief who ruled Mreyelundar in 1479 DR . Background . Narnorn was a thief of legendary status in Returned Abeir , and its true identity was unknown . It was the true power behind the throne of Mreyelundar , although Trusk Rantyne was in charge of day - to - day government of the city . All the gangs in the city also swore fealty to Narnorn .

title: Narnra Shalace
description: Narnra Shalace Narnra Shalace was a rogue who called Waterdeep her home . History . She was the daughter of the song dragon Maerjanthra Shalace and Elminster .
description_long: Narnra Shalace Narnra Shalace was a rogue who called Waterdeep her home . History . She was the daughter of the song dragon Maerjanthra Shalace and Elminster . Her thief name was the Silken Shadow . Narnra was unaware of the fact that her mother was a dragon ( Narnra herself appeared entirely human ) , and thought that she was dead , as her mother staged her own death so that Narnra could come of age without her assistance .

title: Narrak
description: Narrak Narrak was a derro savant cultist of Demogorgon in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Narrak ' s area of expertise was demonology .
description_long: Narrak Narrak was a derro savant cultist of Demogorgon in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Narrak ' s area of expertise was demonology . History . Narrak was a junior member of the Council of Savants and a long - time cultist of Demogorgon . With the Rage of Demons , he gathered a small retinue of followers and started a plot to deliver the city to the demon lord . The first step in his plan was to curse the stone giant s of Clan Clairngorm with Demogorgon ' s madness . He was waiting for a delivery from Droki when an adventuring party escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve ruined his plan and defeated him .

title: Narrow Sea
description: Narrow Sea The Narrow Sea was the main body of water in the old Netherese Empire . The Narrow sea once stretched across nearly the whole northern edge of Netheril . Inhabitants .
description_long: Narrow Sea The Narrow Sea was the main body of water in the old Netherese Empire . The Narrow sea once stretched across nearly the whole northern edge of Netheril . Inhabitants . Human s of Netheril heavily fished the Narrow Sea , as the sea gave the Netherese most of their food . History . In - 3859 DR , the villages of Fenwick , Gers , Gilan , Gustaf , Moran , Nauseef , and Janick on the shore of the Narrow Sea combined for mutual protection , forming the Alliance of Seventon , which later became Netheril . From - 3419 DR to - 3416 DR , the Netherese and the dwarves of Delzoun deliberated for three years and established trade routes across the Narrow Sea . During the Mythallar Age of Netheril , several " mythallar s " were placed in the Narrow sea to warm the waters in order to curb the effects of the freezing ice . In - 339 DR , the " mythallars " of the Narrow Sea ceased to function . The enclave of Lathery fell into the depths of the sea . By the start of Dalereckoning in 1 DR , the Narrow Sea had gone and been replaced by the frozen wasteland of the High Ice .

title: Narth Tezrin
description: Narth Tezrin Narth Tezrin was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narth managed the Lion ' s Share shop together with Alaestra Ulgar .
description_long: Narth Tezrin Narth Tezrin was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narth managed the Lion ' s Share shop together with Alaestra Ulgar . Personality . Narth had an adventurous spirit . He would become a person of renown , no matter the risks . He adored his colleague Alaestra and this stopped him from running away in search of adventures . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Narth was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Nartham
description: Nartham Nartham was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Nartham was a violent and short - tempered fellow , always looking for an excuse to kill .
description_long: Nartham Nartham was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Nartham was a violent and short - tempered fellow , always looking for an excuse to kill . History . In 1491 DR , Nartham , his bulette mount , and four hobgoblin s patrolled the main gate of the temple . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated Nartham and his minions .

title: Nas Trango Shan
description: Nas Trango Shan Nas Trango Shan , or North Guardian Peak , was a mountain in Khazari . Description . Nas Trango Shan was one of two mountains in Khazari , the other being Ahs Trango Shan , that formed the nation ' s eastern border .
description_long: Nas Trango Shan Nas Trango Shan , or North Guardian Peak , was a mountain in Khazari . Description . Nas Trango Shan was one of two mountains in Khazari , the other being Ahs Trango Shan , that formed the nation ' s eastern border . At 15 , 700 ft . ( 4800m ) , Nas Trango Shan was the larger of the two mountains , between which sat the Broken Wall Pass , part of the Silk Road . The slopes were barren and desolate , and offered a good view of the fortress Luntse Dzong on the southern peak .

title: Nasaqh
description: Nasaqh Lord Nasaqh was the lord of the Nasaqh Estates on Mount Sar north of Waterdeep on the Sword Coast North in the 14th century DR . History . Lord Nasaqh was the fourth generation of Nasaqhs to rule the valley encompassed by the Nasaqh Estates .
description_long: Nasaqh Lord Nasaqh was the lord of the Nasaqh Estates on Mount Sar north of Waterdeep on the Sword Coast North in the 14th century DR . History . Lord Nasaqh was the fourth generation of Nasaqhs to rule the valley encompassed by the Nasaqh Estates . The neighboring lands were held by the Agrivar s . The wizard Ostus Agrivar and his paladin son Priam performed many services for Lord Nasaqh , for which he was quite grateful . When King Nasaqh ' s barons — whom Ostus described as " greedy " — revolted against his rule , Priam Agrivar took service with him . The rebellion was finally quelled in the Year of the Dragon , 1352 DR , Priam ' s services were no longer required , and the knight returned to his father ' s house . Following Ostus ' s death in 1352 DR , Nasaqh held the Agrivar lands in trust while Priam adventured in search of his father ' s killer and otherwise fighting evil . Some six years later , Nasaqh likely hoped for Priam to return to the family seat someday . He was still holding the lands for Priam by 1372 DR . Already described as " old " in 1352 DR , Nasaqh was aging by 1372 DR , but had no heir . He was expected to be the last of the Nasaqh lords .

title: Nasaqh Estates
description: Nasaqh Estates The Nasaqh Estates were a plot of land ruled by Lord Nasaqh and his ancestors . They lay between Mount Helimbrar and Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North . History .
description_long: Nasaqh Estates The Nasaqh Estates were a plot of land ruled by Lord Nasaqh and his ancestors . They lay between Mount Helimbrar and Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North . History . By 1372 DR , the Nasaqh Estates had been ruled by four generations of Nasaqhs . The neighboring lands were held by the Agrivar s . When King Nasaqh ' s barons — whom Ostus Agrivar described as " greedy " — revolted against his rule , Priam Agrivar took service with him . The rebellion was finally quelled in the Year of the Dragon , 1352 DR . Following Ostus ' s death in 1352 DR , Nasaqh held the Agrivar lands in trust while Priam adventured in search of his father ' s killer and otherwise fighting evil . Some six years later , Nasaqh likely hoped for Priam to return to the family seat someday . He was still holding the lands for Priam by 1372 DR . Geography . The Nasaqh Estates overlaid a valley between Mount Sar and Mount Helimbrar , primarily belonging to Mount Sar . The Nasaqhs ruled from a fort upon the estate . The neighboring Agrivar estate , held in trust by Lord Nasaqh , was included within the Nasaqh Estates .

title: Nasher Alagondar
description: Nasher Alagondar Lord Nasher Alagondar was the fearless former adventurer and ruler of Neverwinter who held his city firmly in the Lords ' Alliance . Nasher was responsible for laying many plots and magical contingencies against assaults from the city ' s warlike rival , Luskan , even going so far as banning maps of the city being made in order to throw off the spies of Luskan and their potential invasion plans . Description .
description_long: Nasher Alagondar Lord Nasher Alagondar was the fearless former adventurer and ruler of Neverwinter who held his city firmly in the Lords ' Alliance . Nasher was responsible for laying many plots and magical contingencies against assaults from the city ' s warlike rival , Luskan , even going so far as banning maps of the city being made in order to throw off the spies of Luskan and their potential invasion plans . Description . Nasher had a receding hairline . Personality . Brave in the face of his enemies but affable when among his people , Nasher was noted for his steadfast opposition against Luskan and the orcs of the North . He had a great love of music and hearing tales of faraway lands . Possessions . Nasher had collected numerous magic items during his adventuring career and was noted for wearing a " ring of the ram " , a potent " ring of protection " , and a " belt of regeneration " ( which worked much like a " ring of regeneration " ) . He was equipped with some powerful weapons in the form of a " mace of disruption and a frostbrand longsword . Relationships .

title: Nashkel
description: Nashkel Nashkel was a small town on the northern slopes of the Cloud Peaks . Geography . Although formally a part of Amn , Nashkel was separated from the rest of the kingdom by the mountain passes and so was relatively autonomous .
description_long: Nashkel Nashkel was a small town on the northern slopes of the Cloud Peaks . Geography . Although formally a part of Amn , Nashkel was separated from the rest of the kingdom by the mountain passes and so was relatively autonomous . Appendix . Appearances . Nashkel appeared as a small village with a temple to Helm , an inn , store , and a tavern in the " Baldur ' s Gate " game . The village had become important to the whole region because of its proximity to the Nashkel mines where miners were disappearing , which added to the iron crisis . The hero could team up with Minsc and Edwin here . Berrun Ghastkill had a few quests for the adventurer and Volo made an appearance in the Belching Dragon Tavern . This was also where the infamous Noober was encountered .

title: Nasim el Pesarkhal
description: Nasim el Pesarkhal Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and known as the " Dark Caleph " was the younger brother of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal and the leader of el Pesarkhal clan in Memnon . In this position , he directly controlled the black marketeers , and began buying and selling with sources in the Underdark , which boosted earnings for the family by 50 % over only a few years . He also controlled the enforcers and thugs in the city .
description_long: Nasim el Pesarkhal Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and known as the " Dark Caleph " was the younger brother of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal and the leader of el Pesarkhal clan in Memnon . In this position , he directly controlled the black marketeers , and began buying and selling with sources in the Underdark , which boosted earnings for the family by 50 % over only a few years . He also controlled the enforcers and thugs in the city . Nasim was raised by his older brother like a son , and the two of them together were responsible indirectly for the assassinations of more than one hundred people during the syl - pasha ' s rise to power in the late 1360s DR . Nasim ' s half - elven wife , Nureh , was the spymaster of el Pesarkhal family .

title: Nasir al - Nasr
description: Nasir al - Nasr Nasir al - Nasr , the Great Eagle , was the second Grand Caliph of Zakhara and an important historical figure of the Land of Fate . History . After the death of his father , the first Grand Caliph , Nasir was faced with the onslaught of various factions vying for the rule of the new Zakhara .
description_long: Nasir al - Nasr Nasir al - Nasr , the Great Eagle , was the second Grand Caliph of Zakhara and an important historical figure of the Land of Fate . History . After the death of his father , the first Grand Caliph , Nasir was faced with the onslaught of various factions vying for the rule of the new Zakhara . Through skilled wile , diplomacy , and military might , he was able to quell them all and secure the leadership of the entire continent . Nasir also relied heavily upon the wisdom of Fate to guide him through the turbulent times . Were it not for his strong rule and wisdom , the Land of Fate may have splintered into a collection of petty kingdoms instead of remaining strong as a united land .

title: Nasir el - Mamadin
description: Nasir el - Mamadin Nasir el - Mamadin was the mamluk leader of the Diligent Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The mamluk took orders directly from Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir or Preani Qin .
description_long: Nasir el - Mamadin Nasir el - Mamadin was the mamluk leader of the Diligent Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The mamluk took orders directly from Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir or Preani Qin . History . Nasir was originally from a distant land called Anauroch .

title: Naskurl
description: Naskurl The Naskurl family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Naskurls were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Onsil families .
description_long: Naskurl The Naskurl family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Naskurls were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Onsil families .

title: Nasnas
description: Nasnas Nasnas were humanoid creatures created by evil priests or wizards in Zakhara . They were fanatically loyal to their creator and would defend them to the death . Description .
description_long: Nasnas Nasnas were humanoid creatures created by evil priests or wizards in Zakhara . They were fanatically loyal to their creator and would defend them to the death . Description . These creatures were literally half - humanoid , possessing only a single arm and leg and half a face and torso . Their skin had a gray tint and their eyes sparkled with insanity . Nasnas hopped about on their single leg when they moved . Some nasnas had a small wing that did not allow them to fly . Combat . Nasnas used weapons and wore armor . Their single arm was incredibly strong , adding ferocity to their attacks . Their wilds hoots and screams could cause panic in their foes or paralyze them with fear . Iron or magical weapons were needed to harm a nasnas . Habitat / Society . These creatures served as guardians in the strongholds of evil priests or wizards . To create a nasnas a special potion was brewed that included a drop of the creator ’ s blood . The potion was injected into a piece of fruit which was sliced in half . If a woman ate the fruit she would conceive a nasnas and give birth nine months later . The creator would then arrive to claim the nasnas . Ecology .

title: Nasr - uddin
description: Nasr - uddin Nasr - uddin , called the Lame , was a prophet who traveled the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Nasr had a long white beard that fit the physical appearance of a wandering prophet .
description_long: Nasr - uddin Nasr - uddin , called the Lame , was a prophet who traveled the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Nasr had a long white beard that fit the physical appearance of a wandering prophet . He often wore long flowing robes . Personality . Patience and precision was evident in all of Nasr ' s behavior Activities . Nasr appeared to be spreading the teachings of Muhjari along his travels , though in reality he was a follower of Cyric and a paid assassin in the service of a merchant named Faroud . Possessions . Nasr owned an enchanted mace , an enchanted suit of plate mail , a " potion of sweet water " , a " potion of levitation " , and an iron flask that contained an invisible stalker forced to do his bidding .

title: Nastasia
description: Nastasia Nastasia was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in Lake Sember in 1375 DR . History . Nastasia was at the shrine to Eilistraee in Lake Sember when she was attacked by a Nightshadow of Vhaeraun , who killed her and stole her soul .
description_long: Nastasia Nastasia was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in Lake Sember in 1375 DR . History . Nastasia was at the shrine to Eilistraee in Lake Sember when she was attacked by a Nightshadow of Vhaeraun , who killed her and stole her soul . Her fellow priestess took Nastasia ' s body to Qilué Veladorn at the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . Qilue understood that Nastasia ' s soul was missing and asked her goddess for an explanation . Suddenly Nastasia ' s soul came back and Qilue decided to resurrect her in order to interrogate her about this strange phenomenon . Nastasia answered to the best of her capacity , explaining that the Church of Vhaeraun had wanted to use her soul to open a secret gate to Eilistraee ' s astral domain .

title: Natak Hornswallow
description: Natak Hornswallow Natak Hornswallow was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Natak was a rug merchant with few contact outside his hometown of Athkatla , so his invitation to join the Knights was a surprise to many .
description_long: Natak Hornswallow Natak Hornswallow was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Natak was a rug merchant with few contact outside his hometown of Athkatla , so his invitation to join the Knights was a surprise to many . Natak used the Knights ' connections to enlarge his business with the dream to someday establish the mercantile House Hornswallow as one of the premier families of the city . The truth , known to a few , was that Natak was the last illegitimate offspring of lord Piirlon of Zazesspur , who died during the Days of Terror , and Natak had inherited his position in the Knights from him . House Piirlon was the family of Queen Rhinda , making him the illegitimate cousin of king Haedrak Rhindaun III .

title: Natali
description: Natali Natali was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Natali was not sure about her vocation as a monk ; her dreams shifted from being a great warrior , a devoted priest , or a powerful wizard .
description_long: Natali Natali was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Natali was not sure about her vocation as a monk ; her dreams shifted from being a great warrior , a devoted priest , or a powerful wizard . She was very intrigued by adventurers and wanted to learn their fighting skills . Natali tried to act bigger than she was , but feared half - orc s and obvious barbarians . She also found the monastery and its monks a bit stifling . History . Natali was the daughter of a pair of itinerant merchants in Damara until some orc s killed her parents . She was saved by a group of paladin s of Ilmater , who took her to the monastery . Activities . Natali was a novice monk . She assisted Father Hern at the doors at the entrance of the monastery .

title: Natali Dormetsk
description: Natali Dormetsk Natali Dormetsk was a warrior of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Natali was a commander in the contingent led by Madislak Pemsk during the war against the Ice Witch Iyraclea and the white dragon dracolich Zethrindor .
description_long: Natali Dormetsk Natali Dormetsk was a warrior of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Natali was a commander in the contingent led by Madislak Pemsk during the war against the Ice Witch Iyraclea and the white dragon dracolich Zethrindor . He was chosen alongside Stival Chergoba to join Madislak in the duel against Zethrindor .

title: Natan
description: Natan Natan was a Shadar - kai high priest of Tempus in the city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . He was a close friend and advisor to Uwan , Ikemmu ' s leader . Natan regularly received visons that he believed to be from Tempus himself .
description_long: Natan Natan was a Shadar - kai high priest of Tempus in the city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . He was a close friend and advisor to Uwan , Ikemmu ' s leader . Natan regularly received visons that he believed to be from Tempus himself . He was murdered by a Shadar - kai warrior named Vedoran in 1479 DR during a plot to start an uprising in Ikemmu . Relationships . Natan was the witch Ilvani ' s twin brother . Appearance . Although not very old by Shadar - kai standards , Natan had lines on his face and appeared to be much older than he really was .

title: Nath
description: Nath The Nath was a region in northeastern Halruaa . Geography . Located at the junction of the Nathaghal Mountains and Muaraghal Mountains , the Nath was a large basin used by Halruaans to herd livestock .
description_long: Nath The Nath was a region in northeastern Halruaa . Geography . Located at the junction of the Nathaghal Mountains and Muaraghal Mountains , the Nath was a large basin used by Halruaans to herd livestock . The Nath sat roughly 500 ft . ( 152 . 4 m ) above the rest of Halruaa , allowing for slightly cooler temperatures and moderate rainfall . History . Herds of wild rothe and auroch teemed on the plains of the Nath , providing an excellent food source for the country .

title: Nathaghal Mountains
description: Nathaghal Mountains The Nathaghal Mountains , also known as the North Wall , were a range of mountains in South Faerûn that formed the northern edge of Halruaa . Geography . The North Wall surrounded the region of the Nath .
description_long: Nathaghal Mountains The Nathaghal Mountains , also known as the North Wall , were a range of mountains in South Faerûn that formed the northern edge of Halruaa . Geography . The North Wall surrounded the region of the Nath . They ran roughly east to west , from Talath Pass to the Nath Pass , but there was a hilly passage through from the north into Halruaa , named High Aluar , as well as Bandit Pass , which divided the range , and Nath Pass , which led to Dambrath . Fauna . Dangerous species wandered the outside border of these mountains in the area surrounding the Nath . These included Cyclopskin , Manticore s , Roc s , Cockatrice s , and Medusae . Notable Locations . Mount Talath , one of the highest mountains in the range , was the site of a town and the location of the High Temple of Mystra .

title: Nathchan Belemmor
description: Nathchan Belemmor Nathchan Belemmor was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . For a human , Belemmor was a gem - cutter of unequaled talent , so great he worked only on regalia for the nobility and even for royalty . However , he was notorious for his fits of rage .
description_long: Nathchan Belemmor Nathchan Belemmor was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . For a human , Belemmor was a gem - cutter of unequaled talent , so great he worked only on regalia for the nobility and even for royalty . However , he was notorious for his fits of rage . He was one of the most well - known Procampans of his day .

title: Nathgarl
description: Nathgarl Nathgarl was a minor magelord of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Nathgarl was a minor wizard from Unther and an apprentice of Maulygh .
description_long: Nathgarl Nathgarl was a minor magelord of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Nathgarl was a minor wizard from Unther and an apprentice of Maulygh . He was hired with his master by the prince Felodar Aumar in Calimshan to fight the magelords of Athalantar . Quickly however , Maulygh and Nathgarl joined the ranks of the magelords . After a fatal dinner in Hastarl on 229 DR where Maulygh died , the other magelords killed Nathgarl as they didn ' t trust him .

title: Nathlekh
description: Nathlekh Nathlekh ( the City of Cats ) was the capital of the Shou nation of Nathlan . Located at the western edge of the Gulthmere Forest on the shores of the Lake of the Long Arm , Nathlekh was built around a granite plug , atop which The Pride of Nobanion stood , seemingly as an extension of the rock . Originally populated by feline lycanthrope s worshiping Nobanion and Sharess .
description_long: Nathlekh Nathlekh ( the City of Cats ) was the capital of the Shou nation of Nathlan . Located at the western edge of the Gulthmere Forest on the shores of the Lake of the Long Arm , Nathlekh was built around a granite plug , atop which The Pride of Nobanion stood , seemingly as an extension of the rock . Originally populated by feline lycanthrope s worshiping Nobanion and Sharess . It had a significant population of mundane cats ( including lions ) and it ' s mysterious rulers were known as the Cat Lords , all of these factors certainly earned it its moniker . Settled by more and more immigrants from Kara - Tur over the centuries , by 1479 DR , the city had become populated almost entirely by Shou and the small nation of Nathlan had grown up around it . The citizens of Nathlekh were suspicious of outsiders . They forbade anyone not of Shou decent ( especially non - human s ) from taking up residence in the city and restricted visitors to a single , special section of the city . History . In 1386 DR , the Spellplague caused the ground underneath the Shou ward of the city to rise several hundred feet higher up then the rest of the city .

title: Nathong
description: Nathong Nathong was the mysterious capital city of the Yikarian Empire in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Found high in the peaks of the daunting World Pillar Mountains , Nathong was nestled safely near the central core of the Land of the Yak - Men within the Gate of Heaven province .
description_long: Nathong Nathong was the mysterious capital city of the Yikarian Empire in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Found high in the peaks of the daunting World Pillar Mountains , Nathong was nestled safely near the central core of the Land of the Yak - Men within the Gate of Heaven province . Description . As with other cities within the Empire , Nathong appeared to be a single gargantuan building spread atop a plateau high above the clouds . Some said it was large enough to be a mountain itself . Inhabitants . The Emperor of the Lotus Throne , along with his Lotus Court , ruled the Empire from his capital . In addition to a large number of slaves of various races , Nathong sported the highest concentrated population of yikarian s found anywhere on Toril at 7 , 000 inhabitants . A corps of 900 elite Faceless Guard s guarded the only access point to the capital . Activities . Nathong was the political and religious center of the Yikarian Empire . The will of the Faceless God was carried out here through his Lotus Emperor .

title: Nathoud
description: Nathoud Nathoud was a fortified town located in the northern region of the Hordelands bordering Rashemen . Description . Nathoud sat in the hill country at the feet of the southern slopes of the Icerim Mountains .
description_long: Nathoud Nathoud was a fortified town located in the northern region of the Hordelands bordering Rashemen . Description . Nathoud sat in the hill country at the feet of the southern slopes of the Icerim Mountains . Wood was used in the construction of Nathoud since stone - working was little known in the region . The buildings of Nathoud were typically two stories tall and had large overhanging eaves with gently sloping roofs . Elaborate carvings decorated most buildings . Inhabitants . The Myir , a clan of Nar , originally built the town when they came to settle , since they could not compete with the fierce Khassadi horsemen of the region . The Myir of Nathoud were famous for their breeding of the Nathoudi stallion . A yearly horse fair was held in Nathoud . Vendors interested in selling horses during this time needed to apply for a license . Races were held where vendors and horse - breeders could show off their prized animals .

title: Nathoudi stallion
description: Nathoudi stallion Nathoudi stallions were a special breed of horse found in the city of Nathoud where the northern reaches of the Hordelands bordered Rashemen . History . Nathoudi stallions were breed and prized for their endurance and stamina .
description_long: Nathoudi stallion Nathoudi stallions were a special breed of horse found in the city of Nathoud where the northern reaches of the Hordelands bordered Rashemen . History . Nathoudi stallions were breed and prized for their endurance and stamina . They were particularly hardy in cold weather and sure - footed in snow .

title: Nathur Hethkantan
description: Nathur Hethkantan Prince Nathur Hethkantan , also known as the Prince of Bone , was a plaguechanged spellscar red dracolich and the ruler of the Dominion of Bone in Glaur as of 1479 DR , and formerly a human merchant prince of Szant . He was also the granduncle of Queen Imreera Hethkantan of Gontal . Description .
description_long: Nathur Hethkantan Prince Nathur Hethkantan , also known as the Prince of Bone , was a plaguechanged spellscar red dracolich and the ruler of the Dominion of Bone in Glaur as of 1479 DR , and formerly a human merchant prince of Szant . He was also the granduncle of Queen Imreera Hethkantan of Gontal . Description . Nathur ' s body was made of an amalgam of skeletons of hundred former guards and servants , twisted and fused together in the shape of a winged dracolich . Activities . The Prince of Bone was rarely seen by the inhabitants of the other dominions or the rare individuals who explored Glaur , as he was unable to leave the Dominion of Bone because his dracolich form became unstable outside of his dominion . As such , he relied on his undead servants to make known his will outside of the Dominion of Bone . He employed such servants to search for the remains or the lost treasures of the primordial Nehushta . His most trusted servant was an skull lord named Teshaurus . He also enjoyed the occasional visit of the brave ( or foolish ) adventurers who delved so deep in the ruined Glaur , as he seized such opportunities to learn about the events of the outside world .

title: Nathyrra
description: Nathyrra Nathyrra was a former member of the Red Sisters order of drow assassins and is now a devout follower of Eilistraee . She is first met in the bowels of Undermountain , offering assistance in freeing Halaster Blackcloak . She is later available as a henchman in Chapter 2 and is one of the romance options for male characters throughout the expansion .
description_long: Nathyrra Nathyrra was a former member of the Red Sisters order of drow assassins and is now a devout follower of Eilistraee . She is first met in the bowels of Undermountain , offering assistance in freeing Halaster Blackcloak . She is later available as a henchman in Chapter 2 and is one of the romance options for male characters throughout the expansion . Alignment . It should be noted that , although she is technically of lawful evil alignment , she behaves as if she were good - aligned . This indicates that she is only lawful evil for the purposes of game mechanics , as the assassin class is evil - restricted .

title: Natifa
description: Natifa Natifa was a ghost who inhabited the Burning Pool of Natifa in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Appearance . Natifa appeared as an elderly woman .
description_long: Natifa Natifa was a ghost who inhabited the Burning Pool of Natifa in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Appearance . Natifa appeared as an elderly woman . Activities . Natifa inhabited the bottom of the pool , but sometimes she would emerge to perch atop the fountain . Natifa asked any strangers who approached the pool if they would prepare a meal . Those who declined were either asked to leave or had flaming " arafaj " hurled at them , depending on Natifa ' s mood . Those who agreed were asked to name the dish they planned on making . Natifa was intrigued by the more exotic dishes . Any special ingredients needed for the meal were supplied by Natifa , but the strangers were required to use the oven located at the southern end of the pool . Upon completion of the meal , Natifa would sample the dish . Her disapproval earned the stanger a toss into the burning pool . Dishes earning her approval were rewarded with information , typically about travelling in the High Desert . Natifa could also predict the weather with uncanny accuracy and inform strangers of bandit movements .

title: Native Intelligence
description: Native Intelligence Nothing is known of this module as it seems to have never seen play . However , considering the plotlines of previous and future modules that were released , it is likely it has something to do with the book " Legacy of the Green Regent " and discovering that the current Green Regent , Otar , is rumoured to have been seen in Waterdeep .
