title: Natrisse
description: Natrisse Natrisse was a female human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Natrisse was a priestess of Lathander , who worked along Brother Merring , before he went to West Harbor .
description_long: Natrisse Natrisse was a female human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Natrisse was a priestess of Lathander , who worked along Brother Merring , before he went to West Harbor . Gameplay . The Kalach - Cha and the companions could obtain a quest from Natrisse to bring Brother Merring a tithe box . Natrisse would warn them not to open the box , else they ' d feel the wrath of Lathander . If they did , the box was destroyed as well .

title: Natural creature
description: Natural creature Natural creatures are those creatures which occur naturally within the Prime ' s landscape and which are neither from the Feywild like eladrin , the Shadowfell like shadar - kai , the Elemental Chaos like fire giant s , nor the Astral Sea like devil s . This includes such creatures as deer but also larger or more powerful creatures like dire wolves or dinosaur s . Many of Toril ' s humanoid inhabitants are also natural creatures .
description_long: Natural creature Natural creatures are those creatures which occur naturally within the Prime ' s landscape and which are neither from the Feywild like eladrin , the Shadowfell like shadar - kai , the Elemental Chaos like fire giant s , nor the Astral Sea like devil s . This includes such creatures as deer but also larger or more powerful creatures like dire wolves or dinosaur s . Many of Toril ' s humanoid inhabitants are also natural creatures . Oddly , some creatures which do have an extraplanar origin are considered " natural . " These include tiefling s , who are descendants of breeding between humans and fiend s . Similarly , some creatures exist in other planes but are considered " natural " such as githyanki . Exactly what makes a creature " natural " or not seems to depend on bloodlines then rather than actual location , since drow , which originated on Toril , are considered fey rather than natural creatures . Similarly , githyanki , in spite of having originated in the Astral Sea , are the descendants of humans transformed by illithid enslavery and tieflings , in spite of their outsider heritage , are primarily human in blood .

title: Nature domain
description: Nature domain The Nature domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the natural world . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .
description_long: Nature domain The Nature domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the natural world . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Nature elemental
description: Nature elemental A nature elemental was a creature summoned by a special priest spell for a single purpose : to return an area of land or water to its natural state , " i . e . " , before it was touched by any form of humanoid civilization .
description_long: Nature elemental A nature elemental was a creature summoned by a special priest spell for a single purpose : to return an area of land or water to its natural state , " i . e . " , before it was touched by any form of humanoid civilization . When summoned , they began converting the area designated by the caster and continued for 24 hours or until a circular area of radius one mile ( 1 . 6 kilometers ) had been cleansed , whichever came first . Fundamentally , a nature elemental was composed of Air , Earth , Fire , Water , and spirit or life . If the caster was of sufficient level , then the spirit portion came from his or her deity , otherwise , the caster ' s spirit was used in the summoning and departed the Prime Material Plane with the nature elemental when the spell concluded , leaving the caster ' s lifeless body behind . This summoned creature did not have free will , nor was it controllable . It performed the job for which it was conjured , relentlessly and without emotion , destroying all vestiges of civilization , including humanoid life , in its path and then dissipated .

title: Naug - adar
description: Naug - adar The Naug - adar , also known as devil dogs , were a sub organization of the Zhentarim composed by minor wizard s in Zhentil Keep that acted as law enforcement agents and patrol troops in the Keep . The individual naug - adar were usually assigned by the Zhent to spying and eavesdroppings missions . They performed also missions in order to advantage the Black Network killing enemies , manipulate people and events or discovered important secrets .
description_long: Naug - adar The Naug - adar , also known as devil dogs , were a sub organization of the Zhentarim composed by minor wizard s in Zhentil Keep that acted as law enforcement agents and patrol troops in the Keep . The individual naug - adar were usually assigned by the Zhent to spying and eavesdroppings missions . They performed also missions in order to advantage the Black Network killing enemies , manipulate people and events or discovered important secrets . Usually they used many time and resource of kill or cause the demise of their superiors . They can be promoted to the true Zhentarim ranks only if the demonstrated some initiative . Usually informations arrived to the naug - adar followed this pattern : good news were always reported to superiors , bad news were systematically buried ; if the news had no apparent utility half of the time they reported , the other half they treasured their self hoping to use to rise the ranks one day . A very large numbers of the naug - adar died during the Fall of Zhentil Keep but the organization survived Some naug - adar fought in Shadowdale in 1375 as members of the Zhentarim Occupation Army

title: Naug - orls
description: Naug - orls The Naug - orls , also known as devil worms or simply the Worms , were Zhentil Keep ' s thieves ' guild in 1368 DR . However the ties between criminal and official interests in Zhentil were so strong that they usually acted more like a scout ' s company than thieves . Feared and shunned by the Zhent s , the Worms secretly frequented all taverns and inns within the city , spying for their master who served the Council of Lords .
description_long: Naug - orls The Naug - orls , also known as devil worms or simply the Worms , were Zhentil Keep ' s thieves ' guild in 1368 DR . However the ties between criminal and official interests in Zhentil were so strong that they usually acted more like a scout ' s company than thieves . Feared and shunned by the Zhent s , the Worms secretly frequented all taverns and inns within the city , spying for their master who served the Council of Lords . The Worms would kidnap , frame , arrest , or commit murder in service to their master . Also the naut - orls had an organization more like a spy network than a thieves ' guild , paying many times in control all inn , taverns and inner and outer gates . The Worms were led by someone called a " Night Fingers " . Shounra Shalassalar was the Night Fingers of the Worms in 1358 DR . All 600 members of the Worms reported to her through a secretive hierarchy . For truth however the Night Fingers reported all the informations they collected to certain lords of the Council and Shounra ' s real master was Manshoon .

title: Nauloene Tharantra
description: Nauloene Tharantra Nauloene Tharantra was a notorious hedonist and businesswoman living in Waterdeep in the latter half of the . Description . Judging by her nickname and her profession , she was probably a redhead who honored Sune , but this is uncertain .
description_long: Nauloene Tharantra Nauloene Tharantra was a notorious hedonist and businesswoman living in Waterdeep in the latter half of the . Description . Judging by her nickname and her profession , she was probably a redhead who honored Sune , but this is uncertain . She lived on Sevenlamps Cut in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . Her last known public appearance was sometime around the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , when she stood on the stage of the Splendid Falcon theater and dancehall ( also in the Castle Ward ) and announced that she was looking to marry again , stating she felt sufficient time had passed since enduring her last husband ' s cruel nature . She wore a sparkling gown made of chains in a crisscross pattern adorned with blue diamond teardrop pendants dangling from various locations . Personality . She was a lady of pleasure , known to be free - loving and free - spending . Activities . For many years , Nauloene was the manager and hostess of the Heartflame festhall on Snail Street in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep until it burned down on the Night of Pirates in Uktar , the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . History .

title: Naupau
description: Naupau Naupau was a small city in Sossal . Description . Located north of the Great Glacier , along the coast of the Yal Tengri , Naupau was the only known trade city of the nation of Sossal .
description_long: Naupau Naupau was a small city in Sossal . Description . Located north of the Great Glacier , along the coast of the Yal Tengri , Naupau was the only known trade city of the nation of Sossal . Naupau had a number of small trading outposts along the Yal Tengri , as well as a decent number of trade ships . All outside visitors to the nation were confined to the walls of the city .

title: Nauzhror Baenre
description: Nauzhror Baenre Nauzhror Baenre was a high - ranking drow abjurer and house wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . He was a master of Sorcere and for a time in 1372 – 1373 DR he served as acting Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Description .
description_long: Nauzhror Baenre Nauzhror Baenre was a high - ranking drow abjurer and house wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . He was a master of Sorcere and for a time in 1372 – 1373 DR he served as acting Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Description . Nauzhror was plump and wore black robes and a perpetual smirk . Nauzhror had a familiar : a plump , hairy spider that resembled its master and sat on his shoulder . History . Nauzhror once " polymorph ed " Andzrel Baenre into a riding lizard , which promptly bit Nauzhror in the buttocks . After that , the relationship between those two high - ranking males of House Baenre was somewhat strained . During the unexplained disappearance of Gromph Baenre ( who had in fact been imprisoned by the Lichdrow Dyrr ) during the Silence of Lolth in 1372 – 1373 DR , Nauzhror served as the acting Archmage of Menzoberranzan . During that time , Nauzhror scried the Battle of the Pillars of Woe and saw the drow Army of the Black Spider losing the battle . Matron Triel Baenre then sent a contingent of House Baenre to allow the Menzoberranyr forces to retreat .

title: Nawab
description: Nawab A Nawab was the title of the leading , or most wealthy , merchant in a city or town within the Shining Lands . Activities . Nawabs served as a mayor of sorts .
description_long: Nawab A Nawab was the title of the leading , or most wealthy , merchant in a city or town within the Shining Lands . Activities . Nawabs served as a mayor of sorts . They were responsible for appointing judges , maintaining a security force , collecting taxes , and performing other various functions of local government .

title: Naxene Drathkala
description: Naxene Drathkala Naxene Drathkala was was an member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Naxene was usually at the Northfurrow ' s End inn .
description_long: Naxene Drathkala Naxene Drathkala was was an member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Naxene was usually at the Northfurrow ' s End inn . She was a member of the Lords ' Alliance and an agent for Open Lord Laeral Silverhand . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR she was the Watchful ' s liaison to Goldenfields . Naxene was at the inn when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Naxene believed that all can be resolved by magic and to be too smart to mistake something . She supported Laeral as a force of order in a chaotic world Behind the scenes . Naxene was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Naxil
description: Naxil Naxil was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Naxil trained as a sorcerer and alchemist under his father before joining the Church of Vhaeraun .
description_long: Naxil Naxil was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Naxil trained as a sorcerer and alchemist under his father before joining the Church of Vhaeraun . In 1379 DR , Naxil had recently converted to Eilistraee . He was patrolling an entry to the Promenade of the Dark Maiden when Leliana Vrinn asked his help in dealing with a strange construct . Following the construct , Naxil and Leliana inadvertently entered a " gate " leading them to a secret portion of Trobriand ' s Graveyard . There , they were attacked by ooze followers of Ghaunadaur and Naxil nearly lost his life . There they met the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann that had just managed to became again material and together they escaped back to the Promenade . Later during the Ghaunadaur ' s followers attack to the Promenade Naxil helped Leliana in the battle with a ghaunadan . The ghaunadan pursued Naxil until he arrived to the Pit where the Ghaunadaur ' s priests were trying to awoke the avatar of their god . Naxil was put inside the Pit together with Jub and Mazrol but he alone managed to escape , reemerging in a Promenade full only of ooze and with the avatar of Ghaunadaur finally awoke .

title: Nay
description: Nay The nay ( NAY ) was a Zakharan wind instrument that resembled a flute . Description . " Nays " were made from dried , shellacked reeds or similar thin flora .
description_long: Nay The nay ( NAY ) was a Zakharan wind instrument that resembled a flute . Description . " Nays " were made from dried , shellacked reeds or similar thin flora . Sounds were created by blowing through the main opening and manipulating holes made down the side of the instrument , creating a beautiful and eerie tone . The wonderful sound created by the " nay " inspired Zakharans to call it " amir al - harab " which translated from Midani into " the prince of the wild wastes . " History . Despite the somewhat eerie sound that conjured thoughts of a haunted desert , the " nay " was used almost exclusively by the urban Al - Hadhar .

title: Nay of the djinn
description: Nay of the djinn The nay of the djinn was a magical musical instrument created by skilled djinn craftsmen to honor the chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " nays of the djinn " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description .
description_long: Nay of the djinn The nay of the djinn was a magical musical instrument created by skilled djinn craftsmen to honor the chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " nays of the djinn " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description . In many ways this instrument was just like any other " nay " . However , it was constructed of gold harvested from a special plant called a golden wand whose reeds were metallic . These plants were only found within the mountainous region of the dangerous Land of the Yak - Men . Many djinn sacrificed their lives in order to obtain this rare material for the " nay " . Powers . Anyone playing the " nay of the djinn " replicated the effects of the " enthrall " spell to anyone who listened so long as they kept playing the instrument . Bard s or " rawunin " could use this power twice per day , but all others could only activate this magic once per day .

title: Nazari
description: Nazari Nazari was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Nazari was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Nazari Nazari was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Nazari was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . She was considered the wisest among them . One day , Shaspur came up with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . Nazari consulted with the other elders , and then convinced Shaspur to flee without them . Nazari was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Nazra Mrays
description: Nazra Mrays Nazra Mrays is a noblewoman , socialite and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Although she appears to be a typical frivolous Waterdavian noble , she is actually an extremely shrewd gatherer of information . Dagult Neverember entrusted the safekeeping of the dragonstaff to Nazra .
description_long: Nazra Mrays Nazra Mrays is a noblewoman , socialite and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Although she appears to be a typical frivolous Waterdavian noble , she is actually an extremely shrewd gatherer of information . Dagult Neverember entrusted the safekeeping of the dragonstaff to Nazra . In 1479 DR the Green dragon Andareunarthex attempted to extort the dragonstaff from Nazra by kidnapping her young son . The dragon ' s plans were foiled by a young wizard named Tennora Hedare and Clytemorrenestrix , a Blue dragon changed by Spellplague into a human woman .

title: Naztharune
description: Naztharune Naztharune were black - furred rakshasa s with black tiger heads . Abilities . Many naztharune had few magical powers but were strong fighter s who specialized in assassination .
description_long: Naztharune Naztharune were black - furred rakshasa s with black tiger heads . Abilities . Many naztharune had few magical powers but were strong fighter s who specialized in assassination . Ecology . Unlike most rakshasas , the naztharune did not wish to rule but rather enjoyed serving as scouts and assassin s .

title: Nchaser
description: Nchaser Nchaser was a powerful mage who is famous for creating glowing globe s and the spell Nchaser ' s glowing orb . He was known for actively exploring the world , seeking out new magic and twice acting as an advisor for a local ruler , the second time being for the High Captains of Luskan . His tutor in the Art was Nulathoe .
description_long: Nchaser Nchaser was a powerful mage who is famous for creating glowing globe s and the spell Nchaser ' s glowing orb . He was known for actively exploring the world , seeking out new magic and twice acting as an advisor for a local ruler , the second time being for the High Captains of Luskan . His tutor in the Art was Nulathoe . He disappeared sometime in the early 14th century DR . The explorer Darnell the Unfearing claimed to have come upon a tower on an island suspended above Abeir - Toril ' s north pole by a 300 foot tall stalagmite of perfectly smooth ice . When he climbed up it , he reported it being surrounded by hundreds of glowing globes which promptly shot at him as he drew closer to the top . The magical beams fired at him disintegrated the otherwise indestructable ice of the island and Darnell reportedly slid back down the ice so fast that he broke both of his legs when he reached the bottom . Apart from his glowing globes and possibly this tower , the only remaining legacy of Nchaser in the realms is a spellbook , given to High Captain Taerl of Luskan before Nchaser ' s disappearance .

title: Nchaser ' s glowing orb
description: Nchaser ' s glowing orb Nchaser ' s glowing orb , also known as Nchaser ' s glowing globe , was a rare spell that created a permanent mobile magical light source . Effect . This spell fills a fist - sized glass sphere with a " continual light " that the caster can mentally control , changing the brightness from nothing to full daylight .
description_long: Nchaser ' s glowing orb Nchaser ' s glowing orb , also known as Nchaser ' s glowing globe , was a rare spell that created a permanent mobile magical light source . Effect . This spell fills a fist - sized glass sphere with a " continual light " that the caster can mentally control , changing the brightness from nothing to full daylight . No concentration was required to maintain this spell , only to modify the brightness , and there was no limit to the number of globes a caster could control , either individually or simultaneously . The caster had to touch the glass sphere in order to cast the spell , but thereafter he or she could mentally control it within a range of 10 yd ( 9 . 1 m ) per experience level of the caster . The globes could be placed , moved , or carried , but were as delicate as the glass from which they were made . If the caster died , the globes continued to function at their last setting . Another caster able to cast 4th level spells could take ownership of a globe just by touching it . Components . Verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell , as well as a globe of blown glass of the highest quality , and a spark . History . Arcane History .

title: Neachal Fountain
description: Neachal Fountain Neachal Fountain was a large gyser located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located along the Old Iron Road , Neachal Fountain served as the edge marker of a thermal basin that lay south of the road .
description_long: Neachal Fountain Neachal Fountain was a large gyser located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located along the Old Iron Road , Neachal Fountain served as the edge marker of a thermal basin that lay south of the road . Caravans avoided this area due to dangers such as hot springs , and mud pits , many of which were hidden by thin layers of dirt that looked like normal ground . The nomads of the area considered the site holy for being a “ nostril of the earth god . ” The waters from this area were used as an ingredient in potions that removed curses , due to the minerals found here .

title: Nearel
description: Nearel King Nearel of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the second king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Nearel was the seventeenth son and 32 child of King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded , the first ruler of the dynasty .
description_long: Nearel King Nearel of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the second king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Nearel was the seventeenth son and 32 child of King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded , the first ruler of the dynasty . Nearel had at least two sons . History . The man who would become King Nearel was born in the Year of the Empty Hourglass , 951 DR . Because the nobles of the land were trying to restore power to the Bormul Dynasty , Nearel was hidden at birth and raised in a fishing village on the Dragon Neck Peninsula . When Nearel was fourteen years of age , his father , the king , came to visit him . On the voyage , assassins tried to kill Mhoaran but failed . When Mhoaran and Nearel were reunited , the young man used a magical horn to summon a pack of sea cat s , who slaughtered the pursuing assassins . After this incident , the " sea lion " was made a part of the royal seal and coat of arms of Tethyr . Nearel took the throne about nine years later in 974 DR , upon his father ' s death . Much of his reign was spent tracking down and executing surviving members of the Bormul dynasty . Nearel himself killed King Teremir ' s oldest son by 981 DR .

title: Neb
description: Neb Neb was a crazy serial killer in Baldur ' s Gate who fled to Athkatla in Amn . History . Neb was an assassin in Baldur ' s Gate until he was caught by the Flaming Fist .
description_long: Neb Neb was a crazy serial killer in Baldur ' s Gate who fled to Athkatla in Amn . History . Neb was an assassin in Baldur ' s Gate until he was caught by the Flaming Fist . In prison , he met Gorion ' s Ward , who at that time was in the same cell . Neb helped Gorion ' s Ward to escape after he solved Neb ' s riddle . After the escape , Neb traveled to Athkatla , where he was involved in the theft of some illithium from the merchant Unger Hilldark . Unger , however , employed Gorion ' s Ward to solve the case and retrieved the illithium . Gameplay . When approached , Gorion ' s Ward could agree to trade Neb ' s life for the illithium . However , if Minsc or Jaheira were present in the party , then they recognized Neb as a child murderer from Baldur ' s Gate and forced a confrontation .

title: Nebuseddar
description: Nebuseddar Nebuseddar was a fighter in Unther and one of the best champions in the service of Gilgeam in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under the orders of his god - king , Nebuseddar went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king .
description_long: Nebuseddar Nebuseddar was a fighter in Unther and one of the best champions in the service of Gilgeam in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under the orders of his god - king , Nebuseddar went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king . He managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists . Powers . Gilgeam powered Nebuseddar with his divine powers .

title: Necklace of fireballs
description: Necklace of fireballs Necklaces of fireballs were magical items that provided the possessor with the ability to throw explosive beads . Description . A " necklaces of fireballs " was created with an illusory effect that made it appear like a series of beads on a string , sometimes tied into a necklace .
description_long: Necklace of fireballs Necklaces of fireballs were magical items that provided the possessor with the ability to throw explosive beads . Description . A " necklaces of fireballs " was created with an illusory effect that made it appear like a series of beads on a string , sometimes tied into a necklace . Whenever handled by the owner , however , the illusion faded , revealing a series of golden spheres hanging from a golden chain . The spheres could be removed easily by the owner , but others found it impossible to do so . A " necklace of fireballs " ' market value depended on how many beads it currently had and on how powerful those beads were . The cheapest kind of bead would usually be valued at 300 gold pieces , while the most expensive and powerful bead would sell for 1 , 500 gold pieces . These necklaces often were constructed with seven common configurations , known as " type I " to " type VII " to those who cataloged magic items . These necklaces gave off a faint aura of evocation magic of moderate intensity . Abilities . When thrown , a bead from a " necklace of fireballs " would explode with the power of the " fireball " spell .

title: Necromancy
description: Necromancy Necromancy is the school of magic whose spells manipulate the power of death , unlife , and the life force . Spells involving the undead make up a large portion of this school , including " animate dead " and " finger of death " . Highly focused on the Negative Energy Plane , most spells from this school drain abilities .
description_long: Necromancy Necromancy is the school of magic whose spells manipulate the power of death , unlife , and the life force . Spells involving the undead make up a large portion of this school , including " animate dead " and " finger of death " . Highly focused on the Negative Energy Plane , most spells from this school drain abilities . This school is the one most associated with lichdom , a process that allows the caster to live ( or rather , exist ) in an undead state indefinitely by securing their essence in a receptacle known as a phylactery . A wizard who specializes in the necromantic school is called a necromancer .

title: Necromantic singularity
description: Necromantic singularity When cast , necromantic singularity created a temporary link between the Prime Material Plane , the Weave , and the Negative Energy Plane . The negative energy passed from the Negative to the Prime was strong enough to slay dozens , if not hundreds , of victims near the point of opening . With the collapse of the Weave , no reports of the spell being cast have been made .
description_long: Necromantic singularity When cast , necromantic singularity created a temporary link between the Prime Material Plane , the Weave , and the Negative Energy Plane . The negative energy passed from the Negative to the Prime was strong enough to slay dozens , if not hundreds , of victims near the point of opening . With the collapse of the Weave , no reports of the spell being cast have been made . A " sphere of annihilation " , destroyed upon casting , was required to cast the spell .

title: Necromantic sphere
description: Necromantic sphere The Necromantic sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and , to a lesser degree , monk s and crusader s . These powerful spells could restore life force , limbs , or even forgotten experiences . Wielded by an evil priest , they were extremely deadly .
description_long: Necromantic sphere The Necromantic sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and , to a lesser degree , monk s and crusader s . These powerful spells could restore life force , limbs , or even forgotten experiences . Wielded by an evil priest , they were extremely deadly . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Necromantic Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Ned Dameron
description: Ned Dameron Ned Dameron is a prolific science fiction and fantasy illustrator whose art fills many 1 and 2 edition Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . He has also illustrated the covers of authors such as . Background and Education .
description_long: Ned Dameron Ned Dameron is a prolific science fiction and fantasy illustrator whose art fills many 1 and 2 edition Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . He has also illustrated the covers of authors such as . Background and Education . Dameron was born Edward Palfrey IV on May 7 , 1943 . He grew up in Louisiana and studied art at the Newcomb School of Art of . Career . Dameron has worked as a freelance artist for TSR , Inc .

title: Needle
description: Needle The Needle was a water tower in Luskan situated on the north side of Setting Sun Street , and was used during weekly flushes of the sewer system . Structure . The tower could also be used as a water supply in case fires broke out in the city .
description_long: Needle The Needle was a water tower in Luskan situated on the north side of Setting Sun Street , and was used during weekly flushes of the sewer system . Structure . The tower could also be used as a water supply in case fires broke out in the city . The Needle was fed from the River Mirar by a series of windmills that pumped water upwards into its tank .

title: Neera
description: Neera Neera was a half - elf wild mage . History . For her unique magical ability , she was chased for months by a team of Red Wizard s guided by Ekandor .
description_long: Neera Neera was a half - elf wild mage . History . For her unique magical ability , she was chased for months by a team of Red Wizard s guided by Ekandor . On the run near Beregost , Neera met and befriended Gorion ' s Ward , who helped her to defeat the pursing wizard s . Eventually , Neera joined the party of Gorion ' s Ward and later they defeated Ekandor . Neera become the apprentice of the famous wild mage Adoy .

title: Neerg
description: Neerg Neerg was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Esmeltaran around 1370 DR . Personality . Neerg was easily frustrated by people who could not understood his instructions or who were condescending to him .
description_long: Neerg Neerg was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Esmeltaran around 1370 DR . Personality . Neerg was easily frustrated by people who could not understood his instructions or who were condescending to him . Abilities . Neerg specialized in divination and counterspell magic . He was famous among the Shadow Thieves for his creation of a long - lasting variant of the " knock " spell . Activities . Neerg worked as a support for burglars and assassins in his city .

title: Neeshka
description: Neeshka Neeshka was a devil - descended tiefling rogue who journeyed with the Kalach - Cha during the hero ' s quest to defeat the King of Shadows . Description . Neeshka , like many tieflings , was vaguely human in appearance , though her fiendish ancestry was also immediately obvious .
description_long: Neeshka Neeshka was a devil - descended tiefling rogue who journeyed with the Kalach - Cha during the hero ' s quest to defeat the King of Shadows . Description . Neeshka , like many tieflings , was vaguely human in appearance , though her fiendish ancestry was also immediately obvious . Reddish - brown speckles marked the sides of her head near her ears and two small horns brushed aside her coppery hair . A long , spiked tail also marked her fiendish heritage , which she often waved about . Like many tieflings , Neeshka was also impulsive , yet another mark of her otherwordly ancestors . Personality . Neeshka has a relatively timid and defensive demeanor , often wary due to the stigma associated with tieflings . She particularly responds favorably to any kindness or support given to her , and often will only show courage if backed by friends such as the Kalach - Cha . Towards males she is interested in , she is particularly territorial at times , and she would have likely shown great animosity and jealousy towards Elanee and Shandra Jerro were the Kalach - Cha male , particularly when they first joined the party .

title: Nefris
description: Nefris Nefris was a female Red Wizard of Thay and the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . She was the one who first drew the Kalach - Cha to Rashemen by manipulating her daughters Lienna and Safiya . However , it was discovered that she was acting under the hidden orders of the Founder and she was a partial reincarnation of her .
description_long: Nefris Nefris was a female Red Wizard of Thay and the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . She was the one who first drew the Kalach - Cha to Rashemen by manipulating her daughters Lienna and Safiya . However , it was discovered that she was acting under the hidden orders of the Founder and she was a partial reincarnation of her . For this , Akachi ' s brother Araman , under Myrkul ' s " geas " , led a coup in the academy and captured the Founder and killed Nefris .

title: Negative Energy plane
description: Negative Energy plane The Negative Energy plane , sometimes called the Plane of Death or the Negative Material plane , was an Inner Plane or Energy Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Negative Energy plane collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . The goddess Shar managed to channel some of this death energy into the Plane of Shadow and create the Shadowfell .
description_long: Negative Energy plane The Negative Energy plane , sometimes called the Plane of Death or the Negative Material plane , was an Inner Plane or Energy Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Negative Energy plane collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . The goddess Shar managed to channel some of this death energy into the Plane of Shadow and create the Shadowfell . Cosmologists believe that negative energy and its opposite positive energy , combined with the four elements , make up the known universe . This plane was extremely hostile to all forms of life and energy . Only the undead could travel with impunity here , and the more powerful undead could harness this death energy to attack the living with devastating effect . Cosmology . According to the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Negative Energy plane could be reached via the Ethereal Plane or an adjacent elemental plane , but " not " by an elemental vortex . ( However , there is speculation that the Void card in the " deck of many things " brought a person here .

title: Negative energy
description: Negative energy Negative energy was a type of energy originating on the Negative Energy Plane . It manifested as a black , crackling surge of power . It was the antithesis of positive energy , being the " lifeforce " of undead creatures , healing them while causing harm to the living .
description_long: Negative energy Negative energy was a type of energy originating on the Negative Energy Plane . It manifested as a black , crackling surge of power . It was the antithesis of positive energy , being the " lifeforce " of undead creatures , healing them while causing harm to the living . Clerics . Cleric s were adept at using the power of negative energy . It was the power of negative energy that evil clerics channeled to awe or command undead , and it was used in the " inflict " series of spells ( " e . g . " , " inflict light wounds " ) to injure living beings and heal undead . Shadow Magic . As many people thought of positive energy as " light " and negative energy as " dark " , it was popularly believed that negative energy was associated with shadow magic , and that they somehow originated from the same source . However , this was to misunderstand the key philosophy of shadow magic : the manipulation of the symbolic ( shadow ) rather than the real ( negative energy ) . Even learned sages and some wielders of shadow magic made this misconception . In fact , they were distinct and separate cosmic sources , though they could be used to accomplish similar effects .

title: Negative plane protection
description: Negative plane protection Negative plane protection was an abjuration spell that gave the recipient one chance to completely avoid the draining effects of a negative energy attack . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient in order to cast this spell .
description_long: Negative plane protection Negative plane protection was an abjuration spell that gave the recipient one chance to completely avoid the draining effects of a negative energy attack . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient in order to cast this spell . The protection lasted for 10 minutes per level of the caster , or until the target was hit by an attack form using negative energy . This spell opened a channel to the Positive Energy plane and thus gave the recipient a chance to overcome the loss of strength or life experience due to the energy draining effects of creatures and spells that channeled negative energy . If successful , the protected creature was only subject to the physical damage of such an attack , and the attacker was blasted with positive energy in return . If unsuccessful , the target suffered double the physical damage as well as any draining effects from the negative energy attack . This spell could not be cast on the Negative Energy plane Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Neheedra Duskryn
description: Neheedra Duskryn Neheedra Duskryn was a medusa ally of Ogremoch ' s Bane in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . As a drow , she was full of greed and vanity , obsessed by spell gems for their power and beauty .
description_long: Neheedra Duskryn Neheedra Duskryn was a medusa ally of Ogremoch ' s Bane in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . As a drow , she was full of greed and vanity , obsessed by spell gems for their power and beauty . She dreamed of one day ruling a drow settlement as queen and hoped Blingdenstone was the perfect location . History . Neheedra was part of a contingent of House Duskryn that remained in Blingdenstone after the drow attack on the city in 1371 DR . She wanted to collect as many spell gem s as possible . Soon Neheedra engaged in dark rituals designed to secure her hold on power , but the magical pacts she made transformed her into a medusa . Enraged by her fate , Neheedra turned her servants to stone and descended into madness . She wandered the ruins , petrifying any creature she encountered , until met the Ogremoch ' s Bane . She somehow made an alliance with it and from then on they worked in concert . During the Rage of Demons , she was killed by a party of adventurers who had been hired by some deep gnome factions after escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Nehushta
description: Nehushta Nehushta was a primordial artificer who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . Description . Nehushta was a massive being made of different metallic alloys who shined star - white when roused to fury .
description_long: Nehushta Nehushta was a primordial artificer who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . Description . Nehushta was a massive being made of different metallic alloys who shined star - white when roused to fury . Over the years , she modified her own body with fantastic assemblages of gears , blades , and other golem - like improvements . History . Genasi from the world of Abeir believed Nehushta was the creator of both Abeiran and Toril ian genasi , having created them in the dawn of time to serve as her slaves . Members of the Burned believed themselves to be direct descendants of the original genasi crafted by the primordial . The ancient artifact known as the Birthing Furnace was a creation of Nehushta as well , lending credence to those claims . Nehushta was also credited as the creator of the dreaded anaxim s . Before the separation of Abeir - Toril , Nehushta erected the fortress of Glaur in the northern lands of Gontal to serve as a central front during the Dawn War . After the primordials were defeated and Ao split Abeir - Toril into the twin worlds , Abeir and Toril , Glaur was transported to the world of Abeir .

title: Neifion
description: Neifion Neifion is an archfey of the Feywild . His title is the " Lord of Bats " . Neifion has been known to enter into a fey pact with warlock s .
description_long: Neifion Neifion is an archfey of the Feywild . His title is the " Lord of Bats " . Neifion has been known to enter into a fey pact with warlock s . History . Neifion walked on Toril during the Days of Thunder . He entered into a Fey Pact with the warlock Japheth Donard , who stole the pact stone and imprisoned Neifion in Darroch Castle . In order to escape , Neifion sought the aid of Behroun Marhana and Malyanna .

title: Nekiset
description: Nekiset Nekiset was the most powerful cleric in service to Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . Born in Sampranasz as a slave , Nekiset became the leader of her slave group as a youth , impressing her masters .
description_long: Nekiset Nekiset was the most powerful cleric in service to Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . Born in Sampranasz as a slave , Nekiset became the leader of her slave group as a youth , impressing her masters . During a trip to Sampranasz , Seti , the current incarnation of Set , noticed Nekiset for her devotion and evil tendencies and freed her , offering a place among the clergy of Set . Soon she rose through the ranks to the very top . In 1357 DR , she planned the assassination of Pharaoh Akonhorus II . Activities . Nekiset was the leader of the Fangs of Set . She had the same plans as Hodkamset , to replace the young pharaoh Horustep III with a rakshasa follower of Set in order to create chaos inside the clergy of Horus - Re , hoping to use this to give the throne to Seti . Personality . Nekiset had started to think that Hodkamset needed to be replaced , both for her to achieve supremacy and for Hodkamset ' s mad tendencies , but she understood the need to wait until after seizing power to act . Relationship . Nekiset and Hodkamset were so close that many thought they were lovers .

title: Nelanther Isles
description: Nelanther Isles The Nelanther Isles were a widely scattered chain of nearly one thousand islands west of Amn and Tethyr in the Trackless Sea . More than half the islands lacked potable water and were an unfit place to live . The hundreds of islands that could support life were fought over by ruthless pirates who tended to prey upon the shipping lines of Amn , Tethyr , Calimshan , the Sword Coast and the Moonshae Isles .
description_long: Nelanther Isles The Nelanther Isles were a widely scattered chain of nearly one thousand islands west of Amn and Tethyr in the Trackless Sea . More than half the islands lacked potable water and were an unfit place to live . The hundreds of islands that could support life were fought over by ruthless pirates who tended to prey upon the shipping lines of Amn , Tethyr , Calimshan , the Sword Coast and the Moonshae Isles . Geography . Among the hundreds of islands , only the largest of the islands were named . Only a handful of these names were known to mainlanders , while the pirate captains knew them like the back of their hands . The bulk of the the Nelanther pirates were never captured due to the multitude of hiding places among the islands . Mainlander maps showed many of the main islands and many of the minor islands , but not the shoals , currents , small exposed or submerged islets , and other hazards among the inner Nelanther . Most of the islands were surrounded by perilous reefs . The known islands among the pirate captains were : The channel between the Nelanther Isles and the Tethyr Peninsula was known as Asavir ' s Channel ( presumably named after the pirate Asavir ) .

title: Neldorild
description: Neldorild Neldorild was a the fourth largest city in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Description . Neldorild was located on the coast on the Alamber Sea .
description_long: Neldorild Neldorild was a the fourth largest city in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Description . Neldorild was located on the coast on the Alamber Sea . Compared to the other major cities of Mulhorand , Neldorild was a new city , with constant construction projects occurring at any given time . Located several miles down the coast , the small port of Rasolind served as a supply station for both the city and the fishing fleet out of Delgora . Inhabitants . Many rich Mulhorandi came to Neldorild to retire and enjoy the rest of their lives . The priesthood of Nephthys ruled the city . Counting slaves , Neldorild had a population of 40 , 000 .

title: Neldryn Hawklyn
description: Neldryn Hawklyn Neldryn Hawklyn was a male wizard who was one the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar but was killed by the magister Dorgon Heamilolothtar . History . Neldryn was the Royal Mage and the leader of the magelord s that ruled the kingdom of Athalantar .
description_long: Neldryn Hawklyn Neldryn Hawklyn was a male wizard who was one the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar but was killed by the magister Dorgon Heamilolothtar . History . Neldryn was the Royal Mage and the leader of the magelord s that ruled the kingdom of Athalantar . One night at a banquet , Neldryn attempted to impress his friends and colleagues by using the lost Netherese Crystal Chain of Blinding . He summoned the Magister , Dorgon Heamilolothtar , but Dorgon demonstrated himself too powerful and easily slew Neldryn and all the evil people at the dinner . This was secretly observed by a young Elminster Aumar , who for the first time was impressed by magic .

title: Nelkin Danniker
description: Nelkin Danniker Nelkin Danniker , better known as the Snail , was a member of the Zhentarim in Daggerford sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nelkin was the primary Zhent contact of the succubus Pencheska .
description_long: Nelkin Danniker Nelkin Danniker , better known as the Snail , was a member of the Zhentarim in Daggerford sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nelkin was the primary Zhent contact of the succubus Pencheska . Usually he spent his time at the River Shining Tavern where he was well protected . He often hired the Seven Snakes group .

title: Nellis Saradexma
description: Nellis Saradexma Nellis Saradexma was an Imaskari human wizard who served as the ambassador of High Imaskar . Description . Nellis was tall and thin , and had gray lines , like those of genasi , adorning his skin in intricate patterns .
description_long: Nellis Saradexma Nellis Saradexma was an Imaskari human wizard who served as the ambassador of High Imaskar . Description . Nellis was tall and thin , and had gray lines , like those of genasi , adorning his skin in intricate patterns . History . In 1479 DR , Nellis served as the ambassador of High Imaskar in Tymanther . When ambassador Perra was banished from Chessenta , she discovered that High Imaskar and Akanûl had began diplomatic relationships . Nellis was summoned by Vanquisher Tarhun to explain this , but the Imaskari was unable to do so . When Tchazzar began to prepare to invade Tymanther , Tarhun sent Nellis , alongside the paladin Medrash , Balasar , Biri , Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon , and the Platinum Cadre , back to High Imaskar in order to procure the military aid of the Imaskari to help them halt the invading Chessentan forces . After Empress Ususi agreed to help the dragonborn , Nellis was tasked with aiding them during the operation to search for and destroy Gestaniius .

title: Nelnfaen Sauntarae
description: Nelnfaen Sauntarae Nelnfaen Sauntarae was the only drow Magister . He hailed from Sshamath and reigned from 1104 DR to 1126 DR . History .
description_long: Nelnfaen Sauntarae Nelnfaen Sauntarae was the only drow Magister . He hailed from Sshamath and reigned from 1104 DR to 1126 DR . History . Nelnfaen was the Master of Alteration in Sshamath and so a member of the Conclave of Sshamath . However , Nelnfaen broke with the Council , becoming a renegade for his wish to spread magic , especially magic not connected to faerzress . Nelnfaen considered the faerzress as an evil weakness that made the drow subservient to the rulers of their cities , usually clerics of Lolth . He wandered the Underdark exploring many areas , especially the Upperdark . In his tenure as Magister , he befriended some priestesses of Eilistraee and even a few human s from Waterdeep . However , in truth , most human wizards of the surface never realized that there was a Magister in the Underdark and thought it was a time without a Magister . His fate was unknown , and one day in 1126 DR , Azuth appeared to Olohmber Starnardyn , offering to him the position of Magister .

title: Nelve Harssad
description: Nelve Harssad Nelve Harssad was an inhabitant of Tsurlagol , a traveler and an author . Nelve was the author of " My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars " , a book detailing their travels on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR .
description_long: Nelve Harssad Nelve Harssad was an inhabitant of Tsurlagol , a traveler and an author . Nelve was the author of " My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars " , a book detailing their travels on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR .

title: Nelvik
description: Nelvik Nelvik was the pseudodragon companion of Severin Silrajin the Red Dragon Wyrmspeaker and the main leader of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . He was always at his master ' s side during all the Tyranny of Dragons Appendix . Appearances .
description_long: Nelvik Nelvik was the pseudodragon companion of Severin Silrajin the Red Dragon Wyrmspeaker and the main leader of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . He was always at his master ' s side during all the Tyranny of Dragons Appendix . Appearances . " The Rise of Tiamat "

title: Nelvine
description: Nelvine Nelvine , also known as pigeon stone , was the Realms name for a variety of called which was found in large quantities in older rock formations . Description . The gem quality version of these ornamental stones had a blue iridescent flash known as " peristerism " .
description_long: Nelvine Nelvine , also known as pigeon stone , was the Realms name for a variety of called which was found in large quantities in older rock formations . Description . The gem quality version of these ornamental stones had a blue iridescent flash known as " peristerism " . Nelvine was soft enough to be easily cut with even crude tools , but it was too fragile for fine detail work . The base stone was usually white , cream , fawn , or brownish pink and was therefore sometimes called a " pigeon stone " . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Nelvine was used as a component in spells that disguised a person or object without changing the target ' s true nature . It was also powdered for the magical ink to inscribe such spells on scrolls .

title: Nelvon deJuan
description: Nelvon deJuan Nelvon deJuan was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Personality . Nelvon truly believed in the righteousness of the Cloaks .
description_long: Nelvon deJuan Nelvon deJuan was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Personality . Nelvon truly believed in the righteousness of the Cloaks . He was also ambitious . He genuinely cared about his younger brother Larch . Nelvon felt that as older brother his responsibility was to protect Larch , even if he did not like his lifestyle . History . Nelvon was a promising member of the Cloak . He led the testing of Maude Kron , who as a potential wizard had to undergo training with the Cloaks . However , the events went bad and Maude was ultimately killed escaping from the city . In 1491 , DR , Maude ' s familiar planned revenge against Nelvon . With the assistance of Proskler , an adept of Talos , they devised a plot to kidnap Larch deJuan , to get back at Nelvon . They acted at a great party held in Astrid Saj ' s villa , but Nelvon hired an adventuring party that happened to be present and they eventually saved Larch .

title: Nemesis ( property )
description: Nemesis ( property ) Nemesis weapons are quite similar to " bane " weapons in that they grant a given weapon a bonus to accuracy and damage . However , unlike " bane " weapons , wherein the bonus is against a particular creature type , " nemesis " weapons function against creatures which have a particular kind of knowledge or ability . Notable nemesis weapons .
description_long: Nemesis ( property ) Nemesis weapons are quite similar to " bane " weapons in that they grant a given weapon a bonus to accuracy and damage . However , unlike " bane " weapons , wherein the bonus is against a particular creature type , " nemesis " weapons function against creatures which have a particular kind of knowledge or ability . Notable nemesis weapons . A good example of a " nemesis " weapon is Deathbreaker , a " + 1 undead bane necromancer nemesis longsword " . It is useful against both undead and necromancers , making it an ideal weapon for the undead hunter .

title: Nemevon
description: Nemevon Nemevon was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Nemevon and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Nemevon Nemevon was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Nemevon and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Personality . Nemevon tried to convince other beings to kill it for its sins .

title: Nentyarch
description: Nentyarch Nentyarch is an archaic title given to the rulers of the ancient empire of Narfell . The first Nentyarch , Thargaun Crell , created Dun - Tharos in the Rawlinswood in - 970 DR and forged the Crown of Narfell before uniting the various Nar realms under his rule . The empire of Narfell lasted 794 years until Narfell and the neighboring empire of Raumathar destroyed each other .
description_long: Nentyarch Nentyarch is an archaic title given to the rulers of the ancient empire of Narfell . The first Nentyarch , Thargaun Crell , created Dun - Tharos in the Rawlinswood in - 970 DR and forged the Crown of Narfell before uniting the various Nar realms under his rule . The empire of Narfell lasted 794 years until Narfell and the neighboring empire of Raumathar destroyed each other . The last true Nentyarch was Rheligaun " the Horned " , but he disappeared after the fall of the empire . In 722 DR , the leader of the druid circle of Leth claimed the title of Nentyarch when he occupied Dun - Tharos in the Rawlinswood and erected a tree - fortress around it . In 1362 DR , when the Rotting Man came to the Rawlinswood , it sparked a war of attrition , ending in 1371 DR when the Nentyarch and his circle had to flee the blighted forest and go south into the Forest of Lethyr . A year after he was forced out of the Rawlinswood , the Rotting man became trapped in Dun - Tharos after he failed to create a divine abomination . The mystical energies used in his attempt brought back many demon s who , to this day , infest what is now called the Dunwood .

title: Neogi
description: Neogi The neogi were a race of spider - like creatures that were usually accompanied by umber hulk s , their large ape / beetle crossover monsters . Description . A neogi appeared to be a small eight - legged creature , no bigger than a small child and they had a head with reflective eyes that sat upon a long eel - like neck .
description_long: Neogi The neogi were a race of spider - like creatures that were usually accompanied by umber hulk s , their large ape / beetle crossover monsters . Description . A neogi appeared to be a small eight - legged creature , no bigger than a small child and they had a head with reflective eyes that sat upon a long eel - like neck . They fight using a psychic ability to cause pain and discomfort , but it seems to be limited to their line of sight . They are intensely cautious , choosing not to fight unless there is a significant prize of gold or other valuables . Ecology . The neogi travel through the Sea of Night using large spider - shaped ships that require magic for propulsion . They also have access to Starry Compass es , or magical devices that , when properly installed , can allow a normal seafaring craft from Toril to lift out of the water and rise into the Sea of Night . Language . The complicated language of the neogi was called K ' azz ' jak ' n . Religion . The neogi had an unusual view of their deities : The did not offer prayers and rarely sacrifice , but demanded favors and boons from them regularly , seeing the deities as servants of the neogi race .

title: Neothelid
description: Neothelid Neothelids were extremely rare creatures in mind flayer society . To create a neothelid , not only must an illithid tadpole not undergo ceremorphosis , but the elder brain of the colony must have died , as the elder brain would normally eat all tadpoles that failed to undergo ceremorphosis . With the elder brain dead , chaos would erupt in the spawning pools , as the society around them collapsed as well .
description_long: Neothelid Neothelids were extremely rare creatures in mind flayer society . To create a neothelid , not only must an illithid tadpole not undergo ceremorphosis , but the elder brain of the colony must have died , as the elder brain would normally eat all tadpoles that failed to undergo ceremorphosis . With the elder brain dead , chaos would erupt in the spawning pools , as the society around them collapsed as well . If one tadpole survived the resulting chaos , it could grow into the form of a gigantic slug - like creature . The process wasn ' t an instant one . A would - be neothelid was feral monster until it ate a sentient creature . Eating such a being gave it self awareness and its psionic powers . One of these creatures took up residence in the old illithid colony of Phanlinksal .

title: Nephthys
description: Nephthys Nephthys ( pronounced " nef " - thiss ) was a vain but caring member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . She was known as Nesharia in Thay , and as Neselthia in the nation of Unther . History .
description_long: Nephthys Nephthys ( pronounced " nef " - thiss ) was a vain but caring member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . She was known as Nesharia in Thay , and as Neselthia in the nation of Unther . History . Nephthys assisted Isis in resurrecting Osiris , who had been murdered by Set . Relationships . Nephthys was the daughter of Geb and Nut . She was the twin sister of Isis and was once married to Seth , who she left after his murder of Osiris . Nephthys had few true allies . Waukeen closely monitored the growth of the church of the Devoted Lady . Nephthys openly opposed Mask and the Red Wizards of Thay . Description . Nephthys typically appeared as a Mulan woman in royal dress . She often wore numerous pieces of gold jewelry as well . Powers . Nephthys could stun enemies with her mere presence , and kill with a simple gaze . She had the ability to raise the undead into her service , and could increase wealth with a touch of her hand . Nephthys ' will was sometimes communicated through creatures , such as golem s , or hoarding animals , such as rat s . The face of Nephthys might appear to forces hostile to her , and a golden mist might appear to ward off grave robbers .

title: Nerath
description: Nerath The world of Nerath was a world on an alternate Material Plane . People . The deva Demascus was originally from this world .
description_long: Nerath The world of Nerath was a world on an alternate Material Plane . People . The deva Demascus was originally from this world . Deities . Deities from this world were summoned in the Dawn War to help the gods of Realmspace to defend the newly born worlds of this Material Plane against the primordial threat . It ' s not known if those gods remained in Realmspace after the war . History . The abyssal plague originated on this world . Appendix . Background . This world is the core setting of 4th - edition " Dungeons & Dragons " , commonly called the " Points of Light " world . It is home to Nentir Vale and a fallen empire called Nerath , after which this world is known . According to Christopher Perkins , the Nentir Vale was originally conceived to be part of the " Forgotten Realms " setting , before being used as the setting for the Nerath world . Shadowfell Keep and the town of Winterhaven are the only places of Nentir Vale that eventually appeared in a " Forgotten Realms " product .

title: Nereid
description: Nereid Nereids were a race of aquatic fey related to the triton s . Like the nymph s who lived in the coves and streams , the dryad s who lived in the trees , and the oread s who dwelt in the mountains , nereids were fey who were bound to the seas and oceans . They physically resembled tritons except that their bodies displaced light , making them nearly transparent and hard to see , especially when they were in the water .
description_long: Nereid Nereids were a race of aquatic fey related to the triton s . Like the nymph s who lived in the coves and streams , the dryad s who lived in the trees , and the oread s who dwelt in the mountains , nereids were fey who were bound to the seas and oceans . They physically resembled tritons except that their bodies displaced light , making them nearly transparent and hard to see , especially when they were in the water . Locations . Evil nereids roamed the streets of the underwater city of Ascale . They also lived in and defended Lake Ashane in Rashemen . Nereids were also rumored to live within the forest of Shilmista , within a pool formed from the headwaters of the River Valashar . History . In 1361 DR , a nereid ensnared Fyodor on Ruathym and almost drowned him . However , Liriel Baenre rescued him by snatching the nereid ' s shawl and enslaving her .

title: Nergal ( archdevil )
description: Nergal ( archdevil ) Nergal was an outcast archdevil exiled by Asmodeus to Avernus . In an attempt to learn the secrets of silver fire , he captured Elminster whilst the wizard was in Avernus and exhausted from sealing a planar rift between Avernus and Shadowdale . Nergal subjected Elminster to horrific suffering , all the while stealing his memories using a mental link , until Nergal ' s body was destroyed by the Simbul ( his life - force seemingly escaped ) .
description_long: Nergal ( archdevil ) Nergal was an outcast archdevil exiled by Asmodeus to Avernus . In an attempt to learn the secrets of silver fire , he captured Elminster whilst the wizard was in Avernus and exhausted from sealing a planar rift between Avernus and Shadowdale . Nergal subjected Elminster to horrific suffering , all the while stealing his memories using a mental link , until Nergal ' s body was destroyed by the Simbul ( his life - force seemingly escaped ) .

title: Nergal ( deity )
description: Nergal ( deity ) Nergal was the Untheric deity of the underworld and the dead . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a dark man holding a black shield .
description_long: Nergal ( deity ) Nergal was the Untheric deity of the underworld and the dead . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a dark man holding a black shield . Description . Nergal manifested as a human , and never appeared in any other form . In battle , he wore a night - black shield as both a weapon and a means of defense . When using the shield , no one could strike Nergal from behind , no spell of less than 8th level could affect him , and all feared the deadly aura that emanated from it . Worshipers . Prior to Unther ' s destruction in the Spellplague , cultists of Nergal stood watch over the god - tomb of their master and searched for holy relics in the hope they might bring back Unther ' s lost glory . Rituals . Nergal ' s worshipers practiced the sacrifice of good ( including lawful good ) creatures on their altars of black basalt . Another form of sacrifice was a " promised sacrifice , " in which Nergal ' s worshipers woul dedicate the proceeds of future actions to their deity ' s church . History . Nergal presumedly came to Toril with the other Untheric deities aboard the " Galley of the Gods " .

title: Neri
description: Neri Queen Neri was a storm giant queen sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Neri was the queen of the storm giants , married to King Hekaton .
description_long: Neri Queen Neri was a storm giant queen sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Neri was the queen of the storm giants , married to King Hekaton . At one point , she went with her youngest child Serissa to the Sword Coast and the Moonshae Isles to meet friendly small folk . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , her brother - in - law , Uthor , found the dead body of Neri . Uthor went to his niece , Serissa , for counsel and the daughter of the queen managed to calm her father ' s rightful rage . For this , Hekaton decided to appoint Serissa as his heir . Personality . Neri was known for her friendliness towards the small folk , a trait she passed to her youngest daughter , Serissa . However , she showed favoritism between her children , brewing envy between her elder daughters , Mirran and Nym .

title: Nerise Gladham
description: Nerise Gladham Nerise Gladham was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Nerise was captured by air cultists , who took her to a jail at the Fane until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and freed her .
description_long: Nerise Gladham Nerise Gladham was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Nerise was captured by air cultists , who took her to a jail at the Fane until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and freed her .

title: Neronvain
description: Neronvain Neronvain was the Green Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon that attacked the Misty Forest during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Neronvain was the elven prince of the Misty Forest , son of the king Melandrach ; he had a terrible relationship with his father for the cautious mood of the king .
description_long: Neronvain Neronvain was the Green Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon that attacked the Misty Forest during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Neronvain was the elven prince of the Misty Forest , son of the king Melandrach ; he had a terrible relationship with his father for the cautious mood of the king . After a very fierce discussion Neronvain was exiled . After he joined the Cult of the Dragon and became the companion of the green dragon Chuth , he rose in rank . Just before the Tyranny of Dragons he was selected as Green Dragon Wyrmspeaker ; he guided a series of raids in the Misty Forest in order to gain treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen . At last he was eventually defeated by a band of adventurers .

title: Nerrol Hamastyl
description: Nerrol Hamastyl High Steward Nerrol Hamastyl was a half - elf ranger and paladin , and was the High Steward of the Royal Council of Aglarond as of 1374 DR . The council ' s duty was to appoint representatives of the cities and provinces of Aglarond , and Hamastyl was representative of the Simbul at the council , except at times when the Simbul appeared herself .
description_long: Nerrol Hamastyl High Steward Nerrol Hamastyl was a half - elf ranger and paladin , and was the High Steward of the Royal Council of Aglarond as of 1374 DR . The council ' s duty was to appoint representatives of the cities and provinces of Aglarond , and Hamastyl was representative of the Simbul at the council , except at times when the Simbul appeared herself .

title: Nerve dance
description: Nerve dance Nerve dance was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created 1 to 3 red streamers to strike forth from the casters hand .
description_long: Nerve dance Nerve dance was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created 1 to 3 red streamers to strike forth from the casters hand . The streamers could strike at one target or get split between several targets . If hit by a streamer , the target was stuck and experience excruciating pain as long as the streamer was attached . Target stuck by streamers could not cast spells or perform similar actions . The cast needed to maintain concentration on the streamers for them to remain in contact with the target . Breaking the caster ' s concentration ended the spell . Components . This spell required a 6 - inch strand of red spider silk and a glass rod that has a " continual light " spell cast upon it to cast .

title: Nerve swimmer
description: Nerve swimmer Nerve swimmer derived from immature illithid tadpoles and were used as living instruments of torture and interrogation . In the illithid city of Oryndoll , members of the Abysmal Creed were known to experiment with nerve swimmers to spread terror among other creatures . These experiments with illithid tadpoles were considered distasteful even by other illithids .
description_long: Nerve swimmer Nerve swimmer derived from immature illithid tadpoles and were used as living instruments of torture and interrogation .
