Due to the roaming wolves , gnoll s , and orc s in the area , an offer of two dragon s per day was made for anyone defending the project when it began . Its spokesperson was Harammas Malark .

title: New Neverwinter
description: New Neverwinter New Neverwinter was a " movement " based around the rebuilding Neverwinter , but in reality it was a simple propaganda movement by Lord Dagult Neverember to annex the city on behalf of Waterdeep . The movement to create New Neverwinter is being headed by Neverember , whose titles include the Open Lord of Waterdeep , the Lord Protector of Neverwinter , and the heir of Nasher . The propaganda has gone on from 1462 DR to 1480 DR .
description_long: New Neverwinter New Neverwinter was a " movement " based around the rebuilding Neverwinter , but in reality it was a simple propaganda movement by Lord Dagult Neverember to annex the city on behalf of Waterdeep . The movement to create New Neverwinter is being headed by Neverember , whose titles include the Open Lord of Waterdeep , the Lord Protector of Neverwinter , and the heir of Nasher . The propaganda has gone on from 1462 DR to 1480 DR . The backplot of the movement is headed by a war between the nations of Thay and Netheril caused due to the activation of a Dread Ring in Neverwinter Wood . This ' shadow war ' also serves as the basis for the Ashmadai and Waterdeep ' s activities in Neverwinter . Factions . There are many factions involved in the New Neverwinter movement , with Waterdeep being the faction that started the movement , taking advantage of the doings of the Ashmadai , Shadovar and those of Thay . All four factions are the main powers in New Neverwinter , though others such as the Aboleths and Many - Arrows are also involved . Shadovar - Thay War . The Shadovar - Thay War was the conflict that resulted during the New Neverwinter movement .

title: New Sarshel
description: New Sarshel New Sarshel was a busy trade city of Impiltur . After the Spellplague the city captured some of Lyrabar ' s trade . Several members of Impiltur ' s ruling council lived in New Sarshel , which increased the city ' s influence .
description_long: New Sarshel New Sarshel was a busy trade city of Impiltur . After the Spellplague the city captured some of Lyrabar ' s trade . Several members of Impiltur ' s ruling council lived in New Sarshel , which increased the city ' s influence . Prior to the Spellplague the city appeared on maps as Sarshel . There was also a New Sarshel on the eastern shore of the Easting Reach .

title: New Velar
description: New Velar New Velar ( formerly Harrowdale Town or Harrowdale ) was the capital and largest settlement of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Names . The town began as Harrowdale Town ( or simply Harrowdale ) , but , in 1428 DR , the town was renamed New Velar , to mark the formal alliance between the Council of Seven Burghers and Myth Drannor .
description_long: New Velar New Velar ( formerly Harrowdale Town or Harrowdale ) was the capital and largest settlement of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Names . The town began as Harrowdale Town ( or simply Harrowdale ) , but , in 1428 DR , the town was renamed New Velar , to mark the formal alliance between the Council of Seven Burghers and Myth Drannor . Geography . Geographical features . As of 1368 DR , Marco Volo noted that ( then ) Harrowdale Town had kept more old buildings than any other settlement in the Dalelands . Government . The Council of Seven Burghers , the governing council of Harrowdale , was run from the Council Hall in New Velar as of 1368 DR . Defenses . Law enforcement was provided by the town Watch , which , as of 1368 DR , consisted of thirty " constables " , equipped with ring mail , a crossbow , and a short sword . The Watch Barracks in the town also provided a court and a jail , although , in 1368 DR , there were no prisoners . The Watch was led by Ellarian Dawnhorn . Under Ellarian Dawnhorn of the town watch , as of 1368 DR , merchants felt safe in leaving doors open at any time , knowing that sufficient protection would be provided .

title: Newander
description: Newander Newander was a druid who worshipped the deity Silvanus . Description . Newander had sandy brown hair and was just under six feet tall .
description_long: Newander Newander was a druid who worshipped the deity Silvanus . Description . Newander had sandy brown hair and was just under six feet tall . Personality . The druid was a shy man who loved nature yet yearned for civilization at the same time . As a druid , he viewed the forest with love and wished to be as powerful as his friends , who had the ability to shape - change into various animals — an ability he had not developed so far . History . At the Edificant Library , Newander joined his friends Danica Maupoissant and Cadderly Bonaduce in battle against the cleric Barjin . Newander and Cadderly were the only ones not affected by Barjin ' s Chaos Curse — potent magic that enhanced one ' s desires even until self - destruction . Newander resisted the curse to a high degree because his desires were contradictory and unclear even to the druid himself . In the final battle with Barjin , the druid finally achieved the ability to shape - change into a great wolverine and spray Barjin with his musk . The musk disintegrated the mage ' s enchanted robes and thus weakened his defensed to a point where Newander ' s friends could overcome the cleric .

title: Newsbearer
description: Newsbearer A newsbearer was a small device made out of glass , used by the inhabitants of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale to communicate across large distances . Description . The glasspiece would be used to reflect sunlight in a series of signaling codes .
description_long: Newsbearer A newsbearer was a small device made out of glass , used by the inhabitants of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale to communicate across large distances . Description . The glasspiece would be used to reflect sunlight in a series of signaling codes . History . Originally crafted in Termalaine , newsbearers were used to relay crucial messages between the towns during the Battle of Icewind Dale in 1356 DR .

title: Newt ( faerie dragon )
description: Newt ( faerie dragon ) Newt was a faerie dragon who lived in Myrloch Vale . History . Newt made the acquaintance of Tristan Kendrick when the prince and his companions were on a mission to rescue Keren Donnell .
description_long: Newt ( faerie dragon ) Newt was a faerie dragon who lived in Myrloch Vale . History . Newt made the acquaintance of Tristan Kendrick when the prince and his companions were on a mission to rescue Keren Donnell . . When they were escaping from the firbolg fortress , he helped them by creating illusion s that distracted the giants . A few days later , Newt found Kamerynn after the unicorn ' s attempt to cleanse a corrupted Moonwell of the Earthmother . It was crippled and blinded but the faerie dragon found out that it could see illusions and thought about a way to help Kamerynn by recreating the surroundings as an illusion so the unicorn could run towards Genna Moonsinger , the Great Druid of Gwynneth . . The two creatures helped her rescue her daughter , Robyn Moonsinger , from Laric , the Bloodrider who had kidnapped her . . Finally , Robyn rode the unicorn while Newt helped it with its illusions so she could help Tristan in the fight against Kazgoroth .

title: Newt Longscar
description: Newt Longscar Newt Longscar was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Newt Longscar mustered and trained a bloodforge army in the Serpent Valley to fight against the advancing commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest . The commander tried to strike first before Newt was fully prepared and established .
description_long: Newt Longscar Newt Longscar was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Newt Longscar mustered and trained a bloodforge army in the Serpent Valley to fight against the advancing commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest . The commander tried to strike first before Newt was fully prepared and established .

title: Nexal
description: Nexal Nexal was once the capital of the greatest empire in Maztica and the center of the cult of Zaltec . It was destroyed in the Night of Wailing and is now a monster infested ruin . Once hundreds of thousands humans lived within Nexal .
description_long: Nexal Nexal was once the capital of the greatest empire in Maztica and the center of the cult of Zaltec . It was destroyed in the Night of Wailing and is now a monster infested ruin . Once hundreds of thousands humans lived within Nexal . After its destruction more than 10 , 000 monsters of the Viperhand called the place their home . They were once humans before they were transformed into orcs , trolls , ogres and some shapechangers , known as jagre s . Many parts of Nexal sunk or were swept away since the city was built upon an artificial island . Other parts were destroyed and laid into rubble . After that some parts were undermined by the monsters and some bigger houses reconstructed with gruesome decorations like skulls , bones and banners of war . The central square survived more or less intact because there never were that many buildings and those built there were mostly stable pyramid - constructions . Even the palace of Naltecona survived partly intact . The pyramid of Zaltec also survived . Hoxitl ruled from its top over the city and the Viperhand .

title: Nexalan
description: Nexalan The Nexalans ( or Nexala ) were the largest ethnicity living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . When most folk in Faerûn used the term " Maztican " , they were most likely referring to Nexalans , as Nexalans were the only people of Maztica who had traveled to the east as of 1372 DR .
description_long: Nexalan The Nexalans ( or Nexala ) were the largest ethnicity living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . When most folk in Faerûn used the term " Maztican " , they were most likely referring to Nexalans , as Nexalans were the only people of Maztica who had traveled to the east as of 1372 DR . The peoples of the four nations of Nexal , Pezelac , Huacli , and Kultaka were all Nexalans . Description . Nexalans were taller than the Payits . They had lean bodies and angular features . The men never had beards . Nexalans , as a rule , were strong and intelligent , but they often lacked wisdom in their decisions . Society . Nexalan culture placed a strong emphasis on aesthetics and did not care as much about substance . A prime example was the Great Pyramid of Nexal with its grandiose mosaics and gaudy colors . Language . The Nexalan people spoke the Nexalan language . Those living in Pezelac spoke a distinct dialect of that tongue , while those living in Huacli and Kultaka spoke their own languages . Religion . Nexalans primarily worshiped the god Zaltec , but deities of the sun ( Tezca ) and rain ( Calor ) were also given devotion , as was Qotal .

title: Nezram
description: Nezram Nezram , known as the World - Walker , was a powerful Mulhorand i wizard who traveled the planes extensively . Activities . Nezram was a wizard with a passion for gemstones and he specialized in planar and transportation magics .
description_long: Nezram Nezram , known as the World - Walker , was a powerful Mulhorand i wizard who traveled the planes extensively . Activities . Nezram was a wizard with a passion for gemstones and he specialized in planar and transportation magics . He maintained a tower on the western shore of Lake Azulduth , where he created several spells and wrote the spell tome known as " Unique Mageries " as well as crafting several unique magic items , such as the " Claw of Nezram " . History . In 643 DR , he began a centuries - long journey in the planes . In the late 14th century , after hearing of the return of Thultanthar and the discovery of Deep Imaskar , he returned home to his tower , which he found ruined ( it had been looted and destroyed in 681 DR by the dragon Chathuuladroth ) . With the help of his mortal descendants , who had become known as the Nezramites , he built a new tower in the town of Nezras . A few years after Nezram went again to explore the planes , this time in search of clues about an ancient serpentfolk race , until he learned about the Spellplague . When Nezram returned to Toril , he found Mulhorand was no more and in its place was a new nation , High Imaskar .

title: Nezram ' s amethyst aura
description: Nezram ' s amethyst aura Nezram ' s amethyst aura was an abjuration spell shielding the subject from poison and disease . It was presumably developed by Nezram . Effect .
description_long: Nezram ' s amethyst aura Nezram ' s amethyst aura was an abjuration spell shielding the subject from poison and disease . It was presumably developed by Nezram . Effect . The subject of " Nezram ' s amethyst aura " was encompassed by a bright violet light that blocked all poisons and diseases from penetrating , whether by a weapon or a creature ' s touch or bite . It did not however cure such things already affecting the target . Components . The spell required a pinch of amethyst dust .

title: Nezram ' s emerald energy shield
description: Nezram ' s emerald energy shield Nezram ' s emerald energy shield was an abjuration spell that caused the target to be covered by an emerald green hued layer of protective energy . Effects . This shield protected against effects causing deafness and sonic type attacks .
description_long: Nezram ' s emerald energy shield Nezram ' s emerald energy shield was an abjuration spell that caused the target to be covered by an emerald green hued layer of protective energy . Effects . This shield protected against effects causing deafness and sonic type attacks . History . This spell was presumably developed by Nezram .

title: Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding
description: Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding was an abjuration spell that had the dubious distinction of having one of the longest names in the school of Abjuration . Effects . It created a floating , square shaped shield of sapphire blue colored force that protected the target from physical and magical attacks .
description_long: Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding was an abjuration spell that had the dubious distinction of having one of the longest names in the school of Abjuration . Effects . It created a floating , square shaped shield of sapphire blue colored force that protected the target from physical and magical attacks . History . This spell was presumably developed by Nezram .

title: Nezrebe
description: Nezrebe Nezrebe , the White Knight , was a mortal servant of Yeenoghu often proclaimed as his " exarch " , though this was in fact a misnomer since exarchs were divine in nature . Nezrebe stood about nine feet tall and was covered in whitish fur that blackened near the armpits and groin . He wielded a powerful bastard sword , " Winnower " as his weapon of choice .
description_long: Nezrebe Nezrebe , the White Knight , was a mortal servant of Yeenoghu often proclaimed as his " exarch " , though this was in fact a misnomer since exarchs were divine in nature . Nezrebe stood about nine feet tall and was covered in whitish fur that blackened near the armpits and groin . He wielded a powerful bastard sword , " Winnower " as his weapon of choice . Though Nezrebe was physically powerful , he was consumed by , which only the will of his master staved off . This caused Nezrebe to be even more fanatically loyal to Yeenoghu .

title: Nezznar
description: Nezznar Nezznar , also known as the " Black Spider " , was a drow who was in search of the Forge of Spells in Wave Echo Cave . The drow promised a share to Iarno Albrek in exchange for his loyalty and aid . Nezznar was the true leader of the Redbrands , controlling them ( as well as the Cragmaw tribe of goblin s and bugbear s ) in the hopes of finding Wave Echo Cave and unlocking its secrets ( while also keeping it a secret for himself ) .
description_long: Nezznar Nezznar , also known as the " Black Spider " , was a drow who was in search of the Forge of Spells in Wave Echo Cave . The drow promised a share to Iarno Albrek in exchange for his loyalty and aid . Nezznar was the true leader of the Redbrands , controlling them ( as well as the Cragmaw tribe of goblin s and bugbear s ) in the hopes of finding Wave Echo Cave and unlocking its secrets ( while also keeping it a secret for himself ) . Nezznar had many spies reaching all the way to Neverwinter .

title: Nhar - del
description: Nhar - del Nhar - del the Black was a necromancer agent of the Zhentarim in the Dalelands . Description . A pale man dressed in black , Nhar - del had blue eyes , a bald head , and a full brown goatee .
description_long: Nhar - del Nhar - del the Black was a necromancer agent of the Zhentarim in the Dalelands . Description . A pale man dressed in black , Nhar - del had blue eyes , a bald head , and a full brown goatee . Personality . Nhar - del took great pleasure in slow and painful murder . Possessions . He wore a cursed " ring of affliction " ( attuned to necromancy ) , and carried a " wand of fear " . History . Nhar - del started out as a street urchin , but eventually became a necromancer in high regard among the Zhentarim . He was tricked into putting on a " ring of affliction " by a neglected lover .

title: Nhyris D ' Hothek
description: Nhyris D ' Hothek Nhyris D ' Hothek was a yuan - ti slaver who possessed the Crown of Horns prior to the Spellplague . History . Nhyris was a slaver living lived in Skullport working under his uncle Zstulkk Ssarmn of the Iron Ring .
description_long: Nhyris D ' Hothek Nhyris D ' Hothek was a yuan - ti slaver who possessed the Crown of Horns prior to the Spellplague . History . Nhyris was a slaver living lived in Skullport working under his uncle Zstulkk Ssarmn of the Iron Ring . At one point he came in possess of the relic the Crown of Horns . During the Spellplague , the crown warped Nyryis ' body and mind into something unrecognizable . As of 1479 DR , he lurked in the lowest part of Skullport where he preyed on the weak .

title: Ni - Ko Oasis
description: Ni - Ko Oasis The Ni - Ko Oasis , also known as Mud Pit Hollow , was traditionally consider the endpoint of the Golden Way and the Spice Road and the boundary between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . Located in the Plain of Horses , the oasis was a boggy forest bordering on a swamp .
description_long: Ni - Ko Oasis The Ni - Ko Oasis , also known as Mud Pit Hollow , was traditionally consider the endpoint of the Golden Way and the Spice Road and the boundary between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . Located in the Plain of Horses , the oasis was a boggy forest bordering on a swamp . The brown water was deep enough graze the bottom of horse bellies . Inhabitants . The bog was inhabited by korobokuru who would occasionally trade or share stories with travelers .

title: Nicomantis
description: Nicomantis Nicomantis was a cleric with strange powers in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Nicomantis had a strange power over all predacious six - legged insects .
description_long: Nicomantis Nicomantis was a cleric with strange powers in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Nicomantis had a strange power over all predacious six - legged insects . He also all - consuming interest in plants of all kinds , alive or dead . Rumors said that Nicomantis spoke with plants and / or the plants advised him about evil nearby , or that he could make them come to life .

title: Nicos Corynian
description: Nicos Corynian Nicos Corynian was an influential chessenta n noble in 1479 DR . He was also a secret servant of the green dragon Skuthosiin . Description .
description_long: Nicos Corynian Nicos Corynian was an influential chessenta n noble in 1479 DR . He was also a secret servant of the green dragon Skuthosiin . Description . Nicos was a middled - aged man with graying brown hair . He was a family man and had a minor talent for magic . History . In 1479 DR Nicos hired the Brotherhood of the Griffon to serve as a police force due to unrest in Luthcheq . When Aoth Fezim won Shala Karanok ' s favor and was tasked to protect Soolabax , Nicos asked him ( on behalf of Skuthosiin ) to loot for Tchazzar .

title: Nigel Findley
description: Nigel Findley Nigel D . Findley was the author of a number of books for roleplaying games . He is known chiefly for his work on the Dungeons & Dragons and Shadowrun roleplaying games .
description_long: Nigel Findley Nigel D . Findley was the author of a number of books for roleplaying games . He is known chiefly for his work on the Dungeons & Dragons and Shadowrun roleplaying games . He died of a heart attack on 19 February 1995 , at the age of 35 .

title: Nigel Thunderstorm
description: Nigel Thunderstorm Nigel Thunderstorm was a dwarf chef of Citadel Adbar in the late 15th century DR . History . Nigel was the personal chef of King Harbromm .
description_long: Nigel Thunderstorm Nigel Thunderstorm was a dwarf chef of Citadel Adbar in the late 15th century DR . History . Nigel was the personal chef of King Harbromm . During the late stages of the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , he was surprised when he discovered that the dwarves ' strategy was to counterattack using the closed tunnels under the dwarven strongholds .

title: Night ' s jambiya
description: Night ' s jambiya Night ' s jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell cloaked a jambiya , or any other form of dagger , in a shroud of impenetrable shadow .
description_long: Night ' s jambiya Night ' s jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell cloaked a jambiya , or any other form of dagger , in a shroud of impenetrable shadow . The weapon was concealed though a darkened area could still be seen . If thrown , the jambiya was nearly impossible to dodge . Once the spell was cast the jambiya needed to be thrown within one minute or the spell would fade away . A wizard could cast this spell on a dagger and then hand it to someone else to throw , but they still needed to throw the weapon before the spell ran out . The jambiya could not be used in melee combat while the spell was active . Components . This spell required any form of dagger to cast .

title: Night Helm
description: Night Helm The Night Helm is a magical helmet supposedly created centuries ago by Elminster himself for the King of Cormyr . The helm protects the wearer from any mind affecting spell and from scrying . The helm was kept in the Kings Tower in Marsember to be used by an Obarskyr on the run .
description_long: Night Helm The Night Helm is a magical helmet supposedly created centuries ago by Elminster himself for the King of Cormyr . The helm protects the wearer from any mind affecting spell and from scrying . The helm was kept in the Kings Tower in Marsember to be used by an Obarskyr on the run . In 1479 DR the helm was stolen by the Death knight Targrael in an effort to shield her from Manshoon ' s scrying .

title: Night Kiss
description: Night Kiss The Night Kiss was the most notorious tavern in Gontal City . Its owner was a spellscar red tiefling named Narla Gulmaern , who had the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence , making the tavern a safe and popular place for important meetings and illegal activities alike .
description_long: Night Kiss The Night Kiss was the most notorious tavern in Gontal City . Its owner was a spellscar red tiefling named Narla Gulmaern , who had the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence , making the tavern a safe and popular place for important meetings and illegal activities alike .

title: Night Knives
description: Night Knives The Night Knives was a small thieves ' guild that operated out of Selgaunt , Sembia . Organization . The guild numbered forty or so members with a mix of thieves , smugglers , fences and a couple wizard s and priests of Mask .
description_long: Night Knives The Night Knives was a small thieves ' guild that operated out of Selgaunt , Sembia . Organization . The guild numbered forty or so members with a mix of thieves , smugglers , fences and a couple wizard s and priests of Mask . The Night Knives were known to be infiltrated by both Zhentarim and Harper agents . History . The guild was destroyed when the Krollir Venasten , the guildmaster and a powerful cleric of Mask , summoned the greater dread Yrsillar in 1371 DR . Drasek Riven , a lieutenant of the guild and a secret member of the Zhentarim disrupted the circle of protection containing the demon , freeing it . It slew Krollir and possessed his body while he converted the Night Knives into lesser shade s and ghoul s .

title: Night Mask deathbringer
description: Night Mask deathbringer The Night Mask Deathbringer is a special prestige class of the Night Masks in Faerûn . The Night Mask Deathbringers serve the leadership of the Night Masks as their most elite assassins and lieutenants , feared by the natives of Westgate , and hungry for power in their own right . The vampiric leadership of the Night Masks created the Deathbringers as unique intermediaries between themselves and those outside of the guild .
description_long: Night Mask deathbringer The Night Mask Deathbringer is a special prestige class of the Night Masks in Faerûn . The Night Mask Deathbringers serve the leadership of the Night Masks as their most elite assassins and lieutenants , feared by the natives of Westgate , and hungry for power in their own right . The vampiric leadership of the Night Masks created the Deathbringers as unique intermediaries between themselves and those outside of the guild . Using the inherent strength in their blood , The Faceless and his Night Masters chose elite members of the Night Masks to become bizarre hybrids , neither fully mortal nor truly undead . These creatures are the Deathbringers and learn to harness their new powers to aid their own quests for power and to increase the might of the Night Masks as a whole .

title: Night Masks ( guild )
description: Night Masks ( guild ) The Night Masks were a criminal organization based in the city of Westgate . They controlled the criminal underworld of the city and performed assassinations , kidnappings , extortion , smuggling , and blackmail . Organization .
description_long: Night Masks ( guild ) The Night Masks were a criminal organization based in the city of Westgate . They controlled the criminal underworld of the city and performed assassinations , kidnappings , extortion , smuggling , and blackmail . Organization . The Night Masks were headed by a council of four vampire s led by Orbakh , who reigned supreme over the entire guild . The guild was structured so that the higher up the leadership chain someone went , the more protection that person had . Orbakh , being supreme ruler was therefore the most protected . The four Night Masters reported directly to him and , in turn , had Counts who reported to one of them . Each count had several lieutenants who lead four - man squads of rank - and - file rogues : thugs , assassin s , tricksters , " etc " . Whatever type of agent was needed for the job delegated to them . These squads were kept ignorant of any other squad so if something happened to one group , others could not be affected . The watchwords for the Guild were " plausible deniability " . The elite of the guild were the Deathbringers who were given some of the vampiric powers of their master in a gruesome ceremony . History .

title: Night Parade
description: Night Parade The Night Parade were a group of Netherese arcanist s who emigrated from the Prime Material Plane to the Demiplane of Nightmares in the Year of Nightmares ( - 681 DR ) . Over time their descendants begin to be born , twisted by the magic of the realm , into nightmarish creatures , the Night Parade that is known today . At an unconfirmed date relatively recently , those of the Night Parade created " gates " back into the Prime Material Plane because their homeplane was becoming overpopulated .
description_long: Night Parade The Night Parade were a group of Netherese arcanist s who emigrated from the Prime Material Plane to the Demiplane of Nightmares in the Year of Nightmares ( - 681 DR ) . Over time their descendants begin to be born , twisted by the magic of the realm , into nightmarish creatures , the Night Parade that is known today . At an unconfirmed date relatively recently , those of the Night Parade created " gates " back into the Prime Material Plane because their homeplane was becoming overpopulated . " Gates " were opened all over Faerûn , but most entered the portal that led to Calimport . These alien creatures began to establish ' nests ' where they could hide their grotesque features from the populace of the cities that they lived in . The Calimport cell and all of its subordinate nests were led by one who called himself Lord Sixx . Another one used his powers of mass hypnosis to create the illusion of a bad storm over the entire city . They selected several newly born babies and through a ritual , turned them into nightmarish creatures as well . This went on unnoticed for at least 35 years until the hypnotic one was killed by Myrmeen Lhal in 1359 DR .

title: Night Trees
description: Night Trees The Night Trees were two small forests located between Moonwood and Cold Wood . Description . These dark and silent forests were shunned by dwarves , elves , humans and orcs , as an ancient evil power lurked in the dark under the foliage .
description_long: Night Trees The Night Trees were two small forests located between Moonwood and Cold Wood . Description . These dark and silent forests were shunned by dwarves , elves , humans and orcs , as an ancient evil power lurked in the dark under the foliage . Many cruel plant monsters infested the woods , such as assassin vine s , dark tree s , shambling mound s , and tendriculos es . The Night Trees were defended by an evil druid known as the Tree Slaker , who often placed insidious traps to catch intruders . When the Tree Slaker captured someone , he usually bound the victim to a nearby tree and drained the blood out of them to satisfy the dark and thirsty spirit of the forest . By 1372 DR , the Tree Slaker had gathered some acolytes , fellow druids and wicked ranger s eager to sacrifice creatures to please their master . In the northern area of the forest stood a mysterious square tower covered by vines . According to legends , it was an ancient temple dedicated to Chauntea that had been corrupted by the evil presence of the Night Trees . Adventurers who tried to reach the tower found the plant monsters and the Tree Slaker blocking their way .

title: Night ale
description: Night ale Night ale was an ale brewed in Voonlar specifically for the Swords Meet inn " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . This strong ale was very dark in color and thus the name .
description_long: Night ale Night ale was an ale brewed in Voonlar specifically for the Swords Meet inn " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . This strong ale was very dark in color and thus the name . It was available by the tankard for 1 sp each . The cost of a room at the inn included a meal and all the ale one cared to drink . Visitors could also buy a meal and a bottomless tankard of ale for 8 sp .

title: Night hag
description: Night hag Night hags are incredibly evil creatures hailing from the Fiendish Planes . They are known for their mercilessness and ability to walk in the dreams of others . In the fiendish planes they are powerful creatures , being the creators of the process that creates altraloth s , powerful unique yugoloth s , but much more commonly known for being able to harvest soul larvae which are used as currency in the Abyss , Blood Rift and Nine Hells .
description_long: Night hag Night hags are incredibly evil creatures hailing from the Fiendish Planes . They are known for their mercilessness and ability to walk in the dreams of others . In the fiendish planes they are powerful creatures , being the creators of the process that creates altraloth s , powerful unique yugoloth s , but much more commonly known for being able to harvest soul larvae which are used as currency in the Abyss , Blood Rift and Nine Hells . They also have an affinity for nightmare s . Physical description . A night hag stands between five and seven feet tall . She has ugly features , black skin , and burning red eyes . Many night hags have horns of some sort . Their hands end in impossibly long fingers with sharp talons . The body of a night hag appears to be skeletally thin ; however , they possess a great strength fueled by the hatred of all beautiful things . Abilities . A night hag is always neutral evil . A night hag has an array of magical powers , and can transmit a disease called " demon fever " by biting a victim . Night hags are also able to torment chaotic or evil individuals by invading their dreams using a special item called a " heartstone .

title: Night of Crystal & Iron
description: Night of Crystal & Iron The Night of Crystal and Iron was a decisive battle during the Fall of Zhentil Keep . One night , in Alturiak , the forces belonging to the delicate alliance between the white dragon s and frost giant s in Cyric ' s siege army came together in an all - out offensive against the Keep . Amazingly , the tired and starving Zhentilar defenders managed to hold their line against the onslaught .
description_long: Night of Crystal & Iron The Night of Crystal and Iron was a decisive battle during the Fall of Zhentil Keep .
