title: Night of Fourteen Magisters
description: Night of Fourteen Magisters The Night of the Fourteen Magisters was an event involving the position of Magister on Eleasis 4 of 709 DR . It all started with a plot by the archmage Zunroun Iber of Calimport to kill the reigning Magister , Almer Galarthund . With the help of his three assistants ( two of whom died in the process ) , Zunroun clone d himself a dozen times .
description_long: Night of Fourteen Magisters The Night of the Fourteen Magisters was an event involving the position of Magister on Eleasis 4 of 709 DR . It all started with a plot by the archmage Zunroun Iber of Calimport to kill the reigning Magister , Almer Galarthund . With the help of his three assistants ( two of whom died in the process ) , Zunroun clone d himself a dozen times . Whilst secretly scry ing Almer , Zunroun discovered that one of the favorite stops of the Magister for dinner was the Vizier Vanquished inn , in northern Calimshan . When Almer went to the inn , Zunroun unleashed all his clones to attack the Magister . Almer died under the spells , but Zunroun collapsed from the fatigue . All nine surviving clones immediately became Magisters and went mad because of the sudden power . So they started to kill each other , devastating the inn . One of the few surviving inn staff members went to call the inn ' s hired " firestop mage " , the local archmage Belmer of the Six Thunders . Meanwhile , the unconscious Zunroun was killed by his last assistant , Illinge Hardraw . Illinge was still exalting himself for the position he acquired when a spell cast from afar by Belmer killed him .

title: Night of Pirates
description: Night of Pirates The Night of Pirates was an event that took place in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep late in the month of Uktar in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . A pirate - lord hailing from the Nelanther Isles , Elro Starankh , led ninety - six crewmen from three ships into the Heartflame festhall on Snail Street . He proceeded to offer the proprietress , famed madam Nauloene Tharantra , a commission of twenty dragons for each girl who agreed to marry one of the seadogs .
description_long: Night of Pirates The Night of Pirates was an event that took place in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep late in the month of Uktar in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . A pirate - lord hailing from the Nelanther Isles , Elro Starankh , led ninety - six crewmen from three ships into the Heartflame festhall on Snail Street . He proceeded to offer the proprietress , famed madam Nauloene Tharantra , a commission of twenty dragons for each girl who agreed to marry one of the seadogs . Each bride was to receive ten thousand dragons as a dowry in reverse . Only two of the ladies of the evening turned down the offer and a wild celebration with drinking and dancing ensued . At some point in the revels , Starankh set fire to the festhall and it burned beyond the point of salvation . The relatively fancy Arrowsar Apartments were eventually built on the site of the former festhall .

title: Night of Temple Fires
description: Night of Temple Fires The Night of Temple Fires occurred in Waterdeep in 1345 DR . Following a period of unrest between followers of the churches of Lathander , Selûne , Shar and Tempus , one night of violence and looting resulted in the destruction of the Spires of the Morning and the House of Heroes , and the sacking of a subterrenean temple of Shar near Shadows Alley . The Dark Army of the Night tried , but failed to set fire to the House of the Moon .
description_long: Night of Temple Fires The Night of Temple Fires occurred in Waterdeep in 1345 DR . Following a period of unrest between followers of the churches of Lathander , Selûne , Shar and Tempus , one night of violence and looting resulted in the destruction of the Spires of the Morning and the House of Heroes , and the sacking of a subterrenean temple of Shar near Shadows Alley . The Dark Army of the Night tried , but failed to set fire to the House of the Moon .

title: Night of Wailing
description: Night of Wailing The Night of Wailing was the name given to the night during which Nexal was destroyed and many of the inhabitants turned into monsters . Several prophets of Qotal foresaw the events before they occurred and the priestess Erixitl attempted to prevent the calamity . Events were set into motion when Cordell ' s lover and mage Darien killed the Nexalan ruler Naltecona .
description_long: Night of Wailing The Night of Wailing was the name given to the night during which Nexal was destroyed and many of the inhabitants turned into monsters . Several prophets of Qotal foresaw the events before they occurred and the priestess Erixitl attempted to prevent the calamity . Events were set into motion when Cordell ' s lover and mage Darien killed the Nexalan ruler Naltecona . This caused the native Nexalan warriors to attack Cordell ' s native allies . During the ensuing battle , Domincus , Cordell ' s bishop , was captured by Nexalans and sacrificed to Zaltec . The sacrifice of his priest infuriated Helm and he clashed with Zaltec , which resulted in the explosion of Mount Zatal , which overlooked the city . The eruption of Mount Zatal toppled many of the buildings in Nexal , including some of the pyramids , and caused much of the city to sink back into the lakes on which it was built . Lolth took advantage of the chaos and cursed Nexal ' s warriors , turning them into orc s , ogre s , and troll s . As punishment for their lack of faith , she turned the Ancient Ones from drow into drider s . The few Nexalans who survived the disaster fled the city and it was left in ruins .

title: Night of the Hunter
description: Night of the Hunter Night of the Hunter is the first novel in the Companions Codex by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Night of the Hunter Night of the Hunter is the first novel in the Companions Codex by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . In 1484 DR , Doum ' wielle Armgo , a half - moon elf half - drow warrior and the wielder of the magical sword Khazid ' hea , and her father , the dark elf warrior Tos ' un Armgo , were traveling through the Underdark toward the underground drow city of Menzoberranzan when they encountered a band of dark elves of House Xorlarrin . Known for its many skilled wizards , House Xorlarrin was establishing a new drow city named Q ' Xorlarrin in the ancient dwarven homeland of Gauntlgrym with the support of House Baenre , the First House of Menzoberranzan . The Xorlarrin force had been sent east from Gauntlgrym to find the tunnels that would lead to the region known as the Silver Marches . The party was led by Berellip Xorlarrin , the eldest daughter of Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin and a high priestess of Lolth , the Spider Queen , the evil goddess of the dark elves , and her cousin , the wizard Tsabrak Xorlarrin .

title: Nightcloak
description: Nightcloak The nightcloak is a special prestige class for clerics and rangers who worship Shar . Nightcloaks serve Shar in a variety of capacities such as helping her hide knowledge , search for her enemies , and using the Shadow Weave to increase her power . Most nightcloaks possess great charisma and intelligence , a powerful combination to manipulate ignorant nobles and commoners alike to bring about events pleasing to Shar ' s vision of the end of all existence .
description_long: Nightcloak The nightcloak is a special prestige class for clerics and rangers who worship Shar . Nightcloaks serve Shar in a variety of capacities such as helping her hide knowledge , search for her enemies , and using the Shadow Weave to increase her power . Most nightcloaks possess great charisma and intelligence , a powerful combination to manipulate ignorant nobles and commoners alike to bring about events pleasing to Shar ' s vision of the end of all existence .

title: Nighthaunt
description: Nighthaunt A nighthaunt is a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . Thoroughly unnatural and malicious , they take delight in the corruption and suffering of others . As creatures of both death and shadow , they have tremendous powers over darkness .
description_long: Nighthaunt A nighthaunt is a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . Thoroughly unnatural and malicious , they take delight in the corruption and suffering of others . As creatures of both death and shadow , they have tremendous powers over darkness . Physical description . Nighthaunts somewhat resemble gargoyle s ; they have bat wings , talons , curling horns and a whipping serpentine tail . Their body looks as if made of the shadow - stuff of the night itself . They have no face , just a flat triangular space set with a pair of pale eyes blank and round as pearls . Abilities . Nighthaunts are surrounded by aura of " desecration " , can drain levels with a touch , and are powerful spellcasters . However , they become weak in natural daylight . Ecology . Nighthaunts were more common in the ancient days of Imaskar , but are now virtually unknown in Faerûn .

title: Nighthunt
description: Nighthunt The Nighthunt was a quite quiet and rather comfortable inn to the east of Loudwater . Location . The inn was located one ' s day ride east of Loudwater on the south part of the road to Llorkh .
description_long: Nighthunt The Nighthunt was a quite quiet and rather comfortable inn to the east of Loudwater . Location . The inn was located one ' s day ride east of Loudwater on the south part of the road to Llorkh . Structure . The Nighthunt was a quite large wooden lodge of low height embraced by pine and maple trees . A spell was cast to it to prevent fire . Atmosphere . The establishment was a friendly place for adventurers , hunters , and enemies of the Zhentarim . History . Around 1365 DR , it was run by Ildur Arntar , a former ranger .

title: Nightlight
description: Nightlight Nightlight was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It glowed with bioluminescence and was sensitive to being touched by creatures or objects . Description .
description_long: Nightlight Nightlight was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It glowed with bioluminescence and was sensitive to being touched by creatures or objects . Description . Nightlight had tall stalks ranging from five to ten feet ( 1 . 5 – 3 meters ) when mature . The tube - like stems glowed with a bright light out to a distance of fifteen feet ( 4 . 6 m ) and provided dim illumination for another fifteen feet ( 4 . 6 meters ) beyond that . This mushroom was sensitive to touch and would extinguish its glow when first touched by a creature or an object . Touching it again caused the glow to reappear . If the fungi were uprooted , killed , or destroyed , the glow faded away forever after a few seconds .

title: Nightmare ' s Hoof
description: Nightmare ' s Hoof The Nightmare ' s Hoof was a mountain range located in southeastern Returned Abeir , near the Dragon Sea . It separated the city of Sambral from the rest of the Windrise Ports . Geographical features .
description_long: Nightmare ' s Hoof The Nightmare ' s Hoof was a mountain range located in southeastern Returned Abeir , near the Dragon Sea . It separated the city of Sambral from the rest of the Windrise Ports . Geographical features . The Nightmare ' s Hoof was known for its numerous small but active volcanoes , and for the rumors about an extensive clan of fire giant s dwelling within the mountains . The mountains were rich in ore deposits , including gold and high - quality iron . Sambrese dwarves founded many outposts in the mountains to mine those deposits . One of the most infamous mountains of the Nightmare ' s Hoof was Achazar ' s Throne , that was located close to Sambral . There was a heavily patrolled pass through the Nightmare ' s Hoof that connected Sambral overland to Harglast and the other Windrise Ports .

title: Nightmare ( creature )
description: Nightmare ( creature ) A nightmare was a neutral evil outsider from the Lower Planes . They were a type of fiend that existed in the dimensions beyond the natural world . Description .
description_long: Nightmare ( creature ) A nightmare was a neutral evil outsider from the Lower Planes . They were a type of fiend that existed in the dimensions beyond the natural world . Description . Nightmares were evil creatures that appeared to be large black horses with flames wreathing their hooves , flowing forth in the shape of their mane and tail , and trailing from their nostrils and red eyes . If killed , the nightmare ' s flames guttered out , leaving a mane and tail of ash that quickly dispersed . Nightmares did not appear naturally . They were the result of a dark magic ritual applied to pegasi . The ritual involved the removal of a pegasus ' s wings by torture , followed by its transformation and abandonment of its noble qualities in favor of evil . As Mounts . Nightmares were often conjured into the world to serve as steeds for evil priests and wizards . Sometimes they were sent to a mortal as a " reward " for service to a powerful fiendish lord . A nightmare would sometimes serve a powerful evil creature as a mount . It possessed the ability to travel to other planes and a nightmare could bring its rider to one as well . A nightmare extended its resistance to fire to its rider .

title: Nightscale
description: Nightscale Nightscale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Nightscale was similar to leather armor , but it was made from dark snakeskin .
description_long: Nightscale Nightscale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Nightscale was similar to leather armor , but it was made from dark snakeskin . It was treated with numerous alchemical mixtures making it more supple and formfitting . It was often favored by sorcerer s and wizard s . Nightscale was typically made in the Underdark .

title: Nightscar
description: Nightscar Nightscar was an illusion spell that put a mark on a creature or object that only the caster and those chosen by the caster could see . Effects . If this spell was cast upon a person or creature , they had a chance to resist being marked even if they were unaware that they were targeted .
description_long: Nightscar Nightscar was an illusion spell that put a mark on a creature or object that only the caster and those chosen by the caster could see . Effects . If this spell was cast upon a person or creature , they had a chance to resist being marked even if they were unaware that they were targeted . If cast upon an object , or an individual that fails to resist , the target was scarred with a glow that could be seen in the dark . This mark lasted for a few days ; even longer for more experienced wizards . The mark had to be placed on a visible surface or exposed piece of flesh , but could be cast from 30 yd ( 27 . 4 m ) away . The scar remained visible through " polymorph ing " , illusion , or invisibility . Up to seven other beings could be granted the ability to see the " nightscar " , by being in contact with the wizard when the spell was cast . More conveniently , the wizard could hold up to seven small items ( gems , seeds , stones , etc . ) as the spell was cast , and then anyone holding one of those items could see the mark .

title: Nightshade
description: Nightshade Nightshades were large undead creatures from the Plane of Shadow . They were a horrifying mixture of death and darkness , made more frightening by their alien intelligence and spellcasting powers . All nightshades were surrounded by an aura of " desecration " that could draw life from the living .
description_long: Nightshade Nightshades were large undead creatures from the Plane of Shadow . They were a horrifying mixture of death and darkness , made more frightening by their alien intelligence and spellcasting powers . All nightshades were surrounded by an aura of " desecration " that could draw life from the living . Their powers were considerably enhanced in darkness , but they were also greatly weakened by natural sunlight . Nightshades communicated telepathically .

title: Nightshade ( nightclub )
description: Nightshade ( nightclub ) The Nightshade was a nightclub in Scornubel in the late 1360s DR It was dim and usually crowded , and a home to music , passion , and shady dealings . It served as a festhall and gambling house . It lay on top of the crypt of the Wondermen , although the club ' s staff denied its existence or claimed that the secret panel that granted access to the crypt moved regularly .
description_long: Nightshade ( nightclub ) The Nightshade was a nightclub in Scornubel in the late 1360s DR It was dim and usually crowded , and a home to music , passion , and shady dealings . It served as a festhall and gambling house . It lay on top of the crypt of the Wondermen , although the club ' s staff denied its existence or claimed that the secret panel that granted access to the crypt moved regularly .

title: Nightstar ( selukiira )
description: Nightstar ( selukiira ) The Nightstar was the " selu ' kiira " of Saelethil Dlardrageth in which the old secrets of Aryvandaar were recorded . Description . The Nightstar was a dagger - shaped deep purple crystal about 3 in ( 0 .
description_long: Nightstar ( selukiira ) The Nightstar was the " selu ' kiira " of Saelethil Dlardrageth in which the old secrets of Aryvandaar were recorded . Description . The Nightstar was a dagger - shaped deep purple crystal about 3 in ( 0 . 08 m ) in length with pale glyphs . It contained more than seventy spells . History . After the destruction of House Dlardrageth by the Coronal of Arcorar , Ithraides discovered the " selu ' kiira " and concealed it , but created three " telkiira " that would lead to its location . Any wielder of the Nightstar " selu ' kiira " not of House Dlardrageth would be possessed into carrying it to a member of the house . Araevin Teshurr recovered the Nightstar from the vault of Ithraides beneath a white tower in the Elven Court area of the forest of Cormanthor .

title: Nightstone
description: Nightstone Nightsone was a fortified settlement located near the Ardeep Forest , in the hills between Waterdeep and Daggerford . It was connected to the High Road via a side trail . Geography .
description_long: Nightstone Nightsone was a fortified settlement located near the Ardeep Forest , in the hills between Waterdeep and Daggerford . It was connected to the High Road via a side trail . Geography . Nightsone was located a few miles south of the Ardeep Forest . It was built on the Ardeep River and consisted of a fenced island connected to an artificial motte that held the village ' s keep . Its name derived from a mysterious obsidian obelisk in the center of the village that had strange glyph s carved into it and emanated a magic aura . History . Over the years , the villagers of Nightstone had bad relationships with the wood elves who inhabited the Ardeep Forest . Sometime after the War of the Silver Marches , the village was bombarded by a cloud giant floating castle which killed many inhabitants and forced the survivors to escape into nearby caves outside the village .

title: Nightwalker
description: Nightwalker A nightwalker was a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . It was unnatural and malicious , and it took delight in the corruption and suffering of others . It was a creature of both death and shadows , and had enormous powers over darkness .
description_long: Nightwalker A nightwalker was a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . It was unnatural and malicious , and it took delight in the corruption and suffering of others . It was a creature of both death and shadows , and had enormous powers over darkness . Description . A nightwalker ' s body looked as if it was made of shadow - stuff , with a vaguely humanoid form . They were about the size of a house , but were usually no taller than 20 ft . ( 6 . 1 m ) , and their bodies were smooth and hairless . Other . Nightwalkers were the shades of extremely strong - willed and evil mortals whose ancient and unyielding will and malice allowed them to hold their corporeal shape .

title: Nihal
description: Nihal Nihal , sometimes called the Serpent Star , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Nihal didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description .
description_long: Nihal Nihal , sometimes called the Serpent Star , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Nihal didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description . Nihal was a red star , although some stargarzers said that Nihal ' s light was green . Nihal was actually a tear in reality composed of an infinite swarming mass of maggots and worms . History . Nihal , and the other Far Realm - infested stars of Realmspace , were somehow related to the Eldest . Nihal writhed around the position it should hold in the sky , and because of that it was called the Serpent Star . Sometimes Nihal sent its agents to Toril , the Serpents of Nihal , to feed on living things so Nihal could sate its hunger . Some scholars believed Nihal was the brother of another elder evil , Kyuss , or even the same being observed from two different points in time . Nihal was one of the stars the warlock Japheth Donard sought out in 1396 DR , after having lose his pact with the archfey Neifion .

title: Nikitsky
description: Nikitsky Nikitsky lived within the city of Almorel in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Nikitsky served as the Mechnik , or leader , of the governing body of Almorel called the Gospoda .
description_long: Nikitsky Nikitsky lived within the city of Almorel in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Nikitsky served as the Mechnik , or leader , of the governing body of Almorel called the Gospoda . He controlled council meetings and oversaw the well - being of the city .

title: Niko
description: Niko Niko was an woman in Chu ' Yuan province in Shou Lung . History . Niko lived in village of Tangan in Keluh Valley with her mother Shanshu .
description_long: Niko Niko was an woman in Chu ' Yuan province in Shou Lung . History . Niko lived in village of Tangan in Keluh Valley with her mother Shanshu . In 1358 DR she went to hunt with eight male friends . They were however all captured by bakemono followers of the Earth Spider . All her friends were killed but Niko was spared . Niko agreed to become Earth Spider ' s lieutenant in mortal plane , leading the bakemono and goblin spider , but in truth was a ruse in order to gain time to escape . Niko ' s chance arrived when an adventuring party , hired by Emperor to find General Goyat Nagumo , arrived in the area . She helped the adventurers to escape from Earth Spider ' s minions . Eventually with adventurers ' support they all went back to Tangan . Behind The Scenes . Without players ' help Niko will be killed by Earth Spider ' s minions

title: Niko Sevek
description: Niko Sevek Niko Sevek was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Niko was the steward of Zor Aleksi Drejkov .
description_long: Niko Sevek Niko Sevek was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Niko was the steward of Zor Aleksi Drejkov . Secretly , they were part of a cell of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the city . In 1491 DR , however , the high masters of the cult believed that Dreikov had failed and send a cadre of assassins led by Little Wing to eliminate him . Little Wing first killed Sevek .

title: Nikol
description: Nikol Nikol was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Nikol had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Nikol Nikol was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Nikol had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven . Nikol typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Possessions . Nikol bore a sword in battle that was twenty - feet long . It was notched and rusted . History . In 1369 DR , the then - paramount of the storm giants of Mount Woe , Anastes , and five other storm giants were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . Nikol was one of those giants . Nikol and Ramos cooked a moose for Brianna to eat , but during this time , Tavis Burdun and armies of giant - kin attacked . Nikol and Ramos were ordered by Anastes to deal with the verbeeg s . Nikol ' s fate in the ensuing battle was never recorded .

title: Nikolai Nikopolis
description: Nikolai Nikopolis Nikolai Nikopolis was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Nikolai was a repugnant pig .
description_long: Nikolai Nikopolis Nikolai Nikopolis was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Nikolai was a repugnant pig . As a favored student , he felt he could get away with anything , including pestering the low - ranking holy slayer s , guards , and farisan who lived in Sarahin . Decription . Nikolai was a tall man with pale skin . His dirty blond hair contrasted sharply with those of his zakharan neighbors . His eyes were deep blue , appearing violet at times . History . Fascinated by genie s , Nicolai traveled far across Faerûn to Zakhara in order to learn the mystical ways of the sha ' ir . Activities . Nikolai was the lead apprentice of Akim al - Kalass .

title: Nilbog
description: Nilbog Nilbogs were goblin s afflicted with a strange space - time reversal disease known as Nilbogism . The disease appeared to occur when heavy use of magic strained the fabric of the space - time continuum , leading to some very strange localized events . The disease only affected goblins and was not transmitted by them .
description_long: Nilbog Nilbogs were goblin s afflicted with a strange space - time reversal disease known as Nilbogism . The disease appeared to occur when heavy use of magic strained the fabric of the space - time continuum , leading to some very strange localized events . The disease only affected goblins and was not transmitted by them . It was also said that nilbogism was the result of a goblin being possessed by a trickster spirit , which the goblins believed to be a fragment of a trickster deity in the goblin pantheon . This god remained nameless so that Maglubiyet did not find and destroy it as he had done with the other goblin deities . Combat . The nilbog , like all goblins , favored ambushes , dirty tricks , and overwhelming odds to a fair fight . Nilbog adepts favored spells that fooled or confused their enemies . Special Defenses . When struck by any attack that would cause harm , the nilbog would actually heal . A nilbog could only be injured through the use of curative magic . Curative magic harmed a nilbog with the same intensity that the magic would otherwise heal .

title: Nilhogg ' s nose
description: Nilhogg ' s nose Nilhogg ' s nose was a small fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was edible , but provided no nutrition . When consumed , it enhanced the sense of smell for one to four hours , improving the chance of detecting and / or identifying odors .
description_long: Nilhogg ' s nose Nilhogg ' s nose was a small fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was edible , but provided no nutrition . When consumed , it enhanced the sense of smell for one to four hours , improving the chance of detecting and / or identifying odors . However , under the influence of this mushroom , the consumer was also more vulnerable to the effects of smells , such as the nauseating stench of a ghast , for example .

title: Nilraun Dhaerlost
description: Nilraun Dhaerlost Nilraun Dhaerlost was a wizard member of the Zhentarim and an ally of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nilraun was always obsessed with find the Ring of Winter .
description_long: Nilraun Dhaerlost Nilraun Dhaerlost was a wizard member of the Zhentarim and an ally of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nilraun was always obsessed with find the Ring of Winter . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Nilraun was captured in Port Llast by frost giant minions of Jarl Storvald , who also wanted the Ring of Winter . Nilraun offered an alliance with the frost giant jarl , believing this was his best shot at finding the Ring . Secretly , Nilraun plotted to betray Storvald after finding the artifact , not knowing that Storvald also plotted to betray Nilraun . Using his magic , Nilraun identified a blood relative of Artus Cimber , the last known owner of the Ring , living in Bryn Shander . Nilraun usually tried to remain close to the jarl but when Storvald went to hunt the mage he remained in his room in Svarborg .

title: Nilsa
description: Nilsa Nilsa was an astral deva in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . When the Spellplague hit , Nilsa and Garin were commanders of the celestial armies that tried to repel the evil outsiders who arrived in Celestia .
description_long: Nilsa Nilsa was an astral deva in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . When the Spellplague hit , Nilsa and Garin were commanders of the celestial armies that tried to repel the evil outsiders who arrived in Celestia . Appendix . Appearances . Novels . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Nilshai
description: Nilshai Nilshai are sorcerer s native to the Ethereal Plane and are sometimes referred to as ethereal theurges by star elves . These malevolent alien sorcerers spend most of their time on the Ethereal Plane , but they sometimes mount expeditions to the Material Plane to obtain lore and magic . They are servants of the Abolethic Sovereignty and have been invading Sildëyuir , the extraplanar home of the star elves , for several centuries , making portal s to the demiplane that alter the plane ’ s essence , and have recently begun to assault the stars elves ’ citadels .
description_long: Nilshai Nilshai are sorcerer s native to the Ethereal Plane and are sometimes referred to as ethereal theurges by star elves . These malevolent alien sorcerers spend most of their time on the Ethereal Plane , but they sometimes mount expeditions to the Material Plane to obtain lore and magic . They are servants of the Abolethic Sovereignty and have been invading Sildëyuir , the extraplanar home of the star elves , for several centuries , making portal s to the demiplane that alter the plane ’ s essence , and have recently begun to assault the stars elves ’ citadels . When on the Material Plane , a nilshai is always on a mission , whether searching for magical items , engaging in espionage , or looking for slaves to take to its homeland . When residents of the Material Plane interfere , nilshai profligately hurl spells at them in order to kill them as quickly as possible . When faced with spellcaster s , a common tactic of the nilshai is to cast a spell and then immediately cast a counterspell to dispel any magic that might be forthcoming from its foe .

title: Nimbaud
description: Nimbaud Nimbaud was the highest - ranking member of the Zhentarim left in Zhentil Keep during late 1368 DR . History . Nimbaud chose to remain in Zhentil Keep in 1368 DR when Manshoon , sensing Cyric ' s plan , decided to relocated most of the Zhentarim , himself included , to the Citadel of the Raven .
description_long: Nimbaud Nimbaud was the highest - ranking member of the Zhentarim left in Zhentil Keep during late 1368 DR . History . Nimbaud chose to remain in Zhentil Keep in 1368 DR when Manshoon , sensing Cyric ' s plan , decided to relocated most of the Zhentarim , himself included , to the Citadel of the Raven . Nimbaud , hoping to impress the senior wizard , volunteered to remain behind to control the situation and command of a small group of Zhentarim wizards . Thus the Zhentarim could say that they had not abandoned the Keep .

title: Nimbral
description: Nimbral Nimbral was an island nation that was probably the most mysterious land in all of Abeir - Toril . Pegasi - mounted warriors attacked a lot of foreign merchants ( though almost always because they were slavers or pirates ) and large fleets that headed in the supposed direction of the island had a history of being turned away . Nimbral was self - sufficient and only traded with Samarach , Halruaa ( both of these only infrequently though ) and Zakhara , all mysterious and nigh - unknown lands themselves .
description_long: Nimbral Nimbral was an island nation that was probably the most mysterious land in all of Abeir - Toril . Pegasi - mounted warriors attacked a lot of foreign merchants ( though almost always because they were slavers or pirates ) and large fleets that headed in the supposed direction of the island had a history of being turned away . Nimbral was self - sufficient and only traded with Samarach , Halruaa ( both of these only infrequently though ) and Zakhara , all mysterious and nigh - unknown lands themselves . As a result , many wild and varied rumours have been spread by the folk of the mainland who have heard of the place . Expatriates from Halruaa willing to put a premium on the school of illusion , the deceptive inhabitants of the distant island of Nimbral ( called " Nimbrali " ) were all accomplished illusionist s . It seemed their prolonged contact with magic changed their mages into something other than humans . Nimbral illusionists did not have any forbidden school of magic . Nimbral was also known as The Sea Haven .

title: Nimlith
description: Nimlith Nimlith was a small fishing community on the island of Evermeet , consisting of around 200 non - magical wooden structures and inhabited mainly by moon elves ( silver elves ) . Fishing . The fisherfolk of the town caught hake , salmon , and whitefish from the waters west of the island .
description_long: Nimlith Nimlith was a small fishing community on the island of Evermeet , consisting of around 200 non - magical wooden structures and inhabited mainly by moon elves ( silver elves ) . Fishing . The fisherfolk of the town caught hake , salmon , and whitefish from the waters west of the island . Governance . As of 1368 DR , the town was led by Lady Ialantha Rumithamal , a cousin of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . However , as of Alturiak , 1374 DR , the town was governed by Lady Ammisyll Veldann , a member of the Council of Evermeet . Notable features . The town was home to the Holy Ground tavern , and also the mage Kavrala Nightsong .

title: Nimoar
description: Nimoar Nimoar , " the Reaver " , was the leader of a human tribe of barbarians in Northwest Faerûn . The tribe was one of many to attack a small settlement on the Sword Coast North , but this tribe was the one that succeeded , leading to Nimoar ' s tribe taking over the settlement and naming it Nimoar ' s Hold , but this would soon be changed to Waterdeep , the name used by sea captains docking at the harbor . Background .
description_long: Nimoar Nimoar , " the Reaver " , was the leader of a human tribe of barbarians in Northwest Faerûn . The tribe was one of many to attack a small settlement on the Sword Coast North , but this tribe was the one that succeeded , leading to Nimoar ' s tribe taking over the settlement and naming it Nimoar ' s Hold , but this would soon be changed to Waterdeep , the name used by sea captains docking at the harbor . Background . Nimoar was involved in the Orcfastings War , in which the orc s from the Sword Mountains attacked and besieged Nimoar ' s Hold . Nimoar survived the war , but died of old age in 936 DR .

title: Nimor Imphraezl
description: Nimor Imphraezl Nimor Imphraezl was a talented and deadly zekyl assassin of the Jaezred Chaulssin . In the post - Spellplague era , Nimor became the patron of a Jaezred Chaulssin fosterage in Menzoberranzan under the guise of Nagyon Nurindyn , a member of House Nurindyn . Description .
description_long: Nimor Imphraezl Nimor Imphraezl was a talented and deadly zekyl assassin of the Jaezred Chaulssin . In the post - Spellplague era , Nimor became the patron of a Jaezred Chaulssin fosterage in Menzoberranzan under the guise of Nagyon Nurindyn , a member of House Nurindyn . Description . Nimor often appeared as a youthful drow male . He had long silver hair and was short and slender with a narrow , handsome face . He was physically very strong , much stronger than a normal drow . He was a member of the Jaezred Chaulssin , a group of assassins who dreamed of casting down Lolth ' s unholy hierarchy in every drow city in the Underdark and becoming the secret guiding force in rebuilding a new society and then its ruling power . Abilities . Thanks to his draconic heritage , Nimor was much stronger than other drow and had perfected many dark spells of the assassin ' s lethal profession . History . Background . Nimor was not raised in Chaulssin , as it was considered too dangerous for the young . To counteract this danger , the leadership of the Jaezred Chaulssin decided to create fosterages , bases of operation that doubled as places to raise their children .

title: Nimor Ironvice
description: Nimor Ironvice Nimor Ironvice was a member of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus under Fire - Speaker Kholzourl who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym around 1480 DR . He scouted the surface and there Nimor met and befriend Mordai Vell , leader of the Ashmadai . Vell also wanted hellthorn , so Nimor started smuggling the mineral to the ashmadai for a very high price .
description_long: Nimor Ironvice Nimor Ironvice was a member of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus under Fire - Speaker Kholzourl who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym around 1480 DR . He scouted the surface and there Nimor met and befriend Mordai Vell , leader of the Ashmadai . Vell also wanted hellthorn , so Nimor started smuggling the mineral to the ashmadai for a very high price . He was very careful , knowing that Kholzourl would kill him if caught , but he hoped that Asmodeus would send a sign of approbation for his actions .

title: Nimpeth
description: Nimpeth Nimpeth is a city - state on the southern shore of the Vilhon Reach , near to Sespech . Its inhabitants are fiercely proud and paranoid about their trades and produce , and any visitors who question or doubt this are likely to be attacked . Economy .
description_long: Nimpeth Nimpeth is a city - state on the southern shore of the Vilhon Reach , near to Sespech . Its inhabitants are fiercely proud and paranoid about their trades and produce , and any visitors who question or doubt this are likely to be attacked . Economy . The slave city of the Vilhon is known more recently for its fine wine than for its slave trade . The slave trade still exists , though there have been few wars in the area to provide fresh slaves . Architecture . Many of the structures within Nimpeth owe their existence to the slaves of the city . The Citadel of Carifar , the governing palace of Nimpeth , was built by the strong backs of slaves nearly 400 years ago . However , the most notable slave achievement lies outside the city . North of Nimpeth in the rugged Broken Hills lies the Woren Vineyards , an agricultural wonder . The hills have been molded into a sprawling vineyard . Government . Lord Woren is both owner of the Woren Vineyards and lord of Nimpeth . His power rests both in his wealth - brought in from his profitable vineyards - and his slave tradings . He is , unquestionably , the most powerful man in Nimpeth .

title: Nindil Jalbuck
description: Nindil Jalbuck Nindil Jalbuck , a deceased lightfoot halfling and Masked Lord of Waterdeep , was killed and replaced by a doppelganger in 1372 . Nindil was originally from Secomber but went to Waterdeep in search of fortune . Initially Nindil worked as thief but later became a spy and information broker .
description_long: Nindil Jalbuck Nindil Jalbuck , a deceased lightfoot halfling and Masked Lord of Waterdeep , was killed and replaced by a doppelganger in 1372 . Nindil was originally from Secomber but went to Waterdeep in search of fortune . Initially Nindil worked as thief but later became a spy and information broker . However , Nindil changed his life by opening the Garrulous Grocer , and so provided food out of his pocket to the many who were left homeless and destitute by the ravaging devil s of Myrkul in 1358 . Nearly a decade later , Nindil was selected to be a Lord . He spoke for the common folk of Waterdeep . In late 1371 , Nindil was killed and subsumed by Hlaavin , the greater doppelganger who led the Unseen . Mather Ukkhemn of the Knights of the Shield betrayed Nindil ' s identity for a healthy bribe . Hlaavin was content to continue Nindil ' s guise , doing nothing untoward to reveal his deception .

title: Nine Bells
description: Nine Bells The Nine Bells was a huge warehouse built over the hulks of nine sunken ships in the Sargauth river in Skullport . The warehouse functioned as the primary market for the town . A wide variety of goods were available for purchase although availabilities varied day - to - day .
description_long: Nine Bells The Nine Bells was a huge warehouse built over the hulks of nine sunken ships in the Sargauth river in Skullport . The warehouse functioned as the primary market for the town . A wide variety of goods were available for purchase although availabilities varied day - to - day .

title: Nine Golden Swords
description: Nine Golden Swords When Shou immigrants first began traveling west from the lands of Kara - Tur to settle in Thesk and other lands of the west , they brought with them the secret society of yakuza known as the Nine Golden Swords . Their leader was known as the Golden Master , headquartered in the city of Phsant . Marsember .
description_long: Nine Golden Swords When Shou immigrants first began traveling west from the lands of Kara - Tur to settle in Thesk and other lands of the west , they brought with them the secret society of yakuza known as the Nine Golden Swords . Their leader was known as the Golden Master , headquartered in the city of Phsant . Marsember . The Swords had a small organization in the Shou enclave of Xiousing in Marsember . They possessed three of the fabled nine Golden Blade s and hoped to claim Duc - Sum Li ' s blade when he died . Westgate . The Nine Golden Swords ' Westgate guild was employed as agents by the exiled eladrin Caelynna .

title: Nine Hells
description: Nine Hells The Nine Hells , sometimes Hell or Hells , also known as Baator in Infernal , was the home of the devil s . It was a plane of sinister evil and institutional cruelty organized in a strict caste system with a very rigid chain of command . Unlike the demon s of the Abyss , the devils were highly organized in their quest for power and status — scheming and plotting power plays , coups , and assassinations .
description_long: Nine Hells The Nine Hells , sometimes Hell or Hells , also known as Baator in Infernal , was the home of the devil s . It was a plane of sinister evil and institutional cruelty organized in a strict caste system with a very rigid chain of command . Unlike the demon s of the Abyss , the devils were highly organized in their quest for power and status — scheming and plotting power plays , coups , and assassinations . Each of the nine Hells had its own physical laws or properties of matter , but all were inhospitable or deadly to outsiders . This plane ' s place in the cosmology of the Forgotten Realms shifted over time but was always a bastion and incubator for those of the lawful evil persuasion . Cosmology . The Great Wheel cosmology model placed the Nine Hells in the Outer Planes between Gehenna and Acheron , with additional connections to Concordant Opposition and the Astral Plane . Each Hell was a different infinite layer interconnected at " barriers " much like a nine - layered cake — the lowest points of one layer manifested barriers that exited high above the surface of the next lower layer .

title: Nine Swords Company
description: Nine Swords Company The Nine Swords Company was an adventuring company that operated in the early days of the Vast , in the 6th century DR . It consisted entirely of practitioners of the Sublime Way . History .
description_long: Nine Swords Company The Nine Swords Company was an adventuring company that operated in the early days of the Vast , in the 6th century DR . It consisted entirely of practitioners of the Sublime Way . History . The company was formed by Thallastam of Procampur , after he returned from study in Kara - Tur . They adventured through the Vast , performing good deeds and slaying dangerous monsters . When they eventually disbanded , Thallastam concealed his companions ' nine swords in Swords Pool using a spell he ' d cast , to protect and preserve them . His spell at Swords Pool outlived him and his companions , and still preserved their nine swords by 1370 DR . In the mid - 1370s DR , several young blade magic ians of the Vast re - founded the Nine Swords Company , using the Inn of the Nine Swords at Swords Pool . Organization . The first Nine Swords Company consisted of ten blade magic ians : four crusader s ; five warblades ; and Thallastam himself , a swordsage . The nine each wielded a magic sword , while Thallastam preferred to fight unarmed .

title: Nine jewels of Neverwinter
description: Nine jewels of Neverwinter The nine jewels of Neverwinter were enchanted gem s created long ago that gave the bearer many useful powers . Description . Each " jewel " was a unique item made from a different type of gem .
description_long: Nine jewels of Neverwinter The nine jewels of Neverwinter were enchanted gem s created long ago that gave the bearer many useful powers . Description . Each " jewel " was a unique item made from a different type of gem . They were all polished smooth , cabochon style with no facets , and about the size of a human fist . Each was engraved with a command word on one side in very small script . The base gemstones and their colors were : purple amethyst , reddish - brown carnelian , clear and colorless diamond , green emerald , flame red fire opal , white onyx , crimson ruby , blue sapphire , and yellow topaz . Powers . These items had an impressive suite of abilities common to all , and two unique powers . Common Powers . Preservation was a major part of the enchantments placed on the " jewels " . Each stone could " feather fall " whenever necessary , preventing accidental breakage . Anyone wearing or carrying one of the " jewels " on their person was also protected with " feather fall " as needed , with no limit on frequency or duration . Once a day , each " jewel " could " create food and water " if held and ordered to do so .

title: Ning D ' Ahn
description: Ning D ' Ahn Ning D ' Ahn was the seventh High Lama of Tabot in 1357 DR . History . The sixth high lama chose Ning D ' Ahn as his successor when Ning was only eight years old .
description_long: Ning D ' Ahn Ning D ' Ahn was the seventh High Lama of Tabot in 1357 DR . History . The sixth high lama chose Ning D ' Ahn as his successor when Ning was only eight years old . Afterward , according to tradition , the previous Lord of Oceans wandered into the mountains . Ning ' s rule was a difficult one , suffering from the revolt of Baron Phen Do and the independent behavior of the southern monasteries that undermined the government south of the Haraki Ridge . Furthermore , the yig - tsang , the monk council , was divided on most issues , and their delegates to the chief ministers , the tse - khor , were corrupt and untrustworthy . Ning replaced all the Lon Chen with monks he trusted from northern Tabot , which had further alienated the south . In time , there were two attempts on his life , each by a ninja masquerading as a lama . Activities . Ning was always protected by his fanatical and suicidal personal guards , the No - Haree . Twice a year , he appeared to the people while presiding over two outdoor festivals , the Wona Chu ' ing in the dead of winter and the Dui ' yu , the celebration of the harvests .

title: Ninja
description: Ninja Ninjas used deception , " ki " powers , and martial arts to defeat their enemies , gather information , and steal secrets . Though they lacked the outright combat prowess of fighter s and barbarian s , they were adept at bringing foes to battle on their own terms , seeming to appear and disappear at will . In Faerûn , the ninja arts , or ninjutsu , were believed to have originated on the eastern continent of Kara - Tur .
description_long: Ninja Ninjas used deception , " ki " powers , and martial arts to defeat their enemies , gather information , and steal secrets . Though they lacked the outright combat prowess of fighter s and barbarian s , they were adept at bringing foes to battle on their own terms , seeming to appear and disappear at will . In Faerûn , the ninja arts , or ninjutsu , were believed to have originated on the eastern continent of Kara - Tur . In Shou Lung , the term " vagabond " often referred to ninjas . Mostly doing profitable assasinations , ninjas accumulated rather large sums of gold . Sadly , knowing too much , they were often killed by other ninjas . Although armed with a wide assortment of ranged weapons , they were also proficient in using small melee weapons , like dagger s , dirk s , and wakizashi s . If the kill could not be achieved by a ranged weapon , ninjas closed in for a melee attack . Ninjas specialized in one weapon were a rarity . Also , they were masters of survival .

title: Ninth Serôs War
description: Ninth Serôs War The Ninth Serôs War was a conflict fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk , in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Background .
description_long: Ninth Serôs War The Ninth Serôs War was a conflict fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk , in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Background . In the Year of the Deep Wound , 582 DR , Tarag , a chieftain of the sea ogre s , used the powers of the sword " Ilbratha " and his own battle strategies to conquer the western frontiers of the merfolk realm of Hmurrath . There , Tarag founded the two Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . The war . The Axe Kingdoms and Hmurrath fell to fighting in the Year of the Killing Blow , 653 DR , beginning the Ninth Serôs War . The merrow suffered a major defeat in the Battle of the Haunted Plains in the Year of the Coveted Briars , 654 DR . Following their defeat , four - fifths of all merrow in Serôs were forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall . The rest survived on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains . Three years of conflict culminated in the destruction of the Axe Kingdoms and the fall of the merrow to the merfolk of Hmurrath in the Year of the Volanth , 655 DR . This saw the end of merrow " civilization " in Serôs .

title: Niofu Sangto
description: Niofu Sangto Niofu Sangto was a hero of Koryo . Niofu Sangto defeated the Kozakura n navy in the Battle of Wui Eyong in the year Koryo 812 and possessed the " sitting dog " , a magical chalice of uncertain powers , and was the last known have to used it . Niofu Sangto also owned a fortress that stood on the coast somewhere to the east of the city of Tu Pe .
description_long: Niofu Sangto Niofu Sangto was a hero of Koryo . Niofu Sangto defeated the Kozakura n navy in the Battle of Wui Eyong in the year Koryo 812 and possessed the " sitting dog " , a magical chalice of uncertain powers , and was the last known have to used it . Niofu Sangto also owned a fortress that stood on the coast somewhere to the east of the city of Tu Pe . Both the fortress and the " dog " were lost before 1357 DR .

title: Niro Longtooth
description: Niro Longtooth Niro Longtooth was a brigand in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . The oppressive Niro Longtooth extorted the folk of Vanesci Hamlet into giving up their food supplies , else the town would be raided . When the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned , with followers starving for food , the villagers had none to spare .
description_long: Niro Longtooth Niro Longtooth was a brigand in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . The oppressive Niro Longtooth extorted the folk of Vanesci Hamlet into giving up their food supplies , else the town would be raided . The commander surprised Longtooth , confronting the bandits in a bloodforge battle in the streets and fields of the town .

title: Nirva
description: Nirva Nirva was a cloud giant on a quest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the disappearance of King Hekaton , Nirva and sibling Jaral went on a quest in order to place the cloud giant stripe ( and themselves ) at the top of the renewed ordning .
description_long: Nirva Nirva was a cloud giant on a quest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the disappearance of King Hekaton , Nirva and sibling Jaral went on a quest in order to place the cloud giant stripe ( and themselves ) at the top of the renewed ordning . They followed a legend and found pieces of a fallen cloud giant ' s castle in the High Moor . Nirva and Jaral went to Secomber in order to find more about regional history in order to find the exact resting place of the castle .

title: Nirvana
description: Nirvana Nirvana , sometimes called Mechanus , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology representing the alignment of lawful neutral and home of the modron s . Description . This plane was filled with an infinite number of country - sized circular interlocking gears which were habitable on one or both sides .
description_long: Nirvana Nirvana , sometimes called Mechanus , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology representing the alignment of lawful neutral and home of the modron s . Description . This plane was filled with an infinite number of country - sized circular interlocking gears which were habitable on one or both sides . These great flat wheels were at least one thousand miles ( 1 , 600 km ) in diameter and had teeth that meshed at right angles , all turning slowly in synchronicity . Each disk had its own gravity that operated in a sphere circumscribing it exactly and pulling normal to the top and bottom surfaces . The void between the gears was filled with air , allowing easy flight . Outside a gravity sphere , objects would feel only very weak attraction to nearby disks . A plane of Law and order , Nirvana had equal amounts of light and dark , heat and cold , and equal measures of the four elements . There was a place for everything and everything was in its place . Even individuals living here existed to fit into the greater scheme of things and thus achieve a perfect society . There was no pain , but the only pleasure was in successfully filling a role like a gear in a machine .

title: Nishaadhri
description: Nishaadhri Nishaadhri , or the Bound Ones , were mages of Vaasa who swore lifelong fealty to the Warlock Knights . Description . All nishaadhri wore a dark veil over their eyes .
description_long: Nishaadhri Nishaadhri , or the Bound Ones , were mages of Vaasa who swore lifelong fealty to the Warlock Knights . Description . All nishaadhri wore a dark veil over their eyes . Activities . Nishaadhri were not members of a special organization , merely individual magic - users who wished to freely pursue their magical studies unhindered within the borders of Vaasa , which was only possible if they promised to serve the Warlock Knights .

title: Nishan Rhindaun
description: Nishan Rhindaun Prince Nishan Rhindaun was the father of Queen Cyriana III of Tethyr . Relationships . Nishan was a grandson of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through his mother Queen Sybille II .
description_long: Nishan Rhindaun Prince Nishan Rhindaun was the father of Queen Cyriana III of Tethyr . Relationships . Nishan was a grandson of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through his mother Queen Sybille II . His older sister , Zaranda II , was also queen of Tethyr after the death of their mother . Nishan ' s daughter , Cyriana became queen of Tethyr after the death of his sister .

title: Nishrek
description: Nishrek Nishrek was a fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to the discovery of the World Tree , it was Gruumsh ' s realm in Acheron , occupying one face of a gigantic cube ( and then later , the whole cube ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Nishrek was the last known home of the orc pantheon , which tended to wander or be forced out of various previous homes .
description_long: Nishrek Nishrek was a fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to the discovery of the World Tree , it was Gruumsh ' s realm in Acheron , occupying one face of a gigantic cube ( and then later , the whole cube ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Nishrek was the last known home of the orc pantheon , which tended to wander or be forced out of various previous homes . Description . Nishrek was once just the name of Gruumsh ' s realm , stuck to the side of a moon - sized cube floating in the air of Acheron . As new cosmologies were invented to explain what planar travelers discovered , the name followed Gruumsh to new realms and became synonymous with the plane he dominated . Endless war was a constant across all cosmological models , made possible by the positive - dominant feature of this plane — all those who died in battle were raised at sunset to fight again the next night . Great Wheel Model .

title: Niskam Tresdaap
description: Niskam Tresdaap Niskam Tresdaap was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Lance of the Lord . The aging seneschal , Trusted Sword Jak Errins was soon to retire and Niskam was maneuvering to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard His chief rival was Battlelady Peris Whallnsor . Niskam was under the sway of Sapphiraktar , an undead blue dracolich and a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune .
description_long: Niskam Tresdaap Niskam Tresdaap was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Lance of the Lord . The aging seneschal , Trusted Sword Jak Errins was soon to retire and Niskam was maneuvering to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard His chief rival was Battlelady Peris Whallnsor . Niskam was under the sway of Sapphiraktar , an undead blue dracolich and a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune . Niskam believed the voice he heard was Tempus himself speaking to him , but in reality it was the crafty Runemaster .

title: Nisstyre
description: Nisstyre Nisstyre was a drow wizard and leader of the merchant band Dragon ' s Hoard . Description . Nisstyre was thin , with a sharp - featured face , elegantly pointed ears and a mane of unusual copper - colored hair that he normally put up in a ponytail .
description_long: Nisstyre Nisstyre was a drow wizard and leader of the merchant band Dragon ' s Hoard . Description . Nisstyre was thin , with a sharp - featured face , elegantly pointed ears and a mane of unusual copper - colored hair that he normally put up in a ponytail . He carried no weapons , having the ability to use magic instead . Personalty . Nisstyre was very cunning and shrewd , a necessity for being the male leader of an independent group in drow society . Dragon ' s Hoard . Nisstyre had many contacts on the surface , where he was known as ' the Fox ' . He led his band , which was said to be able to obtain anything , no matter the cost . The band were particularly valued for their discreetness . History . Nisstyre was originally from Ched Nasad , where he was trained as a wizard . He disliked having to serve the matriarchy of his homeland , and in his explorations he found the worship of the drow god of rogues , Vhaeraun . He left and formed his own independent merchants ' group secretly devoted to the glory of Vhaeraun and the expansion of drow settlement on the surface . In 1361 DR , Nisstyre ' s band went to Rashemen to obtain magical artifacts from the Red Wizard Merdrith .

title: Nistlor Lothlyn
description: Nistlor Lothlyn Nistlor " The Undying " Lothlyn is a smoothspoken wizard and proprietor of the House of the Wise Unicorn who has recently been turning to necromancy and even lichdom . Having already mastered the summoning of lesser undead he now hoards potions of longevity , purchasing them at every opportunity . Nistlor has three apprentices who help run the Unicorn and assist with his acquiring of spell components .
description_long: Nistlor Lothlyn Nistlor " The Undying " Lothlyn is a smoothspoken wizard and proprietor of the House of the Wise Unicorn who has recently been turning to necromancy and even lichdom . Having already mastered the summoning of lesser undead he now hoards potions of longevity , purchasing them at every opportunity . Nistlor has three apprentices who help run the Unicorn and assist with his acquiring of spell components .

title: Nisviim
description: Nisviim Nisviim was an arcanaloth enchanter who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the chief assistant of Inthracis and the vice - commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Relationships .
description_long: Nisviim Nisviim was an arcanaloth enchanter who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the chief assistant of Inthracis and the vice - commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Relationships . Nisviim served Inthracis loyally because he knew his true name ( " Gorgalisin " ) . His master Inthracis was a clone and kept clones of himself in reserve in case of his death and Nisviim had orders , deep inside his mind , to awake the new body of his master when he sensed his death . History . In 1373 DR , Inthracis was approached by the god Vhaeraun , who demanded that Inthracis kill the three priestesses who were candidates to become the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) : Quenthel Baenre , Danifae Yauntyrr , and Halisstra Melarn . As a reward , Vhaeraun promised Inthracis a higher position . Inthracis entrusted his holdings to his loyal Nisviim and went to battle . After being killed by Pharaun Mizzrym , Nisviim awoke the new clone body of Inthracis .

title: Nivlin Goskull
description: Nivlin Goskull Nivlin Goskull was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Nivlin was a prankster and was known to leave the severed heads of animals on a pillow in some guests ' rooms .
description_long: Nivlin Goskull Nivlin Goskull was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Nivlin was a prankster and was known to leave the severed heads of animals on a pillow in some guests ' rooms . He stopped this particular practice after he was caught and beaten severely . Activities . Nivlin was one of three kitchen drudges that fetched firewood , tended fires , stirred pots , and helped peel , clean , and chop vegetables for the soup . The all - male kitchen staff worked in hot and humid conditions generated by the many fires and bubbling cauldrons , so they wore very little clothing as they sweated and toiled . This made for a very acrimonious atmosphere in the cookhouse as he and his coworkers grudgingly took shouted orders from the two old dwarven cooks , Bezoldur Thornhand and Thaunder Gallowglaive . The drudges returned in kind but somehow the food got prepared . The four serving girls were not given any mercy either and spent as little time as possible picking up orders and then scurrying away to deliver them .

title: Niwa Hirotada
description: Niwa Hirotada Niwa Hirotada was the samurai leader of the Niwa clan and shugo - daimyo of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hirotada was always a supporter of Takenaka Okawa and after the Hojo War he was nominated shugo - daimyo of Miyama by the shikken .
description_long: Niwa Hirotada Niwa Hirotada was the samurai leader of the Niwa clan and shugo - daimyo of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hirotada was always a supporter of Takenaka Okawa and after the Hojo War he was nominated shugo - daimyo of Miyama by the shikken . In 1357 DR , he was in a difficult situation because he was personally loyal to Okawa but his wife was daughter of Takenaka Sugawara and Hirotada tried to remain neutral in the brothers ' conflict . He was developing a strong power base in the province . Personality . Hirotada was a straightforward and honest individual , known to seldom reveal any unnecessary details in conversation . He was also very cunning and intelligent . Above all , he was truly patient , always waiting for the right time to do things . He believed that the conflict between court and bakufu would end with a disaster and that that day he would be ready to be the absolute ruler of Miyama .

title: Niwa Onshi
description: Niwa Onshi Niwa Onshi was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and shugodai of Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Onshi lived in Kuda where he had his office .
description_long: Niwa Onshi Niwa Onshi was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and shugodai of Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Onshi lived in Kuda where he had his office . He led three hundred samurai and one thousand bushi . Often , however , Onshi was busy at Tamanokuni or at the bakufu capital . Relationship . Onshi was a cousin of Niwa Hirotada . He was also head of the Niwa no Kuda branch of Niwa .

title: Niwa Sutai
description: Niwa Sutai Niwa Sutai was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and overseer of Kabe in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kabe , he led a company of four samurai and ten bushi .
description_long: Niwa Sutai Niwa Sutai was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and overseer of Kabe in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kabe , he led a company of four samurai and ten bushi . He also commanded two warships , each with ten sailors and fifteen bushi . All these armed men upset the villagers , who needed to provide food for Sutai and all his men . Relationship . Sutai was the nephew of Niwa Hirotada and the great - great - grandson of the great Niwa Ozuchi , who saved the charters of the Niwa line .

title: Niwa clan
description: Niwa clan The Niwa clan was the most powerful samurai family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . The Niwa possessed most of the land and thanks to their allegiance with the Takenaka clan , their members were granted the position of shugo - daimyo , several shugodai positions , and many other jito positions on the largest shoen in Miyama .
description_long: Niwa clan The Niwa clan was the most powerful samurai family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . The Niwa possessed most of the land and thanks to their allegiance with the Takenaka clan , their members were granted the position of shugo - daimyo , several shugodai positions , and many other jito positions on the largest shoen in Miyama .

title: Nixie
description: Nixie Nixies are an aquatic race of sprite . They dwell in ponds , streams , rivers , and even lakes . They are generally playful and sometimes invite passerbys to come swim and play with them .
description_long: Nixie Nixies are an aquatic race of sprite . They dwell in ponds , streams , rivers , and even lakes . They are generally playful and sometimes invite passerbys to come swim and play with them . They are sometimes seen as wicked creatures , as the pranks they play on mortals occasionally lead to drowning . Physical description . A nixie appears as a beautiful aquatic humanoid that is the size of an elven child . They have green skin , pointed ears , and long hair the color of seaweed . They also have webbed fingers and toes . They often wear little to no clothing , preferring to dress themselves only in pearls and shells . Ecology . Lair . Nixies make their homes in beautiful lakes and streams . They act as guardians of such places , and attempt to drive away any who would despoil the natural beauty of their home . For example , they lived in and defended Lake Ashane in Rashemen .

title: Nizidramanii ' yt
description: Nizidramanii ' yt Nizidramanii ' yt was a black dragon who allied with Jon Irenicus , attacking Suldanessellar and once there guarding the Goblet of Life to prevent anyone from following Irenicus to the Tree of Life . Gorion ' s Ward and companions had to face Nizidramanii ' yt and acquire the Goblet . They could fight or bargain for the Goblet , but the dragon would only give it for all of their treasure ( gold and magic items ) , lying that he had no other treasure himself .
description_long: Nizidramanii ' yt Nizidramanii ' yt was a black dragon who allied with Jon Irenicus , attacking Suldanessellar and once there guarding the Goblet of Life to prevent anyone from following Irenicus to the Tree of Life . Gorion ' s Ward and companions had to face Nizidramanii ' yt and acquire the Goblet . They could fight or bargain for the Goblet , but the dragon would only give it for all of their treasure ( gold and magic items ) , lying that he had no other treasure himself . Appendix . Gameplay . The protagonist of " " must face Nizidramanii ' yt and acquire the Goblet near the end of the game .

title: Njal
description: Njal Njal was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . A wizard from Narfell cast a spell upon Njal , forcing him to attack his fellow dwarves .
description_long: Njal Njal was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . A wizard from Narfell cast a spell upon Njal , forcing him to attack his fellow dwarves . The ensuing fight resulted in Molnir and Njal tumbling to their deaths into the Clearflow River river far below . Activities . Njal would appear as a haunt on the bridge , but only when either Theodo Greataxe or Molnir were also present . Still under the influence of the wizard ' s spell , even in undeath , Njal would try to possess any living creature in order to attack Theodo or Molnir .

title: Nmalk
description: Nmalk Nmalk was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Khuur , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .
description_long: Nmalk Nmalk was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Khuur , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History . In the Year of the Deep Wound , 582 DR , Tarag , a chieftain of the sea ogre s , used the powers of the sword " Ilbratha " and his own battle strategies to conquer the western frontiers of the merfolk realm of Hmurrath . There , Tarag founded the two Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . The Axe Kingdoms and Hmurrath fell to fighting in the Year of the Killing Blow , 653 DR , beginning the Ninth Serôs War . The merrow suffered a major defeat in the Battle of the Haunted Plains in the Year of the Coveted Briars , 654 DR . Following their defeat , four - fifths of all merrow in Serôs were forced to flee south to the other side of the Sharksbane Wall . The rest survived on the Hmur Plateau or living amidst the ruins on the Haunted Plains . Three years of conflict culminated in the destruction of the Axe Kingdoms and the fall of the merrow to the merfolk of Hmurrath in the Year of the Volanth , 655 DR . This saw the end of merrow " civilization " in Serôs .

title: No - Nose
description: No - Nose No - Nose was a goblin leader of history in the Orsraun Mountains . History . Around 1258 DR , No - Nose led the Bloodier Teeth goblin band .
description_long: No - Nose No - Nose was a goblin leader of history in the Orsraun Mountains . History . Around 1258 DR , No - Nose led the Bloodier Teeth goblin band . Joined by all goblin , orc , troll , and kobold tribes in the area , he attacked the village of Urml . However , the villagers won the battle thanks to a mysterious stranger in white armor , later identified as the god Torm , who ' d been sent by the god Tyr to protect his followers in the village .

title: No Foolish Matter
description: No Foolish Matter No Foolish Matter , designed by Ash Law , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the hamlet of Hillpicket , and a travelling carnival . Summary .
description_long: No Foolish Matter No Foolish Matter , designed by Ash Law , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the hamlet of Hillpicket , and a travelling carnival . Summary . The adventure begins with adventurers arriving in the hamlet of Hillpicket . However , when a strange carnival arrives with a reputation as the herald of some bizarre malady , they are compelled to investigate . After battling through a deadly mirror maze , the adventurers confront a doppelganger masquerading as the carnival ' s owner . Upon defeating the creature , they release the trapped Doctor Jubal and end the sickness .

title: No Ziar
description: No Ziar No Ziar , called the Mole , was a male human wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Description . Short - statured and hunch - backed , with a shaved head and such bad myopia that he was always squinting , his nickname was very fitting .
description_long: No Ziar No Ziar , called the Mole , was a male human wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Description . Short - statured and hunch - backed , with a shaved head and such bad myopia that he was always squinting , his nickname was very fitting . Equipment . No Ziar possessed an enchanted walking stick that bestowed an amazing power : the ability to summon and talk to pond turtles . Relations . He was closely affiliated with the yakuza of Pan , and bore their mark : a small tattoo of a blue feather on the heel of his left hand . His familiar was a raccoon called Mita , which swelled to twice its natural size in a fight . Activities . Ever greedy , this wu jen was ready to steal whatever he could lay his hands on that had magical powers . He stashed his stolen treasures in a keep located high in the Vorkani Mountains . No Ziar also brewed potions that transformed people into aquatic creatures . He gained notoriety for tricking helpless people into having a quick meal and changing them into fish , such as tuna or whitefish . It seemed he and his familiar then ate the fish themselves .

title: Noanar ' s Hold
description: Noanar ' s Hold Noanar ' s Hold was a village , just off the Evermoor Way just on the edge of the High Forest , that grew up around one of the most famous hunting lodges in the North . Cottages and well - kept stables rambled between the trees . The village could be reached from Calling Horns .
description_long: Noanar ' s Hold Noanar ' s Hold was a village , just off the Evermoor Way just on the edge of the High Forest , that grew up around one of the most famous hunting lodges in the North . Cottages and well - kept stables rambled between the trees . The village could be reached from Calling Horns . Government . The Hunt Lords rule the settlement and arrange hunting parties for rich sportsmen of the Sword Coast . Rumors and Legends . These hunts can involve anything pursuing normal creatures to sentient beasts and humanoids that are less than willing participants . Notable Locations . The White Hart Inn was the best inn in town and was run by Ghille Cever .

title: Nobanion
description: Nobanion Nobanion ( pronounced " no - BAN - yun " ) , also known as the King of Beasts , Lord Firemane or the Lion King , is a primal spirit sometimes worshiped as a deity of royalty , lion s , and other felines , as well as good beasts . Nobanion was considered to have originally been an interloper deity on Toril , but since his arrival he has firmly established himself within the Faerûnian pantheon . His worship is especially strong in Gulthmere Forest and among the wemic s of the Shining Plains .
description_long: Nobanion Nobanion ( pronounced " no - BAN - yun " ) , also known as the King of Beasts , Lord Firemane or the Lion King , is a primal spirit sometimes worshiped as a deity of royalty , lion s , and other felines , as well as good beasts . Nobanion was considered to have originally been an interloper deity on Toril , but since his arrival he has firmly established himself within the Faerûnian pantheon . His worship is especially strong in Gulthmere Forest and among the wemic s of the Shining Plains . Worshipers . Worshipers include druid s , fighter s , leaders , paladin s , ranger s , soldiers , teachers , and wemic s . Worshipers are often lawful good , lawful neutral , or neutral good . Nobanion reputably prefers his priests to use a heavy pick similar in shape and weight to a lion ' s head . Relationships . The Lion King has long been allied with the archfey Lurue , as well as Tyr , Torm , Mielikki , and the other benign nature deities . All lammasu in the Realms , both greater and lesser , are believed to be his offspring . Dogma and History . Dogma . Hunt only when hungry and do not gorge without need . Waste nothing and all shall have plenty .

title: Noble Adventurer of Cormyr
description: Noble Adventurer of Cormyr Noble Adventurer of Cormyr is a Prestige class whose name is a bit of a misnomer . Nobles can come from any civilised land , though Cormyr is one of the better known producers of those who take this class . Entrants to this class don ' t even have to be nobles , they could just be educated and wealthy merchants or adventurers who have bought themselves political clout .
description_long: Noble Adventurer of Cormyr Noble Adventurer of Cormyr is a Prestige class whose name is a bit of a misnomer . Nobles can come from any civilised land , though Cormyr is one of the better known producers of those who take this class . Entrants to this class don ' t even have to be nobles , they could just be educated and wealthy merchants or adventurers who have bought themselves political clout .
