Most Noble Adventurers are aristocrat s who fancy themselves as dashing warriors , are simply looking for the thrill of adventure to liven up their boring lives at court or wish to use their political power and influence to right wrongs ( percieved or not ) . They use their wealth to buy themselves powerful or just plain flashy equipment and set off on their own to give some monsters or bandits a good seeing - to . Many noble adventurers are prideful and talk down to anybody they consider beneath them , though a few are actual paragons of virtue who endeavour to do the right thing .

title: Noble Hand
description: Noble Hand The Noble Hand was a temple of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . It was the most prominent temple of Helm in the Realms . It also operated as a school for training professional guards .
description_long: Noble Hand The Noble Hand was a temple of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . It was the most prominent temple of Helm in the Realms . It also operated as a school for training professional guards . Around 1368 DR , the temple was led by High Watchful Weaponmaster Ellym " Catsjaw " Thourin . It thrived under Ellym ' s leadership .

title: Noble dao
description: Noble dao Noble dao ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Earth . They used earth elemental s , dao , xorn , and other slaves to mine precious gems , which they craved . Description .
description_long: Noble dao Noble dao ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Earth . They used earth elemental s , dao , xorn , and other slaves to mine precious gems , which they craved . Description . These noble genies were bald and squat . Both sexes enjoyed wearing earrings , large necklaces , and turbans . Males often sculpted their beards and mustaches into ridiculous fashions . Their hands possessed retractable elongated fingernails made from pure metal capable of shredding flesh and armor alike . Combat . Noble dao only entered into combat when they were certain of the results through careful planning and strategy . A wide array of magical abilities was available for attack and defense for noble dao . They were immune to all earth magic and " maze " spells . They were particularly susceptible to holy water . Habitat / Society . Noble dao ruled the rifts of the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth , though some spent most of their time at the side of the Great Khan of the Dao in the Sevenfold Mazework . Ecology .

title: Noble djinni
description: Noble djinni Noble djinn ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Noble djinn were taller and more fair than regular djinn , who had darker complexions .
description_long: Noble djinni Noble djinn ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Noble djinn were taller and more fair than regular djinn , who had darker complexions . They were as strong as common efreet . Abilities . Noble djinn had an extensive array of magical abilities . Like all djinn , these creatures could use a special whirlwind power to either attack or transport other beings . They could create food , beverages , and other items out of thin air , as well as form powerful illusions . Like other djinn , noble djinn could turn invisible at will or take gaseous form . Like all true genies , they could " plane shift " . The true power of noble djinn , which made them distinct from lesser djinn , was their ability to grant " wish es " . Combat . All air - based attacks were utterly useless against noble djinn . Society . Only one percent of djinn were noble . Most noble djinn were local rulers of landholders who commanded djinn . Another group of noble djinn spent their time at the court of the Great Caliph of the Djinn on the Elemental Plane of Air . Served by regular djinn , noble djinn did not require much from other creatures .

title: Noble efreeti
description: Noble efreeti Noble efreet were the warlords of the efreet though they still reported to the Sultan of the City of Brass . These creatures plotted against one another with cunning similar to creatures found on the lower planes . They would try to corrupt any sha ’ ir who summoned them .
description_long: Noble efreeti Noble efreet were the warlords of the efreet though they still reported to the Sultan of the City of Brass . These creatures plotted against one another with cunning similar to creatures found on the lower planes . They would try to corrupt any sha ’ ir who summoned them . Description . Noble efreet were even more massive than regular efreet . Their skin was colored like basalt and their eyes were flame . Males preferred clothing that showed off their massive muscled bodies . Combat . Noble efreet were terrifying warriors , skilled in both magical and physical attacks . They led their troops from the front line were the fighting was thickest . Noble efreet had a wide array of magical powers that could be activated at any time . Habitat / Society . Two groups of noble efreet existed – those native to the City of Brass , and those commanding the efreet on the Prime Material Plane . Those serving on the Prime Material Plane were servants of one of the six great pasha ’ s who ruled in the sultan ’ s name . Ecology . Noble efreet viewed all living creatures as servants or enemies .

title: Noble eladrin
description: Noble eladrin Noble eladrin , sometimes simply called eladrin , are powerful beings who have become so infused with the power of the Feywild that they have become entirely new creatures , taking on aspects of the seasons and other natural phenomena . Noble eladrin are powerful archfey of comparative strength to demon prince s or archdevil s , and who are most commonly found in the Feywild or celestial plane s , particularly Arvandor and Gates of the Moon . Like most eladrin , noble eladrin are almost always free - spirited and noble individuals , whose power often reflects the seasons and other natural phenomena .
description_long: Noble eladrin Noble eladrin , sometimes simply called eladrin , are powerful beings who have become so infused with the power of the Feywild that they have become entirely new creatures , taking on aspects of the seasons and other natural phenomena . Noble eladrin are powerful archfey of comparative strength to demon prince s or archdevil s , and who are most commonly found in the Feywild or celestial plane s , particularly Arvandor and Gates of the Moon . Like most eladrin , noble eladrin are almost always free - spirited and noble individuals , whose power often reflects the seasons and other natural phenomena . Physical description . Noble eladrin look almost identical to regular eladrin , but are differentiated in a few small ways - such as their eyes , which are opaque orbs of solid color - or the aura of radiance they emit from their bodies . Noble eladrin have a few notable abilities that differentiate them from their mortal kin . For instance , many noble eladrin have a bodily resistance to the effects of both extreme cold and extreme heat , much like other celestials , and all have a powerful resistance to the effects of positive energy .

title: Noble marid
description: Noble marid Noble marids were powerful masters of the oceans . Description . Noble marids had pearls for teeth and currents for muscles , making them the strongest and handsomest of all genie kind .
description_long: Noble marid Noble marids were powerful masters of the oceans . Description . Noble marids had pearls for teeth and currents for muscles , making them the strongest and handsomest of all genie kind . Their hair was usually dark grey or blue - black . These genies could assume gaseous ( fog ) , liquid ( rushing current ) , and solid ( gigantic humanoid ) forms . Both sexes wore the most expensive clothes and jewels that they could afford . They enjoyed intimidating others with their impressive physiques . Combat . Noble marids could cast the following spell s as if they were highly powerful archmages : " detect evil / good " , " detect invisibility " , " detect magic " , " invisibility " , " assume liquid form " , " polymorph self " , " purify water " , " gaseous form " , " part water " , " lower water " , " wall of fog " , " water breathing " , " airy water " , " control weather " , " cone of cold " , " solid fog " , " water blast " , and " maelstrom " . All noble marid had the innate ability to walk on water . Noble marids were comfortable at any water temperature and were immune to any water - and most cold - based attacks . Steam did not affect them .

title: Noble tombs
description: Noble tombs Noble tombs were the final resting places of the khans of the Hordelands . Description . The appearance of a noble tomb could vary greatly depending on the wealth and status of the khan in question , ranging anywhere from a simple grave to an elaborate burial mound .
description_long: Noble tombs Noble tombs were the final resting places of the khans of the Hordelands . Description . The appearance of a noble tomb could vary greatly depending on the wealth and status of the khan in question , ranging anywhere from a simple grave to an elaborate burial mound . Most of these noble tombs could be found within the sacred site of Ejen Horo , though their exact location was always concealed to prevent grave robbers from tampering with the tomb . Cliff faces were popular locations for a noble tomb , preferably toward the top . Hills were also used . History . Khans were always buried with some of their most prized possessions since it was believed that they would use them in the afterlife . The favorite mount of a khan was slain and buried with him as well . On some occasions , valued servants were also slain and interred as well . A khan was buried sitting up with his possessions placed around him . The entire tomb was covered and remained unmarked to keep the location hidden . Curses were placed upon the tomb to dissuade robbers . Any slaves used to construct the tomb were slain upon its completion .

title: Nobruzzal
description: Nobruzzal Nobruzzal was a male drow wizard and a student of Solom Ned ' razak at the Inverted Tower in Szith Morcane . Description . A tall and gaunt male drow , Nobruzzal distinguished himself by dressing entirely in black .
description_long: Nobruzzal Nobruzzal was a male drow wizard and a student of Solom Ned ' razak at the Inverted Tower in Szith Morcane . Description . A tall and gaunt male drow , Nobruzzal distinguished himself by dressing entirely in black . He wore black boots and trousers , a black shirt , and a black cloak . Personality . Nobruzzal was a drow of eclectic tastes in magic , preferring to dabble in all manner of schools of magic and practices . Abilities . A skilled wizard and the apprentice of Solom Ned ' razak , Nobruzzal had researched many spell s from a variety of schools . In addition , he had studied alchemy and could create a number of magical potion s . Possessions . As an apprentice of the Inverted Tower , Nobruzzal was denied many possessions as a result of the policy of austerity that his master , Solom , enforced . However , he did keep a snakeskin - bound spellbook in his room and wore a set of " bracers of armor " and a " ring of protection " . Relationships . Nobruzzal had a cordial enough relationship with the other members of the Inverted Tower that he could study alongside them communally . History .

title: Nobu Chuya
description: Nobu Chuya Nobu Chuya was a wakadoshiyori inspector in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Chuya was an administrator of the Karo in Jasuga but his math skills so impressed the shogun that he was promoted to the wakadoshiyori council despite his young age .
description_long: Nobu Chuya Nobu Chuya was a wakadoshiyori inspector in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Chuya was an administrator of the Karo in Jasuga but his math skills so impressed the shogun that he was promoted to the wakadoshiyori council despite his young age . In time , he became the chief inspector of public works . However , Chuya was a corrupt individual , always accepting brides and he had a lucrative business as a loan shark . Usually he spent all his free time in Semmishi where no vice was too indecent for his enjoyment .

title: Noelin Tlestlin
description: Noelin Tlestlin Noelin Tlestlin was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , and Chyndrie Stormwind .
description_long: Noelin Tlestlin Noelin Tlestlin was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , and Chyndrie Stormwind . However , the four women got along well with one another , and commonly named Beliot as " the chief adventurer in our band " . They even referred to him as " Chief Adventurer " when speaking to patrons of the inn , instead of more proper terms like " innkeeper " , " master of the house " , or " hostler " . Appendix . Notes . As noted in the source , one person in Sevenecho , likely one of the chambermaids , is an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay , making a small chance that this is Noelin .

title: Nog
description: Nog Nog was a fallen kingdom of Zakhara , that lay in the jungles of the Nogaro and adjacent river valleys , Southeast of the Haunted Lands and South of the World Pillar Mountains and Jungle of Monsters . It was believed to be younger than the other known lost empire in the region , Kadar . Its language was Noga .
description_long: Nog Nog was a fallen kingdom of Zakhara , that lay in the jungles of the Nogaro and adjacent river valleys , Southeast of the Haunted Lands and South of the World Pillar Mountains and Jungle of Monsters . It was believed to be younger than the other known lost empire in the region , Kadar . Its language was Noga . Nog was an empire of a race of giant s , who , by the 14th century DR , had degenerated into the jungle giant s .

title: Nogah
description: Nogah Nogah was a kuo - toa senior whip and a cleric . Appearance . Nogah had scaled skin and webbed hands and feet , and was quite bloated .
description_long: Nogah Nogah was a kuo - toa senior whip and a cleric . Appearance . Nogah had scaled skin and webbed hands and feet , and was quite bloated . Her face was round and surmounted by wide , bulbous eyes that rarely blinked . Her long lip - less mouth was full of needle - like teeth . She often wore gold - hued garments and a gold crown . Personality . She worked with Aulruick Thoster several times . History . In 1395 DR , she found the Dreamheart in a drowned illithid city deep under the Sea of Fallen Stars . In 1396 DR , she was stripped of her whip status when she started to preach about an ancient power revealed to her by the Dreamheart . When the kuo - toa of Olleth attempted to stop her , she summoned the kraken Gethshemeth . Nogah was killed by poisoned crossbow bolts fired by aberrant kuo - toa in 1396 DR . Possessions . She uses a golden - hued pincer - staff . Abilities . Nogah could co - generate bolts of lightning with another kuo - tan whip .

title: Nogami Sado
description: Nogami Sado Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of Niwa clan that command the Niiashima - jo garrison in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a castle on a small isle strategic for control eastern Miyama he led one hundred samurai and three hundred bushi .
description_long: Nogami Sado Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of Niwa clan that command the Niiashima - jo garrison in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a castle on a small isle strategic for control eastern Miyama he led one hundred samurai and three hundred bushi . Plus Nogami had also ten river boats Personality . Nogami was a trusted follower of Niwa clan with many battle against bandits in his past , also losing an eye . He was an able tactician . He was considered by his troop a martinet and taskmaster .

title: Nojheim
description: Nojheim Nojheim was a male goblin from the Silver Marches who was kept as a slave in the human village of Pengallen . Description . Nojheim was a typical - looking goblin .
description_long: Nojheim Nojheim was a male goblin from the Silver Marches who was kept as a slave in the human village of Pengallen . Description . Nojheim was a typical - looking goblin . He was skinny , had yellow skin and eyes . Wearing human - made clothes , he was relatively well dressed compared to most goblins . Personality . Nojheim was quite unlike most goblins . He had no wish to harm anyone . Nojheim was highly intelligent and perceptive of the people around him , and wise enough to keep his true nature hidden . He considered himself to lack courage , and was resigned to his fate , just trying to survive instead . He could speak the local human language fluently . History . Nojheim grew up among fellow goblins , though he was no typical goblin , developing to be highly intelligent and good - hearted . His mother murdered both his father and his younger sister because they hadn ' t shared their meal with her , and Nojheim knew this was wrong . He never harmed anyone nor wanted to . He doubted he was actually a goblin at all . Nojheim was later hunted down and captured by Rico Pengallen , who enjoyed forcing others , common enemies of human kind , to work for him .

title: Nok
description: Nok Nok was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nyk . Nok and Nyk were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms .
description_long: Nok Nok was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nyk . Nok and Nyk were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms . They would tell stories about failed rescue attempts for a copper piece .

title: Nola Treestump
description: Nola Treestump Nola Treestump was a halfling priestess of Sheela Peryroyl inhabiting the Long Forest in 1367 DR . Activities . Nola spent much of her time protecting the western region of the forest against bandits and other foul creatures who tried to push their way into her domain .
description_long: Nola Treestump Nola Treestump was a halfling priestess of Sheela Peryroyl inhabiting the Long Forest in 1367 DR . Activities . Nola spent much of her time protecting the western region of the forest against bandits and other foul creatures who tried to push their way into her domain .

title: Nolaloth
description: Nolaloth Nolaloth , more completely known as Nolalothcaragascint , was a crystal great wyrm that was asked by the Illefarn Empire to destroy their great Guardian following the fall of Netheril . War with the King of Shadows . The Guardian had been created from one of Illefarn ' s greatest champions , his soul tied to the ancient Weave to become a construct of power great enough to deter Netherese attack .
description_long: Nolaloth Nolaloth , more completely known as Nolalothcaragascint , was a crystal great wyrm that was asked by the Illefarn Empire to destroy their great Guardian following the fall of Netheril . War with the King of Shadows . The Guardian had been created from one of Illefarn ' s greatest champions , his soul tied to the ancient Weave to become a construct of power great enough to deter Netherese attack . But when the Netherese arcanist Karsus , fearing the empire ' s destruction by the life - draining phaerimm s , cast the " Karsus ' s avatar " , and then - goddess of magic Mystryl sacrificed herself to save the Weave , the Weave ceased to exist long enough for the Guardian to lose its power source . Instead of accepting its fate and dying , however , it linked itself to Shar ' s Shadow Weave and became the King of Shadows . Following the King ' s defeat of several mighty Illefarn warriors , the ruling council of Illefarn asked the great wyrm Nolalothcaragascint to destroy it in exchange for a massive addition to his hoard from the empire ' s coffers . The dragon accepted , and flew into battle .

title: Nolan
description: Nolan Nolan was a priest from Caer Corwell . Description . The friar was a short fat man with a bald head .
description_long: Nolan Nolan was a priest from Caer Corwell . Description . The friar was a short fat man with a bald head . Personality . Being a believer in the true gods , Friar Nolan felt the wild revelry of the Moonshae druid s as blasphemous . History . During the Festival of the Spring Equinox in 1345 DR , Nolan set up a white tent near the druid grove in Caer Corwell to preach the existence of gods other than the Earthmother .

title: Nomadic centaur
description: Nomadic centaur Nomadic centaurs were more rugged versions of the common sylvan centaur . They could be found roaming the vast steppes and plains of the Hordelands . Compared to common centaurs , they were more introverted , preferring the company of their own kind .
description_long: Nomadic centaur Nomadic centaurs were more rugged versions of the common sylvan centaur . They could be found roaming the vast steppes and plains of the Hordelands . Compared to common centaurs , they were more introverted , preferring the company of their own kind . Description . Nomadic centaurs possessed the body of a horse with the torso of a man . The hair covering their horse body was very coarse compared to sylvan centaurs and their humanoid torso was thick . These adaptations served them well to protect against the biting winds of the open steppe . Adult males favored long beards or mustaches . Both sexes wore their hair long and braided . Combat . Nomadic centaurs used a variety of weaponry including short bows , lances and sabres . From an early age all nomadic centaurs practiced with the short bow until they were masters , capable of firing off accurate shots while running at a full gallop . Distance attacks were favored by nomadic centaurs since they could use their speed and short bows to their advantage . When surprise was on their side , a nomadic centaur would charge an enemy to intimidate them . Any enemy who fled was ridden down .

title: Nomi Pathshutter
description: Nomi Pathshutter Nomi Pathshutter was the second - in - command of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Nomi concentrated her efforts on eradicating Ogremoch ' s Bane .
description_long: Nomi Pathshutter Nomi Pathshutter was the second - in - command of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Nomi concentrated her efforts on eradicating Ogremoch ' s Bane . History . During the Rage of Demons , she also run the normal activities of the enclave while her master and leader of the Enclave Yantha Coaxrock was in Mantol - Derith .

title: Nomog - Geaya
description: Nomog - Geaya Nomog - Geaya was the hobgoblin deity of war and authority . Physical description . The god appeared as a huge , powerful goblin with rough , ash - gray skin , cold orange eyes , and teeth like a shark ' s .
description_long: Nomog - Geaya Nomog - Geaya was the hobgoblin deity of war and authority . Physical description . The god appeared as a huge , powerful goblin with rough , ash - gray skin , cold orange eyes , and teeth like a shark ' s . Personality . As a commanding figure , Nomog - Geaya was said to have no expressions other than a grim , tight - lipped look of domineering authority . He was quiet and only spoke when he must . Equipment . The hobgoblin deity fought with a " + 3 wounding broadsword " in one hand , and his " + 2 handaxe " , which bore a " symbol of pain " , in the other . Realm . Maglubiyet allowed Nomog - Geaya and Khurgorbaeyag to live in his realm of Clangor on the plane of Acheron to better keep an eye on them . Relationships . Nomog - Geaya was subservient to Maglubiyet , and detested Bargrivyek , the goblin deity of territory . Worshipers . As patron deity of hobgoblins , he was second only to Maglubiyet in hobgoblin religion and his symbol was a crossed broadsword and handaxe . Appendix . Background . Nomog - Geaya was first detailed in Roger E . Moore ' s article " The Humanoids : All About Kobolds , Goblins , Hobgoblins , and Gnolls " in " Dragon " # 63 , 1982 .

title: Non Lu Non
description: Non Lu Non Non Lu Non was the Minister of Agriculture of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Non Lu Non hailed from a farming family of Wang Ku and this granted him direct knowledge about agriculture .
description_long: Non Lu Non Non Lu Non was the Minister of Agriculture of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Non Lu Non hailed from a farming family of Wang Ku and this granted him direct knowledge about agriculture . His competence was noticed by the Emperor ' s Department of Scholarly Appointments , which initially placed him in charge of the Department of Joyful Rebirth of the Soil . He was promoted to minister for his ability in the restoration of the Chukei Plateau and curing a rice blight . In 1358 DR , he was concerned about the loss of the rice production of Chu ' Yuan province , which forced his ministry to use many of his strategic rice reserves .

title: Nondetection
description: Nondetection Nondetection ( or non - detection ) was an abjuration spell that hid the subject from divination and scrying . Effects . The warded creature or object became difficult to detect by divination spells such as " clairaudience / clairvoyance " , " locate object " , and detection spells .
description_long: Nondetection Nondetection ( or non - detection ) was an abjuration spell that hid the subject from divination and scrying . Effects . The warded creature or object became difficult to detect by divination spells such as " clairaudience / clairvoyance " , " locate object " , and detection spells . " Nondetection " also prevented location by such magic items as " crystal ball s " . If cast on a creature , " nondetection " warded the creature ' s equipment as well as the creature itself . Components . A pinch of diamond dust worth 50 gold pieces .

title: Nonthal
description: Nonthal Nonthal was a city located in Turmish . It was known for its industry based on animals and , more notably , the smell that industry produced , which pervaded the entire city . The city contained an unusually high number of gnome s , many of whom were illusionist s .
description_long: Nonthal Nonthal was a city located in Turmish . It was known for its industry based on animals and , more notably , the smell that industry produced , which pervaded the entire city . The city contained an unusually high number of gnome s , many of whom were illusionist s . Nonthal was considered the most peaceful city in Turmish and adventurers were not exactly welcomed in the city . History . The city was named after a wizard , who moved there in the early - to - mid 13th - century DR . He built his home behind an inn and put up signs warning people to leave him alone then promptly disappeared . His house was quickly ransacked of valuables but within was found a map to a ruin called Nonthal ' s Hold within the city itself . The map led to a sunken path behind the Three Trees Inn , a sunken and heavily trapped path , as the people who traversed it quickly found . The Inn was rebuilt so as to give a commanding view of the path and soon became the center of activity in the entire city and its main form of entertainment , as onlookers bet on how far hapless adventurers seeking Nonthal ' s fabled stash of gold got .

title: Noodles
description: Noodles Noodles were produced in several shapes and sizes across Kara - tur , and some countries made their own specific varieties . A selection was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Noodles Noodles were produced in several shapes and sizes across Kara - tur , and some countries made their own specific varieties . A selection was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Volo considered noodles from Kara - tur far superior to those produced in Faerûn . Noodles ordered through " Aurora ' s " were carefully dried and shipped in 1 - lb packages .

title: Noohar Serelim
description: Noohar Serelim Noohar Serelim was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Noohar was one of the most articulate persons in Faerun .
description_long: Noohar Serelim Noohar Serelim was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Noohar was one of the most articulate persons in Faerun . He was a fantastic orator and talked non - stop , even though he seldom had something to say . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR Noohar and his brother Shelvek Serelim were transporting some exquisite wooden carvings made by their people via a great caravan that , unknown to them , was full of Cult of the Dragon agents carrying treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Noori
description: Noori Noori was a member of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Noori somehow managed to enter inside the Eye of the All - Father temple .
description_long: Noori Noori was a member of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Noori somehow managed to enter inside the Eye of the All - Father temple . However , she was on the verge of death by freezing . Her chieftain Wormblod led a group of his berserkers plus an enslaved white dragon and a shaman to try to break inside the temple in order to find Noori . In truth , Wormblod only wanted the treasures inside .

title: Noori Baenre
description: Noori Baenre Noori Baenre was a female high - born cousin to Triel Baenre . She was one of the few exceptions to the rule of only males at Sorcere circa 1373 DR . She was permitted to study magic at Sorcere rather than become a cleric of Lolth at Arach - Tinilith .
description_long: Noori Baenre Noori Baenre was a female high - born cousin to Triel Baenre . She was one of the few exceptions to the rule of only males at Sorcere circa 1373 DR . She was permitted to study magic at Sorcere rather than become a cleric of Lolth at Arach - Tinilith . History . She was one of the Baenre magic - users who Gromph Baenre gathered during the Siege of Menzoberranzan for an attack on Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal .

title: Nor Takt
description: Nor Takt Nor Takt was a lake in the Hordelands near Khazari and Ra - Khati . Geography . This lake was found nestled within the foothills of Katakoro Shan .
description_long: Nor Takt Nor Takt was a lake in the Hordelands near Khazari and Ra - Khati . Geography . This lake was found nestled within the foothills of Katakoro Shan . Given its location , it was likely that Nor Takt began as a collecting pool from both glacial runoff from the Katakoro Glacier and over - spill from Nor Zanskra found to the west . The Takt Muren flowed east out of Nor Takt . Description . Nor Takt covered roughly 900 square miles ( 1450 sq . km ) .

title: Nor Tso
description: Nor Tso Nor Tso , or the Sky Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands found near the center of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . The lake sat north of the mighty Hungtse River , forming part of the boundary of the Wild Yak Meadows to the west .
description_long: Nor Tso Nor Tso , or the Sky Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands found near the center of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . The lake sat north of the mighty Hungtse River , forming part of the boundary of the Wild Yak Meadows to the west . It was fed by the Muren Tso . Description . Nor Tso was a large lake that was roughly circular in shape . It covered approximately 3 , 600 square miles ( 5800 sq . km ) .

title: Nor Yudol
description: Nor Yudol The Nor Yudol , also known as The Churned One or the Evening Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands . Description . Located in the Katakoro Plateau , the Nor Yudol was named after the mud on the bottom of the lake that rose to the surface , giving it a brown color , and cleansing the poisoned waters of the Muren Tso river into the clean water of the Muren Khi river .
description_long: Nor Yudol The Nor Yudol , also known as The Churned One or the Evening Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands . Description . Located in the Katakoro Plateau , the Nor Yudol was named after the mud on the bottom of the lake that rose to the surface , giving it a brown color , and cleansing the poisoned waters of the Muren Tso river into the clean water of the Muren Khi river . Due to the poisons of the river that fed into the lake , as well as the cleansing nature of the lake ' s mud , the lake was divided into three distinct sections . In the western end of the lake , where the Muren Tso feed in , the water was poisoned , and the fish misshapen and violent . In the center , the water and fish were normal . And on the eastern side the water was rich with purifying minerals , and the fish were healthy .

title: Nor Zanskra
description: Nor Zanskra Nor Zanskra was a large lake found in the Hordelands at the northern end of the Katakoro Plateau . Geopgraphy . Nor Zanskra located at the eastern base of a portion the Katakoro Shan range that formed the southern border of Khazari .
description_long: Nor Zanskra Nor Zanskra was a large lake found in the Hordelands at the northern end of the Katakoro Plateau . Geopgraphy . Nor Zanskra located at the eastern base of a portion the Katakoro Shan range that formed the southern border of Khazari . Description . Nor Zanskra was a large lake stretching for nearly 100 miles ( 160 kilometers ) along the base of the mountains . The lake was formed from glacial run - off from the massive Katakoro Glacier .

title: Noreia
description: Noreia Noreia was an erinyes in the service of Glasya . Description . Noreia had woolly black dreadlocks .
description_long: Noreia Noreia was an erinyes in the service of Glasya . Description . Noreia had woolly black dreadlocks . Activities . Noreia was one of the Pradixikai . She usually walked with the her twin sisters , Faventia and Fidentia . History . In 1486 DR , Noreia was on patrol with Faventia and Fidentia when they met Lorcan . They tried to bully him but Lorcan silenced them . Later , she was with Sulci and Nisibis when she informed Lorcan that Sairché had gone with Adolican Rhand .

title: Noreyth Harpell
description: Noreyth Harpell Noreyth Harpell was the master vampire of Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk . History . He was attacked in 1315 DR by the Company of the Red Dawn , who were sent by the undead vampire Artor Morlin because Noreyth encroached upon his territory .
description_long: Noreyth Harpell Noreyth Harpell was the master vampire of Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk . History . He was attacked in 1315 DR by the Company of the Red Dawn , who were sent by the undead vampire Artor Morlin because Noreyth encroached upon his territory . Noreyth and Dhusarra escaped from the ambush , but she later murdered Harpell in his crypt .

title: Norland
description: Norland Norland was an island in the Moonshae Isles that was inhabited primarily by Northlander s . At one time House Kendrick exerted nominal control over the island but as of 1479 DR the isle was ruled by the warrior maiden known as the Storm Maiden . Locations .
description_long: Norland Norland was an island in the Moonshae Isles that was inhabited primarily by Northlander s . At one time House Kendrick exerted nominal control over the island but as of 1479 DR the isle was ruled by the warrior maiden known as the Storm Maiden . Locations . The largest settlement on the isle , Rogarsheim was nominally ruled by Jarl Rault the Wise . The population was a mix of Northlanders , Ffolk , and dwarves . South Jotunhammer Mountains . A mountain range home to many giants , mostly firbolg s .

title: Nornglast
description: Nornglast Nornglast was the smallest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Nornglast was a place haunted by spirits .
description_long: Nornglast Nornglast was the smallest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Nornglast was a place haunted by spirits . An typical Eskornar saying was " Nornglast is ruled by ghosts . " This saying was closer to truth , because Nornglast was the main " principality " of the Eminence of Araunt . History . The town was named after its founders , Clan Nornglast . Around five hundred years before the Spellplague , the bone naga Lod founded the Eminence of Araunt in the catacombs of Nornglast .

title: Noro Amoto
description: Noro Amoto Noro Amoto was a samurai mercenary in Chessenta . History . Noro Amoto founded the Bushido army to fight the Tuigan during the Horde Wars .
description_long: Noro Amoto Noro Amoto was a samurai mercenary in Chessenta . History . Noro Amoto founded the Bushido army to fight the Tuigan during the Horde Wars . Inspired by the Faerûn ians ' bravery during that war , Noro and his men decided to go to Faerûn even after the defeat of the Grand Army of the Tuigan , hoping to learn more about Faerùnian culture in order to strengthen Kara - Tur .

title: Noromath
description: Noromath Noromath was a in name only , being the western half of the elven territory of the great Wealdath forest of Tethyr . Etymology . The name " Noromath " is Elvish for " Legacy of the North " .
description_long: Noromath Noromath was a in name only , being the western half of the elven territory of the great Wealdath forest of Tethyr . Etymology . The name " Noromath " is Elvish for " Legacy of the North " . It was called such by the Elmanesse elves of the forest . Geography . Noromath ' s official borders were east of County Greenshores , south of Amn , west of Durmista , and north of County Uluran ; however , the elves cared little for such human distinctions . Population . Noromath was the original home of the Elmanesse tribe of elves , who were refugees from Myth Drannor . Green elves from the Suldusk also occupied the region , since the tribes were unified . The major population of the western half of the forest , however , was composed of goblin s , hobgoblin s , centaur s , and satyr s . A small population of humans lived in the town of Brost on the outskirts of the forest to the north . Government . In 1370 DR , Allain " Foxfire " Kevanarial was the official representative of the Elmanesse tribes to the Tethyrian court . While officially a duke , he did not consider himself a duke at all , and he refused to declare any place his ducal seat .

title: Norry Waywocket
description: Norry Waywocket Norry Waywocket was a rock gnome sorcerer and a smuggler in Cormyr in the early 1370s DR . He was partner to Coobert Draftworth . Activities .
description_long: Norry Waywocket Norry Waywocket was a rock gnome sorcerer and a smuggler in Cormyr in the early 1370s DR . He was partner to Coobert Draftworth . Activities . Norry and Coobert carried on a profitable trade in smuggling stolen goods across Cormyr and fencing them to certain merchants returning to Sembia on the Way of the Manticore . Living out of Monksblade in Cormyr , they stored their illicit goods in the Tomb of Chonis , their favorite drop - site . They seemed to specialize in small , easy - to - carry treasures , such as jewelry , liqueurs and wines , silks , and fine clothing . As cover their activities , they claimed to be small - time merchants and acted as urbane and amiable gentlemen , and said they lived in Immersea . If pressed , they claimed they only used the tomb as a warehouse . Relationships . Norry Waywocket and Coobert Draftworth were constant companions and old friends , and always worked together . So close were they that they finished each other ' s sentences and accurately anticipated whatever the other needed . Always talking together , they could lie easily about what they did . They even claimed to think alike . History .

title: North Center
description: North Center The North Center was a ward of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Northwest District , this ward controlled all trade passing through the River Gate and the Gate of the Ghost .
description_long: North Center The North Center was a ward of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Northwest District , this ward controlled all trade passing through the River Gate and the Gate of the Ghost . Most of the caravans entering Huzuz passed through the North Center . Inhabitants . A tasked administrator genie named Sandara al - Sahil ran the North Center . She was aided by a large contingent of mamluk s of the Valiant .

title: North Faerûn
description: North Faerûn North Faerûn stretches from the wide Anauroch desert in the west to the eastern edge of the inland Moonsea , in the northern region of Faerûn . It is a region of contrasts , with the forested Dalelands , the wastes of Anauroch , the coastline of the Moonsea , and the bitterly cold steppes of The Ride . Regions .
description_long: North Faerûn North Faerûn stretches from the wide Anauroch desert in the west to the eastern edge of the inland Moonsea , in the northern region of Faerûn . It is a region of contrasts , with the forested Dalelands , the wastes of Anauroch , the coastline of the Moonsea , and the bitterly cold steppes of The Ride . Regions . Anauroch . This desert was once a rich , flourishing land that was home to the ancient Netherese Empire . During a war with the mysterious and powerful phaerimm , this region became magically drained of life and was transformed into a broad wasteland . This desert swallowed the human empires and states of this region , and is now only sparsely populated by desert tribes . Recently , however , it has witnessed the arrival of the Shades ; the strangely - transformed descendants of the original Netherese . Dalelands . This is a forested region that lies to the southwest of the Moonsea . The western edge is defined by the mountains along the eastern edge of the Anauroch desert , and the east by the Dragon Reach of the Sea of Fallen Stars . In the deep , northern forest is Cormanthyr , an ancient homeland of the elves — now mostly abandoned .

title: North Gate ( Luskan )
description: North Gate ( Luskan ) The North Gate in the city of Luskan was a guarded iron gate at the north end of the Upstream Span bridge . Structure . The north side of the gate was outside the city walls , and one would enter south through the gate , across the Upstream Span bridge and into the city on the southern bank .
description_long: North Gate ( Luskan ) The North Gate in the city of Luskan was a guarded iron gate at the north end of the Upstream Span bridge . Structure . The north side of the gate was outside the city walls , and one would enter south through the gate , across the Upstream Span bridge and into the city on the southern bank . During darkness the gate would be kept shut , but was always guarded by up to thirty armed and armoured solders and a wizard from the Arcane Brotherhood . The North Gate , whose watch was led by the Nightkeeper of the North Gate , was a large iron - bound door and portcullis with a square tower to either side . Soldiers who patrolled the gate were armed spears and crossbows . History . Since there were no river crossings in this area that were outside the city ' s walls , as of 1370 DR a cable - ferry crossed the river slightly upstream of the Upstream Span . Each end of the ferry ' s route was guarded by the Arcane Brotherhood , usually by lower - ranking wizards .

title: North Quarter
description: North Quarter The North Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The North Quarter encompassed the Craft District , Central District , and the Warehouse District , forming most of the northern portion of the city .
description_long: North Quarter The North Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The North Quarter encompassed the Craft District , Central District , and the Warehouse District , forming most of the northern portion of the city . Visitors often came to the North Quarter for its wide selection of skilled craftsmen . Many traders and prominent merchant families either stored or manufactured their goods here until they were ready for sale in the Grand Bazaar of the Clothiers ' Quarter . Additionally , the bulk of Huzuz ' s military was quartered within the North Quarter .

title: North Ride
description: North Ride The North Ride was a road in the Dalelands that ran from Tilverton in the Shadow Gap in the south , leading to Cormyr , to Voonlar in the north , leading to the Moonsea . Where the road crossed the River Ashaba , the town of Shadowdale is situated .
description_long: North Ride The North Ride was a road in the Dalelands that ran from Tilverton in the Shadow Gap in the south , leading to Cormyr , to Voonlar in the north , leading to the Moonsea . Where the road crossed the River Ashaba , the town of Shadowdale is situated .

title: North Road
description: North Road The North Road ran through the Vast from the city of Procampur at its most southern point all the way to Mulmaster on the Moonsea at its most northern point . Description . From north to south it ran through : Mulmaster , Maskyr ' s Eye , Kurth , Three Trees Pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains , over the River Vesper , through King ' s Reach , Swords Pool , Dead Tree Hollow , Dragon Falls , across the Fire River , through the Earthfast Mountains at Glorming Pass , between the Adhe Wood and Brynwood , Sevenecho where it bent west , Maerstar , and ended at Procampur .
description_long: North Road The North Road ran through the Vast from the city of Procampur at its most southern point all the way to Mulmaster on the Moonsea at its most northern point . Description . From north to south it ran through : Mulmaster , Maskyr ' s Eye , Kurth , Three Trees Pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains , over the River Vesper , through King ' s Reach , Swords Pool , Dead Tree Hollow , Dragon Falls , across the Fire River , through the Earthfast Mountains at Glorming Pass , between the Adhe Wood and Brynwood , Sevenecho where it bent west , Maerstar , and ended at Procampur . On the way , it connected with the Hunt Trail , the Cross Road , the Long Reach , Blaern ' s Trail , the Hlintar Ride , Stormcrest Trail , Helve ' s Trail , and the High Trail . Several small campsites laid near the North Road as it passed through the High Country , each near a source of water . All along the North were also found boulders carved with the symbol of Clangeddin Silverbeard , a relic of the old dwarf kingdoms of the Vast . Mount Wolf towered over the North Road near Kurth .

title: North Wind ' s Fury
description: North Wind ' s Fury The North Wind ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of the corsair Makbulla bint Dalmar in 1367 DR . Description . " North Wind ' s Fury " was a 70 ft .
description_long: North Wind ' s Fury The North Wind ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of the corsair Makbulla bint Dalmar in 1367 DR . Description . " North Wind ' s Fury " was a 70 ft . ( 21 m ) long " sambuk " crewed by 40 hardened dwarves . Activities . Makbulla primarily hunted the waters around the Pearl Cities and the Pantheist League .

title: North Zakhara
description: North Zakhara The area of north Zakhara was dominated by the conflicting world - views of the independent - minded Free Cities of Zakhara on the one hand and the Mamluk s of Qudra with their fierce loyalty towards the Grand Caliph and belief in order on the other . It was framed by the shores of the Great Sea in the west and north , where it touched Faerûn at the border to Konigheim , and the Land of the Yak - Men in the east . The Furrowed Mountains separated north Zakhara to the south and east from the Haunted Lands in the continent ' s interior .
description_long: North Zakhara The area of north Zakhara was dominated by the conflicting world - views of the independent - minded Free Cities of Zakhara on the one hand and the Mamluk s of Qudra with their fierce loyalty towards the Grand Caliph and belief in order on the other . It was framed by the shores of the Great Sea in the west and north , where it touched Faerûn at the border to Konigheim , and the Land of the Yak - Men in the east . The Furrowed Mountains separated north Zakhara to the south and east from the Haunted Lands in the continent ' s interior . In the southwest , the region stretched to the Sea of Caravans to where the territory directly controlled by Qudra bordered the High Desert . Geography . It was mainly an arid region , broken by short rivers that supported the major cities . Utaqa . The City of Free Man , at the mouth of the river al - Zulma , was the northernmost major settlement of Zakhara . The inhabitants were an independent lot and took pride in their position as the last stronghold of civilization towards the barbaric northern lands . Hafayah .

title: Northdark
description: Northdark The Northdark was a underground domain of the Underdark north and east of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The area was home to some of the most renowned subterranean realms of Faerûn like the svirfneblin ruins of Blingdenstone , the duergar deepkingdom of Gracklstugh and the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad .
description_long: Northdark The Northdark was a underground domain of the Underdark north and east of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The area was home to some of the most renowned subterranean realms of Faerûn like the svirfneblin ruins of Blingdenstone , the duergar deepkingdom of Gracklstugh and the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . Numerous crumbled ancient realms were also found in the Northdark , such as Ammarindar , Delzoun and Netheril ( in the form of Skullport ) . The Northdark bordered on the Buried Realms in the east , meeting it underneath the ruins of Ascore . Deep within the Spine of the World many orc strongholds , troll caves , and giant delvings were buried . Lower Northdark . The lowest minor domain of the Northdark domain in the Lowerdark realm of the Underdark . Located between 12 and 18 mi ( 19 . 31 to 28 . 97 km ) below the region known as the Northwest Faerûn , the Lower Northdark had the Buried Realms to the east and Netherese Caverns to the south .

title: Northeast Faerûn
description: Northeast Faerûn Northeast Faerûn is a remote area that begins in the cold , forbidding lands along the great ice sheets and continues south toward the northeastern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It is bordered on the west by the mountain - hemmed land of Vaasa and stretches east to the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Regions .
description_long: Northeast Faerûn Northeast Faerûn is a remote area that begins in the cold , forbidding lands along the great ice sheets and continues south toward the northeastern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It is bordered on the west by the mountain - hemmed land of Vaasa and stretches east to the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Regions . Damara . This is the remnant of a once - great nation , now a peaceful and tolerant land . To the north is the Great Glacier , which provides fresh water for the rivers that run south through the land . To the west are the Galena Mountains , with Bloodstone Pass forming a trade route with Vaasa to the west . The capital city is Heliogabalus , which lies in the middle of the nation at the confluence of a pair of rivers . Damara forms part of the Bloodstone Lands along with Vaasa . Great Dale . This coastal land is dominated by the large forests of Rawlinswood to the north and the Forest of Lethyr to the south . Between these two is a wide , windswept gap called the Great Dale . The Great Road runs along this gap , starting at the coastal city of Uthmere on the Easting Reach of the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Northeast Zakhara
description: Northeast Zakhara Northeast Zakhara was in many ways the antithesis to the civilization of the rest of the continent . It comprised the Land of the Yak - Men with their evil empire within the World Pillar Mountains ( the Zakharan part of the Yehimal ) and the untamed expanse of the Jungle of Monsters towards the Foreigners ' Sea . Together they effectively cut off land travel towards Kara - Tur in the northeast and east .
description_long: Northeast Zakhara Northeast Zakhara was in many ways the antithesis to the civilization of the rest of the continent . It comprised the Land of the Yak - Men with their evil empire within the World Pillar Mountains ( the Zakharan part of the Yehimal ) and the untamed expanse of the Jungle of Monsters towards the Foreigners ' Sea . Together they effectively cut off land travel towards Kara - Tur in the northeast and east . Geographic limits . The region separated three continents : to the northwest lay the realm of Konigheim of Faerûn ' s Utter East , to the north lay the Kingdom of Nix and beyond to the north and northeast the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of Kara - Tur . To the east , the Sempadan Forest stretched into the eastern continent , while northeast Zakhara ended at the shores of the Foreigner ' s Sea in the southeast . Towards the south , it was bordered by the territory of Zakhara ' s Cities of the Ancients , to the southwest it fell towards the desert of the Haunted Lands , and to the west it touched the lands around the Free City of Utaqa and the Great Sea . Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Northern Four
description: Northern Four This adventuring group made their names along the Sword Coast North and all eventually came to positions of prominence in that region . The group consisted of Nasher Alagondar , Dumal Erard and the lovers Ophala Cheldarstorn and Kurth . Nasher led the group to many victories in the northlands .
description_long: Northern Four This adventuring group made their names along the Sword Coast North and all eventually came to positions of prominence in that region . The group consisted of Nasher Alagondar , Dumal Erard and the lovers Ophala Cheldarstorn and Kurth . Nasher led the group to many victories in the northlands . One tale told frequently is that of their successful attempt to slay a white dragon that would have otherwise destroyed the Black Raven Uthgardt tribe . As a reward , Nasher was given an uthgardt girl named Morregence to raise as his own . Unfortunately , their group broke apart when Kurth attempted to wrest control of the group from Nasher . When Ophala chose loyalty over love and sided with Nasher against Kurth , that was the end of the group . Nasher went on to become the lord of the city of Neverwinter while Kurth became one of the High Captains of Luskan . Ophala joined the mages guild of Neverwinter , the Many - Starred Cloak , unable to reconcile her feelings for Kurth over her hatred of Luskan and its Arcane Brotherhood . Dumal , ever Nasher ' s ally , eventually retired not far outside Neverwinter and set up Helm ' s Hold .

title: Northern Imaskari languages
description: Northern Imaskari languages The Northern Imaskari languages were languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the northern parts of the Hordelands . Description . These languages rolled their rs and had broad , rounded vowels .
description_long: Northern Imaskari languages The Northern Imaskari languages were languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the northern parts of the Hordelands . Description . These languages rolled their rs and had broad , rounded vowels . Speakers . Most of the tribes speaking these languages were found along the westernmost edge of the Endless Waste . Languages . This grouping usually included Commani , Khassidi , Naican , and Raumvira , but Naican was sometimes placed with the Southern Imaskari languages instead . History . These languages were strongly influenced by the Raumathar an Empire , especially Raumvira .

title: Northern Wastes
description: Northern Wastes The Northern Wastes was an area in the north of Kara - Tur . Geography . Though used by many peoples , the name " Northern Wastes " was misleading , as it was in fact a very diverse and interesting part of Kara - Tur , not to be confused with the Land of the Snow Demons and permafrost further north .
description_long: Northern Wastes The Northern Wastes was an area in the north of Kara - Tur . Geography . Though used by many peoples , the name " Northern Wastes " was misleading , as it was in fact a very diverse and interesting part of Kara - Tur , not to be confused with the Land of the Snow Demons and permafrost further north . The Northern Wastes was a little - known land , at least in its northern parts , but its southern parts were much better known . Often these lands were called the Ama Basin in honor of the great Ama River flowing in these lands . There were also the Koryaz Mountains and plenty of forests and swamps . People . There were several native tribes , such as the Issacortae , the Pazruki , and the Wu - haltai , three of the most powerful and influential . They differed from each other in culture and custom . The Issacortae were the most closely knit tribe , while the Wu - haltai very rarely made inter - clan alliances and remained fairly isolated . There were also many small tribes living in the area . There were also immigrants from the Plain of Horses , the Land of the Snow Demons , and other lands .

title: Northern Wizards
description: Northern Wizards The Northern Wizards were one of the two spellcasting organizations in Unther . Organizations . They were a group of wizards that considered themselves the protectors of the common people of Messemprar .
description_long: Northern Wizards The Northern Wizards were one of the two spellcasting organizations in Unther . Organizations . They were a group of wizards that considered themselves the protectors of the common people of Messemprar . They mostly worshiped Mystra and Ishtar . History . The Northern Wizards had always protected Messemprar and it people . When a revolt started in 1357 DR , they found that their main enemy was the god - king Gilgeam ' s army . However , they tried to negotiate with the king . After the Godswar and Mulhorand ' s invasion , the Northern Wizards were the " de facto " rulers of the remaining free Unther by 1373 DR .

title: Northkeep
description: Northkeep Northkeep was the first settlement built on the Moonsea by humans . History . The city was founded in 348 DR ( Year of the Dagger ) on an island near the lake ' s southern shore , about midway between the present towns of Elventree and Elmwood .
description_long: Northkeep Northkeep was the first settlement built on the Moonsea by humans . History . The city was founded in 348 DR ( Year of the Dagger ) on an island near the lake ' s southern shore , about midway between the present towns of Elventree and Elmwood . The city was a beacon of civilization and a jumping off point for merchants . The power of Northkeep made it a target for orcs , giants , and other evil beings , who formed the Dark Alliance to battle and contain Northkeep . Northkeep appeared safe on its island , but in 400 DR ( Year of the Blue Shield ) , a huge force mounted on dragonback , commanded by the black dragon Iyrauroth , swept over the city while ships landed an army that overran and sacked the city . To make their victory complete , a force of nonhuman mage s and cleric s ( forty thousand strong , some said ) gathered on the north shore of the Moonsea and brought the vengeance of Gruumsh down upon the human interlopers . The city sank beneath the purple waves . Features . The Bell in the Depths : This bell sat in one of the tallest of the shattered towers of the sunken city . At times , nearby ships could hear the ghostly bell ring .

title: Northlander
description: Northlander The Northlanders , or sometimes Northmen , were seafaring people who inhabited the northern parts of the Moonshae Isles . Society . Descendants of raiders from the island of Ruathym , the Northlanders were a sturdy , war - ready people who worshiped the god Tempus .
description_long: Northlander The Northlanders , or sometimes Northmen , were seafaring people who inhabited the northern parts of the Moonshae Isles . Society . Descendants of raiders from the island of Ruathym , the Northlanders were a sturdy , war - ready people who worshiped the god Tempus . Unlike the Ffolk , who also inhabited the Moonshaes , the Northlanders were not interested in the subtle beauty of nature and were more comfortable out at sea . The Northlanders were believed to be related to the Uthgardt . History . The Northlanders had a longtime conflict with the Ffolk . The Ffolk were more peaceful , and Northlanders sometimes took to raiding Ffolk settlements , creating tension between the two peoples as a whole . Northlanders quieted down when High King of the Moonshae Isles , Tristan Kendrick , made initiatives towards peace between the two populations of his lands , which were continued by his daughter , Alicia Kendrick . Further advances toward peace between the two peoples brought about marriages between Northlanders and Ffolk , almost forcing families to at least tolerate each other .

title: Northlook ( inn )
description: Northlook ( inn ) The Northlook was an inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located next to Bryn Shander ' s North Gate .
description_long: Northlook ( inn ) The Northlook was an inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located next to Bryn Shander ' s North Gate . Interior . Atmosphere . The Northlook was frequented mostly by adventurers and mercenaries . For that reason , it was a very dangerous place , but also the best source for information and rumors of the Ten Towns region . Services . The proprietor , Scramsax , charged exorbitant rates for all services at the inn . He also had a policy of opening lines of credit for customers and then charging them later with large interests , ruthlessly enforcing that they be paid .

title: Northwest District
description: Northwest District The Northwest District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Northwest District was found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in the western portion of Huzuz .
description_long: Northwest District The Northwest District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Northwest District was found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in the western portion of Huzuz . It was the only part of the city that could be considered a slum . Many fish markets could be found here , selling their catches from Al - Sarif River and Suq Bay . Other less - savory trades such as gambling , smuggling , and slave - trading , also occurred here . The Fishers ' Road ran along the northeastern border of the district , separating it from the Merchants ' District and the Grand Bazaar . Most of the eastern border was formed by the Clothiers ' Way . The Clothiers ' District lay to the south of the Northwest District . Inhabitants . Most of the population of this district were commoners , laborers , and petty criminals . The Northwest District was a haven for illicit activities , making the streets unsafe during the night .

title: Northwest Faerûn
description: Northwest Faerûn Northwest Faerûn , generally referred to as The North , is a region of wilderness , difficult winter weather , orc hordes , and barbarian tribes . It is a mostly untamed region that lies west of Anauroch and north of the High Moor . The inhabitants of areas further south , in West Faerûn , describe this area in condescension as " the Savage North , " which is a reference to the Savage Frontier and a time when its inhabitants were less civilized .
description_long: Northwest Faerûn Northwest Faerûn , generally referred to as The North , is a region of wilderness , difficult winter weather , orc hordes , and barbarian tribes . It is a mostly untamed region that lies west of Anauroch and north of the High Moor . The inhabitants of areas further south , in West Faerûn , describe this area in condescension as " the Savage North , " which is a reference to the Savage Frontier and a time when its inhabitants were less civilized . In spite of this reputation , the region is home to two of the greatest cities in all of Faerûn : Neverwinter , Jewel of the North , and Waterdeep , the City of Splendors . Regions . High Forest . A vast , densely - forested region just to the west of the Anauroch desert . These woodlands are home to elves , centaur s , satyr s , wild creatures and many mysteries . At its southern heart are the towering Star Mounts , from which flows the Unicorn Run . The Frozenfar . The collective name for the lands north of the Spine of the World mountains , including the Sea of Moving Ice , the Reghed Glacier and of course , Icewind Dale .

title: Northwest Zakhara
description: Northwest Zakhara Northwest Zakhara consisted of a number of islands on a beautiful shallow part of the Great Sea off the northern coast of the continent . The two larger archipelagos of the Genie ' s Turban and the Desert ' s Virtues made up the Corsair Domains , with the one major settlement , Hawa . Closer toward the coast of the Free Cities , authority over the Wizard ' s Reach toward the north and the group of three islands — the Bird , the Dancer and the Fortress — to the south , were disputed between the corsairs and the mainland cities .
description_long: Northwest Zakhara Northwest Zakhara consisted of a number of islands on a beautiful shallow part of the Great Sea off the northern coast of the continent . The two larger archipelagos of the Genie ' s Turban and the Desert ' s Virtues made up the Corsair Domains , with the one major settlement , Hawa . Closer toward the coast of the Free Cities , authority over the Wizard ' s Reach toward the north and the group of three islands — the Bird , the Dancer and the Fortress — to the south , were disputed between the corsairs and the mainland cities . The vast open stretch of the Great Sea separated northwest Zakhara from Faerûn in the north and Maztica in the west . The islands of Lahib and Dahab marked the southern border toward west Zakhara . Corsair Domains . The Corsair Domains were a number of islands under the control of these loosely organized buccaneers of Zakhara — efforts of Qudra to the contrary notwithstanding . Piracy , trade , shipbuilding and power - struggles between local would - be rulers shaped daily life there , all helped by the fragmented shape of the islands ' terrain . The Genie ' s Turban .

title: Norun Chethil
description: Norun Chethil Norun Chethil was a monk cook of Candlekeep . History . Chethil was the most able cook of the monastery .
description_long: Norun Chethil Norun Chethil was a monk cook of Candlekeep . History . Chethil was the most able cook of the monastery . In 1487 DR , the shadovar Maerandor decided to use him as his disguise to infiltrate the monastery . Then Maerandor broke Chethil ' s neck , but before before he died he read all his mind .

title: Nostilax
description: Nostilax Nostilax was a half - dragon druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Nostilax had an unusual relationship with her father .
description_long: Nostilax Nostilax was a half - dragon druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Nostilax had an unusual relationship with her father . She was a cunning and conniving individual like her father , using the misconceptions of others to her advantage , but she also had a great love for nature . She venerated her father for his strength and wanted to honor her vow to him . However , she did not appreciate her father ' s choice of minions and his treatment of the surrounding area . She was divided between her loyalties to nature and to her father . History . Nostilax was the half - dragon daughter of Throstulgrael and helped her father settle in the Twilight Marsh . She was his chief lieutenant until she was confronted by an adventuring party sent to recover some items from her father ' s lair . Appendix . Behind the scenes . It is difficult but possible to convince Nostilax to betray her father and also join the Emerald Enclave .

title: Nostyn Vandur
description: Nostyn Vandur Nostyn Vandur was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Nostyn arrived with two ironlord bodyguards at Castle Irlingstar , just after Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave .
description_long: Nostyn Vandur Nostyn Vandur was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Nostyn arrived with two ironlord bodyguards at Castle Irlingstar , just after Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave . He claimed to be sent to lead the investigation into the murder of seneschal Marthin Avathnar but lord steward Gelnur Farland mistrusted him . He together with Duth Gulkanun and Imbrult Longclaws tried to stop Gelnur , Lord Delcastle and Amarune but in the fighting was killed .

title: Nothic
description: Nothic Nothics were one - eyed creeping monsters that lurked in places with great magical knowledge , which they themselves craved . Description . Nothics were the result of a curse befalling wizard s who delved too deep into arcane knowledge .
description_long: Nothic Nothics were one - eyed creeping monsters that lurked in places with great magical knowledge , which they themselves craved . Description . Nothics were the result of a curse befalling wizard s who delved too deep into arcane knowledge . Once transformed , the nothic held no discernible memory of its former self , except for a faint notion that there might be a way to reverse its condition . Despite their deteriorated condition , nothics possessed an exceptional insight , and were capable of extracting knowledge and secrets from the minds of others .

title: Nourisher Creed
description: Nourisher Creed The Nourisher Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were highly focused on the thralls and were the Creed that took care of them , organized them , kept them docile , and ceremorphed them . Oryndoll .
description_long: Nourisher Creed The Nourisher Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were highly focused on the thralls and were the Creed that took care of them , organized them , kept them docile , and ceremorphed them . Oryndoll . In Oryndoll , illithids in the Nourisher Creed controlled menageries , which were spread throughout the Ring Caverns . These menageries varied in size and shape and were used to house exotic , imported breeds of thralls . The Nourishers also supplied exotic brains to the Succulent Encephalon . High - ranking members provided entertainment in the feast hall . The Nourishers also controlled the gohlbrorn packs that were used in the defense of the city . The Nourishers were responsible for maintaining the city ' s large population of thralls and ceremorphing them as well . Members of this Creed were responsible for creating the tren race through crossbreeding lizardfolk and troglodyte s . ( Tren afterward were sold to other Underdark races , from whom they escaped to form small communities throughout the Underdark . ) The Nourishers had also managed to maintain a small duergar population , even after the duergar uprising .

title: Novularond
description: Novularond Novularond was the name of a region of the Great Glacier in Faerûn . History . One branch of the first dwarven migration into Faerûn settled in the Novularond mountains and later became known as arctic dwarves .
description_long: Novularond Novularond was the name of a region of the Great Glacier in Faerûn . History . One branch of the first dwarven migration into Faerûn settled in the Novularond mountains and later became known as arctic dwarves . . A time gate was hidden inside the glacier . It was , according to a legend of Mystryl , " north of Novularond , shining bright upon Misken ' s Peak at Highsummer . " However , the Great Glacier knocked the top off Misken ' s Peak many centuries before the 7th century DR , so it could not be found even after repeated efforts by adventurers to find it . The portal survived but was buried deep inside the glacier and was slowly carried along with it . It was suspected that Ulutiu laid in the middle of the Peaks in the Ice .

title: Noxious step
description: Noxious step Noxious step was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice but when a skulker ' s cover was blown , " noxious step " was the ability to be used .
description_long: Noxious step Noxious step was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice but when a skulker ' s cover was blown , " noxious step " was the ability to be used . The skulker teleported away through shadows for a short distance and cloaked himself in foul - smelling green gas . Apart from giving a degree of concealment , this gas was poisonous in a selective way : enemies in the gas received physical damage from the gas and when the skulker was more skilled , also suffered a temporary loss of offensive capability .

title: Noyerghu
description: Noyerghu Noyerghu was a Thay an gnoll around 1485 DR . History . Noyerghu was a gnoll from Thay who accompanied the Red Wizard of Thay Thegger Grynn in 1485 DR in taking control of the Phylund Lodge .
description_long: Noyerghu Noyerghu was a Thay an gnoll around 1485 DR . History . Noyerghu was a gnoll from Thay who accompanied the Red Wizard of Thay Thegger Grynn in 1485 DR in taking control of the Phylund Lodge . Thanks to possession by the pit fiend Baazka , Noyerghu replaced Flubnak as chieftain of the local gnolls and led them in raids against the caravans from Daggerford . However an adventuring party invaded the lodge to stop the gnoll ' s raids and confronted and killed Noyerghu .

title: Nozumi Takahasho
description: Nozumi Takahasho Nozumi Takahasho was a broken soldier in Shou Lung . History . Nozumi Takahasho was a soldier of the army of General Goyat Nagumo .
description_long: Nozumi Takahasho Nozumi Takahasho was a broken soldier in Shou Lung . History . Nozumi Takahasho was a soldier of the army of General Goyat Nagumo . In 1358 DR , during the army ' s journey through the Kutuk Valley he was captured by Taring savages . Nozumi managed to escape but was infected by a variety of jungle diseases that nearly destroyed his mind . He managed to get back to Suijeng just before the Komite . He wandered the city exhausted , weakened , starving , and thirsty . If questioned , he tried to tell his story but couldn ' t remember the details , eventually collapsing to the ground , sobbing and shaking .

title: Nrymm Aumar
description: Nrymm Aumar Nrymm Aumar was the youngest of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Nrymm was very young when his father , and king , died and he was raised by the women of the court .
description_long: Nrymm Aumar Nrymm Aumar was the youngest of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Nrymm was very young when his father , and king , died and he was raised by the women of the court . When magelord s seized control , Nrymm disappeared . Magelord records indicated that he was turned into an otyugh by the magelords , then kept in the middens of Athalgard , the royal castle in Hastarl , so that they had another blood heir of Uthgrael in their power , other than Belaur Aumar . Nrymm was slain in otyugh form in 238 DR by one of the mages hired by Felodar Aumar .

title: Nualion Galanodel
description: Nualion Galanodel Nualion Galanodel was an adventurer who had recently arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Nualion was not certain that he wanted to remain an adventurer and considered returning to Cormanthor , after having developed a crippling case of claustrophobia while in the sewers .
description_long: Nualion Galanodel Nualion Galanodel was an adventurer who had recently arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Nualion was not certain that he wanted to remain an adventurer and considered returning to Cormanthor , after having developed a crippling case of claustrophobia while in the sewers . Relationships . Nualion was a elven druid , originating in Cormanthor , who , with his friend Turami warrior Florio , dwarven cleric Rorik Ironheart , and human ranger Kyra , decided to form an adventuring party in Selgaunt . History . In 1491 DR , they went to Mulmaster with the intention of exploring some dwarven ruins in the Earthspur Mountains , but the city watch sergeant , Audra Maskyr , hired them to explore the city ' s sewers instead . During the exploration , they fought some large rat s and lost Rorik Ironheart in a flood . At this point , Nualion and the others met another adventuring party sent by sergeant Maskyr , and , with their help , Nualion and his companions exited from the sewers .

title: Nubari
description: Nubari The Nubari were the human s of the Malatran Plateau of southern Kara - Tur . Description . The Nubari people were tall , ranging from five feet to well over six feet in height .
description_long: Nubari The Nubari were the human s of the Malatran Plateau of southern Kara - Tur . Description . The Nubari people were tall , ranging from five feet to well over six feet in height . Their skin was colored in various brown shades from deep bronze to a dark brown . Their hair and eyes were usually black or brown , but occasionally their hair would be autumn - colored . It was usually curly . In rare instances , an individual would be born with the traits of the Ancient Nubari from which the modern Nubari descended . These persons would be even taller than normal and would have golden eyes or only three fingers on each hand . Society . The Nubari lived in tribes arranged by blood relationship . The idea of " people " as opposed to " animals " is a very important distinction to the Nubari . What races the Nubari consider people varies from tribe to tribe . Language . All Nubari tribes spoke Malatran Common . All of the tribes except for the Saiyama also spoke their own tribal dialects . Religion . The Nubari were a shamanistic people . History .

title: Nubari ( ancient )
description: Nubari ( ancient ) The Nubari ( often called the " Ancient Nubari ' " , or simply " the Ancients " , to distinguish them from the race of humans who descended from them ) were a starfaring race that settled on Toril in Malatra . Description . The Ancient Nubari were an exceptionally tall ( reaching seven feet in height ) and willowy race of humanoid s with large , elongated skulls .
description_long: Nubari ( ancient ) The Nubari ( often called the " Ancient Nubari ' " , or simply " the Ancients " , to distinguish them from the race of humans who descended from them ) were a starfaring race that settled on Toril in Malatra . Description . The Ancient Nubari were an exceptionally tall ( reaching seven feet in height ) and willowy race of humanoid s with large , elongated skulls .
