They had only three fingers and a thumb on each hand . Their skin was dark brown , and they had golden tinted eyes . Society . The Nubari were lovers of art , magic , philosophy , and science and lived in harmony with nature . They had advanced and alien technology , and had developed a hard form of ceramic that they used where other races might use metal . The Nubari abhorred violence and for millennia maintained a utopian existence . They lived on several worlds that were said to be like paradise compared to Toril , and they used their spelljamming craft to travel between them . History . The Ancient Nubari came to Toril thousands of years before the Time of Troubles on spelljammer s from another world . They had come to flee a great celestial war in search of peace .

title: Nudar Abd al - Amin
description: Nudar Abd al - Amin Nudar Abd al - Amin was a platoon commander from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Nudar was easy going and well - liked .
description_long: Nudar Abd al - Amin Nudar Abd al - Amin was a platoon commander from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Nudar was easy going and well - liked . Activities . She commanded a platoon within the mamluk s of the Faithful , often protecting caravans travelling from Hiyal to Qudra .

title: Nulara Haphet
description: Nulara Haphet Nulara Haphet , also known as Silversong , was a female human bard who was one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . History . Nulara hailed from distant Mulhorand , a place she never spoke of , and was considered to have the soul of a dark poet and the mind of a criminal genius .
description_long: Nulara Haphet Nulara Haphet , also known as Silversong , was a female human bard who was one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . History . Nulara hailed from distant Mulhorand , a place she never spoke of , and was considered to have the soul of a dark poet and the mind of a criminal genius . Her duty was to expand the guild ' s activity on the Sword Coast North .

title: Nulathoe ' s ninemen
description: Nulathoe ' s ninemen Nulathoe ' s ninemen ( pronounced " nin " - em - en ) , was a rare necromancy spell that preserved a dead body from decay . Effects . This spell halted the decay and rot of corpses for burial preservation or for a possible candidate of " raise dead " or " resurrection " spells .
description_long: Nulathoe ' s ninemen Nulathoe ' s ninemen ( pronounced " nin " - em - en ) , was a rare necromancy spell that preserved a dead body from decay . Effects . This spell halted the decay and rot of corpses for burial preservation or for a possible candidate of " raise dead " or " resurrection " spells . Any corpse treated with this spell could not become undead nor be affected by " animate dead " . This spell did not heal wounds , stop the loss of blood , or reverse any damage to the corpse , but it did keep joints strong and supple and muscles from contracting " rigor mortis " . This spell had no effect on the undead . Components . In addition to a verbal component , the caster had to touch the corpse to complete the spell . Materials required were a small amount of blood from a creature of the same race or species as the corpse and a moonstone worth at least 50 gp ground to a powder . The blood was sprinkled over the head , neck , torso and joints , then the moonstone dust was sprinkled over the whole body . History . " Nulathoe ' s ninemen " was one of the spells found in " Nchaser ' s Eiyromancia " , which the wizard Nchaser gave to the High Captain Taerl of Luskan .

title: Nuldrevyn Talendar
description: Nuldrevyn Talendar Nuldrevyn Talendar was the patriarch of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . Relationships . In youth , Nuldrevyn was always in the company of his brother Marance Talendar .
description_long: Nuldrevyn Talendar Nuldrevyn Talendar was the patriarch of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . Relationships . In youth , Nuldrevyn was always in the company of his brother Marance Talendar . History . Nuldrevyn with Marance fought orc s , brigands , and pirates and rival houses around 1250 DR . The House ' s rivalries led to a clandestine war with Thamalon Uskevren . However , Thamalon killed Marance and Nuldrevyn remained shocked . In time , he became a frail old man , always cautious and conservative in the family ' s businesses but never forgotten . When Marance came back from the Nine Hells in 1372 DR , Nuldrevyn gave his blessing to his vengeance against the Uskevren . Personality . Nuldrevyn was an old codger on the surface but deep inside was a ruthless individual to protect his family . He was proud of his many children , grandchildren , nieces , and nephews , in particular his son Ossian Talendar . Secretly he greatly feared snakes .

title: Null
description: Null Null ( pronounced " NUL " ) was the dragon god of death and undeath with two aspects , The Reaver and the Guardian of the Lost . As the Reaver , he was worshiped by evil dragons and took lives , blessing those who served him in this capacity . As the Guardian , he ferried the souls of dead dragons to Dragon Eyrie and ensured they were no longer troubled by the enemies they may have had in life .
description_long: Null Null ( pronounced " NUL " ) was the dragon god of death and undeath with two aspects , The Reaver and the Guardian of the Lost . As the Reaver , he was worshiped by evil dragons and took lives , blessing those who served him in this capacity . As the Guardian , he ferried the souls of dead dragons to Dragon Eyrie and ensured they were no longer troubled by the enemies they may have had in life . The Guardian of the Lost was known as Chronepsis on other worlds and planes , while the Reaver was known as Faluzure . Description . Whichever role he was in at the time , he appeared as an impenetrable region of blackness in the shape of a dragon . Legend also had it that to touch him was to instantly die . He was said to speak with the dusty croak of the undead . Realm . As a greater deity whose portfolio included the death of dragons , Null ' s realm in Dragon Eyrie was on the peak of the plane and no other draconic god contested that territory . He also had mausoleums in the Plane of Shadow , in Carceri , and in the Outlands . Personality . He was arrogant , fatalistic , proud , and totally lacking in any sense of humor .

title: Numbers sphere
description: Numbers sphere The Numbers sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s . These spells revealed the mathematical underpinnings to many aspects of reality and allowed understanding and manipulation of events in unexpected ways . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .
description_long: Numbers sphere The Numbers sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s . These spells revealed the mathematical underpinnings to many aspects of reality and allowed understanding and manipulation of events in unexpected ways . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Numbers Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Nun
description: Nun Nun was a small village on the Vilhon Reach filled with priests . History . Nun rested on the site of the Battle of Nun ( part of the Rotting War conflict of 902 DR .
description_long: Nun Nun was a small village on the Vilhon Reach filled with priests . History . Nun rested on the site of the Battle of Nun ( part of the Rotting War conflict of 902 DR . As of 1357 DR , Nun was occasionally raided by an orc tribe named the Flaming Spike . The tribe lived in an ancient dwarven hold in the Akanapeaks . Religion . Nun was often refereed to as a shrine rather than a village because the majority of its inhabitants were priest s . Although Nun was filled with followers of numerous faiths , Tempus was the most prominent . There were also notable shrines to Silvanus and Tyr . Politics . Nun was a peaceful village and avoided getting involved in the politics of its region . Despite this , Nun did have a loose alliance with Reth and Hlath to safeguard it from attack from the sea .

title: Nunchaku
description: Nunchaku The nunchaku is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The nunchaku is made of two hardwood wands or dowels connected at one end by a leather thong or short length of chain .
description_long: Nunchaku The nunchaku is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The nunchaku is made of two hardwood wands or dowels connected at one end by a leather thong or short length of chain . The dowels are slightly tapered toward the chained end . An average set of nunchaku cost 2gp and weigh 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . It takes special training to use nunchaku effectively in melee combat , therefore it is considered an exotic weapon . The taper of the dowels improves grip and increases the weight of the free - swinging ends . Nunchaku can be used to disarm an opponent much like the flail . Unarmored monk s can take full advantage of this quick , bludgeoning weapon .

title: Nune
description: Nune Nune was the common name for ( sometimes called " cross stone " or " fairy stone " ) in the Realms . Description . These ornamental stones were translucent brown or nearly clear and occurred in small cross - shaped crystals up to one inch ( two and a half centimeters ) across either arm .
description_long: Nune Nune was the common name for ( sometimes called " cross stone " or " fairy stone " ) in the Realms . Description . These ornamental stones were translucent brown or nearly clear and occurred in small cross - shaped crystals up to one inch ( two and a half centimeters ) across either arm . These were commonly polished to a smooth sheen and pierced to be worn as pendants or linked as bracelets . On Toril , the cross was used as an ornament and not as a holy symbol . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Nune stone powder was an essential ingredient of the ink used to scribe " dispel magic " scrolls and it was added to the immersion treatment when preparing to enchant a " wand of negation " .

title: Nung Chiang
description: Nung Chiang Nung Chiang ( pronounced " nung chee - ang " ) , called the Teacher of the Plow or the Master of the Red Earth , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of agriculture and fertility . As one of the Nine Immortals , Nung Chiang also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers .
description_long: Nung Chiang Nung Chiang ( pronounced " nung chee - ang " ) , called the Teacher of the Plow or the Master of the Red Earth , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of agriculture and fertility . As one of the Nine Immortals , Nung Chiang also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers . History . The immortal . According to the legendary history of Kara - Tur , shortly after the beginning of the world and human kind , the Celestial Emperor sent his great emissaries among the people , with each to teach one aspect of the True Path of Enlightenment . Nung Chiang was one of these emissaries . In the legend , nine tired travelers stopped at a poor remote inn in the dead of winter , and the innkeeper lamented he had no more food to spare . So , despite their tiredness , four went to hunt for game , four went to forage , and the last cooked a meal for the travelers , the innkeeper , and his family . Afterward , they preserved the remainder of the food to see the folk through the rest of winter .

title: Nunwood
description: Nunwood The Nunwood was a forest on the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . The nearby cities of Reth and Hlath used the Nunwood as their main source of lumber . In 1372 DR , Hlath ' s main export was Nunwood lumber .
description_long: Nunwood The Nunwood was a forest on the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . The nearby cities of Reth and Hlath used the Nunwood as their main source of lumber . In 1372 DR , Hlath ' s main export was Nunwood lumber . History . For a while around 1370 DR , Reth stopped cutting down trees from the Nunwood because of a conflict with the Emerald Enclave . When the lumberjacks eventually returned to the Nunwood , they were confronted by creatures using hit - and - run tactics during the night . Inhabitants . Snakes that spat a blinding venom were common in the Nunwood . As of 1357 DR a tribe of hybsil s called the Autunuk were also known to live in the Nunwood .

title: Nur al - Zahir
description: Nur al - Zahir Calipha Nur al - Zahir was a member of the prominent House of Zahir in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Relationships . Nur was the mother of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir and married to his father Achmed Al - Assad .
description_long: Nur al - Zahir Calipha Nur al - Zahir was a member of the prominent House of Zahir in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Relationships . Nur was the mother of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir and married to his father Achmed Al - Assad . She was also the sister of Rahmah .

title: Nura al - Hamiir
description: Nura al - Hamiir Nura al - Hamiir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Nura possessed a sharp wit and keen eye , earning her a notorious reputation for being able to single - out smugglers among the throngs of people who passed through the Pilgrims ' Gate .
description_long: Nura al - Hamiir Nura al - Hamiir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Nura possessed a sharp wit and keen eye , earning her a notorious reputation for being able to single - out smugglers among the throngs of people who passed through the Pilgrims ' Gate . Activities . Nura was the captain of the Pilgrim ' s Gate in Huzuz . She enjoyed her job and excelled at it , often taking the time to personally welcome visitors into the City of Delights .

title: Nura al - Kosiri
description: Nura al - Kosiri Nura al - Kosiri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nura led a group of followers who believed that Imam Jomhur needed to step down from his duties as High Priest .
description_long: Nura al - Kosiri Nura al - Kosiri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nura led a group of followers who believed that Imam Jomhur needed to step down from his duties as High Priest .

title: Nureh el Pesarkhal
description: Nureh el Pesarkhal Nureh yr Catahra el Pesarkhal , an exceptional spymaster of the Memnon underworld , was the wife of the crime lord Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and sister - in - law to the syl - pasha in 1370 DR . Description . She was a beautiful half - elven woman with jet black hair .
description_long: Nureh el Pesarkhal Nureh yr Catahra el Pesarkhal , an exceptional spymaster of the Memnon underworld , was the wife of the crime lord Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and sister - in - law to the syl - pasha in 1370 DR . Description . She was a beautiful half - elven woman with jet black hair . Personality . Nureh utilized many guises — bard , barmaid , and jhasina to name a few — and many agents . The syl - pasha considered her the most skilled spymaster he had ever known .

title: Nuri al - Zaratani
description: Nuri al - Zaratani Nuri al - Zaratani was an amiq rasol living on a zaratan in the waters of the Great Sea near the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Description . Nuri was 6 ft .
description_long: Nuri al - Zaratani Nuri al - Zaratani was an amiq rasol living on a zaratan in the waters of the Great Sea near the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Description . Nuri was 6 ft . ( 1 . 8 m ) tall . Activities . Nuri was the self - proclaimed Caliph of an island formed from the exposed shell of a floating zaratan . He defended his claims against sahuagin living in the area .

title: Nurih al Suhal
description: Nurih al Suhal Nurih yr Catahra al Suhal was a moneylender in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Nurih was married to Fahid yn Nur al Suhal , a cowardly moneylender .
description_long: Nurih al Suhal Nurih yr Catahra al Suhal was a moneylender in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Nurih was married to Fahid yn Nur al Suhal , a cowardly moneylender . Fahid inherited the business from his brother but the former lacked business sense . On the contrary , Nurih was very gifted at this job , and soon she was in charge of all save the name . In 1364 DR , profiting in the central mercantile hub of Teshburl , Nurih joined the Rundeen . She often acted for them to exchange large sums of foreign moneys into Calimshan ' s currencies , which was considered less dangerous there in Teshburl than in Calimport . Her younger sister Melek was also married to Roffas Calindor , a Tethyrian Knight of the Shield .

title: Nurissa Vyllshan
description: Nurissa Vyllshan Nurissa Vyllshan was a female drow illusionist and shadow adept and the leader of the School of the Shadow Weave in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . She petitioned the Conclave of Sshamath to have a position on the conclave as leader of the shadow adepts . However , the Conclave denied them for fear of losing political influence by adding another member to the conclave , and because they distrusted the shadow adepts , many of whom worshiped Shar .
description_long: Nurissa Vyllshan Nurissa Vyllshan was a female drow illusionist and shadow adept and the leader of the School of the Shadow Weave in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . She petitioned the Conclave of Sshamath to have a position on the conclave as leader of the shadow adepts . However , the Conclave denied them for fear of losing political influence by adding another member to the conclave , and because they distrusted the shadow adepts , many of whom worshiped Shar . However , the Conclave could not deny their arcane power , and would prefer to keep the mages in view than in the shadows .

title: Nurr ' Korzahg
description: Nurr ' Korzahg Nurr ' Korzahg was an illithid of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1372 DR . Personality . A close meeting with death shook Nurr ' Korzahg deeply .
description_long: Nurr ' Korzahg Nurr ' Korzahg was an illithid of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1372 DR . Personality . A close meeting with death shook Nurr ' Korzahg deeply . It started considering if one could live without subjugating inferior beings and eating their brains . Nurr ' Korzahg thought about helping non - illithids , just to see what would happen in such occasions . History . At one point , Nurr ' korzahg contracted a rotting illness that threatened its life . He ultimately survived , only losing three tentacles to amputation .

title: Nurthel Floshin
description: Nurthel Floshin Nurthel Floshin was a fey ' ri who served the daemonfey leader Sarya Dlardrageth as her spymaster . Description . Nurthel had only one eye , and it was green .
description_long: Nurthel Floshin Nurthel Floshin was a fey ' ri who served the daemonfey leader Sarya Dlardrageth as her spymaster . Description . Nurthel had only one eye , and it was green . He wore an eyepatch over the other eye - socket , which was filled with a green gem able to assist with his spellcasting . Equipment . Nurthel wore golden mail . He carried an iron short sword inscribed with runes . History . In 1374 DR , he was responsible for stealing a shard of the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " from Tower Reilloch . He Nurthel was killed on Tarsakh 11 , 1374 DR , in a white tower in the Elven Court area of the forest of Cormanthor when Araevin Teshurr used the magic he had learned from the " Nightstar " to invert Nurthel ' s magical protections . Araevin stabbed Nurthel through the throat with his own sword , stating that his death was a revenge for the killing of Grayth Holmfast .

title: Nurvureem
description: Nurvureem Nurvureem was a " draa ' zekyl " shadow dragon with a fell reputation among the inhabitants of the Dessarin River Valley . She maintained several different lairs , though she favored Rundreth Manor . Biography .
description_long: Nurvureem Nurvureem was a " draa ' zekyl " shadow dragon with a fell reputation among the inhabitants of the Dessarin River Valley . She maintained several different lairs , though she favored Rundreth Manor . Biography . Nurvureem was born in 1241 DR shortly after her mother was captured by the malaugrym . Nurvureem was the daughter of Mauzzkyl Jaezred , the Patron Grandfather of the Jaezred Chaulssin but she was lost when the kidnappers were killed by Jaezred Chaulssin assassin s . Nurvureem was not noted in history again until 1304 DR when she was discovered roaming the lands southeast of Triboar between there and the borders of the High Forest . She slew at least three other dragon s and many more wyvern s before she was discovered by the Jaezred Chaulssin in 1358 DR . The drow let her be , content to observe her until they detected a threat or the possibility of their history being exposed through her . In 1373 DR , Nurvureem succumbed to the Rage of Dragons , killing several dragon cultists who had come to try and transform her into a dracolich before destroying the village of Uluvin .

title: Nushala Le ' Quella
description: Nushala Le ' Quella Nushala Le ' Quella was an elf jeweler who lived in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She created jewellery and works of art , and once spent 18 months on a single piece for Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . As of 1368 DR , she was over 600 years old and was held in much respect in the elven community .
description_long: Nushala Le ' Quella Nushala Le ' Quella was an elf jeweler who lived in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She created jewellery and works of art , and once spent 18 months on a single piece for Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . As of 1368 DR , she was over 600 years old and was held in much respect in the elven community .

title: Nuska Ohm Wy
description: Nuska Ohm Wy Nuska Ohm Wy was the a Hengeyokai in Henai River in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Nuska was well known in area from Henai river to Zun Hi for his small thefts and his pranks .
description_long: Nuska Ohm Wy Nuska Ohm Wy was the a Hengeyokai in Henai River in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Nuska was well known in area from Henai river to Zun Hi for his small thefts and his pranks . Usually he try to joined caravans or travelers on the Broken Road and duped them into believing he is just a fellow adventurer , after he stole everyone s clothes while they slept , or poked slow leaks in boats or rafts . Personality . Nuska was not evil , just devious sometimes . He never caused death , just maximum embarrassment . Nuska just loved making fools of humans . The local peasants had a saying , that " You ' ve met Nuska " when a situation was very awkward .

title: Nusrah bin Kerim
description: Nusrah bin Kerim Nusrah bin Kerim was a the leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Decription . Nusrah ' s skin was dark brown .
description_long: Nusrah bin Kerim Nusrah bin Kerim was a the leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Decription . Nusrah ' s skin was dark brown . He had curly gray hair that was thinning . All of his teeth were decayed . Nusrah wore a tiny beard that all of the male followers within the Winged Bulls imitated to make their allegiance clear . Nusrah was an overweight fellow . Activities . Nusrah was merely the puppet of the true leader of the Winged Bulls , Aida al - Irrahman . Relationships . Nusrah was the grand nephew of the Shadow Caliph .

title: Nut cheese
description: Nut cheese Nut cheese was a type of cheese mixed with nuts produced in many cities of the Savage Frontier , including Silverymoon , Mirabar , and Sundabar . A selection was available from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Nut cheese Nut cheese was a type of cheese mixed with nuts produced in many cities of the Savage Frontier , including Silverymoon , Mirabar , and Sundabar . A selection was available from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Each North ern city produced its own variety of nut cheese . If ordered from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue without specifying a desired origin , a customer would receive an assorted lot . Nut cheeses were hard and rich , and mixed with ground hickory nuts , walnuts , and chestnuts . Once mixed with the nuts , the cheeses would be left to ripen .

title: Nuth Harandal
description: Nuth Harandal Nuth Harandal was the leader of the Storm Rune , a guild of merchants and landlords in Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Personality . Nuth was considered a wily and calculating person .
description_long: Nuth Harandal Nuth Harandal was the leader of the Storm Rune , a guild of merchants and landlords in Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Personality . Nuth was considered a wily and calculating person . Background . Nuth was a poisoner and a merchant who used the Storm Rune to increase his own status and wealth in Eskornar society .

title: Nuyen Phi
description: Nuyen Phi Nuyen Phi was the prince of Sayan in Malatra . Personality . Phi believed himself a great general .
description_long: Nuyen Phi Nuyen Phi was the prince of Sayan in Malatra . Personality . Phi believed himself a great general . He was an able speaker . Phi was an arrogant and supremely self - confident individual . History . Around 1357 DR , Phi was the leading member of the Huyen House of Laothan , which controlled most of the military and the lands from the T ' u Lung borders to Nalamh . Phi usually ignored the edicts of King Thok Lian .

title: Nycaloth
description: Nycaloth Nycaloths , later known as nycademons , are the elite cavalry in yugoloth armies , swooping down onto enemy flanks and tearing up unsuspecting troops . These arrogant , green - skinned creatures are eight feet ( 240 centimeters ) tall and possess four muscular arms , a doglike head and a pair of vast , bat - like wings . Nycaloth commanders are larger than their fellows , and lead entire battalions into war .
description_long: Nycaloth Nycaloths , later known as nycademons , are the elite cavalry in yugoloth armies , swooping down onto enemy flanks and tearing up unsuspecting troops . These arrogant , green - skinned creatures are eight feet ( 240 centimeters ) tall and possess four muscular arms , a doglike head and a pair of vast , bat - like wings . Nycaloth commanders are larger than their fellows , and lead entire battalions into war . Nycaloths communicate using telepathy . Combat . Nycaloths most commonly use weapons . They are fond of giant two - headed axes . These axes are very commonly enchanted , with 90 % being magical in nature . Enchantment spells will never affect them . Habitat . Despite the fact that nycaloths are possibly the most powerful of the greater yugoloths ( daemons ) , they are afforded the least status . They always act in a careful and calculating manner . They have the innate ability to travel to any of the lower planes at will . They commonly travel to Nine Hells and the Abyss in order to scout the Blood War . They are bitter of the status of the other greater yugoloths . They are constantly planning and scheming to increase their status among yugoloths .

title: Nydyaa Ealoeth
description: Nydyaa Ealoeth Nydyaa Ealoeth was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Nydyaa ' s consort was Myrlaer Ealoeth .
description_long: Nydyaa Ealoeth Nydyaa Ealoeth was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Nydyaa ' s consort was Myrlaer Ealoeth . Activities . Nydyaa was the lord and matriarch of House Ealoth . She was in charge of internal security , scrying in search of traitors or infiltrators . She reported to Baron Xhalth , despite the fact that she hated his stupidity .

title: Nyerhite Verther
description: Nyerhite Verther Nyerhite Verther was a Calishite silk merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was not a scrupulous individual .
description_long: Nyerhite Verther Nyerhite Verther was a Calishite silk merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was not a scrupulous individual . When unhinged , he exploded in anger and fury . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR , Nyerhite traveled to Waterdeep with a load of Calishite silk , which unknown to him was infested with worms . Unsuspectingly , he journeyed in a great caravan full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures to help bring Tiamat into Toril from the Abyss .

title: Nyh Ilmichh
description: Nyh Ilmichh Nyh Ilmichh was an envoy of the Red Wizards of Thay sent by Szass Tam to propose an alliance between Thay and the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . One day , Nyh Illichh , under orders from his master , approached the Council of Lords of Waterdeep with the purpose of setting up a meeting between Thay and the Council in the hope they could help each other against the rising menace of Tiamat and the Cult of the dragon .
description_long: Nyh Ilmichh Nyh Ilmichh was an envoy of the Red Wizards of Thay sent by Szass Tam to propose an alliance between Thay and the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . One day , Nyh Illichh , under orders from his master , approached the Council of Lords of Waterdeep with the purpose of setting up a meeting between Thay and the Council in the hope they could help each other against the rising menace of Tiamat and the Cult of the dragon . Eventually the Council sent a band of adventurers to speak with Nyh at his residence at the Thayan embassy in Waterdeep . Nyh explained that they needed to meet the tharchion Eseldra Yeth , but this was possible only in her residence in Thay .

title: Nyk
description: Nyk Nyk was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nok . Nyk and Nok were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms .
description_long: Nyk Nyk was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nok . Nyk and Nok were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms . They would tell stories about failed rescue attempts for a copper piece .

title: Nylaersyn Floshin
description: Nylaersyn Floshin Nylaersyn Floshin was a member of House Dlardrageth that infiltrated the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . History . Nylaersyn was a fey ' ri member of House Dlardrageth .
description_long: Nylaersyn Floshin Nylaersyn Floshin was a member of House Dlardrageth that infiltrated the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . History . Nylaersyn was a fey ' ri member of House Dlardrageth . Some time before 1372 DR she posed as a doppelganger named Synyl and managed to infiltrate the Unseen , a spy network in Waterdeep . Alias . Nylaersyn as Synyl was known to have posed as these individuals :

title: Nym
description: Nym Nym was the aged proprietor of The Jewel Box in Menzoberranzan . Activities . He was a retired battle wizard and at some point in his past lost one of his legs and didn ' t get it magically replaced .
description_long: Nym Nym was the aged proprietor of The Jewel Box in Menzoberranzan . Activities . He was a retired battle wizard and at some point in his past lost one of his legs and didn ' t get it magically replaced . It was suspected that he paid a large amount of his profits to the Ruling Council of the city in order for the more blasphemous of the seedier elements of his business to be allowed to pass .

title: Nym ( Icewind Dale )
description: Nym ( Icewind Dale ) Nym is an unscrupulous drow trader who appears in both Icewind Dale and Icewind Dale II . He often sells some of the best items in both games . Nym indirectly caused the fall of both the Fortress of the Severed Hand and Dorn ' s Deep by stealing the elven and dwarven magical items from Dorn ' s Deep and then selling them to the goblinoid armies that proceeded to sack them both .
description_long: Nym ( Icewind Dale ) Nym is an unscrupulous drow trader who appears in both Icewind Dale and Icewind Dale II . He often sells some of the best items in both games . Nym indirectly caused the fall of both the Fortress of the Severed Hand and Dorn ' s Deep by stealing the elven and dwarven magical items from Dorn ' s Deep and then selling them to the goblinoid armies that proceeded to sack them both . The elves of the Severed Hand blamed the Dwarves of Dorn ' s Deep for the fact that the goblinoids had the items , since they were all from Dorn ' s Deep ' s treasury and haughtily ignored the Dwarves pleas of innocence . Divided , the two realms both fell to their respective goblinoid assaults and caused the bitterness between the elves and dwarves of the Spine of the World and Frozenfar that exists to this day . That such an act could cause such far - reaching devastation speaks nothing of the drow ' s utter lack of moral fibre . Nym is not above haggling , though usually only when faced with the prospect of being attacked by powerful and wealthy adventurers who would not only cost him business , but also possibly his life .

title: Nym ( monk )
description: Nym ( monk ) Nym was a monk of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Nym was born and raised at the monastery .
description_long: Nym ( monk ) Nym was a monk of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Nym was born and raised at the monastery . However , he left in order to do good in the name of Ilmater in the outside world . Instead he went mad . Circa 1489 DR , he went back at the monastery and soon rose through its rank . Inside the monastery , Nym found an elemental node , and at the same time he was approached by the Cult of the Howling Hatred and he joined them . Nym helped the cultists to infiltrate the monastery in 1491 DR . Personality . Nym had become mad in the outside world . He had hoped to cure himself by coming back to the monastery , but this had not worked . Thus his hatred grew to the point that he wanted to destroy the world and for this reason he joined the cultists . However , he was resentful of the scarce consideration he received from the cultist leader Bloodwind and deep in his heart Nym hoped that their ritual would fail spectacularly . Activities . Nym was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , and a member of the Order of the Scroll of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . His duty was as Master Teacher .

title: Nym ( storm giant )
description: Nym ( storm giant ) Nym was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Nym was the middle daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Nym ( storm giant ) Nym was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Nym was the middle daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In opposite to her mothers and her youngest sister Serissa Nym and her older sister Mirran had an evil hearth but Hekaton knowing this appointed Serissa as his heir . Mirran and Nym were greatly angered incorrectly blaming their mother Neri for this decision but no act until at the giants ' court arrived Iymrith , disguised as a giant lady . With Iymrith ' s help in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR the two storm giants princesses plotted the assassination of their mother and the kidnapping of their father . Mirran and Nym were entrained several giants ambassadors arrived in search of news about princess Serissa ' s plans for the future . Personality . Nym was a cold and calculating individual . As middle daughter she felt always to be ignored by her parents , too busy with her sisters . In truth Hekaton and Neri found Nym distant and difficult to please .

title: Nym Mlezziir
description: Nym Mlezziir Nym Mlezziir was the Battlemaster of the Eastern Marches in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Nym was one of the primary military commanders of the city , assigned to supervising the patrols in the tunnels and the caverns that included the Gauth Grottoes and the ruins of Oghrann . He was renowned for fighting with dwarves and nighteyes and it was said that he had slain at least two gauth alone .
description_long: Nym Mlezziir Nym Mlezziir was the Battlemaster of the Eastern Marches in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Nym was one of the primary military commanders of the city , assigned to supervising the patrols in the tunnels and the caverns that included the Gauth Grottoes and the ruins of Oghrann . He was renowned for fighting with dwarves and nighteyes and it was said that he had slain at least two gauth alone .

title: Nym Nindar
description: Nym Nindar Nym Nindar , nicknamed " Slowtooth " , was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and operated Slowtooth Weaponry . History .
description_long: Nym Nindar Nym Nindar , nicknamed " Slowtooth " , was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and operated Slowtooth Weaponry . History . Nym Nindar was once an officer in the Purple Dragons , before he retired . He was running his weapons shop by 1358 DR , and was still in business through 1369 DR and in 1374 DR . He was an old man in 1369 DR . Activities . Apart from running Slowtooth Weaponry , and when not otherwise busy , Nindar had a side - business instructing other warriors and young folk in how to wield specific weapons , and in their proper maintenance . His store was popular with mercenaries , adventurer s , and perhaps even brigand s , who often hung around to watch Nindar train his students . They often shared tales of their exploits , and drank Nindar ' s mulled cider . Abilities . Nindar was skilled with many kinds of weapons and could teach them all , though his specialty was the throwing axe . He made axe - throwing his personal sport . He particularly enjoyed demonstrating how a " biter " could go through a design of light shield commonly used around the Inner Sea .

title: Nymara Scheiron
description: Nymara Scheiron Nymara Scheiron , more commonly known as Kitten , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Few people knew her full name . Description .
description_long: Nymara Scheiron Nymara Scheiron , more commonly known as Kitten , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Few people knew her full name . Description . Kitten had brown hair . Activities . Kitten often posed as a tavern dancer in the Dock Ward . She was an expert at following people . History . Kitten was recruited by Mirt and Durnan in the 1340s DR . Residence . Kitten rarely stayed in one place . She had a number of residences around the city . Relationships . Kitten was one of the " Like - Minded Lords " in 1364 DR ( the others were Mirt , Khelben , Durnan , Larissa , and Brian ) , who frequently met up to enjoy each other ' s company .

title: Nymarrath
description: Nymarrath Nymarrath was an aged druid living in Elventree . Activities . Nymarrath took care of the Silver Shadow Cave in Elventree .
description_long: Nymarrath Nymarrath was an aged druid living in Elventree . Activities . Nymarrath took care of the Silver Shadow Cave in Elventree . Relationships . Nymarrath had good dealings with the drow wizard Murssvayas Dhuurniv of Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons , Nymarrath supported Murssvayas in his effort to depose the fire giant s of Maerimydra .

title: Nymbrar Shatterslee
description: Nymbrar Shatterslee Nymbrar " Nighteye " Shatterslee was a traveling minstrel responsible for the composition and performance of " Crying To My Harp " , a collection of satirical ballads criticizing the Waterdhavian nobility that proved to be extremely successful when performed in Waterdeep . After enraging the targets of the criticism and attracting the attention of thugs , Nymbrar left the city .
description_long: Nymbrar Shatterslee Nymbrar " Nighteye " Shatterslee was a traveling minstrel responsible for the composition and performance of " Crying To My Harp " , a collection of satirical ballads criticizing the Waterdhavian nobility that proved to be extremely successful when performed in Waterdeep . After enraging the targets of the criticism and attracting the attention of thugs , Nymbrar left the city .

title: Nymia Focar
description: Nymia Focar Nymia Focar was a fighter and tharchion of Pyarados of Thay . Description . Nymia was handsome with a wide , sensuous mouth .
description_long: Nymia Focar Nymia Focar was a fighter and tharchion of Pyarados of Thay . Description . Nymia was handsome with a wide , sensuous mouth . She had several silver rings in each ear and a stud in the left side of her nose . . Personality . Nymia was often friendly and informal with her underlings , sometimes even took them to her bed . However , she could turn into a ferocious disciplinarian when encountering a setback , sometimes even flogging soldiers who had played no part in whatever had gone amiss - often her former lovers were the ones who wound up tied to the whipping post . History . Nymia played a great role during the war of the zulkirs as one of the highest - ranked commanders of the allied forces .

title: Nymmestra Durothil
description: Nymmestra Durothil Nymmestra Durothil , or Nym , was a gold elf born of House Durothil of Evermeet . Her affinity for magic led her to study at the Tower of the Sun and the Tower of the Moon . However , she had mischievous and a wild side that got her into a great deal of trouble .
description_long: Nymmestra Durothil Nymmestra Durothil , or Nym , was a gold elf born of House Durothil of Evermeet . Her affinity for magic led her to study at the Tower of the Sun and the Tower of the Moon . However , she had mischievous and a wild side that got her into a great deal of trouble . She was able to overcome these destructive tendencies , only after being banished from her home in Evermeet and stripped of her magic in Silverymoon . History . Nymmestra Durothil hailed from a life of privilege and power , but had little respect for how she had got there . An embarrassment to her family , Nym was someone who only partied and got into fights , inadvertently making enemies for her house through crude actions . The final straw came after she seriously hurt another elf in a mage ' s duel . She had chosen to visit the city of Taltempla on Evermeet . She became roaring drunk on evermead and challenged three other wizards to a duel , all at the same time . Although drunk , Nym beat them all soundly , seriously injuring one of them almost to the point of death . The leaders of Evermeet banished Nym to the Sword Coast for this act of uncaring harm she had inflicted .

title: Nymmurh
description: Nymmurh Nymmurh was a bronze dragon summoned to the metallic dragon ' s council to discuss of the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Nymmurh was granitic in his beliefs that humanity were better than metallic dragons .
description_long: Nymmurh Nymmurh was a bronze dragon summoned to the metallic dragon ' s council to discuss of the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Nymmurh was granitic in his beliefs that humanity were better than metallic dragons . His thinking was simple : metallic dragons were created by Bahamut to do good and they must not turn away from that , but lesser species could freely choose to be good . He looked to the Harpers and the Order of the Gauntlet as two examples of his theory . History . For a long time , Nymmurh protected the noble Waterdeep family of Silmerhelve , to the point that he showed affection to members of the family , as exemplified by Dala Silmerhelve . He apparently chose the Silmerhelve family at random in 1032 DR and over time Nymmurh manipulated the family ' s members into being kinder , gentler , and slower to act . Sometimes he appeared in front of Silmerhelve members , usually once a generation , as a long - dead ancestor returned from the grave ( usually as the mad Lady Saerista Silmerhelve .

title: Nymph
description: Nymph Nymphs were fey that typically resembled Tel - quessir women , not just physically beautiful , but literally blindingly so . They usually dwelt in forests , streams , waterfalls , or coves . They were the guardians and protectors of these and the portals to the faerie realm .
description_long: Nymph Nymphs were fey that typically resembled Tel - quessir women , not just physically beautiful , but literally blindingly so . They usually dwelt in forests , streams , waterfalls , or coves . They were the guardians and protectors of these and the portals to the faerie realm . It was said that their beauty could lead anyone who gazed upon them to either blindness , madness , or even death . However , they could suppress this ability if they wished . They absolutely hated anything that was either evil or ugly . Their queen was more powerful than their king . They had the ability to wield the power of nature . They celebrated many different festivals . They tended to live near hollow hills . They were immortal . Appearance . They were very similar to wood elves in most cases ; for instance , they had markedly pointed ears . Nymphs were always female , possessing incredible beauty that was dangerous to behold . As such , they were the frequent target of satyr s and lecherous human males .

title: Nyo - ko
description: Nyo - ko Nyo - ko was the third wife of Funada Mitsuhide , daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nyo - ko born as daughter of a daimyo and her parents had gone to great trouble to teach her refined graces .
description_long: Nyo - ko Nyo - ko was the third wife of Funada Mitsuhide , daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nyo - ko born as daughter of a daimyo and her parents had gone to great trouble to teach her refined graces . In 1357 the shogun Matasuuri Nagahide planned her marriage with Funada Mitsuhide of far Nakamaru to solidify the relations between the shogun ’ s extended family and Nyo - ko ' s father . Nyo - ko however had become the target of an ikiryo . The ikiryo was unconsciously generated by the second wife of Mitsuhide Kei - ko Personality . Nyo - ko was a demure and delicate girl , totally capturing the heart of her husband , Lord Mitsuhide , for the moment . She was skilled in singing and poetry .

title: Nyphithys
description: Nyphithys Nyphithys was an erinyes servant of the lich Arklem Greeth . History . Meeting Arklem Greeth .
description_long: Nyphithys Nyphithys was an erinyes servant of the lich Arklem Greeth . History . Meeting Arklem Greeth . Nyphithys first visited Arklem Greeth in 1371 DR , after the Archmage Arcane had fled the Host Tower of the Arcane and hid in Mirabar following an attempt on his life . It was while the Archmage was wounded and contemplating his fate that she played to her strengths , using Arklem ' s frailty of body and spirit to seduce him with her charms . By the time he revealed to her his desire for lichdom , he was already willing to be her partner . Helping him to gather the necessary ingredients and knowledge , she guided his transformation into a lich . Together , they returned to Luskan to kill those who had assaulted the Archmage and , with the help of Nyphithys ' devilish allies , purged the Arcane Brotherhood of all those Arklem did not consider loyal . Once the dust had settled and the rebuilding process was underway , Arklem honored the bargain with Nyphithys and agreed to redirect the Brotherhood ' s focus towards the newly established Silver Marches . Maugrim ' s takeover .

title: Nyraala golem
description: Nyraala golem A nyraala golem was a type of golem created by illithid s . It was a flailing , slimy , tentacled construct capable of launching surprise attacks . They often served as guards , and were prized because their creation did not involve petitioning the elder brain to surrender part of its mass .
description_long: Nyraala golem A nyraala golem was a type of golem created by illithid s . It was a flailing , slimy , tentacled construct capable of launching surprise attacks . They often served as guards , and were prized because their creation did not involve petitioning the elder brain to surrender part of its mass .

title: Nyssa Seebenstern
description: Nyssa Seebenstern Nyssa Seebenstern was a caravan leader in the Dalelands . Personality . Nyssa was full of enthusiasm and idealism .
description_long: Nyssa Seebenstern Nyssa Seebenstern was a caravan leader in the Dalelands . Personality . Nyssa was full of enthusiasm and idealism . History . Nyssa was a woman of Theskian ancestry . She was well known in the Dalelands for her caravans . In 1479 DR , while traveling with her caravan to Daggerdale , Nyssa was attacked by gnoll raiders .

title: Nyth
description: Nyth Nyth is a small city of 11 , 501 inhabitants ( as of 1372 DR ) in Thesk that relies on trade with its neighbouring settlements . It was once controlled by the independent city - state of Telflamm . History .
description_long: Nyth Nyth is a small city of 11 , 501 inhabitants ( as of 1372 DR ) in Thesk that relies on trade with its neighbouring settlements . It was once controlled by the independent city - state of Telflamm . History . Nyth takes its name from a will - o ' - wisp that used to haunt the village . In a battle that ended with the deaths of all involved , a cabal of wizards defeated the will - o ' - wisp and freed the city . As a result of this , wizards in Nyth are respected but considered to carry great misfortune .

title: Nyth ( creature )
description: Nyth ( creature ) Nyths are creatures very similar to will - o ' - wisp s and the two species can communicate and have been known to ally with each other . Nyths are often mistaken for wisps but some northern barbarian s can supposedly tell the two apart , naming nyths " wildfire " and thinking them to be evil spirits . Nyths have a slightly wider range of colouration than wisps .
description_long: Nyth ( creature ) Nyths are creatures very similar to will - o ' - wisp s and the two species can communicate and have been known to ally with each other . Nyths are often mistaken for wisps but some northern barbarian s can supposedly tell the two apart , naming nyths " wildfire " and thinking them to be evil spirits . Nyths have a slightly wider range of colouration than wisps . Nyths do not feed on negative emotions as wisps do but instead eat their prey like most predators . They have a natural ability to shoot " magic missile s " from their bodies and , while they can extinguish their glow like a wisp ( but only for a short time and not if they fire a " missile " which causes their body to glow even brighter ) , they prefer to hide in the light of the sun . Nyths reproduce by absorbing fire or lightning energy . Such energy heals a nyth and when a certain amount of that energy is absorbed , a nyth splits into two separate creatures . This process causes an explosion of light and sends a multitude of " magic missiles " flying in random directions .

title: Nytus the Shipwright
description: Nytus the Shipwright Nytus the Shipwright was a sailor who retired to become a shipwright in Velprintalar ( later Veltalar ) , Aglarond . He made a reputation for creating quality fishing vessels and large merchant ships that extended across the Sea of Fallen Stars . Other shipbuilders would approach him for advice or commissions .
description_long: Nytus the Shipwright Nytus the Shipwright was a sailor who retired to become a shipwright in Velprintalar ( later Veltalar ) , Aglarond . He made a reputation for creating quality fishing vessels and large merchant ships that extended across the Sea of Fallen Stars . Other shipbuilders would approach him for advice or commissions .

title: O - Cho
description: O - Cho O - Cho was the handmaiden of Sumi - ko in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . O - Cho started working for the Funada clan in 1347 DR .
description_long: O - Cho O - Cho was the handmaiden of Sumi - ko in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . O - Cho started working for the Funada clan in 1347 DR . O - Cho always supported her master , even during her illicit romance with Nagoya Kenko . However , she noticed that Kenko did not love Sumi - ko , so O - Cho told Funada Genzo about the matter and asking for help . Personality . O - Cho considered Sumi - ko to be like a little sister in need of protection and guidance . During family difficulties , she often secretly helped Sumi - ko from behind the scenes . Her devotion was noticed and she was considered a good and loyal servant .

title: O - Kaze
description: O - Kaze O - Kaze was a Phoenix clan ninja in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . During the plot of Goshukara Sadamoto to ruin peace talks between Funada Mitsuhide and the Big Head yakuza gang , O - Kaze was assigned by the Phoenix ninja to kill Jirozu no Nakamaru , framing Funada clan retainers in the process .
description_long: O - Kaze O - Kaze was a Phoenix clan ninja in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . During the plot of Goshukara Sadamoto to ruin peace talks between Funada Mitsuhide and the Big Head yakuza gang , O - Kaze was assigned by the Phoenix ninja to kill Jirozu no Nakamaru , framing Funada clan retainers in the process .

title: O - Shino
description: O - Shino O - Shino was a young maiden in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . O - Shino was an independent - minded young woman of modest means .
description_long: O - Shino O - Shino was a young maiden in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . O - Shino was an independent - minded young woman of modest means . She had no family and for money she did questionable things . History . O - Shino was hired by the korobokuru yakuza Ichi to seduce the monks Anchin and Kaian under the orders of monks of a rival sect , Kogi and Bupposo . Afterward , however , O - Shino came to regret her actions and wanted bloodless revenge against Kogi and Bupposo . Personality . O - Shino was always a modest and unassuming individual . For necessity , she would do dishonest things but always regretted it .

title: OA series
description: OA series The OA series was a series of seven 1st and 2nd edition Kara - Tur - based adventures published between 1986 and 1990 . OA1 to OA4 were not branded with the Forgotten Realms logo , but the wiki accepts them to be part of Forgotten Realms canon .
description_long: OA series The OA series was a series of seven 1st and 2nd edition Kara - Tur - based adventures published between 1986 and 1990 . OA1 to OA4 were not branded with the Forgotten Realms logo , but the wiki accepts them to be part of Forgotten Realms canon .

title: Oak
description: Oak The oak tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor , where they could grow up to 400 ' ( 122 m ) . Varieties . Chime .
description_long: Oak The oak tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor , where they could grow up to 400 ' ( 122 m ) . Varieties . Chime . Chime oaks were specific to the northern sections of the east starwood , a portion of the forest of Cormanthor . They were like regular oaks , but appeared as though they were made of glass . Their leaves froze easily in autumn and winter , and did not fall off the tree , instead making a tinkling noise in the wind , which gave the trees their name . This noise attracted basilisk s . Marsh oak grew in the Farsea Marshes and gall oak and black oak grew in the Vast Swamp . Uses . Oak wood was used for crafting countless items , such as strong doors and tables . Locations . Gnarled oaks grew around the fringe of the Vast Swamp . Notable oaks . The Sacred Oak was a highly respected ancient oak tree in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . The wood and wild elves believed that it was the first tree on Evermeet , while it was more generally believed that the tree came from Arvandor . A huge oak tree formed each of the four corners of the Elfstone Tavern in Waterdeep .

title: Oars to snakes
description: Oars to snakes Oars to snakes was a divine magic spell that could be used offensively or defensively , turning a ship ' s oars into large sea snake s . Effects . This spell was similar to " sticks to snakes " except it was specifically for use on oars , and created a few very large and tough sea serpents that remained in their oarlocks for the duration of the spell .
description_long: Oars to snakes Oars to snakes was a divine magic spell that could be used offensively or defensively , turning a ship ' s oars into large sea snake s . Effects . This spell was similar to " sticks to snakes " except it was specifically for use on oars , and created a few very large and tough sea serpents that remained in their oarlocks for the duration of the spell . " Oars to snakes " affected a minimum of three oars for at least a half hour , with more experienced druid s able to transform more oars for a longer period of time . Most often cast defensively , a ship ' s oars could be used to attack boarders . Each snake could engage one enemy at a time and fought with a devastating , poisonous bite . Casting " oars to snakes " offensively , it had a range of 150 ft ( 46 m ) and the snakes were oriented with their heads inside the ship to attack the rowers . While the oars were in snake form , they were useless for propelling a ship . If any snake was killed in combat , it reverted to a broken and unusable oar when the spell ended . Otherwise , the oars were restored to their original condition . Components .

title: Oasis of Solitude
description: Oasis of Solitude The Oasis of Solitude was located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Sitting between Zarif and the Al - Malih River , the Oasis of Solitude was one of the last sources of fresh water on the Ghost ' s Route to Halwa .
description_long: Oasis of Solitude The Oasis of Solitude was located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Sitting between Zarif and the Al - Malih River , the Oasis of Solitude was one of the last sources of fresh water on the Ghost ' s Route to Halwa . History . Caravans passing through the oasis typically filled any container that would hold water since they faced 200 miles ( 320 km ) of harsh terrain before the next available source of water .

title: Oasis of Vipers
description: Oasis of Vipers The Oasis of Vipers was an old , well - watered set of three pools in Anauroch that was mostly ignored by the Bedine . Geography . This oasis was located near the northernmost border of the Sword .
description_long: Oasis of Vipers The Oasis of Vipers was an old , well - watered set of three pools in Anauroch that was mostly ignored by the Bedine . Geography . This oasis was located near the northernmost border of the Sword . It consistent of three separate small pools . Flora and Fauna . The oasis had a large variety of plant life : s , s , and other small cacti ; , palm , and trees ; and . The vines formed a thick underbrush and webbing among the trees and concealed the bones of many dead creatures , including camels and human s . The oasis was home to hundreds of extremely poisonous serpents , which hunted each other and any life that attempted to drink water from any of the pools . Because of this , there was a complete absence of birds , lizards , or rodents common to other oases .

title: Oath of Devotion
description: Oath of Devotion The Oath of Devotion was one of the sacred vows that paladin s could choose to take when they reached a milestone in their journey of faith . When they dedicated themselves to the tenets of this oath , they also were granted access to a set of spells at no cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Oathbinder genie
description: Oathbinder genie Oathbinder genies were tasked genie s who were believed to be the descendants of a single efreeti . Their sole purpose was to maintain oaths sworn between their master and other beings . They punished any oathbreaker based on the terms of their vow .
description_long: Oathbinder genie Oathbinder genies were tasked genie s who were believed to be the descendants of a single efreeti . Their sole purpose was to maintain oaths sworn between their master and other beings . They punished any oathbreaker based on the terms of their vow . The creation of the first oathbinder genie could be traced back to an efreeti named Mulahid and his affections for the Grandmother of the Everlasting who used her beguiling charm to bind him into service . Description . The skin of oathbinder genies was glossy black , like obsidian . A glow of white fire enveloped their bodies at all times . Their eyes burned fiercely with purple fire . Combat . An oathbinder genie would only be seen when the terms of their contracts required them , usually when someone broke an oath . They magically arrived within minutes of a broken oath . These genies could attack with jets of white fire from their hands . Oathbinder genies were completely immune to any physical or magical attack from the creature who broke their oath . The spirit of an oathbreaker slain by an oathbinder genie was captured and held by the oathbinder for years at a time .

title: Oathbinding
description: Oathbinding Oathbinding was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Oathbinding Oathbinding was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell bound a subject to a predetermined vow or condition , and exacted a penalty for failing to uphold the vow . Though " oathbinding " was similar to the " genie contract " spell , but differed because only one party was the subject of the spell . It was commonly used by a more powerful patron on their subjects . This spell had a definite end and specific condition which would trigger the penalty for breaking the vow . The spell would only end when the vow was fulfilled . " Dispel magic " or " remove curse " spells had no effect upon this spell . Components . This spell only required verbal components to cast , but the caster did need to sacrifice at least 1 , 000 gold to seal the deal .

title: Obaleth
description: Obaleth Obaleth was a cheese with a strong flavor and sharp taste made locally to the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s and 70s DR . Locations . The Worried Wyvern inn in Sevenecho had Obaleth cheese for sale on its excellent menu .
description_long: Obaleth Obaleth was a cheese with a strong flavor and sharp taste made locally to the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s and 70s DR . Locations . The Worried Wyvern inn in Sevenecho had Obaleth cheese for sale on its excellent menu . Prices . It was priced at 1 gold piece per wheel , rather than the typical 4 silver pieces .

title: Obarskyr
description: Obarskyr Obarskyr was the royal house of Cormyr . History . The Obarskyr family originally rose to prominence in Impiltur as a mercenary company .
description_long: Obarskyr Obarskyr was the royal house of Cormyr . History . The Obarskyr family originally rose to prominence in Impiltur as a mercenary company . One member of the family , Ondeth , fleeing the political situation and plague in his homeland , took his wife and two sons to a forest to the west of Marsember known as the Wolf Woods in 6 DR and built a settlement . More men joined him and when the elves in the region realized they could not contain the growing number of human s invading the land they chose Ondeth to attempt to bring peace and slow down the settlement ' s expansion . When Ondeth died , his son Faerlthann became the first king of the realm that the elves and Ondeth had created . In 26 DR , Cormyr was born .

title: Obedient avalanche
description: Obedient avalanche Obedient avalanche , also known by many as Zajimarn ' s avalanche , was a conjuration spell of the creation subschool that called down an avalanche to bury one ' s foes . Effect . The spell opened a rift in midair , from which poured an avalanche of snow that engulfed everyone and everything beneath it and swept outwards from that location .
description_long: Obedient avalanche Obedient avalanche , also known by many as Zajimarn ' s avalanche , was a conjuration spell of the creation subschool that called down an avalanche to bury one ' s foes . Effect . The spell opened a rift in midair , from which poured an avalanche of snow that engulfed everyone and everything beneath it and swept outwards from that location . The avalanche crushed and froze those directly beneath it , and could even bury them in heavy snow . Further away , the impact was less , but the spreading snow shoved all aside and carried them along . The " obedient avalanche " also damaged buildings and other structures , uprooted small trees and lesser plants , and turned the ground into a trail of rubble in the snow ' s path . It also put out all fires , whether they were natural or magical in nature . Users . The " obedient avalanche " was formerly unique to cleric s with the Cold domain , but could also be learned by sorcerer s and wizard s . History . The spell was named for Zajimarn .

title: Oberon
description: Oberon Oberon was a wizard living in a tower in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . The wizard had many dealing with Pasha Pook of Calimport .
description_long: Oberon Oberon was a wizard living in a tower in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . The wizard had many dealing with Pasha Pook of Calimport . History . In 1356 DR , Pook ordered the pirate fleet of Pinochet to attack Captain Deudermont ' s " Sea Sprite " in order to stop the Companions of the Hall from arriving in Calimport . Pook questioned Oberon about his contact with Artemis Entreri .

title: Oboo
description: Oboo An oboo " ( pl . oboos ) " was an altar to the gods of sky and earth that could be found on the steppes of the Hordelands . Description .
description_long: Oboo An oboo " ( pl . oboos ) " was an altar to the gods of sky and earth that could be found on the steppes of the Hordelands . Description . Oboos were always constructed on the tops of hills . Usually the tallest hill was selected for the site of an oboo , but a smaller hill that was the location of a great military victory could also be selected . Oboos varied in their appearance . A simple stack of stones could serve as an oboo , or carefully selected stones could be arranged into a specific pattern to represent an oboo . The vast majority of stones used for oboos were not marred with hand carvings or drawings . History . The presence of an oboo transformed a hill into a holy site , used by shaman s and lamas of the nomads of the steppe . Sites with oboos were used for special ceremonies or to cast communal spells . An oboo increased the power of these spells . Since oboos were sacred sites , even an oboo used by a sworn enemy was usually left alone because the nomads feared risking the wrath of the gods .

title: Oboth Thornsteel
description: Oboth Thornsteel Oboth Thornsteel was a Zhent mercenary leader in Mornbryn ' s Shield sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Oboth was a Zhentarim mercenary in Yartar in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR .
description_long: Oboth Thornsteel Oboth Thornsteel was a Zhent mercenary leader in Mornbryn ' s Shield sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Oboth was a Zhentarim mercenary in Yartar in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR . Following a giant ' s attack on the village of Mornbryn ' s Shield , Oboth and his men occupied the village . First the villagers welcomed them but soon Oboth grow tyrannical and only interested in finding the lost treasure of Mornbryn .

title: Obould
description: Obould Obould , also known as King Obould I Many - Arrows , was an exarch of Gruumsh and the mortal orc king of the Broken Arrow tribe . Description . Obould was a large orc who was intelligent even by human standards .
description_long: Obould Obould , also known as King Obould I Many - Arrows , was an exarch of Gruumsh and the mortal orc king of the Broken Arrow tribe . Description . Obould was a large orc who was intelligent even by human standards . Considering that the blessings bestowed upon him calmed him somewhat he had become able to see things in a far broader perspective than any orc before him . This led to a change in orcish society under his leadership and the founding of Many - Arrows . Obould was known to have four wives and at least eight sons . It was said his only fear was that when he dies his sons will destroy all he has created in their fight to succeed him . Possessions . As a mortal , Obould was known to wear a ridged suit of black plate armor that was adorned with numerous spikes and decorations . Obould was also known to own a set of magical boots , which enabled him to leave no tracks in the snow , walk on ice without slipping and endure the coldest blizzard without harm . In battle he used a magical greatsword enchanted to catch fire at will . His black iron crown had four large rubies set into it each of which could generate a large fireball .

title: Obould XVII
description: Obould XVII King Obould XVII is the seventeenth king in a line of unbroken Oboulds , ruling over the kingdom of Many - Arrows . Obould XVII reunited the tribes in 1460 DR after a series of civil wars split the kingdom . He was the first of his line to attempt the expansion of his power base , sending forces to secure territory in the city of Neverwinter , however , the lieutenant he sent to achieve this , a power - hungry orc female named Vansi , has allied herself with the Abolethic Sovereignty and rather than reporting back to her king , risks turning herself and her warriors into pawns .
description_long: Obould XVII King Obould XVII is the seventeenth king in a line of unbroken Oboulds , ruling over the kingdom of Many - Arrows . title: Obraerl Fowlweather
description: Obraerl Fowlweather Obraerl Fowlweather was a noble in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Obraerl asked the king for equal participation in the council by old and new noble families .
description_long: Obraerl Fowlweather Obraerl Fowlweather was a noble in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Obraerl asked the king for equal participation in the council by old and new noble families . Later , the appearance of a Blueflame ghost started a fight and Obraerl died in the chaos .

title: Obratu
description: Obratu Obratu was an oni at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . Obratu had a partnership of convenience with a duergar called Reulek .
description_long: Obratu Obratu was an oni at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . Obratu had a partnership of convenience with a duergar called Reulek . History . In 1491 DR , Obratu and Reulek decided to recover the treasures of Besilmer . They found a map showing two entrances to King Torhild Flametongue ' s tomb . Reulek decided to go to the tomb using tunnels near the Fane of the Eye and was never seen again . Obratu searched for the entrance near the Shrine of the Tender Oath . He hired renegade dwarves led by Grumink . Together , they killed the clerics of the shrine and occupied the building , searching for the entrance to the tomb . At last , some adventurers came to investigate the shrine and defeated Obratu and Grumink .

title: Obscuring mist
description: Obscuring mist Obscuring mist was a conjuration spell that caused fog to form around the caster . The druid evocation could be used at a range from the caster . The alteration spell obscurement was another variant of this spell .
description_long: Obscuring mist Obscuring mist was a conjuration spell that caused fog to form around the caster . The druid evocation could be used at a range from the caster . The alteration spell obscurement was another variant of this spell . There was also an assassin ' s hex by this name . Effects . A stationary cloud of mist is created by this spell / evocation , offering concealment to those within it . It was thick enough to block sight and darkvision beyond 5 ft ( 1 . 5 m ) and lasted for at least a minute . Wind and some fire effects ( e . g . , " fireball " , " wall of fire " ) could blow or burn the fog away quickly . This spell fizzled under water . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Observer
description: Observer The observer was a larger - than - average beholder - kin ( 6 ' diameter ) with a hard , chitinous skin mottled in shades of pink and purple . It possessed six eye - stalks , three central eyes ( evenly spaced around the equator ) , and three small mouths ( one below each central eye ) . The observer ' s mouths were not what they appeared to be ; each one was actually a sucker attached to the end of a 5 ' tentacle .
description_long: Observer The observer was a larger - than - average beholder - kin ( 6 ' diameter ) with a hard , chitinous skin mottled in shades of pink and purple . It possessed six eye - stalks , three central eyes ( evenly spaced around the equator ) , and three small mouths ( one below each central eye ) . The observer ' s mouths were not what they appeared to be ; each one was actually a sucker attached to the end of a 5 ' tentacle . The creature normally withdrew these tentacles so that the sucker rested flush against the body . These sucker - mouths could extend to attack nearby targets , and , like the death kiss beholder , they drained blood . The observer , unlike many beholder - kin , was not malicious ; however , the highly intelligent creature lacked any sort of empathy . Observers engaged in an almost obsessive pursuit of knowledge ; they would remorselessly eliminate anyone or anything that stood in the way of their research . Many observers would use their powerful psionic abilities to alter the minds of dangerous creatures ; these creatures acted as slavishly loyal guards that protected the observers ' privacy .

title: Obsidian
description: Obsidian Obsidian , also known as natural glass or volcanic glass , came in different grades and varieties , some more prized than others . Low grade obsidian , called pitchstone , was not as shiny or smooth as gem quality obsidian but was useful for grinding and abrading . A variety called blacksmoke obsidian was primarily found in Tashalar , sold in the local bazaars .
description_long: Obsidian Obsidian , also known as natural glass or volcanic glass , came in different grades and varieties , some more prized than others . Low grade obsidian , called pitchstone , was not as shiny or smooth as gem quality obsidian but was useful for grinding and abrading . A variety called blacksmoke obsidian was primarily found in Tashalar , sold in the local bazaars . A rare form of obsidian , called rainbow obsidian , was considered a semi - precious stone . Description . Volcanic in origin , obsidian was a hard , black , glassy stone with a natural sheen . Common obsidian could be chipped into arrowheads , cutting blades , or even weapons if large enough . As an ornamental stone , it was usually tumbled , polished into smooth cabochons , or carved into figurines and fingerbowls . It was often worn as jewelry or inlaid on bracers or pectorals of copper or bronze . Package handlers in Waterdeep wore obsidian rings with a cutting edge on the inside for snipping twine . Gray to white inclusions made obsidian brittle but when cut and polished correctly , snowflake obsidian was equally as valuable as regular obsidian . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers .

title: Obslin Minstrelwish
description: Obslin Minstrelwish Obslin Minstrelwish was Seneschal of Twilight Hall in Berdusk and one of the High Harpers . History . In Tarsakh of 1370 DR , he was running the Harper stronghold during the absence of the severely ill Cylyria Dragonbreast when , under the urging of Bran Skorlsun , Obslin agreed to discuss the evidence that showed Khelben Arunsun was a traitor .
description_long: Obslin Minstrelwish Obslin Minstrelwish was Seneschal of Twilight Hall in Berdusk and one of the High Harpers . History . In Tarsakh of 1370 DR , he was running the Harper stronghold during the absence of the severely ill Cylyria Dragonbreast when , under the urging of Bran Skorlsun , Obslin agreed to discuss the evidence that showed Khelben Arunsun was a traitor . The Harpers had discovered that Khelben had been the one who had stolen the " Scepter of the Sorcerer - Kings " , a powerful Netherese artefact thirteen years before from the Catacombs of Ordulin . This artifact had since ended up in the hands of the Zhentarim .

title: Obsul Ssussun
description: Obsul Ssussun Obsul Ssussun , or " The Door to Light " , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for followers of Vhaeraun . Description . The black book was small , about as wide as an elf ' s hand , and written in Undercommon in small Elven script .
description_long: Obsul Ssussun Obsul Ssussun , or " The Door to Light " , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for followers of Vhaeraun . Description . The black book was small , about as wide as an elf ' s hand , and written in Undercommon in small Elven script . Versions . It was written by the Widower in cooperation with a cleric of Vhaeraun alongside another book . Both books were made twice , one for arcane casters and another for divine casters . Value . It had a spiritual value to the church of Vhaeraun , who were known to buy back the book for a heavy sum . Clan Auzkovyn also provided the seller with a token for life - long safe passage . History . As mentioned above , the book was written by the Widower in cooperation with a cleric of Vhaeraun sometime between 1370 DR and 1372 DR and two copies , each for arcane and divine magic , existed . When the Widower left , he gave it to his secondwizard Zulifein T ' orgh in order that it be used in the fight against Lolth . Zulifein didn ' t follow instructions however , and disappeared towards Sshamath at some point in 1372 DR , intending to use the book to buy his safety there .

title: Obyrith
description: Obyrith An obyrith was a type of demon . It was so ancient it predated mortal life , and even the gods . They rarely had a humanoid shape , and some said that just looking at an obyrith could drive a mortal insane .
description_long: Obyrith An obyrith was a type of demon . It was so ancient it predated mortal life , and even the gods . They rarely had a humanoid shape , and some said that just looking at an obyrith could drive a mortal insane . Some obyrith lords had evolved over time to take on more recognizable shapes , such as Pazuzu or Pale Night . Only twelve obyrith lords survived to modern times .
