They were survivors of the destruction of their reality and the wars that followed the creation of the Abyss :

title: Ocarina
description: Ocarina The ocarina was a tiny glass flute - like instrument with an oval or round - shaped enclosed body , several finger holes and a mouth piece projecting from the body . Geography . Among other products , ocarinas were produced in Galandor ' s Glassworks , a small shop in Kirinwood , a village in southern Cormyr .
description_long: Ocarina The ocarina was a tiny glass flute - like instrument with an oval or round - shaped enclosed body , several finger holes and a mouth piece projecting from the body . Geography . Among other products , ocarinas were produced in Galandor ' s Glassworks , a small shop in Kirinwood , a village in southern Cormyr . Prices . Ocarinas were sold for 40 to 60 gp .

title: Occidian
description: Occidian Occidian was an elven city before the Crown Wars and a center of elven music and dance in the northern parts of Faerûn . History . The city was destroyed in the Year of Singing Sirens when a huge orc horde rushed over many parts of the northern continent .
description_long: Occidian Occidian was an elven city before the Crown Wars and a center of elven music and dance in the northern parts of Faerûn . History . The city was destroyed in the Year of Singing Sirens when a huge orc horde rushed over many parts of the northern continent . The orcs managed to overrun the northland plains and plunged deep into the forests . Many circles of High Magi had bonded with their brothers and sisters in the tower of Occidian so when the orcs broke the wards and destroyed the tower , a magical backslash killed many of the High Magi in other cities like Sharlarion .

title: Ocean domain
description: Ocean domain The Ocean domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters oceanic - themed spell s and powers . They gained the ability to breathe underwater for several minutes to several hours . Deities with the Ocean domain .
description_long: Ocean domain The Ocean domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters oceanic - themed spell s and powers . They gained the ability to breathe underwater for several minutes to several hours . Deities with the Ocean domain . For obvious reasons , only oceanic gods offered the Ocean domain :

title: Ochio
description: Ochio Ochio was the myoshu of Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Myudo was under the control of evil sohei of the Black Temple who terrorized Ochio and other villagers with stories of the dai - oni who led them .
description_long: Ochio Ochio was the myoshu of Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Myudo was under the control of evil sohei of the Black Temple who terrorized Ochio and other villagers with stories of the dai - oni who led them . They forced Ochio and others to assist in rituals to the dai - oni and to pay heavy tributes . Personality . Ochio did not like responsibility , being an indecisive individual . Also , in private , he was dominated by his wife .

title: Ochre jelly
description: Ochre jelly Ochre jellies resemble giant amoebas , consisting of a thick , golden sludge . Description . The ooze ’ s body is made up of yellow - orange colored acid capable of dissolving any organic material .
description_long: Ochre jelly Ochre jellies resemble giant amoebas , consisting of a thick , golden sludge . Description . The ooze ’ s body is made up of yellow - orange colored acid capable of dissolving any organic material . An ochre jelly can grow to a diameter of about 15 feet and a thickness of about 6 inches , but can compress its body to fit into cracks as small as 1 inch wide . A typical specimen weighs about 5 , 600 pounds . Combat . They lurk in dungeons , slowly creeping along floors , walls and ceilings , under and through doors and cracks looking for victims . When they are found , the ochre jellies extends itself and latches onto them , then proceeding to constrict and engulf them . The jelly exudes pseudopods to slam and grapple foes in combat . Reproduction . Ochre jellies reproduce asexually , occasionally being found with several of its divided offspring . Locations . Ochre jellies were known to exist in the dungeon of Xûl - Jarak in Thar . They could also be found in the ruins of the Ulcaster school near Beregost .

title: Octagon
description: Octagon The Octagon was a huge magical prison located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Octagon was found within Iskalat , or the fiery dock ward of the City of Brass . Description .
description_long: Octagon The Octagon was a huge magical prison located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Octagon was found within Iskalat , or the fiery dock ward of the City of Brass . Description . True to its name , the Octagon was in fact shaped like a giant octagon . Activities . The Octagon could easily hold up to 10 , 000 prisoners at any given time . Each prisoner was kept locked within their own cubed cell of solid basalt that sealed magically around them , leaving only a tiny slit for air and to pass food through . Impervious to attacks , these cells could only be opened by the efreeti prison guards .

title: Octel
description: Octel Octel was the common name for in the Realms . Jewelers sometimes marketed them as savage fire . Description .
description_long: Octel Octel was the common name for in the Realms . Jewelers sometimes marketed them as savage fire . Description . This fancy stone occurred in hues ranging from pale yellow to orange and could be facet cut or sliced and polished for inlay work . Large but irregular specimens were mounted with silver as pendants , and imaginative jewelers sold them as " savage fire " . Octel was a soft stone but when properly faceted yielded beautiful , sparkling gems . A typical octel had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . Octel gems could be permanently " awakened " by touching them to a " ring of free action " . Once awakened , their natural inner fire became a faint light source with a radius of about 2 ft ( 60 cm ) in dark places . An awakened octel prevented all magical paralyzation or " hold " effects from operating on beings touching or carrying it .

title: Octopus
description: Octopus Octopi are a breed of multi - tentacles that live within the ocean . Combat . Generally regular octopi are not dangerous unless provoked , and in this case , will usually try to escape .
description_long: Octopus Octopi are a breed of multi - tentacles that live within the ocean . Combat . Generally regular octopi are not dangerous unless provoked , and in this case , will usually try to escape . Many have evolved the ability to blend into their environment . They can not only change the color of their skin , but also use muscle action to change its texture to appear more like whatever they are blending against . If they are pursued by predators , octopi are capable of expelling a cloud of ink before swimming away . Some octopi are venomous , capable of producing a paralytic neurotoxin . Ecology . They make their homes along the bottom of the sea , particularly within coral reefs . Octopi are quite intelligent as go and capable of complex tactics in their pursuit of food .

title: Ocular adept
description: Ocular adept The ocular adept was a prestige class of Faerûn . By giving themselves to beholders , they gained special abilities that went with their worship of the beholder goddess , the Great Mother . Description .
description_long: Ocular adept The ocular adept was a prestige class of Faerûn . By giving themselves to beholders , they gained special abilities that went with their worship of the beholder goddess , the Great Mother . Description . An ocular adept was a divine caster of the Great Mother . What differed an ocular adept from other members of the deity ' s clergy was that they were humanoids and not beholders . Becoming . A humanoid needed to swear to cut all present and future ties with other deities but Great Mother and ask for inclusion into a beholder community as a first step to become an ocular adept . As a second step , the individual needed to willingly undergo a surgery by a beholder to become an ocular adept . The surgery consisted of getting a hole drilled through the forehead by the surgeon through its " disintegrate " eye ray as the first step . The second step was to get an eye from an eyeball implanted in the new hole , the death throes of the eye connected it with the new host . The surgery concluded with a chant that turned the eye functional and gave the " patient " new abilities .

title: Odak Truesteel
description: Odak Truesteel Odak Truesteel was a fat cleric of Dumathoin in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Odak was a cheerful dwarf , friendly with no - dwarves with a very sarcastic humor .
description_long: Odak Truesteel Odak Truesteel was a fat cleric of Dumathoin in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Odak was a cheerful dwarf , friendly with no - dwarves with a very sarcastic humor . His duty was protect dwarves ' s secrets from outsiders but also protect Bapar . odak believed that Shanatar fell because they shared their secrets with human s and others . He suspected of anyone . History . In 1370 following some clues Odak and his companions Bapar Ghalmrin and Soram Battlebellow discovered that a group possessing one of the lost " Scepters of Shanatar " must be in the village of Toralth . On the night of Uktar 10 they entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " and interrupting the ballad that a bard was singing for the lost companions of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company . Bapar accused some of the patrons to had thieved from the dwarves and asked to turn over to him the thieves and the stolen good . Bramas Thorntree then accused some of the other patrons of the steal the " scepter " but meantime Timor , Karr , and Vajal of the Shields of the Highland got up from their chairs and began throwing their beer mugs and swinging their chairs .

title: Odren
description: Odren Odren was a knight and cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . Helm gave Odren and his fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . However , knowing this was a too difficult mission for them alone , Odren recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him .
description_long: Odren Odren was a knight and cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . Helm gave Odren and his fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . However , knowing this was a too difficult mission for them alone , Odren recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him . In truth , Odren ' s plan was to seal both Demogorgon and Gorion ' s Ward , a individual with the blood of Bhaal , inside the keep .

title: Oe - Ura
description: Oe - Ura Oe - Ura , mostly known as the Peachling Girl , was a heroine in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Oe - Ura preferred the company of animals to people .
description_long: Oe - Ura Oe - Ura , mostly known as the Peachling Girl , was a heroine in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Oe - Ura preferred the company of animals to people . She was an intelligent , quick - witted , and eloquent woman . History . One day , a poor farmer was fishing when he discovered a peach floating down the Nanaichi River . He took the peach from water and a female child burst from it . He and his wife decided to raise her , naming her Oe - Ura . Oe - Ura grew strong and the daimyo decided that she would be a menace , ordering her execution . Oe - Ura ' s parents hid her in the Momoben Forest and were executed in her place . Oe - Ura from then on became the champion of poor people against corrupt government soldiers , thieving tax collectors , and other threats to the underclass . Usually she traveled with her companions , the parrot Ai , the monkey Haya , and the wild dog Tomo . In 1358 DR , she was busy defeating the Blue Kumi Bandits but at last successes than to help of Osari Minhiro and his foreign adventuring party .

title: Oe Shodayu
description: Oe Shodayu Oe Shodayu was a retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Shodayu was an old warrior tired of fighting .
description_long: Oe Shodayu Oe Shodayu was a retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Shodayu was an old warrior tired of fighting . He preferred to study the classics and train himself . History . In 1357 DR , during the plot of Goshukara Akinari to make Funada Mitsuhide lose face in front of the special envoy of the shogun , Lord Masago , Shodayu would attempt to strike down Akinari . Personality . Shodayu lacked a true warlike spirit , so he did not advance much in his profession . However , he carried out his duties faithfully and to the best of his abilities .

title: Oebelar
description: Oebelar The Oebelar was formerly a mage in the city of Scornubel . One night around 1338 DR , his tower was struck by blue - white cold fire and destroyed , but the next night , one of his eyeballs and a blackened forearm appeared . Thereafter , they wandered the city either together or independently .
description_long: Oebelar The Oebelar was formerly a mage in the city of Scornubel . One night around 1338 DR , his tower was struck by blue - white cold fire and destroyed , but the next night , one of his eyeballs and a blackened forearm appeared . Thereafter , they wandered the city either together or independently . The hand was both able to write and make gestures . Ballads were written about the remnants of the Oebelar , and more than one adventuring band has chosen the name the Eye and the Hand . Most citizens hated the floating eye and forearm but even the most powerful magic seemed to have no effect on them . They could , however , be harmed by regular weapons .

title: Oedachlo
description: Oedachlo Oedachlo was a powerful mind flayer wizard until a human wizard magically imprisoned him under the sands of Anauroch . However , in 1358 DR , a Zhentarim expedition freed him . Oedachlo remained deeply hidden while exploring the modern Realms .
description_long: Oedachlo Oedachlo was a powerful mind flayer wizard until a human wizard magically imprisoned him under the sands of Anauroch . However , in 1358 DR , a Zhentarim expedition freed him . Oedachlo remained deeply hidden while exploring the modern Realms . His goal was to find the human wizard or his descendants and enact his revenge .

title: Oel ' yvia Reefglider
description: Oel ' yvia Reefglider Oel ' yvia Reefglider was an aquatic elf barmaid in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Oel ' yvia was hired as a barmaid for Basil Willowbrook ' s inn , the Bindle ' s Blade in the Lower Heart district , where she would delight customers with her songs .
description_long: Oel ' yvia Reefglider Oel ' yvia Reefglider was an aquatic elf barmaid in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Oel ' yvia was hired as a barmaid for Basil Willowbrook ' s inn , the Bindle ' s Blade in the Lower Heart district , where she would delight customers with her songs .

title: Oenath
description: Oenath Oenath , also known as Dreamers , are intelligent , wolf - like creatures living in the wilds of Akanûl . They were originally a pack of wolves changed by the Spellplague into their current form . Combat .
description_long: Oenath Oenath , also known as Dreamers , are intelligent , wolf - like creatures living in the wilds of Akanûl . They were originally a pack of wolves changed by the Spellplague into their current form . Combat . Oenath hunt in packs . Their roar has the ability to knock an opponent over at close range . Appearances . Oenath have thin gray fur and white skin . Their faces often look nearly humanoid .

title: Oerth
description: Oerth Oerth , the world of the " Greyhawk " campaign setting , is an alternate Material Plane world parallel to Toril . Inhabitants . Oerth is home to prominent wizards such as Bigby , Drawmij , Tenser , and Mordenkainen whose spells have spread even to the Forgotten Realms .
description_long: Oerth Oerth , the world of the " Greyhawk " campaign setting , is an alternate Material Plane world parallel to Toril . Inhabitants . Oerth is home to prominent wizards such as Bigby , Drawmij , Tenser , and Mordenkainen whose spells have spread even to the Forgotten Realms . Mordenkainen is an acquaintance of Elminster Aumar ' s ; the two have met on numerous occasions at Ed Greenwood ' s house on Earth to exchange spells and lore . Mordenkainen , when he had newly mastered interplanar travel , used to visit Waterdeep with some regularity . In the book " Passage to Dawn " by R . A . Salvatore , when Harkle Harpell enters into an unorthodox contest of wizardry with the Sea Sprite ' s wizard Robillard , Harkle and Robillard cite a number of Oerthly wizards , including Bigby , Melf , Otiluke , and Tenser . " Robillard blanched despite his own impressive display . Of course he knew of Bigby ! He was one of the most powerful and impressive wizards of all time , on any world . " The Oerthly bard Gwydiesin of the Cranes has also chatted with Elminster on occasion .

title: Oey Sambal Pedas
description: Oey Sambal Pedas Oey Sambal Pedas was the sultan of Kilap Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . He ruled over the Laska people . Personality .
description_long: Oey Sambal Pedas Oey Sambal Pedas was the sultan of Kilap Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . He ruled over the Laska people . Personality . Oey Sambal Pedas of Kilap Valley loved stories and storytelling games and always tried to find a a good opportunity for a game . History . In 1358 DR , during a hunt , Oey Sambal Pedas met an adventuring party hired by the Emperor of Shou Lung to find General Goyat Nagumo , and challenged them to a storytelling game . The adventurers had to guess if a story told by the sultan was true or false and vice versa . After some stories , he said goodbye to the adventurers .

title: Of the Fall of Netheril
description: Of the Fall of Netheril Of the Fall of Netheril was a book written by Rhaugilath the Ageless , an archlich of Netheril dwelling at Warlock ' s Crypt . The book detailed Netheril ' s complete history . However , Rhaugilath considered the Netherese Diaspora after Netheril ' s fall to be an integral part of the history , as well as the expected restoration of Netheril , thought to be only beginning in 1374 DR .
description_long: Of the Fall of Netheril Of the Fall of Netheril was a book written by Rhaugilath the Ageless , an archlich of Netheril dwelling at Warlock ' s Crypt . The book detailed Netheril ' s complete history . However , Rhaugilath considered the Netherese Diaspora after Netheril ' s fall to be an integral part of the history , as well as the expected restoration of Netheril , thought to be only beginning in 1374 DR . Thus , " Of the Fall of Netheril " was never likely to be finished , and it reached several volumes . Larloch reviewed each chapter as it was completed , and they were delivered to Candlekeep to be archived in the library there . In one passage , Rhaugilath discussed the phaerimm , the formation of the Anauroch , and history ' s perception of Netheril .

title: Ogaki
description: Ogaki Ogaki was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Ogaki was the second - in - command of Lord Korimori .
description_long: Ogaki Ogaki was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Ogaki was the second - in - command of Lord Korimori . In 1360 he together with his lieutenants Himeji and Sakigahara led a bushi army in a village formally of the Michimori clan . There however an adventuring party , hired by Michimori Uemon to took the Seven Swords to Uemon , fought and defeated his troops . Personality . Ogaki like saw the battle from distance . He was careful of his safety , as he planned to receive the keep of Michimori after his lord ' s triumph . Behind the Scenes . Only a lucky combination of events can permitted to the players to fight and defeat Ogaki

title: Ogandi Tsipiang
description: Ogandi Tsipiang Ogandi Tsipiang was Prince of Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ogandi was the Prince and ruler of Khazari and lived within the city of Skarou .
description_long: Ogandi Tsipiang Ogandi Tsipiang was Prince of Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ogandi was the Prince and ruler of Khazari and lived within the city of Skarou . History . The Prince was forced to offer terms of peace to the invading Yamun Khahan after he successfully captured the city of Alashan . Ogandi has since attempted to reorganize the power structure of Khazari with hopes of consolidating power to better combat future invasions .

title: Ogawa Besar
description: Ogawa Besar Ogawa Besar was a barbarian participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Nobody knew Ogawa Besar ' s origins .
description_long: Ogawa Besar Ogawa Besar was a barbarian participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Nobody knew Ogawa Besar ' s origins . Most people believed he arrived from the Ama Basin , others he thought was the son of a gaijin pirate . One day , he arrived at the dojo of the Iron Hand kung fu school asking to join . At first , master Ling Li Te Hsin wanted reject him for his rude appearance and speech but Ogawa asked the master to consider only his strength and determination . In a show of ability , Ogawa tried to defeat two oxen in a tug - of - war . At last , after a two - hour - long battle , he lost but Master Ling Li was and impressed accepted him in the school . In time , Ogawa became the most promising student of the Iron Hand school and a probable successor of Master Ling Li . In 1358 DR , Ogawa Besar went to participate at the Komite . Ogawa managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists .

title: Ogden Fastrunner
description: Ogden Fastrunner History . Ogden was the captain of a Cormyr ean patrol that was patrolling the near the city of Marsember during the Time of Troubles when a strange poisonous fog killed him and his men . He later rose as an undead creation under the order of the god of the dead , Myrkul .
description_long: Ogden Fastrunner History . Ogden was the captain of a Cormyr ean patrol that was patrolling the near the city of Marsember during the Time of Troubles when a strange poisonous fog killed him and his men . He later rose as an undead creation under the order of the god of the dead , Myrkul . Myrkul ordered the risen Ogden and his men to capture Midnight , but in the end they were all destroyed .

title: Ogden Flamebeard
description: Ogden Flamebeard Ogden Flamebeard was a tavern owner in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ogden managed the Kelvin ' s Comfrort tavern , the most known drinking place of the city , famous for his Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy drink .
description_long: Ogden Flamebeard Ogden Flamebeard was a tavern owner in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ogden managed the Kelvin ' s Comfrort tavern , the most known drinking place of the city , famous for his Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy drink . History . In his youth Ogden had worked in many mines and had grow a network of contact in all dwarfholds of the North , including Mithral Hall .

title: Ogg
description: Ogg Ogg was a hill giant who , together with Lob , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together .
description_long: Ogg Ogg was a hill giant who , together with Lob , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of chief Guh , Lob and Ogg went in search of food for Guh . After wandering , they led a giant contingent to Goldenfields . However , they were defeated by some adventurers .

title: Oghma
description: Oghma Oghma ( pronounced " OGG - mah " ) , also known as The Lord of Knowledge , was the neutral greater power of bards , inspiration , invention , and knowledge in Faerûn . Oghma was the leader of the Deities of Knowledge and Invention and his home plane was the House of Knowledge . His symbol was a blank scroll .
description_long: Oghma Oghma ( pronounced " OGG - mah " ) , also known as The Lord of Knowledge , was the neutral greater power of bards , inspiration , invention , and knowledge in Faerûn . Oghma was the leader of the Deities of Knowledge and Invention and his home plane was the House of Knowledge . His symbol was a blank scroll . Worshipers . Those who worshiped Oghma included artists , bards , cartographers , inventors , loremasters , sages , scholars , scribes and wizards — archivist s , a generalist cleric prestige class , might pray to him as well . They could be of any alignment , unlike most neutral gods . They often wore Oghma ' s symbol , a silver scroll on a chain , as a necklace . Relationships . Oghma ' s most common foes were Mask , Cyric , and Bane . Oghma ' s old archnemesis , Leira , is now dead and an aspect of Cyric . He may have been opposed to Ilsensine . Deities of Knowledge and Invention . Along with Milil , Deneir , and Gond , Oghma was one of the Deities of Knowledge and Invention . He led the deific group and , although Deneir was lost , Oghma continued to lead them . History .

title: Oghrann
description: Oghrann Oghrann was a dwarven realm founded on and under the Plain of Tun . Geography . At its height , Oghrann surrounded the valley of the River Tun , extended into the Sunset Mountains in the west and underneath the Storm Horns in the east .
description_long: Oghrann Oghrann was a dwarven realm founded on and under the Plain of Tun . Geography . At its height , Oghrann surrounded the valley of the River Tun , extended into the Sunset Mountains in the west and underneath the Storm Horns in the east . The lands to the northwest , known at the time as the Helbryn , were also claimed by Oghrann as a hunting reserve , but settlement of those lands was forbidden since the time of Thordbard . History . Founded in the wake of the fall of Shanatar by Thordbard Firebeard , Oghrann lasted until shortly after Ammarindar was abandoned . Disease and attacks from humanoids spelled the end of the realm and its survivors fled to the Far Hills . = References =

title: Ogre
description: Ogre Ogres were a race of giant - kin . Description . Ogres appeared as giant humanoids with very muscular bodies and large heads .
description_long: Ogre Ogres were a race of giant - kin . Description . Ogres appeared as giant humanoids with very muscular bodies and large heads . They stood between 9 and 10 feet tall and could weigh 600 to 650 lbs . Personality . They tended to be lazy and brutish , preferring to rely on ambush and overwhelming numbers in battle . Ogres often worked as mercenaries , hoping for easy plunder . Some ogres enjoyed the taste of raw dwarf flesh . Language . Ogres spoke Jogishk , a patois of the Giant or Jotun tongue . History . According to legend , the ogre race was formed when Othea , wife of the titan Annam All - Father , had an affair with Vaprak . In 1357 DR , a small army of ogres served the monstrous extraplanar being Imgig Zu . He gathered them in the caverns beneath his tower to witness the Great Awakening of his people from " Selûne ' s Eye " , and to provide defense during the deed . The heroes Priam Agrivar , Vajra Valmeyjar , Timoth Eyesbright , and Onyx the Invincible fought through the ogres to confront Imgig and free Cybriana .

title: Ogre giant
description: Ogre giant Ogre giants were imposing giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that seemed to have more in common with ogre s than giants . These creatures spoke the tongue of ogres , but some who lived near humans could speak Midani as well . A rare few even attained enlightenment , serving as missionaries for their kind , though the vast majority were savage brutes .
description_long: Ogre giant Ogre giants were imposing giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that seemed to have more in common with ogre s than giants . These creatures spoke the tongue of ogres , but some who lived near humans could speak Midani as well . A rare few even attained enlightenment , serving as missionaries for their kind , though the vast majority were savage brutes . Description . Ogre giants were larger than many true giants , standing 20 ft . ( 6 m ) tall and weighing 8 , 500 lbs . ( 3 , 800 kg ) . Their bodies were covered in spiky hair and they rarely wore clothing unless directed to do so by a master . Most ogre giants were cyclopean , but some had two eyes as well . Their large elephant - shaped ears often hung down to their shoulders . These richly - veined ears were used to cool their body when flapped . Males of the species possessed a pair of large tusks that jutted upward from their lower jaw . Combat . Their large fists aided them well in combat .

title: Ogremoch ' s Bane
description: Ogremoch ' s Bane Ogremoch ' s Bane was a drifting cloud of sentient , invisible magical dust that lived in the city of Blingdenstone since 1358 DR . Named after the lord of evil earth elemental s to contrast the presence of Entemoch ' s Boon , it moved around the city and any creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth not of a good alignment that it came into contact with were driven into a mindless destructive rage . These creatures could also not be " banished " back home , so they must be destroyed in order to get rid of them .
description_long: Ogremoch ' s Bane Ogremoch ' s Bane was a drifting cloud of sentient , invisible magical dust that lived in the city of Blingdenstone since 1358 DR . Named after the lord of evil earth elemental s to contrast the presence of Entemoch ' s Boon , it moved around the city and any creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth not of a good alignment that it came into contact with were driven into a mindless destructive rage . These creatures could also not be " banished " back home , so they must be destroyed in order to get rid of them . During the drow attack of 1371 , the cloud diverted quite a few of the Svirfneblin ' s extra - planar allies from the defense of the city . Since the fall of the city , the cloud collected more and more earth creatures , elemental s , xorn s , mephit s , thoqqua s and others . Rather than making them rage , it had them stand still as statues at the rear of the cavern that housed the city , whispering promises of victory and glory to them in Terran for some unknown purpose . Elder gnome priests theorized that the cloud ' s presence was somehow tied to that of Entemoch ' s Boon . In 1479 pech identified it as an atypical earth elemental .

title: Ogrillon
description: Ogrillon Ogrillons were the result of orc s and ogre s breeding . Description . Ogrillons looked very similar to orcs , but were often a little taller .
description_long: Ogrillon Ogrillons were the result of orc s and ogre s breeding . Description . Ogrillons looked very similar to orcs , but were often a little taller . Roughly 10 % of ogrillons inherited the physical attributes of their ogre parentage and were clearly distinguishable from their orcs . Although roughly the same size as orcs and other humanoid s , ogrillons were considerably stronger . Most ogrillons had bony protrusions on their shoulders , elbows , knuckles , hips , knees , and toes . Behavior . Ogrillons lived in tribes . They often cooperated with orcs and were regularly used by orc groups as extra muscle . Despite little use for currency , ogrillons often considered gold coins lucky and most ogrillons carried coins with them . Although most ogrillons pursued barbarian or fighter roles , a minority chose to become cleric s , monk s or shaman s . Combat . Ogrillons thrived in combat and were uncomfortable and restless if not in a battle . The use of weapons and armor varied . Although many ogrillons fought without weaponry or armor , others preferred to use clubs , greataxes and other large weapons while wearing hide armor . Ecology . Ogrillons were carnivorous . History .

title: Ogrima
description: Ogrima Ogrima were the result of inter - breeding between ogre s and ogre mage s . Over time they became a separate race of ogres entirely . Description .
description_long: Ogrima Ogrima were the result of inter - breeding between ogre s and ogre mage s . Over time they became a separate race of ogres entirely . Description . These creatures were as tall as ogres but had skin that was either yellow or a sickly blue - green . They had a single horn that protruded from their forehead through their greasy hair . Combat . Ogrima were as strong as ogres but possessed more cunning . Coupled with their limited spell - like abilities and regenerative capabilities , this made them worthy opponents in battle . They favored large weapons and bows . Suspected spellcasters were targeted with their bows before engaging in close combat . Ogrima could use the following spell - like abilities : " levitate " , " blur " , " chill touch " , and " change self " . Bands of ogrima were sometimes accompanied by a stronger ogrima chieftain . Habitat / Society . Ogrima were considered social outcasts by ogres and ogre mages . They were more social than ogres and possessed more skills in crafting , allowing them to build more structures for their strongholds . Tribes of ogrima were arranged into families that spread over their territory .

title: Ogrémoch
description: Ogrémoch Ogrémoch , also known as the Prince of Evil Earth , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Ogrémoch was described as a ten - foot - tall ( 3 meters ) humanoid made of rock and crystal .
description_long: Ogrémoch Ogrémoch , also known as the Prince of Evil Earth , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Ogrémoch was described as a ten - foot - tall ( 3 meters ) humanoid made of rock and crystal . His eyes resembled chipped obsidian and his body sparkled with mica . This was by no means an accurate description however , as few could claim to have ever seen him . Domain . Within the Plane of Earth , in a fortress known as Stonemire , on a plateau near the border with the Plane of Magma , Ogrémoch made his lair . The heat was unbearable and fountains of molten stone , smoke and steam were used as decoration . Tales told of the foundations of the fortress being the entombed bodies of Ogrémoch ' s still - living enemies . Personality . Ogrémoch was a miser , regarding all resources and treasure within the earth as his . This was not because he needed the wealth , but because of the principle of the thing . What he could not crush under is massive form , he outlasted . Relationships . Ogrémoch ' s greatest desire was to destroy Sunnis , his good - aligned counterpart . He was also antagonistic toward his benevolent twin brother Entemoch .

title: Ohlmer Cormaeril
description: Ohlmer Cormaeril Ohlmer Cormaeril was the head of the Cormaeril noble house in Cormyr . Although he appeared to be a respectable nobleman , he was not above kidnapping for slavery , smuggling and trade with pirates . He had been known to mistreat female slaves .
description_long: Ohlmer Cormaeril Ohlmer Cormaeril was the head of the Cormaeril noble house in Cormyr . Although he appeared to be a respectable nobleman , he was not above kidnapping for slavery , smuggling and trade with pirates . He had been known to mistreat female slaves . He was put to death in 1369 DR by Gaspar Cormaeril who wanted to assume control of the house for himself .

title: Oigur
description: Oigur The Oigur were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Oigur lived in the southern wastes of the Hordelands .
description_long: Oigur The Oigur were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Oigur lived in the southern wastes of the Hordelands . Their territory bordered the lands of the Tuigan , Quirish , and Kashghun tribes . Society . They spoke their own language . They were considered rivals of the Naican but were allied with the Gur . History . For many ages , the Dalat had raided Naican territory , and the Oigur would sometimes join them in this , leading to the feud between the Naican and Oigur . When Yamun Khahan came to power and formed his Grand Army of the Tuigan , the Oigur were the second tribe to fall to his conquest . The Oigur became friends with the Gurs , so as not to anger Yamun Khahan .

title: Oigur language
description: Oigur language Oigur was a language spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Oigur was a nasal language .
description_long: Oigur language Oigur was a language spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Oigur was a nasal language . Vowels pronounced close and toward the front of the mouth were drawn out . It also had harsh consonant sounds , especially its Ks , and the sound of L was aspirated . Its grammar had a subject – object – verb order . Speakers . Oigur was spoken primarily by the nomadic Oigur tribe . Script . Oigur did not have a written script . History . Scholars classified Oigur as one of both the Southern and the Eastern Imaskari languages . It was strongly influenced by the Shou Chiang languages of Shou Lung and the tongue of Muhjuri .

title: Oil of animate dead
description: Oil of animate dead Oil of animate dead was a potion that could be rubbed onto a corpse or bones to create either a zombie or a skeleton . The first creature that it saw was regarded as its master and it would obey commands as if it were under the influence of the spell " animate dead " . It could only be used on a medium - sized or smaller creature .
description_long: Oil of animate dead Oil of animate dead was a potion that could be rubbed onto a corpse or bones to create either a zombie or a skeleton . The first creature that it saw was regarded as its master and it would obey commands as if it were under the influence of the spell " animate dead " . It could only be used on a medium - sized or smaller creature . A vial was worth around 1500 gold piece s .

title: Oil of attractiveness
description: Oil of attractiveness Oil of attractiveness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of attractiveness Oil of attractiveness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . When applied to the face , this oil made the user more physically attractive . This effect lasted longer for less attractive people than it did for more attractive people , usually for 6 – 12 hours . If the user left the oil on their face longer than this time period , then the oil transformed into " oil of horridness " and the exact opposite effect was achieved .

title: Oil of cloaking
description: Oil of cloaking Oil of cloaking was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of cloaking Oil of cloaking was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . When smeared on an inanimate object , oil of cloaking masked any magical properties of the item for up to one day . Casting " detect magic " or similar spells did not reveal anything about the magical nature of the cloaked item . Casting " legend lore " on a cloaked item still revealed its history . A flask of this oil could only be used once regardless of how much oil was used . A single flask could be used to cloak an item the size of a normal man or smaller .

title: Oil of great devotion
description: Oil of great devotion Oil of great devotion was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of great devotion Oil of great devotion was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . If a priest of low to middle ranking used this oil , it temporarily granted them a higher understanding of their clerical power . This did not grant additional spells , but it did increase the effectiveness of other abilities such as turning or commanding undead . Oil of great devotion was only usable by priests .

title: Oil of horridness
description: Oil of horridness Oil of horridness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of horridness Oil of horridness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . When smeared on the face , " oil of horridness " drastically reduced the attractiveness of an individual , so much so that most people could not stand to be in their presence . This effect lasted for one full day . A flask containing this oil was never labeled correctly simply because " oil of horridness " was the end result when " oil of attractiveness " spoiled .

title: Oil of impact
description: Oil of impact Oil of impact was a very explosive magical substance . The priest Cadderly Bonaduce was known to use this oil in his youth . A typical vial of this oil had a base value of 5 , 000gp .
description_long: Oil of impact Oil of impact was a very explosive magical substance . The priest Cadderly Bonaduce was known to use this oil in his youth . A typical vial of this oil had a base value of 5 , 000gp . Ingredients . Only some of the exotic ingredients were known that were needed in the process of brewing the Oil of Impact - for example hill giant fingernails and crushed oxen horn . An alchemical device was needed to blend all ingredients together - and a very careful hand to not cause the oil to blow up in the process of brewing . Utilization . The oil could be transported in glass vials . Cadderly designed crossbow darts to hold the oil . These darts were small and narrow and made of iron except for silver caps . The centers of the darts were hollowed out to leave room for tiny glass vials filled with the oil . In case those darts impacted on a hard surface ( such as a wall , limb of a tree or even an orog ' s torso ) the vial collapsed and the oil exploded .

title: Oil of invisibility
description: Oil of invisibility Oil of invisibility was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of invisibility Oil of invisibility was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . When smeared on an item or individual , this oil caused the coated surface to completely disappear . This effect last for 1 – 2 hours . Though anything coated with this oil was invisible to the naked eye , the oil gave off a distinct scent that was easily tracked by most dogs or other creatures with an acute sense of smell .

title: Oil of invulnerability
description: Oil of invulnerability Oil of invulnerability was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of invulnerability Oil of invulnerability was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . This oil had a strong scent of burnt almonds . Powers . When spread on a surface , this wonderful oil protected the surface from damage for 1 – 2 hours .

title: Oil of obedience
description: Oil of obedience Oil of obedience was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of obedience Oil of obedience was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . " Oil of obedience " had a pasty consistency compared to other magical oils . Powers . If smeared on the forehead of a sleeping , or otherwise incapacitated person or creature , this oil would place the individual under the command of whoever used the oil on them as soon as they woke . The controlled individual acted like a mindless zombie , incapable of critical thinking involving anything more complicated than basic functions . They needed to be commanded to perform any activity , including walking . Any impossible order was simply ignored . They were not able to cast spells or perform other complex tasks . However , they still had access to any innate magical abilities . If ordered to perform a self - destructive act , there was a chance that the individual would resist the command . The effects of " oil of obedience " last for 1 – 6 hours .

title: Oil of romance
description: Oil of romance Oil of romance was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of romance Oil of romance was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . " Oil of romance " had the distinct odor of rotting fish . Powers . To properly use this oil the user poured the oil on the ground before a doorway or on a window sill . The user then spoke the name of someone of the opposite sex . If the named person crossed the threshold where the oil was poured , they behaved as if under the influence of a powerful " charm " spell cast by the individual who poured the oil . In addition to this , the charmed person looked upon the person who poured the oil with loving feelings . The effects of " oil of romance " did not wear away naturally over time . Only a " dispel magic " or " limited wish " spell could negate them .

title: Oil of sulphur
description: Oil of sulphur Oil of sulphur was a magic potion that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This item was often used by genie s who sought revenge against their masters . Description .
description_long: Oil of sulphur Oil of sulphur was a magic potion that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This item was often used by genie s who sought revenge against their masters . Description . " Oil of sulphur " was contained within a flask like many other magical potions . In fact , it actually appeared to resemble other beneficial potions or oils when examined , masking its true nature as that of a deadly liquid . Powers . This oil would burst into intense flame 10 - 30 minutes after it was applied , causing vicious burns if applied to living flesh . Uses . Efreet enjoyed using " oil of sulphur " during massages .

title: Oil of the pickpocket
description: Oil of the pickpocket Oil of the pickpocket was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Oil of the pickpocket Oil of the pickpocket was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . When applied to the hands , this oil allowed someone who lacked any thieving skills to pick pockets with the skill of a beginning thief . If used by a thief of any skill level , the oil would increase their pick pocketing skills . " Oil of the pickpocket " lasted for 6 hours .

title: Oilskin
description: Oilskin Oilskin was an arcane abjuration spell that protected an individual or an object from precipitation and being doused by waves . Effects . This spell set up a nearly waterproof barrier around one touched creature or small object .
description_long: Oilskin Oilskin was an arcane abjuration spell that protected an individual or an object from precipitation and being doused by waves . Effects . This spell set up a nearly waterproof barrier around one touched creature or small object . The barrier extended one inch ( 2 . 5 cm ) from the body or the object and prevented all forms of precipitation , including rain , snow , hail , fog , mist , and crashing waves , from dampening the target of the spell . Only immersion in a large body of water could overcome this protection . Once removed from submersion , the spell continued to repel water , but the individual or object was no longer dry . The spell lasted a minimum of 20 minutes and could be extended in 20 minute increments by higher level spellcasters . As an added benefit , eyesight was improved in stormy conditions because the recipient did not have the threat of water getting in his or her eyes . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a small piece of cloth that had been treated with oil to be water - repellent . History . This spell was associated with the pirates roaming the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Oinker - Boinker
description: Oinker - Boinker Oinker - Boinker was an ettin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Oinker - Boinker was one of the minions of the hill giant Chief Guh in Grudd Haug .
description_long: Oinker - Boinker Oinker - Boinker was an ettin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Oinker - Boinker was one of the minions of the hill giant Chief Guh in Grudd Haug . His duty was to take care of the pig s together with some bugbear s .

title: Ojy
description: Ojy Ojy was the spiritual guide of the village of Golden in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur long before the 14th century DR . He was known for forging the magical shuriken called the " stars of Ojy - do " . History .
description_long: Ojy Ojy was the spiritual guide of the village of Golden in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur long before the 14th century DR . He was known for forging the magical shuriken called the " stars of Ojy - do " . History . When bandits besieged the village of Golden , the villagers were forced to defend themselves and Ojy was pressed into work as a weaponsmith , though he knew little of metalworking . With every accurate strike of his hammer , he thanked his guiding spirits , and so the " stars of Ojy - do " were forged from the strength of his faith . They proved just as resilient . . He also crafted other weapons , and with his creations , the villagers fought back . By 1372 DR , " stars of Ojy - do " circulated around the northwest Faerûn and the Sword Coast North .

title: Ojy - do
description: Ojy - do Ojy - do was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was one of the few troublespots of the kingdom around 1357 DR . Geography .
description_long: Ojy - do Ojy - do was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was one of the few troublespots of the kingdom around 1357 DR . Geography . Ojy - do lay inland , at the base of the Ziyero Ridge . Government . Around 1357 DR , Ojy - do was nominally ruled by a governor appointed by King Wanang Sun . However , the true rulers of the city were the Bakshi yakuza clan , who were able to manipulate the governor . The Bakshi were headed by So Golin - po and worked only to gouge money from the city . They controlled both the city guard and the criminal underworld . Golin - po was utterly ruthless in dealing with anyone who had the temerity to steal or con in the city , or who tried to shake his grip on power . Many who opposed the Bakshi were killed , and honorable folk had long since fled the city . Description . Ojy - do was a walled city that had fallen into a dilapidated state under the tyranny of the Bakshi . The largest house in the city was the home and fortified compound of Golin - po . Factions . The most powerful faction in Ojy - do was of course the Bakshi clan of yakuza , but the city was also infiltrated with spies serving King Wanang Sun .

title: Oka Sanai
description: Oka Sanai Oka Sanai was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sanai was a noted satirist , writing some pamphlets against the Funada clan .
description_long: Oka Sanai Oka Sanai was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sanai was a noted satirist , writing some pamphlets against the Funada clan . History . In 1357 DR , after Oka Yoshinaka and Mashida Kowa had clashed with the Gamo brothers , Hidenobu , Mitsutoshi , and Mochikuni , thanks to a plot by Funada Toyoo , Sanai was framed for a satirical pamphlet against the three Gamos . Sanai and his friends thought the Gamo had framed Sanai and wanted revenge . Personality . Sanai was always ready to offer sound advice and wise counsel to his friends . He disliked physical exertion and always tried to win battles with a minimum of effort .

title: Oka Yoshinaka
description: Oka Yoshinaka Oka Yoshinaka was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Yoshinaka and Mashida Kowa clashed with the Gamo brothers , Hidenobu , Mitsutoshi and Mochikuni .
description_long: Oka Yoshinaka Oka Yoshinaka was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Yoshinaka and Mashida Kowa clashed with the Gamo brothers , Hidenobu , Mitsutoshi and Mochikuni . Personality . Yoshinaka was a very handsome but modest young man . Thank to the influence of his brother , Oka Sanai , he inherited his sound wisdom and showed great promise as a warrior - scholar . Yoshinaka valued and cared for his appearance ( knowing it to be a great asset ) but he did not let it get the better of him .

title: Okahira
description: Okahira Okahira was a large city in the northern region of the Miyama Province . As of 1357 DR , it was the third largest city in all the provinces of Kozakura and dominated the northern coast . In that year , around 6 , 000 people populated the city .
description_long: Okahira Okahira was a large city in the northern region of the Miyama Province . As of 1357 DR , it was the third largest city in all the provinces of Kozakura and dominated the northern coast . In that year , around 6 , 000 people populated the city . Okahira was divided into three wards .

title: Okasha
description: Okasha Okasha was a Wanese captain temporary in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Okasha was a sea captain merchant from Wa .
description_long: Okasha Okasha was a Wanese captain temporary in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Okasha was a sea captain merchant from Wa . He had dealings with T ' u Lung agents . In 1357 DR , his ship was damaged in a storm near the Prioto islands and he temporary stopped at Akari for repairs . However , the Shou governor Ko Lei Kho sold him iron bolts and fasteners for repairs at a very high price . Personality . Okasha despised Governor Ko , considering him a tyrannical little tin demigod who thought only of profit . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . If early in the adventure Kitashi is not stopped , T ' u Lung ninja attacked the players on the island and Okasha was their accomplice .

title: Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm
description: Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm was the general and commander of the Studious Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Okin ' s strengths catered to research and tactics for the Studious .
description_long: Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm was the general and commander of the Studious Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Okin ' s strengths catered to research and tactics for the Studious . History . Okin was crippled in battle in his past . Though fully healed , he since lost his taste for warfare and focused on other aspects .

title: Okku
description: Okku Okku is a God of Bears , an ancient spirit of Rashemen . Personality . In life , Okku was a paragon bear - one of an ancient race of intelligent beasts who ruled the wild places .
description_long: Okku Okku is a God of Bears , an ancient spirit of Rashemen . Personality . In life , Okku was a paragon bear - one of an ancient race of intelligent beasts who ruled the wild places . In death , he has become a creature of spirit , regarded by the Rashemi people as a deity of the land . But his teeth and claws are no less sharp than they once were . . . and his strength no longer depends upon bone and sinew , arising instead from the multitude of spirits and beasts who revere his name . Okku and the Spirit Eater . Okku was once a powerful bear that roamed the wilds of Rashemen . According to him , he was a descendant of the ancient pack of Bhalla , from primeval times . During the time of the previous Spirit - Eater , a noble wizard , Okku and his pack had clashed with said wizard at Lake Tirulag . Though defeated , Okku was spared by the wizard and was asked for help in finding an end to the curse , for which he made an oath . However , no cure was found , and Okku agreed to let the man die in a runed chamber within his barrow and die so the curse would remain sealed .

title: Okotampe
description: Okotampe Okotampe was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Okotampe was a shaman among his tribe but left his home to found a new totem for the tribe .
description_long: Okotampe Okotampe was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Okotampe was a shaman among his tribe but left his home to found a new totem for the tribe . He met Onoye and understood her spirit nature , deciding that she was sent to him by the gods to help in his quest , so he decided to travel with her . Later , Okotampe and Onoye joined Doin Sanehiro ' s group in fighting against Jinchin . They remained with Doin at the village of Tomobiki after the end of the adventure . In late 1358 he went into a solitary trip to find a new totem in the Fochu Peninsula of Wa but the thief of his helm of teleportation by some Blue Kumi Bandits prevented Okotampe to went back to home . Personality . Okotampe didn ' t really need anyhing from others , living cheaply . He never bathed , wore filthy rags , spat , cursed , yelled , and was always rude . He considered human s just barbarian invaders , and his people to be more ancient and wise .

title: Oksakex
description: Oksakex Oksakex was a vampiric ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR . Personality . Oksakex hoped to become a greater vampiric ixzan and approached Phiaqiv on more than one occasion asking for a transformation .
description_long: Oksakex Oksakex was a vampiric ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR . Personality . Oksakex hoped to become a greater vampiric ixzan and approached Phiaqiv on more than one occasion asking for a transformation . He always refused but never told of her ambitions to Zekaqux . Abilities . Oksakex regularly fell into holy trances , and these left her with uncontrollable shaking for several hours . Her spell came mostly from the school of divination History . Oksakex was the second only to Zekaqux in the clergy of Ilxendren .

title: Okssort
description: Okssort Okssort was a fire giant who , together with his wife Ildmane , led an attack on Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of Duke Zalto , Okssort and Ildmane went in search of pieces of the Vonindod .
description_long: Okssort Okssort was a fire giant who , together with his wife Ildmane , led an attack on Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of Duke Zalto , Okssort and Ildmane went in search of pieces of the Vonindod . They led a giant contingent to Triboar , the place of an ancient great battle between giant s and dragon s . However , they were defeated by some adventurers .

title: Olam Chistlesmith
description: Olam Chistlesmith Olam Chistlesmith was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR and a member of Clan Chistlesmith . Olam was the mate of Thendara Spearsinger and the father of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful .
description_long: Olam Chistlesmith Olam Chistlesmith was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR and a member of Clan Chistlesmith . Olam was the mate of Thendara Spearsinger and the father of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful .

title: Olara
description: Olara Olara was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Olara was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Scroll of the Disciples of St .
description_long: Olara Olara was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Olara was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Scroll of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . Her duty was to act as a librarian . Secretly , she was also a member of the Cult of Howling Hatred . History . Olara was one of the cultists who infiltrated the monastery in 1491 DR . However , she and Glavel were discovered by Lana . Despite being left for dead after their meeting , Lana survived and in Mulmaster told of her discovery to the Order of the Gauntlet , the Lords ' Alliance , and Zor Garwyl Gos , who hired an adventuring party to investigate . When the adventurers arrived at the monastery , they confronted her . Relationship . Olara was the lover of Glavel , a fellow cultist . Personality . Olara was a little crazy , mumbling to herself on occasion . It wasn ' t easy convincing her to talk .

title: Olbedan
description: Olbedan Master Sufferer Olbedan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God , dwelling at the House of the Harmed in Aralent in the Vilhon Reach . Olbedan was widely regarded as a saintly and trustworthy soul . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent .
description_long: Olbedan Master Sufferer Olbedan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God , dwelling at the House of the Harmed in Aralent in the Vilhon Reach . Olbedan was widely regarded as a saintly and trustworthy soul . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers and never made it to Olbedan . The " Tome " was thought lost in the winter snows .

title: Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks
description: Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks was a tannery and leatherworking shop just outside Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Location . Situated outside of the River Gate on the eastern side of Dagger Falls , Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks stood at the junction of the Tethyamar Trail and the Tesh Trail .
description_long: Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks was a tannery and leatherworking shop just outside Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Location . Situated outside of the River Gate on the eastern side of Dagger Falls , Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks stood at the junction of the Tethyamar Trail and the Tesh Trail . Structure . Interior . Inside Dulwar ' s Leatherworks , the smell of oil and leather suffused the building beneath a high - beamed ceiling , while hides of leather were piled along the walls and all manner of leather clothing was stacked upon shelves . The floor was spattered with oil and a large table with works in progress dominated the shop room . Services . Dulwar ' s Leatherworks offered many sturdy and reliable tanned goods services to all customers who needed such goods . These included items such as leather bracers , boots , clothing , horse harnesses , tack , scabbards and sheaths . Even during the Zhent occupation of Dagger Falls , the shop continued to offer goods to the garrisoned troops , whilst simultaneously operating as a safe house for Randal Morn ' s freedom fighters .

title: Old Gebe
description: Old Gebe Old Gebe was , in 1368 DR , an old man living in Dlusk , Aglarond . During the spring festival there , he would give free hayrides to children and tell stories about mules , including his own mules Sara and Corey . He knew many of the local legends and was knowledgeable on the subject of the Unapproachable East in general .
description_long: Old Gebe Old Gebe was , in 1368 DR , an old man living in Dlusk , Aglarond . During the spring festival there , he would give free hayrides to children and tell stories about mules , including his own mules Sara and Corey . He knew many of the local legends and was knowledgeable on the subject of the Unapproachable East in general .

title: Old Goatbeard
description: Old Goatbeard Old Goatbeard was the skilled yak - folk governor of the Red Goat province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Old Goatbeard was a member of the Seven Sages and the appointed governor of the Red Goat province within the Yikarian Empire .
description_long: Old Goatbeard Old Goatbeard was the skilled yak - folk governor of the Red Goat province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Old Goatbeard was a member of the Seven Sages and the appointed governor of the Red Goat province within the Yikarian Empire . He was well known for his collection of courtesans , all of whom lived within his small but splendid palace on the shores of the Lake of the Emerald Eye . Skills . In addition to being a powerful wizard and priest of the Faceless God , Old Goatbeard was a master shapeshifter who used this ability to develop rogue - like skills . Rumors & Legends . Discrete circles of yikarians were aware that Old Goatbeard smuggled goods through the Blackwash Fens near Lipo .

title: Old Illuskan
description: Old Illuskan Old Illuskan was the language of Old Illusk and the parent language of modern Illuskan , Bothii , and Reghedjic . It also influenced the modern language of Dambrathan . Script .
description_long: Old Illuskan Old Illuskan was the language of Old Illusk and the parent language of modern Illuskan , Bothii , and Reghedjic . It also influenced the modern language of Dambrathan . Script . Old Illuskan had its own alphabet . By 1372 DR , the only known samples of this script were located in the Green Library in Ruathym and in the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan .

title: Old Men ' s Bones
description: Old Men ' s Bones Old Men ' s Bones was a classic game played in Faerûn . Description . An Old Men ' s Bones set consisted of tiny bones that were poured into a pile .
description_long: Old Men ' s Bones Old Men ' s Bones was a classic game played in Faerûn . Description . An Old Men ' s Bones set consisted of tiny bones that were poured into a pile . The object of the game was to remove the bones one at a time from the pile without disturbing the other bones in the pile . Cheaper sets were made from the bones of birds ; however , sets constructed from the slivered bones of wyvern s , dragon s , or other dangerous creatures also existed . Aurora ' s Emporium promised that none of their sets were made from the bones of sentient humanoid s . The bones were usually stored in a leather or metal tube canister . History . The game originated in Phlan and the Moonsea region . Appendix . Inspiration . Old Men ' s Bones is based on the real - life game of .

title: Old Night
description: Old Night In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , Old Night was one of the High Heralds . The sign of Old Night was an ancient , broken bronze shield hung on the wide trunk of an oak tree , surrounded by oak leaves . This office was in charge of training the Heralds Pursuivant , including the " everchanging offices " of Green Shield and Gauntlet .
description_long: Old Night In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , Old Night was one of the High Heralds . The sign of Old Night was an ancient , broken bronze shield hung on the wide trunk of an oak tree , surrounded by oak leaves . This office was in charge of training the Heralds Pursuivant , including the " everchanging offices " of Green Shield and Gauntlet . Additionally , Old Night was the head librarian of Herald ' s Holdfast , the greatest repository of heraldic lore , genealogy , and historic documents of the primary sentient races in North Faerûn . Ironically , Old Night was the most scholarly and reclusive of the High Heralds , and yet the most well known to the peoples of Faerûn because of the authority the office wielded over matters of heraldry and the Law of Arms . The public perception of Old Night was that of an ancient , powerful , benevolent wizard with a mercurial streak , but at least two of the office holders in the ( Farsyr and Shalara ) were rangers . Possessions . The rod of office was a crooked and rough wizard ' s staff made from the remains of a cracked bronze shield , crushed into the shape of a walking - stick .

title: Old One Eye
description: Old One Eye Old One Eye was a beer brewed in Llorbauth from the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Old One Eye Old One Eye was a beer brewed in Llorbauth from the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Araneth Idogyr acquired the recipe for Old One Eye from a cyclops whom he met , and befriended , during the Goblin Wars of 1358 DR . Similar to the brews from Calimshan , this brew had a light coloring but a higher alcohol content compared to its northern counterparts . Old One Eye had a red coloration that developed during the brewing process . The aftertaste was decidedly hot due to its secret ingredients . It was considered one of the best liquors one could purchase outside of the Purple Hills . Prices . Old One Eye could be purchased in the following containers :

title: Old Owl Well
description: Old Owl Well Old Owl Well , located in the hills north of the Sword Mountains , was a popular watering hole and rest stop for caravan traffic , especially between Yartar and Neverwinter . History . In - 2368 DR , at the adamant insistence of the Terraseer , the Empire of Netheril began earnestly colonizing the Savage Frontier .
description_long: Old Owl Well Old Owl Well , located in the hills north of the Sword Mountains , was a popular watering hole and rest stop for caravan traffic , especially between Yartar and Neverwinter . History . In - 2368 DR , at the adamant insistence of the Terraseer , the Empire of Netheril began earnestly colonizing the Savage Frontier . They established several outposts at which Netherese travelers heading west could get fresh horses and supplies . The Terraseer himself identified a perfect spot for one such outpost to be built north of a mineral - rich mountain range not far east of northern Illefarn . However , the site was infested with owlbear s , so the Terraseer had his scouts destroy the 3 , 000 - strong population of beasts in an event known as the Caravan War . The outpost was named " Old Owl Well " after the victory over the owlbears . Once secured , arcanist s arrived and began to drill a hole that eventually dug more than 5 miles below the surface then , with an extensive system of pipes , they established an everlasting water supply that could provide 20 gallons per day .

title: Old Road ( High Forest )
description: Old Road ( High Forest ) The Old Road is a cracked cobblestone road that has partly fallen into disrepair and become overgrown . It links Elven Port , the Nameless Dungeon and Mhiilamniir . Where the Old Road splits off and leads to the Nameless Dungeon there is a guardpost with no less than 25 moon and gold elves from Silverymoon and Evereska .
description_long: Old Road ( High Forest ) The Old Road is a cracked cobblestone road that has partly fallen into disrepair and become overgrown . It links Elven Port , the Nameless Dungeon and Mhiilamniir . Where the Old Road splits off and leads to the Nameless Dungeon there is a guardpost with no less than 25 moon and gold elves from Silverymoon and Evereska . Adventurers who want to visit the Nameless Dungeon will be escorted there only if they have the appropriate token in their possession . Travellers who only want to travel further west along the Old Road will be carefully watched over by the elves . The Old Road gradually switches from a stone - paved road to a well - worn log road , then to a footpath and finally ends in a small grove .

title: Old Road ( Vilhon Reach )
description: Old Road ( Vilhon Reach ) The Old Road was a road in the Vilhon Reach area that runs from Shamph in Chondath , south through the Chondalwood , through Elbulder in Sespech , where it crosses the River Arran , and then further south across the Golden Plains .
description_long: Old Road ( Vilhon Reach ) The Old Road was a road in the Vilhon Reach area that runs from Shamph in Chondath , south through the Chondalwood , through Elbulder in Sespech , where it crosses the River Arran , and then further south across the Golden Plains .

title: Old Shanatar
description: Old Shanatar Once Old Shanatar was home to the powerful dwarven realm of Deep Shanatar . Nowadays only one of Deep Shanatar ' s eight kindoms stand , the rest have been overrun , conquered or simply been destroyed at the hands of drow , mind flayers or duergar . Ranking among the major Underdark domains , Old Shanatar has the most artificial delvings , halls and passages , including works of amazingly huge scale .
description_long: Old Shanatar Once Old Shanatar was home to the powerful dwarven realm of Deep Shanatar . Nowadays only one of Deep Shanatar ' s eight kindoms stand , the rest have been overrun , conquered or simply been destroyed at the hands of drow , mind flayers or duergar . Ranking among the major Underdark domains , Old Shanatar has the most artificial delvings , halls and passages , including works of amazingly huge scale . The domain stretches for hundreds of miles beneath Amn , Tethyr and Calimshan . Just like The Northdark , Old Shanatar has been reasonably well explored and mapped by both its inhabitants and adventurers alike .

title: Old Skull Inn
description: Old Skull Inn The Old Skull Inn was a popular inn in Shadowdale . Ownership . The Old Skull Inn was owned by Jhaele Silvermane .
description_long: Old Skull Inn The Old Skull Inn was a popular inn in Shadowdale . Ownership . The Old Skull Inn was owned by Jhaele Silvermane . As of 1375 DR , Jhaele ' s oldest son , Durgo Silvermane , had taken on the duties as innkeeper of the Old Skull . Interior . It consisted of three floors and a cellar . History . The Old Skull Inn was built in 1280 DR by Buldo Silvermane on top of the ruins of the Twisted Tower Inn . The Old Skull became a common stop for adventurers , merchants , and travelers along the North Ride . During the Zhentarim invasion in 1375 DR , the inn was taken over . Atmosphere . The Old Skull was known for the honesty of its staff , the quality of the food and drink , and its relative safety in the center of Shadowdale . It was also known throughout the Heartlands as one of the best adventuring lairs in all of Faerûn . This reputation led to the term " oldskull " being used outside of the Dalelands to describe an excellent place to drink . Rumors . It was rumored that there were secret passages beneath The Old Skull Inn that lead to The Old Skull Tor and eventually to the Underdark .

title: Old Skull Tor
description: Old Skull Tor The Old Skull Tor was a large , bare hill shaped like a massive dome just north of the village of Shadowdale . The tor was a spur of gnarled volcanic rock . Lichen and thick tufts of grass grew out of the many cracks and fissures .
description_long: Old Skull Tor The Old Skull Tor was a large , bare hill shaped like a massive dome just north of the village of Shadowdale . The tor was a spur of gnarled volcanic rock . Lichen and thick tufts of grass grew out of the many cracks and fissures . Beneath the tor were entrances to the Underdark . Inhabitants . While no one lived on the tor itself , folk could often be found in the area . Shadowfolk use the tor for activities such as laundry drying and a trysting ground . The tor was also used as a sheep pasture . The tomb of Joadath was located atop the tor .

title: Old Staff
description: Old Staff The Old Staff was Azuth ' s favored weapon . Description . Both ends of the wooden , rune - scribed staff were shod in iron .
description_long: Old Staff The Old Staff was Azuth ' s favored weapon . Description . Both ends of the wooden , rune - scribed staff were shod in iron . At the top a fist - sized sapphire pulsed with enormous arcane energies . History . In 1385 DR , Zasian Menz ( serving Cyric ) and Kashada ( serving Shar ) traveled to Dweomerheart and were able to steal the Old Staff . Cyric subsequently used the Old Staff to slay Mystra , causing the Realms - wide catastrophe known as the Spellplague . After the Spellplague , Asmodeus somehow got the Old Staff and handed it to Bryseis Kakistos as part of their covenant .
