In 1400 DR , after Bryseis turned against Asmodeus , she gave the Old Staff to Caisys and told him to hide it so Asmodeus didn ' t have the opportunity to use Azuth ' s powers to the fullest . Caisys hided it in a cave of the Dead Stone Mountains , in the world of Abeir . In 1487 DR , as part of a plan to separate the gods Asmodeus and Azuth , Farideh and her allies went to the Dead Stone Mountains and Isltan Nyaril , Chosen of Azuth , retrieved the Old Staff . After Isltan sacrificed his life to bring back Azuth , the God of Wizards was able to claim his staff at last .

title: Old Stone Keep
description: Old Stone Keep Old Stone Keep was a ruined keep and city found in the Utter East in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Old Stone Keep stood atop the high mountains east of Doegan .
description_long: Old Stone Keep Old Stone Keep was a ruined keep and city found in the Utter East in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Old Stone Keep stood atop the high mountains east of Doegan . It was accessible through the Serpent Valley to the north . Description . Old Stone Keep was at one time a mighty city , housing an ancient keep . However , at some point , the city fell into ruins . It was stripped of its wealth and resources and was by - and - large forgotten . The keep itself was a stone - built fortification in the west . Spreading out to the west was a city full of gray buildings with flat tops or jade - hued roof tiles , with walls adorned with blue geometric designs . Rings of defensive walls stretched through the city , bearing similar designs . The cobbled roads were choked with weeds . North of the city were swamps and marshes crossed by wooden walkways , bordered by river . On the side lay firmer land , leading up to green hills and stony outcrops . Inhabitants . In addition to the occasional human or undead occupiers , medusa e ( locally called " gorgons " ) lurked in the ruins . Reputation . Old Stone Keep was rumored to contain secrets of arcane magic .

title: Oldstone Hall
description: Oldstone Hall Oldstone Hall was a manor house located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and home of the town ' s lords . Location . The manor house lay in the center of town , on Wheloon Way , opposite the Wheloon Moothouse .
description_long: Oldstone Hall Oldstone Hall was a manor house located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and home of the town ' s lords . Location . The manor house lay in the center of town , on Wheloon Way , opposite the Wheloon Moothouse . Description . Oldstone Hall was the grandest building in Wheloon . Its façade was an impressive edifice of soot - darkened stone , intricately decorated with carved monsters : gargoyle s , gremlin s , jabbrawuk s , satyr s , and wyvern s . It was built in the style of early Cormyrean manor houses , of palatial size and almost a castle , suggesting old pride , old wealth , and old entitlement . It was surrounded by large paddock of lush , well - groomed grass , dotted with many big and old duskwood , oak , and shadowtop trees . This was , in turn , enclosed by high stone walls and a set of gates . Stone monsters on plinths also flanked the gates and rested on the walls . Defenses . The gates were warded against unauthorized visitors by " ring ward " s that triggered a warning alarm if contacted . Of the stone monsters guarding the walls and manor , the gargoyles were said to animate if commanded by the lord of Wheloon or the Court Wizard of Cormyr .

title: Oleff Uskar
description: Oleff Uskar Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar was a priest of Tyr who presided over the civil court of Neverwinter known as the Hall of Justice . While practicing what was considered " low justice " , Oleff was assisted by Prior Hlam . Appendix .
description_long: Oleff Uskar Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar was a priest of Tyr who presided over the civil court of Neverwinter known as the Hall of Justice . While practicing what was considered " low justice " , Oleff was assisted by Prior Hlam . Appendix . Notes . Oleff Uskar ' s race is uncertain . In both " Volo ' s Guide to the North " and the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition ( revised ) " , as well as the game " Neverwinter Nights " , Uskar was portrayed as a human . In " " , he is presented as a gnome .

title: Oleg
description: Oleg Oleg was a half - orc smith in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Oleg was a very able weaponsmith but few in the town trusted a half - orc enough to enter his shop .
description_long: Oleg Oleg was a half - orc smith in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Oleg was a very able weaponsmith but few in the town trusted a half - orc enough to enter his shop . Mostly , people threw garbage against his windows . Despite this , Oleg was the most patient and calm individual in Daggerford .

title: Oleg One - Ear
description: Oleg One - Ear Oleg One - Ear was a male human and the proprietor of the tavern called The Dragons ' Den in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Although Oleg didn ' t plan it , the tavern was taken over by the rowdy Purple Dragons garrison in town . However , he was a practical man who knew to mind his own business .
description_long: Oleg One - Ear Oleg One - Ear was a male human and the proprietor of the tavern called The Dragons ' Den in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Although Oleg didn ' t plan it , the tavern was taken over by the rowdy Purple Dragons garrison in town . However , he was a practical man who knew to mind his own business .

title: Olgarth Oldbridle
description: Olgarth Oldbridle Olgarth Oldbridle was a noble in Cormyr and a lord . History . Around 1479 DR , Lord Olgarth was invited to the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth .
description_long: Olgarth Oldbridle Olgarth Oldbridle was a noble in Cormyr and a lord . History . Around 1479 DR , Lord Olgarth was invited to the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth . He went with his bodyguard Burrath but just after they entered the mansion an order of assassins targeted them . He was killed in the fighting . Relationship . Olgarth was a member of the faction led by Traevyn Illance .

title: Olgerkhan
description: Olgerkhan Olgerkhan was a half - orc warrior living in Palischuk in Vaasa . Appearance . Olgerkhan ' s features favored his orcish half with wide eyes in a tusky face ; his lip twisted as a result of his huge , uneven canines ; anbd his thick forehead being adorned with a singular bushy brow over bloodshot eyes .
description_long: Olgerkhan Olgerkhan was a half - orc warrior living in Palischuk in Vaasa . Appearance . Olgerkhan ' s features favored his orcish half with wide eyes in a tusky face ; his lip twisted as a result of his huge , uneven canines ; anbd his thick forehead being adorned with a singular bushy brow over bloodshot eyes . His nose was flat and crooked , his face marked by small and uneven patches of hair . Olgerkhan was not very tall , somewhere between five - and - a - half and six feet ( 1 . 7 to 1 . 8 meters ) . He appeared much larger though , for his limbs and chest were thick and strong . Character . Although not overly smart , Olgerkhan was very polite , respectful , and protective of his love , Arrayan Faylin . He also displayed a sort of wisdom and simplistic insightfulness . History . Olgerkhan almost died defending Arrayan from being killed by Athrogate and Canthan Doolittle . He was saved by Artemis Entreri through the vampiric powers of Artemis ' dagger , consuming the life - force of Canthan and giving it to Olgerkhan .

title: Olhydra
description: Olhydra Olhydra , the Princess of Evil Water , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . In her natural state , she appeared as a huge cresting wave with two eyes like large pearl s or as a shapeless watery mass about 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: Olhydra Olhydra , the Princess of Evil Water , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . In her natural state , she appeared as a huge cresting wave with two eyes like large pearl s or as a shapeless watery mass about 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) in diameter . Personality . Olhydra delighted in creating dangerous and destructive manifestations of water . She was eager to smash any vessel in her realm and destroy any city and town within her reach . She could surge forth tirelessly and relentlessly , but was patient enough to know when to draw back and when to attack , eroding her opponent . Of all the Princes of Elemental Evil , she was the most interested in mortals . She recognized pirates and seafaring raiders as her agents , whether they knew it or not , because they reddened the water with blood and occasionally dropped treasure into her clutches . She sometimes spared the worst of them , knowing they would deliver others to her . Activities . She sought to turn the world into an endless , nightmarish ocean . Relationships . Neither Olhydra nor her followers were fond of Imix and his followers .

title: Olin
description: Olin Olin was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Olin was an adventurer with bad luck .
description_long: Olin Olin was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Olin was an adventurer with bad luck . That all changed when he and his fellows discovered a large amount of money . Olin decided to retire in the first place he came across : Daggerford .

title: Olin Gisir
description: Olin Gisir Olin Gisir means " secret keeper " in Elven , which is precisely what these scholar - mages were . Elven lifespans were many times those of humans , and this brought along with it secrets that were best left secret . Background .
description_long: Olin Gisir Olin Gisir means " secret keeper " in Elven , which is precisely what these scholar - mages were . Elven lifespans were many times those of humans , and this brought along with it secrets that were best left secret . Background . Olin Gisiae were elite elven or half - elven lorekeepers who took it upon themselves to protect dark secrets and ancient magics from those who would have exploited them , making them much like the Cult of the Shattered Peak in that respect .

title: Olisara Lightsong
description: Olisara Lightsong Olisara Lightsong was a Harper agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Olisara was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair .
description_long: Olisara Lightsong Olisara Lightsong was a Harper agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Olisara was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair . The Harper ' s objective was to recover the belongings of a Harper agent killed by the dragon . In 1491 DR Olisara was in Mulmaster as a lead Harper agent for the Moonsea region and possibly asked some adventurers hired by Blade Cora Peytir to save a member of the Cult of the Black Earth who wanted to defect to the Harpers . During the Rage of Demons Olisara was near Hillsfar and hired an adventuring party to investigate some cases of kidnapped farmers in the area , possibly related to the Red Plumes . Personality . Olisara was a wise lead agent . She was a direct individual with a dry sense of humor . Olisara displayed an almost disconcerting amount of knowledge regarding those with whom she held audience using this to bend them to her agenda .

title: Olive Ruskettle
description: Olive Ruskettle Olive Ruskettle was a halfling thief who always aspired to a life of entertaining people and the easy living that profession could bring . History . Her true name was unknown .
description_long: Olive Ruskettle Olive Ruskettle was a halfling thief who always aspired to a life of entertaining people and the easy living that profession could bring . History . Her true name was unknown . She won the name and reputation of Olav Ruskettle , a true and famous bard , in a dice game . Since then Olive did her best to maintain her image as a bard of great talent . Over the years she has been cornered by well - traveled folks who claim to have seen the ' real ' Olav Ruskettle perform , each time she managed to lie her way out of the confrontation . Ruskettle was unique even among halflings , due to her height of less than three feet . Simply by putting on a pair of shoes , she could be mistaken for a human toddler . Unknown even to her at the time , Olive became a Harper when Finder gave her his harper pin in the presence of Elminster Aumar .

title: Ollamh harp
description: Ollamh harp An Ollamh harp was a masterwork magic harp and the most powerful of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Ollamh harps " were superior in every way to ordinary harps .
description_long: Ollamh harp An Ollamh harp was a masterwork magic harp and the most powerful of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Ollamh harps " were superior in every way to ordinary harps . Like other Instruments of the Bards , they could only be used properly by bard s , and could be dangerous if anyone else attempted to play or even carry them . Powers . Bards wielding an " Ollamh harp " had their charming abilities greatly amplified by their magic , in the same way that " Anstruth harp s " did . Like all Instruments of the Bards , these harps had the capability of storing spells . A bard playing an " Ollamh harp " could invoke the spells " Fly " , " Invisibility " , " Levitate " , " Protection from evil and good " , " Confusion " , " Control weather " and " Fire storm " each once a day , until the instrument recharged its magic at the next dawn . History . The first " Ollamh harps " were created by a legendary bard in the Moonshae Isles named Falataer . He used them to test and reward the students of the Ollamh level of his bardic college , which came to be regarded individually as a legendary bard college in its own right .

title: Ollarent Hillgreen
description: Ollarent Hillgreen Ollarent Hillgreen was the assistant to Old Night Shalara Swordshigh at the main library of the Heralds of Faerûn , known as Herald ' s Holdfast , around the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . As an assistant to one of the High Heralds , Ollarent also belonged to the Heralds Pursuivant . He was the senior sage in charge of the Library of Man .
description_long: Ollarent Hillgreen Ollarent Hillgreen was the assistant to Old Night Shalara Swordshigh at the main library of the Heralds of Faerûn , known as Herald ' s Holdfast , around the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . As an assistant to one of the High Heralds , Ollarent also belonged to the Heralds Pursuivant . He was the senior sage in charge of the Library of Man . He fiercely guarded the knowledge under his care and would only give secrets away if directed by Old Night . He required a trade of some historic work or artifact for his information — it was never for sale .

title: Olleth
description: Olleth Through out the Age of Humanity the Arcanum of Olleth was the major morkoth country in Serôs . Early into the Era of Upheaval and after the Spellplague , Olleth is now ruled by the Kuo - toa . History .
description_long: Olleth Through out the Age of Humanity the Arcanum of Olleth was the major morkoth country in Serôs . Early into the Era of Upheaval and after the Spellplague , Olleth is now ruled by the Kuo - toa . History . Olleth was founded in 911 DR . Sometime late in the 14th century of Dale Reckoning the morkoth ambushed a kuo - toa delegation under a truce vouchsafed by Blibdoolpoolp . Half of the kuo - toa were eaten and the rest were kept as slaves . However , several of the surviving kuo - toa were whips of Blibdoolpoolp and started a massive campaign of setbacks , uprisings and disasters . In 1385 DR the Spellplauge struck Olleth and a third of the morkoth mages dissolved in blue flashes . The remaining morkoth lost their grip on the spells they used to enslave others . The kuo - toa moved quickly to seize control of Olleth . Most of the morkoth were killed , though a few escaped and the kuo - toa kept most of the slaves . Afterwords kuo - toa migrated into Serôs for the first time . In 1393 DR several kuo - toa left Olleth and founded the colony of Taunissik

title: Olmaer Naxrin
description: Olmaer Naxrin Olmaer Naxrin was a traveling merchant that traded in Sembia . He occasionally traveled to Voonlar to oversee investments for the Zhentarim . Description .
description_long: Olmaer Naxrin Olmaer Naxrin was a traveling merchant that traded in Sembia . He occasionally traveled to Voonlar to oversee investments for the Zhentarim . Description . Olmaer moved with catlike grace and usually spoke quietly and diplomatically . Personality . He was merciless when the need arose . He killed quickly and efficiently , often using poisoned weapons . Abilities . Olmaer was both nimble and strong , and a specialist with the longsword . Possessions . He wore " bracers of defense " , a " ring of protection " and wielded a longsword . He also had a hand crossbow and a poisoned dart gun . Activities . Olmaer was an agent of the Zhentarim that traveled to Voonlar as part of his itinerary . He gathered intelligence and kept an eye on Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl and his deputies , occasionally making suggestions that were carried out like orders .

title: Ologh
description: Ologh Ologh was a male orc and Overking of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . At some point , Ologh rose to the position of Overking of Vastar .
description_long: Ologh Ologh was a male orc and Overking of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . At some point , Ologh rose to the position of Overking of Vastar . He created a throne for himself and the title , holding court from the Hollow Mountain . However , Ologh the Overking was killed by the black dragon Iyrauroth , dying to the wyrm ' s claws and fangs , in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR , leaving the position vacant . With that , Vastar descended into civil war as orcish factions battled for control across the land . Description . Ologh was described as a " monstrous " orc . Possessions . The Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking was his famous battle standard and an important military artifact .

title: Ologhyn
description: Ologhyn Ologhyn of Voonlar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Ologhyn was known for his collection of rare and strange wands .
description_long: Ologhyn Ologhyn of Voonlar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Ologhyn was known for his collection of rare and strange wands .

title: Olostin ' s Hold
description: Olostin ' s Hold Olostin ' s Hold was a fortified keep , between Everlund and Yartar just off the Evermoor Way located in the northwest edges of the High Forest . Description . Olostin ' s Hold was home to about 200 people and provided security for about 600 farmers and ranchers in the surrounding area .
description_long: Olostin ' s Hold Olostin ' s Hold was a fortified keep , between Everlund and Yartar just off the Evermoor Way located in the northwest edges of the High Forest . Description . Olostin ' s Hold was home to about 200 people and provided security for about 600 farmers and ranchers in the surrounding area . It was the only permanent human settlement in the High Forest . This particular section of the High Forest was sometimes referred to as Turlang ' s Wood . The locals were very careful to not irritate the forces of the forest . The woodcutters cut down dead trees only . History . In 1372 DR circa , the inhabitants had difficulties facing the troll s driven away from the Evermoors down to the south ; due to these monstrous predators the road between Yartar and Everlund became very dangerous .

title: Olothon
description: Olothon Olothon was an elder dragonborn shaman , and the leader of Wandering Stones as of 1479 DR . Description . Olothon had turquoise scales .
description_long: Olothon Olothon was an elder dragonborn shaman , and the leader of Wandering Stones as of 1479 DR . Description . Olothon had turquoise scales . Background . As of 1479 DR , Olothon was the " Stonetalker " of Wandering Stones . As such , Olothon was the one in charge of talking with the stones that composed the corpse of the primordial Arambar ( in truth , the spirits of the dead who gathered around those stones ) , and to protect the village and act as leader for its people . He was good friends with Carnelian , a very old and wise spirit . History . In 1479 DR , Olothon met with Jada Marlserpent , the last member of Clan Marlserpent and one of the fabled dragonheir s , who went to Wandering Stones to learn about her past . That same day , the brown dragon Thovantareth attacked the village , forcing Olothon and Jada to seek shelter in the stones that composed Arambar ' s corpse . Olothon was one of the few individuals who witnessed the primordial awaken and kill the dragon . After that , Olothon accepted Jada as one of the inhabitants of Wandering Stones .

title: Olway Lezard
description: Olway Lezard Olway Lezard was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Olway led the Gray Doom mercenary company .
description_long: Olway Lezard Olway Lezard was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Olway led the Gray Doom mercenary company . History . They survived many skirmishes on the Sword Coast . In 1358 DR , Olway led his men to the city of Timindar in Chondath , having been hired by Lord Reland Tymin . Olway and his men were waiting the arrival of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea in order to attack the enemy but in the meantime they all drunk a lot at the Black Eye inn . Olway provoked Araband Tymin . Later he became involved in the Battle of Thurgabanteth .

title: Olwen Forest - Friend
description: Olwen Forest - Friend Olwen Forest - Friend was a human ranger . Appearance . Olwen was a bear of a man with a muscular chest and his arms bulging with muscles who often spoke with a booming voice .
description_long: Olwen Forest - Friend Olwen Forest - Friend was a human ranger . Appearance . Olwen was a bear of a man with a muscular chest and his arms bulging with muscles who often spoke with a booming voice . He usually wore a forest - green cloak . Combat . Olwen ' s weapon of choice was his mighty enchanted war axe , Treefeller . For many years , his favorite weapon was the bow , but with age his agility decreased . Instead , he discovered the thrill of close combat and mastered this technique with his mighty axe . Background . Olwen was the duke of Soravia . The seat of power and Olwen ' s home was at Kinbrace . The famous ranger Mariabronne was his protégé for many years , being as a son to him .

title: Olympus
description: Olympus Olympus , also called Arborea on the planes , and later known better by its elvish name Arvandor , was the Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model embodying the disorganized but well - intentioned motives of the chaotic good alignment . Although the gods of Olympus and Toril occasionally interacted , the people of Toril rarely concerned themselves with the affairs of the Olympians and vice versa . Memories of Olympus eventually faded and by the time the World Tree cosmology was introduced Arvandor was the accepted name for this plane .
description_long: Olympus Olympus , also called Arborea on the planes , and later known better by its elvish name Arvandor , was the Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model embodying the disorganized but well - intentioned motives of the chaotic good alignment . Although the gods of Olympus and Toril occasionally interacted , the people of Toril rarely concerned themselves with the affairs of the Olympians and vice versa . Memories of Olympus eventually faded and by the time the World Tree cosmology was introduced Arvandor was the accepted name for this plane . Some characteristics and deities originally belonging to Olympus / Arvandor were ascribed to the World Tree plane of Brightwater . Arvandor survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology . Description . This plane had three layers with unique landscapes : Olympus / Arvandor . Two realms , so vast and influential that their names became synonymous with the plane and the layer they occupied , coexisted with little conflict : Olympus , home of the Greek pantheon , and Arvandor , domain of the Seldarine .

title: Oma el Catahras
description: Oma el Catahras Oma yr Raisa el Catahras was the daughter of the innkeeper of The Roving Rune in Teshburl and an aspiring spellcaster and adventuress . In 1370 DR , Oma was being trained by her mother in the magical arts in the hidden basement of her father ' s inn . Oma kept her arcane talents secret , but she longed to finish her schooling so she could explore the world as an adventuress .
description_long: Oma el Catahras Oma yr Raisa el Catahras was the daughter of the innkeeper of The Roving Rune in Teshburl and an aspiring spellcaster and adventuress . In 1370 DR , Oma was being trained by her mother in the magical arts in the hidden basement of her father ' s inn . Oma kept her arcane talents secret , but she longed to finish her schooling so she could explore the world as an adventuress .

title: Oman
description: Oman Oman Island was an isle near the center of the Moonshae archipelago . Prior to the Spellplague the island was a center of Northlander culture and was under control of the Kendrick dynasty . After the Spellplague , a group of Fomorian giants entered through a gate from the Feywild and conquered the island .
description_long: Oman Oman Island was an isle near the center of the Moonshae archipelago . Prior to the Spellplague the island was a center of Northlander culture and was under control of the Kendrick dynasty . After the Spellplague , a group of Fomorian giants entered through a gate from the Feywild and conquered the island . The Fomorians were ruled by Queen Connomae who lived in the Feywild . Due to the Formorian presence the island was nearly uninhabited by civilized races .

title: Omar al - Farid
description: Omar al - Farid Omar al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Omar was more a follower than a leader , trusting in his sister ' s judgement in most matters .
description_long: Omar al - Farid Omar al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Omar was more a follower than a leader , trusting in his sister ' s judgement in most matters . Description . Omar was a chubby man who had a round face . He wore dark clothing to match his hair and eyes . History . Omar ' s parents were killed when he was still a child , forcing him and his sister Fadiya to fend for themselves on the streets of Hiyal until they were welcomed by the Everlasting .

title: Omar bin Omar
description: Omar bin Omar Omar bin Omar was a member of the Dancing Dwarves who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Omar tied his long hair and beard into braids that spun around during his dances .
description_long: Omar bin Omar Omar bin Omar was a member of the Dancing Dwarves who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Omar tied his long hair and beard into braids that spun around during his dances . Activities . Omar was a dervish , meaning he could only access his clerical powers after completing a wild dance . He performed these dances in the " suqs " of Huzuz in front of a live cobra . The cobra became hypnotized by Omar ' s movements , but the clever dwarf sewed the snake ' s mouth shut just in case . The cobra would eventually starve to death , but a nearly unlimited supply could be found in the wilds surrounding the city .

title: Ombedor Steen
description: Ombedor Steen Ombedor Steen was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He was a wizard and a former adventurer who been elevated to the city ' s nobility . As an old man , he studied history , researched esoteric details of magical theory , and developed new spell s .
description_long: Ombedor Steen Ombedor Steen was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He was a wizard and a former adventurer who been elevated to the city ' s nobility . As an old man , he studied history , researched esoteric details of magical theory , and developed new spell s .

title: Ombul Berrypip
description: Ombul Berrypip Ombul Berrypip was a halfling cook in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Ombul lived with his daughter , Lupe Berrypip .
description_long: Ombul Berrypip Ombul Berrypip was a halfling cook in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Ombul lived with his daughter , Lupe Berrypip . He was sent to the mine in the Earthspurs as a cook . When a medusa and her gargoyle minions took control of the mine , Ombul was captured along with many miners , until an adventuring party hired to clear the mine found and rescued them .

title: Omlar gem
description: Omlar gem Omlar gems were exceptionally rare gems mined from the Omlarandin Mountains in Tethyr . Description . Omlars were rock crystals with about the same hardness and color as aquamarine s and could also be mistaken for emerald s of a lighter shade .
description_long: Omlar gem Omlar gems were exceptionally rare gems mined from the Omlarandin Mountains in Tethyr . Description . Omlars were rock crystals with about the same hardness and color as aquamarine s and could also be mistaken for emerald s of a lighter shade . Powers . Omlar gems had the ability to easily absorb enchantments , which made them a coveted component of many a wizard ' s powerful magical items . Source . These gems were only found deep in the hills and mountains of the Omlarandins and were so rare even there that only a few were found every hundred years . Reputation . Because of their rarity and powers , omlar gems fetched sums of money worthy of princes and were sought out by wizards in Duhlnarim , Llorbauth , Saradush , and Zazesspur . Notable uses . Omlar gems were used in the construction of the minarets lining the Trade Way in the Calim Desert from Calimport to Memnon during the Shoon Imperium . These minarets were erected in pairs , one on each side of the road . On the rooftop parapets of each of these 40 - ft - high ( 12 m ) towers , a fist - sized omlar gem was placed above a brass brazier .

title: Omlarandin Mountains
description: Omlarandin Mountains The Omlarandin Mountains were a mountain range in Tethyr and Erlkazar , known for its richness in omlar gem s , which had a variety of magical uses . Etymology . The name " omlarandin " is a corruption of Dwarvish " olaramorndin " , which means " magical peaks " .
description_long: Omlarandin Mountains The Omlarandin Mountains were a mountain range in Tethyr and Erlkazar , known for its richness in omlar gem s , which had a variety of magical uses . Etymology . The name " omlarandin " is a corruption of Dwarvish " olaramorndin " , which means " magical peaks " . Geography . The Omlarandin Mountains were a cluster of lightly forested mountains located in the highlands in the east of Tethyr . They were the smallest grouping of mountains that were part of the greater Iltkazar Range and — with only a few exceptions — were little higher than the foothills around them . The Omlarandins were most famous for being the only known source of omlar gems in Faerûn , though only a few were ever discovered in a given century . One notable rock formation in the mountains was called Orators ' Crag , due to its strange acoustics . Anyone whispering from the small outcropping in the cliff could be heard within the tiny valley below . The crag overlooked the upper waters of the Idolflow river . The Levast River also had its headwaters in the northern reaches of the mountains . Inhabitants . The Omlarandins were the most populated mountains in Tethyr after the fall of Iltkazar .

title: Ommlur Hills
description: Ommlur Hills The Ommlur Hills were the foothills of the Small Teeth located on the west side of the Trade Way . Description . The hills were noted for their pristine beauty .
description_long: Ommlur Hills The Ommlur Hills were the foothills of the Small Teeth located on the west side of the Trade Way . Description . The hills were noted for their pristine beauty . They included many waterfalls and pleasant flood plains . History . These hills were named after a famous Amn ian poet who lived during the second century of the Shoon Imperium and wrote about the pastoral beauty of the hills .

title: Omskilar Rethwood
description: Omskilar Rethwood Omskilar Rethwood was an outlaw as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He loved to kill , often slaying specific individuals with a single crossbow bolt .
description_long: Omskilar Rethwood Omskilar Rethwood was an outlaw as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He loved to kill , often slaying specific individuals with a single crossbow bolt . Failing this , Omskilar would attach a scroll with a message to a bolt ' s shaft in order to intimidate targets . Abilities . Along with all of the other members of the Company of the Cloak , Burtar possessed an immunity to oil of taggit ( which caused memory loss ) .

title: Onan
description: Onan Onan of Tyr was a priest of Neverwinter . Biography . Onan went to investigate disturbances at the Tomb of the Betrayers , though he got trapped by the undead .
description_long: Onan Onan of Tyr was a priest of Neverwinter . Biography . Onan went to investigate disturbances at the Tomb of the Betrayers , though he got trapped by the undead . The Kalach - Cha and the companions could ' ve rescued him and get him out of the tomb .

title: Ondal
description: Ondal Ondal was a wizard who lived in the heartlands prior to the spellplague . He was best known as a vintner who made very good wine . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor was destroyed and the mage disappeared and was thought to have perished .
description_long: Ondal Ondal was a wizard who lived in the heartlands prior to the spellplague . He was best known as a vintner who made very good wine . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor was destroyed and the mage disappeared and was thought to have perished . Several wagonloads of Ondal ' s wine survived destruction and were recovered . These bottles contained wild magic which was released when the bottles were opened . Personality . Most accounts depicted Ondal as a kindly wizard .

title: Ondal ' s wine
description: Ondal ' s wine Ondal ' s wine were white or golden wine s made by the mage and vintner Ondal prior to the spellplague . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor and most of his wine cellar was destroyed . A few wagonloads of wine escaped destruction and these were soon recovered and disbursed throughout the Realms .
description_long: Ondal ' s wine Ondal ' s wine were white or golden wine s made by the mage and vintner Ondal prior to the spellplague . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor and most of his wine cellar was destroyed . A few wagonloads of wine escaped destruction and these were soon recovered and disbursed throughout the Realms . The wine was noteworthy in that the spellplague infused wild magic into the bottles and , whenever a bottle was opened , uncontrolled destructive magic was released . Numerous groups attempted to find the remaining bottles and either destroy them or use them for nefarious purposes .

title: Ondar
description: Ondar Ondar was a farmer in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , he lost six head of cattle to some gnoll s .
description_long: Ondar Ondar was a farmer in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , he lost six head of cattle to some gnoll s . Soon after , on Uktar 10 , Ondar was invited by his best friend Tadaz to the Blue Badger Inn in order to honor Tadaz ' s son Tural heading off to join Tethyr ' s new army at Riatavin . He was there when three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , arrived , seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " .

title: Ondeth Obarskyr
description: Ondeth Obarskyr Ondeth Obarskyr was responsible for creating the settlement in the area known as the Forest Country that would later become known as Suzail , the capital of the nation of Cormyr . Relatives . Ondeth ' s wife was Suzara Obarskyr .
description_long: Ondeth Obarskyr Ondeth Obarskyr was responsible for creating the settlement in the area known as the Forest Country that would later become known as Suzail , the capital of the nation of Cormyr . Relatives . Ondeth ' s wife was Suzara Obarskyr . He had an older brother ( Andar ) who was killed in a boar hunt in Impiltur , a younger brother , Villiam Obarskyr , and two sons , Rhiiman and Faerlthann Obarskyr . Background . In 6 DR , Ondeth moved from Impiltur with his wife , brother and sons to a glen in the wolf woods ( the future site of Suzail ) where they sought to create a new life . After four months , Baerauble Etharr introduced himself and Ondeth asked to be shown the elves living in the forest . Baerauble took Ondeth to an elven hunt in which Ondeth was able to participate , which was to prove an important first meeting . After Suzara left in 12 DR , taking Rhiiman with her , Ondeth began seeing Minda Bleth , the sister of another settler to come to the new settlement , Mondar Bleth .

title: Ondonti
description: Ondonti Ondontis are a rare race closely related to orc s , brought up to be pacifists . The members of the race known as the ondontis are close cousins to orcs . However , the ondontis live as peaceful farmers and gatherers , taking only what they need from the land to survive .
description_long: Ondonti Ondontis are a rare race closely related to orc s , brought up to be pacifists . The members of the race known as the ondontis are close cousins to orcs . However , the ondontis live as peaceful farmers and gatherers , taking only what they need from the land to survive . In outward appearances , ondontis resemble orcs . History . The ondontis dwell north of The Ride , in a secluded part of the Tortured Land . These close cousins to the gray orc embraced the worship Eldath centuries ago . Scattered tribes of ondontis lived peaceful lives until a scouting party from Zhentil Keep stumbled across them in 1340 DR . Because ondontis lived by peaceful and collaborative philosophy , they were not prepared for treachery , and shortly after the initial meeting between Zhents and ondontis , the majority of the ondonti population , with the exception of one isolated tribe out of 15 , was betrayed by the Zhents and kidnapped into slavery . The final tribe left was said to have been guarded by a divine servant of Eldath , whom all of the tribes worshiped , and the divine magic of Ondonti cleric s . Very few ondontis have since then escaped further raids .

title: Ondrath Everwood
description: Ondrath Everwood Ondrath Everwood was a best " tracker " among the War Wizards of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Manshoon decided he needed him in order to uncover the killer inside Castle Irlingstar .
description_long: Ondrath Everwood Ondrath Everwood was a best " tracker " among the War Wizards of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Manshoon decided he needed him in order to uncover the killer inside Castle Irlingstar . Therefore , thanks to a distraction provided by some eyeball s , Manshoon managed to dominate Everwood ' s mind and send him on the hunt . However , his first duty for Manshoon was to eliminate the War Wizard Malver Tulbard , who was investigating Sraunter . He tried to kill Malver at Gocklin ' s dining place , but the intervention of Lord Tauntshaw saved Malver ' s life . Later , Manshoon decided to use Ondrath as his main body . However , Ondrath died when Elminster Aumar , after regaining his true body , destroyed Manshoon for the final time .

title: Ondrin Dracohorn
description: Ondrin Dracohorn Ondrin Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . Appearance . Ondrin was short with ordinary looks and pale blue eyes .
description_long: Ondrin Dracohorn Ondrin Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . Appearance . Ondrin was short with ordinary looks and pale blue eyes . He always dressed in current fashions , and possessed a large metal brooch with a two - headed serpent and three swords . Background . Ondrin rose to prominence by buying up property in Cormyr using the money from his shipping business based in Marsember and Saerloon . There were rumors that Ondrin partook in smuggling , piracy and slaving to make a bigger profit . Ondrin was known for not being able to keep his mouth shut . In 1369 DR , during the abraxus affair , Ondrin met secretly with High Wizard Vangerdahast to discuss his proposal to transfer the power of Cormyr to a council of noble houses , making Vangerdahast into a regent , via a voting system .

title: One - Armed Magurk ' s
description: One - Armed Magurk ' s One - Armed Magurk ' s was a shop in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR run by Magurk . Magurk purchased — no questions asked — goods looted by adventurers from ruins and dungeons found within the untamed wildernesses around Thunderstone : the Hullack Forest , the Thunder Peaks , and the Vast Swamp . He sold it on in his store , and thus his selection varied greatly over time , but generally included a varied collection of artworks , gems , and jewelry ; weapons and armor ; books ; and used equipment .
description_long: One - Armed Magurk ' s One - Armed Magurk ' s was a shop in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR run by Magurk . Magurk purchased — no questions asked — goods looted by adventurers from ruins and dungeons found within the untamed wildernesses around Thunderstone : the Hullack Forest , the Thunder Peaks , and the Vast Swamp . He sold it on in his store , and thus his selection varied greatly over time , but generally included a varied collection of artworks , gems , and jewelry ; weapons and armor ; books ; and used equipment . As Magurk was a former soldier of the Purple Dragons , the local contingent kept a close watch on the store .

title: One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs
description: One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs was a book listing the proverbs of a Dalai Lama of the Padhran religion in Ra - Khati . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR .
description_long: One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs was a book listing the proverbs of a Dalai Lama of the Padhran religion in Ra - Khati . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR .

title: One - way lantern
description: One - way lantern A one - way lantern was a magical lantern that projected a light only the bearer could see . Description . It was small lantern fashioned of fine copper , set with a dark ruby in its center .
description_long: One - way lantern A one - way lantern was a magical lantern that projected a light only the bearer could see . Description . It was small lantern fashioned of fine copper , set with a dark ruby in its center . Powers . The lantern appeared to project a kind of " one - way " light , visible only to those who grasped the handle and completely unseen by all others . For those who could see it , the lantern radiated bright light to a distance of 30 feet ( 9 meters ) , like a " light " spell . The light hampered the infravision of one who grasped , but not the infravision of others . Owing to the size of the lantern , only three human - sized creatures could try to hold the lantern at once . History . The Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist came across a " one - way lantern " on an expedition in the 1360s DR . He wrote details of it in his spellbook " Daltim ' s Tome of Fire " , which he lost in Tethyr in the 1360s DR . It was possible that more " one - way lanterns " might be traded in Faerûn or lost in old treasure hoards . Usage .

title: One Stone
description: One Stone One Stone was an ancestor mound for the Golden Eagle and Sky Pony tribes in the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . Instead of an altar mound at the center of the cairn rings , there was a single massive boulder 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: One Stone One Stone was an ancestor mound for the Golden Eagle and Sky Pony tribes in the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . Instead of an altar mound at the center of the cairn rings , there was a single massive boulder 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) across and 12 ft ( 3 . 7 m ) high and covered in precisely engraved tracery . Carved steps ascended the south face to the altar top . Rumors and Legends . One legend told of a god who sealed a passageway from the Nine Hells with a single rock thrust into the ground . Some wonder if the evil sealed beneath the stone caused the deaths of the tribes and darker tales said the tribes dwelt under the stone within the portal . History . In the past , Lycanthrope s of Claw Hollow , fulfilled sudden attacks to the Sky Pony Tribe on pilgrimage to this holy place to celebrate their ancestors . Sky Pony barbarians therefore had started attacking strangers on sight .

title: One Thousand Broken Dreams
description: One Thousand Broken Dreams One Thousand Broken Dreams is a unique magic + 3 mithral holy drow bane elven longsword . History . It is thousands of years old and was made by the elf Datharian Mistwatcher when his home city was destroyed by the drow .
description_long: One Thousand Broken Dreams One Thousand Broken Dreams is a unique magic + 3 mithral holy drow bane elven longsword . History . It is thousands of years old and was made by the elf Datharian Mistwatcher when his home city was destroyed by the drow . After Datharian was slain in battle , the sword came to a female elf known only as the Stargazer , and she slew hundreds of drow with it . When she realized her sister had been killed in the Battle of Nine Arrows , she died of grief , whereupon another elf picked up the sword . It has been in the possession of many different elves since then . Description . The sword harms evil creatures who touch it and it is rumored if the longsword is held by a good drow , it will shatter into a thousand shards of moonstone , each worth around 50 gp , and would cast " atonement " on the drow . The blade is worth around 100 , 315 gp .

title: One who waits
description: One who waits A nameless creature described as the one who waits lingered in an unknown planar location thought to be somewhere in the Nine Hells . Description . The creature was a gargantuan slug - or worm - like monstrosity , grotesquely fat and sickly green .
description_long: One who waits A nameless creature described as the one who waits lingered in an unknown planar location thought to be somewhere in the Nine Hells . Description . The creature was a gargantuan slug - or worm - like monstrosity , grotesquely fat and sickly green . It had at least three stubby arms , and was topped by a disgusting face , with pointed ears , red eyes , flaring nostrils , and a massive drooling mouth with many fangs . Personality . The one who waits seemed to be rather incurious and lazy . It spoke very crudely . Relationships . The creature was attended by a swarm of flying creatures : gargoyle s and kenku s . It seemed to serve or worship the god Bane , Lord of Tyranny . Realm . Its realm in the Hells was an enormous cavern , where fire seeped from caves and ponds of pale green liquid lay on the ground , and where vapors rose . History . It appeared that the creature had simply lain atop its massive throne for thousands of years , waiting and wishing for power . Then , at last , in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , one side of the subverted Great Door appeared in its realm .

title: Oni mage
description: Oni mage Oni mages , often mistakenly called ogre mages , are powerful , intelligent and cunning oni that possess several potent abilities . Physical description . They often stand 10 ft ( 3 m ) tall and can weigh 700 lb ( 320 kg ) .
description_long: Oni mage Oni mages , often mistakenly called ogre mages , are powerful , intelligent and cunning oni that possess several potent abilities . Physical description . They often stand 10 ft ( 3 m ) tall and can weigh 700 lb ( 320 kg ) . They typically lead oni and other large creatures , both as a mastermind and as a war leader ; their abilities work best with allies . Oni mages are versatile giants that combine physical and magical prowess in combat , using their prodigious strength to deal out significant amounts of damage while relying on its regeneration ability to shrug off wounds . When found in real danger though , they can duck out quickly using " darkness " , " invisibility " , " gaseous form " , or even their ability of flight . Extra . The oni are a race of spellcasting giant s . They are humanoid but often have features that set them apart from normal giants . These can include large horns , extra or missing fingers , a third eye and skin colors that range from red to blue . Given their intelligence and their magical powers , oni prefer to dress as nobility , wearing fine clothing and armor . Despite their intelligence , oni are known to be brutish and wicked .

title: Onoshi
description: Onoshi Onoshi was an inhabitant of the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Onoshi was the son of an Aru fishmonger .
description_long: Onoshi Onoshi was an inhabitant of the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Onoshi was the son of an Aru fishmonger . History . Around 1358 DR , he was paid by a strange to set fire to a peasant ' s minka in the eta area of town . He complied but just after the act , Onoshi was discovered by an adventuring party hired by the daimyo Benju Matsumoto and captured .

title: Onoye
description: Onoye Onoye was a demigod kami in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Onoye was a lesser nature spirit , an earthbound minor deity more goddess than human , of the Wood Spirit people .
description_long: Onoye Onoye was a demigod kami in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Onoye was a lesser nature spirit , an earthbound minor deity more goddess than human , of the Wood Spirit people . She however decided to walk among humans in Kozakura . At one point , Onoye met and befriended the korobokuru Okotampe , who understood her spirit nature and became her travel companion . Later Okotampe and Onoye joined Doin Sanehiro ' s group in fighting against Jinchin . They remained with Doin at the village of Tomobiki after the end of the adventure . Personality . Onoye feared most that people would discover her true nature , as it was forbidden for those not in communion with the Spirit World to know her true nature . Onoye never lied about her condition but revealed only a fragment of her nature ; she and Doin had a complex relationship that ended in a love that could not be requited for Doin . Onoye had gained a complete understanding of the human soul and of the complexity of their societies . However , she was uncurious about some aspects of the material world , like food , money , or shelter .

title: Onsil
description: Onsil The Onsil family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Onsils were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Naskurl families .
description_long: Onsil The Onsil family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Onsils were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Naskurl families .

title: Onsilur Maerdrathom
description: Onsilur Maerdrathom Onsilur Maerdrathom , also called the Ruling Magister , was a wizard inhabiting Sheirtalar during the 4th century DR . He served as Magister from 321 DR to 326 DR . History .
description_long: Onsilur Maerdrathom Onsilur Maerdrathom , also called the Ruling Magister , was a wizard inhabiting Sheirtalar during the 4th century DR . He served as Magister from 321 DR to 326 DR . History . Onsilur assumed the title of Magister after easily slaying Loaradden Derviir after he fell from the sky when Mystra stole his magic mid - flight during a raid on Onsilur ' s home . His first order of business as Magister was to convince the government of Tashalar that all wizards required legal protection and proper standing within the community . The idea of peace , and the prosperity that that would bring , appealed to Tashalar ' s government , but they did not care for potentially taking orders from mages . The rulers of Tashalar decided to hire mages from Mulhorand to eliminate Onsilur the " Ruling Magister " and rid them of their headache . Onsilur successfully defended himself against these strike - and - flee duels until Ansel Burwyth was able to trap his soul within a " kiira " . Thrilled with his success , and lured by the promise of riches stashed within Onsilur ' s Liongirt Tower , Ansel immediately hid the " kiira " and raided Onsilur ' s home .

title: Onthaer
description: Onthaer Onthaer was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Athkatla in Amn . History . Described as " saintly " , Onthaer became a hermit on the lonely , windswept isle of Falconsrise in the Trackless Sea .
description_long: Onthaer Onthaer was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Athkatla in Amn . History . Described as " saintly " , Onthaer became a hermit on the lonely , windswept isle of Falconsrise in the Trackless Sea . There he wrestled and killed the last rock cat on the island with his bare hands .

title: Ontharr Frume
description: Ontharr Frume Ontharr Frume was a paladin of the Order of the Gauntlet and their main delegate at the Council of Waterdeep . Personality . Ontharr was boisterous and gregarious to a fault .
description_long: Ontharr Frume Ontharr Frume was a paladin of the Order of the Gauntlet and their main delegate at the Council of Waterdeep . Personality . Ontharr was boisterous and gregarious to a fault . His dedication to heroic justice created a connection with Sir Isteval ; however , Ontharr had difficulties linking the Isteval of legend to the real man in front of him . History . Ontharr was one of the first to get involved in the Tyranny of Dragons issue . As a friend of Leosin Erlanthar , he provided support to the adventuring party that Leosin befriended in Greenest in their search for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen . When the threat of Severin Silrajin ' s reformed Cult of the Dragon became a global one , Ontharr was chosen as the leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep . Having met them before , he trusted the adventurers recruited to fight the Cult but had to balance his personal convictions with the will of his Order .

title: Onthrilaenthor
description: Onthrilaenthor Onthrilaenthor was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement in the eastern Star Mounts . It was created for the elves by the Ammarindar dwarves and consisted of miles of tunnels and chambers cut into the rock , including vertical shafts to an area near the summit of the southern Star Mounts . The presence of stables near this shaft led to the belief that it was used by the Eaerlanni elves for aerial mounts .
description_long: Onthrilaenthor Onthrilaenthor was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement in the eastern Star Mounts . It was created for the elves by the Ammarindar dwarves and consisted of miles of tunnels and chambers cut into the rock , including vertical shafts to an area near the summit of the southern Star Mounts . The presence of stables near this shaft led to the belief that it was used by the Eaerlanni elves for aerial mounts . Onthrilaenthor was affected by strong winds , sometimes making it difficult to walk through the tunnels . Inhabitants . After its disuse , Onthrilaenthor was inhabited by harpies until they were driven out by the deep dragon Onskarrarrd .

title: Onyx
description: Onyx Onyx was part of the agate family of ornamental stones but was considered a semi - precious stone when found in pure black , pure white , or in straight bands of both colors . Description . This semi - precious stone was carved for jewelry and decorative housewares and was hard enough to wear well .
description_long: Onyx Onyx was part of the agate family of ornamental stones but was considered a semi - precious stone when found in pure black , pure white , or in straight bands of both colors . Description . This semi - precious stone was carved for jewelry and decorative housewares and was hard enough to wear well . It was often used for sculpting figurines ( including the magic " onyx dog " ) . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . There were " nine secrets " that could be enchanted to become an " ioun stone " and onyx was one of them . Physical contact with onyx helped reduce complications and pain during childbirth . Rumors and Legends . Unenchanted onyx was believed to cause bad luck when worn or carried . Elminster has confirmed this suspicion .

title: Onyx Tower
description: Onyx Tower The Onyx Tower was the most powerful creation on the face of Toril , it was ruled by the spirit of hatred , Eldrith the Betrayer . The Onyx Tower was created out of the Elemental Foundations and laid out on the Material Plane , it controlled all of the elements which is what made it so powerful . It was erected in the Marsh of Chelimber .
description_long: Onyx Tower The Onyx Tower was the most powerful creation on the face of Toril , it was ruled by the spirit of hatred , Eldrith the Betrayer . The Onyx Tower was created out of the Elemental Foundations and laid out on the Material Plane , it controlled all of the elements which is what made it so powerful . It was erected in the Marsh of Chelimber . History . Origins . When Eldrith the Betrayer turned her back on the city of Baldur ' s Gate , archers chased her into the Marsh of Chelimber . In the marsh , they shot her down and killed her . However , her rage against the city was so strong that her spirit lived on and created the Onyx Tower in the middle of the Marsh of Chelimber . The Elemental Foundations , located in five of the planes in the Elemental realm , were activated . These foundations could only be shut down by destroying the tower . In the Plane of Shadow , the Onyx Heart was built . The Heart contained the power to turn people into zombies and only by its destruction could the Onyx Tower be destroyed forever . The death of the Onyx Heart ' s holder could also destroy the tower .

title: Onyx the Invincible
description: Onyx the Invincible Onyx the Invincible , or Onyx , Blood of Placidor , was a male dwarf fighter , thief , and adventurer who hailed from Eartheart in the Great Rift and lived in Waterdeep in the late 1350s DR . Personality . He was a wild exception to the classic image of a dour dwarf looking to the past .
description_long: Onyx the Invincible Onyx the Invincible , or Onyx , Blood of Placidor , was a male dwarf fighter , thief , and adventurer who hailed from Eartheart in the Great Rift and lived in Waterdeep in the late 1350s DR . Personality . He was a wild exception to the classic image of a dour dwarf looking to the past . Onyx the Invincible was hot - tempered and bad - tempered , rowdy and impulsive by nature , brimming over with energy to act , to perform great deeds , and grab some gold and fight evil creatures bigger than himself along the way . He had little interest in ancient history , instead wanting to forge his own reputation for the future , to be known as a dwarven hero himself . However , he was still young in his early adventuring days , barely 35 , so his dwarven elders viewed his ways as " the mad passions of youth " . They expected he would achieve either greatness or an early and reckless demise . As a descendent of Placidor , Onyx had the right to call himself " Blood of Placidor " . However , rebellious by nature , he refused to go by the traditional dwarven name . Instead , he named himself " the Invincible " , a challenge to any who would test it .

title: Oolite
description: Oolite Oolite , also known as ool stones in the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars , was a variety of which occurred in tiny egg - shaped . Description . These ornamental stones were usually solid brown in color and were very similar to algae .
description_long: Oolite Oolite , also known as ool stones in the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars , was a variety of which occurred in tiny egg - shaped . Description . These ornamental stones were usually solid brown in color and were very similar to algae . Individual oolite spherules were about in ( 1 – 2 mm ) or less , which was too small to be cut . The aggregate stone was usually polished to bring out the color and mounted in silver jewelry ( particularly tiaras or pectorals ) , or used as eyes in sculpted figurines or to create patterns on chased metals . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Powdered ool stones were a prized ingredient when casting spells that purified or neutralized , and in making the magic ink for scribing those same spells .

title: Oolitikana
description: Oolitikana Oolitikana was an inhabitant of Mitzlato in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Abilities . Oolitikana knew many languages : those of the Dog People , desert dwarves , Poscadar elves , Metahel , Nahopaca , and the Short Ones .
description_long: Oolitikana Oolitikana was an inhabitant of Mitzlato in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Abilities . Oolitikana knew many languages : those of the Dog People , desert dwarves , Poscadar elves , Metahel , Nahopaca , and the Short Ones . History . In 1362 DR , he acted as a translator to Sozarro ' s expedition .

title: Ooraen
description: Ooraen Ooraen was a young member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Ooraen graduated from Sorcere in 1372 DR .
description_long: Ooraen Ooraen was a young member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Ooraen graduated from Sorcere in 1372 DR . During the siege of Dyrr ' s compound for their betrayal of Menzoberranzan during the Siege of Menzoberranzan , Ooraen was called back to his house together with all of Dyrr ' s other wizards to help raise magical defenses .

title: Oota
description: Oota Oota was a self - styled mayor within the Lost Peaks . Activities . Oota managed a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , despite being herself a captive .
description_long: Oota Oota was a self - styled mayor within the Lost Peaks . Activities . Oota managed a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , despite being herself a captive . She had dealings with the maid and Harper spy Tharra . History . In 1486 DR , Oota agreed to meet the disguised Dahl Peredur , that offer his help to made an escape plan .

title: Ooumraun
description: Ooumraun Ooumraun was the second ruler of the phaerimm . History . He was a colleague of Phaerl and developed many new spells .
description_long: Ooumraun Ooumraun was the second ruler of the phaerimm . History . He was a colleague of Phaerl and developed many new spells . After Phaerl ' s death to the sharn , Ooumraun became prominent . Many believed that he knew many other , very powerful new spells that had he taught to no one , using them against his many enemies over the years .

title: Ooze
description: Ooze Oozes were mindless , amorphous blobs that mostly dwelt underground . Abilites . They were essentially blind , but more than made up for that with an ability called blindsight , allowing them to discern nearby objects and creatures without needing to see them .
description_long: Ooze Oozes were mindless , amorphous blobs that mostly dwelt underground . Abilites . They were essentially blind , but more than made up for that with an ability called blindsight , allowing them to discern nearby objects and creatures without needing to see them . Most oozes secreted an acid from their skin that dissolved flesh and other materials rapidly . They had a unique tendency to resist close - range and melee attacks by dissolving the wielder ' s weapon slowly . Varieties . Azure jelly • Black pudding • Blood amniote • Blood elemental • Bloodrot • Blue slime • Bone collector • Gelatinous cube • Gray ooze • Iridescent ooze • Ochre jelly • Shadow slime • Spirit ooze

title: Ooze Master
description: Ooze Master The Ooze Master was a monstrous intelligent ooze in the Doomvault dungeon . Personailty . The Ooze Master believed that all Red Wizards needed to be fused with oozes in order to achieve immortality and it welcomed all that arrived in its presence as new apprentices that needed its gift .
description_long: Ooze Master The Ooze Master was a monstrous intelligent ooze in the Doomvault dungeon . Personailty . The Ooze Master believed that all Red Wizards needed to be fused with oozes in order to achieve immortality and it welcomed all that arrived in its presence as new apprentices that needed its gift . Abilities . It was similar to a lich as , after it was destroyed , it reappeared asleep in the nearby Red Pillar , and it could only truly be slain with the destruction of the Phylactery Vault . If a person was killed by fluids secreted by the Red Pillar , then the Ooze Master gained the knowledge and memories of the dead . It was linked to the White Maw and knewn if it was slain . History . The Ooze Master was the result of one of the experiments of the transmuter Sarkalla to create a sentient ooze . It had once been a Red Wizard that Sarkalla successfully fused with an ooze . It became a powerful creature but was not the perfect assassin that Sarkalla had sought . Rumors and Legends . In 1486 DR , it was destroyed by the heroes of Daggerford .

title: Ooze genasi
description: Ooze genasi The ooze genasi were para - genasi , meaning they where a mix of two elemental outsiders — water and earth . Ecology . The ooze genasi where known to have a disgusting outward appearance and also known for their repulsive personalities .
description_long: Ooze genasi The ooze genasi were para - genasi , meaning they where a mix of two elemental outsiders — water and earth . Ecology . The ooze genasi where known to have a disgusting outward appearance and also known for their repulsive personalities . They where heavyset and durable with drooping bodies and yellowish skin . They usually wore darker earth tone colors . Many had tells of their heritage , such as very bendable limbs or slimy skin . They usually reeked and most people would probably have called them utterly repulsive . Ability . As a general rule , they had a hard time being " charismatic " with their lack in personal skills and stench , but on the other hand they were very sturdy and healthy . Their ancestry also gave the protection from acid and as they grew in ability so did their ability to resist acid . They also had the ability to use the " grease " spell just as a sorcerer of equal ability . Clerics . Ooze genasi clerics worshiped deities with the slime domain .

title: Opal
description: Opal Opal was a milky gem stone related to black and fire opal s , but occurred slightly more frequently . Description . The substrate of opal was usually an opaque pale blue , while the inclusions flashed green to gold .
description_long: Opal Opal was a milky gem stone related to black and fire opal s , but occurred slightly more frequently . Description . The substrate of opal was usually an opaque pale blue , while the inclusions flashed green to gold . Opals were usually cut cabochon or used as inlays , and a typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Opals were considered sacred by followers of Lliira — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . White opals specifically were sacred to followers of Hathor . Powers . Opals had a high affinity to magic and were used in casting numerous spells and in the creation of magic items , especially those that stored spells for later use . The most well - known example was the " helm of brilliance " . Opals could be substituted for other , more scarce materials when constructing such items because of its ability to release spells just as if they were cast normally , with no change in range , power , or effect . When enchanting opal or using it as part of a magical procedure , the best results were obtained at twilight .

title: Opanrael
description: Opanrael Opanrael was the head curator of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Opanrael was a tidy man , almost obsessively such .
description_long: Opanrael Opanrael was the head curator of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Opanrael was a tidy man , almost obsessively such . He placed order and structure in high regard and did not like people with opposing views . Opanrael was naughtily but could became easily excitable by topics that piqued his interest . History . Opanrael was the Head Curator of Mantor ' s Library for many years , being one of the longest - lasting members of the library . In 1489 DR , he was involved in a case of stolen books , but was more concerned about the disappearance of two of the Library ' s scribes , Garda Greenleaf and Ellison Berenger .

title: Opara Rendril
description: Opara Rendril Opara Rendril was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1358 DR , Rendril was a well - known Procampan master metal - smith who crafted high - quality longsword s and helms , while her bracelets and belt - dagger s were famous around the Inner Sea .
description_long: Opara Rendril Opara Rendril was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1358 DR , Rendril was a well - known Procampan master metal - smith who crafted high - quality longsword s and helms , while her bracelets and belt - dagger s were famous around the Inner Sea . By 1368 DR , Rendril was the owner of Rendril ' s Forge , and also an active Harper agent , though she remained based in Procampur .

title: Oparl
description: Oparl Oparl was a town consisting of sixty large Calishite mansions , walled off with each having a good view of the rest of Bedorn , being situated on four high knolls . Strangers were not welcome here . Injured persons were occasionally given some supplies but were otherwise forced off to the nearest source of water by the private security of the nearest mansion .
description_long: Oparl Oparl was a town consisting of sixty large Calishite mansions , walled off with each having a good view of the rest of Bedorn , being situated on four high knolls . Strangers were not welcome here . Injured persons were occasionally given some supplies but were otherwise forced off to the nearest source of water by the private security of the nearest mansion . There were two ways to get into one of the buildings in this town , either as an invited guest or as an invader who had defeated a small army of mercenaries , security guards , and trained or " charm ed " monsters . Buildings were ramshackle and frequently destroyed under their own weight due to poor building methods . Workcrews were thus almost continually hired to rebuild structures in an ever more gaudy and unfeasible fashion .

title: Opawang
description: Opawang The Opawang was an evil sorcerer in Akari . History . The Opawang was originally the Black Leopard Priest , leader of the Black Leopard Cult in Durkon .
description_long: Opawang The Opawang was an evil sorcerer in Akari . History . The Opawang was originally the Black Leopard Priest , leader of the Black Leopard Cult in Durkon . In 420 Shou Years ( −830 DR ) at the mouth of the Fenghsintzu River , General Wo Can of Shou Lung and his army destroyed the Black Leopard Cult temple . The Black Leopard Priest led the remaining cultists to Akari where they built a base for their eventual return to the continent . They were always ruled by the Black Leopard Priest until he sacrificed his own people for immortality , becoming " the Opawang " , the Dead Spirit King . Circa 1220 Shou Years ( 800 DR ) , a pirate gang settled on the isle and the Opawang , seeking to drive them away , created the first ochimo and the pirates abandoned the isle in terror . In 2456 Shou Years ( 1279 DR ) , another pirate gang settled in Akari but this time , before the intervention of the Opawang , the Shou Lung navy crushed them . From then on , the Opawang lived in tranquillity , furthering his studies into the ochimo and capturing the great spirit of Akari , Harooga .

title: Open Feast
description: Open Feast Open Feast was a revelry held on the 26th of Mirtul each year by the King of Cormyr . It was known as the " open " feast because by tradition no members of the royal family attended the festival and the nobles were able to speak openly .
description_long: Open Feast Open Feast was a revelry held on the 26th of Mirtul each year by the King of Cormyr . It was known as the " open " feast because by tradition no members of the royal family attended the festival and the nobles were able to speak openly .

title: Open Grave
description: Open Grave Contents . " Open Grave " is a supplement meant for use in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game , regardless of setting , which lists lore and gameplay information on undead . This ranges from a listing of new monsters to ecological details on undead of any type , as well as statistics for non - player characters ( NPCs ) of undead origin .
description_long: Open Grave Contents . " Open Grave " is a supplement meant for use in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game , regardless of setting , which lists lore and gameplay information on undead . This ranges from a listing of new monsters to ecological details on undead of any type , as well as statistics for non - player characters ( NPCs ) of undead origin . The book is organized into four chapters , as follow :

title: Ophala Cheldarstorn
description: Ophala Cheldarstorn Ophala Cheldarstorn is the covert owner of the Moonstone Mask as well as a respected member of the Many - Starred Cloak . Regarding the Harpers ( as well as Elminster of Shadowdale ) as allies , she counts the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan among her list of foes . Ophala ' s apprentices spend most of their time spying on the Brotherhood through magical means so its agents can be stopped .
description_long: Ophala Cheldarstorn Ophala Cheldarstorn is the covert owner of the Moonstone Mask as well as a respected member of the Many - Starred Cloak . Regarding the Harpers ( as well as Elminster of Shadowdale ) as allies , she counts the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan among her list of foes . Ophala ' s apprentices spend most of their time spying on the Brotherhood through magical means so its agents can be stopped . Ophala once had a brief yet dangerous career as an adventurer of other planes , but she has since retired . The Laughing Wyrm . During Sammaster ' s Rage , Ophala took Zundaerazylym - " The Laughing Wyrm " - to the Astral plane in a successful attempt to free her from the madness that was infecting Faerûn ' s dragons . At the time Zundarazylym was a laundress and seamstress at the Moonstone Mask .

title: Ophealine
description: Ophealine Ophealine , or more commonly glass stone , was the name in the Realms for . The purple or violet variety was called yanolite . Description .
description_long: Ophealine Ophealine , or more commonly glass stone , was the name in the Realms for . The purple or violet variety was called yanolite . Description . Ophealine occurred in large crystals that yielded faceted gemstones of impressive size , and was hard enough to be used in jewelry , especially rings , that were subject to the wear and tear of everyday use . The typical brown hue was so intense that bigger crystals looked opaque . Unfortunately , brown was not in great demand as a gemstone color , but glass stone found its way into rings because it could hold a sharp edge and survive a good bar fight . In Waterdeep , the street name for such items was " knuckle stones " . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . The purple yanolite was considered sacred by followers of Ghaunadaur — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Ophealine had an anti - magic quality such that it could not be used as a material component in any spell , potion , ink or other magical preparation — the magic always failed .

title: Ophidian
description: Ophidian Ophidians ( also pluralized as ophidia and also known as snakemen ) were a cruel race of serpentfolk that often served as slaves to the yuan - ti or spirit naga s . With the pterafolk , they were counted among the " Hidden Folk " . Description .
description_long: Ophidian Ophidians ( also pluralized as ophidia and also known as snakemen ) were a cruel race of serpentfolk that often served as slaves to the yuan - ti or spirit naga s . With the pterafolk , they were counted among the " Hidden Folk " . Description . Ophidians had snake - like bodies , except that they were neither long nor thin , with short and stubby humanoid appendages . They stood upright . They had forked tongues like serpents . They had the ability to change their scale color to match their environment , but their natural color was a spotted green or yellow , with some individuals having some black , brown , or red scales . The greens could range from dark - brownish green to pale blue - green and black scales could also be a faded gray - black . Abilities . Besides their ability to change color , ophidians had a poisonous bite that was also cursed , similar to the bite of a lycanthrope . Any humanoid bitten by an ophidian was in danger of magically morphing into an ophidian , beginning within one to five days . A victim would also lose his or her memories and would be filled with an urge to return to wherever the bite occurred .

title: Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia
description: Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the matriarch of Clan Ophinshtalajiir in 1486 DR . Description . Kaijia had patina - green scales .
description_long: Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the matriarch of Clan Ophinshtalajiir in 1486 DR . Description . Kaijia had patina - green scales . History . In 1486 DR , Kaijia sought out Verthisathurgiesh Anala and Shestandeliath Geshthax in order to investigate a series of murders in the Catacombs of Djerad Thymar .

title: Ophinshtalajiir Perra
description: Ophinshtalajiir Perra Ophinshtalajiir Perra was a dragonborn member of Clan Ophinshtalajiir who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . Description . Perra was tall and gaunt .
description_long: Ophinshtalajiir Perra Ophinshtalajiir Perra was a dragonborn member of Clan Ophinshtalajiir who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . Description . Perra was tall and gaunt . Her brown scales where speckled with white due to her old age . Abilities . For someone of her age , Perra was strong enough to easily handle the big greatsword only high - ranking thymari were allowed to use and to stand on her own against multiple enemies . History .
