Powdered orl could be mixed with powdered black pearl to make a powerful explosive , but the amounts and proportions were not generally known except to some who practiced magic . To touch off an explosion , the mixture had to be exposed to an open flame in a particular way for ignition to occur . The resulting blast had a radius of 30 ft ( 9 .

title: Orlak
description: Orlak Orlak was a powerful vampire who once ruled Westgate . History . Before the Dale Reckoning , Orlak was a powerful vampire .
description_long: Orlak Orlak was a powerful vampire who once ruled Westgate . History . Before the Dale Reckoning , Orlak was a powerful vampire . In - 286 DR , he proclaimed himself Night King and seized the city of Westgate . Orlak ruled for a century until the adventurer paladin Gen Soleilon defeated the master vampire and stopped his reign . Thought slain , Orlak became the ruler of the Underdark beneath the city . Finally , in 1370 DR , Orlak turned one of the clones of Manshoon into a vampire , at the beginning of the Manshoon Wars . However , in his first act , Manshoon ' s vampire clone searched for and destroyed his sire , putting an end to Orlak ' s undead life . Appendix . Notes . It is not really clear if it was the same Orlak in - 286 DR and 1370 DR .

title: Orlarrakh
description: Orlarrakh Orlarrakh , also known as The Green Duchess , was the ruler of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . She was a vassal of Melauthaur , the ruler of Melabrauth . Personality .
description_long: Orlarrakh Orlarrakh , also known as The Green Duchess , was the ruler of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . She was a vassal of Melauthaur , the ruler of Melabrauth . Personality . Orlarrakh was known for not forget even a slight . After she visited the cities of the Dusk Ports , it was normal that its inhabitants had to elect a new ruler when she left . She was also cruel and enjoyed eating the inhabitants of her lands . History . It was believed by most people in Returned Abeir that Orlarrakh was one of the dragons who fought against the primordial s during the War of Fang and Talon . She had a legendary status across the continent . In 1479 DR , Orlarrakh may have been killed , or at least poisoned and crippled with dragonbane amber , by a group of adventurers allied with the Scions of Amber and the Shadowkiss .

title: Orlath
description: Orlath " This horrific serpentine demon shares two humanoid atop a single coiling body . Each torso weaves a set of six humanoid arms , all clutching cruel scimitars . The monster ' s two baboon - like heads glower menacingly , their eyes beady and bright with hate .
description_long: Orlath " This horrific serpentine demon shares two humanoid atop a single coiling body . Each torso weaves a set of six humanoid arms , all clutching cruel scimitars . The monster ' s two baboon - like heads glower menacingly , their eyes beady and bright with hate . " ~ Dungeon Magazine 146 # Legends of the birth of the Orlath come from that the great Prince of demon s battling a powerful marilith . As the marilith died , several of the teeth from the prince got dislodged from him and stuck in the corpse . After a century the body split open and gave birth of the first Orlath . Like the yachlols , Orlath demons are not members of a demonic race like the Tanar ' ri or the Obyrith s They are more akin to their own race , a race shaped by and for Demogorgon himself . The Orlath ' s ability to assume humanoid form , combined with its silver tongue and extensive knowledge , make it an excellent spy or double agent . The Orlath is devastating in combat , leading with a slashing array of scimitars and savages bites . Although weaker then the marilith , the Orlath ' s increased number of arms make it a veritable cyclone of blood and steel in melee .

title: Orlathon Lunemast
description: Orlathon Lunemast Orlathon Lunemast was a human man and a priest of Selûne in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Orlathan was High Priest of The Rising Moon temple of Selûne in Tsurlagol , in charge of 9 subpriests . He was still in charge by 1370 DR .
description_long: Orlathon Lunemast Orlathon Lunemast was a human man and a priest of Selûne in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Orlathan was High Priest of The Rising Moon temple of Selûne in Tsurlagol , in charge of 9 subpriests . He was still in charge by 1370 DR .

title: Orlbar
description: Orlbar Orlbar was a sleepy village on the junction of the Loagrann and Greyflow rivers , supporting about 450 shepherds History . Known as a simple , sleepy town unwilling to grow any larger than it already was . In the summer of 1369 DR a Zhentarim caravan rolled into town and set up a new government .
description_long: Orlbar Orlbar was a sleepy village on the junction of the Loagrann and Greyflow rivers , supporting about 450 shepherds History . Known as a simple , sleepy town unwilling to grow any larger than it already was . In the summer of 1369 DR a Zhentarim caravan rolled into town and set up a new government . A former lieutenant of Geildarr Ithym of Llorkh , Felishar Ivarzin became leader of the village . Wary of the Zhentarim having a base of power even closer to them , the leadership of Loudwater planned a coup to free the village from its new masters . Unfortunately the daughter of Deldron Rein , a wealthy arms merchant , turned traitor and tipped off Felishar to the plan and who was behind it , allowing him to put the uprising down easily . Loudwater , not wishing to invite the full wrath of the Zhentarim , grudgingly signed the Oath of Orlbar , ensuring the Zhentarim ' s control of the village . With his seat of power secured , Felishar broke with the cyric ist faction of the Zhentarim and joined the xvimlar faction . With the help of Fzain Nerist they quickly built an imposing temple to Xvim over the village and Felishar enacted strict regulations on trade .

title: Orlen
description: Orlen Orlen was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Orlen was a respected old farmer who kept his crops in good health .
description_long: Orlen Orlen was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Orlen was a respected old farmer who kept his crops in good health . However , in 1374 DR , his crops were not doing good and Orlen couldn ' t report the problem to the druid s , who would tell him what the problem was . After the Kalach - Cha became the Knight Captain , Orlen was invited to come to the keep , to tend to the fields .

title: Orlenstar Thirlthorn
description: Orlenstar Thirlthorn Orlenstar Thirlthorn was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a druid of Silvanus who tended to the God ' s Grove shrine . History .
description_long: Orlenstar Thirlthorn Orlenstar Thirlthorn was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a druid of Silvanus who tended to the God ' s Grove shrine . History . As a young man , Orlenstar was taking care of the God ' s Grove shrine by 1358 DR , and continued through 1367 DR and 1369 DR . He was still there in 1374 DR . By Eleint of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Orlenstar greeted the priests of the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , believing that magic could be considered as part of nature . However , he found the cleric who met him , Shan Thar , to be patronizing and false to him . Upset by this , he didn ' t return . When adventurers revealed it to be a false temple and a front for followers of Shar and Cyric , Orlenstar would offer his healing spells for free . Personality . Orlenstar was a gentle man , though of saturnine moods . Activities . Orlenstar was officially the caretaker of the shrine of Silvanus and the grove of duskwood trees it resided in . However , the God ' s Grove was a popular spot among Whelunians , so many other folk helped him with this . He spent most days in the grove , but lived in a cabin nearby .

title: Orlex
description: Orlex Orlex was a baatezu devil lord who ruled the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . His reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked . A band of rebellious wizard s arose to depose Orlex .
description_long: Orlex Orlex was a baatezu devil lord who ruled the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . His reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked . A band of rebellious wizard s arose to depose Orlex . Led by the archmage Thakorsil , they created the throne known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " to imprison and permanently bind and enslave the evil fiend . Unfortunately , although they had the best of intentions , the device demanded deeds of despicable evil to function . Thus , they devised the " ritual of twin burnings " , which involved the sacrifice of beings of good heart , believing this was for the greater good , that the ends justified the means . They went ahead with the horrific rites , and successfully bound and enslaved Orlex in the " Seat " , forming a council of wizards that governed Yhalvia . However , corrupted by the sacrifices and with Orlex as their slave , they soon became as cruel , depraved , and wicked as the devil they had replaced . In time , others overthrew them , Orlex was banished to the planes and " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was lost and believed destroyed .

title: Orlgaun
description: Orlgaun Orlgaun was a black dragon allied with the Zhentarim and usually ridden by Manshoon . Manshoon rode him in his first tentative abduction of Shandril Shessair , but thanks to her power of " spellfire " and her friends she defeated Manshoon and greatly injured the dragon . Despite Manshoon ' s efforts , the dying Orlgaun lost all his strength and crashed into the ruins of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Orlgaun Orlgaun was a black dragon allied with the Zhentarim and usually ridden by Manshoon . Manshoon rode him in his first tentative abduction of Shandril Shessair , but thanks to her power of " spellfire " and her friends she defeated Manshoon and greatly injured the dragon . Despite Manshoon ' s efforts , the dying Orlgaun lost all his strength and crashed into the ruins of Myth Drannor .

title: Orlil
description: Orlil Orlil is an island in the country of Lantan . Not much is really known about Lantan , other than that it consists of 3 separate islands located in the Trackless Sea , north of Chultan peninsula : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil . After Captain Cordell from Amn discovered Maztica , Lantaneses , being the westernmost extension of Faerûn along with the reclusive Evermeet and the enigmatic Nimbral , also claimed some lands .
description_long: Orlil Orlil is an island in the country of Lantan . Not much is really known about Lantan , other than that it consists of 3 separate islands located in the Trackless Sea , north of Chultan peninsula : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil . After Captain Cordell from Amn discovered Maztica , Lantaneses , being the westernmost extension of Faerûn along with the reclusive Evermeet and the enigmatic Nimbral , also claimed some lands . Home of Lantan ' s Rare Spellcasters . Lantan as a whole is a country focused primarily in the arts and sciences , unlike that which is found in the rest of Abeir - Toril . The Gnomes of Lantan eventually hope to initiate a kind of renaissance in its scientific and mechanical achievements to finally bring about a global age of peace to all gods , races and sub - races . Its greatest mechanical achievement is said to be that of flying machines . As a result , very few Lantanese Gnomes ever delve into the Arcane Arts of spellcasting , but those who do will usually take up residence on the Island of Orlil .

title: Orlimmin
description: Orlimmin Orlimmin was a village in the Vast , lying where the Long Reach from Bambryn met the Tantras Trail between Tantras and Highbank Forest . Description . Orlimmin was a quiet agricultural center .
description_long: Orlimmin Orlimmin was a village in the Vast , lying where the Long Reach from Bambryn met the Tantras Trail between Tantras and Highbank Forest . Description . Orlimmin was a quiet agricultural center . It was at its busiest when the cattle auctions were held and buyers and drovers , and their cattle , descended on the village " en masse " . South of Orlimmin rose a rugged plateau like a great wall . The area was scattered with gravel pits , worked by miners from Orlimmin . They mostly dug up what they needed and sold any excess to the nearby cities of Tantras and Ravens Bluff . The local tavern was called The Pickled Priest . History . " Circa " 1364 DR , The Cabal of the Crown adventuring company from Procampur visited Orlimmin to explore the gravel pits . One night , one of the pits erupted with " fireball " s , " lightning bolt " s and similar destructive spell s . Although the villagers watched from outside The Pickled Priest , they waited until morning to investigate . Most of the Cabal were found dead , many beheaded , in or beside the pit . A few survivors had fled all the way to Tantras , and refused to speak of what they saw , let alone return to Orlimmin .

title: Orlpar Husteem
description: Orlpar Husteem Lord Orlpar Husteem was a human living on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep and a member of the Husteem noble house . Personality . Orlpar was a trader of drugs , perfumes , spices and wine s , although some of his wares were illicit , such as bloodroot .
description_long: Orlpar Husteem Lord Orlpar Husteem was a human living on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep and a member of the Husteem noble house . Personality . Orlpar was a trader of drugs , perfumes , spices and wine s , although some of his wares were illicit , such as bloodroot . He frequented the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward , where he sourced his supply of goods from its proprietor , Unger Farshal . Relationships . Orlpar ' s elder brother was Orbos Husteem , patriarch of the Husteem house . Possessions . Orlpar used either a dagger or a rapier in combat , both of which were of masterwork quality . He wore a mithral chain shirt and owned a pair of " slippers of spider climbing " . History . Orlpar operated his day - to - day business from his home address . He employed Hala Myrt to be on the streets of the city in order to acquire customers who were sent to meet Orlpar at the Grinning Lion . Orlpar began his criminal career as a fence of stolen goods , but later moved into dealing in drugs such as haunspeir , mordayn powder and tekkil . He collaborated with the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild .

title: Orlumbor
description: Orlumbor Orlumbor , pronounced ( Or - LUM - bore ) , was a small rocky barren island city - state in the Sea of Swords . Geography . The settlement was located due west of the Trollbark Forest between Daggerford and Baldur ' s Gate and 300 miles south of the free city of Waterdeep , on the Sword Coast .
description_long: Orlumbor Orlumbor , pronounced ( Or - LUM - bore ) , was a small rocky barren island city - state in the Sea of Swords . Geography . The settlement was located due west of the Trollbark Forest between Daggerford and Baldur ' s Gate and 300 miles south of the free city of Waterdeep , on the Sword Coast . Few people visited the city , in part because of its treacherous harbor .

title: Ormath
description: Ormath Ormath was a small city on the south - eastern edge of the Shining Plains . Relations . Of the three cities it shared the Shining Plains with , Ormath was the most prone to conflict over the slightest transgression .
description_long: Ormath Ormath was a small city on the south - eastern edge of the Shining Plains . Relations . Of the three cities it shared the Shining Plains with , Ormath was the most prone to conflict over the slightest transgression . The city kept watch over Pikemen ' s Folly , the road connecting Ormath , Lheshayl , and Hlondeth , and controlled the intersection the city was built around , namely the junction between the Folly and the north road . While controlling this intersection , the city shared control of Assam , another small city , with its neighbor Lheshayl and liked nothing more than complete control over it . Lheshayl was aware of this , however , and was unwilling to allow Ormath the opportunity . Government . Ormath was ruled by Lord Quwen , an imposing and militant man who favored blades over politics . He frequently conducted the patrols along roads outside the city with his men , removing any threats to the safety of his land . History . Around 1372 DR , Quwen become concerned with reports of the Wetwoods containing hostile lizardfolk .

title: Ormion Bowbreaker
description: Ormion Bowbreaker Ormion Bowbreaker was a male Chondathan human psion ( seer ) and a soldier based at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . A young man , Ormion was one of the psionicist s hired by Commander Bren Tallsword to instantly transmit secure messages via telepathy to Arabel in the event the castle was attacked . However , Ormion ' s powers went a step further — he successfully foresaw a vicious raid by gnoll s .
description_long: Ormion Bowbreaker Ormion Bowbreaker was a male Chondathan human psion ( seer ) and a soldier based at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . A young man , Ormion was one of the psionicist s hired by Commander Bren Tallsword to instantly transmit secure messages via telepathy to Arabel in the event the castle was attacked . However , Ormion ' s powers went a step further — he successfully foresaw a vicious raid by gnoll s . The War Wizards came to interrogate Ormion and the others and confirmed their loyalty . This proved the effectiveness of psionics in the army , triggering a recruitment drive for more psionically gifted soldiers by 1374 DR .

title: Ormitar
description: Ormitar The Ormitar family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the family was headed by Lassalar Ormitar , who also commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city .
description_long: Ormitar The Ormitar family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the family was headed by Lassalar Ormitar , who also commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city .

title: Ormpetarr
description: Ormpetarr Prior to the Spellplague , Ormpetarr was the capital city of Sespech . After the Spellplague struck , the city became a center for scar pilgrimage s . Features .
description_long: Ormpetarr Prior to the Spellplague , Ormpetarr was the capital city of Sespech . After the Spellplague struck , the city became a center for scar pilgrimage s . Features . The city was filled with ancient brass spires , famed for their ability to reflect the setting sun like flame . As of 1396 DR many of the brass spires lay broken and strewn down the rocky side of a cliff . Economy . Ormpetarr was a banking center and handled all trade on the Golden Road . Military . Prior to 1385 DR , Ormpetarr was home to the bulk of Sespech ' s military . In 1479 DR there are several militias in town . The Order of Blue Flame has a militia known as the Peacekeepers and Tyrangal has soldiers known as the Copper Guard . The monastery of Kelemvor just to the south of the city also maintains a fighting force of monk s and cleric s . Government . Ormpetarr was ruled by Baron Thuragar Foesmasher . In 1479 DR there is no official government but power is shared uneasily by the Order of Blue Flame , forces loyal to the Tyrangal and the huge monastery of Kelemvor just outside of town . History . By 1396 DR much of the city is full of half - collapsed and abandoned buildings .

title: Ormu
description: Ormu Ormu was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It favored warm , moist areas such as steam tunnels and steam vents . Ormu gave off a soft green glow that provided dim illumination in a five foot ( 1 .
description_long: Ormu Ormu was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It favored warm , moist areas such as steam tunnels and steam vents . Ormu gave off a soft green glow that provided dim illumination in a five foot ( 1 . 5 meter ) radius . If harvested and dried , it yielded a phosphorescent powder that could be used to create a glowing pigment .

title: Orn Thavil
description: Orn Thavil Orn Thavil was a human male priest of Tymora who dwelt in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . By 1357 DR , Orn Thavil served as High Priest of the Lady ' s Happy Hall temple of Tymora in the Temple District of Procampur .
description_long: Orn Thavil Orn Thavil was a human male priest of Tymora who dwelt in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . By 1357 DR , Orn Thavil served as High Priest of the Lady ' s Happy Hall temple of Tymora in the Temple District of Procampur . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the Hierarch dined at a banquet hosted by Duke Jozul Piniago of Procampur , and was sat beside the lama Koja of Khazari . He considered the Tuigan to be " savages " and discussed the problems of using printing press es to copy magical prayerbooks . In Marpenoth of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , when Procampur was struck by the featherlung plague , Thavil worked with High Priest Baniya Dolester of Lliira and set up auxiliary shrines in the District of the Poor to treat the sick there . Though their actions halted the spread of the disease , the Thultyrl reprimanded both high priests for breaking Procampur ' s district rules , and were reminded that the city and its laws were older than a number of deities . Thavil was still high priest of the temple in 1367 DR . Description . Thavil was a very old man , thin and with a long , wispy white beard . Activities .

title: Orna
description: Orna Orna was a former member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Orna was a greedy and brutal individual .
description_long: Orna Orna was a former member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Orna was a greedy and brutal individual . She wanted revenge against the cult . History . In 1491 DR , Orna was in Tyar - Besil . She dared to strike a Black Earth priest , so her fellow cultists captured and jailed her . Some time later , some adventurers defeated the jailer cultists and Orna tried to convince them to free her .

title: Ornan Roaryl
description: Ornan Roaryl Ornan Roaryl was the king of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Description .
description_long: Ornan Roaryl Ornan Roaryl was the king of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Description . Ornan was a red - faced , rugged but aging man . Personality . Ornan was a veteran who spent many years fighting outlaws , would - be usurpers , and monsters . He strove to be just and fair , but he had little patience for those who defied him . King Ornan liked plain talk , honest dealings , and subjects who were kind to and supportive of each other . Background . The common people of Eskorn loved their king , and believed that any setback suffered in the kingdom was the work of his opposition or of evil outsiders . Eskornar nobility , however , didn ' t held King Ornan in high regard and wanted to either put his daughter , Dlorna Roaryl , as the new Queen of Eskorn , or to usurp the throne , as was the case of the nobles led by Amaunthur Sardron . Activities . Under his rule , King Ornan traveled across Eskorn , bringing his justice across the realm . He was a harsh judge , executing murderers and flogging thieves while proclaiming their crimes . Those who didn ' t deserved to die were put to work under his knights ' services .

title: Orniiv Fanderfall
description: Orniiv Fanderfall Orniiv Fandarfall , also called the Eclipse , was a male human cleric of Mask . He was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Orniiv was responsible for the guild ' s operation in Baldur ' s Gate .
description_long: Orniiv Fanderfall Orniiv Fandarfall , also called the Eclipse , was a male human cleric of Mask . He was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Orniiv was responsible for the guild ' s operation in Baldur ' s Gate . He was the perfect example of the guild ' s thieves : always cold and inscrutable . His nickname came from a tattoo of an eclipse on his left cheek .

title: Ornoth I
description: Ornoth I King Ornoth I ( full name Ornoth Myrmoran ) was the king of Myrmoran from 168 DR . He became king after the death of his father , Uth I . Ornoth granted nobility to seven of his closest allies , who had long been his counselors .
description_long: Ornoth I King Ornoth I ( full name Ornoth Myrmoran ) was the king of Myrmoran from 168 DR . He became king after the death of his father , Uth I . Ornoth granted nobility to seven of his closest allies , who had long been his counselors . This core of noble houses made up the Council of Lords , and the leader of each house occupied one seat on the council . Ornoth died in 191 DR , leaving a dispute between his twin sons as to who would claim power . Relatives . Ornoth ' s father was King Uth I . He had twin sons , Ornoth II and Uth II .

title: Oroch ' s Stride
description: Oroch ' s Stride Oroch ' s Stride was a portal to the Abyss located in Scornubel . History . For years , a human merchant Oroch controlled the portal which linked Scornubel to Morglon - Daar .
description_long: Oroch ' s Stride Oroch ' s Stride was a portal to the Abyss located in Scornubel . History . For years , a human merchant Oroch controlled the portal which linked Scornubel to Morglon - Daar . After disappearing on an adventure , Tarnrose , a drow wizard and her gang took up residence over the gateway , charging 66 gp for all creatures who could pass through the gate within a two minute time - span .

title: Orog
description: Orog Orogs were orc s who lived and thrived in the Underdark . They looked like normal mountain orc s but were slightly taller , with larger ears and huge pale eyes . History .
description_long: Orog Orogs were orc s who lived and thrived in the Underdark . They looked like normal mountain orc s but were slightly taller , with larger ears and huge pale eyes . History . Orogs were descended from the Skullbiter Tribe of mountain orcs who once lived in the Spine of the World mountain range . When they , along with other mountain orcs , invaded Netheril in - 3605 DR , they were cut off from their retreat route and cornered between the elven and Netherese armies . They sought refuge in a narrow cave at the end of a valley which , unbeknownst to them , led to the Underdark . They became lost but felt safe in the knowledge that they would not be followed by their enemies , delving further underground whenever they could . Eventually they came across a veritable jungle of luminous fungi and decided to settle there . They bred in great numbers and expanded into many surrounding caverns like a virulent plague . They subjugated the creatures already living there and eventually split into a dozen different tribes , discovering rich veins of metal and ore .

title: Orok
description: Orok Orok was a runaway boy of Blue Bear Tribe in Zelbross . History . Orok abandoned his tribe because his siblings bullied him .
description_long: Orok Orok was a runaway boy of Blue Bear Tribe in Zelbross . History . Orok abandoned his tribe because his siblings bullied him . From then on , he hid in a lair in the ruins of Zelbross . Personality . Orok , like all Uthgardt , distrusted magic .

title: Orold Archemusk
description: Orold Archemusk Orold Archemusk was a wizard of the 12th and 13th centuries DR . History . Around 1100 DR , he wrote " Trends in Approaches to the Art " .
description_long: Orold Archemusk Orold Archemusk was a wizard of the 12th and 13th centuries DR . History . Around 1100 DR , he wrote " Trends in Approaches to the Art " . He once visited Thay at the start of that nation . He was greatly admired by surviving Netherese arcanist s and magelord s of Athalantar . He died around 1287 DR .

title: Ororonymilith
description: Ororonymilith Ororonymilith , also known as The Vizier of Broken Thorns , was a bronze dragon vassal of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal in Skelkor , Abeir . History . Ororonymilith was one of the vassals of Gauwervyndhal who were tasked with finding the thief who was hunting in the Dragon Empress ' s forest .
description_long: Ororonymilith Ororonymilith , also known as The Vizier of Broken Thorns , was a bronze dragon vassal of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal in Skelkor , Abeir . History . Ororonymilith was one of the vassals of Gauwervyndhal who were tasked with finding the thief who was hunting in the Dragon Empress ' s forest . Ororonymilith tricked another slave into revealing that the thief was Esham - Ana . When the bronze dragon went to the mines to arrest Esham - Ana , the other slaves rose in rebellion and killed Ororonymilith .

title: Oroth
description: Oroth Oroth , also known as the Hollow Mountain , was a volcano located in southern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Oroth was a large but low , collapsed volcanic peak overgrown with thick forest .
description_long: Oroth Oroth , also known as the Hollow Mountain , was a volcano located in southern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Oroth was a large but low , collapsed volcanic peak overgrown with thick forest . Background . As of 1479 DR , the area around Oroth was teeming with aberrant and strange monsters , most of them gibbering mouther s , creations of the dragon Lhargloroth . The forest around Oroth were so dangerous that Eskornar knights avoided the place at all costs .

title: Orox
description: Orox Orox was a beholder ally of the Orthodox Church of Bane in 1357 DR . History . Orox was a beholder supporting the High lmperceptor of Bane of Mulmaster .
description_long: Orox Orox was a beholder ally of the Orthodox Church of Bane in 1357 DR . History . Orox was a beholder supporting the High lmperceptor of Bane of Mulmaster . In 1357 DR , hidden in a crate , Orox went to Zhentil Keep to help Inquisitor Ginali to kill the non - Orthodox Fzoul Chembryl . Orox tried to kill Fzoul while the latter was busy with the adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds but was defeated . On Uktar 18 of 1369 DR , Mulmaster was attacked by a band of beholder s led by Fzoul Chembryl , Desmonda , and Manxam , killing Orox and over half the followers of Cyric in the city .

title: Orprase
description: Orprase Orprase was another name for , a gemstone especially favored by followers of Tymora . Description . Orprase was a medium - hard , brittle stone that was either colorless or faintly straw - yellow and found as transparent areas in otherwise uninteresting opaque rock samples .
description_long: Orprase Orprase was another name for , a gemstone especially favored by followers of Tymora . Description . Orprase was a medium - hard , brittle stone that was either colorless or faintly straw - yellow and found as transparent areas in otherwise uninteresting opaque rock samples . The stone could be facet - cut into small to medium - sized gems . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . These gems were eagerly sought by followers of Tymora and those that knew their secret . One orprase stone , powdered and mixed into at least 3 oz ( 90 ml ) of wine that had been consecrated to Tymora by a full - fledged priest of that faith , granted extraordinary good luck at resisting one attack or at performing one skill . The benefit occurred on the very next occasion after imbibing the potion , regardless of how long ago it was consumed .

title: Orran
description: Orran Orran was a senior Doomguide and priest of Kelemvor in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was to clear the city ' s graveyard of undead .
description_long: Orran Orran was a senior Doomguide and priest of Kelemvor in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was to clear the city ' s graveyard of undead . History . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Orran assisted Volahk .

title: Orrery
description: Orrery An orrery was complex device used by astrologer s in Zakhara to view and chart the constellation s . Description . An orrery consisted of a silver ball that was surrounded by twelve rings .
description_long: Orrery An orrery was complex device used by astrologer s in Zakhara to view and chart the constellation s . Description . An orrery consisted of a silver ball that was surrounded by twelve rings . Each of the rings represented one of the constellations visible in the night sky . A special lens held within the silver ball emitted a cone of blue light that illuminated the rings surrounding the sphere . Uses . Once calibrated by an astrologer , an orrery would let the user know which constellations were currently visible . By moving the outer rings the astrologer could see which constellations were visible on any date based upon the light shining on them from the lens . Astrologers used orreries to determine the constellations they would use to " hang " their spells .

title: Orrery of the Inner Planes
description: Orrery of the Inner Planes The Orrery of the Inner Planes was an enchanted mechanical object , the origin of which was up for debate . Some scholars believed it to be a marid device , while others thought it to be a creation of the cooperative efforts of both the marid and dao , which seemed highly unlikely . Description .
description_long: Orrery of the Inner Planes The Orrery of the Inner Planes was an enchanted mechanical object , the origin of which was up for debate . Some scholars believed it to be a marid device , while others thought it to be a creation of the cooperative efforts of both the marid and dao , which seemed highly unlikely . Description . The " Orrery of the Inner Planes " looked like a large clock . Powers . The orrery showed the relative positions of the planets , moons , and stars , as well as the junctions of the Inner Planes . In the hands of a competent navigator , the orrery could be used to travel between all of the Inner planes , including all Elemental planes , the Ethereal plane , and the Prime Material Plane . Any ship with the orrery mounted on deck could traverse all of the elements , gliding through solid stone , " sailing " underwater , " etc " . Additionally , the orrery protected both the vessel and all passengers from adverse elemental effects . A ship on the Prime plane could even levitate with the orrery on board . Incompetent navigators who attempted to use the orrery often wound up on dangerous planes of existence instead of their intended destination .

title: Orrik
description: Orrik Orrik was a wizard who dwelt at the Severed Hand . Physical description . Orrik wore all gray robes , and had gray hair .
description_long: Orrik Orrik was a wizard who dwelt at the Severed Hand . Physical description . Orrik wore all gray robes , and had gray hair . He fluttered around his tower , looking at old tomes with admiration . He carried no weapon , but he could disarm the burliest of fighters with a single look . He was about five and a half to six feet tall . He had gentle eyes . Personality . Orrik welcomed only those who came to him with a purpose . History . Gameplay . Orrik would tell an adventurer many things , including the fact that the radiant pool would harm Isair and Madae if it was purified .

title: Orsin
description: Orsin Orsin was a deva shadowalker from Telflamm . History . Orsin lived many lives , always as deva , aasimar , or similar celestial being .
description_long: Orsin Orsin was a deva shadowalker from Telflamm . History . Orsin lived many lives , always as deva , aasimar , or similar celestial being . In 1484 DR , Orsin went in search of the son of Erevis Cale . He arrived near the Abbey , helping the pilgrims going to the Abbey of the Rose to find the right way . There he spoke with Vasen Cale , discovering he was the son of Erevis . He said to Vasen that they were friends in multiple lives so he wanted help Vasen also in this life . For this Orsin decided to always follow him .

title: Orsraun Mountains
description: Orsraun Mountains The Orsraun Mountains were the largest range of mountains south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Orsrauns made up the majority of Turmish ' s western border .
description_long: Orsraun Mountains The Orsraun Mountains were the largest range of mountains south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Orsrauns made up the majority of Turmish ' s western border . To the north of them lay Gulthmere Forest , to the south was the Vilhon Reach and to the west was the Shining Plains . A valley through which the Halondar passed separated the Orsrauns from the Aphrunn Mountains . Mountains of the Alaoreum . The northeastern mountains were known as the Mountains of the Alaoreum and were separated from the rest of the range by Treefall Pass . The Alaoreum were ostensibly the demesne of the dwarves of Ironfang Deep though duergar , as well as the evil inhabitants of the wider Orsrauns repeatedly pressed them . The Orbrekh . The Orbrekh was a thin part of the range separated by a river valley that was comfortably controlled by around thirty to thirty - five hill giant s . Inhabitants . Harper agents also reported a pair of black dragon s living in the westernmost mountains in 1367 DR . Rumors placed a mated pair of brass dragon s in the eastern foothills and at least one copper dragon was claimed to lair in the Orsrauns as well . Notable Locations .

title: Orthaerus Manycloaks
description: Orthaerus Manycloaks Orthaerus Manycloaks was a wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . History . Orthaerus was slain during a spell - duel by the wizard Endarthar .
description_long: Orthaerus Manycloaks Orthaerus Manycloaks was a wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . History . Orthaerus was slain during a spell - duel by the wizard Endarthar . Activities . As a ghost who retained full spellcasting abilities , Orthaerus tormented Endarthar relentlessly . Any visitors to Wildwoods who showed hostility toward Endarthar were aided by Orthaerus .

title: Orva
description: Orva Orva was a kingdom located in what was later south - east Cormyr . Orva was destroyed around - 700 DR , in " one horrific night of blood and slime " and was " long gone and forgotten " by 26 DR when the kingdom of Cormyr was founded . Locations .
description_long: Orva Orva was a kingdom located in what was later south - east Cormyr . Orva was destroyed around - 700 DR , in " one horrific night of blood and slime " and was " long gone and forgotten " by 26 DR when the kingdom of Cormyr was founded . Locations . The Vast Swamp was mostly located over what used to be the Kingdom of Orva . Orvaskyte Keep was once the northernmost outpost . Culture . Language : Thorass was the alphabet used . Calendar : The Kingdom of Orva used its own dating system but some surviving documents also made reference to the Mulhorandi Calendar . Religion : The patron deity of Orva was a human aspect of Labelas Enoreth called Chronos .

title: Orvanath
description: Orvanath Orvanath was a lich and a necromancer . In 1266 DR , he trapped the Bright Banner Brandished adventuring company , including the wizard Ashemmi , in a subterranean crypt north of Mirabar , where he killed them in their entirety , except for Ashemmi who escaped by using a " teleport " scroll . Orvanath joined the Arcane Brotherhood in Luskan .
description_long: Orvanath Orvanath was a lich and a necromancer . In 1266 DR , he trapped the Bright Banner Brandished adventuring company , including the wizard Ashemmi , in a subterranean crypt north of Mirabar , where he killed them in their entirety , except for Ashemmi who escaped by using a " teleport " scroll . Orvanath joined the Arcane Brotherhood in Luskan .

title: Orvustia Esseren
description: Orvustia Esseren Orvustia Esseren was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The guard was smart , tough , and talented with her bow and spear but knew nothing of the " Realms " outside her homeland .
description_long: Orvustia Esseren Orvustia Esseren was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The guard was smart , tough , and talented with her bow and spear but knew nothing of the " Realms " outside her homeland . History . Around 1489 DR , Orvustia followed the advice of her aunt and left her home on a farm near Baldur ' s Gate to see the world . She found work as a guard for a great caravan that , unknown to her , was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Orvyltar
description: Orvyltar Orvyltar was the capital city of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . The city stood at the innermost end of Copper Bay , a protected bay that it the kingdom ' s biggest and safest port .
description_long: Orvyltar Orvyltar was the capital city of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . The city stood at the innermost end of Copper Bay , a protected bay that it the kingdom ' s biggest and safest port . Description . As well as being the capital , Orvyltar was the biggest and most wealthiest in the kingdom . It had a population of over 20 , 000 around 1367 DR , rising to 21 , 000 by 1373 DR . Government . As the capital of the realm of Ulgarth , King Drasna Bluemantle ruled and was based here in the mid - to late 14th century . However , he was regularly away touring his kingdom . Trade . As the kingdom ' s biggest and safest port , Orvyltar was its primary trade route , to the Durpar cities of Morvar and Pharsul and beyond . Indeed , the primary occupation of Orvyltar was trading , and Orvyltarans were fast gaining a reputation as local masters of commerce . Food and mingari spice from eastern Ulgarth and gold and iron from the Galuil Mountains were exported out of Orvyltar , while a wide variety of staples and luxury goods from Durpar were imported . Defenses .

title: Oryal Forestal
description: Oryal Forestal Oryal Forestal was the Silhouette of Spies of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Oryal was very loyal to his friend Renal .
description_long: Oryal Forestal Oryal Forestal was the Silhouette of Spies of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Oryal was very loyal to his friend Renal . Relationship . Oryal had a strong friendship with fellow Shadow Thieves boss Renal Bloodscalp , who helped him often . He developed an attraction to an employee of the Silverale Hall , but only for her appearance and the conversations she overheard . History . Oryal entered the Shadow Thieves at the same time as Renal Bloodscalp and the two became partners and friends . Renal also helped Oryal to kill all aside from their superiors who discovered his ability as a wizard . Activities . Oryal acted as spymaster of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla and his magic powers and his contacts made him a very efficient spymaster . He was known to remember all that friends and foes said , mentally filling and sorting it all to recall even the slighted bit of pertinent information .

title: Oryndoll
description: Oryndoll Oryndoll , the City of Loretakers , was a large underground mind flayer citystate in the Lowerdark of the Darklands . Oryndoll was one of the earliest illithid cities on Toril and was highly famed for its inhabitants rampant collection of exclusive knowledge . Its wealth of knowledge rivaled even Candlekeep ' s great library .
description_long: Oryndoll Oryndoll , the City of Loretakers , was a large underground mind flayer citystate in the Lowerdark of the Darklands . Oryndoll was one of the earliest illithid cities on Toril and was highly famed for its inhabitants rampant collection of exclusive knowledge . Its wealth of knowledge rivaled even Candlekeep ' s great library . The mere mention of the city struck fear into most Underdark denizens of southwestern Faerûn . This city was the birthplace of both the duergar and tren races as well as the tzakand , urophion and mozgriken ceremorphs . Geography . Surface Oryndoll was located in the Underdark beneath the Shining Plains . It lay ninety miles northwest of Ormath and 90 miles northeast of Lheshayl . It was slightly more than 26 miles beneath the surface . Underdark The city was difficult to reach from other places in the Underdark because of its depth , but since the Mindstalker Wars , many tunnels were made that breached into the tunnels of Old Shanatar . Many of these eventually served as slaving routes for the drow of Guallidurth .

title: Osamu Muraoka
description: Osamu Muraoka Osamu Muraoka was a samurai who ran a posthouse in Kozakura and also a jito in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse at the strategic entrance to the pass through the Kurisammyaku , he led a company of thirty samurai and four hundred bushi .
description_long: Osamu Muraoka Osamu Muraoka was a samurai who ran a posthouse in Kozakura and also a jito in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse at the strategic entrance to the pass through the Kurisammyaku , he led a company of thirty samurai and four hundred bushi . Personality . Osamu was a loyal follower of Takenaka Okawa and did not much like the Niwa clan . The shikken put Osamu at the posthouse to keep a watch over Niwa Hirotada .

title: Osari Daizan
description: Osari Daizan Osari Daizan was the daimyo of Tifuido in Wa . Personality . Daizan was a good - natured and cheerful individual .
description_long: Osari Daizan Osari Daizan was the daimyo of Tifuido in Wa . Personality . Daizan was a good - natured and cheerful individual . He was a good administrator and was loved by his subjects . Daizan greatly respected all artists and musician being himself a good musician . History . Osari Daizan was the daimyo of of the city of Tifuido . Until 1348 DR , he was counseled by his uncles Osari Minhiro and Toshi . In 1358 DR , a numbers of strange killings plagued Fochu and also Toshi was killed . Uncle Minhiro went back to Tifuido and told to Daizan that was all guilty of the evil Za - Jikku . However Daizan not truly believed his uncle ' s words and acted too slowly . Later however a dream told him that Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party was fighting the evil . So finally Daizan acknowledged the truth of the tale of Minhiro and started pray for the heroes . An other dream later told him of the defeat of the evil and quickly Daizan went in search of the heroes to congratulate with them .

title: Osari Minhiro
description: Osari Minhiro Osari Minhiro was an old samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . After the death of his daughters , Minhiro became cynical .
description_long: Osari Minhiro Osari Minhiro was an old samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . After the death of his daughters , Minhiro became cynical . He was terrified by large bodies of water . Powers . Minhiro was a protege of Ababuio and he always miraculously escaped death . History . Minhiro was born to the Osari clan in the village of Osata in the Fochu Peninsula . At a young age , during a sea voyage with his parents , wako pirates attacked the ship and only Minhiro survived thanks to a jellyfish sent by Ababuio , the deity of good luck . He married the powerful wu jen Toshi and together they served at the court of his nephew , Osari Daizan , daimyo of the city of Tifuido . After the deaths of all of his daughters before they reached 16 years old around 1348 DR , Minhiro retired to live alone and divorced from Toshi , who instead went to work in the village of Seinin . In 1358 DR , a number of strange killings plagued Fochu and Toshi was killed . Soon after , her ghost appeared to Minhiro in a dream explaining that she had been killed by the minions of Za - Jikku and asked her ex - husband ' s help to stop the evil .

title: Osaw I
description: Osaw I The undying " negus negusti " ( " Prince of Princes " ) , King Osaw I the Wise was the ruler of the holy city of Mezro and one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . Description . King Osaw appeared to be a Tabaxi man of 80 years of age , with hunched shoulders and wrinkled skin , though he was over a millennium - and - a - half old .
description_long: Osaw I The undying " negus negusti " ( " Prince of Princes " ) , King Osaw I the Wise was the ruler of the holy city of Mezro and one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . Description . King Osaw appeared to be a Tabaxi man of 80 years of age , with hunched shoulders and wrinkled skin , though he was over a millennium - and - a - half old . Despite his age and appearance , he had a youthful energy and a deep , questioning gaze . He bore a platinum circlet and platinum armbands as symbols of his kingship . Personality . Osaw was soft - spoken but noble . Abilities . Like all " barae " , Osaw was immortal and could not age or grow sick . He had been granted several special abilities common among the Chosen of Ubtao : If within the Temple of Ubtao , he could also cast the following spells : In addition , Osaw had been granted the special power to recall with crisp precision every event and meeting he had experienced within the entire long length of his reign . Relationships . Osaw ' s son , Kwalu , was " negusti " of Chult and also was another of the " barae " . Activities . King Osaw ruled from a triangular throne room within the Temple of Ubtao .

title: Osbrun
description: Osbrun King Osbrun was the king of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the early 1350s DR . History . King Osbrun once bought the shield called " Thurbrand ' s Protector " from the warrior Thurbrand .
description_long: Osbrun King Osbrun was the king of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the early 1350s DR . History . King Osbrun once bought the shield called " Thurbrand ' s Protector " from the warrior Thurbrand . In the Year of the Crown , 1351 DR , the king ' s treasury and armory were robbed — by magic , some said . This included " Thurbrand ' s Protector " .

title: Osbur
description: Osbur Osbur was a servant of House Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , after the death of Olgarth Oldbridle , his son and heir Elbert Olbridle sent Osbur to Broryn Windstag in order to inform him about the news and to not trust Kormoroth and Yestrel and the Lhendreth s of Saerloon .
description_long: Osbur Osbur was a servant of House Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , after the death of Olgarth Oldbridle , his son and heir Elbert Olbridle sent Osbur to Broryn Windstag in order to inform him about the news and to not trust Kormoroth and Yestrel and the Lhendreth s of Saerloon .

title: Osco Salibuck
description: Osco Salibuck Osco Salibuck was a halfling rogue from Waterdeep . Description . Osco had chestnut - brown curly hair with sideburns .
description_long: Osco Salibuck Osco Salibuck was a halfling rogue from Waterdeep . Description . Osco had chestnut - brown curly hair with sideburns . He also had silver rings in his left nostril and earlobe . He was quite young - looking in 1479 DR . History . In Nightal 1479 DR , Renaer Neverember and his companions ( including Vajra Safahr , soon to be the seventh Blackstaff ) were lying low at Varadras when they discovered Osco had discovered the way to travel to the mansion and was trying to avoid capture by the City Watch for posing as a member of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild . Since Osco didn ' t know any of the magical pass phrases to open doors or return to Waterdeep , he became trapped in the mansion . Osco joined Renaer ' s group and helped return Vajra to Waterdeep so that she could claim the title of Blackstaff . He was tested by Blackstaff Tower , where he met two ghosts , Pikar Salibuck and Osco Salibuck the Elder ( his ancestors ; Osco the Elder ' s ghost was actually being impersonated by the ghost of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ) . Osco then helped Vajra and the others to defeat Khondar Naomal , who was attempting to invade the tower .

title: Osco Salibuck the Elder
description: Osco Salibuck the Elder Osco Salibuck the Elder was a male halfling and an associate of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , and the ancestor of Osco Salibuck . History . He had a statue honoring his service to Khelben in Blackstaff Tower .
description_long: Osco Salibuck the Elder Osco Salibuck the Elder was a male halfling and an associate of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , and the ancestor of Osco Salibuck . History . He had a statue honoring his service to Khelben in Blackstaff Tower . His statue had a rather unpleasant expression , long hair , and carried a small scimitar . His ghost was impersonated by the ghost of Khelben in order to test young Osco Salibuck .

title: Osconivon
description: Osconivon Osconivon was the Lord Magistrate of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Osconivon was a drunken fool in service of Manshoon ; deep he was a coward but not stupid .
description_long: Osconivon Osconivon was the Lord Magistrate of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Osconivon was a drunken fool in service of Manshoon ; deep he was a coward but not stupid . Osconivon thought that Manshoon could protect him better than anyone else ; however if he saw no risk he accepted to silent things to Manshoon or followed interests of other people for the right price . He did not believe in stupid things like pride , honor or trust History . Osconivon was the son of a rich Zhent merchant ; Manshoon appointed him as Lord Magistrate knowing how easy it would be to control him . He accepted brides from everyone , trying to not impact Manshoon ' s interests .

title: Osctl Sleeping Turtle
description: Osctl Sleeping Turtle Osctl Sleeping Turtle was a chieftain in Far Payit in the 4th century DR . History . Osctl was one of the chieftains in the Ixtzul Vale when in 362 DR the Star Worm ' s egg fell from the sky .
description_long: Osctl Sleeping Turtle Osctl Sleeping Turtle was a chieftain in Far Payit in the 4th century DR . History . Osctl was one of the chieftains in the Ixtzul Vale when in 362 DR the Star Worm ' s egg fell from the sky . Thanks to the power of the Star Worm , Osctl managed to become the ruler of all the vale and built the city of Ixtzul .

title: Oshiga
description: Oshiga Oshiga was an trumpet archon in service to Erathaol in 1385 DR . History . Oshiga was an archon who was in service to Erathaol in Mount Celestia for long time .
description_long: Oshiga Oshiga was an trumpet archon in service to Erathaol in 1385 DR . History . Oshiga was an archon who was in service to Erathaol in Mount Celestia for long time . Just after the Spellplague , Oshiga and other five councilors judged the revelations of the deva Eirwyn , who with her allies came to advise them of a fiend menace to Celestia . The Empyrean Odyssey :

title: Osiris
description: Osiris Osiris ( pronounced oh - " sigh " - ris ) is a stern member of the Mulhorandi pantheon who enjoys watching children play . He is known as Osirant in Thay , and by the name Ozrikotep in Unther . History .
description_long: Osiris Osiris ( pronounced oh - " sigh " - ris ) is a stern member of the Mulhorandi pantheon who enjoys watching children play . He is known as Osirant in Thay , and by the name Ozrikotep in Unther . History . Osiris was murdered by Set in a struggle to claim the power of slain Re . He was later resurrected by Isis and Nephthys . Relationships . Osiris is the son of Geb and Nut . He is the brother of Thoth , and Isis is his wife . Osiris considers Kelemvor an ally . Osiris and Set are fierce enemies . He also counters the will of Mask when possible . Avatar . Osiris typically appears in one of two primary forms . The first is that of a Mulan warrior with green skin , dressed in robes and bearing the crown of a king of Mulhorand . The second form is that of a royal mummy . Powers and abilities . Creatures are stunned merely by standing in the presence of Osiris . He possess total control over the undead and non - sentient vegetation . He can kill with a touch , and change shape at will . Other manifestations . The will of Osiris is often communicated through animated plants and creatures such as lammasu . Church of Osiris .

title: Osk Thunderhale
description: Osk Thunderhale Osk Thunderhale was a sea captain sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Osk was at the employ of Lord Dagult Neverember .
description_long: Osk Thunderhale Osk Thunderhale was a sea captain sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Osk was at the employ of Lord Dagult Neverember . Activities . Osk sailed with his ship the " Moon Maiden " from Waterdeep to Luskan and back . Often he was at the Hanging Lantern festhall in Dock Ward of Waterdeep . He was a skilled fiddler and loved playing his fiddle to amuse his crew and the others festhall patrons ' . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Osk saw on sea debris of the " Dancing Wave " ship and a giant warship nearby . Possibly he was contacted by an adventuring party hired by Duvessa Shane .

title: Osse
description: Osse Osse was a continent on Toril , located between Kara - Tur and Maztica . It lay between the Eastern Sea of Kara - Tur and the Western Ocean before Maztica , and north of the Southern Ocean . It was mysterious and little - known to Faerûn .
description_long: Osse Osse was a continent on Toril , located between Kara - Tur and Maztica . It lay between the Eastern Sea of Kara - Tur and the Western Ocean before Maztica , and north of the Southern Ocean . It was mysterious and little - known to Faerûn . People . The people of this land were known as the Osse , or Osslander s . An aboriginal people with an ancient culture , they had strong ties to their ancestors and to their land , and in touch with the natural world . They believed all things had spirits , from trees to rocks to the air itself . They venerated these natural spirits and the spirits of the ancestors alike . Following the philosophy of Alcheringa , the Osslanders also revered ancestral heroes as totems and believed that the stars were the spirits of their ancestors . One of these was Tumbarum , revered as the spirit of music . They gave rise to spirit shaman s , shamanic priests who commanded the spirit world , and to totemist s , who channeled the raw magic of nature spirits , in the form of incarnum . Spirit shamans went on quests to discover their path in life , to preserve nature , and to balance the spirit world .

title: Ossian Talendar
description: Ossian Talendar Ossian Talendar was the heir of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . History . Early in his life , his father Nuldrevyn noticed Ossian ' s great intelligence and energy and so Ossian was chosen as the family ' s heir and trained for this role .
description_long: Ossian Talendar Ossian Talendar was the heir of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . History . Early in his life , his father Nuldrevyn noticed Ossian ' s great intelligence and energy and so Ossian was chosen as the family ' s heir and trained for this role . In time , he gained more and more of Nuldrevyn ' s responsibilities . At the age of maturity , Nuldrevyn chose Ossian for the important role of liaison between Talendar and Selgaunt ' s criminal underground . In 1372 DR , Ossian was tasked with finding some men that could help the returned Marance Talendar in his vengeance . Personality . Ossian was bright , lively , cheerful , and friendly . However , deep within , he was utterly ambitious and was sure that his many services to the family would grant him the patriarch ' s role . However , he was not a cruel man and did not care for vengeance . Ossian took only very calculated risks .

title: Ostoria
description: Ostoria Ostoria ( meaning " father ' s seat " in Jotun ) was the original kingdom of the giant s , founded by Annam All - Father to celebrate the last of his sons coming of age . At the peak of its power , it was dubbed " The Colossal Kingdom " because it occupied an area of Faerûn from the Vilhon Reach to the Cold Lands . As it grew , Annam split it up so that each of his favored sons could acquire part of it .
description_long: Ostoria Ostoria ( meaning " father ' s seat " in Jotun ) was the original kingdom of the giant s , founded by Annam All - Father to celebrate the last of his sons coming of age . At the peak of its power , it was dubbed " The Colossal Kingdom " because it occupied an area of Faerûn from the Vilhon Reach to the Cold Lands . As it grew , Annam split it up so that each of his favored sons could acquire part of it . The capital of Ostoria became a citadel built by Lanaxis called Voninheim . When the dragon s began posing a threat , Ostoria went to war with them . This war would last over a thousand years , and Ostoria was reduced greatly when the end of the war came , restricted to the north of Faerûn . Ostoria ceased to exist after the death of Ulutiu caused his amulet to freeze a large region of Faerûn ' s north ( present - day Pelvuria ) , and the deaths of most of Annam ' s sons , despite Lanaxis ' s efforts to save the kingdom .

title: Ostrav
description: Ostrav Ostrav was a small farming village found in the grasslands of the Duchy of Arcata in Damara along the Beaumaris River . Activities . Despite their relatively small size , the politically neutral community managed to survive and thrive during desperate times such as the rise of Zhengyi .
description_long: Ostrav Ostrav was a small farming village found in the grasslands of the Duchy of Arcata in Damara along the Beaumaris River . Activities . Despite their relatively small size , the politically neutral community managed to survive and thrive during desperate times such as the rise of Zhengyi . Ostrav was known for its friendly inhabitants and fabulous inns .

title: Ostus Agrivar
description: Ostus Agrivar Ostus Agrivar was a male human wizard of the North . He was one of the most renowned wizards of the region and lord of the Agrivar estate . Relationships .
description_long: Ostus Agrivar Ostus Agrivar was a male human wizard of the North . He was one of the most renowned wizards of the region and lord of the Agrivar estate . Relationships . Ostus was head of the Agrivar family . He had one son , the paladin knight Priam Agrivar , whom he groomed to be the next Lord Agrivar . He also had a daughter , Cybriana , with a drow sorceress from Shadowdale . Cybriana and her dark half Kilili ultimately merged into Kyriani Agrivar , a new daughter of Ostus . Possessions . Ostus had a holy trust , as keeper and guardian of " Selûne ' s Eye " . He was the lord of the Agrivar family estate on Mount Sar , including the family home called Ostus ' s Hold . Description . As a young man , Ostus had shoulder - length dark grey hair . He wore a black tunic with a golden collar . As an old mage , Ostus had shoulder - length white hair and a long white mustache . He wore ornate robes and " Selûne ' s Eye " around his neck . History . Youth . Ostus Agrivar ' s past was a part of legend , set down in the Song of Selûne .

title: Osyluth
description: Osyluth Osyluths — sometimes called bone devils — serve as taskmasters and interrogators of the devils . They act as law - enforcement throughout Hell , leading many devils to fear their presence . Bone devils delight in torturing mortals and devils alike , causing physical and mental suffering wherever they go .
description_long: Osyluth Osyluths — sometimes called bone devils — serve as taskmasters and interrogators of the devils . They act as law - enforcement throughout Hell , leading many devils to fear their presence . Bone devils delight in torturing mortals and devils alike , causing physical and mental suffering wherever they go . Osyluths , along with hamatula s , make up the bulk of the Servants of Mammon , Mammon ' s personal army . Physical description . Bone devils appear to be skeletal humanoids a tall , emaciated fiend with dried skin stretched so tight as to outline and emphasize every bone in its body . It has a skull - like head and a bony scorpion - like tail and exudes a stench of decay . An osyluth stands about 2 . 74m ( 9ft ) tall and weighs roughly 227kg ( 500lbs ) . Osyluths often serve as the informers and police of the Nine Hells , monitoring and reporting on the activities of other devils . History . The famed Paladin Kern Desanea , the " Hammerseeker " , fought with an osyluth during his adventures in the Moonsea region .

title: Otaaryliakkarnos
description: Otaaryliakkarnos Otaaryliakkarnos was a wyrm silver dragon follower of Bahamut who lived in Cormanthor . History . In 650 DR Otaaryliakkarnos served as the companion of the moon elf Avourel Omberdawn .
description_long: Otaaryliakkarnos Otaaryliakkarnos was a wyrm silver dragon follower of Bahamut who lived in Cormanthor . History . In 650 DR Otaaryliakkarnos served as the companion of the moon elf Avourel Omberdawn . She taught him a lot of battle tactics who earned him respect among his peers . At some point her niece was killed by dwarves in one of their old dragonmoot s hunt and she resented dwarves ever since . During the last Rage of Dragons , in 1373 DR , the Sisterhood of Essembra sought out Otaaryliakkarnos and offered the watch her while she slept , so she could withstand the effects of the Dracorage . Due to this and because of the Sisterhood open help to the dragonborn of Bahamut , Otaaryliakkarnos became an staunch ally of the song half - dragon sisters . She was chosen to be part of Protanther ' s council in 1489 DR . In the guise of a human named Elia she invited a delegation from the Council of Waterdeep to speak in front of the dragons . An adventures ' band send by the Council of Waterdeep may have convinced her to ally with humanoid races to stop the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat ' s plots . Personality .

title: Othea
description: Othea Othea ( known as Deronain in Auld Dwarvish and Sonnhild in ancient Thorass ) was a goddess who married Annam All - Father and bore his children , who would become the origin of the giant race . She would later claim the cold vast plains with Annam ' s son Lanaxis . Relatives .
description_long: Othea Othea ( known as Deronain in Auld Dwarvish and Sonnhild in ancient Thorass ) was a goddess who married Annam All - Father and bore his children , who would become the origin of the giant race . She would later claim the cold vast plains with Annam ' s son Lanaxis . Relatives . Othea was the wife of Annam All - Father . Her sons were Arno and Julian , Dunmore , Masud , Nicias , Obadai , Ottar , Ruk , and Vilmos . Background . Othea was unfaithful to Annam , her husband . Circa - 26000 DR , she had an affair with Vaprak , resulting in the ogre race , and then c . - 25500 DR she had an affair with Ulutiu , shortly before the end of the giant war against the dragon s , resulting in four sons : firbolg , fomorian , verbeeg , and voadkyn . Annam slew Ulutiu and hurled him into the Cold Sea . Othea was so upset by this that she refused to give Annam another child , but Annam tricked her to get her pregnant . They reached a compromise where Annam agreed to leave Abeir - Toril until the child called for him , in return Othea would not terminate the pregnancy . Othea was poisoned by her son , Lanaxis , when she refused to let him save his citadel of Voninheim .

title: Othea Tor
description: Othea Tor Othea Tor was an isolated mountain far to the north of Faerûn , the physical manifestation of Othea in her death . Description . The ice - covered mountain was only about 200 feet high .
description_long: Othea Tor Othea Tor was an isolated mountain far to the north of Faerûn , the physical manifestation of Othea in her death . Description . The ice - covered mountain was only about 200 feet high . It looked like the figure of a plump woman kneeling on the ground and hunched over . Beneath the ice , the crag was brittle and moss - covered . The mountain had been named by the verbeeg Basil . Othea ' s " womb caves " were located far beneath its surface . Geography . Othea Tor was located in the utter north of Faerûn , beyond the Ice Spires North and just south of the Endless Ice Sea . History . When Lanaxis betrayed and poisoned his mother Othea and his siblings , Othea Tor grew brittle . After Voninheim was covered in ice , Hartkiller emerged from the caves beneath the tor , fully grown and ready to restore Ostoria . In 1369 DR , Othea Tor was destroyed by Tavis Burdun using Annam ' s axe Sky Cleaver , so that Othea ' s shadow could not conceal the Bleak Palace and Twilight Vale any longer , allowing he and his companions to confront Lanaxis .

title: Othelstan
description: Othelstan Captain Othelstan was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who supervised the Cult - controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . Description . The captain was a strong man with unusual black skin .
description_long: Othelstan Captain Othelstan was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who supervised the Cult - controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . Description . The captain was a strong man with unusual black skin . Possessions . In battle , Othelstan wore splint mail and fought with a shield and flail . If forced to use ranged attacks , he would throw a spear . History . Othelstan controlled Parnast during the Tyranny of the Dragons when the mobile Skyreach Castle was just over the village . He briefly met with the Black Wyrmspeaker Rezmir when she arrived in the village in transit to the castle . He was likely defeated soon after by a band of adventures hired to stop the Cult .

title: Otherwind stride
description: Otherwind stride Otherwind stride is a spell of the conjuration school used by some warlock s , particularly those of the fey pact . When cast " otherwind stride " , he or she creates a maelstrom resembling in many ways of a fey crossroad . Any creatures caught in the effect , which is roughly five feet in diameter and must be cast near the warlock , are injured by its energy .
description_long: Otherwind stride Otherwind stride is a spell of the conjuration school used by some warlock s , particularly those of the fey pact . When cast " otherwind stride " , he or she creates a maelstrom resembling in many ways of a fey crossroad . Any creatures caught in the effect , which is roughly five feet in diameter and must be cast near the warlock , are injured by its energy . If the warlock wishes , he or she may step into the chaos unharmed , teleporting themselves a distance of up to twenty - five feet , or more , if they specialize in fey pacts and are above average in intelligence . " Otherwind stride " is not overly complex and the ability to cast it can be regained with a rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Othglas Aumar
description: Othglas Aumar Othglas Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Othglas was a fat , jolly , and food - loving man , with a penchant for poisoning his enemies .
description_long: Othglas Aumar Othglas Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Othglas was a fat , jolly , and food - loving man , with a penchant for poisoning his enemies . In the Warring Princes ' fighting , when the magelord s targeted him , Othglas escaped in Dalniir and joined the ranks of Malar ' s clerics . However , the magelords turned him into a boar during a hunt , and he was slain by his own men in 220 DR .

title: Othiiyr Velthrann
description: Othiiyr Velthrann Othiiyr Velthrann was a sage of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . His life ' s work was his study of the magic sword s of the Royal Guard of King Imphras I and King Imbrar of Impiltur .
description_long: Othiiyr Velthrann Othiiyr Velthrann was a sage of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . His life ' s work was his study of the magic sword s of the Royal Guard of King Imphras I and King Imbrar of Impiltur . These swords were among Soargar ' s Legacy , a collection of the relics of Old Impiltur put together by Mage Royal Soargar , but long since lost . Othiiyr dedicated himself to recording the legends around them , and pieced together the histories of a dozen surviving swords : " Ashram " , " Dornavver " , " Ellendrin " , " Felthann " , " Galathos " , " Iltornar " , " Malagar " , " Palreth " , " Sarghathuld " , " Tendar " , and " Ulfindos " . He was able to examine at least one of these swords himself when , in the Year of the Behir , 1342 DR , the thief Gort brought him " Ellendrin " to identify . Othiiyr offered to buy the sword , but Gort refused , hinting that a contact in the Moonsea had already contracted him to retrieve it . Gort left Othiiyr ' s house and that was the last anyone admitted seeing him and " Ellendrin " again . Othiiyr assisted the Knights of Imphras II in their continuing quest to find the lost swords of Soargar ' s Legacy .

title: Othimturac
description: Othimturac Othimturac was a shadow white dragon bred by the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl . History . As part of an experiment , the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl crossbred various kinds of chromatic dragon s with shadow dragon s in order to create a more suitable race .
description_long: Othimturac Othimturac was a shadow white dragon bred by the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl . History . As part of an experiment , the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl crossbred various kinds of chromatic dragon s with shadow dragon s in order to create a more suitable race . However , only Othimturac , the white dragon offspring , survived ( the Jaezred speculated that it was his immunity to cold that permitted his survival ) . He was later used as a guard for the tower of House Oussgym , the local Jaezred headquarters . In 1374 DR , he was eventually defeated by an adventuring party that had infiltrated the tower .

title: Othla Multar
description: Othla Multar Othla Multar was a sage from the city of Spandeliyon in Altumbel . Othla Multar studied the legends of Adhe Wood in the Vast and theorized that the many mutant spiders there were bred by drow , who released them to guard their passage to the local Underdark , from which they occasionally emerged and crossed into the Tsurlar Forest to trade with pirate vessels that anchored in hidden coves .

title: Othmar bin Jaqal
description: Othmar bin Jaqal Othmar bin Jaqal was a sha ' ir who lived in Mahabba of the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar bound an efreeti named Zet into his service .
description_long: Othmar bin Jaqal Othmar bin Jaqal was a sha ' ir who lived in Mahabba of the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar bound an efreeti named Zet into his service . He belittled Zet at any opportunity and generally treated him poorly . Activities . Othmar was known for burning heretics who opposed the Pantheon .

title: Othmar bin Kaloth
description: Othmar bin Kaloth Othmar bin Kalath was a sha ' ir who lived in Rog ' osto of the Cities of the Ancients in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar was served by a loyal efreeti named Xamus .
description_long: Othmar bin Kaloth Othmar bin Kalath was a sha ' ir who lived in Rog ' osto of the Cities of the Ancients in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar was served by a loyal efreeti named Xamus . Activities . In addition to being an accomplished sha ' ir , Othmar was a " qadi " of Rog ' osto .

title: Othorion Keove
description: Othorion Keove Othorion Keove was an elven warrior . Description . Othorion wore full elven mail armor .
description_long: Othorion Keove Othorion Keove was an elven warrior . Description . Othorion wore full elven mail armor . History . In 26 DR , Othorion strongly opposed Iliphar Nelnueve ' s decision to allow Faerlthann Obarskyr to become the first king of Cormyr . In 900 DR , Othorion was the last survivor of Iliphar ' s court and returned the court to Cormyr . He claimed that he had come to hunt . His arrival was on the eve of Cormyr ' s Battle with the Witch Lords and during the battle , Othorion ' s elves arrived to aid Galaghard III ' s humans , swinging the battle in their favour and bringing them a victory . Othorion stated that he had felt like hunting orc s and goblin s . Othorion gave his approval of the kingdom of Cormyr after the battle .

title: Othovir
description: Othovir Othovir was a shopkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Othovir was a handsome and charismatic male human of Illuskan stock .
description_long: Othovir Othovir was a shopkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Othovir was a handsome and charismatic male human of Illuskan stock . Personality . Othovir cared greatly about his good name . He became angry if he found out someone was looking into his private life or his past . Abilities . He was skilled leather worker and made his living making harnesses for horses and other domesticated beasts . He was a natural spellcaster , able to cast a few sorcerer spells . He was also proficient with a rapier . Possessions . He was the owner and proprietor of Othovir ' s Harness Shop in Triboar . Activities . Othovir created tack and harnesses out of elk hide that were works of art . His skill was unsurpassed in the Dessarin Valley and his designs prized among the nobles of Waterdeep that kept horses . He hunted and skinned the elk himself , selling the meat and other parts to the Lionshield Coster outpost in town . History . Othovir was a member of the noble Margaster family in Waterdeep but moved to Triboar and dropped his surname when some of his family tried to convert him to worship Asmodeus in secret .

title: Othur Roonsundyr
description: Othur Roonsundyr Othur Roonsundyr was a reclusive wizard in Skullport . Personality . Othur was the most militant recluse in the North .
description_long: Othur Roonsundyr Othur Roonsundyr was a reclusive wizard in Skullport . Personality . Othur was the most militant recluse in the North . He did not like people , seeming to find no joy in anything that he or anyone else created . His soft side was touched only by the art and poetry of Kara - Tur . Activities . Othur ' s fields of study were runes , symbols , and ward magic . He was the greatest expert in Skullport about them , and one of the major scholars in these topics outside Candlekeep .

title: Otiluke ' s resilient sphere
description: Otiluke ' s resilient sphere When Otiluke ' s resilient sphere is cast , the result is a globe of shimmering force that encloses the subject creature if it fails to successfully save vs . Spells . The " resilient sphere " ' will contain its subject for the duration of the spell .
