description_long: Otiluke ' s resilient sphere When Otiluke ' s resilient sphere is cast , the result is a globe of shimmering force that encloses the subject creature if it fails to successfully save vs . Spells . The " resilient sphere " ' will contain its subject for the duration of the spell . The " sphere " is completely immune to all damage ; the only method of removing the " sphere " is by the use of a " dispel magic " spell . Hence , the creature caught inside the globe is completely safe from all attacks , but , at the same time , is completely unable to affect the outside world . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as resilient sphere , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Otleo Ressmon
description: Otleo Ressmon Otleo Ressmon , usually known as The Fat , was a male thief who was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Otleo was a career man , rising through the ranks of the guild step by hard step , starting as a common thief . His duty was to control the guild ' s operations in Tethyr , where he posed as a prospering merchant .
description_long: Otleo Ressmon Otleo Ressmon , usually known as The Fat , was a male thief who was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Otleo was a career man , rising through the ranks of the guild step by hard step , starting as a common thief . His duty was to control the guild ' s operations in Tethyr , where he posed as a prospering merchant .

title: Otomo Tahiro
description: Otomo Tahiro Otomo Tahiro was a prisoner shukenja in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tahiro in 1360 went to Ito - Jo to destroy the evil inside but for his weak power he was captured and tortured by magic by an evil Wu jen in the caves deep the castle .
description_long: Otomo Tahiro Otomo Tahiro was a prisoner shukenja in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tahiro in 1360 went to Ito - Jo to destroy the evil inside but for his weak power he was captured and tortured by magic by an evil Wu jen in the caves deep the castle . An adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords met him with mind virtually gone and near death . After blabbering about a terrible monster inside the caves ( a krakentua ) he finally died

title: Otsabe Kanchi
description: Otsabe Kanchi Otsabe Kanchi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family and the zussho of Iyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Iyo , he led a company of two samurai and ten bushi , all loyal only to him .
description_long: Otsabe Kanchi Otsabe Kanchi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family and the zussho of Iyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Iyo , he led a company of two samurai and ten bushi , all loyal only to him . Personality . Otsabe was an ambitious man . He cared almost nothing for the Tsu family , not even sending them all of the tax income . He preferred to act as an ally to Niwa Hirotada and all Niwa retainers were welcomed in his house .

title: Ott Steeltoes
description: Ott Steeltoes Ott Steeltoes was the most competent smuggler of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Ott was a renegade of the Ironmaster clan . He first worked as pirate but later was offered a place in the Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild .
description_long: Ott Steeltoes Ott Steeltoes was the most competent smuggler of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Ott was a renegade of the Ironmaster clan . He first worked as pirate but later was offered a place in the Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild . He quickly accepted , liking the prospect of more power and a less dangerous life . The reorganization of the guild ( and the secret change of the guild master ) gave him more freedom in his thieving operations , which Ott greatly enjoyed . He became good friends with Ahmaergo and the two dwarves often drank together .

title: Ottad el Ostak
description: Ottad el Ostak Ottad yn Malik el Ostak was the younger brother of Basad el Ostak and the head of the thieves ' guild in Memnon for el Kahmir family in 1370 DR . Personality . Ottad was young and power - hungry , which spymaster Nureh el Pesarkhal used to her advantage .
description_long: Ottad el Ostak Ottad yn Malik el Ostak was the younger brother of Basad el Ostak and the head of the thieves ' guild in Memnon for el Kahmir family in 1370 DR . Personality . Ottad was young and power - hungry , which spymaster Nureh el Pesarkhal used to her advantage .

title: Ottar
description: Ottar Ottar was a frost giant and the origin of the frost giant race . His father , Annam All - Father , granted him the cold lands of the north of Faerûn . Relatives .
description_long: Ottar Ottar was a frost giant and the origin of the frost giant race . His father , Annam All - Father , granted him the cold lands of the north of Faerûn . Relatives . Ottar was the son of Annam All - Father and the father of Hrotun .

title: Otto ' s irresistible dance
description: Otto ' s irresistible dance Otto ' s irresistible dance was an enchantment spell that forced the subject to dance . It was presumably developed by Otto . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as irresistible dance , and counted among the spells of the universal province .
description_long: Otto ' s irresistible dance Otto ' s irresistible dance was an enchantment spell that forced the subject to dance . It was presumably developed by Otto . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as irresistible dance , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effect . The victim experienced an irresistable compulsion to dance , including shuffling and tapping their feet , capering and prancing . Naturally , they were completely unable to do anything else , even defend or protect themselves .

title: Otyugh
description: Otyugh Otyughs were strange aberration s that dwelt underground and delighted in the eating of filth and offal . Description . Otyughs were strange - looking creatures , with bloated , oval - shaped bodies around 8 feet ( 2 .
description_long: Otyugh Otyughs were strange aberration s that dwelt underground and delighted in the eating of filth and offal . Description . Otyughs were strange - looking creatures , with bloated , oval - shaped bodies around 8 feet ( 2 . 4 meters ) wide that stood on three shuffling elephantine legs and had a disgusting , rock - like hide . They had a pair of long tentacles that were bedecked in rough thorny growths and ended in leaf - shaped pads bearing rows of more sharp spikes . A third tentacle sprouted from the top of the otyugh ' s body , forming a vine - like stalk standing some 2 feet ( 60 cm ) high , and ended in a pair of eyes and an olfactory organ . The body of the creature contained a massive fang - filled mouth , shaped like a crude gash through its center . A typical otyugh was around 500 pounds ( 227 kg ) in mass . Ecology . Otyughs were primarily omnivorous scavengers . They could consume almost all kinds of refuse and waste , such as carrion , offal , and many other things others would view as garbage . Nevertheless , they would take fresh meat when they had the chance . Behavior .

title: Ouranalathra
description: Ouranalathra Ouranalathra , also called " the Mistmaiden " , was a female great wyrm mist dragon who once laired at Iron Dragon Mountain , in Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn , but by 1374 DR resided at the Lake of Mists in the Endless Wastes . History . In the spring of 231 DR , the Year of the Mist Dragon — a year named for her — Ouranalathra was sighted in lands all around the Inner Sea , challenging , fighting , and publicly slaying any other dragon she could find .
description_long: Ouranalathra Ouranalathra , also called " the Mistmaiden " , was a female great wyrm mist dragon who once laired at Iron Dragon Mountain , in Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn , but by 1374 DR resided at the Lake of Mists in the Endless Wastes . History . In the spring of 231 DR , the Year of the Mist Dragon — a year named for her — Ouranalathra was sighted in lands all around the Inner Sea , challenging , fighting , and publicly slaying any other dragon she could find . She ' d won an enormous hoard of treasure by the winter , called the " The Shining Hoard of the Great Dragon " by bards , and some several hundred adventuring bands departed from Calimport to take it . Ouranalathra spent sixty years fighting them off . She and her treasure disappeared from history afterwards . Ouranalathra once laired at a mountain later known as Iron Dragon Mountain in the Earthfast Mountains , but later moved to the deeps of the Lake of Mists in the Endless Wastes , where she still dwelled in 1374 DR . Appendix . Notes . It is implied that Iron Dragon Mountain is named for Ouranalathra .

title: Ourqax
description: Ourqax Ourqax was a ixilthetocal ruler during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Born in 1212 DR Ourqax started in ascension in 1355 DR at Ilkanar and Ageadren and in ashort time became vitanar .
description_long: Ourqax Ourqax was a ixilthetocal ruler during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Born in 1212 DR Ourqax started in ascension in 1355 DR at Ilkanar and Ageadren and in ashort time became vitanar . However once on the throne Ourqax waited his time to move , becoming the least proactive of all Xedran Reefs leaders . During the Twelfth Serôs War the Xedran Reefs lose the cities of Ageadren and Orilidren and the supporting temples at Ilramas , Ilkanar , Ilphaeth , and Ilteon . After the war Ourqax focused to rebuilt his people and his nation but the the loss of the southern cities of the reefs , his mother - place and source of political powers , started grow madness and sorrow in the Vitanar . However Ourqax planned for 1371 DR to reclaim his lost cities and also attack and destroy the outact merfolk of Thuridru and the rogue vitan Qyxas .

title: Oussa
description: Oussa Oussa was a yuan - ti in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Oussa was a devotee of Zehir .
description_long: Oussa Oussa was a yuan - ti in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Oussa was a devotee of Zehir . History . Oussa was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments . More specifically , he was the chosen of Zehir . Oussa was freed from his chains by the heroes of Daggerford but then he realized that they were not followers of Zehir and tried to kill them but was defeated .

title: Outer Planes
description: Outer Planes Outer Planes is a collective term used to describe a subset of the known planes of existence in various cosmology models . The term refers to the placement of the planes being the outermost concentric sphere that made up the multiverse in the Great Wheel cosmology model . The term continued to be used in the World Tree cosmology model but referred to a different set of planes .
description_long: Outer Planes Outer Planes is a collective term used to describe a subset of the known planes of existence in various cosmology models . The term refers to the placement of the planes being the outermost concentric sphere that made up the multiverse in the Great Wheel cosmology model . The term continued to be used in the World Tree cosmology model but referred to a different set of planes . Outer Planes could refer to :

title: Outland priest
description: Outland priest Outland priests were cleric s , priests , and druid s who came to Zakhara from distant lands to practice their beliefs . Requirements . Members of both sexes and all races could be considered an outland priest , though no Zakharan could ever be considered an outland priest .
description_long: Outland priest Outland priests were cleric s , priests , and druid s who came to Zakhara from distant lands to practice their beliefs . Requirements . Members of both sexes and all races could be considered an outland priest , though no Zakharan could ever be considered an outland priest . Role . Though most Zakharan religions preached tolerance , they carefully monitored outland priests and their strange practices and gods . Possessions . Outland priests carried whatever equipment and gear was acceptable for their chosen god or goddess . Benefits . Outland priests had access to clerical magic that many , if not all , Zakharan priests were unfamiliar with . Hindrances . Distrust followed an outland priest through the Land of Fate , especially when dealing with other native priests of the Enlightened gods .

title: Outland warrior
description: Outland warrior Outland warriors were special warrior s found in Zakhara who traveled there from some other location . Requirements . These warriors had no special requirements .
description_long: Outland warrior Outland warriors were special warrior s found in Zakhara who traveled there from some other location . Requirements . These warriors had no special requirements . Role . Outland warriors served a wide variety of roles in the Land of Fate . Most native Zakharans viewed them with a healthy does of curiosity and / or fear . Possessions . Outland warriors typically carried armor and weaponry foreign to Zakhara . Special Benefits . These warriors did not have any special benefits . Special Hindrances . Outland warriors stood out in Zakhara like a sore thumb . Their accents were thick , their armor was usually heavy , and their sword s were curiously straight . They attracted attention wherever they roamed .

title: Outsider
description: Outsider Outsiders were any non - elemental creatures that originated on a plane other than the Prime Material Plane . Abilities . Most outsiders had darkvision to a range of 60 feet .
description_long: Outsider Outsiders were any non - elemental creatures that originated on a plane other than the Prime Material Plane . Abilities . Most outsiders had darkvision to a range of 60 feet . Notable outsiders . Notable outsiders found in the Forgotten Realms included : Appendix . Notes . In fourth edition D & D rules , the " outsider " creature type was replaced with more specific types such as fey , immortal , and elemental creature .

title: Overking
description: Overking Overking was a title used by a ruler , equivalent to a king . History . The orc kingdom of Vastar was ruled by an overking .
description_long: Overking Overking was a title used by a ruler , equivalent to a king . History . The orc kingdom of Vastar was ruled by an overking . Ologh the Overking held the position and created a throne himself , but died in 572 DR , leaving the position of overking vacant . After a civil war , Grimmerfang seized the throne but took the title Orc - King instead . In 1367 DR , the archmage Yuthrygg of the Many Miracles declared himself overking of Tethyr , but this was contested by Galthaunt the Grimcloak . The same year , the rulers of the cities of Chessenta considered some joint security measures , including the installation of an overking to protect the nation as a whole . However , they determined that none of them should be raised to overking , and argued over the selection process and possible candidates . Various factions put forth their own candidates .

title: Overland flight
description: Overland flight Overland flight was a transmutation spell that functioned like the spell " fly " , except that it only affected the caster and was slightly slower , but lasted much longer . Over an eight - hour period , the caster of overland flight could travel up to 64 miles .
description_long: Overland flight Overland flight was a transmutation spell that functioned like the spell " fly " , except that it only affected the caster and was slightly slower , but lasted much longer . Over an eight - hour period , the caster of overland flight could travel up to 64 miles .

title: Overseer
description: Overseer Overseers were the most dangerous of the beholderkin . Rivaling the power of a hive mother , an overseer resembled nothing more than a large mass of flesh or a tree with mouths on its trunk and eyes on its branches . Overseers possessed powers similar to that of a hive mother and could control the actions of five to ten standard beholder s or five to twenty beholderkin .
description_long: Overseer Overseers were the most dangerous of the beholderkin . Rivaling the power of a hive mother , an overseer resembled nothing more than a large mass of flesh or a tree with mouths on its trunk and eyes on its branches . Overseers possessed powers similar to that of a hive mother and could control the actions of five to ten standard beholder s or five to twenty beholderkin . However , overseers could only control creatures of the same type . Thus , one overseer could control deathkiss es or directors but not a combination of the two beholder types .

title: Oversember Vale
description: Oversember Vale Oversember Vale was a small valley located in the Thunder Peaks . Description . Small pools of water lay at the northern end of the vale .
description_long: Oversember Vale Oversember Vale was a small valley located in the Thunder Peaks . Description . Small pools of water lay at the northern end of the vale . A line of stunted , scraggly trees hugged the steep rock - face on the northwest side of the valley . Inhabitants . The Cult of the Dragon inhabited the vale . The cult had at least one hidden cavern in the vale .

title: Ovith
description: Ovith Ovith was a shadovar scout for Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Ovith and his fellow Cronil went under the orders of Brennus to search for the Abbey of the Rose .
description_long: Ovith Ovith was a shadovar scout for Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Ovith and his fellow Cronil went under the orders of Brennus to search for the Abbey of the Rose . They were attacked by Vasen Cale ' s party before they could find it . Cronil was killed but Ovith managed to escape . He went back to Sakkors and told his prince all about it .

title: Ovon
description: Ovon Ovon was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Ovon was always calm and naive .
description_long: Ovon Ovon was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Ovon was always calm and naive . He was a pacifist and never acted to harm someone . Ovon tended to be enigmatic and spoke in riddles . History . In 1491 DR , he met and befriended Thylius Caramitru , who ' d visited the Monastery . Thylius invited him to his house in Mulmaster and Ovon accepted . However , once in Mulmaster , Thylius enslaved Ovon and forced him to teach him the secret of Yellow Breath . He remained a prisoner of Thylius in the Yellow Breath Chapter House until an adventuring party hired to find missing young nobles freed him . Secretly he was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred

title: Ovros Thilymm
description: Ovros Thilymm Ovros Thilymm was a man of Mordulkin in Chessenta and Head Librarian of the Jedea Academy in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Ovros led Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah to a secret meeting with a contact — in truth , King Hercubes Jedea .
description_long: Ovros Thilymm Ovros Thilymm was a man of Mordulkin in Chessenta and Head Librarian of the Jedea Academy in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Ovros led Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah to a secret meeting with a contact — in truth , King Hercubes Jedea . Description . He was an old man who wore a conical hat and a medallion bearing a cut sapphire . He used a magic glowing quill to write with at night .

title: Owl
description: Owl Owls are nocturnal birds of prey that are known to silently fly through the night in search of food . They feed on small animals , lizards , and other birds . Owls come in a variety of names and appearances .
description_long: Owl Owls are nocturnal birds of prey that are known to silently fly through the night in search of food . They feed on small animals , lizards , and other birds . Owls come in a variety of names and appearances . Combat . One disturbing trait of owls is their ability to turn their heads to face completely backwards . They evolved this ability to find prey without having to turn around and give away their position in the forest . Owls are further aided by the structure of their wings . Their wing beats produce no noise , allowing them to approach their targets in utter silence . Society . Owls are sought out by sages and scholars as they are seen as an excellent companion for those who are considered wise and learned . Locations . Owls were found across the North . Notable owls . Catti - brie , a human , was known to take the shape of an owl after her rebirth as Ruqiah .

title: Owlbear
description: Owlbear An owlbear is a large magical beast that looks like a cross between an owl and a bear . Species . Cormanthor .
description_long: Owlbear An owlbear is a large magical beast that looks like a cross between an owl and a bear . Species . Cormanthor . The owlbears of the Starwood area of the Cormanthor forest quickly ate through their food supply of wolves , rabbits and serpents . Their population began to decrease as food became scarce , although they came across a supply of harvester termites and found that they were edible . They quickly found that they could maintain their own termite colonies by managing their wood supplies , and therefore effectively grow their own food . As a side effect of this practice , horses are drawn to the scent of the termite shells mixed with owlbear saliva , and the owlbears have taken to hiding and waiting for horses to arrive , before pushing them into a termite pit and then devouring them . Pyrolisk s are also drawn to the scent , but owlbears will abandon a pit if a pyrolisk turns up , rather than risk being incinerated . Physical description . Owlbears are monstrous beasts with the bodies of bears covered in thick fur and feathers . Their heads are like those of owls . Combat .

title: Oxsal Keeneyes
description: Oxsal Keeneyes Count Oxsal Keeneyes was a Count of Monteshi and Guild Chancellor of Tethyr . He was a halfling man . Personality .
description_long: Oxsal Keeneyes Count Oxsal Keeneyes was a Count of Monteshi and Guild Chancellor of Tethyr . He was a halfling man . Personality . Count Keeneyes was a strongly religious man ( a servant of Arvoreen ) , and a spirited , capable warrior , ready to prove to the human s that the hin could defend Tethyr . Activities . Although officially in charge of managing the guilds of Tethyr , Count Keeneyes abdicated this duty ( with permission ) to his wife . His focus instead was the defense of Tethyr , primarily from the dreaded ruins of Shoonach . In fact , he was dubbed with the nicknames " Shoonach ' s Guardian " and " Tethyr ' s Guardian " because of this . Though his official manor was Pelmarin , located in the Clovis Fields , he spent the vast majority of his time at Fort Teqlar , within the borders of Shoonach , from where he and nearly 200 soldiers monitored that region in an attempt to contain its evils . In addition , County Monteshi bordered Calimshan , and a large portion of that land was contested by the Calishites , who called the area " Monrativi Teshy Mir " , and so the halfling count ever watched its borders as well .

title: Oyfanen
description: Oyfanen Oyfanen was a dryad living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Oyfanen was the spirit of an oak tree . History .
description_long: Oyfanen Oyfanen was a dryad living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Oyfanen was the spirit of an oak tree . History . Around 1486 DR , Oyfanen was greatly concerned with the invasion of the village by goblinoid s in service to one of the Red Wizards of Thay .

title: Oyn Evenmoor
description: Oyn Evenmoor Oyn Evenmoor was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Oyn was a stubborn , argumentative man with an opinion about everything .
description_long: Oyn Evenmoor Oyn Evenmoor was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Oyn was a stubborn , argumentative man with an opinion about everything . He would generously offer drinks to people to listen to his speeches . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR Oyn attached his wagon carrying exotic birds to a great caravan that , unbeknownst to him , was full of agents of the Cult of the Dragon transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Ozomar Do ' Urden
description: Ozomar Do ' Urden Ozomar Do ' Urden , formerly Ozomar Druu ' giir , was the house wizard of House Do ' Urden . History . Ozomar was formerly a member of House Druu ' giir .
description_long: Ozomar Do ' Urden Ozomar Do ' Urden , formerly Ozomar Druu ' giir , was the house wizard of House Do ' Urden . History . Ozomar was formerly a member of House Druu ' giir . He attended Sorcere , the drow academy of magic , and was a " promising graduate " . After the death of his rival ( and the Do ' Urden house wizard ) Nalfein Do ' Urden , Ozomar happily defected to House Do ' Urden to serve as house wizard , presumably until its destruction in 1339 DR .

title: PC
description: PC A PC ( player character ) is the opposite of an NPC . A PC is the character that you make in a computer roleplaying game , or the character that the player makes in a game of . The term in the plural is frequently used to refer to the group of players .
description_long: PC A PC ( player character ) is the opposite of an NPC . A PC is the character that you make in a computer roleplaying game , or the character that the player makes in a game of . The term in the plural is frequently used to refer to the group of players .

title: Pachipol
description: Pachipol Pachipol was the mayor of Amah in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . Activities . Pachipol ruled Amah , one of the Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach .
description_long: Pachipol Pachipol was the mayor of Amah in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . Activities . Pachipol ruled Amah , one of the Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach . History . In 1358 DR , Pachipol participated in a meeting of leaders of both Chondath and Turmish to discuss the menace of the arcanaloth Yrkhetep . He was choose by lottery to be spokesperson for the group . He exposed the threat , with the help of the sage Inata Eller , to an adventuring party that had ruined some of Yrkhetep ' s previous plots . He asked them to go to Hades and lead the Iron Legion for the last battle with Yrkhetep . Personality . Pachipol appeared to be a passionate individual , caring for his land .

title: Pack runner
description: Pack runner A pack runner is a beastmaster ranger who has chosen to focus his or her connection with the wild through their bond with a canine such as a wolf or jackal . These pack runners form bonds solely with companions of the canine variety , building upon the long history of friendship between canines and humanoid s . So connected is the pack runner and his or her canine friend , that their minds can often seem as one , as the ranger takes on doglike characteristics while their feral friend becomes more and more like a sentient creature .
description_long: Pack runner A pack runner is a beastmaster ranger who has chosen to focus his or her connection with the wild through their bond with a canine such as a wolf or jackal . These pack runners form bonds solely with companions of the canine variety , building upon the long history of friendship between canines and humanoid s . So connected is the pack runner and his or her canine friend , that their minds can often seem as one , as the ranger takes on doglike characteristics while their feral friend becomes more and more like a sentient creature . Culture . Pack runners have no single culture with which they are aligned . Rather , it seems that humanoids in general are naturally drawn to canines , seeking animal companions that are both cunning and social . Canines , and wolves in particular , seem to fit this trait exceptionally well and there is strong evidence to suggest humanoids and canines have worked alongside one another since before the beginning of civilization . This line of thought is furthered by the fact that virtually all humanoid races , from eladrin to goblin s , have a tradition of domesticating doglike pets .

title: Pact of the Iron Ring
description: Pact of the Iron Ring The Pact of the Iron Ring was a brief ritual designed to strengthen the bond between the Warlock Knights of Vaasa . The ritual required each knight to display his ring and swear an oath to all the other knights present . Knights who participated in the ritual were bound to their peers for all time .
description_long: Pact of the Iron Ring The Pact of the Iron Ring was a brief ritual designed to strengthen the bond between the Warlock Knights of Vaasa . The ritual required each knight to display his ring and swear an oath to all the other knights present . Knights who participated in the ritual were bound to their peers for all time . It was possible to secretly withhold an oath during the ritual and knights who did so were not bound by the pact . The ritual could be reversed with the " remove affliction " ritual .

title: Pacys
description: Pacys Pacys was an old wandering bard in 1370 DR . History . Pacys hailed from Maskyr ' s Eye in the Vast but abandoned his home to follow the bard Ardynn , whom he loved .
description_long: Pacys Pacys was an old wandering bard in 1370 DR . History . Pacys hailed from Maskyr ' s Eye in the Vast but abandoned his home to follow the bard Ardynn , whom he loved . Traveling with Ardynn , Pacys discovered he had the talent to be a bard himself . In time , he separated from Ardynn but was with her when Ardynn died in Thar . Relationships . Pacys never stopped loving Ardynn . Personality . Pacys had the great ability to inspire trust in all people . He used this to collect true stories to use in his songs but always changed names to hurt no one . Pacys was a great showman , able to move people to feeling .

title: Padded armor
description: Padded armor Padded armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Padded armor was made up of several quilted layers of cloth and .
description_long: Padded armor Padded armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Padded armor was made up of several quilted layers of cloth and . Padded armor was poorly ventilated and got hot quickly . It was known to become foul with sweat , grime , lice and fleas . Usage . Being one of the cheapest forms of armor , padded armor was commonly distributed to conscripts in times of war . Padded armor was a common sight in northern Zakhara .

title: Paddy Stoutfellow
description: Paddy Stoutfellow Paddy Stoutfellow was a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . Paddy was a halfling with black , bushy hair and sideburns .
description_long: Paddy Stoutfellow Paddy Stoutfellow was a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . Paddy was a halfling with black , bushy hair and sideburns . Personality . Paddy was the clown of the Company of Eight , with a sometimes inappropriate sense of humor . He was cheerful and light - hearted yet exceedingly loyal to anyone he considered a friend . He had a great love of adventure for adventure ' s sake . He only wanted to live adventures worthy of being told to his grandchildren in future . His favorite pastime was thieving , especially if involved difficult mark , because he enjoyed the thrill . He tended to be apolitical , unlike many of his adventuring companions . Abilities . Paddy specialized in combat with the broadsword , which he wielded with two hands . He was quite talented with a crossbow as well . He knew how to ride a horse and was good at fishing . Possessions . Paddy wore chainmail , and his primary weapon was a magic green - dragon - slaying broadsword , which he inherited from former Company member Chiaelin Frendel . He also kept a variety of magic crossbow bolts ready . Relationships . Paddy consider everyone in the Company of Eight his friends .

title: Padhra
description: Padhra The Padhra was the founder and deity of the Padhran religion practiced in the Hordelands . In life , the Padhra was known as Surtava , an ancient Ulgarian prince who abandoned his privileged existence to become a beggar and seek enlightenment . He found it and dedicated the remainder of his life to teaching others his observations .
description_long: Padhra The Padhra was the founder and deity of the Padhran religion practiced in the Hordelands . In life , the Padhra was known as Surtava , an ancient Ulgarian prince who abandoned his privileged existence to become a beggar and seek enlightenment . He found it and dedicated the remainder of his life to teaching others his observations . He was sometimes called the Great Teacher . History . As written in the religious books of the Padhran faith , around −1700 DR , Surtava , an Ulgarian prince , abandoned his crown , his power , and his wealth to become a beggar and seek enlightenment and wisdom . Prince Surtava was accompanied by a pet leopard named Gaumahavi , and she served as his sole companion , friend , and protector . Thanks to her close contact with Surtava and participation in his quest , Gaumahavi developed an animal soul . The leopard became a supernatural and intelligent beast , capable of speech and writing , and even of a search for enlightenment herself . At one point , Gaumahavi gave birth , producing a litter of leopard cubs . Most were ordinary animals , but one , Sandiraksiva , was supernatural and bore an animal soul like his mother .

title: Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom
description: Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom The Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom was a religious text discussing the Padhran religion . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR . Appendix .
description_long: Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom The Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom was a religious text discussing the Padhran religion . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR . Appendix . Notes . The Padhran religion described on the same page in " Storm Riders " only has Four Baskets of Wisdom .

title: Padhran religion
description: Padhran religion The Padhran religion was a faith practiced in the Hordelands and by almost all of those living in the hidden realm of Ra - Khati . History . As written in the religious books of the Padhran faith , around −1700 DR , an Ulgarian prince named Surtava gave up his crown , his power , and his wealth and voluntarily became a beggar to seek enlightenment and wisdom .
description_long: Padhran religion The Padhran religion was a faith practiced in the Hordelands and by almost all of those living in the hidden realm of Ra - Khati . History . As written in the religious books of the Padhran faith , around −1700 DR , an Ulgarian prince named Surtava gave up his crown , his power , and his wealth and voluntarily became a beggar to seek enlightenment and wisdom . After many years of wandering and meditation , Surtava achieved a state he called " Eaum " , or enlightenment . He spent his remaining years preaching what he had learned . Surtava founded the Padhran religion , with the aid of other founders , such as Monkey . When Surtava died , he ascended to the heavens to become the Padhra . In time , his soul was joined by the souls of thousands of other beings who also attained Eaum . They became incarnations of the Padhra , called padhrasattva s . Dogma . The Padhran religion could be broken down into two main philosophies called the " Four Baskets of Wisdom " and the " Sixfold Path " , as outlined by the Padhra ' s two lectures . The Four Baskets of Wisdom summarized the Padhra ' s basic views on life and reincarnation .

title: Paektu - san
description: Paektu - san Paektu - san was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Paektu - san lay on the southern coast of the western peninsula , north of the Dragon ' s Teeth , a series of straits that were impossible to navigate .
description_long: Paektu - san Paektu - san was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Paektu - san lay on the southern coast of the western peninsula , north of the Dragon ' s Teeth , a series of straits that were impossible to navigate .

title: Paelinn
description: Paelinn Paelinn was a female drow and a divine seeker of Kiaransalee who resided in the Undying Temple in Maerimydra . Description . Attractive , tall , and slim , Paelinn was a young drow with striking emerald eyes and a delicate but angled face .
description_long: Paelinn Paelinn was a female drow and a divine seeker of Kiaransalee who resided in the Undying Temple in Maerimydra . Description . Attractive , tall , and slim , Paelinn was a young drow with striking emerald eyes and a delicate but angled face . She kept her yellow - white hair in a tight pulled - back bun . Typically she wrapped herself in a voluminous black " piwafwi " and kept the hood of the cloak up over her head . Personality . A proactive drow , Paelinn preferred to take the initiative in most situations and was a highly tactical thinker . As an avid devotee of Kiaransalee , she often sought the most effective and efficient way of harming her enemies . She was not above executing a defeated foe or retreating if a fight turned against her . Abilities . Paelinn was a rogue possessed of extraordinary grace and moved elegantly and almost entirely silently . This was further enhanced by her magical " silent moves " studded leather and fine " gloves of dexterity " . In combat , she combined her phenomenal agility with her tactical mind to unleash devastatingly timed attacks in a whirling dervish , all the while tumbling and maneuvering into new positions .

title: Paerestus
description: Paerestus Paerestus , also called " Smokebeard " , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast in the 12th century DR . He was a famous bard . History .
description_long: Paerestus Paerestus , also called " Smokebeard " , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast in the 12th century DR . He was a famous bard . History . Paerestus was a famous bard . Some time after the Year of the Quiet Earth , 1161 DR , Paerestus bought " Wythyndle ' s Round Book " from Lord Irlistir of Ulkan for a goodly amount of money . This was a magical and holy book of Milil , Lord of Song , and Paerestus felt it to be a gift of the gods , but only ever listened to and learned the music it played , for later use with lyrics of his own . He kept the " Round Book " stashed in a secret space in the decaying stone wall of the stables behind his house . Paerestus died in a house - fire one morning in the Year of the Tomb , 1182 DR . Though his house was burned down , the " Round Book " survived unscathed in the stables . It was eventually rediscovered by another , likely someone robbing out building stones . Description . A warm , rich voice made Paerestus famous , However , he was short on originality when it came to writing tunes . He had the moniker " Smokebeard " .

title: Pag Hou Ling
description: Pag Hou Ling Pag Hou Ling was a steward in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Pag ' s mother hailed from T ' u lung .
description_long: Pag Hou Ling Pag Hou Ling was a steward in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Pag ' s mother hailed from T ' u lung . Since the age of 15 , he started working for the council kashag serving the dzong - pon of Tsetu for ten years . Later , for six years , Pag worked as an itinerant secretary in the southern districts . In 1355 DR , after he successfully defeated a group of Shou Lung bandits , Pag was appointed as dzong - pon of Chophon . He demonstrated himself very capable , having rid the district of crimes . He made many pilgrimages and donations to the Do ' dzin Gompa . Personality . Pag was the true epitome of a Tabotan : devoted to the extreme to the high lama and his dogmas and strong as iron .

title: Page prince
description: Page prince Being a page prince is a stage in every noble - born drow male ' s life whereupon he must personally cater to the Matron Mother ' s every whim ( more so than usual ) . Page princes are not deemed nobles until they have completed the training required of them . It is the task of the house elderboy to train the page prince in manners .
description_long: Page prince Being a page prince is a stage in every noble - born drow male ' s life whereupon he must personally cater to the Matron Mother ' s every whim ( more so than usual ) . Page princes are not deemed nobles until they have completed the training required of them . It is the task of the house elderboy to train the page prince in manners . When a noble drow male is ten years of age and his wean mother has finished with him he becomes a page prince . He is treated as such until deemed ready to become a noble by the noble females of the house .

title: Pahari
description: Pahari Pahari were shapeshifting nymph s who inhabited the seas and oceans of Zakhara . Description . Pahari resembled mermaid s in their natural form , but they also appeared as small fish or beautiful women .
description_long: Pahari Pahari were shapeshifting nymph s who inhabited the seas and oceans of Zakhara . Description . Pahari resembled mermaid s in their natural form , but they also appeared as small fish or beautiful women . A pahari ’ s scales ranged in color from blue and green to ruby red . Combat . Pahari were shy creatures who loathed combat . They were capable of using weapons , but rarely carried any . They were fond of using magical items to defend themselves . All pahari were strong spell - casters and had powers similar to elemental wizard s who specialized in water magic . Their favorite spell s included : " airy water " , " command water spirits " , " conjure elemental " ( water ) , " converse with sea creatures " , " float " , " sea sight " , " ship of fools " , " strengthen water creatures " , " waterbane " , and " water blast " . Habitat / Society . These marine creatures lived in small communities on the sea floor , usually close to shore . Most of their diet consisted of kelp and seaweed that was supplemented with shellfish and mollusks . Pahari never ate fish , considering it to be cannibalistic behavior .

title: Pain domain
description: Pain domain The Pain domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters spell s and powers themed around pain . Pain Domain Powers . A cleric with the Pain domain could convert an injury dealt from one blow into healing for him or herself , once a day .
description_long: Pain domain The Pain domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters spell s and powers themed around pain . Pain Domain Powers . A cleric with the Pain domain could convert an injury dealt from one blow into healing for him or herself , once a day . Appendix . Background . The Pain domain originated in the " Book of Vile Darkness " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " .

title: Painbearer
description: Painbearer The painbearer was a specialty priest of Ilmater , the Crying God . History . Specialty priests of Ilmater were simply called " clerics " , like other cleric s , around 1358 DR .
description_long: Painbearer The painbearer was a specialty priest of Ilmater , the Crying God . History . Specialty priests of Ilmater were simply called " clerics " , like other cleric s , around 1358 DR . The name " painbearer " was in use by 1369 DR , by which time they had gained additional powers . By 1479 DR , however , all priests of Ilmater were called " painbearers " . Relationships . As specialty priests , painbearers were naturally included among the ranks of the Adorned , the clergy of the church of Ilmater . Entry . Painbearers were naturally required to be quite hardy , in addition to being wise . Later , they also needed skill in healing and to be of a lawful good disposition . Culture . Some painbearers trained at the Convent of St . Rhynda in Tethyr around 1370 DR . Possessions . Painbearers learned to wield bludgeoning weapons as well as the scourge . However , they did not wear armor . Abilities . Painbearers learned techniques and gained greater endurance to help them undergo hardships , weather suffering and to resist pain . A painbearer could also go without food and water for several weeks , and though weakened , they would not die of starvation or thirst during this time .

title: Paine
description: Paine Paine was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Paine was a Zhent executioner until she escaped to the North .
description_long: Paine Paine was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Paine was a Zhent executioner until she escaped to the North . She was paranoid about new settlers in Daggerford , afraid of possible Zhent assassins . She was right : the Zhentarim searched for her in order to kill her .

title: Paitza
description: Paitza A paitza was a warrant of safe passage through Tuigan lands in the Hordelands . It served as a symbol of the " khahans " favor , leaving anyone who carried one free to roam the vast steppe unmolested . Description .
description_long: Paitza A paitza was a warrant of safe passage through Tuigan lands in the Hordelands . It served as a symbol of the " khahans " favor , leaving anyone who carried one free to roam the vast steppe unmolested . Description . " Paitzas " were usually made from metal and measured roughly a foot in length and were several inches wide . The kind of metal used for a specific " paitza " was a symbol of the " khahans " favor , with more expensive metals signifying higher favor . A hole at one end was looped with a leather thong for easy attachment . The " khahans " personal seal , that of a tiger face , was inscribed onto the " paitza " along with a simple message . History . The lama Koja of Khazari was granted a gold en " paitza " for his services to Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde . He doubted it would be very useful after the khahan ' s death , however , and considered leaving it as a gift to the temple of Deneir in Procampur .

title: Paizo Publishing
description: Paizo Publishing Paizo Publishing , LLC is a publisher of fantasy roleplaying games , accessories , and board games . For many years Paizo was the publisher of the Dragon and the Dungeon magazine s . Founded in 2002 by Lisa Stevens , a former Wizards of the Coast employee who left after Hasbro bought the company in 2000 .
description_long: Paizo Publishing Paizo Publishing , LLC is a publisher of fantasy roleplaying games , accessories , and board games . For many years Paizo was the publisher of the Dragon and the Dungeon magazine s . Founded in 2002 by Lisa Stevens , a former Wizards of the Coast employee who left after Hasbro bought the company in 2000 . WotC offered Stevens the opportunity to publish the Dragon , Dungeon and Star Wars Insider magazines which she had long expressed an interest in working on . Taking on many former WotC staffers like herself , Stevens created Paizo to be a magazine publisher . When Wizards of the Coast informed Paizo that their contract would not be renewed in September 2007 , Paizo began the process of turning themselves into a publisher of games rather than magazines and in March of 2008 announced the Pathfinder game - based on the Dungeons and Dragons 3 . 5 OGL . Pathfinder has become a leader of the tabletop RPG market in its own right and Paizo contracts many Forgotten Realms luminaries to write content for the game such as Ari Marmell , Ed Greenwood , Elaine Cunningham , Eric L . Boyd , Jeff Grubb , R . A . Salvatore , Richard Baker Richard Lee Byers and Stephen E . Schend .

title: Palace Guard of Huzuz
description: Palace Guard of Huzuz The Palace Guard of Huzuz served as within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . All members of the palace guard were large individuals who possessed not only intimidating physical strength and presence , but enough intelligence and eloquence to resort to politely addressing visitors .
description_long: Palace Guard of Huzuz The Palace Guard of Huzuz served as within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . All members of the palace guard were large individuals who possessed not only intimidating physical strength and presence , but enough intelligence and eloquence to resort to politely addressing visitors . They also possessed an eye for spotting potential trouble or anything that was out of place . There were 1 , 000 members of the guard . Base of Operations . The palace guard was active within the royal palace of Huzuz . Members . Prince Cheddah al - Assad was the ultimate commander of the palace guard .

title: Palace Lane
description: Palace Lane The Palace Lane was a street located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This was a small street that branched off of the Street of the Inns ; leading travelers northeast toward the Palace of the Enlightened Throne , the Court of Enlightenment , and the beautiful Public Gardens of Huzuz .
description_long: Palace Lane The Palace Lane was a street located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This was a small street that branched off of the Street of the Inns ; leading travelers northeast toward the Palace of the Enlightened Throne , the Court of Enlightenment , and the beautiful Public Gardens of Huzuz .

title: Palace Quarter
description: Palace Quarter The Palace Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Palace Quarter encompassed the Affluent District , Court District , and the East District , forming most of the central and southeast portions of the city .
description_long: Palace Quarter The Palace Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Palace Quarter encompassed the Affluent District , Court District , and the East District , forming most of the central and southeast portions of the city . This quarter was the home of the wealthiest and most powerful figures in Huzuz , from the Grand Caliph and his court to lavish merchant families and the mysterious White Agate .

title: Palace of Loss
description: Palace of Loss The Palace of Loss was the abode of the goddess Shar , located on the Plane of Shadow , before the Spellplague . Description . The Palace of Loss was a tower with neither windows nor doors .
description_long: Palace of Loss The Palace of Loss was the abode of the goddess Shar , located on the Plane of Shadow , before the Spellplague . Description . The Palace of Loss was a tower with neither windows nor doors . Only Shar ' s petitioner s and servants knew the way to enter or exit the tower . Inhabitants . Besides her servants and worshipers , within the tower were kept her prisoners who desired freedom above all else . Thus , Shar could enjoy their pain more fully . History . At one point in time , the Palace of Loss was located in Niflheim , the second layer of Hades , before it was relocated in the Plane of Shadow . After the Spellplague , the Palace of Loss was destroyed , leaving behind a gaping dark hole , much like an inverted tower , called the Foundation of Loss . The hole formed a magical portal to her new home in the Towers of Night in the Astral Sea . The Foundation was surrounded by a sense of sorrow so strong it could be felt , and the area attracted many evil beings of darkness from the Shadowfell .

title: Palace of Sly Ravens
description: Palace of Sly Ravens The Palace of Sly Ravens was the seat for the Caliph of Liham , Harin al - Hayif , in 1367 DR . Location . Located in Liham , the palace did not stand out from the buildings surrounding it .
description_long: Palace of Sly Ravens The Palace of Sly Ravens was the seat for the Caliph of Liham , Harin al - Hayif , in 1367 DR . Location . Located in Liham , the palace did not stand out from the buildings surrounding it . Structure . The Palace of Sly Ravens was made from stucco that had been white - washed . The most distinguishing feature of the palace was the bright red tiles that graced the entire floor of the building . Interior . Modest murals decorated the walls , but the palace was not as opulent as other palaces within Zakhara . Inhabitants . The caliph of Liham called the palace home .

title: Palace of the Enlightened Throne
description: Palace of the Enlightened Throne The Palace of the Enlightened Throne , also known as the Palace of the Grand Caliph and the Seat of the Great Lion , was the seat of the Grand Caliph of all of Zakhara . Description . The Palace appeared as a small city when viewed from the court , covering several acres of land .
description_long: Palace of the Enlightened Throne The Palace of the Enlightened Throne , also known as the Palace of the Grand Caliph and the Seat of the Great Lion , was the seat of the Grand Caliph of all of Zakhara . Description . The Palace appeared as a small city when viewed from the court , covering several acres of land . All of the rooftops were covered with gold . The Palace was joined by rich gardens that were accessible by the general public . Location . Found in the capital city of Huzuz , it was the centre of power for a whole continent . History . Five centuries of building activity led to this splendid , expansive and varied complex . As of 1367 DR , no more changes had been made by Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir and his two predecessors . The citizens of Huzuz took great pride in the Palace and it was beloved by all . It was often referred to as " our palace " by the al - hadhar .

title: Palace of the Simbul
description: Palace of the Simbul The Palace of the Simbul ( or Simbul ' s Palace ) was a palace in Velprintalar ( now called Old Velprintalar ) and the home of the Simbul , queen of Aglarond from 1320 DR to 1425 DR . The palace is constructed from green stone from Mulhorand and is situated on a hill that overlooked Velprintalar . It was protected by a host of magical maeasures .
description_long: Palace of the Simbul The Palace of the Simbul ( or Simbul ' s Palace ) was a palace in Velprintalar ( now called Old Velprintalar ) and the home of the Simbul , queen of Aglarond from 1320 DR to 1425 DR . The palace is constructed from green stone from Mulhorand and is situated on a hill that overlooked Velprintalar . It was protected by a host of magical maeasures . By 1479 DR , the palace was being used by the Simbarch Council . During the Simbul ' s reign , she was not present at the palace very often , but it was occupied by her servants , as well as the Foresters , coucillors and Yuir elves .

title: Paladin
description: Paladin A paladin was a holy crusader , sworn to an oath to promote and fight for their beliefs and values . As paragons of their beliefs , paladins were granted the ability to wield divine magic by deities or similar powers . So long as a paladin stayed true to their oath , they retained the ability to wield these powers .
description_long: Paladin A paladin was a holy crusader , sworn to an oath to promote and fight for their beliefs and values . As paragons of their beliefs , paladins were granted the ability to wield divine magic by deities or similar powers . So long as a paladin stayed true to their oath , they retained the ability to wield these powers . The life of a paladin more commonly attracted good persons to it than those with malice in their heart , but evil paladins were not unheard of . Perhaps the best known paladin of Toril was Gareth Dragonsbane , who later went on to become the king of Damara , as well as the renowned Piergeiron Paladinson , an Open Lord of Waterdeep . Scyllua Darkhope and Aribeth de Tylmarande were infamous examples of fallen paladins , both formerly of Tyr , with Scyllua becoming a paladin of Bane instead . Culture . The defining characteristic of a paladin was their oath , which most frequently called upon a paladin to battle the forces of evil and to defend justice wherever they could .

title: Palaghard Obarskyr I
description: Palaghard Obarskyr I Palaghard I was king of Cormyr from 1164 DR to 1187 DR . Appearance . Palaghard had broad shoulders and blue eyes .
description_long: Palaghard Obarskyr I Palaghard I was king of Cormyr from 1164 DR to 1187 DR . Appearance . Palaghard had broad shoulders and blue eyes . Relatives . Palaghard married warrior queen Enchara of Esparin , in 1162 DR . Their son was Pryntaler Obarskyr . Background . Shortly after his coronation , Palaghard ' s crown was stolen , and he believed it to be the jewellers of Procampur . He gathered an army ready to attack , but it was later found out that the pirate Immursk was responsible .

title: Palaghard Obarskyr II
description: Palaghard Obarskyr II Background . Palaghard was born the second son of King Dhalmass Obarskyr and Jhalass Huntsilver in 1214 DR . Family .
description_long: Palaghard Obarskyr II Background . Palaghard was born the second son of King Dhalmass Obarskyr and Jhalass Huntsilver in 1214 DR . Family . Palaghard ' s queen was Alendue Wyrvar . They had three sons - Lhannas ( who died at the age of 22 in 1258 DR ) , Azoun ( who would become King Azoun III ) and Salember ( who would be regent after Azoun ' s death ) . He also had two sisters - Pelarra ( the great - grandmother of Dukes Bhereu and Thomdor ) and Eliira , as well as an older brother - Proster , who died at the age of 9 in 1222 DR .

title: Palarandusk
description: Palarandusk Palarandusk ( the Unseen Protector , previously the Sun Dragon ) is a male gold dragon who lives in the Sword Mountains on the Sword Coast North . He is a great wyrm . Each time he kills , he weeps .
description_long: Palarandusk Palarandusk ( the Unseen Protector , previously the Sun Dragon ) is a male gold dragon who lives in the Sword Mountains on the Sword Coast North . He is a great wyrm . Each time he kills , he weeps . He watches over the village of Ieirithymbul , regarding its gnome inhabitants as his children . He has prevented the invasion of the Clan Forgebar dwarves three times . He prefers to use an invisible and inaudible form so that he cannot be detected , but spends his time watching the gnomes and making sure they come to no harm . He is particularly interested in eavesdropping if gnomes are talking about their personal views or opinions . Palarandusk ' s secrecy has lead to Volo misinterpreting his true form , and the renowned dragon expert Velsaert from Baldur ' s Gate being unaware of his existence , but Elminster is aware of his identity . Description . Palarandusk still has bright eyes , but his scales are cracked with age and his jaw has turned white . Personality .

title: Pale Night
description: Pale Night Pale Night , also known as the Mother of Demons , is an Abyssal Lord , both enigmatic and unbelievably ancient . In " " , it was revealed that she is a member of the demonic race called the obyrith s . Description .
description_long: Pale Night Pale Night , also known as the Mother of Demons , is an Abyssal Lord , both enigmatic and unbelievably ancient . In " " , it was revealed that she is a member of the demonic race called the obyrith s . Description . Pale Night ' s form is incorporeal , and she appears as an empty flowing white shroud with the suggestion of a shapely female body underneath . It is said that Pale Night ' s true form , as befits an obyrith , is so hideous and terrifying that reality itself rejects it . The shroud that she " wears " hides it . To glimpse Pale Night ' s true form risks madness and death . Relationships . Ancient texts claim that Pale Night is the mother of Graz ' zt , Lupercio , and Vucarik in Chains . If she is indeed the mother of Graz ' zt , she would also be the grandmother of , and possibly the mother of Rhyxali . Other texts make the bold claim that the entire tanar ' ri race is descended from her in some way . However , Pale Night speaks only very rarely and has not confirmed any of this . She also seems to have a mutual defense alliance with Baphomet . Realm .

title: Pale River
description: Pale River The Pale River was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Pale River originated in the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth , flowing to the marid oyster beds in a particularly filthy area of the Elemental Plane of Water .
description_long: Pale River The Pale River was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Pale River originated in the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth , flowing to the marid oyster beds in a particularly filthy area of the Elemental Plane of Water . The Pale River connected the two elemental planes , permitting travel between them in both directions , but few used this elemental vortex for travel .

title: Pale green ioun stone
description: Pale green ioun stone The pale green ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving greater combat skill and fortitude . Description . It was a pale - green ovoid stone .
description_long: Pale green ioun stone The pale green ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving greater combat skill and fortitude . Description . It was a pale - green ovoid stone . Powers . When attuned , the " pale green " granted increased ability to strike one ' s foes in battle and increased health versus wounds . History . The " pale green ioun stone " came about when the dying warrior Rigar Trueblood begged his companion , the mage Spectorial , to preserve his skill and fortitude in battle . Although reluctant , Spectorial acceded and extracted these qualities from Rigar ' s soul , placing them in an " ioun stone " so that others might benefit from them . It eventually fell into the possession of Pai ' Na , a half - drow druid lurking in a giant spider nest beneath Athkatla ' s Graveyard District in 1368 DR .

title: Palevash
description: Palevash Palevash was an ancient and isolated monastery founded centuries before the 14th century DR by the monks of Shou Lung . Many monks of the monastery came to it from the native tribes across the Northern Wastes . However , these tribes and local races sometimes launched raids against the monastery for its wealth .
description_long: Palevash Palevash was an ancient and isolated monastery founded centuries before the 14th century DR by the monks of Shou Lung . Many monks of the monastery came to it from the native tribes across the Northern Wastes . However , these tribes and local races sometimes launched raids against the monastery for its wealth . Only the Pazruki respected its dominion over its valley and held it in high esteem .

title: Palischuk
description: Palischuk Palischuk was a settlement in the northeastern corner of Vaasa . Geography . The city was located just south of the banks of the towering ice river known as the Great Glacier and east of the ruins of Castle Perilous .
description_long: Palischuk Palischuk was a settlement in the northeastern corner of Vaasa . Geography . The city was located just south of the banks of the towering ice river known as the Great Glacier and east of the ruins of Castle Perilous . History . Palischuk was a ruined fortress city , rebuilt by half - orc s . Trade and relations . After Palischuk was rebuilt and reoccupied , its inhabitants succeeded in befriending other nearby settlements . As a result , around 1372 DR , it traded with Bloodstone Gate , Darmshall , and neighboring dwarves harmoniously , but human s still dealt with it cautiously . Inhabitants . The majority of its residents were half - orc . Appendix . Spelling . In R . A . Salvatore ' s works , " Promise of the Witch - King " , " Road of the Patriarch " , and " The Bloodstone Lands , the name of the settlement is spelled as Palishchuk , contrary to how is spelled in all other sources , even in map in " The Bloodstone Lands " .

title: Palla
description: Palla Palla the Light was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish around 1358 DR . Activities . Palla was the leader of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .
description_long: Palla Palla the Light was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish around 1358 DR . Activities . Palla was the leader of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate . History . Palla founded the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate , but only as a means to send bored and disaffected members of the Guldar merchant family out of the city .

title: Pallar the Obedient
description: Pallar the Obedient Pallar the Obedient was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a priest of Torm and was High Priest of the House of the Hand temple by 1358 DR , a position which he still held by 1367 DR . He had 26 subpriests and 48 lay - worshipers .
description_long: Pallar the Obedient Pallar the Obedient was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a priest of Torm and was High Priest of the House of the Hand temple by 1358 DR , a position which he still held by 1367 DR . He had 26 subpriests and 48 lay - worshipers . Priests of Torm ran Calispar Delgorth , a poison - dealing priest of Talona , out of the city early in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . When Calispar later dealt with the Shadowkind assassin s in the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , he asked them to assassinate the high priest .

title: Pallidor
description: Pallidor Pallidor was a wizard in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Pallidor was the apprentice of Vaelish Gant ] and a fellow member of reformed Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Pallidor Pallidor was a wizard in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Pallidor was the apprentice of Vaelish Gant ] and a fellow member of reformed Arcane Brotherhood . He followed his master in his plot to conquer Icewind Dale but after arriving in Bryn Shander , Pallidor abandoned Vaelish , following a voice that called to him . Under the voice ' s instruction , Pallidor recruited Baerick Hammerstone and his crew to make excavations in Kelvin ' s Cairn . There they discovered first black ice and later the corpse of Akar Kessell . Kessel , risen as a wight , explained that he was the voice that had guided Pallidor and possessed the young wizard to use as his vessel . Pallidor likely died when an adventuring party defeated Kessel for good .

title: Palm
description: Palm The palm tree was a type of tree found various places in Faerûn . Varieties . Beetle .
description_long: Palm The palm tree was a type of tree found various places in Faerûn . Varieties . Beetle . The beetle palm could be found growing in the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . They could grow to over 100 ' ( 30 m ) and took their name from their smooth , black bark , which resembled a beetle ' s shell . The wood was oily and burned easily , with less smoke than other woods .

title: Palonya
description: Palonya Sister Palonya was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sister Palonya arrived at the Yawning Portal inn with Brother Sepulcher .
description_long: Palonya Sister Palonya was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sister Palonya arrived at the Yawning Portal inn with Brother Sepulcher . Palonya went inside Undermountain to replace the previous priest of Jergal assigned to catalog the bodies inside some particular Undermountain tombs , while Sepulcher waited . However she was captured by the vampire Dayan and placed among his prisoners inside a room full of necromantic glyph s that siphoned energy from creatures experiencing anger , pain , fear , or other negative emotions . Thanks to it , Palonya lost her memory .

title: Palron Kaeth
description: Palron Kaeth Palron Kaeth was a vampire . Appearance . Palron Kaeth was bald with black sigil tattoos adorning his cheek and neck .
description_long: Palron Kaeth Palron Kaeth was a vampire . Appearance . Palron Kaeth was bald with black sigil tattoos adorning his cheek and neck . He possessed a heavy black leather cloak . History . In 464 DR , in the Sword of Anauroch , Palron Kaeth and the phaerimm fought against Arun Maerdrym and his son Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Arun struck the Duskstaff of Sarael with his Lupinaxe , causing an explosion that killed both him and Khelben and turned the surrounding sand to glass . Palron ' s fate is not clear .

title: Palter
description: Palter Palter was a Netherese floating city . It was established in 1217 NY . As the archwizard who controlled this enclave , Halavar established the laws guided the city .
description_long: Palter Palter was a Netherese floating city . It was established in 1217 NY . As the archwizard who controlled this enclave , Halavar established the laws guided the city . One such law was that everyone had to use magic in one form or another . He encouraged all entrepreneurs , smiths , and business owners to train their workers in the use of cantra s . This aided the city ’ s inhabitants in creating one of the most magical of enclaves . His most famous device , Halavar ’ s universal pantograph , helped propel Palter into the forefront of magic use and availability , but it also caused Halavar a great number of enemies outside the enclave . Though he was an archwizard , he left most of the rule to the constables and an elected council of seven members . This allowed Halavar to spend the majority of his time entertaining children and young adults with puppeteering . He fled his city when a group of arcanists and priests entered Palter to kill him , escaping only to be killed by bandits who wanted his device . The pantograph was never found , but its whereabouts have been theorized to be to the west of Netheril . History . The Golden Age ( 1652 - 2653 ) .

title: Pan
description: Pan Pan was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying on the shore of the Yellow Sea at the western end of the Vorkani Mountains . Organizations . Based in Pan was a yakuza family .
description_long: Pan Pan was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying on the shore of the Yellow Sea at the western end of the Vorkani Mountains . Organizations . Based in Pan was a yakuza family . Their symbol was a blue feather , which was tattooed on the heel of the left hand of their agents . They were allied with the notorious wu jen No Ziar the Mole . History . In 1357 DR , a band of adventurers headed by Glei Yuindo returned to Pan and it was rumored they had discovered the famous lost fortress of Toranu Ganppo . However , before they could tell their story , they died of a mysterious sickness .

title: Pan Chu
description: Pan Chu Pan Chu was the best wako admiral of Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pan Chu , a Kozakuran of Shou ancestry , was the most feared of the wako pirate admirals .
description_long: Pan Chu Pan Chu was the best wako admiral of Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pan Chu , a Kozakuran of Shou ancestry , was the most feared of the wako pirate admirals . He usually took no prisoners and saved only captured ship adapted for war . His ship was the " Golden Lily " , a war junk with a mixed crew of wako from Kozakura , Wa , and Shou Lung . Pan Chu was very efficient in his pirate raids and nobody had yet captured him .

title: Pandemonium
description: Pandemonium Pandemonium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane of chaotic neutral and chaotic evil alignment . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the Deep Caverns in the World Tree cosmology model which was later renamed the Dismal Caverns by the World Axis cosmology model . Description .
description_long: Pandemonium Pandemonium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane of chaotic neutral and chaotic evil alignment . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the Deep Caverns in the World Tree cosmology model which was later renamed the Dismal Caverns by the World Axis cosmology model . Description . Pandemonium was made entirely of rock pierced by innumerable tunnels and caverns large and small . All open space was filled with howling winds that carried the sound of every word , shout , or scream uttered in the place . Without adequate protection , beings with hearing were rendered temporarily deaf in a matter of seconds and permanently deaf in a few minutes . Normal fires could not survive and there was no natural light . Conversation could only be accomplished by shouting at close range . Gravity in Pandemonium always pulled away from the center of any cavern so a traveler could walk on the floor , walls , or ceiling . Streams and rivers would flow along one surface of a cave , or inexplicably down the middle through the air .

title: Pandemonium Stone
description: Pandemonium Stone The Pandemonium Stone was an ancient and extremely powerful artifact that existed in the Elemental Chaos . Description . The Pandemonium Stone was a spire more than five hundred feet ( 152 meters ) tall and more than one hundred feet ( 30 meters ) in diameter .
description_long: Pandemonium Stone The Pandemonium Stone was an ancient and extremely powerful artifact that existed in the Elemental Chaos . Description . The Pandemonium Stone was a spire more than five hundred feet ( 152 meters ) tall and more than one hundred feet ( 30 meters ) in diameter . The spire was made of bone , flesh , ice , minerals , wind , wood , and other materials that were in a constant state of change . It was roughly hewn , and fire , lightning , thunder , and extreme cold flared and crop up around the structure intermittently and randomly . Sometimes intense white runes in an unknown script crawled across its surface . The Pandemonium Stone manifested randomly across the Elemental Chaos , popping into existence in a powerful eruption of various types of energies at different places and points of time . When the spire appeared , it called to the slaad s , who gathered around it to bathe in its energy . History . Faerûn ian sages were unsure of the Pandemonium Stone origins . Some believed the structure contained a sleeping and immensely powerful slaad lord .

title: Pandorym
description: Pandorym Pandorym was an Elder Evil from a distant dimension beyond the Faerûnian cosmology . It was lured to Faerûn and imprisoned by the ancient Imaskari because they wanted it as a deterrent , a doomsday weapon to deter the vengeful deities of the Mulan from destroying Imaskar . Since Pandorym was very dangerous to the Imaskari themselves , they kept its body and mind separated .
description_long: Pandorym Pandorym was an Elder Evil from a distant dimension beyond the Faerûnian cosmology . It was lured to Faerûn and imprisoned by the ancient Imaskari because they wanted it as a deterrent , a doomsday weapon to deter the vengeful deities of the Mulan from destroying Imaskar . Since Pandorym was very dangerous to the Imaskari themselves , they kept its body and mind separated . Both were stored in the Celestial Nadir , a demiplane created by the Imaskari , with its psyche kept in the Imperial Weapon Cache within the Palace of the Purple Emperor , which was shifted to this plane . In the end , Pandorym was never used , and Re , Enlil , and the other deities destroyed the Imaskari Empire in - 2488 DR . After millennia of imprisonment , Pandorym ' s psyche partly freed itself when Datharathi miners from Vaelen discovered the Celestial Nadir in 1370 and mined the local crystal . Pandorym reached out through the crystal , which was used by the Datharathi family to produce artificial limbs and organs , and managed to control its subjects through these implants .

title: Panicked Plague
description: Panicked Plague The Panicked Plague was a disease that afflicted the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . Effects . The disease affected a victim ' s skin , turning it light green and covering it with welts and abscesses .
description_long: Panicked Plague The Panicked Plague was a disease that afflicted the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . Effects . The disease affected a victim ' s skin , turning it light green and covering it with welts and abscesses . Natural and magical treatments could do nothing to stop it . The disease killed quite quickly , perhaps in a day or less . History . In early spring of the Year of Full Cellars , 472 DR , the city of Mussum was struck by the Panicked Plague . Over the course of a single night , known as the " Eve of the Panicked Plague " , over three - quarters of the population suddenly perished . The terrified survivors abandoned the city . Mussum remained plague - ridden even into the mid - to - late 14th century DR , with those venturing into the city still afflicted and slain by the unexplained disease .

title: Panjuis
description: Panjuis Panjuis , the Pixie Fortress , was a located deep within the Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Most believed the location to simply be a myth . Structure .
description_long: Panjuis Panjuis , the Pixie Fortress , was a located deep within the Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Most believed the location to simply be a myth . Structure . The fortress of Panjuis was actually a living castle formed by three giant trees . The diameter of the base of each tree measured 40 ft . ( 12 m ) across . The trees rose 200 ft . ( 61 m ) into the sky . The branches of the three trees twisted and coiled together to form the stairs and chambers of the fortress . Inhabitants . Pixie s inhabited Panjuis up until the early 14th century DR when their king , Teremon , died . Upon his death the fortress began to fall into a state of over - growth . The pixies began to disperse into the Ama Basin . Groups of bakemono attacked Panjuis , eventually defeating the remaining pixies and taking control of the structure .

title: Pankin Yegorovna
description: Pankin Yegorovna Pankin Yegorovna ( pronounced PAN - kin YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was one of the Blade s of Mulmaster . Relationship . Pankin had a daughter , Riasa Yegorovna .
description_long: Pankin Yegorovna Pankin Yegorovna ( pronounced PAN - kin YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was one of the Blade s of Mulmaster . Relationship . Pankin had a daughter , Riasa Yegorovna . Activities . Pankin was one of the Blades and also owned many trading vessels . History . At one point , his wife died and he had the responsibility of caring for his daughter Riasa . In 1491 DR , however , she became a disciple of Thylius Caramitru . Riasa and Thylius performed a demonstration of Yellow Breath at a party held for Aleyd Burral . After Pankin was informed of his daughter ' s activities , he decided to lock her in the Tower of Blades .

title: Pantheist Temple of Tyr
description: Pantheist Temple of Tyr The Pantheist Temple of Tyr was a temple of Tyr the Just God on the Rock of Bral , an asteroid in the Tears of Selûne , which orbited the planet Toril behind its moon Selûne . Notably , it was the only temple to Tyr in Realmspace that did not lie on the planet of Toril , and its priests held a number of non - standard religious views . Although the clergy and their practices followed the rules of mainstream Tyrran faith on Toril , the priests here saw Tyr as a patron deity of good warriors in addition to his role as a god of justice .
