description_long: Pantheist Temple of Tyr The Pantheist Temple of Tyr was a temple of Tyr the Just God on the Rock of Bral , an asteroid in the Tears of Selûne , which orbited the planet Toril behind its moon Selûne . Notably , it was the only temple to Tyr in Realmspace that did not lie on the planet of Toril , and its priests held a number of non - standard religious views . Although the clergy and their practices followed the rules of mainstream Tyrran faith on Toril , the priests here saw Tyr as a patron deity of good warriors in addition to his role as a god of justice . Furthermore , they viewed any lawful good god of justice or war as an aspect or avatar of Tyr , who they said went by different names in different places . In this way , the pantheist priests could receive divine spell s in many crystal spheres where Tyr was otherwise unknown . Conventional priests of Tyr from Toril and lawful good warriors from any crystal sphere were welcomed at the temple , but tended to be troubled by the priests ' views . The temple stood despite the Rock being a haven for pirates . The Tyrrans felt compelled to fight crime and injustice wherever they found it .

title: Panther
description: Panther Panthers were black - furred jungle wildcats similar to , leopard s , and . Description . Like all cats in the leopard family , panthers typically weighed 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and were around four feet ( 120 centimeters ) in length .
description_long: Panther Panthers were black - furred jungle wildcats similar to , leopard s , and . Description . Like all cats in the leopard family , panthers typically weighed 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and were around four feet ( 120 centimeters ) in length . Behavior . Panthers were nighttime hunters , relying on their strong sense of smell and alert senses . They were expert climbers and had superb balance . Combat . Panthers would pounce on their prey after stalking them and would hold tightly with their jaws while raking with their claws . Reputation . Pathers were a favored animal of the god Tempus . Solonor Thelandira favored great cats in general , as did Thard Harr . Notable Panthers . The most famous panther in the Forgotten Realms was likely Guenhwyvar , the astral panther summoned by Drizzt Do ' Urden . She was an unusually large and intelligent panther .

title: Panthers of Xi
description: Panthers of Xi The Panthers of Xi were a ninja clan based in the town of Xi in Koryo . They controlled the Vorkani Mountains between Xi and the Malu River in the east . Their clanmaster was Lin Goh , the wielder of the Black Kumade .
description_long: Panthers of Xi The Panthers of Xi were a ninja clan based in the town of Xi in Koryo . They controlled the Vorkani Mountains between Xi and the Malu River in the east . Their clanmaster was Lin Goh , the wielder of the Black Kumade . The Panthers adopted this as a symbol , and left a black - painted kumade ( a type of weaponized rake ) as a sign of their handiwork or passing . Around 1357 DR , the Panthers waged an ongoing war with the Vi ' oontu ninja clan , who were based in Manchar .

title: Par
description: Par Par was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Par was a wealthy villager of Highcliff .
description_long: Par Par was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Par was a wealthy villager of Highcliff . He asked of Kalach - Cha to go into his house and see what was wrong . The Kalach - Cha found a bunch of sailors , led by Dulahey , who were robbing the place . Once Kalach - Cha defeated the pirates , Par would give some potions as a reward .

title: Par ' s house
description: Par ' s house Par ' s house was a house in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . Par ' s house was located near Edario ' s forge .
description_long: Par ' s house Par ' s house was a house in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . Par ' s house was located near Edario ' s forge . Structure . Like the other houses in Highcliff , Par ' s house was made from stone , wood and straw . Interior . The interior of the house is nicely made , with luxurious drawers , carpets , tables and other furniture . In addition , the containers hold gems , potions , gold etc . History . Par asked of the Kalach - Cha to enter his house and see what is inside . The Kalach - Cha would encounter some angry sailors , led by Dulahey , who would attack . After the situation has been taken care of , Par would give away some potions and enter his house to clean the mess up .

title: Parallel plane
description: Parallel plane Parallel planes were plane s of existence which existed in parallel with the Prime Material Plane . They were defined by a shared geography , bestiary , and were more easily reached than other planes by inhabitants of the Prime . The parallel planes were created in the days of creation when the Primordial s , mighty beings on par with the gods , split the Prime into three parts , finding some parts " too bright " or " too dark .
description_long: Parallel plane Parallel planes were plane s of existence which existed in parallel with the Prime Material Plane . They were defined by a shared geography , bestiary , and were more easily reached than other planes by inhabitants of the Prime . The parallel planes were created in the days of creation when the Primordial s , mighty beings on par with the gods , split the Prime into three parts , finding some parts " too bright " or " too dark . " The two parallel planes created were the Plane of Shadow and the Feywild , though the Plane of Shadow later transformed into the Shadowfell .

title: Paralyze
description: Paralyze Paralyze was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to immobilize creatures with a successful touch attack . Effects . This spell gave the caster a paralyzing touch for a number of minutes equal to his or her experience level .
description_long: Paralyze Paralyze was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to immobilize creatures with a successful touch attack . Effects . This spell gave the caster a paralyzing touch for a number of minutes equal to his or her experience level . For the duration , any living creature successfully touched ( as an attack ) by the caster was paralyzed for a few minutes unless they were able to resist the spell . Undead and non - living creatures like golems were immune to this spell , as were any creatures naturally immune to paralysis . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a bit of ghoul flesh to cast .

title: Paramount
description: Paramount A paramount was the ruler of a tribe of storm giant s . In most storm giant tribes , the paramount was the most powerful giant and stood atop the " ordning " ; however , a paramount did not become such by offering a challenge , as in other giant societies . Instead , a paramount was selected after the observing of a sign or omen .
description_long: Paramount A paramount was the ruler of a tribe of storm giant s . In most storm giant tribes , the paramount was the most powerful giant and stood atop the " ordning " ; however , a paramount did not become such by offering a challenge , as in other giant societies . Instead , a paramount was selected after the observing of a sign or omen .

title: Paramyr Bladerunner
description: Paramyr Bladerunner Paramyr Bladerunner was a male human fighter and an agent of Zhentil Keep based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Paramyr led a contingent of six Zhentish soldiers quartered in Thunderstone at the time , though he tried to keep this fact hidden from others .
description_long: Paramyr Bladerunner Paramyr Bladerunner was a male human fighter and an agent of Zhentil Keep based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Paramyr led a contingent of six Zhentish soldiers quartered in Thunderstone at the time , though he tried to keep this fact hidden from others . Each was much like himself in ability , equipment , and attitude . Personality . Paramyr was arrogant but disciplined and utterly dedicated to the service of Zhentil Keep . Description . In his early 30s , he was handsome with a square jaw . Equipment . Paramyr wielded a " + 2 longsword " and " + 2 chain armor " , and rode a light warhorse . He also possessed a " ring of spell turning " and an " ivory goat figurine of wondrous power " .

title: Parbid
description: Parbid Parbid was a tiefling Shadovar monk . History . He was a member of Cavus Dun and the Brothers of the Gray Mists .
description_long: Parbid Parbid was a tiefling Shadovar monk . History . He was a member of Cavus Dun and the Brothers of the Gray Mists . He was the fighting partner and companion of Afafrenfere , a human Shadovar monk . He used a spear in combat . Parbid was hired in secret by Effron the Twisted , along with several other members of Cavus Dun , to capture Dahlia Sin ' felle and eliminate her companion Drizzt Do ' Urden . Effron conspired in a secret plot to capture Dahlia to fulfill his personal vendetta and gain prestige with the Netherese Lord Draygo Quick , without Herzgo Alegni . Parbid was killed by Drizzt Do ' Urden , with a lightning arrow from Drizzt ' s bow " Taulmaril " during Cavus Dun ' s failed attempt on Dahlia Sin ' felle in the woods of Neverwinter .

title: Parched Mamluk Society
description: Parched Mamluk Society The Parched Mamluk Society , also known as the Parched , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Parched was one of the smallest mamluk organizations in Zakhara .
description_long: Parched Mamluk Society The Parched Mamluk Society , also known as the Parched , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Parched was one of the smallest mamluk organizations in Zakhara . They were dedicated to a single task : to ensure the security of Talab ' s water supply . They were in charge of maintaining the system of aqueducts that brought the water from distant mountains . Organization . The Parched were led by Akbara Abd al - Yahruq , the Most Respected Warrior . Base of Operations . Talab was the center of operations for the Parched .

title: Parg
description: Parg Parg was a goblin in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Parg was a goblin of Frostfur tribe , who lived under the protection of the stone giant shaman Kranum .
description_long: Parg Parg was a goblin in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Parg was a goblin of Frostfur tribe , who lived under the protection of the stone giant shaman Kranum . After the fall of a meteor , Kranum began to act strange ( being secretly possessed by Tyranthraxus ) . At last , the Frostfur tribe was destroyed by the possessed Kranum and his new allies , the Burning Banner orc tribe led by Narle Shieldbiter . Parg was the last survivor and was taken by Narle as a slave . Eventually , an adventuring party hired to stop Vorgansharax ' s cultists freed him . Personality . Like his fellows , Parg was crude and mischievous rather than evil . After being enslaved , he become a shadow of his former self . He was interested only in escape from his captivity , not caring for answers or vengeance .

title: Parise Ulfbinder
description: Parise Ulfbinder Parise Ulfbinder was a lord of Netheril . Relationships . Parise Ulfbinder was friends with Draygo Quick , another Netherese noble .
description_long: Parise Ulfbinder Parise Ulfbinder was a lord of Netheril . Relationships . Parise Ulfbinder was friends with Draygo Quick , another Netherese noble . Like Draygo Quick , had an intense interest in the Chosen of the gods . Parise suspected that Ruqiah / Catti - brie was the Chosen of Mielikki ; he even sent out two Shadovar agents , Untaris and Alpirs De ' Noutess , to kidnap her , although they failed . For a time Parise wondered if Drizzt Do ' Urden was the Chosen of Lolth , although he later rescinded that idea in favor of Dahlia Sin ' felle being favored of Lolth . Parise was also acquainted with Lady Avelyere , with whom he watched the re - acquaintance of the Companions of the Hall on Kelvin ' s Cairn on 19 Ches 1484 DR .

title: Parissus
description: Parissus Parissus was a mercenary and bounty hunter in the region of the Bloodstone Lands from Impiltur . Description . Parissus had a large - boned and round face and short , light - colored hair .
description_long: Parissus Parissus was a mercenary and bounty hunter in the region of the Bloodstone Lands from Impiltur . Description . Parissus had a large - boned and round face and short , light - colored hair . History . Parissus was companion and close friend of the elven warrior Calihye .

title: Parlek Lateriff
description: Parlek Lateriff Parlek Lateriff was a sage , sorcerer , and smith in the Mountainside ward of Waterdeep . He made replica and counterfeit jewelry for nobles , who paid him quite handsomely . History .
description_long: Parlek Lateriff Parlek Lateriff was a sage , sorcerer , and smith in the Mountainside ward of Waterdeep . He made replica and counterfeit jewelry for nobles , who paid him quite handsomely . History . In 1479 DR , Parlek was approached by Renaer Neverember and his companions , who were on the run from the law after making an enemy of Khondar " Ten - Rings " Naomal . Renaer convinced Parlek to let them hide in his house in exchange for " The Annals of Kyrah " , three volumes that Parlek had long sought . A tenday later , Parlek was invited with many others to become a member of the group that Renaer was founding at Roarke House to replace the Moonstars .

title: Parman
description: Parman Parman was a merchant in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Parman was a member the Ardjo family , one of the richest merchant families of Bawa .
description_long: Parman Parman was a merchant in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Parman was a member the Ardjo family , one of the richest merchant families of Bawa . Not truly needing to work , Parman spent most of his time in efforts he thought could improve the nation . He acted as advisor to the king , often even when uninvited , encouraging trading and destroying the pirates of Panjardu . Parman also sponsored many adventuring parties in exploring the wilderness . He was suspicious of all Bertanese people , particularly Bimaru . In 1357 DR , he started focusing on the Bawani Mountains .

title: Parnak
description: Parnak Parnak was a dragon turtle living in the Golden Gulf in Zakhara 1367 DR . Activities . Parnak accosted a pair of merchant vessels sailing the Pearl Way and demanded tribute .
description_long: Parnak Parnak was a dragon turtle living in the Golden Gulf in Zakhara 1367 DR . Activities . Parnak accosted a pair of merchant vessels sailing the Pearl Way and demanded tribute . Insulted by the tribute offered , he decided to destroy both ships and left them on the bottom of the Golden Gulf . Rumors and Legends . The " Reaver " was blamed for the two missing ships that Parnak destroyed . " "

title: Parok Mirami
description: Parok Mirami Parok Mirami was a well known askar guide for the Grand Bazaar in Huzuz . Activities . Parok charged 1 dirham per hour for his guide services .
description_long: Parok Mirami Parok Mirami was a well known askar guide for the Grand Bazaar in Huzuz . Activities . Parok charged 1 dirham per hour for his guide services . Customers who hired him almost always found what they were seeking at the Grand Bazaar . Parok loved pastries and was one of the reasons the Baker ' s pastry shop did so well . Relationships . Several merchants made deals with Parok to guide customers their way . These included the Al - Farif spice shop , the Al - Cinel shop for rare items , and the Al - Danafi house . History . Parok spent many years at the Grand Bazaar and knew the area well . He paid attention to gossip and had a great feel for what was going on in the Bazaar .

title: Paronder ( philosophy )
description: Paronder ( philosophy ) Paronder was a belief that Mystra or some other entity or force of the multiverse promoted a law of cosmic balance , so that those who did something would be rewarded in the same way . For instance , if someone did something good , the cosmos would do something good for them , but if they did something evil , they would be repaid with evil , and so on . Background .
description_long: Paronder ( philosophy ) Paronder was a belief that Mystra or some other entity or force of the multiverse promoted a law of cosmic balance , so that those who did something would be rewarded in the same way . For instance , if someone did something good , the cosmos would do something good for them , but if they did something evil , they would be repaid with evil , and so on . Background . According to Elminster Aumar , the term was named for a human sage named Paronder , who first promoted the belief that the practice of magic had its own tenets and principles , and that studying magical theory would be something useful to those who sought to wield and understand magic . History . One of the main practitioners of this philosophy was the archdevil Klaskornus , although Elminster believed that his motives were far from selfless .

title: Parrot - man
description: Parrot - man The parrot - man was a legendary creature in South Saishu , an island of Koryo in Kara - Tur . The parrot - man was one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who would seek out the parrot - man of South Saishu for him .
description_long: Parrot - man The parrot - man was a legendary creature in South Saishu , an island of Koryo in Kara - Tur . The parrot - man was one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who would seek out the parrot - man of South Saishu for him .

title: Parson Glaive
description: Parson Glaive Parson Glaive was a dwarf priest of Citadel Felbarr in the late 15th century DR . History . Parson was a priest of Moradin and steward - in - waiting in Citadel Felbarr in 1463 DR .
description_long: Parson Glaive Parson Glaive was a dwarf priest of Citadel Felbarr in the late 15th century DR . History . Parson was a priest of Moradin and steward - in - waiting in Citadel Felbarr in 1463 DR . He was a decisive person during the War of the Silver Marches . In 1484 DR , Parson confirmed to King Emerus that young Reginald Roundshield was in fact the legendary Bruenor Battlehammer reborn . He was made King Parson Glaive of Citadel Felbarr in 1486 DR when King Emerus Warcrown abdicated his throne and title to join Bruenor Battlehammer on the march to reclaim Gauntlgrym .

title: Part sand
description: Part sand Part sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could create a 20 foot ( 6 .
description_long: Part sand Part sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could create a 20 foot ( 6 . 1 m ) trough through a mound of sand , loose dirt , gravel , etc . This spell could only be used on a mound sitting above level ground . It did not work against level ground , or depressions in the ground . Once aimed , the spell created the trough in a straight line and the direction or angle of the cut could not be changed . The spell ' s magic held loose debris from falling into the trough once created . Objects unearthed by this spell simply fell to the bottom of the trough . If the trough met stone or other solid objects , then it would be blocked . This spell could also be used to harm any creature whose body was composed of earth . Components . This spell required a two small stones to cast .

title: Parthar
description: Parthar Parthar the Valiant , most known as Rhymallos , meaning " Hidden Eye " , was an unsung hero of the Weeping War . History . Parthar was a gnome member of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Parthar Parthar the Valiant , most known as Rhymallos , meaning " Hidden Eye " , was an unsung hero of the Weeping War . History . Parthar was a gnome member of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor . At the start of the Weeping War , he accepted the proposal of the high mage Ualair to be transformed into a mezzoloth and infiltrate the Army of Darkness as a spy . The Elven High Magic spell went well and , after the Scourging of Jhyrennstar , Rhymallos was leading a regiment under orders of Aulumpiter but secretly sending precious informations to Ualair . Then tragedy hit when , thanks to Rhymallos ' information , Malimshaer discovered the Vaults of Uvaeren , a deposit of important elven artifacts . Aulmpiter personally directed Rhymallos ' s regiment to go to Uvaeren to take the artifacts away . Immediately , Rhymallos informed Ualair but Ualair couldn ' t gather reinforcements for fear of blowing Rhymallos ' cover . So Rhymallos and Ualair fought alone against the Army of Darkness ' s troops at Uvaeren until they destroyed the vault , closing access to the artifacts forever but dying in the process .

title: Parwiccan Cycle
description: Parwiccan Cycle The Parwiccan Cycle was a compilation of ancient elven myths regarding the origins of dragon kind and the first interactions of elves and dragons . The myths compiled in the " Parwiccan Cycle " told of the Tearfall , the felling of the red dragon Mahatnartorian at the hands of elves from Tintageer , and the crusades of the first dragonborn against the dragonspawn , among other events . Many respected scholars , such as most of the sages of Candlekeep , dismissed the " Parwiccan Cycle " as just a compilation of fancy elven mythology with no relationship with actual historical facts .
description_long: Parwiccan Cycle The Parwiccan Cycle was a compilation of ancient elven myths regarding the origins of dragon kind and the first interactions of elves and dragons . The myths compiled in the " Parwiccan Cycle " told of the Tearfall , the felling of the red dragon Mahatnartorian at the hands of elves from Tintageer , and the crusades of the first dragonborn against the dragonspawn , among other events . Many respected scholars , such as most of the sages of Candlekeep , dismissed the " Parwiccan Cycle " as just a compilation of fancy elven mythology with no relationship with actual historical facts . However , events such as the return of the dragonborn race in 1359 DR proved that the " Parwiccan Cycle " was in fact a compilation of historical events .

title: Parwyyd Hanifar
description: Parwyyd Hanifar Parwyyd Hanifar was a human male wizard in the mid – 14th century DR . Description . Parwyyd was tall , elderly , with long white hair , moustache , and blue eyes .
description_long: Parwyyd Hanifar Parwyyd Hanifar was a human male wizard in the mid – 14th century DR . Description . Parwyyd was tall , elderly , with long white hair , moustache , and blue eyes . He wore blue robes trimmed in gold with red gems , with gold cuffs and hoop earrings . Relationships . Owing to his very poor memory , Hanifar hired Dunstanny to assist him in his work . Dunstanny organized his library , carried his books , and kept track of which spell s Hanifar had studied each day and which he had cast , as Hanifar soon forgot . Dunstanny even knew the details of each spell , their dimensions and effects , and could suggest to Hanifar the ideal spell to cast in any given situation . He even alerted Hanifar to danger when he was distracted or deep in thought , and defended him when he had to . Personality . Parwyyd was contemplative , unhurried , and utterly absent - minded . He did not wish to harm others he felt were blameless . He allowed his assistant Dunstanny to do his mundane thinking for him . Nevertheless , he could be quite cunning . Powers .

title: Pasari - niml
description: Pasari - niml Pasari - niml , or mants , were vicious insect - like creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These creatures appeared to be large ants measuring 4 – 6 inches ( 10 – 15 cm ) in length .
description_long: Pasari - niml Pasari - niml , or mants , were vicious insect - like creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These creatures appeared to be large ants measuring 4 – 6 inches ( 10 – 15 cm ) in length . Their face was roughly demihuman in appearance with twisted features exemplifying their malevolence . The facial skin was usually wrinkled and brown . They were capable of using tools with their front legs . Combat . The sight of a pack of pasari - niml was enough to shock many creatures into immobility or flight . Pasari - niml attempted to swarm opponents or burrow beneath them to create a pitfall . Their strong teeth were even able to work holes into armor and expose the soft flesh beneath . Noble pasari - niml communicated well with their warriors during attacks to create a coordinated effort . Mants carried darts and knives to use against opponents . They were immune to all spells from the charm or enchantment school of magic . Habitat / Society . Pasari - niml lived in large colonies containing warriors , nobles , and a single calipha . Colonies were made underground or within the walls of buildings . They preferred to hunt at night .

title: Pasha
description: Pasha " Pasha " was an Alzhedo word and Calishite title for a guildmaster or clan leader of Calimshan . A pasha could belong to the upper or lower classes , depending on the amount of power held and the importance of the guild or house over which the pasha had leadership . The least important pashas were still treated as belonging to the upper end of the merchant middle class and given the respect of the upper class .
description_long: Pasha " Pasha " was an Alzhedo word and Calishite title for a guildmaster or clan leader of Calimshan . A pasha could belong to the upper or lower classes , depending on the amount of power held and the importance of the guild or house over which the pasha had leadership . The least important pashas were still treated as belonging to the upper end of the merchant middle class and given the respect of the upper class . Nothing prevented a pasha from also holding another government or military role . Because of the Calishite convention of placing one ' s least important title first in his list of titles and the use of the " annuv " , to most outsiders , it would be hard to know the true power or class of a pasha from his name alone , unless all of his titles were listed . For example , the caleph of Calimshan , its king , was referred to as pasha , since he was indeed the guildmaster of all guildmasters of Calimport and all Calimshan . To avoid insult , most Calishites would use the term " syl - pasha " ( chief of pashas ) , but outsiders to Calimshan often did not know any better .

title: Pasocada Basin
description: Pasocada Basin The Pasocada Basin was a tough unyielding land in Maztica , north of the deserts where the Dog People resided . It was home to numerous human groups , most notably the Azuposi , and the Poscadar elves . Geography .
description_long: Pasocada Basin The Pasocada Basin was a tough unyielding land in Maztica , north of the deserts where the Dog People resided . It was home to numerous human groups , most notably the Azuposi , and the Poscadar elves . Geography . The area was drained by the Pasocada River and its tributaries , and was largely desert because of a lack of rainfall due to the surrounding mountains , but its altitude and distance north meant it received snow in the winter . The basin was scattered with mesas and buttes of rock protruding from the landscape . These had been carved by seasonal rains which also deposited great banks of sand . The area was mostly covered with brush , consisting of hardy plants like cacti , grass es , and yucca . The Azuposi successfully transformed this brush into farmland , especially in the flood plains . Those areas that received no rain whatsoever were devoid of plant life and were inhabited by monstrous creatures . Canyons such as Long Canyon ran through the basin , through which rivers and streams flowed . The mountains surrounding the basin had much more rainfall and these areas were covered in forests of aspen , fir , pine , and spruce .

title: Pass without trace
description: Pass without trace Pass without trace was a transmutation or enchantment spell that allowed the recipients to move through an area leaving no footprints or scent . Effects . The caster had to touch the creature ( s ) to cast this spell .
description_long: Pass without trace Pass without trace was a transmutation or enchantment spell that allowed the recipients to move through an area leaving no footprints or scent . Effects . The caster had to touch the creature ( s ) to cast this spell . Once activated , the subject could pass ( on foot ) through any type of terrain including mud , snow , sand , dust , etc . and leave no sign or scent behind that could be tracked by normal , non - magical means . The transmutation version lasted longer and left no magical signature behind . The enchantment version actually enchanted the path taken by the recipients and radiated a dweomer for up to an hour afterward . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the enchantment version of " pass without trace " required that a sprig of pine or evergreen be burned and the ashes crushed to a powder and spread about . The transmutation version only required the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus as the material component .

title: Passage to Dawn
description: Passage to Dawn Passage to Dawn is the fourth book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Passage to Dawn Passage to Dawn is the fourth book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book ten of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . In the first part of the book , we learn that Drizzt Do ' Urden and Catti - brie have joined the crew of Captain Deudermont on board the Sea Sprite and have been hunting pirates for the six years after the Battle of Mithral Hall . Now a doppelganger takes Deudermont shape and it isn ' t unmasked before it hints to a mysterious island . Deudermont decides to look for the island to find out who sent the creature . We know that that is the demon Errtu , who needs Drizzt to break his banishment . We also learn that now Mithral Hall is reigned by Gandalug Battlehammer , and that Bruenor Battlehammer , some of his dwarves and the barbarians from Settlestone led by Berkthgar the Bold have moved back in Icewind Dale . In the second part of the book the Sea Sprite crew goes to Mintarn in search of information about the mysterious Caerwich . They are attacked by pirates , but they manage to escape also because of the magical arrival of Harkle Harpell , who joins the crew .

title: Passepout
description: Passepout Passepout was one of Volothamp Geddarm ' s companions during his adventures . Description . Slightly rotund , the only thing larger than Passespout ' s appetite was his belief that women were enamored with him .
description_long: Passepout Passepout was one of Volothamp Geddarm ' s companions during his adventures . Description . Slightly rotund , the only thing larger than Passespout ' s appetite was his belief that women were enamored with him . This belief was usually met with humorous results . Relationships . He was the son of the " famous " Idle and Cantinflas .

title: Passwall
description: Passwall Passwall was a transmutation spell that breached walls . The maximum thickness of the wall depended on the magical power of the caster . Effect .
description_long: Passwall Passwall was a transmutation spell that breached walls . The maximum thickness of the wall depended on the magical power of the caster . Effect . The caster could create a passage through wooden , plaster , or stone walls , but not through metal or other harder materials . If the wall ' s thickness was too great , then a single casting of " passwall " simply made a niche or short tunnel . Several " passwall " spells could be cast in succession to form a continuing passage to breach very thick walls . When a " passwall " spell ended , creatures within the passage were ejected out the nearest exit . If someone dispelled the " passwall " effect , or if the caster dismissed it , creatures in the passage were ejected out the far exit if there was one , or out the sole exit otherwise . Variants . The drow variant of the " passwall " spell could create passageways through solid stone and dirt , but it had a very short duration . Material Component . A pinch of sesame seeds .

title: Path of Enlightenment
description: Path of Enlightenment The Path of Enlightenment , or the True Path , and known in Kozakura as the Way of Enlightenment , was the state religion of both Shou Lung and Wa and a popular one in Kozakura and other Kara - Tur an countries . It was a major religion of much of Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . Dogma .
description_long: Path of Enlightenment The Path of Enlightenment , or the True Path , and known in Kozakura as the Way of Enlightenment , was the state religion of both Shou Lung and Wa and a popular one in Kozakura and other Kara - Tur an countries . It was a major religion of much of Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . Dogma . The Path of Enlightenment was based on a written code of behavior and beliefs believed to have been created by the Celestial Emperor in order that the mortal world and the Celestial Heaven mirror one another in the process of attaining perfection . They admonished people to : In these commandments , " li " was a term meaning " rightness under heaven " . Nine cardinal virtues were also emphasized by the Path : in alphabetical order , these were Artistry , Compassion , Courage , Fidelity , Honor , Karma , Love , Respect for Tradition , and Scholarship . In summary , the Path encouraged people to obey their superiors ; to owe fealty to their lords ; and to venerate the past , ancestors , former emperors , and the priests who taught and preserved the Path . Past generations were treated as guardians of the Path .

title: Pathfinder
description: Pathfinder Pathfinders are bold scouts of the unknown , ranger s whose job it is to find pathways for others to follow . Pathfinders do this through their skills for perception but also through their battle prowess , which allows them to carve a path if none is available . For this purpose , pathfinders look to their weapons , typically two blade s .
description_long: Pathfinder Pathfinders are bold scouts of the unknown , ranger s whose job it is to find pathways for others to follow . Pathfinders do this through their skills for perception but also through their battle prowess , which allows them to carve a path if none is available . For this purpose , pathfinders look to their weapons , typically two blade s . Abilities . In order to survive their dangerous treks through the wilderness , pathfinders hone their combat skills intensively . Very early on pathfinders learn to make the most of their physical capabilities , allowing them to go on long after others have collapsed or died . With more advanced training pathfinders become so confident in their abilities that they appear to grow more powerful with each blow they deal against their quarry . Additionally , since their role is that of a scout rather than a long - term combatant pathfinders rely on staying mobile throughout a battle . Pathfinders learn several exploit s to help them forge new pathways , many of which rely on acting boldly with speed . With only a little bit of training pathfinders learn to use feints to trap their foes , striking them with one of their blades .

title: Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition
description: Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore . It contains " Servant of the Shard " despite it being removed from the series . It was published in February 2004 and August 2005 .

title: Paths of power
description: Paths of power The paths of power were an alternative way for wizard s to view magic and acquire spells in comparison to the conventional system of schools of magic . Magic system . While a school comprised a large number of spells based on one philosophical principle like alteration , each path of power consisted of a much smaller selection of spells of increasing power tied together by one topic .
description_long: Paths of power The paths of power were an alternative way for wizard s to view magic and acquire spells in comparison to the conventional system of schools of magic . Magic system . While a school comprised a large number of spells based on one philosophical principle like alteration , each path of power consisted of a much smaller selection of spells of increasing power tied together by one topic . For example , the Artificer ' s Path contained spells manipulating materials and devices , or the aptly named Road of Seals and Wardings . A wizard could learn a certain limited number of these paths , but was not restricted by anything like the opposing schools of specialist s . Paths of power were usually taught in specific colleges . A wizard had to follow each path by mastering all its spells in succession of rising power , but this learning allowed them to acquire the next spell when they were ready without the need to get it from an external source . Some paths were interconnected , so that the magic - user could switch their studies to a forking path if they so desired . Use of path magic spells .

title: Patma
description: Patma Patma was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Patma had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Patma Patma was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Patma had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven . Patma typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Possessions . Patma bore a rusted sword in battle . History . In 1369 DR , the then - paramount of the storm giants of Mount Woe , Anastes , and five other storm giants were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . Patma was one of those giants . Patma and Sebastion were chosen to find wine and vegetables for Brianna to eat , but during this time , Tavis Burdun and armies of giant - kin attacked . Patma and Sebastion were then ordered by Anastes to deal with the firbolg s . Patma fought with Tavis , until his sword was magically shattered by the firbolg shaman Munairoe . He was then taken down and killed by three firbolg warriors .

title: Patric Fulgirth
description: Patric Fulgirth Patric Fulgirth was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . He was an idle ruler who cared not for the needs of the people . Formerly a powerful nation , Doegan fell into decline under his dereliction of duty .
description_long: Patric Fulgirth Patric Fulgirth was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . He was an idle ruler who cared not for the needs of the people . Formerly a powerful nation , Doegan fell into decline under his dereliction of duty . The commander of the Legendary Campaign sought to depose Fulgirth , and thought this would be an easy task .

title: Patrin
description: Patrin Patrin , formerly a member of Clan Shestandeliath , was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and the leader of the Platinum Cadre in 1479 DR . Due to his faith in a dragon god , Patrin was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .
description_long: Patrin Patrin , formerly a member of Clan Shestandeliath , was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and the leader of the Platinum Cadre in 1479 DR . Due to his faith in a dragon god , Patrin was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description . Patrin was a big dragonborn with scarlet scales , and scars were he once wore his clan ' s piercings . Three silver chains pierced into his lower jaw simulated a beard . Abilities . Patrin was able to breathe fire . As Patrin was a true follower of Bahamut , Nala ' s tiamatan enhancing magic didn ' t had any effects on him . Relationships . The order ' s priestess , Nala , was his lover . History . Due to his faith in a dragon god , Patrin had been casted out of his clan . In 1479 DR , he led the Platinum Cadre to the Black Ash Plain in order to kill as many ash giants they could . They helped the paladin Medrash , Balasar and Khouryn Skulldark after those three had to flee from the giants . Feeling in Medrash a kindred spirit , and due to the connection of their gods , Bahamut and Torm , Patrin wanted to befriend him and to show him the Platinum Cadre was actually a force of good , but Medrash didn ' t wanted to believe in his words .

title: Paul S . Kemp
description: Paul S . Kemp Paul S . Kemp is a New York Times best - selling author most known for his Forgotten Realms novels .
description_long: Paul S . Kemp Paul S . Kemp is a New York Times best - selling author most known for his Forgotten Realms novels . Some examples of his work include the " Resurrection " ( the final installation of War of the Spider Queen series ) and the Erevis Cale novels . Part of the anthology " Realms of the Dragons " , it has been collected in The Erevis Cale Trilogy Omnibus . Part of the book The Halls of Stormweather , it introduces Erevis Cale . Second book of the series , continuing the story of Erevis Cale , started in " Resurrection . " The last book of the War of the Spider Queen series . Focuses on two worshipers of Mask and a halfling cleric of Brandobaris . Details the Shadovar subtle takeover of Sembia . Was to be Kemp ' s third Forgotten Realms trilogy , but it was cancelled . The Sundering Book 2 . Introduces Vasen , Cale ' s son . It was released October 1 2013 . Production problems . On November 3rd 2009 Kemp announced he was ending his work with Wizards of the Coast , and that the Cycle of Night trilogy would not be published . On February 22nd 2010 Paul S .

title: Paulina Claiborne
description: Paulina Claiborne Paulina Claiborne is a pseudonym of Paul Park . According to her fictional biography , Paulina was born in Kansas and educated at home by Chinese missionaries . She has spent several stints in prison .
description_long: Paulina Claiborne Paulina Claiborne is a pseudonym of Paul Park . According to her fictional biography , Paulina was born in Kansas and educated at home by Chinese missionaries . She has spent several stints in prison . Her past occupations include work as a cook , hairdresser , life coach , toxicologist , freelance letter - opener , and private surgeon . She has won the Warden ' s Special Prize for Model Servitude and enjoys knitting , drinking and knife fighting in her spare time .

title: Pavel Shemov
description: Pavel Shemov Pavel Shemov was a cleric of Lathander who traveled with Dorn Graybrook , the song dragon Karasendrieth , and the vampiric smoke drake Brimstone during the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . He fought against Sammaster and died freeing the " Dracorage mythal " from the lich ' s influence . Equipment .
description_long: Pavel Shemov Pavel Shemov was a cleric of Lathander who traveled with Dorn Graybrook , the song dragon Karasendrieth , and the vampiric smoke drake Brimstone during the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . He fought against Sammaster and died freeing the " Dracorage mythal " from the lich ' s influence . Equipment . Pavel fought with a mace and divine spells . Relationships . During their shared journey , Pavel and Brimstone often butted heads because of the former ' s distaste and distrust for the latter ' s status as an undead thing .

title: Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne
description: Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne The Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne was found within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The pavilion stood 10 ft .
description_long: Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne The Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne was found within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The pavilion stood 10 ft . ( 3 m ) off the ground . A lavish golden dome covered the platform . Uses . This platform served as oratory station for important speakers . The Grand Caliph himself used the pavilion during his Ascension Day ceremonies . The pavilion was enchanted so that a speaker could project their voice to every soul in attendance of the court . A special command word was needed in order to activate this feature . If someone standing on the pavilion did not have the command word then their voice would not be heard at all . The pavilion also held enchantment to protect the speaker from hostile magic .

title: Pawldo
description: Pawldo Pawldo was a halfling adventurer who ostensibly lived in Lowhill . Description . Pawldo was a clean shaven , short and hardy individual around 3 ft ( 0 .
description_long: Pawldo Pawldo was a halfling adventurer who ostensibly lived in Lowhill . Description . Pawldo was a clean shaven , short and hardy individual around 3 ft ( 0 . 9 m ) in height with shoulder length gray hair . Personality . Unlike most of his kin , Pawldo lived for a life of excitement . He was a shrewd salesman who enjoyed theatrics especially while bartering . Possessions . Pawldo was often seen wearing a worn leather jacket and ancient yet fine - oiled boots . Relationships . He often traveled with Prince Tristan Kendrick , Robyn , and Daryth of Calimshan . History . Throughout the winter of 1344 DR , Pawldo traveled about the Moonshae Isles and the Sword Coast in search of adventure and profit . During the Festival of the Spring Equinox on Gwynneth in 1345 DR , Pawldo was a seller of hounds . He sold Tristan the moorhound Canthus , but only after the halfling ' s overly - dramatic bartering . Later that night , he headed toward Lowhill with the halfling maiden Allian with whom he was attending a dance . Death . In 1365 DR , Pawldo was slain shortly before the defeat and banishment of Ityak - Ortheel " the Elf Eater " .

title: Paxas
description: Paxas Paxas was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Paxas was a standoffish and focused individual .
description_long: Paxas Paxas was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Paxas was a standoffish and focused individual . Once set nothing could break his concentration , a skill useful to study but no for battle . He however could divined information from the most obscure clues . History . Paxas become one of the first new Dukars of the Order of Kupavi . In 1370 DR , Paxas decided to made a break from his studies and with his companions Dinam and Ka ' ioa ' Tara , were guiding ships attacked by Myth Nantar ' s " mythal " away from the city and toward the Shipwreck Plains . In one of the ships they discovered surface dwellers .

title: Payit
description: Payit Payit was an empire in north Maztica . What is now known as Payit is only half of the ancient empire . Much of Payit is open savannahs of brush and grass , or copses of thin woods .
description_long: Payit Payit was an empire in north Maztica . What is now known as Payit is only half of the ancient empire . Much of Payit is open savannahs of brush and grass , or copses of thin woods . Large expanses of agricultral land can also be found many part of the Payit country . Patches of dense jungle can also be found through out the land . Payit is a land pulled in three ways , firstly by its peaceful and scientific traditions of its forefathers ; secondly , by the warlike traditions and bustling trade that typified the empire of Nexal ; and thirdly , by the presence of the foreigners who have converted Ulatos into a bustling seaport , market , and garrison town . Trade routes extending west linking Payit to Pezelac and Kultaka .

title: Payit ( ethnicity )
description: Payit ( ethnicity ) The Payits were one of the seven major ethnicities of Maztica , inhabiting the lands of Payit and Far Payit in the east . Description . A Payit individual tended to be short but muscular .
description_long: Payit ( ethnicity ) The Payits were one of the seven major ethnicities of Maztica , inhabiting the lands of Payit and Far Payit in the east . Description . A Payit individual tended to be short but muscular . Payits had deep , black eyes . They were wise , intelligent , and agile . Personality . The average Payit had a great sense of humor and was slow to anger . They had open minds and were quick learners . They were very proud of their cultural heritage . Society . The Payits were an agricultural people who had a strong grasp of science and medicine . Men and women of knowledge and learning were highly respected . Women were granted all the same rights as men in Payit society . Payit society at the individual level depended on whether one was a citizen of a city or of a village . Cities offered many choices in education , where one could study the ways of the priesthood , astronomy , or arts of healing . Language . The Payits spoke their own language . Religion . Most Payits worshiped the god Qotal . After 1362 DR , they no longer practiced human sacrifice . Combat . The Payits , being a peaceful people , were not overly skilled at war . History .

title: Payr ' adar
description: Payr ' adar Payr ' adar was a puppet member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . History . Payr ' adar hailed from Chessenta and arrived in Zhentil Keep with a caravan full of exotic women at his service .
description_long: Payr ' adar Payr ' adar was a puppet member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . History . Payr ' adar hailed from Chessenta and arrived in Zhentil Keep with a caravan full of exotic women at his service . Quickly , he started a very lucrative festhall and with mutual vote Payr ' adar was elected to the Council . Secretly he was a member of the Zhentarim . He was one of the few lords to survive the 1368 DR assault on the Keep by Cyric ' s monstrous army

title: Pazruki
description: Pazruki The Pazruki composed several tribes of human s inhabiting the northern part of the Koryaz Mountains . Territory . The territory of the Pazruki bordered the lands of the Fankiang and the Issacortae .
description_long: Pazruki The Pazruki composed several tribes of human s inhabiting the northern part of the Koryaz Mountains . Territory . The territory of the Pazruki bordered the lands of the Fankiang and the Issacortae . Description . The members of these tribes were usually slight and thin . They had straight black hair , but they usually sheared their natural hair off . Instead , the women usually wore wigs , and the men fake beards . The origin of this custom was unknown , but some speculated that it was to deal with infections of lice . Society . The Pazruki highlanders were specialists in agriculture , animal - handling , bowyery , carpentry , chanting , dancing , fishing , horsemanship , pottery , singing , survival , tanning , tracking , weaponsmithing , and weaving . Most Pazruki tribe members were shepherds , who grazed horses and sheep . Horses were used for transportation as well as food . Sheep were used for wool and meat , being the major food source for the tribes . Common yaks and goats were also raised and eaten , as were a variety of birds . Shepherds of these tribes were not nomads , as the hills were fertile and filled with lush grass for animals and livestock .

title: Pazruki language
description: Pazruki language Pazruki , also called Pazruk , was a language spoken by the Pazruki of the Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Related languages .
description_long: Pazruki language Pazruki , also called Pazruk , was a language spoken by the Pazruki of the Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Related languages . Pazruki was related to Issacortae and Wu - haltai , other languages in the Amaese languages group . As with the other Amaese languages , Pazruki was considered to be " only vaguely related " to the Eastern Imaskari languages group . Dialects . It comprised a family of dialects descending from a common ancestral tongue . The Pazruki nation had little writing or centralization , so the language developed independently of the other nations . The two most prominent dialects were Tchaltin - Pazruk and Erla - Pazruk . Speakers . The Pazruki tongue was spoken largely by the Pazruki nation , who dwelled in the northern Koryaz Mountains . Other native speakers were the Pazruki - descended clans who inhabited the forests to the east and the forested hills lying further north . Terminology . A legendary race that ruled the land in ancient times was known as the Maraloi , which meant " ancient lords " in Pazruki .

title: Pazuzu
description: Pazuzu Pazuzu is a powerful demon lord , called the Prince of the Lower Aerial Kingdoms . He rules the skies above all layers of the Abyss and is also known as Pazrael or Pazuzeus . One of the oldest and most reprehensible demon lords , Pazuzu is a master manipulator and corruptor of mortal souls .
description_long: Pazuzu Pazuzu is a powerful demon lord , called the Prince of the Lower Aerial Kingdoms . He rules the skies above all layers of the Abyss and is also known as Pazrael or Pazuzeus . One of the oldest and most reprehensible demon lords , Pazuzu is a master manipulator and corruptor of mortal souls . The Dark Angel of the Four Winds takes great delight in offering aid that seems beneficial , but ultimately spells doom on victim in the long run . Pazuzu ' s domain is called Torremor , a tangled mass of beams , pinnacles , arches , ladders , and other structures , held together by rope and chain . Torremor is located on the 503rd layer of the Abyss . Lore . Pazuzu lusts after innocence , purity , and honesty more than anything else , and the mortal world is a perfect breeding ground for this precious fruit . The demon lord takes from his victims all that makes them pure , then fills their hollow souls with bitterness and cruelty . When not scouting the mortal world for his next conquest , Pazuzu can almost always be found on the 1st abyssal layer — the Plain of a Thousand Portals .

title: Pe Nii - Qwoh
description: Pe Nii - Qwoh Pe Nii - Qwoh was an officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Pe was the adjutant of General Batu Min Ho in the provincial Army of Chukei .
description_long: Pe Nii - Qwoh Pe Nii - Qwoh was an officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Pe was the adjutant of General Batu Min Ho in the provincial Army of Chukei . In 1359 , Pe followed his general on a mission ordered by Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin to defeat the Grand Army of the Tuigan . At the end of the war , devastated by the loss of his family , Batu left the service of the Emperor but , with the Emperor ' s permission , made Pe the heir to both his and his wife properties and ranks .

title: Peaks of Flame
description: Peaks of Flame The Peaks of Flame were a range of volcanic mountains in the center of Chult , said to be the point of entry of Dendar the Night Serpent when she will enter Toril at the end of the world . Geography . Geographical Features .
description_long: Peaks of Flame The Peaks of Flame were a range of volcanic mountains in the center of Chult , said to be the point of entry of Dendar the Night Serpent when she will enter Toril at the end of the world . Geography . Geographical Features . The Peaks of Flame contained three active volcanoes , and the lava tubes for these three volcanoes connected with the Burning Rift , in the Firelands , a region of the Underdark . The volcanoes constantly threw ash and smoke into the skies over Chult . The crater of an inactive fourth volcano was located northwest of the three active peaks . This crater was called Morndin Vertesplendarrorn , or the Emerald Crater . The range was located south of Lake Luo and east of the Valley of Lost Honor . It used to be the northernmost boundary of the empire of Serpentes . Flora and Fauna . Flamesnake s , hell hound s , and pyrohydra s were some of the dangerous monsters that had entered the Peaks of Flame from portals from the Elemental Plane of Fire located below the mountains . History .

title: Pearl
description: Pearl Pearls were not mined , they were the product of oysters or other mollusks , but they were treated like gemstones . Description . Pearls were formed of layers of tchazar ( ) around a bit of grit or other irritant , growing inside a mollusk over the span of a few years .
description_long: Pearl Pearls were not mined , they were the product of oysters or other mollusks , but they were treated like gemstones . Description . Pearls were formed of layers of tchazar ( ) around a bit of grit or other irritant , growing inside a mollusk over the span of a few years . This slow process gave pearls a smooth surface with a deep , rich luster . Pearls were predominantly white but did occur in other colors such as gold , pink , or silver ; rainbow and black being the most rare and valuable . Over - sized pearls ( 3 in or 8 cm in diameter or more ) were frequently flawed in some way and not as valuable . One exception to this was a perfect head - sized pearl that was enchanted to become a " crystal ball " . A typical pearl has a base value of 100 gp to 500 gp , depending on market value . Pearls were considered sacred by followers of Deep Sashelas and Dugmaren Brightmantle — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Specifically , white pearls were sacred to followers of Savras , and black pearls were sacred to followers of Shargaas and Vhaeraun . Powers .

title: Pearl ( Hamayarch )
description: Pearl ( Hamayarch ) The Pearl was the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid - 13th century DR . Her true name , age and race were all unknown , though she appeared mostly human . Appearance .
description_long: Pearl ( Hamayarch ) The Pearl was the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid - 13th century DR . Her true name , age and race were all unknown , though she appeared mostly human . Appearance . The Pearl was a tall and slender woman with snow - white hair , and a youthful , even teenaged , appearance despite her likely age . Her eyes were aquamarine and slanted . She habitually dressed with a wintry theme , in fine clothes and jewelry . Rumors suggested that the Pearl had an elven or demon ic heritage . Skills . As Hamayarch , the Pearl would have been an arcane magic - user of some kind , and was the highest - ranking wizard in the court . As Hamayarch , she governed and regulated the magic - users of Procampur . The Pearl apparently had the ability to manipulate fate and grant luck to people . History . The Pearl ' s nature and history were a mystery to many , though some suspected she was a former " red - roof girl " , as in Procampur ' s red - roofed Adventurers ' District ( that is , an adventurer , or a possibly a prostitute ) .

title: Pearl Bay
description: Pearl Bay Pearl Bay was found in the extreme northern reaches of the continent of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Pearl Bay was located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Land of the Yak - Men .
description_long: Pearl Bay Pearl Bay was found in the extreme northern reaches of the continent of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Pearl Bay was located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Land of the Yak - Men . Both the city of Lipo and the Blackwash Fens were found along its edge . Description . A small ring of mountainous terrain formed the boundary of the bay .

title: Pearl Cities
description: Pearl Cities The Pearl Cities were a group of wealthy Zakhara n seaports along the coast of the Crowded Sea and the western shores of the Golden Gulf next to the High Desert . Activities . These cities - Ajayib , Gana , Jumlat , Sikak , and Tajar - focused on a lucrative trade mainly in luxury goods , with Jumlat ' s and Gana ' s production of pearl s providing the name for the whole group .
description_long: Pearl Cities The Pearl Cities were a group of wealthy Zakhara n seaports along the coast of the Crowded Sea and the western shores of the Golden Gulf next to the High Desert . Activities . These cities - Ajayib , Gana , Jumlat , Sikak , and Tajar - focused on a lucrative trade mainly in luxury goods , with Jumlat ' s and Gana ' s production of pearl s providing the name for the whole group . Haggling and money - making were as important to the inhabitants as the Law of the Loregiver . While all Cities of the Pearl featured richly decorated manors of the wealthy , the poor inhabitants were an even more common sight in their streets .

title: Pearl Way
description: Pearl Way The Pearl Way , or the Southwestern Sea Route , was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Cargo departing Huzuz for the Pearl Cities traveled by ship across the southern portion of Suq Bay , sailing west through the northern reaches of the Golden Gulf , usually directly toward Tajar , before continuing south to the rest of the Pearl Cities .
description_long: Pearl Way The Pearl Way , or the Southwestern Sea Route , was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Cargo departing Huzuz for the Pearl Cities traveled by ship across the southern portion of Suq Bay , sailing west through the northern reaches of the Golden Gulf , usually directly toward Tajar , before continuing south to the rest of the Pearl Cities . History . Given the precious cargo departing both the Pearl Cities and Huzuz , this was the richest trade route in all of Zakhara . Representatives from the Pearl Cities aggressively pursued pirates , so they were not much of a threat for merchants compared to other areas of Zakhara . However , vicious storms were known to strike the Golden Gulf and threaten ships . Communities of sahuagin inhabited the floor of the Golden Gulf as well , but they usually only attacked ships veering away from the coasts into deeper water .

title: Peasants ' District
description: Peasants ' District The Peasants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Peasants ' District was found in the People ' s Quarter and near the center of Huzuz .
description_long: Peasants ' District The Peasants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Peasants ' District was found in the People ' s Quarter and near the center of Huzuz . It was roughly bordered in a triangular pattern by the South District to the south , the Clothiers ' District to the west , and the Central District to the northeast . The Peasants ' District was also bordered by the Enlightened Way to the south , the Farmers ' Road to the west , and the Merchants ' Avenue to the east . The Grand Bazaar abutted the northern tip of the Peasants ' District . Inhabitants . The Peasant ' s District was a mostly residential area , serving as the home for the majority of Huzuz ' s laborers and farmers . This was a relatively peaceful district because there were no grand attractions or wealthy inhabitants with valuable property to steal .

title: Pech
description: Pech Pech were earth - aligned fey . Description . They looked like gnome s with dark brown or dull grey skin , pupilless eyes that reflected light like an owl or cat , and thin , gangly arms ending in abnormally large and powerful hands .
description_long: Pech Pech were earth - aligned fey . Description . They looked like gnome s with dark brown or dull grey skin , pupilless eyes that reflected light like an owl or cat , and thin , gangly arms ending in abnormally large and powerful hands . They could have wiry hair or a thick mane , the colour of wet clay . Activities . Pech were naturally affiliated with the earth , so much so that they were often mistaken for natives of the Elemental Plane of Earth . When they gathered together , they could mould stone as if it were clay and conjure walls of it out of thin air . They also had the ability to petrify and un - petrify living things . When on their own though , they easily wielded pick s in their powerful hands . Their affinity with stone and their natural aversion to sunlight made their underground habitats ideal .

title: Peebles
description: Peebles Peebles was a deep gnome servant of Xazax during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Peebles claimed to have always been fascinated by aberration s , and beholder s in particular .
description_long: Peebles Peebles was a deep gnome servant of Xazax during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Peebles claimed to have always been fascinated by aberration s , and beholder s in particular . Activitis . Peebles was the personal surgeon and attendant of Xazax the Eyemonger , a beholder who hunted other beholders , took their eyestalks , and grafted them to its own body . History . Xazax sent Peebles to Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons to search for more beholder s from which to take new eyestalks . He had checked the duergar and deep gnome sections of the city , but had not yet searched the drow section and the Zhentarim garrison .

title: Peerless archer
description: Peerless archer A peerless archer was one devoted to the perfection of archery , bowyery , and fletching . Outlook . Such an archer dedicated his or her life to the perfection of the bow , being both an expert in its craft and its usage .
description_long: Peerless archer A peerless archer was one devoted to the perfection of archery , bowyery , and fletching . Outlook . Such an archer dedicated his or her life to the perfection of the bow , being both an expert in its craft and its usage . Most of these archers were fighter s or ranger s , but barbarian s , paladin s , and monk s would sometime dedicate themselves to the discipline as well . Training and Education . All archers of this level of skill were trained in the craftsmanship of bows and arrows and were proficient in the use of any longbow or shortbow . Abilities . Peerless archers were skilled at shooting in a range of situations , both at point - blank ranges and at far distances . They were quick at drawing their arrows and very precise in their shooting . Such precision only increased with the skill of the archer . Much like a rogue , these archers were adept at taking advantage of split - second situations that would give them an opportunity to strike at critical regions of a target . More powerful archers learned to increase the damage that their arrows could deal out .

title: Pegasus
description: Pegasus Pegasi are a breed of magical beast s that , at first glance , resemble mere horse s with large bird - like wings . Despite this , they have other avian features as well , their lower legs are feathered instead of furred and their manes and tails are also of feathers . They most commonly live in temperate forests and are incapable of speaking common .
description_long: Pegasus Pegasi are a breed of magical beast s that , at first glance , resemble mere horse s with large bird - like wings . Despite this , they have other avian features as well , their lower legs are feathered instead of furred and their manes and tails are also of feathers . They most commonly live in temperate forests and are incapable of speaking common . Ecology . Being wild and shy magical creatures , pegasi are not easily tamed . The most common way they are trained is after being raised from birth though sometimes a grown pegasus may be tamed , with a friendly attitude to the tamer , making a worthy steed indeed . Being goodly creatures , they will only serve good or neutral riders with an absolute faithfulness for life . Along with their physical attributes , pegasi are also like birds in that they lay eggs rather than giving birth to live young . A pegasus will mature at the same rate as a horse , however , and have somewhat similar habits . Mount . A pegasus will serve as an aerial steed to a good natured humanoid . Society . Many pegasi revere the god Eachthighern and Lurue . On Evermeet , their queen is Yathaghera .

title: Pehllus Tanislove
description: Pehllus Tanislove Pehllus Tanislove was a rising noble and merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Pehllus was the lord of House Tanislove and the lord - consort of House Gheldieg .
description_long: Pehllus Tanislove Pehllus Tanislove was a rising noble and merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Pehllus was the lord of House Tanislove and the lord - consort of House Gheldieg . In his youth , he was a hedonistic party - goer but matured into an honest merchant with a skill for streamlining assets while doubling profits . In 1361 DR , Pehllus inherited his wealth and his membership of the Knights from his father , the famed Lord Pulth Tanislove , an able gem merchant . In 1362 DR , Pehllus moved to Athkatla and married Lady Vyma Gheldieg . He was invited to join the Council of Six in the role of Dahaunarch after the passing of Curkon Gheldieg , his father - in - law and previous Dahaunarch . However , Pehllus wanted more . Known only to a few Amnians , the Tanislove House descended directly from the Torlath dynasty , the royal house that founded the former kingdom of Amn . With the support of Tyrda Q ' Helvor and Rhinnom Dannihyr , Pehllus plotted to remove the Council from power and reestablish the kingdom of Amn , with himself as king .

title: Peieyrie Taskaloath
description: Peieyrie Taskaloath Peieyrie Taskaloath was the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Jhandlatha Taskloath . History . Peieyrie is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , the Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Peieyrie Taskaloath Peieyrie Taskaloath was the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Jhandlatha Taskloath . History . Peieyrie is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , the Arcane Brotherhood . Peieyrie inherited unknown magical items from her father . Personality . Peieyrie was elderly and earthy . She and her sister loved to hear tales of adventure and pranks . Peieyrie would defend herself with " fireball s " and " lightning bolt s " if she must .

title: Pekaonit
description: Pekaonit Pekaonit was a korobokuru chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . History . Pekaonit inherited his position as chieftain of the village of Karoah but thanks to his violent nature he defeated or drove off all challengers .
description_long: Pekaonit Pekaonit was a korobokuru chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . History . Pekaonit inherited his position as chieftain of the village of Karoah but thanks to his violent nature he defeated or drove off all challengers . He led his fellows in constant fighting with other korobukuru tribes , human s , and humanoid s in his belief in the survival of the fittest .

title: Peldar Armsmith
description: Peldar Armsmith Peldar Armsmith was the Cloakmaster of Karlaggar , one of the eight districts of Zazesspur , for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Peldar was a blacksmith before becoming a well - known arms and armors merchant .
description_long: Peldar Armsmith Peldar Armsmith was the Cloakmaster of Karlaggar , one of the eight districts of Zazesspur , for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Peldar was a blacksmith before becoming a well - known arms and armors merchant . Entering into the Shadow Thieves , he was chosen as one of the eight Cloakmasters of Zazesspur . Personality . Peldar had a foul temper . He had decent relationships with the other Cloakmasters as long as they respected his own sphere of influence .

title: Pelek
description: Pelek Pelek was a deep gnome ghost in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Pelek lived in Blingdenstone until he met Buppido .
description_long: Pelek Pelek was a deep gnome ghost in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Pelek lived in Blingdenstone until he met Buppido . He fell in love with him and followed him to Gracklstugh . There , however , he discovered that Buppido was a mad killer , Buppido killed Pelek as well . Some time after , probably because of the energies unleashed by the Rage of Demons , he rose as a ghost in Buppido ' s lair . He could only be given peace if someone took his remains back to his hometown and buried them there .

title: Pelendralaar
description: Pelendralaar Pelendralaar was a dracolich in league with the Cult of the Dragon sought to gain control of all of Faerûn by corrupting the Mythal of Myth Drannor . Description . In life , Pelendralaar was a red dragon .
description_long: Pelendralaar Pelendralaar was a dracolich in league with the Cult of the Dragon sought to gain control of all of Faerûn by corrupting the Mythal of Myth Drannor . Description . In life , Pelendralaar was a red dragon . Relationships . His partner was Mordrayn , a powerful sorceress who operated a cell of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In 1369 DR , the dracolich aided by the Cult of the Dragon tried to spread corruption to the Mythals of Myth Drannor and gain control of the cities of Faerûn .

title: Pelindar Filmarya
description: Pelindar Filmarya Lord Pelindar Filmarya was a paladin of Tyr and the ruler of Leilon following the Time of Troubles . Of mixed Waterdhavian and Tethyrian noble blood , his father ' s side of the family was once renowned in Tethyr for the prowess of its battle knights . His wise justice and pragmatic battle mastery have won him wide respect in the North .
description_long: Pelindar Filmarya Lord Pelindar Filmarya was a paladin of Tyr and the ruler of Leilon following the Time of Troubles . Of mixed Waterdhavian and Tethyrian noble blood , his father ' s side of the family was once renowned in Tethyr for the prowess of its battle knights . His wise justice and pragmatic battle mastery have won him wide respect in the North . The phrase " fear the knights of Leilon " came from a joke about country bumpkins , but Lord Filmarya has turned it into a term of respect .

title: Pella Dheolur
description: Pella Dheolur Pella Dheolur was a member of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . She was the sister of Lord Dheolur . She was of slight build .
description_long: Pella Dheolur Pella Dheolur was a member of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . She was the sister of Lord Dheolur . She was of slight build . Her palms contained fanged mouths with oozing green lips . She was killed in 432 DR by a blue ball of fire cast by Amedahast during the attack on house Dheolur by King Duar Obarskyr .

title: Pellamcopse Woods
description: Pellamcopse Woods Pellamcopse Woods , also known simply as Pellamcopse , was a forest located east - northeast of Waterdeep ' s Northgate . After the Spellplague , the woods were nickname " Pellamcorpse " due to their sinister reputation . Description .
description_long: Pellamcopse Woods Pellamcopse Woods , also known simply as Pellamcopse , was a forest located east - northeast of Waterdeep ' s Northgate . After the Spellplague , the woods were nickname " Pellamcorpse " due to their sinister reputation . Description . The forest contained a large number of briar s and was a favorite hunting ground of Tsarra Chaadren . The woods became plaguetouched after the Spellplague and many plaguechanged monsters roamed the woods . Inhabitants . The forest was inhabited by peryton s and buarala ( trees with tentacles and maws ) . The most famous creature in the woods is the Nameless Haunt , a fearsome cat - man created by the merging of the tressym Nameless ( Tsarra ' s familiar ) and the human Raergar ( Tsarra ' s husband ) . The Nameless protected the Pellamcopse from magical intrusion and guarded " Azuredge " until it was retrieved by Meloon Wardragon in 1479 DR

title: Peltarch
description: Peltarch Peltarch was the only permanent settlement of any size in Narfell as of 1479 DR . The town was located on the southern shore of Icelace Lake and was constructed from the masonry of Old Peltarch to the north of the current settlement . The Nar s of Peltarch were wealthier than their kinsmen who considered them outlanders .
description_long: Peltarch Peltarch was the only permanent settlement of any size in Narfell as of 1479 DR . The town was located on the southern shore of Icelace Lake and was constructed from the masonry of Old Peltarch to the north of the current settlement . The Nar s of Peltarch were wealthier than their kinsmen who considered them outlanders .

title: Penanggalan
description: Penanggalan A penanggalan was a variety of female vampiric undead creature . Description . A penanggalan had two forms .
description_long: Penanggalan A penanggalan was a variety of female vampiric undead creature . Description . A penanggalan had two forms . During the day , the penanggalan appeared as a human female resembling its original form before undeath . At night , the penanggalan returned to its lair and its head separated from its body , revealing a 3 - foot - long tail . A penanggalan ' s eyes glowed red in darkness . Combat . The penanggalan ' s head flew around in search of prey , seeking the most charismatic sleeping female ( especially between the age of 13 and 40 ) and choosing males only when no females were available . When a suitable victim was found , the penanggalan hypnotized her , punctured her neck , and fed on her blood throughout the night . The penanggalan then released the victim , returning to suck more blood each successive night until the victim was dead . Even if the penanggalan failed to return , the victim suffered from a curse , dying after several weeks unless " dispel evil " and healing spells were cast on her . Victims never remembered the feeding of the penanggalan , recalling only vague images of red water and stacked corpses .

title: Pencheska
description: Pencheska Pencheska was a succubus in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Pencheska was a succubus summoned by a lich named Tarul Var of the Red Wizards of Thay , who quickly enslaved her .
description_long: Pencheska Pencheska was a succubus in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Pencheska was a succubus summoned by a lich named Tarul Var of the Red Wizards of Thay , who quickly enslaved her . In 1485 DR , under Tarul ' s orders , she caused chaos in Daggerford by posing as the human courtesan Natyssa . Adventures ultimately unveiled her . Afterward , Pencheska was relocated to the lich ' s rooms in the Doomvault dungeon waiting for new orders from her master . Personality . Pencheska was unhappy with her situation as a slave of Tarul . She did not immediately attack the lich ' s enemies . Behind the scenes . Pencheska also appeared in " Scourge of the Sword Coast " . The DM ' s notes for " Dead in Thay " suggest totally removing her if the PCs had not played the previous adventure .

title: Pendant of Ashaba
