description: Pendant of Ashaba The Pendant of Ashaba was a magical pendant that was created by Ashaba , the first lord of Shadowdale , and was used to determine the rightful lord of the dale . It is a silver crescent moon with horns that point upwards . Originally the pendant hung from a plain string , but this was replaced by a silver chain that was made by Syluné Silverhand .
description_long: Pendant of Ashaba The Pendant of Ashaba was a magical pendant that was created by Ashaba , the first lord of Shadowdale , and was used to determine the rightful lord of the dale . It is a silver crescent moon with horns that point upwards . Originally the pendant hung from a plain string , but this was replaced by a silver chain that was made by Syluné Silverhand . Magical powers . The pendant , upon command , says in the voice of Ashaba : " The bearer of the token be the one and true lord of Shadowdale " . It can also detect alignment a little like the " know alignment " spell , but it can only detect very strongly aligned individuals such as paladin s . The limitations of the pendant in this regard are thought to be related to the limitations of its creator , Ashaba .

title: Penelope Harpell
description: Penelope Harpell Penelope Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their most powerful member during the late 15th century DR . History . Penelope was the wife of Dowell Harpell , the family spokesman in 1479 DR .
description_long: Penelope Harpell Penelope Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their most powerful member during the late 15th century DR . History . Penelope was the wife of Dowell Harpell , the family spokesman in 1479 DR . Penelope continued teaching magic to the reborn Catti - brie after she escaped from a Shadovar magic school . In 1484 DR , she was involved with all her family in the war started by drow associated with the Darkening .

title: Pengallen
description: Pengallen Pengallen was a village in the Silver Marches in northwest Faerûn , located fifteen miles south - east of River Surbrin and not far from Mithril Hall . History . One of the villagers , Rico Pengallen , enjoyed hunting down , capturing and forcing others , common enemies of humankind , to work for him , in the full knowledge of all in Pengallen .
description_long: Pengallen Pengallen was a village in the Silver Marches in northwest Faerûn , located fifteen miles south - east of River Surbrin and not far from Mithril Hall . History . One of the villagers , Rico Pengallen , enjoyed hunting down , capturing and forcing others , common enemies of humankind , to work for him , in the full knowledge of all in Pengallen . In his time , he enslaved a number of goblin s and orc s , and even a bugbear , though only one at a time . When he was done with them , when they ceased to be useful or docile , he had them hanged at the village gate . Among the slaves he took was Nojheim . In the winter of the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , just after sunset , a band of ogre s and orcs attacked the village and carried off captives . These included Tharman ' s wife and son , another boy , and Nojheim . Rico gathered four other villagers , including Tharman and the elder brother of the kidnapped boy , to hunt down the group and rescue the prisoners . Rico largely wanted his slave back , and to stop the raiders from returning to Pengallen . The next day , the group was discovered by the drow ranger Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Penny Williams
description: Penny Williams Penny Williams was " Game Questions Expert " for TSR , Inc . in the 1980s . She served as RPGA Network Coordinator , Polyhedron Newszine editor , and Senior Editor and Coordinating Editor for the RPG R & D Department at Wizards of the Coast .
description_long: Penny Williams Penny Williams was " Game Questions Expert " for TSR , Inc . in the 1980s . She served as RPGA Network Coordinator , Polyhedron Newszine editor , and Senior Editor and Coordinating Editor for the RPG R & D Department at Wizards of the Coast . She then became a freelancer , editing for several game companies , and running the online playtesting program for Wizards products .

title: Penri
description: Penri Penri was a korobokuru forest barbarian adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Penri born in the Bear Clan in northern Kozakura .
description_long: Penri Penri was a korobokuru forest barbarian adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Penri born in the Bear Clan in northern Kozakura . The Bear korobokuru were at war with the Kozakuran s until 1357 DR when the humans won and the korobokuru had to escape into mountainous and snowy forests , struggling to survive . Penri was chosen to go in search of allies and he decided to travel to Miyama . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Penri was a pre - generated PC for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: People ' s Quarter
description: People ' s Quarter The People ' s Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The People ' s Quarter encompassed the Peasants ' District , Pilgrims ' District , and South District .
description_long: People ' s Quarter The People ' s Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The People ' s Quarter encompassed the Peasants ' District , Pilgrims ' District , and South District . The People ' s Quarter was the religious epicenter of Huzuz , as well as the entire Land of Fate . Pilgrims from all over the continent traveled here to worship in the historical Golden Mosque .

title: People of the Black Blood
description: People of the Black Blood The People of the Black Blood were Malar - worshiping lycanthropes from the the many scattered forests throughout Faerûn . They were more of a loose group of small tribes than a formal organization . Organisation .
description_long: People of the Black Blood The People of the Black Blood were Malar - worshiping lycanthropes from the the many scattered forests throughout Faerûn . They were more of a loose group of small tribes than a formal organization . Organisation . Each tribe among the People of the Black Blood acted much like a pack with the leader of the tribe being the strongest member of the group , known as a Bloodmaster . Many of the tribes had their own social hierarchy , based often on the leader ' s animal form . Having little contact with other tribes unless Malar required it of them , the various tribes claimed its own territory to watch over . On occasion when a pack ' s Bloodmaster has lived beyond their usefulness , an agent of Malar is sent to challenge them and select a new one from among the tribe . In 1372 DR , this agent was Kyrran Graylord , Bases of Operation . The group was most active in Faerûn ' s forests . History . It was difficult to pinpoint the origins of the People of the Black Blood due to the disparate and independent nature of their organisation . However it was likely the first tribe came together under direction of Malar , possibly to track down a specific quarry .

title: Pepin Pollo
description: Pepin Pollo Pepin Pollo was a male gnome of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pepin was a gnome who came from Waterdeep to Neverwinter to paint pictures for money .
description_long: Pepin Pollo Pepin Pollo was a male gnome of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pepin was a gnome who came from Waterdeep to Neverwinter to paint pictures for money . He met a lady in 1374 DR and decided to paint her . Gameplay . When the Kalach - Cha and Shandra Jerro came to Pepin Pollo , he dismissed the lady and started painting Shandra ' s portrait . Once done , he thought it was a masterpiece . If the Kalach - Cha became too interested in the painting , then Elanee became displeased . In any case , if the Kalach - Cha bought the painting , then Shandra would like the Kalach - Cha more .

title: Pepper cheese
description: Pepper cheese Pepper cheese was a spicy cheese from Tethyr . It was available for purchase from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .
description_long: Pepper cheese Pepper cheese was a spicy cheese from Tethyr . It was available for purchase from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . Pepper cheese consisted of a mixture of goat and cow cheese , mixed with southern spices . The rind was covered with peppercorns , which gave the cheese its unique appearance . The spicy and tangy flavor of this cheese provided a good pairing with southern dishes .

title: Percival Gallard Woodehouse
description: Percival Gallard Woodehouse Percival Gallard Woodehouse , also known as Pig , was a famous chef in Skullport . History . Percival was a famous chef in Waterdeep until Denver Gilliam hired him to work at the Traitor Picks .
description_long: Percival Gallard Woodehouse Percival Gallard Woodehouse , also known as Pig , was a famous chef in Skullport . History . Percival was a famous chef in Waterdeep until Denver Gilliam hired him to work at the Traitor Picks . Under him , the tavern earned a good reputation . However , Percival was convinced to assist Volothamp Geddarm in one of his trips into the Underdark . During his absence , Denver fired and replaced him . In 1370 DR , back in Skullport , Percival was without a job .

title: Perd Dellmon
description: Perd Dellmon Perd Dellmon was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Perd helped his father Kerbin Dellmon manage a great farm in the valley .
description_long: Perd Dellmon Perd Dellmon was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Perd helped his father Kerbin Dellmon manage a great farm in the valley . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the property . However , Kerbin refused to abandon his farm and go to Yartar and Perd supported his decision , despite fearing for his children . With the lucky arrival of some adventurers , the Dellmons managed to defend the farm .

title: Pereghost
description: Pereghost The Pereghost was one of the great mysteries of the Zhentarim ' s fortress of Darkhold . The warrior appeared out of nowhere in 1356 DR , offering his services to the Black Network . He gave no name other than " The Pereghost " and refused to speak of his history .
description_long: Pereghost The Pereghost was one of the great mysteries of the Zhentarim ' s fortress of Darkhold . The warrior appeared out of nowhere in 1356 DR , offering his services to the Black Network . He gave no name other than " The Pereghost " and refused to speak of his history . Within three years he was given command of the keep ' s entire army . He accomplished this by being ruthlessly efficient and not playing favorites . Darkhold ' s army was one of the few places in the Black Network where soldiers were promoted by merit , not by scheming or bribes . As such , the Pereghost was not just feared , but " respected " by the Zhentilar . In turn , the Pereghost was completely loyal to the Black Network . History . Sometime before the Second Banedeath of 1368 DR , when all Orthodox Banites were driven out of Darkhold , the Pereghost underwent a religious conversion , becoming a divine champion of Cyric . As a result , his alignment switched from lawful to chaotic evil . It is yet to be seen whether this fundamental change has affected the loyalty of his troops .

title: Peren Voranwell
description: Peren Voranwell Lord Peren Voranwell of Lyllburg was a self - appointed landholder in Tethyr . Description . Peren was originally a handsome man , until he was facially disfigured in combat with a troll .
description_long: Peren Voranwell Lord Peren Voranwell of Lyllburg was a self - appointed landholder in Tethyr . Description . Peren was originally a handsome man , until he was facially disfigured in combat with a troll . Personality . Lord Voranwell was a vain man who loved surrounding himself with wealth . History . Peren Voranwell was originally a sheriff of the town of Lyllburgg , in County Morninggold , but after the Ten Black Days of Eleint when the Gulderhorns , the rightful rulers of the region , were forced to flee for their lives , Peren took advantage of the situation . He occupied one of the manor houses of the Gulderhorn estate and set himself up as " Lord " of Lyllburg . In his time as ruler , he collected taxes from the surrounding villages , claiming to use the money for their protection . He clashed with the Company of Eight on several occasions , and was forced to change his ways , which greatly humiliated him . He plotted revenge against the adventurers in order to make their lives miserable . Despite his vices , he actually did protect Lyllburg during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Having been trained as a warrior , he successfully defended against an attack by trolls .

title: Perendra Raslemtar
description: Perendra Raslemtar Lady Perendra Raslemtar ( Per - EN - drah ) was Countess of Elemetar and also served as Court Vizera of Tethyr . Description . Perendra had a large forehead and chin , dark skin , very short black hair , and brown , almond - shaped eyes .
description_long: Perendra Raslemtar Lady Perendra Raslemtar ( Per - EN - drah ) was Countess of Elemetar and also served as Court Vizera of Tethyr . Description . Perendra had a large forehead and chin , dark skin , very short black hair , and brown , almond - shaped eyes . Personality . Lady Raslemtar was shy , curt , and often defensive , but she was also very open - minded regarding the people with whom she interacted . She had been described as " mysterious " . Abilities . Countess Perendra was a powerful wizardess with a natural gift for magic , who achieved the skills of an archmage later in life . Possessions . Among her known magical items , Perendra possessed a " necklace of missiles " , a " ring of invisibility " , and a magical staff . In 1357 DR , she was developing a unique magic wand . Activities . As court vizera , Lady Raslemtar was the primary advisor to the queen in matters of magic and arcane secrets . For a time in the late 1350s DR , Perendra was a member of the Harpers . Relationships . Perendra was the daughter of Lady Saylayne and Baron Amir Raslemtar , one of only five barons to survive the Ten Black Days of Eleint .

title: Perestrom
description: Perestrom Perestrom was a Zhentarim adventurer wizard in Yûlash . History . Perestrom was the master of the Lords of the Ebon Wyrm , a small adventuring party loyal to the Zhent .
description_long: Perestrom Perestrom was a Zhentarim adventurer wizard in Yûlash . History . Perestrom was the master of the Lords of the Ebon Wyrm , a small adventuring party loyal to the Zhent . He led them to sack many places in the Moonsea and Cormanthyr . In 1374 DR , however , in Myth Drannor , the fey ' ri slaughtered most of Perestrom ' s adventurers . Perestrom noticed the strange creatures and went to make a report about them to Scyllua Darkhope .

title: Perfect summons
description: Perfect summons Perfect summons was a transmutation spell that created a summoning area for good creatures only . Effect . The caster created an area in which only good creatures could be magically summoned .
description_long: Perfect summons Perfect summons was a transmutation spell that created a summoning area for good creatures only . Effect . The caster created an area in which only good creatures could be magically summoned . No matter what a later caster attempted to summon , he or she actually summoned a good version ( a celestial beast rather than a fiendish one , for example ) or a good equivalent ( an archon rather than a formian ) . If the summoner was attempting to summon a neutral or evil creature , the good creature that appeared was not bound to obey the commands of the summoner or attack his or her enemies . Instead , it dealt with the summoner as it saw fit — possibly attacking an evil caster . The summoning spell could not be dismissed , though it could be dispelled normally . " Perfect summons " countered and dispeled " distort summons " , and " vice versa " .

title: Periapt of health
description: Periapt of health Periapts of health were common magical item s worn about the neck that prevented the wearer from contracting diseases . Description . These items were crafted with a gem , which hung on a necklace of silver chain .
description_long: Periapt of health Periapts of health were common magical item s worn about the neck that prevented the wearer from contracting diseases . Description . These items were crafted with a gem , which hung on a necklace of silver chain . The gem used was often ruby , but lapis lazuli was also used , as it was cheaper . Hematite was sometimes used in the crafting of this magical jewelry , as that stone was associated with the healing arts . Those made with lapis lazuli sold for around 7 , 500 gold pieces . A " periapt of health " gave off a faint conjuration aura to one able to detect such things . Powers . When worn , the periapt prevented infection or contraction of any disease , including those of supernatural or magical origin . Creation . Anyone trained in the art of crafting wondrous magical items who also knew the spell " remove disease " could fashion this type of amulet .

title: Pericolo Topolino
description: Pericolo Topolino " Grandfather " Pericolo Topolino was a halfling assassin guildmaster of the Morada Topolino in Delthuntle . He appeared to have controlled much of the organized criminal world in Dethuntle and was treated with respect ( and fear ) by almost everyone . Descriptions .
description_long: Pericolo Topolino " Grandfather " Pericolo Topolino was a halfling assassin guildmaster of the Morada Topolino in Delthuntle . He appeared to have controlled much of the organized criminal world in Dethuntle and was treated with respect ( and fear ) by almost everyone . Descriptions . Pericolo was barely four feet tall . He had a neat goatee and often wore a fabulous blue beret , which granted him a magical means of disguise . He also owned a magical rapier and a mithral - lined shirt . History . In 1472 DR , the reincarnated Regis was living in Delthuntle when Pericolo took notice of him while he was climbing a building to escape a gang of much older and larger youths . Pericolo immediately took an interest in Regis and dubbed him " Spider " for his climbing ability . Pericolo manipulated Spider ' s father into allowing Spider to work for him diving for deep oysters , which were cultivated to produce pink pearl s . Pericolo ' s long - term obsession was the discovery and plundering of the infamous shipwreck of " Thepurl ' s Diamond " . The ship was sunk by pirates around the time of the Spellplague and carried the lich Ebonsoul ' s corpse as well as most of his treasure .

title: Peridot
description: Peridot Peridot was the gem - quality version of which occurred in volcanic basalts or with other deposits . Description . These gemstones were found in shades of light to dark olive green and were usually facet cut .
description_long: Peridot Peridot was the gem - quality version of which occurred in volcanic basalts or with other deposits . Description . These gemstones were found in shades of light to dark olive green and were usually facet cut . Peridots were considered sacred by followers of Gaerdal Ironhand and Yondalla — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Peridots were frequently used as a material component for abjuration spells and in constructing magic items that offered protection against spells and enchantments . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp or 50 gp depending on market demand .

title: Perigrog Scrapedust
description: Perigrog Scrapedust Perigrog Scrapedust was a deep gnome businessman in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Perigrog believed that the more the mine produced , the more he could export , and that this would restore the city to its former glory quicker .
description_long: Perigrog Scrapedust Perigrog Scrapedust was a deep gnome businessman in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Perigrog believed that the more the mine produced , the more he could export , and that this would restore the city to its former glory quicker . Activities . During the Rage of Demons , Perigrog ran the salt Whiteshell Mine .

title: Perijan al - Danaf
description: Perijan al - Danaf Perijan al - Danaf was the driving force behind the wealthy House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Perijan was shy and soft - spoken around others .
description_long: Perijan al - Danaf Perijan al - Danaf was the driving force behind the wealthy House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Perijan was shy and soft - spoken around others . Activities . Despite her calm demeanor , Perijan was a financial genius . Though she would never brag about her accomplishments , she single - handedly built the wealthiest merchant house in all of Zakhara . She was a wise investor for any profits from her husband ' s many sea voyages . Relationships . Perijan ' s daughter , Tanya , was a wife to Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir . Perijan remained close with her daughter after her wedding , allowing the family intimate access to the Grand Caliph .

title: Perinsa Falmarya
description: Perinsa Falmarya Perinsa Falmarya was a ghostwise halfling who grew up in the Chondalwood . Activities . Ger tribe lived closer to the outside world than others .
description_long: Perinsa Falmarya Perinsa Falmarya was a ghostwise halfling who grew up in the Chondalwood . Activities . Ger tribe lived closer to the outside world than others . Perinsa grew up as a warrior in this society , hunting for and defending her people as the need arose . Perinsa could speak Common , Halfling , Undercommon , and Elven . Description . Perinsa was 3 feet , 2 inches ( 0 . 9 meters ) tall . She was fairly pretty , but not interested in such matters . Personality . To those who would help her , Perinsa was a true friend ; she was pleasant , or at least civil to those who meant her no harm . She reserved her anger for those who would hold ghostwise halfling s in captivity , showing them no mercy . History . Perinsa ' s tribe often ran into conflicts with gnoll s , wild elves , and centaur s . They roamed nomadically through the forest , trading or fighting with other tribes . When she was seventeen , a wizard led gnoll raiders against her tribe , leaving most of the halflings captured and enslaved . Perinsa was pursuing and fighting a gnoll when they fell down a small cliff , assumed to be dead .

title: Peris Whallnsor
description: Peris Whallnsor Peris Whallnsor was a female human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Battlelady . With Trusted Sword Jak Errins soon to retire , she was contending to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Her chief competitor for the position was Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap .
description_long: Peris Whallnsor Peris Whallnsor was a female human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Battlelady . With Trusted Sword Jak Errins soon to retire , she was contending to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Her chief competitor for the position was Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap .

title: Permanency
description: Permanency Permanency was a universal spell that made certain spells permanent . Effect . The caster could make the following spells permanent when cast on him - or herself : " arcane sight " , " comprehend languages " , " darkvision " , " detect magic " , " protection from arrows " , " read magic " , " see invisibility " , and " tongues " .
description_long: Permanency Permanency was a universal spell that made certain spells permanent . Effect . The caster could make the following spells permanent when cast on him - or herself : " arcane sight " , " comprehend languages " , " darkvision " , " detect magic " , " protection from arrows " , " read magic " , " see invisibility " , and " tongues " . The caster cast the desired spell and then followed it with the " permanency " spell . This application of " permanency " could be dispelled only by a more powerful spellcaster . In addition to personal use , " permanency " could be used to make the following spells permanent on the caster , another creature , or an object ( as appropriate ) : " enhance familiar " , " enlarge " , " fortify familiar " , " magic fang " , and " resistance " .

title: Permanent image
description: Permanent image Permanent image , also known as permanent illusion , is an arcane spell that conjures an illusion more convincing than its lesser " image " cousins . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal elements , and the spell is permanent .
description_long: Permanent image Permanent image , also known as permanent illusion , is an arcane spell that conjures an illusion more convincing than its lesser " image " cousins . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal elements , and the spell is permanent . By concentrating , you can move the image within the limits of the range , but it is static while you are not concentrating . Material components . A bit of fleece plus powdered jade worth 100 gp .

title: Pern
description: Pern Pern was a male human of Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . He was a member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard . One day in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , a huntsman informed the City Guard of a magical tower erected within a single day , a full day ' s hard ride north of Waterdeep ' s Trollwall .
description_long: Pern Pern was a male human of Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . He was a member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard . One day in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , a huntsman informed the City Guard of a magical tower erected within a single day , a full day ' s hard ride north of Waterdeep ' s Trollwall . A City Guard patrol , led by a captain and including Pern , investigated and attempted to scale the tower . Imgig Zu , master of the tower , animated his gargoyle minions to attack the guardsmen .

title: Perrywinkle Shin
description: Perrywinkle Shin Perrywinkle Shin was the highest - ranking active monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . Personality . Perrywinkle was at his core a man who was at peace with himself and he retained a sense of humor .
description_long: Perrywinkle Shin Perrywinkle Shin was the highest - ranking active monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . Personality . Perrywinkle was at his core a man who was at peace with himself and he retained a sense of humor . He greatly disliked subterfuge . History . Perrywinkle agreed to guide Jarlaxle and the two copper dragon sisters Tazmikella and Ilnezhara to the presence of the immortal grandmaster Kane . In 1491 DR , he had become Grandmaster of Flowers but the monastery was infiltrated by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . With the help of some adventurers , he cleared the monastery of their presence .

title: Persana
description: Persana Persana was unknown to many outside of the triton race and those that did know of him believed that he was nothing more than a god of construction and guardianship . This was due to the silence and mystery that Persana , like his triton followers , surrounded himself with . The tritons themselves however , were like the ixitxachitl , a completely theocratic society .
description_long: Persana Persana was unknown to many outside of the triton race and those that did know of him believed that he was nothing more than a god of construction and guardianship . This was due to the silence and mystery that Persana , like his triton followers , surrounded himself with . The tritons themselves however , were like the ixitxachitl , a completely theocratic society . All but those rare outcasts had some kind of connection to Persana ' s church who had many undersea cities built for him by his followers . Persana ' s priests would readily aid those of other faiths ( as would the deity himself ) as long as the end result benefited the tritons . In Serôs , tritons could only be found in numbers in two places , one of which was Myth Nantar which the tritons , along with the other races living there , were attempting to rebuild into a much greater city than before . Most believed that this was penance for the aloof tritons neutrality in the twelfth Serôs war , though in truth , Persana saw the city as having some great destiny that must be protected .

title: Persistent image
description: Persistent image Persistent image is an illusion spell that creates a complex image that does not require concentration . Effect . This spell works the same as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal components , and the figment follows a script determined by you .
description_long: Persistent image Persistent image is an illusion spell that creates a complex image that does not require concentration . Effect . This spell works the same as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal components , and the figment follows a script determined by you . The figment follows that script without your having to concentrate on it . The illusion can include intelligible speech if you wish . For instance , you could create the illusion of several orcs playing cards and arguing , culminating in a fistfight . ( Why you would want to is another issue entirely . ) Material components . A bit of fleece and several grains of sand .

title: Pertelope
description: Pertelope Pertelope was one of the Chosen of the god Deneir and undoubtedly one of the most powerful headmistresses at the Edificant Library . Appearance . Pertelope always appeared as a neatly groomed , graying woman .
description_long: Pertelope Pertelope was one of the Chosen of the god Deneir and undoubtedly one of the most powerful headmistresses at the Edificant Library . Appearance . Pertelope always appeared as a neatly groomed , graying woman . Her hazel eyes had an inquisitive luster more common to a much younger person . After the Chaos Curse took hold on the Edificant Library , Pertelope used to be even more closed up in her clothing , wearing high cut gloves and a long - sleeved , ankle - length gown , bound tight about the collar , covering her transformed shark skin . Personality . The priest was wistful , irreverent and mostly more concerned with common sense than steadfast rules . Background . Pertelope was a chosen of Deneir , reveled in her ability to hear Deneir ' s song . She was a headmistress at the Edificant Library and lived in a room above the great hall . She had an affinity for sharks and had loved watching them swimming in the water when going out fishing with her father . In the time of the Chaos Curse Pertelope lost herself in her affinity for sharks , resulting in maintaining a featureless torso covered by a shark skin with sharp - edged pentacles .

title: Peryton
description: Peryton Perytons were twisted and depraved magical creatures that appeared to be a cross between a giant eagle and a demonic - looking , fang - toothed stag . They were known and feared for tearing the beating hearts from their victims ' chests . Description .
description_long: Peryton Perytons were twisted and depraved magical creatures that appeared to be a cross between a giant eagle and a demonic - looking , fang - toothed stag . They were known and feared for tearing the beating hearts from their victims ' chests . Description . A peryton ' s feathered and winged body was about 7 feet ( 2 meters ) long and 5 feet ( 1 . 5 meters ) tall and was similar to that of a giant eagle with dark green or gray - green feathers . Its head , however , was covered in blue - black or purple hair and was roughly the shape of a deer ' s . Its maw was full of jagged fangs and its claw were as sharp as razors . On the top of its head were a set of extremely sharp and strong antlers , which were as hard as steel and jet black in color . A male had light blue chest feathers , while a female ' s were pale brown . A peryton ' s eyes glowed or glittered and were an orange - red color . Whatever fell magic created perytons granted them a deceptively strong hide that was nearly impervious to anything but magical weapons . Perytons reportedly smelled like humans , although others said the smell was indescribable and immediately triggered a sense of dread .

title: Petitioner
description: Petitioner Petitioner is the term applied to dead people ’ s souls , which made it in some way or another into another plane of existence than the Material Plane . Becoming a petitioner . Upon dying , a mortal ’ s soul was transported to the Fugue Plane .
description_long: Petitioner Petitioner is the term applied to dead people ’ s souls , which made it in some way or another into another plane of existence than the Material Plane . Becoming a petitioner . Upon dying , a mortal ’ s soul was transported to the Fugue Plane . Once there , these souls counted as petitioners but didn ’ t have the attributes of one yet . They became full petitioners after entering the plane of their respective deities . Other petitioners received judgement from Kelemvor . The standards according to which judgement was handed were whether , which and how honestly someone followed a certain deity during its lifetime . The outcomes were called Faithless and False . Petitioner - normal . Normally , a soul of a dead mortal went to the Fugue Plane . Once there it waited until the deity it followed during lifetime or an agent of the same came and picked it up to the final destination , the realm , of its deity . In the deity ’ s realm , the petitioner became a full petitioner with all attributes of one . Normal Petitioners ’ attributes . A normal petitioner was a mindless being .

title: Petralisks
description: Petralisks The Petralisks , or the Gazers , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 1 , 500 dao cavalry using greater basilisks for mounts made up the Petralisks .
description_long: Petralisks The Petralisks , or the Gazers , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 1 , 500 dao cavalry using greater basilisks for mounts made up the Petralisks . Activities . This unit was poorly trained but maintained high morale , perhaps because of the devastating power their mounts had over most corporeal enemies . They were slow to react and maneuver against enemies made from earth and stone . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Petron
description: Petron Merciless Petron was a primordial who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . After the primordials were defeated in the Dawn War and Ao split Abeir - Toril into the twin worlds , Abeir and Toril , Petron founded a great kingdom in the continent of Shyr .
description_long: Petron Merciless Petron was a primordial who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . After the primordials were defeated in the Dawn War and Ao split Abeir - Toril into the twin worlds , Abeir and Toril , Petron founded a great kingdom in the continent of Shyr . Her lands were so flat and trackless that there was nothing to stop a stone rolled across it to reach the sea . Petron was known for being prideful and a perfectionist , and she usually turned those that defied her into glass and stone . Petron was killed by the Abeiran dragon s during the War of Fang and Talon . Her power was so vast that even in dead she turned into glass those dragons who approached her remains carelessly . The dragons eventually throw giant boulders at her corpse to bury her in hopes to avoid her glass - turning aura , creating the Dead Stone Mountains . A few dragons and dragonborn dared to explore the mountains to scavenge Petron ' s remains in hopes to create powerful artifact s . One such such artifact was the Breath of Petron .

title: Petrylloc ' s gambit
description: Petrylloc ' s gambit Petrylloc ' s Gambit is a spell that creates a wall of ice and two walls of stone above a target , which then fall upon it . It was cast in a group casting in 1374 DR by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and the wizards Sememmon and Ashemmi in order to defeat a sharn at the Sleeping Dragon inn .
description_long: Petrylloc ' s gambit Petrylloc ' s Gambit is a spell that creates a wall of ice and two walls of stone above a target , which then fall upon it . It was cast in a group casting in 1374 DR by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and the wizards Sememmon and Ashemmi in order to defeat a sharn at the Sleeping Dragon inn .

title: Phaan Colwyvv
description: Phaan Colwyvv Phaan Colwyvv was a Tessarch of Amn . He was one of only two surviving members of the original Council of Six set up in 1333 DR . At this time , he entered the council as a Pommarch , but rose to Iltarch in 1345 DR and Tessarch in 1362 DR .
description_long: Phaan Colwyvv Phaan Colwyvv was a Tessarch of Amn . He was one of only two surviving members of the original Council of Six set up in 1333 DR . At this time , he entered the council as a Pommarch , but rose to Iltarch in 1345 DR and Tessarch in 1362 DR . Description . Phaan had a hooked nose and was notoriously miserly , focusing on finances and ways to make more profit . He had a cold manner . History . Phaan knew Iltarch Rhinnom Dannihyr well but trusted him little because they ' d once worked together as Shadow Thieves , where Phaan was a spy , nicknamed " Shar ' s Gallant " . Phaan killed all five of his older brothers to become the head of the family , but the family ' s power was decreasing in 1333 DR , at which point he was invited to join the Council of Six by Thayze Selemchant .

title: Phaen of Rags
description: Phaen of Rags Phaen was a lowly wizard of the Hosttower . He committed some fatal mistake , which he never shared with anyone , and was immediately cast out of the Brotherhood . He lost his robe and he began wearing a " Robe of Rags " , which showed his lowly rank in the Hosttower .
description_long: Phaen of Rags Phaen was a lowly wizard of the Hosttower . He committed some fatal mistake , which he never shared with anyone , and was immediately cast out of the Brotherhood . He lost his robe and he began wearing a " Robe of Rags " , which showed his lowly rank in the Hosttower . He traveled to Icewind Dale and eventually joined the Legion of the Chimera . He summoned goblin s into the town of Targos to raid the town . He was killed by adventurers who eventually saved the town and all of the Ten Towns . Later events cast doubt on his story of expulsion from the Brotherhood . Beastmaster Harshom , who heavily implies that he is a current member of the Brotherhood , claims that Phaen answered to him .

title: Phaere Despana
description: Phaere Despana Phaere Despana was the daughter of Matron Mother Ardulace , the head of the Ust Natha branch of the Despana house . She was unsurprisingly plotting to overthrow her mother . Earlier in her life , she ' d had actual feelings for the male called Solaufein , but all such genuine feeling had been chased away from her by relentless torture administered for that purpose .
description_long: Phaere Despana Phaere Despana was the daughter of Matron Mother Ardulace , the head of the Ust Natha branch of the Despana house . She was unsurprisingly plotting to overthrow her mother . Earlier in her life , she ' d had actual feelings for the male called Solaufein , but all such genuine feeling had been chased away from her by relentless torture administered for that purpose . Phaere is encountered in " " in the likely event that the player character elects to infiltrate Ust Natha , disguised as drow , in order to help the dragon Adalon to retrieve her eggs . The eggs have been stolen by Irenicus and given by him to the matron mother , who intends to sacrifice them to a demon in exchange for its aid . One of the first assignments given to the player by the drow is to accompany Solaufein in ambushing a group of ethereally travelling illithid , who have captured Phaere . After that , Phaere constantly gives the player ' s party and Solaufein tasks . It is also evident that there is a tension between the two , and it will be revealed to be because of their former love affair that has since turned into empty bitterness .

title: Phaerimm
description: Phaerimm Phaerimms were aberrations of a wholly evil and sadistic bent . Their desire to erase all other living beings from existence was held in check by their desire to have other beings as slaves and to torture for sport . Phaerimms communicated with one another in a non - verbal way by varying the wind speed around their bodies .
description_long: Phaerimm Phaerimms were aberrations of a wholly evil and sadistic bent . Their desire to erase all other living beings from existence was held in check by their desire to have other beings as slaves and to torture for sport . Phaerimms communicated with one another in a non - verbal way by varying the wind speed around their bodies . With non - phaerimms , they communicated telepathically . They understood Common and knew several other languages . Appearance . Phaerimms were conical in shape with an ovoid head . They had barbed teeth and a poisonous hollow barb on the end of their tails . Phaerimms had four arms . Phaerimm magic required the caster to have four arms . Ecology . Phaerimms would always choose to fly unless prevented from doing so . Phaerimms fed on magic .

title: Phaerl Hawksong
description: Phaerl Hawksong Phaerl Hawksong was a senior priestess of Sehanine Moonbow at the Tower of the Moon ' s Magic in Evereska and a member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She shared the dream of Khelben Arunsun of bringing the elves and humans together .
description_long: Phaerl Hawksong Phaerl Hawksong was a senior priestess of Sehanine Moonbow at the Tower of the Moon ' s Magic in Evereska and a member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She shared the dream of Khelben Arunsun of bringing the elves and humans together . She was happy to join the Moonstars , seeing it as an opportunity to repay her debt to him . History . In " circa " 870 DR , Phaerl was assaulted while traveling in Anauroch but was saved by Khelben Arunsun at nearly the cost of his life . Phaerl and Khelben remained in contact ever since , having similar beliefs about the cooperation of elves and humans . In 1370 DR , Khelben asked her to join his Moonstars and Phaerl gladly accepted . She was in 1374 among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor . Appearance . " Blackstaff ( novel ) "

title: Phaia
description: Phaia Phaia was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Phaia was a true believer of Szass Tam .
description_long: Phaia Phaia was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Phaia was a true believer of Szass Tam . She was also opportunistic and self - obsessed like her master , even ready to betray him to save her own life . Phaia believed that no magic was too dangerous and no experiment too dark if it provided power for herself . History . Phaia was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault under Thaymount . She was a subordinate of Lahnis , but also there to guarantee the loyalty of her superior to Tam ' s cause . In 1486 DR , she was tasked with draining the soul of a prisoner , Kelson Darktreader , in order to power undead creatures . When the heroes of Daggerford arrived , Phaia fought them and was defeated . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Although not easy , she can be convinced to betray Tam in exchange for her life . She can give the players some useful information and even possibly resurrect Kelson when he eventually dies . In that outcome , she readily escapes from Doomvault .

title: Phaikkul
description: Phaikkul Phaikkul was a female half - dragon kir - lanan and the leader of the Screeching Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . Her dark grey scales were large and thick , especially on her back and chest .
description_long: Phaikkul Phaikkul was a female half - dragon kir - lanan and the leader of the Screeching Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . Her dark grey scales were large and thick , especially on her back and chest . Long , sharply pointed horns rose over her temples and her eyes glowed an emerald green . Large frilled ears and a spiny crest that ran along her back and down her thick tail highlighted her shadow dragon heritage . Personality . Softly spoken and subtle , Phaikkul held her subordinates in check with her focused intensity . Abilities . Thanks to her half - shadow dragon heritage , Phaikkul was physically stronger than her other kin and could also expel a cone of billowing shadows to sap the life of her foes . Although a powerful fighter , Phaikkul was a wary combatant ; despite her impressive dragon blood she was not adverse to fleeing combat to seek refuge with her father , Glouroth . Possessions . She wore a set of " gauntlets of ogre power " that further augmented her considerable strength and a " ring of protection " + 1 and a " chain shirt + 2 " .

title: Phalantar Orivan
description: Phalantar Orivan Phalantar Orivan was a fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR who originated from Hlondeth . Personality . Phalantar always smiled gently and moved quietly .
description_long: Phalantar Orivan Phalantar Orivan was a fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR who originated from Hlondeth . Personality . Phalantar always smiled gently and moved quietly . Activities . From his shop , Phalantar ' s Philtres & Components , Phalantar sold and bought spices , exotic medicines , herbs , and spell components , plus rare substances used in creating perfumes , scented oils , and poisons . He dealt regularly with adventurers and wizards and sponsored adventuring parties in exchange for a share of their loot , particular goods he could sell in his shop , and funded some mercenary companies for part of their profits . Phalantar was also known to buy magic items for 40 % of their value , without asking questions . With all this business , he became incredibly rich .

title: Phalorm
description: Phalorm Phalorm ( known as the Realm of Three Crowns ) was a kingdom in Northwest Faerûn made up of dwarves , elves , gnome s , halfling s and human s . History . The kingdom was formed in 523 DR at the Council of Axe and Arrow , a council to deal with the growing orc problem in the area .
description_long: Phalorm Phalorm ( known as the Realm of Three Crowns ) was a kingdom in Northwest Faerûn made up of dwarves , elves , gnome s , halfling s and human s . History . The kingdom was formed in 523 DR at the Council of Axe and Arrow , a council to deal with the growing orc problem in the area . Dwarves from Dardath , elves from the Ardeep Forest , gnomes from Dolblunde , halflings from Mieritin and humans from Delimbiyran collectively agreed to form a kingdom . Ulbaerag Bloodhand of Bloodhand Hold ( later Waterdeep ) rejected the opportunity to join the kingdom , but this decision was reversed later by his son . The kingdom was destroyed by the Horde of the Wastes in 615 DR .

title: Phalse
description: Phalse Phalse was a being with beholder - like characteristics , except that his tentacles ended in mouths . Other beholders found this disgusting . Phalse was one of the six involved in creating the human construct Alias .
description_long: Phalse Phalse was a being with beholder - like characteristics , except that his tentacles ended in mouths . Other beholders found this disgusting . Phalse was one of the six involved in creating the human construct Alias . His symbol was a blue - upon - blue circle , presumably representing a beholder ' s central eye . He pretended to be a servant of a greater being of the Abyss , so he would have greater freedom to act . He disguised himself as a halfling , on a construct body . Phalse was slain by Alias , who impaled him with the sword of Dragonbait , " Hill Cleaver " , and used it to throw him upwards from the top of the Citadel of White Exile into the Positive Energy Plane , where for all intents and purposes he became an exploding star .

title: Phanar Manthar
description: Phanar Manthar Phanar Manthar was a devout priest of Oghma and the disowned son of a Waterdhavian noble house . Background . When Phanar ' s master , Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " , died in 1371 DR , Phanar took on his responsibilities .
description_long: Phanar Manthar Phanar Manthar was a devout priest of Oghma and the disowned son of a Waterdhavian noble house . Background . When Phanar ' s master , Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " , died in 1371 DR , Phanar took on his responsibilities . Phanar introduced Raegar Stoneblade and Damlath to one another and insisted they work together . Together their surveillance and dispatching of Surkhas of Leilon was able to prevent the Arcane Brotherhood from claiming the High House of Thalivar and its secrets .

title: Phandalin
description: Phandalin Phandalin was a human village located northeast of Leilon , where the road that ran from the High Road to Triboar Trail faded into a trail . It was raided by orcs in 951 DR and subsequently abandoned . Phandalin had three deep wells .
description_long: Phandalin Phandalin was a human village located northeast of Leilon , where the road that ran from the High Road to Triboar Trail faded into a trail . It was raided by orcs in 951 DR and subsequently abandoned . Phandalin had three deep wells . Sometime in the 1400s DR , settlers from Neverwinter and Waterdeep had resettled the ruins of Phandalin . Phandalin became a frontier settlement of farmers and prospectors looking for wealth in the Sword Mountains . History . Phandalin was originally a farming community . The orc s of the realm of Uruth Ukrypt ( " Home of Uruth " ) had destroyed all game in their realm , and , in search of food , they turned on the human settlements in the area , raiding them . Phandalin was one of these settlements , and in 951 DR , it was overrun and then abandoned . Government . Phandalin had no functioning government , however , the townsfolk annually elected a townsmaster . The townsmaster would serve as a judge and mediator , and also kept the records that need to be kept .

title: Phandar
description: Phandar Phandar was a type of tree found across Faerûn . Description . Phandar trees had numerous curving branches sprouting from a knobby trunk .
description_long: Phandar Phandar was a type of tree found across Faerûn . Description . Phandar trees had numerous curving branches sprouting from a knobby trunk . The branches faced away from the wind , meaning that a group of phandars almost always pointed the same direction . Phandar leaves were triangular and mottled green . Phandar trees were said to resemble roper s . Usage . Because of its strength , phandar wood was an excellent building material . It was also used in the crafting of bow s , tools , and weapon handles . Its multicolored grains made it prized in jewelry making . Locations . Phandars were found all across Faerûn but rarely north of the High Forest . Due to excessive logging , the total number of phandars were decreasing rapidly .

title: Phandymm
description: Phandymm Phandymm was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR and secretly a cleric of Bane . History . Phandymm was a cleric of Bane loyal to the High Imperceptor of Bane until he met Fzoul Chembryl ; Fzoul gained Phandymm ' s loyalty and used him as spy in the Orthodox faction of the Church of Bane and also thank to him in 1263 DR Fzoul gained control over all the Zhentil Banites .
description_long: Phandymm Phandymm was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR and secretly a cleric of Bane . History . Phandymm was a cleric of Bane loyal to the High Imperceptor of Bane until he met Fzoul Chembryl ; Fzoul gained Phandymm ' s loyalty and used him as spy in the Orthodox faction of the Church of Bane and also thank to him in 1263 DR Fzoul gained control over all the Zhentil Banites . For recompense Fzoul appointed him in the Council but keep his cleric ' s role secret ( Manshoon however had suspects about ) . Phandymm always supported Fzoul in Council .

title: Phane
description: Phane Phanes were a race of immortal magical beast s with the ability to manipulate time itself . Chaotic and destructive , phanes were nonetheless non - evil in nature . Occasionally , phanes formed pacts with powerful mortals who shared their goals .
description_long: Phane Phanes were a race of immortal magical beast s with the ability to manipulate time itself . Chaotic and destructive , phanes were nonetheless non - evil in nature . Occasionally , phanes formed pacts with powerful mortals who shared their goals . Like most immortals , phanes were most commonly found on the Astral Plane , but they tended to wander the planes as they wished , hunting for prey in the spaces between moments . Description . A phane resembled a cloud of black mist in form , although phanes often coalesced into a more solid shape . Above the torso , phanes typically had a humanoid form , while below they more closely resembled a panther or other wild cat . However , at no single time did the shape of a phane remain constant and it appeared to be in constant flux , the air rippling around it as it moved about . Abilities . Phanes were capable of flight , which they used , along with their agile land speed , to evade foes in a battle and , while on the ground or in the air , they traveled roughly twice as fast as a dwarf . When on the aggressive , phanes often used an ability known as " wizening ray " to daze their target .

title: Phanlinksal
description: Phanlinksal Phanlinksal was a ruined illithid settlement located in the Northdark . Geography . Phanlinksal was located in the Upper Northdark beneath the Lurkwood , a few weeks ' march west of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Phanlinksal Phanlinksal was a ruined illithid settlement located in the Northdark . Geography . Phanlinksal was located in the Upper Northdark beneath the Lurkwood , a few weeks ' march west of Menzoberranzan . Structure . The settlement was located in a long , narrow cavern and built in the form of a castle centered around a stalagmite tower , which served as living quarters for prominent members of the community . Inside the tower , balconies lined the walls , overlooking the central elder brain , which was constantly attended to by nimble - fingered slaves . Other structures in the city included the Axial Plaza , a capture pit , thrall barracks , a gladiatorial arena , and birthing pools . Just outside the city was a rothe - inhabited " herd island " surrounded by gorges with a narrow , magical bridge connecting it to the settlement . Inhabitants . Before its destruction , Phanlinksal was home to an elder brain and up to 120 illithid s and three times that number of thralls . History . The city was founded in 491 DR by the elder brains ruling illithid society . They chose a defensible cavern close to the surface to allow for easy raiding of Uthgardt tribes in the Lurkwood .

title: Phantasmal killer
description: Phantasmal killer Phantasmal killer , originally known as Carbury ' s killer , was an illusion spell that created a phantasm of an attack by the most fearful creature the victim could imagine . Effects . This spell reached into the victim ' s subconscious , pulled out the most horrifying creature he or she could imagine , and attacked with it using an illusion only the victim could see clearly ( the caster saw only an indistinct shape ) .
description_long: Phantasmal killer Phantasmal killer , originally known as Carbury ' s killer , was an illusion spell that created a phantasm of an attack by the most fearful creature the victim could imagine . Effects . This spell reached into the victim ' s subconscious , pulled out the most horrifying creature he or she could imagine , and attacked with it using an illusion only the victim could see clearly ( the caster saw only an indistinct shape ) . The victim had one chance to disbelieve the illusion and be free from the nightmare ( although for an early version of this spell , timely applications of " remove fear " or " cloak of bravery " could give additional chances to resist ) or else the imaginary beast pursued and attacked relentlessly until the spell ended or victim died of fright . The spell also ended if the victim or the caster were rendered unconscious , the caster ' s concentration was broken by some means , or the victim had a constitution strong enough to survive the mental onslaught and the resulting physical damage . For the older versions of " phantasmal killer " , certain circumstances could raise or lower the chances of resisting the mind beast .

title: Phantasmal terrain
description: Phantasmal terrain Phantasmal terrain is a spell of the illusion school illusion used by wizard ly initiates to hinder their enemies . When cast , " phantasmal terrain " creates the illusion of forbidding and difficult to cross terrain within an area of five feet in radius within 100 feet of the wizard . This effect can last for several minutes , slowing the movements of creatures within by as much as half , who become so distracted that they become vulnerable to far more mundane traps and hazards .
description_long: Phantasmal terrain Phantasmal terrain is a spell of the illusion school illusion used by wizard ly initiates to hinder their enemies . When cast , " phantasmal terrain " creates the illusion of forbidding and difficult to cross terrain within an area of five feet in radius within 100 feet of the wizard . This effect can last for several minutes , slowing the movements of creatures within by as much as half , who become so distracted that they become vulnerable to far more mundane traps and hazards . " Phantasmal terrain " is taxing on the mind of its caster , however , and can only be cast once per day .

title: Phantom Pass
description: Phantom Pass The Phantom Pass was a pass in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It connected the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau with Vanesci Hamlet in Konigheim . Reputation .
description_long: Phantom Pass The Phantom Pass was a pass in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It connected the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau with Vanesci Hamlet in Konigheim . Reputation . The Phantom Pass was widely considered to be mythical , and provoked a fear in some folk . It was possible to find oneself unexpectedly transported into the Pass . During the 7th century DR , the evil mage Moria Chantel kidnapped travelers near the Phantom Pass , for use in a ceremony to gain immortality . Description . The Phantom Pass was a decayed land , with bare red - brown dirt interspersed with marshes and dotted with protruding rocks and dead trees with above - ground roots and tendril branches , like those that grew on the Forbidden Plateau . The stumps of some trees were big enough to build on . Steep cliffs dropped away to the south . . A derelict village or town stood in the pass , with houses of light beige walls and peaked turquoise - tiled roofs with chimneys , built in the same style as in Vanesci Hamlet . They were all ruined and overgrown with vines .

title: Phantom chasm
description: Phantom chasm Phantom chasm is an illusion spell learned by some wizard s early in their training . " Phantom chasm " , when cast , creates the image of a bottomless pit five feet in diameter within 100 feet of the wizard . Though it is only an illusion , creatures standing over the chasm find it so realistic that they may suffer actual mental trauma , convinced that they are plummeting to their deaths .
description_long: Phantom chasm Phantom chasm is an illusion spell learned by some wizard s early in their training . " Phantom chasm " , when cast , creates the image of a bottomless pit five feet in diameter within 100 feet of the wizard . Though it is only an illusion , creatures standing over the chasm find it so realistic that they may suffer actual mental trauma , convinced that they are plummeting to their deaths . Regardless of whether or not the illusion works , creatures caught within find themselves immobilized from the shock for a brief moment . The spell requires a vast amount of effort on the part of the caster , meaning it can only be used once per day .

title: Phantom plow
description: Phantom plow Phantom plow was a divine magic spell available to cleric s and druid s of Chauntea . It caused a deep , straight groove to form in the earth , possibly causing creatures in its path to fall . It also revealed any dweomers cast on the ground .
description_long: Phantom plow Phantom plow was a divine magic spell available to cleric s and druid s of Chauntea . It caused a deep , straight groove to form in the earth , possibly causing creatures in its path to fall . It also revealed any dweomers cast on the ground . Effects . This spell could not be cast upon consecrated ground , nor would its effect enter consecrated ground . The " plow " also stopped at a wall , but hit the wall with the force of a ram . If the " plow " encountered any dweomers on the earth along its path , such as " phantasmal terrain " for example , that part of the ground sparkled with a bright crimson " faerie fire " for a few minutes . The furrow started at the caster ' s feet and drove in a straight line indicated by the caster for a distance of 100 ft ( 30 m ) . Higher level casters could increase this distance . If the caster ' s feet were not touching the ground , " e . g . " , he or she were standing on the parapet of a castle or " flying " , then the range of this spell was 150 ft ( 46 m ) . Again , higher level casters could extend this range .

title: Phantom steed
description: Phantom steed Phantom steed was a conjuration spell that conjured a magical horse ( or spider in the case of spider domain cleric s ) for the caster to ride . Effect . This spell conjure a quasi - real , horse - like creature .
description_long: Phantom steed Phantom steed was a conjuration spell that conjured a magical horse ( or spider in the case of spider domain cleric s ) for the caster to ride . Effect . This spell conjure a quasi - real , horse - like creature . The steed could be ridden only by the caster and another individual . A phantom steed had a black head and body , gray mane and tail , and smoke - colored , insubstantial hooves that made no sound . It had what seemed to be a saddle , bit , and bridle . They did not fight , but all normal animals shunned them and refused to attack them . The phantom steed would disappear if it sustained a killing blow . The speed , amount of weight they could bear , and their ability to travel over difficult surfaces or even fly depended on the relative skill of the caster .

title: Pharaun Mizzrym
description: Pharaun Mizzrym Pharaun Mizzrym was a talented wizard and and Master of Sorcere from House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . Description . He was charismatic , well dressed , eloquent , and never left standing on one foot .
description_long: Pharaun Mizzrym Pharaun Mizzrym was a talented wizard and and Master of Sorcere from House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . Description . He was charismatic , well dressed , eloquent , and never left standing on one foot . He employed a variety of tools to get the job done - - magic and subterfuge were the two most often seen , but he did not hesitate to make a deal with a whore , break a promise to an ally , or endanger the lives of his apprentices to gain power . Pharaun was very appearance oriented . He considered himself at the height of current fashion . During his travels at the time of the Silence of Lolth , he moped about the lack of proper hair - dressing and bathing facilities . His general appearance was graceful and elegant . Personality . Pharaun ' s condescending manner was obvious in all of his interactions , including those with people of higher social standing than himself . He had a lack of respect for authority and for priestesses in general . He delighted in verbally jabbing and giving back - handed compliments to any he considers inferior - - which was to say everyone .

title: Pharblex Spattergoo
description: Pharblex Spattergoo Pharblex Spattergoo was the chief and shaman of the bullywug tribe in the Mere of Dead Men during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 . Personality . Pharblex greatly enjoyed tormenting the lizardfolk , thanks to Dralmorrer Borngray putting them under his control , and he killed the lizardfolk chief Suncaller .
description_long: Pharblex Spattergoo Pharblex Spattergoo was the chief and shaman of the bullywug tribe in the Mere of Dead Men during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 . Personality . Pharblex greatly enjoyed tormenting the lizardfolk , thanks to Dralmorrer Borngray putting them under his control , and he killed the lizardfolk chief Suncaller . Possessions . In battle , Pharblex wore studded leather and fought with a spear and shield . Relationships . Pharblex ' s bullywugs acted as servants and henchmen for the Cult of the Dragon ' s local leader Rezmir . History . He was probably killed by the lizardfolk chief Snapjaw , helped by a band of adventurers who were enemies of the Cult .

title: Pharnth Aelorothi
description: Pharnth Aelorothi Pharnth Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Pharnth ' s consort was Saesaan Aelorothi .
description_long: Pharnth Aelorothi Pharnth Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Pharnth ' s consort was Saesaan Aelorothi . Activities . Pharnth was the lord and patriarch of House Aelorothi . He used his divination powers to spy on the enemies of House Dlardrageth and reported to Ryvvik Dlardrageth . He was a marginal voice of restraint in the daemonfey council . Personality . Pharnth was very cautious .

title: Pharom Ildacer
description: Pharom Ildacer Pharom Ildacer was the elder surviving aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Pharom was promoted to High Mage in 1341 DR after his masters the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark accepted new students .
description_long: Pharom Ildacer Pharom Ildacer was the elder surviving aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Pharom was promoted to High Mage in 1341 DR after his masters the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark accepted new students . A key player in the Twelfth Serôs War , Pharom in flamerule 5 of 1369 DR met with the " Loreweaver " Pacys in order to had the bard ' s help in understanding of the Prophecy of Thurlathiirn . The High mages and Pacys went to Myth Nantar in marpenoth and thank to Pacys easily opened the barrier surrounding the city . There in uktar 11 Pharom and his fellow casted their magic that sent Iakhovas to the Outer Planes ending the war , but only Pharom remained alive . In hammer 8 of 1370 DR Pharom permitted to the malenti to settle in Myth Nantar . Activiities . Pharom suffered the bad manner of his cousin Morgan Ildacer but he knew too well the need of diplomacy . He had always fascinated by the dukar magic and had start an exchange of spell s with Lashyrr Maerdrymm in order to increase the respective knowledges .

title: Pharos
description: Pharos Pharos was the most powerful elven high mage among the elves of Tethir , Darthiir Wood , and Shilmista and the one who trapped the genie s Calim and Memnon in the " Calimemnon Crystal " and ended the Era of Skyfire . He became a baelnorn and guarded over the " Crystal " for nearly 9 , 000 years . As of 1374 DR , Pharos still resided in the Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen .
description_long: Pharos Pharos was the most powerful elven high mage among the elves of Tethir , Darthiir Wood , and Shilmista and the one who trapped the genie s Calim and Memnon in the " Calimemnon Crystal " and ended the Era of Skyfire . He became a baelnorn and guarded over the " Crystal " for nearly 9 , 000 years . As of 1374 DR , Pharos still resided in the Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen . He cast illusion s and set traps throughout the Keep to prevent anyone from ever finding the " Crystal " .

title: Pharra ' s Alley
description: Pharra ' s Alley Pharra ' s Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep near the House of Wonder . History . The alley was named for Pharra , the first Magistress of the House of Wonder who died in 1247 DR .
description_long: Pharra ' s Alley Pharra ' s Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep near the House of Wonder . History . The alley was named for Pharra , the first Magistress of the House of Wonder who died in 1247 DR . Inhabitants . Wizard s and cleric s of the Circle of Skulls haunted the alleyway . The alley was often used as a convenient shortcut by merchants passing through and as a favorite gathering place for young apprentice mage s who hoped to impress the wizards of the nearby House of Wonder .

title: Pharran Nicostas
description: Pharran Nicostas Pharran Nicostas was a drow wight in Blingdenstone . History . Pharran was a drow warrior who went to Blingdestone .
description_long: Pharran Nicostas Pharran Nicostas was a drow wight in Blingdenstone . History . Pharran was a drow warrior who went to Blingdestone . He refused to go home afterwards and somehow after his death became a wight . He remained sitting on the throne of the city ' s kings until 1479 DR , when an adventuring party hired by Kargien Dissengulp defeated him and his skeleton minions . Personality . Pharran had in life the ambition to become the conqueror of Blingdenstone and this ambition sustained him even after death .

title: Pharx
description: Pharx Pharx was a deep dragon ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard . History . In 1361 DR , Pharx was the strongest ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard group in Skullport .
description_long: Pharx Pharx was a deep dragon ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard . History . In 1361 DR , Pharx was the strongest ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard group in Skullport . In her plan to destroy them , Liriel Baenre convinced her longtime friend , the mutated deep dragon Zz ' Pzora , to dispose of Pharx . Zz ' Pzora approached Pharx in a Skullport bar , where he was drinking disguised as a polymorph ed drow male , and seduced him . Once in his lair , she attacked him . A fierce battle ensued resulting in Pharx ' s death . However , Zz ' Pzora also received fatal injures .

title: Pharyssolnyth
description: Pharyssolnyth Pharyssolnyth was a female wyrm silver dragon of the 16th century before Dalereckoning . She was the author of the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth . History .
description_long: Pharyssolnyth Pharyssolnyth was a female wyrm silver dragon of the 16th century before Dalereckoning . She was the author of the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth . History . Pharyssolnyth dwelled in the elven city of Yrlaphon , among the eastern woodlands of Cormanthor , in its first century after its founding in −1535 DR ( prior to −1435 DR ) . There she wrote the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth , which detailed how dragon s learned and handled magic . Pharyssolnyth was deceased well before 1373 DR .

title: Phase door
description: Phase door Phase door was a conjuration or spell that opened passages , where there were none . Effects . While the spell was called " phase " " " door " " , what appeared on casting was an ethereal , and thus invisible , tunnel .
description_long: Phase door Phase door was a conjuration or spell that opened passages , where there were none . Effects . While the spell was called " phase " " " door " " , what appeared on casting was an ethereal , and thus invisible , tunnel . This tunnel was both invisible and unusable for everyone but the caster , though the caster can open access to others . Only on wooden , plaster or stone surfaces was the tunnel successfully created . The caster can walk through the wall via this tunnel for an increasing number of times per strength of the caste . By using up more uses , the caster can also bring others along . Light or sound from the one side didn ' t get to the other side and if the spell was forcefully ended , for example through dispelling , those inside the phase door were ejected out as it happened when a " passwall " spell was dispelled with someone inside . Access for usage could be given to others by stating a number of conditions on casting . These conditions needed to be observable , like identity or passwords . While its ethereal nature made it possible for some creatures to see it , like with a " gem of true seeing " , just seeing didn ' t allow usage .

title: Phase spider
description: Phase spider A phase spider was a magical beast akin to a predacious version of the ethereal filcher . Phase spiders were monstrous arachnid - kin that dwelt within the Ethereal Plane . They made quick forays into the natural world to snatch an unlucky creature to feed upon .
description_long: Phase spider A phase spider was a magical beast akin to a predacious version of the ethereal filcher . Phase spiders were monstrous arachnid - kin that dwelt within the Ethereal Plane . They made quick forays into the natural world to snatch an unlucky creature to feed upon . Those stolen by phase spiders were never seen again and were regarded as unsolved disappearances . Description . The phase spider resembled a giant , two - eyed , spindly legged spider with the same dark green and white coloration of an ethereal filcher ( though it was a bit more blue than green ) . Combat . While the filcher transported between the Ethereal Plane and the Material Plane for the purpose of stealing , the phase spider did this for the purpose of hunting . It looked for a likely spot in the Ethereal Plane , and then teleported ( its form of teleportation was known as " phasing , " hence the name ) to the Material Plane , presumably ambushing travelers it expected to be there , biting and killing them , and then quickly retreating back to the Ethereal Plane . Behavior . They could not speak . They were regarded as neutral in alignment .

title: Phase trap
description: Phase trap Phase trap was an arcane alteration spell that could temporarily anchor a plane - hopping creature to the Prime Material Plane . Effects . The caster of " phase trap " was required to be within 20 yd ( 18 .
description_long: Phase trap Phase trap was an arcane alteration spell that could temporarily anchor a plane - hopping creature to the Prime Material Plane . Effects . The caster of " phase trap " was required to be within 20 yd ( 18 . 3 m ) and have direct line of sight to the target . If the creature resisted the magic of this spell , then it had no effect . Otherwise , the target was locked to the Prime Material Plane for a number of minutes equal to the experience level of the caster . Magic items that performed the same type of phasing between planes also ceased to function . However , spells that were more advanced than this spell , such as the 5th level " phase door " spell , were unaffected by " phase trap " . Specific Effects . " Phase trap " was particularly good at preventing Ethereal Plane travel but had a chance to prevent Astral Plane travel as well . Creatures that phased through solid objects were also special cases . See below . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a clear gem of at least 50 gp in value that was consumed in the casting . History .

title: Phelansheene
description: Phelansheene Phelansheene was a sorceress under a curse in Amphail in 1370 DR . History . Phelansheene was a sorceress with a spellbook full of ancient and powerful Netherese spell s .
description_long: Phelansheene Phelansheene was a sorceress under a curse in Amphail in 1370 DR . History . Phelansheene was a sorceress with a spellbook full of ancient and powerful Netherese spell s . Once in Amphail she was engaged in a battle with a Red Wizard of Thay . The Red Wizard ended up trapped in a crystal ball hidden in the village and Phelansheene was cursed to manifest in Faerûn only on nights of a full moon and only in Amphail , because her spellbook remained there . She was in love with Thorn Tlassalune .

title: Phelas Urm
description: Phelas Urm Phelas Urm was a merchant from Thentia by the Moonsea . Some time after the sinking of " Valashar ' s Bane " in 389 DR , he purchased the recovered Cormyr ean state sword , " Ilbratha " , from a fellow merchant , Sevan of Amnwater , while in Scornubel , not realizing the blade ' s significance . Phelas took the sword with him as he traveled overland , passing through Cormyr , and the sword was recognized in Arabel .
description_long: Phelas Urm Phelas Urm was a merchant from Thentia by the Moonsea . Some time after the sinking of " Valashar ' s Bane " in 389 DR , he purchased the recovered Cormyr ean state sword , " Ilbratha " , from a fellow merchant , Sevan of Amnwater , while in Scornubel , not realizing the blade ' s significance . Phelas took the sword with him as he traveled overland , passing through Cormyr , and the sword was recognized in Arabel . In the Year of the Firstborn , 392 DR , agents of King Azoun I of Cormyr attempted to recover the sword , and Phelas panicked at being so hunted . Phelas was killed in the process . , but the sword went missing again , either due to the confusion of the situation , or due to a corrupt agent stealing the blade .

title: Phelzel
description: Phelzel Phelzel was a city in Semphar . Description . The city of Phelzel was the second - largest in Semphar , about half the size of Dhaztanar , and a major trading city for that nation , primarily focusing on lumber from the Shalhoond .
description_long: Phelzel Phelzel was a city in Semphar . Description . The city of Phelzel was the second - largest in Semphar , about half the size of Dhaztanar , and a major trading city for that nation , primarily focusing on lumber from the Shalhoond . It was in Phelzel that lumber was finished , and shipped to other ports on the Gbor Nor . Due to its lumber industry , as well as being located along the lake , Phelzel was an important ship - building city , building many of the small boats and merchant vessels that sailed Gbor Nor ' s waters . Semphar law was poorly enforced in the city , with many illegal shops paying bribes to local government officials to get them to turn a blind eye to their operations . Because law was so poorly enforced here , a number of thieves guilds operated in the city , which in turn drew a number of mercenaries and wizards to the city as well .
