The nearby ruins of Bhaluin , also drew a number of adventurers to the city .

title: Phen Do
description: Phen Do Phen Do was a rebellious noble in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Wanting to return the rule of nobles over Tabot , Phen Do bribed the Chi - Kyap Khempo and influenced the Nafeen Gompa and Zotung Gompa , starting a revolt .
description_long: Phen Do Phen Do was a rebellious noble in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Wanting to return the rule of nobles over Tabot , Phen Do bribed the Chi - Kyap Khempo and influenced the Nafeen Gompa and Zotung Gompa , starting a revolt . Three military divisions were stationed in the area to contain the revolt . By 1357 DR , he was training his secret army , the Raccoon - dogs , hidden in the mountains east of Nafeen Gompa .

title: Phenalope
description: Phenalope Phenalope , also known as , was related to the less valuable rhodochrosite . Description . These pink to rose - red semi - precious stones could be or tumbled smooth .
description_long: Phenalope Phenalope , also known as , was related to the less valuable rhodochrosite . Description . These pink to rose - red semi - precious stones could be or tumbled smooth . It was found in crystal form or in large non - crystalline deposits that were cut in slabs , then broken into smaller pieces for tumbling . Folklore said this stone would protect against magical fire . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Folklore was correct . Phenalope extinguished magical flames within a 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) radius and prevented them from igniting or re - igniting . A " fireball " would only produce a flash of light and a puff of smoke around the surface of the sphere where the " fireball " would have detonated . Non - magical fires were also suppressed within range of this stone . No fires could be lit and existing fires had a good chance of being extinguished . Oil - based fires were somewhat less susceptible to phenalope , but eventually they would succumb also . Because of this property , phenalope was used as an inlay in the floors of large meeting halls , ballrooms , and other such places .

title: Phent
description: Phent Phent is large fortress city in Thesk along the Golden Way . Phent is a sprawling fortress that carries with it a heavy feeling of duty , many people here are retired knights and derelict guards , many of Faerûn ' s best human made weapons and armors can be found here . Recently there has been an influx of Gnomish engineers bringing in their expertise to expand the value and variety of the master craftsmen here .
description_long: Phent Phent is large fortress city in Thesk along the Golden Way . Phent is a sprawling fortress that carries with it a heavy feeling of duty , many people here are retired knights and derelict guards , many of Faerûn ' s best human made weapons and armors can be found here . Recently there has been an influx of Gnomish engineers bringing in their expertise to expand the value and variety of the master craftsmen here .

title: Phezult ' s sleep of ages
description: Phezult ' s sleep of ages Phezult ' s sleep of ages was a spell which created a protective sphere of suspended animation . Effects . After casting , a spherical stasis field would slowly expand out from the " spell focus " until it reached it ' s maximum spherical volume .
description_long: Phezult ' s sleep of ages Phezult ' s sleep of ages was a spell which created a protective sphere of suspended animation . Effects . After casting , a spherical stasis field would slowly expand out from the " spell focus " until it reached it ' s maximum spherical volume . Other than the caster , any other creatures in the sphere ran the risk of being placed in suspended animation . Although body functions of those trapped cease , they do not die , starve or age . Those in the sphere can be attacked or killed by conventional means , at which point their body will start to decay . Trying to contact a creature stuck inside the sphere using psionics or magic will yield no response , and the creature attempting the contact will find themselves in stasis for a short time . Individuals can be freed of the spell by casting temporal reinstatement or the reverse of this spell ; Phezult ' s awakening . Components . To create the " spell focus " required at least nine drops of the caster ' s own blood , The blood had to be smeared into an unbroken ring no large than the caster ' s hand . Six of at least 500 gp value then had to be placed inside the ring .

title: Phiaqiv
description: Phiaqiv Phiaqiv was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR as well as the city ' s archmage . History . Phiaqiv was born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Zekaqux was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren .
description_long: Phiaqiv Phiaqiv was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR as well as the city ' s archmage . History . Phiaqiv was born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Zekaqux was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren . In time , thank to their experience , she and Zekaqux become the leading members of the Xendreth . Activities . Phiaqiv ' s field of study was necromancy and she had a coterie of lesser ixzan wizard vampires as attendants and apprentices .

title: Philaerin
description: Philaerin Philaerin was a moon elf and the Eldest of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . He resided in Tower Reilloch on the island of Evermeet . Description .
description_long: Philaerin Philaerin was a moon elf and the Eldest of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . He resided in Tower Reilloch on the island of Evermeet . Description . Despite Philaerin ' s age , his face was smooth and unlined . History . Philaerin was slain in early 1374 DR when Tower Reilloch was attacked . He died protecting a vault in the Tower known as Nandiyerron ' s Armory .

title: Philip Athans
description: Philip Athans Philip Athans was born in 1964 in Rochester , New York , but was raised in Chicago . He is Managing Editor for Wizards of the Coast Book Publishing , and wrote some of the first " Forgotten Realms " books , as well as many others like " Lies of Light " in 2006 and " Realms of War " coming up in 2008 . He is well - known for writing the novelizations of the computer games , Baldur ' s Gate and .
description_long: Philip Athans Philip Athans was born in 1964 in Rochester , New York , but was raised in Chicago . He is Managing Editor for Wizards of the Coast Book Publishing , and wrote some of the first " Forgotten Realms " books , as well as many others like " Lies of Light " in 2006 and " Realms of War " coming up in 2008 . He is well - known for writing the novelizations of the computer games , Baldur ' s Gate and . Background . Athans grew up reading comics and magazines , and watching . He graduated from film school in 1985 and began circulating his own literary magazine called " Alternative Fiction & Poetry " . Career . Although Athans used to work in a record store while working on his writing career in his spare time , he was taken on in the book publising department of TSR in 1995 , and survived the transition to Wizards of the Coast . In 1997 became Managing Editor for Wizards of the Coast Book Publishing , where he ’ s spent most of his time as the Forgotten Realms novel line editor . There he has edited dozens of anthologies and novels , and continues to write his own . His most recent works are the two novels in the Watercourse trilogy .

title: Philter of drunkenness
description: Philter of drunkenness A philter of drunkenness was a magical potion that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .
description_long: Philter of drunkenness A philter of drunkenness was a magical potion that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax . These flasks were wider and the bottom than they were at the top . Powers . This potion caused extreme inebriation immediately after consumption . The period of drunkenness lasted for 6 hours , and was followed by a terrible hangover that lasted for another 3 hours .

title: Phindar streeaka
description: Phindar streeaka Phindar streeaka , meaning " mindless recklessness " , was counted among the drow fighting styles but wasn ' t truly a technique . It was a catch - all phrase to describe berserker - like combat , and it lacked any kind of underlying order in its approach to combat . Description .
description_long: Phindar streeaka Phindar streeaka , meaning " mindless recklessness " , was counted among the drow fighting styles but wasn ' t truly a technique . It was a catch - all phrase to describe berserker - like combat , and it lacked any kind of underlying order in its approach to combat . Description . As the name " mindless recklessness " suggested , the fighting " style " was about mindless violence . Being used by berserkers , it lacked the concept of finesse , and all " skills " they used had nothing to do with intellectual combat theory but everything to do with brute force . This made some moves of the " phindar streeaka " " style " similar to the " z ' ress a ' thalak " style but unlike the former the latter was a product of real combat training . Training . The style was used by drow berserkers . They didn ' t train in anything in particular . Reputation . The " style " was used by the few berserkers in drow society and it was unpopular , because of its complete lack of finesse and its utter chaos was considered something of an welcome mirror on the true face of drow society as a whole .

title: Phlan
description: Phlan Phlan was a large town located on the northern shoreline of the Moonsea at the mouth of the Stojanow river . Founded over 1 , 000 years ago , a series of destruction and rebuilding led to the city being walled off into a destroyed , ruined Old Phlan and a rebuilt , shining Civilized Phlan . Phlan was noteworthy not only for its stubbornness but also as the location of the fabled Pool of Radiance , which was the source of power for the otherworldy Tyranthraxus .
description_long: Phlan Phlan was a large town located on the northern shoreline of the Moonsea at the mouth of the Stojanow river . Founded over 1 , 000 years ago , a series of destruction and rebuilding led to the city being walled off into a destroyed , ruined Old Phlan and a rebuilt , shining Civilized Phlan . Phlan was noteworthy not only for its stubbornness but also as the location of the fabled Pool of Radiance , which was the source of power for the otherworldy Tyranthraxus . The town is currently rebuilding from the devastating Dragon Run of 1306 DR and was growing even more popular as a stop for caravans and ships with recent troubles with Hillsfar , and adventuring was encouraged through the crumbling ruins of Old Phlan . Local points of interest included the ruins of Valjevo Castle , once one of the largest castles in Faerûn . Rather than rebuilding the castle , a group of druids were instead attempting to recultivate the courtyard . The only temple in the city was called the Waiting , which was dedicated to Tyr . History . Phlan was founded in 367 DR as a trading outpost between the elves of Myth Drannor and the dwarves of the Dragonspine Mountains .

title: Phlogiston
description: Phlogiston Phlogiston is the name given to the space between the crystal sphere s of the Prime Material Plane . Bizarre creatures inhabit it and prey on spelljammer s traveling between spheres . In the Spelljammer setting , there is a celestial configuration known as the Triad , which consists of Realmspace , in which the world Toril is located ; Greyspace , where the world of Oerth is found ; and Krynnspace , home of the world of Krynn and the " Dragonlance " campaign setting .
description_long: Phlogiston Phlogiston is the name given to the space between the crystal sphere s of the Prime Material Plane . Bizarre creatures inhabit it and prey on spelljammer s traveling between spheres . In the Spelljammer setting , there is a celestial configuration known as the Triad , which consists of Realmspace , in which the world Toril is located ; Greyspace , where the world of Oerth is found ; and Krynnspace , home of the world of Krynn and the " Dragonlance " campaign setting . The Phlogiston , a rainbow - colored chaotic liquid that surrounds the spheres , has a strong current that flows from Realmspace directly toward Greyspace , making travel in that direction relatively simple ; due to this current , it is impossible to travel directly to Krynnspace from Realmspace . From Greyspace , however , it is a relatively simple matter to travel to either Realmspace or Krynnspace , strong currents leading to both spheres . From Krynnspace one can easily move to Realmspace , but travel directly to Greyspace from Krynnspace is impossible .

title: Phoenix clan
description: Phoenix clan The Phoenix clan was a ninja clan and an ally of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . Despite not being as efficiently as the Hijo clan , the Phoenix were more obscure and secretive , not telling anyone the true name of their clan or the location of their headquarters . Their leader was a mysterious woman called the Serpent ; all other members of the clan had met at least once but could not identify her .
description_long: Phoenix clan The Phoenix clan was a ninja clan and an ally of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . Despite not being as efficiently as the Hijo clan , the Phoenix were more obscure and secretive , not telling anyone the true name of their clan or the location of their headquarters . Their leader was a mysterious woman called the Serpent ; all other members of the clan had met at least once but could not identify her . Circa 1257 DR , the Phoenix decided to ally with the Goshukara to prosper but their mutual ties were not so strong . Their recruitment policy was usually to have an older member sponsor a promising young person , who then disappeared from public life and was trained under their new " father " until , after their so - called father ' s death , they inherited his position .

title: Phourkyn One - Eye
description: Phourkyn One - Eye Phourkyn One - Eye was a sunwyrm posing as a human wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . The wizard Firefingers believed that there had once been a real Phourkyn One - Eye until the sunwyrm killed him and took his place . History .
description_long: Phourkyn One - Eye Phourkyn One - Eye was a sunwyrm posing as a human wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . The wizard Firefingers believed that there had once been a real Phourkyn One - Eye until the sunwyrm killed him and took his place . History . In 1373 DR , posing as Phourkyn , the sunwyrm infiltrated a cabal of humanoid wizards in Thentia who were studying the " Dracorage mythal " . He tried to disrupt their research using all means and regularly informed Sammaster of their progress . After the avariel Taegan Nightwind correctly inferred that the wizards ' draconic ally , Samdralyrion , attacked them not just because of the Rage but because one of their number was a traitor , Phourkyn decided to adopt a more active approach to kill the wizards . He summoned a chasme , binding it to him to increase not on his own strength but that of the demon as well , and sent it to kill the other wizards . When Taegan and the faerie dragon Jivex intervened to defend them , Phourkyn initially tried to use the Chasme to lead them to suspect other wizards of being the traitor .

title: Phsant
description: Phsant Phsant was a large city of 30 , 000 inhabitants ( as of 1479 DR ) in Thesk . Phsant sat along the Golden Way . It was the site of the defeat of the Tuigan Horde and had a large orc population .
description_long: Phsant Phsant was a large city of 30 , 000 inhabitants ( as of 1479 DR ) in Thesk . Phsant sat along the Golden Way . It was the site of the defeat of the Tuigan Horde and had a large orc population . The orcs formed part of the army that defeated the Horde and were accepted members of the populace , having taken jobs as miners , farmers , guards , and mercenaries . The high population of orcs attracted half - orc women who sought a more civilized lifestyle than that available in an orc settlement .

title: Phthta Thak
description: Phthta Thak Phthta Thak ( pronounced " fith - ta thak " ) was a necromancer and inhabitant of the Battle of Bones . Personality . Phthta was a loner and a recluse , wishing nothing more than to be left alone to her work .
description_long: Phthta Thak Phthta Thak ( pronounced " fith - ta thak " ) was a necromancer and inhabitant of the Battle of Bones . Personality . Phthta was a loner and a recluse , wishing nothing more than to be left alone to her work . Numerous traps and undead guarded her underground lair , which was located in the western mountains of the region . Abilities . She wielded considerable necromantic magic as well as many protective and charming spell s . Possessions . She was known to carry a " ring of polymorph self " , a " ring of fire resistance " , a " wand of animate dead " , a " gem of true seeing " , and " boots of climbing " . Her familiar was an undead cat named Bones . Activities . Phthta ' s sole interest was in training her undead charges to work together so they could protect themselves from their natural enemies . She dealt mostly with ju - ju zombie s .

title: Phulir
description: Phulir Phulir was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Phulir was a rather normal - looking individual .
description_long: Phulir Phulir was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Phulir was a rather normal - looking individual . Personality . Phulir was often underestimated by his opponents because of his nondescript appearance , a fact from which Phulir gained advantage . History . Phulir was a old ally of Bramas Thorntree like all in the company . In 1370 DR , he joined the Company , and together they recovered the " Sondarr Scepter " from a long - forgotten dwarven tomb in the Starspire Mountains . They had been ordered to maintain a low profile and , on their return journey on Uktar 10 , stopped at the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth for drink . Later that night , three dwarves , Bapar Ghalmrin , Odak Truesteel , and Soram Battlebellow , entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " . However , the dwarves accidentally engaged in a brawl with the Shields of the Highland adventuring company . Phulir and the others in the Company covered for Bramas and joined in the brawl , so that he could use this as an opportunity to escape with the " scepter " , but the dwarves eventually caught up with him and recovered it .

title: Phultan Hammerwand
description: Phultan Hammerwand Phultan Hammerwand was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Quite peculiar for a vampire lord , Phultan ' s diet of blood had changed his previously corpulent physique to one of sagging flesh .
description_long: Phultan Hammerwand Phultan Hammerwand was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Quite peculiar for a vampire lord , Phultan ' s diet of blood had changed his previously corpulent physique to one of sagging flesh . Lank and patchy reddish - brown hair hung from the back of his head . By 1480 DR , Phultan was horrific looking ; decades without feeding had left him with lesions all over his body . History . In life , Phultan was a silver - tongued fence and information dealer , making his way under the cover of a merchant trader of luxuries . Forming contacts all across the Heartlands , he cultivated an ever - growing web of traded information . However , during one of Phultan ' s many trips to Westgate , he stumbled across information that was highly sensitive regarding a lieutenant of the Night Masks . Hunted by Dahlia Vhammos , the Duchess of Venom , it was only Phultan ' s information - gathering skills that saved him as he managed to learn the correct way of contacting the Night King himself .

title: Phylactery
description: Phylactery A phylactery was a term for a charm or amulet , or repository used to store small parchments bearing holy scripture or arcane writings . Lich ' s phylactery . A magic phylactery was used to store the souls and life force of lich es .
description_long: Phylactery A phylactery was a term for a charm or amulet , or repository used to store small parchments bearing holy scripture or arcane writings . Lich ' s phylactery . A magic phylactery was used to store the souls and life force of lich es . A mage had to create such a phylactery in order to become a lich , a highly expensive and taxing effort . Typically , a phylactery was a sealed metal box containing strips of parchment on which arcane phrases were inscribed . However , a phylactery could be any number of things , such as a ring or amulet . If its physical body was destroyed , a lich could regenerate where its phylactery was located over a matter of days . However , if the phylactery itself was destroyed , then the lich could not regenerate and would remained destroyed . For this reason , liches sought to guard their phylacteries powerfully against any attack .

title: Phylactery of bravery
description: Phylactery of bravery The phylactery of bravery was a magic item of Najm , the Zakharan goddess of adventure . Description . The phylactery was actually a gold - trimmed armband made from parchment inscribed with arcane metallic runes .
description_long: Phylactery of bravery The phylactery of bravery was a magic item of Najm , the Zakharan goddess of adventure . Description . The phylactery was actually a gold - trimmed armband made from parchment inscribed with arcane metallic runes . Powers . While wearing the phylactery and invoking the name of Najm , the wearer was infused with the goddess ' might , granting them supernatural valor and making it easier for them to strike down their foes during combat . Additionally , any emotion - based spells such as " fear " were less likely to succeed against them .

title: Phylactery of faithfulness
description: Phylactery of faithfulness A phylactery of faithfulness was a useful item for divine spellcaster s , in that it enabled the wearer to foresee how their actions would affect their connection to their deity . Appearance . A " phylactery of faithfulness " was a small black box containing religious scripture , tied around the forehead by a leather cord .
description_long: Phylactery of faithfulness A phylactery of faithfulness was a useful item for divine spellcaster s , in that it enabled the wearer to foresee how their actions would affect their connection to their deity . Appearance . A " phylactery of faithfulness " was a small black box containing religious scripture , tied around the forehead by a leather cord . There was no way to determine precisely what function it performed until it was worn . Creation . Despite their usefulness , " phylacteries of faithfulness " were among the simplest and cheapest magic items to manufacture , available to virtually any divine magic spellcaster who could create wondrous items . To create a " phylactery of faithfulness " , the creator must cast " detect evil " , " detect good " , " detect law " , and ' detect chaos " during the process . Activation . If the wearer of a " phylactery of faithfulness " took a moment to contemplate an action or item that may adversely affect his or her alignment and / or standing with their deity , he or she became fully aware of the consequences before performing the action .

title: Phylactery of righteousness
description: Phylactery of righteousness Phylacteries of righteousness were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Phylactery of righteousness Phylacteries of righteousness were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description . A phylactery of righteousness was actually a collection of sacred writings that were worn on the user ' s arm . Powers . This item provided heightened combat skills against the " Unenlightened " or anyone who had offended the user ' s god .

title: Phylo
description: Phylo Phylo was the original myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Phylo " ruled " the Neverlight Grove alone for a long time .
description_long: Phylo Phylo was the original myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Phylo " ruled " the Neverlight Grove alone for a long time . When the sovereign Basidia and its two circles arrived in the Grove , Phylo was happy to have someone to share the burdens of leadership with . When , two years later , with the Rage of Demons , Zuggtmoy arrived in the Grove , she understood that the best strategy was to first corrupt Phylo and in order to gain control of the whole community . Phylo was easily corrupted and started a subtle ideological war during the daily melding to convert all circle leaders to Zuggtmoy . Step by step , most of the myconids succumbed to madness ; only Basidia and its followers resisted . Personality . Crazed , Phylo dreamed all day about a mushroom paradise . It became enthralled by the promise of plentiful soil and moisture , perpetual rot , and beautiful transcendent dreams to be shared in a neverending communal melding — all offered to the grove ' s folk as generous and wondrous gifts from the Lady of Decay . Relationship . Since its arrival , Phylo was best friends with Basidia until the arrival of Zuggtmoy .

title: Phyvvak
description: Phyvvak Phyvvak was an ixilthetocal ruler of history in Seros . History . Born in 1107 DR , Phyvvak ascended to the position of vitanar in 1185 DR .
description_long: Phyvvak Phyvvak was an ixilthetocal ruler of history in Seros . History . Born in 1107 DR , Phyvvak ascended to the position of vitanar in 1185 DR . During his rule , he unleashed many crusades against the other races , claiming the lives of 200 , 000 merfolk , 2 , 000 aquatic elves , and nearly 1 , 000 , 000 koalinth but at the price of 500 , 000 of his own subjects . He was the most dogmatic vitanar of all the Xedran Reefs .

title: Pick
description: Pick A pick , also known as a pickax or pickaxe is a hand tool for digging and breaking up hard or rocky ground . They range in size from about one to four feet ( 30cm to 120cm ) long with a perpendicularly mounted striking head . The head has a sharp spike on one side and the other side may be a chisel , hammer , or another spike .
description_long: Pick A pick , also known as a pickax or pickaxe is a hand tool for digging and breaking up hard or rocky ground . They range in size from about one to four feet ( 30cm to 120cm ) long with a perpendicularly mounted striking head . The head has a sharp spike on one side and the other side may be a chisel , hammer , or another spike . The spike may be slightly curved toward the haft . Primitive picks have only the one spike . The haft is usually made of stout wood but can also be crafted from metal or bone . As with most tools , the pick was adapted for war and often combined with a hammer head on the back . The heavy spike could pierce plate mail , often too well , becoming stuck in the target . Picks intended for use as weapons are :

title: Pick and Lantern
description: Pick and Lantern The Pick and Lantern was a successful tavern in the Venter section of Skullport . The proprietor was a dwarf known as Wilgold Gunderbradt who also owned a flophouse behind the tavern . The tavern welcomed sailors and miners and was known for the collection of maps of Undermountain that adorned its walls .
description_long: Pick and Lantern The Pick and Lantern was a successful tavern in the Venter section of Skullport . The proprietor was a dwarf known as Wilgold Gunderbradt who also owned a flophouse behind the tavern . The tavern welcomed sailors and miners and was known for the collection of maps of Undermountain that adorned its walls . Description . A ship lantern and miner ' s pick were painted on the side of the building .

title: Pick and Shovel Corps
description: Pick and Shovel Corps The Pick and Shovel Corps was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 3 , 500 slaves and gladiators made - up this organization .
description_long: Pick and Shovel Corps The Pick and Shovel Corps was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 3 , 500 slaves and gladiators made - up this organization . The gladiators were typically freed after performing above and beyond their station . Activities . Derro served as the " picks " and dwarves formed the shovel . Both groups wanted to create their own separate communities , but the dao kept them dependent on their generosity for food and tools . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Pien - Hung
description: Pien - Hung Pien - Hung was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pien - Hung was a traveling shukenja who fell sick and asked for hospitality at the Shrine of the Setting Sun and remained there for a while .
description_long: Pien - Hung Pien - Hung was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pien - Hung was a traveling shukenja who fell sick and asked for hospitality at the Shrine of the Setting Sun and remained there for a while . Personality . Pien - Hung returned to robust health thanks to the local sea air and peaceful surroundings . He was a quiet and respectful individual , emanating an aura of cheer and good nature .

title: Piergeiron the Paladinson
description: Piergeiron the Paladinson Piergeiron the Paladinson was the Open Lord of Waterdeep throughout most of the 1300s DR and leader of the Lords ' Alliance . He lived in Piergeiron ' s Palace in Waterdeep . Usually , the identities of the Lords of Waterdeep are concealed from the people , but Piergeiron was one of only four whose identities were known , the others being Ahghairon , Baeron , and Lhestyn .
description_long: Piergeiron the Paladinson Piergeiron the Paladinson was the Open Lord of Waterdeep throughout most of the 1300s DR and leader of the Lords ' Alliance . He lived in Piergeiron ' s Palace in Waterdeep . Usually , the identities of the Lords of Waterdeep are concealed from the people , but Piergeiron was one of only four whose identities were known , the others being Ahghairon , Baeron , and Lhestyn . Piergeiron was personally guarded by Madeiron Sunderstone . Appearance . Piergeiron was tall , muscular and handsome with slightly greying hair . Personality . Piergeiron did not speak very often and when he did , he spoke very slowly . This had led to some of those around him nicknaming him " the Thickskull , " although never in his presence . Relatives . Piergerion ' s father Athar , " the Shining Knight , " was famed for slaying the great red wyrm Kistarianth the Red . Decades later , during Halaster ' s Higharvestide , Piergeiron would slay Kistarianth himself when the dragon rose again as a dracolich . Piergeiron was married to Maethiira , but she died in 1344 DR , leaving him with one daughter , Aleena Paladinstar , who left Waterdeep to explore the planes . Background .

title: Pieron Ramdon
description: Pieron Ramdon Pieron Ramdon was a Lords ' Alliance ' s agent in Mulmaster . History . Pieron was a soldier in Cormyr until he decided to go to the Moonsea in search of a better fortune .
description_long: Pieron Ramdon Pieron Ramdon was a Lords ' Alliance ' s agent in Mulmaster . History . Pieron was a soldier in Cormyr until he decided to go to the Moonsea in search of a better fortune . In 1491 DR , he was possibly involved in the case of the burning of Elmwood . Appendix . Behind the Scenes . Pieron would appear only if Zora Rosealine Culkin is killed during the adventure , becoming a new patron for the players .

title: Pierson
description: Pierson Pierson was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pierson was one of the members of West Harbor militia .
description_long: Pierson Pierson was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pierson was one of the members of West Harbor militia . He was a reluctant friend of thieves , since he kept goods he collected over the years . During the battle against duergar and githyanki , Pierson could ' ve been asked to join the attack . Regardless , he was killed in the battle .

title: Pierson ' s home
description: Pierson ' s home Pierson ' s home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Pierson . Location .
description_long: Pierson ' s home Pierson ' s home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Pierson . Location . Located in near the center of the village , Pierson ' s home was located next to Tarmas ' home . Structure . Like the other houses in West Harbor , Pierson ' s home was wooden . Interior . The building was small . It was composed of a single room , with barrels , a bed , and a drawer . History . Pierson lived in this house . When duergar and bladeling s attacked the village in 1374 DR , Pierson locked himself in the house , afraid someone would steal his supplies . The Kalach - Cha was able to intimidate him , lie to him , pick the lock , or bash the door to get in . In any case , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve ordered him to get into the fight , since he was a member of the militia . After Pierson went to the field , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve looted his house or leave the supplies .

title: Pigeon Rock Oasis
description: Pigeon Rock Oasis Pigeon Rock Oasis was located in the Hordelands . Description . Located just west of the northern Quoya Desert , this small oasis got its name from the nearby outcropping of rock used to identify it .
description_long: Pigeon Rock Oasis Pigeon Rock Oasis was located in the Hordelands . Description . Located just west of the northern Quoya Desert , this small oasis got its name from the nearby outcropping of rock used to identify it . This rock was home to a great number of pigeons , who had carved a large number of nests into the rough surface over the years . This oasis was seldom used . The lack of shade from the hot sun , the salty water , and the dry air from the desert , all made the oasis a poor stop , and prevented people from building any sort of business nearby . Rumors and Legends . Killing the pigeons was considered bad luck .

title: Pikar Salibuck
description: Pikar Salibuck Pikar Salibuck was a halfling apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , he was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush . History .
description_long: Pikar Salibuck Pikar Salibuck was a halfling apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , he was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush . History . Pikar ' s father died while working for Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , so in recognition of this , Khelben took Pikar on as an apprentice . During the attack on the tower , Pikar pulled the stricken Khelben out of the gates of the tower and onto the street in attempt to get him to safety , and was seriously injured in doing so .

title: Pike
description: Pike Pike was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Pike was the personal servant of Shoalar Quanderil .
description_long: Pike Pike was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Pike was the personal servant of Shoalar Quanderil . History . In 1491 DR , like his master , Pike was transferred to the Dessarin Valley , where they were involved in an assault on the Mirabar diplomatic delegation . However , at Ironford bridge , they were confronted and defeated by some adventurers hired to find the delegation .

title: Pikel Bouldershoulder
description: Pikel Bouldershoulder Pikel Bouldershoulder is a dwarven druid of Mielikki and brother of Ivan Bouldershoulder . Description . Pikel has a dyed green beard with a middle parting that is drawn back over his ears to join his long hair at his back in a braid .
description_long: Pikel Bouldershoulder Pikel Bouldershoulder is a dwarven druid of Mielikki and brother of Ivan Bouldershoulder . Description . Pikel has a dyed green beard with a middle parting that is drawn back over his ears to join his long hair at his back in a braid . He wears sandals instead of the traditional boots most dwarves wear , and long green robes with large long sleeves . Equipment . Pikel wears his cooking pot as a helm in times of combat . His weapon of choice is a massive club he calls a sha - la - la or shillelagh . A specially enchanted wooden club used by druids . The club is referred to by his brother Ivan as " his tree " . Personality . Although Pikel has the ability to talk to animals , he has difficulty being understood by anyone of intelligent tongues and he tends to speak in a language of noises and exclamations rather than formulating complete sentences ( e . g . " Oo Oi " followed by a fist punching in the air ) . Only his brother Ivan can really understand what he is trying to say . In fact , whenever Ivan refers to Pikel has " me brother " , Pikel will put an arm around Ivan and echo " Me Brudder " .

title: Pil ' it ' ith
description: Pil ' it ' ith Pil ' it ' ith was the sarrukh former Chosen of Sseth . History . Pil ' it ' ith was a very unusual albino sarrukh that was the last emperor of Okoth .
description_long: Pil ' it ' ith Pil ' it ' ith was the sarrukh former Chosen of Sseth . History . Pil ' it ' ith was a very unusual albino sarrukh that was the last emperor of Okoth . He remained the leader of his race also after the fall of Okoth . While in Outer Planes Pil ' it ' ith managed to find his creator god Merrshaulk that impressed under Pil ' it ' ith himself request choose the albino as his Chosen . For a time Pil ' it ' ith lead his people wandering the planes in search of a right place to settle but only gained the enmity of the khaasta s so they went back to Okoth . There a crisis arisen when started the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and Sseth stopped answering sarrukh ' s prayers . So Pil ' it ' ith decided to replace Sseth with the Mulhorandi pantheon god Set . Set agreed to become the new god of sarrukh but in 1359 DR the god asked the sarrukh ' s help to bind Sseth into eternal slumber . Sseth tried to resist but the only actions he managed to do was strip Pil ' it ' ith of his Chosen ' s status . So the albino started to aged again , despite being one of the oldest sarrukh alive . He remained the leader of his tribe and planned to one day regain his old power .

title: Pilgrims ' District
description: Pilgrims ' District The Pilgrims ' District was one of the wards of Huzuz , the City of Delights . , in 1367 DR . Description .
description_long: Pilgrims ' District The Pilgrims ' District was one of the wards of Huzuz , the City of Delights . , in 1367 DR . Description . Found in the People ' s Quarter , the Pilgrims ' District was the most diverse of all the wards of Huzuz . Travelers staying here could rent anything from simple tents to grand palatial manors . Most notably , the Pilgrims ' District housed all of the great mosques of Huzuz , including the Golden Mosque . The Pilgrims ' District was located in the very heart of Huzuz . It was surrounded by the Central District to the west , the South District to the south , the Court District to the east , and the Craft District to the northeast . This district could be accessed directly by the Pilgrims ' Route , the Merchants ' Avenue , the Street of the Ajami , the Street of the Inns , the Ghost ' s Route , the Grand Bazaar Boulevard , and the Enlightened Way . Activities . The main focus of the Pilgrims ' District was to house the thousands of travelers who visited Huzuz every year on religious pilgrimages . A wide variety of shops could be found catering to the many needs of the pilgrims .

title: Pilgrims ' Gate
description: Pilgrims ' Gate The Pilgrims ' Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The gate was located along the edge of the south central region of the city .
description_long: Pilgrims ' Gate The Pilgrims ' Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The gate was located along the edge of the south central region of the city . Travelers through this gate were rewarded with a fantastic view of the Golden Mosque . This huge arch was locked by massive iron bars . These iron bars were decorated with a thin layer of gold , exemplifying the splendor of Huzuz to anyone who entered the city . Smaller wooden gates were seated within the archway . History . The Pilgrims ' Gate provided immediate access to the South District and Affluent District . Activities . All caravans passing through this gate were searched by guards . Travelers of every type were allowed unbarred passage into the city . The gatekeepers were notorious for their ability to spot smugglers masquerading as pilgrims . They also took great honor and pride in their work , arresting anyone who attempted to make bribes . The Pilgrims ' Gate closed every night at sunset , though admittance to the city was available to those who called out to the guards . Travelers allowed into Huzuz after the gates closed were given closer scrutiny .

title: Pilgrims ' Route
description: Pilgrims ' Route The Pilgrims ' Route was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Travelers departing Huzuz along the Pilgrims ' Route exited the golden city through the Pilgrims ' Gate before heading south .
description_long: Pilgrims ' Route The Pilgrims ' Route was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Travelers departing Huzuz along the Pilgrims ' Route exited the golden city through the Pilgrims ' Gate before heading south . After passing the Shrine of the Brave , travelers followed the southern curvature of Al - Akara Mountains toward Zayir in the east . Another 150 miles ( 240 km ) brought them to the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann , at which point travelers moved south for 200 miles ( 320 km ) toward Hilm situated on Al - Muti River and the other Cities of the Pantheon . History . The name of this route was derived from the bountiful supply of pilgrims traveling from the Cities of the Pantheon toward Huzuz . Since it was used more by pilgrims than caravans , the chance of encountering bandits or raiders along this route was significantly less compared to other trade routes found throughout the Land of Fate .

title: Pillar of Skulls
description: Pillar of Skulls The Pillar of Skulls was a landmark in the plane of Avernus , the first layer of the Nine Hells . It contained the skulls of victims of the Blood War , taken as trophies by the devil s . The Pillar towered over a mile ( over 1 .
description_long: Pillar of Skulls The Pillar of Skulls was a landmark in the plane of Avernus , the first layer of the Nine Hells . It contained the skulls of victims of the Blood War , taken as trophies by the devil s . The Pillar towered over a mile ( over 1 . 6 km ) into the sky of Avernus . It comprised a wide variety of skulls , ranging from the tiny to the size of a house . The majority , however , were of demon s , the enemy of the devils . It stood by the ledge around the layer of Avernus , near a low point where access to the next layer down , Dis , was possible via an exceptionally tall spire in that city . Near the base of the Pillar of Skulls was a huge cave mouth , in which laired the dragon - goddess Tiamat , who guarded passage between the layers here .

title: Pillar of sand
description: Pillar of sand Pillar of sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a pillar of sand that rose into the air , carrying any target into the sky .
description_long: Pillar of sand Pillar of sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a pillar of sand that rose into the air , carrying any target into the sky . This spell would only work in a sandy region . The top of the pillar was a 10 foot ( 3 m ) circle centered on the target . The caster could make the pillar rise as high as the available sand would allow by volume based on the caster ' s power . The pillar could be attacked and destroyed by normal or magical means , collapsing it instantly in the case of destruction . The caster could collapse the pillar at any time . Components . This spell required enough nearby sand to create the pillar in order to cast .

title: Pillars of Woe
description: Pillars of Woe The Pillars of Woe was a cavern and gorge located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Pillars of Woe was located not far south of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Pillars of Woe The Pillars of Woe was a cavern and gorge located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Pillars of Woe was located not far south of Menzoberranzan . It was located 25 miles north of Rhazzt ' s Dilemma and some 20 miles from the Lustrum mine . Description . The Pillars of Woe was a cavern half a mile across with its ceiling a few hundred feet high . There were shelflike caverns on each side and many columns supporting the roof . In the center was a gorge that narrowed between two large columns . History . Battle of the Pillars of Woe . In 1372 DR , the Menzoberranyr Army of the Black Spider and the duergar armies of Gracklstugh ( under the command of Horgar Steelshadow and the aid of Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin ) fought their first battle at the Pillars of Woe . It turned out to be an ambush ; the duergar were already there when the drow arrived , as was the tanarukk army of Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion , which turned on the drow . At the beginning of the battle , the contingent of House Agrach Dyrr also turned against their fellows .

title: Pilot Demitrick
description: Pilot Demitrick Pilot Demitrick was a warrior from Targos who traveled the North , finding work as a guide , hunter , sage and all - round mercenary . He became a renowned guide within the northern territories , leading adventurers and the like into the more dangerous regions of the Savage Frontier . Background .
description_long: Pilot Demitrick Pilot Demitrick was a warrior from Targos who traveled the North , finding work as a guide , hunter , sage and all - round mercenary . He became a renowned guide within the northern territories , leading adventurers and the like into the more dangerous regions of the Savage Frontier . Background . Pilot was born in the fishing village of Targos to a family of fishers whose catches were shipped as far south as Triboar and Leilon . During the Battle of Icewind Dale , the forces of Akar Kessel encircled and seized the town of Targos , leaving many of the inhabitants with nothing better to do but hide . A few small bands of warriors and hunters fought back though , of which Pilot ' s father was a member . After completing a few successful attacks on their oppressors , the town ' s defenders were stopped when Pilot ' s mother was taken hostage and his father was forced to surrender . They were both killed as an example to the town , leaving Pilot orphaned .

title: Pine
description: Pine The pine is common in Faerûn , especially in the north , but also exists on other parts of Abeir - Toril . It grows in places such as the southern slopes of the Spine of the World and in the Vordrorn Forest . Variations .
description_long: Pine The pine is common in Faerûn , especially in the north , but also exists on other parts of Abeir - Toril . It grows in places such as the southern slopes of the Spine of the World and in the Vordrorn Forest . Variations . Blueridge . The blueridge pine can be found in the sandy soil of the Rimwood on the outskirts of the Cormanthor forest . Needleleaf . The needleleaf pine can be found in the sandy soil of the Rimwood on the outskirts of the Cormanthor forest . Pinyon . The pinyon pine grows in the Pasocada Basin area of Maztica where it is eaten by the Azuposi . Ponderosa . One of the largest pine species , the ponderosa is prominent in part of the Savage Frontier . Roseneedle . Roseneedle pines grow along the banks of the River Ashaba and rarely grow more than 3 ' ( 0 . 9m ) tall . The roots of the tree can extend to over 10 ' ( 3m ) in depth , with their ends forming tubers that are shaped roughly like potatoes and make excellent fishing bait . Each needle on the tree has a pink or white rose - like blossom . White . The stately white pine is present in the Savage Frontier and the Cloak Wood .

title: Pingtu
description: Pingtu Pingtu was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Pingtu was briefly an acolyte priest under high priest Bendekik before 1371 DR .
description_long: Pingtu Pingtu was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Pingtu was briefly an acolyte priest under high priest Bendekik before 1371 DR . Pingtu escaped the drow attack of that year . In 1479 DR , Pingtu was back in the city and was the new head priest . However , when he tried a divination ritual , Pingtu heard the voice of his dead master . With help of an adventuring party hired by Kargien Dissengulp , he followed his master ' s instructions in order to end a curse Bendekik had triggered in 1371 DR .

title: Pinochet
description: Pinochet Pinochet was a powerful male human pirate on the Sword Coast . In 1356 DR , he and his fleet , acting on the orders of Pasha Pook , attacked the " Sea Sprite " belonging to Captain Deudermont to stop the Companions of the Hall from arriving in Calimport . Thanks to Drizzt Do ' Urden and his friends , Pinochet ' s pirates were defeated and Pinochet was captured .
description_long: Pinochet Pinochet was a powerful male human pirate on the Sword Coast . In 1356 DR , he and his fleet , acting on the orders of Pasha Pook , attacked the " Sea Sprite " belonging to Captain Deudermont to stop the Companions of the Hall from arriving in Calimport . Thanks to Drizzt Do ' Urden and his friends , Pinochet ' s pirates were defeated and Pinochet was captured . Later , Pinochet was released after promising give up the pirate life and it seemed that he kept his promise .

title: Piper
description: Piper Piper was a self - proclaimed prophet residing in Hilltop . He would constantly rant about prophecies that never seemed to come true — causing a great deal of stress to Mayor Veraunt Shuttlescomb and the village guards . In 1372 DR , when Hol Halstrom called Piper a fool for claiming that death was coming to Hilltop , Piper was angered by this and proclaimed that Hol would die within the week .
description_long: Piper Piper was a self - proclaimed prophet residing in Hilltop . He would constantly rant about prophecies that never seemed to come true — causing a great deal of stress to Mayor Veraunt Shuttlescomb and the village guards . In 1372 DR , when Hol Halstrom called Piper a fool for claiming that death was coming to Hilltop , Piper was angered by this and proclaimed that Hol would die within the week . Halstrom turned up dead on the outskirts of the village just a few days later , nearly decapitated . Piper discovered Halstrom ' s body and added several wounds to the corpse , hoping to attract followers by claiming Hol ' s death was the cause of a new , unnamed god . In the wake of this and a kobold attack on Hilltop shortly after Halstrom ' s death , Piper attracted a small following and spread fear among the populace of the Hilltop . Appendix . Behind the scenes . In the computer game " " , the player can receive a quest to get rid of Piper from Haniah Dales . Among the many methods of disposing of him , the player may convince Piper to travel to either Neverwinter , Silverymoon , or Waterdeep .

title: Pipestone
description: Pipestone Pipestone , was also known as . Description . Pipestone was a soft stone , easily carved .
description_long: Pipestone Pipestone , was also known as . Description . Pipestone was a soft stone , easily carved . It occurred in colors from brown to red . A typical stone was priced at 1 gp per pound ( 4 sp 5cp per kilogram ) . Powers . Wizard spells that required some type of wood as a material component could use pipestone instead . This did not work for divine spells .

title: Pirate Isles
description: Pirate Isles The Pirate Isles were a collection of rocky islands that dotted the Sea of Fallen Stars and were inhabited by pirates . There were fifteen named islands but around sixty in total . The islands that comprised Prespur were not included in the Pirate Isles , despite their proximity .
description_long: Pirate Isles The Pirate Isles were a collection of rocky islands that dotted the Sea of Fallen Stars and were inhabited by pirates . There were fifteen named islands but around sixty in total . The islands that comprised Prespur were not included in the Pirate Isles , despite their proximity . Geography . The general makeup of the islands was mountainous terrain with high rocky cliffs . This meant that there were not a lot of ports in the Pirate Isles . As of 1479 DR , due to the continued shrinking of the Sea of Fallen Stars in the century after the Spellplague , most of the Pirate Isles had become a single large island named Pirate Isle .

title: Piri
description: Piri Piri was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Piri was an apprentice in the College of Mages of his city , known for his skill in piecing together arcane texts .
description_long: Piri Piri was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Piri was an apprentice in the College of Mages of his city , known for his skill in piecing together arcane texts . He was an acolyte of the skin . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn invited him to his new College of Ancient Arcana . There , Piri unlocked an ancient Ritual of Bonding and bonded himself with a quasit , Glizn . However , Piri tried to betray Q ' arlynd just before the casting of the elven high magic spell that erased Kiaransalee from everyone ' s minds . Q ' arlynd killed him and afterward resurrected him . Q ' arlynd used the kiira of Kraanfhaor ' s Door to remove Piri ' s disloyalty from his mind . In 1379 DR , however , Piri started to act strange , worrying Q ' arlynd . He started a magic duel with his fellow Eldrinn Elpragh . He summoned a deepspawn of the Breeder ' s Guild against Eldrinn before being knocked out . Later Master Q ' arlynd arrived and defeated the monster . Later , Q ' arlynd discovered that the quasit bonded with Piri had manipulated him to kill Eldrinn to remove a possible rival . Q ' arlynd cast a spell to send the demon back to the [ [ Abyss ] , but Piri ' s body also disappeared .

title: Pirithin Alagost
description: Pirithin Alagost Pirithin Alagost was a halfling man and a thief . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Activities .
description_long: Pirithin Alagost Pirithin Alagost was a halfling man and a thief . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Activities . Pirithin and the dukes grew increasingly wealthy and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . In all decisions on major policies , Pirithin had one vote while Bellas had two . Pirithin and the Dukes often confiscated property and magic from visitors , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power . They acquired a large collection of magical item s this way , and still sought more . Pirithin lived in a palatial house close to the Fortress of the Five Vultures . History . Pirithin was formerly an adventurer in Bellas ' s Band , under Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while Pirithin took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule .

title: Piscaethces
description: Piscaethces Piscaethces , The Blood Queen , is the creator of the aboleth s . From her blood the Eldest was spawned . Aboleths depict her as a vast aboleth with no tentacles and with mucus the color of blood .
description_long: Piscaethces Piscaethces , The Blood Queen , is the creator of the aboleth s . From her blood the Eldest was spawned . Aboleths depict her as a vast aboleth with no tentacles and with mucus the color of blood . According to Abolethic conceptions , Piscaethces travels the currents of probability between infinite realities , spreading her seed as she moves from one world to another . She never stays long on one Material Plane and is uncaring about her creations . The aboleths know that their creation was a cosmic accident that came about merely as a by - product of the interaction between the Blood Queen ’ s body and the material world and therefore they feel free to act like they want . Nevertheless , they honor Piscaethces by building large domed windows of red crystal within their architecture . Piscaethces strongly resembles the Outer God Shub - Niggurath and the Great Old One Cthulhu , which are known from the writings of H . P . Lovecraft .

title: Pit fiend
description: Pit fiend Scholars pertain that there are sixteen standard ranks of baatezu and pit fiends are right at the top of this hierarchy . Physical description . Pit fiends are the generals of baatezu armies , the orchestrators of mass corruption and the bullies of their lesser devils .
description_long: Pit fiend Scholars pertain that there are sixteen standard ranks of baatezu and pit fiends are right at the top of this hierarchy . Physical description . Pit fiends are the generals of baatezu armies , the orchestrators of mass corruption and the bullies of their lesser devils . They appear as bestial , scaled humanoids twice the height of any human being with a pair of wings that it can wrap around its body . As venom drips from their fangs , fire wreathes the pit fiend ' s entire body . When mortals think of devils , the pit fiends are the creatures that are brought to mind . These creatures appear to be large humanoids with brilliant red skin . Their heads are adorned with massive horns while their bodies are cloaked in a pair of bat - like wings . A long , prehensile tail snakes from their backside . The mouth of a pit fiend is filled with sharpened fangs whose bite carries both a terrible poison and a virulent disease . A pit fiend stands over 12 feet tall and weighs 800 pounds . Abilities .

title: Pit fighter
description: Pit fighter Pit fighters were expert warriors who had learned to fight in closed spaces , such as dungeons or gladiator pits . To survive these dangerous battles , pit fighters picked up unorthodox survival methods that might be considered dishonorable or " dirty . " However , while the pit fighter ' s style might not have been elegant or dignified , it did what it needed to do .
description_long: Pit fighter Pit fighters were expert warriors who had learned to fight in closed spaces , such as dungeons or gladiator pits . To survive these dangerous battles , pit fighters picked up unorthodox survival methods that might be considered dishonorable or " dirty . " However , while the pit fighter ' s style might not have been elegant or dignified , it did what it needed to do . Abilities . Pit fighters , in order to better survive the dangerous circumstances in which they placed themselves , learned to make the best of the tools they had . Pit fighters were more proficient in the use of their arms than most other fighter s , positioning them to deflect or absorb blows better . Pit fighters learned also how , in times of stress , to deal heavier blows than most fighters were able . Many also learned to use " dirty fighting " to their advantage , adding an extra level of pain to the blows they dealt through various tricks that were often unpleasant to watch and endure . Pit fighter exploit s were often just as vicious as their training and lacked any sense of honor .

title: Pit of a Thousand Voices
description: Pit of a Thousand Voices The Pit of a Thousand Voices was located within the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Winding tunnels and caves were scattered throughout the pit .
description_long: Pit of a Thousand Voices The Pit of a Thousand Voices was located within the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Winding tunnels and caves were scattered throughout the pit . Activities . The Pit of a Thousand Voices was reserved for holy slayer s who committed vile crimes against the doctrines of their order . Holy slayers brought here were lowered into the pit , where a sound like a group of baying hounds and wailing moans greeted them . Inhabitants . A gibbering mouther called Al - Bakbuk lived within the pit . It consumed anything lowered into the darkness , adding to its ghastly bulk . A pack of ghoul s serving Akim al - Kalaas also lived within the pit , feeding on any scraps of flesh left by the gibbering mouther . The ghouls worshiped a living idol housed within one of the larger caverns .

title: Pit of the Ghuls
description: Pit of the Ghuls The Pit of the Ghuls was a dangerous valley in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The Pit of the Ghuls was a deep valley surrounded by ring of granite cliffs .
description_long: Pit of the Ghuls The Pit of the Ghuls was a dangerous valley in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The Pit of the Ghuls was a deep valley surrounded by ring of granite cliffs . Many of the cliffs had their own passages that tunneled deep into the ground , providing an easy way for adventurers to get hopelessly lost . A constant stench of decay permeated the cliffs and pit , carried by the constant winds ripping across the desert . Salt water could be found here in the form of the Lake of the Ghuls , located in the northern section of the pit . Rumors & Legends . Rumor said that giant statues carved of gold , silver , turquoise , onyx , emerald , amber , and ruby could be found somewhere within the pit , but dangerous creatures proved more than a challenge for treasure seekers . The arm of a turquoise statue was successfully recovered and came to rest in Ajayib .

title: Pitalla
description: Pitalla Pitalla was a shukenja in the land of Koryo . Pitalla used a " wish " from the " leaping fish " to cure the settlement of Mo ' ki of the ivory plague . He was believed to have then taken the " leaping fish " to the island of Su ' un and left it there , where it remained long lost by the mid – 14th century DR .
description_long: Pitalla Pitalla was a shukenja in the land of Koryo . Pitalla used a " wish " from the " leaping fish " to cure the settlement of Mo ' ki of the ivory plague . He was believed to have then taken the " leaping fish " to the island of Su ' un and left it there , where it remained long lost by the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Pitney Lannon
description: Pitney Lannon Pitney Lannon was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Neverwinter Nights 2 .
description_long: Pitney Lannon Pitney Lannon was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Neverwinter Nights 2 . Pitney was a soldier , and he loved drinking Lazlo ' s Harvest Mead . During the fight with bladeling s and duergar in 1374 DR , Pitney was injured . The Kalach - Cha could ' ve healed him to get him back into the battle . Storm of Zehir . Pitney survived the King of Shadows ' onslaught and returned to the village . When Tarmas disappeared , he and the other soldiers went to rescue him . Once it was realized the Tarmas they found was an illusion , he and the soldiers went to defend the village against dragon s . It was up to adventurers to aid the soldiers or the dragons .

title: Piwafwi
description: Piwafwi A piwafwi was a drow cloak that granted increased powers of stealth and hiding . It came in two varieties , lesser and greater . Description .
description_long: Piwafwi A piwafwi was a drow cloak that granted increased powers of stealth and hiding . It came in two varieties , lesser and greater . Description . A " piwafwi " was a dark - hued cloak . Powers . A " lesser piwafwi " was identical in ability to a " cloak of elvenkind " . When the hood was drawn over the head , it increased the wearer ' s ability to hide . A " greater piwafwi " was a " piwafwi " with the added property of fire resistance . It was also known as a " piwafwi of fire resistance " . When the hood was drawn over the head , the wearer became almost invisible to normal sight , akin to an " invisibility " spell , and infravision , thanks to the heat - shielding properties of the cloak . Creation . The creator of a " piwafwi " had to be a drow and had to know the spell s " endure elements " and " invisibility " . Uses . The drow used these cloaks to stay out of sight in the Underdark . They were fashioned from spider silk and other unknown fibers and it was common for the wearer ' s house symbol to be included on the cloak .

title: Pixie
description: Pixie Pixies were a race of sprites native to Faerie that were created by the fey creator race . Description . Many pixies enjoyed wearing bright colored clothing .
description_long: Pixie Pixies were a race of sprites native to Faerie that were created by the fey creator race . Description . Many pixies enjoyed wearing bright colored clothing . They usually measured 2 . 5 feet ( 0 . 8 m ) in height . Personality . Pixies were usually bold , funny and curious . They did not know fear , and sometimes it put them in situations of life and death . Ecology . These fey had good relations with the other races , but often ended up earning the hatred of someone with a short temper , because they did not know the right time to say what they thought .

title: Piyrathur
description: Piyrathur Piyrathur was a caravan master from Iriaebor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Piyrathur was one of the few Knights operating in the Caravan Cities .
description_long: Piyrathur Piyrathur was a caravan master from Iriaebor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Piyrathur was one of the few Knights operating in the Caravan Cities . He was an able caravan master with investments in Sembia and Westgate , controlling most of the Knights ' business around the Sea of Fallen Stars . Strangely for someone with no magical power , he was a devoted follower of Mystra , donating much money and magical item s to the Church of Mystra . Piyrathur ' s main concern was thwarting the plots of the Men of the Basilisk

title: Placidor
description: Placidor Placidor was a dwarf and the hero of the Battle of Twelvesuns . Descendants of Placidor could call themselves " Blood of Placidor " under the traditional dwarven naming system . However , in the mid – 14th century DR , one such descendent declined as an act of rebellion , naming himself " Onyx the Invincible " instead .
description_long: Placidor Placidor was a dwarf and the hero of the Battle of Twelvesuns . Descendants of Placidor could call themselves " Blood of Placidor " under the traditional dwarven naming system . However , in the mid – 14th century DR , one such descendent declined as an act of rebellion , naming himself " Onyx the Invincible " instead .

title: Plague ( spell )
description: Plague ( spell ) Plague was an arcane illusion spell that caused the recipient to appear as if he or she were suffering from a disfiguring and probably contagious disease . Effects . This powerful illusion mimicked a noxious disease , giving the victim the look , feel , and smell of a true plague - carrier that was obviously apparent to any observer other than the victim .
description_long: Plague ( spell ) Plague was an arcane illusion spell that caused the recipient to appear as if he or she were suffering from a disfiguring and probably contagious disease . Effects . This powerful illusion mimicked a noxious disease , giving the victim the look , feel , and smell of a true plague - carrier that was obviously apparent to any observer other than the victim . The caster had to touch the intended target in order to cast this spell . If the victim did not resist , they were afflicted for seven days per level of the caster . The illusion could be lifted at any time by the caster , or by a sufficiently powerful " dispel magic " . " Cure disease " had no effect whatsoever . To others , rotting flesh smelled rotten , oozing sores felt slimy , and deformities looked real , but the victim felt perfectly normal and saw nothing amiss in a mirror . If the disease was one familiar to the caster , then the chance for someone to detect the illusion via a typical professional examination was quite small . If the disease was one fabricated by the caster or based on second - hand information , then the chance to detect the illusion quintupled . Components .

title: Plague demon
description: Plague demon Plague demons were fiends that were created when creatures succumbed to the abyssal plague . Creation . Similar to ghoul fever , a victim infected by the abyssal plague , either through the ingestion of or contact with Voidharrow , exposure to the blood of another infected creature , or the attacks / death throes of a plague demon , could develop symptoms of the disease and transform upon their death .
description_long: Plague demon Plague demons were fiends that were created when creatures succumbed to the abyssal plague . Creation . Similar to ghoul fever , a victim infected by the abyssal plague , either through the ingestion of or contact with Voidharrow , exposure to the blood of another infected creature , or the attacks / death throes of a plague demon , could develop symptoms of the disease and transform upon their death . Sometimes an infected creature would die before the infection of their body was complete . These creatures would still rise as plague demons , but they would be lesser , undead corpses . Ecology . Plague demons were under the control of the voidharrow , the sentient Abyss located in another universe . The voidharrow desired to spread the abyssal plague across all known worlds , including Toril . There were five known types of plague demon : History . In 1479 DR , plague demons were encountered in Akanûl , Luskan , and Easting .

title: Plague gnat
description: Plague gnat A plague gnat was a small green gnat that infested swampy terrain . Their bite could cause plague gnat boils , a disease that caused large red sores that themselves could contain plague gnats , which , if left untreated , burst into a cloud around the victim .
description_long: Plague gnat A plague gnat was a small green gnat that infested swampy terrain . Their bite could cause plague gnat boils , a disease that caused large red sores that themselves could contain plague gnats , which , if left untreated , burst into a cloud around the victim .

title: Plague of Spells
description: Plague of Spells Plague of Spells is the first novel in the Abolethic Sovereignty trilogy by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary .
description_long: Plague of Spells Plague of Spells is the first novel in the Abolethic Sovereignty trilogy by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary . " Plague of Spells " takes place after the Spellplague through the years of 1385 to 1396 . It follows the Shou monk Raidon Kane , a survivor of the Year of Blue Fire ; Japheth Donard , a young warlock who gained his post - Spellplague powers through a mysterious pact ; and Anusha Marhana , a naive young noble whose curiosity gets the better of her .

title: Plaguegrass
description: Plaguegrass Plaguegrass is grass that has been touched by the spellplague and grows only within the borders of the Plaguewrought Land . The grass was used as the key ingredient in Gregor ' s elixir that blocked the effects of the spellplague . Plaguegrass has blue crystals growing on the stalks .
description_long: Plaguegrass Plaguegrass is grass that has been touched by the spellplague and grows only within the borders of the Plaguewrought Land . The grass was used as the key ingredient in Gregor ' s elixir that blocked the effects of the spellplague . Plaguegrass has blue crystals growing on the stalks .

title: Plagueland
description: Plagueland Plaguelands is a term used to refer to areas or regions where spellplague exists . Creatures that venture close to plaguelands can gain spellscar s . The Order of Blue Flame often seek out plaguelands in what are referred to as Scar Pilgrimage s .
description_long: Plagueland Plaguelands is a term used to refer to areas or regions where spellplague exists . Creatures that venture close to plaguelands can gain spellscar s . The Order of Blue Flame often seek out plaguelands in what are referred to as Scar Pilgrimage s . There is a large area of plaguelands in Interior Faerûn south of the Vilhon Wilds called the Plaguewrought Land .

title: Plaguewrought Land
description: Plaguewrought Land The Plaguewrought Land ( also called the Plaguewrought Lands ) is the name given to what was once the state of Halruaa and a large area south of Chondalwood that continues , as of 1479 DR , to be wracked by the effects of the Spellplague . Inside this plagueland the ground heaves like waves on the ocean and pieces of land levitate randomly to form earthmote s . The vegetation that grows here is strange and twisted and may sprout , mature and then die in a matter of minutes .
description_long: Plaguewrought Land The Plaguewrought Land ( also called the Plaguewrought Lands ) is the name given to what was once the state of Halruaa and a large area south of Chondalwood that continues , as of 1479 DR , to be wracked by the effects of the Spellplague . Inside this plagueland the ground heaves like waves on the ocean and pieces of land levitate randomly to form earthmote s . The vegetation that grows here is strange and twisted and may sprout , mature and then die in a matter of minutes . Most people who travel into this region are killed very quickly by the wild magic . The border has been more or less stable for nearly a hundred years . Pilgrims , encouraged by the Order of Blue Flame , often travel to the Plaguewrought Land in the hopes of acquiring a spellscar . Geography . The Plaguewrought Land is approximately 400 miles long by 200 miles in width and covers the area formerly occupied by the Nagawater and the Golden Plains . The city of Ormpetarr is located at the northwestern border and the veil actually splits the old city in two .

title: Plain of Horses
description: Plain of Horses The barbarians of the Horse - Plain have tried countless times to invade their neighbors , the Shou and T ' u Lung , and have been successful on a few accounts , but their victories were often short lived . Recently though , Tuigan tribes successfully breeched the Dragonwall and devastated many of the northwestern provinces of the Shou Empire . During this invasion , many Shou refugees fled to Faerûn and settled in the Thesk region of the Unapproachable East .
description_long: Plain of Horses The barbarians of the Horse - Plain have tried countless times to invade their neighbors , the Shou and T ' u Lung , and have been successful on a few accounts , but their victories were often short lived . Recently though , Tuigan tribes successfully breeched the Dragonwall and devastated many of the northwestern provinces of the Shou Empire . During this invasion , many Shou refugees fled to Faerûn and settled in the Thesk region of the Unapproachable East . The Horde tribes were eventually driven out and the Shou and T ' u have been focusing most of their military prowess towards defending against further invasions . Geography . The Plain of Horses was divided into several topographical parts . In the northern parts a vast t undra of treeless plains with swamps of snow and ice dominated the landscape . Per tundra south of the mountains , taiga region of forests suitable for farming . Further south are steppe grasslands where herders graze cattle annually . Also worth mentioning that desert almost not inhabited . Climate . Constant extreme temperature changes were prevalent on the Plain of Horses .

title: Plain of Standing Stones
description: Plain of Standing Stones The Plain of Standing Stones was one of the three major subdivisions of the Anauroch desert . The northern dwarves called it " Turlaghh " , the " Field of Broken Dreams " . Geography .
description_long: Plain of Standing Stones The Plain of Standing Stones was one of the three major subdivisions of the Anauroch desert . The northern dwarves called it " Turlaghh " , the " Field of Broken Dreams " . Geography . Anauroch was divided into three distinct areas , the central of which was the Plain of Standing Stones . To its north was the High Ice , and to the south was the sandy region known as the Sword . The mostly waterless region of the Plain was full of gravel and jagged rocks . The area was ravaged by powerful winds , and was almost devoid of trees . Very little of the region was actually flat plain ; much of it rose up as a plateau over the sandy desert to the south . The winds had carved the stone into pillars , spikes , and other strange shapes , and it was full of cliffs , rifts , and rubble . Unlike in the Sword , the Netherese did not build many settlements here before the Fall of Netheril and the creation of the desert , so there were not many ruins or buried treasures . However , the mineral wealth of the land was great , and it was here that the Netherese first discovered " chardalyn " . Flora and Fauna .

title: Plains of Purple Dust
description: Plains of Purple Dust The Plains of Purple Dust , was a vast windy desert located east of the Dragonsword Mountains on the edge of the region formerly occupied by Mulhorand and the northern region of the Raurin desert . The desert expanded in the century following the Spellplague . Geographic Features .
description_long: Plains of Purple Dust The Plains of Purple Dust , was a vast windy desert located east of the Dragonsword Mountains on the edge of the region formerly occupied by Mulhorand and the northern region of the Raurin desert . The desert expanded in the century following the Spellplague . Geographic Features . The Plains of Purple Dust was covered with a purple colored dust that radiated faint magic and stony crags and rocky badlands . Ruins . Dozens of ancient arcane towers made of purple stone could be found here .

title: Planar Sphere
description: Planar Sphere The Planar Sphere was created by the wizard Lavok Corthala , putting many resources and much wealth into its creation .
