It could cure all manner of illness and disease , or remove a curse , or banish an extraplanar creature . Description . " Purification candles " were white in color and intended to be burnt in ten - minute intervals . The longest - lasting candle that could be manufactured burned for ninety minutes . For good mystics , this was the seventh type of candle they learned to make when investigating candle magic . Neutral mystics could choose to learn to make this candle after they reached a sufficiently high level , but choosing this candle excluded them from ever studying to make the black " curse candle " . Powers . After burning for the desired amount of time and then being extinguished ( either by blowing , snuffing , dousing , or reaching the end of its wick ) , this candle performed one of three possible functions for each ten - minute interval it remained lit . The magic took effect when the candle was extinguished . " Purification of the environment : " This burning of the candle could banish one creature that was not native to the plane of the mystic who created the candle .

title: Purify food and drink
description: Purify food and drink Purify food and drink was a transmutation or alteration spell that make food edible and water potable . The alteration version could be reversed , creating putrefy food and drink , which spoiled food and fouled water . Effects .
description_long: Purify food and drink Purify food and drink was a transmutation or alteration spell that make food edible and water potable . The alteration version could be reversed , creating putrefy food and drink , which spoiled food and fouled water . Effects . The transmutation version of this spell as an orison learned by beginning clerics and druids of any faith . When cast , this spell decontaminated one cubic foot ( about 28 , 000 cm or 0 . 028 m ) of food and / or water per experience level of the caster . The spell removed dirt , poisons , parasites , mold , fungus , and impurities of any kind , making it suitable for consumption by most humanoids . Unholy water was ruined by this spell . When cast in reverse , " putrefy food and drink " rotted food and contaminated beverages in like amounts , making them unfit and possibly dangerous to consume . Holy water was ruined by this spell . For comparison : water weighs about 8 . 3 lb ( 3 . 8 kg ) per gallon or 1 kg per liter . One cubic foot of water contains roughly 7 . 5 gal ( 28 l ) and weighs about 62 lb ( 28 kg ) . Components . All versions of this spell only required verbal and somatic components .

title: Purlakhonthiis
description: Purlakhonthiis Purlakhonthiis was the pseudodragon familiar of Lhaeo , Elminster Aumar ' s sage who would become king of Tethyr . She was a platinum - colored pseudodragon with unique abilities . Description .
description_long: Purlakhonthiis Purlakhonthiis was the pseudodragon familiar of Lhaeo , Elminster Aumar ' s sage who would become king of Tethyr . She was a platinum - colored pseudodragon with unique abilities . Description . Purl , as she was called , had platinum scales and appeared even more like a miniature dragon than a typical pseudodragon . She received her unique appearance from permanent spells that were cast upon her . Personality . As was typical of her kind , Purl was playful . Her games included scaring the royal farsann Corwin Vineshigh , who had a fear of dragons . However , in truth , she was protective of Corwin and would growl at anyone treating him unkindly . Likewise , she was extremely protective of her master , Haedrak , and the royal family . Purl hated Duke Inselm Hhune , Count Dancon Riiklass , and Count Krimmon Amethystall and would growl and hiss at them . Abilities . Purl had the improved senses and vision typical of pseudodragons , as well as their resistances . She could communicate telepathically if she desired . Her skin was tougher than a usual pseudodragon , and also unlike them , she could breathe fire from her snout .

title: Purple Dragon knight
description: Purple Dragon knight Purple Dragon knights were the officers and warrior elite of the Cormyr ian army , the bulk of which was known as the Purple Dragons . The Purple Dragons and the knights within distinguished themselves with courage and honor several times in the past and being awarded knighthood within the Purple Dragons was a great honor for anyone from the Forest Country . On the battlefield they worked with the War Wizard s in order to overcome the enemy .
description_long: Purple Dragon knight Purple Dragon knights were the officers and warrior elite of the Cormyr ian army , the bulk of which was known as the Purple Dragons . The Purple Dragons and the knights within distinguished themselves with courage and honor several times in the past and being awarded knighthood within the Purple Dragons was a great honor for anyone from the Forest Country . On the battlefield they worked with the War Wizard s in order to overcome the enemy . The knights ' name came from Thauglor , an ancient black dragon who once dominated the area encompassed by the present kingdom . As Thauglor matured , his scales faded from ebony to violet . Culture . As knights of the crown , members of the Purple Dragons put their honor before anything else and would not bend it for any purpose and the order had high ethical standards for all its initiates . As such , Purple Dragon knights were servants of law and of good , though not always of both . But regardless of a Purple Dragon ' s individual feelings all were expected to do what was best for Cormyr and to serve justice , giving no rest to evil nor corruption .

title: Purple Dragons
description: Purple Dragons The Purple Dragons were the famous military of Cormyr that were renowned for their discipline , skill , and loyalty . The Purple Dragons were considered to be one of the strongest armies in the Realms , and were well renowned for their heroism and acts of valor in the field of combat . They ranged from young nobles who joined as officers to farmers who joined as Blades .
description_long: Purple Dragons The Purple Dragons were the famous military of Cormyr that were renowned for their discipline , skill , and loyalty . The Purple Dragons were considered to be one of the strongest armies in the Realms , and were well renowned for their heroism and acts of valor in the field of combat . They ranged from young nobles who joined as officers to farmers who joined as Blades . The well - disciplined army was made possible through Cormyr ' s military and hierarchical heritage . Recruitment and training . All loyal Cormyrean citizens were eligible to join the Purple Dragons by taking an oath . Although the oath was available to non - humans provided they are Cormyrean citizens , extra measures may have been imposed on non - humans to ensure their loyalty , due to the fact that Cormyr was predominantly human . Nobles were actively expected to take the oath , and would generally be given positions of leadership . Non - nobles would form part of the militia with an initial service of two years . The first six months consisted of an extensive training regime , before starting active duty , such as patrolling Cormyr ' s borders or guarding its cities and towns .

title: Purple Hills
description: Purple Hills The Purple Hills were a range of hills on the coast of Tethyr , lying in County Vintor in the duchy of the Purple Marches . The town of Vineshade was located there . Inhabitants .
description_long: Purple Hills The Purple Hills were a range of hills on the coast of Tethyr , lying in County Vintor in the duchy of the Purple Marches . The town of Vineshade was located there . Inhabitants . Oraundas Haeltower was a farmer producing a cheap , smooth wine from vineyards north and east of Vineshade . During a sale of such wines in 1479 DR , treasure and other valuables began appearing in the wines . This was discovered to be a smuggling operation from the families of Amn .

title: Purple Hills Cider
description: Purple Hills Cider Purple Hills Cider was an alcoholic cider made from a combination of apples , cherries , , plums , , and other fruits from the Purple Hills region . It had the kick of a strong wine with a fruity flavor . Purple Hills Cider was produced by the Kraljaom Distillery in Myratma .
description_long: Purple Hills Cider Purple Hills Cider was an alcoholic cider made from a combination of apples , cherries , , plums , , and other fruits from the Purple Hills region . It had the kick of a strong wine with a fruity flavor . Purple Hills Cider was produced by the Kraljaom Distillery in Myratma . It was sold there and by Aurora ' s Emporium .

title: Purple Marches
description: Purple Marches The Purple Marches was a of western Tethyr known for the quality of its wines . Geography . The Purple Marches were located on the coast between the Sulduskoon River and the River Ith and included the counties of Vintor , Bardshyr , and Elemetar .
description_long: Purple Marches The Purple Marches was a of western Tethyr known for the quality of its wines . Geography . The Purple Marches were located on the coast between the Sulduskoon River and the River Ith and included the counties of Vintor , Bardshyr , and Elemetar . Myratma was the largest city the duchy claimed . The southwestern part of the duchy , in County Vintor , was composed of rolling hills known as the Purple Hills . Where these met the Sea of Swords , there were treacherous cliffs called the Purple Cliffs . These names all came from the multitude of purple flowers growing in the region . Government . In 1369 DR , the Marches were ruled over by Duchess Marilyn Haresdown . Her estate was in the keep of Krennasar , though she was only there three months out of the year . History . The region was first named by Calishites when they expanded their empire north beyond the River Ith ( then the Wurlur ) sometime before - 2400 DR .

title: Purple Rocks
description: Purple Rocks The Purple Rocks were an archipelago in the Trackless Sea located west of Gundarlin beyond the warm water of The River . They appeared as rocky outcroppings , but verdant valleys were sheltered from the storms behind their sparse forested peaks . The dragon Galadaeros considered the Purple Rocks its territory , and it is believed that Flamehome Isle , as he called its lair , was actually one of these two islands .
description_long: Purple Rocks The Purple Rocks were an archipelago in the Trackless Sea located west of Gundarlin beyond the warm water of The River . They appeared as rocky outcroppings , but verdant valleys were sheltered from the storms behind their sparse forested peaks . The dragon Galadaeros considered the Purple Rocks its territory , and it is believed that Flamehome Isle , as he called its lair , was actually one of these two islands . Climate . The Purple Rocks , along with Tuern , Gundarlun and Ruathym , live at the mercy of far harsher sea storms than those on the mainland , and have a winter spanning nearly eight months a year . The " Auril sbreath " ( as the islanders called the bitter and constant winter winds ) , froze everything not built on the lee side of the islands . When not frozen by the " Aurilbreath " , the islands were shrouded in a dense fog that lasted through the day , and its summers were even cooler than subarctic ones . Society . Here , like in rural communities all over the North and other outer islands like Tuern , magic use was punishable by death .

title: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern
description: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern The Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern was a very famous inn and tavern in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . Compared to the Elfsong Tavern , the tavern was frequented more by merchants , employers and adventurers .
description_long: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern The Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern was a very famous inn and tavern in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . Compared to the Elfsong Tavern , the tavern was frequented more by merchants , employers and adventurers . The inn was used by the Harper Randalla Brasshorn as her base of operations .

title: Purple dragon ring
description: Purple dragon ring A purple dragon ring is a brass ring inscribed with the purple dragon symbol of the Obarskyr royal family , and they are usually worn by the Purple Dragon Knights to protect the royal family from harm . By 1372 DR it has been reported that over 4000 of these rings had been made . If this ring is worn on the same hand as a commander ' s ring , they are treated as one ring .
description_long: Purple dragon ring A purple dragon ring is a brass ring inscribed with the purple dragon symbol of the Obarskyr royal family , and they are usually worn by the Purple Dragon Knights to protect the royal family from harm . By 1372 DR it has been reported that over 4000 of these rings had been made . If this ring is worn on the same hand as a commander ' s ring , they are treated as one ring . Value . These rings have been reported as being around 2000 gold pieces each . Other reports record thier value at around 4000 gold pieces .

title: Purple worm
description: Purple worm The purple worm is akin to an enormous ( 5 feet wide and tall and 80 feet long ) and bizarre earthworm . Appearance . As its name implies , it is a deep purple color , with a pale yellow underbelly .
description_long: Purple worm The purple worm is akin to an enormous ( 5 feet wide and tall and 80 feet long ) and bizarre earthworm . Appearance . As its name implies , it is a deep purple color , with a pale yellow underbelly . Separating its yellow part from its purple part are hard crests going down its sides . It is well armored and segmented . One end ends in a large toothed mouth with slit - like eyes above it and dragon ' s ear - like limbs at the sides , and while many worry about falling into the worm ’ s mouth , they often forget about the creature ’ s tail , which ends in a poisonous paralytic stinger . It is often depicted as bursting out of the ground and arching itself in a distinct pose . Purple worms cannot speak . Combat . Purple worms spend their time burrowing through the underground and seek to consume any organic matter they find . Their favored and most feared method of attack is swallowing prey whole . Many groups of adventures have succumbed to such a fate , disappearing down a Purple Worm ' s gullet one after the other . They can also attack with their tail stinger , and by grabbing and grappling with prey . Lair . Purple worms exist deep within the earth .

title: Purung
description: Purung Purung was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . History . Purung was the chieftain of the Kabuaya tribe , one of the most civilized Bawani tribes .
description_long: Purung Purung was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . History . Purung was the chieftain of the Kabuaya tribe , one of the most civilized Bawani tribes . Under his leadership , the Kabuaya progressed much and forged durable relations with the kingdom of Bawa . Purung hoped that one day he would become the governor of a modern Bavanese province .

title: Pusavril
description: Pusavril Pusavril was one of the many merfolk refugee in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Pusavril was a weaver and netmaker .
description_long: Pusavril Pusavril was one of the many merfolk refugee in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Pusavril was a weaver and netmaker . his husband Traylir died in the last battle of the Twelfth Serôs War protecting the High Mages . She after resettled in Myth Nantar started a net business there . She still felt the loss but the atmosphere of the city gave her hope and Pusavril decided to remained there on stable base .

title: Pusriver
description: Pusriver Pusriver was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pusriver was the kindest of her coven , with the job of attracting people .
description_long: Pusriver Pusriver was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pusriver was the kindest of her coven , with the job of attracting people . She was also very forgetful , often asking the same question more than once .

title: Puttak
description: Puttak Puttuk was an Iulutiun village in the southern region of Alpuk known for its domesticated kupuk . Geography . Puttuk was located on the Utaak Stream , northeast of Taak Lake , about 40 miles ( 64 kilometers ) from the Lugsaas Chain and 50 miles ( 80 kilometers ) from the Surykyk Range .
description_long: Puttak Puttuk was an Iulutiun village in the southern region of Alpuk known for its domesticated kupuk . Geography . Puttuk was located on the Utaak Stream , northeast of Taak Lake , about 40 miles ( 64 kilometers ) from the Lugsaas Chain and 50 miles ( 80 kilometers ) from the Surykyk Range . It was a relatively isolated village . Culture . Puttak had a population of about 350 persons in 1359 DR . Much of its culture revolved around its famous kupuk . These kupuk were taken from either of the nearby mountain ranges and domesticated and trained . Within Puttak , kupuk were treated as if they were equal citizens of the community , even sharing food and living space with the Iulutiun villagers . When a kupuk died , it even received its own " equkoku " ceremony . Kupuk had their own burial ground on the east side of the village . Another kupuk - related tradition of the village was its birth ritual . Oldest daughters would seek to give birth at Mount Akka , despite the long journey to that mountain and the accuracy of predicting the day of birth required . That mountain was also known as a primary kupuk nesting site .

title: Pvelnqa Tsunglyl
description: Pvelnqa Tsunglyl Pvelnqua Tsunglyl was a member of the derro Council of Savants of Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Pvelnqua was a traditionalist who openly called for a Uniting War against an enemy like Blingdenstone or Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Pvelnqa Tsunglyl Pvelnqua Tsunglyl was a member of the derro Council of Savants of Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Pvelnqua was a traditionalist who openly called for a Uniting War against an enemy like Blingdenstone or Menzoberranzan . He believed that the derro had become too soft and a war could restore their ancient glory and cull the weak . Secretly , he believed that derro could even win this war and conquer vast parts of the Underdark . His areas of expertise were derro cultural traditions , speleology and the military history of the Underdark . History . Pvelnqua was a recently elevated member of the Council in 1370 DR .

title: Pynroth
description: Pynroth Pynroth was a tiefling youth in the Moonsea . History . Pynroth lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans .
description_long: Pynroth Pynroth was a tiefling youth in the Moonsea . History . Pynroth lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans . Luckily , Pynroth and the others were housed by Ebenz and Bea Farbough , two farmers without children , in a farmhouse near the city . Pynroth lived there for two years until the Rage of Demons . At that time , Pynroth was in the rebellious teenager phase and went out of the home . However , he was attacked by some wild dogs but was protected by Beralt of the Emerald Enclave and saved by some adventurers who happened to be near the farmhouse .

title: Pyong Do
description: Pyong Do Pyong Do was a city in the realm of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was formerly part of the kingdom of Koguryo . Geography .
description_long: Pyong Do Pyong Do was a city in the realm of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was formerly part of the kingdom of Koguryo . Geography . Pyong Do lay in the far southwest of the peninsula , on the shores of the Straits of Koryo . It stood within the province of Koguryo . Locations . The prestigious Do Jang of Won Kwang was established by Won Kwang in Pyong Do in 925 DR . It was still in operation by 1357 DR , and had trained many great generals , even King Wanang Sun .

title: Pypyap
description: Pypyap Pypyap was an imp familiar of Halvin Graingle in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pypyap was a very friendly devil albeit ill - willed .
description_long: Pypyap Pypyap was an imp familiar of Halvin Graingle in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pypyap was a very friendly devil albeit ill - willed . He was honest in his dealings and talkative . He enjoyed being on Toril and he had no wish to go back to Hell . For this reason , he was also very cautious about being killed . History . Pypyap was summoned from the Nine Hells by Halvin Graingle , a member of the Cult of the Dragon , to act as his familiar . He went with his master to the Kabel ' s Hill community in the Quivering Forest . After Halvin ' s disappearance , Pypyap went to ravage the local livestock . Here he was discovered by an adventuring party hired to find Halvin . during the Rage of Demons Pypyap was in Maerimydra in Underdark where he was harassed by some Ogre s but saved by an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect some samples of bloods from Fiend Fire giant . Pypyap grateful to the adventurers help them guiding in the city

title: Pyras Autorian
description: Pyras Autorian Pyras Autorian was the tharchion of Thaymount of Thay . Activities . Pyras had no real talent and was an open puppet of Szass Tam .
description_long: Pyras Autorian Pyras Autorian was the tharchion of Thaymount of Thay . Activities . Pyras had no real talent and was an open puppet of Szass Tam . In turn , Szass kept Pyras safe with bodyguards , magical items , and spells . History . Pyras was tharchion of Thaymount by 1372 DR . He was later sacrificed by his patron Tam in 1385 DR in order to invoke Bane for help in the Thayan civil war .

title: Pyratar
description: Pyratar Pyratar was the capital of Var the Golden in 1367 DR . Description . Pyratar was located on a bay named the Throat within the western regions of the Golden Water .
description_long: Pyratar Pyratar was the capital of Var the Golden in 1367 DR . Description . Pyratar was located on a bay named the Throat within the western regions of the Golden Water . The Throat shielded the city from the harsh winter storms that ravaged much of the surrounding area . Pyratar ' s docks , and their naval traffic , rivaled those of Heldapan ' s across the Golden Water . Inhabitants . This city had a population of 45 , 000 . Pyratar was the home of the Chaka Sememra . They had their fingers entwined within most of the businesses in the capital . A growing sect of worshipers of Mask resided in the city . Led by Kelsipal , their goal was to first take over Pyratar and then the rest of the country .

title: Pyrolisk
description: Pyrolisk The pyrolisk was a magical beast that was very similar in appearance and physical strength to the cockatrice . Their differences lay in the pyrolisk ' s red tail feathers and special abilities . Abilities .
description_long: Pyrolisk The pyrolisk was a magical beast that was very similar in appearance and physical strength to the cockatrice . Their differences lay in the pyrolisk ' s red tail feathers and special abilities . Abilities . While the cockatrice was often cited as having a stoning touch or gaze , a pyrolisk relied on its own special gaze that caused any who met it to burst into flame , along with any nearby source of fire . Pyrolisks themselves were immune to all sources of fire . Unlike the cockatrice , which had an animal intelligence and behavior , the pyrolisk had a somewhat increased intelligence , and was an evil creature . While it normally detested all creatures , its mortal enemy was the phoenix . Ecology . Although a young pyrolisk did not possess all the special abilities that its fully grown counterpart had , it could still cast " pyrotechnics " at will . Behavior . The starwood area of the Cormanthor forest contained a number of pyrolisks . If these encountered an owlbear termite pit , they would use it to hatch their young . The owlbears did not put up a fight since they knew the threat posed by the pyrolisk .

title: Pyrotechnics
description: Pyrotechnics Pyrotechnics was a spell from the transmutation school or the alteration school that operated on a normal fire to produce either bright , blinding fireworks or billowing clouds of thick , choking smoke . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Primidon ' s pyrotechnics " could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive specialization .
description_long: Pyrotechnics Pyrotechnics was a spell from the transmutation school or the alteration school that operated on a normal fire to produce either bright , blinding fireworks or billowing clouds of thick , choking smoke . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Primidon ' s pyrotechnics " could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive specialization . " Pyrotechnics " could originally be learned and cast by arcane magic - user s and by druid s . After the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , it could be cast by druids , wizard s with access to the alteration school , and cleric s , particularly those who commanded the Elemental and Elemental Fire spheres . Following the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , it could only be cast by wizards with access to the transmutation school , sorcerer s , and bard s , as well as warmage s and wu jen . In Zakhara , elemental mage s and sorcerers could learn it as part of the Flame province . Effects . The caster chose an existing fire source at a distance of 400 ft ( 122 m ) or more , and turned it into smoke or fireworks as they willed .

title: Q ' Xorlarrin
description: Q ' Xorlarrin Q ' Xorlarrin was a drow settlement founded around the forge of the ruined dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Q ' Xorlarrin was the sister city of Menzoberranzan . Description .
description_long: Q ' Xorlarrin Q ' Xorlarrin was a drow settlement founded around the forge of the ruined dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Q ' Xorlarrin was the sister city of Menzoberranzan . Description . The focal area of Q ' Xorlarrin was the Great Forge . The rest of the settlement spread out from there , with the chapel housed next to the primordial Maegera . The mines ( which produced mithral and adamantine ) were occupied by slaves and slavedrivers . Inhabitants . The city ' s primarily inhabitants were drow , but a number of drider s dwelt there , as well as plenty of slaves , primarily goblin s and dwarves . History . In 1463 DR , a group of Menzoberranyr drow from House Xorlarrin , led by Ravel Xorlarrin , captured the forge area of Gauntlgrym at the behest of Matron Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin , having been secretly prodded to do so by House Baenre . The purpose was to create a sister city to Menzoberranzan that was free of the direct control of House Baenre and that would provide many valuable forged goods .

title: Q ' arlynd Melarn
description: Q ' arlynd Melarn Q ' arlynd Melarn was a drow wizard . Originally from Ched Nasad , he was a capable battle mage and the only surviving male member of Ched Nasad . Description .
description_long: Q ' arlynd Melarn Q ' arlynd Melarn was a drow wizard . Originally from Ched Nasad , he was a capable battle mage and the only surviving male member of Ched Nasad . Description . Q ' arlynd sported a slightly crooked nose due to a childhood lizard riding accident , which left it broken . In spite of this fact , he was still handsome enough to hold the attention of most females . His shoulder - length white hair was worn in a contingency clip which rested at the back of his neck . As a highly skilled battle mage and master of the College of Ancient Arcana , Q ' arlynd ' s style of dress was fitting for a drow of his stature . As a member of Eilistraee ' s faithful Q ' arlynd bore a crescent - shaped scar on his right palm from when he took his Sword Oath . Personality . Q ' arlynd , despite his education in Ched Nasad , could never be truly evil ; he was unsure of the Surfacers when he first made his way out of the Underdark , but began to accept the goodness of Eilistraee . He was well aware of his good looks and charms and used them when the occasion requires it , but his first and foremost love was for the arcane . History .

title: Qadib
description: Qadib The Free City of Qadib , also known as the City of Wands , was located along the Al - Haul River . Qadib housed more magic users than any other place in northern Zakhara , topped only by Huzuz and Rog ' osto in all the Land of Fate . Trade .
description_long: Qadib The Free City of Qadib , also known as the City of Wands , was located along the Al - Haul River . Qadib housed more magic users than any other place in northern Zakhara , topped only by Huzuz and Rog ' osto in all the Land of Fate . Trade . The city was also known for its universities , which earned it the second title " City of Sages " , and the fabrication of Uther , a yellow - orange dye .

title: Qadim Hills
description: Qadim Hills The Qadim Hills were a grouping of hills in the Troll Mountains of Amn . Geography . These were the western hills of the Troll Mountains , beginning north of Trollford and running until the Green Fields .
description_long: Qadim Hills The Qadim Hills were a grouping of hills in the Troll Mountains of Amn . Geography . These were the western hills of the Troll Mountains , beginning north of Trollford and running until the Green Fields . The hills were relatively steep , and some of the waters composing the Esmelflow began atop them . Inhabitants . Goblins used to inhabit these hills , and they warred against the troll s of the mountains .

title: Qaland T ' akk
description: Qaland T ' akk Qaland T ' akk was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Qaland was the chieftain of the Igidujin tribe and the ruler of Quaraqand and a descendant of the feared Qaland Shurijah .
description_long: Qaland T ' akk Qaland T ' akk was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Qaland was the chieftain of the Igidujin tribe and the ruler of Quaraqand and a descendant of the feared Qaland Shurijah . His only interest was war . His subordinates had to meet weekly quotas for murdered enemies ; those who failed to meet their quotas were personally executed by T ' akk . T ' akk ' s favored enemy was the Fankiang tribe and Chuqali Shilai .

title: Qallit
description: Qallit Qallit was a sahuagin malenti living in the Great Sea near a zaratan around the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Activities . Qallit guarded the island formed by the zaratan ' s shell from intruders , questioning any who approached .
description_long: Qallit Qallit was a sahuagin malenti living in the Great Sea near a zaratan around the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Activities . Qallit guarded the island formed by the zaratan ' s shell from intruders , questioning any who approached . They tried to enlist aid when they were able to help cleanse the isle of a self - proclaimed caliph named Nuri al - Zaratani

title: Qanun
description: Qanun A qanun ( qah - NOON ) was a Zakharan stringed instrument similar to the zither found elsewhere on al - Toril . Description . A " qanun " was a trapezoidal box consisting of 24 - 36 courses .
description_long: Qanun A qanun ( qah - NOON ) was a Zakharan stringed instrument similar to the zither found elsewhere on al - Toril . Description . A " qanun " was a trapezoidal box consisting of 24 - 36 courses . Each course encompassed 3 wound strings made from gut . The strings on an extremely valuable " qanun " could be made from enchanted silk . A set of hooked rings were used to entice sound from the strings . History . The " qanun " was a larger instrument but remained fairly portable . It was a common site among the bazaars and " suqs " of the Land of Fate .

title: Qanun of the spirits
description: Qanun of the spirits The qanun of the spirits was a beautiful magical musical instrument that was presented to the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , so there were multiple " qanun s of the spirits " scattered throughout the Land of Fate . Description .
description_long: Qanun of the spirits The qanun of the spirits was a beautiful magical musical instrument that was presented to the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , so there were multiple " qanun s of the spirits " scattered throughout the Land of Fate . Description . This fine instrument was made from select mahogany from the Isle of the Elephant . Rumors abounded that the strings were made of thin spun gold or even solidified light . A pick carved from a precious emerald was used to play the instrument . Powers . The " qanun of the spirits " was considered to be the most powerful item of all the instruments of the jann . When played , the musician effectively cast the " fire truth " spell . The tone of the instrument determined if the target was telling the truth , with sour notes indicating a lie . This power could be used once per day , though bard s and " rawunin " could use it twice per day .

title: Qar Jysstev
description: Qar Jysstev Qar Jysstev was Namarch on the Council of Six in Amn . Description . He was a skinny man who tried to hide his bald spot with expensive wigs of yoxen hair .
description_long: Qar Jysstev Qar Jysstev was Namarch on the Council of Six in Amn . Description . He was a skinny man who tried to hide his bald spot with expensive wigs of yoxen hair . Personality . Qar advocates the use of the Council to progress Amnian trade , and wants to introduce more trade goods from Maztica to the isolated northern areas of the nation , since this is more profitable , albeit riskier . History . In 1321 DR , Qar became Lord of House Jysstev and later in 1345 DR , he was appointed Dahaunarch . In 1362 DR , he was made Namarch on the Council of Six . His family fell into debt sold all their assets in Athkatla and Murann . Still high ranking , the Jysstev family moved to Eshpurta , where they had allies and honor bound loyalists .

title: Qara
description: Qara Qara was a sorceress from Neverwinter who once attended the Neverwinter Academy , where she received some small amount of wizard training that she ultimately disregarded . She was best known for her travels with the Kalach - Cha . Appearance .
description_long: Qara Qara was a sorceress from Neverwinter who once attended the Neverwinter Academy , where she received some small amount of wizard training that she ultimately disregarded . She was best known for her travels with the Kalach - Cha . Appearance . Described as physically attractive by many around her , Qara had a comely figure with refined tastes in dress , though her hair , which was commonly ruffled and unkempt due to Qara ' s tugging at it in frustration , detracted slightly from her appearance . White cheeks , green eyes , and bright Auburn / Chestnut hair , Qara was of a notably northern stock , possibly Illuskan . As in all other things , Qara ' s disposition and attitude shone through her appearance as well , as she would tend to blush brightly when enraged , roll her eyes when irritated , or move her hands excitedly when enticed . Qara also had a small weasel familiar named Tamin . Personality . Qara , like many people of her age , was impatient and rebellious , though to an extent far more than typical .

title: Qaraqib
description: Qaraqib The qaraqib ( kah - rah - KEEB ) was a set of clackers used by Zakharan dancers . Description . A dancer would hold two sets of " qaraqib " in each hand and manipulate them while moving about .
description_long: Qaraqib The qaraqib ( kah - rah - KEEB ) was a set of clackers used by Zakharan dancers . Description . A dancer would hold two sets of " qaraqib " in each hand and manipulate them while moving about . History . It was rumored that some holy slayer s were able to use the " qaraqib " to secretly communicate with members of their fellowship . The " qaraqib " was banned within the Pantheist League .

title: Qarbo
description: Qarbo Qarbo was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Qarbo was cruel and more than a little manic in his demeanor .
description_long: Qarbo Qarbo was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Qarbo was cruel and more than a little manic in his demeanor . He liked to grin slyly at strangers , as if enjoying an inside joke . Activities . Qarbo ran all the day - to day activities of the cult inside the monastery . History . In 1491 DR , Hellenrae , Qarbo , and their minions disguised themselves as monks occupying the Sacred Stone Monastery . Soon after , however , some adventurers infiltrated the monastery and in the end confronted and defeated Qarbo .

title: Qas ' ah baladi
description: Qas ' ah baladi The qas ' ah baladi ( KAh - sah bah - LAH - dee ) was a large Zakharan kettle drum . Description . These drums were crafted from fire - hardened clay .
description_long: Qas ' ah baladi The qas ' ah baladi ( KAh - sah bah - LAH - dee ) was a large Zakharan kettle drum . Description . These drums were crafted from fire - hardened clay . Tough hides were usually used to cover their heads , though sometimes extremely thin metal was used . The large size of the " qas ' ah baladi " made it inconvenient to transport . History . " Qas ' ah baladi " were used by mamluk s throughout the Free Cities of Zakhara and often saw use in Hiyal and Huzuz when important announcements were needed .

title: Qaxdivak
description: Qaxdivak Qaxdivak was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , as well as a priest of Ilxendren in 1370 DR . Personality . Although small in size , Qaxvidak made up for it by being highly cunning .
description_long: Qaxdivak Qaxdivak was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , as well as a priest of Ilxendren in 1370 DR . Personality . Although small in size , Qaxvidak made up for it by being highly cunning . He possessed a surprising degree of influence over his fellow councilors by subtly playing each against the others and taking advantage of their weaknesses . Qaxdivak was an albino mutation but had a higher than normal natural magic resistance for his kind .

title: Qaynat
description: Qaynat The Qaynat was a group of beautiful and talented women gathered by the fourth Grand Caliph of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . History . Obsessed with beauty , the fourth Grand Caliph filled his harim with physically dazzling women who were also skilled musicians and behaved in a proper courtly manner .
description_long: Qaynat The Qaynat was a group of beautiful and talented women gathered by the fourth Grand Caliph of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . History . Obsessed with beauty , the fourth Grand Caliph filled his harim with physically dazzling women who were also skilled musicians and behaved in a proper courtly manner . Though the women of the " Qaynat " were technically slaves , they wanted for nothing . It was widely believed that their collective beauty had not been matched in any other harim in Zakhara .

title: Qerria
description: Qerria Qerria was the leader of the Order of the Gilded Eye in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Qerria ruled Helm ' s Hold and the Gilded Eye .
description_long: Qerria Qerria was the leader of the Order of the Gilded Eye in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Qerria ruled Helm ' s Hold and the Gilded Eye . She was totally focused in find and destroy evil under the guidance of Helm .

title: Qiltox
description: Qiltox Qiltox was a beholder involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Qiltox was a beholder allied to the Zhentarim ; he lived in the ruin of Myth Drannor until he was forced to flee at the start of the Cormanthor War ; The Zhent relocated him to their new drow allies of House Dhuurniv to help and control the drow .
description_long: Qiltox Qiltox was a beholder involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Qiltox was a beholder allied to the Zhentarim ; he lived in the ruin of Myth Drannor until he was forced to flee at the start of the Cormanthor War ; The Zhent relocated him to their new drow allies of House Dhuurniv to help and control the drow .

title: Qilué Veladorn
description: Qilué Veladorn Qilué Veladorn was the youngest of the Seven Sisters , the Chosen family of Mystra , goddess of magic , and was a drow cleric of Eilistraee as of 1372 DR . . Description .
description_long: Qilué Veladorn Qilué Veladorn was the youngest of the Seven Sisters , the Chosen family of Mystra , goddess of magic , and was a drow cleric of Eilistraee as of 1372 DR . . Description . Qilué was a 6 feet tall drow female of wild , dazzling beauty ( as opposed to the sleek , well - groomed appearance of most drow priestesses ) . She had silvery hair that flowed down to her ankles , and silver eyes , like her goddess , that were larger than those of most drow . Her appearance was so awe - inspiring , imperious at times , that Liriel Baenre believed Qilué to be Eilistraee herself when meeting her for the first time . Personality . The seventh among the Seven Sister , or the Dark Sister , Qilué was the focus of wild rumors , her reputation on the surface Realms being made up of whispers and voices , but nothing more ( and often far from the truth ) . More than any of the other Sisters , because of her service to ( and her being a chosen of ) two free - spirited goddesses ( Eilistraee and Mystra - - " The Two Who Watch , " as she called the goddesses when weary of their directives ) , she was always careful of her power and of using it properly .

title: Qinnaz
description: Qinnaz Qinnaz was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Qinnaz was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Qinnaz Qinnaz was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Qinnaz was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Qinnaz was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Qirmiz min Hudid
description: Qirmiz min Hudid Qirmiz min Hudid was a beautiful but deadly agent of the Brotherhood of the True Flame inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Violent outbursts and mood swings were commonplace when dealing with Qirmiz , causing many individuals who challenged her to experience the full wrath of her blazing power .
description_long: Qirmiz min Hudid Qirmiz min Hudid was a beautiful but deadly agent of the Brotherhood of the True Flame inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Violent outbursts and mood swings were commonplace when dealing with Qirmiz , causing many individuals who challenged her to experience the full wrath of her blazing power . Description . Qirmiz was a beautiful woman who possessed auburn hair and a sultry physique . It was said she had the " face of an angel and the heart of a tiger . " Activities . True to her fanatic zeal , Qirmiz accepted a special sterility curse from the Bonfire , the mysterious leader of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . The curse prevented anyone with whom she was intimate from fathering children . Qirmiz , under magical guise imitating concubines of the Royal Harim of Huzuz , would trade places with several concubines who were sworn to secrecy , and lie with the Grand Caliph periodically , preventing him from siring more children and producing a male heir . However , the curse was not without harmful side effects . Qirmiz herself was permanently sterile , yet the curse infused her with an insatiable appetite for romance .

title: Qoha ' dar
description: Qoha ' dar Qoha ' dar was a human sha ' ir who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Qoha ' dar spent a great deal of time making sure she was always presentable for someone of her lofty station .
description_long: Qoha ' dar Qoha ' dar was a human sha ' ir who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Qoha ' dar spent a great deal of time making sure she was always presentable for someone of her lofty station . Personality . Qoha ' dar ' s pleasant personality was often hidden by her pretentious exterior facade . Activities . Joining the Magical Legion was Qoha ' dar ' s main goal . History . Originally hailing from an affluent family in Muluk , Qoha ' dar visited Huzuz on her pilgrimage and opted to stay in the City of Delights . Relationships . The sha ' ir was always attended by her gen , Ali , and a mamluk bodyguard named Farim , with whom she was infatuated . Due to past excursions , Qoha ' dar had a healthy relationship with the jann , who answered her calls immediately . Possessions . Qoha ' dar enjoyed flaunting her wealth by wearing embroidered robes , opal earrings , a garnet anklet , and by keeping a jeweled " jambiya " strapped to her waist . She also owned a staff enchanted with a " continual light " spell , a " wand of magic missiles " , a " ring of fire resistance " , a " cloak of protection " , and several magical scroll s .

title: Qorrashi
description: Qorrashi Qorrash ( singular qorrashi ) were genie s of cold and ice . Description . Qorrash were elemental creature s native to the Plane of Air .
description_long: Qorrashi Qorrash ( singular qorrashi ) were genie s of cold and ice . Description . Qorrash were elemental creature s native to the Plane of Air . They had blue skin , which was always covered in thick frost , because a perpetual aura of bitter cold always emanated from their bodies . They had white hair . Males were often bald and sported fancy goatees ; females wore their hair long . A typical qorrashi stood over ten feet ( 300 centimeters ) tall and weighed about half a ton . Abilities . Qorrash had such a strong connection to ice that they could walk on any surface of ice — even upside down . Like other genies , they had a wide assortment of inherent magical powers , including but not limited to the ability to turn invisible , to summon a storm of ice , to turn into a gaseous form , and to walk on the wind . A qorrashi could create food and water and other items and generate powerful illusions . They could blast a cone of cold from their palms , and anyone struck by one of their blows would suffer a severe chill that could lead to frostbite . Like all genies , qorrashi had darkvision and could plane shift to the elemental planes , the Astral Plane , or the Prime . Language .

title: Qos
description: Qos Qos was the most powerful of the dukar in Myth Nantar . Activities . Qos was one of the greatest mysteries of Serôs .
description_long: Qos Qos was the most powerful of the dukar in Myth Nantar . Activities . Qos was one of the greatest mysteries of Serôs . He lived inside the Dukar Reef inside Myth Nantar and only his students and his fellow paragons had met him . Qos had total control over the Great Barrier and was the only paragon capable of teach the peacekeeper ' s ways . History . Qos was a key player in the Twelfth Serôs War .

title: Qotal
description: Qotal Qotal , the feathered dragon , also known as the Plumed One , was the lawful good god of healing , feathers and creation in Maztica . He was often portrayed as a huge golden dragon who had golden colored feathers instead of scales . From his neck erupted a lush mane of many colored feathers .
description_long: Qotal Qotal , the feathered dragon , also known as the Plumed One , was the lawful good god of healing , feathers and creation in Maztica . He was often portrayed as a huge golden dragon who had golden colored feathers instead of scales . From his neck erupted a lush mane of many colored feathers . History . After Kukul created humans the gods each gave a gift to mankind . Qotal gave man mayz ( corn ) which enabled the Maztican society to flourish . Qotal became the favorite god of the Mazticans which made Qotal ' s brother Zaltec jealous . Zaltec gave humans dark Hishna magic which made them powerful and caused them to wage wars . Qotal became distressed and his mother the goddess Maztica give Qotal feathermagic to give to humans . Zaltec was angered by his mother ' s interference and slew Maztica . After Maztica ' s death the gods fought a war and ultimately Qotal defeated Zaltec . After the war humans enjoyed a long period of peace and prosperity . Qotal saw men and women enjoying each other ' s companionship and decided he wanted a wife and since his choices were a bit limited he forcibly took his sister Kiltzi as his wife .

title: Qu ' ellarz ' orl
description: Qu ' ellarz ' orl Qu ' ellarz ' orl was a high plateau and district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . It was home to some of the most powerful drow houses in the city , including House Baenre , the most powerful house . Qu ' ellarz ' orl and Tier Breche combined were considered the " two heads " ( most important unifying parts ) of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: Qu ' ellarz ' orl Qu ' ellarz ' orl was a high plateau and district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . It was home to some of the most powerful drow houses in the city , including House Baenre , the most powerful house . Qu ' ellarz ' orl and Tier Breche combined were considered the " two heads " ( most important unifying parts ) of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The plateau was located in the southwestern corner of the city and was screened from the rest of the city by a forest of giant mushrooms . On the other side of the forest was the wealthy district of Narbondellyn . There were nine tunnels between Lake Donigarten and the edge of the Qu ' ellarz ' orl plateau . Description . In contrast to the rest of the city , Qu ' ellarz ' orl was spacious and bare ; no crowds were found here , nor any businesses .

title: Qu ' encesta
description: Qu ' encesta The Qu ' encesta were a far - ranging tribe of Nar found in Narfell known for their savage nature . There were 2 , 700 Qu ' encesta in 1357 DR . Activities .
description_long: Qu ' encesta The Qu ' encesta were a far - ranging tribe of Nar found in Narfell known for their savage nature . There were 2 , 700 Qu ' encesta in 1357 DR . Activities . Though they often treated foreigners with hostility , the Qu ' encesta were on decent terms with the other tribes of Nar found in Narfell . There was always a chance that any defeated outsider would be allowed to flee the boundaries of Narfell if the Qu ' encesta believed they fought bravely . Base of Operations . The Qu ' encesta dominated most of central Narfell between Icelace Lake and the Rawlinswood .

title: Qu ' ima
description: Qu ' ima The Qu ' ima were a moderately sized tribe of Nar found in Narfell who always weighed their options before acting . There were 1 , 900 Qu ' ima in 1357 DR . Activities .
description_long: Qu ' ima The Qu ' ima were a moderately sized tribe of Nar found in Narfell who always weighed their options before acting . There were 1 , 900 Qu ' ima in 1357 DR . Activities . This tribe was known to exile members who behaved against the decisions of the tribe , as in the case of Horse . Base of Operations . The Qu ' ima were found in the western reaches of Narfall between the Hawk ' s Finger and the Giantspire Mountains .

title: Quabah
description: Quabah Quabah was a small village that lay south of the Pit of the Ghuls within the High Desert of Zakhara . History . The village was originally founded by nomads hailing from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue as a religious retreat .
description_long: Quabah Quabah was a small village that lay south of the Pit of the Ghuls within the High Desert of Zakhara . History . The village was originally founded by nomads hailing from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue as a religious retreat . Most of these nomads were devoted acolytes of Hajama the Courageous and Haku the " Master of the Desert Wind . " Inhabitants . Quabah ' s original founders were all strictly celibate males . The culture of Quabah changed when Yezeed , a revisionist leader , adjusted their doctrines to allow marriage . Within a generation , women began flocking to Quabah , as word had spread that the men treated their wives with the same reverence they showed the gods .

title: Quaervarr
description: Quaervarr Quaervarr ( also spelled Quaervaar ) was a small woodland town in the Silver Marches located in the southern part of the Moonwood near Herald ' s Holdfast . History . Quaervarr started out as a logging camp , but grew to be a small town that both tended and logged the trees of the Moonwood with great care .
description_long: Quaervarr Quaervarr ( also spelled Quaervaar ) was a small woodland town in the Silver Marches located in the southern part of the Moonwood near Herald ' s Holdfast . History . Quaervarr started out as a logging camp , but grew to be a small town that both tended and logged the trees of the Moonwood with great care . Rumors . In Silverymoon it is joked that Quaervarr is valuable in the alliance just to preserve its fine inn , the Whistling Stag .

title: Quaervaxthanus
description: Quaervaxthanus Quaervaxthanus was a beholder mage that became Magister . Personality . Quaervaxthanus had a natural talent in creating and modifying spell s .
description_long: Quaervaxthanus Quaervaxthanus was a beholder mage that became Magister . Personality . Quaervaxthanus had a natural talent in creating and modifying spell s . History . In his youth , Quaervaxthanus was blinded by an older eye tyrant that was trying to eliminate the beholder bloodline of which Quaervaxthanus was member . He managed to escape despite the mutilation and disappeared for a long time . He came back many years later as a powerful beholder mage with many powerful Netherese wands and scepters grafted into his empty eye - socket and controlled with his mind , thanks to many new spells . Quaervaxthanus was so known for his talent in spell alterations that some reclusive human archmage s traded with him . In 699 DR , he lured the current reigning Magister Larongar Veverell into a trap and attacked the human mage from above as he slept . After becoming Magister , Quaervaxthanus freely visited some elven mages and gave them new spells instead of killing them like he did all wizards who sought him out . His doom arrived in 705 DR when the human sorcerer Almer Garanthund lured Quaervaxthanus into a sophisticated trap inside a tunnel full of explosive wands .

title: Quaggoth
description: Quaggoth A quaggoth was a bear - like inhabitant of the Underdark . History . Originally believed to have been bred by drow magicians as a slave race , the quaggoth escaped and filled their own niche in the Underdark .
description_long: Quaggoth A quaggoth was a bear - like inhabitant of the Underdark . History . Originally believed to have been bred by drow magicians as a slave race , the quaggoth escaped and filled their own niche in the Underdark . The origin of the quaggoths was unknown . Some sages claim that they were once a semi - civilized race that dominated much of the Underdark through conquest and ritual sacrifice , until the drow , duergar , and other races broke their power . Others speculated they had some sort of civilization on the surface and were driven underground ; this theory was supported by the quaggoths ' hatred for surface - dwelling dwarves and elves . They did , however , have an underground kingdom called Ursadunthar , deep beneath the Spine of the World , until it fell to duergar from Gracklstugh in - 1350 DR . Personality . Quaggoths feared no creature . Though they were dangerous hunters , they were just as often prey for other predators of the Underdark . Quaggoths could be trained as servants and guards if captured young . Description . Quaggoths were humanoids with long , shaggy , white hair covering their entire bodies .

title: Quail
description: Quail Quails were common in the " Forgotten Realms " . Species . Sand hen .
description_long: Quail Quails were common in the " Forgotten Realms " . Species . Sand hen . The sand hen was a rare type of quail that could be found in the rimwood area of the Cormanthor forest , east of the River Lis . It was notable for the tasty stock that could be produced from its carcass .

title: Qualith
description: Qualith Qualith was the written language of illithid s . It took the form of four parallel lines that had texture that conveyed meaning when read by an illithid scanning its four tentacles along the lines simultaneously . It could be written on parchment , in books , or carved into surfaces .
description_long: Qualith Qualith was the written language of illithid s . It took the form of four parallel lines that had texture that conveyed meaning when read by an illithid scanning its four tentacles along the lines simultaneously . It could be written on parchment , in books , or carved into surfaces . Qualith was extremely difficult to read for non - illithids and usually required magic to decipher because each of the four lines of script modified the others and only when taken as a whole was the full meaning understandable . Some specially trained dwarves known as " caradhakers " ( which loosely translates to " mindstalker " ) were said to be able to grasp the basic meaning ( but not the nuances ) by running four fingers over the striations .

title: Quallem
description: Quallem The Quallem family was a noble family of Dordrien in the area that later became Daggerdale . Organization . The head of the family was recognized to be Lady Quallem .
description_long: Quallem The Quallem family was a noble family of Dordrien in the area that later became Daggerdale . Organization . The head of the family was recognized to be Lady Quallem . Base of operations . As a noble family of Dordrien , the Quallem family resided near Dordrien Keep in the Dagger Hills . The Quallem family ' s status among the nobles of Dordrien was significant enough for it to have a sizable crypt set aside for it only a few miles north of Dordrien Keep . History . Sometime after the fall of Jhaamdath in - 255 DR , a Jhaamdath an noble , Dordrien , founded a small enclave of survivors on the western slopes of the Dagger Hills . Although the realm lasted little more than a century before orc attacks spelled its demise , in that time the Quallem family managed to rise to a point of prominence that meant they were honored with a place in the Dordrien Crypts . During Lady Quallem ' s time as the head of the family , she had a son with some degree of skill as a wizard . Both of them were interred in the family vault . However , Lady Quallem herself could not rest easy while her last descendant ' s body was not buried in the family tomb .

title: Quang Muku Forest
description: Quang Muku Forest The Quang Muku Forest or simply Quang Muku was a forest in the kingdom of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . It lay east of the Vorkani Mountains . Description .
description_long: Quang Muku Forest The Quang Muku Forest or simply Quang Muku was a forest in the kingdom of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . It lay east of the Vorkani Mountains . Description . Koryoans thought of the Quang Muku Forest as a " dark and twisted wood " . Geography . The Malu River crossed the Quang Muku Forest and emptied into the sea at Foo Nakar . Locations . According to local myths , there was a lost city of temples lying deep in the woods . The modern cities of Foo Nakar , Karak , and Singye lay on the fringes of the Quang Muku Forest , by the coast . Inhabitants . Quang Muku was apparently once home to an ancient civilization , but this was long - fallen by the 14th century DR , remembered only in local myths of a lost city and men who stood 8 feet ( 2 . 4 meters ) tall . The ancient people lived on as forest - dwelling tribes , known to the Koryoans as savages and strange cannibals . Bosturo , Master of the Muradi Lighthouse , grew up in the Quang Muku Forest . Two powerful spirits known as the Cosalla Huin To watched over the northern glades of the Quang Muku , making mischief on ordinary travelers and inflicting punishments on those who invaded or harmed the woods . Trade .

title: Quaraband
description: Quaraband Quaraband was the capital city of Yamun Khahan ' s empire . Geography . Quaraband was a tent city that did not have permanent structures .
description_long: Quaraband Quaraband was the capital city of Yamun Khahan ' s empire . Geography . Quaraband was a tent city that did not have permanent structures . Because of this the exact location was never certain since the people of the steppes moved to accommodate their needs . However , Yamun ' s capital was located on the vast steppes of the Hordelands somewhere between the Kora Shan range and the northern fringes of Katakoro Shan . Description . The location for Quaraband always possessed rich pastures for the Tuigan horses and other livestock , and easy access to the rivers and streams passing through the area . The only permanent structures were a pair of large stone lions that were gifts from the emperor of Shou Lung . The tents and yurts of the city were arranged according to the " yurtchis " — the city officials who were in charge of the camp . The yurts were placed according to station , water needs , and blood feuds . Defenses . One of Yamun Khahan ' s favorite locations for his capital was a stretch of land that was several miles in diameter .

title: Quarrel
description: Quarrel Quarrel was a half - orc assassin in the service of Tyranthraxus . Description . Quarrel was a slender and powerful female humanoid with black hair , jet colored eyes , and a nose .
description_long: Quarrel Quarrel was a half - orc assassin in the service of Tyranthraxus . Description . Quarrel was a slender and powerful female humanoid with black hair , jet colored eyes , and a nose . Personality . Slim and beautiful , spoke with a rough voice and could not escape her orc heritage . She hoped Tyranthraxus would reward her for killing Shal Bal , Tarl Desanea , and Ren o ' the Blade with transforming her orcish nose into a human one . Possessions . In battle , Quarrel armed herself with her favorite dagger and wore dark over her chain mail . As a secondary weapon , Quarrel equipped herself with a small scimitar . History . In 1340 DR , Quarrel and her assassin guild searched Sembia for ioun stone s . Two weeks later , she was hired by the " Possessing Spirit " to either persuade the heroes of Phlan to join the " Lord of the Ruins " or die . Death . A day later on the 28th of Flamerule 1340 DR , Quarrel met the heroes in the Laughing Goblin Inn but they refused to join Tyranthraxus , so she threw her poisoned dagger at Shal and fled . During a short melee in the inn , Quarrel had her skull crushed in under the hooves of Shal ' s horse familiar , Cerulean .

title: Quarren Urmbrusk
description: Quarren Urmbrusk Quarren Urmbrusk was the lord of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep until 1476 DR . Activities . Quarren was the lord of Urmbrusk , a house known for providing moneylending and land - buying services to many merchants and temples .
description_long: Quarren Urmbrusk Quarren Urmbrusk was the lord of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep until 1476 DR . Activities . Quarren was the lord of Urmbrusk , a house known for providing moneylending and land - buying services to many merchants and temples . History . In 1476 DR , he abandoned his duty in order to go on adventure . He granted control of the House to his sister Lestra Urmbrusk and also granted her the custody of his son , Rutherford Urmbrusk . Quarren then gathered an adventuring party and went into Undermountain . However , Lestra bribed Quarren ' s companions in order to make sure that he never came back from the dungeon . Nobody of that group ever returned . However , in 1479 DR , a voice like Quarren ' s started whispering Rutherford ' s ears .

title: Quarters of the Unclean
description: Quarters of the Unclean The Quarters of the Unclean was the name of the poor sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . This quarter lay outside of the protective walls of the city .
description_long: Quarters of the Unclean The Quarters of the Unclean was the name of the poor sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . This quarter lay outside of the protective walls of the city . It was crowded with small hovels that leaned against each other for support . Tiny walkways were present but were easily congested . Thieves could easily disappear within the cramped confines of the Quarters of the Unclean .

title: Quarterstaff
description: Quarterstaff A quarterstaff ( plural quarterstaves ) is a simple , two - handed melee weapon that may be used as a double weapon . Description . Six to eight feet ( 1 .
description_long: Quarterstaff A quarterstaff ( plural quarterstaves ) is a simple , two - handed melee weapon that may be used as a double weapon . Description . Six to eight feet ( 1 . 8 to 2 . 4 meters ) long for a human - sized creature , a quarterstaff is usually made of wood and sanded cylindrical with a diameter of 2 to 4 inches ( 5 to 10cm ) , with blunt ends . They may be plain wood to intricately carved works of art . The basic quarterstaff can be enhanced with metal - shod ends or textured striking surfaces which increase weight and / or cost . A typical quarterstaff weighs 4lbs ( 1 . 8kg ) and costs nothing because it can be easily made with little skill . Metal enhancements will likely cost extra . Weaponology . The quarterstaff is one of the simplest weapons available to any adventurer . Favored among martial artists , monk s , and some ranger s , the quarterstaff may be used as a double weapon . Wizard s often use enchanted quarterstaves to channel arcane energy and as a mundane walking - stick .

title: Quarterstaff of Battle
description: Quarterstaff of Battle A Quarterstaff of Battle is a improved magic + 3 Quarterstaff of Speed . It is immune to all slashing and piercing damage and gives the wielder a great bonus to his or her ability to disarm opponents , as though he or she had the " Improved Disarm " feat . The staff can be used up to three times per day to deflect medium - sized or smaller projectiles for twelve seconds , including ranged attacks from spells of level 2 or lower , provided they are aimed within five feet ( 1 .
description_long: Quarterstaff of Battle A Quarterstaff of Battle is a improved magic + 3 Quarterstaff of Speed . It is immune to all slashing and piercing damage and gives the wielder a great bonus to his or her ability to disarm opponents , as though he or she had the " Improved Disarm " feat . The staff can be used up to three times per day to deflect medium - sized or smaller projectiles for twelve seconds , including ranged attacks from spells of level 2 or lower , provided they are aimed within five feet ( 1 . 5m ) of the wielder . Once a day , the wielder can use the staff to make a " battlestrike " which is twice as powerful as a normal strike , or up to three times as powerful with a critical strike . This attack might stun or knock over the opponent . In addition , the staff can be used once a day to create a " repulsion " effect . It is worth around 160 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Quasimagical item
description: Quasimagical item A quasimagical item was an item that acted as a permanently activated magical item , provided that it remained within range of a " mythallar " . History . The great Netherese arcanist Ioulaum created the first quasimagical item in −3011 DR .
description_long: Quasimagical item A quasimagical item was an item that acted as a permanently activated magical item , provided that it remained within range of a " mythallar " . History . The great Netherese arcanist Ioulaum created the first quasimagical item in −3011 DR . It was a mantle that allowed one to see in the dark and read someone else ' s surface thoughts . After this , countless quasimagical items were produced , so many that Netheril was flooded with them , wrecking the economy for a time , as such items could be sold for a tenth of the cost of " real " magical item s , and those magical items rose in cost to triple the former price . Most quasimagical items were actually created with the common folk in mind , simple creations to assist in the everyday tasks of the middle class . The first such items to enter the markets were " roomlight s " , tiny globes that lit up upon command . Magical provision of running water and plumbing followed after . When the phaerimm cast their life - draining spell over the empire , the quasimagical items lost their power .

title: Quasit
description: Quasit Quasits are chaotic evil outsiders . Standing about 1 . 5 - 2 feet in size and weighing about 8 pounds , they resemble tiny humanoids with spiky horns and bat wings .
description_long: Quasit Quasits are chaotic evil outsiders . Standing about 1 . 5 - 2 feet in size and weighing about 8 pounds , they resemble tiny humanoids with spiky horns and bat wings . They are drawn to become the familiar s of mage s who match their demon ic alignment . A quasit is a tiny demon that delights in tormenting mortals with vicious – and often lethal – pranks . They delight in causing mischief and mayhem . Sometimes , a quasit will bind itself to a mortal spellcaster to act as a familiar . These demons do so as a means to corrupt the mortal wizard into using her magic as destructively as possible . Similar to its devil ish counterpart , the imp , the quasit is a tiny demon which strikes from ambush and uses shape shifting ( via its Alternate Shape ability ) and invisibility to enter combat at the best moment to administer its poison . Though weak , it still has the innate qualities of a demon , and quasits rarely attack alone or without the ability to escape . For these reasons , it is still a somewhat challenging foe for adventurers . Appearance . A tiny humanoid - shaped creature with spiky horns and bat wings hovers nearby .

title: Quavylene Oblodra
description: Quavylene Oblodra Quavylene Oblodra was the First Priestess of House Oblodra and daughter of matron mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Quavylene was the chosen victim of her mother ' s psychic tortures because she could not measure up to K ' yorl ' s extreme expectations .
description_long: Quavylene Oblodra Quavylene Oblodra was the First Priestess of House Oblodra and daughter of matron mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Quavylene was the chosen victim of her mother ' s psychic tortures because she could not measure up to K ' yorl ' s extreme expectations . Years of abuse transformed Quavylene into a broken shell who trembled at her mother ' s glance . Powers . Like all in her house , Quavylene had good psychic powers . History . Quavylene once conspired to kill Matron Mother K ' yorl but thanks to K ' yorl ' s ability to read minds , she was discovered and punished terribly .

title: Quayle
description: Quayle Quayle is a whiny , foul - tempered , arrogant gnome with a nasal voice who believes that he is a genius and that all those around him are idiots who should acknowledge his super - intelligence . He appears in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Games .
description_long: Quayle Quayle is a whiny , foul - tempered , arrogant gnome with a nasal voice who believes that he is a genius and that all those around him are idiots who should acknowledge his super - intelligence . He appears in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Games . Quayle was found lurking near the bridge to Baldur ' s Gate , and attempted to force his way into the party regardless of what was said to him . Quayle was the only party member in the first game capable of casting both arcane and divine spells . If placed in a party with Tiax , the two would argue a lot . In " " Quayle appeared again , transformed by powerful illusions into a slime by Kalah . Once rescued from that fate it appeared that Quayle ' s personality seemed to have mellowed , perhaps aided by the adoption of Aerie and conversion to the faith of Baervan Wildwanderer . In spite of having been near Baldur ' s Gate in the last game , he had also managed to spend some time in a circus touring Amn and Tethyr along with Aerie . Aerie may later name her child after him .

title: Qudra
description: Qudra Qudra , or the City of Power , was a major power in the northern reaches of Zakhara . Description . Qudra was a model of duty and organization .
description_long: Qudra Qudra , or the City of Power , was a major power in the northern reaches of Zakhara . Description . Qudra was a model of duty and organization . It overlooked the Great Sea from the mouth of Al - Faddi River about 300 miles ( 483 km ) northwest of Hiyal . Qudra served as Zakhara ' s bastion against the unenlightened lands outside its borders . The city ' s fortifications were increased over a long history of pirate raids and barbarian incursions . As of 1367 DR , Qudra had the strongest bulwarks in all of Zakhara , presenting a stern gray face to the north . History . Qudra was ruled by mamluk s who were fiercely devoted to the Grand Caliph in Huzuz . It was considered one of the three great cities of Zakhara . This city was noted for its well run and well treated slave market , its mamluks , amor , and trade in northern goods .

title: Queen ' s Fury
description: Queen ' s Fury The Queen ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of Catharyn of Dambrath . Description . The flag of Queen ' s Fury was a dolphin jumping over a ship .
description_long: Queen ' s Fury The Queen ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of Catharyn of Dambrath . Description . The flag of Queen ' s Fury was a dolphin jumping over a ship . The sight of this flag struck terror into the hearts of any ship on the Great Sea . Activities . The Queen ' s Fury was sailed from Dambrath across the Great Sea to raid as far west as Nimbral on the Trackless Sea .

title: Queen ' s Market
description: Queen ' s Market The Queen ' s Market was one of two major marketplaces in the city of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr . It was located west of Star Street in the Royal Quarter in the northern half of the city , northeast of Ithal Crag and the palace of Faerntarn . The Sea Lions ' Pride , an historic festhall within the city , was located just off the Queen ' s Market .
description_long: Queen ' s Market The Queen ' s Market was one of two major marketplaces in the city of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr . It was located west of Star Street in the Royal Quarter in the northern half of the city , northeast of Ithal Crag and the palace of Faerntarn . The Sea Lions ' Pride , an historic festhall within the city , was located just off the Queen ' s Market . Market fees to sell in the Queen ' s Market were 3 " donsars " ( copper pieces ) per day during the colder months of Marpenoth through Tarsakh . The fee was raised to 3 " paxars " ( silver pieces ) per day from Mirtul to Eleint and a full " aenar " ( gold piece ) on Greencourt and Harvestcourt .

title: Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades
description: Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades was a secret society of spies and assassins working to maintain order within the kingdom of Cormyr . Activities . Under Toraunt Hawkgar , the Blades did their best to keep a low profile , as rumours of their activities made it more likely that their identities would be revealed by the War Wizards , whose attentions they avoided to the utmost .
description_long: Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades was a secret society of spies and assassins working to maintain order within the kingdom of Cormyr . Activities . Under Toraunt Hawkgar , the Blades did their best to keep a low profile , as rumours of their activities made it more likely that their identities would be revealed by the War Wizards , whose attentions they avoided to the utmost . The Blades killed or otherwise disrupted the plans of seditious citizens and nobles who worked against the Crown . This included smugglers and tax evaders as well as those guilty of high treason . They also surreptitiously fostered trade alliances between other nobles , endeavouring to get their targets to make beneficial deals publically rather than in secret . Goals . The Blades worked towards Queen Filfaeril ' s vision of Cormyr , a vision they dubbed " Fee ' s Fire " . In it , a kingdom is believed to be most secure when it ' s people are busy and prosperous and that those who know they will be rewarded for doing so , are more likely to be law - abiding .

title: Queen of Chaos
description: Queen of Chaos The Queen of Chaos is a demon lord of obyrith origins . She became listed as an obyrith in the third edition supplement " " . Description .
description_long: Queen of Chaos The Queen of Chaos is a demon lord of obyrith origins . She became listed as an obyrith in the third edition supplement " " . Description . The Queen of Chaos has the upper torso of a corpulent , blue - skinned humanoid female , whereas her lower body is a mass of ten mauve tentacles . Hidden in the tentacles is a razor sharp parrot - like beak . The Queen has long drooping locks of green hair , and she wears a sahuagin skull as a crown . Her weapon of choice is a huge trident . Relationships . As one of the oldest of the obyrith lords , the Queen of Chaos is said to have created Demogorgon as the first of all tanar ' ri , then discarded him when he grew too unruly . The Queen was the lover of Miska the Wolf - Spider , and is the mistress of the spyder - fiend s . She was once allied with Bwimb . The Queen of Chaos has many enemies , including Obox - ob , whom she dethroned , and the . Realm . The Steaming Fen is an Abyssal layer consisting of a vast swamp and a turbulent ocean . The layer seethes with vermin and is the home of the spyder - fiends . With Miska ' s imprisonment , the spyder - fiends begrudgingly serve the Queen of Chaos . History .

title: Queenspire
description: Queenspire The Queenspire was a temple of Umberlee within Deepwater Harbor in Waterdeep . Location . The building was located on a large rocky outcropping of a sandbar south of the city off the South Ward .
description_long: Queenspire The Queenspire was a temple of Umberlee within Deepwater Harbor in Waterdeep . Location . The building was located on a large rocky outcropping of a sandbar south of the city off the South Ward . History . After discovering a magic abalone shell floating in Waterdeep harbor in 1369 DR , Dread High Trident Meritid Archneie took it as a good omen and petitioned the Lords of Waterdeep to allow him to construct a temple to Umberlee in the city . The Lords consented and construction was nearing completion in 1372 DR .

title: Quelaerel
