description: Quelaerel Quelaeral ( pronounced " kwel - " air " - ell " ) was a spicy brown sauce made by boiling leech es found in the Abyssal layers of Shedaklah and the Slugbed . This delicacy was prized by Calishite gourmands and was used in other cuisines of Southern Faerûn .
description_long: Quelaerel Quelaeral ( pronounced " kwel - " air " - ell " ) was a spicy brown sauce made by boiling leech es found in the Abyssal layers of Shedaklah and the Slugbed . This delicacy was prized by Calishite gourmands and was used in other cuisines of Southern Faerûn .

title: Quelamia
description: Quelamia Quelamia was an Eladrin mage and the most powerful wizard in the employ of House Serrat of Delzimmer . She was so important to the family ' s business that she was given a percentage of profits , something no other employee received . Description .
description_long: Quelamia Quelamia was an Eladrin mage and the most powerful wizard in the employ of House Serrat of Delzimmer . She was so important to the family ' s business that she was given a percentage of profits , something no other employee received . Description . Quelamia had blond hair and blue pupil - less eyes . History . Quelamia was originally from the Feywild although it ' s unknown when she first came to Toril At some point in her life she was a war wizard but gave up the profession for more peaceful pursuits decades before 1479 DR . In 1364 DR , the evil yuan - ti god Zehir appeared to Quelamia and enlisted her aid . In exchange for aiding Zaltys Serrat in her quest to free her birth clan from enslavement by derro , Zehir agreed to help destroy the derro ' s portal to the Far Realm . Because as an Eladrin Quelamia was part of the natural world , she considered the Far Realm to be the antithesis of everything she believed in and thought temporarily allying with an evil god was the lesser evil . In 1479 DR Zaltys learned that her original clan had been abducted rather than killed by derro and she adventured into the Underdark to free them .

title: Quell
description: Quell Quell are ghostly undead creatures that despise the concept of life and the connection the living have to the gods . In essence , they hate the act of worship and the very presence of a quell can isolate a worshiper from the touch of their god . This power is called " intercession " .
description_long: Quell Quell are ghostly undead creatures that despise the concept of life and the connection the living have to the gods . In essence , they hate the act of worship and the very presence of a quell can isolate a worshiper from the touch of their god . This power is called " intercession " . A quell can lash out at a divine spellcaster of any deity and prevent him or her from using their power . Several quell can work together to " intercede " against even high - level clerics . Because of their unique abilities , quell are often used by necromancers to protect themselves from divine powers . As creatures of death and darkness , quell are powerless in daylight and will try and flee from it .

title: Quelsandas
description: Quelsandas Quelsandas was a mature adult bronze dragon allied with Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl of Impiltur agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout .
description_long: Quelsandas Quelsandas was a mature adult bronze dragon allied with Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl of Impiltur agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout . Among the expedition force there were also six bronze dragon s , one being Quelsandas . However , Quelsandas had previously made an agreement with Sammaster to betray his human allies in exchange for being spared from the effects of the Rage . Thus , at the chosen time , just before ambushing the cultist army , he surprised and turned on the Impilturan troops , casting a spell to drive the other bronze dragons into a frenzy . Unfortunately , Quelsandas found himself betrayed as well ; though promised immunity , he cried out in despair as he , too , was afflicted . Taegan and the paladin lord Rangrim managed to kill the traitorous bronze , but the paladin died in the fight .

title: Quelzarn
description: Quelzarn A quelzarn was a giant , eel - like water snake that was able to dwell in most kinds of large bodies of water . Description . Quelzarn looked like eels and had slimy green or brown skin .
description_long: Quelzarn A quelzarn was a giant , eel - like water snake that was able to dwell in most kinds of large bodies of water . Description . Quelzarn looked like eels and had slimy green or brown skin . The slime was often covered in growing weeds and moss . A quelzarn was usually around 30 – 40 feet long and had a spine - like fin along its back , as well as a crest on its head . It had a large fin covering each of its two gills , located behind its jaws . There was a variant of quelzarn known as a greater quelzarn . Habitat . Quelzarn could dwell in fresh - or saltwater and were highly tolerant of pollution . They could be found in tropical , subtropical , and temperate waters . They were solitary creatures . Quelzarn were attracted to magical items . They were sometimes mistaken for naga s . Combat . Quelzarn would eat any living thing . They could use a " hold monster " ability to freeze their prey before snatching it with their jaws . Prey were swallowed hole , left to drown inside the quelzarn ' s gullet . Quelzarn were highly resistant to magic and immune to all electrical attacks . Uses . The quelzarn ' s digestive juices served as a strong acid .

title: Quelzur Naismen
description: Quelzur Naismen Quelzur Naisen was a Red Wizards of Thay pirate in 1359 DR . History . Quelzur was a talented wizard but frequently went in contrast with his superiors and was no prone to make friends .
description_long: Quelzur Naismen Quelzur Naisen was a Red Wizards of Thay pirate in 1359 DR . History . Quelzur was a talented wizard but frequently went in contrast with his superiors and was no prone to make friends . So when he offended the powerful zulkir Szass Tam Quelzur decided to voluntary exile instead to risk to become one of the Tam ' s zombie s . Quickly he turned to piracy and become a very able pirate thank to his " censer for summoning air elementals " , that transformed his ship in ones of the most maneuverable vessel on the Inner Sea . Personality . Quelzur maintained the typical mentality of a Red Wizard , that wizard were superiors to any non - wizards people . He lorded over his crew like a godling . He still dressed like a red wizard .

title: Quenthel Baenre
description: Quenthel Baenre Quenthel Baenre was a drow priestess , and the third daughter of Yvonnel Baenre . She was the Mistress of Arach - Tinilith , the clerical school of Menzoberranzan , and later Matron Mother of First House Baenre . She first appeared as a minor , supporting character in the final three books in the Legacy of the Drow series before rising to prominence in the War of the Spider Queen series which further expanded on her character .
description_long: Quenthel Baenre Quenthel Baenre was a drow priestess , and the third daughter of Yvonnel Baenre . She was the Mistress of Arach - Tinilith , the clerical school of Menzoberranzan , and later Matron Mother of First House Baenre . She first appeared as a minor , supporting character in the final three books in the Legacy of the Drow series before rising to prominence in the War of the Spider Queen series which further expanded on her character . Description . Quenthel was described as strong and beautiful . She was also noted for maintaining a regal and noble bearing even in the heat of battle as well as being somewhat larger than other drow . Personality . Quenthel was the epitome of a noble drow female ; she was cold , ruthless , selfish , cunning , ambitious and arrogant . As a rule , she did not allow insubordination or disrespect ( usually countering such behaviour with physical harm or death ) . Despite this , she endured several taunts and jibes from Pharaun Mizzrym due to him being her only source of magic during the Silence of Lolth . Raised as a noble in Menzoberranzan , she was used to getting her way and having her commands followed without question .

title: Quentin Bodeau
description: Quentin Bodeau Pasha Quentin Bodeau was the most recent leader of House Pook , a thieves guild in Calimport . He started as a thief and became master of the house after the death of Pook and the disappearance of Regis . The house ' s wizard , LaValle , considered him a good man and a competent master .
description_long: Quentin Bodeau Pasha Quentin Bodeau was the most recent leader of House Pook , a thieves guild in Calimport . He started as a thief and became master of the house after the death of Pook and the disappearance of Regis . The house ' s wizard , LaValle , considered him a good man and a competent master .

title: Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar
description: Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , also known as the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " , are five sets of 10 Nether Scrolls each , changed into the form of a tree . The empire of Netheril had acquired a set of the Nether Scrolls , explaining their rapid rise and their mastery of magic . The elves arranged for the scrolls theft from the Netherese , and secreted them away in Windsong Tower , in the city of Myth Drannor .
description_long: Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , also known as the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " , are five sets of 10 Nether Scrolls each , changed into the form of a tree . The empire of Netheril had acquired a set of the Nether Scrolls , explaining their rapid rise and their mastery of magic . The elves arranged for the scrolls theft from the Netherese , and secreted them away in Windsong Tower , in the city of Myth Drannor . The elves learned that the scrolls had to be read in order , and also that every race that read them learned different information . For example , one of the main thieves of the scrolls was Rilmohx Sha ' Quessir , a gnome elf - friend who learned a vast knowledge of illusion magic by glancing only briefly through the scrolls . The elves also learned that altering the scroll ' s form into something different allowed for hidden meanings to be revealed . A High Mage named Tyvollus Aluviirsan therefore transformed the metal scrolls into a thin golden beech tree , with golden metal leaves , and with its trunk in the face of a treant . In the tree ' s foliage are a small silver bird and a snake with golden , silver , and electrum scales .

title: Quessahn Uthraebor
description: Quessahn Uthraebor Quessahn Uthraebor is a warlock living in Waterdeep . Hundreds of years ago , she lived in the High Forest and was married to a deva named Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn but he was killed soon after their marriage . Quess studied at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep and also received tutlage from the Avolakia Briarbones .
description_long: Quessahn Uthraebor Quessahn Uthraebor is a warlock living in Waterdeep . Hundreds of years ago , she lived in the High Forest and was married to a deva named Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn but he was killed soon after their marriage . Quess studied at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep and also received tutlage from the Avolakia Briarbones . Many years later , she chanced upon a newer incarnation of Jinnaoth and they became friends although Jinnaoth didn ' t remember that they were married in one of his past lives . Quessahn helped Jinnaoth stop the ritual of the First Flensing which would have allowed the evil deity Asmodeus to enter Waterdeep .

title: Quesseer
description: Quesseer Quesseer was a Netherese settlement founded in - 2368 DR by Arthindol the Terraseer , just to the north of the Sword Mountains . During its lifetime , the town became a trading center for the towns of Illusk and Waterdeep , as well as for the elves of the forests of Illefarn . It was eventually abandoned in - 2095 DR due to the destruction of Illusk by an orcish horde from the North and the threat of destruction as well .
description_long: Quesseer Quesseer was a Netherese settlement founded in - 2368 DR by Arthindol the Terraseer , just to the north of the Sword Mountains . During its lifetime , the town became a trading center for the towns of Illusk and Waterdeep , as well as for the elves of the forests of Illefarn . It was eventually abandoned in - 2095 DR due to the destruction of Illusk by an orcish horde from the North and the threat of destruction as well .

title: Quest
description: Quest Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded a subject to undertake a task and return with proof the task had been completed . Effects . This divine version of the old " geas " spell could be used to coerce a creature to perform a significant task but unwilling subjects had a chance to resist , especially if the quest was unjust or undeserved .
description_long: Quest Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded a subject to undertake a task and return with proof the task had been completed . Effects . This divine version of the old " geas " spell could be used to coerce a creature to perform a significant task but unwilling subjects had a chance to resist , especially if the quest was unjust or undeserved . If the subject agreed to the quest , even under duress or through deception , this spell was irresistible . Members of the same religion as the caster were also powerless to resist a " quest " , and creatures of the same alignment as the caster were much more likely to succumb . Under the burden of this spell , any procrastination or perversion of the quest ' s instructions resulted in a daily reduction in luck such that it became more and more difficult to avoid harm , sickness , and disease ( not to mention breath weapons and petrification ) . This bad luck accumulated until the subject earnestly pursued the quest and persisted until the quest was completed . The caster could dismiss the " quest " at any time , or temporarily suspend the quest if the circumstances warranted .

title: Questele
description: Questele Questele was a moon elf mage and member of Moonstars . History . In 1486 DR Questele ' s duty was to protect the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .
description_long: Questele Questele was a moon elf mage and member of Moonstars . History . In 1486 DR Questele ' s duty was to protect the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn . However , she was killed by the reaver captain Anton Marivaldi , who tried to collect the bounty on Stedd .

title: Quickling
description: Quickling Quicklings were a rare breed of brownie that were once like any other brownies , but they sought out dark and powerful magic . It was unknown whether they sought the power for altruistic purposes or not , but it was known that the power corrupted them entirely . They became savage hunters who were particularly cruel in their methods of killing .
description_long: Quickling Quicklings were a rare breed of brownie that were once like any other brownies , but they sought out dark and powerful magic . It was unknown whether they sought the power for altruistic purposes or not , but it was known that the power corrupted them entirely . They became savage hunters who were particularly cruel in their methods of killing . They hated humanoids of all kinds and wished nothing more than to kill them all . They were exceptionally adept ventriloquists , which they used to fool others into traps or other dangerous situations . Due to to their hyperactive behavior , no quickling ever lived past fifteen years . Society . Quicklings sought out dark and evil places and lived in a clan structure with their extended families . They favored poisoned or corrupted natural dwellings such as twisted groves of trees ; poisoned , cursed or diseased springs ; or lands once ruled over by chaotic beings that had become overgrown . They avoided outside contact unless it helped them to promote their own evil desires . such as contacting evil outsiders or wizards to offer their services as trackers and assassins .

title: Quickstrike
description: Quickstrike Quickstrike was possibly the last specimen of slug - like creatures called gravecrawler or ancestor worm s . Description . Quickstrike had a gray , plump , segmented body with a hairless and eyeless man - like head .
description_long: Quickstrike Quickstrike was possibly the last specimen of slug - like creatures called gravecrawler or ancestor worm s . Description . Quickstrike had a gray , plump , segmented body with a hairless and eyeless man - like head . His physiology allowed him only a crawling movement . He emanated an aura of petrification causing agony and paralysis in living creatures and eventually turning any living or dead creature to stone . History . In the first years of his existence , he ate the flesh of the corpses , absorbing their knowledge and wisdom . In 1375 DR , the bard Bareris Anskuld stumbled upon Quickstrike during his escape from undead pursuers .

title: Quiet Multitude
description: Quiet Multitude The Quiet Multitude was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The Quiet Multitude did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .
description_long: Quiet Multitude The Quiet Multitude was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The Quiet Multitude did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities . Mystics of the Quiet Multitude worshiped Selan by meditating under the moonlight . As of 1367 DR , there were dozens of sub - sects of the Quiet Multitude across Zakhara , each with their own unique way of worshiping the goddess . The different sects usually did not get along with each other . Base of Operations . Beginning in the mid 1200s DR , the Quiet Multitude rapidly spread throughout all of Zakhara , creating unique sects within every major city on the continent .

title: Quil ' bryn
description: Quil ' bryn Quil ' bryn was a mad drow in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Quil ' bryn was a member of the Drow Resistance against the invading fire giant s .
description_long: Quil ' bryn Quil ' bryn was a mad drow in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Quil ' bryn was a member of the Drow Resistance against the invading fire giant s . However , he was infected by a kind of hedonistic madness and murdered the archmage Solom Ned ' razak . Afterward , Quil ' bryn , despite the objections of Murssvayas Dhuurniv , tried to convince all drow to abandon Szith Morcane . Personality . In his madness , Quil ' bryn wanted to live again in a great drow city , with many slaves at his disposal , focusing only on enjoying life .

title: Quildan Oussgyhm
description: Quildan Oussgyhm Quildan Oussghym was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron father of the Jaezred Chaulssin in Karsoluthiyl in 1374 DR . History . Quildan was the patron father responsible for the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s activities in Karsoluthiyl , namely marginalizing the matriarchy and thus the influence of Lolth ' s dogma while tilting the balance of power towards merchants who funded more of the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s actions during the Silence of Lolth .
description_long: Quildan Oussgyhm Quildan Oussghym was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron father of the Jaezred Chaulssin in Karsoluthiyl in 1374 DR . History . Quildan was the patron father responsible for the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s activities in Karsoluthiyl , namely marginalizing the matriarchy and thus the influence of Lolth ' s dogma while tilting the balance of power towards merchants who funded more of the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s actions during the Silence of Lolth . It seemed that he was a relative newcomer to the leading council of the Jaezred Chaulssin . The basis for this is that he had the service of his unnamed predecessor ' s guinea pig Othimturac , a white dragon who was 25 years at oldest which means that Quildan took office at some point during these 25 years . In 1374 DR , during a sojourn in the Plane of Shadow , he was hit by a spell from a malaugrym sorcerer that made his body unstable . The effect was that Quildan rapidly and continually changed between dragon and drow form and vice versa . Soon he dispatched a messenger to Chaussin asking for help . However , in despair , Quildan ' s minions decided to also kidnap the malaugrym Amarune and demand a cure .

title: Quillan
description: Quillan Quillan was the sage of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Quillan was focused on local flora , always trying to respond to questions with something related to flowers or plants .
description_long: Quillan Quillan was the sage of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Quillan was focused on local flora , always trying to respond to questions with something related to flowers or plants . Despite looking a bit senile , he was very intelligent and hardy . He was a good historian . History . Quillan originally was a druid . Quillan saw the lives and death of two barons of the Barony of Bloodstone . He teach Christine Dragonsbane the ways of the druids . In 1359 DR , he worked as an advisor to King Gareth Dragonsbane but still prided himself with teaching Christine .

title: Quimby
description: Quimby Quimby was a mage of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived some time prior to 882 DR . Quimby was a devoted gourmand but an impatient cook . For aid in meal preparation , Quimby modified the " unseen servant " spell to create " Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet " .
description_long: Quimby Quimby was a mage of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived some time prior to 882 DR . Quimby was a devoted gourmand but an impatient cook . For aid in meal preparation , Quimby modified the " unseen servant " spell to create " Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet " .

title: Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet
description: Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet was an arcane conjuration spell dedicated to cooking and cleaning up a kitchen afterwards . Effect . It was a specialized version of the " unseen servant " spell , capable only of activities related to cooking and other kitchen tasks .
description_long: Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet was an arcane conjuration spell dedicated to cooking and cleaning up a kitchen afterwards . Effect . It was a specialized version of the " unseen servant " spell , capable only of activities related to cooking and other kitchen tasks . Components . The spell required a block of wood and some string as material components . History . Quimby , a mage of the city of Procampur in the the Vast , was a devoted gourmand but an impatient cook . For aid in meal preparation , Quimby modified the " unseen servant " spell to create " Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet " . Due to its narrow usefulness , it was not often studied by adventuring mages and remained a rare spell into the 1360s DR . It was more often used by sedentary or retired wizards and sages . Though it was incapable of brewing potions , it was sometimes put to use creating simple poison s , and once served as a bartender . A copy of " Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet " could be found in Jaluster ' s Orizon , the last traveling spellbook of the mage Jaluster ( ? – 882 DR ) .

title: Quimby ( Easthaven )
description: Quimby ( Easthaven ) Quimby was the owner of the Snowdrift Inn in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . He was a large man who wore a brown outfit .
description_long: Quimby ( Easthaven ) Quimby was the owner of the Snowdrift Inn in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . He was a large man who wore a brown outfit . History . In Eleint , 1281 DR , Quimby provided room and board for the elven adventurer Erevain Blacksheaf , before Hrothgar lead his expedition to Kuldahar .

title: Quinan Varnaed
description: Quinan Varnaed Quinan Varnaed was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Personality . Quinan was a cruel and sadistic man but respected by all in the slave market of Skullport .
description_long: Quinan Varnaed Quinan Varnaed was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Personality . Quinan was a cruel and sadistic man but respected by all in the slave market of Skullport . He did not trust his yuan - ti co - leader , Zstulkk Ssarmn . History . Quinan grew up in a small village in Sembia , where his family treated him very poorly . He abandoned his family and joined the Zhentilar . After a terrible battle in which he was left dying , Quinan was saved by Loviatar . Out of gratitude , Quinan joined the church of Loviatar and went first to Waterdeep , then later Skullport . In Skullport , Quinan offered his services to slavers , quickly entering the slave trade . In 1363 DR , he convinced fellow slaver and yuan - ti abomination Zstulkk Ssarmn to found the Iron Ring Consortium . Quinan was the informal leader of the group . The only barrier to his complete takeover of the organization was Zstulkk , whom he kept at bay .

title: Quinix
description: Quinix Quinix was a glabrezu living in the ruins of the Gate of Iron Fangs on the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . Activities . He traveled through a portal into the Forest of Amtar .
description_long: Quinix Quinix was a glabrezu living in the ruins of the Gate of Iron Fangs on the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . Activities . He traveled through a portal into the Forest of Amtar . The ruins of the gate were also the home of a large tribe of gnoll s whom he easily took control over . The gnolls thought that he was a representative of their " god " Yeenoghu . The gnolls were more organized than before and he used them for raids in the near area from Dambrath , Channathgate and Rethmar . He planned to recruit humans as spies and soldiers . The Swagdar seemed the best suited for this task . His ultimate goal was to raid Halruaa since the magically rich country promised the best profit .

title: Quinn Nardrosz
description: Quinn Nardrosz Quinn Nardrosz was a retired ranger in Jalanthar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Quinn was the head of the council that ruled the village .
description_long: Quinn Nardrosz Quinn Nardrosz was a retired ranger in Jalanthar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Quinn was the head of the council that ruled the village . He was also a member of the Emerald Enclave . History . Quinn was a famed ranger , known for a fierce battle against an Uthgardt barbarian of the Red Tiger Tribe . Quinn lost his left ear but defeated the enemy . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Quinn retired in Jalanthar but remained an active member of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Quiral
description: Quiral Quiral was a human blacksmith and ex - adventurer who lived in Espar , Cormyr as of 1368 DR . Activities . The blacksmith was known for creating high quality sword s , although his methods were slow and careful .
description_long: Quiral Quiral was a human blacksmith and ex - adventurer who lived in Espar , Cormyr as of 1368 DR . Activities . The blacksmith was known for creating high quality sword s , although his methods were slow and careful . He treated swordmaking as a hobby rather than a business .

title: Quirish
description: Quirish The Quirish were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Quirish lived in the central region of the Hordelands .
description_long: Quirish The Quirish were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Quirish lived in the central region of the Hordelands . Their territory bordered the lands of the Oigur , Tuigan , Zamogedi , Fankiang , and Kashghun tribes . Society . They spoke their own language . They were considered rivals of the Fankiang but were strongly allied with the Zamogedi . They sometimes raided the Naican s . History . The Quirish were descended from the same ancestors as the Zamogedi . Their strong blood ties led to a lasting alliance . For many long years , the Fankiang had raided the Quirish , and " vice versa " . The Quirish , being a smaller tribe , were at a disadvantage .

title: Quirish language
description: Quirish language Quirish was a tribal language of the Hordelands . Description . The grammar of Quirish had a subject – object – verb order .
description_long: Quirish language Quirish was a tribal language of the Hordelands . Description . The grammar of Quirish had a subject – object – verb order . Long I and E vowels were drawn out . Consonants , especially its Ks , were harsh . The language was nasal , and Ls were also aspirated . Script . Quirish did not have a written script . History . Scholars classified Quirish both as an Eastern and as a Southern Imaskari language . It was strongly influenced by Muhjuri and by the Shou Chiang languages of Shou Lung .

title: Quiver of Anariel
description: Quiver of Anariel The quiver of Anariel was a magical arrow quiver which automatically replenished its ammunition . Description . The quiver of Anariel looked like any other ordinary arrow quiver , holding twenty arrows .
description_long: Quiver of Anariel The quiver of Anariel was a magical arrow quiver which automatically replenished its ammunition . Description . The quiver of Anariel looked like any other ordinary arrow quiver , holding twenty arrows . It weighed 1 lb ( 0 . 45 kg ) . Powers . This quiver automatically refilled itself with regular or magical arrows , ensuring that it was always full . An arrow quickly disappeared if it was not used , however . A quiver of Anariel could be fashioned that produced basic arrows , masterwork arrows , or a range of magical arrows , at increasing costs : They could also have heads formed from special materials for extra cost , including adamantine ( + 6000 gp ) , alchemical silver ( + 200 gp ) , or cold iron ( + 4005 ) . History . Lady Anariel once gifted one of these quivers along with the bow " Taulmaril " to Clan Battlehammer at Mithril Hall . In 1356 DR , the Companions of the Hall explored the ruins of Mithril Hall and Regis discovered Taulmaril and the quiver in a crack in a stone wall . They gave both quiver and bow to Catti - brie , and she went on to use both in many battles .

title: Quiver of plenty
description: Quiver of plenty The Quiver of Plenty was a magic al quiver capable of producing an unlimited number of magical arrow s . History . The history of the quiver of plenty was unknown , apparently forgotten by 1368 DR .
description_long: Quiver of plenty The Quiver of Plenty was a magic al quiver capable of producing an unlimited number of magical arrow s . History . The history of the quiver of plenty was unknown , apparently forgotten by 1368 DR . However , it was thought to be related to the well documented but unexplainable shortage of skilled fletcher s during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . A quiver of plenty was found in an armoire in Watcher ' s Keep in Amn in 1368 DR . Creation . Operating from Cespenar ' s Forge in the Abyssal Fortress , the imp Cespenar was able to upgrade a quiver of plenty + 1 to a quiver of plenty + 2 if given 10 , 000 gp and a rogue stone . Powers . The quiver of plenty + 1 created unlimited + 1 arrows , while the quiver of plenty + 2 created unlimited + 2 arrows .

title: Quivering Forest
description: Quivering Forest The Quivering Forest was a forest stretching from the foothills of the Dragonspine Mountains in the north to within a mile of Phlan in the south . It acted as a barrier to the great gray waste of Thar to the east . The Quivering Forest lay mainly on the east bank of the River Stojanow .
description_long: Quivering Forest The Quivering Forest was a forest stretching from the foothills of the Dragonspine Mountains in the north to within a mile of Phlan in the south . It acted as a barrier to the great gray waste of Thar to the east . The Quivering Forest lay mainly on the east bank of the River Stojanow . Ecology . Morcant burl , a purple - hued hardwood , grew only in the Quivering Forest . History . The Quivering Forest was first planted as a copse of trees at the time Phlan was founded , c . 367 DR . Due to its magical nature , it grew to a great forest in the span of a single human generation . When the Netherese destroyed Zhentil Keep in 1383 DR , Lord Cvaal Daoran made a pact with the dark fey of the Quivering Forest , promising not to log or travel in the forest in exchange for their aid . In 1456 DR , Lord Talaric Daoran sent loggers into the Quivering Forest , the next day he went missing from Phlan and was never seen again .

title: Quivering palm
description: Quivering palm The Quivering Palm is a spell or incantation used by Kane for dominating enemies . The spell is enhanced by a magical item , such as a ring , and activated through meditative incantation . A spectral hand will appear next to the subject , lightly brushing him or her .
description_long: Quivering palm The Quivering Palm is a spell or incantation used by Kane for dominating enemies . The spell is enhanced by a magical item , such as a ring , and activated through meditative incantation . A spectral hand will appear next to the subject , lightly brushing him or her . Though the subject doesn ' t feel different , the monk can now control the subject ' s body and emit pain and paralysis at will . Its effect are not permanent and wear away after a certain amount of time but the spells effects can be released on will by the enacting monk as well .

title: Quon Tok
description: Quon Tok Quon Tok was a bushi in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Quon Tok picked fights for a living .
description_long: Quon Tok Quon Tok was a bushi in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Quon Tok picked fights for a living . He was helped by his companion Jo Chuik , who organized bets about Quon ' s fighting . Obviously , Quon signaled to Jo Chuik if he thought he would win or lose so his companion could make the right bets .

title: Quorl Vemmil
description: Quorl Vemmil Quorl Vemmil was the first Tessarch on the Council of Six , the ruling council of Amn , and Lord of House Vemmil . He was cruel man who used his family business of alchemy , wine , and ale supply to conceal an underground trade in narcotic s to the south and east . Quorl died in 1345 DR after he plotted to frame the Meisarch Thayze Selemchant by unleashing a plague in Keczulla .
description_long: Quorl Vemmil Quorl Vemmil was the first Tessarch on the Council of Six , the ruling council of Amn , and Lord of House Vemmil . He was cruel man who used his family business of alchemy , wine , and ale supply to conceal an underground trade in narcotic s to the south and east . Quorl died in 1345 DR after he plotted to frame the Meisarch Thayze Selemchant by unleashing a plague in Keczulla . Thayze overcame the plot and forced Quorl and his priests to go to Keczulla , where they were killed , either by the plague , or other means .

title: Quorlinn
description: Quorlinn Quorlinn ( also spelled Quorlin ) was a lesser deity who was the god of the kenku race . History . A number of obscure myths told of the creation of Quorlinn and the kenku .
description_long: Quorlinn Quorlinn ( also spelled Quorlin ) was a lesser deity who was the god of the kenku race . History . A number of obscure myths told of the creation of Quorlinn and the kenku . It was said that a certain deity , a potent , non - lawful sky god , had experimented in creation , but the effort was a failure , producing only the strange god Quorlinn . The sky god was too embarrassed to own up to this . But after a series of legendary and dubious misadventures , in which Quorlinn used disguises , thieving , trickery , and guile , in which he lost a few tail feathers in the bargain , he finally proved his worth to his creator , who rewarded him with a race created in his own image : the kenku . Unfortunately , Quorlinn was less than excited by this . He didn ' t want the responsibility of being god to a whole race . So he taught the kenku the arts of disguise , theft , and magic , so they could look after themselves . Personality . Quorlinn was easily irritated , bad - tempered , snappy , and fickle , but not actually evil . He whined constantly about the responsibility of caring for the kenku , complaining that it weighed him down .

title: Qurth Forest
description: Qurth Forest The Qurth Forest was located along the southern coast of the Lake of Steam and just west of the city of Derlusk . Various towns and ruins bordered the forest with the Barony of the Great Oak on the southwest side . The River Scelptar flowed southwest from its source in the Qurth Forest into the Inner Sea .
description_long: Qurth Forest The Qurth Forest was located along the southern coast of the Lake of Steam and just west of the city of Derlusk . Various towns and ruins bordered the forest with the Barony of the Great Oak on the southwest side . The River Scelptar flowed southwest from its source in the Qurth Forest into the Inner Sea . After the Spellplague , the land was slowly turning into a desert , and the forest was a tiny remnant of its former self .

title: Quth - maren
description: Quth - maren Quth - maren were undead creatures created from flayed corpses by cleric s of Kiaransalee . Description . With every scrap of skin flayed from their bodies and their exposed muscles incessantly oozing acidic blood , the quth - maren were hideous creatures .
description_long: Quth - maren Quth - maren were undead creatures created from flayed corpses by cleric s of Kiaransalee . Description . With every scrap of skin flayed from their bodies and their exposed muscles incessantly oozing acidic blood , the quth - maren were hideous creatures . Unlike zombies , quth - maren did not decompose . Abilities . Intelligent adversaries and vicious in groups , quth - maren had a number of abilities that made them disturbing opponents . History . In 1372 DR , Dorina T ' sarran seized control of Szith Morcane and ordered the priestesses of Lolth there to be flayed and transformed into quth - marens .

title: Quthnorak
description: Quthnorak Quthnorak was a male mind flayer sorcerer who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Contemplative and inquisitive , especially concerning the Weave , Quthnorak was willing to collaborate with even non - illithids when it came to arcane matters .
description_long: Quthnorak Quthnorak was a male mind flayer sorcerer who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Contemplative and inquisitive , especially concerning the Weave , Quthnorak was willing to collaborate with even non - illithids when it came to arcane matters . He enjoyed reclining in a pool of briny fluid to relax . Abilities . Like most mind flayers , Quthnorak had an affinity for psionics and could readily control the minds of others . Despite this , Quthnorak had an abiding interest and talent for the arcane art . He developed his innate powers as a sorcerer to the point that he could cast spells such as " haste " and " alter self " . Possessions . Quthnorak wore a " ring of protection + 2 " and wrapped himself in a " cloak of charisma + 2 " Relationships . A cordial rivalry was established between Quthnorak and the beholder , Sekrr . Both of them had taken up residence in Vournoth ' s Mire and besides working on occasional magic al projects or defending the mire against intruders , they rarely interacted . History . By 1372 DR , Quthnorak had made Vournoth ' s Mire his home along with a beholder called Sekrr .

title: Quwen
description: Quwen Lord Quwen was the ruler of Ormath in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Quwen often led the city ' s patrols outside the walls of the city in order to clear the road of bandits .
description_long: Quwen Lord Quwen was the ruler of Ormath in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Quwen often led the city ' s patrols outside the walls of the city in order to clear the road of bandits . In 1370 DR , he was concerned by reports of lizardfolk activities in the Winterwood ; none of the squads he had sent were heard from again . Personality . Quwen was a true warrior at heart .

title: Quysszt
description: Quysszt Quysszt was a Zhentarim beholder . Activities . Usually Quysszt floated in the Zhentarim ' s headquarters , protected by an " invisibility " spell , spying upon the councilors under orders of Manshoon .
description_long: Quysszt Quysszt was a Zhentarim beholder . Activities . Usually Quysszt floated in the Zhentarim ' s headquarters , protected by an " invisibility " spell , spying upon the councilors under orders of Manshoon . History . In 1358 DR , after the failure of both Avaerl and Zalarth Bloodbrow , Manshoon decided to go himself and kill Elminster Aumar at Spellgard . So the High Lord of the Zhentarim ordered the wizard Belaghar to take care of Zhentil Keep and ordered Quysszt to control and eventually kill him and others if any treachery or misjudgments occurred during Manshoon ' s absence .

title: Qwo
description: Qwo Qwo was an old servant in Shou Lung . History . Qwo was the old family servant of Lady Wu , the wife of General Batu Min Ho .
description_long: Qwo Qwo was an old servant in Shou Lung . History . Qwo was the old family servant of Lady Wu , the wife of General Batu Min Ho . In 1359 , Qwo remained with his lady near the Emperor while Batu went to lead the campaign against the Tuigan . Lady Wu later discovered that there was a Tuigan spy inside the court and correctly deduced that the spy was the Minister of State Security Ting Mei Wan . Wu asked Qwo ' s help to arrest her . However , Qwo was killed along with Lady Wu and all other members of her house when soldiers in the service of Ting Mei Wan stormed the palace where they lived .

title: Qysari Rings
description: Qysari Rings Qysari Rings was the title given to the various magical rings made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . The name comes from " qysar " , an ancient term for " emperor " that Amahl Shoon III , the first in a long line of imperial rulers , adopted for his title . The rings were a subset of the " shoonring s " , a more general term for magic rings made in the Shoon Imperium during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , which had unique and distinguishing elements in their construction and enchantment .
description_long: Qysari Rings Qysari Rings was the title given to the various magical rings made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . The name comes from " qysar " , an ancient term for " emperor " that Amahl Shoon III , the first in a long line of imperial rulers , adopted for his title . The rings were a subset of the " shoonring s " , a more general term for magic rings made in the Shoon Imperium during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , which had unique and distinguishing elements in their construction and enchantment . There were twelve known " Qysari Rings " , as documented by the scribe Rativ ym Shoon , a slave who described and cataloged the rings in the Year of the Errant Kings , 356 DR . This information was later presented in " The Magics of the South " by the Herald of Athkatla , Zatan Arrowswift , but either some of the descriptions have been lost to the ravages of time , or they are being kept secret , because only ten rings are described below and two of those have a questionable pedigree . Description . Each ring had different color metals twisted together in a raised zigzag pattern that flowed around the circumference of the ring .

title: Qysarus Secretus
description: Qysarus Secretus Qysarus Secretus was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It protected the wearer from all forms of magical and psionic detection and scrying . Description .
description_long: Qysarus Secretus Qysarus Secretus was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It protected the wearer from all forms of magical and psionic detection and scrying . Description . Magic rings made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , were constructed of twisted bands of two different metals and were known as " shoonring s " . What easily distinguished the " Qysari Rings " from ordinary " shoonrings " was that they changed form depending on the nature of the person wearing them . When placed on the finger of a cleric , druid , or other priest , the direction of the metal weave turned at right angles to the circumference of the ring . If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised pattern became smooth to the touch but still visible . Wizard s saw no change in the design when it was placed on their finger . Powers . The wearer of this ring became essentially undetectable and unknowable by magical means , such as a " crystal ball " , " ESP " , " know alignment " , " detect evil and good " , " detect lie " , and " detect undead " . It also protected against psionic means of detection or information gathering . History .

title: Qyxas
description: Qyxas Qyxas was a rogue vampiric ixitxachitl . . History .
description_long: Qyxas Qyxas was a rogue vampiric ixitxachitl . . History . Born in 1141 DR Qyxas at one point joined the Honor Guard of the vitanar and become head of the guard under vitanar Phyvvak . Under vitanar Ourqax in 1275 DR was ordered to Qyxas to went in a suicide mission against the outcast merfolk fortress of Thuridru . Qyxas that aspired to the visar ' s position instead alongside two of his fellow betrayed his people warning the merfolk . Later he turned rogue and in time grew in a greater vampiric ixitxachitl , founding near Thuridru a own ixilthetocal settlement . Qyxas teach to his followers to no openly attack other races but learn from them and destroy them from within . However most of Qyxas ' s allies and pawn died during the Twelfth Serôs War . However he still knew most of the fortress ' s secret and plotted to conquer it within a decade ' s time .

title: Qyzal
description: Qyzal Qyzal was a rare female morkoth fighter member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Qyzal was a good strategist but her habit of toying with her victims often caused delays or worse effects .
description_long: Qyzal Qyzal was a rare female morkoth fighter member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Qyzal was a good strategist but her habit of toying with her victims often caused delays or worse effects . She was ambitious like most of the male morkoth . Qyzal was totally loyal to Axar Xyrl , that she believed would become the next Grand Arcane . History . Qyzal born of the same egg clutch as Grand Caster Duupox . She become one of the subordinate of the arcount Axar Xyrl . Qyzal trained two quelzarn to use as war dogs . Xyrl told to her that her future depended if the experiment would be successful . In 1370 DR Axar Xyrl allied with the aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok and the arcount sent Qyzal , with four morkoth soldiers and her quelzarns , and Duupox to organized am ambush against some surface dwellers enemies of Kraok . Secretly Xyrl told her to kept an eye to Duupox and Gantar in search of possible treacheries . Later Axar Xyrl too , together with Gantar Kraok , entered in battle to help his subordinates .

title: R . A . Salvatore
description: R . A . Salvatore Born in 1959 , Robert Anthony Salvatore was born in Massachusetts and resides there with his wife Diane , and their three children , Bryan , Geno , and Caitlin .
description_long: R . A . Salvatore Born in 1959 , Robert Anthony Salvatore was born in Massachusetts and resides there with his wife Diane , and their three children , Bryan , Geno , and Caitlin . They have one grandchild . The family pets include three Japanese Chins , Oliver , Artemis and Ivan , and four cats including Guenhwyvar . Salvatore has written many novels set in the Forgotten Realms and is one of the fantasy genre ’ s most successful authors . His books regularly appear on The New York Times best - seller lists and have sold more than 10 million copies . Salvatore ’ s most recent original hardcover , " The Two Swords " , book three of The Hunter ' s Blades trilogy , debuted at # 1 on The Wall Street Journal best - seller list and at # 4 on The New York Times best - seller list . His books have been translated into numerous foreign languages including German , Italian , Finnish , Hebrew , Greek , Hungarian , Turkish , Croatian , Bulgarian , Yiddish , Spanish , Russian , Polish , Czech , and French . His first published novel was " The Crystal Shard " in 1988 , which introduced an enormously popular character : a drow named Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Ra ' id bint Kawthar
description: Ra ' id bint Kawthar Ra ' id bint Kawthar was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Personality . Ra ' id was friendly and highly intelligent .
description_long: Ra ' id bint Kawthar Ra ' id bint Kawthar was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Personality . Ra ' id was friendly and highly intelligent . Activities . On occasion , he served as a navigator for ships entering Chaos Bay , assisting their captains to safely pass through the deadly coral maze lurking beneath the waves . Possessions . Ra ' id used a magical spear or a normal short sword during combat . Relationships . Ra ' id was the son of the leader of the sea elves inhabiting the coral maze of Chaos Bay .

title: Ra ' koo
description: Ra ' koo Ra ' koo was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay north of the city of Koje . Folk there discovered and disturbed a burial site of the ancient Han people , and brought a curse upon themselves .
description_long: Ra ' koo Ra ' koo was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay north of the city of Koje . Folk there discovered and disturbed a burial site of the ancient Han people , and brought a curse upon themselves . By 1357 DR , it was impossible for any person , not even children , to sleep within the village . The sleepless villagers grew weak and desperate for anyone who could lift their curse or find the cause of their condition .

title: Ra - Khati
description: Ra - Khati Ra - Khati was a country of the Hordelands . The country was found deep in the heart of Katakoro Shan . History .
description_long: Ra - Khati Ra - Khati was a country of the Hordelands . The country was found deep in the heart of Katakoro Shan . History . The country was a successor state to Anok - Imaskar after its demise in - 1943 DR . Society . Ra - Khati was an isolationist nation that feared people from the outside . Anyone who wandered into the nation was given the option to either have their tongues cut out , to remain forever as a citizen , or to be killed , in order to prevent them from telling the outside world about it . Because of this , little was known about the country in the rest of the world . Economy . The country was enormously wealthy in mineral resources . There was no lack of material goods for the average person . Barley , millet , sheep , and yaks were the things primary grown and raised in Ra - Khati . Ra - Khati had no trade with the outside world since the destruction of the city of Kushk by the forces of Solon . Government . Ra - Khati was a theocracy , ruled by the various lama s of the monasteries . The leader was the Dalai Lama , the highest priest of the nation . Each town was overseen by the lama of the town ' s monastery .

title: Ra - Khati language
description: Ra - Khati language Ra - Khati , or Ra - Khatian , was the language spoken by the people of Ra - Khati in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Khazari language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages .
description_long: Ra - Khati language Ra - Khati , or Ra - Khatian , was the language spoken by the people of Ra - Khati in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Khazari language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages . Ra - Khati was slightly influenced by the Solonese dialect of Devic , spoken in Solon . In Ra - Khatian , the title Dalai Lama meant " ocean spirit father " while the name Sandiraksiva translated to " He who refuses to carry the Dalai Lama " .

title: Raanaghaun Cormrael
description: Raanaghaun Cormrael Raanaghaun Cormrael ( named for a famous Netherese priest of Shar ) was a Dark Diviner of Windsong Tower . After the theft of the " Leaves of One Night " , he left the tower and returned to the Fane of Shadows to attempt to rewrite portions of the Dark Diviners ' stolen tome . He never returned .
description_long: Raanaghaun Cormrael Raanaghaun Cormrael ( named for a famous Netherese priest of Shar ) was a Dark Diviner of Windsong Tower . After the theft of the " Leaves of One Night " , he left the tower and returned to the Fane of Shadows to attempt to rewrite portions of the Dark Diviners ' stolen tome . He never returned .

title: Raash
description: Raash Raash was a sage in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was in zoology and ecology and he was considered by most the best expert on dragon s outside Elminster Aumar . Raash had two sages that worked under him .
description_long: Raash Raash was a sage in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was in zoology and ecology and he was considered by most the best expert on dragon s outside Elminster Aumar . Raash had two sages that worked under him . His fees were five times higher than normal for his personal counsel and three times higher for his assistant ' s counsel . Personality . Raash was known for his barbed temper . He only accepted tasks that interested him .

title: Raashub
description: Raashub Raashub was an uridezu and captain of a ship of chaos . History . Raashub was the captain of a ship of chaos that crashed into the Lake of Shadows in the Underdark and was trapped in time in a whirlwind .
description_long: Raashub Raashub was an uridezu and captain of a ship of chaos . History . Raashub was the captain of a ship of chaos that crashed into the Lake of Shadows in the Underdark and was trapped in time in a whirlwind . At the end of 1372 DR or the beginning of 1373 DR , Pharaun Mizzrym and his group , led by Quenthel Baenre , sought out and repaired the ship in order to travel with it to the Demonweb Pits in search of Lolth . Pharaun was able to bind the uridezu captain with a locket and wax figurine , but Raashub ' s attempted to escape by summoning rats and gating in his cousin Jaershed . The group defeated the attack , but with Raashub gone , Pharaun was forced to learn to control the ship of chaos himself ( with the secret help of the invisible Aliisza ) . The group traveled with the ship , but it shattered on the Plane of Infinite Portals . Abilities . Raashub had the ability to summon rat s . Relationships . Raashub had a cousin named Jaershed .

title: Rababah
description: Rababah A rababah ( rah - BAH - bah ) was a strange stringed Zakharan instrument . Description . The " rababah " was a single - stringed instrument that consisted of a rectangular soundbox from which rose a thin neck .
description_long: Rababah A rababah ( rah - BAH - bah ) was a strange stringed Zakharan instrument . Description . The " rababah " was a single - stringed instrument that consisted of a rectangular soundbox from which rose a thin neck . The base of the " rababah " was covered with horse or goat hide . The string was attached to a movable post located at the top of the neck . A horsehair bow was used on the string while moving the post up or down , creating a beautiful melodic tone . History . The " rababah " was the traditional instrument of choice among the nomadic Al - Badia tribes of Zakhara .

title: Rababah of the dao
description: Rababah of the dao The rababah of the dao was a wondrous musical instrument created by dao craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " rababah of the dao " in existence throughout Zakhara . Description .
description_long: Rababah of the dao The rababah of the dao was a wondrous musical instrument created by dao craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " rababah of the dao " in existence throughout Zakhara . Description . This " rababah " was made from the very finest materials available to the dao . Hair from the swiftest horse of the High Desert was used to make the bow . The soundbox was made from the skull of a fearsome great roc . Powers . When played this instrument allowed the user to cast an " entangle " spell once per day . Bard s and " rawunin " could use this power twice per day . This ability only worked if the target was standing on sand or soft ground . A special power was available to bards and " rawunin " . Once per week they could " shift the earth " , summoning a powerful earth elemental to serve them . As long as the instrument was played the elemental would remain under the control of the user . The elemental would instantly return to the Elemental Plane of Earth if the music was interrupted .

title: Rabbit
description: Rabbit Rabbits were common animals throughout the Realms . It was not uncommon to find them cooked and served in taverns and the like , such as at the Elfstone Tavern in Waterdeep . Species .
description_long: Rabbit Rabbits were common animals throughout the Realms . It was not uncommon to find them cooked and served in taverns and the like , such as at the Elfstone Tavern in Waterdeep . Species . Spiny . The spiny rabbit was found in the forest of Cormanthor . It has red fur and bright green eyes , but otherwise resembled a normal rabbit . It was usually calm and placid , but if startled , three spines on its stomach became erect . These spines gave the rabbit its name , and could prove deadly if they pierced the skin . Whistling . The sage Elminster heard tales of a kind of rabbit living in the Brynwood in the Vast that was capable of whistling like a canary . It could even be taught a surprising number of tunes .

title: Race
description: Race The Race was a small tract of water located off the southern edge of the Tethyr Peninsula in West Faerûn . Geography . The sea was named for the frequent sight of ships fleeing the pirate bands that prowled Asavir ' s Channel .
description_long: Race The Race was a small tract of water located off the southern edge of the Tethyr Peninsula in West Faerûn . Geography . The sea was named for the frequent sight of ships fleeing the pirate bands that prowled Asavir ' s Channel . Once through the Race , merchant ships came under the protection of the Calimshan navy . History . In 1356 DR , the Companions of the Hall traveled through the Race after escaping the pirate Pinochet ' s fleet and landed in Memnon .

title: Radatha
description: Radatha Radatha was the leader of the Fire Knives cell in Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Radatha led a group of Fire Knives that escaped to Tilverton .
description_long: Radatha Radatha was the leader of the Fire Knives cell in Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Radatha led a group of Fire Knives that escaped to Tilverton . After the cell refuged in Westgate was destroyed by Alias ' s party , in 1357 Radatha agreed to join a New Alliance with Tyranthraxus , the Zhentarim , priests of Moander and one Red Wizards of Thay in order to imbue in an adventurer the Azure Bonds . Radatha ' s goal was kill the King Azoun Obarskyr IV . Meantime her minions managed to capture the runaway princess Alusair Obarskyr in order to lure Azoun IV in Tilverton . At last however Radatha ' s plan backfired and she was killed by Alusair .

title: Radborne Wynn
description: Radborne Wynn Radborne Wynn was earl of the Storming Gorge in Hartsvale in the late 14 century DR . Description . Rayborne Wynn was a stout man who bore himself impressively yet had a wild look .
description_long: Radborne Wynn Radborne Wynn was earl of the Storming Gorge in Hartsvale in the late 14 century DR . Description . Rayborne Wynn was a stout man who bore himself impressively yet had a wild look . Near the end of his life , Earl Wynn had long gray hair and a beard . He often wore a cloak made from the silvered fur of stoats , and he wore plate mail in battle . Possessions . In addition to ruling over the lands of the Stroming Gorge in the north , Earl Wynn owned a series of silver mines in the Gorge of the Silver Wyrm in Hartsvale . He also had a large and secure keep called Wynn Castle . Earl Wynn rode upon a gray stallion . Activities . The silver mines that supported the economy of Hartsvale were mined by the serfs of Earl Wynn . History . Earl Wynn ' s family first discovered silver in the Gorge of the Silver Wyrm hundreds of years before his birth . In 1369 DR , during the war with giant s that occurred during the time that Queen Brianna Burdun rose to power , Earl Wynn was slain while trying to prevent the queen ' s kidnapping by firbolg s . His chest was crushed when he was stepped on by a wounded and thrashing Galgadayle , who had been injured by the young Avner .

title: Radecere Perethun
description: Radecere Perethun Radecere Perethun was a traveler on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Radecere was usually a loner , but he never refused the opportunity to gamble in a good game , and he was quite good at it .
description_long: Radecere Perethun Radecere Perethun was a traveler on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Radecere was usually a loner , but he never refused the opportunity to gamble in a good game , and he was quite good at it . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR Radacere boarded a great caravan that , unbeknownst to him , was full of agents of the Cult of the Dragon transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Radiant Heart Auxiliary
description: Radiant Heart Auxiliary The Radiant Heart Auxiliary is the junior wing of the Order of the Radiant Heart , and comprises of knights who are not yet old enough or highly regarded enough to gain membership to the senior branch of the Order . Most of the Paladins of the Radiant Heart Auxiliary pledge themselves to goodly deities ; followers of Torm and Helm are particularly common among their ranks . The Auxiliary branch of the Order ' s motto is : " A loyal heart and a faithful spirit .
description_long: Radiant Heart Auxiliary The Radiant Heart Auxiliary is the junior wing of the Order of the Radiant Heart , and comprises of knights who are not yet old enough or highly regarded enough to gain membership to the senior branch of the Order . Most of the Paladins of the Radiant Heart Auxiliary pledge themselves to goodly deities ; followers of Torm and Helm are particularly common among their ranks . The Auxiliary branch of the Order ' s motto is : " A loyal heart and a faithful spirit . " Joining the Auxiliary . In order for a prospective paladin to join the Radiant Heart Auxiliary , they must first be sponsored by an active member of the senior branch of the Order , The Most Noble Order of the Radiant Heart . Two of the Council of three Prelates must also approve the membership , giving their assent for the initiate to be accepted into the fraternity . Most members of the Order come from noble families , often with a history of Order membership . Organization . Each branch of the Order of the Radiant Heart has it ' s own auxiliary , consisting of no more than 40 members ( branches of the Order are called chapters , and are usually based in large towns or cities ) .

title: Radiant fog
description: Radiant fog Radiant fog is a conjuration spell that summons a fog of celestial light . Effect . This spell works like " solid fog " , but the cloud of fog shimmers with brilliant celestial radiance .
description_long: Radiant fog Radiant fog is a conjuration spell that summons a fog of celestial light . Effect . This spell works like " solid fog " , but the cloud of fog shimmers with brilliant celestial radiance . Creatures within the cloud must have strong fortitude or be dazzled , reducing their ability to hit targets for as long as they remain in the cloud and for one minute afterward . Creatures with light sensitivity or otherwise susceptible to bright light are blinded if they fail their saves . Sightless creatures are not affected by the radiance . Spell resistance applies to the reduced movement , melee attack and damage penalties , and dazzling or blinding effects , but not to the concealment provided or the prevention of ranged weapon attacks . Abstinence Component . You must not have cast a or necromantic spell within the past 24 hours before casting this spell .

title: Radiant shield
description: Radiant shield Radiant shield is an evocation spell that shocks attackers and protects against electricity . Effect . A scintillating aura of white radiance wreathes you and causes damage to each creature that attacks you in melee .
description_long: Radiant shield Radiant shield is an evocation spell that shocks attackers and protects against electricity . Effect . A scintillating aura of white radiance wreathes you and causes damage to each creature that attacks you in melee . The radiance also protects you from electricity attacks . Any creature striking you with a natural or handheld weapon deals normal damage but also takes electricity damage ( the creature ’ s spell resistance applies ) . You take only half damage from electricity - based attacks . If an electricity - based attack allows evasion for half damage , you take no damage on a successful dodge1 . The radiance is as bright as a " light " spell , casting bright light in a 10 - foot radius and shadowy illumination to 20 feet . Abstinence Component . You must not have cast a or necromantic spell within the last 24 hours before casting this spell .

title: Radoc
description: Radoc Radoc , also known as " The One " and Doc , was a powerful archmage dwelling in the Star Mounts in the High Forest around 1358 DR . The mysterious charismatic figure known as Radoc gave the appearance of a peaceful yet powerful healer , seldom seen traveling yet known to give aid to those in need , such as to the folk of Loudwater . What wasn ' t known was that Radoc was had been exiled from another Prime Material Plane .
description_long: Radoc Radoc , also known as " The One " and Doc , was a powerful archmage dwelling in the Star Mounts in the High Forest around 1358 DR . The mysterious charismatic figure known as Radoc gave the appearance of a peaceful yet powerful healer , seldom seen traveling yet known to give aid to those in need , such as to the folk of Loudwater . What wasn ' t known was that Radoc was had been exiled from another Prime Material Plane . He had been marked with a glowing sigil by the titan Sylla . His goal was to return to his home , New Empyrea , as its master . He slowly built a power base in the Star Mounts , using tribes of mongrelmen for muscle while purchasing all of the mithril that the orc s of the Spine of the World could mine . His faith was that of Tangg , an other - planar power .

title: Radom
description: Radom Radom was the last member of the dukar Order of Jhimari in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Radom was a ancient Jhimari dukar at time of the fall of Nantarum in - 220 DR ; somehow he ended as a coral statue inside the city ' s Coliseum .
description_long: Radom Radom was the last member of the dukar Order of Jhimari in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Radom was a ancient Jhimari dukar at time of the fall of Nantarum in - 220 DR ; somehow he ended as a coral statue inside the city ' s Coliseum . In 1370 Radom returned to life and quickly adapted to the modern era . his goal was to resurrect with help of Qos his order . Despite he looked like a young elf his 1 , 000 years of isolation greatly spiritually aged him .

title: Radu Malveen
description: Radu Malveen Radu Malveen was a fighter in Selgaunt . Relationships . Radu was a member of the Malveen house .
description_long: Radu Malveen Radu Malveen was a fighter in Selgaunt . Relationships . Radu was a member of the Malveen house . History . Radu was always a lone child . He was not interested in playing with other children , only enjoying to practice with the sword . In 1345 DR , his elder brother Stannis Malveen and his mother , the sorceress Velanna Malveen , fled from Selgaunt after the former was discovered having had dealings with pirates . City officials took Radu and all his siblings out of their estate but Radu secretly went back each night . One night , Stannis went back to his family ' s estate with his vampire master . However , Radu , despite his young age , easily slew the vampire master and Stannis decided to follow Radu ' s will . Radu in later years became a businessman but , unlike his brother Laskar Malveen , who had renounced all ties with Velanna ' s network , Radu delved in smuggling and slaving . He always carefully avoided leaving any clues pointing to him . He also worked as an assassin and duelist . Personality . Radu loved his family in his distorted way . He found enjoyment only in duels to the death .

title: Raedlar Belorgan
description: Raedlar Belorgan Raedlar Belorgan was one of five young men who attempted to assassinate Princess Tanalasta during the Abraxus affair in 1369 DR . He was killed in the attempt . Raedlar was rumored to be a titled Baron of Forgemarket ( a market crossroads in the Wyvernshores countryside ) .
description_long: Raedlar Belorgan Raedlar Belorgan was one of five young men who attempted to assassinate Princess Tanalasta during the Abraxus affair in 1369 DR . He was killed in the attempt . Raedlar was rumored to be a titled Baron of Forgemarket ( a market crossroads in the Wyvernshores countryside ) .

title: Raedra Obarskyr
description: Raedra Obarskyr Raedra Obarskyr was the daughter of Irvel Obarskyr and the granddaughter of King Foril I of Cormyr . In 1486 DR , she served as regent for her wounded brother Baerovus and aided him after his recovery and coronation . During the siege of Suzail , she killed a large wyvern disguised as Thauglorimorgorus and fought the army of Thultanthar .
description_long: Raedra Obarskyr Raedra Obarskyr was the daughter of Irvel Obarskyr and the granddaughter of King Foril I of Cormyr . In 1486 DR , she served as regent for her wounded brother Baerovus and aided him after his recovery and coronation . During the siege of Suzail , she killed a large wyvern disguised as Thauglorimorgorus and fought the army of Thultanthar . After the siege , she succeeded her father Irvel and her brother Baerovus as queen of Cormyr . Raedra was engaged to Aubrin Crownsilver but she dissolved their betrothal before she became queen .

title: Raegar Stoneblade
description: Raegar Stoneblade Raegar Stoneblade was a rogue . Appearance . Raegar was trim and muscular with a tattoo on his left shoulder .
description_long: Raegar Stoneblade Raegar Stoneblade was a rogue . Appearance . Raegar was trim and muscular with a tattoo on his left shoulder . He had long hair and a dark , close - trimmed beard . Personality . Two of Raegar ' s personal rules were " never get into a game if you don ' t know all the players " , and " make sure you know what you ' re carrying " . Possessions . Raegar wore a magical ring on his left hand that , when activated , could shroud the local area with thick fog that only he could see through . He carried a small mirror in his belt pouch so that he could see unnoticed around corners . Raegar also possessed " boots of spider climbing " , and had a short sword in a scabbard on his right leg . Background . Raeger grew up in the South Ward of Waterdeep . His father was a stone carver and a sail maker , but both his parents died during the Time of Troubles when undead assaulted the city . Raegar ensured his survival by becoming a street thief , and then a stone carver . Raegar grew to resent the wizards of Waterdeep because he perceived that they were always causing disaster for the city and were never held to account for these actions .

title: Raelaryn Xorlarrin
description: Raelaryn Xorlarrin Raelaryn Xorlarrin was an elder of the Council of Spiders . He sought to gain the support of a high - ranking wizard in Menzoberranzan and believed that Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre would soon back the Council . History .
description_long: Raelaryn Xorlarrin Raelaryn Xorlarrin was an elder of the Council of Spiders . He sought to gain the support of a high - ranking wizard in Menzoberranzan and believed that Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre would soon back the Council . History . Raelaryn invited his cousin , Hoshtar Xorlarrin , to meet with the Council in the compound of the fallen House Srune ' Lett in Narbondellyn . During the meeting , he and the other elder present were assassinated by a member of the Jaezred Chaulssin to start a civil war .

title: Raelis Shai
description: Raelis Shai Raelis Shai was a tiefling wizard who was the leader of an actor ' s troupe based in Sigil that performed in Athkatla , Amn , for a time . History . When Raelis found that one of her actors , Haer ' Dalis , had vanished she enlisted the help of Gorion ' s Ward to find him .
description_long: Raelis Shai Raelis Shai was a tiefling wizard who was the leader of an actor ' s troupe based in Sigil that performed in Athkatla , Amn , for a time . History . When Raelis found that one of her actors , Haer ' Dalis , had vanished she enlisted the help of Gorion ' s Ward to find him .

title: Raella Hiess
description: Raella Hiess Raella Hiess was a female human wizard living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . She was the true proprietor of The Deepfires inn and collected information for the Lords of Waterdeep . Activities .
description_long: Raella Hiess Raella Hiess was a female human wizard living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . She was the true proprietor of The Deepfires inn and collected information for the Lords of Waterdeep . Activities . Although Raella was the actual proprietress of The Deepfires , she preferred to work behind the scenes and instead served as an ordinary barmaid . Instead , her companion Vhondryl pretended to be the owner . They operated as partners ; Raella was available at all times and arranged meetings between Vhondryl and her customers and clients in the dealing of poisons and potions . Raella used the inn as a means of gathering information for the Lords of Waterdeep and for sale to others , as did her friend Irusyl Eraneth . Raella was herself an accomplished mage . Relationships . Raella and Vhondryl knew each other very well and were quite fond of one another . They ' d been companions for a number of years , even saving each other ' s life on countless occasions . Raella granted Vhondryl permanent rooms at The Deepfires , and together upheld the ruse that Vhondryl was the owner and Raella the barmaid .

title: Raerboth Obarskyr
description: Raerboth Obarskyr Raerboth Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . He was the only legitimate son of King Ulbaeram Obarskyr . Like so many of his kin , he was killed by his aunt Gorauna .
description_long: Raerboth Obarskyr Raerboth Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . He was the only legitimate son of King Ulbaeram Obarskyr . Like so many of his kin , he was killed by his aunt Gorauna . His son , Baerildo was next in line for the throne , but Baerildo was also killed by Gorauna while still an infant , and so Raerboth ' s stepbrother Belmuth " the Bastard " next took the throne .

title: Raerdrimne
description: Raerdrimne House Raerdrimne is a sun elf house known for producing fine ceramics , jewelry , paintings and statues . Only twenty of its members made it to Evermeet during the Retreat . As of 1368 DR , no children have been born to members of the house in centuries .
description_long: Raerdrimne House Raerdrimne is a sun elf house known for producing fine ceramics , jewelry , paintings and statues . Only twenty of its members made it to Evermeet during the Retreat . As of 1368 DR , no children have been born to members of the house in centuries . Most of its members are over 700 years old , meaning that unless the house produces offspring , it will cease to exist in a matter of centuries . The house estate is a structure in Leuthilspar in a shaded grove of trees . History . Members of House Raerdrimne once helped to repel a goblin invasion .

title: Raerlin
description: Raerlin Raerlin was a Calishite human and briefly , apprentice to Elminster , until he stole a key to a container of old spellbooks in Elminster ' s tower . Later , he became a lich , but Elminster assumed that he had been eaten by a dragon . Background .
description_long: Raerlin Raerlin was a Calishite human and briefly , apprentice to Elminster , until he stole a key to a container of old spellbooks in Elminster ' s tower . Later , he became a lich , but Elminster assumed that he had been eaten by a dragon . Background . When Elminster recovered the key to his door in 1355 DR , Raerlin opened a gateway directly into Elminster ' s tower ( which was magically protected ) and attacked Elminster and Storm Silverhand . He drained Elminster ' s magical energy to power his own , and in doing so , defeated Elminster . Storm noticed that one of the books in the room was glowing in a similar way to the lich ' s gate , and burned it . The book was Raerlin ' s phylactery and Raerlin was destroyed . Elminster recovered without serious harm .

title: Rafi al Shuree
description: Rafi al Shuree Rafi al Shuree was the Grand Yrshelem of Caravans of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Rafi was the daughter of a merchant of Calimshan , but for her not - so - beautiful appearance and her meager dowry she was unable to find a husband .
description_long: Rafi al Shuree Rafi al Shuree was the Grand Yrshelem of Caravans of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Rafi was the daughter of a merchant of Calimshan , but for her not - so - beautiful appearance and her meager dowry she was unable to find a husband . So Rafi decided to escape for an adventurer ' s life , while a loyal slave of hers impersonated her in the family house . In her adventures in the Dales , Cormyr , and Sembia , Rafi learned all the secrets of the caravan business , and , at her return to Calimshan , she decided to enter the caravan business with the male alias of Rahimat yi Manshaka . In two years she profited so well that the Rundeen offered her to join , and Rafi gladly accepted . After two more years she was so successful in her Rahimat guise that she approached her own family in order to propose a marriage to " herself " .
