Nobody suspected anything , and after the marriage , her loyal slave finally stopped impersonating her . In 1352 DR Rafi eventually become a " nirdey " — a high rank among the Mitalibbar — in Manshaka , and she finally told her Rundeen masters the truth about her gender . In 1354 DR , she was promoted to Grand Yrshelem .

title: Ragarra
description: Ragarra Ragarra was a Zakhara n goddess who represented the jungle and its violent nature . She wanted to destroy any civilization that wanted to tame the wilderness around it and was therefore considered a savage goddess , " i . e .
description_long: Ragarra Ragarra was a Zakhara n goddess who represented the jungle and its violent nature . She wanted to destroy any civilization that wanted to tame the wilderness around it and was therefore considered a savage goddess , " i . e . " , a deity opposed to the culture of Enlightenment predominant in the Land of Fate . Ragarra ' s symbols included a cyclone , a green three - fingered claw and a baby crocodile biting its own tail . The deity , sometimes also called Raggara , was depicted as a crocodile - headed female with the wings of a bat . Her mate was Shajar , god of the Nogaro River . She filled a similar role in the Land of Fate as the god Malar did in Faerûn . Her cult was driven underground long ago because of its anarchical nature , but became stronger in the years before 1367 DR , cowing parts of the local population with acts of violence . Most of her worshipers resided in or around the cities of Dihliz , Rog ' osto , and Kadarasto , where they had secret lairs .

title: Rage of Demons
description: Rage of Demons The Rage of Demons was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in September 2015 and runs through March 2016 . The storyline was primarily set on the Sword Coast and in the Moonsea region . Description .
description_long: Rage of Demons The Rage of Demons was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in September 2015 and runs through March 2016 . The storyline was primarily set on the Sword Coast and in the Moonsea region . Description . The Wizards of the Coast provided the following introduction to the Rage of Demons : The storyline was also described this way : A key part of the storyline was presented in " Archmage " : the appearance of demons in Menzoberranzan and elsewhere in the Underdark , which were summoned in 1485 DR and 1486 DR by Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre in order to secure her reign over the city . The presence of the demons was according to the plans of Lolth , who arranged for Gromph Baenre to inadvertently summon Demogorgon to the Prime Material Plane in 1486 DR .

title: Rage of Dragons
description: Rage of Dragons A Rage of Dragons , or Dracorage , was a Realms - wide event that occurred when many dragon s went on a collective , senseless rampage , destroying everything in their path . This periodic madness seemed to be tied to the appearance of the King - Killer Star , and lasted for a tenday . In the event of a localized Rage of Dragons , the more common label was a " Flight of Dragons .
description_long: Rage of Dragons A Rage of Dragons , or Dracorage , was a Realms - wide event that occurred when many dragon s went on a collective , senseless rampage , destroying everything in their path . This periodic madness seemed to be tied to the appearance of the King - Killer Star , and lasted for a tenday . In the event of a localized Rage of Dragons , the more common label was a " Flight of Dragons . " Frequency and cause . Rages could take place in a number of different cycles . Some took place every few decades , while others every few centuries . In Faerûn , most sages agreed that this periodic Rage was a direct result of a curse caused by the " Dracorage mythal " , a powerful " mythal " created by the elves around - 25000 DR . Extent of a rage . The exact extent of a single Rage of Dragons was theoretically tied to the exact position of the King - Killer Star when it appeared in the skies above Toril . However , in 1373 DR the lich Sammaster triggered an unanticipated Rage . The last Rage of Dragons resulted in the destruction of the " Dracorage mythal " , thus ending the magical curse upon dragon - kind .

title: Ragged Dain
description: Ragged Dain Ragged Dain was the Captain of the Guard in Citadel Felbarr in 1479 DR . History . He was a friend of his colleague , Reginald Roundshield Sr .
description_long: Ragged Dain Ragged Dain was the Captain of the Guard in Citadel Felbarr in 1479 DR . History . He was a friend of his colleague , Reginald Roundshield Sr . , so Ragged became a mentor his son , the young Reginald Roundshield ( in truth , Bruenor Battlehammer reincarnated ) . The younger Reginald served under Ragged as a caravan escort . In 1484 DR , at the start of the war with orcs and drow , he was one of the military leaders convicted by king Emerus Warcrown

title: Raggnar Redtooth
description: Raggnar Redtooth Raggnar Redtooth was a tavern owner in the Cult of the Dragon – controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . History . Raggnar managed the tavern the Golden Tankard in Parnast .
description_long: Raggnar Redtooth Raggnar Redtooth was a tavern owner in the Cult of the Dragon – controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . History . Raggnar managed the tavern the Golden Tankard in Parnast . Despite not being a cultist , Raggnar was bribed by them to control the villagers and possible visitors . He tried to discourage visitors from remaining in the village for long .

title: Ragheb
description: Ragheb Ragheb was an oasis town located in the southern region of Raurin desert . In the late 15th century DR the town was ruled by the tiefling Alzubra . Description .
description_long: Ragheb Ragheb was an oasis town located in the southern region of Raurin desert . In the late 15th century DR the town was ruled by the tiefling Alzubra . Description . The town surrounded a small but deep lake known as Lake Ragheb . The central area of Ragheb was protected from sandstorms and invaders by a high stone wall . Outside the wall residents lived in semi - permanent tents .

title: Raging Bull
description: Raging Bull The " Raging Bull " was a name given to a captive minotaur in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain , held in a cage suspended from the cavern ceiling , high above the street just outside the doors of The Deepfires inn . History . Sometime in the 1340s DR , an unknown slaver imprisoned the minotaur in the almost unbreakable cage and abandoned him there .
description_long: Raging Bull The " Raging Bull " was a name given to a captive minotaur in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain , held in a cage suspended from the cavern ceiling , high above the street just outside the doors of The Deepfires inn . History . Sometime in the 1340s DR , an unknown slaver imprisoned the minotaur in the almost unbreakable cage and abandoned him there . The minotaur had a " ring of sustenance " to nourish him , but this only worked for seven days and took seven days to recharge , leaving the minotaur to starve in this time . He was still there by 1370 DR , now hopelessly insane . He assaulted anyone who risked coming close to his cage , even to try to free him . He was also tormented by cruel folk like Quinan Vamaed , who saw this unending torture as a gift to the goddess Loviatar . Reputation . Known as the Raging Bull , the minotaur had become a notorious local landmark in Skullport . His angry bellows echoed across Skullport on a disturbingly regular basis , and one could follow them to find The Deepfires inn . However , his dung fell on the street below .

title: Ragnor
description: Ragnor Ragnor was an ogrillon fighter and one of the three leaders of the military contingent of Castle Trinity . History . Ragnor , with the support of the wizard Dorigen Kel Lamond , guided the Trinity ' s invasion of Shilmista , causing great damage to the elves there .
description_long: Ragnor Ragnor was an ogrillon fighter and one of the three leaders of the military contingent of Castle Trinity . History . Ragnor , with the support of the wizard Dorigen Kel Lamond , guided the Trinity ' s invasion of Shilmista , causing great damage to the elves there . The tide of the battle changed when Cadderly Bonaduce and his friends arrived , especially the dwarven brothers Ivan and Pikel Bouldershoulder . Ragnor ' s army was soon defeated and Ragnor was killed .

title: Ragnor ( tribe )
description: Ragnor ( tribe ) The Ragnor were a dangerous tribe of Nar found in eastern Narfell . There were 1 , 900 Ragnor in 1357 DR . Activities .
description_long: Ragnor ( tribe ) The Ragnor were a dangerous tribe of Nar found in eastern Narfell . There were 1 , 900 Ragnor in 1357 DR . Activities . Because of their close proximity to some of the savage people of Rashemen and Ashanath , the Ragnor found themselves constantly at war . They were slightly less hostile to any other outsiders they encountered . Base of Operations . The Ragnor were found among the Teardrops of eastern Narfell .

title: Rah Kigi Lo
description: Rah Kigi Lo Rah Kigi Lo was the secret concubine of the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Rah Kigi Lo lived in Y ' cho Kang , the T ' u Lung royal summer house .
description_long: Rah Kigi Lo Rah Kigi Lo was the secret concubine of the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Rah Kigi Lo lived in Y ' cho Kang , the T ' u Lung royal summer house . Her smuggling and extortion business was led formally by her two sons , Rah Kointo and Hayu Wan , who in truth answered to Rah Kigi . She also owned and ran a fleet of river barges and three warehouses in the village of Wai T ' lu just downriver from Y ' cho Kang . History . Rah Kigi Lo was a widow who in time had become a very able crime lord . She collected the riches of four men before managing to reach the Emperor ' s court , where Rah Kigi came to be Wai Gada Shinzu ' s secret concubine . Relationship . Rah ' s sons , despite their mother ' s efforts to have them introduced into high T ' u Lung society remained two street thugs . Rah ' s most hated enemy was Wai Kung Chui , a widowed township officer in Shosun , a day upriver from Y ' cho Kang .

title: Rahalat
description: Rahalat Rahalat was a Place Spirit who was once a Bedine sorceress in Anauroch . Description . When Rahalat manifested herself , she appeared as a silent , transparent , and floating veiled woman , young and strong but with a heartbroken look on her face .
description_long: Rahalat Rahalat was a Place Spirit who was once a Bedine sorceress in Anauroch . Description . When Rahalat manifested herself , she appeared as a silent , transparent , and floating veiled woman , young and strong but with a heartbroken look on her face . She spoke to visitors telepathically if she so desired . History . Long before the mid – 14th century DR , Rahalat was a Bedine sorceress outcast , abandoned by her tribe at an oasis . She tried to stop everyone coming to her oasis until a tribe murdered her in order to get water . Soon after , the oasis turned to blood , and for ten years , everyone who drank from it died . By 1358 DR , the Bedine would always sacrifice a camel to honor her before drinking from the oasis . She sometimes appeared near the oasis . Rahalat still looked after a herd of goats on the mountain overlooking her oasis . She would warn intruders by making them hear the ringing of goat bells in their minds .

title: Rahimat el Taisar
description: Rahimat el Taisar Rahimat yn Fahd el Taisar yi Almraiven was a Calishite tailor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Rahimat was a tailor and a silk merchant in Almraiven .
description_long: Rahimat el Taisar Rahimat yn Fahd el Taisar yi Almraiven was a Calishite tailor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Rahimat was a tailor and a silk merchant in Almraiven . Usually , he traded using only his given name , because it was believed that his family had a lycanthropy curse . Despite this , Rahimat made full use of his Knights connections . His goal was to become the pasha of the Textiles Guild , despite the position being occupied at the time by Fatima yr Catathra yr Pesarkhal el Caslah , daughter of the syl - pasha . In 1370 DR , Rahimat discovered that Fatima had had an illicit relation with Pasha Jafar el Limiz , master of the Almraiven underworld , and sought to use this information for his power scheme . However , Rahimat was not as clever as he thought he was , and risked earning the ire of the powerful el Pesarkhal family .

title: Rahishu
description: Rahishu Rahishu was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Rahishu was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .
description_long: Rahishu Rahishu was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Rahishu was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur . One day , Shaspur came with a plan to free the dragonborn slaves from the gold dragon Raurokhymdhar . His plan , however , had a flaw : he could not save the elders . The elders decided that Shaspur should flee without them . Rahishu was killed by Raurokhymdhar while misleading the dragon so Shaspur and the other slaves could flee to freedom .

title: Rahmah al - Zahir
description: Rahmah al - Zahir Sitt Rahmah al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph ' s favorite maternal aunt in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rahmah was a member of the Magical Legion but spent too much time in politics to fully develop her power .
description_long: Rahmah al - Zahir Sitt Rahmah al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph ' s favorite maternal aunt in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rahmah was a member of the Magical Legion but spent too much time in politics to fully develop her power . Her magical training was just an elaborate ruse to disguise her true calling as the Grandmother of the Soft Whisper . Rahmah and the Soft Whisper made sure that other Zakharan rulers who did not work to further the Grand Caliph ' s policies were visited by Holy slayer s . Possessions . Much of her outward magical prowess was courtesy of a " ring of spell storing " supplied by the Grand Vizier . Relationships . Rahmah was lifelong friends with the Grand Vizier Alyana al - Azzazi . History . Rahmah studied at the magical university at Qadib .

title: Rahmani
description: Rahmani A rahmani was a Zakharan captain ' s book of naval charts . Uses . Nearly as priceless as a daftar , this notebook contained maps , ocean charts , and landmarks useful for sailing the seas surrounding the Land of Fate .
description_long: Rahmani A rahmani was a Zakharan captain ' s book of naval charts . Uses . Nearly as priceless as a daftar , this notebook contained maps , ocean charts , and landmarks useful for sailing the seas surrounding the Land of Fate . Annotations pointed out useful tips for most entries . These notebooks were never bought or sold , but shared when trust was well - established .

title: Rahvin
description: Rahvin Rahvin was an assassin of some repute sent by Iron Throne leaders to kill Sarevok Anchev . History . While searching for Sarevok in Baldur ' s Gate ' s Undercity , Rahvin met Gorion ' s Ward and tried to kill him for the bounty on his head .
description_long: Rahvin Rahvin was an assassin of some repute sent by Iron Throne leaders to kill Sarevok Anchev . History . While searching for Sarevok in Baldur ' s Gate ' s Undercity , Rahvin met Gorion ' s Ward and tried to kill him for the bounty on his head .

title: Rai - guy Bondalek
description: Rai - guy Bondalek Rai - guy ( in earlier publications spelled Rai ' gy ) was a drow high priest of Lolth and a wizard . He was a lieutenant of Bregan D ' aerthe . History .
description_long: Rai - guy Bondalek Rai - guy ( in earlier publications spelled Rai ' gy ) was a drow high priest of Lolth and a wizard . He was a lieutenant of Bregan D ' aerthe . History . Originally from the destroyed House Teyachumet of Ched Nasad , he was high priest of that city until he was ousted in a coup and " rescued " by Bregan D ' aerthe . In 1366 DR , together with Kimmuriel Oblodra , another lieutenant of Bregan D ' aerthe , Rai - guy betrayed Jarlaxle when Jarlaxle began falling under the influence of the sentient artifact Crenshinibon . Rai - guy also desired Crenshinibon for himself . When he finally obtained it , however , he was killed by the red dragon Hephaestus after Jarlaxle tricked the wyrm into breathing fire on the crystal and subsequently its wielder , Rai - guy .

title: Raiann
description: Raiann Raiann was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre . History . Before she joined the Platinum Cadre , Raiann was a glassblower .
description_long: Raiann Raiann was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre . History . Before she joined the Platinum Cadre , Raiann was a glassblower . She left her profession after joining the order . Raiann became one of Nala ' s staunch supporters . At her behest , she smuggled the fine white sand Nala needed for her rituals . Balasar was able to uncover Nala ' s true allegiances by following Raiann to her secret rendezvous point .

title: Raidon Kane
description: Raidon Kane Raidon Kane was a half - star elf , half - Shou monk and Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . He is one of the main characters in the " Stardeep " novel and the " Abolethic Sovereignty " series . History .
description_long: Raidon Kane Raidon Kane was a half - star elf , half - Shou monk and Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . He is one of the main characters in the " Stardeep " novel and the " Abolethic Sovereignty " series . History . Raidon was trained as a monk at the Xiang monastery in Telflamm in the martial art of Xiang Do . Raidon , whose Cerulean Sign fused with his body during the Spellplague , rescued the multiverse by preventing the awakening of " The Eldest " Aboleth and precuding Malyanna from unlocking the Far Manifold and opening the portal between the Far Realm and the Feywild . Althoug he died at the Citadel of the Outer Void , a place from where the Gods actually cannot claim the soul of a mortal , his soul was probably saved . Raidons friends and allies included the " dream - mage " Anusha Marhana , the star - pact Warlock Japheth Donard , Captain Aulruick Thoster , a scion of Dagon , and the psion Yeva .

title: Rain of blood
description: Rain of blood Rain of blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was favored by the Red Eyes sorcerous society . Effects .
description_long: Rain of blood Rain of blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was favored by the Red Eyes sorcerous society . Effects . This spell called forth a cloudburst of blood from the Negative Material Plane . The blood was far more red compared to ordinary blood . The blood leeched vitality whenever it touched bare skin . Targets would continue to suffer negative effects as long as they remained unsheltered under the rain of blood . Targets wearing less protective armor suffered more damage compared to well - armored targets . This spell was only usable by necromancer s . Components . This spell required a small vial of pure water to cast .

title: Rainbow Falls
description: Rainbow Falls The Rainbow Falls were located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The mighty chasm of the Rainbow Falls was located where the Akundi River plummeted over a thousand feet into the Gogrus River within the Katakoro Shan mountains .
description_long: Rainbow Falls The Rainbow Falls were located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The mighty chasm of the Rainbow Falls was located where the Akundi River plummeted over a thousand feet into the Gogrus River within the Katakoro Shan mountains . Description . Mist from the waterfalls and prevalent low - hanging clouds regularly created beautiful rainbows but masked much of the mountain walls bordering the falls . Rumors and Legends . Natives of Ra - Khati viewed any absence of the common rainbows as a bad omen . Notable Locations . Buildings of the Rainbow Monastery could be found along the descending path along the chasm of Rainbow Falls .

title: Rainbow Gorge
description: Rainbow Gorge Rainbow Gorge was a cleft in the Rauvin Mountains that was generally believed to be the beginning of the River Rauvin . It made up the southern exit from Dead Orc Pass . Geography .
description_long: Rainbow Gorge Rainbow Gorge was a cleft in the Rauvin Mountains that was generally believed to be the beginning of the River Rauvin . It made up the southern exit from Dead Orc Pass . Geography . Rainbow Gorge was located on the south side of the central Rauvin Mountains , between Mount Gaeram and Faerang ' s Doom . It connected to Dead Orc Pass to create a pass through the mountains . Description . Rainbow Gorge was the exit of the River Rauvin from the Rauvinheart caverns , through which the river passed under the Rauvin Mountains from the Cold Wood . Geothermal heat forced the waters out in geysers before emerging in waterfalls out of the cliff face at the gorge . The mist in the air created a constant rainbow . A steep , ancient trail followed the east side of the gorge along Faerang ' s Doom until it reached Dead Orc Pass .

title: Rainbow Monastery
description: Rainbow Monastery The Rainbow Monastery was located next to the Rainbow Falls in the Katakoro Shan mountain range in Ra - Khati . Description . Six colored structures spread along the Rainbow Trail comprised the Rainbow Monastery .
description_long: Rainbow Monastery The Rainbow Monastery was located next to the Rainbow Falls in the Katakoro Shan mountain range in Ra - Khati . Description . Six colored structures spread along the Rainbow Trail comprised the Rainbow Monastery . They were : Activities . Members of the Order of Rainbow Monks were stationed at each of the separate hospices . In exchange for donations , the monks aided travelers in moving their goods up the steep ascent of the Rainbow Trail . History . When Yamun Khahan army passed through the region during the mighty conquest during the mid 14th century DR , a group of deserters seized the monastery as their own , believing it to be an ideal spot to exact tolls from travelers .

title: Rainbow Trail
description: Rainbow Trail The Rainbow Trail was located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The trail was found at the junction of the Gogrus and Akundi rivers met at the Rainbow Falls .
description_long: Rainbow Trail The Rainbow Trail was located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The trail was found at the junction of the Gogrus and Akundi rivers met at the Rainbow Falls . It passed by a series of buildings making up the Rainbow Monastery along a treacherous decent of over a thousand feet at the bottom of the waterfall . Activities . The trail was used heavily by travelers and pilgrims passing through Ra - Khati . Monks from the monastery aided them in transporting their goods up and down the trial in return for a donation .

title: Rainbow obsidian
description: Rainbow obsidian Rainbow obsidian was an obsidian variety with bands of color . It could be used just like black obsidian to make arrowheads and weapons . Description .
description_long: Rainbow obsidian Rainbow obsidian was an obsidian variety with bands of color . It could be used just like black obsidian to make arrowheads and weapons . Description . Rainbow obsidian was black or gray with bands of all colors except yellow . The bands could be thin or quite wide and sometimes the stripes were broken up into spangles . These stones were usually tumbled into irregular shapes for jewelry , but like black obsidian it was hard and brittle and rarely used in items that received shock or wear . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Rainbow obsidian could pass through the various " prismatic " spells without harm and could grant the same protection to other inorganic materials that were connected to it . Thus , an arrow with a rainbow obsidian head could strike through a " prismatic wall " .

title: Raindrop
description: Raindrop Raindrop is the name given to the purest form of , specifically to flawless , colorless crystals or colorless areas inside larger , dark brown cassiterite crystals . Description . These stones , in their most prized form , were clear , hard , and durable , suitable for small faceted gems or they took a velvety smooth polish .
description_long: Raindrop Raindrop is the name given to the purest form of , specifically to flawless , colorless crystals or colorless areas inside larger , dark brown cassiterite crystals . Description . These stones , in their most prized form , were clear , hard , and durable , suitable for small faceted gems or they took a velvety smooth polish . Often they would be cut and polished into a teardrop shape and when placed on cloaks and other garments resembled raindrops , which gave them their popular name . The colored part of the stone was much less valuable and known as woodtine . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp . Powers . This gemstone and its woodtine form could be used as " residual magic " detectors , more sensitive than " detect magic " and other similar spells . When either variety was brought into contact with another gem , stone , or metal , it would darken in color if that item had been previously enchanted and had since released its magical energies . The color change was temporary and repeatable .

title: Raise dead
description: Raise dead Raise dead was a conjuration or necromancy spell that restored life to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , resulting in the spell " slay living " which was very similar to the newer " finger of death " spell . Effects .
description_long: Raise dead Raise dead was a conjuration or necromancy spell that restored life to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , resulting in the spell " slay living " which was very similar to the newer " finger of death " spell . Effects . The application of this spell was limited to creatures that had been dead for no longer than one day per level of the caster . The creature could not be undead , a construct , an elemental , or an outsider . The necromantic versions of this spell were further restricted to only " raise " human s , half - elves , dwarves , gnome s , and halfling s . The soul to be returned to its body had to be free to do so and willing to return , otherwise the spell fizzled . This spell also did not work on creatures that died of old age or that had been killed by a death effect . The corpse of the deceased had to have enough constitution and be intact enough to sustain life ; even though " raise dead " closed lethal wounds and healed mortal damage , missing pieces were not regenerated . Any natural poison or disease agents in the body were cured by the conjuration version of this spell , but not by the necromancy versions .

title: Rakshasa
description: Rakshasa Rakshasas were a type of evil outsider from the lawful evil regions of the Outer Planes , though most lived on the Material Plane . They were powerful sorcerer s and , although they disdained physical fighting as ignoble , could be dangerous in close combat as well . Description .
description_long: Rakshasa Rakshasas were a type of evil outsider from the lawful evil regions of the Outer Planes , though most lived on the Material Plane . They were powerful sorcerer s and , although they disdained physical fighting as ignoble , could be dangerous in close combat as well . Description . A rakshasa could assume any humanoid form , so few ever saw their true faces . In its natural form , a rakshasa had a powerfully built humanoid body and an animal ' s head . Many rakshasas had the head of a tiger , while others could have the heads of dogs , birds , or other animals . The king of the rakshasas was said to possess multiple heads , each a different type of animal . Another physical characteristic of the rakshasa was that its hands were backwards : the palms faced " out " from the body when the arms were at rest . Rakshasa were capable of hiding their disturbing appearance at any time , as they could choose any humanoid form at will . Rakshasa were cruel and wicked . They loved to pose as nobility , living a life of luxury and ease while many slaves and servants toiled under their command . Subraces . Tieflings .

title: Ralan el Pesarkhal
description: Ralan el Pesarkhal Ralan el Pesarkhal is syl - pasha ( ruler ) of Calimshan . He appears as a dark - haired , lean and imposing figure that seems younger than his years , with only a small patches of grey along the temples as any indication that he is anywhere close to being more than sixty years old . Personality .
description_long: Ralan el Pesarkhal Ralan el Pesarkhal is syl - pasha ( ruler ) of Calimshan . He appears as a dark - haired , lean and imposing figure that seems younger than his years , with only a small patches of grey along the temples as any indication that he is anywhere close to being more than sixty years old . Personality . Ralan el Pesarkhal possessess a calm demeanor is most situations , though the smile he offers can be full of secret meanings to those observant enough to catch them . He has a powerful gift in oratory , described as " spellbinding " and has brought him great favor with the common people . Ralan el Pesarkhal has a love for history , particularly the stories of the Shoon Imperium . One of his desires is to gain possession of the ancient city of Shoonach and revive the Imperium . Currently , Shoonach is part of the territories held by Tethyr to the north , and a point of contention between the two countries . History . Ralan el Pesarkhal first entered the political arena of Calimshan while serving as a vizier ( advisor ) of a sultan ( ruler ) of Manshaka .

title: Ralayan
description: Ralayan Ralayan , also known as Ralayn the Occultacle , was an alhoon member of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . The alhoon was the right - hand man of Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk and helped his master in his plots in order to attain for himself the place of Runemaster .
description_long: Ralayan Ralayan , also known as Ralayn the Occultacle , was an alhoon member of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . The alhoon was the right - hand man of Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk and helped his master in his plots in order to attain for himself the place of Runemaster . History . Ralayan was originally hailed from Oryndoll but fled the city and arrived in the Forest of Mir in circa 1350 DR The most famous exploit of Ralayan occurred while working with Priamon : he kidnapped Halaster Blackcloak from Undermountain during Higharvestide in 1369 DR . Priamon stole the secret of " gate " construction from Halaster .

title: Rallio deVore
description: Rallio deVore Rallio deVore was a tiefling in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . History . Rallio entered into an infernal pact but regretting the decision he went to Spellgard in search of Lady Saharel ' s counsel in 1478 DR .
description_long: Rallio deVore Rallio deVore was a tiefling in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . History . Rallio entered into an infernal pact but regretting the decision he went to Spellgard in search of Lady Saharel ' s counsel in 1478 DR . Quickly , however , Rallio despaired of ever seeing the Lady and became depressed , starting to spend most of his time drinking .

title: Rallogar Hardware
description: Rallogar Hardware Rallogar Hardware , or Rallogar ' s Hardware , was a hardware store located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Zendaros Rallogar . Location .
description_long: Rallogar Hardware Rallogar Hardware , or Rallogar ' s Hardware , was a hardware store located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Zendaros Rallogar . Location . Rallogar Hardware was situated opposite the Wheloon Watch House , and on the corner of Wheloon Way and the Way of the Manticore . History . The building was once a stables before being converted into a hardware store . Rallogar Hardware was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business through 1369 DR , and in 1374 DR . Rallogar Hardware provided supplies monthly to the newly built Temple of Mystra . Lady of Mystery Naedaenya Arthas was writing to negotiate better rates in early Eleint . Structure & Interior . The building still resembled an old and dusty stables , including a hayloft stuffed with old junk . Services . The store sold a variety of hardware goods . These ranged from rusty scrap metal to new metal goods , such as nails . Among them was a full range of hooks , from small , fine hooks for hanging masks and wigs , to big barge hooks . Zendaros made sure to keep good stocks of rope and wire , of all lengths and thicknesses , from strangling wire to thick ship towing cables .

title: Ralma Damond
description: Ralma Damond Ralma Damond was a former member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr in 1358 DR . History . Ralma was one of the original members of the Company in 1344 DR .
description_long: Ralma Damond Ralma Damond was a former member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr in 1358 DR . History . Ralma was one of the original members of the Company in 1344 DR . In time , she fell in love with her companion Nestrun Farclutch and in 1352 DR they abandoned the company to settle in Pailstone to form a family . They took care of a sanctuary for the company in the northeastern arm of the Forest of Tethir .

title: Ramael ' s cyclical light
description: Ramael ' s cyclical light Ramael ' s cyclical light was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell was similar to the " continual light " spell , but it faded and glowed with exterior light .
description_long: Ramael ' s cyclical light Ramael ' s cyclical light was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell was similar to the " continual light " spell , but it faded and glowed with exterior light . This spell could only be cast upon an object . An the object used during casting glowed brightly when placed in a darkened area . If placed in a medium lit area , the item would dim the light over several minutes so that it was not overbearing . Components . This spell could be cast without physical components , at which point it mimicked the " continual light " spell . If cast with a gemstones worth at least 10 gp , the light produced would appear as the same color as the gemstone .

title: Ramael the Reader
description: Ramael the Reader Ramael the Reader was a native from Halruaa who lived in the Dalelands in 1367 DR . Description . One of Ramael eyes was lost during his escape from Halruaa .
description_long: Ramael the Reader Ramael the Reader was a native from Halruaa who lived in the Dalelands in 1367 DR . Description . One of Ramael eyes was lost during his escape from Halruaa . Personality . Due to events that occured in his past , Ramael was a cautious individual who was always looking over his shoulder . Activities . Accused of spell theft , which was a serious offense in Halruaa , Ramael had to fight his way out of Halruaa in order to survive . He took up residence in the Dalelands where he posed as a bard . Possessions . Ramael owned many magical items including a " harp of Myth Drannor " , an " amulet of proof against detection and location " , and a " ring of mind shielding " . Ramael created several spells during his lifetime . Rumors and Legends . Ramael earned his nickname " the Reader " because of his fondness for " ESP " spells .

title: Ramas al - Rashid
description: Ramas al - Rashid Ramas al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Ramas and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .
description_long: Ramas al - Rashid Ramas al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Ramas and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham . They used this as a front to mark a for robbery . Relationships . Ramas was brother to Harun al - Rashid and Beyab al - Rashid .

title: Ramenos
description: Ramenos Ramenos is the bullywug deity of somnolence , intoxication , and decay . He is said to be sleeping deep within the Abyss where demons feed sacrifices into his gaping maw . Ramenos is completely uninterested in its worshippers and priests , and is concerned only with feeding and sleep .
description_long: Ramenos Ramenos is the bullywug deity of somnolence , intoxication , and decay . He is said to be sleeping deep within the Abyss where demons feed sacrifices into his gaping maw . Ramenos is completely uninterested in its worshippers and priests , and is concerned only with feeding and sleep . Once active and strong in ages long past , Ramenos now slumbers most of the time , barely able to sustain attention to his own fate . He takes the form of an enormous , bloated frog with a maw vast even for one of his kind . Strangely , bullywugs may revere Ramenos now not for his once great power , but for what he represents , the ideal of a life of overindulgence , something bullywugs struggling to survive might dream of being able to emulate in the afterlife . Ramenos shares its slumbering realm of " Smaragd " on the 74th layer of the Abyss with Merrshaulk .

title: Raml al - Nau
description: Raml al - Nau Raml al - Nau , also known as the Sandstorm , was an elite group of jann soldiers in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . Raml al - Nau served as an army under the direct command of the Grand Caliph .
description_long: Raml al - Nau Raml al - Nau , also known as the Sandstorm , was an elite group of jann soldiers in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . Raml al - Nau served as an army under the direct command of the Grand Caliph . History . Though they were known for numerous acts of valor , the Sandstorm was most famous for their actions defending the shrine of Hajama in the High Desert . Base of Operations . Huzuz served as the technical center of power of the Sandstorm , but the group was active throughout Zakhara based upon the needs of the Grand Caliph .

title: Ramman
description: Ramman Ramman was an ancient Untheric war deity . History . Ramman led Unther to its first victories as a strong and fair champion .
description_long: Ramman Ramman was an ancient Untheric war deity . History . Ramman led Unther to its first victories as a strong and fair champion . He led Unther in battle against the Imaskari and defended Unther during the Orcgate Wars . He drove the god Hoar out of the Untheric pantheon long before modern times . Hoar , appearing in Akanax , where he took the body of King Hippartes as his avatar , paid Ramman back for this by killing him during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR .

title: Rammaq
description: Rammaq Rammaq was an ancient titan , originally living during the Age of Giants , hence his large size as a demilich . History . He had been an undead mage for a very long time , and repeatedly sought to become a demigod , to no avail .
description_long: Rammaq Rammaq was an ancient titan , originally living during the Age of Giants , hence his large size as a demilich . History . He had been an undead mage for a very long time , and repeatedly sought to become a demigod , to no avail . He joined in Akachi ' s crusade as a lieutenant in the hopes of being able to obtain several tomes stored in Eternity ' s End in order to reach apotheosis . The crusade was foiled , but he managed to flee Myrkul ' s wrath and continued to search for a means of becoming a god . When the time for the Third Crusade was at hand , Rammaq returned to the Fugue Plane to resume what Akachi started , in hopes of trying again to obtain the Tome of Ka ' Tai and the Tome of the Dolorous Sage . After the initial wave , he and his soldiers headed to Eternity ' s End . The Kalach - Cha had a number of chances of foiling Rammaq ' s crusade , possibly even killing him . They could allow the books to be lost , and under some conditions Rammaq would see betrayal and attack . If the player retrieved one or both tomes , Rammaq sent an undead minion to assist at the Wall of the Faithless , while he left to work on apotheosis .

title: Ramos
description: Ramos Ramos was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1366 DR . Description . Ramos had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Ramos Ramos was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1366 DR . Description . Ramos had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven . Ramos typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Possessions . Ramos bore a sword in battle that was twenty - feet long . It was notched and rusted . History . In 1364 DR , a festival was held in honor of Ramos , who at that time was of second rank in the " ordning " . During the feast , the sun shone on the aerie for the first time in ten years , and this was seen as a omen that Ramos was to replace the current paramount as the new leader . By 1369 DR , Ramos was no longer paramount , having been replaced by a giant named Anastes . Anastes , Ramos , and four others were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . They heeded his call . Ramos and a giant named Nikol cooked a moose for Brianna to eat , but during this time , Tavis Burdun and armies of giant - kin attacked .

title: Rampage Stunk
description: Rampage Stunk Rampage Stunk was a wealthy Waterdavian merchant with a bad reputation . Most of his hirelings were thugs and he even employed a werewolf in his service . Stunk made much of his money by lending to old noblemen and then foreclosing on their mansions when they couldn ' t repay him .
description_long: Rampage Stunk Rampage Stunk was a wealthy Waterdavian merchant with a bad reputation . Most of his hirelings were thugs and he even employed a werewolf in his service . Stunk made much of his money by lending to old noblemen and then foreclosing on their mansions when they couldn ' t repay him . History . Stunk married into nobility . He decided that the existing family tomb wasn ' t grand enough so he purchased several adjacent plots in the City of the Dead with the intention of razing the old tombs so he could build his own on the site . Unfortunately for Stunk , one of the old tombs was the final resting place of Lord Dorgar Adarbrent ' s long dead fiancee . Dorgar used a spellbook belonging to his dead cousin to cause the dead to rise nightly and haunt Stunk ' s mansion . The hauntings became more and more intense and were finally ended by a young wizard named Gustin Bone and his friend Sophraea Carver . On the night the dead were finally sent back to their tombs , Stunk became lost in the City of the Dead and was found the next morning by Gustin and Sophraea . The experience aged Stunk many years and drove him insane . Appearance . Stunk was a very large man .

title: Ramparts of Dambrath
description: Ramparts of Dambrath The Ramparts of Dambrath were a series of fortified locations along the sharp cliffs of the Hethar Peninsula in southern Dambrath . Description . The Ramparts had two prominent strips .
description_long: Ramparts of Dambrath The Ramparts of Dambrath were a series of fortified locations along the sharp cliffs of the Hethar Peninsula in southern Dambrath . Description . The Ramparts had two prominent strips . The first ran for 150 miles ( 241 km ) to the west of the most narrow strip of the Hethar Peninsula . The second strip was 100 miles ( 161 km ) long on the eastern side of the narrow portion of the peninsula . Activity . Mounted soldiers patrolled the cliff faces , gazing out to sea for many miles for approaching enemies . All approaching vessels were reported through signal stations that were found every 10 miles ( 16 km ) along the coast . The signal stations communicated magically with each other . This rapid communication allowed for quick assembly of appropriate fighting forces to meet any enemy landing .

title: Ramtharage Druin
description: Ramtharage Druin Ramtharage Druin was a priest of Eldath in the Misty Forest in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Ramthar had imprisoned a group of ranger s of Mielikki , accusing them of desecrating the shrine to Eldath .
description_long: Ramtharage Druin Ramtharage Druin was a priest of Eldath in the Misty Forest in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Ramthar had imprisoned a group of ranger s of Mielikki , accusing them of desecrating the shrine to Eldath . However , Elminster Aumar arrived to intercede for the rangers . Ramthar did not listen to their reasons , so El called the avatar s of both Eldath and Mielikki . Ramthar was totally shocked by the meeting and agreed with the two goddesses that they were sisters and friends and so released the rangers .

title: Ranauroch
description: Ranauroch Ranauroch was a site mentioned in the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " , a giant ballad . In it , the giant hero Hjurgen was known as the " leveler of Ranauroch " . Ranauroch was believed to be a prehistoric kingdom or citadel but no evidence of its existence was found .
description_long: Ranauroch Ranauroch was a site mentioned in the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " , a giant ballad . In it , the giant hero Hjurgen was known as the " leveler of Ranauroch " . Ranauroch was believed to be a prehistoric kingdom or citadel but no evidence of its existence was found . Owing to the similar name , it was commonly believed to be beneath Anauroch .

title: Randal Morn
description: Randal Morn Randal Morn was the rightful heir of Daggerdale and had ruled as its Lord since 1369 DR when he reclaimed it from Zhentarim control . As the last surviving member of the Morn family , he lived in exile as a vigilante for over thirty years before his return . Description .
description_long: Randal Morn Randal Morn was the rightful heir of Daggerdale and had ruled as its Lord since 1369 DR when he reclaimed it from Zhentarim control . As the last surviving member of the Morn family , he lived in exile as a vigilante for over thirty years before his return . Description . Randal was of medium build , and was considered handsome with long brown hair . Skills . He was , among his skills as a warrior and leader , an accomplished musician and singer . History . The son of Flars Morn and Maerindra Elrproast , Randal was named after his mother ' s grandsire . During his teenage years , both his parents were savagely slain by hireswords of the Zhents and Randal was rescued by Harpers . The Morn family had ruled over the Dalelands for centuries prior to the arrival of the Zhentarim . A flood of easily manipulated refugees from the destruction of Teshendale arrived , bringing along Zhentarim agents hidden in their midst . Sowing dissent and dissatisfaction with the Morn family , the Zhentarim was able to instigate a rebellion against the ruling Lordship .

title: Randal Sweetgrove
description: Randal Sweetgrove Randal Sweetgrove was the leader of Amaunator ' s faith in Westgate during the Second Sundering . History . Randal led the temple to Amaunator in the city .
description_long: Randal Sweetgrove Randal Sweetgrove was the leader of Amaunator ' s faith in Westgate during the Second Sundering . History . Randal led the temple to Amaunator in the city . In 1486 DR , he heard rumors about a young prophet of Lathander who had just arrived in the city . Randal instructed his men to bring the boy to him . However , when he met with Stedd Whitehorn , the young Chosen of Lathander , Randal did not believe the boy ' s claims that , since the world was in need of hope and new beginnings , Amaunator had changed his incarnation and had once again assumed the role of Lathander . He ordered that Stedd be imprisoned as a heretic . However , Stedd ' s companion , the reaver Anton Marivaldi , recruited Dalabrac and the Fire Knives to break into the temple of Amaunator to free Stedd . Lathander ' s prophet escaped and despite some deva s sent by Randal to pursue him , Stedd and his companions managed to escape the city .

title: Randalla Brasshorn
description: Randalla Brasshorn Randalla Brasshorn was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate who served the Harpers in the mid – 14th century DR . She temporarily became a lieutenant of Xanhast , the general of Mordoc SeLanmere , during the time of Mordoc ' s Gate . History .
description_long: Randalla Brasshorn Randalla Brasshorn was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate who served the Harpers in the mid – 14th century DR . She temporarily became a lieutenant of Xanhast , the general of Mordoc SeLanmere , during the time of Mordoc ' s Gate . History . Baldur ' s Gate . Randalla was a wealthy merchant , who unbeknownst to others , was also a member of the Harpers , serving directly under Jherek . One day , when returning home to Baldur ' s Gate from Waterdeep with her caravan , she was captured by the Red Fang Marauders . She was rescued by five adventurers , including Dorn Redbear . She put Dorn and his " alliance " up to many missions for the Harpers , such as investigating the kidnappings and murders that involved deals between the Hands of Glory and Luvia Bloodmire . Mordoc ' s Gate . When Mordoc moved the Onyx Tower into Baldur ' s Gate , Randalla seemed to survive the tower ' s zombification effect . However , she was captured by Mordoc ' s right - hand - man Xanhast , who turned her into a vampire . While in this vampiric state , she seemed to show loyalty to Xanhast and it was assumed that she aided in the killing of anyone who wasn ' t already turned into a zombie .

title: Randers
description: Randers Randers was a mighty human paladin . Description . Randers was a tan , brown - haired man with narrow features and a prominent forehead .
description_long: Randers Randers was a mighty human paladin . Description . Randers was a tan , brown - haired man with narrow features and a prominent forehead . He wore a blue shirt underneath a suit of purple armor , and his head was covered by a purple , spiked helmet . Personality . Unwavering in his faith and unyielding in combat , Randers was a paragon of holy warriors . Possessions . Randers was adorned in full plate , gauntlets , and wore a " medallion of ESP " around his neck . He wielded a holy avenger in battle , astride his mount , a black horse in full barding . History . The holy avenger was awarded to Randers after he drove a horde of fiend s from a temple outpost .

title: Randil Moorwatch
description: Randil Moorwatch Randil Moorwatch was a mercenary in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , Randil and his Blue Griffon Company were hired by the Sembia n lord Borstag Duncastle to participate in the Cormanthor War .
description_long: Randil Moorwatch Randil Moorwatch was a mercenary in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , Randil and his Blue Griffon Company were hired by the Sembia n lord Borstag Duncastle to participate in the Cormanthor War . However , later , Randil and his men passed into the command of Miklos Selkirk . Randil and his men intercepted Ilsevele Miritar and Fflar Starbrow Melruth , who were on a diplomatic mission , and questioned them .

title: Randolph dul Umast
description: Randolph dul Umast Randolph dul Umast was a Human male priest of Tymora , and the high priest at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . When the temple of The Lady ' s Favor was built in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Randolph dul Umast was appointed its first high priest by his superiors at the Lady ' s Happy Hall in Procampur .
description_long: Randolph dul Umast Randolph dul Umast was a Human male priest of Tymora , and the high priest at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . When the temple of The Lady ' s Favor was built in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Randolph dul Umast was appointed its first high priest by his superiors at the Lady ' s Happy Hall in Procampur . He demonstrated himself to be a wise and capable leader of the local priesthood . Around Kythorn of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , a convoy secretly transported the " torque of faith " , a holy item of Tymora , to The Lady ' s Favor . However , the Vipers bandits attacked the convoy , massacred its guardians , and looted its wealth , including the torque . The Tymorans in Procampur were outraged and Randolph hired the ranger Dura Gerathu to locate the Vipers ' Nest . On the 1st Eleint in 1369 DR , one of the hamlet ' s wells was poisoned , killing a few villagers and sickening twenty two more . The priests of Tymora treated them but found that their magic could do nothing to identify or cure the poison , and they were forced to rely on non - magical treatments .

title: Random Riellor
description: Random Riellor Random Riellor , or Random the Mad , was a necromancer who wandered the entire breadth of Faerûn . Personality . Brilliant and capable , Random was an accomplished spellcaster whose personality seemed to vary on a daily basis .
description_long: Random Riellor Random Riellor , or Random the Mad , was a necromancer who wandered the entire breadth of Faerûn . Personality . Brilliant and capable , Random was an accomplished spellcaster whose personality seemed to vary on a daily basis . Activities . Random wandered the Realms in search of magic that would further his research . He was the only non - Halruaan wizard known to crack the mystery of southern magic through the use of his unique spell , " read southern magic " . . Possessions . Among other magical items , Random owned a ring of teleportation which he used frequently during his travels . He kept a skyship , fully outfitted with a spelljamming helm , in orbit high above Faerûn .

title: Random action
description: Random action Random action is an enchantment spell that causes one creature to act randomly for one round . Effect . The enchanted creature is compelled to act randomly for 1 round .
description_long: Random action Random action is an enchantment spell that causes one creature to act randomly for one round . Effect . The enchanted creature is compelled to act randomly for 1 round . Rather than deciding its action for itself , the subject of the spell takes an action determined randomly by the roll of a d8 . Nothing can affect this die roll in any way . It is always entirely random . Note : Nonintelligent creatures are immune to .

title: Randulaith
description: Randulaith Randulaith was an Illuskan human male wizard and a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Description . Randulaith favored plain clothes of tunic and breeches , but was elegant in dress .
description_long: Randulaith Randulaith was an Illuskan human male wizard and a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Description . Randulaith favored plain clothes of tunic and breeches , but was elegant in dress . Personality . Randulaith was quiet and not a cruel man . He easily made friends among all races and beliefs . He enjoyed fine wine , witty jokes , and desired mermaid s . Activities . Thanks to his amiable nature , Randulaith was a valuable spy for the Xanathar . He frequented Skullport and the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . History . Randulaith was originally from Mirabar , but eventually left the city and came to Skullport . There , he became one of the lieutenants of the Xanathar . He was even tasked with guarding the Eye ' s lair in Undermountain . His long - held plan was to join the ranks of the Lords of Waterdeep . He learned from his fellow Xanathar agent Colstan Rhuul that Brianne Byndraeth was one of the Lords and decided to court her in order to achieve his objective . He successfully got engaged with her . Unknown to Randulaith , he was also under scrutiny for membership in the Lords by Caladorn Cassalanter and Sammereza Sulphontis .

title: Raneger
description: Raneger Raneger was a watersoul genasi crime lord whose base of operations was the Den of Games in Airspur . He was widely considered to be the most powerful criminal in the city . He was grossly obese and spent most of his time soaking his bulk in a pool .
description_long: Raneger Raneger was a watersoul genasi crime lord whose base of operations was the Den of Games in Airspur . He was widely considered to be the most powerful criminal in the city . He was grossly obese and spent most of his time soaking his bulk in a pool . In 1479 DR , Raneger allowed a drow named Chenraya to store illicit items in his warehouse although he wasn ' t aware of their true nature nor the drow ' s plot . When confronted by the deva Demascus he agreed to aid in tracking down the drow .

title: Range of the Marching Camels
description: Range of the Marching Camels The Range of the Marching Camels in west Zakhara separated the High Desert in the north from the Pearl Cities region to the south . Geography . The Range of the Marching Camels ran east to west for hundreds of miles , stretching from Tajar and the Golden Gulf all the way to Akota on the coast of the Great Sea .
description_long: Range of the Marching Camels The Range of the Marching Camels in west Zakhara separated the High Desert in the north from the Pearl Cities region to the south . Geography . The Range of the Marching Camels ran east to west for hundreds of miles , stretching from Tajar and the Golden Gulf all the way to Akota on the coast of the Great Sea . It created a natural barrier that literally split western Zakhara into two geographical halves .

title: Ranger
description: Ranger Rangers were warriors who excelled at exploring the fringes of civilization and hunting down deadly monsters . Hunters , scouts , trappers , and assassins , rangers could be found wherever civilization bordered the wilderness . To aid them in their outback treks , rangers were trained in a number of combat techniques , survival skills , and even magic .
description_long: Ranger Rangers were warriors who excelled at exploring the fringes of civilization and hunting down deadly monsters . Hunters , scouts , trappers , and assassins , rangers could be found wherever civilization bordered the wilderness . To aid them in their outback treks , rangers were trained in a number of combat techniques , survival skills , and even magic . The most famous of all Toril ' s rangers is by far the legendary drow Drizzt Do ' Urden , though Dove Falconhand was also well - known during her lifetime . Culture . Most at home on the edge of civilization , rangers were often hunters , trackers , or some combination of the above , serving as protectors of the civilized world against the wilderness ' feral threats . Stereotyped as wild frontiersmen , rangers were often imagined most at home within dense woodlands . However , this was not true of all rangers and others were more at home within ancient ruins , vast deserts , caverns of the Underdark , or city sewers .

title: Rangewatchers
description: Rangewatchers The Rangewatchers were an adventuring company . History . In 1335 DR , the Rangewatchers battled a red dragon that was marauding against villages in the area .
description_long: Rangewatchers The Rangewatchers were an adventuring company . History . In 1335 DR , the Rangewatchers battled a red dragon that was marauding against villages in the area . During the battle , three Rangewatchers were killed and Montolio Debrouchee ' s face was melted . Montolio ' s skin was restored by healers , but his sight never returned . He felt pitied by his companions , so he retreated to an area later known as " Mooshie ' s Grove " to die . However , he found new life in gaining new skills through his senses other than sight .

title: Rangrim
description: Rangrim Rangrim was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout .
description_long: Rangrim Rangrim was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout . Rangrim volunteered to guide the expedition force , which included six bronze dragon s . However , during an ambush by a cultist army , one of the bronze dragons , Quelsandas , revealed himself as a spy of Sammaster and caught the Impilturan troops by surprise . Rangrim and Taegan managed to kill the traitorous bronze , but the paladin died in the process .

title: Ranna Keeneyes
description: Ranna Keeneyes Countess - Consort Ranna Keeneyes was the wife of Count Oxsal Keeneyes of Monteshi , Tethyr . She was a tiny halfling lady with great practical sense . As her husband spent most of his time in defense of Tethyr at Fort Teqlar , she was given his responsibilities of guild chancellorship .
description_long: Ranna Keeneyes Countess - Consort Ranna Keeneyes was the wife of Count Oxsal Keeneyes of Monteshi , Tethyr . She was a tiny halfling lady with great practical sense . As her husband spent most of his time in defense of Tethyr at Fort Teqlar , she was given his responsibilities of guild chancellorship . In this role , she traveled around the country , often in disguise as a merchant , in the protection of her five children . She ensured that the guilds did not abuse their political status to unfairly affect trade . She had the legal authority from the queen to put such offenders on trial .

title: Rannek
description: Rannek Rannek was a human fighter from Nesmé who was a member of the Riders of Nesmé . History . Rannek was the only survivor left in the ruins of the town when it was destroyed by Proffit and his band of troll s .
description_long: Rannek Rannek was a human fighter from Nesmé who was a member of the Riders of Nesmé . History . Rannek was the only survivor left in the ruins of the town when it was destroyed by Proffit and his band of troll s . He was hit from behind and pinned under a boulder . Somehow he escaped and , ashamed by quick defeat , attempted to make things right by leading a group of refugees to safety , that is , until General Dagna and Galen Firth found them battling trolls . Rannek and Firth grated on each other ' s nerves . When the refugees were safe , Rannek fled east to Damara . Drawn to Damara by a force he couldn ' t explain , but with nothing to lose , he joined with Zhai and Illius to cleanse the Gemspark mine . He accidentally freed Cireka and Ygorl in the process . After that he helped slay the red dragon Caminus . He eventually avenged himself on Proffit ' s trolls . Rannek later ruled over Vaasa , claiming it from the monsters living there for King Gareth Dragonsbane . The sword that he took from Cireka , the Silver Sword of Gith , carried the impending threat that the githyanki would come to try and take it back .

title: Rannigan
description: Rannigan Rannigar was an investigator in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . He recruit tiefling adventurers to do in the Blacklake District some missions to contrast the Ashmadai . Appendix .
description_long: Rannigan Rannigar was an investigator in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . He recruit tiefling adventurers to do in the Blacklake District some missions to contrast the Ashmadai . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Rannigar was involved in the storyline for the tiefling player race , the only non - tiefling NPC .

title: Ranseur
description: Ranseur A ranseur is a two - handed , martial melee reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . Using Gary Gygax ' s classification system described in pole arm s , a ranseur is a specialized spear with some added capabilities .
description_long: Ranseur A ranseur is a two - handed , martial melee reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . Using Gary Gygax ' s classification system described in pole arm s , a ranseur is a specialized spear with some added capabilities . ( Note that the Wikipedia article linked above calls them " corseques " . ) The head has a long , tapered spear tip with two wing - like projections at the base . These secondary barbs project out at about 45° from the center line but are curved backward . The base of the spear head is often indented forming a trap between the spear head and the secondary tines . This unusual weapon head is mounted on a shaft about 8 to 10 feet ( 2 . 4 to 3 meters ) long . An average ranseur costs 10gp and weighs 12lbs ( 5 . 5kg ) . Weaponology . Mainly a thrusting weapon , the ranseur ' s secondary barbs add some defensive capability to the basic spear . In addition , the trap at the base of the spear head can be used to entangle an enemy weapon and , with a twist of the shaft , bend or break the weapon and significantly increase the chance to disarm an opponent .

title: Ranthor
description: Ranthor Ranthor was a human wizard and master of Shal Bal who lived in Cormyr . Description . Being a wizard , Ranthor liked to dress in fine clothes and keep his appearance in good order ; many of his robes were blue , which was his signature color .
description_long: Ranthor Ranthor was a human wizard and master of Shal Bal who lived in Cormyr . Description . Being a wizard , Ranthor liked to dress in fine clothes and keep his appearance in good order ; many of his robes were blue , which was his signature color . Personality . As a teacher , Ranthor was kind and giving , always providing his students with positive encouragement and motivation . When he was a young man , Ranthor loved to dance and was always surrounded by beautiful women . Possessions . After his death , Ranthor left Shal all his personal items , including a staff of power , a cloth of many pockets , a ring of three wishes , a wand of wonder , and his familiar , Cerulean . History . Around 1337 DR , Ranthor took Shal Bal as an apprentice , even though she had no gold nor demonstrated any magical gift . In Flamerule 24 , 1340 DR , Ranthor traveled to Phlan to aid a fellow wizard , Denlor . Death . While communicating with Shal through a crystal ball , Ranthor was stabbed from behind by a dark dagger wielded by an unknown killer who wore a strange serpent - headed armlet .

title: Rantoon Gwa
description: Rantoon Gwa Rantoon Gwa was a ninja and pirate active in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was an infamous murderer who served as second - in - command of notorious pirate Crow Dz Pong , commanding a Koryoan warship . Both were based out of a secret fortress south of Mo ' ki Bay .
description_long: Rantoon Gwa Rantoon Gwa was a ninja and pirate active in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was an infamous murderer who served as second - in - command of notorious pirate Crow Dz Pong , commanding a Koryoan warship . Both were based out of a secret fortress south of Mo ' ki Bay .

title: Rapid reflexive response
description: Rapid reflexive response Rapid reflexive response was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . Ramael the Reader created this spell , but many Halruaan s credited Mycontil .
description_long: Rapid reflexive response Rapid reflexive response was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . Ramael the Reader created this spell , but many Halruaan s credited Mycontil . When cast , this spell allowed the caster to snatch any missile weighing less than 7 lbs . ( 3 . 2 kg ) out of the air and immediately throw it back at their attacker with startling accuracy . One object could be grabbed with each hand . This spell would also enhance the speed of any hand - related movement by the caster for its duration . Because of this , the caster would need to end the spell before attempting to cast a different spell . Components . This spell required a glove that was once worn by a throwing weapons specialist ( or a halfling ) , a shaving of licorice root , and a frog ' s tongue to cast .

title: Rapier
description: Rapier A rapier is a one - handed , martial melee weapon in the sword family . Description . The rapier is a slender , sharply pointed sword often with a complex hilt designed to protect the wielding hand .
description_long: Rapier A rapier is a one - handed , martial melee weapon in the sword family . Description . The rapier is a slender , sharply pointed sword often with a complex hilt designed to protect the wielding hand . The blade may be sharpened along some or all of the length of the blade or may not have any cutting edge at all . The blade is typically an inch ( 2 . 5cm ) wide or less and 39 inches ( 1 meter ) or more in length . A typical rapier costs 20gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . Used mainly for thrusting and piercing attacks , it is favored by many fencers and duelist s alike . Rapiers are relatively light blades and quite deadly in the hands of those properly trained , therefore they are classified as martial weapons . In D & D 3rd edition , rapiers can only be used without penalty with the martial weapons feat . In 3 . 5 edition the rapier is listed as a one - handed melee weapon , not a light weapon . Rapiers are not mentioned in the 2nd edition player ' s handbook . However , Rapiers feature in the " Fighters Handbook " and " Thieves Handbook " for the Swashbucker subclass .

title: Raptoran
description: Raptoran Raptorans are a freedom - loving race of humanoid avians . Description . Raptorans are slightly taller than human s with longer arms and legs although they tend to be slightly thinner .
description_long: Raptoran Raptorans are a freedom - loving race of humanoid avians . Description . Raptorans are slightly taller than human s with longer arms and legs although they tend to be slightly thinner . Most Raptorans have white feathers than may turn darker on the tips as they age . Their facial features tend to be angular and hawk - like . Society . The typical raptoran flock has between forty to eighty members . Each flock is governed by a chief . A high chieftain rules over several hundred flocks . Raptoran flocks usually build their communities into the side of a cliff or some other place that ' s difficult for other creatures to reach . Raptorans do not raise animals for food but are accomplished hunters of game . Religion . The primary deity of the raptorans is Tuilviel Glithien , the Queen of Air and Night who is the patron of the hunt and the family . History . Ages ago , the raptorans made a pact with the lords of the Elemental Plane of Air which gave the raptorans the ability to fly in exchange for their pledge to send warriors to fight for the lords . Abilities . At a young age , all raptorans go through a ritual that determines their fitness to fly .

title: Rarnok Jadronson
description: Rarnok Jadronson Rarnok Jadronson was a ogre mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Rarnok was a foot taller than normal ogres ; he always had the hilt of his greataxe covered by the teeth of his past victims .
description_long: Rarnok Jadronson Rarnok Jadronson was a ogre mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Rarnok was a foot taller than normal ogres ; he always had the hilt of his greataxe covered by the teeth of his past victims . History . Rarnok was the leader of the ogre mercenary company called the Teeth ; in 1375 DR they were recruited by the Zhentarim occupying Shadowdale . They attacked and destroyed the village of Oakwood Knoll with the Skull and Club mercenaries . Later the two mercenaries group argued about the spoils .

title: Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer
description: Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer was a transmutation spell that was only usable by wizard s and cleric s commanding the spell domain . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as mnemonic enhancer , and counted among the spells of the universal province . It allowed one to prepare extra spells or retain one that was just cast , and was presumably developed by Rary .
description_long: Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer was a transmutation spell that was only usable by wizard s and cleric s commanding the spell domain . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as mnemonic enhancer , and counted among the spells of the universal province . It allowed one to prepare extra spells or retain one that was just cast , and was presumably developed by Rary .

title: Rary ' s telepathic bond
description: Rary ' s telepathic bond Rary ' s telepathic bond is a divination spell that forms a telepathic link to let allies communicate . It was presumably developed by Rary . Effect .
description_long: Rary ' s telepathic bond Rary ' s telepathic bond is a divination spell that forms a telepathic link to let allies communicate . It was presumably developed by Rary . Effect . When cast , the spell forges a telepathic bond among intelligent , willing creatures , each creature linked to all the others . The creatures can communicate telepathically through the bond , regardless of language . No special power or influence is established as a result of the bond , and once it is formed , it works over any distance ( although not from one plane to another ) . A " wish " spell can make a " Rary ’ s telepathic bond " permanent , but it can bond only two people per " wish " . Material Components . A piece of eggshell from two different species of creature is required to cast the spell .

title: Raryn Snowstealer
description: Raryn Snowstealer Raryn Snowstealer was an arctic dwarf and a companion of Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Raryn lived with his people , the Inugaakalakurit , on the Great Glacier until he decided to go out and see the world .
description_long: Raryn Snowstealer Raryn Snowstealer was an arctic dwarf and a companion of Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Raryn lived with his people , the Inugaakalakurit , on the Great Glacier until he decided to go out and see the world . At one point , he joined Dorn Graybrook ' s mercenary band , which specialized in dragon - slaying . In 1373 DR , he and the rest of his companions were caught up in Sammaster ' s plot . During their journey , Raryn came back to his home village , but out of fear his people sold him and his companions to agents of Sammaster . He survived until the end of the mission and decided to come back to his people , hoping to forgive them .

title: Ras Nsi
description: Ras Nsi Ras ( or " Duke " ) Nsi was one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . He was infamous for seeking bloody and violent revenge against the Eshowe tribe of Chult and for the creation of the majority of the undead that roam that land . Description .
description_long: Ras Nsi Ras ( or " Duke " ) Nsi was one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . He was infamous for seeking bloody and violent revenge against the Eshowe tribe of Chult and for the creation of the majority of the undead that roam that land . Description . Ras Nsi dressed the part of a Cormyr ean noble , wearing a sky - blue cloak and bearing a rapier . He had soft features , but his eyes supernaturally glowed bright red whenever he became irritable or spoke of his zeal for the city of Mezro . Personality . The first impression one might receive when meeting Ras Nsi was that he was decadent and weak - willed . Nsi , despite his exile , maintained a powerful devotion to both Ubtao and his holy city . He strongly opposed King Osaw ' s opening of the once hidden city to non - Tabaxi . Abilities . Like all " bara e " , Ras Nsi was immortal and could not age or grow sick .

title: Rasaad yn Bashir
description: Rasaad yn Bashir Rasaad yn Bashir was a Calishite monk who wandered the Sword Coast in search of enlightenment after a disastrous mission to a monastery in Athkatla . History . As children , the orphaned brothers Rasaad and Gamaz survived in Calimport by begging and stealing .
description_long: Rasaad yn Bashir Rasaad yn Bashir was a Calishite monk who wandered the Sword Coast in search of enlightenment after a disastrous mission to a monastery in Athkatla . History . As children , the orphaned brothers Rasaad and Gamaz survived in Calimport by begging and stealing . After they were caught in the act by a Selûnite monk of the Sun Soul , the brothers were trained in a monastery and excelled their training in all respects . After Gamaz ' s death , Rasaad left his order to seek his own solace and to find opportunities to reflect his inner light on those in need . He met Gorion ' s Ward in Nashkel .

title: Rashad al - Klemari
description: Rashad al - Klemari Rashad al - Klemari was an elven merchant who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . He was not a member of the House of Al - Klemari merchant family . Activities .
description_long: Rashad al - Klemari Rashad al - Klemari was an elven merchant who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . He was not a member of the House of Al - Klemari merchant family . Activities . Rashad owned a small shop that faced the plaza housing the mosques of all the great gods of Zakhara . He sold religious items to the many pilgrims who visited the area . Rashad was a religious man who worshiped all of the Zakharan gods . He attended services at the Golden Mosque twice a day .

title: Rashara
description: Rashara Rashara was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area .
description_long: Rashara Rashara was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area . Here , however , the cambion twins , using " fiendish charm " and " alter self " spell s , managed to gain the worship of a tribe of madness - infected kuo - toa , who believed them to be gods . Impressed , Graz ' zt sent the hezrou Toad to serve them . Gattash and Rashara planned to destroy the Red Plumes garrison inside the Waydown and go back to the court of the demon lord . They started sending some octopus es to attack Red Plume patrols . They resided in a luxury room in their new Sanctum of Sin with their kuo - toa minions . However , they were killed by some adventurers hired by Arrizz .

title: Rasharoo
description: Rasharoo Rasharoo was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Rasharoo was the leader of the small Circle of Explorers in Neverlight Grove , exploring the Underdark more often than its fellow .
description_long: Rasharoo Rasharoo was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Rasharoo was the leader of the small Circle of Explorers in Neverlight Grove , exploring the Underdark more often than its fellow . When , with the Rage of Demons , Zuggtmoy ' s will twisted most of the Circle , Rasharoo secretly started making plans to escape . Thanks to the cooperation of a party of adventurers escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve , Basidia led Rasharoo , Loobamub , and their followers out of the Grove before was too late Personality . Always a loyal follower of Basidia , Rasharoo ' s knowledge of the outside world permitted it to more clearly notice the signs of madness in Phylo and its followers . Because of this , it only trusted Basidia .

title: Rashemen
