description: Rashemen Rashemen was a magocratic in the far northeast Faerûn . Geography . The people of Rashemen are called Rashemi .
description_long: Rashemen Rashemen was a magocratic in the far northeast Faerûn . Geography . The people of Rashemen are called Rashemi . The country itself is surrounded by mountains , vast lakes and rivers , which provide natural fortifications , making Rashemen an ideally defensible region against the Red Wizards of Thay and the Nar barbarians who are known to attack the territory on a rather frequent basis . Geographically , the northern portion of Rashemen is predominantly barren and ravaged by strong , harsh winds ; while the south is cooler and maintains a more placid environment , which is considerably more hospitable for habitation . Rashemen was considered to be more closely connected to the Feywild than any other location in Faerûn . History . Rashemen was founded in - 4963 DR by the followers of Shemen , a chieftain of a Raumviran tribe , after his death . Sylune , the Witch of Shadowdale , spent some time studying with the Witches of Rashemen before her death . During the Time of Troubles , dead - magic zone s sprung up around the land and the witches had trouble contacting the spirits .

title: Rashemi
description: Rashemi The Rashemi are a human ethnic group native to Rashemen . Appearance . Most are short ( about 5 1 / 2 feet tall on average ) and muscular , with a hardy physique .
description_long: Rashemi The Rashemi are a human ethnic group native to Rashemen . Appearance . Most are short ( about 5 1 / 2 feet tall on average ) and muscular , with a hardy physique . They commonly have dusky skin , dark eyes , and thick black hair . Men are especially hairy and may maintain a thick dark beard ; baldness is virtually unknown in their culture . Women often wear their hair long and elaborately plaited . Culture . Rashemi think of themselves as inhabitants of a harsh and beautiful land ruled by spirits and rarely display the arrogance of other human ethnic groups . Children are expected to earn their place in the world , rather than having it handed to them , and they view life as a series of challenges to face and defeat . They place a high value on individual accomplishment and strength , physical in Rashemen and magical in Thay . Elders are respected for their wisdom and mental strength . Rogues are very uncommon as little value is placed in the accumulation of wealth . Most young adult Rashemi travel extensively for a year as part of a coming - of - age ritual called " dajemma " , resulting in a population with considerable worldly knowledge .

title: Rashemi dictionary
description: Rashemi dictionary A list of words and terms in the Rashemi language . B . Bannik - spirit of health ; often provides divination in a bathhouse .
description_long: Rashemi dictionary A list of words and terms in the Rashemi language . B . Bannik - spirit of health ; often provides divination in a bathhouse . bheur - blue winter hag that brings winter . C . cheznitznia - " shapeshifter " . D . dajemma or darjemma - a type of coming - of - age tradition for young Rashemi men to travel to foreign lands to see and understand more of the world . dierneszkits - " zombies " . domovoi - house spirit . durthan - evil witch . dvorovoi - bad spirit . F . fyrra - " leader " ( i . e . , of a village ) . fang - berserker lodge . H . hathran - " witch " . huhrong - Iron Lord . J . jhuild - Rashemar firewine . M . morrigan - being that moves between " starlight and shadows . " N . nydeshka - " blunt sword " ( refers to someone who is dangerous to others ) . O . othlor - " elder among witches " ( used a title following a name , e . g . Zofia Othlor ) . P . polevik - a creature that appears as a squat dwarf with green hair and beard and one green eye and one orange eye ; usually wanders at highsun . T . taer - ice giants . telthor - place spirit ; spirit animals or people . thomil - rock spirit . U . uthraki - malevolent forest spirit W .

title: Rashemi language
description: Rashemi language Rashemi , also known as Rasallesian , was the language of the people of Rashemen . Speakers . In addition to Rashemen , Rashemi was spoken by inhabitants of Altumbel , the Great Dale , the Hordelands , Narfell , the Ride , Thay , Thesk , and the Vast .
description_long: Rashemi language Rashemi , also known as Rasallesian , was the language of the people of Rashemen . Speakers . In addition to Rashemen , Rashemi was spoken by inhabitants of Altumbel , the Great Dale , the Hordelands , Narfell , the Ride , Thay , Thesk , and the Vast . Some of the elves of the Forest of Lethyr , Sildëyuir , and the Snow Eagle Aerie also spoke this tongue . Planetouched human s from Mulhorand sometimes learned the language as well . Even so , Rashemi was usually only spoken regularly within the borders of Rashemen , and in fact , of all those of the Rashemi ethnicity living in Faerûn , more spoke Thay an Mulhorandi than spoke Rashemi . In addition to Sylvan , the spirit folk in the region of Lake Ashane spoke Rashemi as their primary language . Script . Rashemi employed the Thorass alphabet , which was introduced to Rashemen by Chondathan traders traveling along the Golden Way . History . Rashemi was in the Raumtheran languages group , the collection of languages originating in the Raumathar i Empire . It was derived primarily from Raumvira and Halardrim . Examples .

title: Rashid al - Niran
description: Rashid al - Niran Rashid al - Niran was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Rashid served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .
description_long: Rashid al - Niran Rashid al - Niran was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Rashid served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan . He controlled his own stronghold , complete with a staff of other efreet and noble efreet as well as a contingent of slaves of various races .

title: Rashturiver
description: Rashturiver The Rashturiver was a river in Amn that fed Lake Weng . Geography . This river began in the Cloud Peaks northeast of Lake Weng and due west of Citadel Rashturl .
description_long: Rashturiver The Rashturiver was a river in Amn that fed Lake Weng . Geography . This river began in the Cloud Peaks northeast of Lake Weng and due west of Citadel Rashturl . It had a waterfall near its source and had a twisted course until it reached the Amnurflow . History . The river was named for the famous Amnian general Rashturl .

title: Rasid Nadepa ' an
description: Rasid Nadepa ' an Rasid Nadepa ' an was the crown prince of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Rasid did not truly care about matters of state .
description_long: Rasid Nadepa ' an Rasid Nadepa ' an was the crown prince of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Rasid did not truly care about matters of state . His true ambition was to become the best kensai of Bawa . For this , he often went to hunt in the wilderness . During those travels , he killed many monsters and forged good relationships with many Bawani tribes .

title: Rasping sand
description: Rasping sand Rasping sand was a deadly magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that tore away at any surface . . Powers .
description_long: Rasping sand Rasping sand was a deadly magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that tore away at any surface . . Powers . When thrown , this sand tore both living and non - living surfaces for three full minutes before expiring . Against non - living material one handful of " rasping sand " would literally destroy up to 100 pounds ( 45 kg ) of the object in question . Living creatures suffered increasingly devastating damage while the sand eroded their flesh . Despite its terrifying reputation , " rasping sand " could be easily counteracted with a gallon of water per handful of sand . The water would instantly negate the sand , causing it to dissolve . Anyone wishing to throw a handful of " rasping sand " needed to wear a protective glove or risk becoming the object of its deadly affection .

title: Rassalantar
description: Rassalantar Rassalantar was a hamlet and caravan stop on the Long Road , just north of Waterdeep in the Sword Coast North region . Geography . The small community consisted of six walled farms .
description_long: Rassalantar Rassalantar was a hamlet and caravan stop on the Long Road , just north of Waterdeep in the Sword Coast North region . Geography . The small community consisted of six walled farms . They centered around a spring - fed pond which drained into a stream and emptied to the east into the Stump Bog , a sprawling , desolate marsh haunted by monsters . To the west of the farmhouses , a narrow patch of trees known as Keep Woods masked the ruins of Rassalantar ' s Keep , and to the east of the pond was the Sleeping Dragon . Defense . Since Rassalantar was under Waterdeep ' s protection , sixty guards were stationed in the barracks just off the road behind the Sleeping Dragon inn . The fighter s were outfitted in chain mail with shield s and fought with spear s , longsword s , hammer s , and dagger s . The Waterdhavian soldiers patrolled the Long Road from the gates of their city to a cavern a half - days ride north of Amphail . The guards were rotated back to duty in Castle Waterdeep once a month . The officers , on the other hand , do not rotate , because they were veterans who knew the surrounding country very well .

title: Rassalantar ' s Keep
description: Rassalantar ' s Keep Rassalantar ' s Keep was a fortress built by the warrior Rassalantar . Geography . The keep was not far from the Sleeping Dragon , which was east of the hamlet of Rassalantar .
description_long: Rassalantar ' s Keep Rassalantar ' s Keep was a fortress built by the warrior Rassalantar . Geography . The keep was not far from the Sleeping Dragon , which was east of the hamlet of Rassalantar . The Long Road traveled north of Waterdeep and passed the Keep Woods , which masked the location of the ruins . History . By 1370 DR , it was ruined and occupied only by tramps , doppelganger s , and other monsters . Rassalantar , a caravan stop , sprung up around this time east of the ruined keep .

title: Rassendyll Uoumdolphin
description: Rassendyll Uoumdolphin Rassendyll Uoumdolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster , ruling the city with cunning schemes . Relationships . Rassendyll was the twin brother of Selfaril .
description_long: Rassendyll Uoumdolphin Rassendyll Uoumdolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster , ruling the city with cunning schemes . Relationships . Rassendyll was the twin brother of Selfaril . Personally protected by Thurndan Tallwand and the rest of the Brotherhood of the Cloak , Rassendyll also relied on hiring others within his realm of influence , such as the assassin Branislav Semyon whom he used to remove anyone who might challenge his power . History . After Selfaril had been in power in Mulmaster for twenty - seven years , Rassendyll seized power by removing his brother from office in 1375 DR and replacing him . The removal of Selfaril had been devised by Fzoul Chembryl in a bid to gain control over Mulmaster . The story wen that Rassendyll was in " exile " at this time , assigned to a diplomatic post in Waterdeep . Selfaril ' s soul was trapped in a gem in the hilt of his sword . Rassendyll made an important change in policy after assuming control , making an alliance with the Zhentarim . Appearance . Rassendyll was over 6 ' ( 1 . 8 m ) tall with gray hair and a weathered face . He was in good shape for a man of his age .

title: Rassiter
description: Rassiter Rassiter was a wererat soldier and the leader of the wererats of Calimport . History . While Artemis Entreri was away searching for Regis , Pasha Pook allied with Rassiter and used him and his men as enforcers .
description_long: Rassiter Rassiter was a wererat soldier and the leader of the wererats of Calimport . History . While Artemis Entreri was away searching for Regis , Pasha Pook allied with Rassiter and used him and his men as enforcers . When Artemis returned with Regis , Rassiter considered his position in danger and tried to block the assassin . Rassiter was also involved in fighting with the Companions of the Hall during this time . In the end , the wererats were exterminated by Astral Plane panthers and Pook was killed , so Rassiter tried to ally with Entreri to become the rulers of the streets of Calimport , but the assassin said that he worked alone and easily killed him .

title: Rastafan Dimetar
description: Rastafan Dimetar Rastafan Dimetar was a courtier of Cormyr in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , news arrived in Suzail that runaway princess Alusair Obarskyr was seen near Tilverton .
description_long: Rastafan Dimetar Rastafan Dimetar was a courtier of Cormyr in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , news arrived in Suzail that runaway princess Alusair Obarskyr was seen near Tilverton . Rastafan was one of the many envoys sent by King Azoun Obarskyr IV to the Dalelands in order to recruit an adventuring party to find Alusair .

title: Rat
description: Rat A rat was a long - tailed rodent , a species of animal . Ecology . Rats thrived in urban environments where they could easily feed off the leftover food and waste of the community .
description_long: Rat A rat was a long - tailed rodent , a species of animal . Ecology . Rats thrived in urban environments where they could easily feed off the leftover food and waste of the community . Deep in the Underdark near Menzoberranzan , scurry rats were hunted by riding lizard s of the drow .

title: Rat ' s Bastard
description: Rat ' s Bastard For the past month , orc s have been turning up murdered along with messages that read " The only good orc is a . . .
description_long: Rat ' s Bastard For the past month , orc s have been turning up murdered along with messages that read " The only good orc is a . . . " . The city guard , despite increased patrols can find no evidence as to who the murderer is , but what few clues have been found point to the Red Fellowship . Racial tensions are growing and it seems that a riot is only one more orc corpse away . . .

title: Rat Hills
description: Rat Hills The Rat Hills was the name given to a stretch of coastline a short distance to the south of Waterdeep , often used as a dump by the city . History . When Waterdeep was still young , it was a simple , barren pebble beach that was a favorite spot for ships to land for repairs or take on cargoes like lumber , since even a mile out to sea the water wasn ' t any deeper than five feet .
description_long: Rat Hills The Rat Hills was the name given to a stretch of coastline a short distance to the south of Waterdeep , often used as a dump by the city . History . When Waterdeep was still young , it was a simple , barren pebble beach that was a favorite spot for ships to land for repairs or take on cargoes like lumber , since even a mile out to sea the water wasn ' t any deeper than five feet . Once the city had grown large enough to suffer from raiders , however , the citizens began to worry that such an easy port was not only a free alternative to using the city ' s harbor , but also an easy place from which to attack . A shanty town sprang up that was soon under the control of the Shadow Thieves . The lords responded swiftly though , ordering the City Guard to clear " the Beach " of its inhabitants , kill any who resisted and maintain a strong patrol to ensure the area remained clear . Under escort , the citizenry began bringing their garbage here rather than burning it directly outside the city walls , though this task was now handled by the Dungsweeper ' s Guild . The piles of garbage earned the place its later name — " Rat Hills " — and covered an area almost 4 miles ( 6 .

title: Rat Hills Conflagration
description: Rat Hills Conflagration The Rat Hills Conflagration was a large fire in the Rat Hills garbage dump located south of the city of Waterdeep in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . It was accidentally started by the Confluence in a failed attack against the Unseen . Waterdhavian guard patrols got involved when they spotted what they thought was a group of evil will - o ' - wisp s in the blaze .
description_long: Rat Hills Conflagration The Rat Hills Conflagration was a large fire in the Rat Hills garbage dump located south of the city of Waterdeep in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . It was accidentally started by the Confluence in a failed attack against the Unseen . Waterdhavian guard patrols got involved when they spotted what they thought was a group of evil will - o ' - wisp s in the blaze . They engaged the wisps but did not realize that the group also contained some similar - looking nyths , which explosively reproduced in fire . The Waterdhavians killed the wisps but two guards were lost when the nyths began to reproduce . The nyths went on to inhabit the Rat Hills and , as the Retreat of the moon elves from Ardeep meant that the monster population in the abandoned realm was left unchecked , they infested the Ardeep Forest as well .

title: Rath Modar
description: Rath Modar Rath Modar was a Red Wizard of Thay who had desires to become the next Zulkir of Illusion and even grander plans for himself . Personality . Rath was deceptive and obfuscating .
description_long: Rath Modar Rath Modar was a Red Wizard of Thay who had desires to become the next Zulkir of Illusion and even grander plans for himself . Personality . Rath was deceptive and obfuscating . He had an interest in ancient empires and lost items of power . He plotted revenge from his castle on the Sword Coast . Possessions . The Red Wizard armed himself with a " staff of fire " and carried scrolls of " dimension door " , " feather fall " , and " fireball " spells on his person at all times . History . Rath was a Red Wizard of Thay who was exiled to the Sword Coast because of suspicions that he was involved in a plot by the Red Wizards to retake Thay from Szass Tam . He was a key player in the alliance with the Cult of the Dragon and planned that when Tiamat re - entered the world he would forge a Thayan alliance with her . Because of his exile , he wanted to take revenge by taking an army of dragon s to Thay and conquering it for himself .

title: Rathan Thentraver
description: Rathan Thentraver Rathan Thentraver was a human cleric of Tymora and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He appreciated feasting and drinking very much , so he was overweight and suffered from hangovers from time to time , though he did not complain . His trust in his goddess Tymora , the Lady Luck , made him a fearless man who preferred to act instead of thinking it over .
description_long: Rathan Thentraver Rathan Thentraver was a human cleric of Tymora and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He appreciated feasting and drinking very much , so he was overweight and suffered from hangovers from time to time , though he did not complain . His trust in his goddess Tymora , the Lady Luck , made him a fearless man who preferred to act instead of thinking it over . He used mace and shield in battle . Rathan ' s holy symbol can be clipped into his shield . Rathan ' s best friend was Torm the Rogue .

title: Rathene Fel
description: Rathene Fel Rathene Fel was a bandit in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rathene believed that her comrades had abandoned her and for the right price she would betray them .
description_long: Rathene Fel Rathene Fel was a bandit in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rathene believed that her comrades had abandoned her and for the right price she would betray them . For this , she was bitter and lashed out at others . History . Rathene was a half - orc mercenary who joined the Gray Patriots bandit group after they freed her from a labor camp near Phlan . However , she was captured by Knights of the Black Fist and sentenced to Grimshackle Jail . Rathene believed her comrades had abandoned her , but on the contrary a jailer was bribed to free her . However , an adventuring party there to interrogate her recaptured her . Around 1492 DR Rathene was a bandit leader that help in the reclamation of Phlan .

title: Rathgar the Raider
description: Rathgar the Raider Rathgar the Raider was a man who conquered and seized control of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Rathgar the Raider led a band of warriors who overran Doegan and laid siege to the capital .
description_long: Rathgar the Raider Rathgar the Raider was a man who conquered and seized control of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Rathgar the Raider led a band of warriors who overran Doegan and laid siege to the capital . To pacify his own poor clansmen , Rathgar plundered the realm of its bounty , and became known as the " scourge of north lands " . Finally , he came for the crown itself , and confronted the king and princess in their own throne room . However , with his dying breath , the defiant king cursed him , declaring " For so long as you rule , a curse upon you . The dead will arise , to ensure your demise . " However , Rathgar paid no heed to the curse , until , months later , a captured criminal , a graverobber called Grubkern , whispered of a gathering army of undead coming to rid Doegan of the invaders . As fear spread in the capital , Rathgar determined to investigate , threatening to kill Grubkern if he ' d spoken falsely . Escaping the invaders , the princess of Doegan had looked for a way to make her father ' s prophecy come true , at last enlisting the aid Aelric at Old Stone Keep .

title: Rathgaunt Mote
description: Rathgaunt Mote Prior to the Spellplague in 1385 DR , Rathguant Mote was part of the Rathgaunt Hills and a gnomish abbey known as the Shield of the Rathgaunt Hills sat on the site . When the Spellplague created the Underchasm , the area surrounding the abbey broke off into a large earthmote . As of 1479 DR the mote was inhabited by only the former gnomish monk s who continued to exist as undead creatures .
description_long: Rathgaunt Mote Prior to the Spellplague in 1385 DR , Rathguant Mote was part of the Rathgaunt Hills and a gnomish abbey known as the Shield of the Rathgaunt Hills sat on the site . When the Spellplague created the Underchasm , the area surrounding the abbey broke off into a large earthmote . As of 1479 DR the mote was inhabited by only the former gnomish monk s who continued to exist as undead creatures .

title: Rathool ' s Pond
description: Rathool ' s Pond Rathool ' s Pond , also called Rathool ' s Pool , was a body of water located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Geography . A tributary of the Wyvernflow fed Rathool ' s Pond , though it lay within the city itself .
description_long: Rathool ' s Pond Rathool ' s Pond , also called Rathool ' s Pool , was a body of water located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Geography . A tributary of the Wyvernflow fed Rathool ' s Pond , though it lay within the city itself . Trout could be found in it . History . For some centuries , Whelunians used the pond as a burial site for war heroes and those slain in battle , depositing them in the pond together with their armor and weapon s . Though the corpses decomposed , their armor and weapons took longer to rust away , turning the water orange - brown with rust . By the mid – 13th century DR , Rathool ' s Pond was the local swimming pool and fishing hole . Nevertheless , the contaminated waters were considered unsafe for drinking or fishing , as they were suspected to cause sickness . However , the priests of Chauntea at the Harvest Hall opposed efforts to clean it up , fearing the dead would be disturbed and their spirits grow angry . The elven farmer Bryn Ohme Thornwood mentioned Rathool ' s Pond as an example of how some natural areas of Cormyr had been damaged by human activity .

title: Rathrea
description: Rathrea The rathrea were a type of undead dragon from Returned Abeir . Dragonborn called them ghost dragons . Creation .
description_long: Rathrea The rathrea were a type of undead dragon from Returned Abeir . Dragonborn called them ghost dragons . Creation . Rathrea were created when dragons who failed to awaken after having consumed arambar . Those dragons eventually transformed into wraith - like , incorporeal glowing white spirits who had the ability to divine the future . This ability was limited to certain areas of information and time - spans . The rathrea didn ' t live for much time , fading away in a few weeks . According to Gauwervyndhal , those rathrea " ascended " after they disappeared . History . The Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal prized the rathrea for their ability , as it allowed her to outmaneuver her enemies . Gauwervyndhal forced many of her dragon servants , even her own children , to consume arambar in order to procure more rathrea .

title: Raudor
description: Raudor Raudor was an ancient Imaskari city in the Hordelands . Description . Built during the Imaskari Empire , Raudor was a city nestled beneath a cliff of the Raurin Alta , in what was once a green vale .
description_long: Raudor Raudor was an ancient Imaskari city in the Hordelands . Description . Built during the Imaskari Empire , Raudor was a city nestled beneath a cliff of the Raurin Alta , in what was once a green vale . However , due to rock slides off the cliffs , and the expansion of the Plains of Purple Dust , the city became buried under sand and rock . While the buildings of Raudor were preserved by the sand , few visited the city due to the lack of treasure , and the city ' s ability to drive people insane . The few who did visit the city were mostly evil wizard s , drawn by a desire to try to find the source of the city ' s evil , or the ancient evil artifact s that were said to be there , in attempts to increase their own power . Most who visited the city died , many came back insane , and others still returned more crazy and powerful then they were before , serving as inspiration to others who sought power to come to the city .

title: Rauglothgor
description: Rauglothgor Rauglothgor was a red dragon who became one of the first dracolich s created by Sammaster . By 1357 DR , the Cult of the Dragon under Symgharyl Maruel provided a new lair for Rauglothgor in a tower belonging to the wizard Garthond , who had often fought the Cult . In a twist of fate , in 1357 DR , Symgharyl Maruel captured a strange girl , Shandril Shessair , the daughter of Garthond , and entrusted Rauglothgor with her custody .
description_long: Rauglothgor Rauglothgor was a red dragon who became one of the first dracolich s created by Sammaster . By 1357 DR , the Cult of the Dragon under Symgharyl Maruel provided a new lair for Rauglothgor in a tower belonging to the wizard Garthond , who had often fought the Cult . In a twist of fate , in 1357 DR , Symgharyl Maruel captured a strange girl , Shandril Shessair , the daughter of Garthond , and entrusted Rauglothgor with her custody . However , in a strange series of events involving Elminster Aumar , the Knights of Myth Drannor , a apprentice wizard and a balhiir , it was discovered that Shandril had the power of the " spellfire " . With her new powers , she blew apart Rauglothgor , the cult members , and much of the surrounding terrain .

title: Rauligus Helderstone
description: Rauligus Helderstone Rauligus Helderstone was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Helderstone noble house . History . Rauligus made an agreement with Lord Traevyn Illance to give him much money and live outside Suzail .
description_long: Rauligus Helderstone Rauligus Helderstone was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Helderstone noble house . History . Rauligus made an agreement with Lord Traevyn Illance to give him much money and live outside Suzail . Around 1479 DR , Rauligus was back in the city and Traevyn forced him to a meeting using as an intermediary the wizard - for - hire Morligul Downdagger . However , arriving at the meeting instead were Elminster Aumar disguised as Morligul and Mirt disguised as Helderstone .

title: Raumathar
description: Raumathar Raumathar was a great eastern empire that once included the lands that became Rashemen and Thay . Its people were known to be powerful battle - wizard s , and their art of fighting is still known by some . History .
description_long: Raumathar Raumathar was a great eastern empire that once included the lands that became Rashemen and Thay . Its people were known to be powerful battle - wizard s , and their art of fighting is still known by some . History . Raumathar was established by the Raumviran people in - 900 DR , setting their capital as Winterkeep . In - 623 DR , Raumathar surprised its neighbour Narfell by attacking them while they were being beaten in a war with Mulhorand , beginning the first of many wars with the Nar people . In - 160 DR , the last of these wars began . Known as The Great Conflagration , it culminated in the ruination of both empires a decade later . The surviving Raumvirans were then pushed westward by the Suren people .

title: Raumkreml
description: Raumkreml Raumkreml , also called Chern - kreml or the Black Citadel , was a tower located in the city of Almorel within the Hordelands . Location . Ruamkreml was located in the center of Almorel .
description_long: Raumkreml Raumkreml , also called Chern - kreml or the Black Citadel , was a tower located in the city of Almorel within the Hordelands . Location . Ruamkreml was located in the center of Almorel . Structure . This tower was built as a fortress during the height of the Raumathar Empire . The entire ziggurat was built of wood that had been painted black on the outside , spawning the nickname of the Black Tower . Inhabitants . Almorel used Raumkreml as their seat of government .

title: Raumtheran languages
description: Raumtheran languages The Raumtheran language group was a small branch of the Faerûnian languages family that included languages spoken in northeastern regions of Faerûn , such as Rashemen . Languages . The following languages were considered Raumtheran languages : Appendix .
description_long: Raumtheran languages The Raumtheran language group was a small branch of the Faerûnian languages family that included languages spoken in northeastern regions of Faerûn , such as Rashemen . Languages . The following languages were considered Raumtheran languages : Appendix . Inspiration . The Raumtheran language group is based on real - life languages such as , , and .

title: Raumvira
description: Raumvira Raumvira was a language in the Imaskari languages group that was one of the predecessors to the Rashemi language of Rashemen . Description . Raumvira had round and broad vowel sounds .
description_long: Raumvira Raumvira was a language in the Imaskari languages group that was one of the predecessors to the Rashemi language of Rashemen . Description . Raumvira had round and broad vowel sounds . Its R sounds were rolled . Speakers . Raumvira was spoken by Raumviran s , the remnants of the Raumathar an Empire who resided in the Lake of Mists region . Script . Raumvira was written in the Dethek alphabet , which the Raumvirans learned from the Siremun dwarves long before even the founding of Raumathar . History . Raumvira was strongly influenced by Dwarvish and the dialect of Imaskari ( Roushoum ) spoken in the northern parts of the Imaskar i Empire . It was considered one of the Northern Imaskari languages .

title: Raumviran
description: Raumviran The Raumvirans were remnants of the people of the ancient empire of Raumathar . The Rashemi and Damaran ethnic groups descended from the Raumvirans . Description .
description_long: Raumviran The Raumvirans were remnants of the people of the ancient empire of Raumathar . The Rashemi and Damaran ethnic groups descended from the Raumvirans . Description . Ruamvirans appeared very similar to Rashemi , although they were generally taller and had skin tones of lighter hue . These lighter shades of skin implied a relationship with the Sossrim people . The men were known to grow thick beards . Language . Raumvirans spoke Raumvira and employed the Dethek alphabet of the dwarves . Outlook . The Raumvirans had a strong magical tradition , focused on conjuration , which ultimately led to their downfall . History . The Raumvirans were one of the early tribes living in the area of Rashemen before - 2488 DR when the empire of Ilmaskar fell . During the Orcgate Wars from - 1075 DR to - 1069 DR , they served as mercenaries for the armies of Mulhorand . Though the orcs were defeated , the Mulhorand empire was at its end , and the Raumvirans took this opportunity to build an empire of their own .

title: Rauntil Balarr
description: Rauntil Balarr Rauntil Balarr was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities . Rauntil was a kitchen drudge that carried water , stirred pots , turned spits , cut firewood , stoked fires , and cleaned and cut mounds of vegetables for his two old dwarven bosses , Bezoldur Thornhand and Thaunder Gallowglaive .
description_long: Rauntil Balarr Rauntil Balarr was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities . Rauntil was a kitchen drudge that carried water , stirred pots , turned spits , cut firewood , stoked fires , and cleaned and cut mounds of vegetables for his two old dwarven bosses , Bezoldur Thornhand and Thaunder Gallowglaive . He and his coworkers snapped at each other and groused about having to work continuously , eating on the run . The four serving wenches bore the brunt of their vinegar whenever they came in to pick up an order . The cookhouse was hot and steamy from all the fires , ovens , and boiling cauldrons , so the all - male kitchen staff wore minimal clothing for comfort .

title: Rauragh
description: Rauragh Rauragh was an orc chieftain who , in 940 DR , attempted to lead his orc horde out of the Sword Mountains through the tunnels in the Underdark in an attempt to attack Waterdeep . His plot was uncovered by the gold dragon Palarandusk , who then prevented the invasion .
description_long: Rauragh Rauragh was an orc chieftain who , in 940 DR , attempted to lead his orc horde out of the Sword Mountains through the tunnels in the Underdark in an attempt to attack Waterdeep . His plot was uncovered by the gold dragon Palarandusk , who then prevented the invasion .

title: Rauric languages
description: Rauric languages The Rauric languages were a family of languages with an origin in the Old Empires and Zakhara . Language Groups . Scholars divided the family into two major branches , the Mulani and Untheric languages .
description_long: Rauric languages The Rauric languages were a family of languages with an origin in the Old Empires and Zakhara . Language Groups . Scholars divided the family into two major branches , the Mulani and Untheric languages . Some also placed the Chessentic languages in this group , since those languages were also spoken in the Old Empires , but they were not truly related , although Untheric did strongly influence Chessentan . History . The Imaskari languages strongly influenced the Rauric languages of Mulhorandi and Untheric , through the Ancient Imask languages Rauran and Reian , which were spoken in the region before the coming of the Mulan . Slave argots of these tongues contributed in part to the development of both Mulhorandi and Untheric . Appendix . Inspiration . The grouping up the Rauric languages was inspired by the real - life and languages .

title: Raurin
description: Raurin Raurin , known as the Dust Desert and the Desert of Desolation , was once the center of the ancient empire of Imaskar , but it was transformed into a wasteland in - 2488 DR by the battles between the Imaskari and the avatar s of the Mulhorandi pantheon and Untheric pantheon . After the fall of Imaskar , the ancient city of Solon sought to carve itself a new empire from the desert wastes . It succeeded for a time , gaining control of most of the land south of the Raurin Alta .
description_long: Raurin Raurin , known as the Dust Desert and the Desert of Desolation , was once the center of the ancient empire of Imaskar , but it was transformed into a wasteland in - 2488 DR by the battles between the Imaskari and the avatar s of the Mulhorandi pantheon and Untheric pantheon . After the fall of Imaskar , the ancient city of Solon sought to carve itself a new empire from the desert wastes . It succeeded for a time , gaining control of most of the land south of the Raurin Alta . It traded with Ra - Khati and Durpar . Slowly , however , as the desert spread further and as Shou invaders cut Solon ' s ties with the lands to the north , Solon lost its grip on its territories . After a succession of weak kings over a period of centuries , Solon was only left with the city itself . Since that time , many other desert kingdoms have risen in Raurin ; the most recent and perhaps greatest of these was Bakar , although even Bakar is a pale shadow of the Imaskar Empire before it . . In approximately 357 DR , the wizard Martek , called " The Greatest of Mages , " served as Bakar ' s grand vizier .

title: Raurlor
description: Raurlor Raurlor was a human and became War Lord of Waterdeep in 1026 DR . He was previously the leader of the city ' s army . He aimed to use Waterdeep ' s wealth and power to create an empire in Northwest Faerûn .
description_long: Raurlor Raurlor was a human and became War Lord of Waterdeep in 1026 DR . He was previously the leader of the city ' s army . He aimed to use Waterdeep ' s wealth and power to create an empire in Northwest Faerûn . By 1030 DR , Waterdeep had the largest navy and standing army it had seen since the Trollwars . In 1032 DR , Rhaurlor was opposed by the mage Ahghairon , who had played a major part in the Trollwars . When Rhaurlor attempted to have Ahghairon arrested , Ahghairon turned Rhaurlor ' s sword into a snake . It bit him , poisoning him , and he died .

title: Raurokhymdhar
description: Raurokhymdhar Raurokhymdhar , also known as The Golden , was the gold dragon ruler of the fortress - prison of Raurokh , located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Raurokhymdhar was the ruler of Raurokh , an ancient dragonborn prison .
description_long: Raurokhymdhar Raurokhymdhar , also known as The Golden , was the gold dragon ruler of the fortress - prison of Raurokh , located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Raurokhymdhar was the ruler of Raurokh , an ancient dragonborn prison . She not only kept watch over the dragonborn slaves sent to the prison , but was also tasked with breeding new dragonborn slaves . Among the dragonborn clans that were controlled by Raurokhymdhar were the ancestors of Clan Kepeshmolik . When Shasphur liberated the dragonborn slaves from the prison , Raurokhymdhar was distracted by the elder slaves so Shaspur and the others could flee . After she discovered that the slaves had fled , Raurokhymdhar killed the elders . Raurokhymdhar was slain several years later by the dragonborn of Tymanchebar .

title: Rauvin Vale
description: Rauvin Vale The Rauvin Vale was a valley dominated by the River Rauvin in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvin Vale was bordered by the Nether Mountains to the north , the High Forest ( Turlang ' s Wood ) to the south , Everlund Pass and the Silverwood to the west , and Moon Pass to the east .
description_long: Rauvin Vale The Rauvin Vale was a valley dominated by the River Rauvin in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvin Vale was bordered by the Nether Mountains to the north , the High Forest ( Turlang ' s Wood ) to the south , Everlund Pass and the Silverwood to the west , and Moon Pass to the east . Inhabitants . Communities of human s , elves , goblin s , orc s , and ogre s dwelt in the vale . In the 14th century DR , [ [ troll ] s uprooted from their homes in the [ [ Evermoors ] ] often wandered into the Rauvin Vale in search of new lairs . Wildlife . Common wildlife in the Rauvin Vale were brown bears , deer , elk , [ [ rothé ] ] , red tiger , and wolves . [ [ Dire bear ] ] s , [ [ dire wolf | dire wolves ] ] , [ [ dire rat ] ] s , [ [ worg ] ] s , [ [ wereboar ] ] s , and [ [ werewolf | werewolves ] ] were occasionally spotted . Appendix . title: Rauvincross
description: Rauvincross Rauvincross was a village standing at the northern entrance of the Moon Pass through the Nether Mountains just south of Sundabar . Geography . The community rested along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar which crossed the River Rauvin .
description_long: Rauvincross Rauvincross was a village standing at the northern entrance of the Moon Pass through the Nether Mountains just south of Sundabar . Geography . The community rested along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar which crossed the River Rauvin . The village was located near Lhuvenhead , High Hold , and Rivermoot in the Rauvin Vale . Inhabitants . The village was home to many of the drivers and mule teams that worked the paths around the Moon Pass Gorge .

title: Rauvinheart caverns
description: Rauvinheart caverns The Rauvinheart caverns were an immense system of caverns and tunnels underneath the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvinheart caverns were located underneath Dead Orc Pass and the mountains on either side of the pass .
description_long: Rauvinheart caverns The Rauvinheart caverns were an immense system of caverns and tunnels underneath the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvinheart caverns were located underneath Dead Orc Pass and the mountains on either side of the pass . Description . The caverns were heated by a geothermic source . The River Rauvin passed through the caverns and emerged at the southern mouth of Dead Orc Pass in a waterfall - filled area known as Rainbow Gorge . A number of entrances to the caverns were located in Dead Orc Pass . The caverns were home to creatures of the Underdark and fungi that served as food sources for the orc s that dwelt in the Rauvins .

title: Ravager
description: Ravager Ravagers are the pinnacles of battlerager training , savage warriors who fight with a rage and sense of bloodlust more typical of barbarian s . Stories are told of the terrifying fury unleashed by ravagers , who are said to chew on their shield ' s rim or weapon just to diffuse the excess rage caused by a battle too long delayed . Ravagers charge into combat with little care for their safety , leaving a trail of bloodshed and gore in their wake .
description_long: Ravager Ravagers are the pinnacles of battlerager training , savage warriors who fight with a rage and sense of bloodlust more typical of barbarian s . Stories are told of the terrifying fury unleashed by ravagers , who are said to chew on their shield ' s rim or weapon just to diffuse the excess rage caused by a battle too long delayed . Ravagers charge into combat with little care for their safety , leaving a trail of bloodshed and gore in their wake . Ravagers , who rely on their adrenaline and physical power to carry them through battle , look down upon more disciplined fighters , particularly those that involve the use of " effete " weapons such as rapier s . They laugh off insults that describe them as uncultured or brutish , knowing that when others quake in terror at the horrors of battle they will stand fast and ready . To a ravager , every battle is an opportunity to earn glory , fame , or even the favors of some warrior god and they treat each one as if it were their last , acting with reckless and foolish but sometimes inspiring bravery . Abilities .

title: Ravager ( ship )
description: Ravager ( ship ) The Ravager was the caravel of the pirate Gonchklas . By 1372 DR , it was a wallowing wreck with tattered sails , and one of the most feared ghost ship s on the Sword Coast . The crew of zombie s and skeleton s attacked other ships on sight .
description_long: Ravager ( ship ) The Ravager was the caravel of the pirate Gonchklas . By 1372 DR , it was a wallowing wreck with tattered sails , and one of the most feared ghost ship s on the Sword Coast . The crew of zombie s and skeleton s attacked other ships on sight .

title: Ravel Xorlarrin
description: Ravel Xorlarrin Ravel Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan and leader of the Xorlarrin expedition to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . He and Tiago Baenre were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description .
description_long: Ravel Xorlarrin Ravel Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan and leader of the Xorlarrin expedition to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . He and Tiago Baenre were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description . Ravel had long white hair . He wore purple robes and , like most drow nobles , he wore magical boots that could clack noisily or be silenced at will . He also wore a small silver chain that closed the collar of his piwafwi History . Q ' Xorrlarin . In 1463 DR , Ravel snuck behind Gromph Baenre while he was working on a skull gem and learned about the abandoned dwarven settlement of Gauntlgrym and the primordial that powered the Forge . ( Unbeknownst to him , Ravel and the expedition had in fact been prompted by House Baenre . ) Ravel reported that information to Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin , who assigned him to lead an expedition of House Xorlarrin troops to Gauntlgrym to scout it out and determine whether it would be a suitable place for House Xorlarrin to build their own city . The force consisted of 100 drow , including 19 spellspinners , with 200 goblin s , and a score of drider s .

title: Raven
description: Raven Ravens are black birds similar to crow s . They are opportunistic eaters , feeding on carrion , insects , grains , fruits , and small animals . These birds thrive in most northern climates and are very long - lived , making them ideal pets and companions .
description_long: Raven Ravens are black birds similar to crow s . They are opportunistic eaters , feeding on carrion , insects , grains , fruits , and small animals . These birds thrive in most northern climates and are very long - lived , making them ideal pets and companions .

title: Raven ' s Rack
description: Raven ' s Rack Raven ' s Rack was a shrine dedicated to Ilmater the Crying God , situated atop Tanarspear Hill , west of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach , and quite isolated . " Circa " 1342 DR , a young underpriest from the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum named Kortolt Rushtyn found the " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith of Ilmater . Kortolt took the " Tome " to Raven ' s Rack and used it to aid both believers and non - believers , and to preach about Ilmater .
description_long: Raven ' s Rack Raven ' s Rack was a shrine dedicated to Ilmater the Crying God , situated atop Tanarspear Hill , west of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach , and quite isolated . " Circa " 1342 DR , a young underpriest from the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum named Kortolt Rushtyn found the " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith of Ilmater . Kortolt took the " Tome " to Raven ' s Rack and used it to aid both believers and non - believers , and to preach about Ilmater . The people of Hlondeth came to see Kortolt as a gift from the gods , one who kept them safe and well when they were sick or injured . However , Kortolt was killed by bandits in winter of the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR .

title: Ravenar
description: Ravenar Ravenar , also called , was a variety of tourmaline mainly in demand in the North , and less so in other lands . Description . Ravenar occurred in long crystals like other varieties of tourmaline and was a solid gloss black .
description_long: Ravenar Ravenar , also called , was a variety of tourmaline mainly in demand in the North , and less so in other lands . Description . Ravenar occurred in long crystals like other varieties of tourmaline and was a solid gloss black . Ravenar was commonly used for inlay work on weapons and accouterments . Where it was popular , a typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Powers . Ravenar , like all tourmalines , could absorb any spell cast upon it and immediately convert it into three " lightning bolt s " that blasted outward in straight lines from the crystal facets in directions chosen by the caster . This act consumed the gem in the process .

title: Ravenloft
description: Ravenloft Ravenloft was a campaign setting released by TSR , Inc . It was a Gothic horror setting that took place in an extradimensional space known as the Demiplane of Dread . Ravenloft was linked to the Forgotten Realms by way of the Ethereal Plane , and several crossovers between the two settings have officially been noted .
description_long: Ravenloft Ravenloft was a campaign setting released by TSR , Inc . It was a Gothic horror setting that took place in an extradimensional space known as the Demiplane of Dread . Ravenloft was linked to the Forgotten Realms by way of the Ethereal Plane , and several crossovers between the two settings have officially been noted . Harkon Lukas , one of the Darklords of the Demiplane of Dread was born in Cormyr . Gondegal , the Lost King , was transported there , as was Jander Sunstar , a gold elf from Evermeet , and the entire Castle Spulzeer , along with Chardath and Kartak Spellseer . Glorming Pass in the Vast was said to have a gate to Ravenloft as well . At an unspecified time , a Vistani camp was settled near Daggerford and Duchess Morwen Daggerford asked a group of adventurers to scare them away . The Vistani were in fact trying to lure the adventurers into the realm of Barovia in order to rid the land of the vampire Strahd .

title: Ravens Bluff
description: Ravens Bluff Ravens Bluff was a port city and home to many heroes and adventurers . It was built on a bluff , on the mouth of the Fire River , and the ruins of dwarven city Sarbreen lie directly underneath the city streets . This might have been a major reason why so many adventurers chose to come to Ravens Bluff , and there were routine expeditions into Sarbreen .
description_long: Ravens Bluff Ravens Bluff was a port city and home to many heroes and adventurers . It was built on a bluff , on the mouth of the Fire River , and the ruins of dwarven city Sarbreen lie directly underneath the city streets . This might have been a major reason why so many adventurers chose to come to Ravens Bluff , and there were routine expeditions into Sarbreen . However , unbeknownst to even longtime residents , Sarbreen was not the only city that was built before Ravens Bluff : Drow had previously built a stronghold thousands of years before and created a powerful mythal to protect it . The mythal still existed as of 1374 DR and was suspected to be the cause of the mysterious wildfire phenomenon sometimes witnessed in the city . The status of Ravens Bluff as a port city on a major river may account for the fact that it was attacked at least twice in its long history . An attempt made in the year 1370 DR by the warlord Myrkyssa Jelan , was unsuccessful ( though the warlord herself was not captured ) . Rumors in 1374 DR suggested she was still at large in or around the city .

title: Ravia
description: Ravia Ravia was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Fire in the Moonsea . Personality . Ravia was a cruel and pernicious individual , and believed that she couldn ' t be stopped .
description_long: Ravia Ravia was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Fire in the Moonsea . Personality . Ravia was a cruel and pernicious individual , and believed that she couldn ' t be stopped . She delighted in cruelly taunting others for their wasted efforts . History . In 1491 DR , Ravia was ordered by her master to deliver a " devastation ' s orb " to the cult ' s chapter in Mulmaster . However , during a stop in Elmwood , the orb spontaneously detonated , razing the village . The only survivor was Ravia , who was kept in custody first by Mulmaster ' s City Watch and then by Zora Rosealine Culkin , owner of the village . Her fellows managed to free her just after Ravia recovered from her injures and she joined them . In the end , she was defeated by an adventuring party hired by Zora .

title: Ravilar ' s Cloak
description: Ravilar ' s Cloak Ravilar ' s Cloak , also known as The Cloak , was a mining town within the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The settlement was located in the foothills of the Orsraun Mountains in Turmish .
description_long: Ravilar ' s Cloak Ravilar ' s Cloak , also known as The Cloak , was a mining town within the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The settlement was located in the foothills of the Orsraun Mountains in Turmish . Defense . As a hot - spot for treasure seekers , the town was rough and rowdy . The Cloak was protected by warrior s from all the independent mining groups within the community . These groups were known as " factors " . History . Around 1270 DR , a ranger known as Antonio Ravilar protected the small community of miners from a band of bugbear s . Over the years , the town became known for its murders , such as in 1363 DR , when a merchant Alataz Thrindol from Telflamm turned up missing . In 1370 DR , a bag of emerald s worth 60 , 000 gp was found in a cesspool and a Calishite thief , Rastar of the Blades , took up residence in the merchant ' s manor . Legends . Ravilar ' s Cloak was said to be haunted by a flying helmet . The inhabitants blamed the magical helm for anything that went missing .

title: Ravos Calantar
description: Ravos Calantar Ravos Calantar was a member of the Calantar family , a noble house of Cormyr . History . Following the execution of his aunt and matriarch of his family , Lady Calantar , Ravos came to hate the Obarskyr s with a passion .
description_long: Ravos Calantar Ravos Calantar was a member of the Calantar family , a noble house of Cormyr . History . Following the execution of his aunt and matriarch of his family , Lady Calantar , Ravos came to hate the Obarskyr s with a passion . By 1372 DR , the Cormyrean rulers expected that he was likely to rebel against them . Personality . Ravos was bored with life and sought to perform great deeds . He enjoyed hunting both stag s and bandit s .

title: Ravvas Thurrpurtyn
description: Ravvas Thurrpurtyn During the late 1350 ' s DR , Ravvas Thurrpurtyn was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . Personality . Ravvas was a snobbish young son of a wealthy family who felt he was privileged over others .
description_long: Ravvas Thurrpurtyn During the late 1350 ' s DR , Ravvas Thurrpurtyn was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . Personality . Ravvas was a snobbish young son of a wealthy family who felt he was privileged over others . He was thin and had a nasal voice that accentuated his arrogant nature . He was often disdainful or cruel to those he considered lower in status . He had a tendency to spend money frivolously . History . Sometime after coming of age , Ravvas ' s father got fed up with his wastrel of a son and sent him away from Selgaunt with a final gift of money and instructions to never come back . Ravvas found himself in Voonlar in the winter of the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , around the date the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn , Ansilber Klauthaudra , was dismembered in the common room of his establishment . Within a tenday of the grisly murder , Ravvas bought the inn and took over running the Wizard . The Harpers believed that Ravvas was killed and impersonated by an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay sometime after he left Selgaunt or soon after he bought the Whistling Wizard , which puts his actual death date in 1356 or 1357 DR .

title: Rawun
description: Rawun Rawuns ( formal plural rawunin ) were the bard s and storytellers of the desert in Zakhara . They used epic poems to spread the legends of their tribe . Rawunin sometimes grouped together to form a " takht " , allowing for a greater range of detailed performances .
description_long: Rawun Rawuns ( formal plural rawunin ) were the bard s and storytellers of the desert in Zakhara . They used epic poems to spread the legends of their tribe . Rawunin sometimes grouped together to form a " takht " , allowing for a greater range of detailed performances . Requirements . Only humans and half - elves could become bards , and only a bard could be a rawun . Role . Rawunin had strong memories and stronger voices . They were the keepers and spreaders of knowledge in the Land of Fate . Rawuns in urban areas were often well - read . Possessions . Many rawun were drawn to collecting books and scrolls wherever they could find them . Rawun with a degree of musical talent tended to prefer instruments that left their mouths free to narrate as story as they played . Skills . These individuals were adept at determining the magical properties of items . Once per day they could cause the " evil eye " to fall upon someone or remove it from a person . Rawuns were only able to use universal spell s in Zakhara .

title: Ray of enfeeblement
description: Ray of enfeeblement Ray of enfeeblement was a necromantic spell learned by some inexperienced wizard s , particularly those curious as to the power of necromancy and shadow magic . When " ray of enfeeblement " was cast , a stream of green mist sprayed from the wizard ' s curled finger or implement towards a creature within fifty feet , sapping away their strength in a direct attack upon the creature ' s soul . The spell drained the mental faculties of a wizard somewhat and the wizard required a short rest before they could cast the spell again .
description_long: Ray of enfeeblement Ray of enfeeblement was a necromantic spell learned by some inexperienced wizard s , particularly those curious as to the power of necromancy and shadow magic . When " ray of enfeeblement " was cast , a stream of green mist sprayed from the wizard ' s curled finger or implement towards a creature within fifty feet , sapping away their strength in a direct attack upon the creature ' s soul . The spell drained the mental faculties of a wizard somewhat and the wizard required a short rest before they could cast the spell again . " Ray of enfeeblement " , prior to the Spellplague , was formerly available to sorcerer s as well as wizards , and like all spells , aside from invocation s , its power flowed through the Weave and was subject to the Mystra s ' rulings . As a result , " ray of enfeeblement " was only castable as many times per day as the sorcerer or wizard had prepared it .

title: Ray of frost
description: Ray of frost Ray of frost is a spell cast by wizard s , formerly a cantrip cast by both wizards and sorcerer s , that is filled with cold energy . When cast , the spell conjure s a frigid blast of cold , freezing white or blue air which then streaks towards its intended target , over a distance of no more than fifty feet , slowing their movements down for a brief moment . A " ray of frost " is more powerful if its caster is of an archmage ' s equivalent in arcane skill , dealing twice as much damage .
description_long: Ray of frost Ray of frost is a spell cast by wizard s , formerly a cantrip cast by both wizards and sorcerer s , that is filled with cold energy . When cast , the spell conjure s a frigid blast of cold , freezing white or blue air which then streaks towards its intended target , over a distance of no more than fifty feet , slowing their movements down for a brief moment . A " ray of frost " is more powerful if its caster is of an archmage ' s equivalent in arcane skill , dealing twice as much damage . Prior to the Spellplague " ray of frost " could be cast by both wizards and sorcerers and like all other spells , with the exception of invocation s , ray of frost could not be cast at - will but had to be prepepared . " Ray of frost " was also considered a cantrip , or a very basic spell known to virtually all wizards , though it lost this status following the Spellplague , becoming a fully - ranked spell .

title: Rayad al - Farif
description: Rayad al - Farif Rayad al - Farif was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rayad owned a small shop called " Appointments with the Mighty " where he claimed to be able to arrange meetings between his customers and various elite members of Huzuz ' s society , including the leaders of the great mosques and even the Grand Caliph .
description_long: Rayad al - Farif Rayad al - Farif was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rayad owned a small shop called " Appointments with the Mighty " where he claimed to be able to arrange meetings between his customers and various elite members of Huzuz ' s society , including the leaders of the great mosques and even the Grand Caliph . He only charged his customers if he was able to make an appointment . For appointments with the Grand Caliph Rayad usually just scheduled his clients to appear at the Grand Caliph ' s next public audience . Relationships . Rayad had a falling out with Renn min Zann many years ago , and did everything he coudl to avoid him .

title: Rayanna
description: Rayanna Rayanna the Rose was the leader of the Red Ravens in 1374 DR . History . Rayanna led an adventuring party that was composed of one hundred members .
description_long: Rayanna Rayanna the Rose was the leader of the Red Ravens in 1374 DR . History . Rayanna led an adventuring party that was composed of one hundred members . They were hired by the Cormyr ean Crown in 1364 DR to clear the Stonelands of evil humanoids and they managed the mission .

title: Raymond Swanland
description: Raymond Swanland Raymond Swanland is a science - fiction and fantasy artist who has illustrated the covers of several Forgotten Realms novels . Career . Swanland began his artistic career as a graphic designer for the video game company and worked on all four of that companies games .
description_long: Raymond Swanland Raymond Swanland is a science - fiction and fantasy artist who has illustrated the covers of several Forgotten Realms novels . Career . Swanland began his artistic career as a graphic designer for the video game company and worked on all four of that companies games . During that time he began to illustrate book covers and comic books as well .

title: Razak Irdi
description: Razak Irdi Razak Irdi was a barbarian nomad in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Irdi lived in Chegoyui until around 1350 DR when he stole one of the qaghan ' s prized huluk and headed north .
description_long: Razak Irdi Razak Irdi was a barbarian nomad in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Irdi lived in Chegoyui until around 1350 DR when he stole one of the qaghan ' s prized huluk and headed north . Afterward , he conducted many raids and thefts in order to free horses from their owners . Many times people had tried to capture Irdi but with no success . He always traveled with a herd of 20 to 50 wild horses and a dozen wild dogs , all totally devoted to him .

title: Razfallow
description: Razfallow Razfallow was a half - orc assassin from Calimshan . In 1346 DR , he was hired by the evil wizard Cyndre in his attempt to take over the Moonshae Islands after joining the king ' s council of sorcerers . He slew many members of the royal houses and druid s of the Isles .
description_long: Razfallow Razfallow was a half - orc assassin from Calimshan . In 1346 DR , he was hired by the evil wizard Cyndre in his attempt to take over the Moonshae Islands after joining the king ' s council of sorcerers . He slew many members of the royal houses and druid s of the Isles . It was in this role that he also , under the effects of magical " invisibility " and " silence " , disposed of the clerical and magical defenses of the stronghold of Hugh O ' Roarke .

title: Razim
description: Razim Razim , also called Razim the Incandescent was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Razim served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .
description_long: Razim Razim , also called Razim the Incandescent was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Razim served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan . He controlled his own stronghold , complete with a staff of other efreet and noble efreet as well as a contingent of slaves of various races .

title: Raziz
description: Raziz Raziz was a small village located between the Range of the Marching Camels and the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams in the High Desert region of Zakhara . Description . Raziz was described as being " dropped from a height pelted with refuse , and left to fester in the sun .
description_long: Raziz Raziz was a small village located between the Range of the Marching Camels and the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams in the High Desert region of Zakhara . Description . Raziz was described as being " dropped from a height pelted with refuse , and left to fester in the sun . " Garbage was piled around the entire village , complimenting the streams of filth that flowed freely through the streets . For all these faults , Raziz possessed a well that produced plenty of water for all . Inhabitants . The number of animals in Raziz outnumbered the humans , adding to the unpleasant aroma permeating the village . The inhabitants of Raziz had little culture save one area : dancing . Even the smallest occasion was excuse enough to organize a dancing event to celebrate . Most dancing was complimented by music from the stringed " rababah s " . Though their interest in the outside world was limited , the citizens of Raziz welcomed travelers and traders .

title: Razor grass
description: Razor grass Razor grass was a special type of grass that could be found in small scattered areas throughout Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . As the name implied , razor grass was incredibly sharp , and could easily cut passing animals or unarmored humanoid s . The only distinguishable feature of this grass was that its blades appeared slightly silver compared to regular green grass .
description_long: Razor grass Razor grass was a special type of grass that could be found in small scattered areas throughout Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . As the name implied , razor grass was incredibly sharp , and could easily cut passing animals or unarmored humanoid s . The only distinguishable feature of this grass was that its blades appeared slightly silver compared to regular green grass . Razor grass was not carnivorous but was often found near the squid jail plant , which was a carnivorous plant .

title: Razor of truth
description: Razor of truth The razor of truth was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This blade appeared like a regular razor used by barber s in the bazaar .
description_long: Razor of truth The razor of truth was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This blade appeared like a regular razor used by barber s in the bazaar . Powers . This blade did not provide any combat benefits to the wielder . However , if used like a normal razor during shaving , it was a useful tool during interrogation . The blade would nick the subject being interrogated every time they told a lie . These cuts were so small that they did not even draw blood . Only three lies could be detected in this manner , after which point the razor behaved like a normal tool for two days before the magic recharged .

title: Re
description: Re Re was the former head of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Re died due to injuries he recieved during the Battle of the Gods by the orc deity Gruumsh during the Orcgate Wars . As Re died he transfered his power to Horus who was from then , known as Horus - Re .

title: Reaching Woods
description: Reaching Woods The Reaching Woods was a large forest in Elturgard . In 1459 DR the High Overseer of Torm , ruler of Elturgard , learned that shrines to unapproved god s existed in the forest and declared that no one could enter or exit the woods . By 1479 DR the gnoll s of the forest had exterminated all other humanoids .

title: Read magic
description: Read magic Read magic was a widespread universal spell that let one read scrolls and spellbooks . Effect . By means of " read magic " , the caster could read magical inscriptions on objects such as books , scrolls , weapons , and the like , that would otherwise be unintelligible .
description_long: Read magic Read magic was a widespread universal spell that let one read scrolls and spellbooks . Effect . By means of " read magic " , the caster could read magical inscriptions on objects such as books , scrolls , weapons , and the like , that would otherwise be unintelligible . This deciphering did not normally invoke the magic contained in the writing , although it might do so in the case of a cursed scroll . Furthermore , once the spell was cast and the caster had read the magical inscription , he or she was thereafter able to read that particular writing without recourse to the use of " read magic " . The caster could read at the rate of one page ( 250 words ) per minute . The spell allowed the caster to identify a " glyph of warding " . Focus . A clear crystal or mineral prism .

title: Read southern magic
description: Read southern magic Read southern magic was a divination spell that allowed wizards to read spells written in the Thoth mage - script of southern magic . Two versions of this spell existed : The one had been employed by arcane spellcasters in the Old Empires of Mulhorand , Unther and Chessenta as essential to practice their separate system of magic introduced after the secession of Thay ( though some of them also knew the northern counter - part , " read magic " , giving access to spells from outside their domain ) . The second and much younger version was a rare spell created by Random Riellor from Halruaa around 1347 DR and allowed wizards from outside the closed ranks of southern magicians to read their encoded arcane writings .
description_long: Read southern magic Read southern magic was a divination spell that allowed wizards to read spells written in the Thoth mage - script of southern magic . Two versions of this spell existed : The one had been employed by arcane spellcasters in the Old Empires of Mulhorand , Unther and Chessenta as essential to practice their separate system of magic introduced after the secession of Thay ( though some of them also knew the northern counter - part , " read magic " , giving access to spells from outside their domain ) . The second and much younger version was a rare spell created by Random Riellor from Halruaa around 1347 DR and allowed wizards from outside the closed ranks of southern magicians to read their encoded arcane writings . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components as well as a clear prism of mineral or piece of crystal , that was not consumed in the casting . History . Random only shared this spell with those whom he believed could further his research .

title: Readers
description: Readers The Readers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Zann , the Zakharan god of learning and intelligence . The Readers did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .
description_long: Readers The Readers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Zann , the Zakharan god of learning and intelligence . The Readers did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities . As " anchorite " mystics , these fanatical devotees of Zann found Enlightenment through prodigious reading . The simple act of reading granted them their clerical powers ; retention and comprehension of the subject matter was not required to gain access to their powers . History . The Readers started several holy crusades over their 400 - year existence . Base of Operations . The Readers were based in Huzuz , because the City of Delights had the best centers of learning in all of Zakhara . However , they could be found in any city that had a university or other renowned place of learning . They also maintained a strong presence within the Mosque of Zann the Wise .

title: Reading Room
description: Reading Room The Reading Room was a fortified temple of Deneir in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was located far to the south of the main temple of the Master ' s Library on Iron Dragon Mountain . Activities .
description_long: Reading Room The Reading Room was a fortified temple of Deneir in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was located far to the south of the main temple of the Master ' s Library on Iron Dragon Mountain . Activities . Although every devout follower of Deneir made at least one pilgrimage to the Master ' s Library , most only got as far as the Reading Room , which supported the Library . A secret nonliving matter – only " gate " spell allowed notes and texts to be passed between the two , so that copies of texts could be lent to visitors . Organization . The Reading Room was governed by a Keeper ; a kind old woman in the late 1360s DR . She sent messages through the " gate " , and was aided and protected by loyal watchghost s .

title: Realms Master
description: Realms Master The Realms Master was a caravel piloted by the Halruaan wizard , Dwalimar Omen . The ship had the standard capabilities of a sea - going vessel , but also had the magical ability of flight and teleportation . The " Realms Master " had as a figurehead the image of Azuth , god of mages and consort of Mystra .

Manshoon , Fzoul Chembryl , Elminster , beholder , Zhentil Keep , Zhentarim " The More Things Change " . By Elaine Cunningham " Date : " before 1321 DR ; 1390 DR Summary . After having been rejected by his Moonblade , Elaith Craulnober leaves Evermeet and joins a band of mercenaries . We also learn of his later life . Plot . Elaith Craulnober serves as captain of the king ' s guard in Evermeet and is betrothed to the ruler ' s daughter , Amnestria . The vivid and adventurous - minded princess complains about Elaith being too serious and proper , never questioning the rules and traditions of his kin . Some time later , we learn that Elaith inherited the moonblade of his family , but it rejected him .

Elminster in turn challenges him to a " fireball " - throwing contest and wins hands down with an incredibly impressive fireball .

title: Realms of the Dead
description: Realms of the Dead Realms of the Dead is an anthology of short stories from the " Forgotten Realms " , and the last published anthology of original tales to date . It accompanied the " The Haunted Lands " trilogy by Richard Lee Byers , and had stories spanning both sides of the setting - changing Spellplague . Contents .
description_long: Realms of the Dead Realms of the Dead is an anthology of short stories from the " Forgotten Realms " , and the last published anthology of original tales to date . It accompanied the " The Haunted Lands " trilogy by Richard Lee Byers , and had stories spanning both sides of the setting - changing Spellplague . Contents . Pieces . By Richard Lee Byers This story follows Bareris Anskuld and Mirror as they try to rejoin the resistance movement against Szass Tam . In the city of Amruthar , they discover the body of Urmas Sethdem , whom they question with the aid of Bareris ' s bard ic necromancy magic . From him , they learn that he answered to Chon Vrael , an influential Kossuth an priest in the city who detests undead for the pain they ' ve caused his family . When they approach Vrael after one of his sermons and tell him about the death of his subordinate , he doesn ' t believe them ; not only are Bareris and Mirror both undead , but Urmas Sethdem is alive and has been advising him !

description_long: Realms of the Dragons Realms of the Dragons , edited by Philip Athans , is the ninth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . All the short stories relate in some way to the horrific Year of Rogue Dragons . Contents . Soulbound . By Paul S . Kemp Avnon Des the Seer is the First Demarch of the conclave of the Hall of Shadows . One day he arose from his meditation to find himself , his temple and its inhabitants moved to the Shadow Plane . Kesson Rel is the first Chosen of the Shadow God , marked as a heretic by the Demarchs because he drank from the Chalice and transformed into a creature of shadow . He seeks his revenge by bringing the temple from Elgrin Fau , the City of Silver , to the Shadow Plane , and soul binding a shadow dragon , Furlinastis , into bringing him one of the priests every day tobkill them in front of him , since his oaths prevent him from killing them himself . And so the dragon killed , while looking for a way out of the soul magic . Avnon also tries to decipher the will of his god , as there is no way for them to escape that particular stretch of the Shadow Plane , or to combat the dragon .

title: Realms of the Dragons II
description: Realms of the Dragons II Realms of the Dragons II , edited by Philip Athans , is the tenth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . All the short stories relate in some way to the horrific Year of Rogue Dragons . Contents .
description_long: Realms of the Dragons II Realms of the Dragons II , edited by Philip Athans , is the tenth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . All the short stories relate in some way to the horrific Year of Rogue Dragons . Contents . Faerie Ire . By Erin Tettensor The Woman Who Drew Dragons . By Rosemary Jones The Hunting Game . This story is Erik Scott de Bie ' s first fantasy work to be published . He considers it to be written in an immature version of his style and does not feel it reflects his current writing ability , although he still believes it to be a solid fantasy tale . The Road Home . By Harley Stroh How Burlmarr Saved the Unseen Protector . By Kameron M . Franklin A Tall Tale . By J . L . Collins The Book Dragon . By Jim Pitrat Freedom ' s Promise . By Ed Gentry Possessions . By James P . Davis Queen of the Mountain . By Jaleigh Johnson The Strength of the Jester . By Murray J . D . Leeder

title: Realms of the Elves
description: Realms of the Elves Realms of the Elves , edited by Philip Athans , is the eleventh anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . It serves as an anthology to " The Last Mythal " trilogy . Contents .
description_long: Realms of the Elves Realms of the Elves , edited by Philip Athans , is the eleventh anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . It serves as an anthology to " The Last Mythal " trilogy . Contents . Tears so White . By Ed Greenwood The Bladesinger ' s Lesson . By Richard Baker Comrades at Odds . By R . A . Salvatore Tos ' un Armgo finds himself without any allies since his three drow companions are all dead and he has become an enemy of King Obould Many - Arrows because of Kaer ' lic Suun Wett ' s attempt to kill the orc while Obould and Drizzt Do ' Urden were fighting . Tos ' un knows that he cannot survive the journey back through the Underdark alone .
