Feeling helpless on the surface world , he lets out his rage by attacking orcs with the powerful sentient blade Khazid ' hea . On their journey to recover the body of Ellifain , Drizzt Do ' Urden and Innovindil find that the orc hordes have not yet disbanded after the ( so Drizzt and Innovindil believe ) death of King Obould . Upon inspection , the two elves find that the orcs are building a gate upon a trail further fortifying the orc kingdom . Realizing there is nothing they can do , they continue their journey .

title: Realms of the Underdark
description: Realms of the Underdark Realms of the Underdark , edited by J . Robert King , is the fourth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . Contents .
description_long: Realms of the Underdark Realms of the Underdark , edited by J . Robert King , is the fourth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . Contents . The Fires of Narbondel . By Mark Anthony A story of Zaknafein . It is almost the ' Festival of the Founding ' in Menzoberranzan and Matron Malice Do ' Urden has a plan to raise her house ' s station in the city . Legend has it that Lolth appears somewhere in the city every year during the upcoming festival . Malice has summoned a yochlol that told her of a surefire way that Lolth would appear in House Do ' Urden . Malice tasks Zaknafein with finding the Dagger of Menzoberra . Using a magical spider gem , Zak succeeds in finding Menzoberra ' s tomb beneath the city via a staircase that winds down the length of the inside of Narbondel . He retrieves the dagger from a magic - impeding web that falls apart as soon as the dagger is in his hand and is about to escape Narbondel just as Gromph Baenre lights up the stone pillar with his daily fire spell . But Zak , long harboring a hatred of Lolth decides to defy his matron and casts the dagger back down the staircase before escaping with his life .

title: Realmspace
description: Realmspace Realmspace was the term used to describe the Torilian system and its surrounding environs . To those on the surface of Toril , Realmspace was called the Sea of Night . Contained within a crystal sphere , Realmspace consisted of wildspace ( empty vacuum ) , a sun , eight planetoids , and their satellites .
description_long: Realmspace Realmspace was the term used to describe the Torilian system and its surrounding environs . To those on the surface of Toril , Realmspace was called the Sea of Night . Contained within a crystal sphere , Realmspace consisted of wildspace ( empty vacuum ) , a sun , eight planetoids , and their satellites . Realmspace is located within the Prime Material Plane . The Solar System . The Sun . A single star radiated a comfortable amount of warmth throughout Realmspace . It was particularly susceptible to solar flares , which erupted almost continually . Anadia . One of the Dawn Heralds , this small , amber - and - green - colored planet was closest to the sun and mostly populated by halfling s and umber hulk s . It was covered in canyons that dwarfed the Great Rift , and the equatorial regions were unlivable because of the sun ' s proximity . Coliar . Coliar was a gas giant mostly populated with avian life - forms and other flying creatures . A few " islands " of water and earth revolved around the planet ' s core . Elminster was said to own a resort on one of these islands . The planet was covered with clouds and appeared as a gray - white sphere from Toril .

title: Reaper ' s stance
description: Reaper ' s stance Reaper ' s stance was an exploit that allowed a fighter to hit all opponents within reach and with an improved chance for critical hits . Effects . Once per day , a fighter who learned this exploit could take the " reaper ' s stance " and hit all adjacent enemies with a melee weapon which caused bleeding wounds that continued to drain their health for as long as the fighter had the opportunity to attack .
description_long: Reaper ' s stance Reaper ' s stance was an exploit that allowed a fighter to hit all opponents within reach and with an improved chance for critical hits . Effects . Once per day , a fighter who learned this exploit could take the " reaper ' s stance " and hit all adjacent enemies with a melee weapon which caused bleeding wounds that continued to drain their health for as long as the fighter had the opportunity to attack . This exploit lasted up to a maximum duration of five minutes .

title: Reaper ( Ito - Jo )
description: Reaper ( Ito - Jo ) Reaper was a cursed kensai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Reaper was a kensai retainer of the Ito family who died in their castle ' s burning in 647 DR .
description_long: Reaper ( Ito - Jo ) Reaper was a cursed kensai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Reaper was a kensai retainer of the Ito family who died in their castle ' s burning in 647 DR . Thanks to the " ancient curse " and a krakentua ' s influence , he did not truly die , but continued to haunt the castle as the first of the seven weapon masters . Finally , in 1360 DR , an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords fought and destroyed him .

title: Reaper ( Neverwinter Nights )
description: Reaper ( Neverwinter Nights ) The Reaper is a pivotal character in " . " His realm is accessible to the player via the Relic of the Reaper , which is described as having come into the player ' s hands while they were in the Plane of Shadow after the fall of Undrentide in the second game . During the first half of the game , he serves the same purpose as the Stone of Recall in the original campaign , drawing the player into his realm if he or she dies and reviving them as long as they have a Rogue Stone .
description_long: Reaper ( Neverwinter Nights ) The Reaper is a pivotal character in " . " His realm is accessible to the player via the Relic of the Reaper , which is described as having come into the player ' s hands while they were in the Plane of Shadow after the fall of Undrentide in the second game . During the first half of the game , he serves the same purpose as the Stone of Recall in the original campaign , drawing the player into his realm if he or she dies and reviving them as long as they have a Rogue Stone . Players can also use the Reaper ' s realm to set up a network of portals so they can mark places and then return there by passing through " the Gatehouse " as the Reaper calls it . During Chapter 3 , the player finds out the Reaper has been under the control of Mephistopheles the whole time , commanded to do the archdevil ' s bidding because he holds the Reaper ' s True Name . The Reaper informs the player he or she can command him to let them return home if he or she finds his True Name as well . He does not openly say it , but the Reaper does not like Mephistopheles and only serves him because of the power of his True Name .

title: Reaver ( ship )
description: Reaver ( ship ) The Reaver was a feared pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . The " Reaver " flew a standard of flying crossed cutlass es . Description .
description_long: Reaver ( ship ) The Reaver was a feared pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . The " Reaver " flew a standard of flying crossed cutlass es . Description . This large galleon was filled with 100 corsairs . Armaments consisted of a pair of and a liquid star projector that was capable of fully engulfing a ship in flames . Activities . Captained by a bloodthirsty savage , the " Reaver " struck terror into the hearts of those sailing Suq Bay . Crew . Anwar Tulam captained the " Reaver " . Several wizard s went to sea with him as well .

title: Rebec
description: Rebec A rebec was a string instrument considered a precursor to the violin . Description . Rebecs were favored among peasants and made for very lively music .
description_long: Rebec A rebec was a string instrument considered a precursor to the violin . Description . Rebecs were favored among peasants and made for very lively music . Two - and three - string rebecs were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " produced by guild craftsmen from Selgaunt .

title: Rebekkah Darklyte
description: Rebekkah Darklyte Rebekkah Darklyte was a female drow priestess of Eilistraee in Ravens Bluff around 1370 DR . She was the acting high priestess of The Dark Dancer , a controversial and troubled shrine to the goddess in that city . History .
description_long: Rebekkah Darklyte Rebekkah Darklyte was a female drow priestess of Eilistraee in Ravens Bluff around 1370 DR . She was the acting high priestess of The Dark Dancer , a controversial and troubled shrine to the goddess in that city . History . Aiming to promote peace between drow and other races , Rebekkah Darklyte worked to establish a shrine in Ravens Bluff . She and her followers were aided by the Yarvandar noble family , who were sympathetic to their cause and helped smuggle people and materials into the city and gave the drow the chance to observe human society and dance in safety under the stars . In return , the drow provided the Yarvandars with various rare goods , like edible mushrooms , luminescent fungi , and drow wine Thus aided , Rebekkah Darklyte and her followers rebuilt a warehouse in the Harbor District and renovated it as the shrine called The Dark Dancer . However , they did not obtain a charter from the Clerical Circle , which regulated the construction of new temples . This was not technically illegal , however . Work on the shrine and warehouse was completed in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , and it was soon opened and made public .

title: Rebrum
description: Rebrum Rebrum was a travelling merchant from Sheirtalar in Lapaliiya . Around 1210 DR , Rebrum wrote the " Life of Rebrum " , a bawdy autobiography that was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark .
description_long: Rebrum Rebrum was a travelling merchant from Sheirtalar in Lapaliiya . Around 1210 DR , Rebrum wrote the " Life of Rebrum " , a bawdy autobiography that was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark . Here , Rebrum mentioned a group of drow traders , sent by their matrons , who attempted to barter the " Chanting Chain " , a holy relic of Talos the Destroyer , to another group of drow from a distant city .

title: Recitation
description: Recitation Recitation was an abjuration / evocation spell that invoked a deity ' s blessing on a battle ; aiding the caster and any allies while hindering any enemies in the area of effect . Effects . This spell was cast by reading out loud a passage or declaration of a sacred text related to the caster ' s religion .
description_long: Recitation Recitation was an abjuration / evocation spell that invoked a deity ' s blessing on a battle ; aiding the caster and any allies while hindering any enemies in the area of effect . Effects . This spell was cast by reading out loud a passage or declaration of a sacred text related to the caster ' s religion . For the duration of the spell , the caster and all allies were given a boost to their combat skills and made to strike harder against their foes . Allies of the same religion were given extra luck and strength . Likewise , all enemies were confused and doubtful and made unable to muster their full strength in combat . The area of effect was a 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) circle centered on the caster . Once the spell was completed , the caster was free to do other things . This spell stacked with " prayer " and " chant " so that the effects of any two or all three spells were cumulative . Components . Somatic gestures were required as the priest read the holy text out loud while holding or wearing a holy symbol .

title: Reckoning of Hell
description: Reckoning of Hell The Reckoning of Hell was an event which turned the Nine Hells of Baator into its current state . The archdevils split into two factions . The first was led by Mephistopheles who was followed by Mammon , Dispater and Geryon .
description_long: Reckoning of Hell The Reckoning of Hell was an event which turned the Nine Hells of Baator into its current state . The archdevils split into two factions . The first was led by Mephistopheles who was followed by Mammon , Dispater and Geryon . The second faction was led by Baalzebul who was followed by Zariel , Belial and Moloch . Everything started when Baalzebul was overthrown by Asmodeus . Soon the two factions joined forces against the Lord of Nine .

title: Reclaiming Blingdenstone
description: Reclaiming Blingdenstone Reclaiming Blingdenstone was an adventure module included with the second D & D Next playtester packet . Plot Summary . A concerted effort is being made to reclaim the ruins of Blingdenstone for the svirfneblin .
description_long: Reclaiming Blingdenstone Reclaiming Blingdenstone was an adventure module included with the second D & D Next playtester packet . Plot Summary . A concerted effort is being made to reclaim the ruins of Blingdenstone for the svirfneblin . In the midst of fierce fighting with humanoid s , rogue elemental s and Underdark monsters , adventurers try to help the deep gnomes restore their lost city to a semblance of what it once was .

title: Reconnect
description: Reconnect Reconnect was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was a closely guarded secret weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Effects .
description_long: Reconnect Reconnect was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was a closely guarded secret weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Effects . Wizards used this spell to re - attune themselves to their magical powers after spellslaying . The reconnection lasted for the spell ' s duration . If the wizard performed a spellslaying that kept them from casting spells longer than the reconnection spell ' s duration , then the wizard would not be able to cast spells after the reconnection spell ended . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Reconstruction
description: Reconstruction Reconstruction was an arcane alteration spell that restored a broken object back to its original condition for a short time . Effects . Using this spell , a wizard could touch a piece of a broken object and restore it to the whole object in its original form .
description_long: Reconstruction Reconstruction was an arcane alteration spell that restored a broken object back to its original condition for a short time . Effects . Using this spell , a wizard could touch a piece of a broken object and restore it to the whole object in its original form . The pieces , if available , reformed into the object , and missing pieces were replaced by this spell . All physical properties , such as size and weight , texture , strength , flexibility , hardness , smell , and even the sound it made when struck were restored such that the item was virtually indistinguishable from the original by any normal means of testing . " Detect magic " would register the aura of this spell and " true seeing " revealed the object as being truly broken . The spell lasted for one minute plus one additional minute for each level of the caster . When the spell expired , or if the object was broken again , the item immediately reverted to the condition it was in before " reconstruction " was cast . Any attempt to magically enhance a reconstructed object , such as applying a weapon enchantment or a " permanency " spell , also caused this spell to be canceled .

title: Red Brigade
description: Red Brigade The Red Brigade was a mercenary company active in the 1360s DR . History . Cedric Ravajar joined the Red Brigade and after four years of service he rose to lead it as captain , due to his combat ability and charisma .
description_long: Red Brigade The Red Brigade was a mercenary company active in the 1360s DR . History . Cedric Ravajar joined the Red Brigade and after four years of service he rose to lead it as captain , due to his combat ability and charisma . His best friend Soren Whitespear served as his second - in - command . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , Cedric accepted Calispar Delgorth into his force and included the priest in all of the company ' s decisions . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , while on a routine scouting expedition for a minor noble , two Brigade scouts reported a dead - magic zone in Brynwood Forest in the Vast . Cedric kept the find secret , telling only Calispar , and the two scouts disappeared shortly afterwards . Later that year , Cedric announced his retirement and disbanded the Red Brigade . The group split up and most went their separate ways . A trusted few , however , departed with Cedric . This included Soren , Calispar , the cook Drakar , several soldiers and four dwarven engineers . They secretly returned to the dead - magic zone , where they reformed into the Vipers , a bandit group that raided merchant caravans . Appearance .

title: Red Dragon ( Herald )
description: Red Dragon ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Red Dragon was one of the High Heralds . The sign of this office was a rampant metallic - red dragon with wings unfurled and mouth open with teeth bared . Traditionally , this office was given to a young Herald Pursuivant who was a bit more radical and had fresh ideas for the future .
description_long: Red Dragon ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Red Dragon was one of the High Heralds . The sign of this office was a rampant metallic - red dragon with wings unfurled and mouth open with teeth bared . Traditionally , this office was given to a young Herald Pursuivant who was a bit more radical and had fresh ideas for the future . Youthful enthusiasm led to Red Dragon playing the role of diplomat and matchmaker , arranging marriages between the hundreds of noble houses and helping create the coat - of - arms for their marriage shield and those of any children . Another tradition was that Red Dragon escorted supplicants , heirs , and honorees to ceremonies pertaining to the transfer or attainment of titles , positions , or awards of honor . The residence given to this office was a fortification called Dragonrise , located south of Easting near the headwaters of the southern tributary of the River Chionthar . During the tenures of Lady Anaethe and Lady Bluthba , this office gained a reputation of decadence and ardent self - indulgence , but a successor ( Bellym Glarsh ) struck a different tone by being either less licentious or more cautious .

title: Red Dragon Trading Post
description: Red Dragon Trading Post The Red Dragon Trading Post , also known as the Red Dragon Trading Lodge , was Luskan ' s most successful overland trading company . Location . The post was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Throat water tower in the Mirabar District .
description_long: Red Dragon Trading Post The Red Dragon Trading Post , also known as the Red Dragon Trading Lodge , was Luskan ' s most successful overland trading company . Location . The post was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Throat water tower in the Mirabar District . The lodge could be reached by the long span of Harbor Cross from Blood Island . Inhabitants . Although not as aggressive as Luskan ' s pirates , Red Dragon employees were always alert and well - armed . Due to staff shortages , they were usually looking to hire , at a rate of four gold pieces per day , with food , water and one " potion of healing " supplied per trip .

title: Red Flayers
description: Red Flayers The Red Flayers were a tribe of hobgoblin mercenaries from the High Moor that served the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme . History . The Red Flayers originally occupied territory on the southern High Moor , until they were recruited as guardians by the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme clan in 1026 DR .
description_long: Red Flayers The Red Flayers were a tribe of hobgoblin mercenaries from the High Moor that served the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme . History . The Red Flayers originally occupied territory on the southern High Moor , until they were recruited as guardians by the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme clan in 1026 DR . They relocated to Dragondoom in the Nether Mountains , where they built themselves a citadel , dubbing it Doomspire . For generations , the hobgoblins of the Red Flayers served and defended the Morueme dragons , and each dragon formed their own elite groups within the Flayers . Kizilpazar ' s sons , unhappy under the rule of their sire and reliance on the hobgoblins , eventually used the Red Flayers in experiments of cross - breeding to create the Blood of Morueme , a small elite army of hobgoblin half - dragon s to be used as agents against their father . In 1371 DR , the Red Flayers suffered grievous casualties on a failed assault on the Lady ' s Hand , a stronghold of Loviatar ' s faithful when Nahaunglaroth and Roraurim sought retribution for the death of their exiled mother Idrizraele .

title: Red Goat
description: Red Goat The Red Goat was a central province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . Save for a relatively small stretch of mountainous terrain on its southern edge , the Red Goat province was completely enclosed by other provinces of the Yikarian Empire , making it relatively secure .
description_long: Red Goat The Red Goat was a central province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . Save for a relatively small stretch of mountainous terrain on its southern edge , the Red Goat province was completely enclosed by other provinces of the Yikarian Empire , making it relatively secure . This province ran down a stretch of the World Pillar Mountains where they entered Zakhara . The Red Goat was much longer measured north to south than it was from west to east . Inhabitants . Old Goatbeard ruled this province of the Empire . Herds of livestock here were plentiful compared to those found throughout the Empire .

title: Red Knight
description: Red Knight The Red Knight , or the Lady of Strategy , was the Faerûnian deity of strategy and battle tactics and an exarch of Tempus . Her dogma dictated the use of careful tactics in battle to achieve victory , under the belief that sound strategy was the best way to win a battle with the most favorable outcome . Her symbol was a red knight - errant chess piece with stars for eyes .
description_long: Red Knight The Red Knight , or the Lady of Strategy , was the Faerûnian deity of strategy and battle tactics and an exarch of Tempus . Her dogma dictated the use of careful tactics in battle to achieve victory , under the belief that sound strategy was the best way to win a battle with the most favorable outcome . Her symbol was a red knight - errant chess piece with stars for eyes . Worshipers . The Red Knight was worshiped by generals , tacticians , lawful - minded warriors and paladins alike . Rituals . Clerics of the Red Knight , or " holy strategists , " prayed for their spells at night before sleeping to prepare for the next day . In addition to observing the holy days of the church of Tempus , the church of the Red Knight - - the " Red Fellowship " - - had two important holy days of its own . Midwinter Day . On Midwinter Day the Red Fellowship observed the Retreat . This solemn ceremony consisted of an assembly wherein the clergy discussed the previous year ' s campaigns . Strategies were discussed , battles analyzed , and the accumulated lore integrated into the church ' s teachings . The Queen ' s Gambit .

title: Red Larch
description: Red Larch The town of Red Larch is a waystop on the Long Road seven days north of Waterdeep , and is located at the intersection of three trails . One trail leads to the Bargewright Inn , another to Kheldell , and the third runs into the hills to derelict , monster - infested keeps . The town was named for a stand of red larch trees that were chopped down about the time of the town ' s founding .
description_long: Red Larch The town of Red Larch is a waystop on the Long Road seven days north of Waterdeep , and is located at the intersection of three trails . One trail leads to the Bargewright Inn , another to Kheldell , and the third runs into the hills to derelict , monster - infested keeps . The town was named for a stand of red larch trees that were chopped down about the time of the town ' s founding . Red Larch is known for its nourishing , though otherwise un - noteworthy food , called crumblecake . Crumblecakes are made into moist loaves from nuts , chickpea mash , chopped roots and greens , turkey and wildfowl scraps , all baked together . Notable Locations . In addition to what is listed below , there are farmer ' s and cattle markets , wagon works , and factories for the manufacture of buckles and locks .

title: Red Larch Rambler
description: Red Larch Rambler The Red Larch Rambler was a tavern in the town of Red Larch . Interior . The tavern was a large , well - known , and well - lit tavern .
description_long: Red Larch Rambler The Red Larch Rambler was a tavern in the town of Red Larch . Interior . The tavern was a large , well - known , and well - lit tavern . The establishment was decorated with hanging plants . Families and respectable folk of Red Larch came to the Rambler to drink and converse . The Red Larch Rambler was like a public gathering place .

title: Red Magic
description: Red Magic Red Magic , by Jean Rabe , is the third book of the loosely - related The Harpers series . Summary . Thay is ruled by a council of eight specialized archmages ( Zulkirs ) , one for each school .
description_long: Red Magic Red Magic , by Jean Rabe , is the third book of the loosely - related The Harpers series . Summary . Thay is ruled by a council of eight specialized archmages ( Zulkirs ) , one for each school . Maligor , the Zulkir of transmutation , plots to take control of Thay by himself and destroy his nemesis , Szass Tam . His plan can be said to have three stages : This power battle has raised the attention of the Harpers , who send three of their agents to find a way to stop Maligor ' s plan : a big city mage from the court of Aglarond , a druid who has never even been to a town , and his slightly more civilized centaur friend who is a fugitive from Thay .

title: Red Mazzie
description: Red Mazzie Red Mazzie was the most talented wizard of all Damara in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , in order to gain the favor of King Yarin Frostmantle of the Bloodstone Lands , Red Mazzie captured the copper dragon sisters Tazmikella and Ilnezhara .
description_long: Red Mazzie Red Mazzie was the most talented wizard of all Damara in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , in order to gain the favor of King Yarin Frostmantle of the Bloodstone Lands , Red Mazzie captured the copper dragon sisters Tazmikella and Ilnezhara . However they were freed by Jarlaxle and Red Mazzie was without his prize when Captain Dreylil Andrus arrived to check his claim .

title: Red Orchid
description: Red Orchid The Red Orchid was a ship sunk in the Sea of Fallen Stars by the exiled eladrin Caelynna . The ship was touched by the Spellplague and made sentient . For over eighty years , she remained in Cealynna ' s domain , unable to move , until Kwan Shang - Li ' s crew found the ship and removed the figurehead and attached it to their own ship .
description_long: Red Orchid The Red Orchid was a ship sunk in the Sea of Fallen Stars by the exiled eladrin Caelynna . The ship was touched by the Spellplague and made sentient . For over eighty years , she remained in Cealynna ' s domain , unable to move , until Kwan Shang - Li ' s crew found the ship and removed the figurehead and attached it to their own ship . The " Red Orchid " < nowiki > ' < / nowiki > s spirit helped the crew to refloat their ship . When Cealynna attacked the ship , the figurehead fought a giant squid ally of Cealynna .

title: Red Pillar Halls
description: Red Pillar Halls The Red Pillar Halls was an important bureaucratic location in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Red Pillar Halls were found within the Furnace ward of the city . Activities .
description_long: Red Pillar Halls The Red Pillar Halls was an important bureaucratic location in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Red Pillar Halls were found within the Furnace ward of the city . Activities . The Red Pillar Halls served as the court of the Sultan of the Efreet . Additionally , bureaucrats collected taxes , made appointments , and dealt justice here . Any efreeti hoping to address their grievances here was subjected to an extensive search and needed to dish out hefty bribes to make it into the building .

title: Red Plumes
description: Red Plumes The Red Plumes is a mercenary army of warrior s that operates directly under the will of First Lord Maalthiir . They enforce his will within the walls of Hillsfar , even going so far as to harass its inhabitants , while regularly extorting them , in order to maintain a fear of his authority . They understand their limits however , never going as far as would warrant complaints or pleas too loud as to be heard by the First Lord .
description_long: Red Plumes The Red Plumes is a mercenary army of warrior s that operates directly under the will of First Lord Maalthiir . They enforce his will within the walls of Hillsfar , even going so far as to harass its inhabitants , while regularly extorting them , in order to maintain a fear of his authority . They understand their limits however , never going as far as would warrant complaints or pleas too loud as to be heard by the First Lord . Along with guarding the city , patrols of the Red Plumes can often be found keeping an eye open for monsters , members of the Zhentarim or other threats .

title: Red Prow
description: Red Prow The Red Prow was a slave ship out of Calimport in Calimshan . It sank under the weight of gold and gem s in its hold , then rose again as a ghost ship . By 1372 DR , it was home to wraith s and " weirder things " that rode people as if they were horse s .
description_long: Red Prow The Red Prow was a slave ship out of Calimport in Calimshan . It sank under the weight of gold and gem s in its hold , then rose again as a ghost ship . By 1372 DR , it was home to wraith s and " weirder things " that rode people as if they were horse s .

title: Red Ravens
description: Red Ravens The Red Ravens were a Cormyr - based mercenary company formed by several people who fought together in the Horde War s , headquartered in Arabel , and led by Rayanna the Rose . Its symbol was a red raven amulet . It was tasked ( by the crown ) with clearing the Stonelands to the north of Cormyr .
description_long: Red Ravens The Red Ravens were a Cormyr - based mercenary company formed by several people who fought together in the Horde War s , headquartered in Arabel , and led by Rayanna the Rose . Its symbol was a red raven amulet . It was tasked ( by the crown ) with clearing the Stonelands to the north of Cormyr . The organization consisted of 110 members and they were able to triple their membership fairly easily when the need arose . The organization equipped its members with studded leather armor and longsword s and charged a weekly rate of 200 gold piece s for its services . They were known to be trustworthy and honest , mainly due to the fact that they did not want to lose their government contracts . Despite their size and being well equipped , they were only somewhat successful in their mission to clear the Stonelands , which were still in 1368 not safe for travel .

title: Red River
description: Red River The Red River was a tributary of the River Ith in Tethyr . This creek flowed from the Purple Hills to Myratma and was often flanked by lavenders , hence its former name , Lavender Creek . It received its newer name because its waters flowed red with blood from the First Siege of Myratma during the Reclamation Wars .
description_long: Red River The Red River was a tributary of the River Ith in Tethyr . This creek flowed from the Purple Hills to Myratma and was often flanked by lavenders , hence its former name , Lavender Creek . It received its newer name because its waters flowed red with blood from the First Siege of Myratma during the Reclamation Wars . The fields around it were likewise called the " Red River Fields " . The Red River formed the border between counties Elemetar and Vintor .

title: Red Rock
description: Red Rock The Red Rock was a stone and wood inn located in Dagger Falls ran by the half - elven ex - minstrel known as Kessla . Structure . The taproom of the Red Rock was illuminated by magical globes of light rather than candles , curtesy of Kessla ' s magic .
description_long: Red Rock The Red Rock was a stone and wood inn located in Dagger Falls ran by the half - elven ex - minstrel known as Kessla . Structure . The taproom of the Red Rock was illuminated by magical globes of light rather than candles , curtesy of Kessla ' s magic . Inhabitants . Kessla was assisted by a stable boy named Orthran and two waitresses , Larstiira and Jandylgrae . History . The Red Rock survived inspections from the Zhent s and countless brawls that would erupt inside . Despite this , it was burned to the ground by an army of orc s . The Lord of Daggerdale Randal Morn did not have enough money to rebuild the inn , though some adventurers lent money to Kessla for restoration before 1367 DR .

title: Red Rysal
description: Red Rysal The Red Rysal , or Red Captain , was an outlaw in Teshburl , Calimshan , who had acquired legendary status . History . For many decades , the Red Rysal , clad in red leather , had defended the common folk of Teshburl against abuses of power among the rich and corrupt merchants , guildmasters , and government officials .
description_long: Red Rysal The Red Rysal , or Red Captain , was an outlaw in Teshburl , Calimshan , who had acquired legendary status . History . For many decades , the Red Rysal , clad in red leather , had defended the common folk of Teshburl against abuses of power among the rich and corrupt merchants , guildmasters , and government officials . It was the Red Rysal who uncovered that many of the poor people ' s children were being kidnapped by the priests and clerics of many of the evil temples in the city , such as those dedicated to Bane or Cyric , and then sold into slavery . Once this terrible news came out , there was a massive city uprising , and most of the temples in Teshburl were burned to the ground . By 1370 DR , the Red Rysal ' s true identity remained a mystery to most . Some thought he was a genie . In truth , the Red Rysal was not a single person but rather a title passed down from one person to another , and there were usually two Red Rysals operating at the same time . By 1370 , there had been sixteen Red Rysals in total , most of whom were from the el Ehrat family , a clan of weaponsmiths .

title: Red Sashes
description: Red Sashes The Red Sashes were a vigilante group that was based in Waterdeep . Organization . The individual cells of the Sashes , one for each ward of the city , each answered to an authority only known as " The One " .
description_long: Red Sashes The Red Sashes were a vigilante group that was based in Waterdeep . Organization . The individual cells of the Sashes , one for each ward of the city , each answered to an authority only known as " The One " . Activities . Not an impulsive or excessively violent group , the Red Sashes aimed to arrest the guilty and free the innocent , typically when the City Watch failed in these aims . Membership . Prospective members were approached by the Red Sashes and were forced to swear a loyalty oath to " The One " . These invitations were only given after approval of the member was reached after much observation . Members were not allowed to reveal any secrets of the group to outsiders and had to pay a 5 gold piece per - month membership fee . " The One " . Only a few of the Lords of Waterdeep were aware of " The One ' s " true identity . These included Mirt , Kitten , Nindil , Sammereza and , before his death , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . History . The Red Sashes were formed by Durnan in 1312 DR to fulfill his own personal needs .

title: Red Sisters
description: Red Sisters The Red Sisters were an elite band of assassin s that the Valsharess formed to help her with her plans for taking over the surface , starting with Waterdeep in the early 1370s DR . The Red Sisters assassinated a lot of important people in Waterdeep who were seen as a threat to the Valsharess . In the end , Mephistopheles , the ruler of Cania , killed the last of the Red Sisters .
description_long: Red Sisters The Red Sisters were an elite band of assassin s that the Valsharess formed to help her with her plans for taking over the surface , starting with Waterdeep in the early 1370s DR . The Red Sisters assassinated a lot of important people in Waterdeep who were seen as a threat to the Valsharess . In the end , Mephistopheles , the ruler of Cania , killed the last of the Red Sisters .

title: Red Thunder Mercenary Corps
description: Red Thunder Mercenary Corps The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was a centaur mercenary company based in the Hordelands . History . The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was formed by the centaurs from the Chondalwood after they participated in the Battle of Five Crowns in the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .
description_long: Red Thunder Mercenary Corps The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was a centaur mercenary company based in the Hordelands . History . The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was formed by the centaurs from the Chondalwood after they participated in the Battle of Five Crowns in the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep . Later they fought in the Shaar , Vilhon Reach and Bloodstone Lands , recruiting more members . After the Horde Wars they established themselves in the Hordelands , where they recruited a local centaur tribe . Organization . Tactics . The Red Thunder were three units of 50 archers . Contracts . The Red Thunder charged 150 gold piece s per week for their services . they worked primarily as caravan guards .

title: Red Tiger Tribe
description: Red Tiger Tribe The Red Tiger Tribe was an Uthgardt barbarian tribe active in the Silver Marches of Faerûn . Organization . They were more traditional than the other Uthgardt tribes .
description_long: Red Tiger Tribe The Red Tiger Tribe was an Uthgardt barbarian tribe active in the Silver Marches of Faerûn . Organization . They were more traditional than the other Uthgardt tribes . For example , when people living in the Silver Marches mentioned the wild and savage nature of the Uthgardt barbarians , they were usually speaking about the Red Tigers . Like their snow cat totem beast , the tribe acted aggressive and solitary . They hunted in very small family groups , roaming the North , but primarily in the Cold Wood . Activities . The men of the Red Tiger tribe were strictly hunters and left the gathering and trading to the women , elderly , and children of the tribe . The Red Tigers believed the true test of a hunter was to bring down their prey unaided . Members of the tribe were very suspicious of magic , which they did not understand . To demonstrate their fighting prowess , many Red Tiger fighters preferred to fight unarmed than wield a magic weapon taken from the hands of an arcane spellcaster . Tactics . In 1372 DR , the tribe numbered approximately one thousand individuals , and these warriors roamed their hunting territory in small groups of eight to twenty men .

title: Red Tower of Dayya
description: Red Tower of Dayya The Red Tower of Dayya was located in the Lost City of Ubar in 1367 DR . Description . The Red Tower rose from the center of the city .
description_long: Red Tower of Dayya The Red Tower of Dayya was located in the Lost City of Ubar in 1367 DR . Description . The Red Tower rose from the center of the city . Much of Ubar ' s buildings were in drastic need of repair , but curiously , the Red Tower appeared to be in pristine condition . History . The Red Tower served as the palace of the Amir of Ubar .

title: Red Wizard
description: Red Wizard Red Wizard is a special prestige class in Thay whose members belong to the Red Wizards of Thay . Would - be Red wizards tend to focus on one school of magic . Very few sorcerer s and bard s decide to become Red wizards ; those that do are considered misfits .
description_long: Red Wizard Red Wizard is a special prestige class in Thay whose members belong to the Red Wizards of Thay . Would - be Red wizards tend to focus on one school of magic . Very few sorcerer s and bard s decide to become Red wizards ; those that do are considered misfits . Creations . The Red Wizards created the spell Acid Rain .

title: Red Wizards of Thay
description: Red Wizards of Thay The Red Wizards , formerly known as the Red Wizards of Thay before a coup led by Szass Tam , are an organization of wizards in Faerûn . During their height of power , the Red Wizards were the notorious and nefarious spellcasting ruling class of the inhospitable but well - inhabited country of Thay . Slavers , demonologists , and magical experimenters , the Red Wizards were much feared by most of Faerûn .
description_long: Red Wizards of Thay The Red Wizards , formerly known as the Red Wizards of Thay before a coup led by Szass Tam , are an organization of wizards in Faerûn . During their height of power , the Red Wizards were the notorious and nefarious spellcasting ruling class of the inhospitable but well - inhabited country of Thay . Slavers , demonologists , and magical experimenters , the Red Wizards were much feared by most of Faerûn . They constantly schemed to bring down their neighboring nations of Rashemen , where they were thwarted by the equally famed magicians the Witches of Rashemen ; Aglarond , where they were turned back by the Simbul of the Seven Sisters ; and Mulhorand , where the people of Thay first emigrated from . The leaders of the Red Wizards , and of Thay , were the eight zulkirs , each for a different school of magic . Chief amongst these , and , indeed , among all Red Wizards was Szass Tam , a powerful archmage and feared lich and now the ruler of Thay and sworn enemy of the Red Wizards who escaped him .

title: Red Worm
description: Red Worm The Red Worm was a half - red dragon half - remorhaz of enormous size who had been chosen to be a guardian of the portal in Choshein . Description . The Red Worm had streaks of red running along his otherwise white body , indicative of his draconic heritage .
description_long: Red Worm The Red Worm was a half - red dragon half - remorhaz of enormous size who had been chosen to be a guardian of the portal in Choshein . Description . The Red Worm had streaks of red running along his otherwise white body , indicative of his draconic heritage . Likewise , his head was a strange mixture of draconic and insectiod features ; he bore both frills and horns . The Red Worm was not a mindless monster ; his draconic parentage gave him more intelligence than the typical remorhaz . He was fully capable of devising shrewd attacks , and he was smart enough to suspect that he was guarding a portal of some sort , though he did not know why . Abilities . In addition to the abilities of a typical remorhaz , as a half - red dragon , the Red Worm could breath fire approximately once a day and was immune to fire , paralysis , and magical sleep effects . History . The Red Worm was the spawn of an eccentric female red dragon named Icindallix , whose eggs were fertilized by an especially large male remorhaz . She laired in the caverns where Choshein once stood . The Red Worm eventually grew powerful enough to slay and consume his sire .

title: Red dragon
description: Red dragon Red dragons are covetous , evil creatures , interested only in their own well - being , vanity and the extension of their treasure hoards . They are supremely confident of their own abilities and are prone to making snap decisions without any forethought . The most powerful of the chromatic dragon s , red dragons breathe a cone of fire .
description_long: Red dragon Red dragons are covetous , evil creatures , interested only in their own well - being , vanity and the extension of their treasure hoards . They are supremely confident of their own abilities and are prone to making snap decisions without any forethought . The most powerful of the chromatic dragon s , red dragons breathe a cone of fire . Red Dragons are the most fearsome and cruel of the chromatic dragons . They delight in ruin , death , and destruction . Physical description . Red dragons are physically distinguished by their enormous size and wingspan . They have two large horns upon their heads , which point backwards toward their wings . They smell of smoke and sulfur . Breath weapon . Red dragons expel a cone of fire . Lairs . They make their homes in mountainous lairs . Many prefer to dwell in volcanoes , where the intense heat keeps others at bay . Ecology . Habitat . Red dragons love to make their lairs in deep , underground caves in mountainous regions , especially if there is volcanic activity . Almost all red dragons simply must have a high perch . The higher the better as they believe that their domain encompasses all that they can see .

title: Red leafhopper
description: Red leafhopper The red leafhopper was a type of insect found in Faerûn , such as in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Lyra Sunrose once rode through the rimwood of Cormanthor and found what she thought was an apple tree , but which turned out to be a pine with clusters of red leafhopper larvae hanging from its branches .
description_long: Red leafhopper The red leafhopper was a type of insect found in Faerûn , such as in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Lyra Sunrose once rode through the rimwood of Cormanthor and found what she thought was an apple tree , but which turned out to be a pine with clusters of red leafhopper larvae hanging from its branches .

title: Red slaad
description: Red slaad Red slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Red slaadi had long claws .
description_long: Red slaad Red slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Red slaadi had long claws . If a humanoid were hit by one of these claws , it could become infected with a slaad egg . If allowed to mature , after three months the egg formed a slaad tadpole that erupted from the host ' s chest , destroying all internal organs and instantly killing the host . The newborn tadpole would then eat the corpse and within hours mature into either a blue slaad or a green slaad if the host was a sufficiently powerful spellcaster . Red slaadi appeared as the result of the chaos phage disease that infected humanoids by contact with blue slaadi hooks .

title: Red tear
description: Red tear Red Tears , also known as Tempus ' weeping or Tempus ' s weeping , were gemstones found only in the Realms in deep mines or anywhere old stone had been exposed by erosion , mining , or rockfall . Description . Red tears were teardrop - shaped crystals with a glossy surface , vividly colored fiery orange , cherry red , or blood crimson .
description_long: Red tear Red Tears , also known as Tempus ' weeping or Tempus ' s weeping , were gemstones found only in the Realms in deep mines or anywhere old stone had been exposed by erosion , mining , or rockfall . Description . Red tears were teardrop - shaped crystals with a glossy surface , vividly colored fiery orange , cherry red , or blood crimson . Legends say they were the tears of lovers left behind after their sweethearts perished in battle , stained by the blood of the fallen . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Powers . These gem stones served as a substitute for all material components used in any healing spell that didn ' t require specific construction . Powdered red tear was an ingredient for making the magic ink for creating scrolls of spells that mended broken objects . History . The church of Tempus believed that their deity appeared during the Time of Troubles in both Battledale and the Fields of the Dead , but which occurred first has not been established .

title: Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping
description: Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping was a business located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It rented out storage space for cargo and was owned by Lord Sarp Redbeard , ruler of the town . History .
description_long: Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping was a business located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It rented out storage space for cargo and was owned by Lord Sarp Redbeard , ruler of the town . History . Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping was in business by 1358 DR and still in business in 1369 DR . Famed traveler Volothamp Geddarm wrote about the business in " Volo ' s Guide to Cormyr " . Description . The warehouse stood on the western back of the Wyvernflow River , close to the public wharf . With two joining wings , it was shaped like an arrow head and stood three stories high , making it the largest building in Wheloon . It was constructed of stone , and continually improved to make it more fire - proof and better defended . " Circa " 1367 DR , the topmost floor was rebuilt in stone and the thatch roof replaced with tiles . The entire compound was designed so fire could not take hold , not even incendiary attacks . The loading dock was covered against the elements and equipped with rolling beam hoists and flatcarts . Defenses . The facility was heavily guarded .

title: Redbrands
description: Redbrands The Redbrands were a group of bandits and brigands that , in approximately 1480 DR , had settled in the resettled frontier town of Phandalin near the Triboar Trail and the Sword Mountains . Activities . With no local lord or powerful authority within the small town , the Redbrands were able to harass the farmers and prospectors for two months .
description_long: Redbrands The Redbrands were a group of bandits and brigands that , in approximately 1480 DR , had settled in the resettled frontier town of Phandalin near the Triboar Trail and the Sword Mountains . Activities . With no local lord or powerful authority within the small town , the Redbrands were able to harass the farmers and prospectors for two months . Many were afraid of standing up to the bandit group , including the townsmaster , the closest thing to local authority Phandalin had , Harbin Wester . Description . The Redbrands mostly consisted of human s , male and female , although a handful of halfling s were also in the bandit group . Each Redbrand wore a simple , dirty scarlet cloak . The cloaks were used to stop the undead in their hideout in Phandalin from attacking them .

title: Redcap
description: Redcap Redcaps were evil murderous fey with an insatiable bloodlust . They appeared in the Feywild , or at places where creatures acted on a deep desire for bloodshed . Redcaps needed to kill constantly in order to continue existing .
description_long: Redcap Redcaps were evil murderous fey with an insatiable bloodlust . They appeared in the Feywild , or at places where creatures acted on a deep desire for bloodshed . Redcaps needed to kill constantly in order to continue existing . Their pointed red hats needed to remain soaked in fresh blood , which had to be replenished at least once every three days , otherwise the redcap would simply disappear , a fact they are entirely aware of . Their scythe and boots are spawned naturally with them . Rumors & Legends . In halfling fairy tales , redcaps were said to be former halflings cursed as punishment for betrayal , but these were just stories and nothing more .

title: Reddansyr
description: Reddansyr Reddansyr was a small settlement on the road from Westgate to Starmantle . It had a well - earned reputation as an adventurers ' town because it was a good source of information for such people . Oddly enough , the local temple of Oghma was not responsible for this ; they apparently resented the free flow of information at the Giant ' s Folly , the local festhall .
description_long: Reddansyr Reddansyr was a small settlement on the road from Westgate to Starmantle . It had a well - earned reputation as an adventurers ' town because it was a good source of information for such people . Oddly enough , the local temple of Oghma was not responsible for this ; they apparently resented the free flow of information at the Giant ' s Folly , the local festhall .

title: Redfang
description: Redfang Redfang the Reaper was the insidious monstrous ruler of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Developing a taste for human flesh , Redfang instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci Hamlet .
description_long: Redfang Redfang the Reaper was the insidious monstrous ruler of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Developing a taste for human flesh , Redfang instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci Hamlet . Yearly , his harpies swooped down from the air , snatching people unawares to carry back to the cookpot . The seasonal appearance of Nix was a sick irony : as the villagers brought in the harvest , so too did the harpies of Nix . This doubtless earned Redfang his title , " the Reaper " . At last , a mage known as Haradan the Hermit heard of the disappearances , and decided to investigate and put a stop to it , leading to the Harvest of Horrors .

title: Redfires Inn
description: Redfires Inn Redfires Inn was an inn in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . Redfires Inn was a big place , high quality , and popular with patrons of many different races , though it was costly . It featured room service , and offered boar pie , wine s from all over Calaunt , and pleasure - girls .
description_long: Redfires Inn Redfires Inn was an inn in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . Redfires Inn was a big place , high quality , and popular with patrons of many different races , though it was costly . It featured room service , and offered boar pie , wine s from all over Calaunt , and pleasure - girls .

title: Redinald Rascalin
description: Redinald Rascalin Redinald Rascalin was a human paladin of Torm and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Relations . Redinald was the grandson of Maelin Rascalin , a notorious bandit turned general and defender of the realm , who was rewarded with the barony .
description_long: Redinald Rascalin Redinald Rascalin was a human paladin of Torm and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Relations . Redinald was the grandson of Maelin Rascalin , a notorious bandit turned general and defender of the realm , who was rewarded with the barony . Redinald and his family were the staunchest supporters of King Drasna Bluemantle . Personality . Redinald was a devout Tormtar and a good fit for the path of the paladin , though he was painfully truthful . History . By 1367 DR , warnings circulated that the gray orc s of the Dustwall Mountains were gathering in preparation for a major assault or raids into Ulgarth . Thousands of orcs were expected . In preparation , Baron Rascalin began recruiting solders , even mercenaries , to bolster the city ' s defenses , as well as armorers , weaponsmiths , and anyone else who could lend a hand .

title: Reduce animal
description: Reduce animal Reduce animal was a transmutation spell used by druid s and ranger s to shrink one animal to half its size . The animal had to acquiesce for the transformation to work . Components .
description_long: Reduce animal Reduce animal was a transmutation spell used by druid s and ranger s to shrink one animal to half its size . The animal had to acquiesce for the transformation to work . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic components only . Related spell . The reversed form of the more powerful spell " animal growth " , " shrink animal " , was sometimes also called " reduce animal " , but was in fact a different spell .

title: Redwaters
description: Redwaters Redwaters , also known as Dellon - lune , was a lake in the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale , fished for its Knucklehead scrimshaw . History . The lake ' s original name was Dellon - lune , but it was renamed after a fight between rival fishing boats left bloody corpses in the water , hence ' Redwaters .
description_long: Redwaters Redwaters , also known as Dellon - lune , was a lake in the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale , fished for its Knucklehead scrimshaw . History . The lake ' s original name was Dellon - lune , but it was renamed after a fight between rival fishing boats left bloody corpses in the water , hence ' Redwaters . ' Around 1351 DR , Regis , Companion of the Hall , witnessed a small skirmish between fishing boats over fishing rights , where one man died .

title: Reef giant
description: Reef giant Reef giants were loners who lived among the tropical reefs that surrounded Zakhara . Description . Reef giants had white hair and coppery skin .
description_long: Reef giant Reef giants were loners who lived among the tropical reefs that surrounded Zakhara . Description . Reef giants had white hair and coppery skin . Reef giants normally stood 16 feet ( 4 . 8 meters ) tall and weighed 4000 lb . ( 1800 kilograms ) . They were more barrel - chested than other giants from swimming through the ocean water . Combat . All reef giants preferred fighting underwater . They were immune to regular and magical water and ice - based attacks . Their favored weapon was a giant trident . Once per day a reef giant was able to form a whirlpool capable of sucking enemies under the water and battering them with debris . When attacking ships , reef giants could hurl boulders from a great distance . Habitat / Society . Reef giants mated for life but led solitary existences most of the time . Daughters were groomed to take care of parents when they aged and all of the parent ' s belongings passed to the daughter . These daughters were eagerly sought by reef giant suitors . Ecology . Reef giants fished and foraged for a wide variety of food in the ocean , often netting entire schools of fish at once .

title: Reema Stonefist
description: Reema Stonefist Reema Stonefist was an Order of the Gauntlet fighter in 1489 DR . History . Reema led an adventuring party for the Order of the Gauntlet .
description_long: Reema Stonefist Reema Stonefist was an Order of the Gauntlet fighter in 1489 DR . History . Reema led an adventuring party for the Order of the Gauntlet . When the black dragon Throstulgrael , recently settled in Twilight Marsh near Phlan , started preying upon caravans , Reema and her men were ordered to find and defeat the dragon . Later , fellow Gauntlet agent Zern Xerkstil asked an adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair to discovered what happened to the former party . The adventurers discovered that Reema and her fellows had been killed by kobold minions of the dragon .

title: Reeve Sar Testain
description: Reeve Sar Testain Reeve Sar Testain was a pirate captain in the Moonsea region around 1429 DR , commanding the ship " Audacity " . History . One day in 1429 DR , he and his crew sacked the merchant ship " Abundant Serendipity " after a fierce fight .
description_long: Reeve Sar Testain Reeve Sar Testain was a pirate captain in the Moonsea region around 1429 DR , commanding the ship " Audacity " . History . One day in 1429 DR , he and his crew sacked the merchant ship " Abundant Serendipity " after a fierce fight . Reeve and his men decided to stop to repair the damage and rest for a while in a small village on an isle near Phlan . Soon , the pirates enslaved the villagers . What Captain Reeve did not know was that near the village was a powerful altar to Tiamat . At last , out of desperation , the villagers invoked devil servants of Tiamat , in exchange for their souls and worship , to banish the pirate crew of Reeve Sar Testain . The pirates were swallowed up into the Nine Hells . However , in 1489 DR , during a fight with a Cult of the Dragon warship led by Ixan , their bonds were somehow broken and Reeve and his men , now fiend s , returned to Toril . Eventually , thanks to an adventuring party hired to investigate rumors of dracolich es and ghost ships wandering the area , Reeve and his fiendish pirates were defeated .

title: Reforged Ring
description: Reforged Ring The Reforged Ring was , as of 1479 DR , a relatively new criminal gang in the town of Skullport . Organization . Members of the gang were initiated with a painful rite that involved branding the ring finger with a set of red - hot tongs .
description_long: Reforged Ring The Reforged Ring was , as of 1479 DR , a relatively new criminal gang in the town of Skullport . Organization . Members of the gang were initiated with a painful rite that involved branding the ring finger with a set of red - hot tongs . The branding made it difficult for gang members to leave the gang since many people outside of Skullport understood the significance of the brand and wouldn ' t hesitate to attack slavers . History . The gang ' s name invoked the name of the Iron Ring , a slaver gang that operated in Skullport in the 14th century DR . The gang owned slave pens and warehouses throughout the town . The gang was not very popular in Skullport and was despised by the Lowfellows who had a large number of slaves within their ranks .

title: Refuge
description: Refuge Refuge , also known as succor , is a conjuration spell that alters an item to transport its possessor to the caster . Effects . You create powerful magic in some specially prepared object - a statuette , a jeweled rod , a gem , etc .
description_long: Refuge Refuge , also known as succor , is a conjuration spell that alters an item to transport its possessor to the caster . Effects . You create powerful magic in some specially prepared object - a statuette , a jeweled rod , a gem , etc . This object contains the power to instantaneously transport its possessor across any distance within the same plane to your abode . Once the item is conjured , you must give it willingly to an individual and at the same time inform him of a command word to be spoken when the item is to be used . To make use of the item , the subject speaks the command word at the same time that he rends or breaks the item . When this is done , the individual and all that he is wearing and carrying are instantaneously transported to your abode . You can alter the spell when casting it so that it transports you to within a couple feet of the possessor of the item when it is broken and the command word spoken . You will have a general idea of the location and situation of the item possessor at the time the refuge spell is discharged , but once deciding to alter the spell in this fashion you have no choice whether or not to be transported . Material components .

title: Regbald Stonethrower
description: Regbald Stonethrower Regbald Stonethrower was a dwarven warrior of the Frozenfar around 1369 DR . History . In Tarsakh , 1369 DR , while traveling through the Spine of the World pass into Icewind Dale Regbald was killed fighting hobgoblin raiders and their goblin scouts who ambushed a merchant caravans .
description_long: Regbald Stonethrower Regbald Stonethrower was a dwarven warrior of the Frozenfar around 1369 DR . History . In Tarsakh , 1369 DR , while traveling through the Spine of the World pass into Icewind Dale Regbald was killed fighting hobgoblin raiders and their goblin scouts who ambushed a merchant caravans .

title: Regenerate
description: Regenerate Regenerate was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could reattach or regrow severed body parts . The reverse of this spell , wither , shriveled a body part to dust . Effect .
description_long: Regenerate Regenerate was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could reattach or regrow severed body parts . The reverse of this spell , wither , shriveled a body part to dust . Effect . The caster had to successfully touch the subject for this spell to work . The subject had to be alive ( not dead or undead ) for this spell to have any effect . Any severed appendages , including severed heads of multiheaded creatures , could be reattached by means of this spell . The process only took one minute if the body parts were placed back in their original positions touching the live body . If the parts were not available or too damaged , the live body would regrow the missing members , but it took longer . The conjuration version of this spell took less than half an hour to regenerate missing parts , the necromantic version could take up to an an hour longer than that . Bones and missing or damaged organs would also grow back . As a side effect , the conjuration version of this spell also performed an enhanced version of " cure critical wounds " .

title: Regent of City Works
description: Regent of City Works The Regent of City Works was a civic official position of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . It was subordinate to the Lord Chancellor . Duties .
description_long: Regent of City Works The Regent of City Works was a civic official position of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . It was subordinate to the Lord Chancellor . Duties . The Regent of City Works had a wide range of necessary but unglamorous duties . First , it was responsible for the water supply and sanitation system of Ravens Bluff , as well as building inspection and the cemetery . The Regent also managed the municipal records of births , deaths , indentures , purchases , loans , mortgages , tenancy agreements , property deeds , and treaties . It was thus a very busy Regency , with many hardworking lesser officials handling all these duties . Finally , it also fulfilled the local office of the Heralds of Faerûn , titled The Ravencoat , and performed heraldic duties there . In this position , The Ravencoat was entitled to a maroon - and - gold adorned with black wings , as well as a trumpet . History . For some decades in the mid – 14th century DR , the Regent of City Works had to tidy up after the efforts of the honorary building inspector Ambassador Carrague . For a number of years , the position was filled by the competent but rampantly corrupt Bundrigo Dalastarra .

title: Reghed Glacier
description: Reghed Glacier The Reghed Glacier was a glacial wasteland north of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Reghed Glacier formed the eastern boundary of Icewind Dale and was bordered by the Spine of the World to the south .
description_long: Reghed Glacier The Reghed Glacier was a glacial wasteland north of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Reghed Glacier formed the eastern boundary of Icewind Dale and was bordered by the Spine of the World to the south . To the east of the glacier was a frozen wasteland ; beyond that ( north of Lurkwood and the Valley of Khedrun ) began the enormous Endless Ice Sea glacier . The Reghed Glacier sometimes confused with the Endless Ice Sea . Inhabitants . The Reghedman barbarians of Icewind Dale took their name from this glacier . The Reghed Glacier was home to the white dragon Ingeloakastimizilian ( known as Icingdeath ) , who was slain by Wulfgar . Icingdeath ' s underground lair was located beneath the Evermelt hot springs .

title: Reghedmen
description: Reghedmen The Reghedmen were the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale , also known as the men of the tundra . They eked out a harsh and bitter life between the Reghed Glacier and the Sea of Moving Ice . The Reghedman were tall - taller than most southerners by a head .
description_long: Reghedmen The Reghedmen were the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale , also known as the men of the tundra . They eked out a harsh and bitter life between the Reghed Glacier and the Sea of Moving Ice . The Reghedman were tall - taller than most southerners by a head . They were fair - haired ( blond , red , or light brown ) and blue - eyed . Like the majority of barbarians , they were suspicious of magic , equating it with both weakness and evil . The only power they recognized was the power of a man ' s weapon arm and their god Tempos . Each tribe was formally ruled by a king . Known tribes are the Tribe of the Elk , the Tribe of the Wolf , the Tribe of the Bear , the Tribe of the Tiger , the Tribe of the Seal and the Tribe of the Caribou . Spirituality . The Reghedmen worshipped tribal beast spirits and Tempos ( their name for Tempus ) , the god of war . Tempos was served by shaman s who revered their tribal beast totems highly . These beast totems were also great spirits , similar to the beast totems of the Uthgardt .

title: Reginald
description: Reginald Reginald was a corrupt sergeant of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Reginald on the surface was polite , courteous , and professional but inside he was moved only by greed and ambition .
description_long: Reginald Reginald was a corrupt sergeant of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Reginald on the surface was polite , courteous , and professional but inside he was moved only by greed and ambition . He was a charming and well - spoken individual . History . Reginald was a Red Plume soldier in Hillsfar . During the Rage of Demons , he decided to make money kidnapping non - human farmers around the city and selling them to duergar slavers . However , some angry farmers hired bandits to have revenge . A bandit group attacked a caravan protected by Reginald and his men . An adventuring party caught in the middle brought Reginald and his surviving men to justice , and they would face a tribunal .

title: Reginald Roundshield
description: Reginald Roundshield Reginald Roundshield , nicknamed " Little Arr Arr " , was the son of Citadel Felbarr ' s Captain of the Guard Reginald Roundshield Sr . He was in fact the re - incarnation of Bruenor Battlehammer of the Companions of the Hall . Description .
description_long: Reginald Roundshield Reginald Roundshield , nicknamed " Little Arr Arr " , was the son of Citadel Felbarr ' s Captain of the Guard Reginald Roundshield Sr . He was in fact the re - incarnation of Bruenor Battlehammer of the Companions of the Hall . Description . Reginald looked the same as in his previous life , meaning he had blue eyes and red hair , though of course as a dwarfling he had no beard . Growing up , Reginald was angry and rebellious , blaming Moradin for not allowing him to go to his proper rest in Dwarfhome . However , his epiphany that he could potentially return to help his people as the 13th king of Mithral Hall changed his attitude somewhat , although he decided loyalty to his people was more important than loyalty to his friend , Drizzt Do ' Urden . However , an encounter with his cursed friend Thibbledorf Pwent reminded him of the importance of friendship and he felt bad for his initial decision to abandon Drizzt . History . Citadel Felbarr . Upon Bruenor Battlehammer ' s death in 1462 DR , he arrived in Iruladoon with the rest of the deceased Companions of the Hall ( Catti - brie , Regis , and Wulfgar ) .

title: Regis
description: Regis Regis ( jokingly called Rumblebelly by Bruenor Battlehammer ) was the halfling member of the adventuring group known as the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Spider Parrafin . Physical description .
description_long: Regis Regis ( jokingly called Rumblebelly by Bruenor Battlehammer ) was the halfling member of the adventuring group known as the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Spider Parrafin . Physical description . Regis was barely 3 feet ( 0 . 9m ) tall and so chubby he earned the nickname " Rumblebelly " , given to him by his dwarven friend Bruenor Battlehammer . He had curly brown hair , and one of his fingers on his left hand was a stump due to being cut off by Artemis Entreri . When traveling , Regis typically wore a fine red shirt , brown vest , and breeches . Regis appeared the same after his reincarnation as he did before it , albeit he later wore a neatly trimmed mustache and small goatee . Coincidentally , he was also missing the tip of his pinky finger on his left hand , due to the circumstances of his rebirth .

title: Regweld Harpell
description: Regweld Harpell Regweld Harpell was a member of the Harpell family which lived in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Description . Regweld was very fat .
description_long: Regweld Harpell Regweld Harpell was a member of the Harpell family which lived in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Description . Regweld was very fat . Personality . The eccentric wizard loved crossbreeding animals and succeeded in making Puddlejumper , which was a mix of horse and frog . History . In 1358 DR , Regweld protected Mithral Hall with his family members : Bidderdoo , Bella don Delroy , and Harkle Harpell to help defend Mithral Hall . While riding Puddlejumper in the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , Regweld was hit by three lightning bolt s cast by enemy drow wizards as he battled a group of minotaur s .

title: Reincarnate
description: Reincarnate Reincarnate was a transmutation or necromantic spell that returned a dead creature ' s soul to a new body . The arcane version of this spell was called reincarnation but was similar in most respects . Effects .
description_long: Reincarnate Reincarnate was a transmutation or necromantic spell that returned a dead creature ' s soul to a new body . The arcane version of this spell was called reincarnation but was similar in most respects . Effects . This spell required the caster to touch at least some piece of the dead creature ' s body that was part of the creature at the time of death ; that was not undead , had not died of old age , or been killed by a death effect ; and be cast no more than a week after death occurred . The soul also had to be free and willing to return . If all these criteria were met , then a new body was formed out of the natural environment where the spell was cast and the soul took up residence in it , being a young adult of whatever species appeared . This process took an hour to complete and occurred without any possibility of system shock . The arcane version of this spell required the corpse to have been dead no longer than a matter of days , according to the experience of the wizard .

title: Reiner Trall
description: Reiner Trall Reiner Trall was a male human ranger of Daggerdale and a captain of the Freedom Riders in the 1360s DR . History . In 1367 DR , Captain Reiner Trall led a patrol of men searching for Zhent ish agents in Daggerdale and trying to prevent a Zhent caravan from reaching Dagger Falls .
description_long: Reiner Trall Reiner Trall was a male human ranger of Daggerdale and a captain of the Freedom Riders in the 1360s DR . History . In 1367 DR , Captain Reiner Trall led a patrol of men searching for Zhent ish agents in Daggerdale and trying to prevent a Zhent caravan from reaching Dagger Falls . Possessions . In battle , Reiner carried a bastard sword , handaxe , light crossbow , and spear . Appendix . Appearance . " Doom of Daggerdale " Behind the scenes . Reiner Trall and his patrol are listed as a random encounter for the players , so it ' s possible they never meet him . He does not appear again in other sources .

title: Reinhar I
description: Reinhar I Reinhar I was an arkaiun warchief who rose to prominence in 545 DR in Dambrath . Activities . Reinhar consolidated the might of the various tribes of arkaiun inhabiting the barbarian kingdom of Dambrath .
description_long: Reinhar I Reinhar I was an arkaiun warchief who rose to prominence in 545 DR in Dambrath . Activities . Reinhar consolidated the might of the various tribes of arkaiun inhabiting the barbarian kingdom of Dambrath . He oversaw the enslavement of nearby Luiren and its halfling population . In 551 DR , Reinhar conquered the land of Estagund and the Gunders , the ruling family of that nation . Reinhar continued his onslaught , eventually moving on to capture or destroy several coastal cities in Durpar , before turning back to face the might of Halruaa . Reinhar assembled a force numbering 40 , 000 , including a fleet of 50 ships , during his assault of Halruaa . The cities of Mithel , Galdel , and Zalasuu fell under his control . He was eventually slain , along with most of his army , when they faced the magical might of Mycontil and his assembled archmages .

title: Reinhar II
description: Reinhar II Reinhar II was an arkaiun warchief from Dambrath . Activities . After the death and defeat of Reinhar I at the hands of Mycontil in Halruaa , Reinhar II assumed command of the remaining forces of invading arkaiun .
description_long: Reinhar II Reinhar II was an arkaiun warchief from Dambrath . Activities . After the death and defeat of Reinhar I at the hands of Mycontil in Halruaa , Reinhar II assumed command of the remaining forces of invading arkaiun . They immediately set out for Dambrath , struggling on a grueling march through the Walls of Halruaa before arriving home two months later . Only 1 , 000 of the initial 40 , 000 who invaded Halruaa survived to return to Dambrath . Reinhar II ruled as effectively in defeat as his father did while at war . He pulled all remaining warriors home , knowing they were exposed to attack from outside forces .

title: Reinhar IX
description: Reinhar IX Reinhar IX , also known as Reinhar the Foolish , was the king of the arkaiun in Dambrath in 802 DR . Activities . Expansion .
description_long: Reinhar IX Reinhar IX , also known as Reinhar the Foolish , was the king of the arkaiun in Dambrath in 802 DR . Activities . Expansion . Under the reign of King Reinhar IX , the arkaiun of Dambrath descended into a slovenly bunch . Despite the less than ideal state of his kingdom , Reinhar IX insisted on expanding the borders of Dambrath . Encountering the Enemy . Reinhar IX began his plan by sending mining expeditions for silver and electrum to the Gnollwatch Mountains . The minders encountered drow from the city of T ' lindhet within the mountains . The outraged drow raided and attacked arkaiun strongholds throughout the region , destroying entire villages under the cover of darkness . War with the Drow . As a reprisal , Reinhar made the foolish decision to counter - attack the drow at T ' lindhet . While succeeding in getting into the city , the arkaiun ultimately failed because their act of retaliation actually united the otherwise spiteful drow , unleashing the full might of an entire city of drow . Reinhar ' s force was decimated . The enraged drow demanded the enslavement of the entire nation of Dambrath .

title: Reitheillaethor
description: Reitheillaethor Reitheillaethor or Rheitheillaethor ( " rye " - thigh - " way " - eh - thor ) was a wood elf village of 640 in the High Forest , on the banks of the Heartblood River . History . In 1374 DR it was ruled by Lady Morgwais .
description_long: Reitheillaethor Reitheillaethor or Rheitheillaethor ( " rye " - thigh - " way " - eh - thor ) was a wood elf village of 640 in the High Forest , on the banks of the Heartblood River . History . In 1374 DR it was ruled by Lady Morgwais . On Ches 1 , 1374 DR , Rheitheillaethor was attacked by daemonfey and orc s under their control . They overwhelmed the defenses and drove out the guard . Structure .
