It consisted of numerous buildings and shelters on the forest floor , but most of the elves lived in the branches of the weirwood and shadowtop trees . The weirwoods were magically protected against fire . Inhabitants . The village ' s inhabitants continually changed as elves moved in and out from other areas of the forest . Patrols were maintained to watch over the eastern part of the forest and the Dire Wood to the south .

title: Rekx Tihler
description: Rekx Tihler Rekx Tihler was the Silhouette of Bounty Hunters for the Shadow Thieves in Riatavin around 1370 DR . Activities . In his role as Silhouette , Rekx was one of the guildmasters under Cloakmaster Kiirma Blackmane .
description_long: Rekx Tihler Rekx Tihler was the Silhouette of Bounty Hunters for the Shadow Thieves in Riatavin around 1370 DR . Activities . In his role as Silhouette , Rekx was one of the guildmasters under Cloakmaster Kiirma Blackmane . Rekx planned to assassinate Lord Zelphar Thann in order to advance his position in the guild . Kiirma , however , was against this plan , unless Rekx find a way to disguise the assassination as an accident or illness or anything but an assassination , because such a high - profile action would cause too much trouble . Rekx continued to develop his plot , despite warnings and even threats from Kiirma . Recently , Kiirma considered removing one of Rekx ' s feet until he submitted to her .

title: Reland Tymin
description: Reland Tymin Reland Tymin was a lord in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Reland ruled the city of Timindar .
description_long: Reland Tymin Reland Tymin was a lord in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Reland ruled the city of Timindar . History . Reland in youth was a fierce warrior . He was choose as lord in 1340 DR after the killing of his brother the previous lord . . He in 1358 was killed by Durissa Thornion ' s agents . Personality . Reland was a somber man with a serious approach to governing . In time he had became lame . However he was a fair ruler Relationship . Reland was a good friend of Morissa Thornion .

title: Reldyk Applecrown
description: Reldyk Applecrown Reldyk Applecrown was a minor War Wizard of Cormyr . History . Often he acted as bodyguard for the old Lady Darlethra Greatgaunt , who always requested a young handsome man for her protection in Suzail .
description_long: Reldyk Applecrown Reldyk Applecrown was a minor War Wizard of Cormyr . History . Often he acted as bodyguard for the old Lady Darlethra Greatgaunt , who always requested a young handsome man for her protection in Suzail . Around 1479 DR , the young Reldyk was one of the many War Wizards at the battle at the house of Larak Dardulkyn . Healed of his wounds , Elminster Aumar possessed his body in order to speak with Vangerdahast Aeiulvana . El used the body of Applecrown until 1480 when Manshoon , instead of work with him as ordered by Mystra , destroyed Applecrown , hoping to kill also Elminster .

title: Relgadrar Loroun
description: Relgadrar Loroun Relgadrar Loroun was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Loroun noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon tried to enslave his mind and , despite Relgadrar having powerful magic in his defense , Manshoon managed at last to enslave him .
description_long: Relgadrar Loroun Relgadrar Loroun was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Loroun noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon tried to enslave his mind and , despite Relgadrar having powerful magic in his defense , Manshoon managed at last to enslave him . Relationships . Relgadrar considered Melder Crownrood one of his greatest rivals .

title: Reliath Crescentia
description: Reliath Crescentia Reliath Crescentia was a female wood elf lurk and a young member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . In the mid - 1370s DR , Reliath robbed the Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai of a number of powerful psionic item s . The theft triggered huge debates among the remaining members , which came to focus on the future of the Kaliesh ' erai and led to a schism between older conservative and younger expansionist elements .
description_long: Reliath Crescentia Reliath Crescentia was a female wood elf lurk and a young member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . In the mid - 1370s DR , Reliath robbed the Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai of a number of powerful psionic item s . The theft triggered huge debates among the remaining members , which came to focus on the future of the Kaliesh ' erai and led to a schism between older conservative and younger expansionist elements .

title: Relics of the Righteous
description: Relics of the Righteous Relics of the Righteous was a book written by Thontoros the Learned , the Sage of the Just Gods . Amongst other things , it detailed the enchantment of the magical sword " Dornavver " at Allyn ' s Anvil in Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR .
description_long: Relics of the Righteous Relics of the Righteous was a book written by Thontoros the Learned , the Sage of the Just Gods . Amongst other things , it detailed the enchantment of the magical sword " Dornavver " at Allyn ' s Anvil in Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR .

title: Relirva Indagley ' Belash
description: Relirva Indagley ' Belash Relirva Indagley ' Belash was a scout and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz of Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . History . Relirva was a commoner and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz , trained as a scout .
description_long: Relirva Indagley ' Belash Relirva Indagley ' Belash was a scout and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz of Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . History . Relirva was a commoner and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz , trained as a scout . Serving under the weapon master Durdyn Teh ' kinrellz , she had the opportunity to study the chitine and choldrith of Yathchol and wrote a series of notes about their society and physiology . The Teh ' kinrellz nobles approved when her information indirectly resulted in the death of the secondboy of a rival house . As a reward , Relirva was allowed to also work as a sage of chitine lore . Activities . Relirva was employed by bored nobles who wanted to hunt chitine .

title: Relkath of the Infinite Branches
description: Relkath of the Infinite Branches Relkath of the Infinite Branches was a giant treant deity in the Yuir elven pantheon who was chaotic and unpredictable . Forests were said to sprout wherever he touched the ground . Whilst he was known to defend the Yuir elves , he also took action against some of them , turning priests into trees and villages into forests .
description_long: Relkath of the Infinite Branches Relkath of the Infinite Branches was a giant treant deity in the Yuir elven pantheon who was chaotic and unpredictable . Forests were said to sprout wherever he touched the ground . Whilst he was known to defend the Yuir elves , he also took action against some of them , turning priests into trees and villages into forests . There are some elves who believe that Relkath is merely an aspect of Rillifane Rallathil . Relkath , aspect or discrete entity , was thought to cease to exist with the downfall of the Yuir elves . As of the Post - Spellplague era , Relkath of the Infinite Branches is said to be an Archfey , at least by the fey of the Moonshae Isles .

title: Relmaur
description: Relmaur Relmaur , also known as the Barrier Realm , was a small kingdom of dragonborn located in the southern region of the Howling Mountains in Returned Abeir . Relmaur was located between Melabrauth and Skelkor , and somehow served as a buffer between the two dragon empires . Government .
description_long: Relmaur Relmaur , also known as the Barrier Realm , was a small kingdom of dragonborn located in the southern region of the Howling Mountains in Returned Abeir . Relmaur was located between Melabrauth and Skelkor , and somehow served as a buffer between the two dragon empires . Government . Relmaur was ruled by the High Crown , a title always given to a dragonborn member of Clan Urlingscar , the ruling dragonborn clan since the creation of the kingdom . However , as of 1479 DR , High Crown Harangor Urlingscar had created the Crown Council , as a means to allow all the prominent clans of Relamur — Clans Urlingscar , Belarrak , and Garandorn — to participate in the govern of the kingdom . Geography . Relmaur was located in the southern , warmer slopes of the Howling Mountains range , and thus was composed by mountains covered by thick conifer forests , as well as high valleys , cliffs , rugged ravines , and waterfalls . Those places were full of wild animals such as elk s , boar s , wolves , and more dangerous beasts . Most of the land was full of abandoned or semi - populated stone towers to give dragons wandering the mountains something to attack .

title: Reluhantis
description: Reluhantis Reluhantis was a marilith who was a personal attendant to the demon lord Graz ' zt . Personality . She was a cruel creature who ruled Graz ' zt ' s Argent Palace when he was away with an iron hand , along with her cohort , Unhath .
description_long: Reluhantis Reluhantis was a marilith who was a personal attendant to the demon lord Graz ' zt . Personality . She was a cruel creature who ruled Graz ' zt ' s Argent Palace when he was away with an iron hand , along with her cohort , Unhath .

title: Reluraun ' s Tomb
description: Reluraun ' s Tomb Reluraun ' s Tomb was a tomb in the Ardeep Forest as of 1370 DR . It was the final resting place of Reluraun , an elven warrior who was a hero to the elves . Reluraun ' s body was said to be clad in magic chain mail and lying with a magical " dragon slayer " sword .
description_long: Reluraun ' s Tomb Reluraun ' s Tomb was a tomb in the Ardeep Forest as of 1370 DR . It was the final resting place of Reluraun , an elven warrior who was a hero to the elves . Reluraun ' s body was said to be clad in magic chain mail and lying with a magical " dragon slayer " sword . Inhabitants . As of 1372 DR , Reluraun was a mad and aggressive flying pair of skeletal hands and eyeballs , attacking anyone who ventured too near . His tomb was guarded by three baelnorn s .

title: Remallia Haventree
description: Remallia Haventree Remallia Haventree was the Harper leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . She was also married to the Lords of Waterdeep Arthagast Ulbrinter . History .
description_long: Remallia Haventree Remallia Haventree was the Harper leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . She was also married to the Lords of Waterdeep Arthagast Ulbrinter . History . Remallia was a noble elf living in Waterdeep ; at one point entered in the Harpers and at other time she marry with the Masked Lord Arthagast Ulbrinter . During the Tyranny of Dragons Remallia ' s husband Arthagast was killed by local agents of the Cult of the Dragon ; she used all her strengths to unite all the Realms factions to contrast the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat and for this she was chosen to represent the Harpers at the Council on Waterdeep . Remallia personally was very proactive in fighting the Cult but need to be more cautious cause the weakened state of the Harpers , only recently truly reformed . Personality . Remallia was very quiet , speaking only after others have had their turns and interview only when she think the others need her advices and guidance . She truly believed in the Cult ' s dangers but understand the caution of her fellow Harpers . She valued very much the intelligence , doing all to achieve it .

title: Remarkus
description: Remarkus Remarkus was an insane lich in Myth Drannor in 1357 DR . Activities . Remarkus haunted a kind of war room with a map of Myth Drannor around 757 DR with pins indicating all the undead he controlled .
description_long: Remarkus Remarkus was an insane lich in Myth Drannor in 1357 DR . Activities . Remarkus haunted a kind of war room with a map of Myth Drannor around 757 DR with pins indicating all the undead he controlled . If someone entered he called an equal number of undead and observed the battle , not caring who was the winner .

title: Remnis
description: Remnis Remnis was the god of giant eagle s , a free lord of the sky who willingly rendered his service as a mount and helper to like - minded deities . He untiringly flew across the planes , observing everything with his keen vision , in search of secrets and prey worthy of his attention . He shared his knowledge and wisdom with the deserving .
description_long: Remnis Remnis was the god of giant eagle s , a free lord of the sky who willingly rendered his service as a mount and helper to like - minded deities . He untiringly flew across the planes , observing everything with his keen vision , in search of secrets and prey worthy of his attention . He shared his knowledge and wisdom with the deserving . Relationships . Remnis was on good terms with many neutral or good sky gods , as well as the Seldarine , but especially with Aerdrie Faenya and Syranita of the aarakocra . Worshipers . The intelligent and mighty giant eagles were Remnis ' people . Some of the aarakocra of the North also payed homage to the lord of eagles , as did some of the djinn of Zakhara ; he had a mosque at the djinn Capital , the Citadel of Ice and Steel .

title: Remorhaz
description: Remorhaz A remorhaz , also known as a polar worm , was a monstrous beast resembling a cross between a worm and a centipede . A remorhaz was a creature that thrived in cold environments , particularly arctic regions . Description .
description_long: Remorhaz A remorhaz , also known as a polar worm , was a monstrous beast resembling a cross between a worm and a centipede . A remorhaz was a creature that thrived in cold environments , particularly arctic regions . Description . A remorhaz had leathery tough wings ( which it could not use to fly ) , an insect - like head , and a 40 ft ( 12 m ) scaly body . It was ice - blue in color , had dozens of legs , and its back glowed red with an inner fire that could melt all but the strongest of metals . It had horns along its body and dagger - like teeth . It naturally had very high magic resistance . Combat . A remorhaz produced an incredible amount of heat , allowing it to take advantage of the vulnerability that many creatures in its native environment possessed . Its heat also allowed it to melt nonmagical weapons that struck its red - hot protrusions . A remorhaz liked to wait in ambush for its potential prey . When a living creature dew near , the remorhaz sprang from the ground and struck . It primarily used its teeth in combat , or swallowed its opponent whole and subjecting it to its gizzard and fiery insides . Ecology .

title: Remove affliction
description: Remove affliction Remove affliction , also called remove curse , allowed the caster to remove most curse s from objects or creatures . It could allow a creature to drop a magically cursed item , but would not remove a magically cursed weapon or piece of armor . The more powerful a caster became , the more types of curses could be removed by casting this spell .
description_long: Remove affliction Remove affliction , also called remove curse , allowed the caster to remove most curse s from objects or creatures . It could allow a creature to drop a magically cursed item , but would not remove a magically cursed weapon or piece of armor . The more powerful a caster became , the more types of curses could be removed by casting this spell . The " remove curse " spell was also used to counter and dispel " bestow curse " .

title: Remove blindness or deafness
description: Remove blindness or deafness Remove blindness or deafness was a conjuration spell similar to older cure blindness and cure blindness or deafness which were abjuration spells that could restore sight or hearing in some cases . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell .
description_long: Remove blindness or deafness Remove blindness or deafness was a conjuration spell similar to older cure blindness and cure blindness or deafness which were abjuration spells that could restore sight or hearing in some cases . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell . The conjuration version was the counterspell to " blindness or deafness " and completely restored sight or hearing lost by most magical or ordinary means . This version could heal damaged organs , but not regenerate missing ones . The older , abjuration version of this spell could not repair or regenerate organs damaged by injury or disease , but could restore sight or hearing that was temporarily overwhelmed or lost by the reverse of this spell , " cause blindness or deafness " . Another abjuration spell , called just " cure blindness " , was also reversible as " cause blindness " and was a precursor to the more modern versions . It could not affect the target ' s hearing . All versions of this spell required the caster to successfully touch the target while casting . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast all versions of this spell .

title: Remove curse
description: Remove curse Remove curse was an abjuration spell that could permanently eliminate all curses on an object or a creature , or in some instances , banish an evil presence . The reverse of this spell was " bestow curse " . Effects .
description_long: Remove curse Remove curse was an abjuration spell that could permanently eliminate all curses on an object or a creature , or in some instances , banish an evil presence . The reverse of this spell was " bestow curse " . Effects . The caster had to successfully touch the cursed creature or object to cast this spell . " Remove curse " was effective on most curses , but strong curses , like those on weapons and armor , were usually not permanently removed , just lifted long enough for the person afflicted with a cursed item to get rid of it . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell . Arcane History . The Netherese arcanist Enollar is given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 1561 DR .

title: Remove disease
description: Remove disease Remove disease was a conjuration spell that , on touch , magically removed any diseases and killed any parasites from which the subject is suffering . An older abjuration version called cure disease took longer to work . Effects .
description_long: Remove disease Remove disease was a conjuration spell that , on touch , magically removed any diseases and killed any parasites from which the subject is suffering . An older abjuration version called cure disease took longer to work . Effects . The caster had to touch the diseased creature to apply this spell . The newer version of this spell worked instantaneously while the old version , depending on the virulence of the disease and how long it had progressed , took anywhere from ten minutes to a tenday , but the patient felt better as the progression of the disease was rapidly reversed . These spells could cure most diseases but there were some more formidable examples that are not affected . Both versions did not grant any form of immunity , so the subject was still susceptible to reinfection upon further exposure . The abjuration version spell could also cause disease if cast in reverse upon a successful touch attack . The caster could choose either a debilitating disease ( within an hour , the victim began to lose strength until practically helpless ) , or a fatal one ( healing spells were no longer effective , death occurred in one to six months ) .

title: Remove fear
description: Remove fear Remove fear was an abjuration spell that increased the subject ' s courage and morale in the face of " fear " effects . The reverse of this spell , " cause fear " , could make one or more creatures flee in panic . Effects .
description_long: Remove fear Remove fear was an abjuration spell that increased the subject ' s courage and morale in the face of " fear " effects . The reverse of this spell , " cause fear " , could make one or more creatures flee in panic . Effects . The particulars of this spell changed over time : the earliest version required the caster to touch the intended recipient , whereas later versions had a range of 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) or more and could affect additional creatures if the caster had of sufficient experience . In all cases , the courage reinforcement lasted 10 minutes or until countered . If the subject was already under the influence of a " fear " effect , then this spell either suppressed the fear for the duration of the spell or gave the recipient a strong chance to shake off the fear entirely . If cast on multiple creatures , they all had to be within 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) of each other . When cast in reverse , " cause fear " assaulted the courage and wisdom of the target , likely forcing them to flee from the caster in panic for a short time . " Cause fear " dispelled " remove fear " and vice versa . The older version of this spell had no effect on the undead . Components .

title: Remove paralysis
description: Remove paralysis Remove paralysis was a conjuration or abjuration spell that could free a small number of creatures from a paralyzing effect . Effects . Paralyzing effects that could be removed by this spell included " slow " or " hold " spells , and ghoul touch .
description_long: Remove paralysis Remove paralysis was a conjuration or abjuration spell that could free a small number of creatures from a paralyzing effect . Effects . Paralyzing effects that could be removed by this spell included " slow " or " hold " spells , and ghoul touch . " Remove paralysis " could effect one to four creatures , which had to be in fairly close proximity ( no more than 30 ft / 9 . 1 m apart for the conjuration version ; inside a 20 ft / 6 . 1 m cube for the abjuration ) with no barrier between them and the caster . If three or four creatures were targeted , they each got another chance to resist the paralyzing effect . If two creatures were targeted , they both were twice as likely to resist being paralyzed . If only one creature was targeted , it was guaranteed to be released from paralyzation . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Ren
description: Ren Ren was a male human soldier of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the personal assassin of Commander Tyzack . History . Ren was a member of the Company of Scorpions and also Tyzack ' s personal assassin .
description_long: Ren Ren was a male human soldier of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the personal assassin of Commander Tyzack . History . Ren was a member of the Company of Scorpions and also Tyzack ' s personal assassin . His duty as assassin was usually to silence all members of the Company that discovered the captain ' s secret : in his youth , Tyzack has tried to rebel against the Zhentarim . All changed when , during the Time of Troubles , the Company of the Scorpions met the mortal Cyric . Soon , Cyric become the second - in - command of the company . All the previous bearers of the title had been killed by Ren for discovering the captain ' s secret . In the end , during a rain of metal blades — a manifestation of the crazy magic of that time — Tyzack died , probably killed by Ren , who considered Cyric a better commander . Ren later explained Tyzack ' s secret to Cyric , and the two mocked the dead captain for his stupidity .

title: Ren Ferkins
description: Ren Ferkins Ren Ferkins was the mayor of Dagger Falls around 1479 DR . Personality . Ren was a very patriotic man .
description_long: Ren Ferkins Ren Ferkins was the mayor of Dagger Falls around 1479 DR . Personality . Ren was a very patriotic man . History . In 1479 DR , after an increase in raids by gnoll s , he discussed with the constable the option of hiring a group of Zhent mercenaries to clear the area . Later , Ren assembled the Zhentarim commander and an adventuring party hired by Kendar Morn for a meeting to decide the best option .

title: Ren o ' the Blade
description: Ren o ' the Blade Ren o ' the Blade was a human ranger \ thief who worked at the Laughing Goblin Inn . History . Ren began his career as a ranger until he met the female thief Tempest in Waterdeep .
description_long: Ren o ' the Blade Ren o ' the Blade was a human ranger \ thief who worked at the Laughing Goblin Inn . History . Ren began his career as a ranger until he met the female thief Tempest in Waterdeep . She taught him the ways of a thief . During their adventurers Tempest stole for Ren two ioun stone s . This led to Tempest being killed by assassins under the command of Tyranthraxus . Swearing vengeance , Ren left Waterdeep . Ren , approximately thirty at the time , eventually found his way to Phlan , where he began working as a barkeep at the Laughing Goblin Inn . He met the apprentice wizard Shal Bal and Tyr ian cleric Tarl Desanea there , and after a tavern brawl the three were forced to team together on a mission to Sokol Keep . The three would continue to adventure together around Phlan until Tyranthraxus was brought to justice . After two of the Phlan missions made Ren angry seeing nature despoil , he returned to the ways of the ranger . Ren was attracted to Shal , but let Tarl attain her as Ren was afraid of how much of his attraction to her was due to her similarity with Tempest . Ten years later Ren had dreams of his friends and Phlan being in danger .

title: Renaer Neverember
description: Renaer Neverember Renaer Neverember was a noble and son of the Open Lord of Waterdeep , Dagult Neverember . History . Renaer was born to Dagult Neverember , who served as the Open Lord of Waterdeep .
description_long: Renaer Neverember Renaer Neverember was a noble and son of the Open Lord of Waterdeep , Dagult Neverember . History . Renaer was born to Dagult Neverember , who served as the Open Lord of Waterdeep . Renaer ' s mother died in his youth . Renaer began managing his family ' s extensive property holdings while his father spent time at the palace . In Nightal of 1479 DR , Renaer was confronted by Laraelra Harsard about suspicious happenings at a property owned by the Neverember family . When he entered the house with Laraelra and her bodyguard Meloon Wardragon to investigate , they were kicked out by Khondar Naomal , who was using the house with the permission of Dagult Neverember . Renaer and friends returned at night and found the Blackstaff ' s Heir Vajra Safahr , who had been imprisoned and tortured by Khondar beneath the house in a plot to seize control of the city . The group rescued Vajra fled with his companions through a " portal " in Neverember Manor to Varadras , disused estate outside Waterdeep . Khondar publicly accused Renaer of murdering Vajra .

title: Renal Bloodscalp
description: Renal Bloodscalp Renal Bloodscalp was the Silhouette of Burglars in Athkatla in 1370 . Description . Renal was a shady character who crouched more than he stood .
description_long: Renal Bloodscalp Renal Bloodscalp was the Silhouette of Burglars in Athkatla in 1370 . Description . Renal was a shady character who crouched more than he stood . He held an enchanted short sword as a weapon , one that he famously used if needed . He was also constantly surrounded by his bodyguards on the top floor of his headquarters . He wore black leather armor that was also enchanted . He constantly had a red hood pulled over his head . Personality . Renal , despite his high status , still liked to break into buildings . Sometimes , cleverly disguised , he led a team of thieves on certain jobs . He collected knives from the Old Empires and far - off lands . Renal greatly dislike spider s . He had a constant rivalry with Mae ' Var , another guildmaster . Abilities . Renal was a master thief with exceptional skills in breaking and entering . He possessed a knack for killing as well , and he was a top assassin within the thieves guild . His nickname was derived from his nasty habit of scalping his targets / enemies , typically leaving the scalp at the scene of the crime . History . In his headquarters , he hid Aran Linvail , the leader of the entire organization .

title: Rendaril
description: Rendaril Rendaril was a shopkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rendaril managed the Rendaril Emporium , the largest trade house of the city .
description_long: Rendaril Rendaril was a shopkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rendaril managed the Rendaril Emporium , the largest trade house of the city . Thank to Rendaril ability ' s learned in the markets of Waterdeep , he made huge business .

title: Render
description: Render A render is an unholy creature created by combining a summoned tanar ' ri with a human prisoner . The process was an accident ; while permitting the demon to kill the human for pleasure , the wizard miscast a spell from an unknown scroll , causing the creatures to fuse . The wizard creator died , and hundreds of others died as well before the beast escaped .
description_long: Render A render is an unholy creature created by combining a summoned tanar ' ri with a human prisoner . The process was an accident ; while permitting the demon to kill the human for pleasure , the wizard miscast a spell from an unknown scroll , causing the creatures to fuse . The wizard creator died , and hundreds of others died as well before the beast escaped . Due to its unnatural union , the render is in constant agony . History . The render was created in the experimental labs of Darkhold , and it escaped into the Far Hills to the south of the citadel , where the Zhentarim continue to hunt it . The Zhentarim are desperate to catch it , but all attempts thus far have resulted in failure , with those hunting down the beast often dying in the process . Physical description . The render stands nine feet tall . It is covered in deep black , short fur that covers its entire body ; the fur is matted down with a slimy mucous - like sweat . Its teeth and claws are between five and nine inches in length , and razor - sharp ; its claws are often caked with the remains of its last victim . Its eyes are amber - colored and luminescent . Ecology .

title: Rendeth of the Royal Blood
description: Rendeth of the Royal Blood Rendeth of the Royal Blood , or Rendath , was a human male of the Vast , and the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur . Description . Rendeth had the distinctive family resemblance of copper - colored hair , gray - green eyes , and a sharp chin .
description_long: Rendeth of the Royal Blood Rendeth of the Royal Blood , or Rendath , was a human male of the Vast , and the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur . Description . Rendeth had the distinctive family resemblance of copper - colored hair , gray - green eyes , and a sharp chin . He was a popular and energetic but level - headed young man . Skills . Rendeth had training as a warrior . History . By 1357 DR , Rendeth was Thultyrl of Procampur , the overlord of that city . However , the position of Hamayarch , his loyal mage - advisor , was held by Alamondh , in truth an evil mage named Carthoun Misintle who had desires on the throne . Alamondh plotted to kill Rendeth and take his place under a magical disguise , but was forced to wait until Rendeth produced an heir with the family ' s distinctive appearance . Despite the Thultyrl ' s traditional vow of vengeance on pirates , Alamondh encouraged Rendeth to relax the city ' s stance on piracy , showing leniency and conciliation . A few pirates were even allowed to use Procampur ' s port , provided that their crimes were not too great and no Procampan captain accused them of anything .

title: Rending
description: Rending Rending was a divine spell specifically meant to destroy any kind of manufactured item or creature owned as property . It was granted by the Zakhara n goddess of the untamed wild , Ragarra . Effects .
description_long: Rending Rending was a divine spell specifically meant to destroy any kind of manufactured item or creature owned as property . It was granted by the Zakhara n goddess of the untamed wild , Ragarra . Effects . Any one mundane object created by labor or acquired by commerce was torn to pieces by unseen claws if affected by this spell . Magic items were sometimes affected , depending on their power and resistance . Living beings which were considered property , even slaves , suffered severe rending wounds from it , while free creatures were unaffected . Components . This spell required verbal and somatic component s only .

title: Rendril ' s Forge
description: Rendril ' s Forge Rendril ' s Forge was a metalworking smithy in the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was on Shards Street in the Adventurers ' District . Staff .
description_long: Rendril ' s Forge Rendril ' s Forge was a metalworking smithy in the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was on Shards Street in the Adventurers ' District . Staff . The business was owned by Opara Rendril , a master metal - smith who , in particular , crafted high - quality longsword s and helms , while her bracelets and belt - dagger s were famous around the Inner Sea .

title: Renegades
description: Renegades The Renegades were a mercenary company based in Chessenta . Organization . The company included 70 cavalry , 20 infantry , and 90 archers .
description_long: Renegades The Renegades were a mercenary company based in Chessenta . Organization . The company included 70 cavalry , 20 infantry , and 90 archers . There were also six scouts and ten mages . Tactics . In battle , the Renegades did anything to win . Normally mages and archers first softened the enemy , after which the infantry attacked and the cavalry made the final assault . Contracts . They accepted any kind of job . They were known to be ruthless and twisted the spirit of agreements with employers . They were on good terms with several pirate bands . They normally charged 200 gold piece s per week for their services . History . Around 1358 DR , the Renegades were a military unit from the city of Akanax , the town of soldiers . Desiring gold and glory , they deserted , led by the famous fighter Helyos .

title: Renfod
description: Renfod Renfod was a cleric and a Loremaster Accordant of the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He had short , graying black hair and dark ebony skin .
description_long: Renfod Renfod was a cleric and a Loremaster Accordant of the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He had short , graying black hair and dark ebony skin . He had cataracts that dulled his brown eyes . He wore pale blue robes . History . In 1479 DR , he was assistant to Accordant Vraith .

title: Renin
description: Renin Renin was a drow from Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons , Renin was one of the drow that needed to meet the smuggler Arrizz in order to receive the shipment of supplies procured by Arrizz .
description_long: Renin Renin was a drow from Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons , Renin was one of the drow that needed to meet the smuggler Arrizz in order to receive the shipment of supplies procured by Arrizz . However , at the meeting point , an abandoned shrine to Blibdoolpoolp near the Waydown , he and his fellows were attacked by mad kuo - toa worshipers of the cambion siblings Gattash and Rashara . Renin and three other drow were captured in order to use them as sacrifices .

title: Renn min Zann
description: Renn min Zann Imam Renn min Zann was the highest representative of the assembled Enlightened faiths throughout all of Zakhara . His official title was " Keeper of the Mosques , " and he worked in golden Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description .
description_long: Renn min Zann Imam Renn min Zann was the highest representative of the assembled Enlightened faiths throughout all of Zakhara . His official title was " Keeper of the Mosques , " and he worked in golden Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . Renn min Zann was described as a silver - haired fixture of court life , owing to the longevity of his race . Despite being short of stature , his presence demanded respect . Personality . The imam was a very pragmatic man and gained a healthy reputation for his wisdom and ability to mediate between the moralist s , pragmatist s , and ethoist s . He was particularly adept at ensuring that no one religious faction gained power over the others , filling Huzuz with a level of religious harmony that was not present elsewhere in the Land of Fate . He spent equal time at the Golden Mosque , the Court of Enlightenment , and the Mosque of Zann the Wise in Huzuz . Possessions . Renn possessed an " aba of protection + 4 , ring of spell turning , ring of truth , rod of resurrection , gem of seeing , " and a " staff of devotion " . History .

title: Rensha
description: Rensha The Rensha family were a Calishite mercantile group that famously conquered much of the Delimbiyr Vale . History . Ibun Rensha led his family out of Calimshan at the head of a mercenary army to take over Loudwater in 1150 DR .
description_long: Rensha The Rensha family were a Calishite mercantile group that famously conquered much of the Delimbiyr Vale . History . Ibun Rensha led his family out of Calimshan at the head of a mercenary army to take over Loudwater in 1150 DR . The Renshas quickly moved to exploit the Delimbiyr Vale ' s rich , untapped natural resources for export . One of Ibun ' s first acts as Lord of Loudwater was to ban the ritual to select a new Green Regent every Shieldmeet , naturally seeing a protector of the landscape as a threat to his family ' s prosperity , and hunted down the incumbent Regent . Five more generations of Renshas ruled over the region before the War of the Returned Regent drove them out . Although the Renshas were banned from Loudwater , the family survived in Calimshan and in 1373 DR , Sanaja Rensha aided a failed Zhentarim plot to conquer the city .

title: Rensharra Ironstave
description: Rensharra Ironstave Rensharra Ironstave was an official of Cormyr . Activities . Rensharra ' s duty was to collect income tax .
description_long: Rensharra Ironstave Rensharra Ironstave was an official of Cormyr . Activities . Rensharra ' s duty was to collect income tax . History . In 1480 DR , the Lords ' council gathered by Melder Crownrood under the orders of Manshoon designated Rensharra as a target for elimination . Later Mirt approached her in a trendy dining establishment in Suzail and so discreetly saved her from some assassins . Some time after she confronted Lady Jalassra Dawningdown about the tax income she need pay to the King . Believing herself offended by Rensharra ' s attitude lady Dawningdown later sent four men to beaten her . Mirt however saved her again but soon asked help and protection to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn of Immerford . Personality . Rensharra was a very diligent and paranoid individual , truly honest at heart .

title: Renwick Caradoon
description: Renwick Caradoon Renwick " Snowcloak " Caradoon was the eldest of the three brothers whose exploits led to the creation of the Knights of Samular ( along with Samular Caradoon and Amphail the Just ) . Renwick eventually died in the last battle of the Second Troll War , only to return as an archlich . Life after undeath .
description_long: Renwick Caradoon Renwick " Snowcloak " Caradoon was the eldest of the three brothers whose exploits led to the creation of the Knights of Samular ( along with Samular Caradoon and Amphail the Just ) . Renwick eventually died in the last battle of the Second Troll War , only to return as an archlich . Life after undeath . Since his descent into undeath , Renwick has sought both the Rings of Samular and the Fernisbane . Although he reunited the rings at one point , all the items were hid from him by his descendant Bronwyn . The rings were split up among the Knights of the Samular , the church of Cyric and the Harpers , with the Fenrisbane currently being hid at Blackstaff Tower . In 1491 DR was discovered that his resting place was the Sacred Stone Monastery ; however the monastery was occupied by Cult of the Black Earth . The cultists tried to recruit Renwick but with no success . He however not act against the cultist and they simply ignored him . Possibly however Renwick agreed later to help some adventures that infiltrated the monastery in order to defeat the cultists .

title: Repair injury
description: Repair injury Repair injury was an improved version of " cure moderate wounds " that also alleviated one specific debilitating injury . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject of this spell in order to apply the healing energies .
description_long: Repair injury Repair injury was an improved version of " cure moderate wounds " that also alleviated one specific debilitating injury . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject of this spell in order to apply the healing energies . This spell improved the health of the recipient the same amount as the necromantic version of " cure moderate wounds " and also repaired one wound of a critical or impairing nature . Examples of injuries alleviated by this spell included a broken bone , sprained wrist , twisted ankle , severed tendon , a marled eye , or a mangled ear . Injuries of a more severe nature , such as a crushed pelvis or a shattered bone or joint could be improved by this spell , but not fully cured . A shattered bone would become merely broken , thus removing the life - threatening or maiming aspect of the severe injury but still requiring a long recuperative period . This spell could not restore severed limbs or completely destroyed body parts . Only one application of this spell could be used per injury . Further attempts were equivalent to " cure moderate wounds " . Components . Verbal and somatic components were all that were required to cast this spell .

title: Repel metal or stone
description: Repel metal or stone Repel metal or stone is an abjuration spell that pushes away stone and metal . Effect . Like " repel wood " , this spell creates waves of invisible and intangible energy that roll forth from you .
description_long: Repel metal or stone Repel metal or stone is an abjuration spell that pushes away stone and metal . Effect . Like " repel wood " , this spell creates waves of invisible and intangible energy that roll forth from you . All metal or stone objects in the path of the spell are pushed away from you to the limit of the range . Fixed metal or stone objects larger than 3 inches in diameter and loose objects weighing more than 500 pounds are not affected . Anything else , including animated objects , small boulders , and creatures in metal armor , moves back . Fixed objects 3 inches in diameter or smaller bend or break , and the pieces move with the wave of energy . Objects affected by the spell are repelled at the rate of 40 feet per round . Objects such as metal armor , swords , etc . are pushed back , dragging their bearers with them . Even magic items with metal components are repelled , although an " antimagic field " blocks the effects . The waves of energy continue to sweep down the set path for the spell ' s duration . After casting the spell , the path is set , and you can then do other things or go elsewhere without affecting the spell ' s power .

title: Repel undead
description: Repel undead Repel undead was a necromantic abjuration spell used to drive undead creatures away from the caster . Effects . This spell created a powerful compulsion within undead creatures , prompting them to avoid the caster .
description_long: Repel undead Repel undead was a necromantic abjuration spell used to drive undead creatures away from the caster . Effects . This spell created a powerful compulsion within undead creatures , prompting them to avoid the caster . If any kind of physical barrier prevented the undead from doing this then they simply kept as much distance between them and the caster as possible . This spell was centered on the caster and moved about with them . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components this spell required a magnet with a drop of the caster ' s blood placed at one end and a bone fragment placed at the other . .

title: Repel vermin
description: Repel vermin Repel vermin , and another version called repel insects , were abjuration spells that created an invisible barrier to keep out unwanted pests . Effects . The area of effect for these spells was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius around the spellcaster .
description_long: Repel vermin Repel vermin , and another version called repel insects , were abjuration spells that created an invisible barrier to keep out unwanted pests . Effects . The area of effect for these spells was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius around the spellcaster . The older version of this spell was only effective against normal - and giant - sized true insects , not arachnids like spiders and scorpions . The newer version worked on all manner of vermin . These spells were proof against all normal pests and some giant versions , but large , determined creatures could breach the barrier , taking damage as they crossed into the protected area . Components . The newer version of this spell required verbal and somatic components as well as the caster ' s divine focus or holy symbol . The older version required one of the following : crushed marigold flowers , a crushed leek , crushed stinging nettle leaves , or a small blob of camphor tree resin .

title: Repel wood
description: Repel wood Repel wood , also known as turn wood was a transmutation or alteration spell that pushed wooden objects in a given direction . Effects . This spell caused waves of wood - repelling force to emanate from the spot where the spell was cast , in the direction the caster was facing .
description_long: Repel wood Repel wood , also known as turn wood was a transmutation or alteration spell that pushed wooden objects in a given direction . Effects . This spell caused waves of wood - repelling force to emanate from the spot where the spell was cast , in the direction the caster was facing . Once cast , the druid could move away and do other things while antiwood force flowed on . All wooden objects 3 in ( 7 . 6 cm ) in diameter or smaller were inexorably pushed away at the speed of a brisk walk . Securely fastened wooden objects cracked , splintered , and broke , becoming missiles that joined the stream . Stout objects ( more than 3 in / 7 . 6 cm in diameter ) that were securely fastened to something immobile could withstand " repel wood " , but wooden armor , shields , spears , hafts , staves , bows , arrows , crossbows , siege engines on wheels , furniture , etc . were forced along the path , taking with them anyone managing to hold on . Magical items with wooden components were repelled also , but a successful " dispel magic " or an " antimagic field " were proof against this spell . " Repel wood " lasted for a few minutes ; longer for more experienced druids .

title: Repo La
description: Repo La Repo La , or Broken Wall Pass , was a mountain pass located in eastern Khazari . Geography . Repo La was the only accessible route passing through eastern Khazari and the end of the Katakoro Shan range .
description_long: Repo La Repo La , or Broken Wall Pass , was a mountain pass located in eastern Khazari . Geography . Repo La was the only accessible route passing through eastern Khazari and the end of the Katakoro Shan range . The pass ran between the peaks of Ahs Trango Shan and Nas Trango Shan .

title: Repose domain
description: Repose domain The Repose domain was a deity domain similar to the Death domain . It existed for those good - aligned deities who could not give their cleric s access to evil spells . Once a day , the spellcaster could kill a target instantly with but a touch , though the difficulty was affected by both the skill of the user and the strength of the target .
description_long: Repose domain The Repose domain was a deity domain similar to the Death domain . It existed for those good - aligned deities who could not give their cleric s access to evil spells . Once a day , the spellcaster could kill a target instantly with but a touch , though the difficulty was affected by both the skill of the user and the strength of the target . Deities with the Repose domain . Four gods offered the Repose domain , all of them related to death in some respect :

title: Reptilla Half - elven
description: Reptilla Half - elven Reptilla Half - elven was a half - elf woman who dwelt in the Dragonspine Mountains in the early 1360s DR . Skills . She was a highly dexterous mage , and skilled in making poisons .
description_long: Reptilla Half - elven Reptilla Half - elven was a half - elf woman who dwelt in the Dragonspine Mountains in the early 1360s DR . Skills . She was a highly dexterous mage , and skilled in making poisons . She modified her magical " curdled death " oil to incapacitate rather than kill , and to evaporate into a breathable substance when exposed to high temperatures . Activities . Reptilla and her small dragon familiar , Thsst , dwelt in a cave on the sunnier side of the Dragonspine Mountains . From here , they ambushed animals and lone travelers and used them for Reptilla ' s experiments with poison s . She daubed her " curdled death " on rock faces along mountain paths around her lair . As the stone warmed under the daylight sun , the " curdled death " activated and knocked out passers - by , so she could take her victims alive . Possessions . Reptilla owned a " Staff of Serpents " , " bracers of defense " , a " cloak of displacement " , as well as a vial of " curdled death " . History . She lost her " Staff of Serpents " in the lair of a bronze dragon .

title: Repulsion
description: Repulsion Repulsion is an abjuration spell that prevents creatures from approaching the caster . It is a common spell in the Realms . Effects .
description_long: Repulsion Repulsion is an abjuration spell that prevents creatures from approaching the caster . It is a common spell in the Realms . Effects . An invisible , mobile field surrounds you and prevents creatures from approaching you . You decide how big the field is at the time of casting . Creatures within or entering the field maybe unable to move toward you for the duration of the spell . Repelled creatures actions are not otherwise restricted . They can fight other creatures and can cast spells and attack you with ranged weapons . If you move closer to an affected creature , nothing happens . ( The creature is not forced back . ) The creature is free to make melee attacks against you if you come within reach . If a repelled creature moves away from you and then tries to turn back toward you , it cannot move any closer if it is still within the spell ' s area . Material components . A pair of small iron bars attached to two small canine statuettes , one black and one white . History . The Netherese arcanist Prug is given the credit for the creation of this spell in - 1815 DR .

title: Rerk
description: Rerk Rerk was a farmer in the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , he and five other men went inside the forest to recover Halvin Graingle before he disturbed the fey s .
description_long: Rerk Rerk was a farmer in the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , he and five other men went inside the forest to recover Halvin Graingle before he disturbed the fey s . However , they were too late because the hag Jeny Greenteeth had killed him . Rerk and his fellows found their way to the hag . Some days later , only Rerk exited the forest , having suffered terrible tortures . An adventuring party that happened to be there tried to save Rerk . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Rerk ' s injuries were terrible and there was little chance that the players could save him .

title: Resar
description: Resar Resar was a wizard from Halruaa who traveled to Baldur ' s Gate to find and recover a crashed Halruaan Skyship . For this objective , he recruited Gorion ' s Ward , but when Gorion ' s Ward finished the task , Resar tried to kill him to silence all witnesses of Halruaan secrets .
description_long: Resar Resar was a wizard from Halruaa who traveled to Baldur ' s Gate to find and recover a crashed Halruaan Skyship . For this objective , he recruited Gorion ' s Ward , but when Gorion ' s Ward finished the task , Resar tried to kill him to silence all witnesses of Halruaan secrets .

title: Resist acid and corrosion
description: Resist acid and corrosion Resist acid and corrosion was an abjuration spell that improved the subject ' s defense against caustic substances for a few minutes . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject in order to bestow this protection .
description_long: Resist acid and corrosion Resist acid and corrosion was an abjuration spell that improved the subject ' s defense against caustic substances for a few minutes . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject in order to bestow this protection . This spell made the subject immune to mild acids and more resistant to strong acids and corrosive substances such as the excretions of ooze es , slime s , jellies , and pudding s , " Melf ' s acid arrow s " , and black dragon breath . If exposed to a strong corrosive agent , the subject took only half the usual amount of damage and this spell gave the subject an increased chance to resist the attack , further reducing the damage to one = quarter the normal amount . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Resist energy
description: Resist energy Resist energy was an abjuration spell that absorbed a small amount of damage from one energy type ( acid , cold , electricity , fire , or sonic ) at the choice of the caster . Effects . The caster could protect one creature from one type of damage ( either natural or magical in nature ) per casting of this spell .
description_long: Resist energy Resist energy was an abjuration spell that absorbed a small amount of damage from one energy type ( acid , cold , electricity , fire , or sonic ) at the choice of the caster . Effects . The caster could protect one creature from one type of damage ( either natural or magical in nature ) per casting of this spell . All clothing and equipment worn or carried by the recipient were also protected . Higher level casters could double or even triple the damage absorption afforded by this spell . If the protected creature was exposed to damage from the chosen energy type , a modest amount was absorbed for each separate exposure while the spell remained in effect . Any damage over the absorption limit was felt by the recipient . Note that this spell did not grant immunity from secondary effects , such as the lack of oxygen if immersed in acid or encased in ice . " Resist energy " was a lesser form of " protection from energy " and the two spells did not stack . That is , if both spells were cast on the same creature with the same chosen energy type , the greater " protection from energy " would operate until discharged and only then would " resist energy " begin to work .

title: Resist fire or cold
description: Resist fire or cold Resist fire / resist cold was an alteration spell that granted immunity from normal heat and cold to the subject and improved defenses against intense or magical heat and cold . This spell was the combination of the older resist cold and resist fire spells , allowing the caster to choose the form of protection at the time of casting . Effects .
description_long: Resist fire or cold Resist fire / resist cold was an alteration spell that granted immunity from normal heat and cold to the subject and improved defenses against intense or magical heat and cold . This spell was the combination of the older resist cold and resist fire spells , allowing the caster to choose the form of protection at the time of casting . Effects . The caster was required to touch the recipient in order to bestow this protection . This spell made the subject immune to normal cold temperatures ( experiencing no discomfort standing naked on a glacier , for example ) , or normal fire ( experiencing no discomfort holding a finger in a candle flame , for example ) , as chosen by the caster . If exposed to more intense heat or cold , such as being engulfed in burning oil , hit by a flaming or frostbrand sword , caught in an ice storm , splashed by lava , being on the receiving end of a " fireball " or " cone of cold " , or being blasted by white or red dragon breath , then the subject took only half the usual amount of damage and this spell gave the subject a greatly increased chance to resist such attacks , further reducing the damage to one quarter the normal amount .

title: Respected Mamluk Society
description: Respected Mamluk Society The Respected Mamluk Society , also known as the Respected , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This large mamluk organization had a long and proud history of serving Muluk , the City of Kings .
description_long: Respected Mamluk Society The Respected Mamluk Society , also known as the Respected , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This large mamluk organization had a long and proud history of serving Muluk , the City of Kings . They were bitter rivals with some of the mamluk organizations from Qudra , including the Dutiful Mamluk Society . Organization . The Respected were led by General Oman Abd al - Hazim Base of Operations . The Respected operated out of Muluk in north Zakhara . They had a presence in all of the Free Cities of Zakhara .

title: Ressa
description: Ressa Ressa was Hagen ' s daughter in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Ressa was a merchant and Hagen ' s daughter .
description_long: Ressa Ressa was Hagen ' s daughter in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Ressa was a merchant and Hagen ' s daughter . Ressa would greet the Kalach - Cha if the Kalach - Cha sided with the Watch . Like her father , she thought the Watch was ineffective , but would gain a better impression of them . Before thieves came , Hagen dismissed her , as she could have been captured .

title: Resting Place of the Whip
description: Resting Place of the Whip The Resting Place of the Whip was the local temple of Loviatar in Melvaunt . The temple had seventeen priest s , led by High Whipmistress Suzildara Sharranen . The temple was not particularly popular as worship of Loviatar decreased significantly as of recent times .
description_long: Resting Place of the Whip The Resting Place of the Whip was the local temple of Loviatar in Melvaunt . The temple had seventeen priest s , led by High Whipmistress Suzildara Sharranen . The temple was not particularly popular as worship of Loviatar decreased significantly as of recent times . The church remained in no small part to the alliance they formed with a local cult dedicated to Iyachtu Xvim .

title: Restoration
description: Restoration Restoration was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore a lost life energy level to a creature , remove fatigue , and remove temporary ability handicaps . The older necromantic versions of this spell could restore a lost level , cure insanity and were reversible , resulting in the spell energy drain which siphoned off one life energy level from a creature . Effects .
description_long: Restoration Restoration was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore a lost life energy level to a creature , remove fatigue , and remove temporary ability handicaps . The older necromantic versions of this spell could restore a lost level , cure insanity and were reversible , resulting in the spell energy drain which siphoned off one life energy level from a creature . Effects . The caster had to successfully touch the target of this spell . In order to restore a life energy level , the caster had to apply this spell no later than a number of days equal to his or her own level or else the loss was permanent . The necromantic versions of this spell cured all forms of insanity and negated spells like " feeblemind " that lowered intelligence , whereas the conjuration version returned all lost strength , constitution , dexterity , intelligence , wisdom , or charisma ( only one of these characteristics per casting of " restoration " ) and removed all fatigue and exhaustion , but did not cure insanity . ( See " greater restoration " . ) For the necromantic versions , upon " restoration " of an energy level , both the caster and the recipient were aged two years .

title: Restorers
description: Restorers The Restorers were an organization of desert giant s dedicated to reclaiming the city of Ubar , or Dayya from the terrible jann who occupied it . Activities . The Restorers did what they could to hamper the way of life for the jann inhabiting Ubar .
description_long: Restorers The Restorers were an organization of desert giant s dedicated to reclaiming the city of Ubar , or Dayya from the terrible jann who occupied it . Activities . The Restorers did what they could to hamper the way of life for the jann inhabiting Ubar . They often raided jann communities , poisoned their wells , and scattered their herds . They caused little relative harm to the jann of Dayya considering the population of the large city . Base of Operations . These giant s were active within the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert .

title: Resurrection ( novel )
description: Resurrection ( novel ) Resurrection by Paul S . Kemp is the sixth and final book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary .
description_long: Resurrection ( novel ) Resurrection by Paul S . Kemp is the sixth and final book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . In the new Demonweb Pits the story of Quenthel Baenre ' s group comes to a close as they trek across the barren plane to Lolth ' s temple to see who will became the new " Yor ' thae " ( the Chosen of Lolth ) Quenthel , her strength and faith apparently fully restored , continues to move towards Lolth , fully under the belief that she is the " Yor ' thae " . With her are Pharaun Mizzrym , Jeggred Baenre , and Danifae Yauntyrr . Jeggred is now fully devoted to Danifae , while Pharaun ' s allegiance leans towards Quenthel , though no trust is held between them . Meanwhile , Halisstra Melarn , having joined up with fellow priestesses of Eilistraee , Uluyara and Feliane , continues on her journey to kill Lolth , but determines that she must first kill the " Yor ' thae " . Halisstra believes that person to be Quenthel Baenre . Quenthel ' s and Halisstra ' s groups meet at the Pass of the Soulreaver , a mysterious place located by the Soulreaver beast and individual trials that the faithful must pass to reach Lolth .

title: Resurrection ( spell )
description: Resurrection ( spell ) Resurrection was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore life and full vigorous health to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , called destruction , and could turn a victim to dust . Effects .
description_long: Resurrection ( spell ) Resurrection was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore life and full vigorous health to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , called destruction , and could turn a victim to dust . Effects . The application of this spell was limited to creatures that had been dead for no longer than ten years per level of the caster . The creature could not be undead , a construct , an elemental , or an outsider . The oldest necromantic version of this spell was further restricted to only resurrect human s , half - elves , dwarves , gnome s , and halfling s . This spell did not work on creatures that died of old age but " did " work on creatures killed by a death effect . " Resurrection " required at least a piece of the deceased that was part of the body at the time of death ; even the remains of a " disintegrate d " victim were sufficient . The deceased had to have enough constitution ( at the time of death ) to survive the process , but the body was fully restored , poisons removed , and diseases cured by this spell . Even memorized spells were restored .

title: Rethnor
description: Rethnor Rethnor was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . Along with the others he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate . Rethnor ' s lead ship was the " Cutlass .
description_long: Rethnor Rethnor was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . Along with the others he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate . Rethnor ' s lead ship was the " Cutlass . " Description . Rethnor was a large , strong man with a long black beard , bushy eyebrows , and piercing blue eyes . He wielded a sword in his left hand and a dagger in his right . In 1361 DR , he lost his swordhand in a battle with Fyodor , but it was later restored by the drow priestess Shakti Hunzrin , who was able to command it . History . In 1361 DR , Rethnor was involved with the Kraken Society in a conspiracy to turn the Lords ' Alliance ( especially Waterdeep ) against Ruathym . The Kraken Society assigned him to ally with Shakti Hunzrin , a drow priestess searching for Liriel Baenre , who was journeying to Ruathym . The plot was discovered by the Ruathen with the help of the crew of the " Elfmaid " and Luskan ' s navy , led by Rethnor , was defeated . In 1376 DR , Rethnor died of old age ( although it is implied his son " helped " him along ) and was replaced as High Captain by his son , Kensidan the Crow . Relationships .

title: Retreat
description: Retreat The Retreat was the name given to the mass migration of elves from Faerûn to Evermeet . It was instigated by the Elven Court in 1344 DR . During the Retreat , over ninety percent of the elves in the forest of Cormanthor migrated to Evermeet or Evereska .
description_long: Retreat The Retreat was the name given to the mass migration of elves from Faerûn to Evermeet . It was instigated by the Elven Court in 1344 DR . During the Retreat , over ninety percent of the elves in the forest of Cormanthor migrated to Evermeet or Evereska . When the elves abandoned the forest , they left behind legions of green warder s , who continued to guard the burial sites and ancient groves that the elves had forsook . In the Year of Lightning Storms Cambrizym of Candlekeep wrote that the Retreat had come to an end , though not by official proclamation but rather through having reached its own tipping point , by which almost all who had meant to leave had already done so , leaving only a few lonely pilgrims to make the journey by themselves . Shortly thereafter , the Retreat began to reverse itself , with many from Evermeet returning to Faerûn ' s shores .

title: Retriever
description: Retriever A retriever is a mindless construct created by foul sorcery to be warriors and servants for more powerful demons of the Abyss . They specialize in retrieving lost or desired objects , runaway slaves , and enemies and bringing them back to its master . Appearance .
description_long: Retriever A retriever is a mindless construct created by foul sorcery to be warriors and servants for more powerful demons of the Abyss . They specialize in retrieving lost or desired objects , runaway slaves , and enemies and bringing them back to its master . Appearance . A retriever appears as a giant spider , that stands twice as tall as a human , with forelegs that end in large cleavers . Its body is about the size of an ox , and its four bulbous eyes gleam malevolently . These eyes are capable of producing magical ray attacks that deal fire , cold , electricity , and " petrification " to an enemy .

title: Retta Starling
description: Retta Starling Retta Starling was a female human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . She attended the Tourney of Talent during the Harvest Fair .
description_long: Retta Starling Retta Starling was a female human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . She attended the Tourney of Talent during the Harvest Fair . History . Originally from Neverwinter , Retta came to West Harbor , when she became a widow . Once Lorne lost to Cormick , she became more depressed , as she did not what became of him . Nevertheless , she continued her life with Bevil and other children . During the Harvest Fair , she attended the Tourney of Talent and would reward the winners with some scrolls . When the bladeling s and duergar attacked the village , she barricaded herself , waiting for the Kalach - Cha and Bevil to rescue her children . After the battle , she wanted to know what happened of Lorne . Once the Kalach - Cha defeated Lorne , Retta learned of his son ' s fate . After Ammon Jerro passed through the down , she died , but was revived as a shadow once the King of Shadows re - gained its power . She wanted to trick her youngest son to come with her , but was defeated by Kalach - Cha .

title: Return of the Archwizards
description: Return of the Archwizards The Return of the Archwizards is a trilogy of novels by Troy Denning centered around the elf Galaeron Nihmedu , an Evereskan Tomb Guard . The Summoning . Time Frame : 1371 DR - 1372 DR The floating city of Shade escaped the fall of the mighty Empire of Netheril .
description_long: Return of the Archwizards The Return of the Archwizards is a trilogy of novels by Troy Denning centered around the elf Galaeron Nihmedu , an Evereskan Tomb Guard . The Summoning . Time Frame : 1371 DR - 1372 DR The floating city of Shade escaped the fall of the mighty Empire of Netheril . The city and the powerful archwizards who rule it have been hiding in the frightening and mysterious demiplane of shadow for centuries . In The Summoning , the time has come for the floating city to return to the world of Faerûn and for the evil archwizards to begin an invasion that could enslave the free citizens of the Realms world ! The Siege . Time Frame : 1372 DR The world - spanning schemes of Shade begin to take shape , along with a new empire in the heart of the Great Desert . The second book highlights one of the most intriguing developments in the Forgotten Realms setting : the return of powerful and mysterious villains who will affect the entire balance of power on Toril . The Sorcerer . Time Frame : 1372 DR Tilverton is no more . Phaerimm surround Evereska . The High Ice is melting . Floods sweep through Anauroch . Elminster is still nowhere to be found .

title: Return to sand
description: Return to sand Return to sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused items made from metal , stone , or earth to crumple into sand .
description_long: Return to sand Return to sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused items made from metal , stone , or earth to crumple into sand . This spell targeted a single item or an entire area up to 5 ft . ( 1 . 5 m ) by 5 ft . by 1 foot ( 0 . 3 m ) . Items affected by this spell returned to their normal form after the spell ended . This spell had no effect on magical items or creatures made from stone or earth , such as golem s . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Returned Abeir
description: Returned Abeir Returned Abeir was the name the natives of Toril gave the large , horseshoe - shaped landmass , known to its inhabitants as Laerakond ( pronounced " L - AIR - ah - KON - d " ) , that appeared during the Spellplague . Located west of the Trackless Sea , replacing Maztica from its known spot . Geography .
description_long: Returned Abeir Returned Abeir was the name the natives of Toril gave the large , horseshoe - shaped landmass , known to its inhabitants as Laerakond ( pronounced " L - AIR - ah - KON - d " ) , that appeared during the Spellplague . Located west of the Trackless Sea , replacing Maztica from its known spot . Geography . As of 1479 DR , Returned Abeir was divided into roughly eight regions or kingdoms . The continent was composed of mountain ranges on three sides , surrounding the great bay of the Dragon Sea . The entire continent was covered by arambar , that caused the sky to be silver - colored . This phenomenon was called the " Steelsky " . The Dusk Ports . The Dusk Ports were ostensibly a collection of free trade cities on the western shores of the Dragon Sea . In reality , they were vassal states to the green dragon Orlarrakh . Each port vied with each other for favored status with " The Green Duchess " but all followed her orders . The five Dusk Ports were : Eskorn .

title: Returning
description: Returning Returning was a quality that could be applied to weapons that could be thrown . A weapons with this property would return to the one who ' d thrown it . Creation .
description_long: Returning Returning was a quality that could be applied to weapons that could be thrown . A weapons with this property would return to the one who ' d thrown it . Creation . To craft a " returning " weapon , a spellcaster had to have " telekinesis " available .

title: Reulek
description: Reulek Reulek was a duergar ghost at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . In life , Reulek had a partnership of convenience with an oni called Obratu .
description_long: Reulek Reulek was a duergar ghost at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . In life , Reulek had a partnership of convenience with an oni called Obratu . History . Reulek descended into the Fane with an intent to recover the treasures of Besilmer . After he stole a helm from the king ' s tomb , he was ambushed and killed by four drow ghosts and rose again as a ghost himself . In 1491 DR , some adventurers infiltrated the Fane and were confronted by Reulek ' s ghost . During the encounter , Reulek was ultimately destroyed .

title: Reveal invisible
description: Reveal invisible Reveal invisibile was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible sphere that revealed any invisible creatures and objects located within its range .
description_long: Reveal invisible Reveal invisibile was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible sphere that revealed any invisible creatures and objects located within its range . This worked for natural and magical invisibility . The sphere did not detect planar creatures out of phase or displaced creatures . The caster could center the sphere on themselves or move it around . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Reveal magic
description: Reveal magic Reveal magic makes the hidden auras of magic visible , much like the spell " detect magic " . Unlike " detect magic " , this spell causes all magic in the effected area to glow for all to see , not just the caster . Reveal magic is an uncommon spell in the Realms .
description_long: Reveal magic Reveal magic makes the hidden auras of magic visible , much like the spell " detect magic " . Unlike " detect magic " , this spell causes all magic in the effected area to glow for all to see , not just the caster . Reveal magic is an uncommon spell in the Realms . Effect . When cast over an area , this spell causes all magical radiations to glow with a bright light about equal to torch light . The caster can effect a radius of several feet around them , depending on their skill level with magic . Intensity and type of magic cannot be determined . History . Dagsumn of Waterdeep created the most common version of this spell . Dagsumn sold the spell to the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors for guild membership and a large amount of gold . Dagsumn would freely sell a copy of the spell to anyone for five hundred gold coins . Realmslore . " Reveal magic " is known to the drow , though the drow version requires the material component of a pinch of yellow powder . " Reveal magic " is known to the elves and requires a somatic component of a small , subtle hand gesture or a flick of the caster ' s fingers . A soft , blue glow will then show any magic at work .

title: Revelations of the Icedawn
description: Revelations of the Icedawn Revelations of the Icedawn was a holy book of Auril containing some of the most prized prayers of the Frostmaiden ' s faith . Description . The book had pages that looked and felt as if they were made of blue ice .
description_long: Revelations of the Icedawn Revelations of the Icedawn was a holy book of Auril containing some of the most prized prayers of the Frostmaiden ' s faith . Description . The book had pages that looked and felt as if they were made of blue ice . History . A gift from Auril to Iyraclea with which she was supposed to herald a particularly cold winter , the book was taken by an unidentified man who then fled to Icewind Dale . He was chased by a pair of gelugon s who mortally wounded him in a Ten Towns marketplace and retrieved the book . The man ' s final words were carried south as far as Waterdeep . Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun sent several Moonstars to investigate and possibly recover the book . Their bodies were eventually located , frozen quite literally to the core , and the book was lost . Contents . The book contained prayers that granted appropriately devout supplicants the spells :

title: Revenance
description: Revenance Revenance was a necromancy spell that boosted the fortitude of one or more undead creatures , making them immune to one successful " turning " . An older version of this spell granted immunity for as many turning attempts as the caster had levels . Effects .
description_long: Revenance Revenance was a necromancy spell that boosted the fortitude of one or more undead creatures , making them immune to one successful " turning " . An older version of this spell granted immunity for as many turning attempts as the caster had levels . Effects . The two versions of this spell were quite different in effectiveness . Both protected undead creatures from what would normally be a successful turning by a cleric , paladin , or other holy person able to turn undead , but the older spell did so for as many attempts as the caster had levels , the newer spell only once . The older spell could be cast in much less than a minute and the caster had two minutes to touch each undead recipient , whereas the newer spell took 10 minutes to cast , during which the targets to be touched had to be within a 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) radius . A novice necromancer able to cast this spell could grant immunity to 5 undead creatures . More experienced necromancers could effect greater numbers . " Revenance " did not grant immunity to magic items that affected undead , such as a " mace of disruption " .

title: Revenant
description: Revenant Revenants were undead creatures that would rise from the dead to hunt down and slay their killers with an unwavering zeal . Description . Appearing as decayed and emaciated versions of their once - living selves , revenants typically had open festering wounds and drawn , clammy skin covering their flesh .
description_long: Revenant Revenants were undead creatures that would rise from the dead to hunt down and slay their killers with an unwavering zeal . Description .
