Appearing as decayed and emaciated versions of their once - living selves , revenants typically had open festering wounds and drawn , clammy skin covering their flesh . Ordinarily , revenants had lifeless eyes but when faced with their murderers their eyes would flare with an unnatural light . A revenant possessed greater physical strength and a stronger force of personality than they did in life . Along with the usual differences between the undead and the living , revenants were also impervious to the effects of acid , gases , cold , electricity and polymorph ing . Accompanied by their resistance to non - magic al weapons , this all made revenants particularly tough physically . The " lifespan " of a revenant lasted only until they slayed their killer or killers , or about half a year , whichever came first . After succeeding in its mission of revenge , the revenant crumbled to dust . As long as its task remained unfinished , the revenant slowly decayed and would finally fall apart after about six months .

title: Reverie
description: Reverie Reverie was the elven state of meditation , which had certain sleep - like effects . During the meditation , sometimes referred to as a " trance , " the elf conducted a series of mental exercises that refreshed the elf ' s body and mind . During this meditation an elf was fully aware of the outside world , though breaking meditation in response to external events had an effect on the elf similar to disturbing the sleep of any other humanoid .
description_long: Reverie Reverie was the elven state of meditation , which had certain sleep - like effects . During the meditation , sometimes referred to as a " trance , " the elf conducted a series of mental exercises that refreshed the elf ' s body and mind . During this meditation an elf was fully aware of the outside world , though breaking meditation in response to external events had an effect on the elf similar to disturbing the sleep of any other humanoid . Elves did not actually require sleep as such , but rested in reverie for generally half as much time as the other humanoids slept . Elves were capable of sleep , but only when they were severely ill or wounded .

title: Revil Slombarr
description: Revil Slombarr Revil Slombarr was a heavyset young mage and a member of the Harpers in Loudwater sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Revil lived in the Smiling Satyr tavern , run by a Harper sympathizer .
description_long: Revil Slombarr Revil Slombarr was a heavyset young mage and a member of the Harpers in Loudwater sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Revil lived in the Smiling Satyr tavern , run by a Harper sympathizer . His duty was to protect one of " teleportation circle s " of Krowen Valharrow ' s network but often he was out visiting festhalls .

title: Revjak
description: Revjak Revjak was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Revjak was always in control of his emotions .
description_long: Revjak Revjak was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Revjak was always in control of his emotions . He had a secret desire to experience " civilized life " in the cities of the Sword Coast . History . After the death of Heafstaag at the hands of Wulfgar in 1356 DR , Revjak became king of the tribe and was the one to unify the nomadic Reghedman tribes and strengthen their relationships with the people of the Ten Towns . In 1364 DR , Berkthgar challenged Revjak for the kingship of the Tribe of the Elk and won , thus ending an era of cooperation between the barbarians and the Ten Towns . Relationships . Revjak was the son of Jorn the Red . In 1347 DR , Revjak ' s son Kierstaad was born . Like his father , he embraced " civilized ways . " He later became king of the Tribe of the Elk until his death . He was friends with Wulfgar ' s father , Beornegar .

title: Revlopar
description: Revlopar Revlopar was a young mutant ixzan prodigy and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Revlopar secretly wanted to explore the Realms Above in hopes of learning new spells and magic , but until then he waited while his power grew .
description_long: Revlopar Revlopar was a young mutant ixzan prodigy and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Revlopar secretly wanted to explore the Realms Above in hopes of learning new spells and magic , but until then he waited while his power grew . Abilities . Revlopar ' s twin - tailed mutation permitted him to cast spells like wizard s of other races , rather than being limited to a fixed set of innate spell - like abilities . For this reason , he was considered a prodigy by most other ixzan . Relashionship . Revlopar studied magic under Erqynak .

title: Rewcol
description: Rewcol Rewcol was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Eshpurta around 1370 DR . Personality . The shadow thief was a sort of misanthrope .
description_long: Rewcol Rewcol was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Eshpurta around 1370 DR . Personality . The shadow thief was a sort of misanthrope . He thought that most people were like pathetic sheep and deserved ( and needed ) people like him to guide and direct them . Activities . The wizard worked as an enforcer , punishing those who went against the rule of his boss in the city .

title: Reyill Werned
description: Reyill Werned Reyill Werned was a greengrocer in Hillsfar . Activities . Reyill went to farms outside the city to bought foods and repackaging sold them inside Hillsfar .
description_long: Reyill Werned Reyill Werned was a greengrocer in Hillsfar . Activities . Reyill went to farms outside the city to bought foods and repackaging sold them inside Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Reyill was drinking with his halfling s friends at the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop . Personality . Reyill was no racist but being pragmatical he knew to no voice his opinion about the Great Law of Hunanity inside Hillsfar . Relationship . Reyill was friend of the halfling Roge Applewink , Narder Ulthub and Guylian Stundter .

title: Reynald de Chatillon
description: Reynald de Chatillon Reynald de Chatillon was a fallen paladin in Athkatla in Amn . History . Reynald was a paladin and a member of the Order of the Radiant Heart , but at some point he fell from grace and started living as an outcast .
description_long: Reynald de Chatillon Reynald de Chatillon was a fallen paladin in Athkatla in Amn . History . Reynald was a paladin and a member of the Order of the Radiant Heart , but at some point he fell from grace and started living as an outcast . Later , Reynald joined his fellow fallen paladin Anarg . Reynald and some of his fellows fought some thieves when they were helped by Gorion ' s Ward . Reynald thanked and Gorion ' s Ward for a mission , not knowing that Gorion ' s Ward was already working for the Radiant Order . Gorion ' s Ward succeeded in the mission , earning the trust of Reynald and his fellows . Only Anarg saw the duplicity of Gorion ' s Ward but he was killed in the fighting . At last , Reynald and his companions rejoined the Radiant Order , which was the objective of Gorion ' s Ward ' s mission for the order .

title: Rezim
description: Rezim Rezim was the vizier of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Rezim was a member of the House of Helcaliant and one of the most powerful men of Mulhorand .
description_long: Rezim Rezim was the vizier of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Rezim was a member of the House of Helcaliant and one of the most powerful men of Mulhorand . History . In 1357 Rezim proposed to directly sold the slaves to the nobles instead of leased them using the temples , he argued that without the temples ' intermissions slavery would become more efficient but critics said was a political action to please the landowners that had place him in power . However Pharaoh Horustep III disagreed and Rezim ' s influence start to decline . Personality . Rezim was well known for his cunning and his ruthlessness . However he valued loyalty to him above all . His latest proposal bordered megalomania . Relationship . Rezim was the uncle of Horustep III .

title: Rezlus
description: Rezlus Rezlus was a Zhentarim cleric who was in service to Bane . Rezlus , with his fellow Zhentarim agents planned to seize control of Daggerdale . Description .
description_long: Rezlus Rezlus was a Zhentarim cleric who was in service to Bane . Rezlus , with his fellow Zhentarim agents planned to seize control of Daggerdale . Description . Rezlus carried an ornate staff and wore green robes and an finely detailed choker . His black and white hair hung long down his back . History . Rezlus , with the help of the red dragon , Incendius , secured a base of operations in the heart of Daggerdale and created the Tower of the Void . Four heroes from the Dalelands stood to challenge the power of Rezlus and his cohorts .

title: Rezmir
description: Rezmir Rezmir , or Rezmir the Black , was a half – black dragon human woman who was the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . She descended from House Orogoth . History .
description_long: Rezmir Rezmir , or Rezmir the Black , was a half – black dragon human woman who was the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . She descended from House Orogoth . History . She orchestrated the raid on the town of Greenest . Later , Rezmir traveled north ahead of the Cult ' s loot to Castle Naerytar in the Mere of Dead Men , having developed a relationship with the great black dragon Voaraghamanthar . After she went to the Skyreach Castle to deposit the goods that she raided in the hoard of Tiamat but here she was killed by some adventurers recruited to stop the Cult . Personality . She was a fierce and terrible warrior , and she took great pleasure in the pain and torture of her enemies . She was more devoted to Tiamat than to Severin .

title: Rhalaglingalade
description: Rhalaglingalade Rhalaglingalade was a wizard in Neverwinter . History . In 1370 DR , Rhalaglingalade settled in Neverwinter and announced the creation of a new spell : the " sphere of summer " .
description_long: Rhalaglingalade Rhalaglingalade was a wizard in Neverwinter . History . In 1370 DR , Rhalaglingalade settled in Neverwinter and announced the creation of a new spell : the " sphere of summer " . For his creation he was targeted by many Calishite assassins , one the famed Thyruin of the White Flowers , and subject of many kidnapping attempts by merchants of Amn , Luskan , and Thay . Rhalagligalade asked the protection of the Lords ' Alliance , who sent an adventuring party to act as his bodyguards .

title: Rhammas Thann
description: Rhammas Thann Rhammas Thann was the husband of Cassandra Thann and thus the patriarch of Thann family , although in his later years , he retired from an active role in family affairs . Personality . He was a hardworking and honorable man who was overshadowed by his wife , Cassandra .
description_long: Rhammas Thann Rhammas Thann was the husband of Cassandra Thann and thus the patriarch of Thann family , although in his later years , he retired from an active role in family affairs . Personality . He was a hardworking and honorable man who was overshadowed by his wife , Cassandra . His son , Danilo Thann , remarked several times that Rhammas in particular disapproved of him and his foolishness . History . In 1315 DR , Rhammas convinced his father , Erktos I , to stop the family ' s involvement in the slave trade . Relationships . Rhammas was the eldest son of Erktos I . He once had an out - of - wedlock daughter named Lilly , who was killed by the Knights of the Shield .

title: Rhangaun
description: Rhangaun Rhangaun was a male lich and a senior member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Dead for more than a thousand years , he was little more than a skeleton with glowing eyes .
description_long: Rhangaun Rhangaun was a male lich and a senior member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Dead for more than a thousand years , he was little more than a skeleton with glowing eyes . Possessions . He owned a staff of the magi . History . In his mortal life , Rhangaun of Almraiven of was hired to kill Cauln Aumar of Athalantar in 217 DR . Forced into the group because Rysellan possessed his phylactery , Rhangaun took control after the founder ’ s death .

title: Rhaugilath
description: Rhaugilath Rhaugilath , called " the Ageless " , was a male human and an archlich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Orbedal in ancient Netheril and later one of the servitor lich es of Larloch the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . History .
description_long: Rhaugilath Rhaugilath , called " the Ageless " , was a male human and an archlich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Orbedal in ancient Netheril and later one of the servitor lich es of Larloch the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . History . Rhaugilath was once the ruler of the enclave of Orbedal in High Netheril , known as the Lich - King of Orbedal . In this position , he was an archrival to Larloch of the enclave of Jiksidur . In the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR , Netheril suffered Karsus ' s Folly , all magic failed , and Orbedal fell from the sky to crash - land on the Sword Coast , near the mouth of the Winding Water . Rhaugilath and his phylactery survived the impact , but he was buried and trapped by rubble in a small pocket . Many years later , Rhaugilath was discovered and freed from the rubble — by his archrival Larloch , who ' d found and claimed Orbedal for his own . A vicious battle erupted between the two . Larloch was victorious and he bound Rhaugilath to serve him . He became the first of Larloch ' s lich servitors , as Orbedal became the infamous Warlock ' s Crypt . He was still there by 1374 DR . Activities .

title: Rhaunaguth
description: Rhaunaguth Rhaunaguth was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Rhaunaguth was the opposite of his greatest rival , Dalagor .
description_long: Rhaunaguth Rhaunaguth was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Rhaunaguth was the opposite of his greatest rival , Dalagor . He was courageous , passionate , and always ready for a fight . Often , he led his troops into battle personally and cried for all the fallen , inspiring total loyalty in all his subjects . History . Rhaunaguth was once a ranger of Silvanus from Tantras . However , after his companions were killed by hill giant s near Ravens Bluff , he developed a hatred for giant - kin , vowing to hunt them all to death . In his quest for revenge , he attacked a voadkyn lair , causing a massacre . After this , he lost all his ranger abilities . He retrained himself as a mercenary and in the following years he worked in Thesk , Sembia , and even Turmish , with his reputation rising and attracting more and more followers . In the end , he settled with his company in Skullport . Activities . Rhaunaguth was the leader of one of the three most powerful mercenary groups in the city .

title: Rhauntides
description: Rhauntides Rhauntides was a human wizard living in Highmoon in Deepingdale . He was a cultured man who was devoted to the study of human and elven magic — specifically the history of their use and users up to the present . History .
description_long: Rhauntides Rhauntides was a human wizard living in Highmoon in Deepingdale . He was a cultured man who was devoted to the study of human and elven magic — specifically the history of their use and users up to the present . History . Rhauntides was once an adventurer and gained much wealth and magic during that time . However , around 1338 DR , he moved into a tower of his own creation in Highmoon , where he lived for thirty years . By 1368 DR , Rhauntides had destroyed at least sixteen wizards and adventuring bands who tried to steal magic from his tower . He was invited three times by the elves of Evermeet to come and live with them in Evermeet under the guise of granting him a safe place to raise children , when in reality they wanted access to his extensive arcane knowledge . Description . Rhauntides was tall and thin , handsome , with piercing blue eyes and a small pointed white beard . Rhauntides ' s movements remained smooth and supple . His long dark hair was going white at the temples , which caused him to sometimes be mistaken for Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun by people not familiar with either of them . Personality .

title: Rhauron
description: Rhauron " Rhauron " was mysterious and notorious individual who lived on Tarsith , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir , in the decade of the 1480s DR . Background . Nobody knew nothing concrete about this individual .
description_long: Rhauron " Rhauron " was mysterious and notorious individual who lived on Tarsith , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir , in the decade of the 1480s DR . Background . Nobody knew nothing concrete about this individual . Although many Faerûn ians believed this " Rhauron " was Asgandur Durhauron , the innkeeper of the Dragonhaven Hearth in Proskur , Elminster Aumar knew that this man was in fact a Laerakond an from Tarsith , however not even he was sure who this individual was . Many urban legends surrounded this mysterious man , and in the Dusk Ports it was believed that he was either a powerful archmage , a psion , a guildmaster or an investor of some sort . Nobody knew even his true name , and people gave him various aliases or titles , " Rhauron " being the name that Elminster made up for him . It was believed that " Rhauron " was the one who created , and later controlled , the mysterious artifacts known as the winking gem s , and then procured those gems to Faerûn in order to kill specific people in that continent , including some Waterdavian nobles and merchants . History .

title: Rhavauz
description: Rhavauz Rhavauz was a female drow guard officer in Szith Morcane who fled from Maerimydra after the invasion of Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . During her duties as an officer of Szith Morcane , Rhavauz wore a over her breastplate with the emblem of House T ' sarran on it , a leering black skull upon a white background .
description_long: Rhavauz Rhavauz was a female drow guard officer in Szith Morcane who fled from Maerimydra after the invasion of Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . During her duties as an officer of Szith Morcane , Rhavauz wore a over her breastplate with the emblem of House T ' sarran on it , a leering black skull upon a white background . Personality . Rhavauz had great disdain for the worshipers of Lolth , which only deepened during the Silence of Lolth . Despite this , she held at least some semblance of hope for those of her own family , that they might join her in the worship of Kiaransalee . Abilities . Specializing in the use of a two - bladed sword , Rhavauz was a highly mobile fighter who could spring in and out of combat as needed . Possessions . As an officer in Szith Morane , Rhavauz had access to a nice array of magical items but she customarily kept both a magic al two - bladed sword and breastplate with her at all times and would wear a pair of " slippers of spider climbing " on her feet . Relationships . Rhavauz had a close relationship with Indrizil , a family member who resided under Cormanthor . History .

title: Rhaymon
description: Rhaymon Rhaymon was a male human cleric of Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Rhaymon was a young cleric of the god Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles .
description_long: Rhaymon Rhaymon was a male human cleric of Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Rhaymon was a young cleric of the god Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles . He met and befriended the then - mortal Kelemvor , Midnight , Cyric , and the ex - cleric Adon when they arrived in the dale to seek advice from Elminster Aumar . Later Rhaymon fought against the armies of Bane . After the battle , however , when all believed Elminster dead , Rhaymon came to believe that Adon and Midnight were the culprits and testified against them in the process . Some time later , Rhaymon died from an accident and Midnight met his spirit on the Fugue Plane and he gave some advice to her about Myrkul ' s realm .

title: Rhazbos Redbridle
description: Rhazbos Redbridle Rhazbos Redbridle was a stout and jolly ex - adventurer who operated a stable within Waterdeep . He was also a former mercenary and caravan leader . Personality .
description_long: Rhazbos Redbridle Rhazbos Redbridle was a stout and jolly ex - adventurer who operated a stable within Waterdeep . He was also a former mercenary and caravan leader . Personality . He was a noted member of the Stablemasters ' & Farrier ' s Guild within the city . Though he was quite busy , Rhazbos took time off to tutor the occasional fighter who can afford his services .

title: Rhazzad
description: Rhazzad Rhazzad was a moon elf wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He started studying the Spellplague and the Chasm .
description_long: Rhazzad Rhazzad was a moon elf wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He started studying the Spellplague and the Chasm . He was soon contacted by mysterious and powerful " Masters " living in the Chasm that promised him great power in exchange for his service , causing a spellburst that devastated part of the city . Rhazzad preyed on those stricken by the Spellplague , promising them treatment in his " Tower of Solace " . Instead , he used them to power some dark ritual . He also tricked his fellow wizard Tualo the Bright into opening a " portal " to the Far Realm . However , Dorothea Linkletter , a victim of the Spellplague who transformed into a monster when emotional , asked an adventurer ' s help . The adventurer arrived at Rhazzad ' s tower to give her a medicine . When the adventurer learned of Rhazzad ' s actions , however , suspicions were raised . Later , the same adventurer closed the " portal " to the Far Realm in Tualo ' s house and discovered Rhazzad ' s involvement .

title: Rhazzt ' s Dilemma
description: Rhazzt ' s Dilemma Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was a cavern in the Northdark that served as an outpost for the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan , about 30 miles south of the drow city .
description_long: Rhazzt ' s Dilemma Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was a cavern in the Northdark that served as an outpost for the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan , about 30 miles south of the drow city . It was also 25 miles south of the Pillars of Woe . History . In 1372 DR , the outpost was manned by about 80 warriors ( somewhat fewer than normal ) , mostly from House Agrach Dyrr , and commanded by Mistress Nafyrra Dyrr . The invading duergar army from Gracklstugh passed through the area on their march to Menzoberranzan . Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin , posing as Captain Zhayemd of Agrach Dyrr , reported to the drow ' s city leaders that the outpost had been destroyed by duergar ( though in fact that was not entirely true because House Agrach Dyrr was aligned with Nimor and the duergar ) . His reports led to the formation of Army of the Black Spider to combat the approaching duergar . .

title: Rheax Bormul
description: Rheax Bormul Rheax Bormul was a male rogue and one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rheax was the son of a ruined noble family and he enjoyed causing the decline of members of his former class . His job was to control the guild ' s operations in Amn .
description_long: Rheax Bormul Rheax Bormul was a male rogue and one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rheax was the son of a ruined noble family and he enjoyed causing the decline of members of his former class . His job was to control the guild ' s operations in Amn . Appendix . Appearances . In the " Baldur ' s Gate " novel , Aran Linvail answered to him .

title: Rhetegast Hawkwinter
description: Rhetegast Hawkwinter Rhetegast Hawkwinter , who went by Rhett , was a young Waterdavian noble and half - elf paladin of Torm . History . Luskan .
description_long: Rhetegast Hawkwinter Rhetegast Hawkwinter , who went by Rhett , was a young Waterdavian noble and half - elf paladin of Torm . History . Luskan . In 1480 DR , Rhett was a low - ranking Waterdavian guardsman assigned to man the blockade Waterdeep maintained around Luskan to keep the Fury plague from spreading . He met Kalen Dren as Kalen was attempting to enter the Cliffside Cranny gate . After a brief battle , Kalen subdued the guardsmen and left his powerful broadsword " Vindicator " with Rhett . Surprisingly , Rhett was able to wield the sword and later tracked down Kalen in Luskan with the intent of becoming Kalen ' s apprentice . The two were attacked and captured by the Dead Rats gang and taken back to the gang ' s headquarters . There , Rhett met Myrin Darkdance and Kalen assigned Rhett to guard her , though it was unlikely the powerful mage needed a bodyguard . Rhett tagged along with Kalen and Myrin on several forays into Luskan to investigate the Fury plague infecting the city . Rhett helped defeat Scour , the demon who was the cause of the plague . Westgate .

title: Rhetsim
description: Rhetsim Rhetsim was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Rhetsim was an alchemist running an alchemist shop in Waterdeep ; her role in the Guild was gave to the Slaver division of the Guild the potions they need in their abduction expedition . for this often Ahmaergo or Avaereene went to the Rhestim ' s shop .
description_long: Rhetsim Rhetsim was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Rhetsim was an alchemist running an alchemist shop in Waterdeep ; her role in the Guild was gave to the Slaver division of the Guild the potions they need in their abduction expedition . for this often Ahmaergo or Avaereene went to the Rhestim ' s shop . Rahtsim was a hideous , mean old crone with sparse white hair and numerous chemical scars on her face and hands ; she usually made paid the strangers double normal price in order to minimize her walk - in business with the Guild but she was very competent and her potions were very good . The only people that treats her kindly was Master Randulaith .

title: Rhiazzshar
description: Rhiazzshar Rhiazzshar was a wood elf druid of Silvanus and a member of a tribe in Wildhome . Appearance . Rhiazzshar had amber - colored eyes and mahogany skin .
description_long: Rhiazzshar Rhiazzshar was a wood elf druid of Silvanus and a member of a tribe in Wildhome . Appearance . Rhiazzshar had amber - colored eyes and mahogany skin . She smelled of freshly crushed pine needles . History . When the wild elves became interested in Duvan ' s immunity to the Spellplague , Rhiazzshar pretended to show affection for him so that she could convince Duvan to participate in experiments to determine the limits of his abilities . They became lovers for a time but Duvan rejected her when he realized she was using him for her own purposes .

title: Rhigaerd Obarskyr II
description: Rhigaerd Obarskyr II Rhigaerd Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . Relatives . Rhigaerd II was the father of Azoun IV and had a daughter named Sulesta .
description_long: Rhigaerd Obarskyr II Rhigaerd Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . Relatives . Rhigaerd II was the father of Azoun IV and had a daughter named Sulesta . He was married to Tanalusta Truesilver . Background . When Azoun III died , prince Rhigaerd II was only six years old , so Salember Obarskyr took the throne of Cormyr as regent . Salember plotted to kill Rhigaerd and take the throne , leading Cormyr into civil war .

title: Rhiiman Obarskyr
description: Rhiiman Obarskyr Rhiiman Obarskyr was the brother of the first king of Cormyr , Faerlthann Obarskyr . Relatives . Rhiiman ' s father was Ondeth Obarskyr and his mother was Suzara Obarskyr .
description_long: Rhiiman Obarskyr Rhiiman Obarskyr was the brother of the first king of Cormyr , Faerlthann Obarskyr . Relatives . Rhiiman ' s father was Ondeth Obarskyr and his mother was Suzara Obarskyr . His older brother was the first king of Cormyr , Faerlthann Obarskyr . Background . Rhiiman came to the land that would become known as Suzail with his parents and his older brother in 6 DR . By 12 DR , Rhiiman ' s mother Suzara had had enough and left his father to return to Impiltur , taking him with her .

title: Rhiiman Obarskyr the Glorious
description: Rhiiman Obarskyr the Glorious Rhiiman the Glorious ( real name Rhiiman Obarskyr ) was the fifth king of Cormyr . He reigned from 66 DR until his death in 79 DR . He was the first to push back the borders of the forest , and killed the last great dragon of the Wyvernwater .
description_long: Rhiiman Obarskyr the Glorious Rhiiman the Glorious ( real name Rhiiman Obarskyr ) was the fifth king of Cormyr . He reigned from 66 DR until his death in 79 DR . He was the first to push back the borders of the forest , and killed the last great dragon of the Wyvernwater . Relatives . His namesake was his uncle , who abandoned Cormyr to go back to Impiltur when his father Faerlthann ' s mother ( Suzara Obarskyr ) got tired of his grandfather Ondeth . He was the youngest of Faerlthann ' s four sons but was third in their succession to the throne after he outlived Imlon , Eskruis , and his nephew Bryndar . He was succeeded by his last remaining brother , Embrus .

title: Rhindaun Dynasty
description: Rhindaun Dynasty Rhindaun Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr , founded by the adventuress Zaranda Star Rhindaun . Etymology . The dynasty took its name from King - Consort Haedrak ' s mother , Rhinda , second wife of Alemander V .
description_long: Rhindaun Dynasty Rhindaun Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr , founded by the adventuress Zaranda Star Rhindaun . Etymology . The dynasty took its name from King - Consort Haedrak ' s mother , Rhinda , second wife of Alemander V . History . The dynasty was officially founded in 1368 DR . In the previous year , on Mirtul 3 ( called Crowning Day ) , Zaranda Star had been proclaimed queen by the citizens of Zazesspur . She spent several months speaking with leaders of the country and gaining support from the rest of the cities . She was blessed by the Archdruid of Mosstone on Highharvestide and selected and renamed Darromar as her new capital . Saradush and the Order of the Silver Chalice accepted her as queen in 1368 . After Zaranda Star won the Reclamation Wars and married the lost prince of Tethyr , Haedrak Rhindaun III , her official coronation was in 1369 DR . The full line of succession for the dynasty is unknown , but Queen Zaranda ' s first daughter Sybille succeeded her as the second queen of the line and took the throne in 1397 DR .

title: Rhinnom Dannihyr
description: Rhinnom Dannihyr Rhimmom Dannihyr was a male human rogue who was the leader of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rhimmon arrived at this position because he was at the same time the iltarch of the Council of Six from 1362 DR . In truth , the founder of the Council of Six , Thayze Selemchant , made a deal with the Shadow Thieves for use of them as intelligence agents for Amn in exchange for protection against the guild ' s enemies .
description_long: Rhinnom Dannihyr Rhimmom Dannihyr was a male human rogue who was the leader of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rhimmon arrived at this position because he was at the same time the iltarch of the Council of Six from 1362 DR . In truth , the founder of the Council of Six , Thayze Selemchant , made a deal with the Shadow Thieves for use of them as intelligence agents for Amn in exchange for protection against the guild ' s enemies .

title: Rhinoceros
description: Rhinoceros A rhinoceros was a natural herbivorous animal found in warm plains . Description . They had big , barreled chests with stout legs and thick - skin , which was usually gray in color .
description_long: Rhinoceros A rhinoceros was a natural herbivorous animal found in warm plains . Description . They had big , barreled chests with stout legs and thick - skin , which was usually gray in color . They had one to three horns on their snouts that they used to impale their opponents . Ecology . These creatures were known to be short - tempered and attacked anything they perceived as a threat . Rhinos were reputed to particularly hate fire , and would travel miles in an effort to stomp out any fire within its territory . Rhinoceros hide was used to make an armor known as " chia " in Kara - Tur .

title: Rhinzen Halnian
description: Rhinzen Halnian Rhinzen Halnian was a powerful Elf Wizard and the Master of the House of Wonder mage academy in Waterdeep . He spent most of his time tutoring the children of weathly Waterdavian families , a task he seemed to find excrutiatingly boring . Rhinzen got his kicks by indulging in the narcotic haepthum .
description_long: Rhinzen Halnian Rhinzen Halnian was a powerful Elf Wizard and the Master of the House of Wonder mage academy in Waterdeep . He spent most of his time tutoring the children of weathly Waterdavian families , a task he seemed to find excrutiatingly boring . Rhinzen got his kicks by indulging in the narcotic haepthum . He held the Song Dragon ' s Gorget , a magical item that nulified the effects of Waterdeep ' s dragon ward . Tennora Hedare , a former pupil , stole the gorget but was caught in the act by Rhinzen . However , he was so bombed out of his mind on haepthum that he mistoke Tennora and two apprentices near her for devils and called down a meteor swarm on his tower . The tower was destroyed but Rhinzen survived although he was relieved of his role as Master of the House of Wonder . Appearance . Rhinzen had blonde hair and tourquoise eyes .

title: Rhodea Firehair
description: Rhodea Firehair Rhodea Firehair was a powerful invoker living in Aluarim in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Rhodea ' s personality matched her surname .
description_long: Rhodea Firehair Rhodea Firehair was a powerful invoker living in Aluarim in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Rhodea ' s personality matched her surname . Contrary to most wizard s , Rhodea was often seen at the front line of any battle or conflict , fearlessly leading those around her to victory . With a wide array of destructive spells , she was truly a force to be reckoned with . Activities . Rhodea was the only Elder on the Council of Elders ( Halruaa ) who never missed a call to meeting from Zalathorm Kirkson . She took it upon herself to make sure the Royal Mint was run effectively and fairly .

title: Rhodochrosite
description: Rhodochrosite Rhodochrosite , also known as rosenstone , was most often used in rings and pendants . Description . These ornamental stones were various shades of pink and translucent with a glassy sheen .
description_long: Rhodochrosite Rhodochrosite , also known as rosenstone , was most often used in rings and pendants . Description . These ornamental stones were various shades of pink and translucent with a glassy sheen . They could be tumbled and polished for jewelry . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Rodochrosite stones were considered sacred by followers of Lliira — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . A quantity of rosenstone about the size of an eyeball could be crushed into a powder and brewed with a special tea . A being that had been poisoned or diseased could consume a pot of this tea for a chance at a " neutralize poison " or " cure disease " effect .

title: Rhovann Disarnnyl
description: Rhovann Disarnnyl Rhovann Disarnnyl was a powerful moon elf mage formerly of Myth Drannor . History . He fought and lost a duel with Geran Hulmaster over a moon elf maiden and lost a hand in the battle .
description_long: Rhovann Disarnnyl Rhovann Disarnnyl was a powerful moon elf mage formerly of Myth Drannor . History . He fought and lost a duel with Geran Hulmaster over a moon elf maiden and lost a hand in the battle . Geran was banished from Myth Drannor for his crime . Later , Rhovann was banished for practicing forbidden shadow magic . Rhovann was driven by his desire for revenge against Geran , and , in 1479 DR , Rhovann sought out his old nemesis and helped to stage a coup in Hulburg that deposed the Hulmasters . Rhovann used spells to dominate the mind of the leader of the merchant council , Maroth Marstel , turning him into Rhovann ' s puppet . He then solidified his hold over Hulmaster by creating runehelm golem s using his shadow magic . Rhovann was slain by Geran Hulmaster in 1480 DR at Griffonwatch Keep in Hulburg .

title: Rhundorth
description: Rhundorth Rhundorth was a master blacksmith in Mirabar who became a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Rhundorth was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation .
description_long: Rhundorth Rhundorth was a master blacksmith in Mirabar who became a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Rhundorth was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation . However , at Beliard in the Dessarin Valley , they were ambushed by the Cult of the Black Earth . Rhundorth was captured and transported beyond the River Dessarin . He remained in the Black Earth ' s hands . The earth cultists made him toil for the Cult under the promise of better treatment for his fellow prisoners . Eventually , some adventurers infiltrated the Fane , defeated the cultists , and saved him .

title: Rhyem Maraphiir
description: Rhyem Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was a moon elf and the father of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Rhyem had two children with the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir .
description_long: Rhyem Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was a moon elf and the father of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Rhyem had two children with the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir . History . Soon after Ashemmi ' s birth in Silverymoon , the family moved to live with the wood elves in the Neverwinter Wood , and were taken in by the Ilbaereth house .

title: Rhykdeq
description: Rhykdeq Rhykdeq was an enterprising ixzan merchant in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . Activities . Rhykdeq regularly ferried goods up and down the Deepdrain .
description_long: Rhykdeq Rhykdeq was an enterprising ixzan merchant in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . Activities . Rhykdeq regularly ferried goods up and down the Deepdrain . His nickname derived from the fact that Rhykdeq used brown mold and spells to freeze his cargo into slow - melting cylindrical blocks of ice , to make it easier to transport .

title: Rhymanthiin
description: Rhymanthiin Rhymanthiin ( also called the Hidden City of Hope ) , was created in 1374 DR through a High Magic Ritual of Myriad and manipulation of the Killing Storms through Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , Tsarra Chaadren , and Danthra the Dreamer , all of whose souls were within the body of Tsarra Chaadren , and over ninety wielders of the Art , including five Chosen of Mystra , all by the design of the Pentad ( the five gods Corellon Larethian , Sehanine Moonbow , Dumathoin , Mystra , and Oghma ) . It is a reconstruction of the ancient Miyeritar i city of Faer ' tel ' miir , the Library City . Location .
description_long: Rhymanthiin Rhymanthiin ( also called the Hidden City of Hope ) , was created in 1374 DR through a High Magic Ritual of Myriad and manipulation of the Killing Storms through Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , Tsarra Chaadren , and Danthra the Dreamer , all of whose souls were within the body of Tsarra Chaadren , and over ninety wielders of the Art , including five Chosen of Mystra , all by the design of the Pentad ( the five gods Corellon Larethian , Sehanine Moonbow , Dumathoin , Mystra , and Oghma ) . It is a reconstruction of the ancient Miyeritar i city of Faer ' tel ' miir , the Library City . Location . Rhymanthiin is located on the High Moor on the exact spot that the Miyeritari city of Faer ' tel ' miir once occupied . The High Moor was partly cleansed from this city raising , and the toxins were redirected into the body of the lich Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk , thus also starting the rejuvenation of the High Moor . The city only accepts those who are " worthy of her , " and those with malice in their hearts " shall not find their way here . " Construction .

title: Rhynn Lanthorn
description: Rhynn Lanthorn The Rhynn Lanthorn was a magical lantern held by the elves of Suldanessellar . It had the power to reveal things behind even the most powerful illusions . When Irenicus was attacking Suldanessellar , he hid its entrance with illusions to prevent Elhan and his troops from entering .
description_long: Rhynn Lanthorn The Rhynn Lanthorn was a magical lantern held by the elves of Suldanessellar . It had the power to reveal things behind even the most powerful illusions . When Irenicus was attacking Suldanessellar , he hid its entrance with illusions to prevent Elhan and his troops from entering . The Lanthorn was capable of seeing through the illusions , so he had Bodhi steal it and hide it in Athkatla . Only when it was recovered were the elves able to get back into the city .

title: Rhys Ravenwind
description: Rhys Ravenwind Rhys Ravenwind was a renowned bard and member of the Harpers . Personality . Despite being a bard , Rhys was quite shy .
description_long: Rhys Ravenwind Rhys Ravenwind was a renowned bard and member of the Harpers . Personality . Despite being a bard , Rhys was quite shy . Relationships . Rhys was friends with both Danilo Thann and Arilyn Moonblade . History . Rhys was killed in Waterdeep by the Harper Assassin in 1361 DR .

title: Rhyxali
description: Rhyxali Rhyxali , the Queen of Shadows , is the demon princess daughter of Pale Night ( the Mother of Demons ) . This in turn made her the sister of Graz ' zt ( the Dark Prince ) , Vucarik ( Consort of Chains ) , and Zivorgian , the Lady of Ripe Carrion . Rhyxali was a long - standing ally of Graz ' zt .
description_long: Rhyxali Rhyxali , the Queen of Shadows , is the demon princess daughter of Pale Night ( the Mother of Demons ) . This in turn made her the sister of Graz ' zt ( the Dark Prince ) , Vucarik ( Consort of Chains ) , and Zivorgian , the Lady of Ripe Carrion . Rhyxali was a long - standing ally of Graz ' zt . Rumors said the two were working to absorb a Material Plane world into the Abyss , trapping it in the parched realm of the Nerebdian Vast , the 48th layer of the Abyss . Rhyxali ' s realm of Shaddonon existed on the 49th layer of the Abyss . Rhyxali ' s rule extended over shadow demon s . Unlike her contemporaries , Rhyxali seemed content to rule Shaddonon without the desire to acquire a larger realm . Personal power in the form of information and secrets was the only thing Rhyxali coveted . To this end , Rhyxali created a vast library of secrets run by her lieutenant , Viractuth , a marilith sorcerer . The library ' s contents were so disorganized and chaotic that only Viractuth could find anything of relevance . Virtually all demon lords called Rhyxali an ally and sent envoys to deal in secrets .

title: Ri ' ola ' con
description: Ri ' ola ' con Ri ' ola ' con was the eadar of As ' arem and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Ri ' ola ' con was the highest - ranking member of the council acting as mediator and facilitator despite his old age .
description_long: Ri ' ola ' con Ri ' ola ' con was the eadar of As ' arem and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Ri ' ola ' con was the highest - ranking member of the council acting as mediator and facilitator despite his old age . History . Ri ' ola ' con was the unseen ceremonial emperor of the four shalarin kingdom . After the Twelfth Serôs War he decided to reside in Myth Nantar causing tumult and plotting ' s work . He however wanted fully support the Nantarn Alliance . Ri ' ola ' con was poisoned in the greengrass of 1370 DR while was in his capital of Us ' roch . Relashionship . With the surprise of many , especially shalarin , Ri ' ola ' con forged a friendship with Gayar .

title: Ri ' ola ' kirk
description: Ri ' ola ' kirk Ri ' ola ' kirk was the eadar of As ' arem ' s protege . History . As the only heir of the eadar Ri ' ola ' con after the Twelfth Serôs War Ri ' ola ' kirk must abandoned his life as ranger in order to be instructed by the old shalarin .
description_long: Ri ' ola ' kirk Ri ' ola ' kirk was the eadar of As ' arem ' s protege . History . As the only heir of the eadar Ri ' ola ' con after the Twelfth Serôs War Ri ' ola ' kirk must abandoned his life as ranger in order to be instructed by the old shalarin . However he was often distracted by his affection for the young shalarin dukar Ka ' ioa ' Tara and his hunts in new waters with triton s and dukars . Relashionship . Ri ' ola ' kirk was in his young years in Os ' dahr a friend of the new young queen of Es ' roch Ri ' ena ' wyn .

title: Rian Nightshade
description: Rian Nightshade Rian Nightshade was the Zhentarim envoy to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Rian acted under two principles : logic and greed .
description_long: Rian Nightshade Rian Nightshade was the Zhentarim envoy to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Rian acted under two principles : logic and greed . All her actions were in accordance with this . History . During the Tyranny of Dragons , under orders from her masters , Rian approached the Council of Lords of Waterdeep and offered help against the rising menace of Tiamat and the Cult of the Dragon , for which she gained a seat at the Council . She officially acted as one of the advisers of Lord Dagult Neverember and most of the councilors chose to ignore her real loyalties . Rian approved of all plans to stop the Cult , even the most cruel , and was in favor of an alliance with Thay . Rian was very interested in gaining control of Xonthal ' s Tower for the Zhentarim , and away from the adventuring band hired by the Council . Appendix . Gameplay . If the adventurers gained the respect of the Zhents , then they offered their services at normal cost . However , unlike all the other factions involved , if Rian and the Zhentarim did not respect the adventurers , they still helped them for a substantial price .

title: Riasa Yegorovna
description: Riasa Yegorovna Riasa Yegorovna ( pronounced REE - suh YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was a girl in Mulmaster . Personality . Riasa was an easily excitable , but a little unfocused girl .
description_long: Riasa Yegorovna Riasa Yegorovna ( pronounced REE - suh YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was a girl in Mulmaster . Personality . Riasa was an easily excitable , but a little unfocused girl . She was easily distracted and her attention easily drifted . She was a little clumsy , though stronger than she looked . Family . Riasa was the daughter of Blade Pankin Yegorovna . History . In 1491 DR , she became the disciple of Thylius Caramitru , a minor noble who claimed to have learned at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose the new meditation technique of the Yellow Breath . They gave a demonstration during a party hosted by Astrid Saj and Rosealine Culkin to honor Aleyd Burral , the Resurrected Hero of Phlan . After Riasa ' s father became angry about her frequentation of Thylius and confined her in the heavily guarded Tower of Blades

title: Riatavin
description: Riatavin Riatavin was a city in Amn and later Tethyr in west Faerûn . History . Formerly a city of Amn , Riatavin seceded to become part of Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR .
description_long: Riatavin Riatavin was a city in Amn and later Tethyr in west Faerûn . History . Formerly a city of Amn , Riatavin seceded to become part of Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . On the Feast of the Moon of 1370 DR , the Herald Thorn Tree disappeared hours before he was to perform the Bloodsong . This triggered a storm of controversy . First , there were rumors that the High Heralds had plans to expel Thorn Tree for corruption . Second , the rebel government of Riatavin had hoped to use the Bloodsong to assert their authority over the city amidst their secession from Amn to Tethyr . Third , some claimed that Thorn Tree had been working for , variously , Amn , Tethyr , the Knights of the Shield , or another faction of Riatavin . Thus , Thorn Tree ' s disappearance was expected to be powerful political ammunition for all these factions , further disrupting the secession . In fact , Thorn Tree had actually been murdered by one the Eldreth Veluuthra , and his body hidden so well it might never be found . The city lost population in the years after the Spellplague and , as of 1479 DR , parts of the city were abandoned .

title: Ribsmasher
description: Ribsmasher Ribsmasher was an apparently mad human male who was locked up in the ogre Ghellu ' s Riverguard Keep . Upon being released by adventurers , Ribsmasher attacked his jailors with his bare fists . When he next appears Ribsmasher is again a captive , this time of a cult of Shar .
description_long: Ribsmasher Ribsmasher was an apparently mad human male who was locked up in the ogre Ghellu ' s Riverguard Keep . Upon being released by adventurers , Ribsmasher attacked his jailors with his bare fists . When he next appears Ribsmasher is again a captive , this time of a cult of Shar . It becomes clear that his apparent madness is simply the excessive zeal of a monk in the service of Tempus . When freed once more he travelled to Crossroad Keep ; once there , he made available his abilities to passing adventurers and any rib - related smashing opportunities they may be able to offer him . Quote : " Time to smash some DRAGON RIBS ! "

title: Rice Spirits
description: Rice Spirits The Rice Spirits were a group of Lesser Immortal s of the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant faith of Kara - Tur . They served Nung Chiang , the god of agriculture and fertility . The Rice Spirits governed the harvest and fertility , and were responsible for causing rice to grow tall and sturdy , animals to have their young , and men and women to bear babies .
description_long: Rice Spirits The Rice Spirits were a group of Lesser Immortal s of the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant faith of Kara - Tur . They served Nung Chiang , the god of agriculture and fertility . The Rice Spirits governed the harvest and fertility , and were responsible for causing rice to grow tall and sturdy , animals to have their young , and men and women to bear babies . They also decided if a family should have children . They could appear as women or men or as all manner of animals or magical beasts .

title: Rice candies
description: Rice candies Rice candies were a type of chewy candy from Shou Lung . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .
description_long: Rice candies Rice candies were a type of chewy candy from Shou Lung . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description . Flavored with flower essences and exotic fruits which conferred them a tart taste , rice candies had a chewy and gelatinous texture . Candies purchased through " Aurora ' s " came in packages containing mixed assorted flavors .

title: Richard Baker
description: Richard Baker Richard Baker , full name : L . Richard Baker III , grew up on the Jersey shore before graduating from Virginia Tech University . At some point he joined the Navy and was stationed in Virginia , Rhode Island , and Louisiana .
description_long: Richard Baker Richard Baker , full name : L . Richard Baker III , grew up on the Jersey shore before graduating from Virginia Tech University . At some point he joined the Navy and was stationed in Virginia , Rhode Island , and Louisiana . He has previously worked for TSR , Inc . , but now works for Wizards of the Coast as an author and game designer . Rich currently lives in Pacific , Washington , with his wife , Kim , and two daughters , Alex and Hannah .

title: Richard Whitters
description: Richard Whitters Richard Whitters is a concept artist who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Whitters received his education in New Brunswick , Canada , majoring in graphic design and illustration .
description_long: Richard Whitters Richard Whitters is a concept artist who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Whitters received his education in New Brunswick , Canada , majoring in graphic design and illustration . Career . Whitters started working for Wizards of the Coast in 2007 . He has contributed to both and Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Rico Pengallen
description: Rico Pengallen Rico Pengallen was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description .
description_long: Rico Pengallen Rico Pengallen was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description . Rico was a man of his mid - twenties , rugged and strong . He had a ruddy face and widely spaced blue eyes . Personality . Rico Pengallen was an angry and prideful man , and often aggressive . Possessions . Rico carried a blacksmith ' s hammer when hunting the orcs . He lived in a simple farmhouse built of logs and boards packed with mud , with a steep roof . Nearby was a barn . His property was fenced around and included a goat . History . Rico enjoyed hunting down , capturing and forcing others , common enemies of humankind , to work for him , in the full knowledge of all in Pengallen . In his time , he enslaved a number of goblin s and orc s , and even a bugbear , though only one at a time . When he was done with them , when they ceased to be useful or docile , he had them hanged at the village gate . Among the slaves he took was Nojheim , a highly intelligent and good - hearted goblin . In the winter of the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , a band of ogre s and orc s attacked the village and carried off captives , including Nojheim .

title: Ricven
description: Ricven Ricven was a powerful elf archmage living in Neverwinter before the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He died in the cataclysm that also destroyed his tower , later known as the Fallen Tower .
description_long: Ricven Ricven was a powerful elf archmage living in Neverwinter before the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He died in the cataclysm that also destroyed his tower , later known as the Fallen Tower . His assistant , Lugan , saved himself from the Spellplague but it was too dangerous for him to come back to the Fallen Tower . Therefore , Lugan recruited an adventurer to explore Ricven ' s tower and the adventurer found that the archmage remained in the tower as a ghost , too interested in studying the Spellpague ' s effects on magic to die . Ricven gladly gave his research to the adventurer to give to Lugan .

title: Riders of Blood
description: Riders of Blood The Riders of Blood were renegades from the House of Hanif who operated along Dihl al - Taif in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . Located somewhere within the Haunted Lands , the Riders of Blood struck with the speed and savage efficiency of a sandstorm .
description_long: Riders of Blood The Riders of Blood were renegades from the House of Hanif who operated along Dihl al - Taif in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . Located somewhere within the Haunted Lands , the Riders of Blood struck with the speed and savage efficiency of a sandstorm . Activities . Because of their dislike of the subjugation of their tribe to the Grand Caliph in Huzuz , the Riders of Blood frequently targeted trade caravans traveling between Huzuz and Halwa . All potential caravan targets were carefully scouted before any attack was made . A favored tactic was to have several wind mages batter the caravans with wind and sand for a few days before striking with lancers and bowmen . Organization . The Riders of Blood fielded 250 skilled fighting men and women and several wizards . Fasim Kaldur was their leader . Many of the Riders favored the jambiya since it was a symbol of freedom throughout the Land of Fate . Members . Though most of its members were humans , elves and half - elves were welcomed so long as they proved their loyalty to the Riders .

title: Riders of Nesmé
description: Riders of Nesmé The Riders of Nesmé was a military mercenary organization that served Nesmé . History . In 1358 DR , the Riders of Nesmé sent a small score of soldiers to support the dwarves of Mithral Hall when Menzoberranzan ' s army were on the march to take over the ancient halls .
description_long: Riders of Nesmé The Riders of Nesmé was a military mercenary organization that served Nesmé . History . In 1358 DR , the Riders of Nesmé sent a small score of soldiers to support the dwarves of Mithral Hall when Menzoberranzan ' s army were on the march to take over the ancient halls . Due to the somewhat tense relationship between Nesmé and Mithral Hall , the soldiers were only sent out of fear of Bruenor Battlehammer and Drizzt Do ' Urden than to support the so - called alliance . Around 1368 DR , the Riders of Nesmé were reduced in strength and number by continual troll and orc attacks . It failed to protect the city in 1370 DR when it was sacked by a troll army . In 1374 DR , First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin paid the Riders of Nesmé ( along with Uthgardt barbarian s and lizardfolk ) to defend the city . Equipment . They wore a gray and gold sash .

title: Riding lizard
description: Riding lizard Riding lizards were large , sleek reptiles used as mounts by drow in the Underdark as as a food source for other creatures in the Underdark . Description . Riding lizards were large lizards 20 - 22 feet long ( their tails making up about half their length ) .
description_long: Riding lizard Riding lizards were large , sleek reptiles used as mounts by drow in the Underdark as as a food source for other creatures in the Underdark . Description . Riding lizards were large lizards 20 - 22 feet long ( their tails making up about half their length ) . They had three - toed feet with sticky pads that allowed them to cling to surfaces such as walls and ceilings . Behavior . Riding lizards preferred to take to the walls and ceiling rather than travel on the ground where predators might more easily track them . Lizards generally lived together in a pack in which the strongest individuals guard the weaker ones . Drow often used magical means of compulsion in the training and use of riding lizards so that the lizards were both fearless and perfectly obedient . Abilities . Riding lizards had very keen balance . They were immune to poisons and spores from centipedes , arachnids , and fungi . Trained riders could stay seated when their mount is upside - down . Lizards could run on either all four feet or just their back feet . They had infravision up to 160 feet , but they were susceptible to partial blindness due to bright light . Combat .

title: Rieltar Anchev
description: Rieltar Anchev Rieltar Anchev ( sometimes spelled Reiltar ) was the regional leader of the Iron Throne in Baldur ' s Gate , and the foster father of Sarevok . He killed his wife in front of Sarevok when he was young . He was also a central figure in orchestrating the iron crisis to gain power to the Iron Throne , as well as the doppelganger infiltration of merchant rivals .
description_long: Rieltar Anchev Rieltar Anchev ( sometimes spelled Reiltar ) was the regional leader of the Iron Throne in Baldur ' s Gate , and the foster father of Sarevok . He killed his wife in front of Sarevok when he was young . He was also a central figure in orchestrating the iron crisis to gain power to the Iron Throne , as well as the doppelganger infiltration of merchant rivals . He was unaware that Sarevok intended to use the ensuing war with Amn to cause monumental slaughter that would cause him to ascend as the new Lord of Murder , taking after his real father . History . When Rieltar and Brunos Costak were negotiating a deal with the Knights of the Shield in Candlekeep , Sarevok goaded Gorion ' s Ward to take the opportunity to eliminate the leaders of the Iron Throne . If Sarevok didn ' t succeed , he simply had doppelgangers do it in their stead , disguised as the party of Gorion ' s Ward so that the group would get arrested for murder anyway .

title: Rigar Trueblood
description: Rigar Trueblood Rigar Trueblood was a veteran warrior and hero . As he lay on his deathbed , Rigar Trueblood begged his companion , the mage Spectorial , to preserve his skill and fortitude in battle . Although reluctant , Spectorial acceded and extracted these qualities from Rigar ' s soul , placing them into the " pale green ioun stone " so that others might benefit from them .
description_long: Rigar Trueblood Rigar Trueblood was a veteran warrior and hero . As he lay on his deathbed , Rigar Trueblood begged his companion , the mage Spectorial , to preserve his skill and fortitude in battle . Although reluctant , Spectorial acceded and extracted these qualities from Rigar ' s soul , placing them into the " pale green ioun stone " so that others might benefit from them . However , Rigar ' s own soul would then lack these skills .

title: Righteous brand
description: Righteous brand Righteous brand is a prayer cast by many cleric s , particularly those of the battle cleric tradition . When cast , " righteous brand " lights a cleric ' s weapon with the holy symbol of their deity , allowing the cleric to channel divine power through it . When a cleric strikes a foe with a weapon so enchanted they momentarily brand their enemy with the symbol and the release of divine magic allows them to enhance the martial skill of an ally within twenty - five feet to a degree dependent on the cleric ' s physical strength .
description_long: Righteous brand Righteous brand is a prayer cast by many cleric s , particularly those of the battle cleric tradition . When cast , " righteous brand " lights a cleric ' s weapon with the holy symbol of their deity , allowing the cleric to channel divine power through it . When a cleric strikes a foe with a weapon so enchanted they momentarily brand their enemy with the symbol and the release of divine magic allows them to enhance the martial skill of an ally within twenty - five feet to a degree dependent on the cleric ' s physical strength . Like most prayers of its power level , " righteous brand " increases in strength as the cleric ' s experience grows . " Righteous brand " is easily cast and can be reused instantaneously .

title: Righteous might
description: Righteous might Righteous might is a transmutation spell that enlarges and strengthens the user . Effects . You grow to double your height , and your gear grows proportionally .
description_long: Righteous might Righteous might is a transmutation spell that enlarges and strengthens the user . Effects . You grow to double your height , and your gear grows proportionally . This increase has the following effects : For example , Jozan , a human , casts " righteous might " . He becomes Large , loses 1 from his AC and base attack bonus , and gains + 4 to his Strength score ( from 12 to 16 ) , for an additional + 2 ability bonus on melee attacks and damage . Additionally , his morningstar is now Large , and it deals 2d6 points of damage instead of 1d8 ( plus whatever magical bonuses may apply ) . Magical properties of magic items that get bigger do not change .

title: Righteous rage of Tempus
description: Righteous rage of Tempus Righteous rage of Tempus was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tempus that gave the caster a short window of time in which to hit with a weapon . If the attack was successful , this prayer made it a devastating blow .
description_long: Righteous rage of Tempus Righteous rage of Tempus was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tempus that gave the caster a short window of time in which to hit with a weapon . If the attack was successful , this prayer made it a devastating blow .

title: Righteous wrath of the faithful
description: Righteous wrath of the faithful Righteous wrath of the faithful was an enchantment spell that inflamed the battle fury of the caster ' s allies , improving their abilities in combat and granting a temporary health boost . Effects . When this spell was cast , all friends and allies of the caster in a 60 ft ( 18 .
description_long: Righteous wrath of the faithful Righteous wrath of the faithful was an enchantment spell that inflamed the battle fury of the caster ' s allies , improving their abilities in combat and granting a temporary health boost . Effects . When this spell was cast , all friends and allies of the caster in a 60 ft ( 18 . 3 m ) radius are granted the benefits of an " aid " spell ( temporary increase in morale , combat skill , and health ) . Those of the same religion as the caster were fired with divine fury , allowing them to attack more often and with greater effectiveness . When the spell ended , any remaining health boost was lost and those that experienced the " righteous wrath " found themselves exhausted and had to rest for at least 10 minutes before attempting anything strenuous . Components . Verbal and somatic components , plus the priest ' s holy symbol , were required to cast this spell .

title: Rihuud
description: Rihuud Rihuud was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Rihuud was one of the apprentices of Stonespeaker Hgraam , leader of Clan Cairngorm .
description_long: Rihuud Rihuud was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Rihuud was one of the apprentices of Stonespeaker Hgraam , leader of Clan Cairngorm . During the Rage of Demons , during a rite of " communing with the stone " , he went mad from the demonic energies unleashed and went on a rampage in the streets . Fellow apprentice Dorhun was tasked to take him back alive to their quarters .

title: Rikmo Naquander
description: Rikmo Naquander Rikmo Naquander was a Master Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Rikmo had great attention to detail .
description_long: Rikmo Naquander Rikmo Naquander was a Master Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Rikmo had great attention to detail . He concentrated on understanding the workings of the city - state ' s government and considered getting onto the merchant council in future . Rikmo was ambitious but friendly to his friends . He was wise enough to understand that for now Keshna Finlothleer was a better leader for the guild . History . Rikmo joined the guild in 1358 DR and was soon appointed as an asset in the dealings between the guild and the merchant council .

title: Rilauven
description: Rilauven Rilauven was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . The city was located under an area near the surface city of Neverwinter .
description_long: Rilauven Rilauven was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . The city was located under an area near the surface city of Neverwinter . History . Rilauven ' s Lolth ite priesthood was overthrown by the worshipers of Vhaeraun in a relatively bloodless coup . The city was ruled by a council of the representatives of the Sorcere , Melee - Magthere , and Arach - Tinilith academies . All aspects of culture , be they wizard , fighter , or cleric , were treated the same , although the city ' s Archmage , Malavon Despana , who organized the coup , seemed to hold the most power and Vhaeraun was venerated above Lolth .

title: Rilimbrar
description: Rilimbrar Rilimbrar was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Rilimbrar was the second son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly .
description_long: Rilimbrar Rilimbrar was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Rilimbrar was the second son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly . His mother was named Thelmara Rorntarn . His older brother was Imphras III , who never ruled . Rilimbrar married Ilbritha Eirlthaum in 1297 DR . They were the parents of Sambryl and other daughters but had no sons . History . Rilimbrar was born in 1280 DR . Crowned at the age of fourteen years , when his father and older brother were killed in a bandit attack staged by his cousin Thaum , Rilimbrar waited for two years to rule , while his uncle Crown Prince Kuskur sat on the throne in his place as regent . Rilimbrar was forced to flee to Aglarond in 1295 DR when Thaum attacked Impiltur and defeated his army at the Battle of Five Heads . He returned in 1296 DR to rule after Thaum was killed . Since he had no sons , he established a Council of Lords to rule the kingdom after his death , which occurred in 1338 DR during a mysterious fire . At that point , his eldest daughter Sambryl became regent .

title: Rilimbraun
description: Rilimbraun Rilimbraun was a cleric of Tyr and one of leaders of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR and an old member of the Council of Lords . After the crowning of Imbrar II Rilimbraun alongside Soargilm retired from public life , acting only as advisor of Sambryl .
description_long: Rilimbraun Rilimbraun was a cleric of Tyr and one of leaders of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR and an old member of the Council of Lords . After the crowning of Imbrar II Rilimbraun alongside Soargilm retired from public life , acting only as advisor of Sambryl .

title: Rilira
description: Rilira Rilira was a former drow noble in Szith Morcane . History . Rilira was the head of a noble house in Szith Morcane .
description_long: Rilira Rilira was a former drow noble in Szith Morcane . History . Rilira was the head of a noble house in Szith Morcane . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after the fire giant s occupied the outpost , Rilira hid her identity when the nobles were slaughtered . As a slave , Rilira tried to organize her fellow drow .

title: Rilitar Shadow - water
description: Rilitar Shadow - water Rilitar Shadow - water was an elven wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Rilitar was among a cabal of humanoid wizards in Thentia who studied the " Dracorage mythal " .
description_long: Rilitar Shadow - water Rilitar Shadow - water was an elven wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Rilitar was among a cabal of humanoid wizards in Thentia who studied the " Dracorage mythal " . He continued their studies despite many troubles , the last of which was their draconic ally Samdralyrion going crazy . After this incident , the avariel Taegan Nightwind and faerie dragon Jivex suspected that inside their group was a spy sent by Sammaster , and that this agent was responsible for the death of one of the wizards . Taegan and Jivex discovered that the killer was a chasme and that Rilitar was its next objective , but managed to save the life of the elven wizard . After more investigations and another death among the wizards , it was discovered that the traitor was a sunwyrm posing as a human wizard , Phourkyn One - Eye . In the battle against the sunwyrm , Rilitar and his fellows supported Taegan and Jivex , and Phourkyn was destroyed . However , soon after , Rilitar died from the wounds he ' d sustained during the fight .

title: Riliyyn Scantshar
description: Riliyyn Scantshar Riliyyn Scantshar , or Riliyyr Scantshar , was a human woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast and matriarch of the Scantshar family in the late 1360s DR . Description . Riliyyn was an elderly woman by 1367 DR .
description_long: Riliyyn Scantshar Riliyyn Scantshar , or Riliyyr Scantshar , was a human woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast and matriarch of the Scantshar family in the late 1360s DR . Description . Riliyyn was an elderly woman by 1367 DR . Though she was known for her kindness , she and the rest of the Scantshar family were distrusted and treated with slight suspicion by other folk of Sevenecho . This was largely due to Riliyyn ' s skills as a wizard . Skills . Riliyyn was a wizard of some accomplishment . In an emergency or trouble at The Worried Wyvern , Sevenecho ' s inn , Riliyyn could be called upon by Beliot Sevenecho to provide magical assistance . Riliyyn once made a study of the orc - and monster - infested Glorming Pass north of Sevenecho , and theorized that some evil entity , likely a wizard , a lich , or possibly even an alhoon , dwelled in nearby parts of the Earthfast Mountains . She also believed that it kept a deepspawn in the area to spawn creatures that would discourage explorers from finding its lair .

title: Rillifane ' s Grove
description: Rillifane ' s Grove Rillifane ' s Grove was a grove of old oak trees . It was used by moon and sun elf priests to contact the Seldarine . It was also used for ceremonies , funerals and marriages by wood and wild elves who traveled to Leuthilspar .
description_long: Rillifane ' s Grove Rillifane ' s Grove was a grove of old oak trees . It was used by moon and sun elf priests to contact the Seldarine . It was also used for ceremonies , funerals and marriages by wood and wild elves who traveled to Leuthilspar .

title: Rillifane Rallathil
description: Rillifane Rallathil Rillifane Rallathil ( RILL - ih - fane RALL - uh - thihl ) is the elven god of protection of woodlands and the guardian of the harmony of nature . His priests liken him to a giant ethereal oak tree so huge that its roots mingle with every other plant , which stands in the heart of Arvandor . The great tree draws into itself all the ebb and flow of the season and the lives within the woodlands of the green elves .
description_long: Rillifane Rallathil Rillifane Rallathil ( RILL - ih - fane RALL - uh - thihl ) is the elven god of protection of woodlands and the guardian of the harmony of nature . His priests liken him to a giant ethereal oak tree so huge that its roots mingle with every other plant , which stands in the heart of Arvandor . The great tree draws into itself all the ebb and flow of the season and the lives within the woodlands of the green elves . At the same time it defends and protects those lands against disease , predation and assault of all kinds . The Leaflord is the patron of the " Sy ' Tel ' Quessir " and revered by many voadkyn . The Leaflord is quiet , reflective and enduring over eons unchanged . He is the least flighty of the Seldarine , the least likely to act on a whim , and often grave and self - absorbed . Rillifane ' s avatar manifests only rarely , disliking direct action and preferring to act through his priests . When he does , it is usually in response to an attack on an elven ( usually " Sy ' Tel ' Quessir " ) habitat , and is heralded by sudden gusts of winds shaking leaves from trees . History .

title: Rillo Leadstopper
description: Rillo Leadstopper Rillo Leadstopper was a gnome tinkerer in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Rillo and his daughter Villonah were always at odds with each other .
description_long: Rillo Leadstopper Rillo Leadstopper was a gnome tinkerer in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Rillo and his daughter Villonah were always at odds with each other . Even at a young age , Villonah had trouble with the law . Usually she was captured by the Knights of the Black Fist and released after Rillo paid for the damage she did . In 1489 DR , she disappeared , prompting Rillo to go to Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle to hire some adventurers to help him find her .

title: Rilrae Zolond
description: Rilrae Zolond Rilrae Zolond was member of House Zolond and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Rilrae was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith .
description_long: Rilrae Zolond Rilrae Zolond was member of House Zolond and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Rilrae was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith . She was possessed by one of the demon s sent by Gromph Baenre to kill his sister Mistress Quenthel Baenre , profiting off the Silence of Lolth . However , Quenthel noticed Rilrae ' s the strange behavior in time and immediately killed her , thwarting the assassination attempt .

title: Rilsa Rael
description: Rilsa Rael Rilsa Rael was a crime lord of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Rilsa thought that the Flaming Fists were unnecessarily cruel and uncaring of the poor of the city and believed that the nobles and rich were all to blame for the terrible conditions of the inhabitants of the Outer City district .
description_long: Rilsa Rael Rilsa Rael was a crime lord of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Rilsa thought that the Flaming Fists were unnecessarily cruel and uncaring of the poor of the city and believed that the nobles and rich were all to blame for the terrible conditions of the inhabitants of the Outer City district . History . Rilsa was one of the high - ranking members of the Guild . In 1479 DR , Rilsa was involved in the crisis that culminated in the resurrection of Bhaal .

title: Riltana
description: Riltana Riltana was a windsoul genasi rogue who lived in Airspur . She posed as a messenger for the Airstepper ' s Guild but was in reality an accomplished rogue . Riltana was able to use the air to leap further than otherwise possible .
description_long: Riltana Riltana was a windsoul genasi rogue who lived in Airspur . She posed as a messenger for the Airstepper ' s Guild but was in reality an accomplished rogue . Riltana was able to use the air to leap further than otherwise possible . She lived in a loft in a fashionable district in Airspur . History . Riltana was hired by Kalkan to steal a magic scarf from a deva named Demascus . Kalkan used the Damos artifact to predict years in advance when and where Demascus would be and he instructed Riltana to steal the scarf at that time . Demascus and Chant Morven tracked down Riltana and retrieved the scarf . She agreed to help them investigate demonic cult activity in Airspur and was instrumental in uncovering the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye . In Leafall of 1479 DR , Queen Arathane asked Demascus and Riltana to investigate potential trouble at an arambarium mine on Ithimir Isle off the coast of Akanûl . While investigating , they stumbled upon a drow plot to steal arambarium lead by a priestess of Lolth from Menzoberranzan named Chenraya Xorlarrin . Demascus , Riltana , Arathane and Chant and Jaul Morven sailed to Ithimir Isle and fought Chenraya and her minions .

title: Rilyanna Saerfynn
description: Rilyanna Saerfynn Rilyanna Saerfynn was a young noblewoman and , with her brother Callak , was the last of her family . Rilyanna ' s parents died when she was young and she lived at the family manor with her brother . The dark angel Sathariel visited her when she was a child and she agreed to serve Asmodeus .
description_long: Rilyanna Saerfynn Rilyanna Saerfynn was a young noblewoman and , with her brother Callak , was the last of her family . Rilyanna ' s parents died when she was young and she lived at the family manor with her brother . The dark angel Sathariel visited her when she was a child and she agreed to serve Asmodeus .
