Rilyanna attempted to finish the ritual of the First Flensing to bring Asmodeus to Waterdeep but was killed by Quessahn Uthraebor . Relationships . Rilyanna was rumored to have had incestuous relations with her brother , a rumor that appears to have been true .

title: Rimaq al - Nimar
description: Rimaq al - Nimar Rimaq al - Nimar was a priest and of I ' tiraf in the Cities of the Pantheon . History . Around 1367 DR , Rimaq al - Nimar was the emir of I ' tiraf and the most influential leader in the League of the Pantheon .
description_long: Rimaq al - Nimar Rimaq al - Nimar was a priest and of I ' tiraf in the Cities of the Pantheon . History . Around 1367 DR , Rimaq al - Nimar was the emir of I ' tiraf and the most influential leader in the League of the Pantheon .

title: Rimardo Domine
description: Rimardo Domine Rimardo Domine was a male human wizard , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . He was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . Description .
description_long: Rimardo Domine Rimardo Domine was a male human wizard , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . He was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . Description . Domine was a very imposing man , standing 6 feet and several inches tall , with a muscular physique . He had the typical quadrangular Turmish beard ; he also always dressed in the style of Turmish ' s merchants and decorated his rooms with his home country ' s look , consisting of artistic treasures and perfumed with Turmish incense . Personality . On the surface , Domine was always cordial and friendly , but he pursued only his own interests , not caring if someone was hurt in the process . However , he had a personal ethical code that , for example , prohibited him from harming children and always accepting the surrender of an honorable enemy . His loyalty to the Host Tower of the Arcane derived from his conviction that the Arcane Brotherhood could better govern the North than the many independent cities spread across it . Domine required that visitors to his rooms always brought him some fine food . History .

title: Rimlost
description: Rimlost Rimlost was a tower located on the northern region of Fimbrul , that served as a temple for the followers of the primordial cults of Returned Abeir . Background . Rimlost was the most sacred place of worship in Returned Abeir .
description_long: Rimlost Rimlost was a tower located on the northern region of Fimbrul , that served as a temple for the followers of the primordial cults of Returned Abeir . Background . Rimlost was the most sacred place of worship in Returned Abeir . Followers of the primordials never spoke of the site for fear that dragon s would discover it and form a coalition to destroy the tower . Legacy . The town of the same in Gontal was founded in 1385 DR by Prince Nathur Hethkantan as his way to honor this tower .

title: Rimlost ( keep )
description: Rimlost ( keep ) Rimlost was a fortress located on the southern shore of Glaur Lake , on the kingdom of Gontal . Background . Rimlost was a small trading town and a popular stop for explorers and adventurers seeking a place to use as a base of operations while exploring the Glaur Barrens .
description_long: Rimlost ( keep ) Rimlost was a fortress located on the southern shore of Glaur Lake , on the kingdom of Gontal . Background . Rimlost was a small trading town and a popular stop for explorers and adventurers seeking a place to use as a base of operations while exploring the Glaur Barrens . History . While on the world of Abeir , Rimlost was founded in 1385 DR by Prince Nathur Hethkantan to serve as a base of operations during his ill - fated expedition to the Glaur Barrens . It was named in honor of a tower of the same name located in Fimbrul .

title: Rimmen
description: Rimmen Rimmen of the Scarlet Eye was a magelord who carried himself with the attitude of those who practiced the same magic in Athalantar , that is , one of supremacy through magical might . He particularly enjoyed showing off with his arcane skill to intimidate others . Possessins .
description_long: Rimmen Rimmen of the Scarlet Eye was a magelord who carried himself with the attitude of those who practiced the same magic in Athalantar , that is , one of supremacy through magical might . He particularly enjoyed showing off with his arcane skill to intimidate others . Possessins . Among Rimmen ' s possessions were a ring of counterspells , a dusty rose ioun stone and a headband of intellect .

title: Rinda
description: Rinda Rinda was the author of the " Cyrinishad " and the " True Life of Cyric " . Personality . Rinda genuinely cared for people around her , especially those less fortunate .
description_long: Rinda Rinda was the author of the " Cyrinishad " and the " True Life of Cyric " . Personality . Rinda genuinely cared for people around her , especially those less fortunate . She was very serious in her duty to keep secret the " Cyrinishad " , in order to keep it out of evil hands . History . Rinda was born to a scribe in Zhentil Keep and grew up in a slum . In 1368 DR , her father failed to create a magic book for the god Cyric and out of desperation said that Rinda was more able than him . Cyric ' s minions abducted her and made Rinda write the " Cyrinishad " . Noticing her talents , the gods Oghma , Mystra , and Mask instructed Rinda to also write the " True Life of Cyric " to counterbalance the evil of the " Cyrinishad " . In the end , the plotting around the two books caused the destruction of Zhentil , but thanks to Oghma ' s protection Rinda managed to escape , with orders to keep the " Cyrinshad " away from " all " gods . From that day , Rinda wandered Toril .

title: Rindon Wasatho
description: Rindon Wasatho Rindon Wasatho is a guide for , as well as a member of , the organization known as the Fellowship of the Purple Staff . He often leads new members through the Gulthmere Forest or east to the region between Turmish and the Sea of Fallen Stars . Rindon is entirely loyal to the group and is perhaps the most trusted of their agents .
description_long: Rindon Wasatho Rindon Wasatho is a guide for , as well as a member of , the organization known as the Fellowship of the Purple Staff . He often leads new members through the Gulthmere Forest or east to the region between Turmish and the Sea of Fallen Stars . Rindon is entirely loyal to the group and is perhaps the most trusted of their agents . Personality . A quiet and small - framed man , Rindon is easily mistaken for a wild elf . He is particularly quiet , preferring to speak through his actions . He is also known for the extensive observation he takes before deciding to make contact with a person he does not know . One being Rindon does trust is his animal companion , a bloodhound . Possessions . Among Rindons possessions are a deck of Tashalan divination cards ( which were given to him by his father ) , a + 1 short sword of dwarven craftsmanship and a pair of boots of elvenkind . Rindon wore masterwork studded leather armor .

title: Ring of Myrkul
description: Ring of Myrkul A ring of Myrkul was a magical ring originally worn by a priest of Myrkul . Description . A " ring of Myrkul " was a relatively thick gold band painted black adorned with an image of a white flaming skull ( the symbol of Myrkul ) .
description_long: Ring of Myrkul A ring of Myrkul was a magical ring originally worn by a priest of Myrkul . Description . A " ring of Myrkul " was a relatively thick gold band painted black adorned with an image of a white flaming skull ( the symbol of Myrkul ) . Evil , intelligent creatures who passed within 30 feet of a " ring of Myrkul " were drawn to it . Powers . " Rings of Myrkul " served as keys for priests of Myrkul to enter a temple of Myrkul safely . They also allowed the wearer the ability to walk among the undead without being attacked ( unless the wearer attacked the undead ) . Additionally , the rings had a few offensive abilities , including casting the spells " chill touch " and " ghoul touch " . Before the Time of Troubles ( 1358 DR ) , the rings had greater necromantic powers that could be invoked by Myrkulites , but after the Time of Troubles those powers disappeared . History . When Myrkul was killed in 1358 DR , his secret temple in the Mere of Dead Men in the Sword Coast North sank into the swamp . The priests escaped into the Mere but were killed , their rings falling into the possession of the beasts of the Mere .

title: Ring of avian control
description: Ring of avian control A ring of avian control was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types .
description_long: Ring of avian control A ring of avian control was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types . Powers . The wearer of this ring could completely control any bird with lower intelligence . The wearer could control multiple birds at once depending on how large or strong they were . Complete concentration was needed to maintain control of the birds and give them any order . Bird - like creatures or bird hybrids could not be controlled by these rings .

title: Ring of burning
description: Ring of burning A ring of burning grants the wielder the same powers as a ring of spell storing , containing " Aganazzar ' s scorcher " , " beltyn ' s burning blood " , " fire gate " , " flamestrike " and " shroud of flame " . One of these rings is believed to be housed at the House of the Morning .
description_long: Ring of burning A ring of burning grants the wielder the same powers as a ring of spell storing , containing " Aganazzar ' s scorcher " , " beltyn ' s burning blood " , " fire gate " , " flamestrike " and " shroud of flame " . One of these rings is believed to be housed at the House of the Morning .

title: Ring of cloaked wizardry
description: Ring of cloaked wizardry Rings of cloaked wizardry were special rings found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , whose enchantments were difficult to detect by magical means . Powers . These rings were similar to any other magic ring found on Al - Toril save for the fact that casting " detect magic " did not reveal that the ring was in fact magical .
description_long: Ring of cloaked wizardry Rings of cloaked wizardry were special rings found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , whose enchantments were difficult to detect by magical means . Powers . These rings were similar to any other magic ring found on Al - Toril save for the fact that casting " detect magic " did not reveal that the ring was in fact magical . Spells such as " identify " and " legend lore " worked normally when used on a " ring of cloaked wizardry " .

title: Ring of disintegration
description: Ring of disintegration Ring of disintegration was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created a small bit of disintegrating matter .
description_long: Ring of disintegration Ring of disintegration was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created a small bit of disintegrating matter . Upon impact this bit grew to a 6 inch circlet . Targets struck by this circlet suffer intense pain and immediately lose an appendage , determined at random . Larger creatures only suffered from the pain and did not lose an appendage . Components . This spell required a silver bracelet to cast . The bracelet needed to be worth at least 100 gp and have a bit of mithril worked into the silver . The bracelet was consumed once the spell was cast .

title: Ring of dragons
description: Ring of dragons A ring of dragons was a magic ring that , as the name suggested , bestowed dragon - related powers . Description . It was a brass ring that resembled a dragon or serpent biting its own tail .
description_long: Ring of dragons A ring of dragons was a magic ring that , as the name suggested , bestowed dragon - related powers . Description . It was a brass ring that resembled a dragon or serpent biting its own tail . Usage . They were made by the Cult of the Dragon and particularly used by its upper echelons . They ' d created around 70 such rings by 1372 DR . Powers . The wearer could communicate verbally ( such as by " tongues " ) or telepathically ( in the manner of " Rary ' s telepathic bond " ) with any dragon he or she could see . They could also cast a " silent image " once a day of any dragon he or she had seen with their own eyes . They could also call to any dracolich or evil dragon by name , although this did not guarantee that the creature would respond or arrive , or be helpful . The dragon or dracolich knew the wearer ' s location and could use it to locate them . The call continued until the user ended it , removed the ring , or died . Creation . Forging of a " ring of dragons " required the spell s " detect thoughts " , " sending " , " silent image " , and " tongues " . The ring was worth around 25 , 000 gold piece s .

title: Ring of enduring arcana
description: Ring of enduring arcana Rings of enduring arcana render a spellcaster ' s spells more resistant to dispelling . Creation . To forge a " ring of enduring arcana " , a spellcaster must have " dispel magic " available .
description_long: Ring of enduring arcana Rings of enduring arcana render a spellcaster ' s spells more resistant to dispelling . Creation . To forge a " ring of enduring arcana " , a spellcaster must have " dispel magic " available . Appearance . A " ring of enduring arcana " appears as a fine latticework of gold and mithral that covers most of the length of the wearer ' s finger , with a joint in the middle to allow movement . It seems to shift and flow whenever the wearer casts a spell . Activation . A " ring of enduring arcana " is permanently active for as long as it is worn . However , it does require 24 hours to acclimate to the wearer , starting when it is donned .

title: Ring of feather falling
description: Ring of feather falling A ring of feather falling was a common magical ring that protected the wearer from injury or death from falling . Description . " Rings of feather falling " were crafted with an intricate feather pattern around the whole ring .
description_long: Ring of feather falling A ring of feather falling was a common magical ring that protected the wearer from injury or death from falling . Description . " Rings of feather falling " were crafted with an intricate feather pattern around the whole ring . Although not required for their construction , the rings were often decorated with malachite , because common folk believed ( erroneously ) that the stone had gravitational intervention powers . " Rings of feather falling " gave off a faint transmutation aura . They typically sold for 2 , 200 gold pieces . Abilities . The ring automatically activated the same effect as the " feather fall " spell , whenever the wearer dropped suddenly more than five feet ( 150 centimeters ) , causing him or her to drop slowly like a feather . Creation . Such a ring could be made by anyone trained in the art of crafting magic rings who also knew how to cast the spell " feather fall " .

title: Ring of folly
description: Ring of folly Rings of folly were cursed magic items that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Rings of folly " could be found with a wide array of decorations and made from different metals .
description_long: Ring of folly Rings of folly were cursed magic items that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Rings of folly " could be found with a wide array of decorations and made from different metals . Powers . When worn , this cursed ring drained the wearer ' s natural intelligence and wisdom until they were bumbling idiots . This draining effect was subtle and only noticed when the wearer was required to perform some act requiring rational thought , such as to cast a spell or recite a poem . A " ring of folly " could only be removed with a combination of " remove curse " and " dispel magic " spells , at which point the wearer ' s senses would slowly return to them if given enough bed rest . In some cases " rings of folly " granted beneficial magic such as " feather falling " or " invisibility " in addition to their cursed effect .

title: Ring of frost
description: Ring of frost A ring of frost was a magical ring capable of producing frost . Powers . A " ring of frost " functioned like a " wand of frost " , though it had an unlimited number of charges .
description_long: Ring of frost A ring of frost was a magical ring capable of producing frost . Powers . A " ring of frost " functioned like a " wand of frost " , though it had an unlimited number of charges . History . " Circa " 1369 DR , Ascalan , a retired wizard and fishmonger of The Fish House in Wheloon , Cormyr , owned a " ring of frost " . He used it to refrigerate fish and create blocks of ice for sale .

title: Ring of gaki - protection
description: Ring of gaki - protection A ring of gaki - protection was a magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This item was a plain silver ring .
description_long: Ring of gaki - protection A ring of gaki - protection was a magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This item was a plain silver ring . Powers . When worn by a priest , this ring allowed the wearer to turn all kinds of vile gaki as if they were undead .

title: Ring of genie summoning
description: Ring of genie summoning A ring of genie summoning was a magical ring that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This magical ring was able to summon a particular genie from its elemental plane .
description_long: Ring of genie summoning A ring of genie summoning was a magical ring that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This magical ring was able to summon a particular genie from its elemental plane . Each ring summoned either a genie or a noble genie . A summoned genie served the owner of the ring loyally until the genie was slain . The ring would become an ordinary ring upon the death of the genie . Summoned noble genies left their master ' s service after granting three wish es . If a sha ' ir was powerful enough , she or he could free regular genies from the ring and were sometimes granted a wish that was free from any obligation .

title: Ring of hands
description: Ring of hands Ring of hands was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a circle that acted as a zone of " protection from evil " . The reverse , ring of woe , had the identical effect except it created a zone of " protection from good " . Effects .
description_long: Ring of hands Ring of hands was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a circle that acted as a zone of " protection from evil " . The reverse , ring of woe , had the identical effect except it created a zone of " protection from good " . Effects . Two to ten priests were required to cast this spell simultaneously and then join hands at the conclusion of the ritual . Once cast , the priests and all those within the circle were encompassed by a barrier that acted like an enhanced " protection from evil " spell , with armor and spell resistance effects increased for every priest beyond the minimum two required to cast the spell . However , if any participant broke the circle , or if a protected being attacked a warded extraplanar or summoned creature outside the circle , the spell was immediately canceled . Since the priests did not have freedom of movement and their hands were occupied , they did not have much chance to dodge blows and this negated the improvement in armor conferred by " protection from evil " . However , with more than two priests in the circle , armor benefits were again better than nothing .

title: Ring of lore
description: Ring of lore A ring of lore was a magical ring giving powers of knowledge . Powers . It granted the wearer the ability to cast " legend lore " and " stone tell " once each per tenday with the correct command word .
description_long: Ring of lore A ring of lore was a magical ring giving powers of knowledge . Powers . It granted the wearer the ability to cast " legend lore " and " stone tell " once each per tenday with the correct command word . They could also find magical traps with the knack of a rogue . Creation . One required knowledge of the spells " find traps " , " legend lore " , and " stone tell " as well as the ability to forge magical rings to craft a " ring of lore " . Cost . The ring was worth around 23 , 250 gold pieces .

title: Ring of mind shielding
description: Ring of mind shielding A ring of mind shielding is a magical device that helps keep the one who wears it continually immune to the spells " detect thoughts " , " discern lies " , and any attempt to magically discern his or her alignment . It is worth 8 , 000 gp . Appearance .
description_long: Ring of mind shielding A ring of mind shielding is a magical device that helps keep the one who wears it continually immune to the spells " detect thoughts " , " discern lies " , and any attempt to magically discern his or her alignment . It is worth 8 , 000 gp . Appearance . This ring is usually of fine workmanship and wrought from heavy gold . Creation . A " nondetection " spell is needed in the creation of a " ring of mind shielding " . Users . Many nobles , rebels , shopkeepers that deal in magic , and people that are part of the black market that deals in magic commonly use " rings of mind shielding " .

title: Ring of negation
description: Ring of negation A Ring of Negation was a cursed ring useful for controlling captive mage s . The purpose of the ring was to prevent the wearer from casting spells . Whenever the mage wearing the ring attempted to use magic , searing pain shot up their arm .
description_long: Ring of negation A Ring of Negation was a cursed ring useful for controlling captive mage s . The purpose of the ring was to prevent the wearer from casting spells . Whenever the mage wearing the ring attempted to use magic , searing pain shot up their arm . In theory , the ring could be removed by cutting off the finger . However , since so many spells depended on complicated hand gestures , removing the ring by amputating a finger wasn ' t a practical option .

title: Ring of nine lives
description: Ring of nine lives A ring of nine lives is an ivory ring with the face of a snarling cat . If the wearer falls unconscious or dies , one of the ring ' s " lives " will be used automatically to cast a " heal " spell on the wearer . Also , if the wearer needs extremely quick reflexes , strong willpower or extreme fortitude , he or she can use one of the " lives " for this purpose .
description_long: Ring of nine lives A ring of nine lives is an ivory ring with the face of a snarling cat . If the wearer falls unconscious or dies , one of the ring ' s " lives " will be used automatically to cast a " heal " spell on the wearer . Also , if the wearer needs extremely quick reflexes , strong willpower or extreme fortitude , he or she can use one of the " lives " for this purpose . One of these rings is worth around 70 , 000 gold pieces if all " lives " are intact , but usually these rings are found with some of the " lives " used up .

title: Ring of nondetection
description: Ring of nondetection A ring of nondetection makes it impossible to detect the whereabouts of a person wearing the ring . Appearance . A ring of nondetection is normally made of plain gold .
description_long: Ring of nondetection A ring of nondetection makes it impossible to detect the whereabouts of a person wearing the ring . Appearance . A ring of nondetection is normally made of plain gold . Realmslore . Alusair Obarskyr wore a ring of nondetection for years to avoid being found by Vangerdahast . Rings of nondetection can be found for sale in Raven ' s Bluff .

title: Ring of protection
description: Ring of protection A ring of protection was a magical device that helped keep the one who wore it from physical harm . The ring could deflect a small part of most attacks . Creation .
description_long: Ring of protection A ring of protection was a magical device that helped keep the one who wore it from physical harm . The ring could deflect a small part of most attacks . Creation . " Rings of protection " were old items , and the knowledge to create them was quite well - known . A " shield of faith " spell was needed in the creation , so they were made mostly by cleric s .

title: Ring of spell storing
description: Ring of spell storing A ring of spell storing was a magic ring that stored a number of spell s . Powers . As the name suggested , a " ring of spell storing " stored a spell for later use .
description_long: Ring of spell storing A ring of spell storing was a magic ring that stored a number of spell s . Powers . As the name suggested , a " ring of spell storing " stored a spell for later use . To store a spell , the spellcaster simply cast the spell as normal , but targeted to the ring , and the spell remained intact within it . The spell could then be released and fully cast by anyone who wore the ring . This allowed a spellcaster to prepare a spell for a non - spellcaster , or cast a spell from a scroll into the ring for later use . Multiple spellcasters , and both arcane and divine casters , could have spells in a single " ring of spell storing " . Different levels and numbers of spells could be stored according to the type of ring . A " minor ring of spell storing " stored three levels , so three 1st - level spells or one 2nd - level spell and two 1st - level spells could be stored in it . A standard " ring of spell storing " stored five levels , and a " major ring of spell storing " stored ten levels . Creation . Along with the skill to craft magic rings , a creator required the " imbue with spell ability " spell . History .

title: Ring of spellbattle
description: Ring of spellbattle A ring of spellbattle ( also spelled ring of spell - battle ) was a gold ring inset with silver spheres and communicated to its wearer any spellcasting that occured within 60 feet ( 20m ) . If the wearer knew spellcraft , it was possible that he or she could identify the spell , even if he or she could not see it at all , and once per day , the ring could be commanded to cast " dispel magic " as a counterspell or change the target of the spell , but only to new targets within 60 feet ( 20m ) . Otherwise the redirection failed .
description_long: Ring of spellbattle A ring of spellbattle ( also spelled ring of spell - battle ) was a gold ring inset with silver spheres and communicated to its wearer any spellcasting that occured within 60 feet ( 20m ) . If the wearer knew spellcraft , it was possible that he or she could identify the spell , even if he or she could not see it at all , and once per day , the ring could be commanded to cast " dispel magic " as a counterspell or change the target of the spell , but only to new targets within 60 feet ( 20m ) . Otherwise the redirection failed . The ring was worth around 70 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Ring of sustenance
description: Ring of sustenance A ring of sustenance was a useful magical ring that provided the benefit of nourishment and restful effects while worn . Powers . Wearers did not require food or drink , and required much less in the way of actual sleep .
description_long: Ring of sustenance A ring of sustenance was a useful magical ring that provided the benefit of nourishment and restful effects while worn . Powers . Wearers did not require food or drink , and required much less in the way of actual sleep . For the ring to work properly , it attuned itself to its user . This process involved wearing the ring for a full week ( 7 days ) , while performing normal actions . Removing the ring at any time started the process over . After the week passed , the ring functioned normally . The wearer could elect to sleep only 2 hours , and gain the benefit of a full 8 hour rest . Wizard spells were not memorized faster with this benefit , however , and still required the normal study time . A " ring of sustenance " had a base value of 3 , 500gp .

title: Ring of telekinesis
description: Ring of telekinesis A ring of telekinesis was a magical ring that allowed the bearer to use the spell " telekinesis " at will . Powers . As the name suggested , the ring gave the wearer the power of " telekinesis " , allowing them to move items and creatures weighing up to 225 lb ( 102 kg ) .
description_long: Ring of telekinesis A ring of telekinesis was a magical ring that allowed the bearer to use the spell " telekinesis " at will . Powers . As the name suggested , the ring gave the wearer the power of " telekinesis " , allowing them to move items and creatures weighing up to 225 lb ( 102 kg ) . They could be moved with a gentle , sustained force , attacked in a variety of weighs , or hurled up to 90 ft ( 27 m ) with great force . This last application could be applied to up to nine creatures or objects , but only to the limit of the mass . Description . The " ring of telekinesis " worn by Kilili was very large , consisting of a large round red gem in a gold setting . It emitted a pale orange beam that enveloped its target . History . The drow magic - user Kilili possessed a " ring of telekinesis " . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , she used it to rescue — and then capture — her sister Cybriana after she was dropped by a gargoyle on route to Imgig Zu ' s tower . This ring remained with Kyriani , the result of a merger of Kilili and Cybriana . It returned to Kilili when the two later separated .

title: Ring of the Unquenchable
description: Ring of the Unquenchable The Ring of the Unquenchable was an efreeti military force located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . Though they were a slave legion , the efreeti mamluk s of the Ring of the Unquenchable were favored by the Sultan .
description_long: Ring of the Unquenchable The Ring of the Unquenchable was an efreeti military force located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . Though they were a slave legion , the efreeti mamluk s of the Ring of the Unquenchable were favored by the Sultan . Base of Operations . The City of Brass served as the base of the Ring of the Unquenchable . Their barracks were located near the Charcoal Palace and the major mosques within the ward of Castings .

title: Ring of the holy slayer
description: Ring of the holy slayer Rings of the holy slayer were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special rings were only used by holy slayer s . Powers .
description_long: Ring of the holy slayer Rings of the holy slayer were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special rings were only used by holy slayer s . Powers . These rings pumped deadly poison into the wearer when a command word was uttered . The fanatical holy slayers wore these rings to avoid being captured and questioned . Once slain , the deceased holy slayer could not be interrogated through " speak with the dead " spell s or similar methods . Once used , these rings lost their wicked enchantment .

title: Ring of the vizier
description: Ring of the vizier The ring of the vizier was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types .
description_long: Ring of the vizier The ring of the vizier was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types . Powers . These rings were similar to " message ring s " . When a command word was uttered , the face of the creator of the ring appeared in the center gem . The image of the face was capable of relaying a message that could last for one minute . The creator of these rings could also store one medium - powered spell within the ring . This spell could be used 10 times before it expired .

title: Ring of youth
description: Ring of youth Rings of youth were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . Any wearer of these rings only aged at one - third of the normal rate .
description_long: Ring of youth Rings of youth were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . Any wearer of these rings only aged at one - third of the normal rate . These rings were usable by any class . These rings only slowed the aging time from the moment they were put on . Removal of the ring would bring the aging time back to normal , but the wearer did not rapidly age from the time since they first donned the ring .

title: Ringed Nose
description: Ringed Nose The Ringed Nose was a tavern in East Sabban of Keltar that was a good place to discuss secrets . The tavern was one of the more " seedy " bars in East Sabban . It was situated amongst the slaughterhouses of that district , and thus the stench was usually terrible , no matter how good the food being served there might actually smell .
description_long: Ringed Nose The Ringed Nose was a tavern in East Sabban of Keltar that was a good place to discuss secrets . The tavern was one of the more " seedy " bars in East Sabban . It was situated amongst the slaughterhouses of that district , and thus the stench was usually terrible , no matter how good the food being served there might actually smell . It was a place frequented by the butchers of the city , and most nights the half - orc staff had to work hard to contain the fights that broke out among the patrons . Despite its poor location and the frequency of brawling , this dive was actually a fitting place to tell secrets ; the bartenders were discreet and most people got so drunk they were not likely to remember any conversations they might have overheard .

title: Ringreemeralxoth
description: Ringreemeralxoth Ringreemeralxoth was a young adult green dragon that , as of 1370 DR , lived in the Snakewood southwest of Brigand ' s Gorge and west of the Gulf of Storms . Personality . Ring was was not overly aggressive and tended to stay close to his lair .
description_long: Ringreemeralxoth Ringreemeralxoth was a young adult green dragon that , as of 1370 DR , lived in the Snakewood southwest of Brigand ' s Gorge and west of the Gulf of Storms . Personality . Ring was was not overly aggressive and tended to stay close to his lair . He was dissatisfied with his Snakewood location and was cautiously building his strength before attempting to challenge another dragon for territory . Activities . Ring rarely left the forest , but was known to occasionally hunt the surrounding countryside . History . Ring once ambushed a cadre of highwaymen and acquired a large amount of treasure for his hoard , only to lose it and nearly his life to a pack of 30 troll s .

title: Rings of arbitration
description: Rings of arbitration Rings of arbitration are a pair of rings crafted for lovers who are bound body and soul . They are both a blessing and a curse because through the power of the rings a burden , such as drain of life - force , is shared between the wearers . The rings were created long ago by magic long lost to the world and only a few pairs exist .
description_long: Rings of arbitration Rings of arbitration are a pair of rings crafted for lovers who are bound body and soul . They are both a blessing and a curse because through the power of the rings a burden , such as drain of life - force , is shared between the wearers . The rings were created long ago by magic long lost to the world and only a few pairs exist . They are gold bands with a clear gemstone set in each which reflects the condition of its wearer - turning to black when that person ' s energy or life - force nears its end .

title: Riordan Parnell
description: Riordan Parnell Riordan Parnell was a human bard and a member of Spysong . Description . Riordan was lithe of build and was regarded as quite handsome .
description_long: Riordan Parnell Riordan Parnell was a human bard and a member of Spysong . Description . Riordan was lithe of build and was regarded as quite handsome . Abilities . Riordan was an extraordinary bard , whose ability to coax the truth from reluctant witnesses helped him greatly in his position as a scout for Spysong . His favorite instrument was the lute . When playing and singing , Riordan slipped enchantment s into his tunes and used the magic of his voice — the gift of true bards — to manipulate the mood of his subjects , convincing them of his friendship and trustworthiness . With the help of some fifteen bards around Vaasa and Damara , Riordan coded important messages for Gareth Dragonsbane into songs . Also , Riordan had a mobile strike force of 100 fighters under his exclusive command , which included 20 centaur cavalrymen . Relationships . Celedon Kearney was Riordan ' s cousin .

title: Ripper
description: Ripper Ripper was a fiendish displacer beast who served the drow blackguard , Zedarr T ' sarran . Description . Much larger than most displacer beast s , Ripper was as big as a dire tiger .
description_long: Ripper Ripper was a fiendish displacer beast who served the drow blackguard , Zedarr T ' sarran . Description . Much larger than most displacer beast s , Ripper was as big as a dire tiger . Due to its fiendish heritage , Ripper had rust - red fur instead of the typical black . Personality . He was fiercely loyal to and well - trained by his master , Zedarr T ' sarran . Ripper would often coordinate his movements to best aid his master , especially in combat . Abilities . Alert and agile yet much bigger and stronger than others of his kind , Ripper was a fearsome specimen . Like all displacer beasts , Ripper could " displace " its form , thereby making it harder to ascertain its true location . Additionally , Ripper ' s fiendish heritage made it much more resistant to ordinary weapons , cold , fire , and even magical attacks . Furthermore , it could imbue its own attacks with power that was devastating to goodly creatures . Relationships . Ripper served his master , Zedarr T ' sarran , to the best of his ability . History . In 1372 DR , during the Silence of Lolth , Ripper traveled with Zedarr T ' sarran from Maerimydra to Szith Morcane .

title: Ripplebark
description: Ripplebark Ripplebark was a large subterranean fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known to dwarves as " arantym " and was a major food source for orc s in the North . It grew in shelf - like formations that resembled masses of decaying flesh but had a nut - like flavor .
description_long: Ripplebark Ripplebark was a large subterranean fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known to dwarves as " arantym " and was a major food source for orc s in the North . It grew in shelf - like formations that resembled masses of decaying flesh but had a nut - like flavor . Despite its looks , it was quite edible in its raw state and could be roasted to improve the flavor . Scorched or burnt ripplebark turned black , but was still edible . A single , large shelf of ripplebark could be harvested for 7 to 10 pounds ( 3 . 2 to 4 . 5 kilograms ) of food . Ripplebark was a hardy fungus , able to grow in the coldest caverns or in geothermally heated passages . It did not require light , but thrived when light was available and flourished in heat . In drought or extreme cold it fell dormant for up to eight years waiting for a source of nutrition . It could grow on plant material , including living or dead wood , other fungi , or even pull nutrients from humid air and mist . It also cleansed any diseases that it absorbed . The steel dragon Zundaerazylym experimented with ripplebark to create a highly potent food source for dragons she called longbite .

title: Riqq
description: Riqq A riqq ( REEK ) was a Zakharan tambourine . Description . " Riqqs " were essentially tiny drum fixed with chimes or bells into slots around the sides .
description_long: Riqq A riqq ( REEK ) was a Zakharan tambourine . Description . " Riqqs " were essentially tiny drum fixed with chimes or bells into slots around the sides . History . " Riqqs " were often used by dancers to keep tempo during a performance . Smaller version of " riqqs " called " daffs " were used by the natives of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Riqq of the efreet
description: Riqq of the efreet The riqq of the efreet was an unbreakable magical musical instrument created by efreet craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " riqqs of the efreet " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description .
description_long: Riqq of the efreet The riqq of the efreet was an unbreakable magical musical instrument created by efreet craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " riqqs of the efreet " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description . The cymbals of this " riqq " , or tambourine , were created from the crushed coins collected from the Ruined Kingdoms of Nog and Kadar . The surface was wrapped tightly with the fine hide of a white camel . The steel used to create the body of the " riqq " was forged deep within a volcano , producing a crimson colored metal . The " riqq of the efreet " was painted with runes of power found within the head . Powers . Anyone holding the " riqq " who flashed the runes at someone watching effectively cast the " hold person " spell upon them . This power could be used once per day , but bard s and " rawunin " could perform this act twice per day . Bards and " rawunin " could also " fan the flames " with the " riqq " , summoning a strong fire elemental under their control .

title: Rise of the King
description: Rise of the King Rise of the King is the second book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Rise of the King Rise of the King is the second book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . As the Darkening settles across the land , the drow minions of Quenthel Baenre incite the frost giant s of the Shining White and two white dragon s , Arauthator and Aurbangras , to go to war against the Silver Marches alongside the orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . This is all done , unbeknownst to any but the drow , for the glory of the Spider Queen in her quest to gain the domain of Mystra and get revenge against the renegade Drizzt Do ' Urden . Meanwhile , Drizzt and the other Companions of the Hall — Catti - brie , Bruenor Battlehammer , Regis , and Wulfgar — are resting in Port Llast after their escape from Gauntlgrym / Q ' Xorlarrin . They run into Effron and reveal to him the apparent demise of his mother , Dahlia Sin ' felle , as they leave town for Longsaddle in order to redeem their friend Thibbledorf Pwent from his vampiric curse .

title: Risen Sun heresy
description: Risen Sun heresy The Risen Sun heresy is the belief that the time of Lathander ' s transformation is nigh and Amaunator is about to return . The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun has long existed within the church of Lathander , tolerated by other followers of the Morninglord and preaching that Lathander is the reincarnated form of Amaunator . Believers of the Risen Sun take this one step further into heresy .
description_long: Risen Sun heresy The Risen Sun heresy is the belief that the time of Lathander ' s transformation is nigh and Amaunator is about to return . The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun has long existed within the church of Lathander , tolerated by other followers of the Morninglord and preaching that Lathander is the reincarnated form of Amaunator . Believers of the Risen Sun take this one step further into heresy . Sunlord Daelegoth Orndeir , the leader of the Brotherhood , has embraced the Risen Sun heresy and since 1374 DR has sought to make it the core belief system of those faithful to Lathander . He has accomplished this by recruiting converts to the faith of Amaunator through preaching and performing miracles . Risen Sun heretics have access to the fire , law , nobility , renewal , sun , and time spell domains .

title: Ristamar Rhaal
description: Ristamar Rhaal Ristamar Rhaal was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Personality . Lord Rhaal was a very dignified man , but he still maintained a sense of humor .
description_long: Ristamar Rhaal Ristamar Rhaal was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Personality . Lord Rhaal was a very dignified man , but he still maintained a sense of humor . Activities . Ristamar was an Amnian noble and the chairman of the council of Boar ' s Head s of the Order of the Blue Boar , as well as the owner of Castle Blue . He usually dealt with major government issues , thanks to his connections as a noble . When in combat , Ristamar wore a suit of full plate armor and led cavalry units .

title: Risuak Lake
description: Risuak Lake Risuak Lake was a small , fresh - water lake in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , known for the quality of its fishing . Risuak Lake was located northwest of the Lugalpgotak Sea and was connected to that great body of water by a stream . The village of Vekkak was on its shores , and Gotokok was found along the stream to the south .
description_long: Risuak Lake Risuak Lake was a small , fresh - water lake in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , known for the quality of its fishing . Risuak Lake was located northwest of the Lugalpgotak Sea and was connected to that great body of water by a stream . The village of Vekkak was on its shores , and Gotokok was found along the stream to the south .

title: Rite of Blood
description: Rite of Blood Rite of Blood is a short story by Elaine Cunningham . Plot . Young Liriel Baenre , daughter of Gromph Baenre , has reached the age for her Blooding .
description_long: Rite of Blood Rite of Blood is a short story by Elaine Cunningham . Plot . Young Liriel Baenre , daughter of Gromph Baenre , has reached the age for her Blooding . While her instructor , Xandra Shobalar , prepares a Red Wizard to be able to overcome the drow maiden and rid her of the hated disciple , Liriel meets her father for the first time since she left his household . Publications . " Rite of Blood " is available in the following publications :

title: Rite of Rebirth
description: Rite of Rebirth The Rite of Rebirth was ritual created by the god Bahamut designed to transform good - aligned non - draconic humanoids into dragonborn of Bahamut . Background . The Platinum Dragon rejected the thought of breeding creatures to oppose the aberrant creations of Tiamat .
description_long: Rite of Rebirth The Rite of Rebirth was ritual created by the god Bahamut designed to transform good - aligned non - draconic humanoids into dragonborn of Bahamut . Background . The Platinum Dragon rejected the thought of breeding creatures to oppose the aberrant creations of Tiamat . He instead sought out humanoid volunteers of any non - draconic race who had shown strong determination and the will to work against vile draconic creatures . A potential recruit ' s past didn ' t mattered to Bahamut while the candidate had demonstrated the commitment to oppose Tiamat and her spawn . Even wrongdoers found redemption and purpose in becoming Bahamut ' s servants . Usually , Bahamut called those humanoids he had chose before adolescence , but sometimes adults heard the call of Bahamut as well . The call was a courteous mental question , asking in the hearts and souls of those deemed worthy if were willing to undertake the duty to protect the world from the spawn of Tiamat , giving up all that they were until that moment of their lives for a life of hardships and sacrifices .

title: Rite of Unwinding
description: Rite of Unwinding The Rite of Unwinding was a Shar ran ritual designed to create an ever - expanding dead - magic zone by slowly suppressing the Weave ( as destroying it would also destroy the Shadow Weave ) . The disruption to the Weave caused by this ritual reacted violently to users of silver fire , causing them to be hurt badly every moment they spent within the ritual ' s radius . The closer one got to the source of the ritual , the worse its effects became , with the worst being a dead - magic zone that allowed the Shadow Weave to still function .
description_long: Rite of Unwinding The Rite of Unwinding was a Shar ran ritual designed to create an ever - expanding dead - magic zone by slowly suppressing the Weave ( as destroying it would also destroy the Shadow Weave ) . The disruption to the Weave caused by this ritual reacted violently to users of silver fire , causing them to be hurt badly every moment they spent within the ritual ' s radius . The closer one got to the source of the ritual , the worse its effects became , with the worst being a dead - magic zone that allowed the Shadow Weave to still function . It has only been recorded as being used once . In the second battle for Shadowdale between the Army of Darkhope and Shadowdale ' s defenders , Sharran allies of the Zhentarim began the ritual and sealed the defenders ' fate . Without full access to the Weave , the defenders were even more easily outmatched . Eventually , however , adventurers disrupted the ritual and Syluné Silverhand expended all of her energy to reverse the process , destroying herself as a result .

title: Ritual
description: Ritual A Ritual is a complex ceremony that create magical effects . History . Rituals are as old as magic use itself .
description_long: Ritual A Ritual is a complex ceremony that create magical effects . History . Rituals are as old as magic use itself . . Days of Thunder . The Sarrukh used one of the first rituals to create large numbers of reptilian creatures during the Days of Thunder . Era of Upheaval . Following the Spellplague magic use changed the way rituals functioned . . Rituals are now set forth in writing and follow specific guidelines .

title: Ritual of Purification
description: Ritual of Purification “ " In ancient times the guardian was created to protect Illefarn . If the time has come to dismantle our great instrument , you will be an agent of its destruction " ” - Ritual Statue , Neverwinter Nights 2 History . The Ritual of Purification was presented in the game " Neverwinter Nights 2 " as a " safety ward " developed by the Illefarn Empire to destroy , or severely diminish its guardian , who became the evil King of Shadows .
description_long: Ritual of Purification “ " In ancient times the guardian was created to protect Illefarn . If the time has come to dismantle our great instrument , you will be an agent of its destruction " ” - Ritual Statue , Neverwinter Nights 2 History . The Ritual of Purification was presented in the game " Neverwinter Nights 2 " as a " safety ward " developed by the Illefarn Empire to destroy , or severely diminish its guardian , who became the evil King of Shadows . The Ritual of Purification was created by the dwarven priest Annaeus , who was credited as the " creator " of the Guardian . The Ritual of Purifcation is granted by 5 different statues , 4 being situated in the now ruined city of Arvahn . and one being located in an Illefarn temple in the Mere of the Dead Men . Each statue grants a powerful ritual blessing , that is designed to fight the shadow that the Guardian casts , each ritual power is capable of causing great harm to him , and able to undo the damage that he inflicts . Also , when the complete ritual is preformed as close to him as possible , it is capable of undoing his basic design as the Illefarn Guardian , thus making him vulnerable to permanent destruction .

title: Ritual of Return
description: Ritual of Return Little is known of this powerful arcane ritual but it is believed to be capable of freeing Calim and Memnon from their prison . The ritual requires two books , one of which is held by the efreet of the city of Memnon . The other book was in the possession of Corvus Nightfeather .
description_long: Ritual of Return Little is known of this powerful arcane ritual but it is believed to be capable of freeing Calim and Memnon from their prison . The ritual requires two books , one of which is held by the efreet of the city of Memnon . The other book was in the possession of Corvus Nightfeather . However , when Shahrokh imprisoned Corvus and destroyed his magical items , the extraplanar space the book was stored in was destroyed . Many of the items stored in Corvus ' pocket plane materialized in the archmage Acham el Jhotos ' laboratory and the book may be among these items .

title: Ritual of the border
description: Ritual of the border The Ritual of the Border was a powerful spell devised by the elven mage Vraith . The spell could be used to enlarge the size of plagueland or it could be used to encapsulate rogue areas of spellplague . The ritual required volunteers , who often died horribly during the ritual .
description_long: Ritual of the border The Ritual of the Border was a powerful spell devised by the elven mage Vraith . The spell could be used to enlarge the size of plagueland or it could be used to encapsulate rogue areas of spellplague . The ritual required volunteers , who often died horribly during the ritual .

title: Ritual of twin burnings
description: Ritual of twin burnings The ritual of twin burnings was a complex and extremely evil arcane evocation spell or binding ritual that obliterated the body and spirit of a sacrificial victim . Its sole purpose was to create runes of chaos around " Thakorsil ' s Seat " , in order to permanently bind a creature to that artifact and enslave them to the caster ' s will . Components .
description_long: Ritual of twin burnings The ritual of twin burnings was a complex and extremely evil arcane evocation spell or binding ritual that obliterated the body and spirit of a sacrificial victim . Its sole purpose was to create runes of chaos around " Thakorsil ' s Seat " , in order to permanently bind a creature to that artifact and enslave them to the caster ' s will . Components . The key material component of the " ritual of twin burnings " was the sacrificial victim : a human mage of good nature , commanding magical power to a level in accordance with the number of runes of chaos inscribed . In addition , it required some verbal and somatic components , among them the intonation of " words of dark terror " . There were other material components costing 50 , 000 gp . These included a sacrificial knife with which to slay the victim . Ritual . The " ritual of twin burnings " was not exactly a spell , but shared many similar features . It was quite a complicated ritual that took a full night and day to perform in full . If the one performing it was disturbed at any point , then the ritual failed and had to be repeated in full . There were three main requirements .

title: Ritual strength
description: Ritual strength Ritual strength was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only used by sha ' ir s . Effects .
description_long: Ritual strength Ritual strength was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only used by sha ' ir s . Effects . Sha ' irs used this spell to prepare themselves for the arduous task improving their gen . With the spell active , sha ' irs did not suffer from exhaustion due to the ritual . Components . This spell did not require any physical components to cast .

title: Riurmorn
description: Riurmorn Riurmorn was a businessman in Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . Riurmorn , a man of unknown origin , owned Riurmorn ' s Silks and Linens , a textile business that imported Sembia n textiles and eastern silk .
description_long: Riurmorn Riurmorn was a businessman in Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . Riurmorn , a man of unknown origin , owned Riurmorn ' s Silks and Linens , a textile business that imported Sembia n textiles and eastern silk . In truth , he was a Cult of the Dragon agent .

title: Rivalen Tanthul
description: Rivalen Tanthul Rivalen Tanthul was one of the twelve Princes of Shade . Rivalen was an accomplished wizard but also The " Nightseer " , a high priest of Shar , the goddess of loss and night . This made him what the Netheril call a Theurge , blending the magic of the Art and the Power .
description_long: Rivalen Tanthul Rivalen Tanthul was one of the twelve Princes of Shade . Rivalen was an accomplished wizard but also The " Nightseer " , a high priest of Shar , the goddess of loss and night . This made him what the Netheril call a Theurge , blending the magic of the Art and the Power . Possessions . Prince Rivalen ' s personal sigil was the symbol of Shar ; below it was a pair of curving dark purple ram ' s horns , outlined in black on a dark gray field . Activities . Although High Prince Telamont is the temporal ruler of the Shadovar s , Prince Rivalen was their spiritual leader . From the enormous Hall of Shadow located near the royal palace , the prince administered Shar ' s clergy and pronounced her will to the faithful . Relationships . Hadrhune . Rivalen was Hadrhune ' s greatest rival . He resented the approval that his father had shown to Hadrhune , and was secretly working to undermine him . He knew he must exercise great caution , because Hadrhune ' s enemies had an unsettling tendency of disappearing . History . In - 365 DR , Rivalen killed his mother Alashar by command of Shar .

title: River Agis
description: River Agis The River Agis flowed from the east out of the Marching Mountains and into the Trackless Sea near the city of Memnon . The river was called the Memnon River in most of Tethyr . It served as the border between Calimshan and Tethyr ever since the Eye Tyrant Wars .
description_long: River Agis The River Agis flowed from the east out of the Marching Mountains and into the Trackless Sea near the city of Memnon . The river was called the Memnon River in most of Tethyr . It served as the border between Calimshan and Tethyr ever since the Eye Tyrant Wars . The river was wide and slow - moving and very suitable for cargo - carrying barges and lumber . However , it did not receive as much traffic as would be expected owing to fears regarding Shoonach , as Port Agis , a section of Shoonach , also lay along the river upstream .

title: River Ardulith
description: River Ardulith The River Ardulith was a river on the island of Evermeet . It flowed into the sea at the island ' s capital , Leuthilspar , on the east coast . Although it was a large river , its flow was gentle .
description_long: River Ardulith The River Ardulith was a river on the island of Evermeet . It flowed into the sea at the island ' s capital , Leuthilspar , on the east coast . Although it was a large river , its flow was gentle . It was used by elven boats and ships .

title: River Ashaba
description: River Ashaba The River Ashaba was one of two major rivers running through Cormanthor ( the other was the Duathamper , or Elvenflow ) . Geography . The river cut the forest roughly in half from Shadowdale in the Dalelands to Semberholme .
description_long: River Ashaba The River Ashaba was one of two major rivers running through Cormanthor ( the other was the Duathamper , or Elvenflow ) . Geography . The river cut the forest roughly in half from Shadowdale in the Dalelands to Semberholme . Description . The river was several hundred yards across , and more than 30 feet ( nine meters ) deep in some areas . Its banks sloped steeply in most places . Crossing . Around 1367 DR , the half - elven ranger Lyra Sunrose scouted the area thirty miles to the south of Mistledale . She located a bridge across the Ashaba , but it was damaged by a black dragon with poor eyesight who attacked the bridge thinking it was an enemy . Another bridge was located within the village of Shadowdale near Hangman ' s Knoll . Flooding . Every spring , the heavy rains had a chance of causing the river to flood its banks , although the flooding was not severe , but it would cause hundreds of and frog s to become stranded in the muddy river banks . Inhabitants . The Ashaba contained , and , although the carp in particular could grow to a very large size ; large enough to be a threat to a human - sized creature .

title: River Caraguir
description: River Caraguir The River Caraguir was located in Dambrath . Geography . The River Caraguir originated in the Gnollwatch Mountains , flowing south across Dambrath before emptying into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins .
description_long: River Caraguir The River Caraguir was located in Dambrath . Geography . The River Caraguir originated in the Gnollwatch Mountains , flowing south across Dambrath before emptying into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins . Notable locations . The city of Luenath was located on the west bank of the river .

title: River Chionthar
description: River Chionthar The River Chionthar was a large river that ran through the Western Heartlands . The river started high up in the Far Hills and flowed west into the Trackless Sea on the Sword Coast . Trade .
description_long: River Chionthar The River Chionthar was a large river that ran through the Western Heartlands . The river started high up in the Far Hills and flowed west into the Trackless Sea on the Sword Coast . Trade . Much trade flowed up and down this waterway . Barges could travel as far inland as Iriaebor .

title: River Dessarin
description: River Dessarin The River Dessarin was a major river that flowed through the Savage Frontier in Northwest Faerûn . Description . This river was the main route for trade and commerce of this region .
description_long: River Dessarin The River Dessarin was a major river that flowed through the Savage Frontier in Northwest Faerûn . Description . This river was the main route for trade and commerce of this region . It was cold and deep , flowing from the Dancing Falls at the base of the Lost Peaks to the Sea of Swords just south of Waterdeep . Fishing . The waters of the Dessarin were home to the silver shalass , a fish that was considered a delicacy across the North . Crossing . The Dessarin had three primary bridges : Zundbridge , south of Waterdeep ; the Stone Bridge , farther north and east of Red Larch ; and Ironford . It also had a ford , usable at certain times of the year — the Dead Horse Ford east of Yartar . Tributaries . The Dessarin claimed the River Surbrin , the River Rauvin , and the Laughingflow as its tributaries , also claiming many smaller rivers and streams flowing from a multitude of places , such as Lurkwood and the Evermoors to the north , and the High Forest to the east .

title: River Dolsel
description: River Dolsel The River Dolsel was a river in the Guthland on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The river started in the Dolsel Gap and drained into the Thingulph .
description_long: River Dolsel The River Dolsel was a river in the Guthland on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The river started in the Dolsel Gap and drained into the Thingulph . Trade . Merchants and fishermen used to transport fruit along the smooth river to the markets of Delselar . Inhabitants . Snake s , living and undead , slithered from the dark regions of the Black Jungles to hunt for prey , under the guidence of the yuan - ti .

title: River Esmur
description: River Esmur The River Esmur flowed from the west out of the Elkannath Mountains and into the Dragon Sea , across the lands of the Dusk Ports . Background . The River Esmur was known for its rich banks of fishes , eels , and the coveted rock crab s .
description_long: River Esmur The River Esmur flowed from the west out of the Elkannath Mountains and into the Dragon Sea , across the lands of the Dusk Ports . Background . The River Esmur was known for its rich banks of fishes , eels , and the coveted rock crab s . The lands surrounding the river , known as the Esmur Flats , were a burgeoning fishing center because of that .

title: River Heldar
description: River Heldar The River Heldar was a small river found in the middle of Durpar in the Shining Lands of the Shining South . Geography . The river originated within the Dustwall Mountains , flowing south on a brief course before meeting the Golden Water .
description_long: River Heldar The River Heldar was a small river found in the middle of Durpar in the Shining Lands of the Shining South . Geography . The river originated within the Dustwall Mountains , flowing south on a brief course before meeting the Golden Water . Description . Durpar ' s capital , Heldapan , was found along its eastern bank .

title: River Ith
description: River Ith The River Ith was the longest river in Tethyr . It began in the Snowflake Mountains and Omlarandin Mountains and flowed west across Tethyr , passing through the capital city of Darromar ( formerly Ithmong ) and into the sea at the Sword Coast a few miles west of Myratma . The river formed the southern border of the Purple Marches , Crown Lands , and Golden Marches and the northern border of Ankaram Duchy and Suretmarch .
description_long: River Ith The River Ith was the longest river in Tethyr . It began in the Snowflake Mountains and Omlarandin Mountains and flowed west across Tethyr , passing through the capital city of Darromar ( formerly Ithmong ) and into the sea at the Sword Coast a few miles west of Myratma . The river formed the southern border of the Purple Marches , Crown Lands , and Golden Marches and the northern border of Ankaram Duchy and Suretmarch . In addition to being the longest river in Tethyr , the River Ith was also the fastest , deepest , coldest , and most dangerous . East of Darromar , the only safe place to cross the river was Survale Ford . West of Darromar , the river was calmer , and after Darromar became Tethyr ' s capital in 1367 DR , barge traffic on that part of the river increased . The river was named after Clan Ithal , which provided Tethyr with its first dynasty . Before - 293 DR , it had been named the Wurlur .

title: River Lapendrar
description: River Lapendrar The River Lapendrar , also called the River of Sorrows , was a river that , as of 1357 DR , formed the western boundary of Thay , in east Faerûn . It was named " River of Sorrows " after the gold miners who died working its banks and the Aglarond an army that died there . The river originated in the Thaymount mountain range .
description_long: River Lapendrar The River Lapendrar , also called the River of Sorrows , was a river that , as of 1357 DR , formed the western boundary of Thay , in east Faerûn . It was named " River of Sorrows " after the gold miners who died working its banks and the Aglarond an army that died there . The river originated in the Thaymount mountain range . Amruthar lay on the path of the river , and the city of Escalant was at the mouth of the river , where it flowed into the Sea of Fallen Stars . History . In 1260 DR , an Aglarond an army led by Halacar invaded Thay , and was defeated by the Red Wizards in the Battle of Lapendrar .

title: River Lesh
description: River Lesh The River Lesh was located in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Lesh originated in the Dustwall Mountains of northeast Durpar .
description_long: River Lesh The River Lesh was located in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Lesh originated in the Dustwall Mountains of northeast Durpar . It flowed south through the Ajmer Forest and a stretch of flat farmland before emptying into the Golden Water . The River Lesh was used heavily to float logs harvested from the Ajmer down to Morvar .

title: River Madras
description: River Madras The River Madras was a small waterway found near the borders of Durpar and Var the Golden in the Shining Lands . Geography . The river flowed southeast from the Aerilpar Forest in Veldorn before joining the River Panka and heading due east to empty into the Golden Water .
description_long: River Madras The River Madras was a small waterway found near the borders of Durpar and Var the Golden in the Shining Lands . Geography . The river flowed southeast from the Aerilpar Forest in Veldorn before joining the River Panka and heading due east to empty into the Golden Water .

title: River Mirar
description: River Mirar The River Mirar was a river in the North . The mouth of the river , on the Sword Coast North , split the city of Luskan in two . The ruins of Illusk sat on its southern bank .
description_long: River Mirar The River Mirar was a river in the North . The mouth of the river , on the Sword Coast North , split the city of Luskan in two . The ruins of Illusk sat on its southern bank . Further upstream , Mirabar was situated on the river ' s north bank .

title: River Orlaphar
description: River Orlaphar The River Orlaphar flowed from the north out of the Glaur Lake and into the Trackless Sea , across the lands of the kingdom of Gontal . Features . The valley surrounding River Orlaphar was wild and trackless , full of strange monsters that defied description such as the anaxim s .
description_long: River Orlaphar The River Orlaphar flowed from the north out of the Glaur Lake and into the Trackless Sea , across the lands of the kingdom of Gontal . Features . The valley surrounding River Orlaphar was wild and trackless , full of strange monsters that defied description such as the anaxim s . Because of that , people preferred to navigate the river than to risk to use the overland routes when they needed to travel across Gontal .

title: River Rauthenflow
description: River Rauthenflow The River Rauthenflow was a waterway in northern Mulhorand known for possessing an exceptionally fast current . The Rauthenflow connected Gbor Nor in the Hordelands with the Alamber Sea . Geography .
description_long: River Rauthenflow The River Rauthenflow was a waterway in northern Mulhorand known for possessing an exceptionally fast current . The Rauthenflow connected Gbor Nor in the Hordelands with the Alamber Sea . Geography . The River Rauthenflow moved swiftly west from its origins in Murghôm to empty into the Alamber Sea at the falls of Rauthgor . The region surrounding the waterway was arid , and the only river crossing was a bridge located at Rauthil . Inhabitants . The area surrounding the River Rauthenflow was inhospitable to most habitation . Despite this , various monsters called this region home . The falls of Rauthgor were known to be frequented by a notable population of mermaid s . History . The entire length of the river was navigable due to efforts from the ancient empires of Mulhorand and Imaskar . These massive projects added canals around cataracts , fortified the soft banks with stone , and cleared rapids of large rocks . The Rauthenflow was a vital source of income for Murghôm since they applied a tax to any vessel sailing its waters . Due to the high volume of river traffic , pirates were virtually unheard of on the Rauthenflow .

title: River Rauvin
description: River Rauvin The River Rauvin flowed from the Rauvin Mountains into the River Surbrin and eventually drained into the Dessarin River and out to the Sea of Swords . Description . The Rauvin was often called the Road Through the Marches .
description_long: River Rauvin The River Rauvin flowed from the Rauvin Mountains into the River Surbrin and eventually drained into the Dessarin River and out to the Sea of Swords . Description . The Rauvin was often called the Road Through the Marches . The icy and clear waters of the river were navigable up to the River Redrun near Sundabar . Trade - barges and rafts shuttled goods and folks throughout the North and from the Sword Coast cities . The river was drinkable and fishing was plentiful . There were many shalass , lout , rock eels , river crabs , and turtles living in the river . Orc s and barbarian s shot fire arrow s at the traders who sailed on the river . Generally , the boats which were sailing upstream were also towed by mules or horses . Bandits and robbers often lied in ambush along the shore .

title: River Redrun
description: River Redrun The River Redrun was a river in Luruar . Geography . The River Redrun began in the Druarwood and flowed southeast past the Moonwood and the Night Trees through the Moonlands .
description_long: River Redrun The River Redrun was a river in Luruar . Geography . The River Redrun began in the Druarwood and flowed southeast past the Moonwood and the Night Trees through the Moonlands . It flowed past Citadel Felbarr and joined another river from the Rauvin Mountains to form the River Rauvin in the Sundabar Vale , north of Sundabar . The trail between Citadel Felbarr and Sundabar crossed the Redrun outside of Citadel Felbarr . History . In 1484 DR , the Knights in Silver of Silverymoon planned to turn away the armies of Many - Arrows at the Redrun Ford ( also known as the Crossing of the Redrun ) . However , the Knights in Silver found themselves outnumbered 6 - to - 1 and were slaughtered . The Many - Arrows forces were aided by the magic of Ravel Xorlarrin and his drow forces .

title: River Rimril
description: River Rimril The River Rimril was a river in eastern Amn that was a part of the Esmelflow . Description . The river began somewhere in the Troll Mountains .
description_long: River Rimril The River Rimril was a river in eastern Amn that was a part of the Esmelflow . Description . The river began somewhere in the Troll Mountains . It poured over Eldath ' s Mount at the Green Goddess Falls and into Duskwood Dell . From there , it flowed into the Snakewood . When it emerged from the Snakewood , it flowed southwest to Eshpurta . There it merged with Trifin Creek and together they joined the Amstel River . Serpent ' s Tail was a local name for this river because it flowed out of the south end of Snakewood . History . During the Shoon Empire , this river flowed through the elvish land of Arundath , the Quiet Forest ( as Snakewood was then known ) . Shoon VII was collecting unicorn horns and slaughtered all the elves who tried to protect them . It was said that the River Rimril flowed red with their blood . For years , fishermen could still find some jewelry and trinkets on their hooks .

title: River Rith
description: River Rith The River Rith was a river that flowed south from the northwest of the Border Kingdoms near the village of Arnglar to join the River Scelptar not far from the town of Manywaters . The river was bridged from Manywaters on the eastern bank , allowing a road west to Irl .
description_long: River Rith The River Rith was a river that flowed south from the northwest of the Border Kingdoms near the village of Arnglar to join the River Scelptar not far from the town of Manywaters . The river was bridged from Manywaters on the eastern bank , allowing a road west to Irl .

title: River Road
description: River Road The River Road was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road encircled Huzuz from the north .
description_long: River Road The River Road was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road encircled Huzuz from the north . It approached Huzuz from the east and ran between the city and Al - Sarif River , meeting the South Road on both the east and west side of the city . The River Road was used heavily by caravans bound for the Ghost ' s Route , as well as merchants unloading their cargo from the Trade Harbor . The River Road entered Huzuz from the north side where it ran to the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .

title: River Ruin
description: River Ruin The River Ruin was the largest river in the Land of the Yak - Men and northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Ruin flowed out of the peaks of the World Pillar Mountains within the Ghost Leopard province of the Yikarian Empire , cascading north and west into the Sun ' s Eye province before passing the Blackwash Fens and emptying into the Great Sea at Pearl Bay .
description_long: River Ruin The River Ruin was the largest river in the Land of the Yak - Men and northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Ruin flowed out of the peaks of the World Pillar Mountains within the Ghost Leopard province of the Yikarian Empire , cascading north and west into the Sun ' s Eye province before passing the Blackwash Fens and emptying into the Great Sea at Pearl Bay . The river stretched for approximately 300 miles ( 480 km ) . Description . Due to the harsh arid environment , the river only flowed for six months out of the year . However , heavy rainfall and spring runoff from the mountains filled the dry river bed with turbulent water during the rainy season . Activities . The yikarians used the river to transport goods from the mountains to the coast . During the dry season , caravans used the river bed as a road to move slaves and other cargo from the coast deep into the Yikarian Empire .

title: River Scelptar
description: River Scelptar The River Scelptar was a large river that flowed from the Qurth Forest in the northeast of the Border Kingdoms to the Shining Sea in the southwest , a distance of approximately 300 miles . The mouth of the river was called simply Scelptarmouth . The River Rith was a tributary from the north , connecting about 100 miles inland .
description_long: River Scelptar The River Scelptar was a large river that flowed from the Qurth Forest in the northeast of the Border Kingdoms to the Shining Sea in the southwest , a distance of approximately 300 miles . The mouth of the river was called simply Scelptarmouth . The River Rith was a tributary from the north , connecting about 100 miles inland . The towns of Blackbarn , Dapplegate , and Oeble were on the banks of the River Scelptar .

title: River Shaar
description: River Shaar The River Shaar was an important feature of the Shaar . Geography . The River Shaar originated from the Riftlake in Underhome .
description_long: River Shaar The River Shaar was an important feature of the Shaar . Geography . The River Shaar originated from the Riftlake in Underhome . It flowed west through the Landrise , eventually filling Lake Lhespen before turning south and joining the River Talar near the Misty Vale ( forest ) .

title: River Shining Tavern
description: River Shining Tavern The River Shining Tavern was a tavern in Faerûn that bore the nickname of the Delimbiyr River . The proprietors of the building also used Delimbiyr as their family name . History .
description_long: River Shining Tavern The River Shining Tavern was a tavern in Faerûn that bore the nickname of the Delimbiyr River . The proprietors of the building also used Delimbiyr as their family name . History . Many claimed that this tavern predated every other building in town . It was also rumored to be the place where Tyndal lived during the construction of the first ducal castle . Darfin Floshin could decry the story as being false , but many fond memories of time spent inside the cozy rooms of the River Shining Tavern kept his lips sealed . Description . The River Shining Tavern was a large building made from wood . Though aging , the structure remained solid . Most of the clientele of the tavern had plenty of coin to spend .
