He is extremely dedicated to his job and cannot be bribed . If he discovers corruption within the ranks , he first gives a direct warning , and if that fails he makes an arrest . He is a superb fighter , constantly honing his skills and training his men , drilling them in technique as well as the laws of the city .

title: Rolf Trygveson
description: Rolf Trygveson Rolf Trygveson was a notable inhabitant of Hawa . Description . Tall and strong , Rolf had striking blond hair that stood out among the predominantly dark - haired Zakharans of the Corsair Domains .
description_long: Rolf Trygveson Rolf Trygveson was a notable inhabitant of Hawa . Description . Tall and strong , Rolf had striking blond hair that stood out among the predominantly dark - haired Zakharans of the Corsair Domains . He preferred wearing his hair in two long braids that matched his braided beard . His one eye was blue , and a jeweled patch covered the other . Rolf preferred loose , brightly colored clothing to armor , relying on his dexterity to protect him in combat . Personality . Rolf was a ferocious pirate . Possessions . His ship " Raven " earned notoriety throughout the land of Zakhara . Activities . Rolf and his crew grew lazy in the warm Zakharan realm , often lounging on the island called the Camel ' s Hump for long periods of time . History . Rolf originally hailed from the barbarian tribes near Icewind Dale . Piqued by curiosity , Rolf moved south when his people began trading with people from the Sword Coast . Eventually his pirating ways wore out his welcome , and he and his crew moved even further south . Somewhere in the Great Sea they ran across a Zakharan raiding party and followed them back to the Land of Fate .

title: Rolim Durothil
description: Rolim Durothil Rolim Durothil was the third son of the Durothil patriarch , so he could not inherit a position of power in ancient Aryvandaar . He was a warrior and survived the Crown Wars . His father send him with the expedition to Evermeet to colonize the island in name of all elves .
description_long: Rolim Durothil Rolim Durothil was the third son of the Durothil patriarch , so he could not inherit a position of power in ancient Aryvandaar . He was a warrior and survived the Crown Wars . His father send him with the expedition to Evermeet to colonize the island in name of all elves . For this he was married with Ava Moonflower , a mighty High Mage . It was an arranged marriage , because Rolim had little magical aptiude to pass it down to his children , this should come from his wife . At the beginning he had some problems with the moon elven lady , but he learned to love her during the long voyage to Evermeet . Four hundred years later died the High Council Keishara Amarillis and Rolim became the new High Council of Evermeet . Rolim and Ava had a unusally large family . The childs who came after their father became part of house Durothil , the others became part of house Moonflower .

title: Rolivar Brimbruir
description: Rolivar Brimbruir Rolivar Brimbruir was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Rolivar was a burly man with bushy brown hair that was mostly concentrated on the sides of his face and mustache as he slowly went bald .
description_long: Rolivar Brimbruir Rolivar Brimbruir was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Rolivar was a burly man with bushy brown hair that was mostly concentrated on the sides of his face and mustache as he slowly went bald . He periodically shaved off his mustache , every few months or so . Personality . He was loud and boisterous , friendly to everyone , and loved to laugh . He told jokes that made even the most dour Cyric ists in town chuckle . Abilities . Rolivar was an accomplished brewmaster , specializing in beer made from barley . Activities . In addition to his temple duties and brewing , he was a courier for Mother of the Harvest , Lady Shrae , occasionally shuttling correspondence between her and High Harvestmistress Glamerie Windbough of the House of Plenty in Shadowdale . On these trips he was usually accompanied by about eight temple guards , all mounted and heavily cloaked ( possibly from scrying ) . As a precaution , they checked in with Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl or his deputies to ensure no mistakes were made about their right to travel to and from Shadowdale . Relationships .

title: Rolk
description: Rolk Rolk was a dwarf merchant in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rolk was a gregarious individual who recently had a change of fortune .
description_long: Rolk Rolk was a dwarf merchant in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rolk was a gregarious individual who recently had a change of fortune . He took his new job very seriously . Relationship . He was an acquaintance of Gilfron Milon . History . In 1489 DR , after Vorgansharax ' s coup , he became the main agent of the local Merchant ' s Guild . Rolk hired an adventuring party to recover a book from the lair of the black dragon Throstulgrael , which the dragon had raided from a Guild ' s caravan .

title: Rollo
description: Rollo Rollo was a very young dwarf of Mithril Hall in the late 15th century DR . History . Rollo was born " circa " 1465 DR .
description_long: Rollo Rollo was a very young dwarf of Mithril Hall in the late 15th century DR . History . Rollo was born " circa " 1465 DR . During the late stages of the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , Rollo and his old cousin Winko Battleblade were among the dwarves that marched from Mithril Hall into battle against orc s and drow .

title: Rolo
description: Rolo Rolo was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Activities . In 1491 DR , Rolo and his brother Jott were the main agents of Thylius , running the Yellow Breath Chapter House for him .
description_long: Rolo Rolo was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Activities . In 1491 DR , Rolo and his brother Jott were the main agents of Thylius , running the Yellow Breath Chapter House for him . However , an adventuring party hired to find some missing noblewomen entered the house and defeated and captured Rolo .

title: Rom
description: Rom Rom were undead giant s that inhabited some underground areas of Zakhara . Description . Rom were only male .
description_long: Rom Rom were undead giant s that inhabited some underground areas of Zakhara . Description . Rom were only male . They were tall and well - muscled with human proporations . All rom were talented artists of some kind and their voices were sad and resonant . Combat . Rom viciously attacked anything that disturbed their dwellings . In addition to damage from their immense size , a blow from a rom drained the victim ’ s strength . The mere presence of a rom radiated fear to those viewing them , causing many to flee . When they had the room , rom threw rocks at their attackers . All rom were immune to normal weapons , poison , paralysis , and all enchantment and cold magic . Habitat / Society . It was believed that rom were the remnants of a race of giant herdsman whose wives only produced male offspring , thinning the population when breeding stopped taking place . During their grief , the rom built giant cairns and buried themselves alive , but Fate maintained their existence in undeath . These cairns could be found throughout Zakhara . Vegetation surrounding them was dull and animal life was sparse . During the night , loud lamentations could be heard from deep within the cairns .

title: Romsan Kal
description: Romsan Kal Romsan Kal was a scarred innkeeper in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Romsan was a jovial individual .
description_long: Romsan Kal Romsan Kal was a scarred innkeeper in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Romsan was a jovial individual . He constantly changed the story of how he acquired his scars , from escaping from an illithid to a fight with a dragon . He knew all adventurers ' negotiating ploys and laughed if someone tried to use them on him . Activities . Romsan was the Amn ian manager of the Crossing Inn , the most famous inn near Trank River on the road to Phlan .

title: Ron Spencer
description: Ron Spencer Ron Spencer is an american illustrator who has done work for companies such as Wizards of the Coast , White Wolf , FASA , Pinnacle Entertainment , AEG , Iron Crown , Dragon Gate , Holistic Design , TSR Games , Privateer Press , Toy Vault , and others . He is most notably known for his work on the " Magic : The Gathering " card game .
description_long: Ron Spencer Ron Spencer is an american illustrator who has done work for companies such as Wizards of the Coast , White Wolf , FASA , Pinnacle Entertainment , AEG , Iron Crown , Dragon Gate , Holistic Design , TSR Games , Privateer Press , Toy Vault , and others . He is most notably known for his work on the " Magic : The Gathering " card game .

title: Rondeval
description: Rondeval Rondeval was a legendary stage performer of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Rondeval was a stage performer renowned for his wit , charm , and womanizing ways .
description_long: Rondeval Rondeval was a legendary stage performer of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Rondeval was a stage performer renowned for his wit , charm , and womanizing ways . Rondeval eventually founded an inn in a crossroads that in time became a trade - moot . Legacy . The town of Rondeval , that grow up around his inn , was named after him .

title: Rondeval ( town )
description: Rondeval ( town ) Rondeval was the largest trade - moot in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . The town was named after Rondeval , a legendary stage performer .
description_long: Rondeval ( town ) Rondeval was the largest trade - moot in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . The town was named after Rondeval , a legendary stage performer . The trade - moot was a place of constant gossip and intrigue , where people looking to get rich quick gathered to try to get a variety of jobs . Rondeval was also know for its skilled artists specialized in making fake treasure maps . Government . The owner of the inn acted as the ruler of the town , although technically the town has no official ruler . History . The town grown around the original inn founded by Rondeval .

title: Ronglath Knightsbridge
description: Ronglath Knightsbridge Ronglath Knightsbridge was a male human member of the Zhentarim and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Ronglath was a powerful warrior in service to the Zhentarim and Bane .
description_long: Ronglath Knightsbridge Ronglath Knightsbridge was a male human member of the Zhentarim and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Ronglath was a powerful warrior in service to the Zhentarim and Bane . He infiltrated the guards of Arabel just before the Time of Troubles but was unveiled by the then - mortal Kelemvor and Cyric . Ronglath later became a commander in the Zhentilar army sent by Bane against Shadowdale . He fought with great courage in the Zhent assault until he was again confronted by Kelemvor who finally killed him .

title: Ront
description: Ront Ront was an orc who was trapped in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Ront was an orc warrior of Iceshield tribe in the Dessarin Valley .
description_long: Ront Ront was an orc who was trapped in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Ront was an orc warrior of Iceshield tribe in the Dessarin Valley . His war party was slaughtered by a group of dwarves . Only Ront survived by escaping into the Underdark . There he was captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Ront was a mean , stupid , and hateful individual . He had a great survival instinct , which permitted him to survive in very dangerous situations . However , Ront was ashamed of his cowardly act and believed that Gruumsh , the god of the orcs , was punishing him . Ront engaged in threatening behavior and bullying toward the others unless someone stood up to him .

title: Rontal Qirattar
description: Rontal Qirattar Rontal Qirattar was a male human cleric of Deneir . He was the farsann of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the countess of Calimmon County in Tethyr . Rontal was in charge of planning Lady Kyrin ' s wedding to Garron Ersemm in the beginning of the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR .
description_long: Rontal Qirattar Rontal Qirattar was a male human cleric of Deneir . He was the farsann of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the countess of Calimmon County in Tethyr . Rontal was in charge of planning Lady Kyrin ' s wedding to Garron Ersemm in the beginning of the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR . However , he secretly wanted Kyrin for himself , believing himself to be the ideal man for her , and plotted the removal of Master Ersemm , so he could try to console and woo her .

title: Rook
description: Rook Rook was an allegedly female drow revenant who lived in Araumycos . She was one of the fabled Morndin of Clan Ironstar . " Rook " wasn ' t her true name , but a nickname Daffyd gave to her since he never asked her true name .
description_long: Rook Rook was an allegedly female drow revenant who lived in Araumycos . She was one of the fabled Morndin of Clan Ironstar . " Rook " wasn ' t her true name , but a nickname Daffyd gave to her since he never asked her true name . Description . " Rook " was a thin drow with an odd body and white hair . Her hands only had three fingers who looked like hooks . Abilities . She had the ability to temporarily kill the fungi of Araumycos . History . " Rook " was originally one of the dwarves of Delzoun . When she was killed , her bones were scattered by orc s around Araumycos as a final offense to the dwarves . She was later revived as a drow revenant and her task was to recover her bones and ask for adventurers exploring Araumycos to give her bones a proper dwarven burial .

title: Rookery
description: Rookery The Rookery was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Rookery was the most dangerous section of the City of Brass , causing even the Sultan ' s guards to avoid treading there .
description_long: Rookery The Rookery was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Rookery was the most dangerous section of the City of Brass , causing even the Sultan ' s guards to avoid treading there . The gambling houses , fighting pits , and pleasure gardens filling this ward never closed . Inhabitants . In addition to the gamblers , thieves , and miscreants who occupied this area , plenty of firenewt s populated the Rookery .

title: Rool
description: Rool Rool was a sailor on the Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rool was the first mate of the " Morkoth " ship and a Kraken Society assassin .
description_long: Rool Rool was a sailor on the Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rool was the first mate of the " Morkoth " ship and a Kraken Society assassin . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Rool , posing as a Lords ' Alliance agent , led the squad that captured the storm giant king Hekaton and took him to the ship . Relationship . Rool hated his captain , Tholtz Daggerdark , and used any occasion to kill him , even if meant defeat for himself .

title: Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars
description: Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars The Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was located within the Potala in Saikhoi , Ra - Khati . Description . The main chamber of the Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was a giant work of art .
description_long: Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars The Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was located within the Potala in Saikhoi , Ra - Khati . Description . The main chamber of the Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was a giant work of art . Large rafters hanging 30 ft . ( 9 m ) overheard were painted with beautiful floral patterns themed with different colors . As the name of the room implied , over 100 large stone pillars connected the floor and ceiling of the chamber . Each of these pillars was wrapped with finely woven tapestries depicting a wide variety of scenery from Ra - Khati ' s history . Proverbs were inscribed on the pillars beneath the tapestries , explaining what the Dalai Lama learned from the historical event . A large golden statue dominated the far end of the chamber . The statue depicted an ancient monk meditating cross - legged with his eyes facing the sky . Large rubies were used for the statue ' s eyes and a fist - sized emerald filled his navel . Made from solid gold , the statue weighed over 30 tons . A " karma curse " was placed upon the statue to protect against theft . The statue was actually a representation of Mahavidi , the Padhrasattva of erudition .

title: Roond Asmyrk
description: Roond Asmyrk Roond Asmyrk was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Sune and proprietor of the Silvery Sembian Snail tavern . History .
description_long: Roond Asmyrk Roond Asmyrk was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Sune and proprietor of the Silvery Sembian Snail tavern . History . Asmyrk was once a priest of Sune , goddess of love and beauty , but was forced to leave the priesthood after being criticized for his explicitly hedonistic ways and views . He didn ' t care a bit about this , and Sune still answered his prayers and provided him with spells . By 1358 DR , he was the proprietor of the Silvery Sembian Snail tavern in Wheloon . After several drunken parties spread from the Snail and into the town and disturbed livestock , Lord Sarp Redbeard reprimanded Roond Asmyrk . He began to use sobering spells on patrons and developed more indoor entertainments . He still ran the Silvery Sembian Snail " circa " 1369 DR . Activities . Asmyrk spent several years developing spells that could alter the taste and smell of lesser wines to create " shadow wines " that resembled far more expensive vintages . A connoisseur could purchase both and compare them if they wished . To prevent inebriated patrons and escorts causing trouble outside , Asmyrk also cast spell s upon them to induce some sobriety .

title: Rootweal
description: Rootweal Rootweal was a red wine that originated from the forests of the Yuirwood in Aglarond . Description . The beverage had the color of red silk and was a smooth , full - bodied wine .
description_long: Rootweal Rootweal was a red wine that originated from the forests of the Yuirwood in Aglarond . Description . The beverage had the color of red silk and was a smooth , full - bodied wine . Its flavor was described as " a forest meadow alive in the glad light of the sun . "

title: Roouddan
description: Roouddan The roouddan was a red turnip - like vegetable . It was colloquially known as the " red turnip of Proskur " . It grew around the Sea of Fallen Stars , and was a staple food of peasants .
description_long: Roouddan The roouddan was a red turnip - like vegetable . It was colloquially known as the " red turnip of Proskur " . It grew around the Sea of Fallen Stars , and was a staple food of peasants . It could be used as a thickener in stews and as a base for livestock slop mashes . It kept long and well when protected from heat and the sun , as well as resisting rot and being edible when raw . Normally , roouddans were absorbent , and could not be grown in dry climates . As they absorbed water , they could also be induced to take on flavors by soaking it in spiced water or broth . It was used as a means of smuggling by Mathym Jalander . A normal means of smuggling would be to hide a single vial of wine within bulk food , but with some experiments , Jalander was able to exploit the vegetable for smuggling itself . Jalander discovered that these turnips could absorb wine and hold it without leaking , and treated to prevent hounds from sniffing the contraband . The vegetable could then be crushed to extract the wine . However , the wine stored in the turnip didn ' t store well in skins or kegs , and thus it needed to be bottled .

title: Rope trick
description: Rope trick Rope trick , originally called Undine ' s rope , was a transmutation spell that used a rope to create an extradimensional hiding place . It was a spell known to be favored by the avatar s of the kenku god Quorlinn — in the exceptionally rare case that it used avatars at all . Effects .
description_long: Rope trick Rope trick , originally called Undine ' s rope , was a transmutation spell that used a rope to create an extradimensional hiding place . It was a spell known to be favored by the avatar s of the kenku god Quorlinn — in the exceptionally rare case that it used avatars at all . Effects . When cast upon a piece of rope , one end of the rope would launch into the air and affix itself to the invisible opening of a created extradimensional place . Creatures could then climb the rope to take shelter within that space . The extradimensional spaces was outside of the usual multiverse of plane s . Creatures hiding within were safe from both natural and supernatural detection , including spells , unless those spells could work across planes . Up to eight entities could inhabit the extradimensional space , no matter what their size , provided they could — one at a time — climb the rope , which could support up to eight tons ( seven metric tons ) of weight . A heavier weight than that would pull the rope free , ending the effects of the spell .

title: Roper
description: Roper Ropers are ambush hunters that evolved in the underworld . Description . They take the appearance of stalagmites and wait for a living creature to draw close .
description_long: Roper Ropers are ambush hunters that evolved in the underworld . Description . They take the appearance of stalagmites and wait for a living creature to draw close . Combat . When this happens , the roper quickly lashes out with tendrils extruded from its body that wrap around its target , sapping the creature ’ s strength . The roper then draws its prey into its fang - filled mouth to consume . As a rope never knows when its next meal is coming , they often slay and eat more than they can possibly consume at once . Variants . There are some varieties of ropers that have evolved on the surface of the world . They take the shape of dead tree trunks and hide within the forest . History . Despite their monstrous hunger and evil natures , ropers are intelligent and insightful creatures . In the time between feedings , they learn about their surrounding underworld and contemplate philosophy . Religious pilgrims sometimes brave the lair of a roper for a chance to learn the creature ’ s insight .

title: Ropes for All Uses
description: Ropes for All Uses Ropes for All Uses was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ropes for All Uses carried an assortment of standard ropes , both practical and ornamental .
description_long: Ropes for All Uses Ropes for All Uses was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ropes for All Uses carried an assortment of standard ropes , both practical and ornamental . One specialty rope carried by the shop made it much more difficult to escape from if the rope was used as binding . Focran Samina made these ropes himself and only had three in the store for sale at any given time . They usually sold for double the asking price . Inhabitants . Focran owned and operated this establishment .

title: Rorgak
description: Rorgak Rorgak was the chief commander under Kaanyr Vhok of the Scoured Legion in 1372 DR . Description . He was red - scaled .
description_long: Rorgak Rorgak was the chief commander under Kaanyr Vhok of the Scoured Legion in 1372 DR . Description . He was red - scaled . History . Rorgak assisted his master in preparing the legion for war against Menzoberranzan . He also commanded part of the tanarukk troops in the field during the Siege of Menzoberranzan . When Kaanyr decided to retreat , Rorgak oversaw the disengagement of their troops . Rorgak also assisted Kaanyr in the attack on Sundabar and remained in control of the troops when Kaanyr and his command staff infiltrated the city and afterward left for the planes . He was possibly the first high war chief of the Legion .

title: Rorlyn Handmane
description: Rorlyn Handmane Lionar Rorlyn Handmane was a high - ranking officer of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Rorlyn was one of the kingdom ' s most experienced officers .
description_long: Rorlyn Handmane Lionar Rorlyn Handmane was a high - ranking officer of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Rorlyn was one of the kingdom ' s most experienced officers . He was busy organizing the Council of the Dragon . He helped Glathra Barcantle in battle Elminster Aumar ' s party at the castle . Later he went to investigate the house of Larak Dardulkyn .

title: Rorn
description: Rorn Rorn , also known as Blazing Rorn the Fury or Rorn of the Rages , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Rorn was a gigantic humanoid with cooling lava - like skin and the head and tail of a dragon , capable of transforming into a blazing star of light brighter than the sun .
description_long: Rorn Rorn , also known as Blazing Rorn the Fury or Rorn of the Rages , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Rorn was a gigantic humanoid with cooling lava - like skin and the head and tail of a dragon , capable of transforming into a blazing star of light brighter than the sun . Personality . Rorn was a slave of a powerful fury , and was notorious for his unjust retributions . He returned anger with unmatched rage , insult with atrocity , and violence with wanton destruction . He had a few moments of calm and clarity , however , and during those times he was a very prudent , tolerant , and compromised being . History . Before the sundering of Abeir - Toril , Rorn was the most hated and feared primordial , both by gods and primordials alike , due to his violent temperament and by the fact that he had killed many gods , other lesser divine beings , and even other primordials as well .

title: Roroaros
description: Roroaros Roroaros was an elder black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Roroaros was cruel and enjoyed killing those who had defied him .
description_long: Roroaros Roroaros was an elder black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Roroaros was cruel and enjoyed killing those who had defied him . He was clever enough to consult with Melauthaur before killing his enemies . Activities . In 1479 DR , Roroaros was in charge to rule and protect a coastal region of Melabrauth .

title: Rorreth Monforoth
description: Rorreth Monforoth Rorreth Monforoth was an exiled Red Wizard of Thay sent to Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Rorreth was one of the many exiled Red Wizards .
description_long: Rorreth Monforoth Rorreth Monforoth was an exiled Red Wizard of Thay sent to Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Rorreth was one of the many exiled Red Wizards . He joined the faction of Rath Modar , which was allied with the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Under Rath ' s and the Cult ' s orders , Rorreth infiltrated Valhingen Graveyard in Phlan in order to locate the Pool of Radiance . He raised many undead who caused troubles to local Kelemvor ite priests . Thus the Kelemvorite hired an adventuring party to investigate and in the end the adventurers discovered Rorreth and defeated him . He somehow survived and after becoming more powerful he decided to search power for himself exploring the Yarash ' s pyramid but was again defeated by adventurers . Behind the Scenes . In Dues for the Dead he was 4th level but in Dark Pyramid of Sorcerer ' s Isle had become 11th level spellcaster

title: Rorskryn Mreldrake
description: Rorskryn Mreldrake Rorskryn Mreldrake was a former War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , he was held in thrall by Manshoon .
description_long: Rorskryn Mreldrake Rorskryn Mreldrake was a former War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , he was held in thrall by Manshoon . Together with understeward Corleth Fentable , Rorskryn was summoned by Manshoon to the shop of Immaero Sraunter to receive his orders . Later Alusair Obarskyr revealed to king Foril Obarskyr I the treason of Mreldrake ; however Corleth was in the room and so Manshoon accomplished the fact . Under his master ' s compulsion Rorskryn went thought a gate to Marsember , where he polymorph ed himself in a young female called Mythandra that want sail to Turmish , without any memory of his life as Rorskryn . In 1480 DR he went back to Suzail to bargain an agreement with a mysterious cabal of renegade shadovar . The cabal forced Mreldrake to kill from distance many others War Wizards using a new kind of magic he had discovered . At last he was uncovered as the killer inside Castle Irlingstar by Elminster ' s party and Jarlin Flamtarge , one of the Manshoon ' s bodies . At last his cabal protectors were killed by Elminster and Mreldrake died .

title: Rorstil Hallowdant
description: Rorstil Hallowdant Rorstil Hallowdant was the steward of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , his underling Corleth Fentable , under the orders of Manshoon , tried to delay the Council of the Dragon while , thanks to Manshoon ' s plots , Rorstil was ill .
description_long: Rorstil Hallowdant Rorstil Hallowdant was the steward of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , his underling Corleth Fentable , under the orders of Manshoon , tried to delay the Council of the Dragon while , thanks to Manshoon ' s plots , Rorstil was ill . At last his body was discovered in the house of Broryn Windstag among the house ' s servants .

title: Rosaline
description: Rosaline Rosaline , also known as unionite , , or , was found in large quantities of soft stone ( usually cut in 1 lb / 2 . 2 kg blocks for trading ) , or in small , hard crystals . Description .
description_long: Rosaline Rosaline , also known as unionite , , or , was found in large quantities of soft stone ( usually cut in 1 lb / 2 . 2 kg blocks for trading ) , or in small , hard crystals . Description . The opaque pink variety of this ornamental stone was relatively soft and could be tumbled or cut while the harder crystal form could be by a and exhibited trichroism : three colors in the gem , each viewed from a different angle . The three colors were purple , red , and either blue or green for the third color . A typical soft pink stone had a base value of 10 gp , whereas the trichroic crystal variety had a base price of 50 gp . ) Rosaline stones were considered sacred by followers of Ghaunadaur — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Some tri - colored rosaline crystals with the proper mix of colors had the property of negating one color of any " prismatic " spell . A correctly attuned crystal would vanish when the creature carrying or wearing it came in contact with the first color layer of the " prismatic " spell effect , collapsing the layer with no harm to the creature .

title: Rose
description: Rose A rose was a flowering shrub of the Rosa genus , although the term was often used to describe the flower from this shrub . History . Furthinghome , around 1374 DR , was notable for its culture and export of roses , amongst other flowers .
description_long: Rose A rose was a flowering shrub of the Rosa genus , although the term was often used to describe the flower from this shrub . History . Furthinghome , around 1374 DR , was notable for its culture and export of roses , amongst other flowers . Ilmater . The appearance of white roses could indicate the presence of Ilmater , the deity of suffering and martyrdom .

title: Rose Garden
description: Rose Garden The Rose Garden was a large cluster of various species of roses that grew in the southeast corner of the Battle of Bones . Description . The Rose Garden was large , measuring approximately 140 feet ( 42 .
description_long: Rose Garden The Rose Garden was a large cluster of various species of roses that grew in the southeast corner of the Battle of Bones . Description . The Rose Garden was large , measuring approximately 140 feet ( 42 . 6 meters ) by 140 feet . Roughly octagonal shaped , this supernatural garden mystified sages for centuries . The rose bushes grew together so thickly that passing through them was impossible . One could just make out the secretive passage ways within if they peered through the bushes carefully , but view from the air was blocked by dense foliage . In addition to the common rose , several other species of roses comprised the Rose Garden . Species included the mourning rose , creeper rose , common bloodrose , sunset rose , ruby blushrose , and undead bloodrose . The aroma of roses produced a disorienting effect on those who traveled through the maze for too long . Short term memory was also affected , making it nearly impossible to successfully map the garden . At their widest point , the passages within the Rose Garden were only 30 inches ( 76 cm ) wide , providing ample opportunity for explorers to cut themselves on some of the poisoned thorns or leaves . History .

title: Rose Keep
description: Rose Keep Rose Keep is a trade enclave on the edge of Veltalar , in Aglarond . Appearance . The enclave is walled with scuffed , mortared stone walls .
description_long: Rose Keep Rose Keep is a trade enclave on the edge of Veltalar , in Aglarond . Appearance . The enclave is walled with scuffed , mortared stone walls . Inside is a two story building and an attached three story tower with an observatory on top . Iron - reinforced oak gates lead inside . A large red tent is set up in the courtyard to sell items . There is an underground cellar only accessible by magic . History . Rose Keep was founded as a Thayan Enclave early in the Era of Upheaval . It was the last enclave established before Szass Tam ' s takeover of Thay . Originally overseen by four Red Wizards , it teetered on the brink of failure , partly due to two of the Red Wizards leaving to pursue their own interests and Levant leaving to pledge himself to Szass Tam . This left Dhenna to run Rose Keep by herself with a newborn daughter . She ran it until her death in 1449 DR when her daughter Tharna took over . Tharna continued to run Rose Keep on her own but eventually sought partners in 1474 DR allowing two to buy - in but keeping a majority share for herself .

title: Rosealine Culkin
description: Rosealine Culkin Zora Rosealine Culkin was a noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Rosealine was a typical Mulmaster noble .
description_long: Rosealine Culkin Zora Rosealine Culkin was a noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Rosealine was a typical Mulmaster noble . She was polite but a bit impersonal , and striking to look at . Being very insightful , she could evaluate people after only a brief conversation . Rosealine was very suspicious . Despite all this , she felt a true responsibility for people living in her holdings , and she was horrified at the deaths that occurred . Activities . Rosealine was part of one of the oldest noble families in the city , which had been part of the Lords ' Alliance for generations . She was a skilled wizard . History . In 1491 DR , the Culkin - controlled village of Elmwood was totally destroyed by fire . Rosealine however discovered that there was a survivor and hired an adventuring party to retrieve her for questioning .

title: Rosecork
description: Rosecork A rosecork was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Rosecork wood was durable and extremely resistant to fire . It absorbed such a great concentration of water that open flames could not ignite it , short of exposure to a very hot flame for some hours .
description_long: Rosecork A rosecork was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Rosecork wood was durable and extremely resistant to fire . It absorbed such a great concentration of water that open flames could not ignite it , short of exposure to a very hot flame for some hours . For these properties , it was commonly used in construction . The rosecork was native to the Isle of Prespur in the Sea of Fallen Stars , and was used to these warmer climes . However , Sarliman Eurdoe , an entrepreneur of Wheloon in Cormyr , imported the rosecork for its valuable properties and the trees went on to flourish by the southern tributaries of the Wyvernflow . Bryn Ohme Thornwood mentioned the rosecork as an example of an introduced plant species that had no significant impact on the existing environment . Locations . Rosecork trees were found growing in the following places :

title: Rosemantle
description: Rosemantle Rosemantle was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lathander , the Morninglord . It increased a creature ' s resistance to adverse effects such as fear , nausea , pain , or sickness . Before the Spellplague , it was only available to cleric s of the Morninglord who had been initiated on a path to the faith ' s greatest secrets .
description_long: Rosemantle Rosemantle was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lathander , the Morninglord . It increased a creature ' s resistance to adverse effects such as fear , nausea , pain , or sickness . Before the Spellplague , it was only available to cleric s of the Morninglord who had been initiated on a path to the faith ' s greatest secrets . Effects . The caster had to touch the creature that was the target of this spell . When cast , the recipient of " rosemantle " gave off a soft glow resembling candlelight . For a short time ( depending on the level of the caster ) , the target gained the blessing of increased resistance to fear ( such as a " fear " spell or a dragon ' s aura ) , sickness and nausea ( such as the odor of a ghast or the moan of a cloaker ) , or pain ( such as caused by " Nybor ' s gentle reminder " ) . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Roses of forgetfulness
description: Roses of forgetfulness Roses of forgetfulness were magical flowers that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These strange flowers caused forgetfulness to anyone or anything that inhaled their fragrance .
description_long: Roses of forgetfulness Roses of forgetfulness were magical flowers that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These strange flowers caused forgetfulness to anyone or anything that inhaled their fragrance . Spellcasters could even forget memorized spell s . Direct inhalation of the roses caused amnesia unless the inhaler was able to resist . Loss of identity in this manner was permanent . Short of using a " wish " , only " heal " or " restoration " spells could restore the lost identity .

title: Rosestone Abbey
description: Rosestone Abbey Rosestone Abbey is a partially ruined abbey located in Eastern Thar dedicated to the worship of Amaunator . In 1480 DR Rosestone Abbey was the site of a battle between forces loyal to the rightful Harmach of Hulburg under the command of Kara Hulmaster and those of the shadow mage Rhovann and his puppet Maroth Marstel . The loyalist army won the battle after Geran Hulmaster destroyed a magical device that animated dozens of golem soldiers in Rhovann ' s army .
description_long: Rosestone Abbey Rosestone Abbey is a partially ruined abbey located in Eastern Thar dedicated to the worship of Amaunator . In 1480 DR Rosestone Abbey was the site of a battle between forces loyal to the rightful Harmach of Hulburg under the command of Kara Hulmaster and those of the shadow mage Rhovann and his puppet Maroth Marstel . The loyalist army won the battle after Geran Hulmaster destroyed a magical device that animated dozens of golem soldiers in Rhovann ' s army . Appearance . Much of the abbey is ruined with many gaps in the outer curtain wall . Some of the inner buildings remain intact and these are occupied by a small number of priests .

title: Rot grub
description: Rot grub A rot grub is a 1 inch long grub that eats rotting organic material . They are often found in the bark of treant s in the forest of Cormanthor where they help to combat the tube wilt by eating the rotten wood and the fungal infection that causes it . Outside of Cormanthor , they are most often found in piles of offal or dung , attracted by movement , they will burrow into the nearest moving object and eat whatever they can .
description_long: Rot grub A rot grub is a 1 inch long grub that eats rotting organic material . They are often found in the bark of treant s in the forest of Cormanthor where they help to combat the tube wilt by eating the rotten wood and the fungal infection that causes it . Outside of Cormanthor , they are most often found in piles of offal or dung , attracted by movement , they will burrow into the nearest moving object and eat whatever they can . If the victim is quick , the problem can be treated with fire or by cutting them out with a blade . If not , a " remove disease " spell will get rid of them before they reach the victim ' s heart .

title: Rotface
description: Rotface Rotface was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rotface was petty and had a bit of mean streak .
description_long: Rotface Rotface was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rotface was petty and had a bit of mean streak . She was rude and offensive , with no concern for social rules . In the absence of Deathwallow , she tried to act as the voice of reason but with few results .

title: Rothé
description: Rothé Rothé were herd animals and one of the primary livestock of human s in Faerûn ' s northern areas and of the drow of the Underdark below . Description . These magical beasts resembled .
description_long: Rothé Rothé were herd animals and one of the primary livestock of human s in Faerûn ' s northern areas and of the drow of the Underdark below . Description . These magical beasts resembled . Ecology . The Axe of Mirabar , the militia of the city of Mirabar , rode rothé in the winter .

title: Rotten Root Tavern
description: Rotten Root Tavern The Rotten Root Tavern was a dive on Silverpiece Way in Westgate that , as of 1480 DR , had been in business for over 100 years . Activities . The establishment was best known for its bad food and drink and its sign depicting an evil - looking treant .
description_long: Rotten Root Tavern The Rotten Root Tavern was a dive on Silverpiece Way in Westgate that , as of 1480 DR , had been in business for over 100 years . Activities . The establishment was best known for its bad food and drink and its sign depicting an evil - looking treant . Inhabitants . The bar was the favorite hangout of Kalen Dren when he was in Westgate .

title: Roushoum
description: Roushoum Roushoum , also called Imaskari , was the ancient language of the Imaskari people . Speakers . Roushoum was still spoken deep in the Underdark by the survivors of the Imaskari Empire , the Deep Imaskari .
description_long: Roushoum Roushoum , also called Imaskari , was the ancient language of the Imaskari people . Speakers . Roushoum was still spoken deep in the Underdark by the survivors of the Imaskari Empire , the Deep Imaskari . Related Languages . Roushoum was the major language of the Imaskari languages family . Its many varied descendants included the languages of the Durpari and the various Tuigan dialects , including Raumvira . It had strong influences on the Rauric family of languages as well . The modern variations of Roushoum spoken in the Hordelands were broken down into three subgroupings of languages for convenience : the Northern , Southern , and Eastern Imaskari languages . Script . Roushoum was written using the Imaskari alphabet .

title: Roving Dragon
description: Roving Dragon The Roving Dragon was an inn and restaurant in Suzail , Cormyr and owned by Caladarea Ithbeck . Geography . The inn was located on the promenade above Braundlae ' s Best , a tavern run by Braundlae .
description_long: Roving Dragon The Roving Dragon was an inn and restaurant in Suzail , Cormyr and owned by Caladarea Ithbeck . Geography . The inn was located on the promenade above Braundlae ' s Best , a tavern run by Braundlae . Structure . The establishment was created by knocking through doorways into several adjoining buildings on the upper floor . Customers entered via several staircases from the tavern below , and these bars served to bring the Roving Dragon customers in exchange for it not competing with their drink trade . Its prices are kept reasonable by serving simple but good food . Interior . The sunny chamber at the eastern end of the Dragon was called the " Snout Room " , and afforded a good view of the Royal Gardens past the court buildings . Food and drink . The restaurant served cider , meat tarts , soursweet fish tarts , and soups .

title: Rowaan Vrinn
description: Rowaan Vrinn Rowaan Vrinn was the drow high priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . History . Daughter of Leliana Vrinn , Rowaan was chosen to be the high priestess of the Misty Forest .
description_long: Rowaan Vrinn Rowaan Vrinn was the drow high priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . History . Daughter of Leliana Vrinn , Rowaan was chosen to be the high priestess of the Misty Forest . There , she met Halisstra Melarn during the Silence of Lolth . In 1375 DR , Rowaan also met Halisstra ' s brother , Q ' arlynd Melarn , who ' d followed a clue from Ched Nasad . Rowaan was killed during an attack by a large group of drider s but quickly resurrected . Rowaan was again killed later by a Nightshadow of Vhaeraun and her soul was stolen . At last , after Eilistraee prevailed upon Vhaeraun , Rowaan was correctly resurrected

title: Rowan Babar
description: Rowan Babar Rowan Babar was the founder of the Order of the Dawn and the cult master in 1479 DR . History . Rowan Babar founded the Order of the Dawn in the city of Mreyelundar a few years before 1479 DR .
description_long: Rowan Babar Rowan Babar was the founder of the Order of the Dawn and the cult master in 1479 DR . History . Rowan Babar founded the Order of the Dawn in the city of Mreyelundar a few years before 1479 DR . Some people believed he impersonated the skull of a massive Primordial during the cult ' s rites , but that people usually met untimely ends .

title: Rowanmantle
description: Rowanmantle House Rowanmantle was a small noble house of Cormyr . The family was originally from the Tilverton area but moved its base to Suzail at some point . The family strongly supported the Obarskyr s and advised the crown during the rule of the Steel Regent .
description_long: Rowanmantle House Rowanmantle was a small noble house of Cormyr . The family was originally from the Tilverton area but moved its base to Suzail at some point . The family strongly supported the Obarskyr s and advised the crown during the rule of the Steel Regent . The house ' s strong Dalelands connections helped to forge an alliance between Cormyr , the Dalelands and Cormanthor . This alliance forced Sembia to agree to peace terms .

title: Rowen Cormaeril
description: Rowen Cormaeril Rowen Cormaeril was a Purple Dragon until his cousin Gaspar and several other nobles betrayed the royal family of Cormyr and had their nobility removed by Azoun IV , whereupon he became a scout assigned to Alusair Obarskyr ' s party . He fell in love with princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and eventually married her in the eyes of Chauntea , albeit with no witnesses . He was then separated from her when Alusair ordered him to track down Vangerdahast while the rest of their party fled to safety .
description_long: Rowen Cormaeril Rowen Cormaeril was a Purple Dragon until his cousin Gaspar and several other nobles betrayed the royal family of Cormyr and had their nobility removed by Azoun IV , whereupon he became a scout assigned to Alusair Obarskyr ' s party . He fell in love with princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and eventually married her in the eyes of Chauntea , albeit with no witnesses . He was then separated from her when Alusair ordered him to track down Vangerdahast while the rest of their party fled to safety . . Before he tracked down the Royal Magician , he was tricked by the illusions of Mad King Boldavar into thinking Tanalasta was in danger . In choosing to go to her aid instead of following his orders , he betrayed Cormyr . In doing so , the Mad King turned him into a ghazneth .

title: Royal Constabulary
description: Royal Constabulary The Royal Constabulary was a law enforcement organization that operated in Tsurlagol in the Vast , in the 7th century DR . History . In the early 7th century DR , the Royal Constabulary discovered the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly carousing in the Bloated Gargoyle Inn .
description_long: Royal Constabulary The Royal Constabulary was a law enforcement organization that operated in Tsurlagol in the Vast , in the 7th century DR . History . In the early 7th century DR , the Royal Constabulary discovered the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly carousing in the Bloated Gargoyle Inn . They tried to arrest him but he fled across the rooftops of the city , and was forced to drop the sword Galathos . Urthag escaped and his sword was given to King Lamoth .

title: Royal Council of Aglarond
description: Royal Council of Aglarond The Royal Council of Aglarond was the council that advised the Simbul , ruler of Aglarond , during her reign between 1320 DR and 1425 DR . It met monthly , usually at full moon , at the Council Hall in Velprintalar . The council was made up of 30 members , of which 11 are from major cities and the others are from smaller villages in Aglarond .
description_long: Royal Council of Aglarond The Royal Council of Aglarond was the council that advised the Simbul , ruler of Aglarond , during her reign between 1320 DR and 1425 DR . It met monthly , usually at full moon , at the Council Hall in Velprintalar . The council was made up of 30 members , of which 11 are from major cities and the others are from smaller villages in Aglarond . The Fang and Dahst did not recognise their being part of Aglarond at all , therefore did not send a councillor . Most of the positions on the council were hereditary positions held by the nobility of a particular province or city . The council was originally formed when Aglarond was created in 1065 DR . As of 1374 DR , the council meetings had reached around a tenday in length .

title: Royal Gardens
description: Royal Gardens The Royal Gardens were gardens around the royal palace Castle Obarskyr . Geography . The gardens were located in Suzail , Cormyr , on the slope of a hill away from the city itself .
description_long: Royal Gardens The Royal Gardens were gardens around the royal palace Castle Obarskyr . Geography . The gardens were located in Suzail , Cormyr , on the slope of a hill away from the city itself . Structure . Around 376 DR , the gardens consisted of orchards of apples , peaches , and pear trees . All arranged in rows with banks of , , , a hedge maze , a white gazebo , and a collection of statues , some from Myth Drannor .

title: Royal Gate
description: Royal Gate The Royal Gate was the entrance to the Grand Caliph ' s private apartments within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Gate was constructed of polished stone but , due to a powerful enchantment , could open like a curtain for approaching visitors .
description_long: Royal Gate The Royal Gate was the entrance to the Grand Caliph ' s private apartments within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Gate was constructed of polished stone but , due to a powerful enchantment , could open like a curtain for approaching visitors . Activities . The Grand Caliph ' s most valued guests used this gate when meeting with their leader . Contingents of the Honored and the Dutiful guarded the entrance . The mamluk s were aided by a pair of mages who rode " flying carpet s " and wielded wands .

title: Royal Harim of Huzuz
description: Royal Harim of Huzuz The Royal Harim of Huzuz , or simply the Royal Harim , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Harim was one of the largest sections of the palace .
description_long: Royal Harim of Huzuz The Royal Harim of Huzuz , or simply the Royal Harim , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Harim was one of the largest sections of the palace . It contained dormitories , beautiful gardens , and opulent suites . Inhabitants . The Royal Harim was the home to the Grand Caliph ' s many wives and concubines as well as their slaves , servants , and guards — numbering over 3 , 000 occupants . Rumors and Legends . A secret tunnel , known only to the inhabitants of the harim , was used to escort men into the harim . The men were usually dressed as women .

title: Royal Mint
description: Royal Mint The Royal Mint was the location where all production of Halruaa ' s currency occurred . Location . The Royal Mint was located in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa .
description_long: Royal Mint The Royal Mint was the location where all production of Halruaa ' s currency occurred . Location . The Royal Mint was located in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa . History . Halruaa ' s unique electrum coins , called skie , were produced in the Royal Mint from electrum mined to the east in Maeruhal .

title: Royal Vagabonds
description: Royal Vagabonds The Royal Vagabonds was a secret Shou Lung spy agency . Description . The Royal Vagabonds were a secret clan in service to the Shou Emperor .
description_long: Royal Vagabonds The Royal Vagabonds was a secret Shou Lung spy agency . Description . The Royal Vagabonds were a secret clan in service to the Shou Emperor . All members of the clan were ninja . They were not an official part of the government but still reported to the Minister of State Security and the Chief Imperial Censor . They did most of the difficult missions that the Emperor ordered . Nobody outside the clan could positively identify a vagabond . The only positive means of identification was a magical sigil borne on the chest of each man .

title: Rozsarran Dathan
description: Rozsarran Dathan Rozsarran Dathan was a male warrior who was one of the guards of the Twisted Tower in Shadowdale . History . In 1357 , Rozsarran Dathan was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair .
description_long: Rozsarran Dathan Rozsarran Dathan was a male warrior who was one of the guards of the Twisted Tower in Shadowdale . History . In 1357 , Rozsarran Dathan was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair . He was off duty and just finishing a drink at the Old Skull Inn when the Cult of the Dragon archmage Malark Himbruel approached him and cast a " sleep " spell on him , in order to permit Malark to enter the Tower while adopting Rozsarran ' s appearance .

title: Ruatheene
description: Ruatheene Ruatheene was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . She led the Zhent contingent based in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . She was a favorite of Manshoon .
description_long: Ruatheene Ruatheene was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . She led the Zhent contingent based in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . She was a favorite of Manshoon . Though not a powerful wizard , she maintained the control thanks to the beholder Araunglauth .

title: Ruathlek
description: Ruathlek Ruathlek was the " secret language " or magical script of illusionist s . Waterdeep was known to hold at least one library of books in this dweomer - guarded tongue . History .
description_long: Ruathlek Ruathlek was the " secret language " or magical script of illusionist s . Waterdeep was known to hold at least one library of books in this dweomer - guarded tongue . History . Ruathlek was descended from the Netherese language . It was said that Leira , the goddess of illusion and deception , developed Ruathlek with some of the descendants of Netheril , the wizard s of Nimbral . Unlike most illusionists , the people of Nimbral used Ruathlek as both a magical script and their mundane , everyday language .

title: Ruathym
description: Ruathym The island of Ruathym ( ROO - uh - Thim ) was one of the larger islands north of the Moonshae Isles in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym located more than 200 miles north of the Moonshae Isles .
description_long: Ruathym The island of Ruathym ( ROO - uh - Thim ) was one of the larger islands north of the Moonshae Isles in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym located more than 200 miles north of the Moonshae Isles . It was a rocky island with rugged coasts , narrow coves , green hills , forested purple mountains , and a few villages . It was barely 100 miles long from north to south and not even half that wide at its widest point . Its coast was pockmarked with deep fjords and dotted by clear bays with the exception of the south coast which boasted white , sandy beaches . Some impressive stands of pine grew on the island , surviving only thanks to the preservation effort of the First Axe of Ruathym . Farms and a few small villages occupied the majority of the landscape but a couple of areas were left wild . A spine of tall rocks ran down the middle of the island which were occasionally snow - capped . Environment . As an island in a subarctic climate , the sea played a large role in the environment . 8 months of the year , Ruathym experienced wintry temperatures with fog that clung to the island until quite late in the day ( if it left at all ) .

title: Ruathym ( city )
description: Ruathym ( city ) Ruathym was the largest settlement on the island of Ruathym in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym was located to the south of Holgerstead , another settlement on the island , and close to the magical ruins of Inthar , where a drow banshee dwelt until 1361 DR .
description_long: Ruathym ( city ) Ruathym was the largest settlement on the island of Ruathym in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym was located to the south of Holgerstead , another settlement on the island , and close to the magical ruins of Inthar , where a drow banshee dwelt until 1361 DR . History . In 1361 DR , the " Elfmaid " brought Liriel Baenre and her companion Fyodor to the island , where they hoped to harness the rune magic of Yggdrasil ' s Child . They stayed in Ruathym town for some time , investigating suspicious disappearances and deaths of local fishermen and others . Liriel defeated the drow banshee at Inthar and discovered that Dagmar , the daughter of Ulf the Shaman , was betraying her people to the Kraken Society . Liriel eventually discovered and defeated a conspiracy by Luskan and the Kraken Society .

title: Rubban
description: Rubban Rubban was the term used to describe the captain of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Sometimes , the " rubban " and " nakhuda " , or owner , were the same person .
description_long: Rubban Rubban was the term used to describe the captain of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Sometimes , the " rubban " and " nakhuda " , or owner , were the same person . A rubban was in charge of overseeing the safety and daily operation of the ship and her crew . While at sea , a rubban had full authority , deferring to the " nakhuda " only while in port .

title: Rubbaniyah
description: Rubbaniyah Rubbaniyah was the term used to describe an officer of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Though not required , especially on smaller vessels , " rubbaniyah " were useful in delegating lesser duties to shipmates so the " rubban " and " nakhuda " could focus on other things .
description_long: Rubbaniyah Rubbaniyah was the term used to describe an officer of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Though not required , especially on smaller vessels , " rubbaniyah " were useful in delegating lesser duties to shipmates so the " rubban " and " nakhuda " could focus on other things .

title: Ruben Delgaug
description: Ruben Delgaug Ruben Delgaug was an artist . He was a master artist , a painter , who was long dead by the 1360s DR . Among his works was a set of four paintings of Waterdeep during each season , sized 8×10 inches ( 20×25 centimeters ) .
description_long: Ruben Delgaug Ruben Delgaug was an artist . He was a master artist , a painter , who was long dead by the 1360s DR . Among his works was a set of four paintings of Waterdeep during each season , sized 8×10 inches ( 20×25 centimeters ) . These were rare and priced at 200 gp each , and 1600 gp for a full set . A set of these paintings was present at the Vipers ' Nest bandit hideout in 1369 DR .

title: Ruby
description: Ruby Ruby was a variety of that was a popular and plentiful jewel and had many magical uses in addition to its appeal as a sparkling gemstone . Description . Rubies came in a variety of colors , from colorless through shades of red to deep crimson .
description_long: Ruby Ruby was a variety of that was a popular and plentiful jewel and had many magical uses in addition to its appeal as a sparkling gemstone . Description . Rubies came in a variety of colors , from colorless through shades of red to deep crimson . The darker the shade and the fewer the inclusions and impurities , the more valuable was the gem . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp . About one in every hundred rubies was a star ruby . Powers . Superstitions around the Sea of Fallen Stars held that rubies bestowed good luck on their owners , but magical uses were much more reliable . Crushed to a powder and used in the enchantment , rubies greatly enhanced personal magic items that increased skill , ability , resistance , or luck . Ruby powder was also used to create the magic ink for scribing divine spells of the elemental and sun sphere s , and arcane spells of the abjuration , alteration , or evocation school s . The best time of day to use powdered ruby was " the time of the summer sunset . " Facet cut and polished rubies were required in the crafting of a " helm of brilliance " and were the gem of choice in decorating items that produced healing magic .

title: Ruby Rod of Asmodeus
description: Ruby Rod of Asmodeus The Ruby Rod of Asmodeus is a formidable weapon of evil possessed by the archdevil , Asmodeus . Description . The ruby rod glistens with an unimaginable , unearthly luster .
description_long: Ruby Rod of Asmodeus The Ruby Rod of Asmodeus is a formidable weapon of evil possessed by the archdevil , Asmodeus . Description . The ruby rod glistens with an unimaginable , unearthly luster . Rumors suggest that the value of its gems alone is worth more than one million gold pieces . It is considered a Greater Artifact . Powers . If wielded in melee the ruby rod functions as a " + 6 unholy greatclub " . It bestows an " inflict critical wounds " upon any target it hits . Any being that touches the ruby rod against Asmodeus ' s will is also subject to the " inflict critical wounds " . The ruby rod also has the following supernatural abilities . Asmodeus can use them at will . Anyone else in possession of the ruby rod can use them once per day .

title: Ruby Way
description: Ruby Way Ruby Way was a reddish crystal road in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Structure . Despite its name , the road was not made from ruby .
description_long: Ruby Way Ruby Way was a reddish crystal road in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Structure . Despite its name , the road was not made from ruby . Like the Diamond Road , the Ruby Way had a smooth , shiny appearance but was not slippery underfoot .

title: Ruby blushrose
description: Ruby blushrose The ruby blushrose was a flowering plant that grew within the Rose Garden in the Battle of Bones and other areas of Toril . Description . The flower of this plant was bright red , larger than other roses , and lacked thorns .
description_long: Ruby blushrose The ruby blushrose was a flowering plant that grew within the Rose Garden in the Battle of Bones and other areas of Toril . Description . The flower of this plant was bright red , larger than other roses , and lacked thorns . The ruby blushrose gave off a pleasing aroma that made most humans blush when they smelled it but was actually an airborne poison . Use . This flower was used in perfumes by inhabitants of Kara - Tur . Prolonged exposure to the aromas was believed to cause debilitating exhaustion and light - headedness , which some romantics simply attributed to falling in love . It was suspected that the disorientation one experienced within the Rose Garden was partly caused by this plant .

title: Ruby pendant
description: Ruby pendant A ruby pendant of beguiling was a ruby pendant with the powers of a " rod of beguiling " . Notable examples . Pasha Pook once owned a " ruby pendant " , and it was a key to his move to the top of the Calimport criminal world .
description_long: Ruby pendant A ruby pendant of beguiling was a ruby pendant with the powers of a " rod of beguiling " . Notable examples . Pasha Pook once owned a " ruby pendant " , and it was a key to his move to the top of the Calimport criminal world . The gem was stolen by Regis , who left the criminal world for Icewind Dale , where he used the ruby to gain the upper hand in the negotiation in Ten Towns . Artemis Entreri was sent to find the gem and the hin and get them back to Pook .

title: Ruby ray of reversal
description: Ruby ray of reversal Ruby ray of reversal , also known as Nezram ' s ruby ray , was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that reversed , undid , negated , circumvented , or destroyed particular magical spells , mundane hazards , or adverse situations . Effects . When cast , a narrow lance of bright red light emitted from the caster ' s fingertips in the direction he or she pointed toward a single target .
description_long: Ruby ray of reversal Ruby ray of reversal , also known as Nezram ' s ruby ray , was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that reversed , undid , negated , circumvented , or destroyed particular magical spells , mundane hazards , or adverse situations . Effects . When cast , a narrow lance of bright red light emitted from the caster ' s fingertips in the direction he or she pointed toward a single target . The range of the beam increased with the level of the caster but was at least 240 ft ( 73 m ) for the newer version and 420 ft ( 128 m ) for the older version . If the target was one of the following , then it was altered or negated as described . The " ruby ray " was blocked by solid or opaque objects and had no effect on " anti - magic shell s " , " prismatic sphere s " or other spells or circumstances not listed above . Only one target could be designated per casting of this spell . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a ruby valued at 1 , 000 gp or more for each casting of the spell . History .

title: Rucien - Xan
description: Rucien - Xan Rucien - Xan was a hidden elven realm allegedly located somewhere in the Chondalwood . Supposedly , it contained only one city , also called Rucien - Xan that served as the capital for both it and the nearby realm of Nikerymath . No explorer or adventurer has ever found Rucien - Xan , though stories exist mentioning it that date back to the time when Jhaamdath was founded .
description_long: Rucien - Xan Rucien - Xan was a hidden elven realm allegedly located somewhere in the Chondalwood . Supposedly , it contained only one city , also called Rucien - Xan that served as the capital for both it and the nearby realm of Nikerymath . No explorer or adventurer has ever found Rucien - Xan , though stories exist mentioning it that date back to the time when Jhaamdath was founded . The moonstars did , however , have an agent in Rucien - Xan , though obviously this was a closely guarded secret , as was most of the moonstars ' activity . Nuvian Eyes - Ashen was their regional agent for the Vilhon Reach and Shining Plains regions .

title: Rudiments of the Shadow Weave
description: Rudiments of the Shadow Weave Rudiments of the Shadow Weave was a controversial book about Shar ran doctrine and the Shadow Weave , written by the wizard Vontallion Rose . Description . " Rudiments of the Shadow Weave " contained a series of prose essays about the wonders and doctrine of the Goddess of Darkness in addition to instructions on how to tap into the power of the Shadow Weave .
description_long: Rudiments of the Shadow Weave Rudiments of the Shadow Weave was a controversial book about Shar ran doctrine and the Shadow Weave , written by the wizard Vontallion Rose . Description . " Rudiments of the Shadow Weave " contained a series of prose essays about the wonders and doctrine of the Goddess of Darkness in addition to instructions on how to tap into the power of the Shadow Weave . It also included complete formulae for several Shadow Magic versions of spells , including : Some copies of the very large book were bound in a fine black leather cover with fake golden wire designs . History . The book was written by the infamous archmage Vontallion Rose . Reputation . The book was highly controversial — a person caught owning a copy could be blackballed by the churches of Azuth and Mystra as well as by other arcane organizations . Notable owners . Zembrath Klun and his wife Thalis owned a copy of the book . It was kept on a bookshelf in their bedroom . Unknown to them , their daughter Selice Klun stole the pages of the book for herself .

title: Ruduk
description: Ruduk Ruduk was a Red Wizard of Thay agent in Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ruduk was sent by the zulkir Lauzoril to destabilize the country in order that one day Thay could conquer it .
description_long: Ruduk Ruduk was a Red Wizard of Thay agent in Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ruduk was sent by the zulkir Lauzoril to destabilize the country in order that one day Thay could conquer it . He had great autonomy in his plans . Personality . Ruduk did not truly care for the future of Unther , only to advance his position inside the Red Wizards .

title: Rueldarr
description: Rueldarr Rueldarr was the innkeeper of the Flaming Griffon inn in Mordulkin in Chessenta in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Rueldarr rented rooms to Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah , who ' d just escaped to Mordulkin from Luthcheq .
description_long: Rueldarr Rueldarr was the innkeeper of the Flaming Griffon inn in Mordulkin in Chessenta in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Rueldarr rented rooms to Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah , who ' d just escaped to Mordulkin from Luthcheq . He sent and received messages for them . Description . He wore a green tunic and brown linen vest , with a very thick mustache .

title: Ruen Morleth
description: Ruen Morleth Ruen was a trained monk and rogue who lived in the Mistshore section of Waterdeep harbor . He was a companion of the young wizard Icelin Tearn and the butcher Sull . He was an expert in weaponless combat and held the distinction of being the only person to " escape " from Waterdeep dungeon .
description_long: Ruen Morleth Ruen was a trained monk and rogue who lived in the Mistshore section of Waterdeep harbor . He was a companion of the young wizard Icelin Tearn and the butcher Sull . He was an expert in weaponless combat and held the distinction of being the only person to " escape " from Waterdeep dungeon . History . As a child , Ruen enjoyed playing in the woods . One day , he waded into a pool and was touched by spellplague that was lingering in the water . His spellscar gave him the ability to know the date of a person ' s death by touching them . This ability upset the residents of his village and he left to study at a monastery . Ruen became a successful rogue in Waterdeep but was captured by the Watch and imprisoned . The Watch made a deal to allow him to escape if he would become an informant in Mistshore . While in Mistshore , Icelin approached Ruen and hired him to protect her from the gold elf Cerest Elenithil , who was trying to capture her . Ruen successfully hid Icelin for a while and helped her kill Cerest when he finally caught up to her . He left Waterdeep with Icelin and Sull on a journey to attempt to find a cure for Icelin ' s spellscar . Equipment .

title: Ruexohn
description: Ruexohn Ruexohn was a incubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Ruexohn killed and replaced Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal .
description_long: Ruexohn Ruexohn was a incubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Ruexohn killed and replaced Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal . using his new identity Ruexohn influenced the First Lord ' s decisions . He also introduced Nomerthal to his twin sister Thessaly , just arrived in the city . Thessaly had seduced Nomerthal and Ruexohn convinced him that need to marry Thessaly . So the First Lord organized the First Lord ' s Midsummer Masquerade ballet in order to announce to all the wealthiest citizens of Hillsfar his marriage . As planned at this point an elf assassin ( in truth a fiendish doppleganger ) ruined the announcement of the marriage hitting Thessaly . Ruexohn and Thessaly prepared to escape but an adventuring party hired by Elanil Elassidil to gather intelligence about Hillsfar unveiled them and fought and killed them . However Ruexohn was quickly replaced by an other incubus posing as Davon .

title: Ruggedo
description: Ruggedo Ruggedo was the deep gnome king of Deepearth in the Underdark in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Ruggedo ruled Deepearth until the duergar led by the demon lord Orcus seized the city .
description_long: Ruggedo Ruggedo was the deep gnome king of Deepearth in the Underdark in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Ruggedo ruled Deepearth until the duergar led by the demon lord Orcus seized the city . He lived with his people in exile until 1357 DR when he planned with Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party on how to regain the city . After regaining his city , Ruggedo swore eternal friendship to Gareth . Later he joined the council that ruled the Barony . In 1359 DR , the gnomes had regained control of the city and worked with the dwarves of the Orothiar Clan in order to exploit bloodstone mines . Ruggedo was pondering to join the Alliance of Belt Watchers .

title: Ruha
description: Ruha Description . She is described as having sable hair , a proud nose , sultry eyes , and regal cheeks . Her cheeks are tattooed with crossed hash marks .
description_long: Ruha Description . She is described as having sable hair , a proud nose , sultry eyes , and regal cheeks . Her cheeks are tattooed with crossed hash marks . History . As a child , Ruha would often have visions of things to come . This was seen by her tribe , the Mtair Dhafir , as a sign of witchcraft , and she was outcast by her father , the sheikh . She was then raised by Qoha ' dar , a much older outcast woman , who taught her magic until she died , upon which point Ruha returned to her tribe . To avoid half his tribe leaving , her father arranged for her to marry a warrior from the Qahtani tribe , a man named Ajaman . After the death of Ajaman and the Qahtani at the hands of the Zhentarim , Ruha and Kadumi , Ajaman ' s brother set off to warn the Mtair Dhafir of the Zhentarim . They later came across a young Harper by the name of Lander , whose mission it was to stop the Zhentarim from opening a trade route across Anauroch . Together , the three of them saw to it that many of the desert tribes formed an alliance against the Zhentarim , although Ruha was the only one of the three to survive to see them succeed .

title: Ruhh Island
description: Ruhh Island Ruhh Island was located on Suq Bay near Hayyir . Geography . Given its position along the well - traveled Dihl al - Suq , Ruhh Island was a haven for pirates hoping to prey upon the richly - laden merchant vessels using the shipping lane .
description_long: Ruhh Island Ruhh Island was located on Suq Bay near Hayyir . Geography . Given its position along the well - traveled Dihl al - Suq , Ruhh Island was a haven for pirates hoping to prey upon the richly - laden merchant vessels using the shipping lane . Inhabitants . Ruhh Island held secret pirate bases frequented by the Shark of Suq Bay and the " Reaver " .

title: Ruinspoke
description: Ruinspoke Ruinspoke was a frontier village located near the border of Tymanther and Mulhorand . Ruinspoke served as the base of operations for adventurers and official Tymantheran expeditions sent to explore the old ruins of Unther . Description .
description_long: Ruinspoke Ruinspoke was a frontier village located near the border of Tymanther and Mulhorand . Ruinspoke served as the base of operations for adventurers and official Tymantheran expeditions sent to explore the old ruins of Unther . Description . Ruinspoke was a small village surrounded by a few farms and Untheran ruins in the outlying areas . It was protected by walls and had three gates , one in each of the main roads out of Ruinspoke . Those gates were named the Homeward Gate , on the west side , that was connected to a large and well - maintained road that led to Djerad Thymar ; Tuanek ' s Gate , on the north , named in honor to Lord Jalt Tuanek and that was connected to a path that led north to High Imaskar , and later Mulhorand ; and the Ruins Gate , on the southeast side of town , the most heavily guarded gate as it led to an unsettled area full of Untheran ruins . The largest building in Ruinspoke was Lord Tuanek ' s estate , that doubled as his office of power and as the area used for town celebrations , festivals , and gatherings .

title: Ruke Diggot
description: Ruke Diggot Ruke Diggot was a human male scholar from Mistledale . He was tall with curly red hair . During a trip to the forest of Cormanthor to study butterflies , he met the half - elf ranger Lyra Sunrose and they married a few months later , having eleven children together , all of whom still live in Cormanthor .
description_long: Ruke Diggot Ruke Diggot was a human male scholar from Mistledale . He was tall with curly red hair . During a trip to the forest of Cormanthor to study butterflies , he met the half - elf ranger Lyra Sunrose and they married a few months later , having eleven children together , all of whom still live in Cormanthor . Ruke was killed by a giant frog when it jumped out from an alder thicket and swallowed him whole .

title: Rukhelmoth Glitterstone
