description: Rukhelmoth Glitterstone Rukhelmoth Glitterstone , or simply Rukh was a deep gnome explorer who was held prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while attempting to sneak into the Fane of the Eye , Rukh was captured by Black Earth cultists .
description_long: Rukhelmoth Glitterstone Rukhelmoth Glitterstone , or simply Rukh was a deep gnome explorer who was held prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while attempting to sneak into the Fane of the Eye , Rukh was captured by Black Earth cultists . They decided to sacrifice her to a black pudding living under the temple . However , some adventurers infiltrated the temple , defeated the cultists , and freed her .

title: Rulasuu
description: Rulasuu Rulasuu was an island and naval base located off the coast of southwest Halruaa . Description . The island of Rulasuu served as one of two major bases for Halruaa ' s navy .
description_long: Rulasuu Rulasuu was an island and naval base located off the coast of southwest Halruaa . Description . The island of Rulasuu served as one of two major bases for Halruaa ' s navy . It housed normal sailing vessels as well as magical skyships . A formal city or town did not exist on the island , so the sailors often took their shore leave in the nearby city of Khaerbaal , making it quite rowdy at times .

title: Rulathorn
description: Rulathorn Captain Rulathorn is the aged and distinguished commander of the city watch of Waterdeep . A fair , but tough man , Rulathorn is more than willing to arrest the same person time and again until they cease wrongdoings within the city . Rulathorn reports directly to Open Lord Piergeiron .
description_long: Rulathorn Captain Rulathorn is the aged and distinguished commander of the city watch of Waterdeep . A fair , but tough man , Rulathorn is more than willing to arrest the same person time and again until they cease wrongdoings within the city . Rulathorn reports directly to Open Lord Piergeiron . Possessions . Rulathorn ' s armed with the " red sword " , which is somewhat famous within Waterdeep . He is also known to use an iron horn of Valhalla to summon reinforcements .

title: Ruldarr
description: Ruldarr Ruldarr , a man of grace and manners , was the owner of Ruldarr ' s Pipes , Locks , Tobacco and Fine Furniture in the tiny community of Bargewright Inn in the years after the Time of Troubles . He was also an experienced gardener , his plants taking up much of the room in his house and shop . Description .
description_long: Ruldarr Ruldarr , a man of grace and manners , was the owner of Ruldarr ' s Pipes , Locks , Tobacco and Fine Furniture in the tiny community of Bargewright Inn in the years after the Time of Troubles . He was also an experienced gardener , his plants taking up much of the room in his house and shop . Description . Ruldarr had a refined appearance with a small pointed beard and an oiled mustache .

title: Ruldorn
description: Ruldorn Ruldorn " the Storm Ranger " is a guide , a Harper and a community leader within the city of Everlund . Ruldorn ' s home is hidden a bit west of city , though he can usually be found frequenting the Battered Hat when not guiding others on various trails . Ruldorn has earned his nickname for his ability to navigate in even the worst of storms .
description_long: Ruldorn Ruldorn " the Storm Ranger " is a guide , a Harper and a community leader within the city of Everlund . Ruldorn ' s home is hidden a bit west of city , though he can usually be found frequenting the Battered Hat when not guiding others on various trails . Ruldorn has earned his nickname for his ability to navigate in even the worst of storms . Appearance . A thin , giant of a man , Ruldorn stands almost seven feet ( 2 . 1 m ) tall , weighing only a little more than 220 pounds ( 100 kg ) .

title: Rule - of - Three
description: Rule - of - Three Rule - of - Three was a cambion working with Graz ' zt in a plan to unite the baatezu , tanar ' ri , and yugoloth s . Rule - of - Three was just about the most knowledgeable source on the Abyss available . He dwelt on Azzagrat in the city of Zelatar or in Sigil .
description_long: Rule - of - Three Rule - of - Three was a cambion working with Graz ' zt in a plan to unite the baatezu , tanar ' ri , and yugoloth s . Rule - of - Three was just about the most knowledgeable source on the Abyss available . He dwelt on Azzagrat in the city of Zelatar or in Sigil . He was allied with Graz ' zt , and knew much about the Abyssal Realms . When in Azzagrat , he stayed in the back room of an inn called the Golden Opportunity . People searching for information from him could easily access it , but for a three - pronged price , such as precious metals of three different types or three magic items . Rule - of - Three was the mastermind behind the plan for which he was named , a uniting of tanar ' ri , yugoloth , and baatezu to take over the upper planes .

title: Rule of Dragons
description: Rule of Dragons The Rule of Dragons was a period in Abeir ' s history when dragon s consolidated their rule in the continent of Laerakond . Description . After the War of Fang and Talon , a mighty dragon called Gorloun founded the first dragon empire , and soon rival draconic realms sprang up thereafter .
description_long: Rule of Dragons The Rule of Dragons was a period in Abeir ' s history when dragon s consolidated their rule in the continent of Laerakond . Description . After the War of Fang and Talon , a mighty dragon called Gorloun founded the first dragon empire , and soon rival draconic realms sprang up thereafter . In the lands of the eastern continent Shyr , the despotic primordial Karshimis also created his own nation . These nations quarreled each other for ages , but draconic rule remained nearly unchallenged until the Blue Breath of Change , when Laerakond and other regions of Abeir were transported to Toril , and the fate of the world of Abeir became a mystery to Faerûn ian sages .

title: Ruler ' s Ridge
description: Ruler ' s Ridge Ruler ' s Ridge , or Calim ' s See , was a peak in the Marching Mountains . It was one of the locations where the bakkal s of Coramshan were buried and then the site of a great genie battle . Description .
description_long: Ruler ' s Ridge Ruler ' s Ridge , or Calim ' s See , was a peak in the Marching Mountains . It was one of the locations where the bakkal s of Coramshan were buried and then the site of a great genie battle . Description . Ruler ' s Ridge was located in the northern Marching Mountains near Minthrux Vale and Bottle Falls , where the Two Falls River began . It was once called Calim ' s See . At that time , the mountain was some 500 feet taller . A great avalanche turned what used to be a large , conical mountain into a jagged - edged peak . History . Calim ' s See was once the burial site of choice for the bakkals of Coramshan and the rulers of the first seven dynasties of Calimshan . After being mummified in the First Necropolis of Nykkar , the dead were carted up a road around the mountain and through a set of golden doors in a cliff - side . The entrance to the tombs was lost to time , buried beneath rock and earth in −1990 DR , when a group of more than six djinn , efreet , and dao fought in the mountains in a battle that lasted months and led to the death of a noble dao .

title: Rulers ' Blade
description: Rulers ' Blade The Rulers ' Blade ( also known as the Great King ' s Sword , or Ar ' Cor ' Kerym in Elven , and sometimes referred to as the Crownblade ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Coronal , monarchial ruler of the kingdom of Cormanthyr , leader of the elves . History .
description_long: Rulers ' Blade The Rulers ' Blade ( also known as the Great King ' s Sword , or Ar ' Cor ' Kerym in Elven , and sometimes referred to as the Crownblade ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Coronal , monarchial ruler of the kingdom of Cormanthyr , leader of the elves . History . The Ruler ' s Blade was created by Elven High Magic alongside its mates , the Warblade and the Artblade in - 4000 DR , at the behest of the ill Coronal of Jhyrennstar , Oacenth , who desired the magical swords to determine the rulers of the united tribes and new nation of Cormanthyr . Since it was drawn by the first Coronal Kahvoerm Irithyl , it has never left the side of the Coronals . In 661 DR , after the passing of Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl , the Rulers ' blade hovered atop the Rule Tower awaiting a claiming ceremony during the five years of mourning instituted by the Coronal ' s niece and lone heir , Aravae Irithyl . Aravae was ultimately murdered three years after her uncle died , and in 666 DR , the first open Claiming Ceremony begun in Myth Drannor .

title: Rulisqer
description: Rulisqer Rulisqer of Tyr was a human male paladin of Tyr , god of justice , who policed the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Rulisqer and his fourteen followers believed that public safety and lawful behavior would bring happiness and prosperity to all . Through diligent , expert policing , they broke up brawls in the streets and kept out thieves ' guilds .
description_long: Rulisqer Rulisqer of Tyr was a human male paladin of Tyr , god of justice , who policed the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Rulisqer and his fourteen followers believed that public safety and lawful behavior would bring happiness and prosperity to all . Through diligent , expert policing , they broke up brawls in the streets and kept out thieves ' guilds . Those who drew a weapon would soon find themselves subdued , disarmed , and marched out of town . The Tyrrans seemed to always know when and where there was going to be trouble . Thanks to their efforts , Mossbridges saw very little crime .

title: Rumblebelly
description: Rumblebelly Rumblebelly was the horse and mount belonging to Regis of the Companions of the Hall . Description . Rumblebelly was a fat pinto pony .
description_long: Rumblebelly Rumblebelly was the horse and mount belonging to Regis of the Companions of the Hall . Description . Rumblebelly was a fat pinto pony . He was well - trained . History . Regis acquired Rumblebelly during his time with the Grinning Ponies along the Trade Way ( 1481 – 1483 DR ) . He was named for Regis ' s nickname , " Rumblebelly , " given to him by his friend Bruenor Battlehammer .

title: Rumpadump
description: Rumpadump Rumpadump was a myconid sprout in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rumpadump was very introverted , preferring to hang back and not use its rapport spores unless absolutely necessary .
description_long: Rumpadump Rumpadump was a myconid sprout in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rumpadump was very introverted , preferring to hang back and not use its rapport spores unless absolutely necessary . It was concerned that Voosbur ' s " strange spores " had affected the rest of myconid community . Relationship . Rumpadump was Stool ' s buddy , despite it being as shy as Stool was outgoing . History . Rumpadump lived in Neverlight Grove in the " troupe " of Voosbur . Directed by Zuggtmoy ' s will , Voosbur led its troupe to Gracklstugh to collect bigwig and pygmywort mushrooms . Rumpadump was the only one that remained free from Zuggtmoy ' s corruption .

title: Rundeen
description: Rundeen The Rundeen were a slaving and mercantile consortium that operated in the southern Sword Coast and the Chultan Peninsula . History . They were originally a Tashalaran merchant company that operated during the Shoon Imperium .
description_long: Rundeen The Rundeen were a slaving and mercantile consortium that operated in the southern Sword Coast and the Chultan Peninsula . History . They were originally a Tashalaran merchant company that operated during the Shoon Imperium . When the Knights of the Shield tried to expand their influence to the Chultan peninsula , they were rebuffed by a group calling themselves the Rulnadeen . Upon investigating their new opponents , the Knights realized that it would be much simpler to agree to the merchants ' demands and join them as members of their group rather than get rid of them . Being more experienced in trading with foreign powers , several Knights quickly became high - ranking members of the Rulnadeen while they themselves achieved a foothold in Calimshan . When the Shoon Imperium finally fell in 450 DR , both the Knights and the Rulnadeen saw an opportunity to fill the power vacuum left behind . The Knights tried to take over their southern partners but were prevented from doing so . Angry , the Rulnadeen gave an ultimatum to the Knights who had joined them : sever all ties to the Knights or leave forever .

title: Rundeth Hobyltar
description: Rundeth Hobyltar Rundeth Hobyltar was the only tailor and dyer of High Dale . Personality . He was cynical and laconic .
description_long: Rundeth Hobyltar Rundeth Hobyltar was the only tailor and dyer of High Dale . Personality . He was cynical and laconic . History . Rundeth was in his youth a warrior on Sembia ' s payroll before he settled in High Dale . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Rundeth was a member of the Council of the High Dale .

title: Rune of chaos
description: Rune of chaos A rune of chaos was a magical symbol representing chaos . There were at least nine runes of chaos . The runes of chaos were a key part of the operation of the dread artifact " Thakorsil ' s Seat " .
description_long: Rune of chaos A rune of chaos was a magical symbol representing chaos . There were at least nine runes of chaos . The runes of chaos were a key part of the operation of the dread artifact " Thakorsil ' s Seat " . The horrid " ritual of twin burnings " — which involved the sacrifice , body and soul , of a good mage — created a crystal pane bearing one of the runes of chaos around the " Seat " . With all nine runes of chaos in place , a victim trapped in the chair was eternally bound to it and enslaved to the will of its owner .

title: Runecaster
description: Runecaster A runecaster was a prestige class of Faerûn . Divine spellcasters who knew of the particular advantages of rune magic , runecasters used magic and a special alphabet to create runes , which were symbols that possess magical effects that were both powerful and capable of being used multiple times . Although rune magic was originally created by the dwarves and giants millennia ago , its practice eventually became available to other races .
description_long: Runecaster A runecaster was a prestige class of Faerûn . Divine spellcasters who knew of the particular advantages of rune magic , runecasters used magic and a special alphabet to create runes , which were symbols that possess magical effects that were both powerful and capable of being used multiple times . Although rune magic was originally created by the dwarves and giants millennia ago , its practice eventually became available to other races . The Thunder Blessing in particular spread this form of magic quite effectively as young dwarves brought their particular skills out into the wider world . Runecasters used their runes generally for defensive purposes such as preventing unwanted intruders from entering a particular corridor , protecting a relic , or otherwise deter others from undesirable actions . Applications included protecting temples , trapping poacher trails , and enhancing the capabilities of an otherwise understrength defensive emplacement . The actual method to activate a rune depended on the will of the runecaster . Methods of activation included permanent activation , activation upon being touched , and activation upon being read .

title: Runehammer
description: Runehammer A runehammer is a magic + 1 warhammer that is made from darksteel . It contains the ability to cast a spell once per day , but the spell is the same each time , stored in the head of the hammer in the shape of a rune , giving the item its name . There are three common types of runehammer : Alhalbrin ( " heat metal " ) , Faerindyl ( " burning hands " ) and Thundaril ( " polymorph other " into either snail or toad ) .
description_long: Runehammer A runehammer is a magic + 1 warhammer that is made from darksteel . It contains the ability to cast a spell once per day , but the spell is the same each time , stored in the head of the hammer in the shape of a rune , giving the item its name . There are three common types of runehammer : Alhalbrin ( " heat metal " ) , Faerindyl ( " burning hands " ) and Thundaril ( " polymorph other " into either snail or toad ) . Depending on the type of spell stored , the hammer can be worth between 11 , 000 and 18 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Runemeet
description: Runemeet Runemeet is a holy day of Uthgar on the autumn equinox when the Uthgardt tribes travel to their respective ancestor mounts ( or to Beorunna ' s Well , the holiest of all ) for rites , pacts , and communing with ancestors . This is when juveniles who seek recognition as full tribe members prove themselves by hunting their tribes ' ritual enemies . Although Uthgardt ceremonies can be performed anywhere , the Thunderbeast tribe believed it could not stay strong without an ancestor mound .
description_long: Runemeet Runemeet is a holy day of Uthgar on the autumn equinox when the Uthgardt tribes travel to their respective ancestor mounts ( or to Beorunna ' s Well , the holiest of all ) for rites , pacts , and communing with ancestors . This is when juveniles who seek recognition as full tribe members prove themselves by hunting their tribes ' ritual enemies . Although Uthgardt ceremonies can be performed anywhere , the Thunderbeast tribe believed it could not stay strong without an ancestor mound . = References =

title: Runestone
description: Runestone Runestones are stone slabs , with messages carved into them . These messages could be warnings , instructions , stories and accounts of events . They vary in shape and size depending on the creator and time they were made .
description_long: Runestone Runestones are stone slabs , with messages carved into them . These messages could be warnings , instructions , stories and accounts of events . They vary in shape and size depending on the creator and time they were made . Some runestones even have magic enchantments installed into them . History . The ancient civilization known as the Adamant Kingdom of Xothaer , was home to numerous dwarven scholars . They recorded vast amounts of information on runestones . These records are still found today underneath the Cloud Peaks in various conditions , most shattered . Around 1370 DR the people of Iltkazar were famous makers of Runestones . Description . Runestones are large slabs of durable stone , usually about an inch thick . The have stories , instructions and accounts of events carved into them . Runestones can have messages carved into one or both sides . Runestones were sometimes carved with images or runes in relief . This meant they could be used as seals or a temporary path markers when pressed into wet mud . Although extremely rare , runestones have been discovered made of precious metals . Variations . Dwarven Runestones .

title: Rupert Brock
description: Rupert Brock Rupert Brock was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . On land , he was good - mannered but on board his ship Rupert was a tyrant , leading his crew with a crop and not caring to have adequate supplies .
description_long: Rupert Brock Rupert Brock was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . On land , he was good - mannered but on board his ship Rupert was a tyrant , leading his crew with a crop and not caring to have adequate supplies . He was also only a fair navigator .

title: Ruqiah
description: Ruqiah Ruqiah was a member of the Desai tribe , part of the nomadic Bedine . She was the reincarnation of Catti - brie . Description .
description_long: Ruqiah Ruqiah was a member of the Desai tribe , part of the nomadic Bedine . She was the reincarnation of Catti - brie . Description . Like her former incarnation but despite her parents ' darker complexions , Ruqiah had thick , light brown hair with red highlights and blue eyes . Ruqiah had two spellscars , one on each arm . On her left forearm was a seven - pointed star on a circle of red ( the symbol of Mystra ) ; on her right forearm was a unicorn ' s head ( the symbol of Mielikki ) . History . Ruqiah was born in Anauroch on the spring equinox ( 19 Ches ) in 1463 DR to Niraj and Kavita . At age five , her blooming magic and secret garden caught the attention of the Netherese lord Parise Ulfbinder , who sent Shadovar agents Untharis and Alpirs De ' Noutess to kidnap her . They failed and were killed by Ruqiah , who fled soon after to protect her parents , who practiced magic , from the Netherese . In 1469 DR , Ruqiah was taken in by Lady Avelyere to be trained in the magic arts at her Coven in the Shade Enclave , where she remained for ten years until 1479 DR , when Lady Avelyere discovered her true identity .

title: Rusalka
description: Rusalka A rusalka was a female fey water spirit that lived in cold lakes , streams , and rivers . They were notorious for their song , which could lure mortals into their arms or into watery graves . Description .
description_long: Rusalka A rusalka was a female fey water spirit that lived in cold lakes , streams , and rivers . They were notorious for their song , which could lure mortals into their arms or into watery graves . Description . A rusalka appeared to be a beautiful woman , with pale white skin and hair that was an odd hue of green and gold , but red lips . Despite their cold environs , they often wore little more than a gown or shawl of diaphanous cloth , but a number would even go nude . However , Liriel Baenre encountered a warrior rusalka with muscular body and wearing leather armor , with white skin and empty white eyes . Abilities . In a form of symbiosis , a rusalka was mystically bonded to a specific body of water or waterway , ranging in size from a pond to a lake or a stream to a river . She could move to a distance of up to 300 yards ( 275 meters ) away from the water ' s edge , but beyond this point she could no longer breath . She had to hold her breath or immediately begin to drown in air , and could not breathe normally again until she ' d re - immersed herself in her home water .

title: Ruse
description: Ruse Ruse was a bandit berserker in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Ruse was one of the two lieutenants of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek .
description_long: Ruse Ruse was a bandit berserker in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Ruse was one of the two lieutenants of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek . During a meeting with another bandit group , the Claws of Tiamat , an adventuring party hired to clear the Iron Route of outlaws caused havoc . Ruse was killed in fighting .

title: Rushing Hills
description: Rushing Hills The Rushing Hills was a series of rocky outcroppings that lay southeast of the city of Lheshayl in the Shining Plains in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The Rushing Hills were a rough and rocky range , consisting of natural outcroppings of rock .
description_long: Rushing Hills The Rushing Hills was a series of rocky outcroppings that lay southeast of the city of Lheshayl in the Shining Plains in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The Rushing Hills were a rough and rocky range , consisting of natural outcroppings of rock . These hindered planting in the area . Inhabitants . The Krakk ' t tribe of thri - kreen made their home here , as well as in the plains to the southwest . The tribe only numbered about fifty or so members and was nomadic . The tribe was further split into three distinct packs , for which reason outsiders called them " tri - kreen " . They hunted rabbit s , Plainsteed s , and other herd animals that entered their territory . They considered horse a delicacy . They rarely attacked travelers in the area , but the chances of an attack rose if there were elves in the group ( as elf - meat was also a delicacy for thri - kreen ) . The fire drake s of the Deepwing Mountains hunted for food in the Rushing Hills , and occasionally attacked the thri - kreen there . History . Around 1360 DR , the folk of Lheshayl decided to try to drive the thri - kreen from the hills .

title: Rusk
description: Rusk Huntmaster Rusk was a cleric of Malar . Relationships . Rusk once loved Maleva .
description_long: Rusk Huntmaster Rusk was a cleric of Malar . Relationships . Rusk once loved Maleva . History . Rusk was born as a natural werewolf in a community where people worshiped all nature gods : Silvanus , Chauntea , Malar , and Eldath . For many years , he was welcomed among both humans and wolves , gaining a reputation as a ranger in the Dalelands and Sembia . He was in love with Maleva , a powerful cleric of Selûne . She told Rusk about the Black Wolf prophecy , a heresy shared by both worshipers of Selûne and worshipers of Malar . Rusk later became a hunter of renown . He was hired by Vilsek Malveen of Selgaunt as a guide . Soon he gathered followers and started arguing with Maleva , who wanted him to convert to Selùne ' s faith . Breaking with Maleva Rusk , he instead joined the People of the Black Blood . In 1372 DR , Stannis Malveen contacted Rusk , offering a rare copy of the Black Wolf Scroll in exchange for infecting with lycanthropy a member of the Uskevren family . Personality . Rusk feared he would no longer be the chosen vessel of Malar , and even that he might never have been . He feared he had himself created the individual that would become the new champion of Malar .

title: Russel Roland
description: Russel Roland Russell Roland held the title of Lord MacIntyre of Ravens Bluff from 1354 DR - - ? Appearance . Russel Roland is 5 ' 8 " tall and weighs 175 pounds .
description_long: Russel Roland Russell Roland held the title of Lord MacIntyre of Ravens Bluff from 1354 DR - - ? Appearance . Russel Roland is 5 ' 8 " tall and weighs 175 pounds . He is almost impossibly strong and most clothing cannot conceal his god - like physique . He wears fine clothes as befitting a lord but when hunting his outfit is rugged and practical . Personality . Russel had to become very self - reliant after the premature death of his father in 1353 DR when he was 13 . He likes to hunt , especially monsters that come too close to civilized areas , and is an avid sportsman . He depends on his own great strength and skill and insists that no magic be used when hunting , in tournaments , or in duels of honor . He has enough sense to defer to the older lords in the Advisory Council but will speak out when he thinks it is important to do so . He is often underestimated due to his youth . Background . Lord Russell ' s great - grandfather Maldridge MacIntyre was a wizard of renown in the region and was granted a large tract of land outside Ravens Bluff .

title: Rust monster
description: Rust monster A rust monster was an aberration that corroded and ate metal . Physical description . A rust monster was the size of a small pony , with four insectlike legs and a squat , humped body .
description_long: Rust monster A rust monster was an aberration that corroded and ate metal . Physical description . A rust monster was the size of a small pony , with four insectlike legs and a squat , humped body . Its hide was thick and lumpy and was yellowish tan on the belly and rust - red on the back . Its tail ended in what looked like a double ended paddle . Two long antennae come out of its head , one under each eye . Combat . A rust monster had a weak bite and did not normally attack with it . They attacked anyone who had metal , however , with their antennae . The touch of an antenna could turn even magical metal items into rust . Ecology . Rust monsters ate the rust of freshly rusted metal objects . Behavior . A rust monster could smell metal from ninety feet away . They always went for the biggest source of metal first , and preferred ferrous metals over precious ones .

title: Rusteen
description: Rusteen Rusteen was the Realms name for . Description . Rusteen occurred in shades of brown from pale to dark reddish brown .
description_long: Rusteen Rusteen was the Realms name for . Description . Rusteen occurred in shades of brown from pale to dark reddish brown . They were small but very hard and could be cut into faceted gems and used to decorate swords , armor , shields , and horse tack . A typical specimen had a base value of 500 gp . Powers . This precious stone could be used as a material component for " forcecage " and " wall of force " spells .

title: Rusting grasp
description: Rusting grasp Rusting grasp is a transmutation spell that lets the caster corrode metals and alloys with a touch . Effects . You corrode iron and iron alloys at a touch .
description_long: Rusting grasp Rusting grasp is a transmutation spell that lets the caster corrode metals and alloys with a touch . Effects . You corrode iron and iron alloys at a touch . Any iron or iron alloy item you touch becomes instantaneously rusted , pitted , and worthless , effectively destroyed . If the item is so large that it cannot fit within a 3 - foot radius ( a large iron door or a wall of iron ) , a 3 - foot - radius volume of the metal is rusted and destroyed . Magical metal items are immune to this spell . You may employ " rusting grasp " in combat with a successful melee touch attack . Rusting grasp used in this way instantaneously destroys 1d6 points of Armor Class gained from metal armor ( up to the maximum amount of protection the armor offered ) through corrosion . For example , full plate armor ( AC + 8 ) could be reduced to + 7 or as low as + 2 in protection , depending on the die roll . Weapons in use by an opponent targeted by the spell are more difficult to grasp . You must succeed at a melee touch attack against the weapon . ( See Strike a Weapon , page 136 of the " Player ' s Handbook " . ) A metal weapon that is hit is instantaneously destroyed .

title: Rutherford Urmbrusk
description: Rutherford Urmbrusk Rutherford Urmbrusk was the heir of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Rutherford ' s father , Quarren Urmbrusk abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure in Undermountain granting the control of the House to his sister Lestra Urmbrusk and also granted her the custody of Rutherford .
description_long: Rutherford Urmbrusk Rutherford Urmbrusk was the heir of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Rutherford ' s father , Quarren Urmbrusk abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure in Undermountain granting the control of the House to his sister Lestra Urmbrusk and also granted her the custody of Rutherford . Secretly Lestra bribed the Quarren ' s companions in order to kept sure that he never went back from the dungeon . However in 1479 DR a voice like the one of Quarren started whispered to Rutherford ' s ears . Believing his father to be alive Rutherford gathered some companions , a half - elf mercenary Zarr , a elf wizard , Aizel , a halfling rogue Enda and the half - orc s brothers fighters Squam and Rotwile , for a rescue mission . However Rutherford too disappeared and his uncle hired an adventuring party to find he or his remains .

title: Ruthless punisher
description: Ruthless punisher Ruthless punishers are ranger s of a brutal and merciless temperament , known for their cruelty and terrifying reputation . Most ruthless punishers are hunters of a sort , though they prefer the challenge offered by sentient prey rather than the common beast s most hunters stalk . For good or evil , ruthless punishers are virtually unequaled in their skill at hunting down their foes .
description_long: Ruthless punisher Ruthless punishers are ranger s of a brutal and merciless temperament , known for their cruelty and terrifying reputation . Most ruthless punishers are hunters of a sort , though they prefer the challenge offered by sentient prey rather than the common beast s most hunters stalk . For good or evil , ruthless punishers are virtually unequaled in their skill at hunting down their foes . Culture . Not all ruthless punishers have the same motivations or origins , but most commonly think of themselves as hunters rather than killers . The only difference between them and traditional hunters is their preference in prey , which they prefer to be capable of thought and rationality , deeming an animal ' s limitation to instinct and reaction dull . Humanoids on the other hand , and other sentient creatures , provide more entertaining game , or so ruthless punishers believe . Though they excel in causing pain and fear , a ruthless punisher need not necessarily be evil . A great many ruthless punishers , for instance , act as bounty hunters or vigilantes , hunting down criminals or other villains either out of a personal sense of justice or in pursuit of a reward .

title: Ruudi Stonekin
description: Ruudi Stonekin Ruudi Stonekin was a dwarf cartographer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Ruudi sold her maps inside the Yawning Portal inn .
description_long: Ruudi Stonekin Ruudi Stonekin was a dwarf cartographer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Ruudi sold her maps inside the Yawning Portal inn . She tried to approach all people who had knowledge about Undermountain ' s structure and purchased for generous amounts maps of yet - unexplored sections of the dungeon . Ruudi also sold maps of the Yawning Portal , Waterdeep ' s streets , and all the public fountains in each of the city ' s wards . History . Ruudi arrived at the Yawning Portal in only 1479 DR . Relationship . Ruudi claimed to be related to Clan Melairkyn . Personality . Ruudi had a kind of map mania ; people joked that she used a map even to to to the privy . She was friendly , enthusiastic , and generous with anyone who wanted to speak about maps or Undermountain - related topics but was truly uninterested about other topics .

title: Rydah
description: Rydah Rydah the Storm Soother was the high priestess of Umberlee in Mulmaster . Personality . Rydah was a cunning and cool - headed individual .
description_long: Rydah Rydah the Storm Soother was the high priestess of Umberlee in Mulmaster . Personality . Rydah was a cunning and cool - headed individual . Despite not being violent herself , she believed that the last resort was should always be violence . With that method , she protected herself and Umberlee ' s position in the city . History . Rydah rose through the ranks of the local Church of Umberlee with a combination of politics and force . At last , she killed the previous high priest in a duel on the docks . In 1491 DR , she was concerned by Drayson Fivestars ' s preaching to devotees of her church . She hoped to find someone to stop him .

title: Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma
description: Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma , also known as Rylatar , is a red dragon . Description . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma is around 80 ft ( 24 m ) long .
description_long: Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma , also known as Rylatar , is a red dragon . Description . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma is around 80 ft ( 24 m ) long . Her scales are crimson - colored and her wings are a deep indigo color . Personality . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma claims to not be fond of anything . She likes to play games and hunt . Magic Items . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma has a silver ring in the shape of a winged dragon eating its own tail . The ring has the power to change the shape of a dragon into the form of a human or elf . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma used the ring to take the form of a human woman named Ryla Dragonclaw .

title: Ryld Argith
description: Ryld Argith Ryld Argith was a drow master of Melee - Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Description . Ryld was unusual for a drow due to his large and burly build .
description_long: Ryld Argith Ryld Argith was a drow master of Melee - Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Description . Ryld was unusual for a drow due to his large and burly build . He stood about five and a half feet ( 168cm ) tall . Quite unlike a typical male drow ' s sense of vanity , Ryld had a warrior ' s pragmatism and kept his hair close - cropped to prevent foes from grabbing it during combat . Personality . Although Ryld worshiped Lolth , Ryld was not particularly religious . He was not overly fond of the spider motifs dedicated to Lolth that were so prevalent in Menzoberranzan . He was a " sava " master . He apparently had a liking for duergar brandy , which he snuck out of Gracklstugh and carried with him on his journeys . History . Background . Ryld was a commoner who grew up in the poor district of Braeryn in Menzoberranzan . When Ryld was six years old , he was involved in one of the nobles ' notorious Hunts through Braeryn that ended in a massacre of fire . He was badly burned and buried under dead bodies . He attended Melee - Magthere and became lesser master there , the highest rank he could achieve with his non - noble status . However , he later grew bored with his position .

title: Rylla
description: Rylla Rylla was the Half - drow battlemistress of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Rylla was the main military leader of the Church of Eilistraee .
description_long: Rylla Rylla was the Half - drow battlemistress of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Rylla was the main military leader of the Church of Eilistraee . In 1379 DR , she summoned the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann for a meeting . Rylla was the first that Cavatina alerted when she discovered that the cook Meryl had been replaced by a dretch . Rylla led the Protectors to attempt to catch the infiltrator . Later Rylla discovered that Qilué had killed the druid Horaldin tried to stop her Lady believing her in thrall of Wendonai . However Qilué scaring that she would ruin her plot to kill Lolth was forced to kill also Rylla .

title: Rym Windwalker
description: Rym Windwalker Rym Windwalker was a half - elven wizard living in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Eager to prove himself as a young mage , Rym always looked for adventure .
description_long: Rym Windwalker Rym Windwalker was a half - elven wizard living in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Eager to prove himself as a young mage , Rym always looked for adventure . He was known to join wandering bands of adventurers . Rym ' s adventurous spirit threatened to be his undoing , as he was more likely to charge into battle before weighing the consequences of such actions .

title: Ryndala Merendil
description: Ryndala Merendil Lady Ryndala Merendil of House Merendil was a traitor to Cormyr . History . She attempted to trick Amedahast , the first apprentice royal magician , into aiding an assassination attempt on the young Azoun I .
description_long: Ryndala Merendil Lady Ryndala Merendil of House Merendil was a traitor to Cormyr . History . She attempted to trick Amedahast , the first apprentice royal magician , into aiding an assassination attempt on the young Azoun I . Her assassins were defeated by both Amedahast and Azoun I , and she quickly fled Cormyr . She died sometime later and was interred under an unknown tree , becoming the second ghazneth . Abilities . As a ghazneth , Lady Merendil had the power of disease , causing a feverish plague to sweep around her , sapping the strength and will of her opponents . Even if her enemies survived their encounter with the deadly demon , the plague weakened them enough that the ghazneth could quickly overwhelm them later on . Appendix . Notes . Only called " Lady Merendil " in " " , in " Beyond the High Road " , Merendil was identified as " Mirabelle Merendil " . " Death of the Dragon " , its sequel , later used the name " Ryndala " . The correct name is confirmed in Ed Greenwood ' s " The Merendil Gold " article in " Dragon " # 409 .

title: Rysellan
description: Rysellan Rysellan the Dark was a wizard from Calimshan and the founder of the Twisted Rune . History . Rysellan the Dark was an aging wizard from Calimshan when he founded the Twisted Rune in 864 DR .
description_long: Rysellan Rysellan the Dark was a wizard from Calimshan and the founder of the Twisted Rune . History . Rysellan the Dark was an aging wizard from Calimshan when he founded the Twisted Rune in 864 DR . He intended it to be a secret consortium of wizards that would be the true power behind all rulers of the Lands of Intrigue . In 1182 DR , Rysellan gained the trust of Wyvorlaa , the court wizard of Tethyr , and the Twisted Rune gained influence over Tethyrian politics as a result . However , the work of Rysellan and his closeness with Wyvorlaa caused jealously amongst the Rune ' s other members , and in 1188 DR , three other liches accused Rysellan of divulging secrets . The ensuing battle destroyed Rysellan and two of his three lich apprentices , their phylacteries destroyed — only Kartak Spellseer would survive . This was also a major setback for the Twisted Rune ' s influence in Tethyr , as Wyvorlaa was uncovered and executed . Equipment . Iryklathagra , a powerful blue dragon , had a set of nine matched king ' s tears crystals in her hoard , each depicting one of the founding liches of the Twisted Rune .

title: Rystia Zav
description: Rystia Zav Rystia Zav was a spy and a member of the Harpers during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rytsia had gone mad from loneliness , fear , and demon lord s ' influence .
description_long: Rystia Zav Rystia Zav was a spy and a member of the Harpers during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rytsia had gone mad from loneliness , fear , and demon lord s ' influence . She believed that all beings she met were killers sent after her . History . Rystia was a Harper spy from Nesme . Two years before the Rage of Demons , she was tasked with the mission of finding Mantol - Derith and infiltrating the Zhentarim garrison there . However , Rystia became lost in the Underdark . During the Rage of Demons , she came to the gates of Mantol - Derith without knowing she had arrived or how .

title: Rythan
description: Rythan Crown Prince Rythan of Tethyr was next in line to the throne of Tethyr . He destroyed the lich Jhaniloth Puiral of the Twisted Rune while she was in her lair . In retribution for this act , the Rune created Mulsparkh , and Rythan was killed in the Battle of Nightflames against its armies in 1334 DR .
description_long: Rythan Crown Prince Rythan of Tethyr was next in line to the throne of Tethyr . He destroyed the lich Jhaniloth Puiral of the Twisted Rune while she was in her lair . In retribution for this act , the Rune created Mulsparkh , and Rythan was killed in the Battle of Nightflames against its armies in 1334 DR .

title: Rythanko
description: Rythanko The Rythanko was a magical bracelet of unknown origin . It was carried by a Githyanki aboard a merchant ship on the Moonsea when the ship was captured by the Orcsblood in 1460 DR . A young pirate named Gareth Jadaren took the Rythanko from the Gith and carried it to Mulmaster after he deserted his ship .
description_long: Rythanko The Rythanko was a magical bracelet of unknown origin . It was carried by a Githyanki aboard a merchant ship on the Moonsea when the ship was captured by the Orcsblood in 1460 DR . A young pirate named Gareth Jadaren took the Rythanko from the Gith and carried it to Mulmaster after he deserted his ship . Gareth paid a mage to identify the Rythanko but the mage claimed it was worthless even though he knew it was very powerful . Later , Jandi M ' baren used the Rythanko to create the wards on Jadaren Hold . Powers . The full extent of the Rythanko ' s powers are unknown but it seemed to control the pocket plane that the entity Fandour was imprisoned in and some of Fandour ' s power seemed to be linked to the Rythanko . The bracelet appeared to be semi - sentient and could alter its shape to avoid detection . Appearance . The Rythanko appears as a linked metallic bracelet with three red stones , possibly garnet s .

title: Rythnax
description: Rythnax Rythnax was a black dragon wyrmling near Phlan in 1489 DR . He was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Personality .
description_long: Rythnax Rythnax was a black dragon wyrmling near Phlan in 1489 DR . He was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Personality . Rythnax was a brash , boastful , and young dragon . His main joy was to tell an audience all his stories of his strength , ferocity , and cunning . However , he could attack anyone he felt had not appreciated his stories . He also grew quickly bored . History . In 1489 DR , he was sent to the marsh near Phlan to act as support for Ellison Berenger . Eventually , just after Ellison joined him in his lair , the two were confronted by an adventuring party hired to recover the books that Ellison stole from Mantor ' s Library . Rythnax was defeated by the adventurers .

title: Ryvvik Dlardrageth
description: Ryvvik Dlardrageth Ryvvik Dlardrageth was the third - in - command of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Ryvvik was the youngest and only surviving child of Sarya Dlardrageth .
description_long: Ryvvik Dlardrageth Ryvvik Dlardrageth was the third - in - command of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Ryvvik was the youngest and only surviving child of Sarya Dlardrageth . His father was a vrock . Activities . Ryvvik oversaw all intelligence - gathering operations . History . Sarya killed Ryvvik around 1371 DR . Personality . Ryvvik wanted always to know others ' thoughts and feelings . He enjoyed using his powers to inflict emotional , mental , or psychic pain on others . Ryvvik usually used telepathy and spoke very little .

title: Ryzliir Symryvvin
description: Ryzliir Symryvvin Ryzliir Symryvvin was a female drow elite warrior in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Ryzliir fought with a shortsword and shield in battle .
description_long: Ryzliir Symryvvin Ryzliir Symryvvin was a female drow elite warrior in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Ryzliir fought with a shortsword and shield in battle . History . During the Rage of Demons , Ryzliir was commanded to lead a drow battalion to intercept an expedition led by some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , but she and her troops were defeated .

title: S ' domo rhan
description: S ' domo rhan The s ' domo rhan was a giant beetle that was said to dwell on the Naktong Moors of Koryo . The s ' domo rhan had the power to transform into a beautiful woman , in which form it would lure men to their dooms .
description_long: S ' domo rhan The s ' domo rhan was a giant beetle that was said to dwell on the Naktong Moors of Koryo . The s ' domo rhan had the power to transform into a beautiful woman , in which form it would lure men to their dooms .

title: S ' slaar
description: S ' slaar S ' slaar was a troglodyte chieftain during the Rage of Demons . History . S ' slaar led a troglodyte tribe in the Wormwrithings area .
description_long: S ' slaar S ' slaar was a troglodyte chieftain during the Rage of Demons . History . S ' slaar led a troglodyte tribe in the Wormwrithings area . During the Rage of Demons , he had a disagreement with his war chief H ' slaat about the ownership of a magic sword . Soon a civil war started between S ' slaar ' s and H ' slaat ' s loyalists . Without interruption in the last battle he was killed in the fighting by H ' slaat , that become the next chieftain

title: Sa ' Sani
description: Sa ' Sani Sa ' Sani was a yuan - ti princess around 1374 DR . History . Sa ' Sani was the princess of the Sauringar tribe in the Chultan Peninsula and a priestess of Sseth .
description_long: Sa ' Sani Sa ' Sani was a yuan - ti princess around 1374 DR . History . Sa ' Sani was the princess of the Sauringar tribe in the Chultan Peninsula and a priestess of Sseth . However , around 1374 DR , the Se ' Sehen tribe betrayed Sseth by pleading their allegiance to the new god Zehir and attacked the Sauringar , slaughtering many and taking control of the Temple of World Serpent . Sa ' Sani relocated to Samarach where she worked as a merchant . There , she met the Hero of Neverwinter and manipulated him or her into attacking and destroying the Se ' Sehen .

title: Sa ' id Firdawsi
description: Sa ' id Firdawsi Sa ' id Firdawsi was a rich halfling cloth merchant in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Typical for many halflings , Sa ' id was cheerful and got along well with most people .
description_long: Sa ' id Firdawsi Sa ' id Firdawsi was a rich halfling cloth merchant in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Typical for many halflings , Sa ' id was cheerful and got along well with most people . All of this was an elaborate ruse that concealed his manipulative nature . Activities . Sa ' id ' s cloth business in the Court District was a front for his real job as spymaster of Huzuz . His network of spies stretched across the entire expanse of the Land of Fate . He communicated regularly with Tannous al - Assad with special message ring s . In order to keep hired muscle ignorant of their true patron , Tannous used Sa ' id to hire adventurers and mercenaries for his special missions . History . Tannous al - Assad personally appointed Sa ' id to his position when Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir became the Grand Caliph 30 years earlier .

title: Sa ' luk
description: Sa ' luk Sa ' luks were scoundrels and free adventurers in Zakhara . Rogue s to their core , these men and women owed allegiance to none but themselves . Requirements .
description_long: Sa ' luk Sa ' luks were scoundrels and free adventurers in Zakhara . Rogue s to their core , these men and women owed allegiance to none but themselves . Requirements . There were no special requirements for sa ' luks , and they had no special hindrances . Role . Sa ' luks usually roamed wherever they wanted . They survived by their skill at thieving , and lived for the moment . Freedom was what a sa ' luk most appreciated . They would do what they wanted , when they wanted . Possessions . Sa ' luks usually had nothing to tie them down to one location . Even after scoring a successful haul , they typically spent their wealth quickly on superficial baubles or entertainment .

title: Saablic Tan
description: Saablic Tan Saablic Tan was a clone of the drow wizard Malavon Despana . History . Tan escaped from his master ' s clutches when one of them " died " and then ran to Isair and Madae for help .
description_long: Saablic Tan Saablic Tan was a clone of the drow wizard Malavon Despana . History . Tan escaped from his master ' s clutches when one of them " died " and then ran to Isair and Madae for help . After this , Saablic Tan became the chief wizard of the Legion of the Chimera .

title: Saas
description: Saas The Saas , or " Shields " , were the collection of mountain ranges that surrounded the Great Glacier and isolated it from the rest of Toril . Geography . The icy mountains of the Saas towered over the lands of the Great Glacier .
description_long: Saas The Saas , or " Shields " , were the collection of mountain ranges that surrounded the Great Glacier and isolated it from the rest of Toril . Geography . The icy mountains of the Saas towered over the lands of the Great Glacier . They rose to elevations of thousands of feet above sea level . At their narrowest parts , each range was many miles wide . Three separate ranges composed the Saas , the Tuutsaas Chain in the west , the Lugsaas Chain in the south , and the Angsaas Chain in the east . Most of the mountains of the Saas — as was the case with the other mountain ranges of the Glacier — were made of nearly solid ice , formed during the creation of the Glacier . This permafrost was at least 2 , 000 feet ( 610 meters ) thick in most places . The Saas had few passes — most would only be attempted by risk - taking explorers . Flora & Fauna . Remorhaz lived in all three of the Saas in great numbers , in tunnels below the mountains . Some thus considered them the " gatekeepers " of the Great Glacier .

title: Sabal Mizzrym
description: Sabal Mizzrym Sabal Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . History . Sabal was the youngest twin sister of Greyanna Mizzrym and the daughter of Matron Mother Miz ' ri Mizzrym .
description_long: Sabal Mizzrym Sabal Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . History . Sabal was the youngest twin sister of Greyanna Mizzrym and the daughter of Matron Mother Miz ' ri Mizzrym . Although the two sisters were very similar , Miz ' ri seemed to prefer Greyanna and , without support , Sabal slowly fell into obscurity until she was viewed a fool unfit for the simplest of tasks . It was at that point that Pharaun stepped in and began aiding Sabal , helping her rise through the ranks of the house . This infuriated Greyanna , and she vowed revenge upon Pharaun . After chasing him through the house one night in an attempt to kill him , he escaped to the wizard academy Sorcere at Tier Breche , where he was able to obtain a post as a master . Finally , Greyanna tricked Sabal into accepting a cursed amulet that made Sabal very ill until she died . In 1372 DR , after another confrontation with Pharaun , which she lost , Greyanna asked him why he had helped the youngest twin and not accepted her alliance , as they were identical . Pharaun explained that it was only an intellectual challenge , to raise someone from obscurity to glory .

title: Sabass
description: Sabass Sabass , also known as Sabass of Thay , was a high level wizard in the School of Conjuration and Summoning in the magocracy of Thay in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . and the Zulkir of this school until the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description .
description_long: Sabass Sabass , also known as Sabass of Thay , was a high level wizard in the School of Conjuration and Summoning in the magocracy of Thay in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . and the Zulkir of this school until the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . Sabass kept the traditional bald head of the Red Wizards and had long mustaches that hung down . He also had a small goatee on his chin . Both were gray with age . During his adventuring days he made a great reputation for himself , but after he retired from the adventuring life he became quite sedentary . Personality . Sabass wanted nothing more than to be left alone to do his research , but the demands of politics forced him to get involved because the ambitions of his peers threatened to disrupt trade and create a scarcity of resources , both of which made research more difficult . Sabass wanted to maintain the Balance ( in this case , between the elemental lord s rather than between the gods of Nature ) and was concerned that the Salamander War might anger Kossuth or get other elemental lords involved . Activities .

title: Sabban
description: Sabban A sabban was a major subdivision of a Calishite town or city , akin to a district or ward . Description . A sabban was composed of between three and five drudach s , smaller subdivisions .
description_long: Sabban A sabban was a major subdivision of a Calishite town or city , akin to a district or ward . Description . A sabban was composed of between three and five drudach s , smaller subdivisions . A sabban was surrounded by a wall that was higher than any drudach walls , being elevated with additional stone to form a rampart . Sabbans contained a minimum of certain structures among their drudachs , because each sabban was intended to function as a self - sustaining unit within the larger town or city . Government . The ruler of a sabban was called a sabbalad and served much like a mayor — or in some cases , like a crimelord . A sabbalad was responsible for the drudachs within his sabban , leading through the druzirs positioned under him . If was quite common for the sabbalad to have connections to the criminal underworld as well . For particularly small towns or villages , a sabbalad would be the only mayor , as only one sabban — or perhaps even only one drudach — was present . In larger towns and cities , the sabbalad was subservient to a sultan . Like the druzirs serving under them , the power of a sabbalad had varied depending on the era .

title: Sabinus
description: Sabinus Sabinus was a male human smuggler and crime lord in Tantras in the Vast before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Sabinus interacted with the mortal Kelemvor , who was in search of one of the Tablets of Fate , and smuggled inside Bane ' s agents , the then mortal Cyric and the assassin Durrock , into Tantras .
description_long: Sabinus Sabinus was a male human smuggler and crime lord in Tantras in the Vast before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Sabinus interacted with the mortal Kelemvor , who was in search of one of the Tablets of Fate , and smuggled inside Bane ' s agents , the then mortal Cyric and the assassin Durrock , into Tantras . After the terrible battle between Bane and Torm , Sabinus fled the city , asking help from Cyric , but the thief killed Sabinus , as he was no longer of use to him .

title: Sable
description: Sable Sable was the falcon companion of Keren Donnell . Description . Sable was a huge black falcon .
description_long: Sable Sable was the falcon companion of Keren Donnell . Description . Sable was a huge black falcon . History . The first time Tristan Kendrick and his companions fought a group of firbolg s , Keren and Sable arrived just in time to save the day , but not before Arlen was slain . A while later , it was Sable who told Robyn that Keren had been captured by firbolgs and needed their help .

title: Sable Forest
description: Sable Forest The Sable Forest was located on the Elemental Plane of Fire near the City of Brass . Description . The Sable Forest was filled with large black trees called serpent trees .
description_long: Sable Forest The Sable Forest was located on the Elemental Plane of Fire near the City of Brass . Description . The Sable Forest was filled with large black trees called serpent trees . These trees were usually bare of leaves , taking their nourishment from heat instead of light . Activities . Noble efreeti held hunts in the Sable Forest on a daily basis . Any unwelcome trespassers often found themselves run down by savage hell hound s .

title: Sabu lord
description: Sabu lord Sabu lords , or “ Lion Lords , ” were large cats that lived on the plains and savannahs of Zakhara . They were very territorial , harassing any who traveled through their lands without permission . Description .
description_long: Sabu lord Sabu lords , or “ Lion Lords , ” were large cats that lived on the plains and savannahs of Zakhara . They were very territorial , harassing any who traveled through their lands without permission . Description . These cats were much stronger than other large cats . All had golden fur and males had red flowing manes . Their roar could be heard from far away . Combat . These cats entered combat surrounded by a group of regular lions who fought to the death to defend them . They were incredibly hard to surprise and could leap up to 60 feet ( 18 . 2 m ) for a claw or bite attack . A sabu lord ’ s roar caused damage to all nearby combatants . Brittle items could even be shattered by its power . This roar also summoned all cats within a 15 mile ( 24 . 1 km ) radius to the sabu lord ’ s aid . Habitat / Society . Sabu lords were vain creatures attended by a host of lions . They would usually only hunt for entertainment since food was provided for them . A sabu lord ’ s territory ranged for 15 miles ( 24 . 1 km ) surrounding its lair . Mating between sabu lords occurred at the border between two territories .

title: Sabyna
description: Sabyna Sabyna was a ship ' s mage in 1370 DR . History . Sabyna lived all her life on the sea .
description_long: Sabyna Sabyna was a ship ' s mage in 1370 DR . History . Sabyna lived all her life on the sea . Her father Siann Truesail and two of her brothers were also ship ' s mages . Relationships . Thanks to her family , Sabyna had a network of contacts among ship ' s mages , captains , sailors and merchants . Personality . Sabyna had great social skills that permitted her to be at home with all kinds of people . She constantly fed half - true gossip . She loved cooking , especially very spicy foods and all kinds of exotic dishes , and entertaining guests . Sabyna loved her ship the " Breezerunner " . She fell in love with Jherek Wolf ' s - get but had doubts about their life together .

title: Sacred Oak
description: Sacred Oak The Sacred Oak was an oak tree in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Inhabitants . At night , the tree was frequented by lovers who make their vows in secrecy .
description_long: Sacred Oak The Sacred Oak was an oak tree in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Inhabitants . At night , the tree was frequented by lovers who make their vows in secrecy . wild and wood elves claimed that the Sacred Oak was the first tree on Evermeet . History . The tree was believed to have originated in Arvandor and was looked upon with great respect by the elves on Evermeet . Once per year each Agelong , Queen Amlaruil Moonflower visited the tree to assure the island ' s independence and freedom and to show her dedication to the elven gods .

title: Sacred Seer
description: Sacred Seer The Sacred Seer was a mutated myconid ruler in Sporedome . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Sacred Seer , infected by the madness , decided to worship the demon lord Zuggtmoy together with all her colony , also gaining some derro and fomorians followers .
description_long: Sacred Seer The Sacred Seer was a mutated myconid ruler in Sporedome . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Sacred Seer , infected by the madness , decided to worship the demon lord Zuggtmoy together with all her colony , also gaining some derro and fomorians followers . After the disappearance of many myconid sprouts from all the nearby myconid colonies , Agaricus and his fellows managed to capture the Sacred Seer and were on the verge of putting her to death . However , an adventuring party arrived in search of the fabled braincap mushroom . They offered to save the missing sprouts in exchange for help from the Sacred Seer to find the braincap . After pondering the offer , Agaricus decided to accept the help of the adventurers . Personality . The Sacred Seer was a macabre and brooding creature . Her goal was the decay of all the universe , believing this would benefit her race . The Sacred Seer refused to admit to worshiping Zuggtmoy .

title: Sacred flame
description: Sacred flame Sacred flame is a prayer similar , but not identical , to " lance of faith " . It is cast by cleric s , primarily devoted cleric s . When " sacred flame " is cast the cleric invokes divine power , casting a beam of light from the heavens into the flesh of a creature within twenty - five feet , injuring them to a degree largely dependent on how focused and perceptive the cleric casting the prayer is .
description_long: Sacred flame Sacred flame is a prayer similar , but not identical , to " lance of faith " . It is cast by cleric s , primarily devoted cleric s . When " sacred flame " is cast the cleric invokes divine power , casting a beam of light from the heavens into the flesh of a creature within twenty - five feet , injuring them to a degree largely dependent on how focused and perceptive the cleric casting the prayer is . The resulting blast allows the cleric to grant a boost in courage and health to one ally within their sight to a degree partially dependent on the cleric ' s charisma and partially dependent on how experienced the cleric is . " Sacred flame " , one of the most basic prayers known , can be cast at will .

title: Sacred guardian
description: Sacred guardian Sacred guardian was an enchantment spell that warned the caster whenever the target was in danger . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient of this spell for it to work .
description_long: Sacred guardian Sacred guardian was an enchantment spell that warned the caster whenever the target was in danger . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient of this spell for it to work . For days after this spell was cast , the priest would mystically become aware of any danger that was threatening the target creature . The spell lasted longer the higher the level of the caster and , with a little practice , the priest received a mental picture of the situation facing the recipient . However , no location information was conveyed by this spell ; only what the caster could infer from the mental image . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the caster had to touch the recipient and have a rose petal that had been kissed by the recipient .

title: Sacred lizardfolk poison
description: Sacred lizardfolk poison This sacred poison was used by the lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Effect . When poisoning occurred , the victim suffered instant paralysis for two to twelve minutes unless they had the fortitude to resist it .
description_long: Sacred lizardfolk poison This sacred poison was used by the lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Effect . When poisoning occurred , the victim suffered instant paralysis for two to twelve minutes unless they had the fortitude to resist it . Users . The Poison Dusk lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp typically used this poison on their arrows to incapacitate foes , such as when they tried to ambush and capture a group of adventurers at the Skull Staff in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . They typically laughed when a foe was paralyzed by it . Kessessek , chieftain of the Sharptooth lizardfolk , declined to share it with the adventurers afterwards , saying it was sacred to the god Semuanya .

title: Sadalar
description: Sadalar Sadalar was a crinti warchief living in Dambrath during the 12th century DR . Relationships . Sadalar was the consort of queen Melanith .
description_long: Sadalar Sadalar was a crinti warchief living in Dambrath during the 12th century DR . Relationships . Sadalar was the consort of queen Melanith . Activities . Under direct appointment from Queen Melanith , Sadalar became the first male named warchief of Dambrath . Bribery and corruption plagued his time as warchief . As warchief , Sadalar used his influence raising the standard of life for the arkaiun living in Dambrath , eventually elevating them to second - class citizens as opposed to slaves . Sadalar perished during the battle with the deep gnome city of Aventine .

title: Sadik Harama
description: Sadik Harama Sadik Harama was an old dwarf who ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadik was completely bald .
description_long: Sadik Harama Sadik Harama was an old dwarf who ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadik was completely bald . Activities . Sadik sold a wide variety of metal weapons in the Grand Bazaar . The quality of his weapons was average or good , but he was a poor haggler , so clever customers usually found great deals . Sadik employed a pair of hulking ogre s armed with two - handed sword s .

title: Sadimmin
description: Sadimmin El Sadimmin were the standard army of the country of Calimshan . Etymology . The term " sadimmin " was plural , and meant " powerful swords " .
description_long: Sadimmin El Sadimmin were the standard army of the country of Calimshan . Etymology . The term " sadimmin " was plural , and meant " powerful swords " . Organization . The Sadimmin forces of a given city were under the control of one of the sultans . As of 1370 DR , el Sadimmin had the following military ranks , from lowest to highest : Upon reaching the rank of balak or qayadin , a soldier in el Sadimmin was granted a mansion or villa on the syl - pasha ' s estate . This provided enhanced status for the officer but also meant that the syl - pasha could blackmail him more easily . Garrisons . The barracks for the soldiers of each sabban was known as a " sadidah " . A " sadidah " often had a minaret attached to it and was four stories tall or taller . They tended to be simple and practical structures , holding 40 to 60 troops . Each garrison was controlled by at least four officers and contained armories as well . A " sadidah " armory was stocked about twice as well as that of a typical amlakkhan .

title: Sadiq
description: Sadiq Sadiq , also called Sadiq the Smokey was an efreeti pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadiq served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .
description_long: Sadiq Sadiq , also called Sadiq the Smokey was an efreeti pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadiq served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan . He controlled his own stronghold , complete with a staff of other efreet and noble efreet as well as a contingent of slaves of various races .

title: Sadrach ’ s Splinter
description: Sadrach ’ s Splinter Sadrach ' s Splinter was a thin mesa in the Underchasm . It was connected to the Underchasm ' s east wall by a series of earthmotes and suspension bridges . A dark castle sat on top of the mote .
description_long: Sadrach ’ s Splinter Sadrach ' s Splinter was a thin mesa in the Underchasm . It was connected to the Underchasm ' s east wall by a series of earthmotes and suspension bridges . A dark castle sat on top of the mote . Prior to the Spellplague the castle was the home of the human wizard Sadrach . However , the Spellplague drastically altered Sadrach ' s form so that he became part of the stone of the castle although we was able to create a body for himself out of the castle ' s walls . He lived on the mote with his pet monsters and slaves .

title: Saed
description: Saed Saed was a vampire and the preeminent beast chieftain of Veldorn . Personality . Saed was a melancholy character , always thinking about his lost fortune .
description_long: Saed Saed was a vampire and the preeminent beast chieftain of Veldorn . Personality . Saed was a melancholy character , always thinking about his lost fortune . He found peace only when he used his powers to mediate the beast chieftains ' disputes . Activities . Sometimes Saed thieved off the Shining South caravans that traveled Veldorn . He normally mediated all disputes between his fellow beast chieftains , thanks to his abilities and his psionic power s . History . Once Saed was a member of Chakka Baroda and the wealthiest merchant of Turelve . Thus , as a Durpar i custom , he was also elected nawab . Saed became more and more powerful but did not want to share his wealth with his chaka fellows . So he discreetly started searching for a way to achieve immortality . One day , a very friendly visitor arrived in his court , offering immortality in exchange for an oath to Shar . Saed agreed and the visitor conduced him to Vaelen , where he turned Saed into a vampire slave . Later , he went back to his city as a puppet of his master . When his chaka discovered the matter , they sent adventurers to kill the vampires but skew only Saed ' s master . Saed survived and escaped .

title: Saemon Havarian
description: Saemon Havarian Saemon Havarian appears in both the novel and the game versions of the Baldur ' s Gate II story . He ' s the character responsible for taking the protagonist to the island prison of Spellhold . The Novel .
description_long: Saemon Havarian Saemon Havarian appears in both the novel and the game versions of the Baldur ' s Gate II story . He ' s the character responsible for taking the protagonist to the island prison of Spellhold . The Novel . In the Saemon Havarian is a drunk with a boat . He rows Abdel Adrian to Spellhold on Bodhi ' s command . The Games . In " " and " " , Saemon Havarian is a flamboyant and opportunistic sea - captain and corsair with a knack for getting out of trouble , often by putting others in it in his stead . He will take the protagonist ' s party to Brynnlaw near Spellhold , regardless of whether his aid is acquired through the Shadow Thieves or Bodhi . It will shortly turn out that Havarian has betrayed the party when he leads them into a vampire ambush . He ' s actually working for Irenicus more or less against his will . After the player ' s party escapes from the maze under Spellhold , he appears again with a plan to defeat Irenicus , ultimately forcing the mage to flee .

title: Saerlar Stormwyvern
description: Saerlar Stormwyvern Saerlar Stormwyvern was a Moonstars spy inside Candlekeep . History . Saerlar went to infiltrate Candlekeep .
description_long: Saerlar Stormwyvern Saerlar Stormwyvern was a Moonstars spy inside Candlekeep . History . Saerlar went to infiltrate Candlekeep . He killed and replaced a shadovar agent who had posed as a monk of the monastery . In 1487 DR , after the shadovar special agent Maerandor gathered all shadovar spies inside Candlekeep , Saerlar infiltrated the group . However , Maerandor unveiled him , but just before the shadovar could attack him an earthquake hit the room . Saerlar profited off the confusion and managed to escape .

title: Saerlia Ashley
description: Saerlia Ashley Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley was a female human cleric of Tempus , god of battle . She tended the shrine of Tempus in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . She was a scarred woman who inspired attending adventurers and Purple Dragons soldiers with sermons of battle , blood , and fire .
description_long: Saerlia Ashley Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley was a female human cleric of Tempus , god of battle . title: Saerloon
description: Saerloon Saerloon was a Sembia n city known for its gothic architecture , peppered throughout with gargoyles and other embellishments , and for its mercantile activity , seasoned by thievery and intrigue . Goverment . Saerloon was nominally ruled by a merchant prince , who ultimately served the merchant council .
description_long: Saerloon Saerloon was a Sembia n city known for its gothic architecture , peppered throughout with gargoyles and other embellishments , and for its mercantile activity , seasoned by thievery and intrigue . Goverment . Saerloon was nominally ruled by a merchant prince , who ultimately served the merchant council . Trade . Saerloon was a busy shipping hub . Defenses . Around 7 , 000 " helms " patrolled the city and surrounding area . In 1358 DR , Lady Merelith led these guards . History . Saerloon inherited its distinctive architecture from the Chondathan colonists who established Saerloon as their beachead in the area . In the early days of Sembia , the port was dubbed Saerloon after the master merchant Saer led Sembia to prosperity and wealth . In 1478 DR , Haelta Johannes was made the new Lord Govenor of Saerloon . With the backing of her Netherese masters she began bringing Saerloon under control by exterminating any worship of deities besides Shar .

title: Saesaan Aelorothi
description: Saesaan Aelorothi Saesaan Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Saesaan was the wife of Pharnth Aelorothi .
description_long: Saesaan Aelorothi Saesaan Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Saesaan was the wife of Pharnth Aelorothi . She won his respect by bypassing his magical wards and purloining his most prized spellbook . Activities . Saesaan ' s duty was to acquire arcane lore and powerful magic item s . She reported directly to Sarya Dlardrageth . Personality . Saesaan had an excessive passion for intrigues and betrayals , and was hated for this by most of her fellow fey ' ri .

title: Saestra Karanok
description: Saestra Karanok Saestra Karanok was the vampire daughter of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . During a very bad joke by her brother Naeros Karanok she was locked in a crypt for nine days ; when Saestra exited she was a vampire .
description_long: Saestra Karanok Saestra Karanok was the vampire daughter of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . During a very bad joke by her brother Naeros Karanok she was locked in a crypt for nine days ; when Saestra exited she was a vampire . However she managed to kept secret the fact to her family and directing them in destroying her vampire master . Saestra managed to kept her secret offering herself to supervised the city watch at night , explaining this as a system to improve the watch ' s efficiency . Using the watch ' s cover she killed people she pretended to be wizards secretly draining them of blood . Activities . On days Saestra delivered baskets of food , healing herbs , and small toys for the children of Luthcheq . On night Saestra using confiscated magic tools incriminated a person to be a wizard and during a private interrogation drained the victim ' s blood . Personality . Saestra had two personalities depending of her hunger : in one she was sweet , innocent and loving , in the other she was a savage killer .

title: Saeval Calaudra
description: Saeval Calaudra Saeval Calaudra was a moon elf rogue and assassin and , as of 1374 DR , was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma . He offered support and expertise to Eldreth Veluuthra cells across Faerûn and introduced people to the Vel ' Nikeryma . As of 1374 DR he was the youngest member of the organization .
