title: Safe fall
description: Safe fall Safe fall was a basic alteration spell similar to the " feather fall " spell , but with more versatility . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .
description_long: Safe fall Safe fall was a basic alteration spell similar to the " feather fall " spell , but with more versatility . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects . This spell slowed the falling rate of any solid object or living creatures within its area of effect , which could be as large as 100 square feet . " Safe fall " also deflected any missiles passing through the area . In order for this spell to work , the invisible sheet created needed to be anchored to at least two solid points of contact that were diametrically opposed . Opposite walls usually sufficed for the anchor points . The " safe fall " spell eliminated inertia in either a horizontal or vertical plane . The vertical effect was used to prevent missiles from passing through the invisible barrier . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a single square inch of a closely woven net to cast .

title: Safia al - Gurab Sakir
description: Safia al - Gurab Sakir Safia al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Safia was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master .
description_long: Safia al - Gurab Sakir Safia al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Safia was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master . She was nervous compared to her sister Mara al - Gurab Sakir . Decription . Safia had shiny black hair and dark eyes . Activities . Safia served as one of Akim al - Kalaas ' s apprentices , learning the mystical ways of the sha ' ir .

title: Safiya
description: Safiya Safiya is a Red Wizard of Thay , and one of the companions of the Kalach - Cha during the events of " " . Personality . Safiya was an instructor at the Academy of Shapers and Binders .
description_long: Safiya Safiya is a Red Wizard of Thay , and one of the companions of the Kalach - Cha during the events of " " . Personality . Safiya was an instructor at the Academy of Shapers and Binders . Her mother , Nefris , was the headmistress of the academy . In contrast to most Red Wizards , Safiya has little interest in power - grabs like the other " despots " of Thay , instead focusing on her scholarly pursuit of the arcane arts . She enjoys building construct s and using transforming magics , and is very fond of Kaji , her homunculus familiar , one of her earliest creations . The Kalach - Cha inferred during one conversation that her somewhat sheltered upbringing as the headmistress ' daughter may have had something to do with her being " less ruthless " ( direct quote ) than other Red Wizards . Safiya is nevertheless a highly skilled mage . Specialty . Safiya is specialized in the school of Transmutation , much like Sand , the moon elven wizard in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . As a transmuter , she is dedicated to building and shaping objects , and is highly skilled at crafting enchanted weaponry and armaments .

title: Safsaf
description: Safsaf Safsaf was a vishap living in the Furrowed Mountains in 1367 DR . Personality . Safsaf was a coward , preferring to observe travelers in her land well in advance of encountering them .

title: Saga of the Dragon Queller
description: Saga of the Dragon Queller The Saga of the Dragon Queller ( Sal Hotun Wyrmrever in its original language ) was an ancient giant ballad about the hero Hjurnur Wyrmrever . Description . This epic poem was composed by Hrotun , the first skald , and told the tale of his nephew , the hero Hjurnur , during the great war between the giants and the dragon s .
description_long: Saga of the Dragon Queller The Saga of the Dragon Queller ( Sal Hotun Wyrmrever in its original language ) was an ancient giant ballad about the hero Hjurnur Wyrmrever . Description . This epic poem was composed by Hrotun , the first skald , and told the tale of his nephew , the hero Hjurnur , during the great war between the giants and the dragon s . Like all classically written giant sagas , the poem ' s first stanza introduces the main character , provides a genealogy , and summarizes the entire tale to follow . Amongst other feats , the story tells how Hjurnur snapped a dragon ' s backbone over his knee , ended up allowing the Queen of Dragons to eat his child after losing a riddle contest , and killed a dragon king . At the end of the tale , Hjurnur ends up drowning in the dragon king ' s blood . Excerpt . The following is a translation by Rundigast of Waterdeep of the first stanza of the poem : Reputation . This saga was sung in mead halls within giant steadings all over Faerûn .

title: Saganite
description: Saganite Saganite , also known as " needle stone " , " love stone " , or " hairstone " , was a variety of chalcedony that encased many needlelike inclusions . Description . Saganite was usually a bone white to yellow stone with contrasting brown or greenish - black needles .
description_long: Saganite Saganite , also known as " needle stone " , " love stone " , or " hairstone " , was a variety of chalcedony that encased many needlelike inclusions . Description . Saganite was usually a bone white to yellow stone with contrasting brown or greenish - black needles . The needles most often radiated from a central point like a star . Large samples were common and it was often traded as " a fist of saganite " in the marketplaces of Amn . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . This stone , when added to the material component of any spell that produced explosions or bursts of fire , increased the power of the detonation or flame by a small amount .

description_long: Saghirah Saghirah was a vizier ' s turban living in Simbaya in north Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . When not in the form of a turban , Saghirah appeared to be a snake - like creature . Relationships . Saghirah formed a symbiotic relationship with the ruler of Simbaya , Hayfa al - Simbaya . Activities . She spent most of her time in utter boredom since Hayfa rarely wore her . Saghirah ultimately decided to leave Hayfa and seek a new host .

title: Sagrast Dracohorn
description: Sagrast Dracohorn Sagrast Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr , and steward of the Royal House of Obarskyr . Background . In 245 DR , Sagrast arranged to meet the High Wizard Baerauble Etharr in private at The Ram and Duck to discuss his plans for removing Iltharl Obarskyr from the throne .
description_long: Sagrast Dracohorn Sagrast Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr , and steward of the Royal House of Obarskyr . Background . In 245 DR , Sagrast arranged to meet the High Wizard Baerauble Etharr in private at The Ram and Duck to discuss his plans for removing Iltharl Obarskyr from the throne . Sagrast ' s view was a view generally accepted at the time , that the king was not capable of making decisions and did not make a good ruler . He proposed arranging the marriage of Gantharla Obarskyr , Iltharl ' s sister , to Kallimar Bleth , and waiting for them to produce a male heir so that the king would be pressured into stepping down . This proved to be unnecessary when Iltharl discovered the plot and chose to abdicate the throne to Gantharla , making her the first queen of Cormyr .

title: Saharel
description: Saharel Lady Saharel was formerly an archmage of ancient Netheril and later ruler of Saharelgard , better known as Spellgard , a ruined castle complex on the eastern edges of the former Anauroch desert . History . At some point , presumably after the fall of Netheril ( - 339 DR ) , Lady Saharel became an archlich .
description_long: Saharel Lady Saharel was formerly an archmage of ancient Netheril and later ruler of Saharelgard , better known as Spellgard , a ruined castle complex on the eastern edges of the former Anauroch desert . History . At some point , presumably after the fall of Netheril ( - 339 DR ) , Lady Saharel became an archlich . Lady Saharel continued to watch over Spellgard as an archlich until 1358 DR , when she sacrificed herself in order to destroy the wizard Manshoon and defend Elminster of Shadowdale . As of 1479 DR , Lady Saharel continued to exist beyond death as a kind of prophetic spirit . On rare occasions when she appeared within the ruins of Spellgard , she answered questions posed by any nearby mortals . It was said that no query was off limits . Relationships . Lady Saharel , once a companion and lover of Elminster of Shadowdale , was known to view the Harpers with favor and the Zhentarim with hostility .

title: Sahbuti Shanardanda
description: Sahbuti Shanardanda Sahbuti Shanardanda is a member of the Dark Moon , a Shar ran order of monk s who are the elite of Shar ' s followers . He was born and raised in Amn and taught of the worship of Shar while still very young . Sahbuti now travels the Sword Coast from Waterdeep to Calimshan , doing the work of his goddess which usually involves escorting Dark Moon officials , guarding valuable shipments for the church and occasionally assassinating Shar ' s enemies .
description_long: Sahbuti Shanardanda Sahbuti Shanardanda is a member of the Dark Moon , a Shar ran order of monk s who are the elite of Shar ' s followers . He was born and raised in Amn and taught of the worship of Shar while still very young . Sahbuti now travels the Sword Coast from Waterdeep to Calimshan , doing the work of his goddess which usually involves escorting Dark Moon officials , guarding valuable shipments for the church and occasionally assassinating Shar ' s enemies . He is adept at arriving at exactly the place where he is needed most . Personality . Sahbuti loves nothing and no one , his only companion is a Shadow named Shemnaer who he knows is loyal , but doesn ' t treat with any kind of familiarity . Sahbuti believes that the loneliness and bitterness he constantly feels will be relieved once he is dead . He brooks no criticism of his abilities and quickly accepts duels . He is terse , to - the - point and very confident and like all of his brethren , a staunch opponent of Selûne .

title: Sahlah

title: Sahnd Krulek
description: Sahnd Krulek Sahnd Krulek was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Sahnd was a Knight of the Black Fist in Phlan .
description_long: Sahnd Krulek Sahnd Krulek was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Sahnd was a Knight of the Black Fist in Phlan . However , a day after arresting a powerful noble , he was framed and later sentenced to death , having been falsely accused of plotting to assassinate Lord Regent Ector Brahms . A group of fellow Black Fists , knowing Krulek ' s innocence , secretly freed him and spirited him away from the city . In order to get vengeance against the noble , Sahnd founded the Gray Patriots bandit group . Initially , they tried to act honorably and not harm innocent people , but they occasionally descended into barbarity . In 1489 DR , another bandit group arrived in the area , the Claws of Tiamat led by the sorcerer Jeralla . Sahnd offered to meet with her in order to negotiate an alliance . However , the meeting was attacked by both a warband of the Cult of the Dragon , which wanted to kill the heretical Jeralla , and by an adventuring party hired to clear the Iron Route of outlaws . In the fighting , Sahnd was defeated . Around 1492 DR he was in jail on Phlan when the reclamation army led by Jhessail Greycastle attacked the city .

title: Sahu
description: Sahu Sahu was a large island in the Crowded Sea to the southwest of Afyal . Geography . Like in other places in the Ruined Kingdoms area of Zakhara , ancient ruins dotted the jungles and mountains , which were left here by two fallen empires : the worshipers of Thasmudyan of old and , following it , the New Dynasty of the Necromancer Kings .
description_long: Sahu Sahu was a large island in the Crowded Sea to the southwest of Afyal . Geography . Like in other places in the Ruined Kingdoms area of Zakhara , ancient ruins dotted the jungles and mountains , which were left here by two fallen empires : the worshipers of Thasmudyan of old and , following it , the New Dynasty of the Necromancer Kings . Many dark secrets and dangers to would - be adventurers hid in land and buildings . History . Sahu was also called the " Isle of Serenity " . " Sahu " itself was a word in the dead language of Kadari and can be loosely translated as " Serene Eternity " , meaning nothing else but " death " . Notable locations . Two places of modern habitation , the villages of Misbahd and Jinutt , were located on the island ' s northern shore . The inner part of the island consisted of a wooded plateau with a mountain range called the Vishap ' s Spine along the center .

title: Sahuagin
description: Sahuagin Sahuagin ( pronounced sah - HWAH - gin ) were a fish - like monstrous humanoid species that lived in oceans , seas , underground lakes , and underwater caves . Sahuagin spoke the Sahuagin language , though some were known to also speak Common and Aquan . Physical description .
description_long: Sahuagin Sahuagin ( pronounced sah - HWAH - gin ) were a fish - like monstrous humanoid species that lived in oceans , seas , underground lakes , and underwater caves . Sahuagin spoke the Sahuagin language , though some were known to also speak Common and Aquan . Physical description . Sahuagin were usually green skinned ; darker on the back and lighter on the belly . Many had dark stripes , bands , or spots , but these tended to fade with age . An adult male sahuagin stood roughly 6 feet ( 1 . 83 meters ) tall and weighed about 200 pounds ( 91 kilograms ) . Sahuagin were highly fish - like , with webbed feet and hands , gills , and a finned tail . There was additional webbing down the back , at the elbows and , notably , also where human ears would be . About one in every 216 hatchlings possessed four functional arms . These four - armed mutations were usually black , fading to gray in color . While sahuagin usually killed off defective hatchlings , they allow these to live . Combat . Savage fighters , sahuagin asked for and gave no quarter . When swimming , a sahuagin teared with its feet , striking with its talons or a weapon .

title: Sahvin Sel ' rue
description: Sahvin Sel ' rue Sahvin Sel ' rue was a drow scout of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Sahvin was one of the top scouts of her city .
description_long: Sahvin Sel ' rue Sahvin Sel ' rue was a drow scout of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Sahvin was one of the top scouts of her city . During the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , she was part of a contingent directed by Shontiq A ' Lavallier that spied on Silverymoon , until the Knights in Silver attacked , killing most of the drow . Sahvin tried to escape to the camp of a nearby orc army but the Luruar army commanded by Regis , Wulfgar , and Aleina Brightlance defeated them also .

title: Sai
description: Sai A sai is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The sai is a dagger - shaped metal baton or wand with two side prongs curving up and out from the place where the grip meets the base of the baton .
description_long: Sai A sai is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The sai is a dagger - shaped metal baton or wand with two side prongs curving up and out from the place where the grip meets the base of the baton . All three tips of this weapon are blunt . The side prongs may vary in style for different blocking and trapping moves . An average sai costs 1gp and weighs 1lb ( 0 . 45kg ) . Use . Normally these weapons are used in pairs but can also be used singly with another weapon . Made light for quick movement , many blocking and trapping techniques are possible , but on offense the sai can jab and strike like a dagger , delivering a concentrated blow to sensitive or vulnerable areas .

title: Saibhon el Bhiras
description: Saibhon el Bhiras Saibhon el Bhiras was the Grand Yrshelem of Slaves of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Saibhon was born the son of the leader of the Ice Chain slaver company in Calimshan , and his father taught the young Saibhon about the family business .
description_long: Saibhon el Bhiras Saibhon el Bhiras was the Grand Yrshelem of Slaves of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Saibhon was born the son of the leader of the Ice Chain slaver company in Calimshan , and his father taught the young Saibhon about the family business . When Shadi ' ar nomads killed his father , Saibhon fought the senior slavers for control of the company and managed to keep them at bay until he gained the support of the younger slavers , which assured him the command chain . Saibhon was very competent as a slaver , always judging correctly about how slaves would survive until they arrived at the market . In time , many senior slavers decided to quit the business , and he bought for each of them a festhall in exchange for their quote of the company . His talent was recognized by the Rundeen in 1363 DR when the First Yrshelem of Slaving decided to appoint Saibhon as his heir and retired . Saihon accepted and gave the control of the Ice Chain to his best friend , although he retained thirty percent of the quote . In 1369 DR , Saibhon was promoted to Grand Yrshelem of Slaves , and he sought from then on to increase the Rundeen ' s participation in this business .

title: Saikhoi
description: Saikhoi Saikhoi was the capital city of Ra - Khati . Geography . Nestled deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Saikhoi sat between the two sacred lakes of Norasil and Manasowar .
description_long: Saikhoi Saikhoi was the capital city of Ra - Khati . Geography . Nestled deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Saikhoi sat between the two sacred lakes of Norasil and Manasowar . Inhabitants . Saikhoi was the home of the ruler of Ra - Khati — the Dalai Lama . Rumors and Legends . Any outsider who saw the sacred city of Saikhoi was never permitted to leave .

title: Sailors of the Crimson Sea
description: Sailors of the Crimson Sea The Sailors of the Crimson Sea were a mercenary company based in Chessenta and active in Chondath around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into infantry , cavalry , and archers .
description_long: Sailors of the Crimson Sea The Sailors of the Crimson Sea were a mercenary company based in Chessenta and active in Chondath around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into infantry , cavalry , and archers . Contracts . They tried to work for good employers but never worked for free . They charged 250 gold piece s per week for their services . History . The Sailors were founded in the mid - 1300s DR by Bendix but had many misfortunes . They suffered many casualties during the Battle of Thurgabanteth in Chondath , including Bendix . A new leader emerged after a brief power struggle , but faced the challenges of leading a group suffering from low morale .

title: Saint Dionysus
description: Saint Dionysus St . Dionysus , or St . Dionysius , was a saint of the god Ilmater and patron saint of wine and other alcohol ic spirits .
description_long: Saint Dionysus St . Dionysus , or St . Dionysius , was a saint of the god Ilmater and patron saint of wine and other alcohol ic spirits . The Order of St . Dionysus was based around St . Dionysus . The Church of Dionysus , a center of the Order and devoted to the saint , began construction in the city of Goliad in Damara in the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR . As a result , St . Dionysus was honored in Damara .

title: Saint Fanal
description: Saint Fanal Saint Fanal was a priest and saint of Ilmater and the founder of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains . Personality .
description_long: Saint Fanal Saint Fanal was a priest and saint of Ilmater and the founder of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains . Personality . St . Fanal , although a priest of Ilmater dedicated to alleviating suffering , believed that knowledge of the past would limit suffering in the present , and that educating oppressed peoples would expand their opportunities and capabilities . Thus he devoted himself to learning , preserving , and teaching history . History . St . Fanal founded the monastery that bore his name late in the first century before Dalereckoning .

title: Saint Sollars
description: Saint Sollars Saint Sollars , called the Twice Martyred , was a saint of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . He was the patron saint of Bloodstone Pass . Worshipers .
description_long: Saint Sollars Saint Sollars , called the Twice Martyred , was a saint of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . He was the patron saint of Bloodstone Pass . Worshipers . Within the church of Ilmater , St . Sollars was venerated by the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred and at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains and the Abbey of St . Sollars located in Bloodstone Village in Damara . He was viewed as a patriarch of the faith . It was the only faith to have a saint known as " the Twice - Martyred " and many Ilmatari hoped to follow his path . The people of Damara particularly venerated Ilmater and St . Sollars . Many Damarans , even those who followed other gods , felt a special closeness to St . Sollars , knowing the virtues of endurance in the face of hardship . The yellow rose of St . Sollars was a common sight in the realm . Symbol . His symbol was a yellow rose , which was adopted by the Monks of the Yellow Rose , and a lone , five - pointed star . The Abbey of St . Sollars employed both symbols , where literature related to the saint displayed the lone star . Works . The " Book of St .

title: Sairché
description: Sairché Sairché was a female cambion and the heiress of the succubus Invadiah . Relationships . Sairché was the sister of Lorcan and the only cambion daughter of Invadiah .
description_long: Sairché Sairché was a female cambion and the heiress of the succubus Invadiah . Relationships . Sairché was the sister of Lorcan and the only cambion daughter of Invadiah . Activities . In 1478 DR Invadiah was demoted to succubi in part due to the machinations of Lorcan and his protege Farideh . In 1479 DR , she was summoned by Farideh in search of more protection and they made a deal that Farideh had to perform some missions for Sairché in exchange . Sairché put Farideh and her friends into a deep sleep until 1486 DR when she needed their work . She instructed Farideh to secretely penetrate a Netheril camp on the Lost Peaks . With her new powers she individuated the Chosen prisoners . Sairché wanted to offer the divine sparks of the Chosen to Glasya or Asmodeus , hoping to increase her position . However , many factions , some of them fiendish , sabotaged each other and ultimately the victors were the Harpers when they freed all the Chosen . This angered the internal patrons of Sairché in the Nine Hells . .

title: Saisho
description: Saisho Saisho was a wu jen / ninja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Saisho was born in Miyama and as a child met and befriend Etsu - no - kami Makoto .
description_long: Saisho Saisho was a wu jen / ninja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Saisho was born in Miyama and as a child met and befriend Etsu - no - kami Makoto . Saisho ' s family died when he was very young and he was taken in by his uncle , a talented wu jen living in a ninja village . Saisho was taught magical skills by his uncle and ninja skills by the myusho . When a message arrived of the banishment of the Etsu family , Saisho escaped from the village to find his friend . In 1357 DR , Saisho had just met Makoto when they decided to return to Miyama . Meanwhile , Saisho ' s uncle sent letters saying he had forgiven him for his escape . Behind the scenes . Saisho was one of the pre - created PCs for use in adventures in Miyama .

title: Saishu
description: Saishu Saishu was an island off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula and part of the land of Koryo ( formerly Choson ) in northeast Kara - Tur . Geography . Saishu lay in the Yellow Sea and was separated from the mainland by the Straits of Koryo , which were famed for their huge tidal range and speed .
description_long: Saishu Saishu was an island off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula and part of the land of Koryo ( formerly Choson ) in northeast Kara - Tur . Geography . Saishu lay in the Yellow Sea and was separated from the mainland by the Straits of Koryo , which were famed for their huge tidal range and speed . It was surrounded by numerous smaller islands , including Su ' un , a desert rock raised from the sea . The island itself was covered in forest . A region of the island was South Saishu . History . Queen Ki Hiar of Saishu was once affected by a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest and fell in love with a pirate from Wa . In the early 14th century , the kingdom of Silla was at war with Saishu . At the time , it was led by Dan Zor , the hereditary leader . Finally , in the 1330s DR , the king of Silla conquered Saishu , as well as the kingdom of Koguryo , unifying the whole land of Choson into the Sillan Empire . However , the Sillan king was a tyrant , inflicting crippling taxes and martial law on Saishu , occupying it with Sillan troops . However , General Wanang Sun protected Dan Zor , even arranging a marriage between their families .

title: Saj Amog
description: Saj Amog Saj Amog was a lich and the Zulkir of Conjuration in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . As a zulkir , Amog was a member of the ruling council of Thay .
description_long: Saj Amog Saj Amog was a lich and the Zulkir of Conjuration in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . As a zulkir , Amog was a member of the ruling council of Thay . He was also an ally of Valindra Shadowmantle . History . After many defeats in Neverwinter and busy with crushing the rebels of the Thayan Resurrection , Zulkir Saj Amog was sent from Thay to help Valindra Shadowmantle in her schemes . Amog led a Thayan army to recapture the " Dread Ring " but was defeated by an adventurer .

title: Sajat
description: Sajat Sajats ( sah - JAHT ) were tiny tambourines used by dancers in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . A " sajat " was small enough to be held by the fingers .
description_long: Sajat Sajats ( sah - JAHT ) were tiny tambourines used by dancers in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . A " sajat " was small enough to be held by the fingers . History . Dancers and other performers used " sajats " to accentuate their body movement . The " sajat " could also be used to set the tempo for a performance .

title: Sakai Kazuhiko
description: Sakai Kazuhiko Sakai Kazuhiko was a samurai proprietor of a shoen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Sakai owned a shoen near the village of Itsuki .
description_long: Sakai Kazuhiko Sakai Kazuhiko was a samurai proprietor of a shoen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Sakai owned a shoen near the village of Itsuki . He led thirteen samurai and fifty bushi and was at the time in a dispute over ownership of the village with the sohei Tu - shun . Sakai had captured the western end of Itsuki .

title: Sakigahara
description: Sakigahara Sakigahara was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . Sakigahara was a lieutenant of Ogaki , the second - in - command of Lord Korimori . History .
description_long: Sakigahara Sakigahara was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . Sakigahara was a lieutenant of Ogaki , the second - in - command of Lord Korimori . History . In 1360 DR , Ogaki , Sakigahara , and fellow lieutenant Himeji led a bushi army to a village formally of the Michimori clan . There however an adventuring party , hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords , fought and defeated him and his troops . Relationships . Sakigahara and Himeji disliked each other and both wanted Ogaki ' s position if he was promoted after their lord ' s victory .

title: Sakina
description: Sakina Sakina were air sprites from Zakhara . Friendly by nature , these creatures roamed the sky in search of unique scents and adventure . Description .
description_long: Sakina Sakina were air sprites from Zakhara . Friendly by nature , these creatures roamed the sky in search of unique scents and adventure . Description . Sakina were wind creatures but had no tie to the Elemental Plane of Air . They were usually invisible but could draw water vapor into their bodies to appear as partially visible humanoid creatures . Combat . Sakina were dangerous opponents . They could blast their opponents with compressed air that caused damage and set most opponents off - balance . A sakina ' s favorite attack was their ability to make up to seven creatures , weighing less than 700 lbs ( 317 . 5 kg ) each , as light as air . Affected creatures were blown away on the wind currents unless they were able to grab hold of something . The sakina could control how high the creatures floated and then drop them to the ground to devastating effect . This power could also be used to aid friendly creatures that were in danger . Sakina were able to carry a single human - sized passenger up to 300 miles ( 483 km ) in a single day . Habitat / Society . Sakina were solitary creatures that roamed the skies and kept no treasure .

title: Sakkors
description: Sakkors Sakkors was an ancient Netherese city built on an inverted mountain top . Because of Karsus ' s Folly , it plunged into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Before the fall of Netheril , one of the High Arcanists , Xolund " the Maker " , infused the mythallar of his own city with a rudimentary sentience , which called itself the Source .
description_long: Sakkors Sakkors was an ancient Netherese city built on an inverted mountain top . Because of Karsus ' s Folly , it plunged into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Before the fall of Netheril , one of the High Arcanists , Xolund " the Maker " , infused the mythallar of his own city with a rudimentary sentience , which called itself the Source . Unlike other mythallar s , it could direct or withhold its magical power as instructed . Instead of powering all items in its proximity , it could focus all its power on a single item , on none , or on many . The development of a sentient mythallar had caused a stir among the arcanists of the empire , but the Fall had ended any attempts to duplicate Xolund ' s feat . Erevis Cale first discovered the ruined city and its protector , the kraken Ssessimyth . The mythallar had melded to the head of the kraken , and in the battle that ensued between Erevis and the kraken , the mythallar called out for help in Loross . The Shadovar repaired the mythallar , the power source keeping the city aloft . As of 1479 DR , Sakkors had a population of 15 , 000 and was commonly sighted over Sembia .

title: Sakkratar ' s triple strike
description: Sakkratar ' s triple strike Sakkratar ' s triple strike was a transmutation spell that gave the target increased speed in combat allowing extra attacks . The spell also gave the target ' s weapon a special property Keen and caused it to be covered in pure white flame . History .
description_long: Sakkratar ' s triple strike Sakkratar ' s triple strike was a transmutation spell that gave the target increased speed in combat allowing extra attacks . The spell also gave the target ' s weapon a special property Keen and caused it to be covered in pure white flame . History . This spell was created by a Coronal of Cormanthyr , presumably Sakkratar .

title: Sakrattars Irithyl
description: Sakrattars Irithyl Sakrattars Irithyl was second Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 2900 DR to - 1950 DR , the youngest great - grandson of Kahvoerm Irithyl , first Coronal . He became the ruler of the empire after his father ' s death and the unsuccessful blade draw of Divisav Irithyl , Kahvoerm ' s first son . His reign ended with his death as he sacrificed himself to create a blood dragon that slew a horde of drow that had occupied the former realm of Uvaeren and the Twisted Tower .
description_long: Sakrattars Irithyl Sakrattars Irithyl was second Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 2900 DR to - 1950 DR , the youngest great - grandson of Kahvoerm Irithyl , first Coronal . He became the ruler of the empire after his father ' s death and the unsuccessful blade draw of Divisav Irithyl , Kahvoerm ' s first son . His reign ended with his death as he sacrificed himself to create a blood dragon that slew a horde of drow that had occupied the former realm of Uvaeren and the Twisted Tower . Sakrattars ' rysar was plagued with the rising of the Twisted Tower in - 2549 DR despite repeated attacks on it by the Coronal ' s forces . He also lived to see the infamous Spiderfires , which burned acres and acres of woods and separated Rystall Wood from the main body of Cormanthor .

title: Sala Nidris
description: Sala Nidris Sala Nidris was a Calishite merchant in Neverwinter . History . Sala migrated from Calimshan to live in Neverwinter with her son Zan Nidris .
description_long: Sala Nidris Sala Nidris was a Calishite merchant in Neverwinter . History . Sala migrated from Calimshan to live in Neverwinter with her son Zan Nidris . In 1479 DR , she became one of the targets of the kidnappers that plagued the city , but she was saved by an adventuring party . However , soon after , she discovered that the kidnappers had captured her son Zan and hired the adventurers to find him After defeating an Ashmadai cell , the adventurers freed Zan and returned him to his mother

title: Salabak
description: Salabak Salabak was a human gladiator of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka of the mid – 14th century DR . History . Salabak hailed from a certain tribe in the Great Gray Land of Thar .
description_long: Salabak Salabak was a human gladiator of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka of the mid – 14th century DR . History . Salabak hailed from a certain tribe in the Great Gray Land of Thar . Following the custom of all young males in his tribe , he ' d embarked on a rite of passage . Unfortunately , he was kidnapped by slavers , who led him away to the sea and thence to Calimshan and Manshaka . There , he was owned by Pasha Abon Duum and made to fight as a gladiator in the Arena of Blood , where he was billed as the " Savage of Thar " . Among Duum ' s stable of gladiators , he became a steadfast friend to fellow gladiator Vajra Valmeyjar , the popular champion , and he told her his story . In the mid - 1350s DR , however , Vajra escaped the Arena , seriously wounding several of Duum ' s best fighters in the effort . She left behind Salabak and her other fellow gladiators , and would for a long time fear they remained captives or had inevitably been killed . Afterward , Salabak completed his rite of passage himself — cutting his own throat and destroying his ability to speak , gaining the power of thought speech and illusion in return .

title: Salamander
description: Salamander Salamanders were large elemental , reptilian humanoid s . Personality . Salamanders tended to be greedy and cruel .
description_long: Salamander Salamanders were large elemental , reptilian humanoid s . Personality . Salamanders tended to be greedy and cruel . Combat . Salamanders often wielded spear s . They used their tails to constrict their enemies . Their skin was so hot that even the merest touch caused burns . Society . Salamanders had an excellent culture of metalsmithing and creating weapons that utilized the power of flame . Salamanders formed feudal societies led by kings / queens and dukes / duchesses . Slaves and lesser elemental creatures made up the peasant class . Range . Salamanders originated on the Elemental Plane of Fire . A significant population of them migrated from the Plane of Fire via " portal s " to the Firelands and the Peaks of Flame in Chult . These salamanders posed a threat to the Mines of Segol and the Hazur Mountains . In the same manner salamanders also settled the sun of Realmspace .

title: Salbread
description: Salbread Salbread was a popular type of bread baked by the creative halfling s of Luiren . Description . Because it lasted for weeks before spoiling , and contained much more flavor than standard breads , salbread was made for sailors and other travelers .
description_long: Salbread Salbread was a popular type of bread baked by the creative halfling s of Luiren . Description . Because it lasted for weeks before spoiling , and contained much more flavor than standard breads , salbread was made for sailors and other travelers . Salbread was baked in square pans , allowing for easy storage when travelling . Lemon or orange peels were one of the main ingredients , making it very popular with sailors not only because of the added flavor , but because the orange and lemon peels helped prevent scurvy .

title: Saldashune ' s Mirror
description: Saldashune ' s Mirror Saldashune ' s Mirror was a divination ritual created by Saldashune . It was created to help remember specific details of memories , regardless of whether the person was able to fully recall them or not . Procedure .
description_long: Saldashune ' s Mirror Saldashune ' s Mirror was a divination ritual created by Saldashune . It was created to help remember specific details of memories , regardless of whether the person was able to fully recall them or not . Procedure . A group of wizard s and a specially prepared room were necessary to condict this ritual , as well as the person who needed to remember . This person did not participate in the ritual but stood in the center of the room , trying to recall the information needed . Once started , the ritual could not be stopped until the specific memory was recalled , as the wizards entered into a trance state . The memory was showed in a magic circle that appeared floating in mid - air , so a volunteer would be able to record what was showed . Although the ritual was able to retrieve whatever memory was needed , if the memory contained something or someone warded or of supernatural origin , the countermagic effect could damage the person remembering . It could even killing him or her if the ritual wasn ' t stopped by the people watching the magic circle or the person wasn ' t dragged away from the center of the room . History .

title: Saleem
description: Saleem Saleem was an eccentric human architect who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Though an accomplished builder in his own right , Saleem was both modest and calm when he went about his work .
description_long: Saleem Saleem was an eccentric human architect who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Though an accomplished builder in his own right , Saleem was both modest and calm when he went about his work . Those who knew him said he had a great sense of humor . Relationships . Saleem was always accompanied by Lab , a she - mule companion with whom he carried - on deep one - way conversations . Many who witnessed these interactions believed Saleem to be mad , but others believed that Lab was a " polymorphed " lover or even a genie companion who inspired Saleem ' s architectural designs .

title: Saleem ibn Ahogar
description: Saleem ibn Ahogar Saleem ibn Ahogar was an inhabitant within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Saleem was a representative of the jann of the High Desert and the leader of the jann in Huzuz . Personality .
description_long: Saleem ibn Ahogar Saleem ibn Ahogar was an inhabitant within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Saleem was a representative of the jann of the High Desert and the leader of the jann in Huzuz . Personality . A charmer to the core , Saleem was even able to coax smiles out of the ironclad Alyana al - Azzazi and Rahmah al - Zahir . He ensured they always had a pair of janni bodyguards . Activities . Saleem was the personal bodyguard of the Grand Caliph , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir . Saleem also guarded the Grand Caliph whenever he attended the Royal Harim . Relationships . Though he was technically a subordinate of Jiraad , the noble marid treated Saleem as an equal , gaining his loyalty and respect . Possessions . Saleem wielded a powerful magical great scimitar with " defender " properties .

title: Salember Obarskyr
description: Salember Obarskyr Salember Obarskyr was the regent of Cormyr . Relatives . Salember had a single brother , Azoun III .
description_long: Salember Obarskyr Salember Obarskyr was the regent of Cormyr . Relatives . Salember had a single brother , Azoun III . Background . When Azoun III died , prince Rhigaerd was only six years old , so Salember took the throne of Cormyr as regent . Salember plotted to kill Rhigaerd and take the throne , leading Cormyr into civil war . Death . When he refused to relinquish the throne he was killed by the royal wizard Jorunhast .

title: Salen
description: Salen Salen was the leader of a group of mercenaries who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Salen was a very beautiful salt - and - pepper - haired woman who was an experienced dagger thrower .
description_long: Salen Salen was the leader of a group of mercenaries who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Salen was a very beautiful salt - and - pepper - haired woman who was an experienced dagger thrower . Personality . Being the leader of her company , Salen was smart and sly . In her dagger - throwing contest versus Ren , Salen tried to trick the big man with weighted blades . Possessions . Like many soldiers , Salen dressed in chain mail and fought with a sword , a few daggers , and a throwing axe . History . On the 19th of Flamerule , 1340 DR , Salen and her allies , Jensena and Gwen , challenged Ren o ' the Blade to a couple of contests , which Ren won due to his cunning . On the night of the 28th of Flamerule , Salen and her companions were attacked by a troll outside the Phlan city walls . During the battle , Ren joined the fray , but not before Salen and Gwen were killed by the monster .

title: Saleska Mintharl
description: Saleska Mintharl Saleska Mintharl was a human woman and a priestess of Tempus . She held the title " Shield of Tempus " and was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .
description_long: Saleska Mintharl Saleska Mintharl was a human woman and a priestess of Tempus . She held the title " Shield of Tempus " and was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Saleska was formerly an adventuress in Bellas ' s Band , under Bellas Thanatar . Each member of the band grew wealthy by following Bellas ' s orders . Around the 1330s DR , Bellas ' s Band took power in the city of Calaunt . Bellas named himself Supreme Scepter , while Saleska took the title of Merchant Duke . They now grew wealthier and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . Activities . Saleska and the dukes grew increasingly wealthy and powerful by following Bellas and supporting his rule . In all decisions on major policies , Saleska had one vote while Bellas had two . Saleska and the Dukes often confiscated property and magic from visitors , allegedly " for the benefit of the city " , but mostly used it only for personal gain and use , to increase their power . They acquired a large collection of magical item s this way , and still sought more . Saleska lived in a palatial house close to the Fortress of the Five Vultures .

title: Salid Dhuzma
description: Salid Dhuzma Salid Dhuzma , or the Grand Verser of the South , was a famous bard who lived in Khalab during the mid 14h century DR . Activities . Students from all over East Faerûn and the Hordelands would travel to the small fishing village of Khalab with the hopes of becoming Salid ' s next pupil .
description_long: Salid Dhuzma Salid Dhuzma , or the Grand Verser of the South , was a famous bard who lived in Khalab during the mid 14h century DR . Activities . Students from all over East Faerûn and the Hordelands would travel to the small fishing village of Khalab with the hopes of becoming Salid ' s next pupil . Sadly for these prospective students , Salid would only take one pupil each year . Salid lived within Baelzur ' s Tower . He preferred the comfort of living in a small village to the riches he could have had while living in one of the larger cities located on Gbor Nor . Relationships . Salim was once the apprentice of Tilmar Wanderfoot .

title: Sallissi
description: Sallissi Sallissi was a morkoth living in an underground cavern near Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Sallissi lived as a hermit in an underground lake near Dragonspear Castle .
description_long: Sallissi Sallissi was a morkoth living in an underground cavern near Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Sallissi lived as a hermit in an underground lake near Dragonspear Castle . He was possibly disturbed during the Second Dragonspear War when some adventurer members of the allied army crossed his territory .

title: Salman bin Salman
description: Salman bin Salman Salman bin Salman was a cleric of Hajama living in the small town of Ganam in 1367 DR . Activities . Salman served as head priest for the entire village .
description_long: Salman bin Salman Salman bin Salman was a cleric of Hajama living in the small town of Ganam in 1367 DR . Activities . Salman served as head priest for the entire village . He was also a source of protection for Ganam against the pranks of a deceiver genie named Ibrihim . Possessions . Salman always carried a phylactery that was capable of warding off evil genie s .

title: Salt Jungle
description: Salt Jungle The Salt Jungle was a sprawling woodland region found in East Zakhara . Geography . The Salt Jungle was roughly nestled between Al - Iltifat river to the west and Al - Zilla River to the east , with some overlap on either side .
description_long: Salt Jungle The Salt Jungle was a sprawling woodland region found in East Zakhara . Geography . The Salt Jungle was roughly nestled between Al - Iltifat river to the west and Al - Zilla River to the east , with some overlap on either side . The jungle abutted the coast of both the Foreigners ' Sea and a small portion of the Crowded Sea . The jungle was protected from the harsh climate of the Haunted Lands by an unnamed mountain range that was split by Al - Iltifat . Description . The Salt Jungle was fairly large , covering several hundred miles in every direction .

title: Salt bond
description: Salt bond A salt bond was a formal sign of hospitality offered by a host to a guest and was prevalent in Zakhara n culture . As the name suggested , salt bonds became a formal bond when the guest consumed salt from the host ' s table . Salt bonds typically lasted for three days , during which the host assumed full responsibility for the guest ' s welfare .
description_long: Salt bond A salt bond was a formal sign of hospitality offered by a host to a guest and was prevalent in Zakhara n culture . As the name suggested , salt bonds became a formal bond when the guest consumed salt from the host ' s table . Salt bonds typically lasted for three days , during which the host assumed full responsibility for the guest ' s welfare . Guests under protection from a salt bond also agreed that no harm should befall the host as well , either by themselves or any member of their family . In fact , many Zakharans honored salt bonds long after the three day period ended , extending courtesies when the two parties met elsewhere in the future .

title: Saluqi
description: Saluqi Saluqi greyhounds were unique canines found within the Haunted Lands where the jann used them for hunting , particularly the jann of Amir Heidar Qan . Description . Saluqi had black hides that covered their sleek bodies .
description_long: Saluqi Saluqi greyhounds were unique canines found within the Haunted Lands where the jann used them for hunting , particularly the jann of Amir Heidar Qan . Description . Saluqi had black hides that covered their sleek bodies . Grey marks could be found on their fur . Their heads were long and thin , making them more streamlined when sprinting . Combat . Saluqi preferred to hunt and fight in packs during the night where they could use their infravision and quick attack speed to their advantage . They attacked as one , swarming prey when they were able . Habitat / Society . Skilled huntsmen usually carefully bred and cared for a saluqi from birth . They could be trained to respond to a decent range of calls . Because of their dark coats , saluqi did not perform well if they spent too much time under the fierce rays of the sun . During the day they were kept in shaded areas until they were needed . Ecology . Whether they were capturing small game , or flushing larger animals out into the open , saluqi excelled at hunting . Because there were so few of them found in the Haunted Lands , the impact the saluqi had on local ecosystems was minimal .

title: Saluuknir
description: Saluuknir Saluuknir was an old male blue dragon imprisoned in the " Urn of the Blue Vishap " . History . Originally at home in the Raurin Desert , Saluuknir was bound to the magical " Urn " when its former inmate , the evil marid Merifa of the Pearl Lagoons , tricked the dragon into exchanging places .
description_long: Saluuknir Saluuknir was an old male blue dragon imprisoned in the " Urn of the Blue Vishap " . History . Originally at home in the Raurin Desert , Saluuknir was bound to the magical " Urn " when its former inmate , the evil marid Merifa of the Pearl Lagoons , tricked the dragon into exchanging places . Centuries later , the magic prison was brought back to its original home , the continent of Zakhara , by a corsair . Rumor had it that in 1367 DR it was in the possession of the master of Assassin Mountain . Personality and powers . Saluuknir was forced by the " Urn " to perform three tasks for its owner , while the item gave the dragon some additional magical powers for this purpose in addition to his considerable natural abilities . His prison also prevented Saluuknir from harming its owner or any being when not working towards the fulfillment of the given tasks . Thus the dragon could vent his anger and discomfort about his imprisonment only through threats and blustering . His highest goals were regaining his freedom and vengeance on Merifa of the Pearl Lagoons .

title: Salvanas
description: Salvanas Salvanas was a male elf who liked to hang out in the Copper Coronet . Personality . Salvanas accosted many women who frequented the tavern with flattery and seduction .
description_long: Salvanas Salvanas was a male elf who liked to hang out in the Copper Coronet . Personality . Salvanas accosted many women who frequented the tavern with flattery and seduction . Appendix . Notes . In the Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn game , the only female non - player character he will not try to flirt with is Imoen . He will flirt with Edwina , but " she " will magic missile him to death . If a female player character responds positively to his seduction attempts , he will run away .

title: Salvar Brix
description: Salvar Brix Salvar Brix was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Salvar was a charismatic individual , and always learned what he needed to motivate others to do his will .
description_long: Salvar Brix Salvar Brix was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Salvar was a charismatic individual , and always learned what he needed to motivate others to do his will . He was warm and gracious to those who could help him and quick to dismiss those who could not . Salvar believed that money could buy anything , including loyalty . His main ambition was to unlock forbidden magic and lore lost to most mortals . He believed that Drayson had found some of that magic History . Salvar was of noble birth and joined the Cloak at an early age . His partner was Drayson Fivestars . In 1491 DR , after a routine visit to a lost tower near the city , Drayson began acting strange and soon after was killed . Salvar decided to investigate the killers of his partner , but was ambushed by some thugs . Luckily an adventuring party saved him and he hired them to investigate for him .

title: Salvarad
description: Salvarad Salvarad was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a member of ruling council and a supposed cleric of Talos . In truth , both Shar and Cyric granted him the spells thanks to a peculiar and unique relationship that Salvarad had with these two deities .
description_long: Salvarad Salvarad was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a member of ruling council and a supposed cleric of Talos . In truth , both Shar and Cyric granted him the spells thanks to a peculiar and unique relationship that Salvarad had with these two deities . He professed reverence for Talos , but didn ' t truly worship him . He usually resided in Saerloon . He was one of the leaders who ordered the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR .

title: Sam Wood
description: Sam Wood Sam E . Wood is a prolific fantasy illustrator whose art fills many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . Education .
description_long: Sam Wood Sam E . Wood is a prolific fantasy illustrator whose art fills many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . Education . Wood was originally from Alaska . He attended . Career . Wood began working for Wizards of the Coast in 1995 and has worked on illustrations for many gaming systems . He has collaborated with Todd Lockwood on multiple projects . He now resides in Seattle , Washington , and is self - employed .

title: Samakay
description: Samakay Samakay the Wry was the king of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Samakay ruled the small kingdom of Golconda .
description_long: Samakay Samakay the Wry was the king of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Samakay ruled the small kingdom of Golconda . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , started a war against Golconda . In 1358 during Samakay ' s war council the spymaster Boubakar reported that one of his men had discovered that the battle plans of Hetep were hid in the small keep of Fort Blood . Convinced by Boubakar ' s argumentations and despite Count Belim ' s objections Samakay hired an adventuring party well - known to him to resolve the matter . Soon after however Samakay died of old age without a heir . Relashionship . Samakay trusted only Lord Daud until the latter ' s death in 1357 DR . Personality . Samakay was a just and kind ruler but knew nothing of military matter .

title: Samarach
description: Samarach Samarach was a country on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The country was virtually unexplored by people from the civilized lands as it was incredibly difficult to get to .
description_long: Samarach Samarach was a country on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The country was virtually unexplored by people from the civilized lands as it was incredibly difficult to get to . It was surrounded by rugged mountains and to the northwest were the jungles of Chult . Reputation . To Faerûn at large , Samarach was a nigh - mythical kingdom of the south . Tashalarans described Samarachians as cowards who at night shut themselves in behind the walls of their cities . They apparently hid the passes through the mountains and the roads to their cities behind illusion s . The country was created by the Nimbral ese , which would certainly explain their propensity for illusions . Relations . Samarach was a traditional foe of Nimbral . Rumors & Legends . As across much of the South , monkey spiders were popular in Samarach as companions , familiars , and pets , which led to grubby illicit auctions of them in back alleys and some marketplaces . For the intelligent apes , these constituted slave auctions , and some escaped their masters .

title: Samardag
description: Samardag Samardag the Hoper was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Samardag , loyal to his moniker , always saw the good side of each situation .
description_long: Samardag Samardag the Hoper was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Samardag , loyal to his moniker , always saw the good side of each situation . For him , the sky was always blue , the weather was always fine , and tomorrow would always be a better day . He could have been rich if not for his soft heart that led him to help anyone with a pitiful story . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 Samardag attached his wagon full of fragile porcelain to a great caravan that , unbeknownst to him , was full of Cult of the Dragon agents transporting treasures for the Hoard of the Dragon Queen .

title: Samark Dhanzscul
description: Samark Dhanzscul Samark Dhanzscul was the sixth Blackstaff . Description . Samark had three parallel scars on his face from his right cheekbone to his jaw .
description_long: Samark Dhanzscul Samark Dhanzscul was the sixth Blackstaff . Description . Samark had three parallel scars on his face from his right cheekbone to his jaw . In 1479 DR , he was described as an old man . He wore no beard . Personality . Samark was kind and respectful towards people regardless of their status . He always used the given names of the people he interacted with , rather than just their surnames . History . Samark was the apprentice and heir of Ashemmon of Rhymanthiin , the fifth Blackstaff . He became Blackstaff in 1464 DR , after the death of Ashemmon . When Vajra Safahr came to Waterdeep to learn magic , she met Samark , and after some time , Samark became her mentor and lover , despite her youth . She became the Blackstaff ' s Heir . Samark was murdered by Centiv Naomal , the son of his rival Khondar Naomal , on 20 Marpenoth , 1479 DR . They murdered him and kidnapped and tortured Vajra as part of their plot to obtain access to Blackstaff Tower and rule the city . Centiv proceeded to impersonate Samark in public for nearly two months , but whenever he was founded out , he used magic to prevent people from revealing the truth .

title: Samarskite
description: Samarskite Samarskite was a semi - precious gem used for mourning jewelry or to adorn black ceremonial dress . Description . Samarskite was a rare - earth mineral , hard and dense , with a velvet - black metallic luster , usually cut .
description_long: Samarskite Samarskite was a semi - precious gem used for mourning jewelry or to adorn black ceremonial dress . Description . Samarskite was a rare - earth mineral , hard and dense , with a velvet - black metallic luster , usually cut . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . One or more samarskite gems , carried or worn on the body , was known to protect against undead by reducing the severity of their attacks by a small amount .

title: Samas Kul
description: Samas Kul Samas Kul was the Zulkir of Transmutation since his predecessor ' s death in 1375 DR within the ranks of the Red wizard s of Thay and ally of Szass Tam . He was also the master of Thay ' s Guild of Foreign Trade . Description .
description_long: Samas Kul Samas Kul was the Zulkir of Transmutation since his predecessor ' s death in 1375 DR within the ranks of the Red wizard s of Thay and ally of Szass Tam . He was also the master of Thay ' s Guild of Foreign Trade . Description . Samas was tall and obese , and wore tentlike begemmed , costly robes . He spoke with a plummy , onctuous voice . Personality . Cultivating an air of being cultured , the ambitious Samas was known for his particularly cutting sarcasm and cynical manner . Possessions . Samas wore a Ring of protection which bestowed upon him a protecitve aura invisible as air but strong as steel . He also had a wand of congealed quicksilver that could change an adversary into something harmless like a snail . History . Twin tiefling warlocks worked covertly for Samas Kul , Master of the Guild of Foreign Trade in Bezantur . The corpulent red wizard used the warlocks known as Tolyst and Finora to spy on and intimidate his trade rivals . Tolyst was easily recognized by his large fangs , wolfish grin , and orange eyes . Finora could be identified by her catlike tail and yellow cat ' s eyes .

title: Samayan
description: Samayan Samayan was a boy Chosen of Chauntea . Activities . Samayan was one of the children in a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen .
description_long: Samayan Samayan was a boy Chosen of Chauntea . Activities . Samayan was one of the children in a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen . He always played with Stedd Whitehorn and Vanri , often trailing flowers . History . In 1486 DR , Samayan met and befriended the disguised Dahl Peredur .

title: Sambar ( priest )
description: Sambar ( priest ) Father Sambar was a priest of Shar posing a priest of Mystra at the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Father Sambar was the first to pass through the Shadow Gate , a " portal " to the Plane of Shadow intended to provide a shortcut for the Sharrans ' operations . However , the " portal " was a failure : all Sambar ' s clothing , skin , and flesh simply misted away as shadow .
description_long: Sambar ( priest ) Father Sambar was a priest of Shar posing a priest of Mystra at the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Father Sambar was the first to pass through the Shadow Gate , a " portal " to the Plane of Shadow intended to provide a shortcut for the Sharrans ' operations . However , the " portal " was a failure : all Sambar ' s clothing , skin , and flesh simply misted away as shadow . His gruesome death was seen as a sacrifice to Shar . However , the temple guard accompanying him survived , becoming a dark creature , the first of the shadow guards . Sambar ' s bones were left heaped around the altar , the first of many , and his quarters remained empty .

title: Sambryl
description: Sambryl Sambryl was the regent queen of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Description . Sambryl was a skilled wizard , who was often likened to her great - great - great - grandmother , Queen Sambral .
description_long: Sambryl Sambryl was the regent queen of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Description . Sambryl was a skilled wizard , who was often likened to her great - great - great - grandmother , Queen Sambral . Relationships . Sambryl was the oldest daughter of King Rilimbrar and Queen Ilbritha . Since the royal couple had no sons , Sambryl was forced to marry her second cousin , Prince Imphras IV , who was the next male heir to the throne . Theirs was a marriage in name only , and it was never consummated . History . Sambryl " married " Imphras IV in 1336 DR . When Imphras IV and Rilimbrar both died in a fire in 1338 DR , Sambryl became the regent for a line of boy kings , including Soarimbrar the Younger , Imphras V , and Imbrar II . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel , Taegan Nightwind , she agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout . In 1374 DR , Sambryl ended her regency when Imbrar II came of age .

title: Sambuk
description: Sambuk A sambuk was a sailing ship with a single , triangular sail . It was a type of dhow . Description .
description_long: Sambuk A sambuk was a sailing ship with a single , triangular sail . It was a type of dhow . Description . A sambuk typically had a keel length of around 75 feet ( 23 meters ) long and had a beam or width of 20 feet ( 6 . 1 meters ) . Rather than a sterncastle , it had only a raised platform . Navigation was via a rudder at the stern and the lateen sails . It was slightly more reliable than a barijah , as it could be sail in all seas . A sambuk was crewed by 15 – 20 sailors and could carry 80 passengers or 90 tons ( 81 tonnes ) . In Zakhara . The sambuk was the second - most common ship in Zakhara after the barijah . History . In the Year of the Nine Stars , 657 DR , Grand Caliph Arash bint Sanjar sent an armada of " sambuk " to the Utter East . From these vessels , the corsairs launched a surprise attack on the Five Kingdoms , swiftly overrunning and seizing their defenseless port cities . Then legions of " askar " disembarked , beginning the Scouring of the Utter East . By the end , his forces boarded their " sambuks " and sailed home again .

title: Samdralyrion
description: Samdralyrion Samdralyrion was an old brass dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Samdralyrion was among the metallic dragon s who wanted to find a cure for the Rage .
description_long: Samdralyrion Samdralyrion was an old brass dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Samdralyrion was among the metallic dragon s who wanted to find a cure for the Rage . He was a good ally of Chatulio and Karasendrieth . He decided to join a cabal of humanoid wizards in Thentia to study the Rage . However , when the avariel Taegan Nightwind and the faerie dragon Jivex arrived in the city , Samdralyrion succumbed to the Rage and started attacking the wizards . The intervention of Taegan and Jivex saved the wizards but only at the cost of the brass dragon ' s life .

title: Samia al - Giss
description: Samia al - Giss Samia al - Giss was an inhabitant of the Furrowed Mountians in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a member of the Dervish faction of holy slayers .
description_long: Samia al - Giss Samia al - Giss was an inhabitant of the Furrowed Mountians in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a member of the Dervish faction of holy slayers . She served as an advanced scout for the Everlasting , warning them of potential threats entering the Haunted Lands . Possessions . Samia owned the Amulet of Dreams and some Dust of Truth .

title: Samia al - Kasir
description: Samia al - Kasir Samia al - Kasir was an elven wind mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a former apprentice of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , and served as her assistant .
description_long: Samia al - Kasir Samia al - Kasir was an elven wind mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a former apprentice of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , and served as her assistant .

title: Samia al - Risik
description: Samia al - Risik Imam Samia al - Risik was a High Priest of the Mosque of Zann the Wise in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was the second of Imam Renn min Zann , leading services in the mosque since his duties kept him at the Golden Mosque much of the time .
description_long: Samia al - Risik Imam Samia al - Risik was a High Priest of the Mosque of Zann the Wise in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was the second of Imam Renn min Zann , leading services in the mosque since his duties kept him at the Golden Mosque much of the time . She was an expert linguist , being completely fluent in 27 languages . She was extremely interested in learning drow and affa , and was willing to pay for the chance to learn from a fluent speaker .

title: Samirson Yarth
description: Samirson Yarth Samirson Yarth was one of the best assassins during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Samirson was a very efficient killer living in the city of Urmlaspyr in Sembia .
description_long: Samirson Yarth Samirson Yarth was one of the best assassins during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Samirson was a very efficient killer living in the city of Urmlaspyr in Sembia . He was so deadly that the god Bhaal praised him . Yarth was in the act of killing a man when the god Bane called to him the souls of all assassins and Samirson died immediately .

title: Sammafar
description: Sammafar " Sammafar " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A sammafar was the head manager of a noble ' s estate , ensuring the maintenance of the physical location and the direction of its personnel . While unable to command troops , sammafars often provided advice on matters of estate security .
description_long: Sammafar " Sammafar " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A sammafar was the head manager of a noble ' s estate , ensuring the maintenance of the physical location and the direction of its personnel . While unable to command troops , sammafars often provided advice on matters of estate security . A sammafar was the direct superior to those holding the titles of bailiff and farsann .

title: Sammaster
description: Sammaster Sammaster was an immensely powerful human mage and a former Chosen of Mystra . Sammaster was known for discovering the process which turns a dragon into a dracolich . After being killed in a great battle , he returned several hundred years later as a lich , but has since been destroyed once more .
description_long: Sammaster Sammaster was an immensely powerful human mage and a former Chosen of Mystra . Sammaster was known for discovering the process which turns a dragon into a dracolich . After being killed in a great battle , he returned several hundred years later as a lich , but has since been destroyed once more . Appearance . Sammaster was a tall handsome man with dark brown hair . His hair was usually long and straight . History . Early Life . Sammaster was born in 800 DR , and at age 17 was taken on as an apprentice by a travelling mage named Mnethos . Not long into his training , Sammaster was introduced to the goddess Mystra , whom he soon began worshipping . After just 8 years under the guidance of Mnethos , Sammaster had learnt all he could and began a path of his own . This led to him achieving the status of archmage just a decade later , at age 35 . To reach such a level at that age was almost unheard of at the time . Not long after , he began travelling Faerûn in search of knowledge and wisdom . During this time he made numerous advancements in metamagic through detailed research . In 851 DR the goddess Mystra appeared to Sammaster and offered to make him one of her Chosen .

title: Sammereza Sulphontis
description: Sammereza Sulphontis Sammereza " Sammer " Sulphontis was a traveling merchant and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Sammer had brown skin and purple eyes .
description_long: Sammereza Sulphontis Sammereza " Sammer " Sulphontis was a traveling merchant and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Sammer had brown skin and purple eyes . He often dressed in extravagant silk robes . Personality . Sammer was sly and intelligent with a very sharp eye for detail . Activities . Sammer was involved with politics and family feuds back at his home in Calimshan . He frequently worked against the el Synabbat family ' s underhanded dealings in Skullport . History . Sammer was originally from Calimshan , but he moved to Waterdeep in the 1330s DR . Relationships . Family . Sammer ' s elder brother , Ahmahd el Sufontis , was a pasha in the Trades Ward of Calimport . Sammer ' s sister - in - law ( Ahmahd ' s widow ) was married to the brother of Saida yr Oma yr Pesarkhal el Synabbat , Sammer ' s primary " enemy . " Lords of Waterdeep . Sammer was generally disliked by his fellow Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Samoth Dier
description: Samoth Dier Samoth Dier was a Boar ' s Head , one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , mercenary recruitment company in Amn . Description . Samoth was strong and tall and had a dark complexion .
description_long: Samoth Dier Samoth Dier was a Boar ' s Head , one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , mercenary recruitment company in Amn . Description . Samoth was strong and tall and had a dark complexion . He was a very confident individual . Samoth usually dressed in his artillery field gear . Activities . Samoth was a very talented artillery expert . He was the chief logistics officer for the Order . History . Samoth joined the council to replace Gaurundur Thasz , who died during a campaign in Tethyr .

title: Sampranasz
description: Sampranasz The small town of Sampranasz served as the center for the Cult of Set in Mulhorand . History . Sampranasz had a violent history , and was destroyed three times : once during the Orcgate Wars and twice by natural disaster .
description_long: Sampranasz The small town of Sampranasz served as the center for the Cult of Set in Mulhorand . History . Sampranasz had a violent history , and was destroyed three times : once during the Orcgate Wars and twice by natural disaster . Description . Hidden ruins abounded in this small fishing port , used to good effect by the priests of Set for their secret meetings and general worship . Inhabitants . As of 1357 DR , Sampranasz was ruled by Sannuet , who was a military governor . Sannuet was directly appointed to his position by priests of Horus - Re but served Set in secrecy . Sampranasz boasted a population of 3 , 000 in 1357 DR .

title: Sams Bandar
description: Sams Bandar Sams Bandar was the largest settlement located on Jazirat al - Qraidis within Jazayir al - Sartan . Defenses . Sams Bandar could summon a militia force of 15 armed men during a crisis .
description_long: Sams Bandar Sams Bandar was the largest settlement located on Jazirat al - Qraidis within Jazayir al - Sartan . Defenses . Sams Bandar could summon a militia force of 15 armed men during a crisis . Rumors and Legends . The villagers of Sams Bandar were particularly suspicious of a lagoon called Batihat al - Saji which was located on the other side of the island . Most believed those waters to be haunted , though the nature of what was haunting them depended on the villager asked . Inhabitants . This small village was " ruled " by Najib al - Samsi , an aging fisherman . He would meet weekly with the local court to settle disputes and catch up on general gossip .

title: Samsi Farlak
description: Samsi Farlak Samsi Farlak was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Samsi hated the sea , but he did enjoy telling stories relating to it .
description_long: Samsi Farlak Samsi Farlak was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Samsi hated the sea , but he did enjoy telling stories relating to it . Activities . Samsi was the owner of the Home of the Happy Dolphin , an inn located within the Trade Harbor district of Huzuz . In order to make a profit , Samsi often watered - down wine and spirits served at the inn . If the opportunity presented itself , Samsi would not balk at selling someone , preferably an outland barbarian , into slavery .

title: Samuel
description: Samuel Samuel was a former member of the Flaming Fist in the Gibberling Mountains . History . Samuel was a member of the Flaming Fist but he was convinced to desert by his friend Lena ; however , he was injured in the escape .
description_long: Samuel Samuel was a former member of the Flaming Fist in the Gibberling Mountains . History . Samuel was a member of the Flaming Fist but he was convinced to desert by his friend Lena ; however , he was injured in the escape . Eventually , Samuel met Gorion ' s Ward . Gameplay . Gorion ' s Ward could meet Samuel in two conflicting quests : in one , the Ward was recruited by the Flaming Fist to arrest him , and in the other , his friend Lena recruited the Ward to take him to the Temple of Wisdom to be healed .

title: Samular Caradoon
description: Samular Caradoon Samular was a human knight of Tyr and the founder of the Holy Order of Samular . Relationships . Samular was the youngest of three brothers .
description_long: Samular Caradoon Samular was a human knight of Tyr and the founder of the Holy Order of Samular . Relationships . Samular was the youngest of three brothers . The oldest was Renwick Caradoon who became a wizard and the middle brother Amphail the Just became a paladin as well . History . Caradoon founded the Holy Order of Samular after becoming famous for his heroic actions in the second Trollwar in 952 DR .

title: Sanctify
description: Sanctify Sanctify was a conjuration spell that allowed one or more priests to temporarily dedicate an area to their deity , creating a zone beneficial to followers of that deity and those of the same alignment , and detrimental to undead . The reverse of this spell , defile , did the same for evil priests but made it more difficult to turn undead . Effects .
description_long: Sanctify Sanctify was a conjuration spell that allowed one or more priests to temporarily dedicate an area to their deity , creating a zone beneficial to followers of that deity and those of the same alignment , and detrimental to undead . The reverse of this spell , defile , did the same for evil priests but made it more difficult to turn undead . Effects . One priest could bless a 30 ft ( 9 . 1 m ) square , with each additional priest ( of the same deity ) adding an additional square . The duration was a number of minutes determined by the level of the most experienced priest plus a couple minutes for each additional caster . While the spell lasted , the area became holy to followers of the deity , boosting their morale and becoming more resistant to fear - and charm - based attacks as long as they remained in the " sanctified " area . Friends of the same alignment but different faith were also encouraged , but not to the same degree . Those in the zone wishing to harm the priests or their friends were more susceptible to fear and charm effects , and undead were easier to turn .

title: Sanctify sacred site
description: Sanctify sacred site Sanctify sacred site was a divine magic spell available to priests of Chauntea that could restore a holy site that had been defiled . It was the only known remedy for a moonwell that had been corrupted by a " moonveil " spell . It was a ritual that took all day to cast , required material components that were difficult to procure , but could be assisted by as many followers of Chauntea as practical .
description_long: Sanctify sacred site Sanctify sacred site was a divine magic spell available to priests of Chauntea that could restore a holy site that had been defiled . It was the only known remedy for a moonwell that had been corrupted by a " moonveil " spell . It was a ritual that took all day to cast , required material components that were difficult to procure , but could be assisted by as many followers of Chauntea as practical . Effects . This spell relied on Faith magic and required the casting of " focus " , itself an all - day ritual , before beginning the " sanctify sacred site " spell at sunrise . Although " focus " could enhance a spell for up to a year , " sanctify sacred site " was permanent once successfully cast . The level of the caster , the number of worshipers , and the time of year all had an effect on the chances of success . If cast on Midsummer day , the chance for success was greatly increased . Midwinter and the Spring and Autumn equinox es were also auspicious , but less so . Additional worshipers of Chauntea , in groups of five , also gave a slight boost to the spellcasting .

title: Sanctuary
