description: Sanctuary Sanctuary was an abjuration spell that could prevent enemies from attacking the subject for a few minutes on the condition that the subject does not take direct offensive action . Effects . This spell protected the touched individual from any targeted attack , either melee , ranged weapon , or spell , unless the attacker was able to overcome the " sanctuary " by force of will .
description_long: Sanctuary Sanctuary was an abjuration spell that could prevent enemies from attacking the subject for a few minutes on the condition that the subject does not take direct offensive action . Effects . This spell protected the touched individual from any targeted attack , either melee , ranged weapon , or spell , unless the attacker was able to overcome the " sanctuary " by force of will . If the first attack failed to get past the " sanctuary " , then no subsequent attack by that enemy on the subject would succeed for the duration of the spell . This spell did not protect against area - effect attacks , such as " fireball " . As long as the subject did not directly attack an enemy , he or she could perform non - aggressive actions such as casting " bless " , healing , divination , or even summoning creatures ( such creatures may attack on the summoner ' s behalf ) . The older versions of this spell actually made a failed attacker totally ignore the subject for the duration of the spell . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the use of the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus .

title: Sand
description: Sand Sand was a moon elf wizard of both Luskan and Neverwinter , known for his potion s shop as well as , later on , his aid rendered to the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . Description . Short of height , even for a moon elf , Sand was a physically unremarkable character with long black hair , sky blue eyes , and typical elven ears .
description_long: Sand Sand was a moon elf wizard of both Luskan and Neverwinter , known for his potion s shop as well as , later on , his aid rendered to the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . Description . Short of height , even for a moon elf , Sand was a physically unremarkable character with long black hair , sky blue eyes , and typical elven ears . Often dressed in the elegant robes considered typical for a wizard , Sand kept with him a cat familiar named Jaral . Sand ' s body language , much like his speech , was wry and inquisitive , with a haught arrogance that carried itself in his smile . Sand preferred dagger s as his weapons and usually carried one with him . He also had a strange habit of sniffing the air whilst meeting someone new , coming upon a new location , or otherwise investigating a new experience apparently a result of his sophisticated elven senses . Personality . Snide and sarcastic , Sand generally looked his nose down upon most others around him - when he wasn ' t using it to sniff the air , that is .

title: Sand ( province )
description: Sand ( province ) The province of sand in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of earth , taking its name from one of its most common forms in the desert lands of the Land of Fate . Many of its spells contained and used sand as an essential part . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones .
description_long: Sand ( province ) The province of sand in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of earth , taking its name from one of its most common forms in the desert lands of the Land of Fate . Many of its spells contained and used sand as an essential part . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones . Elemental mage s in Zakhara specialized exclusively in one province , like sand , while sorcerers took spells from two provinces , shunning the other two . Unlike elementalist s , they recognized no opposition between sand and the other three elements in the Land of Fate . Paths of power . Zakharan practicioners of path magic recognized four paths of power within the province of sand :

title: Sand cage
description: Sand cage A sand cage was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown at a target , this sand created a whirlwind cage shaped like an inverted cone .
description_long: Sand cage A sand cage was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown at a target , this sand created a whirlwind cage shaped like an inverted cone . The cone stood 8 feet ( 2 . 4 m ) tall and was 4 feet ( 1 . 2 m ) wide . The " sand cage " would envelop the nearest creature , assuming they fit within the cone , causing abrasive damage as it settled around them . Once trapped within a " sand cage " , a victim was unable to perform any functions aside from moving and suffered a small amount of continual damage until released . The whirlwind created a loud hissing sound that drowned out all but the loudest sounds around it . The whirlwind would actually dissipate if it sustained enough physical damage , though only spells or magic weapons could harm it . Anyone attacking the " sand cage " risked harming the individual trapped within as well . Extremely dextrous individuals had a chance to briefly step outside of the cage to attack it . Each time a trapped individual attempted this feat they were harmed by the swirling sand of the cage .

title: Sand form
description: Sand form Sand form was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell any recipient whom the caster touched , including the caster , was able to animate and control a body made of sand while their real body was up to 100 miles ( 161 km ) away .
description_long: Sand form Sand form was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell any recipient whom the caster touched , including the caster , was able to animate and control a body made of sand while their real body was up to 100 miles ( 161 km ) away . The recipient could use most of their skills , including spellcasting , through the sand form without any negative effects . Only extremely intricate skills such as lockpicking , sewing , etc could not be used . While in sand form , the recipient ' s mind existed in both the sand form and their original body . They were completely aware of their surroundings in both forms . While in sand form the recipient could breath and move their eyes but was otherwise unable to move their original body . Attacks against the sand form did not harm the recipient ' s original body . A sand form immersed in water or heavy rainfall for more than a few minutes would begin to disintegrate . If the sand form was destroyed by any means , there was a chance that the recipient ' s original body died as well . However , the recipient could abandon the sand form at any time without experiencing any negative effects . Components .

title: Sand giant
description: Sand giant Sand giants were disciplined , honorable desert dwellers who lived in stable communities which were often isolated . Although their villages tended to be remote , they did trade with other races and were not isolationists . Sand giant society was highly structured , with each clan ruled by a hereditary monarch .
description_long: Sand giant Sand giants were disciplined , honorable desert dwellers who lived in stable communities which were often isolated . Although their villages tended to be remote , they did trade with other races and were not isolationists . Sand giant society was highly structured , with each clan ruled by a hereditary monarch . Sand giants formerly lived in most deserts in Southern Faerûn but were most commonly found in Raurin . Combat . Sand giants prefered to dig into the sand and ambush opponents . They would often attack with a weapon known as a sand blaster which shot sand at opponents , partially disabling them . In melee combat they often used a scimitar . Appearance . Adult Sand giants stood 10 feet tall and weighed 2 , 000 lbs . Their skin ranged from dark brown to beige in color and their hair ranged from black to blond . Their eyes were usually the same color as their hair .

title: Sand jambiya
description: Sand jambiya Sand jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Sand jambiya Sand jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell turned a fistful of sand into a small sharp weapon . The new blade was no longer than twice the length of the caster ' s hand . A sand jambiya could harm creatures that were immune to normal weapons . Components . This spell required a fistful of sand to cast .

title: Sand of mirages
description: Sand of mirages Sand of mirages was a useful magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that created a deceptive image . Powers . This sand created an illusion of whatever the user wanted barring creatures .
description_long: Sand of mirages Sand of mirages was a useful magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that created a deceptive image . Powers . This sand created an illusion of whatever the user wanted barring creatures . For the illusion to work , the sand needed to be thrown outdoors under the light of the sun . A handful of " sand of mirages " would create an illusion that would fill a 50 foot ( 15 m ) cube . Multiple handfuls could be combined to create larger illusions . These illusions would last as long as they remained in contact with direct sunlight . The illusions would not vanish if struck , but their true nature would be revealed .

title: Sand of obscurement
description: Sand of obscurement Sand of obscurement was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown , " sand of obscurement " created an instantaneious mini sandstorm , effectively blinding anything within the storm .
description_long: Sand of obscurement Sand of obscurement was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown , " sand of obscurement " created an instantaneious mini sandstorm , effectively blinding anything within the storm . This effect lasted for 2 - 8 minutes and covered 50 cubic feet ( 15 cubic meters ) . Those caught within the sandstorm were not only blinded for the duration of the storm , but also for up to 10 minutes after the storm dissipated while they tried to cleanse the sand from their eyes . Blinded victims could shorten this time by flushing their eyes with water . Each additional handful of sand used did not increase the area of effect , but did extend the duration of the sandstorm by several minutes . It should be noted that someone using " sand of obscurement " was not immune to the blinding sand , they were merely prepared for its release and could shut their eyes before it activated .

title: Sand of restoration
description: Sand of restoration Sand of restoration was a magical sand from Zakhara that temporarily repaired buildings and other structures . Powers . If sprinkled on the damaged stones and framework of a building or other man - made structure , " sand of restoration " would temporarily repair all cracks , gaps , etc .
description_long: Sand of restoration Sand of restoration was a magical sand from Zakhara that temporarily repaired buildings and other structures . Powers . If sprinkled on the damaged stones and framework of a building or other man - made structure , " sand of restoration " would temporarily repair all cracks , gaps , etc . on the surface of the building that the sand touched . All previously damaged sections were replaced with translucent sand that lasted for 12 hours before reverting to their previous state . A handful of " sand of restoration " could repair 50 cubic feet ( 15 cubic meters ) . Buildings repaired in this manner could be used to shelter from the elements , but even the slightest physical damage to the structure from outside sources would cause it to collapse .

title: Sand of scintillation
description: Sand of scintillation Sand of scintillation was a useful magical sand from Zakhara that was beneficial to those who found themselves in a tight situation . Powers . When thrown into the air , this sand caused a blinding explosion of hypnotic light .
description_long: Sand of scintillation Sand of scintillation was a useful magical sand from Zakhara that was beneficial to those who found themselves in a tight situation . Powers . When thrown into the air , this sand caused a blinding explosion of hypnotic light . Most creatures who saw the explosion were stunned for several minutes . The explosion affected all of those within 50 feet ( 15 m ) in every direction . Each additional handful of " sand of scintillation " used increased the effect and range by another 50 feet .

title: Sand of sinking
description: Sand of sinking Sand of sinking was a magical sand that turned other sand , earth , or stone into quicksand . This sand originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers .
description_long: Sand of sinking Sand of sinking was a magical sand that turned other sand , earth , or stone into quicksand . This sand originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown upon any other type of sand , earth , and even stone , " sand of sinking " transformed the area into deadly quicksand . A handful of " sand of sinking " was capable of transforming a 9 ft . by 9 ft . ( 2 . 7 m by 2 . 7 m ) square for 2 - 8 minutes . Additional handfuls did not increase the depth , but did increase the effected area . Anyone caught within this area began to sink instantly to a maximum depth of 10 feet . Anyone stuck within the area when the magic wore off was in for a nasty surprise since the effected area solidified into its original state . If used upon a wall , " sand of sinking " behaved similar to a " passwall " spell , creating a 10 foot deep opening . Openings created in this manner were permanent since the quicksand flowed downward away from the opening .

title: Sand of truth
description: Sand of truth Sand of truth was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Sand of truth Sand of truth was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description . This magical dust was created from the remains of a slain sandman . Powers . Sand of truth could reveal illusions , genie - work , and polymorph ed creatures . In essence , it revealed the true nature of any magically altered item or creature . When sprinkled onto such an object or creature , the sand would transform the subject back to its original state .

title: Sand quiet
description: Sand quiet Sand quiet was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Sand quiet Sand quiet was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . When cast , this spell created an area of silence that surrounding an item or individual . All sounds that would normally emanate from the target were muffled . This spell did not prevent spellcasting or other activities requiring speech . All sounds that would have come from the target were randomly transported elsewhere . Components . This spell required a two handfuls of sand to cast .

title: Sand seal
description: Sand seal Sand seal was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell a wizard was able to create a solid barrier of sand capable of barring a doorway .
description_long: Sand seal Sand seal was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell a wizard was able to create a solid barrier of sand capable of barring a doorway . Wizards with more power were able to create sand seals that were more resilient to attack . The sand seal had a small chance to utterly shatter a weapon striking it . Components . This spell required a handful of sand and a small lump of wax to cast .

title: Sand shadow
description: Sand shadow Sand shadow was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell could conceal a target as long as they were mostly within a shadow .
description_long: Sand shadow Sand shadow was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell could conceal a target as long as they were mostly within a shadow . The target could only be viewed through magical detection . The target could move between shadows but became visible when fully exposed to the sunlight . This spell lasted for three hours and could not be ended early by the caster or recipient . A " dispel magic " spell cast by someone else would end the spell . Light spells also made the target visible . Components . This spell required a pinch of dry sand and an eyelash to cast .

title: Sand shroud
description: Sand shroud Sand shroud was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could open up an area of sand directly beneath a target and swallow them whole .
description_long: Sand shroud Sand shroud was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could open up an area of sand directly beneath a target and swallow them whole . This spell only worked over sand or loose earth . Only the dead , undead , or creatures that never lived , such as golem s , could be targets of this spell . If cast successfully , this spell buried the target 60 feet ( 18 . 3 m ) under the sand and covered them up as if nothing happened . Components . This spell required a lump of mud , clay , dried dung , or other powdery substance to cast .

title: Sand slumber
description: Sand slumber Sand slumber was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Sand slumber Sand slumber was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . This spell was used to cause sleep to fall upon any creature that normally required sleep , including genie s . This spell lasted from a few minutes to an hour or two depending on the caster ' s power . Targets instantly fell asleep , collapsing and dropping anything they were holding . They would remain asleep for the duration of the spell unless physically disturbed . Loud noises would not wake them . Components . This spell required a pinch of fine sand to cast .

title: Sand sword
description: Sand sword Sand sword was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Similar to the " sand jambiya " spell , this spell created a sharp blade out of sand .
description_long: Sand sword Sand sword was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Similar to the " sand jambiya " spell , this spell created a sharp blade out of sand . The blade could be as long as the caster ' s arm . It was able to harm creatures that could only be injured by magical weapons . Components . This spell required enough sand to create the sword to cast .

title: Sand tools
description: Sand tools Sand tools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by mechanician s . Effects .
description_long: Sand tools Sand tools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by mechanician s . Effects . Mechanicians developed this spell so they would always have access to their special tools . This spell created a standard array of tools that sized themselves perfectly for the task at hand . The tools were formed from sand but had the strength and hardness of iron . This spell could last for up to 8 hours , but the tools would revert back to regular sand if the job was finished before that time expired . Sand tools could not be carried with the caster . Components . This spell required a bagful of sand to cast .

title: Sand worm
description: Sand worm Sand worm was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned the recipient into a sand worm ; a man - sized worm that no longer needed to eat , drink , or breathe .
description_long: Sand worm Sand worm was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned the recipient into a sand worm ; a man - sized worm that no longer needed to eat , drink , or breathe . The sand worm could easily burrow through sand and loose earth . It could detect heat from living things up to 30 feet ( 9 . 1 m ) while underground and that ranged was doubled above ground . Transforming into the worm partially healed the recipient . Sand worms were able to move faster while burrowing than they could on the surface . Components . This spell required a live worm to cast .

title: Sandara al - Sahil
description: Sandara al - Sahil Sandara al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who was in charge of supervising the North Center of Huzuz . Description . Sandara was a lovely genie who weighed well over 500 pounds ( over 227 kg ) .
description_long: Sandara al - Sahil Sandara al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who was in charge of supervising the North Center of Huzuz . Description . Sandara was a lovely genie who weighed well over 500 pounds ( over 227 kg ) . Activities . Sandara ' s prime charge was monitoring and assuring the steady flow of caravans entering the City of Delights through the North Center .

title: Sandcone
description: Sandcone Sandcone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was used to excavate a cone - sized area of sand where the caster desired .
description_long: Sandcone Sandcone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was used to excavate a cone - sized area of sand where the caster desired . The tip of the cone faced downward . This spell only transported sand ; rocks and other objects within the cone remained in place and fell to the bottom of the cone when the sand was removed . Sand surrounding the cone would not fall into the opening as long as the caster concentrated . Components . This spell required the hair of a desert rat and a pinch of sand to cast .

title: Sandesyl Morgia
description: Sandesyl Morgia Sandesyl Morgia was a female vampire and member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1484 DR . At that time , a new Cult faction led by the mage Severin emerged , switching their adoration from dracolich es to living dragon s . Sandesyl considered this a blasphemy against the teachings of Sammaster so she went to stop Severin ' s plan to resurrect Tiamat .
description_long: Sandesyl Morgia Sandesyl Morgia was a female vampire and member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1484 DR . At that time , a new Cult faction led by the mage Severin emerged , switching their adoration from dracolich es to living dragon s . Sandesyl considered this a blasphemy against the teachings of Sammaster so she went to stop Severin ' s plan to resurrect Tiamat . She was present at the Skyreach Castle in the Greypeak Mountains . She later allied herself with those who would otherwise be enemies of the Cult , such as Elminster Aumar and the forces of Neverwinter .

title: Sandman
description: Sandman Sandmen were rare creatures found in Zakhara . Originally from the Elemental Plane of Earth , these creatures were used by the dao to capture slaves on Toril . They were favored by the dao for this task because of their ability to capture targets without damaging them .
description_long: Sandman Sandmen were rare creatures found in Zakhara . Originally from the Elemental Plane of Earth , these creatures were used by the dao to capture slaves on Toril . They were favored by the dao for this task because of their ability to capture targets without damaging them . Description . These creatures literally resembled a man made out of sand . The sand comprising their bodies was held together by magical forces . Combat . These creatures were ambush hunters , preferring to attack at night . Any creatures that came within 20 ft . ( 6 m ) of a sandman would fall asleep unless they were able to resist . Elves were more resistant to this effect than other races . Each touch from a sandman brought another wave of drowsiness that their opponents had to fight against or risk falling asleep . This deep sleep lasted for at least half an hour , and no amount of noise or physical disturbance would cause the target to awaken during this time . Any victim falling asleep before a sandman often woke up as a slave to the dao in the Great Dismal Delve . Sandmen were immune to all forms of non - magical missile attacks .

title: Sandrew
description: Sandrew Savant Sandrew , usually know as Sandrew the Wise , was the leading cleric of Oghma in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Sandrew hailed from the Silver Marches but settled in Waterdeep circa 1362 DR with the objective of building a temple and a library worthy of his god and the City of Splendors .
description_long: Sandrew Savant Sandrew , usually know as Sandrew the Wise , was the leading cleric of Oghma in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Sandrew hailed from the Silver Marches but settled in Waterdeep circa 1362 DR with the objective of building a temple and a library worthy of his god and the City of Splendors . He was one of the four clerics of Oghma , among the many powerful mages , Khelben Arunsun brought together in 1374 DR in order to restore the High Mages of the lost city of Miyeritaar and cleanse part of the High Moor .

title: Sandspray
description: Sandspray Sandspray was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster caused pillar of sand to explode upward beneath a target .
description_long: Sandspray Sandspray was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster caused pillar of sand to explode upward beneath a target . The pillar rose to 30 ft . ( 9 . 1 m ) high , blinding the target for several minutes and causing abrasive damage based on the magical might of the caster . This spell could only be cast in an area of plentiful sand . Components . This spell required sand to cast .

title: Sandstorm ( novel )
description: Sandstorm ( novel ) Sandstorm is a stand - alone novel by Christopher Rowe . Summary . In the time period after the Spellplague in 1385 DR , the lands of Calimshan were ripped asunder by an event known as the Second Era of Skyfire .
description_long: Sandstorm ( novel ) Sandstorm is a stand - alone novel by Christopher Rowe . Summary . In the time period after the Spellplague in 1385 DR , the lands of Calimshan were ripped asunder by an event known as the Second Era of Skyfire . Following the Spellplague , the Calimemnon Crystal , the magical prison of the efreet Memnon and the djinn Calim , shattered . The released creatures immediately resumed their hostilities that dated back to the First Era of Skyfire , circa – 6500 DR . In the wake of the return of Calim and Memnon , many of the residents of Calimshan , presumed to be human , cast off their long held disguises and revealed themselves to be genasi . These descendants of the elemental powers pledged themselves to either fire or air , took over the port cities of Memnon and Calimport respectively , and joined the war between the efreets and djinns . The Second Era of Skyfire lasted until 1450 DR , when both Memnon and Calim were banished to the Elemental Chaos by an unknown event . They left in their wake a devastated Calimshan , torn by the remaining djinns , efreets , and genasi warlords .

title: Sandyse Thunderquill
description: Sandyse Thunderquill Sandyse Thunderquill was a confident but socially awkward mage and a member of the Harpers in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Sandyse was in training to infiltrate the Arcane Brotherhood .
description_long: Sandyse Thunderquill Sandyse Thunderquill was a confident but socially awkward mage and a member of the Harpers in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Sandyse was in training to infiltrate the Arcane Brotherhood . Her duty was to protect one of " teleportation circle s " of Krowen Valharrow ' s network .

title: Sanfin Lotte
description: Sanfin Lotte Sanfin Lotte was a gossip writer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Sanfin spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn .
description_long: Sanfin Lotte Sanfin Lotte was a gossip writer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Sanfin spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn . He gained money by supplying stories to the city ' s various broadsheets but also sold secrets to the highest bidders and even blackmailed someone if the opportunity arose . In truth , he used the information he gathered to manipulate his power - player clients , both in Waterdeep and Undermountain . History . In 1479 DR , Sanfin ' s parakeet had started to venture inside Undermountain together with some adventuring parties but always went back before them . Relationship . Sanfin ' s constant companion was the parakeet Chloe , well loved by all staff and customers of the inn .

title: Sangalor
description: Sangalor Sangalor , also known as Sangalor of the Secrets , was a mind flayer outcast who became a cleric of Oghma in 1370 DR . Activities . In time , Sangalor became a fervent devotee of the God of Knowledge but was basically still an illithid : his usual trade was to find secrets by request or interrogating evil prisoners by eating their brains .
description_long: Sangalor Sangalor , also known as Sangalor of the Secrets , was a mind flayer outcast who became a cleric of Oghma in 1370 DR . Activities . In time , Sangalor became a fervent devotee of the God of Knowledge but was basically still an illithid : his usual trade was to find secrets by request or interrogating evil prisoners by eating their brains . Sangalor revealed secrets about his home city to anyone who was seriously intending to fight his evil brethren . History . Sangalor originated from the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl but at some point , for unknown reasons , it became an outcast . To survive , Sangalor turned to the worship of Oghma and moved first to Skullport and later to Waterdeep and the Temple of Oghma there .

title: Sanidine
description: Sanidine Sanidine was an ornamental stone found on the surface of sand dunes and gravel screes . Sanidine was favored by the nomadic , desert - dwelling Bedine and to ring - stone size or smaller . Description .
description_long: Sanidine Sanidine was an ornamental stone found on the surface of sand dunes and gravel screes . Sanidine was favored by the nomadic , desert - dwelling Bedine and to ring - stone size or smaller . Description . Sanidine was a pale tan to straw yellow form of . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Large specimens ( about thumb - sized or bigger ) could be used to replace all but specially constructed spell components in the casting of spells related to water or purification .

title: Sansuri
description: Sansuri Countess Sansuri was the ruler of the cloud giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sansuri was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .
description_long: Sansuri Countess Sansuri was the ruler of the cloud giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sansuri was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the disappearance of storm giant king Hekaton , all giant lords started their path to reshaping the ordning . Sansuri ' s plan was to rediscovered one of the ancient Ostoria n markets containing a long - lost trove of dragon magic . In order to accomplish her project , Sansuri lured the bronze dragon Felgolos into her castle and imprisoned him in order to extract information . Though Felgolos knew nothing , Sansuri did not believe him and tortured him terribly . Activities . Sansuri was always near Felgolos trying to extract the informations .

title: Santir
description: Santir Santir was a monk of elven ancestry at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Personality . Santir loved to talk and to gossip , and he was always interested in a good story .
description_long: Santir Santir was a monk of elven ancestry at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Personality . Santir loved to talk and to gossip , and he was always interested in a good story . He knew he could not be an adventurer himself , liking commodity , but he enjoyed tales of adventurers from books and stories . However , Santir was a man of his word and if pressed he would promise to keep quiet the subjects of guests ' research . Activities . Santir was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Scroll of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred . His duty was to act as a librarian . Often he was assigned to help guests in their research . History . In 1491 DR Santir was possibly involved in an investigation about a strange storm originated from the monastery . Some time later Santir and some others monks was kidnapped by cultist of Cult of the Howling Hatred in order to use them in a new plot to access to the elemental node . In a room of the node ' s complex under the monastery thank to the elementary forces Santir was keep in custody by two shadow demon s .

title: Santrin
description: Santrin Santrin " the Skilled " was a gnome man living in Calaunt in the Vast . Around 1358 DR , he was a noted carver of amber , ivory , jade , obsidian , and fine wood , producing extremely fine and beautiful inlays . Though very expensive , his work was famous around the Dragon Reach , and he had a very long backlog of orders .
description_long: Santrin Santrin " the Skilled " was a gnome man living in Calaunt in the Vast . Around 1358 DR , he was a noted carver of amber , ivory , jade , obsidian , and fine wood , producing extremely fine and beautiful inlays . Though very expensive , his work was famous around the Dragon Reach , and he had a very long backlog of orders .

title: Santur
description: Santur A santur ( SAHN - toor ) was a Zakharan instrument similar to the hammered dulcimer . Description . The " santur " was similar in appearance to the " qanun " , being a trapezoidal stringed instrument .
description_long: Santur A santur ( SAHN - toor ) was a Zakharan instrument similar to the hammered dulcimer . Description . The " santur " was similar in appearance to the " qanun " , being a trapezoidal stringed instrument . Unlike the " qanun " , the strings of the " santur " were single strings and not wound . They were made from metal and struck , not plucked , with special hammers . History . The " santur " was a favored instrument of the Pearl Cities region of Zakhara . This fact alone made its use frowned upon within the Pantheist League .

title: Sap
description: Sap A sap , also known as a " slapper " , " slap jack " , or " beavertail sap " , is a light , martial melee weapon that does non - lethal damage . Description . A sap is a lead rod or disk hammered somewhat flat and wrapped in leather , then fitted to a spring handle .
description_long: Sap A sap , also known as a " slapper " , " slap jack " , or " beavertail sap " , is a light , martial melee weapon that does non - lethal damage . Description . A sap is a lead rod or disk hammered somewhat flat and wrapped in leather , then fitted to a spring handle . The handle may be an actual spring or a flexible strip of steel . Lead shot ( small pellets ) can also be used instead of a solid piece of lead . A typical sap costs 1gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . A sap is intended to deliver a non - killing blow , dealing out non - lethal damage for roughing someone up or knocking them unconscious . Knowing where to strike and getting in close enough to use a sap requires some skill and therefore the sap is considered a martial weapon . It is very difficult but not impossible to kill using a sap ( or other non - lethal attack ) by striking in the most vulnerable areas .

title: Sapphiraktar
description: Sapphiraktar Sapphiraktar was an ancient male blue dracolich and a member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Out of vanity , the dracolich maintained his dragon appearance through magic .
description_long: Sapphiraktar Sapphiraktar was an ancient male blue dracolich and a member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Out of vanity , the dracolich maintained his dragon appearance through magic . Personality . Preparing to kill Jymahna for spying , Sapphiraktar taught dragon magic to Rhangaun . Activities . Sapphiraktar made his cavern home in the ruined city of Teshyll west of Alatorin in Calimshan . His vast network of caves ranged south from Memnon for 50 miles ( 80 . 5 km ) , east to the undercity of Keltar , and west to within 10 miles ( 16 . 1 km ) of Teshburl . History . Around 1072 DR , Sapphiraktar became a dracolich . In 1374 DR , Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk was fooled by Khelben " The Blackstaff " Arunsun , his former mentor but now hated adversary , into seeking what he thought to be an ancient Shoon artifact . With this artifact , he planned to take over control of the Twisted Rune . Blackstaff then struck a deal with Sapphiraktar , the Rune preferring to have the Blackstaff deal with the traitorous Runemaster rather than having to deal with him themselves .

title: Sapphire
description: Sapphire Sapphire was a rare variety of that occured in the Realms . Description . Sapphire was found in shades of pale blue to a deep azure .
description_long: Sapphire Sapphire was a rare variety of that occured in the Realms . Description . Sapphire was found in shades of pale blue to a deep azure . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Sapphires were considered sacred by followers of Aerdrie Faenya , Deep Duerra , Eldath , Gaerdal Ironhand — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Black sapphires specifically were recognized as a sign of approval from Bane , and sacred to followers of Labelas Enoreth , Laduguer , Lolth , Shargaas , and Vhaeraun . Powers . Realmslore held that sapphires increased magical skill and strength and therefore they were used in creating magic blades and items that affected the mind , magical prowess , and the element of air . However , sapphires had a dampening effect on magically induced fear , rage , despair , or insanity and could partially protect the wearer from these effects . When used as a spell component , sapphires ensured the greatest initial effect ( usually damage ) upon first impact and the longest possible duration . The most auspicious time of day to use sapphires was midmorn .

title: Sapphire dragon
description: Sapphire dragon Sapphire dragons tended to be territorial and antisocial although they loved to discuss military matters and strategy . They preferred to lair in deep , rocky caves and often kept large spiders in their home as a food source . Combat .
description_long: Sapphire dragon Sapphire dragons tended to be territorial and antisocial although they loved to discuss military matters and strategy . They preferred to lair in deep , rocky caves and often kept large spiders in their home as a food source . Combat . Sapphire dragons breathed a cone of sonic energy which harmed opponents and caused them to panic .

title: Saprach
description: Saprach Saprach was a thief who lived in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Saprach was the proprietor of Saprach ' s Fine Wines , but also had a side - line in thieving and fencing of stolen goods , and specialized in the discreet disposal of dead bodies .
description_long: Saprach Saprach was a thief who lived in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Saprach was the proprietor of Saprach ' s Fine Wines , but also had a side - line in thieving and fencing of stolen goods , and specialized in the discreet disposal of dead bodies .

title: Saprach ' s Fine Wines
description: Saprach ' s Fine Wines The Saprach ' s Fine Wines was a shop in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR , dedicated to selling wine . Location . The store was located in the east side of the city , on Whistleturn Way near the Market .
description_long: Saprach ' s Fine Wines The Saprach ' s Fine Wines was a shop in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR , dedicated to selling wine . Location . The store was located in the east side of the city , on Whistleturn Way near the Market . Services . The store had the finest selection of wines in Tantras . Furthermore , the proprietor , Saprach , had a sideline of fencing stolen property and also specialized in the discreet disposal of dead bodies .

title: Saqr
description: Saqr The Saqr was a small tribe of genasi who lived on an island in the Poison Sea of Relmaur , Returned Abeir . History . The Saqr established their home on a crystal island in the center of the Poison Sea , near a crystal they believed was the heart of a dead god , in hopes of using the dormant power of this item to elevate one of them to godhood .
description_long: Saqr The Saqr was a small tribe of genasi who lived on an island in the Poison Sea of Relmaur , Returned Abeir . History . The Saqr established their home on a crystal island in the center of the Poison Sea , near a crystal they believed was the heart of a dead god , in hopes of using the dormant power of this item to elevate one of them to godhood . Something went wrong , however , and the energies from the crystal killed most of the Saqr and transformed the few survivors into aberrant crystal undead .

title: Sar
description: Sar Sar , also called Vengeance , was a giant two - headed roc who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . Sar was used by the holy slayer s on major raids against caravans travelling either between Halwa and the coast , or between Qudra and the south .
description_long: Sar Sar , also called Vengeance , was a giant two - headed roc who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . Sar was used by the holy slayer s on major raids against caravans travelling either between Halwa and the coast , or between Qudra and the south . The sheer size and appearance of the giant bird usually caused caravan guards to flee for their lives . Sar was fed a diet of camels and enemies slain during raids .

title: Sar ' Rukoth
description: Sar ' Rukoth Sar ' Rukoth was an island in Okoth containing a number of crumbling ruins and new , unlit domes . Each dome contained one of 18 sterile sarrukh and all of that sarrukh ' s servants , protectors , advisers , and entertainers , most of them being yuan - ti . They were connected by a system of tunnels that passed through various salt lakes , caves , and sarrukh tombs .
description_long: Sar ' Rukoth Sar ' Rukoth was an island in Okoth containing a number of crumbling ruins and new , unlit domes . Each dome contained one of 18 sterile sarrukh and all of that sarrukh ' s servants , protectors , advisers , and entertainers , most of them being yuan - ti . They were connected by a system of tunnels that passed through various salt lakes , caves , and sarrukh tombs . The last known khuzdar , or leader of the council , was Ziss ' thiss , whose influence was spread across Faerûn .

title: Saradreza Oussmtor
description: Saradreza Oussmtor Saradreza Oussmtor was a high priestess of Eilistraee . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Saradreza led a group of Sword Dancers , seeing the liberation of Maerimydra as a chance to rally drow with no interest in remaining under the shackles of Lolth ' s tyranny .
description_long: Saradreza Oussmtor Saradreza Oussmtor was a high priestess of Eilistraee . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Saradreza led a group of Sword Dancers , seeing the liberation of Maerimydra as a chance to rally drow with no interest in remaining under the shackles of Lolth ' s tyranny . In Sporedome , Saradreza and her fellows joined in the planning of the assault on Maerimydra . Personality . Saradreza was charismatic and warm hearted . She viewed this as a perfect chance to spread her goddess ' s doctrines .

title: Saradush
description: Saradush Saradush was a metropolis within the land of Tethyr . History . Once a great bureaucratic center for the city ' s royal dynasty , Saradush became a producer of agricultural products for trade .
description_long: Saradush Saradush was a metropolis within the land of Tethyr . History . Once a great bureaucratic center for the city ' s royal dynasty , Saradush became a producer of agricultural products for trade . Despite this , Saradush became an important waystation for trade in the area surrounding the Lake of Steam . Given its proximity to several kinds of terrain , along with increased prominence as trade traffic with Riatavin rises , Saradush also become a haven for travelers and adventurers alike . Saradush fell into a period of decline following the Spellplague . Government . Lord Mayor Tanithe Beyross was the current elected leader of Saradush . However Lord Oon Santele , Count of Surkazar is the true leader behind the Beyross . Armed Forces . The Saradush Guard boasted 200 members and was adequate to resolve most disturbances within the walls of the city . If more help is needed , it was usually found in the form of ex - adventurers or mercenary citizens of the city . Religion . Saradush was unusual as there were no major temples within the city . Those people who regularly worshiped did so in small shrines within their own homes .

title: Sarahin
description: Sarahin Sarahin , translated as the " Wolves ' Den " , was a unique fortress located deep within the Haunted Lands in Zakhara . The actual fortress complex was located on a mountain named Jabal Sarahin . Location .
description_long: Sarahin Sarahin , translated as the " Wolves ' Den " , was a unique fortress located deep within the Haunted Lands in Zakhara . The actual fortress complex was located on a mountain named Jabal Sarahin . Location . The land surrounding Sarahin was dry but received enough rainfall to support forage for small herds of livestock . Defenses . Sarahin sat atop a plateau that stood over 10 , 000 ft . ( 3000 m ) high . Since the walls surrounding the fortress were quarried from the same rock as the plateau , Sarahin could not be seen from the ground even though the plateau was the highest point as far as the eye could see . History . Sarahin was originally constructed by Amir Heidar Qan of the jann . During this time , the fortress of the Everlasting was destroyed , forcing the holy slayer s to scatter throughout the Land of Fate . One holy slayer learned of Sarahin and began planning to overtake the citadel with Grandfather Hasan . Holy slayers infiltrated a nearby village , and attempted to convert the jann to the worship of Hajama . The jann , in turn , tried to convert their sheikh .

title: Sarbossa
description: Sarbossa Sarbossa , also known as , lintonite , comptonite , ozakite , eye stone , or fire rock , occurred in small nodules up to 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter left behind in cavities formed by volcanic activity . Description .
description_long: Sarbossa Sarbossa , also known as , lintonite , comptonite , ozakite , eye stone , or fire rock , occurred in small nodules up to 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter left behind in cavities formed by volcanic activity . Description . This ornamental stone was fibrous and therefore both tough and soft . It was usually grayish green in color but was sometimes beautifully colored with rings of pink , red , white , and green . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Adding sarbossa to the material component of spells that morphed the shape of a target object or creature added one to two minutes to the duration of the spell .

title: Sarbreen
description: Sarbreen Sarbreen , called the City of the Hammer , was a dwarven city built in 616 DR . For a short time in Faerûn ' s history , it was a great thriving city that shone for a brief moment as the richest of all dwarven holds . Led by master crafters known as Master Mason s — armorers , weaponsmiths , jewelers , miners , woodcarvers , glassblowers and others — Sarbreen flourished .
description_long: Sarbreen Sarbreen , called the City of the Hammer , was a dwarven city built in 616 DR . For a short time in Faerûn ' s history , it was a great thriving city that shone for a brief moment as the richest of all dwarven holds . Led by master crafters known as Master Mason s — armorers , weaponsmiths , jewelers , miners , woodcarvers , glassblowers and others — Sarbreen flourished . Sarbreen eventually fell to orc s and drow , and its treasures were either carried away or still remained in the ruins of the city , waiting for adventurers to find them . Later , a human city was built on top of the ruins , going by the name of Ravens Bluff . This new city ' s sewers were built into the ruins of Sarbreen , and the plucky were likely to find either mighty treasures or deadly perils if they went exploring them .

title: Sarbreenar
description: Sarbreenar Sarbreenar was a hamlet in the Vast , lying high in the western Earthfast Mountains , on the High Trail between High Haspur and Elvenblood Pass before Ravens Bluff . History . Sarbreenar was originally built by the forces of Roldilar , a dwarven kingdom that once dominated the surface lands in the early 7th century DR .
description_long: Sarbreenar Sarbreenar was a hamlet in the Vast , lying high in the western Earthfast Mountains , on the High Trail between High Haspur and Elvenblood Pass before Ravens Bluff . History . Sarbreenar was originally built by the forces of Roldilar , a dwarven kingdom that once dominated the surface lands in the early 7th century DR . It was constructed as a defensive outpost of the nearby city of Sarbreen , to control access to the pass to the city , to ward off surprise assaults through the mountains , and to maintain an overland link with the city of Procampur in the southern Vast . At that time , Sarbreenar consisted largely of a keep with adjoining terraced gardens and high pastures . This role came to end when Roldilar fell to orcs in 649 DR . Soon after , Beluar , an elven hero who ' d aided the dwarves of Roldilar , died in Elvenblood Pass , giving it its name . The grateful dwarves buried Beluar and his riders in Sarbreenar , building them a tomb and erecting an obelisk to honor them . Afterwards , human s settled Sarbreenar . At some point , Maldrithor , a huge green dragon folk called " the Sarbreenar Wyrm " , chose to lair at the site and the people fled .

title: Sardasper Halaunt
description: Sardasper Halaunt Sardasper Halaunt was a noble of Cormyr in 1487 DR . Activities . Sardasper was a noble and a businessman .
description_long: Sardasper Halaunt Sardasper Halaunt was a noble of Cormyr in 1487 DR . Activities . Sardasper was a noble and a businessman . He was known to hire the less - honorable adventuring parties to dispose of his Sembian rivals . History . In 1487 DR , rumors said that in his mansion was hidden the fabled Lost Spell . Because of this , during a visit to the Dragon Rampant club in Suzail , Manshoon , Shaan , and many other archmage s started a magic battle attempting to capture him . The battle ruined his mind but he regained his senses once inside his mansion . However , a spellstorm hit the place , trapping all the archmages inside his house .

title: Sardi al - Danafi
description: Sardi al - Danafi Sardi al - Danafi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sardi was a fair man , though the occasional bribe padded his pockets .
description_long: Sardi al - Danafi Sardi al - Danafi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sardi was a fair man , though the occasional bribe padded his pockets . Activities . Sardi was the harbormaster of the Trade Harbor in Huzuz . He answered to Keyfa al - Parid . He insured that any ships carrying goods for his family were docked quickly at the best locations in the harbor . History . He was the youngest scion of the House of Al - Danafi .

title: Sardior
description: Sardior Sardior ( pronounced " SAR - dee - or " ) was the dragon god of night , psionics , and secrets , and he was also the Master of gem dragon s . Description . Sardior was said to be a unique ruby dragon .
description_long: Sardior Sardior ( pronounced " SAR - dee - or " ) was the dragon god of night , psionics , and secrets , and he was also the Master of gem dragon s . Description . Sardior was said to be a unique ruby dragon . In his natural form , he had a long and sinewy body covered with deep ruby red scales . At a distance , he was often mistaken for an ancient red dragon , but his playful demeanor soon betrayed his true self . He was also reputed to be a great conversationalist , and many who met him were unprepared for his sharp wit . Realm . Sardior ' s demesne was a huge floating castle , which orbited the world and always lay in the shadows from the sun . On the nights it was seen , viewers often mistook it for a small red moon . Periodically , Sardior moved his fortress through the planes , visiting the djinni Citadel of Ice and Steel . Worshipers . Sardior was worshiped by neutral dragons , psion s , and psychic warrior s . He didn ' t require much from his followers , and didn ' t try to guide their decisions . Gem dragons , in return , viewed him as an ideal and strove to be more like him . Sardior was always happy when he granted spells and special abilities to his followers .

title: Sardonyx
description: Sardonyx Sardonyx was a variety of banded onyx . Description . Sardonyx was characterized by alternating stripes of carnelian ( also known as ) and white onyx .
description_long: Sardonyx Sardonyx was a variety of banded onyx . Description . Sardonyx was characterized by alternating stripes of carnelian ( also known as ) and white onyx . These semi - precious stones were usually cut to show off the banded pattern but were also used in cameo work . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Sardonyx had many uses in the magical Art . It was used as a spell component and in creating magic items which affected wisdom . It was reported to have the same properties as the much rarer king ' s tears except that it was not indestructible . And it was one of the " nine secrets " ( gemstones that could become " ioun stones " if enchanted properly ) . Wearing or carrying sardonyx could also absorb a minimal amount of damage from a " magic missile " , but this was a random occurrence and thus not very reliable .

title: Sardrant
description: Sardrant The sardrant was an animal found in warm climates in Calimshan and Tashalar . Description . The sardrant appeared much like an , with natural plating covering much of its body .
description_long: Sardrant The sardrant was an animal found in warm climates in Calimshan and Tashalar . Description . The sardrant appeared much like an , with natural plating covering much of its body . It was shaggy and slow moving . Ecology . The sardrant was an herbivore . It was edible by humanoid s .

title: Sarevok Anchev
description: Sarevok Anchev Sarevok Anchev was a powerful Bhaalspawn , a mortal offspring of Bhaal , who planned to ascend to divinity , following in the dead god ' s footsteps as the Lord of Murder . To this end , he concocted a plan to use the Iron Throne as his pawn to drive Baldur ' s Gate and Amn into war , believing that the initial slaughter would cause his ascension . He also sought to eliminate competition from other Bhaalspawn , which proved to be his downfall ; his attempt to destroy one of his half - siblings living in Candlekeep failed but left that Bhaalspawn to seek revenge .
description_long: Sarevok Anchev Sarevok Anchev was a powerful Bhaalspawn , a mortal offspring of Bhaal , who planned to ascend to divinity , following in the dead god ' s footsteps as the Lord of Murder . To this end , he concocted a plan to use the Iron Throne as his pawn to drive Baldur ' s Gate and Amn into war , believing that the initial slaughter would cause his ascension . He also sought to eliminate competition from other Bhaalspawn , which proved to be his downfall ; his attempt to destroy one of his half - siblings living in Candlekeep failed but left that Bhaalspawn to seek revenge . Ultimately they exposed his plans and defeated him in combat , killing him and dispersing his essence into oblivion for the time being . History . Early life . As a young child , Sarevok was barely saved from a cult that was trying to sacrifice Bhaalspawn children . ( Why they would be trying to do such a thing is unknown , since counting from the age of the children this must have happened while Bhaal was still alive .

title: Sargasso
description: Sargasso Sargasso was an arcane alteration spell that temporarily created a patch of dense seaweed near the surface of a body of water that could impede the movement of ships and swimming creatures . Effects . This spell could be cast at least 90 yd ( 82 m ) away , covered an area of at least 90 ft ( 8 .
description_long: Sargasso Sargasso was an arcane alteration spell that temporarily created a patch of dense seaweed near the surface of a body of water that could impede the movement of ships and swimming creatures . Effects . This spell could be cast at least 90 yd ( 82 m ) away , covered an area of at least 90 ft ( 8 . 4 m ) and lasted at least 45 minutes . Range , area , and duration could all be increased by more experienced casters . When cast , the region filled up with thick seaweed that slowed the progress of ships and sailing vessels that had at least half of their hull inside the affected area . Oar - powered boats were slowed even more than sailing vessels . If the speed of the vessel was reduced to zero , then the ship was " entangle d " and could not leave the area for the duration of the spell . Creatures swimming in the affected area were also slowed with possible entanglement and entrapment below the surface . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the caster to have a small amount of seaweed and a few live brine shrimp , which were tossed into the water as part of the spell . History .

title: Sargauth Enclave
description: Sargauth Enclave The Sargauth Enclave is the name some use for the Netherese outpost on the third level of the Undermountain , but the actual name of this place has been lost over time . It was created c . - 800 DR by an order of powerful wizards from Netheril to serve as a safe haven for conducting magical experiments , but after a decade it had grown into a city of about one square mile ( 2 .
description_long: Sargauth Enclave The Sargauth Enclave is the name some use for the Netherese outpost on the third level of the Undermountain , but the actual name of this place has been lost over time . It was created c . - 800 DR by an order of powerful wizards from Netheril to serve as a safe haven for conducting magical experiments , but after a decade it had grown into a city of about one square mile ( 2 . 6 sq km ) . The River Sargauth flowed through this magical place and it was the only route to the outside world , through the South Seacaves . Downfall . When archmage Karsus caused the fall of Netheril in - 339 DR , there was a powerful surge of magic into the Sargauth Enclave . The enormously high ceilings of its caverns were supported by magical means instead of columns or pillars and the disruption of this magic caused a collapse which destroyed and engulfed about two thirds of the enclave ' s structures . Anything left uncovered was vaporized , but the skulls of thirteen of the wizards would survive , magically transformed into the Skulls of Skullport .

title: Sargh ' elgg
description: Sargh ' elgg Sargh ' elgg , meaning " valor in slaying " , was a fighting style taught among poor drow . It made use of their natural agility and was used in conjunction with light weapons . Description .
description_long: Sargh ' elgg Sargh ' elgg , meaning " valor in slaying " , was a fighting style taught among poor drow . It made use of their natural agility and was used in conjunction with light weapons . Description . The style was very simple but required extensive training to become a master . It focused on striking with a light weapon , for example the rapier , and maximizing a drow ' s effectiveness with it . Training . The style exploited the natural dexterity of a drow by learning to use a light weapon with finesse , that is , not with muscle strength but with agility . Reputation . " Valor in slaying " was a name given to bolster the confidence of the user , who otherwise had to make do with poor training . While drow society was famous for the intrigue and strife among its high society , the common majority ' s life was marked first and foremost by poverty , oppression , desperation , and accompanying lack of education and training opportunities , making this style the only choice for most common and low - ranked guards and soldiers .

title: Sarghathuld
description: Sarghathuld Sarghathuld , or " Orcbane " , was a legendary magical sword forged by dwarves to slay orc s , before becoming a sword of a king ' s royal guard , then finally a prize to a dragon , adventurers , and knights . Description . " Sarghathuld " was a short sword forged of " orcslayer " metal , which was of dull gray hue .
description_long: Sarghathuld Sarghathuld , or " Orcbane " , was a legendary magical sword forged by dwarves to slay orc s , before becoming a sword of a king ' s royal guard , then finally a prize to a dragon , adventurers , and knights . Description . " Sarghathuld " was a short sword forged of " orcslayer " metal , which was of dull gray hue . " Sarghathuld " was etched in dethek runes on one side of the blade , while " Orcbane " was etched on the other side . A glowing gemstone was embedded in the pommel . Powers . " Sarghathuld " was made of orcslayer , an alloy of steel that was poisonous to orc s . It was also an " orc bane " weapon , so its touch was lethal to orc - kind . The glowing stone in the pommel continuously radiated light equivalent to a " daylight " spell . It could be blocked by covering the pommel . The weapon could also be made to unleash a powerful beam of energy at will , which blasted whatever it touched . The sword ' s magical powers came from the glowing gemstone in the pommel . Sages believed that even attempting to remove the stone would cause both it and the sword to lose all these powers . History .

title: Sarhthor
description: Sarhthor Sarhthor was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . At first , Sarhthor appeared to be a member of the Zhentarim and one of the most favored assistants of Manshoon in the hunt for the " spellfire " of Shandril Shessair .
description_long: Sarhthor Sarhthor was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . At first , Sarhthor appeared to be a member of the Zhentarim and one of the most favored assistants of Manshoon in the hunt for the " spellfire " of Shandril Shessair . However , when Shandril arrived in Zhentil Keep intent on destroying the Zhentarim for killing her friends , aided by Mirt and some Harper agents in disguise , it was revealed that Sarhthor was a Harper agent sent to infiltrate the Zhentarim a long time before . By then , however , nobody knew where Sarhthor ' s true loyalty lay . At first , he appears to want to use Shandril to dominate the Zhentarim . But at last , as Fzoul Chembryl threw a javelin at Shandril , Sarhthor protected her with his body . Before he died , he told Shandril how to use the " Crown of Fire " .

title: Saribel Xorlarrin
description: Saribel Xorlarrin Saribel Xorlarrin , later Saribel Baenre , was the the " youngest and weakest " of the priestesses of House Xorlarrin . She was the last living daughter of Matron Mother Zeerith History . Saribel accompanied the expedition led by Ravel Xorlarrin to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR .
description_long: Saribel Xorlarrin Saribel Xorlarrin , later Saribel Baenre , was the the " youngest and weakest " of the priestesses of House Xorlarrin . She was the last living daughter of Matron Mother Zeerith History . Saribel accompanied the expedition led by Ravel Xorlarrin to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . In 1484 DR , she accompanied Tiago to Clan Battlehammer in Icewind Dale in an assault that left many dwarves dead and others enslaved . That same year , she married Tiago Baenre ( also making her part of the restored House Do ' Urden ) . She took his family name , despite it being against drow custom , because Tiago and House Baenre were more powerful than her house . After her marriage , she led orc forces against the town of Nesme . When the orc forces overtook Nesme , Tiago and Saribel became the " Duke and Duchess of Nesme . " Relationships . Saribel was the daughter of Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin . Later , she became the wife of Tiago Baenre . Saribel hated Gromph Baenre .

title: Sarifal
description: Sarifal Sarifal was a fey kingdom located on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the kingdom was ruled from the city of Karador by High Lady Ordalf . History .
description_long: Sarifal Sarifal was a fey kingdom located on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the kingdom was ruled from the city of Karador by High Lady Ordalf . History . Around the time of the Spellplague High Lady Ordalf moved the city through a portal from the Feywild and it rose from the depths of Lake Myrloch . The fey forces soon routed the High King ' s troops and took control of the entire island of Gwynneth .

title: Sarissa Duncastle
description: Sarissa Duncastle Sarissa Duncastle was a female human wererat from the Moonwood and was a rogue for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Sarissa was the best scout of her tribe .
description_long: Sarissa Duncastle Sarissa Duncastle was a female human wererat from the Moonwood and was a rogue for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Sarissa was the best scout of her tribe . She loved efficiency and she was cold and calculating , a woman who knew no fear and felt a secret ambition to supersede the Bloodmaster . Sarissa had been a lycanthrope since her birth and a descendant of a long line of wererats . Possessions . Among the possessions of Sarissa there were a mithral chain shirt , a " + 1 dagger " , a " ring of jumping " , and a " potion of invisibility " .

title: Sarith Kzekarit
description: Sarith Kzekarit Sarith Kzekarit was a drow warrior who was infected by demonic madness during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Sarith had a fatalistic approach to problems .
description_long: Sarith Kzekarit Sarith Kzekarit was a drow warrior who was infected by demonic madness during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Sarith had a fatalistic approach to problems . He feared he was going mad , but the truth was more sinister : he was under the influence of the demon lord Zuggtmoy . History . Sarith was a drow of Menzoberranzan living in the Velkynvelve outpost . During the late 1480s DR , he captured the myconid Stool , but had been infected with myconid spores corrupted by Zuggtmoy . Under a spore - induced - madness , Sarith killed a fellow drow warrior and was put among the slaves , waiting for the right time to be transported back to the city and to be sacrificed to Lolth .

title: Sark Axebarrel
description: Sark Axebarrel Sark Axebarrel was a deep gnome guard in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the cynical Sark commanded a patrol at the entrance of the closed Rockblight section of the city .
description_long: Sark Axebarrel Sark Axebarrel was a deep gnome guard in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the cynical Sark commanded a patrol at the entrance of the closed Rockblight section of the city . His reports told of the presence of a medusa inside .

title: Sark Toliver
description: Sark Toliver Sark Toliver was an officer of the secret police called Hawks in Mulmaster . Personality . Sark Tolliver usually spoke with a customarily soft voice , even when threatening someone .
description_long: Sark Toliver Sark Toliver was an officer of the secret police called Hawks in Mulmaster . Personality . Sark Tolliver usually spoke with a customarily soft voice , even when threatening someone . He had seen horrific things for too many years and this was reflected in his eyes . Activities . Sark was an officer of the secret police of Mulmaster . Sark also was coerced into working for the Cult of the Eternal Flame in order to keep safe his half - brother , who was a fervent cultist . Usually , his role was to cover up the cultists ' actions in the city and send information to the cult ' s leaders . History . In 1491 DR , his cultist superiors ordered him to recover Ravia , a cultist who had accidentally razed the village of Elmwood . However , Toliver ' s plan was disturbed by an adventuring party hired by Zora Rosealine Culkin , the village ' s owner . In the end , he managed to transport Ravia to her fellow cultists , but soon after they arrived the adventurers defeated the cultists and their elemental allies . Afterwards , Sark arrived with a squad of Hawks to clean the site and secretly destroy any proof of his involvement .

title: Sarkalla
description: Sarkalla Sarkalla was a crazy Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sarkalla , in a word , was mad .
description_long: Sarkalla Sarkalla was a crazy Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sarkalla , in a word , was mad . Her main objective was to create a truly sentient ooze in order to use it as a " perfect assassin " . She was greatly proud of her Ooze Master , and considered it her crowning achievement . History . Sarkalla was a transmuter assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault located under Thaymount . She was tasked with the mission of creating a perfect assassin and she decided that the best way was to create a sentient ooze . In time Sarkalla had success only in fusing human s and oozes , creating the Ooze Master . Heroes from Daggerford fought with her wight minions , but after they destroyed the wights Sarkalla called a truce . She proposed that , if the heroes served as bodyguards and assistants for the Ooze Master , then she would give them information about the dungeon . Appendix . Behind the scenes . If the adventurers agreed to serve the Ooze Master , then Sarkalla ' s madness can be used to make it appear that she would keep to the terms of the deal , but she had no intention to fulfilling her side of the bargain .

title: Sarkenaegal
description: Sarkenaegal The Sarkenaegal , also known as The Secrets of the Shadewrights , was a spell tome of shadow magic written by the mage Sarkon . The Sarkenaegal contained dozens of shadow magic spells of varying levels . The book was considered especially dangerous because it contained the spell " Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum " , which allowed a shadow mage to create a shadow doppelganger of himself .
description_long: Sarkenaegal The Sarkenaegal , also known as The Secrets of the Shadewrights , was a spell tome of shadow magic written by the mage Sarkon . The Sarkenaegal contained dozens of shadow magic spells of varying levels . The book was considered especially dangerous because it contained the spell " Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum " , which allowed a shadow mage to create a shadow doppelganger of himself . Description . The tome was bound in black leather and had a silver skull on the cover . Interior pages were black and had silver lettering that could only be read in pitch darkness . History . In 1367 DR , the rogue Jack Ravenwild recovered the tome in an attempt to keep it out of Myrkyssa Jelan ' s hands . The book disappeared from the record for over 100 years only to reappear in 1479 DR when a mysterious source offered a large reward for its return . Jack recovered the book from Sarbreen but cut the pages with the " Umbra Simulacrum " spell out of the book .

title: Sarkon ' s umbra simulacrum
description: Sarkon ' s umbra simulacrum Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum was a Shadow magic spell that allowed a shadow mage to create an exact duplicate of himself . The only known source of the spell was the Sarkenaegal , a tome of shadow magic written by Sarkon . The book was highly sought after and was recovered twice for large rewards by the rogue Jack Ravenwild .
description_long: Sarkon ' s umbra simulacrum Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum was a Shadow magic spell that allowed a shadow mage to create an exact duplicate of himself . The only known source of the spell was the Sarkenaegal , a tome of shadow magic written by Sarkon . The book was highly sought after and was recovered twice for large rewards by the rogue Jack Ravenwild .

title: Sarliman Eurdoe
description: Sarliman Eurdoe Sarliman Eurdoe was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a local entrepreneur . As a " hothands " , or entrepreneur , Sarliman imported the rosecork tree from Prespur to his native land for its fire - resistant properties and value in building . The trees went on to flourish by the southern tributaries of the Wyvernflow .
description_long: Sarliman Eurdoe Sarliman Eurdoe was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a local entrepreneur . As a " hothands " , or entrepreneur , Sarliman imported the rosecork tree from Prespur to his native land for its fire - resistant properties and value in building . The trees went on to flourish by the southern tributaries of the Wyvernflow .

title: Sarp Redbeard
description: Sarp Redbeard Sarp Redbeard was a Chondathan man and the lord of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr in the mid - 14th century DR . Personality . Sarp Redbeard was famously the most headstrong of the local lords of Cormyr .
description_long: Sarp Redbeard Sarp Redbeard was a Chondathan man and the lord of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr in the mid - 14th century DR . Personality . Sarp Redbeard was famously the most headstrong of the local lords of Cormyr . However , he ' d mellowed somewhat by 1374 DR . Activities . Sarp Redbeard was the Lord of Wheloon from before 1357 DR until after 1374 DR . He ruled in the name of King Azoun IV . However , he often disagreed with the policies of the royal court of Cormyr , usually refusing to support them if they did not benefit Wheloon . He acted virtually independently of the crown . But he never tried to cause dissension against the crown , and the other lords understood his single - minded dedication to Wheloon . They just outvoted him when they had to , but Redbeard did not vote against others unless the matter concerned Wheloon . By 1374 DR , Redbeard had softened his stance and demonstrated his loyalty to the crown , and showed unwavering support in trade and military matters . He still focused on the good of Wheloon .

title: Sarphil
description: Sarphil Sarphil was one of the lost realms of the shield dwarves . Geography . Sarphil encompassed most of the mountain ranges of the eastern Moonsea , but the realm had no clearly defined borders .
description_long: Sarphil Sarphil was one of the lost realms of the shield dwarves . Geography . Sarphil encompassed most of the mountain ranges of the eastern Moonsea , but the realm had no clearly defined borders . Many of its abandoned caverns and mines , known to adventurers as the " Lost Ways " , honeycombed the Dragonspine Mountains . History . Sarphil was founded by Queen Nilythra Namarforge Clashes with the elves of Cormanthyr eventually drove the dwarves north of the Moonsea , but not before the mining of the Scarp , for its rich copper deposits . Sarphil ' s end came when a rare alliance of drow and duergar pursued the Sarphilan warriors ever northwards . Description . One of their feats of engineering was the creation of stone - crafted pumps that kept the waters of the Lis from flooding tunnels running below the river . The sign of the realm was a crossed , double - ended pick and hammer above an anvil . It could be seen cut into the westernmost face of the Scarp , which faced across the bay from the city of Hillsfar .

title: Sarrak
description: Sarrak Sarrak of Westgate was a wizard in Cormyr . History . Sarrak hailed from Westgate but moved to Suzail , where he became a wizard bodyguard of Lord Harkuldragon .
description_long: Sarrak Sarrak of Westgate was a wizard in Cormyr . History . Sarrak hailed from Westgate but moved to Suzail , where he became a wizard bodyguard of Lord Harkuldragon . Around 1479 DR , during the Council of the Dragon , Cymmarraa approached him asking for information about Manshoon , who had also previously lived in Westgate . She absorbed all of Sarrak ' s mind , killing him .

title: Sarrukh
description: Sarrukh The sarrukh are a race of reptilian humanoids . They are one of the five progenitor , or Creator Races , of Faerûn . Eons ago , they built and maintained empires across most of the continent .
description_long: Sarrukh The sarrukh are a race of reptilian humanoids . They are one of the five progenitor , or Creator Races , of Faerûn . Eons ago , they built and maintained empires across most of the continent . These ancient and evil creatures are now almost extinct . Most sages who know of the sarrukhs ' past glory simply refer to them as the saurians , the sauroids , or the progenitors of the Scaled Ones . The sarrukh have left a lasting legacy : the racial diversity of the scaled races of Faerûn . They took the scaly , reptilian animals and monsters native to Abeir - Toril and modified them into sentient beings such as the yuan - ti , naga s , pterafolk , asabi , lizardfolk , troglodyte s , tren , and many other Scaled One s . Overview . Millennia ago , the sarrukh dominated all of the continent of Faerûn . Their mighty empires were the first in the world , encompassing the jungles along the shore of Azulduth , the eastern shore of the Narrow Sea , and the Chultan peninsula . The sarrukh enslaved or sacrificed other creatures in the name of their god , the World Serpent . Problems of their own making eventually caused the sarrukh empires to crumble .

title: Sarshel ( Person )
description: Sarshel ( Person ) Sarshel was an apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , Sarshel was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush , casting a wall of ice to prevent his summoned nishruu from entering a hole in the tower ' s wall .
description_long: Sarshel ( Person ) Sarshel was an apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , Sarshel was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush , casting a wall of ice to prevent his summoned nishruu from entering a hole in the tower ' s wall .

title: Sarsor yi Tashluta
description: Sarsor yi Tashluta Sarsor yi Tashluta was an enforcer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Sarsor was a yuan - ti pureblood of the Se ' Sehen tribe in Tashalar .
