description_long: Sarsor yi Tashluta Sarsor yi Tashluta was an enforcer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Sarsor was a yuan - ti pureblood of the Se ' Sehen tribe in Tashalar . With the support of the Grand Yrshelem , who knew his true heritage , he infiltrated the Rundeen under the alias of a contortionist from Tashluta . He used his racial abilities to twist his body in order to grapple the people he was ordered to punish , which gave him the nickname the Rope .

title: Sartani
description: Sartani Sartani were monstrous creatures that were a combination of giant and crab . Description . These creatures had the legs and torso of a giant humanoid , but their head and claws were those of a crab .
description_long: Sartani Sartani were monstrous creatures that were a combination of giant and crab . Description . These creatures had the legs and torso of a giant humanoid , but their head and claws were those of a crab . A hard carapace shielded their chest , back , and shoulders , gradually blending into regular flesh . Their coloring ranged from dull red to greasy blue . Sartani never wore clothing . Combat . Once committed to battle , sartani came straight for their enemy . Because of this , they could be lured into fighting one target while ranged combatants struck them from their flanks . Their clawed hands were formidable weapons in combat . Any enemies clasped by one of their claws met a gruesome end . Sartani were immune to all water - based attacks and their hardened shells offered additional protection from fire . They were particularly vulnerable to cold . Habitat / Society . Sartani were rare . So much so that many bestiaries had no record of their existence . Their origins remained widely disputed . Sartani communicated with each other by clacking their mandibles together if they were above water . While under water they would make similar sounds with rocks or shells .

title: Sarth
description: Sarth Sarth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a .
description_long: Sarth Sarth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a . shadowmaster ) at large in Toril as of the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . As a shapeshifter , Sarth could appear as any living thing , but usually appeared as male . When not disguised as human , his preferred shape was that of a tso ( a spidery monster with the head of an eel , native to the Outlands ) . He also took the form of a crocodile on occasion . While wandering the Sword Coast , he disguised himself as a poor and confused priest of Talona . Personality . Sarth was a cautious and prudent malaugrym , intent on becoming a great wizard . Possessions . Sarth had magic items and other loot stashed in various hiding places throughout Faerûn . Activities . Sarth repeatedly traveled from the Plane of Shadow to Faerûn , took up apprenticeship with a wizard willing to teach , learned all he could , and then killed his tutor and stole his or her magic items , books , portable equipment and pocket - able wealth . After hiding his loot in various caches across the land , he retreated back home until he felt safe for another foray .

title: Sarth Khul Riizar
description: Sarth Khul Riizar Sarth Khul Riizar is a powerful tiefling sorcerer and is the Master Mage of Hulburg . He is close friends with Geran Hulmaster and has saved Geran ' s life on numerous occasions . Sarth is several generations removed from his fiendish ancestors .
description_long: Sarth Khul Riizar Sarth Khul Riizar is a powerful tiefling sorcerer and is the Master Mage of Hulburg . He is close friends with Geran Hulmaster and has saved Geran ' s life on numerous occasions . Sarth is several generations removed from his fiendish ancestors . Appearance . Sarth has horns on his head and brick red skin .

title: Sarula Iliene
description: Sarula Iliene Sarula Iliene was a lesser water - based nature deity who attached herself to the Seldarine . History . When the first primitive elves left Faerie in the time before the Seldarine existed , they served the fey and worshiped their gods .
description_long: Sarula Iliene Sarula Iliene was a lesser water - based nature deity who attached herself to the Seldarine . History . When the first primitive elves left Faerie in the time before the Seldarine existed , they served the fey and worshiped their gods . After the Seldarine began to lead the tel ' quessir on Toril , Sarula Iliene , the patron godess of nixie s , began to foster an alliance with Rillifane Rallathil . The two saw each other as father and daughter and , possibly to strengthen this paternal bond , Sarula attempted and succeeded in leaving the Seelie Court and joining the Seldarine . She erected a glass and marble palace on the bottom of the lake known as The Brythanion on Arvandor where she collected the rains of Aerdrie Faenya and caused them to flow into the realm of Deep Sashelas . This caused her to grow closer to the elven sea god but his lover Trishina made sure that their relationship never grew any stronger than amicable . Relationships . Sarula has a close bond with Deep Sashelas but she is much closer to Rilifane . She also maintains an alliance with Eldath but is not nearly as pacifistic as the goddess of calm water .

title: Sarya Dlardrageth
description: Sarya Dlardrageth Countess Sarya Dlardrageth was a half sun elf , half - fiend sorceress , leader of the daemonfey and a princess of House Dlardrageth . She was over five thousand years old as of 1374 DR . Description .
description_long: Sarya Dlardrageth Countess Sarya Dlardrageth was a half sun elf , half - fiend sorceress , leader of the daemonfey and a princess of House Dlardrageth . She was over five thousand years old as of 1374 DR . Description . Sarya had deep red skin and bright orange and gold hair . She preferred to wear her magically protective black robes embroidered with gold . She had a seductive beauty and classic elven features . She was short and girlish . Her gold eyes burned like bright coals , and she had large , bat - like wings emerging from her back . Viewed through the shimmering effect of her heat aura , Sarya ' s long hair seemed to flow as if it were a mane of flames . Her pointed ears looked like regular elf ears , though close inspection revealed a slight scalloped edge to them . Personality . The Cambion Countess was aloof , unforgiving , and totally without remorse . While her abilities made her a formidable foe , she preferred to have her son and nephew sully their hands in combat while she remained the planner behind the scenes . She had nothing but disdain for non elves and utter hatred for most elves .

title: Sarya el Thamal
description: Sarya el Thamal Sarya yr Kadila yr Pesarkhal el Thamal was the granddaughter of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal of Calimshan through his daughter Kadila el Pesarkhal . She was born in 1370 DR . When el Pesarkhal heard the news of the birth of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III ' s triplets two months prior , el Pesarkhal proposed a marriage between his new granddaughter and their son , Prince Coram Rhindaun : The results of this proposal are not recorded in history .
description_long: Sarya el Thamal Sarya yr Kadila yr Pesarkhal el Thamal was the granddaughter of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal of Calimshan through his daughter Kadila el Pesarkhal . She was born in 1370 DR . When el Pesarkhal heard the news of the birth of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III ' s triplets two months prior , el Pesarkhal proposed a marriage between his new granddaughter and their son , Prince Coram Rhindaun : The results of this proposal are not recorded in history .

title: Sash of fire resistance
description: Sash of fire resistance Sashes of fire resistance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items often appeared as red silk sashes with extravagant platinum thread brocade .
description_long: Sash of fire resistance Sashes of fire resistance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items often appeared as red silk sashes with extravagant platinum thread brocade . These sashes could not be worn over armor heavier than leather . Powers . The wearer of this sash was completely immune to normal fire as well as fire - based warding spells such as " wall of fire " or " fire trap " . Additionally , the wearer ignored half of the damaging effects from offensive spells such as " fireball " . Owners . These items were specially crafted by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Ranking members of the Brotherhood were awarded them as gifts .

title: Sash of heat endurance
description: Sash of heat endurance Sashes of heat endurance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items were red silk sashes , brocaded with gold thread depicting writhing flames .
description_long: Sash of heat endurance Sashes of heat endurance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items were red silk sashes , brocaded with gold thread depicting writhing flames . These sashes could not be worn over armor heavier than leather . Powers . These sashes protected the wearer from normal fires that were smaller than a lamp flame . The wearer could also easily endure air temperatures of up to 130 °F ( 54 °C ) comfortably . Wearers did not suffer from dehydration while wearing the sash . Owners . These items were specially crafted by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Lower - ranking members of the Brotherhood were awarded them as gifts .

title: Sashen
description: Sashen Sashen was a Zhentarim wizard and apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Sashen was the junior - most of the Ashemmi ' s pupils and had few ambitions .
description_long: Sashen Sashen was a Zhentarim wizard and apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Sashen was the junior - most of the Ashemmi ' s pupils and had few ambitions . He usually wandered the of dungeons of Faerûn with his bodyguards , searching for ancient knowledge . Personality . Sashen was a cautious and silent individual . His primary interest was researching ancient magic and hidden lore and Sashen believed being in the Zhentarim was a good opportunity for him to do this . He had no interest in the intrigues and political plots of the Zhentarim .

title: Sashesh
description: Sashesh Lady Sashesh was the rappresentative of Sembia in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Sashesh was a merchant and trade liaison that was the principal agent of a cabal of wealthy merchants that wanted made Scardale part of Sembia .
description_long: Sashesh Lady Sashesh was the rappresentative of Sembia in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Sashesh was a merchant and trade liaison that was the principal agent of a cabal of wealthy merchants that wanted made Scardale part of Sembia . She worked to this goal dominating trade and with occasional brides .

title: Satama
description: Satama Satama was a trader and later a wise man in Durpar . He founded the cult of Adama . Satama developed the concept that everything in the world was interconnected , including the deities , making them all part of the same thing .
description_long: Satama Satama was a trader and later a wise man in Durpar . He founded the cult of Adama . Satama developed the concept that everything in the world was interconnected , including the deities , making them all part of the same thing . His ideas spread quickly throughout the region .

title: Satarin
description: Satarin Brother Satarin was a dwarf priest in Helm ' s Hold near Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Satarin took care of the crazed inmates of the Cathedral .
description_long: Satarin Brother Satarin was a dwarf priest in Helm ' s Hold near Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Satarin took care of the crazed inmates of the Cathedral . History . In 1479 DR , he noted that the madness that had spread in Neverwinter on the Night of the Madness had transferred to Helm ' s Hold . So he sent a letter to an adventuring party that had come to be involved in the matter . Soon after , however , Helm ' s Hold fell under the control of the Tormentor and his mind - thrall minions . Personality . His long exposure to crazed people had slightly confused Satarin .

title: Satcheera Moonfist
description: Satcheera Moonfist Satcheera " Silvereyes " Moonfist was a female bard and a member of the Turning Key adventuring company . History . Like the rest of the Turning Key , Satcheera lived at the House of the Key in Tavilar in the Vast .
description_long: Satcheera Moonfist Satcheera " Silvereyes " Moonfist was a female bard and a member of the Turning Key adventuring company . History . Like the rest of the Turning Key , Satcheera lived at the House of the Key in Tavilar in the Vast . Satcheera and the ladies of the Turning Key went adventuring on some far plane but suffered disaster , losing several of their number . Satcheera was one of the few survivors . After that , Satcheera and the others chose to retire , but rather than return together to the House of the Key where they ' d been happy together , they went their separate ways , to Berdusk , Neverwinter and Waterdeep . They never returned to Tavilar . Hearing that adventurers began poked through the ruins of the House of the Key searching for treasure and turning up nothing , Satcheera remarked " Still haven ’ t found our jewels ? They must be looking in far too dry a place ! " Growing elderly , she was the last survivor of the Turning Key , and passed away some time before 1370 DR .

title: Sathariel
description: Sathariel Sathariel was a dark angel in the service of the evil deity Asmodeus . His exact nature is unknown and , although he was described as a dark angel , he may in fact have been a devil . Alternatively , he could have been a fallen angel .
description_long: Sathariel Sathariel was a dark angel in the service of the evil deity Asmodeus . His exact nature is unknown and , although he was described as a dark angel , he may in fact have been a devil . Alternatively , he could have been a fallen angel . Description . Sathariel had black feathers on his wings and his body was shrouded in darkness . Possessions . He had silver armor and wielded a silver sword . History . Sathariel lived in Waterdeep and oversaw the operations of the Vigilent Order . In 1480 DR , he attempted to complete the ritual of the First Flensing , a spell that would have opened a gate to the Prime Material Plane for Asmodeus ' use . He was slain by the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn in 1480 .

title: Satin spar
description: Satin spar Satin spar , also known as feather gypsum , was a variety of that had a sparkling sheen . It was mainly used in carvings . Description .
description_long: Satin spar Satin spar , also known as feather gypsum , was a variety of that had a sparkling sheen . It was mainly used in carvings . Description . This ornamental stone was too soft for jewelry but accepted a good polish . Satin spar was naturally white , pink , pale orange , or pale brown , but could be dyed to almost any solid hue ( this process ruined its sparkle , however ) . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . These stones could partially protect against " magic missile s " if worn , carried or touched at the time of missile impact . One satin spar could absorb one half the damage of one " magic missile " , vaporizing in the process .

title: Sato Kitashi
description: Sato Kitashi Sato Kitashi was a female samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi born from Sato Mikio , the shugo - daimyo of the Hoichi Province .
description_long: Sato Kitashi Sato Kitashi was a female samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi born from Sato Mikio , the shugo - daimyo of the Hoichi Province . In youth Kitashi was an active adventurer and during this time she befriend the li lung dragons of the nearby mountains . The dragons proved to be powerful allies in the struggle that oppose the Sato clan , supporter of the shikken Takenaka Okawa , to the sohei army of Namikami Temple in Yokozu Province , supporter of Hojo Kawakubo .

title: Sato Masako
description: Sato Masako Sato Masako was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Tosa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Sato went to a small village led by Gobo to stop some bandit sohei in answer to a letter sent by Gobo .
description_long: Sato Masako Sato Masako was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Tosa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Sato went to a small village led by Gobo to stop some bandit sohei in answer to a letter sent by Gobo . As he arrived , however , the village was raided and Gobo killed . Sato gave help to the villagers and hired some adventurers who happened to be there to find these raiders and report to him in Tosa . Activities . In Tosa he led a company of three samurai and twelve bushi . He was busy trying to stop a group of Tengu living in nearby hills that played pranks to him for his fatness

title: Satomi
description: Satomi Satomi was a noble in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . She hate Benju for took away her loved daughter .
description_long: Satomi Satomi was a noble in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . She hate Benju for took away her loved daughter . In time her love of the daughter twisted in a desire for control and domination . Activities . Satomi was known as Lady Lotus among servants because she loved that flower and always had tiny symbols that represented stylized lotus blossoms all over everything she wear . History . Satomi born in a samurai family . In time her family decided to marry Satomi ' s daughter to Benju Matsumoto , a idea she totally opposed but with no avail . Satomi went in Aru with her daughter and entered in the court of Benju . When Benju become daimyo as shogun ' s rules Satomi ' s daughter went to Uwaji . This desisted Satomi , that started hate Benju . In time she allied with Eichiro Tanaka , acting as his spy inside the Benju ' s court .

title: Satyr
description: Satyr Satyrs , also called fauns , were fey creatures that delighted in singing , dancing , feasting , and debauchery . They appeared to be men with sylvan features from the waist up and possessed goat legs from the waist down . Personality .
description_long: Satyr Satyrs , also called fauns , were fey creatures that delighted in singing , dancing , feasting , and debauchery . They appeared to be men with sylvan features from the waist up and possessed goat legs from the waist down . Personality . Satyrs had a reputation for being rakes and smooth - talkers . They had a habit of leaving pregnancies wherever they traveled . The children from these unions were spirited away by their fathers soon after birth . Satyrs hail from the Feywild but travel to the world to sate their curiosity . Every new experience fills a satyr with a sense of wonder , and constantly seeking out the next big thing can get one into trouble . Satyrs live in small clans no more than two dozen strong , and rarely are more than one or two satyrs seen at a time . They make their homes at the bases of trees or in burrows . They love creature comforts , so they keep well - stocked larders and stores of wine and mead . Travelers who come upon satyr homes often find them empty because the owner is out exploring or at a woodland revel . Lovers of Story and Song : A satyr would say that it loves beauty above all things .

title: Saul
description: Saul Saul was a halfling in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . The halfling was an inquisitive , talkative , and knowledgeable individual .
description_long: Saul Saul was a halfling in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . The halfling was an inquisitive , talkative , and knowledgeable individual . He liked telling strangers all about Mulmaster . Relationships . Saul was a servant at Astrid Saj ' s house and hoped to enter into the city ' s Blade elite . History . In 1491 DR , he was one of the main servants at Astrid Saj ' s great party in her villa .

title: Saurglyce
description: Saurglyce Saurglyce was a female white dragon dracolich and a partner of Pox in Yartar in 1369 DR . Personality . Saurglyce had a very close bond with her humanoid partner .
description_long: Saurglyce Saurglyce was a female white dragon dracolich and a partner of Pox in Yartar in 1369 DR . Personality . Saurglyce had a very close bond with her humanoid partner . History . Saurglyce was transformed into dracolich by Pox and served the lich as her mount , partner , and confidante . One day , Pox arrived in Yartar riding Saurglyce . They then started to gather followers to establish a Cult cell in the city . In 1373 DR , after the Rage of Dragons , the drow - dragon Nurvureem aided Cult rebels to kill off Pox and Saurglyce .

title: Saurial
description: Saurial Saurials are a rare breed of Scalykind - specifically a Sauroid race descended from dinosaur - like creatures - not native to Toril . Several sub - races exist , though only four can be found on Toril itself . Unlike reptiles , Saurials are not cold - blooded .
description_long: Saurial Saurials are a rare breed of Scalykind - specifically a Sauroid race descended from dinosaur - like creatures - not native to Toril . Several sub - races exist , though only four can be found on Toril itself . Unlike reptiles , Saurials are not cold - blooded . They were brought to Toril by Moander to a place called the Lost Vale , an area hidden somewhere near the Dalelands so that they could be used as Moander ' s slaves to corrupt and destroy the plants and animals in the area in an effort to regain his previous divinity . The plan failed when Finder Wyvernspur , Dragonbait , and Alias defeated Moander , freeing the saurials from their slavery . Elminster convinced the saurials to restore what Moander had forced them to destroy and the Lost Vale was turned into a permanent settlement as a result . A second set of these creatures exist in the southern Jungles of Kara - Tur , and are known as the Lacerials . This group was introduced in the " Malatra Living Jungle " setting by the RPGA network , to go along with their " Living City " Campaign based in " Raven ' s Bluff " .

title: Saurosphinx
description: Saurosphinx Among sphinx es , saurosphinxes are the most civilized . Combat . Saurosphinxes avoid combat , but when given no other choice they try to limit an opponent ’ s ability to attack at range .
description_long: Saurosphinx Among sphinx es , saurosphinxes are the most civilized . Combat . Saurosphinxes avoid combat , but when given no other choice they try to limit an opponent ’ s ability to attack at range . They tend to make flyby attacks on opponents with long - range weapons — bow s and crossbow s , typically — and depart as soon afterward as possible . A saurosphinx forced to fight on the ground tries its best to take to the air and flee as soon as it can . Personality . Though not remarkably intelligent , they are far more interested in conversation than combat , and they sometimes travel long distances to listen to sages and scholars speak . Other , more aggressive sphinxes often see saurosphinxes as little more than educated food . Ecology . They lair in rocky hills , where they seek the shade of small caves during the day and crawl out at twilight to enjoy the waning warmth . They dislike the cold intensely , and they flee from encounters with anyone who wields cold weapons or casts cold spells .

title: Sauruki
description: Sauruki Sauruki was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Scarlet Moon Hall . Possessions . In battle , Sauruki dressed in a chain shirt and fought with quarterstaff .
description_long: Sauruki Sauruki was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Scarlet Moon Hall . Possessions . In battle , Sauruki dressed in a chain shirt and fought with quarterstaff . History . During the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR , Sauruki was sent by his masters to infiltrate the Cult of the Eternal Flame ' s camp in order to spy on their Rite of the Wicker Giant . Around this time , Sauruki joined a group of druid s known as Comnall , Murcadh , and Ragnad .

title: Sava
description: Sava Sava is a game created by the drow . Resembling chess , it involves the moving and capture of pieces that represent soldiers on a battlefield . While the gameplay itself is merely hinted at in the several books it is mentioned in , again , a chess - like game can be inferred .
description_long: Sava Sava is a game created by the drow . Resembling chess , it involves the moving and capture of pieces that represent soldiers on a battlefield . While the gameplay itself is merely hinted at in the several books it is mentioned in , again , a chess - like game can be inferred . This is the game Lolth and Eilistraee are seen playing in the Lady Penitent series , with the board representing the entire plane of existence . The Pieces . The pieces in sava are labeled Warrior , Slave , Priest ( ess ) and Mage . Certain adaptations are allowed , especially in a deity - played game . In the case of the Lolth versus Eilistraee match , specific pieces known as Champions and Mothers were put into play . The Mother piece represented each goddess specifically in these matches , and it was implied that capturing this piece not only ended the game , but the losing goddess would be slain and absorbed by the winner . In the case of Lolth , her Champion was the demi - god Selvetarm , who was later slain . Gameplay . No specific mention of " how " the game itself is played .

title: Savage Frontier
description: Savage Frontier The Savage Frontier is a region in the subcontinent of Faerûn that includes the lands north of the Delimbiyr river that are not strictly part of the High Forest , the Silver Marches , the Sword Coast or Waterdeep . It is located between the Silver Marches and the Sword Coast , where the cities of Neverwinter and Luskan lie . Contrary to its name , much of the area is really no more a savage frontier than other parts of the Realms and is quite civilized ( Ed Greenwood once compared this to similar naming for cities in the US West ) .
description_long: Savage Frontier The Savage Frontier is a region in the subcontinent of Faerûn that includes the lands north of the Delimbiyr river that are not strictly part of the High Forest , the Silver Marches , the Sword Coast or Waterdeep . It is located between the Silver Marches and the Sword Coast , where the cities of Neverwinter and Luskan lie . Contrary to its name , much of the area is really no more a savage frontier than other parts of the Realms and is quite civilized ( Ed Greenwood once compared this to similar naming for cities in the US West ) . However , broader conflicts , such as those between Luskan and Waterdeep and frequent troubles with the Zhentarim do make the area a dangerous one . Locations . Locations in the Savage Frontier include the northerly port city of Luskan , the town of Loudwater on the Delimbiyr River , and the town of Nesmé , which fell to troll aggressors in 1370 DR . The rivers Dessarin and Surbrin also flow through the Savage Frontier .

title: Savahn
description: Savahn Savahn was a high - ranking monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . History . Savahn assisted Perrywinkle Shin .
description_long: Savahn Savahn was a high - ranking monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . History . Savahn assisted Perrywinkle Shin . In 1484 DR , Savahn observed Perrywinkle guiding Jarlaxle and the two copper dragon sisters Tazmikella and Ilnezhara to the presence of the immote grandmaster Kane and the awakening of the grandmaster .

title: Savanfast
description: Savanfast Savanfast was a ruined dwarven fortress located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Savanfast was built within the hollow of a natural stone dome , and had windows that were non - existent in the outside carved in the sides of the natural formation , allowing the dwarves to watch the surrounding terrain without the risk of being spotted by potential intruders .
description_long: Savanfast Savanfast was a ruined dwarven fortress located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Savanfast was built within the hollow of a natural stone dome , and had windows that were non - existent in the outside carved in the sides of the natural formation , allowing the dwarves to watch the surrounding terrain without the risk of being spotted by potential intruders . Within the fortress were tunnels that led to other dwarven settlements , as well as magic light nodes that sang whenever intruders were near Savanfast . Inhabitants . After the dwarves abandoned the place , Savanfast became home to several creatures that found their way into the fortress but were unable to return to the surface world . History . Savanfast was built by the dwarves of Durlyndbold as an outpost to watch out for dragon invaders during the first millennia of the Rule of Dragons . The outpost was later abandoned when the dwarves fled from Durlyndbold .

title: Savengriff
description: Savengriff Savengriff ( pronounced SAY - ven - griff ) was an apprentice wizard of Khelben Arunsun before he helped to refound the Covenant . Description . Savengriff was described as a gaunt man with pale skin and an unremarkable face .
description_long: Savengriff Savengriff ( pronounced SAY - ven - griff ) was an apprentice wizard of Khelben Arunsun before he helped to refound the Covenant . Description . Savengriff was described as a gaunt man with pale skin and an unremarkable face . He possessed dark brown hair , a beard , and hazel eyes . Personality . Savengriff was loyal to Khelben and was always prepared to be attacked . History . Savengriff was regarded as the weakest member of the Company of Crazed Venturers but he was personally recruited by Khelben to be a member of that band in the hopes of grooming him for the Harpers . At one point , he and fellow Venturer Tzarrakyn were both killed in a fight with a beholder . Savengriff ' s body was left in the beholder ' s lair but Khelben used a necklace he had gifted to him to discover the body ' s location , then led a sortie into the lair with Durnan , Mirt , Kitten , Piergeiron , Shalar Simgulphin , and several of Khelben ' s mage apprentices to retrieve it , killing the beholder as well . Khelben asked some cleric allies to bring Savengriff back from the dead , which earned him Savengriff ' s loyalty .

title: Savra Belabranta
description: Savra Belabranta Savra Belabranta was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Savra was totally brainwashed by the cult and fully believed everything .
description_long: Savra Belabranta Savra Belabranta was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Savra was totally brainwashed by the cult and fully believed everything . However , she believed that they should use elemental fury only against Waterdeep ' s enemies . History . Savra hailed from Waterdeep , where joined the Feathergale Knights , a cover group for the Cult of the Howling Hatred . There , she was indoctrinated into the worship of Yan - C - Bin . In 1491 DR , Savra showed some adventurers the Feathergale Spire .

title: Savras
description: Savras Savras ( pronounced " SAV - ras " ) was a god of mages and wizards in the service of Mystra , goddess of magic . Some say he was once a mortal , one of the mighty mages who constructed the portals beneath the city of Raven ' s Bluff . He is portrayed as a man with a crystalline face , clear to all who see him .
description_long: Savras Savras ( pronounced " SAV - ras " ) was a god of mages and wizards in the service of Mystra , goddess of magic . Some say he was once a mortal , one of the mighty mages who constructed the portals beneath the city of Raven ' s Bluff . He is portrayed as a man with a crystalline face , clear to all who see him . His statements are clear , concise , and rarely what the listener wishes to hear . Savras ' symbol is a crystal ball with many monstrous eyes . Worshipers . Savras is worshiped in both north and south as a god of diviners and truth - speakers . His clergy is still sparse , as Savras has just been released from his centuries - old prison . Savras ' s only famous servant was Alaundo of Candlekeep , the one true prophet of the Realms . Savras is particularly beloved in the nations of the Chultan Peninsula ( Tashalar , Samarach , Nimbral , and so on ) , where scrying and spying are practically the national pastimes due to the inhabitants ' fear of the yuan - ti . The Gur s have been known to worship Savras , which may explain the survival of his faith during his long period of imprisonment . Relationships .

title: Sawaka
description: Sawaka Sawaka was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Sawaka was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .
description_long: Sawaka Sawaka was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Sawaka was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Sawaka oversaw about the scaly animals of the land . He ruled Qui during the Season of the Dragon . He governed directing 60 human slaves . He did not care for intruders . History . Sawaka was appointed at the Qui sub - committee after the expulsion of Za - Jikku .

title: Sayeed
description: Sayeed Sayeed was a spellscar ed agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in The Twilight War in 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops .
description_long: Sayeed Sayeed was a spellscar ed agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in The Twilight War in 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops . In 1484 DR , Sayeed and his brother Zeeahd went in search of the Abbey of the Rose in order to capture Vasen Cale . In 1484 DR Minser traveled to Dalelands , Cormyr and finally to the Abbey of the Rose before went back to . They arrived in to the village of Fairelm where discovered that the local peddler Minser had just visited the Abbey . So Sayeed and Zeeahd unlashed their pack of spined devil s to slaughter all inhabitants minus Minser and Elle , how had spoken against them , in order to force Minser to show them the right way . So Sayeed and Zeeahd invaded the Abbey . Sayeed dueled with the just - arrived Vasen Cale and was defeated but thank to his powers survived . Later he tried to save the bone devil that once was Zeeahd from Rivalen Tanthul . Intrigued Rivalen spoke to Sayeed and offered to him to serve Shar . Sayeed agreed and his first duty for Shar he killed the Zeeahd - bone devil .

title: Sayida ibn Afa
description: Sayida ibn Afa Sayida ibn Afa was a rawun who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to those with whom she lived , Sayida despised killing .
description_long: Sayida ibn Afa Sayida ibn Afa was a rawun who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to those with whom she lived , Sayida despised killing . Activities . Sayida was well - connected within Sarahin , serving as confidant to both the Shadow Caliph and the leader of the Loyalists , Yusuf bin Ayyub . She remained confident that Yusuf would appoint her as leader of the Loyalists upon Marwan ' s death . Relationships . Sayida was the niece of the Shadow Caliph . Possessions . Sayida owned a " dagger of quickness " and a " qanun of quiet " .

title: Scale armor
description: Scale armor Scale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Plate mail consisted of a leather coat , leggings and sometimes skirt which was covered in small plates of overlapping scales .
description_long: Scale armor Scale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Plate mail consisted of a leather coat , leggings and sometimes skirt which was covered in small plates of overlapping scales . The finished armor would often resemble the scales of a fish . Although steel was commonly used to make scale mail , actual animal scales ( like dragon scales ) could be used . Although heavy , the flexibility and adjust - ability of scale mail armor made it surprisingly easy to wear .

title: Scalesneer
description: Scalesneer Scalesneer was a lizardfolk shaman of the Muckmarsh tribe in Twilight Marsh near Phlan . History . In 1489 DR , Scalesneer saved his chieftain Bogclaw , curing his wounds .
description_long: Scalesneer Scalesneer was a lizardfolk shaman of the Muckmarsh tribe in Twilight Marsh near Phlan . History . In 1489 DR , Scalesneer saved his chieftain Bogclaw , curing his wounds . Afterward , he helped him to get revenge against the black dragon Throstulgrael . They decided to hire an adventuring party to raid Throstulgrael ' s lair , expected that he would be absent , in order to have vengeance against the dragon . However , at the meeting with the adventurers , they were attacked by a group of will - o ' - wisp s and Scalesneer was killed .

title: Scalykind domain
description: Scalykind domain The Scalykind domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters scalykind spell powers . They gained the ability to rebuke and command reptile s much as an evil cleric rebuked undead . Deities with the Scalykind domain .
description_long: Scalykind domain The Scalykind domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters scalykind spell powers . They gained the ability to rebuke and command reptile s much as an evil cleric rebuked undead . Deities with the Scalykind domain . The Scalykind domain was an uncommon one , but its sponsored deities came from all over Faerûn .

title: Scantshar
description: Scantshar Scantshar was the name of a prominent human family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Activities . The Scantshar family was distrusted and treated with slight suspicion by other village folk .
description_long: Scantshar Scantshar was the name of a prominent human family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Activities . The Scantshar family was distrusted and treated with slight suspicion by other village folk . This was largely due to the fact that the family matriarch , Riliyyn Scantshar , was a wizard of some accomplishment . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Scantshars also contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Scapra
description: Scapra Scapra was the term for gem quality stones . Description . Usually rough crystal scapras were found in pale to medium yellow hues .
description_long: Scapra Scapra was the term for gem quality stones . Description . Usually rough crystal scapras were found in pale to medium yellow hues . This stone could be easily worked even by the unskilled , and could be facet cut , but was too soft for everyday wear in rings or on clothing . A typical specimen has a base value of 100 gp . Powers . This stone could be added to the material component of the " guards and wards " spell and enhanced its effects but was consumed in the casting . Specifically , each scapra added allowed one additional magical effect ( " dancing lights " , " magic mouth " , " stinking cloud " , " gust of wind " , or " suggestion " ) or a " phantasmal force " . Up to five scapras could be used , granting a total of five additional effects .

title: Scar Pilgrimage
description: Scar Pilgrimage A Scar Pilgrimage was a journey to plagueland s in order to gain a Spellscar , such as those made by the Order of Blue Flame . The city of Ormpetarr on the edge of the Plaguewrought Land was one of the favored destinations of scar pilgrims . Sadly , rather than obtaining the spellscar they desired , most pilgrims died horribly .
description_long: Scar Pilgrimage A Scar Pilgrimage was a journey to plagueland s in order to gain a Spellscar , such as those made by the Order of Blue Flame . The city of Ormpetarr on the edge of the Plaguewrought Land was one of the favored destinations of scar pilgrims . Sadly , rather than obtaining the spellscar they desired , most pilgrims died horribly .

title: Scardale
description: Scardale Scardale one of the regions that makes up the Dalelands . It has longed survived where other dales have fallen , such as Teshendale , despite wars , occupation by enemy states and a horrible plague . History .
description_long: Scardale Scardale one of the regions that makes up the Dalelands . It has longed survived where other dales have fallen , such as Teshendale , despite wars , occupation by enemy states and a horrible plague . History . After inheriting the throne , Lord Lashan Aumersair set about to build Scardale ' s power and wealth , intending to conquer all the southern Dalelands . In 1356 DR , he conquered Harrowdale , Featherdale , and , for a time , Battledale . He then moved against Mistledale and its ally Shadowdale , but was defeated by a hasty alliance formed against him . After Lashan ' s fell , Scardale was occupied by an uneasy coalition of troops from Cormyr , Sembia , the other Dalelands and even Zhentil Keep . By 1370 DR , Sembia felt ready to assert its power within the alliance . With the Cormyrian and other Dalelands forces having already left and Hillsfar ' s troops bribed , and no one would protest overly much if the Sembians drove the Zhents from the dale . Before the Sembians could act , Scardale suffered another disaster , the " Shaking Plague " . The Sembian garrison suffered significant losses .

title: Scare
description: Scare Scare , which was originally called Hamring ' s scare , was an arcane necromancy spell used induce fear in several creatures . Cleric s of Bane , Ghaunadaur , Gruumsh , Set , and Urdlen were also granted the ability to cast this spell . Effects .
description_long: Scare Scare , which was originally called Hamring ' s scare , was an arcane necromancy spell used induce fear in several creatures . Cleric s of Bane , Ghaunadaur , Gruumsh , Set , and Urdlen were also granted the ability to cast this spell . Effects . This spell caused a number of creatures within 30 feet of each other and within medium range of the caster to become frightened or shaken for a number of seconds . Components . A bone from an undead creature , such as a ghoul , ghast , mummy , skeleton , or zombie was required to cast this spell , in addition to verbal and somatic component s . History . The spell was invented by Netherese arcanist Hamring in −1294 DR , the same year he invented his " enfeeblement " spell .

title: Scarlet Mummers
description: Scarlet Mummers The Scarlet Mummers were an order of Lliira - worshipers formed to avenge the murder of Lliira ' s High Revelmistress in Selgaunt . Their duties included protecting Lliiran temples and battling with Loviata ns . Their battle prowess caused their fellows in the church to both fear and respect them .
description_long: Scarlet Mummers The Scarlet Mummers were an order of Lliira - worshipers formed to avenge the murder of Lliira ' s High Revelmistress in Selgaunt . Their duties included protecting Lliiran temples and battling with Loviata ns . Their battle prowess caused their fellows in the church to both fear and respect them .

title: Scarlet Sheath
description: Scarlet Sheath The Scarlet Sheath was a tavern located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Anthara Shalymarr . History .
description_long: Scarlet Sheath The Scarlet Sheath was a tavern located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Anthara Shalymarr . History . The building was once an abandoned ruin , until was taken over and lightly renovated by Anthara Shalymarr . She turned it into the Scarlet Sheath tavern by 1358 DR . On more than one occasion , Zhentarim agents assassinated people in the Sheath by sticking long blades through the tapestries and holes in the walls . The famed traveller Volothamp Geddarm once visited the tavern and said he liked it . The Scarlet Sheath was still in operation by 1369 DR . Structure & Interior . The tavern was quite obviously once a burned and ruined building , and still looked like it . Anthara simply and determinedly nailed tapestries over the holes and burn marks . Thus , the interior was dusty and seedy , and resembled a dilapidated harem . The furniture was very comfortable . Defenses . The regular patrons were quick to defend the waitresses from patrons who mistreated them , while Anthara was handy at throwing a knife at any who got too lusty with her . Services . The Scarlet Sheath was the local drinking hole of Wheloon .

title: Scarlet heart mushroom
description: Scarlet heart mushroom A scarlet heart mushroom was a large black mushroom that was covered with heart - shaped red spots . When a living creature approached , its heat caused the mushroom ' s red spots to burst , giving off a cloud of spores that caused blindness that could last for 2 - 8 days ( or until cured with " remove blindness " or similar ) . Although they were immune to fire and sonic damage , acid or cold would destroy the mushrooms , while electricity caused them to become dormant for days at a time .
description_long: Scarlet heart mushroom A scarlet heart mushroom was a large black mushroom that was covered with heart - shaped red spots . When a living creature approached , its heat caused the mushroom ' s red spots to burst , giving off a cloud of spores that caused blindness that could last for 2 - 8 days ( or until cured with " remove blindness " or similar ) . Although they were immune to fire and sonic damage , acid or cold would destroy the mushrooms , while electricity caused them to become dormant for days at a time .

title: Scathebeast
description: Scathebeast Scathebeasts were large herd animals endemic to the world of Abeir . In Toril , they were found in Returned Abeir , more commonly in Skelkor , and in displaced Abeiran lands in Faerûn , usually in Tymanther . Description .
description_long: Scathebeast Scathebeasts were large herd animals endemic to the world of Abeir . In Toril , they were found in Returned Abeir , more commonly in Skelkor , and in displaced Abeiran lands in Faerûn , usually in Tymanther . Description . These huge animals resembled giant slugs , the smallest of them being of the size of a pony . Behaviour . Scathebeasts usually lived in herds of five to eight members , and they had strong family bonds based on scent . Because of this , they aggressively attacked any creature that threatened or hurt a member of their herds . However , rare few scathebeasts could be found living alone in the wilderness . Because of generations of being the prey of choice of dragon s , scathebeasts had developed an instinctive fear of large flying creatures and of sources of fire . Scathebeasts instinctively avoided to destroy grassland through excessive grazing . Some rare scathebeasts occasionally developed a taste for meat . Scathebeasts were intelligent enough to be domesticated . Ecology . Scathebeasts were usually herbivorous , thought they were able to ate meat as well .

title: Scatterspray
description: Scatterspray Scatterspray was an alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a small group of items to fly about in random directions within the radius of the spell effect .
description_long: Scatterspray Scatterspray was an alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a small group of items to fly about in random directions within the radius of the spell effect . The objects had to be free to move — coins in an open purse would work , but gems in a closed jewelry box would not — and could be up to the size of chicken eggs . Between a half - dozen and a dozen or so objects could be launched by " scatterspray " and would reach the radius of effect and then bounce around for the duration of the spell . Damage to creatures inside the area of effect was determined by their size and the nature of the projectiles . Small creatures took more damage , large creatures took little to none , but glass shards might be more dangerous than sling bullets . The caster of the spell was not harmed by being within the area of effect , and magical protections like " shield " or " protection from normal missiles " also prevented damage , but spell casting was very difficult while being pelted by shrapnel . The newer version of this spell just caused a single explosion of objects without ricochet .

title: Scent of danger
description: Scent of danger The scent of danger ritual was used by sha ' ir s to charge their gen ' s sense of smell with supernatural ability . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete scent - related rituals .
description_long: Scent of danger The scent of danger ritual was used by sha ' ir s to charge their gen ' s sense of smell with supernatural ability . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete scent - related rituals . This ritual took 16 hours to complete . This ritual allowed the gen to literally smell the threat of approaching malicious intent so long as it was directed precisely at their sha ' ir . The gen was not able to determine the direction or nature of the danger , only that it was present in the general area . It should be noted that this ability did nothing to warn of regular dangerous occurences such as falling trees , mudslides , etc .

title: Scepter of Savras
description: Scepter of Savras The Scepter of Savras was an incredibly powerful artifact capable of containing the entire essence of a god . Created by the god Azuth and used to contain the deity of divination whose name it came to bear , it was lost for centuries in the Realms . Description .
description_long: Scepter of Savras The Scepter of Savras was an incredibly powerful artifact capable of containing the entire essence of a god . Created by the god Azuth and used to contain the deity of divination whose name it came to bear , it was lost for centuries in the Realms . Description . Four feet ( 1 . 2 m ) long and fashioned from a gray - hued length of duskwood , the Scepter bore nine star sapphire s along its length . The base was capped by a one inch ( 2 . 5 cm ) diameter diamond bearing the symbol of Savras , while the upper end bore a three inch ( 7 . 6 cm ) diameter diamond ( which legends claimed had 1 , 000 facets ) carved with the symbol of Azuth . Powers . While the Scepter could act as a " + 5 quarterstaff " , its main function was to " imprison " any creature it struck .

title: Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye
description: Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye The Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye was a minor artifact of Bane created by Teldorn Darkhope and Fzoul Chembryl . Description . The scepter was equivalent to a " + 3 heavy mace " and was sentient .
description_long: Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye The Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye was a minor artifact of Bane created by Teldorn Darkhope and Fzoul Chembryl . Description . The scepter was equivalent to a " + 3 heavy mace " and was sentient . Non - Banites who touched the scepter were hit by a " ray of enfeeblement " until their strength was depleted , at which time their soul would be " trapped " within . Powers . The wielder was granted the following powers , either continuously or a few times per day :

title: Schonert
description: Schonert Schonert was a priest of Ilmater in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , Schonert noticed that many residents of Downshadow had disappeared while rumors had spread of a treasure in the area .
description_long: Schonert Schonert was a priest of Ilmater in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , Schonert noticed that many residents of Downshadow had disappeared while rumors had spread of a treasure in the area . He decided to hire an adventuring party to uncover the truth . Activities . Schonert usually sent food and supplies to the Downshadow folks .

title: School of song
description: School of song The school of song was a group of arcane spell s that used the voice , speaking or singing , as its central element . It was considered a school of thaumaturgy , a system of grouping spells not by the philosophies of the traditional schools of magic , but by the method that was used to access magical energy . The school of song was in opposition to the schools of necromancy , divination , and invocation / evocation .
description_long: School of song The school of song was a group of arcane spell s that used the voice , speaking or singing , as its central element . It was considered a school of thaumaturgy , a system of grouping spells not by the philosophies of the traditional schools of magic , but by the method that was used to access magical energy . The school of song was in opposition to the schools of necromancy , divination , and invocation / evocation . Specialists in the school of song were called spellsinger s or song mages .

title: School of the Mage of Shadowdale
description: School of the Mage of Shadowdale The School of the Mage of Shadowdale was a small school in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Students accepted by Elfinster could learn magical spell s , or , if they lacked magical ability , they could learn to recognize a specific spell being cast based upon the caster ' s gestures and speech .
description_long: School of the Mage of Shadowdale The School of the Mage of Shadowdale was a small school in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Students accepted by Elfinster could learn magical spell s , or , if they lacked magical ability , they could learn to recognize a specific spell being cast based upon the caster ' s gestures and speech . Though Elfinster could be quite eccentric , his prices were reasonable and he was a proficient teacher . Scroll s could also be purchased here . Inhabitants . Elfinster owned and operated this school .

title: School of the Penitents
description: School of the Penitents The School of the Penitents was an order devoted to the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures , and was dedicated to spreading his faith in the Underdark . It consisted of nine separate groups , each with only four or five members . They kept a number of small enclaves in unexplored locations throughout the Upperdark level of the Underdark .
description_long: School of the Penitents The School of the Penitents was an order devoted to the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures , and was dedicated to spreading his faith in the Underdark . It consisted of nine separate groups , each with only four or five members . They kept a number of small enclaves in unexplored locations throughout the Upperdark level of the Underdark . From these places , they gave aid to those who came to them and spread their dogma of enduring suffering to the denizens of the subterranean world .

title: School of the Shadow Weave
description: School of the Shadow Weave The School of the Shadow Weave was a magic school in Sshamath . Description . The city was unique among drow cities in that it wasn ' t ruled by a clergy but by mages .
description_long: School of the Shadow Weave The School of the Shadow Weave was a magic school in Sshamath . Description . The city was unique among drow cities in that it wasn ' t ruled by a clergy but by mages . Vhaeraun was primarily prayed to in his role as the drow patron of shadow magic and spellfilchers . Religion and divine magic weren ' t viewed highly in the city and the same applied to that faith , too . The church of Vhaeraun , then , chose to use the School of the Shadow Weave as their front to gain power in the city . Under Nurissa Vyllshan , they taught magic that drew from the Shadow Weave instead of the Weave and tried to get accepted as a full College and with it as a member of the city ' s ruling body . They also had followers of Shar among them . However , they had problems getting admission , owing to being connected to not one , but two religions . In particular , the School of Illusion and Phantasm , headed by Felyndiira T ' orgh , was against it . The Sharrans in the group , though , made an open show of their faith and this triggered a discussion about giving them the position to put them under surveillance inside the Ruling Conclave . However , they didn ' t get accepted .

title: Schuyler
description: Schuyler Schuyler was a food critic in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Schuyler went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle in order to test their food .
description_long: Schuyler Schuyler was a food critic in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Schuyler went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle in order to test their food . She was briefly interrogated by adventurers hired by Buhrell Caah about a missing dangerous magical item .

title: Scimitar
description: Scimitar The scimitar was a one - handed , martial melee weapon of the sword family . Description . The scimitar was similar to the falchion in that it was a " backsword " , sharpened on one edge and the other edge was thicker to give it strength .
description_long: Scimitar The scimitar was a one - handed , martial melee weapon of the sword family . Description . The scimitar was similar to the falchion in that it was a " backsword " , sharpened on one edge and the other edge was thicker to give it strength . Scimitar blades were 2 to 3 ft ( 60 to 90 cm ) long and almost always curved but a few are angled like a khopesh . Starting at the hilt , the blade may taper gradually to a point or may increase in width and then rapidly come to a point . The hilt was one - handed and had . An average scimitar cost 15 gp and weighed 4 lb ( 1 . 8 kg ) . Weaponology . Scimitars did not have the damaging power of longsword s or other heavier swords , but with skill they could hit vital areas better than most . Using the one - sided , curved scimitar required special training and was therefore classified as a martial weapon . History . First appearing on Toril around the year - 2059 DR ( 1880 NY ) , scimitars developed from the khopesh , which were created a thousand years prior . These blades were commonly favored by Calishites and some druid s . Notes . 1st edition , 2nd edition and 3 . 0 / 3 .

title: Scimitar of shame
description: Scimitar of shame The scimitar of shame was a magic weapon that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons were available in a wide variety of scimitar s .
description_long: Scimitar of shame The scimitar of shame was a magic weapon that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons were available in a wide variety of scimitar s . Powers . A " scimitar of shame " was magically enhanced to make striking and injuring opponents easier compared to using a normal weapon . Upon command the wielder could activate the weapon ' s true power — unleashing a magical assault on the target ' s honor . If they target was unable to resist this onslaught then they behaved as if under the influence of a " taunt " spell , immediately rushing to attack the wielder of the scimitar with no regard for their surroundings . These magical taunts also interrupted spellcasting or other similar activities .

title: Scintillating sphere
description: Scintillating sphere Scintillating sphere was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to summon a small grape - sized ball of energy that traveled in a straight line where directed .
description_long: Scintillating sphere Scintillating sphere was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to summon a small grape - sized ball of energy that traveled in a straight line where directed . When the sphere reached the destination chosen by the caster , it would pulse twice and explode outward with electrical energy , damaging nearby creatures . The intensity of the explosion was based on the caster ' s power . Components . This spell required a small glass sphere and a pinch of iron oxide to cast .

title: Scions of Amber
description: Scions of Amber The Scions of Amber was a freedom - fighting organization that operated in the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . Activities . The Scions of Amber ' s main goal was to end the dragon s ' rule in the Dusk Ports , and eventually in all Returned Abeir .
description_long: Scions of Amber The Scions of Amber was a freedom - fighting organization that operated in the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . Activities . The Scions of Amber ' s main goal was to end the dragon s ' rule in the Dusk Ports , and eventually in all Returned Abeir . To that end , they were seeking veins of dragonbane amber across the continent . History . The order was founded after the Green Duchess Orlarrakh killed Father Thorn ' s family . He swore to free Returned Abeir from the dragon tyrants , and began to travel across the Dusk Ports to recruit sympathizers for his cause , eventually founding the rebel organization .

title: Scirkhel Wands
description: Scirkhel Wands Scirkhel Wands was a ranger and bard of the Wands family in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Scirkhel was born in 1319 DR .
description_long: Scirkhel Wands Scirkhel Wands was a ranger and bard of the Wands family in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Scirkhel was born in 1319 DR . At a young age , he left home to travel and on his journeys he met and befriended a ranger who told him all he knew about the Heralds of Faerûn . Back in Waterdeep , Scirkhel assumed the office of Falconfree as a member of the Heralds . Circa 1372 DR , he enrolled in the New Olamn bardic college to study as a bard , and here befriended Regnet Amcathra . Relations . He was the great great nephew of Maskar Wands .

title: Scorching burst
description: Scorching burst A scorching burst is an evocation spell cast by many wizard s inflamed with the power of fire . When a wizard chooses to cast this spell , which he can do at any time , he creates a pillar of golden flame at the spot of his target , trapping his target and any others very close within its grasp . The burst must be cast within fifty feet of the wizard and disappears in an instant , but can be recast at any time .
description_long: Scorching burst A scorching burst is an evocation spell cast by many wizard s inflamed with the power of fire . When a wizard chooses to cast this spell , which he can do at any time , he creates a pillar of golden flame at the spot of his target , trapping his target and any others very close within its grasp . The burst must be cast within fifty feet of the wizard and disappears in an instant , but can be recast at any time . " Scorching burst " is twice as deadly if cast by an archmage or mage of equivalent power .

title: Scoril Cimber
description: Scoril Cimber Scoril Cimber , also known as Shadowhawk , was the father of Artus Cimber and a renown highwayman within the King ' s Forest of Cormyr . Description . Scoril was a gruff hooked - nose man with dark green eyes .
description_long: Scoril Cimber Scoril Cimber , also known as Shadowhawk , was the father of Artus Cimber and a renown highwayman within the King ' s Forest of Cormyr . Description . Scoril was a gruff hooked - nose man with dark green eyes . Personality . Being a highwayman , Scoril was stern and demanding of this children , Oric and Artus . Possessions . To aid in his banditry , Shadowhawk wore a heavy black which hid his features from opponents . The bandit also concealed a stiletto in his . History . In Uktar , 1335 DR , Scoril Cimber the Shadowhawk and his son , Artus , encountered Prince Azoun along the road to Irath , a hamlet south of Waymoot , and saved the prince from Zhentarim assassins .

title: Scorlworyx
description: Scorlworyx Scorlworyx was a red dragon in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . History . One day , she heard that the neighboring Circle of the Scales had claimed that , thanks to a scale of Tiamat herself , they could dominate all dragons .
description_long: Scorlworyx Scorlworyx was a red dragon in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . History . One day , she heard that the neighboring Circle of the Scales had claimed that , thanks to a scale of Tiamat herself , they could dominate all dragons . Enraged , Scorlworyx attacked the Circle and killed most of the members , bar their leader Skovac , who sealed himself in the temple with the relic . In order to gain her aid , in 1489 DR , Tibeem and Spernik , agents of the reformed Cult of the Dragon , tried to recover the sacred scale . Around 1492 DR Scorlworyx was intrigued by the new Pool of Radiance but was tricked by some adventurers .

title: Scornubel
description: Scornubel Scornubel , also known as the Caravan City , was a major tradestop for caravans . It lay on the northern bank of the River Chionthar , where the Trade Way reached the river . Population .
description_long: Scornubel Scornubel , also known as the Caravan City , was a major tradestop for caravans . It lay on the northern bank of the River Chionthar , where the Trade Way reached the river . Population . Its population was made up of many races and could increase by between six and eight times during the summer . Description . The river was populated by barges , narrowboats , and skiffs , which made their way west as far as Baldur ' s Gate southeast along the Chionthar to Berdusk and northeast along the River Reaching to Hill ' s Edge . Demonym . A person from Scornubel was known as a Scornubian or Scornubrian . History . The southern part of Scornubel was once a rival city known as Zirta , until it was conquered in the War of Lords . In the years immediately after the Spellplague of 1385 DR , trade across Faerûn ground to a halt and Scornubel ' s fortunes plummeted . The city saved itself by allowing its annexation by Elturgard . Government . In the 14th century DR , the city was ruled by Lady Rhessajan Ambermantle , three Lord High Advisors who were formerly merchants , and an additional council of merchants .

title: Scornubrian sandglass
description: Scornubrian sandglass A Scornubrian sandglass was a miniature hourglass made in Scornubel that took two minutes and two seconds to empty its contents . It was often used to time moves in games or could be used to limit the time taken to make a decision or to choose a partner during certain festivals .
description_long: Scornubrian sandglass A Scornubrian sandglass was a miniature hourglass made in Scornubel that took two minutes and two seconds to empty its contents . It was often used to time moves in games or could be used to limit the time taken to make a decision or to choose a partner during certain festivals .

title: Scothgar
description: Scothgar Scothgar was a Northlander human man and a prince of Rogarsheim on the island of Norland in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , he was due to marry the Ffolk Princess Bridget of Callidyrr , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them .
description_long: Scothgar Scothgar was a Northlander human man and a prince of Rogarsheim on the island of Norland in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , he was due to marry the Ffolk Princess Bridget of Callidyrr , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them .

title: Scott Haring
description: Scott Haring Scott Haring is a game designer who has worked for . He has contributed to Dungeons & Dragons material with gaming material in some of the comic books published by TSR , Inc . and was the author of the " Empires of the Sands " sourcebook .
description_long: Scott Haring Scott Haring is a game designer who has worked for . He has contributed to Dungeons & Dragons material with gaming material in some of the comic books published by TSR , Inc . and was the author of the " Empires of the Sands " sourcebook .

title: Scour
description: Scour Scour was a Voidharrow demon who entered Toril through a gate from another universe with his " sibling " Murmur hundreds of years before the Spellplague . Scour ' s consciousness was scattered into many pieces but Murmur was apparently able to revive much of Scour ' s mind . By 1480 DR , Scour was in Luskan , manifesting as a swarm of mutated vermin .
description_long: Scour Scour was a Voidharrow demon who entered Toril through a gate from another universe with his " sibling " Murmur hundreds of years before the Spellplague . Scour ' s consciousness was scattered into many pieces but Murmur was apparently able to revive much of Scour ' s mind . By 1480 DR , Scour was in Luskan , manifesting as a swarm of mutated vermin . Scour infected many inhabitants with the Fury plague , which caused victims to go into a homicidal rage . Scour attacked an assembly of Luskan ' s gangs , killing many people . He was confronted in Luskan ' s underground by Kalen Dren , Myrin Darkdance , and Sithe and defeated . Sithe sacrificed herself by using her innate abilities to open a portal to the void where she took the remaining fragments of Scour . Appearance . Scour ' s corporal form , such as it was , consisted of a mass of mutated vermin .

title: Scoured Legion
description: Scoured Legion The Scoured Legion ( also known as the Scourged Legion ) of Hellgate Keep was a strong company of tanarukk s . Leadership . The Scoured Legion was led by Kaanyr Vhok , a cambion who proclaimed himself " the Sceptered One and Master of the Scoured Legions .
description_long: Scoured Legion The Scoured Legion ( also known as the Scourged Legion ) of Hellgate Keep was a strong company of tanarukk s . Leadership . The Scoured Legion was led by Kaanyr Vhok , a cambion who proclaimed himself " the Sceptered One and Master of the Scoured Legions . " Members . Vhok ' s Scoured Legion consisted of 2 , 000 tanarukk warriors with auxiliary troops : bugbears , ogres , giants , etc . They had their own forges and armories . Vhok lost 120 tanarukks in the Siege of Menzoberranzan . Base . The Scoured Legion was originally based in Hellgate Keep . After the fall of the keep , they settled in Ammarindar , where they remained until 1372 DR . After the failed Siege of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR , they returned to Hellgate Keep . History . The Scoured Legion invaded the Nameless Dungeon in Alturiak 1369 DR , opposed by a band of snakelike creatures . In 1372 DR to 1373 DR they participated in the Siege of Menzoberranzan alongside the duergar army of Gracklstugh with the support of the Jaezred Chaulssin , but withdrew just as the tide of battle turned against them , leaving their allies to be decimated . Vhok subsequently removed his headquarters to Hellgate Keep .

title: Scourge of fangs
description: Scourge of fangs A scourge of fangs , also known as a whip of fangs or a viper whip , was a snake - headed whip used by many drow cleric s of Lolth . Description . A " scourge of fangs " usually had an adamantine handle and a number of serpentine constructs ( snake heads ) as lashes .
description_long: Scourge of fangs A scourge of fangs , also known as a whip of fangs or a viper whip , was a snake - headed whip used by many drow cleric s of Lolth . Description . A " scourge of fangs " usually had an adamantine handle and a number of serpentine constructs ( snake heads ) as lashes . The snake heads often writhed and hissed in response to the bearer ' s emotions . The snake heads could be controlled by the will of the bearer , but had their own independent " personalities . " Some bearers named each snake head . The number of snake heads on the scourge indicated the level of power of the priestess . If a snake head was destroyed , it would fall off the whip . The rest of the heads continued to function normally . Powers . Each snake head was venomous and its bite caused severe pain .

title: Scourge of the Sword Coast
description: Scourge of the Sword Coast Summary . Recent events caused the brief reactivation of the " portal " to Avernus in Dragonspear Castle . During that window of opportunity , the shade of the pit fiend Baazka reentered Faerûn .
description_long: Scourge of the Sword Coast Summary . Recent events caused the brief reactivation of the " portal " to Avernus in Dragonspear Castle . During that window of opportunity , the shade of the pit fiend Baazka reentered Faerûn . Baazka has allied himself with the Red Wizards of Thay whose plans for the Sword Coast , although disrupted by the adventurers hired by Sir Isteval , continue regardless . Baazka has revealed a " portal " network to the Thayans that they hope to co - opt and use to bring a stream of reinforcements from their homeland . To prevent more setbacks caused by adventurers , Baazka ' s allies have tasked him to rouse the local monster population into raiding the countryside around Daggerford . Refugees , fleeing from these raids , are now being turned away from Daggerford . A dwarven relic belonging to Duke Maldwyn has been stolen , which has infuriated him and placed Sir Isteval under suspicion in connection to the theft . Adventurers in Daggerford travel to various sites in the area , disrupting the plans of the Red Wizards until finally learning the location of the Thayan base - Bloodgate Keep .

title: Scout
description: Scout A scout is a class similar to a rogue or ranger , preferring to stay hidden and attack from a distance rather then up close and personal . They have varying roles , from leading an army through unknown terrain to working as a missionary going solo to learn terrain for the payer . Usually they wear leather armor , as they rely more on speed and agility to out maneuver an opponent .
description_long: Scout A scout is a class similar to a rogue or ranger , preferring to stay hidden and attack from a distance rather then up close and personal . They have varying roles , from leading an army through unknown terrain to working as a missionary going solo to learn terrain for the payer . Usually they wear leather armor , as they rely more on speed and agility to out maneuver an opponent . Weapons and Tactics . A scout often uses light melee weapons , such as dagger s and shortsword s , and a small ranged weapon , like a shortbow or hand crossbow . They fight dirty , preferring to end the fight quick and are generally they are proficient in stealth and lock - picking .

title: Scrag
description: Scrag Scrags ( also known as marine trolls , aquatic trolls , sea scrags , and sea trolls ) were an aquatic version of troll . There were two varieties : freshwater trolls and saltwater trolls . Nomenclature .
description_long: Scrag Scrags ( also known as marine trolls , aquatic trolls , sea scrags , and sea trolls ) were an aquatic version of troll . There were two varieties : freshwater trolls and saltwater trolls . Nomenclature . " Scrag , " " aquatic troll , " and " marine troll " could refer to any troll that lived in water . However , " scrag " often referred specifically to a freshwater troll , also called a " river troll . " In that case , a saltwater troll was called a " marine scrag . " Description . Freshwater trolls were smaller than typical trolls , whereas saltwater trolls tended to be about the same size . All scrags had smaller and weaker arms than those of typical trolls . Abilities . Scrags could only regenerate when in water : Freshwater scrags had to be in freshwater , and saltwater scrags had to be in saltwater . Locations . Scrags were found in the Mortick Swamp in Luiren . They could also be found in the Mere of Dead Men in the Sword Coast North and in the Moonsea ( where known large colonies resided near Hulburg , and the island of Maos ) . In the Underdark , scrags were found in the Darklake and in the Shape of Water in the Glimmersea . Appendix . Appearances . Sourcebooks .

title: Scramsax
description: Scramsax Scramsax was an innkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Scramsax , a retired sellsword , managed the Northlook inn , a well - known place among adventurers and mercenaries of the North .
description_long: Scramsax Scramsax was an innkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Scramsax , a retired sellsword , managed the Northlook inn , a well - known place among adventurers and mercenaries of the North . He profited off his customers by charging the most exorbitant rates in the town . However , he permitted to remain on credit customers who were undertaking a new job but he wanted to be paid with very high interest . If someone did not pay , then Scramsax showed that he could still use a sword .

title: Screaming
description: Screaming Screaming is a quality that can be applied to weapons . If it is applied to ranged weapons , the effects apply to their ammunition . The weapon makes a low humming noise which changes to a painful screaming when it strikes a target , inflicting sonic damage , even within the area of a " silence " spell .
description_long: Screaming Screaming is a quality that can be applied to weapons . If it is applied to ranged weapons , the effects apply to their ammunition . The weapon makes a low humming noise which changes to a painful screaming when it strikes a target , inflicting sonic damage , even within the area of a " silence " spell . It can only affect creatures with normal hearing .

title: Screeching Wing
description: Screeching Wing The Screeching Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan half - dragon called Phaikkul . Organization .
description_long: Screeching Wing The Screeching Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan half - dragon called Phaikkul . Organization . The group was led by Phaikkul , an imposing kir - lanan who would use subtle instruction and occasionally direct intimidation to keep her subordinates in check . Despite the iron - handed rule she kept over her clan , a number of kir - lanan had moved between the Howling Wing and Screeching Wing bands over the years , with both groups operating as a loose collection of followers rather than an unified force . Ultimately , the Screeching Wing served the shadow dragon Glouroth , who laired near the top of the Wailing Cliff . Activities . At the instruction of the shadow dragon , Glouroth , the Screeching Wing was responsible for extracting tribute from travelers of the Deep Wastes who sought to pass the Wailing Cliff . Any creatures that approached the top of the cliff and rung the large bell would be greeted by Phaikkul and her wing .

title: Screen
description: Screen Screen is an illusion spell that hides an area from vision and scrying . Effects . This spell combines several elements to create a powerful protection from scrying and direct observation .
description_long: Screen Screen is an illusion spell that hides an area from vision and scrying . Effects .
