This spell combines several elements to create a powerful protection from scrying and direct observation . When the spell is cast , you dictate what will and will not be observed in the spell ’ s area . The illusion created must be stated in general terms . Thus , you could specify the illusion of yourself and another character playing chess for the duration of the spell , but you could not have the illusory chess players take a break , make dinner , and then resume their game . You could have a crossroads appear quiet and empty even while an army is actually passing through the area . You could specify that no one be seen ( including passing strangers ) , that your troops be undetected , or even that every fifth person or unit should be visible . Once the conditions are set , they cannot be changed . Attempts to scry the area automatically detect the image stated by you with no save allowed . Sight and sound are appropriate to the illusion created . A band of people standing in a meadow could be concealed as an empty meadow with birds chirping , for instance .

title: Scriveners of Doom
description: Scriveners of Doom The Scriveners of Doom were the priesthood of Jergal , the Lord of the End of Everything . Priests of Jergal served as scribes , funerary workers , and morticians . The task of recording the fates and affairs of short - lived mortals of the land rested with the Scriveners of Doom .
description_long: Scriveners of Doom The Scriveners of Doom were the priesthood of Jergal , the Lord of the End of Everything . Priests of Jergal served as scribes , funerary workers , and morticians . The task of recording the fates and affairs of short - lived mortals of the land rested with the Scriveners of Doom .

title: Scroll
description: Scroll A scroll is a rolled or folded document . Unlike a tome , a scroll is usually a single piece of parchment . Magical scrolls contain the words of a spell that is released when the caster reads the words on the page .
description_long: Scroll A scroll is a rolled or folded document . Unlike a tome , a scroll is usually a single piece of parchment . Magical scrolls contain the words of a spell that is released when the caster reads the words on the page . Magical scrolls may be scribed by wizard s , cleric s , or druid s . Scrolls of the appropriate magic may be read by the classes that can scribe scrolls . In addition , rogue s can read magic well enough to activate a scroll and occasionally other classes may have the ability to use scrolls although this may be risky for non magic - users .

title: Scrying
description: Scrying Scrying was the magical ability to use one ' s senses to experience events far away . Magical sensor . Many divination spells of the scrying subschool created a magical sensor that sent the caster information .
description_long: Scrying Scrying was the magical ability to use one ' s senses to experience events far away . Magical sensor . Many divination spells of the scrying subschool created a magical sensor that sent the caster information . The sensor had the sensory acuity of the caster and acted as though it were a separate , independent organ . Any intelligent creature could notice an active magical sensor . The sensor could be dispelled . Limits . Scrying could not penetrate lead . Several magic spells , " antimagic field " , " mind blank " , " nondetection " , and " wardmist " could block scrying . Magical items such as weirdstone s could also block scrying . The semi - precious stone tchazar could blur the scrying of anything close to it . Aids . A chrysoberyl gem ( " aka " " cat ' s eye " ) could be used for short - range but very detailed scrying .

title: Scrying ( spell )
description: Scrying ( spell ) Scrying was both an arcane and divine magic spell that allowed the caster to view a subject at great distance and possibly across the planes of existence . The effect was very similar to using a " crystal ball " but with differences in scope , duration , and components . Newer versions of this spell allowed the caster to hear as well as see the subject .
description_long: Scrying ( spell ) Scrying was both an arcane and divine magic spell that allowed the caster to view a subject at great distance and possibly across the planes of existence . The effect was very similar to using a " crystal ball " but with differences in scope , duration , and components . Newer versions of this spell allowed the caster to hear as well as see the subject . This spell has been known by many names throughout history . It was originally invented by the archwizard Anglin of Seventon in −1939 DR and called Anglin ' s mirror because it changed an ordinary mirror into a scrying device . Over time , Anglin ' s name was dropped and this spell became known as magic mirror . Cleric s received a similar spell they called magic font because it used a basin of " holy water " as the scrying surface . Druid s ( and some clerics ) had a more limited version they called " reflecting pool " for the same reason . Effects . For all versions of this spell , the chance of success was increased by knowledge of the subject .

title: Sculptures for the Elite
description: Sculptures for the Elite Sculptures for the Elite was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This shop was located on the south side of the bazaar .
description_long: Sculptures for the Elite Sculptures for the Elite was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This shop was located on the south side of the bazaar . Splendid sculptures of obsidian and marble could be purchased here . Life - sized sculptures could be ordered and ready in as little as two days , assuming the customer would pose during part of that time . Inhabitants . Jera al - Farif owned and operated this establishment .

title: Scupperden
description: Scupperden Scupperden was an eatery located in the Dredge , the lowest level of Skullport . The establishment was known primarily for its stew made of fish , mushrooms and vegetable scraps which sold for 1 cp per bowl . The stew was described as somewhat alarming but unlikely to kill the eater .
description_long: Scupperden Scupperden was an eatery located in the Dredge , the lowest level of Skullport . The establishment was known primarily for its stew made of fish , mushrooms and vegetable scraps which sold for 1 cp per bowl . The stew was described as somewhat alarming but unlikely to kill the eater . Description . Scupperden was a single room built from scavenged wood , sailcloth and rope . Inside , patrons lined up to a twenty foot long serving trough .

title: Scurrd
description: Scurrd Describe by the Bloodsailor pirate Jalek in Neverwinter Nights as " The Meanest . . .
description_long: Scurrd Describe by the Bloodsailor pirate Jalek in Neverwinter Nights as " The Meanest . . . Foulest . . . Black Bile on the Earth . . . A Bottle of Scurrd " this is the last of a series of drinks used in a drinking contest against the half - orc pirate passes out after this one bottle ! In the Seedy Tavern on the second floor a half naked dwarf called Ulfnog is in a hot room and answers when asked " What is in Scurrd ? " Scurrd may be a mixture of different drinks some may be dwarfish . Jalek comments on Scurrd in the following sentence if asked what is in Scurrd : " What is in Scurrd ? What , indeed . Scurrd . . . just seems to find its way . . . to where it can do the most harm . It ' s truly vicious . It cannot be smelled by the elderly . . . it cannot be held by small children . . . It is Scurrd , and woe be to ye that take it to your tongue . "

title: Scyllua Darkhope
description: Scyllua Darkhope Scyllua Darkhope was the Castellan of Zhentil Keep and High Captain of its armies . A fallen paladin of Tyr , she became a champion and blackguard of Bane . Under her leadership the Zhents were able to recover after the near complete destruction of their city by the humanoid army sent by Cyric in 1368 DR .
description_long: Scyllua Darkhope Scyllua Darkhope was the Castellan of Zhentil Keep and High Captain of its armies . A fallen paladin of Tyr , she became a champion and blackguard of Bane . Under her leadership the Zhents were able to recover after the near complete destruction of their city by the humanoid army sent by Cyric in 1368 DR . Scyllua was killed in 1375 DR by the leaders of the Shadowdale rebellion . Appearance . Scyulla was lean and athletic , possessed of a fierce charisma that both inspired and frightened . She lead the Zhent raids in person upon a white nightmare named Targaraene . Personality . Scyllua was determined , persistent and intelligent , wading into battle with joyous abandon . A zealous agent of Bane , she was a enemy of all good . Biography . Scyulla grew up in the Dalelands and was taken as a slave to Zhentil Keep along with her mother while still a child . A Zhent noble , cousin to Teldorn Darkhope of Mintar , took notice of her mother and brought them into his household . Scyulla adopted the Darkhope surname , but remained bitter over the situations surrounding her upbringing .

title: Scythe
description: Scythe A scythe is a farm implement that can be used as a two - handed , martial melee weapon . Description . A scythe is a long , curved , sharp - pointed , one - sided blade mounted at 90° on a shaped haft and is normally used for harvesting wheat or corn .
description_long: Scythe A scythe is a farm implement that can be used as a two - handed , martial melee weapon . Description . A scythe is a long , curved , sharp - pointed , one - sided blade mounted at 90° on a shaped haft and is normally used for harvesting wheat or corn . The blade is tilted and the haft is shaped to make it easy to swing just above the ground and cut the crop stalks . One or two handles may jut out of the haft to make it more comfortable to swing in a mowing fashion . The military version of this tool will be a bit straighter , reinforced , and balanced for war . An average scythe costs 18gp and weighs 10lbs ( 4 . 5kg ) . Weaponology . The scythe can be used for piercing or slashing attacks in the same manner as some pole arm s , like halberd s , but is not a reach weapon . It takes two hands to wield a scythe and some training to use effectively , so it is classified as a martial weapon . Because the blade is long and slightly curved , it can be used to trip opponents . Other editions . The scythe is not mentioned in the 1st or 2nd edition player handbooks .

title: Sea ( province )
description: Sea ( province ) The province of sea in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of water . Dominated by deserts as the Land of Fate was , the magical province took its name from the one place where water was abundant : the seas surrounding the continent , so important for trade and travel . Many of its spells were related to sea - faring .
description_long: Sea ( province ) The province of sea in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of water . Dominated by deserts as the Land of Fate was , the magical province took its name from the one place where water was abundant : the seas surrounding the continent , so important for trade and travel . Many of its spells were related to sea - faring . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones . Elemental mage s in Zakhara specialized exclusively in one province , like sea , while sorcerers took spells from two provinces , shunning the other two . Unlike elementalist s , magic - users from the Land of Fate recognized no opposition between sea and flame . Paths of power . Zakharan practicioners of path magic recognized four paths of power within the province of sea :

title: Sea Sprite
description: Sea Sprite The Sea Sprite was a large pirate hunting ship that was under the command of Captain Deudermont . The ship was commissioned by the Lords of Waterdeep , who recognised Deudermont ' s talents as a capable sailor and pirate hunter . Second in command on the Sea Sprite was Robillard , a capable wizard , albeit eternally grumpy , and friend to Deudermont .
description_long: Sea Sprite The Sea Sprite was a large pirate hunting ship that was under the command of Captain Deudermont . The ship was commissioned by the Lords of Waterdeep , who recognised Deudermont ' s talents as a capable sailor and pirate hunter . Second in command on the Sea Sprite was Robillard , a capable wizard , albeit eternally grumpy , and friend to Deudermont . Deudermont once owned another vessel , the first Sea Sprite , which was a relatively small ship dedicated to carrying travelers across the Sea of Swords . After it ' s famed sea battle with Pinochet ' s fleet , Deudermont was awarded the second Sea Sprite , a large , beautiful privateer designed by Waterdeep ' s finest engineers and wizards to meet the latest pirate - hunting capabilities . In the decades prior to the spellplague , the Sea Sprite became famous along the Sword Coast , where pirate activity was kept firmly at bay by the efforts of the ship ' s crew . Notable crew members have been Drizzt Do ' Urden , who played an active part in combat with pirates , and Cattie - brie , the Princess of Clan Battlehammer .

title: Sea Tower
description: Sea Tower The Sea Tower was a fortress in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the base of the Guard of Tantras . Location .
description_long: Sea Tower The Sea Tower was a fortress in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the base of the Guard of Tantras . Location . The Sea Tower stood on the city ' s coast , on the southern side of the opening of the bay . It lay at the end of Whistleturn Way . Activities . The Sea Tower was the city ' s main fortress , and held armories and training areas for soldiers .

title: Sea Ward of Waterdeep
description: Sea Ward of Waterdeep The Sea Ward of Waterdeep was the wealthiest ward in Waterdeep and located in the northwest of the city . Geography . The ward contained the Field of Triumph , Heroes ' Garden and the Sea ' s Edge Beach .
description_long: Sea Ward of Waterdeep The Sea Ward of Waterdeep was the wealthiest ward in Waterdeep and located in the northwest of the city . Geography . The ward contained the Field of Triumph , Heroes ' Garden and the Sea ' s Edge Beach . It also contained some of the city ' s largest temples .

title: Sea cat
description: Sea cat A sea cat , also known as a sea lion , was a magical beast that combined the features of a lion and a fish . It was a ferocious predator of the seas . Description .
description_long: Sea cat A sea cat , also known as a sea lion , was a magical beast that combined the features of a lion and a fish . It was a ferocious predator of the seas . Description . The sea cat bore the head and forepaws of a lion but a body and tail similar to those of a fish or of a porpoise of small whale . It had a mane of silky hair running from the top of its head and down its back to its tail flukes . They were depicted as having either tan fur and fish - like scales or green skin and reptilian scales . A full - grown sea cat grew to a length of 12 feet ( 3 . 6 meters ) or even 15 feet ( 4 . 5 meters ) , and it weighed up to 800 pounds ( 360 kilograms ) . Abilities . Sea cats were talented natural swimmers , though not as good as sea horse s . Being mammalian , a sea cat apparently risked drowning if it stayed too long underwater . It could hold its breath underwater for about 10 minutes . On the other hand , sea lions were also reported to have gills , allowing them to extract oxygen from water . The sea lion ' s thick scales had a water - proofing ability , allowing it to survive out of water for up to 24 hours , after which time its gills dried out and no longer functioned .

title: Sea domain
description: Sea domain Umberlee and her alone holds the domain of the untamed sea , to any and all who wants to enter her domain must pay a trubiute to or linking or draw her terrible wrath , The Queen of the depths will strike quick and swift against those who anger her . Power of sea domain . Any divine caster who worships a god of the sea domain may use it to channel the power of the deity .
description_long: Sea domain Umberlee and her alone holds the domain of the untamed sea , to any and all who wants to enter her domain must pay a trubiute to or linking or draw her terrible wrath , The Queen of the depths will strike quick and swift against those who anger her . Power of sea domain . Any divine caster who worships a god of the sea domain may use it to channel the power of the deity . As a Divine caster choses the domain she will become more athletic , also when a caster uses a power associated with the domain that hits an enemy , she can choose to ether attempt to resist an effect on her , or she can choose that the enemy will be more likely to be hit with spells for a short time . The powers of the domain are : < br > Bond of censure < br > Divine bolds < br > Recovery strike < br > Virtuous strike < br > Sea surge divinity . To use the divinity of the sea domain one must have the channel divinity class feat and worship a deity of the domain . And when the caster has this it gains the ability to use " Sea surge " Sea surge .

title: Sea hag
description: Sea hag Sea hags were wicked , cruel fey creatures . As their name implied , they were found in and along the shores of the sea . Description .
description_long: Sea hag Sea hags were wicked , cruel fey creatures . As their name implied , they were found in and along the shores of the sea . Description . Sea hags were revolting to look upon ; their visage was so horrifying that the weak - hearted were known to die upon gazing at these hags . They had an emaciated appearance , despite their joy of gorging themselves on the flesh of sentient creatures . Society . Sea hags were normally solitary . Locations . Sea hags dwelt in cliffs and above and near settlements . They were found in the Sea of Fallen Stars , typically swimming at a depth between 151 and 300 feet .

title: Sea legs
description: Sea legs Sea legs was a divine magic spell that could give a creature the ability to keep its balance and maneuver on board a vessel being tossed by waves . The reverse of this spell , called land legs , removed this ability , making it difficult and possibly dangerous to attempt any action on a heaving deck . As a healing effect , " sea legs " also prevented sea sickness .
description_long: Sea legs Sea legs was a divine magic spell that could give a creature the ability to keep its balance and maneuver on board a vessel being tossed by waves . The reverse of this spell , called land legs , removed this ability , making it difficult and possibly dangerous to attempt any action on a heaving deck . As a healing effect , " sea legs " also prevented sea sickness . Effects . In order to cast this spell , the priest had to touch the person or creature being targeted . The effects lasted an hour for every level the priest had achieved . " Sea legs " gave a person or creature the sense of balance that normally required years of sailing experience to develop , such that they could move about on a vessel in high seas and not be subject to sea sickness . If cast in reverse , " land legs " caused the target to lose this ability such that all movements and actions could result in being knocked off their feet . and made it difficult to stand back up . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required the priest ' s holy symbol to cast . History . This spell was associated with the pirates roaming the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Sea mother whip
description: Sea mother whip A Sea Mother Whip is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa . Those who pick this class seek a closer communion with their goddess , Blibdoolpoolp . In return for the dedication and desire to be close with her goddess , a Sea Mother Whip is given abilities to aid her in the goals that she has been given to her by her church .
description_long: Sea mother whip A Sea Mother Whip is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa . Those who pick this class seek a closer communion with their goddess , Blibdoolpoolp . In return for the dedication and desire to be close with her goddess , a Sea Mother Whip is given abilities to aid her in the goals that she has been given to her by her church . The chief duty of a Sea Mother Whip is to strength Blibdoolpoolp ' s hold over the Sea Mother Whip ' s community , as well as prevent heretics and outside forces from affecting the goddess ' s monopoly on spiritual matters .

title: Sea of Caravans
description: Sea of Caravans The Sea of Caravans , also called Bahr al - Dahil , was an inland sea nestled between north , west , and Interior Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The Sea of Caravans was an important body of water connecting trade and commerce between Qudra and the Free Cities of Zakhara in the north with the Cities of the Heart in the southeast .
description_long: Sea of Caravans The Sea of Caravans , also called Bahr al - Dahil , was an inland sea nestled between north , west , and Interior Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The Sea of Caravans was an important body of water connecting trade and commerce between Qudra and the Free Cities of Zakhara in the north with the Cities of the Heart in the southeast . Both the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue and the Spine of the Dog created steep borders along the entire stretch of the sea ' s western and southern boundaries . Activities . Travel by ship through the sea bypassed hundreds , if not thousands of miles , of perilous desert travel . The Sea of Caravans , Al - Tariq Channel , and Suq Bay were constantly patrolled by the Grand Caliph ' s warships to ensure safe travel for traders and pilgrims .

title: Sea of Fallen Stars
description: Sea of Fallen Stars The Sea of Fallen Stars , also known as the Inner Sea , was the largest inland body of water in Faerûn . Its major areas included the Dragonmere ( Lake of Dragons ) on the west , the Dragon and Easting Reaches on the north , the Alamber Sea on the east and the Vilhon Reach on the south . The sea floor was covered with hundreds of shipwrecks .
description_long: Sea of Fallen Stars The Sea of Fallen Stars , also known as the Inner Sea , was the largest inland body of water in Faerûn . Its major areas included the Dragonmere ( Lake of Dragons ) on the west , the Dragon and Easting Reaches on the north , the Alamber Sea on the east and the Vilhon Reach on the south . The sea floor was covered with hundreds of shipwrecks . History . The name of the sea was from the origin story which stated that the Inner Sea formed when the four Inner Seas merged together , coinciding with the loss of entire continents from earthquakes , fires , and windstorms due to a star sent by deities to punish the titans ' arrogance . Other theories maintained it was actually the eggs of the first dragon s raining down onto the planet . Tens of thousands of dragon eggs did hatch soon after the event , though the real reason for the destruction was the primordial Asgoroth the World Shaper hurling an ice moon down to Abeir - Toril ' s surface . Sarrukh accounts dated around - 31000 DR mentioned a " changing of the stars " in relation to this event .

title: Sea of Moving Ice
description: Sea of Moving Ice The Sea of Moving Ice is the northernmost place in known Faerûn . Almost completely uncharted , it is filled with icebergs and isles of ice , set wide enough apart for a ship to pass . The ice of the sea changes so that all but the most experienced seafarers can be caught off guard , proof of such are a collection of ancient ice - locked ships .
description_long: Sea of Moving Ice The Sea of Moving Ice is the northernmost place in known Faerûn . Almost completely uncharted , it is filled with icebergs and isles of ice , set wide enough apart for a ship to pass . The ice of the sea changes so that all but the most experienced seafarers can be caught off guard , proof of such are a collection of ancient ice - locked ships . Inhabitants . Along with seals , walrus and polar bears , the Sea of Moving is also home to other dangers . Lairs of ice troll s can often be found in errant shipwrecks and white dragon s often make home within larger icebergs . Portals . A portal on the Sea of Moving Ice led to the High Ice .

title: Sea of Swords
description: Sea of Swords The Sea of Swords separates the western coast of Faerûn from the Nelanther Isles , the Moonshaes , Evermeet , Lantan and the further off areas of Abeir - Toril such as Maztica . History . The famed explorer Balduran was the first noted Faerûnian to explore the sea extensively , returning with wealth enough to build a huge city , a fine ship , and with enough left over to retire comfortably .
description_long: Sea of Swords The Sea of Swords separates the western coast of Faerûn from the Nelanther Isles , the Moonshaes , Evermeet , Lantan and the further off areas of Abeir - Toril such as Maztica . History . The famed explorer Balduran was the first noted Faerûnian to explore the sea extensively , returning with wealth enough to build a huge city , a fine ship , and with enough left over to retire comfortably . The sea was named for its numerous pirate attacks upon the shipping route extending from Waterdeep in the north , to Calimshan in the south . Piracy in the region was rampant despite the efforts of the navies of various Sword Coast ports and pirate hunters . Inhabitants . Ships operating in the Sea of Swords often carried trade between the ports of Luskan , Neverwinter , Waterdeep , Baldur ' s Gate , Athkatla , Murann , Velen , Zazesspur , Myratma , Memnon , and Calimport .

title: Sea of Swords ( novel )
description: Sea of Swords ( novel ) Sea of Swords is the fourth book in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Sea of Swords ( novel ) Sea of Swords is the fourth book in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore . Summary . Le ' lorinel has been practicing fighting for years merely to get a chance to kill Drizzt Do ' Urden . The elf fighter is even willing to join the murderous Sheila Kree to get a chance at a duel with him . But Le ' lorinel may or may not be underestimating the skills of the drow . When the elf is challenged , Le ' lorinel is prone to extreme anger and is not afraid to do anything , even kill innocents . Le ' lorinel claims that it would be his pleasure to drive a dagger into the heart of every drow child , just for a chance at Drizzt . However , Le ' lorinel is actually a female moon elf in disguise , wrongfully seeking Drizzt to exact revenge for him killing her family , which happened in the first book of " Legend of Drizzt " , " Homeland " . In truth , Drizzt was the one that saved her , killing no surface elf that day . At the end of the book , there is a battle , and Drizzt tells his friends to save her , but they save him instead . Main characters .

title: Sea sight
description: Sea sight Sea sight was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .
description_long: Sea sight Sea sight was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects . With this spell the target could see through water twice as well as they could on land . Water clarity still affected the distance the target could view . Targets could even stare down into water from a boat without having their vision disturbed by reflections . Components . This spell required the eye of an octopus or squid to cast .

title: Sea spawn
description: Sea spawn Sea spawn were humanoids that were transformed into hybrid marine creatures by making a pact with a powerful marine entity , such as a dragon turtle , a kraken , a marid , a morkoth , a sea hag or a storm giant or by suffering a curse from one such entity . Once transformed , the sea spawn became a minion of one such creature and could never stay away from the sea for too long . History .
description_long: Sea spawn Sea spawn were humanoids that were transformed into hybrid marine creatures by making a pact with a powerful marine entity , such as a dragon turtle , a kraken , a marid , a morkoth , a sea hag or a storm giant or by suffering a curse from one such entity . Once transformed , the sea spawn became a minion of one such creature and could never stay away from the sea for too long . History . It was said that the human inhabitants of the Purple Rocks were claimed as infants by the kraken Slarkrethel and became fanatics dedicated to him . They grew up as humans but became sea spawn when they reached old age to return to their master . The cult was tended by kraken priest s , who were mostly natives but could also include merfolk , merrow , and sea elves .

title: Sea wyrm
description: Sea wyrm Sea wyrms were legless and wingless dragon s that inhabited the oceans and seas surrounding Zakhara . Description . Sea wyrms did not have legs or wings on their elongated bodies .
description_long: Sea wyrm Sea wyrms were legless and wingless dragon s that inhabited the oceans and seas surrounding Zakhara . Description . Sea wyrms did not have legs or wings on their elongated bodies . Combat . Sea wyrms were generally peaceful creatures and rarely attacked unless their territory was disturbed . These creatures did not get stronger as they grew larger , so small young sea wyrms could cause just as much damage as larger older ones . Sea wyrms could execute a constricting attack capable of harming living creatures and ships alike . They were capable of dragging ships equal to their size under the sea . Older sea wyrms could use their breath weapon , which was a blast of sleep - inducing gas . Habitat / Society . Sea wyrms lived underwater or on land , being able to breathe air and water equally well . They could slither on land similar to a snake . Their favorite food was fish or fruit , but they ate anything they could find . Sea wyrms lived in small groups and mated for life . Females only produced one egg from mating . Sea wyrm babies made great pets if they were captured at an early age .

title: Seal of fate
description: Seal of fate The Seal of fate was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item appeared as a seal with letters carved deeply into its surface .
description_long: Seal of fate The Seal of fate was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item appeared as a seal with letters carved deeply into its surface . Powers . If pressed against someone ' s palm , the seal would mark them with a magical imprint . The mark was invisible but did radiate magic and could be seen by casting a " detect invisibility " spell . A person could only be marked once . With this mark a person could attempt to alter the fate of any outcome to their favor . Each time the seal was used there was a chance that it would disappear forever .

title: Sean K . Reynolds
description: Sean K . Reynolds Sean K . Reynolds is a professional game designer who has worked on and co - written a number of Dungeons & Dragons supplements for Wizards of the Coast , as well as material for other companies .
description_long: Sean K . Reynolds Sean K . Reynolds is a professional game designer who has worked on and co - written a number of Dungeons & Dragons supplements for Wizards of the Coast , as well as material for other companies . History . Reynolds first entered the role - playing game industry in 1995 , when he was hired by TSR , Inc . as their online coordinator , beating out for the same position . When TSR was bought out by Wizards of the Coast ( WotC ) in 1997 , Reynolds became part of the WotC web team . Reynolds considers one of his greatest achievements of this time to be the fact that he got TSR / Wotc to relax its " draconian " online policy — enforcement of which in the past was the cause of much bad blood between the company and fans . Reynolds also did some design work for the company during this period , writing RPGA adventures and contributing to " Children of the Night : Ghosts " . By 1998 , Reynolds had left his web position and was working full time for WotC as a designer as part of " Team Greyhawk , " the creative team tasked with revitalizing TSR / WotC ' s oldest campaign setting . Reynolds was laid off from WotC in 2002 , and since has formed his own company , " Sean K .

title: Search for the Diamond Staff
description: Search for the Diamond Staff Search for the Diamond Staff was an adventure module for the D & D Encounters program in 2013 , for the 4th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Plot Synopsis . Following on from the events of Vault of the Dracolich , the sage Imani organises an expedition to one of Uvaeren ' s library - vaults .
description_long: Search for the Diamond Staff Search for the Diamond Staff was an adventure module for the D & D Encounters program in 2013 , for the 4th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Plot Synopsis . Following on from the events of Vault of the Dracolich , the sage Imani organises an expedition to one of Uvaeren ' s library - vaults . However , orcs from the Fangfist tribe steal the " Diamond Staff of Chomylla " from Imani ' s tower . The Zhentarim are the true culprits but they have merely been hired by a sembia n mage to obtain the staff for his shadovar masters , however , the leader of the contingent of mercenaries betrays her employer to keep the " Staff " for herself . The woman fled to Peldan ' s Helm in Mistledale , where she hoped to open the Vault of Song and plunder the artifacts and lore held within but was being chased by Dretchroyaster ' s dragon cultist minions . A three - way battle for the " Staff " ensues inside the Vault between agents of Imani , the Zhentarim and the cultists .

title: Seatower of Balduran
description: Seatower of Balduran The massive Seatower of Balduran rested on a rocky island in the bay of Baldur ' s Gate . History . Named after Balduran , the tower could be reached by a bridge from the western shore linking it to the mainland .
description_long: Seatower of Balduran The massive Seatower of Balduran rested on a rocky island in the bay of Baldur ' s Gate . History . Named after Balduran , the tower could be reached by a bridge from the western shore linking it to the mainland . It was used as a barracks , naval base , dungeon , and fortress . Interior . It had a full armory and catapults to battle hostile ships , and a massive chain which could be stretched from it to the outermost wharf on the east side to bar the harbor to invaders .

title: Seawind Alley
description: Seawind Alley Seawind Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep notable for the ghostly voices that could be heard within the alley . Inhabitants . The voices were harmless and usually spoke nothing but nonsensical phrases .
description_long: Seawind Alley Seawind Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep notable for the ghostly voices that could be heard within the alley . Inhabitants . The voices were harmless and usually spoke nothing but nonsensical phrases . The only resident of note was the Avolakia Briarbones who lived in the sewers under the alley so he could study the phenomenon of the voices . History . Around 1267 DR , the alley led to an inn known as the Banshee at Bay . One night everyone in the establishment was found dead from an unknown disease and many inhabitants of Waterdeep stated the restless spirits of those killed haunt the alleyway .

title: Sebastian Stoe
description: Sebastian Stoe Sebastian Stoe was a boy in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Sebastian was the son of Blazen Stoe .
description_long: Sebastian Stoe Sebastian Stoe was a boy in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Sebastian was the son of Blazen Stoe . He was interested in Ilva . History . In 1491 DR , Sebastian fell in love with Ilva , a girl who worked in a bar . She introduced him to meetings held by a strange dwarf prophet . Believing Ilva to be totally inappropriate for a Blade ' s son , Blazen confronted Sebastian , urging him to break off the relationship but instead he ran away from home . An adventuring party hired by Count Stoe eventually saved him from a strange flame at the meeting room .

title: Sebastion
description: Sebastion Sebastion was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Sebastion had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .
description_long: Sebastion Sebastion was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Sebastion had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt . He was clean - shaven . Sebastion typically wore a simple tunic with a large amount of silver jewelry . His eyes were silver - colored . Possessions . Sebastion bore a sword in battle . History . By 1369 DR , the then - paramount of the storm giants of Mount Woe , Anastes , and five other storm giants were summoned magically by Lanaxis to defend him when he needed to rest during his kidnapping of Queen Brianna and her son Kaedlaw . Sebastion was one of those giants . Patma and Sebastion were chosen to find wine and vegetables for Brianna to eat , but during this time , Tavis Burdun and armies of giant - kin attacked . Patma and Sebastion were then ordered by Anastes to deal with the firbolg s . Sebastion was the first storm giant to fall in the battle , when Tavis blew him apart with one of his powerful rune arrows crafted by the verbeeg Basil .

title: Sebek
description: Sebek Sebek ( pronounced " seh " - beck ) is a jealous , vain , and evil member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Know as Sebethant in Thay and by the name Sebakar in Unther , he delights in devouring humans . History .
description_long: Sebek Sebek ( pronounced " seh " - beck ) is a jealous , vain , and evil member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Know as Sebethant in Thay and by the name Sebakar in Unther , he delights in devouring humans . History . Prior to the Time of Troubles , the largest sect of Sebek ' s worshipers were expelled from Mulhorand by the Brotherhood of Those Who Smile in the Face of Death . They have since resettled in Chessenta . Relationships . Sebek is an outcast in the eyes of the rest of the Mulhorandi pantheon , though he has been known to occasionally ally with Set . Sebek often conflicts with Malar , who dislikes the Mulhorandi deity for possessing a portion of his portfolio of lycanthropes . Avatar . Sebek usually appears in one of two forms . The first , known as the Lord of Crocodiles , is that of a Mulan man possessing the head of a crocodile . This form typically wears a horned and plumed headdress . The second form , known as the Smiling Death , is that of a giant crocodile . Powers and abilities . Sebek can summon and control crocodiles at will , and has been known to swallow boats and living creatures whole . Other manifestations . Sebek rarely manifests in the material world .

title: Secomber
description: Secomber Secomber was a small , peaceful town that acted as the " de facto " border town between the relatively peaceful Western Heartlands and the more savage North along the Sword Coast . The town contained a number of colorful gardens . Geography .
description_long: Secomber Secomber was a small , peaceful town that acted as the " de facto " border town between the relatively peaceful Western Heartlands and the more savage North along the Sword Coast . The town contained a number of colorful gardens . Geography . It sat atop three stone hills on the northern banks of the southern - running Unicorn Run river and the western - running River Delimbiyr . Directly south of the town was the dangerous High Moor . To the north , along the Secomber Trail , was Uluvin . Government . Around 1367 DR , Secomber was ruled by Traskar Selarn , a ranger who truly had the best interests of the townsfolk at heart , and he was seen as one of the people by his loyal subjects . Law & Order . Secomber ' s justice system was a basis for most of the settlements in the Western Heartlands . The town judiciary , known as Rods of Justice , were respected elders who were elected every four years . At any one time there were between six and nine Rods depending on how many were deemed to be required to serve . If a majority of the other Rods voted for it , they could dismiss any one Rod from their company at any time and every Rod could also resign willingly at any time .

title: Second Sundering
description: Second Sundering The Second Sundering ( sometimes called the Sundering of Toril and Abeir ) was a catastrophic event in the history of Toril . Events . Overview .
description_long: Second Sundering The Second Sundering ( sometimes called the Sundering of Toril and Abeir ) was a catastrophic event in the history of Toril . Events . Overview . When Ao the Overgod destroyed the Tablets of Fate at the conclusion of the Time of Troubles , he instigated the Era of Upheaval . The Tablets defined the laws of Realmspace and kept it relatively stable . Without them , chaos ensued and the worlds of Abeir and Toril , separated many thousands of years ago , slowly started to overlap . The Spellplague drastically sped up this process . The Second Sundering involves the re - separation of the worlds of Abeir and Toril . In addition , Ao rewrote the Tablets of Fate . The deities were unsure of what this would do to them and their power , and made efforts with their most powerful servants to prepare for that event . The Second Sundering is somehow connected to the First Sundering that took place around - 17600 DR when an elven High Magic ritual went both forward and backward in time to create Evermeet . 1482 DR . The god of murder , Bhaal , is reborn in Baldur ' s Gate , apparently reclaiming the murder domain from Cyric . 1484 DR .

title: Second battle of Shadowdale
description: Second battle of Shadowdale The second battle of Shadowdale ( often referred to as simply the battle of Shadowdale ) was a battle fought in Shadowdale within the Dalelands in 1358 DR , between the defending forces of the Dalelands , and troops from Zhentil Keep , led by Bane .
description_long: Second battle of Shadowdale The second battle of Shadowdale ( often referred to as simply the battle of Shadowdale ) was a battle fought in Shadowdale within the Dalelands in 1358 DR , between the defending forces of the Dalelands , and troops from Zhentil Keep , led by Bane .

title: Second inter - dale war
description: Second inter - dale war The second inter - dale war occurred in 1356 DR when Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale invaded a number of other dales . His forces quickly overcame Battledale , Featherdale and Harrowdale , and soon began invading Deepingdale and Mistledale . However , Cormyr , Hillsfar , Sembia and Zhentil Keep were displeased by Lord Lashan Aumersair ' s intentions , and an alliance was formed , which saw his defeat and the collapse of his " empire " .
description_long: Second inter - dale war The second inter - dale war occurred in 1356 DR when Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale invaded a number of other dales . His forces quickly overcame Battledale , Featherdale and Harrowdale , and soon began invading Deepingdale and Mistledale . However , Cormyr , Hillsfar , Sembia and Zhentil Keep were displeased by Lord Lashan Aumersair ' s intentions , and an alliance was formed , which saw his defeat and the collapse of his " empire " . Combatants . Thaeron , swordmaster to Lord Elmaer Oraun almost two centuries prior to the battle , who had been living under the guise of farmer Durthar Morgath , but revealing himself as " Thaeron , Rightful Swordmaster of Harrowdale " , rallied men from northern Harrowdale to fight against Lashan , and was killed in the battle .

title: Secret of Phantoms ' Cloister
description: Secret of Phantoms ' Cloister In the last adventure , the party entered the Mind of Karsus , where an unspoiled version of Phantom ' s Cloister , called the Monastery of the Fallen One , exists . It is populated by the shades of monks who worshiped the momentary god but now desire only release from their extraplanar prison . Along the way , the party can rescue a relative of the High Lord of Loudwater , Nardine Twohands .
description_long: Secret of Phantoms ' Cloister In the last adventure , the party entered the Mind of Karsus , where an unspoiled version of Phantom ' s Cloister , called the Monastery of the Fallen One , exists . It is populated by the shades of monks who worshiped the momentary god but now desire only release from their extraplanar prison . Along the way , the party can rescue a relative of the High Lord of Loudwater , Nardine Twohands . NOTE : Secret of Phantom ' s Cloister was never publicly released . Information about the content of the adventure is taken from other modules that were released .

title: Secret of the Silver Blades
description: Secret of the Silver Blades Secret of the Silver Blades is the third title in the four - game " Forgotten Realms " series of computer role - playing games developed and published by Strategic Simulations , Inc . It is the sequel to " Curse of the Azure Bonds " . Story .
description_long: Secret of the Silver Blades Secret of the Silver Blades is the third title in the four - game " Forgotten Realms " series of computer role - playing games developed and published by Strategic Simulations , Inc . It is the sequel to " Curse of the Azure Bonds " . Story . The party is magically summoned to the mining town of New Verdigris , located in a valley deep in the Dragonspine Mountains , in hopes that they will save the town from the overwhelming evil that threatens it . New Verdigris is located on the ruins of a much older city that was suddenly covered by a glacier three hundred years ago . However , the glacier is now receding , which led to the town being reestablished and the resumption of mining operations . While New Verdigris initially prospered , three months ago , a new mineshaft was opened and monsters began pouring through from an unknown source . Previous efforts to stop the monsters have failed and they have made it to the ruins and are threatening to invade the town . The party is the town ' s last hope of finding the source of the evil and clearing the scourge .

It was promised to buyers of the original edition of the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " , if they joined the " Order of Heroes " via the enclosed customer response card . It was dated Summer 1988 and contained : This was the only issue of the newsletter actually published .

title: Secure
description: Secure Secure was an arcane alteration spell that protected a door , portal , or chest from being opened or passed through , although it could eventually be physically destroyed . Effects . This spell prevented even the caster from opening a chest or passing through a door or portal that had been " secured " .
description_long: Secure Secure was an arcane alteration spell that protected a door , portal , or chest from being opened or passed through , although it could eventually be physically destroyed . Effects . This spell prevented even the caster from opening a chest or passing through a door or portal that had been " secured " . The only known means for removing this spell were by a successful " dispel magic " , powerful spells such as " limited wish " , or potent magic items like " chimes of opening " . Otherwise , the object was impervious to fire , cold , electricity , and " knock " , as well as spells that altered the material of the protected area , such as " dig " , " reduce " , " transmute rock to mud " , and " vanish " . Any attempt to place a " glyph " , " rune " , or " symbol " on the " secured " object resulted in immediate triggering or detonation of those effects . If " detect magic " or similar divination spells are used , they would register strong alteration magic in the area protected by this spell . This spell was permanent until dispelled and could be applied to one chest or an area up to 10 ft ( 0 . 93 m ) per level of the caster .

title: Sedge
description: Sedge Sedge was a halfling bard in Neverwinter . Activities . Around 1479 DR , Sedge made his living as a fireside companion for hire , bodyguard , and teller of tales .
description_long: Sedge Sedge was a halfling bard in Neverwinter . Activities . Around 1479 DR , Sedge made his living as a fireside companion for hire , bodyguard , and teller of tales . One of his preferred spots was the Moonstone Mask inn in the Protector ' s Enclave .

title: Sedina Wolfpaw
description: Sedina Wolfpaw Sedina Wolpaw was a scout in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Sedina hailed from Triboar .
description_long: Sedina Wolfpaw Sedina Wolpaw was a scout in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Sedina hailed from Triboar . In 1491 DR she was in Westbridge , where she could have helped some adventurers defeat a remnant cell of the Cult of the Black Earth in that city .

title: Sedji al - Sanje
description: Sedji al - Sanje Sedji al - Sanje was a mamluk of the Valiant who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sedji was the commander of the guards stationed at the Grand Gate of Delights , protecting the main entrance to the palace .
description_long: Sedji al - Sanje Sedji al - Sanje was a mamluk of the Valiant who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sedji was the commander of the guards stationed at the Grand Gate of Delights , protecting the main entrance to the palace . He earned his current position from a promotion after he recognized a holy slayer who attempted to enter the palace , spoiling an assassination attempt before it even began . Sedji recognized the assassin from his previous travels throughout Zakhara . He had his own apartment in the Hall of Commanders . History . Sedji traveled all across Zakhara in his youth .

title: See invisibility
description: See invisibility See invisibility , or detect invisibility , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to see invisible or ethereal creatures and objects . Some creatures had the magical ability to always see invisibility , such as helmed horror s , jade spider s , marid s , and other creatures . Effects .
description_long: See invisibility See invisibility , or detect invisibility , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to see invisible or ethereal creatures and objects . Some creatures had the magical ability to always see invisibility , such as helmed horror s , jade spider s , marid s , and other creatures . Effects . When cast , the spellcaster ' s eyes could see invisible and ethereal things as translucent shapes for a distance as far as he or she could normally see . It was easy to determine which things were visible as opposed to invisible while under the effects of the spell . The spell did not provide any information about whether the invisibility was the result of a spell or of some supernatural quality . It did not permit the caster to see through other opaque objects . Someone or something hidden in a natural manner was not revealed by this spell . The ability provided lasted at least a half hour and longer if cast by a more powerful spellcaster . The effect could also be made permanent . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic component s , a pinch of talc , and a tiny sprinkling of powdered silver .

title: Seeing Stones
description: Seeing Stones The Seeing Stones were a magical set of stones used for communication . Abilities . The Seeing Stones allowed communication between two individuals regardless of the distance .
description_long: Seeing Stones The Seeing Stones were a magical set of stones used for communication . Abilities . The Seeing Stones allowed communication between two individuals regardless of the distance . History . The Seeing Stones were considered to be a state treasure of the kingdom of Eskorn , in Returned Abeir . As of 1479 DR , the stones were used by King Ornan Roaryl to communicate with his seneschal , Mreskan Haundle , whenever the king was traveling across his realm .

title: Seeking
description: Seeking Seeking was a weapon quality that could only be applied to ranged weapons . When fired at a target , the ammunition of these weapons would veer toward the target , moving around anything concealing or obscuring it . However , it would not seek out enemies if their whereabouts were not known to the wielder .
description_long: Seeking Seeking was a weapon quality that could only be applied to ranged weapons . When fired at a target , the ammunition of these weapons would veer toward the target , moving around anything concealing or obscuring it . However , it would not seek out enemies if their whereabouts were not known to the wielder . It required a spell of " true seeing " in the weapon ' s creation .

title: Seerah
description: Seerah Seerah was a ranger and a member of the Order of Blue Flame . Description . She had pale skin and blonde hair .
description_long: Seerah Seerah was a ranger and a member of the Order of Blue Flame . Description . She had pale skin and blonde hair . She wore worn leather armor with a short sword at her hip and a crossbow on her back . Personality . She did not speak much , and when she did it was often to curse . History . Seerah was killed in 1479 DR when Duvan threw a dagger coated with a paralyzing poison into her thigh .

title: Seerat
description: Seerat Seerat the Green was an Emerald Enclave druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . When the black dragon Throstulgrael arrived in the area , Seerat was captured by the dragon ' s kobold minions .
description_long: Seerat Seerat the Green was an Emerald Enclave druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . When the black dragon Throstulgrael arrived in the area , Seerat was captured by the dragon ' s kobold minions . Later , fellow Enclave member Seranolla asked an adventuring party sent to recover some items from the dragon ' s lair to free him but unfortunately Seerat had been killed some time before by the kobolds .

title: Sefer al - Raq
description: Sefer al - Raq Sefer al - Raq was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . As a priest of Kossuth and staunch member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame , Sefer was tasked with recruiting potential members for the Brotherhood from the efreeti city .
description_long: Sefer al - Raq Sefer al - Raq was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . As a priest of Kossuth and staunch member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame , Sefer was tasked with recruiting potential members for the Brotherhood from the efreeti city . Rumors & Legends . Sefer was rumored to be the lover of Jamina al - Mubarak , the Brotherhood ' s ambassador in the City of Brass .

title: Segojan Earthcaller
description: Segojan Earthcaller Segojan Earthcaller was the neutral good gnome deity of earth and nature . Unlike his ally Baervan Wildwanderer , who was a god of the plants and forests of the surface world , Segojan ' s area of concern was the deep earth and the life within it . Segojan was also seen as the gnomish god of the dead , for the forgotten folk interred their fallen kin into his domain .
description_long: Segojan Earthcaller Segojan Earthcaller was the neutral good gnome deity of earth and nature . Unlike his ally Baervan Wildwanderer , who was a god of the plants and forests of the surface world , Segojan ' s area of concern was the deep earth and the life within it . Segojan was also seen as the gnomish god of the dead , for the forgotten folk interred their fallen kin into his domain . His holy symbol was a glowing gemstone ; usually this was a finely cut gem of any type in which illusion spells had been cast to provide magical light . This could be any gem , but Segojan is associated strongly with diamond s . His sacred animal was the badger . Followers . The highly organized Church of Segojan was prominent within most rock gnome communities . In conjunction with the Church of Baervan Wildwanderer , they worked to protect and preserve the natural world , especially below the surface . With the Church of Flandal Steelskin they oversaw the safety of mining operations , and with the Church of Callarduran Smoothhands they sought to forge ties between settlements of deep gnomes in the Underdark and rock gnomes on the surface . Relationships .

title: Sehanine Moonbow
description: Sehanine Moonbow Sehanine Moonbow ( pronounced " seh " - ha - neen " moon " - boe ) is the fey aspect of Selûne , god dess of the moon . She is one of the more powerful members of the Seldarine . The Lady of Dreams actively opposes the nefarious schemes of the Spider Queen and the other drow powers .
description_long: Sehanine Moonbow Sehanine Moonbow ( pronounced " seh " - ha - neen " moon " - boe ) is the fey aspect of Selûne , god dess of the moon . She is one of the more powerful members of the Seldarine . The Lady of Dreams actively opposes the nefarious schemes of the Spider Queen and the other drow powers . She is said to be the wife of Corellon Larethian . Sehanine lives in the realm of Arvandor . As befits the elven goddess of mysteries , Sehanine is cloaked in secrets and illusions and rarely speaks her mind directly , preferring to communicate through a process of dreams , visions , and other mystic experiences . The Goddess of Moonlight is truly spiritual and ephemeral being who evades any attempt to define her and whose serenity surrounds her like a mantle of moondust . Worshipers . Worshipers of Sehanine Moonbow seek out and destroy undead creatures , for Sehanine holds such creatures - - with the notable exceptions of baelnorn and other good - aligned undead beings who voluntarily prolong their existence in order to serve their kin - - to be blasphemous . Relationships .

title: Sehlmari Ssemm
description: Sehlmari Ssemm Sehlmari Ssemm was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Sehlmari was the morale officer and quartermaster of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .
description_long: Sehlmari Ssemm Sehlmari Ssemm was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Sehlmari was the morale officer and quartermaster of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate . She always went a day ahead of the troops with a platoon to buy , gather , or commandeer food , drink , and other necessities . She was a master haggler , always taking what she needed for the troops . Sehlmari had also a lovable sense of humor .

title: Sei
description: Sei Sei was a helpful spirit in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Sei was the spirit of a cherry blossom living near the cursed Ito - Jo .
description_long: Sei Sei was a helpful spirit in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Sei was the spirit of a cherry blossom living near the cursed Ito - Jo . Due to the evil influence of the castle , her kin were decimated and her cousin was captured by the evil inhabitants of castle . In 1360 DR , she met an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to recover the Seven Swords from the castle . She told them all about the damnation of the Ito family and warned them about the seven guardians of the swords . Personality . Sei was shy and demure at first . She greatly resented all the death and misfortune brought by the Seven Swords clan and would help anyone who could stop this evil .

title: Seila Norwood
description: Seila Norwood Seila Norwood was a young noblewoman of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . She was the quintessential damsel in distress and was best known for her romantic attachment to Jack Ravenwild . Description .
description_long: Seila Norwood Seila Norwood was a young noblewoman of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . She was the quintessential damsel in distress and was best known for her romantic attachment to Jack Ravenwild . Description . Seila was pretty and had green eyes . Relationships . Seila was romantically attracted to Jack although she didn ' t quite trust him due to his lies about his noble background . History . In 1479 DR , Seila was traveling with a caravan near Ravens Bluff . The convoy was attacked by a gang led by the infamous slaver Fetterfists and the survivors were sold into slavery to the drow who lived in the Underdark beneath Ravens Bluff . Seila was forced to work as a scullery maid in the kitchens of the drow castle . During her enslavement , she met a fellow slave named Jack Ravenwild who rescued her and returned her to her father , Lord Norwood .

title: Seiveril Miritar
description: Seiveril Miritar Lord Seiveril Miritar ( also Councilor Seiveril Miritar and Lord of Elion ) of the Miritar clan was a sun elf high priest of Corellon Larethian and a councilor of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He lived at Seamist , the Miritar palace . He was over four hundred years old .
description_long: Seiveril Miritar Lord Seiveril Miritar ( also Councilor Seiveril Miritar and Lord of Elion ) of the Miritar clan was a sun elf high priest of Corellon Larethian and a councilor of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He lived at Seamist , the Miritar palace . He was over four hundred years old . Seiveril also owned a townhouse on a hill overlooking the harbour in Leuthilspar . Description . Seiveril was slim with coppery red hair streaked with silver , and although he had thin lines at the corners of his mouth and around his eyes , he was still fit . History . As a boy , Seiveril ' s father Elkhazel told him many stories of the heroism of Fflar Starbrow Melruth and he became Seiveril ' s boyhood hero . Elkhazel also told him about Fflar ' s sword Keryvian , and he retrieved it , mounting it in his home . Seiveril would later resurrect Fflar to fight alongside him . He died in the final battle of the reclaiming of Myth Drannor . Status . Seiveril had been a member of the Council of Evermeet for eighty years by virtue of his governorship over the town of Elion .

title: Sekrr
description: Sekrr Sekrr was a male beholder who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Description . Sekrr looked much like most beholders with ten writhing eye stalks atop his orb - like body .
description_long: Sekrr Sekrr was a male beholder who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Description . Sekrr looked much like most beholders with ten writhing eye stalks atop his orb - like body . He had bright blue eyes and rich , maroon - coloured hide , though a number of his teeth were missing from his bottom jaw . Personality . Considering himself to be a creative and artistic example of his kind , Sekrr liked to ' craft ' sculptures of the creatures he petrified with his eye rays . History . By 1372 DR , Sekrr had made Vournoth ' s Mire his home along with a mind flayer called Quthnorak . Though they usually left each other to their own devices , on occasion they would work together on some project or to defend their joint lair . During the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , when the nearby city of Maerimydra was destroyed by the forces of Kurgoth Hellspawn , a number of drow refugees made their way through Vournoth ' s Mire . Sekrr managed to catch the rear of their party and killed at least three of the drow with his eye rays before coming away with three charmed drow thralls .

title: Sela Kitar
description: Sela Kitar Sela Kitar was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sela had the immense responsibility of coordinating all of the activity within the warehouses of the House of Al - Danafi .
description_long: Sela Kitar Sela Kitar was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sela had the immense responsibility of coordinating all of the activity within the warehouses of the House of Al - Danafi . She was a capable administrator who rose to the challenge .

title: Selan
description: Selan Selan was the goddess of beauty of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and stood for the beauty that lay in everything . Selan ' s symbol was a moon within a ring .
description_long: Selan Selan was the goddess of beauty of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and stood for the beauty that lay in everything . Selan ' s symbol was a moon within a ring . The goddess was described as a flawless maiden cloaked in white . Old tales linked her with the moon , which was said to be her chariot . Like other Zakharan gods she was above such concerns as alignment , as beauty may be craved and valued by good and evil folk alike . Selan ' s followers placed much stock in appearances , but also valued inner beauty . The tried to treat everyone with care and to emphasize that which was positive in themselves and others . Many gardeners and artisans were among Selan ' s worshipers . The bulk of her priesthood consisted of ethoist s with a mainly traditional outlook . Her most important center of worship was the Great Mosque of the Moon in Medina al - Afyal . Relationships . The Faerûnian deity Selûne was a moon goddess that shared a similar name and outlook with Selan , but had a somewhat different portfolio . Thus the connection between the two remained a mystery .
