title: Selanith L ' baros
description: Selanith L ' baros Selanith L ' baros was a female Crinti half - drow ( though 1 / 32 drow ) and the baroness of Herath , a city in Dambrath in the Shining South . Personality . Selanith was a cruel woman who greatly enjoyed contests and games that ended in the death of the loser .
description_long: Selanith L ' baros Selanith L ' baros was a female Crinti half - drow ( though 1 / 32 drow ) and the baroness of Herath , a city in Dambrath in the Shining South . Personality . Selanith was a cruel woman who greatly enjoyed contests and games that ended in the death of the loser . However , she was generous , even lavish with winners . Although she was also highly ambitious , she was cunning and far from foolish . Description . Although officially a Crinti half - drow , Selanith was only 1 / 32nd drow and thus looked much more human than half - elf . Possessions . As well as being the ruler of the city of Herath , Selanith had a vast estate and owned a dozen ranchos and some 10 , 000 horse s . She also took a cut off all trade within her domain and controlled its mines . All this made Selanith L ' baros fabulously wealthy , in fact , the richest woman in Dambrath . If drawn into combat , she wielded a whip . Activities . Ambitious and distantly related to the queen , Selanith hoped to become queen herself someday , or to have a daughter or granddaughter ascend the throne , as many Crinti did .

title: Selantha
description: Selantha Selantha was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Selantha managed a stone - and - wood shop alone from 1364 DR , when her husband disappeared on a trading mission .
description_long: Selantha Selantha was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Selantha managed a stone - and - wood shop alone from 1364 DR , when her husband disappeared on a trading mission . She specialized in intricate decorative filigree work on armor . In 1368 DR , she befriend the mercenary Sergeant Belan Kargis , who courted her . Selantha , however , wanted to know the true fate of her husband before marrying another man .

title: Seldarine
description: Seldarine The Seldarine ( Elvish for " fellowship of brothers and sisters of the wood " ) was the elven pantheon of gods that resided on the astral dominion of Arvandor under the leadership of Corellon Larethian . Pre - Spellplague . Before the Spellplague , the Seldarine consisted of : Post - Spellplague .
description_long: Seldarine The Seldarine ( Elvish for " fellowship of brothers and sisters of the wood " ) was the elven pantheon of gods that resided on the astral dominion of Arvandor under the leadership of Corellon Larethian . Pre - Spellplague . Before the Spellplague , the Seldarine consisted of : Post - Spellplague . The events of the Spellplague were tumultuous . Sehanine became a fey aspect of the goddess Selûne , and Hanali an aspect of Sune . Likewise , Aerdrie became the primordial Akadi , and Rillifane went missing . The other elven gods , except Angharradh , lost so much power that they became exarch s in the service of Corellon .

title: Seldig
description: Seldig Seldig was a deep gnome fighter / illusionist from Blingdenstone . History . Around 1357 DR , Seldig ’ s svirfneblin patrol encountered Catti - brie disguised as a drow female , with the help of Agatha ' s mask .
description_long: Seldig Seldig was a deep gnome fighter / illusionist from Blingdenstone . History . Around 1357 DR , Seldig ’ s svirfneblin patrol encountered Catti - brie disguised as a drow female , with the help of Agatha ' s mask . In 1338 DR , Seldig and fellow gnome , Pumkato , played with Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s panther , Guenhwyvar , and they recognized the powerful beast as a friend , so they stopped the attack on Catti - brie . In 1362 DR , the deep gnome finally , like his longtime friend Pumkato , become a burrow warden .

title: Seldinor Stormcloak
description: Seldinor Stormcloak Seldinor Stormcloak was a male magelord who was one of the most powerful magelords of Athalantar . Description . As a tall man , Seldinor was attractive and extremely charismatic .
description_long: Seldinor Stormcloak Seldinor Stormcloak was a male magelord who was one of the most powerful magelords of Athalantar . Description . As a tall man , Seldinor was attractive and extremely charismatic . Personality . He had a retinue of apprentices and one of his favorite fields of study was the creation of golem s . Relationships . Seldinor was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , second only to Neldryn Hawklyn together with Kadeln Olothstar . History . Around 240 DR , the magelord had his head torn off by his own golem with the help of Elminster Aumar and Myrjala Talithyn .

title: Seldra Tylmarande
description: Seldra Tylmarande Seldra Tylmarande was a half - elf woman who attempted to claim the throne of Neverwinter in 1478 DR using some clever ruses . Appearance . Seldra was described as an attractive brunette half - elf of about thirty years .
description_long: Seldra Tylmarande Seldra Tylmarande was a half - elf woman who attempted to claim the throne of Neverwinter in 1478 DR using some clever ruses . Appearance . Seldra was described as an attractive brunette half - elf of about thirty years . She commonly wore leather armor with a brown cloak and wielded a longsword that she kept at her hip . She also had a spellscar on her arm . She rarely activated her spellscar , but when she did , it wreathed her arms and face in blue fire . As the " Lost Heir " , Seldra wore plate armor with a full helm that obscured her face . Atop the helm was the " Crown of Neverwinter " . She also wore a purple cloak . The Lost Heir activated his spellscar far more frequently , persuading onlookers that it was an ability imbued by the " Crown " . Biography . Seldra was born with a spellscar that allowed her to create and exert limited control over plaguechanged creatures . She claimed to have inherited it from her father . Seldra was a spy in service to Dagult Neverember in Waterdeep but only took the job so that she could keep tabs on the Open Lord of Waterdeep .

title: Seldszar Elpragh
description: Seldszar Elpragh Seldszar Elpragh was the head of the College of Divination and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Seldszar became the Master of his college around 1177 DR , learning the secret about Sshamath ' s " faerzress " : it was cast by the first Master of Divination Chal ' dzar and the powerful conjurer Ythzin .
description_long: Seldszar Elpragh Seldszar Elpragh was the head of the College of Divination and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Seldszar became the Master of his college around 1177 DR , learning the secret about Sshamath ' s " faerzress " : it was cast by the first Master of Divination Chal ' dzar and the powerful conjurer Ythzin . In 1377 DR , Seldszar was the patron of Q ' arlynd Melarn , who was about to start at his new College of Ancient Arcana . Q ' arlynd recommended to the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra to trust only Seldszar when discussing a strange magical phenomena that had affected both wizards and priests . Thus , Miverra and Seldszar spoke about a magical phenomena that involved a disturbance in the " faerzress " spreading from the main temple of Kiaransalee . At last , they decided that a joint force of Eilistraee ' s priests and wizards of the College of Divinatione , including Q ' arlynd and Seldszar ' s son Eldrinn Elpragh , would scout the temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Selfaril Uoumdolphin
description: Selfaril Uoumdolphin Selfaril Uomodolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster until 1375 DR . History . Selfaril become the High Blade in 1348 DR after killing his predecessor .
description_long: Selfaril Uoumdolphin Selfaril Uomodolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster until 1375 DR . History . Selfaril become the High Blade in 1348 DR after killing his predecessor . Selfaril ruled Mulmaster for twenty - seven years until his twin brother Rassendyll Uoumdolphin seized power in 1375 DR and replaced him . Selfaril , meanwhile , was magically imprisoned by Senior Cloak Thurndan Tallwand in a soulgem in the pommel of his sword . He remained trapped in his sword for more than a century . In 1491 DR , the sword resurfaced in the Earthspur Mountains and Thurndan , who disliked the current High Blade Jaseen Drakehorn , decided to take the blade and finally free Selfaril . With the help of some adventurers , Thurndan gained possession of the blade and resurrected the former High Blade . Selfaril gained support among the citizens of Mulmaster and challenged Jaseen to a public duel . Personality . Selfaril was upset to say the least . He had , for over a hundred years , done little other than seethe over the injustice of his twin brother ' s betrayal . He was a pragmatic man , ready to deal with all kinds of being to regain his lost power .

title: Selgard ' s Smithy
description: Selgard ' s Smithy Selgard ' s Smithy was a metalworking smithy in Shadowdale , originally owned and operated by Bronn Selgard . Location . Selgard ' s Smithy lay in central Shadowdale along the North Ride between Tethgar ' s House and the Stone House .
description_long: Selgard ' s Smithy Selgard ' s Smithy was a metalworking smithy in Shadowdale , originally owned and operated by Bronn Selgard . Location . Selgard ' s Smithy lay in central Shadowdale along the North Ride between Tethgar ' s House and the Stone House . History . After Bronn ' s death to the Army of Darkhope in Nightal , 1374 DR , Bronn ' s remaining children were hardpressed to keep up with the demands for weapons and armor by the Zhentarim who were occupying the village of Shadowdale .

title: Selgaunt
description: Selgaunt Formerly known as Chancelgaunt , Selgaunt was a large merchant port on the Sea of Fallen Stars , the capital of the nation of Sembia . History . As of 1372 DR , Selgaunt was the wealthiest of Sembian cities and was ruled by merchant families .
description_long: Selgaunt Formerly known as Chancelgaunt , Selgaunt was a large merchant port on the Sea of Fallen Stars , the capital of the nation of Sembia . History . As of 1372 DR , Selgaunt was the wealthiest of Sembian cities and was ruled by merchant families . Government . The city guard were called Scepters .

title: Selger
description: Selger Selger was the Northman king of Trisk in Purple Rocks in 1370 DR but also an agent of the Kraken Society . Relationships . The Krakenar had control over Selger and Trisk for many decades .
description_long: Selger Selger was the Northman king of Trisk in Purple Rocks in 1370 DR but also an agent of the Kraken Society . Relationships . The Krakenar had control over Selger and Trisk for many decades . At first Selger was only a thrall of Vestress but thanks to the backing of the High Captain Rethnor , the king gained freedom and influence . History . Selger ' s true promotion arrived in 1368 DR when his troops conquered the vassal isle of Utheraal , which greatly pleased Slarkrethel . Later , he placed Krakenar agents in influential positions on Tuern , Gundarlun , the Icepeak , the Whalebones , and in the Korinn Archipelago . Under orders of the kraken , King Selger continued to report to Vestress , although the two hated each other .

title: Selin Ramur
description: Selin Ramur Selin Ramur was the marchion of Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Selin was the nominal ruler of Mirabar and a key member of the Lords ' Alliance .
description_long: Selin Ramur Selin Ramur was the marchion of Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Selin was the nominal ruler of Mirabar and a key member of the Lords ' Alliance . However the true power in the city was the Council of Sparkling Stones and Selin ruled only over foreign policy .

title: Selinor
description: Selinor Selinor was a sage in Ordulin . History . Around 1358 DR , Selinor ' s area of expertise was the Elven Court .
description_long: Selinor Selinor was a sage in Ordulin . History . Around 1358 DR , Selinor ' s area of expertise was the Elven Court . She often acted as an advisor for rulers who needed to negotiate with elves . The recent turmoil in Elven Court kept her busy for the next year . Selinor had five scribes who worked under her . Fees for her counsel were four times higher than normal . She also sold maps of Myth Drannor in her shop .

title: Selpir
description: Selpir The Selpir was a slow and quiet creek that forked from the Ardeep River and the South Ardeep River . Geography . From source to mouth , the Selpir was surrounded by a marshy region known as the Selpir Marsh , which extended all the way to the coast .
description_long: Selpir The Selpir was a slow and quiet creek that forked from the Ardeep River and the South Ardeep River . Geography . From source to mouth , the Selpir was surrounded by a marshy region known as the Selpir Marsh , which extended all the way to the coast . This region contained several ancient Ardeep tombs , many of which were submerged by the Selpir and breached by its flow , although a few of the tombs remained intact . Inhabitants . The Selpir Marsh was occasionally visited by groups of lizardfolk , but the region was mostly frequented by congregations of merfolk .

title: Selsharra Durothil
description: Selsharra Durothil Selsharra Durothil was a sun elf , matron of the powerful Durothil clan , and a member of the Council of Evermeet . During the daemonfey assault on elven settlements in Faerûn in 1374 DR , she and Ammisyll Veldann threatened to withdraw the support of the houses of Durothil and Veldann if Amlaruil Moonflower sent forces from Evermeet to aid the Faerûnian elves .
description_long: Selsharra Durothil Selsharra Durothil was a sun elf , matron of the powerful Durothil clan , and a member of the Council of Evermeet . During the daemonfey assault on elven settlements in Faerûn in 1374 DR , she and Ammisyll Veldann threatened to withdraw the support of the houses of Durothil and Veldann if Amlaruil Moonflower sent forces from Evermeet to aid the Faerûnian elves .

title: Selu ' kiira
description: Selu ' kiira A selu ' kiira ( or high loregem ) was an intelligent gemstone that stored knowledge and could teach this knowledge to a viewer . It could also harm the viewer if it choose not to part with its knowledge . A " selu ' kiira " was a much more complicated form of a " tel ' kiira " .
description_long: Selu ' kiira A selu ' kiira ( or high loregem ) was an intelligent gemstone that stored knowledge and could teach this knowledge to a viewer . It could also harm the viewer if it choose not to part with its knowledge . A " selu ' kiira " was a much more complicated form of a " tel ' kiira " . The amount of knowledge that the " selu ' kiira " could convey in an instant could be vast — sometimes what would otherwise take decades of study .

title: Selvetargtlin
description: Selvetargtlin The Selvetargtlin were the followers of Selvetarm , Lolth ' s champion . Their ranks were largely made up of males , finding comfort in a male god while still paying homage to Lolth . The Selvetargtlin were known for wearing blood red robes , often over a coat of chain mail .
description_long: Selvetargtlin The Selvetargtlin were the followers of Selvetarm , Lolth ' s champion . Their ranks were largely made up of males , finding comfort in a male god while still paying homage to Lolth . The Selvetargtlin were known for wearing blood red robes , often over a coat of chain mail . The clerics of Selvetarm received spells from their god for the purpose of battle . They used spells that could make poisoned blades sprouted from their bodies , as well as traditional divine healing spells . Selvetargtlin in 1375 launched an attack against the Promenade of Eilistraee . They were lead by the Judicator , Dhairn . Although the followers of Selvetarm failed to take the temple , they did considerable damage to the ranks of Eilistraee .

title: Selvetarm
description: Selvetarm Selvetarm , known also as The Spider that Waits , ( self - appointed ) Champion of Lolth or , despite being Vhaeraun ' s son and thus her grandson , Son of Lolth was the drow demigod of warriors and battle prowes . His church basically consisted of a military sub - division of Lolth ' s church , and was practically forgotten outside of his cult in Eryndlyn . In fact , the name assoicated with those followers of the Spider that Waits - - Selvetargtlin - - could be applied without problems to his entire clergy .
description_long: Selvetarm Selvetarm , known also as The Spider that Waits , ( self - appointed ) Champion of Lolth or , despite being Vhaeraun ' s son and thus her grandson , Son of Lolth was the drow demigod of warriors and battle prowes . His church basically consisted of a military sub - division of Lolth ' s church , and was practically forgotten outside of his cult in Eryndlyn . In fact , the name assoicated with those followers of the Spider that Waits - - Selvetargtlin - - could be applied without problems to his entire clergy . Personality . Selvetarm was a ruthless and violent deity , whose only interests consisted of war and spreading destruction . He could ' t find beauty in anything but lethal and efficient combat styles . He hated everything , including Lolth , to whom he was practically enslaved . Despite this hatred , he was quite dutiful , to the point of passing up on chances to gain additional worshippers to preserve her power , as well as his freedom to protect her life . Despite his aggressive traits , he had the capability to be patient to conduct functional ambushes , but frontal wild clashes were his clear preference over anything that required planning and restraint .

title: Selwyn Anderil
description: Selwyn Anderil Selwyn Anderil was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Selwyn managed a farm in the valley .
description_long: Selwyn Anderil Selwyn Anderil was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Selwyn managed a farm in the valley . History . Selwyn went to the Dessarin Valley with his wife Maygan in 1484 DR and built a farm . Later , he employed two brothers from Waterdeep , Ob and Fip Lavelle , as workers . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked the farm , capturing Maygan and the Lavelle brothers and injuring Selwyn . He was later saved by some adventurers .

title: Selydra
description: Selydra Selydra , or the Pale Sybil , was an undead wizard living in Lorosfyr in the 1370s DR . She was a kind of vampire that consumed souls and magic . History .
description_long: Selydra Selydra , or the Pale Sybil , was an undead wizard living in Lorosfyr in the 1370s DR . She was a kind of vampire that consumed souls and magic . History . Selydra went to Lorosfyr in the hopes of learning the secrets of Imaskari magecraft . In 1374 DR , Araevin Teshurr ' s party ventured into her realm in search of a shard of the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " . Selydra explained to Araevin that indeed she had the shard but she needed it to defeat the Maddening Dark . She proposed to exchange it for a thaluud scepter hidden in a vault under Anauroch . Soon , however , a battle broke out between Selydra and her minions and Araevin ' s party , but at last the elves prevailed and Araevin recovered the shard while defeating the Pale Sybil .

title: Selûnarra
description: Selûnarra Selûnarra was also known as Opus , and was a surviving Netherese city whose patron was Selûne . The city survived the phaerimm s ' magical assaults by being transported to the Gates of the Moon , Selûne ' s realm in the Astral Sea , in the Year of the Sundered Webs ( - 339 DR ) . Opus stood in stark contrast to the other enclaves of Netheril .
description_long: Selûnarra Selûnarra was also known as Opus , and was a surviving Netherese city whose patron was Selûne . The city survived the phaerimm s ' magical assaults by being transported to the Gates of the Moon , Selûne ' s realm in the Astral Sea , in the Year of the Sundered Webs ( - 339 DR ) . Opus stood in stark contrast to the other enclaves of Netheril . Where a majority of the archwizards opened up schools for magical study to increase the ranks of spellcasters , Opus instead opened up colleges , universities , and other storehouses of knowledge . Where other floating cities had gladiatorial arenas , magical spell duels , and other barbarous acts , Opus established theaters and libraries . History . Opus was established in - 1926 DR by the mentalist Chever , who spent most of his time trying to acquire knowledge after creating his contact other plane spell . It finally cost him his life in - 1899 DR , when repeated contacts with an extraplanar being drove him insane and he leaped into a sphere of annihilation . Other arcanists quickly assumed the mantle of leadership , and Opus continued to produce some of the best bards , musicians , poets , and scholars ever known in Netheril .

title: Selûne
description: Selûne Selûne ( pronounced " seh - LOON - ay " ) , also known as Our Lady of Silver and the Moonmaiden , was the goddess of the moon . She was also venerated in Faerûn as a goddess of light , stars , navigation , navigators , wanderers , questers , and goodly lycanthropes . History .
description_long: Selûne Selûne ( pronounced " seh - LOON - ay " ) , also known as Our Lady of Silver and the Moonmaiden , was the goddess of the moon . She was also venerated in Faerûn as a goddess of light , stars , navigation , navigators , wanderers , questers , and goodly lycanthropes . History . Selûne was created from the primordial essence of the universe , along with her twin sister , Shar . Together , they created Chauntea ( the embodiment of the world of Abeir - Toril ) and some other heavenly bodies and infused these areas with life . The two goddesses then fought over the fate of their creations . From these struggles emerged the original deities of magic , war , disease , murder , death , and others . Selûne reached out of the universe and from a plane of fire , brought forth a flame and ignited a heavenly body in order to give warmth to Chauntea . This greatly enraged Shar , and she began to erase all light and warmth in the universe . Desperate and weakened because of Shar ' s actions , Selûne hurled some of her divine essence at her sister . Selûne ' s essence tore through Shar , bringing some of Shar ' s essence with it .

title: Selûne ' s Eye
description: Selûne ' s Eye Selûne ' s Eye was an artifact associated with the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . History . " Selûne ' s Eye " was a matter of legend , set down in the Song of Selûne .
description_long: Selûne ' s Eye Selûne ' s Eye was an artifact associated with the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . History . " Selûne ' s Eye " was a matter of legend , set down in the Song of Selûne . It began when the wayward young goddess Selûne traveled to another plane and was smitten by a mysterious and attractive warrior , a lord of his people . The stranger persuaded her to use her father ' s wand of power to transport him and his followers to Toril , where they planned to settle . However , once they landed , he revealed his true form and intentions — he was the monstrous Imgig Zu and he and his people were intent on conquest and ruin . He seized her father ' s wand of power and intended to kill the deceived goddess . Fortunately , a brave young wizard named Ostus Agrivar who was riding by raced to her rescue . Although the wizard was not powerful enough to defeat the monsters , he was capable of causing enough confusion and chaos that Selûne could escape . The goddess , now freed from her subjugation , used the only thing she had left : her own life force .

title: Selûne ' s Smile
description: Selûne ' s Smile Selûne ' s Smile , also known as the Inn of the Crescent Moon , was a tavern devoted to Selûne in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . Services . The Church of Selûne in Waterdeep used the Smile as a base of operations .
description_long: Selûne ' s Smile Selûne ' s Smile , also known as the Inn of the Crescent Moon , was a tavern devoted to Selûne in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . Services . The Church of Selûne in Waterdeep used the Smile as a base of operations . History . In the 1350s DR , Selûne ' s Smile was a newly opened inn managed by Luna . Vajra Valmeyjar became its bouncer for a time and developed a good working relationship and friendship with Luna . It was quiet but known for its sociable and friendly atmosphere . However , by 1357 DR , it had grown rather rowdy — when next Vajra entered , she stepped into a brawl , but quelled it by her very presence . She ' d been summoned by Luna to help with a task : Cybriana , Timoth Eyesbright , and Onyx the Invincible had been seeking the paladin Priam Agrivar , finally arriving at the Smile . Luna introduced them , and Vajra led them to Priam — the drunken beggar outside , whom they rescued from thugs . They all stayed in the tavern ' s common room that night . Shortly after they left to find help for Priam , bounty seekers who ' d pursued Vajra found and killed two of the thugs outside the Inn of the Crescent Moon .

title: Selûne ( moon )
description: Selûne ( moon ) Selûne was the name of Toril and Abeir ' s moon . Description . Selûne was about 2 , 000 miles ( 3 , 200 km ) across and was located some 20 , 000 miles ( 32 , 000 km ) away from Toril .
description_long: Selûne ( moon ) Selûne was the name of Toril and Abeir ' s moon . Description . Selûne was about 2 , 000 miles ( 3 , 200 km ) across and was located some 20 , 000 miles ( 32 , 000 km ) away from Toril . To an observer , it appeared about the size of a human fist held at arm ' s length . It was quite bright on a clear night , able to cast pale shadows . Selûne was followed in the sky by the Tears of Selûne , a constellation of very small celestial bodies ( often identified as nine stars , but in reality hundreds of asteroids ) . Powers . By the hand of Selûne , goddess of the moon and its namesake , the moon could be a conduit of her powers . In 1357 DR , her avatar Luna used a bright beam of moonlight to transport Conner and the kittenlord to her inn , Selûne ' s Smile , and later to crack open the roof of a cavern and blind ogre s holding the paladin Priam Agrivar . Significance . In Kara - Tur , it was believed that the Moon Women of the Celestial Bureaucracy were responsible for steering the motion of the Moon along its course . Lunar events . Eclipses . Due to the size and relative rotation of Selûne and Toril , eclipses were quite frequent and commonplace . Lunar phases .

title: Semberflow
description: Semberflow The Semberflow was a river in the Cormanthor forest . Geography . The stream flowed from Lake Sember to the River Verire .
description_long: Semberflow The Semberflow was a river in the Cormanthor forest . Geography . The stream flowed from Lake Sember to the River Verire . Inhabitants . The waters of the Semberflow ran clear and was home to large numbers of and . Around 650 DR , aquatic elven warrior s guarded the waters of the creek . Originating in the Storm Peaks , flocks of red sheep grazed along the river ' s banks .

title: Semberholme
description: Semberholme Semberholme was a range of wooded hills that were once home to a cavern - dwelling community of elves . It was one of the four old communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and the Tangled Trees ) . It lay on the banks of Lake Sember , in the south and west of Cormanthor Environs .
description_long: Semberholme Semberholme was a range of wooded hills that were once home to a cavern - dwelling community of elves . It was one of the four old communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and the Tangled Trees ) . It lay on the banks of Lake Sember , in the south and west of Cormanthor Environs . The woods of Semberholme were a mystical range of thick - trunked trees in south - western Cormanthor . In fact , they were some of the thickest trees in all of the forest , and the ground level was often darkened by the thick canopy overhead ( thus forcing the elves to build arboreal settlements so as not to be completely without light ) . This also caused the ever - present thick gray fog that rolled along the lake ' s surface and the forest floor , with accompanying lichen , humidity , and mushy peat that could be found throughout . Boundaries . Semberholme as a region was considered to be the forests north of Lake Sember ( but west of the Verire river ) and south of the lake ( but north of the Glaemril . The Thunder Peaks to the west were a natural boundary , though that remained the most definitive boundary .

title: Sembia
description: Sembia Although once a wealthy , independent collection of city - states , Sembia was , as of 1479 DR , a vassal state of the Netherese Empire . Only the cities of Urmlaspyr and Daerlun remained independent . Prior to the Spellplague , Sembia was a young country of considerable wealth and prosperity governed by its merchants .
description_long: Sembia Although once a wealthy , independent collection of city - states , Sembia was , as of 1479 DR , a vassal state of the Netherese Empire . Only the cities of Urmlaspyr and Daerlun remained independent . Prior to the Spellplague , Sembia was a young country of considerable wealth and prosperity governed by its merchants . It was located on the north - western coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars , which put it in the path of many trade routes . Sembians were not particularly war - like , preferring to keep to themselves and their money , but they did go to war with the Dalelands and Elves in Cormanthor , allied with Hillsfar and Zhentil Keep . In the middle of the war however , they switched sides and fought with the elves against human and infernal armies alike . Miklos Selkirk was responsible for this shift . A person from Sembia was known as a Sembite or a Semmite . Sembite is used more commonly in the north of Sembia and the Dragonreach , whereas Semmite is used more commonly in the south .

title: Sembia : Gateway to the Realms
description: Sembia : Gateway to the Realms Sembia : Gateway to the Realms is a seven part series focusing on the residents of Stormweather Towers in Selgaunt . It was originally titled the Sembia series . The first novel , " The Halls of Stormweather " , is an anthology , and multiple authors wrote the rest of installments .
description_long: Sembia : Gateway to the Realms Sembia : Gateway to the Realms is a seven part series focusing on the residents of Stormweather Towers in Selgaunt . It was originally titled the Sembia series . The first novel , " The Halls of Stormweather " , is an anthology , and multiple authors wrote the rest of installments . The series was first released between 2000 and 2003 , with cover artwork by Terese Nielsen . Beginning in 2007 , the series is being reprinted , with new cover art by Raymond Swanland .

title: Sememmon
description: Sememmon Sememmon ( born Malathar Wingstarl ) was a Chondathan human of the Wingstarl family , former student of Manshoon and former Lord of Darkhold but went on the run with his consort Ashemmi . His body is a clone ( his 6th ) that was created for him by Manshoon during his time with the Zhentarim . Description .
description_long: Sememmon Sememmon ( born Malathar Wingstarl ) was a Chondathan human of the Wingstarl family , former student of Manshoon and former Lord of Darkhold but went on the run with his consort Ashemmi . His body is a clone ( his 6th ) that was created for him by Manshoon during his time with the Zhentarim . Description . Sememmon was over 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) tall and , as of 1374 DR , had a light beard . Personality . Sememmon was mild mannered , observant , patient , and keenly intelligent . He was also cunning and calculating , but he controls himself . Sememmon was both ruthless and implacable . Sememmon knew which way the winds were blowing so he and his consort went rogue from the Zhentarim . Sememmon knew that the enemies of his enemy , ( Fzoul Chembryl ) , are his friends . He planned to make himself available to the forces of good . His goal was to make himself indispensable to the countries , nations , and people he once opposed . Sememmon often disguised himself and asked groups of adventurers to perform tasks on his behalf , and he always kept his word in this regard , never abandoning those working for him .

title: Seminarcane
description: Seminarcane The Seminarcane was a six - building complex in Keltar dedicated to magical education . Description . The outer walls were composed of simple brickwork , but the interiors of most of the buildings were decorated by elaborate mosaics .
description_long: Seminarcane The Seminarcane was a six - building complex in Keltar dedicated to magical education . Description . The outer walls were composed of simple brickwork , but the interiors of most of the buildings were decorated by elaborate mosaics . Structures . Three of the six buildings were the following : History . The Seminarcane was built during the Seventh Age of Calimshan . [ [ Seventh Age of Calimshan Reference . title: Semkhrun
description: Semkhrun Semkhrun was founded in - 1124 DR by the ruler of Mulhorand . All that remains today are a few crumbling obelisks on the surface and many subterranean chambers . Circa 1360 DR , the ruins had been rediscovered by adventurers , and it was considered a dangerous ( but potentially lucrative ) site .
description_long: Semkhrun Semkhrun was founded in - 1124 DR by the ruler of Mulhorand . All that remains today are a few crumbling obelisks on the surface and many subterranean chambers . Circa 1360 DR , the ruins had been rediscovered by adventurers , and it was considered a dangerous ( but potentially lucrative ) site . Geography . Semkhrun was built on the Semphar Plain , according to the " prophetic dream " of the god - king who ruled Mulhorand at that time . A group of priests released a donkey on the sunbaked frontier , and followed it until it died of starvation . This location , according to the god - king ' s dream , was where Semkhrun was to be built . And his will made it so . History . The most famous resident of Semkhrun was the Oracle of Fahzakhum , and the city became widely known as The Oracle City . Nothing is remembered now regarding the Oracle ' s nature , but it was famous in its day for its accuracy . The wealthy and the driven came from faraway lands to seek truth . A priesthood quickly developed , calling itself the Masters of the Oracle . They became proud and greedy , and demanded offerings of those who sought to question the Oracle .

title: Semlithol
description: Semlithol Semlithol was a city in Semphar . Description . Located on the coast of the Gbor Nor , Semlithol was a small town in Semphar noted for its orchards , pleasant breezes , and fresh water .
description_long: Semlithol Semlithol was a city in Semphar . Description . Located on the coast of the Gbor Nor , Semlithol was a small town in Semphar noted for its orchards , pleasant breezes , and fresh water . Because of these factors , the town was used primarily as a summer retreat for the nobles of Semphar . Most businesses and people in Semlithol made their money by catering to the wealthy in various ways . Appendix . Note . While listed as Semlithal on maps , The Horde campaign book listed the town ' s name as Semlithol .

title: Semmonemily
description: Semmonemily Semmonemily was a doppelganger working for the Kraken Society . Activities . As a member of the Kraken Society , Semmonemily would gather the latest rumors and information from numerous Underdark sources and unusual informers .
description_long: Semmonemily Semmonemily was a doppelganger working for the Kraken Society . Activities . As a member of the Kraken Society , Semmonemily would gather the latest rumors and information from numerous Underdark sources and unusual informers . History . Semmonemily was once the servant of an Illithid who had transformed into an alhoon . In 1361 DR , while working for the Kraken Society , he killed and replaced a Waterdhavian courier in Yartar on behalf of Baron Khaumfros , in order to plant the seeds of a conspiracy to cause a war between Waterdeep and Ruathym . By 1372 DR , Semmonemily was a senior agent of the Kraken Society , responsible for keeping watch over the Dessarin River valley area .

title: Semorav
description: Semorav Semorav , formally known as Semorav of the Cobra ' s Hood , was a necromancer and an agent of the Coiled Cabal in the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Semorav was a bipedal yuan - ti pureblood but had very distinctive snake - like features .
description_long: Semorav Semorav , formally known as Semorav of the Cobra ' s Hood , was a necromancer and an agent of the Coiled Cabal in the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Semorav was a bipedal yuan - ti pureblood but had very distinctive snake - like features . The scaled skin on either side of his head could be flared out like a cobra ' s hood . Personality . Semorav was very reclusive and stayed in his tower just to the north of the dome of the Cathedral in the midst of the jungle " gardens " . On the rare occasions he did venture out , he masqueraded as the personal scribe of the high priestess Medusanna Mhairdaul who was the only person that knew he was a powerful necromancer . Abilities . In addition to being an accomplished necromancer , Semorav was the recipient of a boon from Sseth . By flaring his hood he could cast " snake charm " , an entry - level cleric spell , at will . Possessions . The tower on the grounds of the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was named Semorav ' s Tower but it was unclear if it was truly his or he was just allowed to use it as a dwelling and laboratory . Activities .

title: Sempadan Forest
description: Sempadan Forest The Sempadan Forest was a vast forest lying on the eastern side of the wide isthmus joining the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with Zakhara . It was known as Herne ' s Wood to the people of the Utter East , on the western side of the isthmus , and as the Jungle of Monsters to Zakharans to the southwest . Geography .
description_long: Sempadan Forest The Sempadan Forest was a vast forest lying on the eastern side of the wide isthmus joining the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with Zakhara . It was known as Herne ' s Wood to the people of the Utter East , on the western side of the isthmus , and as the Jungle of Monsters to Zakharans to the southwest . Geography . The Sempadan Forest spread along the shore around the Segara Sea , east of the World Pillar Mountains and south of the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains . Geographical features . An unnamed river ran south - east through the forest , emptying into the Segara Sea . It had two tributaries descending from the mountains . Two more meandering rivers cut through its narrower southern part , flowing from the eastern heights of the Land of the Yak - Men into the Foreigners ' Sea . Another short one marked the southern border of the forest towards the no - man ' s land between the Haunted Lands , the Ruined Kingdoms and the sea . In the eastern part of the forest was Lake Odoh . History . The nations of Kara - Tur and the Grand Caliph ate of Zakhara had largely ignored the continental isthmus .

title: Semphar
description: Semphar Semphar was the mightiest nation in the Hordelands . It was a of the Tuigan Khahan . Semphar strove to be independent but was subjugated by four different realms in its history , specifically the Imaskari , Mulhorand , the Shou Lung and most recently the Tuigan .
description_long: Semphar Semphar was the mightiest nation in the Hordelands . It was a of the Tuigan Khahan . Semphar strove to be independent but was subjugated by four different realms in its history , specifically the Imaskari , Mulhorand , the Shou Lung and most recently the Tuigan . This subjugation though , guaranteed that Semphar gained several beneficial cultural aspects . History . The first dwarves in Faerûn settled beneath Semphar . Geography . Semphar was known for its ruins , lost tombs , and strange monsters . Bordering it were the ruins of Raudor and Bhaluin , the dark forest of the Shalhoond , and the monsters of the Howling Gap . Perhaps there are even more wonders to be found throughout the land . Trade . Trade in Semphar was based mostly around the caravans that passed through the nation along the Silk Road , as well as the rich agriculture of its lands .

title: Semuanya
description: Semuanya Semuanya was the lizardfolk deity of survival and propagation . Description . Semuanya appeared as an outsized lizard man , strong and agile in both body and mind .
description_long: Semuanya Semuanya was the lizardfolk deity of survival and propagation . Description . Semuanya appeared as an outsized lizard man , strong and agile in both body and mind . He wore only a loincloth and sometimes armor . He wielded a club studded with razor - sharp fragments of shells . He never spoke except when necessary . Personality & Dogma . Semuanya focused entirely on matters of survival and propagation , and nothing else . He taught his followers that any deed done in pursuit of these ends was good , and that any other action that was not was irrelevant and not even worth the effort . He encouraged them to reproduce , to live long lives , and to guarantee the safety of themselves and of their race . Neither good nor evil , nor lawful not chaotic , Semuanya was utterly amoral , uncaring , and unfeeling . He didn ' t even care much for the struggles of his own lizardfolk worshipers , let alone the issues of other beings , dismissing most of these as irrelevant to his greater concerns . He would not even send omens to his shamans .

title: Sendai Argrims
description: Sendai Argrims Sendai Argrims was the heiress of the Amn ian noble merchant house of the Argrims . History . She was hunting in the Fire Leaf Forest with her companions Aleksander and Delgod when they came upon Gorion ' s Ward .
description_long: Sendai Argrims Sendai Argrims was the heiress of the Amn ian noble merchant house of the Argrims . History . She was hunting in the Fire Leaf Forest with her companions Aleksander and Delgod when they came upon Gorion ' s Ward . Gameplay . If Gorion ' s Ward offended Sendai , then Gorion ' s Ward kill her and her companions or dismiss them .

title: Sendever ' s Stables
description: Sendever ' s Stables Sendever ' s Stables was a stables located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Illumor Sendever . Location & Description .
description_long: Sendever ' s Stables Sendever ' s Stables was a stables located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Illumor Sendever . Location & Description . Sendever ' s Stables lay on the eastern side of Wheloon Way . It consisted of a sizeable set of paddocks and stables . The sign by the gate read " Horses Bought , Sold , Doctored , and Boarded " . Defenses . To keep away horse - thieves , hired guards patrolled the stables and paddocks . They were armed with hand crossbow s loaded with dart s treated with a sleep - inducing poison . History . Sendever ' s Stables was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business through 1369 DR , and in 1374 DR . Services . Here , the staff bought , sold , and boarded horse s in their stables . They could also provide training for horses . Their primary specialty , however , was in veterinary care for horses , mule s , and donkey s . The staff could quickly and accurately diagnose a sickness or injury in an animal , and provide proper care for them . They could easily tell if a lame animal had been drugged to hide its condition . Horses in their care were kept in good health , fed well , and exercised appropriately .

title: Sending
description: Sending Sending is an evocation spell that delivers a short message anywhere , instantly . Effect . You contact a particular creature with whom you are familiar and send a short message of twenty - five words or less to the subject .
description_long: Sending Sending is an evocation spell that delivers a short message anywhere , instantly . Effect . You contact a particular creature with whom you are familiar and send a short message of twenty - five words or less to the subject . The subject recognizes you if it knows you . It can answer in like manner immediately . Creatures with Intelligence scores as low as 1 can understand the sending , though the subject ' s ability to react is limited normally by its Intelligence . Even if the sending is received , the subject is not obligated to act upon it in any manner . If the creature in question is not on the same plane of existence as you are , there is a 5 % chance that the sending does not arrive . ( Local conditions on other planes may worsen this chance considerably , at the option of the DM . ) Material components . A short piece of fine copper wire .

title: Sendrin
description: Sendrin Sendrin was a village in the Vast , standing on the junction of the Long Reach trail from Bambryn to King ' s Reach and Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar to Fallentree . History . A temple to Savras was founded in Sendrin around the time when human s first dominated the Vast .
description_long: Sendrin Sendrin was a village in the Vast , standing on the junction of the Long Reach trail from Bambryn to King ' s Reach and Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar to Fallentree . History . A temple to Savras was founded in Sendrin around the time when human s first dominated the Vast . With Savras then commonly seen as a wise user of magic rather than just a diviner , Sendrin became a mecca for wizard s , despite its remoteness . Here , wizards could talk shop , share spells , and practice their magic far from inhabited areas . Some also took the opportunity to play up , party all night , mess around with magic for lewdness and vandalism , and generally get away with what they couldn ' t at home . However , when Azuth defeated Savras and supplanted him as god of magic , Azuth ' s followers sacked and destroyed the Savran temple of Sendrin . The wizards stopped coming , and those who ' d serviced them — scribes , component sellers , tailors , healers , escorts — gradually left . The community they ' d made went mobile , becoming the travelling Magefair . Meanwhile , Sendrin shrank into a simple farming village again .

title: Senityili
description: Senityili Senityili was a sahuagin priestess of Sekolah in the Sea of Swords . History . Senityili lived in the City of Caverns .
description_long: Senityili Senityili was a sahuagin priestess of Sekolah in the Sea of Swords . History . Senityili lived in the City of Caverns . During the civil war in the city , she apparently supported King Ixilthetocal . Senityili believed in an old prophecy that told of the arrival of a stranger who would save the city . So she welcomed Gorion ' s Ward , who had then arrived in the City of Caverns . Afterward , she sacrificed to Sekolah the rebel High Priestess Tlyysixxous and explained to Gorion ' s Ward that the king was mad and that they needed to help her instead of Prince Villynaty .

title: Senni Diggermattock
description: Senni Diggermattock Senni Diggermattock was , along with her husband Dorbo Diggermattock , one of the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Senni ' s main task was to find homes for all the new settlers .
description_long: Senni Diggermattock Senni Diggermattock was , along with her husband Dorbo Diggermattock , one of the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Senni ' s main task was to find homes for all the new settlers . She also managed the commerce routes to Mithral Hall , Gauntlgrym , and Mantol - Derith , and helped maintain the magical defenses of the city . Personality . Senni valued and counted everything , to be sure that Dorbo had all he needed . She was devoted to the vision of a rebuilt Blingdenstone . History . Dorbo and Senni were capable miners , with Senni acting as administrator . With the money they gathered , Dorbo and Senni planned the reclamation of Blingdenstone . They pondered the reclamation mission for ten years , in order to consider all the dangers . Afterward , they led a contingent of settlers to Blingdenstone , slowly reclaiming parts of the city . During the Rage of Demons , Senni faced many threats .

title: Sensei
description: Sensei Sensei was the leader of the Hijo ninja clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . The Sensei always had his face covered in public .
description_long: Sensei Sensei was the leader of the Hijo ninja clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . The Sensei always had his face covered in public . He rarely left the hidden village , preferring to manage all business from there . He was a master of Earth elemental magic . Personality . Sensei was a brilliant and clever strategist , despite lacking physical prowess .

title: Sentinelspire ( mountain )
description: Sentinelspire ( mountain ) The Sentinelspire was a mountain in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Khopet - Dag , the Sentinelspire was a lone volcanic mountain in the Hordelands .
description_long: Sentinelspire ( mountain ) The Sentinelspire was a mountain in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Khopet - Dag , the Sentinelspire was a lone volcanic mountain in the Hordelands . The mountain got its name from its cone , which could be seen many miles away , and was used a navigational aid by the nomadic tribes of the steppe . The nomads of the area believed the mountain was cursed , and that anyone who went near it would die in strange ways . Thus they avoided the mountain , as it had no resources of value to make going there worth it . Places of Note . Hidden inside a canyon in the Sentinelspire was the Fortress of the Old Man , a secret citadel made by a follower of Bhaal , and home to a guild of assassins .

title: Seppremis
description: Seppremis Seppremis was a high elf farmhand in the Moonsea . Activities . Seppremis worked as a farmhand on the Allano rothé farm .
description_long: Seppremis Seppremis was a high elf farmhand in the Moonsea . Activities . Seppremis worked as a farmhand on the Allano rothé farm . History . During the Rage of Demons , Seppremis discovered a secret hideout of House Dlardrageth . Dreaming of the power he might gain , Seppremis explored the place and learned some of its secrets . With this vile knowledge , he decided to attempt the rituals that he believed could bring him great power and wealth . He evoked some mane s and dretch . He was attempting to evoke a goristro when an adventuring party found him .

title: Sepulcher
description: Sepulcher Brother Sepulcher was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . As a priest of Jergal , Sepulcher was stationed at the Yawning Portal , keeping notes of the names and descriptions of any adventurers that entered Undermountain , sometimes questioning them about relatives , spiritual inclinations , and intended Undermountain destinations .
description_long: Sepulcher Brother Sepulcher was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . As a priest of Jergal , Sepulcher was stationed at the Yawning Portal , keeping notes of the names and descriptions of any adventurers that entered Undermountain , sometimes questioning them about relatives , spiritual inclinations , and intended Undermountain destinations . He also informed individuals who were too tall of the problems of fitting their bodies inside a coffin . History . In 1479 DR , Brother Sepulcher arrived at the Yawning Portal inn with Sister Palonya . Palonya went inside Undermountain to replace the previous priest of Jergal assigned to catalog the bodies inside some particular Undermountain tombs , while Sepulcher waited . Personality . Sepulcher was a grim and morose man .

title: Ser ' ryu
description: Ser ' ryu Ser ' ryu was a queen of blue dragon s . Personality . Ser ' ryu took part in Akachi ' s Crusade on the Fugue Plane .
description_long: Ser ' ryu Ser ' ryu was a queen of blue dragon s . Personality . Ser ' ryu took part in Akachi ' s Crusade on the Fugue Plane . She was one of three Akachi ' s lieutenants , and , despite others , didn ' t have own army , because she herself was powerful enough .

title: Serag Kull
description: Serag Kull Serag Kull was one of the captains of the military force known as the Red Plumes . Description . Serag stood around 6 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Serag Kull Serag Kull was one of the captains of the military force known as the Red Plumes . Description . Serag stood around 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) tall with a broad build . He had a scar on his neck that he received from a Zhentarim soldier . Personality . Never to be out - manipulated , Kull was a cruel , sly and dangerously smart individual .

title: Seranolla
description: Seranolla Seranolla the Whisperer was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Seranolla was possibly involved in the case of dracolich es and ghost ship roaming the Moonsea .
description_long: Seranolla Seranolla the Whisperer was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Seranolla was possibly involved in the case of dracolich es and ghost ship roaming the Moonsea . She said that the Enclave was concerned about strange changes in the weather . During the Rage of Demons Seranolla was in Elventree where possibly hired some adventurers to help Elanil Elassidil with some Drow arriving in the surface . Relationship . Seranolla was sister of Serinia and Yavendel .

title: Serelis Greenleaf
description: Serelis Greenleaf Serelis Greenleaf was a ranger in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Serelis usually acted as a mediator between the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community and the elves of the forest .
description_long: Serelis Greenleaf Serelis Greenleaf was a ranger in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Serelis usually acted as a mediator between the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community and the elves of the forest . History . Serelis lived in the Quivering Forest near Kabel ' s Hill . He was possibly involved in the case of the disappearance of Halvin Graingle and six other villagers inside the forest when an adventuring party went to ask for his help .

title: Seren Juramot
description: Seren Juramot Seren Juramot was a mercenary war wizard of the ship the Green Siren . History . Seren was once one of the Red Wizards of Thay and worked with the Thayan enclaves in Raven ' s Bluff and in Silverymoon .
description_long: Seren Juramot Seren Juramot was a mercenary war wizard of the ship the Green Siren . History . Seren was once one of the Red Wizards of Thay and worked with the Thayan enclaves in Raven ' s Bluff and in Silverymoon . Physical Description . She wore a bone white sari and wielded a scarlet - glyphed wand .

title: Serge Affapanov
description: Serge Affapanov Lord Serge Affapanov was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Serge was the father of Ayre Affapanov .
description_long: Serge Affapanov Lord Serge Affapanov was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Serge was the father of Ayre Affapanov . He was allied with the Lords ' Alliance . Activities . Serge was a Mulmaster noble involved in the gemstone trade from Damara and the Bloodstone Lands . History . In 1489 DR , his wife died and he was left alone with his daughter . In 1491 DR , Serge was one of the nobles predicted to become one of the Blades at the next election meeting . However , during one of his trips to Damara , Ayre disappeared . The Lords ' Alliance asked an adventuring party hired to find Liticia Gos to also find Ayre . The adventurers found Liticia in the Yellow Breath Chapter House under Thylius Caramitru ' s influence .

title: Sergen Hulmaster
description: Sergen Hulmaster Step brother of Kara Hulmaster , Sergen was adopted into the family when his father Kamoth Kastelmar married Terena Hulmaster . The Hulmasters allowed Sergen to remain a member of the family even after Kamoth ' s attempt to seize control of Hulburg in 1466 DR . Sergen teamed up with his father ( Kamoth ) in an attempt to capture Hulburg in 1479 DR but was killed by Geran Hulmaster .
description_long: Sergen Hulmaster Step brother of Kara Hulmaster , Sergen was adopted into the family when his father Kamoth Kastelmar married Terena Hulmaster . The Hulmasters allowed Sergen to remain a member of the family even after Kamoth ' s attempt to seize control of Hulburg in 1466 DR . Sergen teamed up with his father ( Kamoth ) in an attempt to capture Hulburg in 1479 DR but was killed by Geran Hulmaster .

title: Sergor
description: Sergor Sergor was a warrior of Damara . History . Sergor was a sergeant in Damara ' s army , stationed at a small garrison in the Tomrav village , near the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .
description_long: Sergor Sergor was a warrior of Damara . History . Sergor was a sergeant in Damara ' s army , stationed at a small garrison in the Tomrav village , near the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . In 1491 DR , despite an alliance with a local goblin tribe , a large group of bugbear s , led by Hrar , attacked the village and captured many hostages , seizing control of the village and the road to the monastery . Eventually , an adventuring party hired for a mission at the monastery defeated a bugbear patrol , and Sergor then asked their help to free the hostages , including his family , and to defeat the bugbears .

title: Serinia
description: Serinia Serinia was a priestess of Mielikki and a member of the Emerald Enclave in Elventree . Activities . Serinia took care of the Hall of the Unicorn , the local temple to Mielikki .
description_long: Serinia Serinia was a priestess of Mielikki and a member of the Emerald Enclave in Elventree . Activities . Serinia took care of the Hall of the Unicorn , the local temple to Mielikki . History . During the Rage of Demons , she helped Elanil Elassidil to bring peace to the spirit of her ancestor , Meira Faerenduil . At the same time , she was worried about her friend , the treant Brightleaf , who had sent no news for a while . Personality . Serinia was a nervous individual . She did not like the company of other people , preferring to spend time with small animals . Relationship . Serinia had good dealings with Elanil Elassidil , the Herald of Elventree .

title: Serissa
description: Serissa Serissa was the storm giant heiress sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . When Serissa was very youth she went with her mother into Sword Coast and Moonshae Isles meeting friendly small folks .
description_long: Serissa Serissa was the storm giant heiress sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . When Serissa was very youth she went with her mother into Sword Coast and Moonshae Isles meeting friendly small folks . Serissa was the youngest daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning . Like her mother Neri Serissa liked the small folks . So when in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR found the dead body of Neri soon Uthor went to his niece Sarissa for counsel and Sarissa managed to calm her father ' s rightful rage . For this Hekaton decided to appoint Serissa as his heir . After her father ' s disappearance reluctantly Sarissa ascended to the Wyrmskull Throne as regent . Serissa was on the throne with her advisors nearby . Personality . Serissa above all feared a civil war among the difference giant races , that maybe can restart the war against the dragon s . She knew well the envy of her older sisters but considered them harmless . Sarissa trusted only her uncle Uthor and Iymrith . In her hearth she had decided to entrust the small folks in help found her father and the assassin of her mother despite all objections .

title: Serpent ' s Cowl
description: Serpent ' s Cowl Serpent ' s Cowl is a small village upstream of Boareskyr Bridge on east bank of the Winding Water . It is very close to the Forest of Wyrms . Located nearby is the estate of Heartwing own by Aluena Halacanter .
description_long: Serpent ' s Cowl Serpent ' s Cowl is a small village upstream of Boareskyr Bridge on east bank of the Winding Water . It is very close to the Forest of Wyrms . Located nearby is the estate of Heartwing own by Aluena Halacanter . The village is named for a Yuan - ti city and temple that was once found on this location . The village itself is warded against dragons to prevent them from digging up the destroyed temple . The village has ferry crossing and further south the Winding Water is poison from the god battle between Cyric and Bhaal at the Boareskyr Bridge .

title: Serpent Hills
description: Serpent Hills The Serpent Hills were a range of rocky hills in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn , bordered on the north , west , and south by the High Moor and on the north , east , and south by the Serpent ' s Tail stream . Geography . The peaks of the western Serpent Hills broaden out and eventually level out to become the High Moor .
description_long: Serpent Hills The Serpent Hills were a range of rocky hills in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn , bordered on the north , west , and south by the High Moor and on the north , east , and south by the Serpent ' s Tail stream . Geography . The peaks of the western Serpent Hills broaden out and eventually level out to become the High Moor . Inhabitants . The Serpent Hills were once filled with life but later turned into a dry , lifeless land inhabited only by reptilian beings . By 1372 DR , the highest population belonged to ophidian s .

title: Serpent Valley
description: Serpent Valley The Serpent Valley was a river valley lying east of Doegan in the Utter East . Description . A tortuously winding river snaked through the Serpent Valley , deep amidst the untamed hills .
description_long: Serpent Valley The Serpent Valley was a river valley lying east of Doegan in the Utter East . Description . A tortuously winding river snaked through the Serpent Valley , deep amidst the untamed hills . All around , the land was marshy or swampy , leaving islands and patches of firmer ground within the loops of the river . The land was green and fertile . Inhabitants . Here , beefy , club - wielding troll s stood their ground and giant snapping turtle s lurked in the river . Roc s also made their great nests by the water . Some bandits and hardy folk lived in the Serpent Valley , building pleasant - looking thatched roof cottages and farms , but life was rigorous and desperate , with mere survival the top priority . Reputation . The Serpent Valley was known as a hard and fearsome place , where bandits laired , the most enduring survivalists made their homes , and only the bravest dared trespass . The river was thought dark and mysterious . History .

title: Serpent lord
description: Serpent lord Serpent lords were reptiles that lived in the hills and ancient ruins of Zakhara . Description . These creatures resembled giant white cobras with human faces that smiled frequently .
description_long: Serpent lord Serpent lords were reptiles that lived in the hills and ancient ruins of Zakhara . Description . These creatures resembled giant white cobras with human faces that smiled frequently . Combat . These creatures were healers and scholars and reluctant to enter combat . Four giant constrictor snakes were around them at all times , and usually more giant venomous snakes and spitting cobras attended them as well . All of these snakes would fight to the death to defend their king or queen . Serpent lords could turn undead and cast a wide range of clerical spell s . They were also highly resistant to magic . When magic failed , a serpent lord could constrict up to eight man - sized creatures at once , crushing them with its massive body . Habitat / Society . Serpent lords lived in large caves secluded in the wild . These creatures served as the lords of all snakes within twenty miles ( 32 km ) of their lair . A wide array of snakes served as their defenders during times of crisis . Serpent lords preferred eating cooked meat , and anyone bringing cooked offerings to them was looked upon favorably . Many sought them out because of their healing powers .

title: Serpentine
description: Serpentine Serpentine was the name given to a family of related materials which included williamsite , ricolite , , picrolite , taxoite , , and sometimes referred to as poor man ' s jade . Top quality samples of williamsite were classified as semi - precious stones and all other varieties were treated as hardstones sold under the name serpentine stone . Description .
description_long: Serpentine Serpentine was the name given to a family of related materials which included williamsite , ricolite , , picrolite , taxoite , , and sometimes referred to as poor man ' s jade . Top quality samples of williamsite were classified as semi - precious stones and all other varieties were treated as hardstones sold under the name serpentine stone . Description . Gem quality serpentine was translucent with an intense green color and could be facet cut or made into s to decorate weapons , armor , and barding or mounted in rings , pendants , and jewelry of all types . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . Carrying , wearing , or being in contact with a gemstone of this type ( williamsite ) could confer the equivalent of a " resist cold " and a " resist fire " to that individual . If more than one serpentine gem was present , only one stone activated per exposure to extreme heat or cold at a time . Each gem could protect against one cold effect and one heat effect before crumbling to useless dust .

title: Serpentine stone
description: Serpentine stone Serpentine stone was the name given to a wide variety of minerals including williamsite , ricolite , picrolite , taxoite , and bowenite . It was used for carving , furniture inlays , and building facing . Outside the Realms it was known as .
description_long: Serpentine stone Serpentine stone was the name given to a wide variety of minerals including williamsite , ricolite , picrolite , taxoite , and bowenite . It was used for carving , furniture inlays , and building facing . Outside the Realms it was known as . Description . This greenish material was found in large deposits and could cut be into thin slabs for ornamental screening , used as an inlay , or as ornamental surfacing . A typical price was 3 gp per pound ( 6 . 6 gp / kg ) . Powers . This stone was used for in the creation of the figurine of wondrous power known as the " serpentine owl " . Certain varieties of this mineral shared the same protective properties as the gem - quality serpentine , i . e . , it granted a one - time boon of a " resist fire " and a " resist cold " spell , disintegrating to dust after reacting to one each of extreme cold and extreme heat . Only skilled jewelers , miners , and spellcasters with experience working with this stone could determine if a particular sample had this magical property or not .

title: Serusan
description: Serusan Serusan ( or Serosian common ) was a shorthand language used as a common trade language by shallow - water races . It was a distinctly an undersea tongue , and contained dolphins ' clicks and whistles , words from the sahuagin language language , the aquatic elvish tongue , and the kuo - toan language , it also included some parts from the aquan language , which was used by locathah , merfolk , and shalarin . All these races could speak and understand Serusan , but unless fluent in it as a separate language , they could only grasp the most basic meanings .

title: Servan Llarabbar
description: Servan Llarabbar Servan Llarabbar was a drow mage in Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , after the demise of Ilvara Mizzrym , Servan was chosen as the next leader of Velkynvelve , but he and most of his minions had become afflicted by the demon lord – spread madness .
description_long: Servan Llarabbar Servan Llarabbar was a drow mage in Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , after the demise of Ilvara Mizzrym , Servan was chosen as the next leader of Velkynvelve , but he and most of his minions had become afflicted by the demon lord – spread madness . Personality . Influenced by madness , Servan started to show heightened paranoia and megalomania . He dreamed of seceding Velkynvelve from Menzoberranzan , to found a land free from the control of the matron mother s .

title: Servant of the Shard
description: Servant of the Shard Servant of the Shard is the first book of The Sellswords trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Servant of the Shard Servant of the Shard is the first book of The Sellswords trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . It was originally book three in the Paths of Darkness series , but as it did not focus on its central character , Drizzt Do ' Urden , or his companions , Salvatore decided to make a separate trilogy based on the events in " Servant of the Shard " , which ended in " Road of the Patriarch " . Summary . Artemis Entreri and the rest of the the Basadoni Guild continue their " war " against all neighboring guilds of Calimport , killing many people . This time , however , there is a difference , which is that the Basadonis have a legion of drow ( Bregan D ' aerthe ) on their side . Artemis Entreri sees the opportunity to gain a sword , Charon ' s Claw , and goes for it . Meanwhile , despite his great willpower , Jarlaxle is being seduced by the power of Crenshinibon , or the Crystal Shard . Artemis Entreri feels that it is necessary to help him get rid of the artifact . The two come across a great opportunity to destroy the Crenshininbon in the form of the man named Cadderly Bonaduce , a Chosen of Deneir .

title: Servants of Mammon
description: Servants of Mammon The Servants of Mammon was Mammon ' s personal army , based in Minauros in the Nine Hells . It was comprised mostly of hamatula s and osyluth s and was commanded by gelugon s . Mammon had a pack of thirteen large hell hound s ( with which he hunted , himself assuming the form of a pit fiend ) and a nightmare .
description_long: Servants of Mammon The Servants of Mammon was Mammon ' s personal army , based in Minauros in the Nine Hells . It was comprised mostly of hamatula s and osyluth s and was commanded by gelugon s . Mammon had a pack of thirteen large hell hound s ( with which he hunted , himself assuming the form of a pit fiend ) and a nightmare . The witch - queen Zbavra was also in the army .

title: Servants of the Royal Egg
description: Servants of the Royal Egg The Servants of the Royal Egg was a mercenary company based in the Great Swamp of Rethild comprised entirely of lizardfolk . Activites . This company hired - out their soldiers to anyone willing to pay .
description_long: Servants of the Royal Egg The Servants of the Royal Egg was a mercenary company based in the Great Swamp of Rethild comprised entirely of lizardfolk . Activites . This company hired - out their soldiers to anyone willing to pay . Supplied from spelljammer ships from Realmspace , this was one of the most prolific mercenary companies in all of the Faerûn .

title: Sespechian
description: Sespechian Sespechian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Sespech and the Shining Plains . Speakers . Sespechian was spoken from Nathlekh in the north to Nagarr in the south and from the Snowflake Mountains in the west to Elbulder in the east .
description_long: Sespechian Sespechian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Sespech and the Shining Plains . Speakers . Sespechian was spoken from Nathlekh in the north to Nagarr in the south and from the Snowflake Mountains in the west to Elbulder in the east . While not spoken over a large region , the language was subdivided into a variety of dialects , including Hlondethan creole , Middle ( or Proper ) Sespechian , Plains Sespechian , and Western ( or " Lizard " ) creole . Hlondethan creole was a mixture of Proper Sespechian with the language of the yuan - ti of Hlondeth , Western creole was mixed with the tongue of the lizardfolk of Surkh , and Plains Sespechian was strongly influenced by the wemic s of the Shining Plains . All of these dialects were distinct enough to make intercommunication difficult , because of both accent and vocabulary . History . Sespechian was an Akalaic language in the Chessan languages group , just like Shaaran and Tashalan .

title: Sess ' innek
description: Sess ' innek Sess ' innek is a tanar ' ri lord worshiped by the lizardfolk as a deity of civilization and dominion . His symbol is a green , clawed , reptilian hand . Description .
description_long: Sess ' innek Sess ' innek is a tanar ' ri lord worshiped by the lizardfolk as a deity of civilization and dominion . His symbol is a green , clawed , reptilian hand . Description . Sess ' innek takes the form of a six - armed lizard king with brown vestigial wings . Each of his six hands wields a longsword of potent magical power . Relationships . Sess ' inek keeps himself apart from other demon lord s , sealing his layer from all intruders . As a result , he has no particular enemies or allies . Even the lizardfolk deity Semuanya ignores him , despite his poaching of that god ' s worshipers . Realm . Sess ' innek dwells on the seventh layer of the Abyss , known as " Kearackinin " , or the " Phantom Plane " . Furthermore , Sess ' innek has sealed and " locked " the layer so it cannot be accessed to without his expressed permission . It is said that Sess ' innek was tired of the Blood War , and went into this self - imposed exile , having nothing to do with the politics of the Abyss . The Phantom Plane was discovered long ago when the wizard Mordenkainen managed to temporarily break the seals . Dogma . " Kill and devour those who oppose Sess ' innek . Take their territory .

title: Sessrendale
description: Sessrendale Sessrendale , or " the Dead Dale " , was founded in 880 DR and destroyed by army from Archendale in the Sessrendale War , ( 1232 DR ) who then salted the earth to prevent resettlement . Some of the families , following the destruction of Sessrendale , fled to Battledale and Deepingdale . Others were driven west into Cormyr .
description_long: Sessrendale Sessrendale , or " the Dead Dale " , was founded in 880 DR and destroyed by army from Archendale in the Sessrendale War , ( 1232 DR ) who then salted the earth to prevent resettlement . Some of the families , following the destruction of Sessrendale , fled to Battledale and Deepingdale . Others were driven west into Cormyr . The Dusk Lord who was the ruler of Sessrendale in 1232 DR fled , and some said to the Vast Swamp . Location . Sessrendale was a quiet valley located between the Thunder Peaks and Semberholme , overlooked by the great mountain crag , Bloodhorn . By 1374 DR , Sessrendale was almost forgotten and no longer appeared on any maps of the Dalelands .

title: Set
description: Set Set ( pronounced " set " ) was the greatest evil power of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known as Typhon in the lands of Thay and Unther , he was a jealous and loathsome being that did all he can to meddle in the plans of his fellow deities . He was also known as Zehir to the yuan - ti race .
description_long: Set Set ( pronounced " set " ) was the greatest evil power of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known as Typhon in the lands of Thay and Unther , he was a jealous and loathsome being that did all he can to meddle in the plans of his fellow deities . He was also known as Zehir to the yuan - ti race . History . It was believed but unproven that following his defeat at the hands of Gruumsh , the wounds of the weakened Re were poisoned by Set , and that he may have survived if not for this act . Set killed Osiris in an attempt to obtain the power of Re , but his plans were thwarted by Horus - Re , and Osiris was resurrected by Isis and Nephthys . After the Spellplague , Set managed to join the Faerûnian pantheon under the name of Zehir . Relationships . Set was the son of Geb and Nut , and brother of Osiris . He considered the other members of the Mulhorandi pantheon to be his enemies , though he has been known to ally with Sebek on occasion . Set had negotiated alliances with Tiamat , as well as with the dragon Maldraedior . However , his actions outside Mulhorand drew unwanted attention , and the deities Bane , Cyric , and Talos all wanted to claim Set ' s power for themselves . Avatar .

title: Setana
description: Setana Setana was a watchghost barmaid in Skullport . Activities . Around 1370 DR , Setana worked as a barmaid for Gallowshawk , earning some notoriety for the inn .
description_long: Setana Setana was a watchghost barmaid in Skullport . Activities . Around 1370 DR , Setana worked as a barmaid for Gallowshawk , earning some notoriety for the inn . Secretly , she was also a Harper agent . She was bound to a golden hair comb . A very frequent guest was the unusual mind flayer Sangalor . History . In life , Setana was very devoted to her mistress , who gave her the comb . When Setana died at sea , she had with her the comb , which was later recovered by an aquatic elf , who traded it to the captain of the ill - fated ship on which Gallowshawk had worked . The comb was the only piece that he had not sold over the years .

title: Setara bint Aasim
description: Setara bint Aasim Setara bint Aasim was a money - changer living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Setara was an attractive woman and she would openly flirt with men to gain information .
description_long: Setara bint Aasim Setara bint Aasim was a money - changer living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Setara was an attractive woman and she would openly flirt with men to gain information . Activities . Setara ' s money - changing business was merely a front to mask her true purpose for the Cult of Istishia as a holy slayer for the Dark Wave . Setara would flash a special coin used by the cult for recognition by their members . If anyone wished to keep the coin they would be marked for assassination . She also made note of solitary children roaming the market , targeting them for kidnapping . Relationships . Setara was the sister of her fellow Dark Wave members Shadha and Sahlah .

title: Setara bint Farid
description: Setara bint Farid Setara bint Farid was the human female captain of the ship " Spray " , operating in the Crowded Sea around 1367 DR . Description . Setara was a muscular , brown - haired woman , who wore padded armor .
description_long: Setara bint Farid Setara bint Farid was the human female captain of the ship " Spray " , operating in the Crowded Sea around 1367 DR . Description . Setara was a muscular , brown - haired woman , who wore padded armor . Personality . She was more interested in gaining fame , rather than fortune . Setara tended to get into more trouble than she could handle . Possessions . Setara owned a " ring of swimming " , as well as a magical cutlass . History . Setara hailed from the city of Gana . She once insulted the marid Nabil , leading to a personal feud .

title: Setara min Jisan
