The city of Luskan has always been a den of pirates , thieves , and murderers . But lately , it has gotten even worse . A ship crashes ashore with nothing but corpses . Everyday people go crazy and kill those around them . The only signs found of even the most hardened criminals who walk the streets at night are bones . Luskan ’ s sister city , Waterdeep , sent a detachment to quarantine the unclean city — to let the filth die , rather than infect the rest of the Realms — but Myrin has slipped inside , declaring that she will save Luskan . Shadowbane follows , determined to save Myrin and therefore her pet city — even if he has to kill every rat in Luskan to do it . Shadowbane features the triumphant return of popular , dark vigilante Shadowbane from Downshadow and carries forth the threads of the worlds - spanning Abyssal Plague series .

title: Shadowbred
description: Shadowbred Shadowbred is the first book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale , struggling to preserve his humanity from a transformation into a shade , struggles alongside Drasek Riven to find and free their friend , Mags , from Sakkors .
description_long: Shadowbred Shadowbred is the first book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale , struggling to preserve his humanity from a transformation into a shade , struggles alongside Drasek Riven to find and free their friend , Mags , from Sakkors . In doing so , the group slows Netheril ' s tightening grip on Sembia .

title: Shadowcaster
description: Shadowcaster Shadowcasters are magic users who concentrate on studying shadow magic . This involves a significantly different path of study than learning most arcane magic , and requires a dedicated mind . Its secrets are closely guarded , so book learning is often not possible — shadowcasters are often chosen very selectively and then taught everything they know on the subject .
description_long: Shadowcaster Shadowcasters are magic users who concentrate on studying shadow magic . This involves a significantly different path of study than learning most arcane magic , and requires a dedicated mind . Its secrets are closely guarded , so book learning is often not possible — shadowcasters are often chosen very selectively and then taught everything they know on the subject . Most often found working for the churches of deities who grant access to the darkness domain , shadowcasters tended to be solitary individuals who faced persecution from paladin s and good - aligned cleric s regardless of their actual actions and intentions , due to a belief that anyone so closely linked to the plane of shadow must be inherently evil . True , the shadow plane was full of evil entities but the plane itself was only mildly evil - aligned and anyone with a disciplined enough mind could master the bizarre power available from it . Many also thought shadowcasters were tied to Shar s Shadow Weave but this was not the case . Due to the direct link a shadowcaster had with the plane itself , its powers could just as easily be accessed with the Weave . Shadow adept s are a type of shadowcaster .

title: Shadowcloak ( cloak )
description: Shadowcloak ( cloak ) A shadowcloak was a magic al cloak used by the Shadowcloaks thieves guild of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The guild was named for these cloaks . Description .
description_long: Shadowcloak ( cloak ) A shadowcloak was a magic al cloak used by the Shadowcloaks thieves guild of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The guild was named for these cloaks . Description . It was a large , baggy , hooded cape or mantle that could be drawn about the wearer and concealed all they wore underneath . It was made of a dull , gray fabric that seemed unnatural . Use . When they successfully joined the Shadowcloaks guild every member was granted their own " shadowcloak " . They had to protect their cloak , and if they lost it to an enemy , they had to reclaim it within three days or be killed . Powers . A " shadowcloak " granted a variety of powers useful to a Shadowcloak ' s trade . For one , it had the same power as a " cloak of elvenkind " , giving them increased ability to hide , to the point of being practically invisible . It also served as a " cloak of protection + 2 " . The wearer also gained infravision , the ability to see in the dark . However , this came with the side effect of limiting their normal vision in well - lit areas , slowing their ability to react according to the light level .

title: Shadowcloaks
description: Shadowcloaks The Shadowcloaks were a thieves ' guild located in the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Shadowcloaks were a rather large organization , but largely comprised of minor and unremarkable thieves and spies .
description_long: Shadowcloaks The Shadowcloaks were a thieves ' guild located in the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Shadowcloaks were a rather large organization , but largely comprised of minor and unremarkable thieves and spies . To join the society , a prospective member had to complete a perilous mission ordered by the Night Hood themself . One could only leave the guild in death , and the Shadowcloaks ensured this was the case , to protect their secrets . The Night Hood was the leader of the guild , and a mysterious figure . Activities . The actions and nature of the Shadowcloaks were mysterious but wide - ranging . Many Calauntans believed they worked closely with the ruling Merchant Duke s of Calaunt , either working for them directly or in alliance , else the dukes would have crushed them early in their reign . They had a monopoly on all fencing , piracy , and smuggling in the city . Outside pirates and smugglers who wished to conduct their trade in Calaunt had to seek permission from the Shadowcloaks and pay a tithe of one - third the value of their goods . Those who did could trade freely in the city . Those who didn ' t were killed .

title: Shadowdale
description: Shadowdale Shadowdale was a farming community in the Dalelands , in north Faerûn . It was the home of the archmage Elminster Aumar and was the home of two of the Seven Sisters , Storm Silverhand and Syluné . Through its history , Shadowdale battled both Zhentarim and drow invasions .
description_long: Shadowdale Shadowdale was a farming community in the Dalelands , in north Faerûn . It was the home of the archmage Elminster Aumar and was the home of two of the Seven Sisters , Storm Silverhand and Syluné . Through its history , Shadowdale battled both Zhentarim and drow invasions . Due to the number of ruins in Shadowdale , it was a popular place for adventuring companies to settle . History . Originally Shadowdale ( then known as the " Land Under Shadow " ) was controlled by the drow , who constructed the original Twisted Tower to protect their underground routes in the area . The drow maintained a population of human s and other races on the surface , used as slaves . The first human ruler of Shadowdale was the water wizard Ashaba , who took power in 906 DR and the Twisted Tower bore his name thereafter , along with the River Ashaba . Aumry Obarskyr became Lord of Shadowdale in 1300 DR . Aumry ruled peacefully over the dale with his wife Syluné Silverhand . The peace in the dale encouraged attacks and sabotage from the Zhentarim , and led to Aumry ' s assassination in 1339 DR . The assassins responsible for Aumry ' s death were captured and killed by Jyordhan .

title: Shadowdale ( novel )
description: Shadowdale ( novel ) Shadowdale , by Scott Ciencin , is the first book of the Avatar series . Summary . In the first part of the book , the adventurers Kelemvor Lyonsbane , Midnight , Cyric , and Adon are presented as they join in a party to rescue a lady , who actually is the goddess Mystra , held captive by the avatar of Bane .
description_long: Shadowdale ( novel ) Shadowdale , by Scott Ciencin , is the first book of the Avatar series . Summary . In the first part of the book , the adventurers Kelemvor Lyonsbane , Midnight , Cyric , and Adon are presented as they join in a party to rescue a lady , who actually is the goddess Mystra , held captive by the avatar of Bane . Midnight also receives a token of Mystra ' s power during the quest . The group eventually manage to help the goddess , who proceeds to defeat Bane . Mystra then tries to ascend to the gods ' world to provide Ao with the names of those responsible for the theft of the Tablets of Fate , but she is destroyed by Helm by Ao ' s order , since the Overgod wants the Tablets themselves back . In her last moment , the goddess pleads for the adventurers to rescue the Tablets and to ask for Elminster ' s help on their quest . In the second part of the book , the adventurers face a difficult travel to Shadowdale , home of Elminster . All the land is scarred and deformed by the violent death of the goddess Mystra , making travel dangerous and deadly . The party manages to reach Shadowdale only thanks to the power Mystra granted to Midnight .

title: Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land
description: Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land , designed by Richard Baker , Eric L . Boyd and Thomas M . Reid , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 .
description_long: Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land , designed by Richard Baker , Eric L . Boyd and Thomas M . Reid , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 . 5 edition ruleset . It focuses on Shadowdale , its invasion by Scyllua Darkhope , and the church of Shar . Summary . The combined forces of the Zhentarim , the drow of House Dhuurniv , and Esvele Greycastle of the Church of Shar overwhelm Shadowdale , after a preliminary raid destroys Elminster Aumar ' s tower and leaves him missing . It ' s up to the adventurers to save the legendary dale from the oppression of these dark forces , as a dead - magic zone emanates and grows from somewhere within the area . Appendix . " Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land " was originally to be titled " Shadowdale : The Weave Unwinding " . This title can still be seen in product descriptions online , such as at Amazon . This module is the second of a three - part series , with " " ( the first ) and " " ( the third ) , with shared plot elements and the theme of a Sharran attack upon Mystra and her Weave of magic , but it can be played independently .

title: Shadowdale Trail
description: Shadowdale Trail The Shadowdale Trail was a road in the Dalelands that ran north and south out of Shadowdale . Followed north out of Shadowdale it dwindled away to open country and became little more than a trail when followed south from Shadowdale along the River Ashaba to Mistledale . Shadowdale Trail intersected with the North Ride in the heart of Shadowdale village .
description_long: Shadowdale Trail The Shadowdale Trail was a road in the Dalelands that ran north and south out of Shadowdale . Followed north out of Shadowdale it dwindled away to open country and became little more than a trail when followed south from Shadowdale along the River Ashaba to Mistledale . Shadowdale Trail intersected with the North Ride in the heart of Shadowdale village .

title: Shadowdancer
description: Shadowdancer Shadowdancers were those who used innate ability rather than arcane magic to harness the power of shadow magic . Always existing in the place where light and darkness met , shadowdancers were enigmatic and dangerous . Despite the connotations between darkness and evil , many shadowdancers used their abilities for good .
description_long: Shadowdancer Shadowdancers were those who used innate ability rather than arcane magic to harness the power of shadow magic . Always existing in the place where light and darkness met , shadowdancers were enigmatic and dangerous . Despite the connotations between darkness and evil , many shadowdancers used their abilities for good . Shadowdancers drew upon the power of the shadows to become a bit like a " super rogue " in that their ability to hide was very potent . As a shadowdancer became more experienced , they could command the shadows to do their bidding . Abilities . Enchant Light Weapon , Shadow The most powerful Shadowdancers could infuse their weapons with the rawest essence of shadow , granting the weapon the ability to become insubstantial at the wielders will .

title: Shadowdark
description: Shadowdark The Shadowdark was an underground domain of the Underdark situated in the Deep Wastes just beneath Shadowdale . Geography . Covering a 120 - mile area of the Upperdark , the Shadowdark was largely centered around the village of Shadowdale .
description_long: Shadowdark The Shadowdark was an underground domain of the Underdark situated in the Deep Wastes just beneath Shadowdale . Geography . Covering a 120 - mile area of the Upperdark , the Shadowdark was largely centered around the village of Shadowdale . Riddled with tunnels , springs , lakes and even geothermal locations , the Shadowdark made a number of connections with surface locations around the dale and gave ample places for the drow in the area to hide .

title: Shadowdark ale
description: Shadowdark ale Shadowdark ale was an ale brewed in Shadowdale with a dark brown cloudy bubbling appearance and a yellow foamy head . Description . It had a light , bitter taste .
description_long: Shadowdark ale Shadowdark ale was an ale brewed in Shadowdale with a dark brown cloudy bubbling appearance and a yellow foamy head . Description . It had a light , bitter taste . History . It was first served at the Old Skull Inn but was later sold in many areas of Faerûn .

title: Shadoweirs
description: Shadoweirs The Shadoweirs ( pronounced SHA - doh - weerz ) were a religious knighthood of the High Forest . Its members , who were ranger s and druid s , were activists of their faith who fought for their beloved forests . They worked for the regrowth of forested areas and strove to halt the assault of civilization on their homeland .
description_long: Shadoweirs The Shadoweirs ( pronounced SHA - doh - weerz ) were a religious knighthood of the High Forest . Its members , who were ranger s and druid s , were activists of their faith who fought for their beloved forests . They worked for the regrowth of forested areas and strove to halt the assault of civilization on their homeland .

title: Shadowfang
description: Shadowfang Shadowfang was a shadowslain fang dragon involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Shadowfang approached the church of Shar in the hopes of using Shadow Weave magic to avoid the Rage of Dragons .
description_long: Shadowfang Shadowfang was a shadowslain fang dragon involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Shadowfang approached the church of Shar in the hopes of using Shadow Weave magic to avoid the Rage of Dragons . However , a Rage - induced madness caused him to attack some devil s in Myth Drannor , resulting in his death . Esvele Greycastle retrieved the corpse and had him raised as a shadowslain undead . In 1375 DR , she gave Shadowfang to the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv to cement their alliance with the Sharrans . The drow initially thought the dragon too subservient to Shar but soon understood that he was a free agent and collaborated with him .

title: Shadowfell
description: Shadowfell The Shadowfell , sometimes simply called Shadow , was a parallel plane from which necrotic energies and shadow magic stemmed . It existed as sort of a counterpart to the Feywild in the sense that it was a reflection or " echo " of the Prime Material Plane except that it was a bleak , desolate place full of decay and death . History .
description_long: Shadowfell The Shadowfell , sometimes simply called Shadow , was a parallel plane from which necrotic energies and shadow magic stemmed . It existed as sort of a counterpart to the Feywild in the sense that it was a reflection or " echo " of the Prime Material Plane except that it was a bleak , desolate place full of decay and death . History . The Shadowfell was created in 1385 DR when Shar , having successfully arranged Mystra ' s death , bound the energies of the Negative Energy Plane with the Plane of Shadow . Since then , the Shadowfell existed as a center of Shar ' s power as well as a transitory place for dead mortals on their way towards judgment on the Fugue Plane . Inhabitants . Much of the Shadowfell was a twisted reflection of the Prime Material plane and was populated primarily by dead creatures such as ghost s , specter s , and other undead who for whatever reason refused to leave the Shadowfell and continue on to the Fugue Plane . There were however , numerous other inhabitants , such as communities of shadar - kai , Shadovar , and dark one s . Locations . Domains of Dread .

title: Shadowfell Keep
description: Shadowfell Keep Shadowfell Keep , originally called Keegan ' s Keep , was one of many fortresses built by Cormyr along its frontier , located in the middle of the Thunder Peaks just northeast of Winterhaven . History . When Cormyr began to create a series of fortresses along its frontier in 236 DR , the shadow dragon Shadraxil took this as an affront to his lands and began attacking the outposts .
description_long: Shadowfell Keep Shadowfell Keep , originally called Keegan ' s Keep , was one of many fortresses built by Cormyr along its frontier , located in the middle of the Thunder Peaks just northeast of Winterhaven . History . When Cormyr began to create a series of fortresses along its frontier in 236 DR , the shadow dragon Shadraxil took this as an affront to his lands and began attacking the outposts . In response to Shadraxil ' s depredations , Cormyr sent a small force of armed men and War Wizard s led by the knight Jerold Keegan . Keegan set about creating a magical trap within one of the keeps in order to ensnare Shadraxil and bind him in the Plane of Shadow . The plan succeeded , and Shadraxil was trapped there for over eleven centuries , kept in a deep slumber for most of that time . Sir Jerold Keegan soon afterwards became the lord of that outpost , which was then called Keegan ' s Keep . The Keep was consecrated to the goddess Selûne . The town of Winterhaven was founded nearby , likely for the keep ' s protection . It was said that some time after Shadraxil ' s banishment , Keegan became a crazed madman and slew all of his family and friends , cursing the keep forever .

title: Shadowgloom
description: Shadowgloom Shadowgloom was an illusion spell that could be employed in two different ways . Description . The two usages were called " gloomcloud " and " quickshadow " .
description_long: Shadowgloom Shadowgloom was an illusion spell that could be employed in two different ways . Description . The two usages were called " gloomcloud " and " quickshadow " . The former created a cloud that could envelop an object or creature for concealment purposes . It protected creatures inside from the effects of sunlight and creatures whose vision wasn ' t fully functional in daylight . The cloud also made it difficult to make attacks inside or into the cloud . The latter created a humanoid shadow that moved in one direction . What humanoid the shadow depicted was the caster ' s choice , thus it could be used for coded messaging purposes , in which the depicted humanoid ' s race determined the message ' s code . Components . " Shadowgloom " used only verbal components .

title: Shadowkind
description: Shadowkind The Shadowkind were an assassins guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Calispar Delgorth , a Talona n priest and member of the Vipers bandits , contacted the Shadowkind and offered them his magic - resistant poison .
description_long: Shadowkind The Shadowkind were an assassins guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Calispar Delgorth , a Talona n priest and member of the Vipers bandits , contacted the Shadowkind and offered them his magic - resistant poison . In exchange , he desired the deaths of a few of his enemies in Procampur , including the high priest of Torm . The Shadowkind accepted on the condition of proof of the poison ' s magic immunity . Calispar accepted and organized a demonstration in the nearby hamlet of Sevenecho . A representative of the Shadowkind , Autton Shadowshroud , was sent to oversee the test . Organization . The Shadowkind were a small but elite guild of assassins . Description . It was customary for members to dye their hair black .

title: Shadowkiss
description: Shadowkiss The Shadowkiss was a criminal organization that operated across the Dragon Sea . Their base of operations was the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Activities .
description_long: Shadowkiss The Shadowkiss was a criminal organization that operated across the Dragon Sea . Their base of operations was the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Activities . The Shadowkiss engages in illegal activities such as drug and poisons selling across Returned Abeir .

title: Shadowmasters of Telflamm
description: Shadowmasters of Telflamm " This page is about the thieves ' guild of Telflamm . For information about the shapeshifters from the Shadowfell sometimes referred to as shadowmasters , see Malaugrym . " The Shadowmasters of Telflamm were a thieves ' guild that operates throughout the east of Faerûn .
description_long: Shadowmasters of Telflamm " This page is about the thieves ' guild of Telflamm . For information about the shapeshifters from the Shadowfell sometimes referred to as shadowmasters , see Malaugrym . " The Shadowmasters of Telflamm were a thieves ' guild that operates throughout the east of Faerûn . Their headquarters were located in Telflamm , where they rule the city in all but name . Formerly comprised of worshipers of Mask , they were later devoted to Shar .

title: Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality
description: Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality was the second major work of Telamont Tanthul , under the pseudonym " Shadow " . Description . " Shadows " was a tome describing the Plane of Shadow , based on investigations by Telamont himself and a group of other researchers .
description_long: Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality was the second major work of Telamont Tanthul , under the pseudonym " Shadow " . Description . " Shadows " was a tome describing the Plane of Shadow , based on investigations by Telamont himself and a group of other researchers . It was careful not to rudely dismiss previous beliefs on planar mechanics and explained the concept of demiplane s and quasiplane s thoroughly , beyond simply describing research into the Shadow Plane . History . When a student at Karsus ' s Academy of Mentalist Study , Telamont Tanthul published a thesis on the planes of existence . His work was scorned , and he was expelled , because thinking at the time insisted that all planes branched from Netheril itself . Further study of the demiplanes and quasiplanes was banned in a number of cities of Netheril .

title: Shadows of the Vampire
description: Shadows of the Vampire Shadows of the Vampire is a series of " Dungeons & Dragons " comic books published by as a tie - in to the adventure " Curse of Strahd " . It is a continuation of the series " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " , and is itself continued in " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Although the series itself is set on the Demiplane of Dread , technically part of the Ravenloft setting , it features a group of " Forgotten Realms " characters who find themselves transported to said Demiplane .
description_long: Shadows of the Vampire Shadows of the Vampire is a series of " Dungeons & Dragons " comic books published by as a tie - in to the adventure " Curse of Strahd " . It is a continuation of the series " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " , and is itself continued in " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Although the series itself is set on the Demiplane of Dread , technically part of the Ravenloft setting , it features a group of " Forgotten Realms " characters who find themselves transported to said Demiplane . Summary . Finding themselves trapped on the Demiplane of Dread , Delina , Minsc , and company must face the forces of darkness , including Count Strahd von Zarovich himself , in order to escape .

title: Shadows of the Vampire part 1
description: Shadows of the Vampire part 1 Shadows of the Vampire # 1 is a comic published by set primarily in the Demiplane of Dread . It is written by Jim Zub , and drawn by Nelson Dunbar . Product Description .
description_long: Shadows of the Vampire part 1 Shadows of the Vampire # 1 is a comic published by set primarily in the Demiplane of Dread . It is written by Jim Zub , and drawn by Nelson Dunbar . Product Description . Minsc and Boo are back ! And things have never looked more dire , as mysterious forces draw the legendary ranger and his crew of adventurers to RAVENLOFT , the Realm of Terror … where they find themselves face to face with undead horrors in the land of eternal night !

title: Shadowslain
description: Shadowslain A shadowslain was a unique type of undead monster created from the use of the " shadow shard " , a Shadow Weave artifact . Creation . A shadowslain was born when a creature was exposed to the necromantic magic of the " shadow shard " .
description_long: Shadowslain A shadowslain was a unique type of undead monster created from the use of the " shadow shard " , a Shadow Weave artifact . Creation . A shadowslain was born when a creature was exposed to the necromantic magic of the " shadow shard " . If they were a living and corporeal being and lacked the ability to use Weave magic in any form , and could not mentally resist its effect , then they were instantly killed and raised again as a shadowslain version of their former self . However , a being who could use Weave magic was simply injured almost to the point of unconsciousness as their magic was ripped from them , but otherwise survived . Meanwhile , one who commanded Shadow Weave magic was unharmed but could choose to die and become shadowslain . Description . A shadowslain being was swathed in flickering , rippling shadows , and its eyes glowed with a light described as unholy and hate - filled . Otherwise , they looked much as they did in life , but as undead beings they became increased emaciated and decayed to the point of being skeletal . Abilities .

title: Shadowstone
description: Shadowstone The Shadowstone was a powerful Shadow Weave heavy mace created by the goddess Shar . Description . The mace weighed 8 lb ( 3 .
description_long: Shadowstone The Shadowstone was a powerful Shadow Weave heavy mace created by the goddess Shar . Description . The mace weighed 8 lb ( 3 . 6 kg ) , and radiated a strong necromancy and abjuration aura . The wielder of this magical item was protected as if they possessed a " scarab of protection " and they cast more powerful darkness spells . Individuals hit by this dark weapon could be stuck blind . History . The Shadowstone was created by the goddess Shar , Mistress of the Night . She gave it to Damian Krale to aid him in uniting and leading the Sharran cells of the Western Heartlands .

title: Shadowstorm ( novel )
description: Shadowstorm ( novel ) Shadowstorm is the second book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary .
description_long: Shadowstorm ( novel ) Shadowstorm is the second book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary . After escaping Sakkors with Magadon Kest in tow , the trio find themselves in Cania at the whim of Mephistopheles . Erevis Cale makes a deal with the archdevil , for their freedom . It is only after the bargain is struck that Mephistopheles rips his son ' s soul in two , keeping part for himself to ensure Erevis keeps his word . Setting forth into the Plane of Shadow , the three set out to do as Cale has promised , only to find they are set upon by the shadow dragon Furlinastis . They make yet another bargain , this time to hunt down Kesson Rel . All the while , Netheril continues its plotting and scheming to bring Sembia into their empire . It is Selgaunt versus Sembia while the Saerb just try to survive the civil war with the help of Abelar Corrinthal and his father .

title: Shadowstrike
description: Shadowstrike Shadowstrike was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to attack a target through the target ' s shadow .
description_long: Shadowstrike Shadowstrike was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to attack a target through the target ' s shadow . After casting the spell the caster would attack the target ' s shadow with a dagger . Successfully striking the shadow caused equal damage to the target . Shadows were usually easier to hit than the target since armor and magical items offering protection were always ignored . The shadow needed to be attacked immediately after casting the spell , otherwise the spell dissipated . A strong light source was needed in order to cast a shadow sufficient enough to attack . Components . This spell did not require physical components to cast .

title: Shadowstuff
description: Shadowstuff Shadowstuff , or shadow substance , was a shadowy form of matter integral to the Plane of Shadow . It was found in items and phenomena there and in the bodies of creatures of darkness , and it was employed in some forms of illusion magic and shadow magic . It could also be crafted as weaponry , building materials , and other items , but such things were hazy , insubstantial , and all too impermanent .
description_long: Shadowstuff Shadowstuff , or shadow substance , was a shadowy form of matter integral to the Plane of Shadow . It was found in items and phenomena there and in the bodies of creatures of darkness , and it was employed in some forms of illusion magic and shadow magic . It could also be crafted as weaponry , building materials , and other items , but such things were hazy , insubstantial , and all too impermanent . Shadowstuff merged with rock was known as shadowstone . Locations . Shadowstuff was found on the Plane of Shadow . It was part of the fabric of the plane itself . The morphic nature of the Shadow Plane caused shadowstuff to manifest in strange ways . For example , in a cave in the Black Rift in the Shadow Swamp , stalactites dripped ephemeral shadowstuff , which was reabsorbed into the plane rather than form a puddle . Sites in the Shadow Fringe , the intersection between the Shadow Plane and the Prime Material Plane , tendrils of shadowstuff appeared and were seen to ebb and flow like tides . This was the case in the Underdark city of Chaulssin , the City of Wyrmshadows .

title: Shadowtop
description: Shadowtop Shadowtop was a type of common tree that grew throughout Faerûn . Description . Shadowtops could grow to be 90 feet tall , growing at a rate of two feet a year .
description_long: Shadowtop Shadowtop was a type of common tree that grew throughout Faerûn . Description . Shadowtops could grow to be 90 feet tall , growing at a rate of two feet a year . Their irregular , feathering leaves grew at the very top of the tree , having dark green tops and a coppery hue on the underside . The tops of Shadowtops were prone to fire . Usage . Shadow - wood was fibrous , making it undesirable for building but good for ropemaking . The fibrous wood was good for cookfires as it burned hot and slow without giving off much smoke . Shadowtop torches , which could be purchased for 1 sp , burned longer than other wood torches and gave off less smoke . Shadow - wood was used to make magical staves and rod s . The dagger " Applebane " had a shadow - wood handle . History . Shadowtop trees flourished in 1314 DR .

title: Shadowtop Glade
description: Shadowtop Glade The Shadowtop Glade was a shrine to Eilistraee in the northern part of Velarswood , near Harrowdale . Geography . The shrine consisted of two series of caverns located on both sides of a steep - sided gully .
description_long: Shadowtop Glade The Shadowtop Glade was a shrine to Eilistraee in the northern part of Velarswood , near Harrowdale . Geography . The shrine consisted of two series of caverns located on both sides of a steep - sided gully . It was named after a grove of shadowtop trees that surrounded the place . Inhabitants . A group of about fifty followers of Eilistraeen , drow and other elves , dwelt in the shrine . Activities . The worshipers of Eilistraee of the Shadowtop Glade were creating a surface home there and had good relations with local humans , whom they aided when ill . Eilistraeen priestesses and moon - worshiping lycanthropes from the nearby Howling Hill joined together in sacred hunts to Eilistraee and Selûne when the moon was full . They also often danced the personal and intimate evensong , in gratitude to their goddess .

title: Shadowy Eye
description: Shadowy Eye The Shadowy Eye was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Shadowy Eye was made - up of 900 dark creeper mercenaries .
description_long: Shadowy Eye The Shadowy Eye was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Shadowy Eye was made - up of 900 dark creeper mercenaries . Activities . This mercenary organization served as advanced scouts for the dao . Delivering false information was severely punished by the dao , so the dark creepers generally provided detailed reports . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Shadraxil
description: Shadraxil Shadraxil was already a great wyrm when the nation of Cormyr was founded in 26 DR and had sired many other Shadow dragon s , including Shhuusshuru . He laired in the Thunder Peaks where his granddaughter Aurgloroasa presently resides . When Cormyr absorbed the nations of Esparin and Orva at its founding , it built several fortresses in the Thunder Peaks to guard its eastern border .
description_long: Shadraxil Shadraxil was already a great wyrm when the nation of Cormyr was founded in 26 DR and had sired many other Shadow dragon s , including Shhuusshuru . He laired in the Thunder Peaks where his granddaughter Aurgloroasa presently resides . When Cormyr absorbed the nations of Esparin and Orva at its founding , it built several fortresses in the Thunder Peaks to guard its eastern border . In 236 DR Shadraxil began attacking these keeps . In response Cormyr sent the knight and dragonslayer Jerold Keegan and a contingent of men to slay him . Keegan ' s plan involved luring Shadraxil into an arcane trap that would seal him inside a magical prison in the Plane of Shadow . The plan succeeded , but in his rage , Shadraxil drew upon all of his considerable arcane powers to extend his influence beyond his prison and managed to drive Keegan mad . Seeing the dragon ' s work for what it was , the knights were told by King Tharyann to slay a juvenile shadow dragon , bury it and keep the affair secret . The fortresses were abandoned for fear of future reprisals from Shadraxil .

title: Shadrun of the Snows
description: Shadrun of the Snows Shadrun of the Snows is a monastary at a hot spring near the borders of Erlkazar . The monastary was founded centuries ago by a holy man named Vashtun who built a small shrine . People would come to visit and leave offerings .
description_long: Shadrun of the Snows Shadrun of the Snows is a monastary at a hot spring near the borders of Erlkazar . The monastary was founded centuries ago by a holy man named Vashtun who built a small shrine . People would come to visit and leave offerings . Some visitors remained to meditate which is how the monastary was formed . When Vashtun died another monk took his name and assumed leadership of the monastary . By tradition , at the passing of each Vashtun , another monk assumes the title . The second in command of the monastary is known as Diamar . People who meditate at Shardun of the Snows often hear a strange voice at the back of their minds which is actually an imprisoned entity named Fandour who is attempting to make contact with the Prime Material Plane . The interior of the monastary is decorated with paintings and carvings of strange geometric symbols that Fandour subconsciously influenced the monks to create . Shadrun is protected by two deva s , Lakini and Lusk .

title: Shael
description: Shael Shael was an elf who operated a clothing shop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Activities . Shael created cloak s , glove s , hat s , shoe s and tunic s which he charged very little , but usually dealt with wealthy clients .
description_long: Shael Shael was an elf who operated a clothing shop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Activities . Shael created cloak s , glove s , hat s , shoe s and tunic s which he charged very little , but usually dealt with wealthy clients . Many of Shael ' s clients invited him to their estates and provided him with the things he needed to live in luxury , such as Queen Amlaruil Moonflower and the Council of Matrons . History . By 1367 DR , Shael was a retired windrider and adventurer .

title: Shaeradim
description: Shaeradim The Shaeradim are the twelve hills surrounding the elven settlement of Evereska . They are almost six thousand feet high and are surrounded for fifteen miles by lesser hills and narrow vales . There is a large valley west of Evereska and inside the hills called the West Cwm .
description_long: Shaeradim The Shaeradim are the twelve hills surrounding the elven settlement of Evereska . They are almost six thousand feet high and are surrounded for fifteen miles by lesser hills and narrow vales . There is a large valley west of Evereska and inside the hills called the West Cwm . The mountain Ilaerothil ( the Sentinel ) is fifteen miles northwest of this site , and Eastpeak is fifteen miles southeast .

title: Shaerl Amcathra
description: Shaerl Amcathra Shaerl Amcathra ( born Shaerl Rowanmantle ) was a female rogue and former diplomatic envoy for the nation of Cormyr . She was married to former Lord of Shadowdale , Mourngrym Amcathra . Background .
description_long: Shaerl Amcathra Shaerl Amcathra ( born Shaerl Rowanmantle ) was a female rogue and former diplomatic envoy for the nation of Cormyr . She was married to former Lord of Shadowdale , Mourngrym Amcathra . Background . Shaerl was sent to Shadowdale by Vangerdahast in 1355 DR , to investigate why the last two lords of Shadowdale had been " chosen " by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . She fell in love with the then ruler of Shadowdale , Mourngrym Amcathra , and the pair married the same year . They had a child , Scotti Amcathra , in 1358 DR .

title: Shafiya
description: Shafiya Chief Shafiya was the leader of the Haifami tribe of Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Shafiya was a young man of incredible physical prowess and vigor .
description_long: Shafiya Chief Shafiya was the leader of the Haifami tribe of Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Shafiya was a young man of incredible physical prowess and vigor . He had black skin like all of the members of the Haifami tribe . History . Shafiya was the third son of the previous chief of the Haifami .

title: Shahrokh
description: Shahrokh Shahrokh was an extremely powerful djinn lord and was the vizar to the pasha of Calimport . Abilities . Shahrokh was a powerful mage who was even able to penetrate Acham el Jhotos ' s wards to enter the city of Almraiven .
description_long: Shahrokh Shahrokh was an extremely powerful djinn lord and was the vizar to the pasha of Calimport . Abilities . Shahrokh was a powerful mage who was even able to penetrate Acham el Jhotos ' s wards to enter the city of Almraiven . History . He worked with efreet to complete the Ritual of Return , which would free Calim and Memnon from their prison . Appearance . Like most djinn , Shahrokh had no legs ; rather , his lower body was a whirlwind . He was larger than most genies .

title: Shajar
description: Shajar Shajar was the savage god of the Nogaro River in Zakhara , depicted with the head of a hippopotamus , and was the consort of Ragarra . Largely forgotten after the fall of the ancient kingdom of Nog and the rise of Enlightenment , his worship was continued by secret cults scattered throughout the Cities of the Ancients area . As the embodiment of the great Nogaro , Shajar represented both its benevolent , life - giving qualities and the destructive character present during the river ' s recurring floods .
description_long: Shajar Shajar was the savage god of the Nogaro River in Zakhara , depicted with the head of a hippopotamus , and was the consort of Ragarra . Largely forgotten after the fall of the ancient kingdom of Nog and the rise of Enlightenment , his worship was continued by secret cults scattered throughout the Cities of the Ancients area . As the embodiment of the great Nogaro , Shajar represented both its benevolent , life - giving qualities and the destructive character present during the river ' s recurring floods . Thus the deity was called upon at births and deaths . < br > The greatest relic of the cult was the Talisman of Shajar .

title: Shajar ( human )
description: Shajar ( human ) Shajar lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Shajar possessed a rare combination of beauty that matched her wondrous spirit .
description_long: Shajar ( human ) Shajar lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Shajar possessed a rare combination of beauty that matched her wondrous spirit . Relationships . Shajar was the slave of Alim Baybars and Melisende Baybars . History . She was the daughter of a desert chieftain who taught her some skill with a blade . She was suited to rule her father ' s tribe , but Fate had other plans . She was captured by slavers and sold to the sultan of the Pearl Coast where she lived in his harim . She was eventually sold to a prince on the island of Harab but the ship carrying her was attacked en route by corsairs . The corsairs were then attacked by the ghoul pirates of Kaff and she was taken to Alim Baybars .

title: Shajji Ghoiji
description: Shajji Ghoiji Shajji Ghoiji was the leader , or " qaghan " , of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the early 14th century DR . Ghoiji ' s brother , Shajji Hoijarek , abandoned his life as a lama to serve under his brother as " apa qaghan " . However , Ghoiji ' s government was corrupt and fell into chaos and finally rebellion " circa " 1337 DR .
description_long: Shajji Ghoiji Shajji Ghoiji was the leader , or " qaghan " , of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the early 14th century DR . Ghoiji ' s brother , Shajji Hoijarek , abandoned his life as a lama to serve under his brother as " apa qaghan " . However , Ghoiji ' s government was corrupt and fell into chaos and finally rebellion " circa " 1337 DR . Hoijarek stepped in , gathering capable advisors to his side and ascending as the new " qaghan " .

title: Shajji Hoijarek
description: Shajji Hoijarek Shajji Hoijarek was a human barbarian of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the 13th and 14th centuries DR . A former lama , he became the " qaghan " or leader of the tribe . History .
description_long: Shajji Hoijarek Shajji Hoijarek was a human barbarian of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the 13th and 14th centuries DR . A former lama , he became the " qaghan " or leader of the tribe . History . Hoijarek was originally a lama at the temples in the city of Jugicha . However , at the age of 50 , he left his temple to serve as " apa qaghan " under his brother , Shajji Ghoiji , who at the time ruled the Tsu - tsu as " qaghan " . However , Ghoiji ' s government was corrupt and fell into chaos and finally rebellion " circa " 1337 DR . Thus Hoijarek stepped in , gathering capable advisors to his side and ascending as the new " qaghan " . For the next 20 years , Hoijarek ruled well and worked to reestablish order in Jugicha and revive Tsu - tsu prosperity . He opposed the Fankiang tribe and the rulers of Li - Raz as a means of uniting his people . However , during a raid , the Fankiang killed his wife and children , Hoijarek made a vow of vengeance , and all the Tsu - tsu swore with him . Hoijarek remained in power by 1357 DR , but knew he had only a few years remaining to witness the fall of the Fankiang before his old body succumbed to age .

title: Shakti Hunzrin
description: Shakti Hunzrin Shakti Hunzrin was a powerful Menzoberranyr traitor - priestess of Lolth and Vhaeraun . She hated Liriel Baenre , pursuing her across Faerun and trying to kill her several times , but she was not successful . Description .
description_long: Shakti Hunzrin Shakti Hunzrin was a powerful Menzoberranyr traitor - priestess of Lolth and Vhaeraun . She hated Liriel Baenre , pursuing her across Faerun and trying to kill her several times , but she was not successful . Description . Shakti was solid by drow standards , even plump , and had hard red eyes . She was nearsighted from birth , but in 1361 DR she was able to heal herself by the power of Lolth and Vhaeraun . Personality . Shakti had no sense of humor . Shakti ' s greatest passion was rothe farming - - she was in charge of House Hunzrin ' s rothe herds on the Isle of Rothe in Lake Donigarten . In fact , she didn ' t really want to be a priestess originally , but she appreciated the power it gave her . History . While seeking revenge against her rival Liriel , Shakti approached Nisstyre , a known follower of Vhaeraun , and offered to become a " traitor priestess " serving both Lolth and Vhaeraun and offering her services to Nisstyre . In 1361 DR , Shakti was ordained a high priestess , despite having not completed all her years at Arach - Tinilith . By 1484 DR , Shakti had become matron mother of House Hunzrin , the Eleventh House .

title: Shal
description: Shal Shal was a succubus posing as the duergar consort of Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Shal was a loyal servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt .
description_long: Shal Shal was a succubus posing as the duergar consort of Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Shal was a loyal servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . Her only mission was to hide the madness that had infected the Deepking . She was unveiled by an adventuring party that had escaped Velkynvelve .

title: Shal Desanea
description: Shal Desanea Shal Desanea was a wizard who lived in Phlan , she was happily married to Tarl Desanea . She hailed from Cormyr . Description .
description_long: Shal Desanea Shal Desanea was a wizard who lived in Phlan , she was happily married to Tarl Desanea . She hailed from Cormyr . Description . Shal was a big , brawny woman , well over six feet tall and over 200 pounds . She had shoulder length auburn ( reddish - brown ) hair , silky skin and green eyes . Possessions . Shal possessed a cloth of many pockets , a magical dagger , a crystal ball , a ring of wishes , a magical flying horse originally named Cerulean , then Mulberry ( although in Pool of Radiance , the horse was again called Cerulean ) that she inherited from her deceased mage master and a wand of wonder . History . Shal Bal was an apprentice magic user when her master , Ranthor of Cormyr , was struck down by an evil foe with a dagger adorned with a bizarre snake ' s - head armlet . Her master was thoughtful enough to leave certain magical artifacts about to enable her escape . One of these artifacts was a ring of wishes that she accidentally used . It transformed her small female frame into a tall , well - muscled body when she wished she was strong enough to remove the saddle and packs off of her magical horse ' s back .

title: Shala Karanok
description: Shala Karanok Shala Karanok was the ruler of Chessenta until Tchazzar ' s return in 1479 DR , when she relinquished the throne and became a minor dignitary in Tchazzar ' s court . In order to divert suspicion from Jhesrhi Coldcreek , Shala took the blame for the sabotage of Tchazzar ' s supplies and he threw her in the dungeon . She was rescued by Chessentan nobles at the start of the Battle of Luthcheq and she returned to kill Tchazzar after he had been weakened by Jhesri ' s magic .
description_long: Shala Karanok Shala Karanok was the ruler of Chessenta until Tchazzar ' s return in 1479 DR , when she relinquished the throne and became a minor dignitary in Tchazzar ' s court . In order to divert suspicion from Jhesrhi Coldcreek , Shala took the blame for the sabotage of Tchazzar ' s supplies and he threw her in the dungeon . She was rescued by Chessentan nobles at the start of the Battle of Luthcheq and she returned to kill Tchazzar after he had been weakened by Jhesri ' s magic . Shala reclaimed the throne of Chessenta and reimposed restrictions on mage s . Appearance . As of 1479 DR , Shala was middle - aged and solidly built with a square jaw and dark hair . She preferred to wear masculine clothing .

title: Shalaer
description: Shalaer Shalaer was once an able half - elf bard who became a spectral harpist and a caretaker for the Harpers in 1368 DR . Activities . Shalaer took care of the House of the Harp in Elventree .
description_long: Shalaer Shalaer was once an able half - elf bard who became a spectral harpist and a caretaker for the Harpers in 1368 DR . Activities . Shalaer took care of the House of the Harp in Elventree . She acted as a counselor and information broker for visiting Harpers , loving to sing and chat with them . She always tried to rally the spirits of despairing or depressed Harpers .

title: Shalanar
description: Shalanar Shalanar was the central barony of Erlkazar and included the capital of the kingdom . Description . The king ' s lands were the primary agricultural lands .
description_long: Shalanar Shalanar was the central barony of Erlkazar and included the capital of the kingdom . Description . The king ' s lands were the primary agricultural lands . Besides the capital city , there were four farming villages and more than a dozen hamlets . Three additional villages made their livelihood from fishing . Geography . Shalanar Barony sat on the western shore of the portion of the Deepwash known locally as Shalane Lake . Impresk Barony was to the north , Carrelath Barony to the west , Tanistan Barony to the southwest , and Ahlarkhem Barony to the southeast . Government . Former adventurer and leader of Elestam ' s Crusaders , Korox Morkann was king of all Erlkazar and ruler of the barony of Shalanar in 1370 DR . He ruled from the capital city of Llorbauth , from the royal stronghold of Klarsamryn .

title: Shalantha ' s delicate disc
description: Shalantha ' s delicate disc Shalantha ' s delicate disc was a conjuration spell that caused a small disk to appear that looked like it was made of rose colored eggshell . A second spell was then cast which the disk absorbed . This spell was released if the disk was ever broken .
description_long: Shalantha ' s delicate disc Shalantha ' s delicate disc was a conjuration spell that caused a small disk to appear that looked like it was made of rose colored eggshell . A second spell was then cast which the disk absorbed . This spell was released if the disk was ever broken . History . It was presumably developed by Shalantha .

title: Shalara Swordshigh
description: Shalara Swordshigh In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , Shalara Swordshigh was the High Herald Old Night , in charge of keeping the heraldry of the Realms in order and maintaining the huge library at Herald ' s Holdfast . Personality . Quiet - spoken , Old Night Shalara said almost nothing in Council of 12 Peers meetings , except to provide lore and information on current situations in the North .
description_long: Shalara Swordshigh In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , Shalara Swordshigh was the High Herald Old Night , in charge of keeping the heraldry of the Realms in order and maintaining the huge library at Herald ' s Holdfast . Personality . Quiet - spoken , Old Night Shalara said almost nothing in Council of 12 Peers meetings , except to provide lore and information on current situations in the North . She could perfectly recall and quote all the words spoken by the other Peers back at them , but played no favorites . She merely strove for clarity in thought and argument . Possessions . Shalara customarily wore " bracers of armor + 4 " and carried a rusty iron sphere ( " iron bands of Bilarro " ) at her belt . History . Shalara was promoted to the office of Old Night after her predecessor , Haemar the Old , died sometime between the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR and the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , She belonged to Lady Alustriel Silverhand ' s Council of 12 Peers which helped rule the Silver Marches around 1370 DR . Old Night held the title of Member at Large . If Lady Alustriel died , Old Night would act as High Lady until the Council voted on a new ruler of the Silver Marches .

title: Shalarin
description: Shalarin Shalarins were an undersea race of graceful humanoid swimmers . Description . These hairless waterborne humanoids usually have dark blue skin " ( though other hues are not uncommon ) " , large dark eyes , long spindly arms , webbed fingers and toes , and a dorsal fin that travels down from their head to the base of their spine and are as slender as elves .
description_long: Shalarin Shalarins were an undersea race of graceful humanoid swimmers . Description . These hairless waterborne humanoids usually have dark blue skin " ( though other hues are not uncommon ) " , large dark eyes , long spindly arms , webbed fingers and toes , and a dorsal fin that travels down from their head to the base of their spine and are as slender as elves . This race of aquatic humanoids are fast swimmers and have slippery skin instead of scales . History . Shalarin originally come from the Sea of Corynactis but , in an effort to gain divine power , the demon lord Dagon opened the " Wildtide Portal " that swept up a large number of shalarin from their home and deposited them in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Having already managed to restrict the shalarin pantheon ' s influence to the Corynactis , he hoped to destroy the contingent in the inner sea by having those loyal to him attack them . He didn ' t count on the merfolk intervening though and together , the merfolk and the surviving 30 % of the shalarin defeated Dagon ' s forces . The shalarin found a new god to replace the old ones whom they could no longer hear and Dagon ' s plan was foiled .

title: Shaleen Oomreen
description: Shaleen Oomreen Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Loviatar . She was the High Priestess , or " Whipmistress " , of the House of Scarlet Hooks temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR .
description_long: Shaleen Oomreen Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Loviatar . She was the High Priestess , or " Whipmistress " , of the House of Scarlet Hooks temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR . She had twenty - four subordinate priests and 114 lay - followers .

title: Shalendra Floshin
description: Shalendra Floshin Shalendra Floshin was a sun elf in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Shalendra was the sister of Darfin Floshin and daughter of Elorfindar Floshin .
description_long: Shalendra Floshin Shalendra Floshin was a sun elf in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Shalendra was the sister of Darfin Floshin and daughter of Elorfindar Floshin . She was always attracted to the portal nexus connecting Ardeep Forest to Evermeet that her family surveyed . In 1370 Shalendra was a cavalier - in - training not yet accepted into the house of the ducal lord of Daggerford . During a trip to Evermeet , she joined the Eldreth Veluuthra . She left Daggerford in disagreement with her father and went back only around 1445 DR when Elorfindar died . Only in 1485 DR however Shalendra met again her brother Darfin . Shortly before 1485 DR , Shalendra was investigating the ruins of a fallen portal when she was approached by the pit fiend Baazka , who had been attracted by her bitterness and burgeoning evil . Baazka convinced her to make a deal with the Red Wizards of Thay to reconstruct the portal using her knowledge and their resources . In truth , Baazka was using Shalendra as a contingency plan in case of the inevitable treachery of the Red Wizards .

title: Shaless
description: Shaless Shaless was a woman of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . She was an adventurer . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , she made a triumphant return to The Drunken Dragon , favorite tavern in Tsurlagol , and there displayed a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s .
description_long: Shaless Shaless was a woman of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . She was an adventurer . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , she made a triumphant return to The Drunken Dragon , favorite tavern in Tsurlagol , and there displayed a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s . According to her , she had explored the ruins of Myth Drannor , battled devil s , and pulled the treasures from their claws . Maerhult , a bard also visiting the tavern , examined two of her harps and pronounced them to be genuine works of old Myth Drannor , and to be rare magical items .

title: Shalhoond
description: Shalhoond The Shalhoond , also called the Great Wild Wood , was a forest located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of Semphar and Murghom , south of the Khopet - Dag , and east of the Mountains of Copper , the Shalhoond marked the border between the nations of the south and the lands of the nomadic tribes of the north .
description_long: Shalhoond The Shalhoond , also called the Great Wild Wood , was a forest located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of Semphar and Murghom , south of the Khopet - Dag , and east of the Mountains of Copper , the Shalhoond marked the border between the nations of the south and the lands of the nomadic tribes of the north . Though no nation claimed the forest for themselves , both Semphar and Murghom had settlements on the edges of the forest that took lumber from the area , transporting the logs to Gbor Nor down the many rivers that ran through the forest . The Shalhoond was noted for its large amount of game , which attracted many hunters from both the north and south . The large number of monsters in the forest made hunting in it a dangerous venture .

title: Shaliana Ghend
description: Shaliana Ghend Shaliana Ghend was a merchant in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Shaliana managed the Scardale Provisioner .
description_long: Shaliana Ghend Shaliana Ghend was a merchant in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Shaliana managed the Scardale Provisioner . History . Shaliana was the only merchant to survive without damage the rule of Lashan Aumersair . She only relocated to outside the town of Scardale after the Second inter - dale war . In 1368 DR , she decided to send her daughter Talana Ghend to reopen inside the city .

title: Shaliim Wyrmslayer
description: Shaliim Wyrmslayer Shaliim Wyrmslayer was in 1373 DR the Overking of Lapaliiya ruling from Sheirtalar , the Lapaliiyan town holy to Waukeen and the most powerful city of the League . History . Around 1353 DR prince Shaliim went to adventures with a band of Waterdhavian wild blades , even planewaking .
description_long: Shaliim Wyrmslayer Shaliim Wyrmslayer was in 1373 DR the Overking of Lapaliiya ruling from Sheirtalar , the Lapaliiyan town holy to Waukeen and the most powerful city of the League . History . Around 1353 DR prince Shaliim went to adventures with a band of Waterdhavian wild blades , even planewaking . In a distant plane ruled by Black Wyrms , a group of powerful black dragon s , Shaliim was forced to kill one of the Black Wyrm , gaining his namesake . In 1357 DR he went back to Lapaliiya , where was forced to battle many thieves in search of his hoard . At last in 1371 DR his father died and Shaliim became Overking . His goal was now found a wife . However the Black Wyrms were still in search of their revenge .

title: Shalis Ptolexis
description: Shalis Ptolexis Shalis Ptolexis was a human woman of Mulhorandi descent who was married to the patriarch of House Darkdance of Westgate , Neveren Darkdance . She was also the mother of the powerful mage Myrin Darkdance . Shalis was a priestess of Sharess and wrote a book called " Wanderings in Love ' s Name " , which was published in 1354 DR .
description_long: Shalis Ptolexis Shalis Ptolexis was a human woman of Mulhorandi descent who was married to the patriarch of House Darkdance of Westgate , Neveren Darkdance . She was also the mother of the powerful mage Myrin Darkdance . Shalis was a priestess of Sharess and wrote a book called " Wanderings in Love ' s Name " , which was published in 1354 DR .

title: Shallows
description: Shallows Shallows is a settlement on the River Surbrin near to the Spine of the World . Its leader is the wizard Withegroo Seian ' Doo , who has his own tower , a thirty foot ( 9 . 1m ) high stone cylindrical building , from which hangs a pennant depicting a pair of hands surrounded by golden stars , on a red background .
description_long: Shallows Shallows is a settlement on the River Surbrin near to the Spine of the World . Its leader is the wizard Withegroo Seian ' Doo , who has his own tower , a thirty foot ( 9 . 1m ) high stone cylindrical building , from which hangs a pennant depicting a pair of hands surrounded by golden stars , on a red background . Its population is around one hundred , of which all the adults are capable of fighting with weapons . The houses are mainly of stone construction with supporting wood . When the wizard ' s tower was constructed by dwarves , they dug a series of tunnels and passageways beneath in order to ease the process , which still exist . History . Shallows came to be when Withegroo built a tower for himself . Noting the relative safety of living beside it , and the trading opportunities it brought , people began to settle around the tower . Orc attack . In 1370 DR a huge force of orc s and frost giant s attacked Shallows during a visit by King Bruenor Battlehammer and the Companions of the Hall , who were able to aid in its defense .

title: Shalok
description: Shalok Shalok was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Shalok was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault located under Thaymount .
description_long: Shalok Shalok was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Shalok was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault located under Thaymount . As one of the most loyal and fanatical followers of Szass Tam , he was tasked with the custody of the Chosen of Tymora Curran Corvalin in the deepest levels of the dungeon . Heroes from Daggerford fought him in 1486 DR , but when Shalok saw things going bad he immediately surrendered . Personality . Despite his loyalty to Tam , Shalok was a coward at heart .

title: Shaloon Farain
description: Shaloon Farain Shaloon Farain was a cleric of Mask in Telflamm in 1370 DR and a Proven Sister of the Shadowmasters . Personality . Shaloon was an enthusiastic and sly young woman .
description_long: Shaloon Farain Shaloon Farain was a cleric of Mask in Telflamm in 1370 DR and a Proven Sister of the Shadowmasters . Personality . Shaloon was an enthusiastic and sly young woman . She was familiar with many of the Proven and common guild members and , with no remorse , she helped them with her powers . History . Shaloon was born to a festhall employee in Telflamm . ( Unknown to most save the highest members of temple of Mask , this woman was also the mother of Keshna Finlothleer . ) Later in life , she entered the church of Mask . Usually , her superiors assigned her to work with the Shadowmasters ' members .

title: Shalush Myrkeer
description: Shalush Myrkeer Shalush Myrkeer was a prominent merchant in Westgate . History . Shalush emigrated from Amn in 1350 DR and wanted to start his merchant house in Westgate .
description_long: Shalush Myrkeer Shalush Myrkeer was a prominent merchant in Westgate . History . Shalush emigrated from Amn in 1350 DR and wanted to start his merchant house in Westgate . For long time , his aspiration to take a place in the Council of Lords was blocked by House Urdo and House Guldar , but with the recent deaths of both the Urdo and Guldar patriarchs and the elevation of Houses Bleth and Cormaeril , Shalush had hope again .

title: Shalvus Martholio
description: Shalvus Martholio Shalvus Martholio was was a Zhentarim spy inside Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR posing as a shepherd Shalvus infiltrated Goldenfields .
description_long: Shalvus Martholio Shalvus Martholio was was a Zhentarim spy inside Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR posing as a shepherd Shalvus infiltrated Goldenfields . His mission was to find the weakness of the place and reported to Nalaskur Thaelond of Bargewright Inn . He was at the livestock fields when giant s attacked the city . Personality . Shalvus wanted rise the Zhent ranks quickly and hoped that Goldenfield was the right place to show his qualities . He accepted any risks to fed his ambition . However Shalvus truly loved animals . Behind the scenes . Shalvus was one of the special NPCs that could be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Shaman
description: Shaman A shaman , sometimes called a spirit shaman , is a powerful primal leader who calls upon nature spirit s for aid or guidance . Shamans , much like cleric s or warlord s , are often leaders or healers , though they lead most often by example and through wisdom than through inspiration or charisma . Shamans are also more durable than their divine or martial equivalents , gaining through their connection to the wild a powerful capacity for enduring pain .
description_long: Shaman A shaman , sometimes called a spirit shaman , is a powerful primal leader who calls upon nature spirit s for aid or guidance . Shamans , much like cleric s or warlord s , are often leaders or healers , though they lead most often by example and through wisdom than through inspiration or charisma . Shamans are also more durable than their divine or martial equivalents , gaining through their connection to the wild a powerful capacity for enduring pain . Arganth Snarrl was a notable shamanic advisor of Obould , during the latter ' s mortal life . Culture . Constantly aware of spirits that others cannot see , shamans fit unevenly into society , even compared with others who draw on the same power , such as druid s or warden s . Within their native cultures shamans are highly valued as healers , storytellers , and spiritual advisors . Outside , shamans are still valued , if only for the power they wield , channeling into allies to empower and heal them while striking down the enemies of nature . Shamans gain their power through alliances with these powers of the " spirit world " and act as intermediaries between them and the corporeal inhabitants of the visible world .

title: Shambarin
description: Shambarin Shambarin , also known as the Shadowcloak , and formerly Keltie " Silkhips " Silmar , was a mage who lived in Berdusk . Description . She often appeared as a bearded recluse of a man .
description_long: Shambarin Shambarin , also known as the Shadowcloak , and formerly Keltie " Silkhips " Silmar , was a mage who lived in Berdusk . Description . She often appeared as a bearded recluse of a man . The disguise helped her hide from old enemies from Amn who were victims of her many thefts . Activities . In her youth , Shambarin spent her time stealing gems , gold , perfumes , and silks from caravans travelling through Amn . Back then she was known as the thief Keltie " Silkhips " Silmar .

title: Shambling mound
description: Shambling mound A shambling mound is a large , animate d plant with predatory tendencies . Description . They appear to be moving , vaguely man - shaped mounds of rotting vegetation .
description_long: Shambling mound A shambling mound is a large , animate d plant with predatory tendencies . Description . They appear to be moving , vaguely man - shaped mounds of rotting vegetation . Shambling mounds feed off of the flesh and blood of living creatures they have engulfed and crushed within their own bodies . Ecology . Lairs . Shambling mounds are a type of plant creature that dwells in forests and swamps . Species . Serpentine . A serpentine shambling mound has been corrupted by tainted blueberries . Their bodies have been stretched so that they resemble serpents with the head and hands on one end and the legs on the other , but otherwise have nothing in common with serpents . There are only a few of these creatures . They dwell in the east starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor , north of the Halfaxe Trail .

title: Shambos
description: Shambos " Shambos " was the Realms name for a tropical sea turtle shell . An adult sea turtle carapace would yield thirty - seven plates if cut by a skilled craftsman who knew how to regulate the heat required to separate them without ruining the color . The thirteen inner plates , known as " blades " , were valued for artistic ornamentation .
description_long: Shambos " Shambos " was the Realms name for a tropical sea turtle shell . An adult sea turtle carapace would yield thirty - seven plates if cut by a skilled craftsman who knew how to regulate the heat required to separate them without ruining the color . The thirteen inner plates , known as " blades " , were valued for artistic ornamentation . The twenty - four remaining edge - plates were of little value because they were usually damaged at some time in the turtle ' s life . Shambos plates were valued from 1 gp to 5 gp each depending on size and quality .

title: Shamph
description: Shamph Shamph , also known as the Crossroads City , was a city in the nation of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . Merchants from the south stopped at Shamph to sell their goods to avoid the war zone between the cities of Iijak and Hlath . Government .
description_long: Shamph Shamph , also known as the Crossroads City , was a city in the nation of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . Merchants from the south stopped at Shamph to sell their goods to avoid the war zone between the cities of Iijak and Hlath . Government . The city was ruled fairly and justly by mayor Tian Redown . Geography . Shamph sat at the junction of the Emerald Way and the Old Road .

title: Shan
description: Shan Shan is a halfling ranger and is the twin sister of Cynda . She is also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak .
description_long: Shan Shan is a halfling ranger and is the twin sister of Cynda . She is also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak . Shan communicates with her sister using sign language . History . Shan and Cynda found many adventures together prior to joining the circus . When the circus was attacked by minotaur warriors from Calimport , Shan and her twin traveled with Cephas and Corvus Nightfeather to Almraiven . Cynda was abducted in Almraiven by two Firesoul genasi and teleported to Calimport where she was forced to fight in the arena . Shan travelled with Corvus and Cephas to Calimport where Cephas was reunited with his father the Pasha but Shan was sent to the gladiator stables . The Pasha scheduled a fight between Shan and Cynda and made it the main event . Immediately prior to the twin ' s fight , Cephas tampered with the magic that levitate d the Pasha ' s palace and caused it to collide with the arena . In the confusion that followed , Shan and Cynda and friends were able to escape Calimport . Equipment . Shan wears leather armor and uses a short sword .

title: Shan Karsha
description: Shan Karsha Shan Karsha was the dominant peak of the Teyla Shan mountain range . Geography . Shan Karsha stood on the eastern rim of the range near the midpoint of its north to south expanse approximately 150 miles ( 240 km ) southwest of Nanhu Oasis .
description_long: Shan Karsha Shan Karsha was the dominant peak of the Teyla Shan mountain range . Geography . Shan Karsha stood on the eastern rim of the range near the midpoint of its north to south expanse approximately 150 miles ( 240 km ) southwest of Nanhu Oasis . Description . This peak rose to an elevation of 14 , 331 feet ( 4370 m ) .

title: Shan Khantayan
description: Shan Khantayan Shan Khantayan was a chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Personality . Shan was not a very able leader but luckily had good counsel from Ayana No - Shui , a fact that all his people knew and accepted .
description_long: Shan Khantayan Shan Khantayan was a chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Personality . Shan was not a very able leader but luckily had good counsel from Ayana No - Shui , a fact that all his people knew and accepted . He was a very vain individual , especially susceptible to jewellery and flattery . Through these , he could be easily manipulated .

title: Shan Nala
description: Shan Nala Shan Nala was the highest peak of the Raurin Alta mountains of the Raurin desert . Geography . Shan Nala stood on the far eastern end of the mountain range near Howling Gap and Solon .
description_long: Shan Nala Shan Nala was the highest peak of the Raurin Alta mountains of the Raurin desert . Geography . Shan Nala stood on the far eastern end of the mountain range near Howling Gap and Solon . It overlooked the peaks of Leopard Shan and Jorhat Shan on the plains below . Description . At an elevation of 13 , 951 ft . ( 4 , 250 m ) , Shan Nala towered above the other peaks of the Raurin Alta .

title: Shan Nikkoleth
description: Shan Nikkoleth Shan Nikkoleth was a death knight commander of the varied armies of undead , cambion s , and demon s in Hellgate Keep . Activities . For his lord Grintharke , this powerful death knight led and directed many patrols .
description_long: Shan Nikkoleth Shan Nikkoleth was a death knight commander of the varied armies of undead , cambion s , and demon s in Hellgate Keep . Activities . For his lord Grintharke , this powerful death knight led and directed many patrols . Many of these patrols scoured the wilderness for treasure for their master and the Keep . Due to this , Hellgate Keep became a house for the treasures of many lost realms . Much like his master , Shan was reputed to have an other worldly origin .

title: Shan Pi
description: Shan Pi Shan Pi was a large peak of Katakoro Shan found in Ra - Khati . Geography . Shan Pi was found in the southeast corner of Ra - Khati .
description_long: Shan Pi Shan Pi was a large peak of Katakoro Shan found in Ra - Khati . Geography . Shan Pi was found in the southeast corner of Ra - Khati . It stood on the perimeter of Katakoro Shan southwest of the Katakoro Glacier . Description . At just shy of 18 , 000 feet ( 5 , 500 meters ) , Shan Pi had an impressive view of the Old Caravan Road as it passed by the Growing Mountains and the Katakoro Plateau .

title: Shan Skar
description: Shan Skar Shan Skar was a prominent peak of Katakoro Shan found in Khazari . Geography . The peak sat high in the northwestern corner of the country near Manass .
description_long: Shan Skar Shan Skar was a prominent peak of Katakoro Shan found in Khazari . Geography . The peak sat high in the northwestern corner of the country near Manass . Description . Given the narrow breadth of Katakoro Shan in that region , Shan Skar ' s altitude of 15 , 000 feet ( 4 , 600 m ) gave it an impressive view of Khazari as well as the Quoya Desert .

title: Shan Thar
description: Shan Thar Shan Thar was a male Tethyrian human cleric of Cyric . In 1374 DR , he purported to be a cleric of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr . History .
description_long: Shan Thar Shan Thar was a male Tethyrian human cleric of Cyric . In 1374 DR , he purported to be a cleric of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Shan Thar got involved in a plot by Esvele Graycastle of the church of Shar to establish a false temple of Mystra in Wheloon and ultimately tear apart the Weave . At the temple , he worked for the so - called Lady of Mysteries Naedaenya Arthas and Starweaver Deinyn Fembrys , both secret clerics of the goddess of shadows . Shan soon became the public face of the temple , recruiting travelers who had some aptitude to participate in the so - called Mystra ' s Sacred Trust rite . In truth , this was a scam to " dominate " and abduct them to fuel the destruction . Eventually , on Eleint 6 , some adventurers recruited to investigate the strange behavior of the supposed Mystran clerics uncovered the ruse , exposing the false temple and foiling the schemes there . Activities . Shan served as the public face of the false temple , greeting visitors and asking how he could help . He would provide healing and clerical services at standard rates .

title: Shan Trango
description: Shan Trango Shan Trango , or the Mountain Guardian , was the highest peak of the various mountain ranges on the eastern rim of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . Shan Trango was found on the far eastern ridge of an unnamed cluster of mountains southeast of the Hollow Crown Mountains .
description_long: Shan Trango Shan Trango , or the Mountain Guardian , was the highest peak of the various mountain ranges on the eastern rim of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . Shan Trango was found on the far eastern ridge of an unnamed cluster of mountains southeast of the Hollow Crown Mountains . Description . Shan Trango rose to an impressive 21 , 200 ft . ( 6460 m ) , overlooking both the Hordelands and much of Kara - Tur as far as the eye could see .

title: Shanalar
description: Shanalar Shanalar was an human female inhabitant of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR who was secretly opposed to the Zhentarim . Personality . Shanalar had a fierce temper .
description_long: Shanalar Shanalar was an human female inhabitant of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR who was secretly opposed to the Zhentarim . Personality . Shanalar had a fierce temper . Activities . In addition to researching new spell s , Shanalar enjoyed riding griffon s with a degree of skill .

title: Shanatar
description: Shanatar Shanatar or Deep Shanatar was the underground realm of the shield dwarves .
