Sheenra born in Athkatla in Amn and lived a happy childhood until her family was caught in a business intrigue ; a rival of her father ended killing her patents and taking Sheenra as slave . Luckily she managed to escape and in revenge thieved the man ' s shop and burned his home . Sheenra later left Amn with no objective in mind but during the travel was intrigued by a traveling minstrel and followed him . Thank to this man , an Harper agent , Sheenra arrived at the Twilight Hall in Berdusk where she blossomed in a able Harper thief and musician . She however always asked for the most difficult missions until Cylyria Dragonbreast assigned a easy one to Sheenra : she had to infiltrate a caravan with two fellow Harpers in order to deliver a message . Instead in the caravan Sheenra seduced a merchant and thieved from him a document . It ' s found out that the man was a Zhentarim and Sheenra had thieved a list of Zhent agents .

title: Sheffol
description: Sheffol Sheffol was the Silhouette of Fences , Smugglers , and Pirates of the Sea ' s Sect of the Shadow Thieves in Murann around 1370 DR . Personality . Sheffol was a happy man who did what he loved .
description_long: Sheffol Sheffol was the Silhouette of Fences , Smugglers , and Pirates of the Sea ' s Sect of the Shadow Thieves in Murann around 1370 DR . Personality . Sheffol was a happy man who did what he loved . Every few years , Sheffol gave away or spent much of his wealth , just to have the chance to accumulate it again , making him very popular among the poor and various temples . Activities . Sheffol ' s primary method of operation was using his vast network of favors , which he acquired by using his money to assist people in trouble . In time , he ' d put together a large and varied network of people in debt to him . Sheffol used these collected favors to transport or store stolen items or contraband goods . He liked using nobles and other popular figures to transport his contraband goods , as their reputations were on the line . Usually , he protected his own identity by using intermediaries to collect on these favors . On the other hand , Sheffol had normal dealings with pirates , fences , and smugglers .

title: Sheh ' stek
description: Sheh ' stek Sheh ' stek was a lizardfolk from the Vast Swamp in Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sheh ' stek was one of the lizardfolk that came through a " portal " in the Vast Swamp and arrived in in Undermountain .
description_long: Sheh ' stek Sheh ' stek was a lizardfolk from the Vast Swamp in Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sheh ' stek was one of the lizardfolk that came through a " portal " in the Vast Swamp and arrived in in Undermountain . He was sent to explore a portion of the dungeon and was captured by the vampire Dayan . Sheh ' stek was left in his cell to die .

title: Sheila Kree
description: Sheila Kree Sheila Kree was a pirate and captain of the ship " Bloody Keel " . Her partners included Jule Pepper , Le ' lorinel , Bellany , and many others . She resided in the Golden Cove with her ogre allies .
description_long: Sheila Kree Sheila Kree was a pirate and captain of the ship " Bloody Keel " . Her partners included Jule Pepper , Le ' lorinel , Bellany , and many others . She resided in the Golden Cove with her ogre allies . She befriended Chogurugga and Bloog , the two head ogres living in the cove .

title: Shelavassa
description: Shelavassa Shelavassa was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Personality . Shelavassa was a very pragmatic individual , willing to give up whatever she needed to in order to avoid bigger troubles .
description_long: Shelavassa Shelavassa was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Personality . Shelavassa was a very pragmatic individual , willing to give up whatever she needed to in order to avoid bigger troubles . Relationships . Shelavassa led a cell of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Moonsea , with Karsev as her right - hand . History . Around 1491 DR , she discovered an elemental node at the ruined Fort Dalton and planned to create a " devastation orb " to unleash over Mulmaster . In order to complete the ritual , she ordered her minions to capture the aquatic elf prince Ulatha Mesavir in order to use him as a sacrifice . However , Shelavassa was confronted and defeated by an adventuring party hired to destroy the cultist group for their bandit activities near River Lis .

title: Shell
description: Shell Shell in the " Forgotten Realms " is short for seashell but includes fresh water varieties and certain amphibian carapaces as well . Seashells are valued for their ability to be carved into cameos and jewelry . Shells are rarely used for currency because prices vary wildly with scarcity , fashion , and geographic location .
description_long: Shell Shell in the " Forgotten Realms " is short for seashell but includes fresh water varieties and certain amphibian carapaces as well . Seashells are valued for their ability to be carved into cameos and jewelry . Shells are rarely used for currency because prices vary wildly with scarcity , fashion , and geographic location . Fine specimens can demand a high price from collectors and craftsmen but flawed pieces are generally worthless . Unless otherwise noted , the price given below for each type is the base value for a large , unblemished specimen that is usable for cameo work . Collectors may pay more for unusual specimens ; any flaws quickly reduce the price . Here are some shells found in the Realms :

title: Shell Game
description: Shell Game " Shell Game " is the 14th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .
description_long: Shell Game " Shell Game " is the 14th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin . It is the second part of " Spell Games " , which related Vajra Valmeyjar ' s past and relationship to Conner and revealed the mystery of the cat child . Appendix . Reprints . This issue was reprinted in the Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 2 trade paperback by in October 2011 .

title: Sherincal
description: Sherincal Sherincal was a half - dragon ( blue dragon ) who hated her human side and was a powerful member of the Legion of the Chimera . History . In 1310 DR , Sherincal battled the heroes of Icewind Dale at the ice palace in the western pass where she was killed .
description_long: Sherincal Sherincal was a half - dragon ( blue dragon ) who hated her human side and was a powerful member of the Legion of the Chimera . History . In 1310 DR , Sherincal battled the heroes of Icewind Dale at the ice palace in the western pass where she was killed . Her remains were later recovered by the Church of Xvim , and transformed into an undead by the reigning Tyrannar in an attempt to destroy the heroes . The attempt fails , and the Tyrannar finds himself dead in short order .

title: Sherlen Miller
description: Sherlen Miller Sherlen Miller was the commander of the militia and the constable in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Her dual role meant Sherlen had to use two different aspects of her personality : as a militia commander , she trained her fellow warriors ; as constable , she had to mediate disputes and take care of the duke ' s interests .
description_long: Sherlen Miller Sherlen Miller was the commander of the militia and the constable in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Her dual role meant Sherlen had to use two different aspects of her personality : as a militia commander , she trained her fellow warriors ; as constable , she had to mediate disputes and take care of the duke ' s interests . Personality . Sherlen considered it a great honor serving in the same role as her great ancestor Sherlen Spearslayer . She preferred her role as commander , feeling she did not suit the diplomatic role she had as constable .

title: Sherlen Spearslayer
description: Sherlen Spearslayer Sherlen Spearslayer was the leader of Daggerford ' s militia around 1370 DR . History . Sherlen was an adventurer who settled down in Daggerford with her husband .
description_long: Sherlen Spearslayer Sherlen Spearslayer was the leader of Daggerford ' s militia around 1370 DR . History . Sherlen was an adventurer who settled down in Daggerford with her husband . When she was pregnant , her husband went to adventure and never returned . After her child grew , Sherlen joined the local militia , rising through the ranks until she became the commander . She delighted in the good works of the militia and was full of wise advice .

title: Shestandeliath Geshthax
description: Shestandeliath Geshthax Shestandeliath Geshthax was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Shestandeliath in 1486 DR . He was a direct descendant of Haizverad . Description .
description_long: Shestandeliath Geshthax Shestandeliath Geshthax was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Shestandeliath in 1486 DR . He was a direct descendant of Haizverad . Description . Geshthax had graying , rusty scales and long tasseled plumes . He had lost his right arm . History . When he was young , he was kidnapped by followers of Tiamat who wanted to ransom him in exchange of the Breath of Petron . When Clan Shestandeliath refused to give in the artifact , the cultists severed his right arm as a punishment . He was later rescued by a detachment of Lance Defenders . In 1486 DR , Geshthax sought out Verthisathurgiesh Anala and Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia in order to investigate a series of murders in the Catacombs of Djerad Thymar . On Hammer 9 of 1487 DR , Geshthax sacrificed himself in order to active the Breath of Petron so he could raise an earth barrier to surround Djerad Thymar and protect the city against Gilgeam ' s forces . Although Geshthax didn ' t died by using the artifact , he was left impaired and his daughter , Shestandeliath Narhanna , succeeded him as the new matriarch of Clan Shestandeliath .

title: Sheva Whitefeather
description: Sheva Whitefeather Sheva Whitefeather was the ranking witch of Mulsantir . She was one of the few " othlors " of that organization . Sheva gave an adventurer the chance to fight for their life against Okku instead of simply allowing them to be sacrificed to save the city , allowing them to recruit followers from the Mulsantir jail .
description_long: Sheva Whitefeather Sheva Whitefeather was the ranking witch of Mulsantir . She was one of the few " othlors " of that organization . Sheva gave an adventurer the chance to fight for their life against Okku instead of simply allowing them to be sacrificed to save the city , allowing them to recruit followers from the Mulsantir jail .

title: Shevarash
description: Shevarash Shevarash is the elven deity of revenge , loss and hatred of the Drow . He never displays any emotion aside from anger and the occasional exultation after the death of an enemy . The Black Archer is disdainful of moderation in the pursuit of revenge , and will often strike preemptively against his foes .
description_long: Shevarash Shevarash is the elven deity of revenge , loss and hatred of the Drow . He never displays any emotion aside from anger and the occasional exultation after the death of an enemy . The Black Archer is disdainful of moderation in the pursuit of revenge , and will often strike preemptively against his foes . Possessions . Shevarash ' s weapons were the Black Bow , the sword Traitorbane , the spear Shama , the sling Ukava and the club Maelat . Worshipers . The church of Shevarash is tiny , but rigidly disciplined . Cleric s spend their days drilling , designing tactics , mapping out the Upper Underdark , and leading hit - and - run raids and assaults on drow territories . Clerics of the Black Archer pray for their spells at dusk , just as the drow sneak into the surface world . The holiest day of the year for the church is Midwinter Night , during which the Dark Court Slaughter is remembered . Inductions into the ranks of the clergy occur at this time . Each new cleric screams vows of vengeance into the night air and swears neither to laugh nor smile until the Spider Queen and her followers are no more . Relationships .

title: Shevaril Starcloak
description: Shevaril Starcloak Shevaril Starcloak was a female half - elf abjurer from Dagger Falls . She served as an advisor to Randal Morn on wizard ing matters . Abilities .
description_long: Shevaril Starcloak Shevaril Starcloak was a female half - elf abjurer from Dagger Falls . She served as an advisor to Randal Morn on wizard ing matters . Abilities . As an experienced abjurer , Shevaril was well - versed in a number of protective spell s that could be put to use . Activities . Shevaril Starcloak worked as an advisor to the lord of Daggerdale , Randal Morn , offering advice on matters relating to magic . History . In 1372 DR , Shevaril was in the employ of Randal Morn as his advisor . She advised him on wizard matters during the drow raids in Marpenoth of that year .

title: Shex
description: Shex Shex is an angel of decay , an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Shex is as tall as an ogre and has wings and claws .
description_long: Shex Shex is an angel of decay , an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Shex is as tall as an ogre and has wings and claws . Her body constantly decomposes , slime oozing down her frame to pool at her feet . She speaks with a slurred , muddy voice . History . Together with the Nighthaunt Ysval , Shex was a field commander for an army of undead trying to conquer Thay in 1375 DR . She was slain by the ghost Mirror at the fight of Thazar Keep . Whether she was ultimately destroyed or just sent back to her home plane is not known .

title: Shey Chorten
description: Shey Chorten Shey Chorten was the name given to a section of the Katakoro Plateau where a large collection of burial mounds could be found . Geography . Shey Chorten was located due west of the Glacier of the Lost King .
description_long: Shey Chorten Shey Chorten was the name given to a section of the Katakoro Plateau where a large collection of burial mounds could be found . Geography . Shey Chorten was located due west of the Glacier of the Lost King . The Old Caravan Road passed by to the south . Description . The presence of so many burial mounds created a hilly section on the relatively flat Katakoro Plateau .

title: Shhuusshuru
description: Shhuusshuru Shhuusshuru , also known as Shadow Wing , was sired sometime before the founding of Cormyr in 26 DR by the shadow dragon Shadraxil . She gave birth to now - leader of the Cult of the Dragon , Aurgloroasa , before expelling her daughter from her realm after two centuries . She preceded the Sibilant Shade ' s ascension to dracolichdom with the help of a nascent cult cell in Berdusk .
description_long: Shhuusshuru Shhuusshuru , also known as Shadow Wing , was sired sometime before the founding of Cormyr in 26 DR by the shadow dragon Shadraxil . She gave birth to now - leader of the Cult of the Dragon , Aurgloroasa , before expelling her daughter from her realm after two centuries . She preceded the Sibilant Shade ' s ascension to dracolichdom with the help of a nascent cult cell in Berdusk . Originally , this was just to gain more power in the Western Heartlands but eventually she took over leadership of the cell . She still holds a loose alliance with her daughter ' s cell in Sembia It was at her insistence that the Berduskan cell ' s second attempt at creating a Sacred One was to involve the red dragon Greshrukk " Red Eye " . This plan involved luring a party of adventurers , who had aquired his stolen phylactery ( in the form of a sword pommel ) , to his cave who they would then ambush , steal the sword and perform a ritual that would quickly transfer his essence to his corpse . From her lair in the tallest of the Far Hills she plots to take over Darkhold and from there , conquer the entire Chionthar river valley .

title: Shi ' drin Philiom
description: Shi ' drin Philiom Shi ' drin Philiom was a fanatic priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . Activities . Shi ' drin was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir and the second - in - command of Molvayas ' s group .
description_long: Shi ' drin Philiom Shi ' drin Philiom was a fanatic priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . Activities . Shi ' drin was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir and the second - in - command of Molvayas ' s group . History . In 1379 DR , he questioned Kâras about Molvayas ' s disappearance but Kâras said he was killed by a priest of House Abbylan . Shi ' drin didn ' t question any further , happy to become the new Eater of Filth of the House .

title: Shi Lin
description: Shi Lin Shi Lin was a wu jen in the town of H ' sin - to in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , she became one of the three wu jen bought under the control of Dragon Claw .
description_long: Shi Lin Shi Lin was a wu jen in the town of H ' sin - to in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , she became one of the three wu jen bought under the control of Dragon Claw . She was a leader of Dragon Claw followers in the city and led her minions to fight the wu jen Ko La Ko and an adventuring party hired by Ko Ho San at the tomb of Poh Nih . The adventurers however killed all her minions and so Shi Lin buried the adventurers inside the tomb with her magic . Personality . Shi Lin was made highly unstable and vicious by the use of cursed Dragon Claw swords and their inherent conflict with her use of magic .

title: Shi Lo
description: Shi Lo Shi Lo was a samurai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Born as the daughter of a noble of the Imperial Court , she studied calligraphy and poetry .
description_long: Shi Lo Shi Lo was a samurai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Born as the daughter of a noble of the Imperial Court , she studied calligraphy and poetry . She first trained in martial arts under Master Lin Kwan Shu of the Five Stars school . She showed such a great ability to focus her ki that she earned the interest of Master Liu of the Southern Star . Master Liu decided to recruited her and Shi Lo accepted . Shi Lo proved herself very suitable to the Southern Star style and soon she gained great renown , with many martial artists going to watch her training . Rumors said that Shi Lo performed for the Emperor on several occasions . In 1358 DR , Shi Lo went to participate at the Komite . She managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists .

title: Shialaevar
description: Shialaevar Shialaevar is an elven wizard who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is a high mage of the city and frequently visited Queen Amlaruil Moonflower at Moonstone Palace . She lives in a home made from magically grown trees decorated by coloured flags which she changes on a daily basis .
description_long: Shialaevar Shialaevar is an elven wizard who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is a high mage of the city and frequently visited Queen Amlaruil Moonflower at Moonstone Palace . She lives in a home made from magically grown trees decorated by coloured flags which she changes on a daily basis . She is the only one who understands the significance of the flags . Appearance . Shialaevar is tall and very thin . She has deep - set eyes .

title: Shiallia
description: Shiallia Shiallia ( pronounced " shee - AL - yuh " or " shee - AL - lee - ah " ) is a good exarch of Mielikki . She usually appears as a voluptuously beautiful female korred whose long blond hair is festooned with garlands of oak leaves and golden acorns . She is the patron and protector of pregnant forest creatures , a planter of trees and nurturer of seedlings .
description_long: Shiallia Shiallia ( pronounced " shee - AL - yuh " or " shee - AL - lee - ah " ) is a good exarch of Mielikki . She usually appears as a voluptuously beautiful female korred whose long blond hair is festooned with garlands of oak leaves and golden acorns . She is the patron and protector of pregnant forest creatures , a planter of trees and nurturer of seedlings . She rejoices in life and shields against death . She is said to be earthy and winsome , and when not taking care of their needs delights in frolicking in the woods and playing with the woodland creatures who are her charges . At times she seems giddy and carefree , but has deeper qualities and a more mysterious quality which differentiates her from the fey forest creatures such as satyrs . While she is fiercely protective of those she protects , she is unlikely to interfere with matters outside of her portfolio if they do not directly involve her . Relationships . Shiallia is said to be the sister ( or sometimes daughter ) of the Tree Ghost and the daughter of Tapann the undying , and sometimes the daughter of Mielikki , who she serves with both Lurue and Gwaeron Windstrom , and thus ultimately Silvanus .

title: Shiau Chen
description: Shiau Chen Shaiu Chen was the proprietor of the Lily Pad Inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember . Chen ran the inn with the help of his Cormyr ean wife Cornelia and his children . He was once a member of the xenophobic society known as The Chuen but was kicked out when he took a non - Shou wife .
description_long: Shiau Chen Shaiu Chen was the proprietor of the Lily Pad Inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember . Chen ran the inn with the help of his Cormyr ean wife Cornelia and his children . He was once a member of the xenophobic society known as The Chuen but was kicked out when he took a non - Shou wife .

title: Shield
description: Shield Shields were a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Shield were usually made from wood or metal and were used by combatants to gain extra protection .
description_long: Shield Shields were a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Shield were usually made from wood or metal and were used by combatants to gain extra protection . Shields were carried in one hand . Shields were usually strapped to the arm that carried them . Smaller shields could be used without compromising the use of both hands . Shields could be used in attacks to bash or push opponents . Some shields had spikes attached to them so that they could be more devastating when used as a weapon .

title: Shield ( merchant )
description: Shield ( merchant ) Shield was a merchant from the city of Everlund in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . Shield partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , and Pomphur of Almraiven — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .
description_long: Shield ( merchant ) Shield was a merchant from the city of Everlund in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . Shield partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , and Pomphur of Almraiven — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves . Shield ' s own small merchant company was converted into a regional base for the coster . Shield and the Seven Suns were in business by 1358 DR , and still going by 1374 DR .

title: Shield ( spell )
description: Shield ( spell ) Shield was a relatively simple abjuration spell used by wizard s or , in the past , sorcerer s . When cast , " shield " manifested a wall of magical force around the caster , deflecting away damage and enhancing their reflexes significantly . " Shield " was not a very complex spell , but it required enough power on the part of its caster that it could not be recast until he or she had taken a short rest of a few minutes or more .
description_long: Shield ( spell ) Shield was a relatively simple abjuration spell used by wizard s or , in the past , sorcerer s . When cast , " shield " manifested a wall of magical force around the caster , deflecting away damage and enhancing their reflexes significantly . " Shield " was not a very complex spell , but it required enough power on the part of its caster that it could not be recast until he or she had taken a short rest of a few minutes or more . Before the Spellplague , " shield " was also used by sorcerer s and , like other spells , could only be used a number of times per day equal to the number of times a wizard had prepared for it or a sorcerer had the energy left to cast .

title: Shield Belt of Storms
description: Shield Belt of Storms The Shield Belt of Storms was a magical golden chain mail belt , made from beljurel s , gold , platinum , and steel . It augmented physical armour with magical defences , and added lighting to a weapon wielded by the wearer . Appearance .
description_long: Shield Belt of Storms The Shield Belt of Storms was a magical golden chain mail belt , made from beljurel s , gold , platinum , and steel . It augmented physical armour with magical defences , and added lighting to a weapon wielded by the wearer . Appearance . The belt was covered in ornate golden scales with shapes like oak leaves , shields and swords , and was adnorned with sixteen gem s . In profile , the belt appeared to be the head of an ice eagle , with a large sea - green gem as its eye . History . The gems are older than the belt itself , having been enchanted before the belt ' s creation . Ryttal Ghalmrin created the metal parts of the belt , and Theod Darkwhisper allowed it to enchant weapons . The belt was originally made for elves , but fell into the hands of the drow for a time . It was possessed by at least seven warriors . The belt was worn by the half - elf warrior Dakath of Nesmé , who died whilst he was wearing it . The belt was then taken to Blackstaff Tower and given to Zelphar Arunsun , who changed the buckle and repaired its scales .

title: Shield Trading Company
description: Shield Trading Company The Shield Trading Company was a merchant house , headquartered in Voonlar , that did business throughout the Dalelands and Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . It was owned by Zaravron Rarthree , an elderly and somewhat reclusive cloth dealer , and was in business some years before the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , through at least the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities .
description_long: Shield Trading Company The Shield Trading Company was a merchant house , headquartered in Voonlar , that did business throughout the Dalelands and Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . It was owned by Zaravron Rarthree , an elderly and somewhat reclusive cloth dealer , and was in business some years before the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , through at least the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities . The Shield Trading Company ran caravans between various cities in the Dalelands and the Moonsea , most of which either began or ended in Voonlar . The company was known to hire adventurers as caravan guards as long as they were not known to have ties with the Zhentarim . The company also owned and operated the Sign of the Shield , the largest and most luxurious inn in Voonlar . Base of Operations . The company headquarters were located on the north side of Shind Road , northeast of the intersection with Daerndrean Street , in Voonlar . It was directly across the street from the Sign of the Shield . Relationships . The Shield Trading Company was independently owned and not under the influence of investors in league with or belonging to the Zhentarim .

title: Shield adept
description: Shield adept Shield adepts were fighter s trained in the expert use of shield s . Culture . Throughout history , the shield was a staple of armies and soldiers around the world .
description_long: Shield adept Shield adepts were fighter s trained in the expert use of shield s . Culture . Throughout history , the shield was a staple of armies and soldiers around the world . formations were the pinnacle of shield use , representing an unbroken wall of shielded soldiers , each protecting their comrade or using their shield to push back foes . Similarly , dwarves developed the " " , which placed the shields of a unit in an overarching arrangement that formed a seemingly impenetrable wall . It was from these traditions that shield adepts drew their inspiration , as well as personal experience in regards to a shield ' s effectiveness . To many fighters , particularly guardian fighters , the shield was a symbol of honor and identity as well as the warrior ' s best friend and a lifesaver . To these fighters , only a comrade in arms was more useful and even then , that ally ' s life might well depend on the fighter ' s swiftly placed shield . Abilities . Shield adepts relied on their shield to protect their allies and fulfill their duties . They also used it as a weapon with which to deal blows , surprising foes who tended to focus solely on the fighter ' s sword or hammer .

title: Shield dwarf
description: Shield dwarf Shield dwarves , also known as mountain dwarves , are among the most common of the dwarven peoples . Once the rulers of mighty kingdoms across Faerûn , the shield dwarves have since fallen by the wayside after centuries of warfare with their goblinoid enemies . Since then , shield dwarves have been less commonly seen throughout Faerûn , though during the Era of Upheaval the subrace , spurred on by the Thunder Blessing , began to retake an important role in local politics .
description_long: Shield dwarf Shield dwarves , also known as mountain dwarves , are among the most common of the dwarven peoples . Once the rulers of mighty kingdoms across Faerûn , the shield dwarves have since fallen by the wayside after centuries of warfare with their goblinoid enemies . Since then , shield dwarves have been less commonly seen throughout Faerûn , though during the Era of Upheaval the subrace , spurred on by the Thunder Blessing , began to retake an important role in local politics . Physical characteristics . The shield dwarves are on average half a foot taller than other dwarves . They are the most common dwarf in the north of Faerûn . They have light skin that is fair or lightly tanned and green or silvery blue eyes with long light brown or red hair , growing white or gray with age . Most males and even some females have large beards and mustaches . The females are slightly shorter and less heavy than the males . Psychology . Shield dwarves are a cynical and gruff people , but they are , despite a reputation to the contrary , fatalistic , still possessing some hope for the future .

title: Shield guardian
description: Shield guardian A shield guardian was a powerful construct created to defend arcane spellcasters . Description . Shield guardians could be made with various sizes and strengths , but the simplest and cheapest to make stood about nine feet ( nearly three meters ) tall and weighed over 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) .
description_long: Shield guardian A shield guardian was a powerful construct created to defend arcane spellcasters . Description . Shield guardians could be made with various sizes and strengths , but the simplest and cheapest to make stood about nine feet ( nearly three meters ) tall and weighed over 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) . They looked something like a large stick figure made of wood with rocky appendages and metal parts . Behavior . Each shield guardian was keyed to a special magical amulet . If the amulet were destroyed , the guardian would cease to function until keyed to a replacement amulet . Whoever wore the amulet could control the shield guardian , and if the last wearer died , the guardian would obey its final orders to the best of its ability . A shield guardian could not speak , but it could magically understand the commands of anyone controlling it through the amulet , no matter the speaker ' s language . Moreover , the wearer of the amulet could summon the shield guardian magically from anywhere within the same plane . Though the guardian might have some difficulty making the journey , it would always know the location of its amulet .

title: Shield of Innocence
description: Shield of Innocence Shield of Innocence was an orog who was also a paladin of Torm , which is an unlikely combination . He had faith placed in him by Queen Zaranda Star of Tethyr . On Mirtul 3 , 1367 DR , he saved the lives of Zaranda and Vander Stillhawk , the latter of whom he also resurrected , when he sacrificed his own life to destroy a lower - planar fiend while the group was putting the Days of Terror to an end .
description_long: Shield of Innocence Shield of Innocence was an orog who was also a paladin of Torm , which is an unlikely combination . He had faith placed in him by Queen Zaranda Star of Tethyr . On Mirtul 3 , 1367 DR , he saved the lives of Zaranda and Vander Stillhawk , the latter of whom he also resurrected , when he sacrificed his own life to destroy a lower - planar fiend while the group was putting the Days of Terror to an end . Queen Zaranda petitioned the Loyal Order of Innocents to consider the Shield of Innocence as their new patron saint after his death .

title: Shield of Myth Drannor
description: Shield of Myth Drannor The Shield of Myth Drannor was a company from Myth Drannor appointed to the watchpost at Helmgrove in order to serve as an early threat to the invading demonic horde in the Fall of Myth Drannor . History . The entire company was destroyed by the horde .
description_long: Shield of Myth Drannor The Shield of Myth Drannor was a company from Myth Drannor appointed to the watchpost at Helmgrove in order to serve as an early threat to the invading demonic horde in the Fall of Myth Drannor . History . The entire company was destroyed by the horde .

title: Shield of faith
description: Shield of faith Shield of faith was a divine abjuration spell that granted greater ability to deflect blows . Effects . Around a touched creature appeared a shimmering , magical field that caused physical attacks to be averted .
description_long: Shield of faith Shield of faith was a divine abjuration spell that granted greater ability to deflect blows . Effects . Around a touched creature appeared a shimmering , magical field that caused physical attacks to be averted . The strength of this field increased with the power level of the caster . Components . As well as verbal and somatic components , casting this spell required a small piece of parchment bearing a fragment of a holy text .

title: Shield of law
description: Shield of law Shield of law is an abjuration spell that grants protection against chaotic opponents . It is the lawful counterpart to the chaotic spell " cloak of chaos " . Effects .
description_long: Shield of law Shield of law is an abjuration spell that grants protection against chaotic opponents . It is the lawful counterpart to the chaotic spell " cloak of chaos " . Effects . A dim , blue glow surrounds the subjects , protecting them from attacks , granting them resistance to spells cast by chaotic creatures , and " slow ing " chaotic creatures when they strike the subjects . This abjuration has four effects : First , the warded creatures gain a + 4 deflection bonus to AC and a + 4 resistance bonus to saves . Unlike " protection from chaos " , this benefit applies against all attacks , not just against attacks by chaotic creatures . Second , the warded creatures gain SR 25 against and spells cast by chaotic creatures . Third , the abjuration blocks possession and mental influence , just as " protection from chaos " does . Finally , if a chaotic creature succeeds at a melee attack against a warded creature , the attacker is " slowed " ( Will save negates , as the " slow " spell , but against " shield of law ' s " save DC ) . Focus . A tiny reliquary containing some sacred relic , such as a scrap of parchment from a lawful text . The reliquary costs at least 500 gp .

title: Shield of senses
description: Shield of senses A shield of senses was a magical shield that protected the bearer from fire and from blindness and deafness . Description . This item was a " + 1 animated fire resistance large steel shield " .
description_long: Shield of senses A shield of senses was a magical shield that protected the bearer from fire and from blindness and deafness . Description . This item was a " + 1 animated fire resistance large steel shield " . It was painted with some form of coat of arms or holy symbol befitting a cleric . Powers . When the wielder was exposed to a magical or non - magical attack that caused blindness , deafness , or both , this item reacted by bestowing " remove blindness or deafness " on the wielder . The " shield of senses " could do this up to two times per day . History . This item was the subject of rumors surrounding Ilmurk Jongrath , a miller and entrepreneur who owned Jongrath ' s Mill in southwestern Tethyr . Ilmurk did heraldic design , painting , and touch - up work for armigerous folk as a side business . It was said that a cleric had Ilmurk paint this shield and then was killed in battle before she was able to retrieve it . Jongrath , being an honest businessman , was believed to have hidden it somewhere on his land , waiting for her to return .

title: Shield of the City
description: Shield of the City The Shield of the City was a medal awarded to members of the city watch for outstanding acts of military service . Occasionally a noble who participated in a battle would receive the award . Description .
description_long: Shield of the City The Shield of the City was a medal awarded to members of the city watch for outstanding acts of military service . Occasionally a noble who participated in a battle would receive the award . Description . The award was a large , gold , shield - shaped badge worn on the chest .

title: Shield of the Lady
description: Shield of the Lady The Shield of the Lady was a militant order of woman wizard s , cleric s , and priestesses devoted to Isis around 1370 DR . Their duty was to protect Mulhorand i heroes from evil and barbarism . These spellcasters joined and assisted adventuring companies operating within Mulhorand and the Old Empires and beyond , on missions that furthered the aims of the goddess .
description_long: Shield of the Lady The Shield of the Lady was a militant order of woman wizard s , cleric s , and priestesses devoted to Isis around 1370 DR . Their duty was to protect Mulhorand i heroes from evil and barbarism . These spellcasters joined and assisted adventuring companies operating within Mulhorand and the Old Empires and beyond , on missions that furthered the aims of the goddess .

title: Shield of the holy
description: Shield of the holy Shields of the holy were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items looked like medium - sized shields bearing the image of one of the eight enlightened gods of Zakhara .
description_long: Shield of the holy Shields of the holy were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items looked like medium - sized shields bearing the image of one of the eight enlightened gods of Zakhara . Powers . If a priest or cleric of the god depicted on the shield ' s image used the shield , then the shield amplified their ability to turn or command undead . The shield also granted additional protection . The shield only granted additional protection if carried by anyone other than a cleric or priest of the god depicted on the shield ' s face .

title: Shield of vigilance
description: Shield of vigilance A shield of vigilance is a large magic steel shield with a symbol of Torm on it . These shields protect their wielders against bashing shock and are highly prized by followers of Torm . It can fetch around 9000 gold pieces .
description_long: Shield of vigilance A shield of vigilance is a large magic steel shield with a symbol of Torm on it . These shields protect their wielders against bashing shock and are highly prized by followers of Torm . It can fetch around 9000 gold pieces . It is rumoured that there is a much more powerful version of this shield that can reflect all electricity and electrical effects .

title: Shield of winds
description: Shield of winds Shield of winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible windy barrier by creating strands of chaotic gusts of wind , resulting in a nearly impenetrable wall .
description_long: Shield of winds Shield of winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible windy barrier by creating strands of chaotic gusts of wind , resulting in a nearly impenetrable wall . Only purely magical weapons such as " magic missle " " s " could pass through the wall . Enchanted objects like arrows were stopped in their tracks . Either " dispel magic " or " anti - magic shell " could destroy the wall . Components . This spell only required the presence of air to cast .

title: Shield other
description: Shield other Shield other is an abjuration spell that summons a protective barrier around another creature . Effect . This spell wards the subject and creates a mystic connection between you and the subject so that some of the subject ' s wounds are transferred to you .
description_long: Shield other Shield other is an abjuration spell that summons a protective barrier around another creature . Effect . This spell wards the subject and creates a mystic connection between you and the subject so that some of the subject ' s wounds are transferred to you . The subject gains a + 1 deflection bonus to AC and a + 1 resistance bonus to saves . Additionally , the subject takes only half damage from all wounds and attacks ( including those inflicted by special abilities ) that deal it hit point damage . The amount of damage not taken by the warded creature is taken by you . Forms of harm that do not involve hit points , such as charm effects , temporary ability damage , level draining , and disintegration , are not affected . If the subject suffers a reduction of hit points from a lowered Constitution score , the reduction is not split with you because it is not hit point damage . When the spell ends , subsequent damage is no longer divided between the subject and you , but damage already split is not reassigned to the subject . If you and the subject of the spell move out of range of each other , the spell ends . Focus .

title: Shieldbreakers
description: Shieldbreakers The Shieldbreakers were an ogre mercenary company based in the Lands of Intrigue . Organization . These ogres were known for being unbiased and honorable .
description_long: Shieldbreakers The Shieldbreakers were an ogre mercenary company based in the Lands of Intrigue . Organization . These ogres were known for being unbiased and honorable . Activities . The mercenaries always refused contacts involving the murder of unarmed foes . Base of Operations . The Shieldbreaker base , Shieldbreaker Citadel , was located south of the Deepwash in Erlkazar . In the High Peaks , the Shieldbreakers made their home in the village of Rivenshield . Possessions . Loyal to their name , the Shieldbreakers never used shield s in battle . The group preferred to wield two - handed weapons , like bardiche s . History . The Shieldbreakers were formed when a group of ogres refused to kill unarmed human s despite the orders of their chief . Around 1358 DR , the Shieldbreakers made an alliance with the barony of Ahlarkhem to protect Duhlnarim against King Ertyk Uhl and his Starrock goblin horde .

title: Shieldmeet
description: Shieldmeet Shieldmeet was the equivalent of a leap year day in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring once every four years , adding a day after the festival of Midsummer and before Eleasis 1 . Traditionally the day was used for fairs , bazaars , musical and theatrical performances , and tournaments of skill and magical ability . Nobles usually held court to hear the petitions of their people and to make or renew trade pacts , alliances , and agreements .
description_long: Shieldmeet Shieldmeet was the equivalent of a leap year day in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring once every four years , adding a day after the festival of Midsummer and before Eleasis 1 . Traditionally the day was used for fairs , bazaars , musical and theatrical performances , and tournaments of skill and magical ability . Nobles usually held court to hear the petitions of their people and to make or renew trade pacts , alliances , and agreements . Shieldmeet was known as Cinnaelos ' Cor ( also seen as Cinnaeloscor ) , " the Day of Corellon ' s Peace " in elvish and marked the end of an " aeloulaev " and the beginning of a new one in the elven Aryselmalyn calendar . Shieldmeet Years . There were Shieldmeets every four years . Since 1372 DR contained a Shieldmeet , this meant that 0 DR and every fourth year prior or afterward also contained a Shieldmeet . Variations . Across Faerûn the Shieldmeet celebrations varied greatly , from calm and reflective to extravagant and outrageous . Appendix . External Links . Forgotten Realms FAQ of the REALMS - L Mailing List

title: Shields of the Highland
description: Shields of the Highland The Shields of the Highland were a mildly famous adventuring company working in the Upper Highlands in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Organization . The Shields of the Highlands were a group of six friends hailing from near the Forest of Mir .
description_long: Shields of the Highland The Shields of the Highland were a mildly famous adventuring company working in the Upper Highlands in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Organization . The Shields of the Highlands were a group of six friends hailing from near the Forest of Mir . They were led by Roalgan , the largest of their number . Activities . The group sought fortune and fame fighting against monsters in the hills of the Golden Marches in Tethyr . Base of Operations . The Shields operated in the Upper Highlands and nearby areas and were known to the people of Survale Ford , Toralth , and Trailstone . Members . Five of the group ' s six members were : History . On Uktar 8 , 1370 DR , they lost two of their members — Timor ' s younger brother Dumax and one other companion — while guarding a caravan . Unexpected cold weather led to snow , and a band of fourteen gnoll s were able to track them and attack them , killing two of them during the ensuing battle . At dusk two days later , the four survivors went to the Blue Badger Inn in the village of Toralth to grieve their loss .

title: Shifter
description: Shifter Shifters , also sometimes called the weretouched , are a race of humanoid s descended from interbreeding between lycanthropes and human s . Fierce and wild - spirited , shifters are feared by many as much as their shapeshifting brethren . Physical Characteristics .
description_long: Shifter Shifters , also sometimes called the weretouched , are a race of humanoid s descended from interbreeding between lycanthropes and human s . Fierce and wild - spirited , shifters are feared by many as much as their shapeshifting brethren . Physical Characteristics . Shifters resemble humans , their close brethren , but with distinctively bestial features such as sharp teeth , claws , pointed ears , or fur . Compared to humans , shifters are somewhat short , the average height range being between 5 ' 7 " and 6 ' , though shifters are lithe and strong and , as a result , are slightly heavier for their size , weighing between 130 and 180 lbs most commonly . In many other ways , however , shifters look like humans . However , to a human ' s eye , the resemblance is less obvious than the differences .

title: Shig ' harakhi
description: Shig ' harakhi The shig ' harakhi , or the younger brothers , were promising flame mages who studied under Nar - Aidiya at the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar . These individuals were called " shig ' harak " . Activities .
description_long: Shig ' harakhi The shig ' harakhi , or the younger brothers , were promising flame mages who studied under Nar - Aidiya at the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar . These individuals were called " shig ' harak " . Activities . These young members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame were brought to the hidden fortress via magic . As part of their ultimate training , all " shig ' harak " were required to successfully research a new spell before their departure . When their studies were completed they were also transported away by magic after a " geas " had been placed upon them , preventing them from willingly revealing any secrets of the Brotherhood . All of the " shig ' harakhi " wore an aba of the elements .

title: Shigatse Glacier
description: Shigatse Glacier The Shigatse Glacier was a monstrous glacier that sat just south of Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The glacier measured 90 miles ( 145 km ) in length and was 30 miles ( 48 km ) at its widest point .
description_long: Shigatse Glacier The Shigatse Glacier was a monstrous glacier that sat just south of Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The glacier measured 90 miles ( 145 km ) in length and was 30 miles ( 48 km ) at its widest point . The Shigatse ' s yearly runoff fed the Muren Tso on the Katakoro Plateau to the east .

title: Shigeruchan
description: Shigeruchan Shigeruchan was a monk of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Shigeruchan was the spiritual leader of the village of Gugedo in Fochu Peninsula .
description_long: Shigeruchan Shigeruchan was a monk of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Shigeruchan was the spiritual leader of the village of Gugedo in Fochu Peninsula . He liked wandering the wilderness composing a lengthy poem to the Path of Enlightenment . History . In 1358 DR , Shigeruchan met Osari Minhiro and a foreign adventuring party . He insisted that the adventurers were possessed by demon s and need to cleanse them through his poem .

title: Shilarn
description: Shilarn Shilarn Silmaeril was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Baeron , she overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives .
description_long: Shilarn Shilarn Silmaeril was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Baeron , she overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives . Shilarn married Baeron , also a Lord of Waterdeep . They had a daughter , Lhestyn the Masked Lady , who later became an Open Lord of Waterdeep . Background . After the Council of Guildmasters seized power in Waterdeep in 1256 DR , most of the Lords of Waterdeep were eliminated because their identities , which were supposed to have remained secret , had been compromised . Only Shilarn and Baeron are known to have survived this purge . In 1273 DR , they both entered the court of the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh , who were in power in the city at the time , and demanded that they leave the city . When they refused , Shilarn struck them down and killed them using her magic . Baeron revealed his identity , restoring the original form of government and becoming the Open Lord . When Baeron died of fever in 1308 DR , Shilarn killed herself by jumping onto his funeral pyre .

title: Shilku
description: Shilku Shilku was a coastal town in Chult , located in a bay south of the Kobold Mountains . It was less than 50 miles ( 80 km ) from Wyrmheart Mine in the north and about 100 miles ( 160 km ) from the Valley of Lost Honor .
description_long: Shilku Shilku was a coastal town in Chult , located in a bay south of the Kobold Mountains . It was less than 50 miles ( 80 km ) from Wyrmheart Mine in the north and about 100 miles ( 160 km ) from the Valley of Lost Honor .

title: Shillelagh
description: Shillelagh The shillelagh ( shuh - ley - lee ) spell enhanced a wooden weapon , such as a club or a staff to do more harm in combat . Effects . The weapon to be enchanted had to be non - magical , made of oak , and not shod with metal .
description_long: Shillelagh The shillelagh ( shuh - ley - lee ) spell enhanced a wooden weapon , such as a club or a staff to do more harm in combat . Effects . The weapon to be enchanted had to be non - magical , made of oak , and not shod with metal . If someone other than the caster wielded the " shillelagh " , the bonus to skill and damage did not manifest . The effects lasted for a few minutes ; longer for more experienced casters . Components . All versions of this spell required an oaken club or staff , the caster ' s holy symbol or divine focus , plus verbal and somatic components . The alteration versions also required a shamrock leaf .

title: Shilmista
description: Shilmista Shilmista , also known as the Forest of Shadows , was a forest near the Snowflake Mountains . Geography . Lying west of the Snowflakes , the forest has been sometimes considered within the territory of Amn or Tethyr , depending on the state of those countries ' borders .
description_long: Shilmista Shilmista , also known as the Forest of Shadows , was a forest near the Snowflake Mountains . Geography . Lying west of the Snowflakes , the forest has been sometimes considered within the territory of Amn or Tethyr , depending on the state of those countries ' borders . Its land encompassed the kingdom of the wild elf Elbereth . The River Valashar began within the forest , at the foot of the Snowflake Mountains . Within the forest , it was shallow and calm . Flora & Fauna . The majority of the trees in the Forest of Shadows were elm and oak trees , though in the higher altitudes , on the slopes of the Snowflake mountains , one could find pine trees and dusktops . Inhabitants . As of 1370 DR , only a single wild elven tribe remained in the forest , hidden in scattered encampments . King Elbereth had a standing order to kill anyone who felled tree or elf . Defenses . The ancient trees were rumored to be imbued with magic and , if called , would provide aid in battle . This was proved by Cadderly Bonaduce , who summoned them with the help of a tome written Dellanil Quil ' quien to fight an army of orc s led by Ragnor and Dorigen of Castle Trinity . History .

title: Shimmer script
description: Shimmer script " Shimmer script " was a name given to a cantrip that obscured magical writings . Effects . The shimmer script spell made magical writings impossible to clearly read using a " wizard eyes " spell or other form of scrying , for the purposes of casting , copying , or memorizing .
description_long: Shimmer script " Shimmer script " was a name given to a cantrip that obscured magical writings . Effects . The shimmer script spell made magical writings impossible to clearly read using a " wizard eyes " spell or other form of scrying , for the purposes of casting , copying , or memorizing . It applied to both the incantations and to the glyphs , runes , and symbols . It could be cast on either the ink that would be used to write the spell , or on a freshly written spell . History . Inhil " Hurler - of - Stars " Lauthdryn , the Magister from 1282 to 1294 DR , had a special love of blowing up castles , a hobby that had many others spying upon him . He developed the shimmer script spell to conceal his spells from them . The spell became widely used .

title: Shimmering sash
description: Shimmering sash Shimmering sashes were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Description .
description_long: Shimmering sash Shimmering sashes were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Description . These sashes were brightly colored and were layered with embroidery depicting protective texts and wards . Powers . Three times per day the wearer of this sash could alter his or her image just like a " blur " spell . When using this power the wearer appeared to shimmer like heated desert air .

title: Shimnus
description: Shimnus Shimnuses were dreadful denizens of the outer planes who found their way to the Hordelands . Description . These creatures resembled ogre - like crones .
description_long: Shimnus Shimnuses were dreadful denizens of the outer planes who found their way to the Hordelands . Description . These creatures resembled ogre - like crones . They had shaggy hair that was usually covered in filth . Sharp , black teeth filled their mouths . Their fingers ended in sharp claws . All shimnuses wore tattered rages . Only female shimnus had been spotted . Combat . Though fearsome in battle , shimnuses resorted to combat as a final option . Deceipt was their preferred method of attack . Magical iron claws and hammers were their preferred weapon . Shimnuses were capable of breathing fire as often as they wished . Once per day they were able to increase their size to that of a storm giant , which they used to throw large boulders . Shimnuses were immune to all mind control and ‘ ’ hold ’ ’ spells . Magical weapons were needed to harm them . Habitat / Society . These solitary creatures were never seen in greater numbers than a pair , and males were never seen . They preferred to make their homes in the barren wilderness on the edge of human societies . Shimnuses were omnivores .

title: Shinar
description: Shinar Shinar was an elder of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Shinar and her fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .
description_long: Shinar Shinar was an elder of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Shinar and her fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party . Personality . Shinar had a warm and thoughtful personality . Powers . Shinar could use low to mid - level clerical healing spells .

title: Shindia Darkeyes
description: Shindia Darkeyes Shindia Darkeyes was a female half - drow in the service of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild . In truth , she was the favorite servant of the original Xanathar and when the Eye killed and impersonated the Xanathar she agreed to join the reformed organization , but in secret she plotted to destroy the Eye , with help from the mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl . Unknown to her , the Eye knew all about her plots .
description_long: Shindia Darkeyes Shindia Darkeyes was a female half - drow in the service of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild . In truth , she was the favorite servant of the original Xanathar and when the Eye killed and impersonated the Xanathar she agreed to join the reformed organization , but in secret she plotted to destroy the Eye , with help from the mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl . Unknown to her , the Eye knew all about her plots . Personality . She ran the blackmail , extortion , and information - gathering operations of the guild .

title: Shing Jaw - long
description: Shing Jaw - long Shing Jaw - long was the only outland member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Shing was a small , handsome man who had long black hair and dark brown eyes that sparkled with intensity .
description_long: Shing Jaw - long Shing Jaw - long was the only outland member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Shing was a small , handsome man who had long black hair and dark brown eyes that sparkled with intensity . Silk robes were his garment of choice . Personality . Though extremely intelligent , Shing was also loud , arrogant , stubborn , and audacious . His pride sometimes got the better of him as he could be goaded into attempting outrageous stunts to prove himself . He was given a place on the Council after proving how dangerous his flying ship could be to native Zakhara n vessels . Activities . Shing and his crew used their dragonship to raid the southern coast of Faerûn and the Free Cities of Zakhara . They avoided the Foreigners ' Sea on Zakhara ' s eastern coast for fear of running into Shou vessels that might report them to the emperor . History . Shing grew up in a pirate family from a maritime province in Shou Lung called Hai Yuan . He worked on one of the emperor ' s spelljamming Dragonships where his abilities as a wu jen proved useful . After a while his captain allowed Shing to help choose new crew members .

title: Shingles McRuff
description: Shingles McRuff Shingles McRuff was a short , very stout dwarf . He was the patriarch of Clan McRuff in Mirabar . Appearance .
description_long: Shingles McRuff Shingles McRuff was a short , very stout dwarf . He was the patriarch of Clan McRuff in Mirabar . Appearance . Shingles only had one eye and covered the other eye socket with an eyepatch . He had a black beard but only on the left side of his face ; the right side was a large scar . Biography . After Marchion Elastul Raurym imprisoned Torgar Hammerstriker to prevent him defecting to Mithral Hall , Shingles took the responsibility of calming the angry and inciteful dwarves in the city , although he was strongly opposed to the marchion ' s act . When Agrathan Hardhammer came to Shingles to ask him to support the marchion ' s line , Shingles punched him to the ground , acting as a catalyst for a large rebellion amongst the dwarves .

title: Shining Citadel
description: Shining Citadel The Shining Citadel was a fabled fortress on the Plane of Shadow . A legend told that the plane was once a normal demiplane but when an order who venerated the plane ' s creator built the Shining Citadel , they used the plane ' s light , color , and life to power it , and the Plane of Shadow was stripped of these things as a result . No being on the Material Plane is thought to have found the citadel , if it exists .
description_long: Shining Citadel The Shining Citadel was a fabled fortress on the Plane of Shadow . A legend told that the plane was once a normal demiplane but when an order who venerated the plane ' s creator built the Shining Citadel , they used the plane ' s light , color , and life to power it , and the Plane of Shadow was stripped of these things as a result . No being on the Material Plane is thought to have found the citadel , if it exists .

title: Shining Falls
description: Shining Falls Shining Falls is a beautiful 120 foot tall waterfall that forms part of the Delimbiyr and once marked the southernmost point of the elf realm of Eaerlann . For many years it was also surrounded by a village that shared its name . History .
description_long: Shining Falls Shining Falls is a beautiful 120 foot tall waterfall that forms part of the Delimbiyr and once marked the southernmost point of the elf realm of Eaerlann . For many years it was also surrounded by a village that shared its name . History . The dwarf stonemason Iirikos Stoneshoulder built a tower of granite for an Illuskan wizard named Silifrey the Spraystrider against the wishes of his elven friends who claimed that she dabbled in dark magic . He ignored his friends & quickly finished his task with the aid of summoned elemental s . Unknown to all , Iirikos warded the tower with magic that would give life to any evil spell cast within its walls which would then attack the caster . Silifrey was dead within a month after moving in . Several villages popped up surrounding the Granite Tower over the years , but without fail , every one of them suffered from the mysterious disappearance of its residents . Rumours abounded that the spirit of Silifrey Spraystrider appears occasionally and is the cause of the disappearances and that there are crypts hidden beneath the village which house the undead skeletons of all those who have vanished over the years .

title: Shining Hand
description: Shining Hand The Shining Hand was a monastic order based in Amn , dedicated to Azuth . Activities . The monk s of the Shining Hand mixed their monastic practices and their faith in Azuth with the study of magic , such that they could also be wizard s .
description_long: Shining Hand The Shining Hand was a monastic order based in Amn , dedicated to Azuth . Activities . The monk s of the Shining Hand mixed their monastic practices and their faith in Azuth with the study of magic , such that they could also be wizard s . History . The Shining Hand was one of the longest - running monastic orders in Amn . However , Amn ' s persecution of wizards and their practices caused many monks of the order to go underground or even to leave the country .

title: Shining Lands
description: Shining Lands The Shining Lands , or the Lands of the One , was the collective term used for three of the countries surrounding the Golden Water . These were : Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden . The term " Lands of the One " was derived from the fact that all three counties followed the belief in Adama .
description_long: Shining Lands The Shining Lands , or the Lands of the One , was the collective term used for three of the countries surrounding the Golden Water . These were : Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden . The term " Lands of the One " was derived from the fact that all three counties followed the belief in Adama . Geography . Located in the southeast corner of Faerûn along the northern shore of the Great Sea , the Shining Lands represented the last civilized region before reaching the mysterious Utter East . Climate . All of the counties of the Shining Lands were hot areas that possessed rich soil . The inhabitants of these lands considered this region the " land of gold . " Winter rainfall and storms were mild except in the southern regions along the shore of the Great Sea . History . The countries of Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden all shared the same way of life because Durpar controlled the other countries for many years . In fact , the term " Durparian " usually referred to anyone from these three countries , not just someone from Durpar . These countries were ultimately ruled by the Council of Merchants from Heldapan .

title: Shining Plains
description: Shining Plains The Shining Plains was a portion of the Vilhon Reach , named after the visual effect of sunlight hitting the plains . The plains themselves were not held by any cohesive force , instead being composed of human - filled city - states , wemic and centaur tribes , and a powerful druidic organization called the Emerald Enclave .
description_long: Shining Plains The Shining Plains was a portion of the Vilhon Reach , named after the visual effect of sunlight hitting the plains . The plains themselves were not held by any cohesive force , instead being composed of human - filled city - states , wemic and centaur tribes , and a powerful druidic organization called the Emerald Enclave .

title: Shining Sea
description: Shining Sea The Shining Sea was one of the great seas of Faerûn . Geography . The sea stretched from the coastline of Chult in the south , to the shoreline of Calimshan in the north .
description_long: Shining Sea The Shining Sea was one of the great seas of Faerûn . Geography . The sea stretched from the coastline of Chult in the south , to the shoreline of Calimshan in the north . The Shining Sea had a large amount of trade and traffic . It was quite large , although it was not as large as the Trackless Sea or the Sea of Swords .

title: Shining South ( region )
description: Shining South ( region ) The Shining South was a loosely defined " region " of the continent of Faerûn . It incorporated some of the lands from both South Faerûn and Southeast Faerûn . Lands .
description_long: Shining South ( region ) The Shining South was a loosely defined " region " of the continent of Faerûn . It incorporated some of the lands from both South Faerûn and Southeast Faerûn . Lands . Dambrath . Dambrath was a nation on the southern coast of Faerûn . It was notable because it was ruled by a race of human , drow and elves know as the Crinti , who made up the upper class . Dambrath was predominantly an isolationist nation , though they did allow some trade with outsiders . Durpar . Durpar was a merchant kingdom of the Shining Lands that rested to the southeast of Veldorn , separated from Estagund by the Curna Mountains . The capital port - city of Vaelan was located near the western shores of the Golden Water . Verdant farms surrounded the Golden Water and the shoreline was given to the mansions of the luxury - loving ruling merchant elite of the kingdom . Inns in Durpar were worth visiting as there were nightly entertainments in every house . All foreigners were welcome , so long as they had wealth and knew how to conduct themselves . Halruaa . Halruaa was a land of magic .

title: Shining Steel Mercenary Company
description: Shining Steel Mercenary Company The Shining Steel Mercenary Company was a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Shining Steel originated as an adventuring party in the Sea of Fallen Stars .
description_long: Shining Steel Mercenary Company The Shining Steel Mercenary Company was a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Shining Steel originated as an adventuring party in the Sea of Fallen Stars . When the leaders of Spandeliyon asked for their help to defend the city from a pirate horde , they recruited more members and successfully defeated the pirates . They decided to continued to act as mercenary group but always with the approach of an adventuring party . When the Horde menaced Faerûn , they decided to join the crusade of Azoun Obarskyr IV , being hired by Sembia . During the war they fought well but were decimated . The few survivors continued on as an adventuring party .

title: Shining Stream
description: Shining Stream The Shining Stream was a river in eastern Tethyr that was the primary tributary of the River Ith . Geography . The Shining Stream began in the Snowflake Mountains and poured into the River Ith .
description_long: Shining Stream The Shining Stream was a river in eastern Tethyr that was the primary tributary of the River Ith . Geography . The Shining Stream began in the Snowflake Mountains and poured into the River Ith . It was fed by Swimstar Creek near Mount Noblesse . Though it meandered more than would be expected , it had a strong current . It was deep in most places , but there were several exceptions where it could be forded . The river formed the western and northern borders of County Morninggold . History . While most of the river was in Tethyrian territory , its headwaters in the Snowflakes were within the barony of Carrelath in Erlkazar , a garrison of troops from Erlkazar defended them .

title: Shining Temple of Bishamon
description: Shining Temple of Bishamon The Shining Temple of Bishamon was a temple to Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Description . Standing atop a high hill , the Shining Temple of Bishamon dominated the town .
description_long: Shining Temple of Bishamon The Shining Temple of Bishamon was a temple to Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Description . Standing atop a high hill , the Shining Temple of Bishamon dominated the town . A gate stood at the entrance of the temple , guarded by massive lion s carved of ebony with eyes of gold and teeth of crystal . Climbing the hill was a 3000 - step stairway , flanked by rows of wooden pillars , dyed red and topped by ivory spires , leading up to the main temple building . In front of the temple stood a soaring apple tree — the fruit was said to bestow immortality on the deserving , but death to the wicked , but only Bishamon could pick them . Hanging from a branch of the tree was a brass bell that was tolled every hour in homage to Bishamon , the Wide Hearing . Within the temple sat cross - legged a colossal idol of Bishamon covered in gold . Before it were long rows of small brass statues of the most important priests of the faith of the last thousand years , numbering 3 , 333 in all . The strange statues depicted them with multiple heads and dozens of arms , to symbolize their good deeds . Activities .

title: Shining White
description: Shining White Shining White was a large cavern and tunnel complex located in the Spine of the World mountain range in northern Faerûn . Inhabitants . It was inhabited by frost giants , who were once united and ruled by Jarl Orel , an ancient frost giant who lay on his death bed .
description_long: Shining White Shining White was a large cavern and tunnel complex located in the Spine of the World mountain range in northern Faerûn . Inhabitants . It was inhabited by frost giants , who were once united and ruled by Jarl Orel , an ancient frost giant who lay on his death bed . His daughter , Gerti Orelsdottr , was at the time the de facto ruler of the giant clan , and being his only child and heir , it was likely that she would succeed him and become the official ruler of Shining White once he was dead . History . Shining White was an ancient barbarian burial cairn . Its name came from both the white marble menhirs and the white chalk soil uncovered by the barbarians ' cuts into the permafrost layer .

title: Shinthala Deepcrest
description: Shinthala Deepcrest Shinthala Deepcrest was a druid of Silvanus and member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave during the 14th and 15th centuries . History . Shinthala represented human s among the three members of the Elder Circle .
description_long: Shinthala Deepcrest Shinthala Deepcrest was a druid of Silvanus and member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave during the 14th and 15th centuries . History . Shinthala represented human s among the three members of the Elder Circle . However , she was unable to act as she would ' ve liked because of the chaos caused by the Spellplague , which had altered the natural ecosystems and drove Cindermoon , the elven member of the Elder Circle , insane . Finally , in 1486 DR , the boy prophet of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn , arrived and successfully cured Cindermoon . However , a large pirate fleet led by the Chosen of Umberlee Evendur Highcastle followed him in order to kill him . Shinthala alone agreed to join Stedd ' s companions and the Turmish navy in fighting them . During the battle , Shinthala and others faced Evendur and Shinthala was seriously injured . Finally , Stedd joined the fight and saved Shinthala ' s life .

title: Shinzi
description: Shinzi Shinzi was a half - drow in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Shinzi was the daughter of a human slave and a drow merchant .
description_long: Shinzi Shinzi was a half - drow in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Shinzi was the daughter of a human slave and a drow merchant . Orphaned , she was adopted by Dalfred Noakes as a step - daughter and was more important as a spy . Activities . Outwardly , Shinzi acted as a promoter for her step - father ' s inn , the Narbondel ' s Shadow in the Eastmyr district . In truth , she spied on the drow , searching for a sign of weakness to use against them . Relationships . Shinzi was adopted by Dalfred , who used her as one of his spies .

title: Ship Isle
description: Ship Isle Ship Isle , or the Island of Ships or the Isle of Ships , was a small island located in the Golden Water of the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . As the name implied , Ship Isle was used primarily for the construction of sailing vessels .
description_long: Ship Isle Ship Isle , or the Island of Ships or the Isle of Ships , was a small island located in the Golden Water of the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . As the name implied , Ship Isle was used primarily for the construction of sailing vessels . The Sholapur chaka set up dockyards along the coast of much of the island . These were used to construct the most prized vessels to sail the Golden Water .

title: Ship Kurth
description: Ship Kurth Ship Kurth was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Kurth . Activities .
description_long: Ship Kurth Ship Kurth was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Kurth . Activities . By 1383 DR , Ship Kurth operated a tavern on the northern bank of the city called One - Eyed Jax ( named for Jarlaxle ) . The tavern was well known for providing foreigners a good place to sleep , but it was also frequented by drow . High Captain Beniago Kurth frequently posted caravan notices on aboard in the tavern . Base of Operations . Ship Kurth ' s base ( known as " Tower Kurth " ) was located on Closeguard Island , connected to the southwest part of the city by a bridge . The island was located relatively close to the Host Tower of the Arcane . Relationships . After ( or rather , in fact , during ) Lord Brambleberry and Captain Deudermont ' s assault on Luskan in 1376 DR , Ship Kurth became the public face of the drow mercenary band Bregan D ' aerthe , lead by Jarlaxle and Kimmuriel Oblodra . History . Ship Kurth was originally founded by Kurth . In the 1400s , Beniago , a drow agent of Bregan D ' aerthe , infiltrated the Ship and became a lieutenant . By 1483 DR , he had become the High Captain .

title: Ship Rethnor
description: Ship Rethnor Ship Rethnor was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Rethnor . Relationships .
description_long: Ship Rethnor Ship Rethnor was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Rethnor . Relationships . In 1376 DR , the dwarf Athrogate , was employed by High Captain Kensidan Rethnor as a guard and informant . That implied a connection to the drow mercenary group Bregan D ' aerthe , since Athrogate was known to work with Jarlaxle , the leader of Bregan D ' aerthe . History . Ship Rethnor was originally founded by Rethnor . In 1376 DR , the current captain died and his son , Kensidan the Crow became the new High Captain .

title: Ship Suljack
description: Ship Suljack Ship Suljack was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by Suljack . Relationships .
description_long: Ship Suljack Ship Suljack was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by Suljack . Relationships . Ship Suljack was allied with Ship Rethnor in 1376 DR . History . Ship Suljack was the only Ship represented when Captain Deudermont proclaimed his plan for the new city of Luskan in 1376 DR . Suljack was killed by Athrogate , by the order of High Captain Kensidian of Ship Rethnor , soon after .

title: Ship of chaos
description: Ship of chaos A ship of chaos was a vessel that could travel the plane s . It sailed between planes on winds of chaos and fed on souls . Description .
description_long: Ship of chaos A ship of chaos was a vessel that could travel the plane s . It sailed between planes on winds of chaos and fed on souls . Description . It was not clear whether all ships of chaos were formed more or less the same , or , as the name implied , each one was different . The ship of chaos recovered by Quenthel Baenre in 1373 DR in the Lake of Shadows ( previously captained by the uridezu Raashub ) was bone white with three masts and tattered sails . The ship ' s lines were made of intestine . There was a maw in the hold of the ship through which the crew fed souls ( generally mane s ) to power the ship .
