The tiller of the ship appeared to be formed out of a dragon wing . The deck was of powdered and compressed bone . The rudder was a sickle blade . The sails of the ship were made of human skin . Ships of chaos were driven through mental control . If the ship of chaos didn ' t accept the pilot , he or she was killed .

title: Ship of fools
description: Ship of fools Ship of fools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell had similar effects of the " feeblemind " spell , but instead of targeting wizard s , this spell made an entire ship ' s crew lose their knowledge of the sea .
description_long: Ship of fools Ship of fools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell had similar effects of the " feeblemind " spell , but instead of targeting wizard s , this spell made an entire ship ' s crew lose their knowledge of the sea . Any naval action attempted by a crew member under the influence of this spell would fail . This spell could only affect one sailing vessel at a time . Components . This spell required a finger bone or nonmagical ring taken from someone who lived a good life to cast . This component was reusable .

title: Ship of the Gods
description: Ship of the Gods The Ship of the Gods was a volcanic island on the Alamber Sea on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It had no ports . History .
description_long: Ship of the Gods The Ship of the Gods was a volcanic island on the Alamber Sea on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It had no ports . History . An eruption in 1369 DR caused part of its upper slopes to collapse . There have been unconfirmed speculative claims that there was treasure buried inside the volcano .

title: Shipshock
description: Shipshock Shipshock was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected ships from underwater attacks .
description_long: Shipshock Shipshock was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected ships from underwater attacks . Once cast , the spell lay dormant until a creature other than a natural animal touched the hull . When triggered , the spell released a blast of electricity that affected every living thing within 100 feet ( 30 . 5 m ) if they were underwater . The spell was spent after one discharge . Components . This spell required a small silver rod to cast .

title: Shivanni Gardpeck
description: Shivanni Gardpeck Shivanni Gardpeck was the proprietor of the Cutlass inn in Luskan . She was also an informant for the drow band Bregan D ' aerthe . Relationships .
description_long: Shivanni Gardpeck Shivanni Gardpeck was the proprietor of the Cutlass inn in Luskan . She was also an informant for the drow band Bregan D ' aerthe . Relationships . Shivanni Gardpeck claimed to be the great - great - great - grandniece of Arumn Gardpeck , who owned the Cutlass during Wulfgar ' s stint there as a bouncer .

title: Shiz - ti
description: Shiz - ti Shiz - ti was the greatest wu jen in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Shiz - ti like his father received an appointment as a minor advisor of the Tairo .
description_long: Shiz - ti Shiz - ti was the greatest wu jen in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Shiz - ti like his father received an appointment as a minor advisor of the Tairo . He spend however most time in his magic research . In 1345 DR he was arrested to had attired a falling star which fell in the merchant ' s district and killed 200 people . The day after the Great Fire ravaged Uwaji , eventually destroying half the city and killing 100 , 000 . All charges against whiz - ti were withdrawn and under Shiz - ti ' s suggestion he was relocated to the island of Paikai to took care of the Temple of the High Moon . There he became the absolute ruler of the place , using the daimyo Fudo Oieto as puppet . Shiz - ti plotted to cancel all human life in Wa , granting the land to animals and plants , like , in his mind , was the will of the gods . However he had no yet found the correct plan to use .

title: Shizadai
description: Shizadai Shizadai was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Shizadai was ordered , together with his older brother Shizuoka , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords .
description_long: Shizadai Shizadai was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Shizadai was ordered , together with his older brother Shizuoka , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords . He may have helped them battle Korimori clan troops led by Sakigahara and Himeji .

title: Shizuoka
description: Shizuoka Shizuoka was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Shizuoka was ordered , together with his younger brother Shizadai , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords .
description_long: Shizuoka Shizuoka was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Shizuoka was ordered , together with his younger brother Shizadai , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords . He may have helped them battle Korimori clan troops led by Sakigahara and Himeji .

title: Shoalar Quanderil
description: Shoalar Quanderil Shoalar Quanderil was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Shoalar always appeared jovial , but with a biting sense of humor and tending to laugh at people rather than with them .
description_long: Shoalar Quanderil Shoalar Quanderil was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Shoalar always appeared jovial , but with a biting sense of humor and tending to laugh at people rather than with them . He saw Olhydra ' s power as a means to become rich . History . Shoalar was once a pirate captain on the Sword Coast and a Crushing Wave cultist . In 1491 DR , he transferred to the Dessarin Valley , where he was involved in an assault on the Mirabar diplomatic delegation . However , at Ironford bridge , he was confronted and defeated by some adventurers hired to find the delegation .

title: Shock
description: Shock Shock was a magical weapon ability . With a command , a shock weapon became sheathed in crackling electricity . Any creature hit by the weapon took damage from the electricity in addition to the damage the weapon did .
description_long: Shock Shock was a magical weapon ability . With a command , a shock weapon became sheathed in crackling electricity . Any creature hit by the weapon took damage from the electricity in addition to the damage the weapon did . Creation . A spellcaster needed the " call lightning " or " lightning bolt " spells to create a weapon with this ability .

title: Shock sphere
description: Shock sphere Shock sphere is an evocation spell learned early in the training of several wizard s that calls upon the elemental power of storm for its energy . When a wizard casts " shock sphere " she or he creates a sphere of crackling lightning and hurls it straight towards a spot within fifty feet of him or her . When the " sphere " reaches its destination it explodes , much like the simpler " force orb " spell , in a surge of electrical power over an area of five feet in diameter .
description_long: Shock sphere Shock sphere is an evocation spell learned early in the training of several wizard s that calls upon the elemental power of storm for its energy . When a wizard casts " shock sphere " she or he creates a sphere of crackling lightning and hurls it straight towards a spot within fifty feet of him or her . When the " sphere " reaches its destination it explodes , much like the simpler " force orb " spell , in a surge of electrical power over an area of five feet in diameter . A short rest is required of a wizard who seeks to recast the spell .

title: Shocker lizard
description: Shocker lizard Shocker lizards are not animals but magical beasts . They possess the magical ability to produce electrical effects from their body . Shocker lizards tend to be small and blue in color .
description_long: Shocker lizard Shocker lizards are not animals but magical beasts . They possess the magical ability to produce electrical effects from their body . Shocker lizards tend to be small and blue in color . They are otherwise similar to normal lizards in attitude . They hunt small animals , insects , and fish for food . Shocker lizards prefer to be left alone . If an intruder enters their territory , the lizard warns off the intruder with a light stunning shock . If the intruder does not leave , the shocker lizard produces large , deadlier electrical discharges . Shocker lizards can work together to produce even more powerful discharges .

title: Shocking burst
description: Shocking burst Shocking burst was a powerful magical ability that could be added to a weapon . When a weapon with this ability hit a foe in a vital area , it released a blast of electricity that harmed the creature . A shocking burst weapon also had the shock ability .
description_long: Shocking burst Shocking burst was a powerful magical ability that could be added to a weapon . When a weapon with this ability hit a foe in a vital area , it released a blast of electricity that harmed the creature . A shocking burst weapon also had the shock ability . Creation . A spellcaster needed a " call lightning " or " lightning bolt " spell to create a weapon with this ability .

title: Shocking grasp
description: Shocking grasp Shocking grasp charged the caster ' s hand with electrical energy that damaged a touched foe . A foe with large amounts of metal would suffer a greater effect . " Shocking grasp " was a common spell in the Realms , though not a popular one .
description_long: Shocking grasp Shocking grasp charged the caster ' s hand with electrical energy that damaged a touched foe . A foe with large amounts of metal would suffer a greater effect . " Shocking grasp " was a common spell in the Realms , though not a popular one . It was known but rare in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . The Netherese arcanist Volhm was given the credit for the creation of this spell in −1970 DR under the name Volhm ' s grasp . Known Users . Pre - spellplague , the underwizards of the Arcane Brotherhood typically knew and used this spell . Calishite elementalist s who followed the Tradition of Air were especially adept at the casting of " shocking grasp " .

title: Shoehorn of puissant castleblasting
description: Shoehorn of puissant castleblasting The shoehorn of puissant castleblasting was a magical item sold to an adventurer by a Sembia n merchant . Appearance . The shoehorn was approximately three finger - widths wide at the wide end , one finger - width wide at the narrow curved end and 2 feet long ( 60 .
description_long: Shoehorn of puissant castleblasting The shoehorn of puissant castleblasting was a magical item sold to an adventurer by a Sembia n merchant . Appearance . The shoehorn was approximately three finger - widths wide at the wide end , one finger - width wide at the narrow curved end and 2 feet long ( 60 . 96 centimeters ) . It was constructed of a smooth non - corrosive alloy and covered with ornate curving runes . When not in use the shoehorn gave off a dim blue light . Powers . When used as a shoehorn while concentrating on a target , the " shoehorn of puissant castleblasting " had the same effect as a " horn of blasting " . In addition , the shoehorn had a variety of other magical abilities :

title: Sholapur chaka
description: Sholapur chaka The Sholapur chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Sholapurs owned most of Ship Isle off the coast of Var the Golden near Myrmyr .
description_long: Sholapur chaka The Sholapur chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Sholapurs owned most of Ship Isle off the coast of Var the Golden near Myrmyr . Their shipyards produced the finest merchant vessels in all of the Shining Lands , making them an extremely wealthy chaka . Base of Operations . The Sholapur chaka was based out of Myrmyr in eastern Var the Golden .

title: Shondarl Stonegiant
description: Shondarl Stonegiant Shondarl Stonegiant was a merchant who lived in the Vast and worked as a locksmith and a supplier of trained dancers . Stonegiant maintained a country house in the town of Maerstar , and fled there following the chaos and disaster in his home city during the Time of Troubles , 1358 DR , along with a number of other merchants from Procampur and Tsurlagol . However , they were harassed by looting mobs of refugees from Tantras , Calaunt and even Mulmaster , who ' d also come through Maerstar .
description_long: Shondarl Stonegiant Shondarl Stonegiant was a merchant who lived in the Vast and worked as a locksmith and a supplier of trained dancers . Stonegiant maintained a country house in the town of Maerstar , and fled there following the chaos and disaster in his home city during the Time of Troubles , 1358 DR , along with a number of other merchants from Procampur and Tsurlagol . However , they were harassed by looting mobs of refugees from Tantras , Calaunt and even Mulmaster , who ' d also come through Maerstar . Stonegiant buried a hoard of coins and trade - bars in one of Maerstar ' s horse paddocks to protect them from the looters , but did not survive to retrieve them afterwards . The hoard was reputed to still be buried in Maerstar by 1370 DR .

title: Shontiq A ' Lavallier
description: Shontiq A ' Lavallier Shontiq A ' Lavallier was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Shontiq studied magic under the tutelage of Ravel Xorlarrin whom he idolized .
description_long: Shontiq A ' Lavallier Shontiq A ' Lavallier was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Shontiq studied magic under the tutelage of Ravel Xorlarrin whom he idolized . During the War of the Silver Marches , Shontiq was with the main army on the Redrun river battling the Knights in Silver , and later at the fall of Sundabar . In 1485 DR , he was made leader of a contingent that spied on Silverymoon , a boring mission for him . However Shontiq was killed on surprise when an army led by Regis , Wulfgar and Aleina Brightlance suddenly attacked his emplacement

title: Shoon I
description: Shoon I Shoon I was the second emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon I was a handsome man , but his eyes were guarded and he had a cruelty that was visible in his facial features .
description_long: Shoon I Shoon I was the second emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon I was a handsome man , but his eyes were guarded and he had a cruelty that was visible in his facial features . Personality . Shoon I was a very proud man . In his vanity , he commissioned the construction of many statues and murals of his likeness that remained for centuries . Activities . Shoon I was responsible for the start of the massive road system project that connected the cities of Calimshan , including beginning the project of extending the Trade Way across the Calim Desert . Shoon also saw to the formation of the Wizard ' s Consortium that grew to become the Guilds Arcane of modern Calimshan . The Consortium was founded in 61 DR , and Shoon I required all wizard s to register so that he could have better control over magic in his realm . Relationships . Shoon I was the son of Amahl Shoon III . He had three older brothers , who were slain in so - called " hunting accidents " orchestrated by his father ' s enemies . He had at least four children , three sons and a daughter . His sons were named Qamar , Ksan , and Aleph . Aleph would go on to become Shoon II . History .

title: Shoon II
description: Shoon II Shoon II was the third emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He was remembered as the Atheist Qysar for his hatred of religion . Activities .
description_long: Shoon II Shoon II was the third emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He was remembered as the Atheist Qysar for his hatred of religion . Activities . Little was remembered about Shoon II ' s reign except for his active attempt to remove all religion from his realm . Relationships . Shoon II was a son of Shoon I . He was the third child . His older twin brother was named Ksan , and the oldest son was named Qamar . They also had a younger sister , whose name was lost to history . Shoon II and Ksan were very close and would join together against their older brother Qamar . Shoon also adored his little sister . Shoon II had six sons , all of whom were ultimately killed by the magic of the artifact known as Saarkanlyth ' s Antaglass . Shoon II had commissioned the magical mirror as a test to humble his proud sons and chose an heir , but all of them failed the test . Shoon II ' s niece gave birth to a son named Aleph yn Jadhar el Shoon , whom Shoon II adopted as his own son . One of the most trusted servants of Shoon II was a man named Sulak yn Khamas el Adnan . Saref Adnan was considered the qysar ' s rare antiques and magic " collector " . History .

title: Shoon III
description: Shoon III Shoon III was the fourth emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . Shoon III moved the government of Calimshan and the Shoon Imperium back to Shoonach from Calimport , where it would remain until the end of the Imperium .
description_long: Shoon III Shoon III was the fourth emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . Shoon III moved the government of Calimshan and the Shoon Imperium back to Shoonach from Calimport , where it would remain until the end of the Imperium . Relationships . Shoon III was the first grandnephew of Shoon II , and the aging ruler adopted Shoon III as his own son and heir only moments before his death . Shoon III had at least two brothers , both of whom would also become emperors of the Imperium . Possessions . Shoon III had a powerful magic ring known as the " Annulus Conflagros " . It had the combined powers of a " ring of fire resistance " and a " wand of fire " and was the second of the so - called " Qysari Rings " ever made . History . Born Aleph yn Jadhar el Shoon in 107 DR , to the niece of Shoon II , Shoon III never saw a day not surrounded in luxury . He was trained from a young age to become the next emperor and told never to trust his regent , Hazamir al Aktorral , who ruled the Imperium until the boy came of age . Shoon III obeyed what he was taught by his mother and his advisers — he began his reign in 123 DR by ordering Hazamir to be executed by beheading .

title: Shoon IV
description: Shoon IV Shoon IV was the first necromancer emperor of the Shoon Imperium and the second - most evil and infamous of all its emperors . He was the only non - elf to ever succeed in designing a " create mythal " spell . Personality .
description_long: Shoon IV Shoon IV was the first necromancer emperor of the Shoon Imperium and the second - most evil and infamous of all its emperors . He was the only non - elf to ever succeed in designing a " create mythal " spell . Personality . Shoon IV was arrogant , bold , and manipulative and had a famous bad temper . In his favor , he was also a master of domestic and foreign policy , because of his impressive foresight into such matters . Possessions . Shoon IV possessed a pair of rings , Annulus Qysarus Major and Annulus Qysarus Minor . The former ring acted like a " ring of spell turning " ; the latter as a ring of spell storing . If both rings were worn together , Shoon IV also gained the powers of a " ring of vampiric regeneration " . His greatest magical work , rumored to include a " create mythal " spell , was called the " Necroqysarus " . It included twelve volumes of magical spells . It was lost to history after the fall of the Imperium . Activities . Shoon IV was a wizard of ever - growing power . He amassed a vast amount of magical knowledge and artifact s in his thirst for power .

title: Shoon Imperium
description: Shoon Imperium The Shoon Imperium was the dominant government of much of south and western Faerûn during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) . It was the most well - documented of all of Calimshan ' s royal dynasties . History .
description_long: Shoon Imperium The Shoon Imperium was the dominant government of much of south and western Faerûn during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) . It was the most well - documented of all of Calimshan ' s royal dynasties . History . Founding . The Imperium started as the idea of Akkabar Shoon the Elder , the scion of a minor branch of a fairly insignificant noble family with a history of breeding talented wizard s . At the age of 16 , Akkabar had the privilege of being made the apprentice of the Vizera Wizard - princess Rhynda Ithal of Tethyr . He lived and studied in Myratma with the queen for more than six years until his apprenticeship was over . He then moved to Calimport and , after four years of selling his prestigious magical abilities to the highest bidder , he became a major figure in the city ' s social elite . After another six years of work , he managed to ingratiate himself into the royal court of syl - pasha Kadar el Tarsaj , quickly earning the right to marry the syl - pasha ' s fifth daughter and , as a wedding gift , was granted the position of syl - vizar of his home city Memnon .

title: Shoon V
description: Shoon V Shoon V was the first empress of the Shoon Imperium and the first woman to directly rule over either Calimshan or Tethyr . Description . Shoon V was a skilled and capable ruler , despite how the nobles looked down on her for being a woman .
description_long: Shoon V Shoon V was the first empress of the Shoon Imperium and the first woman to directly rule over either Calimshan or Tethyr . Description . Shoon V was a skilled and capable ruler , despite how the nobles looked down on her for being a woman . She had an intense fear of undead . Possessions . Because of her phobia of undead , Shoon V commissioned the creation of the Dual Ring of Velsharoon ' s Bindings . This was two rings — one worn on the index finger , the other on the little finger — connected by a fine chain . It protected her against undead and spells from the school of necromancy . Activities . Shoon V lessened the role of wizard s in the Empire from the status they held during the reign of her great - grandfather , Shoon IV . She enhanced the power and size of the military , especially the Farisans and the Sadimmin . She also increased the size of the Qysaghanni , the royal guard . Her efforts expanding the Imperium to include the lands of the Shaar as far as the Landrise , and she took control of lands on the Chultan Peninsula as well , taking the lands of the Tashalar and Thindol .

title: Shoon VI
description: Shoon VI Shoon VI was a powerful wizard and an emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon VI was described as " catlike " in his bearing .
description_long: Shoon VI Shoon VI was a powerful wizard and an emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon VI was described as " catlike " in his bearing . He was a powerful wizard as an adult , far more so than many wizards even five times older than he was . This was in stark contrast to his childhood , when he was prone to illness . Personality . Shoon VI was proud and confident . He preferred to entrust the ruling of the Imperium to his advisers , but he also had the wisdom to select excellent advisers . He had no love of the military , unlike his mother , and he essentially ignored his armies , letting them control themselves . Activities . During his reign , Shoon VI saw to the expansion of both the magical resources of his empire and its intelligence - gathering capabilities . The empire thrived under his rule compared to its status under past rulers . Five years before his death , Shoon VI completed crafting of a battle horror construct called the Champion of Iltakar . Its purpose was to serve as a trainer of the greatest gladiators of the arenas of Iltakar in Shoonach .

title: Shoon VII
description: Shoon VII Qysar Shoon VII was one of the most wicked rulers and one of the most powerful spellcasters to ever have lived in Faerûn . Thought to have died with the Shoon Imperium of Calimshan , in truth , Shoon VII had managed to preserve himself as a lich for a thousand years . Description .
description_long: Shoon VII Qysar Shoon VII was one of the most wicked rulers and one of the most powerful spellcasters to ever have lived in Faerûn . Thought to have died with the Shoon Imperium of Calimshan , in truth , Shoon VII had managed to preserve himself as a lich for a thousand years . Description . The man known as Shoon VII had taken many physical forms over his long life , beginning with that of his natural , Calishite male body . In his demilich form , Shoon appeared as a mostly intact floating skull with gem teeth . In his most recent form , ( the strange circumstances of which are explained below , ) Shoon VII appeared as a short , young wood elven maiden with bobbed , curly silver hair . In this feminine form , he had hazel eyes , which darkened to mahogany when he became angry . Personality . Shoon VII was an exceptionally cruel man , yet he had such great charisma that he could inspire deep loyalty from his underlings and the people of his realm . His speeches were said to have been " awe - inspiring " . While a demilich , Shoon would not bother speaking with anyone who did not refer to him as " Emperor " .

title: Shoonach
description: Shoonach Shoonach was the former capital of the Shoon Imperium , located on the border of Calimshan and Tethyr , and claimed by both . History . Work on Shoonach started as a ploy by King Amahl I to re - garrison the Calishite troops sent to keep an eye on him by his grandfather Akkabar Shoon .
description_long: Shoonach Shoonach was the former capital of the Shoon Imperium , located on the border of Calimshan and Tethyr , and claimed by both . History . Work on Shoonach started as a ploy by King Amahl I to re - garrison the Calishite troops sent to keep an eye on him by his grandfather Akkabar Shoon . Construction began on the site of Iltakar , the capital of the old kingdom of Mir . Surprisingly , Akkabar supported the construction and , when Amahl I was assassinated , construction continued with the stones and slave labor taken from Ithmong when that city was destroyed to prevent an uprising from angry Tethyrian s . By 1369 DR , the Twisted Rune had placed a magical gate in the area to allow for instantaneous movement to other locations .

title: Shoonring
description: Shoonring Shoonrings were magical rings from the time of the Shoon Imperium , which were all made to certain standards . Description . A " shoonring " was always constructed from two different metals .
description_long: Shoonring Shoonrings were magical rings from the time of the Shoon Imperium , which were all made to certain standards . Description . A " shoonring " was always constructed from two different metals . Two strands each of each metal were twisted together to form a cord of each metal , and these two cords were further twisted together to form the ring with a thick band of twined colors . Gems were never used in the construction of the rings ; the only ornamentation besides the metals involved sometimes using magic spells — such as " blueshine " or " everbright " — to add shine to the metals . Crafters of " shoonrings " tended to use specific metals for specific magical properties . What follows are examples of such metals and their associated properties : Powers . With a few exceptions , as far as their powers , " shoonrings " were no different than magic rings made outside of or before or after the Shoon Imperium . " Shoonrings " made during and often after the reign of Shoon VI , however , often had an additional magical property , which was hidden to many wearers .

title: Shoonring of swimming
description: Shoonring of swimming The shoonring of swimming was possibly one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It kept the wearer afloat in all but extreme conditions and allowed quick movement through water , like any " ring of swimming " , but it was its little - known ability to prevent detection or dispelling of all magical " charm s " present upon the wearer that pointed toward this being one of the legendary " Qysari Rings " of old . Description .
description_long: Shoonring of swimming The shoonring of swimming was possibly one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It kept the wearer afloat in all but extreme conditions and allowed quick movement through water , like any " ring of swimming " , but it was its little - known ability to prevent detection or dispelling of all magical " charm s " present upon the wearer that pointed toward this being one of the legendary " Qysari Rings " of old . Description . Magic rings made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , were constructed of twisted bands of two different metals and were known as " shoonring s " . What distinguished the " Qysari Rings " from ordinary " shoonrings " was that they changed appearance depending on the nature of the person wearing them . When placed on the finger of a cleric , druid , or other priest , the direction of the metal weave turned at right angles to the circumference of the ring . If donned by warrior s or rogue s , the raised pattern became smooth to the touch but still visible . Wizard s saw no change in the design when it was placed on their finger .

title: Shoor Vandree
description: Shoor Vandree Shoor Vandree was a young drow warrior during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Shoor was young and quite arrogant .
description_long: Shoor Vandree Shoor Vandree was a young drow warrior during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Shoor was young and quite arrogant . He was still flush about his promotion , showing it by lording over every other male in Velkynvelve . However , Shoor was still insecure about his position and felt the need to show his skill to his mistress and find ways to please her . Relationship . Shoor became the new lover of Ilvara . He enjoyed showing off his promotion to Jorlan . Activities . Shoor was a young drow warrior of House Vandree in Menzoberranzan , living in the Velkynvelve outpost . Thanks to the injuring of Jorlan Duskryn , he became the field commander and lover of the leader of the outpost , Ilvara Mizzrym .

title: Shoosuva
description: Shoosuva Shoosuvas were hyena - shaped demon s that were given to powerful gnoll s as gifts from Yeenoghu after victorious battles . Each shoosuva was bonded with its gnoll master , and warriors who possessed such companions ranked high in gnoll war bands , second only to flind s .
description_long: Shoosuva Shoosuvas were hyena - shaped demon s that were given to powerful gnoll s as gifts from Yeenoghu after victorious battles . Each shoosuva was bonded with its gnoll master , and warriors who possessed such companions ranked high in gnoll war bands , second only to flind s .

title: Shorg
description: Shorg Shorg was a hobgoblin living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in chainmail , Shorg fought with a scimitar , morning star , and javelin s .
description_long: Shorg Shorg was a hobgoblin living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in chainmail , Shorg fought with a scimitar , morning star , and javelin s . History . Around 1486 DR , Shorg was the leader of the goblinoid s who invaded the village of Julkoun under the suggestion of one of the Red Wizards of Thay . Later , he was defeated by an adventuring party .

title: Shornthal Imynster
description: Shornthal Imynster Shornthal Imynster held the title of Magister of Faerûn from 136 DR until 148 DR . Appearance . Historical accounts appeared to confirm that Shornthal had blond hair that he wore down to his ankles .
description_long: Shornthal Imynster Shornthal Imynster held the title of Magister of Faerûn from 136 DR until 148 DR . Appearance . Historical accounts appeared to confirm that Shornthal had blond hair that he wore down to his ankles . He preferred to wear his hair unbound so that it trailed behind him as he moved about . Personality . Shornthal ' s abrupt manner of speaking , and his controversial views on how Faerûn should be governed , made him many enemies among the rulers of the continent . History . Shornthal traveled extensive throughout Faerûn , attempting to convince the various lords and kings of their folly . He was usually greeted with arrows dangerous spells , none of which harmed him . Golem s were even sent against him , but he smashed them to bits . Shornthal eventually perished in battle , but the historical accounts were vague on the exact nature of his death .

title: Short Ones
description: Short Ones The Short Ones were a clan of halfling s that lived in the eastern forested mountain foothills of Maztica in the Pasocada Basin . Description . These small humanoid s were extremely resistant to the native poisons of Maztica .
description_long: Short Ones The Short Ones were a clan of halfling s that lived in the eastern forested mountain foothills of Maztica in the Pasocada Basin . Description . These small humanoid s were extremely resistant to the native poisons of Maztica . Combat . Most short ones were traders or hunters who fought with knifes or sling s . If cornered , short ones could blend into their forest surroundings becoming invisible to the naked eye . Personality . Short Ones were isolated from other halflings of Maztica , and built themselves conical homes from mud and bark . They subsisted by gathering berries , growing some of their own crops , and hunting small game from the forest . Society . They had little contact with other races and were generally distrustful , although they were known to trade with the Nahopaca . The Short Ones were particularly fond of the turquoise beads of the Azuposi , but would not trade with them directly , so had to rely on other means to acquire them .

title: Short sword
description: Short sword A short sword , also known as a shortsword , is a light , piercing melee weapon . Description . In essence , this weapon is a smaller version of the longsword but longer than a dagger or dirk , having many of the same parts including a generally double - edged blade , cross - guard , grip , and pommel .
description_long: Short sword A short sword , also known as a shortsword , is a light , piercing melee weapon . Description . In essence , this weapon is a smaller version of the longsword but longer than a dagger or dirk , having many of the same parts including a generally double - edged blade , cross - guard , grip , and pommel . The blade is typically from 12 to 20 in ( 30 to 50 cm ) long with a sharp point . An average short sword costs 10 gp and weighs 2 lb ( 0 . 9 kg ) . First edition D & D defined the short sword as " all pointed cutting & thrusting weapons with blade length between 15 in ( 38 cm ) and 24 in ( 61 cm ) . " Weaponology . Short swords are standard issue to many different types of soldiers . Archers favor this weapon for use when the combat range narrows to a point such that their bows are no longer effective . Many warrior s , including fighter s , barbarian s , paladin s , and ranger s carry these as a secondary weapon for use in the off - hand . Smaller races will often use short swords as their primary weapon . Light and maneuverable , yet able to provide many different types of attacks , it is arguably the most common weapon on the battlefield .

title: Shortbow
description: Shortbow A shortbow is a two - handed martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The shortbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 3 to 4 feet ( 0 .
description_long: Shortbow A shortbow is a two - handed martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The shortbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 3 to 4 feet ( 0 . 9 to 1 . 2 meters ) long with the ends connected by strong cord or a gut string that is a little shorter than the shaft , causing the wood to bend and keep the string under tension . For a composite shortbow , the shaft is made from laminated materials ( again , horn , wood or bone ) and fashioned with a recurve , meaning the bow remains bow - shaped even when unstrung . A typical shortbow costs 30gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . A composite shortbow costs around 75gp and weighs about the same . Weaponology . Unlike longbow s , shortbows may be used while mounted . Composite bows are stronger than normal bows and therefore can translate more of the archer ' s strength into range and damage . Bows require two hands to fire and a good amount of practice in order to hit a target . Therefore , the shortbow is considered a martial weapon .

title: Shortspear
description: Shortspear A shortspear is a simple , one - handed melee or thrown weapon . Description . A shortspear is exactly what its name implies , a shorter version of the spear .
description_long: Shortspear A shortspear is a simple , one - handed melee or thrown weapon . Description . A shortspear is exactly what its name implies , a shorter version of the spear . Typically , a shortspear is a straight shaft made of wood , either sharpened to a point or tipped with a spearhead fashioned to perform a specific function . The spearhead may be made of iron , bronze , steel , flint , obsidian , rock crystal , ivory , coral , or other material as suited to the job . The shaft is shorter than a quarterstaff , about 5 to 6 feet ( 1 . 5 to 1 . 8 meters ) long , and usually of smaller diameter than a regular spear , especially if intended to be thrown . An average shortspear with a metal spearhead costs 1gp and weighs 3lbs ( 2 . 6kg ) . Weaponology . The shortspear is small and light enough to wield in one hand and requires very little training to thrust it at an opponent . Throwing a spear is usually done only when hunting , when the target is not likely to attack back , or there is another spear handy to replace the one just thrown . However , carrying multiple spears makes it difficult to use a shield . Realmslore .

title: Shoshara
description: Shoshara Shoshara was a priestess of Eilistraee in Shilmista . History . In 1377 DR , she was arguing with Glorst , a former priest of Vhaeraun , about which of their gods had absorbed the other in their duel in 1375 DR , when they were approached by Halisstra Melarn .
description_long: Shoshara Shoshara was a priestess of Eilistraee in Shilmista . History . In 1377 DR , she was arguing with Glorst , a former priest of Vhaeraun , about which of their gods had absorbed the other in their duel in 1375 DR , when they were approached by Halisstra Melarn . Glorst tried to kill her but was defeated . Later Halisstra interrogated Shoshara about the current situation and the location of Cavatina Xarann . However , Shoshara distrusted her and refused her aid , despite Halisstra ' s suffering . So , at last feeling betrayed by Eilistraee , Halisstra killed Shoshara .

title: Shothragot
description: Shothragot Shothragot is an immensely powerful elder evil in the service of Ghaunadaur . Shothragot is the principal instrument in Ghaunadaur ' s plans , and its mission is to slay the worshipers of other god s in order to weaken them . When they are weak enough , Ghaunadaur plans to defeat the other deities and steal their power for himself until he has enough power to challenge Ao .
description_long: Shothragot Shothragot is an immensely powerful elder evil in the service of Ghaunadaur . Shothragot is the principal instrument in Ghaunadaur ' s plans , and its mission is to slay the worshipers of other god s in order to weaken them . When they are weak enough , Ghaunadaur plans to defeat the other deities and steal their power for himself until he has enough power to challenge Ao . History . Shothragot was created in ancient times by its master , Ghaunadaur , as the prime instrument in his plans to conquer the planes and undo the works of the gods . Shothragot is known to worshipers of Ghaunadaur and likewise venerated by many of them itself . Shothragot has slept for years , siphoning power from its dark worshipers until it has enough strength to begin its dark work . While the awakening of any elder evil would be devastating to the planes Shothragot ' s arousement would be even more terrible , due to its power , comparable with that of a god . Like many elder evils , Shothragot ' s influence extends over more than the multiverse in which Toril and the other known worlds lay , such as the world of Oerth .

title: Shou
description: Shou The Shou were human s originally from the Empire of Shou Lung in the eastern lands of Kara - Tur . By 1360 DR , many Shou migrated to Thesk and other lands of Faerûn . Many cities , such as Phsant , Telflamm , Marsember and Westgate , had " Shou Town " districts within their walls , and the Shou nation of Nathlan in the Dragon Coast was founded in the aftermath of the Spellplague .
description_long: Shou The Shou were human s originally from the Empire of Shou Lung in the eastern lands of Kara - Tur . By 1360 DR , many Shou migrated to Thesk and other lands of Faerûn . Many cities , such as Phsant , Telflamm , Marsember and Westgate , had " Shou Town " districts within their walls , and the Shou nation of Nathlan in the Dragon Coast was founded in the aftermath of the Spellplague . The Shou language , High Shou , used the Draconic alphabet . Description . Shou had yellowish - bronze skin , black hair , and broad , flat features . Shou Settlements . Xiousing . The Shou enclave of Xiousing in Marsember was founded around 1419 DR when the waters of the Sea of Fallen Stars receded . Duc - Sum Li was granted regency of the newly created land as a boon from King Azoun V of Cormyr . The district was a crowded , lively place and was like a piece of Kara - Tur transported to Cormyr .

title: Shou Chiang languages
description: Shou Chiang languages The Shou Chiang languages were a group of languages spoken by the various nations of Kara - Tur , namely Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati . The Shou Chiang languages group comprised the Kao te Shou , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati languages . Of them , Kao te Shou and T ' u Lung came from same root tongue .
description_long: Shou Chiang languages The Shou Chiang languages were a group of languages spoken by the various nations of Kara - Tur , namely Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati . The Shou Chiang languages group comprised the Kao te Shou , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati languages . Of them , Kao te Shou and T ' u Lung came from same root tongue . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages . The Shou Chiang languages heavily influenced the Eastern Imaskari languages . Shou Chiang was also the name of the written language of Shou Lung .

title: Shou Lung
description: Shou Lung Shou Lung was a country in the continent of Kara - Tur , which was located to the east of Faerûn . People from Shou Lung were referred to as Shou . Description .
description_long: Shou Lung Shou Lung was a country in the continent of Kara - Tur , which was located to the east of Faerûn . People from Shou Lung were referred to as Shou . Description . It was arguably the largest and most powerful nation in the world , boasting technology that could one day surpass that of Lantan . Lying between Kara - Tur and Faerûn was the Dragonwall , a great wall of stone . According to legend , a wu jen was tasked by the emperor with finding a way to keep the Tuigan hordes from raiding Shou Lung ' s northern provinces . The wu jen stole the " Jade Mirror " from the sea dragon Pao Hu Jen , whose body was thousands of kilometers long . The wu jen led the dragon on a chase across the border , and at a certain point stopped and held up the Jade Mirror to the dragon ' s eyes , which instantly turned him to stone . After his petrified body fell to the ground , the emperor had his engineers carve fortifications into it so that it could serve them as a defensive wall . Government .

title: Shou Lung amethyst
description: Shou Lung amethyst Shou Lung amethyst was a mineral more similar to ruby and sapphire than to the amethyst s found in Faerûn . Kara - Tur was believed to be the source for these gem stones , where their properties were said to protect the nobility . Description .
description_long: Shou Lung amethyst Shou Lung amethyst was a mineral more similar to ruby and sapphire than to the amethyst s found in Faerûn . Kara - Tur was believed to be the source for these gem stones , where their properties were said to protect the nobility . Description . The deep purple amethyst - like hue gave Shou Lung amethyst its name . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Powers . These stones were rumored to have strong magical powers , but none have been documented .

title: Shou Lung emerald
description: Shou Lung emerald Shou Lung emeralds , known as the bureaucrat ' s stone in Kara - Tur , had a rich color and were highly valued in western Faerûn . A legend surrounding these stones held that there were only three of them in existence , but this was clearly a myth as there were at least a dozen known stockpiles of them in various locations around the West . Description .
description_long: Shou Lung emerald Shou Lung emeralds , known as the bureaucrat ' s stone in Kara - Tur , had a rich color and were highly valued in western Faerûn . A legend surrounding these stones held that there were only three of them in existence , but this was clearly a myth as there were at least a dozen known stockpiles of them in various locations around the West . Description . Shou Lung emeralds were similar to western emerald s but were much harder and had a more lustrous polish . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp . Powers . If this stone had powers , they have not been documented .

title: Shou Lung topaz
description: Shou Lung topaz Shou Lung Topaz was found in Shou Lung and the other mysterious nations to the east of Faerûn . It was imported to western Faerûn by travelers from those lands . Description .
description_long: Shou Lung topaz Shou Lung Topaz was found in Shou Lung and the other mysterious nations to the east of Faerûn . It was imported to western Faerûn by travelers from those lands . Description . This bold yellow stone was a form of making it harder than regular topaz and able to make fine gems . A typical specimen had a base value of 1 , 000 gp . Powers . This gem stone recalled the fiery yellow of some cats ' eyes and was used in the construction of magic items associated with felines . Rumor gave it many magical properties but what they might have been has not yet been documented .

title: Shoudra Stargleam
description: Shoudra Stargleam Shoudra Stargleam was sceptrana of Mirabar in 1370 DR , a title that she claimed after assuming control of Mirabar from its previous Marchion . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities & Civilization - p28 " > < / ref > Activities . Her role got involved in signing trade agreements .
description_long: Shoudra Stargleam Shoudra Stargleam was sceptrana of Mirabar in 1370 DR , a title that she claimed after assuming control of Mirabar from its previous Marchion . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities & Civilization - p28 " > < / ref > Activities . Her role got involved in signing trade agreements . Many influential organizations had an interest in Shoudra , including the Harpers , the Zhentarim , and the Cult of the Dragon , the last of which had made at least one attempt on her life . Home . She lived in an apartment in Undercity Square , with a balcony view of the eastern gate . Appearance . Shoudra had bright blue eyes and long , dark ( black ) hair . She was tall , with delicate features , but with a masculine build . History . In 1370 DR , Shoudra was ordered by Marchion Elastul Raurym to travel to Mithral Hall with the gnome Nanfoodle to sabotage the industry there . Shortly thereafter , their plan was uncovered by Steward Regis of Mithral Hall after he enchanted Nanfoodle with his ruby pendant . Shoudra defended themselves , saying that had they known that Mithral Hall was at war with the orc tribes , they would not have attempted to poison the ore .

title: Shoun
description: Shoun Shoun was a settlement in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Shoun was located on Luirenstrand on the coast of the Great Sea in eastern Luiren .
description_long: Shoun Shoun was a settlement in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Shoun was located on Luirenstrand on the coast of the Great Sea in eastern Luiren . Shoun was the port nearest to Passion Island . It was the terminus from a road leading to Beluir , as well as the beginning of a trail leading to Ormpe in Estagund . Inhabitants . Melino Richtoes was the mayor of Shoun in 1367 DR . History . Shoun was founded by halflings in 116 DR . The settlement sported a host of bakeries , eventually giving rise to the phrase " fat as a Shounite " throughout Luiren . Additionally , famous dairies were supplied by goats , which were kept north of the city . It was even rumored that Luiren spring cheese originated here .

title: Shounra Shalassalar
description: Shounra Shalassalar Shounra Shalassalar was the " Night Fingers " , or ruler , of the thieves ' guild known as the Worms in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . All members of the Worms reported to Shounra in one way or another .
description_long: Shounra Shalassalar Shounra Shalassalar was the " Night Fingers " , or ruler , of the thieves ' guild known as the Worms in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . All members of the Worms reported to Shounra in one way or another . To keep her identity hidden from the public eye , Shounra posed as a pleasure queen . The Night Fingers reported all relevant information they collected to certain lords of the Council . Shounra ' s real master was Manshoon . History . After the fall of Zhentil Keep in 1368 DR , the Worms eventually disbanded but Shounra tried to recreate the organization . < nowiki > < / nowiki > In 1370 DR she worked under Lord Payr ' adar .

title: Shradin Mulophor
description: Shradin Mulophor Shradin Mulophor was a Netherese necromancer who somehow survived the fall of Netheril and a thousand years after when he arrived at Undermountain in 1148 DR . This was during a period of major construction and expansion of the dungeon by Halaster Blackcloak . Shradin had been drawn by the ruins of Sargauth Enclave and , with permission from Halaster , converted it into a trading post which later flourished as Skullport .
description_long: Shradin Mulophor Shradin Mulophor was a Netherese necromancer who somehow survived the fall of Netheril and a thousand years after when he arrived at Undermountain in 1148 DR . This was during a period of major construction and expansion of the dungeon by Halaster Blackcloak . Shradin had been drawn by the ruins of Sargauth Enclave and , with permission from Halaster , converted it into a trading post which later flourished as Skullport . He became known as the Lord of Bones and took up exploring the Undermountain during Halaster ' s occasional absences . When Shradin returned to Skullport , he had become frail and addled , his mind ruined by the horrors of Undermountain . Though still feared , much of his respect had been lost . During the chaos of Halaster ' s Higharvestide in 1369 DR , the Skulls of Skullport mounted a combined assault on Shradin , reducing him to a fine red mist . Since then no one has challenged the rule of the Skulls .

title: Shrieker
description: Shrieker A shrieker was a variant of the violet fungus known for the strange and loud noises it emitted to attract prey . Description . Shriekers were human - sized mushrooms .
description_long: Shrieker A shrieker was a variant of the violet fungus known for the strange and loud noises it emitted to attract prey . Description . Shriekers were human - sized mushrooms . They were similar in appearance to violet fungi , but they lacked the ability to move and did not have tentacles with which to poison prey . They could produce a loud , piercing , screaming sound that tended to attract curious creature ( or adventurers ) to the area . They were immune to the poison of violet fungi . Habitat . Shriekers thrived in dark underground environments . Besides being found in large numbers in the Underdark , shriekers also grew on the illithid homeworld . The Flooded Forest was a dark enough environment for shriekers to grow their as well . Behavior . Shriekers could sense nearby motion or light and would respond with their namesake shriek . Each such screaming sound lasted between five and fifteen seconds . A patch of shriekers relied on violet fungi to kill prey with their poison , since a shrieker could not attack or move on its own . Like violet fungi , shriekers gained their nourishment from the breakdown of organic matter that had fallen nearby . Uses .

title: Shrieking Chasm
description: Shrieking Chasm The Shrieking Chasm was a seemingly bottomless chasm located beneath the Howling Mountains in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . The sounds that emerged from the chasm were so terrible that many believed the Shrieking Chasm was the prison of a mad primordial who betrayed its kin to the gods during the Dawn War .
description_long: Shrieking Chasm The Shrieking Chasm was a seemingly bottomless chasm located beneath the Howling Mountains in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . The sounds that emerged from the chasm were so terrible that many believed the Shrieking Chasm was the prison of a mad primordial who betrayed its kin to the gods during the Dawn War . The inhabitants of Relmaur preferred to avoid the chasm for that reason .

title: Shrieking walls
description: Shrieking walls Shrieking walls was an enchantment that turned a room into a sonic trap . Effects . A room no larger than a 20 ft ( 6 .
description_long: Shrieking walls Shrieking walls was an enchantment that turned a room into a sonic trap . Effects . A room no larger than a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) cube could be enchanted to emit shrill shrieks and wails whenever a creature larger than a typical rat ( 3 lb / 1 . 4 kg or 0 . 5 ft / 0 . 014 m ) entered . The sonic attack was only heard inside the room and for the first minute was only a warning , allowing the subject to leave the room or protect their hearing organs . After that , the sonic intensity increased for a few minutes before falling silent , deafening all in the room for a few hours , making them easier to surprise and reducing the ability of spellcasters to speak the verbal components of spells correctly . Tougher creatures were not deafened , but merely stunned for a few minutes . There was no way to resist the spell itself , but hearing protection or things like " silence , 15 ' radius " prevented the sonic energy from reaching the ears . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a small gold en bell and a bee ' s wing as material components .

title: Shrimp
description: Shrimp Shrimp were an aquatic creature found in many areas of Toril . Species . Deeping shrimp .
description_long: Shrimp Shrimp were an aquatic creature found in many areas of Toril . Species . Deeping shrimp . These shrimp were a bright - red freshwater river breed that grew up to 1 ft ( 0 . 3 m ) in length . These shrimp could be found in the Deeping stream . There tasty shrimp were harvested in nets by local halfling shrimpers in the 1360s DR . Their dried shells emitted a soft pink light for up to two days , and could be used to mark trails in the dark . Popper shrimp . Popper shrimp were a breed of shrimp that flourished in the Wyvernwater and the irrigation canals around the village of Nesmyth in Cormyr . Their shells could be used to create an antidote for a gill rot disease that affected giant golden carp . In 1367 DR , a sage in Thunderstone received from an explorer a deceased giant golden carp from Scalewater , a pond south of the Thunder Peaks , identified the gill rot disease , and feared that a red dragon who guarded the pond would retaliate against nearby villages unless it was treated with the popper - shrimp antidote .

title: Shrine of Tempus ( Thunderstone )
description: Shrine of Tempus ( Thunderstone ) The shrine of Tempus in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , dedicated to Tempus , god of battle , was tended by Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley . She inspired attending adventurers and Purple Dragons soldiers with sermons of battle , blood , and fire . She offered her healing only to those wounded in battle , and would confirm the truth of a tale before she started .
description_long: Shrine of Tempus ( Thunderstone ) The shrine of Tempus in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , dedicated to Tempus , god of battle , was tended by Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley . She inspired attending adventurers and Purple Dragons soldiers with sermons of battle , blood , and fire . She offered her healing only to those wounded in battle , and would confirm the truth of a tale before she started . The shrine was a stone building decorated all over with the detritus of war : split helms , broken shields , blood - stained armor , shattered swords , and the skulls of the fallen .

title: Shrine of the Black Sword
description: Shrine of the Black Sword The Shrine of the Black Sword was a small crystal located south of Thaola ' s Wineshop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . As a symbol of remembrance of all slain elves , the pyramid was set in its own grounds and black marble columns lead up to it .
description_long: Shrine of the Black Sword The Shrine of the Black Sword was a small crystal located south of Thaola ' s Wineshop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . As a symbol of remembrance of all slain elves , the pyramid was set in its own grounds and black marble columns lead up to it . Inhabitants . The grounds were maintained by a single elf who lived in a nearby cottage . History . On Fallrite each year , Queen Amlaruil Moonflower used to visit the shrine with a group of nobles to remember the dead .

title: Shrine of the Bold
description: Shrine of the Bold The Shrine of the Bold was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Shrine of the Bold was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .
description_long: Shrine of the Bold The Shrine of the Bold was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Shrine of the Bold was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin . Activities . This shrine was dedicated to Hajama ' s brother Najm . It was erected for the hobgoblin s , farisan , and few holy slayer s who worshiped the god of adventure . History . Since the shrine was empty much of the time , it became a popular location for evening trysts between the holy slayers .

title: Shrine of the Brave
description: Shrine of the Brave The Shrine of the Brave was a " haram " , or holy site , located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . This small roofed shrine was dedicated to the memory of a hero from antiquity .
description_long: Shrine of the Brave The Shrine of the Brave was a " haram " , or holy site , located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . This small roofed shrine was dedicated to the memory of a hero from antiquity . A well and several buildings , which traveling pilgrim ' s used , were located near the shrine . History . The grounds of the Shrine of the Brave was the site where a valiant hero named Komar al - Anni saved a group of pilgrims from a group of enraged jann , selflessly sacrificing his life in the process . Rumors and Legends . Some warriors who spent the night at the Shrine of the Brave were said to receive mystical visions which aided them in future battles .

title: Shrine of the Claw
description: Shrine of the Claw The Shrine of the Claw was constructed by a sect of kuo - toa in the Lake of Shadows who revered the fiend ish kraken that laired there . Location . Located in the north - western end of the Lake of Shadows , the Shrine of the Claw stood upon a large rocky island .
description_long: Shrine of the Claw The Shrine of the Claw was constructed by a sect of kuo - toa in the Lake of Shadows who revered the fiend ish kraken that laired there . Location . Located in the north - western end of the Lake of Shadows , the Shrine of the Claw stood upon a large rocky island . Structure . Exterior . The Shrine of the Claw was a cube - shaped building made from blocks of granite and windows peppered the sides . A smaller cube adjoined the larger building , which was entered via a stone door flanked by a pair of kuo - toa statues . The entirety of the building was carved with fish , squid , and humanoid fish - folk images . Interior . Beyond the stone door that served as the entrance , a foyer greeted visitors with a statue of the Claw , the leader of the kuo - toa in the shrine . A few inner rooms housed and supported the inhabitants of the shrine . These included quarters for the templars that protected the shrine , a mosaic - tiled hall , and a gallery overlooking the shrine ' s sacred pool . . The central and arguably most important area of the shrine was the sacred pool .

title: Shrine of the Jade Monolith
description: Shrine of the Jade Monolith The Shrine of the Jade Monolith was a temple dedicated to the yikarian Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The temple was located in the city of Lipo along the coast of the Great Sea in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire .
description_long: Shrine of the Jade Monolith The Shrine of the Jade Monolith was a temple dedicated to the yikarian Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The temple was located in the city of Lipo along the coast of the Great Sea in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire . Activity . Since the yikarians of Lipo were more tolerant of outsiders compared to others of their race , many pilgrims came to the Shrine of the Jade Monolith with the hopes of having one of the yak - folk plead to the Faceless God on their behalf .

title: Shrine of the Scimitar
description: Shrine of the Scimitar The Shrine of the Scimitar was a mosque dedicated to Vataqatal in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The mosque was situated so that it overlooked the bazaar .
description_long: Shrine of the Scimitar The Shrine of the Scimitar was a mosque dedicated to Vataqatal in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The mosque was situated so that it overlooked the bazaar . Structure . The Shrine of the Scimitar was made from white marble . The marble was stained with red rust to appear like blood . Each pillar of the mosque was woven with lines of red . Inhabitants . All of the priests inhabiting the Shrine of the Scimitar were outspoken Moralist s who defended the various mamluk societies of Zakhara . Rumors and Legends . This mosque was rumored to house spies from Qudra .

title: Shrine to Mystra ( Shadowdale )
description: Shrine to Mystra ( Shadowdale ) The Shrine to Mystra was a holy place devoted to the goddess Mystra in Shadowdale . Structure . The shrine was a low step pyramid of three wide steps .
description_long: Shrine to Mystra ( Shadowdale ) The Shrine to Mystra was a holy place devoted to the goddess Mystra in Shadowdale . Structure . The shrine was a low step pyramid of three wide steps . Geography . It was located behind the temple of Tymora , and was twenty feet by twenty feet on its base and ten feet by ten feet at the top . This top step was made of dark stone and was inscribed with the symbol of Mystra in silver . The shrine had no caretakers or clergy , but was tended by worshipers . History . Followers of Mystra originally wanted to build a shrine on the ruins of Sylune ' s Hut , but Lord Mourngrym wouldn ' t allow it . In compromise , they built a shrine that allowed viewing of both Sylune ' s Hut and Elminster ' s Tower and , as of 1367 DR , it was viewed by both visitors and townsfolk alike . In Hammer , 1375 DR , the Zhent s took over Shadowdale , and removed the silver from the top of the shrine , defacing the carved stone at the top . Dark Doom Malathon , a half - orc priest of Bane , cast " unhallow " upon the shrine and sacrificed at least three villagers upon the altar to the Black Lord .

title: Shrine to Tempus ( Shadowdale )
description: Shrine to Tempus ( Shadowdale ) In Shadowdale , the Shrine to Tempus is an altar of black basalt framed by two iron pillars . The front of the altar bears a golden symbol of Tempus . Flowers are often left here in remembrance of fallen warriors .
description_long: Shrine to Tempus ( Shadowdale ) In Shadowdale , the Shrine to Tempus is an altar of black basalt framed by two iron pillars . The front of the altar bears a golden symbol of Tempus . Flowers are often left here in remembrance of fallen warriors . The Shrine to Tempus is located north of Druid ' s Grove , and is on the east side of the Shadowdale Trail . History . The Shrine to Tempus was originally built to commemorate the Second Battle of Shadowdale , and honor those who have perished throughout the years defending Shadowdale .

title: Shrine to Tsikapasmatra
description: Shrine to Tsikapasmatra The Shrine to Tsikapasmatra was a small temple dedicated to an ancient hero of Khazari , Tsikapasmatra . The shrine was located in the city of Manass . Inhabitants .
description_long: Shrine to Tsikapasmatra The Shrine to Tsikapasmatra was a small temple dedicated to an ancient hero of Khazari , Tsikapasmatra . The shrine was located in the city of Manass . Inhabitants . In 1367 DR , the shrine was tended by a trio of old shukenja . The Yellow Mountain Sect did not bother the attendants since the shrine was so small . Rumors and Legends . Locals believed that anyone seeking courage could offer a generous donation and maintain vigil overnight on the shrine ' s steps to find what they sought .

title: Shrink item
description: Shrink item Shrink item ( originally called Aksa ' s object and later simply item ) was a common transmutation spell used by arcane casters to shrink an object to tiny size . Effects . Upon casting the spell , the caster could touch a non - magical , non - living object and shrink it to as little as times its original volume and mass .
description_long: Shrink item Shrink item ( originally called Aksa ' s object and later simply item ) was a common transmutation spell used by arcane casters to shrink an object to tiny size . Effects . Upon casting the spell , the caster could touch a non - magical , non - living object and shrink it to as little as times its original volume and mass . It would remain in this shrunken state for at least five days — or longer for more powerful casters . If desired , the caster could chose to change the physical make - up of the item , making it behave as if it were made of cloth . Tossing a magically shrunken object onto any hard surface would cause it to revert back to its original size and composition , as would speaking a special command word chosen by the caster . This would end the spell . Even non - solid objects could be shrunken and changed by " shrink item " , such as a burning campfire , including its flame . If the spellcaster knew the " permanency " spell , an item could be created that could be shrunk and expanded indefinitely . Components . Only verbal and somatic component s were required to cast this spell . History .

title: Shrymaun Beldaerth
description: Shrymaun Beldaerth Shrymaun Beldaerth was a priest of Ilmater and the leader of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum " circa " 1265 DR . He held the title " Exalted Sufferer " . Around 1265 DR , the House of Holy Suffering had come into possession of the " Tome of Torment " , considered the holiest book of the Church of Ilmater .
description_long: Shrymaun Beldaerth Shrymaun Beldaerth was a priest of Ilmater and the leader of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum " circa " 1265 DR . He held the title " Exalted Sufferer " . Around 1265 DR , the House of Holy Suffering had come into possession of the " Tome of Torment " , considered the holiest book of the Church of Ilmater . The Spontaer , the senior Sage - Priest of the church , prayed to Ilmater for nearly a year and sacrificed himself to place powerful magical protections on the " Tome " . Although the Spontaer had explicitly requested that the " Tome of Torment " be delivered to the House of the Broken God in Keltar in Calimshan , the greatest temple of Ilmater , Shrymaun Beldaerth denied the Spontaer ' s wishes and refused to relinquish it . Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the Keltar house declared all those of the " degenerate " Mussum house " heretics " and called for them to be cast out and treated as mentally ill . The Mussum house recruited the Companions of the Noble Heart paladin order to their defense , and a holy war ensued over the artifact .

title: Shu
description: Shu Shu were a secretive , slender humanoid race of warriors almost identical in appearance to halfling s except that they didn ' t grow hair . Description . Shu were diminutive humanoids who weren ' t noted as growing any more than four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall .
description_long: Shu Shu were a secretive , slender humanoid race of warriors almost identical in appearance to halfling s except that they didn ' t grow hair . Description . Shu were diminutive humanoids who weren ' t noted as growing any more than four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall . Unlike most humanoids , shu were completely hairless and unlike halflings , they didn ' t seem to grow fat . They adorned their bodies with copious amounts of war paint and wore garish jewellery as well as piercings in their ears and faces . Personality . With other shu , they were friendly and trusted easily , though interactions with other races , especially those that were bigger than them , were a lot more reserved . They generally avoided contact with others , but when they did , they weren ' t hostile unless first threatened . There was one exception , in that they were staunch enemies of the predatory black leopard katanga . Young shu demonstrated much more open - mindedness toward other races and tended to be much more willing to speak and trade with them . Combat . Shu were all proficient with blowgun s and used both them and shortbow s with deadly accuracy .

title: Shu ( deity )
description: Shu ( deity ) Shu was the deity of wind in the group of gods that eventually became the Mulhorandi pantheon . A fair and benevolent deity , he took his responsibilities seriously and ruled in Heliopolis whenever Ra was away . Description .
description_long: Shu ( deity ) Shu was the deity of wind in the group of gods that eventually became the Mulhorandi pantheon . A fair and benevolent deity , he took his responsibilities seriously and ruled in Heliopolis whenever Ra was away . Description . The Upholder appeared as a strong and handsome male human with slightly blueish skin , with winds blowing about him all the time . He was in complete control of air and everything related to that element . History and relationships . Shu was the loyal son of Ra , and fathered Geb ( the earth ) and Nut ( the sky ) with his sister - wife Tefnut . As the embodiment of the atmosphere , he held his two children apart by the command of Ra to prevent them from having more offspring after the birth of Isis , Set , Osiris , and Nephthys . When the deities were asked by Ao through the intervention of Ptah to assist their worshipers who had been abducted by the Imaskari to Toril , Shu stayed behind together with Tefnut and Nut at the command of Ra . Worshipers . While Shu was never worshiped by the Mulan of Toril , some of the djinn of Zakhara payed homage to him , and he had a mosque at their Citadel of Ice and Steel .

title: Shudu - Ab
description: Shudu - Ab Shudu - Ab was a cleric of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and 1374 DR . History . Originally Shudu - Ab was the right hand of high priestess Tiglath but broke with her in search of power .
description_long: Shudu - Ab Shudu - Ab was a cleric of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and 1374 DR . History . Originally Shudu - Ab was the right hand of high priestess Tiglath but broke with her in search of power . After Tiglath ' s disappearance during the Godswar Shudu - Ab became the new high priestess . However she and all her followers were in Unthalass during the Mulhorand ' s attack to that city and she was presumed dead like her followers while the resurfaced Tilgath regained her position . However Shudu - Ab was still alive and in 1374 she was waiting the right time to reappear and regain her power . Personality . Shudu - Ab saw the church of Tiamat only as a mean to gain power she planned to kill Tiglath and rule Unther as representative of Tiamat .

title: Shugenja
description: Shugenja Shugenja ( also spelled shukenja ) were wielders of divine magic who controlled elemental forces . In Shou Lung , shugenja were called dang - ki . Shugenja were the priests of their cultures .
description_long: Shugenja Shugenja ( also spelled shukenja ) were wielders of divine magic who controlled elemental forces . In Shou Lung , shugenja were called dang - ki . Shugenja were the priests of their cultures . Like samurai , shugenja were members of the noble class , but unlike samurai , they did not follow the code of " bushido " .

title: Shulgi
description: Shulgi Shulgi was a vampire thief in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Shulgi was a thief in Cormyr until exploring a ruin met a vampire that turned shulgi also in a vampire .
description_long: Shulgi Shulgi was a vampire thief in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Shulgi was a thief in Cormyr until exploring a ruin met a vampire that turned shulgi also in a vampire . Years later the adventuring company of the Destroyers of Ghosts killed his master , setting Shulgi free . He escaped east finally settling in Messemprar . There he posed as a retired businessman but in truth thieving . He never drunk blood from a human but instead from buyer livestock . Activities . Shulgi was slowly organizing a thieves ' guild in the city . However with the recent turmoils in Unther he stated thought to relocate to Chessenta . Personality . Shulgi was a no - so - evil vampire . However if someone really annoyed him , he would kill him very slowly . He truly enjoyed thieving . He never create an other vampire , remembering the poor treatment from his master .

title: Shur
description: Shur Shur was a powerful human mage who actively opposed violence against nature . Description . Shur had a stern and wrinkled face , framed by long locks of gray and white - streaked hair .
description_long: Shur Shur was a powerful human mage who actively opposed violence against nature . Description . Shur had a stern and wrinkled face , framed by long locks of gray and white - streaked hair . She was dressed in flowing red robes , covered with a black cloak . Personality . A self - appointed protector of the wild , in particular tree s , Shur was abhorred by the destruction of nature . She considered such acts evil , and used her considerable magical talents to both find and stop them . Possessions . Among Shur ' s possessions were a " cloak of protection " and a " ring of mind shielding " , as well as a " gem of insight " .

title: Shurdriira Helviiryn
description: Shurdriira Helviiryn Shurdriira Helviiryn was the head of the College of Alteration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , Shurdriira agreed with the proposal of Master Guldor Zauviir to elevate T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic , to be a new member of the Conclave .
description_long: Shurdriira Helviiryn Shurdriira Helviiryn was the head of the College of Alteration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , Shurdriira agreed with the proposal of Master Guldor Zauviir to elevate T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic , to be a new member of the Conclave . After Q ' arlynd Melarn ' s revelation that only Lolth ' s worshipers could practice Bae ' qeshel , she withdrew her support of Master Guldor ' s proposal .

title: Shuriken
description: Shuriken A shuriken was a small bladed throwing weapon . Description . A piece of sharpened metal , there were many sizes and shapes in use , but there were three main kinds of shuriken : the spike , the small star , and the large star .
description_long: Shuriken A shuriken was a small bladed throwing weapon . Description . A piece of sharpened metal , there were many sizes and shapes in use , but there were three main kinds of shuriken : the spike , the small star , and the large star . The spike was simply a large pin that tapered to a sharp point . A star could have three to eight razor - edged points ; the design ensured that at least one point would strike a target . Uses . A shuriken could only be used as a throwing weapon , thrown with the hand , and was not used in melee . It inflicted small piercing injuries . Their effective range was quiet short ; typically 10 feet ( 3 meters ) . Owing to their small size , shuriken were easy to conceal , being tucked within sashes of folds of clothing . The spike shuriken could even be worn as a pin in the hair . Training . The shuriken was an exotic weapon that required special training to use effectively . It was commonly wielded by monk s , who could use it with their special martial arts techniques . However , they were primarily used by ninja .

title: Shuruppak
description: Shuruppak Lord Shuruppak , or " the Reaper " , was the once - Chosen of Gilgeam and the deity ' s deadly right hand . After Gilgeam was slain , Shuruppak became a wandering murderer , killing many in the name of Unther . Description .
description_long: Shuruppak Lord Shuruppak , or " the Reaper " , was the once - Chosen of Gilgeam and the deity ' s deadly right hand . After Gilgeam was slain , Shuruppak became a wandering murderer , killing many in the name of Unther . Description . Shuruppak dressed in black robes and concealed the top half of his face in an infamous red half - mask in the shape of a skull he skillfully wielded a wickedly sharp greatsword . Personality . In Shuruppak ' s mind , he truly was " the Reaper " , a moniker he attained while serving Gilgeam . History . During Shurupprak ' s long service to Gilgeam he only failed him once . After being ordered to bring in the Enclave , a powerful cabal of wizards based in the Greenfields , Shuruppak managed to kill several of their members before being driven back . In 1357 DR , Shuruppak tried to quell rioting in Messemprar by taking hostages and staging public executions of them . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , Shuruppak ' s god Gilgeam was slain by Tiamat . With Gilgeam ' s death , Shuruppak was stripped of his Chosen status and lost what remained of his sanity , going rogue .

title: Shussel
