description: Shussel Shussel is a small city on the Alamber Sea in Unther . In 1370 DR , in an event called " the Vanishing " , a mysterious fog descended upon the city and overnight , ninety percent of the city ' s inhabitants vanished . They have not been heard from since .
description_long: Shussel Shussel is a small city on the Alamber Sea in Unther . In 1370 DR , in an event called " the Vanishing " , a mysterious fog descended upon the city and overnight , ninety percent of the city ' s inhabitants vanished . They have not been heard from since . The sudden underpopulation and abundance of homes brought squatters and bandits . The city is now under Mulhorand i control , with a heavy guard . The Mulhorandi use the port to bring in supplies for their war effort against Unther . Shussel has its own supply of iron from nearby mines but the supply is known to be dwindling . The fields to the north of the city have been overfarmed and turned to sandy , poor conditions as a result .

title: Shutep
description: Shutep Shutep of Jhalhoran was a resourceful thief in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Shutep thieved from the tombs of the god - kings .
description_long: Shutep Shutep of Jhalhoran was a resourceful thief in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Shutep thieved from the tombs of the god - kings . He was a master of deceiving foreign adventuring parties : Shutep convinced them to break inside a tomb in the Land of the Dead and later escaped alone with the greatest treasure . He was a master impersonator . Personality . Shutep was greedy and sometimes a coward but not evil .

title: Shuushar
description: Shuushar Shuushar the Awakaned was a kuo - toa hermit and mystic who was captured by the drow during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Shuushar was a calm and peaceful presence .
description_long: Shuushar Shuushar the Awakaned was a kuo - toa hermit and mystic who was captured by the drow during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Shuushar was a calm and peaceful presence . Despite his people ' s propensity for madness , his years of seclusion and meditation had , in his words , cleared him of that legacy . He was also a complete pacifist . He didn ' t fight or cause harm to any other creature , even refusing to defend himself or others . History . Shuushar was a monk who hailed from Sloobludop but wandered the Underdark for many years in order to fulfill his training . During the late 1480s DR , Shuushar had attained enlightenment and decided to return to Sloobludop to teach his fellows , but was instead captured by drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Shyarn Feng
description: Shyarn Feng Shyarn Feng was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung in 1358 . History . Born in Wa K ' an province in Shou Lung , Shyarn Feng grew up at the Blue Stork monastery .
description_long: Shyarn Feng Shyarn Feng was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung in 1358 . History . Born in Wa K ' an province in Shou Lung , Shyarn Feng grew up at the Blue Stork monastery . He quickly became a sohei and his first mission was to recover the temple ' s minyarn ( an altar containing holy texts and the remains of the monastery ' s founder ) . which had been stolen by some bandits . He led a squad of sohei and recovered the minyarn but only after it lost its power and all his companions died , the last placing upon Shyarn a curse : he would never be a leader of men again until he had received the forgiveness and blessing of the gods . Shyarn started traveling to Shou Lung , working for various followers of the Path of Enlightenment in order to redeem himself but always something went wrong . In 1358 DR , he was searching for a divine sign from the Celestial Bureaucracy when he was possibly approached by Ko Ho San . Personality . His monk teachers taught him to be very stoic and more reserved and puritan than others . His misfortunes had also made Shyarn very fatalistic . Relationship .

title: Shyntlara Auvryndar
description: Shyntlara Auvryndar Shyntlara Auvryndar was a drow vampire and matron mother of House Auvryndar . History . In 1370 DR , matron mother Shyntlara was a member of the city ' s ruling council .
description_long: Shyntlara Auvryndar Shyntlara Auvryndar was a drow vampire and matron mother of House Auvryndar . History . In 1370 DR , matron mother Shyntlara was a member of the city ' s ruling council . Being in the favor of Lolth , she was able to maintain her position despite her rivals fearing she would create a vampire army . However , she found that she was only able to create vampires from drow that had failed the test of Lolth but had not yet been transformed into drider s . She held that secret close to her heart and revealed it to no one .

title: Shyok Muren
description: Shyok Muren The Shyok Muren was a small river found in Khazari . Geography . The Shyok Muren originated within a branch of the Katakoro Shan mountains in southeastern Khazari .
description_long: Shyok Muren The Shyok Muren was a small river found in Khazari . Geography . The Shyok Muren originated within a branch of the Katakoro Shan mountains in southeastern Khazari . It flowed northwest down from the mountains through central Khazari , passing by the capital of Skarou before joining with the mighty Jumpa River . Description . The Shyok Muren was 75 miles ( 120 km ) long .

title: Shyr
description: Shyr Shyr was a continent on the planet of Abeir . It was the equivalent in that world to the Toril ian continent of Faerûn . Geography .
description_long: Shyr Shyr was a continent on the planet of Abeir . It was the equivalent in that world to the Toril ian continent of Faerûn . Geography . Akanûl was once part of Shyr , until it was exchanged with parts of the lands of Chondath and western Chessenta , which in turn became part of that Abeiran continent . For a time , the lands of Unther were also part of this continent . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p94 " > < / ref > Inhabitants . Its known inhabitants were genasi and Primordial s , such as Karshimis , who was the last known ruler of the continent before the Spellplague transported Akanûl to Toril . For a time , the second incarnation of Gilgeam was also an inhabitant of Shyr . Organizations . The Anarchs of Shyr were an arcane order tasked with the protection of the Shyran population .

title: Shyressa
description: Shyressa Shyressa was a female vampire and a member of the Twisted Rune . She slew the vampire that created her and began to study magic . She gained a Runemaster seat in the 1360s DR .
description_long: Shyressa Shyressa was a female vampire and a member of the Twisted Rune . She slew the vampire that created her and began to study magic . She gained a Runemaster seat in the 1360s DR . She enjoyed playing cat - and - mouse games with people who drew her attention . She created many fire spells that give off dark flames in order to be more subtle in the night hours when she was active .

title: Shyuk Glacier
description: Shyuk Glacier The Shyuk Glacier was a large glacier nestled within the steep peaks of the Katakoro Shan mountain range in southern Ra - Khati . Geography . The glacier measured roughly 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length and 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide at its farthest points .
description_long: Shyuk Glacier The Shyuk Glacier was a large glacier nestled within the steep peaks of the Katakoro Shan mountain range in southern Ra - Khati . Geography . The glacier measured roughly 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length and 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide at its farthest points . As of 1367 DR it had begun to creep out of the mountains into the foothills bordering the northern boundary of the Wild Yak Meadows and Katakoro Plateau .

title: SiNafay Hun ' ett
description: SiNafay Hun ' ett SiNafay Hun ' ett was Matron of House Hun ' ett for many years . Thinking House Do ' Urden posed a threat , she attacked it with the help of Bregan D ' aerthe . With Jarlaxle ' s betrayal , her house was defeated and punished by the ruling council of Menzoberranzan .
description_long: SiNafay Hun ' ett SiNafay Hun ' ett was Matron of House Hun ' ett for many years . Thinking House Do ' Urden posed a threat , she attacked it with the help of Bregan D ' aerthe . With Jarlaxle ' s betrayal , her house was defeated and punished by the ruling council of Menzoberranzan . After that , Matron Hun ' ett became a member of House Do ' Urden under her new name , Shi ' nayne Do ' Urden . She was tricked and sacrificed to Lolth by Matron Malice Do ' Urden for the Zin - carla ritual of Zaknafein . She was particularly diminutive , even by drow standards , standing just over four feet tall .

title: Siamorphe
description: Siamorphe The current Siamorphe ( pronounced " SIGH - a - morf " or " SEE - a - morf " ) usually appears as an older lady of the nobility , her hair touched with grey but well kept , and her iron - gray eyes missing nothing . Her clothing shows the jeweled purple of the true nobility , with a silver chalice and adamantine scepter in her hands , and a tiara carved from a single diamond on her brow . Siamorphe is the vessel of a semi - divine power , which is passed down to a successor when the successor is dying .
description_long: Siamorphe The current Siamorphe ( pronounced " SIGH - a - morf " or " SEE - a - morf " ) usually appears as an older lady of the nobility , her hair touched with grey but well kept , and her iron - gray eyes missing nothing . Her clothing shows the jeweled purple of the true nobility , with a silver chalice and adamantine scepter in her hands , and a tiara carved from a single diamond on her brow . Siamorphe is the vessel of a semi - divine power , which is passed down to a successor when the successor is dying . The current Siamorphe is the latest in that lineage . By preference , the successor is a direct descendant of the previous power ’ s mortal form , but anyone of noble blood will suffice . The former Siamorphe was a nobleman of Baldur ' s Gate , who passed the power to Lady Siamorphe of Waterdeep , chosen when she was killed in a riot in the Year of the Dusty Throne ( 1256 DR ) . Her portfolio is providing the Divine Right of nobility to rule , and encouraging the responsibility to rule well and wisely for the more common classes beneath them .

title: Siangham
description: Siangham A siangham is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The siangham looks like a heavy metal arrow with a hilt or handle where the feathers would be .
description_long: Siangham A siangham is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The siangham looks like a heavy metal arrow with a hilt or handle where the feathers would be . It is about a foot and a half ( 46cm ) long with a piercing tip . An average siangham costs 3gp and weighs 1lb ( 0 . 45kg ) . Weaponology . It takes special training to use a siangham in melee combat , therefore it is considered an exotic weapon . While normally used for thrusting attacks , it can be used to slash or parry .

title: Sibyl
description: Sibyl Sibyl was a half - fiend yuan - ti abomination who was an avatar of Sseth during the Time of Troubles and who wanted to become a god . Sibyl had four arms and a set of wings , which was unusual for common yuan - ti . She was ink black with clawed hands .
description_long: Sibyl Sibyl was a half - fiend yuan - ti abomination who was an avatar of Sseth during the Time of Troubles and who wanted to become a god . Sibyl had four arms and a set of wings , which was unusual for common yuan - ti . She was ink black with clawed hands . Magical Abilities . Sibyl was proficient — much more so than normal yuan - ti — in the " fear " spell . Worshipers . Sibyl was worshiped by the Se ' Sehen tribe , which lived in South Faerûn , and was also worshiped by Medusanna of House Mhairdaul .

title: Sickle
description: Sickle The sickle is a farm implement slightly modified and strengthened to make a simple , light melee weapon . Description . This weapon is like a farmer ' s sickle commonly used to harvest grains .
description_long: Sickle The sickle is a farm implement slightly modified and strengthened to make a simple , light melee weapon . Description . This weapon is like a farmer ' s sickle commonly used to harvest grains . It has a handle to which is attached a blade that is curved in more or less a semicircle , coming to a sharp point . The cutting edge is on the inside of the curve . The whole weapon resembles a large question mark ( " ? " ) between 1 and 2 feet ( 30 and 60cm ) tall . An average sickle costs 6gp and weighs 2lbs ( 0 . 9kg ) . Weaponology . Combat sickles evolved from the working tool . Very common in farming communities , the inconspicuous nature of the weapon makes it an ideal choice for those areas where peasants are forbidden to own weapons . The sickle is favored by druid s and any peasant who wants to carry a weapon yet have a chance to remain inconspicuous . Because of its shape , the sickle can also be used in trip attacks . As with all light weapons , it can be used with finesse by dexterous individuals . Over the years , several design improvements have been made .

title: Siege of Darkness
description: Siege of Darkness Siege of Darkness is the third book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Siege of Darkness Siege of Darkness is the third book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book nine of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . In the first part of the book , the dwarves of Clan Battlehammer in Mithral Hall are preparing to face a drow attack from Menzoberranzan . Drizzt Do ' Urden and Catti - brie are tasked with securing the alliance of the barbarians of Settlestone . Catti - brie has to beat their leader Berkthgar the Bold in a duel in order to convince him . In the meantime in Menzoberranzan the very air seems to whisper of something big to happen . House Baenre is afraid of a conspiracy against them by the other houses ; they fear that they may have lost the favor of Lolth . The svirfneblin of Blingdenstone also feel something in the air . We learn that the Spider Queen fears she might be unable to keep an eye on Menzoberranzan for a time and she asks the demon Errtu to take her place . In the second part of the book , the effects of the Time of Troubles present themselves , with magic going awry .

title: Siege of Menzoberranzan
description: Siege of Menzoberranzan The Siege of Menzoberranzan was a siege of the drow city of Menzoberranzan by the combined forces of Horgar Steelshadow of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scoured Legion with the secret backing of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Background . Slave uprising .
description_long: Siege of Menzoberranzan The Siege of Menzoberranzan was a siege of the drow city of Menzoberranzan by the combined forces of Horgar Steelshadow of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scoured Legion with the secret backing of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Background . Slave uprising . During the Silence of Lolth , which began on Eleint 28 , 1372 DR , the goddess Lolth did not answer any of her supplicants , nor were her clerics able to cast any spells or otherwise use divine magic . Menzoberranzan , a matriarchal order ruled by Lolthite priestesses , was naturally in a perilous position . Priestesses were ordered by Matron Mother Triel Baenre not to speak of the Silence , but word nevertheless got out . A group of renegade male drow , led by the alhoon Syrzan ( likely with support from the Jaezred Chaulssin ) , instigated an uprising of slaves and " undercreatures " on Marpenoth 20 . This group , which used stonefire as a weapon , damaged the city and forced the slaughter of a large number of slaves . Battle of the Pillars of Woe .

title: Sigil
description: Sigil Sigil ( pronounced / ' sɪg . ɪl / ) , also frequently known as the Cage or the City of Doors , is a city - state and the supposed center of the multiverse which includes the Prime Material Plane and all other known plane s according to some forms of the Great Wheel cosmology . People coming to Sigil from the Prime Material Plane are often treated as clueless inferiors by the planar elitists who dwell there .
description_long: Sigil Sigil ( pronounced / ' sɪg . ɪl / ) , also frequently known as the Cage or the City of Doors , is a city - state and the supposed center of the multiverse which includes the Prime Material Plane and all other known plane s according to some forms of the Great Wheel cosmology . People coming to Sigil from the Prime Material Plane are often treated as clueless inferiors by the planar elitists who dwell there . They are thus widely referred to as " the Clueless " , " berks " or more charitably , as " Primes " . It is highly recommended that planewalker s new to Sigil employ a guide , known locally as a " tout , " lest they be taken advantage of or mugged . Such guides can be little better themselves , though , either serving to persuade a traveler to the side of their faction or simply robbing their " customer " once their back is turned . Geography . Sigil is located inside of the Outlands , a plane at equal distance from each of the Outer Planes , hovering above an immensely tall landmark known as the Spire that sits at the plane ' s center .

title: Sigil Fernel
description: Sigil Fernel Sigil Fernel was a necromancer inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . To say Sigil Fernel was cruel was putting things mildly .
description_long: Sigil Fernel Sigil Fernel was a necromancer inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . To say Sigil Fernel was cruel was putting things mildly . As a boy he probably enjoyed tearing the wings off of flies and replacing them with parts from other insects , all before attempting to bring them back to life . This early trait translated well into his adult life . Abilities . Sigil possessed considerable necromantic skill and probably a degree of surgical prowess as well . Possessions . Among Sigil ' s wide array of magical items were a " wand of lightning " , " boots of speed " , " ring of monster summoning III " , and " bracers of defense AC 3 " . Activities . Nothing pleased Sigil more than constructing his own horrifying reanimated creations from the body parts of many creatures .

title: Sign of the Shield
description: Sign of the Shield The Sign of the Shield was an inn in Voonlar that catered to travelers looking for luxurious accommodations . Location . The grand inn was on the south side of Shind Road , facing the Shield Trading Company across the street .
description_long: Sign of the Shield The Sign of the Shield was an inn in Voonlar that catered to travelers looking for luxurious accommodations . Location . The grand inn was on the south side of Shind Road , facing the Shield Trading Company across the street . A short way towards the southwest was the intersection of Shind Road with Daerndrean Street . Structure . The Shield was the largest building in Voonlar , topping four stories with a hipped slate roof and an imposing stone facade that resembled a temple edifice . Four massive stone pillars framed the entrance and supported a large third - floor balcony that sheltered the entrance below and provided a venue with an impressive view . The rectangular building extended deeper than it was wide , except for the fourth floor which ended halfway back . The rest of the fourth floor was a rooftop herb garden and sunning area used by the staff . To the west , a large stable building provided shelter for animals and lockable sheds for storage of wagons and carriages . To the east was a well - tended lawn that was framed by a tall cedar hedge and a row of apple trees . The columns were covered with ivy and flowering vines that hid signs of aging .

title: Sigurd
description: Sigurd Sigurd was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . History . Sigurd was a warrior of Earthfast and an ally of the Harpers .
description_long: Sigurd Sigurd was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . History . Sigurd was a warrior of Earthfast and an ally of the Harpers . He made a number of journeys to Rashemen . He toured its wilderness , seeing such sites as Lake Ashane , the High Country , Lake Tirulag , and the Urlingwood from afar , as well as the ruins of Citadel Rashemaar ( destroyed in 1360 DR ) . He also visited the cities of Immilmar and Kront . His guide on some of these travels was Ygsvar . On his travels , Sigurd spent a great deal of time with the Rashemaar and their berserker s , making many friends among them and growing quite fond of the people , their country , and their firewine . He decided he liked them because they were very dwarf - like , for their underground dwellings and their capacity for ale and firewine . Sigurd grew quite familiar with them and their ways . Sigurd wrote a report on Rashemen for the scribe Lhaeo Rhindaun . Lhaeo used it as part of his report on the Unapproachable East , sent to Lady Alustriel Silverhand of Silverymoon in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Personality .

title: Sika al - Bana
description: Sika al - Bana Sika al - Bana was a halfling who worked and cared for Hama Sayif within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sika played his pipes while Hama performed his splendid dances .
description_long: Sika al - Bana Sika al - Bana was a halfling who worked and cared for Hama Sayif within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sika played his pipes while Hama performed his splendid dances . He also took care off all haggling for Hama ' s customers . Relationships . Sika ' s mate was Bara Minora . Sika had been with Hama ever since he saved the lives of he and his mate in Al - Akara Mountains .

title: Sikak
description: Sikak Sikak was one of the rich Pearl Cities of Zakhara . History . The metropolis gained its wealth from its famous fishing industry generated from the coastal waters next to the city and nearby Maribar Island that teemed with all kinds of different fish .
description_long: Sikak Sikak was one of the rich Pearl Cities of Zakhara . History . The metropolis gained its wealth from its famous fishing industry generated from the coastal waters next to the city and nearby Maribar Island that teemed with all kinds of different fish . Sikak took its symbolic sobriquet " City of Coins " from the bigger fish ' s scales that resembled silver coins .

title: Sil ' zet Tlabbar
description: Sil ' zet Tlabbar Sil ' zet Tlabbar was the favorite daughter of Ghenni Tlabbar , matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Sil ' zet was the oldest and favorite daughter of Ghenni .
description_long: Sil ' zet Tlabbar Sil ' zet Tlabbar was the favorite daughter of Ghenni Tlabbar , matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Sil ' zet was the oldest and favorite daughter of Ghenni . In 1372 DR , Ghenni was targeted by Nimor Imphraezl of the Jaezred Chaulssin as part of his bargain with House Agrach Dyrr , who wanted Ghenni dead . Nimor infiltrated the Faen Tlabbar complex and unfortunately Sil ' zet was at her mother ' s side at that time , so Nimor killed both Ghenni and Sil ' zet .

title: Silakul
description: Silakul Silakul was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . Silakul was the leader of the Cult cell that assisted Dretchroyaster .
description_long: Silakul Silakul was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . Silakul was the leader of the Cult cell that assisted Dretchroyaster . History . In 1479 DR , the lair of Dretchroyaster was attacked by some adventurers and they defeated Silakul . Personality . A cunning and twisted individual , Silakul ' s goal was to unlock the true power of a dracolich and use it to increase the Cult ' s power over the Dalelands .

title: Silari Carver
description: Silari Carver Silari Carver was the mayor of the halfling city of Fasruil in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor of Fasruil , Silari was a wealthy farmer and landowner .
description_long: Silari Carver Silari Carver was the mayor of the halfling city of Fasruil in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor of Fasruil , Silari was a wealthy farmer and landowner . History . Silari served as a priestess of Yondalla in her past , but she left the clergy to focus on dealing with her land and duties as mayor .

title: Silas Broon
description: Silas Broon Silas Broon was a tavern owner of the Flagon and the Dragon in Skullport . Relationship . In his early mercenary days , Silas befriended a pseudodragon called Weeshrike , who went on to save his life numerous times and even now patrolled his master ' s place for potential minions of Dalagor .
description_long: Silas Broon Silas Broon was a tavern owner of the Flagon and the Dragon in Skullport . Relationship . In his early mercenary days , Silas befriended a pseudodragon called Weeshrike , who went on to save his life numerous times and even now patrolled his master ' s place for potential minions of Dalagor . History . Once Silas was a mercenary until he disagreed with Dalagor , earning him as an enemy . So he decided to stop fighting and become a tavern owner . Around 1370 DR , his tavern was well frequented by his former companions .

title: Silat
description: Silat Silats were shapeshifting hag s that roamed the wilderness of Zakhara . They would venture into the cities of the Land of Fate under magical disguise to search for food . Description .
description_long: Silat Silats were shapeshifting hag s that roamed the wilderness of Zakhara . They would venture into the cities of the Land of Fate under magical disguise to search for food . Description . Their true appearance was that of a giant humanoid female with pale green or blue skin . Their hair was a darker color of their skin . Curved ram horns sprouted from the side of their head . Older silats had longer horns with the horns growing a full spiral every century . A silat ’ s teeth and nails were yellow but harder than obsidian . No matter what form they took , silats always wore rags that barely concealed their skin . Combat . All silats possessed superhuman strength . They could attack with their claws or with a bite . Magical or iron weapons were needed to injure them and they were capable of regeneration . Silats were immune to poison and mind - influencing spell s . Silats could polymorph at will once they reached adulthood . Matriach silats , those older than five centuries , could also polymorph others . Habitat / Society . These usually solitary creatures could be found just about anywhere in Zakhara .

title: Silaviul Mountains
description: Silaviul Mountains The Silaviul Mountains were a mountain range in southeast Faerûn , and were an arm of the great Yehimal mountains . They separated the kingdom of Ulgarth and the barbarian lands to the east from the Utter East proper in the south . A river ran through the plains along the northern flank , before turning south in the Stony Waste and crossing through the mountains at their western end .
description_long: Silaviul Mountains The Silaviul Mountains were a mountain range in southeast Faerûn , and were an arm of the great Yehimal mountains . They separated the kingdom of Ulgarth and the barbarian lands to the east from the Utter East proper in the south . A river ran through the plains along the northern flank , before turning south in the Stony Waste and crossing through the mountains at their western end .

title: Silbran Obarskyr
description: Silbran Obarskyr Silbran Obarskyr was a queen of Cormyr . She took the crown after the death of her husband , Ulbaeram Obarskyr , so that she could protect her son Raerboth from his wicked aunt Gorauna . When her son came of age , the crown passed to him .
description_long: Silbran Obarskyr Silbran Obarskyr was a queen of Cormyr . She took the crown after the death of her husband , Ulbaeram Obarskyr , so that she could protect her son Raerboth from his wicked aunt Gorauna . When her son came of age , the crown passed to him .

title: Sildëyuir
description: Sildëyuir Sildëyuir is a region of the Feywild that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end . It is the home of the reclusive star , or mithral , elves , who constructed the realm nearly two thousand years ago by breaking it off from the Feywild and turning it into a demiplane of finite size . However , as a consequence of the Spellplague that erupted in 1385 DR , Sildëyuir has been rejoined with the Feywild .
description_long: Sildëyuir Sildëyuir is a region of the Feywild that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end . It is the home of the reclusive star , or mithral , elves , who constructed the realm nearly two thousand years ago by breaking it off from the Feywild and turning it into a demiplane of finite size . However , as a consequence of the Spellplague that erupted in 1385 DR , Sildëyuir has been rejoined with the Feywild . The plane has many of the same features and hills as the Yuirwood , and its borders match those of the Faerûnian forest . Sildëyuir is covered with dells with silver - boled trees and streams . Its forests are not as dense as the Yuirwood ’ s , and its trees are taller and more majestic with very little undergrowth . Phosphorescent grow on the silver - trunked trees , and unlike the humidity of the Yuirwood , the air of Sildëyuir is cool . At the borders of the demiplane , the forest grows thicker and thicker , and any track one follows or makes simply bends back on itself . Sildëyuir is in perpetual twilight .

title: Silence
description: Silence Silence is an illusion spell that creates an area where sound is negated . Effect . Upon the casting of this spell , complete silence prevails in the affected area .
description_long: Silence Silence is an illusion spell that creates an area where sound is negated . Effect . Upon the casting of this spell , complete silence prevails in the affected area . All sound is stopped : conversation is impossible , spells with verbal components cannot be cast , and no noise whatsoever issues from , enters , or passes through the area . The spell can be cast on a point in space , but the effect is stationary unless cast on a mobile object . The spell can be centered on a creature , and the effect then radiates from the creature and moves as it moves . An unwilling creature can attempt a Will save to negate the spell and can use SR , if any . Items in a creature ' s possession or magic items that emit sound receive saves and SR , and unattended objects and points in space do not . This spell provides a defense against or language - based attacks , such as " command " , harpy song , a " horn of blasting " , etc .

title: Silence , 15 ' radius
description: Silence , 15 ' radius Silence , 15 ' Radius was an alteration spell that created a zone of complete silence in a sphere of radius 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) . Effects .
description_long: Silence , 15 ' radius Silence , 15 ' Radius was an alteration spell that created a zone of complete silence in a sphere of radius 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) . Effects . This spell could be cast on an object , a creature , or into the air . If cast upon a creature , it had a chance to resist the spell and , if successful , the center of effect was placed one foot ( 30 cm ) behind the creature . All sounds were stopped at the source and no sound entered or exited the area of effect . Spells with verbal components could not be cast within the sphere of silence and sonic attacks such as a harpy ' s song were ineffective . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were necessary to cast this spell .

title: Silence of Lolth
description: Silence of Lolth The Silence of Lolth ( also know as the Wrath of Lolth ) was a period between 28 Eleasias 1372 DR and 28 Ches 1373 DR when Lolth stopped granting divine spells , would not respond to communions of any type , and stopped all physical planar travel to the Demonweb Pits in the Abyss . Description . In 1372 DR , the priestesses of Menzoberranzan discovered that the Spider Queen was no longer answering their calls .
description_long: Silence of Lolth The Silence of Lolth ( also know as the Wrath of Lolth ) was a period between 28 Eleasias 1372 DR and 28 Ches 1373 DR when Lolth stopped granting divine spells , would not respond to communions of any type , and stopped all physical planar travel to the Demonweb Pits in the Abyss . Description . In 1372 DR , the priestesses of Menzoberranzan discovered that the Spider Queen was no longer answering their calls . Some weeks after the Silence of Lolth began , Matron Mother Triel Baenre of Menzoberranzan tasked a group led by Quenthel Baenre to actively go out and discover why the goddess was not answering their calls and whether others in different cities were suffering the same fate or whether it was just Menzoberranzan that was affected . The expedition found that all followers of Lolth were affected and that Lolth was alive but locked away in her domain . The souls of Lolth ' s worshipers were unable to meet her and waited for months aimlessly in the Astral Plane . The expedition eventually discovered the full truth : Lolth had removed the Demonweb Pits to its own planar space and was seeking a " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) to complete her transformation .

title: Silent Rain
description: Silent Rain Silent Rain were an elven mercenary company based in Evereska . Tactics . The Silent Rain were a group of archers that destroyed all enemies with their arrows .
description_long: Silent Rain Silent Rain were an elven mercenary company based in Evereska . Tactics . The Silent Rain were a group of archers that destroyed all enemies with their arrows . Contracts . The Silent Rain charged 100 gold piece s per week for their services . They were however interested only in contacts that would advance elven causes or destroy humanoid s .

title: Silent Sail
description: Silent Sail The Silent Sail was a merchant guild operating in the Cormyrean city of Marsember . The group took its name from the Marsemban slang word for a ship whose ownership could not be traced . Membership consisted of eleven aging Marsemban merchants who made their fortunes in the shipping trade .
description_long: Silent Sail The Silent Sail was a merchant guild operating in the Cormyrean city of Marsember . The group took its name from the Marsemban slang word for a ship whose ownership could not be traced . Membership consisted of eleven aging Marsemban merchants who made their fortunes in the shipping trade . The guild was active in smuggling and secretly controlled several Sembian trading companies .

title: Silent Sword
description: Silent Sword The Silent Sword was an inn found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a much quieter place than the Happy Hippocampus .
description_long: Silent Sword The Silent Sword was an inn found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a much quieter place than the Happy Hippocampus . It had good quality service and moderate prices . A number of small " bed - and - beer " houses huddled around it .

title: Silent shoes
description: Silent shoes Silent shoes were special footwear used by some rogue s . Uses . Creaking shoes were a thieve ' s nightmare .
description_long: Silent shoes Silent shoes were special footwear used by some rogue s . Uses . Creaking shoes were a thieve ' s nightmare . Silent shoes were soled with a rare flexible material found deep within the jungles of Chult . This substance eliminates any sound created by old leather from typical shoes or boots . These shoes were useful for minimizing noise when travelling within cities as well as natural habitats . Prices . A pair of silent shoes cost 10 gold .

title: Silixia
description: Silixia Silixia was a young brass dragon in the Gray Vale sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s , DR Silixia noticed that the nearby stone giant s had become aggressive , so she started helping all the people to flee the vale .
description_long: Silixia Silixia was a young brass dragon in the Gray Vale sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s , DR Silixia noticed that the nearby stone giant s had become aggressive , so she started helping all the people to flee the vale .

title: Silk Road
description: Silk Road The Silk Road was the primary overland trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Description . Beginning in Dhaztanar in Semphar , and ending in Yenching in Shou Lung , the Silk Road was the major trade route that connected the eastern lands of Kara - Tur to the western lands of Faerun , and was where most of the goods that traveled between the two areas passed .
description_long: Silk Road The Silk Road was the primary overland trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Description . Beginning in Dhaztanar in Semphar , and ending in Yenching in Shou Lung , the Silk Road was the major trade route that connected the eastern lands of Kara - Tur to the western lands of Faerun , and was where most of the goods that traveled between the two areas passed . Due to its shorter length , and the larger number of villages along it , the Silk Road was more preferred over the northern Spice Road . The greater amount of civilization meant the roads were better patrolled , and bandits were less of a problem than on the more open northern roads . The area between Semphar and Khazari , specifically the Howling Gap area , was the most dangerous part of the trip . It was customary to hire additional guards before passing through this area , only to dismiss them once out of the region . Locations along the Silk Road included :

title: Silk bodysuit
description: Silk bodysuit Silk bodysuits were used by some rogue s to eliminate noise generated from armor and clothing . Uses . Silk bodysuits were typically black and made from a special fabric imported from Maztica .
description_long: Silk bodysuit Silk bodysuits were used by some rogue s to eliminate noise generated from armor and clothing . Uses . Silk bodysuits were typically black and made from a special fabric imported from Maztica . They helped the wearer to remain quiet and blend with the shadows . The only draw - back from wearing a silk bodysuit is that they could not be worn with armor , leaving the wearer vulnerable if they were discovered . Prices . A silk bodysuit could be purchased for 10 gold .

title: Silke Rosena
description: Silke Rosena Silke Rosena was a talented musician and entertainer living in Beregost . History . Silke was a musician in Beregost but she usually used her talents to manipulate others into doing her will .
description_long: Silke Rosena Silke Rosena was a talented musician and entertainer living in Beregost . History . Silke was a musician in Beregost but she usually used her talents to manipulate others into doing her will . At one point , at Feldepost ' s Inn , she tricked Glayde , Faltis , and Tessilan but they later realized the cheat and began searching for her . For her own protection , Silke manipulated her new " fiancee " Garrick ; Garrick involved Gorion ' s Ward in the situation . At the meeting point , Silke asked Garrick and Gorion ' s Ward to kill Glayde , Faltis , and Tessilan , saying that they were thugs . However , Gorion ' s Ward realized her lies and in the fighting Silke was killed .

title: Silkroot
description: Silkroot Silkroot , also known as Knight ' s Veil or Styxroot , was a stimulant that improved the reflexes and caused temporary euphoria . Geography . The root was found growing wild in Akanûl .
description_long: Silkroot Silkroot , also known as Knight ' s Veil or Styxroot , was a stimulant that improved the reflexes and caused temporary euphoria . Geography . The root was found growing wild in Akanûl . Unfortunately , Silkroot was addictive and eventually ate through the stomach of users . Silkroot addicts could be weaned off the drug by chewing on the leaves of the plant .

title: Silkstone
description: Silkstone Silkstone was a fibrous variety of similar to tiger eye . Description . This ornamental stone was found in many colors , yellow being the most common , and was cut , tumbled , or used for engravings such as seals for merchants and nobles .
description_long: Silkstone Silkstone was a fibrous variety of similar to tiger eye . Description . This ornamental stone was found in many colors , yellow being the most common , and was cut , tumbled , or used for engravings such as seals for merchants and nobles . It exhibited faint highlights when light hit at certain angles . A typical stone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Like tiger eye , silkstone was worn as a protection from spirits , though this was more old wives ' tale than fact . However , shadow s were known to hesitate briefly when encountering someone wearing a silkstone , perhaps giving them time to flee . This property also made powdered silkstone a viable substitute component when casting spells related to life - energy drain and the restoration of those effects . It was also used in the creation of magical inks needed to make scrolls of those spells .

title: Silla
description: Silla Silla was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a region of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was briefly known as the Sillan Empire , covering all Choson , under the king of Silla in the early to mid – 14th century DR . Geography .
description_long: Silla Silla was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a region of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was briefly known as the Sillan Empire , covering all Choson , under the king of Silla in the early to mid – 14th century DR . Geography . Silla lay in the eastern and northern parts of the Koryo Peninsula , in the lands around the Vorkani Mountains , which were also known as the Sillan Mountains . It was bordered in the south - west along the Tumen River by the kingdom of Koguryo . Its northern reaches lay around Koje and Foo Nakar . History . Under the influence of a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest , Prince Du - yang of Silla fell in love with a plotting woman and was slain by her jealous husband . In the early 14th century , Silla was at war with both Koguyro and Saishu , under the then king of Silla . Instrumental in Silla ' s campaign was General Wanang Sun , a master of strategy who , even as he aided the king of Silla in overcoming the other kingdoms , plotted to become king himself and lay the foundation for a more secure and prosperous realm .

title: Silly Satyr
description: Silly Satyr The Silly Satyr was a tavern in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located by the western gate out of the city , on the Street of Shadows . Around 1358 DR , the Silly Satyr was notorious as being very wild and had a bad reputation .
description_long: Silly Satyr The Silly Satyr was a tavern in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located by the western gate out of the city , on the Street of Shadows . Around 1358 DR , the Silly Satyr was notorious as being very wild and had a bad reputation .

title: Silmarien Silverleaf
description: Silmarien Silverleaf Silmarien Silverleaf was a moon elf from the realm of Synnoria in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Silmarien dressed in a blue shirt , green pants , and tall , brown leather boots .
description_long: Silmarien Silverleaf Silmarien Silverleaf was a moon elf from the realm of Synnoria in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Silmarien dressed in a blue shirt , green pants , and tall , brown leather boots . Over her shoulders was draped a purple cloak , as well as her lengthy gray hair . Possessions . Among Silmarien ' s possessions were an ensorceled suit of chain mail , a magical long sword that made her more effective in combat versus giant s , a pair of " gauntlets of ogre power " , and a " girdle of many pouches " . Activities . In response to Synnoria ' s dwindling population , Silmarien took it upon herself to travel across Faerûn in search of male elves , hoping to attract some of them back to Synnoria for breeding .

title: Silnia
description: Silnia Silnia was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Silnia and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .
description_long: Silnia Silnia was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Silnia and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes . Powers . Silnia was tormented by terrible nightmares , which could affect other beings in the vicinity .

title: Silvanus
description: Silvanus Silvanus ( pronounced " sihl - VANN - us " ) , the Forest Father , was the god of nature , though formerly considered only the god of wild nature and druids . Silvanus was one of the oldest and most prominent deities in Faerûn , and the wilder counterpart to Chauntea the Earthmother . His worshipers protected places of nature from the encroachment of civilization with vigor and were implacable foes of industrious peoples .
description_long: Silvanus Silvanus ( pronounced " sihl - VANN - us " ) , the Forest Father , was the god of nature , though formerly considered only the god of wild nature and druids . Silvanus was one of the oldest and most prominent deities in Faerûn , and the wilder counterpart to Chauntea the Earthmother . His worshipers protected places of nature from the encroachment of civilization with vigor and were implacable foes of industrious peoples . Worshipers . The Church of Silvanus had a pervasive influence , especially across the continent of Faerûn . Non - worshipers often viewed the Church unfavorably due to its tendency to disrupt expansion into woodland , sometimes with violence . Examples of rituals for worship were entreaties for spells at sundown or in moonlight . The " Dryad Dance " was a replenishing ritual of wild , wayward dance that called out dryads to join the ritualists for mating . Most Silvanite clerics , sometimes referred to as Forest Masters , also functioned as druids or rangers . Relationships . Whilst having no superiors , Silvanus was a long - time ally of Chauntea , despite their clergies ' differences . He was also allied with Lathander .

title: Silvarren Longshank
description: Silvarren Longshank Silvarren Longshank was a priest of Helm in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Silvarren was a priest of Helm in Neverwinter .
description_long: Silvarren Longshank Silvarren Longshank was a priest of Helm in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Silvarren was a priest of Helm in Neverwinter . However his superior in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR ordered to him to re - opened the shrine in Red Larch . However he instead stopped at the Talking Troll tavern in Triboar , having lost faith in himself and in the decisions of his superiors . He tried to forgot his miser thank to alcohol

title: Silver
description: Silver Silver was a precious metal that was used all across Toril for a vast variety of purposes . Properties . ( most notably lycanthrope s ) were vulnerable to silver .
description_long: Silver Silver was a precious metal that was used all across Toril for a vast variety of purposes . Properties . ( most notably lycanthrope s ) were vulnerable to silver . Vampire s , bearded devil s , wraith s and wight s were also vulnerable to silver . Wizards from Aglarond never wore silver and were rumored to be vulnerable to silver . Applications . Silver was widely used in currency , weapons , armor , jewellery and magical items . It was sought after due its purity and beauty . Currency . Silver was commonly used in the form of coins all across the realm . The shape , size and value of these coins varied dependent on the time and place that they were from . Weapons and armor . Silver is often used in the production of items that relate to light and moon magic . The soldiers who protect the High Palace of Silverymoon wear suits of silver plate mail . Magic Items . During the Shoon Imperium , pure silver was used in the crafting of magic rings that enhanced the wearer ' s spellcasting ability . Treatment . Maintaining the shine on silver required polishing with a non - abrasive cloth . Scalewater Carp were known to be particularly good at polishing silver with their mouths .

title: Silver ( half - elf house )
description: Silver ( half - elf house ) The Silver house of half - elves was a noble house descended from the Yuir elves of the Yuirwood . They kept peaceful relations with the human s during the conflicts of the era . Silverhall in Velprintalar was the traditional family home .
description_long: Silver ( half - elf house ) The Silver house of half - elves was a noble house descended from the Yuir elves of the Yuirwood . They kept peaceful relations with the human s during the conflicts of the era . Silverhall in Velprintalar was the traditional family home . Around 1368 DR , Donya Silver was a sorceress and personal friend of the Simbul . Around this time , the house ' s members served in the Aglarond an army and traded with neighboring nations in east Faerûn .

title: Silver Ravens
description: Silver Ravens The Silver Ravens are the personal army created and utilized by Miklos Selkirk . Among their goals are to gather information , attain magical items and generally improve the image of Sembia abroad . It is for this reason that when Silver Ravens are working abroad they hide the coat - of - arms typically worn only while in Sembian lands .
description_long: Silver Ravens The Silver Ravens are the personal army created and utilized by Miklos Selkirk . Among their goals are to gather information , attain magical items and generally improve the image of Sembia abroad . It is for this reason that when Silver Ravens are working abroad they hide the coat - of - arms typically worn only while in Sembian lands . Leadership . Miklos sees the Ravens as his answer to the Harpers , with whom Sembia has regularly clashed . While he encourages paladin s and other honorable fighters to join their ranks , he knows that the reality they might need to undertake some dishonorable deeds to accomplish their goals . Ultimately though , all Miklos requires that his agents hold their loyalty to Sembia .

title: Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad
description: Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad The Silver Scimitar , as it was originally named , was commissioned by Amahl Shoon IV early in his reign as qysar of the Shoon Imperium . Sometime after his paranoia grew into insanity , it took on his appellation and became known as the Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad . It was made in conjunction with " Amahl ' s Mastering " , which allowed the wearer to command the " Silver Scimitar " to attack and defend without being held in the hand .
description_long: Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad The Silver Scimitar , as it was originally named , was commissioned by Amahl Shoon IV early in his reign as qysar of the Shoon Imperium . Sometime after his paranoia grew into insanity , it took on his appellation and became known as the Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad . It was made in conjunction with " Amahl ' s Mastering " , which allowed the wearer to command the " Silver Scimitar " to attack and defend without being held in the hand . The " Silver Scimirar " was considered one of the " Seven Swords of the Shoon " . Description . Among his many faults , Amahl IV was a poor swordsman with an unreliable memory . He commissioned a " sword of dancing " to be made in the form of a heavy , silver - plated scimitar and had his artificers add additional capabilities that could only be unlocked by the wearer of the " Mastering " . The command words to activate the three additional modes were clearly engraved on the hilt of the sword in the old Alzhedo dialect used in the Shoon court . To make it even more obvious , the active command word gave off a red glow to indicate which mode was in use , and perhaps to allow the sword to be seen in the dark .

title: Silver Stag
description: Silver Stag The office of Silver Stag was one of the High Heralds of the Heralds of Faerûn . At its inception , Silver Stag was charged with supporting the practice of heraldry in the lands of Impiltur , Thesk , Damara , and the independent cities of northeast Faerûn . Silver Stag was also tasked with maintaining and administering heraldry in lands east of the Inner Sea .
description_long: Silver Stag The office of Silver Stag was one of the High Heralds of the Heralds of Faerûn . At its inception , Silver Stag was charged with supporting the practice of heraldry in the lands of Impiltur , Thesk , Damara , and the independent cities of northeast Faerûn . Silver Stag was also tasked with maintaining and administering heraldry in lands east of the Inner Sea . The Silver Stag office was based out of the Stormspire in the center of the town of Songhal in Impiltur . History . In the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR , Ilvarthaele Everstone , once a scribe and loremaster in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast , was selected by the High Heralds to join them as a High Herald herself . She was also permitted to establish a new High Herald office , that of the Silver Stag , which she based in the Stormspire in Songhal near the end of that year . This was the first time a new High Herald post had been created in the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars since the Heralds had been founded in the Year of the Watching Helm , 992 DR .

title: Silver Stake
description: Silver Stake The Silver Stake is a lycanthrope - hunting organization based in a compound on the outskirts of Baldur ' s Gate . They number between twenty and thirty and attempt to capture and cure lycanthropes in the Western Heartlands . The organization is led by Karel Mahorne , an elderly priestess of Mielikki .
description_long: Silver Stake The Silver Stake is a lycanthrope - hunting organization based in a compound on the outskirts of Baldur ' s Gate . They number between twenty and thirty and attempt to capture and cure lycanthropes in the Western Heartlands . The organization is led by Karel Mahorne , an elderly priestess of Mielikki . Members . Many of the Silver Stake ' s members are those who have lost loved ones to lycanthropy and want to make a difference . These are mainly ranger s , fighter s and cleric s , and membership is open to anyone of good alignment who shares the organization ' s goals . The clerics in the organization will venerate Mielikki out of respect for Karel , but many actually worship Selûne . All members have at least one magically enhanced weapon and one silver weapon . Base . The compound consists of a shrine to Mielikki and a collection of lore on lycanthropy and its cures . It is manned by two acolytes , a priestess of Selûne , and guarded by a few men - at - arms . Gas bombs . The Silver Stake employ explosive devices packed with allergy - inducing materials that can weaken a lycanthrope so that it can be successfully captured . They are effective to about 15 feet ( 4 .

title: Silver Stake gas bombs
description: Silver Stake gas bombs A Silver Stake gas bomb is a unique invention used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . The creation was invented by the alchemist Dram Kallen of Baldur ' s Gate and the bombs are pressurized with a substance to which lycanthropes are allergic ( this varies with the type of lycanthrope although typically might be catnip or wolfsbane ) . When the bomb is thrown against a hard surface , it explodes and scatters the contents over a radius of around 15 ' ( 4 .
description_long: Silver Stake gas bombs A Silver Stake gas bomb is a unique invention used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . The creation was invented by the alchemist Dram Kallen of Baldur ' s Gate and the bombs are pressurized with a substance to which lycanthropes are allergic ( this varies with the type of lycanthrope although typically might be catnip or wolfsbane ) . When the bomb is thrown against a hard surface , it explodes and scatters the contents over a radius of around 15 ' ( 4 . 8m ) . The bombs look like small , tightly sealed leather or cloth pouches that faintly radiate abjuration magic . They can cause a severe reaction of coughing and sneezing in a lycanthrope for around a minute , after which the effects begin to subside , but usually remain for the next 24 hours .

title: Silver Sword of Gith
description: Silver Sword of Gith The Silver Sword of Gith is an artifact sacred to the Githyanki . It was the first and most powerful of the githyanki silver sword s and belonged to the Githyanki hero Gith . When Gith left her people to seek an alliance with Tiamat and never returned , the sword was lost .
description_long: Silver Sword of Gith The Silver Sword of Gith is an artifact sacred to the Githyanki . It was the first and most powerful of the githyanki silver sword s and belonged to the Githyanki hero Gith . When Gith left her people to seek an alliance with Tiamat and never returned , the sword was lost . Description . The Sword of Gith is a jagged - edged scimitar - like greatsword with a silver blade and golden hilt . Appearances . The sword is central to the plot of " Forgotten Realms : Demon Stone " , though the player does not find out why until the end of the game . The Slaad lord Ygorl desired the artifact to increase his own power . At the time , the sword was in the hands of Cireka , a Githyanki general . The two battled over it , pitting their armies against each other until their fight spilled over into Toril and Khelben Arunsun trapped them in a magical stone . When adventurers release the two , their fight resumes until Cireka is slain by the red dragon Caminus . Rannek of Nesmé retrieves the blade and uses it to help defeat Ygorl . He is concerned however , that the Githyanki will return to retrieve it at some point . Neverwinter Nights 2 .

title: Silver Tear
description: Silver Tear Silver Tear was one of the weapons of Tymora , the Faerûn ian goddess of good fortune . It was a " + 5 luck blade longsword " . It was not , however , her favored weapon ; that honor went to the coins that she used as " + 5 distance speed shuriken s " .
description_long: Silver Tear Silver Tear was one of the weapons of Tymora , the Faerûn ian goddess of good fortune . It was a " + 5 luck blade longsword " . It was not , however , her favored weapon ; that honor went to the coins that she used as " + 5 distance speed shuriken s " .

title: Silver Turban Legion
description: Silver Turban Legion The Silver Turban Legion , or the Feathers , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 250 djinni riding griffon s comprised the Silver Turban Legion .
description_long: Silver Turban Legion The Silver Turban Legion , or the Feathers , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 250 djinni riding griffon s comprised the Silver Turban Legion . Only females were permitted to join . Activities . The Silver Turban Legion served as shock troops for the djinn . Base of Operations . The Citadel of Ice and Steel within the Elemental Plane of Air served as base of all djinni military organizations .

title: Silver dragon
description: Silver dragon Silver dragons ( aka " shield dragons " ) are the second most powerful of the metallic dragon s , and are true friends to all . The silver dragon enjoys the company of human s and elves so much that it will often take the form of a human or elf and live among them for the majority of its life . It should be noted that silvers , like all dragons , believe themselves the most superior creatures in the world .
description_long: Silver dragon Silver dragons ( aka " shield dragons " ) are the second most powerful of the metallic dragon s , and are true friends to all . The silver dragon enjoys the company of human s and elves so much that it will often take the form of a human or elf and live among them for the majority of its life . It should be noted that silvers , like all dragons , believe themselves the most superior creatures in the world . However , apart from the ability to fly , which they enjoy greatly , they tend to prefer the physical forms of humanoids for everyday life . Physical description . At first glance , the silver dragon appears very similar to the white dragon . The wings are more curved than a white ' s though , and the silver has two talons on its wings rather than the single talon of most dragons . The silver dragon also has a beautiful frill that begins at the top of its head and flows all the way down its neck and body to the tip of the tail . The frill is silver towards the body , fading to a purple hue at the edge . They have two long , smooth silver horns with black tips , pointing up and back from the head .

title: Silver fire
description: Silver fire Silver fire is one of the special abilities the Chosen of Mystra are gifted with . Once per hour , a Chosen of Mystra can unleash from within his or her body a beam of magical whitish flame known as " silver fire " ( which is also used as a general name for the overall power invested in each of her Chosen by the goddess ) . This beam is 5 feet wide and can be made to extend as far as 70 feet if desired .
description_long: Silver fire Silver fire is one of the special abilities the Chosen of Mystra are gifted with . Once per hour , a Chosen of Mystra can unleash from within his or her body a beam of magical whitish flame known as " silver fire " ( which is also used as a general name for the overall power invested in each of her Chosen by the goddess ) . This beam is 5 feet wide and can be made to extend as far as 70 feet if desired . No magical or physical barrier has been discovered that can stand up against it , and the beam inflicts tremendous damage on all beings struck by it . Any nonliving object touched by the beam is utterly destroyed . An individual also can choose to expel the " silver fire " in the shape of a cloud that fills a cone - shaped area 5 feet in diameter at its base , up to 70 feet long , and up to 70 feet across at its widest . This silver cloud causes no damage , but banishes dead magic areas forever , instantly restoring such an area ' s connection with the Goddess of All Magic . This use of the " silver fire " is extremely rare , since Mystra considers it an emergency action only .

title: Silver spark
description: Silver spark Silver spark was a poison sometimes used by holy slayer assassin s of the Soft Whisper in Zakhara . Description . This poison was a radiant vapor .
description_long: Silver spark Silver spark was a poison sometimes used by holy slayer assassin s of the Soft Whisper in Zakhara . Description . This poison was a radiant vapor . Rumor stated that is was derived from distilled moonlight and bottled passion . It possessed a rich and musky aroma . Uses . Victims could not resist breathing deeply of this perfumed poison once a holy slayer offered it . Once inhaled , intense pain wracked the victim ' s body for several intense minutes .

title: Silverbark
description: Silverbark Silverbarks were a type of tree that grew in Faerûn . Descriptions . Silverbark trees were thin and rarely grew above 12 feet tall .
description_long: Silverbark Silverbarks were a type of tree that grew in Faerûn . Descriptions . Silverbark trees were thin and rarely grew above 12 feet tall . Their red wood was covered in loose silver bark . Their large leaves ( as large as human hands ) were deep red , waxy , and serrated with a point at the end . Usage . Silverbark sap , which was clear in color , was a mild antitoxin that could be eaten to to prevent some poisonings . Silverbark leaves were strong enough to be used to make bags and baskets . Natives of the High Moor used silverbark leaves to wrap and protect their food . Silverbark wood was light and brittle . It was sometimes used by the poor to make stakes . Locations . Silverbarks grew alongside birch es in swampy areas in Luruar .

title: Silverhair Knights
description: Silverhair Knights The Silverhair Knights , also called sin eaters , were an order of priests of the goddess Eilistraee , completely dedicated to the redemption and subsequent protection of drow followers of Lolth , Vhaeraun , and other deities of the Dark Seldarine . They fully embraced the teaching of Eilistraee about showing mercy and compassion , and fought dark elves using only nonlethal means , hoping to make them understand the error of their ways and choose a different life . Beliefs .
description_long: Silverhair Knights The Silverhair Knights , also called sin eaters , were an order of priests of the goddess Eilistraee , completely dedicated to the redemption and subsequent protection of drow followers of Lolth , Vhaeraun , and other deities of the Dark Seldarine . They fully embraced the teaching of Eilistraee about showing mercy and compassion , and fought dark elves using only nonlethal means , hoping to make them understand the error of their ways and choose a different life . Beliefs . Silverhair Knights vowed to never willingly kill any drow and were thus specifically trained at dealing nonlethal violence . They aimed to show to other dark elves the strength that could be found in compassion , and that living in peace , without the endless conflict and paranoia that ruled their society , was a concrete possibility . They hoped that other drow would see that the Silverhair Knights honestly meant them no harm , and so would feel safer about joining them . The Silverhair Knights believed that this could lead the drow to choose to abandon the teachings of Lolth and cleave to Eilistraee .

title: Silverhall
description: Silverhall Silverhall was the traditional home of the Silver family of half - elves in Velprintalar ( now known as Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . Description . Silverhall was a low airy building and one of the oldest in the city .
description_long: Silverhall Silverhall was the traditional home of the Silver family of half - elves in Velprintalar ( now known as Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . Description . Silverhall was a low airy building and one of the oldest in the city . It featured towers and large lawned grounds that contained numerous guest houses and gazebos .

title: Silverspear
description: Silverspear House Silverspear is a relatively small moon elf house . As of 1368 DR , its matriarch is Tyllaetha Silverspear . Many of its members become priest s or wizard s .
description_long: Silverspear House Silverspear is a relatively small moon elf house . As of 1368 DR , its matriarch is Tyllaetha Silverspear . Many of its members become priest s or wizard s . The house estate is located in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet , and unlike most structures in the city , its buildings were constructed by non - magical means . The estate is a mix of architectural styles . The house colours are silver and green .

title: Silverwood
description: Silverwood The Silverwood was a forest on the eastern borders of the Evermoors and to the west of the Nether Mountains . Description . The Silverwood was once part of the High Forest , but after centuries of logging , the woodcutters took most of the trees on both sides of the Evermoor Way , inflicting a deep wound to the heart of the forest .
description_long: Silverwood The Silverwood was a forest on the eastern borders of the Evermoors and to the west of the Nether Mountains . Description . The Silverwood was once part of the High Forest , but after centuries of logging , the woodcutters took most of the trees on both sides of the Evermoor Way , inflicting a deep wound to the heart of the forest . Bare hills covered with stumps and old fallen trees flanked this plain . The Silverwood survived thanks to its dark and tangled thickets and to its steep and dangerous ground . Many creatures from the Evermoors , including trolls , roamed these woods looking for food .

title: Silverwraith
description: Silverwraith Silverwraiths were incorporeal undead that could only be created in areas of particularly potent negative energy . Description . Appearing similar to ghost s , silverwraiths manifested as skeletal forms with hints of the clothing they wore in life .
description_long: Silverwraith Silverwraiths were incorporeal undead that could only be created in areas of particularly potent negative energy . Description . Appearing similar to ghost s , silverwraiths manifested as skeletal forms with hints of the clothing they wore in life . Their bodies were translucent and incorporeal , emitting a soft blue glow . A silverwraith lacked a physical form , so their ability to interact physically with the material plane was greatly limited . Along with the usual differences between incorporeal undead and the living , silverwraiths were also impervious to the effects of cold , electricity , and polymorph ing . Abilities . Silverwraiths were able to harm living creatures with the merest touch of their limbs and although they had a number of resistances and abilities they were especially potent against spellcasters . In addition , they still retained all the powers , experience , and special qualities they once had in life . Psychology . The personality and experience of a silverwraith was undiminished in undeath . History .

title: Silvery Sembian Snail
description: Silvery Sembian Snail The Silvery Sembian Snail was a tavern and festhall located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Housemaster Roond Asmyrk . History .
description_long: Silvery Sembian Snail The Silvery Sembian Snail was a tavern and festhall located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Housemaster Roond Asmyrk . History . The Silvery Sembian Snail was named after the Silvery She - Snail , who was actually a famous nightclub dancer from Sembia . The tavern was in business by 1358 DR . It was still in business " circa " 1369 DR , and quickly growing famous . After several drunken parties spread from the Snail and into the town and disturbed livestock , Lord Sarp Redbeard reprimanded Roond Asmyrk , who began to use sobering spells on patrons and developed more indoor entertainments . Famed traveler Volothamp Geddarm wrote about the business in " Volo ' s Guide to Cormyr " . Location . The tavern lay at the main crossroads with the Way of the Manticore on the eastern bank of Wheloon . Description . The Snail was a place of comfort , luxury and fun , with merry parties that could grow noisy . Services . The tavern had an impressive wine cellar that outdid those of many nobles and merchants of Cormyr , Sembia , and Waterdeep .

title: Silvery She - Snail
description: Silvery She - Snail The " Silvery She - Snail " was the stage - name of a famous nightclub dancer of Sembia . History . Her act was quite successful , thanks in part to a number of flying illusion spells developed by an archmage .
description_long: Silvery She - Snail The " Silvery She - Snail " was the stage - name of a famous nightclub dancer of Sembia . History . Her act was quite successful , thanks in part to a number of flying illusion spells developed by an archmage . This mage , powerful and reclusive , became so infatuated with the She - Snail that he kidnapped her . But he wooed her successfully and she retired sometime in the early 1360s DR to marry him . The Silvery Sembian Snail tavern in Wheloon , Cormyr , was named after the Silvery She - Snail .

title: Silverymoon
description: Silverymoon Silverymoon was the prime signatory state of the Confederation of the Silver Marches and therefore , viewed by many as the capital . It was ruled for centuries by High Lady Alustriel Silverhand , a powerful wizard and one of the Seven Sisters , some of the most powerful individuals on Faerûn and also Chosen of Mystra , the goddess of magic . In 1369 DR , Alustriel stepped down , paving the way for her trusted adviser Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade to ascend to the city ' s supreme office .
description_long: Silverymoon Silverymoon was the prime signatory state of the Confederation of the Silver Marches and therefore , viewed by many as the capital . It was ruled for centuries by High Lady Alustriel Silverhand , a powerful wizard and one of the Seven Sisters , some of the most powerful individuals on Faerûn and also Chosen of Mystra , the goddess of magic . In 1369 DR , Alustriel stepped down , paving the way for her trusted adviser Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade to ascend to the city ' s supreme office . She is now the leader of the entire confederation . Silverymoon was often dubbed " the Gem of the North " , for it resembled and emulated the ( formerly ) lost elven city of Myth Drannor in many respects . It was one of the few civilized places in the middle of the rough and untamed wilderness that was the North of Faerûn . It had a rich cultural life and was renowned as a meeting place for all races that were morally inclined towards good . Even the occasional drow with good intentions ( most notably the famous ranger Drizzt Do ' Urden ) could eventually find hospitality in the city of Silverymoon .

title: Silverymoon Pass
description: Silverymoon Pass The Silverymoon Pass separated the two sections of the western end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The road from Silverymoon to Sundabar passed through the Silverymoon Pass .
description_long: Silverymoon Pass The Silverymoon Pass separated the two sections of the western end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The road from Silverymoon to Sundabar passed through the Silverymoon Pass . Description . The pass was a narrow and deep valley of jagged rocks and dark bramble bush . In the shadow of the highest peaks , heaps of snow laid all the year on the southern side . The road was often closed for threatening avalanches during the winter . Patrols from Silverymoon and Sundabar regularly walked across this road .

title: Silverymoon Pass road
description: Silverymoon Pass road The Silverymoon Pass road linked Silverymoon to Sundabar and was 165 miles long . Starting at Silverymoon the road passed by Khelb before entering Silverymoon Pass . The road exited Silverymoon Pass at Auvandell , and continued on to terminate at Sundabar .
description_long: Silverymoon Pass road The Silverymoon Pass road linked Silverymoon to Sundabar and was 165 miles long . Starting at Silverymoon the road passed by Khelb before entering Silverymoon Pass . The road exited Silverymoon Pass at Auvandell , and continued on to terminate at Sundabar . Between Khelb and Auvandell inside Silverymoon Pass near the top of the pass was the watchtower Hawk ' s Nest . The road was patrolled by the Knights in Silver , from Silverymoon , and by troops from Sundabar to stop monsters and bandits preying on the road ' s traffic .

title: Silverywing
description: Silverywing Silverywing was a young silver dragon . She lived in the Dawn Age and served the legendary gold elf Prince Durothil . She died at age 20 , in combat with the red dragon Mahatnartorian .
description_long: Silverywing Silverywing was a young silver dragon . She lived in the Dawn Age and served the legendary gold elf Prince Durothil . She died at age 20 , in combat with the red dragon Mahatnartorian . History . Birth and early years . Durothil received Silverywing ' s dragon - egg from the ancient red great wyrm Mahatnartorian , who killed her mother and gave the egg to the prince . They both had made a bargain : the prince got the egg and , twenty years later , the dragon , in exchange for a special moon elf as a sacrifice . Durothil kept Silverywing confined within his magical dimension . Silverywing grew to develop a love for learning and beauty . She and Durothil created attacks and together . Freedom and death . After 20 years of confinement , Durothil planned to let Silverywing go free , and sent Sharlario Moonflower to the top of a mountain in preparation . Mahatnartorian appeared and attacked Sharlario . Silverywing emerged from the magical dimension , ridden by Durothil , and attacked Mahatnartorian , but she was not powerful enough to defeat the great wyrm . The fight was over quickly and resulted in the deaths of Silverywing , Mahatnartorian , and Durothil himself .

title: Silvo Carver
description: Silvo Carver Silvo Carver was the mayor of Crimel in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor , Silvo was also a wealthy merchant who owned a large number of cattle and sheep .
description_long: Silvo Carver Silvo Carver was the mayor of Crimel in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor , Silvo was also a wealthy merchant who owned a large number of cattle and sheep . His herds grazed on the fertile land south of the city .

title: Simbarch of Aglarond
description: Simbarch of Aglarond The simbarchs of Aglarond are a loosely bound order of wizard s who take their inspiration and principal teachings from the Simbul , a powerful sorceress who for a time ruled over Aglarond before her disappearance during the Era of Upheaval . Though the Simbul is now gone her ideological descendants continue to hold a prominent place in Aglarond , effectivelly acting as the ruling class of the nation . Regardless of whether a simbarch is part of this cultured elite or not , all draw on the same spell s and arcane secrets that made the Simbul well - known throughout Faerûn .
description_long: Simbarch of Aglarond The simbarchs of Aglarond are a loosely bound order of wizard s who take their inspiration and principal teachings from the Simbul , a powerful sorceress who for a time ruled over Aglarond before her disappearance during the Era of Upheaval . Though the Simbul is now gone her ideological descendants continue to hold a prominent place in Aglarond , effectivelly acting as the ruling class of the nation . Regardless of whether a simbarch is part of this cultured elite or not , all draw on the same spell s and arcane secrets that made the Simbul well - known throughout Faerûn . Culture . While she was ruler of Aglarond , the Simbul took on many apprentices and learners , much as she herself had learned under Elminster . To these students she taught the art of using magic , while also embellishing her lessons with inventions of her own . When she disappeared , her apprentices gathered together to collect this knowledge and preserve it , calling themselves simbarchs in honor of their departed master . Since then simbarchs have taken on students of their own , passing on the ways of the Simbul to form a new tradition of arcane magic in Faerûn .

title: Simberuel Astalmé
description: Simberuel Astalmé Simberuel Astalmé was one of the last princes of Ascalhorn . History . In 882 DR , Prince Simberuel Astalmé led a group of human refugees from the fallen kingdom of Ascalhorn .
description_long: Simberuel Astalmé Simberuel Astalmé was one of the last princes of Ascalhorn . History .
