In 882 DR , Prince Simberuel Astalmé led a group of human refugees from the fallen kingdom of Ascalhorn . Attacked by vrock demon s in the Turnstone Pass , the dwarves of Citadel Sundbarr came to the rescue . During the battle , Astalmé gave his life to save the Forgemaster of Sundbarr and , in gratitude , the dwarves offered the humans a home in the abandoned surface portions of the citadel and over time build and founded the settlement of Sundabar .

title: Simbul
description: Simbul The Simbul , born Alassra Shentrantra Silverhand , and also known as the Witch - Queen of Aglarond , is one of the Seven Sisters , a Chosen of Mystra , and one of the most powerful spellcasters in Faerûn . Her character is that of a wild and powerful sorceress , highly unpredictable and prone to sudden outbursts of rage . She is queen of Aglarond , a nation in the east of Faerûn , but many of her subjects fear her as much as they respect her for her recklessness and apparent unstable nature .
description_long: Simbul The Simbul , born Alassra Shentrantra Silverhand , and also known as the Witch - Queen of Aglarond , is one of the Seven Sisters , a Chosen of Mystra , and one of the most powerful spellcasters in Faerûn . Her character is that of a wild and powerful sorceress , highly unpredictable and prone to sudden outbursts of rage . She is queen of Aglarond , a nation in the east of Faerûn , but many of her subjects fear her as much as they respect her for her recklessness and apparent unstable nature . Her character is also noteworthy as the lover to the highly popular Sage of Shadowdale , Elminster . The Simbul was protected by a personal guard called the Simbulmyn , commanded by High Captain Hovor Seawind in 1374 DR . Apprentices . As of 1374 DR , the Simbul had four female human apprentices : Evenyl Nathtalond , a wizard and sorcerer ; Phaeldara , also a wizard and sorcerer ; The Masked One , a sorcerer and rogue ; and Thorneira Thalance , a sorcerer and wizard . Successor .

title: Simov
description: Simov Simov , also known as Simov the Pious , was a cleric of Oghma in the Fallen Lands , and a regional agent of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Simov preferred to stay alone in his tower .
description_long: Simov Simov , also known as Simov the Pious , was a cleric of Oghma in the Fallen Lands , and a regional agent of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Simov preferred to stay alone in his tower . This also for remain mentally sane from the power that Oghma gave to him . History . Simov in past helped to destroy a lich living in Seshrentor , a tower north - northeast of Llorkh in Fallen Lands ; at one point asked to his god with a " wish " spell a knowledge power , so Oghma gave him the ability to have knowledge about all people around him on a one - mile radius . Simov nearly was driven insane from knowledge about too many people , so he retreat in the isolate Seshrentor tower , collecting books , some gave to him by Khelben Arunsun . Before 1370 DR his friend Khelben asked him to join the Moonstars and Simov accepted .

title: Simulacrum
description: Simulacrum Simulacrum was an illusion spell . Description . The spell allowed the creation of a moving ice - statue look - alike of a person .
description_long: Simulacrum Simulacrum was an illusion spell . Description . The spell allowed the creation of a moving ice - statue look - alike of a person . The caster cast the spell on a rough humanoid form shaped from snow or ice . The form then became a look - alike of a specific person with capabilities not as good as those of the original . How much it actually looked like the original depended on the mundane disguise ability of the caster . Damage to the figure could only be repaired with special equipment and effort . The figure was under the complete control of the caster and could be ordered to do anything . Components . " Simulacrum " used verbal , somatic , and material components , namely a snow or ice figure , a body part of the creature to be copied ( something like a hair sufficed ) , and ruby powder that increased in amount in relation to the creature to be copied .

title: Simurgh
description: Simurgh Simurghs , or the “ King of Birds ” , were avian creatures of Zakhara known to protect good - hearted lawful beings . Description . Simurghs had a male or female human face with the body of a giant eagle .
description_long: Simurgh Simurghs , or the “ King of Birds ” , were avian creatures of Zakhara known to protect good - hearted lawful beings . Description . Simurghs had a male or female human face with the body of a giant eagle . Their feathers were metallic orange in color . These creatures had two pair of golden wings that could propel it quickly through the air . A simurgh ’ s long tail feathers could make a peacock jealous . Combat . Simurghs were pacifists and would rarely enter into combat , even to save others . They could cast the following spell s : " detect invisibility " , " know alignment " , " infravision " , " shape change " ( birds or human only ) , " speak with animals / monsters " ( birds or human only ) . A simurgh could spread its wings and hypnotize any creature viewing them . Habitat / Society . More than half of these solitary creatures were female . Most avian creatures obeyed simurghs and many freely followed them like admirers . These strange flocks were only encountered far from human settlements . Simurghs only kept a lair when mating , which occurred roughly every six years . A suitable lair would be a mountain cavern that was deep in the wilderness .

title: Simyaz
description: Simyaz Simyaz was the leader of the githyanki party sent out after the blade of the sacred Silver Sword stolen by Irenicus . The blade was subsequently given to Saemon Havarian , who knew it could only bring trouble and was anxious to be rid of it . Simyaz ' s group went after him in a levitating ship , but it was somehow capsized , possibly by the same sahuagin who may have attacked Havarian ' s ship .
description_long: Simyaz Simyaz was the leader of the githyanki party sent out after the blade of the sacred Silver Sword stolen by Irenicus . The blade was subsequently given to Saemon Havarian , who knew it could only bring trouble and was anxious to be rid of it . Simyaz ' s group went after him in a levitating ship , but it was somehow capsized , possibly by the same sahuagin who may have attacked Havarian ' s ship . Simyaz and a few other githyanki ended up taken prisoners by the illithid s living near Ust Natha , forced to fight for their amusement . The player character will encounter Simyaz and his group for the first time at sea if they choose to take Havarian ' s offer to come aboard his ship and sail out after Irenicus . In that case , the githyanki will attack the ship , only to be interrupted by sahuagin sinking it . The other time Simyaz can be encountered is if the party decides to enter the illithid caverns when working for the drow in Ust Natha . There , they will immediately find themselves captured and put into the cell next to the githyanki .

title: Sinaht Irithyl
description: Sinaht Irithyl Sinaht Irithyl was the chosen heir of Sakrattars Irithyl , and the third Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1950 DR to his death in - 1338 DR . He became coronal upon drawing the Rulers ' Blade after the former coronal ' s death . His rysar was known for a successful campaign against the drow of the Twisted Tower and the former realm of Uvaeren in - 1354 DR , which utilized the combined forces of Cormanthyr and Rystall Wood to rout many of the dark elves from the woods .
description_long: Sinaht Irithyl Sinaht Irithyl was the chosen heir of Sakrattars Irithyl , and the third Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1950 DR to his death in - 1338 DR . He became coronal upon drawing the Rulers ' Blade after the former coronal ' s death . His rysar was known for a successful campaign against the drow of the Twisted Tower and the former realm of Uvaeren in - 1354 DR , which utilized the combined forces of Cormanthyr and Rystall Wood to rout many of the dark elves from the woods . Unfortunately , they failed to penetrate the Twisted Tower , and many drow managed to escape into the Underdark .

title: Singdown
description: Singdown A huuk , or " singdown " , was a competition held by Iulutiun s to settle disagreements . Description . A huuk was a battle of wits ; it was essentially an exchange of sung insults between two parties .
description_long: Singdown A huuk , or " singdown " , was a competition held by Iulutiun s to settle disagreements . Description . A huuk was a battle of wits ; it was essentially an exchange of sung insults between two parties . Rules . An insult was only " valid " if it followed these three " rules " : The competition was played in rounds , with each opponent taking a turn to offer an insult , while the audience listened . A game was played for at least three or four rounds but could go much longer if the two competitors were equally matched . Result . The reaction of the audience determined the winner , and particularly creative or witty insults were preferred . Singdowns were used to resolve minor disputes , so that violence could be avoided .

title: Singing sword
description: Singing sword A singing sword was a magic + 1 greatsword made of silver . It sang constantly ( and loudly ) when it was drawn , and gave its wielder a morale bonus , and a larger morale bonus against spells or effects affecting the mind . It was worth around 25 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Singing sword A singing sword was a magic + 1 greatsword made of silver . It sang constantly ( and loudly ) when it was drawn , and gave its wielder a morale bonus , and a larger morale bonus against spells or effects affecting the mind . It was worth around 25 , 000 gold pieces . The goddess Eilistraee gifted twenty holy singing bastard swords to Qilue Veladorn and the drow of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . The blades ' song made its wielder confident and immune to " charm " , " command " , " confusion " , " fear " , " friends " , " repulsion " , " scare " and " suggestion " . An " emotion " cast on the wielder only caused " rage " , focused on the one who cast the " emotion " spell . The sword ' s song also cancelled the effects of a harpy ' s song , silenced shrieker s , and could " entrance " weak , earthly , living creatures , although this ability could be negated by a bard ' s counter - song .

title: Singing tree
description: Singing tree Singing trees were bizarre plant - like sanguivores ( blood - feeders ) found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Singing trees looked like regular deciduous trees , but had unique leaves .
description_long: Singing tree Singing trees were bizarre plant - like sanguivores ( blood - feeders ) found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Singing trees looked like regular deciduous trees , but had unique leaves . Each leaf sang with a beautiful high - pitched voice , combining together to form an irresistible orchestra . If hungry enough , the body of the tree joined the song with a bass voice . Combat . Singing trees used their bass voice to lure animals within hearing distance . The song compelled most animals to approach the tree for a rest , at which point the tree would drop several leaves on the animal to feed . Feeding leaves fell from the tree in a natural manner . Charmed animals did not even feel the small prick of the leaf ' s stem as it broke their skin and drew blood . After consuming a bit of blood , the leaf would float back to the tree and attach itself . If a singing tree was attacked directly , it would send a swarm of leaves at the attacker , draining blood and temporarily blinding them . Habitat / Society . Singing trees were usually found far from humans in secluded areas , using their songs to lure animals close enough for them to feed .

title: Singye
description: Singye Singye was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Singye lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea .
description_long: Singye Singye was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Singye lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea . E ' Tyon Bay lay just north of Singye . History . By 1357 DR , E ' Tyon Bay had become infested by tigerworm s , which sunk four fishing boats and a merchant ship . Singye authorities offered a reward to any who could eliminate the menace . In that year , following battles between Koryoan troops and advance forces of Kozakura around Karak in the south , around a thousand refugees fled to Singye and camped outside the city . Inhabitants . Singye was home to the wu jen Yuraka , owner of the last known scroll case of the " Ky Trencha Ukang " .

title: Sinhalite
description: Sinhalite Sinhalite was a rare find in streambed gravel , both active streams and ancient , dried up riverbeds . When polished cabochon or cut , these fancy stones were called sinhalas . Description .
description_long: Sinhalite Sinhalite was a rare find in streambed gravel , both active streams and ancient , dried up riverbeds . When polished cabochon or cut , these fancy stones were called sinhalas . Description . In natural form , these crystals were rounded pebbles , tumbled and smoothed by water action . They were yellow - brown to pale straw - yellow and yielded gemstones up to 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . A sinhala could prevent magical " darkness " in a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) radius around the stone .

title: Sinklayr Greenstroke
description: Sinklayr Greenstroke Sinklayr Greenstroke was a Grand Druid of the North around the 1340s DR . History . Sinklayr was a servant of Silvanus , the main deity revered in the heart of the Tall Trees region , particularly in the Deep Glade .
description_long: Sinklayr Greenstroke Sinklayr Greenstroke was a Grand Druid of the North around the 1340s DR . History . Sinklayr was a servant of Silvanus , the main deity revered in the heart of the Tall Trees region , particularly in the Deep Glade . He aided the preservation of the woodland home of Eaerlann . Prior to the fall of Hellgate Keep , the order did much to defend and protect the eastern edge of the High Forest . In 1374 DR Sinklayr was a devotee of Mielikki and a member of the Tall Trees circle known for wandering all time for the forest

title: Sinmon Thul
description: Sinmon Thul Sinmon Thul was one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruiting company in Amn . Description . Sinmon was a big man with brown hair and a bushy mustache .
description_long: Sinmon Thul Sinmon Thul was one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruiting company in Amn . Description . Sinmon was a big man with brown hair and a bushy mustache . He did not like the formalities of nobility nor the bureaucracy involved in being one of the Boar ' s Head s . Activities . Sinmon was a leading member of the Order of the Blue Boar . He was a tactical genius and so was often put in charge of field operations . In his younger ( and less heavy - set ) days , he would lead cavalry charges . History . Sinmon hailed from an Amnian mercantile family , but as third son he needed to make his own fortune . He gained fame and money leading a mercenary company in the Sword Coast until joining the Order .

title: Sinnafain
description: Sinnafain Sinnafain ( also spelled Sinnafein ) was an elf in the Moonwood who married the drow renegade Tos ' un Armgo . She was also the leader of the elves of the Moonwood . Personality .
description_long: Sinnafain Sinnafain ( also spelled Sinnafein ) was an elf in the Moonwood who married the drow renegade Tos ' un Armgo . She was also the leader of the elves of the Moonwood . Personality . As leader of the elves of the Moonwood , Sinnafain was sympathetic to groups ( such as Casin Cu Calas ) that killed or harassed orc s in protest of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . She often pardoned these vigilantes . History . In Sinnafain ' s first encounter with her future husband , Tos ' un Armgo , his sword , " Khazid ' hea " , persuaded him to attack her , but he refrained from hurting or killing her . The two later married and had two children , Teirflin and Doum ' wielle Armgo , while living in the Moonwood . At some point , Tos ' un started a " contest " between his children for one of them to win possession of " Khazid ' hea " . Doum ' wielle won and killed her brother in 1484 DR after he attempted to take it from her . She fled and her parents followed . Along the way , they were pursued by orcs . Tos ' un , apparently having reverted to his old ways , slashed Sinnafain ' s legs and left her for dead .

title: Sinveri Trollkin
description: Sinveri Trollkin Sinveri Trollkin was a quarter - drow half - elf woman who served as the general of the armed forces of Ulgarth around 1367 DR . She hailed originally from the land of Dambrath , but had turned renegade . Sinveri was a capable leader and intelligent .
description_long: Sinveri Trollkin Sinveri Trollkin was a quarter - drow half - elf woman who served as the general of the armed forces of Ulgarth around 1367 DR . She hailed originally from the land of Dambrath , but had turned renegade . Sinveri was a capable leader and intelligent . She was a devout follower of Tyr , god of justice and warfare .

title: Sirac
description: Sirac Sirac of Suzail was an acolyte of Torm in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sirac was the son of the famous adventurer Artus Cimber , but was given up as a baby .
description_long: Sirac Sirac of Suzail was an acolyte of Torm in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sirac was the son of the famous adventurer Artus Cimber , but was given up as a baby . He grew up in an orphanage in Suzail , and learned to fend for himself living on the city ' s streets as a teenager . Although orphaned , Sirac was always aware of his lineage . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , he joined a caravan to Baldur ' s Gate . He then traveled to Neverwinter before finally arriving in Bryn Shander , where he intended to work as a knucklehead trout fisherman . He befriended Dellvon Ludwig , who converted him to the worship of the god Torm . Sirac was present at the local House of the Triad when giant s attacked Bryn Shander . Personality . Sirac belived firmly in duty and honor . He was honest at heart and felt he had found a true home in Icewind Dale . Appendix . Behind the scenes . Sirac was one of the special NPC that can be played by the players during the campaign ' s arc in their city .

title: Sirak Mazelor
description: Sirak Mazelor Sirak Mazelor was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Sirak liked luxurious items made by the drow .
description_long: Sirak Mazelor Sirak Mazelor was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Sirak liked luxurious items made by the drow . She was a sophisticated individual . History . Sirak was a merchant working for House Baenre . During the turmoil between the duergar and deep gnome s instigated by the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu , Sirak was ready to fully conquer the trading post , but only if the Zhentarim accepted the change in government .

title: Siremun
description: Siremun Siremun was the last Dwarven kingdom to be founded in the Dwarven expansion at the height of their races power during the Age of the Proud Peoples . The Firepeaks were discovered by a band of dwarven adventurers in - 11900 DR who then decided to settle there as many of their kin had done . The last wave of the dwarven expansion followed them after many years .
description_long: Siremun Siremun was the last Dwarven kingdom to be founded in the Dwarven expansion at the height of their races power during the Age of the Proud Peoples . The Firepeaks were discovered by a band of dwarven adventurers in - 11900 DR who then decided to settle there as many of their kin had done . The last wave of the dwarven expansion followed them after many years . Unfortunately , no more dwarves followed them that far and eventually communications completely broke down with the west . Since the Firepeaks are sacred to the Tuigan , who believe the region to be the home of their fire god , the nomadic humans often visited the dwarven kingdom , naming them " Siremun " or Iron Men ( who they believe are jealous of them because their legs are too stunted to reach the stirrups of a horse ) . Regardless , the dwarves took their Tuigan name as the name of their kingdom . Siremun contained many deposits of skystone , a transparent volcanic rock that served as a durable and efficient building material with which they built most of their structures and then later traded with the Caliphs of Semphar .

title: Sirge Wintermelt
description: Sirge Wintermelt Sirge Wintermelt was a scout and member of the Harpers in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 , Sirge followed rumors of the Cult of the Dragon gathering orc s from the Thar .
description_long: Sirge Wintermelt Sirge Wintermelt was a scout and member of the Harpers in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 , Sirge followed rumors of the Cult of the Dragon gathering orc s from the Thar . In doing this , Sirge discovered the Claws of Tiamat bandit gang . He was captured by them and discovered that they were not Dragon Cultists , but only crazed zealots of Tiamat . Eventually , he was freed by an adventuring party hired to clear the Iron Route of outlaws . In 1491 DR he possibly resurfaced in Mulmaster during an investigation about a mine in Earthspur Mountains saying to the adventurers that Harpers want free the local miners , most political dissidents of the city knowing important secrets .

title: Sirhan al - Din
description: Sirhan al - Din Sirhan al - Din was a janni and member of the Sword Dancers in 1367 DR . Description . Sirhan stood over 6 ft .
description_long: Sirhan al - Din Sirhan al - Din was a janni and member of the Sword Dancers in 1367 DR . Description . Sirhan stood over 6 ft . ( 2m ) tall . He had dark eyes , chestnut hair , and dusky skin . History . Sirhan was a resident of Sarahin from the time the jann first built that great fortress . He was completely loyal to the Sword Dancers . Activities . Sirhan served as master of the hounds . He managed to capture and train two cheetahs who followed him wherever he went .

title: Sirhan min Hajama
description: Sirhan min Hajama Sirhan min Hajama was the Imam of the Midnight Mosque in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Sirhan was a cheerful individual .
description_long: Sirhan min Hajama Sirhan min Hajama was the Imam of the Midnight Mosque in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Sirhan was a cheerful individual . Activities . He desperately wanted to retrieve a relic rumored to be the heart of the Lion of Suja . He believed that successfully retrieving the relic would bring him enough prosperity to fend off attacks from holy slayer s .

title: Siri al - Klemin
description: Siri al - Klemin Siri al - Klemin was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Siri ' s real name was Khorasan , though he would never share that information with mortals . Personality .
description_long: Siri al - Klemin Siri al - Klemin was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Siri ' s real name was Khorasan , though he would never share that information with mortals . Personality . Compared to his vocal companion , Siri was quiet and sullen , usually only speaking when addressed by another . Activities . Siri was one of two dao who operated the ferry that ushered people across the mighty Al - Sarif River that bisected Huzuz . Siri often exchanged gossip with ferry travelers . Kenai and Siri were known to make deals with the travelers as well , but evil intentions were usually hidden behind their charismatic smiles . History . Siri was forced into penance by the Great Khan of the Dao for committing an unknown crime . He missed his homeland greatly and could be bribed to talk about it if paid enough .

title: Sirine
description: Sirine Sirines are playful , fun - loving fey creatures who love to sing and dance . Physical description . Sirines look like normal human females although their skin may have a yellow or greenish tinge to it .
description_long: Sirine Sirines are playful , fun - loving fey creatures who love to sing and dance . Physical description . Sirines look like normal human females although their skin may have a yellow or greenish tinge to it . Their hair varies from normal human colors to silver or dark green . Combat . Sirines prefer not to engage in direct combat . Rather , they tend to use their abilities to escape back to their home . Sirines can charm another creature and can damage their foes ' intelligence . Some sirines use bows , slings or javelins as weapons and a small number carry magical javelins . A single touch from a sirine had a chance of instantly reducing the target ' s intelligence . This effect lasted until dispelled with magic , or until any sirine touched the victim again . Ecology . They often frolic with strangers , although only for a short amount of time and almost never invite strangers back to their lair .

title: Sirius Rulak
description: Sirius Rulak Sirius Rulak was a Zhentarim mercenary commander in Daggerdale around 1479 DR . History . Rulak and his squad were paid by the Shadovar to expel a large band of gnoll s from Anauroch .
description_long: Sirius Rulak Sirius Rulak was a Zhentarim mercenary commander in Daggerdale around 1479 DR . History . Rulak and his squad were paid by the Shadovar to expel a large band of gnoll s from Anauroch . Instead of killing the gnolls , Rulak devised a plan to drive the band to Daggerdale . He later offered his services to Daggerdale ' s leaders to eliminate the gnolls . Rulak was assembled by the mayor of Dagger Falls with the constable and an adventuring party hired by Kendar Morn for a meeting to decide the best option for dealing with the gnolls .

title: Sirocco
description: Sirocco The Sirocco were a mercenary company based in Anauroch around 1358 DR . Tactics . The Sirocco ' s simple tactics consisted of waving their scimitar s over their heads and shrieking out a ululant war cry and attacking .
description_long: Sirocco The Sirocco were a mercenary company based in Anauroch around 1358 DR . Tactics . The Sirocco ' s simple tactics consisted of waving their scimitar s over their heads and shrieking out a ululant war cry and attacking . However , they had the best desert scouts and always knew their enemy ' s tactics . Organization . Membership . The Sirocco consisted of light cavalry . Nearly 30 were armed with bows . Contracts . The Sirocco charged 120 gold piece s per week . Plus they wanted some luxury items and news from the greater " Realms " . They always respected their oath , but anyone betraying them earned themselves a tireless enemy . History . The Sirocco arrived in Faerûn around 1346 DR from a distant southern land , perhaps even Zakhara . They fought well in the Shaar and in the Old Empires until they eventually settled in Anauroch , where they established good relationships with the Bedine . They operated as caravan guards , becoming an enemy of the Zhentarim over time . Members . They were commanded by the female elf Hajima sitt - Nasir .

title: Sirrus Melandor
description: Sirrus Melandor Sirrus Melandor was the Chief Prelate of Ravens Bluff from 1353 DR - - ? Appearance . Sirrus Melandor stands 5 ' 11 " tall and weighs 155 pounds .
description_long: Sirrus Melandor Sirrus Melandor was the Chief Prelate of Ravens Bluff from 1353 DR - - ? Appearance . Sirrus Melandor stands 5 ' 11 " tall and weighs 155 pounds . He has salt - and - pepper hair , icy blue eyes , and is extremely good looking and charismatic . He is usually seen dressed in temple vestments which are decorated with the symbols of his office , and carrying a staff . He has a powerful voice that can command attention if needed . Personality . Sirrus Melandor is the high priest of Tyr in Ravens Bluff and epitomizes the god of justice . He is slow to anger and weighs the considerations of each situation carefully , keeping his own council until he comes to a decision . When he speaks , it is with firm conviction . He is fairly successful at maintaining an air of cooperation among the civic temples for the betterment of the city . He enjoys studying other religions and his main goal in life is to expand the influence of his own temple but without exploiting his office to do so . Background . Sirrus was born in a hamlet near Ravens Bluff . His family were merchants . He became an apprentice to the Temple of Tyr at age 14 and became a full cleric at 18 .

title: Sirvinhandra
description: Sirvinhandra Sirvinhandra was a green dragon ( great wyrm ) who , on 22 Mirtul 1373 DR , emerged from a lair in the Dun Hills to attack the Abbey of the Just Hammer , causing devastation , before being killed by Lord High Justiciar High Avenger Deren Eriach .
description_long: Sirvinhandra Sirvinhandra was a green dragon ( great wyrm ) who , on 22 Mirtul 1373 DR , emerged from a lair in the Dun Hills to attack the Abbey of the Just Hammer , causing devastation , before being killed by Lord High Justiciar High Avenger Deren Eriach .

title: Sirya Redlock
description: Sirya Redlock Sirya Redlock was a ranger in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Activities . Sirya ' s mother was a shaman of the Issacort people and her father a ranger from Faerûn .
description_long: Sirya Redlock Sirya Redlock was a ranger in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Activities . Sirya ' s mother was a shaman of the Issacort people and her father a ranger from Faerûn . She learned all about her father ' s profession and started wandering over all the Wastes , and also to south and even visiting her father ' s place of birth . She never stopping wandering . People often asked her counsel about the Wastes ' terrain . Personality . Sirya was friendly with strangers , loyal to friends , and loved sharing information about her travels .

title: Sisterhood of Essembra
description: Sisterhood of Essembra The Sisterhood of Essembra was a small and isolated female - only organization who lived in the forest of Battledale . Most of its members were half - dragon descendants of the notorious song dragon Essembramaerytha . History .
description_long: Sisterhood of Essembra The Sisterhood of Essembra was a small and isolated female - only organization who lived in the forest of Battledale . Most of its members were half - dragon descendants of the notorious song dragon Essembramaerytha . History . The Sisterhood was said to have been founded by the children of Essembramaerytha , known to non - dragons as the legendary adventuress Essembra . She had several half – song dragon daughters with human s who caught her fancy , and after her dramatic departure her daughters , many of them skilled sorcerer s capable of assuming human form , dwelt quietly in the forest of Battledale . Some wed humans or elves , while others mated with passing song dragons . Over time , female half - dragons from other lands , mostly of silver and song lineages , joined them in quiet fellowship . They helped travelers who ventured into their forest , and over time locals began to call them the Sisterhood of Essembra . However , the Sisterhood did not coalesce into a formal organization until 1371 DR , when drow from the Auzkovyn clan tried to invade Battledale .

title: Sisterhood of the Oaks
description: Sisterhood of the Oaks The Sisterhood of the Oaks were a mercenary company based in the Chondalwood around 1358 DR . History . They were a group of ranger s who fought during the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .
description_long: Sisterhood of the Oaks The Sisterhood of the Oaks were a mercenary company based in the Chondalwood around 1358 DR . History . They were a group of ranger s who fought during the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep . Membership . The Sisterhood were female trackers , archers , and scouts . They were all vegetarians , never harming fish , birds , and other " children of nature " . Contracts . The Sisterhood took 1 gold piece for a day for each member . Usually they acted as escorts or scouts , or as a special attack force .

title: Sisters of the Merciful Mother
description: Sisters of the Merciful Mother The Sisters of the Merciful Mother were a religious order devoted to the goddess Hathor . Membership . The members of this order were clergy of Hathor who took vows of pacifism .
description_long: Sisters of the Merciful Mother The Sisters of the Merciful Mother were a religious order devoted to the goddess Hathor . Membership . The members of this order were clergy of Hathor who took vows of pacifism . Activities . They served in the cities of Mulhorand and had the supreme authority to intercede on the behalf of anyone in need , the injured and the sick , even slaves . Their actions in these matters could not be countermanded , even by a cleric of Horus - Re .

title: Sithe
description: Sithe Sithe was a half - genasi , half - demon warrior who worked as an enforcer for the Dead Rats gang in Luskan . Although she was half - demon , she very much disliked being referred to as a demon . Description .
description_long: Sithe Sithe was a half - genasi , half - demon warrior who worked as an enforcer for the Dead Rats gang in Luskan . Although she was half - demon , she very much disliked being referred to as a demon . Description . Sithe had black skin and black eyes . Rather than hair , she had tendrils of darkness leaking from her scalp . She usually dressed in black silks . Abilities . Sithe could open a portal to the void whenever she liked . She was an expert swordswoman and was even capable of defeating Kalen whom she often sparred with . Possessions . Sithe carried a large black axe and was very proficient in its use . History . Sithe was the product of an involuntary coupling between her windsoul genasi mother and a demon . In 1480 DR , Sithe was ordered by Toytere , the leader of the Dead Rats , to capture Myrin Darkdance so the Rats could deliver her to the Coin Spinners gang . Sithe attacked a dwarven caravan by herself , killing many dwarves and capturing Myrin . While at the Dead Rats headquarters , Myrin was made to think she was actually chosen as queen of the Rats in order to keep the powerful wizard under control .

title: Sithierel
description: Sithierel Sithierel was a shadar - kai hexblade who sailed the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Sithirel was a shadar - kai involved in Despayr ' s plot in 1374 DR .
description_long: Sithierel Sithierel was a shadar - kai hexblade who sailed the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Sithirel was a shadar - kai involved in Despayr ' s plot in 1374 DR . Together with his companion Grask , a dusk beast , his duty was to pilot the boat " Necreme " .

title: Sitting bull
description: Sitting bull The sitting bull was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bull . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Sitting bull The sitting bull was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bull . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . One who drank from the cup was instilled with the powerful wu jen spell " surelife " , saving them against natural causes of death , and a protection against all assaults short of physical attack . However this benefit lasted for only one hour , and the cup itself could only be used once a day . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " sitting bull " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . However , it was later lost . In the mid – 14th century DR , King Wanang Sun led an expedition to recover three of the Wo - ha Ui - jung . He was successful , discovering the " sitting bull " , " sitting monkey " , and " standing deer " by 1357 DR . He was widely believe to make regular use of the " sitting bull " .

title: Sitting dog
description: Sitting dog The sitting dog was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a dog . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Sitting dog The sitting dog was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a dog . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . The powers of the " sitting dog " were uncertain ; they were listed in obscure records , but these accounts contradicted one another . It was variously said to allow its bearer to set something ablaze with only a look , or to sing that could hypnotize those who heard , or to cure blight - stricken crops , but it also might cause baldness . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " sitting dog " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . The " sitting dog " was last used by the hero Niofu Sangto , who in the year Koryo 812 defeated the Kozakura n navy in the Battle of Wui Eyong . However , the " sitting dog " was later lost by 1357 DR .

title: Sitting monkey
description: Sitting monkey The sitting monkey was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a monkey . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Sitting monkey The sitting monkey was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a monkey . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . To use the " sitting monkey " , one had to hold a ceremony at midnight , in which they burned incense inside the cup and made a certain , strange chant . In return , they received greater skill in climbing , an overall boost to abilities that depended on experience , and the power to use the " true seeing " spell like a shukenja one time a day . A user had to perform this ceremony nightly in order to retain these powers . However , if they continued this regimen for six months or more , they suffered a permanent change : their toes became as prehensile as a monkey ' s , able to naturally grasp things like branches , ledges , and ropes . This made it uncomfortable to wear shoes . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " sitting bull " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . However , it was later lost .

title: Sittl
description: Sittl Sittl was a malenti spy of Ascarle . Personality . Sittl was a great actor , always with the facade of a happy and generous person .
description_long: Sittl Sittl was a malenti spy of Ascarle . Personality . Sittl was a great actor , always with the facade of a happy and generous person . In truth , he was a sadist with a bloodlust . Activities . Sittl posed as an aquatic elf ranger and normally wandered the Trackless Sea with fellow sea elf ranger Xzorsh . History . He assisted Xzorsh in 1361 DR to help the " Elfmaid " , which was pursued by the Kraken Society of Ascarle and by Rethnor of Luskan . However , pretending to ask for reinforcements , Sittl secretly informed his master of the ship ' s location and disappeared . Xzorsh searched for him and finally found Sittl on Ruathym under the " charm " of a kelpie . Sittl tried to kill Xzorsh but failed and they reconciled . Sittl said that he had been captured by a group of merrow s . However , the drow wizard Liriel Baenre read Sittl ' s mind and saw strange images , starting to suspect the truth . After some investigation , she deducted the truth of Sittl . At last , Xzorsh found Sittl inside Ascarle with the Northlander traitor Dragmar and finally Sittl revealed the truth to his presumed friend . However , Xzorsh easily killed Sittl . Relationships .

title: Six Coffers Market Priakos
description: Six Coffers Market Priakos The Six Coffers Market Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Originally founded by six merchants , only four of the remaining founders remained alive in 1367 DR .
description_long: Six Coffers Market Priakos The Six Coffers Market Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Originally founded by six merchants , only four of the remaining founders remained alive in 1367 DR . Thelve Baruinheld served as the leader of the organization , operating out of Berdusk . Base of Operations . This merchant company had bases of operation in Berdusk , Waterdeep , Silverymoon , Priapurl , and Selgaunt .

title: Six Spiked Rings
description: Six Spiked Rings The Six Spiked Rings were an adventuring company from Turmish . History . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , the Six Spiked Rings visited the town of Ylraphon in the Vast and explored the House of Moander temple of the god Moander .
description_long: Six Spiked Rings The Six Spiked Rings were an adventuring company from Turmish . History . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , the Six Spiked Rings visited the town of Ylraphon in the Vast and explored the House of Moander temple of the god Moander . Greater darktentacles attacked and killed some of their number , but two escaped with treasures won from the temple : a large bag of gems , and a sack of metal magic wand s of great age and power .

title: Sixfold Symmetry
description: Sixfold Symmetry The Sixfold Symmetry was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Sixfold Symmetry was made - up of 500 crysmal mercenaries .
description_long: Sixfold Symmetry The Sixfold Symmetry was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Sixfold Symmetry was made - up of 500 crysmal mercenaries . Activities . The activities of this group was unknown , but they were never seen outside of the Sevenfold Mazework . Base of Operations . The Sevenfold Mazework within the Great Dismal Delve served as base of all dao military organizations .

title: Skagi
description: Skagi Skagi was a Shadar - kai warrior living in the Shadowfell side of Ikemmu . He was Cree ' s brother and was a close friend of Ashok . In 1479 DR Skagi travelled with Cree , Ashok and Vedoran on a quest to rescue the witch Ilvani from a Shadar - kai enclave in the Shadowfell .
description_long: Skagi Skagi was a Shadar - kai warrior living in the Shadowfell side of Ikemmu . He was Cree ' s brother and was a close friend of Ashok . In 1479 DR Skagi travelled with Cree , Ashok and Vedoran on a quest to rescue the witch Ilvani from a Shadar - kai enclave in the Shadowfell . In 1480 DR he journeyed with a caravan to Rashemen to discover the cause of the visions that were haunting Ilvani . Appearance . Unlike his brother , Skagi was stocky in build and had long grey hair . His torso was covered in green tattoos . Equipment . Skagi carried a falchion .

title: Skalnaedyr
description: Skalnaedyr Skalnaedyr , named for its dragon founder , was the largest city in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . The city grew rapidly from a village in the 15th century DR and the city ' s architecture was a jumble of buildings and streets . Government .
description_long: Skalnaedyr Skalnaedyr , named for its dragon founder , was the largest city in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . The city grew rapidly from a village in the 15th century DR and the city ' s architecture was a jumble of buildings and streets . Government . The city was ruled by the elder blue dragon Skalnaedyr . He showed respect to his human subjects and allowed the residents a great degree of freedom . Skalnaedyr was rarely seen and his vizier Merwena handled the day - to - day operations of the government . History . A plague among the dragons of the Copper Mountains in 1409 DR caused many dragons to flee the region . One blue dragon , Skalnaedyr , stopped to rest in a small village called Phannaskull . The frightened villagers pledged fealty to the surprised dragon , who agreed to rule the village . Due to Skalnaedyr ' s enlightened ( for a dragon ) rule , the small village grew into a city during the 15th century DR .

title: Skalnaedyr ( dragon )
description: Skalnaedyr ( dragon ) Skalnaedyr was an elder blue dragon and the ruler of the city in Murghôm that bore his name . He was one of the Princes of Murghôm , and also considered to be the strongest wyrm who lived in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . History .
description_long: Skalnaedyr ( dragon ) Skalnaedyr was an elder blue dragon and the ruler of the city in Murghôm that bore his name . He was one of the Princes of Murghôm , and also considered to be the strongest wyrm who lived in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . History . In 1409 DR , a plague swept through the dragon population of the Copper Mountains , causing many dragons to flee . Skalnaedyr flew to Murghôm and stopped to rest near a small village known as Phannaskull . The frightened villagers pledged fealty to the surprised dragon , who agreed to rule the village . Due to Skalnaedyr ' s enlightened ( for a dragon ) rule , the village grew into a city during the 15th century DR . He also rescued the dragonborn Ananta from an unknown but certainly grisly fate , and made her Guardian of Dracowyr . Skalnaedyr really cared for her to the point of putting himself in harm way in order to protect her if she was in danger . In 1479 DR , he acceded to play the " xorvintaal " proposed by the the vampiric smoke drake Brimstone .

title: Skarn Stonegrinder
description: Skarn Stonegrinder Skarn Stonegrinder was a dwarf sage in 1358 DR . His expertise was in geology , mining , and metal smithing . Nobody knew why he lived among the men of Impiltur .
description_long: Skarn Stonegrinder Skarn Stonegrinder was a dwarf sage in 1358 DR . His expertise was in geology , mining , and metal smithing . Nobody knew why he lived among the men of Impiltur . His fees were a percentage of the operations he advised . His treasure was hidden somewhere in the Earthfast Mountains .

title: Skarou
description: Skarou Skarou was the capital city of the nation of Khazari . Description . Sitting where the Jumpa and Shyok Muren rivers met , the city of Skarou was well fortified due to the divided nature of the nation ' s politics .
description_long: Skarou Skarou was the capital city of the nation of Khazari . Description . Sitting where the Jumpa and Shyok Muren rivers met , the city of Skarou was well fortified due to the divided nature of the nation ' s politics . Though the capital of the nation , Skarou was considered run - down and ramshackle for its size , due to most of its power having been taken by the nobles of the nation . Inside the city was the Seven - Tiered Palace , from which the royalty of Khazari ruled , the Monastery of the Flowing Water , and the largest monastery of the Red Mountain sect . There was also a small monastery of the Yellow Mountain sect inside the city , resulting in some feuding between the two groups . Skarou was one of the five great cities of Khazari legend , along with Manass , Taghla , Barkhul and Alashan . Appendix . Note . While shown as Skarou on maps , the city was called both Skarou and Skardu in The Horde booklet .

title: Skaug
description: Skaug Skaug was a pirate captain and the founder of the Port of Skaug on the Isle of Skaug in the Nelanther Isles . Description . The pirate had a hook - like nose .
description_long: Skaug Skaug was a pirate captain and the founder of the Port of Skaug on the Isle of Skaug in the Nelanther Isles . Description . The pirate had a hook - like nose . History . With three ships , Skaug used his ill - gained fortune and supplies to build the port on the small island north of Ioma around 1169 DR .

title: Skeletal Finger
description: Skeletal Finger The Skeletal Finger thieves guild were a notorious band of ambitious and powerful rogues active from the waning years of the 11th century DR to the mid 12th century . Wherein they caused widespread chaos , political upheaval and the loss of at least one sacred relic . Operating out of a nigh - impregnable hideout in the Small Teeth , the first act definately attributed to the guild was the assassination of Imnel IV in 1094 DR which would spell the end of the Torlath royal family of Amn a year later .
description_long: Skeletal Finger The Skeletal Finger thieves guild were a notorious band of ambitious and powerful rogues active from the waning years of the 11th century DR to the mid 12th century . Wherein they caused widespread chaos , political upheaval and the loss of at least one sacred relic . Operating out of a nigh - impregnable hideout in the Small Teeth , the first act definately attributed to the guild was the assassination of Imnel IV in 1094 DR which would spell the end of the Torlath royal family of Amn a year later . They were blamed for numerous problems in both Amn and Tethyr , generally causing chaos in the lands surrounding their secret base . Some time in 1128 DR , in the wake of the defeat of the Magelords of Mintar by the Harpers , the Skeletal Finger came across many documents detailing an intricate plan of revenge against the dragon Sharpfangs , who had ravaged Mintar over a century earlier , including the location of her lair in the Marching Mountains and a few tantalising details about her impressive hoard .

title: Skeleton
description: Skeleton Skeletons are undead animated corpses similar to zombie s , but are completely devoid of flesh and do not feed on the living . They can be made from virtually any solid creature , and as such their size and power varies widely . In addition to the basic humanoid skeleton , there are also skeletons created from wolves , trolls , ettin s and even giants .
description_long: Skeleton Skeletons are undead animated corpses similar to zombie s , but are completely devoid of flesh and do not feed on the living . They can be made from virtually any solid creature , and as such their size and power varies widely . In addition to the basic humanoid skeleton , there are also skeletons created from wolves , trolls , ettin s and even giants . Animated skeletons are immune to mind affecting spells ; they cannot be rendered unconscious and cannot tire . Clerics often have the ability to repel or destroy undead creatures , of which animated skeletons are usually the weakest such adversaries . Edged and piercing weapons , such as swords and arrows , are mostly ineffective against skeletons ; only blunt weapons , such as warhammers , are effective at knocking the bones apart . The necromantic spell " animate dead " allows the caster to create skeletons . Varieties . Other Varieties .

title: Skelkor
description: Skelkor Skelkor was the most powerful dragon empire of Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Many people considered it to be " the " evil empire of the continent . Inhabitants .
description_long: Skelkor Skelkor was the most powerful dragon empire of Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Many people considered it to be " the " evil empire of the continent . Inhabitants . Skelkor was a land dominated by dragons . However , slaves of many humanoid races , mainly dragonborn , human s , halfling s and a minority of genasi , composed the bulk of empire ' s population . Government . Skelkor was ruled by Gauwervyndhal the Empress Dragon , one of the most powerful and feared dragons of Returned Abeir . She was served by her " suzerains " , dragons directly related to her — most of them her own children — , tasked with day - to - day ruling and the protection of the empire . Geography . Skelkor was composed by a landscape dominated by open rolling plains of lush grass and ribbon - like forests that encircled small marshes , roamed by various herd beasts , such as the Abeir an - endemic scathebeast s . History . After the sundering of Abeir - Toril , the corpse of Arambar was left in the lands that eventually would become Skelkor . Slaves who fled from their dragon masters founded the town of Wandering Stones in the rocks that composed the remains of the primordial .

title: Skerrit
description: Skerrit Skerrit is the neutral good god of the centaurs . He is known as the Forest Walker , the hunter and protector of the sylvan lands . He watches over the centaur communities and always aspires to maintain the natural balance .
description_long: Skerrit Skerrit is the neutral good god of the centaurs . He is known as the Forest Walker , the hunter and protector of the sylvan lands . He watches over the centaur communities and always aspires to maintain the natural balance . His domains are Animal , Heal , Plant and Sun . Spear is his favored weapon .

title: Skie
description: Skie Skie was a young barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Skie worked at the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth , a village in northeastern Tethyr .
description_long: Skie Skie was a young barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Skie worked at the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth , a village in northeastern Tethyr . She worked there to help her starving family . During the day , Skie helped on her family ' s farm .

title: Skie ( currency )
description: Skie ( currency ) Skie was the most common form of currency in Halruaa . Description . These coins were made from electrum at the Royal Mint in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa .
description_long: Skie ( currency ) Skie was the most common form of currency in Halruaa . Description . These coins were made from electrum at the Royal Mint in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa . A skie coin was fashioned with the image of Halruaa ' s current wizard - king , Zalathorm Kirkson .

title: Skie Silvershield
description: Skie Silvershield Skie Silvershield was the innocent and extremely naive daughter of Grand Duke Entar Silvershield . She reputably enjoyed sneaking out of the safety of her father ’ s well - guarded estate and held unrealistic dreams of a life of adventure . She reportedly awaited " rescue " by Eldoth , her lover .
description_long: Skie Silvershield Skie Silvershield was the innocent and extremely naive daughter of Grand Duke Entar Silvershield . She reputably enjoyed sneaking out of the safety of her father ’ s well - guarded estate and held unrealistic dreams of a life of adventure . She reportedly awaited " rescue " by Eldoth , her lover .

title: Skield
description: Skield Skield was a drow living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Skield was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith .
description_long: Skield Skield was a drow living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Skield was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith . Rumors and Legends . Skield reportedly met his demise when he was sent by Duchess Falrith to face a pair of beholders in Veldorn . Others believed he just escaped while he had the change .

title: Skiff
description: Skiff A skiff was a small open boat . Marsember . Skiffs were used extensively in Marsember , Cormyr for personal transportation .
description_long: Skiff A skiff was a small open boat . Marsember . Skiffs were used extensively in Marsember , Cormyr for personal transportation . These skiffs were usually made from wood and sealed with tar or fish oil . They were flat - bottomed and around 10 ' ( 3m ) in length , with identical upturned ends so that the direction of travel was reversible . They could be rigged with sails if necessary , but were often pole - driven by their occupants .

title: Skill domain
description: Skill domain The domain of skill has three deities and of them there are Corellon and oghma whom are patrons of artistic skill . The creator of elfs suports primarily visual art , arts created with magic , and all the arts of the eladrin , while the binder of what is known inspires skill in the ways of music and invention . Sune s power can aid in any skill that lends itself to more beauty .
description_long: Skill domain The domain of skill has three deities and of them there are Corellon and oghma whom are patrons of artistic skill . The creator of elfs suports primarily visual art , arts created with magic , and all the arts of the eladrin , while the binder of what is known inspires skill in the ways of music and invention . Sune s power can aid in any skill that lends itself to more beauty . Aesthetically pleasing art and architecture pleases lady Firehair , but she also wants all her followers to demonstrate skill in improving her or his personal appearance . Power of skill domain . Any divine caster who worships a god of the skill domain may use it to channel the power of the deity . As a Divine caster choses the domain she will have more success with the skills it is trained in , also , when they use a power of the domain she may use that power as a basic attack . The powers of the domain are : < br > Divine Bolts < br > Overwhelming Strike < br > Righteous brand < br > Valiant strike < br > Divine Excellence divinity . To use the divinity of the skill domain one must have the channel divinity class feat and worship a deity of the domain .

title: Skin dancer
description: Skin dancer Skin dancers were creatures that wore the flesh of human beings in an attempt to appear human . Abilities . If a skindancer stole another person ' s skin , their victim became a skin dancer .
description_long: Skin dancer Skin dancers were creatures that wore the flesh of human beings in an attempt to appear human . Abilities . If a skindancer stole another person ' s skin , their victim became a skin dancer . A skindancer would be returned to normal if a " restoration " spell was cast on them .

title: Skin kite
description: Skin kite A skin kite is an animated slice of skin that is constantly in danger of rotting away . Physical description . No two skin kites look identical , as their bodies are made of the skin type and color of their recent prey .
description_long: Skin kite A skin kite is an animated slice of skin that is constantly in danger of rotting away . Physical description . No two skin kites look identical , as their bodies are made of the skin type and color of their recent prey . It is not uncommon for skin kites to have random clumps of hair , furthering their gruesome appearance . Normally , skin kite weigh 5 pounds and have a wingspan of 5 feet . Combat . Like dead leaves , they fall from the sky on their victims , where they " meld " with their prey ' s skin , tearing off a section and absorbing it . In this way they replenish their rotting bodies long enough to find more victims .

title: Skip Williams
description: Skip Williams Ralph Williams , almost always referred to as Skip Williams , is an American game designer . He is probably best known today as co - creator of Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition and as the longtime author of Dragon Magazine ' s column " Sage Advice , " a position he recently vacated ( now writes the column ) . Williams ' professional involvement in the industry goes back to the first edition AD & D game and even beyond ; Williams is credited in the preface to the 1978 Advanced Dungeons & Dragons Player ' s Handbook among many other works .
description_long: Skip Williams Ralph Williams , almost always referred to as Skip Williams , is an American game designer . He is probably best known today as co - creator of Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition and as the longtime author of Dragon Magazine ' s column " Sage Advice , " a position he recently vacated ( now writes the column ) . Williams ' professional involvement in the industry goes back to the first edition AD & D game and even beyond ; Williams is credited in the preface to the 1978 Advanced Dungeons & Dragons Player ' s Handbook among many other works . When TSR , Inc . was purchased by Wizards of the Coast , he moved from Wisconsin to Washington and worked on the 3rd Edition design team . Though he was laid off from Wizards of the Coast in 2002 , he continues to produce D & D and d20 material on a freelance basis . His most recent publications include " Cry Havoc ! " published by Monte Cook ' s Malhavoc Press and " Races of the Wild " from Wizards of the Coast .

title: Skixtalq
description: Skixtalq Skixtalq , also known as Skixtalq the Obscurant , was one of the most powerful elder orb s in Faerûn . Activities . The beholder was the Chosen of Gzemnid , who was said to have send visions to it .
description_long: Skixtalq Skixtalq , also known as Skixtalq the Obscurant , was one of the most powerful elder orb s in Faerûn . Activities . The beholder was the Chosen of Gzemnid , who was said to have send visions to it . For its position , Skixtalq was greatly respected in Zokir and the rulers of the city regularly sought its counsel . Skixtalq could be considered to be a kind of sage , being the hive ' s preeminent acquirer of knowledge . It acquired its moniker as a result of Skixtalq ' s relentless efforts to erase knowledge about beholders on the surface . Often , it had its charmed agents attack libraries and sages , stealing or destroying tomes about beholders and silencing arcane scholars who studied them .

title: Skoraeus
description: Skoraeus Skoraeus Stonebones was a titan worshiped as a god by the stone giant s . His holy symbol was a stalactite . Unlike other titans , he had no realm of his own and wandered the mountain regions of the Elemental Chaos .
description_long: Skoraeus Skoraeus Stonebones was a titan worshiped as a god by the stone giant s . His holy symbol was a stalactite . Unlike other titans , he had no realm of his own and wandered the mountain regions of the Elemental Chaos . His only concern was with the affairs of the stone giant people .

title: Skortchclaw
description: Skortchclaw Skortchclaw was a large tribe of orc s located in the Spine of the World . Activities . In 1370 DR , the clan leader , King Ugra Ngarl , was forcing goblin slaves to mine mithral from beneath Fortress Eyegad .
description_long: Skortchclaw Skortchclaw was a large tribe of orc s located in the Spine of the World . Activities . In 1370 DR , the clan leader , King Ugra Ngarl , was forcing goblin slaves to mine mithral from beneath Fortress Eyegad . Large quantities of the metal were being sold to a buyer in the High Forest . History . In 1372 DR , Pharaun Mizzrym and Ryld Argith discovered the Skortchclaw symbol carved into a wall in the Braeryn district of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . That indicated isolated members of the Skortchclaw tribe in Menzoberranzan were involved in an uprising led by the alhoon Syrzan against the priestesses of the city .

title: Skouloun
description: Skouloun Skouloun was one of the Nimbral Lords . He was a sharp - witted and sharp - tongued figure and one of the leading Elders . History .
description_long: Skouloun Skouloun was one of the Nimbral Lords . He was a sharp - witted and sharp - tongued figure and one of the leading Elders . History . In order to have moneys for his magic research Skouloun sold many rival wizards to the shadovar . Skouloun was planewalking when the Spellplague hit , so escaping the disaster . He started study a powerful longevity spell until 1487 DR when he resurfaced and competed with his fellow Elder Yusendre and other archmages for possession of the Lost Spell , a key element for his spell , during a spellstorm . He however was killed by Tabra for his dealing with the shadovar .

title: Skovac
description: Skovac Skovac was a wight in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . Personality . Skovac ' s only objective was to protect the temple ' s relic .
description_long: Skovac Skovac was a wight in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . Personality . Skovac ' s only objective was to protect the temple ' s relic . He was bitter in undeath and resented the living . History . In life , Skovac was the leader of the Circle of the Scales , a group of druid worshiping dragon s in a temple in the Dragonspire Mountains . However , he proclaimed that thanks to a scale of Tiamat herself , he could dominate all dragons . One day , the red dragon Scorlworyx attacked the Circle and killed most of the members bar Skovac . He sealed himself inside the temple with the relic . In time , he became a wight . In 1489 DR , the reformed Cult of the Dragon agents Tibeem and Spernik discovered the whole story of Skovac . In order to gain the alliance of Scorlworyx , Spernik and a host of kobold s reached the temple . However , an adventuring party hired to capture Spernik also found the location . In the temple , the adventurers killed Skovac .

title: Skred
description: Skred Skred was a male troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for his tribe . Description . Skred wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on his raids .
description_long: Skred Skred was a male troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for his tribe . Description . Skred wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on his raids . He typically wrapped himself in a cloak and wielded an over - sized morningstar . Personality . He took great enjoyment in battle , especially close - quarters fighting . Skred ' s sojourns were often motivated by the allure of acquiring treasure from those he defeated . Abilities . A fine tracker , Skred was an experienced traveler in the Underdark and was quite good at listening to his quarry ' s movements . In battle , although not overly strong , he was a furious combatant who wielded an over - sized morningstar with deadly effect . If needed , Skred could shift his attacks to smash an opponent ' s weapon or intersperse vicious swipes of his claw between his morningstar ' s blows . Despite his barbarian rages leaving him heedless to attacks , Skred could rely on his uncanny reflexes and troglodyte stench to see him through a fight . Possessions . On Skred ' s hunts , he was well - equipped with a number of magic item s .

title: Skriaxit
description: Skriaxit Skriaxits ( also known as blackstorms and living sandstorms were malevolent air elemental s . They were retributive spirits summoned from the Elemental Plane of Air millennia ago by ancient gods . Skriaxits could whip up powerful sandstorms that can ripped the flesh from their victims within minutes .
description_long: Skriaxit Skriaxits ( also known as blackstorms and living sandstorms were malevolent air elemental s . They were retributive spirits summoned from the Elemental Plane of Air millennia ago by ancient gods . Skriaxits could whip up powerful sandstorms that can ripped the flesh from their victims within minutes . Creatures killed by skriaxits were animated three days later as desert wraith s , malevolent spirits of the sands . These creatures had two forms , that of a human and that of a jackal . Their goal was to destroy any living creature that they encountered .

title: Skuerren Skargettian
description: Skuerren Skargettian Skuerren Skargettian was a duergar tavern owner in Skullport . History . Skuerren managed the Thrown Gauntlet , a tavern known for offering violent spectacles of armed and unarmed combat at least once a tenday .
description_long: Skuerren Skargettian Skuerren Skargettian was a duergar tavern owner in Skullport . History . Skuerren managed the Thrown Gauntlet , a tavern known for offering violent spectacles of armed and unarmed combat at least once a tenday . Skuerren paid gangs to " recruit " combatants in the streets , but volunteers were welcome . A hulking troll kin bouncer named Stonebreaker kept control of the situation .

title: Skuld
description: Skuld Skuld was located on the coast of the Alamber Sea . Prior to the Spellplague , Skuld was the capital city of the nation of Mulhorand . The City of Eternity , as it was also known , was claimed to be the oldest inhabited settlement in Faerûn , and , before its destruction , was certainly the largest .
description_long: Skuld Skuld was located on the coast of the Alamber Sea . Prior to the Spellplague , Skuld was the capital city of the nation of Mulhorand . The City of Eternity , as it was also known , was claimed to be the oldest inhabited settlement in Faerûn , and , before its destruction , was certainly the largest . The Spellplague completely destroyed Skuld , burying its streets and buildings in rubble . History . The city of Skuld was built in approximately - 2100 DR , and in that time no invading force succeeded in breaching its walls . Pre - Spellplague . Geography . The city of Skuld was surrounded by defensive battlements that , until the Spellplague , remained intact for over 35 centuries , though slave quarters existed outside this barrier , extending from the eastern gate . The city was divided into a number of districts , separated from one another by additional walls . City Catacombs . The temple of Osiris could be found between the merchant and warehouse districts . Built along the southern wall of the city , this temple served as the only official entrance to Skuld ' s catacombs .

title: Skulk
description: Skulk Skulks were a subrace of human kind , known to be stealthy cave - dwellers . History . Skulks originally descended from a tribe of nomadic human s who had wandered Calimshan after the defeat of the Djen .
description_long: Skulk Skulks were a subrace of human kind , known to be stealthy cave - dwellers . History . Skulks originally descended from a tribe of nomadic human s who had wandered Calimshan after the defeat of the Djen . They were abducted by drow and forced into servitude in the city of Guallidurth for centuries , their descendants kept passive by their fear of the darkness surrounding them . They finally escaped when a giant lizard appeared from the darkness , drove off the drow overseers , and led the slaves away . The lizard was an avatar of Ibrandul known as the Stalker and through it , the humans learned his worship . While some of these men and women returned to the surface to spread Ibrandul ' s faith , the rest remained in the Underdark , surviving by raiding the farms and caravans of Guallidurth as well as those of human settlements on the surface . Over time ( and continued use of a particular spell provided by their god ) these people became the known as skulks and could thereafter be found living near many entrances to the Underdark .

title: Skulker ' s venom
description: Skulker ' s venom Skulker ’ s venom was the most basic of all abilities used by a skulker of Vhaeraun . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " skulker ' s venom " by invoking Vhaeraun ' s name and then striking his intended target with the poisoned weapon .
description_long: Skulker ' s venom Skulker ’ s venom was the most basic of all abilities used by a skulker of Vhaeraun . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " skulker ' s venom " by invoking Vhaeraun ' s name and then striking his intended target with the poisoned weapon . The target didn ' t only suffer physical damage , which became increasingly more severe as the skulker gained power , but became more susceptible to follow - up attacks , though the effect quickly dissipated as did the poison if not used fast . A truly accomplished skulker could use this ability to temporarily weaken the target ' s offensive abilities .

title: Skulker of Vhaeraun
description: Skulker of Vhaeraun A skulker of Vhaeraun was a catch - all term for followers of Vhaeraun in the post - Spellplague era . History . During the course of the War of the Spider Queen , Vhaeraun died but his church didn ' t collapse , at least not completely .
description_long: Skulker of Vhaeraun A skulker of Vhaeraun was a catch - all term for followers of Vhaeraun in the post - Spellplague era . History . During the course of the War of the Spider Queen , Vhaeraun died but his church didn ' t collapse , at least not completely . Followers who didn ' t believe or simply didn ' t know about their god ' s demise continued with their prayers to Vhaeraun and these prayers were answered , though none knew by exactly what . Whatever answered their prayers , it gave the Vhaeraunites their magical powers . Divine casters regained their spells and lay - worshipers also gained some minor abilities . For the drow , the post - Spellplague era was a time when Lolth ' s rule was almost unchecked due to the competition being dead . The church of Vhaeraun continued their opposition work while another religious alternative to Lolth was Ghaunadaur . Abilities . As a general rule , a skulker of Vhaeraun ' s abilities were directed at getting into places and coming safely out again , or they revolved around poison . All skulkers were able to increase the power of applied poison with an ability called " skulker ' s venom " .

title: Skull Crag
description: Skull Crag Skull Crag was a human hamlet in the Storm Horns to the northwest of Cormyr . It was a mining community with a population of 270 around 1372 DR . The settlement was overshadowed by a large rock that had been made into a shrine to Kelemvor .
description_long: Skull Crag Skull Crag was a human hamlet in the Storm Horns to the northwest of Cormyr . It was a mining community with a population of 270 around 1372 DR . The settlement was overshadowed by a large rock that had been made into a shrine to Kelemvor .

title: Skull Staff
description: Skull Staff The Skull Staff was a landmark and territorial marker on the western fringe of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Description . It was a massive broken log , up to 15 feet ( 4 .
description_long: Skull Staff The Skull Staff was a landmark and territorial marker on the western fringe of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Description . It was a massive broken log , up to 15 feet ( 4 . 5 meters ) thick and standing 30 feet ( 9 meters ) high , jutting out of the ground at a steep angle . Its base was surrounded by a many and varied number of skulls heaped about it , and more lined its sides , held in place by iron spikes and wooden stakes . Smaller hunks of wood held lone skulls further away from the main mass . There were skulls of beings such as orc s , goblin s , hobgoblin s , troll s , lizardfolk , and ogre s ; monsters like hydra s ; and animals like crocodile s and dire boar s . Geography . It stood just within the swamp on its south - western shore , beyond a waterlogged thicket and a stand of weeping willow trees . A muddy path wended around the Skull Staff and ran between bogs and deeper into the Vast Swamp , with felled trees bridging the water . The path led to the Lost Refuge , some ten miles ( 16 kilometers ) away . History .

title: Skull eyes
description: Skull eyes Skull eyes was a transmutation spell available only to cleric s of Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It was similar to the " eyebite " spell except it " charmed " or " confused " its targets . Effects .
description_long: Skull eyes Skull eyes was a transmutation spell available only to cleric s of Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It was similar to the " eyebite " spell except it " charmed " or " confused " its targets . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to perform gaze attacks on three or more victims , one at a time . The intended targets had to be alive ( not undead ) , in sight , and within 45 ft ( 14 m ) . More experienced casters could extend the range and duration , allowing more time to attack more targets . Each victim got a chance to resist the magic of this spell and , if successful , suffer no ill effects . The caster could choose between a " charm " effect , very similar to the " charm monster " spell , or a " confusion " effect for each victim in turn , until the spell duration expired or until no more targets were available , whichever came first . As a harmless but dramatic side - effect of this spell , the caster ' s eyes turned jet black with irises shaped like skulls . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Skull of secrets
description: Skull of secrets Skull of secrets was a divine magic available to priests of Cyric , the Black Sun . It created the image of a floating skull that could recite a message and shoot a tongue of flame . Effects .
description_long: Skull of secrets Skull of secrets was a divine magic available to priests of Cyric , the Black Sun . It created the image of a floating skull that could recite a message and shoot a tongue of flame . Effects . The floating skull had eyes of red flame and trailed black flames when it moved around inside a fixed sphere with a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius . The caster could choose the center of the sphere to be a point 105 ft ( 32 m ) away ( even farther for more experienced casters ) . The image was intangible and the flames were not real . The skull moved at fairly rapid pace and was highly maneuverable . The message to be delivered and the conditions necessary to trigger the message and the tongue of flame were set at the time of casting in a manner similar to a " magic mouth " spell . The instructions could be complex and could be different for the message and the flame attack . The message had to be no greater than twenty - two words in length and could not be a magical incantation . The tongue of flame could shoot from the mouth of the skull for 10 ft ( 3 m ) and it was 1 ft ( 30 cm ) in diameter at the widest part of the cone .

title: Skull watch
description: Skull watch Skull watch was a necromancy spell that created a watchful guardian that sounded an alarm when a living creature was detected . An older version of this spell had a much shorter duration but was otherwise practically identical in effect . Effects .
description_long: Skull watch Skull watch was a necromancy spell that created a watchful guardian that sounded an alarm when a living creature was detected . An older version of this spell had a much shorter duration but was otherwise practically identical in effect . Effects . The primary material component of this spell was an intact skull and jaw bone from an intelligent creature ( the later versions specified a humanoid creature ) . When cast , the spell caused the skull to become sensitive to life in a 20 ft ( 6 . 1 m ) wide by 90 ft ( 27 . 4 m ) corridor emanating from the eye sockets , as if the skull were gazing down said corridor . The skull could be positioned by resting it on a surface or it would hover in the place it was held as the spell was being cast . If any living creature entered the warded corridor , the skull immediately let out a piercing shriek that could be heard up to a quarter mile ( 400 m ) away and was telepathically heard by the caster as long as he or she remained on the same plane as the skull . After the alarm was triggered , a hovering skull floated gently to the ground .

title: Skullbreaker
description: Skullbreaker Skullbreaker , also known as Skullcrusher , was a mace belonging to the dwarven cleric Ambergris . Description . Skullbreaker was nearly 4 ft ( 1 .
description_long: Skullbreaker Skullbreaker , also known as Skullcrusher , was a mace belonging to the dwarven cleric Ambergris . Description . Skullbreaker was nearly 4 ft ( 1 . 2 m ) in length , with a core of polished hardwood and a black leather handle . History . Ambergris carried the weapon with her during her time with the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun .
