Some of the mountains were enormous , with peaks reaching over 20 , 000 feet above sea level . The western slopes were covered with trees , a forest known as Shilmista . The River Valashar begins in Shilmista , formed from the accumulation of waters from three waterfalls in the mountains . The Shining Stream , a major tributary of the River Ith also flowed down from the Snowflakes . Inhabitants . It was home for many millennia to the great red dragon Fyrentennimarr , until he was slain by Cadderly Bonaduce and company . The lich Priamon Rakesk maintained a lair in a tower hidden among the mountains . History . Its northeastern peaks housed the camouflaged Castle Trinity , a castle built into the rock face and hidden to all but the most observant .

title: Snowflake obsidian
description: Snowflake obsidian Snowflake Obsidian was a variety of obsidian found in large deposits of volcanic origin . Description . This ornamental stone was black volcanic glass with grayish splashes in the matrix that often exhibited snowflake - like symmetry if cut correctly .
description_long: Snowflake obsidian Snowflake Obsidian was a variety of obsidian found in large deposits of volcanic origin . Description . This ornamental stone was black volcanic glass with grayish splashes in the matrix that often exhibited snowflake - like symmetry if cut correctly . It was brittle and weak , but could be used for small carvings . It was either tumbled and sold as a gemstone , or quarried in " trade blocks " ( large , irregular chunks ) of up to 25 lb ( 12 kg ) each . A typical gemstone had a base value of 10 gp . Powers . Snowflake obsidian could mitigate damage to creatures or objects from dragon ' s breath . A piece of this gemstone at least the size of a thumbnail had to be worn on the outside of armor or mounted on the outer surface of an object . When exposed to dragon ' s breath , the stone absorbed an unpredictable portion of the damage and disintegrated .

title: Snowflower
description: Snowflower The snowflower was a plant that grew in cold climates . Description . Like an arctic version of tumbleweed , snowflowers tumbled across the ice in the wind .
description_long: Snowflower The snowflower was a plant that grew in cold climates . Description . Like an arctic version of tumbleweed , snowflowers tumbled across the ice in the wind . They had vibrant purple , pink , or yellow - green flowers . Ecology . Snowflowers grew in crevices in ice and rock . The snowflower was edible by humanoid s . It was also a favorite of ice worm s , long furry creatures that dwelt in glaciers . Usage . The snowflower could be used as a component in perfume . Location . The snowflower could be found on the Great Glacier or on the High Ice .

title: Snowhair the Sorceress
description: Snowhair the Sorceress Snowhair the Sorceress was a character appearing in a ballad about the rumored Bryndar of Brynwood in the Vast . According to one tale about the Bryndar , they were real human women who adopted animal forms to discourage anyone who ventured into their forest . A certain minstrel wrote a ballad about one of these women , whom he named " Snowhair the Sorceress " .
description_long: Snowhair the Sorceress Snowhair the Sorceress was a character appearing in a ballad about the rumored Bryndar of Brynwood in the Vast . According to one tale about the Bryndar , they were real human women who adopted animal forms to discourage anyone who ventured into their forest . A certain minstrel wrote a ballad about one of these women , whom he named " Snowhair the Sorceress " . She was depicted as a scornful , white - haired mage . Appendix . Notes . Snowhair the Sorceress only appears in the ballad , and thus is assumed to be fictional . However , as the Bryndar are speculated to be real , it is possible that Snowhair the Sorceress is based on a real person .

title: Snowshoes
description: Snowshoes Snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It allowed one creature to walk over snow and ice at the same rate as if it were normal ground . Effects .
description_long: Snowshoes Snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It allowed one creature to walk over snow and ice at the same rate as if it were normal ground . Effects . While casting this spell , the caster had to touch the creature being targeted for this spell to take effect . Assuming the target did not willfully resist , he , she , or it could travel over icy or snowy terrain without any hindrance of movement typically associated with ice , snow , or heavy snow . In addition , this spell significantly helped prevent slips , falls , and other mishaps that could occur when attempting skills or maneuvers requiring balance or dexterity on ice and snow . It also helped prevent the recipient from cracking ice or falling through already cracked ice caused by their weight . For beginning casters , this spell lasted one hour or until it was dismissed , whichever came first . Higher level casters could make this effect last many hours . While under the influence of this spell , creatures treading over ice and snow were no easier to track than they were walking on dry , solid ground . Components .

title: Snùt
description: Snùt Snùt was a goblin messenger in Northdark . Personality . Snùt was easily terrified and betrayed his clients if his life was in danger .
description_long: Snùt Snùt was a goblin messenger in Northdark . Personality . Snùt was easily terrified and betrayed his clients if his life was in danger . History . In 1479 DR a female drow from Menzoberranzan payed Snùt to sent to a group of deep gnome s a message saying that a group of drow slavers soon arrived at the Passage of Old Mine ( in truth they were adventurers hired by House Xorlarrin , House Melarn and Bregan D ' aerthe on their way to the Sezz ' ia outpost .

title: So - Kehur
description: So - Kehur So - Kehur is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . So - Kehur is quite corpulent for a Mulan .
description_long: So - Kehur So - Kehur is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . So - Kehur is quite corpulent for a Mulan . He often wears a wand dangling from his belt . Personality . So - Kehur never wanted to become a necromancer or any kind of wizard but his family pushed him into it . So - Kehur would have been content to stay home and manage his family ' s estates . Importance . So - Kehur often accompanied his fellow necromancer Muthoth . Both played a key role during the battle at the Keep of Sorrows by killing the enemy warriors with the help of their dark craft and raising them as undead to add to Szass Tam ' s forces . So - Kehur is mind - bound to Szass meaning that he has to fulfill every order from Szass on danger of death . Background . So - Kehur is the brother of Nephis Sepret , wife of Ramas Ankhalab , autharch of Anhaurz in Lapendrar . He achieved his position by help of Szass Tam himself . History . in circa 1372 So - Kehur was a cleric of Kossuth in the Thayan enclave of Proskur ; after he was recalled home and train as Red Wizard Necromancer

title: So Golin - po
description: So Golin - po So Golin - po , nicknamed the Hojyko Yada ( meaning " mountain badger " ) , was a human yakuza who was head of the Bakshi yakuza clan and through them the " de facto " ruler of the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Activities . As the clanhead of the Bakshi , So Golin - po was the mastermind behind their rise to power over Ojy - do and the true ruler of the city .
description_long: So Golin - po So Golin - po , nicknamed the Hojyko Yada ( meaning " mountain badger " ) , was a human yakuza who was head of the Bakshi yakuza clan and through them the " de facto " ruler of the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Activities . As the clanhead of the Bakshi , So Golin - po was the mastermind behind their rise to power over Ojy - do and the true ruler of the city . Although the city was nominally ruled by a governor appointed by King Wanang Sun , the Bakshi were able to manipulate the governor . Golin - po controlled both the city guard and the criminal underworld . He and the Bakshi worked only to gouge money from the city , which became dilapidated . Taking it as a personal insult , Golin - po was quick to order the murder of anyone who had the temerity to steal or con in his city , or who tried to shake his grip on power . Many who opposed the Bakshi were killed . Golin - po was actually seen himself , remaining closely guarded by his henchmen in his compound . However , each day he taught his combat techniques to students in the courtyard or garden . Those who offended the Hojyko Yada were often dragged in and beheaded during a practice fight .

title: Soapstone
description: Soapstone Soapstone , also known as steatite , was a soft and brittle but easily worked hardstone . Description . This harder version of was found in colors ranging from white to green and was often dyed other colors .
description_long: Soapstone Soapstone , also known as steatite , was a soft and brittle but easily worked hardstone . Description . This harder version of was found in colors ranging from white to green and was often dyed other colors . Easily worked by unskilled hands for low - detail carving , it could hold intricate patterns but was not hard enough to hold delicate shapes . It could be easily polished to a warm , glossy finish . A typical price was 9 sp per lb ( 20 sp per kg ) . Powers . Colloquial wisdom gave soapstone some mystical properties involving fire or capturing warmth , but these have not yet been proven .

title: Soares
description: Soares Soares was a thug in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Soares was a charming and sure - of - himself individual .
description_long: Soares Soares was a thug in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Soares was a charming and sure - of - himself individual . He indulged in compliments if they gave him an advantage over others . He was afraid to deceive his new masters however . History . Soares was a thug and a mercenary in Phlan until he was recruited by the Cult of the Dragon . One of his first missions in 1489 DR was to silence an adventuring party hired to recover some stolen books but he was defeated and killed .

title: Soargar
description: Soargar Soargar was one of the founders of the new Impiltur . History . Soargar was the archmage of the Elethlim dynasty and in his role he witnessed the plague that in 922 DR killed most of the family , the disappearance at sea of Princess Aliia in 924 DR , and finally the fragmentation of the kingdom in 926 DR .
description_long: Soargar Soargar was one of the founders of the new Impiltur . History . Soargar was the archmage of the Elethlim dynasty and in his role he witnessed the plague that in 922 DR killed most of the family , the disappearance at sea of Princess Aliia in 924 DR , and finally the fragmentation of the kingdom in 926 DR . Afterward , he kept in his care most of the royal treasures of Impiltur , hoping to one day renew the country . In 1095 DR , Soargar , along with his apprentice Sambral and the visiting archmage Velgarbrin of Baldur ' s Gate , helped the War Captain of Lyrabar , Imphras Heltharn , to destroy a goblinoid horde . In the battle , Soargar was fatally injured but before he died he told Imphras where he had hidden the Impilturan treasures and encouraged him to use them to become the new king .

title: Soargyl
description: Soargyl The Soargyl family is a noble house of Sembia . It is seated in the city of Selgaunt , and a sworn enemy of the House Uskevren . Their family badge is silver swans on a backdrop of green , and their motto is " Always even in the end .
description_long: Soargyl The Soargyl family is a noble house of Sembia . It is seated in the city of Selgaunt , and a sworn enemy of the House Uskevren . Their family badge is silver swans on a backdrop of green , and their motto is " Always even in the end . " They are rumored to use necromancy . Properties . The family owns a mansion , Sarntrumpet Towers , in the heart of Selgaunt .

title: Soarimbrar the Younger
description: Soarimbrar the Younger Soarimbrar Heltharn the Younger was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Soarimbrar was the son of Prince Verimlaun .
description_long: Soarimbrar the Younger Soarimbrar Heltharn the Younger was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Soarimbrar was the son of Prince Verimlaun . He was named after his grandfather . He had an older sister named Ilmara . Soarimbrar was related to King Imphras II through Imphras ' fourth son Velimbrar . History . Born in 1335 DR , Soarimbrar was declared king of Impiltur at the age of three years when King Rilimbrar , Queen Ilbritha , Crown Prince Imphras IV , and his own father , Prince Verimlaun all died in a mysterious fire at the royal tower . Because Soarimbrar was too young to rule , his relative , Princess Sambryl , became Queen - Regent , as it was determined that her husband , Imphras IV , died " after " her father King Rilimbrar , and thus she had become a queen . King Soarimbrar , however , never lived to see the throne . He was murdered only a matter of days before his coronation when he had come of age in 1351 DR . He had been riding through some farmlands near Lyrabar and his entire retinue died with him . His assassins were never caught . Soarimbrar ' s nephew Imphras V became the next king , but he , too , was not old enough to reign .

title: Society of Brilliance
description: Society of Brilliance The Society of Brilliance was a neutral society consisting of a few scholars represented by various races in the Underdark . Dogma . Their goal was to study the Underdark , hoping to gain a better understanding about the terrain where they lived .
description_long: Society of Brilliance The Society of Brilliance was a neutral society consisting of a few scholars represented by various races in the Underdark . Dogma . Their goal was to study the Underdark , hoping to gain a better understanding about the terrain where they lived . History . They went on a pilgrimage to Gravenhollow some years before the Rage of Demons .

title: Society of the Jade Empress
description: Society of the Jade Empress The Society of the Jade Empress was a secret society in Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Jade Empress planned to reestablish the Hai dynasty on throne .
description_long: Society of the Jade Empress The Society of the Jade Empress was a secret society in Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Jade Empress planned to reestablish the Hai dynasty on throne . For this , they wanted to kill all of the Chin dynasty imperial family , a very hard task . They were based in Hai Yuan . History . The Society of the Jade Empress had been planning their assassination plot for a long time . They gathered allies in most of the monasteries of Hai Yuan and killed many of the lowest - ranking local Shou bureaucrats .

title: Society of the Kuo - Tan
description: Society of the Kuo - Tan The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a secret society secretly helping Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a vigilante organization .
description_long: Society of the Kuo - Tan The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a secret society secretly helping Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a vigilante organization . They investigated corruption , evil , and vice in the court or abroad and when they discovered any they took lethal countermeasures . History . The Society of the Kuo - Tan split from the Tsui Tong when it started to become corrupt . The original founders of the Tsui created the Kuo - Tan to stop their now - evil first creation . In time , they gained the tacit support of the Emperors . In 1357 DR , one of their most powerful members was the maternal grandfather of the current Emperor Kai Chin .

title: Society of the Sword
description: Society of the Sword The Society of the Sword was the largest and oldest mercenary company in Chessenta and also active in the Vilhon Reach around 1358 DR . Organization . Contracts .
description_long: Society of the Sword The Society of the Sword was the largest and oldest mercenary company in Chessenta and also active in the Vilhon Reach around 1358 DR . Organization . Contracts . They wanted only high - profile jobs , never against a weak opponent . Employers were required to also pay for transportation , food , and additional equipment . They payed shares to the beneficiaries of slain members . They charged 1500 gold piece s per week for their services , or 300 gp per day for shorter jobs . History . The Society was founded in the mid - 1200s DR . During Stilmus ' s leadership , the Society was obsessed by honor and developed a grudge against the Renegades .

title: Society of the Verdant Arrow
description: Society of the Verdant Arrow The Society of the Verdant Arrow is an anti - human organization that met at Mytela Halvasyn ' s house around 1368 DR . The organization was made up of the half - elf descendants of Lady Mytela Halvasyn , who advocated the banishment of human s from Aglarond , thereby returning it to the way things were during the days of the Yuir elves . The members were particularly frustrated by the often - absent human ruler of Aglarond , the Simbul , and strongly opposed the Sons of Hoar .
description_long: Society of the Verdant Arrow The Society of the Verdant Arrow is an anti - human organization that met at Mytela Halvasyn ' s house around 1368 DR . The organization was made up of the half - elf descendants of Lady Mytela Halvasyn , who advocated the banishment of human s from Aglarond , thereby returning it to the way things were during the days of the Yuir elves . The members were particularly frustrated by the often - absent human ruler of Aglarond , the Simbul , and strongly opposed the Sons of Hoar . The organization was led by Guthrae in 1368 DR , and Caytran Halvasyn in 1374 DR . Only the wealthier half - elves were allowed to join .

title: Sofir Naj - kri
description: Sofir Naj - kri Sofir Naj - kri was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . As the head of the College of Alchemy , Sofir possessed a natural love of chemicals .
description_long: Sofir Naj - kri Sofir Naj - kri was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . As the head of the College of Alchemy , Sofir possessed a natural love of chemicals . She and one other instructor taught all of the classes that dealt with alchemy . Since she lacked the formulas for many rare potions , Sofir would potentially wave tuition fees in exchange for such a formula .

title: Soft Whisper
description: Soft Whisper The Soft Whisper was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Hakiyah , the Zakharan goddess of truth and honesty . The symbol of the Soft Whisper was a jade jambiya . Activities .
description_long: Soft Whisper The Soft Whisper was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Hakiyah , the Zakharan goddess of truth and honesty . The symbol of the Soft Whisper was a jade jambiya . Activities . An enemy of the Grand Caliph was an enemy of the Soft Whisper . It was unknown whether or not the Grand Caliph gave commands to the Soft Whisper , but those who spoke out against him met swift ends at the hands of these skilled assassins . Within Huzuz it was rumored that the Grand Vizier merely had to go pray at the Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest if she discovered a threat to the Grand Caliph ' s life and wished to have it eliminated . Organization . The Soft Whisper was the only holy slayer organization where all of the members were female . They were led by Grandmother Rahmah al - Zahir . Base of Operations . Holy slayers of the Soft Whisper were active throughout the Land of Fate , but Golden Huzuz was the seat of their power . Several members of the Soft Whisper held positions of power with the royal harim of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne . The basement of the Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest housed several members of the Soft Whisper .

title: Soften earth and stone
description: Soften earth and stone Soften earth and stone is a transmutation spell turns stone to clay or dirt to sand and mud . Effect . When this spell is cast , all natural , undressed earth or stone in the spell ' s area is softened .
description_long: Soften earth and stone Soften earth and stone is a transmutation spell turns stone to clay or dirt to sand and mud . Effect . When this spell is cast , all natural , undressed earth or stone in the spell ' s area is softened . Wet earth becomes thick mud ; dry earth becomes loose sand or dirt ; and stone becomes soft clay that is easily molded or chopped . You affect a 10 - foot - square area to a depth of 1 to 4 feet , depending on the toughness or resilience of the ground at that spot ( DM ' s option ) . Magical , enchanted , dressed , or worked stone cannot be affected . Earth or stone creatures are not affected . Creatures in mud must succeed at Reflex saves or be caught for 1d2 rounds and unable to move , attack , or cast spells . Creatures who succeed at their saves can move through the mud at half speed , and they can ' t run or charge . Loose dirt is not as troublesome as mud , but all creatures in the area are reduced to half their normal speed and can ' t run or charge over the surface . Stone softened into clay does not hinder movement , but it does allow characters to cut , shape , or excavate areas they may not have been able to affect before .

title: Sohang Gitse
description: Sohang Gitse Sohang Gitse was a gambler yakuza in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Sohang Gitse took bets on any and all contests in the tournament .
description_long: Sohang Gitse Sohang Gitse was a gambler yakuza in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Sohang Gitse took bets on any and all contests in the tournament . Although technically a criminal , he was scrupulously honest about the gambling he managed . Sohang had a vast network of informants to help him set odds for each fight . He had gathered a great deal information on specific fighters , judges , and the tournament in general , which he would share with anyone for a price .

title: Sohei
description: Sohei Sohei were special warrior - priests that could be found in Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . In Shou Lung , they were called no - sheng . Role .
description_long: Sohei Sohei were special warrior - priests that could be found in Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . In Shou Lung , they were called no - sheng . Role . Sohei usually served as guardians for monasteries . Abilities . These individuals focused more on the warrior aspects of their lives , training extensively with weapons as well as martial arts . They also possessed limited magical powers .

title: Sojourn
description: Sojourn Sojourn is the third book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .
description_long: Sojourn Sojourn is the third book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore . It was later reissued as book three of the Legend of Drizzt series . Summary . Drizzt Do ' Urden , a forty - year - old renegade drow who has forsaken the ways of his evil people to live a better life on the surface of Faerûn , greets the dawn each morning to acclimatize himself to his new home , in spite of the great pain it causes him . To the rogue drow , the sun represents his denial of the other darker world of the Underdark , especially of the city of Menzoberranzan . Alongside him sits his faithful companion , the astral panther Guenhwyvar . After a disastrous run - in with a skunk one day , Drizzt decides to leave in search of a new home further down the mountainside . He encounters a group of gnoll s who invite him to be an ally . Being naive to the ways of the world , Drizzt doesn ' t know they are evil until they outline a plan to raid a local farm and kill and enslave the humans living therein . With the aid of Guenhwyvar , he slays the band , but for some time after feels remorse in doing so . It is at this point that he decides to learn more about the races living around him .

title: Sokol Keep
description: Sokol Keep Sokol Keep was located on Thorn Island near Phlan . Structure . It was an ancient fortress with stone walls charred , grayed , and desolated from dragon fire .
description_long: Sokol Keep Sokol Keep was located on Thorn Island near Phlan . Structure . It was an ancient fortress with stone walls charred , grayed , and desolated from dragon fire . In 1480 DR , a beacon was placed on the highest tower to be utilized as a light house . Interior . In the large courtyard of the keep , dragon fire burned and destroyed most of the wooden buildings that lined the courtyard , the only exception was the stone building of the temple of Tyr . The shrine was primarily intact , but the wooden bell tower was in disrepair . The temple was located in the far left corner of the courtyard passed the old wooden gates . In the center of the courtyard was the keep ' s old mess hall , which was an open airy building with tables . The charred stable and blacksmith shop were on the right with a rotting shed and barracks on the immediate left . History . Tyrian Temple . In approximately 1290 DR , construction of the Temple of Tyr on Thorn Island was finished ; however , it was never used by anyone other than the cleric s who built it . Shortly after completion , a flight of the dragon s burned and destroyed the keep in 1306 DR .

title: Solar
description: Solar Solars are the most powerful of all the angel s . A solar has a deep and commanding voice , and stands about 9 feet tall . It weighs about 500 pounds .
description_long: Solar Solars are the most powerful of all the angel s . A solar has a deep and commanding voice , and stands about 9 feet tall . It weighs about 500 pounds . Solars are powerful champions of good . Only the most powerful fiends approach their power . Solars have immense fighting prowess complemented by their magical greatsword s as well as composite bow s that allow the solar to equip any slaying arrow when drawn . A solar is an incredibly powerful extra - planar being and has many spell - like abilities at its disposal , including Power Word , Kill , invisibility and it can also polymorph into humanoid forms . In addition , to overall compliment their fighting abilities against evil , a solar also has the spellcasting ability of a very powerful cleric . The solars are the most powerful members of the angelic choirs . They often serve as the direct hand of the divine being to whom they owe their allegiance and seek to spread the influence of their patron god throughout the universe . Appearance . A solar appears to be a powerfully - built humanoid with flawless skin and beautiful features . Their body sometimes appears to be made of gold , silver , or some other precious metal .

title: Solara
description: Solara Solara was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Solara led the Company of the Singing Dawn .
description_long: Solara Solara was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Solara led the Company of the Singing Dawn . In 1358 DR , she heard rumors of a legion following the tactics of the old Chessentan Empire in Chondath and Solara decided to investigate , together with the Llandrydd ' s Steel group and Enhanen ' s men . She faced the undead army led by the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric . Personality . Solara looked to be a confident individual . She expected that all her men followed her orders without questions .

title: Solaufein
description: Solaufein Solaufein was a drow male living in Ust Natha and secretly a worshiper of Eilistraee . He grudgingly worked for the city ' s houses while at the same time not believing in the justification of the viciousness with which they dealt with other races and each other . He also had a particularly bitter relationship with Phaere , with whom he ' d had an actual romantic relationship in the past .
description_long: Solaufein Solaufein was a drow male living in Ust Natha and secretly a worshiper of Eilistraee . He grudgingly worked for the city ' s houses while at the same time not believing in the justification of the viciousness with which they dealt with other races and each other . He also had a particularly bitter relationship with Phaere , with whom he ' d had an actual romantic relationship in the past . She had been tortured when they had been found out , and now there was nothing left but her ambition . In the game " " , Solaufein is encountered if the player chooses to have their party disguised as drow and infiltrate Ust Natha in order to retrieve Adalon ' s eggs . Solaufein is put in charge of the newcomers , and generally accompanies them on their missions , the first of which is rescuing Phaere from a group of illithid . The player character can gain a degree of respect from Solaufein by showing the right kind of attitude and intelligence , affecting future interactions with him . He is generally depressed with his life , when not exchanging insults with Phaere ; she would have him killed at a whim if he did not have the protection of another house in the city .

title: Soldim Jedea
description: Soldim Jedea Soldim Jedea was a member of the Jedea family and the first ruler of the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta following its revolt from Unther in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . Soldim was the most powerful mage of the Jedea family , and it became standard practice for the family ' s best mages to rule the city . Soldim later founded the Jedea Academy , a school for magic .
description_long: Soldim Jedea Soldim Jedea was a member of the Jedea family and the first ruler of the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta following its revolt from Unther in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . Soldim was the most powerful mage of the Jedea family , and it became standard practice for the family ' s best mages to rule the city . Soldim later founded the Jedea Academy , a school for magic .

title: Solid fog
description: Solid fog Solid fog , formerly known as Veridon ' s solidifier , was a conjuration or alteration spell that created a tangible fog . Users . " Solid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s .
description_long: Solid fog Solid fog , formerly known as Veridon ' s solidifier , was a conjuration or alteration spell that created a tangible fog . Users . " Solid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s . In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive and Variation specializations . Effects . Functioning like its precursor " fog cloud " , the " solid fog " spell caused a cloud of fog to emanate from the point of origin , obscuring sight and concealing those within . It was also so dense that it slowed all movement within , forcing all creatures to a crawling pace and hindering both melee and ranged weapons , bar magic rays . It could even slow the descent of something falling through it . The " solid fog " would dissipate as a normal fog in a severe wind , and could not be cast underwater . A " permanency " spell made a " solid fog " permanent and continually reforming . Components . A casting of " solid fog " required a mixture of a pinch of powdered hoof from some animal , and a pinch of powdered dried pea s . History . The spell was created by the arcanist Veridon of Netheril , ruler of the enclave of Lathery .

title: Solid sand
description: Solid sand Solid sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This useful sand could be tossed upon any soft surface such as snow , mud , regular sand , and even quicksand , where it would instantly harden into a shell that could be walked upon .
description_long: Solid sand Solid sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This useful sand could be tossed upon any soft surface such as snow , mud , regular sand , and even quicksand , where it would instantly harden into a shell that could be walked upon . A handful of " solid sand " could be used to cover 500 square feet or less and lasted for 10 - 40 minutes .

title: Solom Ned ' razak
description: Solom Ned ' razak Solom Ned ' razak was a male drow wizard who was the Archmage of Szith Morcane and head of the Inverted Tower . Description . Solom was a middle - aged drow with a fine fashion sense and an air of hedonism .
description_long: Solom Ned ' razak Solom Ned ' razak was a male drow wizard who was the Archmage of Szith Morcane and head of the Inverted Tower . Description . Solom was a middle - aged drow with a fine fashion sense and an air of hedonism . He was ruggedly handsome , though not especially muscular , and wore a gold hoop in his left ear . His garb consisted of black trousers tucked into knee - high black leather boots , and a billowing purple shirt unbuttoned halfway down . A fine gold headband ( his " heaband of intellect " ) held his long white hair back from his face , and the sleeves of his shirt were tucked into elaborate gold bracers ( his " bracers of armor " ) A fine black cloak ( his " cloak of charisma " ) completed the ensemble . He smelt of perfume and incense . Personality . Ambitious and rebellious , even amid the matriarchal drow of Szith Morcane , Solom had long defied any dilution of his dominance over the Inverted Tower . When speaking with others , he would prefer to deal them from atop his ornate throne , where his authority was made most apparent . The archamge ' s aim was to one day turn Szith Morcane into a magocracy , like Sshamath , with himself as its undisputed ruler .

title: Solon
description: Solon Solon was a city in the Raurin desert . History . Solon was an Imaskar i city that was founded in - 6422 DR and became the capital city of Lower Imaskar during the Middle Kingdoms period of the empire .
description_long: Solon Solon was a city in the Raurin desert . History . Solon was an Imaskar i city that was founded in - 6422 DR and became the capital city of Lower Imaskar during the Middle Kingdoms period of the empire . After the fall of Imaskar , the ancient city of Solon sought to carve itself a new empire from the desert wastes . It succeeded for a time , gaining control of most of the land south of the Raurin Alta . It traded with Ra - Khati and Durpar . Slowly , however , as the desert spread further , Mulhorand took Gbor Nor , and Shou conquerors cut Solon ' s ties with the lands to the north , Solon lost its grip on its territories . After a succession of weak kings over a period of centuries , Solon was only left with the city itself which was then taken by the lich Ambuchar Devayam at the head of a Durpar i army . From the city , Ambuchar came close to conquering Ra - Khati but ultimately failed . He began digging up the city for imaskari artefacts , caring not a whit for his subjects and cutting off all trade .

title: Solonor Thelandira
description: Solonor Thelandira Solonor Thelandira ( pronounced soe " - loe - nohr theh - " lan " - dih - ruh " ) was the elven god of hunting , archery , and survival in wild and harsh places . He taught his followers the arts of hunting ; including archery , moving unseen and hiding in the wild places . He watched over the borders of wilderness and farmed land and sought to maintain the balance between them .
description_long: Solonor Thelandira Solonor Thelandira ( pronounced soe " - loe - nohr theh - " lan " - dih - ruh " ) was the elven god of hunting , archery , and survival in wild and harsh places . He taught his followers the arts of hunting ; including archery , moving unseen and hiding in the wild places . He watched over the borders of wilderness and farmed land and sought to maintain the balance between them . Solonor lived in the realm of Arvandor on the plane of Arborea . Description . Solonor manifested as a lean & muscular male elf clad in a cloak of leaves . Wolf , a Beast Totem Spirit worshipped by wild elves , was often depicted at the side of Solonor in religious iconography . Personality . Solonor always kept his word and so did not offer it lightly . He often came across as grim due to the complexities of his duty making compromises between those who wanted to exploit nature ' s gifts and those who wished to preserve nature in an unaltered state . Realm . Solonor ' s divine realm was called the Pale Tree and was located in the deepest , most dense part of Arvandor ' s unspoilt woodlands .

title: Soman Galt
description: Soman Galt Soman Galt was a former adventurer and Dagult Neverember ' s lacky . History . Around 1479 DR , Galt was mayor of Neverwinter .
description_long: Soman Galt Soman Galt was a former adventurer and Dagult Neverember ' s lacky . History . Around 1479 DR , Galt was mayor of Neverwinter . Personality . Even though Lord Neverember assumed Galt was his stooge , the mayor was actually under the control of the Abolethic Sovereignty .

title: Somatic component
description: Somatic component The somatic component was a basic part of spellcasting . Many spells required the caster to make a motion to cast the spell . If the caster was unable to make the correct motion , the spell could not be cast .
description_long: Somatic component The somatic component was a basic part of spellcasting . Many spells required the caster to make a motion to cast the spell . If the caster was unable to make the correct motion , the spell could not be cast . Wearing armor or using a shield interfered with the somatic components of arcane spells , creating a risk of spell failure . Bard s and some other arcane classes could cast spells in light armor without this risk , because their somatic components were less elaborate . Each spellcasting tradition had its own somatic components .

title: Somidorr Danthan
description: Somidorr Danthan Somidorr Danthan was a half - elf man and smuggler of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Somidorr made a number of shrewd decisions in his illicit trade , and by 1358 had become very rich and dangerous . He desired to increase his own power with the acquisition of magical item s , and didn ' t care who he took them from or how .
description_long: Somidorr Danthan Somidorr Danthan was a half - elf man and smuggler of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Somidorr made a number of shrewd decisions in his illicit trade , and by 1358 had become very rich and dangerous . He desired to increase his own power with the acquisition of magical item s , and didn ' t care who he took them from or how .

title: Somraggah
description: Somraggah Somraggah was a large town in Murghôm . Description . Somraggah was a large town in the nation of Murghôm that sat along the Road of the Dawn , and bordered the Plains of Purple Dust .
description_long: Somraggah Somraggah was a large town in Murghôm . Description . Somraggah was a large town in the nation of Murghôm that sat along the Road of the Dawn , and bordered the Plains of Purple Dust . Once an important trade route , with the opening of the River Rauthenflow to ships , and the cessation of trade through Solon , trade along the Road of the Dawn , and through Somraggah , dwindled . Adding to the city ' s hardship , the northward expansion of the Plains of Purple dust caused the once - fertile landscape around the city to dry up , devastating the crops of local farmers . However , large despots of jasper and chalcedony were discovered in the former riverbeds , and the dry landscape allowed date palms to grow well , allowing the city to remain prosperous despite these changes . As of 1359 DR , the city was known for its jewelers , gem cutters , and miners , and its dates were shipped as far as Impiltur and Shou Lung .

title: Son - liin
description: Son - liin Son - liin was a stormsoul genasi who grew up with her father in the wilds of Akanûl . History . In 1479 DR she was very young , just barely a teenager .
description_long: Son - liin Son - liin was a stormsoul genasi who grew up with her father in the wilds of Akanûl . History . In 1479 DR she was very young , just barely a teenager . Aoth Fezim took her along on the Brotherhood of the Griffon ' s expedition to kill the gray dragon Vairshekellabex . She was the force ' s primary scout because she knew the land so well . While on the expedition , she was charmed by Yemere , a steel dragon disguised as a genasi . Yemere forced Son - liin to take the expedition through a canyon that was infected by Spellplague and caused her to shoot an orc during a parlay , touching off a brief battle . The charm was broken when Gaedynn Ulraes and Aoth killed Yemere . After her time fighting for Aoth , she asked to join the Brotherhood and was accepted for membership although she was told it would be many years before she was given a griffon . Relationships . Gaedynn became a mentor of sorts to Son - liin , watching her back and teaching her battle techniques . Their close association caused her to develop a crush on Gaedynn , although it was unsure whether he shared her feelings or not . Appearance . Son - liin had purple skin .

title: Song
description: Song A song was a unit of time lasting a minute or two . It was the length of time it takes to sing a song . The school of song was a school of thaumaturgy , a group of spells that used songs and the voice as its central element .
description_long: Song A song was a unit of time lasting a minute or two . It was the length of time it takes to sing a song . The school of song was a school of thaumaturgy , a group of spells that used songs and the voice as its central element . Specialists in this school of magic were called spellsinger s or song mages .

title: Song dragon
description: Song dragon Song dragons were a type of dragon . They lived among human ity in the guise of human women . Physical description .
description_long: Song dragon Song dragons were a type of dragon . They lived among human ity in the guise of human women . Physical description . Song dragons resembled copper dragon s in general shape , but they were more slender and possessed iridescent silver - blue scales . This made them bright and impressive in appearance . A song dragon possessed a unique alternative form , that of an attractive human woman aged between 20 and 30 years old . Despite this restriction , song dragons could be male or female . Personality . Song dragons eschewed the company of other dragons , choosing instead to live amongst humankind , aided by their alternate forms as young human women . Many were also talented actor s . This made it extremely difficult to tell them apart from actual humans . They would reveal their real identities only when in great danger . They sought to protect and preserve the environment . To this end , they usually worked with or served the Harpers , good mage s , and other people and organizations of similar inclinations . However , to human civilization , they were rare and surrounded in mystery . Habitat . Song dragons lived throughout the lands of the Realms .

title: Song of Selûne
description: Song of Selûne The Song of Selûne was a legend about the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . The story . The story began with Selûne as a youthful and beautiful goddess , residing in a mystic realm populated by deities .
description_long: Song of Selûne The Song of Selûne was a legend about the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . The story . The story began with Selûne as a youthful and beautiful goddess , residing in a mystic realm populated by deities . Turning aside from a life of ease , she was impulsive and grew tired of life in her own plane . Thus , she " borrowed " a wand of power from a god known only as " her father " and used the wand to fly away in a bubble of force , so that she might experience life in other realms . In time , she traveled to a plane with a forbidding blood moon palely glowing over a barren land . There , Selûne was smitten by a mysterious and attractive warrior , a lord of his people . The stranger persuaded her to use the wand to transport him and his followers to Toril , riding upon winged beasts , where they planned to settle . However , once they landed , he revealed his true form and intentions — he was the monstrous Imgig Zu . He and his people were hideous shapechanging monsters , set on conquest and ruin . He seized her father ' s wand of power and intended to kill the deceived goddess .

title: Songfarla
description: Songfarla Songfarla was an ancient and hidden rock gnome realm located in the eastern spur of the Sunrise Mountains . Geography . Songfarla was located in the eastern Sunrise Mountains at the source of the most northwestern tributary of the River Murghol , which was approximately equidistant from the ruins of Delhumide and the Lake of Mists .
description_long: Songfarla Songfarla was an ancient and hidden rock gnome realm located in the eastern spur of the Sunrise Mountains . Geography . Songfarla was located in the eastern Sunrise Mountains at the source of the most northwestern tributary of the River Murghol , which was approximately equidistant from the ruins of Delhumide and the Lake of Mists . Trade . To maintain their hidden existence , the gnomes of Songfarla traded their goods quietly , utilizing merchants who claimed no affiliation with any realm . These merchants operated in Almorel , Murghyr , and Duirtanal for things that the gnomes could not make themselves — they were otherwise completely self - sufficient . Defenses . Songfarla ' s greatest defense was its anonymity . Not even the Thay an Zulkir of Divination knew of its existence . Practically all passages into and around Songfarla were hidden by powerful illusion magic . History . A settlement in the Sunrise Mountains was founded by escaped slaves from Netheril . In - 3149 DR , it became the kingdom of Songfarla when its population exploded with an influx of more refugees .

title: Songhorn
description: Songhorn A songhorn was a wind musical instrument , similar to a longhorn . Description . Songhorns were simple recorders made of wood .
description_long: Songhorn A songhorn was a wind musical instrument , similar to a longhorn . Description . Songhorns were simple recorders made of wood . Their sound was mellower than that of longhorns and fared better on lower ranges . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Songs and Swords series
description: Songs and Swords series The Songs and Swords series by Elaine Cunningham covers the adventures of Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann . Several of the books were originally part of the loosely - connected Harpers series , but as the story of Arilyn Moonblade became more fleshed out and the books became more popular , they were joined together as their own series .
description_long: Songs and Swords series The Songs and Swords series by Elaine Cunningham covers the adventures of Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann . Several of the books were originally part of the loosely - connected Harpers series , but as the story of Arilyn Moonblade became more fleshed out and the books became more popular , they were joined together as their own series .

title: Sono
description: Sono Sono was a servant in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Sono was totally loyal to his daimyo but also in love with Buntaro Ostato .
description_long: Sono Sono was a servant in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Sono was totally loyal to his daimyo but also in love with Buntaro Ostato . Activities . Sono was a servant in the house of the daimyo Benju Matsumoto . She had talent playing the samisen and often played for Benju ' s guests .

title: Sons of Alagondar
description: Sons of Alagondar The Sons of Alagondar were a nationalist rebel group operating in the city of Neverwinter . Almost all of the Sons of Alagondar were descendants of those who served Lord Nasher Alagondar . They refused to leave Neverwinter even as Mount Hotenow erupted and actively opposed the city ' s new self - imposed leader Lord Protector Dagult Neverember , wishing to return Neverwinter to the way it was before the cataclysm rather than creating the ' New Neverwinter ' that Neverember endorsed .
description_long: Sons of Alagondar The Sons of Alagondar were a nationalist rebel group operating in the city of Neverwinter . Almost all of the Sons of Alagondar were descendants of those who served Lord Nasher Alagondar . They refused to leave Neverwinter even as Mount Hotenow erupted and actively opposed the city ' s new self - imposed leader Lord Protector Dagult Neverember , wishing to return Neverwinter to the way it was before the cataclysm rather than creating the ' New Neverwinter ' that Neverember endorsed . Shortly after 1474 DR the group was led by a Harper named Cymril but she was killed when Neverember mounted reprisals against the group ' s activities . Leaderless , a power vacuum formed and soon the group split into two factions , the Nashers and the Graycloaks The Nashers . Primarily made up of the younger members of the group and led by Arlon Bladeshaper , who claimed to be descended from one of the Neverwinter Nine , the Nashers were the more radical faction of the two , practicing extreme methods and allying themselves to the shadier side of Neverwinter ' s underworld such as the Dead Rats and Thay an agents , even using a former Kraken Society building as their Headquarters .

title: Sons of Gruumsh
description: Sons of Gruumsh Appendix . Trivia . The original cover of " Sons of Gruumsh " incorrectly showed the author as Will Littrell .
description_long: Sons of Gruumsh Appendix . Trivia . The original cover of " Sons of Gruumsh " incorrectly showed the author as Will Littrell . Corrected versions were quickly shipped out , but a number of the incorrect editions remain . Product images online , like Google Books , often use the incorrect cover .

title: Soolabax
description: Soolabax Soolabax was a walled town in Chessenta near the border with Threskel . The town was overcrowded and there was no room inside the walls for new construction . The town ' s nominal ruler was Baron Hasos Thora , though he was a vassal of Tchazzar .
description_long: Soolabax Soolabax was a walled town in Chessenta near the border with Threskel . The town was overcrowded and there was no room inside the walls for new construction . The town ' s nominal ruler was Baron Hasos Thora , though he was a vassal of Tchazzar . There was a temple to Amaunator in the town . Soolabax was briefly besieged in 1479 DR by Threskel an forces until the Brotherhood of the Griffon lifted the siege .

title: Soot
description: Soot Captain Soot was a traveler of Zakhara and the Elemental planes in 1367 DR . Description . Captain Soot had jet - black skin and curly white hair .
description_long: Soot Captain Soot was a traveler of Zakhara and the Elemental planes in 1367 DR . Description . Captain Soot had jet - black skin and curly white hair . He had a well - trimmed beard and mustache . Activities . Captain Soot used his ship , the Ebony Queen , the travel between the Elemental planes . He was even able to trade with genie s since they considered him to be an honorary genie . Soot also traded with the mamluk s of Qudra . Soot would transport passengers and goods for a hefty fee .

title: Sophraea Carver
description: Sophraea Carver Sophraea Carver was the youngest member of the Carver family , who were renowned as the keepers of Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . She was somewhat unique as a heroine of the Realms in that she had no special abilities or adventuring profession . Although she was never touched directly by the Spellplague , some of the blue fire seeped into her and she gained a sixth sense while within the walls of the City of the Dead .
description_long: Sophraea Carver Sophraea Carver was the youngest member of the Carver family , who were renowned as the keepers of Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . She was somewhat unique as a heroine of the Realms in that she had no special abilities or adventuring profession . Although she was never touched directly by the Spellplague , some of the blue fire seeped into her and she gained a sixth sense while within the walls of the City of the Dead . History . Sophraea ' s goal in life was to become a dressmaker and she intended to obtain an apprenticeship with one of Waterdeep ' s finest dressmakers . Her plans were interrupted when something began to disturb the dead in the City of the Dead . Along with her friend Gustin Bone , Sophraea tracked the source of the disturbance to an old noble named Dorgar Adarbrent . With Dorgar ' s help , she and Gustin successfully reversed the curse and returned the dead to their tombs . Appearance . Unlike the rest of her family , Sophraea was tiny . She had curly black hair .

title: Soqaxu
description: Soqaxu Soqaxu was a lizardman warrior of a tribe in the Flooded Forest . Personality . Soqaxu was a smart and experienced warrior .
description_long: Soqaxu Soqaxu was a lizardman warrior of a tribe in the Flooded Forest . Personality . Soqaxu was a smart and experienced warrior . He was willing to use others to do his dirty work . History . In 1491 DR , after strangers made a camp near the forest , he was sent by his king to lead a patrol on a fact - finding mission . During the mission , he met an adventuring party hired to clear the area of bandits .

title: Soram Battlebellow
description: Soram Battlebellow Soram Battlebellow was a dwarf fighter in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Soram was a pragmatic and bullheaded individual , seeing everywhere insults against him .
description_long: Soram Battlebellow Soram Battlebellow was a dwarf fighter in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Soram was a pragmatic and bullheaded individual , seeing everywhere insults against him . Despite Soram also was in search of the glory he believed no - realistic resurrect the Shanatar ' s kingdom . Soram had no trust in their mission but wanted protect Bapar . History . In 1370 following some clues Soram and his companions Bapar Ghalmrin and Odak Truesteel discovered that a group possessing one of the lost " Scepters of Shanatar " must be in the village of Toralth . On the night of Uktar 10 they entered the tavern seeking the " Sondarr Scepter " and interrupting the ballad that a bard was singing for the lost companions of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company . He accused some of the patrons to had thieved from the dwarves and asked to turn over to him the thieves and the stolen good . Bramas Thorntree then accused some of the other patrons of the steal the " scepter " but meantime Timor , Karr , and Vajal of the Shields of the Highland got up from their chairs and began throwing their beer mugs and swinging their chairs .

title: Soravian Talebringers
description: Soravian Talebringers The Soravian Talebringers was an organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Talebringers were a group of rangers and clerics of Ilmater focusing on helping the people of Soravia and keeping the various local communities in touch .
description_long: Soravian Talebringers The Soravian Talebringers was an organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Talebringers were a group of rangers and clerics of Ilmater focusing on helping the people of Soravia and keeping the various local communities in touch . The people of Soravia trusted them . History . The Talebringers acted for some time but emerged politically after 1357 DR when the duchy of Soravia was at risk of falling into chaos with its ruler , a puppet of Zhengyi , killed in battle with Gareth Dragonsbane . Many of them joined Gareth in his quest to free Damara . In 1359 DR , they cleared the land of any minions of Zhengyi who remained and answered to all the citizens ' requests .

title: Sorcere
description: Sorcere Sorcere was one of the three schools at the Tier Breche academy in Menzoberranzan . It was within Sorcere that drow mages and wizards were trained . It was nicknamed " the Tower .
description_long: Sorcere Sorcere was one of the three schools at the Tier Breche academy in Menzoberranzan . It was within Sorcere that drow mages and wizards were trained . It was nicknamed " the Tower . " Structure . Exterior . Sorcere ' s complex was made from sculpted stalagmite towers . The tower itself had many spires and was located against the western wall of the Tier Breche cavern . Interior . Sorcere had hallways filled with paintings , sculptures , and framed magical texts . All students lived alone in the apprentices ' wing and were allocated austere quarters with a pallet and a zurkhwood desk and chair . The interior walls of the complex were lined with lead sheeting and stucco from gorgon ' s blood and spellstore dust . Sorcere ' s scrying chambers were large and circular . The walls were lined with lead sheeting and stucco from gorgon ' s blood and spellstore dust , just as the rest of Sorcere . Runes of gold were inscribed on the walls to protect against magical intrusion . In the middle was a huge scrying crystal bound with the eye of an eagle that was living beneath the crystal in a cage . Mages could cast spells through the crystal .

title: Sorcerer
description: Sorcerer A sorcerer , sometimes known as a sorceress if female , is a wielder of arcane magic bound only by their own willpower . Unlike most other arcane spellcasters , particularly the wizards they are often compared with , sorcerers have innate magical ability and are noted for their lack of study in obtaining such power . And while a wizard focuses on isolating their foes and diminishing their ability to fight , a sorcerer prefers to unleash his or her full power , without restraint , blasting their enemies into oblivion .
description_long: Sorcerer A sorcerer , sometimes known as a sorceress if female , is a wielder of arcane magic bound only by their own willpower . Unlike most other arcane spellcasters , particularly the wizards they are often compared with , sorcerers have innate magical ability and are noted for their lack of study in obtaining such power . And while a wizard focuses on isolating their foes and diminishing their ability to fight , a sorcerer prefers to unleash his or her full power , without restraint , blasting their enemies into oblivion . The magic a sorcerer wields is , as a result , intensely powerful though often somewhat unpredictable , much like a barbarian in the heat of a " rage " . Among the best - known sorcerers in Faerûn is the Simbul , a powerful sorceress from Aglarond , although most of her sisters are also skilled sorcerers . Culture . Sorcerers are arcane artists , casting spell s as a poet might write poetry , innately , rather than through regimented study . How they come by this power is not commonly known , though it is speculated that sorcerers ' very flesh is , in some way , touched by arcane power .

title: Sorcerer ' s Moon
description: Sorcerer ' s Moon " Sorcerer ' s Moon " is the fourth issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It ended the story arc begun in " The Gathering " and continued in " The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " and " The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye " .
description_long: Sorcerer ' s Moon " Sorcerer ' s Moon " is the fourth issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It ended the story arc begun in " The Gathering " and continued in " The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " and " The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye " . Background . The back of the issue presents a map of the caverns beneath Imgig Zu ' s tower , where all of the action takes place . Appendix . Reprints . This issue was reprinted in the Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 1 trade paperback by in March 2011 .

title: Sorcerer ( kit )
description: Sorcerer ( kit ) Sorcerers were the most common form of mage found in Zakhara . It should be noted that Zakharan sorcerers were completely different than their Faerûnian counterparts who went by the same name . Requirements .
description_long: Sorcerer ( kit ) Sorcerers were the most common form of mage found in Zakhara . It should be noted that Zakharan sorcerers were completely different than their Faerûnian counterparts who went by the same name . Requirements . Members of every race , both men and women , could be sorcerers . Role . Sorcerers were " common " mages in the Land of Fate and generally treated with less suspicion than sha ' ir s or elemental mage s , whom many Zakharans feared . Possessions . Much like other magic - users , sorcerers never wore armor and could only use daggers , jambiya s , darts , or staves . Benefits . Sorcerers were able to cast universal spells as well as spells from any two provinces of elemental magic . Sorcerers could even use spells from traditionally opposed elements , such as flame and sea . Some sorcerers dedicated themselves fully to the study of their two chosen elements . These sorcerers lost the ability to cast universal spells , but gained significant advancements to their elemental spells .

title: Sorcerous duel
description: Sorcerous duel A sorcerous duel often occurred between two sorcerers who were unable to resolve their differences peacefully . These duels were respected and honored throughout the Land of Fate . All sorcerers in Zakhara abided by the rules of the sorcerous duel or faced harsh consequences from their superiors .
description_long: Sorcerous duel A sorcerous duel often occurred between two sorcerers who were unable to resolve their differences peacefully . These duels were respected and honored throughout the Land of Fate . All sorcerers in Zakhara abided by the rules of the sorcerous duel or faced harsh consequences from their superiors . Rules of Conduct . Sorcerous duels could not occur on a day that held religious significance for either of the participants . If the sorcerers belonged to a sorcerous society , then the heads of those societies were contacted about arranging the duel . It should be noted that two sorcerers from the same society rarely dueled since even suggesting a duel was usually enough to get them both expelled from their order . If the heads of the orders deemed the duel unnecessary , then the duel did not happen . A duel would be arranged for the nearest acceptable date , assuming the heads of the orders agreed that a sorcerous duel was the only way to resolve the issue . Locations for sorcerous duels were carefully selected , especially if the sorcerers involved were specialized in different elements . An area with large quantities of each sorcerer ' s main element was preferred .

title: Sorelisa Zandra
description: Sorelisa Zandra Sorelisa Zandra , was a Zhentarim bounty hunter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , posing as officers of Mirabar , Sorelisa and her partner Naeremos were sent to find the notorious dwarf criminal Worvil Forkbeard by offering protection and a recruitment offer .
description_long: Sorelisa Zandra Sorelisa Zandra , was a Zhentarim bounty hunter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , posing as officers of Mirabar , Sorelisa and her partner Naeremos were sent to find the notorious dwarf criminal Worvil Forkbeard by offering protection and a recruitment offer .

title: Soren Whitespear
description: Soren Whitespear Soren Whitespear was a human man . He was a mercenary in the Red Brigade and later a bandit with the Vipers . History .
description_long: Soren Whitespear Soren Whitespear was a human man . He was a mercenary in the Red Brigade and later a bandit with the Vipers . History . Soren Whitespear and Cedric Ravajar were best friends for many years , before either of them joined the Red Brigade as mercenaries . When Cedric became captain , Soren was his second - in - command . When Cedric disbanded the Brigade in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Soren went with his friend to join his newly founded bandit group , the Vipers , at the Vipers ' Nest . Soren was reluctant at the idea , but became one of the senior members of the group . Personality . Despite being a bandit , Soren hated raiding merchant caravans , considering it a waste of his warrior skills . Still , he took the lead in any raid , quick to engage caravan guards first . Abilities . Soren loved a good battle , and usually fought bare - chested armed with both short sword and dagger simultaneously . Description . Soren was 5 feet and 9 inches ( 1 . 7 meters ) tall and weighed 175 pounds ( 79 kilograms ) . Though small and light , he had surprising power and grace , and great stamina . His hair was short , wavy , and blond , and he had pale blue eyes .

title: Sorenth Gorender
description: Sorenth Gorender Sorenth Gorender , nicknamed Happy , was a vampire and a lower - ranked member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . He was also owner and bartender of the Purple Lady festhall . Description .
description_long: Sorenth Gorender Sorenth Gorender , nicknamed Happy , was a vampire and a lower - ranked member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . He was also owner and bartender of the Purple Lady festhall . Description . Sorenth was a man with a handsome face and long , gently curling blond hair that hung to his shoulders . He loved his hair , and usually tied it in a ponytail with a ribbon in keeping with his dress that night . He almost always smiled . Personality . Sorenth maintained an air of elegance and charm , always sociable , friendly , and courteous . Even when he was angry , his manners were perfect . He thus seemed very trustworthy . History . Sorenth was the owner and bartender of the Purple Lady , a top - quality festhall in Westgate . Even before his recruitment to the Night Masks , he was a master blackmailer , using the so - called Purple Ladies to acquire information for blackmail . The vampire Orbakh specifically chose him to be his main link to the city ' s criminal underworld , and made him a vampire and a Night Mask . Activities .

title: Sorgar Illance
description: Sorgar Illance Sorgar Illance was the head of the Illance noble house of Cormyr . He was an ex - adventurer who was both bald and bitter . He was a thief and cruelly enjoyed brawling , especially to the death .
description_long: Sorgar Illance Sorgar Illance was the head of the Illance noble house of Cormyr . He was an ex - adventurer who was both bald and bitter . He was a thief and cruelly enjoyed brawling , especially to the death . He was put to death by Gaspar Cormaeril in 1369 DR .

title: Sorlan
description: Sorlan Sorlan was a ghost in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sorlan hated the Red Wizard s but had become crazy .
description_long: Sorlan Sorlan was a ghost in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sorlan hated the Red Wizard s but had become crazy . If someone proved to be an enemy of the Red Wizards , Sorlan would helped them , but it was no easy task . History . During his life , Sorlan was an adventurer who was captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon where he was subjected to horrible experiments until he died . As a cruel twist of fate , he rose as a ghost but was eternally bound to the place of his death . In 1486 DR , Sorlan was still waiting for some end to his torments .

title: Sorn
description: Sorn Sorn was a fighter in Thay and an agent of the zulkir Lauzoril in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under Lauzoril ' s orders , Sorn posed as a trader and went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose a new king .
description_long: Sorn Sorn was a fighter in Thay and an agent of the zulkir Lauzoril in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under Lauzoril ' s orders , Sorn posed as a trader and went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose a new king . He managed to finish among the tournament ' s finalists . His orders were to win or kill the winner .

title: Sornafein Melarn
description: Sornafein Melarn Sornafein Melarn was the house patron of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow was intelligent and handsome , with great charm .
description_long: Sornafein Melarn Sornafein Melarn was the house patron of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow was intelligent and handsome , with great charm . He enjoyed his current situation . Abilities . Melarn had a beautiful voice and was skilled with a number of stringed instruments . History . Sornafein was a musician in his early life until a performance circa 1390 DR when he met Zhindia Melarn , who fell in love with him at first sight . He soon became the first house patron of the new House Melarn . His ability to mitigate the matron mother ' s fury made him the most popular male of the house .

title: Soronil Noonshadow
description: Soronil Noonshadow Soronil Noonshadow was a moon elf diviner and information broker from Luskan . History . His past life was a mystery , and his ability to survive in Luskan despite the enemies his profession made him was also a mystery .
description_long: Soronil Noonshadow Soronil Noonshadow was a moon elf diviner and information broker from Luskan . History . His past life was a mystery , and his ability to survive in Luskan despite the enemies his profession made him was also a mystery . Fortunately , Soronil liked mysteries , and he was a fountain of information for anyone who could pay or work for it . Appendix . Appearances . Soronil will appear as a companion in the upcoming Sword Coast Legends game .

title: Sorrowsworn demon
description: Sorrowsworn demon A sorrowsworn demon was a breed of tanar ' ri demon that preyed upon feelings of grief and loss . Description . A sorrowsworn demon was a gaunt humanoid standing some 12 – 15 feet ( 3 .
description_long: Sorrowsworn demon A sorrowsworn demon was a breed of tanar ' ri demon that preyed upon feelings of grief and loss . Description . A sorrowsworn demon was a gaunt humanoid standing some 12 – 15 feet ( 3 . 6 – 4 . 5 meters ) tall and weighing 500 pounds ( 230 kilograms ) . It had hooked claws for hands , a dusky black hide , and slender bat - like wings emerging from its back . Its face was a demonic , skeletal visage contorted into a mockery of utter grief , with a wide toothy maw and two short and twisted horns upon its high brow . Powers . At a whim , this demon exuded an aura that provoked creatures within 30 feet ( 9 . 1 meters ) to suffer intense feelings of despair and personal loss , constantly imagining the worst bereavements and failures they ' d ever known or could dread to know . Those of iron will could shrug off such thoughts ; the rest were overwhelmed and distracted and weakened by them . When in battle or tormenting a victim , a sorrowsworn demon hissed and whispered incessantly , both in voice and in the mind . It could affect one thinking being at a time , to a distance of 60 feet ( 18 .

title: Sorvic
description: Sorvic Sorvic was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . When working , Sorvic usually kept around 20 gp on his person .
description_long: Sorvic Sorvic was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . When working , Sorvic usually kept around 20 gp on his person . History . Sorvic was a cultist and , alongside Maelgot , one of the bodyguards of Talis Kasterel , at his master ' s side in the Cult ' s occupied hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains .

title: Sos ' Umptu Baenre
description: Sos ' Umptu Baenre Sos ' Umptu Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a cleric of Lolth . Description . Sos ' Umptu was about the height of Quenthel Baenre .
description_long: Sos ' Umptu Baenre Sos ' Umptu Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a cleric of Lolth . Description . Sos ' Umptu was about the height of Quenthel Baenre . Personality . Sos ' Umptu had a calculated and deliberate malice . She was the least ambitious of the Baenre daughters and was content to be the keeper of the Baenre chapel , refusing opportunities to gain more power , such as becoming the Mistress of Arach - Tinilith . She spent much of her time creating a jeweled spider golem to guard the chapel . History . Sos ' Umptu served as the keeper of the House Baenre chapel in Menzoberranzan for more than 200 years . During Matron Mother Triel Baenre ' s reign , Sos ' Umptu served as Triel ' s advisor when her main advisors , Gromph and Quenthel , were not available . Sos ' Umptu helped create the Fane of Quarvelsharess , a temple to Lolth where she served as a high priestess . She may have also been a mistress of Sorcere . During Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre ' s reign , Sos ' Umptu originally served as First Priestess of House Baenre . In later years , she and Quenthel ' s daughter Myrineyl competed for the title of First Priestess .

title: Sosdrielle Vandree
description: Sosdrielle Vandree Sosdrielle Vandree was a drow and the mistress of Gromph Baenre in Menzoberranzan . She bore Liriel Baenre and raised her for the first five years of her life . Although Sosdrielle was beautiful , she lacked ambition and magical talent , so she was not successful .
description_long: Sosdrielle Vandree Sosdrielle Vandree was a drow and the mistress of Gromph Baenre in Menzoberranzan . She bore Liriel Baenre and raised her for the first five years of her life . Although Sosdrielle was beautiful , she lacked ambition and magical talent , so she was not successful . She was ordered to death by Gromph when Liriel was five , so that Gromph could then claim Liriel , who showed wizardly aptitude , as his own . Drow children were considered the property of the mother , and had Sosdrielle not been killed , Gromph would have had no claim on the child . Unknown to all but a few , Sosdrielle was the subject upon which House Baenre ' s impressive shrine to Lolth was modelled after , it having been crafted by Gromph . When Liriel came of age , visitors to the shrine who knew her well enough began to notice the similarity between the image and the girl , Liriel having inherited her beautiful features mostly from her mother . During a conclave of the city council in the temple , the matron mothers took the likeness to be a sign from Lolth of her favour towards the girl .

title: Sossal
description: Sossal The nation of Sossal was located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . This chilling place was locked between Pelvuria and Yal Tengri .
description_long: Sossal The nation of Sossal was located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . This chilling place was locked between Pelvuria and Yal Tengri . There was a trade city on the Great Ice Sea called Naupau . Inhabitants . Natives of Sossal were called Sossarhim or Sossrim . Humans from there seem crafted from snow , with alabaster skin and white hair , typically dressed in white . Some say Sossrim sometimes traveled to Calimshan .

title: Sot
description: Sot Sot was the not so famous innkeeper of the Laughing Goblin Inn though his pork and cabbage soup was renowned throughout Phlan . History . Around 1290 DR , Sot ' s grandfather was a cleric of Tyr and guardsman at Sokol Keep on Thorn Island .
description_long: Sot Sot was the not so famous innkeeper of the Laughing Goblin Inn though his pork and cabbage soup was renowned throughout Phlan . History . Around 1290 DR , Sot ' s grandfather was a cleric of Tyr and guardsman at Sokol Keep on Thorn Island . In 1340 DR , gave his grandfather ' s holy symbol of Tyr to Tarl Desanea , which was similar to Tarl ' s own holy symbol but had different writing on it . Personality . Though odd for some , Sot collected rare glass liquor bottles and he displayed these treasures behind his bar . Equipment . Sot ' s weapon of choice for use at the inn and adjoining tavern was a large cudgel , which was basically a club or short staff . He and the cook would always reach instinctively for their cudgels when trouble was brewing at the inn .

title: Sothillis
description: Sothillis Sothillis , or Sythillis , was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Sythillis along with Cyrvisnea , led an army of goblin s , kobold s , ogre s , hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric in attacks upon southern Amn .
description_long: Sothillis Sothillis , or Sythillis , was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Sythillis along with Cyrvisnea , led an army of goblin s , kobold s , ogre s , hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric in attacks upon southern Amn . At the end of their campaign , they assaulted the city of Murann and captured gold from Maztica . The army numbered in almost 3 , 000 soldiers . As of 1374 DR , the force still inhabited the city . Personality . While he is a renowned leader , Sothillis is greatly feared for his cruel actions . Description . With mottled green skin and jet black hair , Sythillis is a giant among even the ogre - magi , standing just under 16 feet ( 4 . 8m ) tall and weighing nearly two tons . His short , red horns are encircled in mithral - laced arcane runes . Equipment . Among Sothillis ' s possessions are Kingscar , Blue lightning , a medallion of thoughts and a ring of evasion . Appearances . Games . In Baldur ' s Gate 1 a letter from the Iron Throne leader Rieltar to Davaeorn references the " Sythillisian uprising " in Amn as a reason why Amn will not act to stop the Iron Crisis .

title: Sothillisian War
description: Sothillisian War The Sothillisian War was a war that lasted over 4 years between the nation of Amn and the Sothillisian Empire with the goal of recovering the lost Armory of Nedeheim . The ogre mage Sothillis and his mate Cyrvisnea began this war by leading their army of kobold s , goblin s , hill giant s and ogre s , supported by Cyricists in an attack on Fort Ishla and Esmereltan . Both attacks were resounding victories , due in no small part to their superior numbers and the defenders distracted by the secession of Riatavin to Tethyr .
description_long: Sothillisian War The Sothillisian War was a war that lasted over 4 years between the nation of Amn and the Sothillisian Empire with the goal of recovering the lost Armory of Nedeheim . The ogre mage Sothillis and his mate Cyrvisnea began this war by leading their army of kobold s , goblin s , hill giant s and ogre s , supported by Cyricists in an attack on Fort Ishla and Esmereltan . Both attacks were resounding victories , due in no small part to their superior numbers and the defenders distracted by the secession of Riatavin to Tethyr . The ogre magi were dismayed to not find the armory in Esmereltan , but found documents hinting that it had been moved to the city of Murann . Cyrvisnea led part of the goblin and kobold sections of their army , aided by their Cyricist allies to Imnescar and sacked it . Sothillis meanwhile , left a hill giant garrison in Esmereltan and went through Trademeet towards Murann , laying seige to it . The Pirates of the Nelanther Isles blockaded Murann ' s port and the siege continued until the fall of winter .
