title: Sprite ( classification )
description: Sprite ( classification ) Sprites were a grouping of fey races , consisting of grig s , nixie s and pixie s . Though sprites were generally reclusive , they were ready to combat ugliness and evil and defend their homes . In battle , they favored ambushes and tricks , and fought with their magic and their tiny weapons .
description_long: Sprite ( classification ) Sprites were a grouping of fey races , consisting of grig s , nixie s and pixie s . Though sprites were generally reclusive , they were ready to combat ugliness and evil and defend their homes . In battle , they favored ambushes and tricks , and fought with their magic and their tiny weapons . According to legend , a sprite could only die by sickness or injury , never old age . History . In 1369 DR , a clan of sprites dwelt in the Misty Vale in Brynwood in the Vast , where they served the Green Lady , a druid of Eldath .

title: Sprite ( creature )
description: Sprite ( creature ) Sprites were the warrior relatives of pixie s . They were fierce defenders of good wherever they dwelt , and were also firm judges of other creatures ' hearts and intentions . Personality .
description_long: Sprite ( creature ) Sprites were the warrior relatives of pixie s . They were fierce defenders of good wherever they dwelt , and were also firm judges of other creatures ' hearts and intentions . Personality . Because of their austerity and zealous attitude against evil , sprites were considered overly sullen and harsh by other fey . Unlike pixies , they did not care to engage in fun activities or adorn themselves . However , they were excellent judges of character , and could always sense another creature ' s real nature and emotions . They were quick to ally with good - natured creatures , and would come to their aid even at unexpected times . Combat . Sprites were expert brewers of toxins , poison s , and antidotes . In particular , they favored a potent sleep poison with which they coated their arrows . They usually harvested the ingredients for these toxins in forests , even venturing into dangerous areas to find them , but were not above stealing some from hag s ' gardens if extremely necessary . Society . Typically , sprites ' villages could be found in glades deep inside thriving forests , or inside the trunks of trees or treant s .

title: Spruce beer
description: Spruce beer Spruce beer was an alcohol ic beverage made from the spruce tree . Orlenstar Thirlthorn , a druid of Silvanus and caretaker of the God ' s Grove shrine in Wheloon , Cormyr , brewed his own spruce beer by 1358 DR . This was one of a number of factors that made the grove a popular spot for locals .
description_long: Spruce beer Spruce beer was an alcohol ic beverage made from the spruce tree . Orlenstar Thirlthorn , a druid of Silvanus and caretaker of the God ' s Grove shrine in Wheloon , Cormyr , brewed his own spruce beer by 1358 DR . This was one of a number of factors that made the grove a popular spot for locals .

title: Spysong
description: Spysong Spysong was a scouting organization that collected information about threats to the kingdom of Damara for King Gareth Dragonsbane . Spysong operated in the Bloodstone Lands . Their primary mission was finding the location and the defenses of the Citadel of Assassins .
description_long: Spysong Spysong was a scouting organization that collected information about threats to the kingdom of Damara for King Gareth Dragonsbane . Spysong operated in the Bloodstone Lands . Their primary mission was finding the location and the defenses of the Citadel of Assassins . Notable members . There were also a number of ranger s who kept a close eye on and protected these three important leaders as much as they coukd when they were out on the land .

title: Squallocks
description: Squallocks Squallocks was a vrock advisor of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Squallocks was at the Undying Temple assisting Graz ' zt and the queen of Maerimydra Hledh Hellspawn in the ritual to permit Graz ' zt to resist to Vizeran DeVir ' s spell .
description_long: Squallocks Squallocks was a vrock advisor of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Squallocks was at the Undying Temple assisting Graz ' zt and the queen of Maerimydra Hledh Hellspawn in the ritual to permit Graz ' zt to resist to Vizeran DeVir ' s spell . Possession . Squallocks possessed a robe of stars .

title: Squaring the circle
description: Squaring the circle Squaring the circle was an alteration spell that allowed a wizard to modify the shape of the effective area of other spells . Square or cubic areas could be changed to circular or spherical or vice - versa ; a square into a rectangle ; or a circle or sphere into an oval or egg shape . History .
description_long: Squaring the circle Squaring the circle was an alteration spell that allowed a wizard to modify the shape of the effective area of other spells . Square or cubic areas could be changed to circular or spherical or vice - versa ; a square into a rectangle ; or a circle or sphere into an oval or egg shape . History . The creation of " squaring the circle " was attributed to young archmage Sammaster , in the period of his delving into metamagic in the late 830s DR , though it was unclear if he indeed developed the spell himself , or was merely instrumental in its rediscovery and subsequent distribution .

title: Squatting toad
description: Squatting toad The squatting toad was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a toad . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Squatting toad The squatting toad was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a toad . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . The " squatting toad " could be used to cast the spell " creeping darkness " . Furthermore , one who drank any kind of beverage from the cup would permanently gain slightly increased strength and agility but reduced charisma , as well as the ability to swim . They would also grow 1 – 4 inches ( 2 . 5 – 10 cm ) in height . However , this would only happen once ; repeating the ceremony or imbibing again would have no effect . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " squatting toad " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . The " squatting toad " came into the possession of the folk of the island of Saishu . In the mid – 14th century DR , the grateful people of Saishu presented the " squatting toad " as a gift to King Wanang Sun , for lifting the oppressive regime of the Sillan Empire . It was in his possession by 1357 DR .

title: Squch
description: Squch Squch was a scaladar and self - proclaimed leader of the mechanical entities that populate Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He was created by Trobriand as one of his " most intellectually stimulating experiments in this century " ( century not known ) . He aimed to break free from the graveyard and control the city of Waterdeep for himself .
description_long: Squch Squch was a scaladar and self - proclaimed leader of the mechanical entities that populate Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He was created by Trobriand as one of his " most intellectually stimulating experiments in this century " ( century not known ) . He aimed to break free from the graveyard and control the city of Waterdeep for himself . He used the other inhabitants to help him discover this exit . Squch could speak both Common and Drow . Unusually for a scaladar , Squch had independent will .

title: Squeaking floors
description: Squeaking floors Squeaking floors was an evocation spell that caused a solid surface to emit loud squeaks whenever touched or tread upon . Effects . This spell could be cast on any flat surface .
description_long: Squeaking floors Squeaking floors was an evocation spell that caused a solid surface to emit loud squeaks whenever touched or tread upon . Effects . This spell could be cast on any flat surface . The actual material of the surface was not important ; stone , wood , dirt , etc . , as long as it was solid . Whenever the surface was stepped on or touched by a creature larger than a typical rat ( 3 lb / 1 . 4 kg or 0 . 5 ft / 0 . 014 m ) the enchanted surface would squeak loudly enough to be heard 100 ft ( 30 . 5 m ) away . The sound could be heard and direction determined regardless of doors , walls , floors or other interposing barriers . Even creatures who could move silently were only able to halve the distance the sound traveled . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , this spell required a rusty iron hinge that squeaked as a material component .

title: Squealer
description: Squealer A squealer was a carnivorous creature with three arms that dwelled in forests and jungles . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Salabak created the illusion of a squealer to scary away the beggars of Memnon who were hanging around him , Vajra , and Conner .
description_long: Squealer A squealer was a carnivorous creature with three arms that dwelled in forests and jungles . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Salabak created the illusion of a squealer to scary away the beggars of Memnon who were hanging around him , Vajra , and Conner .

title: Sree
description: Sree Sree was a Rashmeni Wychlaran who adopted the young daughter of Yaraella , a Witch believed to have committed suicide to end the troubling visions she received from the spirt world . In reality , Sree killed Yarealla because she refused to join the Wychlaren and so Sree could raise the young girl to become a powerful witch . Sree was killed by vengeful water spirits in 1480 DR during a Wychlaran circle ritual .

In reality , Sree killed Yarealla because she refused to join the Wychlaren and so Sree could raise the young girl to become a powerful witch . title: Srindin
description: Srindin Srindin was once an elven explorer in Anauroch . After a life of exploration and adventure across all the Realms , Srindin retired in the Anauroch , where he discovered a hidden fertile valley . He built a small castle where he lived as a hermit .
description_long: Srindin Srindin was once an elven explorer in Anauroch . After a life of exploration and adventure across all the Realms , Srindin retired in the Anauroch , where he discovered a hidden fertile valley . He built a small castle where he lived as a hermit . After his death , the valley was named after him and some adventurers arrived at Srindin ' s castle in order to find his treasure , but some fell magic protected the treasures .

title: Srinshee
description: Srinshee The Srinshee ( born Oluevaera Estelda ) was one of the most famous baelnorn of all time . In her time she was many things : the Senior Cor ' Selu ' Taar ( Grand Mage of the High Mages of Cormanthor ) , leader of the Srinshinnar ( and thus her commonly known title ) , Wardnorn of the Vault of Ages , the Lorenorn for the armathors and was also High Court Mage of Myth Drannor for a time . She aided three Cormanthyran Coronals : Miirphys , Tannivh , and Eltargrim .
description_long: Srinshee The Srinshee ( born Oluevaera Estelda ) was one of the most famous baelnorn of all time . In her time she was many things : the Senior Cor ' Selu ' Taar ( Grand Mage of the High Mages of Cormanthor ) , leader of the Srinshinnar ( and thus her commonly known title ) , Wardnorn of the Vault of Ages , the Lorenorn for the armathors and was also High Court Mage of Myth Drannor for a time . She aided three Cormanthyran Coronals : Miirphys , Tannivh , and Eltargrim . She also helped raise the " Mythal " over the elven city of Myth Drannor in 261 DR . Appearance . During much of the Coronal Eltargrim ' s rule , she was a baelnorn , guardian of the Coronal ' s most precious treasures , and teacher to many of the Court ' s mages . However , shortly before the Opening , she was restored to life and youth by the human Goddess of Magic Mystra as a reward for attempting to save Mystra ' s Chosen Elminster . She stood among the other mythal - casters as a fresh - faced ( but still agedly wise ) elven maid of only 200 winters .

title: Srinshee ' s spell shift
description: Srinshee ' s spell shift Srinshee ' s spell shift was a mighty abjuration spell that let one manipulate a spell cast by another creature . Effects . This spell caused the caster to be able to perceive the Weave which allowed the caster to swiftly recognize and either counterspell or manipulate the spell being cast by another spellcaster .
description_long: Srinshee ' s spell shift Srinshee ' s spell shift was a mighty abjuration spell that let one manipulate a spell cast by another creature . Effects . This spell caused the caster to be able to perceive the Weave which allowed the caster to swiftly recognize and either counterspell or manipulate the spell being cast by another spellcaster . History . It was presumably developed by the Srinshee .

title: Srivven
description: Srivven Srivven is a mage and along with Iraun , they are the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Srivven and Iraun travelled Faerûn plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards .
description_long: Srivven Srivven is a mage and along with Iraun , they are the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Srivven and Iraun travelled Faerûn plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards . Srivven has no actual right to rule over Adaerglast although he and Iraun believe that the gods have appointed them this task . They have resisted several attacks and , due to the strong magic in Adaerglast , have protected themselves by setting up many very powerful spellwebs .

title: Srossar
description: Srossar Srossar was a bronze dragon possessed by Tyranthraxus . History . Srossar was an ancient dragon .
description_long: Srossar Srossar was a bronze dragon possessed by Tyranthraxus . History . Srossar was an ancient dragon . Around 1240 DR , some agents of Tyranthraxus ( who were in turn deceived ) tricked Srossar into believing that bathing in the Pool of Radiance , a portal to an unknown dark plane underneath Valjevo Castle , would give him greater wisdom and understanding of the metaphysics of the universe . However , in truth , when the dragon entered the pool , Srossar was possessed by Tyranthraxus . Tyranthraxus immediately commenced building an army of monsters for the subjugation of Faerûn . Using Srossar ' s body , Tyranthraxus took control of most of the city of Phlan until 1340 DR . In that year , an adventuring party hired by Councilman Porphyrys Cadorna defeated Tyranthraxus , killing Srossar in the process .

title: Ss ' khanaja
description: Ss ' khanaja Ss ' khanaja was a city inhabited mainly by high - class naga and their staff , with some yuan - ti and lizardfolk making their homes in the Underdark passage that the city was built around . It was located in the Serpent Hills of Najara , in the west .
description_long: Ss ' khanaja Ss ' khanaja was a city inhabited mainly by high - class naga and their staff , with some yuan - ti and lizardfolk making their homes in the Underdark passage that the city was built around . It was located in the Serpent Hills of Najara , in the west .

title: Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun
description: Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun , or the City of Fountains , was once the capital city of the ancient serpent empire known as Najara . It was raised some 30 , 000 years before modern times by a powerful creator race called the Sarrukh . By the 14th century DR , however , the secretive empire of Najara or the Kingdom of Snakes was governed from Ss ' khanaja .
description_long: Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun , or the City of Fountains , was once the capital city of the ancient serpent empire known as Najara . It was raised some 30 , 000 years before modern times by a powerful creator race called the Sarrukh . By the 14th century DR , however , the secretive empire of Najara or the Kingdom of Snakes was governed from Ss ' khanaja . Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun was left buried and nearly forgotten . Originally built as a temple city by the cult of Ssharstrune , Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun was abandoned after the death of the deity it honored and stood sealed for thousands of years until it was restored by its guardian , the ancient bone ha - naga Terpenzi and its followers . However , in the Year of the Moor Birds , 90 DR , Netherese wizards in the employ of the Shadowking drove Terpenzi and his ophidian servants out and partially razed the city , creating wards to prevent any serpent - related species from returning . By 1373 DR , human s inhabited the land above the ruins , in the village called Serpent ' s Cowl .

title: Sschindylryn
description: Sschindylryn Sschindylryn was situated miles below the King ’ s Forest of Cormyr . This drow city was a strong trading power in the Underdark but a minor military one , at best . History .
description_long: Sschindylryn Sschindylryn was situated miles below the King ’ s Forest of Cormyr . This drow city was a strong trading power in the Underdark but a minor military one , at best . History . Around 1136 DR , Sschindylryn was infiltrated by the Jaezred Chaulssin . They took control over a minor noble house and installed a fosterage . The leader of this fosterage in 1372 DR was Patron Father Ilphtrin Imphraezl . The city was very war - like , using their portals to raid other underdark settlements and cities . At some point in its history , Sschindylryn lost a war against Menzoberranzan . The defeat caused an almost complete demilitarization of the city . What followed was a time of rebuilding the city as a mercantile power . Toward that end , the city ' s spellcasters specialized in magic of divination and such that allowed easier travel . Sschindylryn enjoyed , for a Lolth - ruled city , rare political and social stability that resulted from the ruling priestesses ' inaction in regards of following Lolth ' s philosophy of strife , as well as economic stability and power which the male - dominated merchant class has built through surprisingly peaceful means .

title: Sschindylryn ' s Gate
description: Sschindylryn ' s Gate Sschindylryn ' s Gate was a Toril - Oerth portal leading to Erelhei - Cinlu in Underdark . History . The portal was discovered by scouts from the city of Sschindylryn , a drow city under Cormyr known for its use of portals to explore and conquer other parts of the Underdark .
description_long: Sschindylryn ' s Gate Sschindylryn ' s Gate was a Toril - Oerth portal leading to Erelhei - Cinlu in Underdark . History . The portal was discovered by scouts from the city of Sschindylryn , a drow city under Cormyr known for its use of portals to explore and conquer other parts of the Underdark . During a battle with Menzoberranzan , the portal was damaged and none from the western city knew how to operate it or to where it led .

title: Sseelrigoth
description: Sseelrigoth Sseelrigoth was a blight wyrm from the Shadowfell . When Tchazzar was wounded by the spellplague and travelled through a rift between the Prime Material Plane and the Shadowfell , Sseelrigoth subdued and imprisoned him . Sseelrigoth fed from Tchazzar ' s essence for nearly 100 years until Jhesrhi Coldcreek rescued him from his imprisonment .
description_long: Sseelrigoth Sseelrigoth was a blight wyrm from the Shadowfell . When Tchazzar was wounded by the spellplague and travelled through a rift between the Prime Material Plane and the Shadowfell , Sseelrigoth subdued and imprisoned him . Sseelrigoth fed from Tchazzar ' s essence for nearly 100 years until Jhesrhi Coldcreek rescued him from his imprisonment . Once freed , Tchazzar slaughtered Sseelrigoth and returned to the Prime Material Plane .

title: Ssendam
description: Ssendam Ssendam is the Slaad Lord of Madness . Description . Ssendam appears as a gigantic golden amoeba with a humanoid brain as a nucleus .
description_long: Ssendam Ssendam is the Slaad Lord of Madness . Description . Ssendam appears as a gigantic golden amoeba with a humanoid brain as a nucleus . Ssendam has been described alternatively as male and female in different sources , and in truth it is impossible to tell what gender Ssendam is . Ssendam is widely believed to be the oldest slaad lord , predating even Ygorl . Relationships . Ssendam cares little for other slaad , and his involvement with the race is limited at best . Realm . Ssendam ' s domain has been described as as a golden castle that rises from raw chaos . Ssendam is often found floating in the vicinity of the Spawning Stone that serves as the mating grounds of the slaad race . There , she often takes the form of a golden slaad . Legends suggest that Ssendam serves as the stone ' s self - appointed guardian , although Ygorl is most often credited with the stone ' s actual creation .

title: Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa
description: Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa was a beautiful yuan - ti cleric of Sseth in Samarach in 1372 DR . Activities . Ssentenna was a yuan - ti from the Sauringar tribe who , under orders of the powerful undead jahi , managed the secret cabal of the Harim of the Jahi .
description_long: Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa was a beautiful yuan - ti cleric of Sseth in Samarach in 1372 DR . Activities . Ssentenna was a yuan - ti from the Sauringar tribe who , under orders of the powerful undead jahi , managed the secret cabal of the Harim of the Jahi .

title: Ssessibil Istahvar
description: Ssessibil Istahvar Sssessibil Istahvar was a non - human archmage in the Savage Frontier . Activities . Ssessibil was an archmage not native to Toril living with a small entourage in the Lonely Tower .
description_long: Ssessibil Istahvar Sssessibil Istahvar was a non - human archmage in the Savage Frontier . Activities . Ssessibil was an archmage not native to Toril living with a small entourage in the Lonely Tower . Often , he was away from the tower in his home in an alternative Prime Material Plane , where the dominant species , like himself , was a race of giant cat - like reptilian bipeds . Ssessibil , while having very few interests in the Silver Marches , protected his dwelling with the help of fearsome elemental guardians and destructive traps . For him , the Lonely Tower was a secret refuge , a fortress of solitude , where enemies and rivals from his home plane would never have the opportunity to locate him . History . During his last absence from the tower , which lasted about thirty years , the wizard Arbane was able to overcome the defenses of the Lonely Tower and , after stealing Ssessibil ' s treasure , proclaimed himself master of the tower . This lasted until a company of adventurers defeated him in combat , allowing the return of the previous owner .

title: Sseth
description: Sseth Sseth ( also known as Merrshaulk ) was the chief god of the reptilian yuan - ti , a chaotic evil mastermind of traps , poison , and murder . His clerics were known as " vrael olo " . His symbol was a flying snake with bared fangs .
description_long: Sseth Sseth ( also known as Merrshaulk ) was the chief god of the reptilian yuan - ti , a chaotic evil mastermind of traps , poison , and murder . His clerics were known as " vrael olo " . His symbol was a flying snake with bared fangs . History . Like all the other gods of Toril , during the Time of Troubles , Sseth was cast to the Prime by Lord Ao . He appeared over the jungles of Chult as an enormous magic - using winged snake , exhorting his priests to gather their strength . But as he slept in his lair , he was bound by the Mulhorand i god Set into a magical captivity in the Abyss . The Father of Jackals then usurped his portfolio and thereafter granted spells in Sseth ' s name . The vast majority of yuan - ti were unaware of this ; those who knew something were vaguely aware that the Slitherer Supreme was distressed in some way . Set ' s binding upon the yuan - ti god was imperfect , and fragments of nightmares sometimes appeared in visions to his followers . Those who saw them generally interpreted the dreams to mean that Sseth was upset or angry . Repeated divinations determined that Sseth was in distress of some sort , prompting many yuan - ti to quest for answers .

title: Sshamath
description: Sshamath Sshamath or the City of Dark Weavings is a Drow city located in the Gauth Grottoes below the Far Hills . It has contacts in the Zhentarim citadel of Darkhold . History .
description_long: Sshamath Sshamath or the City of Dark Weavings is a Drow city located in the Gauth Grottoes below the Far Hills . It has contacts in the Zhentarim citadel of Darkhold . History . Sshamath was established in - 4973 DR by the Lolth - worshiping drow house Sshamath . It was a standard drow city for nearly 2000 years . Then , in - 2867 DR it was discovered that the city ' s local " faerzress " was fluctuating badly . Five years later it was gone and the city was greatly weakened . Around three centuries previously , the Matron Mother s of the city had given birth to an unusually large number of male children . This contributed to a large increase in the number of wizard s , and a decrease in the number of priestesses . Thanks to the lack of nearby threats , the house wizards set about plundering the ruins of lost civilizations , such as Netheril and Oghrann . They took and duplicated every magical item that they could find , using them to instigate a very short civil war that killed all of the house matriarchs and replaced them with wizards . Thereafter , practitioners of the art reigned supreme .

title: Sshumath Daerindra
description: Sshumath Daerindra Sshumath Daerindra was a drow half - deep dragon that roamed the Deep Wastes in the Underdark . Description . As a half - deep dragon , Sshumath ' s features were a distinctly draconic compared to other drow ; he had clawed hands and vicious fangs .
description_long: Sshumath Daerindra Sshumath Daerindra was a drow half - deep dragon that roamed the Deep Wastes in the Underdark . Description . As a half - deep dragon , Sshumath ' s features were a distinctly draconic compared to other drow ; he had clawed hands and vicious fangs . Personality . Highly confident and unusually inquisitive , Sshumath was an oddity in the Underdark because he was generally more interested in talking to those he encountered than fighting them . Abilities . Like other half - deep dragon s , Sshumath could expel a gout of acid that would burn his enemies . In combat he would use haste and invisibility spell s to outmaneuver his enemies and bring his fearsome attack spells and greatsword to bear . Possessions . Sshumath carried a magic greatsword with him , which he would alternate with his spells in combat . Activities . Very interested in learning new bits of information , Sshumath wandered the Deep Wastes where he would engage those he met with a barrage of questions , but happily repaid news that interested him in kind . History .

title: Ssibalentanamas
description: Ssibalentanamas Ssibalentanamas was the priest in charge of the yuan - ti breeding program that took place in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was also the First Consort of the ruler of Hlondeth , Dediana Extaminos . Activities .
description_long: Ssibalentanamas Ssibalentanamas was the priest in charge of the yuan - ti breeding program that took place in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was also the First Consort of the ruler of Hlondeth , Dediana Extaminos . Activities . As the First Keeper of the Sacred Eggs , Ssibalentanamas controlled the histachii that guarded and tended the hundreds of yuan - ti eggs that were incubated in brood chambers deep below the Cathedral of Emerald Scales . Ostensibly , he was breeding an army to defend Hlondeth , but only he and the high priestess Medusanna Mhairdaul knew the full extent of the program . As the First Consort , he attended Dediana Extaminos , but he was not the father of Dmetrio Extaminos . Relationships . Ssibalentanamas was in a unique position , being the ally of Medusanna and the consort of Dediana , since the two females detested each other and came close to trading blows on at least a few occasions .

title: Ssipriina Zauvirr
description: Ssipriina Zauvirr Ssipriina Zauvirr was the matron mother of House Zauvirr in Ched Nasad . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn .
description_long: Ssipriina Zauvirr Ssipriina Zauvirr was the matron mother of House Zauvirr in Ched Nasad . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn . She hired the duergar mercenary band Clan Xornbane , with the help of Zammzt , to assist . She took over the Black Claw Mercantile Company storehouse , which was operated by House Zauvirr , House Melarn , and the Menzoberranyr House Baenre . She ordered Clan Xornbane to kill Matron Mother Drisinil Melarn . Ssipriina ' s daughter , Faeryl Zauvirr , also betrayed Quenthel Baenre and her protector Jeggred by leading the two to her mother to be captured . However , Clan Xornbane was given the direction to attack House Melarn prematurely . Their stonefire bombs contributed to chaos in the city . Angry at the disruption to her plans , Ssiipriina turned on them , killing the leader of the clan , Khorrl Xornbane , and causing the rest of the band to flee . However , the duergar ' s stonefire ( as part of a Jaezred Chaulssin plot directed by Zammzt ) rapidly destroyed the city .

title: Sssartisss
description: Sssartisss Sssartisss was a mixed poison distilled by the yuan - ti . Description . Sssartisss was a sticky , transparent liquid .
description_long: Sssartisss Sssartisss was a mixed poison distilled by the yuan - ti . Description . Sssartisss was a sticky , transparent liquid . If it came in contact with air , the outer surface would solidify into a thin film with a grooved texture . Below the film , it would remain a fluid and could maintain its potency for decades . Sssartisss had a tangy flavor . It was distilled from the poisons of several venomous snakes . Powers . When sssartisss entered the bloodstream through injury , it could induce paralysis in under ten seconds , followed by unconsciousness . The paralysis would last between two and twelve minutes , and unconsciousness , if it occurred , could last for up to four hours . All Scaled Ones were immune to the effects of this poison . History . Sssartisss was one of only two mixed poisons — the other being ts ' ous — that the yuan - ti were successful at creating . Ordinarily , it was very difficult to blend venoms from different snake varieties , because the toxins would negatively effect each other .

title: St . Amahl
description: St . Amahl St . Amahl was a saint of the god Ilmater .
description_long: St . Amahl St . Amahl was a saint of the god Ilmater . He was the Ilmatari saint of nomads , especially those who wandered the desert . The Friary of St . Amahl was a caravanserai - turned - monastery in the Calim Desert of Calimshan , named for St . Amahl . The monks believed their well would never run dry " while St . Amahl watches over us . "

title: St . Faelar ' s Cloisters
description: St . Faelar ' s Cloisters St . Faelar ' s Cloisters was a monastery of Ilmater in Calimshan , dedicated to St .
description_long: St . Faelar ' s Cloisters St . Faelar ' s Cloisters was a monastery of Ilmater in Calimshan , dedicated to St . Faelar . Location . St . Faelar ' s Cloisters rested near the headwaters of the Calim River in the south - central Marching Mountains . Structure . The encampment was a log and stone rustic structure that had space for at least a dozen occupants . Activities . The monk s and ranger s of the Cloisters engaged in the training of escaped slaves , teaching them how to survive in the mountains , how to climb , " etc " . History . In the month of Kythorn in 1370 DR , the entire structure was burned to the ground in an act of arson attributed to Tara of the Burning Mists , though this was never conclusively proven . This act of terror left three of the monks dead and was initiated by a " flaming sphere " spell controlled by a laughing , cloaked assailant . Inhabitants . The head priest of St . Faelar ' s in 1370 DR was Father Jamad .

title: St . Liwan
description: St . Liwan St . Liwan was a saint of the Church of Ilmater and the patron of the House of St .
description_long: St . Liwan St . Liwan was a saint of the Church of Ilmater and the patron of the House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing . St . Liwan ' s teachings focused on food and diet and the peaceful effect they had on people . His followers would not only feed the hungry ; they insisted on providing the best food possible as a means of bringing satisfaction from want . Liwan believed that even war could be eradicated if all people everywhere were well - fed .

title: Staephon Gylesman
description: Staephon Gylesman Staephon Gylesman was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Lantern Inn and Boathouse by 1358 DR and still held the position in 1369 DR . Though he managed the inn , his more profitable service was , in fact , renting small boats and barges to patrons .
description_long: Staephon Gylesman Staephon Gylesman was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Lantern Inn and Boathouse by 1358 DR and still held the position in 1369 DR . Though he managed the inn , his more profitable service was , in fact , renting small boats and barges to patrons . These could be made available at any hour , without fuss , delay , or being seen . Staephon was also an expert in old ballads and literature of north Faerûn . He was a bluff but cheerful man .

title: Staff
description: Staff A staff ( or stave ) is a pole - shaped implement used by various races as a walking stick or weapon and often has magical properties or abilities . The height of a staff is roughly the same as the height of the intended user and the diameter is such that it can be grasped comfortably in the hand . Some staves are tapered , becoming slightly narrower at the top .
description_long: Staff A staff ( or stave ) is a pole - shaped implement used by various races as a walking stick or weapon and often has magical properties or abilities . The height of a staff is roughly the same as the height of the intended user and the diameter is such that it can be grasped comfortably in the hand . Some staves are tapered , becoming slightly narrower at the top . Often staves are metal bound on one or both ends and they may be perfectly straight or gnarly and twisted . Runes , patterns and other decorations often personalize a staff to its owner . The plural , " staves " , is used almost everywhere in D & D literature but " staffs " is also acceptable .

title: Staff of devotion
description: Staff of devotion The staff of devotion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .
description_long: Staff of devotion The staff of devotion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety . Powers . " Staves of devotion " could only be used by priests and clerics . Any priest could use the following powers three times per day without draining any charges : " atonement " , " bless " , " create food and water " , " cure light wounds " , " avert evil eye " , and " purify food and drink " . Each of the following powers consumed one charge : " cure serious wounds " , " dispel magic " , " enthrall " , " neutralize poison " , and " remove curse " . name = " LoF : FaF - p52 " / > Additionally , ethoist s , moralist s , and pragmatist s could use the following powers at the expense of three charges : " flame strike " , " holy word " , " legend lore " , " raise dead " , and " restoration " . Simply carrying the staff of devotion bolstered the immunity of the wielder to many forms of attacks including poison and elemental attacks .

title: Staff of entrapment
description: Staff of entrapment A staff of entrapment was a type of short brass staff originally made in Netheril and containing the " dimensional anchor " and " Otiluke ' s resilient sphere " spells . It was worth around 37 , 000 gold pieces if fully charged , but most were missing their charges when found .
description_long: Staff of entrapment A staff of entrapment was a type of short brass staff originally made in Netheril and containing the " dimensional anchor " and " Otiluke ' s resilient sphere " spells . It was worth around 37 , 000 gold pieces if fully charged , but most were missing their charges when found .

title: Staff of eyes
description: Staff of eyes A staff of eyes was a spiralling staff with a large piece of amber at the top , and inlaid with silver . It contained the " arcane eye " , " remove blindness " and " see invisibility " spells . It was worth around 35 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Staff of eyes A staff of eyes was a spiralling staff with a large piece of amber at the top , and inlaid with silver . It contained the " arcane eye " , " remove blindness " and " see invisibility " spells . It was worth around 35 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of fiendish darkness
description: Staff of fiendish darkness A staff of fiendish darkness is a bone or ebony staff with a metal claw at one or both ends . They were used by the human s and drow serving demon s and devil s , and contain the " darkness " spell , and two each of the " animate dead " , " dispel magic " and " summon monster IX " spells . The last of these can only summon nightmare s .
description_long: Staff of fiendish darkness A staff of fiendish darkness is a bone or ebony staff with a metal claw at one or both ends . They were used by the human s and drow serving demon s and devil s , and contain the " darkness " spell , and two each of the " animate dead " , " dispel magic " and " summon monster IX " spells . The last of these can only summon nightmare s . If a good - aligned creature holds this staff , one level is temporarily drained until he or she puts it down . The staff is worth around 98 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of flames
description: Staff of flames The staff of flames was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .
description_long: Staff of flames The staff of flames was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety . Powers . These staves granted to following powers to a wizard at the expense of one charge : " affect normal fires " , " flaming sphere " , " pryotechnics " , " sundazzle " , and " sunfire " . The following powers consumed two charges for regular wizards and only one charge for flame mages : " conjure fire elemental " , " sun stone " , and " enhance fire creature " . Flame mages gained exclusive access to the " conflagration " power at the expense of four charges . Any mage holding the staff gained the advantage of the " flameproof " spell so long as they maintained contact with the staff .

title: Staff of miracles
description: Staff of miracles A staff of miracles is made from white wood and adorned with the various deities worshipped in Myth Drannor . It contains the " heal " spell , and two each of the " holy aura " and " rosemantle " spells . It is worth around 77 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Staff of miracles A staff of miracles is made from white wood and adorned with the various deities worshipped in Myth Drannor . It contains the " heal " spell , and two each of the " holy aura " and " rosemantle " spells . It is worth around 77 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of night
description: Staff of night A staff of night is made from a dark wood covered in carvings of runes meaning stars , darkness and night . The wielder is granted immunity against the umber hulk ' s confusing gaze power . The staff contains the " darkness " , " darkvision " and " low - light vision " spells .
description_long: Staff of night A staff of night is made from a dark wood covered in carvings of runes meaning stars , darkness and night . The wielder is granted immunity against the umber hulk ' s confusing gaze power . The staff contains the " darkness " , " darkvision " and " low - light vision " spells . It also contains the " dispel magic " spell but this only works against light spells , and two of the " summon monster VI " spell , but these will only summon one umber hulk , and can only be used once per tenday . If the summoned umber hulk dies or is destroyed , the staff will crumble to dust . The staff is worth around 30 , 000 gold pieces . Aumry , Lord of Shadowdale between 1300 DR and 1339 DR , possessed the " staff of the hulk " , a staff similar to a " staff of night " that was stolen from his tomb and never recovered .

title: Staff of open doors
description: Staff of open doors A staff of open doors is a wooden staff covered in carvings of doors , some of which have decorative keyholes and some with iron bindings . The staff contains the " knock " , " open / close " , " password " and " shatter " spells . It is worth around 42 , 000 gold pieces .
description_long: Staff of open doors A staff of open doors is a wooden staff covered in carvings of doors , some of which have decorative keyholes and some with iron bindings . The staff contains the " knock " , " open / close " , " password " and " shatter " spells . It is worth around 42 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of peace
description: Staff of peace A staff of peace is most often made from yew and contains the " calm emotions " , " hold person " , and " sanctuary " spells , all heightened to 6th level , and two of the " greater command " spell . If the wielder ' s patron is Eldath , he or she becomes quite the diplomat . The staff is worth around 175 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of power
description: Staff of power A staff of power was a powerful magical staff . Description . A " staff of power " was usually straight with a precious gem on top .
description_long: Staff of power A staff of power was a powerful magical staff . Description . A " staff of power " was usually straight with a precious gem on top . Powers . A " staff of power " has a number of potent abilities , including casting " magic missile " , making enemies enfeebled , creating a " continual flame " , allowing the user to " levitate " and be protected by a " wall of force " and " globe of invulnerability " , holding monsters , and using offensive spells such as " lightning bolt " , " fireball " , and " cone of cold " . A staff of power could also be willfully broken to release all of its charges within a 30 - ft area . Upon being broken , the staff had a 50 % likelihood of transporting the wielder to another plane , or else the wielder would be destroyed by spell energy . A staff of power could also be used as + 2 quarterstaff .

title: Staff of scrivening
description: Staff of scrivening The staff of scrivening originated in Myth Drannor and it is covered with symbols of quills and runes in many languages . It contains the " amanuensis " , " comprehend languages " , " erase " , and " read magic " spells , and two of the " suppress glyph " spell . It is worth around 54 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of skulls
description: Staff of skulls A staff of skulls was usually made from ebony with a carving of a skull at one end , but could also be made from a giant thigh bone with a real skull at the end . It contained the " animate dead " , " cure light wounds " and " inflict light wounds " spells , and two of the " circle of doom " spell . It was worth around 39 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of the Woodlands
description: Staff of the Woodlands The Staff of the Woodlands was a powerful , enchanted staff . History . It was once used by a man only known as the " Wild Man of the Wood " .
description_long: Staff of the Woodlands The Staff of the Woodlands was a powerful , enchanted staff . History . It was once used by a man only known as the " Wild Man of the Wood " . Its wielder enjoyed the benefit of a permanent barkskin spell and enhanced armor class , and it granted the ability to charm animals and summon shambling mound s .

title: Staff of the World Pillars
description: Staff of the World Pillars The Staff of the World Pillars was a powerful magical staff carried by the Forgotten God . Powers . This staff combined all of the effects of a " ring of regeneration " , a " staff of withering " , and " chimes of interruption " .
description_long: Staff of the World Pillars The Staff of the World Pillars was a powerful magical staff carried by the Forgotten God . Powers . This staff combined all of the effects of a " ring of regeneration " , a " staff of withering " , and " chimes of interruption " . In the hands of the Forgotten God this staff was powered by the beliefs and sacrifices of the Forgotten God ' s loyal yikarian followers , meaning that it could be used without expending a charge like other magical staves . The " Staff of the World Pillars " possessed 40 irreplaceable charges in the hands of anyone but the Forgotten God .

title: Staff of the hulk
description: Staff of the hulk The staff of the hulk was a magical staff once possessed by Aumry , Lord of Shadowdale . It was made from twisted iron and a violet geode lay at the top , held by a claw . The staff can be used once per day to summon an umber hulk to do its wielder ' s bidding .
description_long: Staff of the hulk The staff of the hulk was a magical staff once possessed by Aumry , Lord of Shadowdale . It was made from twisted iron and a violet geode lay at the top , held by a claw . The staff can be used once per day to summon an umber hulk to do its wielder ' s bidding . When used , the geode at the staff ' s top glows and shoots a purple beam into the ground , from which the hulk appears .

title: Staff of the magi
description: Staff of the magi The staff of the magi was a powerful magical artifact . Description . Generally , a " staff of the magi " was a long wooden staff encased in iron and inscribed with magical sigils and runes .
description_long: Staff of the magi The staff of the magi was a powerful magical artifact . Description . Generally , a " staff of the magi " was a long wooden staff encased in iron and inscribed with magical sigils and runes . Powers . The " staff of the magi " had a number of abilities that were permanent and a number of others that required charges . It bestowed spell resistance upon its bearer , although the bearer could willingly lower the spell resistance in order to absorb spell energy in order to add more charges . If the staff ' s charges ever exceeded 50 , or if the bearer chose to do so , it broke and exploded in a powerful magical burst . When this happened , the bearer had a 50 % chance of either being destroyed by the staff ' s energy or traveling to another plane of existence . The staff allowed unlimited use of the following abilities : " detect magic " , " enlarge person " , " hold portal " , " light " , " mage armor " , and " mage hand " . The staff was created with 50 charges .

title: Staff of the sands
description: Staff of the sands The staff of the sands was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .
description_long: Staff of the sands The staff of the sands was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety . Powers . These staves granted the following powers to a wizard at the expense of one charge : " move sand " , " sand slumber " , " sand sword " , " stoneskin " , and " traceless travel " . The following powers consumed two charges for regular wizards and only one charge for sand mages : " conjure earth elemental " , " desert fist " , and " create shade " . Sand mages gained exclusive access to the " sink " power at the expense of four charges . Any mage holding the staff gained the advantage of the " cool strength " spell so long as they maintained contact with the staff .

title: Staff of the sea
description: Staff of the sea Staves of the sea were magical staves that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These staves allowed a wizard to use the following powers : " cool strength " , " depth warning " , " converse with sea creatures " , " water blast " , and " waterbane " .
description_long: Staff of the sea Staves of the sea were magical staves that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These staves allowed a wizard to use the following powers : " cool strength " , " depth warning " , " converse with sea creatures " , " water blast " , and " waterbane " . Using these powers expended one charge . The following powers expended two charges for regular wizards and only one charge for sea mages : " conjure water elemental " , " ice storm " , and " command water spirits " . A sea mage wielding this staff could summon a " maelstrom " . " Maelstrom " consumed four charges . Simply holding the staff granted the wielder the " water breathing " ability . This power did not consume a charge , but was only available as long as the staff had at least one charge remaining .

title: Staff of the winds
description: Staff of the winds The staff of the winds was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .
description_long: Staff of the winds The staff of the winds was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety . Powers . These staves granted to following powers to a wizard at the expense of one charge : " alter normal winds " , " flying jambiya " , " solid fog " , " wind blade " , and " wind wall " . The following powers consumed two charges for regular wizards and only one charge for wind mages : " conjure air elemental " , " cloudkill " , " wind carpet " , and " summon wind dragons " . Wind mages gained exclusive access to the " windtomb " power at the expense of four charges . Any mage holding the staff gained the advantage of the " feather fall " spell so long as they maintained contact with the staff .

title: Staff of transportation
description: Staff of transportation A staff of transportation is a hollow wire staff with a mottled brown uncut gem at each end . It was originally made by a wizard named Whisper , and contains the " blink " and " dimension door " spells , and two of the " teleport " spell . It is worth around 68 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of vision
description: Staff of vision A staff of vision contained the " darkvision " , " remove blindness " and " see invisibility " spells , and two copies of the " true seeing " spell . Each time one of these was used , there was a chance that the caster would become mentally fatigued . It was worth around 43 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of withering
description: Staff of withering A staff of withering was a magic al staff that could wither and age those it struck . Description . Imgig Zu ' s " staff of withering " was an 8 - foot - long ( 2 .
description_long: Staff of withering A staff of withering was a magic al staff that could wither and age those it struck . Description . Imgig Zu ' s " staff of withering " was an 8 - foot - long ( 2 . 4 meters ) rod fashioned of black oak , polished and twisted . Powers . In combat , the " staff " functioned as a " + 1 quarterstaff " . It had a number of charges that could be unleashed , to progressively deal additional injury , to age those it struck by ten years , and to cause a struck limb to become withered and useless . However , the ageing effect meant little to immortals and the undead , and creatures that gained power with age could benefit from the extra years . History . The extraplanar monster Imgig Zu once transported the fire elemental Jogaoh from his home plane to the world of Toril . Employing a Lockstone , Imgig then trapped the powerful elemental in the form of a weak dwarf , binding him to Toril , and furthermore used his " staff of withering " to drain the strength from Jogaoh ' s limbs . Nevertheless , Jogaoh was able to escape .

title: Stag - Horned Flagon
description: Stag - Horned Flagon The Stag - Horned Flagon tavern , the only only one located in Amphail , is run by Krivvin Shamblestar . The wood and stone bar is rather dark and cozy , whose clientele claims a wealth of Waterdhavian nobles . It is so named for the drinking cup , an unknown warrior ' s helmet with two antlers , which hangs over the bar .
description_long: Stag - Horned Flagon The Stag - Horned Flagon tavern , the only only one located in Amphail , is run by Krivvin Shamblestar . The wood and stone bar is rather dark and cozy , whose clientele claims a wealth of Waterdhavian nobles . It is so named for the drinking cup , an unknown warrior ' s helmet with two antlers , which hangs over the bar . The tavern enjoys an excellent reputation , in fact Mirt the Moneylender once called it a " Safe place to get blind drunk in . "

title: Stag King
description: Stag King The Stag King was a dark fey lord who ruled part of Ashenwood forest in Rashemen . The Stag King was thousands of years old . Many centuries ago he agreed to aid a tribe of elves in exchange for the right to mate with three elven maidens .
description_long: Stag King The Stag King was a dark fey lord who ruled part of Ashenwood forest in Rashemen . The Stag King was thousands of years old . Many centuries ago he agreed to aid a tribe of elves in exchange for the right to mate with three elven maidens . Over the generations , the Stag King ' s blood overpowered his descendent ' s elven blood and they began to resemble him . Years after he fathered his children , the Stag King returned and declared himself king of his mixed blood offspring . In 1479 DR , Zyl , one of the Stag King ' s servants , led the mercenary captain Aoth Fezim to his stronghold . Aoth was able to convince the Stag King to join with the Rashemi berserkers to attack the Durthan stronghold of the Fortress of the Half - Demon . During the battle , the Stag King held his warriors back and let the berserkers lead the assault although once his fey entered the battle , they were quite effective . The Durthans and their allies were driven into the tunnels below the fortress and the Stag King and allies were forced to enter the catacombs to finish off the Durthans .

title: Stag Skull Bridge
description: Stag Skull Bridge The Stag Skull Bridge was a bridge spanning the Thunder River in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . It led the way north out of town into the Hullack Forest . Defenses .
description_long: Stag Skull Bridge The Stag Skull Bridge was a bridge spanning the Thunder River in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . It led the way north out of town into the Hullack Forest . Defenses . Eight Purple Dragons — veteran monster slayers all — were stationed on the Stag Skull Bridge at all times , guarding the way from the Hullack Forest . Activities . The bridge gained some notoriety for the number of foresters and adventurers that came running out of the Hullack Forest with monsters hot on their tails . The Purple Dragons would let these folk pass safely before engaging the monsters on the bridge , and so virtually every Dragon on duty here was a veteran monster slayer . Description . It was a grandly built old stone bridge . From dusk to dawn , a lantern was kept burning on either side of the northern end of the bridge , to let adventurers and foresters know which way to flee to safety . The local saying " between the Stag ' s lights " came to refer to being " almost out of danger " .

title: Stag at Bay
description: Stag at Bay The Stag at Bay was a tavern located near the Silver Moon Gate within Everlund . Patronage . The Stag tended to the needs of hunters and travelers of the region , as it provided them with a meeting area where they could boast about their adventures in the Savage Frontier .
description_long: Stag at Bay The Stag at Bay was a tavern located near the Silver Moon Gate within Everlund . Patronage . The Stag tended to the needs of hunters and travelers of the region , as it provided them with a meeting area where they could boast about their adventures in the Savage Frontier . History . The tavern was named after the tapestry of an elven hunt that hung on the wall .

title: Stagsmere
description: Stagsmere Stagsmere was a manor house near Waterdeep , located nine miles east of Rassalantar . By 1374 DR , the manor was ruined . Structure .
description_long: Stagsmere Stagsmere was a manor house near Waterdeep , located nine miles east of Rassalantar . By 1374 DR , the manor was ruined . Structure . The manor consisted of a central three - storey building with east and west wings , both two storeys each . By 1374 DR the upper storey of the west wing had mostly collapsed to rubble . The roof was edged with battlements , and a stone stag adorned each corner , in a rearing position . The style of architecture was similar to that of the Brossfeather villa in the North Ward of Waterdeep . A gravel path led up to the manor , and the entire rear porch was spanned by stone steps . The entry chamber was domed and had a marble floor with a large metal chandelier containing oil lamps . Large marble staircases led to the upper floor on both sides of this room .

title: Stagwick
description: Stagwick Stagwick was a village in Hartsvale , notable for being the home of Tavis Burdun . Description . Stagwick was a small settlement with narrow streets and huts .
description_long: Stagwick Stagwick was a village in Hartsvale , notable for being the home of Tavis Burdun . Description . Stagwick was a small settlement with narrow streets and huts . Geography . The village was the eastern connection of Coggin ' s Rise , which ran west to the Clear Whirl River and Hartwick . Government . Stagwick was led by the Dobbin family . History . As of 1366 DR , the Dobbin family had ruled Stagwick for 35 generations , as detailed in the book " A Full History of the Dobbins of Stagwick " . On the day that Princess Brianna was abducted by Ice Spire ogre s , she had been attending a fire giant dance performance at the Weary Giant in the village .

title: Stained glass golem
description: Stained glass golem The stained glass windows of a temple or stronghold does not only show of the wealth and grandeur of the group who lives there it might also be the hiding place of its hidden guardians . There constructed to blend in with the decor of the structure and most importantly to hide them from the eyes of unwanted visitors . Appearance .
description_long: Stained glass golem The stained glass windows of a temple or stronghold does not only show of the wealth and grandeur of the group who lives there it might also be the hiding place of its hidden guardians . There constructed to blend in with the decor of the structure and most importantly to hide them from the eyes of unwanted visitors . Appearance . The flat glass and thin two - dimensional beings that are stained glass golems are silent and never communicate . The only sound they make are the tinkling sound that ' s like delicate crystal wind chimes and as they move they flicker and twinkle as the light strikes them and breaks down in to its component hues . Combat . Stained Glass Golems attack by slashing with their " arms " , which are as sharp as broken glass . Construction . A Stained Glass Golem ' s Body is constructed from 50 pounds of glass shards and cost 10 , 000 gp to create . Assembling the body requires a good " glass making " crafter . The Creator must be powerful and be able to cast arcane spells . It drains the creator of experience and some spells : Limited wish , and Polymorph any object spells .

title: Stamkk
description: Stamkk Stamkk was a male bugbear who ran the kitchen in the Coliseum of Maerimydra for Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . A bugbear of some stature , Stamkk was armed with an array of cleavers and kitchen knives .
description_long: Stamkk Stamkk was a male bugbear who ran the kitchen in the Coliseum of Maerimydra for Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . A bugbear of some stature , Stamkk was armed with an array of cleavers and kitchen knives . Personality . Stamkk was an especially cowardly bugbear for his size , despite his outward appearance as a bully he was not above fleeing as soon as he felt threatened . Abilities . A passable chef , Stamkk could run a kitchen well enough to feed numerous fire giant s . Possessions . As the boss of a large kitchen , Stamkk had access to all manner of kitchen implements and utensils . Relationships . Stamkk was a brutal with the goblin s who helped him run his kitchen but conversely they would stick with the bugbear wherever he ran . History . In 1372 DR , the half - fiend fire giant Kurgoth Hellspawn invaded Maerimydra and made the Coliseum ( Maerimydra ) there his home . To feed his giant - sized appetite , Kurgoth conscripted Stamkk and a few goblin s to prepare meals for him .

title: Standing bear
description: Standing bear The standing bear was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bear . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .
description_long: Standing bear The standing bear was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bear . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers . Those who drank from it received the strength of a bear for three hours , but also developed a flushed appearance and an excitable mood . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " standing bear " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . For many years , the " standing bear " was in the possession of the Yio Dufong , a yakuza clan in T ' o na ' Chee . All the Yio Dufong would imbibe before a fight , and for this reason they were called the " bears " . However , the " standing bear " was later stolen and by 1357 DR had still not turned up .

title: Standing deer
description: Standing deer The standing deer was a magical chalice . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description .
description_long: Standing deer The standing deer was a magical chalice . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a deer and had a deep cup . Powers . The magic of the " standing deer " was invoked by filling it with rose petals . It could be used to cure blindness and to cast the shukenja spell " commune with lesser spirit " . Handling the chalice caused its glamor to rub off on the holder , improving their social status as with the spell " face " . History . As one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , the " standing deer " < nowiki > ' s < / nowiki > powers had most likely at one stage influenced the history of Koryo . However , it was later lost . In the mid – 14th century DR , King Wanang Sun led an expedition to recover three of the Wo - ha Ui - jung . He was successful , discovering the " sitting bull " , " sitting monkey " , and " standing deer " by 1357 DR .

title: Stannis Malveen
description: Stannis Malveen Stannis Malveen was an aquatic vampire in Selgaunt . Relationships . Stannis was the heir of the Malveen house .
description_long: Stannis Malveen Stannis Malveen was an aquatic vampire in Selgaunt . Relationships . Stannis was the heir of the Malveen house . History . Stannis was a dandy who enjoyed his wealthy life as heir to one of the wealthiest families of Selgaunt . However , everything changed in 1345 DR when Stannis and his mother , the sorceress Velanna Malveen , fled from Selgaunt after the former was discovered having had dealings with pirates . Their ship was destroyed at sea and Velanna was killed , but not before summoning the aid of some sort of aquatic vampire , who rescued and turned Stannis into one of its kind . Stannis went back to his family ' s estate with his new master . Here , however , Stannis ' s brother , Radu Malveen , despite his young age , easily slew the vampire master and Stannis decided to follow Radu ' s will . Under Radu ' s orders , Stannis remained hidden at the estate without contacting anyone until 1372 DR , when Stannis convinced Radu to plot the ruin of the Uskevren house . Personality . Always a dandy , the years of isolation made Stannis exaggerate this characteristic .

title: Stannoc
description: Stannoc Old Stannoc was a halfling in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Stannoc spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn .
description_long: Stannoc Old Stannoc was a halfling in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Stannoc spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn . He was a gambler and odds - maker , speculating on various aspects of adventurers ' Undermountain careers . He knew a lot about the dungeon , including some forgotten secrets . Personality . Stannoc was a very able judge of character and often with only a small conversation with an adventurer Stannoc understood if they would live or die in the dungeon .

title: Stannor Thistlehair
description: Stannor Thistlehair Stannor Thistlehair was a lightfoot halfling carpenter in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Stannor worked as a carpenter at Waelvur ' s Wagonworks .
description_long: Stannor Thistlehair Stannor Thistlehair was a lightfoot halfling carpenter in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Stannor worked as a carpenter at Waelvur ' s Wagonworks . History . In 1491 DR , Stannor noticed his boss Ilmeth Waelvur and some others sometimes disappear into a hidden tunnel .

title: Star Meadow Hall
description: Star Meadow Hall Star Meadow Hall is a tall white marble tower in the midst of the Star Meadow in Evereska , and is home of the Nihmedu family . Inside is airy and light , filled with smooth curves and softly glowing walls . A staircase swirls down from the upper floors into the foyer and leads into the lower house .
description_long: Star Meadow Hall Star Meadow Hall is a tall white marble tower in the midst of the Star Meadow in Evereska , and is home of the Nihmedu family . Inside is airy and light , filled with smooth curves and softly glowing walls . A staircase swirls down from the upper floors into the foyer and leads into the lower house . Along the walls sit benches of white marble and tables of translucent alabaster , often with a delicately embossed vase or ethereal statuette placed carefully on top . Towards the middle of the tower lies a circular great room , where the family takes its meals on the rare occasions when there are enough of them to fill it . Leading off it through a broad archway is the Contemplation , a tome - filled chamber , staring over the treetops through a theurglass window .

title: Star Mounts
description: Star Mounts The Star Mounts are an impressive and forbidding range of peaks , located in the center of the High Forest . Description . Some rumors told that , during the peaceful nights among the Star Mounts , strange flashing lights took place which would attract or send away dragon s and other flying creatures .
description_long: Star Mounts The Star Mounts are an impressive and forbidding range of peaks , located in the center of the High Forest . Description . Some rumors told that , during the peaceful nights among the Star Mounts , strange flashing lights took place which would attract or send away dragon s and other flying creatures . According to other rumors , the elves would have created mysterious crystals that constellated the mountains , while some sinister construct s emitted beams of light when they were exposed to the moonlight . Some lonely peaks had a sharp cusp shape , they stood on the mountains ' top . Many people thought that these protuberances were the dwellings of powerful wizard s and formidable sorcerer s . The aarakocra s built their nests on these peaks and the dragons found shelter in the caves next to the Star Mounts . History . The earliest recorded names for these mountains have been attributed to the elves of Earlann , who named them for the stars in the northern heavens .

title: Star Protective Services
description: Star Protective Services The Star Protective Services , formerly known as the Company of the Star , was a band of adventurers that was led by Zaranda Star before she became queen of Tethyr . The band gained notoriety for their combat teachings . History .
description_long: Star Protective Services The Star Protective Services , formerly known as the Company of the Star , was a band of adventurers that was led by Zaranda Star before she became queen of Tethyr . The band gained notoriety for their combat teachings . History . After they were arrested in Zazesspur by Baron Faneuil Hardisty in 1366 DR and subsequently escaped , the group lived with the peasants in the surrounding hills and dales , teaching many of the villages in northern and central Tethyr how to defend themselves against attacks from bandits . This caused some of the figures in power to interpret their actions as training an army .

title: Star Worm
description: Star Worm The Star Worm , also known as H ' Calos , is a unique creature that fell to Maztica in the city of Ixtzul in approximately 350 DR . The creature was originally encased in a metorite and was believed to be associated with the planet H ' Catha . Although the residents of Ixtzul claimed the Star Worm was their protector in order to intimidate other cities , in reality the worm was placed into a magical slumber to prevent it from devouring the city and the rest of Payit .
description_long: Star Worm The Star Worm , also known as H ' Calos , is a unique creature that fell to Maztica in the city of Ixtzul in approximately 350 DR . The creature was originally encased in a metorite and was believed to be associated with the planet H ' Catha . Although the residents of Ixtzul claimed the Star Worm was their protector in order to intimidate other cities , in reality the worm was placed into a magical slumber to prevent it from devouring the city and the rest of Payit . The last ruler of Ixtzul created a race of intelligent giant ants , the Bacar , to maintain the magical wards binding the Star Worm . Combat . The Star Worm is an excellent burrower and prefers to attack from beneath opponents and then swallow them whole . The sight of the Star Worm bursting through the ground will often cause opponents to flee in fear . Although the Star Worm has no spellcasting ability and lacks a dragon ' s special attacks , it ' s comparable in toughness to an adult dragon . Ecology . Although the Star Worm is slightly more intelligent than a typical animal it thinks about very little other than eating . Appearance .

title: Star diopside
description: Star diopside Star diopside was the form of , a durable gemstone . Description . Diopside was a hard , durable gemstone that was usually found in unattractive colors , such as very dark green or brown .
description_long: Star diopside Star diopside was the form of , a durable gemstone . Description . Diopside was a hard , durable gemstone that was usually found in unattractive colors , such as very dark green or brown . Occasionally , mountain - and streambed - pebbles would yield crystals of lighter shades of green that produced attractive semi - precious stones ( see dioptase ) . The most prized specimens of diopside exhibited four - or six - ray stars when cut and polished . A typical specimen had a base value of 100 gp . Powers . Star diopside had a very specific and unusual property of flashing repeatedly whenever it was within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of illusion / phantasm magic . It was thus in demand for decorating entryways to courtrooms , temples , and homes of the well - to - do .

title: Star elf
description: Star elf Star elves , or mithral elves or Ruar - tel - quessir as they used to be known , like sun elves have only recently ventured back into Faerûnian life . Long ago they retreated to the demiplanar realm of Sildëyuir , where they are currently under attack by an extraplanar threat . As a result , some are now returning to the Yuirwood .
description_long: Star elf Star elves , or mithral elves or Ruar - tel - quessir as they used to be known , like sun elves have only recently ventured back into Faerûnian life . Long ago they retreated to the demiplanar realm of Sildëyuir , where they are currently under attack by an extraplanar threat . As a result , some are now returning to the Yuirwood . Physical characteristics . Star elves look a lot like moon elves , with light skin and hair of gold , red , or silver . They have violet or gray eyes with occasional gold flecks in them . They are tall for elves , being about 5 1 / 2 to 6 ft tall , and have a slender build . They like to wear elaborate tunics but in neutral tones , so as to better remain unseen in the forest . They are strikingly handsome by human standards , even more so than other elves . Psychology . Aloof and cautious , star elves are unfamiliar with recent events in Faerûn and even other races . Isolated in the twilight realm of Sildëyuir , they had no contact with dwarves , gnome s , halfling s , and even human s , and they liked it that way .

title: Star metal
description: Star metal Star metal was the name in the Realms for a metallic . Description . Star metal was the leftover material from the impact of an object fallen from space .
description_long: Star metal Star metal was the name in the Realms for a metallic . Description . Star metal was the leftover material from the impact of an object fallen from space . It was extremely rare and in high demand because it could be forged with common metals to make durable weapons of great strength . When found , these stones were usually small , about thumb - sized , though ogre - head - sized pieces were known to have been discovered . In addition to weaponsmithing , tiny pieces were sometimes sliced and polished for inlay work . A typical price was 10 , 000 gp per pound ( 22 , 100 gp / kg ) . Powers . Alloyed with common metals , this material increased the strength , sharpness , flexibility , and durability of weapons , making them ideal for enchantment . Star metal was reputed to enhance the strength and duration of any enchantments placed on blades that included it , but it was difficult to prove such claims .

title: Star of Ojy - do
description: Star of Ojy - do A star of Ojy - do was a magical shuriken forged by Ojy of Golden in Koryo in Kara - Tur . Description . Two distinct versions of the " stars of Ojy - do " were recorded ; one three hooked blades around a circular center and the other had four blades joined at the center .
description_long: Star of Ojy - do A star of Ojy - do was a magical shuriken forged by Ojy of Golden in Koryo in Kara - Tur . Description . Two distinct versions of the " stars of Ojy - do " were recorded ; one three hooked blades around a circular center and the other had four blades joined at the center . Powers . These weapons were " + 1 shuriken " that inflicted freezing cold on their targets . History . When bandits besieged the village of Golden , the villagers were forced to defend themselves . The spiritual guide Ojy was pressed into work as a weaponsmith , though he knew little of metalworking . With every accurate strike of his hammer , he thanked his guiding spirits , and so the " stars of Ojy - do " were forged from the strength of his faith . They proved just as resilient . By 1372 DR , " stars of Ojy - do " circulated around the northwest Faerûn and the Sword Coast North .

title: Star rose quartz
description: Star rose quartz Star rose quartz was a smoky pink quartz which had an . Description . When cut cabochon , star rose quartz reflected or transmitted light in a star - like pattern .
description_long: Star rose quartz Star rose quartz was a smoky pink quartz which had an . Description . When cut cabochon , star rose quartz reflected or transmitted light in a star - like pattern . It was used as a centerpiece in modest jewelry , like pectorals and earrings , worn mainly by the matrons of long - established houses . A typical specimen had a base value of 50 gp . Powers . While carrying or wearing one of these stones , the star rose quartz had a chance to deflect a spell directed at the bearer . Because of this property , this semi - precious stone was an alternate spell component for all abjuration spells and any divine magic of the protection sphere that could use a material component that wasn ' t specially prepared for a particular spell .

title: Star ruby
description: Star ruby Star Ruby was a rare form of red corundum that exhibited . Description . Star rubies were more opaque than regular gem - quality rubies and had a reflective optical effect that highlighted a white six - pointed star on the surface of cabochon - cut stones .
description_long: Star ruby Star Ruby was a rare form of red corundum that exhibited . Description . Star rubies were more opaque than regular gem - quality rubies and had a reflective optical effect that highlighted a white six - pointed star on the surface of cabochon - cut stones . Other stars with even - numbered points were also possible . About one out of every one hundred rubies was a star ruby . A typical specimen had a base value of 5 , 000 gp or 1 , 000 gp depending on market conditions . Star rubies were considered sacred by followers of Callarduran Smoothhands , Corellon Larethian , Labelas Enoreth , and Shargaas — appropriate for sacrifice , or to be consecrated for use , or recognized as boons or omens when found . Powers . Star rubies shared all the properties of plain rubies plus some very unique healing abilities . This jewel could be used to create a superlative healing vapor that when inhaled delivered the combined effects of : The star ruby first had to be subjected to a " knock " spell and then " wraithform " had to be cast on it , creating a thick , red vapor . This remedy was known to work on mammalian creatures , but it was unknown how it affected non - mammals .

title: Star sapphire
description: Star sapphire Star Sapphire was a very rare form of sapphire that exhibited . Description . Asterism is a reflective optical effect that highlights a white six - pointed star on the surface of cabochon - cut stones .
